title: Adrien's cellphone
text:
Adrien's cellphone - Intro
is a smartphone owned by Adrien Agreste. His phone number is +33635124.
In "Ephemeral", after finding the truth about his father and mother, it becomes part of Ephemeral's akumatized object.

title: Adrien's cellphone
text:
Adrien's cellphone - Appearance
In the first five seasons, Adrien's cellphone was white with grayish edges. It had three white-gray cameras on the top, one camera on the bottom, and another on the back of the phone. The wallpaper was set to a photo of Adrien and Nino.
Starting from season 6, Adrien's cellphone has a black case. On the top side of the screen, it has a small round camera, and on the back, in the top left, it has four round cameras arranged in a square.

title: Adrien's cellphone
text:
Adrien's cellphone - Trivia
As seen in "Copycat", Adrien's phone number is +33635124.
As seen in "Gorizilla", Adrien's email is Adrien@Agreste.mode.
Adrien's contact list includes Vincent, Nino, his bodyguard, Nathalie, Gabriel, Kagami, and Chloé.
As seen in "Copycat", his home's phone number is saved as a contact on his cellphone.
Placide I.T.'s contact name is "G" which supposedly stands for "Gorilla" as Adrien has called his bodyguard in previous episodes.
Despite Adrien having Kagami's number, in "Ikari Gozen" and "Perfection" it is shown that Kagami doesn't have Adrien's number.
Given that in "Kung Food", Adrien came to Marinette's place after Alya called him so he could help translate, it's possible that he has Alya's number.
According to Marinette in "Copycat", the phone is "one of these super-expensive high-tech smartphones".
This is the first phone Marinette steals.
Adrien has a contact in his phone with no image named "Inconnu" which is the French word for "unknown". This is actually Alya.
Whenever Adrien transforms into Cat Noir or sneaks out of the house, he uses a piano app on his phone to make it seem like he's still at home playing the piano.

title: Adrien's cellphone
text:
Adrien's cellphone - Trivia
Despite his home background being a photo of him and Nino, in some episodes this differs. For example, in "Oblivio", it's a picture of a few houses by the Stade des Princes and several of Ladybug.
There is an Akuma alert on Adrien's cellphone as seen in "Miraculous New York".
Errors
In "Copycat", the phone's color changes from white to black throughout the episode.
Throughout later episodes, the phone is painted black.

title: Adrien's Double Life/Transcript
text:
Adrien's Double Life/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: Hey guys, I'm Adrien. In everyday life, I’m just a normal guy.
Alya: Nice scarf, Adrien!
Adrien: Well, almost. Because my father is Gabriel Agreste, a great world-renowned fashion designer. I sometimes model for him, posing for his advertising campaigns. I don't hate it, but I won't make a career out of it. Actually, I mostly do it to make my father happy. Ever since Mom disappeared, he hasn't been the same. So, I try to be there for him. On a day to day basis, his assistant Nathalie is really the one taking care of me.
Nathalie: Your schedule, Adrien.
Adrien: Thanks, Nathalie.
Adrien: She and the Gorilla. I call him that because he's huge and he never speaks, just like a gorilla! He drives me to all my activities. Between photoshoots, fencing, learning Chinese and piano, I don't have much time for myself. I don't even have time to enjoy my awesome room, or to invite my friends over to hang out.
That's why I'm so happy go to school and see my friends. Especially Nino, who I tell everything. Okay, fine, almost everything.

title: Adrien's Double Life/Transcript
text:
Adrien's Double Life/Transcript - Intro
The only thing I can't tell him is... that when I'm not Adrien, I'm Cat Noir, and I protect Paris from supervillains. This has really changed my life, because before, I couldn't even go to school because my father was too scared for me to leave the house!
My kwami's named Plagg. All he can think about is food, and it’s always stinky Camembert.
Plagg: Oh, the exhaustion! My poor aching body! I can’t move a muscle!
Adrien: He’s lazy, but thanks to him, I can turn into a superhero.
[ Transformation Sequence ]Adrien: Plagg, claws out! (Adrien transforms into Cat Noir)
Adrien: He just has to enter my Miraculous, the ring I'm always wearing, and bam! I transform! He’s also the one who gave me my superpower.
Cat Noir: Cataclysm!
Adrien: With it, I can destroy whatever I touch. But I can't get it wrong, because I only have 5 minutes after using it before I transform back. Then, Ladybug just needs to capture the villain's akuma...
Ladybug: No more evildoing for you, little akuma!
Adrien: And the day is saved! Being Cat Noir's awesome. I can finally do whatever I wanna do and say whatever comes to mind!
Cat Noir: What do you say we wrap this up?

title: Adrien's Double Life/Transcript
text:
Adrien's Double Life/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: Plus, I get to save Paris with Ladybug. In short, it's a great break from my life at home. When I’m Cat Noir, I really have a blast.
(His phone rings) Ah! This is to tell me that it's time for my Chinese lesson. The Gorilla must already be waiting for me. I better go! And who knows? I may have to save Paris again today! See you later!

title: Adam
text:
Adam - Intro
is a lacrosse player.
In the story "Replay" in "Miraculous Adventures", when Adam gets upset at his teammates and Adrien at a lacrosse game, he is akumatized by Hawk Moth into Replay, a time-controlling supervillain.

title: Adam
text:
Adam - Appearance
Physical appearance
Adam is an average height with tan skin, brown eyes, and brown hair with bangs brushed towards one side of his face.
Civilian attire
Adam wears green-tinted protective glasses and a blue jersey t-shirt with white lining, two white stripes around each sleeve, and a white 77 printed on the front. He also wears gray protective upper arm gear underneath his shirt, blue gloves, white jersey shorts with blue edges and two blue stripes around each sleeve, and white socks and sports shoes. He also has a watch on his left arm.
As Replay
Replay has pale blue skin and gray eyes. He wears a blue and yellow helmet that covers his entire head with a clear visor over his eyes, a triangular white section on the front, yellow fast-forward icon designs on the sides, and a red and yellow oval in the white section. He has his white shorts and lacrosse jersey, the latter turned into a sleeveless tank top, and he has blue gloves with yellow trimming that cover him up to his elbows. The watch is in the same place and over his glove.

title: Adam
text:
Adam - Personality
As Adam
Adam is dedicated to playing lacrosse, but he is also hot-tempered and quick to get frustrated with others. Easily upset, Adam strikes Adrien with his lacrosse stick after his team makes fun of him for missing a play. Additionally, Adam feels strongly about being respected, as he proclaims that it "is not fair" that his team teased him for his lacrosse skills despite Adam trying his best. However, after his akumatization and back at the game, Adam shows good sportsmanship, apologizing to Adrien and telling him "good game" even though his own team lost.
As Replay
Replay is proud, determined, and vengeful to those who bother him or offended him in his eyes. He finds amusement and power in being able to control others with his watch, but he also loses his temper easily at people who miss his watch's beams and undermine him. On occasion, Replay gets intimidated, surprised and nervous by Adrien's lacrosse joining up with him when he is about to attack Adrien.

title: Adam
text:
Adam - Abilities
As a civilian
Adam is skilled at playing lacrosse.
As Replay
Replay possesses the power to alter the flow of time on objects and living beings around him using his stopwatch. By Replay pressing buttons on his watch, the watch shoots a yellow beam of light that can pause an object, rewind its actions, or fast forward its actions. For example, he uses the watch to pause and rewind Chloé when she confronts him, reversing her movements and forcing her back to her place.
However, the beam can be deflected using a mirror, and if the beam hits Replay, it has the same effect on him as it would have for his target.

title: Adam
text:
Adam - Relationships
Adrien Agreste/Cat Noir
Adam greatly dislikes Adrien, placing some of the blame on him after he gets scolded by his team and given a five minute penalty. While being Replay, he attempts to get revenge on Adrien by rewinding a winning shot, but Adrien's team coming to his defense prevents Replay from fighting him. After being reverted back to normal and returning to the game, he treats Adrien kindly, apologizing for his past behavior and shaking hands with him to congratulate Adrien and his team's victory.
While being Replay, he despises Cat Noir and finds his antics annoying, wanting to pause Cat Noir's lips to make him stop talking.

title: Action
text:
Action - Intro
"" is a season 5 special episode of the series Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir made with the participation of the Breteau Foundation to raise awareness of plastic waste pollution.
The special was released on MyTF1 MAX, Disney+, Netflix and for free on the Breteau Foundation's website along with free educational resources and lesson plans for primary teachers.

title: Action
text:
Action - Synopsis
Marinette (Ladybug), Adrien (Cat Noir), and their friends want to actively fight plastic pollution in Paris. The adventure leads Marinette to realize that the group should try to fix the problem at its root, by trying to meet with the largest plastic manufacturer in person and convince him to change his habits — but supervillain Monarch has other plans.
Disney+
Ladybug and Cat Noir face the King of Plastic.
Netflix
As the gang helps clear the Seine of trash, a powerful industrialist gets akumatized into a villain who can turn everything he touches into plastic.

title: Action
text:
Action - Plot
The episode starts with Marinette and Adrien arriving at the Liberty. Nino informs them of the plastic situation as their friends have noticed a lot of plastic polluting the Seine and that they have been removing it from it as it leads to the ocean. He shows Adrien and Marinette that the houseboat is now an eco-friendly water plant and can receive the plastic that is in the river. Nino then goes on about how plastic is bad as it does not decompose as all of the plastic used has ended up in the environment and will remain in some way as Nino states that the problem has worsened.

title: Action
text:
Action - Plot
In the engine room, Anarka along with Juleka and Ivan with tools are fixing the engine because if they do not, the Liberty will sink along with Marinette and her friends. Markov announces that there is a dramatic increase in the amount of plastic waste fallen in the Seine. It is revealed that he source of their problem is Bertrand King, a plastic magnate, who has been marketing Morpho Fans, fans made of plastic worldwide with the help of Gabriel Agreste's who designed the flags and André Bourgeois, who installed vending machines selling the fans due to the heatwave. Adrien apologizes as he was not aware that his image was in the advertisements for the fans.

title: Action
text:
Action - Plot
Suddenly, smoke comes out of the engine as Anarka decides the teenagers and her must abandon the houseboat before it sinks due to the excessive amount of plastic the ship has collected. Unfortunately, the plastic comes out of the houseboat and goes flying in the air. Nino tells Adrien that he must talk to his father about the Morpho Fans as they are a disaster. Adrien warns Nino that his father will not listen. Marinette comes up with another plan and wonders if the solution can be reached in another way by going to Bertrand himself.
At the bakery, the gang is there as Tom goes over the plastic products the bakery has and Mylène faints from what she is hearing. The guys go to one of Bertrand's employees as he is delivering the plastic to the Dupain-Cheng bakery. When asked by Marinette, the employee says Mr. Bertrand King is at "the top of the social ladder" and presses a button on a Bertrand statue as it points to the top of a nearby tall building as she gets an idea on how to get inside and talk to Mr. Bertrand King face-to-face.

title: Action
text:
Action - Plot
At the front of the building, Nino and his friends are in disguises as Max sees one of the nearby bodyguards walking over to them. The guard goes to Adrien who is with the kids and asks whether or not he is on the fans. Adrien says yes as Marinette convinces the bodyguard that Adrien is meeting Mr. Bertrand King to discuss new advertising campaigns and that the students are his cleaning and delivery people. The bodyguard is convinced by her story as he asks for Adrien's autograph on his fan.
Inside Mr. Bertrand King's office, the teenagers are doing a presentation with the help of Markov as Alya goes over the positives of plastic as it is cheap to produce, strong, light and is the reason why Bertrand and other companies make products out of them as well as medical advancements. Mylène then goes to the negatives such as the fact that too much of plastic is created and that most of the items are being used just once before it is thrown away including his fans. Adrien asks Bertrand to help end plastic pollution. She suggests that he could make his products so that they do break down eventually and that they are biodegradable as the friends end their presentation.

title: Action
text:
Action - Plot
Bertrand agrees, saying that people use plastic, throw them away and buy them again. The guys cheer, believing Bertrand has changed and will listen. But he says that is the point because people keep buying his products over and over again, he earns money from this and that is how his company runs. He goes over if nobody kept repeatedly buying his products, he would not be the King of Plastic and that nothing is going to change. He goes over that many of the things the friends have are plastic and says his plastic is going to remain forever. Outside, Marinette and her friends are disappointed that their plan to reduce the amount of plastic being made failed.
In City Hall, Marinette talks to Mayor Bourgeois about the vending machines as he says that the Parisians love the Morpho Fans and that the removing of the machines would damage his image, as her plan fails. In Gabriel's atelier, Adrien tells his father that plastic can even be found in his clothes and in the hand fans. His father tells Adrien that the fans are just there to keep his brand thriving and is just a trend until the heatwave ends as his plan also does not succeed.

title: Action
text:
Action - Plot
Marinette video chats with Adrien, saying his father did not listen to him at all. She sees Nadja Chamack's picture and it gives her an idea. Nadja tells Marinette she can't report Bertrand's practices because it is his money that lets the television channel thrive. Marinette states that it is essential that Paris knows about the pollution and that it's for the world Manon's will grow up. Nadja sadly leaves and apologizes to Marinette.
Back on the Liberty, without any success, the guys manage to send a global communication, explaining the problem and showing the terrible consequences of this pollution. Live on television, Fei, Aeon and Jessica also help as the friends explain how people in power haven't done anything to help. André Bourgeois announces on TV that he was completely unaware of this and uninstalls the vending machines for the Morpho Fans. Gabriel, however says he did not know his designing skills and talents were going to be used for a company that produces pollution. Marinette and her friends cheer as the anti-plastic revolution has begun and as she is hugged by Adrien.

title: Action
text:
Action - Plot
In his office, Bertrand confronts Gabriel about lying on television live on a video call as Bertrand sees his profit opportunities get away. Bertrand threatens to expose Gabriel but he is not afraid, telling Bertrand that nobody will believe anything he says. Gabriel hangs up on the call, leaving Bertrand furious that the people he trusted and who helped him with his company betrayed him and said they knew nothing about the pollution.
Using these feelings, Gabriel in his lair, transforms into Monarch, uses the power of the Horse Miraculous to send the megakuma he creates to Bertrand. Landing in his pen, Monarch akumatizes Bertrand into King of Plastic with the power of Submission from the Bee Miraculous, allowing him to turn anything or anyone he touches into plastic as well as immobilize them with his staff. He decides to use these new powers to seek revenge on those who turned their backs on him.

title: Action
text:
Action - Plot
In City Hall, King of Plastic finds Mayor Bourgeois who panics and runs away. However, he is trapped by King of Plastic who uses his new enhanced capabilities to jump in front of him and paralyzes André and turns him into plastic. King of Plastic walks out of City Hall and is faced with Officer Roger and the police force who try to stop him. He turns all of them into plastic statues as well as freezing them. Next, he swears to get revenge on Gabriel Agreste.
At Marinette's house, Adrien is teaching Marinette Mandarin. After mispronouncing a sentence, they both see King of Plastic jumping his way to the Agreste Mansion. Adrien runs off, transforming into Cat Noir as Marinette transforms into Ladybug. They meet up and notice King of Plastic making is way to the house of Gabriel Agreste. Placide I.T notices King of Plastic making is way in and tries to stop him. However, his efforts prove to be a failure as he is frozen and turned into plastic. Cat Noir's staff ends up being turned into plastic as they heroes try to stop him. King of Plastic makes his way to the Liberty.

title: Action
text:
Action - Plot
Freezing and turning Ivan and Mylène into plastic, Nino and the rest of his remaining friends run away from the King of Plastic. Ladybug saves Nino in the nick of time and Cat Noir battles him. Summoning her Lucky Charm, Ladybug receives a plastic bag. Realizing that the plastic bag is immune to King of Plastic's powers, she realizes that tons of plastic will be needed. Nearby, Alya gets Ladybug's plan. She goes and tells that the houseboat's treatment system will be needed to be running. Cat Noir cataclysms the engine as smoke and all of the collected plastic are released and is sent flying to the sky.

title: Action
text:
Action - Plot
Ladybug and Cat Noir manage to defeat him with the help of Nino's resistance by overwhelming him with the plastic they have collected as the plastic lands and buries King of Plastic on the top of the houseboat. Ladybug destroys King of Plastic's staff as the akuma is released. After purifying and uses her Lucky Charm, she reverses all of the damage caused. King of Plastic is deakumatized into Bertrand and realizes just how dirty he is by being under the pile of plastic and realizes that plastic may not be as good as he thought. Ladybug gives him the Magical Charm. After listening to Ladybug and Cat Noir, Bertrand makes his plastics from materials that do break down. Shortly afterwards, Bertrand accepts the anti-plastic movement of Marinette and her friends as the bakery uses more ecologically friendly materials as Bertrand wants to and with her help, will get the whole world involved.

title: Action
text:
Action - Plot Developments
This episode doesn't have a specific place in the timeline because it's a special made to raise awareness regarding plastic pollution by providing opportunities for children to become engaged in real world issues that transcend classroom walls. However, due to Kagami already being the female face of Gabriel, and André still being the mayor, it can be placed some time after "Revelation" and before "Collusion".

title: Action
text:
Action - Trivia
This episode shares its name with the concept of the Bee Miraculous.
This concept is applied when Marinette and her friends take action to get rid of plastic pollution all over the world.
The concept of action was also applied in other episodes:
Ever since "Stoneheart", Ladybug and Cat Noir have taken action to protect the Parisians from Hawk Moth/Shadow Moth/Monarch's threats.
Adrien took action upon himself to improve his life after his mother's passing while his father did heinous actions to get her back.
Starting from "Sapotis", Ladybug took desperate actions to recruit other Miraculous superheroes to aid her and Cat Noir against the akumatized villains.
In "Catalyst", Hawk Moth took great action to increase his superpowers thanks to the titular villain.
In "The Battle of the Miraculous", Chloé decided to take action against Ladybug for refusing to lend her the Bee Miraculous, by getting akumatized into Miracle Queen and seizing control over the Miraculous holders up to that point.
In "Mega Leech", Mylène and Ivan took action against Project Oxygen.
In "Hack-San", Marinette took the necessary actions to have the city protected in her absence.

title: Action
text:
Action - Trivia
In "Strikeback", Félix took a detrimental action by stealing almost all of the Miraculous for Monarch in order to seize the Peacock Miraculous.
In "Intuition", Monarch attempted many actions with the Snake Miraculous to try and seize Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous.
In "Confrontation", Sabrina took action by asking Marinette for help to expose Lila and Chloé's deception.
In "Representation", both the Agrestes and Graham de Vanilies couples took it upon themselves to use the Peacock Miraculous to make their families.
The concept can also refer to when people don't know, can't, don't or forced to do nothing such as when Bertrand King, André and Gabriel didn't take any course of action despite them all very much knowing the amount of pollution created by the Morpho Fans.
Adrien didn't tell his friends about his departure to London, but by not telling there was nothing they could do.
Nor when it came to his father and cousin, Adrien had no idea how hurt, angry and desperate they both really were because of their problems not to mention they didn't say anything either.

title: Action
text:
Action - Trivia
His family had the power to stop all their actions and own up to what they did but they refused and didn't care how their actions affected other people.
Until "Revolution", André didn't do anything to really discipline his daughter Chloé.
When it came to her problems, Ladybug was aware of the emptiness of her situation and being angry that she couldn't do nothing to stop her enemies from taking advantage of it.
In "Miraculous London", from Tikki's situation it's also likely she didn't reveal the knowledge of Gabriel's identity (to at least Marinette) not only to disturb the flow of time but not to act like Gabriel: trapping someone in a situation that's lousy.

Adoration - Intro
"" is a season 5 episode of the series Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. Based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 17th written and produced episode of season 5. It is also the 121st written and produced episode of the series overall.

title: Adoration
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Adoration - Synopsis
When Marinette and Zoé are chosen to organize the end-of-school-year party, Marinette learns that Zoé is secretly in love with someone in ninth grade at school. Zoé says that she cannot talk about it. To Marinette, this can only mean one thing: Zoé is in love with Adrien! But before she finds out whether she is right or not, a common enemy of the girls will try to ruin their beautiful friendship…
Disney+
Ladybug and Cat Noir face an invisible enemy.
Netflix
While planning the year-end dance, Marinette discovers that Zoé is in love and worries it might be with Adrien. Lila and Chloe scheme to frame Marinette.

title: Adoration
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Adoration - Plot
The episode starts with Zoé and her stepfather, Mayor Bourgeois on the top of the hotel looking at his 'dream depository'. They are looking at some of the movie related items. Mayor Bourgeois shows Zoé a movie script he wrote and reveals he changed his name for his wife. Audrey Bourgeois calls out for the mayor, asking for a foot massage and tells Zoé never to give up on her dreams as he rushes to his wife. Zoé is staring at a framed picture of the person she is in love with.
In the library at school, Mr. Damoclès reminds some of the students that it is almost the end of the school year which means it is almost time for the dance for the end of the year. Zoé and Marinette are elected as representatives to organize the dance.

title: Adoration
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Adoration - Plot
In Marinette's room, as Zoé walks into her room, Marinette introduces her to it and shows her around and sees one of Marinette's sketches. Marinette accidentally shows Zoé photos of Adrien and other pictures related to his modelling career. She shows Zoé the exterior of her bedroom and uses a pair binoculars and looks around in them. She then decides the dance should take place at the Eiffel Tower. Marinette suggests that Zoé could ask her father if the Eiffel could be used for the end-of-year dance. They go together to the hotel to ask him.

title: Adoration

text:
Adoration - Plot
They arrive at the hotel and Zoé reassures Marinette she has learned to tolerate with Chloé's bad behavior. Zoé greets and talks to some of the staff there. Chloé and Sabrina notice them and tell them Marinette is not welcome. Suddenly, Armand distracts Chloé by using Mr. Cuddly. She calls for her father to check the cameras and see if Marinette has stepped foot on the carpet. Mayor Bourgeois arrives and uses the computer updating as an excuse for the cameras not working. Suddenly, Audrey walks in and when Chloé complains about her half-sister, she does not show any care about her issue and gets her confused with Zoé. Marinette is impressed with how Zoé stood up to Chloé and thanks Marinette for helping her change. Zoé asks her father if there is a way for the party for the end of the year to be held at the Eiffel Tower as Chloé and Sabrina eavesdrop, the mayor authorizes the plan.

title: Adoration

text:
Adoration - Plot
Meanwhile, at the Agreste mansion, Gabriel has made raclette, saying he has decided to make Adrien's wishes come true as Adrien thanks him. When Adrien asks his father for permission to go to the dance with Marinette, Nathalie steps in and reminds Gabriel he has decided to make his son's dreams come true. He allows it as Adrien thanks him once again.
Meanwhile, at the hotel, Lila is putting on makeup as Gabriel video calls her, reminding her that she is to protect Adrien from Marinette. Lila reassures him and tells him a plan is formed to resolve the issue permanently as the call ends. She walks in to where Sabrina and Chloé are. Lila tells her that Zoé is not the problem but instead Marinette as she is being a bad influence for Zoé. Lila tells Chloé she has a plan to get rid of Marinette for good but in order for the plan to work, Chloé and Sabrina must be in it.

title: Adoration

text:

As Zoé and Marinette enter Zoé's room, Marinette is excited about the dance at the Eiffel Tower. She spots the framed photograph of the person she is in love with and quickly hides it. Sabrina becomes worried and refuses as the plan is going against anything what she stands for as she is demoted to underling. Sabrina becomes miserable as Chloé shows Sabrina her whistle and throws it and runs off into tears. Lila tells Chloé all they have to do now is wait as Sabrina  puts on her whistle and cries.
Meanwhile in his lair, Monarch senses Sabrina's strong emotion of sadness and creates a megakuma. He absorbs Kaalki into his ring and teleports the megakuma to Sabrina. The megakuma infects the whistle and transfers the power of the Miraculous of the Dog as Miss Hound's Fetch, to her Alliance ring. Sabrina gets akumatized into Vanisher as Lila tells Chloé, Vanisher is a good underling. Vanisher touches Chloé's phone with her whistle and blows it, making the phone in her hands.

title: Adoration

In Zoé's room, Marinette shows her her sketch for a dress. Marinette tells Zoé that telling Adrien how she feels is difficult as Zoé tells her she can relate to that situation. Vanisher enters the room without them noticing. Marinette calls Alya about the plans and is impressed and tells her about Zoé's crush. Marinette panics when she sees Zoé talking to the holographic Adrien on her Alliance ring and thinks Zoé may be in love with Adrien and they meet about as they drive away on Marinette's scooter to the florist as Vanisher follows them from behind.

title: Adoration

text:
Adoration - Plot
Vanisher touches the flowers, a spray can, napkins, baker peels, a tablecloth, cymbals, a guitar with her whistle. Zoé and Marinette are at the Eiffel Tower, waiting for the rest of the students to show up. Vanisher and Chloé are secretly hidden there and Vanisher blows her whistle, making everything she has touched with her whistle come to her and puts the items in Marinette's bag as Tikki watches. Chloé appears from behind and accuses Marinette of taking her phone. She opens Marinette's bag as the items Vanisher has touched with her whistle fall out and everyone watches as Tikki flies away. Chloé pretends as though Marinette stole the items for the party to make her dress and shows them a sketch of the book. The flowers fly in the wind as Marinette sees some of the flowers on Vanisher's invisible body. Mr Damoclès expels her from school as her parents cry. Zoé takes the blame instead, not wanting Marinette to suffer.

Marinette sneaks away and Tikki tells Marinette what she saw and knows Vanisher was behind all of this. Marinette transforms into Ladybug. Ladybug informs Cat Noir of the situation and uses her Lucky Charm and receives a pinata. She tells the people who saw what just happened it was the work of Vanisher and tries to hit her with her yo-yo but Vanisher dodges. Everyone runs away as Adrien runs in a different direction and transforms into Cat Noir. Ladybug and Vanisher continue to fight each other as Cat Noir arrives and Ladybug's Lucky Vision tells her how to defeat Vanisher.

title: Adoration

text:

Ladybug breaks apart the pinata and Cat Noir sprays her, giving Ladybug and Cat Noir an idea of where Vanisher is. She blows her whistle and makes the guitar appear and Ladybug knows where the megakuma went. She grabs the whistle and throws it to Cat Noir who uses his cataclysm on it. The megakuma is purified by Ladybug uses her Lucky Charm to repair the damage and return everything to where it is supposed to be as Vanisher is deakumatized back into Sabrina. Chloé scolds her as Ladybug gives her her magical charm. Ladybug tells the crowd of people that Marinette was framed thanks to Chloé and Vanisher. Everyone is staring at Chloé, looking angry as her father looks disappointed, she walks away furious. Ladybug and Cat Noir fly off to detransform.  Mayor Bourgeois looks at Zoé, admiring her bravery to stand up for Marinette and for taking the blame.

title: Adoration

text:

Marinette thanks Zoé for her actions and encourages her to tell her crush her feelings. Marinette is shocked to find out that Zoé is in love with her and encourages Marinette to do the same. A picture of Gabriel comes into Adrien's mind, disallowing him. Adrien feels strange and advises Marinette to go home as he apologizes and walks back to the mansion. Gabriel is watching everything from window and sees Marinette walking home and walks into the darkness. Lying in her bed, Marinette is praised by Tikki for telling Adrien how she feels happy and brave as the episode ends.

text:
Adoration - Plot Development
More about the superpower of the Dog Miraculous is revealed.
It's revealed that, in its full capability (like when used by an adult), Fetch can be used to mark multiple objects at the same time and then the user can summon them as they please, being it summoning them one by one or multiple objects at the same time.
According to Principal Damoclès, as of this episode, there are left two weeks for the last day of school before summer break. Having in consideration that the last day of school falls on Bastille Day (a French holiday that happens on July 14th), which happens on "Revolution", the events on this episode happens at the very end of June, possibly the 30th.
Lila continues to use her "friendship" with Chloé to better ruin Marinette's life and keep her away from Adrien. This time, she serves of Chloé to make Sabrina be akumatized so they can blame Marinette of stealing things to make her dress.
This is the last episode where Chloé tries/attempts to send/exile Zoé back to New York, but in "Revolution", she was forced to leave Paris with her mother.

title: Adoration
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Adoration - Trivia
The episode shares its name with the concept of the Dog Miraculous.
Besides the use of the superpower Fetch, we see people showing their adoration for others:
Some people are shown expressing their adoration in a selfless way.
Like in "Collusion", when Mayor Bourgeois mentioned how much citizens of Paris adored Ladybug and Cat Noir.
Zoé expresses her adoration for Marinette by supporting the latter's crush over Adrien (despite her own feelings for her) and taking the blame for all the accusations Chloé places on Marinette for stealing.
Marinette was willing to risk Adrien's love for her by letting Zoé declare her supposed love for him out of adoration for their friendship.
While others are shown expressing their adoration in an obsessive way.
André Bourgeois shows his obsessive adoration for Audrey by doing everything she wants. That also included changing his own name.
Sabrina expresses her adoration for Chloé by doing whatever she demands, even if that goes against what she believes in, like stealing.
Plagg's adoration for cheese causing trouble in "Rogercop" and "Kwamibuster".
As well as those are shown expressing their adoration in a dreamy/openly way.

Due to his former modelling, Adrien was adored by many fans.
The Dog Miraculous represents a person's loyalty, how they change or diminish over time, nor be abused, let alone take advantage of it, how it can be blinding.
Sabrina Raincomprix as the current Dog Miraculous holder, Miss Hound, she was extremely loyal to Chloé, with notable examples being "The Evillustrator", "Miraculer", "Penalteam" and this episode, until her cruelty became too much and gave it to someone else who deserved it more such as Marinette and Ladybug.
Her loyalty towards Chloé diminished starting from "Perfection" and "Confrontation".
Alya's and Cat Noir's deep loyalty to Marinette and Ladybug, Nathalie's to Gabriel and Sabrina's to Chloé.
How Chloé's obsession over Ladybug diminished starting in "Miraculer" and finally concluded in "The Battle of the Miraculous", when Ladybug constantly avoided giving her back the Bee Miraculous in spite of Chloé being warned the dangers of her using it again.

This episode reveals interesting things about Zoé:

text:

As she has a crush on Marinette, possibly coming from their first encounter back in "Sole Crusher", as the latter was the first person in Paris to show any kindness to her. However, because Marinette is in love with Adrien, Zoé, up until this episode, never dared to confess her feelings for her. Until the episode's end, she finally lets Marinette learn about her feelings.
This confirms that Zoé is sapphic, marking the fourth appearance of an LGBTQ+ romance in the show, after Nathaniel and Marc, Juleka and Rose, and Barbara Keynes and Olympia Hill.
This also makes Zoé the tenth LGBTQ+ character overall.
She has formed a good relationship with the staff of the hotel, knowing their names and treating them with respect, something that they return by covering for her whenever they can from Chloé, together with mayor Bourgeois.
It's shown that, while Marinette and her class are on ninth grade, Zoé and her class are on eighth grade, meaning that Zoé, Marc, Aurore Beauréal and Mireille Caquet are possibly a year younger than the students in Marinette's class, including herself.
That also confirms that Zoé is younger than Chloé.

text:
Adoration - Trivia
It's revealed that Butler Jean's name is Armand and the unnamed maid's name is Sophie.
It's revealed that mayor Bourgeois's first name, André, is not his actual name, but rather one that he took when marrying Audrey.
He was originally called Anaximandre, which also ends in "-andre".
This is the second time Lila frames Marinette for stealing following "Ladybug".
And this is the third time overall where Marinette was accused of stealing something following "Rogercop" and "Ladybug".
Like the same episode, the person who is being accused is innocent (both Marinette and Zoé).
This is the second time Marinette almost gets expelled from school.
References
Sabrina is the third character who received the power of her own Miraculous through her alliance ring in an akumatized form, following Kagami in "Perfection" and Kim in "Derision".
This is the fourth overall time Sabrina gets akumatized following "Antibug", "Catalyst" and "Miraculer".
This is the third time she was akumatized into Vanisher, and the first time Vanisher is the main villain of an episode.
This episode shares resemblances to "Malediktator" and "Gang of Secrets":

title: Adoration
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Adoration - Trivia
Both Chloé and Marinette pushed those that were close to them away or ended their friendship for one reason another.
In "Gang of Secrets", Marinette pushed her friends away out of stress and desire to protect while Chloe, similar to "Malediktator," did it out of selfishness and not being able to get what she wanted.
Because of their actions, it led to the akumatizations of both villains.
Unlike Chloe in the titular episode but in "Malediktator" and Marinette in "Gang of Secrets", both felt remorse for causing their loved ones akumatizations.
All the villains wanted something pure and simple back but they went the wrong way about it.
Chloé trying to expel Marinette during the end of the school year is similar to her getting Socqueline suspended for the last 2 weeks of school in "Derision".
Unlike Socqueline, both Marinette and Zoé managed to avoid being kicked out of school for the remainder of the school year.
This is the ninth time where a Lucky Charm object breaks (excluding the broken plate in "Troublemaker") followed by "Robostus", "Weredad", "Miraculer", "Psycomedian", "Hack-San", "Miraculous Paris", "Derision" and "Protection".

title: Adoration
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Adoration - Trivia
This is the fourth time where Ladybug breaks the Lucky Charm object herself, following "Miraculer", "Psycomedian" and "Derision".
This is the nineteenth time where Adrien is a minor character in the permanent timeline following "Intuition", "Destruction", "Penalteam", "Ephemeral", "Dearest Family", "Qilin", "Sentibubbler", "Optigami", "Crocoduel", "Guiltrip", "Sole Crusher", "Furious Fu", "Mr. Pigeon 72", "Gang of Secrets", "Truth", "Cat Blanc", "Silencer" and "Style Queen".
If the webisodes were counted, this would be the forty-first.
Errors
Despite the fact that André was named "Anaximandre" during his cinema career, the movie script he shows has both "Anaximandre" and "André Bourgeois" at the same time.
When Marinette takes Zoé to her room after they were selected to organize the end-of-the-year party, the former says the latter had never been there, which is untrue, as Zoé is seen in Marinette's room in "Gabriel Agreste".

title: Adoration
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Adoration - Trivia
However, having in consideration Zoé was not originally at Marinette's room at the beginning of their plan, but at the Le Grand Paris (as her role in the plan was to keep Armand away from the party), it's possible that Zoé's presence at Marinette's room in "Gabriel Agreste" is a mistake of that episode.
When Chloé throws Sabrina's whistle, it becomes black for a second.
When Lila and Chloé set up Sabrina for akumatization, Sabrina's Alliance ring is black.
When Monarch akumatizes Sabrina, his voice isn't deep like it usually is, instead being like Gabriel's civilian voice.
In the Brazilian Portuguese dub, Zoé refers to the florist as a "he", but a feminine-looking florist is seen later. This could be explained by the florist identifying as a male, although there is no other evidence of this.
When Monarch touches Barkk's cage to transfer her power to Vanisher, he touches it with his right hand despite the Dog Miraculous ring being on his left hand.
The central part of Mr. Damoclès' beard moves unnaturally back and forth during the scene at the library.
While Lila counts down before Vanisher first shows up, her chin is noticeably bigger and her face is deformed.

title: Adoration/Transcript
text:
Adoration/Transcript - Intro
[ Theme Song ]
Andre: Are you sure, Zoé? (Zoé holds a picture frame oh-so dearly.) Look, back then, I wrote an entire movie to declare my love to her. Admittedly, the script was a bit long, but... that was only because I had so much love for my sweet Audrey! (shows Zoé his manuscript for the movie "Solitude")
Zoé: "Written by... Anaximandre"?
Andre: Uhm— Well... I changed my name in the name of love! In fact, I changed my life for love—
Audrey: (off-screen) Andre!!! Come and give me a foot massage! Where on earth is he??
Andre: Never bury your dreams, Zoé. You have two whole weeks left before the end of the school year to tell whoever it is you're in love with exactly how you feel!
Audrey: Andre???
Andre: Audrey, darling! Sorry to keep you waiting! I'm coming! (dashes away)
(Upon Andre's departure, Zoé keeps her lovesick eyes on the picture frame.)
Denis Damoclès: As you know, it's almost the end of the school year, which means it's almost time for our end-of-the-year dance! That's why we ask you to select the class representatives who will organize the event. Let me remind you that traditionally reps should be one 8th grade student and one 9th grade student.

title: Adoration/Transcript
text:
Adoration/Transcript - Intro
Marc: The eighth graders elected Zoé Lee, Mr. Damoclès.
Alya: And Marinette Dupain-Cheng has been elected to represent the ninth graders.
(Zoé smiles cheek-to-cheek at Marinette.)
Denis Damoclès: Well, perfect, then! We'll meet with you both tonight to find out what you've planned. Surprise us!
Marinette: We're going to make a great team! Wait 'til you hear my ideas— (turns around to look at Zoé, who seems to have stopped moving) You okay, Zoé?
Zoé: (wide-eyed) Your room is... beautiful!!
Marinette: Oh! Silly me. You've never been here before. Let me show you around! (pulls Zoé with her) This is my chaise lounge. I made it myself from salvaged parts. (opens her chest which happens to have tons of photos of Adrien inside and her gifts for his future birthdays) That's my storage chest— IT needs some tidying up. (holds her mannequin) My mannequin for working on my fashion designs, (scurries to her computer table) my desk, where I do my homework... and now, my most important spot: my creative workshop — with my sewing machine, threads, fabrics...
Zoé: (takes a look at Marinette's notebook) Woah... that's gorgeous!

title: Adoration/Transcript
text:
Adoration/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (chuckles) Thanks! It's just 	a sketch, of course. That's the dress I'd like to make for the dance. Well, I still have to get all the necessary pieces, but I hope I'll have time and... (accidentally pulls her "Adrien" drop down board) WAH! Oops, sorry! That's kind of dangerous and useless anyhow. I should just get rid of it already. I'm past all those "crazy" plans to try and talk to Adrien anyhow. (retracts her "Adrien" drop down board) Come on! Let's head to the patio!
(On the balcony, Zoé and Marinette go sightseeing with a pair of binoculars.)
Marinette: Outdoors at the Trocadero?
Zoé: Under the vault of the Grand Palais?
Marinette: (gasps) The Eiffel Tower! It's the perfect place! (starts sketching on her sketchbook) That's where we should have our first kiss! It has to be exceptional, magical, miraculous— (gasps) I know, I need to learn how to say "I love you" first. I'm good at dreaming about it, but when it comes to actually doing something? It's almost impossible. Although... you could help me!
Zoé: Help you with what?

title: Adoration/Transcript
text:
Adoration/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: I was thinking we could ask your stepfather about using the Eiffel Tower for the dance. But... maybe you don't want to bother him with that.
Zoé: No, totally the opposite! Let's go talk to Anaximandre!
Marinette: Um... who?
Zoé: I mean, let's go talk to my stepdad, the Mayor of Paris!
Marinette: I just realized that if your "lovely" half-sister sees us together, she'll make your life a living nightmare!
Zoé: Chloé doesn't have that power anymore!
(Zoé and Marinette proceed inside.)
Zoé: Hello, Armand! So, did Justine like the movie yesterday?
Armand: Hello, Zoé! Justine loved it so much that it's all she talks about now.
Zoé: Awesome! (to a maid) Hello, Sophie!
Sophie: Hello, Zoé! How are you doing?
Chloé: (to Zoé) What gives you the right to bring the baker girl into my house??
Zoé: This isn't your house, Chloé. It's ours.
Chloé: I only tolerate your presence as long as you stick to my rules! And right now, Dupain-Cheng has set foot on the first step of my stairs!
Armand: (dashes to Chloé to give her Mr. Cuddly) Your Mr. Cuddly, mademoiselle. I washed it with a new fabric softener. Lavender scented. I hope you like—

title: Adoration/Transcript
text:
Adoration/Transcript - Intro
Chloé: I don't care (throws Mr. Cuddly on the floor) about your lavender, Jean-Benoît!
Zoé: The butler's name is Armand, not Jean-Benoît. As for Marinette, she hasn't stepped foot on your stairs.
(Scene shows Marinette's feet that are inches away from the first step of the stairs.)
Chloé: I saw it! I know I did! We'll check the hotel's security cameras. DADDY!!
Andre: Oh, I'm sorry, sweetie. We're in the middle of a computer update, and the last five minutes weren't recorded because the cameras were off...
(Zoé gives Chloé a triumphant look, who is now very furious. Seeing Audrey walking down the stairs, Chloé takes an opportunity to seek help.)
Chloé: Moooom! My half-of-a-sister has allowed the baker girl to walk up MY stairs!!
(Audrey seems to be unbothered.)
Audrey: Since when do you need me to torment your sister, Zoé?
Chloé: But... I'm not Zoé. It's me, Chloé!
Audrey: Yes, well, Chloé, Zoé, who cares? Stop confusing me or I'll send you both back to New York! As for the stairs, they're MINE, so shoo, both of you! (to Andre) Gold, diamond and platinum!
Andre: (gives a credit card to Audrey) Here you are, my darling, Audrey!

title: Adoration/Transcript
text:
Adoration/Transcript - Intro
Zoé: Chloé, I believe you're still on the stairs, and if you've been listening to our mother, that's no longer allowed. Unless you want to go back to New York with me?
Chloé: (growls) I'll make you pay for every one of these steps!
Zoé: (deadpan sarcastic) Sure, Chloé, of course, you will. In the meantime, have a nice day.
Chloé: Don't you dare go ANYWHERE near my room!!
(Sabrina picks up Mr. Cuddly and follows Chloé from behind.)
Marinette: Wow...! What happened to the scared Zoe who moved here from New York a few months ago?
Zoé: It's all thanks to you, Marinette. You're the one who helped me change!
(As Zoé and Marinette proceed to talk to Andre, Chloé and Sabrina are still seen eavesdropping at the two.)
Zoé: Andre, I have a question for you, or rather for the Mayor of Paris.
Andre: (brings out his portrait) The Mayor of Paris is listening to you, my dear Zoé!
Zoé: Marinette and I have been selected to plan for the end-of-the-year dance at school, and we were wondering if there is any way we can have it on the Eiffel Tower!

title: Adoration/Transcript
text:
Adoration/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (holds up her sketch book containing the sketches of her plan) There'll be a concert, then a DJ set, a buffet, and for those who don't like to dance, a trampoline stretched between the four pillars of the tower!
Andre: Interesting! (a montage of Andre as a cinematographer flashes on the background as he gets carried away) We could also film the evening, and the images would be projected in real time on a giant screen. A film within the film about the film of the party, because cinema is life and life is cinema... (montage ends) and if someone needed to proclaim their love for somebody else, this would be the perfect place and time for it... (clears throat) Well, by the power vested in me, the city of Paris authorizes to hold this party on the Eiffel Tower. (gives the sketchbook back to Marinette)
Marinette: (takes her sketchbook from Andre) Thank you, Mr. Mayor!
Andre: And by the way, if Chloé comes asking questions, (whispers) we never had this conversation.
Zoé: You got it, Anax!
(Chloe, still hiding to eavesdrop between the three of them, growls furiously.)
Nathalie: Raclette?

title: Adoration/Transcript
text:
Adoration/Transcript - Intro
Gabriel: Yes, Nathalie. Adrien told me that he would enjoy this, (places a pot of potatoes on the griddle) and I've decided to make all my son's dreams come true.
Adrien: Thanks, Dad!
Gabriel: Would you like some salami, Nathalie? (offers Nathalie a plate with salami, only to be greeted by a doubtful face)
Adrien: Dad, could I go to the school dance with Marinette?
Gabriel: Dance...? (with a sudden change of mood, he places the plate back on the table) Adrien, you're an Agreste — too exceptional for–
Adrien: Marinette is exceptional, too!
Gabriel: (sternly) Adrien, I'm your father, and I order you to give up on this idea.
(Adrien, with nothing to reply, simply looks down...)
Nathalie: Didn't you want to make all your son's dreams come true?
(...but Nathalie is able to use his word against Gabriel, to Nathalie's content, who is then seen smirking at the surrendering look on Gabriel's face. Gabriel simply sits down on his chair.)
Gabriel: (begrudingly) Alright, fine.
Adrien: Thank you, Dad!
Gabriel: (on-call) You're supposed to be protecting my son, and yet, Marinette Dupain-Cheng is still being a very bad influence on him!

title: Adoration/Transcript
text:
Adoration/Transcript - Intro
Lila: Don't worry, Mr. Agreste. A plan is already in motion that should resolve this problem quickly, once and for all.
(Lila turns off Gabriel's hologram from her Alliance and comes out of the bathroom to reveal that she has been in Chloé's quarters all along.)
Chloé: (while Sabrina pampers her nails with a nail file) Punching bags are supposed to be punched! They're not supposed to punch back!
Lila: The problem isn't Zoé, it's Marinette. She's the one setting a bad example for your half-sister.
Chloé: (jumps up onto her feet furiously)ARGH! I need to be done with this... anti-bullying party pooper!!!
Lila: I have the perfect plan to get rid of her for good, but it's going to require... you two. (points at Chloé and Sabrina)
Marinette: Wow... we're actually getting the Eiffel Tower!! (squeals) Well, we should probably plan this afternoon, go see Kitty Section and Nino for the music, my parents for the buffet— oh, and we need a florist for the decor. This is going to be the best party ever!
(While Marinette is talking, Zoé spots a picture frame by her compartment. She rushes to quickly hide it.)

title: Adoration/Transcript
text:
Adoration/Transcript - Intro
Sabrina: But... I can't do something like that! (gets down on her knees) Chloé, I'd do anything to help you, but this... this goes against everything I stand for! You know my dad is a police officer! I just can't!
Chloé: It's precisely because your father is a policeman that no one will suspect you! And if you get caught, he'll clear your name.
Sabrina: You mean, he'll be furious with me!
Chloé: Do you want to be demoted from underling to punching bag? You want to join the baker girl and the half-of-a-sister??
Sabrina: (gasps) No! I'm your friend!
Chloé: (shakes her head 'no') Mmm-mmm. My underling. You are my underling. If you're not willing to do anything for me, then get lost!
(Sabrina frowns tearfully and walks away, dejected.)
Chloé: Oh, wait! (brings out a whistle) Remember this?
Sabrina: (smiles hopefully) Oh, yes, my toot-toot whistle!
Chloé: (throws the whistle on the floor) Try whistling into it to see if you can ever find another friend who's half as good as me!
(Sabrina runs out of the room, sobbing.)
Chloé: Your plan was lame and ridiculous! What are we gonna do now?
Lila: We're just going to wait.

title: Adoration/Transcript
text:
Adoration/Transcript - Intro
(Sabrina is seen on the corridor, wearing her whistle on her neck with a frown and continues to cry, burying her head in her knees.)
Monarch: Lila Rossi isn't lying when she promises something. I sense an emotion with rare power. (corrupts a butterfly into an akuma) Kaalki, (Kaalki's pod hovers toward Monarch...) your power is now mine! (...and absorbs her power) Voyage, my Megakuma!
Monarch: (from his lair) Vanisher, I am Monarch. Do you want to keep your best friend? Well, to that end, I am restoring your power of invisibility.
Sabrina: (sniffs) Thank you, Monarch!
Monarch: (from his lair) And to increase your chances of success, I’m transferring the essence of the Miraculous of Adoration to you, which will give you the power to recall any object you'll have previously touched. Barkk, (her pod hovers towards Monarch...) your power is now mine! (...and absorbs her power) Transfer! (transmits the power of Adoration into Sabrina's Alliance) From now on, you will be able to steal undetected, risk-free. All you have to do is whistle.
Sabrina: Thank you, Monarch. (succumbs into the Megakuma and transforms into Vanisher)
Lila: Three, two, one.
(Vanisher breaks in Chloe's room.)

title: Adoration/Transcript
text:
Adoration/Transcript - Intro
Chloé: (gasps, to Lila) Are you... a witch??
Vanisher: I'm willing to help you, Chloé... if you're willing to keep me as a friend!
Lila: See? Now there's a good underling.
(Vanisher walks towards where Chloé's phone is. She touches it with her whistle.)
Chloé: My phone!
(Chloé is about to stop Vanisher but Lila gestures to her to stay put. Vanisher walks to Chloé and Lila as she whistles, "fetching" the phone that she touched with her whistle. Lila and Chloé smile at each other, satisfied.)
Marinette: And voilà! This version is simpler — less princess-y, don't you think?
Zoé: Mhm!
Marinette: And with less items to gather and put together, I might actually finish this dress in time! (sighs) If only it was that simple with Adrien... I'm trying not to come up with any more complicated ideas, but it's still hard to tell him how I feel.
Zoé: I get it. Telling someone how you feel is... not easy. It's the most difficult thing in the world, actually. I also can't tell the person I love my true feelings.
Marinette: (gasps, excitedly) No way! You're in love? That's so awesome! Who is it? (squeals) Is it someone I know from our school? I'm so happy for you!!
Zoé: It's... pretty complicated.

title: Adoration/Transcript
text:
Adoration/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: If it's complicated, you can tell me. I'm an expert in complicated situations.
(As Marinette and Zoé continue talking, Vanisher sneaks inside the room.)
Zoé: Anyway, there's no point in thinking about it because in two weeks time, we won't see each other anymore.
Marinette: (gasps and squints her eyes with a grin) A ninth-grader, then? (Zoé simply looks away with a little smile on her face.) I'm totally butting into your business but one thing I know for sure is that this person must be wonderful! If someone as awesome as you loves 'em.
Zoé: Yes. Wonderful. Loved by everyone.
Marinette: (laughs) Kind of like Adrien, then! I know how hard this is, but love conquers all! When you love someone, nothing’s impossible, nothing’s forbidden! Love has NO limits, no boundaries!
(Vanisher spots Marinette's sketchbook by the corner of the bed.)
Zoé: Except... this person's in love with someone else.
Marinette: Oh... right. It does sound like that could be an obstacle. But who knows? Maybe he's not really in love with the person you think that he is. And even if he were, why couldn’t he be in love with another person, or two people, or even no one at all?

title: Adoration/Transcript
text:
Adoration/Transcript - Intro
Zoé: It's true: you ARE an expert at complicated situations, Marinette!
Marinette: Anyway, if you won’t be seeing each other anymore in two weeks, there'll never be a better time than the party to say how you feel.
(Marinette and Zoé go down to the hotel's lobby.)
Zoé: I have to call my drama teacher and tell him I can't make it to class.
Marinette: Okay. I'll wait for you outside.
Alya: (on-call) Wow... the Eiffel Tower! You girls nailed it!
Marinette: It was all thanks to Zoé — she's the real hero! (sits on her scooter) You should've seen her stand up to Chloé! She's not getting walked all over anymore! (whispers) Hey, did you know she has a secret crush on a ninth grader?
Alya: (on-call) No... who is he?
Marinette: I wish I knew... I would've helped her otherwise!
Alya: (on-call, laughs) You, the great expert of love declarations?
Marinette: Come on, this is serious. Zoé's in eighth grade which means her true love won't be at the same school anymore next year.
Alya: (on-call) It's hard to help her if we don't even know who he is.

title: Adoration/Transcript
text:
Adoration/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: True... (sees Zoé exit the door while using her Alliance with the hologram of Adrien on it, which may have caused her quite a misunderstanding as she gasps in realization) What if Zoé's in love with Adrien??
Alya: (on-call) Huh?
Marinette: Everybody loves Adrien!! That would explain why she didn't want to tell me!
Alya: (on-call) What are you going to say to her if Adrien is the love of her life?
Marinette: I don't know. I'll keep you posted. Bye! (quickly keeps her phone)
Zoé: If we don't hurry, we're going to miss it!
Marinette: Who? Adrien?
Zoé: Um, no, the florist! The shop closes soon. You think about Adrien a lot, don't you?
Marinette: Uh— no! I don't think about him THAT much, you know? He doesn't belong to me. Well, I mean, he kinda does a little, but none of this matters because no one really belongs to anyone! What matters is (leans closer to Zoé) what brings us together and what you and I are supposed to do. You know, organize the school dance?
(Marinette brings out an extra helmet from her scooter's compartment and gives it to Zoé to wear it. Both of them ride the scooter and drive away. Vanisher is seen tailing them.)
[Montage starts.]
[Montage ends.]

title: Adoration/Transcript
text:
Adoration/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Once all the students are here, Kitty Section will open the evening with a concert. Anyone who doesn't like dancing...
Zoé: And who isn't afraid of heights...
Marinette: ...can have fun on a huge trampoline set up between the feet of the Eiffel Tower.
Marinette: My parents will have to prepare a buffet with the Dupain-Cheng bakery's most popular specialty.
Zoé: We'll also have the chance to enjoy beautiful decorative works by our talented, favorite florist!
(Whilst the two are speaking, Chloé and Vanisher continue their plan behind the scenes. Vanisher blows her whistle, transporting everything that she touched with her whistle earlier to the Eiffel Tower. Vanisher then puts all of the things they gathered inside Marinette's bag, where a surprised Tikki witnesses unnoticed. Vanisher returns to Chloé, who smirks at her proudly.)
Chloé: (walking out of her hiding place towards everyone) Dupain-Cheng! Give me my phone back!
Andre: My darling, Chloé, do you want me to buy you another phone?
Chloé: No! I want my phone! The one that's in the baker girl's gym bag!!
Tom: Don't you dare accuse my daughter!!

title: Adoration/Transcript
text:
Adoration/Transcript - Intro
(Chloé walks towards where Marinette's bag is but Marinette beats her to it, grabbing it quickly as Tikki phases to a floor below to avoid being seen.)
Marinette: It's private!
Chloé: She wouldn't stop me from looking if she had nothing to hide. Super suspicious.
Adrien: (scowls) What are you doing, Chloé? Quit it!
Chloé: There will be no obstruction to my justice!!
(Chloé flips Marinette's bag upside down, pouring out all the contents of her bag and revealing that her phone is indeed inside the bag — a part of their plan to frame Marinette. Everyone gasps unbelievably to this sight.)
Marinette: (in disbelief) What???
Zoé: Chloé's planned all this!!
Chloé: Oh, really? (drops the bag) And how did I do it? Am I a magician, maybe?
Marinette: Of course! Magic! An akumatized villain would've made these things appear in my bag!

title: Adoration/Transcript
text:
Adoration/Transcript - Intro
Chloé: An akumatized villain? (laughs) And where is this "invisible" akumatized thief? Besides, why would this hypothetical villain use YOUR bag to stash things that, (takes Marinette's sketchbook and starts browsing it) wouldn't you know, look conveniently just like the elements you need for... your dress?? (shoves Marinette's sketch to her face) Which looks utterly ridiculous, by the way.
Marinette: What are you talking about?
Chloé: Here's proof: these doilies have the initials "TS" on them. You think they stand for Thick Simpleton? No! They stand for Tom and Sabine! Because they come from the Dupain-Cheng bakery, don't they?! (Tom and Sabine nod) See? Her own parents are accusing her, (Marinette facepalms at the back) and they're right! Oh! Look what else I just found! (pulls out Anarka's flag)
Anarka: My flag!

title: Adoration/Transcript
text:
Adoration/Transcript - Intro
Chloé: That's right! This disgusting thing belongs to her friend, Anarka! Just look at her sketch which is nothing short of a confession. (tosses Marinette's sketchbook to the side) Her evil intention was to cut your flag into pieces for her terrible dress. She doesn't just steal from her parents but from her friends' parents, too! And what's this...? (picks up the paper flowers on the ground and shows it to the others)
Florist: My flowers!
Chloé: And she stole her most beautiful paper flowers which she'd made with her own little hands! Those poor fragile little flowers...
(Chloé ironically throws them away and lets them fly in the wind; they happen to land on Vanisher, blowing her cover. Marinette squints to the direction where Vanisher is.)
Chloé: And look what shines like a bright sun among those miserable things, my beloved, expensive gold phone that SHE stole from me!
Marinette: Why would I steal a phone to make a dress? It doesn't make any sense!

title: Adoration/Transcript
text:
Adoration/Transcript - Intro
Chloé: To melt it down! That monster was planning to melt my gold phone into jewelry to go with her hideous dress! That's a first-degree phone slaughter! It's a good thing we caught her red-handed! The jury must convict the baker girl straight away! I rest my case.
Denis Damoclès: Marinette Dupain-Cheng. I'm so disappointed in you. Even though we're only a few days away from the end of the school year, all this evidence leaves me no choice but to expel you from school.
(Sabine sighs, burying her head in Tom's chest.)
Tom: Marinette... what's happened to you?
Anarka: If you needed something, all you had to do was ask.
Marinette: No, I—
Zoé: It was me! (Everyone turns their heads to Zoé.) Marinette had nothing to do with it!
Marinette: What?? No, Zoé—
Chloé: Are you out of your mind?? Who do you think you are, ruining MY indictment!?
Zoé: I stole everything so Marinette could have her dream dress because... you should never bury your dreams.
(Andre looks at Zoé with empathy.)
Chloé: Well, you just earned your ticket back to New York!
(Behind one of the beams of the Eiffel Tower, Marinette runs to hide and meet with Tikki.)
Tikki: Marinette, I saw what happened! It was a supervillain—

title: Adoration/Transcript
text:
Adoration/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Vanisher, I know. Tikki, spots on!
(She transforms into Ladybug and opens her bugphone.)
Ladybug: Cat Noir, it's me. We got a vanishing villain on the Eiffel Tower. Meet me there! (turns off her bugphone)
[Superpower Sequence]
Ladybug: Lucky Charm! (receives a piñata)
(Ladybug shows herself to the crowd.)
Ladybug: I know who did this!
Chloé: (shakes her head annoyingly) Ugh, that's all we need. Maybe your piñata did it, Ladylame?
Ladybug: No, it was an akumatized villain! There — Vanisher!
(She hurls her yo-yo towards the direction where Vanisher is, but then she is able to avoid it. All of them run to escape, except for Adrien who also happens to go hide behind a beam. The battle begins between Ladybug and Vanisher, with Vanisher throwing cymbals towards Ladybug but successfully evades it. Ladybug jumps down from the beam and spins her yo-yo as a shield from Vanisher's attacks. As a sound of a whistle was heard, Vanisher "fetches" one of the baker's peel and uses it against Ladybug, but the superhero in red is able to knock her down. Meanwhile, Adrien is still hiding behind a beam.)

title: Adoration/Transcript
text:
Adoration/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: Ladybug's going to need us to plead her case! Plagg, claws out! (transforms into Cat Noir)
(Back to the battle, Ladybug is still looking for the invisible villain around. Vanisher then ambushes Ladybug from above and attempts to hit her with the peel. Ladybug manages to swing above a beam to evade her attack. Cat Noir joins her shortly.)
Cat Noir: I got your message and got here quickly as I could, m'lady.
(Ladybug uses her Lucky Vision, pinpointing the piñata in her hands, the bottle of spray adhesive and Cat Noir.)
Ladybug: Perfect timing, kitty cat! How would you like to help me reveal the truth? (points at the bottle of spray adhesive below them)
Cat Noir: Always happy to help a friend out of a sticky situation!
(Our feline superhero jumps below to grab the bottle of spray adhesive, which catches the attention of Vanisher, as well as Monarch.)
Monarch: (from his lair) The only way to remain innocent and unmasked, Vanisher, is to seize Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous!

title: Adoration/Transcript
text:
Adoration/Transcript - Intro
(Vanisher spins around the peel she's holding, preparing for another blow. Ladybug then tosses the piñata in the air and crushes it with her yo-yo, causing the confetti to shower down on Vanisher. Cat Noir takes the opportunity to spray the adhesive on Vanisher to let the confetti stick to her, revealing herself. Vanisher whistles in panic in hopes to get another weapon, which gives Ladybug knowledge of where the Megakuma is.)
Ladybug: The whistle!
(It is a successful "whistle" after all — Vanisher gets hold of an electric guitar from the houseboat and uses it against Cat Noir. Ladybug throws her yo-yo at Vanisher to capture her and to finally steal the whistle from her, which then she tosses to...)
Ladybug: Cat Noir!
Cat Noir: Cataclysm! (catches the whistle and disintegrates it, freeing the Megakuma)
Ladybug: No more evil-doing for you, Megakuma! (swipes open her yo-yo) Time to de-evilize! (captures the Megakuma...) Gotcha! (...and frees the purified butterfly) Bye-bye, little butterfly!
[Superpower Sequence]
Ladybug: Miraculous Ladybug! (tosses the piñata into the air and repairs every damage caused by the villain)

title: Adoration/Transcript
text:
Adoration/Transcript - Intro
(After every damage has been reverted, Vanisher de-transforms into Sabrina. Ladybug opens her yo-yo once more to give Sabrina a magical charm.)
Chloé: Sabrina! You were ridiculous! Utterly ridiculous!
Ladybug: (walks to Sabrina and gives her the magical charm) This magical charm will help you remember where good and evil lie, and to make the right choices.
Sabrina: (holds the charm close to her chest) Thank you, Ladybug!
Ladybug: (about Zoé) This young girl is innocent. She was framed... by Vanisher.
Cat Noir: With Chloé's help.
(Chloé squints her eyes in seething hatred, and shifts her head from side to side to see that all the people around her are looking at her suspiciously. She simply scoffs and walks away like the sassy girl that she is.)
Ladybug and Cat Noir: (fist bump) Pound it!
(The two of them make their depature. Zoé and Andre exchange warm smiles.)
Marinette: It was so kind of you, Zoé, but... don't ever sacrifice yourself for me or anyone else. And the same thing goes for your feelings.
(Zoé looks at her, unsure how to interpret Marinette's words.)

title: Adoration/Transcript
text:
Adoration/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (sighs) I know... you're in love with Adrien. Don't sacrifice your feelings for him because of me. He has the right to hear your declaration.
Zoé: Adrien?! But you're the one he loves...
Marinette: Even if he loves me, he'd be flattered to know that you love him too. Let him know how you feel about him... (Zoé frowns and looks down.) Zoé, you're an amazing person. One can only feel honored to be loved by you.
Zoé: Are you sure?
Marinette: Of course! You can't keep it to yourself!
Zoé: But... Adrien’s not the one I’m in love with.
Marinette: Oh? Who is it, then?
(Zoé simply looks at Marinette and smiles, with no words needed to answer her question. With her reflection in Zoé's eyes, Marinette realizes that the person Zoé likes... is her.)
Marinette: Oh... Oh! Oh. (Zoé keeps her tender, loving smile and gaze at Marinette as the two share an embrace moments after) I am truly, very honored. I mean it, Zoé.
Zoé: Thanks, Marinette. (they let go of their embrace) You're right! It's such a relief to get these things off your chest. You should try it, too!
Marinette: What do you mean?
Zoé: Adrien! What are you waiting for? Go tell him you love him!

title: Adoration/Transcript
text:
Adoration/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: But— wait what? How is he going to react? And what am I going to say to him?? What if I just do what I always do — mess things up and definitely ruin things between us?!
Zoé: Marinette... I've been wanting to tell you how I feel since the day I met you. But since you're madly in love with Adrien, I thought it would be pointless and ruin things between us. But look, I just told you, and I can see it doesn't change anything.
Marinette: Which changes everything for me...
Zoé: You were right: telling someone that you love them doesn't ruin anything. It's time you started taking your own advice, too. (Marinette becomes wide-eyed.) What are you waiting for? Go!
(Marinette smiles and gives Zoé one last hug as she finally goes to Adrien to tell him how she really feels.)
Marinette: Adrien!! (runs and pants as she stops in front of him)
Adrien: What's going on, Marinette?
Marinette: I— My hair is a mess, I'm not wearing my princess dress, there's no music, no rose petals everywhere, and we're not on the Eiffel Tower. But even though this isn't at all how I'd imagined this magical moment would play out, it feels right.

title: Adoration/Transcript
text:
Adoration/Transcript - Intro
(Adrien is at a loss for words, leaving him wide-eyed as Marinette finally declares:)
Marinette: Adrien, I love you.
Adrien: This couldn't be any more magical, Marinette.
(As the two delight in their "magical moment", the two lovebirds lean in for a kiss. But alas, the "wall" between them separates them once again.)
Gabriel: (emerges from the shadows in an illusion) Adrien... no.
(Adrien stops midway their kiss as he opens his eyes. Marinette does the same.)
Marinette: Is something wrong...?
Adrien: (slowly steps back) I don't know... I feel strange. Maybe you should go home.
Marinette: Oh... okay...
Adrien: I'm sorry.
(Adrien proceeds to walk inside the courtyard, leaving Marinette by the gate. Marinette takes a glance on one of the mansion's windows, where she sees Gabriel lurking behind it. Gabriel is then seen fidgeting with his ring as he steps back into the shadows.)
Marinette: The important thing is... that I told him how I feel. Right, Tikki?
Tikki: Of course, Marinette! You were very brave! You've finally told Adrien you love him! That's huge!
Marinette: Yes... yeah. (puts her fists by her chest, still dazed lying on her bed)

text:
Adoration/Transcript - Intro
