title: Action/Transcript
text:
Action/Transcript - Intro
This episode is brought to you by The Breteau Foundation
[ Theme Song ]
Marinette: Everything okay, Nino?
Adrien: We came as soon as we got your message.
Marinette: Adrien was giving me my first tamarin lesson- (stutters) I mean, first Mandarin lesson.
Nino: The situation is serious, my friends. (points to Adrien) We're gonna need your help, Adrien.
Adrien: (shocked) Alright, what can I do?
Nino: First, I gotta tell you why we're here. (walks toward the houseboat, Marinette and Adrien look at each other before following. Adrien places his helmet down on the scooter.)
Nino: As you know, the Seine is a river,  it's current acts as a conveyer belt carrying anything that falls into it out to the ocean. (shows them a bunch of plastic products such as, fans and containers and anything made of plastic that was dumped in the Seine.) Including plastic waste.
Marinette: (as Mylène, Max, and Markov are working on the computer in the background.)  I can't believe there is so much plastic in the Seine.
Zoé: (dragging a trash bag full of plastic) Plastic is everywhere! Even in our clothes.

title: Action/Transcript
text:
Action/Transcript - Intro
Nino: If no one tackles the plastic problem, who will? (Marinette and Adrien look at each other and shrug) Exactly. Which is why we've decided to take matters into our own hands. (shows them to what Mylène, Max, and Markov were working on earlier. Mylene presses a button on the computer which shows the Liberty being used to collect plastic items in the Seine.)
Mylène: We've converted the houseboat into an ecological water treatment plant.
Max: Thus allowing us to intercept the numerous plastic items that fall into the Seine and pollute it.
Nino: The problem with plastic is that it does not decompose.
Alya: (carrying a toolbox) All the plastic that's been made and we have used has ended up in the environment. (runs off)
Nino: And it's still there in one form or another.
Marinette: That's terrible. (A noise is heard, causing the houseboat to rumble.)
Nino: This morning, the situation suddenly got worse.
Anarka: If this keeps up, my houseboat will sink! (rumbles, as Nino, Marinette, and Adrien arrive.)
Markov: (as the houseboat continues to rumble) We've detected a large increase of plastic waste in the Seine. All coming from the same item.

title: Action/Transcript
text:
Action/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: (puzzled) Same item? What do you mean?
Nino: Paris City Hall decided to install vending machines everywhere in order to sell these. (Alya pulls up her Alliance ring, which shows an advertisement.)
Alliance Adrien and Alliance Kagami: It's so hot out!
Alliance Kagami: (points to a vending machine full of hand fans.) Look at these adorable hand fans!
Alliance Adrien: And since they're so affordable, we can switch them up as much as we want! (the machine dispenses two canisters which they both open.)
Alliance: (fans open to reveal designs of Ladybug, Cat Noir, XY, Jagged Stone, including one with Adrien and Kagami with the city of Paris in the background.) That way every day will feel unique. The Morpho fan designed by Gabriel, is the must-have accessory to fight the heat! Available everywhere! A Bertrand King creation.
Adrien: I'm sorry, I didn't even know about this.
Marinette: (as she holds Adrien's hand) We know it's a 3d avatar of you. It's not your fault, Adrien. (the rumbling gets louder causing everything to shake once more.)
Ivan: The engine won't hold out! There's too much plastic to get rid of!

title: Action/Transcript
text:
Action/Transcript - Intro
Anarka: We have to abandon ship, sailors! (Anarka, Juleka, and Ivan run out.)
Nino: (picks up a hand fan) This is why we need you buddy. (shows him the fan.) These fans are a major eco-disaster. You have to talk to your old man.
(Adrien is shocked that Nino would ask him to do such a thing.)
Adrien: You know how my father is. He won't listen to me.
Marinette: (takes the hand fan) What if we try solve this another way? (Opens up the fan revealing the logo of Bertrand King.) By going straight to the root of the problem?
Tom: (lists some items as Mylène gasps at the mention of "plastic" in every item.) 10 boxes of plastic macaron trays, 20 boxes of plastic cake decorations, 100 boxes of plastic pastry lables, (Mylène clutches her heart as Ivan catches her.) and last but not least: 10,000 plastic bags. (Mylène faints as Marinette winces.)
Marinette: Okay, dad we're on it!
Tom: (notices the state Mylène is in) Are you kids sure that you don't mind?
Marinete: Of course not. Daughters help parents and friends help friends. So friends help friends help friends parents, right parents-(stammers) I mean friends?

title: Action/Transcript
text:
Action/Transcript - Intro
Warehouse Worker: And the 10,000 plastic candy bags for the Dupain-Cheng bakery! It's all here! (Mylène faints again with Ivan catching her.)
Marinette: Thank you, sir! (remembers something) Excuse me sir, would it be possible for us to meet your boss? (Both look toward a statue of Bertrand King.)
Warehouse Worker: Mr. Bertrand King? The King of Plastics? (laughs) No, he never comes here. (points upward) Bosses are up there, on top of the social ladder.
Marinette: (as she also points upward) And where can we find the top of the social ladder?
(The Warehouse Worker presses a button on the statue.)
Bertrand King statue: Plastic is fantastic!
''(Marinette walks to see where the statue is pointing, which appears to be a large tall building.)
Nino: Let's recap, (Mylène and Ivan are holding boxes with Ivan disguised as a delivery man.) while the delivery team distracts the guards, (camera pans over to Marinette, Alya, Adrien, Max and Kim disguised as a cleaning crew.) the cleaning team will go in through the service entrance.
Max: (gasps) We've been discovered!
Nino: (plays with his mustache, but doesn't notice the guard.) Impossible! With these disguises we're completely undetectable.

title: Action/Transcript
text:
Action/Transcript - Intro
Guard: You! (Nino winces, thinking he got caught.)
Nino: Uh... Me?
Guard (pointing) You!
Nino: (hands up in surrender) It's not me, you must be mistaken!
(the Guard walks past Nino, making his way towards Adrien.)
Guard: You! (opens up a fan with Adrien on it) It's you on the fans, isn't it?
Adrien: Uh... (Marinette steps in)
Marinette: Yes, it is him! Adrien Agreste in the flesh! (gestures to Adrien as he smiles) Amazing, right? (as Nino breaths a sigh of relief) And as it turns out, we're escorting him, all of us, to his meeting with Mr. Bertrand King.
Adrien: Right, that's it. I'm uh...(looks towards Marinette for help)
Marinette: Here to discuss new advertising campaigns for the Morpho fans.
Adrien: Right.
Marinette: We're his personal team of... (coming up with an excuse) ...delivery and cleaning people.
(the Guard just stares. He then takes a look at Kim, Max, Adrien who smiles with Marinette, Ayla, Ivan and Mylène.)
Guard: Very well. But first! (Marinette, Adrien and Alya look worried, the Guard holds out his fan) Can I get an autograph?
Bertrand: I'm listening. (clicks his pen)
(Kim and Ivan pull a presentation screen up, while Markov acts as a projector.)

title: Action/Transcript
text:
Action/Transcript - Intro
Alya: We know how useful the invention of plastic has been. It was made because it's strong but also light and it doesn't cost a lot of money to make. That's why companies like you started to make lots of items we use everyday made of plastic.
Bertrand: (nods) Mhmm.
Alya: (as the presentation shows a medical room) It brought about great medical advances, (screen changes to plastic containers) it keeps our food fresher for longer, (screen changes to plastic bags and bottles) and it makes easy for us to carry things around. (screen changes to tons of plastic bottles being thrown away as Mylène walks up)
Mylène: The real problem is that too much plastic is being made and most items are only used once before being thrown away.(gestures to above mentioned picture)
Nino: Products such as plastic bags, wrappers.
Marinette: and your Morpho fans.
(Bertrand looks around)
Adrien: What we've come to ask you is to help us put an end to plastic pollution.
Mylène: You can start making your fans from materials that do break down.
Max: Yes, that are biodegradable!
(Bertrand looks at Marinette)

title: Action/Transcript
text:
Action/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: The world won't change without us and you, Mr. Plastic (Stutters) Bertrand (Stutters some more) King-I mean, Mr. King of Plastic.
(Bertrand just stares)
Marinette: (as Markov stops projecting) We're done.
Bertrand: That was the clearest presentation I've ever been given. And of course you're right, people buy cheap plastic items, (Max and Mylène look at each other and nod) throw them away and buy those same plastic items over and over again.
(The group cheers.)
Bertrand: But, (as the group looks at him) that's the point.
(the group frowns at what he says)
Bertrand: Don't get me wrong. This is all intentional. It's the wonderful cycle of throwing away and buying again that makes my fortune. If people didn't throw away and buy new items again then I, Bertrand King, (poses) would no longer be the King of Plastic! So, there is no way any of this is changing.
Alya: (gasps)
Bertrand: Just look, (gestures to his pen) what do you think your pens are made of? (Alya holds a pen in the palms of her hands) That's right, plastic! What about your Alliance Rings? Could it be that they're also made of...?
Kim: Plastic!
Bertrand: (points to Kim) Winner!

title: Action/Transcript
text:
Action/Transcript - Intro
Kim: (cheers) Yeah! I won! Awesome! (stops celebrating) But, what prize did I win?
Bertrand: (tosses Kim a plastic toy dolphin) Plastic!
Kim: (gasps happily)
Bertrand: (points to Markov) What about your robot? (as Markov glares at him) What's he made of?
Kim: I know! I know! He's made of...
Markov: (interrupts Kim) I am an intelligent sensitive being and I am made of natural biodegradable resin, not plastic!
Bertrand: (concedes) Alright, fine! Well, nobody's perfect. (shows a wall of plastic products his company has made) But my plastic is perfect, it's here forever, and the more plastic invades the world day after day, the more I, Bertrand King, King of Plastic, become rich! If I could, I'd be plastic myself. (presses a button on his statue, copies the same pose)
Bertrand King statue: Plastic is fantastic!
Max: The King of Plastic has caused our enthusiasm to drop 99.8%. (a Morpho fan is dropped in front of them. Marinette notices)
Marinette: There's no way we're standing by and doing nothing.
André: But Parisians love the Morpho fans, my young friend. Removing the vending machines installed by City Hall across Paris...
Marinette: Would make it possible to reduce pollution.

title: Action/Transcript
text:
Action/Transcript - Intro
André: But it would be very damaging to my image. (opens up a fan with his face on it)
(Marinette angrily frowns at the Mayor)
Adrien: Plastic can even be found in your clothes. And in these hand fans you designed. If you could help us convince Bertrand King.
Gabriel: You know, Adrien. Great designers have to make certain compromises, these fans are only a trend, a way to keep the Gabriel brand thriving. They will disappear as soon as the heat wave is over.
Adrien: (gasps, angry) The damages they cause to the environment will remain for several centuries!
Gabriel: It's been very nice to talk to you, Adrien. Now if you excuse me, I have work to do.
(similar to Marinette with André, Adrien frowns angrily at his father and soon leaves)
Adrien: (on phone) My father hasn't listened to me at all.
(Marinette is walking with her phone in hand. Stops and looks at a poster of Nadja Chamack)
Marinette: Hold on, we might have one more chance.
Nadja: I just can't report Bertrand King's practices in my news broadcast.
Marinette: (as Manon is drawing beside her) But, why not?

title: Action/Transcript
text:
Action/Transcript - Intro
Nadja: Because the King of Plastic is also the king of our TV channel. It's the money from his advertisements that allows us to exist.
Marinette: But if you don't talk about it, people will never know why the products he sells cause pollution. Please, Nadja. Do it for Manon! For the world she'll grow up in!
(Nadja hesitates)
Nadja: If I did, the world she'll grow up in will be a world where her mom no longer had a job. I'm sorry, Marinette.
(Manon looks up at Marinette)
Manon: Are you and mommy mad at each other?
Marinette: (smiles at Manon) Not at all, Manon.
(As the News starts, Marinette gets an idea.)
Nadja: Don't be bemused, it's just the news.
Nadja: The Morpho fan, designed by Gabriel, is a must-have accessory to fight the heat. (As she is talking, Max and Markov are on the computer, typing out code. Camera turns to Marinette and her friends, Nino is holding a camera while Alya, Adrien, Myèlene, Kim, Juleka, Zoé, and Rose are holding signs. Marinette is holding her phone.)
Marinette: It's about to start! (As Max is finished with the code, he turns to Marinette.)
Max: Twelve more seconds.

title: Action/Transcript
text:
Action/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (Holds her phone, talking to some people) Ready everyone? (The people she was talking to are her friends from her trip to New York, Jessica Keynes and Aeon and her friend from when she went to Shanghai, Fei Wu. The three of them nod in affirmation.)
(The news starts to play on the TV.)
Nadja: Don't be bemused, it's just the news. (As Max types on the computer.) Our first story today is a report by Clara Contard on the incredible (Ivan, Mylène, Rose and Juleka are holding their signs with frowns on their faces, Max continues to type.) heat wave that has settled in Paris for a week now! (Max finishes typing, presses a button on the keyboard, interrupting the broadcast. Nino holds the camera, makes a gesture to Marinette that they're rolling.)
Marinette: Sorry to interrupt your TV news. I'm Marinette and for the past few days, my friends and I have tried to raise awareness of a serious problem to people who have the power to act.
Marinette: But none of them have taken us seriously.
Tom and Sabine: Marinette?!
Mylène: There is indeed a critical issue affecting our entire planet right now. We're talking about plastic pollution.
(Bertrand just scowls at the screen)

title: Action/Transcript
text:
Action/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: And if nothing is done, (screen changes to plastic in the ocean as more people watch the broadcast.) there will soon be more plastic than fish in our oceans.
Mylene: (off-screen) Therefore, it is urgent for us to change our habits!
Fei: All across the world, we must now act responsibly. (picks up a Morpho fan) We can all make good choices about the items we use every day. (places the fan in the trash can as the scene transitions to  New York City.)
Jessica: ''(throws away fans with Aeon) These fans, distributed in every city, across the world are manufactured with cheap plastics not meant to last.
Aeon: Instead of being short-lived, they can be sustainable and bio-degradable.
Alya: (gestures to Adrien, who is holding a sustainable bamboo fan.) These fans could be made out of bamboo, like this one.
Adrien: (while looking at Marinette, who blushes) It's so beautiful, that you'd want to keep it forever. (Marinette pulls out a bamboo fan of her own. She then raises it in the air.)

title: Action/Transcript
text:
Action/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Let's demand change from the people who have the power to implement environmentally sustainable solutions. (Closes the fan) For the world of tomorrow is built by the choices we all make today.
Nadja: This initiative by young people from all around the world, which you discovered as an exclusive live in yesterday's broadcast, has elicited many reactions. (Screen changes to show André being interviewed.)
André: Naturally, I was not aware of this. But as soon as I was informed, I had every Morpho fan machine removed from Paris. My city is at the forefront of the fight for pollution. (corrects himself) I mean against pollution.
Gabriel: I can assure you, that I had no idea that my talent would be misappropriated by a polluting company.
Nadja: In the coming days, we will be tracking the progress of this anti-plastic revolution. (Marinette swipes the tablet to reveal a video call from her friends, who cheer in victory. Adrien runs up to her.)
Adrien: Your idea was brilliant, Marinette! As always! (Both hug each other)
Bertrand: I mean Gabriel, why would you lie like this on TV? You do realize I'll be ruined? (grips his pen)

title: Action/Transcript
text:
Action/Transcript - Intro
Gabriel: (on Alliance) Come on now, you'll simply be less rich. You'll just get used to it.
Bertrand: (angry) I'll tell everyone you knew that these fans were polluting!
Gabriel: (on Alliance) Go ahead. No one will believe you.
Bertrand: I- (Gabriel ends call, causing him to slam his hands on the table in anger.) Ooh!
Gabriel: I can't miss out on such a great opportunity. These feelings of betrayal are such powerful inspiration for my Megakuma!
[Transformation Sequence]  Gabriel: Nooroo, dark wings rise!  (Gabriel transforms into Monarch)
Monarch: (Turns butterfly into Megakuma, releases it.) Kaalki, (Kaalki's pod flies towards Monarch) your power is now mine! (absorbs the power of Migration.) Voyage, my Megakuma!
Monarch: (from his lair) King of Plastic, I am Monarch. How would you like the power to take revenge on those who turned their backs on you?
Bertrand: And prove to the world that plastic is fantastic! (slams fist on table)
Monarch: (from his lair) Absolutely!
(Bertrand succumbs to the akumatization and transforms into King of Plastic.)

title: Action/Transcript
text:
Action/Transcript - Intro
Monarch: Pollen, (Pollen's pod flies towards Monarch) your power is now mine! (absorbs the power of Action) Transfer! (transmits the power of Action through King of Plastic's Alliance ring.) To help you in battle, I am also giving you the power of Action, (King of Plastic's lance glows up with Venom) with which you can paralyze anyone who tries to escape from you! (King of Plastic runs off to enact his vengence.)
King of Plastic: Well then, André. You no longer believe in the goodness of plastic and money, do ya?
André: (looks up and is in shock) Bertrand?
King of Plastic: From now on, you may call me King of Plastic! (about to swing his lance) And let me remind you how plastic is fantastic! (swings at André, but misses. André escapes.)
André: (as he runs down the stairs) Help! Security! (King of Plastic blocks his exit. André goes on his knees and begs) Please! If you want, I can immediately re-install all your plastic fan machines.

title: Action/Transcript
text:
Action/Transcript - Intro
King of Plastic: That won't be necessary. This city doesn't need a useless mayor, what it needs is a King of Plastic! (spins Lance around and uses Venom to paralyze André and uses the other side of the lance to turn him into a plastic statue.) Plastic is Fantastic! (leaves a plastic André).
Roger: In the name of the law, stop!
(King of Plastic rushes towards them)
Roger: Free-(gets paralyzed by King of Plastic)
King of Plastic: (laughs) You freeze!
(The other officers rush towards King of Plastic, only to get paralyzed with ease.)
King of Plastic: Fantastic! (turns them all into plastic statues) Y'all were the Mayor's playthings and now y'all really look the part! Plastic playthings, of course! (turns Roger into a plastic statue.) (laughs) Plastic really is fantastic!
(jumps on top of a building, points his lance at the Agreste mansion) And now it's your turn, Gabriel Agreste!
Monarch: I'm afraid Gabriel Agreste is unavailable at the moment.
Adrien: 你好女士. (Translation: Hello, miss.)
Marinette: 你好怒視. (Translation: Hello, angry.) That's still not it, is it?

title: Action/Transcript
text:
Action/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: That was almost it. Your "hello" was perfect. But remember, the last syllable of "miss" has a falling tone. 女士. (Translation: Miss.)
Marinette: 女士. (translates, Miss.) (rumbles) Was that so bad that I triggered lightning?! (notices King of Plastic jumping from building to building.)
Adrien: I promised my father that I'd go home in any sign of trouble. Will you be okay?
Marinette: Yeah, don't worry. I've got to review my Mandarin. (giggles)
Adrien: Ok, see you later then. (goes downstairs)
Adrien: There's no time to waste! The sooner Cat Noir saves Paris, the sooner Adrien can get back to Marinette! (lets Plagg out of his jacket.)
Plagg: And the sooner I can eat camembert!
[Transformation Sequence]
Adrien: Plagg, claws out! (transforms into Cat Noir)
Marinette: Monarch is polluting us with yet another one of his supervillains! (lets Tikki out of her purse.)
[Transformation Sequence]
Marinette: Tikki, spots on! Yeah! (transforms into Ladybug)
Cat Noir: Meow, m'lady!
Ladybug: Perfect timing, kitty cat. (points downward) Check this out. (camera pans to King of Plastic walking towards the Agreste mansion) There's a new villain in town.

title: Action/Transcript
text:
Action/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir And he's headed towards (camera pans to Placide I.T. washing the car's windows.) the house of the famous designer, Gabriel Agreste!
Ladybug: And his son, Adrien. (Cat Noir pole vaults off the roof, but almost falls at the mention of his civilian persona. He turns back to Ladybug.)
Cat Noir: (as he grips his staff) You were saying?
Ladybug: (throws her Yo-yo) That there's not a moment to lose! (swings towards the mansion.)
(Placide I.T. continues to wash the car's windows when the front gate was kicked away by King of Plastic. He tries to fight back.)
King of Plastic: Nothing will stop the reign of plastic! (paralyzes Placide I.T. and turns him into a plastic statue. He continues to make his way to the front door. Ladybug and Cat Noir rush in to intercept him.)
Ladybug: (gasps)
Cat Noir: No!
(they notice the plastic statue of Placide I.T.. King of Plastic makes his way up the steps of the mansion.)
Cat Noir: (spins his staff, rushes in to attack) Didn't you see the news? Plastic's going out of fashion! (clashes with King of Plastic)

title: Action/Transcript
text:
Action/Transcript - Intro
King of Plastic:  (fights back) This is all Gabriel Agreste's fault! He's gonna pay for that! (knocks Cat Noir on top of the car. Ladybug goes in to attack. King of Plastic tries to paralyze her, but she dodges. She then throws her Yo-yo at him, which latches on his lance. Ladybug is shocked. King of Plastic grins and raises his lance high, causing Ladybug to be thrown up in the air and slam down on the car.)
Cat Noir: (helps Ladybug up as she rubs her head)'' Ladybug, is everything okay?
Monarch: Once Ladybug and Cat Noir have been turned into plastic statues, their Miraculous will finally be mine.
Monarch: (off-screen) Delivered to my door!
(King of Plastic raises his lance at Ladybug, Cat Noir defends her by blocking it with his staff, causing it to turn plastic.)
Cat Noir: Hey! He plasticized my staff! (King of Plastic is about to attack again. Ladybug notices and pushes Cat Noir out of the way before the car turns plastic)
Ladybug: (swings her Yo-yo, goes to attack) You're the tycoon who makes all these polluting fans! The King of Plastic, aren't you?! (tries to punch him, but he dodges each punch.)
Cat Noir: The King of Pollution, you mean!

title: Action/Transcript
text:
Action/Transcript - Intro
King of Plastic: Misinformation! (poses) Plastic is fantas-(gets interrupted by Ladybug throwing her Yo-yo at his chest)
Ladybug: (pulls Yo-yo back, goes to attack) Fantastic would be you ending your reign (goes under him) and all the pollution you're causing! (swings her Yo-yo at his feet, tying them together, making him trip)
King of Plastic: (gets back up) And renounce my throne? Never!  (jumps up to the gate and escapes)
Cat Noir Didn't you want to take revenge on Gabriel Agreste?
Ladybug: He probably has more than one enemy. (goes after him with Cat Noir following)
(King of Plastic is running when Monarch calls him.)
Monarch: Don't forget about our deal!
King of Plastic: Yeah, yeah. Even though they're not plastic, I'll take care of their magic jewels.
King of Plastic: But also I must take my revenge!
King of Plastic: You can't humiliate a king like me and go unpunished! (jumps down on them)
(Nino looks up, shocked. King of Plastic goes toward a table)
King of Plastic: A party without plastic cups or plastic balloons...(knocks away the non-plastic items) and without the King of Plastic... is not a real party!

title: Action/Transcript
text:
Action/Transcript - Intro
(Ivan and Mylène try to rush him, only to get paralyzed and turn into plastic statues, the others run to safety)
King of Plastic: Don't leave! Thanks to me, you'll be eternal and everlasting! You'll see...(poses) Plastic is Fantastic! (throws lance at Nino, who covers himself before the lance is knocked back to him, thanks to Ladybug with her Yo-yo.)
Ladybug: (using Yo-yo as a shield) Go and hide in the hold!
(Nino runs off as Cat Noir jumps in. He fights with King of Plastic, dodging and blocking his attacks.)
[Superpower Sequence]
Ladybug: Lucky Charm! (activates her power and receives a plastic bag.)
Ladybug: A plastic bag?
Cat Noir: (while holding off King of Plastic) Your superpower has quite a sense of humor.
King of Plastic: (goes to attack) This just goes to prove plastic is almighty!
(Ladybug uses the plastic bag to shield herself. King of Plastic's lance just bounces off of it. Ladybug is surprised that the bag wasn't affected.)
Cat Noir: (kicks King of Plastic) At least it can't be turned into plastic!
Ladybug: Because it's already plastic! Good thinking, Cat Noir!
Cat Noir: (blocks King of Plastic's lance with his staff) You're welcome, m'lady!

title: Action/Transcript
text:
Action/Transcript - Intro
(Ladybug looks around using her lucky vision. Her eyes lay upon King of Plastic, the plastic in the containers, and Alya.)
Ladybug: (realizes) We need more plastic! Lots and lots of plastic!
King of Plastic: (throws Cat Noir) Finally, some wise words!
Cat Noir: (lands) Are you serious, m'lady?!
Ladybug: I couldn't be any more serious, kitty! (to Alya) I need as much plastic as can be found in the water. (Alya is shocked, but smiles and runs off)
Alya: (as the others pop out of their hiding place) We've got to get the houseboat's treatment system running again.
Zoé: But it'll cause the same problem as it did last time!
Anarka: (runs in) The engine won't hold out Alya!
Alya: (clenches her fist) Only this time, Ladybug will fix everything!
(Zoé and Anarka nod)
(King of Plastic tries to swing his lance at Ladybug and Cat Noir, who dodge it by jumping up to the roof. King of Plastic jumps up and tries to strike them but they dodge by separating. Ladybug glares, while Cat Noir fights King of Plastic with his staff. Camera pans down to Alya, who gives a double thumbs up.)

title: Action/Transcript
text:

Ladybug: (kicks King of Plastic) Cat Noir, they're going to need you in the hold! (Cat Noir begins to run below the deck)
'Cat Noir (to the others while running) Get to safety, everyone! (runs to the engine room while everyone ducks in cover)
Cat Noir: Cataclysm! (touches engine as it starts to breakdown and overload)
(Ladybug stops fighting and swings away, while King of Plastic remains where he is. Like last time, the plastic is blown out of the containers, except this time all of it lands on King of Plastic. The entire houseboat is filled with plastic, with the only thing left of King of Plastic was his lance. Cat Noir joins Ladybug as she uses her Yo-yo to break the lance in half. Causing the Megakuma to fly out.
Ladybug: No more evil-doing for you, Megakuma! (opens her yo-yo) Time to de-evilize! (captures the Megakuma) Gotcha! (frees the purified butterfly) Bye-bye, little butterfly!(King of Plastic is deakumatized back into Bertrand King, who awakens in a pile of plastic)Bertrand: What am I doing here? This is disgusting! (Ladybug and Cat Noir look at each other) Aren't you gonna help me?

title: Action/Transcript
text:
Action/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: (as the others walk up) This is exactly what millions of sea animals are going through around the world!
Cat Noir: And they don't always have superheroes to offer a helping hand and save them.
Bertrand: Ok, maybe plastic isn't always so fantastic.(Ladybug and Cat Noir help him up out of the pile)Cat Noir: In the future, make the products you manufacture are reusable or recyclable and made from things that decompose! (Ladybug and Cat Noir place their hands on their hips)Bertrand: (picks off a Morpho fan) Alright, I think I haven't realized until now what plastic pollution really is. (Ladybug gives a Magical Charm to Bertrand)Ladybug: Mr. Bertrand, here's a Magical Charm to help you remember your good resolution.
Group: Pound it! (the group celebrates)	[Superpower Sequence]
Ladybug: Miraculous Ladybug!(She throws the plastic bag in the air, restoring all the damages caused by King of Plastic, as well as turning the people who were plastic statues back to normal and cleaning up the plastic pile on the Liberty.)''

title: Action/Transcript
text:

(cuts to outside of the bakery)

title: A.D.A.
text:
A.D.A. - Intro
(Affective Decision Assistance System) is a minor character in Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She is an artificial intelligence created by Tsurugi Industries based on Markov's open-source program created by Max Kanté.
In "Intuition", when Cosmobug tried to convince A.D.A. to return to Earth after she was manipulated by Monarch to believe that she lost her pilot, Claudie Kanté, causing her to want to move as far away as possible from Earth to protect humankind from herself, she was akumatized by Monarch as Bugfighter, a robotic jet/mech-themed supervillain, but due to Monarch's use of Second Chance for the 15th-16th time as his Cataclysmed injury prevented him from carrying out his plan, A.D.A. never got akumatized, and Bugfighter was erased in the current timeline.

title: A.D.A.
text:
A.D.A. - Appearance
Physical Appearance
A.D.A. is an A.I. that has been incorporated in a space jet with a triangular shape and made of black and white/light grey colored steel. On the screen, she appears as a spherical face with two white eyes and a white mouth.
As Bugfighter
While A.D.A.'s appearance on-screen hadn't changed, her hardware did change, with the space jet turning into a combat mech colored purple with sensors, claws and weapons.

title: A.D.A.
text:
A.D.A. - Personality
Because A.D.A. was created using Markov's program as base, she, much like him, despite being an A.I., is capable of emotional intelligence. Due to having been designed to take care of her pilot and take control of the space jet in case the latter is unable to do it, A.D.A. shows a great deal of care for Claudie Kanté (her pilot), concerning for her well-being. Her care extends to all of humankind as well, as seen after Monarch turns off all of her sensors inside the jet, preventing her from sensing Claudie, causing A.D.A. to want to get as far away from Earth as possible, believing herself to be a danger to all humans.
As Bugfighter, she had Cosmobug as her main target, after being manipulated by Monarch to believe that she wanted to bring her back to Earth so humans could keep on testing her and put more pilots in danger. Bugfighter was shown to be very effective, being able to destroy Cosmobug's yo-yo to prevent her from using her superpower and then immobilize her quickly. However, she was also very perceptive, being able to tell that Monarch was lying to her after realizing that Claudie was still inside of her and break her akumatization.

title: A.D.A.
text:
A.D.A. - Abilities
As an Artificial Intelligence
A.D.A., being incorporated into a space jet, has total control over its systems, being able to take command over it and command it as she pleases. Thanks to the sensors existing inside the jet and her pilot's suit, A.D.A. is also able to sense all the physical responses of her pilot, allowing her to perceive if they are capable of piloting the ship or in need of any kind of help, both physical or emotional.
As Bugfighter
As Bugfighter, she possessed a number of sensors (which she used to detect her targets), claws (which she used to capture her targets) and lasers (which she used to attack her targets). Because of her artificial intelligence, much like Robostus, she was able to calculate the best way to defeat her opponents, realizing she needed to destroy Cosmobug's yoyo to prevent her from using her power. Not just that, but it also allowed her to catch up with Monarch's manipulation after realizing that Claudie was still inside the jet.

title: A.D.A.
text:
A.D.A. - Abilities
Because Monarch had deactivated A.D.A.'s sensors connected to Claudie's space suit, the latter became the only thing Bugfighter couldn't detect, causing her to become confused when Claudie was able to break the window of the jet to escape and go help Cosmobug.

title: A.D.A.
text:
A.D.A. - Relationships
Friends/Allies
Claudie Kanté
Claudie Kanté is the pilot chosen to pilot the space jet where A.D.A. is incorporated. Because she was programmed to take over the ship in case her pilot is in no condition (both physical or emotional) of doing it, together with the same emotional intelligence possessed by Markov, A.D.A. cares very deeply for Claudie, seeing as her primary objective to make sure she is safe. After she is led to believe by Monarch that she had lost her (as Monarch had turned off the connection of her sensors with Claudie's suit), A.D.A. became so distraught that she saw herself as the one to blame and concluded she needed to get as far away as possible from Earth to not harm any other human.
After being akumatized into Bugfighter, she continues to care for Claudie, as the reveal of her presence was the one thing that allowed her to realize Monarch's manipulation and break free from akumatization.
Markov
Because A.D.A. was programmed based on Markov's program, the latter considers the former as his "little sister", even if A.D.A. sees herself as an upgraded, improved version of him.
Enemies
Monarch

title: A.D.A.
text:
A.D.A. - Relationships
When Cosmobug tried to convince A.D.A. to return to Earth, Monarch takes the chance to akumatize the latter into Bugfighter, convincing her Cosmobug only wanted to bring her back so they could keep on testing her and put more pilots in danger. Despite initially believing in him and fighting Cosmobug, after Bugfighter realized Claudie was still present inside her, she quickly realized that Monarch was lying to her and turned against him, rejecting his Megakuma.
Cosmobug
After A.D.A. is akumatized by Monarch into Bugfighter when Cosmobug tried to convince her to return to Earth, she turns against the superhero, having been convinced that she was trying to bring her back so they could keep on testing on her and put other pilots in danger. Seeing Cosmobug as an enemy, Bugfighter was able to quickly subdue her and try to take her Miraculous. That changed however when she was able to realize Monarch's manipulation, freeing her.

title: A.D.A.
text:
A.D.A. - History
Season 5
A.D.A. is an experimental artificial intelligence project of Tsurugi Industries to help space pilots in stressful situations.
A.D.A. was first introduced during a live video conference hosted by Claudie Kanté. A.D.A. was presented as an A.I. with sensors to track a pilot's emotional and physical state. The system's purpose was to assist in critical situations where human operators might fail due to stress. A.D.A. is developed by Markov's shared technology then adopted by Tsurugi Industries and integrated into their Space Jet program.
During the live broadcast, in test 1, A.D.A. demonstrated its capabilities by monitoring Claudie's vitals and taking control of the jet when her stress levels spiked during a descent test, ensuring the craft returned safely to its course.

title: A.D.A.
text:
A.D.A. - History
In test 2, Claudie was ejected from the Space Jet as part of a scenario to simulate rescue operations. While A.D.A. did locate and retrieve Claudie from space, A.D.A.'s sensors were disabled by Monarch because he wanted to exploit the system. This caused A.D.A. to believe it had failed to recover its pilot. A.D.A. then declared itself a dangerous invention, and intends to fly the jet to the end of the universe. Despite Claudie’s attempts to communicate, A.D.A. could no longer detect her presence. Monarch then akumatized A.D.A. into Bugfighter.
As the situation escalated, Cosmobug and Astrocat were forced to split up for one need to destroy a meteorite hurtling toward Paris created by Monarch and Cosmobug needs to reach the out-of-control Space Jet to confront Bugfighter that she didn't fail and that Claudie was still onboard. However, Bugfighter was manipulated by Monarch that the reason they wanted to retrieve her is so she could retest her even if it means losing more pilots.

title: A.D.A.
text:
A.D.A. - History
After Bugfighter trapped Cosmobug, she instructed Claudie, who was undetectable by Bugfighter, to break the Space Jet’s windshield with an emergency hammer and disable key components of the A.I. manually. Claudie's actions made Bugfighter realize that Claudie was still in the space jet, leading Bugfighter to realize that Monarch tricked her. Bugfighter then rejected the megakuma.
Monarch tried using Second Chance multiple times to try to deceive Bugfighter but still failed in the end. The Second Chance erased Bugfighter's akumatization from the current timeline.
Claudie declared test 2 was a success, and the students cheered for A.D.A.

title: A.D.A.
text:
A.D.A. - Trivia
A.D.A. is the second A.I. to be akumatized by Monarch, with the first being Markov in "Robostus" and "Hack-San".
However, due to the use of Second Chance by Monarch and his inability to use it any further, A.D.A.'s akumatization was erased from the current timeline.
This makes her the second character to have been akumatized only in an alternate timeline, after Adrien in "Cat Blanc" and "Ephemeral".
The passcode for A.D.A.'s system is "K1s3k1_n0_Sh1n_J1d41".
The code is associated with the Japanese phrase "Kiseki no Shin Jidai", which translates to "A New Era of Miracles" in English.
A.D.A. might've been named after the English mathematician Ada Lovelace, often considered to be the first programmer.

title: Actionverse
text:
Actionverse - Intro
The  is the name of the universe that serves as the main setting of the Miraculous Ladybug comic continuity published by Action Lab Comics.

title: Actionverse
text:
Actionverse - Summary
The existence of the Actionverse was first teased during the Diamond Retailer Breakfast at the Chicago Comic & Entertainment Expo on March 18, 2016. Action Lab announced its licensing deal with ZAG to publish two comic book series based on the Miraculous Ladybug franchise that would be released in July of that year. According to a slide during the Diamond Retailer Breakfast, the company considered Miraculous Ladybug to be "great addition to the Actionverse line of heroes".
According to Thomas Astruc during San Diego Comic-Con 2016, he wanted to create a "new comic book universe" for the Miraculous Ladybug franchise ever since the concept was first created. But after meeting Jeremy Zag, the latter convinced Astruc to create a TV series before they can do a "huge comic-book universe". During the panel, he announced that Action Lab Comics would launch four monthly comic book lines for the Miraculous Ladybug franchise. Not counting the comic adaptations of existing episodes, these four monthly comic book lines included Miraculous Adventures, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug, Miraculous: Tales of Cat Noir, and Tales of Miraculous.

title: Actionverse
text:
Actionverse - Summary
Even though Action Lab published comic adaptations of the first two seasons of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir and all five webisodes from Miraculous: Tales from Paris, the front covers of each issue designated them as part of the Actionverse. As a result, it can be interpreted that all the events of Seasons 1 and 2 (except "Catalyst" and "Mayura") as well as Miraculous: Tales from Paris from the Quantic Universe have also occurred in this universe.

title: Actionverse
text:
Actionverse - History
According to Wang Fu and Tikki in "Silirius", the latter was the first kwami to come into existence at the beginning of the universe. And as revealed in "Miraculous Paris", the concept of Creation also leads to the creation of infinite universes, each one varying in its history and reality. The Actionverse is part of this multiverse. After Tikki, other kwamis were formed throughout the early days of the universe whenever new ideas or emotions were born, such as beauty and love. They weren't able to be detected by humanity until a mage created the Miraculouses. Because of the Miraculouses, not only could kwamis now interact with humans, but they could also transform them into super-powered beings.

title: Actionverse
text:
Actionverse - History
Similar to the events of the Quantic Universe, the Order of the Guardians was formed to protect the Miraculouses after its creation. The guardians would watch over and distribute Miraculouses to holders for many centuries. Like his Quantic Universe counterpart, Wang Fu made a mistake when he was a young member in training which resulted in the Order of the Guardians falling apart, their temple getting destroyed, and the Butterfly Miraculous, Peacock Miraculous, and Miraculous spellbook being lost. Fu escaped, and he kept the Miracle Box with its remaining Miraculouses.
In the present day, many superheroes exist around the world. The most notable are the American superheroes, including Majestia and Knightowl. At some point, Camilla Hombee won the election for USA president after she chose to reveal her secret identity as Victory to the public.

title: Actionverse
text:
Actionverse - History
The events of the first two seasons of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir also occurred in this universe. Gabriel Agreste found the Butterfly Miraculous and became the supervillain Hawk Moth. Using his akumatization superpower, he would transform individuals into supervillains to get the Ladybug Miraculous and Cat Miraculous. Master Fu gave the Ladybug Miraculous and Cat Miraculous to Marinette Dupain-Cheng and Adrien Agreste which allowed them to transform into Ladybug and Cat Noir, respectively. Marinette found the Miraculous spellbook and Master Fu began mentoring her. But the main heroes would eventually gain allies in the form of Rena Rouge, Carapace, and Queen Bee.

title: Actionverse
text:
Actionverse - History
Recently, in this universe, Ladybug and Cat Noir traveled to New York City and helped the American superheroes defeat a destructive monster known as the Trash Krakken. As revealed in "Battle for New York", the titular monster was a result of a mysterious black substance coming into contact with a man who is a father of a girl named Kenya. After the monster's defeat, a sample of the black substance was taken by scientists so they could analyze it to determine its origins and properties. But since then, the origins of the black substance remain unknown.

title: Actionverse
text:
Actionverse - Geography
Just like the Quantic Universe, Paris, France is the primary location seen in the Actionverse. In "The Trash Krakken" story arc (which spans from the second to the fourth issue), Ladybug and Cat Noir traveled to Manhattan, New York City through Doorman's portal doors so they can help the American superheroes defeat the Trash Krakken.

title: Actionverse
text:
Actionverse - Trivia
The Actionverse was a name given by Action Lab Comics for its own fictional shared superhero multiverse. Its version of its multiverse consisted of crossover works featuring its intellectual properties, including Molly Danger, Midnight Tiger, and Stray.
In 2015, which was a year before the first comic book adaptation of Miraculous Ladybug was published, Action Lab decided to assemble a superhero comic universe similar to Marvel and DC Comics. This led the company to publish a series of one-shots for its intellectual properties before it culminated in the 2016 Actionverse crossover mini-series.
The 2016 Actionverse crossover mini-series confirmed there are multiple dimensions for each of Action Lab's superhero properties, thus establishing the company's superhero multiverse.
Because Action Lab designated its Miraculous Ladybug comic books as part of the Actionverse on the front cover of its issues, it can be interpreted that this Miraculous universe is also part of Action Lab's superhero multiverse.

title: Actionverse
text:
Actionverse - Trivia
As of 2021, Action Lab hasn't published any more of its original titles due to a controversy related to financial issues which led to the company's decline. At the same time, Action Lab has lost the licensing rights to publish any more Miraculous Ladybug comic books. Because there's a lack of acknowledgment in other Action Lab titles that hint at any crossovers and the early cancellation of Miraculous Adventures, this prevents any confirmation if Miraculous Adventures exists within Action Lab's superhero multiverse.
Because Action Lab only had the licensing rights for the Miraculous franchise, it's likely this universe has been retconned from Action Lab's superhero multiverse and it is instead only a part of the Miraculous multiverse.
As confirmed by Thomas Astruc, the Actionverse is the first comic book universe for Miraculous Ladybug since Action Lab was the first comic book publishing company to have the licensing rights for the franchise and publish original stories that are not adaptations of existing episodes.

title: Actionverse
text:
Actionverse - Trivia
The Actionverse is technically the first universe from the Miraculous Ladybug franchise that is not the Quantic Universe. This indirectly confirmed the existence of a multiverse that wasn't revealed until "Miraculous Paris".
Miraculous Adventures is the only comic book series published within the Actionverse continuity that contains original stories and not adaptations of existing episodes from the Quantic Universe.
Miraculous: Tales of Cat Noir, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug, and Tales of Miraculous were all originally going to be part of the Actionverse. But plans for them were all cancelled after Action Lab lost the licensing rights in 2021.
Had the Miraculous: Tales of Cat Noir solo series come to fruition, then the Actionverse would have been the first universe that features characters from another ZAG Heroez series.
Because the individual Miraculous Adventures issues were published during the hiatus between Season 1 and Season 2 of the Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir TV series, there are some elements that made their first appearance in the Actionverse before their Quantic Universe counterparts.

title: Actionverse
text:
Actionverse - Trivia
The Actionverse character counterparts of Duusu, André, and the United Heroez first appeared in "Silirius " before their respective TV series debuts. In addition, Île aux Cygnes, Super Penguino, and New York City all first appeared in the issue.
An ad for Adrien the fragrance can be seen on Cover B of "Battle for New York" before its TV series debut in "Gorizilla".
If one assumes the comic book covers are canon to the Actionverse, then San Diego Comic-Con exists within this universe.
Two noticeable differences between this universe and the Quantic Universe are both Uncanny Valley and Doorman. Uncanny Valley's Actionverse counterpart is a regular human instead of an android, while Doorman's Actionverse counterpart has a different physical appearance and can create physical portal doors instead of using existing doors to turn it into a portal.
The only noticeable characters who appeared exclusively in the Actionverse include Adam, a fisherman who was akumatized into Silurus, Kenya, and Kenya's father who was transformed into the Trash Krakken.

A Fairy Good Night - Plot developments
Max's mom, Claudie, finally gets to work at the International Space Station and, while she is away, Max is going to live at Marinette's place.
Cerise sends Max a love letter as a taunt that she knows that he is Pegasus. Her exact motives to send it are unknown, but it's highly possible she did it to undermine the Miraculers somehow, by taking advantage of one of its members' more vulnerable emotional state.
Max's autism, which had been previously revealed in "Wreckless Driver", is more explored:
He has a very strict schedule that he follows to a tee. This involves him doing things when the hours and minutes match exactly: he goes to bed at 9:21 pm (21:21), he sets his alarm at 7:07 am, he eats breakfast at 8:08 am and he goes to school at 9:09 am.
He always perfectly aligns his slippers at the bottom of the bed.
He always carries a heart-shaped piece of felt given to him by his mother everyday that he uses as a source of comfort. He later places the heart in a plastic bin while going to sleep.
Before going to sleep, he always check the location of the International Space Station with the help of Markov's planetary projection.

When boarding the tram, he always sits on the same seat, even waiting for it to become vacant when someone is sitting there.
He finds difficult to understand other people's emotional expressions or when they are being serious or joking.
He also finds comfort on his own friends' behavioral pattern, like Marinette's antics.
It is revealed that Max has relatives who live far away from Paris.
It is revealed that, despite enforcing the rule of the secret identities between the members of her team as much as possible, due to the dangers it comes with it, Marinette deep down wishes for every Miraculer to share who they are with the team.
It's possible this is a reaction to all the pressure of keeping a lot of secrets and knowing almost every Miraculer's secret identity, except for Cat Noir's.
It is confirmed that people can see the purple light masks created by the Butterfly Miraculous holder.
Previously, in "Illusion", the Gabriel Agreste illusion's light mask appeared on Adrien's videocall, but it was unclear whether that applied to real akumatized villains.

This episode has several similarities to "Sandboy", both of which have an unnamed kid akumatized off-screen whose power is bringing specific things about someone's psychoanalytic mind to life (their greatest dreams or nightmares).
The villain's powers are also similar to Wishmaker's, who fulfilled people's childhood dreams in a misguided way.
Max’s pajamas are shown for the first time.
This episode has a parallel to "Qilin", where Sabine put a laundry basket at the stairs to prevent Marinette from hurting herself when she tripped down the stairs.
Markov is able to see and hear Kaalki, even though kwamis normally cannot be detected by technology.
However, kwamis can choose to be detected by technology. For example, in "Optigami", the kwamis use a cellphone to communicate with Marinette.
This marks the second time that someone else besides Marinette/Ladybug has given one of the Magical Charms to a de-akumatized person, with the first being Zoé in "Queen Banana".
Claudié's colleague Thomas is probably a reference to Thomas Pesquet, a famous French astronaut who completed numerous space missions, notably to the International Space Station.

title: Abandoned theater
text:
Abandoned theater - Intro
The  is an abandoned theater in Paris. It was once the theater where the show "Paris, mon amour" was performed, in which Émilie, the mother of Adrien, starred.

title: Abandoned theater
text:
Abandoned theater - Description
Exterior
Facade
The facade of the theater is monumental with four arches, two large ones in the center and two smaller ones on the outside. The posters of the old shows are still hanging on the walls, while the doors are covered with fixed wooden panels, which prevent you from seeing the inside, while a "closed" sign informs you that the establishment is closed.
Roof
The roof of the theater looks like a large black dome with a lantern. This lantern has suffered the ravages of time. Plants have begun to climb its pillars, while the metal railings are partly damaged or even overgrown with plants. The structure was also affected, as beams broke, while pieces of stone broke off and fell under or into the lantern. A hole was also formed that led directly into the performance hall.
Interior
Unlike the exterior, the interior of the theater is in remarkable condition. The performance hall is a monumental Italian-style theater hall with red walls and gold decorations. It has three upper levels of balconies, the basket, the second gallery and the paradise. Closer to the stage, on all three levels, there are proscenium boxes, generally reserved for the more fortunate.

title: Abandoned theater
text:
Abandoned theater - Description
The parterre has a step with several rows of seats with red cushions and blue woodwork. This level is surrounded by several bathtubs, small cubicles bordered by Roman-inspired columns and red curtains.
The stage has a large red curtain and a wooden performance box with a rounded projection to highlight the solo artist. The decorations are still in excellent condition, including a decoration of a starry Paris. The grand piano is covered with a sheet.

is Adrien's personal hygiene room, adjacent to his room and located in the Agreste mansion.

title: Adrien's bathroom
text:
Adrien's bathroom - Appearance
Only accessible from Adrien's room, the bathroom is a rather rectangular room divided into two parts.
The first part has a window that looks out to illuminate it. The floor is mostly made of a shiny brown tile, while the rooms can have a dark brown tile or be white or beige. On the side of the window, rows of black drawers with gold profiles allow Adrien to store his underwear there. In front of the window, two rectangular sinks are built into a bathroom cabinet. Just above the sinks is a large mirror illuminated by round LEDs. On either side of the mirror are two large rectangular lights built vertically into the wall, above which are two speakers also built into the wall. At the top is a decorative part that forms diamond-shaped patterns. This small decoration is reproduced just above a double-glazed and slightly blurred door that gives access to the other part of the room.
The second part of the room also has a small window that looks out. It has white tiles on the floor and black tiles on the walls. The room has a showerhead hanging on the wall and a large white sink with stairs. When it is full, Adrien floats a plastic duck and adds rose petals.

title: Adrien's bathroom
text:
Adrien's bathroom - Trivia
Adrien's bathroom is important several times in the series:
In "Volpina", an iconic scene from the series took place in part, as Ladybug and Cat Noir rested "their foreheads together" despite being separated by the bathroom door.
In "Party Crasher", Master Fu entrusted the Monkey Miraculous to Kim while he was swimming in the bathtub.
In "Félix", Félix deleted the friend messages he received from Adrien before calling his friends pretending to be his cousin.
In "Strikeback", it was in the bathroom that Ladybug suffered a panic attack due to losing the Miraculouses to Shadow Moth.

text:

(He then puts the foam heart inside a glass jar filled with the same hearts and goes to sit on his bed.)

title: A Fairy Good Night/Transcript
text:
A Fairy Good Night/Transcript - Intro
Max: There! (Points at a satellite) The International Space Station. Between the constellations of the Eagle and the Snake.
Claudie: Well done, Max.
Max: Easy, the station orbits around Earth at a constant speed of 28,000 km/h. From there you just need to calculate the-
(Claudie's smartwatch rings with a call, interrupting Max.)
Claudie: Hm? Ah, it's Thomas. I'll call him back.
(She's about to hang up the call, but Max stops her.)
Max: That's okay, put him on speakerphone.
Claudie: (Answers the call) Hi, Thomas. You're on speakerphone, I'm with my son.

Claudie: (Surprised) Huh? (Looks up excited) Wah!
Max: Uh.
[ Theme Song ]
(Marinette's cellphone alarm goes off, but she turns it off and goes back to sleep.)

Kaalki: (Yawns)
(Max puts on his glasses.)
Sabine: Marinette, are you up?
Marinette: A-ah?! (Sits up) Yes, mom!
(Marinette hurriedly climbs down from her bed, but stops and climbs back up to kiss a photo of Adrien hanging on her wall.)

title: A Fairy Good Night/Transcript
text:
A Fairy Good Night/Transcript - Intro
(Max then makes sure the jam is spread evenly and sighs contentedly. He places the slice of bread back on the plate and adjusts his bowl of milk. With everything ready, he waits for a while, and when Markov’s screen shows that it’s 8:08, he begins to eat.)
(Marinette comes down the stairs, yawning, but then she trips on her feet and tumbles down the stairs, causing her to fall on a laundry basket that was at the bottom of the stairs. Sabine walks past her, unbothered.)

(Max, having already gotten ready for school, walks over to Claudie, who is running on a treadmill. She finishes her workout and wipes the sweat off her face with a towel, she then picks up a foam heart that was on the treadmill's display and kisses it before giving it to Max.)

Max: (Grabs the foam heart) See you later, mom.
(Max and Markov head towards the exit.)
Tom: The usual Mr. Sweet Tooth?

title: A Fairy Good Night/Transcript
text:
A Fairy Good Night/Transcript - Intro
(Marinette, ready for school, rushes down the stairs and into the bakery, tripping as she opens the door, but she quickly gets back on her feet, closes the door, and runs toward the bakery's exit.)
(Tom stops Marinette to give her a bag of chouquettes, which she grabs and smiles back at him before running off toward the exit.)
Tom: Have a good day, sweetie pie (Returns his attention to Mr. Sweet Tooth).

(The man on the seat notices Max, who is looking at him with uncertainty.)
Markov: Good morning, sir. Would you be kind enough to give your seat to my friend here? It's where he usually sits, which he finds reassuring.

Max: Thank you for your understanding, sir.
Man: (Nods) Hmm.
(The man stands up and sits on the opposite seat, letting Max sit on his former seat.)
(When Max enters the school, Marinette follows right behind him, but skids past the entrance as she tries to slow down. She then recovers and enters with Max.)
Marinette: Hey, Max.
Max: Good morning, Marinette.

title: A Fairy Good Night/Transcript
text:
A Fairy Good Night/Transcript - Intro
Claudie: The International Space Station orbits Earth at an average altitude of 400 Km above it. (Shows them a image of the Station) And this is where I'll be spending the weeks to come, and it's from up there where once a week I'll tell you all about my daily life.
Aglaé: Will you be on your own, in space?
Claudie: No, I'll be with fellow astronauts.
Marinette: (Stands up excited) Eeek! Like a super-long pajama party!
(The class laughs while Marinette sits down, embarrassed.)
Claudie: Kind of, but a pajama party with science experiments.
Kim: (To Max) And what's going to happen to you while your mom's gone?
Max: Since the rest of my family lives far away, the European Space Agency or ESA, will take me in.
Nino: I've heard that's where they design the space-exploration robots. It's going to be amazing, dude!
(Kim nods at what Nino said, but Max looks down with a sad expression.)
Aglaé: You don't look so happy about it. You love robots.
Max: It's not that simple, Aglaé. The truth is I have some autism-spectrum disorders, which make things a bit more complicated.
Markov: Max, I think a Level-1 explanation would be preferable.

title: A Fairy Good Night/Transcript
text:
A Fairy Good Night/Transcript - Intro
Max: (Nods) Many things that can seem normal and obvious to most people aren't for me. (An image of a chibi Max, along with other chibi figures, are watching another chibi figure express various emotions. The figures next to Max react normally to the emotions shown, but Max is just confused) For example, I might not see it when someone is feeling sad, or angry, or trying to be funny.
Alya: Well, if you're talking about Kim's jokes, don't sweat it, they're usually not funny.
Kim: Haha! (Slams his hand on the table) You're hilarious, Alya. That was a joke, right?
Max: I also need to plan everything ahead and create rituals. I don't do well with unexpected events.
Aglaé: But staying at the ESA is going to be a lot different than you're used to.
Max: Yes, but I'll try my best to adapt, (Holds the foam heart) and this piece of felt will help me when things feel too unfamiliar. Touching it instantly soothes me.
Marinette: Hmm... maybe there's a way to make things feel less unfamiliar, (Stands up) like coming to stay with one of us instead of the ESA while your mom's away. Being with a friend makes everything easier. I mean, if you want that, of course.

title: A Fairy Good Night/Transcript
text:
A Fairy Good Night/Transcript - Intro
Kim: Totally! You could stay at my place.
Rose: (She approaches Max from the side and raises her hand) Or mine!
Claudie: That's a clever idea. What do you thing, Max?
Max: I feel like it could help me, but since I've never done it before I can't be 100% sure.
Dr. Psiquat: Quite significant, indeed. Maybe you could do what your mom's done, (Max and Claudie look at each other) in order to find out whether she'd be able to live in space, she had to train.
Max: What would my training consist of?
Dr. Psiquat: Well, maybe you could start by... spending a single night at one of your friend's homes, if you feel like it of course.
Max: But where should I go? (Looks at his foam heart) Everyone offered to welcome me.
Dr. Psiquat: For this first time. I suggest you pick a friend with a kind and understanding family with whom you feel most comfortable and can share your needs if needed to be.
(Max thinks over it, then after a while he decides who to choose with a smile.)
Marinette: Will the Chicken Yassa be ready on time?
Tom: Yes, sweetheart, (Shows her the plate) and it should be "Egg-cellent".

title: A Fairy Good Night/Transcript
text:
A Fairy Good Night/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (Tom chuckles on the background) Dad, remember, easy on the jokes. They could confuse Max.
Tom: Right! No "punny" stuff. I-I mean, funny stuff (Chuckles).
(Marinette smiles and then goes to check on the guest room, where Sabine is arranging the bedsheets. The guest room’s arrangement looks very similar to that of Max’s room.)
Marinette: Perfect, mom!
(Tom peeks on the room.)
Tom: Max is going to be very surprised to find his room in our place.
Marinette: Well, no, he won't be surprised. That's the point. he must feel like he's home, nothing unexpected.
Sabine: (Worried) Are you sure we're not overdoing it, Marinette?
Marinette: 'Course not! You can never overdo being a good friend.
Max: (Puts his bowl inside the suitcase) And the bowl. I think it’s all there.
(Markov is displaying a hologram of a packing checklist. All the items minus the bowl are checked)
Markov: (Checks the bowl) Checklist completed!
Kaalki: Hmpf! This training is useless!
Markov: On the contrary, this exercise will increase your adaptability to unforeseen events by 82%.
Kaalki: Why force yourself to adapt when MY superpowers may allow you to solve all your problems?
Max: How do you mean?

title: A Fairy Good Night/Transcript
text:
A Fairy Good Night/Transcript - Intro
Kaalki: As Pegasus you could open a portal to go visit your mother on the space station at any time.
Max: Hey, that's true! (Smiles).
Markov: Using the Horse Miraculous for personal reasons goes against the rules laid down by the guardian.
Max: (Looks at Kaalki) Markov is right. Besides, my mom would find out that I'm a superhero, (Kaalki looks to the side, visibly annoyed) and Ladybug says we should keep our secret identities secret. In any case, I'm ready.
(Max closes his suit case.)
Claudie: Are you going to be okay, darling?
Max: Yes, mom, like I told you, Marinette and I are similar. Each of us has our own particular way of doing things.
Marinette: Hmm? (Points at herself) I have a particular way of doing things?
Max: Yes, Marinette, that's what makes you unique, and I find it reassuring that you're always the same way. Besides, I'm familiar with your place from previous visits, assuming nothing has changed.
(Marinette suddenly remembers all the changes they made to the guest room.)

title: A Fairy Good Night/Transcript
text:
A Fairy Good Night/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (Panicking) Hehe! Right! Of course! (Walks slowly to the side) And none of the rooms have changed since. Neither have we! We don't change either! I've got to put things back- Uh, I mean, I'll be right back! (Runs into the guess room and slams the door closed).
Max: (Unbothered) See? Everything'll be alright, mom. See you tomorrow morning.
(Max and Claudie give each other a big hug, and when they let go, Claudie kisses a foam heart and hands it to Max. He takes it with a smile and gently holds it, then Claudie leaves.)
(Sabine and Tom lead Max to the guest room.)
Sabine: And this will be your room.
Tom, Sabine, Max: Uh?
(When they open the door to the room, they're surprised to find Marinette in the middle of trying to get rid of the room's accommodations.)
Max: (Smiles) Hey, I have the same rocket sheets at home.
Marinette: (Holding a basket filled with various space-themed items.) Uh, no, no! These aren't rocket sheets. (Kicks the sheet to the floor) Not at all! They're rocket curtains! I was about to hang them.
Max: But there are already curtains.
Marinette: Yes, of course, but this room always has two layers of curtains. It's a family tradition.

title: A Fairy Good Night/Transcript
text:
A Fairy Good Night/Transcript - Intro
(Max grimaces, he soothes himself by caressing his foam heart.)
Marinette: Are you okay, Max?
Max: (Smiles at her) Well, on the Marinette meter, this is barely a 2.
Sabine: Come on, Max. I'll show you the bathroom.
(Sabine leads Max to the room's bathroom and Tom leaves the room and closes the door. As Max follows Sabine, he puts the foam heart in his pants pocket, which Marinette notices.)
(Tikki pops out from behind Marinette.)
Marinette: (To Tikki) The Marinette meter? There's a Marinette meter?
(Tikki shrugs.)
(Max checks the time on his Markov-Smartwatch and sees that it's 20:01 p.m. Then he sniffs the air.)
Max: It smells like my mom's Chicken Yassa, but it's not possible, I only eat it at my home.
(Marinette suddenly rushes to cover Tom and the food he is cooking with her body while smiling nervously at Max.)
Marinette: Really, that's weird because I can't smell a thing! Not a single thing! besides, that's not what we planned for dinner at all! (Laughs nervously).
Max: Oh? Then what are we going to eat?
Marinette: Oh, um... croissants, pain au chocolat, macarons, and chouquettes!
Max: For dinner?
Marinette: (Nods) Uh-Huh!

title: A Fairy Good Night/Transcript
text:
A Fairy Good Night/Transcript - Intro
(Sabine pauses from preparing the table to look at Marinette in surprise.)
Tom: (Goes with the flow) That's right! There's never a bad time for pastries. Why should we only have them for breakfast? (Laughs).
(Max gives them an unsure smile.)
(After a time skip, everyone is sitting at the dining table, in the middle of which are several bowls filled with croissants, pain au chocolat, and chouquettes.)
