(Max holds his foam heart in his hands.)
Marinette: You don't like pastries?
(Max sets aside the bowl he was given by them, gets up from the table, and leaves the room.)
Marinette: Uh... (Grabs her head with her hands) It's the whole breakfast-for-dinner idea! Maybe I overdid it and now we're at 12 on the Marinette meter (Marinette jumps up from her chair and falls backward to the floor) and that's too much for Max!
(Max returns to the dining room with his bowl in hand.)
Max: I needed my bowl, I've customized it with very useful features. (Sits down on the table and adjusts his bowl) Cocoa level, milk temperature and sugar ratio. Is this okay with you?
Marinette: (Sighs in relief and sits down again) If it's okay with you, it's okay with us.
(Tom and Sabine nod.)

title: A Fairy Good Night/Transcript
text:
A Fairy Good Night/Transcript - Intro
Tom: Night, Max.
Sabine: Sweet dreams.
Max: Goodnight Mrs. and Mr. Dupain-Cheng!
Marinette: (Waves at him) Goodnight!
Max: (Waves back) Goodnight, Marinette!
(Max closes the door and then puts the foam heart inside the glass jar filled with the same hearts, he goes to sit on the bed, takes off his slippers and then lines them up neatly in front of the bed.)
(Max then presses a button on his wristwatch, and Markov flies to his charging station on the bedside table and displays the current time on his screen, which is 21:18.)
(Max opens the top drawer of the bedside table and puts his glasses' case and Kaalki's lego-bed inside.)
Max: Kaalki!
(Kaalki floats over and lies down on her bed. Max closes the drawer of the bedside table and lies down on the bed. He glances at the Markov-clock and sees that it’s 21:21.)
(Max looks toward the door, as if waiting for Claudia to come in, but remembers that she isn't there, so he sighs and turns off the nightlight.)
Markov: Should I project the sky for you?
Max: Yes, I'll look for the space station on my own, like I will when my mom's up there.

title: A Fairy Good Night/Transcript
text:
A Fairy Good Night/Transcript - Intro
(Markov displays the hologram of space for him, and Max looks around searching for the International Space Station.)
Max: (Points at it) There, look! It's right there!
Markov: Well done, Max! Should I switch off now?
Max: Yes, thank you.
(Max opens the drawer of the bedside table where Kaalki is sleeping, puts his glasses inside the case, and closes it again. He then lies down on the bed again and puts on his sleep mask.)
Max: Goodnight, Markov!
Markov: Sweet dreams, Max (Turns off his screen).
(With Max and Markov asleep, Kaalki pokes her head out of the drawer. When she sees that they’re both asleep, she comes out of the drawer and flies up to the ceiling, going through it too.)
Marinette: I think Max adapted pretty well to our home.
Tikki: I figured he would. He adapted to Kaalki after all.
Marinette: (Laughs) You're right. Kaalki isn't the most understanding Kwami and... (Gasps) Oh, no! Maybe I shouldn't have entrusted Kaalki to Max. Maybe things aren't okay between them!

title: A Fairy Good Night/Transcript
text:
A Fairy Good Night/Transcript - Intro
Kaalki: (Pops out from under Marinette's bed) Maybe? Maybe in 6000 years of collaborating with humans, I've never been treated like that. (Flies around dramatically) I, who once slept on silk cushions embroidered with gold, am now sleeping in... Can you guess? A drawer! (Dramatically looks down).
Marinette: I'm sorry, Kaalki. It's my fault. (Looks down) I'll find a new holder for you.
Kaalki: What?! (Turns around to look at Marinette) That's out of the question! This kid has everything to be the greatest Horse Miraculous holder of all time! (Marinette and Tikki look at each other) Do you realize he knows the geographic coordinates of every city in the world by heart?
Marinette: So, there's no problem with Max?
Kaalki: The problem, dear guardian, is that beings as exceptional as Max and myself aren't receiving the recognition we deserve! You should do something about it, (An image of a golden statue of Pegasus on a horse appears behind her) and make sure that statues in our honor are erected everywhere on Earth!
Marinette: Uh, (Smiles) I'm afraid that's not going to happen, Kaalki. Are you sure that Max has adapted well to his role as a superhero? That everything's fine with him?

title: A Fairy Good Night/Transcript
text:
A Fairy Good Night/Transcript - Intro
Kaalki: (Waves her hoof dismissively) Come on! Who wouldn't be happy to be my holder?
(Suddenly, there's a knock on the trapdoor leading up to Marinette's room.)
Max: Marinette!
Marinette: Max?
Max: Can I talk to you?
Marinette: Hide! (Kaalki and Tikki fly off to hide, while Marinette starts to go down the ladder from her bed and opens the trapdoor.)
Max: Marinette, have you seen Kaalki?
Marinette: Uh, Kaalk-what?
Max: Not Kaalk-what, Kaalki. You know, my kwami.
Rena Rouge: (Suddenly appears sitting by the window) Marinette, why do we still have to keep our identities a secret? I mean, you told me you're Ladybug and it hasn't changed anything.
Luka: (Suddenly appearing in front of Max) Lying, lying again, always lying. The burden is too much to bear.
Marinette: (Falls back) Luka? Y...You're supposed to be in Brazil!
Rena Rouge: You'll feel better once you're rid of your secrets, Marinette. Let's drop the masks. (Transforms back into Alya)
Marinette: (Stands up) You're not real! None of this is possible! (Starts running up the ladder to her balcony.)
Meringue Man: (Chasing Mr. Sweet Tooth) Eat me! Eat me!
Mr. Sweet Tooth: I love meringues, but this is way too much!

title: A Fairy Good Night/Transcript
text:
A Fairy Good Night/Transcript - Intro
Meringue Man: Eat me!
Marinette: What is happening!?
Man: Ahhhhh! (Being chased by a bookshelf with a glowing face spitting out books) That's not what I meant when I said I wanted to read more books!
Tikki: (Comes out of hiding) Marinette, look at the moon!
(The moon now has a giant pacifier stuck onto it.)
Kaalki: (Comes out of hiding) I completely agree with your friends, guardian. No more living in hiding. Let the world know how exceptional I am.
Marinette: Those weren't my friends, Kaalki, they were just projections of things I wish for.
Tikki: You wish everyone could stop hiding their secret identities?
Marinette: It'd make things easier, yes. Unfortunately, it just can't be. (To Kaalki) Go find Max, the real one, and make sure he stays safe. There's an akumatized villain who's a very wishful thinker. Tikki, spots on! (Transforms into Ladybug and swings off of her balcony with her Yo-yo.)
Claudie: From now on, we'll never be apart. You won't have to adapt to this strange world or deal with any unexpected events again.
(Max's smile grows, and the Claudie projection slightly chuckles. She then leads him out of the room while holding his hand.)

title: A Fairy Good Night/Transcript
text:
A Fairy Good Night/Transcript - Intro
Kaalki: You're imagining the whole thing. This isn't your mother, it's just an illusion. Come on, transform!
Max: I can't transform. Ladybug hasn't called on me.
(Kaalki sadly follows them out of the bakery.)
Cat Noir: I got your message, M'Lady, but I haven't seen a villain anywhere.
Ladybug: And yet the moon has been turned into a pacifier.
Cat Noir: Hmm, maybe they're not in Paris...
Ladybug: But up there on the moon!
Cat Noir: Pegasus could go and have a look to make sure.
Ladybug: Pegasus?! No, let's not bother him in the middle of the night. He must be sleeping. We can go as Cosmobug and Astrocat!
Cat Noir: But it'll take us hours to reach the moon.
Ladybug: Mm... you're right. (She opens the Miraculous Call system on her yo-yo and spins through the icons.)
Max: Woah!
Claudie: (Holding an astronaut helmet out) You don't need training anymore.
(Max laughs and smiles but then receives an alert in his glasses that Ladybug's calling him.)
Max: Uh!
Kaalki: Ladybug is calling you! You can transform now!
Claudie: I'm not going on the space station anymore.
(Max gasps)
Ladybug: He's not answering.
Cat Noir: Maybe he's had a run-in with the akumatized villain.

title: A Fairy Good Night/Transcript
text:
A Fairy Good Night/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: Let's make sure one last time. (Clicks on the horse icon again.)
Max: Hmm?
Claudie: You can stay home... forever.
(Max looks at Kaalki, realizing something is wrong, then looks up at the moon and spots the giant pacifier.)
Max: (Steps back) No, mom. I want to keep exploring new things the way you explore space.
Kaalki: Well said, kid!
(Max quickly runs into the bakery.)
Kaalki: The time has finally come to let your talents speak for themselves.
Max: Kaalki, full gallop! (Transforms into Pegasus) Voyage! (Opens a portal on the floor and jumps through it.)
Cat Noir: Hmm?
Ladybug: Pegasus! Hahaha, I'm so glad to see you! Is everything okay?
Pegasus: Why wouldn't it be, Ladybug?
Ladybug: No reason! You're right, everything's fine, except there might be an akumatized villain on the moon, which is why we need your help.
Pegasus: Got it. Voyage! (Opens a portal to the moon)
[Transformation sequence]Cat Noir: (eats a purple magic cheese) Power Up! (transforms into Astrocat)
(Astrocat flies through the portal and checks that area of the moon, then goes back through the portal to the Eiffel Tower.)
Astrocat: No akumatized villain on that side of the moon.

title: A Fairy Good Night/Transcript
text:
A Fairy Good Night/Transcript - Intro
Pegasus: (Closes the portal) Voyage! (Opens a portal to a different side of the moon which Astrocat flies through.)
Ladybug: Hey, Pegasus, umm... I was wondering, how have things been since I've entrusted you with your miraculous and since you've been living with Kaalki?
Pegasus: Just fine. I've very happy to be a superhero and get the opportunity to be of use to you and the people of Paris.
Ladybug: Ah. (Smiles)
Astrocat: I think I've found our akumatized villain, but it's someone... rather unusual.
[Transformation sequence]Ladybug: (eats a purple magicaroon) Power Up! (transforms into Cosmobug)
(Cosmobug flies through the portal, following Astrocat.)
Astrocat: Selenite guards? A child asleep? Looks like it's going to be easy.
Cosmobug: We'll see about that once we've found her akumatized object.
Astrocat: I bet it's the pacifier. That's the symbol we could see from Earth.
(Chrysalis begins establishing telepathic connection with the akumatized child.)
Cosmobug: The butterfly villain's about to wake her up.
Chrysalis: (In Fairy Good Night's mind) Sorry to wake you, Fairy Good Night, but Ladybug and Cat Noir are about to disrupt your peace and quiet.

title: A Fairy Good Night/Transcript
text:
A Fairy Good Night/Transcript - Intro
Fairy Good Night: (Gets up from the bed) Ugh, even here I can't enjoy my pacifier? No fair! Guards!
(The moon guards start getting up to look for the superheroes.)
Astrocat: Maybe this doesn't look so easy now.
(A moon guard swings its spear and starts running towards them. Both heroes dodge out of the way.)
Astrocat: Cataclysm! (He flies toward the guard at high speed and uses his power to crumble it into pieces, only for all the parts to start forming back together again.) Oh! (nervous laugh)
Fairy Good Night: Leave me alone! I'm not doing anything bad. I'm a good girl. I make people's biggest wishes come true!
Chrysalis: (In Fairy Good Night's mind) Fairy Good Night, you're wasting your time trying to convince Ladybug and Cat Noir. There's only one way to get rid of them, seize their miraculous.
Fairy Good Night: Guards, seize their miraculous! (The moon guards start running towards the heroes)
Cosmobug: Lucky Charm! (Gets soap)
Astrocat: Soap? What are you planning to do? (Cosmobug dodges a strike from a moon guard) Wash them away?

title: A Fairy Good Night/Transcript
text:
A Fairy Good Night/Transcript - Intro
Cosmobug: (Looks around but can't find a solution.) No. That's not it. (The moon guards start throwing their spears at her, forcing her to dodge in the air.) Lucky Charm! (Gets a roller skate) Huh?
Astrocat: (While fighting with the guards) I'd say you're on a "roll," but the look on your face is telling me otherwise.
Cosmobug: First some soap now this skate?
Astrocat: They must mean something, don't you think?
Cosmobug: Sure, but- uh! (Dodges another spear throw) What? I'm just not seeing it. Lucky Charm! (Gets a banana peel while she keeps dodging throws from the moon guards) What does the soap, roller skate, and banana have in common?
(Astrocat slides between a guard's legs and uses his Staff to sweep them off their feet.)
Cosmobug: Ah! Sliding! That's what!
Astrocat: You want to use a banana peel to make her fall to the ground?
Cosmobug: No, not to the ground. To Earth!
Astrocat: Oh, got it!
(Astrocat cataclysms another guard and continues fighting them, while Cosmobug throws the banana peel out to the other side of the battlefield and starts chasing Fairy Good Night, swinging her yo-yo at her. Fairy Good Night runs from her and then slips on the banana peel.)

title: A Fairy Good Night/Transcript
text:
A Fairy Good Night/Transcript - Intro
Fairy Good Night: Ahhhhh!
Cosmobug: (Through her earpiece) Pegasus, you're up!
(A portal opens beneath Fairy Good Night before she can touch the ground.)
Pegasus: Welcome to Earth.
Fairy Good Night: No! No! (Tries to run away)
Pegasus:  (Opens another portal in front of her that she runs through, making her end up in the moving Eiffel Tower elevator. Pegasus waves to her through the portal.) Bon voyage!
(Another portal opens right next to the villain. Astrocat reaches his hand out.)

title: A Shared Secret/Transcript
text:
A Shared Secret/Transcript - Intro
Narrator: Some events are known to all. Others are known to only one person, me. For only I know every secret.
[Intro]
Narrator: Marinette Dupain-Cheng was able to keep the secret of her secret identity for a while, but that secret eventually became too heavy to bear. So, she shared it with her best friend, Alya Césaire.
Alya: Marinette, I'm your very best friend.
Marinette: And I… I'm Ladybug.
(Alya becomes surprised, that someone, whom she admired the most was her best friend, as she recalling her moments with Marinette/Ladybug.)
Narrator: At that moment, Alya suddenly understood everything.
Alya: Marinette?
Marinette: (holding Kaalki while the other kwamis watch the monitor) Oh, Alya! What do you think of my new squishies? Pretty cute, right?
Alya: What new squishies? (Alya, Mylène, Juleka and Rose become surprised.)
Marinette: Uh- (looks at Kaalki, confused)
Tikki: Marinette, we're magical creatures, remember? We can't be seen or heard on screen or in photographs.
Ziggy: Ooh, so that's why I'm not showing up on these magic paintings!
Marinette: Right, she can only see me and I look completely ridiculous, don't I?
Alya: Marinette, are you feeling okay?

title: A Shared Secret/Transcript
text:
A Shared Secret/Transcript - Intro
(Syren leaps out, and dives back in, pushing Kim underwater with her. Marinette tries to run away to transform.)
Narrator: Her sudden disappearances whenever a supervillain showed up.
Alya: Where is he? Can you see him? (sees Marinette paddling away from the theater in a trash bin) Marinette, what are you doing?!
Marinette: Um, I'm gonna go get help! (tips the bin, falling into the water, and grabs hold of the bin) I'm fine!
Narrator: Her nonsensical excuses.
Commentator: (Marinette watches the live broadcast on air and gulps anxiously.) When we return from commercial, Nadja Chamack will be joined by Ladybug and Cat Noir for an incredible, exclusive interview.
Manon: (Points at Nadja on the monitor.) Mommy, there's mommy!
Alya: Why can't I get an exclusive interview like that for my Ladyblog? (Sighs.)
Marinette: (Stutters) Oh, I forgot to err, tell my bakery something. They're in the parents downstairs. Do you mind keeping an eye on Manon while I'm not here?
Alya: Don't you mean tell your parents something in the bakery?

title: A Shared Secret/Transcript
text:
A Shared Secret/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (Continues stuttering.) Err, right. Well, err, sometimes, it can take a while - they don't always understand even when I explain. Err, actually, it's not their fault, they...
Alya: Marinette?
Marinette: Yes?
Alya: Go!
Marinette: Right! (Marinette leaves.)
Narrator: It all finally made sense.
Narrator: Marinette confessed that their friendship was what had helped her fully assume her role as a superhero.
Marinette: Well, I'm still not sure I'm up for this, but Alya's in danger. I can't sit back and do nothing.
Narrator: Superhero Alya had instantly become an admire of, even dedicating a blog to her. Then Alya remembered everything that Marinette had done for her as Ladybug.
Narrator: Even giving her a chance of becoming a superhero herself.
Ladybug: (as she holds out the Miraculous box to Alya) Alya Césaire, here is the Miraculous of the fox, which grants the power of illusion. You will use it for the greater good. (Alya takes the box) Once the job is done, you will return the Miraculous to me. Can I trust you?
Alya: Totally, Ladybug.
[Transformation Sequence]Alya: Trixx, let's pounce! (Alya transforms into Rena Rouge.)

title: A Shared Secret/Transcript
text:
A Shared Secret/Transcript - Intro
Narrator: And trusting her to the point of leaving her own Miraculous with her to replace her one day when she had to leave Paris.
Alya: You can't leave Paris. What do we do if there's a supervillain and you're in London?
Marinette: Well, we'll do... (takes off her earrings and hands it over to Alya, along with her keys) this.
Alya: What do you expect me to do with these??
Marinette: If everything goes fine, nothing. Otherwise, Ladybug. And don't forget to feed the kwamis. (hugs Alya) I trust you.
Announcer: Startrain number 6966 to London is about to depart.
[Transformation Sequence]Alya: Spots on! (Alya transforms into Scarabella.)
Narrator: Thus, Alya became Scarabella.
Narrator: And even though Scarabella was a capable superhero, it was as Rena Rouge, then Rena Furtive, that Alya truly found her place.
Narrator: In their daily lives, knowing Marinette's secret allowed Alya to help her best friend in her role as a superhero.
Alya: I'm gonna go through all these notes and see if I can make any sense out of it.
Ladybug: Huh! You would do that?

title: A Shared Secret/Transcript
text:

title: Adrien's room
text:
Adrien's room - Intro
is the bedroom of Adrien Agreste, located in the Agreste mansion. Starting from season 6, the room has been split into two floors, with the upper floor used by Adrien as a bedroom, and the lower floor used by Kitty Section for band rehearsals.

title: Adrien's room
text:
Adrien's room - Appearance
First saga
Adrien's bedroom is split over two levels, with access to a spacious bathroom. It features large windows along one wall. The lower level features a double bed, a desk with computer, a white sofa with a large-screen TV, and various games, including a foosball table and arcade games. The upper level, accessed via a spiral staircase, offers ample storage space, as well as access to a climbing wall and a skateboard ramp.
Second saga
After the death of his father, Adrien undertakes major renovations to his bedroom. It now consists of two rooms.
The first is the original room, completely redesigned as a game room, party room, and rehearsal room. The game room have been moved closer to the bay window, and the football table has been placed nearby. It now features a large multicolored sofa and a slightly raised stage with the Kitty Section's musical instruments. The upstairs balcony and its large bookcase remain.
The main change is the addition of a staircase leading to the new room, Adrien's actual bedroom. Still under construction, it has white walls with a blue and yellow section, a gray floor, and another bay window with large white curtains.

title: Adrien's room

There are also several cardboard boxes and a makeshift cardboard wardrobe, as well as a cube-shaped wardrobe that serves as a bedside table.

title: Adrien's schedule
text:
Adrien's schedule - Intro
is a chart showing the schedule of Adrien Agreste's daily activities. The chart is concealed in a pull-down mechanism which is attached to the ceiling under the loft of Marinette's room where her bed is located.

title: Adrien's schedule
text:
Adrien's schedule - Appearance
The schedule is a calendar that goes from January to June. It includes dates for fencing, basketball, photo shoots, Chinese lessons, and other events.

title: Adrien's schedule
text:
Adrien's schedule - Trivia
It says "volontariat au centre de chatons abandonnés" on June 1st, which translates to "volunteering at the abandoned kitten center."
February 4th has "Lunch with Thomas" written in it. This is a reference to Thomas Astruc.
There's also "lunch with Young Sun" on January 30th and "lunch with Adrianaaaa" on May 23rd.
According to this schedule, Adrien's fencing lessons are always on Fridays, his Chinese classes are on Mondays, and he has basketball on Wednesdays.
Alya calls Marinette "insane" for owning such an elaborate schedule on Adrien.
Days in red are public holidays. Most of them correspond to official public holidays in France.
Monday, January 1 is New Year's Day.
Monday, April 21 most likely is Easter Monday.
Friday, May 1 is May Day/Labor Day.
Friday, May 8 is Victory in Europe Day.
Friday, May 29 appears to represent Ascension Day. However, Ascension Day falls on a Thursday, 39 days after Easter Sunday, while this day falls on a Friday, 39 days after Easter Monday.
The vacation from April 19 to April 27 is decorated with an illustration that appears to be the character Ella from the show Sammy & Co, which is produced in part by Zag.
Error

title: Adrien's schedule
text:
Adrien's schedule - Trivia
Every month is shown with an incorrect number of days:
January, March and May are shown as having 30 days, whereas they actually have 31.
February, April and June are shown as having 31 days, whereas they actually have fewer — April and June with 30 and February with 28 or 29.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - Intro
Adrien Agreste is a teenage boy who was chosen by Master Fu to wield the Cat Miraculous and become the superhero Cat Noir.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - Before Season 1
Adrien Agreste is the son of the late famous French fashion designer, Gabriel Agreste and the late former British aristocrat from the noble Graham de Vanily family and actress, Émilie Agreste. His parents tried fruitlessly to have a child, but due to his mother's infertility, they were unsuccessful. His parents even went back to his maternal grandparents for help but still, nothing worked. Not until one day, Adrien was manifested by Émilie from her and Gabriel's emotions of love for each other in her womb with the help of the broken Peacock Miraculous and placed his amok in the family rings. When he was born, his parents were very happy and emotional, and their lives become perfect with his presence; he was called their "little prince and "little miracle" ever since.
Adrien was home-schooled for his entire life and lived in the Agreste mansion with his parents. At this time, his only friend was Chloé. His mother went missing within nine months before Adrien was allowed to go to school. This changed his father, making him more distant. Adrien started modeling in order to get closer to him.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Ladybug & Cat Noir", Adrien ran away from home and tried to go to school against his father's orders. He almost made it inside, but was followed by Nathalie and his bodyguard. He pleaded with them to let him go to school. Before he could go in, he saw an old man struggling to get up from the sidewalk, with his cane out of reach. Adrien handed the man his cane but was forced to return home. Nathalie was home-schooling him when Gabriel scolded him for leaving the safety of the mansion.
Upset, Adrien ran to his room and cried into his pillow. When he felt the ground shake, he ran outside seeing Stoneheart throw a van at Agent Roger, and turned on the news in his room to learn more. Then, noticed a black box on his coffee table. Opening it, a flash of light entered the room and he met Plagg. After chasing him around his room, he put on the Cat Miraculous and transformed into a superhero. Eager, Adrien didn't listen to all of Plagg's instructions and left his room, jumping with his baton across Paris.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
Getting the hang of walking on his baton, he fell off when Ladybug fell from the sky and crashed into him. Once untangled, he introduced himself as Cat Noir and ran off to fight Stoneheart while his partner followed. At the Stade des Princes, Cat Noir stopped him from attacking Kim, saved Alya from being hurt but misused Cataclysm on a soccer goal. Ladybug and Cat Noir took down Stoneheart and turned him back into Ivan. He returned to his house before he detransformed and tried feeding Plagg food his personal chef provided, but Plagg only accepted Camembert, much to his annoyance. That wasn't the only thing that brought him down: because Ladybug didn't capture the akuma, it multiplied and affected innocent Parisian citizens, turning them into Stonehearts. Even worse, Cat Noir couldn't repair the damage nor capture the akuma leaving him thinking.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Stoneheart", the next day, Adrien snuck out of the house again. He complained about Plagg's Camembert addiction and had enough with being cooped up at home. Adrien made it to school before Nathalie could catch him. Chloé led him around the school and signed autographs for the people who asked. When Chloé put gum on Marinette's seat, he tried to remove it, but Marinette was mad and made him stop. Nino, seeing Adrien's predicament, decided to become his friend.
When Stoneheart busted down Literature classroom's door and took Chloé and Mylène captive, Adrien ran from the room and transformed into Cat Noir. He hit Stoneheart and caused him to grow. Stoneheart called on his minions and they attacked the hero, letting the original one walk away. When one of them threw a car at Alya, he threw his staff at it, keeping it from killing her however, this led to him being captured. Until Ladybug freed him when she returned his staff. They went after the original Stoneheart who was on the Eiffel Tower.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
When Ladybug didn't feel like she could succeed in taking down Stoneheart; since she failed once and the police didn't trust her Cat Noir encouraged her to try again. When Hawk Moth told him to give up his Miraculous, he saw Ladybug step up and capture all the akumas creating his face. Then heard the promised that they would defend Paris and keep them safe. It was in that moment that Cat Noir decided that he loved the girl under the mask. He followed Ladybug up the Eiffel Tower to free Mylène and fought off the other Stonehearts while she figured out what to do with her Lucky Charm. When Ladybug made Stoneheart drop his akumatized object, Cat Noir threw it up to her so that she could free the akuma. He used Cataclysm so that he could catch Ivan. After all the damage was fixed he couldn't wait to see Ladybug again and leaves.
The next day, Adrien went to school with permission from his father. He apologized to Marinette for the gum incident and explained he was only trying to help her. Happy that he was forgiven and made a new friend, he went home.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
In "The Bubbler", it was Adrien's birthday and wanted to have a birthday party, but his father wouldn't let him. Nino tried to convince Gabriel to give Adrien one, but he failed and was banished from the Agreste mansion. After lunch, he went outside the mansion to find all of his classmates gathered in the courtyard and an akumatized Nino hovering above everyone on a bubble. Adrien ran inside to transform, but was convinced by Plagg to enjoy the party.
He listened to Plagg's advice and joined the party. At first, Adrien didn't notice how miserable everyone else was, but when Ladybug showed up, he ran of to transform. Cat Noir fought with her against Bubbler, but ended up surrounded in red bubbles and then captured by them. He demanded Bubbler bring the adults back, but that only angered him; they were sent skyward. Cat Noir used Cataclysm to escape from the bubble, threw his baton at the Eiffel Tower and let Ladybug swing them back to the ground. They returned to the Agreste mansion, but it was too late; the students were sent skyward. He and Ladybug chased Bubbler up the Eiffel Tower and distracted him with a broken air vent until Ladybug captured his akuma.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
Back at the Agreste mansion, Adrien opened the gift Marinette left, believing it to be from his father. He wore the scarf to school the next day, very happy with the results.
In "Mr. Pigeon", Adrien heard of a fashion design competition happening at his school as the prize; he would model the hat that won the event. He saw Marinette's designs and was excited for her work. When Mr. Pigeon attacked Paris with his pigeons, he transformed into Cat Noir to help Ladybug which wasn't easy with his feather allergy. Warned her, that the park keepers were disappearing too so he acted as bait to get Mr. Pigeon's attention but was carried away. When Ladybug followed, they were trapped in a cage until he freed them with Cataclysm.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
They ran inside Le Grand Paris so Cat Noir could feed Plagg. Afterwards he followed Ladybug to the Grand Palais where they found the park keepers trapped inside. Ladybug planned on him grabbing the bird call, but his allergies kicked in, leading them into a brawl against Mr. Pigeon and his pigeon fists. Using Ladybug's Lucky Charm, the pigeons turned against Mr. Pigeon, leaving him defenseless. They smashed the bird call, Ladybug purified the akuma, and the city was returned to normal. With less than an hour left to the end of the competition, Adrien returned to the school, showed his father around, congratulated Marinette when she proved her hat was her own design, and beat Chloé winning the competition. But as soon as he put the hat on Adrien sneezed telling his friends that he was allergic to feathers.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Stormy Weather", Adrien had a photoshoot in the park. He saw Marinette and Alya when Manon interrupted the shoot by shouting at her. When Stormy Weather attacked the park in the middle of the shoot, he left to transformed into Cat Noir and confronted Stormy Weather but was blown away. Helped to his feet by Ladybug he was stopped by her from flirting. Then, they fought Stormy Weather but were blown away twice and trapped in a bus.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
When freed, they heroes ran to the KIDZ+ studio and broke down the door, but she wasn't there and found a recording. Stormy Weather then turned off the lights and ran to the rooftop. Because Cat Noir had night vision, he led Ladybug there. He defended themselves from the falling hail while Ladybug figured out what to do with her Lucky Charm then summoned his Cataclysm and took down a billboard. Stormy Weather blasted a hole through the billboard before it could crash into her. Ladybug wrapped her yo-yo around Stormy Weather's ankle, preventing her from escaping. Ladybug pulled her back to the ground and she lost her umbrella. Cat Noir threw it to her and she broke it, purifying the akuma and returning the city to normal. Adrien returned to the park and finished the photo shoot with Manon as his partner.
In "Timebreaker", Adrien was at the Trocadéro to watch Alix's and Kim's race as well as liked Marinette's banner. When she dropped Alix's watch, he caught it, but Chloé grabbed it, dropped it and broke it leading to Alix's akumatization. He transformed into Cat Noir and avoided Timebreaker's touch, but ended up disappearing when he protected Ladybug.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
In the past, Adrien didn't remember disappearing and was excited to work with two Ladybugs. The Ladybugs summoned their Lucky Charms and came up with a plan to stop the Timebreakers while he distracted them by using Cataclysm. Future Ladybug wrapped the Timebreakers' ankles together while Past Ladybug created a ramp that flung them in the air. The Ladybugs broke the rollerskates, released the akumas, and cleansed the city, merging the two Ladybugs and Timebreakers. When Ladybug left, Cat Noir was determined to make her fall for him.
In "Copycat", Adrien was at fencing practice at the school when he left to go to the locker room, found a new voicemail from an unrecognized number on his phone, and found Plagg had eaten all of his Camembert. Noticing the time, he and Plagg transformed into Cat Noir and hurried over to the statue ceremony in the park. At the ceremony, he proceeded to boast about himself, saying he was the better of the duo and that they were in a relationship making Théo Barbot very jealous.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
After the ceremony, Cat Noir returned to the school and detransformed. Adrien grabbed his bag and went home, but immediately returned to school because his phone was missing. On the way, he saw a news report about Cat Noir stealing the Mona Lisa. He and Plagg transformed again and went to the Louvre to help, but were caught by police but escaped and told Ladybug he was innocent. The police chased him through Paris until he went in a subway system and came out on the other side as Adrien. Plagg guessed the thief was akumatized and Adrien agreed. They transformed again and went to Théo's studio where Cat Noir was trapped by Copycat. Ladybug arrived and freed Cat Noir with Copycat's Cataclysm. Using a spoon, Cat Noir and Ladybug defeated Copycat and returned the city (and the Mona Lisa) to normal. Adrien returned to school, but his phone wasn't there. The next day, Adrien found his phone in his bag. Nino invited him to the movies that night, and Alya and Marinette tagged along.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
In "The Pharaoh", Adrien was watching the Ladyblog's most recent update, discussing with Plagg the possibility that Ladybug went to his school and girls were better than cheese. When he saw Alya's new livestream, he immediately transformed into Cat Noir and went to the Louvre. He arrived just as the Pharaoh was trying to leave. Before he could land a blow, he was thrown into a sarcophagus. While Ladybug freed him The Pharaoh escaped with Alya. They were still trapped in the room, so he used Cataclysm to break the bars of the exhibit leaving Ladybug to detransform and feed Plagg.
When Plagg was full, he transformed again and freed Ladybug from a time-shifting bubble. Once outside he distracted all the mummies and gave Ladybug time to save Alya but it didn't work, then he and Ladybug trapped the mummies in a bus. Sometime before this, he used Cataclysm again. Cat Noir watched as Ladybug saved Alya for a second time and returned the city to normal. As Ladybug left, he asked Alya if she wanted to know his age with little time left he ran away and went home to study for a history test the next day.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Lady Wifi", Adrien was late to an akumatized villain battle, but he helped Ladybug defeat the villain. The next day in class, he found out about Alya's theory of Chloé being Ladybug. When Lady Wifi appeared on screen, he ran from the school and transformed into Cat Noir, to stake out Le Grand Paris to protect Chloé. Seeing her through his phone he became shocked that Alya could be right until the real Ladybug showed up beside him. When Lady Wifi appeared in Chloé's room, he and Ladybug entered the scene and fought her. After Chloé was freed, they led Lady Wifi down to the basement to trap her, but she caught onto what they were planning and set up a trap of her own in Le Grand Paris' restaurant.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
Which led Cat Noir being separated from Ladybug but managed to catch up seeing her trapped against a kitchen wall. But, was thrown and trapped in the freezer with the impact making his ring fall off his hand, forcing him to detransform. Luckily, he found it and transformed before Ladybug could free him, thus protecting his identity. Seeing that she used her Lucky Charm, he listened to her plan and hurried to defeat Lady Wifi before she detransformed. He destroyed the WiFi antenna on the roof, cutting Lady Wifi's powers off and the two fought hand to hand until Ladybug showed up. They defeated Lady Wifi, captured her akuma and returned the city to normal. With only a minute left on her Miraculous, Cat Noir followed Ladybug downstairs asking her to stay promising that he won't tell anyone her identity. Hearing her words instead of looking, Cat Noir closed the door, ran outside and detransformed. In his heart, Adrien wanted to know who she was; with her being so close, but he hadn't been thinking clearly. He and Plagg returned home for the night.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
In "The Evillustrator", Adrien was partnered with Alya and Nino for their particle physics presentation. Then, went to the library after class to research the presentation, but was interrupted when Chloé was attacked by several berets and a hairdryer. Hiding behind a bookcase, he transformed into Cat Noir and helped Ladybug take down the hairdryer. They tried taking down the villain too, but he escaped. Instead, Ladybug and Cat Noir went to Le Grand Paris to investigate why the Evillustrator was after Chloé. After Ladybug left in an angry huff, he was left behind to guard her but later, was called by Ladybug and told was to guard Marinette while she was on her date with Evillustrator.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
He went to Marinette's house, introducing himself to her and telling her not to worry about the evening; all she had to do was take Evillustrator's stylus. He followed Marinette and Evillustrator along the shoreline of the Seine. When they passed under the pont, he boarded the boat, but was heard by Evillustrator. He blocked him from going after Marinette in order to get his stylus back, but the villain kicked Cat Noir's staff away, knocking the stylus out of her hand. Cat Noir tried to attack him, but was trapped in a cube with her and left on a sinking ship. Marinette helped him remove the cube and together, they escaped. After leaving Marinette safely on the streets by La Seine, he went to Le Grand Paris and met Ladybug there. Together, they protected Chloé and took down the Evillustrator. The next day at school, Adrien asked Marinette what she thought about Cat Noir and him protecting her. She stuttered and stumbled over her words, but her overall impression of him was positive. He patted her shoulder and left for class.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Rogercop", Adrien attended Career Day at school, called his father but was sad that he wasn't coming and went back inside the classroom. After an accident, noticing Chloé's bracelet on Plagg's head by his feet they left the room. Once out, he wanted an explanation because of the predicament they're in; meanwhile he tried to get the bracelet off him to no avail. However when Rogercop attacked Adrien attempted to transform but Plagg warned him if the bracelet gets absorbed his powers will be damaged. Thanks to some quick thinking he manages to free Plagg and transform. Then, the duo fought and followed Rogercop to City Hall. But soon had police turn on them and yet managed to escape. By nightfall, hearing that they're now wanted felons the cat had the idea of defending themselves in a court of law. However, the heroine had another idea; Cat Noir distracted the guards so Ladybug could sneak inside and after the guards were finished he joins her. Together using Cataclysm to trap the villain and a pair of oven mitts they defeat Rogercop and seeing that his transformation was about to wear off he says that Ladybug wouldn't be able to resist him with his mask off before leaving.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Dark Cupid", during school Adrien attempted to write a love poem to Ladybug but threw it away and went home. While in his room, he moped over who Ladybug could be but Plagg comments that he knew nothing about her. Adrien replies saying Plagg knew nothing about love, then wanting to confess his love he transformed into Cat Noir. Finding Ladybug, he tried to reveal his love for her but before he could he saw Dark Cupid preparing to fire an arrow but turns her around taking the hit instead. Being under the arrow's affect he turned against her and teamed up with Dark Cupid. The cat caught up with Ladybug trying to fight her when the heroine asked why was he full of hate he believed hate conquers all but seeing her intentions he fled in fear until Ladybug tied him down trying in vain to kiss him until Dark Cupid frees him. As the fight continues, Cat Noir attempted to use Catalysm on Ladybug very curious on what would happen if his power was used on someone.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
Ladybug barely avoids it but Cat Noir pinned her down while being distracted he got kissed by her breaking the spell. After Dark Cupid was defeated, he tried to tell Ladybug something thinking he remembered what happened she tried to explain confused he wanted to confess his love but due to his time being almost up the duo parted ways. Adrien returned home ashamed of how cruel he was being to Ladybug, then noticed someone answered his poem but saw it wasn't signed. Seeing a ladybug, he believed that it might have come from the heroine and swoons over believing he still has a chance to win her love.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Horrificator", Adrien played the leading role Officer Jones in a monster movie the class was preparing for a film contest but there were complications when Mylène ran away out of fear. Needing a new actress Chloé took over and with rewritten script he tried to back away from her during the kissing scene but was intervened by Alya and Marinette. Then, he worked with Marinette who was the temporary leading actress and moved into the kissing scene again but was stopped by Chloé. Afterwards, they all heard a scream and found pink slime realizing what it meant Adrien thought of a quick excuse claiming he left something behind. With Adrien's whereabouts covered, he transformed into Cat Noir meeting up with Ladybug, the hero explained that the slime was indestructible. While he and Ladybug protected the other students they started looking for villain during their fight against Horrificator they discovered that the monster feeds off of fear and that it's Mylène.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
They followed the villain to the maintenance room where Cat Noir and Ladybug found the captured students but couldn't free them. Using Cataclysm on the bars the hero was able to trap Horrificator, using his staff as a pair of drumsticks and makeshift drums. He followed Ladybug's lead in calming the villain down, with that she purified the akuma and freed the school. Afterwards, when their movie didn't make the cut Adrien comforted Nino believing all great directors start from nothing.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Darkblade", after dealing with an akuma attack Adrien went to school and during their free time he heard from Alya that Marinette was running for class representative. He said he'll give Marinette his vote if she can give a good speech, sometime later during the middle of his fencing class Adrien gets defeated by his instructor's finishing move being impressed. But shortly afterwards he saw his fencing teacher get akumatized into Darkblade and he transforms into Cat Noir. Then, the hero fought against the villain and his knights all the way to the Pont des Arts, but lost his staff and was outnumbered with nowhere else to go Cat Noir pretended to fall off the bridge but heard the knights heading for City Hall.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
Meeting the knights there, he was ready for round two but got cornered until Ladybug rescued him. They did their best to protect City Hall to discover that the knights were after flag despite their efforts Darkblade got his banner. The hero refused to give up and challenged Darkblade once more this time he defeats the villain's finishing move and thanks to a windup toy he tossed the sword to Ladybug where the heroine captured the akuma, cleansed the city and left to detransform. Back inside Adrien claimed like Marinette he was turned into a knight. Then, heard that Marinette's diary was stolen by Chloé and her speech about being elected by fair means. By the next day Adrien cheered for Marinette who won the election.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
In "The Mime", Adrien was heading over to the mime performance show but was disappointed that his father wasn't coming until his bodyguard slammed on the breaks and they were attacked by The Mime. He was told by Ladybug to get to safety but was briefly distracted by her beauty; once Adrien separates himself from his bodyguard and Natalie he transforms into Cat Noir. However, the fight was cut short when The Mime puts them in a cage and a huffy kitty tried to ram the bars but they disappeared before he could. They quickly chased The Mime down to discover he's after the theater troupe bus, Cat Noir worked as a distraction while Ladybug tried to get his hat and get everyone to safety. Once they stopped the cat got locked in a sword fight with the villain until he gets pinned but with a quick assist from Ladybug he escaped.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
With a shoe box and using villain's powers against him they were able to trap The Mime, capture the akuma and cleanse the city. He noticed that Ladybug is about to transform back and was bummed that he couldn't be her date to the performance. After that Adrien detransformed and attended the performance happy that he wasn't going to be alone when Alya and Marinette were seated next to him. Once the show ends Adrien returned home.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Princess Fragrance", after dealing with The Magician of Misfortune; Adrien detransforms and went to school but missed his Chemistry Class. Once there he saw that Marinette trip down the stairs but managed to catch her and asks if she was okay. Then, he went home watching Prince Ali's event from his room but saw Princess Fragrance attacking the event and quickly transformed into Cat Noir. He went to the Le Grand Paris Hotel after a quick confrontation with the villain the hero tried to get Prince Ali out of Paris but ended up under the affects of Princess Fragrance's perfume becoming her minion. When Ladybug finally arrived, he fought against her and tried to use Cataclysm but ended up using it on the fireworks control panel box on an upcoming boat. After that he was pulled into the river, when he got out Cat Noir was licking himself dry until the Miraculous Ladybug power returned him to normal and wondered where Ladybug was.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Animan", Adrien saw Nino eyeing Marinette and Alya from a distance and was informed that his best friend had a crush on Marinette. Then, comes with Nino as support so he can ask her to the zoo but not wanting to be alone Adrien gets asked by Nino to come with him and he agrees. At the zoo, he stayed hidden but remained in contact with Nino by ear communicator, when Plagg wanted to hear more Adrien hushed him. In the midst of him coaching Nino, he heard that the message got scrambled and was shocked that Nino had a crush on Alya. Seeing the animal stampede, he transforms into Cat Noir and confronted Animan with Ladybug who was after Kim. He attempted to grab the charm but seeing the other animals the duo quickly retreats.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
While running the heroes attempted to put the animals back in their cages but to no avail. On higher ground they moved back to the original plan but discovered that Animan escaped. They quickly find Kim and Animan on the bridge after he was restrained Cat Noir placed a tracer on Kim but when the villain escaped again they followed Kim to Marinette's parent's bakery. Once inside they planned their next move but not before he eyed Marinette's family picture. Using Kim's wristband and air freshener to cover their scent, the cat noticed a tissue box and wanted to trap him but it would only work until the villain got bigger. They decided to use a nearby bus, upon hearing Animan they hid and caught him but his transformation into a panther caused Cat Noir and Ladybug to flee leading him into the bus. Upon fighting him they discovered that each transformation tired Animan out using Cataclysm on the bus console they waited until the villain got tired to grab the akuma.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
Which worked until Animan changed into a T-Rex causing them to seek cover. While Cat Noir worked as a distraction Ladybug restrained him but when he moved in to grab the charm he almost got chomped. When he realized what Ladybug was trying to do he watched in horror as his partner was eaten filled with anger the hero was prepared to fight but relieved to see Ladybug safe. After cleansing the city he embraced her before leaving.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Simon Says", Adrien came to the Challenge tv studio to support Nino who was performing in the contest then came across a hypnotist named Simon who wanted to meet him. All went well until Simon got akumatized into Simon Says seeing the trouble he transformed into Cat Noir and heard that the villain was after his father. After dealing with some of Simon Says' minions he meets up with Ladybug and Nino who's looking for Adrien, Cat Noir tried to dissuade them but seeing Nino's concern the hero says he'll meet her at the Agreste Mansion and detransforms then went home with Nino and Ladybug. Once there he tried to warn his father that he's in danger after Adrien made an excuse he transforms into Cat Noir again and warns Ladybug that Simon Says' army was closing in. He told Gabriel that they needed to board up the defenses and having enough of the man's stubbornness Cat Noir confidently tells him that he's in danger like everyone else.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
Seeing that Ladybug was looking for Adrien, he detransforms in the shower. Once out he and Ladybug talked over the picture of Adrien's mother commenting on how both have the same eyes. But the moment was interrupted when Simon's Army breaks in, captures Gabriel and the heroine puts him in the bathroom, knowing she can't fight alone Adrien transforms for the third time and went to the tv studio. Along with Ladybug they defeated Simon Says and saved Gabriel Agreste but leaves when his miraculous starts to time out. Back at home, Adrien received a surprised from hug from his father but the moment was stopped when he gets asked about his ring but retorts by saying, "that's the only thing you've noticed about him." Then, the next day Adrien heard that Nino wanted Ladybug and Cat Noir to appear for his next performance and transforms into Cat Noir heading towards the studio.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Pixelator", he spent job experience day at the Le Grand Paris hotel as receptionist being paired with Chloé. Seeing a guest at the door Adrien was told to watch and learn but knowing something wasn't right, he tried to save Chloé but became digitized with her. He tried to find a way out however Chloé didn't want to be left alone but aware there's an akumatized villain he wanted to transform quickly. However, Plagg told him not to be in a rush, then suddenly Fang was digitized too, causing Chloé to jump in his arms in fear. Sometime later, he and Chloé were found by Ladybug in the photos of Vincent's studio where she promised to free them. Due to a deal caused by Ladybug, Adrien was freed and asked Nino to cover for him before leaving, seeing the damage Pixelator had done he transformed into Cat Noir. Meeting with Ladybug, he gets the idea from her on where the akuma was but his cover was blown and after a brief fight he got digitized again but this time used Cataclysm not only to free himself but everyone else too.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
After using a compact mirror they were able to stop Pixelator's photo spree. Once the day was over Adrien his friends were reward with tickets to Jagged Stone's concert and was happy that he got to enjoy his first concert.
In "Guitar Villain", Adrien came across Marinette who was leaving the hotel and gets jumped on by Chloé. Being a fan of Jagged Stone, he was informed by her that the rock star was staying at her father's hotel. But he asked Chloé thinking she liked XY and she preferred Jagged Stone instead, soon the rock star gets akumatizied into Guitar Villain after separating himself from Chloé; Adrien transforms into Cat Noir. After a scuffle the cat was joined by Ladybug who saved him Fang's attack, soon afterwards they followed the villain who's after XY. They barely make it there, but XY was captured and raced back to the Eiffel Tower. As the duo climbed up they were attacked by Fang. After taking care of the dragon they dealt with Guitar Villain having Cat Noir as the distraction with his Cataclysm and using a can of hair spray the heroes were able to save XY.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
Once Jagged was returned to normal Cat Noir asked him for autograph. At school the next day, Adrien told Marinette that he heard she designed Jagged's album and asked if he could have her autograph after signing it, he thanked her.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Kung Food", Adrien received a call from Alya saying that Marinette needed a translator he shortly arrives at her house. Then, on their way to the competition he spoke with Marinette's great uncle in Chinese and found out he does speak English but not very good and yet Wang Cheng was impressed with Adrien's Chinese. At the Le Grand Paris, he asked Marinette's uncle if he needed help and the cook says no, soon Marinette came to apologize for the inconvenience but he took it as great experience to practice his Chinese with someone. When Adrien heard Chloé disown Wang Cheng's main dish and after Marinette stood up for him, he praises her for doing so but heard Marinette doubt that her great uncle liked her. Adrien assured her that he does by telling her that Wang Cheng used the flowers she gave him in his dish to honor her. During the contest his joy was turned into shock when Wang Cheng lost the contest, they both figured out Chloé sabotaged the dish and felt bad for him. While waiting for him Adrien noticed that all the exits are blocked off with caramel and went off to look for Marinette's uncle but used the time to transform into Cat Noir.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
Meeting up with Ladybug, they fought Kung Food's minions as they climbed up the building. Finally making it to the top and after Chloé was saved. They face off against Kung Food and using a Cataclysm on the villain's bag the duo was able to save Marinette's uncle. After Wang Cheng got another chance to compete in the contest and when Chloé complains about his dish, Adrien reminded her that she was removed from judging position due to her sabotage. Once Wang Cheng won, he tried the soup with Marinette.
In "Gamer", Adrien faced against Max while trying out for the Ultimate Mecha Strike III Tournament. He manages to beat Max and is expected to continue on with him in the tournament. Marinette, not wanting to miss a chance to hang out with him, beats Max's high score and Adrien told her he'd come to her house to practice. Later that day, he came to Marinette's house and was greeted by her parents. Not wanting to be embarrassed Adrien hurried to her room and they started practicing he did admit to Marinette that her parents were nice, she thanked him for the compliment. As they continued Adrien was very impressed with her gaming skills and claimed she could win even without him.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
That's when he was informed on her secret to winning was a lucky charm bracelet and was given it to increase his chances of winning, but as Marinette's parents continued to offer snacks he agreed. At the park, Adrien found the pie delicious, then decided to go back but noticed a giant robot behind them where he easily found out it wasn't a publicity stunt for the tournament and were quickly under fire. They tried to run but ended up separated, with Marinette in danger he transformed and safely took her to the roof of Le Grand Paris Hotel. When she had concerns about Adrien, Cat Noir assured her he was fine, after being joined by Ladybug they led Gamer to the stadium.
Once there he used Cataclysm on Gamer's robot destroying it however wasn't over. Soon he and Ladybug engaged Gamer's robot in another duel but this time with their own robot and after a giant-sized smack down they saved Max. During the night of the tournament Adrien saw how Marinette regretted taking Max's spot and gave it back. Admired by her kindness, he gave his spot to her and cheered for them as they competed.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Reflekta", Adrien was getting ready for class picture day with his classmates. But when he saw that Chloé wasn't satisfied with her spot he quickly brushed it off saying that they all got to be in the same photo. But when Juleka got akumatized into Reflekta he transformed into Cat Noir. After a brief scuffle, he attempted to use Cataclysm to free everyone from the school but got turned into an image of the villain. Despite not having any powers he couldn't do nothing in an effort to help Ladybug he rallied everyone against Reflekta.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
Once she was gone, he and Ladybug separated themselves from the crowd trying to prove that even though he looked like the villain it was still him on the inside. Reminding the heroine about the task at hand, Cat Noir wanted to come with her but Ladybug retorted against it, but he reminded her just because his powers are gone doesn't mean he can't help. Having an idea, they leave for the tv studio in an attempt to trap Reflekta but end up capturing the mayor instead but due to the hero already being transformed he was unaffected by the villain's powers. Using a camera, they were able to defeat the villainess and was returned to normal with their full powers intact while he a distaste for heading before heading back to the school. Afterwards, he went to the park with his friends to do a new class photo and complimented to Marinette that it was a great idea.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
In "The Puppeteer", after shaking off his bodyguard, Adrien was taking a train to the movie theaters. Noticing Alya and Marinette in the next car he waved at them but was shocked when Alya turned into Lady Wifi, seeing that everyone was danger he transform into Cat Noir. After Lady Wifi leaves he asked Marinette where the villainess was going and was informed that Alya was being controlled by Puppeteer and heading to her house. Meeting Ladybug there they used a previous plan to defeat her and Cat Noir used Cataclysm on the WiFi antenna freeing his partner but the villain managed to escape. Even though she was beaten, the heroes were shocked to discover that Lady Wifi didn't have the akuma but Puppeteer did.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
Realizing her power he asked if Ladybug had the Cat Noir doll too but she didn't and knew they had to find Puppeteer fast before she took control of him too. But he was about to detransform and leaves to recharge once Cat Noir transformed again he called Ladybug asking if she found the young villain and the heroine reports she was at the KIDZ+ TV building. Appearing behind his partner the cat got his arm twisted by Ladybug but confirmed he wasn't a puppet yet but ends up being controlled by her, despite that Ladybug manages to capture the akuma returning Cat Noir and everyone else back to normal. Afterwards he asked what happened the heroine explained he was puppet but didn't anything foolish and allowed Ladybug to pulled his heart strings anytime.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Antibug", Adrien was already in class and like everyone else he saw that Chloé was a wreck but also saw her acting strange afterwards. Once excused he quickly figured out that she was being attacked by a villain, he and Plagg transformed and went to the Le Grand Paris to protect her. When Chloé refused to admit if someone was out to get her, he and Ladybug talked to her butler that's when they learned during one of their games Chloé and Sabrina had a fallout which ended their friendship. Piecing it together it turns out that she was attacked by an akumatizied villain named Vanisher who was actually Chloé's friend Sabrina. Leaving the hotel Cat Noir exclaimed that it was going to be hard fighting someone they couldn't see and gleefully gave Ladybug a rose. But seeing the heroine's hair moving strangely the duo quickly got into a defensive stance; in the midst of fighting Vanisher Cat Noir heard from Chloé that Sabrina's akuma was in the brooch. After Sabrina was deakumatized he saw that she was right and asked why Ladybug didn't believe her and took his leave with her.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
Soon after that he saw Chloé get akumatizied into Antibug, needing to buy time for Ladybug, Cat Noir fought against her but ended tied up to his staff and used as bait to lure her out. During Antibug's taunting he was asked to work with her but refused to work with a mere copycat saying he and Ladybug were a team hoping the real one would show up soon. Unknown to him, Cat Noir felt someone giving him a hand quickly assumed it was his partner (actually Marinette in civilian form) and was set free. With Ladybug back in action and a bag of marbles they were able to defeat Antibug, then Adrien went to school the next day.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Volpina", Adrien was secretly watching his father who was curious about what he was hiding in his safe. After Plagg opened the door Adrien saw a book (which is the miraculous spellbook.) Upon reading he also sees a picture Hawk Moth wondering why someone like him was in a book about heroes, but quickly leaves for school taking it with him. While there he comes across a girl named Lila who tries to tell him that she is a Miraculous wielder too. But through a harsh scalding from Ladybug, he found that Lila's stories weren't true at all and leads her to getting akumatizied into Volpina. At one point Adrien tries to talk Lila out of causing trouble but when it doesn't he transform into Cat Noir.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
On the Eiffel Tower, he sees Volpina daring to drop 'Adrien' off the tower, but knowing it was an illusion Cat Noir showed Ladybug it wasn't really his alter ego but throwing his staff. The duo defeats Volpina, he hears his partner's attempt to apologize to Lila but she rejected it. Using his regular voice and keeping his bathroom door closed he convinced Ladybug that was ok. But Adrien noticed that his father's book was missing and asked Plagg if he moved it but the kwami said no. Leaving him worried that if he doesn't find it soon he'll have something scarier to deal with than Hawk Moth's anger.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Santa Claws", Adrien was decorating a Christmas tree in the foyer hoping his father would join him too since his mother wasn't here. Seeing that he wouldn't Adrien went back to his room in anger believing his father cared about himself deciding to hate the holiday he transformed into Cat Noir leaving his room. As he leaped through the city, Cat Noir sang about being a lonely cat of the night because everyone else got be with their families but him. The hero got so angry to the point where he dared to used his Cataclysm on a Christmas tree but was stopped by memory of his mother and used it on a Gabriel Brand Ad pillar instead.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
Then he began to lament that he didn't wanted to be alone and that tomorrow would be a new day with that Adrien detransformed and yet noticed Plagg exhausted cold and hungry. Picking him up, he apologized for his actions but didn't have any food for him, remembering Marinette's gift he opened it to find a hat and found it nice. Placing his kwami inside he wished Plagg a "Merry Christmas" then with help from Santa Claus the two are brought back home. Arriving there he comes across Ladybug who was convinced there was a villain around but tried to convince her that it wasn't Santa Claus, but she refuses to listen.
Afterwards he sees that Ladybug's mistake led to Santa Claus being akumatized for real and they transformed again. Along with her they chased Santa Claws through the Paris streets using a box the duo manages to grab Santa Claws' hat, purify the akuma and save the holiday.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
In "The Collector", Adrien was asked by his father why he took the book. He answers saying he wanted to know what Gabriel was hiding behind the portrait. Disappointed by his actions, he said he'd get him another copy however was informed that it was one of a kind and the source of his inspiration. As a result, he was banned from returning to school and that he would continue homeschooling with Nathalie and was disappointed. Later, Adrien was playing pool, contemplating how to get his father's book back so he could go back to school.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
Then heard his father's destructive tantrum and rushed downstairs to see what the commotion was. Just as he reached the door to his father's atelier, Nathalie stopped him, being told his father was very busy. Then, reminded that he was supposed to be practicing his piano. Knowing his dad wouldn't forgive him unless he got the book back, he transformed into Cat Noir to find it. When he was about to leave, he saw a message sent by Ladybug that said she knew who Hawkmoth was. Arriving, he was told by Ladybug that she believed it was Gabriel Agreste leaving him shocked and asking for proof. Ladybug answered by saying she couldn't tell him the proof, but showed him evidence that supported her claims.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
When they arrived at the Agreste mansion, Cat Noir saw how destructive Gabriel's tantrum was. Then, they went up to look for Adrien, but the Collector was there, waiting for them. He and Ladybug started to battle him, making sure not to get captured. He threw his staff at the villain but it was captured in his book then they retreated behind the staircase and made their way into Adrien's room barricading the door. Using a bike pedal, foosball table and his belt it resulted in the Collector's book being filled up defeating him.
After Gabriel returned to normal, Cat Noir rushed to him but when he asks about his son the heroes assured him that Adrien was safe and left (unknown that Ladybug was right.) After the book was returned, he admitted that he shouldn't have taken it without his consent in the first place. Adrien also heard that the book and him were the very last few things his mother gave to him before she disappeared. When his father came to a realization, Adrien asked if that meant he was able to go to school to which Gabriel agrees and he hugged him. Then, arrived at school and was happily greeted by his fellow classmates.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Prime Queen", Cat Noir appeared across from Nadja on a couch in the TV 5 studio. While waiting for the show to start, he jokingly told her that he loved chouquettes as the show almost aired he called Ladybug but received no answer. After the show's introduction, they engaged in a playful banter. When Nadja tried to get the two to admit they were dating, to Cat Noir's surprise, seeing a picture of them kiss on Valentines Day he asked when did that happen, continuing to gasp in shock as the pictures continued. After Ladybug denied her claims, he jokingly said that hopefully one day they'd be a couple but was led out of the room by her with an excuse that Paris needed saving.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
When Nadja said that everyone would be disappointed, he agreed with Ladybug if they were true fans, they'd understand leaving with her. Out of the studio, still believing her he asked who needed help and was told that they needed saving from Nadja's questions. He retorted that was the price of stardom, but was reminded that they're superheroes, not stars. Following Ladybug, he proposed they go out for ice cream but their trip was halted by Prime Queen who was broadcasting from a billboard surprised to see Nadja akumatized. When invited to save Chloé, Cat Noir tested the billboard's intangibility with his staff passing through successfully the hero asked Ladybug if she was ready but she suggested getting there by their own means, he quickly rejected the idea, pointing out this was the fastest way.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
Agreeing they both jumped through the screen, landing in the subway train where Chloé was held. After Prime Queen entered the room, they both agreed that Cat Noir would get the train's car door open and Ladybug would take care of Prime Queen. As she disappeared through a screen he realized they were trapped, he suggested using his Cataclysm but was stopped by Ladybug, insisting they used it for an emergency confused, he called their current situation one. But they needed to lure Prime Queen out to get her akuma deciding to play along, to the hero's surprise, his hand was grabbed by the heroine and confessed that they were in love to Prime Queen. As the train stopped he landed with Ladybug on top of him causing him to purr in delight to his surprise. Once again the villainess demanded they remove their miraculous so her ratings could max out, to prove their feelings he tried to kiss Ladybug but to his dismay, was rejected.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
This time, she was threatening to push a trapped Alya into the Seine River. The heroes tried to follow through the screen to the Louvre, but ended up in a freezer. He again proposed to use Cataclysm but Ladybug saw no point in doing so and tried to kiss her, but was again rejected, so she used her Lucky Charm receiving a roll of tape. As Ladybug searched for another object to use with her Lucky Charm, Cat Noir urged her to hurry, as the tomb holding Alya was almost completely out of the screen. Using a pizza box, Ladybug taped onto the screen then, they baited her into the freezer, saying that they were taking off their miraculous and about to kiss. When she reached through, they pulled her in and subdued her. The cat used his staff to break Prime Queen's watch, his Cataclysm to destroy the door and Ladybug purified the akuma and saved Alya.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Despair Bear", Adrien was listening to Tom teach the class how to make macaroons. He followed the class out after the fire alarm went off. After everyone was outside, it turned out that Chloé had called the fire department. When Marinette was accused of the prank, he defended her, asking why she would want to disrupt her own father's cooking class. Even though, Marinette wanted to report Chloé; because of her suspicions Adrien discouraged the idea, saying they couldn't proof it. As a result, Denis Damoclès punished everyone after no one confessed but, when Chloé got out of it Adrien was disappointed.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
After seeing Chloé yell at Rose for sweeping to close to her. He confronted her, asking if she was the one who called the fire department, to which she admits, saying that "they all seemed to enjoy getting dirty making cookies." Hearing that, he ended their friendship until she learned how to be nicer to everyone. Later, he was invited to a party that Chloé was throwing in an effort to be nice and rekindle their friendship. When Adrien saw that Marinette had suspicions about the party, he commented that sometimes Chloé can be nice. Then, he was bumped by her and asked for a dance; leading Marinette to the dance floor. Shortly after they began dancing, Alya and Nino helped fix their hand positions after they left, they continued.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
But the party was interrupted when Adrien and Marinette saw Sabrina and Kim being controlled by the villain Despair Bear, they exchanged excuses and rushed off to transform. As a controlled Kim tried to attack Ladybug, Cat Noir tripped him into the ball pit and made Despair Bear fly off his ankle. The heroes tried in vain to capture him however, he kept on jumping from person to person, leaving them confused. Until Despair Bear latched onto Cat Noir's leg and tried to take Ladybug's miraculous. When restrained by her, he made Cat Noir use his Cataclysm against her, but was pulled away by Chloé before he could. After Ladybug summoned her Lucky Charm, receiving a fork he followed Ladybug upstairs and began to fight her.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
As they fought Cat Noir attacked Ladybug with his staff but when the villain was unraveled, he was freed from his control. While she purified the akuma, he watched the tiny Despair Bear and yet fell over because of Jean Butler's sudden weight increase due to the Miraculous Cure. Afterwards Cat Noir rushed away when his ring showed he was about to transform back. After Chloé invited Tom over to teach them how to make macaroons, Adrien complimented Chloé on her kindness and renewed their friendship. After Adrien pinkie-swore that they'd be friends forever, she went on to insult everyone's macaroons. He laughed and told Marinette that Chloé would never change then asked her if he was able to have a macaroon. Marinette nervously told him he could and Adrien complimented her, saying was a good baker as a dancer.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Riposte", Adrien approached Marinette after hearing her compliment about him being handsome thanking her. He taught her about the rules of fencing complimenting that she had good reflexes and soon was locked in a fierce duel with the mysterious fencer after it Marinette claimed him the winner. He asked her if she was sure of what happened when but she wasn't he offered the mysterious fencer a decisive match. When she refused he tried to follow her and doing so Adrien researched his opponent. But was interrupted when Riposte attacked and demanded a rematch and yet he refused to fight her in her current state. Then, Ladybug soon arrived but seeing her outmatched he threw her his opponent's saber but when the heroine was cornered Adrien dived in to save her but sprained his ankle in the process.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
Hiding behind a chimney Ladybug tried to call Cat Noir but received no answer Adrien claimed he was busy but when Riposte found them they tried to reason with her to no avail. As Ladybug and Riposte fought he took the opportunity to transform but Plagg told him he was taking a lot of risks however was interrupted when Ladybug found him and made their way to Louvre Museum. While in the sarcophagus, disregarding Plagg's protest and knowing she needed help he transformed into Cat Noir. Despite having a sprained ankle he arrived just in time to help his partner. Along with Ladybug after a fierce fight and using a radiator the duo was able to defeat Riposte.
Afterwards he left to detransform and let his presence be known to Ladybug asking her about Cat Noir finally arriving and she was glad that he did admitting he was better at fencing than she was. Seeing Ladybug leave Adrien secretly blew a kiss; outside the museum he makes up with Kagami believing the point was hers. But she remained doubtful he explained that it was Marinette's first time fencing. When she playfully admits that Adrien liked her he says that Marinette was good friend and waited to give Kagami a decisive match.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Befana", sometime before Marinette's birthday Adrien was talking to Alya about it but when they saw her listening he switched the subject about taking Alya's sisters to the dentist. After the preparations were done he along with his classmates wished her a happy birthday and gave Marinette a small gift but before she could open it Befana ruined the celebration. Finding a quick place to hide Adrien transformed into Cat Noir. The cat tried to defend Marinette from her akumatized grandmother but was under attack by her minion but thanks to Marinette's friends they provided him with an opportunity to get her to safety.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
Carrying her away he said she must be a very cool girl if her friends are willing to protect her and asked Marinette why her grandmother was freaking out she explained that her grandmother wanted to spend more time with her. After getting Marinette to the Eiffel Tower the hero told her happy birthday before leaving to deal with Befana and her angels. Upon finding her, Cat Noir used his staff to block the way and broke into a song with Ladybug finishing it. As they fought Befana's angels he saw the villain was heading towards the tower and tried to steer her ride in another direction but got knocked off and caught by Ladybug.
