After the angels were dealt with Cat Noir noticed that the akuma was hiding in the Befana's candy bag, once the heroine summoned her Lucky Charm receiving a tuba he was surprised that she knew how to play but Ladybug replied she didn't.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
Soon the ground crumbled below them, then they were surrounded by Befana and her minions when he heard Ladybug admit defeat and then winked at him. Cat Noir played along admitting to her that Marinette was here leading the way separating Befana from her angels. Worried that he betrayed her, he was relieved not to find Marinette in the closest and was assured by Ladybug that she was safe. By using Cataclysm on a fire hydrant and the tuba; the heroes were able to save Marinette's grandmother. Returning to the party, Adrien gave his gift to Marinette a lucky charm bracelet he made himself, explaining that he always carries the bracelet she gave him everywhere he goes. As the party goes on Adrien smiled at the bracelet.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Robostus", Adrien was having science with his classmates, after watching Max and Markov fix the computer system he marveled at the sight of the little robot. But when Max voiced concerns about Markov being separated and saw the robot's akumatization, he and Plagg quickly hid understanding that Markov did have emotions and transformed into Cat Noir. Meeting up with Ladybug the duo tried to reason with Robostus, but were tossed out of the school and fought Robostus' army throughout the city. Shortly after Cat Noir revealed he could translate Morse code with the new mayor saying that the city would be ruled by robots. But knowing where Robostus was going they went to the Stade des Princes stadium. During their fight, he and Ladybug were surrounded and captured, then Cat Noir was asked if could use his Cataclysm but couldn't due to being restrained.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
Since the cat was unable to see he asked Ladybug what's going on and heard that Robostus wanted to use their jewels to make a wish to become human. Which he found strange because he knew that it was always Hawk Moth that demanded their jewels. They were about to have their powers taken but thanks to Max's intervention they were set free. After he dodged the machines the cat used Cataclysm on Robostus's robot and with a harp the heroes saved Max and reunited him with Markov.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
In "The Dark Owl", over the past week Adrien has been transforming into Cat Noir to save The Owl who was actually Denis Damoclès trying to be his own hero. During the end of the school day, Adrien was excited to play an online game with Nino but when Denis Damoclès hurried them out he said he had to continue with his Chinese lessons and sadly looked back in the principal's direction. After they saved The Owl for the fifth time Cat Noir and Ladybug talked on the rooftops on how to deal with him despite that he admired the man's good heart. He offered to stop Denis Damoclès by the scaring him but instead wanted to make his dream come true agreeing he returned home for the night. After Adrien finished school the next day he informed Nino that he still had Chinese lessons but was free tomorrow and looked back in Denis Damoclès' direction with a smile.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
He transformed and went with Ladybug to Alya's house to ask for a favor. When Alya staged as a convincing super-villain Cat Noir praised her for a good performance. Once they staged everything for The Owl, things took a disastrous turn which caused The Owl's identity to be revealed where he hoped no one would find out. By nightfall, while watching tv Adrien became shocked that their little plan caused Denis Damoclès' akumatization and to threatened harmless animals. He transformed into Cat Noir and went to the stadium meeting up with Ladybug after they stayed in contact the cat distracted Dark Owl with a conversation while Ladybug tried find the akuma. After she got flunged into the stadium he caught her and had a brief fight with the villain but resulted in the duo using their powers and tricked into a trap. However, he and Ladybug discovered Dark Owl's plot was faked just to lure them.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
Inside the crate, since they used their powers earlier Cat Noir saw no other way out admitting they've lost. In an effort to fool Dark Owl, he was informed by Ladybug that they were going detransform but have their eyes closed thinking they were giving up for real he was hesitant until Ladybug assured him. As they did so, Adrien gave her his ring but she closed his hand; surprised he wanted to speak but his mouth was closed by Tikki. Once Plagg was recharged he retransformed and used Cataclysm destroying the crate. After another fight, they discovered that the akumatized object isn't on Dark Owl but back at the school. But the villain got out of the cat's grip he followed him to the school after he caught up Cat Noir saw that Dark Owl was defeated. The next day he and Ladybug witnessed The Owl become a hero smaller scale and with that they had more free time. He asked Ladybug if she wanted to catch a movie but when she spoke of other plans he watched her leave love struck.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Gigantitan", Adrien was in the middle of a photo shoot at the Trocadéro and waved hello a baby boy named August, not too faraway he noticed the boy's mother having trouble and wanted to help but was told by Vincent to stay put. Then, he left to meet with his bodyguard upon seeing him Adrien noticed an akuma heading right for him but akumatized August into Gigantitan instead. After he found a hiding place, he transforms into Cat Noir then after getting the baby's attention with his bell. He tried to lure him to the river but ends up getting caught and found by Ladybug. Quickly escaping the heroes discovered that the akuma was in Gigatitan's bracelet but after Ladybug's failed attempt he commented that she wasn't too good with kids either. After he heard of her plan to use the Eiffel Tower as a playpen he commented it would work in theory but was unsure on how to get him there, thinking it'd be simpler if Ladybug used her Lucky Charm.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
He and Ladybug used themselves as lures and offered to sing the lullaby but she teasingly said they wanted to calm him down not burst his eardrums and the cat retorted back saying that he had a great voice and would serenade to her someday. However Gigantitan got distracted again until the cat got his attention with a car saying he enjoyed playing with cars too when he was little. Once they were at the tower Cat Noir attempted to use Cataclysm on the kid's bracelet, but got thrown off and crashed into André's ice cream stand and used it on an ice cream cone. Reuniting with Ladybug, with not much time left using a treat as a disguise and Cat Noir's bell the duo was able to finally capture the akuma where Ladybug admitted he was good at taking care of babies and reunited August with his mother.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
Meeting up with his bodyguard, Adrien was approached by Marinette who asked if he could hang out with her but seeing his bodyguard's frustration he turned down her offer. But offered her a ride home instead, however from her mixed up answer she turned him down by saying she would take a coleslaw home but (meant to say rickshaw). And yet, he told Marinette to enjoy her dinner and see her at school tomorrow.
In "Glaciator", Adrien transformed into Cat Noir and worked with Ladybug to save people from a runaway bus. After that he invited her to have a rooftop dinner with him as a chance to know each other but she had other plans accepting that he said if her plans ended early she could join and went home. Then, Adrien was at the dinner table waiting for his father but was informed that he wasn't coming leaving him disappointed and texted Nino that he couldn't come to their night out. Afterwards, he returned to his room; gave Plagg a piece of Camembert telling his kwami to fuel up and used his phone to record practicing piano piece. Determined about his date with Ladybug, Adrien told Plagg even though she didn't say yes she didn't say no either.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
But nonetheless, he transformed into Cat Noir, left his room heading towards the balcony date spot, finished the preparations and waited for Ladybug. After being let down by her, he blew out all the candles and was extremely heartbroken noticing Marinette not too faraway. He approached her asking if he could stick around not wanting to be alone and remembered meeting her once when she mentioned about having bad luck about the supervillain being in love with her. He related to having relationship problems of his own and spoke of the special dinner date he planned for Ladybug but she didn't come. Through their conversation Cat Noir saw that Marinette had her heart broken too wanting to cheer her up, he took her to the date spot he prepared but was still glum that his lady didn't come. And yet expressed hope she would but as Marinette tried to cheer him up they were under fire by Glaciator finding a place to hide the hero asked her if another villain had a crush on her but Marinette said no. Taking Marinette home he was thanked by her for cheering her up.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
Finding Glaciator, Cat Noir tried to fight against him but was sent flying until he was caught by Ladybug. Angrily he asked her how her date went with her "friends" but after evacuating people to safety and taking cover themselves they saw that Glaciator didn't attack couples. When he heard of Ladybug's idea for them to act as a couple he refused saying it's not cool to play with people's feelings and attacked the villain but failed until he was shielded by the heroine. Taking cover again and seeing that the cat was angry at her for missing their date she apologized, seeing her sincerity he apologized too and went along with Ladybug's couple plan. After they got close enough they discovered André was inside the monster and using a makeshift propeller and Cataclysm on a bus they saved Paris from being buried under a mountain of ice cream.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
Now alone so they could talk at the dating spot, Cat Noir discovered Ladybug was in love with someone else but considered him a close friend. Respecting her honesty he told her she was his best friend too and gave her a kiss as well as a rose complimenting it went with her costume before leaving. Returning home, Adrien was asked if he had a heart ache over Ladybug rejecting him, but he didn't still held onto hope that she would love him someday and accepted his friendship with her. The next day, Adrien approached André's ice cream stand as he heard that his ice cream was magical and said you have to believe to make it work and André agreed then was given a cone that made him think of Ladybug and enjoyed his ice cream.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Sapotis", after Adrien witnessed the damage the Sapotis had done on television, he transformed into Cat Noir. Meeting up with Ladybug, he saw her destroy the monster's hat and asked how did she know and said it was through trial and error. But saw that there was no akuma and discovered that they had to destroy the original hat. He quickly understood that they had to capture them all but after going through many clones they had no luck soon he and Ladybug got completely overwhelmed and surrounded. Then, he was confused when Ladybug's Lucky Charm gave her a teapot as he battled more Sapotis' he told the heroine that his kung fu wasn't enough. Once Ladybug understood the teapot's purpose, Cat Noir was shocked that she had to leave but trusting her he told her to go. The hero did his best to hold off the Sapotis' but wondered what was taking Ladybug so long and was overwhelmed again.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
He almost had his ring taken until Cat Noir was saved by Ladybug and their new ally. Upon seeing her he was amazed as the cat thought he was Ladybug's only superhero friend and was introduced to Rena Rouge welcoming her to their team. For the moment he enjoyed playfully teasing Rena seeing that working with her was going to be fun. But they were surrounded again and retreated to higher ground while Ladybug gathered the materials she needed Cat Noir and Rena Rouge drove the little monsters back. Then, moved to a new area to enact Ladybug's plan seeing the Sapotis close in he told Rena it's time to use her mirage powers. After instructing her, he noticed that she would transform back soon but wasn't worried as he could keep her secret but when Rena refused Cat Noir praised her for learning fast. When the fox voiced concerned if the plan would work he assured her it would and after collecting all the hats he used Cataclysm to destroy them. Once Alya's sisters were returned to normal, Rena Rouge had to leave but he looked forward to working with her again and returned the twins home.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Gorizilla", Adrien approached his father asking for a favor but when he heard Gabriel's response he realized it'd be too late by then and leaves. Soon he snuck out of his room and made his way to the Paris streets trying to keep a low profile which was easier said than done when he came across a fan named Wayhem. Soon his picture was posted on the internet, noticing his bodyguard he tried to run but was soon chased by a mob of fans. Until he ran into Marinette, knowing she lived close by Adrien asked if he could hide at her place but hearing the fan mob he realized it was too late. Following her, they hid in the park fountain where he thanked her for hiding him as people went crazy over the new ad he modeled in. Marinette expressed excitement over it but Adrien was embarrassed by it and yet was surprised to see her in pajamas.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
Remembering the task at hand, they both came out of hiding but upon seeing his body guard Adrien pulled Marinette back down. Explaining that he left his house without permission but they were spotted by another fan who took a picture of them and had to move again. Arriving at the train station, Adrien apologized to Marinette for dragging her into this and for the idea of people thinking she was his girlfriend but she said flusteringly it was no problem. He was asked if his father was going to be okay with this, Adrien retorts how could anything bad happen and pulled out his Lucky Charm. And yet, their moment was ruined by another fan mob realizing they couldn't stay he grabbed Marinette's hand and tried to run but was quickly surrounded seeing their only means to escape he pushed her into an opened train car.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
Upon wearing disguises the duo made it to the theaters and Adrien was complimented by Marinette for coming here. He told her this was actually where he was going when the fan mob showed up because the theater was showing a movie where his mother was playing the leading role. However, as soon as Adrien took off his helmet he and Marinette were swarmed again things went from bad to worse when Placide I.T. was akumatized into Gorizilla and was taken captive. Being carried to the tallest building he apologized to Ladybug for all the trouble seeing at Ladybug's urging he jumped off the building seeing him plummeting to his doom Plagg advised him to transform but couldn't. And yet, he was caught by Ladybug landing safely on the ground he almost called her his lady but caught himself.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
However, he noticed she was about to detransform but Gorizilla was still on the loose and carried away by the heroine. Then was asked where the villain's akuma might be noticing Ladybug's time he advised that he'll hide while waiting for Cat Noir to show up but she retorts by saying it'd be too late by then having an idea he heard of his partner's plan. He agreed to act as bait but also heard Ladybug say that she needed his Cataclysm for it to work when he voiced concerns about him not showing up the heroine says she trusts him. However, Adrien was asked by Plagg on how was his going to pull it off since he couldn't be in two places at once. With Wayhem acting as his double they transformed into Cat Noir using Cataclysm on the ground below the heroes were able to stop Gorizilla.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
Coming from his hiding spot Adrien thanked Wayhem for filling in for him and believed that the incident changed his opinion of him but Wayhem said he had the best day ever being in Adrien's shoe for a bit. Upon hearing his apology, Adrien gave him his email address believing that the two could be good friends. Returning home, he was met by his father believing he'd be angry but to his surprise Adrien saw the movie sitting next to his father he was reminded that all he had to do was ask and they had to trust each other as they continued watching the movie.
In "Captain Hardrock", Adrien was playing a piece on the piano with his father watching upon making a sour note he was stopped by him. Then, he was asked if he had been practicing that's when Adrien suggested that he would improve if he played with others but Gabriel retorted against it. Then, when he mentioned about going to his friend's concert but ended up being grounded and was told to continuing practicing.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
As Adrien practiced he was approached by Plagg who tried to cheer him up by saying that he could enjoy the concerts from the comforts of home. But he said that his friend's concert was all that mattered Plagg tried to sing Adrien his own concert appreciating it but was still bummed.
When they witnessed Captain Hardrock's destruction on the news he transformed into Cat Noir. With Ladybug the duo tried to control the ship or anchor it with no success, but by using a chain on the ship's compass the vessel ran aground with everyone on solid ground Cat Noir used Cataclysm and destroyed the ship. Back at his room, he asked his father if he could play with him as a duet afterwards Gabriel agreed to let him attend his friend's concert. Making it in time he meets Luka and takes part in the concert as the band's keyboard player.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Frightningale", at home Adrien heard from his father that Clara was a fan of his and seeing this as a promotional opportunity for Gabriel's business in other countries. Adrien was surprised that he was going to part in Clara's video, but seeing that the costume looked like his Cat Noir costume he almost refused until his father insisted. At the studio, Adrien looked himself in the mirror while Plagg was very impressed with the costume but he felt uncomfortable. The kwami agreed that he wasn't too fond of the bell but admitted the costume was something Adrien wanted deep down.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
However, he was more concerned with everyone figuring out his identity until Plagg assured him they wouldn't. Then, had the idea to act as lame as possible so the crew would pick someone else and was surprised at the number of people that auditioned to be Ladybug including Chloé, when his father asked about his mask Adrien said he couldn't find it and also heard that Marinette changed her mind about Clara's offer. Despite being nervous they were doing alright until it was time to put on the masks despite the duo claiming that they had lost them they were easily found. Just before Adrien put on the mask Chloé came into the studio and cancelled Clara's shoot which caused the singer to be akumatized into Frightningale. Finding a hiding place he and Plagg transformed into Cat Noir however even with Ladybug they found it difficult to fight her and became affected being forced to sing and dance. But thanks to a pair of handcuffs the heroes movements were synced preventing them from being turned into statues. Then, used Cataclysm on Frightningale's mike, the Miraculous Ladybug returning everyone to normal and saved Clara.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
Watching Clara's new video from the school's library Adrien says he liked this version believing he couldn't have pulled off being Cat Noir. With Marinette believing that he didn't look a thing like the hero he complimented Marinette believing that Ladybug wasn't as funny as her leading to everyone sharing a laugh.
In "Syren", Cat Noir worked together with Ladybug and Rena Rouge to round up some escaped zoo animals leading a pair of panthers into a cage. When he saw that Ladybug and Rena had to leave the hero expressed annoyance about being kept in the dark and the heroine explained that she would talk to him about it and voiced that he hated secrets. Returning home, Adrien voiced out his frustrations about Ladybug keeping secrets from him through his action figures and asked Plagg if he knew anything but the kwami couldn't be swayed. Until Adrien tried to bribe him with cheese and continued until he noticed his room was filling up with water but told him this wasn't over before transforming.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
Seeing the streets flooded he found Ladybug telling her that he didn't know she was going swimming but understood that cats weren't crazy about water and knew that they had to fight Syren underwater. The cat jokingly asked Ladybug about summoning her Lucky Charm and received a potion bowl, upon seeing it he said they could scoop out the water but it'd take forever. After Ladybug understood it's purpose Cat Noir had to wait while his partner sought out help becoming annoyed again about secrets. Fed up with waiting Adrien detransformed, grabbing his ring he threatened to quit being Cat Noir if Plagg didn't tell him what Ladybug was hiding. When Plagg retorted he shouldn't do that he reminds him that no one would know or care. Until Plagg mentioned that he would care if Adrien quits and believes the reason would be his love of cheese. And yet, the kwami admitted that he was close friend and making Adrien smile then they were approached by a man. The boy quickly noticed him as the man he helped before and was informed that everything would be explained later as well as that Ladybug needed help being given a green vial Plagg understood what it meant saying he hated transforming.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
Now with the playing field leveled in their new "Aqua Mode" Cat Noir joined Ladybug by bringing the villain to the surface they defeated Syren, saved Paris from flooding and thanked Ladybug for keeping her promise. Back at the mansion, Adrien was practicing his Chinese until was approached by Mister Chan posing as his substitute tutor. When Nathalie left, Plagg officially introduced him to Master Wang Fu the guardian of the Miraculous. So he could understand more about the magic jewels and was also given a box of Camembert cheese with each wedge containing different powers when the time came to use them.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Zombizou", in the Locker Room Adrien heard that it was Miss Bustier's birthday like his classmates he prepared a gift for her expressing joy that she was his teacher. Along with his friends he was amazed at the gift Marinette prepared and asked Chloé if she made one too. Afterwards, Adrien went to his classes finally arriving in Miss Bustier's he wasn't too surprised that Marinette's gift was ruined by Chloé. Upon Ms. Bustier's returned he was shocked to see that she was akumatized into Zombizou, but thanks to Ladybug's intervention he and his classmates escaped. But upon seeing something wrong with Sabrina he discovered that the kisses were contagious an ran into the Locker Room with the others.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
Upon opening his locker Adrien pretended to be infected seeing past his act Plagg asked him if it was a trick to get a kiss out of Ladybug but he said that he needed to work under the radar and transformed into Cat Noir. Meeting his partner on the roof he understood that Zombizou was after Chloé with the zombies closing in; eyeing a nearby bus he was asked by Ladybug if he knew how to drive and answered yes. Using his staff and belt they got everyone safely inside but his driving skills weren't very good so they decided to take Chloé to the Eiffel Tower. Carrying her the rest of the way, he saw that his partner was distraught at losing the rest of their friends. And yet, comforted Ladybug by reminding her that she'll fix everything in the end. Reaching the top of the tower he was surrounded by Zombizou's minions and tossed Chloé to her. While trying to keeping them at bay it was only a matter of time before he came under the spell he told Ladybug that he'd chill out here and if they were going to end up kissing he'd rather do it after the madness was over.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
Even though, Ladybug refused to leave Cat Noir said she was the only one who could fix this and then collapsed under the minion's weight. Now fully a zombie he used Cataclysm to get into the office and tried to kiss Ladybug but latched onto Chloé instead. When everyone was cured by the magic ladybugs he was pushed away by her, after Zombizou's defeat they heard Chloé's heartfelt apology to Miss Bustier being proud of and returned home. Then, Adrien went to school the next day.
In "Frozer", after saving a runaway para-glider, Cat Noir had a daydream in which he presented Ladybug with a rose asking again if she'll accept him as her boyfriend and revealed his identity to her but was brought back to reality by Ladybug. He was informed again that she was in love with another guy (unaware that it's his alterego). And yet, asked Ladybug would she give him a chance if this guy wasn't around but she answers she can't imagine (unaware that she has a crush on his alter ego). They detransformed and went off to school.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
Adrien came to fencing pratice but was easily beaten by Kagami. In the locker room, he told her that he was having trouble with his love life and was advised to change targets. When Adrien thought about changing his game Plagg gave him advice on how he greets Camembert although thankful his wielder told him that his advice might be best suited to someone else. During a visit at the ice rink Plagg was surprised that Adrien left Kagami for Marinette but Adrien told him she's just a friend wanting to check if she was okay. But soon the whole ice rink and all of Paris was getting covered in ice because of the akumatized villain Frozer. Thanks to the heroes new Ice Mode they were they transformed into Ice Noir, however due to their previous encounter he gave Ladybug the "cold shoulder" leaping off as he preferred to track and observe.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
But upon seeing Frozer as well as Ladybug under fire he ducked in to save her admitting that they needed a plan and was admired for he is observing skills and with a bag of salt they were able to save Paris from being a frozen wasteland. Returning to the ice rink he helped Philleppe save it while informing Kagami that he won't change targets and she accepts his decesion leaving for home. However, he soon hears Marinette greeting her Adrien hears Marinette's offer about going to the ice rink again surprised he asked just the two of them. That's when Marinette flusterling asks of bringing the whole gang answering that he'll clear his schedule.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Style Queen", Adrien was getting ready for Fashion Week show but felt awkward with Plagg commenting he looked ridiculous but heard someone coming and saw Marinette. To whom he saw looking incredibly nervous but assured her that her hat design was great or his father wouldn't have picked it as the winner of the contest. He briefly showed it off to her to whom he thanked for the compliment. Then, the show went well and Adrien shared a quick glance a Marinette until Style Queen attacked looking for Gabriel. He proclaimed that his father wasn't here; which ended with him being turned into a glitter statue. Then held prisoner by the villain at the Eiffel Tower and was given Style Queen's flower along with a protective force field but was fading away. After the villainess' defeat, he was revived with the Miraculous Ladybug (superpower), brought back to the show by Ladybug and thanked her for saving him.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Troublemaker", Adrien was watching the show "Fill My Shoes" in his room and was asked by Plagg why he was watching this show. He said the show was being filmed at Marinette's house as the showed continued he was surprised to see that she had many pictures of him. When he saw that Troublemaker had appeared he transformed into Cat Noir and went off to the bakery once there he tried to open the locked gate but with no good. The cat attempted to use his powers but the villain heard what he was doing and threw him into the side of a van until Ladybug pulled him up to Marinette's Balcony.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
Landing on Marinette's bed, he eyed her many photos until Ladybug averted his gaze but upon hearing Troublemaker's attack he used her bed in self-defense. Cat Noir and Ladybug tried to fight the villain but had trouble to do her intangibility when he saw Troublemaker trying to take Ladybug's earrings he tripped her and knocked away the villain's pen. Also he understood the villain's power was also her weakness resuming the fight Cat Noir almost had his ring taken but was prevented by Ladybug and yet was tangled in her yo-yo. Seeing his partner's forced detransformation he freed himself and used Cataclysm to have the villain drop the earring. Back on his feet he told Ladybug he wasn't expecting her to share her identity like that.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
Still holding in his power after the heroine summoned her Lucky Charm receiving a broken plate. At first, when Ladybug didn't see how to use it Cat Noir suggested maybe losing an earring weakened her power. Following her back to Marinette's room per part of the plan he proceeded to check outside for Troublemaker. Upon hearing the broken plate he reenters the room revealing their trick (super-gluing Ladybug's earrings). With Troublemaker solid Cat Noir was able to grab the pen and destroy it deakumatizing Penny. Joining Ladybug on the balcony he was playfully told that he won't be finding out her identity and Cat Noir retorts calling her the girl of his dreams.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
At school the next day, Adrien approached Marinette in the locker room to check on her albeit surprised her by accident. Then, asking about the photographs he hears from Marinette that she's really into fashion. In a teasing manner he asked if she was lying but understood saying he got use to having lots of fans as well as photographs of him everywhere. Knowing of Marinette's passion he asked if she like to come to his next photoshoot hearing her response Adrien said he'd keep her posted. Leaving he told Marinette that he'll see her in class and was happy to have her as one of his fans.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Queen Wasp", the show resumed with Adrien showing off Marinette's hat until he was surprised as everyone to see his father and even more so received a hug from him. After the show was over he encouraged Marinette to stand proud for her design, when he heard that she had the chance to go to New York Adrien was happy as well as excited at the idea of modeling for her. He asked Chloé if she felt the same but was saddened to see Audrey disregard her and was shocked when Chloé transformed running off with the Bee Miraculous. He was escorted back to the limo and home with his father hoping Chloé doesn't do anything reckless. Upon hearing about the "runaway train" Adrien and Plagg quickly transformed into Cat Noir.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
After he and Ladybug stopped the supposed "runaway train", Cat Noir was angry at Chloé for using her powers to create a problem. When Ladybug demanded the Bee Miraculous back and Chloé refused with shock he easily figured out that his partner lost it and yet was pulled away by her reminding him of the events of "Style Queen". But soon they realized Queen Bee was gone and chased after her back to the hotel but the job of retrieving the Miraculous was harder than they thought as they found Chloé akumatized into Queen Wasp with it and paralyzed everyone. During the fight they realized the akuma was in her jewel but had trouble getting to it without being stung, they managed to escape the swarm by going underwater. Coming up for air and seeing that Ladybug's Lucky Charm gave her a snorkel he said the charm had a funny sense of humor taking in the fact she won't drown.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
With that in mind Cat Noir and Ladybug used trashcan bins to protect themselves and went back to the hotel. By taking the fight underwater they avoided Queen Wasp's swarm and using Cataclysm to destroy the jewel the heroes returned Chloé to normal and resurfaced. But thanks to the Miraculous Ladybug, the jewel was restored, he and Ladybug looked sadly at Chloé saying it must be returned but was begged by her for another chance. After seeing her get disregarded by Audrey again Cat Noir comforted her understanding why she did this and along with Ladybug encouraged her to do the right thing. With the Bee Miraculous returned, he accepted Chloé's apology and returned home.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Reverser", Adrien saw Marc and Marinette spying on Nathaniel saying it's not cool to spy on people. But she nervously explained that they were working on a surprise for him. Accepting her answer he said that was thoughtful of her and offered his help if she needed it leaving the school. On his way home Adrien along with his bodyguard were struck in traffic. Looking out his window he was shocked to see Ladybug flying through the air by the villain Reverser. He told the Gorilla that he left his fencing gloves behind saying he'll meet him later and quickly transformed into Cat Noir. Meeting with her, he was ready to take on Reverser, but being distracted by his partner caused the cat became an easy target causing him to be afraid of everything. Which caused them to fall into the river; pulling themselves to shore Cat Noir was worried he'd catch a cold but was reminded by Ladybug that they had to stop Reverser. Still afraid he didn't want to fight but was encouraged by her to pursue him by looking for Nathaniel they tried to leave but realized they weren't going anywhere.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
Taking a cab to the school, the heroes saw that Reverser beat them there and yet eyeing one of Nathaniel's drawings they discovered that he's at the Louvre Museum. Where the scaredy cat realized they had to take another cab making it to the museum they asked him for help. After hearing the news he asked about Marinette but Ladybug said there was no time, knowing he wouldn't be much help Cat Noir opted to stay behind. When Alix offered to help the hero was welcomed to it heading to Eiffel Tower the group saw the space dumpsters coming down which caused the kitty to shake in fear under his blanket.
But was comforted by Ladybug knowing they could do this, knowing even with powers messed up they were still a team. As apart of the plan he and Nathaniel were purposely given to Reverser's demands but the hero was actually blindfolded and tied to a makeshift kite. With Alix doing the steering he used Cataclysm on the villain's hoverboard, thanks to his confidence being restored by the Miraculous Ladybug. He caught Marc setting him on the ground and was happy they were returned to normal.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Anansi", through video chat on his phone Adrien along with Marinette at Alya's house watched and admired how Alya and Nino were in perfect sync with each other expressing that he'd wished that he had someone like that. But when Marinette voiced disappointment that he wasn't allowed to come, Adrien didn't take it too hard seeing that one day his father won't see him as a child anymore. Then heard from Alya's sister Nora that Alya wasn't allowed to go out because of the danger of akumatized villains. When Alya spoke of her sister's overprotectiveness Adrien learned from Marinette when they were out Nora attacked someone who she thought was akumatized but was actually a normal guy in a costume. Then, he refereed the arm wrestling match between Nino and Nora and saw that Nino won.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
After he saw his friends in danger he and Plagg transformed into Cat Noir. However with Anansi's great strength the heroes found it difficult to fight against her. Soon the cat was caught in her web and when the villainess went for the ring he invoked his Cataclysm to protect it. Then while wait for Ladybug to return Cat Noir tried his best to guide Nino impressed by his wits in combat seeing Ladybug return with the help of their new ally Carapace, heard the spider's comment and by challenging Anansi to a "fight". With Carapace's powers the hero was set free and asked Ladybug if he was truly replaced, once Anansi's helmet was destroyed and Alya was saved. Heard from the heroine herself that he was irreplacable making him smile.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Malediktator", Adrien along with his classmates watched Chloé’s documentary but unlike everyone else he couldn't laugh about it and was shocked when she stormed off. Sometime later, he heard from Marinette that Chloé left for New York leaving him saddened. However, when Marinette talked ill will about her Adrien retorted that no one was useless and that she was his only friend growing up with that in mind he couldn't celebrate her unhappy departure. But soon Malediktator enters the scene and Adrien transforms into Cat Noir after a brief scuffle he and Ladybug retreat to higher ground. After Ladybug summoned an abacus with her Lucky Charm the cat says he'll take care of Malediktator while she figures out how to use it. He attempted to use his Cataclysm on the super mayor but it left Cat Noir wide open leading him to being hit with Malediktator's bubbles turning him into a real cat. Soon he becomes Audrey's pet and yet he was still wary of the villain clawing away at him.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
Cat Noir was napping until, his eye caught a dot from Ladybug's laser pointer while trying to catch it he knocked out the guards leaving Malediktator defenseless and was soon returned to normal by the Miraculous Ladybug cure. Joining the ladies he was disappointed that he missed out on a party and yet was proud that Ladybug and Queen Bee were working together for real. After Chloé left with her parents he apologized to Ladybug for not being helpful but she retorts saying that he was big helped surprised he asked for details but with her time almost up Ladybug said she'll tell him next time. The next day, Adrien attended another party for Chloé but this time it was her heroic actions as Queen Bee and praised Marinette for it.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Sandboy", Adrien was reading a book in his room and wished Plagg a goodnight who was going to bed (but snuck out). After awhile he saw his room change into cage bars, he tried to wake up Plagg but was horrified that he was turned into a sock. As the bars started to close in on him Adrien tried to call his father or Nathalie for help but to no avail. He desperately tried to break the bars but it was unless until Plagg arrived; Adrien was relieved he wasn't a sock but wanted a good explanation. He quickly transformed into Cat Noir and used Cataclysm to break the bars.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
He found the city a mess of living nightmares and was joined by Ladybug, however it wasn't easy fighting Sandboy with his sand blowing everywhere. After seeing his partner become powerless because of it he defended her and soon got struck with the sand too but still had his powers intact. The cat explained losing his wasn't what he feared most but Ladybug hating and trying to destroy him. Fighting an evil Ladybug while defending the real one he advised her to come up with a plan quick as he was about to detransform. By tricking the evil Ladybug and using a piece of her weapon the duo was able to defeat Sandboy. Upon hearing what happened the young boy explained he was akumatized because of a nightmare, saying that's what happens when you let kids watch whatever they want on tv with little time left Cat Noir asked Ladybug to return the young man home. After that he was asked by Ladybug if he really thought she was anything like his nightmare he replied she wasn't calling her the girl of his dreams.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
He returned home and was approached by Plagg who hugged him saying thank you. Confused he asked Plagg if something was wrong but the kwami thanked him for letting him his freedom mostly. And yet Adrien completely understood why Plagg left saying he knew what it was like to have restricted freedom and all he had to do was ask. Touched he was embraced by Plagg again calling him the best Cat Noir ever but he doesn't want he him to get too mushy about it.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Catalyst", after dealing with a late night akumatized villain Adrien returned home and detransform. While Plagg was eating Camembert he already knew they were heroes and wanted to go back to bed until Adrien explained that today was Heroes' Day where everyone has to do one good deed. While at school, he was still disappointed with Lila's lies and yet was surprised that Marinette was going to doing a big macaroon tasting. Sometime later, Adrien returned to school, excitingly Marinette that he got permission from his father to coming to her tasting and the two walk inside the school. However, that's when they hear from the news about Ladybug's akumatization and Cat Noir's destruction to make matters even worse that's when Hawk Moth commenced his biggest plan yet. By amplifying his powers the mastermind sent a swarm of red akumas to the school.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
Despite saving Adrien and Marinette, many of his friends were reakumatized after finding a safe place, he attempted to transform but was halted by Gorizilla. With him giving the okay, Adrien was freed by Plagg and transformed into Cat Noir, informing Ladybug that their battle was going to be a full house. Joining with his partner, the cat was giving the Bee Miraculous aware that they were going to need the full team. Arriving at Chloé's he plugs the bee signal and seeing her snarky behavior, he turns to leave to find another Queen Bee and Chloé takes back what she said and then joined with the rest of his allies. He quietly asks Ladybug what's the plan.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Mayura", despite the team putting up a good fight Cat Noir and Ladybug lost their allies as well as they were about to detransform back. But thanks to him using Cataclysm on the ground below them the duo escaped, afterwards he gave Plagg a piece of Camembert to recharge and accepted to share it. When he heard Ladybug express doubt on how to beat Hawk Moth commenting that he found a way amplify his powers like they did. But remaining unfazed he gave Ladybug words of encouragement if their team crumbled then he proposed to go back to being a duo and do what they do best giving people hope. Soon they were found by the army Adrien and Plagg retransformed into their Aqua Mode but upon resurfacing they still found themselves outnumbered.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
But with the Paris Rebellion's help along the way he and Ladybug see the reason to keep hope alive. Making it to the tower they managed to corner Hawk Moth and summoned his Cataclysm despite Scarlet Moth trying to reason with the duo Cat Noir wouldn't listen aware of the consequences of such a wish. Soon as he and Ladybug closed in Scarlet Moth, he was pushed out of the way by Ladybug to discover the Scarlet Moth they were talking to was an illusion leading to a fight with him; the hero manages to catch the mastermind's cane destroying it and deakumatized everyone. They were locked into hand to hand combat with him but lost and yet were saved by Rena and the others.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
He and the team were about to close in on him again but they were blown away by a Moth creature. After the creature disappeared they all noticed a feather realizing their archenemy had help thanks to the Peacock Miraculous holder and that Hawk Moth escaped but managed to save the city. With Cat Noir's time almost up he retrieved the Bee Miraculous from Chloé and returned it to Ladybug. Afterwards, Adrien attended Marinette's picnic sitting next to her but soon had to leave for his father's banquet but before he left. He commended Marinette for her kindness and willingness to help others calling her their "Everyday Ladybug". As he left he was approached by Marinette and surprised that she kissed him on the cheek to express her thanks and quietly thanked her.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:

Sensing he made a terrible mistake, Adrien left to find her along the way, by discovering the Couplebreakers trio just before they are de-akumatized by Chrysalis, Adrien also further discovered he and Marinette were tricked and knowing that the Ultrakuma was heading for Marinette, a horrified Adrien quickly transformed into Cat Noir and bursts into the classroom where she was and attempted to destroy the Ultrakuma with Cataclysm, but he was too late as it barely escaped his reach and infected her purse.
In an act of despair he detransformed right infront of Marinette who was at the time being manipulated by Chrysalis and tried to plead with Marinette to resist the ultrakuma but with no success.

title: Adrien Agreste/History
text:
Adrien Agreste/History - Season 6
Now with his villainess girlfriend fixiated on him, while under fire Adrien plead with her and noticing her struggling, seizing the moment, he pulled her into an embrace and told her they were both duped by Ray, Loic, and Nelson, apologizing for being deceived, begging for Marinette's forgiveness, and admitting he still loved her.
With their love renewed they shared a kiss, undoing Marinette's akumatization, the Ultrakuma emerges and flew away, and happy to know they were back together again and the bullies' attempt to break them up failed.
They later explain everything to Alya and Nino, who patched things up, then when the school day was over, Adrien asked her about the letter in her bag being informed it was an unfinished poem.

title: Adrien Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Adrien Agreste - Intro
is one of the two titular main protagonists of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir and Miraculous World (alongside Marinette Dupain-Cheng), and a minor character in Miraculous World: London - At The Edge of Time and Miraculous World: Tokyo - Stellar Force. He is a human-sentimonster created by his late mother Émilie Agreste from her emotion of love.
He is also a former student in Miss Bustier's class at Collège Françoise Dupont in Paris, France, and a former fashion model for his late father's brand. He is currently in a relationship with Marinette Dupain-Cheng.
With the Cat Miraculous, when inhabited by Plagg, Adrien transforms into Cat Noir ("Chat Noir" in the French version), a black cat-themed superhero with the power of Destruction, tasked with protecting Paris from akumatized villains, as well as other dangers. He is the second-in-command of The Miraculers.

title: Adrien Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Adrien Agreste - Intro
In "Syren", after Marinette helps Master Wang Fu translate the Grimoire in order to find a way to give Ladybug and Cat Noir the ability to transform into different powered up forms, he is able to make the potion that grants the aqua form. Adrien is able to use it to become Aqua Noir, which gives him a specially modified aqua suit with fins on his feet, granting him enhanced swimming capabilities, as well as allowing him to breathe and speak underwater.
In "Frozer" when the titular akumatized supervillain freezes over Paris to turn the city into his domain, Adrien uses Marinette's Magic Camembert to transform into Ice Cat, which gives him a specially modified ice suit with skates on his feet, granting him enhanced skating capabilities as well as allowing him to withstand subzero temperatures.
In "Reflekdoll", when Tikki accidentally brought the Ladybug Miraculous to an unrecognizable Adrien transformed by Reflekta, he temporarily used it and became Mister Bug, gaining the power of Creation.

title: Adrien Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Adrien Agreste - Intro
In "Desperada", when Ladybug chose him to fight the titular villain, Adrien temporarily obtained the Snake Miraculous, which, when inhabited by Sass, transformed him into Aspik, a snake-themed superhero with the power of Intuition. He later returned the Miraculous after failing 25,913 times to save Ladybug from Desperada.
In "Cat Blanc", in an alternate future, Cat Noir, conflicted between his loyalty towards his father and the girl he loved, was akumatized by Hawk Moth into Cat Blanc, a white cat-themed supervillain with the power of infinite destruction. After Ladybug fixed her mistake, the alternate future was erased, including Cat Noir's akumatization.
In "Miracle Queen", after removing the Snake Miraculous from a brainwashed Viperion, Adrien unified the Snake Miraculous with the Cat Miraculous to become Snake Noir ("Serpent Noir" in the French version).
In "Miraculous World: New York - United Heroez", after Mr. Ramier had been reakumatized into Mr. Pigeon for the 51st time, Cat Noir became Astrocat to stop Mr. Pigeon from taking over the moon for him and his pigeons. Astrocat has the power to travel long distances swiftly via flight, including in space.

title: Adrien Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Adrien Agreste - Intro
In "Ephemeral", after finding out the truth about his parents, Adrien, affected by an akuma, gave the Cat Miraculous to Shadow Moth (who subsequently became Shadow Noir) and was akumatized into Ephemeral, a supervillain who could make time faster or speed up the time it took for a Miraculous holder to de-transform. Later, after Sass used Second Chance, Ephemeral was erased from reality.
In "Kuro Neko", after giving up on being Cat Noir due to feeling unappreciated by Ladybug, Adrien was convinced by Plagg to create a brand new identity as a holder of the Cat Miraculous, becoming Cat Walker ("Patte De Velours" in the French version) and donning a brand new suit. He returned to his original hero persona at the end of the episode.
In "Evolution", after future Bunnyx was paralyzed during a fight against Monarch, Cat Noir took her Rabbit Miraculous and combined it with the Cat Miraculous to become Rabbit Noir, gaining the power of Evolution, so he and Ladybug could keep fighting the supervillain and prevent him from changing the past or discovering their true identities.

title: Adrien Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Adrien Agreste - Intro
In "Miraculous Paris", he was kamikotized by Betterfly into Celesticat, an angelic-cat-themed superhero to help Ladybug and Betterfly escape from Shadybug and Claw Noir.
In "Passion", to avoid detection by Safari's venom bolts, Adrien temporarily used the Ladybug Miraculous and once again became Mister Bug.
In "Revolution", after seeing all the Parisians willingly stand up and fight injustice with their own hands and refuse to turn their backs on Ladybug and Cat Noir, Adrien evolved his powers, allowing him to use Cataclysms as many times as he wants and not de-transform after using them. He was forcibly sent to London by his father to shelter him from Operation: Perfect Alliance, but managed to finally share a kiss with Marinette before leaving.
In "Representation", after being sent to London, Adrien returns to Paris as Astrocat hoping to find Marinette so he could tell her his identity and stay together, but after being struck with Nightormentor's dust and the fear of putting her in danger, he backs off the idea and returns to London.

title: Adrien Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Adrien Agreste - Intro
In "The Final Day", when Monarch commenced his global plan against the French Duo, Adrien acknowledged that due to his nightmares, he was not the right state of mind to wield the power of Destruction safely and sent Plagg back to Paris with the ring to help Ladybug. After Monarch's defeat and wish, Adrien reclaimed his Miraculous and rejoined Ladybug and their whole team in Paris.
In "Miraculous Tokyo", it is revealed that Adrien and Plagg have traveled to New York City again to assist the United Heroez in defeating a powerful villain.
In "Climatiqueen", after having difficulty looking for his passion and trying out various activities alongside Marinette, he meets Sublime while trying out running alone, and develops a passion for running.
In "Revelator", after Ladybug's secret is revealed to Rena Rouge by the powers of the titular villain (though he incorrectly assumes the secret is her identity), Cat Noir is able to evolve his Cataclysm into a new power called Miraculous Cat Noir, allowing him to destroy anything "created" by an akumatized villain, like exposed secrets.

title: Adrien Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Adrien Agreste - Intro
In "The Chained Titans", troubled by a friendly dispute about potential future hamster names between Adrien and Marinette, Nino believed that he could strengthen their relationship by allowing them to become temporary superheroes together. As Nino's stand-in, Adrien temporarily used the Turtle Miraculous. When inhabited by Wayzz, he became Trionyx, a turtle-themed superhero with the power of Protection.

title: Adrien Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Adrien Agreste - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Adrien is a fair-skinned French-British teenage boy standing at an average height, and is about half a head taller than Marinette Dupain-Cheng with short, brushed-back blonde hair that is swept to the right, emerald-green eyes, and a rosy tint on his cheeks, nose and the tips of his ears. In the first five seasons, his hair was curved and stuck upwards with a small tuft bending to the right at the top.
From Season 6 onwards, his hair is combed neater, facing down.
Civilian Attire

title: Adrien Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Adrien Agreste - Appearance
In the first five seasons, Adrien wore a white button-down jacket with an upturned collar and sleeves rolled up above his elbow, which he kept unbuttoned, and a pocket at the right. Underneath, he wore a black t-shirt with five horizontal stripes around the chest, which were colored, from top to bottom, yellow, brown, bright green, navy blue, and purple. He wore blue jeans and a logo of a black butterfly in a circle on the sides. In addition, he wore orange sneakers with white laces. On the ring finger of his right hand, he wore the Cat Miraculous, which was silver when he wasn't transformed. He sometimes carried the lucky charm bracelet Marinette gave him in his pocket. Starting from "Re-creation", he wore the combined Graham de Vanily Twin Rings on the ring finger of his left hand.

title: Adrien Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Adrien Agreste - Appearance
From season 6 onwards, his outfit is mostly the same as he was in the first five seasons, except that his jacket is wrinkled and creased, no longer having the right pocket and the sleeves are also slightly long as well, having passed his elbows. He replaced his orange sneakers with white ones with matching laces, black lining above the sole, and a linear black section behind the tongue at the sides. He still wears the Graham de Vanily Twin Rings on his left ring finger.
As Cat Noir
In the first five seasons, Cat Noir had cat eyes with green sclerae, dark green irises and slitted pupils. His hair became slightly longer, untamed, and covered his normal ears, with his bangs being brushed to the middle of his head. Cat Noir wore a textured black skin-tight catsuit made of a material similar to leather with small metal studs on his shoulders and abdomen with thin black linear accents around the aforementioned body locations and arms.

title: Adrien Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Adrien Agreste - Appearance
He wore matching gloves that had claws on the fingertips and dark gray ankle-length boots with black lining and a horizontal line in the middle, a hidden wedge, silver pawed toes, and paw-shaped treads. He also had black cuffs with a metal stud to accent the top of the boots and wrists. He had a golden bell on his neck, connected to a silver zipper on the front of his costume on a black zipline, and a long, detachable black belt that wrapped around his waist and hung out from the back like a tail with a metal stud securing it at the left, and there was a silver rectangular buckle and small holes lined in silver at its end. He wore black cat ears made of the same material as his suit with a silver stud at the bottom front and a black mask with part of it pointing at the bridge of the nose to cover his face. When transformed, his ring turned black and gained a bright green paw print on its face. He kept his staff attached to his lower back. His suit had a hexagonal pattern.

title: Adrien Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Adrien Agreste - Appearance
From season 6 onwards, his appearance becomes slightly altered; his hair is brushed to the right, and all of the studs become diamond-shaped. In addition, his torso, shoulders, arms, and waist are dark gray, with a silver zipline in the middle. He also has pockets in place of the linear accents around his waist, which tilt downwards diagonally on either side. His belt is now secured at the right. His mask sharpens at the bottom corners in a slight angular cut. He now has the symbol of the Cat Miraculous on his back, which is black and angular in design.
As Mister Bug

title: Adrien Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Adrien Agreste - Appearance
Mister Bug's hair was the same as his civilian form unlike Cat Noir, covering the Ladybug Miraculous. On his face was a red mask with black spots in a symmetrical design, his eyes were still green, and the waterlines were black. He wore a black, turtlenecked skin-tight superhero bodysuit with red accents on his upper torso, extending to his abdomen, thighs, on his forearms ending on a point in the back of his hands, and his shins which resembled boots with black soles, all of which were covered in black symmetrical spots. He had red shoulder pads and armor in his chest which were covered in black spots. The yo-yo, when not in use, was tied on his waist with a black string.
As Aspik

title: Adrien Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Adrien Agreste - Appearance
Aspik's eyes had vivid green irises and golden sclera with slit pupils. He wore a dark turquoise skin-tight suit with a hexagonal texture. He had teal hands with a downward point on the wrist to accent the diamond-shaped segments on his elbows, the shoulder pauldrons, the angular torso piece that pointed in an elongated end, and the pentagonal knee pads, the armor being lined in black. There were also pale yellow diamond-shaped accents on top of the knee pauldrons, on the palm, and in the middle of the chest with black lining. There was also angular black lining connecting to the chest piece which wrapped around the chest and past the thighs. Aspik also had a dark teal skullcap covering his hair and an angular dark teal mask with thin black lines jutting out to accent his armor details, and small pale yellow fang-shaped pieces below.
He wielded a lyre as tool, which was located on his back when not in use. He wore the Snake Miraculous, a bangle, on his left wrist.
As Snake Noir

title: Adrien Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Adrien Agreste - Appearance
Snake Noir's costume resembled both of his traits as Cat Noir and Aspik. His suit was black, with Aspik's chest armor and knee pauldrons, but without the shoulder pads. In addition, the armor is now mostly lined in black without any yellow accents, and there is now armor on the front of the lower arm to match the knee pauldrons that now have a black W-shaped point on top connecting to the lining. Snake Noir sported Cat Noir's boots, pockets, and his belt, which had a teal colored-tip composed of three large vertical scales and the holes lined in teal, and green cat eyes. Alongside the usual black cat ears but with teal insides, his hair was again covered by a black helmet, and his mask from Aspik is retained. He wore the Cat and Snake Miraculouses on his right ring finger and wrist.
As Cat Walker

title: Adrien Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Adrien Agreste - Appearance
Cat Walker had dark green hair that he parted on the left with a few wild strands and his hair tied in a short ponytail at the nape of his neck. He also had a pair of fake black cat ears in his hair. He had the same eye color and cat-like slit sclerae as Cat Noir. His mask was black, similar to Cat Noir's, but it had a horizontal golden stripe across the top with a dip in the middle where the edge of the mask dipped.
His costume was dark gray and looked similar to an 18th century military uniform with six gold paw print-shaped buttons, and another two on the backs of his shoulders, with the top two having gold cords connecting to each other and the back, and gold lining on the middle of the torso, sides of the neck, shoulders, and above the arm. He had tall black boots that reached a little past his knees with a point upwards and long black gloves that almost reached his shoulders. His shoulders were also black and the ends of his fingers had pointed curved cat-like claws.

title: Adrien Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Adrien Agreste - Appearance
Unlike Cat Noir, he had no bell. His long black belt was tied around his waist and extended into a fake tail in the back along with a gold belt buckle on the front in the shape of a right angle pointing to his left.
As Rabbit Noir
Most of Rabbit Noir's suit remained black, gaining light blue highlights on his shoulders, lower arms, legs, boots and belt with a white cotton ball on the end. He maintained his ears but they changed from cat-eared ones to rabbit-eared ones with black outsides and blue insides. His bell changed from gold to white, keeping the Rabbit Miraculous on his waist and the umbrella on his back. He also gained light blue markings under his eyes on his mask.
As Cat Blanc
Cat Blanc had a similar appearance to Cat Noir, except that his skin was very pale, and his catsuit was completely white, including the bell and the cat ears. His hair was also white, and his eyes were icy blue instead of their normal green.
As Ephemeral
Ephemeral had pale, light grayish heliotrope colored skin and glowing pupil-less brilliant magenta eyes and wore a moderate magenta skin-tight outfit that covered most of his body, except for his eyes and the area of his nose and mouth.

title: Adrien Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Adrien Agreste - Appearance
The suit possessed shoulder pads, gloves and knee-high boots that were a darker shade of moderate magenta and glowing pink outlines and a black line around the waist. There were sets of three black arrows pointing down on his torso and limbs and a pointy helmet on his head with the same color of the suit with a black coloration at the front outlined by a glowing pink line and black arrows at the sides. All the arrows of his body started to flicker when he started accelerating one's time until all of the arrows were lit up and the acceleration took effect.
As Celesticat
Celesticat had an extremely similar appearance to Cat Blanc, but with green eyes and a pair of large, angel-like wings for flight. His body also gave off a brilliant light.
As Trionyx

title: Adrien Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Adrien Agreste - Appearance
Trionyx wore a forest green metallic jumpsuit, with a defined physique. The suit had a large collar with brilliant lime trim and zipline, the zipper being a hexagon. On his shoulders were brilliant green hexagonal pauldrons, matching the one on his chest with two pieces on each side, resembling turtle fins. The sides of his torso, navel, thighs, and the front of his calves had lighter forest green padding with angular shapes and brilliant lime trim. He had black pieces near the ribcage with green neon lines, green pieces around the waist, forest green hexagonal pauldrons on his knees, and brilliant green hands with thick, metallic cuffs. His forest green boots were ankle-length, had brilliant green trim and a hexagon on the foot, dark green toes with an indent in the middle, and black soles. Over his face, he wore a dark green mask with a lighter gradient near the end, and his sclerae turned yellow while the iris turned dark orange. His hair was slicked above to the right. His ears were covered by dark green pieces with three neon lines, and forest green material surrounded the chin. He wore the Turtle Miraculous around his right wrist and his shield at the back.

title: Adrien Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Adrien Agreste - Personality
Adrien is a charismatic dreamer, but he is also often shy, a bit reserved and considerably innocent and naïve — particularly due to his unfamiliarity with much of the world beyond his father's reach. According to Nino Lahiffe, because of it, he resembled a baby bird afraid to come out of his shell. Due to his kind heart with or without his mask, Adrien always tries to see the best in others; in the case of those that have mean or cruel intentions, like Lila Rossi and Chloé Bourgeois, he's willing to give second chances believing that with patience and time, anyone can change. His patience does have limits though, as he ended his friendship with Chloé after she refused to apologize for her actions in "Queen Banana", even though they reconciled in the next episode, most likely due to his unwillingness to abandon a friend. However, his patience with Chloé finally ended when he found out about her actions in "Derision", ending their friendship.
However, in "Revelation", he saw the difference of those who mean well and those who don't reach the limit of their patience with those who are manipulative, such as Chloé and Lila as he becomes blunt to Lila, and ends his friendship with Chloé.

title: Adrien Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Adrien Agreste - Personality
Despite that, again due to his lack of social interactions and naivety courtesy of his parents' overprotective upbringing, he can be oblivious at times to the darkness or mischief in the hearts of others, like his father or his cousin.
This also extends to the situations of others like in the Season 4 finale; if he thought more clearly and remembered as Cat Walker it is possible he also could be akumatized like Ladybug and everyone else when she mentioned it as her greatest fear and tried to protect him, possibly oblivious of his own actions such as when he asked to take on some of his partner's responsibilities to prevent Ladybug's akumatization.
However, by that point, Adrien's increased loneliness and inability to process his feelings in a healthy way most likely compromised his judgement, due to either his absent but overbearing father or the secrets he kept leaving him unable to safely vent his frustrations, talk about his feelings and ask for advice since he did not have someone to talk to like Marinette had Alya and Luka.

title: Adrien Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Adrien Agreste - Personality
Furthermore, while Plagg truly cares about Adrien, his own lack of maturity compared to the more empathic Tikki might have also contributed to his inability to emotionally process things correctly, causing trouble for him, like his advice in "Miraculous New York" to hide the truth from Ladybug.
This notably changed in Season 5, as he spent more time with Nathalie and she openly showed him affection, gave him advice and since quitting modelling allowed him more time to talk to his friends like coming to Luka for advice.
The growing bonds he has with Nathalie and Luka, as well as Marinette, caused him to become more mature and emotionally stable.

title: Adrien Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Adrien Agreste - Personality
His reaction in "Rocketear", when being told by Nino of him and Alya knowing their identities through Ladybug (though Adrien didn't know she did it in an emergency), while somewhat justified since he knew no one but Ladybug must know the Miraculous holders' identities, and also came from him not realizing that Nino and Alya's situation is different from his and Ladybug's since they own the Miarculouses that Shadow Moth needs and through his discussion with Plagg following the incident, he chose to keep his feelings to himself due to Ladybug already being mentally and emotionally strained by her new role as Guardian.
Even though he is not very openly emotional to most people, he is friendly, empathetic, understanding, supportive, selfless, wise, and encouraging to others; and in hard times, he will defend his friends against those who would do them harm.
This caused him to take the blame for Chloé's prank in "Stoneheart" and often being forgiving of her nasty behavior because she was his only friend for a long time, though he eventually cut ties with her when he made more friends and she became more mean spirited.

title: Adrien Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Adrien Agreste - Personality
His will for exposure, change and making friends definitely complements his personality, although it is a bit of a struggle for Adrien due to his busy schedule.
He always put the needs and feelings of others above his own even with those like Plagg or Chloe, with or without his mask, he connects with the hearts of others before speaking his feelings of anger or sadness.
He does it with many of his classmates and friends.
Like with Marinette to think before she speaks and to be more open-minded, positive, and patient when she dislikes people or feels emotions of anger.
Or with Kagami to be more understanding, open-hearted, and compassionate when it comes to others who make her feel hurt or insecure.
Indeed, Marinette fell in love with Adrien not because of his looks but his kindness in apologizing for the gum incident (despite not being his fault) and giving her his umbrella, despite her not giving him a chance to explain himself in "Stoneheart".
Furthermore, his kindness and sociable personality makes him unique.

title: Adrien Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Adrien Agreste - Personality
Despite the loss of his mother, the emotional abuse of his father and his only long time friend being the egotistical Chloé, Adrien always remained kind and understanding, unlike her, who, despite having an absent mother, had numerous chances to become better, but refused, the arrogant and selfish XY or the rich kids at the Diamond Dance in "Emotion".
Initially at least, despite his limited interactions, he was also more warm and sociable than Kagami who, despite being a good person who also sought to make new connections and a loyal friend, came off as cold and unapproachable but improved with his and Marinette's help.
Alongside her, Adrien was also able to emotionally reach Felix in "Emotion", make him bring everyone back and start to change his ways.

title: Adrien Agreste

Adrien Agreste - Personality
Adrien's shyer and gentler characteristics can be observed in awkward, uncomfortable situations or scenarios with particular people. This was shown when he nervously asked Marinette to sign his copy of Jagged Stone's new album, shyly greeted Ladybug in "Simon Says", posed with Marinette as their alter-egos in Clara Nightingale's music video and tried to make Marinette more comfortable around him, but froze up and instead played a joke during "The Puppeteer 2".
While liking to have fun, Adrien is more serious, obedient, somewhat insecure, and less lively due to his strict upbringing.
He is sensitive and perceptive; he was the only one who thought it was rude to party when Chloé told everyone she was 'leaving Paris'.
He gets his feelings hurt when people like his father disappoints him, however he is used to it and is able to manage these feelings to avoid attracting akumas, a notable feat since he unknowingly lived in the same house as his enemy.
When in public, he usually tries to downplay his feelings on it, like his relationship with his father.
He has an easier time letting his feelings show to those whom he is close to.

However, Adrien will act on impulse if emotional enough, like lying to Théo Barbot out of jealousy about his relationship with Ladybug and sneaking out into the night while unhappy on Christmas, missing his mother, though the latter was due to his father's distant and cold attitude.
He realizes that his father is overprotective, causing him to occasionally act rebelliously, like going places with his friends or alone without informing his family and taking things that don't belong to him, though the former case was caused by his father's over-protection.
While his love is what makes Adrien stronger, his desire to be loved makes him vulnerable whenever disappointed by those he cares for, as seen when Ladybug didn't show up for their date in "Glaciator", (despite her telling him otherwise) or his father on numerous occasions.
Family-related issues also strike him emotionally, even in the simple (though repeated) situation when his father doesn't show up to spend dinner with him due to his loneliness, or when Mayura's deception leads him into trouble; this means that he follows his heart at the most inconvenient times due to his desire for love and companionship.

Even moreso, making him sad and angry when he finally has the love he desires just to have it be taken from him as seen in "Oblivio" and "Cat Blanc".
This reached a critical point in "Jubilation", when the power of Gift forced him to live his greatest desire about having Ladybug's love, her hand in marriage and a family with her.
Only to be tearfully told the truth by her that it wasn't real and upon waking up, he reacted violently even to the point of almost using his Cataclysm on an akumatized villain, though he did snap out of it before doing something he would've regretted upon hearing Ladybug shout.

This emotional instability, combined with lack of social interactions, goes to the point where he was so desperate for love that he stepped on boundary lines such as relentlessly and romantically chasing after Ladybug despite knowing she was after someone else or expressed any happiness or joy that she was. However, unlike how Felix was in his debut episode, Cat Noir did not try to force himself on Ladybug in any way and always backed off when she said no, though his flirting (whether real or as a joke), combined with Ladybug's stress as the Guardian, caused her to sternly reprimand him and even to aggressively throw him in a trash bin while fighting Glaciator. Adrien understands that all life is valuable, so he usually thinks reasonably and will express distress and frustration when someone is difficult or something is going wrong, especially in Plagg's case, and actively avoids using his Cataclysm on a living being.
However, according to Gabriel, he is very similar to his mother, describing them as "dramatic" and "headstrong when it comes to other people's safety".
Furthermore, in "Miraculous Paris", he refused to use the ultimate power at the cost of another family ending up like his, broken.
However, his heroic tendencies can lead to recklessness with or without the mask, insisting on fighting Riposte with a sprained ankle in order to protect his crime-fighting partner.
And again to a more dangerous extent when his ribs were broken as a result of his Cataclysm being used against him, though he knew he needed to help Ladybug, something she acknowledged since she didn't bench him after finding about his condition and even sent him to deliver the Bee Miraculous to Queen Bee.
On the verge of dying, he insisted on continuing to fight, showing his will and determination to help even if restrained.
