title: Aeon/History
text:
Aeon/History - Intro
Aeon is an android superhero under the alias of Uncanny Valley who was constructed by Majestia and is a member of the United Heroez.

title: Aeon/History
text:
Aeon/History - Before [[Season 1]]
Aeon was constructed with advanced technology by Olympia Hill/Majestia, whom she developed a mother/daughter relationship over time, even calling her "mother". Aeon also has a "stepmother" Barbara Keynes/Knightowl and a "stepsister" Jessica "Jess" Keynes/Sparrow, who is also her best friend. She attendes Armstrong High School and is part of Dean Gate/Doorman's class, along with Jess. Using her advanced technology she became the superhero Uncanny Valley and joined the United Heroez, a superheroe team lead by her mother.

title: Aeon/History
text:
Aeon/History - [[Miraculous New York]]
When a plane traveling to New York City from Paris is attacked by the supervillain Techno Pirate and he almost causes it to go upside down, Uncanny Valley appears outside where Marinette Dupain-Cheng and Adrien Agreste are. She then hacks into the plane's systems, to tell the pair that they have the situation under control and to tell the passengers that the United Heroez are here to protect them. Just then Majestia arrives, with Techno-Pirate throwing a bomb at Uncanny Valley as Majestia blows it up into the sky causing a big explosion. After Techno-Pirate is defeated by Knightowl and Sparrow, Uncanny Valley manages to fix the plane. Majestia then checks if Uncanny Valley's hurt, sharing a hug as she tells her mother that she's 100% operational. Then she and her mother wave at the passengers as they fly away with the other heroes and Techno-Pirate.

title: Aeon/History
text:
Aeon/History - [[Miraculous New York]]
Uncanny Valley then detransforms into Aeon and goes to the lobby of the Hotel Lafayette. At the lobby, Aeon uses her X-ray vision to scan the French students, their teachers, and Placide I.T., noticing two of them (Marinette and Adrien) to be missing. She spots them at the door trying to get in, Aeon then presses the light switch with her hand to hack into the system to open the doors as Marinette falls down. Jess Keynes then arrives complaining about how there babysitting some tourist, as Aeon points out that Marinette and Adrien are made for each other. Jess tells her that she should stop meddling with people's private lives, with Aeon agreeing and telling her that they should focus on theory mission to protect the French students.
Later, Aeon and Jess watch as the French students go to their rooms. Jess then jokes with Aeon about how they should do something and complains about the whole situation being boring. Marinette and Adrien then go in the Aeon and Jess' room as make their way into the rooftop party. Aeon and Jess then stare at the pair, whom introduced themselves to them. Jess then tells them to use the stairs to get to the roof, with her and Aeon soon joining them.

title: Aeon/History
text:
Aeon/History - [[Miraculous New York]]
When they get to the rooftop party, Aeon sits down next to Jess as she listened to Jess start playing her guitar and everyone starting to dance along. After Hot Dog Dan arrives, Aeon and Jess meet Alya Césaire and Nino Lahiffe who ask Jess to play the song played in "Despair Bear" at Chloé Bourgeois' party. Aeon then listened to Jess play as Marinette and Adrien dance while floating under the moon light.
The next day, Aeon and her class go to the New-York Historical Society. There Aeon and Jess notice Marinette and Adrien at the door trying to get in again. Aeon, Jess, Alya, and Nino then come up with a plan to get at Marinette to confess her feelings to Adrien in seriously dangerous situation. Alya and Nino get Marinette and Adrien to go to the Lafayette room, where Jess throws her weapon at a lightswitch causing the lights to go out and Aeon makes a hologram of Solitude, a supervillain who goes after people who are loved by no one. They then hear the rumbling causing Aeon to turn off the hologram of Solitude.

title: Aeon/History
text:
Aeon/History - [[Miraculous New York]]
Techno-Pirate who's now been akumatized into Techlonizer arrives at the New-York Historical Society and Aeon and Jess transform into Uncanny Valley and Sparrow respectively. The heroes soon start fighting Techlonizer, as their professor Dean Gate transforms into Doorman and opens a portal using a door for the heroes so they can escape. Uncanny Valley flies to the portal, but Techlonizer grabs her, absorbing her powers. He then throws Uncanny Valley away and she's rendered powerless due to Techlonizer taking her scanning tools and laser away. Uncanny Valley continues to fight Techlonizer as Ladybug and Cat Noir arrive to help her and Sparrow. Uncanny Valley and Sparrow decide to not warned the other heroes wanting to prove them that their capable of fighting crime on their own.

title: Aeon/History
text:
Aeon/History - [[Miraculous New York]]
The pair then goes after Techlonizer who runs away as they watch the French superheroes argue. Then the heroes manage to corner Techlonizer on a building, with Ladybug and Cat Noir summoning their Lucky Charm and Cataclysm respectively. Ladybug uses her yo-yo to protect Uncanny Valley from Technolizer's lasers and Cat Noir uses his staff to protect Sparrow. After Ladybug angrily decides to never trust him since he left Paris defenseless, Cat Noir is schocked and accidentally drops his staff as Techlonizer turns around to grab Cat Noir's wrist to throw him away but Uncanny Valley appears by shielding Ladybug but he cataclysms her with an unprecedented force.

title: Aeon/History
text:
Aeon/History - [[Miraculous New York]]
Majestia then finds out about her daughter's death and yells a giant "NOOOO" while flying down from the stratosphere and then punches Techlonizer, making him smash through several buildings. Majestia starts crying as Uncanny Valley detransforms back into Aeon, to Ladybug and Cat Noir's surprise. Ladybug then uses her Miraculous Ladybug to revive her and transforms back into Uncanny Valley and hugs her mother when she awakes, but an angered Knightowl suspends Sparrow for disobeying protocol and demands the French superheroes surrender their Miraculouses. She then watch as the French superheroes run away.
Back in their civilian forms, Barbara Keynes and Olympia Hill bring Aeon and Jess back to the hotel and they forbids them from tracking down Techno Pirate again for good for making mistakes earlier. They then watch the news with the other hotel guest, where President Camilla Hombee/Victory makes a statement about the hunt for Techno Pirate and postpones the French American Friendship celebration ceremony. When they see Marinette and Adrien outside the hotel, Aeon and the other students run out to see them as is forced by his father Gabriel Agreste to leave New York City.

title: Aeon/History
text:
Aeon/History - [[Miraculous New York]]
Aeon and Jess soon decide to take action after seeing Hawk Moth on the news. Uncanny Valley, able to see through other people's identities, goes to recruit Ladybug and Cat Noir while Sparrow tries to contain the crisis. Uncanny Valley finds and recruits Marinette, then goes to return the Cat Miraculous to Adrien. At first, Adrien is hesitant, but Uncanny Valley plays back a recording of Marinette saying that she can't be Ladybug without him. Adrien becomes Cat Noir again and flies back to New York with Uncanny Valley but notes that he had to get back before the his private jet lands.

title: Aeon/History
text:
Aeon/History - [[Miraculous New York]]
Once Cat Noir and Uncanny Valley rendezvous with Ladybug and Sparrow, they come up with a plan to manipulate Doorman into helping them infiltrate the Statue of Liberty, where Miraclonizer is waiting to launch a missile on Hawk Moth's order if Ladybug and Cat Noir don't surrender. Uncanny Valley drops Sparrow off where she obtaines the Eagle Miraculous annd transforms into Eagle, who uses her power of the Eagle Miraculous to dispel the effects of Miraclonizer's use of Liberation. The four superheroes soon defeat and de-akumatize Techno Pirate and restore everything to normal. Majestia and Knightowl congratulate their protégés and admit that they should give them more freedom to grow.
Later Ladybug and Cat Noir thank her for bringing them back together and after they say goodbye she deletes the information on the French superheroes' secret identities. At the French American Friendship celebration ceremony, Snowflake makes an ice sculpture of Ladybug, Cat Noir, Uncanny Valley, and Eagle as people celebrate them, with the last two waving at the crowd.

title: Aeon/History
text:
Aeon/History - [[Miraculous New York]]
Uncanny Valley and Eagle are about to ambush a group of criminals lead by Cash in an alleyway before a Monk with the Native American Miracle Box appears and demands the Eagle Miraculous be returned. Uncanny Valley and Eagle proposes that, instead, he should help start a new generation of heroes.

title: Aeon/History
text:
Aeon/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Action", Aeon takes part in a plan made by Marinette and her friends in Paris to reduce the amount of plastic polluting the planet. She and Jess video call with them and Fei from Shanghai, before Max Kanté hacks into a live TVi broadcast and manages put them on screen. From New York City, Aeon and Jess explain the problem by showing the viewers the terrible consequences of this pollution and telling them how to make better choices about the items they use every day.
In "Re-creation", Uncanny Valley is seen fighting off the Miraculized who are using Sublimation. Uncanny Valley analyzed the quantum imprint and carry the powers of some Miraculous powers and she says to the other superheroes that something occurred in Paris. Soon after Miraculized Nora uses Clout on top of the Tour Montparnasse, Uncanny Valley and the other superheroes use Doorman to get to Paris.

title: Aeon/History
text:
Aeon/History - [[Season 5]]
After Eagle and Knightowl free Nora, Uncanny Valley and Majestia repair the Tour Montparnasse that Nora damaged. She then tells her mother to search for Ladybug and Cat Noir, which she agreed to. Soon Uncanny Valley and the other superheroes join the Resistance, the Order of the Guardians, and Ladydragon in the fight against the Miraculized. As she fights the brainwashed civilians, Majestia returns as she didn't find the French superheroes, to everyone's disappointment.

title: Aeon/History
text:
Aeon/History - [[Miraculous London]]
However, as suggested by "Miraculous London", after Gabriel made his wish to Gimmi, when Bug Noire used her Miraculous Ladybug to undo the effects of Operation Perfect Alliance, Uncanny and the other United Heroez, along with Ladydragon, the Resistance, and the Guardians, were saved as the Miraculized were returned to normal en masse with no memory of what happened. After returning home to the USA, the United Heroez learned from the news and Ladybug that Gabriel has sacrificed himself to end Monarch's threat forever, leaving them unaware of the truth that Gabriel was Monarch, and Ladybug had lied to everyone out of respect for Gabriel's last request, but still feared what would happen if the truth got out, making Ladybug a pariah in the eyes of her allies, especially Uncanny and the rest of the United Heroez.

title: Aeon/History
text:
Aeon/History - [[Miraculous Tokyo]]
At the end of "Miraculous Tokyo", as Adrien is listening to a voicemail from Marinette she sent him while on her way home from Tokyo to Paris with Kagami on the Tsurugi private jet, he is soon joined by Uncanny, who notices something is wrong. As he hangs up from listening to Marinette's voicemail and puts his cellphone away, Adrien expresses his concern for Marinette and sending her a reply later as he lets Plagg out from his jacket, if he, Plagg, and Uncanny make it through their impending fight. Uncanny reassures him that they will be okay. As Adrien transforms with Plagg into Cat Noir, Uncanny hops into the air next to him as, joined by Majestia, Knightowl, Eagle, and maybe a few other members of the United Heroez, they prepare to face down a massive, six-fingered hand reaching out of a dimensional rift towards them as lightning crackles all around the portal.

title: Akumatized villains/Movie
text:
Akumatized villains/Movie - Intro
Akumatized villains are people (or things) transformed into supervillains through Akumatization, the superpower of the Butterfly Miraculous.

title: Akumatized villains/Movie
text:
Akumatized villains/Movie - Transformation
Whenever a person has strong emotions, the holder of the Butterfly Miraculous senses it and can charge a butterfly with Nooroo's power, Transmission, transforming it into an akuma. The akuma then flies away from Hawk Moth's lair to the targeted person or any other who is feeling stronger negative emotions and possesses the heart of the person (the holder of the Butterfly Miraculous can also akumatize himself if he feels enough negative emotion to do it).
Once the heart is possessed, it immediately creates a telepathic link between Hawk Moth and the other person, allowing them to communicate through a butterfly-shaped light mask that appears in front of Hawk Moth's and the victim's faces.
Once the connection is established, Hawk Moth explains to the person that he'll give them the ability to accomplish their goals if, in return, the person will retrieve the Ladybug Miraculous and Cat Miraculous from Ladybug and Cat Noir.
When the person agrees, a dark purple appears from the heart and surrounds the person. Once it recedes, it reveals the victim has transformed into a supervillain.

title: Akumatized villains/Movie
text:
Akumatized villains/Movie - Abilities
An akumatized villain has an appearance and abilities that relate to their occupation, circumstances, and/or interests. For example, because the criminal was disguised as a mime, he becomes The Mime, a villain with the ability that any object he mimes can manifest as a solid, but invisible construct. It appears that the powers come with all the knowledge and muscle memory the akumatizated victim needs in order to use the powers effectively.
Aside from their superpowers, akumatized supervillains have enhanced strength, durability, agility and fighting skills. For example, The Mime is able to fight Cat Noir and resist his attacks.
Similar to the original, they and the Butterfly Miraculous share a mental link, meaning they can see and hear through each other's eyes and ears however there seems to be something else just as Gargoyle was hit by a speeding train and knocked out briefly and then Gabriel as Hawk Moth was coming too it seems that mental link also works in the terms of physical pain meaning if the user's champion experiences enough of it then, the holder will feel it too being briefly knocked out to unconscious even being forced out of the transformation.

title: Akumatized villains/Movie
text:
Akumatized villains/Movie - Defeat
To defeat them, the akumatized villain must receive a massive hit or explosion to release the akuma from his heart. Once the akuma is released, the villain collapses and transforms back into their normal self.
After the akuma is released, the owner of the Ladybug Miraculous uses the Yo-yo to capture the akuma. Once captured, the Yo-yo will "de-evilize" the akuma and revert it back to a normal butterfly.
It's possible for an akumatized villain to break free of the akumatization themselves, but that requires a great deal of willpower and a whole lot of strength.

title: Agreste mansion/Movie
text:
Agreste mansion/Movie - Intro
The Agreste mansion is the residence of the Agreste family.

title: Agreste mansion/Movie
text:
Agreste mansion/Movie - Appearance
Exterior
The Agreste mansion is a two-story stone building with a zinc roof with a raised third floor whose roof is topped by a tall lantern. It has large rectangular windows on the main floors and small portholes on the roof. The building is accessed via a portico of about twenty steps and a large double wooden door. On the right side of the building is an automatic door that leads to an underground garage.
Garden
The villa has a large landscaped garden. These are evergreen cypress trees that are set in rose beds near the manor's surrounding walls. There are also hexagonal medians with shrubs cut into rectangles and forming squares that are softly illuminated by blue lights.
The floor is paved, allowing the car to go to the garage.
Interior
The foyer has mostly white walls with gray marble parts and black details. Large cylindrical lights suspended from the ceiling provide illumination at night. The floor is smooth white marble with isolated black patterns resembling a feather and black and white patterns further out. Red plants are placed on each side of the entrance and paintings are hung.
This room has access to various rooms in the mansion, including Gabriel's atelier.

title: Agreste mansion/Movie
text:

This room has a large white marble staircase that splits in two to reach the upper floor. This staircase is overlooked by a huge painting of Gabriel Agreste and Adrien Agreste, both dressed in black.

The first floor has a long corridor with a vaulted ceiling, whose walls have a first part in carved black marble and a white part where numerous photographs of the Agreste family are hung. This corridor leads to Adrien's room.

title: Agreste car
text:

The  is a luxury car created by Tsurugi Industries and formerly owned by Gabriel Agreste. It is commonly seen being driven by Placide or Nathalie.

title: Agreste car
text:
Agreste car - Appearance
Exterior
The Agreste car is a silver sedan. It has four headlights and four rear lights. It also has black tires with silver rims on the wheels.
Interior
The interior of the car is very comfortable with large black seats in the rear to provide all the comfort to the passengers. They are large enough to accommodate five teenage boys of different builds. The front seats are gray and much narrower than the rear ones. The dashboard has a small screen with built-in GPS.

title: Agreste car
text:
Agreste car - Trivia
Placide is the primary driver for the limo. However in "Queen Wasp", "Miraculer", "Party Crasher" and "Multiplication", Nathalie drives it, and in "Animaestro", Gabriel drives it himself.
The shade of grey varies between episodes, sometimes even being black.
Depending on the episode, the license plate changes:
Throughout season 1, and in some later episodes, it has no plate.
In seasons 2-3, it's sometimes "BB-123-BB".
From season 3 and onwards, it usually says "AGR - 75".
In "Miraculous New York" and "Miraculous Shanghai", Gabriel's seen in similar cars in the titular cities, but it's unlikely those are the same car, as it would require him to transport them by plane.
In "The Bubbler" and "Ephemeral", Adrien is seen in a long limo, but it's unknown whether it's meant to be the same car.

title: Agreste's private jet
text:
Agreste's private jet - Intro
is a jet model CB-06X built by Tsurugi Industries and formerly owned by Gabriel Agreste.

title: Agreste's private jet
text:
Agreste's private jet - Appearance
Exterior
Gabriel's private jet is a Tsurugi Industries CB-06X heavy aircraft capable of flying non-stop from Paris to Shanghai.
This jet has a very thin nose with an entirely white fuselage. It has long black windows under which there is a gold line and the logo of the brand Gabriel. Its wings are equipped with winglets that allow it to reduce the distance for take-off and landing at secondary airports, but also to increase the flight altitude to increase the speed on the ground.
It has a single propulsion reactor at the rear on which is the Tsurugi Industries logo and the model of the plane, as well as two fins that form a V-shaped tail called a "butterfly".
Interior
The jet is particularly luxurious. It has a large cockpit with some particularly comfortable white seats in the burgundy and modular rear. Each seat has a metallic gray table and individual air vents and lamps for the air conditioning.
The space is white and has a large and slender rectangular window that allows you to observe the outside without risk, with a blue or gray floor depending on the brightness, a golden line under the window.

title: Agreste's private jet
text:
Agreste's private jet - Appearance
The plane also has a business office where Gabriel Agreste does some important work during his flight, especially related to the research of the Ladybug and the Cat Miraculouses, as well as the Prodigious. This room is lit by soft blue lights, has a single chair, and a large white desk table. It has a computer with a holographic screen.

title: Agreste's private jet
text:
Agreste's private jet - Trivia
This private plane first appeared during the special "Miraculous New York", specifically when Uncanny Valley went to look for Adrien who was headed to Paris.
In "Miraculous Shanghai", Gabriel and his son, plus their kwamis, used this private jet to travel to Shanghai for the opening of a Gabriel store located on Najing Road.

title: Agreste mansion's dining room
text:
Agreste mansion's dining room - Intro
The  is the dining room of Adrien's house.

title: Agreste mansion's dining room
text:
Agreste mansion's dining room - Appearance
Some of the walls in the dining room have black and white vertical stripes, while part of the floor is deeper and made of wood. The dining room includes a large rectangular wooden table surrounded by dark brown chairs with white cushions. A bronze candelabra sits towards one end of the table. There are also long vertical windows with light brown curtains and tall dark grey trim on the walls. Above a white and silver fireplace in the room is a large portrait on the wall featuring Gabriel, Émilie, and Adrien. To the right of the fireplace is a framed painting, and on the wall opposite the fireplace is a white ledge, where a black and gold clock is set, and a huge mirror with a detailed bronze frame.

title: Agreste mansion's dining room
text:
Agreste mansion's dining room - Trivia
The Agreste mansion's dining room has been important on several occasions:
In the first five seasons, this is where Nathalie would give Adrien his schedule for the day.
In "The Collector", Ladybug and Cat Noir temporarily fought the eponymous villain in the dining room.
In "Santa Claws", Gabriel allowed Adrien's friends and their families to celebrate Christmas in the dining room.
In "Feast", this is where Nathalie revealed to Gabriel that the statue displayed at the Louvre Museum was actually a sentimonster and that it had its amok inside.
In "Ladybug", this is where Nathalie secretly took the Peacock Miraculous in order to try one last time to obtain the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses creating a powerful sentimonster.
Also, in a flashback in this episode, it was revealed that this is where Gabriel gave Adrien permission to go to Marinette's birthday party held in "Befana".
In "Gabriel Agreste", this is where Gabriel hosted the private meeting of the Paris elite members, and where Chloé later snuck in to take Bob's cellphone so she could insert the memory card from her cellphone.

title: Agreste mansion's dining room
text:
Agreste mansion's dining room - Trivia
In "Protection", this is where Gabriel told Tomoe that he wanted to move up the date of the Diamonds' Dance, and this is where they argued with each other over who should watch over their son.
In "Conformation", Monarch temporarily searched for Ladybug in the dining room after she transformed back to try to escape the Miraculized.
In "Werepapas", this is where Adrien's maternal grandparents and paternal grandparents argued over who should have custody of him.

title: Aglaé
text:
Aglaé - Intro
is a recurring character in Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir first introduced in season 6.
In "Wreckless Driver", in the past at some point after Monarch's defeat, on her first day of school, Aglaé was akumatized by Chrysalis into Lady Butterfly, a butterfly-themed supervillain, after Raymond Pugnant, Loïc Stompet, and Nelson de Glusset locked her inside the school's butterfly house.

title: Aglaé
text:
Aglaé - Appearance
Physical appearance
Aglaé is a pale skinned teenage girl. She has long black hair with white streaks tied in a long braid, slightly swept, full bangs, split forelocks, and dark gray eyes.
Civilian attire
Aglaé wears an oversized hoodie. The top half of it is lavender with a goopy-like design to it, while the bottom half is darker with lilac drawstrings. Beneath are black shorts. She wears a pair of purple tights, purple socks with white ghost patterns, and black shoes with buckles. She also has a transparent choker with a black pattern. She has black goth-like eyeshadow.
As Lady Butterfly
Lady Butterfly wore a metallic lilac supervillain jumpsuit. The neck and collarbone were dark purple with a split bottom, accenting the droplets and markings at the sides of her armpits, rib cage, and on her feet. They were framed by lighter lilac sections with line indents across the limbs. Her sleeves were rounded and inflated, with tiny spike-like appendages sticking out. On the palm was a dark fuchsia crystal butterfly with a hook on top.

title: Aglaé
text:
Aglaé - Appearance
Her hair turned a dull dark purple and was tied into two braided pigtails, with same-colored but saturated lipstick. Her eyes turned dark orange. Her skin gained a slight pink tinge to it. She wore a lilac helmet with a big, dark fuchsia transparent visor, covering her eyes. It had a white border, which thickened near the top, and extending above were curly antennae. Unfolding from her back were curved, pointed pastel pink wings adorned with darker swirls and markings

title: Aglaé
text:
Aglaé - Personality
Aglaé is a very shy, vulnerable and soft-spoken girl. She is usually seen holding sage flowers to try to ward off akumatizations and is extremely afraid of akumatized villains. When an akuma attack occurs, she curls up completely, freezing in place. Despite her fears, Aglaé is very supportive of her friends and shows great attention to the people close to her, trying to reassure them, even if her words may sometimes lead people to make mistakes.
Her extreme fear of akumatization and akumatized villains is the result of accumulated trauma that was left unattended for months. It started with Alix's first akumatization into Timebreaker, as Aglaé was one of the people she stole time from, causing her to disappear. That experience had such an impact on Aglaé that she developed this fear, which then evolved into something worse, which was her being scared of butterflies. It caused her to lock herself in her own room and avoid school.

title: Aglaé
text:
Aglaé - Personality
Despite the end of Monarch, she's still afraid of butterflies. It was taken advantage of by Ray, Loïc, and Nelson, who locked her at the school's butterfly garden, leading to her akumatization into Lady Butterfly. Despite being de-akumatized by Ladybug, the recorded footage of her akumatization haunted her, causing her fear to evolve to include all types of insects and anything related to them, including insect-themed superheroes, like Ladybug.
However, Aglaé has tried to overcome her trauma, her friends doing their best to help her after she told them about it and suggested that she seek professional help, like the school's psychotherapist, who had helped some of them with many types of issues they were struggling with. Her eagerness to overcome her trauma caused her to be overwhelmed when she was informed that therapy would take a long time. This resulted in her directing her frustrations towards Dr. Psiquat, which led to the latter's akumatization. Eventually, she was able to give therapy a chance and, with the help of her friends and Dr. Psiquat, she managed to take an important step to overcome her fears.

title: Aglaé
text:
Aglaé - Personality
As Lady Butterfly, her main objective was to get back at the bullies for locking her in the butterfly room, encasing them in cocoons. However, she soon enough directed her attention towards the rest of the Parisians.

title: Aglaé
text:
Aglaé - Abilities
As a Civilian
Due to her fear of akumatized villains, Aglaé has researched ways to prevent her friends from being akumatized, one of them being the use of flowers, especially sage. Since she is studying Japanese in secondary school, she has a basic or even advanced knowledge of the subject.
As Lady Butterfly
Lady Butterfly had the ability to trap her victims in cocoons. She was able to fly like an actual butterfly.

title: Aglaé
text:
Aglaé - History
Before Season 6
According to Aglaé, during the events of "Timebreaker", she became one of Timebreaker's victims. After being touched by her, Aglaé was frozen in place and she slowly began to fade from reality. From her perspective, she faded into a white void and lost any perception of the passage of time. She was afraid of her non-existence and the fact that she would never see her family or friends again. Fortunately, Ladybug's magic ladybugs fixed everything and restored her to reality. Afterwards, Aglaé hoped she would appreciate and enjoy life even more than before. However, a few days later a butterfly landed on her, and she realized she had developed a fear of butterflies because of their similar appearance to akumas. Out of fear, she shut herself away in her room and self-isolated.
Season 6

title: Aglaé
text:
Aglaé - History
On the first day of the next school year, after Ladybug announced the defeat of Monarch, Aglaé returned to school, feeling safe enough to leave the house again. Unfortunately, due to isolating herself from the world for so long, Aglaé had become antisocial and nervous around other people. Later that day, Mrs. du Bocquale planned a visit to the butterfly greenhouse, but Aglaé was too scared to go inside. Ray, Loïc and Nelson offered to help her and walk in the greenhouse with her, but abruptly closed the door behind her when she went inside, revealing it was a prank. Paralyzed with fear of the butterflies around her, she was akumatized into Lady Butterfly. With the power to trap people inside cocoons, she trapped Ray, Loïc, and Nelson along with other civilians. Afterwards, she was de-akumatized by The Miraculers.

title: Aglaé
text:
Aglaé - History
In "Climatiqueen", noticing that Aurore was sad because she was losing Chloé's social media contest, Aglaé sprinkled sage on her to ward off a possible akumatization and comforted her, encouraging her to stay true to herself rather than spread gossip for views. Later in the cafeteria, Aglaé became stressed when she was unable to find Aurore. When she realized Aurore had been akumatized into Climatiqueen and attacked the school, she was overcome with fear. Marinette and Adrien helped bring her to the nurse's office and barricaded her safely inside. After Climatiqueen was defeated, Adrien returned to check on her.
In "The Dark Castle", Aglaé worried about the possibility of Bunnyx not coming back if Ladybug and Cat Noir did not succeed in defeating the new Butterfly Miraculous holder. Later, when she was invited to Alix's birthday party, she asked about Marinette's absence from the party.
In "Vampigami", after Ray, Loïc and Nelson ruined Prem's origami bat, Aglaé and her friends angrily told them to apologize to Prem.

title: Aglaé
text:
Aglaé - History
In "Wreckless Driver", Aglaé was stuck in a falling tram because of an akumatized villain. Although Ladybug came to rescue her, Aglaé appeared to be afraid of her and ran away. During gardening class, she became scared of a ladybug and sprayed essential oils to make it fly away. Aglaé then revealed to her friends that she has had a fear of insects ever since she was akumatized, which had progressed from her original fear of butterflies to all insects and even the insect-adjacent Ladybug. Marinette and Alya walked her to class and invited her to meet for lunch. At lunchtime, Aglaé told her friends she wanted to stay home again so she would never have to confront her fears, but her friends convinced her to try therapy. During her therapy session, she revealed to Dr. Psiquat the origin of her phobia of insects. However, Aglaé believed that therapy would heal her after one session, and when Dr. Psiquat informed her it would take more time than that, she became devastated, causing her to snap at her and leave the office crying.

title: Aglaé
text:
Aglaé - History
Dr. Psiquat, feeling hopeless because she couldn't help Aglaé, was akumatized into Wreckless Driver. With her powers, she captured Aglaé and erased her of her fears. Aglaé, feeling liberated, thanked and praised Wreckless Driver.
After her de-akumatization, Dr. Psiquat brought her to the greenhouse to try exposure therapy. Aglaé apologized to her, believing that she was responsible for her akumatization for snapping at her. Dr. Psiquat reassured her that it was not her fault, and encouraged her to enter the greenhouse for as long as she felt comfortable. Surrounded by her friends, Aglaé entered the greenhouse and was able to look at the butterflies inside with a smile before backing out. Dr. Psiquat congratulated her for her excellent start, and for finding a support system in her journey of overcoming her fears.

title: Aglaé
text:
Aglaé - History
In "A Fairy Good Night", Aglaé participated in a classroom video conference hosted by astronaut Claudie Kanté from the International Space Station, who spoke about her upcoming space mission. Aglaé asked if she would be alone in space, to which Claudie responded that she would be living alongside other astronauts. Aglaé pointed out that Max seemed unhappy about staying with the European Space Agency in his mom's absence. Max then opened up to the class about his autism spectrum disorder, and how it causes him to struggle with unexpected events like his mom's departure. Hearing this, Aglaé expressed worry for him.
In "Heartfixer", after the Couplewreckers tricked the school into believing that Marinette had cheated on Adrien with Nino, Aglaé briefly confronted Marinette about it, much to her confusion.

title: Aglaé
text:
Aglaé - Relationships
Friends/Allies
Aurore Beauréal
Aglaé and Aurore are good friends and get along well. In "Climatiqueen", when she sees Aurore upset, Aglaé fears she might get akumatized, so she sprinkles sage on her and encourages her to stay true to herself—unaware that this would give Aurore the idea to spy on Adrien and Marinette in order to gain fame within the Bee Community by spreading the rumor that the two would break up. During break time, when she couldn't find her, Aglaé searched for her everywhere, deeply worried. When Aurore was akumatized into Climatiqueen, Aglaé froze in place upon hearing her voice.
In "The Dark Castle", they are seen hanging out at Alix's birthday party.
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/Ladybug
Aglaé considered Marinette her friend from the moment she took her to the school infirmary with Adrien Agreste. During "Wreckless Driver" following Aglaé's phobia of insects, Marinette was understanding and tried to help her, before ultimately agreeing with her friends that she should seek therapy. Later, she was just as supportive, participating in Aglaé's protective circle in the Butterfly greenhouse.

title: Aglaé
text:
Aglaé - Relationships
Because of her phobia of insects, Aglaé was terrified of Ladybug, even putting herself in danger when Ladybug carried her to safety.
When Aglaé was Lady Butterfly, Ladybug stopped her attacks against the people of Paris.
Adrien Agreste/Cat Noir
Adrien tried to reassure Aglaé to prevent her from getting stressed. He even had to make up an excuse to go get a glass of water and transform into Cat Noir. Later, he was very supportive of Aglaé regarding her phobia of insects. He even went so far as to accompany her and participate in the protective circle to help her inside the Butterfly greenhouse.
When Aglaé was Lady Butterfly, Cat Noir stopped her attacks against the people of Paris.
Mylène Haprèle
Mylène cares for Aglaé so much that she worries about her, reassuring her and telling her that Aurore hasn't been akumatized and that she's fine. Later, Mylène is just as comforting, participating in Aglaé's protective circle in the Butterfly greenhouse.
Alix Kubdel/Bunnyx/Timebreaker

title: Aglaé
text:
Aglaé - Relationships
Aglaé was severely traumatized by Alix, who had been transformed into the akumatized villain Timebreaker. During their encounter, Alix made Aglaé disappear, leaving her believing it was the end of her life. Fortunately, Miraculous Ladybug was able to restore everything to normal. However, Aglaé struggled to forget this traumatic experience and chose to isolate herself at home, fearing the outside world. Although she eventually returned to school in season six, she continued to be afraid of butterflies and the possibility of akumatization—both for herself and for others.
In "Wreckless Driver", Aglaé confided in psychologist Dr. Psiquat about her anxiety and is now working with her to find a solution to her psychological issues. Despite her trauma, Aglaé does not seem to hold a grudge against Alix, as she showed concern at the possibility of Alix remaining in the Burrow permanently if Ladybug and Cat Noir failed to defeat the new villainous Butterfly Miraculous holder and she even attended Alix's birthday party in "The Dark Castle".
Rose Lavillant

title: Aglaé
text:
Aglaé - Relationships
Aglaé and Rose seem to be good friends. In "Daddycop", Rose briefly considers inviting her to the girlfriends' movie night. In "Wreckless Driver", she showed encouragement to her friends by being present to create Aglaé's protective circle at the Butterfly greenhouse.
Prem
In "Vampigami", Aglaé defended Prem and her friends against Ray, Loïc, and Nelson. The three boys said there couldn't be anything between Prem and Rose. Aglaé then retorted by asking them to leave the couples alone.
Enemies
Raymond Pugnant, Loïc Stompet and Nelson de Glusset
In "Wreckless Driver", it is revealed that on the first day of school, Ray, Loïc, and Nelson decided to mock Aglaé for her fear of butterflies. They pretended to be kind to her but then locked her inside the butterfly enclosure. This caused Chrysalis to sense her negative emotions and use them to akumatize her into Lady Butterfly. Ray and his friends attempted to escape, but the akumatized villain sealed them in cocoons. They were eventually rescued by Ladybug.

title: Aglaé
text:
Aglaé - Relationships
In "Vampigami", when Ray, Loïc, and Nelson took Prem's paper vampire bat, Aglaé was one of the few who stand up for him. However, the trio was too arrogant to apologize. When Nelson admitted they had gone too far, Aglaé suggested that they should go and apologize to Prem.

title: Aglaé
text:
Aglaé - Etymology
Aglaé is a name derived from the ancient greek aglaïa, which means "radiant beauty".

title: Aglaé
text:
Aglaé - Trivia
In "Wreckless Driver", it's revealed that she was one of Timebreaker's victims in the titular akumatized villain's episode.
This moment was the beginning of Aglaé's trauma regarding akumatizations and bugs (especially butterflies).
Ever since that moment, Aglaé became afraid of even getting out of her house and going to school. Only after Monarch's defeat, she gained the courage to come back with a belief that everything is back to normal.
It is implied that she may have been homeschooled or did online classes to keep up with everyone else.
Aglaé, Jean Duparc, Marc Anciel, Prem, Raymond Pugnant, Loïc Stompet, Nelson de Glusset and Marinette Dupain-Cheng are the only known students of the Collège Françoise Dupont to have only been akumatized once.
Although Nathaniel Kurtzberg and Zoé Lee have not been akumatized again on-screen, "Mr. Pigeon 72" reveals that Nathaniel has been akumatized into the Evillustrator five times, and Zoé has been re-akumatized into Sole Crusher in the video game "Miraculous: Paris Under Siege".
It is unknown if she received a magical charm after she was de-akumatized in the flashback of "Wreckless Driver".

title: Airships
text:
Airships - Intro
The  are a public air transport network in the city of Paris, established by Mayor Bustier.

title: Airships
text:
Airships - Appearance
The airships that sail the skies of Paris feature various shades of green and a yellow line at the bottom, as well as a blue logo with an "M" reminiscent of the metro.[1] They use a carrier gas to provide most of their lift, and their propulsion systems give them a certain three-dimensional maneuverability.
The airships have a rather large cabin, capable of accommodating around ten passengers, allowing them to travel around Paris with an exceptional aerial view.
Airships offer ecological and economic advantages (low energy consumption, quiet operation, the ability to avoid large airports, and the ability to transport very large loads over long distances).
Stations
According to the project presented by Caline in the "Nouveau Monde" program after her election, the airship stations will be similar to those of the tram.

title: Airships
text:
Airships - Trivia
Prior to season 6, in various episodes such as "Wishmaker" and "Multiplication" several blimps could be seen advertising Adrien's fragrance.

title: Alix Kubdel
text:
Alix Kubdel - Intro
is a major character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She is also the deuteragonist of "Miraculous World: London - At the Edge of Time". She is a former student in Miss Bustier's class at Collège Françoise Dupont.
In "Timebreaker", after Alix's birthday gift, a special pocket watch was destroyed, she was akumatized by Hawk Moth into Timebreaker, a time-travelling supervillain.
In "Timetagger", it was revealed that Alix would receive the Rabbit Miraculous in the future. When the Miraculous is inhabited by Fluff, she becomes Bunnyx, a rabbit-themed superhero with the power of Evolution.
In "Gang of Secrets", after Marinette kept hiding secrets from her friends, Alix was re-akumatized by Shadow Moth into Timebreaker alongside Lady Wifi, Princess Fragrance, Reflekta and Horrificator. The five supervillains all formed the Gang of Secrets, a group of supervillains who wanted to reveal Marinette's secrets.

title: Alix Kubdel
text:
Alix Kubdel - Intro
In "Evolution", when in need of help to retrieve the Rabbit Miraculous from Monarch, Ladybug gave the Dog Miraculous to Alix who used it to transform into Canigirl, a dog-themed superhero with the power of Adoration. With her power to retrieve any object her ball had touched, she managed to steal the Rabbit Miraculous from Monarch and fused it with the Dog Miraculous into Bunny Dog. After the battle, Alix returned the Dog Miraculous to Ladybug, but she was allowed by Ladybug to keep the Rabbit Miraculous, so she could keep on helping them against Monarch. She became Bunnyx, and remained inside of her Burrow, ready to help the superheroes defeat Monarch, returning only to her time once they manage to defeat him completely.
In "Re-creation", Bunnyx sent Su-Han, Luka Couffaine, Jagged Stone, Penny Rolling and Fang to Paris by her Burrow to fight against Monarch. After Ladybug recovered the stolen Miraculous and reforged them following Monarch's defeat, Alix temporarily returned to the present timeline and joined the Miraculers.

title: Alix Kubdel
text:
Alix Kubdel - Intro
In "Miraculous London", the timeline started being rewritten in a way that compromised Alix's existence in the future with her future selves disappearing, leading her to find out what happened and recruiting Marinette's help to do it. Bunnyx and Chronobug discovered Timestalker responsible for finding out Ladybug's identity and thwarted their efforts, preventing them from discovering the latter's identity. After Timestalker gave up, the Burrow's timeline was restored back to normal along with Alix's future selves.
In "The Dark Castle", Alix was convinced by Ladybug to temporarily lend her Miraculous, so the latter could watch over the Burrow and the Rabbit Miraculous, in order for Alix to return to Paris for a few hours to celebrate her 16th birthday with her friends and family.

title: Alix Kubdel
text:
Alix Kubdel - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Alix is a slender, short, and lean French-Amazigh teenage girl with slit brilliant cerulean eyes and slightly dull pinkish-red hair in a spiky bob cut that is partially tied into a small ponytail on the right side. She has full bangs with the sides short, curved, and above the face, with forelocks behind the ear.
In the future, she becomes much taller and she has dyed her hair red with black tips, which is now medium-length and styled into a frayed pixie cut. Her bangs have also been swept to the right. She wears salmon pink lips.
Civilian Attire

title: Alix Kubdel
text:
Alix Kubdel - Appearance
Alix wears a black cap with a black old English S logo that is outlined in white on the front. She wears a black long-sleeved, azure-ish gray t-shirt underneath a dark vermilion tank vest. Each sleeve has lime green scaley patterned fabric-like designs resembling snakes, starting from her shoulders and coiling around her arms until their heads stop at her wrists. She also wears black capris with pink stitching at the top and pockets and black lace at the cuffs, black 1/2 hose length socks with two pink horizontal stripes, and black high top sneakers with pink laces, black and lime green checkered sides with a wavy orange line over it at the sides and beneath the tongue, and white soles. She also has a pale beige band-aid on her left shin. Her Miraculous is kept in the pockets; it is silver with a circular pattern engraved on the cover. When opened, it reveals what appears to be a blue hologram of a woman holding a clock with the current time.

title: Alix Kubdel
text:
Alix Kubdel - Appearance
In the future, Alix has on a pink tank top with a black bunny-eared gear logo, a black vest with pink pockets and zipper over it, black wrist-length fingerless gloves, a pair of black goggles over her head, with sky blue lenses bordered by gold, ripped denim shorts over her black leggings, and the same sneakers which now have pink accents on the toe and bottom. She also has gold piercings on her ears and nose, and her arms are covered with lime green snake scale tattoos, decorated with pink flowers and undersides.
As Bunnyx

title: Alix Kubdel
text:
Alix Kubdel - Appearance
Bunnyx wears a vivid arctic blue jumpsuit with a white section going from her chest to the middle of her thighs with black lining and a small sapphire blue–colored circle on each side of her torso and the front of her thighs, accented by the gloves and boots. The torso part has black-edged pockets at her stomach, and she has a black turtleneck with a white cotton ball attached and the gloves go almost to the elbows. Her boots are short and reach the middle of her ankles, and on each side, and the soles are black. Her mask is blue at the top, and white at the bottom, bordered in black.  She has white rabbit ears, which have black lining, and are baby blue on the insides. Her tool, an umbrella which is white on the outside, white and baby blue on the inside, with a white handle, is attached to her back when not in use. The Rabbit Miraculous, a white and blue pocket watch with a black rabbit face, is stored in her pocket. Her hairstyle also alters a little, losing the ponytail and the side bangs being a little more inwards.

title: Alix Kubdel
text:
Alix Kubdel - Appearance
From Season 6 onwards, she retains her looks, but the blues of her outfit appear more softer in color with a shorter umbrella. She also has the symbol of the Rabbit Miraculous on her back that is white in color.
In the future, her costume is a little different. Her gloves extend to the middle of her upper arms and the section of her torso only goes to her waist and having a small sapphire blue–colored circle at its center and yet a small sapphire blue–colored circle located at the center of her chest. Her mask also has small sapphire blue–colored circles at the bottom corners. Her adult hairstyle and accessories are retained.

title: Alix Kubdel
text:
Alix Kubdel - Appearance
When she is elderly as seen in "Miraculous London", she wears a suit with a Maya blue shirt, a black ribbon as a bowtie, and arctic blue puffy pants. She also wears a sleeveless white wooly-trimmed vest, with three blue buttons and black rims on the pockets, the lining being scalloped in the middle. The Rabbit Miraculous is in her right pocket, with the watch connected to the lowest button with a chain. She also wears white gloves with a black rim, two blue buttons and white boots with black rims, and three blue buttons at the sides, arctic blue toes, and black soles. Her mask is the same as adult Bunnyx, but with oval-rimmed white glasses.
As Timebreaker

title: Alix Kubdel
text:
Alix Kubdel - Appearance
Timebreaker wore a black helmet with red spiked edges on the back and two green eye shields with black gradients at the bottom over each eye. There was thin silver lining on top. She also wore a nearly black suit with lime green patches around her waist, around her lower hips and upper legs, and below her knees in an angular design, trimmed in silver. Below her back of her wrists, there were glowing lime green ovals with silver lining, and on her chest, there was a glowing red hourglass shape with two black triangles inside within a larger silver outline. Her knee pauldrons were black with a silver outline. There were also gray lines beneath the arms and down to the elbow pit. Her roller blades were black with two glowing white wheels on each one with a black center and a thin green line around the foot's ball and instep, and on the bottom of the foot in an angular design. A power bar was on the sides of the blades keeping track of her energy level, being red at the lowest level and becoming luminous vivid cyan at the top when it was full. Her suit and helmet had a hexagonal pattern.
As Canigirl

title: Alix Kubdel
text:
Alix Kubdel - Appearance
Alix wore a dark brown turtleneck suit with a tiny dog tail in the back. There was a V-shaped section colored white on her chest extending down her back and around her ankles, along with black on her shoulders, sides and upper legs, and a dark brown mask with white spot on the left. Like Miss Hound, she wore a dark brown beanie on the right with black trimming and small dog ears, one dark brown and the other black with a spot beneath it, and the ball was on her chest. title: Alix Kubdel
text:
Alix Kubdel - Personality
Alix is a tomboy. Tough, stubborn, reckless, and self-confident, she isn't afraid of challenges or saying what is on her mind. At the same time, she can be kind and grateful, like when her father gives her the family heirloom and when Ladybug fixes it after it breaks. She can become emotional and hold resentment toward others if something goes wrong because of them, like with her watch. After her Akuma is purified, she realizes her own fault of not taking better care of the watch, and she tells Ladybug that she'll be more responsible with it.
Alix can be supportive and affectionate towards her friends as seen in "Zombizou", where she joined in on Rose and Juleka's group hug after Ladybug returned everything to normal, and joined the school rebellion, when Chloe sabotaged Marinette's gift, or in "Frightningale", where she praised Marinette for her giving up her chance to perform with Adrien Agreste and cheered for her when she rehearsed with him.
Alix is also helpful towards others as seen in "Reverser", where she sees Ladybug and Cat Noir's condition and insists on helping the heroes defeat the villain. She also gives Nathaniel some advice about Marc.

title: Alix Kubdel
text:
Alix Kubdel - Personality
But Alix's greatest trait is none other her trustworthiness. She is capable of keeping secrets, including those that are not hers. That, combined with her bravery and will to help her friends, is what allowed Ladybug to entrust her with the Rabbit Miraculous, the most dangerously powerful Miraculous of the Miracle Box. With that, and as Bunnyx, she is capable of keeping secret any key event from the future in order to preserve the timeline. This is seen through her adult version who, despite knowing Hawk Moth's real identity, never told Ladybug about it, as it was still not the right time for it.
After finally retrieving her watch as Bunnyx, but being forced to leave the present in order to protect it from Monarch, Alix continued to watch over her friends through the timeline but also had her chance to explore it.
Ever curious, she explored various points in time like places that were connected to family curiosity and in history, like the painting of Mona Lisa (in honor of her dad) or the battle between Kephri and King Tutankhamun I (in honor of her brother), but she also explored the future, like a more futuristic version of Paris or humans accomplishing space travel.

title: Alix Kubdel
text:
Alix Kubdel - Personality
And yet, Alix wasn't completely alone in Burrow where she would often meet up with her older selves, from them she learned how to better care for the timeline as well as the rules seen in "Miraculous London".
Also by traveling through and seeing past events in said timeline she seems to humbled by things most would freak out about and yet, like a rabbit on the lookout for predators, Bunnyx has to sense the outcome of events first before rushing off.
Which may explain why she didn't use her power after discovering Gabriel's reasoning and path towards villainy because like Marinette in "The Dark Castle" and as well as why Bunnyx had to leave as despite how things may go in time one must always to resist messing with it.

title: Alix Kubdel
text:
Alix Kubdel - Personality
As an adult, Bunnyx is still full of self-confidence as she believed she could defeat Timetagger on her own. And yet she is also humble, admitting when she can't do things by herself, growing out being reckless. She is still tough and very determined as well as clever, seen when she left a clue for Ladybug and Cat Noir to find her in the past. She is pretty responsible with the powers she's given and with that, she knows how to keep things secret in order to keep time catastrophes from happening. Due to her time-based powers allowing her to access a pocket dimension of any point in time, like Viperion, she too has learned to become cool, calm and observant.

title: Alix Kubdel
text:
Alix Kubdel - Personality
As Timebreaker, her rage increased to the desire of revenge without regret against her classmates. She was very determined to fix her watch, and she didn't care about anyone that she took energy from to do so, even taking advantage of Rose Lavillant's kindness. While wanting to succeed, Timebreaker was willing to retreat if it meant a better chance. Despite this, her overconfidence in her abilities was her downfall when she assumed the present and future Ladybugs weren't clever enough to stop her, as well as have a limited understanding of how time travel works.

title: Alix Kubdel
text:
Alix Kubdel - Personality
When akumatized a second time as Timebreaker in "Gang of Secrets", she, along with Lady Wifi, Reflekta, Princess Fragrance, and Horrificator, wanted to expose Marinette's secrets in hopes of saving her and to be friends again by forcing her to give them up. In her case she wanted to go back in time to prevent Marinette from ending her friendship with them and turning back to the way it was. She and the Gang of Secrets had no qualms putting bystanders in danger to find Marinette, such as taking the energy so she can travel back in time. Her desire to persevere their friendship was so intense that she, Reflekta, Horrificator, and Princess Fragrance chased after an illusion of Marinette instead of taking Cat Noir's ring, with her falling into Ladybug's trap.

title: Alix Kubdel
text:
Alix Kubdel - Abilities
As a Civilian
Alix is exceptionally fast and skilled at rollerblading. She is very confident about this, and races Lê Chiến Kim in "Timebreaker". As seen in "Reverser" and "Recreation", she does graffiti art, showing signs of talent in it.
Since her father and brother also work in the Louvre, so she may know a lot about art and history itself, in "Evolution", she says that one day she will become a scientist who will discover time travel. Just like Ladybug and Cat Noir, she has the stamina and endurance to handle the power two Miraculouses without much struggle.
As Bunnyx
Bunnyx has enhanced capabilities such as speed, agility, and strength, and she is almost invulnerable to physical damage. These abilities allow her to react to and evade akumatized villains attacks, as well as jump and leap several times her height and length. Like a rabbit, Bunnyx has enhanced senses such as hearing and smell. Her tool is a umbrella that she can use as a weapon, shield, parachute, and communication device. According to Alix, during one of her travels upon meeting the Musketeers, she got trained in fencing techniques from them.

title: Alix Kubdel
text:
Alix Kubdel - Abilities
Her special superpower, Burrow, allows her to create portals that can traverse through time. By advancing in time a few seconds, she can simulate teleportation. Notably, she can utilize this ability multiple times without necessitating detransformation, a testament of adult Bunnyx's skill as a Miraculous holder. This is similar to Second Chance, used with the Snake Miraculous.
When Bunnyx uses Burrow she enters a pocket dimension that allows her to view the past, the present and the future. Due to her having the Rabbit Miraculous, she also has the ability to sense anomalies or disturbances in the timeline like in "Cat Blanc". Depending on how bad the time anomalies or disturbances are Bunnyx will suffer from changes in the timeline.

title: Alix Kubdel
text:
Alix Kubdel - Etymology
Alix's name is a feminine shortened version of Alexander, meaning "defender of man".
"Alix" is also the medieval French version of "Alice".  This links to Lewis Carroll's "Alice in Wonderland" when Alice is chasing the White Rabbit. The White Rabbit has a pocket watch. Coincidentally, Alix's pocket watch is the Rabbit Miraculous.
In the French version, Alix's villain name is Chronogirl.
In the Irish dub, her name is changed to Ailbhe.
"Ailbhe" is a traditional Irish unisex name, now predominantly feminine, meaning "white," "bright," or "rock".

title: Alix Kubdel
text:
Alix Kubdel - Trivia
Miraculous Holder and Akumatized Villain
Although Thomas Astruc spells her superhero name as Bunnyx , some official sources spell it as Bunnix.
She is the first villain in the show to make a hero disappear (presumably killing him), Cat Noir, by touching him while he is protecting Ladybug — although Ladybug goes back in time and prevents this outcome from happening again.
This also may count as the first known disappearance (presumed death) of a kwami and a Miraculous, as Plagg is in the ring for Adrien to be Cat Noir.
A scarlet version of Timebreaker appeared in the two-part special event "Heroes' Day".
Timebreaker appeared another time in "Gamer 2.0" for Gamer 2.0's powers.
A statue of Timebreaker appears in the Musée Grévin in "The Puppeteer 2".
Following Alya Césaire, Nino Lahiffe, Chloé Bourgeois, Nathalie Sancoeur, Luka Couffaine, Max Kanté, and Kagami Tsurugi, is the eighth person to become a Miraculous holder and akumatized villain, excluding Gabriel Agreste, who akumatized himself.

title: Alix Kubdel
text:
Alix Kubdel - Trivia
Alix is one of five Miraculers members to have a single parent shown on-screen which was preceded by Sabrina with Roger Raincomprix, later followed by Max with Claudie Kanté, and Ivan with Raul Bruel.
In the opening of Season 2, Alix has rabbit stickers on her face, foreshadowing that she would become the owner of the Rabbit Miraculous.
She is the second person to receive her Miraculous at night following Alya in "Sapotis".
Alix's power as Bunnyx is similar to the one she has as Timebreaker, as they both allow her to travel through time. However, her time traveling power as Bunnyx doesn't require her to steal the life energy from others to travel through time.
Her Timebreaker suit makes the same noise as the Prototype Omnitrix, which is a broken watch like the Rabbit Miraculous, which is also capable of holograms, transformations, and, through transforming, time travel.
Alix is the first superhero whose power shares similarities to her power from when she was akumatized, with both Timebreaker and Bunnyx having the power to travel through time this trait would later be followed by Nathaniel and Ivan.

title: Alix Kubdel
text:
Alix Kubdel - Trivia
As of "Timetagger", Alix is the only member of the team who didn't get her Miraculous in the current timeline.
But that changed in "Evolution", when Ladybug gave her the Rabbit Miraculous.
Because of the Rabbit Miraculous' power and "Cat Blanc", Alix was the only known member of French Miraculous superhero team to know the identities of Ladybug and Cat Noir.
However, in "Gang of Secrets", Alya learns Marinette's secret, leaving Adrien to be the only one for Bunnyx and Viperion to know the secret, and purely them.
Likewise, in "Wishmaker", Viperion finds out about both Ladybug and Cat Noir's identities.
Also, because of her ability to travel through time, Alix became the only person in the Miraculers to know the secret identities of all of its members, as neither Ladybug nor Cat Noir know who each other are.
Similar to Cat Noir and Rena Rouge, Bunnyx's ears are fake. It's been seen that they respond to her mood as they went down due to her exhaustion and sadness of her inability to beat Timetagger in the same episode since her ears are fake they could be a pair of clip on ears.
As of her future alter ego is she technically the oldest member of the team.

title: Alix Kubdel
text:

Through the appearance of her elder altergo in "Miraculous London", she is the third eldest of all Miraculous holders following Tomoe Gozen and Master Fu.

The third member of the Miraculous Team to do so.

But due to this version of the Dog Miraculous being from the past she was actually the first to get it.
If the Rabbit's watch is followed chronologically Alix is the first and last member of the team to get a miraculous let alone two.

And yet, the sixth member if Alya is counted as she was likely told of Su-Han's existence and about her best friend's connection to Master Fu but Alya hasn't officially met either of them yet.

title: Alim Kubdel
text:
Alim Kubdel - Intro
is a minor character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He is a historian at the Louvre and the father of Alix and Jalil Kubdel.
In "Evolution", it's revealed that Alim had always known that his daughter Alix would one day become the superhero Bunnyx, as her future self had been sending him postcards about her travels to the past and had been preparing Alix during the present until the moment Ladybug would need her help to defeat Monarch.

title: Alim Kubdel
text:
Alim Kubdel - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Alim Kubdel stands at a medium height with pale blue eyes and orange-brown hair. He also has a mustache.
Civilian Attire
He wears thin-rimmed glasses, a lavender scarf, a purple undershirt, and a dark gray vest with a gold Egyptian hieroglyph pattern. He also wears a gray jacket and slacks, and black shoes.

title: Alim Kubdel
text:
Alim Kubdel - Personality
Alim is reserved yet gentle. He cares deeply for his kids, he is very fond of history, and is a good listener. Despite being supportive and patient, he doesn't like theories being accepted as facts, and he does not think they allow for criminal actions, like touching an artifact, in order to prove them.
In fact, like a good amount of people, Alim isn't easily swayed nor fooled by the negative publicly of people on the internet in "Reunion", as he stood firm in defending Ladybug's and Cat Noir's actions understanding his daughter's destiny.
In "Evolution", his patience is extremely vast as he knew that his daughter was going to become a Miraculous holder but waited for the right moment to unveil her destiny. But knowing of the Miraculouses being extremely important like Alix, he too knew how to keep secrets. However, such a trait of his has limits in "The Dark Castle", as he got fed up with Armand's constant attempts to change the Louvre.

title: Alim Kubdel
text:
Alim Kubdel - History
Prior to Season 1
Alim lived in Paris, having a love for History, until one day he grew up into an adult and at some unknown point in time worked as a historian at the Louvre Museum. Then, at some point, he married an unknown woman and then became a father with two children, Jalil and Alix. Until one day, whether through a separation, divorce or the children's mother's death, Alim raised both his kids alone and while his children were growing up, he was approached by his daughter's future's self. Although it is unknown how much she divulged to him, he was given another time version of the Rabbit's Watch and series of photographs from her showing him of her future travels as well as informing him of her destiny of being the Rabbit Miraculous holder but was told to keep it a secret, so Alim decided to train his daughter for the day she would become Bunnyx.
So to hide the watch Alim came up with the tradition of it being a family heirloom pass down by generations. Then, after arrival of Ladybug, Cat Noir and Hawk Moth as well as Alix's 15th birthday fast approaching Alim knew that his daughter's destiny was drawing near.

text:

So far, he is the only known member of the Kubdel family not to be akumatized.
He previously owned the family watch before giving it to Alix.
Based on his explanation of how the watch is handed down to the youngest child in the family in the French version, Alim Kubdel is either the youngest child or an only child to receive the watch from one of his parents.

title: Alim Kubdel

title: Ali
text:
Ali - Intro
Prince  is a minor character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He is the crowned prince of the Achu Kingdom.

title: Ali
text:
Ali - Appearance
Physical appearance
Prince Ali is a dark-skinned handsome, slender teenage boy with olive-green eyes and short dark, slightly puffed curly hair with a curly goatee resting on his forehead. His lips are reddish-coloured and his cheeks and the tips of his ears are slightly tinted blood-red.
Civilian attire
He wears a white dress shirt underneath a light gray vest with a white pattern and a gray dress jacket. He has a white handkerchief folded into the left pocket on his jacket, and he wears a dark green tie. He also wears gray dress pants and black dress shoes.

title: Ali
text:
Ali - Personality
Prince Ali is kind and fun-loving. Due to his royalty, he is expected to act regal and to be safe, which he finds difficult, considering that he greatly enjoys doing new and exciting things. He feels constrained by his schedule and his chaperone's watchful eye, as while he has a good heart and likes helping others, he wants to do things on his own terms, and he understands when risks and detours should be taken. Able to recognize authenticity in people, he doesn't like good actions coming from selfish reasons, but he appreciates real, genuine compassion.

title: Ali
text:
Ali - Relationships
Friends/Allies
Rose Lavillant
Touched by Rose's compliments, Ali asks Rose to accompany him to the children's hospital where he plans to volunteer and thereby befriends her. In the end card of "Princess Fragrance", he can be seen watching fireworks with her.
Acquaintances
Soraya Khan
Prince Ali is almost always seen with Miss Soraya Khan. However, he tends to take advantage of moments when she is away, in order to do things she did not plan or does not approve of.
Chloé Bourgeois
After Chloé gives him Tikki as a gift for the sick children, believing her to be a stuffed toy, Prince Ali is slightly confused by Chloé's false modesty, and later on, he turns her down to spend time with Rose.

title: Ali
text:
Ali - Etymology
Prince Ali is named after Thomas Astruc's brother.
Additionally, his name is a reference to one of the characters in Scheherazade's stories in One Thousand and One Nights, and the cover identity used by the titular character of the 1992 Disney animated film, Aladdin, including the song of the same name.

title: Ali
text:
Ali - Trivia
An image of Prince Ali was first shown as a glimpse for a future episode by Thomas on his Twitter, describing it as "straight from the 1001 nights". A couple months later, he posted a video of the last French recording session for the first season that includes Chloé mentioning Ali's name.
He has many similarities with Adrien, because the both of them are nice rich teenage boys who would like to behave like other children their age and be free. Both are also suffocated by their busy schedule and rich lifestyles and are longing to be freed from them.
In addition, they are both accompanied by an assistant whose priority is work, Soraya Khan for Prince Ali and Nathalie Sancoeur for Adrien.
Another similarity between them is that Adrien and Prince Ali have green eyes and the colors black and white in their clothing.
In "Catalyst", Lila claimed to be his friend, and to have invited her several times to his palace or to events organized by him.
In the French dub of "Princess Fragrance", Prince Ali's kingdom is named Kowar.
In "Truth" and "Lies", he comes back to Paris to celebrate his birthday in Hôtel de Ville.

title: Ali
text:
Ali - Trivia
In "Emotion", although he was not Parisian, he was invited to the Diamonds' Dance.

title: Alec Cataldi
text:
Alec Cataldi - Intro
is a recurring character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He is a French TV host and a good friend of Nadja Chamack.
In "Wishmaker", after he came to regret his life choices and not following his childhood dream, Alec was akumatized by Shadow Moth into Wishmaker, a childhood dream supervillain who could turn people into what they wanted to be when they were children. He also received a Magical Charm from Ladybug that prevented him from being reakumatized.

title: Alec Cataldi
text:
Alec Cataldi - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Alec is tall, having tan skin, bald head, thin dark brown eyebrows, and dark brown eyes.
When he was a kid, he used to have a big red afro.
From "Wishmaker" onwards, he wears a large ash-blonde wig.
In Season 6, his wig now resembles his old afro gold hair.
Civilian Attire
He wears a light blue V-necked T-shirt with two buttons below the collar, white pants, and black and white sneakers. On his left wrist, he has a black woven bracelet with white clasps, and on his right wrist, he has a leather wristband with a silver buckle.
After deciding to pursue his childhood dream, he started wearing a bright gold V-necked leotard with shoulder pads, bronze gloves and a turtleneck collar. He also wore a pair of gold thin rectangular platform shoes with bronze high wedges on his feet. He also held a gold adult length baton with a microphone on top. He also wore a big gold wig.
As Wishmaker

title: Alec Cataldi
text:
Alec Cataldi - Appearance
As Wishmaker, Alec's skin turned dark mulberryish gray, and he had moderate mulberry colored eyes. His head was covered in black head cover with white eyelids that reached his lips, and his lips were painted with black lipstick just like people's lips who got infected with Kim's form of Dark Cupid's arrows. He also wore a black and white shoulder pad bodysuit with white diagonal, horizontal, and vertical stripes that were connected to each other. Just like Juleka's form of Reflekta, Wishmaker wore a pair of black thin rectangular platform shoes with medium gray triangular high wedges on his feet. He also held a black adult length baton with a microphone on top.

title: Alec Cataldi
text:
Alec Cataldi - Personality
Alec is enthusiastic and engaging. He enjoys presenting on television, and he tends to be optimistic. Sometimes, he can be unintentionally insensitive, like with Aurore Beauréal when she loses the KIDZ+ competition in "Stormy Weather", or when he mocks Denis Damoclès for his attempt at being a superhero in "The Dark Owl". With Wang Cheng's loss during the finale of World's Greatest Chef contest in "Kung Food", though, he shows a bit of sadness. He knows when to take a situation seriously, especially when akumatized villains are involved, as he listens to Ladybug's warning about XY's life being in danger and immediately cancels an interview with XY to get him to safety in "Guitar Villain". Outside of hosting television shows, he gets along well with others overall, including his co-worker Nadja Chamack.

title: Alec Cataldi
text:
Alec Cataldi - Personality
In "Wishmaker", it's revealed that the reason behind his mocking attitude during his shows has to do with the frustration he has been feeling for not been able to make his childhood dream come true out of fear of being mocked, just like when he used to be mocked for his big hair, what also caused him to shave his head. After being deakumatized, he came to embrace his dreams and becomes the television host he wanted to be, encouraging others to follow their dreams.
As Wishmaker, he insisted on making people live out their childhood wishes, a desire born from a belief that he wasted his life not pursuing his own dreams because others always made fun of him. He did not seem to care that the wishes he made real caused chaos or if his targets wanted their childhood wish to come true, believing he was making them happy.
After the Akumatization, he decided to have a more uplifting and positive attitude on his shows, to inspire more dreams becoming reality.

title: Alec Cataldi
text:
Alec Cataldi - Abilities
As a Civilian
Alec is talented at being on television, knowing how to relay information, and interact with people that are often contestants and interviewees depending on the show. During those shows, he is both capable of bringing the best or the worse on a person, by either highlighting one's qualities or exposing their flaws in a mocking way.
It is shown in "Wishmaker" that he is skilled at playing the guitar, despite not owning one. He usually plays the guitar using an app on his smartphone.
As Wishmaker

title: Alec Cataldi
text:
Alec Cataldi - Abilities
Wishmaker was able to fire flying rainbow stars at any target he wanted by using his microphone scepter. Once a person was hit by a star, their childhood dreams would turn into reality even if the targeted person didn't remember them. He was capable of firing two stars at once. According to Ladybug, the targets of Wishmaker were unwillingly forced to live their childhood dream(s), meaning they had no control over it, regardless of whether or not they actually enjoyed it. His only weakness was that he had no offensive capabilities and apparently couldn't undo them once the person's dreams came into reality as when a man turned into a Dino Huggie he attempted to attack him with no effect.
He had a degree of combat, using his microphone scepter as a staff. Additionally, he was very agile, being able to leap onto rooftops.

title: Alec Cataldi
text:
Alec Cataldi - Relationships
Nadja Chamack
Alec and Nadja are shown to have a healthy working relationship.
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/Ladybug
Alec and Marinette do not interact much often, but it is shown that he gets along well with her. He smiles and cheers for her and her great-uncle Wang Cheng in the end of Kung Food”. Despite his relatively good relationship with her, he does not show any hesitance when filming in her room in “Troublemaker”.
With Ladybug, Alec greatly admires her for keeping Paris safe and is shown occasionally reporting her heroics. In the end of “Wishmaker”, he realized that his true dream is to make other people’s childhood dreams come true. Alec asks Ladybug, Cat Noir and Viperion what their dreams are and did not show any ill towards the heroes when they reveal that even after they have dreams, they cannot tell due to their secret identities.

title: Alec Cataldi
text:
Alec Cataldi - Trivia
He appears in Alya's video in "The Mime", trying to interview Ladybug.
His last name, Cataldi, was initially revealed when it was seen written on the advertisement at the entrance of the TVi Tower in "The Puppeteer".
It was shown in "Pixelator" that Alec lives in the Grand Paris Hotel. You can see him in his room when Pixelator is looking for Jagged Stone.
In the episode "Wishmaker", Alec makes an allusion to RuPaul in his appearance and by announcing a quote very similar to one used at the end of each RuPaul's Drag Race episodes.
RuPaul's quote was "If you can't love yourself, how in the hell are you going love somebody else?", while Alec's quote is "Because how are you going to love other people, if you don't love yourself?"
Alec's costume in that scene is also highly reminiscent of a drag queen like RuPaul.
Thomas Astruc stated that Alec doesn't need labels anymore.
Alec bears a physical resemblance to his English voice actor, André Gordon.
In an earlier concept, Alec was a thirteen-year-old boy named "Alec Dotte". This name is possibly a pun on "anecdote", meaning "a short account of an incident", a reference to his job as a TV host.

title: Alec Cataldi
text:
Alec Cataldi - Trivia
The first line in "Stormy Weather" is spoken by Alec, thus meaning he has the first line in the whole franchise.
Alec is the character with the biggest gap between his debut and akumatization episodes, first appearing in "Stormy Weather", which is the first episode and getting akumatized in "Wishmaker", which is 96 episodes later.
