title: Alix Kubdel/History
text:
Alix Kubdel/History - Intro
Alix Kubdel is a skilled roller skater with rollerblades and a former student of Caline's class at the Collège Françoise Dupont. She is also the current holder of the Rabbit Miraculous, using it to transform into Bunnyx.

title: Alix Kubdel/History
text:
Alix Kubdel/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Ladybug & Cat Noir", Alix is one of the students at Collège Françoise Dupont joining Miss Bustier's class. After class was over, she went to the field for gym class. She was later seen leaving the field just before Stoneheart arrived.
In "Stoneheart", Alix was one of the many people who crowded Ivan after his previous akumatization, asking him if he didn't remember anything. During attendance, she was as surprised as everyone else when Ivan was reakumatized. Later, Alix, along with her classmates and other Parisian citizens, heard Hawk Moth's demand that Ladybug and Cat Noir surrender their Miraculouses. She was horrified, but when Ladybug refused and vowed to protect the Parisians, Alix cheered. The next day, she was amused when Marinette stood up to Chloé.
In "The Bubbler", Alix was one of the many people Bubbler forces to attend a surprise birthday party for Adrien. Though she dances at the party, she was quite miserable. She cheers when Ladybug and Cat Noir show up to stop Bubbler, but gets bubbled by him as a result, though she was later freed after his defeat.

title: Alix Kubdel/History
text:
Alix Kubdel/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Mr. Pigeon", Alix heard of the Derby Hat contest happening at their school and was talking to Ivan and Juleka in the courtyard.
In "Timebreaker", Alix celebrated her 15th birthday with her father at Le Grand Paris hotel's restaurant. When Mr. Kubdel asked her why she didn't dress up, Alix merely points out that she did remove her cap. Mr. Kubdel then presents her with a silver pocket watch as a gift. At first, she was uninterested by it, but after her father shows her that it produces a hologram when opened, she took a liking to it. She then received a message reminding her about the bet between her and Kim happening at the Trocadéro. Though she doesn't want to ditch her father, Mr. Kubdel allows her to go, but not before reminding her to take care of the watch. At Trocadéro, after Max explains the rules of the bet, Alix takes out her watch and asks Alya to hold it while she raced Kim. The watch ends up being passed along from classmate to classmate until Chloé drops it and Alix accidentally skates over it. Horrified, Alix angrily blames her entire class.

title: Alix Kubdel/History
text:
Alix Kubdel/History - [[Season 1]]
Marinette suggests that maybe she get the watch fixed, but Alix tells her that the watch was irreparable as it was one-of-a-kind. She is then akumatized into Timebreaker and began touching people in order to steal their energy so that she can travel back in time and save her watch. After stealing Cat Noir's energy, Timebreaker has enough power to go back in time and therefore does so, but failed in stopping the watch from being broken. Then Past Alix blames Ladybug for incident and is also akumatized into Timebreaker. Then the other Timebreaker offers her her help. The two Timebreakers battle Cat Noir and two Ladybugs but are defeated in the end. Ladybug then gives Alix her watch back she thanks her for fixing it and realizes that she never should have let anyone watch over it for her, promising to be more careful.
In "Lady Wifi", Alix was in Ms. Bustier's class until everyone heard a sudden announcement from Lady Wifi, then she and everyone fled the school after her announcement was made.
In "The Evillustrator", Alix was in Science Class with her friends getting paired up for a Physics presentation,

title: Alix Kubdel/History
text:
Alix Kubdel/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Rogercop", she was enjoying Career Day until Chloé accused Marinette of stealing her bracelet. Then, Alix got irked at Marinette when she accused them of stealing as well.
In "Dark Cupid", she was finishing a Literature lesson in Ms. Bustier's class and went home after school was finished.
In "Horrificator", Alix had the job of board clapper as she and her friends were making a film for a movie festival until Mylène got scared and the gang needed a new actress for the lead with Chloé being chosen then Marinette. However, the movie was put on hold when the crew couldn't find Kim or Max and became more surprised that there was pink goo encasing them in the school. Alix followed the group to Mr. Damocles' office only to discover that he was gone too but soon Ladybug and Cat Noir arrived informing the group that the akumatized villain Horrificator was running around. Then, Alix ends up as one of the villain's victims being encased in a goo cocoon until she and everyone were set free.

title: Alix Kubdel/History
text:
Alix Kubdel/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Darkblade", Alix heard that representative elections were coming up and was asked by Marinette how she wasn't running but retorted to her the same question. During their class she became surprised that her friend to suggestion to run, sometime later Alix heard that Chloé brought Jagged Stone to City Hall to sign autographs and gave into her bribe. However, when Darkblade came looking for a fight she and the others looked to their representative for advice being that Chloé was no help Alix followed Marinette's lead in boarding up the windows and went upstairs with the others.
During the heroes' skirmish with Darkblade, she and everyone were briefly turned into his knights until he was defeated and things were returned to normal. Afterwards, Alix was shocked that Chloé and Sabrina had stolen Marinette's diary and wandered if they had any answers which Chloé denies. Then, heard Marinette's speech about wanting to elected by fair means applauding for her friend's speech and for winning the next day.
In "Princess Fragrance", she was in Science class with her friends.

title: Alix Kubdel/History
text:
Alix Kubdel/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Pixelator", during Miss Bustier's class trip to Le Grand Paris hotel, Alix was shown having a pillow fight with Ivan until Miss Bustier reminds them that what they were doing was worth a huge portion of their grade.
In "Gamer", Alix watched as Max and Adrien competed to be finalists in a video game competition. She then watches as Max and Marinette compete and was surprised when Marinette defeats Max easily. She felt bad for him losing his spot, though when the actual competition comes around, she cheers as Max and Marinette enter the arena.
In "Reflekta", Alix was put in the front row of the class photo. When Juleka winds up akumatized, she was one of the many people affected by Reflekta and was returned to normal after Reflekta's defeat and goes to take multiple class photos with her friends at the park.
In "Antibug", Alix like everyone else found out that something weird was going on with Chloé.

title: Alix Kubdel/History
text:
Alix Kubdel/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Santa Claws", Alix alongside her father went to Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie and receives a Christmas log from Marinette. Later, she learned that Adrien went missing and joins in the search to look for him. Once she heard that Adrien was home safe, she goes with everyone else to the Agreste mansion and is invited inside for a Christmas feast.
In "Despair Bear", Alix watched the cooking lesson Tom Dupain was giving the class until it was interrupted by Chloé, who had secretly called the fire department in the middle of it. She later attended the party Chloé hosted and, after Despair Bear's defeat, baked some macarons along with the other party guests.
In "Befana", she attends Marinette's 14th birthday party and appears to have fun until Befana shows up. When Befana sends her fairy minions after Marinette, Alix helps the others in trying to restrain them, refusing to let them hurt Marinette, though she is turned into coal by Befana as a result. However, after Befana's defeat, Alix is returned to normal and continues to celebrate Marinette's birthday.
In "Robostus", Alix, along with the rest of her class, is shown to be fascinated by Max's robot Markov.

title: Alix Kubdel/History
text:
Alix Kubdel/History - [[Season 2]]
In "The Dark Owl", once Mr. Damocles' alter ego - The Owl - earns the Parisians' respect, Alix along with Kim and Max request to take a picture with him and pose as owls.
In "Gigantitan", at a meeting in Marinette's bedroom, when Alya told the girls that Marinette has a crush on someone, Alix was quick to reveal that she and the others knew it was Adrien. She then listened to a plan devised by Marinette and Alya to set Marinette up on a romantic date with Adrien. She was given the code-name "Violet" and put in charge of skating by André's ice cream cart and throwing rose petals at Marinette and Adrien while they eat ice cream. However, when the girls actually did the idea, things didn't go as planned, leaving Alix to wait by André's ice cream cart for a long time. Running out of patience, she saw Cat Noir flying through the air and take a hard landing through André's ice cream cart. Eventually, she came back and threw rose petals at the girls, asking if Adrien had left. She joined the girls in taking a rickshaw ride home.

title: Alix Kubdel/History
text:
Alix Kubdel/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Frightningale", Alix and the other girls attend auditions held by Clara Nightingale to be extras in her new music video. When Marinette was offered the role of Ladybug, she was happy for her but nevertheless delighted when Marinette turns down the offer to be with her friends, embracing her in a group hug. When Chloé shows up to audition for the role of Ladybug, Alix can't help but laugh when Marinette expresses her belief that Chloé doesn't stand a chance of being chosen and calls herself Master Marinette Dupain-Cheng. However, when Chloé does get the role; Marinette changes her mind as a result, Alix cheers her and Adrien on as they rehearse together in Ladybug and Cat Noir costumes. She was disappointed when Chloé caused the shoot to be canceled, and when Frightningale appears, Alix runs to safety.
Later, she appears alongside many other Parisians in the new version of Clara's music video and watches it with her classmates.

title: Alix Kubdel/History
text:
Alix Kubdel/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Syren", Alix went to the movies with her friends, but the theater soon winds up flooded by Syren, forcing her and the others to go up to the roof for safety. When Marinette says that she will go get help and paddles away in a garbage can, Alix cynically asks if that means they're saved.
In "Zombizou", Alix and the rest of Miss Bustier's class got gifts for their teacher's birthday, though she was disappointed upon learning that Chloé didn't get Miss Bustier anything.
Later, when she discovered that Chloé had sabotaged Marinette's gift, Alix shared her displeasure with the rest of her classmates and pointed out that over half the akumatizations in Paris were caused by her.
She was surprised when Miss Bustier was akumatized into Zombizou and ran out of the classroom with the rest of her class while Zombizou and Ladybug fought.
She hid inside one of the lockers in the locker room until Ladybug showed up and took the non-infected students up to the roof.
When Alix learned that Zombizou was after Chloé, she expressed irritation over the fact that akumatized villains are always caused by her and angrily told Chloé that she only ever thinks of herself.

title: Alix Kubdel/History
text:
Alix Kubdel/History - [[Season 2]]
Then she was taken to safety inside an empty bus along with other non-infected students.
However, Rose, who was also inside the bus, turned out to be infected from previously helping Chloé get away from some kissing zombies.
After she kissed Juleka, Rose charged towards the others, but Alix held her back, having full faith in Ladybug.
After Zombizou's defeat, Alix was returned to normal and hugged Rose and Juleka.
In "Frozer", when Alix learns about Adrien's date with Kagami from Marinette, the girls all suggest ways that Marinette could get out of playing matchmaker, with Alix suggesting that she claim to have already promised to hang with her friends. However, when Marinette decides not to cancel and expresses her belief that maybe she and Adrien are better off just friends, Alix and the other girls vehemently disagree and quickly get into an argument.
In "Style Queen", Alix is shown to be attending Gabriel Agreste's fashion show.
In "Queen Wasp", Alix was seen in the audience of Gabriel Agreste's fashion show.

title: Alix Kubdel/History
text:
Alix Kubdel/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Reverser", Alix was part of the school's Art Club and did some spray paint on the walls. When Marinette was introducing Marc to everyone, she greeted him and teased Nathaniel about his love of drawing superheroes. When Chloé showed up and claimed to have a project to work on, Alix quickly guessed that it was a collage of selfies, causing an embarrassed Chloé to leave.
Later at the Louvre museum, when Nathaniel explained the incident between him, Marc, and Marinette, Alix believed that it was a misunderstanding as Marinette would never make fun of somebody. When Ladybug and Cat Noir arrived, she was surprised by how clumsy the heroine was and how easily frightened Cat Noir would get due to both being reversed by Reverser. After learning that Reverser was after Nathaniel, she offered to help the duo in defeating him. Though Ladybug initially refused as it is dangerous, she made a point that the two would need help due to their current condition and refused to abandon Nathaniel as he was her friend.

title: Alix Kubdel/History
text:
Alix Kubdel/History - [[Season 2]]
At the Eiffel Tower as part of Ladybug's plan, Alix flew the kite that Cat Noir was attached to. Then, gave Ladybug her yo-yo back and, after Reverser was turned back into Marc, she shouted Miraculous Ladybug with the heroine. The next day at school, Alix listened as Marc and Nathaniel presented their comic to the Art Club.
In "Malediktator", Alix laughed at the Queen Bee presentation Chloé showed to the class and quickly pointed out how Chloé went out of control after having superpowers for only five minutes. Later, she learned that Chloé was leaving Paris and was ecstatic, happily celebrating alongside the rest of the school. However, Malediktator soon crashed the party and made it so that she, along with other students and staff, destroy the building. After Malediktator's defeat, Alix attended a party honoring Queen Bee.

title: Alix Kubdel/History
text:
Alix Kubdel/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Catalyst", like most of her classmates, Alix believes Lila when she says in a video chat that she's in the Kingdom of Achu and working on a project to reduce pollution. She then listens to Mr. Damocles as he praises Ladybug and Cat Noir's heroism and is excited when Marinette claims that for her good deed, she is organizing a school-wide macaron tasting with lots of treats. Later, she learns that an akumatized Ladybug destroyed Cat Noir with his own Cataclysm (unaware that this was just an illusion created by Volpina) and is deeply upset. Just then, a bunch of scarlet akumas swarm the school and one of them turns Alix back into Timebreaker, who then heads to the Eiffel Tower.
In "Mayura", after Scarlet Moth's defeat, Alix attends a picnic honoring Marinette's good deeds alongside her other classmates.

title: Alix Kubdel/History
text:
Alix Kubdel/History - "[[Miraculous Shanghai]]"
Alix was enjoying spring break with her friends having a picnic meanwhile her future self as Bunnyx after Fluff was rescued from Monarch in "Evolution", she ventured to Shanghai witnessing the past Ladybug and Cat Noir battle against YanLouShi alongside Ladydragon. When the hero trio, deakumatized him and restored the city to normal, Bunnyx formally introduced herself to Fei.

title: Alix Kubdel/History
text:
Alix Kubdel/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Chameleon", Alix and the rest of her classmates greeted Lila, who had returned to school. As Lila claimed to have tinnitus and needed a front row seat, Alix changed her seat, unaware that Lila was lying. Later, after the ordeal with Chameleon, Alix listened along with her other classmates as Lila continuously lied about being friends with Ladybug. Back in class after Lila claimed to no longer need a front row seat as her tinnitus was gone, she was one of the many students to request to move back to her old seat.

title: Alix Kubdel/History
text:
Alix Kubdel/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Backwarder", Alix and the other girls are called to Marinette's house for an emergency meeting, though because it is early in the morning, Alix is very tired. When Marinette explains that Adrien and Kagami will both be at the royal wedding in England and asks for ideas on how to prevent a potential romantic weekend, Rose suggests that Marinette dress up as a famous British star to lure Adrien away from Kagami, though Alix is quick to point out that once Adrien discovers her true identity, he'll be upset as he hates liars and will likely fall for Kagami while Marinette winds up in jail. Eventually, the girls all agree that Marinette should just tell Adrien her feelings before he leaves. The next day, Alix and the other girls ask how everything went with Adrien and cheers when Marinette says that she gave him a letter. Alix is happy when Adrien approaches Marinette but even more so when he gives her something. However, she is surprised when she discovers that it's constipation capsules.

title: Alix Kubdel/History
text:
Alix Kubdel/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Gamer 2.0", when Max asked Alix if she'd like to test his new video game, she turned him down as she had an upcoming skating tournament to practice for. Later, she was one of the many people Gamer 2.0 zapped into his game, and her akumatized identity was forced to fight Lady WiFi, though she ended up losing. After Ladybug and Cat Noir defeated Gamer, she and the other Parisians were set free.
In "Oni-Chan", Alix was seen on the school's second floor.
In "Miraculer", Alix was seen in the school courtyard.
In "Oblivio", she along with a few others found Nino and Alya's hiding spot, then at their field trip's end Alix heard their apology for the trouble they caused.
In "Party Crasher", Alix helped the girls plant trees. She then received a text explaining that Max was helping Nathaniel and Marc recover some lost data on their computer and therefore couldn't make it.

title: Alix Kubdel/History
text:
Alix Kubdel/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Timetagger", Alix started hearing a strange message from her family watch, surprised that it was for Ladybug, and left to find the heroine. But equally surprised to see Ladybug and Cat Noir at the Louvre museum, she was shocked that the message was true. Hearing the watch's hologram about digging deep into the past; after figuring out what it meant, Alix took the duo to the Egypt exhibit and, after finding and destroying the right relic, the trio was shocked to find a mysterious Miraculous holder inside. After being set free, she explained to Alix and the heroes that she was a Miraculous holder, named Bunnyx, from the future and a part of the duo's team of heroes, explaining her purpose as the team's last resort. She also told them how she was stuck in stone because of future Cat Noir damaging her jewel.

title: Alix Kubdel/History
text:
Alix Kubdel/History - [[Season 3]]
Then, when Bunnyx asked Alix for her watch, she reluctantly gave it to her. Doing so, Alix was shocked upon learning that it was the Rabbit Miraculous and even more so to discover that Bunnyx was her future self, becoming ecstatic that she will eventually be given the Rabbit Miraculous. A confused Ladybug asked about how all this will end, knowing that her younger self has seen it all happen, but Bunnyx responded that she was in stone for so long she couldn't remember anything, except that her younger self played a vital role in her memory. Older Alix then transformed. Leaving the museum, the group saw the damage Timetagger had done, leading to Ladybug doubting her abilities, but Bunnyx informed her that she will grow up to be the greatest leader and superhero ever, defeating so many villains. Interestingly, when Cat Noir asked about his love with Ladybug, she put it in words they didn't understand.

title: Alix Kubdel/History
text:
Alix Kubdel/History - [[Season 3]]
They met Timetagger outside, but before the fight began, she placed her younger self in a specific spot. As Cat Noir tried to help, Bunnyx warned him that was how her jewel got damaged in the first place (or will get damaged). After a while, the fighting started to take a toll on Bunnyx, but Alix still believed in her future self's victory. She became astonished that Ladybug was going to surrender. Then, she gave the heroine her pen to write a "defeat treaty", but adult Bunnyx was surprised as that was the same one from her memory. Still believing that her leader was going give up, she refused to surrender until being assured by Ladybug giving her the note and returned to her time delivering the news to future duo.
She was comforted by her leader saying she didn't fail, and with the help of both duos, they were able to defeat Timetagger. Then upon hearing future Ladybug, Alix asked when she was going to get her Miraculous with her older self answering, "As soon as you starting acting as cool as I am, mini me." She bid her future self farewell and then pounded it with Ladybug and Cat Noir.

title: Alix Kubdel/History
text:
Alix Kubdel/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Ikari Gozen", Alix participated in Friendship Day event with her girls and went off to solve the first clue.
In "Reflekdoll", due to their science teacher not showing up Alix and her friends were let out an hour early. With some free time, she, Mylène and Rose were asked by Alya if any of them were interested in being Marinette's model for her website and was shocked when Juleka offered.
In "Desperada", Alix agreed with her friends about how much calmer Marinette was around Luka than Adrien seeing him as worthy "boyfriend material". Then, heard a commotion on the deck of the Couffaine houseboat and was surprised to see Jagged Stone asking Anarka to come play with him but she sternly refuses. However, things went from bad to worse when Jagged's mistake led Vivica to be akumatized into Desperada leading everyone to being captured. But with Ladybug, Cat Noir and their new ally Viperion, Alix and her friends were set free.

title: Alix Kubdel/History
text:
Alix Kubdel/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Startrain", Alix was getting ready for her class' big field trip to see Big Ben in London. Afterwards, she sat next to Kim during the train ride soon and later heard Marinette yawning laughing in amusement as well at Kim's funny faces. Then, she had her attention turned Marinette and Adrien happy that they were sleeping peacefully. However, their trip took an unexpected turn when Max's mother was akumatized into Startrain by a stowaway akuma blasting everyone off into space. Despite following Marinette's lead into trying to overtake the train Alix and everyone were ecstatic to see Ladybug and Cat Noir were onboard and followed Ms. Bustier to the back of the train. With help from the heroes' new ally Pegasus they were all safely brought back to earth.

title: Alix Kubdel/History
text:
Alix Kubdel/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Feast", she was at the Lourve Museum with Marinette and Alya waiting for her father to unveil a newly discovered statue. She heard that Alya say she was close to figuring out the mystery of the Miraculous holders. This information had left Marinette astonished, reminding her that she stopped looking for Ladybug's identity. Alya retorted about looking for Hawk Moth's instead. Through Alya's research, Alix was told that Miraculous heroes had been around for centuries, showing them previous holders of Black Cat, Butterfly and Ladybug. She then showed that they all had a special emblem which caused Alya to theorize that some Order of the Guardians had been watching over the heroes until they disappeared 200 years ago. Talking with Alya, she figured out during that time there hadn't been any other heroes around until Ladybug and Cat Noir showed up, leaving Alix amazed.
In "Kwamibuster", aware that Ms. Mendeleiev was on "a certain show" Alix became irked that her brother was a part of it.

title: Alix Kubdel/History
text:
Alix Kubdel/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Félix", she was one video chat with her friends discussing on what they can do for Adrien, with Alix agreeing that they can't just show up at Adrien's house since his father wouldn't allow it but agreed to Marinette's idea to send video messages.

title: Alix Kubdel/History
text:
Alix Kubdel/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Cat Blanc", Alix was seen with her friends on her skates while waiting for Marinette to get back from dropping off her gift for Adrien. To make it more fun, she bet Rose her skates if Marinette didn't do it, and Rose bet her unicorn plushie. Upon seeing a saddened Marinette return, Alix received the plushie, and after Rose's encouragement, she saw her friend rush off to try again. Then, Bunnyx exited from her burrow, warning Ladybug about a major crisis that was about to happen, asking the heroine if there was anything to report on her end but Ladybug said no. In a hurry, Bunnyx brought Ladybug inside her burrow, explaining that they shouldn't mess with the events of time, but this was major crisis, and upon seeing Ladybug eyeing the future, she put a bowl over her head, warning her young leader about surprises. Then, led Ladybug to an alternate future where Paris was destroyed, but all she told Ladybug to do was her usual thing: capture the akuma and restore order. Afterwards, she retreated to her burrow to try something else in case Ladybug failed, wishing her luck.

title: Alix Kubdel/History
text:
Alix Kubdel/History - [[Season 3]]
Observing the future through the Burrow, she saw that Marinette unintentionally exposed herself to Adrien. Soon parts of her body began to fade, and she learned that it was the heroes' and Hawk Moth's love that destroyed Paris, leaving Bunnyx to wonder how it happened. Viewing the past again, she saw that despite Marinette and Adrien ending up together, Gabriel threatened to break them up leading to Adrien exposing his identity to his love (and unknowingly to their greatest enemy) in an attempt to save her. As the timeline continued, Bunnyx discovered what led to Cat Noir's akumatization and Earth's destruction. She pleaded to Ladybug to fix this nightmare.

title: Alix Kubdel/History
text:
Alix Kubdel/History - [[Season 3]]
Continuing to observe, Bunnyx saw Cat Blanc's anger reach a boiling point, threatening to destroy everything in the universe, causing all of her burrow screens to go blank, horrified that he was going to cause the end of the world. Upon seeing Ladybug deakumatize Cat Noir, she praised her young leader for a great job, but realized if Ladybug used her restoration powers in the future, Cat would still have the memory of Marinette's identity. Realizing what Ladybug had to do, Bunnyx was instructed to bring her back ten minutes before she picked her up.

title: Alix Kubdel/History
text:
Alix Kubdel/History - [[Season 3]]
Following suit, Bunnyx asked Ladybug if she knew how Adrien discovered her identity and found what she saw through her previous portal was correct, but the young heroine was unsure of what happened next. Aware of the secrecy of her powers, she gave Ladybug false information about what happened. After opening a portal, Bunnyx rejoiced that her body and the timeline were fixed. Then, Bunnyx was asked by a confused Ladybug if changing the events of time erases her memory. She gently answered, "What is seen, can't be unseen," informing her leader that she knows her identity and a few other things. Ladybug asked Bunnyx if she knew Hawk Moth's identity, but she withheld that information, telling Ladybug that time was fragile. She also told her young leader why she chose Bunnyx to wield the Rabbit Miraculous: because she knew how to keep things secret and returned to her own time.
Then, Alix heard that Marinette backed out of giving Adrien her gift.

title: Alix Kubdel/History
text:
Alix Kubdel/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Ladybug", Alix was in Bustier's class finishing Mock exams until she heard that Marinette cheated on the test, which she found surprising, aware that Marinette would never do that, but became more depressed when it resulted in her friend getting expelled, leaving Alix and everyone else vulnerable to being reakumatized into Timebreaker. However, due to Nathalie's condition, it was removed.
In "Miracle Queen", Alix was enjoying time with her friends at the Canal Saint-Martin.

title: Alix Kubdel/History
text:
Alix Kubdel/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Gang of Secrets", like the others, Alix knew that Marinette was suffering over breaking up with Luka and proposed a way to help her by making a friendship bracelet and leave for Marinette's house. But when they confronted Marinette about her feelings and she refused to give an answer when it led to Marinette renouncing her friendship Alix and her friends were devastated to the point of being reakumatized again. As apart of the plan, Alix wanted to go back in time to find what ruined their friendship and stop it, so she started stealing people's energy but was stopped by Cat Noir. Sometime later using an illusion by Rena Rouge Alix was caught in the pool and along with her was deakumatized and after hearing Marinette confess her feelings Alix and the others continued being friends.
In "Psycomedian", Alix was seen in the school's cafeteria with the rest of her friends as Marinette was talking about how her relationship with Adrien was evolving.

title: Alix Kubdel/History
text:
Alix Kubdel/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Sole Crusher", like everyone else Alix was surprised that Chloé had a half-sister named Zoé and thought she was going to be like Chloé until being told by Marinette that she met her at the bakery and not to judge a book by its cover. After hearing Zoé bullying Marinette in Art Class, they were confused about their new classmate's behavior upon hearing Alya's comment about Chloé's influence on her sister Alix believed with the others that they should get Zoé out of there.
In "Queen Banana", Alix was seen working on a class movie project over spring break with her classmates. She bursts out in laughter at something Chloé says, because it's ridiculous.
In "Gabriel Agreste", she and friends come up a plan to get Marinette and Adrien together with the help of Marc and Nathaniel.

title: Alix Kubdel/History
text:
Alix Kubdel/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Mega Leech", Alix was in Miss Bustier's classroom as she was taking attendance. When Marinette told Ms. Bustier that Mylène and Ivan were protesting in Place des Vosges as they were trying to stop Mayor Bourgeois's project oxygen. Alix and the rest of the class visit the park. Alix alongside Nathaniel stood in front of a tree to prevent them from being cut down. Though, this also made her witness a stressed André get akumatized and the creation of Mega Leech. Her mind was quickly taken over by a Maledikator clone that tells her to cut down every tree in the park using a shovel.
In "Guiltrip", she and the rest of the class got a text from Marinette that they found Juleka in the boiler room. From her friend, Alix and all her classmates learned of Rose's condition. Then, they all heard of Juleka's akumatization from Rose and left to the bathroom to help their friend but they ended up suck inside the titular sentimonster and by drowning in their own guilt were turned into Reflekta copies until Juleka was deakumatized and everyone was set free by Ladybug, Cat Noir and Pigella

title: Alix Kubdel/History
text:
Alix Kubdel/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Crocoduel", she watched Kitty section perform with her friends, then realized Luka was upset that Marinette wasn't coming to their performances anymore due to his akumatization into Truth. Alix and the others came up with a plan to have Marinette and Luke be friends again at his and Juleka's birthday party in an effort to help them reconcile and Adrien can't come this Saturday. And Alix said Marinette might act up her usual ways.
In "Hack-San", Alix was at the park still wagering bets with Kim.
In "Rocketear", Alix along with her classmates were watching Cat Noir fight against the titular villain.
In "Wishmaker", Alix along with her class were being informed of the career expo.
In "Ephemeral", she was seen in Miss Bustier's class and then went to see the Kitty Section concert on the Liberty boat.

title: Alix Kubdel/History
text:
Alix Kubdel/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Penalteam", she and her rest of the class were at the stadium with Ms. Bustier and Didier Roustan about to play a game of soccer. She suggests girl's vs boys, but Kim said the boys will lose again Marinette suggest draw straws to get which teammate and everyone agrees. However, until Chloe's attitude ruined the game for everyone more so when she was akumatized into the titular villain. So Alix along with Alya, Ms. Bustier and Didier, they were all imprisoned in Chloe's penalty spheres forced to watched a miraculous holder style soccer match until the Miraculers won the game setting them all free.
In "Risk", like everyone else while in the courtyard, Alix had heard that Adrien was going on a trip to promote his father company she was happy for him.

title: Alix Kubdel/History
text:
Alix Kubdel/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Evolution", Alix was with her father at the Louvre, confirming her interest in a career in science when asked by her father and excitedly mentioned about creating a time machine so her father can visit different time periods. But seeing a sad smile on his face, she asked why with Alim replying so he could remember this day as they both saw Ladybug and Rabbit Noir appear from the burrow, excitedly Alix was thrilled that the day of her becoming a Miraculous holder had finally come. And yet, it was met with confusion upon her when she received the past Dog Miraculous until it was explained by Ladybug that the duo needed her help retrieving the Rabbit Miraculous back from Monarch which left her confused upon seeing Rabbit Noir replying the things were complicated. Regardless she accepted the Dog Miraculous further explaining the mission, Alix discovered unlike the others she will keep the watch until Monarch was defeated meaning she'll have to be away from her own time.

title: Alix Kubdel/History
text:
Alix Kubdel/History - [[Season 5]]
Seeing her father so calm and being showed pictures of her future self, Alix discovered that Alim knew of her destiny as Bunnyx all along and transformed into Canigirl, before leaving she embraced him saying she'll be back soon and follows the heroes into the Burrow. Once there she saw the "complication" (seeing her future self frozen and understood the mission). To save the present Rabbit's watch, Alix used fetch to mark it in the past, then once Monarch followed them in the Battle of the Scarlet Army, through fetch Alix successfully got it back then unified herself into Bunny Dog and managed to save the present Rabbit's watch by hiding in the Burrow. With Monarch's plan to disrupt the timeline foiled, the trio was congratulated by a restored adult Bunnyx, with the mission completed Alix tried to return the watch but was reminded by Ladybug that it was her time to officially become Bunnyx. Afterwards both she and her adult self returned the past Dog Miraculous and Monarch to their points in time.
In "Multiplication", Mr. Kubdel announces to the class that Alix was chosen to protect the Rabbit Miraculous and her picture was shown being in the future.

title: Alix Kubdel/History
text:
Alix Kubdel/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Reunion", Alix was enjoying her hops through time until the day she received a kwagatama from Fluff as a sign of their friendship, then she received a message from Ladybug about her brother's akumatization, asked for help in knowing the future 200 years from now and dropped the answer where Ladybug would find it. Once her brother was deakumatized she sent him a message praising her brother for not giving into the rumors spread through social media.
In "Re-creation", she finally returned after a long absence to bring Luka, Jagged, Su-Han, and Penny to fight the Miraculized in Paris after they had been fighting several of them in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. After Gabriel's death, she was allowed to return home and attended the pool party at the Agreste mansion and she cheered while watching Alec's interview with Miss Bustier then, she joined Team Miraculous for their next adventure.

title: Alix Kubdel/History
text:
Alix Kubdel/History - "[[Miraculous London]]"
At the start of the episode, the 15, 25 and 70-year-old versions of Bunnyx played a chess-like game, until the latter two disappeared because of Cerise Bianca's world ending wish with Gimmi and the Ultimate Miraculous Absolute Power. After stopping Timestalker with Chronobug's help, the Guardian mentioned that Alix might have to stay in the Burrow, but it doesn't seem like she stayed there permanently, as Alix returned a few weeks later to the current timeline for the party in "Re-creation".

title: Alix Kubdel/History
text:
Alix Kubdel/History - [[Season 6]]
In "The Dark Castle", Alix's birthday was coming up, but due to her duties as Bunnyx, she won't be able to attend it.
Until Marinette, as Ladybug, offered to serve as temporary guardian of time as Bunnybug, so Alix can attend her birthday party with her family, friends, and fellow Miraculers.
Alix agrees, but warned Marinette of how the keeper of the Rabbit Miraculous must NOT interfere with the timeline.
After Alix went to her party, Bunnybug attempted to make minor adjustments to the party to keep it from being ruined for Alix, but the third attempt leads to catastrophic consequences for everyone, Paris, and the whole world, forcing Bunnybug to let events play out as they should and not interfere any further.
When Alix returns from her party to take back the Rabbit Miraculous and become Bunnyx again, she makes it clear she had a great time and thanks Marinette for covering for her in the meantime.

title: Alix Kubdel/History
text:
Alix Kubdel/History - [[Season 6]]
Although Marinette wants to free Alix of her duties as Bunnyx, Alix reminds her it is their destiny with Marinette being Ladybug and Alix being Bunnyx, so Alix is given the Rabbit Miraculous and Fluff back, returns to being Bunnyx, and provides a way home for Marinette, grateful for what she did for her so Alix could still enjoy her birthday, and assure everyone, family, classmates, and fellow Miraculers, that she'll be alright until the Butterfly Miraculous is safely back in the hands of Ladybug as Guardian of the Miracle Box.

title: Alliance rings
text:
Alliance rings - Intro
were techno-magical rings. The rings available to the public were highly advanced smart devices that could project a small rectangular holographic screen. The images and voices of Adrien Agreste and Lila Rossi were used as male and female templates for the rings AI. As of "Revelation", Gabriel Agreste had replaced Lila with Kagami Tsurugi as the female AI, after the former failed to keep Marinette Dupain-Cheng away from Adrien.
Unbeknownst to everyone, their true purpose was to allow Monarch to transfer the Miraculous superpowers through his special rings, which he created by melting down and remolding the stolen Miraculouses, to the ring worn by an Akumatized villain without giving them the actual Miraculouses, thus allowing him to strengthen his villains without the risk of losing a Miraculous. The rings also had a secondary feature of tracking down the movements of their wearers and notify Gabriel Agreste in case any of them registered any superhuman reading, in this way allowing him to easily identify Ladybug and Cat Noir in case they would use an Alliance ring.

title: Alliance rings
text:
Alliance rings - Intro
In "Conformation", it's revealed that the Alliance's ultimate goal was to enslave most of the humanity through the Perfect Alliance project, soothing the wearers into complacency after they were forced to live their worst nightmares, in this way turning them into pawns meant to capture Ladybug and Cat Noir once Gabriel and Tomoe removed their source of comfort.
In "Re-creation", after the global Miraculized attack, all of the Alliance rings (at the least the ones in Paris) were melted down to create a statue of Gabriel Agreste in honor of his sacrifice in the battle against Monarch, unknown to everyone as the same person.

title: Alliance rings
text:
Alliance rings - Appearance
The Alliance rings used by the general public had a thick band and buttons to access its technology, with them being used around the intermediate phalange of the ring finger. The rings had the logos of both brands that designed and created them, engraved, with the Gabriel's engraved on the outer part of the shank between 2 tiny black spots (likely mics and/or cameras), and the Tsurugi's parallel engraved on the other side of the inner part of the shank. The hologram projector was located in the center of the Gabriel brand's logo. While most Alliance rings were silver, some could be gold. In both versions, the logos had a darker shade of the color the rings' had. The only way to use the alliance ring was by putting it on your index finger of your left hand, instead of your ring or middle finger and your thumb to scroll. There were rings of different sizes, for people with differently-sized fingers.
The reconfigured Miraculouses when used by Monarch, are dark purple. When Monarch deransforms, the rings become silver.

title: Alliance rings
text:
Alliance rings - Function
The Alliance rings functioned like smartphones. There were two ways to activate and control the rings: either by touching the control button or reciting the words "Please, Alliance" and giving it a vocal command. A holographic screen appeared whenever a ring was used which showed the AI avatar and different apps. The Alliance had many apps, including: phone, calendar, GPS, step counter, camera, games and music. When someone used vocal commands, it required the word "Please" otherwise the Alliance assistant wouldn't understand the command. In "Intuition" and "Confrontation", it's revealed that the rings had accessories that enabled the hologram projector to create a bigger display of the holographic screen from the size of a laptop to that of a TV. In a bigger display version, the screen could be divided into multiple windows and a keyboard could be used as well through touch control.

title: Alliance rings
text:
Alliance rings - Function
To activate one of his rings and give his Akumatized villain the superpower of that Miraculous, Monarch simply needed to plug in the ring to the cage of the corresponding kwami, causing the kwami to be absorbed into the ring, to charge it, then tapped the Miraculous symbol of his chosen ring and spoke the activation phrase: Transfer. The power could be transferred either before (for example in "Jubilation", "Elation", and "Protection") or after (for example in "Determination", "Passion" and "Revelation") the transformation into an akumatized villain. Depending on the situation, some villains (or Monarch) received the respective Miraculous' tool.
Villains whose Miraculous' power didn't require the respective tool, such as Ikari Dozen in "Multiplication", Manipula in "Determination", Glaciator in "Elation", Ryukomori in "Perfection", Gold Record in "Migration", and Reflekta in "Confrontation", didn't receive it.
Depending on the villain and the Miraculous, superpowers which require tools could be activated in different ways:
Some villains, such as Kikou in "Transmission" and Hoaxer in "Revelation", activated the power without any weapon.

title: Alliance rings
text:
Alliance rings - Function
Other villains, such as The Darker Owl in "Jubilation", Dark Humor in "Derision", Riposte Prime in "Protection", Vanisher in "Adoration", Matagi Gozen in "Pretension", Miss Sans-Culloute in "Collusion" and King of Plastic in "Action", activated the power with a weapon they received when akumatized.
There were also villains who received the tool, such as Safari in "Passion", and Pharaoh in "Reunion". This also applied to Monarch when he used the powers of those Miraculouses, as seen in "Illusion", "Deflagration" and "Intuition".
It was also possible for Monarch to give a villain multiple Miraculous powers at once; it is revealed in "Passion" that he could give as many as six powers at a time. It was revealed in "Transmission" that each Alliance ring could only hold the essence of one Miraculous at a time, however if the akumatized person was wearing more Alliance rings, then they could receive multiple Miraculous powers simultaneously.

title: Alliance rings
text:
Alliance rings - Function
Monarch could also use the superpowers himself by speaking the respective kwami's name and the phrase "Your power is now mine." Prior to reforging the Miraculous, he was limited in how many he could use at once, four being a very serious risk to his well being. However, as seen in "Illusion", Monarch could now use five Miraculous powers at once without any strain.
Once the akumatized villain has been defeated, the kwami would return to its cage with its energy used up and in need of food.
Gabriel wore an Alliance with an AI in the likeness of his wife Émilie. It was programmed to alert Gabriel if anyone in Paris did something superhuman, such as travelling an abnormal distance in a short amount of time. It was made with the intention of finding Ladybug and Cat Noir in their civilian forms.

title: Alliance rings
text:
Alliance rings - Function
When Gabriel and Tomoe launched Operation: Perfect Alliance, the Alliance rings gained the ability to transform ordinary people into superhumans called the Miraculized with the powers of all the Miraculouses in Monarch possession, after he transferred the essence of all the imprisoned Kwamis at once. The Alliance user had to simply say the words "Alliance, Miraculize me!" and they would transform in a similar fashion to Akumatization. However if the Alliance were to be taken off or destroyed the transformation would come undone.

title: Alliance rings
text:
Alliance rings - Trivia
Monarch had fourteen special Alliance rings in his possession which is all the Miraculouses he stole by melting down and reforging them into rings.
The only Miraculouses in the Chinese Miracle Box which haven't been turned into rings are the Rabbit (which the heroes recovered in "Evolution"), the Butterfly, the Peacock (which Félix got during their trade in "Strikeback"), the Ladybug, and the Cat.
As of "Re-creation", Gabriel abandoned his Alliance ring with Émilie as the AI after his sacrifice via the wish, allowing Marinette to restore them to their original forms.
It was unknown what would happen to the kwami if the akumatized victim was stripped of their Alliance ring that holds them if said kwami would return to its cage in Monarch's lair or remained where it was just separated from its Miraculous.
As seen in "Migration" and "Derision", the rings were waterproof.
Most Parisians wore Alliance rings (and therefore stopped using their smartphones), with a few exceptions:
In "Jubilation", Marinette decided not to wear one, believing that it would put her secret identity at risk.

title: Alliance rings
text:
Alliance rings - Trivia
In "Illusion", Adrien decided not to wear his as he had enough for having a discomfort about seeing his image being everywhere on everyone's rings.
Alix never used one due to her leaving the current timeline to protect the Rabbit Miraculous.
Mylène and Ivan didn't wear Alliances, and in "Conformation", it's implied that's due to them being not being made sustainably.
In the same episode, due to their nightmares caused by Nightormentor, Adrien, Ivan and Mylène eventually put on Alliance rings.
Anarka and Luka never wore one, and the reason was unknown.
Félix didn't wear one, possibly due to his hatred for his uncle and seeing his cousin was being used on everyone's rings as an AI.
Interestingly, his mother Ameile had one in "Emotion" and "Conformation".
In "Revelation", Lila became the first person to destroy her Alliance ring, and didn't wear one in later episodes.
She also used her cellphone starting with the episode.
In the same episode, it was also revealed that an Alliance ring could be an akumatized object. This would later be seen again in "Conformation".

title: Alliance rings
text:
Alliance rings - Trivia
In "Collusion", both Nadja Chamack and Théo Barbot were seen without them, despite the former wearing one in all her other appearances.
The alliance rings are similar to the Emblem Ring from Fire Emblem Engage. The ring may act like a smartphone but the emblems were like AI and when akumatized with a Miraculous they're engaged with it but they're like a dark emblem.
"Evolution" was the only episode of Season 5 in which no Alliance rings appear, due to them being created and introduced in subsequent episodes ("Multiplication"/"Destruction").
The Alliance rings were seemingly made of metal. They were remoulded into a metallic statue in "Re-creation" and the official ZAG Store re-creations are made of stainless steel.
However, Bertrand King states in "Action" that they were made from plastic.

title: Alix Kubdel/Movie
text:
Alix Kubdel/Movie - Intro
Alix Kubdel is a minor character of "Ladybug & Cat Noir: The Movie". She is a student at Collège Françoise Dupont.

title: Alix Kubdel/Movie
text:
Alix Kubdel/Movie - Appearance
Physical appearance
Alix is a slender, short, and lean French-Arabic teenage girl with brilliant cerulean eyes and messy pink/red hair in a bob cut that is partially tied into a small ponytail on the right side. She looks like her show counterpart.
Civilian attire
Alix wears a black cap with a black old English S logo that is outlined in white on the front. She wears a black long-sleeved, azureish gray blouse underneath a dark vermilion tank vest. Each sleeve has a lime green scale patterned fabric snake, starting from her shoulders and coiling around her arms until their heads stop at her wrists. She also wears black jean shorts with pink stitching and black lace at the cuffs, black 1/2 hose length socks with two pink horizontal stripes, and black high top sneakers with pink lace, black and lime green checkered sides and white soles. She also has a band-aid on her left shin.

The rollerblades are dark blue with gray cuffs, a black line in front of the toes, pink liners, and pink and lime green stitching. They also have orange laces and lime green buckles. The wheels are gray with lime green centers and pink bolts attaching them to the black frame.
Akumatized
The rollerblades are black with two glowing white wheels on each one and a thin green line about the foot's ball and instep. A power bar is on the sides of the blades keeping track of her energy level, being red at the lowest level and becoming luminous vivid cyan at the top when it's full.
