title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Intro
is one of the four deuteragonists (alongside Tikki, Plagg and Nino Lahiffe) of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She is also the deuteragonist of Miraculous World: Paris - Tales of Shadybug and Claw Noir. She is a former student in Miss Bustier's class at Collège Françoise Dupont and Marinette Dupain-Cheng's best friend. She is currently in a relationship with Nino Lahiffe. She is also the only admin of the Ladyblog and head of the school blog.
In "Lady Wifi", after Alya was suspended from school because of Chloé Bourgeois, she was akumatized by Hawk Moth into Lady Wifi, a technology-themed supervillain whose powers came from her smartphone and its Wi-Fi signal.
In "Sapotis", after her younger twin sisters were akumatized into the titular villains, Alya received the Fox Miraculous from Ladybug. When the Miraculous is inhabited by Trixx, Alya becomes Rena Rouge, a red fox-themed superhero with the power of Illusion who helps Ladybug and Cat Noir "during particularly difficult missions" in the second season and beyond.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Intro
In "Mayura", during the fight with Scarlet Moth, while trying to protect Carapace from one of Dark Cupid's arrows, Rena Rouge was akumatized into Rena Rage, a red fox-themed supervillain.
In "Oblivio", due to her and Nino's embarrassment at being caught playing the Super Penguino video game together, she was akumatized alongside him into Oblivio, a single entity and a memory-erasing supervillain.
In "Félix", after being fooled by the titular character into thinking that Adrien didn't appreciate his friends' kind videos, Alya was reakumatized into Lady Wifi alongside Reflekta and Princess Fragrance. The three formed the Punishers Trio, a group of akumatized supervillains who wanted to get revenge on the disguised Félix.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Intro
In "Gang of Secrets", after Marinette kept hiding secrets from her and the group, Alya was reakumatized by Shadow Moth into Lady Wifi once more alongside Reflekta, Princess Fragrance, Timebreaker, and Horrificator. The five formed the Gang of Secrets, a group of supervillains who wanted to reveal Marinette's secrets. Lady Wifi was cornered by Ladybug, who successfully encouraged her to reject the akuma and deakumatize herself. After the rest of the Gang of Secrets were deakumatized, Marinette finally confessed to Alya that she is Ladybug.
As of "Optigami", she is now a permanent holder of the Fox Miraculous and Marinette's presumptive successor as the Guardian of the Miraculous.
In "Sentibubbler", Shadow Moth discovered that Alya was Rena Rouge. She created an illusion of Ladybug to trick him into believing she would no longer use the Fox Miraculous, keeping her and her family safe from him. This forced Alya to only use her Miraculous behind the scenes until Shadow Moth's defeat.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Intro
In "Hack-San", when Marinette had to temporarily leave Paris to celebrate her aunt's birthday, she left the Ladybug Miraculous with Alya. When Robostus and the titular sentimonster started wreaking havoc, she used the Miraculous herself. When inhabited by Tikki, she becomes Scarabella, a ladybug/scarab-themed superhero with the power of Creation.
From "Rocketear" until "Strikeback", after being forced undercover in "Sentibubbler", her costume changed to reflect her situation and she declared a new identity as Rena Furtive, an arctic fox-themed superhero.
In "Strikeback", after her activity as Rena Furtive was accidentally exposed to Shadow Moth by Carapace, subsequently revealing to Ladybug that Nino knew her superhero identity, she renounced the Fox Miraculous and returned it to Ladybug. Following the episode's events, Alya was temporarily unable to become Rena Rouge or Rena Furtive after Monarch managed to steal the Fox Miraculous along with all the others contained in the Chinese Miracle Box from Ladybug's yo-yo.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Intro
In "Miraculous Paris", after Betterfly kamikotized the Alya Césaire of his universe, Alya herself was possessed and kamikotized by proxy into Ubiquity, a superhero with the power to connect herself with any of her multiversal counterparts, and act as a portal to other universes. Later on, she was rekamikotized by Betterfly into Ubiquity as part of Ladybug's plan to defeat Monarch, Shadybug and Claw Noir. Her transformation was undone by Monarch, which served as a ploy to mislead the supervillains about the existence of another kamikotized superhero. After Shadybug and Claw Noir were convinced to become superheroes, Betterfly kamikotized Alya into Ubiquity for the third time to open a portal back to their universe. However, after Monarch used Sublimation to travel to other universes to get the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses from other versions of the heroes, Betterfly was forced to dekamikotize her and kamikotize Ladybug instead. She was then kamikotized a fourth time to successfully open a portal for them.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Intro
In "The Kwamis' Choice", in order to allow Marinette to be free to love Adrien, Alya was chosen by Tikki to temporarily wield the Ladybug Miraculous, thus becoming the superhero Scarabella once more. After her secret identity as Scarabella was discovered by Monarch, he formulated a plan to take her Ladybug Miraculous, forcing her to give the Miraculous back to Marinette.
In "Revelation", after Alya was removed from Hoaxer's control by Marinette, she temporarily received the Ladybug Miraculous as part of Marinette's plan to stop Hoaxer, once again becoming Scarabella.
In "Re-creation", after Marinette recovered the stolen Miraculous and reforged them following Monarch's defeat, Alya was given back the Fox Miraculous permanently, reunited with Trixx, and became Rena Rouge once again.
In "The Illustrhater", due to the danger presented by the new holder of the Butterfly Miraculous, Marinette officially nominated Alya as her successor, both as Guardian and as the Ladybug Miraculous holder, in case anything were to happen to her. She also had Tikki give Alya a kwagatama so that she would be able to access Marinette's memories as Guardian.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Intro
In "Revelator", it's shown that, after getting her Miraculous back, Alya, along with the other secondary heroes of Ladybug's team, was trained to unlock her adult powers, no longer detransforming after using her power. She, as Rena Rouge, also discovered the truth behind Marinette's lie about Monarch's identity during the fight against the titular villain. She became angry at her best friend for both hiding the truth—especially from Adrien—and for now being forced to keep the secret. After she realized that not all secrets are meant to be shared, she had her memory of the secret erased by Cat Noir's newly unlocked power, Miraculous Cat Noir.
In "Sadnansi", it is revealed that Alya, along with her twin sisters Etta and Ella, are half-sisters to Nora, as they do not have the same father. Later in the episode, after realizing the pain that Marinette's secret was causing her, and realizing that it was tied to Gabriel Agreste and his supposed sacrifice in the final battle against Monarch, Alya starts using the power of Illusion to recreate the battle and make sense of it.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Intro
In "Secret Protocol", Alya received the Ladybug Miraculous from Tikki after Marinette became suspicious of her uncle Wang being the new Butterfly Miraculous holder, and briefly became Scarabella again. Later on, she unified the Fox Miraculous with the Ladybug Miraculous to become Renabug. At the end of the episode, she returned the Ladybug Miraculous to Marinette.
In "Nemesis", after many failed attempts, Alya finally manages to deduce Gabriel Agreste was Monarch and that Marinette (as Ladybug) lied to the entire world in order to protect Adrien. After confronting her with the truth, the two ended up coordenating a trap for the new holder of the Butterfly Miraculous, where Alya creates an illusion of Marinette (as herself) to be akumatized and use that to find the villain's location. The plan works and the illusion of Marinette is akumatized into Nemesis, a supervillain capable of turning people into stone. On the aftermatch of the trap, Alya and Marinette talk about the latter's secret, with the former getting very upset and telling her best friend that, even if she will keep her secret, she better stop lying to her if she wants to keep their friendship.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Appearance
Physical appearance
Alya is a Martinican Creole-French teenage girl with medium nougat skin and has heart-shaped, two-toned cinnamon brown/salmon pink lips, grayish gold eyes, and a mole above her forehead on the right side. Her brown hair was wavy and had a reddish-brown ombré, growing slightly past her shoulders and having brilliant tangelo tips with her bangs having a split in the middle. She had thick locks that fell in front of her ears on either side and were slightly curved down to where the nape of the neck was.
From Season 6 onwards, her hair becomes shortened to neck-length into a voluminous dark copper bob cut, with her hair now having vermilion reflections almost reaching the top of her head.
Civilian attire
In the first five seasons, Alya wore black horn-rimmed cat eye glasses with a white spot on each side. Her outfit consisted of a white tank top underneath a short-sleeved buttoned up plaid shirt with white, beige, orange, and purple stripes with pockets, light blue jeans, and white Adidas sneakers with a black zigzag design on the sides and tongue.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Appearance
From "Sentibubbler" and onwards, Alya wore a fanny pack around her waist with the same color as her shirt and an orange strap to hide Trixx, and her Fox Miraculous underneath her shirt, from the public eye. Her Miraculous appeared identical to its charged form, but without the gradated segments.
From Season 6 onwards, her attire is slightly different; she still wears her tank top underneath the same shirt, but her plaid shirt now has folded 3/4-length sleeves and the hem tied up in a front knot. Her jeans are also high waisted and light-washed. She still wears her fanny pack around her waist. Her sneakers are also different, being regular ones rather than adidas ones, which are now black on the front, the sides, around the heel and on the soles in an angular, linear-like design, while the tongues, laces, toe caps, and soles are still white. Her glasses are also now dark brown, as well as her fanny pack's strap. Her Miraculous also altered, becoming silver as a sharp, straightened S-shaped pendant necklace with a silver string. She still wears her glasses.
As Rena Rouge

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Appearance
In Seasons 2-5, Rena Rouge's hair turned longer and became a three-toned ombré, having the roots turn reddish-brown/brilliant vermilion that mixed into orange with the tips being white, and she wore her hair back into a high ponytail with an orange elastic band tying it back, which resembled a fox's tail.
The locks in front of her ears also pointed at the tip in a slightly curvy manner.
The top layer of Rena Rouge's bodysuit was an orange swan necked overcoat with a black part on her neck pointing down to her Miraculous, a white inward curvy front, and black gloves that went up to the middle of her upper arms with an upward point on top.
The overcoat layer attached down to the vertical front center with a zipper, which the Fox Miraculous acted as, which was a fox tail pendant with gold lining and gradated segments.
The overcoat also had a long fox tail-like coattail that ended a bit below Rena Rouge's knees at a sharp white upward pointing tip.
The bottom layer of her suit was orange with a white thigh-length center on the front of the body and black boots starting at a point in the middle of her upper legs.
Her boots had orange soles and black fox paw print markings.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Appearance
Rena Rouge wore an orange mask with a white bottom half that pointed downwards in the middle and a black mark above each eye that resembled eyebrows.
Two long, pointing orange fox ears with white insides, black tips, and black edges were attached to the top of her head.
She attached her flute diagonally on her back when it was not being used.
Her suit had a hexagonal pattern.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Appearance
From Season 6 onwards, Rena Rouge's costume remains the same, except for some minor alterations. The orange parts of her costume now have a fur texture. The black on her legs spreads up by the outer sides of her thighs, while the palm-side of her gloves are white with orange palms. Her fox ears have also become longer and more triangular. On her back, she has the symbol of the Fox Miraculous which is dark orange in color. The Fox Miraculous is also higher on her collar that is now a turtleneck and is flipped on the left side, where it loses the gradients in the segments in favor of a simple faint vermilion ombré, and the tip of it is still white but now points at the top. The locks in front of her ears also appear to slightly thicken in a round fashion. Her mask also gains sharp black waterlines. Her flute also turns into three simple shades; dark orange at the top with a black gradient and lining, orange in the middle, and white at the end with black lining.
As Rena Furtive

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Appearance
Rena Furtive had the same appearance as Rena Rouge except for having cerulean hair with her outfit having a blue camouflage print design, along with pale, light grayish cornflower blue eyes. The white accents on her outfit turned into a very pale blue, while her black accents turned light indigo. Her flute also changed colors to match her new appearance entirely. Her Miraculous would also blend in with this new design, becoming a light blue instead of the usual orange.
Rena once manifested a pink version of her suit, her possessing. cerulean hair and her outfit with a pink camouflage print, along with pale cornflower blue and light gray eyes. The white accents on her outfit change to a very pale purple, while her black accents change to a light pink. Her flute also changes colour to fully match her new appearance. Her Miraculous would also blend in with this new design, becoming a pink.
As Scarabella
Scarabella wore a turtlenecked brilliant red zipped-up tailcoat with black polka dots. The turtleneck was black with a downward pointing bottom.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Appearance
Underneath, she wore a black skin-tight superhero bodysuit with brilliant red accents giving the appearance of elbow-length fingerless gloves, short shorts, short sleeves and thigh-high boots with black spots and soles. On her face, she wore a brilliant red mask that had five black polka dots in a symmetrical design with black waterlines around her eyes, and on her head, she had a brilliant red bandana with black spots. Her hair remained let down, except it was more curvy and bent upwards, and her bangs were tucked in her bandana. Her yo-yo could be found around her hips and at the center when not in use.
From Season 6 onwards, her appearance changes a little. The spots on her costume are smaller in size, while the waterlines around her eyes are now gone. Her shoulder accents now appear slimmer in appearance, while the gloves now stop at the palm. In addition, her hair maintains its style from her civilian form, but with a red ombre near the end. Her bangs are now revealed, and rest at a much higher position while her bandana is now worn beneath them. Her earrings are now hidden by her hair.
As Lady Wifi

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Appearance
Lady Wifi had a very deep violet butterfly-shaped mask on her face, and her eyes were moderate cerise. The top of her hair turned a slightly darker shade, and she wore a very dark purple turtleneck supervillain bodysuit, her lower arms and legs were white with three white stripes that were white above each. On her chest was a glowing light brilliant rose Wi-Fi symbol, and a thin white line went around her waist, with the line creating a semicircle above a short vertical white line in the front, resembling a power button.
As Rena Rage
In "Mayura", Rena Rage had the same appearance as her superhero counterpart except for being red all over without the pattern she had on her superhero counterpart, and her flute being dark red, owing to her having been taken over by a Scarlet Akuma. Her appearance resulting from a regular Akuma is unknown.
As Oblivio

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Appearance
Oblivio was a purple faceless silhouette with an orchid glowing outline, standing at a tall height with a muscular build. They had a light silver laser cannon with light lavender highlights and a pale purple rectangular light on top with dark purple energy inside in their left hand that shot memory-erasing beams, and a gray glove on their right hand with orchid markings across the wrist down to the palm vertically with a black oval-shaped pad on top, and orchid tips at the index and middle fingers, and on the palm.
As Ubiquity
When kamikotized, Ubiquity's hair turned longer into a two-tone ombré, having the roots turn purple, fading into orchid halfway, and was worn straight, loose and messy at the bottom.
Her bangs gained a thick sharp tuft in the center curving to the right, while the locks in front of her ears grew to the shoulders with a split at the tips, the shorter sides curving upwards on either side of her face just above the shoulders.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Appearance
She wore a dark purple superhero turtleneck bodysuit covered in stars. There were darker accents consisting of a four-pointed star on the chest, round sections on either side of said chest that extended to the shoulders, followed by a pattern of thick lines coiling around the arm where there were two stripes on top of the middle one and at the bottom, and the hands. She had large white dots on the sides of the chest with a thinner ring around them and three thin red stripes stretching out below down to the knee with matching spots that went in a gradational pattern from large to small. A purple flowing magical foot-length cape was attached to her arms with stars inside.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Appearance
Ubiquity wore a purple mask with stars and a matching headband and her eyes turned magenta, the mask having been covered with large round goggles, the kamikotized object, which were outlined by a glowing white. The sides of the goggles had Ubiquity's logo: a winged wheel, where the wheel was dark purple with a white circle in the middle framed by a thin ring, and purple translucent wing-like pieces jutted from behind with white lining. In the middle of the goggles were white markings above the eyes akin to eyebrows and a gradational pattern of vertical circles going downwards. On top was a small upside down droplet-shaped piece lined in white. She also wore a purple lipstick of the same color as most of the jumpsuit.
As Renabug

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Appearance
Renabug wore a suit that possessed traits from both the Ladybug and Fox Miraculouses. Much like Scarabella, she wore a black skin-tight superhero bodysuit with brilliant vermilion elbow-length wristbands, whilst also retaining the shape of her top as a layer on the jumpsuit. The layer rested on her collarbone with a swan-neck and flared out sleeves, all of which had black spots. The bodice on top was brilliant vermilion with a white front, black zipline, and coattail near the end with a white tip.
Her torso had a white front reaching the center of her hips, with brilliant vermilion accents in between them, matching her long, upward, side-pointed boots. Her mask was brilliant vermilion with a white lower half, with black circular accents above the eyelids to appear as a mix between Scarabella's spots and Rena Rouge's eyebrow markings, matching her nose and waterlines.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Appearance
Her hair was styled like that of Rena Rouge's, but with red tips and being at a shorter height to match the length of Scarabella's bob-cut. Her fox ears were red with black tips and white insides, accented by a red headband with black spots. She wore the yo-yo at the side and her flute at the back. She also wore the Ladybug and Fox Miraculouses around her ears and on the chest as a zipper respectively.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Personality
Alya is an energetic, passionate, fun, self-confident, and adventurous girl, but is also down-to-earth. Her foresight has come in handy many times such as posting her video of Ladybug on her blog first, before showing it to Marinette Dupain-Cheng on her cellphone, mindful that something might go wrong knowing how clumsy her friend is. When it comes to anything involving Ladybug and Cat Noir, she easily becomes very excited and has a single goal of updating her blog quickly, such as when she is kidnapped by the Pharaoh to be a sacrifice yet still records herself and live streams the video on her blog. Sometimes, she goes too far, such as spying on Chloé Bourgeois's locker in an attempt to find out if she is Ladybug, which results in her getting punished by Mr. Damoclès.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Personality
Alya doesn't like being undermined or doubted by others, especially when it comes to her work. If someone points out something wrong to her, she is too stubborn to admit they are right. Though her research is generally right when she takes her time, Alya tends to jump to conclusions, like quickly suspecting Chloé of being Ladybug after seeing the girl with her own Ladybug suit and toy yo-yo and mistaking them for the real ones. She also has a habit of never checking her sources or doing ethical investigating of her blog posts, while demanding others to provide proof for their claims; she doesn't do that herself often.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Personality
Her reporter's edge seems to have calmed down thanks to her alter ego as Rena Rouge being aware that there are lines when it comes to exposing secrets learning that despite not being told everything as friends there was still trust between them. Nevertheless, Alya, as a reporter, still values the truth above everything else, especially in her relationships. This causes her to sometimes force things when she senses someone close to her is keeping a secret from her, like with Marinette after her strange behavior regarding her breaking up with Luka Couffaine caused Alya, along with her other female friends, to try to discover what was happening with her best friend. Not just that, but she doesn't like to keep secrets that directly affect her relationships, like Nino Lahiffe. Despite Marinette telling her to keep her identity as Rena Furtive a secret from everyone (especially him), the latter told him the truth as she couldn't bear to keep secrets from her boyfriend since a lack of communication cause him to get akumatized.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Personality
Alya's desire to uphold the truth at all costs is so great that she takes personal indignation when someone abuses it, especially in the name of journalism. In "Revelator", after Vincent Asa starts to spread fake news about Marinette and Adrien's relationship in order to get more followers and become famous, she is willing to expose him by any means necessary, even using her powers as Rena Rouge to do so. Not just that, but her belief in the truth being essential for one's personal growth causes her to get angry when someone hides a truth that involves another from them. After she accidentally learned about Marinette's secret about Monarch's real identity, Alya got very upset with her, especially because the former would need to keep that secret and lie to Adrien about it, something that went against her principles. Nevertheless, she had hope that her best friend would be able to take the right decision about the secret, before Cat Noir used his power to erase that knowledge from her after realizing that not all secrets are meant to be shared.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Personality
However, even after having her memories erased, she would notice her best friend was keeping something from her, eventually realizing in it has something to do with Gabriel Agreste and his apparent sacrifice, leading her to start investigate, using her power as Rena Rouge to help her visualize her theories and make sense of them. Eventually, in "Nemesis" she would come to the conclusion Gabriel Agreste and Monarch were the same person and, similar to the last time she discovered, she got very upset with Marinette, but not as much, due to seeing how her best friend is suffering with the entire situation, deciding to keep her secret until she decides to reveal it, but warning her to not lie to her again, if she hopes to keep their friendship.
In "Sadnansi", it's revealed that the root of her obsession in exposing the truth at all costs sterns from her own trauma of discovering that Nora was her half-sister and that her parents had been hiding that fact from her during most of her life, hating that others had decided for her what she should or shouldn't know.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Personality
Alya is extremely loyal, supportive, helpful, and sometimes pushy, such as when she goes out of her way to encourage and (sometimes literally) push Marinette into spending time with Adrien. She is also very stubborn when it comes to doing things her way, such as the photoshoot of Marinette's fashion line. At times, she can be a bit demanding at times just as keeping Nino in line about revealing Marinette's crush on Adrien. She also has a dramatic side to her personality, such as when she pretends to be a unicorn with Manon Chamack and later makes an excuse to Adrien's photographer, to make Marinette a support model for Adrien, instead of her. Having to babysit her younger siblings at home, she is great with kids, though sometimes she pushes her responsibility of watching them onto Marinette so she can go on dates with Nino.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Personality
As described by Cat Noir in "The Pharaoh", Alya is a "brave chick", unafraid to get close to villains in her pursuit of the truth, tending to forget her safety at times and needs rescuing by the very superheroes she is filming. As Ladybug, Marinette calls Alya bossy, feisty, and bold. Her bravery and determination have helped both civilians and superheroes, such as when she makes a plan with her classmates to save Marinette and sacrifices herself in the process or rides a bike to distract Gigantitan from harming Ladybug, showing a more compassionate side towards her beloved ones in danger and great skills in leadership.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Personality
Alya holds great admiration and respect for the two superheroes, especially Ladybug, wishing to know anything and everything about her. Much more, she wildly dreams of knowing Ladybug's identity, not once thinking about the consequences of posting the information on her blog, as Marinette mentioned to her in several episodes. However, she would respect her desire to keep it secret. Alya wishes to work alongside her and that dream came true when the superheroine chose her to wield the Fox Miraculous and asks for her help in defeating Sapotis. She greatly values the trust Ladybug has in her, making her someone of her word above her burning desire to continue helping her teammates and returns her Miraculous back.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Personality
During a trip to the Wax Museum, upon seeing a statue of her akumatized alter ego she felt remorseful about her actions. Her willingness to learn from her mistakes is shown once again in "Optigami". Despite respecting Ladybug as the guardian and her best friend, she impulsively took the Turtle Miraculous when it was not required in Ladybug's plan. Just as easily as she fell for Lila Rossi's deception in the past, Alya ends up being fooled by Shadow Moth's tricks showing she has a lot to learn. When Ladybug quickly exposes the identity of Sentinino, Alya becomes devastated at the realization that her impulsiveness almost turned catastrophic. This event prompts her to self-reflect, ultimately learning from her mistake which earns Ladybug's decision of turning her into a permanent miraculous holder.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Personality
As Rena Rouge, she retains most of her personality traits such as her undying loyalty, trustworthiness, and curiosity. She is supportive of her allies, whom she gets very excited about working with, causing her to be a bit of a scatterbrain. Like a fox, Rena Rouge is cunning and resourceful, quickly learning and adapting her illusion-creation abilities to use them to her advantage. Upon becoming a full-fledged holder, she learned the negative side of having such a status living as well as eating her own words as Lady Wifi in "Sentibubbler", as through her exposed identity, Alya was blackmailed by Shadow Moth into betraying Ladybug at the cost of sparing her family. As well as learning to be careful of who you give the knowledge too because of how they use it. As well as from it being more understanding and sympathetic towards others like Marinette likely discovering by living through that her best friend had it worst than she did.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Personality
When telling the truth one must also do it considering how things will go as Rena Rouge was blinded by her anger she had no consideration on how dangerous it would be if anyone learned the truth about Gabriel Agreste especially for Adrien with the new Butterfly Miraculous holder around acting like Monarch.
Being Ladybug's right-hand, Rena Rouge has showed to possess great leadership skills, as seen when she perfectly led the Miraculers during their trap against the new holder of the Butterfly Miraculous after Ladybug (as part of their plan) was turn to stone and had her earrings seized.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Personality
In her first time as Scarabella, she acted like a rookie, stressing over what her superhero name should be and falling into obvious traps. The reason for her behavior stemmed from the pressure of trying to live up to Ladybug's expectations, as well as Cat Noir's, who had a hard time accepting her as a replacement for his everyday partner. After he was able to accept and trust her as a partner, Scarabella's true superhero nature was able to flourish, being able to come up with a plan to defeat Robostus. In her second time as Scarabella, having learned to work with Cat Noir, she was able to cooperate very well with others, even when she had just met them, as she was able to make great teamwork with Kitty Noire moments after they had just met each other, with the two of them quickly coming up with a plan together to defeat a villain and execute it perfectly.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Personality
As Lady Wifi, her desire for answers increased considerably. Despising Ladybug's secrecy, she would stop at nothing to find out her secret identity, even if it meant exposing a horrible person underneath, such as when she believed that Chloé was Ladybug. Her speediness to update onlookers remained the same, but her methods for finding info became sneakier than her normal self. Aside from that, she was also vengeful towards people that wronged her such as Denis Damoclès whom she paused after exposing his secret of suspending Alya.
As Rena Rage, her personality as Rena Rouge seemed to invert, making her cruel and aggressive.
As Oblivio, she wanted nothing more than to erase the memories of everyone in Paris.
When akumatized a second time as Lady Wifi in "Félix", she, along with Reflekta and Princess Fragrance, wanted revenge on Adrien for sending an ungrateful message. However, after learning it was his cousin Félix, the Punisher Trio aimed their anger at him for making Adrien look like a monster. She would also "punish" anyone who got in their way, such as pausing Nino and Nathalie.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Personality
When akumatized a third time as Lady Wifi in "Gang of Secrets", she, along with Reflekta, Timebreaker, Princess Fragrance, and Horrificator, wanted to expose Marinette's secrets in hopes of saving her and to be friends again by forcing her to give them up by trapping her. She and the Gang of Secrets had no qualms putting bystanders in danger to find Marinette, such as pausing a few students at the library. When Ladybug captured her and reminds her the important of trust as well as needing her as Rena Rouge, Lady Wifi broke free of Shadow Moth's control.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Abilities
As a civilian
Alya is very tech-savvy, keeping up the school blog and Ladyblog with ease, uploading videos and streaming live recordings. She records with her cellphone and knows how to download videos from it. Judging from her Instagram photos, she is also quick with a camera, taking many photos of Ladybug and Marinette without being noticed until the heroine spotted her first.
She also can use applications to see more aspects of pictures than can be seen at first sight. In "Startrain", she started a blog about astronomy.
Aside from that skill, Alya is a very good writer, composing several articles for her blogs and penning the script for Nino's film in "Horrificator". Observant and a quick thinker, Alya has figured out a lot of things about Ladybug, Cat Noir, their Miraculouses, and the villains they fight from watching them. Even before becoming a regular superhero, she knew about their time limit and the Akuma-corrupted objects. She quickly deduced that the kwamis are the power source of their powers. While not knowing that her best friend is Ladybug, Alya guessed correctly the identities of Carapace and Cat Noir, though is apparently not sure about the latter.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Abilities
Her observation skills and previous knowledge allowed her to discover the existence of previous Miraculous holders and the Order of the Guardians.
Likewise, Alya excels at presenting herself in her videos, explaining situations when needed, and usually keeping her cool if the situation gets dangerous, as with the Pharaoh. She quickly developed great acrobatic skills even in her civilian form, demonstrating decent fighting abilities and good coordination while dancing with Nino. She's also good at rapping and is learning to cook with her mother.
Alya also possesses a very strong willpower. During "Mayura", she, as Rena Rouge, is shown to try to resist the power of Dark Cupid's hate arrows, despite eventually ending up being consumed by hate. In "Gang of Secrets", after some incentive by Ladybug, who reminded her of her identity as a superhero, she was able to free herself from Shadow Moth's control and deakumatize herself, a feat no person has ever managed to perform.
Similar to Marinette, Alya is shown to be very clever using her illusions to outsmart Shadow Moth into believing she'll never receive the Fox Miraculous again and save her loved ones.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Abilities
She is shown to have a good memory as she was able to perfectly remember word for word of her conversation with Cat Noir the previous night in "Rocketear".
As Rena Rouge/Rena Furtive
Rena Rouge has enhanced capabilities such as speed, agility, and strength, and she is almost invulnerable to physical damage. These abilities allow her to react to and evade akumatized villains attacks, as well as jump and leap several times her height and length. She has enhanced senses similar to those of a fox, such as hearing, smell, night vision, and stealth.
Her tool is a flute, which she can use as a weapon for both attack and defense against enemies, a telescope and communication device, with her being able to call upon any superhero of her team.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Abilities
Her special power, Mirage, is executed by playing her flute to produce an orange ball of energy at the far end of it. Wherever she throws the ball of energy, it creates a hyper-realistic illusion - however, the illusion disappears if it is touched. This ability makes Rena Rouge an excellent member of the team, as she uses her illusions to trick enemies and outsmart them, to the point of being capable of defusing entire crisis without even engaging in direct combat.
Initially, using her power would depower her and cause her to detransform after 5 minutes, however, in "Revelator" it is shown that Rena Rouge has learned to control her adult powers, allowing her to not detransform back and use Mirage as much as she wishes.
In "Nemesis", through her illusion of Marinette that had been akumatized by Chrysalis into the titular villain, Rena Rouge gained the power of petrification.
As Scarabella
She had the same abilities as Ladybug: enhanced skills like speed, agility, and strength, and near invulnerability to physical damage.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Abilities
Like Ladybug, Scarabella could wield her yo-yo remarkably well, like using it as a grappling hook, a rope to restrain others, a projectile, and a shield if she spun it fast enough. Her mastery over the yo-yo was so remarkable that she was able to capture Cat Noir, a more experienced superhero, with it. After an evil akuma was released from its corrupted object, she could open her yo-yo, throw it to grab it, and remove the dark energy, releasing it as a normal butterfly.
Along with her special power, Lucky Charm created an object that helped her to achieve her objective, and it was often to stop a villain. Though struggling at first, her cleverness helped enable her to perceive where the object could be used to help her achieve her goal. Once the villain was dealt with, Scarabella could throw her Lucky Charm object into the air and use the Miraculous Scarabella, which would make it revert back to energy and fix all of the damage done since the villain appeared.
As Renabug
Renabug had the same powers as Rena Rouge and Scarabella, with Lucky Charm, Mirage, her flute tool, and her yo-yo tool.
As Lady Wifi

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Abilities
A Wi-Fi signal gave Lady Wifi power, but if the signal was too weak or nonexistent, she lost her abilities. She used her cellphone, which was the Akumatized object, as her weapon. Swiping her phone, she could shoot out glowing pink icons:
The pause and stop icons, which could freeze people.
The padlock icon, which could lock doors, and bind body parts to a surface.
The camera icon, which she used to film and broadcast videos that she could project in the sky and on all available screens.
The fast forward icon, which acted like a hoverboard as a mode of transportation. This was first shown in "The Puppeteer".
Lady Wifi was also able to dispel any of the currently in-use icons by crossing them off using her cellphone. Additionally, Lady Wifi could teleport to cell phones and antennas.
In "Félix", Alya's tablet became Lady Wifi's new weapon and, because of her satellite connection, her previous weakness regarding the existence of Wi-Fi signal was removed and her abilties expanded to being able other teleport other people with her as she teleported Princess Fragrance and Reflekta with her.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Abilities
Even without her phone abilities, Lady Wifi was skilled in hand-to-hand combat, easily being able to pin Cat Noir down on the ground. She was also shown to be remarkably strong, easily lifting an entire wooden chest and throwing it across the room at Ladybug.
However, she was also vulnerable to her own power, and if someone snatched her phone, they could use it against her, as seen in "Evolution" when Monarch snatched her phone and paused her.
As Rena Rage
She retained the same ability as Rena Rouge, as well as the same weapon.
As Oblivio
Oblivio had super strength and wielded a laser cannon that could fire a blast of purple energy that caused whoever it hit to lose their memories. They were invulnerable to physical attacks, which phased right through them.
As Ubiquity
Ubiquity's main power was the ability to be omnipresent in all the universes where she had a counterpart. She did this by connecting to any of the counterparts and turning them into Ubiquity. Once she did that, she could see, hear, talk and act through her counterparts. When she was in control, her counterparts had no idea what was happening, only regaining control once the real Ubiquity was not using their bodies.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Abilities
Her second power was the ability to open portals between universes through her cape which became covered in stars, simulating a universe, when activated. By connecting herself with her counterparts, she could create a bridge between her world and her counterparts'. Since she could act through all her counterparts, she could open portals from and to any universe she desired.
Because she could act through all of her counterparts by turning them into her, her kamiko was also present in the same object of that counterpart, similar to when an akumatized villain used Multitude while holding their akumatized object, with the akuma being able to be freed by breaking only one of the cloned objects.
Also, she was able to sense when others try to cross over to other universes as she felt when Monarch tried to after granting himself the power to travel across universes with the Rooster Miraculous.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Etymology
Alya's name is derived from the late R&B singer Aaliyah, just as the rest of her family's names are references to jazz singers.
In Slavonic, "Alya" means "beautiful" or "scarlet", possibly a reference to her red-brown hair. In Arabic, it means "sky," "heaven", or "loftiness".
Her surname, Césaire, is a name variation of "Caesar", which translates to "hairy", akin to her large wavy hair.
In the English dub, her surname is often pronounced as See-ZER or Seh-ZAR, depending on the episode. In the French dub, however, it's pronounced as Seh-ZER, which is the correct pronouncination following the rules of French orthography and orthoepy.
In the Serbian and Croatian dubs, her name is changed to Ајла Сезар/Ajla Sezar.
In the Bulgarian dub, her surname is changed to Сезаре (Sezare).
Her name is also sometimes pronounced with a soft l sound (as Aľa).
Probably due to the Wi-Fi technology being trademarked, the term has been consistently spelled like Wifi as part of her akumatized identity.
Alya's superhero name, Rena Rouge, is a play on "Renard Rouge", which means Red Fox in french.
Alternatively, "rena" could also be referring to the word for "fox" in Haitian-Creole.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Etymology
In the Italian dub, she is called Volpe Rossa, which also means "Red Fox".
In the European Portuguese dub, her name was changed to Fox Rouge. This was most likely done to avoid confusion about the meaning of the word "rena" in Portuguese, which means reindeer.
Alya's other superhero name, Rena Furtive, is the first part of "Rena Rouge" with the English word "Furtive", which means "done in a evasive or secretive way".
Unlike in "Sapotis", in which Alya chose the name "Rena Rouge" very quickly, Alya had a hard time settling up with a superhero name for when using the Ladybug Miraculous. Before settling with Scarabella in the very end of the episode, she comes up with the following names: "Captain Bug", "Wonder Bug", "Super Bug", "Bug-a-Lady", "Lady Luck", "La Bugette", and "Black Spots of Justice".
"Scarabella" is a portmanteau of the words, "scarab", a species from the scarab beetle, and "ella" which in various contexts means girl. Although, the second word could also be ''bella'' which means ''beautiful girl/woman/lady".
Scarabs used to be considered a sacred animal by the ancient Egyptians, being a symbol of rebirth and used as a good luck charm.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Etymology
When Alya and Nino become Oblivio, their supervillain name is a pun on the word oblivion, which means, "the state of being unaware or unconscious of what is happening".
Alternatively, it might come from the word 'oblivion' in reference of their power of erasing memories.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Trivia
Character Development and Design
Unlike in the final product, Alya knew that Marinette was Ladybug in the early concept of the show.
As of "Gang of Secrets", Alya is one of the few people that know Ladybug's identity along with an adult version of Alix Kubdel, Luka Couffaine, Su-Han and the Chinese Miracle Box's kwamis.
She is also one of the two members in the current French Miraculous superhero team to know Ladybug's true identity, following Luka, who discovered in the episode "Wishmaker", however, he is the only member of the French Miraculous superhero team to know both Ladybug and Cat Noir's secret identity.
In older concept art, Alya didn't wear glasses but instead wore sunglasses on top of her head.
Revealed by the Staff
News of Alya appearing as a superhero in an upcoming season was first released at Anime Expo 2016 during the Miraculous Ladybug panel.
Rena Rouge's identity was later revealed to be Alya at the Miraculous panel at New York Comic Con 2016.
It was confirmed again at the panel at San Diego Comic Con 2016, along with revealing her debut to be in Season 2.
Her superhero name was revealed at a TFOU press conference on August 31, 2017.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Trivia
The final concept design of Rena Rouge was revealed at the New York Toy Fair 2017 as a preview for a fashion doll and action doll of her.
Alya has her own official Instagram account. You can find her under the username @alya.ladyblogger.
Manager of the character accounts announced that she no longer works at ZAG. The future of accounts is unknown.
She mentions starting a bullet journal in one of her Instagram pictures.
Due to her father's job at the zoo, on occasion, he lets Alya and her friends or family in after-hours.
Since September 2020, Alya has now her own Facebook account.
As a Miraculous Holder and Akumatized Villains
Alya is one of the few characters to have more than one akumatized identity along with Nino Lahiffe, Chloé Bourgeois, Luka Couffaine, Kagami Tsurugi, Caline Bustier, Roland Dupain, Nathalie Sancoeur and Lila Rossi
In "Gang of Secrets", Alya becomes the first person to be able to free herself from the power of Akumatization.
However, she is the second person to resist Akumatization overall, following Chloé who was able to refuse being akumatized in "Miraculer".

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Trivia
Alya is the most recurring supporting character of the series, appearing in nearly every episode, alongside the main cast of Marinette, Adrien, Hawk Moth, Tikki, and Plagg.
Likewise, Lady Wifi made the most on-screen reappearances out of any other akumatized villain in the series.
In "The Evillustrator", she reappears in Nathaniel's fantasy, teaming up with Stormy Weather to attack Marinette and her third appearance while being controlled by the titular villain in "The Puppeteer".
Lady Wifi appears in "Gamer 2.0" for Gamer 2.0's powers and as a wax statue in the Musée Grévin in "The Puppeteer 2".
As of "Gang of Secrets", Lady Wifi is the fourth akumatized villain to disobey Hawk Moth, now Shadow Moth, following Gigantitan, Robustus and YanLuoShi.
Additionally, she is the first akumatized villain to resist him.
As seen in "Mr. Pigeon 72", Alya has been akumatized into Lady Wifi four times. ("Lady Wifi", "Félix", "Gang of Secrets" and one off-screen akumatization).
With her akumatizations in Rena Rage, Oblivio with Nino and her four kamikotizations in Ubiquity, Alya has been akumatized 10 times in total.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Trivia
With her 10 akumatizations, Alya comes in second place alongside Chloé for having been akumatized the most number of times behind Mr. Ramier and ahead of Kagami, Juleka, Lila and Roger.
However, unlike the others, Alya, along with Chloé, Kagami and Lila, haven't been re-akumatized into the same villain all of the time.
Lady Wifi is the first villain who manages to remove a Miraculous from one of the heroes without making it disappear, as Cat Noir drops his ring when she throws him into a freezer. However, she is unaware of the success as she focuses on Ladybug at the time.
The next to do so was the titular villain in "The Dark Owl" and the titular villain in "Troublemaker".
Lady Wifi is the only akumatized villain to make her debut before the episode named after her, as she appears in a fantasy in "The Evilllustrator", which, in production order, happens before "Lady Wifi". This is most likely because the episodes were released out of order and "The Evillustrator" was aired after "Lady Wifi".
Her family comes from Martinique, which is possibly a reference to Aimé Césaire.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Trivia
Which is an island in the Caribbean Sea which is also included in the continent of North America (in origins terms or Western Hemisprhere) meaning she is actually the fifth person of said country to wield a Miraculous following Micazoyolin, Gilbert, La Mariquita, and Colt Fathom, but preceding Jessica, Zoé Lee and Felix making her the first American Ladybug and Fox Miraculous holder.
In "Hack-San" she uses the Ladybug Miraculous, becoming Scarabella. She is the third person to use it, after Marinette in "Stormy Weather" and Adrien in "Reflekdoll".
Overall she is the sixth person of french origins to use the Ladybug Miraculous following Jeanne d'Arc, La Coconielle, Gilbert, Gabriel, Marinette, and Adrien.
Her theme song during transformation is shown to be a mix between Pigella's and Ladybug's.
Ladybug presents the Bee Miraculous to Alya in "Style Queen", but she is turned into a glitter statue before she can accept it and if she had Alya would've might been the first American Bee Miraculous holder before Zoé Lee.
In the opening of Season 2, Alya has fox stickers on her face, foreshadowing that she would become the owner of the Fox Miraculous.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Trivia
Alya is the first superhero to integrate Ladybug and Cat Noir's team, excluding themselves.
Alya is the first person to become an akumatized villain and a Miraculous holder, excluding Gabriel Agreste, who akumatized himself.
As revealed in "Syren", she still gets called on by Ladybug to be Rena Rouge from time to time, but she always gives back the Fox Miraculous when she is done.
This changes in "Optigami", when Marinette decides to make Alya the permanent holder of the Fox Miraculous.
This changes again in "Strikeback", when Alya renounces the Fox Miraculous and returns it to Ladybug after taking risks under Risk's influence, Carapace accidentally exposing her identity to Shadow Moth, and revealing her role as Rena Furtive to Nino.
However, once more this changes in "Re-creation", after Marinette recovers and reforges the stolen Miraculouses following Monarch's defeat, Alya is permanently entrusted with the Fox Miraculous, reuniting with Trixx and resuming her role as Rena Rouge.
This makes her the third person to have a permanent hold on a Miraculous from the Chinese Miracle Box, after Marinette and Adrien.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Trivia
Similar to Cat Noir, Rena Rouge's ears and tail are fake, but it is unknown if they respond to her mood and emotions, or if they can enhance senses.
Since her ears are fake, they could be a pair of clip on ears.
As seen in "Mayura", Rena Rouge is the second person who isn't Ladybug or Cat Noir to break an akumatized object, following Queen Bee in "Mayura".
In "Rocketear", Rena Rouge's costume adapts to her new undercover role, becoming Rena Furtive.
Her suit in this form is light blue with camouflage patterns. This resembles an arctic fox, which is all white in the winter to camouflage itself in the snow to sneak up on their prey and hide from predators.
She is also the first known Miraculous holder whose costume adapts to their new role.
Unlike Chloé's renouncing of the Bee Miraculous by Ladybug, Alya willingly renounced herself as the Fox Miraculous holder without hesitation, making her the first person to do so.
Interestingly, Ladybug's opinion on the matter was opposite between the two. While she wanted Chloé to renounce the Bee Miraculous, she didn't want Alya to renounce the Fox Miraculous.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Trivia
In "Re-creation" Marinette told her about Monarch making the Wish and how she found the Agreste's wedding rings in his place, implying that she may be aware of Monarch's true identity and Adrien's nature as a sentibeing.
However, this was shown to not be the case in "Miraculous London", as Ladybug decided to hide from Adrien and the entire world the truth about Gabriel Agreste being Monarch.
Also in "Revelator", due to said villain's powers, Rena Rouge discovered that Marinette's secret about lying to the entire world and Adrien (becoming the very first person to discover it after the fact), much to Rena's fury, but due to Cat Noir evolving his powers, this information was erased from Rena's mind.
However she discovers Monarch's identity again in Nemesis.
Currently, seven characters know Alya is Rena Rouge: Marinette, Nino, Kagami, Tomoe, Nathalie, Chloé and Adrien.
Marinette personally gave the Fox Miraculous to Alya as Ladybug in "Sapotis".
Nino found out in "Catalyst".
Tomoe most likely got this information from Gabriel, along with the identities of Carapace, Viperion, Pegasus, Ryuko, King Monkey, and Bunnyx.
Nathalie and Chloé found out in "Miracle Queen".

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Trivia
Due to Chloe being akumatized when she found out, she doesn’t actually remember Alya’s secret identity since akumatized villains forget all their memories when de-transformed.
Adrien found out from Nino in "Rocketear".
Kagami found out from eavesdropping on Marinette and Alya in "Perfection".
Eight, as Gabriel Agreste found out previously, but is now dead.
Eleven, if counting Luka, Max, and Kim when they were brainwashed in "Miracle Queen".
Twelve if we count Felix if Kagami told him
Miscellaneous
In "The Puppeteer 2", it is revealed she is ticklish.
In "Truth", it is revealed that Alya is a fan of the longest running sci-fi TV series, Doctor Who, since her bedroom door is painted to be in the exact likeness of the front doors of the TARDIS.
In "Miraculous: Paris Under Siege", after André Bourgeois cancelled the Aset exhibition due to the centerpiece being broken, due to the anger at her hard work going to waste she was reakumatized into Lady Wifi alongside Truth, Sole Crusher, and The Bubbler, working with Stormy Weather to take over Paris using Aset's power.
As mentioned in "Startrain", besides the Ladyblog; Alya has also worked on other blogs.

title: Alya Césaire
text:
Alya Césaire - Trivia
In "Confrontation", it is revealed that Alya wants to be a reporter when she grows up.
In "Wreckless Driver", it is revealed that Alya has received help from Dr. Psiquat regarding some family problems.
In "Sadnansi", it's implied that those family problems were in regard her struggles after discovering her parents hid from her during most of her life that Nora was her half-sister.

title: Alya's cellphone
text:
Alya's cellphone - Intro
is a smartphone owned by Alya Césaire. Her phone number is +33636768.
In "Lady Wifi", it gets infected with an akuma, turning Alya into a villain; it then serves as her weapon. After her time as Lady Wifi, Alya gets a new phone.
At the end of "Sapotis", she says that she very recently got another new phone.
In "Destruction", Monarch destroys Alya's phone, and later starts she using an Alliance ring.
She occasionally uses a new one, as seen in "Reunion" and "Re-creation".

title: Alya's cellphone
text:
Alya's cellphone - Appearance
Normal
In the first five seasons, Alya's cellphone was black with white edges. It had three white-gray cameras on the top, one camera on the bottom, and another on the back of the phone. It also had a ladybug-themed charm hanging from it on a light magenta string.
Starting from season 6, Alya's cellphone has a black cover. On the top side of the screen, it has a small round camera, and on the back, on the top left, it has four round cameras arranged in a square.
Akumatized
Under the effects of Alya's akumatization in Lady Wifi, the cellphone had a white case with black stripes on the back, recalling Lady Wifi's costume.

title: Alya's cellphone
text:
Alya's cellphone - Trivia
As seen in "Lady Wifi", Alya's phone number is +33636768.
One side of the ladybug ornament has inverted colors, making it black with red spots.

title: Alya's cellphone
text:
Alya's cellphone - Trivia
In "The Mime", Marinette accidentally drops the cellphone off of her balcony, barely catching it in time.
Alya's old cellphone has no discernible camera on the back. However, it does have a flashing red light to indicate when it records video.
At the end of "Sapotis" she states that her brand new phone ran out of battery, implying she got another new phone.
Errors
In "The The Evillustrator" and "Horrificator", the colors of the charm on Alya's old cellphone are inverted.
