title: Amélie Graham de Vanily
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Amélie Graham de Vanily - Intro
Lady  is a recurring character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir.
She is the daughter of Emil & Milly Graham de Vanily, the widow of the late Colt Fathom and the mother of Félix Fathom. She is also the younger twin sister of the late Émilie Agreste, the sister-in-law of the late Gabriel Agreste, and the maternal aunt of Adrien Agreste.
In "Lady Chaos", after feeling wronged after Mr. López lied about not having a pet to have the apartment she wanted to buy for herself and Félix and being pressured by Marinette to bend the truth about how Gabriel really was to Adrien, she was akumatized by Chrysalis into Lady Chaos, a supervillain with the power to turn people chaotic and wild. She received a Magical Charm from Ladybug that prevented her from being akumatized again. Amelie later purchased an apartment so she could move in to Paris with Félix and become closer to Adrien. It is also revealed that she is aware Gabriel was Monarch and how Tomoe Tsurugi was involved.

title: Amélie Graham de Vanily
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Amélie Graham de Vanily - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Since Amélie is Émilie's twin sister, she is borderline identical to her with the exception of light blonde hair and a darker shade of green for her eye color. She has pink nail polish.
From season 6 onwards, she no longer wears eyeliner. She doesn't have a pointy chin, her hair is slightly darker, and her skin is lighter. She wears dark pink lipstick and red nail polish.
Civilian Attire
Amélie wears a gray blouse with a black stripe on both the edges underneath a dark gray long-sleeved jacket with a pearl-amber white stripe on the edges of the jacket. She also wears dark gray business pants and black ankle-strap heels.
From season 6 onwards, her jacket and business pants are now gray. The stripe on the edges of the jacket are gray and thicker.
As Lady Chaos

title: Amélie Graham de Vanily
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Amélie Graham de Vanily - Appearance
Lady Chaos wore a black asymmetrical and teared dress and gained white skin. She wore a black choker and had a black left arm and rips on each limb that were inverted colors of each other as well as the hands. She also wore long crimson nails on her right hand over her glove. Her head was completely bald and black at the top right. Her right eye was replaced with a light red crescent moon, while the other turned dark brown with a yellow jagged edge and brilliant cyan sclera to accent her lipstick, which was cyan on top and yellow at the bottom. She also wore black mascara featuring three long eyelashes and yellow dots at the tip. Beneath was a red marking and on the left of her head at the back was a large crimson diamond-like headpiece to match the interior of her dress. It had a pointed part on the left shoulder and its color matched her ripped tights and high-heeled boots. She wielded a red scepter, which turned conical above with a large black sphere on top.

title: Amélie Graham de Vanily
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Amélie Graham de Vanily - Personality
Just like her sister and mother, Amélie is outwardly positive, optimistic, and sensitive. She firmly believes that family should be together in times of distress. However, she is quite naïve, specially in regards to her son, as revealed in "Gabriel Agreste" when she believed that Gabriel gave her son his wedding ring, when in reality, Félix stole it right off her brother-in-law's finger.
Amélie proves to be quite loyal and defensive, and incredibly oblivious to her son's true actions. It's evident in how she covered for her son when Ladybug and Cat Noir came to search and understand the connection between him and Monarch. Amélie believed she was doing the right thing by protecting Félix from the superheroes who believed him to be a villain.
According to her son's play in "Representation", in her youth, Amélie was well-behaved, docile, responsible, and wanted to please her parents. For that same desire, she agreed to wed a ruthless billionaire, in an arranged marriage, despite the unhappiness it caused her.

title: Amélie Graham de Vanily
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Amélie Graham de Vanily - Personality
Due to her upbringing as being the "good daughter", Amélie is a very honest person who hates lying and is very adamant of rules. This is seen during "Lady Chaos", where she lost the possibility of buying an apartment that was perfect for her and Félix, due to the other buyer arriving late before she signed the contract and lying about not having pets. This is also seen when Marinette, in a desperate attempt to prevent Adrien from figuring out the truth about Gabriel, asked Amélie to bend the truth about him, only focusing on the good qualities, something she was barely able to do, due to her dislike towards her brother-in-law.
As Lady Chaos, she wanted nothing but to ruin people's lives by turning them wild and chaotic.

title: Amélie Graham de Vanily
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Amélie Graham de Vanily - Abilities
As Lady Chaos
Lady Chaos wielded a scepter that could create a dark sphere around her, which followed her everywhere. Whenever someone entered her sphere, their eyes glowed orange, and they became a chaotic being with no other desire than to sow chaos. The more people affected by her sphere, the more powerful her scepter became, allowing her to make the sphere larger. However, her sphere did not affect those under its protection, as demonstrated when Carapace created a shield around himself and others to protect them, and the sphere did not affect them. It also did not affect Cat Noir until Carapace removed the shield.

title: Amélie Graham de Vanily
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Amélie Graham de Vanily - Relationships
Family
Félix Fathom
Amélie loves her son and cares for him a lot, but she doesn't seem to teach him about morals-rather spoiling and indulging in his bad behavior. During the events of "Félix", she attempts to defend his actions and believes he talked Gabriel into handing over his wedding ring. She happily allows him to keep the ring, revealing that she had only wanted it to give it to him instead of keeping it for herself. However, she might be unaware that her son discovered her twin sister in a comatose state hidden by Gabriel.
In "Multiplication", Amélie shows how much her motherly love can prevent her from seeing her son for who he really is, as she protected him by lying to Cosmobug and Astrocat about his whereabouts, believing they were mistaken when thinking that Félix was a villain, when they actually wanted to get information from him as he stole all other Miraculouses from Ladybug and gave them to Monarch, to which Amélie might be unaware about.

title: Amélie Graham de Vanily
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Amélie Graham de Vanily - Relationships
In "Emotion", Amélie is asked by her son to pretend he's missing in front of Gabriel to see how cruel Gabriel really is, while he impersonated Adrien in his uncle's Diamonds' Dance. After being dismissed by Gabriel, Amélie told Argos he was right about his uncle hating her, to which Félix detransformed, embraced his mother and told her that not everyone in his family were monsters like his uncle, referring to Adrien (and possibly Kagami). It was also shown that Félix trusted his mother with the knowledge that he had the Peacock Miraculous and that he's Argos.
In "Representation", it's revealed Amélie was originally infertile and only got pregnant due to her husband's use of the Peacock Miraculous. While it was mentioned that her parents and Colt wanted a child to be the heir of their wealth and lineage, it is unknown nor is it mentioned if Amélie herself wanted a child. Despite this, unlike Colt, Amélie did love their son Félix and never mistreated him nor blamed him for his father's death.
Colt Fathom

title: Amélie Graham de Vanily
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Amélie Graham de Vanily - Relationships
It's not much known about Amélie's relationship with her late husband. However in "Representation", according to her son Félix, Amélie was forced into an arranged marriage to an American billionaire named Colt Fathom by her parents and she did it to please them. Due to her infertility, they were unable to have children, so Colt used the Peacock Miraculous to get his wife pregnant with Félix. Félix having his stuffed bunny ripped might be an implication of Colt's abuse towards Amélie, as she was seen wearing a white rabbit mask in Gabriel's soirée in "Gabriel Agreste". However, it's unknown if Amélie was aware of her husband's abusive behavior towards their son. Also, unlike her husband, Amélie genuinely loves their son and never blamed him for Colt's illness and death.
Also despite losing her husband, Amélie managed to move on from his death, unlike her brother-in-law, who also lost a spouse to the damaged Peacock Miraculous.
Adrien Agreste

title: Amélie Graham de Vanily
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Amélie Graham de Vanily - Relationships
When Amélie visits the Agreste mansion, she joyfully greets Adrien with a kiss, commenting to Gabriel on how much he's grown and calling him the "absolute cutest". This suggests that when her nephew and son were little, she lavished affection on Adrien, and loves him dearly even after his mother's disappearance. She cares about him, despite her hatred for his father, and would apologize to him as shown when her son pretended to be him and tried to get Adrien's friends to hate him, despite her lack of discipline on her son.
In "Lady Chaos", when she was in Paris looking for a new apartment to move in, she's asked to talk about Gabriel in a documentary done by Adrien to learn more about his late father, and Amelie was reluctant to lie about Gabriel but only gave in for Adrien's sake. At the interview, she barely manages to answer Adrien's questions about his father whitout exposing his true nature, which leads to her akumatization.
After being deakumatized, it's revealed that the reason she and Félix moved to Paris is to be there to support Adrien when the truth about his father will be eventually revealed.
Gabriel Agreste

title: Amélie Graham de Vanily
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Amélie Graham de Vanily - Relationships
Amélie outwardly acts friendly towards Gabriel, but in reality, she isn't fond of the fact that he won't return the Graham de Vanily Twin Rings to her. After she believes that Gabriel had given one of rings to Félix, she stops holding that against him.
Unknown to her, her brother-in-law threatened Félix to get Émilie's ring in "Gabriel Agreste".
However, in "Emotion", on Félix's instructions she pretends her son is missing in front of Gabriel and goes in his Diamonds' Dance to ask for his assistance in finding Félix, only to be quickly dismissed by him, but not before she tells Gabriel he has changed since her sister's disappearance. Later in London, Amélie tells Félix he was right about Gabriel, as he saw her worried and didn't care and called him a monster.
In "Conformation", Amélie unknowingly fell victim to her brother-in-law's last scheme by infecting her with his nightmare dust to make her dependent on his Alliance ring app.
Likely from her son, Amélie becomes aware of her brother-in-law's supervillain identity as Monarch, and that Ladybug lied about him to the world to protect Adrien and to prevent Tomoe Tsurugi from going to prison.

title: Amélie Graham de Vanily
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Amélie Graham de Vanily - Relationships
In "Lady Chaos", upon learning from Marinette that Adrien was doing a documental to learn more about his father, Amelie immediately refused to lie about Gabriel, both because of her dislike for lying and also for her resentment towards her late brother-in-law for supposedly destroying her beloved sister's life, albeit she reluctantly agreed to lie for Adrien's sake, albeit she barely could do it when interviewed, laughing at the mention of Gabriel having qualities.
Émilie Agreste

title: Amélie Graham de Vanily
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Amélie Graham de Vanily - Relationships
According to Félix's play in "Representation", Amélie and Émilie had opposite personalities growing up. While Émilie was more unruly, daring, and hated the nobility life, Amélie was docile, mannerly, and wanted to please her parents however she could. Despite leaving her family behind for a life with Gabriel, Émilie still cared for Amélie and felt sorry as she was also infertile and asked Gabriel to help Amélie and Colt to have a child with the Peacock Miraculous. This showed that Émilie loved and cared for her sister, even though she didn't have a good relationship with their parents. Amélie was implied to have recuperated this close relationship with her sister and likely spoke highly of her to Félix, given that her son knew that his aunt was a kind soul.
Unknown to her, Gabriel actually kept Émilie's unconscious body under his mansion and used his powers to try to revive her, until in "Re-creation", he instead chose to reunite with Émilie in the afterlife, finally allowing her to rest.
In "Lady Chaos", she stil holds resentment towards Gabriel as she blames him of ruining her sister's life.

title: Amélie Graham de Vanily/History
text:
Amélie Graham de Vanily/History - Intro
Lady Amélie Graham de Vanily is the twin sister of Émilie Agreste, mother of Félix Fathom, and aunt of Adrien Agreste.

title: Amélie Graham de Vanily/History
text:
Amélie Graham de Vanily/History - Before [[Season 1]]
As revealed during "Representation", Amélie was the second born daughter of the Duke and Duchess of Westchester-Munster, Emil and Milly Graham de Vanily, aristocrats in the British nobility, who were just expecting one child, a boy, to continue the family's legacy but instead had her and her older twin sister by seven seconds, Émilie. Her parents initially struggled over who they should hand over their legacy to, but they soon decided to hand it to Émilie, also giving her the Graham de Vanily Twin Rings. While Émilie was more brash, spunky, wild as well as shrinking her responsibilities for her family's name and hated the nobility life growing up, Amélie grew up wanting to please her family, becoming well-mannered, obedient, dutiful, and staying at home doing whatever they wanted. For the same reason and after Émilie married Gabriel, a low-class tailor who was beneath her social status, Amélie, despite her reluctance, resigned herself to marry Colt Fathom, an American man described as wealthy yet heartless lord of war. Her parents and Colt also dreamed for a child to be the heir to their wealth and noble lineage. It is unknown nor is it mentioned if Amélie herself wanted a child.

title: Amélie Graham de Vanily/History
text:
Amélie Graham de Vanily/History - Before [[Season 1]]
As time passed, Amélie and Colt weren't able to have a child as Amélie was infertile, even with the best medical care her parents could afford. The couple then heard that Émilie and her husband Gabriel Agreste were somehow able to have one, making Colt very furious and jealous. Sometime later after Colt made a deal with Gabriel, he used the damaged Peacock Miraculous to create an amok and inserting it into a ring to get Amélie pregnant out of his jealousy. A few months after this, Amélie gave birth to a son: Félix Fathom around the same time Émilie gave birth to Adrien Agreste. However, Colt became ill after creating Félix and mistreated him, calling him a monster and it's unknown if Amélie was ever aware of this.
Fourteen years later, when Félix became a teenager, Amélie lost both her husband and sister, due to them both developing an incurable illness after using the damaged Peacock Miraculous. Sometime after this, Amélie sent Gabriel a message to try and get the Graham de Vanily Twin Rings back from him, but he never replied back.

title: Amélie Graham de Vanily/History
text:
Amélie Graham de Vanily/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Félix", Amélie and Félix go to Paris to visit Gabriel and Adrien. Amélie calls Nathalie Sancoeur to see if someone could get them, Nathalie then sends Placide I.T. to get them. When they arrive at the Agreste mansion, Nathalie opens the door for Amélie, her nephew Adrien sees her shadowed silhouette and briefly mistakes her for his mother Émilie. Amélie happily greets Adrien and Gabriel, she then says that she thought it'd be best if they were all together on the anniversary of Émilie's disappearance.
Amélie then watched as Félix greeted Adrien and Gabriel. She then points out that Adrien and Félix look just like twins. She reminds Gabriel of the time they pretended to be each other and had him and Émilie fooled for a whole weekend, though Gabriel insists that he won't be fooled twice. Félix attempts to greet his uncle with a handshake, but Amélie reminds him that Gabriel isn't the physical type.

title: Amélie Graham de Vanily/History
text:
Amélie Graham de Vanily/History - [[Season 3]]
She also notices that Gabriel still has his wedding ring and asks him about Émilie's, claiming that she'd like the rings back. Gabriel tells Amélie that the rings are special to him, but Amélie insists that they're special to her, too, as they've always been in her family. Gabriel tells her that they'll discuss it later and sends Amélie with Nathalie while Félix goes upstairs with Adrien to his room.
Later that day, Adrien scolds Félix for the bad video he sent to his friends and says it was unforgivable. Amélie tries to get them to forgive her son, but Félix sincerely apologizes and promises to make it up to Adrien someday as well as become a better person. Amélie then watches as the two cousins hug and as Félix also apologizes to Gabriel and offers another handshake which Gabriel hesitantly returns this time.

title: Amélie Graham de Vanily/History
text:
Amélie Graham de Vanily/History - [[Season 3]]
Amélie then blows a kiss to Adrien and exits the mansion. Amélie gets in the car and then watches as the two cousins say goodbye to each other. On the Startrain, Amélie takes as Félix reveals to her that he got the ring for her when he shook Gabriel's hand, which is what she wanted. She's so happy and proud of him that she lets him keep it, as she had been planning to give it to him anyway; she just wanted the ring back with her side of the family.

title: Amélie Graham de Vanily/History
text:
Amélie Graham de Vanily/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Gabriel Agreste", Amélie and Félix are invited to a soirée by Gabriel. In the car ride to the Agreste mansion, Félix tells Amélie that he hopes to see some superheroes while in Paris. Amélie then tells it would be exciting to see some as she gives a flying kiss to Félix. When they arrive at the mansion, Amélie greets Gabriel and then thanks him for "giving" one of the Graham de Vanily Twin Rings back to Félix.
Amélie then inserts her phone into a robot's tray as all cellphones will be secured for privacy. Amélie is later seen dancing with an unnamed man at the party. Later after "Gabriel" is akumatized and defeated by Ladybug and Cat Noir, Amélie watched as the heroine gave Gabriel a Magical Charm.

title: Amélie Graham de Vanily/History
text:
Amélie Graham de Vanily/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Multiplication", Cosmobug and Astrocat go to the apartment in London where Amélie and Félix live. They go to speak to Amélie about her son's whereabouts. Amélie claims that her son was not home when she woke up but she didn't worry because she thought he might've gone to see his cousin in Paris. She then claims that Félix wasn't returning her calls and that she contacted Gabriel but he told her that he hadn't seen him. She then thanks the heroes for their support.
Sometime after, Amélie knocks on Félix's bedroom door to tell him that it is tea time. Amélie assures Félix not to worry, claiming she'll protect him from those who think he is a villain and then leaves.
In "Emotion", it's revealed that at some point before the events of the episode, Amélie learned about Félix having the Peacock Miraculous and his identity as Argos. She was also previously asked by her son to pretend that he was missing and ask Gabriel for help to see how cruel Gabriel really is, while Félix impersonated Adrien at the Diamonds' Dance.

title: Amélie Graham de Vanily/History
text:
Amélie Graham de Vanily/History - [[Season 5]]
Inside the place where the Diamonds' Dance will take place, Amélie struggled to make her way in through the guards. As bodyguards try to keep her outside and fail, she yells at Gabriel that Félix has been missing for weeks. She confronts Gabriel about his friends being no help with the search and on how she wasn't even invited to the ball.
Gabriel dismisses her and Nathalie walks her out of the building. Amélie then asked Nathalie why she's still complacent in his actions. Nathalie then tells her she doesn't have a choice, with Amélie telling her that there's always a choice as she leaves.
Back in London, Amélie told Argos he was right about his uncle hating her, to which Félix detransformed, embracing his mother and telling her that not everyone close to his uncle were monsters like him, referring to Adrien and Kagami.
In "Representation", Amélie's background is revealed by Félix and Kagami to Marinette.

title: Amélie Graham de Vanily/History
text:
Amélie Graham de Vanily/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Conformation", when Gabriel reakumatized himself into Nightormentor and used the powers of Multitude, Voyage, and Sublimation (power to fly) to spread his nightmare dust to everybody across the globe, including Amélie. Once Amélie and everyone were suffering, Gabriel released a new tranquillity app on the alliance rings that has the power to calm them down with Adrien and Kagami Tsurugi's images.
Once as Amélie was hooked on the app through her alliance ring, Gabriel broadcast a fake video of Ladybug and Cat Noir's kidnapping Adrien and Kagami, thus disabling the app and causing Amélie's nightmares to return. Gabriel then used the alliance rings to broadcast himself and give everyone a chance to help save the pair by saying the activation command: "Alliance, Miraculize me". It's unknown if Amélie goes along with this.
In "Re-creation", by the time when one month had passed since the universe was re-created by Gabriel, Amélie attended a pool party at Villa Agreste with her son. She was seen sitting with Nathalie by the pool while Placide offered her a drink.

text:

"" is a season 1 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. According the series' production/written order, it is the 13th episode of season 1, as well as the 13th episode of the series, overall.

title: Animan
text:
Animan - Synopsis
A humiliated zookeeper is akumatized into a villainous shapeshifting animal on a day when Marinette, Adrien, and friends are visiting the zoo in Paris.
Disney+
Ladybug and Cat Noir face the zookeeper, now Animan.

title: Animan
text:
Animan - Plot
At the Collège Françoise Dupont courtyard, Marinette and Alya look through La Mode, a magazine Adrien models for. From a distance, Nino peeks at the girls. Adrien notices him eyeing Marinette. Nino admits to him that he has a huge crush on Marinette but is too shy to go talk to her. Adrien encourages him to ask Marinette out to the zoo to see the new panther exhibit. Nino begins to walk over to her but panics at the last minute and runs back to his best friend. Adrien smiles and assures his friend that he would be happy to help.

title: Animan
text:
Animan - Plot
Later, Alya and Marinette are on their way home after school, still admiring the pictures of Adrien in the magazine. Distracted, Marinette accidentally bumps into Nino and drops the periodical from her hands. Stiff as a board, Nino does not move at all, prompting Adrien to come out from behind him and apologize on Nino's behalf. Marinette giggles at the sight of Adrien but then realizes that her magazine -- prominently featuring several pictures of Adrien -- is in plain sight. Attempting to be a gentleman, Adrien also goes to pick it up, and they bump heads, cuing another apology from Adrien. Hoping to get Nino to open up, Adrien suggests that they do something together to make it up to them, but Nino remains frozen. Adrien ends up inviting the girl to the zoo at four that afternoon. In a trance, Marinette agrees, then shakes in her boots when Alya tells her that Adrien just asked her out. Believing that she is about to have her first date with Adrien, Marinette begs Alya for help. Across town, Nino has the same reaction when Adrien tells Nino that he and Marinette would be alone together at the zoo.

title: Animan
text:
Animan - Plot
Marinette arrives at the zoo and takes a seat on a park bench. Using an earpiece and microphone, Alya intends to coach Marinette on what to say while Alya herself remains out of sight behind a tree. Marinette spots Max and Kim who explain they came to see the new panther. Nino arrives shortly after, causing Marinette to question why Adrien is nowhere to be seen. Unbeknownst to her, Adrien is hiding in the bushes to coach Nino. Nino's nerves, however, still get the better of him and he winds up agreeing with her suggestion to wait for Adrien to arrive, much to Adrien's annoyance.

title: Animan
text:
Animan - Plot
Elsewhere in the zoo, Kim and Max are looking at the new panther as she eats her meat. Max tells Kim how fast the panther can go. Unimpressed, he replies that could easily beat her. Otis Césaire, the zookeeper, grows aggravated by this comment and tells Kim not to bother the animal. Kim continues to taunt both the zookeeper and the panther by boasting about winning the County Athletics Tournament. Max then points out that it would be much more likely for the panther to eat Kim than to race him, but Kim ignores the comment. Once again, Otis tells Kim to stop bothering the animal, but he remains persistent in mocking the "poor widdle kitty" and her "angry babysitter" as he and Max walk away.

title: Animan
text:
Animan - Plot
Meanwhile, Nino and Marinette continue to awkwardly wait for Adrien. Marinette asks if he's really arriving. Coached by Adrien, Nino replies back, "Yes, he is, but first I wanted to take this opportunity to..." Adrien tries to get him to say "I love you, Marinette", but he cracks and instead says that he has a crush on a girl but is afraid to tell her. Marinette assures him that she can help him, and wants to know who this lucky girl is. Nino tries to say "it's you" to Marinette, but at the last second, changes the girl to "your best friend Alya", prompting three loud "What?!"s from Adrien, Marinette, and Alya herself. Marinette, however, likes the idea and offers to help get the two of them together. Contrastingly, Alya, who views Nino as a "brother", feels everything but happiness with this development.

title: Animan
text:
Animan - Plot
From his lair, Hawk Moth senses Otis's annoyance with the overly competitive Kim and sends an akuma to the zookeeper's bracelet. He offers the man a chance to put Kim in his place. Once the zookeeper agrees, he transforms into Animan, a shapeshifting villain who sets out after the boy. Animan releases the entire menagerie and, in the form of a panther, corners Kim and Max. He tauntingly tells them that he will give them a head start in their race.

title: Animan
text:
Animan - Plot
Over at the benches, Alya again objects to Marinette arranging a date for her and Nino. Marinette tells her that he will be devastated if she were to refuse. Before they can carry on any further, they spot Kim and Max running for their lives from the zoo animals, led by Animan. Marinette and Nino rush away, and once she is out of sight, Tikki scolds Marinette for not respecting Alya's wishes before transforming her into Ladybug. Elsewhere in the zoo, Plagg changes Adrien into Cat Noir. The heroes find Kim, cornered by Animan. They distract the panther long enough for Kim to flee, and Ladybug incapacitates him by tying him up in her yo-yo, but before they can take his bracelet, the animals he freed come to his aid and force them to retreat. The heroes split up, realizing that it would be too much of a hassle to get all of them back into their cages. Ladybug spots Nino and Alya running for their lives, so she locks them in the empty gorilla habitat for their own safety while the animals are loose in the streets of Paris.

title: Animan
text:
Animan - Plot
The heroes return to where they left the panther, only to find no sign of him. This confuses Ladybug, knowing that her wire is impossible to break. They decide that for the time being, the best course of action would be to find Kim. They eventually spot him, once again cornered by the panther atop a bridge. Cat Noir tells Kim to run but not before planting a tracking device on him. Ladybug again ties Animan up in her yo-yo, but he simply turns himself into a bald eagle and flies off towards Kim. Cat Noir uses his tracking device to find Kim desperately begging for help from the owners of the Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie. Recognizing that their foe probably has a good sense of smell, Ladybug asks to see Kim's sweatband. She places it on a railing and sprays herself and Cat Noir with a deodorant to hide their own scents. Sure enough, Animan -- now in the form of a ladybug -- flies to where the heroes placed the sweatband. Ladybug traps him in a tissue box, but he changes back into a panther and chases the heroes into an empty bus with the doors locked.

title: Animan
text:
Animan - Plot
The duo struggles to fight him as he changes into a variety of animals, gradually getting slower each time. Ladybug figures out that the transformations must be tiring him out. Cat Noir activates his Cataclysm to make the bus go haywire. The doors are wide enough to give the heroes a chance to escape but not a tired grizzly bear. At first, it seems that he has successfully been worn out, but just as they are about to take the bracelet from the sleeping panther, he transforms into a Tyrannosaurus Rex. Ladybug summons her Lucky Charm, and, as usual, is confused by the object -- this time, a car jack. She leaves it aside and realizes that her partner could use his cat-like agility to climb onto the dinosaur and distract him while she uses her yo-yo to tie him up for good.

title: Animan
text:
Animan - Plot
With the Tyrannosaur defeated, Ladybug is confused as to why the Lucky Charm would provide her with something they did not need. However, when Cat goes over to retrieve the bracelet, he just narrowly avoids being chopped in half by Animan's massive teeth. Understanding at once, Ladybug charges at the T-Rex. Cat Noir is horrified as he watches the villain apparently swallow her whole. He prepares to attack but is relieved when he sees Ladybug, safe and sound, having used the car jack to open the dinosaur's mouth, retrieving the bracelet, and cleansing the akuma.
Ladybug throws the car jack into the sky, which repairs all of the damage done by the fight, returns the animals to their cages in the zoo, and turns Otis back into himself. She prepares to bump fists with her partner, but he is too relieved that she is all right that he embraces her before realizing that his transformation is about to wear off.

title: Animan
text:
Animan - Plot
From his lair, Hawk Moth vows that he will be the top of the food chain to get Ladybug and Cat Noir someday. Meanwhile, Ladybug turns back into Marinette, tiredly returning home and crashing onto her bed before receiving a call from Alya. Realizing that she left her two friends at the zoo, Marinette apologizes to Alya over the phone before catching up with her in front of the bakery storefront. The girls reconcile as Nino joins them, offering cookies. Nino comes clean to Marinette and admits that he used to have a crush on her before spending so much time with Alya. Funnily enough, as Alya and Nino admit, while they were locked in the same cage all day, they realized that they had a great deal in common. Alya also admits that she told  Nino that Marinette had feelings for another boy but did not tell him who it was. She adds that while she was helping Marinette at the zoo, Nino was being coached by Adrien. Nino offers to talk to the "mystery guy", but Alya keeps him in line. Marinette giggles, and the end title card appears: Marinette imagining Alya and Nino smiling at each other in the gorilla habitat.

Inaccuracies

title: Animan
text:
Animan - Trivia
The black panther in this episode is entirely black. A real-life black panther, be it a melanistic leopard, jaguar, or puma (also called a mountain lion), is actually a very dark brown. Additionally, black leopards and jaguars actually have a lot of visible spots shown through their dark coat, and a black puma has spots around the belly (albeit only a few).
Despite Max saying that Kim could be a panther's lunch if he raced one, panthers do not usually hunt humans and will usually only attack if provoked.
Max states that panthers can run at speeds of up to 60 miles per hour. However, panthers, assuming they're melanistic leopards, run at speeds of up to approximately 30 miles per hour. In the French version, it is correctly stated that panthers can run at speeds of up to 60 kilometers per hour.
Animan, as a bald eagle, makes a cry uttered only by red-tailed hawks.
As a bald eagle, Animan was able to sniff out Kim's wristband. However, in real life, most birds (including eagles) have very poorly-developed olfactory bulbs and, therefore, a very weak sense of smell, if they even have one at all. Additionally, eagles almost always find prey by sight over any other sense.

title: Animan
text:
Animan - Trivia
Animan's bear form was unable to escape through the bus doors. However, in real life, grizzlies have enough force to lift objects up to 500 kg.
The episode's depiction of a Tyrannosaurus is inaccurate in several ways:
The dinosaur's arms are longer than in real life and are positioned differently on its body. It's also seen to pronate its arms, which it couldn't do in real life without breaking them. Lacking the ability to cross their radius over the ulna, most bipedal dinosaurs, including theropods (like T. Rex), held their hands in a clapping position.
When Animan transformed into the dinosaur, it busted through the roof of the bus. In reality, the bus would have combusted due to the massive size of the dinosaur. Also, the bus shouldn't support the weight of a 3-ton Tyrannosaurus, not even a damaged one.
The T-Rex lacked eyebrow horns in real life. However, relatives of the T-Rex, like Albertosaurus, had smaller versions of the brows seen on Animan.

title: Animan
text:
Animan - Trivia
The T-Rex's roars sound similar to the ones from The Dino King, which featured both the T-Rex and its relative, Tarbosaurus. However, after studying the brain case of a T-Rex, scientists now think that the T-Rex emitted a deep, unsettling, rumbling sound thanks to closed mouth vocalization. This could be a modification Hawk Moth gave to Animan.
Despite its mouth being opened by Ladybug's car jack with ease, the average Tyrannosaurus Rex had a bite force of around 12,800 pounds, meaning it would have crushed the car jack, and, possibly, snapped Ladybug in half by the time she got out. Though considering that this is a lucky charm object, it might be more durable than an average car jack.

title: Arc de Triomphe
text:
Arc de Triomphe - Intro
The  de l'Étoile is one of the most famous monuments in Paris. It stands in the center of the Place Charles de Gaulle (originally named Place de l'Étoile), at the western end of the Champs-Élysées.

title: Arc de Triomphe
text:
Arc de Triomphe - Description
Located on a high point that joins the 8th, 16th and 17th arrondissements of Paris, the Arc de Triomphe is approximately 50 meters high, 45 meters long and 22 meters wide.
Its façades feature several high reliefs, four of which are particularly well-known:
The Departure of the Volunteers of 1792 (La Marseillaise), by François Rude. This sculpture features volunteers with the appearance of ancient heroes being urged to fight by a winged figure, an allegory of Victory.
The Triumph of 1810, by Jean-Pierre Cortot. Using figures from antiquity and the allegory of Victory, it is a representation of the triumph of Napoleon I.
The Resistance of 1814, by Antoine Étex.
The Peace of 1815, by Antoine Étex.
Under the arch is the famous Tomb of the Unknown Soldier. It is a tomb surrounded by black terminals linked together by black chains. It consists of a slab of Vire granite on which is inscribed an epitaph in honor of the soldier, as well as a cannon's mouth placed in the center of a bronze shield where the Eternal Flame burns.
During important events, the French flag is displayed under the arch.

title: Arc de Triomphe
text:
Arc de Triomphe - Trivia
The Arc de Triomphe has been classified as a Historic Monument since 1896.
In the series, the Arc de Triomphe has been important on several occasions:
In "Pixelator", the monument was the main location of the fight between Ladybug and Cat Noir and the eponymous villain.
In "Anansi", the eponymous villain held Alya hostage in a giant spider web before fighting Ladybug and Carapace under the arch. Due to the villain's punches to the monument, it collapsed on the villain and the superheroes, who were protected by Carapace's Shell-ter. Later, after destroying the villain's akumatized object with Cat Noir's Cataclysm and capturing and purifying the akuma, the Arc de Triomphe was returned to normal thanks to Ladybug's Miraculous Ladybug.
In "Ladybug", the Arc de Triomphe's roof was the scene of the clash between Ladybug and Cat Noir, and Mayura and her sentimonster. Later, after making her sentimonster betray her by giving her the item containing the amok, Ladybug and Cat Noir were about to obtain the Peacock Miraculous, but were stopped by Hawk Moth who rescued Mayura.
In "Optigami", the Arc de Triomphe was unknowingly teleported to the Moon by Kaalki.

title: Arc de Triomphe
text:
Arc de Triomphe - Trivia
In "Penalteam", Penalty placed a soccer goal under the arch.
In "Multiplication", the Arc de Triomphe was destroyed by Ikari Gozen's sword, but was later rebuilt thanks to Ladybug's Miraculous Ladybug.
In "Pretension", Ladybug fought the copies of Matagi Gozen on the Arc de Triomphe's roof.
In "Revolution", Chloé had a golden statue of herself built on the Arc de Triomphe. However, after being sent by her father to London with her mother, the statue was torn down.

Tikki: Why didn't you listen to Alya, Marinette?
Marinette: I couldn't help it!  I didn't want Nino to be sad.

title: Animan/Transcript
text:
Animan/Transcript - Intro
Tikki: We'll deal with that later. Now it's time to transform!
[ Transformation Sequence ]
Marinette: Tikki, spots on! Ha! (Marinette transforms into Ladybug)
Adrien: We've gotta do something. (Plagg sighs while he sits on Adrien's head)
[ Transformation Sequence ]
Adrien: Plagg, claws out! (Adrien transforms into Cat Noir)
(Kim runs away from Animan, but he reaches him.)
Animan: You lost, kiddo. What do you think of panthers now?
Kim: That... panthers are the best?
Ladybug: And what do you think about ladybugs?
Cat Noir: And another black cat?
Animan: I think I'm higher on the food chain.
Hawk Moth: Animan, take their jewels! Their Miraculouses! Bring them to me!
Ladybug: If you value your life, get out of here! Now!
(Kim runs away. Animan chases him, but Ladybug stops him.)
Ladybug: Cat Noir, his bracelet. The akuma must be inside the charm!
Cat Noir: You hold him, I grab the bracelet.
Animan: (to the other animals) Attack!
(Ladybug and Cat Noir run.)
Cat Noir: We need to put them all back in their cages!
Ladybug: Oh, really? I'm sure they'll do it without putting up a fight!
(Ladybug and Cat Noir see Alya and Nino running from the gorilla and the superheroes jump over them.)

title: Animan/Transcript
text:
Animan/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: I think we'd better split up!
(She goes to the direction where Nino and Alya ran from the gorilla and she grabs Nino and Alya by the back of their clothing.)
Nino: Hey!
Alya: Hey!
Nino: What the...?
Ladybug: (takes Nino and Alya to the empty gorilla habitat and locks the cage) Stay put and you'll be safe. (then leaves)
Nino: (he looks at Alya) Uhh... Hey, what's up?
(Alya lets out a disgusted groan.)
(Meanwhile, Cat Noir runs away from the animals and goes up a tree.)
Ladybug: There are too many of them! We can't capture them all.
Cat Noir: Well, what are we gonna do then?
Ladybug: Back to Plan A. If we can destroy his bracelet, I can capture the akuma. Everything will go back to normal!
Cat Noir: Sounds like a good idea!
(The animals run away from the zoo. Ladybug sees they didn't break her yo-yo.)
Ladybug: But... it's unbreakable!
Cat Noir: He didn't actually break it. (squats down and he gives the yo-yo back to Ladybug)
Ladybug: Then how did he get away?
Cat Noir: I don't know, but we better find Kim... I mean, that boy, before he does.

title: Animan/Transcript
text:
Animan/Transcript - Intro
(Ladybug extends her yo-yo and and Cat Noir spins his staff and they leave the zoo then they retracts their respective tools once they land on a rooftop.)
Cat Noir: Over there!
Ladybug: (sees Animan about to approach Kim)
Animan: It's down to just the two of us, Kiddo. (Kim falls) And then there was one. (Animan is about to attack Kim, but Ladybug stops him)
Ladybug: You're not getting away this time!
Cat Noir: (to Kim) Quick, go and hide in the first building you come to. (places a tracker on Kim’s back before he runs off)
Animan: You'll never get me! (transforms into an eagle and flies away)
Cat Noir: Now we know how we got away earlier.
Ladybug: Where's Kim? (Cat Noir shows screen on his staff which is detecting Kim's location) Good job, kitty. (scratches Cat Noir's chin)
Kim: Help! Rescue me! Please!
Tom: It's okay, son. Come this way. Easy.
Cat Noir: He's safe inside this building. Panthers can't open doors, so it won't get inside.
Ladybug: Panthers can't, but what if he morphs into a smaller animal? Like a mouse, or...
Cat Noir: Right. But we do have an advantage over him. We know exactly where to find his prey.

title: Animan/Transcript
text:
Animan/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: Animan will sniff him out sooner or later, but it's bought us a bit of time to plan our next move.
(A man is seen fixing his car. He sees a bear and runs away.)
Cat Noir: We have to stop Animan before Paris turns into a Jungle.
Ladybug: Follow me.
(They enter the bakery.)
Ladybug: Hi, mo...am.
Sabine: Oh,  but... you're... you're, you're Ladybug!
Ladybug: Yeah, exactly.
Nadja: We interrupt this broadcast with a special report. Animals are invading Paris. The police work harder trying to contain the situation. For your safety, stay in your homes and remain calm. Mayor Bourgeois will address the-- (Sabine turns off the TV)
Ladybug: You'll be safe here. Can I borrow this?
Kim: Sure. (gives her his wristband)
(Cat Noir looks at a family photo of Marinette and her parents.)
Ladybug: Come on, Cat Noir. Make sure you lock all the doors and windows.
Cat Noir: We'll take care of the rest. You won't be in danger.
Ladybug: Thanks Da-- uh, sir, for all your help.
Tom: You're welcome, Ladybug.
(Ladybug and Cat Noir go downstairs. Ladybug puts Kim's wristband on the railing.)
Ladybug: Et voila.
Cat Noir: Whoa! What's that stuff?

title: Animan/Transcript
text:
Animan/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: Air freshener! It'll cover up our scent so he can't smell us.
Cat Noir:  Thanks. (He sniffs himself) I've always wanted to smell like... Ocean summer breeze? (he sees a small box) Couldn't we capture him inside something like this?
Ladybug: Only until he transforms into something bigger. (sees a bus) Would that make a big enough cage?
Cat Noir: Definitely. But how could we get him inside there? (hears Animan coming) He's coming.
Ladybug: It's working. He's sniffing out Kim! (Cat Noir sniffs her and he gasps and he giggles. She is unamused) Follow me.
(Animan goes directly to the bakery, and turns into a "Ladybug" to enter in gap between double doors. Ladybug traps him in the box.)
Ladybug: A Ladybug? Smart choice. (Animan turns into a panther. Ladybug and Cat Noir leave the bakery.)
Cat Noir: Couldn't have he chosen a slower-moving animal?!
(Ladybug and Cat Noir enter the bus to hide on opposite sides of the bus. Animan is looking for them and they nod at each other. Ladybug and Cat Noir then surprise him.)
Ladybug: Where's the button for the doors? (presses all the buttons to no avail) Of course nothing works! No keys!
(Animan morphs into a bear and knocks Cat Noir out.)

title: Animan/Transcript
text:
Animan/Transcript - Intro
Hawk Moth: Take his Miraculous... The ring! The ring!
(Ladybug gives Cat Noir's staff to him and he knocks Animan out. Animan morphs into a Ladybug, then into a panther.)
Ladybug: All these transformations seem to be tiring him out.
Cat Noir: Then just let him wear himself out. It'll make it easier to capture his akuma. Cataclysm! (uses his Cataclysm to make all the buttons work. Ladybug and Cat Noir escape the bus, but Animan is trapped inside it.)
Ladybug: It's not exactly a cage, but... it'll do. (Animan morphs into a bear)
Cat Noir: I don't think he can bear to listen to that noise.
Ladybug: You around is too much to bear. Now we wait.
(Animan now morphs into a ladybug, then into a gorilla.)
Cat Noir: Ready to free the akuma?
(Animan is tired, and morphs into a panther again.)
Ladybug: It's working!
(Animan morphs into a dinosaur. He destroys the bus.)
Cat Noir: Hey! Since when do extinct animals count?
Ladybug: The T-Rex might have disappeared a long time ago, but technically it's.. still an animal. (The T-Rex roars and the two slowly back up)

title: Animan/Transcript
text:
Animan/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: Well, I know of some other animals that will soon be extinct... The cat and the ladybug! (Ladybug and Cat Noir escape and hide on the side of a car)
Ladybug: Lucky Charm! (throws the yo-yo into the air and a car jack appears.) Huh? A car jack?
Cat Noir: Too bad Animan doesn't have any flat tires.
Ladybug: Look how small his front arms are.
Cat Noir: So it won't be great at basketball. What are you getting at?
Ladybug: You climb on top of him where he can't swipe at you, and while you're distracting him, I'll floor him!
Cat Noir: Sounds like a good plan. I can be very distracting.
(Animan finds them and chases them.)
Cat Noir: It's gonna be tight. (while Animan chases them, Cat Noir stands on top of him. Ladybug pulls him with her yo-yo.)
Ladybug: Well, that's weird, we didn't have to use this. What does it mean?
Cat Noir: Well, I guess that only means we rock as a team.
(Cat Noir goes over to retrieve the bracelet; though he just narrowly avoids being chopped in half by Animan's massive teeth after being pulled away by Ladybug.)
Ladybug: Cat Noir, wait! (Animan roars) I know what to do. (She starts running towards Animan)
Cat Noir: Ladybug!
Ladybug: Enjoy your meal!

title: Animan/Transcript
text:
Animan/Transcript - Intro
(Ladybug goes directly to his mouth, and apparently swallows her, to Cat Noir's horror)
Cat Noir: No! (spins his staff) You're so gonna pay for this!
(Cat Noir prepares to attack with his stick but just then, Ladybug is then seen opening Animan's mouth with the car jack. Cat Noir is relieved when he sees her, safe and sound. Ladybug picks up Animan's bracelet and smashes it with her hands. The akuma flies off of it.)
Ladybug: No more evil doing for you, little akuma. Time to de-evilize! (capturess the akuma with her yo-yo) Gotcha! (releases a purified butterfly) Bye bye, little butterfly. Miraculous Ladybug! (throws the Lucky Charm into the air, its energy turns everything back to normal. Animan is turned back into Otis.) Pound it? (Cat Noir hugs her)
Cat Noir: Ladybug! That was a wild ride. (his Miraculous beeps) Whoops! Better take my whiskers and run! (Ladybug looks at him as he leaves)
Ladybug: See you next time, Cat Noir.
Otis: Oh! What happened to me?
Ladybug: Everything's okay. But you should get back to the zoo and check on your animals.

title: Animan/Transcript
text:
Animan/Transcript - Intro
Hawk Moth: (groans) You ruined everything, Ladybug. This is not how it was supposed to end! But I promise you, one day it will be me at the top of the food chain! And you'll be nothing!
Marinette: (her phone rings) Oh no! I forgot all about Alya! She's gonna be so mad at me!
Tikki: And imagine if she knew you're the Ladybug who shut her up in a cage with Nino!

I should have never told  Nino I'd set up a date with you. I just wasn't thinking. But I'll explain everything to him, so don't worry. Promise. Do you forgive me? (sees Alya. Both laugh. Nino comes out of the bakery with cookies from the bakery and gives one to Alya)
Alya: Thanks, Nino.
Nino: Do you want one, Marinette?
Marinette: Uhh...What's he doing here?

Marinette: Oh, yeah!
Nino: Actually, it was you.
Marinette: Huh?
Nino: Or that's what I thought. But after chilling with Alya that whole time...

title: Animan/Transcript
text:

Alya: (interrupts) Yeah, well...we don't have to give her all the deets, do we?
Nino: Oh, yeah, my bad.

Marinette; Adrien was there!
Alya: Yup! LOL, huh?

title: Antibug
text:
Antibug - Intro
"" is a season 1 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 24th written and produced episode of season 1. It is also the 24th written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Antibug
text:
Antibug - Synopsis
Nickelodeon
Chloé gets akumatized into Antibug after an argument with Ladybug; Ladybug must battle a villain with the same powers that she has.
Netflix
Crestfallen when her hero Ladybug refuses to heed her advice, Chloé akumatizes into Antibug, an evil twin of Ladybug with identical powers.
Disney Channel
Ladybug argues with Chloé, who then transforms into Antibug, a rival with formidable powers.
Disney+
Ladybug and Cat Noir face Chloé, now Antibug.

title: Antibug
text:
Antibug - Plot
In Chloé's room, Chloé is going through her closet and complaining that she has nothing to wear. Hearing a noise, she goes to investigate and is attacked by her floating skin care bottles. The invisible force takes the shoes away from her and throws across the balcony into the Agreste mansion courtyard. Chloé futilely yells for them to come back.
At school, Chloé is and looks exhausted, almost falling asleep at her desk. Marinette and Alya notice this and wonder if it's because Chloé's friend, Sabrina, is gone, although Olga Mendeleiev shushes them. Chloé's hair is then pulled, resulting in her shouting in pain and being reprimanded by Olga Mendeleiev. Chloé tries to explain that something invisible is harassing her, but she isn't believed, with the class laughing at her. Olga Mendeleiev shushes the class.

title: Antibug
text:
Antibug - Plot
The invisible force grabs at Chloé's purse, trying to take it off her. Even with this occurring, Olga Mendeleiev still does not believe Chloé. Chloé is thrown back from the invisible presence letting go of her purse only to hit her in the face repeatedly with said purse, resulting in Olga Mendeleiev yelling at Chloé to sit in her seat. Chloé throws the purse away, cowering in the corner of the room. Both Marinette and Adrien watch, focused.
Juleka's pen is snatched from her fingers and is thrown at Chloé. Several more pens are thrown at Chloé, making her run down the steps. Olga Mendeleiev yells at Chloé to stop running and return to her seat. Before she can do so, the invisible presence takes Chloé's sunglasses from her head, fighting with Chloé for them. The presence leads Chloé over to Miss Bustier's desk and abandons the sunglasses, instead tugging at Chloé's hair. The entire time, the class laughs at her. Chloé flees from the room, waving her hands in front of her to ward off the invisible presence. The invisible presence follows Chloé, moving Adrien's tablet in the process. The door closes behind it resoundingly.

title: Antibug
text:
Antibug - Plot
Both Marinette and Adrien immediately ask if they can go to the bathroom. In the girls' bathroom, crude drawings of Chloé and multiple instances of Chloé's name being scratched out are present on the walls and stall doors. A set of pictures is then sent to everyone in the school depicting what has been happening to Chloé. Marinette, Tikki, and Adrien realize that something must be done to help her and the two of them transform into Ladybug and Cat Noir.
Outside Le Grand Paris, Mayor André Bourgeois is giving a press conference, saying that attacking his daughter is like attacking all of Paris. Ladybug and Cat Noir show up behind the mayor, saying they will help him. Back in Chloé's room, André announces that Ladybug and Cat Noir are there to help, prompting Chloé to rush out from behind one of her couches and tackle Ladybug in a hug, much to her annoyance. Chloé then does not leave Ladybug alone the entire time she is in her room, taking several selfies with and pictures of Ladybug. André explains the situation to Ladybug while Cat Noir searches Chloé's room.

title: Antibug
text:
Antibug - Plot
Ladybug turns on Chloé's television, turning the four sections of the screen to various areas in the hotel where the invisible presence could be hidden. These include three different angles of the hotel's foyer and Chloé's balcony. Ladybug asks Chloé if she's had any problems with anyone recently, which Chloé denies, saying everyone loves her. Ladybug picks up a picture off the ground and asks about the girl who is in it with Chloé, Sabrina. Chloé says it's impossible for Sabrina to hate Chloé; Sabrina "worships [her]. [She's] her idol." Ladybug sighs and tells the mayor to keep Chloé inside as the invisible presence can't go through walls and won't be able to attack Chloé. Ladybug and Cat Noir then leave, heading down to the hotel's entrance.

title: Antibug
text:
Antibug - Plot
Downstairs, they ask Armand what he knows of Chloé and Sabrina, saying that it will remain between them. Jean tells Ladybug of a game that Chloé and Sabrina liked to play called "Ladybug and Cat Noir," where Chloé would dress up as Ladybug and Sabrina would dress up as Cat Noir. Two days previously, they were playing this game with the butler as the villain "Big Mustachio." Ladybug interrupts Jean's retelling to ask who Big Mustachio is, only to find out that it was Chloé's idea.
Continuing with his story, Big Mustachio hid in the lounge area of the hotel where Jagged Stone was being interviewed by Nadja Chamack. "Ladybug" and "Cat Noir" burst in the room, prompting the man at the bar and the people on the couches to turn their attention to them. Immediately, Chloé recognized Jagged Stone and approached him, sitting between him and Nadja.

title: Antibug
text:
Antibug - Plot
Jagged Stone believed that Chloé was the actual Ladybug, prompting Chloé to lie between her teeth that she was there to meet Jagged. Noticing her hair was different, he asked what she did with it, her reply is that she needed a new hair style. The entire time, she was being filmed. She then took over Jagged Stone's interview, forcing Nadja to direct questions to her.
Sabrina, however, found Big Mustachio and called Chloé by name. Jagged Stone and Nadja became angry at being deceived. Chloé protested, saying she was Ladybug. Her proof was her taking her yo-yo and bouncing it up and down, hitting Fang's head each time. Annoyed, Fang bit the yo-yo's string and ate it, the remaining string hitting Chloé in the face. Nadja and Jagged Stone laugh as Chloé ran off crying. Staring at Sabrina, Chloé ripped off her mask.
Sabrina and Jean followed Chloé to her room, Sabrina trying to apologize. Sabrina didn't know that Chloé was pretending to be the actual Ladybug apart from their game. Angry, Chloé said that Sabrina never knew anything and that even Fang was smarter than her. Chloé threw the yo-yo remains at Sabrina and told her she never wanted to see her again.

title: Antibug
text:
Antibug - Plot
Chloé is watching Jean, Ladybug, and Cat Noir from the television in her room.
Sabrina came back the next day. Chloé ignored her the entire time, saying that she didn't know any Sabrina. Sabrina tried to get Chloé, her best friend, to turn around, even holding out the rose pin that Chloé gave her as a symbol of their friendship. Jean approached Chloé, asking her to speak to Sabrina since she's right there. Instead, Chloé said that she couldn't see anyone, that she must be invisible, because, in her eyes, Sabrina didn't exist. Sabrina closed the door and left with tears in her eyes.
Ladybug and Cat Noir come to the conclusion that the invisible presence is Sabrina and that she was akumatized. In her room, Chloé has determined that it's impossible for Sabrina to be akumatized, let alone attack her because Sabrina's too afraid of Chloé.

title: Antibug
text:
Antibug - Plot
Downstairs, Ladybug thanks Jean for his help. He leaves. Spinning, Cat Noir grabs a flower and offers it to Ladybug who in turn places it in the vase next to her with several other roses. It won't be easy to find someone who can't be seen, so the two decide to wait for Sabrina to find them. Ladybug says that they have the advantage since Sabrina doesn't know that they're there, but Sabrina is behind them. As Ladybug and Cat Noir wander off, Sabrina picks up the flower and twirls it in her fingers. Her face lights up purple as Hawk Moth speaks to her, calling her "Vanisher." Hawk Moth commands her to bring him the Miraculouses, to which she responds by saying they won't see her coming.
Vanisher drops the flower, making enough noise for Cat Noir to turn back. Since he stopped walking, Ladybug turns to see what caught his attention. As Cat Noir begins to explain, the hair around Ladybug's left ear moves. Shocked, Cat Noir jumps forward, bringing out his staff. He and Ladybug stand back to back, his staff and her yo-yo making circles for defense.

title: Antibug
text:
Antibug - Plot
In her room, Chloé decides that if Sabrina is Vanisher, then she will be the one to defeat her. She opens her closet and presses a button on her remote, revealing a Ladybug costume complete with a wig, mask, earrings, and yo-yo.
Back in the lobby, Vanisher proceeds to throw chairs and vases at Ladybug and Cat Noir, the two heroes either dodging or breaking said objects. Ladybug summons her Lucky Charm, this time being a container of red glitter. When it lands in her hands, Chloé appears on the hotel's stairs, dressed as Ladybug and taunting Vanisher. Ladybug tells Chloé to move, prompting her to descend the stairs and tell Vanisher that if she stops, then she might become her best friend again.

title: Antibug
text:
Antibug - Plot
Angry, Vanisher throws books at Chloé. She dodges it only because Ladybug tackled her to the ground and because Cat Noir used his staff to block any remaining books. Chloé continues to taunt Vanisher even when Ladybug moves Chloé out of the way. Vanisher runs up to Ladybug and grabs her while Cat Noir searches for Vanisher in the background. Trapped in Vanisher's arms, Ladybug opens the glitter, drops the container on her knee, and pops it into the air, the container turning so that it covers Vanisher in pink and red sparkles. Ladybug rolls, freeing herself.
Vanisher threatens that even though Ladybug can see her that doesn't mean she can defeat her. Cat Noir extends his staff in front of Vanisher, drawing her attention to him as he slides down it and away from Ladybug who is removing Chloé from the scene. Ladybug hides Chloé again and tells her not to move, returning to Cat Noir. Ladybug decides the Akuma is in Sabrina's bag, to which Chloé protests. She comes out of hiding and swings her yo-yo, losing control as it breaks and knocks Vanisher in the head and drawing her attention.

title: Antibug
text:
Antibug - Plot
Ladybug asks Cat Noir to deal with Vanisher while she deals with Chloé. Cat Noir traps Vanisher's arms while Ladybug lassos Chloé and spins her into an elevator destined to the penthouse. Chloé tells Ladybug that the akuma has to be in the brooch that Vanisher is wearing since it was a gift from Chloé. Annoyed, Ladybug tells Chloé that her being in the battlefield puts everyone in danger. Ladybug presses a button to a higher floor as Chloé protests.
Back in the battle, Vanisher throws pots at Cat Noir, trapping his head in one. While he struggles to get it off, Ladybug grabs Vanisher's bag and rips it open, spilling its contents on the floor. No akuma comes out. Angry and using Ladybug's confusion, Vanisher rushes at her. Ladybug blocks her arms. At the same time, she notices a rose glittering excessively on Vanisher's chest: the brooch. Ladybug pins Vanisher to the elevator doors, forcing the brooch to fall and allowing Ladybug to step on it. The akuma flutters out in the direction of Chloé's camera (she's watching from her room and is annoyed with Ladybug for not listening to her). Ladybug captures the akuma then uses Miraculous Ladybug, returning everything to normal.

title: Antibug
text:
Antibug - Plot
In his lair, Hawk Moth growls in defeat and frustration at his window.
Sabrina returns to normal, cradling the brooch when she realizes she almost lost it. Ladybug smiles and holds out her fist for Cat Noir to bump, but instead, he asks why she didn't listen to Chloé, as she was only trying to help and telling the truth. Ladybug responds that it was Chloé who put them in danger and then lied; Ladybug doesn't listen to liars.
Watching in her room, Chloé is outraged by what Ladybug said. She was Ladybug's biggest fan, but since Ladybug called her a liar, she felt as if Ladybug didn't deserve her devotion. The channel changes to TVi with Nadja Chamack, after Chloé throws the remote to the ground in frustration. Ladybug, Cat Noir, and Sabrina leave the building. Before they can clear the entryway, they are attacked with a barrage of questions by reporters.
Chloé decides she's through with Ladybug. This prompts Hawk Moth to reopen his window and send out another akuma to avenge the Vanisher's defeat.

title: Antibug
text:
Antibug - Plot
Chloé rips off her Ladybug mask and stomps on it. She then falls to her knees, crying. The akuma lands on Chloé's left earring as the dark version of Tikki, connecting her to Hawk Moth. He offers her an alliance to defeat Ladybug, which Chloé agrees to, transforming into Antibug.

title: Antibug
text:
Antibug - Plot
During her interview, Ladybug realizes that she is going to detransform attempts to leave the scene only to be interrupted by Antibug. Where she tells Ladybug that if it weren't for her, she wouldn't have defeated Vanisher, and now she was going to defeat Ladybug. Antibug's taunt makes the heroes recognize her as Chloé. Ladybug tells Cat Noir she is about to detransform and he tells her he can handle Antibug. Where she teases Ladybug, saying that she's nothing without Cat Noir. Ladybug promises Antibug that they'll see each other again soon before dashing off and detransforms. Upon detransforming, Marinette quickly realizes that she has no food for Tikki. Marinette laments how the whole situation is her fault, but Tikki tells her otherwise. They both sneak off to The Palace to find Tikki something to eat. After grabbing some cookies for Tikki, Marinette rushes to find Cat Noir only to find him hanging from a pole hoisted by Antibug. She taunts Cat Noir only for him to retort. Hawk Moth suggests using Cat Noir as bait. Antibug tries to convince Cat Noir to team up with her, but he refuses.

title: Antibug
text:
Antibug - Plot
In the distance, Marinette wants to help but Tikki doesn't have enough energy. Tikki tells her that she can save Cat Noir as herself but Marinette is unconvinced claiming on Ladybug could. Tikki then tells her she is Ladybug and that Ladybug is within her. Marinette agrees that she needs to save Cat Noir and comes up with a plan. She uses her cellphone as bait and plays the interview from earlier to fool Antibug into thinking Ladybug is nearby. While Antibug is distracted Marinette saves Cat Noir by taking the pole and using it to pull him up. Once Antibug discovers she's been played, Cat Noir shows up and begins to attack Antibug. Tikki has also gained enough energy, allowing Marinette to transform into Ladybug once more. Ladybug finds Cat Noir as Antibug continues her attacks. Ladybug suggests that the akuma is in her yo-yo, while Cat Noir says it's her earrings, as she had them before her transformation.

title: Antibug
text:
Antibug - Plot
Ladybug and Antibug both attack each other simultaneously. Ladybug summons her Lucky Charm while Antibug summons her Anti Charm. When Antibug ends up with a large weapon and Ladybug a bag of marbles, Antibug taunts her and proceeds to attack. Ladybug, searching around, realizes the purpose of the marbles when she looks at Cat Noir. She throws them at him, and he whacks them, releasing the marbles onto the ground and tripping Antibug. Fallen down and her sword taken by Cat Noir with his staff, Antibug complains that Ladybug is weak to rely on Cat Noir. Ladybug replies firmly that she and Cat Noir are a team. Cat Noir uses Cataclysm to trap Antibug into the glass floor beneath her, and Ladybug grabs her earrings. Destroying them, she de-evilizes the akuma and utilizes the Miraculous Ladybug to fix everything. Ladybug apologizes to Chloé about not taking her advice, which Chloé accepts and once more becomes Ladybug's biggest fan. Before departing, Ladybug suggests to Chloé that she make amends with Sabrina.

title: Antibug
text:
Antibug - Plot
Back in class, Marinette is sitting with Alya as she watches Chloé sit down. Sabrina enters the room and stands still next to the seat until Chloé tells her to sit down. Sabrina gladly accepts, and while looking away from her, Chloé makes a small smile. Afterward, Chloé gives Sabrina a new brooch, much to Sabrina's joy and Chloé's secret contentment. Marinette comments that Chloé and Sabrina will always be best friends in their weird way, just like she and Alya. The end card is of Marinette and Alya being happy while Adrien, sitting in front of them, is amused.

title: Antibug
text:
Antibug - Plot Developments
This is the first episode where Chloé stops being a fan of Ladybug, foreshadowing "Miracle Queen". But unlike the latter she doesn't become a permanent enemy of Ladybug.

title: Antibug
text:
Antibug - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in France on TFOU.
This is the first episode to show two different akumatized villains.
In "The Evillustrator" there are three, but Stormy Weather and Lady Wifi only appear in a dream.
In "Princess Fragrance" there are two, but Jean Duparc's akumatization was not shown.
In "Timebreaker" there are two, but they're just the same villain from different timelines.
In "The Puppeteer" there are four, but only Manon was the actual akumatized villain.
Vanisher's akumatization is not shown, making this the second time this happens, after "Princess Fragrance".
Some of the drawings in the bathroom include Chloé with a mustache, Chloé as an elephant, and Chloé as a rat.
Big Mustachio is known as "Super Mustache" in French.
Big Mustachio's goal is to give everyone in Paris handlebar mustaches.
Cat Noir handing Ladybug a flower is reminiscent to a scene in the Ladybug PV where Cat Noir gives Ladybug a rose.
Despite having her own classroom, Olga Mendeleiev is using Literature classroom in this episode. But in the end, Caline is back in the classroom.

title: Antibug
text:
Antibug - Trivia
Master Wang Fu can be seen sitting at the counter when Chloé and Sabrina burst into the room dressed as Ladybug and Cat Noir.
This is first known instance where Ladybug has mistaken an object to be the akumatized one, believing it to be Sabrina's bag when it actually is her brooch. Later, she thinks the akuma is in Chloé's yo-yo until Cat Noir suggests that it's in the earrings, since the yo-yo was broken before Chloé was akumatized.
The Lucky Charm and the Miraculous Ladybug are both used twice.
Counting the Anti-Charm, Lucky Charm is used the most times in an episode so far in the series (3 times total).
Interestingly if Chloé had been honest with Ladybug in the first place her akumatization wouldn't have happened the same with Bob Roth in "Silencer".
References
When Ladybug rips open Vanisher's purse, one of the contents that spilled out was a ticket for Jagged Stone's concert, previously seen before in "Pixelator".
This episode makes many references to "Copycat":
It's unknown if the mistake of one of the sides of Ladybug's yo-yo having inverted colors in a few scenes, gave the writers the idea on making Chloé's akumatized form Antibug.

title: Antibug
text:
Antibug - Trivia
This is the second episode where a Miraculous holder had their powers used against them.
When Antibug says "I love a good cat fight" this may also be in reference to a similar line said in "Copycat". Other references to this episode is when Cat Noir says that he "doesn't take orders from a copycat".
This is the third episode where Plagg doesn't have a speaking role following "Timebreaker" and "The Evillustrator".
This is one of the four episodes of season 1 in which Hawk Moth doesn't hold his end monologue after being defeated. The other three being "Princess Fragrance", "Copycat" and "Simon Says". However, he does hold his monologue after Vanisher is defeated.
Allusion
Someone would have known that Sabrina was missing, even her own father, to file a missing person's report.
Errors
For a brief moment, Nadja Chamack's hair is a dark purple instead of its fuchsia color.
Sabrina's hair is miscolored brown in one shot.
When Cat Noir is searching through Chloé's closet, all of her clothes are missing. When he moves on to another section, her dresses are back on their hangers.

title: Antibug
text:
Antibug - Trivia
When André Bourgeois is lamenting over Chloé's clothes, he is directly behind Ladybug. When the camera angle changes, he is nowhere in sight. The dresses also go back to being missing.
When Chloé shows up to Ladybug and Cat Noir's fight with Vanisher, she already has her mask on, but while walking down the stairs it disappears. It then reappears when Vanisher tries to throw a book at her.
At the end of the episode, Cat Noir says that Chloé's yo-yo was destroyed when Fang ripped it. But when Chloé tries to fight Vanisher, she uses another one. Presumably, she had it repaired or replaced after the original was ruined.
When Chloé gets possessed by an akuma, she doesn't have her Ladybug's mask on her face, having thrown it on the floor and stomped on it before the Akuma arrived. When she returns back to normal, the mask is on her face.
While shouting at Chloé when she first shows up in costume, Ladybug's hair clips through her arm.
When Ladybug drags Cat Noir to the elevator, a few of the spots on her suit glitched for a second.
When Adrien is in the bathroom stall looking at photos of Chloé, the stripes on his shirt are missing.

title: Antibug
text:
Antibug - Trivia
When Vanisher messes with Chloé's hair, she sends the photo to everybody, yet no phone was seen taking the image.

text:

[ Theme Song ]
Chloé: (to herself) Ugh, this is rubbish! Ugh, I don't have a thing to wear! (points to a pink outfit) This one is way too pink! (points to a pair of red heels) Those ones are so last season! (picks up a pair of brown heel ankle boots in her right hands, while holding another pair of red heels on her left) Those ones didn't cost nearly enough. (tosses the boots away) And these are never in season! Agh, I hate all of these! (hears shattered glass) Huh? (looks around her room while still holding her red heels) Is someone there? Anybody?
(Chloé looks in her bathroom. Suddenly, someone invisible throws a cosmetic bottle at her. It shoves all the cosmetics to the floor, before pushing down Chloé's bed. It then picks up Chloé's shoes and runs to the balcony. The invisible person is laughing evilly.)

title: Antibug/Transcript
text:
Antibug/Transcript - Intro
Alya: Sabrina has been absent since yesterday, huh? (Ms. Mendeleiev shushes them. Both Marinette and Alya giggle as an apology. Suddenly, Chloé's hair is then pulled)
Chloé: Ow!
Olga Mendeleiev: What is it, Chloé?
Chloé: Someone pulled my hair! (Ms. Mendeleiev looks at Mylène)
Mylène: I didn't do it, Ms. M.
Chloé: It wasn't her, it's-it's some invisible mystical being. Like a leprechaun. Or a unicorn without the horn. (everyone in the class starts laughing at her)

Chloé: (the invisible presence then grabs at Chloé's purse, trying to take it off her) Oh, it's happening again. Oh, wah! (falls down)

Chloé: I can't! (the invisible person hits her repeatedly with the purse) My purse is beating me up! (Adrien and Marinette see this strange situation)
(Chloé runs to the corner of the classroom while screaming. The invisible person then picks up Juleka's pen and throws it at Chloé. Several more pens are thrown at Chloé, making her run down the steps while continue screaming.)
Ms. Mendeleiev: Chloé, we don't run in the classroom! Get back to your seat!

title: Antibug/Transcript
text:
Antibug/Transcript - Intro
(Chloé is about to do it, when the invisible presence takes Chloé's sunglasses from her head, fighting with Chloé for them. The presence leads Chloé over to Miss Bustier's desk. It abandons the sunglasses, instead tugging at Chloé's hair.)

(The class laughs at her while Chloé flees from the room, waving her hands in front of her to ward off the invisible presence. The invisible presence follows Chloé, moving Adrien's tablet to Nino and he stops Adrien's tablet from moving. The door closes behind it resoundingly.)
Marinette: (whispers) Tikki, we've gotta get outta here.
Adrien: Miss, please, I have to go to the restroom. (walks out of the class) Thank you. (closes the door)
Marinette: So do I, please?
Tikki: Somebody seems to have it in for Chloé.
Marinette: Huh, the hard part's going to be finding out who doesn't.
(Suddenly, Marinette's cellphone dinged. The class', including Ms. Mendeleiev's, phones dinged too, much to their confusion. In the boys' bathroom, Adrien skims through his phone to see a set of pictures depicting what has been happening to Chloé.)
Adrien: Something really strange going on.

title: Antibug/Transcript
text:
Antibug/Transcript - Intro
Marinette and Adrien: (at the same time with their respective Kwami) Time to transform!
[ Transformation Sequence ]Marinette: Tikki, spots on! Ha! (Marinette transforms into Ladybug)
[ Transformation Sequence ]Adrien: Plagg, claws out! (Adrien transforms into Cat Noir)
André: Damaging my daughter's reputation is the same as soiling the reputation of the Mayor of Paris, umm, which is me. And an attack on Chloé is an attack on Paris.
(Ladybug and Cat Noir leaps down behind him.)
Cat Noir: We'll find the culprit, Mr. Bourgeois. You have my word.
(Cut to inside the hotel in Chloé's room.)
André: Chloé, my darling. We got special guests for you.
Chloé: (appears behind one of her couches) Ladybug! (runs and tackles Ladybug in a hug) I knew you'd come to save me! You know, considering what good friends we are!
(Cat Noir opens the door of Chloé's closet in her room to investigate, while Chloé constantly taking pictures of Ladybug.)
André: I had to put out an emergency call to all the biggest designers. Can you imagine? My daughter wearing department-store clothing? How humiliating.

title: Antibug/Transcript
text:
Antibug/Transcript - Intro
(Ladybug sighs in annoyance. She then turns on Chloé's television, turning the four sections of the screen to various areas in the hotel where the invisible presence could be hidden.)
Ladybug: Have you had any run-ins with anyone lately?
Chloé: I never have run-ins with anyone. Everybody absolutely loves me.
(Ladybug bends down to pick up a photo of Chloé and Sabrina off the floor.)
Ladybug: Really? Not even with your closest friends? (hands the picture to Chloé)
Chloé: Ah, Sabrina? (drops the photo back to the floor while giggling) Impossible. She adores me, I'm her idol!
Ladybug: (sighs again before turns to André) Your daughter's safe here with the doors and windows locked. This enemy may be invisible, but it can't go through walls.
Chloé: (tackles Ladybug into a hug again) I'm sure you'll make my life perfect again! Just like it was before!
(Ladybug gets off of Chloé and walks away. She pulls Cat Noir by his arm when he's not following her to the elevator.)

Ladybug: Whatever you tell us won't go any farther than this room.
Armand: Mademoiselle did have a run-in with someone.

title: Antibug/Transcript
text:
Antibug/Transcript - Intro
(Flashbacks to what happened two days ago in the hallways.)
Armand: Miss Chloé and her friend Sabrina like to impersonate Ladybug and Cat Noir.
Chloé: (from the flashback) Aha! (points to Jean, wearing Groucho glasses. He pushes the elevator button and the doors closed before Chloé and Sabrina "caught" him)

title: Antibug/Transcript
text:

Jagged Stone: Well, you did the right thing. (notices "Ladybug"'s hair) Hey, what's the dealio with your hair? (Chloé realizes that he's with Nadja Chamack and the camera is focusing on her)
Chloé: Oh, ah… ha. The old hair was so drab. This color is amazing. (sits on the couch between Jagged Stone and Nadja Chamack. She unintentionally slaps Jagged with her ponytail) Don't you think? I got a few minutes to spare. I'm sure you'd jump at the chance to interview me!
Jagged: Hey, wait! I thought you're coming by to say hi to me?
Chloé: And I did! Now where were we? (winks) (flashbacks interrupted again)
Ladybug: She pretended she was me?! How often does that happen?
Armand: She idolizes you. (flashbacks again)
Sabrina: (grabbing Jean's arm) Chloé, I found Big Mustachio!

title: Antibug/Transcript
text:

(Chloé takes out her toy yo-yo, bouncing it up and down. But she unintentionally hits Fang's head each time. (flashback ended.)

title: Antibug/Transcript
text:
Antibug/Transcript - Intro

title: Antibug/Transcript
text:
Antibug/Transcript - Intro

Hawk Moth: (from his lair) It's time to fulfill our agreement, Vanisher. Cat Noir and Ladybug are at your mercy. Take their Miraculouses and bring them back to me.

Cat Noir: Huh?
Ladybug: Huh?
Cat Noir: Uh, the flower. It– (Cat Noir notices Vanisher is trying to take Ladybug's earrings) Look out Ladybug! (they jump into action and use their weapons as shields in front of them)
Chloé: (watching from her room) If it really is you Sabrina, then I want to be the one to take you down. (goes over to her closet and looks at her Ladybug costume) You didn't get my costume, invisible one. Now you'll have to face me.
(Back at the foyer, Vanisher is throwing vases to Ladybug and Cat Noir, who deflect them.)
Ladybug: Lucky Charm! (Ladybug's Lucky Charm gives her a glitter container) How handy.

title: Antibug/Transcript
text:
Antibug/Transcript - Intro
Chloé: (from the top of the stairs, dressed as Ladybug) Looking for me Sabrina? I'm right here, come on!
Ladybug: Oh no, seriously? (to Chloé) You need to leave!
Chloé: If you stop this ridiculousness right now, I might let you be my BFF again. (Vanisher picks up books and starts throwing them at her)
Vanisher: You've got no friends left, Chloé. And you'll never have any, EVER again. (Ladybug and Cat Noir protect Chloé. Ladybug takes her aside while Cat Noir tries to find Vanisher) I'll make sure of that.
