Backwarder/Transcript - Intro
(Ladybug jumps simultaneously as Cat Noir pushes the pipe to the cross; Backwarder trips over it, skidding to Cat Noir. The timer ends.)
Cat Noir: Cataclysm! (destroys the brooch)
Backwarder: NOOOOO!
Ladybug: No more evil-doing for you, little akuma. Time to de-evilize! (captures the akuma) Gotcha! Bye bye, little butterfly! (releases a purified butterfly) Miraculous Ladybug! (The Miraculous cure fixes all the damage done, and Ms. Lenoir turns back to normal.)
Ladybug & Cat Noir: Pound it!
Cat Noir: Well, at least I think so, 'cause to be honest. I still don't understand what all that was about.
Ladybug: (helping Ms. Lenoir get up) That's because we girls are mysterious that way. (looks at Ms. Lenoir)
Cat Noir: (his ring beeps) Oh, oops! Sorry, but I'd better scat, super fast.
(Cat Noir approaches Ladybug and kisses her hand courteously.)
Ladybug: Why the rush?
Cat Noir: It's a secret, you see, we cats are mysterious too. (He runs away, and Ladybug gently seats Ms. Lenoir on a bench.)
Ms. Lenoir: What happened to me?

title: Backwarder/Transcript
text:
Backwarder/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: (opens her yo-yo and gets the right letter) I gave you the wrong letter earlier, I hope you'll forgive me. I can't do anything to change the past, but I hope this letter will change your future. (She swings away on her yo-yo, and Ms. Lenoir smiles while looking at the letter.)
Hawk Moth: Don't believe for one second that you've won, Ladybug! I've acquired more information that will enable me to track the Guardian down. And even though no one in Paris goes by the name of Master Fu, I will find where he's hiding. Soon I'll be able to have him decipher the spellbook for me and maybe, who knows, even get my hands on every Miraculous known on Earth!
Train conductor: (to a passenger who needs to use the washroom) I know it's taking a long time—
(Hawk Moth laughs maniacally, alarming the conductor and the passenger; Gabriel and Adrien detransform and exit the washrooms simultaneously, both gasping when they see each other.)
Adrien: You seem to be feeling a lot better, Father.
Gabriel: Oh yes, I am. (escorts Adrien to his seat)

title: Backwarder/Transcript
text:
Backwarder/Transcript - Intro
Train conductor: (glances at Gabriel awkwardly as he passes while speaking to the passengers; the passenger goes to the washroom) Ladies and gentlemen, our incident has been resolved. This train for London is about to depart, stand clear of the doors, we apologize for any inconvenience.
Master Fu: Marianne, I—
Ms. Lenoir: (at the same time as Master Fu) Fu, I— (Both chuckle gingerly; the atmosphere abruptly saddens.)
Master Fu: Marianne, I'm sorry I took so long to come here. I always felt as long as I was in charge of the Miracle Box, I'd be a danger to anyone I'm close to... but that's all in the past now.
Ms. Lenoir: (placing her hand on his) I know you always wanted to do what's best. I know what a responsibility it is being the Guardian of the Miraculous. Unfortunately, Hawk Moth now knows that I know you.
Master Fu: Yes, he could hurt you to get to me.
Ms. Lenoir: We can't be together again until he's been defeated.
Master Fu: I have full trust in the ones I have chosen. (Master Fu and Ms. Lenoir hold hands) They will succeed.
Ms. Lenoir: Now it's my turn to go and hide, my sweet, darling Fu.
Master Fu: Marianne, I've never told you this but I... I...

title: Backwarder/Transcript
text:
Backwarder/Transcript - Intro
Ms. Lenoir: (puts her finger on Fu's lips) Shh. Save it for when I get back.
(Mr. Ramier lets out wistful tears looking at the couple; scene shifts to Marinette and Tikki gazing from above.)
Tikki: (emotionally) Why doesn't he just tell her?
Marinette: Because it's probably not the right time yet.
Tikki: How about you? (Marinette opens her mouth in befuddlement) When will it be the right time for you?
Marinette: (disappointed) I'll tell you if I'm still alive after seeing Adrien again tomorrow morning.
Rose: (joyful and curious) So, how did it go?
Mylène: Did you tell him?
Marinette: Yeah... (awkwardly rubs her arm) I mean... kind of. Basically, I gave him a letter. (The girls start cheering)
Rose: Tell us exactly what you wrote in the letter!
Marinette: (awkwardly) Oh, not much, it's not really important, is it?
Alya: What? How can you say that, girl? (Her and Marinette look shocked as Adrien approaches.)
Adrien: Uh. Hey, Marinette! (Alya pushes Marinette in front of Adrien.)
Marinette: (squeals nervously) Hey.

title: Backwarder/Transcript
text:
Backwarder/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: I was very surprised when I read your letter, but since it seemed to be so important, I spent the whole weekend walking around London looking for it. (holds out a medical bag as the girls shriek in astonishment) For you. (Alya helps Marinette get the pharmacist medical bag)
Marinette: (embarrassed) Thank you.
Adrien: I'm glad I could help. (walks into the school)
Marinette: Disaster! (collapses)
Alya: Disaster? He had you on his mind all weekend; he even brought back a gift for you!
Rose: (excited) Yeah, what is it?
Alya: Come on! Show us!
Mylène: Open it!
Alix: Open it!
Marinette: No, we're good. (shifts the bag out of the girls' reach as they try to take it) Trust me, you really don't need to open it.
(Alix knocks the medical bag into Alya's hands and she opens it.)
Alya: (confused) Constipation capsules?
Marinette: (mortified gasp) Ah, uh, I... (bends her head low)
Rose: (sweetly) What a beautiful display of pure love! (The other girls start laughing.)

title: Banana Boomboom
text:
Banana Boomboom - Intro
was the secondary antagonist of the episode "Queen Banana". He was a banana-themed gorilla Sentimonster manifested by Shadow Moth for Queen Banana from her pride, sadness and anger after she was removed from the class cinema project (which she was trying to take over) in "Queen Banana". He temporarily went berserk because of Cat Noir's Cataclysm but got immobilized by Vesperia's Venom and defeated with Ladybug's de-evilization process.

title: Banana Boomboom
text:
Banana Boomboom - Appearance
Physical appearance
Banana Boomboom was a noticeably large, bulky creature that took the form of a banana-themed gorilla. He had red eyes with purple sclera, a pale yellow face, black V-shaped eyebrows, and two sharp canine teeth. His head was perfectly shaped to fit Queen Banana's car and carried five bananas tied around his chest.

title: Banana Boomboom
text:
Banana Boomboom - Abilities
Banana Boomboom was able to throw giant bananas that turned anyone hit by them into a banana. He was also very physically strong as he could easily destroy the cinema.

title: Banana Boomboom
text:
Banana Boomboom - Trivia
Banana Boomboom had a similar appearance to Gorizilla.
He was the third Sentimonster to be cataclysmed, the other two being Reflekdoll and Lighteye.
In contrast to the first two Sentimonsters, however, this was accidental, as Cat Noir actually intended to destroy Queen Banana's go kart.
This was the first Sentimonster that the accompanying title villain named themselves. Shadow Moth never named the Sentimonster and never mentions him by name in the episode.
This was the first Sentimonster to be immobilized.
Banana Boomboom was the second sentimonster based on an animal, the first being the Butterfly sentimonster.

title: Ball
text:
Ball - Intro
The  is the tool of the Dog Miraculous.
The current owner of the ball is Sabrina Raincomprix, who uses it as the superhero Miss Hound.
Previously, it was used by Gabriel Agreste when he used the Dog Miraculous with the other Miraculouses in his possession to become Monarch. And also, it was temporarily used by Félix Fathom when he used the Dog Miraculous to become Flairmidable in "Strikeback" and by Alix Kubdel when she used the Dog Miraculous to become Canigirl, and later unified with Rabbit Miraculous to become Bunny Dog in "Evolution".

title: Ball
text:
Ball - Appearance
The ball changes color depending on whose possession it's in:
When used by Miss Hound, the ball is metallic orange with brown and white circular patterns, it also has a blue circle in the middle.
From season 6 onwards, the ball now has a design of a dog nose.
When used by Flairmidable, it seems to be a brighter shade of orange from Miss Hound's original design.
When it was temporarily used by Canigirl, the ball had the same pattern as Miss Hound's ball, but it had darker colors.
When it was used by Monarch, the ball changed color from brown to purple.

title: Ball
text:
Ball - Abilities
Like the other Miraculous tools, the ball is nearly unbreakable and can be used to deflect attacks. When used offensively, the ball can make opponents trip when stepped on, it can also be thrown or kicked at opponents to attack.
Its main purpose is to activate Fetch: the holder throws the ball or they use it to touch the intended target(s) and hits it before rebounding into their grasp. As seen in "Strikeback", once the holder activates their power, the ball will locate and pursue the marked target and, once it touches it, the ball teleports the target along with it back to its owner.
From season 6 onwards, Miss Hound now has the ability to call on any Miraculous Heroes (including Cat Noir and Ladybug) by picking one of their sigils from her ball. Clicking one sends an empathic signal to the designated hero which tells them that Miss Hound needs their help. The ball can also be used as a communicator.

title: Ball
text:
Ball - Trivia
The ball is the fourth Miraculous tool introduced to be based off of a toy, after the Ladybug Miraculous' yo-yo, the Bee Miraculous' spinning top, and the Mouse Miraculous' skip rope.
It's the smallest of all the known Miraculous tools.

title: Barkk/History
text:
Barkk/History - Intro
Barkk is the kwami connected to the Dog Miraculous. Currently, she lets Sabrina Raincomprix transform into Miss Hound.

title: Barkk/History
text:
Barkk/History - Before [[Season 1]]
When the concept of Adoration came into existence, Barkk came into existence. Before the Miraculous jewels were created, Barkk and the other kwamis traveled all over the universe unable to interact with humans. Then, thousands of years ago, a mage created the Miraculouses. When her Miraculous was not being worn, Barkk was dormant in the Dog Miraculous, which was stored inside the Miracle Box.
In 1940, Barkk was taken to the future by Ladybug and Rabbit Noir to help them defeating Monarch and retrieving the Rabbit Miraculous from him, by giving her Miraculous to Alix Kubdel, allowing her to become Canigirl. As a result, Barkk learned about her siblings future owners.

title: Barkk/History
text:
Barkk/History - Season 1
During Season 1, Barkk was dormant in the Dog Miraculous.

title: Barkk/History
text:
Barkk/History - Season 2
During Season 2, Barkk was dormant in the Dog Miraculous.
In "Sandboy", Barkk was celebrating Nooroo's birthday in the Miracle Box with the other kwamis and she was excited when Tikki and Plagg arrived. She marveled at the gift Tikki brought, a marker that she thought was a paintbrush, and she played with the other kwamis. When the time came to find Nooroo, Barkk got into position in an effort to contact him, but the kwamis contacted his wielder instead. Upon hearing him, they shuddered at the thought of being his slave and they prevented him from discovering their location by cutting off the connection. They realized that if they contacted Nooroo's wielder rather than Nooroo, then someone must have been akumatized and that Tikki and Plagg's wielders would be in danger.

title: Barkk/History
text:
Barkk/History - [[Season 3]]
During season 3, Barkk was dormant in the Dog Miraculous.
In "Kwamibuster", she was activated along with her kwami brothers and sisters to help Multimouse enact her plan to rescue Tikki and Plagg. During the confrontation, Barkk was one of the few kwamis captured but was set free with the help of Multinoire. After Kwamibuster's defeat, she and the others cheered for Marinette as their plan was a success and returned to Miracle Box.
In "Miracle Queen", she was activated alongside Stompp, Roaar, Ziggy, Daizzi, Mullo, Orikko and Fluff by Queen Bee with the intent to use them against Ladybug and Cat Noir. After being commanded to transform her, they collectively all withheld their transformation phrases. Upon hearing Master Fu renounce his title, they protest, but Master Fu does so anyway, resulting in the Miracle Box changing shape and form. After failing to escape, Queen Bee throws off their respective Miraculouses, and they, alongside their kwamis are returned to the Miracle Box by Ladybug.

title: Barkk/History
text:
Barkk/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Truth", Barkk was accidentally released from the Miracle Box when Marinette tried to figure it out, she explored Marinette's room. During a video call on her new guardian's computer, she and the others surrounded the screen in amazement. When Marinette leaves for her date with Luka, she and the kwamis hid with the Miracle Box. Upon hearing the titular villain enter the room, she left to warn the others. After Truth's defeat, Barkk and the others saw that Marinette was sad about breaking up with Luka to the point of tears, she didn't know exactly how to help but joined with her siblings in giving their new guardian a group hug.

title: Barkk/History
text:

Seeing her guardian voice concerns about what Trixx did but when he eased her worries, Barkk along with Wayzz didn't look easily convinced. After the Gang of Secrets had been defeated, Barkk and the others look on as Marinette unveils her secret to Alya.
In "Mr. Pigeon 72", she was playing along with Roaar in one of Marinette's designer hats until they were joined by their other siblings. Then, Barkk joined in helping clean up Marinette's room.

Everyone trembles in fear of their new wielder, while he comments to his wife about his greatest victory in obtaining almost all of the Miraculouses from the Miracle Box and how he will use them to finally obtain Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses and wish for her to return. title: Basilica of Saint Clotilde
text:
Basilica of Saint Clotilde - Intro
The  is a Parisian religious building located in the 7° arrondissement of Paris.

title: Basilica of Saint Clotilde
text:
Basilica of Saint Clotilde - Description
The Basilica of Saint Clotilde is a neo-Gothic basilica built between 1846 and 1857, designed by François-Christian Gau and Théodore Ballu. It is 90 meters long and 38 meters wide. It has two towers topped by spires reaching 70 meters in height.
Reproducing the Gothic style of medieval cathedrals, such as Notre-Dame de Paris, the basilica features numerous flying buttresses and pinnacles supporting the nave walls. However, these are of no use in stabilizing the building due to its iron structure, designed by Gustave Eiffel.
Numerous stained-glass windows adorn the side facades, the two main ones being at the ends of the transept.

title: Basilica of Saint Clotilde
text:
Basilica of Saint Clotilde - Trivia
It's named after Clotilde, the wife of Clovis I, the first king of the Franks.
It was declared a historical monument in 2015.
As it only appeared in backgrounds of episodes from Season 1 and Santa Claws (which was produced and released before the rest of Season 2) it's unknown whether it'll appear again.

title: BBD News
text:
BBD News - Intro
is a television news network filmed in London, United Kingdom.
In "Representation", the main topic of the news was the election of a new mayor of Paris, the main candidates for which are Caline Bustier and Armand D'Argencourt, as well as the arrival of love couple Adrien Agreste and Kagami Tsurugi.

title: BBD News
text:
BBD News - Features
BBD seems to be a generalist channel presenting a reporter presented live from their London studio by a presenter. The other nature of the programs is unknown.

title: BBD News
text:
BBD News - Trivia
This is the third international television channel, after US News Now from "Miraculous New York" and TV News SH from "Miraculous Shanghai", to appear in the series.
BBD is an obvious parody of BBC (British Broadcasting Corporation), the British public service broadcaster.
In the original French version of "Representation", the reporter says "God Save the King", which is the name of the British auth and expression of British patriotism and hope for the long life of the monarch.
In the English dub, the reporter says "God Save the Queen". This was changed due to the death of Queen Elizabeth II on September 8, 2022, and the ascension to the throne of her son, King Charles III.

text:
Badoom - Appearance
Badoom was fully made of balloons. His torso was a yellow round balloon. His head was red in color with black eyes and a mouth that seemed drawn. His facial expressions were variable and reflected what he felt. Most often, he had a wide smiling mouth and furrowed, angry eyebrows and eyes. His right hand was pink and his left hand was blue. His right leg was purple and his left leg was blue.

title: Badoom
text:
Badoom - Personality
Badoom probably had no independence, fully obeying the Magician who created and commanded him. He obeyed the villain's orders without resistance and didn't care what happened to the civilians. His sole purpose was to help the villains fight superheroes. Badoom mainly distracted the heroes, attacking innocent people so that the heroes focused on saving them, becoming easier targets for the Magician and the Mime.

title: Aurore Beauréal/History
text:
Aurore Beauréal/History - Intro
Aurore Beauréal is a student in Ms. Mendeleiev's class at Collège Françoise Dupont and a final contestant for KIDZ+ to become the weather forecaster.

title: Aurore Beauréal/History
text:
Aurore Beauréal/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Stormy Weather", Aurore was a contestant in the KIDZ+ competition to find a new weather girl, with 5000 other contestants. She managed to become one of the two finalist, along with Mireille Caquet. On the final day of the contest, the two girls rode a limousine to the TVi Tower. As they arrive, they both wave at their fans who cheer from them.
They then are seen with Alec Cataldi as introduced them both to the viewers watching at home. Mireille then watched as Alec told viewers to the viewers to text one for her and two for Mireille to determine a winner. When the voting was done, Alec announced that Mireille had won by a landslide with 82% of the votes and a devastated Aurore runs off the stage.

title: Aurore Beauréal/History
text:
Aurore Beauréal/History - [[Season 1]]
Hawk Moth feels Aurore's anger and sends an akuma her way. At the TVi Tower, Aurore enters the elevator when the power suddenly goes down. The akuma then enters the elevator and Aurore swins her parasol at it to try to make it go away. She then opens the parasol and the akuma infects it. After the power comes back, Hawk Moth offers to make Aurore into the best weather girl the world has seen, so long as she can get Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses, to which Aurore agrees. She is then transformed into Stormy Weather, a weather-controlling supervillain.
With her trophy in hand, Mireille enters an elevator heading down and before she can reach her designated floor, Stormy Weather appears. She then introduces herself and tells Mireille that she's the only weather girl who always gets the forecast right. Stormy Weather then attacks with her parasol and traps Mireille in the elevator, freezing it open with ice. Stormy Weather then runs off as Mireille screams for help.

title: Aurore Beauréal/History
text:
Aurore Beauréal/History - [[Season 1]]
Stormy Weather sashays out of the TVi Tower to a crowd chanting Mireille's name. Angry that they still cheer for Mireille, Stormy Weather unleashes a wind storm on the people, blowing them and the metal railings away. Stormy Weather then takes off into the sky. In the sky near the Place des Vosges, Stormy Weather's flight is halted by a stray Mireille balloon. She looks down, finding the park vendor handing another one to a child.
Stormy Weather makes her presence known by sending out another windstorm, blowing the people away. She then surrounds the carousel in thick ice, covering it entirely and trapping Alya Césaire and Manon Chamack inside. Stormy Weather then lands in the park, zapping the Mireille balloons with her parasol.
Cat Noir then arrives and stops her as she is leaving the Place des Vosges, throwing a few puns at her and even calling her Ice Queen while he warns her to stop. Annoyed, she sends a gust of wind his way blowing him off the park's fence; over several buildings; and into four cars.

title: Aurore Beauréal/History
text:
Aurore Beauréal/History - [[Season 1]]
After Ladybug arrives, Stormy Weather floats over her and Cat Noir. She points her parasol into the sky, causing clouds to appear over Paris. Lightning rains down, aimed at Cat Noir, but Ladybug rushes at him, knocking them both to the side. Cat Noir then sprints towards Stormy Weather, but she freezes the road, making it slick. He is thrown backward as she sends yet another gust towards him.
Cat Noir only remains on the street due to Ladybug, who thinks quickly, wrapping her yo-yo around a lamppost and grabbing his tail. Stormy Weather then makes the wind stops and the heroes fall. Stormy Weather them sees a screen with Mireille and blasts it. Ladybug and Cat Noir then jump off two separate buildings and swinging their weapons at Stormy Weather. She turns, blowing them and many cars several streets away.

title: Aurore Beauréal/History
text:
Aurore Beauréal/History - [[Season 1]]
Stormy Weather halts her flight to speak with Hawk Moth. He determines that the world knows of her powers and that it is time for her to keep her end of the deal. He tells her about his plan. Stormy Weather then returned to the TVi Studio and recorded a message for the people of Paris. In the recording Stormy Weather is seen giving the weather. She then casts all of France in eternal winter, and it begins to snow.
Ladybug and Cat Noir then arrive at the TVi Tower and busted open the doors on the way. They find the Stormy Weather's forecast that prerecorded. Laughing, Stormy Weather appears in the doorway behind Ladybug and Cat Noir. She aims a blast at the lights, taking out all of the lights in the building. The two heroes then fall as she does this. Laughing, Stormy Weather runs off and the heroes follow. Stormy Weather then hits Ladybug with a fire extinguisher.

title: Aurore Beauréal/History
text:
Aurore Beauréal/History - [[Season 1]]
On the roof, Stormy Weather cackled as she released a cyclone around the building. Stormy Weather then sets hail onto the heroes. Cat Noir pulls Ladybug in front of him, raising his staff and twirling it in a circle, blocking Stormy Weather's ice. Ladybug then uses Lucky Charm, with a bath towel appearing, and Cat Noir summons his Cataclysm and taunts Stormy Weather, distracting her as he runs his hand along the billboard. It comes crashing down toward Stormy Weather. She blasts a hole in it with a bolt of lightning and Ladybug wraps her yo-yo around Stormy Weather's ankle.
Ladybug takes off, running under pipes and against a crane before jumping over an HVAC. Opening the towel, Ladybug soars into the air, pulling Stormy Weather down. The speed at which she falls and the angle of the crane cause her to lose her parasol. Cat Noir catches it, tossing it to Ladybug, who breaks it in half and releases the akuma. After Ladybug does her Miraculous Ladybug, Stormy Weather is transformed back into Aurore, who wonders what she was doing there.

title: Aurore Beauréal/History
text:
Aurore Beauréal/History - [[Season 1]]
In "The Evillustrator", Stormy Weather is shown in Nathaniel Kurtzberg's fantasy. She is seen as Marinette Dupain-Cheng runs away from her. Lady Wifi then appears and puts a pink pause symbol on Marinette, and Stormy Weather freezes her with her parasol. But then, Super-Nathan arrives, and erases Stormy Weather's parasol. He then traps the two villains in a cage he draws.
In "Lady Wifi", Aurore is outside of Collège Françoise Dupont, when Chloé Bourgeois bursted out of her limousine. Chloé then insulted Aurore about her looks and told her that it's was still a month from Halloween, to Aurore's shock.
In "Dark Cupid", Aurore is seen outside of Collège Françoise Dupont, along with Mireille and some other girls, admiring a pillar with one of Adrien Agreste's new posters on it. Just then Chloé and Sabrina Raincomprix arrive, with Chloé telling Aurore and the girls to stop gushing over Adrien as he is now hers.

title: Aurore Beauréal/History
text:
Aurore Beauréal/History - [[Season 1]]
Aurore then watched as Sabrina unrolled a poster that Adrien had unwittingly signed earlier. It is a copy of the one on the pillar, Aurore then reads what it says, with that being "To Chloé, the most wonderful girl of the universe and the love of my life", signed by Adrien. This causes Aurore and the girls to burst out crying.
In "Gamer", Aurore was at the bus stop when Cat Noir told her and all the other citizens as the titular villain was on his way. Aurore then runs away but she was shot by the villain at some point offscreen and was transformed into experience points. But after the villain was defeated and Ladybug did her Miraculous Ladybug, Aurore was transformed back to normal.
In "Reflekta", Aurore is seen with her class taking a class photograph in the courtyard of Collège Françoise Dupont. Vincent the photographer tells the class to look at the camera and say spaghetti, which everyone does. Aurore is then seen taking to three other students before the titular villain arrives.

title: Aurore Beauréal/History
text:
Aurore Beauréal/History - Before Season 2
At some point before the events of "Prime Queen", Aurore filmed a television shampoo commercial. In the commercial, Aurore appears saying "She's a girl and she doesn't have a shampoo? What the bubble-" while holding a bottle of the shampoo she's promoting. The shampoo commercial reappeared in "Silencer".

title: Aurore Beauréal/History
text:
Aurore Beauréal/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Style Queen" and "Queen Wasp", Aurore is seen sitting on the front row of the fashion show of Gabriel Agreste, next to Soraya Khan and Vincent Asa. She is later seen when the fashion show was interrupted by the first titular villain and in a recording of that on the news. She was also present when Gabriel arrives and hugs his son, Adrien.
In "Catalyst", Aurore became one of the victims akumatized by Scarlet Moth, being transformed back into a scarlet version of Stormy Weather. She was then instructed by Scarlet Moth to head to the Eiffel Tower where he is. At the Eiffel Tower, Stormy Weather watched as Scarlet Moth arrive and made a statement to the Ladybug and Cat Noir.
In "Mayura", Stormy Weather is first seen at the Eiffel Tower, chanting Scarlet Moth's name. She is sent to battle the French Miraculous superhero team, with other members of the Scarlet Army. Stormy Weather then makes a huge cyclone appear that lifts the Mime, Riposte, and Rogercop in the air. She shoots a thunderbolt at Ladybug, but Carapace throws his shield at Ladybug, protecting her and reflecting her attack back at herself, which she dodges.

title: Aurore Beauréal/History
text:
Aurore Beauréal/History - [[Season 2]]
After awhile of attacking the heroes, Cat Noir extends his staff on the ground so that Queen Bee can stand on it and tells Stormy Weather that her forecast was wrong, calling her Ice Queen. He then flings Queen Bee, who uses her foot to break Stormy Weather's parasol, releasing the akuma. Stormy Weather is then transformed back into Aurore in mid-air, and Cat Noir catches her when she falls.
Aurore then joins all the other de-akumatized people. Soon Dark Cupid arrives and shoots arrows at Aurore and the other de-akumatized people, causing their emotions to become negative. Scarlet Moth then re-akumatizes them all, making Aurore be transformed back into Stormy Weather. She then continued to attack the heroes, until Ladybug and Cat Noir were the only ones left.

title: Aurore Beauréal/History
text:
Aurore Beauréal/History - [[Season 2]]
After Ladybug and Cat Noir escaped, Stormy Weather and some other members of the Scarlet Army followed Animan into the sewers as he was tracking down the heroes. Later, Stormy Weather and the other members of the Scarlet Army jump out of the sewers and into the city, where Ladybug and Cat Noir are. Stormy Weather then flew in the air as the people of Paris arrive to face off against the Scarlet Army, so Ladybug and Cat Noir can go face Scarlet Moth.

title: Aurore Beauréal/History
text:
Aurore Beauréal/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Gamer 2.0", Aurore was one of the many former akumatized villains that the titular villain zapped into his video game dimension. Stormy Weather (played by the titular villain) fights Anansi (played by Cat Noir) and is easily defeated. The villain later uses Stormy Weather again when he faces off against Ladybug. After the villain is defeated by Ladybug and Cat Noir, Aurore and the others are freed by Ladybug's Miraculous Ladybug.
In "Stormy Weather 2", at the end of the school day, Sabrina tells Chloé that Aurore's GPA dropped a whole point on her last report card. Chloé makes fun of Aurore for this, telling her that she can't expect to be a weather girl and have good grades at the same time. Chloé then tells Sabrina not to make Aurore cry, mockingly pointing out that she may turn into Stormy Weather again and even makes fun of her akumatized powers.

title: Aurore Beauréal/History
text:
Aurore Beauréal/History - [[Season 3]]
Then Marinette Dupain-Cheng steps in and tells Chloé that Aurore will do better next term and also advises Aurore to ask for help if she needs it. However, Chloé states her belief that "once a villain, always a villain", making Aurore furious. though Marinette tells her that people change. As Chloé the insulted Marinette and Alya, Aurore took the chance to get into her car and leave the scene.
Aurore thinks about what Chloé said to her and angrily exits her car. Just as enters the elevator at the TVi Tower, an akuma infects her parasol. Hawk Moth tells her that people don't change; they grow. He offers her the power to control all the forces of nature. Aurore agrees and is transformed back into Stormy Weather once again.
Stormy Weather then creates a volcano and then she declares that she will use her giant volcano to move the Earth away from the sun, therefore trapping everyone in an eternal winter and proving just how powerful she can be. She then laughs evilly and creates lightning. Later Stormy Weather goes to the rooftop of Le Grand Paris to confront Chloé and Sabrina.

title: Aurore Beauréal/History
text:
Aurore Beauréal/History - [[Season 3]]
At first, Chloé believes that it's Ladybug but is surprised when she sees her instead. Stormy Weather asks her if she still finds her powers ridiculous. Chloé merely states that she was right about "once a villain, always a villain", provoking Stormy Weather to trap her and Sabrina in a block of ice. Ladybug and Cat Noir then charge towards Stormy Weather, with her blowing away the two heroes using a hurricane. She is eventually defeated offscreen by the heroes and transformed back into Aurore.
In "Ikari Gozen", Aurore and Mireille announce Paris' annual Friendship Day on TV, where two people picked at random will go on an adventure across Paris in order to find where a celebrity is hiding. Aurore the introduces this year's celebrity, Adrien. Aurore then joins Adrien and Mireille as the first pushes a button that releases all the riddles. At the Musée Grévin (which is the secret hideout of Adrien during the game), Aurore thanked Adrien for his participation. Then Adrien makes a statue pose next to the statue of his father, making Aurore and Mireille giggle at him.

title: Aurore Beauréal/History
text:
Aurore Beauréal/History - [[Season 3]]
While Aurore was on her phone, the akuma alert goes off in the museum, making her stop what she was doing and exit the building. Later when it was safe, she returned to the museum and posted for a picture with the winners of the game: Alya and Wayhem, along with Adrien, Aurore, and the bodyguard.

title: Aurore Beauréal/History
text:
Aurore Beauréal/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Sole Crusher", Aurore is present when Mr. Damoclès enters Ms. Mendeleiev's classroom with Zoé Lee. Aurore then watched as the principal introduced Zoé to the entire class after threatening to call her stepfather, Mayor André Bourgeois, if she wasn't admitted into school.
In "Hack-San", after Robostus sends out a signal to all Parisians with a message sent through their phones, Aurore is hypothesized offscreen. She is then sent by Robostus to the Musée Grévin, positioning herself where her statue used to be. There after Scarabella and Cat Noir arrive, Aurore unfreezes from her position. She then pulls out her phone and moves towards the heroes. Aurore is commanded to seize the Ladybug and the Cat Miraculous, along with the other high-profile hypothesized individuals. She then watched as Scarabella and Cat Noir delivered themselves to Robostus. Later, Aurore is freed from Robostus' control by Scarabella's Miraculous Scarabella.

title: Aurore Beauréal/History
text:
Aurore Beauréal/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Perfection", Aurore goes to Liberty for Kitty Section's performance of Adrien's love song to Marinette. There she is seen standing next to Mireille and behind to Kagami Tsurugi as she witnessed Marinette panic and run away after she tried to confess her feelings to Adrien.

title: Avenue Winston-Churchill
text:
Avenue Winston-Churchill - Intro
The  is a street located in the 8th arrondissement of Paris. It is known for being the access road to the Grand Palais and the Petit Palais.

title: Avenue Winston-Churchill
text:
Avenue Winston-Churchill - Description
Created in 1896, avenue Winston-Churchill is a 220 meter long street between Cour de la Reine on the Seine side and Place George Clémenceau on the Champs-Élysées side.
With a width of 90 meters, this avenue has an asphalt roadway and particularly wide sidewalks that serve as a forecourt to the Grand Palais and the Petit Palais.
The street is tree-lined by some plots of the Champs-Élysées gardens, particularly on the Petit Palais side.
Avenue Winston-Churchill forms a street connecting the Champs-Élysées to the Hôtel des Invalides across the Pont Alexander III Bridge and the avenue du Maréchal Gallieni which crosses the esplanade of the invalidities.

title: Avenue Winston-Churchill
text:
Avenue Winston-Churchill - Trivia
The avenue is named after Winston Churchill (1874-1965), former Prime Minister of the United Kingdom.
Since its creation, this avenue has known several names:
Avenue Nicolas II (1900).
Avenue Alexandre III (1900-1966).
In the series, this avenue appears several times:
In "Frightningale", part of the confrontation between the heroes of Paris and the villain of the same name takes place there.
In "Style Queen" and in "Queen Wasp", many Parisians gathered to watch the celebrities attending the Gabriel Fashion Week show.
In "Multiplication", IKari Dozen multiplies there after destroying the Grand Palais.

title: Barbara Keynes/History
text:
Barbara Keynes/History - Intro
Barbara Keynes is a superhero in the United States called Knightowl, along with her partner Sparrow.

title: Barbara Keynes/History
text:
Barbara Keynes/History - [[Miraculous New York]]
Knightowl is first seen as she, Majestia, Uncanny, and Sparrow rescue the plane carrying Principal Denis Damocles and his students from College Francois Dupont in Paris from being attacked by wanted American supervillain Techno-Pirate.
After the plane makes it safely to NYC and lands at JFK Int'l Airport, Majestia and Knightowl assign Uncanny and Sparrow, in their civilian identities as Aeon and Jessica, to watch over the French students at their hotel.
However, later, while Majestia and Knightowl are busy with other duties, Sparrow, disobeying their orders, goes after Techno-Pirate again, joined by Uncanny, and also the French Miraculous Duo in Ladybug and Cat Noir, as Techno-Pirate had been Akumatized by Hawk Moth into Techlonizer and was completing a mission for Hawk Moth with stealing a sword belonging to Marquis de Lafayette, who aided George Washington during the Revolutionary War and gave Washington his saber as a gift of friendship between the fledgling United States and the Kingdom of France.

title: Barbara Keynes/History
text:
Barbara Keynes/History - [[Miraculous New York]]
When Cat Noir lets his guard down while being scolded by Ladybug for disobeying her and breaking her trust by coming to NYC when she told him to stay in Paris to protect that city from any threats from Hawk Moth or Mayura, Techlonizer grabs him and flings him towards Ladybug, threatening to kill her with his active Cataclysm.
Uncanny throws herself in the way of the attack and takes it herself to protect Ladybug, resulting in Uncanny's destruction as the Cataclysm reduces her body to a rusted, sparking, cracked wreck, and sensing this, Majestia rockets back to Manhattan and clobbers Techlonizer through several buildings in retaliation in her grief-induced heartbroken fury.
Knightowl finds Lafayette's saber shortly after Hawk Moth recovered a de-Akumatized Techno-Pirate and withdrew, with Techno-Pirate having discarded it after being clobbered by Majestia.
Knightowl then heads up to the rooftop where Majestia, Uncanny, Sparrow, Ladybug, and Cat Noir are to discover what happened to Uncanny.

title: Barbara Keynes/History
text:
Barbara Keynes/History - [[Miraculous New York]]
As Majestia cradles Uncanny's lifeless body in her arms, and calls out Cat Noir in her heartbroken grief as to what he had done, leaving him feeling extremely guilty and remorseful, Ladybug is able to use her Miraculous Ladybug to repair and restore Uncanny to working order, much to Majestia's relief and gratitude as she thanks Ladybug for restoring Uncanny.
However, Knightowl is furious with Sparrow for disobeying orders, suspends her from duty, and orders Ladybug and Cat Noir to hand over their Miraculous as punishment for getting involved in United Heroez business and getting Uncanny hurt/killed, saying they will only get their Miraculous back when they leave New York to avoid giving the United Heroez any more trouble or interference in their duties.
Majestia tries to calm Knightowl down, but Knightowl will have none of it, and Ladybug and Cat Noir are forced to flee when Knightowl proves unreasonable.

title: Barbara Keynes/History
text:
Barbara Keynes/History - [[Miraculous New York]]
Infuriated by their disobedience to her order to surrender their Miraculous to her until they leave New York, Knightowl tries to pursue them, but loses them when Ladybug and Cat Noir escape into the sewers to remain hidden and revert back to Marinette and Adrien to throw Knightowl off their trail.
Later, in their civilian disguises as Olympia and Barbara, when Aeon and Jessica plead for another chance to help, Barbara is still unwilling to change her mind, and Olympia is forced to agree with her.
Jessica tries to tell off her mother for her overprotectiveness and refusal to let Aeon and her do more to help the United Heroez because of the earlier incident with Ladybug and Cat Noir, but Barbara remains ironclad in her decision that Jessica and Aeon are not old or experienced enough to be on their own and must remain with the adult United Heroez until further notice.
The subject is dropped as Barbara and Olympia leave for a press conference with President Hombee to announce that the Franco-American Friendship Festival is postponed until Techno-Pirate is brought to justice.

title: Barbara Keynes/History
text:
Barbara Keynes/History - [[Miraculous New York]]
When Techno-Pirate reappears, now having become Miraclonizer thanks to both being Akumatized again by Hawk Moth and possessing the Eagle Miraculous, he feigns surrendering to the United Heroez to lure them in.
When Knightowl and the others arrive and confront him, he uses the Eagle Miraculous' Liberation to free them of their ethnical and moral restraints, causing them to go berserk, with Knightowl taking her no nonsense and no tolerance policy to the extreme with threatening to arrest anyone who committed even the smallest of infractions, like forgetting to return an overdue library book.
When Jessica, upon gaining possession of the Eagle Miraculous and becoming Eagle, reverses the effects and restores the United Heroez to normal, it is then that the American nuclear missile that Miraclonizer got possession of launches from Lady Liberty.
Knightowl is horrified upon seeing it, realizing that if it is not stopped, the world could be facing the nuclear Armageddon of World War III.
Majestia is able to intercept the warhead and hurl it into the Sun, saving the planet from certain doom.

title: Barbara Keynes/History
text:
Barbara Keynes/History - [[Miraculous New York]]
Knightowl goes to meet up with Ladybug, Cat Noir, Uncanny, and Eagle, helping them defeat Techlonizer and turning him back into Techno-Pirate, leading to his arrest and incarceration as he's handed over to the NYPD ESU SWAT team to be taken to Riker's Island Penitentiary.
Eagle is worried that Knightowl will be angry with her again for disobeying her orders, but Knightowl instead voices how proud she is of Eagle, who initially gives away that Knightowl is her mom, but Knightowl assures her as she takes off her mask that it was time to show that the legendary male Knightowl and Sparrow are long gone, and it was time for the current Knightowl to embrace her true gender.
Knightowl and Majestia also apologize for their earlier prejudice against Ladybug and Cat Noir, thanking them for helping inspire Uncanny and Eagle and show they were finally ready to take chances and be on their own, independent of the adult United Heroez, leading to Ladybug and Cat Noir doing their trademark "Pound It!" fist-bump with Uncanny and Eagle.

title: Barbara Keynes/History
text:
Barbara Keynes/History - [[Miraculous New York]]
As a result, the Franco-American Friendship Week festivities are able to continue, and Snowflake honors Ladybug, Cat Noir, Uncanny, and Eagle with an ice sculpture dedicated to them.

title: Barbara Keynes/History
text:
Barbara Keynes/History - [[Season 5]]
In the season finale, "The Final Day", when Hawk Moth, now called Monarch, launches his endgame with Operation Perfect Alliance, turning anyone around the world in possession of an Alliance Ring into Miraculized soldiers to carry out his will with hunting down Ladybug and Cat Noir, Knightowl and the other United Heroez are struggling to fight off many American citizens who have become Miraculized as well, as the United Heroez were also struggling against Nightormentor's nightmares they had been inflicted with, with Majestia's nightmares being how is she supposed to solve all of the world's problems, even with all of her powers. Knightowl assures her she believes in her, earning thanks from Majestia, and they continue their fight, until Uncanny analyzes one of the Alliance Rings and figures out that the source of the Miraculized is coming from Paris, where Ladybug and Cat Noir live.

title: Barbara Keynes/History
text:
Barbara Keynes/History - [[Season 5]]
Thanks to Doorman, the United Heroez head to Paris, arriving just in time to free Nora Cesaire from her Alliance Ring, restoring her to normal, then Majestia and Uncanny repair the Montparnasse Tower that Nora cracked in half with the Tiger Miraculous' Clout before being freed. Knowing Ladybug and Cat Noir need their help, Uncanny tells her mom to go find them while she and the rest of the United Heroez aid the Resistance, Ladydragon, and the Guardians against the Miraculized. As Knightowl fights the Miraculized in hand-to-hand combat, Grandmaster Su-Han asks her how she can handle Nightormentor's nightmares and still fight so efficiently, to which Knightowl responds that she is the nightmare.

title: Barbara Keynes/History
text:
Barbara Keynes/History - [[Season 5]]
Despite her efforts, Knightowl is punched with the Tiger Miraculous' Clout attack from one Miraculized that sends her crashing into the Place de la Concorde Ferris wheel, dismantling it, and incapacitating her, as the Miraculized begin to overrun all the good guys and allies of Ladybug and Cat Noir, and the freed civilians, trying to fight them off. Majestia also returns from searching for Ladybug and Cat Noir, but somberly reports she was unable to find either of them, leaving things to look extremely grim for the heroes and civilians as the Miraculized keep coming by the dozens to try and overwhelm them before hunting down Ladybug and Cat Noir with their allies eliminated.

title: Barbara Keynes/History
text:
Barbara Keynes/History - [[Season 5]]
However, as hinted at in "Miraculous London", after Gabriel made his wish, Bug Noire used her Miraculous Ladybug to undo the effects of Operation Perfect Alliance, restoring the Miraculized to normal, and also erasing all of Nightormentor's nightmares, saving Knightowl and the rest of the United Heroez, the Guardians, the Resistance, and Ladydragon all at once. With the world safe thanks to Ladybug, the United Heroez returned to the USA, where they soon learn over the news of Ladybug's announcement that Gabriel Agreste had sacrificed himself to end Monarch's threat forever. What Knightowl and the rest of the United Heroez did not know was that Gabriel was Monarch, and Ladybug, in accordance with Gabriel's last request, had lied to them and the rest of the world to keep the truth buried.

title: Barbara Keynes/History
text:
Barbara Keynes/History - [[Miraculous Tokyo]]
Knightowl makes a cameo appearance at the end of Miraculous Tokyo as she, Majestia, Uncanny, Eagle, and Cat Noir are dealing with their own threat of some giant monster emerging over New York from a portal, the first thing being its six-fingered hand reaching out towards them as they tense for battle.

title: Azabudai Hills
text:
Azabudai Hills - Intro
(麻布台ヒルズ, Azabudai Hiruzu) is a skyscraper complex located in the Minato district of Tokyo.

title: Azabudai Hills
text:
Azabudai Hills - Description
Azabudai Hills is a complex of three neo-futuristic skyscrapers built according to the plans of Pelli Clarke Pelli Architects.
First, the Azabudai Hills Mori JP Tower is the complex's main skyscraper. The third tallest structure in Tokyo and the tallest skyscraper in the Japanese capital, it stands 325.2 meters tall with 64 floors. The tower features an elegant glass facade with rounded corners, resembling flower petals when viewed from above. It is designed to withstand major earthquakes thanks to state-of-the-art damping technologies. The lower floors house numerous shops, restaurants, and a medical center. The middle floors contain many high-end offices occupied by international companies. The upper floors comprise the Aman Residences, some of the world's most exclusive and expensive private residences, offering ultra-luxury services.
The other two towers are Azabudai Hills Residence A and Azabudai Hills Residence B. These two skyscrapers measure 237.2 and 262.8 meters in height, respectively.

title: Azabudai Hills

title: Bee Miraculous
text:
Bee Miraculous - Intro
The  is a hair comb that, whenever Pollen inhabits it, transforms the wearer into a bee-themed superhero with the power of Action.
To activate the comb, the user must speak the transformation phrase: "Buzz On". To deactivate the comb, the user must speak the detransformation phrase: "Buzz Off".
The hair comb is currently owned by Zoé Lee, who uses it to transform into Vesperia. It was previously stored in the Chinese Miracle Box and only lent to her when the situation required it. But, as of "Re-creation", she now posseses the Miraculous permanently. As of "Grendiaper", Zoé also secretly uses the Miraculous to transform into Fury, a vigilante who enacts punitive "justice" however she sees fit.
Previously, it was temporarily lent to Chloé Bourgeois who used it to transform into Queen Bee, but she was permanently stripped of the Miraculous after becoming a traitor and joining Hawk Moth.

title: Bee Miraculous
text:
Bee Miraculous - Appearance
In its charged mode, the hair comb is golden with an arch on top and nine teeth. One side of the hair comb has the design of a bee; the head and thorax are made of a larger and smaller black gemstone, respectively. The abdomen is represented by a section with seven stripes: four yellow and three black alternating stripes. Four pearly white wings stretch out to make the arch with alternating lines forming veins and sections that resemble a bee's wings. If a minor uses the Miraculous and activates Venom, the hair comb starts losing power. It beeps, then the black stripes and gemstones start discoloring as an indication (one stripe is equivalent to one minute) Zoé (or another bee miraculous holder) has left before they de-transform.
In Season 6 onwards, the comb retains its golden base and general shape, but the prongs are now two sharp forks that extend upward like bee antennae. The center maintains the bee shape with the head and thorax formed from four shiny black gems, and the abdomen formed with four alternating yellow and black stripes, now more defined and symmetrical. The wings are a translucent pearly white, and their veins are finer and more delicate.

title: Bee Miraculous
text:
Bee Miraculous - Appearance
In its activated mode, the body and teeth of the comb are pure yellow while the wings are pure white.
In its camouflage mode, the hair comb changes its appearance depending on the person currently holding it:
In the possession of Zoé Lee, the body of the comb is yellow with pink segments, with pink wings, and light blue edges while the teeth are pink. It represented the colors from her flower on her shirt. The design is also more geometric, matching the pattern on her shirt.
In Season 6 onwards, it changes to three hexagons with pink edges forming a bee, two of the hexagons are completely light blue, while the middle hexagon is light blue with two pink segments, and the two sharp forks turned pink.
When it was worn by Gabriel Agreste, it was a silver inverted "V" shaped piece.
When it was worn by Marinette Dupain-Cheng, it was light and shiny rose gold.
When it was worn by Chloé Bourgeois, it was completely metallic gray.
As an akumatized object, the yellow and black are inverted and the wings take on a darker shade,
When it was scarlet akumatized, it gains a reddish color.

title: Bee Miraculous
text:
Bee Miraculous - Appearance
In its reforged ring form, it was a thick band with a circle surface, similar to the Cat Miraculous, inside of it was the symbol of the Bee Miraculous which glowed yellow. It used to sit on the middle finger of Gabriel's left hand.

title: Bee Miraculous
text:
Bee Miraculous - Abilities
The Bee Miraculous has the ability to transform its wielder into a bee-themed superhero, granting its wielder incredible superhuman powers of speed, endurance, agility, stamina and strength. It also makes the user nearly invulnerable.
Its special weapon is an unbreakable Spinning Top, which can be also be utilized as both a weapon, a communicator, a method of transportation and an object that can be used to breathe underwater. Its special superpower is named Venom, which gives the user the ability to instantly paralyze the target for an indeterminate amount of time in order to obtain their goal, like defeating a villain. As long as the superpower isn't used by a minor, the wielder can remain transformed indefinitely. However, as soon as the superpower is used, the wielder loses power and the transformation wears off in about approximately five minutes. The hair comb also has the ability to give the wielder the costume they truly desire or also which matches their mood, as shown in "Grendiaper", where it unexpectedly gives Zoé a darker costume reflecting her anger towards all the injustice she saw that day.

title: Bee Miraculous
text:
Bee Miraculous - History
Five thousand years ago, a mage successfully helped the kwamis to interact with humans by creating magic jewels, which were called Miraculouses. In order to repay the mage, and to live on the physical world alongside humans, the kwamis decided to help humanity by letting humans utilize their energy and powers through the Miraculous they were bonded with, which included Pollen and the Bee Miraculous.
At some point in time, all of the knowledge about the Miraculouses and their powers was written down in code in a book called the Grimoire, with very few people knowing how to decipher the code. Miracle Boxes were also created at an unknown time to store the dormant Miraculouses. To protect and distribute Miraculouses, the Order of the Guardians was formed and existed for many years. Throughout its existence, guardians trained younger generations to keep a watchful eye over the Miraculouses and the Grimoire, which were placed in the guardians' temple.
Many Bee holders throughout history used Pollen's power for good, like Mìfēng in China, who started the legacy.

title: Bee Miraculous
text:
Bee Miraculous - History
172 years ago, after an disastrous event where a young Wang Fu used the Peacock Miraculous to create a sentimonster and his negative emotions and imaturity led to the creature rampaging through the temple and eating and destroying everything in its path, Fu was entrusted with the Chinese Miracle Box (which included the Bee Miraculous) by a monk and was told to run away from the mess. However, on the mountain range outside the temple, in order to escape from the the monster, Fu jumped over a fissure on the ground - accidently opening the Box and spilling all of its contents on the snow. Due to his distress, Fu didnt notice he accidently left both the Peacock and the Butterfly on the mountain, alongisde the Grimoire, until it was too late and he was too far away to come back. Somewhere along the line, the Peacock got dangerously damaged, to the point of being improper for use - but, as it turns out, no one knew of this fact until it was too late.

title: Bee Miraculous
text:
Bee Miraculous - History
On a previous trip overseas with the Agrestes, Nathalie found the Butterfly and Peacock Miraculouses and gave the jewels to Gabriel. In "Representation", it was revealed that neither the Agrestes nor the Graham de Vanily couples could bear children on their own, so Émilie and Colt used the Peacock Miraculous to create Adrien and Félix respectively, but in doing so, they grew sick over time and were eventually left in a condition where they fell into an eternal slumber due to using the Peacock Miraculous in its damaged state.

title: Bee Miraculous
text:
Bee Miraculous - History
Desperate to fix his mistake, Gabriel Agreste began using the Butterfly Miraculous for evil to obtain the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses in order to gain access to their absolute power, becoming the supervillain Hawk Moth, later Shadow Moth (when unified with a now fixed Peacock Miraculous), and finally Monarch. This decision proved one of the most significant for the history of the series, as Gabriel began utilizing Nooroo's power to akumatize the civilians of Paris, France, trying to get one of them to draw out the current holders of the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses, unintenionally helping start off Marinette's and Adrien's journeys as Ladybug and Cat Noir, and later, the rest of the Miraculers.

title: Bee Miraculous
text:
Bee Miraculous - History
One of the members of the Miraculers was Chloé Bourgeois, who found the Bee Miraculous after it was lost by Ladybug in "Style Queen" due to a mishap. Chloé then decided to use it to become Queen Bee, wanting the fame and glory that came from being a superhero - but proving to be inadequate for the job as she revealed her secret identity on live TV and caused a crisis on the Metro on purpose to receive adulation from the public, causing her to be scolded by Ladybug and Cat Noir and was forced to give the Miraculous back in "Queen Wasp".
In "Malediktator", however, Ladybug decided to give Chloé another chance, and, from season 2-3, she became a member of the team, helping Ladybug and Cat Noir during "particularly difficult missions". Chloé was a temporary holder, meaning she would only receive the Miraculous from Ladybug when she was needed for the mission, and had to give it back after the crisis was solved. But, out of anger of not always been picked for all the missions, she betrayed the team in "Miracle Queen" and allied herself with Hawk Moth - this caused her banishment from the team and for the Bee Miraculous to be forcefully stripped from her, making Queen Bee no more.

title: Bee Miraculous
text:
Bee Miraculous - History
After the Bee Miraculous was left without a wielder, Ladybug would later entrust it to Zoé Lee in "Queen Banana", who would then use the Miraculous to become Vesperia. She used the Bee in the same temporary way her predecessor did from this episode all the way into "Strikeback".
Félix, after finding out about his true origins as a sentihuman and learning that the Peacock Miraculous could erase his and his cousin's lifes if it feel into the wrong hands, orchestrated a plan to capture all of the Miraculouses of the Chinese Box from Ladybug and traded all of them (besides the Ladybug and the Cat) for the Peacock, which included the Bee Miraculous, succeeding in "Strikeback". When Gabriel unified it with the Butterfly and other miraculouses, he became Monarch.

title: Bee Miraculous
text:
Bee Miraculous - History
In "Destruction", Gabriel used a laser machine to melt down the Miraculous into a pile of dust, and then reforged it into a special Alliance ring for transferring Pollen's power of Action to any akumatized villain who wore a regular Alliance ring. In "Re-creation", Marinette Dupain-Cheng manages to recover all of the Miraculous that were previously stolen. In "Miraculous London", Lila stole all of the Miraculous under Marinette's care in an alternate timeline, which included the Bee Miraculous, in order to render her truly powerless and to fuse the Ladybug and the Cat to gain her wish without her interference, but her plan was ultimately thwarted by the combined efforts of Chronobug and Bunnyx, and the event was erased from the timeline.

title: Bee Miraculous
text:
Bee Miraculous - History
After the events of "Miraculous London", Marinette, having realized both instances of all of the Miraculouses being stolen happened because all of them were kept in the same place, and with the idea that centralized power is inherently flawed, and that distributing it among members of a society is a far superior idea, restored and upgraded the Bee Miraculous by redesigning its original design and adding the Miraculous Call: a call feature that grants the holder the ability to summon other superheroes who possess a Miraculous from the Chinese Miracle Box in order to receive aid on their missions. This new feature is particularly useful, as the new holder of the Butterfly Miraculous, Chrysalis, is even more fearsome than her predecessor. After the alterations, the Bee Miraculous was given back to Zoé permanently - putting Vesperia back on the map.
In "Grendiaper", Zoé, after being fed up with all the injustice around her and feeling unable to do anything, be as Zoé or Vesperia, decided to don a new persona: Fury, using the Bee Miraculous to create a black wasp-themed vigilante who would enact punitive "justice" with her own hands in secret.

title: Bee Miraculous
text:
Bee Miraculous - Trivia
Bees symbolize beauty, productivity, and growth.
In "Style Queen", Ladybug says that the Bee Miraculous is the Miraculous of Subjection, although this was later retconned.
According to Thomas Astruc, the production thought that it was too complicated, so it was changed to Action.
The Miraculous being a hair comb is a pun on honeycombs.
At the end of the seasons 1-3 theme song, the Bee Miraculous briefly appears in the Miracle Box.
It was revealed at the Miraculous Ladybug San Diego Comic-Con 2016 panel that there would be a bee-themed superhero in Season 2.
The bee-themed superhero was later revealed to be Chloé Bourgeois.
Ladybug had originally planned to give the Bee Miraculous to Alya Césaire in "Style Queen", but Alya is turned into a golden statue by Style Queen before she can receive it.
The Bee Miraculous's model was changed between "Style Queen" and "Queen Wasp".
Like the Ladybug and Cat Miraculous, the legacy of the Bee dates back to Ancient China and is over 5000 years old.
In "Optigami", Marinette unifies the Bee Miraculous with the Ladybug Miraculous and temporarily becomes Lady Bee.
The Bee Miraculous is the first Miraculous to be an Akumatized object.

title: Bee Miraculous
text:
Bee Miraculous - Trivia
It's the third Miraculous to be destroyed and restored afterwards, following the Cat Miraculous and Rabbit Miraculous (past version) in "Timebreaker".
It's the fourth Miraculous used for evil, even if briefly, following the Butterfly Miraculous, the Peacock Miraculous and the Cat Miraculous (only in the alternate future in "Cat Blanc" and briefly in an alternative timeline in "Ephemeral" by Shadow Noir).
In the Brazilian Portuguese dub of "Queen Wasp", its transformation phrase is "Hora do Show", however, starting from "Malediktator", it's changed to  "Ativar". Later, in "Party Crasher", "Hora do Show" turns out to be the transformation phrase of the Monkey Miraculous.

title: Bob Roth
text:
Bob Roth - Intro
Robert "Bob" Roth is a supporting antagonist of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He is Jagged Stone's former producer and the owner of Bob Roth Records. He is also the father of singer XY.
In "Ephemeral", after he lost a penny, Bob was akumatized offscreen by Shadow Moth into Moolak, a golden safe supervillain.
In "Migration", after realizing Luka was Jagged Stone's son, he tricked the Kitty Section into signing a contract with him, then firing everyone except Luka, now referring him as "Jagged Jr". However, when Luka refused to be part of Bob Roth Records after he was nearly reakumatized, Bob was akumatized by Monarch into Gold Record, a golden supervillain with the power to turn anyone into an LP record with his golden record, and was given the power of the Horse Miraculous through his Alliance ring. After his deakumatization, he refused to take the Magical Charm from Ladybug.

title: Bob Roth
text:
Bob Roth - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Bob is tall and somewhat overweight with light gray receding hair, a gray mustache, tan skin, and moderate spring-bud eyes.
From season 6 onwards, his hair and mustache are darker.
Civilian Attire
He wears white dress pants and a white dress jacket over a pink shirt with gray buttons. His dress shoes are reddish brown with medium gray tips. He also wears moderate spring-bud sunglasses with black rims on his head, a thick gold necklace around his neck, and a gold ring with a red ruby jewel on the middle finger on his right hand.
From season 6 onwards, his shirt buttons become yellow.
As Moolak
Moolak kept himself inside a big cube-shaped safe made of gold with lasers at each vertice at all times. His body appeared to be made of gold. However, because he was always seen covered in gold coins, only his face could be seen.
As Gold Record
Gold Record's appearance was similar to his civilian outfit, except his body and clothes were completely gold, his hair was longer and his belt had a star in the middle. He was also wearing his sunglasses (which are more round) in front of his eyes instead of on his head.

title: Bob Roth
text:
Bob Roth - Personality
Bob is very arrogant and greedy, only caring about money and fame, as shown in "Guitar Villain" when he asks Jagged Stone to change his style to match that of XY, in order to sell more albums. He'll be dishonest in order to get his way, lying to Marinette when he asks her to create Jagged Stone's new album cover, which Jagged Stone requested, and tells her to base it off of the previous cover test design that is similar to the style of XY's promotional artwork. However, while begrudgingly, he does back down if he is threatened, not wanting to lose Jagged Stone's sales or deal with the wrath of his pet crocodile, Fang. It seems to work for him, as he is very wealthy. He is also very famous; his statue is even in the museum in "The Puppeteer 2".

title: Bob Roth
text:
Bob Roth - Personality
In "Silencer", he is shown to be cowardly hiding behind Marinette when being threatened by the titular villain or when he used Ladybug as a shield to defend himself against Silencer at the cost of the heroine losing her voice. His dishonesty also continues when he refuses to admit that he stole everything from Kitty Section and isn't afraid to blackmail others to get them out of his way, meaning that he is also pushy and forceful towards others to do their job like with Ladybug. Once out of danger, he is also boastful which led to him carelessly revealing the truth on live television.
Also in the aforementioned episode, he is a father who spoils his son XY whom he indulges and has never taught XY any morals or ethics as he always allows his son to steal other singers' ideas. In "Illusion", Bob was seen even promoting his son's career in times that was not appropriated, how he interrupted Alec's well-exposed observation regarding the current threat of Monarch and how people should act to better support their heroes just to promote his son's new CD.

title: Bob Roth
text:
Bob Roth - Personality
In "Migration", it is seen how far Bob is willing to go and how many lines he is willing to cross to make money. After he learns that Luka is Jagged's son, he tries to do everything he can to have the boy work for him, knowing he would be a great sensation like his father. To that end, he insists on having Luka and the rest of the Kitty Sections to sign a contract with him (not even realizing he had already promised them a contract some months earlier). However, as soon he manages to convince them to sign a contract, he immediately fires all members of the band, except for Luka, taking ownership of everything belonging to them (their name, their songs, their lyrics, Marinette's creations for the band, etc.) and everything they might create in the future, basically preventing them from forming any other band together.

title: Bob Roth
text:
Bob Roth - Personality
As Moolak, his greed was increased immensely, as his purpose was to turn any person he encountered into gold coins he then greedily kept inside his safe with him. His greed also caused him to get interested on the Miraculouses, wondering if they were valuable for Shadow Moth wanting them so much, only giving up on them when the latter threatened to take away his powers.
As Gold Record, he was very persistent on capturing Luka so he could work for him and make him even richer. However, his obsession in pursuing Luka was his own undoing, as Ladybug used Luka as bait to take his akumatized object and release the megakuma inside. He had distaste towards Rose, Anarka and Juleka's music, despite the fact they were amazing songs, sending their records into outer space. Despite that, he liked the Rubber Ducky's record song, sending it to his office.

title: Bob Roth
text:
Bob Roth - Abilities
As a Civilian
Bob is a savvy businessman. He is also a very good manipulator as seen in "Guitar Villain", where he tells Marinette to make Jagged Stone's new album to be modern like as opposed to what Jagged Stone really wants.
As Moolak
He was hidden inside an impenetrable flying safe. The bulbs on the corners of the safe could shoot lasers that transformed people into gold coins that were collected inside the safe. Once in the safe, the coins took up too much room for the Horse Miraculous user to teleport inside.
The code to open the safe was 0099.
As Gold Record

title: Bob Roth
text:
Bob Roth - Abilities
Gold Record could throw his golden record at his target, transforming them into LP records which sang the deepest feelings and secrets of said person. He could also use this power on animals like pigeons or even inanimate objects like a rubber duck or a wall, which still "sang" but are unintelligible. Gold Record also received from Monarch the power of Voyage, the superpower of the Horse Miraculous, through his Alliance ring. With it, he could teleport anything or himself to certain locations, using it to swiftly evade attacks, make surprise attacks or use it in conjuntion of his golden record. He would also use it to teleport the LP records he turned people into, either to the wall of his office (for the LP records he considered to be a hit) or into space (for the LP records he considered to be trash).

title: Bob Roth
text:
Bob Roth - Relationships
Family
XY
Bob is fond of XY's style and constantly tries to encourage Jagged to change his style to be more like his.
In "Silencer", it is revealed that Bob and XY are father and son, respectively. The two get along quite well as they are both fond of stealing others' ideas to achieve success. This connotes that he doesn't teach his son anything about morals and ethics in entertainment business. Despite this, it’s revealed that he has a low opinion on his own son who is being talentless about coming out to make a original idea of music.
Enemies
Jagged Stone
Though Bob is Jagged Stone's producer, the two do not get along very well. Bob is always trying to pressure him into changing his style into something more modern like XY, something Jagged is completely against. He also threatens to drop Jagged from his record label if his album doesn't hit #1 on the charts.
In "Migration", their relationship have become so much worse to the point Jagged, after being inspired by Luka's own actions in refusing to work for Bob, decided to cut ties with the latter and end their contract for good.
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/Ladybug

title: Bob Roth
text:
Bob Roth - Relationships
Bob first encounters Marinette in "Guitar Villain" when he offers her a chance to design Jagged Stone's new album cover, though he lies to her and says that Jagged is changing his style in order to ensure that she makes an album cover like XY's. In "Troublemaker", he is fine with filming Jagged Stone in her parents' bakery. However, in "Silencer", he has no qualms about stealing her costume ideas for XY. When Marinette confronts him about this and decides to tell the truth on live TV, Bob threatens to ruin her reputation if she does so, reminding her that people wouldn't believe her anyway.
Regarding Ladybug, he doesn't appear to be grateful for her heroic actions and even pushes her in front of him just so his voice won't be stolen (causing her to lose her voice), as shown in "Silencer".
In "Migration", when Ladybug tries to give Bob her Magical Charm after de-akumatizing him, he rejects it and continues to try to exploit Luka for profit. He also ineffectually attempts to use Ladybug and Cat Noir to protect him from Anarka.
Luka Couffaine

title: Bob Roth
text:
Bob Roth - Relationships
When Luka, along with Marinette, confronts Bob about him for plagiarizing Kitty Section's idea, Bob dismisses his claims and threatens Marinette in front of him, angering him so much that he gets akumatized.
In "Migration", after learning Luka was Jagged's son, Bob became obsessed in having the boy work for him, going as far to trick him and his band to sign an abusive contract that gives to Bob the ownership over everything belonging to the Kitty Sections (like their name, music and everything Marinette created for them) along with everything they might create, all while firing every member of the band except for Luka, believing that the mere prospect of becoming rich and famous would convince him to work for him despite how he tricked him and his friends. However, after Luka is able to resist an akumatization attempt by Monarch by breaking his guitar, Luka declares to Bob that, if silence is the only way for him to avoid their contract, then he will never play again, something that angers Bob very much, leading to his akumatization.

title: Bob Roth
text:
Bob Roth - Relationships
As Gold Record, he became obsessed with pursuing Luka and turn him into a record so he could use the boy's music to make more money. That obsession ended up being his undoing, as Ladybug used Luka as bait to get his akumatized object and later is once again told off by Luka that he will not create music for him.
Caroline
TBA

title: Bob Roth
text:
Bob Roth - Etymology
Moolak's name is derived from "moolah", which is a slang term for money.
His French villain name Pognak, comes from a pun between "pognon", which means "money" and "niaque", which means combativeness, biting.

title: Bob Roth
text:
Bob Roth - Trivia
Similar to Robostus and Feast, Bob Roth, as Moolak, has shown an interest in the Miraculouses, appearing to want to keep them for himself, after wondering if they were valuable. However, unlike them, he quickly gave up on the idea after being threatened by Shadow Moth to have his powers removed.
He currently holds the record for facing the 2nd highest number of most Miraculous holders, with facing 10 Miraculous holders, which is all the holders on the The Miraculers except for Cat Noir, Rena Rouge, Bunnyx, Miss Hound, Rooster Bold, Caprikid, Minotaurox and Argos, and is behind Penalteam, who faced 15 Miraculous holders.
In "Migration", Bob Roth is the second person to not want a Magical Charm, following Chloé Bourgeois and preceding Kagami Tsurugi.
Unlike Chloé and Kagami, Bob is the only character who couldn't be persuaded (or tricked) to keep his Magical Charm.
