title: Befana
text:
Befana - Intro
"" is a season 2 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 8th written and produced episode of season 2. It is also the 34th written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Befana
text:
Befana - Synopsis
Netflix
When Marinette elects to hang out with her friends on her birthday instead of her grandmother, grandma is akumatized into a candy-gun-wielding baddie.
Disney Channel
Marinette's grandmother gets akumatized to Befana. Armed with a pistol, she wants to turn her into coal statue by revenge on Marinette for lying to her.
Disney+
Ladybug faces her own grandmother, now Befana... who wants to teach her good manners!

title: Befana
text:
Befana - Plot
It's Marinette's birthday! To celebrate, Tikki creates a special charm called a Kwagatama to give as a birthday gift. She tells Marinette that kwamis have given their holders gifts for years and is happy to be her kwami, but Marinette is distracted. Tikki is hurt that Marinette wasn't paying attention and believes that she doesn't like the gift, but Marinette apologizes and quickly explains that she was thinking about a surprise party her classmates were planning. Marinette tells Tikki about the different things she's seen around the school (Juleka holding a bike pump at school, Nino listening to her favorite song, Adrien and Alya are whispering and act nervous when she arrives) and tells her that she believes Alya's story about having to go to the dentist is just code for a surprise party. To verify this, she asks her parents, and their guilty and nervous response confirms her suspicion. Elated that her classmates would do something so nice, Marinette rushes to the door to greet them when she hears the doorbell ring.
However, much to her and her parents' surprise, it is her grandmother Gina.
Gina greets Marinette and gives her a shirt as a birthday gift.

title: Befana
text:
Befana - Plot
However, the shirt is for a much smaller child.
She also gives Marinette the candy that she used to like as a child.
Tom and Sabine try to convince Gina that Marinette is old enough to like new things, but Gina rebuffs her son and insists that they will have fun.
Gina and Marinette leave on her motorcycle.
Grandmother Gina takes Marinette to the park and to the zoo, still under the impression that Marinette is a small child.
Meanwhile, Marinette worries that she was wrong about the party.
She doesn't like the candy Gina gave her but is too polite to tell her so.
Then Alya calls Marinette and asks her to come to "the dentist".
Marinette is overjoyed that the party is still on and asks her grandmother if she can go.
The two of them have a misunderstanding, and Gina thinks that Marinette is just making excuses to get out of their day.
She returns home depressed.
Sabine tells Tom to talk to her, but he accidentally destroyed Marinette's birthday cake.
The two of them work to make a cake so the party will be saved and forget about Gina.
Meanwhile, Gina discovers that Marinette was lying about eating the candy she'd given her.

title: Befana
text:
Befana - Plot
Hawk Moth senses her negative emotions and sends an Akuma, which enters the candy tin.
He gives her the ability to "punish the bad and reward the good" and akumatizes her into Befana.
Befana goes downstairs and turns Tom, who had tried to correct her, into coal.
When Sabine objects, Befana tells her that she has always been sweet and turns her into a fairy.
Befana commands Sabine to take her to Marinette.
Marinette is having a wonderful time at her party and has just received a gift from Adrien when Befana attacks.
Befana refuses to listen to her excuses and tries to turn her into coal.
Instead, the shot hits Mylène.
Adrien manages to get away and transform into Cat Noir.
Befana's shot hits Adrien's gift, and she comments that Marinette doesn't deserve presents.
Cat Noir confronts Befana, telling her that he likes that she wears black.
She offers to help him wear white, as one of her fairies, but he rejects the offer, saying black brings out the green in his eyes.
Befana sets Sabine on Cat Noir and continues to attack Marinette.
Marinette is unable to transform and is in danger of being turned into coal.
Alya and the other kids decide to rescue her themselves.

title: Befana
text:
Befana - Plot
Alya begins to throw dishes at Befana and is turned into coal.
Then Kim tries to grab Befana's gun and is also changed.
She orders the children to stand back, but Rose cries for her to leave Marinette alone, telling her that she was the sweetest girl in the world.
Though Befana is annoyed that Rose spoke without permission, she thinks that Rose was sweet to defend her friend and turns her into a fairy.
Marinette attempts to transform but is interrupted by Cat Noir, who carries her off. Befana sends Rose and Sabine to attack them, but the remaining children lasso them with banners and try to stop them. Befana turns the remaining children into coal and heads off to get revenge on Marinette. Cat Noir takes Marinette to the Eiffel Tower and goes back to face Befana after wishing her a happy birthday. Marinette takes the moment of solitude to transform.
Meanwhile, Befana goes throughout the town turning "bad" people into coal and "good" people into fairies.
She is knocked off her bike in the midst of her song by Cat Noir, who makes up his own song.
The song is finished by Ladybug, who arrives on the scene.

title: Befana
text:
Befana - Plot
Hawk Moth orders Befana to attack them, but Befana tells him to say the magic word, which he replies to with a "please." However, she decides to get Marinette first and heads off to the Eiffel Tower.
Panicked, Cat Noir follows her, saying that he left the girl there.
Ladybug almost tells him that she was fine by accident and follows him.
Cat Noir tries to take control of Befana's cycle but is knocked off the bike and has to be rescued by Ladybug.
Befana tries to turn Ladybug into an angel, saying she'd make a perfect minion, but Ladybug avoids the blast and manages to get onto the tower.
Befana is angry that she rejected her "gift" and has her angels attack her.
While the angels attack Cat Noir, Ladybug is chased up the tower by Befana, who fires on her.
She fires straight into the air, and Ladybug manages to duck out of the way.
The projectiles are pulled down by gravity and almost hit Befana, who is afraid of her own attack.
Befana avoids the shots.
She tries to shoot Ladybug but has to refill her gun.
Ladybug tells Cat Noir that Befana is vulnerable to her own bullets.
He comments that the akuma is probably in the candy tin.
Ladybug uses Lucky Charm and gets a tuba.

title: Befana
text:
Befana - Plot
Before they can use it, Befana's attack turns the ground under them into coal, and her angels push them through to the floor below.
Surrounded by the angels, Ladybug and Cat Noir try to think of a way out as Befana moves forward.
Ladybug notices the water main and discovers how she should use the tuba.
To buy time, she surrenders and tells Cat Noir to show Befana where Marinette was.
Befana puts off taking his Miraculous until she gets her granddaughter and tells the angels to guard Ladybug.
However, Ladybug manages to tie them up with a fire hose.
Nervous that he might accidentally betray Marinette, Cat Noir shows Befana a closet.
He is relieved when Marinette isn't there.
Befana accuses him of lying again, but before she attacks him, she hears the elevator go down and runs to meet it, thinking Marinette was in it.
Instead, inside are her fairies, tied with the hose.
Ladybug reassures Cat Noir that Marinette is safe and tells him to use his Cataclysm on the fire hydrant.
She puts the tuba over the stream of water, and the water is redirected towards Befana.
Befana tries to get away from the stream of water and shoots it with her gun, however, the water has covered her.

title: Befana
text:
Befana - Plot
The tuba, the water, and Befana are all turned into coal.
Ladybug breaks the candy tin, captures the akuma, and uses Miraculous Ladybug to set things right.
Hawk Moth promises that he will punish Ladybug and Cat Noir one day.
Back at the party, Gina flirts with André before Marinette pulls her aside to show her the bag cover she created with Gina's gift. Gina comments that Marinette has learned a lot since Gina's last visit, and Gina tells Marinette that for her next birthday, her gift will be a trip. Marinette thanks Gina but tells her that the gift wasn't important; the giver was. Sabine and Tom approach with the cake, and Kim and Ivan hold Marinette up to blow out the candles. Then Adrien gives her his gift again: a charm bracelet like the one she gave him in "Gamer". Marinette struggles to thank him, and her family enjoys watching her be happy.

title: Befana
text:
Befana - Plot
As the party goes on, Marinette and Tikki talk about Adrien's gift. Marinette was happy that he made it himself, but Tikki called it strange. Marinette said Tikki’s gift was stranger, which angers her, but Marinette then reveals that she was wearing it as a charm necklace around her neck. She said that it was just as precious, saying that the gift itself didn't matter, but the person giving it. The episode ends with Adrien looking happily at the bracelet Marinette gave him.

title: Befana
text:
Befana - Plot Developments
This episode features Marinette's birthday. Tom confirms that Marinette turns 14 in this episode.
It's revealed that on special occasions active kwamis make a special object for their owners called a Kwagatama.
A flashback to the events of this episode is seen in "Ladybug", where Adrien is shown making the charm bracelet and getting permission from his father to go to Marinette's party.
It is also revealed that Lila Rossi was secretly watching Marinette's party unfold from her apartment.
When Marinette mentioned seeing Juleka with an air pump, Tikki suggests that Juleka has a bike, which is revealed to be true in "Oni-Chan".
When Befana mentions, "What does a cat do when it feels threatened?" and answers it, she is referring to one of a cat's most common behavioral patterns and instincts.
Her saying, "You'll look beautiful in white my pretty kitty" foreshadowing Cat Noir's akumatization in "Cat Blanc".
Cat Noir saying: "I'm much more into black- makes my eyes stand out, don't you think?", is similar to one of the compliments Lady Noire says to Mister Bug in "Passion".

title: Befana
text:
Befana - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in France on TFOU.
Chloé and Sabrina are the only students in Marinette's class who do not attend the party.
In the webisode "My Birthday Party", Marinette notes she wouldn't invite them to her birthday party.
After Sabrina ended her friendship with Chloé in "Confrontation" and forgave everyone in "Daddycop," she was invited for the first time to a party by one of her friends in "The Dark Castle."
This is the second time a character sings outside of a performance or recording, following "Princess Fragrance".
The song Befana sings throughout the episode is "La donna è mobile".
In the Thai dub, Befana, Cat Noir and Ladybug's song is translated, unlike the other songs in the show.
References
Marinette celebrates her birthday in this episode. Other characters who have celebrated their birthdays in previous episodes include Adrien in "The Bubbler", Alix in "Timebreaker" and Nathaniel in "The Evillustrator".
Adrien gives Marinette a charm bracelet that is similar to the one she gave him in "Gamer".
Allusions

title: Befana
text:
Befana - Trivia
The design of the t-shirt Gina gave to Marinette for her birthday appears to be inspired by Inuit artist Kenojuak Ashevak. More specifically, it appears to resemble Ashevak's Illustrious Owl and Preening Owl.
When Befana tells Hawk Moth "You didn't say the magic word," he replies "Please," an exchange from the movie Jurassic Park.
Errors
In the scene where Gina is buying ice-cream at Marinette's birthday party, Alix’s hair is black.
In the scene where Marinette's parents are holding the birthday cake, Alya's hair appears to be miscolored blonde at the top, turning into a light orange color on the bottom.
In the scene where Gina rebuffs Tom at the bakery, her necklace disappears for a frame.
When Befana is riding her motorcycle, there were originally five fairies who can be seen flying around her. But a few scenes after, only four are in the shot. The missing fairy is absent for the remainder of the episode.
When Ladybug summons her Lucky Charm, Cat Noir calls it a tuba. However the Lucky Charm is a bit smaller than a tuba, therefore making it a euphonium.
Sabine's hair is miscolored into dark tones.

When activating his Cataclysm Cat Noir says it a few seconds early yet it doesn't have it on his hand.
After Ladybug comes up with a plan to defeat Befana, her earrings appear empty and have no spots.

title: Befana/Transcript
text:
Befana/Transcript - Intro
[ Theme Song ]
Tikki: Marinette, this is quite a special day for you!
Marinette: Yes, Tikki! It sure is. Hmm, still no call...
Tikki: There's a ritual we kwamis perform on a day like this.
Marinette: (distracted) Oh really? That's nice.
Tikki: But I don't know if you humans would like it. I wonder if you guys even give each other presents on your birthday.
Marinette: (She looks surprised) Oh really, Tikki? You got me a birthday present?
Tikki: A kwami specialty.
Marinette: Oh, that so awesome! What is it?
Tikki: (Tikki does a small dance in the air while humming, then spits something into Marinette's hands) Miraculous birthday, Marinette!
(Marinette looks shocked and slightly disgusted)
Tikki: (crestfallen) Oh no, you don't like it, do you?
Marinette: Yes! Yes, I love it! It's amazing. It's a, uhhh, what is it?

title: Befana/Transcript
text:
Befana/Transcript - Intro
Tikki: A Kwagatama. A great symbol of friendship among us kwamis. We take a hair from our Miraculous holder and join it to the hairs of all the former Miraculous holders. And with them we grow a magic resin for a few months and- (she notices Marinette is on her phone not listening and looks disappointed) I know you don't wanna tell me because you don't want to hurt my feelings but it's obvious you don't like it.
Marinette: I'm sorry, Tikki! I-I really love your gift. It's just that Alya should already have called me by now. We're supposed to be taking her little sister to the (she mimes air quotes) "dentist" (she winks) at four o'clock today.
Tikki: (puzzled) Do you humans always celebrate your birthday by going to the dentist?
Marinette: No, of course not, Tikki. It's a secret code! They're actually throwing me a surprise birthday party!
Tikki: But how can it be a surprise if you know about it?
Marinette: The thing about surprises is you know about it but pretend you don't so you won't spoil it for the people who are organising it!
Tikki: What about the dentist?

title: Befana/Transcript
text:
Befana/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: It's a fake-out! See, Alya's gonna pretend to take me to the dentist, but she'll really be taking me to my surprise party!
Tikki: What if you're wrong?
Marinette: Impossible. All the signs are there, Tikki. (As she talks, the scene she describes is shown) Juleka totally jumped when I caught her holding a bicycle pump. (In the flashback, Juleka stammers wordlessly and Marinette walks off, humming. The flashback ends)
(Tikki and Marinette continue their conversation as they come down from outside)
Tikki: Perhaps Juleka has a bicycle!
Marinette: No, Tikki! Obviously she was planning to use the pump to blow up balloons! A surprise birthday party always has balloons! Also, yesterday (again the scene she describes plays as she talks, Marinette is sitting beside Nino on a bench to listen to his headphones) I caught Nino listening to my favourite song! (the flashback ends)
Tikki: Perhaps it's his favorite song, too!
Marinette: Are you kidding? He hates it! He has no reason to listen to it unless... He's making a playlist for my surprise party! Elementary.
(Tikki gives Marinette a sceptical look and a third scene plays as Marinette describes it)

title: Befana/Transcript
text:
Befana/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Okay. Why was Alya having a secret convo with Adrien, huh?
(Adrien and Alya see Marinette then they continue their conversation)
Adrien: (loudly, in the flashback) Uh, uh... yes, Alya! I know a very good dentist and here's his number! (he holds out a paper to Alya and the flashback ends)
Marinette: Which means... He's going to be there!
Tikki: Or it means Alya is taking her sisters to see Adrien's dentist!
Marinette: Fine, you know what? There's one no-fail way to find out if there's a surprise party in the making.
Marinette: (in a whisper to Tikki) Watch their faces. (she flings open the door) Mom! Dad! Do you know anything about Alya planning a surprise party for my birthday?
(Her parents freeze in place, in the middle of decorating a large cake. Tom immediately hides the cake in the garbage and sits on the lid while Sabine leans on the counter)
Tom: Uh, oh, uh... Party? Uh, what party? Uh, which Alya, again?
Sabine: (aside to her husband) You're overdoing it... we're talking about her best friend!
Tom: Alya! Of course, Alya! We haven't seen her in years! (nervously laughs)
Sabine: (sighs)

title: Befana/Transcript
text:
Befana/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (to Tikki) See? Parents always know when there's a surprise party in the works.
(the doorbell rings)
Marinette: And now, on the other side of this door, check out who's coming to get me! Just in time for the party! It's- (she opens the door) Grandma?!
Tom: (sticking his head around the corner) Mom?
Sabine: (likewise sticking her head around the corner) Gina?
(Marinette laughs in delight and hugs her grandmother, Gina Bianchi)
Gina: (pushing up her sunglasses and speaking with an Italian accent) Marinetta! You're so tall for your age! Did you get my letter from Patagonia?
Marinette: Yes! And the ones from Australia, Bali, and Estonia, too! Did you really get chased by a bear?!
Gina: (laughs) Yes. But we wound up good friends in the end.
Tom: (whispering) Mom. It's her birthday, remember?
Gina: Why do you think I'm here? (she gives Marinette a package from inside her motorcycle helmet) Happy birthday, my little fairy! My Inuit friend knitted it especially for your tenth birthday!
Tom: (whispering) Uh, she's fourteen.

title: Befana/Transcript
text:
Befana/Transcript - Intro
Gina: (visibly startled) My. How time flies. (Marinette opens the package, and the shirt inside is obviously much too small for her. Gina waves her hand) That's okay. I'll ask my friend to make another one.
Marinette: No! No, it's awesome! I can make this work. It's perfect, grandma. Thank you.
Gina: Your Nonna has also brought you your favourite candy! (she places a tin in Marinette's hand)
Marinette: Oh! (she laughs uncertainly)
Gina: You still love them, right?
Marinette: Yes, yes of course...
Gina: And that's not all, my fairy! We'll have a wonderful day, you and I! Just like the last time. Well go to the merry-go-round and to the zoo, then-!
Tom: Uh, mom? Can I have a word, mom? Uh, just the two of us.
Gina: What, Tom? That I don't know my Marinetta anymore because I'm always travelling?
Tom: No, mom! It's just-
Gina: You think she doesn't want to spend time with her Nonna, is that it?
Marinette: No! Of course I want to spend time with you! Uh, besides, it's not four o'clock yet.
Gina: There. You see? Come on, let's go, Marinetta! We're going to have a ball! (she pulls Marinette out of the house)

title: Befana/Transcript
text:
Befana/Transcript - Intro
(Gina is getting ice cream for her and Marinette, who has been pretending to eat the candies and constantly checking her phone)
Marinette: It's four o'clock. Maybe you were right. I jumped to conclusions, and there really is no surprise party. (she spits out another candy into the wrapper and puts it in the tin)
Tikki: How come you don't tell your grandmother you don't like this candy?
Marinette: I don't want to hurt her feelings. We don't get to see each other very often. (Marinette's phone rings and Marinette yelps in surprise, nearly dropping her phone) Alya!
(Behind Alya, Kim, Nathaniel, and Juleka are attempting to blow up balloons and there are tables set up)
Alya: Sorry, I'm running late. Can you meet me at the park? We'll, uh-(she stops when the balloon Kim is inflating explodes, knocking him back while Nathaniel and Juleka are unfazed. Alya hurriedly continues what she was saying) -jam straight from there to the uh, dentist!
Marinette: Yes, uh, yes! Awesome! To the dentist! Totally! (she giggles) I'll be right there! (she hangs up and turns to find Gina standing there) Oh! Uh- I'm so sorry, Grandma. I have to go to the dentist with Alya-

title: Befana/Transcript
text:
Befana/Transcript - Intro
Gina: Surely you're not going to the dentist on your birthday? I still have to take you to see the trains at Gare de Lyon Station!
Marinette: Well, it's because Alya actually has sisters who are twins and well, because there are two of them, Alya needs my help. (to herself) Wait what am I saying? (to Gina) That's all a fake-out. You know what I think, Grandma, is that Alya might be throwing me a surprise birthday party-
Gina: (obviously saddened) I get it, my fairy. Don't worry about me. Run along now and go meet your friend.
Marinette: Are you sure?
Gina: Go on. I'll hold on to all of this. We'll catch up with each other later.
Marinette: (abruptly hugs Gina tightly) Oh, thank you! (she runs off, leaving Gina on the bridge) You really are the best grandma in the world!
(Tom is putting the candles on the cake when Sabine rushes in)
Sabine: Tom, that's the motorcycle! They're coming back! Marinette can't see the cake!
(Sabine leaves, and Tom picks up the cake in a panic, looking for where to hide it and ends up stuffing it in the garbage again)
Sabine: (to Gina) Uh, where's Marinette?
Gina: Tom was right. She's too old now to spend time with her Nonna...

title: Befana/Transcript
text:
Befana/Transcript - Intro
Sabine: What? No, no! Tom never said that.
Gina: That's sweet of you, Sabine. But it's not a big deal. That's life. I'll be up in the apartment if you need me. (she goes sadly upstairs)
Sabine: (as she walks up to Tom, who is standing gloomily over the trash) You should go and speak to your mother, she's u- (before she can finish, she notices the cake in the garbage) Oh no!
Tom: I know, and it's almost time for the party!
Sabine: Okay, I can help you. We can manage, and we'll take Gina to the party with us! (she and Tom fistbump)
(Alya leads a blindfolded Marinette to her surprise party, and she's delighted, especially to see Adrien smiling and waving to her)
(Gina looks at the tin of Befana sweets she gave Marinette)
(Marinette receives a book from Mylène and hugs her)
(Gina looks sadly at the shirt she got Marinette and then goes to eat one of the candies, discovering that Marinette has not been eating them as she does so. She puts the lid back on)
(The window opens and the butterflies take flight)

title: Befana/Transcript
text:
Befana/Transcript - Intro
Hawk Moth: What could be more powerful than a grandmother deserted by her own granddaughter? Perfect fodder for disappointment and misunderstanding! (a butterfly lands in his open hand and is filled with energy before taking wing) Fly away, my little akuma and evilize her ailing heart!
(The akuma flies out the window and out over Paris)
(The akuma flies in Marinette's open window and lands in  the candy tin)
Hawk Moth: Befana, I am Hawk Moth. I'm restoring your matriarchal power as grandmother. You will use these candies to reward the deserving and punish the ungrateful. As for my reward, you will bring me the Miraculous of those pesky little kids: Ladybug and Cat Noir!
Gina: You're right, Hawk Moth. The time has come to teach them all a lesson! (she transforms into Befana)
(Tom and Sabine are finishing decorating the third cake with sprinkles and strawberries. Sabine is seated on Tom's shoulder to reach the top.)
Sabine: Tada!
Tom: Ha!
Sabine: (pats his chest) Good job, partner! We'd better get going, the party awaits us!
Tom: Oh, wait, we've gotta tell mom.
(Befana flies through the bakery door on her motorcycle)
Befana: Not this time. Don't tell your mama what to do.

title: Befana/Transcript
text:
Befana/Transcript - Intro
(Tom and Sabine are startled)
Tom: Mom-! (he slips on a rolling pin and the third cake lands in the garbage yet again)
Befana: (laughing and waving her candy gun) Do you know what naughty boys get? (she spins the cylinder of her gun and fires it at Tom, turning him to coal) Coal! (she turns to a terrified Sabine, who is cornered by the register) You have nothing to fear, my fairy. (she flicks her wrist to rotate the cylinder of her gun to white) You've always been good to me. (she fires at Sabine, who turns into an angel-like fairy with a white mask) So, now tell me. Marinetta isn't at the dentist, is she?
Sabine: No, mistress.
Befana: Then take me to her!
Adrien: Happy birthday, Marinette.
(Marinette stares, open-mouthed, at the small blue box in her hand until Alya's hand reaches over and closes her mouth)
Alya: Open it, Marinette!
(Marinette giggles but before she can open Adrien's gift, Befana's voice interrupts, startling everyone)
Befana: (she enters, singing "La Donna è Mobile") ♫ La Befana comes at night, on her shaky broom in flight. She gives candy to those who are dandy. ♫ (She then hops off her motorcycle and walks towards Marinette.)
Marinette: Grandma!?

title: Befana/Transcript
text:
Befana/Transcript - Intro
Befana: You lied to your grandma, Marinetta.
(Adrien runs off in the background as Befana is speaking)
Marinette: No, I- I didn't know Alya was throwing a surprise party for me.
Alya: (moving in front of Marinette) She's for real, ma'am.
Befana: And all those candies you pretended to be eating?
Marinette: I'm sorry, grandma. It's just that I didn't want to upset you.
Befana: I'm not your grandma anymore. From now on, I am only Befana! And I'm going to punish you for all those lies! (she tries to shoot Marinette, but Marinette ducks. Mylène is hit instead and turns to coal)
Marinette: No!
(Adrien is hiding behind a tree and lets Plagg out of his outer shirt)
Plagg: We didn't even get in on the buffet!
Adrien: Party's over, my friend!
[Transformation Sequence]
Adrien: Plagg, claws out!(Adrien transforms into Cat Noir)
Befana: It's rude to leave while Befana's still speaking to you. (her gun's aim is knocked away by Cat Noir's staff and she looks over at him)
Cat Noir: (perched on top of a speaker) Hey, I never knew grandmas could be so nasty.

title: Befana/Transcript
text:
Befana/Transcript - Intro
Befana: You would look wonderful in white, my pretty kitty. (she rotates the cylinder of her gun again and fires at Cat Noir, who dodges easily, but barely)
Cat Noir: Eh, not convinced. I'm much more into black- makes my eyes stand out, don't you think? (he dodges more blasts from Befana's gun)
Befana: (to the fairy Sabine) Take care of this pesky pussycat!
(The fairy Sabine flies up to get Cat Noir, who dodges her)
Cat Noir: Hey, I thought fairies were supposed to be nice! (Sabine manages to attack him and they go into the treetops)
Befana: (firing coal shots at Marinette) You're not getting away unpunished, Marinetta! (Marinette trips and drops Adrien's present, which is turned to coal) You don't deserve all these presents, you spoiled little brat! Now, for what you really deserve. (she attempts to fire her gun again, but it is empty, forcing her to reload from the bag at her waist) Don't worry. You'll get what's coming to you.
Marinette: (she crawls quickly under a table) This isn't how I envisioned my birthday party...
Tikki: (as the table turns to coal) You need to transform!
(Marinette gets out and hides again)
Befana: Do you lie only to me?
Marinette: Cat Noir!

title: Befana/Transcript
text:
Befana/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: (still trying to fend off the fairy Sabine) Stay put, I'll be right there! (he is attacked again) Uh, soon!
Befana: (turns Marinette's hiding spot into coal) Or do you also lie to your parents and your friends, too?
Alya: (hiding behind a bush, talking to her classmates) We gotta help Marinette!
Befana: The time has come to teach you a lesson. (a plate hits her and she looks around to see Alya throwing plates at her)
Alya: Marinette is not a liar!
Befana: Someone has to teach you table manners! (She turns Alya to coal)
Marinette: Alya!
(Kim tries to jump Befana and grab her gun, but is turned to coal)
Marinette: No, Kim!
Befana: That's what you get for stealing candy, you bunch of ill-mannered kids!
Rose: Don't touch Marinette! She's only the nicest person in the world!
Befana: That's very disrespectful, to speak up without permission! But then again, it's quite noble of you to stick up for your friends. Okay. I shall make you a fairy. (She turns Rose into another white, angel-like fairy) You are going to help me discipline your friend. (laughs)
Marinette: Tikki, spots-
(behind her, Sabine falls into the trees and Cat Noir drops down in front of her)

title: Befana/Transcript
text:
Befana/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: Sorry I kept you waiting. We need to find you a better hiding place (he winks and holds out his hand for her) Shall we? (he lifts Marinette away with his staff)
Befana: Marinetta is getting away with the kitty! Catch them!

title: Big Ben
text:
Big Ben - Intro
The  is the nickname for the Great Bell of the striking clock at the north end of the Palace of Westminster; the name is frequently extended to refer to both the clock and the clock tower. The tower is physically part of Westminster Palace, the home of the Houses of Parliament.

title: Big Ben
text:
Big Ben - Description
Built to a design by Augustine Pugin and inaugurated in 1859, the Elizabeth Tower is a tower almost 96 meters tall, inspired by the characteristic bell towers of medieval Gothic civil architecture, with some Italian influences. It stands at the northwest corner of the Palace of Westminster.
A symbol of London and England, the tower houses the Great Clock of Westminster. It has four dials, one on each side, seven meters in diameter. Its hands measure 2.7 meters for the hours and 4.2 meters for the minutes, respectively. It contains five bells that ring every fifteen minutes. The largest of these is the Great Bell of Westminster, commonly known as Big Ben, the third heaviest bell in the United Kingdom, weighing 13.8 tons. Big Ben chimes every hour, as well as on New Year's Eve and during national events. The melody of this clock is "Westminster Quarters."
When the British Parliament meets, a British flag is raised at the top and the dials light up.

title: Big Ben
text:
Big Ben - Trivia
The Big Ben has been a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1987.
The tower was renamed "Elizabeth Tower" in 2012 following the Diamond Jubilee of Queen Elizabeth II (1926-2022).
Before then, it was simply called the "Clock Tower".
In real life, visiting Big Ben is very selective. Non-residents of the United Kingdom are prohibited, and requests for visits for residents must be submitted four months in advance to a local British government representative.
Thus, a visit to the tower by Caline's class would not have been possible.
However, it can be assumed that an intervention by Chloé's father could have allowed the class to go.
It is also possible that the presence of Shu Yin, Marinette's aunt, could have facilitated this visit, as Marinette could have made arrangements with a local representative of the British government since she resides in London.
In "Startrain", Pegasus crashed the Startrain into the tower's bell tower. After the defeat of Startrain, the damage was later repaired thanks to Ladybug's healing power.

The boiler room is a large two-level room located in the school basement. The walls, ceiling and floors are decorated in gray tones. A long corridor leads to the boiler room, which is illuminated by blue lamps above and red ones below. There is an inscription 21B on the wall next to the corridor. On each of the walls and ceiling there are pipes, various types of drawers, handles, ventilation grilles and switches. Pipes also run along the floor, but their location is smaller. Cast-iron scaffolding was also installed around the walls, thanks to which you can get into the chest and unfamiliar rooms located on the upper floor. At the central point of the boiler room there is an unknown device, similar to a furnace, which is connected to pipes. This device is gray or dark blue in color with multiple handles. It also has glazed parts from which blue light emanates. Despite the lighting in blue, which is located on the ceiling and under the scaffolding, the room looks gloomy and dark.

title: Bertrand King
text:
Bertrand King - Intro
is the former main antagonist of the episode "Action". He is a plastic manufacturer and the owner of his company.
In "Action", after an anti-plastic movement initiated by Marinette and her friends worldwide, causing André Bourgeois and Gabriel Agreste to give false deniability on their role on the plastic pollution on the Seine on television and speaking out against things made of plastic such as his Morpho fans, Bertrand was akumatized by Monarch into King of Plastic, a supervillain with the power to turn people into plastic and received the power of the Bee Miraculous through his Alliance ring. He also received a Magical Charm from Ladybug to prevent him from being re-akumatized.

title: Bertrand King
text:
Bertrand King - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Bertrand is a plus-sized man with fair skin and blue eyes, as well as thick eyebrows, white hair and a mustache.
Civilian Attire
He is wearing a pink jacket, under which is a light pink shirt with a collar and has a large red bow tie. He also wears white trousers and pink half-boots with a decorative bow. In front of his eyes he wears large glasses with gray frames.
As King of Plastic
King of Plastic acquired a pink skin tone, his eyes were brown with vivid yellow sclera, and his mustache and eyebrows were made of smooth light purple plastic. The head was covered with a black cloth. On his head he wore a hat resembling a crown, with multicolored inset balls.
The color scheme of the suit was pink and black. He had a suit with a thick collar, in the center of the suit there was a large heart with two curls. The barges were decorated with two pink balls. A rim in pink and black stripes was visible on the belt. Yellow hemispheres were visible on the knees, and at the bottom of the buff with a golden ornament on top. Two purple balls were visible on the shoes, similar to shoulder and forearm decorations.

title: Bertrand King
text:
Bertrand King - Personality
Matching his outside appearance, Bertrand possesses a very approachable and a bit jovial demeanor. He is willing to hear other people's opinion and is quite honest with everything he says, not being afraid to admit the real reason behind his selling tactics. His honesty also applies to complimenting other people's efforts when they deserve it. That side of him actually makes him look very charismatic, but it also deviates the attention from his darker side.
The truth is that Bertrand used to be blinded by his obsession with plastic. He loved plastic and was happy to surround himself with plastic things, possibly a consequence of being the owner of a company that fabricated plastic items. Even with concerning teenagers trying to draw attention to the problem of plastic pollution and convince him to reduce plastic consumption, he showed no concern about the environment, with the main thing for him being the wealth obtained thanks to plastic that people kept buying. As long as it made profit and was useful to him, it was alright, and the environment wasn't a priority in his eyes.

title: Bertrand King
text:
Bertrand King - Personality
However, despite that, he is not above admitting when he is wrong. When Ladybug and Cat Noir showed him the problem of plastic waste by using garbage collected from the Seine to defeat him, and in this way showing him how the animals living in the river felt by being surrounded by waste, Bertrand immediately changed his behavior. He decided to help solve the problem of plastic waste by becoming an example towards plastic recycling and the use of reusable and biodegradable materials.
As King of Plastic, his personality hadn't changed much, as he still had a deep love for plastic. However, he became vengeful towards the people that wronged him, like the ones who turned away from him after the environmental action of students. He did not hesitate to turn into plastic the people who betrayed him – the mayor and Gabriel – and those who stood in his way: police officers, Adrien's bodyguard or superheroes.

title: Bertrand King
text:
Bertrand King - Abilities
As a Civilian
Bertrand is a particularly gifted businessman who heads the world's largest plastic manufacturing company.
As King of Plastic
He had the ability to turn anything into plastic. He could even turn people into plastic statues of different colors if he touched the victim with the tip of the cap of his pen-turned-lance. With the addition of his own powers, King of Plastic got from Monarch the power of the Bee Miraculous, Venom, that gave him the ability to paralyze his opponent by stinging them with the nib of his pen-turned-lance. He used this power to immobilize opponents and turn them into plastic. He was also strong being able to kick away the front gate of the Agreste mansion.

title: Bertrand King
text:
Bertrand King - Relationships
Gabriel Agreste
Bertrand maintained a good relationship with Adrien's father. Although angry that Gabriel lied to the news about his talent being misappropriated by Bertrand's company, he forgave him after he was de-akumatized.
André Bourgeois
Little is known between the relationship between Bertrand and André, but it can be assumed that they were friends.

title: Bertrand King
text:
Bertrand King - Trivia
Bertrand is the last character to receive a Magical Charm in Season 5.
Technically, this is only somewhat true:
Although "Action" chronologically takes place in between "Confrontation" and "Collusion", it is not considered a part of the main storyline.
Considering that "Confrontation" is the last episode of the main storyline where a character receives a charm, "Action", Bertrand's first and only appearance, is the last episode in chronological order where a character receives a charm.
He is also the only new character in season 5 to be introduced, akumatized, and receive a Magical Charm in the same episode.
Bertrand's name may be a reference to the Belgian musician Plastic Bertrand.
It may also be a reference to the popular fast-food chain Burger King.
His voice resembles that of a cowboy and the founder of Kentucky Fried Chicken, Colonel Sanders, from the KFC commercials.

Sometime after Re-Verse Gabriel, cut his ties with the Supreme and became his new identity Betterfly, he created his lair which served as a headquarters to house the Resistance then, soon he led the Re-Verse Alya, Nino and Maxkov to here and had them join said group. Needing to be quick, Gabriel entered the portal heading to the Quantic Universe.
After the dark duo broke into Betterfly's lair, they demanded to know where the hero had gone and by using Re-Verse Nino as a hostage they followed Betterfly's trail to the Quantic Universe.

Basilica of the Sacred Heart of Montmartre - Intro
The  is a Catholic place of worship in Paris located on the top of the hill of Montmartre, in the 18th arrondissement.

id: Basilica of the Sacred Heart of Montmartre::Description::0
title: Basilica of the Sacred Heart of Montmartre
text:
Basilica of the Sacred Heart of Montmartre - Description
Its location at 130 meters above sea level, near one of the highest points in Paris, and its dome rising 83 meters make it visible from afar. With nearly eleven million pilgrims and visitors a year, it is the second most visited religious monument in Paris, after Notre-Dame de Paris.

id: Basilica of the Sacred Heart of Montmartre::Trivia::0
title: Basilica of the Sacred Heart of Montmartre
text:
Basilica of the Sacred Heart of Montmartre - Trivia
The Basilica of the Sacred Heart of Montmartre has been classified as a Historic Monument since 2022, following an inscription in 2020.
The Basilica of the Sacred Heart of Montmartre first appeared in the background in "Stormy Weather", when the eponymous villain flew away from the TVi Tower.
Additionally, the Basilica of the Sacred Heart of Montmartre appeared as a drawing on a stamp stuck in Fu's gramophone, where Wayzz used to sleep.
The Basilica of the Sacred Heart of Montmartre was mentioned in "Ikari Gozen" by Alya, where she met Wayhem for the Friendship Day.
In "Wishmaker", the Basilica of the Sacred Heart of Montmartre was featured on the map showing the locations of the Paris Career Expo.
The Basilica of the Sacred Heart of Montmartre is the setting for the level "The Bubble - Northern Hills" in the video game "Miraculous: Paris Under Siege".

title: Busy Day
text:
Busy Day - Intro
"" is the fourth webisode of the series, Miraculous: Tales from Paris.

title: Busy Day
text:
Busy Day - Synopsis
Marinette wants to go to the movies to be with Adrien but must stay and help her parents bake macarons at the bakery. Alya, Juleka, and Rose come to the rescue to help Marinette so that she'll be done on time to go see Adrien.

title: Busy Day
text:
Busy Day - Plot
In the bakery, Marinette assists Tom and Sabine to prepare macarons for a special order. Alya comes to the bakery and mentions that Adrien and Nino are going to the cinema in the upcoming afternoon. Marinette is eager to go to the cinema with them, but unfortunately, she is assisting her parents.
Alya offers to help with the macarons, but Marinette is skeptical on the idea, as they still won't be finished on time. So, Alya figures out another plan, asking Rose and Juleka to help. While helping, Rose requests to make special heart-shaped macarons as it would be romantic. In response, Tom apologetically rejects it, since all the macarons have to be the same for the order. However, he does offer to make a special batch of macarons for Valentine's Day.
With everyone's work, the order is successfully accomplished. Suddenly, Adrien and Nino enter the bakery to grab a bite before going to the cinema. Nino asks Marinette, what movie she recommends to watch. Tom and Sabine appreciate all the hard work from Marinette and her friends, so they give her movie tickets to watch a film and relax with her friends. In the end, Tom gives a batch of macarons to the children to enjoy at the film.

Tom: We still have a lot of macaroons to make, my darlings. This is our biggest order ever!

title: Bullroarer
text:
Bullroarer - Intro
The  is the tool of the Eagle Miraculous.
The current owner of the bullroarer is Jessica Keynes, who uses it as the superhero Eagle.

title: Bullroarer
text:
Bullroarer - Appearance
The bullroarer is a weighted airfoil, or thin slat of wood in a particular aerodynamic shape, with tan in the middle and light brown on the ends. On one side, there's an open section where the string goes back in. Eagle wraps it around her left hand when she's not using it. The length of the string could be unlimited and could be controlled by willpower.

title: Bullroarer
text:
Bullroarer - Abilities
Not much is known about the weapon, but it appears that it has some of the same abilities as the yo-yo and the spinning top. It might be able to be used as a source of transportation, and as a weapon, as Eagle is shown spinning it to ambush criminals in an alleyway.

title: Bullroarer
text:
Bullroarer - Trivia
The bullroarer is the third Miraculous tool that is based off of an instrument, following the Fox Miraculous' flute, the Snake Miraculous' lyre, and followed by the Pig Miraculous' tambourine.
It is also the fourth Miraculous tool to be based on a toy and a string, following the Ladybug Miraculous' yo-yo, the Bee Miraculous' spinning top and the Mouse Miraculous' skip rope.
When comparing it to it's real life counterpart the bullroarer is oldest of the Miraculous weapons dating back to 17,000 BC.

title: Bund

Bund - Intro
The , or Waitan (Chinese: 外滩; pinyin: Wàitān, Shanghainese: ngathae, lit. 'Outer Beach') is a waterfront area and a protected historical district in central Shanghai. The area along the river faces the modern skyscrapers of Lujiazui in the Pudong District.

title: Bund

Bund - Description
1.5 kilometers long, the Bund is first of all presented as a long promenade raised ten meters above the level of the Huangpu, this one being marked out by benches, lampposts, but also various sellers of superhero souvenirs. Along its entire length, the promenade offers a particularly impressive panorama of the Lujiazui and its various towers. The promenade is separated from the Zhongshan Road by a row of bushes and trees. Moreover, the boulevard presents itself as a two-way traffic lane.
The waterfront is separated from Zhongshan Avenue by a row of bushes and trees. In addition, the avenue is presented as a two-way traffic lane.
Notable buildings
Along the Bund, fifty-two buildings of European architecture were built. Thus, in particular, there are buildings in the Romantic, Gothic or Baroque style, but also Beaux-Arts, Neoclassical and Art Deco. The most symbolic buildings of the Bund are:

title: Bolas
text:
Bolas - Intro
The  is the tool of the Tiger Miraculous.
The current owner of the bolas is Juleka Couffaine, who uses it as the superhero Purple Tigress.

title: Bolas
text:
Bolas - Appearance
When used by Purple Tigress, the bolas string is brilliant crimson, with three weighted, striped balls at the end in a triangle pattern. The balls are brilliant crimson on one half, and pale, light grayish fuchsia on the other half, which bears very dark cerise stripes, there are also three gold rings near where the balls attach. When not in use the Tiger Miraculous holder ties them around their waist as a belt and it functions akin to a Tiger's tail, attached by a golden ring as a buckle.
From Season 6 and onwards, the bolas are dark crimson and there are three ropes connected to each ball. The balls are completely dark crimson with very dark cerise stripes. The ring that ties the strings together acts as a buckle to her new black belt with gold spikes.

title: Bolas
text:
Bolas - Abilities
Although it's unknown what the full abilities of the bolas are, just from its looks it's implied that, like Ladybug's yo-yo, Vesperia's spinning top, and Polymouse's skip rope, the bolas have unlimited length, they can be spun really fast to block attacks, they can grab, flail, and restrain opponents, Purple Tigress is shown doing this, swinging it around and using the weights to hit opponents; this is also a trait of real-life hunting bolas.

title: Bolas
text:
Bolas - Trivia
It's the third tool to be worn as a superhero outfit accessory, after the Turtle Miraculous' shield and the Mouse Miraculous' skip rope, and followed by the Rooster Miraculous' fountain pen.
Bolas with three weights are known either as Achico or Boleadora.
Ironically, bolas originate from countries such as Argentina, Uruguay, and the Americas, all places where tigers don't naturally live. However, the bolas are a hunting tool, and tigers are a well-known predator, so it's possible that's where the link comes from.
In real life, each ball of a bolas is attached to its own string. However, Purple Tigress has all three balls tied to the same string.
It's unknown if the Tiger Miraculous holder can divide the three weights.

title: Brooklyn Bridge
text:
Brooklyn Bridge - Intro
The is a bridge in New York City that connects Manhattan to Brooklyn across the East River.

title: Brooklyn Bridge
text:
Brooklyn Bridge - Description
Based on a design by John Augustus Roebling and inaugurated in 1883, the Brooklyn Bridge is one of the oldest suspension bridges in the United States. 1,825 meters long, 84 meters high and 28 meters wide, the bridge has three granite pylons spaced 487 meters apart, connected by steel load-bearing cables.
The apron is located 44 meters above the East River and allows circulation on two levels, the first being a double three-lane that allows the passage of vehicles, while the second being a very pedestrian promenade, frequented and appreciated for its view of the New York City skyline.

title: Brooklyn Bridge
text:
Brooklyn Bridge - Trivia
Every day the bridge is used by 121,930 vehicles per day.

In real-life Paris, there are 60 bus lines that serve the city. Their number ranges from 20 to 99.

In "Glaciator", Ladybug and Cat Noir intervened to save the passengers of a bus that went out of control.

title: Burrow (pocket dimension)
text:
Burrow (pocket dimension) - Intro
The Burrow is a pocket dimension that the holders of the Rabbit Miraculous use. This place can only be accessed via the Rabbit Miraculous' superpower of the same name.

title: Burrow (pocket dimension)
text:
Burrow (pocket dimension) - Appearance
The Burrow is a spherical dimensional pocket filled with windows that can be used to view and travel through all events of the past, present, and future.

title: Burrow (pocket dimension)
text:
Burrow (pocket dimension) - Abilities
Through these portals, the Rabbit Miraculous holder can exit the dimensional pocket at any point in space and time. Each portal can be "fast-forwarded" or "rewinded" by swiping their hand across it like a touchscreen. While anyone can "fast-forward" or "rewind" the portals, only bearers of the Rabbit Miraculous can open the portal.
Portals to the future change accordingly with events that occur in the past and/or present, meaning that if a change occurs in one of them, the future is progressively rewritten.
In "Evolution" it is revealed that there is no physical law in the dimensional pocket, meaning that anyone inside it can walk anywhere and in any direction without needing ground to support them, even vertically through the air. It is also revealed that the Burrow is located at the center of the entire flow of time, meaning that it is used by all bearers of the Rabbit Miraculous, both past, present, and future.

title: Burrow (pocket dimension)
text:
Burrow (pocket dimension) - Trivia
The Burrow has only been used six times so far:
In "Cat Blanc", Bunnyx used it to take Ladybug into the future in order to try to find out what caused Cat Noir to become akumatized and prevent it from happening.
In "Strikeback", after Ladybug unified her Miraculous with the Horse and Rabbit Miraculouses, she brought Flaimidable to the Burrow so she could go to the past and use the Dog Miraculous's superpower to retrieve Risk's akumatized object.
In "Evolution", after Monarch merged his Miraculous with the Rabbit Miraculous, he used the Burrow to try to obtain Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous, and later to save his wife from the illness caused by the damaged Peacock Miraculous.
In "Reunion", Bunnyx used the Burrow to find out what the weather would be like in Paris in the future.
In "Miraculous World: London, At the Edge of Time", Bunnyx brought Ladybug into the Burrow just before the wish affects her, and they both try to find out who discovered Ladybug's secret identity and how to restore time.
In "The Dark Castle", Bunnybug spends a few hours watching over the Burrow so Alix can spend her sixteenth birthday with her family and friends.

title: Burrow (pocket dimension)
text:
Burrow (pocket dimension) - Trivia
She later hands over this responsibility, along with the rabbit miraculous, to Bunnynette (her near future self, just a few hours older) so that she could fight Dark Castle along with Cat Noir.

Bois de Boulogne - Intro
The  is a green space located in the 16th arrondissement of Paris.

title: Bois de Boulogne
text:
Bois de Boulogne - Description
Located in the far west of Paris, the Bois de Boulogne covers an area of 846 hectares, bordered to the east by the urbanization of the 16th arrondissement, to the south by Boulogne-Billancourt, to the west by the Seine, and to the north by Neuilly-sur-Seine. Considered one of the green lungs of the capital, the woods are arranged in various plots to form parks and clearings. There are also two lakes, the upper lake and the lower lake, the Marne Saint-James, and several ponds, which form islands and landscapes offering relaxing views and beautiful boat rides.
The Bois de Boulogne also boasts several buildings and cultural sites, such as the Longchamps Racecourse and the Jardin d'Acclimatation, a year-round amusement park.

title: Bulgan
text:
Bulgan - Etymology
The name Bulgan is of Mongolian origin, meaning "stable".
The name is often associated with the Bulgan Provice in Mongolia. It also carries a broader connotation of "soft", "tender" or "gentle".

title: Bulgan
text:
Bulgan - Trivia
Bulgan can be associated with the Taurus sign in several ways:
People with the Taurus sign are known to be kind, independent, trustworthy, patient, hardworking, loyal, and determined, which aligns well with the meaning behind Bulgan's name. They are also very connected with their senses, which causes them to seek indulgence, like food. This fits his relationship to the Taurus sign.
His theme color is brown, which is a color the Taurus sign can represent.
However, the Taurus sign is mostly associated with the color green.
Given Bulgan represents Taurus, the bull constellation, it's likely that since Mongolian bulls can be found in Mongolia, which are an indigenous Chinese cattle breed, this could be intentional for Bulgan's motifs, not just his etymology.
As Taurus, he has horns on his helmet. This likely resembles those that can be found on a bull's head.

title: Buckingham Palace
text:
Buckingham Palace - Intro
is the official residence of the British monarch, located in the City of Westminster, London. It is a highly symbolic place for the royal family and an major tourist destination.

title: Buckingham Palace
text:
Buckingham Palace - Description
Built from 1703 to 1826, then remodelled several times in the following years, Buckkingham Palace has been the home of the sovereign of the United Kingdom since 1837 and the accession to the throne of Queen Victoria.
The palace is a French-inspired neoclassical building. Its public façade, facing The Mall and the Queen Victoria Memorial, features three rows of four Corinthian columns, each surmounted by a triangular pediment, one in the center and two smaller ones at each end. It is particularly high up on the side that houses the famous balcony from which the royal family greets the crowds that gather in the square and The Mall during important events of the British royal family.
The building features an immense 17-hectare garden with an artificial lake. This is where the Royal Garden Parties are held.
Buckingham Palace is a major tourist attraction, particularly its enclosure with the Royal Guards and their changing of guard ceremony.

title: Buckingham Palace
text:
Buckingham Palace - Trivia
Buckingham Palace has been a Grade I listed building since 1970.
In the series, this is the location of the reception given in honor of the royal wedding, which the Agreste and Tsurugi families attend in "Backwarder".

title: Brandenburg Gate
text:
Brandenburg Gate - Intro
The  is a symbolic and historical monument in Berlin located at Pariser Platz, Germany.

title: Brandenburg Gate
text:
Brandenburg Gate - Description
Built in 1791 by Carl Gotthard Langhans at the request of Frederick William II, the Brandenburg Gate is a neoclassical monument 26 meters high and 65.5 meters long, dominating the Place de Paris. Built as a symbol of peace, this gate is composed of twelve Doric columns, six on each side, forming five passages, demonstrating its design based on the Propylaea of ​​the Acropolis in Athens.
A quadriga by Johann Gottfried Schadow representing Victoria, the Roman goddess of victory, sits proudly atop the gate.
The Brandenburg Gate is a highly symbolic landmark in Berlin; the city's history is closely tied to it. It served as a border post between West and East Berlin, symbolizing the city's division during the Cold War.

title: Brandenburg Gate
text:
Brandenburg Gate - Trivia
Originally, the Brandenburg Gate was called the "Gate of Peace" (Friedenstor), recalling Frederick William II's desire to make it a symbol of peace.
On October 2 and 3, 1990, the Brandenburg Gate was the scene of the German reunification ceremony.

title: Butterflies
text:
Butterflies - Intro
are insects used by the holders of the Butterfly Miraculous to transform people into supervillains or superheroes.
When butterflies are used for good, they are transformed into Kamikos, as seen in "Miraculous Paris". They also can be used for evil, and thus transformed into Akumas by supervillains such as Hawk Moth/Shadow Moth/Monarch or Chrysalis. Once their akumatized villains are defeated by The Miraculers, Ladybug purifies them back into normal butterflies.
In "Catalyst" and "Ladybug", Hawk Moth akumatizes Nathalie Sancoeur to Catalyst, a villain with the ability to boost superpowers. With Catalyst's boost, Hawk Moth is transformed into Scarlet Moth and gains the ability to release an unlimited number of akumas at once. However, he loses this ability when the cane is broken although Nathalie stays akumatized.
In "Dearest Family", Shadow Moth figured out how to evolve his powers, allowing him to create a Megakuma, a stronger akuma that is capable of breaking through the barrier of the Magical Charms.

title: Butterflies
text:
Butterflies - Intro
In season 6, Chrysalis found a way to boost her powers, letting her create an Ultrakuma, which is a stronger version of the Megakuma, and allowing her to shoot Antikumas which can sever the transfer of powers from the kwami to the holder, temporarily removing their powers and changing their suit to a lighter color.

title: Butterflies
text:
Butterflies - Appearance
Before it is charged with energy by the owner of the Butterfly Miraculous, the butterfly is pure white. However, once the butterfly becomes a kamiko or akuma, it's black with translucent purple highlights. A Megakuma looks the same as a regular kamiko or akuma but slightly bigger.
In "Catalyst", when infused with extra power by Scarlet Moth, the akumas are crimson with bright red edges and white markings.
An Ultrakuma is dark purple with light-purple veins on its wings and is about the same size as a regular akuma with longer legs.

title: Butterflies
text:
Butterflies - Creation and abilities
A kamiko is a magical butterfly. Its goal is to possess an important object of a person who feels strong emotions, forming a telepathic connection between the person and the Butterfly holder (typically with an invisible beam shaped as the holder desires like a butterfly). They are supposed to be used for good purposes by transforming ordinary people into superheroes via positive emotions, but with Hawk Moth they are instead used to create villains by honing in on negative emotions.
Users of the Butterfly Miraculous don't have an endless supply of butterflies, so when they start to run out, the users can grow their own over time. Hawk Moth creates an akuma by charging a butterfly with magical energy, but it's unknown if the holder can magically create their own butterflies.

title: Butterflies
text:
Butterflies - Creation and abilities
Kamikos/Akumas have their own telepathic link to the Butterfly Miraculous owner, but if the Kamiko/Akuma goes too far away, the link is disconnected. They can squeeze through impossibly small spaces, even being able to move through the seal of a windowpane. As seen in "Miraculous Paris", a Kamiko can be sent to a champion through a blast. As Betterfly was able to quickly launch a Kamiko to Cat Noir when he was in danger.
Once the deal is made, the person is enveloped in a magical dark-purple ether, stemming from the object containing the Kamiko/Akuma, that transforms the person into a superpowered champion. The stronger their emotions, the more powerful the resulting hero or villain will be.

title: Butterflies
text:
Butterflies - Creation and abilities
If an Akuma is removed from one's object but goes uncaptured and unpurified, it will multiply before returning to the Butterfly Miraculous owner and entering the cane. The copies of the Akuma will subsequently fly around and indiscriminately seek out other people. Any person that makes contact with the Akuma clones will turn into exact physical copies of the original host's superpowered form and be frozen like statues in this state. When the akuma's former host manage to regain the intense emotions that transformed them to begin with, the original akuma will leave the cane and return to transform them once again, and the aforementioned duplicates will awaken and be under the full control of the original, forming a massive clone army. When multiple akumas are in existence, they can be controlled by the Butterfly Miraculous owner, to the point of forming a giant swarm shaped like their head, which they can speak through. It is unknown if Kamikos can do this as well.

title: Butterflies
text:
Butterflies - Creation and abilities
However that's not always the case shown in "Miraculous Shanghai", when King Cash was deakumatized, the akuma didn't multiply but instead Hawk Moth sent it to a new champion, showing that he can choose to let it multiply or choose a new champion.
As seen in "Kwamibuster", "Hack-San" and "Representation" if an akuma or kamiko is contained somehow (such as in a bowl, a jar, or a bucket) it will be unable to multiply.
As of "Cat Blanc", it seems that the butterflies have a sense of awareness, as when it was purified by Ladybug, instead of flying straight away it landed in Cat Noir's hands, and stayed for a bit. The butterfly itself must have sensed it and Cat Noir were one of the last akumas/kamikos and akumatized/kamikotized people in the world.
As shown in "Startrain", it would also appear that kamikos and akumas can amplify someone’s emotional state which can lead to them accepting the power even if the holder of the Butterfly Miraculous is out of range from it.

title: Butterflies
text:
Butterflies - Creation and abilities
After discovering Ladybug was able to enhance her own powers and create Magical Charms, Shadow Moth was able to boost his powers, allowing him to create a much more powerful akuma called a Megakuma. This new akuma is able to break through the barrier of the Magical Charm and destroy it, causing the charm to disappear.
Megakumas can also give their victims a great amount of stamina to achieve their goals, as Froggy was akumatized into Risk at sunset in the titular episode and was able to ride his bicycle around Paris for almost 24 hours without getting tired.
In "Determination", if a megakuma is inside an object made of multiple pieces its essence can split apart among the pieces, but it's also unknown what's going to happen if and when a Megakuma's essence is left behind.
In "Intuition", it is revealed that Akumas/Kamikos are able to fly through the vacuum of outer space.
In Season 6, Chrysalis was able to upgrade her akumas into a more powerful version called Ultrakumas. Chrysalis was also able to shoot antikumas through the light mask of her akumatized villains, rendering those it hits powerless.
Weaknesses

title: Butterflies
text:
Butterflies - Creation and abilities
There are several ways to de-spell, reject or avoid the Kamiko/Akuma and Kamikotization:
As per all of the episodes of the main series, the Akumatized/Kamikotized object can be broken, damaged, or destroyed, causing the Akuma/Kamiko to flee, and the target will return to normal.
The Ladybug Miraculous can then be used to capture and purify the Akuma back into a butterfly while it attempts to flee. But it's unknown if the power can be used to heal Kamikos due to their benevolent nature.
As shown in "Despair Bear", "Gigantitan", "Chameleon", "Furious Fu", "Startrain", "Ikari Gozen" and "Crocoduel", if the emotions of the intended target weaken before the Akuma/Kamiko reaches them, the Akuma/Kamiko will wait and/or be attracted to the person in the area whose emotions are the strongest.
As shown in "Riposte" and "Gigantitan", an Akuma/Kamiko can be seen before reaching its target and possibly stopped and purified beforehand.
As shown in "Zombizou", the Akuma/Kamiko can be intercepted by another person, who is then possibly akumatized/kamikotized instead.

title: Butterflies
text:
Butterflies - Creation and abilities
As shown in "Catalyst", "Heart Hunter", and "Miraculous New York", the Akuma/Kamiko can be called back by the holder of the Butterfly Miraculous.
Also shown in "Catalyst", the Butterfly Miraculous owner is limited to releasing only one Akuma/Kamiko at a time. Hawk Moth circumvents this by creating an akumatized champion that gives him the power to release multiple akumas at once.
As shown in "Chameleon", an Akuma/Kamiko can be taken and used even without strong negative/positive emotions.
As shown in "Startrain", the Akuma/Kamiko can stray too far from its owner and lose its telepathic contact with them, resulting in a rogue hero or villain if it possesses someone.
However, Monarch was able to stay in contact with a Megakuma far from Earth in "Intuition". It is likely Megakumas can be connected with from great distances unlike standard Akumas.
As shown in "Miraculer" and "Gabriel Agreste", the target can reject and expel the Akuma/Kamiko if they are strong-willed enough.
As shown in "Miraculous Paris" and "Cat Blanc", an akuma/kamiko can be destroyed using Cataclysm before it can reach its target.

title: Butterflies
text:
Butterflies - Creation and abilities
As shown in "Gang of Secrets", "Rocketear", "Qilin" and "Penalteam", the target can reject and expel the akuma/kamiko if the emotions that caused their transformation to be lost or supplanted.
In "Mr. Pigeon 72", Alya Césaire helps Marinette Dupain-Cheng learn the Ladybug Miraculous holder can create Magical Charms which repel akumas and protect those who wear it. Since kamikos have a benevolent nature, it's possible they are able to bypass the Magical Charm's protection and/or strengthen it.
As shown in "Furious Fu", the Order of the Guardians' monks are taught a chant:  "whirlwind of wisdom" by saying "the virtuous wind resists the temptation" and repeating "My anger is mine, but I am not my anger" to repel akumas, if the Butterfly Miraculous is in the wrong hands.
As seen in "Migration", the person can break free by breaking, damaging or destroying their object containing the Akuma/Kamiko before being fully akumatized/kamikotized.
However, this will only happen if the victim is willing to reject it, otherwise the victim's akumatized/kamikotized object will be split in half, but the Akuma/Kamiko will still remain as seen in "Crocoduel".

title: Butterflies
text:
Butterflies - Creation and abilities
From "Derision", if the victim understands why they feel the way they do (as well as others), as in with Marinette with her dealing with painful past memories, they can find a way to make peace with them and the akuma will leave them alone.
In "Daddycop", where Sabrina understood why everyone was hesitant to be friends with her due to being Chloé's lackey for so long and when the ultrakuma came to her Sabrina swiftly rejected understanding the feelings of others as well as what she truly wanted.
As seen in "Confrontation" if several people encourage someone who has a Magical Charm, the charm will conjure an energy shield capable of purifying megakumas. It's unknown if Kamikos are affected or not.
As seen in "Kwamibuster", "Hack-San", and "Representation", an Akuma/Kamiko can easily be trapped or contained by using a container such as a bowl, bucket, and jar, which prevents them from escaping and multiplying.
As seen in "Miraculous Paris", the user needs to recall the butterflies they create quickly because the user runs the risk of being tracked and found.

title: Butterflies
text:
Butterflies - Failure
The Butterfly Miraculous owner can revoke the Kamiko/Akuma, taking away their champion's powers and turning the Kamiko/Akuma back into a normal butterfly.
An akuma will leave the object it inhabits after the object is broken, damaged or destroyed. From there, the owner of the Ladybug Miraculous can catch it with the yo-yo in order to "de-evilize" it by removing the Butterfly Miraculous energy from it. Afterward, once the akuma reverts back to being a normal butterfly, the Ladybug Miraculous owner releases it, and the butterfly is free, possibly returning to the countryside rather than to Hawk Moth's lair.
If an akuma is set free from an object without being purified, it will multiply into countless akumas and possess any people they come across, turning them into physical duplicates of the akumatized champion. When the original is defeated and purified, its duplicates will vanish, returning the original champion and the other people affected back to normal.
However, it's unclear whether this process would still apply should a Kamiko be used with good intentions when it's charged.

title: Butterflies
text:
Butterflies - Etymology
The term "Kamiko" might be derived from the term "Kami no Ko" (神の子), which in Japanese means "Prodigy" or "child of god", while "akuma" (悪魔, hiragana あくま) means "demon" or "devil".
In most Asian lore, butterflies symbolize change. However, they are a sign of bad luck when in large numbers.
In some animistic beliefs, the sight of butterflies or moths approaching or entering one's house means that an unexpected guest or intruder will arrive in the near future.
In the Korean dub, they're simply called "Black Butterflies".
Ironically, they are still called that in their scarlet forms, too.

title: Butterflies
text:
Butterflies - Trivia
Kamikos aren't evil by nature. The black color just means they're charged with power.
The word "evilize" was created by Thomas Astruc.
In "Party Crasher", it is shown that akumas are produced by butterfly farming from Hawk Moth's repository.
As of this episode, an akuma is yet to be seen in its larvae stage, and it is also unknown what they eat when in that stage. Since they grow into white butterflies, it could be possible that they start out as white caterpillars.
It is not known which species of butterfly the white butterflies bred by Hawk Moth belong to.
Although both Hawk Moth and Cerise only use white butterflies to turn them into Akumas, it’s not known whether the holder of the Butterfly Miraculous can only use white butterflies or if they could theoretically turn any random butterfly of any species into an Akuma.
Akumas are similar to Kwamis, both being able to inhabit an object and transform a person into a super-being.

title: Butterflies
text:
Butterflies - Trivia
"Sentibubbler", "Destruction", "Emotion", "Re-creation" and "Miraculous Tokyo" are currently the only episodes in which an akuma does not appear in any form, whilst "Mayura" is, so far, the only episode in which the default black-and-purple akuma does not make an appearance.
When Cataclysm is used on a kamiko or akuma, it will be destroyed like everything else, as seen in "Miraculous Paris" and "Cat Blanc" respectively.
As seen in "Miraculous Shanghai" and "Simpleman", the user of the Butterfly Miraculous is not necessarily immune to the superpowers of their akumatized champions.
However, it seems like the champion can knowingly "exclude" the Butterfly holder when they use their power on a larger area, as neither Darkblade's nor Lies' barriers affected Hawk Moth/Shadow Moth in their respective episodes.
It is unknown if there are positive counterparts of Megakumas or Ultrakumas. If there are, then their purpose would likely be to destroy or bypass the negative counterparts of Magical Charms, if they exist.
