title: Butterfly Miraculous
text:
Butterfly Miraculous - Intro
The , also called the Moth Miraculous, is a locket brooch that whenever Nooroo inhabits it, transforms the wearer into a butterfly-themed superhuman with the power of Transmission.
To activate the brooch, the user must speak the transformation phrase: "Light Wings Rise". To deactivate the brooch, the user must speak the detransformation phrase: "Light Wings Fall". To activate the brooch for evil purposes, the user must speak the transformation phrase: "Dark Wings Rise". To deactivate the brooch, the user must speak the detransformation phrase: "Dark Wings Fall".
The brooch is currently owned by Cerise Bianca, who somehow came into possession of it after the wish that was made by Gabriel Agreste in "Re-creation". From Season 6 onwards, Cerise has fully assumed her role as the new Butterfly Miraculous villain, using it to transform into Chrysalis, a butterfly-themed supervillain using her own improved version of akumas, known as ultrakumas.

title: Butterfly Miraculous
text:
Butterfly Miraculous - Intro
It was previously owned by Gabriel Agreste, who used it to transform into Hawk Moth, Shadow Moth (when unified with the Peacock Miraculous), and later Monarch after stealing all the other Miraculouses. He used the Miraculous for evil purposes, creating akumatized supervillains who attempted to steal Ladybug's and Cat Noir's Miraculouses. However, in his final battle with Bug Noire, she knocked the brooch right off him. Since the Guardian stripped him of the Miraculous, he was no longer its holder.
In "Miraculous Paris", it is revealed that an alternate version of the Butterfly Miraculous in an alternate universe is used by a superhero version of Gabriel who uses it to transform into Betterfly.

title: Butterfly Miraculous
text:
Butterfly Miraculous - Appearance
In general, the Butterfly Miraculous is a locket brooch and glows whenever someone is feeling strong emotions. In charged mode, when Nooroo inhabits the brooch, it's a deep violet button with a black rim and tiny curved lines, some of the lines branch out on the rim of the brooch, a hinge on the left and a slot on the right makes the locket brooch open, in which a photo can be placed, it has four light purple strips coming out of it making it resemble a butterfly or a moth. If a minor is using the Butterfly Miraculous and uses its Miraculous superpower, the brooch will start running out of power. It makes a beeping sound then the strips and gem start discoloring. (One part is equivalent to one minute) Cerise or (another miraculous holder) has left before they de-transform.
In Season 6 onwards, the butterfly wings are now thicker and more detailed with the purple button now has a bright ring and a darker center.
In its activated mode, the brooch lacks the four strips.
In its camouflaged mode, the brooch changes color and form depending on whose possession it's in:
When it was worn by Gabriel Agreste, the brooch was circular and had a thin black lining around it.

title: Butterfly Miraculous
text:
Butterfly Miraculous - Appearance
When it was worn by Scarlet Moth, it was red.

title: Butterfly Miraculous
text:
Butterfly Miraculous - Abilities
The Butterfly Miraculous grants its wielder superhuman characteristics such as speed, strength, stamina, and agility.  It also makes the user nearly invulnerable.
Its special weapon is a cane which contains a hidden sword stick that can be used to fight opponents. Furthermore, the cane can keep butterflies when the holder wants to kamikotize/akumatize people somewhere else, and when a kamiko/akuma isn't purified, it will stores itself on the top of the cane waiting for the person to regain their strong emotions again. The cane can be used as an offensive weapon and a means of communication with other Miraculous owners, as seen in "Miraculer".

title: Butterfly Miraculous
text:
Butterfly Miraculous - Abilities
The Miraculous superpower of the Buttefly Miraculous is Kamikotization, (when used for evil it's called Akumatization). Upon sensing a strong emotion from a person, the holder takes an ordinary butterfly and charges it with energy, turning it into a kamiko, (when used for evil it's called an akuma), which is then sent out to possess an object that the person has on them. Once the kamiko/akuma possesses this object, a telepathic connection is formed between the recipient and the Butterfly Miraculous wielder. Once an accord is reached, the recipient is transformed into a Kamikotized superhero or an akumatized supervillain with their own unique superpowers.
In addition, the wielder can telepathically connect to the kamikotized/akumatized person to talk with them and perceive what that person perceives. If the kamikotized/akumatized person is using their powers wrongly or not the way the holder wants them to, the holder can cause pain to the kamikotized/akumatized person by controlling the person's body to a certain extent or take away their powers.

title: Butterfly Miraculous
text:
Butterfly Miraculous - Abilities
When the kamkotized/akumatized person's powers are removed (usually through their akuma being removed and purified), they lose any memory of what they did while in the kamikotized/akumatized state.
Even when disguised, the Butterfly Miraculous grants its wielder the ability to sense emotions in order to precisely pinpoint a targeted person's identity. Able to sense various people and their emotions, the wielder usually targets a person with the strongest emotions for the best manipulation.
Also, like the Ladybug Miraculous, it is revealed in the episode "Dearest Family" that the only limits Butterfly Miraculous holders have are the ones they put on themselves. When Shadow Moth found this out, he was able to increase the power of his akumas to make megakumas, giving them the ability to pierce through the force field of the Magical Charms created by Ladybug, thus allowing those who received them to be re-akumatized or amokized again.

title: Butterfly Miraculous
text:
Butterfly Miraculous - Abilities
In "Sublimation", the Butterfly Miraculous is discovered to have the ability to force those that have been akumatized to fire "antikumas" from the holographic mask that manifests when the holder communicates with them. These have the effect of negating the powers of those they hit.
The brooch also has the ability to give the wielder the costume they truly desire.

title: Butterfly Miraculous
text:
Butterfly Miraculous - History
Five thousand years ago, a mage successfully helped the kwamis to interact with humans by creating magic jewels, which were called Miraculouses. In order to repay the mage, and to live on the physical world alongside humans, the kwamis decided to help humanity by letting humans utilize their energy and powers through the Miraculous they were bonded with, which included Nooroo and the Butterfly Miraculous.
At some point in time, all of the knowledge about the Miraculouses and their powers was written down in code in a book called the Grimoire, with very few people knowing how to decipher the code. Miracle Boxes were also created at an unknown time to store the dormant Miraculouses. To protect and distribute Miraculouses, the Order of the Guardians was formed and existed for many years. Throughout its existence, guardians trained younger generations to keep a watchful eye over the Miraculouses and the Grimoire, which were placed in the guardians' temple.
Many Butterfly holders throughout history used Nooroo's power for good, like Hùdiè in China, who started the legacy.

title: Butterfly Miraculous
text:
Butterfly Miraculous - History
172 years ago, after an disastrous event where a young Wang Fu used the Peacock Miraculous to create a sentimonster and his negative emotions and imaturity led to the creature rampaging through the temple and eating and destroying everything in its path, Fu was entrusted with the Chinese Miracle Box (which included the Butterfly Miraculous) by a monk and was told to run away from the mess. However, on the mountain range outside the temple, in order to escape from the the monster, Fu jumped over a fissure on the ground - accidently opening the Box and spilling all of its contents on the snow. Due to his distress, Fu didnt notice he accidently left both the Peacock and the Butterfly on the mountain, alongisde the Grimoire, until it was too late and he was too far away to come back.

title: Butterfly Miraculous
text:
Butterfly Miraculous - History
On a previous trip overseas with the Agrestes, Nathalie found the Butterfly and Peacock Miraculouses and gave the jewels to Gabriel. In "Representation", it was revealed that neither the Agrestes nor the Graham de Vanily couples could bear children on their own, so Émilie and Colt used the Peacock Miraculous to create Adrien and Félix respectively, but in doing so, they grew sick over time and were eventually left in a condition where they fell into an eternal slumber due to using the Peacock Miraculous in its damaged state. Desperate to fix his mistake, Gabriel Agreste began using the Butterfly Miraculous for evil to obtain the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses in order to gain access to their absolute power, becoming the supervillain Hawk Moth, later Shadow Moth (when unified with a now fixed Peacock Miraculous), and finally, Monarch.

title: Butterfly Miraculous
text:
Butterfly Miraculous - History
This decision proved one of the most significant for the history of the series, as Gabriel began utilizing Nooroo's power to akumatize the civilians of Paris, France, trying to get one of them to draw out the current holders of the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses, unintenionally helping start off Marinette's and Adrien's journeys as Ladybug and Cat Noir, and later, the rest of the Miraculers.
In "Cat Blanc", in an alternate timeline, Gabriel and the Butterfly Miraculous were both accidently destroyed by a Cataclsym let out by the eponymous villain during a gigantic meltdown - however, the event was erased from existence after the intervention of Bunnyx. Moreover, the same destruction would befall Gabriel and the brooch yet again in "Miraculous Shangai", after an enraged Yan Luo Shi got infuriated with Hawk Moth trying to give him orders and blasted him out of existence with his ray - this event was repaired by Ladybug's Miraculous Ladybug superpower.

title: Butterfly Miraculous
text:
Butterfly Miraculous - History
Gabriel's time as Monarch came to an end in "Re-creation", where he was defeated by Bug Noire after a long, hard battle and had his Miraculous forcefully stripped from him by her - during the scuffle, the brooch was knocked off by Bug Noire's staff and fell off into the water below the Crypt.
Victory was short-lived tho, as Cerise Bianca, an Italian teenage girl who had deduced Gabriel's secret identity and had objectives of her own, managed to sneakily steal the Butterfly Miraculous way. In "Miraculous London", she used it to akumatized herself and steal the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses in an alternate timeline, but, thanks to the efforts of Chronobug and Bunnyx, her plan was thwarted.
Some time before "Climatiqueen", Cerise decided she would follow in her predecessor's footsteps and became the supervillain Chrysalis, akumatizing civilians in order to obtain information on the Miraculers and thus, figure out Ladybug's and Cat Noir's secret identities. It is now the Miraculers' duty to fight against Chrysalis and recover the Butterfly Miraculous.

title: Butterfly Miraculous
text:
Butterfly Miraculous - Trivia
The Butterfly Miraculous is one of three Miraculouses whose powers are not voice activated. The other two are the Snake Miraculous and the Peacock Miraculous.
Butterflies symbolize, among other things, transformation, change, resurrection, and hope.
Curiously, the Butterfly Miraculous is one of the two known Miraculouses to give its holder a passive ability even while untransformed, alongside the Peacock Miraculous: in the former's case, it allows to user to feel nearby individuals's emotions, as well as being "notified" of when a particularly powerful emotion appears; in the latter's case, it allows to user to sense when an object has an amok inside of it.
The Cat Miraculous also gives the user a passive ability in the form of night vision, however, this ability only activates when the Cat holder is transformed.
In the French dub of "Ladybug & Cat Noir", the transformation phrase of the Butterfly Miraculous is "Que les ailes de la nuit se déploient !" which literally translates to "Let the wings of the night unfurl!". This is replaced in future episodes by the usual "Transforme-moi".

title: Butterfly Miraculous
text:
Butterfly Miraculous - Trivia
Similarly, in the German dub of "Ladybug & Cat Noir", "The Collector", and "Gorizilla", unlike all other Miraculouses, the Butterfly Miraculous has a unique transformation and de-transformation phrase. Furthermore, the transformation phrase used in "The Collector" is different from the phrase used in "Ladybug & Cat Noir" and "Gorizilla". Starting from "Queen Wasp", however, the phrase is the same like all other Miraculouses.
In the Korean dub of "The Collector", the transformation and de-transformation phrases of the Butterfly Miraculous are exactly the same, both being "Spread the wings of darkness" when translated. However, it is changed to "Reap the wings of darkness" from the episode "Reflekdoll" and on.
In the French comic adaptation of "Ladybug & Cat Noir", Nooroo states the Butterfly Miraculous represents generosity.
Later, Miraculous Mexico confirmed on their X that it represents transmission.
The Butterfly and Peacock Miraculouses have rather similar powers.
Both allows the user to charge small things with magic to infect objects of specific people and telepathic communication with them.

title: Butterfly Miraculous
text:
Butterfly Miraculous - Trivia
They are also the only two known Miraculous superpowers which the user does not need to say the superpower's name to activate it.
Interestingly, both Miraculouses take the form of brooches, which may cast light on the fact that they have such similar powers.
However, the holder of the Butterfly Miraculous cannot be kamikotized/akumatized while transformed (though they can be if they revert to their civilian form first), while the Peacock Miraculous holder may manifest a sentimonster from their own emotions by using an amok on themself while still transformed.
Unlike akumatization however, amokization can infect an object that's been destroyed, although it is still possible to damage it further to release the amok.
Also, unlike akumatization, a sentimonster can only be controlled by the one who possesses the object containing the amok, while the power to control akumatized supervillains belongs solely to the Butterfly Miraculous owner.
The Butterfly Miraculous has the most powers out of all the known Miraculouses with six, though it is arguable that almost all of these powers are different parts of the same superpower:
Kamikotization/Akumatization
Empathy
Telepathy
Bodily control

title: Butterfly Miraculous
text:
Butterfly Miraculous - Trivia
Controlling butterflies
Power removal
As shown in "Simon Says", akumas and akumatized villains can retain their powers even when the Miraculous holder isn't transformed.
However, as shown in "Mayura" and "Ladybug", when Scarlet Moth de-transforms, willingly or not, everyone who was akumatized by his scarlet akumas returns to normal.
That is due to the fact those akumatized villains were created because of another akumatized villain who turned his cane into the power source of those scarlet akumatizations.
Similarly, they will retain their powers even after the holder and/or the jewel are destroyed, as seen in "Cat Blanc" and "Miraculous Shanghai".
The Butterfly Miraculous' user is seemingly immune to the effects of the akumatized villains, as Hawk Moth wasn't trapped in one of the Bubbler's bubbles despite being an adult, nor was he turned into a knight from Darkblade's barrier.
However, this doesn't apply when the Miraculous is inactive, as shown in "Simon Says", nor to non-magical powers as shown in "Robostus".
However, in "Catalyst", not only was Hawk Moth affected by the titular akumatized supervillain, he counted on it to fulfill his plan.

title: Butterfly Miraculous
text:
Butterfly Miraculous - Trivia
Also, in "Cat Blanc" and "Miraculous Shanghai", Hawk Moth was destroyed by his own akumatized victims.
In "Simpleman", he was also affected by the titular akumatized supervillain.
The Butterfly Miraculous is the first known Miraculous that is being used for evil. The second is the Peacock Miraculous.
If used for good, the Butterfly Miraculous can kamikotize people into superheroes instead of akumatize people into supervillains. It can also give people hope to fight when the world is in danger.
The power to cause pain to a kamikotized person or remove their powers is supposed to be a safeguard to prevent the person from using their powers wrongly or evilly.
"Timetagger" suggests that Gabriel's successor as Hawk Moth will also be a villain.
This proves to be true when Cerise Bianca acquires the brooch from the Agreste mansion after Gabriel's defeat.

title: Butterfly Miraculous
text:
Butterfly Miraculous - Trivia
Since the jewel can be used for both good and evil, the Butterfly Miraculous holder can sense both positive and negative emotions regardless. Due to past holders it's likely before the jewel was Gabriel's; the goods ones used it's power to calm them down and talk them out of causing trouble. Because maybe they experienced or already knew what was going to happen if they gave powers to those who don't think straight. There's also the possibility that the good holders would use both negative and positive emotions to find champions that could fight against other villains/tyrants.
Like the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses, the legacy of Hawk Moth dates back to Ancient China and is over 5000 years old.
In "Ladybug & Cat Noir", the inactive Miraculous is large enough to sit in Gabriel's palm and contain a photo, but in "The Collector", the inactive Miraculous is notably smaller, being the same size as the active one is without wings.
There is a photo of Émilie inside the brooch. However, it's unknown if the photo is currently still there after Cerise got her hands on the Butterfly Miraculous.
Fu mentions in "Ladybug & Cat Noir" that he thought the Butterfly Miraculous had been lost forever.

title: Butterfly Miraculous
text:
Butterfly Miraculous - Trivia
As revealed by Thomas Astruc, season 2 would explain how Gabriel found the Miraculous after it was lost. The cited tweet has since been deleted, and no episode of season 2 explained this. It is likely this plot was delayed until a further season.
In "Feast", Fu's past and him losing the Butterfly and Peacock Miraculouses is seen.
In "Hawk Moth and the Akumatized Villains", Marinette plans that after Hawk Moth's defeat, the jewel will be used the way it is meant to using positive emotions to create heroes.
Without realizing it, by putting Ladybug and Cat Noir in situations requiring the use of other Miraculouses, Hawk Moth did have a hand in giving rise to the other Miraculous wielding heroes. This is the intended purpose of the Butterfly Miraculous and because of him putting the heroes in said situations, he fed his own greed.
According to Gabriel in "Nathalie as seen by Gabriel", it was actually Nathalie that found the Butterfly and Peacock Miraculouses.

title: Butterfly Miraculous
text:
Butterfly Miraculous - Trivia
This is mostly confirmed in "Passion", where it is revealed that Nathalie used to be a hunter for magical artifacts and was hired by Gabriel and Émilie to help them find the Miraculouses. Even if the three of them found the Butterfly and Peacock Miraculouses together, Nathalie must have been the one to track them.
Given the confirmation that the transformation phrase for a Miraculous is dependent on whether it is being used for heroic or villainous purposes, it is likely Nooroo's activation phrase would be different with a heroic holder.
This is proven true in "Miraculous Paris" as alternative Gabriel Agreste is heard uttering the phrase ¨Light Wings Fall¨ when de-transforming. By this we can assume the transformation phrase to be ¨Light Wings Rise¨ in English.
The Butterfly Miraculous was the only Miraculous to have been used by only a single holder in-show, and the only Miraculous to have only one known camouflaged form.
This was later changed in "Re-creation", when Cerise gets her hands on the Miraculous.

title: Butterfly Miraculous
text:
Butterfly Miraculous - Trivia
Also, the Butterfly Miraculous is the only one from the Chinese Miracle Box that hasn't been wielded by a minor until "Miraculous Paris", where Marinette unified Betterfly's Miraculous and hers to become Ladyfly, although this was an alternate version of the Butterfly Miraculous. While Cerise also may fall under this category, it is not fully known if she is actually a minor or if that was also a fabrication.
In "Miraculous Paris", it's revealed that the Miraculouses also exist in alternate worlds and that, in one specifically, the Butterfly Miraculous is used for good by Gabriel whose superhero name is Betterfly.
Ironically, the superhero's enemies Gabriel faces are the holders of the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses who act as supervillains, with that being the total opposite of the main universe.
In "Miraculous London", it's revealed that if the Butterfly Miraculous holder akumatized themselves, they will also have no memory of what happens when they were akumatized. This is proven due to the fact that Cerise had made her akumatized self keep a notebook to keep track of what she saw to uncover Ladybug's secret identity.

title: Canal Saint-Martin
text:
Canal Saint-Martin - Intro
The  is a 4.5 km long canal in Paris, connecting the Canal de l'Ourcq to the river Seine. Over nearly half its length (2069 m), between the Rue du Faubourg du Temple and the Place de la Bastille, it was covered in the mid-19th century to create wide boulvards and public spaces on the surface. The canal is drained and cleaned every 10–15 years, and it is always a source of fascination for Parisians to discover curiosities and even some treasures among the hundreds of tonnes of discarded objects.
In "Ikari Gozen", during the Friendship Day scavenger hunt, the canal was the first location given to Marinette and Kagami where they were to meet up.

In "Daddycop", the Raincomprix apartment is shown to be located near the canal.

title: Caline Bustier
text:
Caline Bustier - Intro
is a recurring character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She is the mayoress of Paris and a former teacher at Collège Françoise Dupont.
In "Zombizou", while trying to protect Marinette Dupain-Cheng from an akuma which was originally trying to akumatize Marinette after Chloé ruined her gift for Caline's birthday, Caline was akumatized by Hawk Moth into Zombizou, a zombie kissing supervillain.
In "Miraculous World: New York - United Heroez", Caline revealed to her class that she was pregnant.
In "Collusion", Caline was unfairly fired from her job as a teacher as a result of Chloé and Cerise's manipulations and was almost akumatized by Monarch into Miss Sans-Culotte, a villain themed after the Sans-culottes. However, the first akumatization became useless as Caline rejected it. Feeling a sense of injustice after watching an edited video of Mayor Bourgeois admitting to using his position to limit citizens' freedom, she was fully akumatized by Monarch into Miss Sans-Culotte, and received the power of the Pig Miraculous through her Alliance ring, allowing her to transform people into singing balloons.

title: Caline Bustier
text:
Caline Bustier - Intro
In "The Final Day", Caline begins her campaign in Paris' mayoral elections. In the special's second part, "Re-creation", she wins the election and becomes the new mayoress of Paris. She also gives birth to Harmonie, her daughter.

title: Caline Bustier
text:
Caline Bustier - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Caline is tall and light-skinned with long ginger hair which she pulls back in a high bun, strong cyan eyes, thin light pink lips, and freckles.
Civilian Attire
She wears a light cerulean jacket with a moderate opal popped collared shirt and a white undershirt beneath, along with a pair of white earrings and a small goldish white necklace. She also wears light cerulean pants and white high heel shoes.
From season 6 onwards, she now wears a red, white, and blue striped sash over her right shoulder, and the ends of the sash are tied together next to her hips with thick golden tassels.
As Zombizou

title: Caline Bustier
text:
Caline Bustier - Appearance
Zombizou was a light Malachite green-skinned villain with moderate cerulean hair with a gray hue and brilliant arctic blue eyes. She wore black lipstick in a heart shape. She wore a butterfly-shaped pink mask, curved on top and curving to point beneath the eyes. She wore a primarily black dress with torn sleeves and was adorned with a pink heart and a smaller black heart within it. The black heart had a pink lipstick stain on it. The dress had pink puffy sleeves that feature a stapled design, a la Frankenstein. She also had black fingerless gloves that were connected to her sleeves and leggings, both of which had holes. Zombizou wore her hair in a bun decorated with two pink hair sticks with large round ends. On her feet, she wore black high-heeled boots with pink shoelaces. She wielded black lipstick.
As Miss Sans-Culotte

title: Caline Bustier
text:
Caline Bustier - Appearance
As Miss Sans-Culotte, her skin turned pure white, with vertical light brilliant blue and light brilliant red stripes going through her whole body. Her lips were also light brilliant red in color. Her hair was cut short, reaching the top of her neck, and golden blonde in color. She wore a gold metallic Phrygian-style cap, gold strapless breastplate that fitted her baby bump, and gold high-heeled boots. The cap, the plate, and the boots all detailed Greco-Roman embossed designs on them. She also wore high-waisted pants in the same colors and stripes as her skin. Her akumatized object, the bracelet, converted into a thick golden chain that wrapped around her entire left forearm, and had a huge guillotine blade, also with Greco-Roman embossed designs on it, at the end of it, which she threw at her targets using her right arm. As she was powered up by the Pig Miraculous, the blade glowed in a hot pink color.

title: Caline Bustier
text:
Caline Bustier - Personality
Caline is a pleasant, kind, helpful, and instructive teacher. Even though she is kind to her students, she can be stern with them if they misbehave and she will send them to Principal's office if she thinks it's necessary. When André Bourgeois is upset at her when Chloé Bourgeois loses her bracelet in "Rogercop", she is indignant at the rebellion. However, if a villain or another threat appears, Caline gets nervous, as seen when Rogercop questions her and will suggest to her students that they leave if it becomes potentially dangerous, as seen in "Lady Wifi". Caline also has incredible willpower, being able to initially resist becoming infected by an akuma in "Zombizou", something not very many can do. She also has a great deal of compassion for others especially towards those that mean and hateful like Chloe believing that with patience and setting good examples anyone can be good and change.

title: Caline Bustier
text:
Caline Bustier - Personality
However, her kind and compassionate nature can come as a flaw as well. Because Caline is willing to give new chances, try to appeal to a person's better side and make sure everyone is on equal ground, she is sometimes unable to perceive the true length of a person's less good nature, which results in her becoming a bit naive and vulnerable to those who try to take advantage of her kindness. The best example of this is Chloé Bourgeois. Despite Chloé's mean nature is very well-known and evident, Caline always treated Chloé like any other student, giving her nothing but kindness and compassion and trying to help her become her better self. However, that also prevented her from giving Chloé the real punishment she actually deserved, as seen in "Zombizou" when Chloé ruined Marinette's birthday gift or in "Revelation" after discovering Sabrina has been making all of Chloé's school work for her. Another example is Lila Rossi, as Caline (like most people) was fooled by the girl's lies and manipulation, even having a new class representive election two weeks before the end of the school year, after Lila expressed how "unfair" it was to uphold an election without her, in "Revelation".

title: Caline Bustier
text:
Caline Bustier - Personality
Caline is aware of this flaw of her and is able to learn from the mistakes she commits because of it, as seen in "Confrontation". After Marinette is able to expose Lila and Chloé, Caline decides to take a new approach when it comes to deal with Chloé. In "Collusion", even if still trying to call upon her better side (which she still believes to exist), she now is more stern with her. This is again seen in "Revolution", as Caline grew tired of Chloé's nastiness and is the one to strip her from her megakuma.

title: Caline Bustier
text:
Caline Bustier - Personality
Despite her gentle and calm nature, Caline does have a temper, which is mostly seen when in face of a great injustice, especially when her students are at the receiving end of it. This is perfectly seen in "Mega Leech", as she became furious upon hearing that Ivan and Mylene were taken by the police, calling to Roger and demanding him to take them back to the Place des Vosges so she can pick them up herself, all while confronting mayor Bourgeois about his actions. This temper of her is seen again in "Collusion", as, after watching an edited video where it appars that mayor Bourgeois was plotting a dark future for the children of Paris, she became so enraged that she falls victim of Monarch's akumatization even if she previosly had been able to resist it.

title: Caline Bustier
text:
Caline Bustier - Personality
Caline also takes her job as teacher very seriously, as she knows the future of world rests on the newer generations. That belief is what drove her to become a great teacher, as most of her students were able to become better people under her care and get along quite well between each other. She would also make sure they would have the necessaries tools to become their better selves and also to protect themselves from akumatizations. All that served as base for her to become a great Mayoress to Paris, from where her leading skills were able to bloom. She managed to lead Paris into becoming an example to follow to the world, creating green areas, reducing pollution, harnessing clean energy, increasing public transportation and improving educaton.
As seen in "El Toro De Piedra", Caline had also started a project called "New Chances", where criminals are giving a new chance into integrating society with less prejudice as possible, including giving them a job. One example of that is Ivan's father, Raúl, who used to be a criminal known as El Toro.
As Zombizou, her views on love became warped, believing that she was spreading the love by turning people into kissing zombies.

title: Caline Bustier
text:
Caline Bustier - Personality
As Miss Sans-Culotte, duped by the false video of the mayor, Caline was angry that André used collusion to wrongly take her job away and wanted to confront him but her sense of reasoning was still there as she listened to what Zoé had to say about her stepfather. She was even willing to let Ladybug and Cat Noir accompany her in case if any trickery, upon talking to André, she was shocked to hear that he admitted what he was wrong and humbly hearing that her job reinstated, satisfied, Caline released the akuma.

title: Caline Bustier
text:
Caline Bustier - Abilities
As a Civilian
Caline is a qualified teacher, having taught French, literature, poetry, and history.
In "Zombizou", she is shown to be able to resist or even overcome Hawk Moth's influence (something not very many akumatized victims can do), though unfortunately, she succumbed after approximately 30 seconds. By "Collusion", she is shown to be even better at resisting Hawk Moth's influence even when she is heavily pregnant by taking deep breaths, and manages to break free of it the first time.
As Zombizou
With her lipstick, Zombizou could blow kisses that turned people into zombies with brilliant mulberry eyes who sought to kiss and hug other people, and she could even spread kisses through direct kissing, as shown with Mr. Damoclès in his office. Although the effect wasn't seen, it is probable Mr. Damoclès was infected. The zombies had contagious kisses.
Zombizou also had enhanced physical abilities such as strength and agility.
As Miss Sans-Culotte

title: Caline Bustier
text:
Caline Bustier - Abilities
As Miss Sans-Culotte, she had a huge guillotine blade she could throw at her targets, being able to cut through solid objects easily. When the blade touched a person, they were transformed into a red, blue, or white singing balloon. As she was given the power of the Pig Miraculous, Gift, through her Alliance Ring, the blade got infused with the power, making so that the transformed people saw their own dreams of freedom and obeyed her every command, as they were made to see her as the one to free them all.
Miss Sans-Culotte also had enhanced agility, despite being pregnant when she was akumatized.

title: Caline Bustier
text:
Caline Bustier - Trivia
Caline looks noticeably similar to the character Lucille from A Monster in Paris. Despite this, no one who designed Caline ever saw A Monster in Paris and their similarities are entirely coincidental.
Her akumatized form was first revealed as a silhouette in a promotional poster on Jeremy Zag's Instagram.
Caline celebrates her birthday in "Zombizou".
Caline is the third character in the show to be akumatized on their birthday, the first two beings Alix in "Timebreaker" and Nathaniel in "The Evillustrator".
Caline was the first character in the show to be akumatized not because of a person, but by the akuma itself.
Caline is the first character to attempt to resist an akumatization, even though she didn't succeded to do so.
In "Gamer 2.0", Zombizou returns as a playable akumatized villain as part of the Gamer 2.0's powers.
A scarlet version of Zombizou reappeared in "Ladybug", but she is quickly de-akumatized.
In "Miraculous New York", it is revealed that she is pregnant.
In "Multiplication", Caline appears notably pregnant for the first time.

title: Caline Bustier
text:
Caline Bustier - Trivia
In the same previous episode, she was wearing a different outfit due to her pregnancy, but in "Illusion" onwards she went back to wearing her normal outfit just opening her white t-shirt.
As shown in "Perfection", Caline was also shown to be able to perform her yoga classes even while pregnant while many other pregnant women would hardly be able to perform these types of activities.
In "Collusion", she becomes the first civilian to be akumatized while pregnant.
In "Re-creation", she finally gives birth to her daughter named Harmonie.
According to one of Adrien's Instagram story posts, Caline owns a dog.
As revealed in the Miraculous Secrets card game, Miss Bustier was once a student of Mr. Damoclès when she was in school, and once pinned a fish to his back as an April Fool's joke.
Caline is the second civilian to purify a Megakuma and the first one to do so without the help of a Magical Charm.

text:
Caline Bustier - Trivia
Caline is a sapphic character, being part of the fifth LGBTQ+ romance pair to appear in the show, after Nathaniel and Marc, Juleka and Rose, Barbara and Olympia, Zoé and Marinette (despite the latter was shown to be one-sided and eventually became platonic for both parts) and followed by Lê Chiến Kim's parents (Lê Cường Minh and Vadim Ature).

title: Camilla Hombee
text:
Camilla Hombee - Intro
, also known as Victory, is a supporting character of Miraculous World: New York - United Heroez. She is the president of the United States of America.

title: Camilla Hombee
text:
Camilla Hombee - Appearance
Physical appearance
Camilla is a dark-skinned woman. She has brown eyes and dark brown hair that is cut short and combed to the right side.
Civilian attire
She wears a black blouse under a blue jacket with a US flag pinned to her lapel. Her neck and ears are decorated with jewelry made of pearls, Camilla ties her jacket with a black belt at the waist. She also wears a blue pencil skirt with a black stripe on the front and black heels.
As Victory

title: Camilla Hombee
text:
Camilla Hombee - Appearance
Camilla's hairstyle does not change after the transformation. The super heroine's outfit is in three colors: blue, red and white, which is a reference to the flag of the United States. The back of her head, ears and neckline are covered with a blue fabric decorated with white stars. The rest of the blouse has red and white stripes in the shape of the letter "V". The inside sleeves are white and the outside are blue with white stars. The woman also wears red and white elbow-length gloves. The pants are decorated in the same tone as the sleeves of the upper garment - white inside and blue on the outside, decorated with white stars. He wears a thick red belt on his hips. The shoes are red with two white stripes, up to the knee. Victory also has a shield, which resembles the letter "V". It is blue in color with white stars, adorned at the top with two red and one white stripes.

title: Camilla Hombee
text:
Camilla Hombee - Abilities
Being the president, Camilla has skills in politics, communication and leadership.
As Victory, she carries a shield in battle and has access to a countless number of military weapons hidden in secret compartments throughout New York City.

title: Camilla Hombee
text:
Camilla Hombee - Trivia
Based on her outfit, a costume decorated in the style of the American Flag, and her very prominent use of a shield, it's likely she was based on the Marvel Comics character Captain America.
Her full name, Camilla Hombee, is an anagram of Michelle Obama, who was a First Lady of the United States.
She is the first female president of the United States compared to the real world.

title: Bọ rùa
text:
Bọ rùa - Intro
was a Vietnamese girl. She was a past Miraculous holder, wielding the Ladybug Miraculous and transforming into a ladybug-themed superhero when Tikki inhabited them.

title: Bọ rùa
text:
Bọ rùa - Appearance
Bọ rùa had long black hair and dark eyes. She wore a white conical hat with a frontal design of a flying ladybug and flowers, and she wore the earrings. Her áo dài included a red tunic with black dots and black edges on the sleeves, collar, and flaps. The front flap of the tunic over the chest features designs of black curls connected to the black edges and a white flower button with a black center over it. Also, she wore black trousers and black shoes.

title: Bọ rùa
text:
Bọ rùa - Personality
Bọ rùa is "nice and a bit shy."

title: Bọ rùa
text:
Bọ rùa - Abilities
If this past Ladybug Miraculous holder had the same powers as the current Ladybug (Marinette), she had enhanced abilities and the superpowers Lucky Charm and Miraculous Ladybug. She also had the yo-yo for a weapon.

title: Bọ rùa

Feri González revealed the character as her eighth Inktober drawing, noting that she was created by Thomas Astruc.

Before the destruction of the Order of the Guardians she and La Mariquita were the last of Ladybugs before Marinette.

title: Cafeteria
text:
Cafeteria - Intro
The cafeteria is a room in Collège Françoise Dupont.

title: Cafeteria
text:
Cafeteria - Appearance
First saga
The cafeteria is located on the top floor at the back of the school. The room is long and narrow with high ceilings. The walls at the two short ends of the room are brick, while the long sides of the room are beige. The floors are checkered in black and white, and the ceiling is wavy and light blue. There are stairs leading up to the cafeteria at the end of the room (for clarity, the end with the stairs will be referred to as the near end).
The long sides of the room have short walls with framed pictures of various root vegetables on them. Extending upwards from these to the ceiling are sloped walls (similar to an A-frame) containing tall skinny windows. The sides of the room have gray support beams running from the floor to the ceiling with a crossbeam running across the walls. These act to break up the windows into sections as well. The brick walls at the end have two gray crossbeams on them as well. Between these crossbeams are framed pictures of citrus fruits and squash at the near and far ends respectively. The ceiling has several hanging light fixtures each with two horizontal tube lights.

title: Cafeteria
text:
Cafeteria - Appearance
The lunch line begins at the near end. There is a poster of vegetables on the wall behind the line, and several short rectangular planters with leafy green plants in them are on the floor. There is also a larger leafy plant next to the support beam. The counter consists of wooden slats, and there are two metal shelves— plus the counter surface— in which to choose food, plates, bowls, and cups from. Hanging above these are black signs with brown frames (presumably the lunch menu written on chalkboards).
The cafeteria kitchen is on the other side of the line. There is a door on the side as well as a door in the back. The kitchen includes a hood with lights underneath, counters, a sink with a sprayer, and shelves with pots on the wall. In front of the kitchen is a yellow cabinet and trashcan with a microwave on top. The same can be found in front of the other three walls.

title: Cafeteria
text:
Cafeteria - Appearance
The middle of the room has planters and tables. In the very center is a tree with red leaves in a circular planter. Said planter also contains short green plants. There are two other rectangular planters with green plants: one with large leaves and one tree with small leaves. These contain shorter plants, too. The tables are circular and rectangular with different colored tops. The tables also have different colored pitchers on them. The chairs are wooden with metal legs and black feet, and the backs have a handle.
Second saga
After the renovation of the school, the canteen has retained the same architecture, but several changes can be observed. First, the hall is no longer located at the back of the school, but on a side wing, and seems to have access to the terraces. Secondly, the hall now has white and blue walls. Finally, the tables are now rectangular with red and white chessboards, surrounded by wooden chairs.

title: Cafeteria
text:
Cafeteria - Trivia
In "Despair Bear", Marinette's father mentioned the cafeteria refrigerator.
Before "Illusion", Adrien was never eaten in the cafeteria, due to his father ordering him to go back to house when he didn't have class.
The cafeteria has been important in several episodes:
In "Zombizou", Ladybug entered the cafeteria to look for her classmates, but ran away when she was chased by students infected by the eponymous villain.
In "Malediktator", Marinette and her friends were eating lunch in the cafeteria before being interrupted by the sound of the blades of the Bourgeois' helicopter.
In "Chameleon", after seeing how Lila was taking advantage of her classmates' kindness, Marinette tried to reveal that Lila is a liar by throwing a paper napkin at her, but Lila managed to catch it while complaining about the pain in her wrist and how she "saved" Max with the napkin, causing her classmates to become angry at Marinette.
In "Guiltrip", after receiving a message from Rose on her cellphone informing her that she was at the hospital due to her illness, Juleka ran away from the cafeteria crying, chased by Marinette who asked her what happened.

title: Cafeteria

Cafeteria - Trivia
In "Risk", Marinette tried to recruit Alya, Nino, Kim, and Rose to help her stop Adrien from leaving Paris for London, only to be called jealous because Lila is going with Adrien. Later, due to the eponymous villain, Marinette stormed out of the cafeteria saying that she will do it herself.
In "Illusion", Nino, Alya, Marinette, and Adrien were hatching a plan to find out how Monarch was transferring the Miraculous superpowers to his Akumatized villains, only to be interrupted by a crowd of Adrien's fans due to a photo posted by Lila via her Alliance ring.
In "Deflagration", after Zoé and the students in the cafeteria sided with Marinette and protected her, Chloé was akumatized there by Monarch into Sole Crusher.
In "Sadnansi", after Twig and Nora's confessions to each other, it lead to Nora to getting akumatized by Chrysalis into Sadnansi.

title: Caline Bustier/History
text:
Caline Bustier/History - Intro
Miss Caline Bustier is the mayoress of Paris a former teacher at Collège Françoise Dupont.

title: Caline Bustier/History
text:
Caline Bustier/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)", when Miss Bustier noticed Nino sitting the back with his headphones on, she told him to move to the front row. Once the entire class was seated, she introduces herself to her new students. After class was over, she noticed Ivan getting angry at Kim and sent him to the principal's office.
In "Stoneheart (Origins - Part 2)", during attendance, Miss Bustier was amused when Adrien shouts "present" loudly upon hearing his name be called. When she calls for Ivan, she was shocked when Stoneheart bursts into the classroom instead. Later, while watching the news with her students, she was shocked when Hawk Moth announced himself and demands that Ladybug and Cat Noir surrender their Miraculouses, but when Ladybug refuses and vows to protect the people of Paris, Miss Bustier cheers.

title: Caline Bustier/History
text:
Caline Bustier/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Lady Wifi", Miss Bustier compliments her students, as most of them did well on their last assignment. She then gives them their homework and asks Alya to deliver Marinette's. The next day, when Marinette comes late to class and shouts once hearing from Nino that Alya was suspended, Miss Bustier told her to be discrete if she comes in late. However, when Marinette shouts again after hearing that Alya thought Chloé was Ladybug, she angrily sends her to the principal's office. However, when Lady Wifi appears, she instructs her students to go home for their safety, but not before giving them homework.
In "Mr. Pigeon", Miss Bustier was seen next to Mr. Damocles as he announces Gabriel Agreste's derby hat contest to her students.

title: Caline Bustier/History
text:
Caline Bustier/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Dark Cupid", Miss Bustier talked to the class about how most fairy tales end with the prince breaking a spell by kissing the princess and asks why, to which Rose replies that only love conquers hate. When Max begins to point out that sort of logic is only in 87% of fairy tales, Miss Bustier cuts him off. She notices that Adrien was writing something rather than listening and asks him what she said, but when Adrien repeats what she'd told the class, she's impressed. Once class ends, she reminds her students to finish Sleeping Beauty.

title: Caline Bustier/History
text:
Caline Bustier/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Pixelator", Miss Bustier took the class to Le Grand Paris hotel for a work experience field trip. When she notices Ivan and Alix having a pillow fight and reminds the class that the trip was worth a huge portion of their grade to get them to stop. Miss Bustier then notices that Marinette and Alya are not on the mayor's list, but Chloé then gives her father another paper explaining Marinette and Alya's jobs. The mayor told Alya her job and almost told Marinette hers when Jagged Stone comes into the hotel. After the ordeal was taken care of, Miss Bustier reminds the mayor that he never gave Marinette her job, which the mayor then says was gopher duty.

title: Caline Bustier/History
text:
Caline Bustier/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Darkblade", she announces that Chloé was running for class representative and gave her students until the end of lunch to decide whether or not they wanted to be a candidate. When the end of lunch arrives and no one volunteers, Miss Bustier almost declares Chloé the class representative, but then Marinette says that she'd like to run. Delighted, Miss Bustier reminds her to develop her campaign and have a speech prepared. The next day, Miss Bustier reveals that by majority vote, Marinette has won.
In "Reflekta", Miss Bustier poses with her students for a class photo, though when Chloé starts to complain about where she was put, she told her to behave herself. When Juleka asks to use the bathroom while the photographer gets some batteries, Miss Bustier allows her to go but told her to hurry back. Mr. Damocles reminds her that the photographer said no one is to move, but Miss Bustier explains that it was an emergency. She also allows Sabrina to go to the bathroom.

title: Caline Bustier/History
text:
Caline Bustier/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Despair Bear", Miss Bustier and her class were listening to Tom Dupain's cooking lesson until the fire alarm goes off. She tells her students to exit the classroom quietly and single file.
In "Robostus". she looked on in horror as the titular villain took Max.
In "Frightningale", she took part in Clara Nightningale's new music video.
In "Zombizou", it's Miss Bustier birthday.
Everyone in her class gives her a gift - everyone except Chloé, who forgot.
When she discovers that Chloé sabotaged the gift Marinette made her, unlike her students, she was more forgiving.
Then, asks to speak to her outside, and Marinette, thinking that she's in trouble, gets angry and becomes vulnerable for akumatization.
However, before the akuma can infect her, Miss Bustier assures Marinette that she isn't in trouble and only wants her to set a good example for her classmates by forgiving Chloé, making Marinette's negative emotions go away.

title: Caline Bustier/History
text:
Caline Bustier/History - [[Season 2]]
Marinette insists that Chloé was the worst person she's ever known, but Miss Bustier reminds her that there are people worst that Chloé living in Paris and shares her belief that people like Chloé are capable of great things but need a positive example in order to better themselves.
After she and Marinette come to an understanding, Miss Bustier notices the akuma and fearfully tries to shoo it away, unaware that her being afraid made her vulnerable for akumatization.
When the akuma infects her, she attempts to resist, but ultimately gives in when Hawk Moth says that he wants to give her the power to spread love and compassion, turning her into Zombizou.

title: Caline Bustier/History
text:
Caline Bustier/History - [[Season 2]]
Zombizou enters her classroom and told her students that from now on, everyone will hug, kiss, and feel the love. She blew a kiss at Chloé, but Chloé used Sabrina as a human shield and the kiss infects her instead. Zombizou prepared to blow another kiss, but Ladybug bursts in and stops her before she can. She fights her until an infected Sabrina, Ivan, and Mylène come back into the classroom. She decides to leave Ladybug to them and goes from classroom to classroom looking for Chloé, all while blowing multiple kisses at the students and staff.

title: Caline Bustier/History
text:
Caline Bustier/History - [[Season 2]]
Zombizou eventually catches up to Ladybug, Cat Noir, and Chloé on top of the Eiffel Tower and demands that Ladybug hand over her Miraculous and Chloé. When Ladybug goes to fight her, Zombizou points out that she's all alone as everyone else has already been infected and tells her to accept her love and hand over her Miraculous. But instead, Ladybug uses her Lucky Charm item to wipe the lipstick off Zombziou's face. When she attempts to reapply, Ladybug grabs the lipstick from her and breaks it, freeing the akuma and turning Zombizou back into Miss Bustier, who then expresses remorse over letting her negative emotions get the better of her and hurting a lot of people. However, when Chloé admits that the whole ordeal was her fault and apologizes, she accepts the apology and hugs her. The next day, Miss Bustier enters her classroom and says that they'll start the day by giving nice compliments to their neighbors.

title: Caline Bustier/History
text:
Caline Bustier/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Malediktator", when Chloé presents a video of herself dressed as Queen Bee to the class, Miss Bustier asks Chloé why she made her assignment about herself. When the class starts making fun of Chloé, Miss Bustier tells them to calm down and then tells Chloé that class isn't over when she angrily exits.
In "Catalyst", Miss Bustier believes Lila when she says on a video chat that she's in the Kingdom of Achu. She asks her what she'll be doing for Heroes Day and thanks her on behalf of Earth when Lila claims to be working on a pollution-reduction project. After Lila hangs up, Miss Bustier tells her students that though it may be hard to live up to Lila's standards, there are other ways to do good deeds. She then goes around and asks everyone what good deeds they are planning on doing. Later, when a bunch of scarlet akumas invade the school, Miss Bustier was seen shooing some away and reminds everyone that there's a hero in every one of them.
In "Mayura", Miss Bustier is delighted upon seeing that Ladybug and Cat Noir are alive and well.

title: Caline Bustier/History
text:
Caline Bustier/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Chameleon", Miss Bustier announces to the class that Lila has returned. She believes Lila when she claims to have tinnitus and need a front row seat, therefore when Marinette complains about having to sit in the back due to the new seating arrangement, Miss Bustier reminds her that she doesn't have any trouble hearing or seeing. Enraged by Lila's lies, Marinette was almost akumatized, but Miss Bustier calms her down when she tells the class to open their textbooks. After lunch break, when the class returns, Miss Bustier does attendance. When Marinette fails to answer despite calling her name three times, Miss Bustier believes that she may have hearing problems after all and asks her to move to the front row next to Lila. When Lila claims to have been cured of her tinnitus and no longer need a front row seat, Miss Bustier allows several of her students to move back to their original seats.
In "Oblivio", after Alya and Nino explain that they were akumatized because they were embarrassed at being caught playing Super Penguino, Miss Bustier forgives them but reminds them that games should be played at home rather than school field trips.

title: Caline Bustier/History
text:
Caline Bustier/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Startrain", Ms. Bustier was taking her class on a field trip to see Big Ben in London, and upon seeing Chloé go to the opposite train car, she points her to the other direction until being informed by Sabrina that Chloé's father arranged for her to sit in first class. During the train ride, she sat next to Nathaniel reading a book, however their trip took a turn when Max's mother was akumatized into Startrain, sending everyone into space. After Ladybug and Cat Noir appeared, she followed Ladybug's instructions and led everyone to the back of the train. Once the titular villain was defeated, everyone was put safely on the ground and then resumed their class trip.
In "Kwamibuster", she was in the middle of teaching the class a history lesson, until she saw some of her students being distracted by a noise below, but quickly regained their attention.
In "Gamer 2.0", Miss Bustier collects her students' tests and later was seen talking to Mr. Damocles when she along with several other Parisians are brought into Gamer 2.0's game. As her akumatized identity, Zombizou fights Horrificator and easily defeats her. After Gamer 2.0's defeat, Miss Bustier and the others are freed.

title: Caline Bustier/History
text:
Caline Bustier/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Timetagger", Ms. Bustier was one of the many people the titular villain sent into past, altering the future.
In "Ladybug", Ms. Bustier told everyone that they did well on the Mock Exams, but became surprised that Marinette had the test answers when she heard Marinette accuse Lila of sabotage. Ms. Bustier sent them both to Principal Damocles' office. When the squabble ends with Marinette's expulsion, it leaves her saddened to the point of being akumatized again into Zombizou, but she was deakumatized when Nathalie lost her powers.

title: Caline Bustier/History
text:
Caline Bustier/History - Miraculous New York
In "Miraculous New York", it is revealed that she is expecting a child, and therefore, could not accompany the class on their trip to New York, due to having a few medical exams she was unable to postpone, with Olga Mendeleiev replacing her.

title: Caline Bustier/History
text:
Caline Bustier/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Mega Leech", she was taking roll call with her students until notice Mayor Bourgoise is planning to tear down the park to make through project oxygen. She calls Roger to let Mylene and Ivan back She requests that the two be driven back to the park. She and her class head to the park to put the stop of Project oxygen with artificial air. Mayor Bourgoise to cancel project oxygen and grow as many trees as possible in Paris and Caline congrats.
In "Guiltrip", Caline Bustier was teaching when Rose felt pain and asked to go to the infirmary . Caline told Marinette to go with her, just in case.
In "Wishmaker", Caline was at her classroom observing Marinette handing out the career questionnaires to the students. She heard Chloé bragging about her wealth and criticizing her classmates, and Caline replied that decisions shape who people become. She heard Denis Damoclès comment about the Paris Career Expo, emphasizing that the students could meet specialists from various fields and should not let context define their roles.

title: Caline Bustier/History
text:
Caline Bustier/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Ephemeral", Caline was at her classroom sharing a piece of literature with the class. She heard Adrien make a joke about the writer of I Am a Cat, saying "Meow-meow?", which made the class laugh, and then he explained that the author was Natsume Sōseki, apologizing for the joke. At another moment, Caline was reciting a literary text, she didn't notice that Adrien passed a love letter to Marinette.
In "Penalteam", Caline was with the students at the Stade des Princesses, observing the soccer activity meant to promote teamwork. She followed Didier Roustan's guidance and noticed the arguments between Chloé and Marinette about the rules and the teams. When Chloé started rejecting the game, Caline tried to intervene, reminding everyone of the importance of inclusion. Later, Chloé became Penalty and created an unbeatable team, putting the students in danger, while Caline watched the superheroes' battle from afar.

title: Caline Bustier/History
text:
Caline Bustier/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Multiplication", Caline was present at her classroom while Alim and Denis Damoclès announced that Alix would become Bunnyx and needed to leave for a while. She reminded all the students that you didn't need to be a superhero to help Ladybug and Cat Noir. During the unfortunate meeting, Caline noticed Marinette's sadness, Alya offering support, and Mylène looking worried, but Ivan reassuring her. She observed Chloé making comments about Ladybug and Lila defending her.

title: Butterfly Sentimonster
text:
Butterfly Sentimonster - Intro
is a minor antagonist of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. It is a giant butterfly-like Sentimonster manifested by Mayura from Hawk Moth's despair from his grand plan being foiled to save him from being unmasked in "Mayura".
It also makes an appearance in "Miracle Queen" using its stinger to attack Jade Turtle and escape through fast-flight with Mayura and Hawk Moth, although this time it was manifested from Hawk Moth's determination.

title: Butterfly Sentimonster
text:
Butterfly Sentimonster - Appearance
Physical appearance
As it represents a butterfly, it has largely sized dark purple wings with black and a white dot spots with gray edges at the end. It has a magenta head with teal eyes with large dark yellowish-green antennas with the body having purple fur with black stripes with some yellowish-green spikes with each side of the body and large dark purple arms with the tail being violet.

title: Butterfly Sentimonster
text:
Butterfly Sentimonster - Personality
Not much is known about the butterfly sentimonster, but is known to hit aggressively and follow Mayura's orders accordingly. It also has an attack screech.

title: Butterfly Sentimonster
text:
Butterfly Sentimonster - Abilities
The butterfly sentimonster has the power to cause extreme winds that can blow its opponents away by flapping its wings. It also possesses a strong stinger that is strong enough to break Shell-ter, as seen in "Miracle Queen".

title: Butterfly Sentimonster
text:
Butterfly Sentimonster - Trivia
It is the first recurring sentimonster in the series, the second being Lollipop Boy.
It is also proof that different emotions can create the same sentimonster, as in "Mayura" it was created by Hawk Moth's despair, but in "Miracle Queen" it was created by Hawk Moth's determination.
It appears at the end of both season 2 and season 3.
The Butterfly Sentimonster is the only known sentimonster that is an insect and also the first sentimonster manifested during the series.

Civilian attire

title: Butterflies/Movie
text:
Butterflies/Movie - Intro
An Akuma is a magical butterfly capable of giving the target superhuman abilities. The use of those butterflies, while usually used for good can be used for evil, as demonstrated by Hawk Moth, transforming people into supervillains. An army of akumas is created and led by Hawk Moth, while Ladybug and Cat Noir are tasked with capturing and purifying them.

title: Butterflies/Movie
text:
Butterflies/Movie - Appearance
Similar to their show counterparts, the akumas are black with translucent purple except being colored with highlights they have spots and are bit bigger.

title: Butterflies/Movie
text:
Butterflies/Movie - Creation and abilities
The Butterfly Miraculous holder can create one or more Akumas in a variety of ways. The simplest way is for the wielder to hold their hands together or make a fist and materialize their magical energy in the form of a butterfly. The created Akuma, either by making contact physically or with an important object belonging to a person with strong negative emotions, will penetrate their heart and form a telepathic connection between the person and the Butterfly holder, which in turn will transform the said person into an akumatized supervillain.
Weaknesses
If the akuma inhabits a victim's heart only enough outside force like Gargoyle colliding with a train or until the champion(s) are exhausted the akuma will leave the victim.

title: Butterflies/Movie
text:
Butterflies/Movie - Failure
Unlike their original counterpart when an akuma isn't captured nor purified by the Ladybug miraculous holder instead of it multiplying it flies into sky likely returning to it's creator.

title: Butterflies/Movie
text:
Butterflies/Movie - Trivia
Unlike in the main show, instead of being normal butterflies turned magic, Akumas are literally created by the power of the Butterfly Miraculous.
Also, instead of the Butterfly Miraculous holder being limited to creating only one Akuma, there is no limit to how many the user can create.

title: Butterfly Miraculous/Movie
text:
Butterfly Miraculous/Movie - Intro
The Butterfly Miraculous is a locket brooch that whenever Nooroo inhabits it, transforms the wearer into a butterfly-themed superhero/supervillain.
The locket brooch was formerly owned by Gabriel Agreste, who used it to transform into Hawk Moth. He used the Miraculous for evil purposes, creating akumatized supervillains who attempted to steal Ladybug's and Cat Noir's Miraculouses to restore Emilie and their family.

title: Butterfly Miraculous/Movie
text:
Butterfly Miraculous/Movie - Appearance
The brooch is designed to resemble a butterfly or moth, a deep purple jewel in the middle, with  four pale purple strips extending out of it, like wings.
When in camouflaged mode, the miraculous is smaller and slightly rounder in shape than when in charged mode, and has a metallic appearance to it.

title: Butterfly Miraculous/Movie
text:
Butterfly Miraculous/Movie - Abilities
The butterfly miraculous has the ability to penetrate an obscure butterfly, also known as an akuma, into someone's heart and give that person powers.

title: Butterfly Miraculous/Movie
text:
Butterfly Miraculous/Movie - Trivia
Strangely, the Butterfly Miraculous in the movie seems to represent corruption rather than transmission.
Different from the series, where the akuma needs an object, the movie's akumas enter/penetrate people's hearts.
According to Master Fu, it's the most feared of the jewels.
Unlike it's TV show counterpart, it's currently unknown how the Butterfly and Peacock Miraculous ended up missing.

title: Butterfly Miraculous/Re-Verse
text:
Butterfly Miraculous/Re-Verse - Intro
The Butterfly Miraculous is a locket brooch that, whenever Nooroo inhabits it, transforms the wearer into a butterfly-themed superhero with the power of Transmission.
To activate the brooch, the user must speak the transformation phrase: "Light Wings Rise". To deactivate the brooch, the user must speak the detransformation phrase: "Light Wings Fall". To activate the brooch for evil purposes, the user must speak the transformation phrase: "Dark Wings Rise". To deactivate the brooch, the user must speak the detransformation phrase: "Dark Wings Fall".
The locket brooch is currently owned by Gabriel Agreste, who uses it to transform into Betterfly.

title: Butterfly Miraculous/Re-Verse
text:
Butterfly Miraculous/Re-Verse - Appearance
In general, the Butterfly Miraculous is a locket brooch and glows whenever someone is feeling emotions. In charged mode, when Nooroo inhabits it, is a dark purple button with a black lining with tiny curved lines, some of them branching out on the outer area of the brooch and a hinge at the left, making the locket brooch open, in which an image can be placed and four light purple strips coming out of it, making it resemble a butterfly or moth. If a minor is using the Butterfly Miraculous uses its Miraculous superpower, the brooch starts running out of power. It makes a beeping sound and the strips and gem start discoloring. (One part is equivalent to one minute) the holder has left.
In its activated mode, the brooch lacks the four strips with the gem is a discolored dark purple.
In its camouflage mode, the brooch changes color and form depending on whose possession it's in:
When worn by Marinette Dupain-Cheng, it looks similar to its activated mode, but the rim of the brooch is bronze.

title: Butterfly Miraculous/Re-Verse
text:
Butterfly Miraculous/Re-Verse - Abilities
The Butterfly Miraculous grants its wielder superhuman characteristics such as speed, strength, and agility.
Its special weapon is a cane which contains a hidden sword stick which can be used for fighting opponents. Furthermore, the cane can keep butterflies when the holder wants to kamikotize or akumatize people somewhere else. The cane can be used as an offensive weapon and a means of communication with other Miraculous owners.
Depending on how the Butterfly Miraculous is used, its superpower takes different names: if the Butterfly Miraculous holder uses it for benevolent purposes, the superpower is called Kamikotization. While, if it is used for evil purposes, the superpower is called Akumatization. After sensing a strong emotion from a person, the holder takes a normal butterfly and charges it with energy, transforming it into a Kamiko or an Akuma, which is then sent to possess a object belonging to that person. Once the akuma or kamiko possesses this item, a telepathic connection is formed between the recipient and the bearer of the Butterfly Miraculous and once an agreement is reached, the recipient is transformed into a superhero/supervillain.

title: Butterfly Miraculous/Re-Verse
text:
Butterfly Miraculous/Re-Verse - Abilities
Furthermore, the wielder can telepathically connect to the akumatized or kamiked person to speak with them and perceive what that person perceives. If the akumatized or kamiked person is using their powers wrongly or not the way the holder wants them to, the holder can cause pain to the kamikotized or akumatized person by controlling the person's body to a certain extent or take away their powers.
Even when disguised, the Butterfly Miraculous grants its wielder the ability to sense emotions in order to precisely pinpoint a targeted person's identity. Able to sense various people and their emotions, the wielder usually targets a person with the strongest emotions for the best manipulation.
The brooch also has the ability to give the wielder the costume they truly desire.

title: Butterfly Miraculous/Re-Verse
text:
Butterfly Miraculous/Re-Verse - Trivia
This Butterfly Miraculous is from a re-verse where it's used for heroic intentions.

title: Café Crème
text:
Café Crème - Intro
The , known as Le Café before Season 6, is a café located on the Place de la Sorbonne in the 5th arrondissement of Paris.

title: Café Crème
text:
Café Crème - Appearance
Exterior
Located near the fountain on the Place de la Sorbonne, the Café Crème is a place with a burgundy facade and awning. It has a terrace with many small white round tables with gold-colored wooden chairs with white cushions. This terrace is shaded by the trees of the square.
Starting in Season 6, the café got new name Café Crème and it has undergone a complete renovation. The facade was repainted a darker burgundy with elongated slate signs to better showcase the products and drinks served, as well as four rectangular windows with beige curtains that covered three-quarters of the interior. Additionally, three white and red-striped awnings were added: two small, standard ones and a larger, arched one above the entrance.
The terrace furniture has also been updated, now featuring round tables for two, wooden chairs with white seats, and red umbrellas. The terrace is also decorated with some green plants.
Interior
The interior of the cafe has beige walls with square columns whose lower parts are covered with wood, as well as a white and brown tiled floor forming rectangular patterns, and a brown brick ceiling.

His name is an anagram of capitalismo, the word for capitalism in various Romance languages, referencing his wealth and power.
Coincidentally, one of the female equivalents of Camilo is Camilla, and Camilla Hombee's name is also an anagram.

title: Canals of Amsterdam
text:
Canals of Amsterdam - Intro
The  are a network of canals totaling over 100 kilometers that have shaped the urbanization of Amsterdam, in the Netherlands.

title: Canals of Amsterdam
text:
Canals of Amsterdam - Description
The canals of Amsterdam extend over a total of more than 100 kilometers and are crossed by 1500 bridges, thus connecting 90 islands.
The central area of ​​these canals is the Grachtengordel. Known as the "canal belt" in English, it consists of four concentric canals spaced 80 to 150 meters apart, forming a very cohesive district with distinctive gabled buildings. Many of Amsterdam's museums and important landmarks are located within this area.
The first of its canals is the Singel. This is the very first canal in the city, which at the time served as a moat for the medieval city of Amsterdam until the beginning of its urban expansion in 1585.
The second is the Herengracht ("Patrician Canal"). It is very famous for its "Golden Bend" (Gouden Bocht) between the Leidsestraat and Vijzelstraat bridges.
The main attractions along this canal are the Biblical Museum, the Cat Museum (an art museum dedicated to cats), the Hendrikje Bag Museum, the Willet-Holthuysen Museum, and the Amsterdam Botanical Garden.

title: Canals of Amsterdam
text:
Canals of Amsterdam - Description
The Keizersgracht ("Emperor's Canal") is the third canal. It is home to, among other things, the Huis Marseille, the Netherlands' first photography museum, and the Homomonuement, a monument commemorating all those who have been victims of persecution because of their homosexuality.
The Prinsengracht ("Prince's Canal") is the last and longest canal in the Grachtengordel. It is particularly on the banks of this canal that the Anne Frank House is located, the building in which the Frank family attempted to hide from the roundups organized by the Third Reich and from which Anne Frank wrote her famous diary.

title: Canals of Amsterdam
text:
Canals of Amsterdam - Trivia
The main canals of Amsterdam have been a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 2010. under the title "Area of ​​17th-century concentric canals within the Singelgracht in Amsterdam".

title: Camilla Hombee/Actionverse
text:
Camilla Hombee/Actionverse - Intro
Camilla Hombee is the president of the United States of America, as well as the civilian identity of Victory, a superheroine and America's "super fighter". She also is a member of the American superhero team.

title: Camilla Hombee/Actionverse
text:
Camilla Hombee/Actionverse - Appearance
Physical appearance
Camilla is at a regular adult height with brown skin, golden brown eyes, and short curly reddish brown hair.
Civilian attire
She wears a tan trench coat and black boots. Over her natural hair, she wears a long, straight dark brown wig.
As Victory
Victory wears a dark blue mask. She wears a red, white, and blue body suit. The upper body and the upper arms are blue with a white star on each section. The hips and lower arms are solid red, and the rest of her body and her legs have red and white horizontal stripes. Additionally, she wears blue gloves, and she has blue boots with white marks on the fronts. She carries a white star-shaped shied.

title: Camilla Hombee/Actionverse
text:
Camilla Hombee/Actionverse - Personality
Camilla is proud, determined, and stubborn. She is a strong leader as she handles herself professionally in front of other superheroes, but she thinks highly of her ideas and isn't always open to other people's suggestions and insights. When others prove expertise and bravery that gain her appreciation, though, Camilla listens to their advice and trusts them as allies. Due to years of experiences with villains, viewing many of them as merciless, Camilla cares most about stopping them, not bothering to ask questions on their motives or identity until afterwards. She is willing to use whatever method it takes to save the day, even if it's catastrophic, and the safety of humanity matters greatly to her.

title: Camilla Hombee/Actionverse
text:
Camilla Hombee/Actionverse - Abilities
As civilian
Being the president, Camilla has skills in politics, communication and leadership.
As Victory
Like Victory, she carries a shield into battle and has access to an infinite number of military weapons hidden in secret compartments throughout New York.

title: Camilla Hombee/Actionverse
text:
Camilla Hombee/Actionverse - History
Miraculous Adventures
In "The Big Leagues", after Ladybug and Cat Noir return to the  American superheroes, Camilla flies onto the roof in a helicopter and jumps out. She removes her trench coat and her wig, transforming into a shielded heroine named Victory, who is President of the United States. She explains the situation to Ladybug and Cat Noir with the help of Uncanny Valley's scan about plan to stop Trash Krakken, which had begun terrorizing the city before noon, trapping several heroes. With the help of superheroes from across the country, she planned to cause a massive explosion that would destroy the Trash Krakken. Ladybug is hesitant, but Victory assures her that Ladybug, using her powers, can repair the damage. Victory refuses to believe it's dangerous. She's willing to take this risk to defeat the villain. She orders the other superheroes to prepare. Ladybug objects, but Victory stubbornly sticks to her plan, ignoring Ladybug and her experience. She returns to the helicopter, giving orders, first and foremost, for Majestia and Uncanny Valley to go into orbit to join the other heroes.

title: Camilla Hombee/Actionverse
text:
Camilla Hombee/Actionverse - History
In "Battle for New York", Sparrow is captured by the villain, after which Knightowl calls Victory to begin the operation. She signals everyone to prepare. After defeating the Trash Krakken, the American superheroes, still on the same rooftop, thanked Ladybug and Cat Noir for their help, did the "Pound It". Before returning to Paris, Ladybug gives Victory samples of the unknown substance she obtained, which turned Kenya's father into the Trash Krakken. Victory promises to recruit the best scientists, seeing them home and saying goodbye.

title: Camilla Hombee/Actionverse
text:
Camilla Hombee/Actionverse - Relationships
Acquaintances
Ladybug
Camilla is aware of Ladybug's Miraculous Ladybug, and she puts trust in the ability to revert everything to normal after using a powerful and destructive attack on the Trash Krakken. However, she sees Ladybug in an inferior light, describing her as "the superheroes' cleaning lady" and considering akumatized villains to be nowhere near as serious or dangerous as other types of villains. Additionally, though she listens to Ladybug's questions and concerns about her plan to defeating the Trash Krakken, she doesn't think them over, strongly feeling like the current plan is the one option they have. However, she believes in Ladybug as an essential role for the superheroes' success to save New York. She shows respect towards Ladybug after Ladybug finds another solution that defeats the Trash Krakken, and she assures her that scientists will look into the unknown black substance that created the monster as she leaves.

Camilla revealed her secret identity to the public so that she would have a better chance of making it through the election.
Based on her outfit, a costume decorated in the style of the American Flag, and her very prominent use of a shield, it's likely she was based on the Marvel Comics character Captain America.
To communicate with her allies, Victory has a special phone, painted in the colors of her costume.
