title: Cat Miraculous
text:
Cat Miraculous - Intro
The , also known as the Black Cat Miraculous, is a ring that, whenever Plagg inhabits it, transforms the wearer into a black cat-themed superhuman with the power of Destruction.
To activate the ring, its user must speak the transformation phrase: Claws Out. To deactivate the ring, its user must speak the detransformation phrase: Claws In. To activate the ring for evil purposes, the user must speak the transformation phrase: Daggers Out. To deactivate the ring, the user must speak the detransformation phrase: Daggers In.
The ring is currently owned by Adrien Agreste, who uses it to transform into Cat Noir.

title: Cat Miraculous
text:
Cat Miraculous - Appearance
In charged mode, the ring has a thick band with a circle surface surrounded by a lining with four pointed diamond shapes on each diagonal side. It's black with a glowing chartreuse cat paw print in the middle of the circle. If a minor is using the ring, it’ll start running out of power if they've activated Cataclysm, making a beeping sound, with one pad of the paw print disappearing every minute as an indication (one paw print is equivalent to one minute) Adrien (or another Cat Miraculous holder) has left before they detransform.
In Season 6 onwards, the ring is now a dark gray color and the paw print has claws.
In activated mode, it loses the paw print making the ring pure black.
In camouflage mode, the ring changes form depending on who wears it:
When worn by Adrien Agreste, it is silver, and the circle is blank.
When Cat Noir was akumatized into Cat Blanc and kamikotized into Celesticat it became pure white, with the inner circle being blank.
When worn by Marinette Dupain-Cheng, the ring was smaller and rose gold, its band was a bit thinner while the circle was blank and slightly raised.
When worn by Zoé Lee, the ring was pink, and the circle was blue.

title: Cat Miraculous
text:
Cat Miraculous - Abilities
When it's used to transform, the Cat Miraculous grants its holder a black cat themed costume that they truly desire as well as incredible superhuman powers of strength, speed, agility, and endurance. Its special weapon is a staff, which can be utilized as a weapon, a communicator, and a rebreather. Its special superpower is Cataclysm, which gives the user the ability to damage or destroy an object, such as structures, akumas' hiding places, or metal bars. It also provides its holder with cat like abilities such as super stealth, night vision and enhanced hearing. However, if the Cat Miraculous holder is a child, using Cataclysm will force them to detransform after five minutes. An evil holder can override this and use Cataclysm indefinitely, but at a great cost.
The Cat and Ladybug Miraculouses are also more powerful than the rest of the Miraculouses. If they're used together along with a special invocation, their holder will achieve the absolute power to alter reality to their wishes. However, because the universe must maintain balance, every action has an equal and opposite reaction; for instance, a wish to become human would result in someone else losing their humanity.

title: Cat Miraculous
text:
Cat Miraculous - Abilities
The other power is the Miraculous Cat Noir, unlocked by Cat Noir, in "Revelator". If there is something that is a causal effect caused indirectly by the supervillain and/or a crisis that the Miraculous Ladybug is unable to fix due to not being a "damage" (like revealed secrets), the holder throws the cataclysm power in the air and says Miraculous [the hero's name of the Cat Noir Miraculous holder], causing the Cataclysm to explode into a massive Cataclysm swarm that flies around the specific area and destroy the intended phenomena. So far, this power was used to erased specific memories originated indirectly by a supervillain's power.
Power-Ups
After Plagg consumes one of several special potions or a food made with one, and the Cat Miraculous holder transforms, or if they consume a special potion or a food made with them after they've transformed, they are able to unlock a power-up, an additional specific ability granted by each potion. So far, only seven potions have been shown, each with a unique color:
The green potion transforms Plagg into "Aqua Plagg" and grants its user the ability to breathe underwater and improves their swimming capability with flippers added on their feet.

title: Cat Miraculous
text:
Cat Miraculous - Abilities
The cyan potion transforms Plagg into "Plagg Glacier" and grants its user the ability to resist cold temperatures and to move freely on ice with ice skates on their feet.
The purple potion transforms Plagg into an unknown space form and grants its user the ability to move freely and breathe in high altitudes and space.
A red potion that grants unknown powers.
A yellow potion that grants unknown powers.
An orange potion that grants unknown powers.
A pink potion that grants unknown powers.

title: Cat Miraculous
text:
Cat Miraculous - History
Five thousand years ago, a mage successfully helped the kwamis to interact with humans by creating magic jewels, which were called Miraculouses. In order to repay the mage, and to live on the physical world alongside humans, the kwamis decided to help humanity by letting humans utilize their energy and powers through the Miraculous they were bonded with, which included Plagg and the Cat Miraculous.
At some point in time, all of the knowledge about the Miraculouses and their powers was written down in code in a book called the Grimoire, with very few people knowing how to decipher the code. Miracle Boxes were also created at an unknown time to store the dormant Miraculouses. To protect and distribute Miraculouses, the Order of the Guardians was formed and existed for many years. Throughout its existence, guardians trained younger generations to keep a watchful eye over the Miraculouses and the Grimoire, which were placed in the guardians' temple. The Cat Miraculous, meant for good purposes, has been used by many heroes throughout history.

title: Cat Miraculous
text:
Cat Miraculous - History
Many Cat holders throughout history used Plagg's power for good, including Hēi Māo in China, who started the legacy. Others include Dark Grimalkin, a holder from England that fought against the dragons and later against Scarlet Fate during the Hundred Years War before falling in love with her, and upon being captured, relinquished the Cat Miraculous.

title: Cat Miraculous
text:
Cat Miraculous - History
172 years ago, after an disastrous event where a young Wang Fu used the Peacock Miraculous to create a sentimonster and his negative emotions and imaturity led to the creature rampaging through the temple and eating and destroying everything in its path, Fu was entrusted with the Chinese Miracle Box (Which included the Cat Miraculous) by a monk and was told to run away from the mess. However, on the mountain range outside the temple, in order to escape from the the monster, Fu jumped over a fissure on the ground - accidently opening the Box and spilling all of its contents on the snow. Due to his distress, Fu didnt notice he accidently left both the Peacock and the Butterfly on the mountain, alongisde the Grimoire, until it was too late and he was too far away to come back. Somewhere along the line, the Peacock got dangerously damaged, to the point of being improper for use - but, as it turns out, no one knew of this fact until it was too late.

title: Cat Miraculous
text:
Cat Miraculous - History
On a previous trip overseas with the Agrestes, Nathalie found the Butterfly and Peacock Miraculouses and gave the jewels to Gabriel. In "Representation", it was revealed that neither the Agrestes nor the Graham de Vanily couples could bear children on their own, so Émilie and Colt used the Peacock Miraculous to create Adrien and Félix respectively, but in doing so, they grew sick over time and were eventually left in a condition where they fell into an eternal slumber due to using the Peacock Miraculous in its damaged state.
Desperate to fix his mistake, Gabriel Agreste began using the Butterfly Miraculous for evil to obtain the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses in order to gain access to their absolute power, becoming the supervillain Hawk Moth, later Shadow Moth (when unified with a now fixed Peacock Miraculous). This decision proved one of the most significant for the history of the series, as Gabriel began utilizing Nooroo's power to akumatize the civilians of Paris, France, trying to get one of them to draw out the current holders of the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses.

title: Cat Miraculous
text:
Cat Miraculous - History
Adrien Agreste was ultimately chosen by Wang Fu to wield the Cat Miraculous in "Ladybug & Cat Noir", using it to transform into the hero Cat Noir, tasked with stopping Kawk Moth and his akumatized villains and recovering the Butterfly Miraculous back to the side of good. Throughout his journey, Adrien unified it with the Snake and Rabbit Miraculouses to transform into Snake Noir and Rabbit Noir in "Miracle Queen" and "Evolution", respectively. During the events of "Kuro Neko", he briefly used Cat Walker as his temporary identity.
In "Reflekdoll", the ring was used by Marinette Dupain-Cheng in order to become Lady Noire. Marinette continues to utilize the Miraculous in special, highly specific situations whenever a swap is needed, like during "Passion". Later, she unified it with Mouse Miraculous to transform into Multinoire in "Kwamibuster" and the Ladybug to transform into Bug Noire in "Conformation", "Re-creation", and "Miraculous London".
In "Ephemeral", in an alternate timeline, Gabriel unifies the Cat Miraculous with the Butterfly and the Peacock to transform into Shadow Noir, but the event was erased from the timeline after Sass's interception.

title: Cat Miraculous
text:
Cat Miraculous - History
In "Transmission", the ring was given to and used by Zoé Lee to become Kitty Noire, as she became the primary holder of the Cat Miraculous after Plagg had set Adrien free from his mission so he could be in love with Marinette, but in "Deflagration", she had to renounce the offical title and relinquish the Miraculous back to Adrien after her secret identity was compromised. In the same episode, Monarch had managed to steal the Cat Miraculous from Zoé and nearly unified it with the Butterfly and Ladybug before being stopped by Plagg, who, heroically, destroyed his own Miraculous to save everyone. By the end of the episode, Ladybug fixed the Cat Miraculous, stole it back from Monarch, and later, told Plagg to give it back to Cat Noir.

title: Cat Miraculous
text:
Cat Miraculous - History
In "Re-creation", Gabriel managed to steal both Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses from Marinette and used them to summon Gimmi and make his wish of restoring Nathalie's health, at the cost of his own life, with Marinette recovering them both after the wish had been made. In "Miraculous London", Lila stole all of the Miraculous under Marinette's care in an alternate timeline, which included the Cat Miraculous, later fusing it with the Ladybug to make her wish come true, but her plan was ultimately thwarted by the combined efforts of Chronobug and Bunnyx, and the event was erased from the timeline.

title: Cat Miraculous
text:
Cat Miraculous - History
After the events of "Miraculous London", Marinette, having realized both instances of all of the Miraculouses being stolen happened because all of them were kept in the same place, and with the idea that centralized power is inherently flawed, and that distributing it among members of a society is a far superior idea, upgraded the Cat Miraculous by altering its original design and adding the Miraculous Call: a call feature that grants the holder the ability to summon other superheroes who possess a Miraculous from the Chinese Miracle Box in order to receive aid on their missions. This new feature is particularly useful, as the new holder of the Butterfly Miraculous, Chrysalis, is even more fearsome than her predecessor.
In "Mister Agreste", the eponymous villain managed to steal the Cat Miraculous off Cat Noir's finger after the hero was left trapped underneath debris, but Adrien was capable of escaping and avoided revealing his secret identity via a subway entrance. After being deakumatized, a mortified Théo gave the Miraculous back to Ladybug, who promptly tasked Plagg with the job of getting himself and the ring back to Cat Noir. The two reunited shortly after off-screen.

title: Cane
text:
Cane - Intro
The  is the tool of the Butterfly Miraculous.
The current owner of the Cane is Cerise Bianca after she acquired the Butterfly Miraculous in "Re-creation" to become the supervillain Chrysalis.
It was previously owned by Gabriel Agreste when he became a villain under the aliases of Hawk Moth, Shadow Moth, and finally Monarch.

title: Cane
text:
Cane - Appearance
The cane changes color depending on whose possession it's in:
When owned by Chrysalis, the cane's gemstone is lilac with a butterfly on the side of it and part of the cane is decorated with a thin purple spiral. The holder can wield the cane in their hand or keep it on their back when not in use.
When owned by Hawk Moth/Shadow Moth, the cane is dark purple and smooth. There is a purple gemstone with black lines within a cylinder on top. There is also a silver sword inside the cane, with the round stone and cylinder being its hilt and pommel. The cane is roughly half as tall as its wielder. The holder can wield the cane in their hand or keep it on their back when not in use.
When owned by Scarlet Moth, it was bright red.
When owned by Monarch, the cane remains the same, but now it is slightly longer.

title: Cane
text:
Cane - Abilities
Like all Miraculous tools, the cane is virtually indestructible. So far, only Cataclysm has been shown to be capable of damaging or destroying it. The cane contains a hidden blade, making it a swordstick/cane-sword for combat and defense, as shown in "Robostus". The blade is sharp enough to slice a missile cleanly in half. It can also be wielded as a blunt melee weapon. In "Cat Blanc", it is revealed that the cane can be summoned to the wielder's hand if they lose it, though only if they are in relatively close proximity to the cane itself.
The stone on the cane can hold an akuma if its object is destroyed, but the akuma isn't purified, as Hawk Moth does with the Akuma used for Ivan Bruel in "Ladybug & Cat Noir". Once the original victim is vulnerable again, as seen with Ivan in the next episode, the wielder releases the akuma. In "Backwarder", it is revealed that the cane has the power to keep the butterflies that Hawk Moth uses to create his akumas. In "Miraculer", it's revealed that the cane can be used as a phone by opening the stone at the top.

title: Cane
text:
Cane - Abilities
In "Catalyst", the cane served as Scarlet Moth's power source after receiving enhancement from Catalyst. With it, he could turn butterflies into akumas by tapping them with it, summoning infinite amounts of akumas seemingly out of nowhere and directing his Scarlet Army by raising it. Once it was destroyed, however, the scarlet akumas reverted to normal butterflies.

title: Cane
text:
Cane - Trivia
Canne de combat, translated from French to cane fighting, is a martial arts style created in France. Hawk Moth has displayed a few of the techniques involved when he spins his cane before slamming it on the ground.
It's the fifth Miraculous tool to be revealed to be able to be used for communication, following the Ladybug Miraculous' yo-yo, the Cat Miraculous' staff, the Bee Miraculous' spinning top, and the Peacock Miraculous' hand fan. The sixth is the Fox Miraculous' flute.
The cane is the first Miraculous tool to be an amokized object.
It's also the first amokized object to be used to create multiple sentimonsters (the Butterfly Sentimonster in "Mayura" and "Miracle Queen", Sentialec and Sentinino in "Optigami", Hack-San in the episode of the same name, and Strikeback in "Risk").
In "Backwarder", the butterfly in the cane is a normal butterfly, and Hawk Moth infects it with energy before sending it out. However, in all other instances, it is already an akuma/megakuma, and he just sends it out.
For an unknown reason, Monarch's cane is slightly longer than Hawk Moth's/Shadow Moth's, as seen by the placement of the arms at the end of the transformations.

title: Captain Hardrock
text:
Captain Hardrock - Intro
"" is a season 2 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 16th written and produced episode of season 2. It is also the 42nd written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Captain Hardrock
text:
Captain Hardrock - Synopsis
Hawk Moth akumatizes Juleka's mother into Captain Hardrock, a pirate whose indestructible ship blasts loud music to destroy a music festival.
Netflix and Disney Channel
Juleka's mother gets akumatized into Captain Hardrock; steering an inpregnable ship and armed with a pirate sword, she wants to blast her music across Paris.
Disney+
Ladybug faces Juleka's mother, now Captain Hardrock.

title: Captain Hardrock
text:
Captain Hardrock - Plot
Marinette, Alya, Nino, Rose, Juleka, Ivan, and Mylène are all helping to set up the Couffaine houseboat for a music festival. While cleaning up, Marinette expresses worry since Adrien has not shown up yet. Alya reassures Marinette that Adrien will arrive soon and just to make certain asks Nino when Adrien will arrive. Nino explains that Adrien had something to do with his father, but he will come right after. Suddenly, Juleka’s mother, Anarka, arrives on the scene and after seeing that Marinette is cleaning the houseboat, she tells her not to as her family likes the “lived in” look.
At the Agreste mansion, Adrien is playing the piano for his father and Nathalie, but accidentally makes a mistake. Gabriel tells Adrien to stop and asks if he has been practicing. Adrien believes that he’ll improve when he gets a chance to perform with his friends, but Gabriel tells him that Agrestes are soloists, not group members, and to practice some more to show him later. Adrien reminds his father that he promised that he’d let him go to the concert with his friends, but Gabriel says after Adrien’s performance, he needs to regain focus. He then leaves Adrien’s room with Nathalie.

title: Captain Hardrock
text:
Captain Hardrock - Plot
Nino gets a phone call from Adrien, who tells him that he can no longer come to the concert, which Marinette and Alya overhear. Marinette is upset over missing a chance to hang out with Adrien. Alya reminds Marinette that it’s not the first time Adrien’s dad stopped him from hanging out with his friends. Suddenly, Anarka arrives on the scene and spots Alya putting a metal statue on top of the ship’s compass. She explains that metal must never come near a compass since it attracts the needle. Marinette compares herself and Adrien to the compass and statue, believing that she is the statue and Adrien is the compass since they may be meant to stay apart. Alya, however, believes that Adrien is the statue and Marinette is the compass that goes crazy whenever he’s near. She then reassures Marinette that they’ll be other chances, but Marinette isn’t convinced. Rose then pops in and says that while everything is ready, Luka appears to be missing. Anarka asks Marinette to go get Luka, which Marinette, in turn, asks who Luka is. After Anarka explains that Luka is her son and where to find him, Marinette goes to get him.

title: Captain Hardrock
text:
Captain Hardrock - Plot
Marinette goes down to Luka’s cabin. After seeing him sitting cross-legged on top of his bed, she unintentionally stutters while trying to introduce herself and says that everyone is waiting for him. Luka says hello and playfully teases her stuttering, but quickly apologizes and explains that he usually makes more sense with his guitar, which he begins to play. Marinette sits down on Luka’s bed and listens. She is amazed by his talent. Luka explains that he finds music to be simpler than words. Marinette gets off the bed and walks over to a picture of Jagged Stone and Luka's collection of guitar picks. She picks up a Jagged Stone guitar pick. Luka and Marinette both express that Jagged Stone is their favorite singer. Then Luka tells Marinette she can keep the Jagged Stone guitar pick. He says to Marinette that he is going to join the "groove"; a reference to when Marinette was trying to say the group, but she said groove instead. Feeling embarrassed, Luka makes Marinette feel better by complimenting she is a funny girl. Marinette looks at Luka while he walks away and she looks at her new guitar pick before putting the guitar pick in her pocket.

title: Captain Hardrock
text:
Captain Hardrock - Plot
Back in Adrien's room, Adrien is watching the news about the music festival. Nadja Chamack and André Bourgeois are discussing the list of performers, such as Jagged Stone and XY. Nadja mentions the music festival could the biggest music festival since the event's debut in 1982. Plagg tries to cheer Adrien up by pointing out the bright side of seeing all of the concerts in his room. Adrien tells Plagg he only wanted to see his friends' concert. To try to cheer Adrien up again, Plagg performs a private concert with him singing about his love for cheese. Although Adrien appreciates Plagg for trying, he is still sad and he goes back to practicing the piano.

title: Captain Hardrock
text:
Captain Hardrock - Plot
Marinette joins everyone on the boat, where Luka is playing on his electric guitar. Alya notices Marinette and Luka are looking at each other and she comments that Marinette has found a new "statue." Marinette, however, denies this. Anarka tells the band to give them a show whenever Luka is ready. Luka pulls off a big sheet covering the tall speakers. Mylène then gives Alya and Marinette earplugs and tells them that they are going to need them. After they put them on, Luka sherds his guitar which makes a very loud sound that’s enough to make cars on the streets go flying.
Alya, Marinette, and Nino are shocked by how loud it was. Police helicopters, boats, and cars rush over to the houseboat and Roger Raincomprix comes out. He proclaims that Anarka’s volume is too high and she’ll have to play something else. She, however, refuses. Roger threatens to shut down her concert if she doesn’t turn down her volume. She continually refuses to change anything. As a result, he writes up a couple of tickets for her. Anarka rips up the tickets while she laughs. Raincomprix is so frusturated he begins to write even more tickets.

title: Captain Hardrock
text:
Captain Hardrock - Plot
In his lair, Hawk Moth senses Anarka's irritation and he sends an akuma to her. The akuma possesses the Liberty's binnacle and transforms her into Captain Hardrock. When the band refuses to play, Captain Hardrock tells the Liberty to bind them in chains and throw them down into the hold. Captain Hardrock fires speakers onto the Eiffel Tower, where Jagged Stone was performing. Harsh noise is emitted from the speakers, which forces the preformers to leave the general area. Adrien sees the news alert in his room about the warning. Adrien transforms and leaps through his window to confront her.
Down in the the hold, Tikki winks at Marinette from her bag and magically opens the lock imprisoning her and Luka. With the chains loose, he asked Marinette how she managed to do it, with her claiming that she used the guitar pick he gifted her earlier to pick the lock. Luka is amazed and compliments Marinette. Alya gets them to focus on their predicament next, but when they're about to free the others, Captain Hardrock goes to the hold and sees them escaping, missing the chance to free the others.

title: Captain Hardrock
text:
Captain Hardrock - Plot
She breaks into Luka's room as he was shouting out the open window, suggesting Marinette escaped through it. Captain Hardrock commands the ship to re-capture Luka. She looks through the window, but doesn't see Marinette, so she goes back abovedeck. Marinette pushes a cabinet under Luka's bed, revealing that she was hiding inside of it. Marinette transforms.
Up on the main deck, Captain Hardrock shot her speakers at the XY stage. The noise again forced the people around to flee. While looking for more performers to sabotage, she sees Cat Noir and begins to shoot at him. When he lands on deck, the Liberty manages to capture him. But Ladybug arrives just in time to break him free.
As Ladybug and Cat Noir begin to fight off the Captain Hardrock's attacks, Roger and other officers try to tell Captain Hardrock to stop her attack while chasing her in their boats. Captain Hardrock blasts them out of the water and Ladybug uses her yo-yo to catch them.

title: Captain Hardrock
text:
Captain Hardrock - Plot
Ladybug and Cat Noir continue to fight Captain Hardrock as they try to find her akuma. While they are talking, she blasts the speakers onto Clara Nightingale's preforming area. Cat Noir and Ladybug try to take the ship off of its course in vain. Captain Hardrock responds by telling them that the ship only responds to her.
As Cat Noir is fighting Captain Hardrock, Ladybug goes into the hold to save the rest of her classmates. After she frees them, Luka asks if Marinette is alright. Ladybug responds by saying she is the one who alerted her. She blushes as Luka says that she is brave. Cat Noir is captured by Captain Hardrock and Hawkmoth reminds her to take his ring. Just as she reaches for the ring, Ladybug pulls her down from the mast she bound Cat Noir to. Roger attempted to follow the Liberty and throw Captain Hardrock on a paddle boat. She blasts him out of the water again, but Ladybug and Cat Noir end up hiding.

title: Captain Hardrock
text:
Captain Hardrock - Plot
Ladybug and Cat Noir are on the bow of the ship. She uses her Lucky Charm to tie Captain Hardrock to the ship, which spins in circles because of the compass. The ship then stops at land and Cat Noir uses his Cataclysm to destroy the ship. Ladybug purifies the akuma and uses Miraculous Ladybug to return the city to normal. Back at the Agreste mansion, Adrien asks his father to play a piece as a duet, and Gabriel agrees. Finally, Adrien is allowed to go to the concert. He hugs his father before setting off.
Meanwhile, Roger Raincomprix is checking the noise level, and he agrees to allow them to play at the music festival. Then Adrien comes and accidentally knocks over a box containing a keyboard. Adrien calls it an original ZX20.4 keyboard in shock making it sound like it is a rare or at least a very good keyboard. He says he knows how to play it, and joins the concert before the end card appears.

title: Captain Hardrock
text:
Captain Hardrock - Plot Developments
Similar to Ladybug and her Lucky Charm:
When Cat Noir used Cataclysm to destroy the ship's compass, the ship itself went with it but it when came to the bus console in "Animan" only that was destroyed and the bus was still standing. It could be back then, that he exerted extra focus because they needed the bus for the plan to work hinting that his power could be controlled by willpower.
Gabriel tells Adrien that Agrestes have always been soloists, hinting that he and his son have other relatives with that surname.
However, as revealed in "Revelation", this is not true, as Gabriel's real last name is Grassette, and the last name Agreste  was invented by him.

title: Captain Hardrock
text:
Captain Hardrock - Trivia
This episode is the first to:
Premiere in USA on Netflix and the only one to do so.
Be revealed when a concept art of Captain Hardrock's ship was shown during a Nolife interview.
Air in the US before being aired in other countries, later being followed by "Ikari Gozen", "Miraculous New York", "Wishmaker", "Ladybug Saves Christmas", "Qilin", "Risk", and "Daddycop".
Have someone's house turn into an akumatized object.
That Ladybug uses Miraculous Ladybug after the villain was deakumatized.
In the French version, the episode is called "Capitaine Hardrock".
This episode reveals that Luka also likes Jagged Stone and he is his favorite singer.
This is the second episode where an akumatized villain does not have constant possession of the akumatized item to retain his or her powers following "The Dark Owl".
When the ship lands on the ground, the couple sitting on a bench right before it appears to be eating one of André's ice cream cones.
References
The scene where Cat Noir jumped out of the window after finishing his transformation is a recycled scene from "The Collector".
The class photo that was taken near the end of "Reflekta" can be seen in Juleka's room.

title: Captain Hardrock
text:
Captain Hardrock - Trivia
This is the fourth time Cat Noir used his cataclysm to destroy an akumatized object and on the biggest akumatized object yet.
Plagg sings off-key in the episode, but in "Santa Claws", he sings perfectly.
Allusions
Nadja Chamack's phrase when she broadcasts the news about the National Music Festival is "Tune in here.. to hear more tunes." The Festival refers to Make Music Day, celebrated worldwide on June 21 since 1982.
According to Thomas Astruc, this episode references French singer Richard Gotainer (who wrote a song called Capitaine Hard Rock as a reference to Captain Haddock from The Adventures of Tintin, and Captain Harlock, the space pirate.
When Luka calls Marinette "a funny girl" reference to the song "Belle" in Disney "Beauty and the Beast" films.
Errors
Penny's hair is miscolored gray instead of purple.
Gabriel's eyes are colored dark gray in some shots.
When Luka giggles at Marinette’s stuttering, his shirt is black instead of white.
When Anarka is akumatized, she doesn't have either a red or purple shadow on her face unlike other akumatized villains.

title: Captain Hardrock
text:
Captain Hardrock - Trivia
When Marinette opens the door to run away with Luka from Captain Hardrock, Nino's head is rotated at 180 degrees for a few seconds.
The poster of Jagged Stone disappears from Luka's room when Captain Hardrock enters his room.
Gabriel's hair is not colored for a few seconds.
Nino's hair is missing when Captain Hardrock exits Luka's room.
During the scene when Cat Noir leaps from speakers to speakers behind the blue background, everything disappears in one frame.
In the scene where Luka compliments how brave Marinette is in front of Ladybug, the drawstrings of his sweater are not visible.

title: Captain Hardrock/Transcript
text:

Gabriel: I've heard enough. Are you sure you're practicing, Adrien?

Gabriel: We Agrestes are soloists. We're no where group members. I suggest you rehearse your piece some more. You'll play it for me again later today.

(Marinette becomes sad and turns away. Alya and Nino look at each other; Nino nods and walks away. Alya walks over to her)

title: Captain Hardrock/Transcript
text:

text:

title: Captain Hardrock/Transcript
text:

I'm giving you an indestructible ship and you will use it to sale around Paris and blast your music out everywhere you go as loudly as you please. Luka: You're amazing. A real magician Marinette.

title: Captain Hardrock/Transcript
text:

Alya: Excuse me, but some of us are still chained up here you know. (Captain Hardrock walks downstairs laughing)

title: Captain Hardrock/Transcript
text:

title: Captain Hardrock/Transcript
text:

title: Captain Hardrock/Transcript
text:

text:
Cat Blanc - Intro
"" is a season 3 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 22nd written and produced episode of season 3. It is also the 74th written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Cat Blanc
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Cat Blanc - Synopsis
Netflix
Marinette uses her powers to leave a gift for Adrien, causing him to realize her secret identity - which has a devastating impact on the future.
Disney Channel
When Marinette makes a serious mistake she has to face the consequence of fighting the last person she'd ever imagine get akumatized.
Disney+
Ladybug faces Cat Noir... akumatized into Cat Blanc.

title: Cat Blanc
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Cat Blanc - Plot
In his repository, Gabriel tells Émilie that he misses her but will get Ladybug's and Cat Noir's Miraculouses in order to repair their past mistakes. Meanwhile at Trocadéro, the girls wait for Marinette to come back from giving a gift to Adrien for his fifth name's day. Alya is confident that she'll do it, but Alix is sure she won't. Alix bets her skates that Marinette won't, and Rose bets her favorite unicorn plush that Marinette will. The girls then spot Marinette coming back and see that she didn't deliver her gift, much to their disappointment. Marinette expresses doubt as to whether or not Adrien will like the gift, though Alya tells her that the only way to know is by giving it to him. Rose firmly tells Marinette that until she delivers her gift, there will be no more picnics, sleepovers or movies, therefore giving Marinette the motivation she needs to follow through. She heads to the Agreste mansion, and on her way, Tikki asks Marinette if she's really going to give her gift to Adrien.

title: Cat Blanc
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Cat Blanc - Plot
Marinette says that she won't take no for an answer. However, once she arrives at the mansion, she learns from Nathalie on the intercom that Adrien isn't home. Marinette asks her when he'll be home, but Nathalie doesn't know and hangs up. Marinette is perplexed since Adrien's fencing tournament should've already ended. Tikki suggests Marinette give her gift to him at school, but remembering what Rose had said, Marinette decides to sneak the gift into Adrien's room as Ladybug. Tikki is against Marinette using her powers for personal reasons, but Marinette promises to be quick and transforms into Ladybug, who then enters Adrien's room through an open window. Once inside, she immediately begins admiring all his possessions.
Once arriving home, Nathalie tells Adrien that he is very late, to which Adrien says that the award ceremony of the fencing class took longer than expected, and they dropped Kagami off at home.
Nathalie lets Adrien in, and on the way to his room, he asks her to tell his father that he won, to which Nathalie says she'll do once he finishes working.
Meanwhile, Ladybug continues to admire Adrien's things until she remembers the gift.

title: Cat Blanc
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Cat Blanc - Plot
She places it on his bed and prepares to leave when she realizes that she didn't sign it.
So she grabs a pencil and puts her signature on the card before taking off.
Unbeknownst to her, as she is leaving, Adrien comes into his room and sees her.
He spots Marinette's gift, a beret, on his bed and wonders why Ladybug would leave a gift from Marinette in his room.
Plagg suggests that maybe Marinette asked her to, but Adrien quickly realizes that Marinette and Ladybug are the same person and the boy Ladybug had once said she loved was him.
Plagg tries to deny it, but it's too late.
Plagg reminds Adrien that he and Ladybug shouldn't know each other's identities, but Adrien insists that she doesn't need to know his identity just because he knows hers and promises that everything will be okay.
Putting the beret on his head, he runs out of his room to find Marinette, while Plagg compares the situation to smelly cheese, saying that putting it in a box won't stop it from smelling.
While heading back to Trocadéro, Ladybug is met by Bunnyx, who informs her that something had happened to cause a disaster in the future.

title: Cat Blanc
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Cat Blanc - Plot
She asks Ladybug if she did anything abnormal, but Ladybug cannot think of anything, so she takes her inside her Burrow.
Ladybug looks around and sees many points in the past and future, so Bunnyx puts a bowl over her head to prevent her from seeing anything and questions her to know what she's getting for her next birthday, the 15th year, and Ladybug answers that she didn't.
She lectures Ladybug that avoiding interference with time is standard procedure, but the situation is desperate as their very future is at risk; as she says this, Bunnyx's right arm begins to glitch and fade.
She takes them through a portal to the rooftop of the Montparnasse tower.
Below is a future Paris, rendered a devastated wasteland; the Eiffel Tower has been toppled over, the buildings and streets are submerged underwater, and the moon, visible in the oddly bleached grey sky, appears to have been cracked in two.
Ladybug asks what happened, but Bunnyx insists that the less Ladybug knows about what happened in this timeline, the better.
Her only instructions are for Ladybug to capture the akuma and restore order.

title: Cat Blanc
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Cat Blanc - Plot
She heads back inside her Burrow in order to be able to jump back into time in case anything goes wrong.
Once she's gone, Ladybug spots an akumatized Cat Noir (completely white and with blue eyes) singing to himself on top of the building's edge.
Cat Noir, now Cat Blanc, is delighted to see Ladybug, exclaiming that he thought he'd lost her forever and prepares to snatch her earrings, only for Ladybug to kick him away and ask what's the matter with him.
Cat Blanc apologizes for being rude and asks for her Miraculous, stating that he's made some mistakes and tearfully pleads for Ladybug to save him.
Sympathizing, Ladybug looks around him to see where his akuma could be, only for Cat Blanc to say that it's in his broken heart before attacking her.
As the two battle and jump off the roof, Cat Blanc reveals that he knows she's Marinette, which shocks Ladybug since she never told him that.
Bunnyx watches this unfold from her Burrow and sees the point in time when Marinette as Ladybug left her gift for Adrien in his room.

title: Cat Blanc
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Cat Blanc - Plot
She then sees Marinette go back to the girls, with her hair down, and delightfully explains that she gave her gift to Adrien, causing Alix to give Rose her unicorn plushie back.
Bunnyx is perplexed since she doesn't remember that happening and sees that her own unicorn plushie has faded.
She looks further and sees that after Marinette had told the girls that she put her gift in Adrien's room, Adrien had come by, confessed his love to Marinette, and the two kissed, much to the other girls' delight.
She then looks back to where Ladybug is fighting Cat Blanc on top of a floating bus, who demands that she give him her Miraculous so that he can fix everything.
He fires a Mega Cataclysm at her, which she barely dodges.
The attack topples the entire Montparnasse Tower, much to Bunnyx's horror.
The impact as the building hits the water shakes the Burrow, and Bunnyx grows more frantic to find out what caused all this.

title: Cat Blanc
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Cat Blanc - Plot
Adrien and Marinette become an official couple, which is even reported on the news by Nadja Chamack. Meanwhile, Cat Blanc tells Ladybug that everything had been perfect until Hawk Moth found out about their love, claiming that's what caused the terrible destruction. Bunnyx wonders how and sees a point in time when Gabriel tells Marinette that her dating Adrien is making the Agreste brand look bad and she must end the relationship, threatening to remove Adrien from school if she doesn't. Tom and Sabine are angry that Gabriel is breaking their daughter's heart and demand that Nathalie leave their bakery at once. Later, Marinette visits the Agreste mansion and breaks up with Adrien, much to Adrien's heartbreak. Adrien wants to go after her, but his bodyguard prevents him from doing so. Nathalie watches this unfold from the window of Gabriel's atelier and informs Hawk Moth that everything is going according to plan. Hawk Moth creates an akuma and sends it after Marinette, confident that her pure and utter despair will bring about his "masterpiece".

title: Cat Blanc
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Cat Blanc - Plot
Meanwhile, Adrien tearfully begs his bodyguard to let him go after Marinette, to which he reluctantly agrees. While heading towards her, he notices the akuma and, in a great panic and out of fear, he transforms into Cat Noir and destroys it with his Cataclysm, much to Marinette's shock. It is then that Cat Noir reveals that he's been aware that she was Ladybug, and the two get back together. Nathalie, who also witnessed Adrien's transformation, informs Hawk Moth that his son is Cat Noir. Though he is shocked at first, he quickly declares that the Miraculouses will soon be his. The window that Bunnyx is viewing the events through cuts off and is replaced with static, as are most of the other windows of the Burrow. She hurries to find a window that still works, but falls as her left leg from the knee down becomes intangible. She hops to a functioning window and sets it back to the fight between Ladybug and Cat Blanc.
Bunnyx sees that she is slowly fading from existence and pleads with Ladybug to hurry up.
Meanwhile, among the girders of the fallen Eiffel tower, Cat Blanc tells Ladybug that as soon as he finds her, she'll give him her Miraculous.

title: Cat Blanc
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Cat Blanc - Plot
Ladybug sneaks up behind him, tackles him, and takes his staff.
However, she finds no akuma inside it.
Cat Blanc fires multiple Cataclysms at her, which she dodges, and he chases her up to one foot of the tower high above the water.
He threatens her with another ranged Cataclysm as they balance on the upturned concrete foundation attached to the tower.
Cat Blanc then says that she can end everything more quickly by handing her Miraculous to him.
Ladybug refuses and calls on her Lucky Charm, receiving an eraser.
Cat Blanc says that he'd like to erase the past but there's only one way.
He reminds her that combining their Miraculouses can grant one wish and proclaims that his wish would be to fix everything so that they can be in love again.
He prepares to take her earrings, but Ladybug tackles him and snatches his belt.
To her shock she discovers that the akuma isn't in there either.
Upset that Ladybug isn't listening, Cat Blanc readies another attack which she prepares to block with her yoyo.

title: Cat Blanc
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Cat Blanc - Plot
At the last second, he lowers his aim and disappointedly fires the small Cataclysm at the foundation beneath her, which she easily avoids by moving her foot but causes her to fall into the water.
Ladybug is unharmed by the fall as she lands in the water.
She rolls herself over to face downward, and sees the destruction that Cat Blanc had wrought on Paris; on the submerged streets, dull grey statues of people all look in terror at one spot.
Some are shielding themselves from something, like a ranged attack.
Shocked, Ladybug goes deeper to investigate what happened while using her yoyo as a scuba mask.
A burn mark at the base of where the Eiffel tower once stood marks the epicenter of some kind of explosion.
Standing in front of it are statues of future Ladybug and Hawk Moth, both frozen and reacting differently to whatever happened.
Ladybug looks at the statue of Hawk Moth first; he shields his body with his cane, and his face is hidden behind the other arm.
Ladybug swims towards her future self, who is behaving differently than the other statues; she's reaching toward the blast and calling out.

title: Cat Blanc
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Cat Blanc - Plot
Current Ladybug looks her in the face and gently touches her cheek, but the destroyed Ladybug crumbles to dust at the slightest disturbance, earrings and all, and disappears into the current.
Her living counterpart gasps in horror and nearly drops the yoyo.
Clearly, Cat Blanc's Lady from his own timeline was turned to ash by a massive Cataclysm attack, along with everyone else in Paris and possibly the world.

title: Cat Blanc
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Cat Blanc - Plot
Bunnyx continues to investigate and learns that Ladybug and Cat Noir had located Hawk Moth. Fighting him in his repository, Cat Noir prepares to use Cataclysm, but Hawk Moth says that he doesn't want to do that while calling him by his real name, revealing that he knows his secret identity. He then shows Émilie's body and reveals that everything he is doing is to bring her back. Cat Noir realises that Hawk Moth is his father and is horrified, repeatedly asking why. Hawk Moth reclaims his cane and kicks him to the Eiffel Tower and says that they can save his mother with his and Ladybug's Miraculous. Ladybug shows up and reminds Cat Noir that every wish has a price to pay, though Hawk Moth claims that Ladybug would let him save his mother if she truly loved him. Torn between his mother and the girl he loves, drives Cat Noir off of the edge, and shouts at them pleading for them to stop. Seeing the chance as his son's heart became shattered, Hawk Moth sends an akuma towards him. It infects his bell. Cat Noir tries to resist, but it proves futile as he apologizes to Ladybug and succumbs to his akumatization.

title: Cat Blanc
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Cat Blanc - Plot
Ladybug watches in horror as Hawk Moth transforms him into Cat Blanc with the power of infinite destruction. However, Cat Blanc is conflicted between using his powers on either Ladybug or Hawk Moth and his Cataclysm overloads due to his negative emotions, detonating in a massive explosion that thunderously wipes out Paris and everyone in it, including killing his father and girlfriend as well as accidentally destroying the moon with the backblast. As already seen by current Ladybug when she observed the poses of the underwater statues, the last thing future Ladybug does is reach toward Cat Blanc, standing her ground and calling to him even as she is overtaken by the white light. Hawk Moth, on the other hand, cowers in fear in his last seconds, his arrogance broken as he suffers the disastrous and uncontrollable consequences of his own actions. Witnessing the death of future Ladybug and Hawk Moth and the destruction of Paris, Bunnyx pleads with Ladybug to end the nightmare.

title: Cat Blanc
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Cat Blanc - Plot
Ladybug emerges from the water and furiously asks Cat Blanc what he did, to which he claims that he didn't mean to. Angry and betrayed that she won't give him her Miraculous and believing that she no longer loves him, he decides to just destroy everything, much to Ladybug and Bunnyx's horror as he charges up a Giga Cataclysm that if unleashed will destroy the very fabric of the universe, with Bunnyx yelling that he is going to bring an end of the world. Ladybug frantically tells Cat Blanc that she'll give him her Miraculous, so Cat Blanc deactivates the Giga Cataclysm he'd made. He tells her that he's Cat Blanc, not Cat Noir, but Ladybug declares that he will always be Cat Noir to her and then leans in to kiss him. Of course, it's just a distraction, and she grabs his bell and breaks it, releasing the akuma.

title: Cat Blanc

text:
Cat Blanc - Plot
Ladybug purifies it, and Cat Blanc turns back into Cat Noir. However, he is still aware of her secret identity, so Ladybug figures that she must use her Lucky Charm to fix the event that caused the bad future. Going inside Bunnyx's Burrow, Ladybug figures that when she left her gift as Ladybug for Adrien, he figured out that she was Ladybug and told someone, who eventually told someone else, until it was all over the news. She goes back to the time when she was writing her name on the card and erases it before fixing everything with Miraculous Ladybug. Adrien then walks into his room and is surprised to see Ladybug, who tells him that she was delivering a gift from his Brazilian fans for his fifth name's day since there's a postal strike there. Adrien is happy about the gift, though Plagg wonders why they didn't deliver cheese instead.

text:
Cat Blanc - Plot
Ladybug asks Bunnyx if she remembers everything, to which Bunnyx says that what's seen is seen. She reveals that she knows the identities of Ladybug, Cat Noir and a few others. Ladybug asks about Hawk Moth's identity, though Bunnyx says that she can't tell her since there's a time for everything, explaining that she was chosen because she knows how to keep secrets. She bids her farewell and goes inside her Burrow.
Marinette tells the girls that Adrien wasn't home and she dropped her gift off at home, planning on telling them that she did deliver it only to realize that she just couldn't do it. The girls all give her a hug. Later, Ladybug meets with Cat Noir on a rooftop. Cat Noir asks her what her sudden call was for, to which Ladybug says that she already took care of it before leaning on his shoulder. Though he doesn't understand what she's talking about, he's perfectly fine with it.

text:
Cat Blanc - Plot Developments
This marks the second appearance of Bunnyx, following "Timetagger".
It is revealed why Alix was chosen as Bunnyx by Ladybug. By time traveling, Bunnyx can see everything whether past, present or future. So it is very important that she knows how to keep secrets so as not to create a temporal catastrophe, an ability that Ladybug detected in Alix.
Also when Ladybug asked Bunnyx if altering the past altered her memory she said, "What is seen can't be unseen" which references the quote, "What has been seen cannot be unseen, what has been learned cannot be unknown. You cannot change the past, but you can learn from it. You can grow from it. You can be made stronger".
With that in mind it could imply that regardless whether if any timeline is either altered or deleted Rabbit Miraculous holder's memory of said timeline remains unchanged as long as they stay in the Burrow. If so, Adult Bunnyx is the only other person besides Ladybug that remembers the events of "Cat Blanc".
As Adult Bunnyx saw the unicorn plushie disappear, she said, "That can't be right that isn't how it happened" this foreshadows that the events in the portals follows one's expectations or memories.

title: Cat Blanc
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Cat Blanc - Plot Developments
This episode also reveals how the Rabbit Miraculous holders tend and care for the timeline:
When a rip like this happens, it's apart of their job to know and study how things happened originally so they can change it back.
Also when needing help from someone else to fix it, a Rabbit Miraculous holder can't just pull any random thing or person out of the timeline, because they may risk of being comprimised or not cooperate such as why adult Bunnyx grabbed present Ladybug instead of the time version of her that already knew Cat Noir's identity nor both were already in love.
Since Bunnyx knew how the corrupted future happened and lied to Ladybug it's reasonable why because of the same time travel rule as in those of the present needing to know as little of the future as possible so the good futures don't go off course. And yet, so the bad futures can be avoided and not unintentionally cause the events that began them or by some chance if they don't then they could end up still living them but differently like with Ladybug in "Re-creation".

Cat Blanc - Plot Developments
This episode has many notable facts that are erased from reality after Ladybug goes back in time to stop her past self from writing her name on the letter that led Adrien to discover her secret identity.
This is the first time Marinette is shown with her hair down.
This is technically the first time that Adrien/Cat Noir gets akumatized, but since Ladybug corrects her mistake, it also never happens in the corrected timeline.
This is the third time Marinette figured out Cat Noir's identity following "Oblivio" and "Desperada". This is the second time Adrien figured out Ladybug's identity following "Oblivio". In said episode they both forget about their discovery after the Miraculous Ladybug, and in "Desperada", Marinette finding out was erased due to Second Chance.
This marks the second time of Marinette learning Adrien's/Cat Noir's identity has been reverted due to time related Miraculous superpowers.
This is the first time Gabriel has deliberately akumatized his son and Cat Noir uses Cataclysm on an akuma, which confirms that they can be killed/destroyed.
This is the third time Marinette is targeted by an akuma, following "Zombizou" and "Chameleon".

Hawk Moth is shown to be able to call for his cane from afar which could be another ability of being an adult Miraculous holder.
It's revealed Bunnyx knows Ladybug's and Cat Noir's secret identities, even before the events of "Cat Blanc" and during it she also knows the identity of Hawk Moth and his reasoning of why he wanted the Miraculous and the only one member of the Miraculous Team to do so.
This episode provides an answer as to why Marinette and Adrien, in either civilian or hero form, cannot pursue a romantic relationship with each other, anyone else or let alone know/reveal their identities as long as Hawk Moth (or at least Gabriel as Hawk Moth) is active, since he will exploit it to try and gain possession of their Miraculouses.
According to a tweet by Thomas Astruc, Cat Blanc remained alone in his akumatized state for months before Bunnyx transported Ladybug to his timeline.
With the alternate timeline taken into account this is also the second time where someone stays akumatized for the longest period of time. Meaning that Adrien had stayed like that for 2 months or more possibly tying or beating Vivica's record in "Desperada".

Cat Blanc - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in Switzerland on RTS Un.
It's revealed that Adrien has a fifth name, which is Athanase.
This is the first time that when Ladybug was de-evilizing the akuma, she didn't say her original catchphrase; she said "Time to de-evilize Cat Noir".
When Hawk Moth mentioned the heroes' love being their downfall in "Oblivio", he was partially right, but it was also his desperate, obsessive love that played a part in this, too, leading to them all making terrible mistakes:
Marinette unknowingly led Adrien to discovering her identity.
Despite it leading to the teens becoming a couple, Gabriel tried to use their love against them which led to his attempt to akumatize Marinette.
Adrien's mistake was that, despite saving Marinette, he transformed out in the open allowing his identity to be discovered.
Gabriel tried to use what he knew to his advantage by akumatizing his son and forcing Adrien to choose. However Gabriel was oblivious to the pain he caused him. This resulted in his power being a massive explosion where, not only Gabriel perished, but everyone on the planet.

text:
Cat Blanc - Trivia
Not to mention, Gabriel broke his promise to Émilie about keeping their son out of harm's way. Even moreso the promise they kept was broken even before the events of the episode.
As well as Nooroo advising him about continuing about the dangers of moving on with his dark path.
While being blinded by the prospect of victory and revenge, Gabriel also made another terrible mistake by amplifying his son's powers: he didn't just put Ladybug at the risk of being destroyed but also, by extension, the Ladybug Miraculous. If they had been, then the ultimate wishing power wouldn't have been achieved, rendering his entire quest and all his actions pointless.
Hawk Moth says to his son if Ladybug truly loved him, she would let him save his mother. Like before, he's partially right she would but not like this. If they had known about Émilie's condition sooner, the heroes could've consulted Master Fu to see if he knew anything about this. Meaning it's likely Hawk Moth just assumed that was the only way. It is also unknown if Émilie's condition can be reversed without them but if it can, then all of his actions would be pointless.

For a long time prior to the episode's release, a common theory in the fandom was that Cat Noir's akumatized form would be Cat Blanc, which was confirmed in the episode.

This episode showed scenes from "The Evillustrator", "Frightningale", "Glaciator" and "Timebreaker".
Gabriel calling Marinette his masterpiece is what he also called Audrey in "Style Queen".
Ladybug saying "The best kept secrets are the ones you never share" is what Cat Noir says in "Miraculer". This is one of the few times Ladybug had to save the world on her own.
The way Cat Blanc uses Mega Cataclysm, is a variation of a power he was supposed to have in an older concept called the Black Storm but he focuses and releases his power from his hands instead of his ring.
The way he used it is similar to Son Goku's famous Kamehameha from Dragon Ball same as the titular villain in "Animaestro".
This is the fourth time Hawk Moth loses control of his akumatized villain following "Robostus", "Gigantitan" and "Miraculous Shanghai".
In this instance, his villain was put into a position where he felt like he couldn't choose who he was more loyal too and because deep down Adrien knew no matter what side he chose he'd lose someone he loves forever.

text:
Cat Blanc - Trivia
This is the eighth time, where Cat Noir attempted to use his powers on someone else following "Dark Cupid", "Princess Fragrance", "Despair Bear", "Troublemaker", "Malediktator", "Miraculous Shanghai" and "Miraculer" but this is the fifth time he did it of his own free will.
This is the third episode not to feature a light mask of any kind, following "The Collector" and "Startrain". Interestingly, the light mask appears in the storyboard for the episode.
Allusions
The line, "It's bigger on the inside," which Ladybug says upon entering Bunnyx's Burrow, is a line often said by characters in the Doctor Who franchise when entering The Doctor's TARDIS for the first time.
The interior of Bunnyx's Burrow is also decorated to look like the roundels on the walls of the Tardis interior throughout the classic series of Doctor Who, which ran from 1963-1989.
It is also the same thing Cat Noir said in "Feast" when he and Ladybug were inside the sentimonster.
The moon's appearance after Cat Blanc's attack on it resembles the Death Star from Star Wars, specifically Episode 4: A New Hope because the Death Star in Episode 6: Return of the Jedi was not a full sphere as it wasn't completely built yet.

Cat Blanc - Trivia
In a way, Gabriel and Adrien's relationship bares a resemblance to Lillie and her mother Lusamine of the Pokémon anime.
As both families are high class and the parents are the heads of a major company as Lusamine is the head of Aether Foundation and Gabriel is head of his fashion company.
Both parents also had an interest in other things, Gabriel with the Miraculous and Lusamine with Ultra Wormholes and Ultra Beasts and yet in the pursuit of their desires both led to a terrible accident as Mohn (Lillie and Gladion's father) was sucked into an Ultra Wormhole while Émilie was put into a coma because of using the damaged Peacock Miraculous.
They were consumed by so much grief and heartbroken over what happened they forget the grief of their kids.
Despite it after sometime later, both parents continued in pursuit of their desires, leading to their relationships being strained.
All three kids believed that their parents were dead until they found prove that their parent is still alive but unlike Gladion and Lillie; Adrien with the alternate timeline being erased he was put back in the dark about his mother.

Due to both Adrien and Lusamine being in the dark about what truly happened to their loved ones both were oblivious and/or ignorant towards the other.

Marinette's eyelashes disappear briefly during her conversation with Tikki.
When the akuma enters Cat Noir's bell, the butterfly-shaped light mask's activation sound can be heard when the scene jumps to Cat Noir's face, but the mask doesn't appear on his face nor Hawk Moth's (most likely because they're face to face with each other). However, the butterfly-shaped light mask appears in the storyboard of the scene.
Despite Ladybug destroying Cat Blanc's tail/belt for mistakenly thinking the akuma was there, the part of the belt that is usually tied up in his waist is still on him until he gets de-akumatized.
When Ladybug was viewing a burrow portal linked to the Mesozoic Era, Otis Césaire's bracelet can be seen on the right arm of the Tyrannosaurus Rex shown.

(An eraser is summoned.)

title: Cat Blanc/Transcript
text:
Cat Blanc/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: (grabs his belt and rips it) Time to de-evil—  (No Akuma emerges, and she looks at the belt in confusion)

title: Cat Blanc/Transcript
text:

text:

title: Cash
text:
Cash - Intro
is the main antagonist of Miraculous World: Shanghai - The Legend of Ladydragon, and a cameo antagonist in Miraculous World: New York - United Heroez.
He is a crime lord and black market dealer and the owner of Cash Antiques. He is a manipulative thief who is responsible for the execution of Wu Shifu and has stolen the Sacred Cave Key from Fei Wu and sold it to Nathalie for a huge amount of money.
In "Miraculous Shanghai", after losing the battle to Fei, he was akumatized by Hawk Moth into King Cash, a golden terracotta warrior-themed supervillain.
As of "Miraculous Shanghai", Cash has been interrogated at the Shanghai Court for his actions. After a few months, he and his gang secretly met up in a New York alleyway to discuss an illegal plan which caught the eye of a few heroes.

title: Cash
text:
Cash - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Cash has short gray and black hair, which is slick and pulled back. He has thick black eyebrows and lines under his eyes, which seem to be dark brown in color.
Civilian attire
Cash wears a white button-up shirt with pockets on either side, a gold pendant and watch on his left wrist, white slim-fitting pants, and white dress shoes. He also carries a white fan that has a detailed yellow and red pattern on it, as well as a repeated yellow Chinese character design. The Chinese characters translate to "gold" (金).
As King Cash
King Cash was made completely out of gold.
However, his teeth remained white.
While his hair was styled the same way, it had a bun on top.
His chest had a circle in the middle representing a Chinese coin with four Chinese characters depicted at each cardinal direction.
The characters were "不"(no, not), "義"(Righteousness, "之"（indicates possession), and "財"（money) respectively.
His upper chest had a darker golden line going from his back to the circle in the middle, and the lower was solid, with small gold bubbles on it.
Above his chest on each side, he had pointy shoulder pads with a darker design on them.

title: Cash
text:
Cash - Appearance
His arms stuck out at the bottom and he had puffy sleeves on both sides with two flaps that ended with a long golden armband.
He had gold gloves, merged with his fingers.
He had a lighter gold belt and three overlapping pieces of fabric right below.
From the hip down to his knees, he had three flaps extending from his belt (one on the left, one on the right, and one on the back) which stopped at his knees.
He had puffy pants underneath, resembling the sleeves that stopped before his knee caps.
His knees were uncovered and he wore golden shoes.
Around his limbs were bronze cuffs.
His akumatzed object, his fan, turned blue with a light yellow pattern and border that lit up when he sent his blades out from it.
His fan had a yellow Nakabone and Oyabone.

title: Cash
text:
Cash - Personality
Cash is a very sleazy, manipulative and greedy individual. He believes money is the only thing that matters in the world and will do anything to it. He is easily provoked whenever he is duped, robbed, tricked or betrayed. He also enjoys capitalizing on items that are beloved by people, believing they will bring him the most money. He is shown to be a coward, as shown when he thought Fei was going to kill him by feigning remorse and begging for his life in exchange for money, when she confronts him for his actions.
Cash doesn't hesitate to use force to get what he wants. This is shown when he orders his henchmen to chase after Marinette and Fei, after discovering that Fei double-crossed and betrayed him, and later attempting to threaten Marinette to call her uncle to give him his money if not for Fei defending Marinette by knocking his phone out of his hand. He also threatened Fei he'd kill her the same way he did to her father, only to be knocked unconcious by her.

title: Cash
text:
Cash - Personality
As King Cash, he was still very money-centered and willing to do whatever it took for the "fortune" Hawk Moth promised him. He took great pleasure in fighting the heroes. He liked watching people suffer and using his power to hurt people. He smiled while attacking Ladybug, Cat Noir, and Ladydragon. He was incredibly powerful and showed that he would stop at nothing to get his money and destroy the heroes.

title: Cash
text:
Cash - Abilities
As a Civilian
Cash is a powerful crime boss and a successful businessman in running his shop which helps to conceal his underworld activities. He's also bilingual in Mandarin and French.
As King Cash
In addition to being a taller metal robot-like machine, he was also made entirely of indestructible gold. When he swung his hand fan, he was able to conjure and shoot magical diamond shaped blades that had two different effects, depending if they were made of silver or gold: the silver blades that could slice everything in their path in half, while the gold ones could turn anything into a golden statue. His fan also acted as a sword, being able to instantly cut through anything he put it through. He sliced through a pillar in the Sacred Cave, smashing down and almost crushing Ladydragon. He also gained super strength, agility, and fighting skills.

title: Cash
text:
Cash - Relationships
Wu Shifu
Cash and Wu Shifu didn't have a good relationship. Because of Cash and his influence, Wu Shifu lost almost all his students except Fei.
Fei Wu
Fei and Cash didn't have a good relationship. Unknown to Fei, Cash was the one who stole the Sacred Cave Key and took her adoptive father's life. When Fei was older, she started looking for answers about her father, he told her that she'll have to pay to get her answers. Fei started stealing and sold her stolen belongings to Cash. Every time she came to his store, Cash told her that she'll need to pay more. Later on, when Fei stole Marinette's belongings and Marinette came to get them, Fei double-crossed and betrayed him by swapping Marinette's fake earrings to her Miraculous earrings and they escaped. Cash was enraged when he found out that he was double-crossed and betrayed and ordered his henchmen to chase after her and Marinette and decided to pursue them and told Marinette that Fei was the person who stole her belongings. At the end of the special, Fei took him to court and had him arrested.
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/Ladybug

title: Cash
text:
Cash - Relationships
Cash and Marinette didn't have a good relationship partially because Marinette is Fei's friend and she helped her. Fei stole her belongings and sold them to him. Later on, Fei helps Marinette find Cash's sovereign shop. Marinette comes in willing to buy her Miraculous and Tikki back from Cash. When Fei swapped the jewels, she and Marinette escaped, Cash pursued them and threatened Marinette that if she doesn't call her uncle and give him his money, she will be in trouble only for Fei to knock his phone out of his hand. As King Cash, he fought her as Ladybug. He doesn't referred Marinette by her name instead referring her as "kid" probably due to not knowing her name.

title: Cash
text:
Cash - History
Before the series, Cash used monetary coersion to have Wu's students leave his school, leaving the Prodigious Cave unprotected. Consumed by greed, he destroyed Wu's school then was responsible for Wu's death, leaving Fei orphaned, and stole her bracelet in her sleep. Afterwards, soon he sold the key to Nathalie who in turned gave it to Gabriel.

title: Cash
text:
Cash - History
In "Miraculous Shanghai", Cash ran a pawn shop. Manipulating Fei, he got her to steal and collect numerous valuables for him to broker, in exchange for information about her father's death and the whereabouts of her bracelet. When Marinette wonders around the streets of Shanghai, Fei stole her purse, delivering her earrings, phone, other valuables, and Tikki to him. Seeing that the objects were little value, Cash told her to bring Marinette to bargain them for a high price. However after Fei returned, she had a change of heart and swapped Marinette's earrings with fake ones, and quickly left the shop. After noticing Tikki was missing from his shop, he inspects the quality of the earrings and realizes that Fei had swindled him and stolen them. He pursued the two girls to the Prodigious Cave, and revealed to Marinette that Fei was the one that stole her belongings and threatens Marinette to call her uncle for the money he thinks he owned. Seeing Fei rushed to Marinette's defense, he lashed out in anger telling Fei if she does this, she never get her answers letting it slip that he was responsible for her father's demise.

title: Cash
text:
Cash - History
But soon he was akumatized by Hawk Moth into King Cash, and they entered the cave together using the bracelet that Nathalie bought from him, causing Cash to realize that Hawk Moth was his buyer. Instead, they were confronted by Mei Shi, the Guardian of the Prodigious. They were followed by Ladybug and Fei into the cave and proceed to fight them. During the brawl, Fei picked up the Prodigious and transforms into Ladydragon; after Cat Noir arrived, the combined efforts of the three heroes led to King Cash's akumatization.
After the fight wih YanLuoShi outside, Cash was tied up inside the cave and tried to bargain for his freedom. Fei berated Cash while untying him, confronting him about everything he has done to her for the sake of greed. Instead of taking vengeance, she decides to let justice take it's course, and took him to the Shanghai courthouse to face charges for his crimes.
At some point prior to "Miraculous New York", he either got out of prison or avoided charges.

title: Cash
text:
Cash - History
In "Miraculous New York", he's seen getting out of a car in an alleyway in preparation for something illegal. Until Eagle and Uncanny Valley saw him and his henchmen from a nearby rooftop and were about to confront him when Monk made himself known to reclaim the Eagle Miraculous.

title: Cash
text:
Cash - Trivia
Cash's character design is a homage to Anthony Wong, a Hong Kong film actor and singer.
Cash's name reflects his greed. Though, it's likely that "Cash" is an alias, since Chinese characters cannot form the name "Cash".
Given that "Miraculous Shanghai" takes place before "Miraculous New York", and since Ladydragon dropped him at prison, it's likely that he escaped prison after Ladydragon left.
If Ladybug and Cat Noir had known that Cash had the Sacred Cave Key, they would have traced it that it was sold to Nathalie Sancoeur, which could lead them to know that Hawk Moth is Gabriel Agreste.
Ladybug, Cat Noir, and Fei Wu never considered asking Cash about the key or even bother wondering how Hawk Moth obtained it in the first place.

text:
Cash Antiques - Intro
Cash Antiques: Antiques, Calligraphy Painting, Silver, & Goods (Chinese: 現金古董:古玩字画银货), better known as , is a pawn shop full of various stolen goods owned by Cash. Most of the items were retrieved by Fei Wu who was forced to sell stolen properties to him in exchange for information about her adoptive father’s fate.
After buying stolen goods from Fei, Cash sells them for a much higher value than what he paid.

title: Cash Antiques
text:

Cash's sovereign shop is stationed in a dark alleyway and is quite small. The outside is piled with objects such as suitcases, vases, chairs, etc. Right next to the entrance door are shelves and bookcases showcasing jewelry inside frames. A bright sign hangs on the top of the entryway with the name of the shop "現金古董", translating to "Cash's Antique Shop", in red words. The bottom of those words say "古玩字画银货", which translates to "Antiques, calligraphy painting, silver, and goods." On the inside, there are more bookcases with displays on the left. On the right is a vending machine filled with stuffed toys. The back of this room has a glass table with rows of jewelry inside. On the walls, three Chinese opera masks hang in frames, mostly in white, red, and blue. Behind the table is a backroom where Cash's henchmen rest.
