title: Caroline
text:
Caroline - Intro
is a minor character in season 6 of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She is the mother of Sublime Varlette and the ex-wife of Séverin Varlette.
In "Sublimation", after Bob Roth refused to give a second chance to her daughter in gaining his sponsorship after an accident that destroyed the latter's running prosthetics, she was akumatized by Chrysalis into Sublimation, an athletic supervillain capable of turning people into the best version of themselves. She also received a Magical Charm from Ladybug that prevents her from being akumatized again.

title: Caroline
text:
Caroline - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Caroline is a Belgian woman with light skin and average height. She has dirty-blonde hair which is neck-length and similar to a pixie cut. Her bangs are swept up and out of her face at left while the rest flares out. She has brown eyes framed by slightly bushy eyebrows. She has a slightly defined jaw and chin.
Civilian Attire
She wears a black jacket over a white top and red pants with a black stripe on the sides. She also wears a pair of black and white sneakers and a watch on her left wrist, as well as a pair of silver earrings.
As Sublimation

title: Caroline
text:
Caroline - Appearance
Sublimation wore a pair of transparent yellow goggles, seemingly shaped like a crown at the sides (hence her name) to match her winged anklets. Her bangs were swept at the opposite side with a neater hairstyle. She wore a white jumpsuit with red thick stripes running past her armpits, inner arms, sides of her torso and legs, and thinner ones around the collarbone. Above the collarbone, around the back, and behind the legs were blue stripes. Her padded soles were red on top and blue beneath with a circular spot in the middle. Her suit was also unzipped, with a gold zipline, which partially revealed a black swan-neck suit beneath. On her chest was a logo made of three gold rings, the middle one filled in, matching her metallic gold fingers with black wrists. She wielded a medal with a logo matching the one on her chest. Her earrings were lighter.

title: Caroline
text:
Caroline - Personality
Similar to Gabriel and Tomoe, Caroline is an authoritarian regarding the way she raises her daughter. Just like them, she places great pressure on Sublime to be her best version, forcing her to face any problem she comes across on her own. This is because of friction with her ex-husband, Severin, who is always helping Sublime whenever she faces a problem. Despite the fact this allowed Sublime to become independent and self-sufficient, all while allowing her to think of creative ways to deal with any obstacle, it also caused her to develop anxiety whenever she has to face a big challenge. However, despite this, Caroline loves her daughter immensely, and she truly has Sublime's best interests in sight, even if she can sometimes exaggerate in the way she shows this.
Caroline is also a very determined person, as she didn't give up to trying to convince Bob Roth to be Sublime's sponsor. However, her determination can easily turn into stubbornness, as she is normally unbending whenever she has something in mind.

title: Caroline
text:
Caroline - Personality
As Sublimation, she became determined to turn everyone into the best version of themselves. However, she prioritized those that she regarded as being the reason why her daughter didn't get her sponsor, like her husband (who is always there trying to help Sublime) and especially Bob Roth, whose greed prevented him from giving Sublime a second chance. When Ladybug and later Cat Noir tried to stop her, Sublimation's attention went to them, criticizing them for helping greedy people like Bob. Ladybug was especially criticized by Sublimation, who viewed her as the reason why Sublime's prosthetics broke.

title: Caroline
text:
Caroline - Abilities
As a Civilian
TBA
As Sublimation
Sublimation's superpower allowed her to turn the people she hit with a blast from her medal into the best versions of themselves. Those people would lose all the fear that was holding them back and be motivated to achieve whatever goal they wanted. However, her power didn't work on people that already perceived themselves as being the best versions of themselves. After she hit Ladybug and Cat Noir, the effect of her power soon after came undone.
She also had great skills in hand-to-hand combat, as she was able to fight Ladybug and Cat Noir and hold her own against them. She also possessed super-agility and strength, which allowed her to jump between buildings and even stop a moving car and remove its sunroof.

title: Caroline
text:
Caroline - Relationships
Family
Sublime Varlette
Since her daughter was born, Caroline has raised her to be independent and outstanding.
She made her study harp and flute, which helped her win first prize at the conservatory, and learn five languages, including Greek, Japanese, and American English.
She also supported her training in Paralympic races, where she won 100 and 400 meter events.
But the pressure to be perfect caused anxiety and fear of failure.
Caroline doesn’t pay much attention to these issues, and when Sublime has an attack, she tells her to overcome them to move forward.
Her upbringing is based on independence, so she doesn’t allow anyone to help her because that would make her weak.
For Caroline, her daughter’s career is very important, and she promotes her herself to influential people to get sponsors like Bob Roth and Tomoe Tsurugi.
When Sublime’s prosthetics broke during a race, Caroline cared more about the competition than her daughter’s health, and she asked Bob Roth for a second chance, saying it was just a temporary problem.
After being rejected, she became Sublimation.

title: Caroline
text:
Caroline - Relationships
After being freed, Sublime and her parents visited Tomoe Tsurugi who accepted to be her new sponsor, after Bob Roth rejected her for using prosthetics.
Séverin Varlette
Since their divorce in 2016, the relationship between Séverin and Caroline hasn't been very good, mainly because he's kind and always helps their daughter, Sublime, which makes Caroline think he's spoiling her and preventing her from becoming independent. As a result, she often scolds him whenever she sees him acting that way. However, that doesn't stop them from agreeing on certain matters, such as when they told Bob Roth that they wanted their daughter's promotion as a Paralympic athlete to be based on respect. When Caroline was akumatized into Sublimation, she transformed Séverin into a “better version of himself,” one that aligned with her own vision of how he should behave toward their daughter.
Allies
Ladybug

title: Caroline
text:
Caroline - Relationships
Due to Sublime being distracted by Ladybug and falling, breaking her prosthetics, Caroline was akumatized and became angry at Ladybug, saying that Parisian superheroes were made to destroy things, which hurt Ladybug's feelings as she knew it was her fault. After Caroline was deakumatized and using Miraculous Ladybug, Sublime's prosthetics were restored, so Caroline no longer holds a grudge against Ladybug and received a Magical Charm from her, which would help prevent her from becoming akumatized if Chrysalis targeted her again.
Cat Noir
As Sublimation, she fought against Cat Noir and also hit him with an Antikuma.
Tomoe Tsurugi
Caroline is grateful to Tomoe for sponsoring her daughter and Tomoe tells her that there is no need for gratitude, as she herself knows what it is like to live with a disability and that technology helps people overcome obstacles. However, due to the smirk on her face after Caroline leaves, it is unknown what Tomoe's true intentions are for this collaboration.
Acquaintances
Chrysalis

title: Caroline
text:
Caroline - Relationships
Caroline was akumatized into Sublimation by Chrysalis, giving her the ability to make people into better versions of themselves. During this, Chrysalis fired Antikumas from her Sublimation mask, leaving her confused and surprised by the unexpectedness of what was happening.
Alya Césaire & Nino Lahiffe
In "The Illustrhater", they asked her for information about the new owner of the Butterfly Miraculous and she answered that she did not remember anything after the akumatization. In any case, Caroline is friendly to Alya and Nino, since she allowed them to ask her questions.
Enemies
Bob Roth
Bob Roth was the first sponsor Caroline aimed for to support her daughter Sublime as a Paralympic athlete. She even manipulated him into staying to watch her daughter's race, as he was about to leave because Sublime had no gold medals and he didn’t believe a symbolic one was worth anything. Caroline claimed that Sublime would win a pure gold medal at the world championship and accepted his offer that he would keep the medal once she won it.

title: Caroline
text:
Caroline - Relationships
When Sublime fell on the track and broke her prosthetics, Caroline immediately went after Bob to convince him to give her another chance, insisting it was just a setback. However, he refused, stating that setbacks didn’t make money, which ultimately caused Caroline to be akumatized into Sublimation.
As Sublimation, Caroline went after Bob to force him to recognize her daughter's talent by turning him into a better version of himself, but both Ladybug and Cat Noir got in her way. After Caroline was deakumatized, Sublime got a second chance and passed the trial. However, Caroline got angry at Bob because he wanted them to find a way for Sublime to wear tennis shoes with her athletic prosthetics to promote them, knowing full well that it wasn't feasible. In the end, thanks to her daughter and ex-husband, Caroline rejected Bob as Sublime's sponsor.

title: Caroline
text:
Caroline - Trivia
It's unknown if Caroline had kept her ex-husband's last name after divorcing him or if she returned to her maiden one.
Caroline's power as Sublimation is very similar to that of Liberation, the superpower of the Eagle Miraculous, as both are meant to turn people into a "better" version, freeing them from whatever is holding them back.
This is actually the first villain with good powers as her purpose wasn't to destroy anything, but to make people better.

I almost transformed back right there under Cat Noir's nose! Cat Noir tries to seduce Ladybug by putting on some irresistible new perfume. He soon starts winning hearts… but not the one he was hoping for!

title: Catnip Fragrance
text:
Catnip Fragrance - Plot
On a Paris rooftop, Ladybug is seen reading a magazine showing Adrien in a perfume advertisement.
While Ladybug reacts gleefully to the image of Adrien, Cat Noir observes her and takes out a bottle of the perfume from the advertisement, before imagining her being attracted to the smell of the perfume on him and kissing him.
He sprays the perfume onto himself and moves in, unaware that several passing cats are attracted to the smell.
Ladybug notices Cat Noir twirling his staff, upon which he exhibits a flamboyant flourish, complete with perfume-scented roses, and advances upon an unimpressed Ladybug, trying to get her to kiss him.
The moment is interrupted when a massive swarm of cats appears and starts chasing Cat Noir, startling him into falling off the rooftop and pursuing him across the skyline, leaving Ladybug to continue admiring Adrien's picture in her magazine.
Cat Noir gets the idea to throw off the amorous felines by diving into the Seine, and sure enough, the cats lose interest and leave upon catching a whiff of the smelly river water.

title: Catnip Fragrance
text:
Catnip Fragrance - Plot
Later, Ladybug hoists a soaking Cat Noir out of the river with her yo-yo, but she too is repulsed by his odor when he tries to kiss her once more, before promptly leaving him to drop back into the Seine.

title: Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part 1)
text:
Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part 1) - Intro
"" is a Season 2 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 24th written and produced episode of Season 2. It is also the 50th written and produced episode of the series, overall.
This episode is also the first part of the two-parter, "Heroes' Day".

title: Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part 1)
text:
Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part 1) - Synopsis
Marinette lies about preparing a good deed to perform for others on the Day of Heroes and quickly finds her untruth spinning out of control.
Disney+
Ladybug must prove herself when the whole city gets akumatized.

title: Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part 1)
text:
Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part 1) - Plot
After facing another supervillain late at night, Marinette and Adrien go home and fall asleep. However, they are soon awoken only seconds later and reminded that it's Heroes' Day: a day where every Parisian has to do a good deed in honor of their superheroes. Marinette panics since her time as Ladybug prevented her from preparing hers, but she is saved by Tom and Sabine, who give her a box of macarons to give to her classmates.

title: Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part 1)
text:
Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part 1) - Plot
Meanwhile at the Agreste mansion, while getting ready for school, Adrien sees his father through his bedroom window staring at a stone statue of Émilie Agreste. As he goes downstairs, Nathalie tells Adrien that she booked the Chinese and fencing rooms for him as he requested and reminds him that he much also make an appearance at the Agreste Foundation's Heroes Day Gala. After Adrien leaves for school with his bodyguard, Nathalie goes to talk to Gabriel and tells him that it's time to implement his plan, pointing out how his target, Lila Rossi, has had months to brood her anger over Ladybug. It will be peaked now that everyone is celebrating her on Heroes Day. Gabriel asks Nathalie if she's really okay with helping him, to which Nathalie says that she'll always be there for Gabriel.
At school, Lila speaks to Miss Bustier's class through a video chat.
She tells them that she is in the country of Prince Ali (The Kingdom of Achu) and had been invited by him to his palace.
Marinette, aware of Lila's deceitful nature, attempts to expose her lies by pointing out that Prince Ali is in America, but Lila says that Prince Ali wasn't actually with them.

title: Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part 1)
text:
Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part 1) - Plot
Marinette vows to herself that she'll expose Lila's lies one day, but Alya, who overhears, believes that Marinette is just jealous because Lila had once tried to date Adrien.
When asked by Miss Bustier what she has prepared for Heroes' Day, Lila says that she has received permission from other countries to work on a project to reduce pollution and is meeting with Prince Ali to get his approval.
The class and Miss Bustier, excluding Marinette and Adrien, are amazed and thank her on behalf of planet Earth.
She then claims that she has to go because it is getting late where she is.
Once she hangs up, it is revealed that she actually still lives in Paris and is hiding in her room.
When her mother comes in and asks who she was talking to, Lila says she was talking to her boyfriend, Adrien.
Mrs.
Rossi also asks her about the school, which Lila claims is closed from all the akuma attacks.
Lila's mother then receives a call from Mr.
Damoclès, but Lila convinces her not to answer it since he's probably been akumatized.
The two are then interrupted by the noise of the ongoing Heroes' Day parade, which irritates Lila.

title: Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part 1)
text:
Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part 1) - Plot
Miss Bustier tells the class that even if they don't have Prince Ali as a friend, there are other ways to do good deeds. Mr. Damoclès bursts into the room dressed as The Owl and talks about how Ladybug and Cat Noir have saved Paris from Hawk Moth. He then asks everyone what heroic deeds they're doing. Nino says that he will be playing music for the retirement home. Adrien says that he will give a Chinese lesson to his fencing class and a fencing lesson to his Chinese class. Alya says that she has met with the mayor to discuss building handicap facilities. Hearing everyone's good deeds makes it hard for Marinette to admit that all she did was bring macarons for the class. Chloé mocks Marinette for doing so little, but Alya defends her by saying that it's better than nothing. Angry that Alya would imply that she didn't prepare anything, Chloé says that since she is a superhero, she is offering her autograph to anyone who wants one. However, Marinette still feels embarrassed by not having much done, so she tells the class that she is organizing a party for the whole school with countless amounts of pastries.

title: Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part 1)
text:
Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part 1) - Plot
Once home, Marinette asks her father for help in making the treats, but he cannot since he has to finish baking a giant Ladybug cake for the mayor. Sabine advises Marinette to just be honest with her classmates, but Marinette decides to make the treats herself instead.
Nathalie and Gabriel wait inside the lair for the first part of their plan to unfold. In her room, Lila angrily scrolls through a bunch of news feeds about Ladybug until coming across an interview with Gabriel and Nadja Chamack. In it, Gabriel announces that he is funding a tribute to Ladybug due to her saving him and his son countless times. After he says that Volpina is a false hero in comparison to Ladybug, Lila becomes enraged and flings her laptop against the wall. With her negative emotions hitting their peak, Gabriel transforms into Hawk Moth and sends an akuma to Lila. It infects her wristbands and Hawk Moth offers her the power of illusion once more. Lila agrees, and she is transformed back into Volpina.
With her illusionary powers, Volpina sends an illusion from the Eiffel Tower: an akumatized Ladybug with inverted colors and Cat Noir appear on a Ladybug float.

title: Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part 1)
text:
Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part 1) - Plot
"Akumatized Ladybug" and "Cat Noir" are fighting, with the latter warning everyone to stay back from his possessed friend. The two of them fight briefly, with one of the news reporters recording the battle. "Akumatized Ladybug" tells "Cat Noir" to give his Miraculous to Hawk Moth, but "Cat Noir" tells her if Hawk Moth wants a ring he can make one himself. "Akumatized Ladybug" tells him that it is not nice to deny a request of from a friend. "Cat Noir" tells her that they won't probably be friends again until she is deakumatized. "Akumatized Ladybug" traps "Cat Noir's" hand in her yo-yo. Just then, "Cat Noir" summons his Cataclysm and attempts to use it on the yo-yo to stop her. However, "Ladybug" is too fast and pulls him towards herself, and she plants his hand on his own chest: "Cat Noir" disintegrates into black dust, which shocks everyone dearly. "Akumatized Ladybug" picks up Cat Noir's ring and announces that she will give it to Hawk Moth.

title: Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part 1)
text:
Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part 1) - Plot
With the people of Paris drowning in despair, Hawk Moth seizes his opportunity to continue the second part of the plan. He deakumatizes Lila and then creates another akuma in his lair for Nathalie. It infects her tablet and transforms her into Catalyst, a supervillain who has the ability to boost powers. Catalyst infuses Hawk Moth's cane with energy, which transforms him into Scarlet Moth, allowing him to release as many akumas as he desires. With his boosted powers, Scarlet Moth sends a swarm of akumas all over the city.
Marinette, who is at home, continues to attempt to create her Heroes' Day pastries that she promised her classmates but has trouble with the task. She pleads with Tikki to let her transform into Ladybug and use her Lucky Charm to help her with her task but soon realizes that she can't use her powers for her own personal needs. Tikki encourages Marinette to just be honest with her classmates, but Marinette is worried about ruining the party. However, Tikki assures her that nothing can ruin the party on Heroes' Day.

title: Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part 1)
text:
Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part 1) - Plot
Marinette returns to school, dreading returning to disappoint everyone, just as Adrien catches up to her and tells her he will be able to come to her pastry tasting.
Noticing how nervous Marinette looks, Adrien fears that Marinette doesn't have enough food for him, but Marinette assures him that she does.
Once inside the building, the two find themselves with bigger problems, as numerous students have seen the illusion fight between the "akumatized Ladybug" and "Cat Noir".
In the middle of a live interview between Nadja Chamack, Jagged Stone, and Clara Nightingale, the three are akumatized back into Prime Queen, Guitar Villain and Frightningale respectively as numerous red akumas descend on the school and also akumatize other students and staff back into their akumatized selves.
Adrien saves himself and Marinette from akumatization.
Chloé tells everyone not to panic as she knows what to do and rushes home to prepare the bee signal.
Marinette realizes that the akumas are infecting those who are afraid and warns the other students not to show fear.
Juleka is nearly akumatized but after hearing Marinette's warning, she calms down.

title: Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part 1)
text:
Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part 1) - Plot
Alya and Nino also comfort one another to prevent themselves from being afraid.
Alya then calls her sister Nora and tells her not to be afraid, but Nora confidently tells Alya that fear is afraid of her as she smashes a bunch of akumas with a broomstick while their younger sisters cheer her on.
Meanwhile, Marinette runs into the restroom to transform into Ladybug and heads straight to Master Fu for additional help.
Adrien tries to find a place to transform but is soon captured by his bodyguard, who has turned back into Gorizilla. By Scarlet Moth's command, he forces him to keep Adrien safe while instructing Sabrina, now Vanisher again, to follow Ladybug to Master Fu. As Gorizilla takes Adrien away from the battle, Plagg sneaks behind the villain and blows on the ground, causing it to crack which makes Gorizilla trip and drop Adrien. Once he gets away from Gorizilla, Adrien transforms into Cat Noir.

title: Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part 1)
text:
Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part 1) - Plot
Meanwhile, a suspicious Ladybug realizes that she's being followed and ducks inside of a sewer. She sees Vanisher's footprints in the water, uses her yo-yo to tie her up, and then purifies her akuma, turning her back into Sabrina. Sabrina is delighted upon seeing the real Ladybug and promises to tell everyone the truth while Ladybug heads over to Master Fu. Once there, Master Fu voices how much he's feared the day Hawk Moth would realize how much power he actually has and then takes out the Miracle Box for Marinette to choose a trusted ally to help her. Tikki advises Marinette to take all the Miraculouses, but Marinette points out that she won't have time to explain to everyone what to do and says that she needs allies that already know what to do. She picks up the Fox Miraculous for Alya, Bee Miraculous for Chloé, and Turtle Miraculous for Nino.

title: Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part 1)
text:
Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part 1) - Plot
Afterwards, she gets a call from Cat Noir informing her that there are many villains and that Hawk Moth overdid himself. Then, he is approached by the heroine expecting him to do the same thing and is given the Bee Miraculous. Meanwhile, Ladybug finds Alya and Nino hidden back in the school's lockers. Lacking a good excuse to separate them, she gives them their respective Miraculouses, revealing their superhero identities to each other. Nino is surprised that Alya is Rena Rouge and even more surprised that she never told him, but Trixx reminds him that a superhero must keep their identity secret before Alya transforms into Rena Rouge. Nino is impressed but wonders why Alya is not surprised that he is Carapace. She merely tells him to transform. After he and Wayzz greet each other with a handshake, Nino transforms into Carapace.

title: Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part 1)
text:
Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part 1) - Plot
Chloé, in the meantime, has set up a "Bee Signal", somehow unconvinced of the parade fight. Cat Noir shows up and Chloé is annoyed that Ladybug sent over her "second fiddle". When Cat Noir threatens to find another Queen Bee, Chloé takes back the comment and tells him to give her the Miraculous. Cat Noir coerces Chloé to ask for it politely before giving it to her. After being greeted by Pollen, Chloé transforms into Queen Bee.
With all five heroes united, they arrive at the Trocadéro, where Queen Bee asks why they are waiting, with the akuma army nearby at the Eiffel Tower. Ladybug retorts she wants to wait to see what they are planning just as Scarlet Moth arrives, apparently out of his lair, with Catalyst remaining behind. He broadcasts himself on TV and asks Ladybug and Cat Noir how they plan to fight his massive army. As the heroes bicker how they will approach the fight, Cat Noir asks Ladybug what her plan is while she looks on wordlessly.

title: Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part 1)
text:
Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part 1) - Plot Developments
This episode reveals that Adrien and Marinette are the only ones who know about Lila's habitual lying.
This episode shows Hawk Moth removing someone's powers for the first time.
And an akuma leaving its host without Ladybug destroying an object or purifying said akuma while the affected host has not shown signs of confusion or fatigue.
Where Hawk Moth leaves his lair while he is transformed.
Nino discovers Alya's superhero identity, and her knowledge of his, which she appeared to gain in "Anansi", is confirmed.
The Miraculous Ladybug and Lucky Charm are not used in this episode, the latter for the first time.
Master Fu said, "I knew the day would come when Hawk Moth would discover his real power". It implies that Gabriel wasn't the only Butterfly Miraculous holder in history to have their powers amplified by an akumatized villain.
He is the second Miraculous holder to have their powers amplified by an akumatized villain following Chloé in "Queen Wasp".
This is the only episode that Plagg uses his power without a holder where we don't see any unwanted damage. As compared to "Style Queen", it's implied that when kwamis do so they have limited control over their powers.

title: Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part 1)
text:
Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part 1) - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in Switzerland on RTS Deux.
Rena Rouge, Carapace, and Queen Bee return in this episode to assist Ladybug and Cat Noir in their mission. This marks the first instance where all superheroes appear at once.
This episode includes the most transformation sequences, with a total of six transformations, surpassing "Sapotis" and "Anansi", which had only three, and "Queen Wasp", which had only four.
With this, all Miraculous users introduced up to this point transform in a single episode.
A new version of Alya's transformation sequence is shown when she transforms in her everyday attire.
Also, Rena Rouge's eyelids are now black whenever she blinks as opposed to "Sapotis" where her eyelids remain uncolored.
A new effect has also been added in Alya's transformation.
During Nino's transformation, Carapace's theme is changed from his transformation during "Anansi".
Adrien, Marinette, Nino, Alya, Chloé, and Lila don't wear the Heroes' Day pin like the rest of the class, Miss Bustier, and Mr. Damoclès.
This episode premiered exactly one year after season 2 had started (not counting "Santa Claws").

title: Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part 1)
text:
Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part 1) - Trivia
The first person to get de-akumatized is Sabrina Raincomprix.
References
Akumatized Ladybug shares the same color-inverted costume as the titular villain from "Antibug".
If you listen closely, the theme song from "Frightningale" plays as the Ladybug balloon parades in front of Lila's window.
Akumatized villains from season 1 and season 2 return in this episode, but their designs are colored red due to Scarlet Moth's power.
Those that have been reakumatized are: Volpina, Prime Queen, Guitar Villain, Frightningale, Horrificator, Stoneheart, Gamer, Princess Fragrance, Gorizilla, Dark Cupid, Mime, Timebreaker, Vanisher, Gigantitan, Glaciator, Animan, Riposte, Pharaoh, Rogercop, and Stormy Weather.
The way Cataclysm is used in this episode is similar to how it is used in "Rogercop" and "Gorizilla".
The animation for the scene where Plagg offers Adrien his cheese while the two are in his bathroom is reused from "The Bubbler", but this time the cheese doesn't have the red ribbon.
This is the sixth time two or more people have been akumatized in one day, the previous times having been in "Lady Wifi", "Princess Fragrance", "Antibug", "Volpina" and "The Queen's Battle".

title: Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part 1)
text:
Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part 1) - Trivia
This is the first time more than two people have been akumatized in one day, with a total of four.
Hawk Moth's transformation music is changed completely, being different from the ones in "Gorizilla" and "Queen Wasp".
Allusions
Chloé's bee signal is a reference to the Bat-Signal.
Although many countries have a holiday called "Heroes' Day" (most commemorating specific people), France is not actually one of them.
Errors
Marinette doesn't have her earrings during the scene where she is in the kitchen.
When Marinette is showing her father the list of treats for the party, her eyes are green instead of blue.
When Volpina gets de-akumatized by Hawk Moth, the tips of her hair are brown instead of white.
Ladybug gives Cat Noir just the Bee Miraculous by itself, but when he gives it to Chloé, it's in the box.
Though Lila's mother appears to be Clara Contard, Thomas Astruc stated it to be an animation error.
When Rena Rouge transforms, her eyelids are normal. However, after the transformation, her eyelids turn black.
Just like in "Malediktator", Chloé's sunglasses are on her head prior to transforming, but disappear when she transforms.

title: Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part 1)
text:

When Gabriel enters his lair, there are no butterflies shown, but after he transforms into Hawk Moth, the butterflies are there.
When Gabriel and Nathalie are in the former's lair, the window is open. However after Gabriel turns into Hawk Moth, the window is shown to be closed, which leads to him opening it once again.
While Trixx is talking to Nino, the Fox Miraculous on Alya's neck is in its charged form when it should be in its disguised form.
Alix isn't wearing her cap when she is outside of the classroom running from the akumas nor when she is turned back into Timebreaker.
When Adrien is telling the people to run away from the scarlet akumas, he didn't have his school bag.
He also didn't have his bag when he ran to the door and when his bodyguard, as Gorizilla, captured him.
Marinette didn't have her school bag when she ran into the bathroom.
When the five heroes are together at the end of the episode looking at the Eiffel Tower, the Bee Miraculous in Queen Bee's hair is seen in its akumatized form.
The earrings of the akumatized Ladybug don't have reverted colors.
When Miss Bustier's class greets Lila during the video call, Kim's hair color is from black to brown.

title: Cat Miraculous/Movie
text:
Cat Miraculous/Movie - Intro
The Cat Miraculous is a ring that, whenever Plagg inhabits it, transforms the wearer into a black cat-themed superhero/supervillain with the power of Destruction.
To activate the ring, its user must speak the transformation phrase: "Claws Out".
The ring is currently owned by Adrien Agreste, who uses it to transform into Cat Noir.

title: Cat Miraculous/Movie
text:
Cat Miraculous/Movie - Appearance
In charged mode, the ring has a thick band with a circle surface surrounded by a lining with four pointed diamond shapes on each diagonal side. It's black with a glowing chartreuse cat paw print in the middle of the circle.
In camouflage mode of Adrien Agreste, it is silver, and the circle is blank.

title: Cat Miraculous/Movie
text:
Cat Miraculous/Movie - Abilities
When it's used to transform, the Cat Miraculous grants its holder a black cat themed costume that they truly desire as well as incredible superhuman powers of strength, speed, agility, and endurance. Its special weapon is a Staff, which can be utilized as a weapon. Its special superpower is Cataclysm, which gives the user the ability to damage or destroy an object, such as structures or metal bars. If the Ladybug Miraculous holder needs to communicate or needs the help of the Cat Miraculous holder, it will start to glow constantly as a sign to transform.
If the Cat and Ladybug Miraculouses are fused, their holder will achieve the absolute power to alter reality to their wishes.

text:

title: Cat Noir (2D-Verse)
text:
Cat Noir (2D-Verse) - Appearance
As Cat Noir
This Cat Noir has a very similar appearance with to that of Adrien Agreste from the Quantic Universe; he has cat eyes with green sclerae, dark green irises and slitted pupils. His hair becomes longer and untamed and it covers his normal ears. Cat Noir wears a textured black skin-tight catsuit with metal details. He wears matching gloves that have claws on the fingertips and boots with a hidden wedge, silver toes, and paw-shaped treads. He has a golden bell on his neck, connected to a zipper on the front of his costume, and a long belt that wraps around his waist and hangs out from the back like a tail. He wears black cat ears and a black mask to cover his face. When transformed, his ring turns black and gains a bright green paw print on its face. He keeps his staff attached to his lower back. Whoever, this Cat wielder also possesses some notable differences: his suit has a high collar and his belt has a silver belt buckle resembling a cat's head.

title: Cat Noir (2D-Verse)
text:

As Cat Noir
Cat Noir has enhanced physical skills such as superhuman speed, agility, and near-invulnerability. He is fast enough to outrun a pair of panthers, being capable of running at least between 35-50 mph. Like a cat, Cat Noir also has enhanced senses such as hearing, smell, night vision, and super stealth.
Cat Noir uses his staff efficiently, wielding it as a sword, throwing it with great precision, and having it be deflected back to him. He is able to spin it at high speeds to form a shield or take advantage of its duplication and length-changing features.
His special power, Cataclysm, allows him to negatively affect and essentially destroy anything that he touches with his ring hand. While it is usually used for object destruction, it can be used for a variety of different effects, for example, causing a bus's controls to go haywire and creating a platform in a structure.

title: Champ de Mars
text:
Champ de Mars - Intro
is a garden in front of the Eiffel Tower.

title: Champ de Mars
text:
Champ de Mars - Description
Created in 1770, the Champ de Mars is a landscaped garden of 24.3 hectares with a length of almost 1 kilometer from the Eiffel Tower to the forecourt of the École militaire. Being one of the largest green spaces in Paris, it is divided into two parts.
The first forms the green spaces surrounding the base of the Eiffel Tower. There are ancient trees and two bodies of water. The second starts from Avenue Gustave Eiffel and has a length of 780 meters up to the École militaire. Rectangular in shape and punctuated by wide lawned avenues and long pedestrian avenues, square-cut trees underline the perspective and create small spaces where there are statues, fountains, a kindergarten and a stage for music.
The center of the Champ de Mars is crossed by the Avenue Joseph Bouvard which creates a square with a central traffic island with the basins of the Champ de Mars.
The Champ de Mars is an important place in the history of Paris and France in general, as it was the scene of numerous historical events.
Today the garden is extremely popular among Parisians and tourists and numerous events take place there, such as concerts or giant gatherings.

title: Champ de Mars
text:
Champ de Mars - Trivia
The Champ de Mars has been a classified site since 1956.
The Champ de Mars has been classified as a World Heritage Site by UNESCO under the title "Paris, Rives de la Seine" since 1991.
Since its creation, the Field of Mars has experienced several important historical moments. We can mention in particular:
The Federation Day on 14 July 1790, a major revolutionary holiday celebrating the first anniversary of the Storming of the Bastille on 14 July 1789.
The Champ de Mars Massacre of July 17, 1791, during which at least 50 people lost their lives under fire from the National Guard.
As Commander of the National Guard, Gilbert du Motier took part in this shooting. Although he resisted by preventing artillery fire with his mount, his participation made him reviled by the revolutionaries and marked the beginning of his loss of prestige in France.
The Paris Universal Exhibitions of 1867, 1878, 1889, 1900 and 1937 took place there, with in particular Gustave Eiffel's construction of the Eiffel Tower to celebrate the centenary of the French Revolution during the edition of 1889.
The fencing events (foil and saber) of the 1900 Olympic Games took place there.

title: Champ de Mars

In "Queen Wasp", it was on one of the central lawns where Audrey Bourgeois placed her helicopter to wait there Marinette, before the latter causes reconciliation between fashion critics and her daughter.

title: Champs-Élysées
text:
Champs-Élysées - Intro
The Avenue des Champs-Élysées is a boulevard in the 8th arrondissement of Paris, 1.9 kilometres (1.2 mi) long and 70 metres (230 ft) wide, which runs between the Place de la Concorde and the Place Charles de Gaulle, where the Arc de Triomphe is located.

title: Champs-Élysées
text:
Champs-Élysées - Description
The Champs-Élysées is a 1910 meter long and 70 meter wide avenue with a four-lane two-lane cobbled roadway. The entire avenue is bordered by a symmetrical row of square-cut plane trees.
Nicknamed "the most beautiful avenue in the world", the Champs-Élysées follows the historical axis of Paris connecting the Place de la Concorde to the Place Charles de Gaulle.
On the side of the Place de la Concorde, the beginning of the avenue is marked by a group of twin statues, the Marly Horses. From this entrance and up to the Champs-Élysées roundabout, the street is surrounded by the Jardins des Champs-Élysées. On these first 800 metres, there is also a junction with the Avenue Winston-Churchill which allows access to the Grand Palais and the Petit Palais.
After the roundabout, the Champs-Élysées is surrounded by various buildings containing numerous very popular shops and restaurants along 20 meter wide pavements and shaded by a second row of trees.
Finally, the avenue des Champs-Élysées ends on the Place Charles de Gaulle where the Arc de Triomphe dominates.

title: Champs-Élysées
text:
Champs-Élysées - Description
The Champs-Élysées is a very popular place for its shopping and proximity to many Parisian monuments. Its axis offers a fantastic perspective on the Louvre Palace, the Jardin des Tuileries and the Place de la Concorde to the south-west.

Netflix

Disney Channel

title: Chameleon
text:
Chameleon - Plot
Marinette arrives at Literature classroom to find that almost everyone has swapped seats, leaving an empty seat beside Adrien.
Marinette believes that Alya got everyone to switch seats so that she could sit by Adrien and thanks her.
She then wonders if it's such a good idea since she might lose focus and fail her classes.
However, Alya reveals that she isn't sitting by Adrien but, rather, in the back row.
When she asks why, Nino tells Marinette that it's because "she" has a hearing problem and needs a front-row seat.
Marinette wonders who "she" is.
Just then, Miss Bustier walks into the classroom and announces that Lila has returned from her trip to Achu and will be joining their class again just as Lila herself enters the classroom and greets everyone.
Noticing that a front-row seat has been saved for her, Lila thanks everyone for remembering her hearing problem and sits down.
Marinette skeptically asks Lila about her hearing problem, which Lila claims is tinnitus, a constant buzzing in her left ear, caused by the sound of an airplane motor bursting her eardrum when she was saving Jagged Stone's cat.

title: Chameleon
text:
Chameleon - Plot
Marinette points out that Jagged Stone's pet is a crocodile, but Lila claims that he used to have a cat before finding out that he was allergic.
She then asks Adrien for help in catching up with her schoolwork.
Marinette complains to Miss Bustier about having to sit in the back, so Adrien offers his seat to Marinette, which Marinette and Lila both oppose.
Lila feigns sadness about her return causing so many problems and says that she'll sit in the back if that's what Marinette really wants.
Everyone glares at Marinette, forcing her to sit in the back.
Once she takes a seat, an outraged Marinette angrily watches as Lila flirts with Adrien.
Hawk Moth senses Marinette's anger and sends an akuma after her. However, before it can infect her, Miss Bustier tells the class to open their textbooks, making Marinette calm down. Hawk Moth senses that Marinette's negative emotions have ceased but is confident that they will emerge again, telling his akuma to be patient.
At lunch, everyone gets Lila's food for her because she claims to have a sprained wrist and can't get her own food.

title: Chameleon
text:
Chameleon - Plot
Marinette complains about Lila to Alya, saying that Lila made up her hearing problem just so that she can sit next to Adrien and is lying about her sprained wrist, too.
Alya doesn't understand why Marinette seems to have it out for Lila, so Marinette decides to tell her everything.
She drags her and Nino to a separate table away from the others and talks about Lila when she first came to school.
She mentions how everyone had been amazed by her incredible life, but Marinette had found something to be off.
Therefore, she spied on her and overheard her say to Adrien that she was friends with Ladybug, calling her a liar.
However, Nino finds it uncool that Marinette had been eavesdropping on Lila and Adrien, and Alya asks for proof that Lila doesn't really know Ladybug.
Realizing that she can't do so without revealing her secret identity, Marinette decides to prove that Lila is lying about her sprained wrist by throwing a napkin at her.
Lila catches it with her "sprained" wrist, revealing that it is not sprained at all.

title: Chameleon
text:
Chameleon - Plot
However, Lila covers herself by pretending to be hurt, even more, claiming that she wanted to catch the napkin before it hit Max's eye as she'd seen a man in India gets his eyes gouged out with a napkin.
Max is grateful, and everyone else scolds Marinette for hurting Lila further.
Lila, however, defends Marinette, saying that she had only been trying to give her a napkin.
With that, Marinette is furious and angrily storms off into the restroom, which leaves everyone bewildered.
Lila follows her and asks Marinette why she doesn't like her, believing it to be because of the new seating arrangement and a desire to sit next to Adrien.
She says that it's not worth it to fight over a boy and offers to be her friend and help her with Adrien.
Marinette, however, refuses, saying that she'll only be Lila's friend when she stops lying to everyone.
She reveals that she is aware that she'd been lying about having tinnitus, her sprained wrist, being in Achu, and being friends with Ladybug.
Lila admits this and says that she only tells people what they want to hear, which Marinette says it's obviously called lying.

title: Chameleon
text:
Chameleon - Plot
Unconcerned, Lila retorts that there's nothing Marinette can do about it when everyone can't resist when they're lied to and gives her a choice: she's either with her or against her.
She gives Marinette until the end of the class to make up her mind and leaves the restroom.
Frustrated, Marinette goes inside one of the stalls and complains to Tikki how Lila is even worse than Chloé and fears that if she doesn't expose Lila as a liar soon, she'll turn all of Marinette's friends against her.
With her emotions becoming negative again, Hawk Moth sends the akuma back to Marinette just as she starts sobbing.
Tikki notices the akuma and alerts Marinette, who fearfully backs away from it.

title: Chameleon
text:
Chameleon - Plot
Lila runs into Adrien in the hallway and asks him to help her catch up on her schoolwork. She also asks him to teach her piano, claiming that her uncle was a famous pianist who'd tried to teach her but had to stop due to arthritis. Adrien says that he's fine with being her friend and helping her catch up but asks Lila not to lie to him like she did about Ladybug. Upset that Adrien thinks she's lying about Ladybug, Lila retorts that Ladybug is the liar, but Adrien encourages Lila to just be honest with him. Lila rebuffs this and angrily storms off.
The akuma nearly infects Marinette, but with encouragement from Tikki to remain positive, she is able to prevent the akuma from infecting her. Hawk Moth is surprised that Marinette's negative emotions faded but isn't upset as he senses something else. Marinette realizes that she must purify the akuma before it akumatizes someone and transforms into Ladybug. Meanwhile, Lila spots the akuma and allows it to infect her earring. She introduces herself to Hawk Moth and promises to get him Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses if he gives her powers. Hawk Moth agrees and turns Lila into Chameleon.

title: Chameleon
text:
Chameleon - Plot
Chameleon goes to Adrien and apologizes for the way she acted earlier, promising not to lie anymore and asks him to make peace with her. She then kisses his cheek, taking on his appearance and making him fall asleep. She stuffs Adrien inside his locker and leaves. Once she's gone, Plagg expresses concern for Adrien.

title: Chameleon
text:
Chameleon - Plot
Chameleon, still with Adrien's appearance, goes up to Alya and Nino and insults the latter, taking his cap from him, and rushes off. Ladybug watches all this unfold and follows Chameleon, who jumps on top of several high buildings and in front of a bus, causing it to swerve off the road and nearly hit a woman with her baby. Thankfully, Ladybug saves them just in time. She then follows Chameleon to the top of the Eiffel Tower, who pretends to be Adrien about to fall off. Ladybug catches Chameleon, who attempts to "thank" Ladybug with a kiss. However, Ladybug is aware that it's not really Adrien, and Chameleon admits this to be true. She fights Ladybug and tries to kiss her, but Ladybug is able to dodge her attacks. She believes the akuma to be in the cap Chameleon is wearing and rips it, but nothing comes out. She then looks up and finds that Chameleon is gone, much to her frustration.

title: Chameleon
text:
Chameleon - Plot
Plagg wonders what could possibly wake Adrien up from his enchanted sleep. He fears that a kiss may be the answer and reluctantly prepares to kiss Adrien. However, Adrien wakes up before Plagg does so. Plagg explains how Lila had put Adrien to sleep, and Adrien realizes that Lila must've been reakumatized. He transforms into Cat Noir and takes off.
Ladybug searches for Chameleon as a woman looks for her son.
A young boy appears and tells Ladybug that he saw the supervillain go to the merry-go-round.
Ladybug thanks him for his help but warns him to get away.
However, unbeknownst to her, the young boy is a shapeshifted Chameleon, and the real boy is asleep inside the merry-go-round.
The boy's mother then appears and thanks Ladybug for finding Quentin, much to her confusion.
Chameleon jumps towards Ladybug and prepares to kiss her, but before she does, Cat Noir jumps in front of her and takes the hit instead.
With Cat Noir's appearance, Chameleon tries to take the Miraculous from the now-sleeping Cat Noir, but Ladybug intervenes and stops her.
Chameleon then calls on Cataclysm and attempts to use it on Ladybug, but Ladybug dodges.

title: Chameleon
text:
Chameleon - Plot
Chameleon also attempts to kiss her before taking off to the Eiffel Tower.
Hawk Moth orders Chameleon to grab Cat Noir's Miraculous, but Chameleon says that she wants to get Ladybug's first and follows the hero to the top of the Eiffel Tower.
Ladybug calls on her Lucky Charm and receives a T-shirt, which Chameleon mocks.
She then pins down Ladybug and tries once again to kiss her, but Ladybug holds her back and looks around for a plan.
She spots a waitress, an oyster shucker, and an oyster and comes up with an idea.
She tricks Chameleon into using Cataclysm on the ground below them, causing them to fall where a selection of seafood is served.
Chameleon prepares to kiss Ladybug, but Ladybug grabs an oyster and puts it in front of Chameleon's mouth, causing her to take on its form and making Cat Noir wake up.
He joins Ladybug on the Eiffel Tower and congratulates her on a job well done, though he points out that they must still find the akumatized object.
Ladybug gives the waitress Chameleon and the T-shirt, and she opens the oyster with the oyster shucker, revealing a black pearl inside it.
Ladybug breaks the pearl, purifies the akuma, and returns everything to normal.

title: Chameleon
text:
Chameleon - Plot
Ladybug is surprised to learn that Chameleon was Lila and says that at least now Lila can truthfully say that Ladybug saved her life. She offers her a truce, which Lila accepts and thanks Ladybug, saying that she'd be honored to be her friend. Ladybug advises Lila to stop lying and be honest with others, which Lila promises to do from now on. However, when Ladybug and Cat Noir leave, Lila makes a face that makes it clear that she has no intention of listening to Ladybug and still holds a grudge against her. Hawk Moth senses this and is confident that Lila's feelings about Ladybug will serve his purpose one day.

title: Chameleon
text:
Chameleon - Plot
Later at school, Lila tells her classmates that Ladybug saved her life and still refers to her as her close friend. Max asks Lila if the tinnitus gave her vertigo when she went up the Eiffel Tower, which Lila claims was not the case since Ladybug gave her an earplug to stick in her right ear. Marinette, who was angrily listening to everything, notes how Lila had said in the morning that the buzzing was in her left ear and prepares to call Lila out for it. However, Adrien convinces her not to, as exposing her would only make things worse, and as long as the two of them knew the truth, it didn't really matter since Lila is really skilled at deceiving others with her lies.

title: Chameleon
text:
Chameleon - Plot
Marinette sits at the back of the class, and Adrien decides to join her, even congratulating her for taking the high road. Marinette reminds herself to stay focused but unintentionally zones out and misses Miss Bustier calling out her name for attendance. Miss Bustier makes Marinette sit in the front next to Lila as a result, but Lila then claims that Ladybug cured her tinnitus and no longer needs a front-row seat, so she sits in the back next to Adrien. However, this creates a domino effect and prompts several other students to want to swap seats, too, and soon everyone is sitting in their original seats, with Lila sitting next to Nathaniel.
After school, Lila confronts Marinette, saying that she's made her choice and that from now on, the two of them are at war. She vows to make Marinette lose all her friends and make Adrien hers. Unfazed by this threat, Marinette tells Lila that they'll see about that before walking away. Lila walks away as well in a huff.

title: Chameleon
text:
Chameleon - Plot Developments
The Miraculous Secrets webisode "Lila" takes place right after this episode, given that Marinette is seen writing about the titular character's return to school in her diary.
Following "Catalyst", Marinette and Adrien are the only people who know the truth about Lila and her lies.

title: Chameleon
text:
Chameleon - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in Spain on Disney Channel.
Lila is akumatized a fourth time. However, unlike with her previous ones, Lila doesn't get akumatized into Volpina, but instead into a new villain, Chameleon.
Lila is akumatized voluntarily, like Gabriel in "The Collector" and Nathalie in "Catalyst", but she is the first person to physically grab the akuma and direct it to a determined object.
She introduces herself and tells her plan to Hawk Moth instead of the other way around.
Lila's akumatization into Chameleon marks the first time a villain doesn't change their appearance upon akumatization; however, this quickly changes after she uses her powers on Adrien.
Scenes from "Volpina" are reused.
Just like in "Volpina", Hawk Moth hints that he may use Lila again for his evil plans.
Ladybug tries to destroy Chameleon's exact copy of Cat Noir's staff with her leg, but it only splits in half in the same manner as he already had done in the past.
At the base of the Eiffel Tower, a man is seen giving a balloon to a recolored version of Manon Chamack's character model.
This is the first episode Sabrina speaks whereas Chloé does not.

title: Chameleon
text:
Chameleon - Trivia
Six students do not change seats to accommodate Lila in the beginning: Adrien, Chloé, Sabrina, Mylène, Max, and Kim, all of whom except Adrien have the same seats the entire episode.
Lila ultimately winds up seated next to Nathaniel.
Lila told several new stories assumed/confirmed to be lies, listed below:
Lila has tinnitus
She sprained her arm
Lila once saw a guy in India get his eye gouged out by a napkin
Her uncle taught her to play the piano
Jagged Stone had a cat Lila saved before finding out he was allergic.
Lila caught tinnitus as a result of saving Jagged Stone's cat on a airplane runway.
Lila didn't experience vertigo when going up the Eiffel Tower because Ladybug gave her an earplug for her right ear even though her tinnitus was supposedly in her left ear.
Ironically, her lie that Jagged Stone has a cat turns out to be true, as a flashback in "Wishmaker" shows a young Jagged chasing after a cat.
References
This episode has many similarities with "Zombizou", including:
In both episodes, Hawk Moth targets Marinette, and Miss Bustier says something to calm her down.
In both episodes, the Akumatized Villain's power involves kissing.

title: Chameleon
text:
Chameleon - Trivia
In both episodes, Adrien and Plagg have a conversation in a locker, and Adrien transforms in it.
In both episodes, Cat Noir is affected by the villain.
In both episodes, Ladybug defeats the villain on the Eiffel Tower.
This episode shows Cat Noir being impersonated by an akumatized villain for the second time, with Copycat being the first to do so.
Ladybug mistakes an object for the akumatized one, believing it to be Nino's cap when it actually is Lila's earring, which happened previously for her in "Antibug" with Sabrina's brooch.
When Ladybug saves the pedestrians from a bus, the baby in the stroller uses August's character model.
The bus still bears the advertisement for the KIDZ+ weather girl competition from "Stormy Weather".
Allusions
Marinette holding a croissant in her mouth while being late for school is a reference to a common anime trope where characters often carry a slice of toast in their mouth when they are late for school.
This can also be seen in the opening theme for each episode of the first five seasons.

title: Chameleon

Lila also has a different bag from the one she had in "Volpina" and in later episodes.

This happens once at the end of the episode as well.
When the class gets mad at Marinette, Adrien is mad as well, which was confirmed to be an animation error.

In the cafeteria, Nathaniel is first shown to be sitting alone. In the next shot, he is sitting on the other side of the table with another person.

title: Chameleon

In one frame when Ladybug pounces away after Chameleon runs off while Ladybug rips Nino's cap, her pigtails disappear.

Toward the end of the episode, the various students switching back to their old seats include Max being heard requesting to move and shown standing up, even though his seat location had never changed.

text:

title: Chameleon/Transcript
text:

Will you make peace with me? (kisses Adrien on the cheek, turning into Adrien and making the real Adrien collapse onto the ground, sound asleep; in Lila's voice) Whoops, I lied. (puts Adrien into a locker and leaves)

text:

title: Central Park
text:
Central Park - Intro
, called the green lung of Manhattan, is the iconic green space of New York City located in the heart of Manhattan.

title: Central Park
text:
Central Park - Description
Rectangular in shape, Central Park has an area of ​​341 hectares.
It is composed of numerous gardens and lawns that allow New Yorkers and tourists to sit on the lawns, offering both a corner of green and a view of the skyscrapers that surround the park.
Central Park also arbitrates several bodies of water, ranging from a simple pond to an artificial lake. From north to south we find:
Harlem Meer (Harlem Lake).
The Reservoir, the largest artificial lake in Central Park.
The Lake.
The Pond, a lake located below sea level.
The park is also home to notable buildings, such as Belvedere Castle, a neo-Gothic style building inspired by Scottish castles.

title: Central Park
text:
Central Park - Trivia
Central Park has many sports fields.
Within Central Park is the famous Central Park Zoo.
The Reservoir is also called the Jacqueline Kennedy-Onassis Reservoir in honor of Jacqueline Kennedy-Onassis, the First Lady of the United States from 1961 to 1963 during the term of her husband John Fitzgerald Kennedy, the 35th President of the United States.

title: Channel Tunnel
text:
Channel Tunnel - Intro
The  is a predominantly underwater railway tunnel that links Coquelles (France) and Folkestone (England) under the English Channel.
Starting from "Bakerix", the Startrain regularly uses the tunnel to connect Paris - Gare du Nord and London.

title: Channel Tunnel
text:
Channel Tunnel - Description
Opened on 1 June 1994, the Channel Tunnel is 50.5 kilometres long, of which 38 are under the English Channel at the Pas de Calais level, and is located 40 to 107 metres below the seabed depending on its location. The tunnel itself consists of three lateral tubes.
The two at the ends are the railway tunnels. These have a diameter of 7.6 meters. In addition to the railway, the two tubes have a platform to reach a cross section (emergency exit) that is every 375 meters. These allow you to reach the third central tube, 4.8 meters in diameter and which allows the circulation of special vehicles for maintenance and rescue.

title: Channel Tunnel
text:
Channel Tunnel - Trivia
The Channel Tunnel was first mentioned in the series by Marinette in "Bakerix".
In the episode, Marinette explained to Tikki how a train can make the connection between France and England despite the natural separation that is the English Channel.
In "Startrain", the train akumatized broke through the Channel Tunnel to move towards the surface and then towards space.
Only the southern tunnel appears in the series, generally used for the direction Paris - London.

In "Miraculous London", while she was akumatized into Timestalker, Cerise used one of her diaries to write down things she saw when she traveled through time to remember them when she would be deakumatized after she returned to her lair as part of her plan of getting the Ladybug and Cat Miraculous.

However, due to Chronobug and Bunnyx's intervention, this information was altered to say that Ladybug's secret identity is that of the late Gabriel Agreste, which angers Cerise as this prevented her from stealing the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses (and almost all the other Miraculouses as well) to make her unknown wish.

text:
Chloé's room - Intro
is the former bedroom of Chloé Bourgeois in Le Grand Paris.

title: Chloé's room
text:
Chloé's room - Appearance
Chloé's room is located on the top floor of Le Grand Paris in the luxurious imperial suite, entrance is through a set of double doors from the hallway into the center of the room. The room is primarily white and divided into three sections, a center room where people enter, the left side with Chloé's bed and bathroom and the right side with a living area.
Entrance
The center room has a round white table with a vase of roses on top and a black with yellow rose patterned carpet underneath. Next to the entrance on either side are two mirrors above two lamps and two paintings with their own lamps above. The entrances to each side are furnished with large pink curtains.
Left side room
The left side room is a hallway leading to Chloé's bed with large pink curtains in the middle and back of the room the same as the entrance. The bed is large with pink backing, white covers and pillows and two dolls, a large teddy bear and a large ladybug and at the foot is a pink Ottoman sofa.

title: Chloé's room
text:
Chloé's room - Appearance
Next to the bed is a bathroom with a large mirror with a honeycomb patterns running along the sides, various toiletries and a 24 carat gold toilet. First on the left of the hallway is a closet filled with clothing, accessories, and different varieties of shoes. The back wall of the closet is a door to a secret compartment which stores Chloé's Ladybug cosplay outfit (including a wig) and accessories.
Right side room
The right side room is has two boxy pink sofas and chairs with white cushions and a thinner chaise lounge chair, also pink, in the center of the room is a low glass table with a gold rose pattern on it and a brown wooden frame and sides. A purple red rose patterned carpet lies underneath the two sofas, chairs and table while a round ladybug patterned carpet under the chaise lounge. At the end of the room is an enormous television and speakers that can be linked to the hotels CCTV system.
Balcony

title: Chloé's room
text:
Chloé's room - Appearance
The room also includes a large spacious balcony that can be accessed through the center and right side rooms, large windows run the length of the room facing the balcony giving an expansive view of the city. The balcony has several white chairs and sofas around a small blue table in the center part and a single white chair on the right side. Several small trees in white pots adorn the balcony and the balcony is fenced off with flower stylized metal bars the middle and white stone pillars to the sides.

title: Chloé's room

In her bathroom, Chloé has a honeycomb patterned frame on the edges of her mirror. This complements the reference to bees in the design of Chloé's clothing.
Chloé's room is called the "Imperial Suite". It is not the room that is seen in "Mr. Pigeon", despite including the same stuffed animals on the bed, as that room is the Royal Suite.
It is unknown what became of this room after Chloé’s defeat and banishment from Paris in "Revolution".

title: Chinese Miracle Box
text:
Chinese Miracle Box - Intro
The , also called the Mother Box, is a jewelry box used to store the Miraculouses when they are not in use. It was the first Miracle Box ever created and the one that possesses the most powerful Miraculouses.
The Miracle Box is currently owned by Marinette Dupain-Cheng, as she became its new guardian in "Miracle Queen".
In "Strikeback", Félix Fathom, acting as Adrien, tricks Ladybug into giving him the Dog Miraculous, and using its power, Fetch, he stole her yo-yo, and traded all of the Miraculous that were being kept in the Miracle box to Gabriel Agreste in exchange for the Peacock Miraculous, leaving the Miracle Box empty.
In "Re-creation", before Gabriel makes his wish, he relinquishes all the jewels back to Ladybug. After the wish, she decides to give all the Miraculouses back to their holders permanently, to prevent all of them from being stolen all at once ever again, leaving the Miracle Box empty once again.

title: Chinese Miracle Box
text:
Chinese Miracle Box - Appearance
|-|Current=
Exterior
After Master Fu gave up the Miracle Box and named Marinette the new Guardian in "Miracle Queen", the box has now taken on a rounded out appearance and is red, covered in a ladybug pattern with a golden ring around each of the spots, which are the drawers where the Miraculouses are kept when they are not in use. It also has each Kwami's logo on the spots when inhabited, identifying which miraculous is in which drawer (though in some scenes, all of the spots are black). Though Marinette doesn't use it much, as she allows all the Kwamis to roam freely in her room and she can summon the Miraculouses using her yo-yo.
Side drawers
The drawers on the top half of the box are meant to contain the Cat, Bee, Dog, Snake, Pig, Rooster, Ox, Mouse and Fox. The bottom half is meant to contain the Goat, Dragon, Horse, Turtle, Rabbit, Monkey, Tiger, Peacock and Butterfly. It is unknown where the Ladybug Miraculous is meant to go. Although since Ladybug is the guardian, it is likely that there is no drawer meant for her earrings since she is supposed to be wearing the Miraculous.

title: Chinese Miracle Box
text:
Chinese Miracle Box - Appearance
At the top of the box is a button with the symbol of the Ladybug Miraculous on it that releases the kwamis from the box when it is pushed, even if their Miraculouses are not in the possession of holders.
|-|Former=
Exterior
The box was made out of very dark brown wood, had a golden hinge for the lid, and was shaped like an octagon. Four of the sides had gold buttons on the center, and the four sides in between them had two golden buttons that were vertically aligned. Each button had a darker-colored Chinese character on it naming an animal from the Chinese zodiac. The lid of the box at the top had a red design, a circle with patterns in the middle surrounded by wavy lines as the edge. The box included twelve drawers where more Miraculouses were being stored.
On the side of the gramophone in which the wooden box was stored, the Chinese characters for miracle (奇跡) were engraved.
Top level
Inside the box, on the top level, there was a gold outline of a flower with five petals, each petal had a pointed tip, and a center. The color outside of the flower was red. Each section of the flower was meant for a Miraculous.

title: Chinese Miracle Box
text:

The center section was raised above the others, and it included the yin-yang symbol, yin having a red outline and yang having a white outline. In yin, there was a red circle with five black spots, which was where the Ladybug Miraculous was placed. In yang, there was a silver paw print within a silver-edged circle, which was where the Cat Miraculous was placed.
Each petal-shaped section was a different color with a darker-shaded circled symbol in the center, and the Miraculouses placed in them represent the Five Elements. The petal section opposite of the lid's hinge was blue with a darker blue peacock symbol, which was where the Peacock Miraculous was placed. The lower left petal section was pink with a purple butterfly symbol, which was where the Butterfly Miraculous was placed. The lower right petal section was green with a darker green turtle shell symbol, which was where the Turtle Miraculous was placed. The upper left petal section was orange with a darker orange fox symbol, which was where the Fox Miraculous was placed. The upper right petal section was yellow with a darker yellow bee symbol, which was where the Bee Miraculous was placed.
Side drawers

title: Chinese Miracle Box
text:
Chinese Miracle Box - Appearance
The sides of the box had twelve small drawers marked by each button. Each drawer was square, and its inside was colored with a raised circular padded center. One Miraculous was stored in every drawer, each one a Chinese-zodiac-themed Miraculous as labeled by a button with an animal icon. Following is a list of the locations of the zodiac Miraculous starting from the bottom-back and moving around clockwise.
The bottom-back drawer was light blue with a cottontail symbol and held the Rabbit Miraculous.
The top-back drawer was red with a red dragon symbol and held the Dragon Miraculous.
The back-right drawer was turquoise with a turquoise coiled snake symbol and held the Snake Miraculous.
The bottom-right drawer was lighter-brown with a lighter-brown horse symbol and held the Horse Miraculous.
The top-right drawer was white with a white goat symbol and held the Goat Miraculous.
The front-right drawer was mustard-yellow with a brown monkey symbol and held the Monkey Miraculous.
The bottom-front drawer was maize and held the Rooster Miraculous.
The top-front drawer was light orange with a light orange dog symbol and held the Dog Miraculous.

title: Chinese Miracle Box
text:
Chinese Miracle Box - Access
During Fu's ownership of the box, it was stored in a phonograph. To open it, he must press the eyes of two opposing dragons engraved on a side of the phonograph. The dragons' eyes glow red, and a hatch opens between them, revealing ten buttons. He presses three particular buttons, which causes the phonograph to turn 180 degrees. The top with the record pops off, two sets of doors slide open, and a table spirals upwards from the inside of the phonograph with the box on it.
When the box itself is opened, the drawers containing the Zodiac Miraculous open seemingly independently.
In "Miracle Queen", all of the drawers opened simultaneously when the titular villain opened the box, acting in a rather mechanical form.
According to the "Kwamis" book, on the cover it's implied that the box will open when Marinette clicks one of the spots of which Miraculous she intents to give out or the Kwamis let themselves out.

title: Chinese Miracle Box
text:
Chinese Miracle Box - Access
In "Truth", the Chinese Miracle Box opened when Marinette pressed on the Ladybug Miraculous icon, releasing all the Kwamis but the drawers containing the Zodiac Miraculous seemingly still open independently in "Furious Fu". When the Kwamis re-entered the box in "Furious Fu", they had to go in Ying-Yang pairs.
Starting from "Gang of Secrets", Marinette hides the Chinese Miracle Box in a sewing box that she created. Just like with Master Fu's phonograph, the box is contained in a secret compartment, which opens only if she or Alya click the supplies in the right order.
Magic World
Within the Miracle Box, there is a pocket dimension, described by Tikki as a whole universe, where the Kwamis can gather. It's where they are meant to reside when their Miraculouses are not in use. The doorway to the Kwamis' magic world is in the box's lid.

title: Chinese Miracle Box
text:
Chinese Miracle Box - Access
This inner world is a seemingly endless expanse of night sky, but it is still bright as day. Directly below the entrance is a magic circle which the Kwamis can use to communicate with other, non-present Kwamis on their cycle, or birthday. The world also has a number of various items, toys, artworks, gadgets, etc., which the Kwamis brought in over the years to keep themselves entertained.
There is no way to contact the Kwamis while they are inside their magic world.

title: Chinese Miracle Box
text:
Chinese Miracle Box - Trivia
The wooden box appears to be patterned after an East-Asian influence, as evidenced by the octagonal construction, the flower-patterned inlay, and the stylized, red relief.
The flower could be styled after the cherry blossom, though it could be based on any other bloom of the Malus genus.
Another option is that it is a lotus, due to the way the petals are pointed outwards, not inwards like a cherry blossom, and the general importance of lotuses across Asia.
The top of the box's original design bears the Chinese symbol/pattern Lu (representing prosperity) or Shou (representing longevity).
When Fu gives Miraculouses away, each Miraculous is stored in a smaller box that resembles the Miracle box.
Now that Marinette is the guardian, she doesn't need the boxes to transport Miraculouses anymore as she can summon them from the Miracle Box to her yo-yo.
However, in "Re-creation", after restoring the Miraculouses to their original forms, Marinette used the boxes to permanently give them to her friends, with one meant for the Butterfly Miraculous, though it was stolen by Cerise.
The box's design as of "Miracle Queen" resembles the original design of the Ladybug Miraculous.

title: Chinese Miracle Box
text:
Chinese Miracle Box - Trivia
Similar to Ladybug's yo-yo, the Miracle Box could also apply to the the magic satchel theory, as it is able to hold all the things the Kwamis have collected over the years. Some of the things that are seen in the Kwamis' magical world:
A piano

In "Feast", it was confirmed that other Miracle Boxes existed but were destroyed. However, Ladybug's Miraculous Ladybug repaired the damaged guardians' temple, including the destroyed Miracle Boxes and therefore the Miraculous.
As of "Miracle Queen", it's unknown if, when the box changes under the condition of new guardianship, if the Kwami's magical world changes with it.

title: Chinese Miracle Box
text:
Chinese Miracle Box - Trivia
A mini-box version of the current Miracle Box hasn't been revealed yet, but in some production screenshots it has been revealed this Miracle Box also has the mini-boxes just like the previous one. This has not been confirmed yet, since as of season 4, Ladybug retrieved the Miraculous through her yo-yo directly from the Miracle Box itself.
As of "Strikeback", Gabriel has 16/19 of the Miraculouses that were currently in this Miracle Box.
But as of "Evolution", Gabriel has 15/19 of the Miraculouses that were currently in this Miracle Box after losing the Rabbit Miraculous.
In order to diminish the strain the Miraculous superpowers have on him, including the one of the Butterfly Miraculous, Gabriel can only use up to 6/19 of the Miraculous superpowers at the same time.
As of "Intuition", he can only use 14/19 of the Miraculous superpowers despite still having the Snake Miraculous.
When Gabriel made his wish and sacrificed his own life to have it granted, he was in possession of 9/19 of the Miraculous, with 7 of them being in the form of rings.

title: Chinese Miracle Box
text:
Chinese Miracle Box - Trivia
Since the box changed after Marinette became the Guardian, there have been two versions of the box seen on screen: one where the spots are all black, and one where the spots each depict the symbol of a Miraculous, showing which drawer contains which Miraculous.
Now that Marinette has permanently delivered all the Miraculous under her care to her superhero allies, the Miracle Box remains as it was at the end of season 4: completely empty. However, this time by its guardian's choice.
It now serves to hold a Miraculous in case its holder needs to get separated temporarily from it for some reason or if they renounce it until the guardian can find a replacement.
