title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - Intro
Chloé Bourgeois is a teenage girl and the daughter of Audrey Bourgeois and Paris' former mayor, André Bourgeois. She is Marinette Dupain-Cheng's rival. At first, the Bee Miraculous was supposed to be given to Alya but Ladybug lost it. Chloé later found it as she was walking down the Eiffel Tower after her mother was de-akumatized. It was temporarily used by her to transform into the Bee themed superhero, Queen Bee until she was expelled from the French Miraculous superhero team in "Miracle Queen".

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - Before Season 1
Chloé was left by her mother at some point in her younger life. Chloé has been friends with Adrien Agreste since they were little. She also presumably knew his maternal cousin, Félix Fathom during their childhood and considered him to be the fake version of Adrien. She went to Collège Françoise Dupont for four years previously with Marinette.
Mentioned in "Ladybug & Cat Noir" and in "Derision", Chloé harshly bullied Marinette, such as always getting her into trouble, putting cockroaches in her locker, putting green paint on her seat which would ruin her pants, and having Kim open a box of spiders when Marinette, who was in love with him at the time, confessed to him, so she would fall into the water with her recording it all ready to post on the internet if it wasn't for Socqueline, outraged she enforced that principal Damoclès to expel her.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Ladybug & Cat Noir", Chloé walked into Literature classroom with her friend, Sabrina Raincomprix. They walked over to Marinette Dupain-Cheng and kicked her out of her seat, choosing to sit there this year since Adrien would be sitting in front of them. When Adrien never showed, Chloé was upset. She went to the library and wasn't seen from for the rest of the day due to Stoneheart.
In "Stoneheart", the next day, Chloé made fun of Ivan and his inability to remember being Stoneheart. She led Adrien around the school. She also put gum on Marinette's seat, saying Marinette needed an attitude adjustment. When Stoneheart broke through Literature classroom's door, he took Mylène Haprèle and Chloé as captives and broke through the wall, carrying them through Paris to the Eiffel Tower. Stoneheart threw Chloé off the Tower, but as she was fell close to the ground, Ladybug caught her. The next day, she was forced to sit in her previous seat, Marinette and Alya Césaire sitting behind Nino Lahiffe and Adrien.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 1]]
In "The Bubbler", it was Adrien's birthday and she forgot to get him a gift. When she was taken by Bubbler to the Agreste mansion, she requested a slow dance so that she and Adrien could dance together. She tried kissing him but was interrupted when Ladybug changed the song. The gift that Chloé made Sabrina buy never made it on time for Adrien's birthday, much to her frustration.
In "Mr. Pigeon", Chloé planned on entering a fashion design competition and expected to win by stealing Marinette's design. Sabrina stole it from her at the Trocadéro and Chloé sent it off to someone else to make it. She tried passing it off as her own design to Gabriel Agreste's face, but Marinette proved that it was her own design. Chloé ran off crying.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Timebreaker", Chloé was at the Trocadéro to watch Alix's and Kim's race. She took Alix's watch from Adrien, was spooked by the blue light coming from it, and dropped the watch. The watch rolled on the track and broke, leading to Alix's akumatization. She disappeared when Timebreaker touched her. In the past, Chloé dropped the watch because both Future Ladybug and Future Timebreaker startled her. But she had her energy stolen in the new reality and yet was revived with Miraculous Ladybug (superpower.)

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Lady Wifi", Chloé tried being discreet when she took her Ladybug cosplay out of her locker. The next day, she caught Alya looking taking a picture of her locker and accused her of trespassing in her "sacred garden" and therefore stealing "her very soul." She manipulated Denis Damoclès into suspending Alya for a week which led to Alya's akumatization. When Lady Wifi showed up at the school, Chloé ran back to Le Grand Paris. In her room, she dressed up as Ladybug and threw around a yo-yo until her phone rang. Answering it, Lady Wifi appeared and froze Chloé. When she was freed due to Ladybug's and Cat Noir's appearance, and after the heroes and Lady Wifi left, Chloé changed out of her costume into her normal clothes and ran down to the entrance of the hotel, running to her father. Her phone rang and she answered it, allowing Lady Wifi to teleport up to the roof.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 1]]
In "The Evillustrator", Chloé picked up Nathaniel's sketchbook and made fun of his crush on Marinette to the entire class. After Nathaniel left and class resumed, she was partnered with Sabrina and Marinette for a particle physics project. This annoyed her as she wanted to work only with Sabrina so that Sabrina would do all of the actual work. After arguing with Marinette about how she treats Sabrina and their friendship, Chloé met up with Sabrina and Marinette at the library. She tried bribing Sabrina into doing her work but was attacked by several berets and a hairdryer. Ladybug and Cat Noir saved her from the hairdryer. Cat Noir guarded Chloé while she was in her room. He also started on her physics homework but did not finish it before he left to guard Marinette. Later that night, the Evillustrator attacked Chloé while she was in her room. He erased her clothes and tried to injure her several times, but Ladybug and Cat Noir defended her. The next day at school, Chloé pretended to be traumatized by the events of the previous night's attack. She convinced Sabrina to do her homework and be her friend again.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Rogercop", she attended Career Day at school with her father while showing off her new bracelet and giving a quick insult to Marinette over her clumsiness. But soon accused Marinette of stealing her bracelet, so she asked Sabrina's father to arrest her, but when he refused to, Chloé turned to her father for help. Soon after noticing Rogercop, she tried to get his assistance and rode in the villain's car who was in the pursuit of her father. In the car, she continuously asks the policeman to arrest Marinette while the heroes and Rogercop continued their fight on top of the vehicle. Once arriving at City Hall, Chloé gets taken hostage by the villain and held captive with her father inside the building. But seeing Ladybug, Chloé’s cheering accidentally revealed the heroine's location and was forced to fight the heroes but only left the room. After Sabrina's father was returned to normal, Chloé was happy her bracelet was found. As well as being reminded by her father not to accuse someone without proof.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Dark Cupid", after Chloé gets Adrien to autograph a poster of him, she shows it around, making fans cry. Soon after, Kim presents Chloé a fancy brooch for Valentine's Day and fails, which causes Chloé takes a picture and sends it to the whole school. After being embarrassed by her, he gets akumatized into Dark Cupid. He hits Sabrina with an arrow, making her scribble all over the poster of Adrien that Chloé got framed. Then, Dark Cupid finds Chloé and when she trips and falls on flower pots, she complains that her clothes and hair are dirty. Then Dark Cupid says that her heart doesn't have room for love, because it's already full of hate. When Dark Cupid gets defeated, Chloé finds out what Sabrina did and yells at her.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Horrificator", during the process of making a monster movie for a film contest when Mylène becomes afraid Chloé taunts her for her bad acting skills. Afterwards, she assumes the lead actress role and thanks to Nino rewriting the script Chloé was happy about doing a kissing scene with Adrien but was stopped by Marinette and Alya. Then, she decides to make the lead actress a nurse and leaves for a costume with Marinette agreeing but quickly figured her trick and the scene was stopped yet again. Soon they all heard a scream and find their friends gone as well as being trapped inside the school, then Ladybug and Cat Noir arrive. During their search for Horrificator, Chloé and Sabrina went their separate way but end up as the villain's prisoners in the maintenance room and when she was found she begs Ladybug to hurry. After Horrificator was defeated Chloé was freed with the other captivate students.
In "Darkblade", Chloé was seen with her father when he got reelected as mayor.
Then, at school, she runs for class representative but threatens everyone else from competing by blackmailing them making no exception with Marinette when Chloé hears that she is running too.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 1]]
While everyone was in the courtyard she had Sabrina go into Marinette's house and steal her diary meanwhile she bribes everyone into voting for her using Jagged Stone's autograph.
When Marinette comes to dissuade them, Chloé gives her a choice drop out or everyone learns her secrets but that is put on hold when Darkblade and his knights attack everyone looks to Chloé for guidance but she wants everyone votes in exchange for her help.
With Marinette taking over she follows everyone upstairs but during the fight, Chloé get turned into a knight but after everything was fixed due to Ladybug and Cat Noir.
She taunts Marinette by asking where she was hiding but Marinette says she got turned into a knight but when Marinette demands her diary back Chloé puts the blame Sabrina but no one believes her.
After the next day Marinette gets elected as class representative she finds Sabrina applauding her Chloé asks what is she even good for.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Princess Fragrance", after Marinette drops Tikki, Chloé finds her and, since Tikki looked and acted like a toy, she mistakes her for one. After Marinette tells her to give her back Tikki, she refused, telling Sabrina that this would be her ticket to meet Prince Ali. When Rose overhears about Prince Ali, she shows Chloé her letter to the Prince, and asks her to give it to him. But Chloé refuses, ripping it into pieces. Causing Rose to get akumatized into Princess Fragrance. Chloé planned to give Tikki as a gift to Prince Ali, who was visiting Paris for the children's hospital. She tells him that Tikki is a gift for the poor sick children. Then, Princess Fragrance entered, spraying a green gas from her perfume gun behind Chloé, giving off a foul odor and making everyone think it was her who caused the smell. She escapes with the prince, his chaperon and Cat Noir but ends up as one of Princess Fragrance's minions. At the end of the day, Prince Ali asked Rose to accompany him to the Children's hospital, leaving Chloé mad and frustrated.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Pixelator", she helped her father with the work experience assignments and chose to work with Adrien at the reception at Le Grand Paris. She saw Pixelator come in and said only the finest celebrities can come into the hotel. He attempted to take a picture of her, and at the moment he pressed the button Adrien pushed in
front of Chloé and both of them got "digitized". Chloé tried to call her father for help but to no avail, when Adrien suggested to look for a way out she didn't want to be alone however when Fang got "digitized" too Chloé leaped into Adrien's arms terrified. Sometime later, Chloé was found by Ladybug along with the rest of Pixelator's victims, due to a deal with him by Ladybug, Chloé was set free. After Pixelator was defeated and job experience day was over Chloé was expecting a concert ticket as her reward but didn't get one for not doing any work and gets angry.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Guitar Villain" she tells Adrien the big news about Jagged Stone staying at her father's hotel. But when Adrien thought she liked XY, she lied for Adrien's affection, saying that she likes Jagged Stone and leads him inside the hotel. When Guitar Villain attacks Chloé panics and asks Adrien to protect her but gets put into the elevator by him. The next day, she saw Adrien get an autograph from Marinette causing her to bite down on a Jagged Stone magazine in anger.
In "Kung Food", after Chloé sabotages Marinette's great uncle Wang Cheng's Celestial Soup for the World's Greatest Chef contest, he gets akumatized into Kung Food. He plans on capturing Chloé to make Brat Soup, which would also include Ladybug and Cat Noir. Using his minions that tasted his soup, he captures Chloé and ties her on top of the soup in the Le Grand Paris's pool on the roof to use her as bait to lure Ladybug and Cat Noir in. After Kung Food is defeated, Chloé is saved from being dropped into the boiling hot soup. Afterwards, Mayor Bourgeois kicked his daughter off the "judging team" after learning what she did to Wang Cheng's soup.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Gamer", Chloé was on the second floor of the library with Sabrina who mocked the others for flitting over technology until she texts on her phone continuously, being a hypocrite herself.
In "Reflekta", she complained about not being next to Adrien in the class photo, and got Sabrina to make sure Juleka didn't come back from the bathroom, by putting a chair on top of the door as she was next to Adrien. After Juleka was found, Chloé heard that Marinette was going to change the photo and was determined to stop her. Chloé had Sabrina videotape her sneaking into Denis Damoclès's office but after finding Marinette she gave Chloé two ultimatums but it ends with her running after Marinette. But ends up getting turned into a mirror reflection of Reflekta. Afterwards, she tries to scrub off Reflekta's makeup and is returned to normal with the Miraculous Ladybug and when everyone decides to do another class photo in the park. She watches from a nearby tree calling the photo ridiculous.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Antibug", two days ago she was cosplaying Ladybug and Cat Noir with Sabrina pretending to catch a made up bad guy but when Sabrina accidentally revealed her identity in front of everyone causing Chloé to become angry and ignore Sabrina which led to her friend's akumatization. Then, was harassed by Vanisher who was Sabrina at home and school. At the hotel, she also interfered multiple times when Ladybug and Cat Noir were fighting Vanisher and finding a way to help she tells Ladybug that the akuma is in her brooch. After she overheard Ladybug calling her a liar, she gets akumatized after stomping on her ladybug cosplay mask and turned into Antibug, a villain who wanted to take Ladybug down.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 1]]
But she had to deal with Cat Noir because Ladybug was about to detransform that's when Antibug taunted her by saying she's nothing without Cat Noir. A fight ensued between them ending with her tying the cat up and using him as bait to lure out her former idol meanwhile she tries to convince Cat Noir to team up with her. But he retorts by saying that he doesn't work with a mere copycat which angers her running out of patience. Antibug gives Ladybug a final warning until she hears the heroine's voice but only finds Marinette's phone and a freed Cat Noir. At the top of the hotel, Antibug and Ladybug face off with a bag of marbles and was defeated.
Afterwards, hearing Ladybug's apology Chloé’s reconsiders becoming the superheroine's number one fan again. During the next day at school per Ladybug's advice, Chloé made amends with Sabrina by giving her a new brooch.
In "Volpina", she was jealous and complained that Jagged Stone wrote a song about Lila and not her, even though it was a lie.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Santa Claws", Chloé comes to the bakery with her father to tell Marinette and her family Merry Christmas and she was urged by her father to call a temporary truce. Chloé told her rival happy holidays albeit very loudly but says she still hates Marinette's guts before leaving and enjoys eating with her father. When Santa Claws entered the hotel, she ran away in fear after a bunch of cockroaches bursts out of the box. After she heard that Adrien went missing, but was found, Chloé Bourgeois came to the Agreste mansion with her classmates and embraced him, then joined everyone for the Christmas dinner.
In "The Collector", when Chloé hears that Adrien was banned from school she was devastated and being comforted by Sabrina. After Adrien was allowed to go to school again she jumped into his arms and embraced him.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Prime Queen", Nadja Chamack gives Chloé a chance to talk to Ladybug and Cat Noir on Side by Side; however, she starts lamenting on how Ladybug is her close friend. Prime Queen, later on, captures her and leaves her on the train. Disgusted, she begged the heroes to save her, but afterward, they left to follow Prime Queen. Chloé was still asking for someone to get her out of here but after Prime Queen was defeated Chloé was instantly teleported back to her room due to the Miraculous Ladybug.
In "Despair Bear", while Marinette's father Tom Dupain was teaching cooking lesson Chloé disgusted on the idea of getting dirty made a secret call on her cell phone. Soon after the Fire Department arrived she tried to the pin the blame on Marinette but Alya and Adrien vouched for her but everyone was stuck cleaning as punishment. Then, Chloé was approached by Adrien to whom she admitted bringing the firemen to the school was her idea. Having enough of her cruelty to others Chloé got denounced as Adrien’s friend leaving her devastated.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 2]]
Returned home sulking about what happened to her butler Jean and was given her childhood toy Mr. Cuddly Chloé remembered how to be nice at his urging she hosted a party inviting everyone she tried to maintain her niceness as long as she could using her toy as a reminder. But when everyone finds out about it she is fed up with Jean for embarrassing her and fired him but ends up being attacked by Despair Bear until Ladybug and Cat Noir arrive and she batters them for being late. When the villain ends up controlling Cat Noir she took Adrien's advice to heart and stopped the cat from using Cataclysm on her idol. As the heroes moved the fight to the top of the hotel Chloé followed them and upon Ladybug's asking she helped the heroine defeat Despair Bear and rehired Jean after he returned to normal. After talking with Adrien she made amends with him but went back to criticizing her classmates afterward.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Robostus", Chloé and various students laugh when Marinette leaves her bag in her locker. When Max Kanté shows the class Markov, Chloé shows no consideration about the robot. When Markov reprimands Olga Mendeleiev for not being reasonable, Chloé laughs with the rest of the class. When Markov gets akumatized she escapes the classroom with everyone else.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Frightningale", Chloé appeared dressed as Ladybug for the auditions as the heroine in Clara's video. She hastily told everyone to exit since "the star" had arrived and the singer was impressed by Chloé’s talent. And yet, when Clara said you have to be a good match with Adrien Chloé’s retorts by saying they already are. She was extremely happy that she got to be in the video with Adrien hugging him but when Marinette changes her mind she lost her spot and became disgusted at the idea of becoming an extra in the video and stormed off back to the limo. When her butler gave her Mr. Cuddly saying she doesn't want him but took him anyway then got an idea. She demanded that her father cancel the show but when he refused Chloé threatened to call her mother to tell her what happened. After finding a way Chloé told everyone to leave and threw Clara's mike breaking it. But soon was demanded by Frightningale to sing and dance but when she refused she turned into a statue. After the villain's defeat, Chloé was returned to normal with the Miraculous Ladybug.
In "Syren", Chloé was asked by Kim to go to the movies with him but she didn't show up.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Zombizou", it was Miss Bustier's birthday and all the students prepared a gift for her, except for Chloé because she forgot to give Miss Bustier a present.
When she heard Marinette saying that she was heartless.
Chloé got her revenge by scribbling over her gift with permanent marker and soon was discovered by the entire class and was called by Alya and Alix for her cruel nature.
Then, soon after Miss Bustier got akumatized into Zombizou, the villain tried to make Chloé her first victim but she avoided it by using Sabrina as a human shield.
When Ladybug arrived she and the other students made their way into the Locker Room.
Upon hearing the heroine, Chloé came out of her hiding place running to her only to get shoulder thrown into a locker with Ladybug apologizing yet the others reveal themselves all here.
Except for Adrien, only to find him as a minion with everyone screaming alerting the rest of Zombizou's minions closing in they all moved to the roof.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 2]]
From the news they all heard that Zombizou was after Chloé and she was worried when she saw her father being affected too; however Alya, Nino and others don't hesitate to give into the villain's demands but Ladybug retorts knowing that she doesn't deserve what Zombizou had in mind.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 2]]
With the roof no longer safe they all moved to the bus, and she hesitantly told Max and Kim to go first but as the zombies make their way to roof they sacrificed themselves for her. When Chloé notices this, she told Kim that doesn't mean that he should expect to get a kiss from her but as she slid down Cat Noir missed her and begged for someone to save her. After Rose failed to catch her, Chloé got a twisted ankle and battered her for not being fast enough while on the bus ride to the Eiffel Tower; Rose and Juleka became infected too, Alix provided Chloé with enough space to escape yet still she wasn't moved by the sacrifice. Arriving at the tower she was carried the rest of the way by Cat Noir, after the loss of Nino and Alya, seeing her idol become disheartened over everyone sacrifices Chloé comforted her by saying only the best remain. Upon reaching the top, Zombizou's minions were already there with Cat Noir surrounded Chloé got tossed to Ladybug and thrown into the tower office. Finally making it where Ladybug needed her to be, she told her idol that she won't get in her way now and good luck but when an infected Cat Noir closes in Chloé takes the hit instead.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 2]]
After everyone returned to normal Chloé apologized to Miss Bustier about her actions causing trouble for everyone. But ends up being forgiven by her teacher with a hug which she enjoys for a moment then became a bit disturbed. By the next day, Chloé was demanded by Alya that she apologizes to everyone but retorts by saying they should be thanking her instead until Marinette separates them and took back her earlier comment leaving Chloé shocked. Then she quickly left a gift on Miss Bustier's desk before taking her seat.
In "Style Queen", Chloé attended Gabriel's fashion show with her parents and became as disgusted as her mother at not getting what she desires but she became more shocked when her mother was akumatized and struck Adrien. She tried reasoning with her by acting as her assistant but when Ladybug entered the scene understanding of her idol's purpose Chloé convinced Style Queen not to attack her and informed her mother where Gabriel Agreste was and taken to his mansion and then to the Eiffel Tower. She was instructed to keep an eye out for Ladybug but panicked about her situation and tried to break Adrien out.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 2]]
Eying the heroine she asked her where Cat Noir was but was shocked that he was no where to be found, and informed Ladybug where her mother's akuma was but told her to leave before Style Queen spots her and yet was turned into a gold statue. After Style Queen's defeat, Chloé was relieved her mother and Adrien were alright as she and her mother were walking down the tower Chloé asked her mother if she could come to New York with her and discovered a strange box. At home she opened it at first startled by her kwami Pollen.
In "Troublemaker", Chloé was walking out of the school's locker room with Sabrina.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Queen Wasp", after the show Chloé was expecting her mother to totally disregard Marinette's hat but became shocked that her mother liked it and how her rival had the opportunity to come to New York with her. Full of anger, jealously and desperate to prove herself to her mother, Chloé revealed the Bee Miraculous and transformed into Queen Bee and rushed off. Watching the city from up high, she was annoyed that there was nobody to save and got the idea to create a problem. Using her Venom power, she paralyzed the Metro driver to cause a speeding train and have it posted on the news, she tried to stop it on her own but was saved by Ladybug and Cat Noir. After that Chloé tried to save face but Ladybug called Queen Bee out on her recklessness and selfishness as well as seeing that her mother wasn't impressed.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 2]]
Having enough, Queen Bee was demanded by the heroine to relinquish the Bee Miraculous but refused, sneaking away Chloé returned home disheartened by her mother. She became akumatized again but as an evil Miraculous user known as Queen Wasp, and paralyzed everyone in the hotel. Then, moved onto the heroes still wanting to proved herself better and sent her wasps after them but when she saw them moving under the recycle bins she found it disgusting. With a snorkel she was pulled underwater by the heroes and once defeated Chloé returned to normal but was saddened that the Bee Miraculous was destroyed and for what she did to Pollen. Being brought up to the surface and with the Bee Miraculous repaired, Chloé was told by Ladybug and Cat Noir that the jewel must be returned but she begged them to give her another chance.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 2]]
When the news crew arrived Chloé was still disregard by her mother for her actions fully understanding her she was told by the heroes that when it comes to making a mistake it's important to fix it. Taking their advice to heart she returned the jewel and apologized to them. Sometime later, she was approached by Marinette and was encouraged to make things up with her mother; meeting Audrey at her helicopter. Chloé hesitantly asked her why she doesn't love her with Marinette's help the two discovered they had more in common than they thought. When her mother asked if everything that Marinette said was true and Chloé said yes and became happy that she finally gained her mother approval and much more that she will stay with her in Paris.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Reverser", Chloé approached the Art Club to present a project of her own but when called out another collage of selfies. She said no but hid it back in her bag and quickly left the room. Later Chloé, was having her nails done by Sabrina while having a drink, when Reverser arrived demanding to where Marinette and Nathaniel are she brushed him off. Then, she and Sabrina were struck with the villain's airplanes and this time Chloé tended on Sabrina until the Miraculous Ladybug returned them to normal and were confused by each others’ actions.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Malediktator", Chloé made a documentary for her class about being a true hero but most of them knew what really happened and that she acted nothing like a hero causing everyone, even Sabrina, to laugh at her. Which Chloé caught and fired her "best friend" and having enough of being criticized by everyone she stormed off out of the classroom in anger. Arriving at City Hall, she asked her father to banish Marinette from Paris when he couldn't Chloé started calling her father's position of power useless and threatened to leave for New York with her mother despite her father's attempts to get her to stay. Soon she and her mother were on route to the airport until their helicopter was brought down by Malediktator. When Chloé discovered that Malediktator was her father and when he said he could do everything she wished for but she was hesitant and seeing the problem she knew Ladybug was needed. Sneaking away from them she found herself in the subway, disgusted by the smell she braved it to look for the heroine. Then, made her way back home with Malediktator and minions still looking for her escaping to the roof she ran into Ladybug.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 2]]
Relieved she asked the heroine for help to which Ladybug agreed to but she needed to know why her father was angry. At first, Chloé blamed Marinette, then her father, and after being edged by the heroine to be honest she tearfully admitted it was her fault because she wanted to leave Paris because she served no purpose. Sympathetic the heroine told Chloé the exact opposite that everyone has one and yet she remained doubtful, but when given the opportunity to fix her mistake she accepted. Transforming into Queen Bee, she and Ladybug went off to find Malediktator upon doing so she tried to apologize but it fell on deaf ears. Despite putting up a fight the duo couldn't get close to Malediktator because of her guard shield and when he tried to enslave the entire city Queen Bee was impressed that Ladybug's Lucky Charm conjured a machine gun calling it effective.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 2]]
But was surprised when Ladybug threw it away leaving her concerned when the heroine assured her and clued in that all she had to do was take the sting out Queen Bee activated her Venom power. With Malediktator defenseless she paralyzed him and tossed his sash to Ladybug with everything and everyone returned to normal Chloé detransformed and returned the Bee Miraculous earning Ladybug's and Cat Noir's approval. Afterwards, she went home with her parents, then the next day she cleaned up her superhero hideout until she was approached by Marinette saying they have a surprise for her. Returning to the school Chloé was surprised that everyone threw a new party honoring her alter ego Queen Bee then she proceeded to show off her new cellphone case to everyone.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Catalyst", Chloé was getting for Heroes' Day with her classmates until she saw an illusion on video created by Volpina about Ladybug being akumatized and destroying Cat Noir she remained unconvinced that her idol would do such a thing. When a swarm of red akumas attacked the school Chloé remained calm and understood what needed to be done leaving for home. Sending out the bee signal Chloé wondered what was taking Ladybug so long and she when saw the signal go out she asked what took her so long, but was surprised to see Cat Noir saying that he was second fiddle. But she quickly takes her remark back when the hero says he'll find another Queen Bee but was pushed by the hero to ask for her Miraculous nicely afterwards she transformed into Queen Bee. Rejoining the other heroes she asked Ladybug why weren't they fighting and Ladybug answers they had to know what Hawk Moth was planning. Like everyone else, she was shocked to see him in person, and yet hearing their archenemy boast about his army Queen Bee told him not to get cocky and that she was going to sting him where it hurts.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Mayura", despite putting up a good fight against Hawk Moth's army after Rena Rouge and Carapace have been akumatized she told Ladybug not to worry about her being akumatized. But she became hesitant when her parents and Jean were reakumatized into their evil forms once again, then soon she was re-akumatized as well turning against her allies. Until thanks to the people of Paris and the heroes destroying Hawk Moth's cane, Chloé and Pollen were returned to normal and joined the others to stop Hawk Moth from stealing the heroes' jewels. Just as they were about to corner she attempted to use her Venom power to paralyze him but she and the others were blown away by a guardian created by the Peacock Miraculous wielder, Mayura. Quickly realizing that their archenemy had help she informed the others that he had escaped, later she returned the Bee Miraculous to Cat Noir.
Then, Chloé attended a picnic put together for Marinette to thank her for all good she had done while there she rejected the cookies Sabrina made. Then, was shocked when Marinette planted a kiss on Adrien while everyone else cheered for her.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Chameleon", Chloé was sitting at her usual seat along with Sabrina while everyone else was assigned to new seats.
In "Animaestro", Chloé was seen ordering Thomas Astruc to give her some dark chocolate macarons, assuming him as a waiter. After he told her that he is the movie director for the Ladybug and Cat Noir movie and not a waiter, she criticises him for not making a movie about Queen Bee, which is herself. When she saw Marinette crawling around, she also blamed him for hiring her as a waitress, but then changed her mind and decided that Marinette should be the waitress. When Marinette finally found her passion fruit flavored macaron for Adrien, she and Marinette stood beside each other at the same time, disappointed that Kagami Tsurugi. They accidentally copied each other and got annoyed until Chloé was asked by Marinette if she knew Kagami and says that she doesn't just know her, but despises her.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 3]]
Telling her of their first encounter; when Chloé spotted Kagami looking at them and deliberately locked arms with Adrien, she tried to go after them, but was restrained by Marinette. This made her come up with a plan to get rid of Kagami, preventing Adrien from getting close to her. Chloé then stole a seating chart from the security guard, being angered upon discovering that she was two rows behind Adrien. When Marinette was unsure about going along with the plan, she convinced her to do so by saying that if they don't, Adrien and Kagami might end up moving to Japan together.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 3]]
As part of the plan she was brought a garbage bag, ladle, and cooking string. Upon inspecting them she says that she asked for rope, but Marinette replied that the string was all she could find. Chloé then takes a bunch of macarons on a tray, puts them in the garbage bag, and smashed them. Then spits her gum into the ladle and gave it to Marinette, warning her not to screw up. As Chloé watched Marinette holding a tray of macarons and pretended to be clumsy, tripping over Adrien and Kagami causing the them to spill all over, she picked up a piece of chocolate cake, telling Jagged Stone to hold it for her. Upon seeing Marinette give Adrien a macaron she scolds her for as that wasn't part of the plan.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 3]]
As they hid behind a table, she saw that Kagami stepped on the gum. Moving on Chloé had  stuck moist crumbs of macarons onto all the chairs, so that Kagami wouldn't have a place to sit. Then, she tied the cooking string to a free chair and the one with the cake on it and pulled the string, swapping them. Chloé was very happy as she saw Kagami about to sit on the caked chair but saw Kagami being called by mother. She blamed Marinette and asked her what the deal was with the macaron being told that it was passion fruit flavored. With that she recognized it as Adrien's favorite flavor and that Marinette had a crush on him. Chloé laughs at her, claiming that she was a nobody in his eyes and decides to tell him to prove it. But the akumatized villain Animaestro came Chloé dismissed him turning her attention back to Adrien, only to find him gone. After Ladybug and Cat Noir defeated Animaestro, Chloé reveals that she had decided not to tell Adrien about Marinette having a crush on him since she isn't worth the extra attention. Also telling her that they'll never team up as she grabbed a black macaron on Marinette's tray and promptly entered the theater.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Bakerix", Chloé was boarding the Startrain during its inauguration with her father but before the ceremony could proceed it was interrupted by Bakerix. As Chloé was led off the train by Cat Noir, she retorts that they should've called Queen Bee for help but was told by the hero they were doing fine keeping her offered in mind and fled to safety.
In "Gamer 2.0", she was in the Library with Sabrina and Marinette until Max came in to ask Marinette if she test his new game. But Marinette turned him down rambling on that she made many things to do until Chloé clarified that everyone including her had better things to do in their lives. Soon she and several people were captured by Gamer 2.0 until Ladybug and Cat Noir defeated Gamer and was set free.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Miraculer", Chloé continued to wait in anticipation about becoming Queen Bee again but was angry that the team dealt with Destroyer without her. While at school she comes across Lila. From her Chloé learned that Ladybug comes to her through a special chant. Then was approached by Marinette who warned her about Lila but she took it as an insult. When a sentimonster appears she waits for the heroine once again albeit does the chant but quickly saw that Lila played her for a fool, giving into her anger she tells Sabrina to go away as they have nothing in common. Soon she was approached by akuma again with Hawk Moth trying to convince her that in coming to his side she'd have limitless power but not wanting to give up on Ladybug Chloé resisted the akuma.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 3]]
Then, she was approached by Miraculer saying that with Ladybug's powers they could play their game. But Chloé reacted with anger saying she didn't want to be Ladybug and that their was "only one" and she wasn't it. Then she saw weakened Cat Noir appear with the Bee Miraculous, but was again asked by Mayura to join them, hiding she told the hero they wouldn't be in this mess if they gotten her sooner. She was silenced by Ladybug who told to her to listen as they had a plan in mind, with Rena's powers they tricked Miraculer into giving Ladybug her powers back. However, Chloé was awestruck that Sabrina mistook an illusion of her for the real her claiming they were suppose to be best friends.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 3]]
After retrieving the Bee Miraculous, Chloé followed Ladybug's instructions to follow Mayura back to Hawk Moth. Transforming into Queen Bee she meets Mayura on the roof where the two have a scuffle and was convinced again to join them but refused. She came close to taking the Peacock Miraculous but the villainess got away, returning to the others she helped deakumatized Sabrina. Afterwards, she was told by Ladybug that her adventures as Queen Bee was over because of Hawk Moth knowing her identity putting her and everyone she loves in danger. Seemingly understanding the heroine Chloé gives her the Bee Miraculous, but hopes that they'll call on her again.
After the heroes were gone she rips the picture of her and Ladybug and went to play with Sabrina with her being Ladybug. At school the next day, Chloé goes to talk to Lila about the so called chant but with Lila changing her words around Chloé says that she wasn't totally useless and walked away.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Oblivio", while they are on their class field trip, Chloé and the students found Nino and Alya playing Super Penguino. They were laughing at the fact that the game was childish. When Sabrina even admit that they play the game, Chloé hushed her telling her not to say a word.
In "Party Crasher", Chloé was in the middle of a make-up frenzy with her butler Jean and father until they were called away to join Adrien's All Boys party.
In "Stormy Weather 2", Chloé made fun of Aurore because her GPA dropped a whole point, causing her to be akumatized into Stormy Weather for the second time. When Stormy Weather threatens to move the Earth away from the sun by creating a catastrophic, gigantic volcano, Chloé sets up her Bee Signal and waits with Sabrina for Ladybug to give her the Bee Miraculous. While waiting, the two recall the times when Chloé helped Ladybug defeat Despair Bear and when she was Queen Bee. Eventually, she is confronted by Stormy Weather, who traps her and Sabrina in a block of ice. Once Stormy Weather is defeated, she and Sabrina are freed, though Chloé insists that Queen Bee would've done a thousand times better.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Ladybug", Chloé was in Ms. Bustier's class and heard that Marinette was accused of stealing and cheating the Mock Exam answers seeing her leave for the principal's office. Upon seeing that everyone was sad about Marinette's expulsion and a swarm of scarlett akuma's enter the school, Chloé while defending Sabrina resisted akumatization.
In "Startrain", Chloé was getting ready for her class field trip to see Big Ben in London and wait for Sabrina. Once she arrived, Chloé went to the first class section of the trains thanks to accomadations made by her father and after getting settled she told Sabrina to leave. Upon seeing an akuma, she moved everyone out of the train car and tried to tell her classmates but when Alya and the others examined the area but found nothing they thought it was her calling a false alarm. But it turned out that the false alarm was true when Max's mother Claudie was akumatized into Startrain blasting everyone into space.
In "Kwamibuster", Chloé, like the rest of her class, was aware that Olga Mendeleiev was on a tv show and watched in the library. When Olga Mendeleiev's lost, she felt sorry for her.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Félix", she watches the video Felix sent to her disguised as Adrien.
In "Cat Blanc", in alternate timeline Chloé looked on in anger that Adrien and Marinette officially became a couple calling it ridiculous as she walked into the school.
In "Heart Hunter", she gets angry when seeing Ryuko with Ladybug, and Hawk Moth convinced her to betray the heroes in order to become Queen Bee for good.
In "Miracle Queen", she was akumatized into Miracle Queen. She is defeated, stripped of her hero status and expelled from the hero's team by Ladybug, whom she renounces her fanship off in response.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Lies", Chloé accuses Sabrina of having lost her purse.
In "Sole Crusher", Chloé meets Zoé for the first time and she doesn't really like her because Zoé doesn't act like her. Then, Chloé critiques Zoé because she is texting the "Baker Girl" referring to Marinette. Later on, when Zoé gets akumatized into Sole Crusher, Sole Crusher interrupts Chloé's photoshoot. She saw her half-sister is akumatized and she ran off to Marinette's to hide. Later on, she threatened the titular villain into crushing Kitty Section by sending her back to New York, she was stopped by Marinette, who knows she has gone too far. Later she demanded her father to send Zoé back to New York, but was convinced otherwise.
In "Queen Banana", Chloé was in her room while Sabrina was serving her bananas and watching tv. She participates in the film trying to control everything. Then she gets akumatized into Queen Banana after getting angry saying the others didn't make her movie. Afterwards, she receives a Magical Charm from Zoé as a show of sympathy, but Chloé still hates her.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Gabriel Agreste", she plans to ruin Adrien's life by letting Gabriel see a video of Marinette and her friends planning to get her and Adrien together at school.
In "Mega Leech", she goes with the rest of the class to Place des Vosges for the Oxygen project.
In "Guiltrip", she gets angry when others don't laugh at her jokes.
In "Optigami", she is reduced to ashes by her mother who has become Style Queen again.
In "Sentibubbler", she appears in Marinette's Nightmare, saying it's ridiculous not to have been Ladybug.
In "Wishmaker", Chloé mocks Marinette saying that her job will be a baker.
In "Dearest Family", she can be heard in the distance crying out to his father.
In "Penalteam", she refuses to play soccer, so she gets akumatized in Penalty and creates her soccer team. Afterwards, she leaves and partners with Lila.
In "Risk (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 1)", she pushes Marinette when Adrien leaves.
In "Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)", she is terrified when Monarch now has all of the Miraculous.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Multiplication", she gets mad at the loss of the Miraculous, and says it would never have happened if she was still Queen Bee, Lila tells her that Ladybug sometimes makes mistakes in life.
In "Illusion", Chloé wants to sit with Adrien, but he doesn't want to.
In "Determination", Chloé is a prisoner of Manipula, when Ladybug arrives, Chloé calls her a sucker because of the loss of the Miraculous.
In "Passion", when the students leave the classroom, Chloé is heard in the distance saying that she doesn't want to go back to the Middle Ages.
In "Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1)", she and Sabrina talk badly about Marinette.
In "Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)", she knocks Marinette off her chair and insults her in front of everyone, but Zoe puts her in her place, Chloe gets akumatized into Sole Destroyer.
In "Derision", her past bullying of Marinette was revealed and Adrien ends their friendship for good after she refused to make amends.
In "Perfection", she pushed Marinette out of her yoga spot, but Lila takes her somewhere, eventually Chloe decides to make Lila her best friend, which angered Sabrina.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Adoration", Chloé was frustrated that Zoe brought Marinette at their house and saw her step on the stairs framed Marinette at the Eiffel Tower by lying that Marinette steals stuff, but then Ladybug and Cat Noir called her out.
In "Emotion", she went to the Diamond Ball, and mistook Marinette for one of her friends. But quickly discovered that it was her, but Felix made her disappear. Then, it was only when Felix finally understood the real outcome of the world he created by Ladybug, Adrien and Kagami that she and everyone else was restored.
In "Revelation", she got mad at Sabrina because she revealed to Miss Bustier that Sabrina has been doing Chloé's homework for her. Then, she becomes a delegate with Lila after the latter cons the rest of the class into holding new class rep elections.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Confrontation", she and Lila conspire to submit forged career forms for their classmates and frame Marinette in order to destroy the latter's reputation and ruin the other students lives. However, Sabrina, knowing that this was going too far, even for her and finally fed up with their mistreatment towards her, betrays them by secretly allying herself with Marinette and publicly exposing them. As a result, Lila is expelled and while Chloé's not expelled (due to her mother influencing her father not to), loses her last remaining "friend", Sabrina and Ms. Bustier vows to come down on her much harder as her teacher. But Lila, who takes on a new identity of "Cerise" contacts her, telling her that "the war is just beginning".
In "Collusion", after abusing her power (under Cerise's influence) to get Marinette expelled and Ms. Bustier fired, Chloé, with the help of Gabriel and Tomoe's robots, took over as the new Mayor of Paris after her father voluntarily resigns, making some new changes by declaring Monarch, Ladybug and Cat Noir "outlaws".
In "Revolution", Gabriel as Monarch makes a deal with Chloé and akumatizes her as Queen Mayor.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 5]]
After abusing her power and imprisoning many dissidents, Chloe traps Ladybug and Cat Noir in hopes that their true identities will be revealed, but she was then eventually overthrown by Miss Bustier with the help of the Resistance and all of the Parisians, ending her reign as mayor.
She also gets abandoned by Gabriel and Tomoe (who were planning on betraying her once the French superhero duo's identities was exposed) to save themselves and even Cerise, who steals Tomoe's laptop and stops helping her.
Then, she's forced to leave Paris with her mother.
On the plane to London, Audrey holds her daughter responsible for the Bourgeois family losing face and vows to take control of her life again; her first in doing so will be her education.
Angered she even lost her mother's love and respect, Chloé retreats to the back of the plane.
She then scrolls through her contacts on her Alliance ring, and stops at Sabrina.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 5]]
She is lost in thought and she appears to have some sort of epiphany, but turns down a chance to reconcile with Sabrina to try and taunt Marinette one last time about Adrien's departure in an attempt to regain some control over her life again, but it backfired (due to Marinette having already been told about it and witnessed it) with Marinette coldly shutting her down and told her off, citing that her and Adrien's love for each other will never fade away and lastly tells Chloé she no longer has no power over anyone or anything anymore and that she is now the one who is "utterly ridiculous", before hanging up.
After this, Chloé finally realizes that she has hit rock-bottom and truly lost everything, and she can only cry in despair over being left completely powerless and alone.

title: Chloé Bourgeois/History
text:
Chloé Bourgeois/History - [[Season 6]]
In "Daddycop", Chloé appears at the beginning in a vlog on her social media that is watched by Sabrina, where she claims to be doing well in her new life in London, and puts out advertising for a new minion, while also throwing shade at Sabrina for her prior betrayal.
In "Queen of the Dreadzone", Chloe comes back to Paris to shoot a movie about Queen Bee, she recieve a package from Cerise.

title: Chris Lahiffe
text:
Chris Lahiffe - Intro
is a minor character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He is Nino's little brother, with whom Nino has a close bond. Starting from season 6, he is a student at Collège Françoise Dupont.
In "Christmaster", after he began to want Christmas to arrive immediately so that he could receive his gift, he was akumatized by Hawk Moth into Christmaster, a Christmas elf-themed supervillain who could control toys in order to get his present from Santa Claus.
In "Timetagger", an older Chris from the future was akumatized by someone and became Timetagger, a time-traveling rapper-themed supervillain that could travel through time and send people/objects in any point of time, who came to the present.

title: Chris Lahiffe
text:
Chris Lahiffe - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Chris has light auburn hair, moderate orange eyes, and a moderate orange/light brown skin tone. He wears black glasses identical to his brother's.
As an teenager in the future, Chris becomes taller and his hair mostly remains the same except that his sides are cut.
Civilian Attire
Chris wears a grayish lime green t-shirt with a white neck collar. on top, he wears a blue, indigo, and bluish black plaid flannel short-sleeved jacket. He also wears dark blue jeans that he tucks up from the bottom, and black and white striped vivid chartreuse green sneakers with small platform soles about 1 cm.
From season 6 onwards, his blue, indigo, and bluish black plaid flannel short-sleeved jacket now have white buttons and paler green t-shirt with long sleeves with a white neck collar with new pattern on his shirt and his sleeves.
As a teenager, Chris wears a dark green gas mask with silver filters around his neck. He wears a black jacket with yellow linings. He has a lime green dress t-shirt underneath. He wears camouflage cargo pants and moderate green shutter shades. His shoes are black, lime green, and white with a velcro straps.
As Christmaster

title: Chris Lahiffe
text:
Chris Lahiffe - Appearance
As Christmaster, he had white skin, cream-colored teeth, matching scleras, and red eyes. He wore a black and red jester-like Santa Claus hat, a red and black tunic, black fingerless gloves, a black butterfly shaped mask around his eyes, and jester boots.
As Timetagger
Timetagger had pale blue skin, blue-violetish black hair, and vivid green eyes. Covering his eyes were green shades. He wore a black hoodie with sky blue edges, the hood over his head, and black sweatpants. Under the hood was a light brilliant yellow visor, and on the back of the hoodie was a symbol depicting a clock. Around his neck, he had a gas mask colored light brilliant arctic blue and light brilliant yellow and a yellow chain necklace with a clock on it. He wore high-top shoes that were mainly black with yellow laces and had blue symbols on them.

title: Chris Lahiffe
text:
Chris Lahiffe - Personality
Chris is small and funny. He considers himself a big boy, which is why he is capricious and rebellious when Marinette wants to play with toys with him, making him extremely hard to get along with. Despite having a lot of toys, he thinks dolls are for small children, and his toys are different. For this reason, he does not like to watch cartoons intended for younger people and protests when someone says he is too young to play certain games. However, the boy is highly curious, hinted at by how excited he is at the gifts that Marinette hides from him. He can be skeptical, but if someone doesn't admit to lying after he calls them out, he is quick to believe them. This is shown when he does not believe that Marinette is Santa's elf but believes it soon after calling her out, hoping that the girl would get the perfect gift for him. He hates the term love and thinks it's horrible, but he also knows how to be polite, greeting Ladybug while Cat Noir takes him away.

title: Chris Lahiffe
text:
Chris Lahiffe - Personality
Even though Chris and his friends love to play even he knows that there are times to be serious. Upon seeing Ladybug and Cat Noir acting like his age and fighting so poorly to the point of them giving up their jewels. He knew of what would happen if Hawk Moth got them and like Manon is shown to be very clever.
As Christmaster, he was very greedy and fond of his toys, even willing to give up his akuma for them.
As Timetagger, he was incredibly arrogant and conceited in his own abilities and fond of taunting his enemies. He showed little to no concern about how his actions would affect others or history in general, sending people back in time at random and even tormenting Bunnyx by banishing her to various time periods. He was even willing to manipulate Hawk Moth as part of his scheme, making him believe that he was sent by his future counterpart to get the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses for him in the past, only to double-cross him by revealing that he wasn't the one who sent him at all.

title: Chris Lahiffe
text:
Chris Lahiffe - Abilities
As Christmaster
He wielded a magic snow globe that, when a toy touched it, makes the toy enlarge, come to life, and have powers and abilities that corresponded to the nature of the toy. Examples included:
Grobotek Ultima Destruktor.
Colonel Woof-Woof, a toy dog that could track people through smell.
A toy catfish that could swim through the air.
Green toy soldiers.
A T-Rex.
Ladybug and Cat Noir action figures that could use Lucky Charm and Cataclysm, respectively.
The Ladybug and Cat Noir toys could also use their powers multiple times.
He also resided in a floating citadel made of building blocks.
His powers also transported Santa Claus and his sleigh to Paris.
As Timetagger
His spray paint gun allowed him to open a portal in time. He could open a portal for himself or shoot someone to send them to a time period of Timetagger's choosing. This often resulted in altering history, such as making Mr. Ramier a famous knight in the 15th century with a statue of him built outside the Louvre, ancient paintings depicting Jagged Stone and Nadja Chamack, and an ancient Egyptian stone tablet with an image of André the Ice Cream Man.

title: Chris Lahiffe
text:
Chris Lahiffe - Abilities
He could also use his gun to mark a location with graffiti and later use the graffiti to teleport "back in time" to that location in the same pose he struck when he marked the location.

title: Chris Lahiffe
text:
Chris Lahiffe - Relationships
Family
Nino Lahiffe
Not much is known about Chris's relationship with his brother, but Nino does care about him as he shows concern for him when he appears sad after being at Marinette's house and later on when he is akumatized.
Friend/Allies
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/Ladybug
In "Christmaster", Chris was being babysat by Marinette and gets annoyed when she suggests that he play with his toys rather than video games, insisting that he is a big boy. He notices that Marinette has several presents hidden in her room and asks about it, only for Marinette to lie and claim that she is one of Santa's elves. He is upset with her when he learns the truth, though he quickly forgives her but is disgusted to learn that the presents she hid are for a boy.
Like everyone else in Paris, Chris greatly admires Ladybug.
In "Simpleman", he along with his friends rush to the heroes defense trying to convince them not give their jewels to the titular villain and by extension Hawk Moth showing his bravery. His willingness to help her come up with a plan to stop the titular villain.

As Christmaster, he was sure that his toys would defeat her and Cat Noir but when he saw that the heroes were willing to destroy them he agreed to Ladybug's deal and surrenders his akuma.

title: Chris Lahiffe
text:
Chris Lahiffe - Trivia
In the French version, Chris is named Noël.
Since his debut episode was planned as a Christmas special, the different name is apparently intended to match the episode's name with the holiday theme.
This follows suit on the wordplay of Nino's name with Nolife.
He is the first akumatized victim that willingly gives his akumatized object to Ladybug.
He's the sixth child to be akumatized, following Manon Chamack, August, Ella and Etta Césaire and the unnamed boy.
Additionally, Christmaster's powers are similar to the Puppeteer's, as they both bring toys to life with an akumatized object used to control them.
He is the first known akumatized villain that was akumatized by the Future Butterfly Miraculous holder.
He has the distinction of being the only akumatized victim with multiple akumatized identities who has never been akumatized on-screen.
Timetagger is the third akumatized villain to have time-related powers after Timebreaker and Backwarder.

title: Christmaster
text:
Christmaster - Intro
"" is a special Christmas themed season 3 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 12th written and produced episode of season 3. It is also the 64th written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Christmaster
text:
Christmaster - Synopsis
Netflix
Marinette babysits Nino's little brother, Chris, who akumatizes into Christmaster and wields a magic snow globe that can make giant toys.
Disney+
Ladybug face Nino's little brother, now Christmaster.

title: Christmaster
text:
Christmaster - Plot
Marinette is taking care of Chris Lahiffe, the brother of her friend, Nino, but he is bored by Marinette's games, considering them to be for babies. He gets curious about the chest in Marinette's room. In order to keep the secret that she keeps presents for Adrien's future birthdays, Marinette says that she's one of Santa's secret elves who keeps presents for Christmas, and only the best-behaved kid in the world can receive a gift before Christmas, leading Chris to want Christmas to come immediately. Nino and Alya come in and pick up Chris.

title: Christmaster
text:
Christmaster - Plot
Marinette starts to make another present for Adrien of his 50th birthday, but falls asleep. When she wakes up, she realizes that it is snowing and that the streets of Paris have been invaded by living toys in search of Santa Claus and thought that Hawk Moth has akumatized Chris. Marinette transforms into Ladybug and, finding Santa's broken sled, calls Cat Noir who reveals that he is at the ice rink with Philippe and Santa Claus. After reaching them, Santa explains that he was inexplicably catapulted to Paris, and Cat Noir saved him from the toys bringing him there. At that moment, living toys arrive that require Santa to give a gift to Christmaster, but Santa refuses, stating that he has to wait for Christmas. However, there is an exception for the best-behaved child in the world, the same thing Marinette had told Chris. Since Philippe is the only one able to move on the ice, he entertains the toys (ending up being captured) while the heroes bring Santa to safety.

title: Christmaster
text:
Christmaster - Plot
Cat Noir wears Santa's hat to be followed by living toys, while Ladybug and Santa Claus move away. They find Nino desperately looking for his younger brother, since he disappeared along with some of his toys, confirming to Ladybug that Chris was akumatized, and it was he who caused all that disaster. Ladybug uses Lucky Charm which gives a stationery set, and she writes what she would like; since Ladybug is at the top of the list of the best, she has the right to receive a gift in advance. Santa takes her list and discovers that Ladybug has asked for whatever Chris Lahiffe wants. After warning her that that would be the only gift she will receive this year, Santa grants Ladybug her wish. The gift is taken by a toy that is brought to Christmaster, allowing Ladybug to follow him. Cat Noir has been captured by toys. Hawk Moth orders Christmaster to take his ring, but Ladybug intervenes.

title: Christmaster
text:
Christmaster - Plot
Christmaster animates a toy version of each of the superheroes, which can use their special powers over and over again. Santa Claus intervenes and gets rid of the two toys. Christmaster brings to life the toy he had received, making it huge. With a ploy, Ladybug tells him that if he does not give her his snow globe (containing the akuma) then Cat Noir will destroy the robot with the Cataclysm. Despite Hawk Moth trying to dissuade him, Christmaster reluctantly gives his globe, which is destroyed by Cat Noir, freeing the akuma that is then purified by Ladybug. The two heroes say goodbye to Santa Claus and then Ladybug puts Paris back to normal. Hawk Moth claims that Ladybug deprived him of his Christmas presents; however, his birthday is near, and it will be a day Ladybug will never forget.
Marinette babysits Chris again, and the two promise to always tell each other the truth. When Chris asks again what is in the chest, Marinette starts to explain it to him, but by mentioning her crush on someone, Chris starts to complain because he doesn't like romantic things. Marinette continues talking about her crush, hamming it up for extra effect.

title: Christmaster
text:
Christmaster - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in Canada on Family Channel.
In French, the episode is named "Maître Noël", translating to 'Master Christmas'.
Christmaster is the first akumatized victim to voluntarily hand over his akumatized object to Ladybug.
As revealed by Thomas Astruc, this episode was meant to be the original Christmas episode but was cancelled due to not being "Christmassy" enough.
Since then, the script had been revised with Philippe Candeloro's character, Philippe being added in.
Interestingly, the names of Philippe's daughters, Luna, Maya, and Thalia, share their names with Candeloro's real life daughters.
Following "Prime Queen", this is the second time Adrien is only seen in his Cat Noir form for a whole episode.
Similar, Marinette told a lie (well from her perspective) without knowing it was the truth: this time the lie was that she was one of Santa's elf helpers, about Santa's rules and making an exception to the most well behaved kid in the world. To her shock and surprise Santa said the same thing as she did to Chris and by seeing his list as Ladybug, Marinette is the most well behaved kid in the world.

title: Christmaster
text:
Christmaster - Trivia
Cat Noir states that nothing can resist his Cataclysm, even though in both "Reflekdoll" and "Miraculer", he and the sentimonster were able to resist it to some extent. This suggests that he has either lack of knowledge or experience with his Cataclysm, or this episode took place before the other two from his perspective.
References
Christmaster's akumatization are not shown, making this the seventh time this happens, after Magician of Misfortune in "Princess Fragrance", Vanisher in "Antibug", the Unnamed boy in "Sandboy", August akumatization in "Weredad", Alya and Nino's akumatization in "Oblivio" and Vivica in "Desperada".
This episode also marks the 7th time Hawk Moth sends out an akuma off-screen, following "Princess Fragrance", "Antibug", "Sandboy", "Weredad", "Oblivio" and "Desperada".
When Cat Noir describes the other weird situations he and Ladybug have been in, he references the events of "The Pharaoh" and "Mr. Pigeon".
The sword that Toy Ladybug summoned is similar to the Lucky Charm design seen in "Sandboy".
Allusions

title: Christmaster
text:
Christmaster - Trivia
The phrase "All your toys are belong to us" is a reference to an internet meme originating from the 1992 Mega Drive port of the 1989 arcade video game Zero Wing.
The whole episode is an homage to Stéphane Aubier & Vincent Patar's "Panique Au Village", referencing their stop-motion animation skills.
When Marinette and Santa Claus mention a witch delivering presents to kids, they are referencing the fictional figure Befana: a witch said to bring presents to kids in Italy on January 5th.
Coincidentally, her own grandmother was akumatized into such a villain in "Befana."
Errors
The title card of the English dubbed version of this episode incorrectly refers to it as "Chris Master".
The same mistake happens on the official trailer and the videos of the official channel.
The correct title was used in a short from April 2024.
When Netflix and Disney+ released the episode, the incorrect title was used as well.
The episode is also incorrectly titled on BBC iPlayer.

title: Claudie Kanté
text:
Claudie Kanté - Intro
is a minor character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She is the former conductor of Startrain and a recent astronaut. She is also the mother of Max Kanté.
In "Startrain", after Claudie thought she failed to become an astronaut, she was akumatized into Startrain, a train conducting supervillain.

title: Claudie Kanté
text:
Claudie Kanté - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Claudie is a dark-skinned woman of average height. She has dark brown eyes and short brown hair that's styled in a large, braided bun composed of many small, thin braids.
From season 6 onwards, she is shown to wear pink eyeshadow and her hair now become black that's styled in a large, high braided bun composed of many small, thin braids.
Civilian Attire
She wears a moderate raspberry dress jacket with sleeves going slightly past her elbows with a matching galaxy rectangular pin attached with 'TRAIN' written on it over a black blouse, a black belt moderate crimson dress pants and a hat with a black peak and jacket matching accenting the pants-matching center equator and a matching name tag on her jacket. For accessories, she wears a black smart watch and earrings silver dangling with ringed planets.
From season 6 onwards, she is shown wearing a blue dress jacket with a rocket logo on the right side over a dark green sweater
As Startrain

title: Claudie Kanté
text:
Claudie Kanté - Appearance
Startrain had a very robotic and angled appearance, with most of her body being covered in armor and a black skintight suit underneath. The armor itself was primarily a blueish chrome, comprised of a seat, chest plate, gloves and a helmet reminiscent of a race car driver, complete with a red, angled visor. Her outfit was also styled with bright red and pink accents around the sleeves, waist and parts of her helmet. The deadman switch holding her akuma changed into a full arm attachment, confining her right arm to the console at all times. Her chair also provided the same limitations, restricting her movement. Underneath the armor, Startrain had a deep magenta skin tone and black lipstick, with her lower face being the only part visible.

title: Claudie Kanté
text:
Claudie Kanté - Personality
Claudie is very enthusiastic, both about her job and the possibility of becoming an astronaut. She can get very anxious when she is waiting for important news. Claudie is a very proud and sacrificing mother, as she postporned her dream to become an astronaut so she could remain close to her son, only pursuing it once Max was old enough to be self-suficient. She also treats A.I.s lilke Markov and A.D.A. as a sentient being instead of a robot.
As Startrain, she was so enthralled with her dream that she disregarded pleas from others, including her own son, though she acted cheerfully towards him. She completely disregarded other people's safety as she intended to travel across the universe with only a minimum oxygen supply. She was also very antagonistic towards those who threatened her, which was shown when she overheated a train car to stop Ladybug and Cat Noir from reaching her.

title: Claudie Kanté
text:
Claudie Kanté - Abilities
As a Civilian
Claudie is very skilled in conducting a train safely and quickly. Max even says that he loves traveling through the Startrain because the travels with his mother are always safe and the train arrives on time to its destination.
Claudie passed all the tests required to become an astronaut, which includes various skills. After the training, she got skilled enough to conduct a flying test to Tsurugi Industries's newly space jet with A.I.
As Startrain
As Startrain, she was the conductor of the akumatized train of the same name, which was a vehicle capable of space flight. The train itself was well prepared for intergalactic travel, able to reach near impossible speeds instantaneously and break through the atmosphere in seconds. It was also indestructible, air tight and pressure shielded.

title: Claudie Kanté
text:
Claudie Kanté - Abilities
From within the train itself, Startrain could control any of its functions, displaying the ability to adjust the temperature with air conditioning units, drain oxygen from selected cars to create a void, or prevent doors from being opened without specialized equipment or skills in programming like Markov. She also had the ability to summon the beverage serving drones of the train, modified by the Akuma to be durable robots capable of shooting destructive laser bolts.
Interestingly, Startrain was one of the only villains to have no powers of her own, especially since she was both bound to the control board by the deadman switch and to the floor by her lower body. This meant that she became completely vulnerable once Ladybug, Cat Noir and Pegasus were able to break into the captain's cabin.

title: Claudie Kanté
text:
Claudie Kanté - Relationships
Max Kanté
Claudie loves her son very much and is very proud of his accomplishments, especially the fact he was able to program an A.I. that is able to develop actual human emotions. Because her main dream involves being very far away for a long time, she put it on hold for a long time so she could look after Max until he was older.
Due to her son's autism, Claudie had made sure to always keep a tight schedule with him in order to keep him comfortable as much as possible. This also led her to start give him heart-shapped pieces of felt that she kisses so that her son would have her love with him and use it as a source of comfort whenever he feels distressed. However, her eventual departure to the International Space Station for several weeks had caused her to start worry how Max would react to it. Fortunately, she gets reassured after Max decided he would be okay living at Marinette's during that time.

title: Claudie Kanté
text:
Claudie Kanté - Relationships
As Startrain, she still had some affection for her son, as she excitedly told him she would be able to share her dream with him. However, despite everything, she turned against him when he tried to stop her, even if she only did it with the objective to prevent him from moving forward.
A.D.A.
Because A.D.A. was created based on her son's A.I. program and designed to help her pilot the Tsurugi space jet in case she can't, Claudie has great trust in her. After A.D.A. got hacked by Monarch and had her sensors turned off, Claudie got very worried about her, especially because she had become basically an unintended prisoner of her.

title: Claudie Kanté
text:
Claudie Kanté - Trivia
Claudie was revealed in a synopsis by RTS Deux.
Claudie might be based on retired French astronaut Claudie Haigneré.
Startrain is the second Akumatized villain to name herself, the first being The Collector.
Startrain is the third Akumatized villain to act on her own accord. The first was The Collector, who Akumatized himself, and the second was Robostus, who betrayed Hawk Moth and tried to get the Miraculouses for himself.
However, Startrain is the first Akumatized villain to not be Akumatized directly by Hawk Moth, as the Akuma was too far from him.
In "Climatiqueen", it is revelated that Claudie wrote a book, "Claudie Kanté: Weather from Space".
In "A Fairy Good Night", it's revelated that Claudie sometimes goes to Max's therapy sessions.

title: Clara Contard
text:
Clara Contard - Intro
is a minor character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She is a journalist and news reporter, who working at the TVi Tower for the TVi television network.

title: Clara Contard
text:
Clara Contard - Appearance
Clara has dark green eyes, and her golden blonde hair is cut into a short bob that ends in the center of her neck. She wears a white business jacket with a folded collar, and she wears a pink shirt beneath it.
From season 6 onwards, her hair is blonde instead of golden blonde and her eyes are now cornflower blue.

title: Clara Contard
text:
Clara Contard - Personality
Clara is a very serious and focused person in her work. She likes to be in the field of view and report live, whether it's on the street or in certain places. She's probably brave and dedicated to her work, because despite the dangerous weather conditions, she reports in "Stormy Weather 2" and "Perfection".
She is also always looking for sensational news, which is why she can be seen trying to interview Marinette, as the girlfriend of the French starry boy Adrien Agreste in "Climatiqueen".

title: Clara Contard
text:
Clara Contard - Abilities
As a reporter, Clara has excellent language skills and the ability to express herself clearly and effectively, able to attract the attention of viewers and accurately convey information.

title: Clara Contard
text:
Clara Contard - Etymology
Clara Contard's name is a pun on the French word racontar, which means "gossip".

title: Clara Contard
text:
Clara Contard - Trivia
In "The Dark Owl", Mrs. Rossi and Clara Contard used the same background model. According to Thomas Astruc, they are not the same character, and it was an animation mistake that both characters use the same model.
Prior to the episode "The Dark Owl", both models in the series were used for background characters. Interestingly, in "Simon Says" and "Guitar Villain", Clara's model can be seen in TVi Tower, as well as in various episodes as a photographer, but it is unknown if she was herself.
Her background model is used for Arlette, Nadja's and Clara's boss in "Prime Queen".
"Qilin" and "Noe" are the only times she's seen reporting in the TVi Tower, instead of reporting from outside.
