When she saw Monarch de-transform, it's likely she fully understood the "Cat Blanc" incident and what adult Bunnyx had meant back then, why she lied and probably got a good gist of what happened. As she was right about Adrien finding out her identity from the gift, as well as remembered what Cat Blanc said about them being an "item" suspecting that herself from that future knew who he was too. And from Félix's story and their fight, Ladybug figured out that Gabriel knew about their relationship and did something as Hawk Moth to break them up leading to her partner's akumatization, him possibly learning of either heroes identity and discovered why and what he did.
But it hasn't been confirmed or denied with the information if Ladybug has figured out that Cat Noir is her boyfriend.
Another way a victim can deakumatize themselves by coughing out the akuma.
It's revealed Monarch's costume comes with removable gloves. It's unknown if he needs them on to create a megakuma or if any of his previous forms, Hawk Moth or Shadow Moth have the removable gloves too.

title: Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1) - Plot Developments
Gabriel created a quantum imprint detector to detect a quantum imprint of a certain Miraculous holder while they are transformed. Back in "Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)", Ladybug discussed using Hawk Moth's broken cane to track him, this likely means that the guardians, as well as anyone who studies the Miraculous, has traditional means to track a person's quantum imprint. Though it is unknown how is it accomplished, since this episode shows a modern, high-tech version to trace one's quantum imprint.
And yet, it's possible that the guardians didn't only track Miraculous holders by their quantum imprints but could've used their chosen superpowers to track them since some of them aren't for stealth or if they don't have an active Ladybug to repair the damage.

title: Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1) - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in Switzerland on RTS Un, alongside "Re-creation".
This is the eighth season 5 episode that is not named after the concept of a Miraculous.
In this episode, the concept of conformation: the act of conforming or producing conformity, is applied through many instances and other episodes:
Tormented by the nightmares caused by Nightormentor, the people around the world wearing Alliances conformant with the fact showed to them by the rings that Ladybug and Cat Noir had kidnapped Adrien and Kagami, giving in then to the Perfect Alliance and becoming Miraculized.
Those who had never used an Alliance ended up giving in to their desperation and started wearing the Alliance as well:
Adrien, afraid to be akumatized by Monarch and destroy the world as a result, gives his Cat Miraculous to Plagg so he could give it to Ladybug and then accepts an Alliance ring so he could control his nightmare.
Ivan, who was afraid that his nightmare of losing Mylène would become a reality, also gave in to the Alliance ring.

title: Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1) - Trivia
After the "revelation" that "Ladybug" and "Cat Noir" had kidnapped "Adrien" and "Kagami", both desperate to save his friends and to end his nightmare, Ivan lets himself transform into a Miraculized.
Mylène, who had always refused to wear an Alliance for not being eco-friendly, but a symbol of consumerism, ended up using one after being both tormented by her nightmare and convinced by her friends.
Ladybug finally has the confirmation that Gabriel Agreste, the father of the boy she loves, is Monarch, in this way conforming with the fact that the story told by Félix and Kagami is real.
In "Copycat", everyone was convinced by the news that Cat Noir was a thief because of the titular villain.
In "Catalyst", many gave into Volpina's illusion of heroes being gone leaving them vulnerable to akumatization and becoming apart of Scarlet Moth's army.
The opposite of the concept of conformation could also be seen in some instances and other episodes:

title: Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1) - Trivia
Nathalie, who was at the edge of reaching the final state of her illness caused by using the damaged Peacock Miraculous and also tormented by her nightmare of Gabriel getting and use the Ladybug and Cat Miraculous to get his wish, refused to give in and decided to stop Gabriel once and for all, only failing because of her fragile state.
After the world is led to believe Ladybug and Cat Noir had kidnapped Adrien and Kagami, Alya refused to believe in that, both because she had an absolute faith in the heroes of Paris and because she knew who Ladybug is, and inspired her friends to do the same.
As well as Fei and the North American heroes that came to Paris to help.
In "Copycat", after everyone was convinced by the news that Cat Noir was a thief, Ladybug was the only one who believed he was innocent.
There were those who didn't believe Hawk Moth's lies and stood alongside Ladybug and Cat Noir against him.
This is the fourth time Gabriel has (directly) akumatized himself, following "The Collector", "Dearest Family" and "Representation".

title: Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1) - Trivia
As Gabriel akumatizes himself into Nightormentor, parts of Hawk Moth's akumatizing theme from certain episodes of Season 1, such as "Dark Cupid" and "The Pharaoh" for example, can be heard. Going by production code order, this is the fourth episode of season 5 to reprise Hawk Moth's themes from season 1.
It's revealed what the nightmare instigated by Nightormentor is to some characters:
Marinette's nightmare is to be the source of Adrien's pain.
This nightmare of hers is a reflection of what she had learned at the night before from Félix and Kagami. Despite still processing the information, her subconscious had caused her to have a nightmare where she is the reason why Adrien loses his father, despite the fact he is the villain in their love story that is trying to prevent them from being together.
When actually the reason isn't true as it was Gabriel's own choices that forced both heroes' hand in the first place.
Tom's nightmare is for Marinette, consumed by sadness of being away from Adrien, to stop eating at all, causing her to become so tiny that she is eaten by a mouse.

title: Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1) - Trivia
Sabine's nightmare is that Tom would become so worried about Marinette's sadness that he would be akumatized into Werebaker.
Judging from Sabine's description, Tom was probably a variant of Weredad who can trap people in bread and create an army of croissants.
Alya's nightmare is that Monarch would come to her to know Ladybug's identity while her second nightmare is that when she gives the Cat Miraculous to Monarch.
Nathalie's nightmare is that Monarch would get both the Ladybug and Cat Miraculous and use the absolute power to mold the world based on his madness.
Mylène's nightmare is that all the trees in the planet had been taken away by aliens (possibly the Aklipt Invaders from "Timetagger").
Ivan's nightmare is that Mylène would leave him to save polar bears from an endangered habitat.
As Nathalie prepares to shoot Gabriel with her bow and arrow in the Crypt, Scarlet Moth's transformation theme from "Catalyst" and "Ladybug" can be heard, and it is the first time this theme is used since the latter episode.
This is the first fusion form done on the cliffhanger of an episode.

title: Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1) - Trivia
Monarch was only shown to absorb Stompp into his rings, but he also absorbed Wayzz, Pollen, and Kaalki into his rings off-screen.
It's unknown why he didn't absorb a fifth Kwami into his rings, as he stated he could use up to 5 Miraculouses in ring form.
This is the first episode to make it debatable whether there is an end card or not.
This is the sixth episode of seasons 4 and 5 not to have a polka-dotted pattern on its end card, following "Rocketear", "Penalteam", "Determination", "Reunion" and "Migration".
This is the only episode of Season 5 that does not have an endcard.
Allusions
Marinette hiding in a cupboard under the sink is a reference to Jurassic Park.
The Miraculized's appearance and circles on their faces resemble the Guards from Squid Game, which they wear pink hoods and featureless black masks with a triangle, square, and circle on it to conceal their identities.
References
When Marinette wakes up from her nightmare, Tikki is catapulted to the end of Marinette's bed, similar to "Sentibubbler".
This is the fourth time where there is no Lucky Charm following "Catalyst", "Risk", and "Representation".

title: Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1) - Trivia
This is the ninth time when the Miraculous Ladybug superpower wasn't used following "Ladybug and Cat Noir", "Catalyst", "Destruction", "Illusion", "Intuition", "Emotion", "Revolution", and "Representation".
This is the twenty-first time where Adrien is a minor character in the permanent timeline following "Style Queen", "Silencer", "Cat Blanc", "Truth", "Gang of Secrets", "Mr. Pigeon 72", "Furious Fu", "Sole Crusher", "Guiltrip", "Crocoduel", "Optigami", "Sentibubbler", "Qilin", "Dearest Family", "Ephemeral", "Penalteam", "Destruction", "Intuition", "Adoration" and "Pretension".
If webisodes were to be counted, this would be the forty-fifth.
It is also the first two parter where Adrien is a minor character in the permanent timeline.
This is the eighth time Sublimation is used, following "Penalteam", "Strikeback", "Miraculous Paris", "Illusion", "Deflagration", "Pretension" and "Revolution".
This is the third time an akumatized villain was akumatized twice in a row, following Stoneheart and Qilin.
Unlike Stoneheart and Qilin, Nightormentor wasn't the main villain of the episode; the Miraculized are.
This is also the only time a character's later akumatized form re-appears.

title: Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1) - Trivia
Nightormentor, however, is a variant of The Collector.
This episode marks the fifth time Adrien does not transform into Cat Noir, following "Style Queen", "Mr. Pigeon 72", "Transmission" and "Emotion".
Ivan being the first to be Miraculized can be seen as a throwback to "Stoneheart", as he chronologically became the first akumatized villain created by Gabriel and the first villain Ladybug and Cat Noir had to face.
Adrien surrendering his Miraculous to Plagg so he can help Ladybug, was actually a good call not only because of the state of both his and his father's minds but the situation too as he was right as it would not only jeopardize his identity but make things worse and with him akumatized or controlled like a sentimonster. Gabriel wouldn't hesitate to use him in his plot of desperation and revenge like he did in "Cat Blanc" and "Ephemeral".
When Marinette attempted to transform, she was warned by Tikki that using her powers for personal reasons doesn’t always works out for her, referencing most of the episodes such as "The Bubbler", "Volpina", "Santa Claws", "Cat Blanc" and "Risk".
Similar to "Emotion", Gabriel blamed someone else for something that wasn't their fault.

title: Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1) - Trivia
In Marinette's dream, she was trying to rescue Adrien who was imprisoned in a house of thorns which is parallel to what Cat Noir was trying to do in "Weredad".
This is the second episode where Marinette/Ladybug and Adrien/Cat Noir don't share any interaction with each other in any way (physical or talking), following "Representation". However, they interact during her dream.
Similar to "Elation", both Adrien and Marinette's sense of shock, dread and anger were both at the same person Gabriel and themselves.
They were both mad at Gabriel for his actions: Adrien for his father taking him away from everyone he cared about and Marinette for all his actions as Hawk Moth, Shadow Moth and Monarch.
They were both mad at themselves for not acting sooner: Adrien not only let his father control his life but similar to Chloé and Lila, he gave his father too many chances to change and by the time he realized that it was too late. Marinette suspected that Gabriel was Hawk Moth back in "The Collector", but was easily fooled by his tricks and in "Illusion", things probably would've been different.

title: Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1) - Trivia
This is the third time Ladybug has unified her Miraculous with one or more Miraculouses in a season finale following "Miracle Queen" and "Strikeback".
However, unlike the first two times, Ladybug unifies the Ladybug Miraculous with the Cat in her civilian form instead of as Ladybug and she unifies the Miraculouses in the first part instead of the second part.
The Qigong master Sabine watched in "Qilin" can be seen again on the TV.
In his room, Adrien has the same photo of him and Marinette which he saw during the fight with Nightormentor in the previous episode.
The photo of Fu and Marianne, which is the lock screen background of the former's tablet, is reused from the end card of "Furious Fu".
Alongside the premiere on TFOU, TF1 released a writers' commentary of the two parter, revealing new information:
The photo of Adrien and Kagami arriving was created using the digitized models while they were kept in London.
Gabriel and Tomoe had been planning the Perfect Alliance plan since "Animaestro" and putting it in place since "Multiplication". They tested the first part of the plan when Gabriel akumatized himself in the previous episode.

title: Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1) - Trivia
Marinette didn't fully understand that Gabriel is Monarch in "Representation", but she was suspicious.
The plan and the app are an allegory of people being addicted to their phones and those in power spreading "poisons" and monetizing "antidotes", and causing mental illnesses to make people addicted.
Even though Adrien didn't live through and isn't aware of the events of "Cat Blanc", it still influenced his decision to remove his miraculous.
They had planned since 2014/2015 for Cat Noir not to be there during the final fight against Gabriel, as they wanted Marinette to unify the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses.
Ivan couldn't resist putting on the Alliance ring because he has "things stressing him out", about which fans will find out in later seasons.
This is revealed in the Season 6 episode "El Toro De Piedra".
Errors
The Statue of Liberty is shown with the French and American flag banners from "Miraculous New York", although it is most likely not French-American Friendship Day anymore.
Due to Earth's rotation, it should've been day in North America and night in South America, and not the other way around.
Gisèle's eyes are miscolored gray instead of purple.

title: Collusion
text:
Collusion - Intro
"" is a season 5 episode of the series Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 22nd written and produced episode of season 5. It is also the 126th written and produced episode of the series overall.

title: Collusion
text:
Collusion - Synopsis
The end of the school year is approaching, and the revolution is rising. Monarch decides to set up a dangerous plan for his secret identity... but also for Ladybug and Cat Noir. Without knowing it, the villain will get help from Lila, who is controlling a meaner ever Chloé behind the scenes. As for Marinette, she doesn't know that Adrien does not dare to tell her a dreadful secret that could jeopardize their relationship forever.
Disney+
Ladybug and Cat Noir face a revolutionary enemy.
Netflix
In her new disguise, Lila manipulates Chloé to help her rule the school. Can Ladybug and Cat Noir stop her before she triggers an all-out revolution?

title: Collusion
text:
Collusion - Plot
The episode opens with Gabriel at the Crypt talking to Émilie that he will get the Miraculous of Ladybug and Cat Noir and that he has not much time left before the cataclysm turns him into dust. Meanwhile Nathalie watches Émilie's video on how Gabriel should stop obsessing over the Miraculous and bringing her back while he watches from behind. Marinette and Adrien speak to each other. While getting ready for school, Adrien gets pancakes from Gabriel, who asked him if he told his girlfriend about his departure for London, Nathalie retorts that being his vision of happiness and not Adrien's. Gabriel states that he is Adrien's father and he knows what's best for him, Adrien, resisting the ring's control on him, said that he should have listened to Marinette's advice he tells Nathalie goodbye and told the Gorilla that he will be walking to school to take his mind off of things.

title: Collusion
text:
Collusion - Plot
Marinette and Adrien meet at Collège Dupont as they're about to kiss, they giggle for a bit. Rose who is a bit angry about them waiting for the big moment forces the duo to kiss, but Marinette and Adrien decided when it will be a good time for them to kiss. Inside Ms. Bustier's classroom, Sabrina walks to Chloé without speaking a single word and angrily scoffs at her as she decides to sit next to Nathaniel, who accepts her as his new seatmate. Chloé is upset that her former ex-"BFF" and underling is no longer friends with her. She sees Marinette and Adrien and makes fun of them by comparing them as "How to go from magazine paper to toilet paper". Unfazed by this remark, Marinette tells her rival that she can still be mean while she still can and decided to let her in on a secret. She points out that her old friend Lila is no longer at College Dupoint due to her lies after Marinette stopped her, and Marinette threatens Chloé by saying that she'll do the same thing with her. The bully states that she would love to see that.

title: Collusion
text:
Collusion - Plot
Cerise, who is in her hideout at the Catacombs, communicates with her via an earpiece to let Marinette think she is the best and they're not done with her yet, as the screen pans to reveal her board full of pictures of Parisians, such as Mr.
Damoclès, Miss Bustier, and Marinette.
While Ms.
Bustier was teaching about the aristocrats, Chloé decides to play loud music.
Ms.
Bustier threatens her to send her to the principal's office if she doesn't turn down the music, but Chloé refuses, causing her to tell the new principal, Olga, about this, sending Caline to the principal's office and Mayor André allows this.
Caline leaves to the office.
Marinette scolds Chloé for causing unnecessary stress for their pregnant teacher while Mylène tell her they won't let her treat Caline like that, but Chloé smugly mocks the latter.
Ivan is mad that Chloé made fun of Mylene.
Marinette tries to help but as Caline comes back, Chloé pretends to be slapped by the former.
The other students come to Marinette's defense, but it is futile when Chloé calls Olga to order Caline and Marinette to go to the principal's office anyway.

title: Collusion
text:
Collusion - Plot
Tom and Sabine are called over and try to help their daughter not get expelled before the end of the school year, but Chloé shows "proof" of what happened.
Ms.
Bustier then tries to reason with Chloé by showing her the birthday gift Chloé gave her in "Zombizou".
When Chloé's plan to expel Marinette doesn't work, Chloé believes Ms.
Bustier is blackmailing students and manipulating them, so Chloé asked Olga for her immediate dismissal.
This shocks everyone in the office.
Caline pleads to Olga that she can't do it to her old friend, but sadly has no choice but to obey Mayor Bourgeois' orders.
Cerise removes the pictures of Marinette and Caline on her board as she smiles evilly.

title: Collusion
text:
Collusion - Plot
A heartbroken Caline sadly packs up her things, struggling not to cry. Meanwhile, Monarch, in his lair, senses sadness from the former teacher and sends a Megakuma after using Kaalki. The Megakuma lands in her cardboard box full of her belongings. She says no thank you and breaks free from control. The Resistance and Sabrina sadly stands at the school gate to say goodbye to their former teacher. Gisèle, Caline's girlfriend, decides to speak to Olga, but Bustier pleads not to do that. Despite being sad, she's sure they'll find a solution, as she and her former class promise to be there for each other. Annoyed, Chloé watches from behind and contacts André about sending Caline to prison or exiling her from Paris, but André has an important meeting with Gabriel and Tomoe Tsurugi. Cerise, standing nearby, tells Chloé that she should speak to her father at the palace and remind him that "No one disobeys Chloé Bourgeois". Cerise puts on green contacts lenses and puts on a dark wig with bun, disguising herself as a maid/waitress without being recognized.

title: Collusion
text:
Collusion - Plot
Meanwhile at the Palace, Gabriel, Tomoe and André are having a talk about police robots to replace the Paris police. Chloé then comes barging into the place, still mad about André not obeying her orders. Cerise (disguised as a maid) tells Chloé to turn on her camera. Chloé then continues to tell her father to continue to do whatever she wants and everyone has to continue whatever Chloé wants, that Ms. Bustier must go to prison and her classmates must not go to any high school i.e. meaning to repeat a year like what happened to Juleka. But André says that this is taking things a bit to far Chloé retorts that her mom Audrey is right and he has no authority, and that if it weren't for Ladybug and Cat Noir, Paris would be run by supervillains. André states that Ladybug and Cat Noir are wonderful, and asks if Adrien would not go to high school, but Gabriel states that the question is irrelevant because next year Adrien would be going to London, which surprises Chloé. André tells his daughter that he has to finish lunch first.

title: Collusion
text:
Collusion - Plot
Meanwhile at the houseboat, Mylène is upset that Mr. Damoclès has been fired and now Marinette expelled and Ms. Bustier fired because of Chloé and the Resistance aka Team Miraculous can't let it happen. Alya knows it's never too late for justice. Rose still hopes the end of the school year dance/prom happens and won't be cancelled by Chloé's plans Marinette knows that no one can stop Adrien and Marinette from loving each other. Everyone smiles with a happily while Adrien is worried. Meanwhile Back at the palace Gabriel and André have a heartfelt talk about their younger days, and the police robot idea, André has some regret that Audrey barely respects her husband and Chloé is a selfish and heartless daughter. The reason André got into politics was to impress Audrey, and Gabriel knows that he secretly records his words and maid Cerise is seen spying on the two of them. André has lied, cheated and abused his power on people. André wants to get back into doing what he loves directing and making movies, after a conversation Gabriel stops recording and André tells Tomoe not to use the police robots and City Hall is not for sale.

title: Collusion
text:
Collusion - Plot
Back at his mansion, Gabriel re-edits the video and sends it to make it seem André is a tyrant. At the café, Ms. Bustier and Gisèle are having lunch until she receives a video from an anonymous source about Gabriel's video about André. Gabriel transforms back into Monarch, sends the Megakuma back to Ms. Bustier and akumatizes her into Miss Sans-Culotte and grants her the power of Jubilation who turns people into singing balloons. Gisèle tries to stop her girlfriend, but to no avail.

title: Collusion
text:
Collusion - Plot
Gabriel speaks to Tomoe that their plan is working. Miss Sans-Culotte turns Mr. Banana into a singing balloon and shows everyone in Paris about André's actions live on television. Marinette tells Adrien that the Resistance won't give up. They suddenly get a Megakuma alert, Marinette and Adrien speak to Tikki & Plagg about what's going on and they transform into Ladybug and Cat Noir to find the villain. Back at the Resistance HQ, Zoé sees the video of her stepfather and decides to go to City Hall to convince the people that he is innocent. Back at the Hotel Palace, Chloé is shocked to see that her father has not been akumatized, until she receives a call from Gabriel about a special gift, but she told him he could have offered Adrien but now that he and Marinette are a couple she doesn't want him anymore due to what happened in "Derision". But Gabriel tells about another gift, of power that she can control, Chloé refuses at first but Cerise reminds her that her father might not be Mayor for much longer, and asks her about how she would answer to all the people she hurt. Chloé asks Gabriel what this "gift" is.

title: Collusion
text:
Collusion - Plot
Back at City Hall, Officer Roger Raincomprix and the French police force are standing guard from Miss Sans-Culotte and she turns the rest of the police officers into singing balloons Ladybug and Cat Noir appear on the scene who witness Sans-Culotte turning everyone of Roger's Police force into a balloon and the French revolution, The dynamic duo spring into action and fight the akumatized villain, Ladybug summoned a Lucky Charm which is a paper crown. Cat Noir asks Ladybug too see if the villain can give free reign. Ladybug knows that the Lucky Charm means.

title: Collusion
text:
Collusion - Plot
The singing balloons attack the superhero duo as Miss Sans-Culotte decides to go to City Hall to find Mayor Bourgeois, but Zoé comes in and says that her stepfather has made mistakes but is not a bad guy. Miss Sans-Culotte says the only thing that works is a revolution. Just as when Zoé is about to turn into a balloon, Ladybug and Cat Noir manage to save her in the nick of time. André sees his edited video, turns the TV off and tries to contact Gabriel but went straight to voicemail. André tells his old colleague that he and Gabriel are no longer friends, but it did however gave him the right decision. Miss Sans-Culotte, Ladybug, Cat Noir and Zoé came into the Mayor's office and the villain tells the mayor that he cheated, lied and used collusion and demanded him to step down as Mayor once and for all.

title: Collusion
text:
Collusion - Plot
André decides by the powers vested in him to step down as Mayor and leaves with Zoé, Miss Sans-Culotte breaks free from her akumatization and turns back into Ms. Bustier who reunites with Gisèle and leaves as Ladybug and Cat Noir does their pound it, and the heroine notices the Lucky Charm always knows to pick the right villain. Cat Noir tells her to repair everything with it, she fixes everything with a Miraculous Ladybug to turn everything back to normal.
Just then, Chloé with police robots shows up with Clara Contard. Ladybug notices the Lucky Charm was meant for Chloé, not André or Miss Sans-Culotte, Chloé then states that duo has used their powers against democracy and declares them as villains. The heroes try to fight back against the robots but flee due after being overpowered, leaving Chloé smiling over her new plan. In the post-end card scene, Tom, Sabine, Marlena, Otis, Nora, Ella and Etta watch the news of Chloé becoming mayor of Paris on TV as she states that power must return to the people and declares all Miraculous holders, mainly Monarch, Ladybug and Cat Noir are outlawed as the episode ends with a cliffhanger.

title: Collusion
text:
Collusion - Plot Development
Following Mr. Damoclès' resignation in "Confrontation", Ms. Mendeleiev is the school principal and is pressured by Mayor Bourgeois to obey every command of Chloé, like allowing her to listen loud music during classes.
In the aforementioned episode, Ms. Mendeleiev once stated things would be different if she was principal and ironically, she takes the position after Mr. Damoclès resigned.
Using Mendeleiev's role as principal and pretending to have been slapped by Marinette, Chloé forces the former to expel Marinette and fire Miss Bustier.
Despite the episode showing an argument about expelling Marinette, it is not confirmed if she got really expelled, as Chloé turned her attention to Miss Bustier when the latter tried to reason with her one more time.
This is the third and last time Marinette almost gets expelled from school, following "Ladybug" and "Adoration".
Chloé and Lila are both responsible for two of those times, while Lila is solely responsible for the former.
Marinette telling Chloé that she'll put a stop to her nastiness foreshadows her end in "Revolution".

title: Collusion
text:
Collusion - Plot Development
After ending her friendship with Chloé definitively in "Confrontation", Sabrina sits next to Nathaniel's seat until the school year is over.
This is the twenty-ninth time where Ladybug's Lucky Charm is an object that appeared in a previous episode. This time, it is the paper crown from "Dearest Family". Unlike the first one, in which it served as a reminder, it also served as a warning as André gave up his position of power and Chloé immediately seized it.
With this in mind, it could be that a new ability of the Lucky Charm was revealed as it appears that depending on the situation that the object can be used to solve more than one problem or warn the holder of one problem being more dangerous than the other.
Since this episode comes after "Confrontation", Tikki knew or was aware of Chloé's rise in hatred and desire for revenge, knowing she would strike back in retaliation, similarly to Félix in "Emotion".
Chronologically, this is the last Season 5 episode where the Miraculous Ladybug superpower is used.
Cat Noir mentions it is almost Bastille Day, a national day of France that is celebrated on July 14. Given that the school year is almost over, this episode takes place in July.

title: Collusion
text:
Collusion - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in Switzerland on RTS Un alongside the previous episode, "Confrontation".
This is the fifth season 5 episode that is not named after the concept of a Miraculous.
Through the concept of collusion, there are characters conspiring to do something:
Cerise and Chloé conspire to punish those who have stood against them at school: Marinette and Miss Bustier. After putting Ms. Mendeleiev as principal (who is completely complacent to Mayor Bourgeois, who is in turn complacent to Audrey), they create a situation that results in Marinette being expelled and Miss Bustier getting fired.
Cerise also conspired for her own gain behind Chloé's back, manipulating her into throwing a tantrum at her father when he was in a meeting with Gabriel and Tomoe to give the former the idea of manipulating Chloé to take her father's role as mayor.

title: Collusion
text:
Collusion - Trivia
Gabriel and Tomoe conspired to have Mayor Bourgeois replace the police force with security robots in order to replace Ladybug and Cat Noir's roles as peacekeepers of Paris. With the mayor's refusal, Gabriel manipulates Chloé into allying herself with him to take the role as mayor of Paris, after he causes a situation that forces André to resign as mayor that involves akumatizing Miss Bustier. With Chloé as mayor, all Miraculous holders are outlawed and the security robots replace the police force.
This episode also shows how collusion was used in terms of people's lives:
André mentions that he and Gabriel were both happier in their earlier lives and wonders what went wrong, as André traded his life as a movie producer for politics and had nothing to show for power and wisdom; he had everything but he didn't have emotional wisdom.
How Chloé continuously raved on how things wouldn't have happened if she stayed as Queen Bee but didn't gain the emotional wisdom or maturity to see the real outcome if she stayed, and how she deceived the public into believing Ladybug and Cat Noir were the bad guys.

title: Collusion
text:
Collusion - Trivia
Lila wanted to live or made her choice to live a life of lies while Ladybug and Cat Noir were forced into it.
How Nino tricked himself into believing Alya and Cat Noir were together in "Rocketear".
From "Representation", that Adrien was mad at himself for how hopelessly he fooled himself into believing that his father was grieving over his mother, and by the time he realized Gabriel was doing something more, it was too late.
It is revealed that Lila has La Plage as her secret hideout located at the Paris catacombs.
It is revealed that Ms. Mendeleiev's first name is Olga.
Adrien and Marinette are at the front of the school references the theme song It's Ladybug.
It is revealed that Miss Bustier is in a relationship with a woman named Gisèle.
This marks the fifth appearance of an LGBTQ+ romance in the show, after Barbara Keynes and Olympia Hill, Zoé and Marinette, Nathaniel and Marc, and Rose and Juleka.
They also share the first same-sex kiss in the series.
It is revealed that André's father was also in politics.
This is the first time a character doesn't appear after they're de-akumatized since Season 1.

title: Collusion
text:
Collusion - Trivia
This, however, happened in eight episodes of Season 1 ("Stormy Weather", "The Evillustrator", "Dark Cupid", "Mr. Pigeon", "Pixelator", "Simon Says", "Darkblade", "The Pharaoh", and "Horrificator").
It is revealed that Alliance rings can transmit recordings and footage even when the person is akumatized and with the powers of the transmitted Miraculous.
This is also the first time someone who shows signs of pregnancy becomes akumatized, but it's unknown if it causes any ill effects with someone under those conditions.
This is the second time Adrien and Marinette's Lucky charms appear together in the same episode, following "Befana".
Ironically, André lamenting to Gabriel about how he abused his power as mayor to please his wife and daughter, and suggesting they should give up their privileges so they can be happy with how things they were before contrasts with Gabriel's intention to obtain the Miraculous, as he is throwing everything away to bring his wife back, and is using his power and privileges to hide his identity and control everything he wanted his way.

title: Collusion
text:
Collusion - Trivia
At the end, André resigned his position and divorced from his wife making himself happy to be free and have custody of Zoé, while Gabriel, even if he wanted to stop being Monarch, especially with his Cataclysm wound, chose to keep pursuing the Miraculous while he is pushing everyone away.
How much and how little they both believed in change, André did so a lot believing if he gave his power up for the sake going back there was a brighter future but Gabriel believed so little was because he thought nothing was going to be there for him either going backwards or forwards without power except pain, misery and suffering which ironically, he and everyone else was already there.
André ending his friendship with Gabriel mirrors Adrien officially ending his friendship with Chloé in "Derision". In regards to this, Adrien broke it off when Chloé refuses to change herself to become better and stayed abusive, André broke it off when seeing Gabriel changed for the worst, especially when the latter uploaded an edited video making the former look like he was abusing his status as mayor.

text:
Confrontation - Intro
"" is a season 5 episode of the series Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. Based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 21st written and produced episode of season 5. It is also the 125th written and produced episode of the series overall.

title: Confrontation
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Confrontation - Synopsis
The end of middle school is approaching and Lila and Chloé must defend the future of their classmates in front of the class council. Marinette is worried: what will be the next evil plan of the two brats?
Disney+
Ladybug and Cat Noir face Reflekta again.
Netflix
Lila's scheme hit a new low when she hatches a plan that could ruin every student's future. But in a dark moment, help comes from an unexpected hero.

title: Confrontation
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Confrontation - Plot
The episode opens in Adrien's room, where Adrien laments his concerns to Plagg about telling Marinette that he is moving to London. Adrien worries that if he'll fill up his papers about him being in London, it'll break Marinette's heart.
At Collège Françoise Dupont, Marinette and Adrien worry and wonder what's going to happen next as Lila and Chloé are the new class representatives. Subsequently, their respective Kwamis, Plagg and Tikki attempt to comfort them, though Plagg comforts Adrien with little success, Tikki was able to cheer up Marinette by saying that she's the best. In Mrs. Bustier's class, Mrs. Bustier thanks Marinette, who gives the students' files to Chloé and Lila, for being entrusting towards the students' futures. In Chloé's room, Chloé and Lila force the clearly distressed Sabrina to reforge the students' files to ruin Marinette and everyone's lives, much to her dismay as she finally decided that enough is enough.

title: Confrontation
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Confrontation - Plot
Meanwhile, Denis Damoclès finds the Resistance in the boiler room, and upon learning that they are fighting against evil, he loyally decides to let them continue on their operations, due to his apparent fondness for superheroes. Olga Mendeleiev finds out and laments that she's not the principal to make the strictest rules. In the library, where the conference room of teachers has been held, Lila shocks the teachers about the students' files (which were reforged). To make matters worse, Lila even shows Juleka will be repeating the year.
In the classroom, the students are mad about their false futures. Juleka sees that she will be repeating and gets upset, leading to her getting akumatized by Monarch and becoming Reflekta once again as Monarch breaks through her Magical Charm; he also gives her the power of the Tiger Miraculous, Clout, which she and her clones can use to their advantage. Marinette and Adrien transform into Ladybug and Cat Noir respectively, and defeat Reflekta, transforming her back into Juleka. However, Monarch still senses negative emotions within the school, and opts to wait for another akumatization attempt.

title: Confrontation
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Confrontation - Plot
Back in class, Alya asks Lila what happened with the files and she and Chloé start accusing Marinette of tampering with the files by forging everyone's handwriting. Marinette points out that she doesn't even know how to copy people's handwriting, but Sabrina does. Sabrina comes clean and says that she forged the forms and reveals that Chloé and Lila forced her to do it. Playing off her outburst, Lila continues to lie to Sabrina, causing Sabrina run out of the classroom and into the new bathroom pretending to distress at first, while threatening to have her father put Chloé and Lila in jail. Chloé and Lila argue with Sabrina in the bathroom, with Lila also threatening to put her in jail by her own father, while also revealing her deceptive nature.

title: Confrontation
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Confrontation - Plot
It is revealed that Sabrina and Marinette set up a fake mirror in the new bathroom, with everyone, including Ms. Bustier and Denis Damoclès, hearing what Lila said, finally realizing that Marinette was right all along about Lila's true nature. Chloé gets her father André Bourgeois (who is being forced by Audrey) to make Denis let her and Lila stay in school and refuse to allow the career forms to be resubmitted. Denis gets frustrated and almost gets akumatized by Monarch again, but the students' reaction to the Magical Charm prevent him from being akumatized. When Juleka comes in and begs for Denis to resist the Megakuma, he is amazed that Juleka no longer has her speech impediment and lets it go, allowing him to unlock a new ability of the charm that purifies the Megakuma. Monarch gets angry that he is defeated yet again. Denis makes his final decision to allow the students to redo their career forms.

title: Confrontation
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Confrontation - Plot
However, because of this, Denis is fired from his job as principal by André. He packs all of his stuff up into a box and before he leaves, all of the students and teachers applaud him for doing the right thing. Later, Ms. Bustier tells Chloé that she really thought that she can change if people reached out to her, but says that she was wrong about her. She also admits that while she can't expel her, she will get very special attention from her as punishment, much to Chloé's dismay. Chloé receives a call from Lila, who left the school in all the confusion. Lila tells her to be prepared and that the war had just started, while also being revealed to have another identity as Cerise Bianca, a movie star.

title: Confrontation
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Confrontation - Plot Developments
In this episode, new hidden Magical Charm abilities are introduced. It's revealed that the Magical Charms react to emotions and that it can protect their holders from Megakumas if they focus enough or/and are motivated by others. It's also seen that the presence of other Magical Charms can also boost the magic of the Magical Charm of the person that is about to be akumatized.
In this case, it occurred with the Magical Charm Denis Damoclès received in "Jubilation", as it evolved into a larger version of itself, basically becoming a shield, capable of purifying Megakumas.
Another weakness of Clout is revealed: in the unique circumstances that the power is duplicated, then it can be turned against itself, resulting in massive super-explosion when the punches collide, thus incapacitating the users.
This is the episode where Lila decides to dismantle Adrien's relationship with Marinette.
Denis Damoclès becomes fully aware of the students forming a resistance and having their headquarters at the boiling room, and covers for them from teachers who are very strict like Olga Mendeleiev.

title: Confrontation
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Confrontation - Plot Developments
Nino suggests that the Resistance members all apply to enroll at Lycée Jacques de Trémeuse, which like Collège Françoise Dupont, is the name of a French superhero known as Judex.
This episode confirms that Sabrina has finally ended her "friendship" with Chloé for good, as she had betrayed her and Lila by exposing them in front of the whole class.
This is parallel to what Adrien did in "Derision", where he calls off his friendship with Chloé. In a way, both of them were friends with Chloé, but knew of her awful behavior and yet they couldn't do anything to stand up to against her. Adrien gave her multiple chances to become a better person, but after hearing what she did to Marinette last year, he stood against her and ends their friendship, to whereas Sabrina is very loyal and would do anything for Chloé but after being forced to forge the students' study options and pin the blame on Marinette was the tipping point to have Sabrina secretly conspire with Marinette to expose Chloé and Lila's schemes.

title: Confrontation
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Confrontation - Plot Developments
This could also be a callback to the episode where Adrien confronts Chloé after she remarks about treating those who are inferior to them, Sabrina was seen with an angry scowl, indicating her loyalty towards Chloé started to waver since she treats her as a doormat too.
This episode reveals that Lila has been wearing a wig since "Volpina", and even has two identities: one being Lila Rossi, and the other being Cerise Bianca, who is the class representative of her class in another school and a movie star. It is also revealed that she has multiple mothers and that for each mother, she has one different identity. Since she has three different mothers, means that she has at least three different identities:
Lila Rossi: She is the daughter of an Italian ambassador who, up until this episode, studied at the Collège Françoise Dupont and used to be a model to the Gabriel brand.
Cerise Bianca: According to her classmates, she is an actress that has been away from Paris in a movie shoot for most of the school year and is the class representative in a different school.

title: Confrontation
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Confrontation - Plot Developments
Despite it not being confirmed who is the mother of this identity, it's hinted that one is the mother she talked to through the Alliance in "Revelation", as they talked through voice only possibly to hide the wig she is using and the fact she told her she was away from Paris, just like Cerise told to her classmates.
There's a third possible identity, whose mother is deaf and whose house served as Lila's habitation for a time at least between "Perfection" and "Revelation", before telling her she would need to leave again.
This episode reveals Ms. Bustier's class dream jobs:
Alya wants to be a reporter.
Nino wants to be a movie director.
Mylène wants to be an environmental activist while Ivan would take care of his and Mylène's kids.
Juleka wants to be a mortician, or someone who prepares funerals.
Rose wants to be a hairstylist, even though she says at first that she wants to be one for unicorns and dragons.
Sabrina wants to be a nurse.
Chloé doesn't want to do anything because she's already rich.
Lila claims she wants to become a politician and spread peace, but this is a lie.

title: Confrontation
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Confrontation - Plot Developments
Besides Lila and Chloé, the only students whose dream jobs weren't revealed are Max, Nathaniel and Kim; although it is implied that Kim wants to be a swim instructor when he thinks Max got his form by mistake, as Max wants to be a physiotherapist, who helps people to restore injuries, disabilities, or movement, being said that Kim and Max's form papers are mixed, and Nathaniel probably wants to be a famous illustrator.
Everyone in school finally learns that Lila was lying about everything, from saying she was halfway around the world so she wouldn't go to school, framing Marinette for pushing her down the stairs, and everything else ever since she came to school (and if she was above anything, she could convince Sabrina's father to throw her in jail). After learning Lila's deceptive nature, Ms. Bustier apologizes to Marinette for not believing her.
It is revealed that Juleka repeated a year of school. This explains why she is not in the same school year and school as Luka, even though they are supposed to be twins (however, this was a retcon from earlier episodes where it's implied that Luka was older).

title: Confrontation
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Confrontation - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in Switzerland on RTS Un alongside the next episode, "Collusion".
This is the fourth season 5 episode that is not named after the concept of a Miraculous.
The concept of confrontation is applied several times during this episode:
Sabrina is finally able to stand up against Chloé and Lila for all the abuse she has suffered at their hands by aiding Marinette in exposing them in front of all their classmates and teachers.
After Sabrina reveals to have proof against them regarding the fake study options forms, Chloé and Lila confront her about it, with the former doing it angrily and demanding to have the proof she has, while the latter just responds that, whatever proof Sabrina may have, she will always counter it with another lie to discredit it.
Marinette and her friends confront Chloé and Lila over their behavior, as well as their confrontation of the fact that they have been lied to and manipulated for a long time.
Juleka is finally able to overcome her speech impediment and gather the courage to finally speak louder after her friends tried to help confront her akumatization.

title: Confrontation
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Confrontation - Trivia
Denis Damoclès is initially unable to confront Mayor Bourgeois about wanting to change the students' fake forms (that have already been passed into the system), being the reason for his almost being akumatized. With the motivation of his students (especially Juleka), Miss Bustier and Cat Noir, Denis Damoclès is able to drive away a Megakuma (and by doing so unlocking the Magical Charm's hidden power). Because of it, he is finally able to stand up against Mayor Bourgeois, even if that meant losing his job, for the sake of his students' dreams.
Mayor Bourgeois is pressured by his wife Audrey into not allowing Denis Damoclès to expel Chloé and Lila and to change the fake forms. Because he doesn't have the courage to stand up against her, he has no other choice but to force the principal into doing it. When he doesn't, Mayor Bourgeois has no other choice but to fire him.
Adrien didn't have the courage to tell Marinette that he was moving to London by the school year's end.

title: Confrontation
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Confrontation - Trivia
As of this episode, Juleka is the only character that has been regularly akumatized, amokized and akumatized, akumatized in a group of akumatized villains, akumatized in her scarlet version, and akumatized with a superhero power.
This is also the second time Reflekta's clones have her copy power instead of just Reflekta herself, following "Guiltrip". But unlike the first time, her clones were controlled by the titular sentimonster, and this time, it is Reflekta herself who has the ability to control them.
Juleka is also the second member of the French Miraculous superhero team to receive a second Magical Charm, after Kagami in "Protection".
This episode has one of the shortest akuma fights of any episode.
There were a couple of scenes in the storyboard version that were cut when this episode finally aired.
Marinette and Adrien had short conversations with their kwamis before transforming to fight Reflekta and her clones.

title: Confrontation
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Confrontation - Trivia
After Miss. Bustier apologizes to Marinette, Alya hugs the latter and asks how she could be so gullible as an apology with every other classmate (minus Lila and Chloé) getting in for a group hug with the two. Adrien even says "You're really amazing, Marinette" and she blushes.
In production and airing order, "Collusion" comes after this episode. However, in chronological order, "Action" takes place after this episode.
References
When Juleka completely overcomes her "speech impediment", she did it in front of Denis Damoclès, Miss Bustier, and the whole class, minus Chloé and Lila, much like she did back in "Crocoduel".
As this episode is the twenty-first produced episode of season 5, this is a direct parallel to the twenty-first episode of season 4, "Dearest Family", as Gabriel discovered a way to destroy the Magicial Charms via creating megakumas.
Coincidentally, this episode is the twenty-first episode of Season 5 where she gets akumatized, much like how "Reflekta", was the twenty-first produced episode of Season 1 where she was akumatized there.
Clout's activation sequence used by Reflekta is similar to Purple Tigress' in "Crocoduel".

title: Confrontation
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Confrontation - Trivia
Clout's sound effect was reused from Wind Dragon's sound effect.
Errors
When Monarch looks at his Cataclysmed hand after being defeated, his Alliance rings, which were supposed to be under the glove, are all absent.
When Marinette and the others confront Chloé and Lila in the bathroom, the lighting for all the characters is off.
When Marinette and Sabrina fist-bump, Mylène is in the default T-pose.
When Monarch absorbs the power of Elation from Roaar's cage, he uses his right hand, but the Tiger Miraculous is on his left hand.
When Ladybug is sticking the tape to the ground, she isn’t wearing her Magical Charm suit.
Also, when she is about to release the purified butterfly from her yo-yo, her pigtails brielfy glitch out.
In this episode, Juleka claims she wants to be a mortician, but in "Reflekdoll", it's shown that she wants to be a model.
However, it is possible that she has given up on her dream of being a model and has changed it to being a mortician.
In the French dub, she just mumbles "J'aimerais devenir..." (I want to be...) without finishing her sentence.
The hair tie on Lila's wig disappears and re-appears before she throws it in the trash.
