title: Confrontation/Transcript
text:
Confrontation/Transcript - Intro
[ Theme Song ]
Plagg: You look even more lost than pasteurized cheese in the French cheese section! How hard is it to fill out an orientation form? All you have to do is write down your request for next year's school and your career goals.
Adrien: I can't write down the truth, Plagg. If Marinette finds out that my father's decided to send me to a private school in London next year, it will break her heart and mine, too. (He places his head down on his table and frowns. Plagg slouches and frowns as well.) What? No cheesy joke to comfort me?
Plagg: I know how I would feel if I had to be separated from you, Adrien, and there is nothing funny about that at all. (sighs)
Kim: (to Max, while walking out the library) I can't wait for the results of the teacher rep meeting.
(The door closes.)
Marinette: I hope everything goes well.
Tikki: Marinette, I don't get it. What happens at a teacher rep meeting that's so worrisome?
Marinette: This meeting is where our futures are being decided, Tikki. The teachers need to review our school performances and decide whether or not we'll be able to pursue the studies we've chosen.
Tikki: If I were your teacher, I'd decide that you're the best!

title: Confrontation/Transcript
text:
Confrontation/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (smiles) Thank you, Tikki!
(The door opens behind them as Adrien walks beside Marinette. But before he places his form on top of the pile of forms, he notices Marinette frowning.)
Adrien: Is something wrong, Marinette?
Marinette: I'm having a really strange feeling about something. Up until now, Alya and I were the class reps. When our classmates gave us their career forms, they are also entrusting us with their hopes and dreams.
(Flashback: Each of Marinette's classmates tell her what their dream careers and dream schools would be in the future, starting with Alya at their home.)
Alya: Well, you know I want to be a reporter, so I'll need to specialize in literature in high school!
(Nino, at the school's courtyard...)
Nino: Movie director!
(Mylène and Ivan, at Liberty...)
Mylène: Just write "Defender of the Earth"!
Ivan: I'll be a stay-at-home dad! While Mylène saves the world, I'll be taking care of the kids.
(Rose, at the school's art classroom...)
Rose: (dreamily) Hairstylist for unicorns!
Marinette: (off-screen) There's no such thing, Rose.
Rose: Oh, okay... (strikes a pose) hairstylist for dragons!
(Juleka, at her room in Liberty...)

title: Confrontation/Transcript
text:
Confrontation/Transcript - Intro
Juleka: (mumbling) I want to be a mortician...
Marinette: Awesome! (takes her folder) That is so you!
(Sabrina, while feeding Chloé at the school's cafeteria...)
Marinette: (off-screen) A nurse?
Sabrina: (while holding a piece of sushi with her chopsticks) Well, yes! I love taking care of other people.
Chloé: (snaps her fingers) Sushi!
(Sabrina feeds Chloé a piece of sushi. Marinette frowns at this sight.)
(End of flashback.)
Adrien: Except that now, Chloé and Lila are the new class reps.
Marinette: Yes, and they'll be the ones presenting our friends' forms to the teachers during the teacher rep meeting. And they're just so...
(Flashback: Marinette asks Chloé about her plans in the future.)
Marinette: What about you, Chloé? What do you want to do in life?
Chloé: Nothing! I don't need to do anything since I'm already rich! (scatters all the content of her folder on the floor)
(Marinette asks Lila as well in the locker room.)

title: Confrontation/Transcript
text:
Confrontation/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (reads Lila's application aloud) To the question "What do you want to do in life?", you answered, "I want to resolve every political conflict on the planet in order to establish world peace and solve the environmental crisis. Also, free candy for everyone." Are you serious?
Lila: I could've added "I want to become your best friend", but we both know that would've been a lie, just like the rest. (walks away)
(End of flashback.)
Marinette: (looks away) I feel like I'm betraying our friends by entrusting their forms to such awful girls.
Adrien: If Chloé and Lila try to do something bad, we'll find a way to stop them. (places a hand on Marinette's shoulder) I trust us. (hugs Marinette) I trust you.
(Marinette hugs him back, frozen for a second, but then smiles.)
Marinette: Your file is the only one still missing.
Adrien: I'm... still not sure what I want to do yet.
Marinette: It's fine. (takes the pile of files and starts to walk out the library with Adrien) You still have a little time before the teacher rep meeting.
Ms. Bustier: Thank you for everything that you've done so far, Marinette.

title: Confrontation/Transcript
text:
Confrontation/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: You're welcome, Ms. Bustier. (gives a suspicious glare at Lila and Chloé) I... hope the meeting goes smoothly.
Ms. Bustier: And now, let's give our support to your new class representatives: (Marinette hands over the orientation sheets to Lila and Chloé) Lila and Chloé.
Lila: (places a hand over her heart) Chloé and I vow to respectfully represent you during the teacher rep meeting.
(The whole class applauds as Lila grabs the orientation sheets from Marinette, holding them close to her chest. The three of them shoot daggers at one another.)
Lila: Good! After you destroy the forms, you'll fill out new ones using your talent for forging students' handwriting. I'll tell you what to write.
Chloé: Oh, wait— Not so fast! You're using too many words to explain your plan!
Lila: We're going to make fake forms. And then, we'll defend those at the teacher rep meeting. Every student will then be signed up for a study course that doesn't fit them at all.
Chloé: But... they'll be furious when they realize.
Lila: Exactly. And we'll pin it all on Marinette!

title: Confrontation/Transcript
text:
Confrontation/Transcript - Intro
Chloé: Oh! Like Daddy does at city hall! He always says, (impersonates Mayor Bourgeois) "In case of a problem, always blame it on your predecessor!"
Lila: For it to work, Sabrina would just have to say, at the right time, that Marinette forced her to forge the fake forms, and everyone's life will be wonderfully ruined!
(Chloé smiles in amazement on Lila's conspiracy.)
Chloé: Villainous! Utterly villainous!
(Lila grins menacingly. Sabrina suddenly blows her whistle interrupting Lila and Chloé.)
Sabrina: (anxiously) I don't think I can do it! (blows her whistle again, her face getting redder with anxiety) Helping Chloé doesn't hurt anyone, but this... (blows her whistle) forging documents and lying... (blows her whistle) It's different! (blows her whistle and pants) It's going to hurt people! (pants and blows her whistle again)
Chloé: (grabs Sabrina's whistle) You want to see toot-toot whistle ever again?
Lila: (places more piles of the orientation sheets on Sabrina's desk) Then get to work! (closes the closet door as Sabrina frowns as she finally decided that enough is enough.)
Nino: On the agenda today, comrades, is a problem.

title: Confrontation/Transcript
text:
Confrontation/Transcript - Intro
(Outside the boiler room, Denis Damoclès eavesdrops on them.)
Nino: (off-screen, muffled) We swore to help Ladybug and Cat Noir in their fight.
Denis Damoclès: Huh? Intruders?
Nino: But if they haven't defeated Monarch by the start of the next school year, how will we help when we're no longer here at Francoise Dupont together?
(Denis Damoclès sneaks inside the boiler room to check the commotion.)
Nino: I propose the following solution: let's all go to the same Jacques de Trémeuse high school! Then, our fight against evil can continue!
Denis Damoclès: (to himself) Oh, sweet kids!
(While Nino lays down his plan, Marinette notices Denis Damoclès sneaking away out the boiler room and smiles fondly.)
Nino: And that'll settle Comrade Mayo's problem of not knowing where to go.
(As Marinette hears her phone ring, she discreetly walks out the meeting.)
Nino: (to Adrien, who smiles reassured) Wouldn't it, dude?
(Adrien smiles after Nino gives him a friendly nudge.)
Nathaniel: The design courses I want to take are available at the Performing Arts High School, so I won't be able to attend Jacques de Trémeuse.
(The whole gang sighs in dismay.)
Marinette: H-Hello?

title: Confrontation/Transcript
text:
Confrontation/Transcript - Intro
(Just a floor above, Mrs. Mendeleiev, alongside Denis Damoclès, are spying on the students.)
Mrs. Mendeleiev: See? Marinette just came out of the boiler room! And I saw the others go in earlier! Unacceptable!
Denis Damoclès: Uh... I asked them to go, actually, to make sure the cockroaches are gone. I hate cockroaches!
Mrs. Mendeleiev: Oh? (fixes her glasses) Well, if I were the principal, things would be different here! (goes down the stairs)
Alya: You okay, Marinette?
Marinette: Uh— Yes. (slips her phone inside her pocket) Yeah...
Mylène: It's really unfair that we're forced to decide what we want to do so early on in life!
Nino: That is so true! We should get to try a bunch of subjects before we decide on a career and get to stay with our buds and help each other at the same school.
Ivan: Our future is at stake here. We have to do something!
Mylène: I declare a form-filling strike. No student files, no career forms!
(The Resistance approves and cheers altogether.)
Juleka: (mumbling) Sorry, it's too late; we handed in our forms...
Rose: Juleka's right. Except for Adrien, we've all already handed in our career forms.
(The Resistance collectively sighs in dismay once again.)

title: Confrontation/Transcript
text:
Confrontation/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Did you manage to figure out what you want to do?
Adrien: I think so. (smiles)
(The two of them proceed inside the school grounds.)
Lila: I will defend your form as if my life depended on it. Thank you for entrusting me.
(Adrien scowls at her and walks away. Lila grins at Chloé as they go on with their plan, too, with Sabrina following them from behind. As the three of them proceed to the girl's restroom, the door is unfortunately taped with a sign of a toilet crying.)
Chloé: Ugh! When will they ever repair them? Lousy school!
(They enter inside of a somewhat portable toilet by the courtyard. Once inside, they read through Adrien's orientation form. Surprised, they notice a folded sheet of paper inside the folder as Lila reads it.)
Lila: "I've been thinking a lot, and still not know what I would like to do later in life. The only thing I know for sure is that I love Marinette Dupain-Cheng. But I guess that doesn't really help you. I'm sorry. Adrien Agreste."
Chloé: Ugh, it's pathetic! (takes the sheet of paper from Lila...) Utterly pathetic! (...and throws it in the toilet)

title: Confrontation/Transcript
text:
Confrontation/Transcript - Intro
Lila: Whatever you've already written down on Adrien's fake form, write it again... but worse! (hands over Sabrina another folder with fake forms for her to work on)
Lila: (grabs a folder) Alya Césaire, optician.
Ms. Bustier: (gapes in confusion) Are you sure there isn't a mistake? I thought for sure that Alya wanted to be a reporter.
Lila: That's what's written on the form Marinette gave us. It's true that it is strange, but, come to think of it, a reporter helps people to better understand the world — to clarify the things that seem fuzzy. Kind of the way an optician makes glasses.
Denis Damoclès: Oh, that's true! And Alya Césaire actually wears glasses!
Mrs. Mendeleiev: Her grades allow it. I see no reason for us to oppose it.
Denis Damoclès: Who are we to judge? Our duty is to support our students as best we can. Please enter the following in the career studies system, Mrs. Mendeleiev: Alya Césaire, optician.
(Mrs. Mendeleiev types in as ordered. Lila grabs another folder and reads it.)
Lila: Juleka Couffaine wants to repeat the year.
(The teachers gasp collectively.)
Denis Damoclès: That's unusual.

title: Confrontation/Transcript
text:
Confrontation/Transcript - Intro
Ms. Bustier: But she's already repeated a year! And her grades have gone better!
Lila: Yes, but perhaps until she's resolved her speech impediment, she'd rather stay on familiar ground. With your help, Ms. Bustier, of course. Sometimes, once step back is one step forward.
Ms. Mendeleiev: Her grades allow it. I see no reason for us to oppose it.
Denis Damoclès: (sighs deeply) Ms. Mendeleiev, please enter Juleka Couffaine, repeating the grade.
(Ms. Bustier lets out a suspicious frown.)
Alya: (furious) Optician?! That's not what I want to be at all!
Kim: Phy-si-o-therapist?!
Max: Swimming instructor?! But I can't even swim!
Kim: You sure you didn't get mine by mistake?
Rose: Minister of the Interior? Interior of what?!
(Juleka seems to be bothered of her results.)
Rose: (to Juleka) Are you alright? Jul...? (looks at her paper and gasps) "Repeating the year"?! That's completely bogus!
(A commotion ensues in the classroom.)
Ivan: Juleka has to repeat a grade?!
Alya: Repeating? No way!
(The class continues their clamor about Juleka repeating another year, but Juleka seems to be very done with it. Until...)

title: Confrontation/Transcript
text:
Confrontation/Transcript - Intro
Monarch: Ahh, teacher rep meetings... Endless sources of anguish and crushed hopes! There's too many to choose from! (corrupts a butterfly and turns it into a Megakuma) Kaalki, your power is now mine! (absorbs Kaalki's power of Migration) Voyage, my Megakuma! A feast of broken dreams awaits you!
Rose: Jul, you have to resist; otherwise, you might get akumatized! Remember what Ladybug said when she gave you this Magical Charm? We'll find a solution!
Juleka: (mumbling) I can't repeat a year... It's not fair!
(The Megakuma enters her result sheet. Rose gasps and steps back seeing that Juleka is possessed by the Megakuma.)
Monarch: (from his lair) Reflekta, I am Monarch. Once again, they're refusing to hear your voice. But thanks to the power I'm about to give you, everyone will finally understand you — so perfectly, that they will think exactly like you! Roaar, your power is now mine! (absorbs her power) Transfer! (transmits the power of Elation into Juleka's Alliance) I am also entrusting you with the power of the Tiger! With it, a single punch will silence those who dare to resist you!

title: Confrontation/Transcript
text:
Confrontation/Transcript - Intro
(And with that, Juleka succumbs to the Megakuma and begins to transform. In the midst of transforming, the whole class altogether encourage her to resist the akumatization, but her negative emotions weighed more and Megakuma successfully got hold of her, transforming her into Reflekta in front of the class once again. The whole class run away after her transformation.)
Reflekta: Staying together no matter what? What a great idea, my dear Nino! (throws a piece of her fan at Nino, transforming him into one of her own lookalikes)
Reflekta and Nino as Reflekta: If we're all identical, who can keep us from being together all the time? Together forever!
(The two of them throw fan blades at Mylène and Ivan, then at Rose, who tries to run away.)
Reflektas: Together forever!
(The Reflektas jump away. Ms. Bustier is seen hiding underneath the table, cowering in fear. Marinette proceeds to run inside the temporary portable restroom to transform.)
Marinette: Tikki, spots on! (transforms into Ladybug)
(In the art classroom, Adrien runs in to hide and transform as well.)
Adrien: Plagg, claws out! (transforms into Cat Noir)
(By the school grounds, Reflekta begins to cause havoc.)

title: Confrontation/Transcript
text:
Confrontation/Transcript - Intro
[Superpower Sequence]
Reflekta: Clout!
(Activating her power, the school walls break one by one. After breaking, the Reflektas spread out and continue to make everyone one of their own.)
Reflektas: Together forever!
(Ladybug and Cat Noir arrive at the scene, landing on a rooftop nearby where they can see all the chaos happening. Each Parisian gets thrown by a fan blade and transforms into a clone of Reflekta...)
Reflektas: Together forever!
(...as well as Nathaniel and Alya who are on the street.)
Reflektas: Together forever!
Ladybug: We better find a solution before the whole city is crawling with Reflektas!
Cat Noir: Reflektas with the Tiger's punch as a bonus — it's not going to be easy!
Ladybug: In that case...
[Superpower Sequence]
Ladybug: Lucky Charm!
(receives a tape dispenser)
Ladybug: So, they multiply... Well then, let's divide them!
Cat Noir: Really hope you can get us out of this sticky situation, m'Lady!

title: Confrontation/Transcript
text:
Confrontation/Transcript - Intro
(The two heroes jump into action with their plan, with Cat Noir holding himself in a narrow alley. He breaks his staff into two and sticks it on the wall and drapes a fake cloth with a brick design, creating a diversion. After Ladybug tapes it on the ground to keep the cloth in place, she jumps off with Cat Noir.)
Cat Noir: You can't touch these bakers! I love their croissants too much.
(He vaults away as soon as Reflekta chases after him. Meanwhile at a florist, another Reflekta is about to make another clone.)
Reflekta: Together forever!
(Ladybug hits Reflekta with her yo-yo.)
Ladybug: Maybe you should ask what he thinks first before suggesting a career change?
(Ladybug jumps away to a building as Reflekta goes after her, leading them to the trap that she and Cat Noir set up, and the same goes for Cat Noir's wild goose chase.)
Ladybug and Cat Noir: (pretend to be stuck) Oh no!
Reflektas: Clout!
(As the Reflektas get close to the fake brick wall, Ladybug and Cat Noir leap away to let the Reflektas taste their own medicine. Their powers collide, creating a massive explosion in the middle of the city. Ladybug then breaks Reflekta's fan and sends the Megakuma flying out of it.)

title: Confrontation/Transcript
text:
Confrontation/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: No more evil-doing for you, Megakuma! (swipes open her yo-yo) Time to de-evilize! (captures the Megakuma) Gotcha! (opens her yo-yo and sending off the purified butterfly) Bye-bye, little butterfly!
[Superpower Sequence]
Ladybug: Miraculous Ladybug!
(She tosses the tape dispenser in the air and fixes every damage caused by the villain, that is, un-cloning every Reflekta clone back to who they are.)
(In the alley, Reflekta de-transforms into Juleka. Ladybug gives her another Magical Charm.)
Ladybug: Juleka, this Magical Charm will help you remember to never give up hope. We will always be there for you.
Ladybug and Cat Noir: Pound it!
Monarch: Patience. I can still sense despair and anger.
Juleka: (mumbling) I don't know what came over me... I'm really, really sorry! (starts to cry)
Rose: (starts to comfort Juleka) No, no, it's okay! Everyone's fine!
Alya: Lila, what happened during the teachers' rep meeting?
Lila: (pretends to have no knowledge about everything that's happened) I don't know. All I did was defend what was in the files Marinette had given us! (looks at Marinette with fake innocent eyes)
Alya: What's on your sheet, Marinette?

title: Confrontation/Transcript
text:
Confrontation/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (looks at her sheet) I'm going to a high school where I can specialize in fashion just like I requested—
Chloé: A-ha! That totally proves that she's the villain!
Lila: Oh, Marinette! You didn't need to (kicks Chloé on her leg) do this!
Alya: Do what?
Lila: Marinette is obviously mad at you for electing me to replace her as your class representative. But... you do realize that by creating those fake forms, you've destroyed their futures? You've risked losing all your friends?! Then, no one will ever trust you again. And then, everyone will call you... a liar?
Marinette: And how exactly would I have created those fake forms?
Lila: Well, by forging everyone's handwriting, for instance.
(The whole class gasps and turns to Marinette.)
Marinette: But I don't know how to do that, unlike Sabrina.
(Chloé pushes Sabrina to the center.)
Sabrina: Yes, I admit it. I forged the forms.
(The whole class gasp again.)
Lila: Come on, be brave, Sabrina. This is for everyone's good. Who asked you to do something so terrible?
(The whole class waits for an answer, with Lila and Chloé seemingly about to triumph at last, but...)

title: Confrontation/Transcript
text:
Confrontation/Transcript - Intro
Sabrina: (turns to look at Lila and Chloé) YOU DID! Chloé and Lila forced me to do it!
Chloé: (gasps) You traitor! That was not the plan!
(Lila steps on Chloé's foot to keep her quiet, which causes Chloé to wince in pain.)
Lila: Oh, Sabrina... I'm sorry. I hadn't noticed that by becoming friends with Chloé I was hurting you so much. You were so blinded by jealousy that Marinette, like a civilian Monarch, took advantage of it to manipulate you.
Sabrina: HUH?! No, she didn't!
Lila: But we forgive you, you know?
Sabrina: You're so horrible! You're turning everything I say against me!
Lila: We've got nothing against you, Sabrina. We all understand that this is Marinette's fault. You don't have to lie anymore.
Sabrina: I don't care! I have proof! And my policeman dad will put you both in jail! (runs out the classroom, sobbing)
Lila: Poor thing. She's so fragile. She doesn't know what she's saying. Ms. Bustier, as class reps, shouldn't we go and talk to her?
(Ms. Bustier nods hesitantly.)
Chloé: Sabrina! SABRINA! GET BACK HERE RIGHT NOW! (Sabrina enters the temporary portable restroom.) SABRINA! HEEL!

title: Confrontation/Transcript
text:
Confrontation/Transcript - Intro
(Chloé furiously stomps down the stairs whilst Lila walks down calmly. Sabrina is seen sobbing inside the restroom as Chloé and Lila barge in. Lila locks the door behind her.)
Chloé: Sabrina, you're... being... ridiculous! UTTERLY RIDICULOUS! There's no proof that we forced you to cheat!
Sabrina: Yes, there is!
Chloé: (starts to shake her) Show me the proof or I'll have my dad fire yours!
Lila: (stops Chloé) Calm down!
Chloé: But this dingbat will get us caught!
Lila: You're the one who'll get us caught if you keep getting worked up like this. (to Sabrina) What's your so-called proof, Sabrina? A microphone, a video? It doesn't matter. I'll come up with a new lie and people will believe me. I had everyone believing that Marinette pushed me down the stairs. I had everyone believing that I was halfway around the world so I wouldn't have to go to school. And if I wanted to, I could even convince your own father to put you in jail! And that's what's going to happen if you don't hand over that proof!
Sabrina: (smiles confidently as she sighs in relief) There was no proof! (Lila is taken aback.) Well, until now!

title: Confrontation/Transcript
text:
Confrontation/Transcript - Intro
(Sabrina brings out a button remote and presses it, revealing that the temporary restroom was a trap set for Lila and Chloé, showing everyone their true motive. The mirror now shows the other side of the wall, where the whole class and faculty are seen to be standing just right outside the temporary restroom.)
Marinette: You've just told everyone who you really are, Lila.
(Now cornered, Lila begins to panic.)
Marinette: A few days ago, Sabrina warned me about what you were planning.
(Flashback: Outside the boiler room, Marinette answers the call.)
Marinette: Hello?
Sabrina: (inside Chloé's closet) I can't! Not anymore! What should I do, Marinette?!
Marinette: Exactly what they're asking you to. We're going to need proof and I have an idea to catch them!
(Marinette sticks the broken toilet sign outside the girls' restroom door.)
Marinette: It just took a little bit of... D.I.Y.!
(Construction workers start to build the temporary restroom by the courtyard under Denis Damoclès' supervision. Now inside, Marinette removes the mirror and replaces it with a remote-controlled two-way mirror and puts a small hidden microphone underneath the sink.)
(End of flashback.)

title: Confrontation/Transcript
text:
Confrontation/Transcript - Intro
(Sabrina walks beside Marinette and the girls share a fist bump. The two of them turn to Denis Damoclès and Ms. Bustier together.)
Marinette: I'm sorry for the damage, but it's for everyone's good. I'll fix everything.
Ms. Bustier: We owe you an apology, Marinette. And most of all, me.
(Marinette smiles.)
Denis Damoclès: Chloé Bourgeois and Lila Rossi, you are hereby expelled from school!!
(Chloé and Lila growl angrily at this humiliation and justice against them, whilst Chloé opens her Alliance and contacts her father, the Mayor.)
André: (in the Alliance transmission) If you want to keep your job, Mr. Principal, then keep my daughter and her friend in your school!
Denis Damoclès: If those are your orders, Mr. Mayor, but couldn't we at least review the students' files again?
André: (in the Alliance transmission) Impossible! Everything's in the system already! (whispers) Reviewing them would mean acknowledging this whole forged form story, which would be terribly damaging to our institution's image!
Denis Damoclès: (disapproving) But that means these children will have a future that doesn't match their ambitions! They'll be unhappy! The school would have betrayed them!

title: Confrontation/Transcript
text:
Confrontation/Transcript - Intro
André: (in the Alliance transmission) What do you want me to say, my friend? C'est la vie!
(André turns off the transmission with a frown. In his office, it is revealed that Audrey coached him to what he'd say.)
Audrey: Good job. Now you're not getting fired either. (walks out the office, leaving Andre to contemplate his actions alone)
(Back at the school, in the principal's office, Denis Damoclès throws the orientation forms off his table and places his head down in frustration.)
Monarch: Patience always pays off sooner or later! (sends off his Megakuma)
Marinette: (gasps) Again?! NO! (grabs a folder and fends off the Megakuma)
Denis Damoclès: I destroyed my students' futures... I'm unworthy of my title!
Sabrina: It's not your fault, Mr. Damoclès!
(While Marinette fights off the Megakuma, she notices something glowing in Sabrina's pocket and Denis Damoclès', to Marinette's surprise.)
Marinette: Don't give up!
Monarch: (from his lair) Come on, my Megakuma, destroy that Magical Charm!
Marinette: Do what you think is right!
Alya: We trust you!
(Denis Damoclès' Magical Charm in his pocket glows brighter.)
Chloé: Hah! He was always a coward, a complete coward!

title: Confrontation/Transcript
text:
Confrontation/Transcript - Intro
(The glow on Denis Damoclès' Magical Charm starts to fade.)
Ms. Bustier: Don't listen to her! We can still work things out!
(Denis Damoclès' Magical Charm glows bright again.)
Marinette: The Magical Charm reacts to emotions! Ms. Bustier, get those two out and get as many people in here as you can! Trust me!
(Ms. Bustier nods and sends Chloé and Lila outside the office.)
Chloé: You're going to regret meddling in this!
Ms. Bustier: (to the rest of the class, except Chloé and Lila) All of you, quick! We need as many people as possible!
(The whole class walk inside the office.)
Chloé: HEY! (growls and turns to Lila who is already walking out the school) Hey, what's-your-name! Get back here! What's the next part of the plan?! You can't leave me here alone like this! Get back here!! Lee-la!!
(Lila continues to walk out of the school, ignoring Chloé. Back in the office, Marinette continues to fight off the Megakuma with a folder. The whole class continues to give Denis Damoclès words of encouragement to prevent him from getting akumatized.)
Cat Noir: (appearing from behind) What would the owl say if he saw you like this?

title: Confrontation/Transcript
text:
Confrontation/Transcript - Intro
Denis Damoclès: Cat Noir?! Oh, even superheroes are going to witness how incompetent I am! I'm worse than a supervillain! (sobs)
(Juleka walks towards Denis Damoclès, with her glowing Magical Charm in her hand.)
Juleka: You... You... You can do this, Mr. Damoclès!
(The whole class is stunned, especially Denis Damoclès.)
Denis Damoclès: J-J-Juleka! Your speech impediment!
Juleka: Every student in this school and all the teachers are counting on their super principal!
Monarch: (from his lair) The Megakuma should break the Magical Charm! Why isn't it working?!
(Denis Damoclès brings out his Magical Charm, glowing brighter than ever, as Juleka shows hers that is glowing bright as well.)
Denis Damoclès: Yes! I-I can do this, too! I can still make everything right!
(His Magical Charm gives out the brightest glow as it turns into a shield. The Megakuma flies towards him...)
Marinette: NO!
(...but the shield deflects the Megakuma successfully, and purifies it too. In his lair, Monarch is aghast in disbelief and horror at what happened.)
Monarch: NOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!!
(Denis Damoclès' shield reverts to his Magical Charm. The whole class celebrates and gives Denis Damoclès a group hug.)

title: Confrontation/Transcript
text:
Confrontation/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: Well done! (jumps out the window)
Gabriel: (throws his glove and reveals his Cataclysmed hand) It can't be true!?! Defeated by a bunch of kids?!? With or without your Magical Charms, I'm not done with you yet!!!
André: That's stupid if you do that! I'll be fired— I mean, I'll fire you, and Chloé and Lila will be reinstated anyway!
Denis Damoclès: (in his office) I don't care! For too long, I've been sacrificing my principles for interests that go against the common good. Find someone else to do your dirty work!! (hangs up in finality as the class cheer for him) What are you all still doing here? Don't you have new school forms to fill out?
(The whole class look at each other, confused.)
Denis Damoclès: If I'm to lose my job, then I might as well send you to the schools you actually want.

title: Confrontation/Transcript
text:
Confrontation/Transcript - Intro
(The whole class cheer again now that they've finally given a second chance to be sent to their chosen schools. They proceeded to go outside once they received their newly changed orientation forms. Once out, Ms. Bustier closes the office door. Back in the office, a melancholic Denis Damoclès puts away his things. Stepping outside, the whole class awaits and applauds him to honor him for standing up for his students. The class bids him goodbye as Denis Damoclès leaves the school.)
Cat Noir: And then finally, the principal left. And that's the whole story.
Ladybug: (gasps) So that was the true power of the Magical Charm!
Cat Noir: Awesome, right? If things continue this way, people won't need us anymore to be de-akumatized.
(Ladybug shakes her head and smiles.)
Ms. Bustier: Come in.
(Chloé enters the room.)
Ms. Bustier: (scowls) Where's Lila?
Chloé: How should I know? I'm not the betrayer's mother.
(Ms. Bustier is taken aback.)
Ms. Bustier: (gasps) I really thought you were good at heart, Chloé, that there was a possibility that you could change if people reached out to you. I was wrong. Now, whether you like it or not, you are going to have to face the consequences of your actions.

title: Confrontation/Transcript
text:
Confrontation/Transcript - Intro
Chloé: And what are you going to do to me, huh?! You can't even expel me!
Ms. Bustier: You're right. But from now on, you'll be getting some very special attention from me.
(A surprised Chloé glares at Ms. Bustier and growls. She storms out of the classroom right after.)
Chloé: "Special attention" – Ridiculous! Utterly— (gets a call from her Alliance ring) Who is this?! (answers the call)
(On the streets, Lila, about to take on a new identity, takes off what is revealed to be her wig and throws it in the trash.)
Lila: The war is only just starting. Be ready. (ends the call)
Student 1: Oh, Cerise! Is your movie shoot over?
Student 2: We didn't think we'd see you again before the end of the school year!
(It appears that Lila returned to her original identity, Cerise Bianca, who is sporting a short pixie haircut and brown eyes instead of her long chestnut brown wig and green chartreuse contacts from before.)
Cerise: Yes! I moved heaven and earth so I can be back just in time for the teachers' rep meeting. It would've been such a shame if your favorite delegate were missing!
es:Confrontación/Transcripción
pl:Konfrontacja/Transkrypt

title: Collusion/Transcript
text:
Collusion/Transcript - Intro
[ Theme Song ]
Gabriel: Emilie, my love, a cycle is coming to an end. In a matter of days, it will all be over — or rather, it will all start over again… (clenches his right hand, entirely blackened by the Cataclysm.) I swore to you that I would do everything to bring us together again. We're almost there.
(He unfolds his left sleeve to cover his cataclysmed arm and walks away.)
Emilie: (v.o.) When Gabriel has a vision, nothing can stop him. Not even the impossible. His passion…
Emilie: (in the video) …sweeps everything away. He wanted so badly to make me happy but he pushed us too far. And when I realized that, I couldn't make him understand that…
(Gabriel goes up the stairs in the mansion's foyer.)
Emilie: (v.o.) …sometimes, you have to let go. Now it's too late for me. (coughs)
(Gabriel glances at the half-opened door of Nathalie's room. He goes up to the door and eavesdrops on Nathalie listening to Emilie's video recording.)
Emilie: (v.o.) But not for you, Nathalie. Adrien shouldn't have to suffer the consequences of our mistakes. Our little prince has the right to create his own vision of happiness.
(Gabriel scowls and leaves from the door.)

title: Collusion/Transcript
text:
Collusion/Transcript - Intro
Emilie: (in the video) Please protect him. (smiles bitterly)
(As the video recording comes to an end, Nathalie shares the same bitter smile that Emilie left in the video.)
Adrien: Morning, Marinette!
Marinette: Morning, Adrien!
(They grab their lucky charms on the bedside and head to the bathroom. While brushing their teeth, they try talking, but only end up mumbling. They burst out laughing. As Marinette eats breakfast, Adrien walks downstairs to the kitchen. Marinette, on the other hand, almost knocks over the milk carton with her cereal bowl.)
Adrien: Watch out, Marinette!
Marinette: (after luckily catching the milk carton from falling) Oh! Thanks, Adrien! (chuckles)
(Before Marinette leaves, Tom and Sabine give her two bags of treats. Meanwhile, Adrien heads to the mansion's kitchen.)
Tom: And voilà! My darling daughter's croissants.
Sabine: And choquettes for her Adrien!
Adrien: Thank you! See you later, Marinette! (hangs up)
Adrien: Good morning!
Gabriel: Just in time for breakfast! By the way, how did your friend Marinette take the news of your upcoming departure for London, Adrien?
(Adrien reacts with surprise.)

title: Collusion/Transcript
text:
Collusion/Transcript - Intro
Gabriel: You haven't told her yet, have you? I can understand it is indeed a little sad… but you know I'm doing this for your happiness.
Nathalie: Are you sure this is about his vision of happiness and not your own?
Gabriel: (becomes visibly angry and starts rubbing his ring behind his back) I am his father, and I know what is best for him.
Adrien: You should've listened to Marinette's advice, father. Your pancakes taste as bad as ever. (moves his plate away) Have a nice day, Nathalie. (takes his bag and walks out as Gabriel looks at him furiously)
Adrien: (to his bodyguard) If you don't mind, I'd rather walk. I need to take my mind off things.
Plagg: You really put your father in his place! I can't wait to see his face when you tell him you're not going to London!
Adrien: I have no idea how to tell him that, Plagg.
Plagg: But you're going to tell him, right? You can't wait until you're gone to tell him you're not going.
Adrien: All I know is — whatever happens, Marinette and I will last forever.
Plagg: Forever? Well, in the meantime, you only have a few days left!
Marinette: Adrien!
Adrien: Marinette!
Marinette: (pulls out a paper bag) Choquettes?
Adrien: Thank you.

title: Collusion/Transcript
text:
Collusion/Transcript - Intro
(The couple try kissing twice, but stop both times and start blushing while bursting out laughing. All their classmates are watching them on the school's staircase.)
Rose: How can they still get it wrong? It's not like it's complicated.
Alya: For these two, it is. It's very complicated.
(Rose becomes fed up and walks over to them.)
Rose: You two, that's enough! Do it!
Marinette: Wha– What are you talking about, Rose?
Rose: The kiss! The wonderful act that will seal the eternal love between the cutest sweethearts ever! The sweethearts we've been waiting forever for! So — you two, kiss. Now. Or I will kiss you both!
Adrien: It's nice of you to support us, Rose, but we're just waiting for the right time. Aren't we, Marinette?
Marinette: Oh, you said it so well. You're perfect, Adrien, as always.
Adrien: No, you are.
Marinette: No, you are.
Adrien: No, you are.
Marinette: No, you're perfect.
Adrien: No, you're perfect.
Marinette: No, you're perfect.
Adrien: No, you.
Marinette: No, you.
(As they go back and forth, their classmates look on, confused and exhausted.)
Rose: Aw, you're so cute. But so irritating too!

title: Collusion/Transcript
text:
Collusion/Transcript - Intro
(As the students settle in their seats, Sabrina walks up to her ex-"best friend". They look at each other confrontationally. Sabrina scoffs at her, then sits next to Nathaniel instead. Chloé notices Marinette and Adrien walking in.)
Chloé: Adri-nothing and his baker girl, or "how to go from magazine paper to toilet paper"!
Marinette: (unfazed) Be mean while you still can, Chloé. I'm gonna let you in on a secret. Remember your friend Lila who used to hurt everyone with her lies? See her anywhere in this classroom? No, because I put a stop to her nastiness and I'll do the same with you!
Chloé: Oh, I'd very much like to see that, Dupain-Cheng.
(Marinette proceeds to sit in her seat. The camera pans to reveal a small earpiece in Chloé's right ear.)
Cerise: (through the earpiece) Let her think that she's the best.
Cerise: We're not done with her yet.
(Cerise stands in her very own secret lair in front of a corkboard with pictures of her enemies and people related to them. She listens in to Miss Bustier's lesson.)
Caline: (heard through the earpiece) No, Kim, the Sans-culottes of the French Revolution weren't called this because they ran around in their swimsuits.

title: Collusion/Transcript
text:
Collusion/Transcript - Intro
(The class laughs at Kim's comment. Chloé merely yawns, and smirks as she turns on her Alliance.)
Caline: It was in fact, because, unlike the rich aristocrats, they wore plain canvas pants.
(The teacher is interrupted by Chloé playing loud music.)
Chloé: (starts dancing on her desk) Bla-bla-bla, no one cares, no one cares, no one cares about this!
Rose: Chloé, quit it!
Nino: Turn it off! We find it interesting!
Rose: We wanna hear the lesson, we care!
Chloé: Of course you find it interesting. You'll all need to find jobs later on, but I won't! That's the difference between the Sans-culottes (points to the others) and the aristocrats, (points to herself) isn't it, Miss Bustier?
Caline: Chloé, that's enough. Turn off that music right away or I'll send you to the principal's office.
Chloé: I don't think so. Actually, I think you're the one who's going. (calls the new principal on her Alliance) Ms. Mendeleiev, the new school rules allow music in class, don't they?
(Miss Bustier is shocked.)
Olga: (through the Alliance) Uhh… are you sure?
Chloé: Would you like me to disturb my father, the Mayor of Paris, so he can confirm that for you?

title: Collusion/Transcript
text:
Collusion/Transcript - Intro
Olga: (hangs up with Chloé and calls Miss Bustier instead) Miss Bustier, please see me in my office.
(Miss Bustier walks out dejected.)
Chloé: Bye-bye!
Marinette: Chloé, are you out of your mind? Miss Bustier is pregnant, she doesn't need this stress!
Mylène: We won't let you treat her like this!
Chloé: And how are you going to stop me, huh? By drowning me in your tears?
André: (through the Alliance) Chloé's wishes are Paris City Hall's orders. (hangs up)
Olga: It's an order from the mayor. He's my superior. I have no other choice but to comply.
(Miss Bustier grows a hopeless expression.)
Ivan: (stands in front of Chloé, prepared to punch her) What did you say to Mylène?!
Marinette: (stands in front of him with her hand raised) No, Ivan, that's exactly what she wants!
(Miss Bustier walks in and sees the scene.)
Cerise: (through the earpiece) Now.
Chloé: (rubs her cheek vigorously to make it appear red) Ow! Marinette slapped me!
Marinette: What?! No, I didn't! I was stopping Ivan from–
Adrien: Chloé's lying! She's a manipulator!
(The rest of class explodes in a cacophony of statements defending Marinette.)

title: Collusion/Transcript
text:
Collusion/Transcript - Intro
Chloé: See? They all pretend to be non-violent, but they'll attack a helpless girl! (makes another call with her Alliance) Ms. Mendeleiev! (smiles to the class evilly)
Sabine: This is absurd! You can't expel Marinette days before the end of the school year!
Tom: Without an investigation? Or proof?
Chloé: Look! (rubs her cheek again) How's that for proof?
Caline: Chloé, do you remember this gift you gave me on my birthday? (shows a golden bracelet she received from the student in "Zombizou") To me, that is proof that you're a fragile teenager who doesn't know love and is simply looking for attention. And… we all tried to help you. So, please, whatever it is you want, ask yourself if it's worth all the suffering you're causing.
Chloé: Did you hear that? A homeroom teacher using a student's feelings to blackmail her. This is inappropriate, utterly inappropriate! My father, the mayor, would never tolerate this in a school.
(Cerise dictates every word Chloé says to her.)
Chloé and Cerise: He would ask for her immediate dismissal.
(Everybody reacts with shock.)
Caline: Olga, you can't do this!
Olga: (sighs) I'm sorry, but since the mayor is my superior, I have no choice but to comply.

title: Collusion/Transcript
text:
Collusion/Transcript - Intro
(With great satisfaction, Cerise unpins two photos of Marinette and Miss Bustier from her corkboard as a sign of victory.)
(Miss Bustier packs her belongings into a box, struggling to hold back tears.)
Monarch: A committed teacher who was unjustly dismissed — this is perfect for my Megakuma. (turns a butterfly into a Megakuma) Kaalki, your power is now mine! (absorbs the Kwami into his Horse Miraculous ring) Voyage, my Megakuma! And turn this feeling of injustice into righteous anger!
(The Megakuma flies through the Voyage portal and lodges itself in Caline's box.)
Monarch: (telepathically from his lair) Miss Sans-Culotte, I am Monarch. You have fallen victim to a corrupt system, but I am offering you the power to avenge this injustice.
Caline: No… thank you!
Monarch: (telepathically from his lair, surprised) What do you mean "no, thank you"?
Caline: (employs a special breathing technique to calm down) All I want is to talk some sense into my student… using words… I don't need your evil powers for that. (breaks out of her akumatization)
(The Megakuma flies out of the box and is purified into a normal butterfly.)
Monarch: What?
(Monarch's Alliance rings.)

title: Collusion/Transcript
text:
Collusion/Transcript - Intro
Alliance Emilie: You have an appointment in ten minutes with the mayor and Tsurugi-san.
Monarch: (groans) Dark wings fall. (detransforms into Gabriel)
(The students of Miss Bustier's class say goodbye to their teacher. Her partner is waiting for her.)
Gisèle: Just let me have a word with that new principal of yours!
Caline: (grabs her wrist) It wouldn't do any good, Gisèle. (to her students) Besides, I'm sure we'll find a solution! I won't let you down!
Marinette: Neither will we, Miss Bustier! You can count on us.
(Inside the school, an annoyed Chloé watches the gathering.)
Chloé: (through the Alliance) Because it looks like they haven't really learned their lesson!
(André sees Mrs. Tsurugi's car park in front of the hotel.)
Chloé: But if she's imprisoned, or gets expelled from Paris–
André: Okay, okay, okay, we'll talk about this later, I don't have time to chat right now. (helps Tomoe out of her car)
(Next to the hotel, Cerise spies on the mayor. She has a duffel bag around her shoulder.)
Cerise: Are you going to let your father talk to you like this, Chloé?
Chloé: (through the earpiece) What?! You think you're going to teach me how to be mean?

title: Collusion/Transcript
text:
Collusion/Transcript - Intro
Cerise: (sets her bag down and opens it) No, of course not, but you should go see your father at the palace to remind him that no one disobeys Chloé Bourgeois.
(Gabriel's car arrives too. The designer steps out.)
(Blueprints for Tsurugi Industries' police robots are layed out across the table.)
Tomoe: Our police robots are the future of security, Mr. Mayor.
Gabriel: Paris will set an example by being the first to use them. Elegance and power in the service of order.
André: What about all of my policemen who'll be out of a job? They've got to make a living!
Tomoe: Your policemen mostly get paid for doing nothing. It seems that Ladybug and Cat Noir are the ones who have been enforcing the law in Paris the last few months, wouldn't you agree?
Gabriel: Who would you rather trust — children whose identities you don't even know?
Tomoe: Or robots that will be entirely under your full, yet remote, control?
(André is deep in thought.)
Gabriel: If you want to remain the engineer of Paris for a long time to come, André, you have to board the train of the future before it leaves you at the station. (hands André a pen from his jacket)

title: Collusion/Transcript
text:
Collusion/Transcript - Intro
Chloé: (storms towards the three) DADDY! How dare you hang up without obeying me?!
Cerise: (through the earpiece) Turn on your camera!
Chloé: (whispering) Why do you want me to do that?
André: (overhears) To do what?
Chloé: Uhhh…
(Cerise finishes her disguise by putting on a wig. She's dressed exactly like a maid employed at the hotel.)
Cerise: Just trust me and you'll get everything you want.
(Chloé smiles awkwardly, then turns on the camera of her Alliance.)
Chloé: You have to do what I want because everyone has to do whatever I want!
(Cerise watches the three adults at the table through her phone. She zooms in on Gabriel in particular, then walks into the hotel.)
Chloé: Miss Bustier must go to jail and all of the students in my classroom must be FORBIDDEN from attending any high school, EVER!
André: Ouu… don't you think this is taking things a bit too far, Chloé?
Chloé: Mom is right, you have NO command of authority! That's why nobody obeys you, you're ridiculous!
(On her phone, Cerise notices Gabriel beginning to smile. She's hidden right outside the restaurant. She continues speaking to Chloé through the earpieces.)

title: Collusion/Transcript
text:
Collusion/Transcript - Intro
Cerise: You're right, Chloé, your father is weak. And if it weren't for Ladybug and Cat Noir, Paris would be run by akumatized villains, right?
Chloé: You're such a weak mayor that if it weren't for Ladybug and Cat Noir — and everyone knows how pathetic they are — if it weren't for them, Monarch would be the mayor of Paris!
Cerise: If you, Chloé, were the mayor, you'd ban superheroes.
Chloé: If I were the mayor, I'd ban superheroes!
Gabriel: You should follow your daughter's example, André. She isn't as cowardly as you are.
André: Oh, come on! Ladybug and Cat Noir are wonderful; everyone loves them. As for her classmates, what she's asking for is unreasonable! Would you let me forbid Adrien to go to high school?
Gabriel: The question is irrelevant. When next school year starts, Adrien will be in London.
Chloé: Uh? Adri-nothi– I mean, Adrien won't be in Paris any longer?
André: (sighs and takes off his sash) I'll do whatever you want, Chloé, I promise, but right now, you must let me finish this lunch. (leads his daughter outside)
Cerise: Well done, Chloé. That was a real display of power.
(Chloé smiles triumphantly.)

title: Collusion/Transcript
text:
Collusion/Transcript - Intro
Tomoe: This fool's dithering is wasting precious time that we can no longer afford to waste. Or more exactly, that you can no longer afford to waste.
Gabriel: (pulls down his left sleeve to uncover his fully blackened arm; takes the mayoral sash off the table and stands up) I'll talk to him.
Mylène: First, Mr. Damoclès, and now Miss Bustier and Marinette all dismissed because of Chloé? We can't let that happen!
Marinette: There's only a few days left before the school year ends, Mylène.
Alya: It's never too late for justice.
Rose: But what about the end of the year dance? It's the perfect time for kisses. What are you gonna do if you can't go, Marinette?
Marinette: No one can stop us from loving each other, Rose.
Everyone: Awww!
(Adrien starts looking worried.)
André: Seriously, Gabriel, what's this whole police robot idea all about?
Gabriel: Have I ever offered a single bad idea to you, André? We've always helped each other, haven't we?

title: Collusion/Transcript
text:
Collusion/Transcript - Intro
André: Remember when we were young and penniless? (opens his 'dream depository') When Emilie, you and I would make the world right from our little attic room? (picks up an old tie from the depository) You made me my very first suit so I'd feel confident and Audrey, whom I'd fallen in love with, would finally notice me? Don't you think we were much happier back then? That our lives were more beautiful, more fair?
Gabriel: Come on, you have everything to be happy, André. Your wife, your daughter, Paris City Hall…
(Cerise spies on their conversation from behind some plants.)
André: A woman who barely respects me, a selfish, heartless daughter, and a City Hall that I never wanted. I only got into politics like dad to impress Audrey, you know that.
Gabriel: (disgruntled, he discreetly turns on his Alliance's recording function) I have no idea what you're talking about.

title: Collusion/Transcript
text:
Collusion/Transcript - Intro
André: Look at me, Gabe. All my life I've lied, I've cheated and I've abused my power. I used to be a dreamer, an artist, I wanted to make movies! Now I've become a tyrant in servitude to my family and friends… (wipes his face with the mayoral sash) Police robots today? And tomorrow? I'll replace teachers with machines, maybe? Or perhaps I'll turn the school into a prison! A factory of fools just smart enough to buy products that make you, me and Tsurugi-san rich? And you? Look at yourself. You used to create unique clothing to help people's dreams become a reality. Today you design police robots and connected rings. You  know what? Maybe there's still hope. Maybe we can still change, give up our privileges, go back to the way it was before! (picks up and starts looking through one of his old movie scripts)
Gabriel: What should I tell Tsurugi-san?
André: Tell her no, I won't do it. City Hall is no longer for sale, Gabe.
Gabriel: (turns off recording) If that's what you want… (walks off)
André: Hey, this script wasn't that bad at all actually. Haha, funny scene!

title: Collusion/Transcript
text:
Collusion/Transcript - Intro
André: (in the recording) Look at me, Gabe. All my life I've lied, I've cheated and I've abused my power. I used to be a dreamer— (The video gets fast-forwarded.) Police robots today? And tomorrow? I'll replace teachers with machines, maybe? Or perhaps I'll turn the school into a prison! (The selected clips are put together into one shorter, deceptive video.) All my life I've lied, I've cheated and I've abused my power. Police robots today? And tomorrow, I'll replace teachers with machines, or turn the school into a prison!
Gabriel: Alliance, send the video, please.
Gisèle: It's gonna be okay. (kisses Caline on the cheek) I'll be right back.
(After Gisèle leaves, Caline receives a notification on her Alliance. She opens it to see the edited clip of André admitting to corruption on TVi News.)
André: (in the video) All my life I've lied, I've cheated and I've abused my power. Police robots today? And tomorrow, I'll replace teachers with machines, or turn the school into a prison!
Caline: It's not about me getting fired anymore, the mayor can't do this! Someone has to stop him!
(A ready Megakuma waits on Monarch's hand.)
Monarch: Now is the perfect time. Voyage, my Megakuma!

title: Collusion/Transcript
text:
Collusion/Transcript - Intro
(The Megakuma flies out underneath the table Caline is sitting at and infects the bracelet in her hand.)
Monarch: (telepathically, from his lair) Miss Sans-Culotte, you thought an education could change the world for the better, but your superiors betrayed your ideals. If you want to protect them, you're going to have to fight!
Caline: (struggling) No, there has to be another solution besides violence!
Monarch: (telepathically, from his lair) There is — power. And I'm about to give you one. A magical, mighty power. All I ask in return are Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous.
Caline: Gyaahh… I'm only doing this for the children, Monarch. (is covered in a black-purple ether and transformed into a supervillain)
Monarch: (telepathically, from his lair) To give strength to your revolution, I am entrusting you with the essence of the Miraculous of Jubilation. It will give you the power to make people see their dreams of freedom and thus, win over supporters for your cause! Daizzi, your power is now mine! (absorbs the Kwami into the Pig Miraculous ring) To arms, citizens! Form your battalions! Transfer! (taps the ring)

title: Collusion/Transcript
text:
Collusion/Transcript - Intro
(A component inside Miss Sans-Culotte's Alliance ring displays the Pig Miraculous' symbol. The blade at the end of the chain wrapped around her wrist lights up pink. Théo Barbot sees her and tries running away.)
Miss Sans-Culotte: No one can stop the revolution! (hits him with her blade, transforming him into a red balloon)
Balloon Théo: Ah, ça ira ça ira ça ira! La-da-dee, la-da-dee, la-da-da!
Miss Sans-Culotte: Long live the revolution! (walks away with her first 'supporter')
Gisèle: Caline, you can't do this! You said it yourself — there are other ways!
(Miss Sans-Culotte ignores Gisèle and jumps away.)
Monarch: Dark wings fall. (detransforms)
Gabriel: (calls Tomoe using his Alliance) The trap is set, Tsurugi-san. While we wait for Ladybug and Cat Noir to fall into it, the only thing that remains is for us to turn Chloé Bourgeois into a savior.
Nadja: So, Mr. Banana, your autobiography "Stay Peachy" is being made into a movie. What can you tell us about it?
Mr. Banana: Stay peachy!
Miss Sans-Culotte: (appears with her army) That's enough! (transforms him into a balloon)
Balloon army: Ah, ça ira ça ira ça ira!

title: Collusion/Transcript
text:
Collusion/Transcript - Intro
Miss Sans-Culotte: Television shouldn't be used to stupify the masses, but to awaken the consciousness of the people! (plays the video of André on her Alliance)
André: (in the video) All my life I've lied, I've cheated and I've abused my power. Police robots today? And tomorrow, I'll replace teachers with machines!
(Parisians around the city watch the video.)
Marinette: I'm sure everything will be okay. The Resistance won't give up.
Adrien: I hope so…
Marinette: Is something else… going on? Do you wanna talk about it?
Adrien: (stays silent for a brief moment, thinking) I–(Adrien gets a notification on his phone.)Adrien's phone: Megakuma alert! Megakuma alert!
Adrien: I have to– uhh… I have to go! My father insisted I come home right away in case of a Megakuma alert. (runs off)Marinette: (heads to the Liberty's quarterdeck) I hope Adrien isn't in trouble.
Tikki: I'm sure he'd tell you if he were, Marinette.
Marinette: You must be right. Tikki, spots on! (transforms into Ladybug)''
Adrien: (hides behind a staircase) I was just about to tell her but it's never the right time… Plagg, claws out! (transforms into Cat Noir)
André: (in the video) I've cheated and I've abus–

title: Collusion/Transcript
text:
Collusion/Transcript - Intro
(Zoé turns off her Alliance and runs off to everyone's surprise.)
André: (in the video) Police robots today? And tomorrow, I'll replace teachers with machines!
Chloé: Are you kidding me?! Has he been akumatized or something?! (answers an incoming call on her Alliance) Mr. Agreste?
Gabriel: (through the Alliance) Chloé, I was very impressed by your eloquence earlier and it compelled me to give you a gift. The most precious, the most superb gift there is.
Chloé: The only thing you could've offered me was Adrien, but now that he's made a fool of himself with his baker girl, I don't want him anymore.
Gabriel: I was actually thinking of a gift that would grant you power.
Chloé: No need. I already have everything I want since my dad is the mayor of Paris.
Cerise: (from her lair, through the earpiece) With his confession, your father may not be the mayor for much longer. And if he's no longer able to protect you, what will happen when you have to answer to all the people you've hurt?
Chloé: (to Gabriel) …Alright, wait a second, what's this gift you keep talking about?

title: Collusion/Transcript
text:
Collusion/Transcript - Intro
(Police officers headed by Roger Raincomprix are stationed outside of City Hall to protect the mayor from Miss Sans-Culotte. The supervillain attacks them and transforms them into balloons one by one without much difficulty. Ladybug and Cat Noir meet up on the rooftop of a nearby building.)
Cat Noir: It's almost Bastille Day, m'lady. Do you think this akumatized villain wants to celebrate the French Revolution early?
Ladybug: Mostly I think it's strange that Monarch would support a revolutionary.
(The two heroes jump into action and attack the villain. A battle ensues.)
Miss Sans-Culotte: Ladybug, Cat Noir, help the Sans-culottes free Paris from its aristocratic mayor!
Ladybug: Terror isn't a solution!
Cat Noir: There are elections to make your voice heard.
Miss Sans-Culotte: Or a revolution when everyone is corrupt. Nothing can stop freedom!
Cat Noir: We're all for the big dance and fireworks on July 14th, but don't you think that's a lot, Miss Sans-Culotte?
Ladybug: Just be careful she doesn't make you lose your head, kitty!
Cat Noir: I can't make heads or tails of her definition of justice.
Ladybug: Let's try something else.
[Superpower Sequence]

title: Collusion/Transcript
text:
Collusion/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: Lucky Charm! (receives a crown)
Cat Noir: A crown?
Ladybug: (sees the crown, Miss Sans-Culotte, and City Hall highlighted in her vision) Revolution… Sans-Culotte… Mayor Bourgeois is acting like the king of Paris, and maybe he should be removed from office after all.
Cat Noir: Are you saying we should give this villain free reign?
Ladybug: I don't know… I feel like that's what the Lucky Charm means. You're right, it's not up to us to decide who gets to be the mayor and who doesn't. An akumatized villain just needs to be deakumatized.
Miss Sans-Culotte: (to her balloons) Take care of them while I accomplish my mission!
(Ladybug and Cat Noir are squashed in a pile of balloons.)
Miss Sans-Culotte: (laughs) This is what happens when you hesitate. When faced with adversity, we must dare, and dare again, and go on daring!
Zoé: (runs in) Hey, wait! My stepdad Mayor Bourgeois has made some mistakes, but… deep down, he's not a bad man.
Miss Sans-Culotte: I've tried to listen to people, to educate my students, to convince with words, but we have to face the facts — there's only one thing that ever works: a revolution! (attacks Zoé with her blade)

title: Collusion/Transcript
text:
Collusion/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: (swoops in and protects Zoé from the attack with her yo-yo whilst Cat Noir fights off the balloons) Give yourself one last chance. You're a teacher, aren't you? Then try to use your best weapon one last time — your words. Granted, they don't work on everyone, but if this girl is telling the truth, maybe it will work with the mayor!
Miss Sans-Culotte: (considerately) Hmm…
André: (in the video) And I've abused my power–
(The real André Bourgeois shuts off the display screen in the office. He calls Gabriel on his Alliance.)
Gabriel: (pre-recorded voice) You've reached Gabriel Agreste's voicemail. Please leave a message.
André: I thought we were friends, Gabriel, but it seems that is no longer the case. But then again, what you did was just the push I needed to finally make the right decision. I do feel sorry for you, however. Goodbye, Gabriel. (hangs up and looks at the script of Solitude on his table)
(The door to the office opens. Miss Sans-Culotte walks in, closely guarded by Ladybug and Cat Noir.)
Miss Sans-Culotte: Mr. Bourgeois! You cheated, lied and used collusion! You must be accountable to the people and step down as mayor of Paris!

title: Collusion/Transcript
text:
Collusion/Transcript - Intro
André: You're absolutely right! I should never have become mayor in the first place, and such an excellent teacher as you should never have been fired. So, we're going to fix this! By the powers vested in me, I now reinstate you to your position!
(Ladybug, Cat Noir, and Miss Sans-Culotte are greatly surprised. Zoé peeks in.)
André: And now, by the powers vested in me, I… fire myself from City Hall! (takes off his sash and picks up the movie script) Ah, what a relief. I'll let you close the door on your way out. Goodbye! (walks off with a pleased Zoé)
Miss Sans-Culotte: (to Ladybug and Cat Noir) You were right. Sometimes a revolution can also be won with words. (breaks out of her akumatization and turns back to normal. The Megakuma escapes the infected object and purifies itself)
Gisèle: Ah, Caline!
Caline: Gisèle!
(The two women run to each other and kiss on the lips, then walk out together.)
Ladybug and Cat Noir: (fist bump) Pound it!
Ladybug: It's weird, I didn't get to use the crown. The Lucky Charm always indicates the right way to defeat the villain.
Cat Noir: But you also use it to repair the damage.
Ladybug: Maybe you're right. Miraculous Ladybug!

title: Collusion/Transcript
text:
Collusion/Transcript - Intro
(Every member of Miss Sans-Culotte's balloon army is turned back to their normal self. Ladybug and Cat Noir think it's another job well done, until…)
Chloé: Arrest Ladybug and Cat Noir!
(With reporters behind her, surrounded by eight police robots and with their control case in hand, Chloé enters the office.)
Ladybug: (sees Chloé and her robots highlighted in her vision) The Lucky Charm wasn't for Miss Sans-Culotte!
Cat Noir: A crown for the queen of brats, of course!
Chloé: (to the reporters) Ladybug and Cat Noir have just helped a supervillain force my father, the mayor of Paris, to resign. They have no right to use their magic powers in that way! Lucky for us all, I'm here to defend my father and protect… demotra– uhh, memocracy–
Cerise: (through the earpiece) Slowly, Chloé — de-mo-cra-cy.
Chloé: De-mo-cra-cy!
Cerise: (through the earpiece) Well done!
Cat Noir: What exactly do you think you get to defend? Your father stepped down of his own accord.
Chloé: See? Here they go again using their powers against demacro– demicro– uh, DECROMACY! They're not superheroes, they're supervillains!
Ladybug: That's enough! (throws her yo-yo at Chloé)

title: Collusion/Transcript
text:
Collusion/Transcript - Intro
(Chloé defends herself from Ladybug's attack by forming a shield with her robots, then has them launches a barrage of projectiles at the heroes. As they're busy defending themselves, she traps them in a net.)
Cat Noir: Cataclysm! (destroys the net)
(Ladybug and Cat Noir quickly escape through a window. Chloé smiles maliciously.)
(Marinette and Alya's families watch the news concerned. Chloé is making an announcement on live TV.)
Chloé: People of Paris! Until we find a detromatic solution — I mean, a solution that will work — I'll be your new mayor of Paris. That's it! Power must– one sec… (clears throat and whispers into the earpiece) I can't say that, it's ridiculous.
Cerise: (through the earpiece) Trust me, nothing is more powerful than a lie.
Chloé: (whispering) Obviously. (to the camera) Power must return to the people! And I am of the people, which is why, as of today, the super-offenders Monarch, Ladybug, and Cat Noir are outlawed.
