title: Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript
text:
Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript - Intro
[ Theme Song ]
(A news broadcast from Paris plays on a screen in the room. André is seen handing out ice cream to customers near the Eiffel Tower.)
Nadja: It's the first day of summer break in Paris.
(Denis Damoclès closes the door of Collège Françoise Dupont. Election posters for the two candidates, Caline Bustier and Armand D'Argencourt are displayed by the stairs.)
Nadja: Classes are barely over and the campaign for the mayoral election has already begun.
(Caline hands out campagin flyers to Parisians with the help of Gisèle, Mylène Haprèle and Ivan Bruel.)
Nadja: Tourists have already started arriving from all around the world to savor a taste of Paris, taking advantage of the good weather and making great memories in the company of family and friends.
(Customers are gathered in front of Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie. In another shot, many people are shown spending time in a park.)
Nadja: Good weather also prevails in London, where Adrien Agreste and Kagami Tsurugi arrived yesterday. According to a stateman from the Gabriel brand, the couple will be pursuing their successful modelling careers there.

title: Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript
text:
Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript - Intro
(Photos of Adrien and Kagami leaving their private jets, surrounded by reporters and adoring fans are shown.)
Nadja: A story by our correspondent in the UK right after this message.
(An advertisement featuring Adrien and Kagami begins to play.)
Ad voice: For flawless skin and flushing out toxins.
(The real Kagami throws one of her sneakers at the screen in frustration.)
Ad voice: Perfection — the drink that hydrates... to perfection.
(Gabriel Agreste is on call with Tomoe Tsurugi. He monitors all the rooms in the London lab, including those where Adrien and Kagami are staying, using a camera system.)
Gabriel: Now that our children are safe in London, we can launch the Perfect Alliance.
Tomoe: One day, they'll understand that we did this all for their own good. Take care of the poison while I prepare the remedy.
Gabriel: Nooroo, dark wings rise! (Transforms into Monarch.)
Monarch: (Turns a butterfly into a Megakuma.) Dark wings fall. (Detransforms.)
Gabriel: Akumatize me, dear Megakuma!
(The Megakuma infects Gabriel's Alliance ring. He becomes Nightormentor.)

title: Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript
text:
Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript - Intro
Nightormentor: Mullo, Orikko, Kaalki, your powers are now mine. (Absorbs them using his blowpipe.) Sublimation! I choose the power to fly. (Touches his torso with the orange energy orb around his hand created by the superpower.) Multitude! (Splits into 42 clones.) Voyage!
(Nightormentor's clones teleport to large cities all over the globe. Using their abilities, they spread nightmare dust over the cities in flight.)
Nightormentor: After spreading bad dream dust all across the world, I will awaken the dormant nightmares in each human's mind!
(He finishes spreading the dust.)
Nightormentor: Voyage! (Teleports back to his lair.) Fall in! (Merges with all his clones to become one person again, then breaks out of his akumatization.)
Gabriel: (Walks back to the holographic screen.) The nightmare has begun.
Tomoe: And our wish to bring our children together can finally come true.
(Marinette, dressed in a red knight armor with black polka dots, drives up to the Agreste mansion's gate on her scooter. She speaks to the camera at the gate.)
Marinette: I want to see Adrien!
Gabriel: (through the camera) You'll have nothing more to do with my son!

title: Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript
text:
Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: We'll see about that! (Grabs her sword and breaks down the gate with it.) I'm coming, Adrien!
(Tall, thick, thorny vines spring out from the mansion all the way into the clouds. Marinette finds Adrien tied up at the top.)
Marinette: Adrien! I'm going to save you!
(A large dragon appears and attacks Marinette with a gust of flames. The girl fights back and defeats it. The dragon turns out to be Gabriel Agreste akumatized. He detransforms and falls onto the vine, unconscious.)
Marinette: Mr. Agreste? (Trips.) WOAH! (Falls over and accidentally touches Gabriel with her sword, making him disintegrate.)
Adrien: Father, NO! (crying) Why did you do that, Marinette?
Marinette: (Wakes up in a panic.) Adrien! I have to free him from the dragon, I mean– from his father! Gah!
Tikki: He's in London now, Marinette. Remember?
(Marinette experiences a sudden headache as the background flashes purple.)
Tikki: What's happening?
Marinette: Tikki, I need to find out where Mr. Agreste has sent Adrien. I need to free him, I mean... to talk to him. (Experiences another sudden ache.) At least to make sure that he's okay... (Grabs her phone and dials Adrien's number.)

title: Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript
text:
Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: (pre-recorded voice) Hey! This is Adrien's voicemail. Leave a message.
(Marinette hangs up and sees no new calls from Adrien. Then, a pop-up with Tsurugi Industries' logo appears on her screen.)
Marinette: What? (Opens it.)
(The pop-up turns out to be another advertisement with Adrien and Kagami, this time, for a perfume.)
Ad voice: Use Perfection, the fragrance.
Tikki: His father won't tell you a thing, will he?
Marinette: He won't, but maybe his assistant Nathalie will. Adrien told me that she was always kind to him. Let's go and talk to her.
Marinette: (Runs downstairs and passes by her parents watching TV on the way.) I have an errand to do. See you later!
Tom: (Blocks the door.) A-Aren't you going to eat something before you leave?
Marinette: I'm not feeling very hungry, dad.
Sabine: (Puts her hand on her husband's shoulder.) It's understandable that Marinette would have a poor appetite after Adrien's departure.
Tom: But breakfast is the most important meal of the day! (Pulls out an enormous bag filled with croissants.)
Marinette: Oh no, no, no, no, no, no, don't worry, I– (Experiences another flash of pain and grabs her head.)

title: Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript
text:
Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript - Intro
(Tom and Sabine look at their daughter with concern.)
Marinette: This has... nothing to do with Adrien. I'm fine! I promise. Besides, he's just in London, he's probably doing great, there's no reason to worry. I was just heading out to meet up with my friends. (Takes the bag of croissants from her dad.) And that mountain of croissants comes at a perfect time. Love you both! (Walks out.)
(Marinette's parents follow her outside and watch as she leaves from the top of the staircase.)
Tom: (Grabs his head in pain.) Ah, I've gotta tell you, I had the most horrible nightmare. Marinette was so sad that Adrien was gone that she stopped eating! And she became so teeny, teeny-tiny that a mouse gobbled her up!
Sabine: I had a nightmare too! You were so worried about Marinette that you were akumatized into Werebaker! You trapped Marinette inside a giant brioche and an army of croissants had to protect her!
(The pair hugs.)
(As Marinette walks outside, she bumps into Alya and drops her croissant bag.)

title: Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript
text:
Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript - Intro
Alya: Marinette! I've gotta hide at your place! Monarch is about to find me and I'm terrified I'm gonna blab your– (Gasps and grabs her head.) Your secret identity! Oh no, it'll be even worse if I hide at your place. (Grabs her head again and falls down on the ground in pain.)
Marinette: Are you okay, Alya?
Alya: Yeah, it's just that... we can't be seen together! (Runs off.)
Marinette: Aly– AAH! (Winces in pain.) Tikki, I... I can't think... AH!
(Tikki looks on, worried.)
Marinette: I just... need to talk to Nathalie... (Picks up the croissant bag.) Once I know Adrien is fine, we'll go see Alya. (Stuffs the bag into the basket on the back of her scooter.)
(Tikki sees a hole exposing the contents of the bag and enters the basket. Marinette puts on her helmet and drives away.)
(Adrien, akumatized into Anticat, sits on the ground holding a dead Ladybug. The sky is red, the moon is shattered in half, the city razed to the ground and every citizen turned into stone.)
Anticat: I've destroyed everything... it's my fault.
Monarch: (telepathically) Anticat, there is only one way to repair all of this. You're going to give me Ladybug's Miraculous... and yours.

title: Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript
text:
Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: (Wakes up.) NO! (Hyperventilates.)
Adrien: (on the camera footage) Open the door, NOW! (Bangs on the door of his room.) LET ME OUT!
Gabriel: It's time to begin distribution of the antidote to these nightmares.
Adrien: (on the camera footage) Open the door!
Tomoe: (Scans her handprint on her console, then presses a button.) The process has launched.
(On the map of the world displayed in front of her, a meter begins filling up.)
(From the wall, an assistant robot emerges.)
Adrien: OPEN THE DOOR!
(A compartment inside the robot opens. There is a small box with the Gabriel brand logo on it inside. Adrien walks up and opens the box. Inside is an Alliance ring. The teen turns it on.)
Alliance Kagami: We all have nightmares.
Alliance Adrien: We all have fears.
Alliance Kagami: Unfortunately, these negative emotions can lead to the worst.
Ad voice: After months of research, Tsurugi Labs have found the antidote. The Perfect Alliance app will allow you to find inner peace thanks to relaxing activities proposed by Kagami and Adrien.
Alliance Kagami and Adrien: Whatever your level of anxiety, you'll find serenity again with us.

title: Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript
text:
Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript - Intro
Ad voice: To download your app for free, say "Perfect Alliance".
(Adrien grabs his head in pain, then tries putting the ring on. He stops halfway through.)
Adrien: This is insane! My father is out of control! (Throws the Alliance on the floor.)
Plagg: That is a pretty accurate description of your father, yes. What are you waiting for? Transform and get out there! Besides, we'll never find any cheese here.
Adrien: (whispers) Plagg, hide! There are cameras everywhere!
Plagg: Relax. May I remind you that kwamis cannot be filmed or have their voices recorded?
(Plagg sticks his tongue out, makes weird faces and shakes his butt in front of the camera. On Gabriel's view, he isn't visible.)
Adrien: (Grabs his head.) But my father could hear or see me transform into you-know-who!
Plagg: Hmm... (Flies into the wall and disables the room's cameras.) There! No cameras, no problem.
Gabriel: Tsurugi-san, could you activate the camera on the robot in my son's room?
Plagg: Shall we?
Adrien: No, Plagg.

title: Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript
text:
Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript - Intro
(The robot drives up to Adrien. Its built-in camera turns on. Adrien becomes visible once more. The compartment with the Alliance opens up again, with a new ring. Adrien takes the ring and turns it on.)
Ad voice: To download your app for free, say "Perfect Alliance".
(Adrien turns the ring's volume up, then covers the robot's camera with the ring.)
Ad voice: To download your app for free, say "Perfect Alliance".
(Irritated, Gabriel turns off his display's sound.)
Ad voice: (repeating) To download your app for free, say "Perfect Alliance".
Adrien: (Covers his ears.) I cannot transform... (Looks at his ring and tries taking it off.)
Plagg: What are you doing?!
Adrien: I'm not in my right mind. I'm too angry — at myself for falling short of Marinette's love, at my father for sending me  here in London, at this stupid app and these rings that use my image... it makes me sick! This nightmare is giving me the horrible feeling that, if I transform, I'll get akumatized and destroy everything with my Cataclysm — Marinette, Ladybug... (Takes off the ring and hands it to Plagg.)
Plagg: Surely Ladybug can help you.

title: Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript
text:
Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: If I ask her for help, I'd have to give her information that would jeopardize my secret identity... and I can't.
(Plagg grabs the ring.)
Adrien: We'll see each other again, my friend. I know it. In the meantime, the only thing I can do is not get akumatized.
(Plagg flies out of the room through the vent.)
Adrien: (Defeated, finally puts on the Alliance.) Perfect Alliance.
Alliance Kagami: Adrien, focus on the thing you like the most — the soothing, peaceful sound of the foils brushing against one another.
(On his cameras, Gabriel sees both Adrien and Kagami on their beds, using the Perfect Alliance app. Their stress levels are being measured.)
Tomoe: The stimuli that Adrien is receiving on his ring are relaxing his nervous system. The images he's watching are now associated with the feeling of well-being. He's forgetting all about the nightmares he'd previously been obsessing about. Soon he'll calm down and later, fall sound asleep.
Gabriel: Perfect Alliance is a success, dear Tsurugi-san.

title: Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript
text:
Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript - Intro
(Marinette arrives on her scooter and parks next to trash cans. She opens the basket. Inside, Tikki has eaten all the croissants and relaxes. Marinette smiles at her, then hides inside a trash can.)
Tikki: Marinette, wait! You know that using your superpowers for personal reasons has never brought you any luck.
Marinette: It isn't personal this time, it's for Adrien. Tikki, spots on. (Transforms.)
(Ladybug swings over the fence and inside the mansion with her yo-yo.)
Alliance Kagami: We all have nightmares.
Alliance Adrien: We all have fears.
Alliance Kagami: Unfortunately, these negative emotions can lead to the worst.
Ad voice: After months of research, Tsurugi Labs have found the antidote.
(Nathalie looks around to see Perfect Alliance ads displayed everywhere. The messages keep repeating. Suddenly, a giant Monarch appears in front of her.)
Monarch: (Laughs.) Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous are finally mine! At last, I can make my wish!
(The two Miraculous merge together. A white ball of energy erups from them and consumes the entire city.)

title: Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript
text:
Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript - Intro
Nathalie: (Wakes up in a panic, then grabs her tablet and turns on its recording feature.) Adrien, when I'm no longer here– (Grabs her head.) ...Your mother told me, one day, when your father hired me, aagh...
(A Tsurugi Industries pop-up appears on the screen.)
Ad voice: After months of research, Tsurugi Labs have found the antidote–
Nathalie: (Swipes the pop-up away.) He's going to finally do it...
(The woman looks to the crossbow on the wall in her room. With great difficulty, she walks towards it and takes it with her.)
(Ladybug looks at a photo of herself (Marinette) with Adrien with a sad expression. She hears mechanical noises. Through a crack in the door, she watches Nathalie walk downstairs, crossbow in hand.)
(Plagg flies away from London with the Cat Miraculous.)
(Tom and Sabine relax with the Perfect Alliance app.)
Alliance Adrien: That feeling when you're kneading dough... making bread relaxes me so much.
Tom: See, Sabine? I always told you that Adrien would make a great baker...
Sabine: Yes, you're right, Tom, and Kagami is very gifted too...
Tom and Sabine: Adrien and Kagami really form a perfect alliance...

title: Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript
text:
Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript - Intro
Plagg: If I'd known it'd take so long, I would've made myself a cheese sandwich for the voyage!
(Ladybug enters Nathalie's bedroom to investigate. She looks at the explorer outfit in its glass display case, then at an old photo of Gabriel, Nathalie and Émilie on an expedition. She realizes the outfit is the same one worn by Nathalie in the picture.)
Ladybug: Nathalie?
(Plagg finally arrives in the city.)
(Plagg looks through the living room window, but only finds Tom and Sabine hypnotized by the Perfect Alliance app.)
Plagg: Drat, where is she?
Plagg: Marinette? Marinette! (Comes across a photo of Marinette with her friends on the Liberty. He chooses to head there.)
(The meter on the screen in Tomoe's lair is nearly full.)
Tomoe: Eighty procent of the Alliance users have already downloaded the app.
Gabriel: Good, let's move on to the next phase.
Tomoe: I recommend that we wait until as many users as possible are dependent on the antidote before we deprive them of it. Otherwise, the shock won't be great enough to provoke the next phase of the plan.
(Plagg arrives to find Marinette's friends laying on hammocks and couches, all focused on their Perfect Alliance apps.)
Plagg: Ah, Alya!

title: Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript
text:
Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript - Intro
Alya's Alliance Kagami: As proven by our investigative journalism, there isn't any problem anywhere, is there, Adrien?
Alya's Alliance Adrien: Not a single one. Everything's fine, Kagami.
(Mylène stumbles onto the boat.)
Mylène: Friends, I had an awful nightmare. All the trees on Earth had been uprooted by extraterrestrials. What if it was a prophetic dream? What if the world is in danger?
Nino: Put this on, Mylène. (Holds up an Alliance ring.) You'll feel better.
Mylène: I refuse to touch an object that was made without respect for the Earth's resources. Besides, these rings broadcast bogus images of Kagami and Adrien. (Spots Ivan using one of them.) Ivan! What's gotten into you?
Ivan: I had a horrible nightmare that you were leaving me to go take care of a polar bear whose habitat was threatened.
Mylène: I'd never leave you! You're my teddy bear! (Hugs him.) Come on, you can take that ring off.
(Ivan takes his Alliance off, but his nightmare instantly returns.)
Ivan: No! I'm sorry, I can't!
Mylène: (Looks at him, stumped.) Hey, wake up people, that thing's got you all hypnotized!

title: Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript
text:
Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript - Intro
Alya: The ring isn't our enemy, Mylène. True, the app is lame, but Gabriel Agreste is like us, he's just looking for a way to help Ladybug and Cat Noir.
Nino: It makes you chillax. You forget all about your nightmares, your negative emotions. I can see you're stressed out. Put it on, and then no more risk of you being akumatized.
(Mylène hesitates, but once her nightmare causes her pain again, she gives in.)
Mylène: If this means fighting against Monarch... (Turns the Alliance on.)
Mylène's Alliance Adrien: Kagami, how about a walk in the forest?
Tomoe: Ninety-nine percent download. We may begin, Gabriel.
Gabriel: Nooroo, dark–
(An alarm goes off in Gabriel's lair.)
Gabriel: Give me a minute.
(Gabriel runs in and turns four switches on Émilie's cryogenic pod back on. He stands in front of the pod and speaks to his wife one last time.)
Gabriel: Émilie... I've given up on everything. My dreams, my ambitions, my morality. But I never gave up on you, my love. I only have a few hours left now... but nothing will stop me from seizing Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous. I will unite the magic jewels so I can make the wish that will bring you back to me.

title: Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript
text:
Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript - Intro
(The bushes behind Gabriel rustle. Nathalie comes out of hiding, pointing her crossbow at Gabriel.)
Nathalie: I can't let you do that... if you make the wish to bring her back, someone will have to go in her place. Émilie would never have agreed to this!
Gabriel: Do you think I'd be monstrous enough to sacrifice a human being? This is terrible! All these years working together and you really think that I'm a monster?
(Gabriel walks towards Nathalie. She backs off, terrified. He smiles at her compassionately, but suddenly....)
Gabriel: Nooroo, dark wings rise!
(Gabriel becomes Monarch and knocks the crossbow out of his assistant's hands. She loses her strength and faints. The supervillain picks her up and takes her with him.)
Monarch: There's nothing you can do to stop me now.
(Ladybug looks through the drawers. She takes out a tablet and turns it on.)
Ladybug: The tablet stolen from Master Fu?
(The superheroine walks over to the bed and picks up Nathalie's tablet instead. She opens a random folder and finds scans of pages from the Miraculous spellbook as well as information about Miraculous holders whose identities were revealed in "Miracle Queen".)
Ladybug: It can't be...

title: Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript
text:
Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript - Intro
(The door opens. Monarch walks inside and places Nathalie down on the bed. Ladybug observes them from hiding.)
Monarch: Dark wings fall. (Detransforms.)
(Ladybug gasps when she sees her greatest enemy is the famous fashion designer.)
Gabriel: I knew that you would betray me, Nathalie. I was prepared.
Ladybug: (typed message) Cat Noir, Gabriel Agreste is Monarch. I'm waiting for you at his place. We'll only have a shot if we fight him together.
Gabriel: I knew it as soon as I realized that you were instigating Adrien's defiance. When you started insidiously supporting his ridiculous fling with Marinette Dupain-Cheng.
(Ladybug looks angered and determined. She prepares to hit 'Send' on the message.)
Gabriel: You will be loyal to me until the end, after all.
(Nathalie grabs her head in pain.)
Gabriel: (Puts an Alliance on her ring and turns on the Perfect Alliance app.) As for the rest, let bygones be bygones. Just think of it as a horrible nightmare. You can relax now... (Walks out.)
Ladybug: (Walks up and takes off the ring from Nathalie's finger.) Where is Adrien Agreste, what have you done with him?!

title: Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript
text:
Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript - Intro
Nathalie: He is safe, but you aren't. (Coughs.) The whole world is in danger. Monarch is about to send all of humankind after you and Cat Noir. (Ladybug gasps in shock and Nathalie coughs.) He can't get ahold of your Miraculous...
Ladybug: You don't look well. I'll take you to the hospital!
Nathalie: (Grabs Ladybug's hand.) I am beyond... all medicine. (Coughs.) I used the Miraculous of the Peacock while it was still damaged (Ladybug looks in shock upon learning that Nathalie was Mayura.) and... and soon I will... (Coughs strongly.)
(Nathalie pulls out a phone from underneath her pillow and shows Ladybug a photo of Émilie.)
Nathalie: Stop Monarch at all costs. That's what she would have wanted...
(Ladybug is mortified.)
Nathalie: Transform back, transform back! (Closes her eyes.)
Ladybug: What? Why? Wake up! Wake up! ''(Tries to wake up Nathalie, to no avail.)
Gabriel: Nooroo, dark wings rise! (Transforms into Monarch.)
Monarch: Proceed to the next phase of the plan.
(Tomoe scans her handprint once more, then presses a different button. The world map turns red.)
(Tom's Perfect Alliance app turns red. Avatars of Ladybug and Cat Noir interrupt.)

title: Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript
text:
Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript - Intro
Alliance Cat Noir: So you two think you can do better than us?!
Alliance Ladybug: You think your Perfect Alliance is stronger against Akumas than Cat Noir and Ladybug?!
(The superheroes drag Kagami and Adrien away.)
Alliance Adrien: Help! Please save us!
Alliance Kagami: Please, leave us alone!
(Every Alliance ring in the world turns off.)
Ivan: No! Mylène, I'm scared!
(As the teenagers try to turn their rings back on, a sudden news report is broadcasted.)
Nadja: Don't be bemused, it's just the news. Ladybug and Cat Noir have just abducted Adrien Agreste and Kagami Tsurugi, the perfect couple!
(The friends all fall into despair and grab their heads.)
Rose: There's nothing left to protect us from being akumatized now!
Alya: Ladybug would never do that! (Takes off her Alliance.)
Kim: You saw what we all saw!
Alya: Trust me, we all know Ladybug because she saved each and every one of us at least once! We all owe something to Ladybug and we know she would never kidnap anyone, and neither would... (Notices Plagg on the ship.) Cat Noir?
(Plagg gestures to Alya with the ring.)

title: Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript
text:
Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript - Intro
Monarch: I carefully held onto the Magical Charm that your guardian, Ladybug, had entrusted to Gabriel Agreste... (Places the charm on a special pad on his control board.) unaware that he was me. And the Cataclysm that your friend, Cat Noir, inflicted on me won't have served only to destroy me in the end. (Places his exposed left hand on a second scanning pad.)
Tomoe: The Cataclysm dust and the Magical Charm has provided us Ladybug and Cat Noir's quantum imprint.
(The two pads scan the Charm and Gabriel's hand.)
Monarch: Such irony... they've personally provided me with the weapons to defeat them. Transfer!
(Every Kwami's magic is absorbed through tubes into the control board. Tomoe presses a third button. Around the world, Alliance rings turn back on.)
Alliance Gabriel: Hello, I am Gabriel Agreste, designer of Alliance and father to Adrien. My son and his friend Kagami are victims of Ladybug and Cat Noir. If you want to help me save them, say "Alliance, Miraculize me!"
(The rings turn off.)
Ivan: Alliance, Miraculize me!
(Ivan is engulfed in a black-purple ether and becomes Miraculized.)

title: Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript
text:
Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript - Intro
Alya: Take off your rings! It's a trap from Monarch, he's found a way to take control of Alliance!
Mylène: Ivan!
Miraculized Ivan: Join me, Mylène! Let's find Ladybug and Cat Noir and free our friends! (Makes a few punching motions.)
Mylène: Ivan, take off your ring!
Nino: Wait up, dude!
(Nino, Kim and Nathaniel begin struggling with their Miraculized friend. Alya uses the opportunity to run to the back of the ship and meet up with Plagg.)
Alya: (whispering) Where's Ladybug and why aren't you with Cat Noir?
Plagg: Precisely! Would you agree to be my temporary holder?
Alya: (whispering) Doesn't feel like I really have a choice here, do I? Wait! What if I get akumatized? I know who Ladybug is and– (Grabs her head.) I keep having this haunting nightmare where I gave up the Miraculous to Monarch. Besides, with Cat Noir's powers, I could...
Plagg: I know, destroy the world, bla-bla-bla. I better find Ladybug then, and quick!
Alya: I could help you if I still had a phone to call Marinette.
Plagg: Well, alright then, it shall be Plagg alone versus the rest of the world! (Flies away.)
Ladybug: (Tries calling Cat Noir on her bugphone.) Pick up, please!

title: Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript
text:
Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: (pre-recorded voice) Voicemail! Meow!
Ladybug: Cat Noir, I need you right now! I'm at–
(Another alarm blares. The windows of the room are closed with metal plates as part of the mansion's security system. Before they fully close, Ladybug catches a glimpse of some Miraculized on rooftops by the mansion.)
Tomoe: Ladybug and Cat Noir's quantum imprint detector activated.
(White beams of light are emitted from the Miraculized's Alliance rings. They all point to Nathalie's room.)
Unnamed Miraculized: Ladybug's in there!
Tomoe: A Ladybug imprint has been detected in your home, Gabriel!
Monarch: Ah, she's probably trying to flee from the Miraculized by hiding here. How very ironic.
(Voyage portals open all around Ladybug.)
Miraculized: Release them! Ladybug! Release them! Where are Kagami and Adrien?!
Ladybug: What?
Unnamed Miraculized 1: Venom!
Unnamed Miraculized 2: Clout!
Ladybug: What on earth are you talking about?
(Ladybug fends off the supervillains' attacks. More portals open behind her.)
Miraculized: Ladybug, where are Kagami and Adrien?! Release them!
(Ladybug is surrounded.)
Monarch: You're trapped, Ladybug. In a moment, your Miraculous will be mine.

title: Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript
text:
Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript - Intro
Tomoe: I can't detect any imprint for Cat Noir. She is alone.
Monarch: That will make things even easier.
Miraculized: (repeating) Where are Kagami and Adrien?! Release them! Ladybug, release them!
(Ladybug fights off the attacks of the Miraculized army. She drops the chandelier in the room on them, then escapes into the hall.)
Plagg: (Spots the Miraculized all heading to the Agreste mansion.) Ah, there! At least you can always count on the villains to find the superheroes. (Flies through one of the Voyage portals into the mansion hall.)
(Plagg hides near the staircase. Ladybug runs from the Miraculized, struggling to hold them off.)
Miraculized: (repeating) Ladybug, release them! Where are Kagami and Adrien?!
(As Ladybug closes the door of a room filled with her enemies, she remembers Nathalie's last words.)
Nathalie: (flashback) Transform back!
Ladybug: Of course! (Swings away and runs into the kitchen.)
Ladybug: (Runs in and hides in one of the cupboards.) Spots off. (Detransforms.)
(The white trails leading to the mansion all disappear.)
Unknown voice: Quantum imprint lost.
Miraculized: Where'd she go? Where did she go? Where is she? (All teleport away.)

title: Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript
text:
Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript - Intro
(Marinette and Tikki look at each other, concerned.)
Monarch: Hah... hah... Ladybug is still here, I can feel it! She must have transformed back! She's vulnerable! (to Tomoe) Make sure that the others keep looking for Cat Noir, I'm going to give a personal, proper welcome to Ladybug. After all, I am her host. But before I meet her, you, nice Kwamis, are going to give me the power to fight her and make me invulnerable! Stompp, your power is now mine! (Absorbs the Kwami into his Ox Miraculous ring.)
Monarch: (Teleports in.) Oh, LADYBUG!
Marinette: (Feeds Tikki.) I can't get ahold of Cat Noir or transform... (Grabs her head in pain.)
Monarch: (from the hall) Ladybug!
Monarch: Where are you? (Walks to the dining room.)
(Plagg flies into the kitchen.)
(As Plagg enters the cupboard, the ring can't pass through the door with him, so it falls on the ground.)
(Monarch hears the ring dropping and stops.)
Plagg: Sorry...
Marinette: Where's Cat Noir?
Plagg: He fell victim to that wretched Alliance ring. What are you doing here?
Marinette: This is where Monarch lives.

title: Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript
text:
Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)/Transcript - Intro
(Plagg reacts with shock and fear. He looks at Tikki, who just nods. Marinette slightly opens the cupboard door and picks up the Cat Miraculous off the floor. Marinette puts it on but notices the cupboard door abruptly opened, much to her shock. Marinette gets dragged out by Monarch as Tikki becomes very worried while Plagg gives a glaring look on his face.)
Monarch: Found you! (Marinette, determined looks back at Monarch with a smirk, and Monarch is in shock when he finds out who Ladybug is) Marinette Dupain-Cheng?!
Marinette: No. Tikki, Plagg, unify! (She kicks Monarch in the face, flips back, and stands up.)
[Transformation Sequence]
Bug Noire: Call me Bug Noire.

title: Colt Fathom
text:
Colt Fathom - Intro
was a posthumous antagonist of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He was an American billionaire, the father of Félix Fathom, and the husband of British aristocrat Lady Amélie Graham de Vanily.
In "Representation", it is revealed that Colt was a temporary Peacock Miraculous holder, having been lent the brooch for a one-time use by his co-brother-in-law, Gabriel Agreste in exchange for the employment of one of his best men. He used his own feelings of jealousy towards Gabriel and Émilie to create his son Félix and have Amélie pregnant with him. However, after using the damaged Peacock Miraculous, Colt developed the same illness as his sister-in-law and ending up passing away not long after she became comatose.

title: Colt Fathom
text:
Colt Fathom - Appearance
Physical appearance
If Félix and Kagami's depiction of Colt's physical appearance is accurate, then it's safe to say that he had a big bushy moustache.
Civilian attire
If Félix and Kagami's depiction of Colt's civilian attire is accurate, then it's safe to say that he wore a brown cowboy hat with a dark brown band around the crown and a vest he kept unbuttoned. He also wore a ring on his left ring finger.
Peacock Miraculous holder
If Félix and Kagami's depiction of Colt as a Peacock Miraculous holder is accurate, then it's safe to say that he would have had a blue suit and a blue cowboy hat with the Peacock Miraculous attached to the band.

title: Colt Fathom
text:
Colt Fathom - Personality
Félix's father, Colt, was a difficult and controlling man, even more so than Gabriel and Tomoe were with their children. He was wealthy and, as depicted in a play by Kagami and Félix, treated his wife Amélie poorly, having forced her into the marriage for the sake of wealth and lineage. Colt was extremely proud and elitist, looking down on those he considered beneath him, including Émilie and Gabriel. He desperately wanted an heir, and his inability to conceive a child with Amélie fueled a bitter jealousy towards his sister-in-law and her husband.
Despite his aversion to magic, Colt eventually used the Peacock Miraculous to create Félix. However, he felt no love for his son. When the use of the Miraculous resulted in a fatal illness for Colt, he blamed Félix for his condition, fostering a deep hatred towards him. He then exerted complete control over Félix, stripping him of anything that brought him joy. Like Gabriel and Chloé, Colt refused to take responsibility for his own actions and instead projected blame onto others.

title: Colt Fathom
text:
Colt Fathom - Personality
Colt's disdain for magic was significant. Even when Gabriel offered a magical solution to his desire for a child, Colt viewed it with disgust, hesitant even to touch Amélie's pregnant belly after using the Miraculous. This aversion to magic further contributed to his resentment of Félix.

title: Colt Fathom
text:
Colt Fathom - Abilities
As a civilian
Colt was a very talented businessman, which allowed him to acquire a great fortune and status to satisfy his thirst for power. It seemed that part of his business activities were oriented towards war, particularly in military weapon construction and potentially mercenaryism.
As a Peacock Miraculous holder
The Peacock Miraculous granted him enhanced physical abilities, a hand fan as his tool, and Amokization as his superpower, allowing him to manifest emotions of himself or others into physical form to create sentimonsters. After amokizing his ring to create his son, he used it to physically, bodily, and telepathically abuse and control Félix until his death.

title: Colt Fathom
text:
Colt Fathom - Relationships
Amélie Graham de Vanily
Not much is known about Colt's relationship with his wife. However, in "Representation", according to her son Félix, Colt married Amélie because her parents arranged it, as they wanted her to marry an affluent man who came from a high position of status, unlike her sister Émilie, who married Gabriel, a low-class tailor who was beneath her social standing. Amélie only accepted his hand to please them, and in Félix's play, Colt was seen excited by his marriage, unlike Amélie, however it was unclear if he felt any love for his wife. As they were unable to have children, Colt used the Peacock Miraculous to get his wife pregnant with Félix. It is unknown if she ever knew about his abuse towards their son. It's also implied that Colt was abusive towards Amélie as Félix narrated, "if he became a fond of anyone who displeases his father", and it showed an arm of a stuffed bunny being ripped and in "Gabriel Agreste", Amélie also wore a bunny mask in the party.
Félix Fathom
It was revealed that Colt passed away around the same time his sister-in-law, Émilie, fell into a coma, due to using the broken Peacock Miraculous and the Agrestes didn't attend his funeral.

title: Colt Fathom
text:
Colt Fathom - Relationships
However, in "Pretension", while protecting Kagami from her akumatized mother, he mentioned to her that his father was "a thousand times worse" than Tomoe is to her.
In "Representation", through a play, Félix revealed to Marinette that his father didn't love him. His father created him from his jealousy towards Émilie and Gabriel, and blamed Félix for his worsening illness from using the damaged Peacock Miraculous. Colt was abusive towards Félix, calling him a "monster", actively using his Amokized ring to control Félix like a puppet and destroying anything that would make Félix happy. During one of these moments, Colt slammed his fist against the wall with enough pressure to make it crack and cause Félix pain. When Colt passed away, Félix took the ring, gaining his freedom and motivating him to free oppressed people like Adrien and Kagami from their controlling and abusive parents.
Gabriel Agreste

title: Colt Fathom
text:
Colt Fathom - Relationships
In "Representation", through a play, it's revealed that Colt despised and looked down on Gabriel for his common background; calling him the inferior tailor Émilie choose to give up her rank, wealth, and family for. When Colt heard Gabriel and Émilie were able to conceive their son, Adrien, he seethed and even confronted Gabriel as he believed he and Amélie were the ones who truly deserved a child, not the other way around. Émilie had Gabriel lent the Peacock Miraculous for her sister and brother-in-law to have a child. Gabriel gave Colt the Miraculous in exchange for his best man - Placide I.T. - to protect his child. At first, Colt refused, but eventually used it to create Félix out of his jealousy.
Émilie Agreste
In "Representation", through a play, it's revealed that Colt detested Émilie and called her the "curious and futile sister" who'd gave up her rank, wealth, and family to marry Gabriel, the "inferior tailor". He was jealous that Émilie and Gabriel were able to conceive Adrien before he and Amélie could conceive Félix.
Adrien Agreste

title: Colt Fathom
text:
Colt Fathom - Relationships
Not much is revealed on the relationship between Colt and Adrien, though the latter apologized to Félix for not being able to attend the former's funeral, due to Émilie falling into a coma around the same time. It is possible that Colt despised his nephew as much as his son, but never showed that hatred when they interacted.
Emil and Milly Graham de Vanily
Through a play in "Representation", because of his wealth and status, Amélie's parents arranged their marriage and also wanted the two to have a child. Due to his wife's infertility, they were given the best medical treatments by them, but nothing worked.
Placide I.T.
Through a play in  "Representation", Placide I.T. worked for Colt and was his best man before his employment was traded to Gabriel Agreste in exchange for being lent the Peacock Miraculous to create a child for himself.
Duusu
Through a play in "Representation", despite Colt's disdain for sorcery, he temporary used her power to create Félix out of his jealousy. However, due to the Peacock Miraculous being broken at the time, it slowly took its toll on Colt.

title: Colt Fathom
text:
Colt Fathom - Relationships
It is possible that Colt blamed Duusu as much as he blamed Félix for his illness. But since he only had the Peacock Miraculous temporarily, he was unable to use it to mistreat her.

title: Colt Fathom
text:
Colt Fathom - Trivia
In "Félix", it was mentioned that his funeral was after Émilie's.
Later, in "Multiplication", it was revealed by Ladybug that he died a year prior to the events of the episode.
In "Pretension", Félix mentioned to Kagami that his father was "a thousand times" worse than Tomoe Tsurugi.
In "Representation", he is referred to as a wealthy and heartless warlord, implying that he made his fortune by developing military weaponry.
His given name could possibly be a reference to Samuel Colt, an American industrialist, businessman, and the inventor of the revolver.
In "Evolution", Gabriel traveled to the past to save Émilie by helping his younger self to fix the damaged Peacock Miraculous. If he had succeeded, he would have saved Colt's life as well.
He is the fourth person from the Western Hemisphere to wield a Miraculous following Micazoyolin, Gilbert du Motier, and La Mariquita.
He is the first human villain to permanently die in the series.

title: Climatiqueen
text:
Climatiqueen - Intro
"" is a season 6 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 1st written and produced episode of season 6. It is also the 132nd written and produced episode of the series overall.

title: Climatiqueen
text:
Climatiqueen - Synopsis
Ladybug and Cat Noir face a villain determined to steal their thunder. Will the superheroes weather the storm?
TFOU
Ladybug and Cat Noir train against an opponent determined to steal the hearts of the Parisians. Superhero storm alert!
Disney+
A storm is headed Ladybug and Cat Noir's way.

title: Climatiqueen
text:
Climatiqueen - Plot
The episode starts with Adrien scrolling through social media. More specifically, on the Zoo app. The videos are of the following: Rose introduces Unipony to her followers, Aurore elaborates on the identity of a cirrostratus cloud relating to a change in the weather, and Chloé announces she will be starting a contest on the Bee community, granting a wish to the Bee who gains the most followers. We then see Alec Cataldi hosting an episode of "One Day, One Passion" all about Gabriel Agreste, re-telling the story of his "heroic sacrifice". Adrien unhappily stops watching and texts Marinette. He lays himself on his bed, and we get to see his bedroom is currently in renovation.
Tikki informs Marinette she received another text from Adrien, watching her holder gather items to be repaired at their respective workshops. Marinette reads Adrien's text and gets determined to come up with an equally sweet reply, but Tikki reminds her she has to go to school. Marinette panics and says she'll figure out something on the way instead.

title: Climatiqueen
text:
Climatiqueen - Plot
At the Agreste Mansion, Adrien is making pancakes for himself and Nathalie, with Plagg adding a little cheese to his. Plagg quickly hides when he hears Nathalie come in, and when Adrien serves the pancakes, Nathalie comments that he did a good job on them, and also tells him that he doesn't need a schedule anymore as he's free to do whatever he wants. He has the choice to do what he wants to now without being told to like when Gabriel was still here. Meanwhile, Marinette arrives outside the mansion, but is quickly swarmed by paparazzi. Luckily for her, Placide intervenes and chases them off with a water hose while she heads inside to meet up with Adrien. Once she meets up with him, she says she got his text message, and responds with kissing him several times. Afterwards, they head out on her scooter to College Francois Dupont. As they make their way there, Adrien mentions not having a passion to pursue. When he asks if she can help him, Marinette happily agrees.

title: Climatiqueen
text:
Climatiqueen - Plot
At school, Aurore is looking over the rankings for Chloé's contest, and sees she's at the bottom of the list. She looks at a video from the person at the top of the list, Diane, and becomes more disheartened. As Marinette and Adrien arrive, Vincent pops out of a trash can to get a scoop, but Marinette tells him off, before Placide arrives to discipline Vincent with spraying him with water. Back with Aurore, her best friend Aglaé arrives to sprinkle some sage on her, explaining that it helps ward off Akumatizations. As they talk, Aurore tells Aglaé that she wants to win a signed copy of Weather From Space from Claudie Kante due to her love of meteorology. However, she starts to cry over fearing she won't win Chloé's contest, and Aglaé tries to reassure her she still has a chance, telling her she just has to remain true to herself and not try to win via dishonest means, like spreading gossip. It appears her encouragement works as Aurore thanks her before walking off.

title: Climatiqueen
text:
Climatiqueen - Plot
As Marinette takes Adrien through several courses at the school to see what would be his passion, with various positive or negative results, Aurore secretly spies on them, takes photos of moments where Adrien and Marinette embarrass themselves, and posts them on Chloé's contest. In doing so, she starts getting likes and moves up in the rankings. At one point, as Adrien and Marinette take a break to talk, Aurore takes their picture and types out a lie suggesting that Adrien and Marinette could be breaking up, which further bumps her up in the rankings to be near the top 20.
Marinette and Adrien attend classes where Adrien excels, such as Japanese and poetry with Ms.
Jinet.
Unfortunately, Marinette struggles in these subjects, and Aurore takes advantage of her success to move up in the rankings.
As Aurore climbs into the top 10, she worries that there is only an hour left before Chloé selects her winner, and she fears she won’t have enough time to secure her spot.
While reviewing the photos she took of Marinette and Adrien, Aurore manages to break into the Top 5 of Chloé's contest.

title: Climatiqueen
text:
Climatiqueen - Plot
However, Diane then enters the scene and showcases a video similar to Aurore's, which receives significantly more likes.
This makes Aurore feel despondent, leading her to retreat to a restroom stall to cry.
With just ten minutes remaining, she is on the verge of giving up.
At that moment, an Ultrakuma flutters in and infects her parasol.
Shortly after, she is contacted by Chrysalis, who offers her the power to gain more followers than anyone else.
After Aurore decides she no longer wants Claudie's signed book and just wants to win Chloé's contest, she agrees to the deal.
She asks to be renamed the more powerful version of Stormy Weather, known as "Climatiqueen," and Chrysalis grants her wish and akumatizes her.
In the cafeteria, Marinette and Adrien are alongside their friends Nino, Alya, Zoé, Mylène, Kim, and Ondine when Aglaé enters, asking about Aurore because she hasn't seen her for a while.
When Kim jokingly suggests that Aurore might be Akumatized, Aglaé panics and sprinkles sage on herself.
Ondine scolds Kim for his poor choice of words.
Mylène helps calm Aglaé down, but then Zoé shows the photos Aurore posted regarding Chloé's contest, which feature Marinette and Adrien.

title: Climatiqueen
text:
Climatiqueen - Plot
As Marinette and Adrien demand to know who posted them, Aglaé deduces that it must have been Aurore.
Suddenly, the sky darkens with storm clouds, and Aurore, now transformed into Climatiqueen, makes her dramatic entrance.
Using her parasol, she starts zapping civilians with lightning, compelling them to mash the like button for her posts so she can win Chloé's contest.
In the cafeteria, Marinette, Adrien, and their fellow Miraculous users flee for cover along with the other students while they try to escort Aglaé to safety.
Once Aglaé is secured in the nurse's office, Marinette excuses herself to retrieve her belongings, giving her an opportunity to find a hiding spot and transform into Ladybug.
Meanwhile, Adrien also excuses himself to get Aglaé some water, but his real intention is to find a place to hide and transform into Cat Noir, despite there being a water faucet and a glass nearby that Aglaé had pointed out.

title: Climatiqueen
text:
Climatiqueen - Plot
As they engage Climatiqueen, she proves to be very powerful, using her cyclones to keep Ladybug and Cat Noir at bay. At one point, she even throws a train at them, but Cat Noir is able to destroy it with Cataclysm as he runs through it before coming out the other side. His extreme behavior with how he is fighting Climatiqueen concerns Ladybug, but he assures her he is just excited to be fighting alongside her to find the Ultrakuma and de-evilize Aurore. Finally, the clock strikes 1:00, and as Climatiqueen checks her cellphone, Chloé declares that she has won the contest. Although she's happy to have won, Climatiqueen refuses to relinquish the Ultrakuma and continues to attack Ladybug and Cat Noir. Finally, Chrysalis contacts Climatiqueen and suggests that, even though she won, why not go further and get more followers than even Chloé? Interested, Aurore agrees to Chrysalis' suggestion, but also agrees to retrieve the Ladybug and Black Cat Miraculous for Chrysalis once she's done, and sets off for the Eiffel Tower.

title: Climatiqueen
text:
Climatiqueen - Plot
Realizing what this could mean if Climatiqueen gets access to the Eiffel Tower's transmitters, Ladybug and Cat Noir shift to their space forms of Astrocat and Cosmobug to pursue Climatiqueen, but she uses her powers to keep them away and buy her time to reach the Eiffel Tower before they can stop her. Knowing they can't chase her in their space forms, Cosmobug contacts Max for help. Detecting the summon from Ladybug, Max has Markov attach to his wrist before having Kaalki transform him into Pegasus. Using Voyage, he arrives to ask Ladybug and Cat Noir for the plan, and they have him provide a Voyage portal to get to the Eiffel Tower before Climatiqueen. Once there, Ladybug tells Cat Noir to Cataclysm the structure to prevent Climatiqueen from using it. Ladybug and Pegasus will rescue all the civilians that are inside when the tower collapses.
When Climatiqueen arrives, she stunned to find Cat Noir beat her there.

title: Climatiqueen
text:
Climatiqueen - Plot
As he gloats that the Miraculers have a network that allows them to always be one step ahead of the Akumatized supervillains, Climatiqueen taunts that she'll still complete her plan and she quickly moves to carry it out, but Cat Noir immediately uses his Cataclysm on the Eiffel Tower, reducing it to rust and causing it to collapse, leaving Climatiqueen to punch through the rusted metal before turning back to scream in horror at her plan being thwarted as the Eiffel Tower collapses, and Ladybug and Pegasus rescue the civvies using Voyage.
Angered at being denied using the tower to get more followers, Climatiqueen prepares to retaliate and attack Cat Noir, but Ladybug uses another of Pegasus' Voyage portals to sneak up on her, disarm her of her parasol by grabbing it with her yo-yo, and then after returning to the ground via the Voyage portal, break the parasol in two, releasing the Ultrakuma.
Climatiqueen reverts back into Aurore, who is then rescued by another Voyage portal, landing safely in Cat Noir's arms, while Ladybug catches the Ultrakuma, purifies it, and then uses her Miraculous Ladybug to restore the Eiffel Tower, the train, and disperse the storm clouds.

title: Climatiqueen
text:
Climatiqueen - Plot
Ladybug, Cat Noir, and Pegasus share a "Pound It" fist bump afterwards for a job well done.
Afterwards, as Chloé reiterates that Aurore won the contest, Aurore doesn't feel too much like celebrating now. When Ladybug, Cat Noir, and Pegasus ask why, she explains why she entered the contest to begin with and what it was she wanted if she won. Stunned and surprised by her reasons, the trio of Miraculous users offer her some words of wisdom, and Ladybug grants her a Magical Charm to protect her. Afterwards, Adrien returns to Aglaé with the water he said he was getting for her, while Marinette returns with all her stuff, saying she got zapped by Climatiqueen, but she's all better now.
Thanks to the encouragement she got from Ladybug, Cat Noir, and Pegasus, Aurore returns to posting videos of her love of meteorology, and shows off a double rainbow that appeared after Ladybug used her Miraculous Ladybug. It is later that she sees herself getting tons of likes from the new community she joined, the Ladybug Community, and one of them is from Max's mom, Claudie, much better than the book she originally wanted.

title: Climatiqueen
text:
Climatiqueen - Plot
In the epilogue, Adrien thanks Marinette for all her help, and decides to find his passion at his own pace. He then leaves to head home, and Marinette, in a surprise move, doesn't decide to chase after him, being commended on her mature move by Tikki. However, when Adrien reaches his house, instead of going in, he starts to go for a run around Paris. It is at this time he's joined by a new student, the para-athlete Sublime Varlette, who sports a pair of prosthetic legs, and the two go for a run together.

title: Climatiqueen
text:
Climatiqueen - Plot developments
Adrien is unsure about what to do now that he is free to do whatever he wants, as all of his previous activities had been imposed to him by his father. It is also revealed that Nathalie arranged for his schedule to be fully open to allow him to do what he wants.
Likewise, his room is revealed to be in renovation with his football table, video games and everything being gone.
Marinette tries to help Adrien to find something that he may enjoy doing, like trying out her own favorite activities or his previous ones with him. Between those activities, they were:
Marinette's activities: Painting, learning science, and baking.
Adrien's activities: Learning Japanese and poetry-making.
At the end of this episode, Adrien discovers his love for running and meets Sublime Varlette, both of whom are later featured in "Sublimation", where it was revealed that she and Adrien had been running partners for some time.
Similar to his father as of "Illusion", Adrien has started to be the one to make breakfast for him and Nathalie. As such, Adrien is revealed to have some culinary skill.

title: Climatiqueen
text:
Climatiqueen - Plot developments
According to Nathalie, his pancakes are much better than Gabriel's, as they are delicious and sweet. This is a nod to how Marinette criticized Gabriel's pancakes for being tasteless back in "Pretension" and also a nod to how Adrien is more caring, sweeter and kinder than the self-oriented Gabriel was.
His skill also extends to baking, according to Marinette later in the episode. She also states his drawing was good for a beginner and Adrien himself is shown to be rather good at poetry (which is revealed to have been one of his former extracurriculars).
It is revealed that there is a new social media called Zoo, where each community inside it is named after the animals of each of the members of the French Miraculous superhero team.
Marinette, Adrien and all the members of the Miraculers are part of the community represented by the animals of their respective Miraculous.
Chloé is part of the Bee Community and uses it to expand her own popularity, even making contests for those of the same community as her, forbidding those from the Ladybug, Goat, Fox, Turtle and Horse (and possibly all the other Communities) from joining.

title: Climatiqueen
text:
Climatiqueen - Plot developments
In this episode, it was revealed that Diane, Nora Césaire and Raymond Pugnant are also part of the Bee Community.
Aurore Beauréal used to be part of the Bee Community. After seeing how her desire for popularity caused her to betray her friends and use their private life to win a contest, she left it and joined the Ladybug Community.
It is revealed that Ondine, Manon, and Kagami have enrolled into Collège Françoise Dupont.
This marks the first time in which Ondine is seen outside of her swimsuit.
There is a new teacher at Collège Françoise Dupoint, Gine Jinet, with her teaching Poetry.
She is in a wheelchair, making her one of the few characters with a disability.
Interestingly, Poetry used to be a subject taught by Caline Bustier when she was a teacher at Françoise Dupoint, meaning this new teacher most likely came to take her place as teacher after she became the mayoress.
Two of Mylène's new pins are the "Progress Pride" flag and a peace sign colored like the rainbow, both symbols of LGBTQ+ identity.

title: Climatiqueen
text:
Climatiqueen - Trivia
Climatiqueen is a portmanteau of the words "climatic" and "queen".
This is the first episode of the second story arc of the Miraculous saga.
It also mirrors the very first episode of the first story arc (and the very first episode of the entire series), by having the same person (Aurore Beauréal) be akumatized by the Butterfly Miraculous holder into a supervillain with weather powers. Many scenes and details in the episode are reminiscent of "Stormy Weather":
Aurore's reason of getting akumatized; joining a contest and eventually losing.
The iconic running up the wall of a building.
Cat Noir giving the akumatized Aurore Beauréal a nickname: "Dramatiqueen". In Stormy Weather, he called her "Ice Queen" instead.
Ladybug using her yoyo to grab onto something and grabbing Cat Noir's tail to prevent him being blown away by one of Aurore's attacks.
Aurore using her wind attacks to launch a vehicle at Ladybug and Cat Noir.
Cat Noir's one-on-one interaction with Aurore while spinning his tail.
Ladybug breaking Aurore's parasol to release the akuma.

title: Climatiqueen
text:
Climatiqueen - Trivia
One of the animations of Ladybug throwing her yoyo is similar to when she threw said weapon around the ice-encased carousel with Alya and Manon inside to try and break it.
Despite being the first episode of the second story arc, there are several clues in this episode and the next two that point out this episode is not the first in the second arc's chronology:
At no point in the episode, was Aurore referred to as the first akumatized victim of the new Butterfly holder, by civilians or the heroes.
Later, in "Wreckless Driver" it's revealed that Aglaé was the first alumatized victim.
Ladybug and Cat Noir are already aware of the Ultrakuma, suggesting they saw them before.
In "The Illustrhater", Alya and Nino interrogated the only persons known to have been akumatized by the new holder at the time: Caline Bustier and Caroline, the latter being akumatized in "Sublimation".
Since Adrien discovers his love for running and meets Sublime by himself, this explains why Marinette didn't know about her in the aforementioned episode.

title: Climatiqueen
text:
Climatiqueen - Trivia
This is the first episode of the entire series in which Gabriel Agreste is physically absent either in his civilian form or with his supervillain alter-egos due to his permanent death after the events of "The Final Day".
However, in addition to being mentioned, he is briefly seen in pictures on Adrien's phone at the beginning of the episode.
Chrysalis' akumatization process is shown and confirms that akumatization process can often vary between Butterfly Miraculous holders:
After her Ultrakuma akumatizes her target's object, she and her target appear in a purple void within the target's mind. Cerise calls them by name (showing that the Butterfly Miraculous is capable of revealing this information) and tempts them into accepting the akuma.
That means Gabriel also knew the names of the victims he akumatized but, like himself, he also encouraged his victims to throw their old names away to symbolize their new ones.
Her victims are the ones to come up with their villain name, after which they transform. She lets them choose their own name to give them the illusion that they are in control and that she only wants to help them.

title: Climatiqueen
text:
Climatiqueen - Trivia
When she manifests in her victims' minds to talk to them, she appears as a blank silhouette with no distinctive male or female features and speaks in a combination of both male and female voices, so that the victims are unable to discover her gender.
This episode marks Vincent Asa's first physical appearance since "Kwamibuster".
In one scene, Vincent emerges from a trash bin with his phone setup and insists Adrien to give him a few words about his father, leading to Marinette quickly rejecting him then dragging Adrien away. This most likely foreshadows the events of "Revelator".
When Adrien watches the video of Aurore's weather facts at the beginning of the episode, the instrumental of the song "Big Bang" by Clara Nightingale can be heard in the background.
Pegasus' transformation sequence has been reanimated.
Before he does his end pose, his poses reference to the video game Just Dance at the bottom right corner of the screen, where mini projections mimic his poses.
On the end card, hearts with all superheroes' icons appear, except Ryuko's, possibly an accidental omission on the part of the staff.

title: Climatiqueen
text:
Climatiqueen - Trivia
The box with objects from Adrien's fourth year from "El Toro De Piedra" can be seen on Marinette's cart with supplies which she pulls throughout the episode, although the other timeline clues place the episodes in the opposite order.
The sage that Aglaé uses repels moths in real life due to its strong aroma, which contains compounds such as camphor and cineole that alter the sensory receptors of these insects.
Errors
In the English dub, when Adrien is making pancakes, Plagg's gasp is retained from the original French version.
Chloé, who's living in London, says that the contest will end at 1pm. However, it ends at 1pm in Paris, in which the timezone is one hour ahead of London's.
When Mylène tries to calm Aglaé down her hair goes through her pins.
When Marinette stammers over her words in the poetry scene, Gine's fingers clip into her pants.
When Diane discovers that Aurore takes part in Chloé's contest, the timer says that it ends in an hour. But when Aurore is in the toilet shortly before her akumatization, it says that the contest ends in ten minutes.
When Nino opens his cellphone, Kim is not wearing his Miraculous.

title: Climatiqueen
text:
Climatiqueen - Trivia
Ladybug and Chloé know Climatiqueen's name even though she never mentioned it.
Despite Max wearing his Markov watch on his right arm in other episodes and the transformation sequence, it's on his left arm during the scene before he transforms.
When Max transforms the right sleeve of his cardigan can still be seen for a few frames even though his right arm already has transformed with his suit.
The straps on Pegasus' torso have an effect during the transformation, even though they're already present on the suit.
When Climatiqueen wants to attack Cat Noir on the Eiffel Tower, her arm passes through her hair.
When Climatiqueen was running on the roof and shooting at students in the collège's courtyard, Adrien, Marinette and Aglaé walked through the door to the school infirmary.
Aglaé's hair tie is missing in some shots.
After defeating the supervillain, when Adrien brought the glass to Aglaé, its texture merged with Adrien's hand.
In the poetry class scene, Alya is seen with two fanny packs.

text:

Marinette: It's easy! A passion is something amazing and wonderful you can't stop thinking about. It's something you love unconditionally. Something that takes up a lot of space in your life. You know what I mean?

(Marinette and Adrien walk away while Vincent is hosed by Placide. The camera pans back to Aurore, who scrolls on her phone again before sage is sprinkled atop her by Aglaé.)

Aglaé: I've heard sage helps fight against akumatizations.
Aurore: But I'm not about to get akumatized.

title: Climatiqueen/Transcript
text:

title: Copacabana
text:
Copacabana - Intro
is a residential and commercial neighborhood in Rio de Janeiro. It is very famous worldwide for its famous beach.

title: Copacabana
text:
Copacabana - Description
Located in the south of the city and overlooking the Atlantic Ocean, Copacabana is a 5.2 km2 neighborhood with a population of 160,000. It is a very dense and affluent neighborhood, with most buildings ten stories high and numerous hotels, restaurants, and nightclubs.
This neighborhood attracts many tourists, especially for its long promenade and its famous beach, one of the tourist icons of Rio de Janeiro.

title: Copacabana
text:
Copacabana - Trivia
Copacabana is named after a chapel that houses a replica of the Virgin of Copacabana, a small village on the shores of Lake Titicaca in Bolivia.
In "Re-creation", it is revealed that Su-Han was training Luka, Jagged, and Penny on beach before they were attacked by the Miraculized.

title: Copacabana Beach
text:
Copacabana Beach - Intro
is a 4.5 km long beach in the district of Copacabana, in Rio de Janeiro. It is one of the most famous beaches in the world and is a tourist attraction of the city.

title: Copacabana Beach
text:
Copacabana Beach - Description
Bordered by the Atlantic Ocean, Copacabana Beach is a 4.5-kilometer-long crescent-shaped white sand beach, 30 to 100 meters wide, located south of Rio de Janeiro.
Nicknamed the "Princess of the Seas," it is considered one of the most beautiful beaches in the world with its emerald waters. It is very popular with tourists and many athletes who come to play soccer, volleyball, or even practice capoeira.
This beach is also a center of Rio de Janeiro life, hosting events and celebrations, such as fireworks, concerts, sporting events, and religious gatherings.
On the city side, the beach is bordered by a long Portuguese promenade with black and white wave patterns, forming the longest sidewalk in the world. It is lined with palm trees.

title: Copacabana Beach
text:
Copacabana Beach - Trivia
Copacabana Beach takes its name from the neighborhood of Copacabana.
Copacabana Beach is the site of New Year's Eve celebrations in Rio de Janeiro with fireworks and the tradition of laying flowers there at midnight.
In 2016, the beach hosted three events of the Rio 2016 Olympic Games: beach volleyball, open water swimming, and triathlon.
Copacabana Beach first appears in "Conformation".
It is on this beach that Su-Han, Luka, Jagged, and Penny fight the Miraculized before being taken to Paris by Bunnyx.

title: Colosseum
text:
Colosseum - Intro
The , originally the Flavian Amphitheatre (Amphitheatrum Flavium), is an ovoid Roman amphitheatre located in the centre of the city of Rome, Italy. The largest amphitheatre built under the Roman Empire, it is today one of the symbols and one of the most visited monuments of the Italian capital.

title: Colosseum
text:
Colosseum - Description
Built between 72 and 80 AD at the request of Emperor Vespasian, the Colosseum is an amphitheater that could accommodate between 50,000 and 80,000 spectators.
Built between the Esquiline and Caelian hills, it was constructed using travertine limestone, turf, and Roman concrete. It is a completely freestanding structure. It has an elliptical plan and measures 189 meters long by 156 meters wide, while its outer wall is 48 meters high.
Greatly weakened by earthquakes and the removal of stones, the surviving section of the monumental outer wall's facade comprises three superimposed stories surmounted by a podium upon which rises a high roof, both pierced by regularly spaced windows. The arcades are framed by half-columns of the Doric, Ionic, and Corinthian orders, while the attic is adorned with Corinthian pilasters.
The central arena is an oval measuring 86 m long and 54 m wide, surrounded by a 4.5 meters high wall that rises to the level of the first tiers of seating. It hosted gladiatorial combats, wild animal fights, public executions, reenactments of famous battles, and dramas based on Roman mythology.

title: Colosseum
text:
Colosseum - Description
Today, the Colosseum is one of Rome 's most visited tourist attractions. It remains one of the great symbols of the past grandeur of Roman civilization and has important links with the Catholic Church.

title: Colosseum
text:
Colosseum - Trivia
Since 1980., UNESCO has included the Colosseum in its World Heritage List under the title "Historic Centre of Rome, the properties of the Holy See located in this city benefiting from extraterritorial rights and St. Paul Outside the Walls."

title: Dark Cupid
text:
