title: Dark Cupid
text:
Dark Cupid - Synopsis
Marinette considers declaring her feelings to Adrien for Valentine's Day, but first, they must stop Dark Cupid, a villain bent on eradicating love.
Disney+
Ladybug and Cat Noir face Dark Cupid, alias Kim.

title: Dark Cupid
text:
Dark Cupid - Plot
In class, Miss Bustier reviews how most fairy tales end, with the prince kissing the princess, due to love being the only thing that can defeat hate. According to Max, this is only true 87% of the time. During this discussion, Adrien is distractedly writing on a paper. Miss Bustier, believing he isn't paying attention, asks Adrien what she just said, and he does, word for word, without looking up. The bell then rings, prompting Miss Bustier to remind the class to read Sleeping Beauty by Charles Perrault. She dismisses them, wishing them a happy Valentine's Day.

title: Dark Cupid
text:
Dark Cupid - Plot
Adrien remains at his desk, pondering what else to write on the paper, before he becomes frustrated, crumples it into a ball, and throws it away. Marinette stayed behind, rifling through the trash can for the paper. During this, Chloé and Sabrina stop Adrien from leaving. Chloé asks Adrien to sign a poster, and Adrien declines as he does not enjoy giving autographs. Chloé reassures Adrien that he isn't signing a poster, but a petition against hamsters' cruelty — due to the ugly sweaters they're forced to wear. Annoyed, he signs it, walking away. At that moment, Chloé spots Marinette searching through the trash can. She and Sabrina make rude jokes about Marinette being too poor for food and new clothes, then run away, laughing.
Marinette, however, finds the note. Translated from French, it says, "Your hair is jet black, your eyes as blue as the heavens, I want to ask who you are behind your mysterious mask. I see you every day and I would like you to give me a sign, I shall love you 'til the end of my days, will you be my Valentine?"

title: Dark Cupid
text:
Dark Cupid - Plot
Tikki is surprised by the fact that it was a love letter but assures Marinette that it is about her, even when Marinette states that there are many other girls with black hair and blue eyes. Tikki also mentions that the "mysterious mask" is about Marinette's inner self. Marinette jumps up and down excitedly, telling Tikki to pinch her as she must be dreaming. Tikki is confused by this but pinches Marinette anyway, causing Marinette to shout.
After the school day ends, Max hands Kim a box, stating that inside the box was the piece of jewelry girls loved most. Kim opens the heart-shaped box, revealing a yellow brooch with large blue gems and 10 pearls of varying size. Alya sees this and drags Marinette over, wondering whom it is for. Max almost reveals whom, but Kim shushes him, stating, "The walls have ears". Alya, the reporter that she is, begins recording, asking Kim, who the lucky lady is, but Marinette stops her, excited for Kim. Kim then begins to despair because he hasn't yet asked the girl to be his Valentine and doubts that she would accept. Marinette reassures him that the girl will love Kim's gift and that he should have no regrets.

title: Dark Cupid
text:
Dark Cupid - Plot
Max gives Kim a map with red and yellow highlights on it. The yellow markings are the girl's route, and the red ones are Kim's. He has to get to the Pont des Arts within two minutes in order to cross her path. Thanking Marinette, Kim sprints to the bridge, jewelry box in hand. Alya then nudges Marinette, claiming Marinette should take her own advice. This leads to Marinette deciding to write Adrien a letter about her feelings for him.
Chloé and Sabrina stand outside the school next to a pillar with one of Adrien's new posters on it and with several girls, including Mireille Caquet and Aurore Beauréal, standing around it. Chloé tells the girls to stop gushing over Adrien as he is hers. She then has Sabrina unroll the poster that Adrien unwittingly signed earlier. It is a copy of the one on the pillar, only it says, "To Chloé, the most wonderful girl of the universe and the love of my life", signed by Adrien. This causes the girls to burst out crying. Chloé tells Sabrina to rub the poster in their faces if they aren't crying enough.

title: Dark Cupid
text:
Dark Cupid - Plot
Back in Marinette's room, Marinette is at her desk, writing words, then scratching them out on a piece of paper. She complains to Tikki that writing love letters are difficult. Tikki suggests that Marinette just needs to write a response to Adrien's letter. Marinette wonders why she didn't think of that earlier, then Alya enters, holding a pink heart-shaped card. Marinette immediately gets to work, her words coming easier as she writes. When she's finished, Alya reminds her to sign the card, but both of them become distracted when a ladybug enters the room, landing on the card. Alya mentions ladybugs bring good luck, "especially to cute lovers", referring to a recent post she made about ladybugs on the Ladyblog.

title: Dark Cupid
text:
Dark Cupid - Plot
In Adrien's room, Adrien and Plagg view Ladyblog's article on ladybugs. Adrien is still trying to figure out who Ladybug is, and Plagg could care less and would rather eat cheese. Plagg points out that Adrien knows nothing about Ladybug, but Adrien counters that Plagg knows nothing about love. This causes Plagg to list his favorite cheeses, making Adrien more dejected. In that moment, Adrien decides to tell Ladybug that he loves her. Plagg makes an adorable noise in abject horror before returning to his Camembert heaven.

title: Dark Cupid
text:
Dark Cupid - Plot
On the Pont des Arts, Kim waits nervously for his girl to arrive. He hears her speaking on the phone and gasps. Kim has a crush on Chloé, who is discussing an expensive frame for Adrien's signed poster, ignoring Kim, who steps in her way, stuttering before he gains his composure. He drops to one knee, landing in a puddle of water. Holding out the box and asking if she would be his Valentine, a man on a bike rides past, splashing Kim with more water. Then, the wind blows an empty chips bag in his face. Chloé spots this and commands him not to move. She then takes a humiliating picture of him, sending it to the rest of the school. Chloé leaves, laughing, telling Kim that her heart belongs to someone far more awesome than him. Kim falls to the ground, crying.

title: Dark Cupid
text:
Dark Cupid - Plot
Hawk Moth senses Kim's misery from his lair. He releases an akuma, claiming a feast awaits it due to the heartbreak and illusions on Valentine's Day. The akuma flies to Kim, infecting the brooch. Hawk Moth gives Kim the name Dark Cupid and the power to break apart lovers and friendships. Kim transforms into a red and a black villain with wings, an open-heart bow, arrows shaped like roses, and the insignia of a broken heart across his chest. The brooch remains on the strap holding the quiver of arrows in place. Dark Cupid takes to the air, shooting arrows at people left and right, breaking apart relationships. The lips of people affected by his arrows turn black.

title: Dark Cupid
text:
Dark Cupid - Plot
Marinette and Alya head out of the bakery. Tom offers the two girls freshly made candy apples, which they take. They run to a nearby mailbox to send the letter off. Marinette hesitates, her hand shaking, as she shoves the letter in the box. It is this moment when they receive a text message from Chloé, a picture of Kim. Marinette immediately feels guilty, as it was her advice that led Kim to ask Chloé to be his valentine. Alya offhandedly mentions that she hopes Adrien won't act like Chloé, causing Marinette to freak out and attempt to get the letter back. Alya calms Marinette down, saying she was only joking. Alya spots Dark Cupid in the sky.
Dark Cupid spots the heart-shaped apples Alya holds, shooting an arrow at Alya, claiming that every heart must be broken. This turns Alya against Marinette. Alya shoves the sticky candy apples on Marinette, announcing that the two were never friends and that Marinette's letter to Adrien was stupid. She runs off, cackling. Marinette glares at Dark Cupid, discovering the brooch. She makes the connection that Kim was akumatized and transforms into Ladybug to follow him.

title: Dark Cupid
text:
Dark Cupid - Plot
Chasing after Dark Cupid, she spots him taking aim at Chloé, who is angry over the lack of karats in the frame of Adrien's portrait. Ladybug knocks off Kim's aim, causing the arrow to miss. Ladybug attempts to talk Dark Cupid out of attacking the rest of Paris due to Chloé's meanness, but Dark Cupid believes that he is justified in breaking hearts. He says he'll only stop when he breaks every heart in Paris, then takes aim at Ladybug. She knocks away his shots with her yo-yo. Using it as a shield, Ladybug skirts across Paris' rooftops before falling off a steep incline, holding onto the eave of a building. Dark Cupid loses her. Hawk Moth threatens to take Dark Cupid's powers away if he doesn't find the Miraculous. Dark Cupid searches for her vigorously.

title: Dark Cupid
text:
Dark Cupid - Plot
Ladybug watches Dark Cupid fly by. Cat Noir then appears, holding out a hand to Ladybug while he's standing on his staff, which is wedged into a wall. She takes it and stands on his baton. He pulls her close, shushing her when she tries to tell him about Dark Cupid. Just as he is about to say, "I love you", Dark Cupid arrives. Cat Noir swings Ladybug around, shielding her with his body and taking the shot meant for her. He hugs her, his lips turning black, and he squeezes her, stating that he hates her and that she means nothing to him. To get free, Ladybug steps on Cat Noir's foot, then uses the end of Cat Noir's staff as a springboard, flinging herself into the air. She yo-yos away, landing in the lobby of Chloé's hotel.
Cat Noir retracts his staff and returning it to its normal length. He climbs up the side of the building and finds Dark Cupid at the top and he is agreeing to assist him in taking Ladybug's Miraculous.

title: Dark Cupid
text:
Dark Cupid - Plot
Ladybug finds Chloé and Sabrina and tells them to run away, that Dark Cupid is after them. Chloé can't believe that Kim holds a grudge against her and she thinks he's jealous because Chloé has Adrien, "a super hot guy from her class...[who's] super rich". Sabrina points to the poster outside and it begins to move, Dark Cupid revealing himself from behind it. Ladybug protects the girls from Dark Cupid's arrows, wraps Chloé up in her yo-yo string, and pulls Chloé outside, telling her to run.
Cat Noir jumps out in front of Ladybug and he stops her pursuing from Dark Cupid while he chases after Chloé and Sabrina. At this moment, Ladybug really doesn't want to fight Cat Noir so she gets out of his reach and leading him up Paris' rooftops. She stops him with her yo-yo and she questions him as to where he gained all this anger. He tells her that hate conquers all and Ladybug counters that by stating what wins, love. From this, she realizes that only love can save him, and for that to happen, she has to kiss him. Ladybug chases after Cat Noir because she is trying to kiss him but he runs away and the tables having been turned.

title: Dark Cupid
text:
Dark Cupid - Plot
Dark Cupid corners Chloé and he is preparing to take his revenge. But she launches into a selfish rant about her clothes and hair being ruined and she decides to let Dark Cupid change her and she is believing that things couldn't get any worse for her. Seeing how pathetic and petty she already is, he decides not to waste an arrow on her as she has no room in her heart for love and he is laughing at her while he flies away. Chloé is still covered in dirt and she is approached by Sabrina, who was turned dark. Sabrina takes a photograph of Chloé by sending it out to the rest of the school.
Ladybug catches Cat Noir by the ankle and she is tying him around a lamp post. Hanging upside down, she tries to kiss him three times, but he squirms, and Dark Cupid arrives. Freed, Cat Noir fist-bumps Dark Cupid. Activating his Cataclysm, he comments on how he always wondered what would happen if he used his Cataclysm powers on a person. Hiding behind a tree, Ladybug uses Lucky Charm, and a candy apple appears. Using her Lucky vision, Ladybug spots the water fountain, Cat Noir's Cataclysm, and Dark Cupid's quiver's strap.

title: Dark Cupid
text:
Dark Cupid - Plot
Sliding from behind the tree, Ladybug has her yo-yo swinging. She tells the boys she has Valentine's gift for them, spurring them into action. Ladybug defends herself from Dark Cupid's arrows with her yo-yo and ducks under Cat Noir's arm, his hand far too close to her face for comfort. She then pulls on his tail, making him stagger as she bounces on his head. In the air, she flings the candy apple at Dark Cupid's head, where it sticks. Dark Cupid pries it off, but due to its stickiness, he is unable to notch an arrow properly. He leaves Cat Noir to fight Ladybug while he washes his hands.
Cat Noir chases Ladybug around the fountain until he pins her on the ground. While he is monologuing, he releases her arms. This allows Ladybug to reach up and pull down Cat Noir's face, kissing him. When Cat Noir snaps out of it, he has no memory of what previously happened or where he is. Ignoring his confusion, Ladybug swings him up onto her shoulders and throws him at Dark Cupid. He lands on Dark Cupid, and the unused Cataclysm dissolves the quiver's strap.

title: Dark Cupid
text:
Dark Cupid - Plot
Taking the brooch, he tosses it to Ladybug, jokingly pretending it's her Valentine's Day present. Ladybug goes along with it, gushing over how he shouldn't have gotten it for her before she "accidentally" drops it. She smashes the brooch under her heel, revealing the akuma. Opening her yo-yo, Ladybug captures the akuma, setting it free after she cleanses it. Throwing the candy apple into the air, Ladybug cleanses the rest of Paris. This act stops Alya from cutting a picture of her and Marinette in half. This also stops Sabrina from defacing the poster of Adrien, but the damage was already done there, causing Sabrina and Chloé to cry. Kim returns to normal, and Ladybug and Cat Noir fist-bump.
Ladybug's Miraculous beeps, sending her running off. Cat Noir stops her, wanting to tell her something, but he is unable to. Ladybug tries to explain the kiss, but as Cat Noir has no idea what she's talking about, she stops. He tries to speak again, but his Miraculous begins beeping, stopping him. Since Ladybug does not wish to see his civilian form, nor reveal hers, the two depart in opposite directions.

title: Dark Cupid
text:
Dark Cupid - Plot
Back at the mailbox, Marinette watches as the mailman opens the box, letters cascading out of it. Tikki mentions that this is Marinette's chance to take the letter back, but Marinette has changed. Marinette learned that in order for Adrien to love her back, he must first know that she loves him.

title: Dark Cupid
text:
Dark Cupid - Plot
Adrien returns home and he goes to his bedroom but he is feeling down. He collapses on his bed and Plagg tries to discuss the day. Plagg can remember everything that happened but Adrien cannot. All Adrien knows is that he was extremely mean, rude and he fought against Ladybug because of Dark Cupid's arrows. Plagg tries cheering him up by picking him one of the dozens of letters and gifts on Adrien's desk. He ends up seeing a pink, heart-shaped letter. It floats next to Adrien and he reads it and he is surprised that someone answered his letter. The card, translated from French, states "Your hair is brilliant like the sun, your eyes are lucky green. When I look at you I wonder about all your thoughts and dreams. Yes, your Valentine I'll be, our love will be so true. Together for eternity, my heart belongs to you". Plagg believes that with something so lovey-dovey that it has to have been written by Adrien's soul mate. However, it isn't signed. A ladybug flies into the room onto the letter, making Adrien believe that the letter came from Ladybug. He follows it to the window where it flies away.

title: Dark Cupid
text:
Dark Cupid - Plot
Meanwhile, Marinette can't remember if she signed the letter or not, recalling a ladybug distracted both her and Alya. Alya laughs at the fact that Marinette forgot to sign something to Adrien. The ladybug flies into the shot again, and the end card appears.

title: Dark Cupid
text:
Dark Cupid - Plot Developments
Marinette and Adrien share their first kiss as Ladybug and Cat Noir, although Adrien doesn't remember it afterward. However, he, as Cat Noir, finds about the kiss in "Prime Queen".
This episode shows that non-magical effects of an akuma attack cannot be fixed by Miraculous Ladybug.
As of this episode, it is the first to introduce a different weakness about the Miraculous superpowers.
While under the influence of Dark Cupid's arrows as Cat Noir, Adrien always wondered what would happen if he ever used his powers on someone. His answer to that question wasn't revealed until "Miraculer".
Although Adrien couldn't remember what happened while under the effects of Dark Cupid's arrow and yet Plagg could, it's likely when kwamis are transformed with their owners, they have some resistance to effects of akumatized villains. When they detransform, the effects will transfer to the kwamis but Adrien was reverted back to normal before he detransformed and the answer wasn't revealed until "Oblivio".
This is the first time where Cat Noir attempted to use his powers on someone else of his own free will albeit he was mind controlled into doing it.

title: Dark Cupid
text:
Dark Cupid - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in France.
This episode is the tenth to air in Korea and France.
According to Thomas Astruc, the "internet would break because of [this episode]".
This episode is called "Le Dislocœur" in French, intending to be a pun with "-cœur" meaning "heart" and "disloqueur", meaning "breaker". The name of the episode can be translated to "heartbreaker".
This episode is stated to occur on Valentine's Day. If this is taken to mean February 14, as it does in the real world, then the rest of the series would have to occur over a span of five months, creating some continuity issues.
Assuming the series occurs during the 2015-2016 school year, this would also mean that Valentine's Day occurs on a Sunday, when school should be out.
This episode also came out a week before the real Valentine's Day in the year 2016 (when premiering on Nick and 4 days before the same holiday premiering on Netflix a year later after it).
Théo makes a cameo in this episode by holding the framed Adrien poster when delivering it to Chloé.
This is the first episode in which Cat Noir's transformation isn't seen.
Aurore has a different voice in this episode.
References

title: Dark Cupid
text:
Dark Cupid - Trivia
Adrien mentions not liking signing autographs, something he was seen doing in "Ladybug & Cat Noir". This could be a continuity error, or he could've changed his mind afterwards.
Allusions
Ladybug trying to kiss Cat Noir while upside down resembles a scene from the Spider-Man 2002 film.
Errors
In the classroom, Nathaniel can be seen sitting next to an augmented version of his sketch of Chloé's bracelet (from "Rogercop").
From the beginning of the initial classroom scene, the wastebasket by Miss Bustier's desk is seen just around the side of the desk, at the end facing the outside window. But when Adrien throws away his crumpled-up poem, the basket is suddenly beside the other end of the desk, and forward of it. Subsequent to that, the basket is no longer forward of the desk.
The colors of the charm on Alya's cellphone are inverted.
When Alya is hit by Dark Cupid's arrow, it briefly shows that the candy apples she was holding suddenly disappeared when she stumbles back. When she was affected by Dark Cupid straight afterwards, she sticks the candy apples onto Marinette's shirt.
Before Cat Noir attacks Ladybug, she holds her yo-yo in her hand while it's still attached to her waist.

title: Copycat/Transcript
text:
Copycat/Transcript - Intro
[ Theme Song ]
Tikki: How about inviting him to a movie then?
Marinette: Right, Tikki. Can you imagine that conversation?
Tikki: (in Marinette's voice) "Hey Adrien, would you like to gah— wuh, (gets tongue-twisted and sticks her tongue out) glah."
Marinette: Exactly. I can't help it. Every time I see him, (She imagines that an image of Adrien appears in the clouds) I get all clammy and I feel like fainting.
Tikki: So... basically the only way you could have a normal conversation with him, is if you're blindfolded.
Marinette: Pretty much.
Tikki: There is a very simple solution, Marinette, it's called a cell phone. You just need his number.
Marinette: I know who'll have Adrien's number!
(Marinette pulls out her phone to call Alya.)
(Théo and André Bourgeois are facing the crowd, with the giant statue covered with a sheet behind them)
André: I'm sure you've outdone yourself, Théo.
Théo: It was my honor. And I can't wait to meet Ladybug, I hope she'll autograph the photo I used as the inspiration for the statue.
André: Oh, it's nearly time. Ladybug and Cat Noir should already be here by now.

title: Copycat/Transcript
text:
Copycat/Transcript - Intro
Alya: Look, we all know improv's not your bag, (gives Marinette a notepad) so just stick to this script.
Marinette: But all the teachers say I don't sound natural when I read.
Alya: Then memorize it. It's pretty simple. You can do this. Just don't improvise. Got it?
Marinette: (looks at the Alya's phone and the script) Forget it! This is never gonna work!
Alya: (taps the call button on her phone) Too late. It's dialing. (She jumps behind Marinette's chaise.)
(Marinette gasps and panics while holding the cell phone in one hand, not knowing what to do.)
Adrien's voice recorder: Hey, this is Adrien's voicemail. Leave a message.
Marinette: It's gone to voicemail!
Alya: Leave a message! Don't improv!
Marinette: Uhh, hello. Uh, Adrien's voicemail, uh, this is Marinette, who, uh, has a message for you, of course, cause it's, uh, your phone, so, umm... (chuckles) Callmeseeyoulater,bye! (throws the phone onto the chaise)
(Alya looks at her, exasperated.)

title: Copycat/Transcript
text:
Copycat/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (moans) What? What did you expect me to say? "Hey, hot stuff, this is Marinette, I'd ask you on a date to a movie, but I've got such a crazy crush on you that the only way I can talk to you without foaming out the mouth is over this stupid phone." Pretty ridiculous, right?
Automated voice: (from phone) If you wish to hear your message again, press 1. If you wish to erase your message, press 2.
Marinette: (gasps)
Alya: Hit 2! Hit 2!
(Marinette lunges and taps the phone.)
Automated voice: (from phone) Message saved. Goodbye.
(Marinette screams, before she collapses on the chaise)
Alya: It's not as bad as you think.
Marinette: Hmm?
Alya: Okay, it's bad. But you were gonna have to tell him one of these days, some way or another. Think of it this way: no more secrets!
Marinette: The voicemail recorded my whole conversation.
Alya: Big deal!
Marinette: I called him "hot stuff". He cannot be allowed to hear that message, Alya! If he does, I'll die of shame!
Alya: Okay, okay. I got an idea. If Adrien's phone went to voicemail, it means the dude's busy. Which also means you can get to it before he does. Hmm, I wonder where he'd be...

title: Copycat/Transcript
text:
Copycat/Transcript - Intro
(Marinette pulls down a large copy of Adrien's schedule from the ceiling.)
Marinette: Of course! He's got fencing club after school, that's why he didn't pick up! It ends in exactly twenty-two and a half minutes.
Alya: You are seriously insane. You know that, right?
(Marinette giggles)
Plagg: (Adrien's phone vibrates.) Ahhhhh!
Automated voice: (from phone) You have 1 new message. (Plagg shuts it off.)
(Back in the gym, Adrien defeats his opponent. He pulls up his mask.)
Adrien: Gotta get a drink of water. I'll be right back. (He runs to his locker and opens it. He opens his bag and sees Plagg inside, finishing his cheese.) Plagg, you pig!
Plagg: You have 1 new message. (burps)
Adrien: Move, please, so I can check my voicemail. Hmm, don't recognize this number. Oh no, now we're late! Time to transform, Plagg! (His ring flashes.)
Cat Noir: (leaping over a building) Woo-hoo! Yeah-ha-ha! Ha! Hahaha! (lands in front of the statue) Hey, everybody!
(Marinette covers her mouth and looks panicked.)
Alya: They're unveiling Ladybug and Cat Noir's sculptures today! I totally spaced!
Marinette: Me too.
Alya: Uh, you never mentioned going to the unveiling before.

title: Copycat/Transcript
text:
Copycat/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: I'm not, I mean, I am! Uh, I mean, I forgot?
Alya: Listen. About Adrien's cellphone, what if we go right after?
Marinette: If we wait after the ceremony, Adrien's fencing training will be over, and he'll have his phone back by then.
Alya: Shoot. I gotta cover this event for the Ladyblog... I'm sorry, Marinette!
Marinette: Don't sweat it. I can manage. I think!
Alya: You sure?
Marinette: Yes, yes. I'm sure.
Alya: Cool. Good luck, and stay out of trouble. And don't improv!
Tikki: Isn't Ladybug supposed to be at the unveiling?
Marinette: Yes, but Marinette needs to be at the school first.
Tikki: But it is a ceremony in your honor.
Marinette: And it's my honor that's at stake right now. I'll be in and out of there in five minutes. We can be at the ceremony in no time!
Théo: Excuse me, Cat Noir, but Ladybug's not here.
Cat Noir: Don't worry about Ladybug. I'm sure she'll be here any minute. I can handle this situation alone for now. I'm the one in charge anyway, you know.
Théo: It's just that, I wanted to ask her to autograph this photo. She's amazing. She's so brave and smart, the way she always saves everyone...
(Cat Noir glares at the photo; Théo doesn't notice.)

title: Copycat/Transcript
text:
Copycat/Transcript - Intro
André: Perhaps the ceremony should commence. It might bring her here faster.
Théo: Please, just one minute more, Mayor Bourgeois, she's going to come, I can feel it...
Marinette: ...I'm there! (sees all the lockers)
Tikki: Oh boy.
Marinette: Which one's his?
Tikki: If you call him, you'll make his phone ring.
Marinette: Nice, Tikki! (She calls Adrien, and puts her ear against each locker to figure out where the ringing is coming from.)

(Théo looks at Ladybug's statue and sighs sadly.)

Tikki: (She phases through the locker and opens it.) Ta-dah!

title: Copycat/Transcript
text:
Copycat/Transcript - Intro
Théo: Ladybug didn't show up. I just wanted to express my adoration for her. Let her know that everything I had went into her statue. I'm sure if she took a little time to get to know me, she would see how much we have in common. Our devotion to the things we love.
Cat Noir: Hey, don't mean to burst your bubble, but you know, Ladybug and me, we're a thing, you know?
Théo: Really?
Cat Noir: Yeah, we're like this. (crosses his fingers)
Théo: (growls; walks away angrily) What does Ladybug see in him?
Tikki: They're coming! Put back the phone!
Marinette: I haven't erased the message yet!
Tikki: We're out of time and we really ought to be getting to that ceremony, come on!
(Marinette hides behind the door as it opens.)
Student: Whew! That was rough. Ha ha.
(Marinette edges out the door without anyone seeing her. As she leaves the building, Cat Noir lands on the roof. Having changed back, Adrien opens the locker room door and steps in, whistling. He opens his locker and takes his bag.)
Théo: A thing, huh? You don't even take love seriously. Calling it a thing... You don't deserve her!(Smacking away the Cat Noir Head Sculpture.) I do!

title: Copycat/Transcript
text:
Copycat/Transcript - Intro
Hawk Moth: Disappointed by Ladybug and jealous of Cat Noir. The perfect formula for disaster. (turns a butterfly into an akuma) Fly away, my little akuma, and evilize him!
Hawk Moth: Hello, Copycat. I am Hawk Moth. Once you get rid of Cat Noir, you can take his place. And Ladybug will be yours forever.
Théo: The very thought of it makes me purr. (turns into Copycat)

(Adrien grabs the house phone so he calls his cellphone)

(She collapses on the bed)

title: Copycat/Transcript
text:
Copycat/Transcript - Intro
Adrien's Voicemail: Hey, this is Adrien's voicemail. Leave a message.
Adrien: Ugh, it must still be at the gym. (He grabs Plagg, who was in the middle of eating, and leaves.)
Copycat: (humming)
(The civilians are surprised. Some hold up their phones to take pictures or videos.)

title: Copycat/Transcript
text:

title: Copycat/Transcript
text:

title: Copycat/Transcript
text:

title: Césaire apartment
text:
Césaire apartment - Intro
The  is the residence of Otis Césaire, Marlena Césaire, and their daughters.

title: Césaire apartment
text:
Césaire apartment - Appearance
Exterior
The exterior of the apartment building is made up of brown bricks and solid tan-colored siding, with giant gray shingles on the roof. The top floor is inset from the floor(s) below it. One side of the building includes a blue square and blue vertical wavy lines on each side of the window. The larger windows have iron window accents wrapping around the bottom side, and some accents have brown baskets holding flowers attached to them. There is also an outside balcony with iron fencing outside of one of the doors on the top floor.
Interior

title: Césaire apartment
text:
Césaire apartment - Appearance
The Césaires' apartment is on one end of the top floor of the building. It consists of a living room, dining room, and kitchen in one main area, as well as four bedrooms, including Alya's room and Ella and Etta's room, and Nora's room. The walls of the main area are pale pink, and the floor is wooden. A couple sides of this area have windows, some of which have large dark red curtains, and sliding doors in the living room area open to the balcony, where there is a potted plant to one side. Another side of the area is a long wall with doors to other rooms at various points. In the kitchen end, the wall extends into a hallway to the apartment's main entry door. Many decorations on the walls are images of animals, such as bugs, fish, a rhinoceros, foxes, tigers, and an elephant.

title: Césaire apartment
text:
Césaire apartment - Appearance
The living room includes pink, turquoise, and purple bean bag chairs, dark brown squarish sofa furniture, a flat screen television on a brown table, and a purple and tan rug with a diamond-like pattern. A wooden office desk with a computer is aligned to the backside of the large sofa. Between the office desk and the kitchen counter is a round wooden dining table with six wooden chairs. On the opposite side of the kitchen counter is a wall with multiple drawers and kitchen appliances, including an oven and a microwave oven, and the sink. A bookshelf is situated against the main area's long wall, just to the right of the door to Ella and Etta's room.
In "The Dirtifiers", a nursey room is included due to Marlene being pregnant with her unborn daughter.

title: Césaire apartment
text:
Césaire apartment - Trivia
The animal decorations on the wall are related to Otis' job as a zookeeper and his love of animals.
As seen in "Sapotis", there are pictures of red foxes on the wall.
This is ironic due to the fact that Rena Rouge, a Fox Miraculous holder debuted in that episode.
A mancala board sits on the office desk.

title: Daizzi
text:
Daizzi - Intro
is a supporting character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He is the kwami of Jubilation who is connected to the Pig Miraculous. With his power, Daizzi's wearer can use the pearl anklet to transform into a pig-themed superhero.
Daizzi and his Miraculous are currently owned by Rose Lavillant, who uses it to transform into the superheroine Pigella.

title: Daizzi
text:
Daizzi - Appearance
Daizzi is 10 centimeters (or 4 inches) tall and is light pink with a large black mark around his left eye. He has pink eyes, a pink antenna on the top of his head, floppy pig-like ears, a pig snout, and a thin curly tail.

title: Daizzi
text:
Daizzi - Personality
Daizzi is notably fond of cute things, and he is excitable and curious. He also has a strong desire to have a wielder of his own, implying that, like Ziggy, he is one of the least active kwamis.

title: Daizzi
text:
Daizzi - Abilities
Daizzi can fly, levitate, and phase through solid objects. He can also carry objects that are larger and/or heavier than him.
As a kwami, Daizzi is able to transform the holder of the Pig Miraculous into a pig-themed superhero and gives the user the superpower Gift, allowing those who receive the gift to see their deepest desire and feel joy from it.
The effects of Daizzi's Gift is unknown, but it would most certainly be unconstrained and results in some kind of catastrophe though he would be able to restrain it somewhat.

title: Daizzi
text:
Daizzi - Relationships
Friends
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/Ladybug
Daizzi first met Marinette in "Kwamibuster", when she enlisted Daizzi and his fellow Kwamis help to save Tikki and Plagg from the titled villain as Multimouse. The Pig Miraculous is one of the few Miraculouses that the temporarily mouse-themed heroine didn't use, but she did hide herself in the kwami's mouth for a short time.
After the events of "Miracle Queen", Marinette becomes the new Guardian of the Chinese Miracle Box. Daizzi enjoys wandering free around his new guardian's room and quickly grew to like his friends, which came in handy when Ladybug picked her friend Rose to serve as Daizzi's new on-and-off user of the Pig Miraculous.
Until Daizzi and his siblings were stolen by Monarch in "Strikeback".
In "Destruction", it was revealed months prior that Daizzi and his siblings were taught on what to do if they were captured by Monarch and when the plan was put into action, Daizzi was briefly reunited with his guardian until Monarch forced them back through the voyage portal.
In "Re-creation", after Monarch's defeat, Marinette was able to restore Daizzi's Miraculous to its original form and sent Daizzi to live permanently with Rose.

title: Daizzi
text:
Daizzi - Relationships
Rose Lavillant/Pigella
The first time that Daizzi sees Rose is through a video call screen of her with the rest of Rose's and Marinette's friends, and because kwamis aren't able to be seen or heard through technology, Rose had no idea that Daizzi and his fellow kwamis are in her friend's room. When they met in person for the first time, both of them immediately find the other to be very cute and get along very well.
In "Ephemeral", he briefly meets Rose again as they were needed in Ladybug's fight against Moolak along with Gigantitan in "Kuro Neko" and in "Risk".
In "Re-creation", after Ladybug defeats Monarch thereby reclaiming the jewels once they were reforged back to their proper forms, Daizzi was happy to reunited with Rose.
Enemies
Gabriel Agreste/Hawk Moth/Monarch
At first Daizzi did not know Hawk Moth's identity, but he knew that Nooroo was under his service and like all his other kwami companions, he wanted to rescue him.

title: Daizzi
text:
Daizzi - Relationships
In "Heart Hunter", Hawk Moth managed to find Master Fu and steal the Miracle Box and Daizzi was at his disposal, in Miracle Queen, Daizzi was activated by Chloe and had the intention of using it against Ladybug while Hawk Moth supported her decision but Ladybug was able to return Daizzi and the other Kwamis to the Miracle Box.
However, in "Strikeback", Felix betrayed Ladybug and using Barkk's power, stole all the Miraculouses from the Chinese Miracle Box, leaving Daizzi and his companions under the service of Monarch.
In "Evolution", Gabriel treats Daizzi and his companions as slaves, demanding complete obedience from him.
In "Destruction", Daizzi and his companions call Gabriel a meanie, which caused Gabriel to seal their mouths, then they are forced to reveal the location of their guardian to Gabriel but end up leading him into a trap organised by Ladybug to recover Daizzi and his companions. But in the end, he ends up failing, subsequently Gabriel melts Daizzi's Miraculous and turns it into the Alliance rings to transfer the power of Jubillation from Daizzi to any akumatized villain he wishes and imprisoned Daizzi and the rest of his companions in cage.

title: Daizzi
text:
Daizzi - Relationships
In "Jubilation", Monarch transferred Daizzi's power to Darker Owl and after he was defeated, Daizzi returned to his cage with his energy depleted and told Monarch that he was hungry and activated a pet food dispenser that Daizzi was forced to use reluctantly accept.
In "Collusion", Monarch transferred power from Daizzi to Miss Sans-Culotte.
In "The Last Day", Monarch transfers Daizzi's power and that of all the other caged kwamis to the Miraculized, then during his guardian's battle against Monarch, Bug Noire managed to snatch all the rings from his right hand including the Pig Miraculous, then Ladybug freed Daizzi from the cage, freeing him from Monarch's control.

title: Daizzi
text:
Daizzi - Trivia
Daizzi was first revealed in a second season trailer on August 31, 2017.
Daizzi's name was confirmed in the credits of the Latin American Spanish dub of "Sandboy".
A few qualities that pigs represent are virility, sincerity, sloth, and determination.
The pig is the twelfth animal of the Chinese zodiac, being also sometimes represented as a boar.
Daizzi's name is a reference to the pig character Zhu Bajie from Journey to the West, who is often called "Dai Zi", which means "idiot". His name in the English version of the story is Pigsy or simply Pig.
One of Xuppu's past holders Sun Wukong, also known as the Monkey King, journeys beside Zhu Bajie in Journey to the West. But Zhu Bajie being a past holder of the Pig Miraculous is unknown.
Daizzi is the fourth Kwami to have emotion related powers following Nooroo, Duusu and Liiri.
Daizzi was the only Kwami seen returning to his cage in Monarch's lair after the akumatized villain was defeated during the fifth season.
Daizzi and Orikko were the only kwamis of the Chinese Miracle Box that did not appear in the sixth season, however they do appear in the theme song.

title: Curiosity Kicked the Cat
text:
Curiosity Kicked the Cat - Synopsis
Cat Noir finds out that Ladybug has written a love letter for her crush. He tries to get a hold of it to discover the mysterious stranger's identity, but soon learns the hard way that curiosity and cats don't mix.

title: Curiosity Kicked the Cat
text:
Curiosity Kicked the Cat - Plot
On the rooftops of Paris, Ladybug starts to write a love letter to Adrien, daydreaming and swooning about him. Unbeknownst to her, Cat Noir is watching from afar, and gets the idea to take the love letter in order to find out who she is writing to. During his first attempt Cat Noir tries to grab the letter by sneaking below her, but Ladybug walks away with it, leading to his hand being pecked by a pigeon and falling. He finds Ladybug at a rooftop flower garden and hides in an empty flower pot to avoid her detection, as soon as she's gone Cat Noir tries to follow her but becomes stuck inside the pot and rolls away. Then he tries fishing for it but hooks a stray cat instead and gets scratched. Having enough, Cat Noir ties a rope to himself to swoop and grab it, but Ladybug easily dodges him. After bumping into obstacles while swinging, Cat Noir falls into the Seine with a splash. The letter gets soaked, so Ladybug scrunches it into a ball and throws it away. Cat Noir enthusiastically grabs the letter, only to discover that it's illegible.

Disney+

text:
Crocoduel - Plot
The episode begins at the Liberty, where Kitty Section's members are rehearsing.
After they complete rehearsals, Luka asks everyone why Marinette wasn't there and if she is okay.
Alya tells him that Marinette was alright, but was a little busy.
Luka tries to say they can tell him the truth, and acknowledges that Marinette knows he still loves her.
Rose makes an excuse, saying Marinette had water-pony classes at the time.
Luka then leaves.
Everyone stares at Rose while Alya sarcastically claps at her.
Rose tries explaining she couldn't "tell the truth because it would break his heart, Marinette feels embarrassed when she is in front of him," and they need to fix it.
Mylène says they have to figure out a way for Marinette and Luka to be together again, at least as friends.
Together, they conspire about where Marinette and Luka should meet.
Zoé suggests somewhere Marinette needs to go.
Ivan and Nino suggest a place where they have to talk.
Alya then suggests that instead of the cinema they were going to on Saturday with the intent to watch Rock and Monster Parade, they can cancel it and have a party in the boat instead for Juleka and Luka's birthday.

title: Crocoduel
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Crocoduel - Plot
Everyone agrees with her and assigns themselves a task for the party accordingly.
Since Alya decided she would bring Marinette to the party, Alya talks to Marinette in her room about inviting her to Juleka's birthday with the original movie plan.
Unknown to Marinette, Alya is tricking Marinette into believing it's only Juleka's birthday, even though the Couffaine siblings are twins.
Marinette falls for it at first, but she quickly realizes Alya tricked her into going to a party when they arrive at the boat.
Alya explains to Marinette that she is wrong about Luka and that everything will be fine.
She also says they can be friends if they can't be together.
Marinette reminds Alya that she knows he's in love with her but she's in love with Adrien, and every time they see each other he just ends up getting hurt because he knows she'll never be the same.
Alya chastises her for overdoing this a little, but Marinette continues to remind her that Luka has already been akumatized twice because of her and feels bad about it.

title: Crocoduel
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Crocoduel - Plot
Alya says that since Marinette can create Magical Charms as Ladybug, everything will be okay and they can try to be friends again, insisting she has to do this because it is her duty.
Marinette agrees, but internally she neither wants to see Luka nor be his friend.
At Collège Françoise Dupont, by hiding behind a bin, Marinette runs to Juleka.
She says Alya insisted she has to come to the party, but she knows Luka will be there and she doesn't want to see him.
She then asks Juleka if she could arrange for Luka to "not" be there because she wants to avoid akumatizations on her birthday.
Juleka tells Marinette she would do what she could.
Marinette happily thanks her in advance, hugs her, and runs off.
At the Liberty, Juleka, nervous, starts trying to tell Luka that Marinette is coming to their birthday party but she doesn't want him there.
However, as soon as she says Marinette is coming, he gets excited and feels happy about it.
Juleka nervously stops the conversation.
Luka senses Juleka is sad but is interrupted by a knock at their window.
Unknown to Luka, she feels guilty because Luka becomes involved in the party.
When Luka opens the window, Jagged Stone enters their room.

title: Crocoduel
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Crocoduel - Plot
Originally, he wanted to meet Luka.
They both discuss music.
Juleka says hi but is unnoticed.
Luka and Jagged continue talking but Anarka Couffaine angrily interrupts them, claiming she doesn't want outsiders (Jagged Stone) on the boat, especially without the captain's permission.
Luka asks Anarka if Jagged can come to their birthday party, to which Anarka replies only if Juleka agrees with it too.
Jagged is surprised at seeing Juleka behind the window and apologizes that he didn't see her there.
Anarka asks Juleka if she wants him at the party, which Juleka agrees to as she does want him there.
Jagged triumphantly leaves.
Meanwhile, Juleka receives two calls: one from Alya with Rose, Alix, and Mylène, asking if Luka will be there for the party, and one from Marinette asking if Luka won't be there.
Juleka becomes really confused and very upset over the guilt she has from not telling Luka about what Marinette said to her.
Alya arrives at the Liberty with Marinette, Nino, Rose, Mylène, and Zoé.
Alya admits to Marinette she is really very impressed that she came there, and tells Marinette she didn't think Marinette would come calmly and meet Luka, and says Marinette is brave.

title: Crocoduel
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Crocoduel - Plot
Unknown to Alya, Marinette actually thinks Luka isn't at the party because she asked Juleka to tell him to go somewhere else.
Marinette says it's important to grow up and overcome things in life, then secretly whispers to Juleka and asks if she really did what she was asked to do.
Then she sees Luka there playing guitar and gets overwhelmed by the situation.
Luka says hi to Marinette, but Marinette runs away, saying she has to do something super urgent.
While running, Marinette accidentally jumps inside the boat from the rooftop, groaning, and tells everyone she's fine.
Juleka is feeling very guilty about the situation.
Everyone starts asking questions about Marinette, and Juleka runs away from the group in tears.
In response, Luka says that he knew it, that Marinette doesn't like him anymore, that she doesn't even want to be friends, which Juleka wasn't brave enough to tell him earlier.
Luka sadly sits back and starts playing sad music with his guitar.

title: Crocoduel
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Crocoduel - Plot
Shadow Moth senses the emotions of Luka, cruelly disappointed and wanting his friendship with his last-loved back. Shadow Moth corrupts the butterfly to an akuma and orders it to fly and evilize him, but the akuma wasn't able to akumatize him anymore because everyone reassured Luka and comforted him. Shadow Moth seems a bit worried and disappointed when he notices that the negative emotions are gone, and orders his akuma to stay there as he says a party with teenagers always has a lot of emotions. Meanwhile, Juleka, worried, walks inside the Liberty and gets noticed by Marinette who is hiding behind the counter. Juleka comes over to her. When Marinette asks why Luka is here, Juleka sadly remains silent. Marinette sees Juleka's sadness and realizes that Juleka couldn't bring herself to tell him to leave. Shadow Moth senses Juleka's emotions and tries to akumatize her. Before he succeeds, Marinette relieves Juleka by apologizing for stressing her out over something nearly impossible for her, and hugs her. Once again, the akuma wasn't able to akumatize Juleka because her negative emotions had been erased, much to Shadow Moth's disappointment.

title: Crocoduel
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Crocoduel - Plot
At the party, while everyone is dancing, Jagged Stone arrives and apologizes to Luka for being late.
When everyone learns that Jagged is Luka's father, they are surprised.
Shadow Moth senses the teenagers' emotions and tries to akumatize them.
Again, the akuma wasn't able to akumatize Marinette's friends because they are overjoyed, and they continue to party.
Meanwhile, in the boat, when Juleka tells Marinette that Jagged is her father, she is very surprised asking why Juleka thinks Jagged doesn't love her but loves Luka more.
The two girls notice Luka and Jagged enter the boat, as Jagged gives Luka a bass guitar and tells him not to tell his sister, causing Juleka to be upset again.
Shadow Moth senses Juleka's emotions about not being loved by her father and tries to akumatize her again.
But before that happens, Marinette comforts Juleka and talks to Jagged about not bringing Juleka a gift.
But, surprisingly, Jagged reveals that the bass guitar was actually a gift for Juleka, making Juleka happy and irritating Shadow Moth.

title: Crocoduel
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Crocoduel - Plot
As Jagged prepares to show the kids the music disc he brought for Luka, Anarka storms in and furiously yells at Jagged for showing her children the disc that resulted in their breakup.
Jagged disagrees, but Anarka calls him a pirate, who left two sailors (Juleka and Luka) behind.
However, the disagreement between two estranged lovers became a fight and they begin to fight over the disc as Marinette, Juleka, and Luka watch in shock.
Shadow Moth finally senses how upset Jagged and Anarka are towards each other, so he sends the akuma towards them. It infects the disc. The fight ends with Jagged and Anarka ripping it in a fit of rage, and are akumatized by Shadow Moth back into their original akumatized selves, Guitar Villain and Captain Hardrock, joining forces to become Crocoduel, still fighting each other.

title: Crocoduel
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Crocoduel - Plot
The teens all evacuate the boat as they all watch in shock Crocoduel getting akumatized and fighting each other. Marinette whispers to Alya that she needs help to slip away. Alya pretends to hurt her ankle and gets the attention of others, whilst Marinette escapes and transforms into Ladybug. The other teens leave with Alya while Luka and Juleka watch their akumatized parents still fight each other. Ladybug arrives at the scene and jumps to the top of the Eiffel Tower. She flings her yo-yo at Guitar Villain, but he dodges, and he and Captain Hardrock taunt her. Shadow Moth then orders the villains to seize her Miraculous, and both race for it as Ladybug escapes, looking for Cat Noir.
Meanwhile, a stylist is putting makeup on Adrien when suddenly, they hear a loud noise and come out from the dressing room to see the two villains chasing Ladybug. The stylist tells Adrien to take shelter while Ladybug and Cat Noir deal with the situation, but Adrien tells her to go find safety and he'll finish the makeup by himself. The stylist fawns over Adrien, even calling him a pro before scampering off. Once the stylist is gone, Adrien transforms into Cat Noir.

title: Crocoduel
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Crocoduel - Plot
Crocoduel continues to chase after Ladybug, until Captain Hardrock fires a big boulder at Ladybug and it hits her. Crocoduel corners Ladybug and threatens her to give up her Miraculous, even bickering over who gets it, but is interrupted when Cat Noir arrives and hits both of them. He then asks Ladybug to promise that they wouldn't be like that when they're an old couple, but Ladybug explains for it to happen they have to be a couple first. The heroes escape and Crocoduel chases after them. Cat Noir hits Guitar Villain with his staff. He then falls down, but is caught in time by the crocodile. Captain Hardrock taunts him, saying that he won't let the two "house pets" beat them and laughs. When she turns around, Ladybug is gone and wonders where she went. Just then, Ladybug lands on the bow of the ship and prepares to attack, when suddenly Guitar Villain prepares to attack her, but she dodges, landing down at the Place de la Concorde, where Cat Noir catches up with her. Crocoduel leaves them there to fight again, but not before they hear Cat Noir complain that they don't have any wings or a flying pirate ship.

title: Crocoduel
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Crocoduel - Plot
Up in the sky, Crocoduel continues to face off. Captain Hardrock taunts Guitar Villain, saying that he only cared about his music, and he adds their music. They attack each other again but miss. In his lair, Shadow Moth sighs and says that they'll tire of this eventually. Ladybug and Cat Noir, meanwhile, seeing the big boulders hit certain locations in Paris, go off to rescue people who are nearly hit by the boulders, until they save both Luka and Juleka from getting hit by one of them. Ladybug comments on how the villains were in love once, and Luka adds that both of those feelings are long gone. Ladybug then replies that it's no reason to not talk to each other. She then summons her Lucky Charm and gets a tape dispenser, and Cat Noir comments on how the tape won't be useful in patching things up between the villains. Ladybug then realizes they need someone to talk to, and takes Juleka. She then tells Luka to not stay there, and almost says, "We'll talk later" and says that it's not safe instead. She then swings away with Juleka. Cat Noir wonders where they're going, and decides to save Paris instead and leaps away, leaving Luka by the river.

title: Crocoduel
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Crocoduel - Plot
Ladybug and Juleka land in an alley, where Ladybug asks her if she's fine; she nods. She then opens her yo-yo and presents Juleka with the Tiger Miraculous, which the latter hesitantly takes. Roaar comes out and growls, scaring Juleka. Ladybug then tells Juleka that once they're done with the mission she'll give the Miraculous back to her, and asks if she can trust her. Juleka says yes, but in a low voice. Roaar then encourages her, and keeps asking if she's sure, making Juleka raise her voice and scream yes very loud, impressing Roaar and making his back land on a wall. Roaar then tells her the transformation words, and Juleka transforms into Purple Tigress.

title: Crocoduel
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Crocoduel - Plot
Back in the open, Cat Noir has just rescued a civilian, who thanks him. Just then, Ladybug and Purple Tigress arrive, with Ladybug telling Cat Noir to launch them in the air. Cat Noir agrees, then sees Purple Tigress, and introduces himself to her. After thinking about her name for a while, Purple Tigress introduces herself, and surprised by her name, Cat Noir declares both of them as family; Ladybug facepalms and groans at this. Cat Noir then grabs his staff and extends it very long while Ladybug and Purple Tigress run towards its end. The three of them put their hands on their respective ends and Cat Noir throws them up into the sky, to let Ladybug land on Captain Hardrock's ship, and Purple Tigress land on Guitar Villain's pet.

title: Crocoduel
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Crocoduel - Plot
Purple Tigress almost calls Guitar Villain "dad" but realizes her mistake very quickly and resists revealing her identity. She grabs her bolas and starts fighting with him while Ladybug starts fighting with Captain Hardrock. They both end up getting the akumatized object from both of them and run away with it. Both villains are furious about this. The two superheroines meet up at the end of the ship and and break it together, but no akuma comes out and they both looked shocked with confusion. Ladybug asks where it is and Purple Tigress confirms that it went in that specific object. Captain Hardrock then threatens them to "walk the plank" and Guitar Villain laughs at the joke and then insults them. He uses her power to make the two teenage girls falls off the "plank", but they jump off the ship in time.

title: Crocoduel
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Crocoduel - Plot
They go through the grey clouds while Cat Noir notices them. He extends to staff upwards so Ladybug and Purple Tigress have a place to land, and they end up going down the pole and became safe. Cat Noir questions if it worked or not and the two girls express their confusion. Ladybug then gasps and takes out her Lucky Charm and uses her Ladybug vision which hits the Lucky Charm, the four pieces of the disk, and Purple Tigress. Ladybug then explains that since they broke them separately, they should join them together again and then break them again. The titular villains go down through the grey clouds and try to start attacking the three heroes. They safely go into a corner of a building and Ladybug asks Purple Tigress to keep the villains at bay while Ladybug uses her Lucky Charm tape to fix the broken record.

title: Crocoduel
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Crocoduel - Plot
Purple Tigress runs up that same building and jumps on the roof to make an angry pose. As the akumatized villains go near the superheroine, she activates her power, Clout. She wishes that her parents would talk it over instead of arguing and then puts her Clout'ed hand on the ship that makes it fly backwards which hits Dragon Fang and they all go up through the grey clouds which makes a little sunshine ray go though. As Cat Noir looks so shocked that the heroine did that, she falls down to the ground. Ladybug looking impressed but not shocked lets Cat Noir cataclysm the akumatized object and he follows the teenage girls' orders and it worked. The akuma comes out of it and Ladybug de-evilizes it. She then creates two Magical Charms for both Anarka and Jagged. Juleka thanks Ladybug for trusting her and hands her back the Tiger Miraculous.

title: Crocoduel
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Crocoduel - Plot
Later on during sunset, Jagged and Anarka continue to argue. This time, they were arguing over whose fault it was they got akumatized. Juleka finally snaps and yells at them to stop arguing, and orders them to apologize to each other by talking instead of yelling at each other. They apologize and both take fault for the akumatization. Later on at night, Jagged reaffirms to, Juleka that if she ever needs someone to talk to he's here to listen. Luka and Marinette smile from a distance, agree to be buddies and patch things up between them as the episode ends.

title: Crocoduel
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Crocoduel - Plot Developments
Luka and Marinette make up by the end of the episode, deciding that they should remain friends.
Juleka receives the Tiger Miraculous in this episode to become the superheroine "Purple Tigress".
Luka is saddened by Marinette being late to a Kitty Section concert, just like in the events of "Truth".
In this episode, it is Luka and Juleka's birthday.
This is the first time that two Magical Charms are given in an episode.
It's revealed that Ladybug's yo-yo can create multiple Magical Charms as long as two or more people are sharing a single akuma while expressing the same negative feelings or emotions.
With the Lucky Charm object being tape, it could imply there have been incidents in the past where an akumatized object had broken before the person holding it was akumatized.
Just like the Lucky Charm when activating the Miraculous Ladybug (superpower), the object doesn't have to be completely intact to cause an akumatization, but this is most likely due to the powers of the Butterfly and the Peacock being combined.
It's revealed that Shadow Moth can still sense the negative emotions of the Magical Charms holders.

title: Crocoduel
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Crocoduel - Plot Developments
Since Magical Charms are meant to prevent akumatizations, Shadow Moth can sense negative emotions but can't akumatize or amokize people who have Magical Charms.
It is revealed Juleka can be so quiet that it startles someone, such as Jagged.

title: Crocoduel
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Crocoduel - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in Brazil on Gloob.
This makes it the third episode in a row, chronologically and production code-wise, to introduce a new hero.
Such a trio also occurred in season 3, with "Ikari Gozen", "Timetagger", and "Party Crasher".
Luka is saddened by Marinette being late to a Kitty Section concert, just like in the events of "Truth".
This is the eleventh episode to feature someone's birthday, after Nathaniel in "The Evillustrator", Adrien in "The Bubbler", Alix in "Timebreaker", Marinette in "Befana", Miss Bustier in "Zombizou", Nooroo in "Sandboy" Wang Cheng in "Miraculous Shanghai", Tom in "Bakerix", and Prince Ali in "Truth" and "Lies".
However, this is the first episode to feature the birthday of two characters.
It's confirmed that Juleka and Luka are twins and that their birthday is on a Saturday in the year the episode takes place.
This is the first time someone becomes a superhero on their birthday. In this case, it's Juleka.
This is the second time someone receives a Miraculous on their birthday following "Timebreaker".

title: Crocoduel
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Crocoduel - Trivia
This is the fourth time Anarka gets akumatized into Captain Hardrock, following the episode with the same name and two off-screen akumatizations as seen in "Mr. Pigeon 72", the sixth time Jagged Stone has been akumatized into Guitar Villain, following the episode with the same name, "Catalyst" and three off-screen akumatizations as seen in "Mr. Pigeon 72", and the third time Fang has been akumatized, following "Guitar Villain", and "Catalyst".
This is the tenth time where Adrien is a minor character in the permanent timeline following "Guiltrip", "Sole Crusher", "Furious Fu", "Mr. Pigeon 72", "Gang of Secrets", "Truth", "Cat Blanc", "Silencer" and "Style Queen".
The Tiger Miraculous' power is revealed to be Clout, the activation phrase is, Roaar, Stripes On!, and Roaar's concept is Elation (Exaltation in the French dub).
This is the fourth time two people are akumatized with one akuma, following "Sapotis", "Oblivio", and "Heart Hunter".
This is the sixth time where more than one person is akumatized with the same akuma, following the aforementioned episodes, "Félix", and "Gang of Secrets".

title: Crocoduel
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Crocoduel - Trivia
Unlike the other multiple akumatizations, the two villains compete against one another, instead of joining forces.
This is the second time more than one person is akumatized with one akumas who isn't from the Cesaire family.
This also marks the first time where akumatized villains fight one another, excluding episode "Gamer 2.0", where former akumatized villains are used as avatars in a game created by the titular villain.
This is the first time that two Magical Charms are given in an episode.
It's revealed that Ladybug's yo-yo can create multiple Magical Charms as long as two or more people are sharing a single akuma while expressing the same negative feelings or emotions.
When Marinette is hiding in a garbage can and is trying to get Juleka's attention in the school courtyard, the latter said, "Talking garbage can? Awesome!". According to Ezra Weisz, this line was improvised by him and Reba Buhr for the English dub. This is because, in the original French version, Juleka would mumble whenever she speaks.

title: Crocoduel
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Crocoduel - Trivia
This is the first time an akumatized object is broken before the akumatization is complete. It's revealed that, when it happens, it's necessary to unite the pieces before breaking the object and releasing the akuma.
Jagged Stone, Anarka, and Purple Tigress are the seventh, eight and ninth people to break an akumatized object, instead of Ladybug and Cat Noir, following Queen Bee, Rena Rouge and Carapace in "Mayura", Fang in "Lies", Marianne Lenoir in "Furious Fu" and Polymouse in "Mega Leech".
It is also the fifth time this happened, following what's written above.
With the Lucky Charm object being tape, it could imply there have been incidents in the past where an akumatized object had broken before the person holding it was akumatized.
Just like the Lucky Charm when activating the Miraculous Ladybug (superpower), the object doesn't have to be completely intact to cause an akumatization, but this is most likely due to the powers of the Butterfly and the Peacock being combined.

title: Crocoduel
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Crocoduel - Trivia
This episode, alongside "Ladybug & Cat Noir", "Mayura", "Félix", "Gang of Secrets" and "Gabriel Agreste", are the only episodes not named after a singular akumatized villain or sentimonster and the sixth time.
This is the third time a kwami scares its owner upon meeting them, after Marinette in "Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)" and Mylène in "Mega Leech".
This is the thirteenth time Ladybug's Lucky Charm object is the same as from a previous episode. This time following the tape roll previously appeared in "Prime Queen".
This is one of the few times where both Ladybug and Cat Noir transform completely off-screen.
This is the third episode where Tikki appears but doesn't have a speaking role following "Horrificator" and "Feast".
This is the ninth episode where Plagg doesn't make a physical appearance in any way following "Prime Queen", "Despair Bear", "Malediktator", "Animaestro", "Christmaster", "Truth", "Furious Fu" and "Guiltrip".
Marinette references the times Luka has been akumatized because of her, which occurred in "Silencer" and "Truth".

title: Crocoduel
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Crocoduel - Trivia
However, in the case of "Silencer", she was only an indirect cause of his akumatization because if Bob Roth had been honest and allowed Luka and the others to perform in the first place, then he wouldn't have been akumatized.
Although her attempts in this episode were to allow Luka to be akumatized again so he could receive a Magicial Charm, by Marinette avoiding him and if not for her friends, then she would have unknowingly been the cause of his third akumatization.
Jagged and Anarka as their akumatized alter egos trying to prove who was right in an argument while trying to destroy everything around them is a reference to a fight between the Hatfields and the McCoys.
This is one of the few times where an akuma doesn't akumatize the first person who feels a negative emotion.
It is revealed Juleka can be so quiet that it startles someone, such as Jagged.
This is the second time that the parents of a character become akumatized, following "Heart Hunter" and followed by "Dearest Family".
This is the first episode where Zoé appears but Chloé doesn't.
This is the tenth time where the akumatized object resembles a Lucky Charm which was a record disc from "The Bubbler" .

title: Crocoduel

text:
Crocoduel - Trivia
This is the last time Cat Noir refers to Ladybug as "Bugaboo" until the future episode "Sleeping Syren".
During Ladybug's "vision" sequence, the objects are colored with a dark shade of pink, similarly to some episodes from seasons 1 and 2, not the light red shade seen in most episodes.
Errors
When Marinette explains during the chalk board sequence of Luka and Juleka's birthday party, the sequence glitches.
When Juleka runs off, Rose's eyelash clips with her eye.
Even though one of the plot points of this episode is that Marinette and Luka haven't seen each other since their break-up, Luka was on the boat in "Sole Crusher" with all of his friends.
One of Guitar Villain's shock-waves clips in a wheelie bin, although the outside of it is completely regular.

Kitty Section throws their masks in the air but they don't come down.

title: Crocoduel

text:
Crocoduel - Trivia
Most of Marinette's friends, namely Ivan, Mylène, Alya, Nino, and Rose, saw Jagged Stone being revealed as Luka and Juleka's father in "Truth", but they are still surprised when Luka calls Jagged his father.
When Juleka told Marinette, it is obvious Marinette pretended to be surprised as she already know about when she was Ladybug.
When Juleka runs off, the pattern on Zoé's shirt is missing and Mylène is missing all her pins, except for the flower.

It's revealed that the inside of the yo-yo is a shallow, light pink basin with medium purple slanted walls.

title: Crocoduel
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Crocoduel - Trivia
This error was corrected when the episode aired on Disney Channel in Southeast Asia.
When Juleka transforms, the tiger paw is pointing the wrong way. The claws are supposed to point down toward the bracelet, instead they point up toward the rings.
The Miraculous Ladybug parts the cloudy sky, even though it wasn't caused in any way by the villains.
When Ladybug reaches into her yo-yo to manifest the Magical Charms, her left arm is cut-off just below the edge of the frame.
In the English dub of the episode, Ladybug says that the Tiger Miraculous is the Miraculous of the Clout, which is its power, instead of Elation (Exaltation), which the latter was correctly used in the French dub.
The same thing happened in "Desperada" with the Snake Miraculous, although the error was present in both dubs.
Coincidentally, Luka and Juleka are twins.
When Guitar Villain catches Ladybug's attention, Shadow Moth orders both villians to seize Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous, but Cat Noir hasn't joined the fight during this time.
