title: Croco Duo
text:
Croco Duo - Intro
is an music duo consisting of Jagged Stone and Anarka Couffaine. They split up after they had Luka and Juleka, and Jagged thought he wouldn't be a good father, so he went solo.

title: Croco Duo
text:
Croco Duo - Description
In the band, both Jagged and Anarka have dark purple hair and robotic-like heads. Anarka wears a silver suit with purple stripes down and her hair is tied up in a braid with a pink hair tie. Jagged wears a black shirt that is cut in the middle and green shoulder pads in the shape of a circle. His sleeves and pants are colored black with green stripes down them and he carries a black wavy piano around him.

title: Crocoduel/Transcript
text:
Crocoduel/Transcript - Intro [ Theme Song ] Rose: ♫
I see their faces everywhere I goDreaming about them in the night!You know I love unicornsAnd nothing makes me feel better! ♫
(Finishing off their song, the band members throw their masks in the air as Zoé, Mylène, Alix, Alya and Nino cheer for them. Rose and Juleka hug each other. Luka looks around sadly.)Luka: Marinette hasn't come around here for a while. Is she okay? Alya: (nervously) Oh, yeah! Yeah! She's fine. It's just that she... she... she's got a lot of stuff going on. Luka: You can be honest with me, you know? She's stopped showing up because she knows I'm in love with her, right? Rose: Of course not, Luka! Marinette stopped coming because the rehearsals are the exact same time as her Aqua Pony classes with Pom-pony, her favorite pony! Pom-pony is so cute, with his golden mane that's so brush-able, but he's also super sensitive and everytime Marinette misses Aqua Pony, Pom-pony gets depressed! (pouts)Luka: I get it, Rose. Thanks. (walks away)Alya: (claps sarcastically) Wow, Rose.

title: Crocoduel/Transcript
text:
Crocoduel/Transcript - Intro
Rose: I know, but we couldn't tell him that Marinette is too embarrassed to see him. It would have broken his heart! We've gotta find a way to patch things up between them so they can see each other and be buddies again! We can all be buddies, right? Oh, I know! Luka could go to Aqua Pony class with Marinette!
Mylène: You know that "aqua pony" is not real, don't you?
Rose: (cups her face) Oh. Yeah, right!
Mylène: I'm sure we can figure out a way to get Luka and Marinette together!
Zoé: Something that Marinette has to come to.
Ivan: Where they'll talk to each other!
Nino: And be buddies again!
Alya: Hey, aren't we all going to see the Rock and Monster Party Parade together this Saturday? What if, instead of going to the movies, we had a party right here on the houseboat! For Juleka's birthday... and Luka's!
Mylène: Of course! Since they're twins, it's Luka's birthday, too, which means he'll be there!
Zoé: And Marinette!
Nino: Wait a sec, Adrien can't come this Saturday! He's got a fashion show.
Alya: Perfect! If Adrien shows up, Marinette wouldn't be able to take her eyes off him.
Alix: And she might act... well, you know?
Zoé: I'll help set up!
Nino: I'm on music!

title: Crocoduel/Transcript
text:
Crocoduel/Transcript - Intro
Alya: And I'll take care of Marinette!(All of them face Juleka.)Mylène: What do you think, Juleka? Awesome idea, right?
Juleka: I... yeah.(The rest of them high-five each other. Rose approaches Juleka.)Rose: Thanks, Jul. You're the best! (kisses Juleka's cheek)''
Marinette: A party on the house boat for Juleka's birthday? Okay. (Alya and Trixx high-five behind her. She becomes suspicious and stops sewing.) Oh! Wait a minute, Alya Césaire. We were supposed to go to the movies for Juleka's birthday, but now we're having a party on the houseboat and since Luka is Juleka's twin, it's also his birthday, which means he'll be there! But you thought I'd never figure that out and would end up on the houseboat with him, and since the houseboat is on the river, I'd have no way of leaving, and I'd be forced to talk to him! It's a trap!
Alya: Okay, girl. You're really good. No wonder you're Ladybug.
Marinette: Alya, you can't do this to me!
Alya: No, you can't do this to Luka! You've been avoiding him for too long. You have to talk to him. Just because you're not together doesn't mean you can't still be friends.

title: Crocoduel/Transcript
text:
Crocoduel/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: But it'll be so awkward! You know that Luka's in love with me, but I'm in love with Adrien, and every time we see each other, he just ends up getting hurt all over again because he knows I'll never feel the same.
Alya: Overdoing it a little?
Marinette: He got akumatized twice because of me.
Alya: Yeah, but things are different this time! If that happens, once you— I mean, Ladybug, saves him and gives him the magical charm, he'll never get akumatized again! And then you guys can try to be friends again! You can't say no to that. (softly) It's your duty!
Marinette: Uh... okay.
Marinette: (off-screen) Juleka! Hey!
(Juleka looks over the school grounds, corners, until she sets her eyes on the trash can.)
Marinette: Psst! Psst! Psssst! Juleka!
Juleka: Talking garbage can? Awesome!
Marinette: (peeks her head over the trash can) No, Juleka, it's me! I'm really sorry. I told Alya I'd come to your birthday and I thought there'll be no problems with Luka but... I really hate to ask this; but do you think you could arrange for Luka to, like, not go?
Juleka: Uhh...

title: Crocoduel/Transcript
text:
Crocoduel/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: I know, it's his birthday, too, but it wouldn't exactly be a great birthday if the girl who broke his heart were there, right? I'd totally miss it if I could but Alya just won't drop it. You know, I feel terrible that I make Luka unhappy and that he got akumatized because of me. I don't think I could ever look him in the eyes again, and... and...
Juleka: (sighs) I'll see what I can do.
Marinette: Really! You'll talk to him? Oh, Juleka, you're the best!
(She hugs Juleka and immediately goes back behind the trash can. Marinette makes her escape as she bumps on the walls and trips on the stairs.)
Juleka: (sighs) Hey, I'd like to have a party here with the gang on Saturday after all.
Luka: (stops playing his guitar) Great idea!
Juleka: And actually, um... well... Marinette...
Luka: Marinette will be there? Woah, I'm so relieved. I really thought she was avoiding me. (continues playing his guitar) That's cool, really! Super cool!
(Juleka looks down sadly. Luka notices her.)
Luka: Was there something else?
Juleka: No. (looks away) No.
Luka: (stands up from the bed and approaches her) Juleka, I know that look. You're holding back something in there. That needs to come out.

title: Crocoduel/Transcript
text:
Crocoduel/Transcript - Intro
(A knock on the window was heard and startles them both.)
Luka: Dad? (opens the window for Jagged Stone to enter)
Jagged Stone: Luka! Hey, son! How's it strumming? (swings in the window and fist bumps with Luka)
Luka and Jagged: Rock and roll!
Juleka: (behind the open window) Hi. (looks down as she gets unnoticed)
Jagged Stone: Ready for the chord of the day, my boy? The diminished D7. I use it in all my tear-jerking ballads.
Anarka: (furiously) Jagged Stone, you scallywag! No stowaways on my ship! Disembark my house right this instant!
Jagged Stone: (nervously) Hey, Anarka! Rock and roll! How'd you know I was here? I was being so sneaky!
Anarka: "Sneaky"?? Your tour bus is parked on the dock, you one-hit wonder!
Jagged Stone: Nanarky, you can't keep me from teaching the diminished D7 to my son!
Anarka: I appreciate you trying to create a bond with your children, Jagged. But no one sets foot on my houseboat without the captain's permission, and that captain is me!
Luka: Well then, Mom, uh, with your permission, could Dad come to our birthday on Saturday? Juleka wants to throw a party.

title: Crocoduel/Transcript
text:
Crocoduel/Transcript - Intro
(Jagged turns around and sees Juleka behind the open window and hugs Anarka, much to his surprise. Juleka looks down once again.)
Jagged Stone: (lets go of Anarka) Hey, Juleka! Rock and roll! I didn't see you there.
Anarka: Juleka, you really want this old pirate to be at your birthday?
Juleka: I— um... (pulls the window door closer to her) Yes.
Jagged Stone: (laughs triumphantly) Awesome! See you on Saturday then! (jumps out the window only to hit the wall, whimpering...) Rock and roll! (...and falls on the river)
(Anarka exits the room, leaving Luka and Juleka in shock. Juleka's phone buzzes with an incoming phone call.)
Alya: (on the phone) So, Juleka, everything good? Luka will be there, right?
(Juleka's phone buzzes again with an incoming phone call.)
Marinette: (on the phone) Hey, Juleka! Everything good? Luka won't be there, right?
Luka: (plays his guitar) I'm so happy that everyone will be there!
(Juleka becomes hesitant, placing a palm on her face.)
Alya: Marinette, I have to say that I'm really impressed with you. I never thought you'd be so chill about seeing Luka again. (walks to Juleka's side) See how brave Marinette's being, Juleka?

title: Crocoduel/Transcript
text:
Crocoduel/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: It's nothing. You gotta get over things in life. Grow up a bit. (leans closer to Juleka, whispering) Sorry again. We're asking to do this but thanks for getting Luka out of here, Juleka. I couldn't handle this otherwise. Is he okay, by the way? I hope he didn't take it too hard— AHHH! (sees Luka playing his guitar on the other side of the boat)
Luka: Hey, Marinette!
Marinette: (panics and runs away) Excuse me! Sorry! I've got something to do! It's super urgent! Yep! Bye! (falls on the stairs that leads below the deck) I'm okay!
Luka: (to Juleka) Is something wrong with Marinette?
Rose: What's going on, Jul?
Alya: Where is she going?
Nino: Is there a problem?
Alix: Is she okay?
Ivan: What's wrong with her?
Juleka: (pressured) It's just that... I— um— oh...! (cries as she runs away from the gang)
Rose: Jul!
Luka: (sighs) I knew it. Marinette doesn't want to have anything to do with me, and Juleka didn't have the heart to tell me. (walks away and sits to play a sad tune on his guitar)
Shadow Moth: The cruel disillusion of a young man who hoped that a friendship with a faded love could be rekindled. (corrupts a butterfly) Fly away, my little akuma! Go evilize that heart!

title: Crocoduel/Transcript
text:
Crocoduel/Transcript - Intro
(The akuma flies out of the window.)
Alya: Luka, come on. It's not like that!
Nino: You know how she gets around awkward situations.
Zoé: She doesn't hate you. She's just... Marinette.
Rose: And she wouldn't say anything because she didn't want to hurt you.
Ivan: She was trying to protect you.
Alix: Everyone loves you here!
(The whole gang embraces Luka as he smiles.)
Luka: Thanks, guys, for everything.
(The akuma halts in the air.)
Shadow Moth: (in his lair) How strange. The negative feelings have disappeared. But stay where you are, my little akuma. The party with teenagers always makes for a party of strong emotions.
Marinette: (peeking behind the counter) Juleka!
(As Juleka noticed her, Marinette hides behind the counter once again. Juleka walks to the counter to see Marinette.)
Marinette: Why is he here? (Juleka shies away) You couldn't tell him, could you?
Shadow Moth: (from his lair) A young girl disappointed in herself and wrecked with guilt!
(The akuma flies below the deck and heads towards Juleka.)
Marinette: Of course, you couldn't tell him. I asked you to do the impossible. I'm so sorry, Juleka. (embraces Juleka as she hugs her back)

title: Crocoduel/Transcript
text:
Crocoduel/Transcript - Intro
(The akuma halts for the second time and flies away.)
Shadow Moth: (from his lair) Again? What's going on?
Jagged Stone: Hey, kids! Everything jammin'?
(The others starts to murmur upon his arrival.)
Luka: Hi, Dad!
Jagged Stone: Sorry I'm tardy to the party, son. You have any wrapping paper I could borrow?
(The party music stops.)
Alya: Hang on. Jagged Stone...
Nino: ...is the father of...
Rose: ...Luka and Juleka?
Shadow Moth: (from his lair) A group of friends surprised to find out that two of them have been keeping secrets.
(The akuma returns to the deck and heads towards Ivan.)
Ivan: That's... so... awesome!!
(The party resumes, and the akuma flies away for the third time.)
Shadow Moth: (from his lair) Yes, well, I should've guessed.
Juleka: Oh, yeah. He's my dad.
Marinette: What?? Jagged Stone is your father? (Juleka looks away from her) Why would you think he doesn't love you and likes your brother better?
(Footsteps are heard coming towards them as Luka and Jagged enters the room.)

title: Crocoduel/Transcript
text:
Crocoduel/Transcript - Intro
Jagged Stone: You'll see, she's a real beauty! A sound that'll make your head spin. (Marinette and Juleka peek over the counter) So you better hide it, okay? (hands over a guitar case to Luka) And not a word to your sister!
(Hearing this, Juleka becomes dejected and starts crying again.)
Shadow Moth: (from his lair) Ah, a young girl whose biggest fears have come true! (The akuma heads to the bottom of the deck and targets Juleka for the second time.) And what could be worse than not being loved by your own father.
Marinette: Hang on, Juleka. I'm sure this is just a misunderstanding. You need to talk to your dad. That's how problems get solved. (stands up angrily from behind the counter to confront Jagged.) Jagged!
Jagged Stone: (shuffling his feet, shocked on Marinette's sudden appearance) Marinette!
Marinette: (notices Luka beside Jagged) Hi, Luka! Yes, I know we need to talk, and we will, but don't worry. But right now, I need to talk to your dad! Jagged, you can't just give an amazing electric guitar to your son and nothing... (struggles to pull Juleka from behind the counter) ...nothing... (grunts as she successfully pulls out Juleka beside her) ...and nothing to your daughter!

title: Crocoduel/Transcript
text:
Crocoduel/Transcript - Intro
Jagged Stone: (sighs, sarcastic) Hey, thanks a lot for your incredible discretion, Marinette. Rock and roll. Actually, this was supposed to be a surprise gift for Juleka. Juleka plays bass for Kitty Section, right? So I thought it'd be cool if I gave her the very first bass I ever owned. (pulls out a bass guitar from the guitar case and hands it to Juleka) Happy birthday, Juleka.
Juleka: Thank you!
(Jagged smiles fondly at Juleka. Shadow Moth groans and face palms in his lair.)
Jagged Stone: And of course, I've got a present for my two kids. My gift for Luka was this original edition of the first LP from Crocoduo, the group I had with their mom. (blows the dust away from the vinyl and hands it to Luka) Happy birthday, Luka.
Anarka: Jagged Stone, you really are a shipwrecker. How dare you come here and give my son the album that caused our break-up?!
Jagged Stone: "Caused our break-up"?? You mean the album to help me get my life back after you left me!
Anarka: (stomps her way towards Jagged) You got a lot of nerve, pirate! You were the one who left me! (pulls the vinyl from his hands)
Jagged Stone: No, you were!!

title: Crocoduel/Transcript
text:
Crocoduel/Transcript - Intro
Shadow Moth: (from his lair) Finally! Two fractured lovers full of resentment and anger!
(The akuma flies in the room, heading towards the vinyl Anarka and Jagged are tugging each other. As the akuma lands on the vinyl, the disc breaks in two, causing Anarka and Jagged to fall on the ground, now possessed by the akuma. Luka, Juleka (who accidentally drops the bass) and Marinette gasp in fear.)
Shadow Moth: (from his lair) Crocoduel, I am Shadow Moth. I'm giving you the power to get back together, to better tear each other apart! You finally have the chance to prove to the other that you were right. All I ask in return is that one of you bring me Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous. May the best rocker win!
(Anarka and Jagged, as well as the whole houseboat are now being engulfed by the akuma's power, turning them into Captain Hardrock and Guitar Villain, respectively. Marinette, Luka and Juleka run to the top of the boat.)
Marinette: Everybody, get out of the boat! Quick!
(The others step out to the docks and gasp in horror as the houseboat is completely engulfed by the akuma. Captain Hardrock and Guitar Villain are now floating in the sky, facing off against each other.)

title: Crocoduel/Transcript
text:
Crocoduel/Transcript - Intro
Captain Hardrock: Ye selfish sea dog, ye sailed off on your own cruise leaving two little mateys behind!
Guitar Villain: I had to go solo after you destroyed our duo!
Captain Hardrock: Liberty, (brings out her cutlass) fire!!
(Liberty begins to fire cannonballs at Guitar Villain, who dodges.)
Guitar Villain: Ultimate Solo!
(Powerful ripples from his guitar pushes Captain Hardrock aback, as well as the vehicles on the ground.)
Juleka: (softly, from below) Stop arguing, start talking!
Marinette: (to Alya) You-know-who needs a little help to slip away! (Alya nods)
Alya: (kneeling down) Ow! Ouch! I think I just sprained my ankle!
(As Alya gets the attention of the others, Marinette makes her escape behind a wall. She unlocks her purse and Tikki comes out of it.)
Marinette: (to Tikki) Time to transform!
(Marinette transforms into Ladybug and swings away. Nino and Ivan help Alya climb up the stairs. Luka and Juleka watch Crocoduel fight.)
Captain Hardrock: (growls) Come back here, you scallywag!
Guitar Villain: You have to catch me!

title: Crocoduel/Transcript
text:
Crocoduel/Transcript - Intro
(Ladybug hurls her yo-yo at the top of the Eiffel Tower, taking a closer look at Captain Hardrock and Guitar Villain's battle. She lassoes her yo-yo once again, this time at Guitar Villain, but misses.)
Guitar Villain: Ha ha ha! Your powers are off-key, Ladybug!
Captain Hardrock: You shouldn't venture into deep waters if you don't know how to swim!
Shadow Moth: (from his lair) Now, Crocoduel! Seize their Miraculous!
Guitar Villain: Ladybug's Miraculous is mine!
Captain Hardrock: No, mine!!(Crocoduel flies toward Ladybug as she dives from the Eiffel Tower)Ladybug: Whenever you're ready, Cat Noir! The show's already started! (swings around the Eiffel Tower as she is being chased by Crocoduel)''
Stylist: Quick, Monsieur Adrien! We better seek shelter while Ladybug and Cat Noir deal with this!
Adrien: The show must go on! Find safety. I'll finish putting on my make-up myself. (closes the dressing room door)
Stylist: Oh! What a pro! (runs away)
Adrien: Plagg, claws out! (transforms into Cat Noir)
Captain Hardrock: Unless you want to be crushed by my cannonballs, Ladybug, give your Miraculous!

title: Crocoduel/Transcript
text:
Crocoduel/Transcript - Intro
Guitar Villain: No! You're going to give your jewels to me, or my Awesome Solo will destroy Par—
(Before he could continue, Cat Noir jumps on top of him and throws his baton at Captain Hardrock, knocking her down from Liberty's wheel. He then lands beside Ladybug.)
Cat Noir: Bugaboo, promise me that we won't be like them when we're an old couple.
Ladybug: For that to happen, we'd have to be a couple first, Kitty Cat!
(Ladybug lassoes her yo-yo in the air while Cat Noir vaults upward with his baton.)
Guitar Villain: Hey! Where do you think you're going?
(Crocoduel begins to chase them on the rooftops. Cat Noir uses his stick to knock off Guitar Villain on top of his dragon, but his dragon is able to catch him from falling.)
Captain Hardrock: Don't tell me you're gonna let those two house pets beat us?! (laughs maniacally, then searches for Ladybug who is now right behind her) Huh? Where did she go?
Guitar Villain: I'm the only one who gets to shipwreck you, Captain Hardrock!
(He flies towards Captain Hardrock. Ladybug tries to capture him but fails to do so. She swings to the ground as Cat Noir joins her.)
Captain Hardrock: Come on, Guitar Villain! We've got a duel to finish!

title: Crocoduel/Transcript
text:
Crocoduel/Transcript - Intro
Guitar Villain: You stay here! We'll be back for you!
Captain Hardrock: Steer a course to the sky! (laughs)
(Crocoduel flies upward, toward the clouds.)
Cat Noir: Hey, no fair! We don't have any wings or a flying pirate ship!
Guitar Villain: So, where were we?
Captain Hardrock: The only thing you've ever cared about is your music!
Guitar Villain: Our music!
Captain Hardrock: Liberty, (extends her cutlass) fire at will!!
(Cannons began firing again at Guitar Villain. He dodges every single cannon flying at him.)
Guitar Villain: Awesome Solo! (sends power ripples from his guitar at Captain Hardrock and dodges them too)
Shadow Moth: (from his lair, sighing) They'll tire of this eventually.
Ladybug: To think that they were in love once...
Luka: Looks like those feelings are long gone.
Ladybug: (detaches her yo-yo from her waist) Still, it's no reason to stop talking to each other. Lucky Charm!
(As she summons her power, a tape roll lands on her hands.)
Cat Noir: Not sure if that's gonna be strong enough to patch things up between them, m'lady.
Ladybug: We need someone to listen to!
(Ladybug hurls her yo-yo away and holds Juleka beside her. She turns her head around to see Luka.)

title: Crocoduel/Transcript
text:
Crocoduel/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: Luka, don't stay here. We'll talk later. I-I mean, it's not safe. (swings away with Juleka)
Cat Noir: Where's she going? Eh, I'll just protect Paris on my own. (vaults away, leaving Luka behind)
Ladybug: You okay?
(Juleka nods. Ladybug does a swipe on her yo-yo, taking out the Tiger Miraculous and hands it over to her.)
Ladybug: Juleka Couffaine, here is the Miraculous of the tiger, which gives the power of clout. You will use it for the greater good.
(As Juleka grabs the Tiger Miraculous from Ladybug, the paw on the center begins to glow, summoning the tiger kwami, Roaar.)
Roaar: (roars, which scares Juleka) Let's cause some havoc!!
Ladybug: Once the job is done, you will return the Miraculous to me. Can I trust you?
Juleka: (weakly) Yes.
Roaar: What? I can't hear you!
Juleka: (hesitates, softly) ...Yes.
Roaar: (flies toward Juleka as she steps back) I still can't hear you! Come on, is that all you got?
Juleka: I said... YES!!!
(Juleka's yell pushes Roaar onto the wall)
Roaar: Ooohh! You are good! You and I are gonna get along just fine! All you gotta say now is, "Roaar, stripes on!"
[Transformation Sequence]Juleka: Roaar, stripes on!

title: Crocoduel/Transcript
text:
Crocoduel/Transcript - Intro
Roaar: There you gooooo!! (Juleka transforms into Purple Tigress.)
Random Civilian: Thank you, Cat Noir! (runs off)
(Ladybug arrives on the scene with Purple Tigress.)
Ladybug: Hey, Kitty Cat! You're gonna have to throw us up as high as you can! Can you do that?
Cat Noir: I can sure try! (to Purple Tigress) Hey there! I'm Cat Noir, and you are?
Purple Tigress: I'm... uhh... Purple Tigress!
Cat Noir: Purple Tigress? (goes beside her and snuggles her) Meow! That makes us practically family!
(Ladybug hits her face with her palm in annoyance. Cat Noir extends his baton on the ground, long enough for Ladybug and Purple Tigress to vault up through the clouds. Ladybug and Purple Tigress grab onto the baton.)
Cat Noir: Here we go! (launches Ladybug and Purple Tigress up to the sky)
(Ladybug and Purple Tigress soar in the air, reaching Captain Hardrock and Guitar Villain.)
Ladybug: (upon landing on Liberty) Ahoy, Captain Hardrock!
Purple Tigress: (upon landing on Guitar Villain's dragon) Time to turn the volume down, Da— uh— Guitar Villain!

title: Crocoduel/Transcript
text:
Crocoduel/Transcript - Intro
(Guitar Villain is about to swing his guitar at Purple Tigress as she also pulls her Bolas out from her waist. Guitar Villain and Purple Tigress begin their battle, as well as Ladybug and Captain Hardrock on Liberty. Ladybug grabs the broken half of the akumatized vinyl from Captain Hardrock's back and jumps at a distance from her.)
Captain Hardrock: Give that back, Ladybug!
(Purple Tigress also manages to grab the other broken piece of the akumatized vinyl from Guitar Villain.)
Guitar Villain: Hey, come back! You're ruining the music!
(Purple Tigress joins Ladybug by Liberty and together, they break the broken halves of the vinyl, only with no akuma emerging from it.)
Ladybug: Where's the akuma?
Purple Tigress: I'm sure I saw it go in there!
Captain Hardrock: I'll make ye walk the plank, vermin!

title: Crocoduel/Transcript
text:
Crocoduel/Transcript - Intro
Guitar Villain: (laughs) Not in the top 10 anymore, are we?(Crocoduel corners Ladybug and Purple Tigress at Liberty.)Guitar Villain: Rockin' Riff, Baby! (produces powerful ripples from his guitar)(Ladybug and Purple Tigress jump off Liberty, now falling from the sky. Cat Noir extends his stick to catch them as Ladybug and Purple Tigress slide down on it.)Cat Noir: It didn't work? (returns his baton behind him)Ladybug: I don't get it!
Purple Tigress: The akuma entered these objects before they were torn and separated.
Ladybug: Oh! (She uses her Lucky Vision, eyeing the tape roll and the broken pieces of the akumatized vinyl that she and Purple Tigress are holding, and Purple Tigress herself.) We broke them separately, so we should actually join them together to break them together again!(Crocoduel is now flying towards them.)Captain Hardrock: Full speed ahead!!

title: Crocoduel/Transcript
text:
Crocoduel/Transcript - Intro
Guitar Villain: Awesome Solo!! (The three heroes run off as Crocoduel chases them through the streets. They are now hiding beside a building.)Captain Hardrock: (laughs evilly)Guitar Villain: Rockin' Riff, Baby!(Purple Tigress growls)Ladybug: Go ahead, Purple Tigress! Keep them at bay!(Purple Tigress jumps away. Ladybug places the broken pieces of the akumatized vinyl on the ground as Purple Tigress runs to the top of a monument. She then activates her power as Crocoduel flies at her direction.)[Superpower Sequence]Purple Tigress: Clout! (A powerful orb of energy now wraps around Purple Tigress' right fist.)Purple Tigress: Mom, Dad, I'm sorry, but... talk it over instead of arguing!!(She jumps towards Captain Hardrock as her power collides with Liberty, sending it flying up in the sky and bringing Guitar Villain with them. Purple Tigress joins Ladybug and Cat Noir.)Ladybug: (now holding the tape-wrapped akumatized vinyl) It's up to you, Kitty!

title: Crocoduel/Transcript
text:
Crocoduel/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: Cataclysm! (disintegrates the akumatized vinyl)(The akuma finally emerges from the broken pieces of the akumatized object.)Ladybug: (swipes open her yo-yo) No more evil-doing for you, little akuma! title: Daizzi/History
text:
Daizzi/History - Intro
Daizzi is the kwami connected to the Pig Miraculous. Currently, he lets Rose Lavillant transform into Pigella.

title: Daizzi/History
text:
Daizzi/History - Before [[Season 1]]
When the concept of Jubilation came into existence, Daizzi came into existence. Before the Miraculous jewels were created, Daizzi and the other kwamis traveled all over the universe unable to interact with humans. Then, thousands of years ago, a mage created the Miraculouses. When his Miraculous was not being worn, Daizzi was dormant in the Pig Miraculous, which was stored inside the Miracle Box.

title: Daizzi/History
text:
Daizzi/History - Season 1
During Season 1, Daizzi was dormant in the Pig Miraculous.

title: Daizzi/History
text:
Daizzi/History - [[Season 2]]
During Season 2, Daizzi was dormant in the Pig Miraculous.
In "Sandboy", Daizzi was celebrating Nooroo's birthday in the Miracle Box with the other kwamis and was excited when Tikki and Plagg arrived. After interrupting Pollen to ask what the two brought as presents for the occasion, he marveled at Tikki's gift, a yellow marker. The kwamis thought it was a paintbrush and played with it until Xuppu started the party. When the time came to contact Nooroo, Daizzi got into his required position. In the effort to contact him, but the kwamis contacted his wielder instead. Upon hearing the villain's voice, the kwami shuddered at the thought of being his slave. To prevent the discovery of their whereabouts, the kwamis broke off the connection and realized that if they contacted Nooroo's wielder rather than Nooroo himself, then someone must have been akumatized and that Tikki's and Plagg's wielders were in danger.

title: Daizzi/History
text:
Daizzi/History - [[Season 3]]
During season 3, Daizzi was dormant in the Pig Miraculous.
In "Kwamibuster", he was activated along with his kwami brothers and sisters to help Multimouse enact her plan to rescue Tikki and Plagg. During the confrontation, Daizzi was one of the few kwamis to avoid capture. After Kwamibuster's defeat, Daizzi and the others cheered for Marinette as their plan was a success and was returned to Miracle Box.
In "Miracle Queen", he was activated alongside Stompp, Roaar, Ziggy, Barkk, Mullo, Orikko, and Fluff, by Queen Bee with the intent to use them against Ladybug and Cat Noir. After being commanded to transform her, the kwamis all collectively withheld their transformation phrases. Upon hearing Master Fu renounce his title, Daizzi and the others protest but Master Fu does so anyway, resulting in the Miracle Box changing shape and form. After failing to escape, Queen Bee throws off their respective Miraculouses, and they, alongside their kwamis, are returned to the Miracle Box by Ladybug.

title: Daizzi/History
text:
Daizzi/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Truth", Daizzi was accidentally released from the Miracle Box when Marinette tried to figure out its functions. In his eagerness, Daizzi was awed by everything he saw. Particularly, he was interested in Marinette's lamp. During a video call on his new guardian's computer, Daizzi and the other kwamis surrounded the screen in amazement, and upon seeing Marinette's friends, Daizzi found them very cute, wanting Alya as his wielder. However, he was told by Trixx that Alya was already taken and she was his wielder. When Marinette leaves for her date with Luka, he and the kwamis hide with the Miracle Box. When the kwamis hear the titular villain break into Marinette's room, Daizzi panics at the thought of being discovered by Hawk Moth again, but Ladybug and Cat Noir defeat him.
After the titular villain's defeat, Daizzi and the others saw that Marinette was sad about breaking up with Luka to the point of tears. He didn't know exactly how to help, but he joined with his friends in giving their new guardian a group hug.
In "Lies", Daizzi was seen playing with the other kwamis.

title: Daizzi/History
text:
Daizzi/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Gang of Secrets", he was seen talking with some of the other kwamis until his guardian arrived home. Later, he and the others hear Marinette voicing her distress about being condemned to a life of secrets and lies forever because of her alter ego. When they hear someone coming, the kwamis including Daizzi hide in the Miracle Box. After the Gang of Secrets had been defeated, Daizzi and the others look on as Marinette unveiled her secret to Alya.
In "Mr. Pigeon 72", Daizzi was in Marinette's room and saw that Barkk and Roaar were playing with one of their guardian's designer hats until he and Ziggy took it. Then, he worked with Alya and the kwamis to clean Marinette's room.

title: Daizzi/History
text:
Daizzi/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Furious Fu", hearing that Master Fu was returning, Daizzi, along with his friends expressed a desire to see him again despite Marinette trying to keep them hidden for their safety. When his new guardian voiced concerns about leaving the Miracle Box unguarded, Daizzi realized if someone stayed to guard the box, the others could go, but then the kwamis cheated their way out. As a result, they thought all of them would be going, but they were stopped by Marinette. As a last resort, they used the "puppy dog eyes" on her, and Marinette reluctantly agreed. However, Daizzi and the kwamis had a hard time keeping quiet while in Marinette's bag but were pleased to hear that Master Fu was doing well and had become a great painter.
Upon returning home, Daizzi realized that Su-Han had returned to reclaim the box as he was the previous guardian before Master Fu's incident. With Su-Han's strictness, he and the other kwamis sadly returned to the box. After seeing Ladybug's valiant actions against the titular villain, Su-Han realized that Master Fu's choice wasn't so bad, allowing Daizzi and the kwamis to stay with Marinette.

title: Daizzi/History
text:
Daizzi/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Sole Crusher", Daizzi was listening to Marinette's concerns about Zoé's change in attitude. He suggested that Zoé was cranky because she was hungry.
In "Guiltrip", Daizzi and his Miraculous was given to Rose Lavillant and upon meeting they commented how cute each other were. He aided her by transforming into Pigella and by diving into the sentimonster along with the heroes they find Reflekta. Afterwards using Gift to project her dearest desire, the trio was able to de-akumatize Juleka, and by climbing out, they were able to defeat the sentimonster. With the job done, Daizzi and Rose detransformed, and he went dormant in his Miraculous once more, returning to Ladybug.
In "Optigami", Daizzi heard that Marinette received an invite to attend an event by Audrey and was excited that he and the kwamis get to go but was told by Marinette with no owner they can't leave. After Shadow Moth's plan was foiled, he heard Marinette and Alya talk about mistakes and learning from them. Coming to a realization, Daizzi heard that Trixx was going to be with Alya on a permanent basis.

title: Daizzi/History
text:
Daizzi/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Sentibubbler", Daizzi and his siblings were woken up when Marinette had a nightmare about Alya betraying her to Shadow Moth, Daizzi like the others were agreed that Alya was the correct choice as a Miraculous holder but was worried about Trixx due to his mischievous.
In "Hack-San", Daizzi and the kwamis were aware that Marinette was leaving for a trip to London, but heard their guardian making an excuse to stay. Not wanting to leave Paris unguarded and when Daizzi heard that Marinette pretend to break her leg. Daizzi was shocked but was informed by Longg about that trick never working especially if parents want to go on vacation.
In "Wishmaker", when Marinette explained what a career was, Daizzi and the kwamis voiced ideas on what she could do in life until Sass silenced them, asking Marinette himself what she wanted to do; then saw her leave for the career expo.
In "Simpleman", Daizzi felt very dizzy when Manon, Ella and Etta shook the sewing box.

title: Daizzi/History
text:
Daizzi/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Dearest Family", after Tikki ate the pieces of galette, Marinette brought for them, the kwamis quickly realized what she did. Daizzi huddled together with the others when they realized the danger Tikki's hunger for candy can represent, despite the kwami of Creation refusal at that. When Tikki and Marinette left, the kwamis flew around in a panic. Shortly after he watched Marinette, realize that Sass warning was real and transforms to stop Tikki only to be affected by her hunger, which scared him.
Hearing a commotion downstairs, Daizzi and the others were commanded to hide. After Ladybug saved her family, Daizzi and the kwamis see her return with pieces of galette for them. Despite that they were still nervous regarding Tikki, until Marinette ensured them that Tikki will control herself and the kwamis ate the pieces of galette happily.

title: Daizzi/History
text:
Daizzi/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Ephemeral", during the fight against Moolak, Daizzi and his Miraculous were given to Rose and transformed into Pigella. After the battle, Daizzi and his jewel were returned to Ladybug. Later, they briefly met Sass owner Luka when he came into Marinette's room, but their introductions were cut short when Luka received a message from Ladybug allowing Sass to use his power to go back to the last marked time.
Soon Daizzi discovered why as he and everyone noticed the Absolute Power being activated meaning Shadow Moth obtained the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses and started his wish. Sass explained to Luka the consequences of it and the latter hurried the former to use his power, which he does, causing the kwamis encounter with Luka to be erased.
In "Kuro Neko", during the fight against Gigantitan, Daizzi and his Miraculous were given to Rose to become Pigella again. Later, Daizzi and the other kwamis tried to comfort Marinette after Cat Noir gave up on his Miraculous and was surprised to learn that she intended to replace him with someone who doesn't love her.

title: Daizzi/History
text:
Daizzi/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Penalteam", Daizzi and his Miraculous were used again by Rose to become Pigella and help Ladybug, along with many other heroes, to defeat Penalteam.
In "Risk", Daizzi and his Miraculous were briefly given back to Rose. Later, Daizzi and the other kwamis watched Marinette search for different ways to sabotage Adrien and Lila's journey, unaware that she was under the influence of Risk's superpowers.
In "Strikeback", after Flairmidable betrayed Ladybug by stealing her yo-yo, his Miraculous, along with all the others, was given to Gabriel Agreste in exchange for the Peacock Miraculous.

title: Daizzi/History
text:
Daizzi/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Evolution", Daizzi is seen with the other kwamis as Gabriel begins using their powers for his own benefits. He and the others were forced to accompany Monarch when he used the Rabbit Miraculous to travel through time to any moment he could try to get the Ladybug and Cat Miraculous. When in the Burrow, Daizzi and the kwamis manage to exit the cane and plead for Ladybug to save them before Monarch forced them back in.
When Monarch travels to the time when Reverser had changed the abilities and personalities of Ladybug and Cat Noir, Monarch questions why he is feeling weakened. Sass explains that the kwamis need food to keep up their strength or else there will be dire effects to them and Gabriel. Monarch is forced to find Nathalie to get the kwamis food.
In "Multiplication", Daizzi's miraculous was destroyed by Gabriel and re-shaped into an Alliance Ring.
In "Destruction", when Gabriel becomes angry at Orikko for not being able to grant the specific abilities he wanted because of the Sublimation limitations, Daizzi would defend Orikko from Gabriel calling him useless until he and the others were forced to be silent.

title: Daizzi/History
text:
Daizzi/History - [[Season 5]]
Gabriel would then force the kwamis to try to speak Ladybug's real name but were prevented by the magic spell since Ladybug is still their holder. They were then forced to show Gabriel where Ladybug lives only to trick him in going on a scavenger hunt for her address. When Monarch appeared to have been captured by Ladybug and Cat Noir, the kwamis tried to return to Ladybug but were forced to stay with Monarch when he teleported away.
In "Jubilation", Daizzi's power of Jubilation was given to Darker Owl who forced a shared dream onto Ladybug and Cat Noir. The two were able to break free from the dream and Daizzi's powers were returned when Darker Owl was defeated.
it:Daizzi/Storia

title: Courage in Me

Courage in Me - Trivia
Lou Jean is the singing voice actress of Marinette/Ladybug in both English and French versions.
Its official music video was released on July 23, 2023 on the official Miraculous YouTube channel.
It contains clips from the movie.
Marinette's original English voice actor, Cristina Vee, released a cover of the song on her 2023 covers album "Obnoxious Theater Kid".

title: Daddycop
text:
Daddycop - Intro
"" is a season 6 episode of the series Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. Based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 4th written and produced episode of season 6. It is also the 135th written and produced episode of the series overall.

title: Daddycop
text:
Daddycop - Synopsis
To celebrate her hundredth kiss with Adrien, Marinette has planned a romantic evening - forgetting that she'd already planned a movie night with her girlfriends at the same time!
TV Guide
To honor her hundredth kiss with her boyfriend Adrien, Marinette plans a romantic evening alone with him, but she suddenly forgets that she also planned a movie night with her girlfriends on the same day so now she has to juggle two plans.
Disney+
Ladybug and Cat Noir face an overprotective villain.

title: Daddycop
text:
Daddycop - Plot
The episode begins with Sabrina watching a video of her former "friend" Chloé Bourgeois in London, bragging about her new life in said city as the aftermath of "Revolution". Barkk, worried of her holder's action of watching these videos of her ex-"BFF", encourages Sabrina that she should stop watching those videos since Chloé's really not a good person. Now encouraged by Barkk's comforting, she puts items that remind her of Chloé in the trash, including her Queen Bee action figure. Sabrina leaves her room to start the day.
Sabrina and her dad exit their apartment. He notices his daughter's reluctance as he gets in the car first. Acknowledging this, he asks her if she doesn't want to ride together like they used to. Sabrina turns his offer down quickly. Worried, Roger then offers reassurance that she could tell him anything if someone was bothering her. Sabrina quickly replies with a lie; she's ok. Some girlfriends are waiting for her at the bus-stop and they're gonna go to school together.

title: Daddycop
text:
Daddycop - Plot
Roger bids Sabrina a cheerful goodbye and drives off to work in his patrol car. Sabrina's small smile turns into a frown, presumably because she lied about her condition at the moment. She slowly walks away. She is lastly seen sitting at the bus-stop alone with her bag on her lap.
Tikki is inside Marinette’s scooter box, looking at the items inside confusedly. Poking her head out of the box, she asks Marinette why she’s so insistent on having her dinner with Adrien take place tonight. Marinette explains that the Hoa Tinh star will be in conjunction with Jupiter which, according to her mother, brings good luck. She’s convinced that if she and Adrien have their one-hundredth kiss tonight, their love story will last forever. Still in confusion, Tikki questions if Marinette won't kiss Adrien until this evening. Marinette confirms this, adding that she's gotten special authorization from the mayor of Paris, Mrs. Bustier for Fire Captain Hessenpy from the Paris Fire Brigade to put on a fireworks display especially for the occasion.

title: Daddycop
text:
Daddycop - Plot
Tikki admires for a second how Marinette thoroughly thought about everything. Marinette tells her kwami that that's right, love requires planning. Speaking of planning, she points out that she has just enough time to (drive back home to) put tonight's meal in the fridge and make it to school on time. Surprisingly enough, she spoke too soon. Her scooter breaks down, leaving her stuck in the middle of a road. Marinette panics.
As Marinette panics, Sabrina's bus pulls up, and she notices her from the window exiting the bus; she runs up to her trying to get her attention. Marinette is completely focused on her phone call not noticing Sabrina, she explains to the mechanic that she can't postpone the dinner, and she needs her scooter fixed right now. Sabrina, hearing this, goes to transform. She comes back as Miss Hound and offers her help by using her ability to fetch to quickly transport the broken scooter to the mechanic. While she's doing that, Marinette turns into Ladybug to get home faster with her groceries, but when Miss Hound returns and finds Marinette gone, disheartened, she turns back into Sabrina and heads off to school, as Barkk looks on with deep concern.

title: Daddycop
text:
Daddycop - Plot
At school, Juleka, Rose, Mylène, Kagami, Alya, and Zoé are preparing for their weekly movie night at Marinette's. When they see Marinette going to speak to Adrien, they confront the two to remind Marinette of movie night, but it appears that, because of Marinette's focus on making her 100th kiss with Adrien perfect, she totally forgot, and Kagami calls her out on it. As a result, Adrien later tells Marinette that he is cancelling coming to the dinner she had planned, mainly because he doesn't want to ruin her movie night with the other girls. While Marinette struggles to convince Adrien to come so her plans are not ruined, Zoé, noticing Sabrina sitting alone and looking deeply upset, goes to speak to her. Sabrina admits to still being ashamed and guilt-ridden for everything she did against Marinette and the others while serving as Chloé's lackey. Zoé assures her she's changed for the better since cutting ties with Chloé, and even offers her to come over to the girls' movie night to help cheer her up.

title: Daddycop
text:
Daddycop - Plot
Later, in the science lab, Zoé attempts to convince the other girls to invite Sabrina to their movie night, but they are reluctant because of their own contempt of Sabrina being Chloé's henchgirl. Zoé calls them out for not giving Sabrina a chance to show that she changed her ways and points out that Chloé still would have been bullying them if Sabrina hadn't found the courage to stand up to her. Knowing that Zoé was right, the other girls don't even try to deny her statement as Alya tells Zoé that she can ask Marinette about inviting Sabrina. In the meantime, Marinette tries to see if Adrien would still come if she holds her girls movie night alongside the dinner and the girls agree to it. As a result of the confusion that follows, Zoé finds Sabrina in the library and confirms her invitation, prompting a hug from her. Sabrina believes that Marinette agreed to invite her to the movie night, and the girls agreed to allow Adrien to come to have his dinner with Marinette.

title: Daddycop
text:
Daddycop - Plot
At Marinette's house, the girls are confused when they see all the decorations Marinette set up for her and Adrien, while Sabrina excitedly told her father of what happened, and he takes her home to get ready with his light and siren on. As Marinette looks for Adrien, she soon hears her doorbell ring. Rushing downstairs to answer it, she's surprised and confused to find Sabrina there. Explaining that she was waiting for Adrien and had not invited Sabrina, both of them become downcast and disheartened upon learning the truth. As a result, Sabrina leaves crying, while Marinette somberly watches the Paris Fire Brigade and Captain Hessenpy set off the fireworks.

title: Daddycop
text:
Daddycop - Plot
Sabrina calls her father, telling him to come pick her up as she now believes she doesn't belong in Paris at all, believing Marinette and the other girls still hate her for her actions as Chloé's lackey. Enraged to see his daughter upset, Lt. Raincomprix immediately turns his cruiser around and rushes to her aid with his light and siren on. At the same time, back with Marinette, she explains the whole situation to the other girls, and as they wonder who it was at the door if it wasn't Adrien, Zoé realizes to her horror that it was Sabrina, and rushes to leave to go find her, followed by Alya, Kagami, Juleka, Rose, and Mylène.
Meanwhile, as Sabrina weeps, one of Chrysalis' Ultrakumas finds her and infects her whistle. As Sabrina gasps upon realizing she's being contacted by the Butterfly Miraculous holder that succeeded Hawk Moth/Shadow Moth/Monarch/Gabriel Agreste, Chrysalis barely starts to speak to her before Sabrina furiously rejects the Ultrakuma, refusing to be Akumatized ever again thanks to her training with Ladybug and the other Miraculous heroes.

title: Daddycop
text:
Daddycop - Plot
Seeing she was unable to Akumatize Sabrina, Chrysalis has her Ultrakuma seek out her father, Lt. Raincomprix, instead. As the Ultrakuma infects his patrol car as he was still rushing to Sabrina's aid with his light and siren on, Chrysalis contacts him and offers him power to help him seek justice for what has happened to his daughter. Knowing he has to right this wrong, he accepts, and asks to be transformed into "Daddycop", the powerful version of Rogercop. Chrysalis grants his request, and Roger and his cruiser are Akumatized, with his cruiser becoming a hovercraft with red-and-blue emergency lights, and Roger himself sporting armor styled with red-and-blue lights as well.

title: Daddycop
text:
Daddycop - Plot
As Zoé and the other girls find Sabrina and rush to her aid, they are halted by Daddycop, who places them under arrest for the emotional trauma they've caused his daughter. Realizing what's happened, Sabrina pleads to her father that they're innocent, but he ignores her pleas as he intends to force the girls to see Sabrina as he sees her: Through the eyes of love, and fires his red-and-blue lasers at them, striking Alya, Kagami, Mylène, Zoé, Rose, and Juleka, causing them to bend over stunned, but when they recover, they've been brainwashed into being entranced and saying hypnotically, "Sabrina, we love you.", and chasing her down when she flees in fright. Witnessing it from her balcony, Marinette realizes things have gotten really bad, and ducks out of sight to have Tikki turn her into Ladybug.
Back with Daddycop, he continues to zap Parisians at random to entrance them into joining the mob chasing after Sabrina, until they corner her in an alleyway.
Luckily for Sabrina, Ladybug rescues her, but then has to flee as Daddycop pursues her to get Sabrina back.
Cat Noir soon joins them, and Ladybug has him provide a distraction for her.

title: Daddycop
text:
Daddycop - Plot
Turning into Astrocat, Cat Noir heads off to draw off Daddycop.
While Astrocat keeps Daddycop busy, Ladybug turns to Sabrina, asking for Miss Hound's assistance.
However, still consumed by feelings of guilt for her past mistakes, Sabrina takes off the Dog Miraculous and offers it back to Ladybug, believing she is unworthy of it and being part of the Miraculers team because of her own past atrocities.
Ladybug doesn't see it that way, assuring Sabrina she's become a better person since then when she used it to defeat her former friend Chloé as Penalty, and Ladybug believes in her.
Sabrina is taken back by this, but when Ladybug encourages her to see the Sabrina she wants to be deep down and believe in herself, motivated by Ladybug's wisdom, Sabrina is able to will the Dog Miraculous to take on a new appearance before affixing it to her clothes again, summoning Barkk, and transforming into Miss Hound again, this time with a new costume to boot, much to Miss Hound's amazement before Ladybug assures her she's incredible.

title: Daddycop
text:
Daddycop - Plot
Back with Daddycop, as Astrocat continues to toy with him and evade his attacks, Daddycop is contacted by Chrysalis, telling him to turn around and face Astrocat as she had a plan to deal with him. Despite his initial hesitation, Daddycop complies, and Chrysalis sends an Anti-kuma through Daddycop, hitting Astrocat, forcing him to revert back into Cat Noir, with his Miraculous powers disabled, causing him to fall out of the sky. Luckily, Ladybug, having transformed into Cosmobug, is able to rescue him with a Lucky Charm air mattress, and takes over serving as the decoy, telling Cat Noir to recharge and rendezvous with Miss Hound at the very auto shop Miss Hound took Marinette's scooter to earlier, as Cosmobug has a trap set up for Daddycop.
As Miss Hound arrives at the auto shop, she then contacts Max via the same summon system Ladybug installed in her yo-yo, only Miss Hound accessed it through her ball. When Max gets the call, he has Kaalki turn him into Pegasus before using Voyage to rendezvous with Miss Hound and a recovered Cat Noir, who comments on Miss Hound's new look before she tells them that Ladybug has a plan to de-akumatize Daddycop.

title: Daddycop
text:
Daddycop - Plot
Meanwhile, as Cosmobug continues to evade Daddycop's shots, she heads for the Arc de Triomphe.
As she approaches it, she contacts Miss Hound, who confirms that she, Pegasus, and Cat Noir are in position and ready.
Timing it right, she gives them the signal, and Pegasus opens a Voyage portal to the auto shop from the archway of the Arc.
Caught off-guard by this, there's nothing Daddycop can do as he flies through it still chasing Cosmobug, allowing Miss Hound to tag his hovercraft cruiser with her ball, recall it with Fetch, and allow Cat Noir to Cataclysm it, reducing it to a rusted wreck, releasing the Ultrakuma.
As Daddycop falls towards the ground, he turns back into Lt.
Raincomprix, who is rescued by Cosmobug and placed safely on the ground next to what's left of his cruiser, before she reverts back to Ladybug and sees to capturing and purifying the Ultrakuma, then using her Miraculous Ladybug to fix all the damage to Paris, returning everyone entranced by Daddycop to normal, leaving them confused and startled when they can get their bearings again, and restoring Roger's cruiser back to its original appearance.

title: Daddycop
text:
Daddycop - Plot
She then gifts him a Magical Charm, and some encouraging words regarding his love for Sabrina, which Miss Hound overhears, beaming proudly, before sharing a "Pound It" fist bump with Pegasus, Ladybug, and Cat Noir.
Meanwhile, in her lair, Cerise transforms back from Chrysalis. When Nooroo questions what happened and whether her actions are truly necessary, Cerise silences him with a snap of her fingers. She scolds him that she did not give him permission to speak, referring to him simply as "kwami" instead of using his name. Then, she opens another of her journals and resumes writing as she tries to devise another plot.

title: Daddycop
text:
Daddycop - Plot
Later, Sabrina is at Marinette's for the movie night. Lt. Raincomprix is on the phone, double-checking to make sure she's okay, but Sabrina and Marinette assure him everything's fine before hanging up. Afterwards, Sabrina formally apologizes to the other girls, admitting that she knows that she wasn't always nice to them because she was Chloé's helper, but tells them that she has changed and that she will be happy to be their friend if they give her a chance. The girls instantly accepts Sabrina's apology and Marinette points out that everyone make mistakes and tells Sabrina that she was a victim of Chloé too and that she was very brave standing up to her and separating herself from her. She also apologizes for being so focused on her relationship with Adrien, that she forgot to give her attention to the ones who really helped the most and promises to be more attentive and hugs Sabrina. The other girls joins in and give her a group hug and welcomes her with open arms.

title: Daddycop
text:
Daddycop - Plot
As a result, the next day or so at school, Sabrina appears before the others sporting a new look and new confidence. The others are very impressed, and while everyone else comments on Sabrina's new look, Marinette and Adrien share a private moment as Marinette apologizes for wanting to make their 100th kiss perfect, and Adrien responds with sharing their 101st kiss with her, leaving both laughing.
However, in the ending stinger, Zoé emerges from the restroom to find an old enemy named Ray from New York waiting for her. He taunts her by calling her "Cockroach" and shows her a video from her past in NYC, where she is seen behaving like a bully. He threatens to reveal the video to her friends. Quick to react, Zoé snatches the cellphone, deletes the video, and hands it back to Ray. However, he smugly retorts that nothing in the digital world ever truly disappears, including her past actions in New York. He calls her "Cockroach" once more before walking away, laughing maliciously and arrogantly, while Zoé glares at him with silent contempt and fury.

title: Daddycop
text:
Daddycop - Plot Developments
It is revealed that after getting hit by an antikuma, the Miraculous holder can detransform and transform back to regain their superpowers.
Furthermore, antikumas also have the ability to nullify power-ups.
It is also revealed that the amount of antikumas released can be controlled, as Chrysalis only sent one from Daddycop, as opposed to "Sublimation" where she sent an uncontrollable swarm.
It is revealed that Raymond Pugnant, one of Zoé's schoolmates, and most likely her tormentor from her boarding school, is also attending the Françoise Dupont and threatens to show everyone who Zoé really was back in NYC.
Although this episode is Ray's proper debut, his picture appeared on Aurore Beauréal's phone as part of Chloé's contest on the Bee Community in "Climatiqueen".
Zoé’s old design is shown briefly at the end of the episode.
Sabrina becomes one of the few people to reject an akuma before being akumatized and the first to reject an ultrakuma.
At 9 seconds, this is also the fastest time anyone has rejected an akuma.
This would be broken by Mylène in "Noe".
Sabrina refers to the French Miraculous superhero team as the "Miraculers".

title: Daddycop
text:
Daddycop - Plot Developments
The name was later shown to be coined by Ladybug in the opening scene in "Revelator".
Interestingly, that was her akumatized villain name for the episode of the same name.
It is revealed that large objects, such as police cars, can act as akumatized objects. Previously (e.g. in "Rogercop", "Captain Hardrock", "Startrain" and "Crocoduel"), the akuma either only infected a part of the vehicle or it was transformed as an extension of the villain.
It is revealed that Ladybug is not the only one who can use the feature to call other heroes, but other heroes can use it with their tools as well. This may be so the other heroes can call Ladybug whenever an akumatized villain appears when they are transformed, to call other heroes either when they are in need of their help or to call them when Ladybug can't.
In "The Illustrhater", Rena Rouge called Marinette normally instead of using this feature. It's likely it can't be used when both holders are transformed, as they could just use their weapons' phone modes, like how they could in the previous seasons.
Sabrina becomes one of the few people to reject an akuma before being akumatized and the first to reject an ultrakuma.

title: Daddycop
text:
Daddycop - Trivia
This is the second episode where there are two scenes following the end card, after "Revolution".
This is the second time Cat Noir has been hit by antikumas, after "Sublimation".
This is the last episode Miss Hound is shown in her original superhero outfit.
However, her original superhero outfit appeared in "Revelator" pre-opening scene.
This is (at least so far) the only episode where a member of the French Miraculous superhero team was seen in both their Season 1-5 and Season 6 superhero forms.
Also, starting from this episode Sabrina gets a new camouflaged mode for the Dog Miraculous after Ladybug gives her the assurance that she's a good person.
The new camouflage mode is a brooch, which is completely different from the Miraculous' usual appearance as a choker. This is the second time this has happened, after the Monkey Miraculous became a headband when worn by Marinette in "Kwamibuster".
This is ironic because in "Antibug", Sabrina received a brooch from Chloé as a sign of their former "friendship" and with the Dog Miraculous' new camouflage mode being a brooch it now symbolizes Sabrina's desire to move on from the past as well as forge a new path with real friends.

title: Daddycop
text:
Daddycop - Trivia
This episode takes place chronologically before the events of "El Toro De Piedra", "Mister Agreste", "The Illustrhater", and "Revelator", as Sabrina is wearing her outfit from Seasons 1-5 until the post-end card scene.
Since Alix is traveling through time in the Burrow, Kagami takes her place in Marinette's girlfriend group.
Juleka, Rose, Mylène, Kagami, Zoé and Sabrina are seen in their pajamas for the first time.
Ladybug uses the only Lucky Charm she summons in the episode to rescue Cat Noir, similarly to "Lady Wifi".
This is Nooroo's only speaking appearance in season 6.
In Disney Channel's Season 6 trailer, a seemingly older version of Sabrina's transformation is featured. Namely, Barkk's face can be seen, which isn't the case in the final version, and there are differences in the background.
References
It is unknown whether Roger didn't receive a Magical Charm from Ladybug after his akumatization in "Kuro Neko" or its protection was bypassed by the ultrakuma, but he gets a new one in this episode.

title: Daddycop
text:
Daddycop - Trivia
It is possible Ladybug forgot to give Roger a charm in that episode much like she initially did with André in "Glaciator 2", since no charm was shown being destroyed or it wasn't on him when it happened.
This episode, like "Adoration", also has a correlation to the meaning of the Dog:
In the terms of being accepted into a new pack after Sabrina broke off her "friendship" with Chloé, she had a hard time being accepted by Marinette and the others.
But Sabrina thought that she deserved to be alone like a lone wolf and accepted it, likely believing since Marinette and the others wouldn't forgive her nor couldn't she forgive herself for the damage she did as Chloé's minion.
It also probably comes from the guilt she feels over what she didn't do, much like Andre Bourgeois; despite being best friends, she didn't try to do anything to curb Chloé's behavior.
So much so that she also believed she didn't deserve to be a part of another pack: Team Miraculous/the Miraculers. However, Sabrina should've considered Ladybug's actions: if Ladybug was willing to forgive Chloé for her past actions, the heroine can forgive Sabrina and give her a Miraculous.

title: Daddycop
text:
Daddycop - Trivia
The difference between them was that Sabrina's attempts to change were for real (and therefore successful since she gave an apology and gained new friends) while Chloé's weren't, despite the many chances everyone gave her to prove she can change.
Similar to Rena Rouge in "Strikeback", Sabrina too wanted to renounce her Miraculous willingly but unlike Rena, Ladybug managed to convince her to keep it as a sign of her growth.
This episode bears a resemblance to "Malediktator", "Weredad" and "Kuro Neko":
As all three akumatized victims wanted the power to help or protect their daughters.
From "Weredad", after both fathers (Roger and Tom) were told they their daughters can handle their own problems.
From "Malediktator", both Sabrina and Chloé thought bad of themselves until they were encouraged by Ladybug to think otherwise.
Ladybug was wrapped up in her own problems and/or situations and she wasn't paying attention to how others (in this case Sabrina) were feeling, which causes Sabrina to nearly get akumatized (but she instantly rejected it), and Roger to get akumatized instead.
Cat Noir mentioning about escaping his fans references him doing so in "Gorizilla" and "Elation".

title: Daddycop
text:
Daddycop - Trivia
A picture of Adrien and Marinette from the end card of "The Puppeteer 2" can be seen in Marinette's room inside a blue picture frame with the picture being edited to another background.
Allusions
Two of Mylène's new pins are the "Progress Pride" flag and a peace sign colored like the rainbow, both symbols of LGBTQ+ identity.
The film Kagami wanted to see, "Lone Tigress & Cub", is a reference to the 1970 manga Lone Wolf & Cub.
The books Sabrina is holding in the library scene are actual real books: Homer's Odyssey, Gustave Flaubert's Madame Bovary and Victor Hugo's Les Misérables.
In the French version of this episode, Chrysalis keeps her trait of blending male and female voices. In the English dub, however, she only spoke with her regular voice.
Similarly to the English dub of the episode, the German dub kept her speaking with a single feminine voice as well.
Errors
At the beginning of the episode, when Miss Hound touches Marinette's scooter with her ball, the ball is both in her hands and around her neck.
Cosmobug says "Retrogradation" instead of "Power Down" to turn back into Ladybug.

title: Daddycop
text:
Daddycop - Trivia
Since this is the potions power-ups detransformation phrase in the original French version, this may have been a translation error.
Since the term retrogradation means the apparent backward motion of planets, it's also possible this is a new detransformation phrase specifically for the space power up.
Sometimes the button with the dog symbol on Miss Hound's hat is missing
Despite Sabrina owning a Magical Charm, the ultrakuma did not destroy it.
It could be presumably that she wasn't wearing it at the moment.
Another reason could be is that a Magical Charm could only repel the akumas by the Butterfly Miraculous holder they were initially akumatized, so the Magical Charm can't protect those from a new holder. It is also possible that an ultrakuma can bypass a Magical Charm.
In the English dub, Ladybug says "No more evil-doing for you, little akuma", instead of "ultrakuma".
The heroes acknowledge Daddycop's name despite them never hearing it.
When Miss Hound uses the Dog Miraculous' ball to contact Pegasus for help, her symbol for the Dog Miraculous is visible amongst the others, despite her making the call.

title: Cour Napoléon
text:
Cour Napoléon - Intro
The  is an open courtyard of the Louvre Palace in Paris.

title: Cour Napoléon
text:
Cour Napoléon - Description
The Cour Napoléon is the only open courtyard of the Louvre Palace and is made of sandstone and granite slabs. Rectangular in shape and with a surface area of ​​28,000 m2, it is bordered to the west by the Place du Carrousel, to the north by the Richelieu Wing, to the east by the Pavillon de Sully and to the south by the Denon Wing.
The center of the courtyard is dominated by the Louvre Pyramid and the adjoining pyramids and pools, which serve as the main entrance to the Louvre Museum.

title: Cour Napoléon
text:
Cour Napoléon - Trivia
In real life, an equestrian statue of Louis XIV is located near the Louvre Pyramid.
The pavilions are also decorated with "Illustrious Men", a series of 86 statues representing personalities of French culture, such as Jean de la Fontaine, Molière, Montesquieu, among others.
In the TV series, the Cour Napoléon has been important on several occasions:
In "The Pharaoh", it is in the Cour Napoléon where most of the fight between Ladybug and Cat Noir against the eponymous villain took place.
In "The Mime", he is in the Cour Napoléon where Fred was akumatized into the eponymous villain and briefly fought Ladybug and Cat Noir.
In "Ladybug & Cat Noir", a civilian was transformed into a copy of Stoneheart after Ladybug forgot to purify his akuma.
In the next episode, the duplicate woke up and set out to find the original Stoneheart at the Collège Françoise Dupont.
In "Riposte", while chasing Ladybug and Adrien, the eponymous villain arrived in the Cour Napoléon and cut the Louvre Pyramid in half with her sword.
It is also in the Cour Napoléon where Adrien and Kagami first got along.

title: Cour Napoléon
text:
Cour Napoléon - Trivia
In "Captain Hardrock", the eponymous villain attacked the stage that XY had set up in the Cour Napoléon for the National Music Festival.
In "Animaestro", the eponymous villain attacked the Cour Napoléon and destroyed the pyramid with his powers.
In "Bakerix", to prevent Ladybug and Cat Noiprom chasing him, the eponymous villain physically lifted the Louvre Pyramid and threw it at it, trapping them inside.
In "Timetagger", the Cour Napoléon was defaced with graffiti by the eponymous villain that helped him travel through time and space.
In "Derision", it is in the Cour Napoléon where the end of the fight between Ladybug and Cat Noir against Dark Humor took place.
In "Revolution", Queen Mayor was overthrown by the parisians who supported Ladybug and Cat Noir.
It was during this event that Lila took over Tomoe's laptop.

title: Daddycop/Transcript
text:
Daddycop/Transcript - Intro
Chloé: (in the video) Everything in London is incredibly more incredible than in Paris. All I need now is a minion, to manicure my nails. The last one turned out to be more than disappointing, she totally betrayed me. So, if you're interested and above all loyal, apply now.
Barkk: You should stop watching these videos of Chloé, she's really not a good person.
Sabrina: You're right, Barkk. (sniffs)
(She gets up, goes to a drawer full of items relating to Chloé, including nail polish, a cup, Sabrina's brooches, a Queen Bee figurine, a picture of her and Chloé, the cap Chloé bribed her with in "The Evillustrator", and a golden cup that may be a trophy, and throws them in the trash)
(Barkk smiles, before Sabrina picks up her bag from a chair and leaves her room.)
Roger: Are you sure we can't ride together like we used to?
Sabrina: No thanks, Daddy dear. (seemingly disappointed)
Roger: If someone was bothering you at school, you'd tell me, right?
Sabrina: Everything's fine, Dad. Some girlfriends are waiting for me at the bus stop. We're gonna head to school together.
Roger: Oh! (chuckling) I'm really glad you made new friends. Have fun, sweetheart! (closes the car door)

title: Daddycop/Transcript
text:
Daddycop/Transcript - Intro
(As Roger drives away, Sabrina's smile fades and walks to the other direction. She is now seen sitting on a bench by the tram stop, all alone.)
[ Theme Song ]
Tikki: (peeking from the box) Marinette, I don't understand. Why does this dinner absolutely have to take place tonight, otherwise it will be a disaster?
Marinette: Because, Tikki, tonight, the Hoa Tinh star will be in conjunction with Jupiter.
Tikki: (confused) And what does that mean exactly?
Marinette: Well, according to mom, it brings good luck. That's why I invited Adrien Agreste over tonight! Besides, since we've been going out, we've kissed exactly ninety-nine times. So, if we kissed for the hundredth time tonight, our love story is bound to last forever!
Tikki: So, you don't intend to kiss Adrien until this evening?
Marinette: I have special authorization from the Mayor of Paris, Mrs. Bustier, and from Fire Captain Hessenpy to put on a fireworks display especially for the occasion.
Tikki: Wow, you really thought of everything!
Marinette: That's right! Love requires planning. Speaking of which, I've got just enough time to put tonight's meal in the fridge and make it to school on time.

title: Daddycop/Transcript
text:
Daddycop/Transcript - Intro
(Just then, her scooter powers down. Marinette panics.)
Marinette: Oh no! This is a disaster!!
(In a bus, Sabrina is seen holding her whistle. She sees Marinette talking over the phone, making big movements. Sabrina stands up from her seat.)
Marinette: But tomorrow will be too late, Mr. Mechanic! If you don't fix it now, it will be a disaster! If I don't get tonight's meal in the fridge in time, it will go bad and then I won't have anything for my evening with Adrien, which means I will have to cancel! (while her commotion on the phone continues, Sabrina attempts to help her.) AND I'll miss this once in a lifetime tonight only lucky conjunction! Our hundredth kiss won't happen and my future love life will be ruined forever!
(Sabrina runs to hide behind a van.)
Sabrina: Barkk, on the hunt! (transforms into Miss Hound)
Marinette: That's why you HAVE to get my scooter right no— (the other side of the line hangs up) Uh, hello?
(Miss Hound jumps in the scene.)

title: Daddycop/Transcript
text:
Daddycop/Transcript - Intro
Miss Hound: Hello, citizen! I couldn't help but notice that your electric vehicle is immobilized because of a breakdown. I could take it to the auto repair shop! (she uses her ball and bounces it on the scooter. She waves to Marinette and jumps away.)
Marinette: (smiles) Our scooter problem's fixed! (grabs her paper bags) And now, time to get these in the fridge! (runs to hide behind a post) Tikki, spots on! (transforms into Ladybug and swings away)
Miss Hound: Hello, sir! I need a vehicle repaired! Fetch!
(her ball travels to where Marinette's scooter is and retrieves it, magically appearing beside her. Mr. Mouleux scratches his head in confusion. Miss Hound returns to the same place where she encountered Marinette...)
Miss Hound: Now let's take care of your—
(...and now she's nowhere to be found.)
Miss Hound: Where did she go? (goes behind a post) Lay down. (de-transforms)
(Sabrina walks away dejectedly. Barkk gives her an "it's OK" smile, of which Sabrina smiles back at.)
Ladybug: Spots off! (de-transforms)
Tikki: Thanks to Miss Hound, (Marinette gives her a macaron) you won't be late for school!

title: Daddycop/Transcript
text:
Daddycop/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: You're right, Tikki. Sabrina used to be on Chloé's side, doing evil things and today, she's acting for the greater good, helping others. (the two of them enter her trap door. Down at the living room, she unpacks her groceries.) With Sabrina, I finally succeeded where I failed with Chloé.
Tikki: You were right to entrust her with Barkk's Miraculous. That was a fitting choice!
Marinette: (drops her groceries in realization) AAAHH! FITTING! I completely forgot to take Adrien's measurements for his suit! (runs upstairs) Tape measure! I need my tape measure!!
(Tikki smiles while holding her macaron.)
Alya: I made bento dinners for tonight! (brings out bento boxes and puts them on the table)
Juleka: I brought fruit tea! (holds out two tumblers)
Mylène: Great! (brings out two lunch boxes) That'll be so much better than the sugary soda we had last time.
Kagami: I found the DVD for Misumi Yuki's movie, "Lone Tigress and Cub".
Zoé: (puts out two bags of oranges) Can't wait to see that movie after what you told us, Kagami!
Rose: This is going to be the best movie night ever!

title: Daddycop/Transcript
text:
Daddycop/Transcript - Intro
(The girls giggle. Behind Kagami and Mylène, a dejected Sabrina walks to the table all by herself. Zoé notices Sabrina sitting at a table parallel to them. Just then, Marinette zooms in the cafeteria.)
Marinette: (making her way through a line of students getting lunch) Sorry! Sorry! Sorry!! Excuse me! (pants)
Alya: Ah, here comes Hurricane Marinette.
Marinette: Sorry! (pulls Adrien away from his table) I need to borrow him for a minute.
(On a quiet side in the cafeteria, the couple stopped there to talk. Marinette brushes her hand on Adrien's arm.)
Adrien: Hello, Marinette. (leans in for a kiss)
Marinette: (takes a step back, covering her lips) AHH! No! This morning, we're kissing on the cheek!
Adrien: Uh, okay? (kisses Marinette on the cheek) But... why?
Marinette: It's for a surprise! For our surprise evening! (kisses Adrien back on his cheek and brings out her tape measure to begin taking his measurements)

Marinette: There's no hiding anything from you. (writes on her small notepad)
Alya: Ready for tonight, girl?
(The girls appear before Marinette.)
Marinette: How— How did you know??

title: Daddycop/Transcript
text:
Daddycop/Transcript - Intro
Alya: Marinette, our girls' movie night is every first Wednesday of the month. Of course, we know about it.
Mylène: And since it's at your place, there's no chance of you being late this time.
Marinette: Tonight? Our movie night? Y-Yeah...! Of course! Duh! (titters)
Kagami: You totally forgot, didn't you?
Marinette: N-Not at all! I'll see you girls later! (grabs Adrien's hand and walks away from the girls with him) I have things to work out with Adrien.
Kagami: (deadpan) She totally forgot.

title: Daddycop/Transcript
text:
Daddycop/Transcript - Intro
Zoé: Everything okay, Sabrina? If you need to talk...

(sniffs) Now I'm trying to make new ones but... I just can't seem to. When I see all of you, it's clear to me that I don't belong in your group and why would I? I was so mean to everyone. (sniffs) Deep down, I always knew none of it was right but I genuinely love Chloé. I thought she'd change eventually. (Zoé nods.)

title: Daddycop/Transcript
text:

Sabrina: (grabs a piece of pastry from her+ paper bag and gives it to Zoé) Here, you want one?

text:

title: Daddycop/Transcript
text:

Marinette: Uh, you're welcome?
(In Roger's police car, Sabrina enthusiastically climbs into the front passenger seat.)
Sabrina: Hurry, Dad! I've got to get my PJs, my toothbrush, my eyedrops, and toot-toot whistle! (buckles her seatbelt) I've been invited to Marinette's house tonight!
Roger: That's great news, sweetheart! You can count on your daddy to be on time.

title: Daddycop/Transcript
text:
Daddycop/Transcript - Intro
(The car drives away. Roger turns on his light and siren as he drives Sabrina home to get her stuff.)
Rose: I just don't get the connection between these petals and Japanese cinema.
Alya: (looks at the balloon decoration saying "100") Something doesn't add up.
(Up on the balcony, Marinette uses her binoculars to look out for Adrien.)

Alya: Then why aren't you with us already?
(The doorbell rings.)

Sabrina: I'm... I'm here for movie night?
Marinette: But who invited you??
Sabrina: You did.
Marinette: What? No! I invited Adrien. You didn't see him in the stairway, did you?
Sabrina: No, it's just me.

title: Daddycop/Transcript
text:
Daddycop/Transcript - Intro
Sabrina: (dejected) Sorry, Marinette. I probably should go then. (about to leave but turns around one last time) Surely, something can be done.
Marinette: (frowning) Do you know how to make the Hoa Tinh star return to Jupiter another day?
(Sabrina shakes her head "no".)
Marinette: Then, no. Nothing can be done.
(Marinette closes the door, leaving Sabrina a crying mess. She sobs as she goes down the apartment. Back on the balcony, the fireworks from afar set off, with Marinette's failed plan for her special evening with Adrien.)

Roger: (while driving) But... weren't you supposed to be sleeping at your friend's house?
Sabrina: There's no place for me — not at Marinette's house, not at the school, not in this city! (sobs)

Alya: Wait, wait, wait, you invited Adrien to our sleepover?
Marinette: (crying) The hundredth kiss, the fireworks, the stars — it could only happen tonight!
Alya: Without asking us??

title: Daddycop/Transcript
text:

Roger: I must fix this miscarriage of justice.
Chrysalis: And what should I call you?
Roger: Daddycop!
(Chrysalis closes her palm)
(Roger stands on his now transformed cruiser, making a flexing pose)
Zoé: Sabrina, come back! This is a misunderstanding!

title: Daddycop/Transcript
text:

Daddycop: You! Freeze! In the name of love, I'm arresting you for moral damage to my daughter.
Sabrina (stands up) No, Dad! It wasn't their fault!!
Daddycop: You're finally going to see my Sabrina as I see her, through the eyes of love!

All the girls: Sabrina. We love you!

Civilians: Sabrina!
(Sabrina runs down the road, evading the people chasing her. Sabrina runs down an alley.)

(Sabrina encounters a dead end in the alley. She turns to face the crowd of people who slowly inch closer to her.)

title: Daddycop/Transcript
text:

Sabrina: No, leave me alone!
(Suddenly, Ladybug's yoyo grabs Sabrina up out of the alley into her arms. Daddycop chases after Ladybug.)

(Sabrina takes the Dog Miraculous off and offers it back to Ladybug.)

title: Daddycop/Transcript
text:

Sabrina: Ladybug... I don't deserve that Miraculous. (Sabrina Looks away.) I'm an awful person, I'm not worthy of being part of the Miraculers... Just like I'm not worthy of having friends.
(Ladybug looks sad, but then smiles encouragingly as she pushes the Dog Miraculous back to Sabrina.)
Ladybug: Sabrina, the reason I gave you the Dog Miraculous is because I know you're a good person. You've already changed, you just can't see it yourself yet.

Ladybug: Visualize the Sabrina you've become, the one you want everyone to see.

[ Transformation Sequence ]Sabrina: Barkk, On The Hunt! (Miss Hound receives a new look)Miss Hound: (Looks down at her new look) Oh! That's incredible!
Ladybug: You're incredible.
