Astrocat: You better get new glasses or learn how to aim, Daddycop!
(Daddycop's police car drops down under a green bridge and flies across the Seine, and flies back up into the sky. A purple butterfly mask appears over his face as Chrysalis speaks to him.)

title: Daddycop/Transcript
text:

Chrysalis: I'll take care of him if you will. Turn around.
Daddycop: But...I'll crash into him!
Chrysalis: Just trust me.
(Daddycop turns around to Astrocat, who is close behind. Chrysalis blows on top of her purple open palm, releasing a wispy, purple butterfly. The butterfly shoots out of Daddycop's butterfly mask, and hits Astrocat. The butterfly makes Astrocat detransform out of his space power up, turns his suit lighter, and causes him to fall out of the sky.)

title: Daddycop/Transcript
text:

[Superpower Sequences]Ladybug: Miraculous Ladybug!(She throws the air mattress into the air, and ladybugs shoot out from it, reverting the damage done and reversing Daddycop's mind control.)
(Ladybug pulls a magical charm from her yo-yo; red, blue and white to match Daddycop's color scheme. It glimmers. Ladybug takes Roger's hand to give him the magical charm.)

title: Daddycop/Transcript
text:

I've been focusing so much on my relationship with Adrien that I forgot to give my attention to the ones who really needed it. I promise I'll be more attentive from now on. Welcome, Sabrina.

title: Corcovado
text:
Corcovado - Intro
is a mountain located in the center of Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. It is 710 meters high and located in Tijuca National Park. It is also known worldwide for the Christ the Redeemer statue erected at its summit.

title: Corcovado
text:
Corcovado - Description
Corcovado is a 710-meter-high granite peak located west of downtown Rio de Janeiro, of which it is entirely a part within Tijuca National Park. Its name comes from its shape, reminiscent of a hunchback.
At its summit stands the famous Christ the Redeemer statue, a monumental statue 38 meters high representing Jesus Christ.
The summit has many hiking trails leading to its top, as well as the Corcovado train.

title: Denis Damoclès
text:
Denis Damoclès - Intro
is a recurring character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He is the principal of Collège Françoise Dupont.
In "The Dark Owl", after trying and failing to become a superhero and being humiliated by the media for it, he was akumatized by Hawk Moth into Dark Owl, an Owl-themed supervillain.
In "Jubilation", after feeling discouraged by his further attempts at becoming a superhero, Mr. Damoclès was akumatized into Darker Owl, a new version of his previous akumatized form Dark Owl, by Monarch and received the Pig Miraculous superpower through his Alliance ring. He also received a Magical Charm from Ladybug to prevent him from being reakumatized.
In "Confrontation", after Sabrina and Marinette exposed Chloé and Lila's manipulation along with Lila's true nature, Mr. Damoclès tried to expel them. But unfortunately Mayor Bourgeois forbade him, along with refusing to allow the students to retake their course forms. Mr. Damoclès was about to be akumatized by Monarch, but with the help of his students, Miss Bustier, and Cat Noir, he was able to purify the megakuma with his Magical Charm. He finally stood up against Mayor Bourgeois, despite being fired from his job as principal.

title: Denis Damoclès
text:
Denis Damoclès - Intro
In "Re-creation", Mr. Damoclès fell victim to Perfect Alliance, becoming a Miraculized until Alya and Nino freed him by destroying his Alliance ring. After Monarch's defeat, he later became the principal of a refurbished Collège Françoise Dupont, where he unknowingly enrolled Cerise so she can start her devious plan.

title: Denis Damoclès
text:
Denis Damoclès - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Mr. Damoclès is a stout man with amber eyes. He has large, bushy black eyebrows, gray sideburns and beard, and a light gray mustache. He is bald on the top of his head.
From Season 6 onwards, his eyebrows are slightly bushy, his beard is slightly shorter, his mustache is slightly smaller, and his hair color is now camel tan yellow.
Civilian Attire
He wears a brown dress jacket with a chest pocket and pockets on either side of the waist over a white dress shirt with a white hue, a light chestnut brown necktie worn on his collar, dark vermilion, almost dark grayish-brown/dark grayish-tangelo dress pants, and grayish tangelo loafers with white strips above the tips of his toes.
From Season 6 onwards, his dress shirt is now yellow and his tie is now dark brown.
As Dark Owl

title: Denis Damoclès
text:
Denis Damoclès - Appearance
His eyes were round and yellow with half white, and half orange scleras. His face was covered with a black mask, while there were brown circles with white edges around his eyes. The mask also included two tuft-like points with brown tops that came out above his eyes and pointed backward. His beard was brown, his mustache notably having tips sticking out, and two black vertical stripes went up it. He wore a black suit that included a brown covering and padding over his upper body, arms, and legs. The covering included black or darker lines, and a brown symbol of an owl's face appeared on the chest. Above his hips, he had a brown belt with two pockets towards his right side holding objects based on his symbol. He wore brown gloves that had two ridges each, brown boots with black soles, and a long cape that was black on the back and brown on the other side. The cape could also transform into a pair of wings that had a gray mantle along with several black feathers on either side of the wings.
As the Darker Owl

title: Denis Damoclès
text:
Denis Damoclès - Appearance
Darker Owl had a similar appearance to Dark Owl, but having a different scheme of color, with them becoming darker and more vibrant. His beard and mustache also became more metallic, with the former becoming lighter and grayer in color and the mustache adopting a bright pinkish color. But the biggest difference was the mask, with its color being not just dark, but having also shorter and sharper tuft-like points above the eyes that had pink circles around them, which were now fully yellow.

title: Denis Damoclès
text:
Denis Damoclès - Personality
Mr. Damoclès is courteous and authoritative to an extent, but he tends to struggle a lot under pressure, especially when Mayor Bourgeois has a preference for his daughter Chloé and the latter uses that to manipulate him to do what she wants, even if that goes to his disciplinary beliefs. He can be quite forgetful and stingy as well, as seen in "Reflekta", where he not remembering who Juleka Couffaine is when Marinette Dupain-Cheng states that she missed the class photo and deciding to ignore her claims entirely when Chloé brings up the fact that he is paying the photographer by the hour.

title: Denis Damoclès
text:
Denis Damoclès - Personality
Despite his flaws, Mr. Damoclès can feel concerned over the well-being of others, such as when he questions Jagged Stone's decision to face the titular villain in "Pixelator". He holds admiration and respect for Ladybug and Cat Noir, so much so that he attempts to become a superhero himself, desiring to help others under the secret identity "The Owl" and showing that he has a good heart and intentions. However, Mr. Damoclès can be obtuse at times, not listening to Cat Noir and Ladybug when they urge him to stop his superhero antics so he won't endanger himself, which leads to his identity being revealed and some people mocking him. After he is de-akumatized, he learns his lesson and decides to help out others by performing small deeds, without putting himself at risk.

title: Denis Damoclès
text:
Denis Damoclès - Personality
Underneath it all, he truly does care about his students especially when he's wrong about them and willing to put things right in "Confrontation", upon seeing that Marinette was right about Lila Rossi's lies and what Lila and Chloe did to their class' career forms he rightfully wanted to expel them. But hearing that the expulsion couldn't go through he at least wanted to make things right for the rest of the class. And yet, when the mayor refused and if Damoclès did so he'd be fired, believing that there was nothing he could do and ruined his student's future felt that he didn't deserve his title as principal. Until his students thought otherwise hearing that they still believed in him and Juleka speak with confidence inspired him to do the same. Speaking to the mayor with confidence he puts his foot down no longer refusing to sacrifice his morals to satisfy someone. With his final act as principal, Damoclès lets his students redo their course forms and the school repays him with a proper heroes leaving.

title: Denis Damoclès
text:
Denis Damoclès - Personality
As Dark Owl, he was vengeful towards Ladybug and Cat Noir for accidentally humiliating him, and desired to do the same thing to them. He strived to be the only hero in Paris, aiming to get rid of Ladybug and Cat Noir to achieve his goal. Despite his plans and hostility towards the heroes, the Dark Owl wasn't needlessly evil, even chiding Ladybug and Cat Noir for believing he would really harm a kitten when his scenario was revealed to be a fake, and was still a man of his word, releasing the heroes from danger after they made the gesture of surrendering their Miraculouses.
As Darker Owl, he continued to be vengeful towards Ladybug, as Monarch made him believe that the superhero, along with Cat Noir, didn't want anyone else to be a superhero but them, using the misinformation that Socqueline Wang was Ladybug to further impulse his desire for revenge, as she unintentionally increased the principal's dismay about trying to be a superhero. Even after realizing that Socqueline was not Ladybug, the Darker Owl continued with his desire to defeat Ladybug and Cat Noir, using the same type of trap he had used previously to lure them and direct them to the perfect moment to use Gift on them.

title: Denis Damoclès
text:
Denis Damoclès - Abilities
As a Civilian
Intelligent and calculating when having a goal, Mr. Damoclès fakes a scenario in order to trap the heroes when he was akumatized.
Calling it a hobby, Mr. Damoclès has certain IT skills, helping Ms. Mendeleiev with her computer troubles and claiming that he created a program for his computer. However, he still ends up getting a virus into the school's hard drive and his program Albert has glitches and problems but is designed well enough to recognize and respond to commands, albeit poorly and often unsuccessfully. He also modifies his grappling hook when it fails to shoot correctly in "The Dark Owl".
When being The Owl, Mr. Damoclès shows off his agility and skill at climbing a tree. However, his older age makes him less smooth in his maneuvers, being prone to falling over, and he is unskilled at throwing a boomerang or aiming and shooting a grappling hook gun.
As Dark Owl

title: Denis Damoclès
text:
Denis Damoclès - Abilities
While Dark Owl didn't have real superpowers, he had a wide arsenal of gadgets and tools, such as a fully functioning grappling hook, numerous owl-themed boomerangs, wings that he could use to glide through the air, and in "Gamer 2.0", owl-themed smoke bombs. He was able to communicate with his akumatized computer Albert, who could carry out many different functions to aid the Dark Owl when he commanded them. He also had a strong jump and enhanced combat capabilities, enabling him to efficiently battle with Ladybug and Cat Noir individually.
As Darker Owl
In "Jubilation", besides his original abilities as Dark Owl (with the exception of his akumatized computer), Darker Owl receives from Monarch the power of Gift, the superpower of the Pig Miraculous, through his Alliance ring. With it, he could force people to live their deepest dreams/wishes, rending them completely vulnerable. He could shoot it through his grapple gun.
As Miraculized
As Miraculized, he could use 15 Miraculous powers in his system:
Mirage to cast and communicate through hyper-realistic illusions.
Venom to paralyze anyone they touched with their stinger hand.
Shell-ter to create a nigh-unbreakable force field.

title: Denis Damoclès
text:
Denis Damoclès - Abilities
Multitude to split themselves into any amount of smaller clones.
Resistance to gain immunity to other superpowers and attacks.
Clout to gain an energy boost and release it as a punch that overwhelmed anything it encountered.
Wind Dragon, Water Dragon, and Lightning Dragon to transform into and manipulate the elements of wind, water, and lightning.
Second Chance to rewind time to a previously marked moment, allowing them to correct any issues or mistakes that occurred in the original timeline.
Voyage to open a portal to anywhere in the universe.
Genesis to create any object they desired, but the object was mundane and lacked any superpower, magic, or mythical properties.
Uproar to manifest a toy that chaotically disrupts an opponent's superpowers when touched.
Sublimation to grant themselves a super ability of their choosing.
Fetch to retrieve a previously marked item, no matter where it is.
Gift to manifest an image of a person's happiest desire, placating them and driving away negative forces.

title: Denis Damoclès
text:
Denis Damoclès - Relationships
Friends/Allies
Olga Mendeleiev
When Ms. Mendeleiev has computer trouble in "Robostus", Mr. Damoclès happily tries to help her.
Caline Bustier
Caline was once one of Mr. Damoclès' students before he became the principal, she played a harmless prank on him in the past, which never affected their relationship in the present and they still maintained a good relationship as faculty members.
Ladybug and Cat Noir
Mr. Damoclès is very appreciative of the work Ladybug and Cat Noir do in order to protect Paris. He is inspired by them to create his superhero persona, though he doesn't listen to the duo when they try to warn him that what he's doing may be dangerous. During Heroes' Day, he talks to Miss Bustier's class about the heroic deeds Ladybug and Cat Noir have done throughout the year.
As Dark Owl, he is vengeful towards Ladybug and Cat Noir for unintentionally humiliating him and seeks to get rid of them in order to become Paris' only superhero.
Socqueline Wang

title: Denis Damoclès
text:
Denis Damoclès - Relationships
Mr. Damoclès and Socqueline seem to have a rather good relationship as seen in "Jubilation", even after the latter no longer studies on the former's school. This is showed when Socqueline helps him while pretending to be Ladybug whenever he ends up in trouble while performing his good deeds as The Owl. Inclusive, Mr. Damoclès is showed to buy supplies (like materials to do his owl mask) on Socqueline's family's shop. Socqueline also seems to be encouraging towards Mr. Damoclès' superhero work, even if sometimes her encouragement may cause the opposite effect at the wrong time (like when Mr. Damoclès was feeling down about being The Owl). While being akumatized by Monarch, Mr. Damoclès became shocked to know that Socqueline could be Ladybug.

title: Denis Damoclès
text:
Denis Damoclès - Relationships
During one of Marinette's flashbacks in "Derision", it was showed that, despite having a good relationship with his former student, Mr. Damoclès was able to suspend Socqueline for the rest of the remaining school year (causing her to miss the end-of-the-year party and graduation) for something that happened outside the school out of fear of what Chloé's father, the mayor, could do. Despite that, Socqueline didn't hold a grudge on him and they continued to be on good terms with one another.
While being Darker Owl, he went after Socqueline for believing she was Ladybug, wanting to punish her for thinking that she believed that only her and Cat Noir could be superheroes. After being revealed that Socqueline was not Ladybug, Darker Owl used her as bait to lure the real Ladybug and Cat Noir, being even willing to let her fall to her death.
Acquaintances
Markov

title: Denis Damoclès
text:
Denis Damoclès - Relationships
Mr. Damoclès doesn't believe that Markov has human emotions and dismisses him as a mere toy, even confiscating him from Max when he proves to cause trouble. Markov attempts to change his mind by talking to him about his IT skills, and though Mr. Damoclès is momentarily intrigued, he soon believes himself to be crazy for talking to a toy and puts Markov in his drawer.
It's implied that Mr. Damoclès stopped seeing Markov as a toy after witnessing his akumatization into Robostus.
Enemies
Chloé Bourgeois
Because of his fear of whatever the mayor (Chloé's father) may do to either him or the school (like firing/replacing him or cutting funds to the school), whenever Chloé threatens to phone her father for whatever reason, Mr. Damoclès always complies with whatever demands she makes, such when her bracelet was missing, when Chloé demands that he suspend Alya for taking a photo of her locker and unfairly suspending Alya from school, as well as not punishing her like the rest of the school in "Despair Bear". In "Malediktator", like most of the school, Mr. Damoclès takes pleasure in Chloé leaving Paris.

title: Denis Damoclès
text:
Denis Damoclès - Relationships
His fear is so great that he is even willing to punish students when their transgressions were not committed inside the school, therefore not having any real power to punish them, just because Chloé demands it as seen in "Derision", during Marinette's flashback, where Principal Damoclès suspended Socqueline for the remaining of the school year for breaking Sabrina's phone outside the school because Chloé wanted to.
Ray Pugnant, Loïc Stompet and Nelson de Glusset
TBA
Lila Rossi/Chrysalis
Unfortunately, Mr. Damoclès was one of the people who fell for Lila's lies. In "Catalyst", he thought she was in the kingdom of Achu helping Prince Ali and in "Ladybug", he believed Lila's false accusations of Marinette which temporarily got the latter expelled until Lila was forced by Adrien and (secretly) Nathalie to get her back into school. However, he finally made it up to Marinette by attempting to expel Lila and Chloe until he was prevented to do so by André Bourgeois.

title: Denis Damoclès
text:
Denis Damoclès - Etymology
The name Damocles refers to a character from an ancient Greek story who, after praising the king's good fortune at his position of wealth and power, was invited to sit in the king's place on the throne, unaware (at first) that a sword hung over his head suspended by a single horse hair. The literal meaning of "Damoclès" is "fame of the people".

title: Denis Damoclès
text:
Denis Damoclès - Trivia
Mr. Damoclès' design is very reminiscent of an owl. He also has many pictures of different owls in his office.
In "The Dark Owl", it is revealed that he is a fan of comic book superhero Knightowl, owning various related comics and merchandise.
His Akumatized form was first revealed as a silhouette in a promotional poster on Jeremy Zag's Instagram.
While his homemade costume and his akumatized appearance are strongly based off of Knightowl's appearance from the in-universe comic books and merchandise, his akumatized form resembles the character Knightowl from the Miraculous Adventures comics.
His akumatized villain costume is a modified version of his original costume, a trait similar to Chloé's Akumatized villain costume in "Antibug".
As Dark Owl, he is one of a few villains to almost murder Ladybug and Cat Noir by almost drowning them.
Dark Owl briefly reappears in "Ladybug", but he is quickly de-Akumatized.
Dark Owl appears another time in "Gamer 2.0" for Gamer 2.0's powers.
His first name was revealed five seasons after his initial introduction, in "Jubilation".
Mr. Damoclès is the first civilian to purify a megakuma with his magical charm.

title: Dark Cupid/Transcript
text:
Dark Cupid/Transcript - Intro
[ Theme Song ]
Miss Bustier: In most fairy tales, the prince breaks the spell by kissing the princess. Can anyone tell us why?
Rose:  (stands up, swoons) Because only love can conquer hate!
Miss Bustier: Correct, Rose.
Max: Technically speaking, this reasoning is only exhibited in about 87% of all fairy tales and-
Miss Bustier: Thank you, Max. That's enough.
(Marinette is looking over Adrien's shoulders as he writes a letter.)
Miss Bustier: Adrien, I hope what you're writing has to do with my lesson.
Marinette: (gasps)
Miss Bustier: (approaches Adrien) Can you tell me what I just said?
Adrien: That's why in most fairy tales, the prince breaks the spell by kissing the princess because only love conquers hate.
Miss Bustier: Very good, Adrien! Now, everyone, don't forget to finish Sleeping Beauty by Charles Perrault tonight, and happy Valentine's day, students!
Marinette: (to Alya) Hey, go ahead, I'll meet you outside.
Alya: Mhm.
(Marinette continues to look over Adrien's shoulder as he continues to write his letter before Adrien crumples it up stands up and tosses the letter in the garbage can.)
Chloé: Hi Adrien, sign here please.

title: Dark Cupid/Transcript
text:
Dark Cupid/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: (sighs) Oh, come on, you know I hate signing autographs, Chloé.
Chloé: Oh, that's not what this is. This is a petition against cruelty to hamsters. Have you seen some of the ugly sweaters they are forced to wear? It's appalling.
(Adrien begrudgingly signs the poster. Chloé hugs the poster and Sabrina smiles before they notice Marinette who is digging through a trash can as she pulls out a sheet of paper.)
Chloé: (mockingly) Well well, Marinette, looking for something to eat?
Sabrina: Maybe she's looking for some better clothes!
(Both laugh before running off)
Marinette: Ughhh!
Tikki: Don't give them the time of day, they don't deserve it.
Marinette: You're right, Tikki. (begins to read the letter) "Your hair is dark as night, your pretty bluebell eyes, I wonder who you are beneath that strong disguise. Every day we see each other and I hope that you'll be mine, together our love could be so true, please, will you be my Valentine?"
Tikki: Whoa, now that's a love poem.
Marinette: Who could he be talking about? Hair as dark as night, bluebell eyes?
Tikki: Uh... you?
Marinette: (laughs nervously) Me? No way. There are plenty of girls at school with dark hair and blue eyes.

title: Dark Cupid/Transcript
text:
Dark Cupid/Transcript - Intro
Tikki: Yeah, but bluebell eyes...
Marinette: What do you think he means by "strong disguise"?
Tikki: (sighs) This is poetry. He means who you are deep down inside. He wants to get to know you Marinette! He's talking about you!
Marinette: (laughs and jumps up and down excitedly) Pinch me!
(Zoom out to the outside of the classroom. Marinette continues to laugh until she shrieks.)
Marinette: Not literally!
(Zoom back into Marinette rubbing her arm, with Tikki giggling.)
Max: Operation Valentine's Day is commencing. According to my extensive research and cross-referencing of online shopping sites, this particular jewel, (reveals a heart box hiding behind his back) was ranked highest in popularity. (He hands the box to Kim.)
Kim: (laughs) That's perfect, Max! I better hit a home run with this one. Love is like baseball, right? You gotta have a strategy or you'll strike out. (Alya spots Max and Kim's conversation and gets excited. She grabs Marinette and drags her over to the boys) But if you aim right, you'll hit it out of the ball park. Score!
Max: Oh yes Kim, lovely metaphor.
Kim: (eyeing the gem inside the box) Meta-who?

title: Dark Cupid/Transcript
text:
Dark Cupid/Transcript - Intro
Alya: (grabs Kim's hands and looks at the jewel) Ooh! Sparkly! Is that for moi?
Max: (annoyed) Negative Alya. The recipient of this gem has already been determined, it's--
Kim: (grabs Max and cuts him off) Shh! Keep it on the down-low!
Alya: (excited) Scoop! Kim's got a major crush! (takes picture with phone) Who's the lucky lady?
Marinette: (pushes Alya's arm down) It's gorgeous Kim. She's gonna be ecstatic! (Alya giggles)
Kim: (rubs back of head uncomfortably) Technically, she's still gotta accept it. (grabs Max) What if she says "no"!?
Marinette: (Alya looks around worriedly) She won't Kim, no way! (pumps fist) Don't hold back, Kim. Go for it, no regrets!
Kim: Operation Valentine's Day is underway! (high-five's Max)
Max: (Kim jogging in place, holding a map) Her route is highlighted here in yellow, yours in red. If you run at ten miles per hour you're going to gain a four and a half minute advance on her. Halt and wait here facing northwest -- the third most romantic spot in Paris. (Marinette and Alya thumbs up behind Max) Go go go!
Kim: Thanks, you guys. (runs away)
Alya: (elbows Marinette) I know someone who's good at dishing out advice who can't take some herself.

title: Dark Cupid/Transcript
text:
Dark Cupid/Transcript - Intro
(Alya points to Adrien who enters the car.)
Adrien: Let's go.
(The door shuts and Adrien's bodyguard drives away.)
Marinette: You're right. It's time I told him.
Alya: Say what?!
Marinette: I'm gonna do it. I'm gonna tell Adrien my true feelings. Well... I'm gonna write them on a card, that is.
Alya: (looks shocked then laughs) Yeah!
Marinette: Yeah! (they fist bump)
Alya & Marinette: Operation Valentine's Day! (they perform a handshake and run off. Cut to Aurore, Mireille and various other girls ogling over a poster of Adrien.)
Girls: He's so cute!
Chloé: Keep dreaming all you want girls but the boy is mine.
(Sabrina nods before unrolling the poster, the girls gasping)
Aurore: "To Chloé, the most awesome girl in the world and the love of my life. Signed, Adrien."
(All the girls begin to cry, then Chloé looks at one girl who tries not to burst out crying)
Chloé: Uh, she's not crying enough.
(Sabrina brings the poster towards the one girl who is crying silently causing her to cry even more as Chloé and Sabrina laugh.)
Marinette: Dear Adrien, dear Adrien... Dear Adrien... (sighs) I'm no good at this love letter writing thing... I sound like a total dorkasaurus!

title: Dark Cupid/Transcript
text:
Dark Cupid/Transcript - Intro
Tikki: Only when you say words like "dorkasaurus"!
(Marinette turns her chair around in frustration)
Tikki: Relax, Marinette, I'm teasing. Think of Adrien and speak from the heart.
Marinette: (sees Adrien's letter, gasps) Adrien's letter! That's it! Why didn't I think of that before? I'll answer his poem!
Alya: Marinette!
Marinette: (gasps)
Alya: (enters the room, with a pink heart-shaped card) Check it out!
Marinette: It's perfect! Thank you, thank you, thank you!
(Marinette writes the love letter, with Alya watching.)
Marinette: Voila!
Alya: Don't forget to sign it!
(A ladybug flies inside the room, distracting Marinette.)
Alya: This is a good omen! Ladybugs are good luck, especially in the love department!
Marinette: Really?
Alya: Yeah you of all people should know about ladybugs.
Marinette: R-really? Wh-why do you say that?
Alya: Since ancient times the ladybug has been a symbol of love, guiding hearts on the path to devotion. It was on my blog this week. You read it didn't you?
Marinette: Oh yeah, yeah, of course. (turns back towards her computer and sighs)

title: Dark Cupid/Transcript
text:
Dark Cupid/Transcript - Intro
Plagg: So she's got eyes, arms, legs, big deal! How can you possibly be in love with Ladybug? You don't even know who she really is!
Adrien: (sighs) You don't know anything about love...
Plagg: Oh sure I do, I love Cheddar, I love Swiss and I love Camembert.
(Adrien stands up causing his chair to spin as he heads for the window resting his arm and head against it in distress.)
Plagg: (mockingly) Aww, the poor boy's frustrated because he can't finish the poem for his masked sweetheart?
Adrien: I don't need a poem when I can tell her to her face... I love you.
Plagg: Bleh, gross. You're making me lose my appetite. (eats the Camembert) Almost.
Chloé: And that's right, in a 24 karat gold frame. Deliver it to Le Grand Paris Hotel and bill it to Daddykins, uh, I mean, Mr. Bourgeois. (stops after noticing Kim) What are you doing here?
Kim: (nervously) I-I...
Chloé: (mockingly) You-You...
Kim (clears throat and kneels down in a puddle of water) Will you be my Valentine? (presents a brooch to Chloé)
(A passing bike splashes water in Kim's face, and a chip bag blowing in the wind sticks to him.)
Chloé: (gasps) Don't move!
(Chloé takes a humiliating photo of Kim then hits the send button.)

title: Dark Cupid/Transcript
text:
Dark Cupid/Transcript - Intro
Chloé Wait till everyone gets a load of this! Hahahaha! No offense, Kim, but my heart's saved for someone more awesome than you.
(Chloé begins to walk off before turning back.)
Chloé: Don't you just hate how harsh love can be?
(Kim drops the brooch and pulls the chip bag off his face and begins to sob.)
Hawk Moth: Ah, Valentine's Day, the day of love and the day of fools. So many delusions, so much disappointment. My evil akumas, you are going to have such a field day.
(Hawk Moth transforms the akuma, charging it with power)
Hawk Moth: Fly away my little akuma, and evilize him!
(The akuma flies off, soon finding a sobbing Kim and enters into the brooch.)
Hawk Moth: Dark Cupid, I am Hawk Moth. I can give you the power to shoot your arrows, pierce love and impale friendships. But there is something you must do for me in return.
Kim: No love affair or friendship will escape my fury. No one will ever love again!
(Kim is transformed into Dark Cupid by the akuma, and is seen shooting arrows at lovers whose lips turn black once hit and run away from their loved ones.)

title: Dark Cupid/Transcript
text:
Dark Cupid/Transcript - Intro
Civilian: (winces, while her purple lipstick darkens into black. She throws the cake she’s holding into the river) Hahahahahaha! (taunts her lover and runs away)
Civilian: (smashes bouquet of flowers into wall) Ugh, stupid flowers!
Civilian: (pulls hand away from woman who he is with) Get off me! (the woman remains shocked while he leaves)
Dark Cupid: Hahahahahaha!
Hawk Moth: Hahaha! Perfect. It won't be long before Ladybug and Cat Noir show up to meet their doom! (evil laughs)
Tom: Candy apples, girls?
Marinette: (takes the candy apples) Thanks, Papa.
(Marinette and Alya exit the bakery.)
Alya: Come on, Marinette! Do it before you chicken out!
(Marinette is a little scared at first, but finally, she puts the love letter in the mailbox.)
Alya: Yeah!
Marinette: I did it!
(They hug each other. Their phones ring, and they see Chloé texted them.)
Alya: Chloé? Since when did she start texting us?
(They open the chat, and see a picture of Kim. Both gasp.)
Alya: What a witch!
Marinette: And I was the one who told Kim to do it! I didn't know he was talking about her!
Alya: Dang, I hope Adrien doesn't do the same thing to you. I mean...

title: Dark Cupid/Transcript
text:
Dark Cupid/Transcript - Intro
(Upon hearing this, Marinette panics, and tries to get the love letter out of the mailbox.)
Marinette: What have I done!?
Alya: Girl, calm down! I was totally joking! Kind of... Adrien would never do that. (sees Dark Cupid in the sky) What in the world is that?! (points up at him)
Dark Cupid: Huh? (sees the candy apples Alya is holding) All hearts must be destroyed! (shoots arrows at the love apples, and shoots one at Alya, making her lips black)
Marinette: Alya?
(Alya sticks the candy apples on Marinette's shirt.)
Marinette: Hey, seriously?!
Alya: You're not my BFF, (she reveals her face with the black lips) you're a joke! Adrien's gonna laugh his head off at your lame attempt at poetry! (runs away, cackling)
Marinette: Alya! (looks at Dark Cupid) What did he do to her? (looks at Dark Cupid's brooch) I've seen that jewel someplace before. It's Kim's pin! He's been akumatized! (pulls the candy apples off of her shirt) This is... not... good! We gotta find him, fast! (runs to a bench)
[ Transformation Sequence ]Marinette: Tikki, spots on! Ha! (Marinette transforms into Ladybug)
Chloé: Ugh! I never said 18-karat gold! Those gold tones will never match my 24-karat toilet! Idiots!

title: Dark Cupid/Transcript
text:
Dark Cupid/Transcript - Intro
(Dark Cupid spots Chloé and shoots an arrow at her, but Ladybug stops him, making him miss.)
Chloé: (gasps)
Dark Cupid: Ladybug!
Ladybug: Stop, Kim!
Dark Cupid: I'm not Kim, I'm Dark Cupid! I'll never stop! If I can't have love, then no one can!
Ladybug: Okay, Dark Cupid, I get it. Chloé totally burned you. But that doesn't mean you have to take it out on all of Paris!
Dark Cupid: Oh yes, I do! And I won't stop until everyone's heart is crushed. Say adios to your loved ones. From now on, you'll hate them!
(Dark Cupid attempts to shoot his arrows at Ladybug who dodges them with her yo-yo. She soon falls catching herself on a roof gutter with her yo-yo.)
Hawk Moth: If you want to continue destroying love, bring me Ladybug's Miraculous, or I'll remove your powers!
Cat Noir: Falling for me already, my lady? (pulls Ladybug down next to him) I need to talk to you.
Ladybug: It’s gotta wait. Dark Cupi-
Cat Noir: (hushes her) I swore to myself that I'd tell you as soon as I saw you. Ladybug, I-I... Look out!
(Cat Noir spins around to shield Ladybug, and is struck by one of Dark Cupid's arrows.)
Ladybug: (gasps) Cat Noir!
Cat Noir: (his lips turn black) Ladybug, I—I... loathe you!

title: Dark Cupid/Transcript
text:
Dark Cupid/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: Cat Noir, snap out of it!
Cat Noir: (squeezes Ladybug incredibly close to him) You're nothing Ladybug, and nothing to me! I hate you!
(Ladybug jumps on Cat Noir’s foot which made him feel pain on his foot and she uses his staff to launch herself into the air before grappling her yo-yo onto a street lamp and rolling into Le Grand Paris.)
Chloé: Ladybug, it's about time, where have you been?
(Cat Noir is still holding on to his staff before he retracts his staff then he puts his staff on his back and he climbs up the wall where he meets face to face with Dark Cupid.)
Hawk Moth: (to Dark Cupid) Offer to help him in return for Ladybug's Miraculous.
Dark Cupid: (to Cat Noir) I can help you crush Ladybug, but you must give me her Miraculous in return. (holds his hand out to Cat Noir)
Cat Noir: No...problem. (cackles and holds his hand out to the villain)
Hawk Moth: Yes. Yes! And once I have Ladybug's Miraculous, taking Cat Noir's will be child's play!
Ladybug: You gotta get out of here. Your friend Kim's turned into Dark Cupid and I don't know what he'll do if he finds you here.
Chloé: Moi? But how could he possibly have a vendetta against me?
Ladybug: (aside) Who doesn't?

title: Dark Cupid/Transcript
text:
Dark Cupid/Transcript - Intro
Chloé: Duh! It's because of this. Everyone would love to get their hands on it. (zooms in on the poster of Adrien). That's Adrien, a super hot guy in my class. And rich, too! He's hot for me of course.
Ladybug (under her breath) Not according to the poem.
Sabrina: (she is pointing at the poster of Adrien) It's alive!
(The poster begins to seemingly walk into the Hotel and from behind it emerges Dark Cupid, he fires his arrows at Ladybug, Sabrina and Chloé and Ladybug deflects them with her yo-yo. She then grabs Chloé with her yo-yo and drags her onto the street.)
Chloé: Daddy!
Ladybug: Run, Chloé, run!
(Chloé begins to run, followed by Sabrina. Cat Noir drops down from above and stands in front of Ladybug.)
Cat Noir: Well, well, Ladybug.
Ladybug: I don't want to fight you, Cat Noir.
Cat Noir: Ugh, that friendliness. It's so revolting. You are definitely not my friend!
(Cat Noir leaps into the air and swings his staff directly at Ladybug. She dodges it and jumps up onto the roof to run away, and Cat Noir pursues her. Ladybug uses her yo-yo to grab Cat Noir’s staff, and pulls him towards her.)
Ladybug: Why are you so full of hate, Cat Noir?!
Cat Noir: Because hate conquers all!

title: Dark Cupid/Transcript
text:
Dark Cupid/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: I hate to burst your bubble, but hate doesn't conquer all. Love does! (then she remembers what Miss Bustier and Rose said earlier about love)
Miss Bustier (in flashback): The prince breaks the spell by kissing the princess.
Rose (in flashback): Only love can conquer hate!
Cat Noir: You're just buying time! Fight!
Ladybug: I'll do better than that.
Cat Noir Huh?
Ladybug: Come on, kitty kitty, just a peck... (she tries to kiss him, but misses) Almost!
Cat Noir: (yells) Get back, you savage! (begins running away from her)
Ladybug: Here, kitty kitty kitty! Come here! (runs after Cat Noir)
Dark Cupid: (laughs) You can't outrun me, Chloé!
(While she is trying to escape Dark Cupid, she trips over a flower stand and falls near several civilians.)
Chloé: Help!
(The civilians see Dark Cupid but they run away while they are screaming and Chloé also sees him.)
Dark Cupid: Happy Valentine's Day, Chloé. Now you'll get what you deserve.
Chloé: My hair! There is nothing worse in this world than a bad hair day! First, Ladybug wrinkles my new jacket, second, you totally ruined my hair! Just go ahead and just change me already! This day can't get any worse...

title: Dark Cupid/Transcript
text:
Dark Cupid/Transcript - Intro
Dark Cupid: I don't need to waste this arrow on you. Your heart is so dark and shriveled, there's no room for love. (laughs while flies away)
Chloé: Ugh! How dare you talk to me like that? (bumps into Sabrina) Huh? Why are you just standing there? Help me up!
(It's revealed that Sabrina's lips have also turned into black.)
Sabrina: Ha! You think I'd help someone as stuck up as you? (takes an embarrassing picture of Chloé with her cellphone) Wait till everyone gets a load of this! (cackles while she runs away)
Chloé: Ughhh...
(Ladybug ties Cat Noir's leg with her yo-yo and he drops his staff then she ties him to a lamppost. She suspends herself from the top of the lamppost and she is leaning closer to Cat Noir so she can kiss him while she is hanging upside down.)
Cat Noir: No, no!
Ladybug: Don't worry, I'm not looking forward to it either. (tries to kiss him again but he dodges, so she holds his nose to prevent him from dodging a kiss from her) I can't believe I'm doing this.

title: Dark Cupid/Transcript
text:
Dark Cupid/Transcript - Intro
(She tries to kiss him again and Cat Noir whimpers but an arrow appears between them that is shot by Dark Cupid. But as he shoots more arrows at Ladybug she dodges them, making Cat Noir freed from the lamppost. He picks up his staff and puts it on the back of his suit, then he joins Dark Cupid while Ladybug hides behind a tree.)
Cat Noir: How you gonna fight both of us now, bug eyes? (Cat Noir and Dark Cupid fist bump each other)
[ Superpower Sequence ]Cat Noir: Cataclysm!
Cat Noir: I've often wondered what would happen if I use my Cataclysm on someone.
[ Superpower Sequence ]Ladybug: Lucky Charm! (a candy apple appears)
Ladybug: A candy apple? What am I supposed to do with this? Think, Ladybug... (looks around and spots the fountain, Cat Noir's ring and Dark Cupid's brooch)
Ladybug: Hey! I've got a Valentine's gift for you! (comes out of her hiding place)

title: Dark Cupid/Transcript
text:
Dark Cupid/Transcript - Intro
(Cat Noir and Dark Cupid are going to attack Ladybug together. Dark Cupid shoots arrows at her and she deflects them with her yo-yo. Cat Noir is about to use his Cataclysm on her but she avoids it and she grabs him by his belt, then she jumps on him and throws the candy apple at Dark Cupid's head but he removes it, causing the candy apple stuck on his hand now.)
Ladybug: Looks like you've got yourself in a sticky situation!
(Dark Cupid removes the candy apple from his hand and tries to shoot an arrow at her but his hand gets stuck to the bow.)
Dark Cupid: (yells) Ladybug!!
Ladybug: And now, for the pussy-cat! (Cat Noir stands up then he yells and he continues to fight Ladybug by chasing her until he sits on top of her)
Dark Cupid: Cat Noir, her Miraculous! (meanwhile starts washing his hands at the fountain)
Cat Noir: With pleasure! Finally, I'll find out who you are, Ladybug! Your little secret will be out of the bag!
(Before Cat Noir finds out who Ladybug really is, she grabs his face and kisses him to break the spell.)
Cat Noir: (he’s confused, his lips turn to normal while the arrow’s effect disappears) Huh? Wh-what am I doing here?
(Ladybug grabs his hand and carries him.)

title: Dark Cupid/Transcript
text:
Dark Cupid/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: No time! The quiver pin, Cat Noir! Now! (throws Cat Noir, making him scream and he lands on top of Dark Cupid) Grab it! Grab the pin!
(Cat Noir accidentally destroys the sash with Cataclysm.)
Dark Cupid: No!
Cat Noir: (takes the pin) Sorry, need that. Happy Valentine's Day! (throws the quiver pin to Ladybug)
Ladybug: Awww, you shouldn't have... (drops the pin) Whoops! (stomps on the pin to release the akuma) No more evil-doing for you, little akuma. Time to de-evilize! (captures the akuma) Gotcha! (releases the purified butterfly) Bye bye, little butterfly.
[ Superpower Sequence ]Ladybug: Miraculous Ladybug! (throws the Lucky Charm into the air and its energy restores everything back to normal)
Alya: (she is about to cut a picture of her and Marinette in half) What the heck am I doing?
Chloé: (to Sabrina) What the heck are you doing?!
Sabrina: (turns out she was scribbling on Adrien's portrait) I-I have no idea! (both sob in despair)
Kim: (he transforms back to his normal self) Huh?
Ladybug & Cat Noir: Pound it!
Ladybug: (her Miraculous beeps) Oops!
Cat Noir: Wait, Ladybug! I gotta tell you something.
Ladybug: Look, the kiss... I had to break the spell, or...

title: Dark Cupid/Transcript
text:
Dark Cupid/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: Kiss? What kiss? No, I just wanted to say... (his Miraculous also beeps)
Ladybug: Look out, Cat Noir, your ring is flashing!
Cat Noir: Uhh... yours too!
Ladybug: (laughs) We're about to turn into pumpkins, and personally, I'd rather not see that. (both Ladybug and Cat Noir run away in opposite directions)
Hawk Moth: Grrr... blasted Ladybug! Blasted Valentine's Day!
(The window closes.)
Tikki: Hey, there's your chance to get your card back!
Marinette: That was before...
Tikki: Before what? Tell me!
Marinette: I realized that even with all this hate everywhere, love still wins. But if I wanna win over Adrien, he needs to know the truth about how I feel.
Tikki: Ah! This is a big day!
Plagg: Hahaha! Can you believe all the horrible thoughtless things you said to Ladybug? (eats his Camembert)
Adrien: You think it's funny, huh? Ugh!
Plagg: What's the big deal? You've got so many cards from all these lady fans of yours! Take your pick! (he chooses between all the cards and he picks a heart-shaped one by tossing the card to Adrien while he is laying facing down on the bed and have his eyes closed)

title: Dark Cupid/Transcript
text:
Dark Cupid/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: (sees the card and gets surprised) Whoa, hold up! Someone answered my poem? But I threw it away! (he starts to read the poem) "Your hair shines like the sun, your eyes are gorgeous green, I look at you and wonder your innermost thoughts and dreams. Yes, your Valentine I will be, our love will be so true, together for eternity, my heart belongs to you." (gasps)
Plagg: Aww, well, anyone who writes as sickeningly sweet as you must be your soulmate.
Adrien: It isn't signed... (a ladybug flies and lands on the card. He follows it to the window, and watches it fly away) Could it have come from Ladybug?
Plagg: Oh, please.
Alya: What do you mean, you don't remember? Did you sign the card or not?
Marinette: I don't know! The ladybug came along while I was writing, then you were yapping about your blog, and then... It's all a blur!
Alya: (laughs) I don't believe you! The girl didn't even sign it! I love you and all, but sometimes you seriously bug! You know that, right?
(Both of them laugh as a ladybug flies outside the house.)

title: Darkblade
text:
Darkblade - Intro
"" is a season 1 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. According to the series' production/written order, it is the 14th episode of season 1, as well as the 14th episode of the series, overall.

title: Darkblade
text:
Darkblade - Synopsis
While Marinette tries to retrieve her diary from Chloé, Adrien's fencing teacher is akumatized into Darkblade, a villain who storms city hall.
Disney+
Ladybug faces Armand D'Argencourt, now Darkblade.

title: Darkblade
text:
Darkblade - Plot
Marinette jumps down into her room from the balcony, immediately detransforming from Ladybug. Nadja Chamack is on Marinette's computer, the news report about how Ladybug and Cat Noir saved the day. Marinette pulls out a pink box, prompting Tikki to ask about it. Marinette explains that it will be holding her diary, which contains all of her secrets as Ladybug. Marinette sets the diary in the box with the lid open, telling Tikki to try and take it out. Tikki flies down and picks up the edge. Before she can fly out, the lid slams shut, locking her inside. Marinette lets her out with a key.

title: Darkblade
text:
Darkblade - Plot
Nadja Chamack switches to another news report, stating that the previous day, André Bourgeois was reelected for the fourth time as the Mayor of Paris. Seeing Chloé's attitude in the news footage, Marinette comments that Chloé is acting like she is the one to have been reelected. This comment prompts Marinette to remember that the next day is the election for class representatives at Collège Françoise Dupont and that Chloé is in the running. Tikki suggests that Marinette run too, but Marinette feels as if she has too much to do between homework and saving Paris. The news report returns, bringing with it the face of Armand D'Argencourt, the losing candidate, who is also a fencing instructor at the collège. Marinette rests her hand on her chin, watching the report until she sees the time in the corner of 8:44 am, knowing she'll be late to school if she stays any longer.
In Miss Bustier's classroom, Chloé and Sabrina are standing in the front of the students.
Chloé is running with Sabrina as her deputy.
Just then, Marinette runs in, her excuse being that she missed the bus and she has a cold.

title: Darkblade
text:
Darkblade - Plot
Alya brings Marinette up to speed, mentioning that Chloé has been the class representative since elementary school.
Miss Bustier dismisses them for lunch, letting the class mull over its decision.
In the school's courtyard, Chloé uses threats to dissuade Kim from entering the race for class representative and wanders off with Sabrina to threaten the rest of the class.
When Marinette asks Alix what Chloé told her, Alix mentions that she doesn't care and wonders why Marinette won't run.
Marinette claims again that she's far too busy to run, but then cedes that she will run if no one else will.
Returning to the classroom, Miss Bustier asks if anyone else wants to run against Chloé and Sabrina.
Finding no opposition, Miss Bustier almost declares Chloé and Sabrina the class representatives, but Marinette interjects, stating that she'll enter the race.
Excited, Miss Bustier tells Marinette that the next day the candidates will give speeches and the students will have a chance to vote.

title: Darkblade
text:
Darkblade - Plot
During a break, Alya tries to help Marinette come up with a campaign platform. Marinette realizes that she had not put much thought into how to run a campaign, but is approached by Rose, Juleka, and Nino, who supply her with plenty of ideas. Alya spots Adrien descending the stairs and asks him if he will vote for Marinette. Adrien responds that he will if she gives a good speech, thereby motivating Marinette further. Only meters away, Chloé and Sabrina watch the scene, and Chloé explains to Sabrina that according to her father, the best way to win a political race is to destroy the opposition's reputation and reveal its secrets.
Back in her room, Marinette lists what her classmates want in her diary, trying to come up with her speech. Marinette's cellphone buzzes, and when Marinette picks up she sees Alya, who appears angry. Alya explains that Chloé invited the entire class to the Hôtel de Ville to meet Jagged Stone. Marinette is excited since Jagged Stone is her favorite singer but quickly realizes that Chloé is buying her classmates' votes with autographs. Marinette leaves her room, leaving the diary box open on her desk.

title: Darkblade
text:
Darkblade - Plot
As Marinette runs out of the bakery, Sabrina steps around the corner, on her phone with Chloé. Sabrina walks in past the customers Sabine is waiting on, claiming she needs to pick up a math book that Marinette borrowed from her. Sabine explains that Marinette just left, and sends Sabrina up to Marinette's room.
During his fencing class, Adrien is taken out by a remarkable attack from his coach, Mr. D'Argencourt, who reveals that the move was developed by his ancestor, Darkblade. D'Argencourt then explains how his ancestor once conquered Paris and ruled over it with an iron fist, but was overthrown by a wealthy Frenchman. Nadja Chamack appears behind him and asks him whether the story of his ancestor was what motivated him to run in the election. Infuriated, Mr. D'Argencourt ends Adrien's lesson and storms off. Hawk Moth senses Mr. D'Argencourt's frustration and sends an akuma after him.

title: Darkblade
text:
Darkblade - Plot
As Mr. D'Argencourt leaves the school, Nadja and her cameraman follow him while getting footage for the news. When Mr. D'Argencourt bumps into a poster featuring Mayor Bourgeois, he angrily slashes it to pieces, surprising the news crew behind him. The akuma then arrives and possesses his fencing sword. Hawk Moth offers D'Argencourt the chance to be the city's new ruler and akumatizes him into the supervillain Darkblade, who transforms Nadja and her cameraman into knights. He proclaims that he will form an army, take over City Hall, and reclaim his family's throne. Seeing Darkblade continue to turn citizens into knights, Adrien transforms into Cat Noir. Darkblade and Cat Noir face off and begin to fight.

title: Darkblade
text:
Darkblade - Plot
Meanwhile, Sabrina arrives inside Marinette's room and talks to Chloé on the phone, trying to find something to steal that they could use against Marinette. Sabrina spots Marinette's diary and tries to grab it, only to have the diary box close down on her hand. Meanwhile, Marinette arrives at City Hall and sees Jagged Stone and the launch party for Chloé's campaign. Alya meets Marinette, revealing that she got Jagged Stone's autograph. This offends Marinette, but she eventually decides that this is all right as long as Alya still votes for her.
Cat Noir continues fighting with Darkblade at the Pont des Arts but loses when his staff is thrown off the bridge. He hides under the bridge and manages to overhear Darkblade's plan to go after Mayor Bourgeois at City Hall.

title: Darkblade
text:
Darkblade - Plot
Back at City Hall, Marinette explains to her classmates that Chloé is bribing them for their votes. Chloé arrives, pulls Marinette away from the crowd, and reveals to her that she and Sabrina have her diary, blackmailing her to end her campaign. This conversation is interrupted by Darkblade and his army, who storm the building but are blocked by Cat Noir. Jagged Stone mistakes the battle outside for excited fans, goes out to perform for them, and is confronted by Darkblade. Jagged Stone tries to persuade Darkblade that "violence is never the answer," and is promptly transformed into a knight.

title: Darkblade
text:
Darkblade - Plot
Panicking about Darkblade, several students ask Chloé for help. Chloé replies that she can't help her classmates unless they vote for her and that she'll announce a solution the following day. Marinette realizes that Cat Noir needs her help to defeat the knights, but also realizes that her classmates are depending on her to protect them. Tikki suggests that she trust her instincts, and so Marinette begins guiding her classmates in barricading the doors and defending City Hall, and tells the mayor they have to retreat. Once everyone is out of the way, she turns into Ladybug and rushes to help Cat Noir.

title: Darkblade
text:
Darkblade - Plot
Outside, Cat Noir is surrounded by knights, but Ladybug rescues him with her yo-yo. As they work together to fight off the knights, Darkblade turns two cars into catapults and launches himself onto the roof. Cat Noir and Ladybug follow him and see that he is about to place his family flag on top of City Hall. Ladybug realizes that akuma must be in Darkblade's sword, and tries to get the sword before he plants the flag, but she is too late. As Darkblade plants the flag, a dark cloud spreads over Paris and creates a gigantic cylinder of darkness that shrinks inwards, turning everyone it passes through into knights.
Ladybug and Cat Noir realize that they have little time to spare before they too are transformed into knights.  Ladybug uses Lucky Charm, which produces a small wind-up toy. Using her lucky vision, Ladybug tosses the toy under Darkblade's shoulder, tickling him and causing him to drop his sword. Ladybug rushes in and snatches the sword, revealing the akuma and causing the cylinder of darkness to vanish. She catches the akuma and purifies it, tosses the toy into the sky, and cleanses the city, returning everyone back to normal.

title: Darkblade
text:
Darkblade - Plot
Ladybug finds her way back inside and detransforms. Tikki expresses her pride in Marinette for being both Ladybug and a student leader at the same time. While the students removed the posters and chairs from the door, Marinette makes it public that Chloé had stolen her diary. The students start to surround and question Chloé, who tries to deny all allegations against her, but her efforts are in vain as Sabrina shows the box locked around her hand and pleads that Marinette opens it, which she obliges to. Chloé's inexcusable actions lead most of the students to believe that she's already lost the race to be the class representative.
However, Marinette explains to her classmates that she wants to be voted in fairly, and not just because she's an alternative to Chloé. She explains that she will not make any promises that she would be unable to keep, but asserts that she is resourceful and knows how to prioritize–and most importantly, that she believes in herself, earning praise from the class, including Sabrina, causing Chloé to walk away furiously. The following morning, Marinette is elected as the new representative, with Alya as her deputy.

title: Darkblade
text:
Darkblade - Plot Developments
In the image that appears behind Marinette when she says that she's too busy to run for class representative, there are images of Ladybug saving a baby, saving a train full of people, saving an airplane from falling on the Eiffel Tower, and stopping a meteorite.
Which foreshadowed in "Gigantitan" when she and Cat Noir saved baby August, in "Prime Queen", when they saved Chloé from a speeding train and many more in "Queen Wasp".
When Marinette comments about Chloe acting as the mayor of Paris foreshadows the latter doing so in "Revolution".

title: Darkblade
text:
Darkblade - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in Korea.
This episode was the twelfth to air in France and Korea.
In the French, Korean, and English dubs of the episode, Juleka doesn't make any sense when Rose and Nino are asking Marinette to do things with her campaign. However, in the Spanish dub, she asks to be able to watch horror films.
The transformation music in this episode is changed slightly with a rock-n-roll edge to it.
André Bourgeois called Jagged Stone a pop star in the English dub.
When Hawk Moth akumatizes D'Argencourt into Darkblade, he does not explain what power he gives as Darkblade. Instead, he gets to the point on grabbing the miraculous jewels in return for the powers.
Alya's contact photo on Marinette's phone is different from the other two seen in all other episodes.
References
Cat Noir doesn't use Cataclysm in this episode following along with "The Mime".
Errors
In the English version, in the ending monologue Hawk Moth says that at the end of the battle, he will rule. In the original French version, however, he says that he will hit the bull's-eye. Thomas Astruc confirmed that it was a translation error.

title: Darkblade
text:
Darkblade - Trivia
According to the speed of the circle closing in, Ladybug and Chat Noir would've turned into Darkblade's knights.
Marinette's computer doesn't have a keyboard in the beginning of the episode.
When Marinette leaves for the City Hall, she leaves her pen beside the diary chest, but when Sabrina is in Marinette's room later, the pen is on top of the diary instead.
When Marinette is rolling in her chair, her diary chest appears to be open. However, in the next scene, it is closed.
Throughout the scene when Marinette explains to Alix and Alya that she's very busy to run for class representative, her earrings are in charged mode instead of camouflage mode.
Plagg leaves Adrien's shirt to witness Darkblade knighting Nadja and her cameraman, yet also leaves again when Adrien exits into the school to transform.
When Alya asks Marinette what she is busy with, she appears out of nowhere rather than walking in.
When Sabrina tries on the hat Marinette made in the bedroom, the flower on the hat changes position from back to front.
In several scenes, Sabrina is shown without the diary chest on her hand when it should be.

title: Darkblade
text:
Darkblade - Trivia
In one frame when Marinette rushes to admire the poster of Jagged Stone in her room, a framed photo of Adrien is layered above her.
When Marinette tells Rose, Nino, and Nathaniel that they are being bribed by Chloé, Nathaniel's hair is darker then it should be.
Hawk Moth makes his typical remark, "It won't be long before Ladybug and Cat Noir show up to meet their doom!" after the pair has already been on the scene for some time.
In the French and Korean dubbed versions, there is an error where Cat Noir's Miraculous beeps after Cat Noir and Ladybug defeated Darkblade despite he doesn't use Cataclysm at all. This has been corrected in the English version.
Also, he looks at his miraculous and leaves the scene as if he was about to transform back, despite not using his powers.
Penny's hair is miscolored pink.
At the beginning of the episode, Marinette puts the diary chest into her bag but the bag seems to be not big enough to hold the chest.
Alya says that Chloé has been class representative since kindergarten, even though she only joined the class at the beginning of the school year.

title: Darkblade
text:
Darkblade - Trivia
Though, it's possible that she somehow found out Chloé was class representative while she was attending Collège Françoise Dupont.

title: Darkblade/Transcript
text:
Darkblade/Transcript - Intro
[ Theme Song ]
Nadja: (giving a news report on Marinette's computer.) Ladybug and Cat Noir have saved Paris yet again.
Marinette: (grunts) And yet again, Marinette hopes she'll finally have enough time to complete her magic box.
Tikki: What's the magic box for, Marinette?
Marinette: To lock up my diary, and all my secrets.
Tikki: Every little secret? You're telling me that you write everything down in that thing?
Marinette: Uh... yeah, something wrong?
(Marinette repeatedly closes and opens her box to test if it works.)
Tikki: Well, for one, what if someone finds out you're Ladybug? And two, what if someone finds out you're Ladybug?!
Marinette: Not gonna happen. Try it, Tikki.
(Tikki flies in the box and tries to lift the diary, but gets locked in.)
Tikki: (Muffled) Hey!
Marinette: And... it works! (Marinette unlocks the box to free Tikki)
Nadja: (From computer.) Yesterday, Mr. Bourgeois was re-elected as mayor of Paris for the fourth consecutive term. Here we see Mr. Bourgeois with his daughter.
Marinette: Ugh! Look at Chloé, acting as if she were the mayor of Paris! Oh! Which reminds me, Class Representative Elections are tomorrow!
Tikki: What's so bad about that?

title: Darkblade/Transcript
text:
Darkblade/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Chloé is running for class rep. The one person who cares the least about the students, and the most about herself.
Tikki: Well then, maybe you should run!
Marinette: I totally would, but, don't you think I got enough to do with my duties as Ladybug and all my school work?
Tikki: Yes, but, if you truly believe in something, you have to try and make it work. It's better to fail trying than not having tried at all!
Marinette: Maybe...
Tikki: Don't underestimate yourself, Marinette!
Nadja: (From computer.) Armand D'Argencourt, one of Bourgeois's opponents, and fencing instructors of Françoise Dupont High School, was pummeled in the polls. In fact, D'Argencourt acquired the least number of votes in Paris History.
(Marinette looks at the clock in the computer, and gasps.)
Marinette: I'm going to be late for school! Again! See, this is what I'm talking about! (closes computer)
Miss Bustier: Chloé is running for the class representative position and Sabrina will be her deputy. Do we have any other candidates?
(Kim raises his hand but Chloé and Sabrina glare at him.)
Chloé and Sabrina: Hm!
Miss Bustier: Yes, Kim?
Kim: Um, er... nothing.
(Marinette enters the classroom.)

title: Darkblade/Transcript
text:
Darkblade/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Hi! I'm sorry! I-uh, I-uh, the bus, (Marinette starts coughing), dry throat!
Alya: Chloé's running again! She's been class rep since when? Kindergarten?
Marinette: Oh! Why don't you run as candidate? You'd make an awesome representative!
Alya: No can do. My blog is a full-time job!
Miss Bustier: Alright, I'll give all of you till the end of lunch to decide if you like to be a candidate.
Marinette: (to Kim) So what did Chloé say to you this time? She offered to go on a date with you?
Kim: No, she threatened to tell everyone I'm afraid of spiders.
Rose: She told me that if I ran for the election, I'd get kicked out of scrapbooking club, and you know how much I love all those stickers, colorful scraps of papers, and gluing!
Alix: I couldn't care less about being a candidate, and what's your excuse?
Marinette: Well, uh, um, I'm... really busy! (thinks about being Ladybug and saving Paris)
Alya: With what? Oversleeping?
Marinette: Well, No! But, uh, well, I guess I would run if no one else did.
Miss Bustier: So, are there any new candidates who would like to run against Chloé and Sabrina?
(Marinette looks around, looking at Kim and Rose, the latter of whom squeaks.)

title: Darkblade/Transcript
text:
Darkblade/Transcript - Intro
Miss Bustier: Given that Chloé and Sabrina are the only candidates, there's no point in voting. So, Chloé and Sabrina...
(Chloé and Sabrina sigh in satisfaction.)
Marinette: (panics at the last minute; raises her hand) I'll run!
(Everyone except Chloé and Sabrina looks at her excitedly.)
Miss Bustier: (surprised) Wonderful! You'll need to develop your campaign and have a speech ready by tomorrow. We'll have the vote then.
Alya: So, let's hear the scoop on your campaign! How are you gonna represent?
Marinette: Represent? Uh, I have no idea. I still can't believe I raised my hand...
(Rose, Ivan, Juleka and Nino come over to them, enthusiastic.)
Rose: Way to go, Marinette! You spoke from the heart, it was truly authentic! (she giggles)
Marinette: Huh? Oh, uh... Thanks.
Rose: When you win, can we get more comfortable chairs? They're so hard, I can barely concentrate in class. (she gasps in delight) Maybe pink ones!
Nino: And it'd be primo if we could listen to our beats while we study in the library.
Juleka: Uh, you know... um, I don't-, you know.
Marinette: Um... (Chuckles) Sure, Juleka.
Alya: (sees Adrien) Adrien! Marinette can count on your vote, right?

title: Darkblade/Transcript
text:
Darkblade/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: Sure, depending on her speech. (leaves)
Marinette: (stares at Adrien) Better get cracking on that campaign. (Alya nuzzles her head)
Chloé: (from afar) I've watched how my daddy wins every election, and I'm going to follow in his footsteps. I know just how to win!
Sabrina: By having the best campaign?
Chloé: Ha! Whatever! The secret to winning in politics is ruining your opponent's reputation!
Marinette: Softer chairs, music in the library, whatever Juleka said... I'm writing down everyone's issues! Now I just have to get all this in my election speech.
Tikki: I'm proud of you, I'm sure you're gonna win! You'll make an awesome class rep!
Marinette: They're all relying on me to defeat Chloé. Even Adrien, do you realize that?
(Marinette's phone vibrates. It's Alya calling.)
Alya: (From phone.) Marinette, battle's on.
Marinette: Why? What's going on?
Alya: Chloé's invited the whole class to her campaign launch party at City Hall and she's got Jagged Stone coming, too!
Marinette: Seriously? Jagged Stone, my favorite star?! I love him! Oh, and so does everyone else.
Alya: Precisely! She's trying to buy student votes with autographs!

title: Darkblade/Transcript
text:
Darkblade/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Not if I have anything to say about it! Meet you there!
(Marinette leaves the house, but forgets her diary. Sabrina, undercover, is about to enter the bakery to look for something to embarrass Marinette.)
Sabrina: I'm going in, Chloé. (enters the bakery)
Sabine: Hello!
Sabrina: Hi there! Marinette borrowed my math book for our Geometry homework, but I need it back.
Sabine: Marinette's not here, uh, I've got customers to attend to, but go on up and grab it from her room if you don't mind.
Sabrina: I'd be glad to, thanks!
Adrien: Wow, Mr. D'Argencourt, never seen you on fire like this! That was some attack!
Armand: It ought be. This particular maneuver hither was developed by my ancestor Darkblade.
Adrien: Darkblade?
Armand: In the days of yore, Darkblade conquered Paris and ruled over it with an iron fist. Until he was overthrown vence by a wealthy Frenchman who used his dirty gold to buy the loyalties of the common people. To think that not so long ago, my ancestor's flag was waving above Paris...
Nadja: Is that why you ran in the election, Mr. D'Argencourt? To seek revenge on your ancestors behalf?
Armand: Part le fer! Who dost we have hither?

title: Darkblade/Transcript
text:
Darkblade/Transcript - Intro
Nadja: Nadja Chamack. Don't be bemused, it's just the news! Do you have anything to say about your quote un-quote landslide defeat?
Fred: Hey, you! Excuse me! How did you get in the school?
Nadja: I think it's time to get back to the studio! (runs away)
Fred: Get back here!
Armand: Here endeth the lesson.
Hawk Moth: A loser and an utter failure in an election. But the perfect candidate to lobby my own campaign. (turns a butterfly into an akuma) Fly away, my evil little akuma, and take control of this defeated fighter!
Nadja: Mr. D'Argencourt, it has been said, and I quote, that you're "stuck in the dark ages like a stubborn old rusted battle-axe". What do you have to say to that?
Armand: Poisonous wretch! Darest thou approach with such venomous questions? Be gone now, pestilent pain in the neck! (bumps into a poster with Mr. Bourgeois in it. He slices it to pieces. The akuma comes and enters his saber.)
Hawk Moth: Darkblade... In return for the powers I'm giving you, you'll capture Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous for me.

title: Darkblade/Transcript
text:
Darkblade/Transcript - Intro
Armand: When the flag bearing the emblem of mine ancestors lies once again upon the roof of City Hall, then to thee I shall indeed be indebted! (turns into Darkblade)
Nadja: (suddenly nervous) Anything y-you'd like to say about your t-transformation into a-
Darkblade: Darkblade! The lord of Paris! (uses his sword to turn both Nadja and her cameraman into knights) Thou shalt become my knights! Soon mine army shalt be immense and unstoppable! (cuts the billboard in half with his sword) We shall take City Hall by storm and reclaim the throne from Bourgeois the usurper!
(Adrien and Plagg are watching what happens; Plagg drifts idly over Adrien's shoulder.)
Plagg: Whoa, that's some medieval madness!
Adrien: (enters the school) Time to transform!
[ Transformation Sequence ]Adrien: Plagg, claws out! (Adrien transforms into Cat Noir)
Darkblade: (approaches the Gorilla) Zounds! What a great beast to join our conquest! (turns him into a knight)
(Civilians chant "Part le fer!" as Darkblade expands his army.)
Darkblade: Let us to battle, knights! Part le fer!
Cat Noir: The people had their say and they chose Bourgeois over you, D'Argencourt!

title: Darkblade/Transcript
text:
Darkblade/Transcript - Intro
Darkblade: Thy peoples matter not to me. D'Argencourt was defeated, not Darkblade! En garde!
Sabrina:  (from Chloé's phone) Chloé, I made it in. So, what am I looking for?
Chloé:  (from Sabrina's phone) Anything. As long as it's totally embarrassing.
Sabrina: (searching, she finds a hat Marinette made) Wait, I had one just like this! How about... a ball of yarn! Or a screwdriver?
Chloé: 'Course not, dingbat! A disgusting photo of her or some really tacky piece of clothing! Dig around a bit!
Sabrina: (after looking at photos of Adrien; sees Marinette's diary) Ohh... how about her diary?
Chloé: Wow! You can actually accomplish something when you put my mind to it!
(Sabrina is about to grab the diary from the box, but the diary's box closes down on her hand. She yelps and tries to get it off, dropping her phone.)
Chloé: Sabrina? Sabrina?!
Mr. Bourgeois: I'm pleased to welcome you all to the official launch of Chloé's electoral campaign. And a special thank-you to world-famous pop-star Jagged Stone for endorsing her.
(The other students are amazed.)
Chloé: And, when you vote for me, you'll get free tickets to Jagged's next concert!
(Alya gets an autographed CD, and Marinette sees her.)

title: Darkblade/Transcript
text:
Darkblade/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Huh! You got an autograph?
Alya: Uh... Yeah, got you one too. Sorry, couldn't help myself.
Marinette: Nope, I'm not falling for it. But, I'll consider forgiving you if you vote for me.
(Alya chuckles and nods.)
(Darkblade performs the same feint-and-strike he did to Adrien before. His staff goes flying.)
Cat Noir: Seriously? How did I not see that coming?
Darkblade: Take him!
(His knights go after Cat Noir, but he throws himself out of the bridge, hiding under it.)
Darkblade: Nary a minute to be wasted! City Hall awaits us!
Cat Noir: City Hall, huh? You go first. I'll catch up with you.
Chloé: What took you so long? You'd better have gotten her diary.
Sabrina: I did! Sorta... (shows her the locked diary box)
Chloé: (she gasps and turns Sabrina away from their classmates) What is that?
Sabrina: When I grabbed the diary, this crazy box clipped down around my hand!
Chloé: And I'm supposed to believe you? Ughhh... Why do I bother?
Marinette: Do you realize that you're all being bribed? Concert tickets are awesome, but they aren't gonna solve classroom problems.
Nathaniel: So what's your campaign then, Marinette?

title: Darkblade/Transcript
text:
Darkblade/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Well, uh, I'm, uh, thinking cushions would be more realistic than buying new chairs. (to Rose) Your cushion could be very pink. And I'll see about listening to music in the library. Through headphones, of course.
Chloé: (sarcastically) Remarkable. You actually sound like a class rep. Too bad you don't have a chance of winning. A word?
(Chloe shoves her behind the pillar Sabrina is hiding behind.)
Marinette: Oh! My diary! What were you doing-?
Chloé: If you don't pull out of the race, all your secrets will be revealed.
Marinette: Don't-uh, I mean, uh, what secrets?
Chloé: Ha! I guess we'll find out... as soon as I get my hands on a chainsaw!
(Trumpets start playing a fanfare.)
Knight: O-ye, o-ye! Darkblade shalt speak now! Listen or be imprisoned!
Darkblade: Henceforth, my flag shalt fly over thy kingdom! Bourgeois, pathetic knave, come hither and do battle!
Mr. Bourgeois: What did he say?
Alya: Basically, he's gonna bust you up.
Mr. Bourgeois: Ehh... Ask my secretary for an appointment!
(He and the students shut the doors.)

title: Dean Gate
text:
Dean Gate - Intro
Professor , also known as Doorman, is a major character in Miraculous World: New York - United Heroez. He is a teacher at Armstrong High School in the Queens borough of New York City in the United States of America.

title: Dean Gate
text:
Dean Gate - Appearance
Physical appearance
Dean is a tall, thin man with a bald head.
Civile attire
He wears circular glasses, a white shirt with a green sweater, a green and white striped tie, and brown pants.
As Doorman
Doorman wears glasses with pink lenses, a white shirt, pink tie, white gloves, and a dark purple coat and pants with pink accents on the collar, arms up to his shoulders, hands and leg holes, and a stripe down the buttons of his coat.

title: Dean Gate
text:
Dean Gate - Personality
He is mostly informative, friendly and helpful along with a strong sense of morality when using his powers.
However, when under the effects of Liberation, he becomes extremely curious and selfish.

title: Dean Gate
text:
Dean Gate - Abilities
Doorman can turn any door into a portal connecting any two locations, such as from Paris to New York. The exit portal appears in a door at the desired location and portal remains for as long as the door stays open. Once the door is closed, the portal closes as well and he can then use that same door to open another portal to an entirely different location. The only known weakness to this ability is that once the door is damaged it can no longer be used as a portal.

title: Dean Gate
text:
Dean Gate - Trivia
A character named Doorman, who also has the power to create and open portals, exists in Marvel Comics.
He is a reference to Craig Pelton who's the dean of Greendale Community College from Community.
In the United States, deans are mostly prevalent in tertiary education (American colleges and universities) than in secondary education (American middle and high schools). Though, deans are also common in private college-preparatory schools. Because Gate works at a public high school and he's referred to as a "teacher" by Alya Césaire, it's unlikely that he's an actual dean at Armstrong High School.
He bears resemblance to the doorman of Le Grand Paris.
In the French dub, Dean is revealed to be a teacher at Armstrong High School which is something that's never mentioned in the English dub.

title: Dean Gate
text:
Dean Gate - Trivia
On Jessica's contact list, Dean Gate is labeled as "Prof. Gate". However, while the "professor" title normally applies to those who teach American tertiary schools, this is not an error. New York has a very different education system compared to the other states where it allows teachers to be a "professor" or "doctor" at secondary schools. Some teachers can even prefer being called by their "professor" title instead of the "Mr."/"Ms."/"Mrs." title.

title: Delmar
text:
Delmar - Intro
is an American boy who lives in the Queens borough of New York City. He is also a student in Professor Gate's class at Armstrong High School.

title: Delmar
text:
Delmar - Appearance
Physical appearance
Delmar is a dark skinned boy with short black hair. He has brown eyes and he wears a green jacket over a white shirt and green pants.

title: Delmar
text:
Delmar - Personality
Delmar is a very kind and open person. He is the first to greet Marinette and Adrien, praising them for the puppet video created by their class. Moments later, he invites French guests to a secret rooftop party. When he sees Sabrina, he sends the girl a "peephole", and when she does not appear at the party, he personally follows her so that the girl does not sit in the room.

title: Delmar
text:
Delmar - Relationships
Sabrina Raincomprix
Sabrina and Delmar have crushes on each other. They first met when Sabrina and her class arrived in New York.

title: Delmar
text:
Delmar - History
Miraculous New York
For the French American Friendship celebration ceremony, Delmar and his class stayed at Hotel Lafayette. At the lobby of the hotel, Delmar played table football with his classmates. There he noticed Marinette Dupain-Cheng fall along with her suitcase, which opened releasing the sock puppets that Miss Bustier's class used for the student film they made.
Delmar recognizes them and helps them pick up the sock puppets. Delmar then tells Marinette, Alya Césaire, and Sabrina Raincomprix about a rooftop party. He invites them but tells them to be quite so no adult finds out. As he leaves he winks at Sabrina, making her blush.

title: Delmar
text:
Delmar - History
Later when night falls, Delmar goes to Sabrina's room and opens the window invitingly for Sabrina. The two walk together onto the fire escape and into the rooftop party. Soon, Delmar sees Hot Dog Dan in the sky and corrects Marinette and Adrien Agreste who thought it was bird or a plane, respectively. He then watched as Sabrina tried one of Hot Dog Dan's magical hot dogs and grew magical hair. Then as Jessica Keynes starts to play the song played in "Despair Bear" at Chloé Bourgeois' party, Delmar and Sabrina are seen dancing with arms wrapped around each other.
The next day, Delmar and his class go to the New-York Historical Society on a bus. After getting off the bus, he is seen when Dean Gate is counting his students to make sure everyone is there. Inside, Delmar is seen standing behind Sabrina and Chloé while they waited for the tour to start. When the tour given by Professor Gate begins, Delmar is seen listening to him as talked about various history moments.

title: Delmar
text:
Delmar - History
Back at the hotel, Delmar is seen in front of Sabrina watching the news with the other hotel guest, where President Camilla Hombee/Victory makes a statement about the hunt for Techno Pirate and postpones the French American Friendship celebration ceremony. Delmar and Sabrina are then seen holding each other tight as they continue to watch the news.
That night, Delmar attends the French American Friendship celebration ceremony. He is first seen talking to someone as Marinette talked to Alya. Then as the fireworks go on, Delmar watch as Sabrina told Chloé she was glad to see her finally having fun. Delmar then smiled as Chloé responsed by saying she was only happy because they were leaving the next day.

Dearest Family - Intro
"" is a Season 4 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 21st written and produced episode of Season 4. It is also the 99th written and produced episode of the series, overall.

text:
Dearest Family - Synopsis
Galette day and an awkward gift from Gina to her granddaughter give Shadow Moth an opportunity to reakumatize the whole Dupain-Cheng family at once. Bakerix, Weredad, Qilin and Befana are back. And if that wasn't bad enough, Tikki suddenly gets a serious case of the munchies and starts acting really strange. Will Cat Noir's help be enough to help Ladybug be the queen of the day?
Disney+
Ladybug and Cat Noir face Dearest Family.
Netflix
On Three Kings Day, Tikki becomes obsessed with galettes and Marinette must fight more of her akumatized family members.

title: Dearest Family

text:
