The episode starts with Gabriel trying to akumatize himself while having a magical charm, but due to him getting a magical charm, the akuma is unable to akumatize him and gets purified instead. He talks to Nathalie through his tablet and says that the magical charm keeps on repelling the akuma to which Nathalie replies that if Ladybug was able to create a magical charm, his powers are capable of growing too. She also says that its written in the Grimoire that "the only limits to the powers of the Miraculous are those their holders set for themselves". To which, Gabriel transforms to Shadow Moth and concentrates on his power to create a much powerful akuma then tries to akumatize himself again after detransforming but with no avail, then transforms again and makes another akuma, this time with even more evil force as a purple colored light surrounds him and purple lightning streaks began to form around it as it flutters away from his palm. He detransforms again and this time successfully akumatizing himself into the Collector, and destroying the magical charm.

text:

Meanwhile in the Dupain-Cheng Bakery, Tom tries to open the oven to take out the galette. However, Roland barges in and tells him that is not how it is done. He opens the oven and the three of them, Tom, Roland and Sabine, gasp in amazement as the galette comes out golden-brown, shining. Tom then takes out the galette and sets it on the table. The three of them each take a bite of the galette and the three of them shower it with compliments. Sabine then congratulates Tom and Roland for it was the first recipe they made together. Roland and Tom then hug each other. Then, Sabine draws up the curtains and sees the long queue of people outside the bakery, waiting to buy their galette.

In Marinette's room, the smell of the galettes wakes Tikki up. She asks Marinette what the smell is, so Marinette explains to her that it was a galette that is made for King's Day and whoever finds the charm in their slice gets to wear the golden paper crown, but also says that it was too early and tells Tikki to go back to sleep. Tikki then says that she had never smelled something so sweet and wonderful and asked Marinette if she could go try a little bit. However, Marinette refused and said that nobody could see her. The Kwamis arise from their sleep and Barkk says that she's hungry. Marinette reluctantly gets up and says that she gets it.

title: Dearest Family

text:

Back down at the Dupain-Cheng Bakery, Tom and Roland work together to bake the galettes while Sabine packs them in boxes. She also asks them if she can have a tiny piece of galette. Tom is about to cut a slice of galette for Marinette but suddenly, Roland snatches it away and says that it was not how it was done and the tradition was that they were supposed to sell all the galettes first, then the last one is for the family to share. From Marinette's purse, Tikki sniffs the galette and admires it while Marinette laughs and Tom gives her croissants instead. Marinette thanks her father and walks away.

At the stairway, Tikki squeals in excitement and Marinette tells her they would have to wait until that night until they can eat the galette, but she could have the croissant to eat while waiting. She also say that she had to taste whatever it was and pleaded with Marinette to let her try it. Marinette heads back into her room where she tells the Kwamis that she brought them some galette.
However, she gasps in shock when seeing that there was no galette in her purse and it looked like Tikki had eaten it all.

She lies to the Kwamis that she must have dropped it somewhere and apologises, in order to protect Tikki.

Tikki immediately flies out of Marinette's purse and shouts at them for accusing her.

Sass tells Marinette that she knows how much Tikki loves to eat, but also asked her if she understood her appetite for food.
Stompp cried that it was a gourmet craving of cosmic dimensions.

Marinette then interrupts him by saying that he was exaggerating and that it was just a galette.

Tikki flew in front of her and told her not to listen to the Kwamis and that it was easier to go back down to get more galette for everybody.

title: Dearest Family

text:
Dearest Family - Plot
At the stairway, Tikki apologizes to Marinette and says that the distribution of the galette samples took too long and the smell was too good for her to resist eating it, while Marinette runs down the stairs. Marinette told her not to worry, saying that there would be enough galette for everybody and there was no need to react like the Kwamis did. Tikki replied, saying that she was just trying to get a sniff of the galette.

title: Dearest Family

text:

Bakerix uses his big fists to try to hit Ladybug. However, Ladybug manages to dodge it in time. Bakerix orders her to give him her Miraculous, but she refuses and they start fighting. Bakerix falls and Ladybug starts eating the galettes, saying that she couldn't stop because it was too good. Bakerix shouted at her, saying that galettes were not to be stolen, but to be eaten together as a family, while dragging Ladybug by her legs. He also says that the Miraculous was his. While holding Ladybug captive, he tries to get her Miraculous while Ladybug continues chewing the galette. Cat Noir arrives in the nick of time, and uses his staff to seperate the two. Bakerix falls back and Cat Noir says that the galette looked delicious and asks Ladybug to leave a piece for him. Ladybug refuses but thanks him for his help. She also says that Cat Noir had to deal with Bakerix as she has an emergency. Cat Noir agreed and called the task a piece of cake. Ladybug leaves, carrying a few pieces of galette.

title: Dearest Family
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Dearest Family - Plot
Ladybug runs into an alleyway and detransforms. Tikki is back and eats the pieces of galette in Marinette's hands. Marinette asks Tikki about what was going on and concludes that Sass was right about her not knowing Tikki well enough. All that is left is crumbs of galette, and Tikki apologizes while looking up with a psychopathic smile. She then says that she needs more and flies out of the alleyway. Marinette tries to transform, but Befana finds her first. Befana calls her her fairy and Marinette is shocked to see her. Two angels behind her grab her, and Marinette looks up. Befana praises them and thanks them for helping her find Marinette first. Marinette is then at a loss for words.

title: Dearest Family
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Dearest Family - Plot
Cat Noir jumps down and dodges Bakerix's fist. Cat Noir almost escapes, but Weredad grabs him from behind. Cat Noir is annoyed by his attack from behind and Bakerix steps up, saying that he was the one who's about to take Cat Noir's Miraculous. Cat Noir smirks and looks behind, calling for Ladybug. Bakerix and Weredad are baffled, and Cat Noir manages to escape Weredad's grip, laughing about how he did not think it would work. While running, Qilin suddenly punches him and he goes flying. He runs the other way and finds himself surrounded. He uses his Cataclysm on the ground and a massive hole appears. Cat Noir was inside.

title: Dearest Family
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Dearest Family - Plot
Shadow Moth immediately tells them not to let it allude them and that Cat Noir was just doing it to save time so he could transform back. He then tells them to follow him while eating a piece of galette, saying that his Miraculous would be the charm in his galette. Weredad, Bakerix and Qilin look down into the hole. They are about to jump in when Befana diverts their attention from the whole, celebrating that she found Marinette. The three argue for a while, then they jump up to follow Befana. Shadow Moth tells them to come back, but they do not listen. Weredad uses a stalk to grab hold of the end of Befana's broom and he pulls it. Marinette shrieks as they fall to the ground, the angels in shock. The four of them start arguing, and Marinette sneaks away. Marinette sees many Parisians panicking over their lost galette, and Marinette is taken aback. Marinette gasps and immediately knows that it was Tikki.
In the sewers, Cat Noir catches his breath and falls against a wall while detransforming. Plagg is exhausted, but his face lights up when he sees camembart. Adrien tells him to get his strength back, as they were not out of the situation yet.

title: Dearest Family
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Dearest Family - Plot
Marinette runs around in the park and finally finds Tikki. A man runs away and Marinette sees Tikki eating galette. Marinette calls for Tikki and warns her that she could not stay there as nobody was supposed to see her. Tikki apologizes and tells her that she just cannot help herself. Marinette says that she has to try to keep herself together, and that her family has been reakumatized and she needed her. Tikki moans and says that there was only one piece left, and if she ate it, it meant there would be no more, but she knew how to get more. Marinette tries to stop her because she knew that a Kwami who uses their power without an owner always ends up in a disaster. Tikki did not heed Marinette's advice and used her Lucky Charm.

title: Dearest Family
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Dearest Family - Plot
Tikki's Lucky Charm creates a giant galette that was red with black spots. It kept growing and soon, it covered the entire of Paris. Even Shadow Moth gasps while everyone panics. From a manhole, Adrien and Plagg look out. Plagg says that Tikki used her power. Meanwhile, Marinette begs Tikki to stop. Tikki does not stop, and says that she was just making the biggest galette in the world. A bridge and Montparnasse Tower starts to crack and Plagg says that Tikki has gotten a little case of the munchies, and then he goes on explaining about the time when it rained chocolate mousse for weeks a thousand years before, back when humans had just discovered chocolate. He then tells Adrien not to worry, as there was a reason the Kwami of Destruction existed, and he explains that he limits Tikki’s power of creation. Adrien transforms and jumps out of the manhole. He uses his staff for leverage, and he becomes Astrocat in midair. He uses his Cataclysm on the giant galette, and quickly flies back down. Behind him, the galette explodes into a ginormous pink cloud.

title: Dearest Family
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Dearest Family - Plot
Marinette and Tikki watch the galette explode and Tikki gets ready to use her Lucky Charm again. Before Tikki could do it, Marinette says that Sass was right and asks Tikki why she did not tell her anything. Tikki stops and says that she was afraid of Marinette thinking less of her because of her cravings. Marinette comforts Tikki and tells her that she would always like her and that everyone had their own weaknesses. Marinette puts out a hand and offers to help Tikki overcome her weaknesses, like she always helped Marinette. Tikki holds her rumbling stomach and Marinette says that she believes in Tikki and has faith in her. Tikki takes her hand and Marinette praises her. She walks behind a tree and transforms.

title: Dearest Family
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Dearest Family - Plot
Meanwhile, Dearest Family is still arguing. They look back and suddenly realize Marinette disappeared. They jump down, looking for her. Cat Noir stays on a roof and Ladybug jumps down. She thanks him for the help with the galette and Cat Noir asks her about her Kwami. Ladybug assures Cat Noir that it would not happen again, and Cat Noir asks how the four were akumatized even after Ladybug gave them all magical charms. Ladybug says that Shadow Moth might have found a way of overpowering the magic, but it was not going to stop them from saving the Dupain-Cheng family again.
Ladybug and Cat Noir jump down with confidence, and Bakerix throws three cars at them.
They dodge swiftly, and Cat Noir fights Qilin.
Weredad jumps in, but they both jump away in time.
Ladybug tells Cat Noir that they had to find where Shadow Moth hid the akuma.
Befana tries to shoot them, but they dodge.
Ladybug uses her yo-yo to tie her legs together and Cat Noir punches her stomach.
Befana hits Bakerix, and the both of them fall together.
Ladybug grabs Bakerix's yeast canteen before Bakerix can take it, and she throws it on the floor.
To her surprise, no akuma came out.

title: Dearest Family
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Dearest Family - Plot
She tells Cat Noir there was nothing and Cat Noir picks Befana's candy box up and throws it on the floor.
It breaks, but there was no akuma in it either.
Cat Noir shrugs and jumps away before Befana can shoot him.
Gina says that Ladybug and Cat Noir would not stop them from getting Marinette the freedom she needed.
Ladybug pulls Befana aside and Bakerix stars fighting Ladybug, while saying that there would be no freedom for Marinette without discipline.
Weredad fights Cat Noir while saying that Marinette is his baby.
Qilin jumps down on him and says that Marinette is old enough to know what was right for her and that the only one she needed was her.
Ladybug and Cat Noir stand back to back while Ladybug swings her yo-yo in the back.

title: Dearest Family
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Dearest Family - Plot
She tells Cat Noir that the akuma must have been in an object that was the same for all four villains. Cat Noir said that they had better find it quickly, and Ladybug uses her Lucky Charm. She gets a crown and immediately realizes that the akuma was in the galette at home. Cat Noir asks her what she meant by at home, and Ladybug says that she meant the Dupain-Cheng family's home and that they ate galette and the akuma must be in the leftover galette. She then added that it was just a guess and tells Cat Noir to stop them from following her. Cat Noir puts a hand on his face and sighs.

title: Dearest Family
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Dearest Family - Plot
Ladybug slams the door open and grabs the galette. Cat Noir runs in after her and shuts the door in time before Dearest Family can get in. They try to push the door open, and Cat Noir struggles to keep it closed. He tells Ladybug that he did what he could and Ladybug tries to resist her temptation of eating the galette. She runs to Cat Noir and gives him a 'special delivery'. Cat Noir thanks her and says that he has the charm, so he was the king. He uses his Cataclysm on the charm, and the megakuma flies out. Ladybug and Cat Noir are shocked to see it, and Ladybug said that it must have been how Shadow Moth broke the magical charms. She deevilizes the megakuma and the four transform back. Cat Noir then asks Ladybug to be his queen, since he was the king. Ladybug laughs and accepts, wearing the crown she got from her Lucky Charm, saying that tradition was tradition. They both do their pound it, and then Ladybug takes off her crown and throws it in the air, using her Miraculous Ladybug to set things right.

title: Dearest Family
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Dearest Family - Plot
Ladybug gives the four of them each a magical charm and says that it will not guarantee that they will not be a victim of Shadow Moth again, but it would help them eat their galette in peace. They both left the building and Ladybug secretly went to her balcony. She slides down the stairs while detransforming and gives the Kwamis each a small piece of galette. They hesitate because Tikki was there too, and Marinette says that Tikki was controlling herself very well. They take it away and excitedly eat them. Tikki apologizes and says that she never expected to have a craving again, but the galette Marinette's family created was too good. Marinette laughs and forgives her, but also asks her what they were going to do the next year on galettes day. Tikki says that she gave it some thought, and decided that she would manage to reduce her cravings if she just ate galette more often. Marinette laughs and gives her the last piece of galette, which Tikki takes and eats happily.

title: Dearest Family
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Dearest Family - Plot
Outside the bakery, they stare at the motorbike silently. Gina speaks up first, apologizing for their behavior. Roland says that they got into an argument because each of them thought they knew what was right for her, and Tom and Sabine said that they did not stop to ask what Marinette felt about it. Marinette said that they all knew her pretty well, and walked up to the motorbike, saying that the bike would be awesome, in a few years, but she would be super excited to have an electric mini-scooter. Upon hearing Marinette, the four of them continue arguing. Marinette laughs and the episode ends with Marinette getting on the motorbike with Gina waving to her happily and Tom, Roland and Sabine in shock.
In the repository, Gabriel says to Émilie that when he gets Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous, he will use them to destroy this world and make a new one where they'll never be apart again, at whatever the cost.

title: Dearest Family
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Dearest Family - Plot Developments
This episode reveals that Kwamis enter a "food-hungry" or a feeding frenzy state when they eat delicious and unique individualized foods. Being the Kwami of Creation, Tikki's hunger overpowers her.
Because of this, the other Kwamis call Tikki "The Great Sweet-Tooth".
It's also shown that, when a Miraculous holder transforms with a Kwami while in a feeding frenzy state, they will be affected by their Kwami's hunger and cravings. Because of this, Marinette stuffed herself with stolen galettes after she transformed into Ladybug.
It's revealed that an akuma can possess an item broken long before the akuma was created, and still akumatize people holding its parts, even when they are far away.
Remote akumatization has been demonstrated in "Sole Crusher", and multiple akumatizations via a broken object was seen in "Crocoduel".
Also, this is one of the several times where an akumatized villain or villains aren't in constant possession of an akumatized object.
According to Plagg, centuries ago, Tikki went out of control with chocolate causing her to use her powers to make chocolate mousse rain from the sky for eight weeks.

title: Dearest Family
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Dearest Family - Plot Developments
This is the first time Tikki uses her power without a holder; her Lucky Charm creates a gigantic galette in the sky. It's shown that whenever Tikki uses her power, a humanoid manifestation (which is later to be revealed to be Tikki's true form in "Re-creation") is formed that later changes into the object summoned from her Lucky Charm, unlike how it happens with the other Kwamis that have been seen using their powers so far.

title: Dearest Family
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Dearest Family - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in Brazil on Gloob.
Part of this episode was read during Brazilian Miraculous Day 2021 by voice actors.
This is the last episode where Philece Sampler voiced Sabine.
This is also the second time Marinette’s age was revealed, following "Befana".
This is the fourteenth episode where Adrien is a minor character in the permanent timeline following "Style Queen", "Silencer", "Cat Blanc", "Truth", "Gang of Secrets", "Mr. Pigeon 72", "Furious Fu", "Sole Crusher", "Guiltrip", "Crocoduel", "Optigami", "Sentibubbler" and "Qilin".
This is one of the numerous episodes the heroes fought multiple akumatized villains at the same time, following "Heroes' Day", "Félix", "Gang of Secrets" and "Crocoduel".
This is the second time akumatized villains fight one another following "Crocoduel". This excludes "Gamer 2.0". Though, unlike Captain Hardrock and Guitar Villain, Dearest Family weren't actually fighting one another, they do argue and forcefully keep each other away from Marinette, believing each of them in their own right knows what's best for her and they try to raise her by their own.

title: Dearest Family
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Dearest Family - Trivia
Two children waiting outside the bakery are used with recolored models of Manon Chamack.
A child who is crying while their mother comforts them is a recolored model of Ella and Etta Césaire.
This episode takes place during Epiphany (also called Three Kings Day) which is celebrated on January 6th. According to Tom, this holiday is months after Marinette's fourteenth birthday, meaning her birthday is after January and February of the prior year and before those same months next year. According to Marinette, this episode is on a Sunday.
This episode heavily features a real Three Kings Day tradition in France called "galette des rois". Every Three Kings Day, French families bake galettes with a porcelain charm inside called a fève. Whoever finds the fève first receives a paper crown and is crowned king or queen, and gets to choose a consort.
This is the third time The Collector appears, following "The Collector" and "Gabriel Agreste".

title: Dearest Family
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Dearest Family - Trivia
Tom, Gina and Sabine are akumatized for the second time, after "Weredad", "Befana" and "Qilin" respectively, returning as their former akumatized form, while Roland is akumatized for the third time, after "Bakerix" and "Simpleman", who returns as Bakerix despite his recent akumatized form being Simpleman.
In this episode, Shadow Moth is able to find a way to break through the protection given by Ladybug's Magical Charms and destroy them, allowing him to reakumatize Roland Dupain and Sabine Cheng, despite them receiving a Magical Charm in "Simpleman" and "Qilin".
This also means that, as of "Re-creation", this would be the final time that Gabriel in his supervillain form creates a regular akuma.
It may be possible that a magical charm protects against every akumatized form a person may have, as destroying Roland's Simpleman-themed charm allowed him to become Bakerix.
The Magical Charm Gabriel uses to test the megakuma is the one his sentimonster received in "Gabriel Agreste".
Since his sentimonster's Magical Charm prevented him from transforming, it's likely that Magical Charms can protect anyone who holds them, even if they weren't the people who received them.

title: Dearest Family
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Dearest Family - Trivia
Despite the fact that Shadow Moth was able to find a way to destroy the Magical Charms, Ladybug keeps giving them to the deakumatized villains, hoping they can still protect their owners in some way.
Roland's and Sabine's original Magical Charms from "Simpleman" and "Qilin" respectively are destroyed by Shadow Moth's megakuma, although they receive replacements following their deakumatization.
In the Brazilian Portuguese version, Roland argues that Marinette will be an adult when she's 18. In the English version, he believes she should be 21.
The scenes of Bakerix inflating are reused from "Bakerix".
This is the sixth time where a Kwami uses its powers without an owner, following Plagg in "Style Queen" and "Catalyst", Trixx in "Gang of Secrets" and Kaalki in "Sole Crusher" and "Optigami".
One of the things Tom, Sabine, Gina, and Roland argue about is how Marinette is too young to drive Gina's motorcycle.
Ironically, unknown to them, she drove a motorbike in "Queen Banana" and a sports car in "Glaciator 2", both in her superhero alter ego.
The electric scooter Marinette is seen driving in the end card is also similar to her Lucky Charm in the former episode.

title: Dearest Family
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Dearest Family - Trivia
This is the fifth episode that features a post-credit scene, following "Miracle Queen", "Gabriel Agreste", "Optigami", and "Sentibubbler".
This is the second time that multiple Magical Charms are given out, following "Crocoduel".
This episode holds the record for the most Magical Charms in an episode with a total of 7. However, only four of them are created in the episode, as Gabriel's, Sabine's first, and Roland's Simpleman charm were created in "Gabriel Agreste", "Simpleman", and "Qilin", respectively.
The scenes of the Montparnasse Tower and a bridge cracking under the weight of the galette are reused from "Style Queen", but from a different angle while using shadow effects and with the adding of the large galette in the sky.
The scenes of the Miraculous Ladybug used to fix the two locations are also recycled from the same episode.
It is implied that the only reason Plagg exists is to limit and balance the amount of creation caused by Tikki.
This is the tenth time Marinette gets separated from Tikki, following "Princess Fragrance", "Sandboy", "Miraculous Shanghai", "Reflekdoll", "Weredad", "Kwamibuster", "Feast", "Sole Crusher" and "Hack-San".

title: Dearest Family
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Dearest Family - Trivia
This is the second time Tikki leaves Marinette on her own, following "Sandboy".
This is the second time Cat Noir uses his power three times in one episode, after "Timetagger".
Despite what Master Fu said in "The Collector", Gabriel was able to akumatize himself without renouncing the Butterfly Miraculous. It is unclear whether this is an error or an evolution of his abilities.
It is possible that a Butterfly Miraculous holder is able to akumatize without giving up his Miraculous, and that Gabriel had given up the Miraculous as a preventative in case Ladybug and Cat Noir managed to defeat him and saw the Miraculous on his chest, realizing that he was Hawk Moth.
Marinette, her family and Gabriel were all acting the same way, believing they know someone else or what's best for them (Tikki, Marinette, and Gabriel's family respectively). Unlike Gabriel, Marinette and her family admitted they were wrong.
For Marinette, like Cat Noir in "Crocoduel", she had forgotten that Tikki and the other Kwamis were born a long time ago because of that the kwamis know more about each other than their owners.

title: Dearest Family
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Dearest Family - Trivia
Marinette didn't fully understand why Tikki was going obsessive about eating galettes unaware that she behaved the same way in her love endeavors: obsessive.
This is fourth time where the visualization process wasn't seen when Ladybug received her Lucky Charm following "Mayura" (with the mini miracle box), "Guiltrip" and "Optigami".
Tikki attempting to eat the galette at the time she is being sucked away to transform is similar to what happened with Plagg in "Stormy Weather".
Marinette attempting to transform then being interrupted by Befana is the same thing that happened in "Befana".
As of this episode now, Gabriel wants to use the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses to destroy this world and make a new world where he and Émilie are never separated again.
In "Ephemeral", it's revealed by Sass that every time the Ultimate Miraculous Absolute Power is used, the current world is destroyed, and rebuilt.
This episode was aired out of order, being aired before "Gabriel Agreste", in which Gabriel gets a magical charm, and "Qilin", in which Sabine is akumatized for the first time and receives the magical charm seen in the episode.

title: Dearest Family
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Dearest Family - Trivia
This is the tenth time where Cat Noir uses his powers to destroy a previous object following "Mayura".
This is the second time Cat Noir uses Cataclysm three times in an episode following "Timetagger".
This is the second time all of the Kwamis from the Chinese Miracle Box are seen on-screen. However, similarly to "Sandboy", in which Duusu is only mentioned, and "Truth", in which Plagg only appears on the end card, Trixx only appears as an animation error.
This is the twenty second time in which the Lucky Charm is summoned twice, after "The Bubbler", "Antibug", "Sapotis", "The Dark Owl", "Syren", "Style Queen", "Anansi", "Malediktator", "Mayura", "Miraculous Shanghai", "Reflekdoll", "Weredad", "Miraculer", "Oblivio", "Desperada", "Ikari Gozen", "Timetagger", "Heart Hunter", "Psycomedian", "Glaciator 2" and "Hack-San".

Tom: And yet perfectly crispy!
Sabine: It's delicious! Congratulations! It's the first recipe you've made together: your own father-and-son King's Day galette!
Roland: The perfect alliance of tradition...
Tom: And modernity!
(Tom and Roland come in for a hug. Sabine opens the bakery.)
Tikki: (panics) Marinette! Marinette, what's that smell?

title: Dearest Family/Transcript
text:
Dearest Family/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (half-asleep, voice hoarse) It's a galette. Made for King's Day. Every year, same day, same time, whoever finds the charm in their slice gets to wear a golden paper crown. (yawns) Go back to sleep, Tikki. It's too early for a Sunday. (covers herself with her blanket)
Tikki: But I've never smelled anything so sweet and wonderful! May I please go and try a little bit?
Marinette: No, Tikki! No one can see you!
(The Kwamis start to wake up and come out from different places in Marinette's room)
Wayzz: (from one of the drawers) What's going on?
Stompp: Is it breakfast time yet?
Barkk: Ooohh, I'm hungry! I'm so hungry!
Marinette: (sits up on her loft bed) Oh, okay. I get it.
Marinette: (sleepy) Good morning.
Roland: Oh, it's my baby sweetiepie!
Tom: Did my little girl have a good night sleep?
Marinette: (yawns) Can I please have a tiny piece of galette?
Tom: Marinette has always loved galettes! (grabs a bread knife to slice the galette before Roland snatches it away from him)

title: Dearest Family/Transcript
text:
Dearest Family/Transcript - Intro
Roland: That's not how it's done! The tradition is that first, we sell all the galettes we made, (hands over the tray of galette to Sabine) and then we get to enjoy the very last galette together as a family! Until then, (slides the galette in a box) all the galettes are for the customers.
(Tikki, inside Marinette's purse, inhales the sweet smell of the galette. Marinette and Tom share a hearty chuckle as Tom hands her a tray of croissants.)
Marinette: (grabs a piece of croissant) Thanks, Dad! (walks to the stairs, closing the door behind her)
Tikki: Where's the galette thing-y that's giving off that enchanting smell?
Marinette: We're gonna have to wait until tonight for the galette, Tikki. But you can have some of this croissant while you wait!
Tikki: (flies in front of Marinette, blocking and surprising her) I can't wait that long, Marinette! The smell is soooo extraordinary! I have to taste whatever it is, please, please, please?
Marinette: (chuckles) Alright. I'll go try and get you a piece. I do want to try Dad and Grandpa's new galette! Hide, Tikki!
(Tikki zooms in her purse as the both of them head back downstairs.)

title: Dearest Family/Transcript
text:
Dearest Family/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Um... I was just thinking, maybe I could help you by handing out little samples of the galette to the customers standing in the line outside! It'll help them stay patient!
Roland: Great idea!
''(Marinette grabs a tray of sliced galettes on the table and shoves a few pieces inside her purse for Tikki to munch on.)
Roland: It's nice to see that young people still have a sense of service.
Marinette: Nino! Chris! Happy King's Galette Day! (The Lahiffe brothers grab a one piece each from the tray.) A quartet of queens for the King's Galette! (Alya, Nora, Ella and Etta grab pieces of galette from Marinette as well.) Enjoy, girls!
(She went on with other customers to let them have a taste of the galette made by her family as all of them are put in a trance in savoring the delicious little slices of galette.)
Marinette: Here you go! I brought you all some of that delicious ga— (gasps as she found a lethargic Tikki who finished all the slices of galette she shoved inside her purse) Uhh... I... must've... dropped the pieces! Sorry! (scratches the back of her head)
(But the Kwamis are not convinced enough as they collectively gasp in fear.)
Sass: That's not what happened!

title: Dearest Family/Transcript
text:
Dearest Family/Transcript - Intro
Daizzi: Tikki ate them all up!
Tikki: (furious) Me? You're accusing me?
(The Kwamis huddle together, terrified)
The Kwamis: Oh, that's right!
Marinette: (giggles) You guys are joking! Tikki would never do such a thing!
Sass: Marinette, you know how much Tikki loves to eat, but do you really understand the Kwami of Creation's appetite for food?
Stompp: It's a gourmet craving of cosmic dimensions!
Sass: The pastry your father and his father created together is exceptional, unique. I'm afraid its impact on Tikki will—
Marinette: You're exaggerating, Sass. It's just a galette.
Sass: I'm sorry to have to tell you this, but I think you don't know Tikki as well as you think you do.
(Tikki glares at the Kwamis angrily.)
Marinette: What?! Of course, I know her! I can say that I know her better than anyone!
Tikki: Don't listen to them, Marinette! He's not worth getting upset about when it's so much easier just to go back and get some galette for everybody!
(The Kwamis gasp in fear and huddle again.)
Marinette: You're absolutely right, Tikki! So, everyone just stay here like good Kwamis and Tikki and I will be back soon with some galette for everyone, okay?

title: Dearest Family/Transcript
text:
Dearest Family/Transcript - Intro
(The Kwamis, still huddled together, nod together in agreement. Hearing the trapdoor closing, they disperse inside the room in panic.)
Ziggy: We're never gonna get to taste that sublime galette!
Barkk: And we'll be lucky if that's the only consequence of the Great Sweet Tooth's appetite!
Sass: Barkk, Wayzz, since this is an emergency, I'm giving you permission to go out.
(Barkk and Wayzz nod to each other and fly outside.)
Tikki: I'm sorry. But the distribution took so long and the galette samples smelled so good. (whimpers)
Marinette: Don't worry, there'll be enough for everybody! There's no need to react like they did. (opens the door to the bakery)
André: (tugging a galette box from Roland) I promise to erect a statue in your honor in front of City Hall in exchange for your last galette!
Roland: That's not how it's done! The Dupain-Chengs eat the last galette (hits André with a baguette continuously) together as a family! (snatches the box of galette and pushes André out of the bakery) Get out of here! Away, you felon! (closes the bakery door) Ahh, so, shall we enjoy this last galette?

title: Dearest Family/Transcript
text:
Dearest Family/Transcript - Intro
(A cheerful sound of a motor horn was heard just outside the bakery. The motorcycle parks in front the bakery with Gina on board. She then takes off her helmet.)
Chloé: (background) Ridiculous! Utterly ridiculous! Are you kidding me?
Roland: (panics, brings down the box of galette and fixes his hair) Gina?
Tom: Mom?(Roland, Tom and Sabine open the door. Marinette goes to join them as well before Tikki stops her.)Tikki: Um, Marinette, what are you going to do about the galette? (points at the galette on the shelf)Marinette: Don't worry, Tikki. I'll put aside a piece for you and the others. (runs towards the bakery exit)Gina: Happy birthday, Marinetta! (leans on her motorcycle gift wrapped with a big red ribbon)Tom: Mom, Marinette's last birthday was only a few months ago and you were there.
Gina: Oh, this year has gone by a little fast.
Roland: How can anyone have their head so far up in the clouds?! A birthday's a birthday! A Galette's Day is a Galette's Day!

title: Dearest Family/Transcript
text:
Dearest Family/Transcript - Intro
Gina: Who cares? A party is a party! We put candles on the galette and Marinetta will get the present earlier, that's all. (to Marinette) Happy birthday, sweetheart! It's a beauty, isn't it? (Roland, Tom and Sabine groan) Eighteen hundred cubic centimeters, 2V cylinders, zero to three hundred kilometers per hour in five seconds flat!
Roland: Gina! We're talking about a fourteen-year-old girl!
Tom: There's no way she's going to ride that... thing!
Gina: And why not?
Wayzz: Psst!
Wayzz and Barkk: Marinette.(Marinette looks over Wayzz and Barkk peeking behind a lamppost, Wayzz pointing at Tikki who is about to get her hands on the box of galette inside the bakery.)Gina: Nothing is too good for my little fairy?
Marinette: (runs inside the bakery and snatches the box of galette from Tikki) Tikki! What are you doing?

title: Dearest Family/Transcript
text:
Dearest Family/Transcript - Intro
Tikki: I was just trying to... g-get a sniff of this fabulous galette! Ah! (zooms into Marinette's purse)(Marinette's family enters the bakery, which sends Marinette to fumble over the box of galette she was holding.)Marinette: Ahh! Oh, there you are! (manages to catch the box, nervous) I was... just about to bring this galette to the living room! So we can eat it as a family! Right?(Gina, Roland, Tom and Sabine stare blankly at her.)''
(While Gina is speaking, Marinette distributes plates to the four of them, putting the plates on the coffee table.)
Gina: You may not want to see it but Marinetta is no longer a little ragazza! She's a young lady and she's going to love her Nonna—
Roland: Nonsense! Marinette will be an adult when she's twenty-one! Until then, she's a child. Allowing her to think otherwise is crazy enough—
Marinette: I don't think I—
Tom: You guys didn't come here to argue again?! I know my little girl better than anyone, and I think that huge bike is way too dangerous for her!
Marinette: Hey, I'm—
Roland: You're right, son. Your mother is irresponsible and dangerous!
Tom: That's not what I said!
Gina: (to Roland) And what do you know about Marinette, Mr. Grumpy?

title: Dearest Family/Transcript
text:
Dearest Family/Transcript - Intro
Wayzz: Psst!
(Marinette gasps, seeing Barkk and Wayzz hiding behind a lamp to let her know that Tikki is flying towards the galette on the dining table. Tikki was about to take a bite before Marinette slides on the table and the galette slips from her hands, unable to grab Tikki as well. The galette lands on her hands safely with her family finally noticing her strange behavior.)
Sabine: What exactly are you doing, Marinette?
Marinette: Nothing! (giggles) Don't you think it's time we ate Dad and Grandpa's delicious galette? (sees a hungry Tikki by the corner of the ceiling, about to dive into the plate of galette she is holding) Okay, everybody! Here you go! (places the galette on the coffee table and distributes the plates on their hands) Come on! Yummy-yummy! Mmm, it's so good! Mmm.
(Marinette turns back to see the corner of the ceiling where Tikki was last seen but is now nowhere to be found. She shifts her head around the room anxiously to find her Kwami, placing the galette back to the dining table and hides behind a stool.)
Gina: Tom is overprotective of his daughter anyway. Just like his father was with hi—
Roland: That's how it's done! Parents protect their children!

title: Dearest Family/Transcript
text:
Dearest Family/Transcript - Intro
Tom: I don't overprotect my little girl!
Sabine: Yes, you do, Tom! She's not a little girl anymore, you know?
(Marinette, in the background, continues to catch Tikki. She climbs up the stairs.)
Gina: Agreed! Which means she can ride the bike.
Sabine: That's not what I said!
Marinette: Tikki is not acting normal!
Sass: It's not as if we didn't try to warn you.
Xuppu: When the Great Sweet Tooth has the munchies...
Ziggy: She becomes out of control!
Marinette: There is still one way to take control of this situation. Tikki, spots on!
(Tikki, from downstairs, gets summoned in Marinette's earrings as Marinette transforms into Ladybug.)
Ladybug: (sighs in relief) That was close! (her stomach grumbles) What's going on? (folds her arms around her stomach...) I'm... (...and looks at the Kwamis, now overtaken by Tikki's uncontrollable cravings) starving!!
The Kwamis: Uh-oh!
Roland: What Marinette needs is some rules of discipline!
Gina: Nonsense! What she needs is more freedom!
Tom: What she needs is a dad who can protect her from everything!
Sabine: The person who knows best what Marinette needs is Marinette herself!

title: Dearest Family/Transcript
text:
Dearest Family/Transcript - Intro
Shadow Moth: A family divided by a tradition that was supposed to bring them together! How terribly sad! (opens his hand to corrupt a butterfly...) Luckily, I just have the recipe to reconcile them! (...and turns it into a megakuma) Fly away, my megakuma, and once again, plunge this family into darkness!
(The megakuma flies out the window, now targeted towards the Dupain-Cheng family.)
Shadow Moth: (from his lair) Dearest Family, I am Shadow Moth. Don't worry, your magical charms won't stop you from getting your powers back.
(The magical charms on Sabine and Roland's hand are destroyed.)
Shadow Moth: (from his lair) Each of you thinks they know Marinette better than the others. To help you figure this out, I'm returning your powers to all of you.
(The megakuma's power engulf Tom, Sabine, Roland and Gina, transforming them into Weredad, Qilin, Bakerix and Befana, respectively.)
Shadow Moth: (from his lair) Weredad, Bakerix, Befana, and Qilin, may the strongest of you raise Marinette as they please! But in return, bring me the Miraculous of Ladybug and Cat Noir.
Befana: I'm coming, Marinetta. (twirls her gun on her fingers) Your Befana will set you free!

title: Dearest Family/Transcript
text:
Dearest Family/Transcript - Intro
Bakerix: That's not how it's done! I'll give you the discipline you need!
Weredad: I'm the only one that can protect my little girl!
Qilin: Marinette! I won't let them control your life!
(The four of them race the stairs to Marinette's room.)
Ladybug: (to the Kwamis) Quick, hide!
(The Kwamis find their places to hide as Ladybug gets up on the balcony. Weredad breaks the trapdoor.)
Weredad: My baby's not here!
Bakerix: (points at the open balcony trapdoor) She snuck out!
Qilin: (to Weredad) You frightened her!
Bakerix: (to Weredad) It's your fault!
Weredad: (to Bakerix) No, your fault!
Befana: (to Weredad) No, it's yours!
Qilin: (to Befana) No, yours!
Bakerix: No, it's yours!
Weredad: It's yours!
(The four of them continue to argue. Weredad breaks the roof above Marinette's room.)
Weredad: Marinette!!!
Ladybug: (whimpers, clutching her stomach) Oh, I'm so hungry! It's impossible to resist these cravings! I need... (sniffs and spots Mayor Bourgeois with a box of galette)
André: Finally! I've got some! I've got some! (holds his box of galette above his head only to be snatched by Ladybug using her yo-yo) AHH! My galette! (whines) No!!!

title: Dearest Family/Transcript
text:
Dearest Family/Transcript - Intro
(Still above the roofs. Ladybug starts to eat large slices of galette.)
Ladybug: Did I just steal these? (inserts two slices of galette in her mouth) I've done something terrible! (swallows the galette) What's gotten into me?
Bakerix: That's because you need discipline, Ladybug! Just like my granddaughter! (takes his bottle of yeast and drinks and becomes buffer)
(Ladybug evades his attack, leaping to another rooftop.)
Bakerix: Give me your Miraculous!
(Bakerix continues his attempt to catch Ladybug as she constantly dodge her attacks before she jumps on him and leaps to another rooftop once again.)
Ladybug: (eats another two slices of galette) I can't stop! This galette is so good!
Bakerix: Galettes are not to be stolen, but eaten as a family! Miraculous is mine!
(Bakerix grabs Ladybug by her feet as Cat Noir enters the scene, hitting him with his baton before Bakerix could take off Ladybug's earrings.)
Cat Noir: Hey, that looks delicious, m'lady! Save me a piece?
Ladybug: No way, kitty! But thanks for the helping hand! I need you to deal with Bakerix. (puts a few pieces of galette in her hands) I've got an emergency!

title: Dearest Family/Transcript
text:
Dearest Family/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: Sure. Piece of cake! (to Bakerix) Don't move or you're toast!
(Ladybug runs to an alleyway with the pieces of galette in her hands.)
Ladybug: Spots off!
(She de-transforms into Marinette. Tikki lands on her hands full of slices of galette, eating them ceaselessly.)
Marinette: Tikki! What's going on? So, Sass was right? I don't know you as well as... I thought?
Tikki: (looking down) Sorry, Marinette... (looks up to Marinette with a crazy expression) but I need more!!
Marinette: AHH!! (Tikki flies away) Tikki, wait! Tikki, spots...
Befana: Marinetta! My fairy!
Marinette: Grandma!
(Befana's two white "fairies" corner Marinette behind her.)
Befana: Bravo, my angels! Thanks to you, I'm the one who found Marinetta first!
Cat Noir: Hey! No fair, attacking from behind!
Bakerix: Hey! I was the one about to take his Miraculous!
Cat Noir: (smiles deviously) Ladybug!
Weredad: Huh? (releases Cat Noir from his arms)

title: Dearest Family/Transcript
text:
Dearest Family/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: Ha-ha! I never thought I'd fool anyone with that silly old— AHH! (He gets thrown up in the air by Qilin. He lands on the ground and tries to escape, but it was too late now that Qilin, Bakerix and Weredad cornered him.) Cataclysm! (breaks the ground, taking advantage of the dust he created to escape)
Shadow Moth: (from his lair) Don't let him elude you! Cat Noir's only bought himself some time. He's used his Cataclysm so he'll soon transform back! Follow him! (takes a bite of his galette) His Miraculous will be the charm in my galette.
(Qilin, Weredad and Bakerix look down on the hole created by Cat Noir's Cataclysm. Befana flies just above them with Marinette.)
Befana: (sing-song) I found Marinetta! I'm the one that found her!
Bakerix: Befana found my little sweetie?
Weredad: She's my Marinette!
Qilin: Marinette doesn't belong to anyone!
(The three of them leap on the roofs to chase after Befana.)
Shadow Moth: (from his lair, dropping the galette from his hand) No! Come back!!
(Weredad wraps his vines on Befana's motorcycle and pulls them on the roofs.)
Bakerix: That broom's just like the bike; it's not for kids!

title: Dearest Family/Transcript
text:
Dearest Family/Transcript - Intro
Qilin: There's no way we'll let you impose your bad habits on Marinette!
Befana: You don't know what she needs!
Weredad: I'm the only one who knows how to raise her right!
(Marinette makes her escape back to the ground.)
Parisian 1: My galette! Where did it go?
Parisian 2: Someone stole my galette?
Parisian 3: That weird bug just ate my galette!
Marinette: (shocked, gasps) Tikki?
Cat Noir: Claws in! (de-transforms into Adrien)
(He brings out a camembert to feed Plagg, who is laying weakly on his palm.)
Adrien: Get your strength back, Plagg. We're not out of this yet!
(Plagg takes a bite from his camembert.)
Marinette: Tikki! (The Kwami continues to feed off the galettes from the boxes.) Tikki, you can't stay here! People aren't supposed to see you! Come with me!
Tikki: I'm sorry, Marinette. I just can't help myself! (puts her hands on her face)
Marinette: You've gotta try to keep it together, Tikki. My family's been re-akumatized! I need you!
(Tikki tries to resist but fails, and so she flies to another box, containing a small piece of galette.)

title: Dearest Family/Transcript
text:
Dearest Family/Transcript - Intro
Tikki: Oh, there's only one piece left. It means if I eat it, it'll be all gone! Oh! I know how to get more! (grunts as she uses her power, a powerful pink aura of energy surrounding her)
Marinette: Tikki, no! A Kwami that uses their power without their owner always causes a disaster!
Tikki: I'm the Kwami of Creation!!!! (summons a burst of energy, leaving Marinette in complete shock) LUCKY CHARM!!!!!!!!
(Using her power of creation, a large beam creates a ginormous ladybug-patterned galette, overshadowing the whole city of Paris.)
Plagg: Uh-oh, Sugar Cube's used her power!
Adrien: Sugar Cube?
Plagg: Tikki, Ladybug's Kwami.
Marinette: Tikki! I'm begging you! Stop this! Control yourself!
Tikki: But Marinette, I'm just making the biggest galette in the world!!!
(Tikki continues to use her Lucky Charm to create one giant galette, with bridges starting to crack, as well as the Montparnasse Tower.)
Plagg: Looks like Tikki's got a little case of the munchies again.
Adrien: "Little"?

title: Dearest Family/Transcript
text:
Dearest Family/Transcript - Intro
Plagg: The last time was centuries ago when humans discovered chocolate. It rained chocolate mousse for eight weeks! (groans) Don't look so worried. There's a reason there's also a Kwami of Destruction! (winks) Come on, Adrien! Transform!
Adrien: Plagg, claws out! (transforms into Cat Noir)
(He begins to run up on the ground and launches himself with his baton to stop the giant galette from growing much larger.)
Cat Noir: (upon launching) Power up! (transforms into Astro Cat)
(He flies into space towards the giant galette that Tikki made.)
Astro Cat: Cataclysm! (activates his power and touches the giant galette, creating a giant explosion in space as he flies back to Earth)
(Back at the Jardin des Tulieries, the skies clear up and Tikki becomes frustrated.)
Tikki: Oh, no! It's okay! I'll just make another one! (uses her power for the second time) An even BIGGER ONE!!!
Marinette: So, Sass was right. But... why didn't you tell me anything?
Tikki: (cools down) I was afraid you'd think less of me... because of my cravings.

title: Dearest Family/Transcript
text:
Dearest Family/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Oh! Of course not! I'll always like you, Tikki! Everyone has weaknesses, you know? (reaches out her hand) Let me help you overcome yours, just like you're always helping me overcome mine. (Tikki's stomach grumbles) You can resist! I have faith in you! Look at me! (Tikki flies to hold Marinette's hand and Marinette cups her in them) Bravo! (goes to hide behind a tree) Now, Tikki, spots on!
Qilin: No, it's yours!
Weredad: (notices that Marinette is missing) My baby! Where'd she go?
(The four of them jump back on the ground.)
Qilin: Marinette?
Weredad: Marinette!
(Back on the rooftops, Ladybug joins Cat Noir.)
Ladybug: Thanks for your help with the galette, kitty cat.
Cat Noir: How's your Kwami? Better?
Ladybug: Yes. It won't happen again.
Cat Noir: How could Shadow Moth get to the Dupain-Cheng family again? Didn't you give them magical charms?
Ladybug: I did, but maybe he found a way of overpowering their magic. But that's not gonna stop us from saving them again!
Dearest Family: Marinette!

title: Dearest Family/Transcript
text:
Dearest Family/Transcript - Intro
(Ladybug and Cat Noir leap to the ground to face the four of them. The battle ensues, starting with Bakerix throwing a car at the superheroes. The two split after the dodging the car as Cat Noir faces Qilin and Weredad, evading their attacks as well. He then rejoins Ladybug by her side.)
Ladybug: We've gotta find where Shadow Moth's akuma is hiding!
(Befana fires at Ladybug and Cat Noir and the two avoid it. Ladybug grapples her yo-yo on Befana's legs, with Cat Noir knocking both Befana, as well as Bakerix. Bakerix's yeast bottle falls from his waist and Ladybug takes the opportunity to grab it with her yo-yo, breaking it, only with no akuma flying out of it.)
Ladybug: (gasps) Nothing!
Cat Noir: Maybe this one? (breaks Befana's candy box, and no akuma is yet to be seen)Befana: (continues to fire at them) You won't stop us from giving Marinette the freedom she needs!(Ladybug continuously evades all of Befana's attacks.)Bakerix: No freedom without discipline!
Weredad: She's my baby!
Qilin: Marinette is old enough to know what is right for her! The only one she needs is me!
Ladybug: The akuma must be in an object that's the same for all four villains.
Cat Noir: Better find it quickly!

title: Dearest Family/Transcript
text:
Dearest Family/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: Lucky Charm! (uses her power and gets a paper crown) A... crown? Of course! The akuma's in the galette at home!
Cat Noir: At home?
Ladybug: Uh... What I mean is... at their'' home! The Dupain-Cheng home! They must have eaten galette too, as a family! And the akuma's is there. I mean, I'm guessing so. Stop them from following me!
Cat Noir: Oh, no! Not again!
Befana: (behind the door) Quick! This way!
(Dearest Family attempts to break the door.)
Cat Noir: (pushing the door shut) I did what I could!
(Ladybug's stomach grumbles and resists to not put the slice of galette in her mouth. She thinks of an idea and runs towards Cat Noir.)
Ladybug: Special delivery! (hands the slice of galette to Cat Noir)
Cat Noir: Thank you, m'lady! (pulls the charm inside the galette) And I got the charm! I'm the king! Cataclysm! (activates his power and breaks the charm containing the megakuma) What in the...?
Ladybug: A more powerful akuma! So that's how Shadow Moth broke the magical charms! No more evil doing for you, big butterfly! (opens her yo-yo) Time to de-evilize! (captures the megakuma) Gotcha! (releases the purified akuma. fluttering away) Bye-bye, little butterfly!

title: Dearest Family/Transcript
text:
Dearest Family/Transcript - Intro
(Dearest Family is now de-akumatized and transform back to their civilian forms.)
Cat Noir: (grabs a golden paper crown on the coffee table) Since I'm the king, (wears the crown on his head) Would you be my queen, Ladybug?
Ladybug: (giggles) With pleasure, kitty cat! Tradition is tradition!
(Cat Noir puts on the paper crown lucky charm on Ladybug.)
Ladybug and Cat Noir: Pound it!
Ladybug: Miraculous Ladybug!
(She throws the paper crown in the air and fixes all the damages caused by the villains and Tikki's craving mayhem. The magical ladybugs bring the Dupain-Cheng family safely back on the living room couch. She swipes her yo-yo open and grabs four charms for the Dupain-Cheng family and distributes it to them.)
Ladybug: I can't promise that these magical charms will protect you from Shadow Moth. Maybe they'll help you eat your galette in peace!
(The two heroes make their exit as they vault to the roofs, with Ladybug returning shortly after to de-transform inside her bedroom. Tikki lands on Marinette's palms.)
Marinette: There you go! You finally get to taste Dad and Grandpa's famous galette!
The Kwamis: (gather around Marinette's hand full of crumbs of galette) Woah!

title: Dearest Family/Transcript
text:
Dearest Family/Transcript - Intro
Sass: In front of Tikki?
Marinette: Go ahead! Tikki's controlling herself very well! (pats Tikki's head with her thumb)
(The Kwamis disperse after grabbing their own pieces of galette from Marinette's hand.)
Tikki: I'm really sorry, Marinette. I thought I'd never have one of those craving episodes again, but the galette your family created is really an exceptional event in the culinary history of humanity!
Marinette: (chuckles softly) I don't blame you, Tikki. But what are we gonna do next year on Galette Day?
Tikki: I've given this some thought! I'm sure that I can reduce my cravings if I just eat galette more often!
(The two share a little laughter before Marinette gives Tikki a piece of galette.)
Gina: Marinetta, we're really sorry. We all got into an argument about this bike.
Roland: Because each of us thought we knew what was right for you.
Tom: But none of us thought to ask...
Sabine: How you were feeling about it?
Marinette: Actually, you all know me pretty well! This bike will be awesome, in a few years. However, I'd be super excited to have an electric mini scooter!
(Gina, Tom, Sabine and Roland are in shock.)
Tom: Uh, a scooter's okay. But with a helmet, right?

title: Dearest Family/Transcript
text:
Dearest Family/Transcript - Intro
Sabine: See, I told you she would be solo.
(Marinette smiles.)
(The end card shows Marinette riding a mini scooter while passing out galettes, while her family except her grandmother (who is cheering for her) has worried expressions)
Gabriel: Émilie, my queen, Ladybug and Cat Noir escaped me again today, but I will never give up. I will get their Miraculous. Thanks to the all powerful forces of destruction and creation, I'll destroy this world that took you from us to build a new one, where we'll never be apart again. I will succeed, Émilie. Whatever the cost.

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2) - Intro
"" is a season 5 episode of the series Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. Based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 11th written and produced episode of season 5. It is also the 115th written and produced episode of the series overall.

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2) - Synopsis
Monarch is faced with a unique opportunity that he refuses to lose. The world is about to be reshaped, and no one seems to be able to stop it… because the kwamis made a decision that completely distracted Marinette & Adrien from their responsibilities. For better and for worse.
Disney+
The kwamis' choice is transforming Paris.
Netflix
Marinette and Adrien enjoy the benefits of their new reality, but Monarch has set his sights on two superheroes. Can they keep the Kwamis safe?

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2) - Plot
Adrien has his TV tuned to TVi's report of the events following "Transmission" at the scene of Kikou's defeat: Les Olympiades. Clara Contard is interviewing the new holders of the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses: Scarabella and Kitty Noire. Clara asks if Ladybug and Cat Noir were forced to step down. Scarabella declines to answer directly, but she does say that their predecessors have nothing to feel guilty about. Kitty Noire adds that like their predecessors, they will accomplish their mission of ending Monarch's reign.
Clara then remarks Ladybug and Cat Noir may have renounced their Miraculouses to live their supposed love story. Scarabella answers that neither Ladybug and Cat Noir nor her and Kitty Noire are in love or in a relationship. Clara then asks for their names. The new heroes introduce themselves as their new hero personas then leave. The program cuts to Nadja who wishes Scarabella and Kitty Noire luck in their mission.

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2) - Plot
Adrien turns off his TV. He checks his phone for messages from Marinette, there are none. He walks over to his foosball table, places a ball, and sadly knocks the ball into the goal to his right. He checks his phone for messages from Marinette again, still nothing. He dejectedly lies his torso on the foosball table.
Scarabella swings back to her apartment, lands in her room and detransforms into Alya. She asks Tikki how she did as Scarabella. Tikki sadly says she was fantastic. This makes Alya believe she screwed up. Tikki reassures Alya she did great, she just misses Marinette. Tikki hears Ella and Etta about to barge into Alya's room, so she hides in her fanny pack. The twins inform Alya that Marinette has arrived. Marinette gives the twins the chouquettes she brought and the twins run off cheering. Marinette expresses her approval of Tikki's choice for a new holder. Tikki comes out of hiding and hugs Marinette's face. Alya remarks that Marinette's mood has improved.

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2) - Plot
Marinette suddenly gets a call from Adrien, she answers flustered. He tells her he left his bag at her place, he asks if he can come get it, to which she refuses. Marinette tells Adrien she'll bring him his bag tomorrow and hangs up. Marinette embarrassedly sits down and covers her face with her hands. Alya asks what happened with Marinette and Adrien. Marinette tells her about Adrien's hand raising idea. Marinette worriedly asks Alya about if she thinks Kitty Noire and Scarabella can handle Monarch and that Alya must keep her identity from her boyfriend Nino. Alya tells her not to worry about it, as it's now on Scarabella and Kitty to carry that burden. Alya tells Marinette to focus on Adrien instead.

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2) - Plot
On the roof of Le Grand Paris, Kitty Noire detransforms into Zoé. Plagg congratulates Zoé on her victory, he remarks she'd be the perfect holder if she had a cheese cellar. She tells him Le Grand Paris is home to the largest cheese cellar in Paris. This pleases Plagg immensely. Zoé warns Plagg to be careful, to which he agrees and hides in her hat. Zoé takes the elevator down to the sixth floor, where the restaurant's cheese cellar is. Zoé sneaks into the kitchen to find her half sister Chloé eating ice cream. Chloé blows up at Zoé. She apologizes to her half sister and asks how she can make it up to her. Chloé gets Zoé to carry a bunch of her shoes to Zoé's room to clean. Plagg, furious at how Zoé is treated by Chloé, suggests he Cataclysm her. Zoé tells him not to. Plagg expresses his fury over Zoé's mistreatment again. She tells Plagg she has to lay low in order to conceal her secret identity.

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2) - Plot
Gabriel rises into his atelier, he smiles and begins to dance to a song playing on a radio. He dances out his atelier door into the foyer, he dances up the stairs to slide down the banister where he stops in front of his assistant Nathalie. Nathalie asks what has gotten into him. Gabriel asks if she can smell something. She asks him if he's making pancakes, to which Gabriel denies. He exclaims it's even better and twirls her around. Gabriel brings Nathalie to his atelier and activates his Alliance. It has recorded data beyond normal human capabilities from two other Alliances: Alya's and Zoé's. Nathalie congratulates Gabriel, he triumphantly asks Nathalie if she can now smell the scent of victory as he descends into his lair. Nathalie looks at the painting of Émilie with concern. Gabriel talks to his comatose wife about his imminent victory. Nathalie, in her room, expresses her worries about Gabriel's plans to phone with videos of Émilie.

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2) - Plot
Gabriel tells his captive kwamis they will play their parts in his plan and his knowledge of the secret identities of Scarabella and Kitty Noire. Gabriel transforms into Monarch. He takes the Miraculous superpowers of Pollen, Mullo, Orikko, Stompp, and Kaalki. He uses Voyage to teleport to François Dupont. Daizzi asks Sass what they can do to stop Monarch. Sass replies he fears they can do nothing.

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2) - Plot
At Françoise Dupont's boiler room, the Resistance holds a meeting to pay tribute to Ladybug and Cat Noir, show their support for Scarabella and Kitty Noire, and announce the change of the Ladyblog into the Scarablog. Adrien and Marinette show concern for Ladybug and Cat Noir. Adrien assures Marinette Cat Noir is okay. Nino goes over the Anti-Akumatization system. An app developed by Max and Markov. When the exclamation mark button is pressed, a signal is sent to a box in the boiler room which broadcasts the warning music written by Kitty Section throughout the school. Everyone cheers except Lila. Kim, Mylène, and Ivan are in charge of evacuation, Rose, Juleka, Zoé, and Max try to calm down the akumatized victim, and Nathaniel, Adrien, Marinette, Alya, and Nino gear up with condiment squirting guns if the victim is fully akumatized.

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2) - Plot
The bell rings, dismissing the kids for lunch. Nino asks Alya why they weren't picked as the new Ladybug and Cat Miraculous holders as he believed they were great as Rena Rouge and Carapace, Alya replies they would have to lie to each other to protect their secret identities. Nino is okay with this, he tells Alya she doesn't have to be super to be his hero. Nino and Alya leave for the cafeteria. Unbeknownst to everyone, Monarch was there invisible. He pulls the cables to the box, sabotaging the Resistance's plan. Monarch uses Multitude to split into five and runs towards the unsuspecting Miraculous holders.

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2) - Plot
In the cafeteria, Zoé places some camembert on her plate and drops a piece in her bag for Plagg, making him happy. Two invisible Monarchs follow Zoé to her seat, two other Monarchs are waiting by Alya, and the fifth Monarch is crouched atop a light fixture. Adrien pulls out a seat for Marinette to which she sits in. Marinette's friends cheer her on quietly. Adrien asks Marinette about the heart of palm and if it reminds her of something. Lila tells Chloé she is generous to let Marinette get close to Adrien. Chloé asks her Alliance to define generous, which it fails. Chloé barks at Sabrina to define the word generous. She politely asks her Alliance to define the word generous, which succeeds. The definition angers Chloé, making her want to ruin Marinette's time with Adrien.

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2) - Plot
Marinette tries to get her hand to move to hold Adrien's hand, but it's frozen in fear. Adrien tells her she doesn't have to hold his hand if she isn't ready and they can just be friends. Marinette blurts out she doesn't want to be friends, Adrien dejectedly says he understands. Marinette exclaims she didn't mean that and that her hand shall obey her, she continues to force her hand toward Adrien, but ends up falling over. Chloé walks over and claims Marinette is back where she belongs, at her feet. Zoé stands up to defend her friend, but she gets cold feet. Adrien steps in to defend Marinette. He lends Marinette his hand and helps her back to her seat. Chloé claims that he's being too nice to her and laughs as she tells Adrien that Marinette is in love with him.

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2) - Plot
Already aware of this, Adrien calls her out on her cruel behavior and tells her to return to her seat while he returns to his. Chloé continues her attempts to humiliate Marinette, but her friends defend her and Zoé stands up to her half sister. Chloé threatens Zoé with their mother, saying she'll send Zoé back to New York. Zoé, not intimidated by this threat, takes Chloé back to her seat, telling her that she could care less about being sent back to New York. Everyone in the cafeteria congratulates Zoé for her actions, angering Chloé further for being humiliated.

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2) - Plot
Monarch, sensing Chloé's hatred and rage, akumatizes her into Sole Destroyer. Nino tries to activate the Anti-Akumatization System, but the alarm doesn't go off. Nino rolls with it and puts the next part of the plan into action. Mylène and Max try to help their fellow students escape Sole Destroyer's wrath, but they're transformed into singing shoes. The Monarchs remark their plan is in motion, one Monarch recombines with the other four Monarchs. Two Monarchs follow Zoé and the other two follow Alya. Marinette and Adrien hide under their table, where Sole Destroyer finds her. Sole Destroyer swings her leg at Marinette, missing as Adrien pulls Marinette back. Adrien throws a chair at Sole Destroyer to distract her so he and Marinette can get away. Zoé runs into the locker room. Plagg praises Zoé's earlier intervention.

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2) - Plot
Zoé attempts to transform, but the Monarchs strike her and Plagg with Venom. A Monarch takes the Cat Miraculous. Alya runs into a stall in the girl's bathroom to transform, but both she and Tikki are struck by the Venom wielding Monarchs. A Monarch grabs the Ladybug Miraculous. The two groups of Monarchs use Voyage to teleport to Arènes de Lutèce, where he puts on the Ladybug and Cat Miraculous. Monarch unfreezes the kwamis. Plagg tries to Cataclysm Monarch, but he has Resistance activated, leaving his Cataclysm unable to harm him. Having no other option to prevent Monarch from achieving victory, Plagg and Tikki fly away. Monarch recites the unification phrase, pulling Tikki and Plagg back toward their Miraculouses, but the kwamis resist the transformation. Plagg tells Tikki to summon her Lucky Charm for Ladybug so she can get their Miraculouses back and stop Monarch, so Tikki does so. The unification nearly completes, but Plagg Cataclysms the Cat Miraculous, destroying it.

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2) - Plot
This leaves Monarch and Tikki in a huge crater, wanton destruction across Paris, and sends the Lucky Charm to Marinette. She realizes that her having the Lucky Charm means Alya is out of commission, so she attempts to call her best friend. Monarch awakens to see the Cat Miraculous crumble to dust. Tikki also awakens, but Monarch orders her to stay put. Marinette's call reaches Alya voicemail. Nino helps Adrien up, asking him where Scarabella and Kitty Noire are. Adrien replies they're most likely busy elsewhere in Paris.

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2) - Plot
Marinette escapes to the girl's washroom to find Alya paralyzed. Marinette pieces the clues together to realize that Monarch is behind this. Marinette makes her way home with the Lucky Charm and a trash bin to execute her plan. Sole Destroyer kicks Sabrina, turning her into a singing shoe. The hiding Adrien and Nino wonder where Marinette and Alya are. Nino believes Sole Destroyer transformed them. Adrien gets an alert on his phone from TVi. Clara in her helicopter reports on Monarch's theft of the Ladybug Miraculous. With the superheroes down, Nino and Adrien gather the Resistance to reclaim the stolen Miraculous and return them to their rightful holders. Marinette readies herself to face Monarch.

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2) - Plot
Monarch orders Tikki to explain the situation. She explains to him how Plagg destroyed his Miraculous and himself with it. Monarch demands that Tikki provide a solution to bring Plagg back and his Miraculous with him. Tikki tells Monarch he must toss the Lucky Charm in the air and call out his Miraculous Monarch Bug. Monarch commands Tikki to tell him where the Lucky Charm is. Tikki replies she doesn't know, she entrusted the Lucky Charm to the universe and doesn't know where it is. Marinette, dressed as Ladybug in a motorcycle helmet makes her appearance. Monarch claims that she is powerless at the moment because he possesses her kwami and Miraculous. Marinette explains that Tikki and Plagg have triggered a series of events that can only be repaired by Miraculous Ladybug which requires the Lucky Charm she possesses in tandem with the Ladybug Miraculous Monarch possesses. Monarch remarks it will also bring back the Cat Miraculous too.

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2) - Plot
He uses Voyage to take possession of the Lucky Charm and transforms into Monarch Bug. He calls out his Miraculous Monarch Bug but is duped by a fake Lucky Charm Marinette made. Marinette uses this opportunity to try to take back her Miraculous, but Monarch Bug throws her off him. He attempts to paralyze her, but to his misfortune, Nino stands in his way. He is joined by the Resistance who spray Monarch Bug with condiments to keep him visible. Rose and Juleka threaten Monarch Bug with a captive Sole Destroyer, but he releases Sole Destroyer's megakuma, reverting her back into Chloé.

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2) - Plot
Adrien takes advantage of the distraction to grab the Ladybug Miraculous. Monarch tries to take it back, but is quickly surrounded by Ivan, Kim, and Rose. Adrien hands the Ladybug Miraculous to Marinette, who thanks him and then transforms into Ladybug. She calls out "Miraculous Ladybug!" which repairs the disaster and restores the Cat Miraculous, bringing Plagg back. Ladybug reacts swiftly and retrieves the Cat Miraculous. However, as she does this, she notices that Monarch has reconfigured the Miraculous into rings. He seizes this opportunity to escape her grasp. Marinette tries to capture him again with her yo-yo, but Monarch uses his power, Multitude, to evade her and returns to his lair via Voyage. In his lair, Monarch recombines, wipes the condiments from his face, and laments the victory of Ladybug and the Resistance.

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2) - Plot
At Marinette's house, in her room along with Alya, Tikki, and Plagg question how Monarch figured out Scarabella and Kitty Noire's secret identities so quickly. Marinette observes while Scarabella and Kitty Noire were figured out, Monarch hasn't figured out Ladybug or Cat Noir's secret identities. Marinette tells Plagg to give his Miraculous back to Cat Noir. Plagg asks to say goodbye to Kitty Noire first, Marinette obliges. Zoé, in her room, is curled up in a ball, sad because she believes she failed as Kitty Noire. Plagg comforts her and convinces her that she was an exceptional holder and very brave for standing up to Chloé. He tells Zoé to not let anyone push her around. Zoé gifts Plagg a wrapped slice of camembert. This makes Plagg ecstatic. He exclaims he was proud to be Zoé's kwami and leaves for Adrien's house. As she watches Plagg leave, her smile fades to a frown and then she curls back up into a ball. Later that night at the Jardins du Trocadéro, Ladybug and Cat Noir remark their duo is the only successful formula. They congratulate their kwamis and the Resistance and pound it in honor of them.
