title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2) - Plot Developments
It's revealed that kwamis can actually be directly affected by the Miraculous superpowers of other kwamis, as Monarch was able to use Venom, Pollen's Miraculous superpower, on both Plagg and Tikki. Not just that, but they remain affected by the Miraculous superpower even after returning to their respective Miraculous, as they remained paralyzed after Monarch took their Miraculous and then put them on, summoning the two kwamis who were still immobilized.
This has already been hinted, as it has already been shown that kwamis can be indirectly affected by other kwami Miraculous superpowers through their owner, like akumatization.
It's shown that the user of Venom can undo the effects of its power over someone with a snap of fingers, evidenced by how Monarch was able to free Tikki and Plagg from their paralyzed state.
Another weakness of the Ox Miraculous and its superpower, Resistance was revealed:

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2) - Plot Developments
According to Plagg, if someone who's currently under the effects of Resistance puts on or holds an object after they activated the power, the object in question won't be protected by it. This was shown when Monarch put on the Cat Miraculous after he activated the ability, which mean that the ring wasn't impervious to superpowers, enabling Plagg to use his Cataclysm directly on it and not be nullified.
This implies either a similar situation to this has happened before, Stompp was in a situation where Resistance was activated and then Stompp or a Miraculous holder of his held or worn an item that was broken, or the kwamis simply know how their Miraculous superpowers interact with each other inherently.
Resistance doesn't protect the user's body from something that doesn't count as an attack or at least the weakness of another power.
It's revealed that Multitude users can control how many clones they can revert to after they have already split.
It's revealed that to revert to a smaller number of clones, the user has to say "Fall in".

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2) - Plot Developments
It's revealed that Zoé, Marc, and Nathaniel are also part of the Resistance. However, it is never revealed on what their code names are by the end of season 5.
The Resistance has developed a protocol for the eventuality that an akumatization happens in the school, involving an alarm to warn everyone at school, evacuating all the students, and using any calming techniques to cast away any negative emotions the target may be feeling in order to help them fight the akumatization.

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2) - Trivia
This is the second season 5 episode that is not named after the concept of a Miraculous, the first being "Reunion". It's interestingly the only episode of the eight not to have a name which starts with either "R" or "C".
The concept of deflagration, which means "the heating of a substance until it burns away rapidly", is applied to the calamity caused by Tikki and Plagg when they use their Miraculous superpowers to prevent Monarch from using their respective Miraculouses to grant his wish, with Plagg using his Cataclysm to destroy his Cat Miraculous and Tikki using her Lucky Charm to create an object for Marinette in order to help her fight Monarch and get the two Miraculouses back from him. The consequences of the use of their respective Miraculous superpowers causes a successive wave of creation and subsequent destruction that threatens to destroy not only Paris, but the whole world unless reverted.
It went opposite of how the Ultimate Miraculous Absolute Power was described in "Ephemeral".
The term deflagration was also shown in an emotional point of view in some episodes:

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2) - Trivia
In "Animan", Cat Noir felt immense anger and worry upon believing the titular villain had eaten Ladybug alive, but his anger burned away upon the relief that she was safe.
In "Rocketear", Nino felt anger towards Cat Noir for "stealing" Alya from him, leading to his akumatization into the titular villain, but then it burned away into remorse upon learning what really happened that night he found the pair.
In "Miraculous Paris", Shadybug and Claw Noir were burning up with anger over the pain of their lives but when they talked with their counterparts it burned away into sadness then into new strength to start their new lives.
During the previous episode, "Transmission", after being freed from their roles as Miraculous holders, Marinette's and Adrien's sadness burned away and turned into joy at the chance their kwamis gave them.
In "Emotion", when Felix was burning up with anger and hatred towards oppressors, then it burned away and turned into remorse, guilt and fear towards his actions.
In "Pretension", Marinette let her courage burn up when confronting Gabriel, then burn out when she left.

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2) - Trivia
Scarabella and Kitty Noire are formally introduced to all of Paris, with the latter revealing her superhero name.
Despite this being Scarabella's formal introduction to the people of Paris, she has already saved the city before during the events of "Hack-San". However, because everyone was under Robostus' control, they don't remember her.
This is the second time an unidentified character can be heard singing a song after Stationation in "Party Crasher". Contrary to popular belief, Gabriel doesn't sing nor lip-synch "Snapping My Fingers" when he is briefly seen dancing to the song. Instead, it is sung by Fred Lenoir for an unknown singer on the radio Gabriel regularly listens to.
Because Wilfried Pain mentions that the song comes from the radio and Gabriel wears an Alliance ring outside his gloves, this indicates that the Alliance rings have a radio mode. However, unlike the other modes, it's likely radio mode doesn't have a holographic screen since it is never seen throughout his dance number.

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2) - Trivia
The song is later reused in the episode "Emotion", this time sang by Argos as he snaps his fingers to make all the Parisians disappear. In the English dub, Argos' rendition is the in-universe cover of the song.
An instrumental of the song is playing in the background in "Illusion" while Gabriel is making pancakes for Adrien, and when the latter and Marinette enter the kitchen in "Pretension".
"Snapping My Fingers" is currently the first known song where the original French version is left untranslated and can be heard across various dubs. According to Wilfried Pain, this is not an error and intentionally wants the song to be left untranslated because the French version is the international version.
However, despite the intention, the song has been dubbed in the Brazilian Portuguese and Catalan versions.
Parts of Viperion's transformation sequence music briefly play when Gabriel announces Scarabella and Kitty Noire to Nathalie.
It's revealed that Zoé, Marc, and Nathaniel are also part of the Resistance. However, it is never revealed on what their code names are by the end of season 5.

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2) - Trivia
The Resistance has developed a protocol for the eventuality that an akumatization happens in the school, involving an alarm to warn everyone at school, evacuating all the students, and using any calming techniques to cast away any negative emotions the target may be feeling in order to help them fight the akumatization.
The Resistance wield condiment guns, which are similar to Hot Dog Dan's guns, and the Inklings' Splattershot guns from Splatoon.
When Nino questions why Ladybug and Cat Noir hadn't pick him and Alya, he claims to Alya she would have made an awesome Ladybug. Ironically, Nino does not know Alya is Scarabella, especially since he also does not know Alya knows who Ladybug is and the latter entrusted the former with her miraculous.
Also, Nino didn't know Plagg consider having him as his new holder in the previous episode, but considering Nino and Alya tell each other everything, especially they both know each other as Rena Rouge and Carapace, Plagg decided to chose Zoé.

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2) - Trivia
This is the third time Monarch uses Venom, Voyage, Multitude and Sublimation to create invisible clones of himself that can teleport as well as immobilize people, following "Miraculous Paris" and "Illusion".
Lila is seen making use of her "friendship" with Chloé to disturb Marinette's love story with Adrien, manipulating Chloé into interrupting their romantic lunch.
This is the ninth time Chloé gets akumatized, following "Antibug", "Queen Wasp", "Mayura", "Miracle Queen", "Queen Banana", "Penalteam" and 2 off-screen akumatizations that were revealed in "Mr. Pigeon 72". This time, however, she gets akumatized into Sole Destroyer, her sixth akumatized form overall.
Interestingly, this akumatized form is a variation of Zoé's akumatized form, Sole Crusher.
This is the fourth two-part episode in which Chloé is akumatized, following "Queen's Battle", "Heroes' Day" and "The Battle of the Miraculous".
This is also the fourth time Chloé is willingly akumatized, following "Miracle Queen", "Queen Banana" and "Penalteam".
Sole Destroyer is also the first akumatized supervillain not to receive a Miraculous superpower through an Alliance in season 5.

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2) - Trivia
This is the only time on-screen that Chloé was fully akumatized with her wearing only her default outfit (excluding "Miraculer", as she only ever got infected with the Akuma).
Chloé is the second character to possess two akumatized forms with the same akumatized object, with Alya being the first in "Oblivio" and "Félix".
This is the third time, after Queen Wasp and Mayura where Chloé had no memory/recollection when she was akumatized as Sole Destroyer.
This is the third time an akumatized villain use their shoes as a weapon after "Sole Crusher" and "Penalteam".
However, this is the second time that an akumatized villainous form of Chloé has used her shoes as a weapon, after "Penalteam".
This is the seventh time footwear is used after "Timebreaker", "Frozer", "Heroes' Day", "Gang of Secrets", "Sole Crusher" and "Penalteam".
This is the first time someone reuses a power previously summoned through the use of Sublimation.
This is the first time where Gabriel gets both the Ladybug Miraculous and Cat Miraculous in the permanent timeline, though he loses them thanks to the Resistance, who helped Ladybug get them back.

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2) - Trivia
Monarch loses the Cat Miraculous twice, as he lost it when Plagg used his Miraculous superpower to destroy the it, which is later restored by Ladybug's Miraculous Ladybug, only to lose it again to Ladybug.
This is also the fifth time where Monarch obtains one or more Miraculouses, but loses them following "Miraculer", "Miracle Queen", "Miraculous New York" and "Evolution".
It's revealed that kwamis can actually be directly affected by the Miraculous superpowers of other kwamis, as Monarch was able to use Venom, Pollen's Miraculous superpower, on both Plagg and Tikki. Not just that, but they remain affected by the Miraculous superpower even after returning to their respective Miraculous, as they remained paralyzed after Monarch took their Miraculous and then put them on, summoning the two kwamis who were still immobilized.
This has already been hinted, as it has already been shown that kwamis can be indirectly affected by other kwami Miraculous superpowers through their owner, like akumatization.

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2) - Trivia
It's shown that the user of Venom can undo the effects of its power over someone with a snap of fingers, evidenced by how Monarch was able to free Tikki and Plagg from their paralyzed state.
Another weakness of the Ox Miraculous and its superpower, Resistance was revealed:
According to Plagg, if someone who's currently under the effects of Resistance puts on or holds an object after they activated the power, the object in question won't be protected by it. This was shown when Monarch put on the Cat Miraculous after he activated the ability, which mean that the ring wasn't impervious to superpowers, enabling Plagg to use his Cataclysm directly on it and not be nullified.
This implies either a similar situation to this has happened before, Stompp was in a situation where Resistance was activated and then Stompp or a Miraculous holder of his held or worn an item that was broken, or the kwamis simply know how their Miraculous superpowers interact with each other inherently.
Resistance doesn't protect the user's body from something that doesn't count as an attack or at least the weakness of another power.

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2) - Trivia
It's revealed that Multitude users can control how many clones they can revert to after they have already split.
It's revealed that to revert to a smaller number of clones, the user has to say "Fall in".
This is the eighth time where a kwami uses their Miraculous superpowers on their own onscreen, following "Style Queen", "Catalyst", "Gang of Secrets", "Sole Crusher", "Optigami", "Dearest Family" and "Ephemeral", and the first time a kwami does so in season 5.
This is the third known time where Plagg used his Miraculous superpower without an owner onscreen following "Style Queen" and "Catalyst".
This is the second known time where Tikki used her Miraculous superpower without an owner onscreen following "Dearest Family".
This is first known time where two kwamis used their Miraculous superpowers onscreen in the same episode.
This is the second known time where Plagg attempted to Cataclysm someone onscreen following "Ephemeral" but since the events were undone by Sass, this is technically the first time Plagg attempted to Cataclysm someone onscreen in the permanent timeline.
This is the first known time Plagg has Cataclysmed his own Miraculous onscreen.

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2) - Trivia
Plagg is second behind Kaalki in using their Miraculous superpowers the most in an episode onscreen, using Cataclysm twice, but he holds the record for the most times his Miraculous was destroyed onscreen with a total of three.
Marinette and Adrien now know that Monarch destroyed the original forms of the stolen Miraculouses and turned them into rings, along with them and the rest of the Resistance seeing him in his new form for the first time.
This is the sixteenth time where an akumatized object wasn't destroyed.
Following "Dearest Family", when Tikki is calm, she can use her power in a minor scale, in the same way her holders use, creating random objects that are necessary to solve a problem but when she does that, her power of creation gets out of control and keeps creating random objects around.
Back in "Style Queen", when Plagg mentioned that Ladybug needed to repair everything quickly likely meant that Plagg's power doesn't only destroy the area where the power is used, but it would spread.
This episode gives more insight about the Ultimate Miraculous Absolute Power:

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2) - Trivia
The power will only work if both the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses, as well as their respective kwamis, are intact.
But due to Plagg destroying his Miraculous, the unification process was disrupted making it the first known time that happened.
This episode confirms from "Sandboy", that any user of the Ladybug Miraculous can use a Lucky Charm even if they're not the summoner as long as they wear the earrings.
When Monarch noticed that the Cat Miraculous was destroyed and heard Tikki's explaination, he figured out what happens to a kwami in said situation despite him unintentionally or accidentally doing it before such as in "Timebreaker" and "Miraculous Shanghai".
This is the third time where a fake Lucky Charm was made, following "Silencer" and "Psycomedian". Like in "Silencer", Monarch was fooled by mimicry.
Marinette wore a similar disguise from "Feast", but this time she made it look like her upgraded suit.
This is the first time that the Resistance directly fights Monarch himself, with Nino, Alya, Marinette and Adrien doing it in their civilian form for the first time.
This is the first episode where Zoé's room is shown.

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2) - Trivia
Like in "Style Queen", "Plagg" and "Miraculer", Plagg mentioned what he did to the dinosaurs.
Plagg and Tikki ask a question similar to Ladybug's in "Jubilation", unknown that they already have the answer.
Following "Evolution", a new unification is revealed: Monarch Bug.
This is the fourth episode where someone else other than Marinette Dupain-Cheng wields the Ladybug Miraculous, the first being in "Reflekdoll" and "Passion" with Adrien, and Alya in "Hack-San".
This makes Gabriel the fourth main cast member to be Ladybug Miraculous holder, after Marinette Dupain-Cheng, Adrien Agreste and Alya Césaire.
He is also the sixth person of French origins to wield the Ladybug Miraculous following Jeanne d'Arc, Aramis and temporarily succeeding Marinette, Adrien and Alya.
He is also the third male to wield the Ladybug Miraculous following Micazoyolin and his son, and the second French male to wield the Cat Miraculous following his son.

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2) - Trivia
When being caught by Monarch and trying to escape him, the kwamis took a page from their owner's book as Plagg, similar to Cat Noir, was quick to react without thinking and sacrificed himself to keep hope alive by destroying his own Miraculous and Tikki from Ladybug feeling sad over her counterpart's sacrifice and had a desire to make the most of it but couldn't.
This is the sixth time where the heroes sit on a rooftop with a view of the Eiffel Tower following "The Dark Owl", "Lies", "Hack-San", "Kuro Neko" and "Jubilation".
The is the fifth time where both holders are separated from their Miraculouses and kwamis in a single episode following "Reflekdoll", "Feast", "Passion" and "Transmission".
This is the first time ever where both holders are separated from their Miraculouses and kwamis in back to back episodes.
Like Marinette in "Style Queen", Alya officially meets Plagg.
This episode begins where the previous episode left off, but unlike "The Collector", "Truth" and "Evolution" it isn't a season opener.

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2) - Trivia
Similarly to "Origins", "The Queens Battle", "Heroes Day", "The Battle of Miraculous", "Truth" and "Lies", "Shadow Moth's Final Attack", "Evolution" along with "Multiplication" and "Destruction", these episodes take place during the same day.
Also taking it into consideration this is the fourth time where Cataclysm is used three times in a single episode following "Copycat", "Timetagger" and "Dearest Family".
Chloé's jealousy against Marinette dating Adrien is a callback to "Cat Blanc", but instead happening in the alternative future, it happens in the permanent timeline.
Like in "Transmission" it is further evidenced how Adrien and Lila are no longer friends, as she did not want to sit with him this time unlike in "Illusion". Lila too once again uses Chloé to interrupt a romantic moment between Marinette and Adrien.
This is the second time a Miraculous Holder attacks a civilian following "Félix".
When Rose, Kim and Ivan were about to dogpile on Monarch, the background is the same colors as their respective Miraculouses: pink for the Pig, light brown for Monkey, and light blue for the Ox.

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2) - Trivia
This is the third time Monarch revokes the akuma, following "Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part 1)" and "Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1)".
Errors
The first English dub release featured the episode's title as "The Kwamis's Choice - Part 2" in the title card. This was changed for the US premiere of the episode.
The version with the misspelled title would later be the one uploaded to the official English YouTube channel.
In the background of the news report at the beginning of the episode, the firefighter and the dark-haired woman are in default T-poses.
During Nadja's report at the beginning, the world map background is both static and moving at the same time. Based on earlier episodes, the map should be constantly moving.
There are some errors that occur after Gabriel's musical number abruptly ended by Nathalie's appearance:
Nathalie's shoes are miscolored silver gray.
Gabriel and Nathalie are the same height. Nathalie is normally shorter than Gabriel, even in heels.
When this episode was first featured on ABC iView and ABC Me, when Monarch uses Voyage to exit his lair, the subtitles depict him saying, "To beyond!", instead of "Voyage!".

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2) - Trivia
The logo on Sass' cage is a snake in a circle shape, instead of a spiral shape.
When Nino addresses the Resistance, his bracelets pierce his skin.
In one scene, the fork in Sabrina's hand is missing.
Monarch activates Sublimation without saying its name although it is possible Monarch used it offscreen.
The Eiffel Tower in the final scene isn't lit up.
When Monarch first puts on the Cat Miraculous, the Horse Miraculous is miscolored gray.
When Monarch first sees Marinette in disguise, Monarch's eyes are misaligned.
When Monarch uses Multitude and Voyage to escape from Ladybug, Nino is still immobilized.
When Ladybug and the Resistance do the signature "pound it", Juleka's glove is miscolored white.
In the scene where Monarch's clones first enter the cafeteria and start observing Alya and Zoé, there are some errors regarding the appearance of the Butterfly Miraculous:
The Miraculouses of the clones who watch Zoé have two white strands instead of four.
The Miraculouses of the clones who watch Alya are gone entirely.
In the English dub, when Marinette is in Alya's room, the former incorrectly refers to Kitty Noire as a "he".

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2) - Trivia
As Sole Destroyer turns Sabrina into a singing shoe, her eyes don't glow.
In some scenes, Monarch's cane is missing and Monarch Bug is missing his yo-yo.
Longg does not appear in her cage.
In the Italian dub, Sole Destroyer is incorrectly called Sole Crusher.
Even though he seemingly removed the Rooster and Turtle rings when putting on the Cat Miraculous, Monarch is still able to use Sublimation.
Chloé is shown not to know the meaning of "generous", despite having used it in "Despair Bear".

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
[ Theme Song ]
Clara Contard: Were Ladybug and Cat Noir forced to step down after Monarch stole several Miraculous from them?
Scarabella: I’m sure you’ll understand that we can’t answer that question. But Ladybug and Cat Noir have nothing to feel guilty about.
Kitty Noire: We’ll accomplish our mission just like they did, because the goal we all share is to defeat Monarch, isn't it?
Clara Contard: Or perhaps Ladybug and Cat Noir renounced their mission so they could finally live their love story?
Scarabella: They were never in love or in a relationship, and neither are we.
Kitty Noire: (leans on her staff) So far anyway!
Scarabella: Of course not! We just met!
(Scene pans to Adrien frowning.)
Clara Contard: (v.o.) So, what should we call you?
Scarabella: Scarabella. Nice to meet you!
Kitty Noire: Kitty Noire. I’ve got a feeling we’re gonna get along!
Scarabella: I’m sure we will!
(Scarabella and Kitty Noire leap off, to Clara’s awe.)
Nadja Chamack: Well, Clara, seems like Paris now has two new heroines with strong personalities! Let's wish the best of luck to Scarabella and Kitty Noire!

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
(Adrien turns off the TV and looks at his phone showing Marinette in his contact list, just a button away in calling her. He stands up from his couch and walks to his foosball machine and attempts to play with it, but loses interest in a few seconds as he continues to wait for Marinette’s call on his phone and frowns again, leaning on his foosball machine.)
Scarabella: Spots off!
(She de-transforms into Alya.)
Alya: So, tell me, Tikki! How’d I do?
Tikki: You were fantastic, Alya! (whimpers)
Alya: No, it's the interview, wasn’t it? Did I say something wrong?
Tikki: No, no! You were perfect! It’s just... I was thinking about Marinette. I hope she’s okay.
(Tikki hides quickly as Ella and Etta enter Alya’s room.)
Ella and Etta: Alya, Alya! Marinette’s here! She bought chouquettes!
Alya: Marinette!
Marinette: (gives the bag of chouquettes to Ella and Etta) Enjoy, you little tornadoes.
Ella and Etta: Yay!
(Alya closes the door after the twins leave her room and hugs Marinette.)
Marinette: Tikki couldn't have made a better choice to replace Ladybug.
Tikki: (zooms out of Alya’s fanny pack and reunites with Marinette) Oh, Marinette!
Marinette: Well done, Tikki!

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Alya: Wow, this morning my BFF couldn't leave her bed drowning in a pool of her own tears, and suddenly now, look at those happy dry eyes and rosy cheeks! (Marinette holds both her cheeks) Did we miss an episode or something?
Marinette: (her phone rings and answers Adrien’s call as Alya begins to watch her suspiciously) Adri-mine— uh, Adrien! (titters) You left your bag at my place?
Alya: (to Tikki) He left his bag... at her place?
Marinette: Yes— uh— no, you can't come over! Uh— no no. No, nothing serious, I’m just, uh… shaving my socks! (chuckles) I just hate lint! Sure, okay, I'll bring you your bag tomorrow. (ends call) Oh, “shaving my socks”!? It makes no sense! I can't believe myself sometimes…
Alya: How many episodes did I miss?
Marinette: What? No, there’s been no new episode.
Alya: Then, how did we go from “I’m pathetic and I’ll never love again” to “Yay! I’m going out with Adrien”?
Marinette: I’m not going out with Adrien…
Alya: Hmm… but he did leave his bag, so he was over there, wasn’t he? (gasps) Did you guys kiss?
Marinette: No!
Alya: Did you at least hold hands?
Marinette: No, we didn’t!
Alya: I got it! You finally told him you love him!

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: That’s not exactly how it went…
Alya: So then, exactly how did it go?
Marinette: Well, I raised my right hand, or the left. Sometimes both— I don’t know.
Alya: Alright… so then I didn’t miss anything. We’re just back at episode one.
Marinette: How’s the new holder of the Black Cat Miraculous? You think he can handle Monarch? How about you? You can’t tell a thing to Nino. You sure it’s gonna be okay?
Alya: Stop worrying about this stuff. Secret identities, the war on Monarch, that’s all Scarabella and Kitty Noire’s problem now. You no longer have to worry about losing your Miraculous because of love. Just focus on Adrien. I’m sure you can do better than just raising your hand whenever he talks to you.
(Marinette blushes.)
Kitty Noire: Claws in!
(She de-transforms into Zoé.)
Plagg: Panache and repartee, you have my congratulations! You only lack one thing keeping you from being the perfect holder: a cheese cellar.
Zoé: Then, you'll be happy, Plagg! I live in a hotel! And the restaurant has the largest cheese cellar in Paris!
(Zoé's last line, "largest cheese cellar in Paris" echoes in Plagg's ears, causing his eyes to dilate.)
Zoé: But you have to be very careful!

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Plagg: (upon settling inside Zoé's beanie) "Careful" is my middle name!
Chloé: What are YOU doing here? You and your dirty sneakers are not allowed inside the restaurant! The half-of-a-sister zone is limited to the freight elevator, the backstairs, and the broom closets! Get ready to move back to New York! MOOOOOOOM!!
Zoé: I'm sorry, Chloé. It won't happen again. What can I do to make it up to you?
(Chloé smirks at her remark.)
Plagg: So it smells just like cheese, but it's not cheese?? And it needs cleaning too!? How about I cataclysm that sister of yours instead?
Zoé: It’s pointless Plagg.
Plagg: Zoé, you can't let them treat you that way; no one speaks to me like that! Just ask the T-rexes — that is, if you can find one! BECAUSE THEY'RE NOT SO SMUG ANYMORE NOW, ARE THEY?
Zoé: It’s best to stay out of trouble in this family if I'm going to protect my secret identity.
Plagg: You start by giving up cheese, and then you end up giving up on dignity, freedom, and justice!
Zoé: I feel like you like to blow things out of proportion, don't you?
Plagg: Yes… especially when I’m starving.

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Fred Lenoir:♪ Ohhh Uabababah~! ♪♪ Tout ce qui se dessine, n'est pas ce que tu vois ♪♪ Tout ce qui se combine n'est pas ce que tu crois ♪♪ Tout ce que je désire, je l'obtiens de toi ♪♪ En claquant des doigts ! ♪
(Gabriel leaps out of his atelier and starts sliding down while the song is still playing.)
Fred Lenoir:♪ Comme d'un battement d'ailes légères, ♪ ♪ Je m'élève vers mes hauteurs solitaires ♪♪ Et de là-haut, je regarde en bas ♪♪ En claquant des doigts ! ♪♪ Buh ba ruh bah ba dubadub—
(The song suddenly stops playing. Gabriel also stops dancing when he notices Nathalie is standing in front of him.)
Nathalie: What has gotten into you?
Gabriel: (inhales) Can you smell that, Nathalie?
Nathalie: Don’t tell me you’ve been making pancakes again?
Gabriel: No, Nathalie! Even better! (shortly dances with Nathalie and twirls her around)
Alliance Émilie: Warning threshold exceeded. Data beyond normal human capabilities have been recorded on two Alliances. Between 4:12 pm and 4:26 pm, Alya Césaire traveled 14.8 kilometers. Zoé Lee traveled 15.2 kilometers. Their routes were 98% identical.
Gabriel: Meet the new holders of the Miraculous: Scarabella and Kitty Noire!

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Nathalie: Congratulations, Gabriel.
Gabriel: Now I just need the right combination of powers to deceive them! (presses the buttons within Émilie's portrait to open the hatch to his lair) Can you smell it now, Nathalie? The smell of victory! (goes down the pipe)
(Nathalie looks up at Émilie's portrait, worried.)
Gabriel: The day has come, my love. Soon, the Miraculous of the Ladybug and the Black Cat will be mine and we'll finally unite them and make my wish! We'll be together again, at long last.
Nathalie: I miss you, Émilie, but I’m so scared of the price Gabriel is willing to pay to bring you back.
Gabriel: The world is about to change, dear Kwamis, and you are going to play your parts in this metamorphosis, here by my side!
Roaar: You always say that and you always lose!
Gabriel: You're not very kind, Roaar. But until now, I did not know the secret identities of the Miraculous holders!
(All the Kwamis whine in fear.)
Sass: That's impossible, he'sss lying!

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Gabriel: We have to seize opportunities and we learn from our mistakes, don't we? I'll start by akumatizing someone to force the new holders, Alya Césaire and Zoé Lee, to turn into Scarabella and Kitty Noire! (takes off his ascot tie) Nooroo, dark wings rise!
(Gabriel transforms into Monarch.)
Monarch: Then, I'll freeze them when they try to transform! Pollen, (Pollen's pod flies towards Monarch) your power is now mine! (gains the power of Action) And I'll be able to catch them both at once for I'll be many! Mullo, (Mullo's pod flies towards Monarch) your power is now mine! (absorbs the power of Multiplication) They won't see me coming for I'll be invisible! Orikko, (Orikko's pod flies towards Monarch...) your power is now mine! (...and gains the power of Pretension) No one will be able to harm me for I will be invulnerable! Stompp, (Stompp's pod flies towards Monarch and absorbs his power of Determination) your power's mine, too! And of course, I will be elusive. Kaalki, (Kaalki's pod flies towards Monarch) your power is now mine! (gains the power of Migration) Voyage! (creates a portal)
Daizzi: What can we do, Sass?
Sass: Nothing, I'm afraid, Daizzi. (frowns)

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Nino: We never knew who Ladybug and Cat Noir were... and we never will. Today, we pay tribute to them. The Miraculous having been passed on to two new holders doesn't change anything, for our support isn't a matter of people, but one of principle, and that principle is called freedom! Speaking of which, Comrade Beurre Maître d'Hôtel is about to change the Ladyblog into the Scarablog, and do a story on the new superheroes to show our support! (turns off the music)
Adrien: I wonder what happened to Ladybug.
Marinette: I hope Cat Noir is okay. (frowns)
Adrien: (gapes at Marinette's remark and holds her hand) I'm sure he is.
(Marinette panics upon the contact of Adrien's hand with hers. Zoé smiles at the scene. Max and Kim play around.)
Nino: Thanks to Max and Markov we've finally set up the anti-akumatization system, Markov installed an app on your Alliances or smartphones. You can (opens his Alliance ring) activate it if you see someone being akumatized at school. If you press here, a signal is sent to this box, (points at a router placed on the table) which broadcasts the warning music, written by Kitty Section, throughout the school.

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
(Nino presses a button on his Alliance ring and plays the music, which alerts Denis Damoclès in his office. The Resistance cheer with the plan's initial success.)
Nino: Then, Kim, Mylène and Ivan will take care of evacuating the school, while Rose, Juleka, Zoé and Max try to stop Monarch's victim from being akumatized. Lastly, Nate, Adrien, Marinette, Alya and I will gear up with paintballs, so, we're ready to fight back in case there's no way to stop the akumatization.
(The school bell rings.)
Max: For every minute we're late to the cafeteria, we have a 30% less chance of getting fries!
(The Resistance disperses. Alya and Nino are left behind.)
Nino: Why weren’t we picked? We clearly rocked as Rena Rouge and Carapace... right? (leans on the chair) You’d have made an awesome Ladybug!
Alya: It’s better this way. We would’ve had to lie to each other to protect our secret identities.
Nino: (kisses Alya on her cheek) Well, it's okay. You don't have to be super to be my hero!

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
(Nino walks out the boiler room, leaving Alya with a smile on her face, but frowns right after as her eyes pan to her fanny pack and sighs. She then follows Nino from behind. Seconds later, Monarch is revealed to have been secretly spying on them, appearing after Alya leaves the room.)
Monarch: All I have to do now is (plugs out the wirings from the router) wait for a negative emotion. This shouldn’t take long in a school. Multitude! (multiplies into five mini Monarchs and turns invisible, exiting the boiler room)
Plagg: (while hugging the piece of cheese inside Zoé's sling bag) Ahh, never before has pasteurization tasted so much like freedom!
(Zoé looks around and heads to her table, not noticing that two invisible mini Monarchs are already spying on her from behind a plant box. Two more of them are spying on Alya, and one on top, overseeing the entire cafeteria.)
Marinette: (as Adrien helps her with her seat) Thanks, Adrien.
(Upon sitting down, Marinette blushes as all her classmates' attention are pointed at her and Adrien. Her friends cheer her on from Adrien's rear.)
Adrien: Did you see today's lunch salad is heart of palm? (raises his fork with a piece of the heart of palm)

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (nervously) Yes, palms! They remind me of the beach... (plays with her salad)
Adrien: What about the hearts? Do they remind you of something?
Marinette: Of course, they do! They remind me of... the heart of the beach!
(A piece from her salad falls off from her fork. She picks it up with a hint of embarrassment and chuckles. Zoé watches Marinette with a smile from her seat. On another table, Chloé is seen taking pictures on her phone. Lila sits down next to Chloe.)
Lila: You're very generous to let Marinette get so close to Adrien.
Chloé: Generous? What does that mean? Alliance, (turns on her Alliance) define "generous".
Alliance Adrien: I'm having trouble understanding your question.
Chloé: Ugh, that thing never works. Sabrina!
(Sabrina turns on her own Alliance ring.)
Sabrina: Alliance, please define "generous".
Alliance Adrien: Giving freely and lavishly.
Chloé: "Lavishly"? "Freely"? Eww! There is no way I’m being generous. I am going to destroy Dupain-Cheng!

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
(Back in Adrien and Marinette's table, Marinette attempts to reach out and hold Adrien's hand but shakes as she is a few inches away from his hand. She attempts to do it again, but this time forcibly reaching for his hand.)
Adrien: Are you okay, Marinette? If you're not ready, you don't have to.
Marinette: (while struggling to reach out for Adrien's hand) No! I can... do this!! (grunts aggressively)
Adrien: You know, we can just be friends if you prefer.
Marinette: No! No, I don't want to be friends with you!
Adrien: (taken aback and gasps) I see...
Marinette: No! I didn't mean it like that! Ugh, my hand... will obey me!!
(Pulling herself to reach Adrien's hand causes her to fall off her chair. Chloé shows up in front of Marinette to humiliate her.)
Chloé: So, finally back where you belong, baker girl? Crawling at my feet, of course!
Adrien: Chloé, go back to your seat, please. (reaches his hand out to Marinette, which she successfully held on to, and pulls her up)
Chloé: Don’t be so nice to the baker girl, Adrikins. You’re giving her false hope! Because you know what? No, you'll never guess, it's so ridiculous! Marinette Dupain-Cheng is... in love with you! (laughs maniacally)

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: You can’t reveal someone’s secret to everyone, Chloé. It's really mean! (goes back to his seat)
Chloé: A baker girl who thinks she's good enough to be with a rich and famous model... What a joke! It’s funny, right? (silence ensues in the cafeteria) Right!?? (looks at Sabrina) Sabrina!
Sabrina: (forcibly) Oh, yes. Very funny, Chloé.
Mylène: That's enough, Chloé!
Alya: Leave them alone, Chloé!
Chloé: You're not laughing because she's missing something: (picks up a piece of pie from Marinette's plate) a piece of humble pie. Get it? 'Cause she's a baker girl?
(Chloé attempts to throw the pie at Marinette only to be stopped by Zoé in a nick of time.)
Chloé: (gasps in disgust as Zoé puts down the pie back on the table and pulls her away from Adrien and Marinette's table) Should I call Mom and have you sent back to the hole you should never have crawled out of??
Zoé: Maybe I'll go back to New York, maybe not. But what's for sure is that you're going back to your seat and leaving Marinette alone! (pushes Chloé back to her seat)
Chloé: You're even worse than her!!
(All the students in the cafeteria cheer for Zoé.)

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Chloé: And you all, you're even worse than they are!! (slams her fists on the table) I'LL CRUSH YOU ALL!!
(Zoé walks back to her seat, frowning, yet smiles as she looks at Marinette who is also smiling at her for doing a great job standing up against her cruel sister. Chloé is now fueled with rage.)
Monarch: Dear Chloé's humiliation is exactly what I need! (sets the akuma free from his cane) Fly, my megakuma!
Sabrina: Chloé's about to get akumatized!
(The akuma flies towards Chloé, who proudly accepts it and enters her sunglasses.)

Mylène: What do we do?

(All the students in the cafeteria evacuate the area as Chloé transforms into Sole Destroyer, starting up with her first target, Mylène, then Max, changing them into golden stilettos.)

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)/Transcript
text:

Mylène and Max:(as golden stilettos) ♪ Chloe, you’re so pretty ♪♪ I’m just a shoe, what a pity! ♪♪ Sole Destroyer is your name ♪♪ Crushing us is your vile game ♪

On of the tables, Adrien and Marinette are seen hiding, only to be found by Sole Destroyer as she lifts up the table.)

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)/Transcript
text:

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)/Transcript
text:

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)/Transcript
text:

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)/Transcript

title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)/Transcript
text:

text:

title: Dark Grimalkin
text:
Dark Grimalkin - Intro
was a past Cat Miraculous holder who was revealed by the memory of Jeanne d'Arc in the episode "Reunion". He was a champion of England sent to subjugate France before he and France's own champion, Jeanne d'Arc (known as Scarlet Fate), fell in love with each other. When Plagg inhabited the Cat Miraculous, he transformed into a cat-themed superhero.

title: Dark Grimalkin
text:
Dark Grimalkin - Appearance
Physical appearance
Dark Grimalkin is a young strong-looking man with long, black hair, sideburns and a stubble.
As Dark Grimalkin
Dark Grimalkin wears dark grey chain-mail armor that is covered by a long black tunic. The tunic has a bright green cat paw logo on his torso. He wears black boots and gloves. He also wears a removable black helmet with triangular protrusions similar to cat ears.

title: Dark Grimalkin
text:
Dark Grimalkin - Personality
As described by Jeanne d'Arc, Dark Grimalkin was a noble warrior that defended his own nation with great courage. Despite being at different sides of a war and entering in many conflicts, he admired Jeanne for her dedication to protect the innocent people that were caught in the crossfire of the war and that led him to fall in love with her, with the same happening with her. Realizing they were both manipulated by their respective monarchs into fighting each other, they entered in a secret relationship, despite knowing that would be considered treason. Their love for each other was so strong that they abdicated of their roles as Miraculous holders so they could be together.

title: Dark Grimalkin
text:
Dark Grimalkin - Abilities
If this past Cat Miraculous holder had the same powers as the current holder, he had enhanced physical abilities and the superpower Cataclysm. He also used the staff.

title: Dark Grimalkin
text:
Dark Grimalkin - Trivia
The name "Grimalkin" is an archaic term for "cat". It stems from "grey" (the colour) plus "malkin", an archaic term with several meanings (a low class woman, a weakling, a mop, or a name). Scottish legend makes reference to the grimalkin as a faery cat that dwells in the highlands.
Chronologically, he is the first Cat Miraculous holder to have a confirmed interaction with a Ladybug Miraculous holder (Jeanne d'Arc), as well as having a romantic relationship with her which would be followed by Adrien and Marinette
He and Jeanne d'Arc are also the first known Miraculous holders ever to have been at opposite sides of a conflict.

title: Dog Miraculous
text:
Dog Miraculous - Intro
The  is a collar necklace that, whenever Barkk inhabits it, transforms the wearer into a dog-themed superhero with the power of Adoration.
To activate the collar necklace, the user must speak the transformation phrase: "On The Hunt". To deactivate the collar necklace, the user must speak the detransformation phrase: "Lay Down".
The collar necklace is currently owned by Sabrina Raincomprix, who uses it to transform into Miss Hound. It was previously stored in the Chinese Miracle Box and only lent out to her when the situation required it. But, as of "Re-creation", she now posseses the Miraculous permanently.
In "Strikeback", Ladybug mistakenly lends the Miraculous to Félix Fathom while under the impression he is Adrien Agreste. He used the Miraculous to transform into Flairmidable.

title: Dog Miraculous
text:
Dog Miraculous - Appearance
In general, the Dog Miraculous is a collar necklace. In its charged mode, when Barkk inhabits it, it is a black collar necklace with an open end. The tips of the edges are shaped like gray dog heads, with two rounded light brown bead-like objects next to each one. At the front of the jewelry, there are five light larger brown bead-like objects. If a minor is using the Miraculous, the necklace starts running out of power, they make a beeping sound, and the bead-like objects start discoloring one at a time as an indication of how much time (one bead is equivalent to one minute) Sabrina (or another Dog Miraculous holder) has left. In its activated mode, the five beads are grey.
In Season 6 onwards, the Dog Miraculous is styled as a metallic brown necklace and the tips of the edges become round. In its activated mode, the necklace is silver.
In its camouflage mode, the collar changes color and form depending on whose possession it's in:
In the possession of Sabrina Raincomprix, the necklace is metallic orange.
In "Daddycop" and onwards, Sabrina changed its disguised form into an orange colored brooch with bronze lining.
When it was worn by Gabriel Agreste, the necklace was silver.

title: Dog Miraculous
text:
Dog Miraculous - Appearance
When it was worn by Alix Kubdel, the necklace was light silver.
When it was worn by Félix Fathom, the necklace was brown.
When it was worn by Chloé Bourgeois, the necklace was yellow gold.
When it was worn by Marinette Dupain-Cheng, the necklace was rose gold.
In it's reforged ring form, it was a thick band with a circle surface, similar to the Cat Miraculous, inside of it was the symbol of the Dog Miraculous which glowed caramel. It used to sit on the ring finger of Gabriel's left hand.

title: Dog Miraculous
text:
Dog Miraculous - Abilities
The Dog Miraculous has the ability to transform its wielder into a dog-themed superhero, granting its wielder incredible powers of speed, endurance, agility, stamina and strength.
Its special weapon is an unbreakable ball, which can be utilized as both a weapon, a communicator, and an object that can be used to breathe underwater. Its special superpower is named Fetch, which gives the user the ability to fetch and return any arbitrary object that has been touched by the ball in order to obtain their goal, like defeating a villain. As long as the superpower isn't used, the wielder can remain transformed indefinitely. However, as soon as the superpower is used, the wielder loses power and the transformation wears off in about approximately five minutes. The collar also has the ability to give the wielder the costume they truly desire.

title: Dog Miraculous

title: Dog Miraculous
text:
Dog Miraculous - History
Five thousand years ago, a mage successfully helped the kwamis to interact with humans by creating magic jewels, which were called Miraculouses. In order to repay the mage, and to live on the physical world alongside humans, the kwamis decided to help humanity by letting humans utilize their energy and powers through the Miraculous they were bonded with, which included Barkk and the Dog Miraculous.
At some point in time, all of the knowledge about the Miraculouses and their powers was written down in code in a book called the Grimoire, with very few people knowing how to decipher the code. Miracle Boxes were also created at an unknown time to store the dormant Miraculouses. To protect and distribute Miraculouses, the Order of the Guardians was formed and existed for many years. Throughout its existence, guardians trained younger generations to keep a watchful eye over the Miraculouses and the Grimoire, which were placed in the guardians' temple.
Many Dog holders throughout history used Barkk's power for good, like Gǒu in China, who started the legacy.

title: Dog Miraculous
text:
Dog Miraculous - History
172 years ago, after an disastrous event where a young Wang Fu used the Peacock Miraculous to create a sentimonster and his negative emotions and imaturity led to the creature rampaging through the temple and eating and destroying everything in its path, Fu was entrusted with the Chinese Miracle Box (Which included the Dog Miraculous) by a monk and was told to run away from the mess. However, on the mountain range outside the temple, in order to escape from the the monster, Fu jumped over a fissure on the ground - accidently opening the Box and spilling all of its contents on the snow. Due to his distress, Fu didnt notice he accidently left both the Peacock and the Butterfly on the mountain, alongisde the Grimoire, until it was too late and he was too far away to come back. Somewhere along the line, the Peacock got dangerously damaged, to the point of being improper for use - but, as it turns out, no one knew of this fact until it was too late.

title: Dog Miraculous
text:
Dog Miraculous - History
On a previous trip overseas with the Agrestes, Nathalie found the Butterfly and Peacock Miraculouses and gave the jewels to Gabriel. In "Representation", it was revealed that neither the Agrestes nor the Graham de Vanily couples could bear children on their own, so Émilie and Colt used the Peacock Miraculous to create Adrien and Félix respectively, but in doing so, they grew sick over time and were eventually left in a condition where they fell into an eternal slumber due to using the Peacock Miraculous in its damaged state.

title: Dog Miraculous
text:
Dog Miraculous - History
Desperate to fix his mistake, Gabriel Agreste began using the Butterfly Miraculous for evil to obtain the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses in order to gain access to their absolute power, becoming the supervillain Hawk Moth, later Shadow Moth (when unified with a now fixed Peacock Miraculous), and finally, Monarch. This decision proved one of the most significant for the history of the series, as Gabriel began utilizing Nooroo's power to akumatize the civilians of Paris, France, trying to get one of them to draw out the current holders of the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses, unintenionally helping start off Marinette's and Adrien's journeys as Ladybug and Cat Noir, and later, the rest of the Miraculers.

title: Dog Miraculous
text:
Dog Miraculous - History
One of the members of the Miraculers is Sabrina Raincomprix, who was chosen by Ladybug in "Penalteam" to wield the Dog Miraculous, becoming the heroine Miss Hound. Sabrina, from that point on, became a member of the team, helping Ladybug and Cat Noir during "particularly difficult missions". From "Penalteam" to "Strikeback", Sabrina was a temporary holder, meaning she would only receive the Miraculous from Ladybug when she was needed for the mission, and had to give it back after the crisis was solved.

title: Dog Miraculous
text:
Dog Miraculous - History
Félix, after finding out about his true origins as a sentihuman and learning that the Peacock Miraculous could erase his and his cousin's lifes if it feel into the wrong hands, orchestrated a plan to capture all of the Miraculouses of the Chinese Box from Ladybug and traded all of them (besides the Ladybug and the Cat) for the Peacock, which included the Dog Miraculous, succeeding in "Strikeback". For his plan, he used the opportunity that was given to him: In "Risk", Ladybug, due to being under the effect of Risk's power, mistook him for Adrien Agreste, the true intended recipient of the Miraculous - he went along with it, and used the Miraculous to transform into Flairmidable, furtively using his Ball on her Yo-yo when she wasn't looking; later on, he used his Fetch to grab her yo-yo, which had a magical connection with the Chinese Miracle Box, using it as a bargaining chip for the Peacock Miraculous. When Gabriel unified it with the Butterfly and other miraculouses, he became Monarch.

title: Dog Miraculous
text:
Dog Miraculous - History
In "Evolution", in order for her plan to recover the Rabbit Miraculous from Monarch to work, Ladybug gave Alix Kubdel the Dog Miraculous temporarily, letting her become Canigirl so she could Fetch the Rabbit Miraculous away from Monarch. Later, she fused the Dog with the Rabbit, becoming Bunny Dog in order to escape from Gabriel's own Fetch by going into the Burrow dimension.
In "Destruction", Gabriel used a laser machine to melt down the Miraculous into a pile of dust, and then reforged it into a special Alliance ring for transferring Barkk's power of Adoration to any akumatized villain who wore a regular Alliance ring. In "Re-creation", Marinette Dupain-Cheng manages to recover all of the Miraculous that were previously stolen. In "Miraculous London", Lila stole all of the Miraculous under Marinette's care in an alternate timeline, which included the Dog Miraculous, in order to render her truly powerless and to fuse the Ladybug and the Cat to gain her wish without her interference, but her plan was ultimately thwarted by the combined efforts of Chronobug and Bunnyx, and the event was erased from the timeline.

title: Dog Miraculous
text:
Dog Miraculous - History
After the events of "Miraculous London", Marinette, having realized both instances of all of the Miraculouses being stolen happened because all of them were kept in the same place, and with the idea that centralized power is inherently flawed, and that distributing it among members of a society is a far superior idea, restored and upgraded the Dog Miraculous by redesigning its original design and adding the Miraculous Call: a call feature that grants the holder the ability to summon other superheroes who possess a Miraculous from the Chinese Miracle Box in order to receive aid on their missions. This new feature is particularly useful, as the new holder of the Butterfly Miraculous, Chrysalis, is even more fearsome than her predecessor. After the alterations, the Dog Miraculous was given back to Sabrina permanently - putting Miss Hound back on the map.

title: Dog Miraculous
text:
Dog Miraculous - Trivia
Dogs symbolize guidance, protection, fidelity, faithfulness, alertness, love, loyalty and friendship.
At times a collar necklace is also called a dog collar, which is befitting as Barkk is the kwami of adoration and a dog wearing a collar means they have a home or an owner.
The transformation phrase "On the Hunt" is a reference to dogs hunting in packs to find animals such as rabbits and foxes in hunting seasons using their sense of smell and hearing or to find a lost person. The detransformation phrase " Lay Down" is a reference to dogs laying down to rest or relax.
It's the eighth Miraculous used for evil, even if briefly, following the Butterfly, Peacock, Cat (only in the alternate future in "Cat Blanc" and briefly in an alternative timeline in "Ephemeral" by Shadow Noir), Bee (briefly in "Miracle Queen" by Miracle Queen), Eagle (briefly in "Miraculous New York" by Miraclonizer), Turtle (briefly in "Optigami" by Senticarapace and later in "Strikeback" by Monarch) and Ladybug (briefly in an alternative timeline in "Ephemeral" by Shadow Noir).

title: Dog Miraculous
text:
Dog Miraculous - Trivia
The Dog Miraculous is currently the Miraculous with the most camouflaged forms seen in the show, with a total of seven: Marinette's, Chloé's, Sabrina's (two different forms), Félix's, Gabriel's and Alix's.
The Dog Miraculous matches Sabrina as its holder, as her father is a police officer, and they often use dogs in their services such as Dobermanns, German Shepherds, and Rottweilers.
Whilst the female holders wear a hat with dog ears in their transformed states, Felix was shown with ears similar to the holders of the Cat Miraculous.
The masks worn by the holders resemble different dog breeds.
The Dog Miraculous was used by two different members of the Miraculers before these members received their primarliy-wielded Miraculous: Felix, who used it in "Strikeback" prior to receiving the Peacock Miraculous, and Alix, who used it in "Evolution" prior to receiving the Rabbit Miraculous.
Curiously, both of these members used the Dog Miraculous in the same episode where they received their primarily-wielded Miraculous.

title: Dog Miraculous
text:
Dog Miraculous - Trivia
Moreover, both Felix and Alix used the Dog Miraculous to steal their Miraculous - Felix used Fetch to steal Ladybug's Yo-yo containing the other Miraculous in the Chinese Box, as well as the Dog Miraculous itself as bargaining chips for the Peacock Miraculous, which was under Monarch's possesion at the time, and Alix used Fetch to steal the Rabbit Miraculous off Monarch's hands - however, it should be noted that only Alix was instructed by Ladybug to do that and did so by her permission.

title: Despair Bear
text:
Despair Bear - Intro
"" is a season 2 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 4th written and produced episode of season 2. It is also the 30th written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Despair Bear
text:
Despair Bear - Synopsis
Netflix
Trying to learn how to be nice, Chloé throws a party but loses her temper and fires her butler, who becomes akumatized into the vengeful Despair Bear.
KidsClick
Humiliated by Chloé, her own butler gets akumatized by Hawk Moth. Now Despair Bear, he can manipulate anyone he touches and is determined to get revenge on Chloé. Ladybug and Cat Noir must not lose control!
Disney+
Ladybug faces Chloé's butler, now Despair Bear.

title: Despair Bear
text:
Despair Bear - Plot
Marinette's father, Tom Dupain, is teaching the class how to bake macarons. Alya tells Marinette that she loves it when her dad gives the class lessons. Marinette says her dad does, too. Chloé, however, begins complaining about having to get herself dirty. In order to avoid baking, she walks away from the class and phones someone, to which Marinette notices.
Tom asks Marinette to place the bowl he'd been baking within the cafeteria fridge. When she leaves to do so, Tikki flies out and asks for a taste, but Marinette tells her not yet and to control her sweet tooth. Suddenly, the fire alarm goes off and the whole class evacuates the school.

title: Despair Bear
text:
Despair Bear - Plot
Soon afterward, Mr. Damoclès is giving an announcement, furious as someone called the fire department for no apparent reason and was wasting the department's valuable time. He demands that the guilty party should apologize. Marinette is convinced that it was Chloé since she saw her make a phone call before the alarm went off, but Alya tells her that seeing Chloé make a phone call isn't solid enough proof. Chloé attempts to blame Marinette for the incident, but fortunately, Adrien and Alya defend her. Mr. Damoclès states that since no one is willing to confess, the whole school is going to be punished. However, when Chloé threatens to call her father, Mr. Damoclès agrees to punish everyone but her.

title: Despair Bear
text:
Despair Bear - Plot
All students are forced to clean up the school grounds while Chloé sits on a bench with her phone. Adrien witnesses Chloé being rude to Rose and making her cry. He angrily walks up to her and asks if she was the one who called the fire department, which Chloé admits to. She says that since everyone seems to enjoy getting dirty baking, it's no different from having to mop floors. Adrien sighs and asks Chloé how long they've been friends. Chloé says since they were tots. Adrien tells Chloé that unless she starts being nice to people, he's not going to be her friend anymore.
Later on, at the Le Grand Paris hotel, Chloé is sitting in her room, looking sad, when Armand comes in and offers her some chocolate, which she promptly gobbles up. She then starts crying and tells Armand what Adrien said. In order to cheer her up, Armand gives Chloé her favorite childhood stuffed bear, Mr. Cuddly. Chloé grabs him and starts hugging him affectionately. Jean offers to help Chloé. When asked why, he says it's because that's what it means to be nice. He also tells her that the bear, Mr. Cuddly, can help her to be kind towards others. Chloé agrees and is sure that she'll win back Adrien's friendship.

title: Despair Bear
text:
Despair Bear - Plot
At Marinette's room, Rose, Juleka, and Mylène are all trying out hats designed by Marinette while Alya records them. Just then, Alya receives an invite from Chloé to a party, as well as Rose, Juleka, and Mylène. Rose says Chloé is nice for doing that, but Marinette finds it hard to believe that Chloé could ever be nice. Mylène suggests that maybe someone hacked her phone, but when Marinette says that she didn't receive an invite, Alya concludes that it must be Chloé. However, quickly afterward, Marinette does receive an invite, much to her disgust. At first, she refuses to go, but after finding out from Alya that Adrien will be there, she agrees to come along.
Hawk Moth learns of Chloé's party and is so confident that someone will obtain negative emotions there that he sends out an Akuma ahead of time.

title: Despair Bear
text:
Despair Bear - Plot
At the party, Chloé watches over the guests on top of the hotel steps. Armand suggests that she greet them with a hug and kiss. Chloé is against letting anyone touch her cheeks, but Armand tells her that's what Mr. Cuddly would do. When Chloé sees Adrien walk in with Marinette, Alya, and Nino, she rushes downstairs and hugs and kisses him. Rose, Kim and Max do the same thing to Chloé. Chloé becomes hesitant to kiss Marinette's cheeks, with Marinette equally being against the idea. But after spotting Mr. Cuddly from the distance, Chloé reluctantly gives in. At the same time, Marinette is watched by Adrien who looks happy, she gives in as well. Once they've kissed each others cheeks, both girls immediately spit in disgust in front of the crowd. Alya laughs and declares that she should've recorded them. Marinette tells her not to rub it in.
The party soon goes into full effect with Nino being the DJ and several kids either playing in the ball pit or video games on the big screen.
Armand suggests that Chloé check to make sure the guests are having a good time.
Chloé asks why she should do that and Armand tells her it's what Mr.
Cuddly would do while waving the bear in front of her.

title: Despair Bear
text:
Despair Bear - Plot
Embarrassed, Chloé pushes Armand's arms down and agrees to do so.
She walks over to Nathaniel and with forced kindness asks him if he's having fun.
Mylène dances her way towards Chloé and asks for some ice in her drink.
Chloé says she doesn't know where the ice cubes are and then begins to insult Mylène's sweater, much to Mylène's surprise.
Hawk Moth is pleased with Chloé and prepares to infect Mylène with the akuma, but before he can, Armand reminds Chloé of Mr.
Cuddly.
She quickly takes back her insult and offers to get Mylène the ice cubes, which makes her negative emotions go away, much to Hawk Moth's frustration.
After giving Mylène multiple cubes of ice and spilling them on the floor, much to her surprise, Nino then plays slow dance and the others started to dance.
Kim asks Chloé for a dance.
At first, she refuses, disappointing Kim, which almost gets him akumatized, but Chloé is reminded once again of Mr.
Cuddly and therefore accepts his offer, infuriating Hawk Moth even more.

title: Despair Bear
text:
Despair Bear - Plot
As Kim and Chloé are dancing, Alya asks Marinette to dance with Adrien, but she refuses, however, Alya purposefully pushes Marinette forward into Adrien, and Adrien asks Marinette to dance and he takes her hand without her answering. As they are moving on the dance floor, Alya twirls towards them, rearranges their hands so they're closer together, and then twirls away to dance with Nino. Marinette is quietly joyful that her dream is slowly coming true and continues to dance with Adrien.
While dancing with Kim, Chloé is outraged when she sees Marinette and Adrien dancing. She starts heading towards her but finds her path blocked by Armand and Mr. Cuddly. Kim asks Chloé if that is her bear and everyone begins laughing at her in amusement. Chloé loses her cool and drags Armand into the kitchen, where she angrily fires him. As a result, he is akumatized into Despair Bear.

title: Despair Bear
text:
Despair Bear - Plot
Despair Bear rushes to Sabrina and attaches itself to her leg. Sabrina, under the influence of the bear, begins chasing Chloé with a hairbrush. Chloé hides behind Kim, and Despair Bear attaches itself to Kim, making him ask Chloé if she would want to dance. Seeing Despair Bear clinging to Kim's leg, Marinette and Adrien make quick excuses to each other so they can leave and transform.
Despair Bear moves from Kim, to Max, to Alya, to Ivan, and finally to Cat Noir. Battle ensues between Ladybug and Cat Noir. A controlled Cat Noir attempts to use Cataclysm on Ladybug, but is stopped by Chloé when she pulls his tail.
Ladybug uses Lucky Charm and receives a fork. Chloé follows the two superheroes as they run upstairs. Ladybug manages to sever a string on Despair Bear, as he is still made of cloth, and attaches the string to an umbrella. While she distracts Cat Noir, Chloé unravels the rest of Despair Bear by spinning the umbrella. Once Cat Noir is back to normal, Ladybug breaks the string and releases the akuma. Chloé gloats in how she helped the two heroes and grants Armand his job back.

title: Despair Bear
text:
Despair Bear - Plot
At the end of the episode, Chloé invites Marinette's dad to the party so he can finish the cooking lesson he began at the beginning. Adrien and Chloé pinky-promise that they will always be best friends. Chloé appears to go back to being rotten, insulting everyone's macarons. Adrien asks Marinette for one of hers. She drops the pan, but luckily, he does manage to catch one. He tells her that her baking is as good as her dancing.

title: Despair Bear
text:
Despair Bear - Plot Developments
In this episode, Hawk Moth tries to akumatize Mylène and Kim, but he fails thanks to the intervention of Armand reminding Chloé to be nicer. This situation confirmed that people who were previously akumatized can be turned into villains again with a different akuma.
Marinette is aware that Tikki has a sweet tooth, but she didn't know the full extent of it until "Dearest Family".
This episode shows that Hawk Moth is aware of Chloé's terrible personality, going as far as to say that he "counts on it" to akumatize people.

title: Despair Bear
text:
Despair Bear - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in Spain on October 21, 2017 in Disney Channel.
This episode, in French, is called "Doudou Vilain".
"Doudou" means "security blanket" or "toy."
During Chloé's flashbacks about Mr. Cuddly, her mother is seen for the first time, facing away from view and implied to be leaving Chloé.
Hawk Moth sends an akuma without someone with negative emotions in mind.
Plagg does not appear in any sort of way in this episode.
When the akuma flies off to Paris, the image is a close-up, so the Eiffel Tower is no longer seen. The change is likely an aftermath of the reveal of Hawk Moth's lair's location in "The Collector".
A picture of the script from this episode was posted on Twitter by Thomas Astruc on February 17, 2016.
This is one of the times that Chloé is the cause that someone is akumatized.
This is the last episode where Marieve Herington voices Sabrina.
At the beginning of the episode, as the title card appears, a bus with an Adrien, the Fragrance ad on it can be seen.

title: Despair Bear
text:
Despair Bear - Trivia
For unknown reasons, there seems to be an alternate version of the episode, which was released by the official Spanish, Portuguese and Italian YouTube channels, and doesn't feature the ad, with that area of the bus being empty.
References
The slow dance music Nino plays is a slower, more extended version of the same song from the slow dance soundtrack from the episode "The Bubbler". The same melody later appears in "Miraculous New York". There is a distinct auditory resemblance to the guitar solo in "I Won't Hold You Back" by Toto.
Chloé calls Armand Jean-Marc shortly before walking up to Nathaniel. This might be a reference to the introduction of Marc, Nathaniel's love interest, later in the season.
Some of Ladybug and Cat Noir's fight on the rooftop is recycled animation from "Copycat".
As what happens in "Dark Cupid", "Princess Fragrance", and "The Puppeteer", Cat Noir is mind-controlled by the villain.
Cat Noir comes close to using Cataclysm on Ladybug for the third time, as well as using it on someone else of his own free will following "Dark Cupid" and "Princess Fragrance".
Allusions

title: Despair Bear
text:
Despair Bear - Trivia
When Adrien and Marinette are dancing together, some of the dance moves are a reference to the 1991 version of the film Beauty and the Beast.
In the Latin American Spanish dub, one of the misnames Chloé calls Armand is Jean-Claude Van Damme, who is actually a Belgian actor known for his actions movies.
Like in the US, what Chloé did by pulling a false fire alarm is also illegal in France. In reality, this would have resulted in her receiving up to three years in jail and a fine.
Errors
In one scene just before the camera zooms into Marinette after Chloé tries to frame her for calling the fire department, Adrien's hair is missing for seven frames.
When the camera zooms out of DJ Nino, there are no vinyls visible.
In the scene where Armand is about to give chocolate to Chloé, he appears bald in the reflection on the cover of the dish.
Alix's cap is not on her head in the pastry lesson, but in the fire drill, it reappears.
During the dance, there's a girl with a pink dress and long black hair, who appears in separate spots while dancing with different boys.
In the English dub, macaron is pronounced as macaroon, which is another food.

If it was Chloé who made the false alarm for the machination on the others, the operator would have to have identified the number which corresponds to the coordinates.
When Chloé is first shown looking over the party, Sophie appears in front of the background, but her hair is brown.
