title: Desperada
text:
Desperada - Intro
"" is a season 3 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 11th written and produced episode of Season 3. It is also the 63rd written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Desperada
text:
Desperada - Synopsis
Jagged Stone seeks to replace the guitarist he fired, who akumatizes into Desperada, a villain with magic instruments that traps people as stickers on her guitar case.
Disney Channel
Jagged Stone's guitarist Vivica gets akumatized into Desperada. Armed with her evil guitar case, she wants Jagged Stone to pay for firing her; Ladybug and Cat Noir better be ready to rock on.
Disney+
Ladybug faces Desperada, an akumatized guitar player.

title: Desperada
text:
Desperada - Plot
Luka is giving Marinette a guitar lesson, and her friends comment on how easy it is for Marinette to talk to Luka. Adrien and Kagami arrive at the Liberty to join their friends. Alix, Alya and Mylene comment on how cute Luka and Marinette would be together. When Adrien and Kagami arrive, everyone is shocked that Gabriel seemed to have let Adrien go out. They explain how they were supposed to be at fencing practice, but they "accidentally" ended up at the wrong address. Marinette is saddened by how well Adrien and Kagami get along. Kagami mistakes Luka for Marinette's boyfriend. Marinette tells Alya that Luka is just a friend, much to Alya's disbelief.

title: Desperada
text:
Desperada - Plot
Jagged Stone arrives, requesting that Anarka become his new guitarist. Anarka immediately refuses, saying that she would not be a second choice. She thinks Jagged Stone is only asking her to become his guitarist because he fired his original one again, but Jagged denies this, saying she quit on her own. Anarka still refuses, and Jagged is disappointed until he notices Marinette. He asks her if she knows anyone who can be his guitarist. Alya points at Luka, signaling to Marinette that she should recommend Luka. Marinette misinterprets this message and recommends Adrien instead, to everyone's shock. Adrien tells Marinette that he actually doesn't know much about the guitar. Jagged Stone is reluctant and asks about Luka. Marinette likes Jagged's idea and says Adrien can borrow Luka's guitar.

title: Desperada
text:
Desperada - Plot
Before Adrien can play any notes, Jagged Stone's former guitarist, Vivica, who had been akumatized into Desperada, makes an appearance to take revenge against Jagged for firing her. This confirms Anarka's suspicions, who earlier had denied Jagged's claim that Vivica quit by her own decision. Desperada uses musical instruments, which are pulled out of her guitar case, to fire yellow smoke at everyone, which turns them into stickers on her guitar case. Marinette quickly runs into the ship's cabin to transform into Ladybug.
While Luka tries to help him and Adrien find a safe hiding place, Ladybug uses her yo-yo to knock Desperada's trumpet away. While Ladybug continues to battle the villain, Luka wonders where Cat Noir could be. Adrien says he might not be there on time, so Luka decides to help Ladybug in the meantime. Luka plays his guitar, which distracts Desperada, giving time for Ladybug to capture her. She wire-cuts the bridge the villain was standing on and helps Luka and Adrien escape into the sewers.

title: Desperada
text:
Desperada - Plot
Ladybug thanks Luka for his help. She tries to contact Cat Noir but gets no answer. Adrien escapes into the sewers. Ladybug summons her Lucky Charm, creating a gong. Ladybug leaves Adrien and Luka to hide while she goes to see Master Fu but borrows Luka's guitar. Luka hides in a locker. Adrien pretends to hide, then escapes to transform.
Meanwhile, Desperada is running through the streets searching for Ladybug and hears horrible guitar music. The music's source turns out to be from Luka's guitar with bread attached to have pigeons peck on the strings. This distraction gives Ladybug time to see Master Fu. Master Fu tells Marinette to choose a Miraculous. Knowing that Desperada is relentless and that there would be no second chances, Marinette decides to borrow the Snake Miraculous.

title: Desperada
text:
Desperada - Plot
Cat Noir tries to escape through the sewers until he bumps into Ladybug. She searches for the Snake Miraculous and tells him she wants to give it to Adrien Agreste, saying he's the perfect one for the job. Cat Noir claims that his incredible sense of smell will help them locate Adrien and leads Ladybug to the lockers but says his nose failed him. Luka comes out of his locker and asks if Desperada has been defeated. He then notices Adrien's absence. Cat Noir tells Ladybug to split up and find Adrien and tells Luka to hide back in the locker.
Cat Noir runs off and detransforms. Adrien is ecstatic that Ladybug chose him to wield the Snake Miraculous. Plagg disapproves of such an idea, because he can't possibly be the perfect one for the mission if he is also Cat Noir. Adrien retorts by saying the Lucky Charm told her he was, but Plagg says that isn't how the superpower works. Plagg also comments on how trying to reason with Adrien is pointless, because he isn't listening. Adrien sees this as an opportunity to get Ladybug to fall in love with his civilian self, and he has to try.
Ladybug then finds Adrien and offers him the Snake Miraculous.

title: Desperada
text:
Desperada - Plot
Much to Plagg's dismay, Adrien accepts the Miraculous and transforms.
Before leaving the sewers, Ladybug explains how the snake's power functions.
Upon activation, the user has five minutes to go back in time as many times as he wants by pulling back the head on the bracelet.
Ladybug summons her Lucky Charm and receives a horse saddle.
The two exit the sewers, and Ladybug is captured by Desperada, who is hiding in the Eiffel Tower.
Adrien uses his Second Chance.
Adrien names himself Aspik.
He makes several attempts to succeed but is constantly distracted while trying to charm Ladybug.
In one version, he even confesses his love for Ladybug along with his identity as Cat Noir.
However, this knowledge is erased from Ladybug's mind after she is captured, and Aspik uses his second chance.
He attempts to change the future 25,913 times over the course of months but fails every time.
Knowing he wasn't the right person to wield the Snake Miraculous, he immediately detransforms and returns the bracelet to Ladybug.

title: Desperada
text:
Desperada - Plot
Surprised by his actions Ladybug convinces Adrien to try again but upon him refusing the heroine believes she did something wrong until Adrien explained that he messed up telling her what's been happening during his time as Aspik, after Luka returns Adrien recommends that Ladybug give the Miraculous to him.
Ladybug gives Adrien a thank you kiss on the cheek for saving her life so many times.
Ladybug give the Miraculous to Luka, who uses it to transform into Viperion.
Adrien finds Plagg and is disappointed that he could've made a bad impression on Ladybug. Plagg tells him to make up for it as Cat Noir, and he transforms.
Ladybug finds Desperada hiding on the Eiffel Tower, and Cat Noir uses his Cataclysm on the ground below. After using his Second Chance a few times. Viperion figures out how to defeat Desperada. The three use Ladybug's yo-yo, Viperion's lyre, and the saddle to tie up the villain's arms and legs. Ladybug breaks Desperada's guitar case and cleanses the akuma. Ladybug uses Miraculous Ladybug, and Desperada is deakumatized into Vivica. Luka returns the Miraculous to Ladybug.

title: Desperada
text:
Desperada - Plot
Back on Anarka's boat, Jagged apologizes to Vivica for firing her, and she is rehired. Kagami tells Marinette that she was wrong about her and Luka but tells her to choose between Adrien and Luka, because life doesn't always give you a second chance at love. Alya tells her Luka and Adrien also have a right to choose, and the end card appears.

title: Desperada
text:
Desperada - Plot Developments
This episode gives further insight about the Snake Miraculous:
The transformation phrase for the Snake Miraculous is shown to be "Sass, Scales Slither!" whereas the detransformation phrase for it is shown to be "Sass, Scales Rest!" and superpower is Second Chance.
Those around a Snake Miraculous holder can only see the final reality that is created with Second Chance, because time is constantly being rewritten. Ladybug's perspective of Adrien giving up and her and Cat Noir's perspective of Viperion immediately knowing how to defeat Desperada is understandable due to the effects of the temporal loop.
Even though the power allows the user to undo any progress their opponent has made, it also undoes their own progress, requiring them to start their plan all over again. Because of that, the user must be well aware of his or her actions so they can perform his or her plan exactly how it was meant to be while adjusting it to any adversities it may encounter.
Time is turned back for everyone else and the rest of the world, but not for the user, as they will only be returned to where they were when time was marked, but that’s all.

title: Desperada
text:
Desperada - Plot Developments
The magic ladybugs from the Miraculous Ladybug (superpower) cannot restore memories from a timeline that was undone by the power of Second Chance.
This is the first time where Ladybug's vision gives her an escape route, or a way distract to a villain without the use of her lucky charm.
Luka receives the Snake Miraculous for the first time in this episode, and his alter-ego, Viperion, officially debuts.
He is the second superhero whose identity is known by Cat Noir, following Queen Bee while his transformation is the longest sequence out of all the other heroes, being around 25 seconds compared to the usual 16.
This episode takes place before the events of "Feast" and "Party Crasher" but after the events of "Miraculer".
As of this episode, this is the second time a Miraculous holder is chosen by someone else other than Ladybug, as Adrien chose Luka to use the Snake Miraculous and herself and Cat Noir were chosen by Master Fu in "Origins".
This is the second time Adrien gets a different Miraculous other than the Cat Miraculous. The first episode being "Reflekdoll".
This time, he receives the Snake Miraculous.

title: Desperada
text:
Desperada - Plot Developments
Adrien becomes the first person to have wielded three different Miraculouses, having now used the Cat, the Ladybug, and the Snake.
Adding his transformation to Aspik, this is the first time that the same person is shown transforming into a Miraculous superhero three times in one episode.
Coincidentally, this is also one of very few episodes where Ladybug's transformation is never shown.
Kagami mistakenly calls Luka, Marinette's boyfriend.
Luka actually became Marinette's boyfriend foreshadowed in "Truth".

title: Desperada
text:
Desperada - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in UK & Ireland on Disney Channel.
It is revealed that Anarka and Jagged Stone used to work together.
Jagged also calls Anarka "Anarky", which may be based on the word "anarchy" meaning a state of disorder due to absence of authority.
Ironically, Adrien was acting a bit like his father as well as Chloé when he used the Snake Miraculous as all three used the power of the jewels for their own personal matters or to prove something but in doing so it put others in danger.
Also, Adrien trying to impress Ladybug, as Aspik wasn't necessary when he unknowingly already had the heroine's love and also unlike them Adrien realized knowing when to stop for the greater good and find a better way.
This episode takes the record for the most number of times a Miraculous superpower has been used in a single episode with Second Chance being used a total of at least 25,917 times.
Additionally, if it were to be assumed that Adrien used Second Chance every five minutes for every reset, it would mean that in his perspective, he had been Aspik and had been trying to save Ladybug for nearly 3 months (89.96 days).

title: Desperada
text:
Desperada - Trivia
It means as Aspik, Adrien holds the second longest tenure of using a Miraculous straight as an active holder on the Miraculous Team following his time as Cat Noir being longer and tied with Ladybug.
This episode tops as the longest someone has been akumatized possible being beaten or tied with "Cat Blanc" later.
Through Ladybug's perspective, Adrien also holds the shortest tenure of using a Miraculous straight as an active holder on the Miraculous Team.
As Plagg and Adrien were talking about Ladybug's Lucky Charm, he comments that the power doesn't work that way, implying that Plagg has seen Tikki and her wielders use her powers before. Due to them knowing each other so well it could also be that Plagg and Tikki are the most likely used out of all the kwamis.
This is the second time where multiple characters receive a Miraculous on the same day following "Origins" and preceding "Penalteam".
But unlike the other two, this episode involved two characters (Adrien and Luka) sharing a Miraculous (the snake) despite Adrien already having one.
In the Italian Dub, this episode contains a swear word, told by Anarka Couffiane.

title: Desperada
text:
Desperada - Trivia
Four transformation sequences appear in the episode: Cat Noir's twice, Aspik's, and Viperion's, like in "Queen Wasp" and "Evolution".
They're surpassed by "Catalyst" and "Stormy Weather 2" with six.
References
This is the fourth episode which involves a music-related villain, the first three being "Guitar Villain", "Frightningale", and "Captain Hardrock".
Desperada's akumatization are not shown, making this the sixth time this happens, after Magician of Misfortune in "Princess Fragrance", Vanisher in "Antibug", the Unnamed boy in "Sandboy", August akumatization in "Weredad" and Alya and Nino's akumatization in "Oblivio".
In one of Adrien's Second Chances, he tells Ladybug that he is actually Cat Noir and that he loves her.
However, in both times, she ends up forgetting about it, the first time due to Miraculous Ladybug reverting all the damages caused by Oblivio and the second time due to the time reversal power of the Snake Miraculous.
This is the third time Marinette/Ladybug kisses Adrien on the cheek. The other two times were "Mayura" and "Oblivio".
But in "Oblivio", they do not remember the kiss.

title: Desperada
text:
Desperada - Trivia
When Plagg says that Adrien can't be two superheroes at the same time, it is very similar to what he said to Adrien in "Gorizilla", when the boy used Wayhem as a decoy.
Adrien giving Ladybug a rose as Aspik is similar to what he did as Cat Noir in "Glaciator" and "Weredad".
Desperada is similar to villains like season one's Pixelator and season two's The Collector, in which civilians and heroes were imprisoned by the villain's prison collection. In this case, Desperada's prison is in a musical instrument. In "Pixelator", it's in the picture frames, and in "The Collector", it's in the magical book.
Allusions
Ladybug, Adrien and Luka using the sewers to escape Desperada, is similar to when Valjean used the sewers to escape in "Les Misérables".
Near the end of the episode, Hawk Moth says "History repeats itself, Ladybug, but rest assured, one day, I will be the one who rewrites it!", foreshadowing the events of "Evolution".
Which also comes from an old saying "Those who forget the past are doomed to repeat it", which also kept on happening with Gabriel.
Errors
When Adrien calls back Sass and catches him in his hands, he doesn't have the Snake Miraculous on his wrist.

title: Desperada
text:

The end pose in Viperion's transformation features Luka with blue hair. Right after his transformation, his hair is dyed teal.
Before, there wasn’t a table inside the boat. All of sudden when Marinette and Alya were talking, a bright blue table appeared behind them.
When Ladybug gives the Snake Miraculous to Adrien and Luka, she said that the Miraculous grants the power of second chance. According to Thomas Astruc, that is a dialogue error.
Cat Noir said "Cataclysm" twice when destroying the sewer. One time he activated it, the second time he said it was when he touched the wall.
In the Netflix CC for English, when Adrien gets Kagami’s bag, it lists Marinette incorrectly for the dialogue.
When Adrien transformed into Aspik, he was seen with the lyre, but after that, you don't see the Lyre until Luka transforms into Viperion.
After Adrien transforms into Aspik, the Cat Miraculous disappears.
Ladybug received the saddle before Adrien detransformed, but when she gave Luka the Snake Miraculous, she doesn't have the saddle until she finds Desperada at the Eiffel Tower.
Ladybug was brought back by the power of Viperion; in the next frame, her image is on Desperada's guitar case.

title: Didier Roustan (character)
text:
Didier Roustan (character) - Intro
Didier Roustan is a season 4 minor character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He was a French sports journalist and a friend of Caline Bustier.
In "Penalteam", he ran a soccer learning class in the Stade des Princesses for the Miss Bustier's students of the Collège Françoise Dupont at the request of their teacher.

title: Didier Roustan (character)
text:
Didier Roustan (character) - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Didier was a tall man with brown hair, brown eyes, a brown moustache and goatee, and a graying beard.
Civilian Attire
He was wearing a green T-shirt with a white and dark blue soccer ball design.

title: Didier Roustan (character)
text:
Didier Roustan (character) - Personality
He saw kind and balanced. Particularly passionate about football, Didier loved everything that directly or indirectly related to this sport. He liked to share his passion for football with others, using this knowledge of its history to improve some of his observations. Thus, he was easily moved when he witnessed an action that reminded him of the great moments of football or when he met a future talent, such as when he was able to notice that Marc was very good at playing football or the ability of Marinette to solve the problem for Chloé's reluctance to play.

title: Didier Roustan (character)
text:
Didier Roustan (character) - Abilities
Didier had a great knowledge of football, which he used to teach young people not only the fundamentals of the sport, but also its history, in particular the great players and the great competitions that have marked generations.

title: Didier Roustan (character)
text:
Didier Roustan (character) - History
Season 4
In "Penalteam", Miss Bustier invites Didier Roustan, a famous French sports journalist, to teach a special soccer lesson at the Stade des Princesses for her students. He was joined to teach how to play together and develop some team spirit. Since Nathaniel doesn't show up for class, he invites Marc to play together, whose skills surprise him. During the game, he blows the whistle when Adrien mistakenly picks up the ball due to the fact that he has never played soccer, after which he explains the rules to him and gives a sign to continue the match. Didier is thrilled with Marinette's goal. Later, he also wonders what to do with Chloé, who doesn't want to play football. He agrees with Marinette, who suggests that Chloé change the team after each goal scored.

title: Didier Roustan (character)
text:
Didier Roustan (character) - History
After Chloé got angry, she was akumatized into Penalty and created her own Penalteam. Didier agrees with Alix, after which a red card arrives at him and he falls into a yellow bubble located above Paris. Penalty orders him to comment on the entire match. Didier completes the task by telling what happens during the game. Thanks to the Miraculous Ladybug, he is released and finds himself back at the stadium. After Chloé leaves, Didier informs the students that they are missing a player again.

title: Didier Roustan (character)
text:
Didier Roustan (character) - Trivia
He was first mentioned by Thomas Astruc. He said that "Maybe only the French people will recognize him, but he's got the best shirts in the world".
In "Penalteam", Marc described him as a legend of sports journalism.

text:
Destruction - Synopsis
What if Ladybug’s worst nightmare came true? What if Monarch could force the kwamis who know Ladybug’s address to lead him to her? The unfortunate little creatures would have no choice but to obey him... And if Monarch showed up at Marinette Dupain-Cheng’s home, would she be able to escape him?
Disney+
What if Monarch showed up at Marinette's home?
Netflix
Monarch finds a loophole to force the Kwamis to reveal Ladybug's identity. But Ladybug devises a ruse that sends the villain on a scavenger hunt.

title: Destruction
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Destruction - Plot
The episode starts with Marinette, in her room, watching a video of Alya's Ladyblog, about Monarch has all the Miraculouses,. While Marinette tries to lower the volume, suddenly Alya enters the room and hears that she was watching Ladyblog. Marinette tries to explain that the video launched itself, and Alya "agrees" with her. Alya then asked whether she wanted fruit to which Marinette says yes. While going back, Alya tells Marinette to take her mind off Monarch and rest. When Alya goes back Marinette opens the video again, in which Alya says Ladybug and Cat Noir to be extra careful and Marinette grows concerned.
In the repository, Gabriel vows to Émilie that he will retrieve the Ladybug's Miraculous and then turns to Kwamis and says they are going to help him with this.
He walks towards the Grimoire and reads it.
He then orders Orikko to give him the power of Time Travel, since Orikko's power is Sublimation.
But he can't do it, since time travel is Fluff's power, and he can't copy the power of another Kwami.
Gabriel asks if he is trying to deceive him, to which he tells Gabriel to reread the Grimoire.

title: Destruction
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Destruction - Plot
While, he is re-reading it, Sass explains that each Kwami represents one concept, and that a concept can only exist once in the universe.
Xuppu goes to Gabriel and explains it by taking the example of Tikki.
Since, Tikki is the Kwami of Creation, there can only be one Creation concept.
If there is another power of Creation, then it will be called replication instead of Creation.
Gabriel then asks Orikko to give him the power to locate Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses, but Orikko states that that is not a power, but a wish.
Xuppu again explains that if he asks Santa for a pair of socks, it is a wish but if he asks to give him the power to knit socks, then Santa first himself should know how to knit socks, in order to teach him.
Gabriel becomes frustrated and asks Orikko to give him the power to unmask Ladybug and Cat Noir secret identities.
But again, he can't do this, since Sublimation cannot disrupt other Kwami's magic, such as how the Miraculous conceal the identities of their holders.

title: Destruction
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Destruction - Plot
In a fit of anger, Gabriel accuses Orikko of being a useless Kwami, which hurts Orikko's feelings. The other Kwamis begin to mock Gabriel, prompting him to silence them all in frustration. Gabriel claims that he only needs the Kwamis, not their powers, to reveal the identity of their Guardian. He then allows them to speak and demands that they say the name of their Guardian. When all the Kwamis chant "Ladybug," Gabriel’s frustration grows as he insists that he already knows that name. He tries to get them to tell him Ladybug's true identity, but they are unable to do so; instead, bubbles come out of their mouths, since the spell prevents the Kwamis from revealing their holder’s identity, and Ladybug has not yet renounced them. At last, finding a loophole, Gabriel orders the Kwamis to reveal the location of Guardian's place, since there are no rules against it. A terrified Ziggy tells him to just follow the smell of croissants. Gabriel transforms into Monarch, unifying the Butterfly, Horse, Turtle, and Bee Miraculouses and says that it's time to catch Ladybug.

title: Destruction
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Destruction - Plot
The scene shifts to Marinette' house, where Tom is baking some croissants. Sabine comes and asks him why he is baking bread at this time. Tom, while kneading dough, explains her that since he is no superhero, he is doing what he is best at, that is baking bread and pastries. He hopes that when people will eat his bread Monarch would have less victim to akumatized. Sabine tastes a piece of bread and says that with every day passing she loves him even more. After that they both begin to knead dough and sing together.
In her room, Marinette is lying on her bed and scrolling on her phone through the recent event news.
She tries to think anything else than Monarch but fails to do so.
Suddenly, a Voyage portal opens in her room and Monarch comes out of it.
Both, Monarch and Marinette, are surprised to see each other.
Monarch asks the Kwamis that are they sure about this.
Ziggy says that now he has to ask Marinette for the gift.
When Monarch asks her about the "gift", she remembers and says she have it.
As she climbs down the bed, Monarch points the Spinning Top and warns her to not to make any sudden moves.

title: Destruction
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Destruction - Plot
She proceeds towards her chest drawer, almost tripping over her chair in the process, but manages to take out the "gift" from her drawer.
When she gives it out to Monarch, he realises that the "gift" is a key with a ladybug design keychain.
He becomes furious and asks the Kwamis, why are they giving him a keychain, when asked for the Guardian.
The Kwamis reply that since Ladybug is very careful, they don't know her real address.
So, in case if they got lost Ladybug organised a treasure hunt to her real address and the first clue was to "follow the smell of croissants".
Monarch asks Marinette if she knows where Ladybug is, to which she denies, saying that Ladybug gave her the keychain when she gave her the Mouse Miraculous, in case she lost it since she very clumsy.

title: Destruction
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Destruction - Plot
Just as Marinette is about to give the keychain to Monarch, Alya enters the room with a tray of croissants but drops it in surprise upon seeing Monarch. He exclaims that Alya surely know where Ladybug is, to which Alya takes out her phone and starts recording Monarch. Monarch breaks her phone in rage and takes the keychain. When he breaks the keychain, he sees a piece of paper with "42" written on it. When he asks Kwamis about it, they tell him about the Ice Rink by mistake. Monarch takes advantage of it and teleports to Ice Rink by Voyage, leaving a dumbfounded Alya.
Monarch arrives at the ice rink and asks Philippe about the key. Philippe leads him to the lockers and opens a locker door. Monarch sees that it contains a photograph of Cat Noir statue at Grévin Museum and a piece of paper which has "street" written on it. He realises that these clues spell out an address. As he prepares to leave, Philippe stops him and takes selfie with Monarch. Monarch pushes Philippe aside in annoyance and travels to Grévin Museum through Voyage. As Monarch goes away, Philippe posts his selfie online, along with Nadja Chamack, Lady Ice, Jagged Stone, and Clara Nightingale selfies.

title: Destruction
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Destruction - Plot
At Musée Grévin, Véronique proceeds to close the museum, but Monarch teleports behind and orders her to take him to Cat Noir's statue. When they arrive at the statue's place, Véronique leaves him, and Monarch begins examining it. He notices a piece of paper in Cat Noir's bell. He sees that it has "halfwit" written on it. Suddenly, Cat Noir's "statue" grabs his hand, and Ladybug wraps her Yo-yo around their hands. Ladybug summons Lucky Charm, plastic tubing and wraps it around Monarch, immobilizing him. As Ladybug pulls both of them down, Cat Noir activates Cataclysm to scare him if he attempted to escape. Monarch becomes surprised due to the sudden turn of events. Ladybug explains that when she got Philippe and Monarch's selfie notification, she came here in advance to change the real address and the statue. She tells him to surrender the Miraculouses or Cat Noir will cataclysm him.

title: Destruction
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Destruction - Plot
But as she tries to take the Butterfly Miraculous, Monarch recklessly pulls Cat Noir and lets his forearm be touched by cataclysm. As he screams in pain, Ladybug and Cat Noir back away in horror. As both back away, Monarch uses Voyage to escape from the duo. When he is gone, Ladybug can't believe that she again failed, when the Kwamis were so close, and Cat Noir begs Ladybug to undo the effects of cataclysm with her superpower since after all behind Monarch's mask is a real person. But Ladybug tells him that she can't do anything since Monarch took the Lucky Charm with him. Both of them become devastated over the recent event.
At Marinette's house, She explains the recent events to Alya. But Alya tells her to explain the whole plan. So, Marinette explains her plan part by part to her but becomes sad at the end since she failed to recover the Miraculouses. Alya cheers her up by saying that it was the most amazing plan. She then comments on her broken phone that Monarch has to buy her a new one, and both laugh at it. Tikki watches and smiles at them, seeing Marinette in less stress.

title: Destruction
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Destruction - Plot
The scene shifts to his lair, where Gabriel is disintegrating the Miraculouses with the help of a device. After that, in Gabriel's atelier, Tomoe and Gabriel discuss something when Adrien interrupts them. After Adrien leaves, Tomoe agrees and gives Gabriel a small briefcase containing a small power orb. Back in his lair, he places the power orb in the device. It produces a beam, which remodels the disintegrated Miraculouses into Alliance Rings. After remodeling every Miraculous, he wears the Alliance ring outfit and the Miraculous rings on his fingers. As he asks the Kwamis about his new Miraculous, it shows each Kwami trapped in a small glass pod in a circular designed construction. He proceeds to wear gloves over his Miraculouses and transform into Monarch, now donning a new suit, resembling Hawk Moth, but with some upgrades. He proclaims Ladybug and Cat Noir will not be able to trick him since his reign is about to begin.

title: Destruction
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Destruction - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in Brazil on Gloob.
The episode shares its name with the concept of the Cat Miraculous.
This is the second time Cataclysm is used on a real person, following the time Miraculer used the power on Cat Noir.
This is the first time Cat Noir uses Cataclysm on a human being.
Unlike the first time, Ladybug is unable to undo the damage, as Monarch escapes with her Lucky Charm.
Just like the lipstick in "Oblivio", most likely her Lucky Charm disappeared when she de-transformed.
It's shown that Cataclysm, when at least used on a transformed Miraculous holder, is able to affect their civilian form covering the struck area with black marks, but if a transformed Miraculous holder is left untreated, it's revealed in "Multiplication" and other episodes that, if so, it's similar to necrosis and will spread causing occasional irritation for the person.
While on the contrary that this happened before but unlike Cat Noir, Monarch wasn't hit a vital area (for the most part) allowing him to survive.

title: Destruction
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Destruction - Trivia
Even though, Cat Noir said that he wasn't sure what his Cataclysm would do if it struck Monarch, the hero either forgot, blocked it from his memory that he already knew as it happened to him in "Miraculer" or he just said it to intimidate him.
However, it’s possible that Miraculer wasn’t using the pure version of the Cataclysm, and Cat Noir really didn’t know what his power would do, if he used it directly without alterations from other powers.
Outside of the magical ladybugs or possibly Akumatization, Amokization and Sublimation, it's unknown if the guardians found any other means to heal or cure others who have been physically harmed by other forms of Miraculous magic.
This is also the second time a Miraculous suit is damaged, with the first being during "Miraculer".
Besides the super power of Cataclysm, the concept of destruction also was utilized in several aspects of the episode and others:
Gabriel melts the Miraculouses to create them into something new with them, essentially destroying them.
Mentally, Monarch also destroyed or at least put a crack in the heroes confidence.

title: Destruction
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Destruction - Trivia
Cat Noir felt the same devastation of using his powers on someone as he did in "Miraculous New York" but to a lesser extent:
Unlike the others time, it wasn't an accident or of his own free will but he knew that Monarch forced him to do it and he didn't surrender his ring either.
Hawk Moth's relentless hunting, secrets, and stress destroyed or at least put cracks in the heroes relationship and with others, such as in "Glaciator", "Syren", "Frozer", "Cat Blanc", "Miracle Queen", "Truth", "Lies", "Gang of Secrets", "Kuro Neko", and later in "Elation".
How Master Fu was right in "Kwamibuster", about one person being forbidden to use so many Miraculous, making said person lose or destroy their mental state such as with Monarch during "Evolution".
How Chloé set up her own destruction for her reputation by siding with Hawk Moth during "The Battle of the Miraculous", and later in "Revolution".
She also destroyed any chance she had reconciling her friendships as well as Marinette's confidence with her constant pranking in "Derision".
When the Miraculouses are being used for evil by anyone they become their own form of destruction.

How Gabriel's obsessive love indirectly destroyed everything while Cat Noir did it directly in "Cat Blanc".

Because of their choices, Chloé and Gabriel ended up in a vicious cycle where they indirectly destroyed each other.

The Cat Miraculous represents for people to remember that destruction isn't always bad, there are different kinds or that not everything needs to be physically destroyed to make a difference.
Through the current Cat Miraculous holder, Adrien as Cat Noir,  he used his powers to destroy something when he or Ladybug required to, meaning his destruction was controlled and within reason.

Plagg mentioned in "Miraculous Paris", that destroying can be a good way to start over.
For the case of many akumatized villains, everything they destroyed it was done out of malice, revenge and showing no restraint.

title: Destruction

text:
Destruction - Trivia
In "Collusion" and "Revolution", Andre finally understood that a life of wealth and power was destroying his family and wanted to change his ways.
Despite some holders being bad, but thanks to the guardians and good holders their destruction in some cases is rather limited and other cases like Gabriel it's a temporary fix.
Especially when it came to most of the sentimonsters as they were a physical representative of negative emotions that if not let go of then the people they served would've destroyed themselves.
Throughout the series shows how Gabriel went through the 3 forms of destruction, emotional when he lost Émilie, mental when he couldn't beat Team Miraculous and physical destruction fulfilling the prophecy in "Timetagger".
Like how Shadybug and Claw Noir were emotionally destroyed but through the help of their light counterparts they destroyed their negative parts and gave themselves a new path.
When Adrien was talking about his mother and refusing to let another family end up like his destroyed; he sympathized with those who already lost their loves ones and realized destroying or sacrificing another life would be pointless to fix a problem.

title: Determination
text:
Determination - Intro
"" is a season 5 episode of the series Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. Based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 6th written and produced episode of season 5. It is also the 110th written and produced episode of the series overall.

title: Determination
text:
Determination - Synopsis
Marinette and Adrien wonder about their feelings. While Marinette tries to convince herself that she needs to stop being in love with Adrien because it diverts her from her role as a superhero, she discovers that she has feelings for another boy, who has changed a lot lastly... As for Adrien, he is becoming increasingly interested in Marinette. What if she were more than just a friend? He doesn't know that, by inviting Marinette out, he is about to unleash a whirlwind of feelings that will change their lives…
Disney+
Ladybug and Cat Noir face a viilain… and her 17 goons!
Netflix
Conflicted by her feelings for Adrien, Marinette brings Luka om their museum date. But Monarch disrupts the awkwardness when he akumatizes the curator.

title: Determination
text:
Determination - Plot
The episode begins when Marinette rides her motorcycle to Collège Françoise Dupont, Adrien was shocked to see Marinette take off her helmet with her hair down, Kagami gave Marinette the I Love Unicorns helmet, then Adrien greeted Marinette, and then she left the school. As Kagami talked to him about something Adrien was brooding. In the locker room, Kagami put on her fencing outfit for fencing class, then saw that Adrien was looking at her paintings, however, he looked at the painting with Marinette in it, and then showed Kagami the painting he looked at. Kagami showed Adrien her phone with Marinette's contact open, saying he needs to call her and ask her out.
The next day, Marinette arrives at Liberty to see her other friends to show them her work for the band. Adrien calls her and says his feelings have changed asking to meet. Adrien tells Kagami he asked to meet at the Musée Grévin because that's where his feelings changed. Marinette talks to Luka and tells him how she always makes mistakes when in love with Adrien. He reassures her by telling her to explore her feelings and spend time alone with Adrien. She asks Luka to go with her so she would be less scared.

title: Determination
text:
Determination - Plot
They meet outside along with Adrien and Kagami and meet Véronique the museum curator. She leaves Adrien and the gruop to see mayor Bourgeois. Adrien talks about his feelings and realises he loves Marinette. Kagami and Luka start to leave the room they are in, and Adrien and Marinette follow them.
Véronique meets with mayor Bourgeois to talk about opening her new hall of superheroes. The mayor does not want to open the hall and says it will cause more akumatizations. She argues that it will cause hope instead. He threatens to close the museum. Marinette and Adrien run after Kagami and Luka end they get trapped inside the hall of superheroes together.
In the following scene, Véronique is heartbroken. Monarch senses Veronique's emotions and makes a megakuma, absorbs Kaalki in the ring and uses the power, voyage, to teleport the megakuma to Véronique's location. Véronique temporarily tries to resist the akuma, but Monarch akumatizes her in the end and gives her the power of the Ox Miraculous as Minotaurox's Resistance. Véronique is turned to Manipula and has the power to bring the wax statues to life and recreate the superheroes using her wax statues.

title: Determination
text:
Determination - Plot
Marinette starts to panic after trying to open the metal wall, thinking something will go wrong. Adrien says that it is fine, and he is here. Marinette mixes up her words in saying that he is the problem and makes all sorts of mistakes because of her feeling for Adrien (including losing all the miraculouses in the Season 4 finale). She mentions that I can't tell you anything, while Adrien responds, "You can tell me everything." Manipula smashes the metal wall to the same exhibit Adrien and Marinette are in.
Manipula uses her brochures to bring the superhero wax statues to life. They both hide behind statues. Marinette escapes by making a run for it while Adrien stays hidden. Marinette transforms into Ladybug while the wax heroes run out of the museum. Ladybug follows them and lands on a roof top meeting up with Cat Noir, who apologizes for the delay.

title: Determination
text:
Determination - Plot
Ladybug and Cat Noir catch up to Manipula. Manipula announces that she brought the heroes back and Monarch will renounce evil and that the museum can once again celebrate the superheroes. Ladybug and Cat Noir try to persuade her to reject the megakuma and that Monarch is manipulating her. Monarch then convinces her not to trust Ladybug. She blames Ladybug for losing the miraculous, but Cat Noir supports her. Then, the wax heroes were actually an illusion and the wax statues of Rena Rouge and Vesperia surprise attack from behind but, Ladybug and Cat Noir destroy the statues. Manipula runs away. On top of their heads, it a piece of paper which contains each part of the megakuma. After destroying and realizing all of the strips of paper must be destroyed in order to capture the megakuma, they chase after Manipula. Monarch tells Manipula that he was right that it was Ladybug's fault on losing the miraculouses; thanks to Félix and his treacherous actions as Flairmidable. Manipula announces that Paris has a new superhero.

title: Determination
text:
Determination - Plot
She orders the statues to pair up and get Ladybug and Cat Noir's miraculouses. She enters City Hall and orders mayor Bourgeois to open the hall of superheroes. Chloé tells the mayor not to listen to her. The mayor apologizes to Manipula, saying he can't. She tells the statue Cat Noir to use his cataclysm. She threatens mayor Bourgeois by saying that if he doesn't change his mind, the wax statue Cat Noir will destroy City Hall. Meanwhile, the Minotaurox statue is walking behind her. After defeating the wax statue superheroes, Ladybug and Cat Noir rip up the brochures and capture the parts of the megakuma.

title: Determination
text:
Determination - Plot
They enter City Hall, ready to battle the statue versions of themselves. Cat Noir saves Ladybug just when the fake Cat Noir is about to cataclysm her. Cat Noir helps her up and Ladybug uses her Lucky Charm. She gets a bowling ball. Cat Noir opens the door and meets Manipula. She points to Minotaurox who is about to hit the mayor and Chloé who are whimpering in fear. Ladybug demands that mayor Bourgeois and his daughter be free but Manipula says she will not until the mayor opens the hall of superheroes. Ladybug asks mayor Bourgeois why he won't allow it and Chloé blames Ladybug for losing all the other miraculous because of having Félix to betray her and accepted the deal of wanting the peacock miraculous. Chloé also calls her lame and tells her this would not have happened again if the Bee miraculous was with her to become Queen Bee and would never be replaced by her successor Vesperia and that Ladybug has no choice but to protect her from Manipula.

title: Determination
text:
Determination - Plot
Ladybug looks around, trying to figure out how to use her Lucky Charm but finds nothing. Cat Noir tries to cataclysm the remaining strips of paper but Manipula grabs his wrist and uses Cat Noir's powers on her. Scared he has harmed another person with his superpower, Manipula reveals she is immune to superpowers due to Monarch giving her the power of Resistance. She throws Cat Noir to the Minotaurox statue and he tries to take his ring. Ladybug tries to rescue Cat Noir but is stopped by Manipula. She tries to take Ladybug's earrings but realizes that how to use her Lucky Charm and that Manipula is not invincible. She gets crushed under a chandelier and the rest of the brochures are destroyed and the remaining parts of the megakuma are captured.
Ladybug throws her lucky charm in the air and all of the damage has been undone. Manipula gets deakumatized back into Véronique. Ladybug gives her the magical charm and mayor Bourgeois is convinced by Ladybug to authorize the opening of the hall of superheroes. After that, she admits her true feelings to Cat Noir. They run off and detransform.

title: Determination
text:
Determination - Plot
At the museum, Marinette asks Adrien if it is safe to come out to which he answers yes. Marinette leaves to go home and waves goodbye to Adrien, Kagami and Luka. Kagami asks Adrien if he has figured out how he feels about Marinette and he answers yes. Adrien believes he is falling in love with Marinette and Marinette believes she is falling in love with Cat Noir as the episode ends.

This episode marks the last time Adrien calls out (or otherwise refers to) Marinette with the infamous phrase "She's just a friend".
This also begins a minor arc (at least from Marinette and Adrien's perspective) of the reverse love square unknown to the duo they are still in pursuit of the other.

title: Determination
text:
Determination - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in France on TFOU.
The episode shares its name with the concept of the Ox Miraculous.
It's revealed that Resistance, despite protecting the user from the effects of Miraculous-related superpowers, including Cataclysm, it doesn't work on indirect attacks like a falling chandelier, compared to Shell-ter, a superpower born from the concept of protection that can be destroyed with one hit from Cataclysm.
However both powers are the same to a degree as both protect the user from damage but at different levels as Resistance is used directly on the user while Shell-ter provides protection around the user.
Sometimes resistance doesn't only mean physical but also mental as it checks out the mental state of various characters with hurt feelings or damaged minds.
For Ladybug, she is still hurt over the events of "Strikeback" at the lost of the jewels and depowerment of the team.

title: Determination
text:
Determination - Trivia
As herself, just like every other fan girl, even Kagami, and mentioned by her and Luka, Marinette always had come up with plans to get Adrien's love but always ended in disaster as she said in "Glaciator 2" but unlike the others, Marinette is beginning to distinguish what is real and fake.
Cat Noir is still traumatized over the use of his powers in "Destruction", "Miraculous Paris" and "Jubilation" even to the point of saying the same line when his Cataclysm was used on someone.
Chloé is still continued to harbor a grudge towards Ladybug for the "Miracle Queen" incident and jealously towards the other holders. And Véronique's akumatization and Chloé's depowerment happened for the same reason: she couldn't put her own fears, desires and feelings aside for the sake of the people.
In a way, Chloé was partially right, as had they defeated Hawk Moth back in "Heroes' Day" then the loss of the jewels probably wouldn't have happened. However, she would still have to face surrendering her powers upon the discovery of him having the Peacock Miraculous.

text:
Derision - Intro
"" is a season 5 episode of the series Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. Based on the series's production order specifically, "" is the 14th written and produced episode of season 5. It is also the 118th written and produced episode of the series overall.

title: Derision
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Derision - Synopsis
Just as it seems like Marinette is finally about to have a normal date with Adrien, she strangely starts suffering from repeated panic attacks. She doesn't understand why, and it's starting to jeopardize her relationship with the one she loves. And it creates an emotional situation that could make her the perfect target for Monarch! What if the answer to her problems lay in her own past? Back when Marinette wasn't the Marinette we know today…
Disney+
Marinette's relationship problems may lay in her past.
Netflix
Marinette's panic attacks interfere with her first date with Adrien, and when Monarch senses her fears, she'll need to delve into her past to resist him.

title: Derision
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Derision - Plot
Marinette is asleep in her bedroom when she gets a wake up call from Adrien. He excitedly reminds her that they're going to the swimming pool. Marinette is also excited to go to the pool and see Adrien, but she gets a sharp and unpleasant feeling. Tikki asks her if she's alright, to which Marinette responds that she is. She just feels lightheaded and most likely needs to eat some breakfast to feel better. She tries to eat, but her stomach prevents her from doing so. Her mother Sabine remarks how coincidental it is that her stomach hurts the day she finally goes on a "date" with her crush, embarrassing her daughter. Sabine shares her experiences with stomach butterflies she had when she went on her first date with Tom, now her husband and Marinette's father. The sharp and unpleasant feeling returns again and fades just as quickly. In the process, Marinette spills her meal. She apologizes to her mom for making a mess, Sabine tells her not to worry about it and to go see her love. Marinette thanks her mom and leaves.

title: Derision
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Derision - Plot
Marinette arrives at the pool and greets Adrien, who was already there. He greets her back and offers her his hand. She shyly takes it and the two enter the entrance to the pool. Adrien asked the person at the reception desk how they gain access to the pool, the person responds they have to buy tickets. Marinette again gets a sharp and unpleasant feeling, retracting her hand in fear. Adrien concernedly asks her if she's okay. She nervously assures him she's okay and grabs their armbands so they can change. The sharp and unpleasant feeling comes back once again while Marinette tries to change into her swimsuit. Adrien asks her again if she's doing okay. She fearfully reassures Adrien she's okay, she's just having trouble with her shoelaces and she'll be out soon. Adrien leaves her alone and she starts to hyperventilate. Tikki asks her what's up with her, but Marinette is clueless as to the reason why.

title: Derision
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Derision - Plot
She manages to get changed and tries to work her way down the stairs while holding onto the railing to get to her waiting friend. Kim greets Marinette, returning the sharp and unpleasant feeling. Adrien climbs down the pool ladder, offering Marinette his hand to help her in. She tries to take his hand, but the sharp and unpleasant feeling gets so severe that she storms out on Adrien. Kim asks him what he did to get her to blow up at him like that. Ondine points out Marinette's emotional distress. Kim dismisses this saying Marinette does this every time someone pranks her. He then proceeds to tell Adrien and Ondine about what happened between him and Marinette the previous year, expecting them to find it hilarious. Marinette runs into the changeroom in full panic mode. Monarch seizes the opportunity and sends a megakuma in an attempt to akumatize Marinette into Panic. She resists and tries to remember the source of her panic attack and uncertainty around Adrien.

title: Derision
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Derision - Plot
During the previous school year, Marinette had developed a crush on Kim. However, she hates going to school because of Chloé, a cruel bully who has the teachers wrapped around her finger and the other kids are too afraid of her to help Marinette. She tries to convince her mom to let her stay home, but she lists off the excuses she gave the last few days that she didn't want to go to school. Sabine tries to reassure her daughter she'll be okay, school will be over in two weeks and the chances of Chloé sharing a class with Marinette for the fourth year in a row is slim. Marinette doubts her luck will change and accidentally spills her breakfast.
Marinette runs to the front door of the school, trying to get to class while avoiding Chloé along the way.
She seems to make it to her locker without any issues, but when she opens the locker door, a swarm of bugs spills out and heads straight for her.
She screams and runs away in panic, accidentally knocking over a bucket of water in the girls' bathroom, which causes her to trip and land face-first on the floor.
As she attempts to leave for class, she is stopped by the principal, Mr.

title: Derision
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Derision - Plot
Damoclès, who has been informed by Chloé that Marinette has been out of class without permission.
He orders her to come to his office.
After her conversation with Mr.
Damoclès, Marinette finally makes it to class, only to be scolded by her science teacher, Ms.
Mendeleiev, for being late.
She is instructed to quietly go to her desk.
Marinette reluctantly obeys, but as she sits down, she yelps in pain—she has sat on a paint tube, ruining her favorite pair of pants.
Chloé seizes the opportunity to mock her once again for the prank she pulled earlier.
Marinette accuses Chloé of placing the paint tube on her seat, but Ms.
Mendeleiev shuts her down, reprimanding her for accusing another student without evidence, telling her not to yell, and sending her to the principal's office for her actions.
Once again, Chloé laughs at her misfortune.
Meanwhile, Rose and Juleka give her dirty looks, but she threatens and mocks them back into submission.
Marinette exits the principal's office with an additional three hours of detention on Saturday.
Rose tries to explain Chloé's actions with her absent mother, but Mylène counters her mother left too and she finds no fun in bullying Marinette.

title: Derision
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Derision - Plot
Kim offers Marinette his swimming trunks to replace her ruined pants.
She declines, but is touched by the thought.
Chloé shoos off Marinette's friends, informing her she'll be in the cafeteria to make her life a nightmare.
Socqueline steps in to tell Chloé to leave Marinette alone.
Socqueline tells Marinette that she needs to stand up to Chloé on her own, as Socqueline won't be around to help her much longer as she is graduating.
Socqueline's in the highest grade of the school, and the school year's almost over.
Marinette remarks the teacher's fear of Chloé and shifts her attention to Kim, who's antagonizing Max.
Socqueline's in disbelief that her friend could have a crush on Kim, asking her what she sees in him.
Marinette believes she likes him for his kindness.
Socqueline thinks she's confusing kindness for foolishness.
Marinette decides to invite Kim to go to the swimming pool with her.
Unfortunately for her, Sabrina, Chloé's minion, overhears and tells Chloé about it.
She talks to Kim about Marinette's plans and tricks him into playing a prank on her.
Marinette and Socqueline get on a bus headed for the pool.
Socqueline asks Marinette her intentions.

title: Derision
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Derision - Plot
Marinette shares her plans: if all goes well and there's a moment that's right, she intends to confess her feelings to Kim.
Marinette says goodbye to Socqueline and leaves for the pool.
Socqueline stops the bus to be nearby, just in case her friend needs her.
Marinette and Kim have a splendid time at the pool, enough that Marinette decides to reveal her love for Kim.
In response, Kim presents her with a gift that has spiders in it, freaking Marinette out and sending her hurtling to the pool below.
Chloé manipulated Kim into doing this so she could humiliate Marinette on social media by recording the entire thing and posting it on the internet.
A livid Socqueline, who obviously followed Marinette, and as such, saw everything, angrily destroys Chloé's phone with the recording on it out of outrage before Chloé can post it online.
Kim, not understanding what he did, goes to Marinette, expecting her to find his prank funny.
A revolted Socqueline shoos him away being furious about what he and Chloé did and disgusted by their shamelessness, retorting he should be ashamed of himself.
Kim dismisses her, believing it was just a joke.

title: Derision

text:

Marinette is traumatized from this experience, changing her outlook on love.
From that point onward, she decides she has to know everything about anyone she falls in love with and make sure they're not friends with Chloé.
The next day at school, Chloé tries to get Socqueline suspended from school out of spite for breaking her phone, preventing her from having new fuel for tormenting Marinette.
She argues Socqueline attacked her.
Mr.
Damoclès tells Chloé due to it happening off school property, he can't do anything.

Damoclès with her dad, the mayor.
Mr.
Damoclès suspends Socqueline for the rest of the school year.
Socqueline tries to protest, but Chloé has the principal wrapped around her finger.
Marinette catches Socqueline before she leaves, remorseful things ended up this way.
Socqueline tells her to keep fighting and doing the right thing.
With that, she leaves.
Back in the present, Marinette's revelation breaks her free from the akumatization, forcing Monarch to retrieve his megakuma.
Meanwhile, Kim finishes his story with Ondine, while Adrien is furious with him for his actions.

title: Derision
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Derision - Plot
Kim shrugs off their anger, focusing instead on the supposed hilarity of the situation and his admiration for Chloé, which only fuels Adrien's frustration as Ondine calls Kim out for his cruel behavior.
Unrepentant, Kim believes he did nothing wrong and swims away in anger.
Monarch senses Kim's feelings of rejection and sends the megakuma after him.
He names him Dark Humor, the evolved form of Dark Cupid, and grants him the power of the Monkey Miraculous.
Kim then transforms into Dark Humor.
Excitedly, Marinette rushes to tell Adrien about her recent revelation but is stopped in her tracks by the sight of Dark Humor.
A lifeguard suddenly appears, barking at Dark Humor to stop flying above the pool.
Adrien quickly grabs Marinette's arm and pulls her away.
Dark Humor summons a rubber ducky on the tip of his arrow and shoots it at the lifeguard.
The lifeguard decides to drain the pool, thinking that people jumping into an empty pool would be funny.
Ondine disagrees, believing it's dangerous.
Dark Humor, thinking she lacks a sense of humor, shoots at her as well.
In the chaos, Adrien hides Marinette in her changeroom and goes to get help.

title: Derision

text:
Derision - Plot
Seizing the opportunity, Marinette transforms into Ladybug.
Meanwhile, Adrien hides in his changeroom to transform into Cat Noir.
At the Jardin des Tuileries, Ondine swings her pool noodle at toy boats in the fountain, sinking them and making their owners cry.
Dark Humor asks the kids where their sense of humor is and shoots at two of them.
Ladybug and Cat Noir use their miraculous-tools to defend Dark Humor's targets.
Cat Noir, full of hatred and rage for Kim, attacks Dark Humor recklessly, spouting off about his lack of awareness to those he hurts.
Ladybug tries to calm her partner down, but he's too focused on defeating Dark Humor.
He wails on the akumatized supervillain with his staff and then activates his Cataclysm, trying to use it on Dark Humor.
Unthankfully, he's stopped by Ladybug's yo-yo.
Dark Humor takes the distraction to strike Cat Noir with one of his arrows, turning his Cataclysm into a ball generator and Cat Noir into an even bigger goofball than usual.
Ladybug attempts to use her Lucky Charm, but Dark Humor shoots her yo-yo, turning it into a balloon and rendering her unable to use her Lucky Charm.

title: Derision
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Derision - Plot
Cat Noir notices the balloon and knocks into Dark Humor's way, obstructing his vision and giving Ladybug the chance to detransform behind a pillar and retransform, restoring her ability to activate her Lucky Charm.
It gives her a toilet bowl.
Ladybug grabs a glue tube, evading the rain of arrows, but seemingly gets hit by one of Dark Humor's arrows.
In reality, she faked getting hit, as it's part of her plan.
She squirts out some glue into the toilet bowl and emerges from her hiding spot acting as if she was hit by one of Dark Humor's arrows.
Ladybug spots Cat Noir, and pretends to want to put the toilet bowl on his head.
She chases Cat Noir and lures Dark Humor into chasing her.
When he's close enough, she turns around and plants the toilet bowl on his noggin.
Ladybug questions Dark Humor's sense of humor while Cat Noir taunts him.
Ladybug tosses her yo-yo, wrapping its string around the toilet bowl and pulls, shattering it and bringing Dark Humor's eye reticle with it.
Ladybug then breaks it with her yo-yo, releasing the megakuma.
She de-evilizes the megakuma, releases it, and throws part of her Lucky Charm in the air, activating her Miraculous Ladybug.

title: Derision

It reverts those hit by Dark Humor's arrows back to normal and fixes the mess the battle made.
Dark Humor deakumatizes into Kim, who asks what happened.
Ladybug tells him Monarch used his emotions to manipulate him.
She opens her yo-yo, pulling out a magical charm to give to Kim, telling him to keep it with him to remind him not to make the same mistakes.
Cat Noir apologizes for his rash behavior earlier.
Ladybug reminds him that's why there's two of them: to keep the other in check.
The two heroes pound it, signifying a job well done.

title: Derision
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Derision - Plot
Back at the pool, Kim expresses remorse for the actions he committed as Dark Humor, but Ondine replies he still does bad actions as himself by saying that Marinette liked him and he ended up breaking her heart. He tries to defend himself, pleading ignorance, but Ondine retorts that just because he didn't know, doesn't mean the pain he caused Marinette was any less real. Kim realizes Ondine is right about how his pranks can have consequences and vows to change his ways. He apologizes to Marinette for his actions, to which she accepts. Ondine rejoices at her love's growth. Outside the pool, Marinette is able to share with Adrien why she gets so nervous around him: she's afraid of getting hurt again like she was by Chloé's manipulation of Kim. Adrien shares with Marinette that he's scared too: of doing something wrong, hurting her, someone else hurting her, and scared of losing her. But Adrien believes that together, they will help each other, no matter what. He reaches his hand out for Marinette to grab, she holds it, but lets go and apologies, as she's not ready for that yet. Adrien tells her they have time and they go their separate ways for the time being.

title: Derision
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Derision - Plot
Later that day, Adrien visits Chloé at Le Grand Paris to confront her about the heinous deeds she did to Marinette last year. He demands that she apologize to Marinette for the cruel way she treated her, insisting that Marinette would forgive Chloé and that it would be a sign of her ability to change. Chloé, however, shows no concern for the harm she has caused and dismisses the situation, expressing that she views people like Marinette as doormats who exist solely for her amusement. Meanwhile, Sabrina continues to paint her nails reluctantly, feeling disgusted by her "best friend's" attitude since Chloé treats her like a doormat too. Adrien is deeply troubled by what Chloé has done to Marinette and Socqueline over time, as well as by her egotistical selfishness. Despite the multiple chances he, Ladybug, Cat Noir, and others have given her to improve, Adrien finally realizes that people like Chloé will likely never change. Firmly, he tells her that they will never be friends again, bringing their friendship to an end as he leaves. In response, Chloé hypocritically calls him a traitor behind his back.

text:
Derision - Plot Development
Through Marinette's flashback, several things about the characters in the previous school year are revealed:
Marinette used to be in love with Kim, adoring him the same way she now adores Adrien, having had pictures of him around her room and going to the pool watch him swimming.
It is also explored how much she used to be bullied by Chloé, being her main target. She was always suffering with Chloé's cruel and humiliating pranks and couldn't be friends with other students who, despite wanting to be her friends, were pressured by Chloé to be away from her. In order to avoid Chloé, Marinette was constantly trying to get excuses to not go to school and would be late to classes as Chloé always warned Principal Damoclès about it, causing her to get detention.
Since they've been classmates for four years, it's unknown if Chloé also pranked Marinette the last two years too, but judging by Chloé's previous actions and behaviors, it's not too far a stretch to say this is the case.

In fact, the reason why Marinette used to wear a pair of blue jeans that were her favorite, but they were ruined due to one of Chloé's pranks in which she had green paint all over her seat in her class. This prank is similar to the one in "Stoneheart", in which Chloé tried placing her chewing gum on Marinette's seat.
The flashback also shows how the characters appeared in the previous class photo seen in "Reflekta"; Marinette, during eighth grade, was in the same class as Chloé for three years, as well as Sabrina, Rose, Juleka, Max, Kim and Nathaniel all sharing their eight grade homeroom and science classes. Meanwhile, Mylène was in a different set of classes.
It is also hinted that the reason why Marinette uses pigtails as her hairstyle during the ninth grade is because she wants to have the same confidence Socqueline has, and in a way, be able to stand up against Chloé.
Kim used to be even more childish and naive than he is now, as he used to play much more pranks on people than he does now and would fall much easier for Chloé's manipulation.

If it wasn't for Chloé's harsh prank, Marinette and Adrien's friendship and relationship could've started off better.
Socqueline, who used to study at Collège Françoise Dupont as a ninth grader at that time, was the only person Chloé was scared of, as she was not intimidated by her and would always defend Marinette from her.
Because of her actions defending Marinette after Chloé filmed her falling for Kim's prank by breaking Sabrina's phone, where the video was recorded and stored, Socqueline was suspended for the remaining two weeks of that school year, missing the end-of-the-year party and graduation.

This is writer Mélanie Duval's favorite episode of the series.
The episode shares its name with the concept of the Monkey Miraculous.
The superpower Uproar is shown being used to turn people wild and start mocking others, however, it's possible that was a result of it being mixed with Dark Humor's power, as Dark Cupid can change other people's feelings.
Besides the use of its superpower, its concept, derision, defined as regard with mockery, is also applied throughout the episode:
Kim is revealed to have a tendency to play cruel pranks on people without realizing how he hurts people's feelings with them, with one in particular being the reason why Marinette panics whenever she tries to declare her love for Adrien.
It is shown how Chloé used to bully Marinette by playing cruel and humiliating pranks on her, mocking her afterwards and even manipulating others to do the same. Not just that, but she also forced others to not be friends with her with the threat of targeting them as well.
The people hit by Dark Humor's arrows are forced to play cruel pranks on others.

Similar to "Hack-San", his anger came from the pain of feeling a loved one hurt or in danger this time being Marinette unknown to him that she and Ladybug are the same person.

title: Derision
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Derision - Trivia
This is the seventh time where a Lucky Charm object breaks, excluding the broken plate in "Troublemaker" followed by "Robostus", "Weredad", "Miraculer", "Psycomedian", "Hack-San" and "Miraculous Paris".
This is the third time where Ladybug breaks the Lucky Charm object herself, following "Miraculer" and "Psycomedian".
Errors
Kim uses spiders in his prank on Marinette. However, in "Darkblade", he admits to Marinette that he is afraid of spiders and that's what Chloé used to keep him from running for class representative.
However, it's possible that his fear of spiders may have been formed in the between, as the prank was done when he was an eighth grader and he tried to run for class representative during his ninth grade.
What Kim says is that Chloé "threatened to tell everyone I'm afraid of spiders." Whether it's true that Kim is afraid of spiders is not relevant, only that people thinking it's true will embarrass Kim.
When Ondine destroys the boats, the mouth of the blonde hair girl is strangely shaped.
When Ladybug and Cat Noir were defending civilians, one of the mother's eyes were briefly yellow instead of brown.

title: Derision
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Derision - Trivia
In one of the flashback scenes, after Marinette accidentally knocks down her bowl of cereal, she's shown to have her earrings on, even though this flashback takes place a year prior to getting her miraculous.
When Socqueline kicks Chloé's phone, her eyes are white.
In one of the scenes where Ladybug is chasing Cat Noir, trying to get Dark Humor to follow her, her suit is a mix of her normal and upgraded suit. None of the sections of it are black, but she's got her new hairstyle and the ladybug zipper.
In the flashback some scene in the flashback the rubber band that ties Marinette bun can be seen in some scene and some scene it just disappears.
After the scene when Monarch transferred Xuppu to Kim, his hand appeared out of nowhere.
When Ladybug is figuring out how to use the Lucky Charm and sees the arrow that Dark Humor had shot, the arrow disappears in the last frame.
After Marinette enters the science classroom after coming back from Principal's office, Nathaniel is sat next to a brown haired boy.  After Marinette sits on the stool though, Nathaniel is sat next to a red haired boy.
