title: Derision/Transcript
text:
Derision/Transcript - Intro
[ Theme Song ]
Marinette: Adrien?
Adrien: (on the phone) Good morning, Marinette! I was just going to tell you how excited I am that we're meeting at the swimming pool later, and to wake you up just in case you were still sleeping.
Marinette: (heartily laughs) Good call! I'm super excited, too.
(As she ended the call, she suddenly gets lost hold of her phone, dropping it on her bed. Her hands start shaking, her heart beating faster upon the vision of a school locker door.)
Tikki: Everything okay, Marinette...?
Marinette: Y-Yeah! I'm just feeling a little lightheaded, Tikki. I'll feel better after I grab some breakfast.
(In the kitchen, Marinette timidly mixes the cereal in her bowl.)
Sabine: Aren't you going to eat, sweetie?
Marinette: My stomach feels kinda yucky.
Sabine: On the morning you happen to finally have a real date with Adrien?
Marinette: Mom...! (continues to feebly mix the cereal on her bowl)
Sabine: It's not surprising. I'm sure those butterflies are just like the ones I had on my very first date with your father.

title: Derision/Transcript
text:
Derision/Transcript - Intro
(As Sabine continues to talk to Marinette, Marinette begins to have visions of that one school locker once again and unconsciously spilling milk on the table.)
Marinette: Oh! Sorry, sorry, sorry! (puts the spoon in her bowl) I don't know what's wrong with me today.
Sabine: Let me take care of it. (starts wiping the table with a sponge) Go to the swimming pool and meet your Adrien.
Marinette: (gives Sabine a kiss) Thanks, Mom.
Marinette: Good morning!
Adrien: Good morning!
(He reaches out his hand to Marinette, in which she takes it with a slight hesitation. The two of them enter the swimming pool together, hand in hand. They stop by the reception.)
Adrien: Good morning, ma'am! How do we get in?
Receptionist: You have to buy tickets, young man.
Adrien: Then, two tickets, please.
(Glancing at a shelf nearby, Marinette sees a picture of Kim and Ondine, which causes her to have visions of the school locker again and lets go of Adrien's hand in panic.)
Adrien: You're shaking. Are you sure you're alright?
Marinette: I-I'm okay— I'm fine! I love the swimming pool!

title: Derision/Transcript
text:
Derision/Transcript - Intro
(She hastily takes the two bracelets on the counter. They proceed to the dressing room, with worry drawn on Adrien's face. As Marinette enters a cubicle, she puts down her bag, unzipping it, and the vision of the school locker haunts her once again, causing her to hyperventilate, slowly going down on her knees.)
Adrien: (knocking on Marinette's cubicle) Marinette, everything okay?
Marinette: Yeah, I just have a problem with my shoelaces. Go ahead, I'll meet you there.
(Adrien walks away from her cubicle, while Marinette breaks down inside, taking heavy breaths.)
Tikki: Marinette, what's going on with you?
Marinette: (breathes heavily) I don't know. I feel strange...
(By the stairs, Marinette is seen wearing her swimsuit and climbs down shakily with both hands holding the rails. Adrien, Kim and Ondine sees her.)
Kim: (waves by the pool) Over here! Marinette!
(Marinette starts to panic even worse upon the sight of Kim, with the visions of the school locker continues to haunt her again.)
Adrien: (to Marinette, as he climbs down the pool) Need a hand?

title: Derision/Transcript
text:
Derision/Transcript - Intro
(Reaching her hand out to Adrien, the school locker that's been haunting her opens which appears to be full of a swarm of bees. Marinette screams to this sight and runs away in panic and fear.)
Adrien: Marinette! What's wrong?
Marinette: Leave me alone! I need to be by myself and... stop pretending to be so nice to me! (runs up the stairs)
Kim: (laughs and swims towards the edge of the pool) Woah, Adrien, that must've been some prank you pulled to make Marinette freak out like that. What did you do to her?
Ondine: (comes out of the pool) It's not funny, Kim! Can't you see Marinette's not okay?!
Kim: Oh, come on. She always reacts like that when someone pranks her.
Ondine: What on earth are you talking about?!
Kim: Right. You guys wouldn't know. (swims a lap and swims back to Adrien and Ondine) Let me explain, you'll see; it's hilarious! It was last year, when Marinette and I were in eighth grade.
(In the dressing rooms, Marinette enters one of the cubicle and slams the door shut, taking heavy breaths.)
Marinette: What's wrong with me?! I'm destroying everything I've ever wanted!
(A portal appears in front of her, a Megakuma emerging from it and lands on Marinette's bracelet.)

title: Derision/Transcript
text:
Derision/Transcript - Intro
Monarch: (from his lair) Panic, I am Monarch. I have sensed your distress. It's a terrible thing when emotions get so strong that you lose control of your physical being. If you want, I can give you the power...
Marinette: (voiceover) This can't be happening... I've got to pull myself together! I have to figure out why I get like this every time I get close to Adrien! Otherwise, I'm gonna fall apart!
Kim: Three, two, one... go!
(Kim and Ondine jump into the pool.)
Kim: I'm catching up to you! I'm catching up to you!
Ondine: In your dreams! Even with a motor in your swimsuit, you'd still be slower than me!
(From a distance, a lovesick Marinette is wringing her hair while looking at Kim, who is being splashed with water by Ondine.)
Sabine: Aren't you eating, sweetie?
Marinette: I have a tummy ache. Can't I stay home today?
Sabine: Hmm... Yesterday, your foot hurt, and the day before that, it was your head. Come on, chin up. You only have two weeks of school left with her. She probably won't even be in your class next year.

title: Derision/Transcript
text:
Derision/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Three years in a row, Mom. Why would my luck change now? (stands up from the table and bumps her cereal bowl, spilling milk on the table, her clumsiness thriving yet again, to which Sabine simply smiles)
Denis Damoclès: Classes started ten minutes ago, yet you're still roaming the hallways! This is the eighth time this week! Good thing an anonymous student warned me every time you're about to break the rules... (whispers to himself) I wonder who that mysterious Chloé could be... Anyhow, my office now, Miss Dupain-Cheng!
(Marinette follows with her head down.)
Ms. Mendeleiev: (sarcastic) Congratulations! Another two weeks like this and you'll set a new school record for the number of tardies in my class this year. Now go to your desk. Quietly.
(Marinette closes the door and walks to her table.)
Chloé: What's with the even-more-depressing-than-usual face, Dupain-Cheng? Something bugging you?
(Sabrina chuckles. Just as Marinette sits on her chair, she feels something gooey which turns out that someone spilled paint on her seat. The class looks at her, causing Marinette to feel humiliated. Chloé laughs at this sight.)

title: Derision/Transcript
text:
Derision/Transcript - Intro
Chloé: She wants to design clothes yet she can't even keep hers clean!
Sabrina: Wow, Chloé, you really put a stain on her character!
Chloé: Shush! If I'm not the one who's said it, it's not funny.
Marinette: Chloé, this was another one of your dirty tricks!
Ms. Mendeleiev: Not only are you late and wasting everyone's time running around, now you're groundlessly accusing one of your classmates? Why don't you go and see what the Principal thinks of this?
Marinette: But I just came back from his office!
Ms. Mendeleiev: Well, go back!
(Marinette begins her walk of shame once again.)
Chloé: And to think the day is just getting started! (notices Rose glaring at her) What's your problem? You wanna play with some paint, too? (Rose looks away. She sees Juleka glaring at her as well) What about you? Is there something you want to tell me? Other than (mocks Juleka) ah-dah-dah-duh-duh? (laughs as Juleka looks away too)
(Marinette peeks through the door, worry drawn on her face, and closes it.)
Marinette: (as she goes down the stairs) I just got three more hours of detention on Saturday, and it's all because of Chloé.

title: Derision/Transcript
text:
Derision/Transcript - Intro
Rose: Don’t be mad at her. She's this way because her mother left her when she was young.
Mylène: So did mine! And you don't see me having fun bullying Marinette. We've got to do something about your pants. I'm afraid they might be ruined for good.
Marinette: Oh— They were my favorite pair...
Kim: (off-screen) You can have my swimming trunks if you'd like!
Marinette: (blushes and titters) Thanks, but swimming trunks are for swimming pools. It'd be weird to be wearing them in the school yard.
Chloé: (off-screen) Out of the way, you parasites! I warned you: no talking to the baker girl!
Rose: (whispers as the three of them walk away) We'll talk in the cafeteria.
Marinette: The only place she never goes to, for now.
Chloé: (to Kim) Parasite means you, too, goldfish brain!
Kim: Oh, thanks! That's nice! (leaves)
Chloé: I have big news for you, Dupain-Cheng! Starting now, there will be no rest for you, not even in the cafeteria! I'll be there to make your life a nightmare!
(Socqueline scares Chloé off with what seems to be almost a kick, foot poised near Chloé's face.)
Socqueline: I've warned you, Bourgeois! You leave Marinette alone!

title: Derision/Transcript
text:
Derision/Transcript - Intro
Chloé: Hmmm... you can't even have fun with people in peace these days!
Socqueline: Marinette, I promised your mom I'd keep an eye on you, but I can't be around all the time. And next year, I won't even be here anymore! You've gotta learn to stand up to Chloé!
Marinette: Well, even the teachers are afraid of her. And the semester's almost over... Hopefully, next year we won't be in the same class again.
(Marinette gazes at Kim, who is bullying Max with his glasses.)
Socqueline: Don't tell me you're crushing on this dingbat?
Marinette: Why not? He's nice, funny... and kinda cute!
Socqueline: And are you going to do something about this, for a change?
Marinette: You're right, I've gotta do something. I know! I could ask him out to the swimming pool after school, what do you think?
(Socqueline glares at Kim, who snatches Max's glasses back and wears it on him.)
Max: No! Stop! (leaves)
Kim: C'mon, Max! Laugh a little!
Socqueline: I think you might be confusing kindness for foolery, Marinette.
Marinette: You're being too hard on him.
Socqueline: Be careful, Marinette.

title: Derision/Transcript
text:
Derision/Transcript - Intro
(Meanwhile, Sabrina spies on the conversation between Socqueline and Marinette. She approaches Chloé, who gives her a scoop on Marinette's plan.)
Sabrina: (whispering) Looks like Kim and Marinette will be at the swimming pool...
(Chloé's mischievous grin grows as she sets her gaze upon Marinette and Kim.)
Marinette: I'll see you tonight then!
Chloé: So... I heard Marinette asked you to go with her to the swimming pool.
Kim: Yeah, we're going swimming together. Cool! 'Cause I love to swim!
Chloé: That's not why she asked you, dummy!
Kim: It's not? Then, what are we going to do?
Chloé: She wants to declare her feelings for you!
Kim: For me? But why?
Chloé: Probably because she's utterly ridiculous, and so are you, which makes you two perfect for each other!
Kim: Oh? You think so?! But, uh... if we're not swimming, then... what are we supposed to do when we're together?
Chloé: What do you like to do besides swimming?
Kim: Uh... I like to laugh!
Chloé: Well, there you go! That's what you're gonna do: laugh! Because I've got a great idea for a super funny practical joke!
(Chloé whispers her little scheme to Kim.)
Kim: You sure she'll like it?
Chloé: She'll LOVE it.

title: Derision/Transcript
text:
Derision/Transcript - Intro
Kim: (chuckles) Awesome! You're just too funny, Chloé!
Chloé: You know me, an absolute scream!
Socqueline: So... you're going just like that? What are you gonna say to him?
Marinette: I don't know... I'll just see if we're having a good time, and if I feel like the moment's right at some point, I'll just tell him how I feel, that's it. This isn't Taekwondo, Socqueline! We're just going to the swimming pool. I don't need to have a plan or go over my every move.
(Socqueline looks worried. The bus arrives at the swimming pool stop, and Marinette gives Socqueline a kiss on the cheek.)
Marinette: I'll tell you how it went tomorrow!
Socqueline: Right...
(Marinette gets off the bus, leaving Socqueline perturbed. Marinette runs towards the entrance of the swimming pool, right after the bus leaves. Back in the bus, after a few contemplations, Socqueline presses the stop button and gets off as well.)
Marinette: You know, Kim, I think you're really funny... and nice... and sweet, too. And I... I think I'd like us to be more than friends.

title: Derision/Transcript
text:
Derision/Transcript - Intro
Kim: You do? (smiles and gets on his knees, presenting a tiny box) Oh, Marinette, when you're around, I feel like I'm in a dream, as if I were swimming in the awesomest ocean! I'd give you every pool floaty in the world if I could! But all I have is this tiny... thing. (smiles nervously)
Marinette: (smiles and blushes) Oh, Kim! (stands up, grabbing the tiny box and looks at Kim lovingly for a moment) I love you!
(As soon as Marinette opens the tiny box, a bunch of spiders crawl out, reaching for her arms. She starts screaming and drops the box, while Kim bursts into laughter.)
Kim: Chloé was right, spiders are hilarious!
(As more spiders crawl in on her feet, Marinette keeps screaming while trying to wipe the spiders off her arms, and tries to back away, leading to her to fall backwards into the water. Mid-way, she sees Chloe and Sabrina taking a video of her from one of the balconies, in slow motion, right before she plunges into the water. The lifeguard helps her out of the pool and calls out the duo who flees from the scene laughing.)
Lifeguard: Hey! You two!

title: Derision/Transcript
text:
Derision/Transcript - Intro
Chloé: From this day on, your life will be an endless torment, Dupain-Cheng! (replays the video clip of Marinette falling down the pool on the phone) Even if you spent your whole life locked in your room, you'd still be the star of Shame TV on social media every day!
(As Chloé continues to laugh off her triumph, Socqueline appears and swiftly kicks the phone out of Chloé's hands and steps on it, breaking the device. Socqueline scowls at the intimidated Chloé and Sabrina right after.)
Kim: (off-screen) So, that was hilarious, right? I'm cracking up! (laughs)
Socqueline: (pushes Kim away) You! Go away! You should be ashamed of yourself!
Kim: Come on! It was just a practical joke! (walks away)
(Marinette opens the door and breaks down as she sees Socqueline.)
Marinette: (sobs) I will never, ever fall in love again!
Socqueline: It wasn't your fault, Marinette.

title: Derision/Transcript
text:
Derision/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Yes, it was! You were right! I should've known, been more prepared... I should've had a plan! I should've been careful! (wipes her tears as her face shifts to anger) I'll never tell another boy that I love him before I know (slams the door with her fist) everything about him! Whether he's kind or not, thoughtful, what he does outside of school and with who, I'll know everything, his birthday, all his first names, his schedule, his favorite things! And above all, I'll make sure that he is NOT friends with Chloé! (breaks down and hugs Socqueline)
Chloé: And then, for no reason at all, she attacked me with her ugly little feet! Fortunately, by some incredible stroke of luck, I didn't get hit! (Socqueline facepalms.) Then, I had to witness the massacre of an innocent phone!
Denis Damoclès: (clears throat) I'm afraid there's not much I can do. All of this happened in an extra-curricular setting, outside the school premises... and it wasn't even your phone!
Chloé: (nods) Oh, I understand... (pulls out her phone) Luckily, when Daddy finds out how incompetent you are, he'll appoint a new principal with a greater sense of justice!

title: Derision/Transcript
text:
Derision/Transcript - Intro
Denis Damoclès: Uh— Come now, Miss Bourgeois, we don't want to bother the Mayor for something so minor! Socqueline, you're hereby suspended for two weeks!
Socqueline: (objects, getting on her feet quickly) But that means until the end of the year! What about the class council? What about the prom?
(Chloé, being victorious, gives Socqueline a menacing grin.)
Chloé: Good riddance.
Marinette: (off-screen) Socqueline, wait! (catches up to Socqueline, who then stops walking upon hearing Marinette) I'm sorry. This is all my fault. It's not fair you're being punished because of me!
Socqueline: (places her hands on Marinette's shoulder) Every good fight is worth fighting. We shouldn't be influenced by our chances of winning, but by whether or not it's the right thing to do! (starts walking away) Remember, Marinette: you gotta know when to step in; that's the only way you can change things in life!
Marinette: (laughs triumphantly) I know why I'm so afraid!
(Back at the pool, Adrien and Ondine are furious of Kim's backstory.)
Ondine: You did THAT to Marinette?!

title: Derision/Transcript
text:
Derision/Transcript - Intro
Kim: Just like Chloé said: when you like a girl, you get on one knee, compliment her and give her jewelry! Except that time, it wasn't for real! It was just a practical joke! (laughs and sighs) Chloé is the prettiest girl in the world and the funniest, too...
(Kim smiles. However, Adrien is none too pleased at all with Kim’s actions and is about to throw hands, clenching his fist in great rage.)
Ondine: (enraged) How could you say that in front of me and do such awful things to Marinette?! Your behavior is cruel and unacceptable!
Kim: (a bit frustrated) Come on! Loosen up, you guys! It's like you can't even speak your mind these days. (scoffs)
Ondine: That doesn't give you permission to hurt other people!
Kim: Whatever! I'm the way I am and I'm fine that way! It's not my fault you guys have no sense of humor! (Adrien and Ondine scowl angrily at Kim as he dives in the pool and swims away, looking very angry.)
Monarch: A free spirit feeling unjustly rejected? As an ardent defender of freedom of oppression, it is my duty to help him! Voyage, my Megakuma! (the Megakuma enters the portal, leading it back to the swimming pool)

title: Derision/Transcript
text:
Derision/Transcript - Intro
Monarch: (from his lair) Dark Humor, I am Monarch. We should be able to laugh at anything and anyone. That's why I'm giving you the power to win people over with your unique sense of humor! Xuppu, (Xuppu's pod hovers towards Monarch) your power is now mine! (absorbs his power) Transfer! (taps on his ring and transmits the power of the Monkey Miraculous to Kim) Of course, the spoilsport Ladybug and Cat Noir will try to knock some sense into you. But thanks to the essence of the Miraculous of Derision that I'm also giving you, you will be able to seize their Miraculous!
Kim: At least you get my sense of humor! (succumbs to the akumatization and transforms into Dark Humor)
(Back at the dressing rooms, Marinette finally comes out with confidence.)
Marinette: Adrien! I know what's wrong with me! (goes down the stairs) It's not my fault, and it's not your fault, either! It's all Chloé's fault!
Dark Humor: So, all you wet blankets, ready to learn to have fun?
Marinette, Adrien and Ondine: Kim?!
Lifeguard: Hey, you! There's no flying in the pool!
Adrien: (takes Marinette's hand and runs away to put her to safety) This way!

title: Derision/Transcript
text:
Derision/Transcript - Intro
Dark Humor: Aw, it's like you can't do anything anymore! (shoots his arrow with a rubber duck tip at the lifeguard)
Lifeguard: I'm going to drain the pool! It'll be hilarious when people dive in! (runs away)
Ondine: That's not funny at all! It's seriously dangerous!
Dark Humor: Why aren't you laughing? Where's your sense of humor? (shoots Ondine with an arrow)
(In one of the dressing rooms, Adrien puts Marinette to safety.)
Adrien: Stay here. I'm going to get help! (closes the door)
Marinette: (gasps) At least when we're running away hand in hand, I don't shake like a leaf! Tikki, spots on! (transforms into Ladybug)
(Adrien proceeds to hide in another dressing room.)
Adrien: Kim's gone WAY too far! Plagg, claws out! (transforms into Cat Noir)
Ondine: Bullseye! Direct hit! What?! Don’t you like playing battleships? (continues to hit the ships on the fountain with a pipe as the children start crying)
Dark Humor: Why aren't you laughing? Where's your sense of humor? (shoots arrows at the children and gets blocked right on time by Ladybug and Cat Noir)

title: Derision/Transcript
text:
Derision/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: (with immense anger) Can't you pick on someone your own size?! Do you have no shame at all?! (attempts to hit Dark Humor with his staff)
Ladybug: Cat Noir, calm down. We just need to destroy the akumatized object. You're gonna hurt him!
Cat Noir: And he'd deserve it! (continuously beats Dark Humor with his staff out of anger and tackles him on the ground) We'll see if you're still laughing after I wiped that smile from your face with my... Cataclysm!
Ladybug: (stops Cat Noir by wrapping her yo-yo around his wrist) No! What's happening to you?
(And as the heroes are both distracted, Dark Humor takes the opportunity to touch Cat Noir with one of his arrows, to which Dark Humor laughs maniacally and triumphantly. Now under the influence of Dark Humor, Cat Noir's Cataclysm harnesses balls instead of destructive energy.)
Cat Noir: (skips around like a child) I don't know about you, but I'm having a ball! (produces tiny balls all over the area...) Sorry you have to bounce so soon! (...which causes people to slip off their feet)
[Superpower Sequence]
Ladybug: Lucky Charm!
(Dark Humor disrupts Ladybug's Lucky Charm by shooting an arrow and turning it into a balloon.)
Ladybug: No!

title: Derision/Transcript
text:
Derision/Transcript - Intro
(Dark Humor laughs.)
Monarch: (from his lair) This is where your luck runs out, Ladybug!
Cat Noir: (as he continues to scatter tiny balls around the area) Balloon? YAY! Come on, buddy! Let's play ball! (tosses the balloon towards Dark Humor, blocking his sight)
Dark Humor: H-Hey!
Ladybug: (after hiding behind a pillar) Spots off! (de-transforms...)
Marinette: Spots on! (...and transforms back to reactivate her power)
Ladybug: Lucky Charm!
Dark Humor: Wait! How did she do that?!
Monarch: (from his lair) She had time to transform back and forth, you fool!
(Ladybug receives a toilet bowl.)
Dark Humor: (laughs) What's with that? Is nature calling?
(He shoots an arrow at Ladybug as she flips back to dodge it. Ladybug then uses her Lucky Vision: looking at the toilet bowl, at Cat Noir who is still skipping around, the arrow that Dark Humor just shot,...)
Parisian kid: Heheh, I know how to keep people glued to their seats! (glues a seat and runs away)
(...a glue tube that a child left on a bench at a distance, and an arc to one of the wings near the museum.)
Ladybug: That's right, nature's calling me to kick your butt!

title: Derision/Transcript
text:
Derision/Transcript - Intro
(Dark Humor continues to shoot arrows at Ladybug as she makes her run to execute her plan. She dodges the arrows one by one but then makes a mishap as one of the arrows makes her lose balance, but makes it to where she was going anyway...)
Dark Humor: I got her?!
(...Hiding by the arc, she applies glue in the toilet bowl, and comes out pretending she got hit by one of Dark Humor's arrows.)
Ladybug: Hahahah! It's my turn to laugh now!
Dark Humor: Ladybug! Make way for Ladygag! (laughs)
(Cat Noir is seen juggling the tiny balls.)
Ladybug: Cat Noir! Yoo-hoo! Here, kitty-kitty! (does multiple attempts to place the toilet bowl on top of Cat Noir's head as a diversion)
Cat Noir: Ew! Are you out of your mind?!
Ladybug: What's wrong? Where's your sense of humor? Would you prefer a litter box? (laughs)
Dark Humor: Hahah! Good one, Ladygag!
Monarch: (from his lair) You got them both! Bravo, Dark Humor! Now all you have to do is to take their Miraculous!
(Dark Humor flies to chase after Ladybug and Cat Noir.)
Ladybug: (chuckles as she runs after Cat Noir) Sit, kitty! The potty's just getting started!

title: Derision/Transcript
text:
Derision/Transcript - Intro
(Dark Humor closely reaches for Ladybug's earrings, and as Ladybug notices him behind her, she puts the toilet bowl on Dark Humor's head.)
Dark Humor: Hey! Get this off of me!
Ladybug: Hah! That's right! I pretended to be hit. What's the matter? Don't you like my practical joke? You really need a sense of humor.
Cat Noir: Over here! Right there! Nope, over here!
Dark Humor: This... isn't funny!
(Ladybug wraps her yo-yo around the toilet bowl on Dark Humor's head and breaks it, along with the akumatized object, making the Megakuma emerge from it.)
Ladybug: No more evil-doing for you, Megakuma! (opens her yo-yo) Time to de-evilize! (catches the Megakuma) Gotcha! (releases the purified butterfly) Bye-bye, little butterfly! Miraculous Ladybug!
(Ladybug throws a broken fragment of the toilet bowl in the air and reverts every damage caused by the villain back to normal, including the victims of Dark Humor and himself, who is de-transformed back to Kim.)
Kim: What happened?
Ladybug: Monarch used your emotions to manipulate you. (opens her yo-yo and grabs a magical charm) Kim, this is a magical charm. Always keep it with you. May it help you avoid making the same mistakes again.

title: Derision/Transcript
text:
Derision/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: I'm sorry. I let my emotions get the better of me, too.
Ladybug: Don't worry. It can happen to anyone. That's why there's two of us. That way, one of us is always there to help the other.
Ladybug and Cat Noir: Pound it!
Kim: (worried) I can't remember anything. I hope I didn't do too many awful things while I was a supervillain...
Ondine: (displeased) The worst thing is that you do awful things even when you're not akumatized, Kim.
Kim: (annoyed) Again, with that story? It was just a joke!
Ondine: (points to Marinette) A girl liked you and you broke her heart!
Kim: (ignorantly) But I had no idea!
Ondine: (honestly) Just because you have no idea is no excuse! The pain is still real!
(Kim sighs and looks at his magical charm, finally realizing that his prank shouldn't have came at the expense of Marinette's feelings.)
Kim: You're right, Ondine. I'm just a fool who doesn't think about the consequences of what I say or do. But I'm going to change. (to Marinette, apologetically) I'm sorry I hurt you, Marinette. Can you please forgive me?
Marinette: (smiles kindly at Kim for his sincere apology) Apology accepted, Kim.

title: Derision/Transcript
text:
Derision/Transcript - Intro
Ondine: (hugs Kim) There! That's the boy I fell in love with! (kisses Kim's cheek)
(Seeing Kim and Ondine reconciled, Adrien and Marinette smile at one another, realizing that everything’s sorted out.)
Marinette: I finally figured it out why I keep making things so difficult — why I'm so afraid of telling you how I feel. I know you'd never mean to hurt me, but... somehow I'm still scared. And, I'm afraid I'll be scared for a long time to come.
Adrien: I'm scared, too. This is all new to me as well. I won't always know how to react. I'm scared of doing something wrong, scared of hurting you, scared of someone else hurting you... scared of losing you. But we're together, you and me, and we'll do whatever we can to help each other. And then together, maybe we'll become less and less scared. (reaches out his hand to Marinette)
(A hint of hesitation washes over Marinette: at one second she holds Adrien's hand, and lets go at the next.)
Marinette: I'm sorry.
Adrien: We've got time.
Adrien: I know about everything that you did to Marinette last year, Chloé. You're going to go and apologize to her and prove to everyone that you can change. I'm sure she'll forgive you.

title: Derision/Transcript
text:
Derision/Transcript - Intro
Chloé: (cackles) Forgive me? What do I care about her forgiveness? I couldn't care less about Dupain-Cheng's feelings! She and the likes of her only exist to suffer for my entertainment. Why bother having power if you can't use it against those who don't have any? You're the one who’s getting things wrong, with your baker girl! You're a prince! You belong with me, the princess! You're in this world to shine! To make fun of all the losers who are only good enough to be used as doormats! (She reaches her hand out to Sabrina, who angrily scowls at Chloé's remark since she views her as a doormat. Sabrina continues to paint Chloé's nails nonetheless.)
Adrien: You're nothing like a princess, Chloé. I supported you. I gave you multiple chances to become a better person. Everyone reached out to you, including Ladybug and Cat Noir when they gave you the Miraculous of the Bee again. But all you ever think about is yourself.
Chloé: And what else is there to think about? Losers and nobodies? The little bees? The planet?

title: Derision/Transcript
text:
Derision/Transcript - Intro
(She scoffs and goes back to reading her magazine. Adrien glares at Chloé in anger and great spite. This was the final straw for Adrien, who was completely fed up with Chloé's attitude.)
Adrien: (angrily) We will NEVER be friends again, Chloé. You and I are DONE. (walks away in anger)
Chloé: (glares at Adrien) Traitor.

is a minor character in Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir, first introduced in season 6. She is a student at Collège Françoise Dupont.

title: Diane
text:
Diane - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Diane is a French teenage girl of average height, with dark skin. Her hair is natural brunette and is dyed pink, tied in two afro puffs with two small pigtails that frame her face, and she has brown eyes.
Civilian Attire
She wears a yellow, orange, and salmon colored shirt under a white scoop tank top with a four-leaf clover symbol as a neckline. She also wears green with pastel yellow  clover printed  trousers and she also has orange sneakers . She also wears beads of different colors in her hair, including two four-leaf clovers in her pigtails, and yellow eyeshadow.

title: Diane
text:
Diane - Personality
Diane is a particularly cheerful and outgoing teenager who loves social media. She is very happy when she discovers that her videos have received a lot of reactions, placing her in first place in the Chloé Bee Community Competition on Zoo.

title: Diane
text:
Diane - Abilities
Diane is gifted with a large fortune that allows her to easily do everything she undertakes. With great luck, she has managed to make videos that have been very successful on Zoo, so much so that she has taken first place in the Chloé Bee Community Competition. Later, this providence allows her to create the perfect painting of Jagged Stone.
She seems to like both poetry and cooking, as in "Climatiqueen" she was seen taking Gine's poetry class and Marlena's cooking class at the cafeteria, and in "The Ruler" was seen painting in art classroom and taking a gardening class on the school roof.

title: Diane
text:
Diane - Relationships
Acquaintances
Aurore Beauréal
Diane is a friend of Aurore and did not hesitate to show her her successes in the competition, having failed to notice Aurore's sadness and incomprehension in her videos, as Aurore had tried to post similar videos without success.

title: Diane
text:
Diane - History
Season 6
In "Climatiqueen", Chloé Bourgeois ran a contest for the most followers in Bee Community Competition on Zoo. Diane was one of the participants. Later, she attends a poetry class, where she enjoys watching Adrien and Marinette perform. When Aurore gets to fifth place, Diane enters the locker room and celebrates her victory over Raymond Pugnant for first place. She notices the depressed Aurore and apologizes before trying to comfort the girl, showing her that this competition was just a matter of affection anyway. She boasts millions of likes on a video about a cat who thinks it's stupid and says it's all because of her luck. Since Aurore was trying to repeat Diane's video, these words make her cry. Aurore runs off to the restroom, and a confused Diane looks at her guiltily.

title: Diane
text:
Diane - History
In "Sleeping Syren", Diane eats lunch with Ondine, Marinette, Alya, Juleka, Rose, Kagami, Mylène and Zoé, having conversations about their boyfriends. When Ondine states that he is unsure if Kim loves her or not, she suggests to ask Kim to let him know that she wants to kiss. Outside the Collège Françoise Dupont courtyard, Diane and Mylène agree with Ondine to not force him to kissing. Diane and the other girls watch through the doorway witnessing Kim refusing to kiss Ondine much to the girls' dismay of Kim hurting Ondine's feelings. After the incident of Sleeping Syren, Diane suggests that she should carry a swimsuit everywhere she goes, never knowing about the weather. After watching Kim and Ondine kiss each other, Diane and the girls feel awkward, deciding to leave the cafeteria.
In "The Ruler", during her art class, Diane accidentally dropped a paint can, spilling on the canvas making a painting of Jagged Stone. During gardening class, Diane and Max were cutting the bushes mishearing Marinette's dash to the greenhouse as a jet plane.

title: Diane
text:
Diane - Trivia
Diane's character theme is the four-leaf clover, which can be seen on her clothes, accessories, and cellphone.
Diane, Mireille Caquet, Socqueline Wang and Sublime Varlette are the only known current/former students of Collège Françoise Dupont not to have been akumatized in any way.
Although Adrien Agreste has never been akumatized in a permanent timeline, he has been akumatized twice in two alternate timelines.

title: Duusu
text:
Duusu - Intro
is a major character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She is the Kwami of Emotion who is connected to the Peacock Miraculous. With her power, Duusu's wearer can use the brooch to transform into a peacock-themed superhero.
Duusu and her Miraculous are currently active and owned by Félix Fathom, who uses it to transform into the superhero Argos to secure his own, Kagami's and Adrien's existence.

title: Duusu
text:
Duusu - Appearance
Duusu is a brilliant phthalo blue creature and is 10 centimeters tall. She has a small pale, light grayish cerise circle on the center of her forehead and matching eyes with deep cobalt blue sclerae. Duusu's mouth is a dark magenta and contains rows of teeth on the top and the bottom. Duusu's tail, reminiscent of that of a real peacock, contains five feathers, and those feathers have a dark blue stripe running on the edge of each feather. The eyes of the feathers are brilliant orchid, with a black interior and a dark blue exterior. She also has three feathers coming out from behind her head, the central one of which is longer than those to its left and right.

title: Duusu
text:
Duusu - Appearance
From Season 6 onwards, most of her appearance remains the same, except she is now a darker blue, her limbs have light blue tips, her sclerae are a slightly darker shade, the circle on her forehead and her eyes are more saturated, and the feathers on her head now have pinkish-purple tips. Her tail feathers are now slightly shorter and broader, and the eyes of her tail are slightly different, with the black interior now being a dark blue and the brilliant-orchid exterior now being slightly more saturated. There are also now ridges running along the stripes of each feather.

title: Duusu
text:
Duusu - Personality
When her Miraculous was damaged, Duusu was very unpredictable, often switching from happiness to sadness in an instant. Duusu was somewhat oblivious to her behavior around others and to what her owner did with her powers. She was easily excited and seemed to enjoy chaos, but she also expressed genuine concern for Nathalie's health, indicating her caring nature. This extends to Duusu showing compassion; for instance, she felt sympathy for Marinette when she saw her crying about being separated from Adrien.
After her Miraculous is repaired, it becomes clear that her erratic behavior was partly due to the damage to the Peacock Miraculous. Duusu describes it as feeling like there was "chaos in [her] head" and that she was trapped in a nightmare. Her personality from before is to a lesser degree than when her Miraculous was broken. Her belief that being used for evil was a nightmare shows that, like her fellow Kwami, she desires her powers to be used responsibly and for the greater good.

title: Duusu
text:
Duusu - Abilities
General Skills
As Duusu's holders can sense where an amok is hiding it's likely she can sense it too as well as have a good memory.
As a Kwami
Duusu is able to fly, levitate, phase through solid objects, and carry objects that are larger and/or heavier than her.
As a Kwami, Duusu has and can give the power of emotion and is able to transform the holder of the Peacock Miraculous into a peacock-themed superhero or supervillain with the power of Amokization.

title: Duusu
text:
Duusu - Etymology
Duusu's name may be based on the Slavic word for soul, "duša".
It may instead be based on the French word "douce", meaning "sweet".

title: Duusu
text:
Duusu - Trivia
Duusu was first revealed by Jeremy Zag with a picture posted on his Instagram on June 27, 2016. The post did not contain any comments from him.
Her name was revealed on October 7, 2016 during the Miraculous panel at New York Comic-Con.
As seen in the concept art, when she cries, her tears appear to glitter.
This idea, however, is part of an old concept and may not be true in the completed version of the character.
The official Miraculous Ladybug Twitter, however, did comment on the image, stating "Who do you think is hiding behind the peacock kwami? 💙"
Also, another piece of concept art that was revealed shows Duusu with her Miraculous's future holder, which later turned out to be Nathalie Sancoeur.
Duusu has coloration and plumage similar to that of a peacock, a male peafowl.
Duusu's first appearance in any Miraculous media is in the second issue of Miraculous Adventures, alongside several Kwamis, known and unknown, as they fly through space in a flashback.
The reason why Duusu speaks in a high-pitched voice is because many peacocks make high-pitched calls, though this was yet to be confirmed.

title: Duusu
text:
Duusu - Trivia
Prior to the airing of "Truth", it was uncertain whether or not Duusu was aware that she was being used for evil and if her sporadic personality was a result of the Peacock Miraculous being damaged. The events of the episode confirmed both to be the case with her saying it was like her mind was chaotic and she was inside a nightmare being used for evil purposes, unaware that it was indeed reality.
Duusu is one of four Kwamis to have emotion-related powers, the other three being Nooroo, Liiri and Daizzi.
Duusu is so far the only bird Kwami who does not have a beak.

title: Dragon Miraculous
text:
Dragon Miraculous - Intro
The  is a beaded choker that, whenever Longg inhabits it, transforms the wearer into a dragon-themed superhero with the power of Perfection.
To activate the choker, the user must speak the transformation phrase: "Bring the Storm". To deactivate the choker, the user must speak the detransformation phrase: "Storm Subsides".
The choker is currently owned by Kagami Tsurugi, who uses it to transform into Ryuko. It was previously stored in the Chinese Miracle Box and only lent out to her when the situation required it. But, as of "Re-creation", she now posseses the Miraculous permanently.

title: Dragon Miraculous
text:
Dragon Miraculous - Appearance
In general, the Dragon Miraculous is a choker with a crystal bead. In charged mode, when Longg inhabits it, is a black choker that has a sangria black bead-like pendant with a red center and five red vertical lines on the front on it. If a minor is using the miraculous, the choker will start running out of power, making a beeping sound, and the vertical lines will start disappearing (one part is equivalent to one minute) Kagami (or another Dragon Miraculous holder) has left.
In Season 6 onwards, the choker has a gold color with a round, dark purple centerpiece, and 5 sharp points on top. The centerpiece resembles an eye, more specifically, a dragon's eye.
In its activated mode, the bead and lines turn black.
In Season 6 onwards, the choker turns silver and the centerpiece lacks the sharp points.
In its camouflage mode, the choker changes color and form depending on whose possession it's in:
In the possession of Kagami Tsurugi, the bead is red.
In Season 6 and onwards, it changes to a red and chartreuse color, bearing resemblance to a dragon blood jasper.
When it was worn by Gabriel Agreste, the bead was silver.

title: Dragon Miraculous
text:
Dragon Miraculous - Appearance
When it was worn by Marinette Dupain-Cheng, the bead was bubblegum pink.
In its reforged ring form, it was a thick band with a circle surface, similar to the Cat Miraculous, inside of it was the symbol of the Dragon Miraculous which glowed scarlet. It used to sit on the index finger of Gabriel's left hand.

title: Dragon Miraculous
text:
Dragon Miraculous - Abilities
The Dragon Miraculous has the ability to transform its wielder into a dragon-themed superhero, granting its wielder incredible superhuman powers of strength, speed, agility, endurance, and stamina. It also makes the user nearly invulnerable.
Its special weapon is an unbreakable red jian sword with a black leather handle. It has a circle that separates the blade from the handle. In it are three teardrop shapes colored light gray, blue, and yellow. There are two gold spikes protruding from the circle heading upwards. This can also be utilized as both a weapon, a communicator, and an object that can be used to breathe underwater.

title: Dragon Miraculous
text:
Dragon Miraculous - Abilities
Its special superpower, Elemental Dragons gives the user the ability to transform into one of three elements: water, wind, or lightning. It also gives the user the ability to create/manipulate one of these elements without transforming into it, as seen by Dragon Bug in "Miracle Queen" when she created a water sphere around her and changed its size. As long as the superpower isn't used by a minor, the wielder can remain transformed indefinitely. However, as soon as all three elemental transformations are used, the wielder loses power, and the transformation wears off in approximately five minutes. The beaded choker also has the ability to give the wielder the costume they truly desire.

title: Dragon Miraculous
text:
Dragon Miraculous - History
Five thousand years ago, a mage successfully helped the kwamis to interact with humans by creating magic jewels, which were called Miraculouses. In order to repay the mage, and to live on the physical world alongside humans, the kwamis decided to help humanity by letting humans utilize their energy and powers through the Miraculous they were bonded with, which included Longg and the Dragon Miraculous.
At some point in time, all of the knowledge about the Miraculouses and their powers was written down in code in a book called the Grimoire, with very few people knowing how to decipher the code. Miracle Boxes were also created at an unknown time to store the dormant Miraculouses. To protect and distribute Miraculouses, the Order of the Guardians was formed and existed for many years. Throughout its existence, guardians trained younger generations to keep a watchful eye over the Miraculouses and the Grimoire, which were placed in the guardians' temple.
Many Tiger holders throughout history used Roarr's power for good, like Lóng in China, who started the legacy, and Hua Mulan.

title: Dragon Miraculous
text:
Dragon Miraculous - History
172 years ago, after an disastrous event where a young Wang Fu used the Peacock Miraculous to create a sentimonster and his negative emotions and imaturity led to the creature rampaging through the temple and eating and destroying everything in its path, Fu was entrusted with the Chinese Miracle Box (Which included the Dragon Miraculous) by a monk and was told to run away from the mess. However, on the mountain range outside the temple, in order to escape from the the monster, Fu jumped over a fissure on the ground - accidently opening the Box and spilling all of its contents on the snow. Due to his distress, Fu didnt notice he accidently left both the Peacock and the Butterfly on the mountain, alongisde the Grimoire, until it was too late and he was too far away to come back. Somewhere along the line, the Peacock got dangerously damaged, to the point of being improper for use - but, as it turns out, no one knew of this fact until it was too late.

title: Dragon Miraculous
text:
Dragon Miraculous - History
On a previous trip overseas with the Agrestes, Nathalie found the Butterfly and Peacock Miraculouses and gave the jewels to Gabriel. In "Representation", it was revealed that neither the Agrestes nor the Graham de Vanily couples could bear children on their own, so Émilie and Colt used the Peacock Miraculous to create Adrien and Félix respectively, but in doing so, they grew sick over time and were eventually left in a condition where they fell into an eternal slumber due to using the Peacock Miraculous in its damaged state.

title: Dragon Miraculous
text:
Dragon Miraculous - History
Desperate to fix his mistake, Gabriel Agreste began using the Butterfly Miraculous for evil to obtain the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses in order to gain access to their absolute power, becoming the supervillain Hawk Moth, later Shadow Moth (when unified with a now fixed Peacock Miraculous), and finally Monarch. This decision proved one of the most significant for the history of the series, as Gabriel began utilizing Nooroo's power to akumatize the civilians of Paris, France, trying to get one of them to draw out the current holders of the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses, unintenionally helping start off Marinette's and Adrien's journeys as Ladybug and Cat Noir, and later, the rest of the Miraculers.

title: Dragon Miraculous
text:
Dragon Miraculous - History
One of the members of the Miraculers is Kagami Tsurugi, who was chosen by Ladybug in "Ikari Gozen" to wield the Dragon Miraculous, becoming the heroine Ryuko. However, due to her brashness, Kagami ended up revealing her identity to her mother and to Hawk Moth, which caused her to be banished from the team due to breaking one of the biggest rules. Nonetheless, after the events of "Heart Hunter" and "Miracle Queen", the banishment was revoked from that point on, and Kagami became a member of the team, helping Ladybug and Cat Noir during "particularly difficult missions". From "Heart Hunter" to "Strikeback", Kagami was a temporary holder, meaning she would only receive the Miraculous from Ladybug when she was needed for the mission, and had to give it back after the crisis was solved.
In "Miracle Queen", Marinette fused the Ladybug and the Dragon Miraculouses to transform into Dragonbug in order to succed on her plan. She would also reuse this form in "Sleeping Syren".

title: Dragon Miraculous
text:
Dragon Miraculous - History
Félix, after finding out about his true origins as a sentihuman and learning that the Peacock Miraculous could erase his and his cousin's lifes if it feel into the wrong hands, orchestrated a plan to capture all of the Miraculouses of the Chinese Box from Ladybug and traded all of them (besides the Ladybug and the Cat) for the Peacock, which included the Dragon Miraculous, succeeding in "Strikeback".
In "Destruction", Gabriel used a laser machine to melt down the Miraculous into a pile of dust, and then reforged it into a special Alliance ring for transferring Longg's power of Perfection to any akumatized villain who wore a regular Alliance ring. In "Re-creation", Marinette Dupain-Cheng manages to recover all of the Miraculous that were previously stolen. In "Miraculous London", Lila stole all of the Miraculous under Marinette's care in an alternate timeline, which included the Dragon Miraculous, in order to render her truly powerless and to fuse the Ladybug and the Cat to gain her wish without her interference, but her plan was ultimately thwarted by the combined efforts of Chronobug and Bunnyx, and the event was erased from the timeline.

title: Dragon Miraculous
text:
Dragon Miraculous - History
After the events of "Miraculous London", Marinette, having realized both instances of all of the Miraculouses being stolen happened because all of them were kept in the same place, and with the idea that centralized power is inherently flawed, and that distributing it among members of a society is a far superior idea, restored and upgraded the Dragon Miraculous by redesigning its original design and adding the Miraculous Call: a call feature that grants the holder the ability to summon other superheroes who possess a Miraculous from the Chinese Miracle Box in order to receive aid on their missions. This new feature is particularly useful, as the new holder of the Butterfly Miraculous, Chrysalis, is even more fearsome than her predecessor. After the alterations, the Dragon Miraculous was given back to Kagami permanently - putting Ryuko back on the map.

title: Dragon Miraculous
text:
Dragon Miraculous - Trivia
Dragons symbolize storms, fantasy, and adventure.
In China, dragons symbolize power, strength, and health.
In Japan, dragons symbolize balance, freedom, and good luck.
It is the third known Miraculous to be a type of necklace, following the Fox Miraculous necklace and the Mouse Miraculous pendant.
The Dragon Miraculous powers are based on the elements that are usually present in a storm (water, wind and lightning).
Unlike the other Miraculouses, whose use of one's power leads to the holder starting to lose power causing their detransformation, the Dragon Miraculous, because it has three different powers, will only start losing energy once all three powers are used.
It is possible this could be due to these three powers all being part of a single power - Elemental Dragon;
The Dragon Miraculous is one of the few Miraculous whose transformations and detransformation phrases do not directly relate to the animal it is based on; instead, it is based on its elemental/weather powers and the association of Eastern dragons with the weather.

title: Dragon Miraculous
text:
Dragon Miraculous - Trivia
During the special "The Battle of the Miraculous", the Dragon Miraculous, because it was in Marinette's possession, was one of the few Miraculous of the Miracle Box, along with the Ladybug, Cat, Turtle, Butterfly, and Peacock Miraculouses, to not fall into Hawk Moth's possession (the latter two have already been in his possession).
Despite the fact that the Turtle Miraculous also didn't fall into Hawk Moth's possession, its holder was captured by the villain, causing him to possess it indirectly.
In "Miracle Queen" and "Sleeping Syren", Marinette, as Ladybug, unifies the Dragon Miraculous with the Ladybug Miraculous and temporarily becomes Dragon Bug.
Marinette is the third person of Chinese origins, the fourth person of Asian origins and the first person of French origins to wield the Dragon Miraculous.
Kagami is the first Miraculous holder to use her Miraculous as both a hero and villain, since, in "Perfection", she was akumatized into Ryukomori and gained the power through her Alliance ring.

However, "Storm Subsides" is the actual correct detransformation phrase, as it was previously used by some official sources, such as the official Miraculous Ladybug website.

title: Dormant Sentimonster
text:
Dormant Sentimonster - Intro
The  was a major antagonist in Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir, serving as the unseen overarching antagonist of Seasons 1 and 2, the titular main antagonist of the episode "Feast" and a posthumous antagonist in Season 4 and Season 5.
It was a frog-like sentimonster manifested by Wang Fu from his hunger.
In "Feast", after being found in Tibet by Alim Kubdel and freed from its petrification in stone by Mayura, the sentimonster was akumatized by Hawk Moth into Feast, increasing the creature's size to make it bigger and stronger.

title: Dormant Sentimonster
text:
Dormant Sentimonster - Appearance
Physical appearance
The Dormant Sentimonster had a frog-like vivid blue-violet body and was the size of a dog. It had a white Order of the Guardians symbol in the middle of its face.
As Feast
Feast maintained its exact physical appearance from before it was akumatized. However, it was much larger in size, easily towering over any human.

title: Dormant Sentimonster
text:
Dormant Sentimonster - Abilities
As sentimonster
Being a sentimonster created with the emotions of anger and hunger towards the Miraculouses, it could track down the jewels and devour anything in its path. It also had a long, sticky, frog-like tongue, which helped it to restrain obstacles. Whatever it ate would be trapped in a pocket dimension within its stomach for all eternity. However, some objects were better preserved than others, such as Cat Noir's staff (not preserved) or Fu's metallic staff which contained the amok (preserved). It was also said by Master Fu that it was immune to the Miraculous powers.
As Feast
Being an akumatized sentimonster, Feast was considerably more powerful. The sentimonster's now-enormous size allowed it to pass through obstacles by jumping, like buses. Feast may have had increased speed resistance since it caught up with and continued to chase after Fu without getting tired.

title: Dormant Sentimonster
text:
Dormant Sentimonster - History
The sentimonster was first created by Wang Fu when he previously used the Peacock Miraculous 172 years ago during his training to become a guardian when he was watching over a Miracle Box for 24 hours without any food.
During that time, Fu became hungry and used the Peacock Miraculous to manifest the Dormant Sentimonster with the intention of being a companion in order to fetch him some food. But because of Fu's emotions, the sentimonster was completely different from what he envisioned, it began rampaging throughout the guardians' temple, eating all of the Miracle Boxes and swallowing all the guardians. It eventually found Fu, who was trying to escape with the last Miracle Box, the Chinese Miracle Box and the digital copies of the Grimoire. However, Fu lost the Butterfly Miraculous, Peacock Miraculous, and the Grimoire while fleeing the ravenous creature as it fell into a pit filled with lava, being encased in molten rock for 172 years.
Eventually, the Butterfly Miraculous, Peacock Miraculous, and the Grimoire were found by Gabriel, Émilie, and Nathalie while they were on a treasure hunt in Tibet.

title: Dormant Sentimonster
text:
Dormant Sentimonster - Trivia
It is the second known sentimonster to be akumatized, the first one being Kagami Tsurugi.
The Guardians' downfall was caused because of the Dormant Sentimonster. This was later fixed by Ladybug's Miraculous Ladybug.
It was the first known sentimonster to have control of itself, although Mayura threatened to destroy it if it tried to rebel against her.
It was the first sentimonster that didn't had a name until it was akumatized.
It is currently the only akumatized supervillain not to gain any more powers after the akumatization, only changing in size.

title: Dupain-Cheng residence
text:
Dupain-Cheng residence - Intro
The  is the home owned by Tom Dupain and Sabine Cheng and their daughter Marinette, which is located above their bakery.

title: Dupain-Cheng residence
text:
Dupain-Cheng residence - Appearance
External
The apartment is a triplex occupying the top three floors above the Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie.
Internal
Hall and stairs
It is accessed by two entrances, one from the back of the pastry shop, and an entrance from the side street of the Place des Vosges, by a large blue double door, which opens onto an entrance hall with white tiles with a blue carpet motif with golden lines and white walls.
From there you have to climb a two-story staircase made of wood and blue carpet to reach the door of the living room. The door on the first floor which leads to access to the bedroom and bathroom of the residence.
Guest room
First seen in "A Fairy Good Night", the guest room is located on the left door at the top of the stairs, right across the Living Room's door. It's a small and modest room with small desk, chair, and an adjacent, doorless bathroom. The walls are mostly tan-colored, with one turquoise and contains windows with white curtains. There's a platform bed with two nightstands with lamps on either side, and a small bookshelf at the foot of it.
First floor room

title: Dupain-Cheng residence
text:
Dupain-Cheng residence - Appearance
The first floor room is not known exactly and its purpose has not been revealed. The floor is made of light brown panels, while the walls are white. A round rug in two shades of orange with an unknown pattern can be seen on the floor. A Chinese calendar hangs on one of the walls, highlighting important days and holidays in China. The windows are decorated with orange curtains. To the left of the calendar is a low chest of drawers with a black vase with a branch of pink flowers on it. Opposite the calendar, right next to the stairs, is another low chest of drawers made of dark wood, decorated with a white or green tablecloth. A candle and a gong hang on the chest, set in an ornate dark wooden frame. In the episode Qilin on the Other Side, Sabine also places a low black vase containing a variety of flowers. On the left side is a black lamp and a dark brown wooden shelf. On the right side are the stairs to the upper floor and the bathroom door.
Bathroom

title: Dupain-Cheng residence
text:
Dupain-Cheng residence - Appearance
The bathroom is accessed through a light wooden door. The walls are covered with black tiles. In front of the entrance is a rectangular white sink, and directly above it hangs a large frameless mirror. On the right side, you can see a faucet and a shower hose, indicating that this is where the shower or bathtub is located.
Tom and Sabine's room
Tom and Sabine's room is not shown in its entirety, and it is difficult to say exactly where it is located. From the layout of the remaining rooms, it can be deduced that it is on the first floor, however, it is not known whether the previously mentioned room is part of the bedroom or if it is accessed through a separate door. From the frame shown, you can see that the bed is made of dark wood, while the sheets are black and white striped. To the right of the bed is a triangular shelf made of dark wood, on which are placed a clock and a night lamp with an orange lampshade.
Laundry room

title: Dupain-Cheng residence
text:
Dupain-Cheng residence - Appearance
Going up the stairs you directly access the laundry room. This room is located on the second floor of the residence. The laundry room has a dark brown floorboards. The walls are white. Dark brown doors with white glass lead to the kitchen and living room, which are on the same floor, while white doors lead to the hallway. In the small room there is a washing machine, an unspecified appliance and a narrow dark wooden shelf on which various objects are stored. On the stairs hangs a photo of Sabine and Marinette, while near the door that leads to the hallway you can see a painting with a plant motif enclosed in a white frame.
Living Room

title: Dupain-Cheng residence
text:
Dupain-Cheng residence - Appearance
The floor of the living room is made of dark brown panels. The upper part of the walls is white, while the lower part, closer to the floor, is covered with white panels and decorated with cream-colored rectangles with protruding frames. The windows of the living room are decorated with white curtains that reach the floor. In the center of the living room is a light pink corner sofa and a white coffee table, under which is a round pink and white rug. In addition, the sofa is decorated with numerous colorful pillows in black, gray and pink, with polka dots and stripes. Next to the bedside table is also a small pink pouf or seat cushion. Right behind the sofa is a brown and white rectangular lamp. The sofa is in front of a black flat-screen TV, placed on a low black chest of drawers with white furniture. The shelves of the chest of drawers contain other electronic devices. On the right is a white vase. Above the sofa you can see a bamboo painting. On the same wall is a long window that, like the ones in the kitchen, has gray shutters with white polka dots.
Kitchen

title: Dupain-Cheng residence
text:
Dupain-Cheng residence - Appearance
The kitchen has large oak windows with pink and white polka dot shutters. Below the windows is a countertop with a white dishwasher, two sets of dark oak cabinets, a stainless steel sink, a blue refrigerator, and an oven. On the counter next to the sink is a microwave, various spices and sauces, metal utensil holders, and two pink cabinets. The floor is made of tiles decorated with a repeating pattern of pink round flowers set in gray square outlines on a white background, and semicircular arrow-shaped decorations on the edges.
The table is dark oak with a glass top; around it are three stools with black legs and white seats. Above the table hang two rectangular lamps with yellow and pink rectangular lampshades. Next to the table is an Asian tapestry depicting swimming koi carp. On the table is often a black vase with green plants, probably bamboo, and other objects such as a fruit bowl or a Chinese teapot.

title: Dupain-Cheng residence
text:
Dupain-Cheng residence - Appearance
Right next to the front door are white stairs with a black railing that lead to Marinette's room. On the wall near the stairs is a painting with a black frame depicting a green bamboo. These stairs are also near the front door, next to which hangs a painting of a koi carp. Opposite the stairs you can see a light wooden bookcase full of books and, next to it, a black lamp with a pink lampshade.
Marinette's room
Marinette's room is located on the top floor of the residence. The floor is decorated with brown panels, while the walls and ceiling are painted in blush pink. The room is lit by three windows: two large arched windows with semi-transparent shutters and a round window. In the fourth season, when Marinette becomes the Guardian of the Miracle Box, the windows are covered with colored paper. Right next to the entrance, on the right side, there is a pink dressing table with black decorations, on which a sink and a mirror are mounted. It is separated from the desk by a wooden stand and a small green screen.

title: Dupain-Cheng residence
text:
Dupain-Cheng residence - Appearance
A light pink desk runs along two walls, and right next to it is a dark pink chair decorated with Marinette's floral logo. On the furniture, Marinette keeps the most necessary things: a pink and black shelf, a pink night lamp, and a computer monitor. There are posters and a cork board on the wall. For a long time, Marinette has also hung photos of Adrien on her desk. Near the desk, there is a light pink dressmaker's mannequin with a hat designed by Marinette hanging from it. Marinette's logo is pinned to the mannequin's chest. Next to it is a mirror with a black frame.
Near the round window, there is a chaise longue with a pink and brown backrest and a pink mattress with white polka dots. It is also decorated with a brown and pink pillow and a red Chinese umbrella. On the back wall, from the entrance of the room, there is a dark pink chest with gray upholstery with pink flowers and a brown and pink square lamp. There is a poster hanging right next to the window. In the center of the room is a pink, black and white carpet.

title: Dupain-Cheng residence
text:
Dupain-Cheng residence - Appearance
The room also has a mezzanine, which is accessed by a white staircase. Both the mezzanine and the stairs have a black railing. There is a mattress where Marinette sleeps that has pink and black sheets with two pillows on top: a pink one with a black bow and a decorative one that depicts a white cat with black stripes, with pink paws, ears and nose. Above the mattress is a shelf with a night lamp and books on it. On the side wall is also a cork board where Marinette hangs photos of her friends. The railing and the mezzanine support are decorated with a row of colored paper airplanes. There is also an entrance that leads to the balcony above the mezzanine.
Balcony
The balcony is located on the roof of the residence. The floor is made of brown panels. On the sides of the balcony is a light wall and on the front is a gray railing. On the balcony there is a beach chair in various shades of pink and a wooden table in the shape of a reel. Next to the chair there is a white box and, just above it, a sunshade, decorated with colored lights. There are various types of plants on the wall to the left, on the floor to the right and on the railing.

title: Dupain-Cheng residence
text:
Dupain-Cheng residence - Trivia
The residence is across the street from Marinette's school, Collège Françoise Dupont. Across the street on the opposite side is the Place des Vosges park.
On the first floor there is a door with a bell.
In "Troublemaker", Marinette indicates that this is the access to the residence's bathroom, proving that this door is usable.
This door is likely to be used by Tom and Sabine to go back and forth to the bakery from their bedroom and the bathroom to avoid disturbing Marinette during the night.
The residence has been the scene of several attacks by the akumatized villains:
In "The Evillustrator", the titular villain snuck into Marinette's room to try to invite her to a boat trip on the Seine.
In "The Bubbler", Sabine was kidnapped by a bubble of the titular villain while in the living room.
In "Animan", Ladybug and Cat Noir tried to capture the titular villain in the stairwell hall.
In "The Puppeteer", the titular villain, while maneuvering Alya transformed into Lady Wifi, tried to steal the dolls of Marinette from her room.
In "Prime Queen", the titular villain entered Marinette's room through her computer to kidnap Alya.

title: Dupain-Cheng residence
text:
Dupain-Cheng residence - Trivia
In "Troublemaker", Penny was akumatized in the mansion's stairs and while fighting Ladybug and Chat Noir in the living room she managed to get a earring from Ladybug.
In "Reflekdoll", it is in Marinette's room where Juleka was reakumatized into Reflekta and was amokized created Reflekdoll , breaking through the balcony.
In "Weredad", Tom was akumatized into Weredad in the living room after Cat Noir rejected Marinette.
In "Gamer 2.0", Rose, Juleka, Ivan and Mylène were teleported to the game of the titular villain while they were in Marinette's room.
In "Truth", the titular villain entered the living room and used his powers on Marinette's parents to find out if Marinette had a diary in her room by Marinette.
In "Sole Crusher", the titular villain broke through the roof of the residence to catch Chloé, who had taken refuge there.
In "Dearest Family", Tom, Sabine, Gina and Roland were akumatized in the living room after arguing about who knew Marinette best.

title: Dupain-Cheng residence
text:
Dupain-Cheng residence - Trivia
In "Miraculous Paris", Alya transformed into Ubiquity in Marinette's room to make get Betterfly from his universe to the main, and later also Shadybug and Claw Noir under threat from the latter. Later, while in the room, Re-Marinette stole Re-Adrien's Miraculous in order to combine it with the his to express the desire, without succeeding. Afterwards, Monarch teleported into the room to make a deal with Shadybug and Claw Noir to obtain Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses to make all three's wishes come true.
In "Representation", Nightormentor entered Marinette's room to look for her in order to force her to reveal Adrien's whereabouts, but was stopped by Cat Noir.

title: Dr. Psiquat's office
text:
Dr. Psiquat's office - Intro
is a psychiatric practice owned by Perrine Psiquat, where she works as a psychiatrist, in Paris.

title: Dr. Psiquat's office
text:
Dr. Psiquat's office - Appearance
Exterior
Dr. Psiquat's office is located on the second floor of a Haussmann-style building, accessible via black and white stairs with a tiled landing and an elevator with black partitions.
Interior
Waiting room
The waiting room has white walls with black lower panels, where various paintings hang, and a smooth wooden floor. A large window illuminates the room, and a thick white curtain hangs.
The room has seven chairs, either black or white, six of which are arranged in two rows of three facing each other. There's a small rectangular white table on which magazines are placed for patients and their companions to read.
Near the window and the seventh chair is a small transparent shelf with a close-up of miniature model cars and a model of a two-masted sailboat. A green plant completes the room's decor near a black door.
The room is closed off by a brown wall that blocks access to the corridor, with gray walls featuring square and rectangular patterns.
The entire room is illuminated by white, round wall lamps recessed into the ceiling.
Examination room

title: Dr. Psiquat's office
text:
Dr. Psiquat's office - Appearance
The room is very spacious and bright. It has white walls with several framed posters, a smooth wooden floor, a black lamp, and several model airplanes and a helicopter hanging from the white ceiling.
Next to the front door, there's a small green plant on one side and a small wooden cabinet with a globe on top. On the wall opposite the front door, there's also a closed fireplace with a time-turner on the windowsill and another model airplane, above which hangs a large, blurry wall mirror. Near the two windows, there's a tall shelf with numerous model vehicles: cars, buses, airplanes, as well as a construction machine and a radiator under each window.
Opposite the front door, there's a large green plant.
The room is divided into three distinct sections. Further from the windows is an area with a large wooden desk.
Further toward the center of the room, near a large white plaid carpet, is the consultation area, with a blue chair for the doctor and a chaise longue for the patient.

title: Dr. Psiquat's office
text:
Dr. Psiquat's office - Appearance
In the corner opposite the desk, there's a small children's play area with a yellow chair, a round table with a rim filled with toy cars, small toys, and a large blue teddy bear, all on a white bell-patterned carpet and a black lamp.

title: Dr. Psiquat's office
text:
Dr. Psiquat's office - Trivia
This psychiatrist's office is consulted, or has been consulted, by several characters from the series:
Max goes there every Thursday evening at 6:15 pm for his autism spectrum disorder, his neurodiversity.
Mylène consults her to overcome her fears.
Juleka consults her for speech problems.
Alya consulted her a long time ago for family problems.
"Sadnansi" implies that the family issue for which Alya sought Dr. Psiquat's help was about the indignation she felt for her parents hiding from her the fact she and Nora had different fathers for most of her life.
Aglaé now consults her to overcome her fear of insects, akumas, akumatized villains, and of being akumatized.
Adrien consults her to discuss his different perception of his father's public actions versus those in the private sphere.

title: Doorman (Actionverse)
text:
Doorman (Actionverse) - Intro
Doorman is a superhero in the United States of America and a member of the American superhero team.

title: Doorman (Actionverse)
text:
Doorman (Actionverse) - Appearance
Physical appearance
Doorman is tall and muscular with tan skin, brown hair brushed upwards, and light brown eyes.
As Doorman
He wears a blue mask over his eyes. His superhero suit is blue with a yellow collar and sleeves, long sleeves, and an image of a light blue door with a yellow doorknob on his chest. Additionally, he has a dark blue cape.

title: Doorman (Actionverse)
text:
Doorman (Actionverse) - Abilities
Doorman can make portals connecting two distances, like from Paris to New York.

title: Doorman (Actionverse)
text:
Doorman (Actionverse) - History
Miraculous Adventures
In the end of "Silurus", Doorman opens a portal in the tent leading from Paris to New York so that Ladybug can pass through it. He greets the superheroine. A moment later, he opens a door with a portal to New York for Cat Noir, where Knightowl and Sparrow are already waiting for him. He walks to the edge of the roof, joining the other superheroes, looking out over the devastated the city destroyed by the villain names as the Trash Krakken. Doorman accompanies the Paris superheroes as Majestia explains what happened to New York. However, Ladybug and Cat Noir running off to detransform, thus surprising their new allies before parting ways over the rooftops.
Later in "The Big Leagues", Ladybug and Cat Noir return to Majestia, Knightowl, Sparrow, Uncanny Valley, and Doorman fifteen minutes after they originally left. After President Camilla Hombee arrives by helicopter and reveals her secret identity as Victory, Doorman can be seen in the background, after which he no longer appears.

title: Doorman (Actionverse)
text:
Doorman (Actionverse) - History
In "Battle for New York", after defeating the Trash Krakken, the American superheroes, still on the same rooftop, thanked Ladybug and Cat Noir for their help, did the "Pound It". Doorman reopens the portal from New York to Paris, asking Ladybug and Cat Noir to go through, and then saying goodbye to them a moment later.

title: Doorman (Actionverse)
text:
Doorman (Actionverse) - Trivia
Doorman's outfit is reminiscent of Superman and other superheroes with similar designs from the Golden Age of Comic Books.
Additionally, another character named Doorman, who also has the power to create and open portals, exists in Marvel Comics.
In the third issue of Miraculous Adventures, Doorman is with the group of superheroes that Ladybug and Cat Noir have to temporarily leave to detransform, but when the duo return, he isn't with the group anymore, despite the rest of the superheroes still being there.

title: Egyptian papyrus
text:
Egyptian papyrus - Intro
The  is a 5,000 year old scroll from ancient Egypt. It currently resides in the ancient Egyptian exhibit in the Louvre.

title: Egyptian papyrus
text:
Egyptian papyrus - Appearance
The papyrus is old and worn. It is mostly covered in hieroglyphs, along with larger images depicting the 1,000 mummies and an offering ritual.
In hieroglyphs, the papyrus tells the event of Pharaoh Tutankhamen I planning to sacrifice an innocent woman to the sun god Ra in a ritual of one hundred mummies in order to bring back his deceased wife, Princess Nefertiti, using the power of his scepter. However, the Ladybug of the time prevented him from succeeding.

title: Egyptian papyrus
text:
Egyptian papyrus - Trivia
The hieroglyph of the girl about to be sacrificed has glasses similar to Alya's. Because of this, the Pharaoh believes she must be his new offering in the episode of the same name.
Some of the hieroglyphs are of Tikki, Ladybug, King Tut, Princess Nefertiti, and Tut and Nefertiti embracing.
A photo of part of the papyrus is featured in Histoire.
There are a few historical differences between the Quantic Universe and the real world.
The ancient Egyptian Ladybug was active and stopped Tutankhamun around 5,000 years ago in the Quantic Universe, however, in the real world, Tutankhamun actually ruled Egypt approximately 3,000 years ago.
In the real world, Princess Nefertiti was actually the wife of Pharaoh Akhenaten, who ruled Egypt until a couple of years before the ascension of Tutankhamun.

title: Eiffel Tower
text:
Eiffel Tower - Intro
The  is an iron lattice tower at Champ de Mars (Field of Mars) in Paris, France. When it was first constructed in 1887 by Gustave Eiffel, the local Parisian artists disliked it because they believed the unique and gigantic structure would divert good reputation during the World Fair, but today it is Paris's most famous and beloved landmark and the most visited monument in the world.
