title: Eiffel Tower
text:
Eiffel Tower - Trivia
The Agreste mansion and Collège Françoise Dupont are located near the Eiffel Tower.
In the webisode "Marinette in Paris," Marinette writes that the Eiffel Tower is her favorite monument in Paris.
Marinette states in the webisode that the Eiffel Tower is 1,063 feet high, which is its actual height.
It is illuminated in "The Evillustrator", "Rogercop", "The Mime", and "Guitar Villain".
It is also decorated like a Christmas tree in "Christmaster".
The Eiffel Tower has been part of multiple akumatized villain attacks:
It is where Ladybug and Cat Noir fight Bubbler in "The Bubbler".
Mr. Pigeon uses the Tower as a platform to give his ultimatum in "Mr. Pigeon".
The Evillustrator creates a miniature Eiffel Tower for his date with Marinette in "The Evillustrator".
In "The Mime", the titular villain cuts the Tower in half, and it falls over. However, after Ladybug uses the Miraculous Ladybug, the tower is repaired.
In "Princess Fragrance", Jean Duparc is akumatized off-screen into The Magician of Misfortune, a supervillain who threatens to make the tower disappear.
In "Stoneheart", Stoneheart climbs the Tower and Hawk Moth delivers his message to Ladybug and Cat Noir.

title: Eiffel Tower
text:
Eiffel Tower - Trivia
In "Guitar Villain", Guitar Villain uses the Tower as a battleground against XY, Ladybug, and Cat Noir. Fang also gets stuck in the Tower in his akumatized dragon form.
In "The Puppeteer", Ladybug throws the doll of herself, and it lands on the Tower, prompting The Puppeteer to use Lady Wifi to retrieve it.
Antibug's Anti-Charm pierces the side of the Tower in "Antibug".
Volpina uses the Tower to dangle her illusion of Adrien and threaten Ladybug in "Volpina". The Tower also becomes her cage because of Cat Noir's Cataclysm, which leads to her de-akumatization.
The Collector collects the Tower in his book.
Cat Noir hides Marinette on the Tower from her grandmother, who is akumatized as Befana. The clever Befana figures out Cat Noir hid Marinette on the Tower. Ladybug climbs up the Tower while Befana is chasing her and blasting candy at her.
Ladybug traps Gigantitan in the Tower by using her yo-yo string. The big baby pulls the strings, which causes the Tower to break and fall over. As in "The Mime", Ladybug later restores it.
Captain Hardrock blasts loudspeakers on the Tower to ruin Jagged Stone's concert.
In "Zombizou", it gets invaded by zombies.

title: Eiffel Tower
text:
Eiffel Tower - Trivia
Also in that episode, Ladybug mentions Gustave Eiffel's office as a statue of him is seen inside. It was his company that was responsible for creating the real Tower.
In "Style Queen", the titular vilain deposits Adrien as a gold glitter statue on the Tower and then fights Ladybug there, culminating in Plagg breaking the Tower with his own Cataclysm. Once again, Ladybug repairs the damage.
In "Reverser", Reverser changes Mayor Bourgeois during the latter's space dumpster campaign and later has a showdown with Ladybug and Cat Noir.
In "Heroes' Day", it's where Volpina is situated when she creates illusions and where Scarlet Moth commands his army and fights the heroes.
In "Chameleon", it's where Ladybug and the titular villain fight.
In "Reflekdoll", Ladybug and Cat Noir defeated an unknown akumatized villain and Reflekta along with a Sentimonster.
In "Desperada", Desperada uses the tower as a vantage point to target the heroes, and Viperion is there while thinking of a plan to defeat her.
In "Cat Blanc", it's destroyed by Cat Blanc in an alternate future.
In "Miraculous New York", Mr. Pigeon uses it as a rocket to take his pigeons into space.

title: Eiffel Tower
text:
Eiffel Tower - Trivia
In "Multiplication", Ikari Dozen knocks down the tower with her sword.
In "Pretension", Matagi Gozen chased Argos to the office at the top of the tower after he kidnapped Kagami and hid her there.
In "Climatiqueen", Climatiqueen and the heroes fight on the tower, and Cat Noir cataclysms it to stop to stop the villain's plan to hypnotize everyone in the city.
In "Grendiaper", Grendiaper uprooted the tower and tossed it away. Luckily, Pegasus used his powers to put the tower safely back in place.
Thomas Astruc has confirmed that the tower's locations in season 1 were illogical and that the Tower was in every shot. Realistic geography was planned for season 2.
Every Kwami who has been seen using their power without a holder, with the exception of Tikki in "Dearest Family" has effected the Tower in some way.
Plagg using Cataclysm broke the Tower and caused it to collapse.
Trixx using Mirage created an illusion of the Tower dancing.
Kaalki using Voyage teleported the Tower to the Sahara Desert.
Sass using Second Chance made the lights on the Tower flash uncontrollably.
According to Cat Noir, in "Ladybug and Cat Noir: Welcome to Paris", the tower has 1,665 steps.

title: Ella and Etta Césaire
text:
Ella and Etta Césaire - Intro
are minor characters of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. They are Alya and Nora's younger twin sisters.
In "Sapotis", after being scolded by Alya and losing their opportunity to go to an amusement park for misbehaving, they were both akumatized by Hawk Moth into the Sapotis, two mischievous monster supervillains.
In "The Dirtifiers", after their mother was mad at them for dirtying their apartment, Ella and Etta were both akumatized by Chrysalis into the Dirtifiers, ink-themed supervillains. They also received Magical Charms from Ladybug that prevent them from being akumatized again.

title: Ella and Etta Césaire
text:
Ella and Etta Césaire - Appearance
Physical appearance
Both Ella and Etta have tan skin, wavy brown hair that are put into low buns, pale crimson lipsticks, and vivid gamboge eyes.
From season 6 onwards, they start to wear pink eyeshadow.
Civilian attire
Etta has light sea green earrings. She wears a brilliant cerise and white-striped t-shirt, jean shorts with folded up legs, mulberryish black leggings, and brilliant cerise sneakers with white laces and white toe tips.
Ella has pink earrings. She wears a light sea green and white-striped t-shirt, jean shorts with folded up legs, ceruleanish black leggings, and light sea green sneakers with white laces and white toe tips.
As the Sapotis

title: Ella and Etta Césaire
text:
Ella and Etta Césaire - Appearance
Every clone of the Sapotis had smaller proportions, and they were red with a light purple stripe on their heads. Two light purple ear-shaped ridges with black edges came out of each side of their heads. Their eyes were vivid gold with light blue violet-gray pupils, and they had two pointy canines. Their feet were like hands, having opposable thumbs, and they had black claws. Additionally, they had golden bands around each wrist, ankle, and hips. They wore light tutus with two golden bands, the colors from the bands to the tips being red, light purple, and black. Their akumatized object, a light purple propeller hat with black rims, holes, and red spinners on top rested on their heads.
As Dirtifiers
Dirtifiers had azure skin, light blue sclerae, and amber eyes with thick X-shaped pupils. Their hair turned dark purple, made of multiple gel-like locks with glitter inside styled in high buns. On the right of their heads, there was a swirly sidelock. Their lips were light mulberry, and their earrings were silver. Covering their faces were dark purple goopy-like masks with glitter inside.

title: Ella and Etta Césaire
text:
Ella and Etta Césaire - Appearance
They both wore dark purple short-sleeved jumpsuits with a zipper, goopy ankle cuffs, and dark purple high tops with white soles, laces, cyan dots and appendages around the front and back of said sole, and dark purple cuffs around their arms with large holes inside, resembling goo. They wielded white machine guns with a dark purple rectangle at the sides and tip, and they had dark purple tubes connected to their backs, attached to a rusty, large dark purple canister with white splotches on the rims and lid.

title: Ella and Etta Césaire
text:
Ella and Etta Césaire - Personality
Ella and Etta are rambunctious, energetic, fun-loving, enthusiastic, and mischievous, but naughty little girls. They often speak in unison, and while they usually get along, they sometimes argue with each other over things like their possessions.
Very energetic, they love messing around, and they leap onto Cat Noir in excitement when he asks them where their house is in order to take them home. Disobedient at times, they enjoy causing trouble and blaming the Sapotis for their behavior. However, they don't like being in trouble, and they cry when they are upset, like being devastated when Alya punishes them by telling them they won't get to go to the amusement park the next day.
Even though Ella and Etta and their friends love to play, they know that there are times to be serious. Upon seeing Ladybug and Cat Noir acting like their age and fighting so poorly to the point of them giving up their jewels, they knew of what would happen if Hawk Moth got them and like Manon, they are shown to be very clever.

title: Ella and Etta Césaire
text:
Ella and Etta Césaire - Personality
As the Sapotis, their mischief increased, happily breaking rules and causing mayhem across Paris. They enjoyed eating, and they didn't care for others' safety as long as their own selfish desires were being met. However, because of their obsession with fun, they easily fell for Rena Rouge's illusion of an amusement park, ignoring Hawk Moth's warning that it was a trap. They also tended to growl, which was noticeable when they said "Miraculous" while ganging up on Ladybug and Cat Noir.
As Dirtifiers, they became extremely mischievous and determined to dirty all of Paris, stopping at nothing to achieve their goal. They could also throw tantrums when the heroes found a way to clean up their ink. Due to Chrysalis' manipulations, they believed that if they made a mess of everything, their mother would no longer be angry with them for leaving the whole city like their little sister's room, and when they could no longer make a mess, they believed that their mother would no longer love them.

title: Ella and Etta Césaire
text:
Ella and Etta Césaire - Abilities
As civilians
Ella and Etta has shown a certain predisposition for football, as well as a certain intelligence when necessary.
As the Sapotis
As the Sapotis, they had increased speed and dexterity with which to climb over anything. They could curl into balls, allowing them to tackle people with stronger impact. When they consumed food, they multiplied into more Sapotis, though these new ones would vanish when the propellers on their hats were destroyed. They could also drive vehicles (car, bicycle, rickshaw), helping each other.
As the Dirtifiers

title: Ella and Etta Césaire
text:
Ella and Etta Césaire - Abilities
As Dirtifiers, they wielded a giant soap dispenser filled with ink, which was attached to their backs like a backpack. They also carried ink guns that allowed them to spray ink around them. By spinning at high speeds, they could distribute ink even faster. They created pools of ink in which they could submerge themselves and move discreetly, reappearing in another pool wherever they had left their mark. This tactic enabled them to surprise several members of the Miraculers, allowing Chrysalis to incapacitate them with her antikumas. However, their ink was vulnerable to water, and when Ryuko caused a storm in the city to clean it up, they were unable to create any more messes.

title: Ella and Etta Césaire
text:
Ella and Etta Césaire - Etymology
Ella's name is a reference to Ella Fitzgerald, and Etta's name is a reference to Etta James, just as the rest of their family's names are references to jazz singers.

title: Ella and Etta Césaire
text:
Ella and Etta Césaire - Trivia
Their akumatized forms were first revealed as silhouettes in a promotional poster on Jeremy Zag's Instagram.
As the term "Sapotis" is from a Créole legend that Ella and Etta pretend to be, the Sapotis are one of the few villains Hawk Moth did not technically name.
In one of Alya's Instagram photos, Ella and Etta have a teddy bear similar to Chloé's Mr. Cuddly, but in a different color.
In "Gamer 2.0", the Sapotis return as playable akumatized villains as part of the Gamer 2.0's powers.

title: Ella and Etta's room
text:
Ella and Etta's room - Intro
is the bedroom of Ella and Etta Césaire located in the Césaire apartment.

title: Ella and Etta's room
text:
Ella and Etta's room - Appearance
The wall with the brown door is parallel to the wall with the window, and the walls are tan. The light switch, a button, is on the left side of the door. The window has sliding glass windows and green folded curtains, and a string of blue and red lights hang above the window. The floor is wooden with a brown rug in the middle that has two dark brown stripes and a hopscotch-like design having a grassy ground and sunny sky within the shapes. From the ceiling hangs a white round paper lantern.
One of the twins' beds is to the left of the window, and it has a pink pillow, light pink sheets, and a pink blanket. The other twin's bed is to the right, having a blue pillow, light blue sheets, and a blue blanket. At the end of each girl's bed is a brown wooden desk, including a chair with the same color as their bed. Spherical nightlights are attached in outlets next to each girl's bed. At least two brown shelves are above each girl's bed, full of books and other objects. Beneath the window, there is a green chest patterned with purple hearts. Drawings by the girls are on the walls and the inner side of the door.

title: Eagle Miraculous
text:
Eagle Miraculous - Intro
The  is a talon pendant necklace that, whenever Liiri inhabits it, transforms the wearer into an eagle-themed superhero with the power of Freedom.
To activate the talon pendant necklace, the user must speak the transformation phrase: "Wings of Liberty". To deactivate the talon pendant necklace, the user must speak the detransformation phrase, which is currently unknown. To activate the talon pendant necklace for evil, the transformation phrase is: "Wings of Prey". To deactivate the talon pendant necklace, the user must speak the detransformation phrase, which is currently unknown.
The talon pendant necklace is currently owned by Jessica Keynes, who uses it to transform into Eagle.

title: Eagle Miraculous
text:
Eagle Miraculous - Appearance
In charged mode, the Eagle Miraculous is a talon pendant necklace that consists of a dark brown eagle talon with a bronze ring and golden flexor tubercle around the base. It hangs around the wearer's neck by a black filament and reaches down to the wearer's mid torso. If a minor is using the talon pendant necklace and they’ve activated its Miraculous superpower, Liberation, it’ll start running out of power, making a beeping sound with one section flashing before discoloring every minute as an indication of how much time they have left before they detransform.
In activated mode, it's the same as its charged mode, but the talon, flexor tubercle and the three sections of the ring are discolored.
In camouflage mode, the necklace changes form depending on who wears it:
When worn by Jessica Keynes, the talon and ring become dark gray.
When worn by Gabriel Agreste, the talon and ring became silver gray.
When worn by Mike Rochip, the talon and ring become dark brown with a red stripe on the talon.

title: Eagle Miraculous
text:
Eagle Miraculous - Abilities
When it's used to transform, the Eagle Miraculous grants its holder an eagle themed costume that they truly desire as well as incredible superhuman powers of strength, speed, agility, and endurance. Its special tool is a bullroarer, which can be utilized as a weapon and a communicator. Its special superpower is Liberation, which gives the user the ability to free a person from mental or emotional restrictions that limits their actions. They can deactivate the effects of Liberation by speaking the cancellation phrase Cooldown. However, if the Eagle Miraculous holder is a minor, using will force them to detransform after five minutes.

title: Eagle Miraculous
text:
Eagle Miraculous - History
The Eagle Miraculous was created thousands of years ago by an unnamed mage.

title: Eagle Miraculous
text:
Eagle Miraculous - Trivia
Eagles symbolize freedom, strength, courage, power and might.
The bald eagle is the national bird of the United States.
The Eagle Miraculous is the first Miraculous that does not belong to the Chinese Miracle Box to appear.
The Eagle Miraculous is the second Miraculous to be used by an akumatized supervillain after being akumatized.
Catalyst is the first akumatized supervillain to use a Miraculous, with it being the Peacock Miraculous, during Heroes' Day.
However, Catalyst was deakumatized when she activated the Peacock Miraculous, while Techlonizer was still akumatized and still had his powers when he activated the Eagle Miraculous.
With Jessica being a part of the North American team of superheroes, her Miraculous, like Ladybug, Black Cat, Butterfly and Rabbit Miraculouses, is the fifth known Miraculous to remain constantly active.
Considering that the Chinese Miracle Box was the only one standing after the destruction of the Order of the Guardians by Master Fu's sentimonster that ate all the other Miracle Boxes, the Eagle Miraculous was the only known Miraculous from outside the Mother Box to not be eaten by it.

title: Eagle Miraculous
text:
Eagle Miraculous - Trivia
However, it's unknown why the Eagle Miraculous was not in the Native American Miracle Box during that time. Since the American Revolution happened between 1775 and 1783 and the Order of the Guardians fell around 1840s, it is to wonder why its Guardian didn't retrieve it from George Washington later on, since Miraculous are supposed to return to their respective Miracle Boxes when not in use.
It's possible that the Guardian had permited George Washington to hold on to the Eagle Miraculous in case its use was necessary to keep the independence and was unable to retrieve it before the incident with Master Fu's sentimonster.
Since the Miraculous was given to George Washington, it's unknown if he knew about the powers of the Miraculous when he became its keeper before it was put in a museum in New York.
In an old animatic of the show's theme song, the Eagle Miraculous was present before being replaced in the show proper. In the animatic the jewel was a light yellow ring embossed with an eagle facing left.

title: Eagle Miraculous
text:
Eagle Miraculous - Trivia
When Miraclonizer used the Eagle Miraculous, he obtained the ability to fly. It's unknown how this happened, but it may be due to the akuma, it being one of Miraclonizer's greatest desires, or it being one of the adult powers of the Miraculous.
It's the fifth Miraculous to be a necklace, alongside the Fox, Mouse, Dragon and Dog Miraculouses.

title: Duusu/History
text:
Duusu/History - Intro
Duusu is a kwami that is connected to the Peacock Miraculous and with her power, her wearer can use the brooch to transform into a peacock-themed superhero, the current wearer being Félix Fathom.

title: Duusu/History
text:
Duusu/History - Before Season 1
When the concept of emotion first came into existence, Duusu came into existence. Before the Miraculouses were created, Duusu and the other kwamis traveled all over the universe, unable to interact with humans. Eventually, a mage created the Miraculouses, which allowed humans to see kwamis and the kwamis to help them.
For 5000 years, Duusu had been dormant in the Peacock Miraculous, stored in the Chinese Miracle Box at the temple of the Order of the Guardians in China.
At an unknown point in time, a chinese man named Kǒngquè became the first Peacock Miraculous holder and with it the first to use Duusu's power.
One hundred seventy-two years ago, Master Fu used the Peacock Miraculous to create a sentimonster that would bring him food while he was doing a Guardian test. However, he ended up creating a ravenous sentimonster with an insatiable hunger for Miraculouses due to Fu's own resentment towards the Miraculouses. This mistake resulted in not only the destruction of the temple, but also in the loss of the Peacock and Butterfly Miraculouses and the loss of the Miraculous grimoire.

title: Duusu/History
text:
Duusu/History - Before Season 1
At some point in recent times, Nathalie found the Butterfly Miraculous and the Peacock Miraculous, then showed them to Gabriel who took them with him back to Paris. The Miraculous were dormant for the long period of time (the 172 years after Master Fu lost the Miraculous) until the Peacock Miraculous after being found in the Tibet by Gabriel Agreste, alongside Nathalie Sancoeur and his wife Émilie Agreste, was used by Tomoe Tsurugi to create Kagami Tsurugi, Émilie to create Adrien Agreste, and by Colt Fathom to create Félix Fathom. Unfortunately, the Peacock Miraculous had been damaged at some point during or after its loss which caused Émilie's health to decline until she was preserved in a glass coffin, leading to Duusu becoming dormant in the Miraculous again and said Miraculous being put in his safe behind the Painting of Émilie Agreste. It also caused Colt Fathom to eventually die and Tomoe Tsurugi to lose her eyes.

title: Duusu/History
text:
Duusu/History - Season 1
Throughout the first season, Duusu was dormant in the Peacock Miraculous in the safe of the Agreste mansion.

title: Duusu/History
text:
Duusu/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Mayura", her Miraculous becomes temporarily activated by Nathalie to save Hawk Moth and was returned to Gabriel's safe afterwards.

title: Duusu/History
text:
Duusu/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Reflekdoll", Duusu was briefly activated by Nathalie to become Mayura and created the sentimonster Reflekdoll. After Mayura and Hawk Moth were defeated, she expressed excitement over what happened but became concerned when Nathalie began coughing and fell to the floor. She was told by Gabriel that Nathalie would be fine, but she needed peace and quiet.
In "Ladybug", Duusu saw that Nathalie's condition was worsening due to overusing the damaged Peacock Miraculous. Duusu became dormant when Gabriel took back the Miraculous but became active one more time when Nathalie stole it. She became active and was happy that her wielder was up and running, but when Nathalie wanted to create the ultimate sentimonster, Duusu advised against it as Nathalie had to rest. Nathalie disagreed and reminded Duusu that she was doing this audacious task for Gabriel. Duusu cried, remarking on how romantic it was. Nathalie then transformed into Mayura. Returning to the mansion, Duusu heard that Nathalie's time as Mayura was over for now and went dormant in the Peacock Miraculous again rather sadly.

title: Duusu/History
text:
Duusu/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Truth", Gabriel is able to fix the Peacock Miraculous and puts it on, causing Duusu to appear. Now that her Miraculous is fixed, Duusu is shown to have her mind completely cleared, expressing great joy to see Nooroo, only for her fellow kwami to tell her, her nightmare was not over, as they were about to be used by Gabriel to turn him into Shadow Moth. Duusu was briefly activated by Gabriel to become Shadow Moth and created the sentimonster Lighteye.
In "Queen Banana", Duusu is seen with Nooroo beside Gabriel when he gets ready to both akumatize Chloé into the titular villain and create a sentimonster for her.
In "Gabriel Agreste", Duusu and Nooroo are summoned by Gabriel with a sad look, knowing that their evil master was planning to abuse their powers as always.
In "Glaciator 2",

title: Duusu/History
text:
Duusu/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Multiplication", Duusu remained dormant, until his Miraculous was activated again by Félix, and Duusu meets him for the first time and then asks for Nathalie and if he was her new owner, to which Félix replied he was much more than that.
In "Emotion", Félix and Duusu transformed into the antihero Argos and created the sentimonster Red Moon to free his cousin Adrien and Kagami from their oppressive parents, but after Argos abandons his plan, he flees to his house in London and detransformed back and Duusu saw Félix comforting and embracing his mother.

title: Duusu/History
text:
Duusu/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Pretension", Duusu was activated again by Félix, who returned to Paris to free Kagami from her mother by separating them and taking the former to the Eiffel Tower, where Argos detransformed and there Duusu watched Félix reassuring Kagami that he didn't want to hurt but to know her as he felt a kinship with her, but quickly transformed back into Argos to protect Kagami from her akumatized mother and in the sewers, Félix detransformed and Duusu watched as he explained to Kagami his refusal to create a sentibeing for selfish reasons and his empathy towards them, but when confronted by Ladybug, Cat Noir and the akumatized Tomoe, Félix transformed once again to escape from the latter.

title: Duusu/History
text:
Duusu/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Representation", when Félix heard that Kagami was in London as well, he transformed with Duusu again and went to Kagami's hotel balcone to reunite with her and then escape back to Paris to seek Marinette's help to defeat Monarch and Tomoe and be able to love each other freely. On the Eiffel Tower, Argos detransformed and dressed like his cousin Adrien to lure Marinette to the school, where Duusu felt bad for her when seeing her cry in heartbreak over her separation from her boyfriend, but Félix reassured his kwami, they were doing this to help her to have a happy ending, which cheered up Duusu and Félix transformed once again to create the sentimonster Once Upon a Time, who revealed that Duusu was used by Émilie and Colt Fathom to create both Adrien and Félix respectively, and Félix, after his father's death caused by the damaged Peacock Miraculous, became determined to get his hands on said Miraculous to protect his existence and succeeded on this by betraying Ladybug back in "Strikeback" and after finishing the story. Argos returned Kagami back to London.
In "Re-creation", she and Félix transformed into Argos to join Ladybug's restored superhero team.

title: Duusu/History
text:
Duusu/History - [[Season 6]]
In "Yaksi Gozen", Duusu and Félix travel to Paris to meet up with Kagami and Longg, before transforming into Argos and Ryuko to go meet up with Marinette, alerting her to their impending arrival by contacting her through the Ladybug Miraculous with the Miraculous Call.
After they arrive, and Argos explains the circumstances regarding himself and Ryuko now that he was in possession of the Peacock Miraculous so it would be safe from being used for evil purposes, he powers down, allowing Duusu to reunite with Tikki so they, and Longg, can go off to talk privately while Félix and Kagami speak to Marinette.
Once they explain their intentions to entrust their rings containing their Amoks to her for safekeeping in Ladybug's yo-yo, Duusu, Longg, and Tikki all agree with this idea, but have to hide when Marinette's parents and Adrien interrupt them.
Duusu is not able to turn Félix back into Argos before he is paralyzed and captured by Tomoe Tsurugi, Akumatized by Chrysalis into Yaksi Gozen.
However, a joint effort by Ladybug, Cat Noir, and Ryuko, ensures Félix's rescue, and for now, Tomoe is accepting of Kagami and Félix's relationship.

title: Elation
text:
Elation - Intro
"" is a season 5 episode of the series Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. Based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 9th written and produced episode of season 5. It is also the 113th written and produced episode of the series overall.

title: Elation
text:
Elation - Synopsis
When Ladybug chases after Cat Noir, he runs away from her. When Adrien chases after Marinette, she runs away from him. Tikki and Alya grow increasingly concerned as they watch Marinette's moves: is their friend looking for yet another excuse to run away from her feelings for Adrien, or is she really falling for another boy? When they cross paths with André the ice-cream maker – whose ice cream is supposed to know and reveal the mysteries of love – Marinette and Cat Noir make a chilling discovery that will freeze their hearts!
Disney+
Ladybug and Cat Noir face Glaciator again.
Netflix
Emotions flare as Ladybug chases Cat Noir while Adrien pines for Marinette. Monarch takes advantage of Ladybug's sandness to try to uncover her identity.

title: Elation
text:
Elation - Plot
After defeating a villain, Ladybug and Cat Noir do their trademark "pound it" fist bump and as Cat Noir proceeds to leave, Ladybug pulls his tail and stops him. She then shows Cat Noir a table for two with chouquettes and offers him to sit down and eat with her, he refuses because he will detransform in a minute and Ladybug says in a very flirtatious tone "You know, one minute can feel like eternity if you are with the right person" but Cat Noir proceeds to go away, but before that Ladybug tries to kiss him but he just backs up and asks her what she is doing. Ladybug, disappointed asks Cat Noir if he has a new girlfriend but he thinks she is trying to put him at test and responds with "I know your tricks and it's not gonna work" and just goes away.

title: Elation
text:
Elation - Plot
As Cat Noir hides to detransform, a fan spots him and brings her friends to all take a selfie with him but he escapes a few seconds after detransforming, he then looks at Marinette's house and decides to go in. Meanwhile in Marinette's room, Marinette is complaining about the fact that Cat Noir isn't flirting with her as he used to do, in response Alya reminds her that she asked Cat Noir to stop flirting with her but then Marinette starts to think that maybe Cat Noir is not in love with her anymore, the conversation continues with Marinette arguing with Alya.
Meanwhile, Adrien enters Tom and Sabine's bakery and asks Tom and Sabine if Marinette is here. After figuring out as to why he is acting strange, the conclude Adrien is in love in Marinette. Sabine calls Marinette and tells her that Adrien can meet her at school. Meanwhile, while Adrien is waiting for Marinette, a customer enters and recognizes him as the face for the Alliance rings. The customer takes a selfie of him and Adrien and posts it online. Tom and Sabine tell him that Marinette is unavailable and gives Adrien a free bag of chouquettes.

title: Elation
text:
Elation - Plot
As he walks out, eating the chouquettes, a group of fans recognize him from the customer's post. Adrien transforms into Cat Noir and uses his staff to get away from them onto a balcony near the bakery. Cat Noir becomes shocked when he sees Marinette go into the exterior of her bedroom. She becomes shocked as well when she sees Cat Noir. After they see each other and Cat Noir goes over to the top of the bakery where Marinette is and gives her a rose, Cat Noir extends his staff so that he and Marinette are high in the sky.

title: Elation
text:
Elation - Plot
Meanwhile, in Marinette's bedroom, Alya and Tikki talk about their negative emotions and decide to check up on Marinette. They go to the top of the bakery but cannot find her. Meanwhile, Marinette and Adrien are in the sky and try to find Andre, the ice cream man who is at the Ile aux Cygnes. They go to find him. After Andre refuses to serve them ice cream because he thinks Cat Noir is with Ladybug and Marinette is with Adrien, they decide it is too much to bear. Marinette tells Cat Noir she is fine with him wearing a mask, they kiss. Cat Noir then explains that although he likes her he can't be with her due to the fact he would be taking advantage of her. Marinette becomes upset with the fact that people are telling her who and who not to love.

title: Elation
text:
Elation - Plot
Meanwhile, in his lair, Monarch senses Marinette's emotions. He creates a megakuma and absorbs Kaalki into his Miraculous and teleports the megakuma to Marinette. The megakuma goes into the rose Cat Noir gave her. In an attempt, to help her reject the megakuma, Cat Noir kisses Marinette. the megakuma leaves the rose and goes into a portal that leads to Monarch. Cat Noir apologizes to Marinette for kissing her for the second time. Meanwhile, Monarch senses another person's strong emotions. It turns out the person is Andre as he doubts whether or not his ice cream flavors are wrong.
The megakuma is teleported to him and it destroys Ladybug's magical charm. The megakuma enters his ice cream scoop. Monarch absorbs Roaar into his ring and transfers Andre the essence of the Miraculous of Elation. Andre is akumatized into Glaciator. After seeing him, Cat Noir hides Marinette in a changeroom. Marinette calls Alya and tells her where she is. Tikki quickly flies to where Marinette is.

title: Elation
text:
Elation - Plot
Cat Noir catches up with Glaciator and uses his staff to slice him. His attempt is unsuccessful as Glaciator becomes one. He uses his destructive power on Cat Noir and leaves him hurt. Glaciator comes to the bakery and quickly gets Tom and Sabine out before Glaciator destroys the bakery. Tikki catches up with Marinette and Cat Noir hides Tom and Sabine as Marinette transforms into Ladybug. Glaciator corners Cat Noir and when he puts his hands out to get Cat Noir's Miraculous, Alya gets the attention of Glaciator.
Glaciator uses his powers on Alya and he starts chasing Ladybug. Ladybug and Cat Noir end up in a building where Glaciator cannot find them. Ladybug uses her Lucky Charm and receives a giant parasol. When Glaciator is about to get Cat Noir's Miraculous, Ladybug throws the parasol which is tied to her yo-yo. It flies through Glaciator's ice cream body and opens it, so that Glaciator cannot see anything. Ladybug pulls him toward a bus that is up in flames and melts Glaciator's body. All that is left is Andre and his scoop. Cat Noir throws his staff to break it.

title: Elation
text:
Elation - Plot
After purifying the megakuma, Ladybug gives Andre his magical charm. She throws the parasol in the air to revert all of the damage caused by Glaciator. Monarch detransforms into Gabriel and looks at his left arm and sees the damage slowly spreading. He says he will use Cat Noir's feelings towards Marinette to end Ladybug. After taking her home, Ladybug and Cat Noir wave goodbye. And after Plagg talks to him, Adrien realises Marinette could have feelings for him again as the episode ends.

title: Elation
text:

The episode shares its name with the concept of the Tiger Miraculous.
For an unknown reason, the concept is different in the French dub, being Exaltation.
The episode reveals a new variation of Clout. As shown with Glaciator, the user doesn't always have to be enveloped in energy to strike their opponents, as they can just charge their fists with energy and release it.
However, this could be due to Monarch modifying the Miraculous, André being akumatized, or André being an adult.
Besides the superpower of Clout, the concept of elation expresses a great feeling of joy and exhilaration, something that guided Marinette and Cat Noir's relationship in this episode.
Both Marinette and Cat Noir were shown exhilarated when at the presence of each other, causing them to dive into their own excessive feelings of joy for being together and ignore the dangers of both of them being in love with each other and their reason.

title: East River
text:
East River - Intro
The  is a sea strait in the United States of America located in New York City and connecting Long Island Sound to New York Bay.

title: East River
text:
East River - Description
Containing salt water from the Atlantic Ocean, the East River flows through New York City and separates the boroughs of Queens and Brooklyn on Long Island from the Bronx and Manhattan.
Connecting Long Island Sound to New York Bay, the East River is 16 miles (26 km) long. Between the Bronx and Queens, the strait is particularly wide and has a maximum depth of 165 feet (51 m). It is in this section that Rikers Island is located.
Immediately after the Bronx Kill, a small strait that connects it to the Harlem River, the width of the East River becomes significantly shorter before widening at its main junction with the Harlem River.
From that point on, the East River continues in a south-southwest direction, separating Manhattan from Queens. The East River is then bisected by Roosevelt Island for almost 2 miles (3 km).
After the inflow of Newtown Creek, the East River separates Manhattan from Brooklyn. Just past the Williamsburg Bridge, the strait turns west, then south-southwest again, to reach New York Bay at its confluence with the Hudson.

title: East River
text:
East River - Trivia
Despite its name referring to a river, the East River is actually a strait.
The tidal current within the East River changes regularly.

title: El Toro De Piedra
text:
El Toro De Piedra - Intro
"" is a season 6 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 7th written and produced episode of Season 6. It is also the 138th written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: El Toro De Piedra
text:
El Toro De Piedra - Synopsis
While Ivan faces a difficult family situation, Marinette finds a letter addressed to Adrien... from his father.
Gloob
While helping Adrien unpack boxes of childhood souvenirs, Marinette finds a letter with secrets that could hurt him. Should she hand it over or keep it a secret?
Disney+
Ladybug and her team face a stone-hearted villain.

title: El Toro De Piedra
text:
El Toro De Piedra - Plot
In the opening scene, a convicted felon named Raúl Bruel is speaking to an accomplice about a plot to steal the Mona Lisa from the Louvre after it is returned from its restoration project. The accomplice is set to wear Raúl's old El Toro costume to create a distraction, allowing Raúl to steal the painting while everyone's attention is diverted. As Raúl's visitation time comes to an end and he has to return to his cell, it is revealed that his accomplice is Ivan, who appears upset and uncertain. It's also revealed that Ivan is Raúl's son, as Raúl affectionately calls him mijo, which is Spanish for "son".

title: El Toro De Piedra
text:
El Toro De Piedra - Plot
Kitty Section are getting ready to put on a concert for Mayoress Caline Bustier, as thanks for her services as their teacher before she became Mayor. Rose will be lead singer, Juleka will be on guitar, Ivan on drums, and Luka joining them with his own guitar via satellite from his current residence in Brazil. While Ivan practices, still fuming over what his father told him about the art heist of the Mona Lisa, Adrien and Marinette try to fix the equipment to allow Luka to perform with them as it is acting up and the signal keeps failing. It is during this time that Marinette finds Adrien's old items from his younger years. Each box labeled with a difference number to show that age of Adrien's life and what is inside. When Marinette encourages Adrien to let her look inside and he agrees, it gives Adrien a chance to take a trip down Memory Lane, and ask himself what happened to his father to cause Gabriel to become so distant and cold-hearted in the last year of his life.

title: El Toro De Piedra
text:
El Toro De Piedra - Plot
After Adrien leaves to go help Kitty Section, as Marinette looks through one photo album, she finds a letter addressed to Adrien from Gabriel in it as it sported his photo from when he released the Alliance Rings, the start of his endgame with Operation Perfect Alliance. Deciding to show the letter to Nathalie first and foremost, Marinette enters her room just after Nathalie had finished a call on her laptop with someone. The two read the letter, where Gabriel reveals that he is Monarch, and asks his son to take up his mantle, continue where Gabriel left off, and secure the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses to summon Gimmi and use the Ultimate Miraculous Absolute Power to bring Gabriel and Émilie back, as well as revealing the truth of Adrien's origins. Shocked and horrified by this, Marinette realizes if Adrien reads it, it would ruin everything she and Nathalie had done to make the world believe Gabriel died a hero and make Marinette a pariah for lying to everyone. Nathalie intends to destroy the letter so it never sees the light of day, but Marinette decides to hold onto it until she feels Adrien is ready to be given it.

title: El Toro De Piedra
text:
El Toro De Piedra - Plot
Meanwhile, Ivan's frustration regarding his father finally boils over, and he knocks over his drum set in the process, before declaring he's stepping out for a bit, but will be at the concert to perform, despite the girls, even Myléne, calling Ivan her "teddy bear", asking him to wait and tell them what's wrong, and when Ivan leaves the Agreste mansion, he's spotted by a mysterious male person who quickly follows him.
At the Louvre, Raúl, disguised as a security guard, is in position for the heist, while Ivan enters the restroom to recover his father's old El Toro costume, but appears to have second thoughts.
When Ivan doesn't show up as scheduled once the real Mona Lisa is back in place, Raúl calls him to inquire what's wrong, but Ivan, still with the duffel containing the costume, is sitting by the Seine, mulling over what to do with either following his father's footsteps, or be the good guy from being cared for by his grandmother while his father was in lockup, and ignores his cellphone ringing.

title: El Toro De Piedra
text:
El Toro De Piedra - Plot
Raúl storms into the restroom where he hid the duffel, and finds a letter that Ivan left him, declaring that he no longer wishes to follow his father's footsteps and wants to do something good with his life instead, and hopes his father understands and comes around to his way of thinking.
Unable to understand why Ivan left him high and dry, Raúl becomes enraged, and as he is about to rip the letter to shreds, one of Chrysalis' Ultrakumas slips under the restroom door and infects the letter.
As Chrysalis makes contact with Raúl, when he initially shouts at her over believing he's in any distress and was offering sympathy and compassion, caught off-guard by this, Chrysalis recovers and uses a more tough guy style approach to encourage Raúl to accept the power being offered to him to take vengeance on Ivan for betraying him.
Raúl accepts and asks to be Akumatized as "El Toro de Piedra".
Chrysalis grants his wish, and after being transformed, Raúl uses his whip to transform any unlucky civilian that crosses his path into bulls under his control to stampede through Paris and find Ivan.

title: El Toro De Piedra
text:
El Toro De Piedra - Plot
When he finds Ivan by the Seine, although terrified and fleeing at first from his furious father, Ivan stops to stand up to him and tell him off, but Raúl is unmoved and tries to turn Ivan into another of his bulls. Ivan escapes and ducks into the sewers to hide. At that point, he takes out his Ox Miraculous and looks at it.
At the concert at the Collège Françoise Dupont, Miss Bustier's class and Zoé, offer a heartfelt thanks to Mayoress Bustier for her efforts as their teacher, earning Caline a standing ovation from the other guests, including Principal Damocles and Ms. Mendeleiev. Even Caline's baby daughter Harmonie gives her mother an applause. However, before the concert can start, Luka's connection fails again, and Ivan has not returned. Marinette soon gets Minotaurox's SOS through the Ladybug Miraculous and excuses herself to go look for Ivan. Once hidden, she tells Tikki that Minotaurox needs their help and has Tikki transform her into Ladybug.

title: El Toro De Piedra
text:
El Toro De Piedra - Plot
When Ladybug finds Minotaurox in the sewers and asks what's wrong, he transforms back into Ivan and tells Ladybug he is stepping down from the Miraculers, handing back the Ox Miraculous and renouncing Stompp. When she asks why, he explains about his father Raúl and how he had always pressured Ivan into following his footsteps and becoming a bad guy like him, but since he was cared for by his grandmother and joined the team and fallen for Myléne, Ivan doesn't want to do that anymore, and he's frustrated and scared about it, unsure which way to go. Understanding his plight, Ladybug offers him words of encouragement, and thanks to her heartfelt wisdom, Ivan's morale recovers, and he proudly puts on the Ox Miraculous again and has Stompp transform him into Minotaurox once more.

title: El Toro De Piedra
text:
El Toro De Piedra - Plot
Back at the Kitty Section concert, with Luka unable to restore his uplink to perform with the band, and Ivan still not back, Juleka suggests she and Rose perform on their own. Rose is hesitant as she sings terribly without backup instruments, so Juleka is chosen to perform solo. Juleka is hesitant, but encouragement from her twin brother, plus a kiss from Rose, gives her the morale boost to dawn her guitar, go on stage, and perform solo.
As Juleka sings, Ladybug sends a summon for help to Adrien, who excuses himself while everyone is focused on Juleka to transform into Cat Noir to assist her and Minotaurox.
Meanwhile, Minotaurox faces off against El Toro de Piedra and his herd of bulls.
Ladybug calls upon her Lucky Charm, summoning a cowboy hat, and puts it on as they prepare for a classic American Wild West showdown against El Toro de Piedra.
While Cat Noir distracts the bulls, Minotaurox uses his powers of Resistance to protect himself and his fellow Miraculers from being turned into more of El Toro de Piedra's bulls.
This leads to an intense moment where Minotaurox successfully flips over the bull that El Toro de Piedra is mounted on, with a little help from Ladybug.

title: El Toro De Piedra
text:
El Toro De Piedra - Plot
She skillfully uses her yo-yo like a lasso, snagging Minotaurox's ankle and pulling him under the bull, assisting him in flipping it over.
Once subdued, Minotaurox disarms El Toro de Piedra of his whip and destroys it with his hammer, which results in the release of the Ultrakuma.
Ladybug quickly captures and purifies it.
As Juleka finishes her performance, she receives a standing ovation from the crowd, and Rose rushes onto the stage to hug her, causing both of them to tumble over.

title: El Toro De Piedra
text:
El Toro De Piedra - Plot
Back with Raúl, Minotaurox confronts him over Ivan, but soon enough, the Paris Police Department arrives and surrounds Raúl, placing him under arrest for violating his parole with the reformation program he was in due to the destruction caused while he was Akumatized and preparing to take him back to prison to resume his sentence, and this time, keeping him in lockup until his sentence is over. Ladybug and Cat Noir explain to Lt. Raincomprix that Raúl's actions did not violate his parole since he was Akumatized at the time, and Ladybug fixes everything with Miraculous Ladybug, returning the civilians to normal and back to wherever they were when transformed, and the damage caused by Raúl's rampage. With further encouragement from Minotaurox, Raul agrees to complete his reformation program, for Ivan's sake, and Roger, convinced to let Raúl go thanks to the Miraculers, orders his lawmen to stand down and disperse now that the situation was resolved.

title: El Toro De Piedra
text:
El Toro De Piedra - Plot
Later, back at Kitty Section's rehearsal studio, Ivan apologizes for his earlier behavior, and the others forgive him, with Mylène assuring her teddy bear that if he ever has problems to let her know so she can help. Meanwhile, Marinette prepares to give Adrien the letter from Gabriel, but seeing how he just wants to enjoy the good memories of Gabriel and Émilie before Gabriel became so cold and distant, she can't bring herself to do it and hides the letter up the back of her blazer before joining Adrien.
In Monarch's lair, unbeknownst to any of the Miraculers, Nathalie is in a meeting with a secret group that knows the truth about Gabriel, who is referred to by the alias "The Diamond", as well as his secret identity as Monarch.
They were also aware that Ladybug has lied to the world about Gabriel defeating Monarch.
When the group asks Nathalie for details about The Diamond's final moments, since she was The Diamond's "Shadow", she claims she has nothing to share because she was unconscious at the time.
The only thing she knows is that his wish brought her back to life.
This statement is a ruse to protect Marinette and her identity as Ladybug from the organization.

title: El Toro De Piedra
text:
El Toro De Piedra - Plot
Despite Nathalie's lack of information, she suggests that the group reach out to Tomoe Tsurugi, who is using the alias "The Machine", for more answers.
When the group approaches Tomoe for an explanation, she also has little to offer.
However, she states that the specifics aren't important.
The only thing that should matter to them is the success of the "Perfect World Project".
She proposes to continue where Gabriel left off and asks for Nathalie to follow her if the group approves.
The group warns Tomoe about the consequences of failure, but she assures them that she never fails.
After a vote, Tomoe is granted authority by unanimous decision to continue Gabriel's work so that the organization can acquire the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses for their Perfect World Project.
Once all the other members leave, one remaining member, represented by a stalk of wheat, reminds Nathalie of his own plans for the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses and asks if she understands his orders.
Nathalie confirms her understanding, revealing that this member is her father, Camilo Pista.

title: El Toro De Piedra
text:
El Toro De Piedra - Plot Developments
More about Ivan is revealed in this episode:
It's shown that Ivan has Spanish ancestry.
His father, Raúl, was a criminal known as El Toro and is now part of Mayoress Bustier's project "New Chances", where he was given a job as a security guard at the Louvre. Raúl also implies that his wife, Ivan's mother, was also a criminal.
Knowing of his father's former criminal persona might have subconsciously inspired Ivan's more bull-like appearance (compared to an Ox) as Minotaurox.
Due to his father's criminal background, Ivan was raised by his grandmother.
His father had been pressuring him to be a criminal like him, something that Ivan does not want to be, with those frustrations of his being behind of some of his outbursts.
It is revealed that Gabriel left a will to Adrien prior to his final battle against Ladybug/Bug Noire. It revealed his former identity as Monarch and expressed his intention of having Adrien carry on the hunt for the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses.
It's possible Gabriel left this will due to realizing he was running out of time as Monarch due to his Cataclysm wound.
It's revealed that Luka is still in Brazil, despite Monarch's defeat.

title: El Toro De Piedra
text:
El Toro De Piedra - Plot Developments
The reason behind this, revealed in "Mister Agreste", is that there is a new Butterfly Miraculous Holder and he fears being akumatized due to still being in love with Marinette.
The scene where Marinette talks to Luka after her talk with Nathalie had been revealed during a script reading on Gloob's Miraculous Day 2024.
This is the first time that Chrysalis directly requests retrieving Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses to her akumatized victim before akumatizing them, instead of waiting for Ladybug and Cat Noir to interfere.
This is the second incident where a member of the Miraculers briefly renounce their Miraculous by feeling they aren't worthy; the first being Sabrina in "Daddycop".
It is revealed that Ivan did not wear his Miraculous at all times like the rest of his teammates due to the pressure his father was putting on him to follow in his footsteps and become a villain. That would explain why in previous episodes, like "Climatiqueen" and "Sleeping Syren", he was not seen wearing the Ox Miraculous.

title: El Toro De Piedra
text:
El Toro De Piedra - Plot Developments
It's revealed that Gabriel and Nathalie were part of a secret organization that wants Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses to make "the perfect world", with the former being part of a council of that organization known as "The Diamond" and Nathalie being his "Shadow".
This secret organization is well aware of Gabriel being Monarch and that Ladybug lied to the world.
Tomoe Tsurugi, known as "The Machine" will become in charge of Gabriel's mission, with Nathalie now serving as her shadow.
It's revealed that Nathalie is the daughter of one of the members of the council, whose name is revealed to be Camilo Pista in the subtitles on Hulu.
The name Camilo Pista first appeared in the telephone directory of Gabriel's cellphone in "Miraculous Paris" along with two other names, Francis Kasenti and Frank Masson.
Since Camilo was revealed to be a member of the organization, it can be assumed that the latter two are as well.

It is also a combination of both his son's akumatized and superhero itentities, Stoneheart and Minotaurox.
Raúl telling Ivan he's gonna make him a real bull with a "heart of stone" is direct reference to his akumatized self.

Both Raúl and Ivan's akumatized objects are letters.
One of the boxes in Adrien's room has the number 15 on it. This could imply that Adrien has turned fifteen, which would mean that his birthday occurred sometime prior to this episode.

title: Déborah
text:
Déborah - Intro
is a minor character in Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She is a young girl who needs her pacifier to feel reassured at night.
In "A Fairy Good Night", after her father decided to take away her pacifier at bedtime, she was akumatized by Chrysalis into Fairy Good Night, a supervillain capable of making people's wishes come true.

title: Déborah
text:
Déborah - Appearance
Physical appearance
Déborah is a young girl with dark skin and brown eyes.
Civilian attire
When sleeping, she wears a purple nightgown and a sleep bonnet, both decorated with yellow stars and waxing moons.
As Fairy Good Night
Fairy Good Night had light orchid skin and a large, glowing light purple afro with bright yellow stars. On the bridge of her nose were lighter freckles. She had golden eyes with light yellow eyeshadow and a yellow diadem-like marking across her forehead made of several diamonds, four-point stars, and waxing moons, with a star flanked by two more waxing moons at the center. Her eyelashes were a dull purple and turned pointy, resembling stars.
She wore a light orchid nightgown decorated with yellow stars and waxing moons, large puffy sleeves, a ruffly neckline and skirt trim, and pointed yellow shoulder pads. She also wore light purple glittery wristbands reaching the lower arm, connected to a yellow star on the middle finger. Her akumatized object, her pacifier, became a yellow star-shaped one with holes on each point. She was barefoot.

title: Déborah
text:
Déborah - Appearance
Fairy Good Night rested in a lilac glowing waxing moon, decorated with deep indigo curtains accented by yellow stars and waxing moons, held by yellow star clips.

title: Déborah
text:
Déborah - Personality
Not much is known about Déborah, except that she is very attached to her pacifier, as she finds it hard to fall asleep without it. Her dependence on the pacifier caused her father to take it away from her, which caused great distress and led to her being akumatized. After being deakumatized by the Miraculers, Pegasus, sympathizing with her, reassured her that she will one day be able to stop using the pacifier when she feels ready, and Ladybug helped her talk with her father about the best way to deal with the situation.
As Fairy Good Night, she wanted nothing more than to peacefully sleep on the Moon while sucking on her pacifier. While doing so, she used the Moon to channel her power to grant people's wishes, believing she was doing good. However, when someone disrupted her sleep or tried to steal her pacifier, she became very defensive. Due to still being a child, she also threw tantrums.

title: Déborah
text:
Déborah - Abilities
As Fairy Good Night, she was capable of changing the shape of the Moon into that of a pacifier. Through the Moon, she could channel her power to bring people's wishes into reality. However, most likely due to her young age, she did not fully control how the wishes manifest. Some of them became twisted (such as a giant meringue monster chasing a man who loves meringue or a giant bookshelf chasing a man who wishes to read more), while others conflicted with reality itself (such as Marinette's wish for her teammates and herself not to be burdened with secret identities, which clashed with the need to protect the Miraculous and their loved ones).
She also commanded a group of selenite warriors that acted as her protectors. These guards possessed spears that they used as weapons and could throw at great speed. They were also able to reconstruct themselves whenever they were destroyed, even by Astrocat's Cataclysm.

title: Déborah

Déborah - Relationships
Family

TBA

title: Déborah
text:
Déborah - Etymology
The name Déborah is Hebrew origin deriving from "bee", most famously referring to the biblical prophetess and fourth Judge of Israel.
Her akumatized villain name, Fairy Good Night, is a wordplay on the saying "have a very good night".
Likewise, her French name, Fée de Beaux Rêves (meaning: Fairy of Sweet Dreams) is a wordplay on the expression fais de beaux rêves, meaning "have sweet dreams".

title: Déborah
text:
Déborah - Trivia
Fairy Good Night's powers are similar to those of Sandboy - both bring specific things about someone's psychoanalytic mind to life (their greatest dreams or nightmares).

title: Episode guide
text:
Episode guide - Intro
The following is a list of episodes for Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir and related media.
From 2015 to 2026, six seasons have been aired. Season 7 is currently scheduled to premiere in November 2026, and three additional seasons are in development.
A series of TV movies called Miraculous World started airing in 2020. Five have been released, and a sixth one is in production.
Alongside the main series, there have been four series of webisodes released over the years.

text:
Ephemeral - Intro
"" is a Season 4 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 22nd written and produced episode of Season 4. It is also the 100th written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Ephemeral
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Ephemeral - Synopsis
To defeat a villain, Ladybug calls on nine superheroes when she only needed Cat Noir and his Cataclysm. But she could not reach him, since she doesn’t know his secret identity. According to the Celestial Guardian of the Miraculous, this situation cannot go on. It is too dangerous to leave the Miraculous of the Black Cat to a stranger. If Ladybug wants to remain the Guardian, she must find a way to tell Master Su-Han who Cat Noir really is. Someone needs to know. When faced with such an ultimatum, what will Ladybug do?
Disney+
Ladybug faces Ephemeral.
Netflix
Under pressure from Su-Han, Marinette asks Cat Noir to temporarily reveal his identity to her. But what happens when she discovers who he really is?

title: Ephemeral
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Ephemeral - Plot
The episode starts with Gabriel standing in front of Émilie's cryogenic pod in the repository. He says to her that he had done everything for her, and if necessary, he will do it hundred times over again. Then he gets a call from Nathalie telling him it's time for the conference of the 100th collection of Gabriel brand, and he leaves the repository.
Outside the Agreste mansion, Bob Roth's coin falls in a roadside sewer, and he becomes upset at the thought of losing money. As a result of Bob Roth's negative emotion, the Butterfly Miraculous glows, alerting Gabriel just as the limo pulls up to the conference. He tells Adrien that he is not feeling well and Adrien will represent him instead. Adrien tries protesting, but Gabriel insists while twisting his ring. Adrien sadly obeys and is dropped off alone.
Moolak, the akumatized form of Bob Roth, converts people into coins and storing them in his safe.
Shadow Moth reminds Moolak about the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses, and if he will not obey him, he will take his powers back.
Just then, Ryuko uses her lightning power on the safe but is unable to break it.

title: Ephemeral
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Ephemeral - Plot
It is shown that Ladybug, along with Ryuko, Pegasus, Vesperia, Pigella, Purple Tigress, King Monkey, Carapace, Viperion, and Polymouse are fighting against Moolak.
Ryuko says that it is impossible to enter the safe without opening its door.
Then, Ladybug tells Pegasus to use Voyage to get inside the safe.
But, when he uses it, he is unable to get inside the safe due to the lack of space in the safe.
Vesperia says that it must be cataclysmed to defeat him, but Ladybug replies that she had been sending Cat Noir messages but he isn't picking up.
During the conference, Adrien is watching everything unfold in the building while Nathalie coaches him through an earpiece when the battle above the building distracts him.
Ladybug eventually gives up and uses her Lucky Charm which gives her a fire truck.
Ladybug then ties up Moolak with her yo-yo while Polymouse distracts him by using Multitude.

Ephemeral - Plot developments
As of this episode, Luka is aware of Su-Han's existence.

It also appears that he's still unaware of Cat Noir's true identity since he cannot use his staff to locate him the same way he located Ladybug. As a result, he demands Ladybug find out who he is to secure the Cat Miraculous' exact location.
This episode reveals that heroes other than Ladybug and Cat Noir are able to use the ear communicator, as Luka is shown using it.
It's revealed that the Miraculous tools have synced digital clocks that aren't affected by GPS time satellites.
This also marks the first time Plagg attempts to Cataclysm a person, followed by "Deflagration". However, since these events would be reversed, then that would make "Deflagration" the first.

Internationally, this episode first premiered in France on TFOU.
This is the 100th episode of the whole show and was implied to be very important and impactful.
Ezra Weisz reconfirmed this episode along with "Glaciator 2" and "Gabriel Agreste" being very important on social media, and that they're the three episodes to watch out for.

To honor the achievement of the show of reaching the 100th episode, the number 100 is often used many times during this episode:
Gabriel tells Émilie that he would do everything he had done over 100 times if necessary. He would also try 100 times again to get the jewels.
The Gabriel brand celebrates its 100th collection.

"Ephemeral" is an adjective for something lasting for a very short time, whether a feeling of emotion or a plant, for example.
Ephemeral events in the episode include the short time Marinette and Adrien dated, the short time the titular villain is on-screen (only 20 seconds pass between his first and last appearance, of which he's only seen on-screen in around 10), and Gabriel's victory.
When Ladybug is seen failing to contact Cat Noir, she is left with a voicemail greeting. According to Ezra Weisz, the voicemail greeting was improvised by him and Bryce Papenbrook to include a cat-related joke for the English dub.

Both episodes show what would have happened if Ladybug and Cat Noir discovered each other's identities. However, unlike "Cat Blanc", where Cat Noir is the one to discover Ladybug's identity, "Ephemeral" shows what would happen if Ladybug was the one to discover Cat Noir's identity. Ephemeral - Trivia
In both episodes, Adrien would discover the truth about his parents. However, both moments would result in different akumatized identities and outcomes. In "Cat Blanc", Adrien was akumatized into Cat Blanc and, because he got divided between his loyalty to his loved ones, he ended up losing control of his power, destroying Paris, and damaging the Moon. In "Ephemeral", he would be akumatized into Ephemeral and controlled by his father to capture Marinette and take her Miraculous, so Gabriel can use the Absolute Power.
In both episodes, Adrien's akumatization would lead to a great catastrophe. As Cat Blanc, he would destroy Paris and kill all of its inhabitants, including Ladybug and Hawk Moth, while also damaging the Moon, which would lead to great disturbances on the tides. As Ephemeral, he would allow his father to get both the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses, being able to use the Absolute Power to grant his wish, which would cause the current universe to be destroyed, so it could be rebuilt.

text:
Ephemeral - Trivia
Several of the objects shown to be affected by the satellite, such as car headlights and clocks on ancient monuments, do not depend on GPS time in real life, and so will not go haywire when the satellite does. Also, most objects that are connected aren't connected every minute of the day, so will not act up and/or repair themselves the exact moment the satellite does.
When Ladybug transforms into Cosmobug her right arm doesn't have the space texture at first.
When Cosmobug and Astrocat reset the satellite, the clock on the Gare du Nord resets itself to 1:00, not 1:05.
At the end of the episode, North America is in bright sunlight. Because New York, is on the East Coast and is 6 hours behind Paris, it would have been 7:05 PM on the eastern side of America at that time, considerably darker, assuming the episode takes place in winter. The time difference varies depending on the date, but it would've been dark in America either way.

"" is a season 5 episode of the series Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. Based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 18th written and produced episode of season 5. It is also the 122th written and produced episode of the series overall.

title: Emotion
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Emotion - Synopsis
Adrien must attend the Diamonds' Dance organized by his father and Mrs. Tsurugi. He will be the king of the ball alongside Kagami, who has been chosen to be this year's queen. Neither Adrien nor Kagami want to go, but they are only teenagers who cannot disobey their parents's orders. When she finds out that Adrien did not dare to tell her about the dance, Marinette decides to go too. But how will she enter such a private event where she does not seem to be welcome at all?
Disney+
Ladybug faces Argos.
Netflix
Marinette sneaks into the elite Diamond Dance where Gabriel plans to pair Adrien and Kagami, but a more sinister intruder threatens to ruin the party.

title: Emotion
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Emotion - Plot
Marinette and Adrien visit André's ice cream stand, with the ice cream serving matchmaker happy the two kids are together. He narrates the ice cream and then gives it to the two lovebirds. They take a seat edge of the Seine, sharing their ice cream. After their long moment is shared, both slowly stare into each other's eyes, and attempt to kiss each other, but they are interrupted by the ringing of Adrien's phone.
In panic, Adrien quickly turns around and explains to Marinette that he's supposed to meet up with his father, so he cannot stay with her, although Marinette is doubtful if this is the truth. After Adrien leaves, the confused Marinette turns to Tikki, asking her whether Adrien seemed to be acting weird. Tikki shrugs it off, saying that they always act weird with each other.

title: Emotion
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Emotion - Plot
Soon, we see Marinette, Alya and Nino sitting together at a table, with Marinette talking about Adrien's strange behavior, and how he randomly decided to leave without telling her beforehand. Jokingly, Alya and Nino mock her, asking how out of all people, Marinette, the girl who's knows Adrien's schedule off by heart, doesn't know where Adrien is off to tonight. Marinette argues back though, stating that she gave up on obsessing over Adrien's schedule, believing him is free to do whatever he likes, and she isn't in charge of him. To answer Marinette's previous concern about Adrien, Alya pulls out her Alliance and searches up the Diamonds' Dance, a society ball that Adrien's father, Gabriel, hosts every year for his most powerful friends and their children. The group starts to talk about how strict the ball is, and the perquisite of being on the official guest list to enter, meaning that people like Kagami, Prince Ali, Chloè and Zoè are invited to attend.

title: Emotion

text:
Emotion - Plot
The scene changes to Kagami and her mother fencing against each other in an open park, until Kagami's mother states that they have to stop and get ready to attend the Diamonds' Dance. Unexpectedly, while walking towards a bench with her duffle bag on it, a familiar voice yells out her name. Lila, with a sad tone, asks if Kagami is alright, because "she doesn't look happy". Kagami then replies admitting that she is to go to the Diamonds' Dance with her mother, but doesn't want to go because her mother and Gabriel Agreste were planning to introduce her and Adrien as the king and queen of the ball.

title: Emotion

text:
Emotion - Plot
Meanwhile, outside the cinema, Zoé tells Marinette that she is not going to the Diamonds' Dance, saying that it is just a place where hypocritical brats go to. She gives Marinette a white mask, which is also an invitation and a security key to the ball so that she can go to the dance and so that no one will recognize her. At the place where the Diamonds Dance will take place, there are bodyguards scanning the white masks of the guests. Gabriel dismisses an incoming call from Lila Rossi on his Alliance ring, much to her anger. As he welcomes Kagami and Tomoe, the Bourgeois family suddenly enter, with Chloé rudely remarking Adrien must be late because of Marinette. As Adrien goes to the Diamonds Dance and flirtingly greets Kagami, Marinette shows up and a bodyguard scans her white mask.

title: Emotion
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Emotion - Plot
Inside the place where the Diamonds' Dance will take place, Amélie suddenly rushes in. As the bodyguards try to keep her outside and fail, she pretends as though Félix is still missing and criticizes Gabriel for not helping her to find him, to which he orders Nathalie to walk her out of the building, and Marinette takes her mask to the machine which scans it, allowing her into enter the place the ball will take place. As she enters, she is wearing a white dress and the mask. As she pretends to be from an immensely rich family and makes up a fake identity with the alias "Zoé" when Chloé asks her questions, she sees "Adrien" and Kagami sitting together high up. As they converse about Adrien's relationship with Marinette and also about her family ring, they see Gabriel, Tomoe and Chloé's parents sitting together in a corner.
As "Adrien" takes Kagami's hand and the dance begins, Marinette runs up to "Adrien" and tells him that he could have told her he was going to the dance.
Chloé and Gabriel become furious that Marinette is at the party.
As they dance, the robots scan Marinette and "Adrien" dancing and Chloé realizes that this was a result of Zoé and Marinette working together.

title: Emotion
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Emotion - Plot
When Marinette looks at "Adrien" closer, she realizes that he is not Adrien, but his identical cousin Félix and asks what he has done with Adrien.
Chloé jumps on Marinette to remove her mask and Félix transforms into Argos.
He then releases Red Moon, a sentimonster of his creation into the sky.
Argos explains Red Moon's powers: anyone bathed in its light will disappear at its master's command by snapping his fingers.
He makes Chloé disappear as the guests of the dance run away in fear and terror.
He then is confronted by his uncle Gabriel and makes him disappear, saying he is freeing himself, his mother and Adrien from him.
Argos is snapping his fingers and making everyone disappear.
He makes Tomoe disappear when Kagami is about to help her get up, much to Kagami's horror.
Argos grabs Marinette and leaps out of the building where the Diamonds' Dance is taking place.
At Marinette's angry demand of knowing what he did to Adrien, Argos states he cares about his cousin and takes Marinette to a bin and puts her there to keep her safe.
Marinette transforms into Ladybug.

She shows up when Argos is snapping his fingers and making random and innocent people disappear as Red Moon gets bigger and higher in the sky and angrily attacks him for his betrayal back in Strikeback, saying he's the reason she lost all the other Miraculouses to Monarch, accusing him of working for him without caring about endangering the people of Paris, to which Argos agrees but states that he works for no one and only helped Monarch to get his hands on the Peacock Miraculous and tell her about his plans and the wish he will make when he merges her and Cat Noir's Miraculouses: to be rid of the world's oppression.

By this time, the entire world will have bathed in the light of the Red Moon. Argos gets ready to snap his fingers to disappear all humanity unless Ladybug surrenders her Miraculous, and Ladybug uses her Lucky Charm and is shocked when she doesn't receive anything. She looks at him and then looks around for a way to defeat him. Ladybug realizes what needs to be done and accepts her fate as Argos makes her disappear in a puff of pink smoke. As Argos walks around in the streets of Paris, there is absolutely nobody left. Nobody that is, except for Kagami who is furious at him for his actions. Argos then brings Adrien back, leaving Kagami shocked. He tells Adrien and Kagami about how they are all in a world free from oppression.

The scene flashbacks to when Argos was at the top of a building. He creates an amok that enters a ring that looks like Adrien's ring and creates Red Moon. And later when Marinette and Adrien were eating ice cream at the Île aux Cygnes. Argos is hiding behind a tree and watches them and waits for Adrien when he runs off and he hides himself and Red Moon in a changing room and calls out for Adrien. Adrien goes into the room and sees Argos. He tells Adrien to come closer and snaps his fingers, making Adrien disappear. The scene flashes to the present where Argos claims that they can all be free as it is just the three of them. He asks if they are happy, to which Kagami furiously attacks him and Adrien asks how he can be happy if he doesn't have his friends, father, and the girl he loves. He is shocked when he doesn't find her there and snaps his fingers repeatedly, trying to bring her back but it doesn't work, much to his horror and Adrien and Kagami angrily convince Argos to bring everyone back and so he does. text:

Back in London, Argos de-transforms into Félix and hugs his mother as Duusu watches and agrees with his mother that Gabriel is a monster, but with a smile says not all of them are. The next day, as the damages caused by Argos is being repaired without the Miraculous Ladybug, André makes Adrien, Kagami, and Marinette ice cream. At the Agreste mansion, Adrien asks his father as to why he couldn't tell Marinette about the Diamonds' Dance, Mr. Agreste replies with that he doesn't want to hear about Marinette ever again. He punches his computer in frustration and anger, because he had enough of people who don't know their place. Outside the Agreste mansion, Lila says that she will show him that she is more than a bottle of perfume and reveals that she knows that he is Monarch as the episode ends.
