title: Emotion
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Emotion - Plot Developments
The episode shares its name with the concept of the Peacock Miraculous.
Félix Fathom, as the current Peacock Miraculous holder Argos, let fits of rage over the past blind and confuse him until he was set straight.
Meaning he learned the one trait he was missing to fully mastering his powers and that is: perspective. Learning it when he "disappeared" Marinette but couldn't bring her back and before, he experienced everything that others around him endured as well as being reminded of what he forgot.
Besides the power of Amokization, this episode showed the characters expressing their emotions openly and how those emotions has guided their actions:
Félix expressed his anger and hate towards everyone he perceived as oppressors, emotions that guided his actions to get rid of everyone except for the ones he cared about and/or sympathized with.
From a sense of corrupted freedom but, through Adrien and Kagami's perspective, he learned that it isn't only about doing what you want, but sharing it with others, taking responsibility for your actions, understanding that even it has a price and belongs to everyone regardless of the situation.

title: Emotion
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Emotion - Plot Developments
He wanted to free the world from oppressors, but by stealing the Miraculouses from Ladybug, he gave power to the biggest oppressor of all.
After realizing how he acted the same way as his predecessors before him, in creating a sentimonster to satisfy his selfish desires, in grief he releases Red Moon from existence.
Félix unknowingly felt shocked when he looked at Kagami's ring.
Even though Félix didn't want to hurt Adrien, he ended up hurting him anyway.
Marinette crashed the Diamonds' Dance to tell Adrien that he doesn't need to hide things from her in fear of disappointing her.
As Ladybug, she was still mad and angry at Félix for his betrayal and actions in "Strikeback", causing her to fight him aggressively but like Cat Noir in "Jubilation", she kept her composure to think rationally in asking him why he did it.
While dancing with "Adrien" at the party, she felt like an outcast class-wise.
Her no longer stalking Adrien (romantically) is a sign of the emotional growth she developed in "Derision".
Amélie expresses her frustration and anger towards Gabriel for the way he pushed her away, even ignoring her desperation in finding her son.

title: Emotion
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Emotion - Plot Developments
Both Adrien and Kagami (especially the latter as she witnessed it first hand) were furious at Argos for destroying everyone they loved.
However, unlike her, Adrien felt the same anger, worry and fear after losing a loved one and feeling helpless about it happening with his mother prior to the series and Ladybug in "Desperada" and "Hack-San".
The episode also showed people disregard the emotions of others:
Gabriel forbids Adrien from bringing Marinette to the Diamonds' Dance or even mentioning it to her, as he wants him and Kagami to be the King and Queen of the Ball. Later on, he forbids him from even mentioning her and also disregards Amélie (despite seeing how desperate she is for not knowing where Félix is) and Lila.
He and Félix both acting narrow-minded in regards to the wishes they desired, as they both were so wrapped up in their feelings that they forgot or didn't care about anyone else that got caught in crossfire, even reciting along with Nathalie in "Passion", "I have nothing left to lose".
It also showed people containing their emotions:
Kagami is still afraid of telling her mother how she feels. By the episode end's, she decides to do it.

title: Emotion
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Emotion - Plot Developments
Nathalie is seen containing her anger towards Gabriel for forcibly trying to join Adrien with someone else. It is also enlightened how she is going against her feelings to obey him, as it's the only way for her to get what she wants.
Even though he was unaware, Félix acted like the akumatized victims Monarch had created and similar to others:
The Bubbler, as they both were blinded by their rage and hatred towards those who had more authority than them but they didn't differentiate that there are good adults in the world too even though their intentions were pure and for the same person: Adrien.
Lady Wifi, as both wanted something so small but they went through great lengths to get it no matter who they hurt and when it came to said lengths they learned the hard way of why.
Miraculer, as both wanted those they cared about to be happy but they went the wrong way about it.
Pharaoh, as both assumed that Ladybug was a bad person when she is truly noble and just.
Queen Wasp and Dark Owl, as the trio wanted to prove that they were better than someone else but did the opposite.

title: Emotion
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Emotion - Plot Developments
Master Fu, both created sentimonsters with intentions that were pure but due to not keeping their feelings in check, their creations turned into real monsters but both were able to fix their mistakes or see the error of the ways with the help of others.
A new ability of Amokization is revealed, as not only the creator can give powers and abilities to the sentimonsters they create but the latters can also do that for their creators as seen with Argos and Red Moon.
So in this way, it is possible for a Peacock Miraculous holder to undo the damage they cause as long as they have the power to do it.
Since Argos initially didn't think about the drawbacks of using Red Moon in anger, it took action based on the holder's emotions or mindset despite being created for specific intentions, implying that the person controlling them needs to think clearly when using Amokization and directing orders.
It also reminds us that emotional battles, balances and freedom are just as important as physical ones but sometimes even more damaging.

title: Emotion
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Emotion - Plot Developments
Such as in "Cat Blanc", where Cat Noir was emotionally pulled between his loved ones and in "Ephemeral", where Adrien achieved emotional balance upon discovering Ladybug's identity and she knew his filled with joy that he didn't have to hide anymore.
Socqueline started to emotionally pave the way in "Derision", for not only for Marinette but for everyone to stand up against Chloe.
In "Re-creation", where Gabriel emotionally accepted that he was doing everything for himself not his loved ones or the people.
What Ladybug said, "Winning isn't always what you think it is", was true as she knew she couldn't win against Félix physically but won against him emotionally.
Félix begins to understand the emotional discipline all the good Miraculous holders are bound by like Ladybug and Cat Noir and why the Miraculouses were given to certain people so carefully.
More so, despite him gaining his physical freedom when his father had passed, it wasn't until this episode Félix realized he wasn't emotional free due to his father's influence on him and acted no different than him: being mad at others for something he didn't fully understand nor accepted.

title: Emotion
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Emotion - Plot Developments
When Ladybug warned him about the price and he said he was ready but when everything played out Félix discovered how wrong he was.
Where Marinette and Adrien were both emotionally choked by the responsibilities as their alter egos because of Monarch.
In trying to restore his life as it was before, Gabriel was slowly losing himself to his madness until Ladybug helped him see the truth.
The Peacock Miraculous represents showing emotions, everything they mean and like life, feelings should be respected despite taking it.
How bad Gabriel's influence as Monarch affected the people due to him always feeding off of everyone's negative feelings, the people couldn't express themselves freely anymore fearing that they'll have to keep them buried as Marinette mentioned in "Transmission" and more.
Like how Adrien as Cat Noir could share his feelings of love so easily, and was completely swooned over Ladybug but over time he moved onto Marinette.
But he didn't respect Ladybug's feelings romantically when she was in love with someone else at least not until "Perfection".
The same way Kagami learned in "Protection" and expressed while fighting Félix.

title: Emotion
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Emotion - Plot Developments
The emotions towards the sentimonsters were changed as Gabriel and Nathalie only saw them as beings to do their bidding and had no problems in destroying them while Félix's feelings towards them were genuine and harbored great sadness in doing it.
As well as being obsessed with trying to save the sentimonsters that he didn't consider that Ladybug and Cat Noir felt the same and just as the sentimonsters deserved to be saved so did everyone else.
He should've taken solace in a way sentimonsters can come back, normal everyday people (at least outside of the Miraculous Ladybug superpower) can't and just as human lives can be short as seen through various episodes so were the formers.
Like the alluring feathers of a peacock just as it's not good to be deceived by appearances it also isn't good to be deceived by feelings either whether they are your own or not.
If Gabriel had thought more clearly, Adrien did what he asked. It's likely that he assumed both boys switched places again and when Marinette crashed the party he believed that she was in on their trick but she wasn't. Plus, he also forgot when living in the world of rich and famous or in a small area word travels fast.

title: Emotion
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Emotion - Plot Developments
Through his madness, he blamed Nathalie believing she was responsible for starting Adrien's and Marinette's relationship but it was really him.
Similar to how Adrien was deceived when he spread his own kindness around just to find out that are some people who won't change and how as Cat Noir, he mentioned on occasion that it's not cool to play with other people's feelings.
Félix was so angry that he made a horrible mistake and like Gabriel didn't bother to fully understand Ladybug and Cat Noir.
Like how Ladybug and Shadow Moth, commented on Chloé's anger in "Queen Banana" and because of it along with her hatred, her desire for power and revenge she had no idea she was being played but still had to be stopped.
By giving into it Chloé also didn't have the emotional maturity to see that are staying as Queen Bee wouldn't do anyone any good.
In "Daddycop", Roger let his worry and protectiveness towards his daughter made him fail to realize why she had a hard time making friends.
This episode reveals:
That Marinette and Adrien are a couple meaning that they officially became one some time between the events of "Adoration" and this episode.

title: Emotion
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Emotion - Plot Developments
The reason why Félix wanted the Peacock Miraculous via extension, the power he needs to ensure he would get what he wants either by forcing Ladybug and Cat Noir to surrender their Miraculous so that he can use the Absolute Power to grant his wish of having a world where everyone is oppressed by no one and is free to be and/or do what they want or not if the heroes refused.
Why else he wanted to get rid of people in power because he was controlled and excluded throughout his life. Later in "Pretension", he mentions to Kagami that his father was even more controlling and strict than Tomoe, causing his desire to free oppressed people. Which is true in "Representation", as Felix is a senti, who was constantly controlled and abused by his father throughout his childhood. When Colt died, he seized the ring containing his amok, gaining him his freedom.
A new variation to the Lucky Charm: like in "Sandboy", Ladybug received no item as so but it wasn't a result of a power cancellation. Meaning in extremely rare instances, a Ladybug Miraculous holder doesn't always need a Lucky Charm object to defeat a villain.

title: Emotion
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Emotion - Plot Developments
The reason for this is either Tikki was aware of Argos' desire, or Ladybug realized that she couldn't defeat him, and since he already had the power to do what he wanted, it was best for Ladybug to let him see the consequences of his actions.
Which could imply that a kwami's level of awareness isn't limited to actions of their holders but also to those that around their owners too.
This is the first time where the powers of the Peacock Miraculous is used by a minor leaving Akumatization as the last Miraculous superpower that hasn't been used by a minor so the effects of it under these conditions are unknown until "Miraculous London".
Because Argos created Red Moon before transforming during the Diamonds' Dance, the detransformation countdown of the Peacock Miraculous isn't showed or mentioned.
Félix was in a dilemma too, had he known that Ladybug and Marinette were the same person, he would've been aware that he unintentionally roped Adrien into stealing from his girlfriend and attempted to do it again.

title: Emotion
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Emotion - Plot Developments
Interestingly it wouldn't have mattered if Marinette had came to the party or transformed at all because of Argos and his sentimonster. Had she not transformed to make it look like Ladybug was gone then, due to Felix not knowing that both girls are the same person; Adrien and Kagami would convince Argos to bring her and Cat Noir back telling him that they weren't the oppressors he thought they were. Then, if he was Félix would use his powers to restore them to prove it but due to his powers not working on those who have dual identities thinking he killed them leading to him learning his lesson another way.
Since Kagami knew of Marinette's secret back in "Perfection", this episode would act as her sign of proof.

title: Emotion
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Emotion - Trivia
This episode was finished as of September 10, 2022.
It's revealed that Prince Ali's chaperone is named Soraya Khan.
This is the first episode in which Gabriel doesn't transform into any of his Miraculous-wielding forms.
Félix is the second Miraculous holder to reveal his identity as such to the public, following Chloé, who revealed her identity as Queen Bee in "Queen Wasp" to the public.
Lila is shown to be one of the few people aware of Gabriel's supervillain identity alongside Nathalie Sancoeur, Adult Bunnyx, Félix Fathom and Tomoe Tsurugi.
It's implied that Amélie may be aware of Gabriel's supervillain identity as well.
This is the second time someone has to clean up the damage instead of using the Lucky Charm. The first happened in "Miraculous New York".
This is the second 18th produced episode to introduce a new hero, following "Ikari Gozen".
However, Félix only officially becomes a hero in "Pretension".
Coincidentally, these two heroes (Kagami and Félix) introduced in these episodes would later become a couple in "Pretension" as well.
Following Mei Shi in "Miraculous Shanghai", this is second time the villain of an episode sees the destruction they caused.

title: Emotion
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Emotion - Trivia
It is revealed that Kagami is a descendant from a family of samurai and she always follows her mother because it is tradition for her to obey.
This is first time Marinette is seen wearing a dress.
References
This is the third episode to:
Involve the physical appearance of London in the series, after "Startrain" and "Multiplication".
Have the last episode of season 5 where Kaalki is absent.
Where Marinette crashes a party or private event following "Party Crasher" and "Gabriel Agreste".
Where Félix impersonates Adrien and like the other times, it led to trouble following "Félix" and "Strikeback".
This is the fourth episode to:
Consequently, not to have any akumatized villain, following "Sentibubbler", "Destruction" and "Illusion".
Have Gabriel as a minor character in the permanent timeline, following "Kuro Neko", "Ephemeral" and "Cat Blanc". As well as one of the few episodes where he is not a major character.
Where Adrien doesn't transform into Cat Noir following "Style Queen", "Mr. Pigeon 72", "Transmission" and the preceding "Conformation".

title: Emotion
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Emotion - Trivia
Where Félix is the fourth character overall that wanted the hero duo's jewels for themselves besides Gabriel following Markov, Bob Roth and Nathalie.
Where many characters are technically killed in the show following "Timebreaker", "Miraculous Shanghai" and "Cat Blanc" but the first time it's does by the effects off a sentimonster.
To have Marinette's hair seen in a bun following "Animaestro", "Kwamibuster" and "Derision".
This is the sixth episode to:
Where the Miraculous Ladybug superpower wasn't used following "Ladybug and Cat Noir", "Catalyst", "Destruction", "Illusion" and "Intuition".
A character sings outside of a performance or recording, following "Princess Fragrance", "Befana", "Santa Claws", "Deflagration" and "Migration".
This is the second time someone dances to that song, after Gabriel in "Deflagration".
In Season 5 not to feature Gabriel Agreste, following "Multiplication", "Jubilation", "Derision", "Intuition" and "Protection".
This is the fourteenth episode:

title: Emotion
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Emotion - Trivia
Where magical charms don't appear since their introduction following "Sentibubbler", "Hack-San", "Ephemeral", "Kuro Neko", "Risk", "Evolution", "Destruction", "Illusion", "Passion", "Reunion", "Transmission", "Deflagration" and "Intuition".
Plagg doesn't make an appearance, following "Prime Queen", "Despair Bear", "Malediktator", " Animaestro", "Christmaster", "Truth", "Furious Fu", "Guiltrip", "Crocoduel", "Qilin", "Destruction", "Determination" and "Intuition".
that features a post-credit scene, following "Miracle Queen", "Gabriel Agreste", "Optigami", "Sentibubbler", "Dearest Family", "Multiplication", "Jubilation", "Illusion", "Transmission", "Perfection", "Derision", "Intuition" and "Protection".
Unlike several other times where Cat Noir was "deceased" at the villain's hands, this is the first time where it's done with Ladybug as well as being brought back.
This is the fifth time a character has a musical number outside the specials, after "Silencer", "Deflagration", "Perfection" and "Migration".

title: Emotion
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Emotion - Trivia
This is the twenty-seventh time where Ladybug's Lucky Charm is an object that appeared in a previous episode. (Including the vehicles in "Weredad", "Queen Banana", "Glaciator 2", and "Ephemeral" this is actually the thirty-first time this happened.)
During Ladybug's fight against Argos, a scene from "Evolution" is reused.
Ladybug saying, that "there is always a solution" is a recall to "Timetagger".
Even though Félix didn't realize it, he put Ladybug in the same situation she and her team were in during "Strikeback".
This episode bares similarities to "Evolution" and "Elation":
As both enemies got defeated by the qualities of the jewels they used in "Evolution", Monarch lost the Rabbit's Watch in his impatience, while Félix with the Peacock's brooch got taught the meaning of perspective.
The same as Adrien in "Elation", where Félix realized how wrong he was in his situation, what they both did to Marinette in one night, they did to someone else nor someone else did it for far longer.
Allusions
Felix's superhero name, Argos, is a reference to the Greek mythological creature of the same name, whose multiple eyes were placed by Hera on the peacock's tail.

title: Emotion
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Emotion - Trivia
The scene where Marinette got extremely angry and attacked a villain without thinking calmly, is similar to the "Samurai Jack" episode "The Search for Jack's Sword".
Félix does share some similarities to Lord Shen from "Kung Fu Panda 2" as both:
Come from high class families or royalty.
Are peacock villains; while Shen was an actual peacock, Félix was peacock themed supervillain.
Turned something that was supposed to be used for good to evil: for Shen his parent's fireworks and Félix the Peacock Miraculous.
Did horrible actions in desperate bids to change their fates: Shen killed all the pandas so no one could stop him, Félix used his powers from Red Moon to get rid of oppressors so he and others can live in a world where they're free.
But instead of causing happiness they caused terror and were reprimanded for their actions: Shen was banished from his home by his parents and Félix was chewed out by his cousin and Kagami.
But unlike Shen, Félix was able to undo what he did and felt great remorse for his actions.
Were defeated by great warriors: Shen was defeated by Po physically; Félix was defeated by Ladybug, Adrien and Kagami emotionally.

title: Emotion
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Emotion - Trivia
Félix does share some similarities to Lord Viren from "The Dragon Prince" as both:
Both used the conditions or situations of someone else (Viren used Sarai while Felix used Kagami and Adrien) for things they never asked for.
Both played the denial game and let his emotions and fears run wild using anything or anyone as a justification for his own selfishness until they accepted the truth with their deaths as atonement.
But unlike Viren and his uncle, Felix was "emotionally" dead while it took Marinette's "physical" death for him to see the truth.
Similar to Zubeia, Ladybug too is the protector of her home (Paris), but both were put through mishaps that they didn't deserve.
Errors
In the English dub, when Argos de-transforms, he says "Hold my feather" instead of "Fold my feathers".
In the flashback where Argos creates Red Moon, he doesn't charge the amok with energy, the amok itself gains energy by itself.
When Argos drops Marinette in the trash can on the sideview, it looks like she is still wearing her mask, despite Chloé having removed it at the Dance.

title: Ellie
text:
Ellie - Intro
is a girl living in Paris. She graduated from the Paris Art School and now is working as an artist.
At the "Miraculous Cruise" special event, she was akumatized by Hawk Moth into Invisigence, a supervillain who can make any monument in Paris disappear.

title: Ellie
text:
Ellie - Appearance
Physical appearance
Ellie is a girl of average height with blue eyes and brown hair with 2 streaks of green at the front. She has thin lips and a dark rose coloured  glossy lipstick.
Civilian attire
Ellie wears a multicolour shirt with mostly green and purple but with splatters of other colours as well. She wears high rise jeans, green socks and white trainers with pink laces.
As Invisigence
As Invisigence, she wears a purple jumpsuit, lighter purple tights and boots that reach her shins. Her hair is now in a green bob cut.

title: Ellie
text:
Ellie - Trivia
The character was created by Angie Nasca.
She has similar abilities in her akumatized form as the Magician of Misfortune.

title: English Channel
text:
English Channel - Intro
The  is an epicontinental sea of ​​the Atlantic Ocean that separates France and the United Kingdom. Since 1 June 1994, the Channel Tunnel has made possible the railway connection between France and England.

title: English Channel
text:
English Channel - Description
Located northwest of the European continent and France, the English Channel is a sea of ​​75,000 km2, about 530 kilometers long, with a minimum width of 34 kilometers and a maximum of 250 kilometers, all for an average depth of 54 meters while its maximum depth is 180 meters.
The English Channel is one of the busiest maritime areas in the world, especially its eastern part known as the "Eastern Channel".
It is in this part in particular, near the Pas de Calais, that the Channel Tunnel was dug under the seabed to connect France and the United Kingdom.
The Seine, the emblematic river of Paris, flows into the Channel at the height of the city of Le Havre (76).

title: English Channel
text:
English Channel - Trivia
In the series, the Channel has been important several times:
In "Startrain", after breaking the Channel Tunnel, the Startrain akumatized crossed the Channel from its depths to reach its surface, and then headed into space.
In "Multiplication", Cosmobug and Astrocat crossed the Channel from its depths to reach London.
Normally, it is impossible to exit the Channel Tunnel this way, unless you use the Cataclysm.
In "Conformation", the English Channel was crossed by Plagg while trying to reach Paris to give his Miraculous to Ladybug since Adrien had fallen under the control of the Alliance rings.

title: Emil Graham de Vanily
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Emil Graham de Vanily - Intro
Lord  is a character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He is the husband of Lady Milly Graham de Vanily, father of Émilie Agreste and Amélie Graham de Vanily and the maternal grandfather of Adrien Agreste and Félix Fathom. He is the Duke of Westchestermunster in London, England.
In "Werepapas", when his wife gets akumatized, the Ringmaster transforms Emil and Johnny Grassette into Werepapas, a boxing-themed werewolf duo. He and Johnny are forced to fight with each other for their grandson's custody.

title: Emil Graham de Vanily
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Emil Graham de Vanily - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Emil is a very tall man with a fair complexion, neatly combed gray hair and mutton chops, a hawk nose, and large ears. He also has brown eyes
Civilian Attire
Emil wears a tan plaid suit with a white high-collared shirt, burgundy color tie, with a gold brooch attached to it and a gold attached at the second bottom button of his vest. He also wears a large gold signet ring on his left ring finger.

title: Emil Graham de Vanily
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Emil Graham de Vanily - Personality
Through the way Félix and Kagami presented him in "Representation", Emil appears to be a traditional man that cared about the legacy of his noble and aristocratic family. He is very chauvinistic towards his wife, snapping at her whenever she attempts to voice out her opinion until after she is deakumatized.
When Émilie was growing up, Emil worried she wasn't sure if he was right to entrust the family's legacy to her due to her rebellious nature, including when Émilie decided to give up everything for Gabriel, who went by Gabi Grassette, Emil was furious but was willing to help the couple conceive a child and gave his Parisian home to them. Once he comes to Paris to visit his grandson Adrien, as both his parents had passed, Emil still speaks ill of Gabriel's occupation and background and his late daughter's decision to be with him.

title: Emil Graham de Vanily
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Emil Graham de Vanily - Personality
He calls Adrien a half-decent looking child. Due to this, he is determined to get full custody of his grandson while dismissing Nathalie as an employee and Gabriel's parents. He even goes as far to forcing the two to sign a contract so they can cut ties with their grandson. Due to his wealth, Emil believes he can get whatever he wants as long as he offers enough money. Emil is short-tempered, having a tendency to slam and bang his fists, scream, and shout at anyone or anything who displease him at the slightest, such as Milly trying to speak up, or Johnny's profession as a fast food owner.
When he's transformed by his akumatized wife into a werewolf, he retains his attitude, but apologizes whenever he does something wrong, especially when he's forced to attack Johnny and Ladybug. After his wife is deakumatized, he starts to let her express her opinions and warms up to his grandson and his paternal grandparents. He respects Adrien's decision to stay in Paris with Nathalie as his legal guardian. He likes things uncommon for aristocrats, like French fries, much to the Grassettes' satisfaction.

title: Emil Graham de Vanily
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Emil Graham de Vanily - Relationships
Family
Milly Graham de Vanily
His wife, Emil usually had a controlling nature in their relationship. He went as far as to grabbing her wrist to stop her from greeting the Grassettes and constantly ridicule her to the point where he called her opinions useless (which he would care less of his own wife's words and suggestions). He would even scream at her to stay in her place and to keep quiet making her his own slave, which lead to her akumatization. After she is deakumatized, she finally stands up to him.
Émilie Agreste
His eldest daughter, Emil originally believed Émilie was worthy of inheriting the kingdom until he realized how different she was from his expectations, making him wonder if he and Milly was right to entrust her with the family's future.
After Émilie decided to stay in Paris and marry a then humble Gabriel, Emil became outraged at his daughter's choice and disowned her.
However, despite this, he was still willing to help her to get the best medical treatments after she was unable to have a child and also by giving her his mansion to live in Paris.
After Émilie's death, he still thinks lowly of her decision of marrying Gabriel.
Amélie Graham de Vanily

title: Emil Graham de Vanily
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Emil Graham de Vanily - Relationships
Amélie was the opposite of Émilie growing up as she was more obedient and docile. Emil made his younger daughter, Amélie, his heiress after Émilie renounced her title to be with Gabriel. He and Milly also arranged her marriage to Colt Fathom, despite the unhappiness it caused her.
Also, due to Amélie's infertility, Emil was willing to help his younger daughter to have a child with the best medical treatments, albeit without success.
Adrien Agreste
One of his grandsons, Emil first met Adrien sometime following Gabriel's death, with the intention of claiming guardianship over the young boy.
However, when he's introduced to his grandson, he greets him coldly, due to his dislike of his son-in-law and his oldest daughter's decision to marry him, saying that Gabriel and Émilie had a "half-decent looking child" and insisted that Adrien called him "Lord Graham" instead of "Grandfather".

title: Emil Graham de Vanily
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Emil Graham de Vanily - Relationships
During a lunch with his grandson and Adrien's paternal grandparents, Emil immediately wanted to claim full custody of his grandson, regardless of what he wants, dismissing that he was in the care of Nathalie and also wanted to keep him away from Gabriel's parents to protect his family's reputation, and demanded Adrien to hand over the Graham de Vanily Twin Rings to him, which Adrien reluctantly does.
This leads to Milly's akumatization to decide who will get their grandson's custody.
After Milly is deakumatized, Emil softens and allows his grandson to stay in Nathalie's custody, while welcoming him to visit him and his wife.
Gabriel Agreste
Emil detested Gabriel for his lowly background and occupation, even after his death, calling him Émilie's dressmaker husband.
Unknown to Emil, he initially acted similar to Gabriel regarding Adrien, as both of them wanted to decide for Adrien instead of letting him choose what he wants and also wanting to take the boy to London away from Nathalie, his girlfriend and life in Paris.
However, unlike Gabriel, he in the end accepted Adrien's decision to stay in Paris with Nathalie.

title: Emil Graham de Vanily
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Emil Graham de Vanily - Relationships
Also, like the rest of the world, Emil is unaware of Gabriel's villainous identity as Monarch.
Colt Fathom
Because of Colt's wealth and status, Emil arranged his and Amélie's marriage to please him and his wife, Milly. He and Milly tried to help Colt and Amélie conceive a child but with no success.
Acquaintances
Johnny Grassette
Emil initially looked down at Johnny due to his profession and immediately wanted to get him and his wife Gabrielle to sign a contract to grant him and Milly full custody of Adrien, while also forbidding Johnny and Gabrielle to have any contact with their grandson, which Johnny quickly refused to sign, even after Emil offered to pay him and Gabrielle off (the same thing he tried to do 16 years ago) and began to argue with Emil, especially after he accused Johnny of stealing the Twin Rings, which led to Milly's akumatization, who forced Johnny and Emil to physically fight against each other for Adrien's custody, which both grandfathers didn't want to do and quickly apologized to each other.

title: Emil Graham de Vanily
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Emil Graham de Vanily - Relationships
After Milly's deakumatization and Adrien decision to stay with Nathalie, both Emil and Johnny were in better terms, with Johnny inviting Emil and Milly to his French fry restaurant, which Emil accepted as he secretly liked French fries.
Gabrielle Grassette
Emil initially looked down at Gabrielle due to her profession and immediately wanted to get her and her husband Johnny to sign a contract to grant him and Milly full custody of Adrien, while also forbidding Gabrielle and Johnny to have any contact with their grandson, which Gabrielle called monstrous, even after Emil offered to pay her and Gabrielle off (as he tried to do 16 years ago).
Nathalie Sancoeur
Emil knew Nathalie as an employee of his late daughter and son-in-law.
When Nathalie formally greeted Emil and Milly, Emil rudely dismissed her by reminding her that the Agreste mansion used to belong to him and his wife.
When Emil is discussing with Adrien's other grandparents about who will get custody of Adrien, he dismisses Nathalie's care for him, stating she's an employee without legal right to take care of his grandson unlike him and his wife.

However, after Milly's deakumatization, Emil softened and after seeing Adrien hugging Nathalie and stating he wants to live with her, he recognizes Nathalie as Adrien's legal guardian.
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/Ladybug
Emil first met Marinette when she was disguised as a young maid who served their food during the lunch where they discussed about Adrien's custody.
Emil glared angrily at Marinette when she tried to defend Adrien, by stating he wasn't alone, before the girl corrected herself.
Unknown to Emil, she was actually his grandson Adrien's girlfriend, who like Adrien, opposed the idea of Emil and Milly getting full custody of Adrien and taking him away from Paris, so Marinette tried to stop him by first preventing him from taking the Graham de Vanily Twin Rings from Adrien and then by spilling juice on a contract which would grant Emil full custody of Adrien and also force his paternal grandparents to stop having any contact with him.
As Ladybug, Emil apologized to the superheroine when his akumatized wife forced him to attack her.

title: Empire State Building
text:
Empire State Building - Intro
The  is a 381-meter (1,240 ft) skyscraper in Manhattan, New York City. Located on Fifth Avenue, it is the seventh-tallest building in the city and one of its iconic skyscrapers.

title: Empire State Building
text:
Empire State Building - Description
Built in 1931, the Empire State Building is an Art Deco skyscraper located in Midtown Manhattan. It stands 1,245 feet (381 meters) tall with 102 floors, and its antenna allows it to reach a height of 1,443 feet (443 meters). It is constructed of limestone granite with a steel and concrete frame. The facade is clad in Indiana limestone panels, which give the building its distinctive blond color.
The façade of the tower's floors is divided into several vertical bays on each side, with windows slightly protruding from the limestone cladding. The bays are arranged in groups of one, two, or three windows on each floor. The bays are separated by alternating narrow and wide pilasters. The windows in each bay are separated by vertical mullions and connected by horizontal spandrels between each floor.
The lamps illuminate the top of the skyscraper at night and can take on different colors, particularly those of New York sports teams, American events, community or personalities tributes, or during disasters.
It's also on the National Register of Historic Places. Therefore, the Empire State Building is New York's most iconic skyscraper, as well as one of its most important symbols.

title: Empire State Building
text:
Empire State Building - Trivia
The Empire State Building has been listed on the National Register of Historic Places since 1982.
The Empire State Building has been a National Historic Landmark since 1986.
The Empire State Building was the tallest skyscraper in the world from 1931 to 1973, surpassed by the twin towers of the World Trade Center.
From 1931 to 1973, then from 2001 to 2012, it was the tallest skyscraper in New York.
It was first surpassed by the Twin Towers of the World Trade Center before the September 11 attacks, then by the construction of One World Trade Center.
In "Miraculous New York", the Empire State Building was one of the skyscrapers destroyed by Majestia when under the influence of Miraclonizer.
However, it was erroneously visible in the background during the sequences where Hawk Moth appeared on screens in Times Square.

title: Fang
text:
Fang - Intro
is a recurring character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He is Jagged Stone's pet crocodile.
In "Guitar Villain", when Hawk Moth akumatized Jagged Stone into Guitar Villain, Fang was affected as well and was transformed into a fire-breathing dragon.
In "Crocoduel", after Jagged Stone and Anarka Couffaine were reakumatized by Shadow Moth, Fang was transformed into a dragon again.
In "Migration", after Jagged Stone gives up his fame as a rock star, Fang, Jagged, Luka Couffaine and Penny Rolling left Paris to prevent Monarch from targeting Luka as he knows Ladybug and Cat Noir's secret identities.
In "Re-creation", after allying himself with Su-Han and the Order of the Guardians, Fang returns to Paris to help out in the fight against the Miraculized. alongside Jagged, Penny, and Luka.

title: Fang
text:
Fang - Appearance
Fang looks similar to a saltwater crocodile. He is a large and pale brown reptile with jagged teeth and golden eyes with oblong pupils.
As a "helper" to Guitar Villain, Fang was a large purple dragon with large wings and brilliant green eyes.

title: Fang
text:
Fang - Personality
For a crocodile, Fang acts rather tame as he is never seen attacking people and seems fine with being a pet, as seen in "The Collector" where he seems to enjoy his owner's performance. He also has some dog-like behaviors as he wags his tail and hangs his tongue out of his mouth, as seen in "Pixelator". Fang doesn't like being pestered and growls at Bob Roth.
He is also very food motivated and has a sweet tooth.

title: Fang
text:
Fang - Abilities
General Skills
As a crocodile, Fang is a skilled swimmer and has a very strong bite with sharp teeth.
Although Fang has some atypical traits, he is still an animal, which means that he acts out of instincts. This turned out to be a crucial factor in Ladybug's plan in "Lies", because since Fang can't understand the concept of lying, he was able to enter Lies' sphere of aura without being paralyzed.
In "Re-creation", Fang shows martial skills having been trained in Mirakung Fu by Su-Han, like Luka, Jagged and Penny. He proves to be very competent and agile for a simple crocodile.
As a Dragon
When Jagged was akumatized and became Guitar Villain, Fang also transformed into a dragon. In this form, Fang could fly and shoot green fire blasts out of his mouth.

title: Fang
text:
Fang - Relationships
Jagged Stone
Jagged is Fang's owner. Fang appears to enjoy Jagged's company, even putting up with a collar around his neck, and he acts as a dog would to his owner. Jagged loves Fang dearly and treats him like a dog. Jagged pets and grooms Fang every day. Jagged is very knowledgeable about what Fang's needs are. Jagged doesn't appreciate it when people don't understand Fang's needs and requirements, including André Bourgeois.
Fang is also shown to care a lot about Jagged as he growls and glares at Bob in order to help him out in "Guitar Villain". When Fang is pixelated by Pixelator in the episode of the same name, Jagged is horrified, calling out for Fang.
Vincent Asa
Unlike Jagged, Fang likes Vincent and smiles while wagging his tail when he is around.
Bob Roth
Fang gets irritated with Bob. If Jagged needs to force Bob to do something, Fang growls and glares at him as a way of threatening him.
Chloé Bourgeois
After Chloé repeatedly drops her yo-yo on his head in "Antibug", Fang becomes angry and bites off the yo-yo string, causing the string to fly back at Chloé's face.

title: Fang
text:
Fang - Trivia
Fang is the first pet to have been introduced in the series.
In "Pixelator", André Bourgeois assumes the name "Fang" applies to Penny Rolling.
In "Guitar Villain", when an akuma flies into Le Grand Paris to corrupt Jagged Stone, Fang attempts to eat it.
According to Penny in "Troublemaker", Fang hates flying on airplanes in the daytime.
Fang's dragon form reappeared in "Crocoduel", while a scarlet version of his dragon form appeared in the two-part special "Heroes' Day".
In the Irish dub, his name is changed to "Scian" (Knife).
In the Norwegian dub, his name is changed to "Jafs" (Gobble).
In the Serbian dub, his name is changed to "Zubonja" (Toothy).
As seen in "Lies", Fang is the fourth character, besides Ladybug and Cat Noir, to break an akumatized object, following Queen Bee, Rena Rouge and Carapace in "Mayura".
Moreover, Fang is the first non-human character to destroy an akumatized object in "Lies".
He is also the first character who is not a superhero to destroy an akumatized object.

title: Fluff
text:
Fluff - Intro
is a supporting character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She is the Kwami of Evolution who is connected to the Rabbit Miraculous. With her power, Fluff's wearer can use the pocket watch to transform into a rabbit-themed superhero.
Fluff and her Miraculous are currently active and owned by Alix Kubdel, who uses it to transform into the superheroine Bunnyx.
After "Re-creation", Fluff still resides in the Burrow to keep the powers of the Rabbit Miraculous out of the new Butterfly Miraculous holders hands.

title: Fluff
text:
Fluff - Appearance
Fluff is 10 centimeters (or 4 inches) in height and has a white body, neck, a pair of white arms and legs, a white round head, two whiskers, and a fluffy rounded tail. She has pale pink eye shadow on the upper eyelids, eyelashes, and blue eyes. She has long white ears with rounded tips with baby blue inner ears. She also has two top front teeth with a gap in between them.
From Season 6 onwards, her eyes are now dark cyan and have black pupils with white dots inside them and her ears are slightly more teardrop-shaped.

title: Fluff
text:
Fluff - Personality
Fluff is extremely curious and full of energy, but she can also be easily startled. She is also somewhat of a scatterbrain with a tendency to be easily confused over what current time it is and having déjà vu on occasion. This is due to how much she travels through time and must be able to resist the temptation to alter time, much like Sass and their holders.

title: Fluff
text:
Fluff - Abilities
Fluff can fly, levitate, and phase through solid objects. She can also carry objects that are larger and/or heavier than herself.
As a Kwami, Fluff is able to transform the holder of the Rabbit Miraculous into a rabbit-themed superhero conferring the power of teleporting through space and time.
Since her wielder's can access the Burrow with the jewel and sense time disturbances, it's implied that Fluff can go there and sense disturbances too. As well as having her memory remain unaffected do to the changes or deletions of certain timelines.

title: Fluff
text:
Fluff - Relationships
Friends
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/Ladybug
Like Plagg, due to Tikki being out of the box she was aware of Ladybug's existence as Tikki's owner. After Marinette, as Multimouse, used the Mouse Miraculous' superpower to make small copies of herself, she hid in Fluff's mouth. The Rabbit Miraculous is one of the few Miraculouses that Multimouse didn't use to defeat Kwamibuster. After "Miracle Queen", Fluff and her fellow Kwamis accept Marinette as their new guardian and move in with her.
Like her Kwami siblings, she is friendly, helpful and supportive towards Marinette.
In "Strikeback", Fluff fuses her powers with Tikki’s and Kaalki’s to help Marinette defeat Risk.
By playing on Monarch's greed, Fluff was freed and very happy to see her Guardian in "Evolution".
In “The Dark Castle”, Fluff reunites briefly with her Guardian and fuses her powers with Tikki’s to help Marinette look after time while Alix is away.
Alix Kubdel/Bunnyx/Canigirl/Bunny Dog
In "Evolution", Fluff meets Alix when her Miraculous is entrusted to her.
In "Timetagger", after Bunnyx detransforms, Fluff looks between adult Alix and young Alix before sitting herself on her current owner's shoulder.

title: Fluff
text:
Fluff - Relationships
In "Evolution", Fluff's future self is briefly separated from her future owner Bunnyx after Monarch paralyzes her with Venom. After securing both versions of Rabbit Miraculous, her current and future selves are reunited with both of her owners, and remain in the Burrow for safety. However, it's unknown since Fluff was freed if she ever told her owner of the villain's actions or not, if the constant travels through time altered her memory so she couldn't or just like her owners (excluding Monarch) she had to wait until the right moment to tell.
Prior to "Reunion", Fluff gave Alix her kwagatama as a sign of their friendship.
From "Miraculous London", with Elderly Bunnyx from the future Fluff and her are going to be together for years to come.
Adrien Agreste/Cat Noir/Rabbit Noir
Like Tikki, due to Plagg being out of the box she was aware of Cat Noir's existence as Plagg's owner. In "Timetagger", future Fluff briefly meets Cat Noir's younger self when Bunnyx detransforms. In "Kwamibuster", Fluff's current self came to help save Plagg and by extension his owner from having his identity revealed.

title: Fluff
text:
Fluff - Relationships
In "Evolution", Fluff's future self fuses her powers with Cat Noir to stop Monarch from changing the past.
Alya Césaire/Rena Rouge
Fluff was aware that Alya is her guardian's best friend and her sibling Trixx's temporary owner then in "Gang of Secrets", she officially her and since then they been good friends.
Status unknown
Chloé Bourgeois/Queen Bee
Fluff doesn't know Chloé too well but she was aware that the latter was her sister Pollen's temporary owner however her impression of Chloé likely soured in "Miracle Queen", when the girl demanded Fluff and her siblings to give her their powers they refused.
Enemies
Gabriel Agreste/Hawk Moth/Shadow Moth/Monarch
In "Evolution", like the other kwamis, Fluff discovers who Nooroo's owner is and the reason for his actions. Later, she fuses her powers with Nooroo’s to help Gabriel change the past and prevent his wife’s coma but was rescued by Canigirl's ball, thus being spared from being caged and having her Miraculous reforged into a ring, unlike her Kwami brothers and sisters.

title: Fluff
text:
Fluff - Trivia
Fluff is the only one of the zodiac Kwamis that was not revealed in the TFOU promotion.
Fluff, along with Sass and Pollen, are the only Kwamis whose names are actual unaltered English words.
Fluff is the only Kwami whose Miraculous is not worn or attached onto any piece of clothing.
Thomas Astruc confirmed Fluff's name on Twitter on November 11, 2018.
Rabbits symbolize, among many things, vigilance, abundance, speed, and harmony.
The rabbit is the fourth animal of the Chinese zodiac.
In the terms of the episodes international release dates (including the special condition of Ikari Gozen) Fluff is the first known Kwami of the Chinese zodiac to be activated and used.
Despite not having an appearance in "Timebreaker", Fluff is the first Kwami to have her Miraculous destroyed followed by Plagg in the same episode, Pollen in "Queen Wasp", Nooroo in "Miraculous Shanghai" and Wayzz in "Optigami".
In "Timetagger", future Alix is seen feeding Fluff a carrot. This is a point of interest because despite carrots often being affiliated with rabbits, they are actually the rabbit equivalent of junk food. The primary food source for the average rabbit is hay/grass.

title: Fluff
text:
Fluff - Trivia
Fluff's name is a reference to a rabbit's most distinguished feature: their fluffy tails.
It's also fitting that Fluff's power is Burrow and that she is the Kwami of Evolution, because as time moves on, everything evolves and changes as it grows.
Fluff's appearance and power is also a reference to how rabbits live in the wild: underground in burrows.
Fluff's power also has another correlation with it's name as when it comes to creatures like rabbits in burrows there's usually more than one tunnel or way out similar to the ways of time travel as they are many outcomes.
Similar to Marc missing in Olga Mendeleiev's class photo in "Reflekta". Fluff not appearing in "Timebreaker" despite her Miraculous doing so is partially reasonable because by when this episode debuted Fluff's character along with most of the other Kwamis characters weren't created yet. But the in universe reason of why is still unknown however, it could be that due to the Rabbit Miraculous' nature or due to Fluff already being merged with Bunnyx and sealed in stone slumber is why she didn't come out despite her owner having her jewel.
Fluff and Kaalki are the only Kwamis with portal related powers.

title: Fluff
text:
Fluff - Trivia
Fluff and Duusu are the only Kwamis yet to appear in a Miraculous movie special.
Fluff is the only Kwami from the Chinese Miracle Box who was retrieved from Gabriel in Season 5 until "Re-creation" where Marinette managed to retrieve all the other Miraculouses.
Fluff is the second Kwami after Trixx to not be shown flying into the Miraculous during a transformation sequence, as only a burst of light appears in teenage Bunnyx's transformation sequence.

title: Feast
text:
Feast - Intro
"" is a season 3 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 15th written and produced episode of season 3. It is also the 67th written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Feast
text:
Feast - Synopsis
A strange statue uncovered in Tibet turns out to be a sentimonster called Feast that was created accidentally by Master Fu when he was a child.
Disney Channel
When Master Fu's past comes back to haunt him, he takes Marinette's and Adrien's miraculous back to protect them: that they are ready for anything to defend him, even if it means facing a sentimonster without their powers.
Disney+
Ladybug and Cat Noir face the sentimonster Feast.

title: Feast
text:
Feast - Plot
Nadja Chamack announces the arrival of a new statue at the Louvre museum that Alim Kubdel discovered in Tibet.
Marinette, who is at the unveiling with Alya and Alix, looks through the crowd of people to admire Adrien, who is also there.
Alya gets irritated with Marinette and reminds her that she'd asked Alix to get them to the unveiling so she can share her discovery about superheroes, not so Marinette can gawk at Adrien.
Once she has Marinette's attention, Alya starts by informing her that superheroes get their powers from jewels called Miraculouses.
Marinette stops her and reminds Alya that she'd said she wouldn't investigate Ladybug's secret identity anymore in order to avoid endangering her.
However, Alya says that her discovery is actually meant to help Ladybug unmask Hawk Moth.
She goes on to say that superheroes like Ladybug and Cat Noir have existed for centuries but the world forgot about them after depictions of them disappeared.

title: Feast
text:
Feast - Plot
She points out the papyrus showing the ancient Egyptian Ladybug along with a portrait of a knight who appears to be a Cat Miraculous holder, a portrait of a woman who appears to be a Butterfly Miraculous holder, and Hercules, who appears to have been a Lion Miraculous holder.
Marinette scoffs at the concept of a Lion Miraculous, with Alix jokingly suggesting that there's a Bunny Miraculous as well.
Alya goes on to say that statues were originally painted but most of the paint disappeared over time.
However, microscopic pigments still exist and, using a special app on her phone, she shows the girls that one of the statues at the Louvre is of an ancient Ladybug Miraculous holder.
She also reveals that every depiction of a Miraculous holder has the same symbol somewhere on them.
Marinette recognizes the symbol as the one on the Miracle Box, and Alya concludes that an Order of Guardians must be watching over the superheroes.
Alix takes note of the symbol looking like the one on the statue her father found.
Meanwhile, when Mr.
Kubdel unveils the statue he discovered, Nathalie is immediately shocked and drops the tablet she'd been holding.

title: Feast
text:
Feast - Plot
Adrien asks Nathalie what's wrong, though Nathalie insists that it's merely a dizzy spell.
Adrien suggests that they go home.
As they leave, Alix reveals that the statue is over 200 years old, and Alya reveals that there hasn't been any Miraculous superheroes during that time until Ladybug and Cat Noir showed up to fight Hawk Moth.
Alya is convinced that her video will help Ladybug unmask Hawk Moth.
Marinette worryingly asks Alya if she'll really post her discovery on the Ladyblog to which Alya reveals that she already did.
Concerned, Marinette says that she has homework to do and takes off.

title: Feast
text:
Feast - Plot
Marinette shows Alya's Ladyblog video to Master Fu and apologizes, stating that she never should've entrusted the Miraculous to Alya. However, Master Fu points out that Alya is an excellent reporter and would've discovered the secret eventually, though he insists none of it will lead Hawk Moth to him. However, when he learns of the statue at the Louvre museum, he flies into a panic and insists that they're doomed. Marinette is puzzled as to why Master Fu is freaking out over a statue, to which Master Fu reveals that it isn't a statue; it's a sentimonster created by the Peacock Miraculous. Marinette reminds Master Fu that she and Cat Noir have fought sentimonsters before, but Master Fu says that particular sentimonster is more powerful as it was created from the negative emotions of someone who didn't know what they were creating. He reminds Marinette of the mistake he'd told her he made and decides to reveal the full story.

title: Feast
text:
Feast - Plot
Long ago, when Fu was just a boy, he was chosen to become a guardian. However, Fu was unhappy with the training, preferring to be with kids his own age. One of his training tasks required him to watch over the Miracle Box for a full 24 hours without food or water. But as time passed, Fu became hungry and decided to use the Peacock Miraculous to create a sentimonster that would bring him some rice balls from the kitchen. However, his hunger and resentment over the Miraculouses created a sentimonster that wanted to devour all the Miraculouses. In his panic, he lost the staff he'd placed the amok in and was so afraid that he didn't think to simply destroy the sentimonster. One of the monks gave him the last, remaining Miracle Box and Miraculous Spellbook and said to run away with them. While running from the sentimonster, he lost the Miraculous Spellbook and the Peacock and Butterfly Miraculouses, and the temple of the Order of the Guardians was destroyed.

title: Feast
text:
Feast - Plot
Once finishing his story, Master Fu says that if Hawk Moth finds out about the sentimonster, he will use the Peacock Miraculous to bring it back to life. Marinette assures him that she and Cat Noir will be there to fight it, but Master Fu believes that they won't stand a chance and decides that it would be best if he took their Miraculouses from them and left Paris. Marinette pleads with him not to, asking that he trust her. Master Fu thanks her for everything.
At the Agreste mansion, Gabriel tells Adrien that Nathalie gets dizzy spells sometimes like his mother but they're nothing serious.
Nathalie thanks Adrien for being concerned, and Gabriel assures his son that he shouldn't worry about her.
Once Adrien leaves, Nathalie informs Gabriel that the statue at the Louvre museum isn't really a statue; it's a dormant sentimonster.
Gabriel tells her that she can either destroy it or bring it back to life, though Nathalie is worried since she wasn't the one who created it and, therefore, won't be able to control it.
Gabriel promises to help her, noting that it's from the region where he found his Miraculouses, and it could prove useful.

title: Feast
text:
Feast - Plot
He tells Nathalie that she must return to the Louvre at night, though when Nathalie starts coughing, Gabriel tells her to get some rest first.
Meanwhile in his room, Adrien practices piano while sadly looking at a photo of his mother.
Plagg asks him what's wrong, to which Adrien says that his mother used to get dizzy spells just like Nathalie and his father would say those weren't serious either.
In order to cheer Adrien up, Plagg plays a duet on the piano with him, which succeeds in making him laugh.
Adrien notes that only his mother could make him laugh and thanks Plagg.

title: Feast
text:
Feast - Plot
Late at night, Mayura sneaks into the Louvre museum to avoid the guards and heads to the dormant sentimonster, informing Hawk Moth that it is hungry for Miraculouses. She awakens it, and the creature immediately tries to eat her Miraculous, only for it to stop when Mayura threatens to take its amok away. Once she has the sentimonster under control, Hawk Moth sends an akuma after it, which the sentimonster ate it up. Hawk Moth offers it the power to track Miraculouses so that he can satisfy his hunger in return for two special Miraculous jewels of the Ladybug and the Cat after he swallowed up their owners. At first, he is reluctant, but Hawk Moth promises to give them back to him once he is finished with them and even offers the Peacock and Butterfly Miraculouses as a bonus. The sentimonster agrees the deal and is akumatized into Feast of increasing his size, who immediately begins to chase after the Miraculouses.

title: Feast
text:
Feast - Plot
While Adrien and Plagg are sleeping, Wayzz sneaks into Adrien's bedroom to take his ring. Plagg witnesses Wayzz about to remove the ring, and the latter apologizes before doing so. He leaves a note for Adrien on his bed, which wakes him up. Wayzz does the same thing to Marinette and her earrings. When Marinette reads the letter, she immediately calls out to Master Fu, who runs away on a bike. She chases after him but is horrified when she spots Feast running after Master Fu. Master Fu tells Wayzz that it's a good thing he took her Miraculous; otherwise, the sentimonster would've swallowed her whole. Wayzz argues that Marinette could've transformed into Ladybug and fought it, but Master Fu says that fighting is sometimes futile. Meanwhile, Marinette heads back to the bakery and puts on a biker outfit and full-faced helmet to disguise herself before chasing after Master Fu on a bike. Hawk Moth and Mayura see that Feast is running after a man on a bike and conclude that he must be the Guardian of the Miraculouses, with Mayura remarking that soon he won't have anything to guard as Feast will devour everything.

title: Feast
text:
Feast - Plot
A disguised Ladybug heads after Master Fu on her bike when she spots Cat Noir disguised as Mr. Banana on a scooter. She worries that his costume is unsafe, though Cat Noir assures her that he's wearing helmet and pads underneath. Ladybug gets annoyed because he keeps calling her Bugaboo and threatens to start calling him Banana Noir, which he likes. As Feast closes in on Master Fu, Ladybug decides to take a shortcut and gets the attention of a bus driver, informing him that she's Ladybug. Though the driver doesn't believe her, when she informs him that a man on a bike is being chased by a monster, he agrees to help by driving his bus in between Feast and Master Fu. Feast swallows the bus once the driver escapes it and continues his chase.

title: Feast
text:
Feast - Plot
Wayzz informs Master Fu that Ladybug and Cat Noir, despite their ridiculous costumes, haven't let him down. Master Fu finds that impossible since the two don't have their Miraculouses. Meanwhile, Roger agrees to help Ladybug and Cat Noir on the condition that they stay on the side of the road. Roger tries to get Feast to stop, only for the creature to devour his car and megaphone. André also helps Ladybug and Cat Noir by giving them a ride on his ice cream cart while they throw ice cream at the Feast. Wayzz tells Master Fu that there's no use in running as Ladybug and Cat Noir will always be there for him. Master Fu tells Wayzz that he doesn't want to be the cause of their downfall, though Wayzz reminds him that whether he likes it or not, he's the guardian. Master Fu agrees, calling it his decision before taking off the Turtle Miraculous, sucking Wayzz inside of it.

title: Feast
text:
Feast - Plot
Meanwhile, Ladybug and Cat Noir run out of ice cream to throw at Feast, who then eats André's cart. Ladybug tells André to get to a safe location while they take care of Feast. As Feast approaches the duo, Master Fu tells the sentimonster to leave them alone, announcing that he is the guardian of the Miraculouses. Hawk Moth is surprised that the guardian is an old man and tells Feast that he'll have no trouble getting rid of him. Master Fu secretly gives Ladybug and Cat Noir their Miraculouses and lures Feast away from them with the Miracle Box. Before Feast can eat him, Ladybug and Cat Noir, now wielding their Miraculouses, save him. Master Fu puts the Turtle Miraculous back on and prepares to transform, but his bad back prevents him from doing so. Wayzz reminds Master Fu that he's too old, and Ladybug assures him that she and Cat Noir can handle Feast. The duo jump in front of him, and Hawk Moth tells Feast to enjoy as Ladybug and Cat Noir can't get away.

title: Feast
text:
Feast - Plot
As the duo fight Feast, Ladybug says that they must figure out where the amok is, to which Cat Noir points out that Feast doesn't have anything on him. So Ladybug calls on her Lucky Charm and receives a metal detector. She goes to Master Fu and asks him if the staff he put the sentimonster's amok in was made of metal, to which Master Fu says partially. Ladybug figures that the staff must either be in the guardians' temple or inside the sentimonster. Feast winds up eating Cat Noir's staff and the bus Ladybug and Master Fu are hiding behind; so after getting Master Fu to safety, she ties her and Cat Noir to each other with her yo-yo and allows Feast to swallow them. Hawk Moth is delighted by this and tells Feast to enjoy the other Miraculouses as he's earned them. Feast chases after Master Fu while Ladybug and Cat Noir begin searching for Master Fu's staff.

title: Feast
text:
Feast - Plot
Master Fu decides to stop running and accept his fate, telling Wayzz that he's the best kwami he could ever hope for, with Wayzz reciprocating that it's been an honor to be his kwami. But before Feast can swallow them, Ladybug finds Master Fu's staff with her metal detector, and Cat Noir uses his Cataclysm on it, destroying Feast and releasing both the amok and akuma. Ladybug purifies them both. Hawk Moth is angered at another failure, but when Mayura falls to the floor coughing, he checks to make sure she's okay. Ladybug uses Miraculous Ladybug to fix all the damage, and Master Fu thanks her since he won't have to run anymore. Ladybug says that she only put his teaching to practice. Cat Noir notices their Miraculouses beeping and realizes that they must take off. The duo bid Master Fu farewell before leaving.

title: Feast
text:
Feast - Plot
Nadja announces the mysterious reappearance of a temple in the Tibetan mountains that went missing 172 years ago. Clara Contard, who is on a helicopter flying above the temple, adds that all the monks who used to live in the temple also reappeared. Alya notes that the temple has the symbol of the Order of the Guardians on it and runs to add it on her Ladyblog. Master Fu and Marinette also hear of the news. Master Fu is relieved that his mistake was undone and thanks Marinette. He decides that one day, he will visit the temple and explain himself to the monks. He also decides that Marinette should begin her training as a guardian. But since Hawk Moth knows who he is, he cannot stay in his massage shop, so Marinette helps him pack and places his boxes inside a moving van. Putting on a fake mustache and getting into the driver's seat, Master Fu assures Marinette that he'll always be there for her.
In his repository, Gabriel declares that since he now knows what the guardian looks like, he'll use that knowledge to his advantage and prepare a dish of revenge served cold against the heroes.

title: Feast
text:
Feast - Plot Developments
According to Alya's research, the most recent previous Ladybug Miraculous holder existed 200 years ago, and there haven't been any other holders around since Ladybug and Cat Noir.
With that, she could be talking about La Mariquita or Bọ rùa since they were the previous Ladybug holders before Marinette between the early 1800s and the Order's destruction.
Since the Order's destruction was in 1844 and Tikki mentioned in "Bakerix", having an owner before 1988, it's likely there hasn't been any other holders around since Ladybug and Cat Noir for 30-170 years.
Unknown to all of them, the use of jewels began 14 years prior to Ladybug and Cat Noir appearance.
The Order of the Guardians is revealed to have erased most records of the Miraculouses being used throughout history until their disappearance.
It is revealed that the Peacock Miraculous holder can sense amoks created by previous holders.

title: Feast
text:
Feast - Plot Developments
It is revealed that Master Fu's mistake, which was mentioned in "The Collector" and "Sandboy", was using the Peacock Miraculous to create a sentimonster to bring him food during his training, while being angry, caused his negative emotions to manifest as the creation of a beast with a hunger for Miraculouses that destroyed the temple and devoured the monks and the other Miraculouses there. The sentimonster embodies Fu's grief for looking after the Miraculous, as they were a burden in his life. This caused Master Fu to lose the Miraculous spellbook as well as the Peacock and the Butterfly Miraculouses.
It is revealed that the Guardians' Temple where Master Fu grew up was in Tibet.
This also reveals that, before using the Turtle Miraculous, Master Fu also used the Peacock Miraculous.
It is confirmed that other Miraculouses exist beside the ones in Master Fu's Miracle Box.
As shown in "Miraculous New York", when the Eagle Miraculous had been found.
This episode partially reveals the reason why Gabriel, Nathalie (had the jewels) and why Adrien and Marinette were given their Miraculouses as all four were needed to help Master Fu fix his mistake.

title: Feast
text:
Feast - Plot Developments
Partially personal for Adrien the reason why he was given the Cat Miraculous was so he could live a life Master Fu couldn't: a life of freedom and fun.
Master Fu acted like Gabriel as both caused mistakes with the Miraculous (arguably the Peacock Miraculous) and yet handle it differently Gabriel saw it best to hide his mistake while Fu found it best to run away but unlike him the former master saw it was useless to do so and decided to face what he feared.

title: Feast
text:
Feast - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in Canada on Family Channel.
Adrien and Plagg play the piano together as seen in "The Puppeteer 2". As this is when Plagg reveals his music talent to Adrien, that means this episode likely occurs before "The Puppeteer 2".
In "Sandboy", as Plagg and Tikki dove into the Miracle Box from the top view, one of the many things seen inside is a piano. So it's likely that Plagg taught himself how to play, learned from one of his previous owners, or from one of his other kwami siblings.
This is the first episode where the main villain is a non-sentient being.
This is also the second episode where a non-human gets akumatized, after "Robostus".
This is the fifth time Hawk Moth akumatizes a sentimonster, following "Riposte", "Catalyst", "Mayura" and "Oni-Chan".
Before Astruc's confirmation on BlueSky, this proves that a sentimonster can be akumatized just like a normal human.
This is the first episode without an akumatized object.
Hawk Moth discovers Master Fu's identity as the Guardian of the Miraculous.

title: Feast
text:
Feast - Trivia
As a result, Master Fu goes into hiding meaning this episode is before the events of "Ikari Gozen" and "Party Crasher" as Master Fu began to move and hide his identity more carefully.
It's after the events of "Backwarder", "Miraculer", "Desperada", "Startrain", and "Kwamibuster".
Adrien is wearing the Mr. Banana costume he used in "Kwamibuster", the previous episode production code wise.
Other Miraculous holders are revealed in this episode, with one for the Ladybug Miraculous, one for the Cat Miraculous, one for the Butterfly Miraculous, and it is theorized that Heracles used to be a Lion Miraculous holder.
After defeating Feast, Ladybug is able to restore everything the sentimonster ate, including the temple, the monks, and the Miraculouses.
This is the first time where Ladybug captures and purifies them both together at the same time, which is first done by Mister Bug in "Reflekdoll".
Given that the temple was destroyed 172 years prior to this episode, that means Master Fu was 14 when the temple and the Order of the Guardians vanished, roughly the same age Marinette and Adrien were when receiving their Miraculouses.

title: Feast
text:
Feast - Trivia
Since the timeline for the show begins in 2014 and the temple was destroyed 172 years prior to this episode, that means the temple has been gone since 1844 it's likely this episode as well as all the ones before and after it take place someplace in the modern 21st century, and this episode takes place sometime in the year 2016.
On the back of the bus, the "Adrien the Fragrance" perfume ad from "Gorizilla" is seen.
Alix makes a joking nod of the possibility of there being a Bunny and/or Rabbit Miraculous which foreshadows her obtaining it in "Timetagger".
Master Fu acknowledges Marinette as a full-fledged Ladybug and begins her training as the new guardian. He would make her the new guardian by the end of the season in "Miracle Queen".
After Ladybug and Cat Noir are swallowed by the sentimonster, Cat Noir observes, "It's bigger on the inside," a reference to Doctor Who's TARDIS.
In the background of the scene in which Master Fu leaves, the bridge over Canal Saint-Martin can be seen, implying that Fu's massage shop is near it.
This marks the fourth time Gabriel/Hawk Moth makes a pun about revenge being a dish served cold, following "Kung Food", "Glaciator", and "Frozer".

title: Feast
text:
Feast - Trivia
However, like in the first two instances, the pun was referencing the food/eating powers of the villain, opposite to the ice powers of Frozer.
During the flashback, as a kid Master Fu lost the spellbook when leaping over the lava crater, if the book had fallen into the lava then it would've burned to ashes. But according to Tikki in "Volpina", Master Fu had been looking for the book for a long time meaning that it was intact implying that it didn't fall into the lava or it must have other defenses besides the code written inside.
The music used in Master Fu's flashback is actually a remix of tracks created by Noam Kaniel for the second season of The Mysterious Cities of Gold, which came out in 2012, before he worked on the Miraculous soundtrack.
Errors
Master Fu said he was younger than Marinette when the incident happened, although he was the same age as Marinette at that time.
In the flashback, the Miraculouses of the Fox, Turtle and Peacock are camouflaged, just like in "Ladybug and Cat Noir".
Before Wayzz takes the Cat Miraculous off Adrien's finger, the ring is still in it's activated mode.

title: Feast
text:
Feast - Trivia
When Master Fu puts back the Turtle Miraculous, it is in its camouflage mode and, when Wayzz gets out, it appears in its active mode.
When Mayura de-transformed, Nathalie's bun appears before she does.
When Marinette first sees Feast, a glimpse of her earrings can be seen, although Master Fu had taken them earlier.
When the akuma is flying out of Hawk Moth's lair, the Eiffel Tower is shown in the background.
When Feast snatched Cat Noir's staff from his hands, and ate it, it cut right through its lips.
As Ladybug releases the purified akuma and amok, the glow effect inside of the yo-yo is missing.
