title: Feast/Transcript
text:
Feast/Transcript - Intro
[ Theme Song ]
Nadja Chamack: Don't be bemused, it's just the news! The Louvre Museum will be unveiling its latest acquisition today: a mysterious statue carved from hardened lava, which was recently discovered on the highest mountaintops of Tibet, by the museum's curator, Mr. Kubdel.
Marinette: (dreamy voice) Adrien.
Alya: Marinette, I asked Alix to get us into this unveiling so I could show you what I figured out about superheroes. Not so you could gawk at Adrien. You can do that any day at school, girl.
Marinette: Super Adrien... —ah, heroes! I'm all ears.
Alya: Cool, so first, you need to know that superheroes like Ladybug and Cat Noir get their powers from magic jewels called Miraculous.
Marinette: You told me you're gonna stop researching Ladybug so you wouldn't jeopardize her secret identity!
Alya: Oh, I—I know. Except this research has nothing to do with her identity. I'm gonna help Ladybug unmask Hawk Moth! And I think I found a connection between superheroes, Hawk Moth, and the Miraculous.

title: Feast/Transcript
text:
Feast/Transcript - Intro
Alya: Okay, I'm convinced Ladybug, Cat Noir, and other Miraculous holders have been depicted through the centuries. Until, for some unknown reason, they disappeared, and the world forgot about them. We already know this. The Ladybug from Ancient Egypt.
Alya: Here, a black knight, or Black Cat Miraculous holder. Come on!
Alix: Hmm...
Alya: And here, a lady, or a Butterfly superhero. Now this, Hercules, or Lion Miraculous holder.
Marinette: Okay, so now there's a Lion Miraculous?
Alix: Why not a Bunny Miraculous while you're at it?
Alya: Now you know back in the day sculptures were painted, right? Most of the paint vanished over time, but tiny microscopic pigments still remain. Thanks to this special app, witness how it originally looked. But here's the big thing. All these works of art have something in common. It's the same symbol! Look, it's everywhere. (Marinette gasps as she imagines Master Fu's mission) It's like some kind of secret society emblem. As if a kind of Order of the Guardians has been watching over the superheroes since the beginning of time!

title: Feast/Transcript
text:
Feast/Transcript - Intro
Alix: Huh, looks like the symbol on the Tibetan statue my old man found. (Mr. Kubdel unveils the statue, Nathalie gasps, and the tablet she's holding falls and breaks)
Adrien: Nathalie, are you okay?
Nathalie: It's nothing, Adrien. Just a dizzy spell.
Adrien: Maybe we should head home now. (Nathalie, Adrien, and his bodyguard go upstairs)
Alix: According to my old man, the statue is almost two hundred years old!
Alya: From what I found, there hasn't been any Miraculous-wearing superheroes for the last two hundred years!
Alix: So, this statue would be the last known trace of a Miraculous.
Alya: Until Ladybug and Cat Noir showed up a few months ago to fight Hawk Moth, yeah!
Alix: That's rad!
Alya: I'm sure my video will help Ladybug unmask Hawk Moth!
Marinette: Wait! You're gonna publish your theories on the Ladyblog?
Alya: Actually, I already uploaded a video.
Alix: The mystery of the Miraculous. It's beyond awesome!
Marinette: For sure it is, right? Amazing! I'm sure Ladybug will be super excited about it. And so will Hawk Moth. Uh, uh, I gotta go. I forgot I had, um, homework! Catch you later!

title: Feast/Transcript
text:
Feast/Transcript - Intro
Alya: It's like some kind of secret society emblem. As if a kind of Order of the Guardians has been watching over the superheroes since the beginning of time.
Marinette: It's my fault, Master. I'm sorry. I never should have entrusted her with the Miraculous.
Master Fu: Alya is an excellent journalist. Sooner or later, she would have unveiled this secret kept under wraps for centuries. But don't worry. None of it can lead Hawk Moth to us.
Alya: And that same symbol is on this statue that arrived at the Louvre earlier this week.
Master Fu: Impossible! That's impossible! We're doomed!
Marinette: Because of a statue? But just a second ago, you were saying—
Master Fu: That's not a statue, Marinette. It's a Sentimonster! A magical creature conjured from an emotion shaped by the power of the Peacock!
Marinette: But, Master. Cat Noir and I have already defeated Sentimonsters created by Mayura.
Master Fu: Yes, but...
None of them came close to the power of this one.
It was born from a negative emotion of a young man who had no idea what he was creating.
Remember when I told you I made a terrible mistake?
For you to understand, I must tell you the entire story.

title: Feast/Transcript
text:
Feast/Transcript - Intro
(as Master Fu explains, a montage of what happened is shown) I was younger than you when I was chosen to be a Guardian.
My parents told me that it was a great honor.
That I couldn't turn it down.
So they took me to the temple.
I wasn't very happy there.
I would have preferred to live with my parents and be with other children my age.
I didn't want to be a guardian of anything.
One of the test to become a Guardian required me to watch over a Miracle Box.
For a full twenty-four hours without any food.
All I had for support was my apprentice's staff.
Soon I was hungry.
With each passing hour I became hungrier.
And it was all because of the Miraculous.
Because I had to watch over them.
I couldn't take it any longer.
So I took the Peacock Miraculous and used its power.
All I wanted was a nice little companion I could sent to the kitchen to fetch me some rice balls.
But the Miraculous must never be used for the wrong reasons.
The anger I was feeling mingled with my intense hunger.
And I created a Sentimonster that was very different from the one I had envisioned.

title: Feast/Transcript
text:
Feast/Transcript - Intro
A ravenous Sentimonster out to devour everything, but specifically the Miraculous, since they were the bane of my life at that very moment.
In my panic, I lost my staff.
The very object that would have enabled me to control it.
I was just a young boy.
I was so afraid I didn't even think of destroying it by simply using the Peacock Miraculous.
I tried to erase all traces of the foolish thing that I had done.
A monk told me to run away with the grimoire he managed to save and the Miraculous Box.
The very last Miraculous Box.
That's when I realized my Sentimonster had devoured all the other Miraculous Boxes that were kept in the temple.
And when the monks tried to stop it...
the temple, the Order of the Guardians, everything, it was destroyed.
I tried to run away from the Sentimonster.
But by doing so, I lost the grimoire and both the Butterfly and the Peacock Miraculous.
I thought the Sentimonster had disappeared forever.
(montage ends) As soon as Hawk Moth finds out about it, he'll be able to use the power of the Peacock to bring it back to life.
Marinette: Master, if that happens, Cat Noir and I will be there.

title: Feast/Transcript
text:
Feast/Transcript - Intro
Master Fu: But you won't stand a chance! He's totally immune to the powers of the Miraculous! And please stop calling me Master. I have never been a Guardian to begin with. I will not make another mistake! You and Cat Noir will give me your Miraculous back and I'll leave Paris with the Miracle Box, since that's what the monster is after. It will come after me, sparing the city and its inhabitants.
Marinette: But what if it catches up with you this time?
Master Fu: That will be my fate. It's all my fault, after all.
Marinette: I won't let you leave on your own! When you chose me to become Ladybug, you placed your trust in me. I'm asking you to do the same today.
Master Fu: Thank you, Marinette. Thank you for everything.
Gabriel Agreste: Nathalie sometimes gets dizzy spells. But it's nothing serious.
Nathalie: It's thoughtful of you to be concerned, Adrien.
Gabriel: You don't have to worry about her.
Adrien: If you say so, Father. (walks away to go to his room)
Alya: And that same symbol is on this statue that arrived at the Louvre earlier this week.
Nathalie: I felt an amok within. This isn't a statue, it's a dormant Sentimonster. Very old and very powerful.

title: Feast/Transcript
text:
Feast/Transcript - Intro
Gabriel: Which means you can destroy it or bring it back to life.
Nathalie: But since I wasn't the one who created it, I won't be able to control it.
Gabriel: I will help you. It comes from the region where we found our Miraculous. I have a strong feeling it could prove very useful to my quest. You will return to the Louvre tonight.
Nathalie: Very well. (coughs)
Gabriel: You should get some rest before you go.
Nathalie: Don't worry, I'll be fine.
Plagg: Why the long face?
Adrien: My mom used to have dizzy spells, just like Nathalie. My father said those weren't serious either.
Plagg: How about a duet?
Adrien: You play the piano?
Plagg: My talents go way beyond sniffing out cheese, young man. (Plagg plays a duet on the piano with him)
Adrien: Mom's the only one who could make me laugh like that. Thank you, Plagg.
Mayura: I can feel its yearning, Hawk Moth. It's hungry; ravenous for Miraculous. (touches the stone and destroys it to release the Sentimonster.)

title: Feast/Transcript
text:
Feast/Transcript - Intro
Dormant Sentimonster: Yum, yum! Miraculous! (notices the Peacock Miraculous on Mayura and jumps at her and then unleashes his long tongue to devour the brooch, but Mayura dodges before holding out her fingers to stop the sentimonster on its tracks.)
Mayura: You take one more step and I'll take your Amok away from you. (the sentimonster roars in protest and Mayura moves her hand causing him pain, subduing it) Do you really want me to destroy you? The Sentimonster's all yours, Hawk Moth.
Hawk Moth: Ah, the frustration of a Miraculous just out of your grasp! I know that feeling of hunger only too well. (turns a butterfly into an Akuma) Fly away, my little akuma, and evilize this Sentimonster!
Hawk Moth: (from his lair) Feast, I am Hawk Moth. You have a consuming hunger that only the Miraculous can satisfy. I'm giving you the power to track them down and devour every single one! But after you've swallowed up their owners, you must bring two Miraculous back to me. The one of Ladybug and the Black Cat.
Dormant Sentimonster: (shakes his heand and growls harder)

title: Feast/Transcript
text:
Feast/Transcript - Intro
Hawk Moth: (from his lair) Oh, but don't you worry. I'll give them back to you as soon as I'm done with them. I'll even give you the Peacock's and mine as a bonus. And thus you shall have eaten every single Miraculous, and your hunger shall be satiated. Do we have an agreement? (Dormant Sentimonster nods) All right. It's dinner time, Feast! (Dormant Sentimonster transforms into Feast)
Feast: Yummy! Miraculous! (rushes out of the Louvre)
Plagg: Huh?
Wayzz: I'm sorry. (Plagg looks shocked as Wayzz is about to remove the ring, making the black cat kwami disappear, only leaving his Camembert and a letter behind, waking Adrien up)
Marinette: Wayzz? (read the letter) "Marinette, you're a most incredible Ladybug, but I cannot let you and Cat Noir risk your lives to fix a mistake that I made. I hope you can forgive me. Be happy and forget all about me. Signed, Fu." (the letter disappears) No way! Tikki! No! Master! Wait!
Marinette: No! Master! Wait!
Wayzz: Master, is this the best solution?
Master Fu: It's the only solution.
Marinette: Master!
Feast: Yummy, yummy! Miraculous!
Master Fu: See, Wayzz? If Marinette had kept her Miraculous, the Sentimonster would have swallowed her right up.

title: Feast/Transcript
text:
Feast/Transcript - Intro
Wayzz: Or she would have transformed into Ladybug and fought it.
Master Fu: Sometimes fighting is futile, Wayzz.
Hawk Moth: Feast is attracted by the Miraculous's scent. The man it's chasing can only be the Guardian of the Miraculous.
Mayura: Soon, he'll have nothing left to guard. (Hawk Moth nods) Feast is going to devour everything.
Hawk Moth: And we shall relish the taste of triumph, my dear Mayura.
Cat Noir (Adrien): Hi there, Bugaboo.
Ladybug (Marinette): Cat Noir? Is that you?
Cat Noir (Adrien): Of course it is. Who else would you expect by your side?
Ladybug (Marinette): Isn't that costume of yours a little unsafe?
Cat Noir (Adrien): Only on the outside. I've got a helmet and pads on under my banana peel, Bugaboo.
Ladybug (Marinette): If you call me Bugaboo one more time, I'll start calling you Bananoir.
Cat Noir (Adrien): As you wish, Bugaboo.
Ladybug (Marinette): Let's take a shortcut. There! The bus! Hey, driver! I'm Ladybug and I need you to help me!
Bus Driver: Ladybug? Right. And your buddy here is the famous Banana Cat, I presume.
Cat Noir (Adrien): Just call me Bananoir.

title: Feast/Transcript
text:
Feast/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug (Marinette): It doesn't matter who we are. That man is being chased by a monster and we have to help him!
Bus Driver: Okay, you can count on me!
Ladybug (Marinette): Thank you, Super Driver. Now!
Wayzz: Master, look! Ladybug and Cat Noir! Despite their ridiculous costumes, they haven't let you down!
Wang Fu: That's impossible! They don't have their Miraculous!
Roger Raincomprix: Okay, I'll help you, but ride on the side of the road before you get hurt.
Roger Raincomprix: In the name of the law, I... Oh, destruction of public property! I... Whoa!
André Glacier: My name is André, I make the ice cream, my friends with masks...
Wayzz: Look, Master. It's obvious it's them. Who else would do something so crazy?
Cat Noir (Adrien): Hey, have a taste of this! Some exploding banana split from Bananoir!
Ladybug (Marinette): Much tastier than any Miraculous!
Wayzz: Just look, Master. There's no use in running! Your disciples never give up the fight, no matter what! With or without their Miraculous, they are Ladybug and Cat Noir!
Master Fu: I don't want to be the cause of their disappearance!
Wayzz: Whether you like it or not, you're the Guardian!

title: Feast/Transcript
text:
Feast/Transcript - Intro
Master Fu: Precisely. This is my decision to make!
Cat Noir (Adrien): André, we're out of ammo!
Ladybug (Marinette): André, go somewhere safe! We're gonna handle this! (notices Feast coming towards them) I hope.
Master Fu: Hey! Leave them alone! I'm the one you have been wanting the past one hundred and seventy-two years!
Hawk Moth: (amused) The Guardian of the Miraculous is this decrepit old man?
Master Fu: Looking for this? (holds up the Miracle Box)
Feast: Yum, yum! Miraculous!
Hawk Moth: You won't have any trouble getting rid of him, Feast!
Master Fu: Go and transform, quickly! (He holds out one hand behind him with "Marinette" and "Adrien"'s Miraculous. "Marinette" takes the earrings and "Adrien" takes the ring.) I am the last of the Miraculous Guardians! And I intend to accomplish my mission! I am not scared of you anymore! (Feast grabs Fu's bike. Ladybug yo-yos Fu and the Miracle Box to safety.) Thank you, Ladybug.
Wayzz: I knew you'd make the right choice!
Master Fu: Come on Wayzz, shell-- Aaah!
Wayzz: Master, your back! You know you're too old to play superheroes!
Ladybug: We can handle this. Take the Miraculous Box and go hide.

title: Feast/Transcript
text:
Feast/Transcript - Intro
Hawk Moth: Enjoy, Feast. They can't get away from you now!
Ladybug: We have to find its Amok!
Cat Noir: Except this Sentimonster isn't carrying any baggage!
Ladybug: Cover me! Lucky Charm! (A metal detector appears) A metal detector? When you created the Sentimonster, you put the Amok inside your staff, right?
Master Fu: Correct.
Ladybug: Was your staff made out of metal, by any chance?
Master Fu: Partially, yes.
Ladybug: There are only two places where your staff could be. Where the temple was, or...
Cat Noir: Hey! Hurry, milady, this thing already swallowed my stick whole! Aah!
Ladybug: Go hide, Master! (Master Fu running and she ties her and Cat Noir to each other with her yo-yo)
Cat Noir: Uh, you sure it's the right time, milady?
Ladybug: Ready to get the staff back?
Cat Noir: Oh no, not the tongue... (Ladybug giggles, Feast swallows them)
Hawk Moth: Yes! Great work, Feast! Keep those two Miraculous nice and warm for me, and enjoy the other ones. You've certainly earned them.
Feast: Mm? Yum yum! Miraculous!
Cat Noir: Wow... It's bigger on the inside. Oh! My stick! (touch the bubble and it breaks into smaller ones) What is that? Is it digesting things or something?

title: Feast/Transcript
text:
Feast/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: Whatever he swallows gets sealed here forever.
Cat Noir: In that case, we'd better hurry up and figure out where the Master's staff is hiding.
Master Fu: Farewell, my dear Wayzz. You're the best kwami I could've ever hoped to have by my side all these years.
Wayzz: It's been an honor to be your kwami, Master.
Ladybug: I knew it! It had to be intact, otherwise the Sentimonster would have disappeared!
Cat Noir: Be careful what you wish for! Cataclysm!
(Feast bursts into bubbles and is gone, leaving Cat Noir and Ladybug on the street with the released akuma and amok.)
Ladybug: No more evil-doing for you. Time to de-evilize! (Ladybug catches the akuma and amok) Gotcha! Bye-bye, little butterfly.
Hawk Moth:(furious) No! That's impossible!
(Mayura falls down, transforming back. Hawk Moth rushes to her in concern.)
Nathalie: (smiles) I'm fine. (Hawk Moth looks unconvinced)
Ladybug: Miraculous Ladybug! (She throws the metal detector into the air, restoring everything that got swallowed.)
Ladybug, Cat Noir, & Master Fu: Pound it!
Master Fu: Thank you, Ladybug. Because of you, I won't have to run anymore.

title: Feast/Transcript
text:
Feast/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: I only put your teaching to practice, Master. (The earrings and ring start beeping)
Cat Noir: I know two people who'd better run before they transform back.
Ladybug: Goodbye, Master.
Nadja Chamack: Don't be bemused, it's just the news! Extraordinary and inexplicable!
(Gabriel and Nathalie are watching the news report.)
Nadja Chamack: That pretty much sums up the surprising reappearance of this temple in the Tibetan mountains—
(While Kagami practices kendo, Tomoe Tsurugi is listening to the news report.)
Nadja Chamack: —A hundred and seventy-two years after it was destroyed.
(Audrey Bourgeois is watching the news report with interest.)
Nadja Chamack: Let's go to Clara Contard on location.
Clara Contard: That's correct, Nadja. But what makes this phenomenon particularly unexplainable is that all the monks who used to—
Alya: Whoa! The symbol of the Guardians of the Miraculous!
Clara Contard: —live in the temple have also reappeared—
Alya: I gotta add this to the Ladyblog!
Clara Contard: —they disappeared in the year 1844!

title: Feast/Transcript
text:
Feast/Transcript - Intro
Master Fu: So my mistake has been undone. The monks have been freed and the temple has been restored. I can't thank you enough, Marinette and Cat Noir. I'm finally free from the burden of the past that has been haunting me for so long. I shall go and see them someday soon and explain everything to them. (Marinette nods) Your training is complete, Marinette. You are now a fully-fledged Ladybug. And the time has come for me to prepare you to become the new Guardian.
Marinette: The Guardian? But Master, you're the Guardian! You have been for a hundred and seventy-two years!
Master Fu: Precisely. It's high time I handed it over. You have proven that you are more worthy of it than I am. In fact, your training is starting right now. You will spend the next twenty-four hours meditating with the Miracle Box without anything to eat.
Marinette: Uh, actually, I... I need to help at the bakery.
Master Fu: (laughs) I was joking. Those strict traditions did no good when I was your age. I have no intention of continuing them. Instead, your first task will be to help me carry these boxes to my van.

title: Feast/Transcript
text:
Feast/Transcript - Intro
Wang Fu: Now that Hawk Moth knows who I am— (puts on a fake mustache) —it's too dangerous for me to live here. But don't worry, Marinette. Whenever you and Cat Noir need me, I will always be here for you. (climbs into driver's seat of van) I'm not going anywhere until Hawk Moth is defeated. I'll never leave you. (Marinette nods)
Gabriel: I have not digested my defeat, Ladybug. It's simply honed my appetite all the more. But now that I know what the Guardian looks like, I intend to put that knowledge to use and prepare a dish of revenge especially for you! And it shall be served... very cold.

title: Fei Wu
text:
Fei Wu - Intro
(吴飞/吳飛) (Wu Fei in Chinese order) is the titular deuteragonist of Miraculous World: Shanghai - The Legend of Ladydragon.
She is a teenage girl living in Shanghai, China. She was found by Wu Shifu as a baby on the doorstep of his Martial Arts School and raised by him as his adopted daughter.
Wu Shifu trained her in the martial arts and raised her to uphold the values of the Prodigious and one day take over as Guardian of the Sacred Cave. After Wu Shifu died and his school was destroyed, Fei became a thief to amass enough money to pay off a local crime boss, Cash, who claimed he could tell her the truth about her adoptive father's fate.
In "Miraculous Shanghai", she helped Ladybug and Cat Noir stop Hawk Moth from claiming the Prodigious. She began wearing the Prodigious herself and uses it to become Ladydragon, a dragon-themed, animal shapeshifting superhero.
In "Conformation", she was one of the people alerted by her Alliance ring about Ladybug and Cat Noir allegedly kidnapping Adrien and Kagami.
In "Re-creation", she joined in on the battle against the Miraculized.

title: Fei Wu
text:
Fei Wu - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Fei is a Chinese girl of average height and slender build who has black hair with very dark blue-violet reflections aside from a streak of strong amaranth down the left side of her head. She often wears her hair back in a long ponytail that runs about equal length to her shoulders and has dark brownish-gray eyes and light brilliant crimson lipstick.
In Season 6 onwards, she doesn't wear lipstick and her eyes become lighter.
Civilian Attire
Fei is often found wearing a black leather jacket. Underneath, she wears a black T-shirt with a design below the collar. It has a pink dragon and white clouds. Fei also wears a pair of blue jeans with a black leather belt and circular grommets. There is a red chain that hangs from the right side, paired with white combat boots. She accessorizes with a left fingerless glove and oval-shaped white sunglasses with a golden chain attached to the arms on top of her head.
As Ladydragon

title: Fei Wu
text:
Fei Wu - Appearance
Ladydragon wears a red and yellow bodysuit with black markings and her hair turns brilliant amaranth with her ponytail extended past her shoulders. She wears a red, yellow, and black domino mask with her eyes changing from dark brownish gray to luminous vivid gold.

title: Fei Wu
text:
Fei Wu - Personality
Fei deeply treasures the example and teachings of her late adoptive father, Wu Shifu. She has a strong sense of duty as the last Guardian of the Sacred Cave and this can lead her to take desperate measures to perform that duty. During the events of Miraculous Shanghai, she is forced to come to terms with the fact that this desire had led her to actually betray Wu's teachings and qualities, something that drove her to despair and caused her to question whether she deserved to be the Guardian.
Fei has a profound need to help people in any way that she can, even (and perhaps especially) strangers. It is this essential compassion and unwillingness to allow harm to come to the innocent that helps her come to understand how far she had strayed from being the woman that her father trained her to be.
While Fei has a quick temper, her good-hearted nature restrains her from causing harm. She chose to hand the crook Cash over to the Shanghai authorities rather than take vengeance out on him, even though his cooperation with Hawk Moth almost certainly led to her father's death, the destruction of his school, and the ruin of the only home and life she had ever known.

title: Fei Wu
text:
Fei Wu - Abilities
As a Civilian
Fei is highly trained in Kung Fu, and is very strong as she was able to repel and distract foes simply with the shockwaves of her punches and kicks. Later on, she was able to use the same power to destroy Cash's fan.
Fei is good at disguise and avoiding detection. She carries a number of simple disguises, mostly hats and sunglasses, that help her quickly change her appearance when she wishes to escape detection or evade pursuers.
Fei can play the squeeze-box accordion at a high level of proficiency.
Fei is bilingual in French and modern Chinese.
As Ladydragon
She can use the Prodigious to transform into any one of the eight animals that the Renlings resemble, so long as she possesses the value that a given Renling represents. For example, she needs to show calmness to use the power of the Bear Renling and needs to show patience to use the power of the Mantis Renling.
As Her Dragon Form

title: Fei Wu
text:
Fei Wu - Abilities
She can transform into a dragon as long as she possesses the value of justice. In her dragon form she is able to fly and she can manipulate the elements of a storm (wind, water and lightning), allowing her to create whirlwinds, summon water sprouts, and shoot bolts of lightning. The dragon is the most powerful form that the Prodigious grants her.
Her wind power is strong enough to keep a person aloft in the air, as seen when she saved Marinette from falling. Her water power is strong enough to hold back a gigantic foe, as seen when she shoot a water spout in YanLuoShi's face. Her lightning power was strong enough to clash evenly against a powerful disintegration beam, as seen when she countered YanLuoShi's attack. She can also conjure storm clouds all around her as seen in "Re-creation", but the effect is unknown.
As Lady Bear
She can transform into a bear as long as she possesses the value of calmness. In her bear form, she is very big and strong.
Her bear form is strong enough to overpower the enhanced strength of an akumatized supervillain like King Cash.
As Lady Mantis

title: Fei Wu
text:
Fei Wu - Abilities
She can transform into a mantis as long as she possesses the value of patience. In her mantis form, she is very small, making her hard to hit, and she is very agile.
As Lady Snake
She can transform into a snake as long as she possesses the value of courage. In her snake form, she possesses a long serpentine body that is highly thin and flexible. It's unknown if she has venom when she bites her opponents.
Her serpentine body helps her to avoid her opponents' attacks, as seen she avoided King Cash's blades and slipped between the cracks of the giant stone pillar that almost crushed her.
As Lady Monkey
She can transform into a monkey as long as she possesses the value of compassion. In her monkey form, she is very acrobatic and nimble.
As Lady Eagle
She can transform into an eagle as long as she possesses the value of confidence. In her eagle form, she is able to fly and can carry people through the air.
As Lady Horse
She can transform into a horse as long as she possesses the value of honor. In her horse form, she is a very fast runner.
As Lady Tiger
She can transform into a tiger as long as she possesses the value of discipline. In her tiger form, she has fierce attack power.

title: Fei Wu
text:
Fei Wu - Relationships
Family
Wu Shifu
She loves her adoptive father Wu Shifu deeply, treasuring his examples, teachings and doing everything she can to keep it alive as well as wanting to avenge him when everything he built was gone. However, in trying to do so out of revenge and desperation, it caused her to betray Wu's teachings and qualities as well as seeing Mei Shi as YanLuoShi causing destruction to the city drove her into despair and questioned whether she deserved to be the Guardian. She was aware that her father would devote his energy not to revenge, but instead something good with that in mind, she was able to unlock the power of the dragon.
Wang Cheng

title: Fei Wu
text:
Fei Wu - Relationships
Fei happily accepts Wang Cheng's hospitality at being invited to his 60th birthday. He said that the accordion was an instrument that he always wanted to play, but he never took the time to learn, Fei told him that she could play if he wanted and he agreed. Later on, Wang Cheng said that Fei was the magic ingredient that Marinette was desperately looking for after all. In "Re-creation", after seeing Wang being affected by the nightmares and about to be ganged up by the Miraculized, she transforms into Lady Monkey to save him and free the people from being brainwashed from their Alliance rings.
Friends/Allies
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/Ladybug

title: Fei Wu
text:
Fei Wu - Relationships
At first, Fei stole Marinette's things so that she can sell them to Cash for information about her father, but with him being sleazy about the price, she decides to return them. However, seeing that Marinette's earrings (the Ladybug Miraculous) may be worth something, they planned to have her pay a high price for them. In searching the city for her, they bump into each other while Marinette was trying to outrun people she thought meant to harm her and Fei helps her escape. When Marinette explains the importance of the earrings, she sympathizes and helps her to get them back although not by honest means, and was lectured about it.
She brings Marinette to her home and explains her own hardships, but just when she was going to tell her the truth, Cash beats her to it and Fei hesitantly explains her actions, leaving Marinette tearfully crushed. Seeing her new friend threatened, she refuses to let Marinette pay for her mistakes, upon seeing her trying to flee, she tried to protect her, but hearing Marinette express doubt, Fei begged for forgiveness. However, seeing that she wouldn't and ran, Fei was hurt.

title: Fei Wu
text:
Fei Wu - Relationships
During YanLuoShi's rampage, she reunites with Marinette, surprised to see her and shocked that she was forgiven, but retorts that she didn’t deserve it, despite doing it for a good cause. When talking about her father's values and with her help, Fei fully understood the dragon's value, using its power to save Marinette. Later, she comes to her friend's granduncle’s house and celebrates his 60th birthday with her.
As with Ladybug, Fei becomes acquainted with her, aware that she is one of the good guys, and accepts the heroine's help in getting Hawk Moth and King Cash out of the Sacred Cave using the Prodigious' power. She works along with her in stopping YanLuoShi from destroying the city, but when consumed by guilt about her actions causing all of this, Fei felt unworthy and left to sulk about her mistake until after a pep talk, they were able to de-akumatize Mei Shi and save the city. She thanks Ladybug for all she's done. As they celebrate her Uncle Wang's birthday, she offically dubs Marinette her sister-figure.
She fought for Ladybug and Cat Noir against the Miraculized in "Re-creation".
Adrien Agreste/Cat Noir

title: Fei Wu
text:
Fei Wu - Relationships
Fei doesn't know Adrien personally and even attempted to steal his ring, but, upon seeing his bodyguard heading towards her, she gave up. After Mei Shi is de-akumatized, she later comes to Marinette's granduncle’s house and celebrates his 60th birthday with Adrien and her.
She doesn't know Cat Noir too personally, but welcomes his help in getting Hawk Moth and King Cash out of the Sacred Cave using the Prodigious' power. She works alongside him in stopping YanLuoShi from destroying the city but when consumed by guilt about her actions causing all this destruction, Fei felt unworthy and is left to sulk, despite Cat Noir convincing her to try again, and when the city is saved, she thanks Cat Noir for all he's done.
She fought for Ladybug and Cat Noir against the Miraculized in "Re-creation".
Renlings
At first, Fei is shocked when she first saw them, but she easily got along with them and quickly adapted to her new powers.
After she failed to achieve the dragon transformation and Mei Shi got akumatized into YanLuoShi, she felt great depression for her failure, both to stop the crisis and live up to her father’s teaching. The Renlings felt sorry for her.

title: Fei Wu
text:
Fei Wu - Relationships
After Fei and the others returned to the Sacred Cave for Cash, Fei decided that she would not take revenge and instead let justice take its course, which made the Renlings cheer for "a truly wise Renren".
In "Re-creation", they, along with Mei Shi, comforted her as she had a nightmare about not being worth of the Prodigious and transformed her to fight against the Miraculized.
Mei Shi
Fei has a mentor-student relationship with Mei Shi when being tested to see if she is worthy of being the next Renren. Feeling that the dragon's powers weren't working, she was informed by Mei Shi that the dragon was the strongest of them all, and to master it, the Renren's actions must be noble and just. However, hearing Fei's use of the dragon's powers in revenge, she was told that her judgment and intentions were clouded, and unless she let it go, she wouldn't be able to ascend to it, but was more horrified when he was akumatized into YanLuoShi.

title: Fei Wu
text:
Fei Wu - Relationships
Upon seeing the destruction that he caused, Fei, along with Ladybug and Cat Noir, tried their best to stop him, but she was devastated that her actions caused everything, starting to believe that he was right and didn't deserve to use the Prodigious' power. So much that she fled in shame, and yet, when the two girls made amends, Fei finally understood what Mei Shi meant and the dragon's value, using it to stop his destruction, and with Ladybug's help, they de-akumatized him. She was relieved he was okay and, seeing that Fei had all the human values required, was recognized as the next Renren, and after retrieving the Sacred Cave Key, Fei and her friends were surprised and happy to see him again as her advisor.
In "Re-creation", he, along with the Renlings, comforted her as she had a nightmare about not being worth of the Prodigious and transformed her to fight against the Miraculized.
Enemies
Cash

title: Fei Wu
text:
Fei Wu - Relationships
Fei was willing to pay Cash any ransom of money by any means necessary to get information from him about her father. After stealing Marinette's things, she asked him if anything was of value. Upon seeing that her earrings could be worth something, she worked with him to get Marinette to pay a price for them. But when Cash is being sleazy about the price and backing out of their plan, she tricked him by swapping Marinette's earrings with the spare ones and left his shop.
She was devastated that Cash told Marinette the truth about what really happened and when Fei hears him disrespect her father she ends their deal. Moreover, when she finds out that he was the one responsible for what happened to her father, she becomes furious wanting revenge but was more shocked when he was akumatized into King Cash. Regardless, she fiercely fought him with the power of the Prodigious, and with Ladybug and Cat Noir's help, they de-akumatized him. After they had calmed Mei Shi, Fei gave him a hard scolding about what his greed made her lose, despite that, she would let him face justice in prison.

title: Fei Wu
text:
Fei Wu - History
Prior "Miraculous Shanghai"
Fei was found as a baby left on the door step of Wu Shifu's training school where she was adopted by the master being given her name "Fei" which meant "to fly in the sky" in Mandarin. For years she was trained by her adoptive father in martial arts, such as Kung Fu so she could inherit his legacy as he was the guardian of the Sacred Cave. However, their days together weren't always peaceful as Cash constantly tried to evict them for money every her father refused. As a teenager, the day had come where her adoptive father having complete faith in her entrusted the sacred cave key to her. And yet, to her horror, one night Fei had found her home destroyed and her father had passed away leaving her with the sole responsibility of protecting the cave. Later that night, she woke up from a nightmare, realizing her bracelet was stolen in her sleep and resolved to do anything to reclaim it.
Knowing of Cash's and her adoptive father's relationship, Fei made the deal with the black market dealer in exchange for information about her father, she'd brought him objects of great value at the cost of stealing from others.
"Miraculous Shanghai"

title: Fei Wu
text:
Fei Wu - History
While in the Shanghai streets, Fei was observing everyone despite doing a few good deeds until she spotted Adrien's ring but seeing preoccupied with a group of fanboys and his bodyguard she backs off. Later, while disguised she stole Marinette's earrings, kwagatama and her purse without being noticed except by Lian, Kang and Jiao then got chased by them demanding that she returned what she stole. Then in the street, she confronted the boys and easily defeated them and making her way to Cash's shop, dumping Marinette's belongings she asked Cash if there was anything of value offering 200 yuans for all of it. But Fei disagreed thinking that it would be better to return the items then heard Cash have her find Marinette to make her buy them back instead for more money.

title: Fei Wu
text:
Fei Wu - History
Searching the streets again, Fei bumped into Marinette finding her being chased by the three boys from before moving quickly hearing Marinette say that she probably didn't understand a word she's saying, but Fei confirms that she can and led Marinette away by slip into an alley to lose them. Afterwards, she asked Marinette what happened with her explaining that her belongings were stolen including her earrings and Fei asked if they had sentimental value, to which Marinette sadly confirmed. Sympathizing Fei admitted that she also had the same problem and resolved to help Marinette.

title: Fei Wu
text:
Fei Wu - History
Until they are spotted the three boys again and fled but seeing that Marinette's disappearance becomes the highlight on the news not wanting to draw attention the girls disguise themselves while Fei led them to a street full of pawn shops taking a bike to Cash's store and introduce themselves to each other properly. To which Fei explains her former life including her father's school had lost all the local customers and he wanted to teach Kung Fu to tourists before it was destroyed. Fei, upset, admits that she has become the exact opposite of what her father wanted. But that left Marinette, confused, upon hearing her friend compliment her bravery, however, she retorted and they arrived at Cash's pawn shop.

title: Fei Wu
text:
Fei Wu - History
Once inside hearing Marinette's excitement about finding her earrings in Cash's shop window at her friend's request Fei was asked to translate amidst her excitement but Cash like Fei spoke English too so translations weren't necessary. However, getting the earrings back were tricky as he asked for 100,000 yuans in return. Her original CGI model was first seen in Jeremy Zag's Instagram story on February 11, 2019.
Three days after that, on February 14, he released two pictures of Ladydragon: one with a 2D concept art and the other with the CGI concept.
It is strongly implied that she wears mascara, since it is shown running down with her tears in Miraculous Shanghai.

A similar case happened in the end credits for the Shanghai special.
Ladydragon's earlier outfit was inspired by Bruce Lee.

title: Evolution
text:
Evolution - Intro
"" is a Season 5 episode of the series Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. Based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 1st written and produced episode of Season 5, thus making it its premiere. It is also the 105th written and produced episode of the series overall.

title: Evolution
text:
Evolution - Synopsis
Following his victory over Ladybug, Monarch is now in possession of the Rabbit Miraculous. Now able to use the power of time travel, the supervillain wants to return to a point in the past when Ladybug and Cat Noir were weak and use that advantage to seize their Miraculous. Our heroes will have to face their enemy in a race through time… and their previous adventures.
Disney+
Ladybug and Cat Noir face their enemy through time.
Netflix
With Monarch in possession of the Kwamis, Paris is in grave danger. Can Ladybug and Cat Noir stop his plan to rewrite history before it's too late?

title: Evolution
text:
Evolution - Plot
The episode begins by immediately following up on the events of "Strikeback": at sunset, on the rooftops of the Jardins du Trocadéro, Ladybug and Cat Noir observe as the people of Paris cheer for them.
The newly named Monarch proclaims his rule on Paris, in a similar fashion to the events of "Stoneheart", but this time, through the illusion of the message retriever, which is surrounded by Shell-ter.
He says that he will continue to attack Paris relentlessly unless they bring him the Miraculouses of Ladybug and Cat Noir.
Nadja reports this and says that despite the threats of Monarch, the citizens of Paris still support the two heroes and throw stones at the message retriever; Monarch has won the battle but the war of the Miraculouses is just starting.
Even Ladybug argues back, declaring that no matter who he is, Hawk Moth, Shadow Moth, or Monarch, he will never get their Miraculous, and Cat Noir adds that they won't stop fighting until they get back all the Miraculous back from him.
Cat Noir destroys the Shell-ter containing the illusion of the message retriever, with only one strike of his staff, and Ladybug disposes of the illusion with her yo-yo.

title: Evolution
text:
Evolution - Plot
As the crowd continue to cheer for the heroes, Ladybug thanks Cat Noir, who replies that "it's you and me".
Meanwhile, Gabriel in his respository standing in front of Émilie, telling her that his victory is almost complete, whereas Ladybug assures people of Paris that Monarch's victory will never come. Sass warns him about a big price to pay for doing such a thing, but Gabriel silences Sass, similar to what he did in "Sandboy" to Nooroo. Whereas Ladybug and Cat Noir on the other hand tell the citizens they'll never be silenced and won't be Monarch prisoners. Gabriel correspondingly threatens and insults the terrified kwamis, deeming them as his slaves. He then calls Nathalie to tell her about his recent accomplishemnts; he has all the Miraculous that were previously stored in the Miracle Box, even the all-powerful Rabbit Miraculous that grants the power of Evolution. A hesitant Nathalie attempts to slow him down, but Gabriel cuts off the call and unifies the Butterfly and Rabbit Miraculous, transforming into Monarch.

title: Evolution
text:
Evolution - Plot
As Ladybug tries to figure out how Monarch stole all the Miraculous, she's instantly interrupted by a Burrow opening behind her and Cat Noir, from which Rabbit Noir and herself from a few minutes in the future are chasing Monarch, who is seemingly getting weaker unifying several Miraculous at once; all three of them exit via another Burrow.
The befuddled Ladybug and Cat Noir are greeted by another Burrow, from which the adult Bunnyx appears and explains to the duo the situation.
Meanwhile, Monarch plans to travel back to moments in time in which Ladybug and Cat Noir were vulnerably weak.
He enters a Burrow portal, and travels back to the events of "Lady Wifi"; specifically, the scene where Lady Wifi had Ladybug pinned against a wall.
Monarch enters the scene, stealing Lady Wifi's phone, pauses her with her powers, and prepares to steal Ladybug's Miraculous.
Meanwhile, Ladybug, Cat Noir, and Bunnyx enter Borrow, noticing Monarch is creating an alternative timeline by changing the events of "Lady Wifi".
Bunnyx rewinds time a few seconds back, removing Monarch from the timeline; Ladybug captures Monarch with her yo-yo.

title: Evolution
text:
Evolution - Plot
Monarch, in disbelief, asks how they were able to stop him since he has the Rabbit Miraculous, to which Bunnyx responds that Burrow can be accessed by any holder of Rabbit Miraculous regardless of what time they're from.
Ladybug once again uses her yo-yo to catch Monarch, but he opens his cane, taking all the Kwamis out, preparing to battle.
He unifies the Miraculous of Butterfly, Rabbit, Bee, Fox, and Turtle; by doing so, he gets weaker.
Ladybug tries to catch him, but he uses his strength to throw her off once freed.
He uses Mirage to create clones of himself to distract heroes, as he paralyzes Bunnyx with Venom.
Using Shell-ter, he tries to steal her version of the Rabbit Miraculous, but thanks to the heroes, it was prevented.
With Monarch getting weaker, Ladybug lassos him, again but he fuses with the Dragon Miraculous, using Wind Dragon to escape through a portal to the events of "Riposte".
Needing to match him, Cat Noir tosses the Rabbit Miraculous to Ladybug for her to use, as the Rabbit holders are the only ones who can open the portals.

The duo follows and fight Monarch through countless time portals, ending up in 1940's France.

title: Evolution
text:
Evolution - Plot developments
Alongside the previous and next two episodes, it forms a pentalogy called "The Rise of Monarch".
This episode begins where the previous episode left off. The events in this episode, alongside "Risk" and "Strikeback", take place during the same day.
Interestingly, if Gabriel had succeeded in giving his younger self the knowledge of how to fix the Peacock Miraculous, it would have created a paradox; if Émilie never fell ill from using the damaged Miraculous, then he would have never become Hawk Moth and turned people into supervillains, which means the heroes would never have been given their Miraculouses and the events that lead to Gabriel possessing the Rabbit Miraculous would have never occurred, which would mean he never traveled back in time to give his younger self the knowledge of how to fix the Peacock Miraculous. But due to the heroes stopping him it's unknown what paradox he would've created.

title: Evolution
text:
Evolution - Plot developments
Even though if he did drop the drive in the past with the crazy chance there is no paradox then it would only solve half the problem sure it would prevent Émilie, Nathalie and Colt from getting sick by the jewel but only until the jewel got stolen, lost, or damaged again let alone at least their demises would've happened at the hands of something else.
Plus it's also unknown even if the Peacock Miraculous was fixed in the past, if Colt would have continued to abuse Felix or not. Let alone what else Colt could've done if he continued to let his fear of being outdued consume him.
The kwamis finally know who Nooroo's owner is, and why he wanted the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses.
When Sass tried to reason with him, he said someone would take her place if he used the wish. And yet, through the kwamis perspective, seeing their Master's wife in a coffin it's likely they believed she died unless Nooroo explained what happened.
Through the circumstances, the kwamis don't know that they are actually close to Cat Noir.

title: Evolution
text:
Evolution - Plot developments
Except Wayzz and Kaalki, possibly Sass too. Wayzz knew the whole time, Kaalki found out his identity in "Sole Crusher" and Sass also possibly found out it when Luka did in "Wishmaker".
This episode gives further insight about Burrow:
Even though anyone can pass through it, only the Rabbit Miraculous holders can change the destination of the portals and open them.
The Rabbit Miraculous users can use it as many times as they wish without detransforming, independently of being adults or not which explains how Marinette did it in "Strikeback". However, once the user detransforms, they suffer from a temporary temporal anomaly, like talking backwards which didn’t happen to her because she didn't open or use the Rabbit's Burrow as long as Rabbit Noir.
The pocket dimension is at the center of all the time flow, being shared by all the Rabbit Miraculous holders, regardless of point in time they're from.
It's unknown if the Burrow dimension was created when Fluff was born or when she first discovered or used her powers. If said dimension was created when the first option happened that could imply that Fluff is about as old as Tikki.

title: Evolution
text:
Evolution - Plot developments
Even though Rabbit Miraculous holders can choose what point in time they can go to, similar to Voyage and a few other powers, if the user's mind isn't focused then the destinations of the portals aren't going to be completely chosen by choice implying that maybe sometimes the portals or the burrow dimension itself can choose where the traveler(s) need to go. Or in Monarch's case, it was probably due to the power drain that he was suffering that made him change course.
When Monarch grabs Lady Wifi's phone and pauses her, it seems the user of the Butterfly Miraculous can use the Akumatized villain's object that the akuma went into, but it is unknown if the user can use their weapons that don't possess the akuma.
However, it is also likely, given the circumstances, an akumatized object could be use by anyone else, regardless if they are in the possession of the Butterfly Miraculous or not.
Monarch is shown to be able to make the kwamis go inside his cane. This is similar to how Trixx was able to stay in Scarabella's yo-yo, suggesting that it's a real ability of Miraculous holders to be able to put any additional kwamis with them inside their tools.

title: Evolution
text:
Evolution - Plot developments
It's revealed that Master Fu had met Marinette and Adrien long before he had decided to give them the Ladybug Miraculous and the Cat Miraculous respectively, since he got separated from Marianne when they were escaping the Nazis. This is probably the reason why he chose them in the future and knew they would make a great superhero team.
Through their meeting Master Fu only knew what Miraculouses he was going to give out in the future based on the duo's superhero appearances but didn't know what the heroes looked like in their civilian forms except for the few physical features he could see.
Interestingly, Master Fu would be about 110 years old on the day he fled.
Similar to "Ephemeral", while not completely confirmed like Jeanne d'Arc, 1940's Barkk and her Miraculous were taken briefly to the future where she likely sensed Tikki's, Plagg's and Fluff's powers in her future guardian and Rabbit Noir, making her aware that some of her siblings will get owners or alter her current self's memory creating a different past timeline where she may have shared this information with them when her past self returned to the box.

title: Evolution
text:
Evolution - Plot developments
This technically means the first Miraculous given to the French Miraculous superhero team is the Dog Miraculous.
Due to it being the past version of the Dog Miraculous and if Rabbit's watch is followed chronologically (the current one) Alix is the first and last member of the team to get a miraculous as well as the first in history to get two in a night.
It's revealed that the Miraculous superpowers' effectiveness depends on how much energy their respective kwami possesses. If the kwami is left without food or their holders overuse their powers in one transformation, either by single-use or unifying powers with other Miraculous, the holder becomes weakened.
This is probably the reason Master Fu said unifying too many Miraculouses is dangerous in "Kwamibuster" and which may explain how Cat Noir was able to break the Shell-ter with just one hit of his Staff.
This is contradicting Adrien's using the Snake Miraculous in "Desperada", where only Sass was weakened by the 25,917 times Second Chance was used. Thinking that, it could be with time power related Miraculouses and what Rabbit Noir said maybe these particular ones aren't bound to the normal flow of time.

title: Evolution
text:
Evolution - Plot developments
Sass also said "If you destroy us, you'll destroy yourself too", implying that the more kwamis the holder fuses together or drains them dry by using their powers, then the electrical discharges will intensify possibly killing the holder and endangering the kwamis if they don't defuse.
With this in mind and from "Princess Fragrance", "Oblivio", "Miraculer", and "Psycomedian", this could contradict the kwamis' immortality making them possibly semi-immortal. Alternatively, it could mean that the kwamis are indeed immortal, but overuse of their powers without feeding to regain energy could destroy their physical forms. If true, it's unknown to what extent that could damage the Miraculouses.
Also, this episode confirms what Monarch mentioned back in "Mayura" and since he said he didn't have any food for the kwamis that means he was using his own energy for everything or foolishly thought that the kwami's energy limitless or hoped it wouldn't take long. This also implies that he hasn't fed Nooroo at all since first using his Miraculous let alone he has no idea how to take care of the kwamis properly.

title: Evolution
text:
Evolution - Plot developments
It's revealed that Alix's father, Alim Kubdel, already knew about his daughter's future as the superhero Bunnyx, as her older self had been sending him postcards from the past, explaining everything to him.
Even though Alim knew about the importance of the watch, the family tradition of passing it down was real, but the time he chose to give Alix the watch was a deliberate choice.
Due to him knowing such importance meaning Alim knew how to keep secrets as Bunnyx mentioned in "Cat Blanc".
It's unknown when Alim was given the Rabbit Miraculous by his future daughter if it was before or after Hawk Moth's debut.
In a way, things came full circle as both Bunnyx made their debuts as Miraculous holders when a villain misused or abused the power of time travel - for adult Bunnyx it was Timetagger and for current Alix it was Monarch.
Nathalie breaks ties with Gabriel as of this episode after he fails to prevent her sickness due to his obsession to get Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses.
In the flashback of Gabriel giving Émilie the Peacock Miraculous, the back of the jewel is visibly broken, implying that most likely the couple knew it was broken.

title: Evolution
text:
Evolution - Plot developments
Since the flashback was seen before they used the jewel it could also imply that they found it broken but didn't know the full extent until that day or the first time they used it meaning the jewel could've been damaged during it's time in the snow.
Monarch and Nathalie were beaten by one of the qualities of the Miraculous. With the Rabbit Miraculous's power of time travel and due to its severe dangers, one of the qualities is to resist temptation and through his impatience he lost it. And yet, she didn't think about the full consequences of using such power.
This is another reason why kwamis have to wait a long time for an owner. When a Miraculous is needed to protect the world, the jewel needs to be matched with a person of the right physical, mental and emotional qualities needed or learn to have them to use the powers properly.
That's the same thing Adrien learned in "Desperada", as he was so enamored with Ladybug that it distracted him but unlike his father he knew better (surrendering the jewel to Ladybug) and showed great improvement in "Miracle Queen".

title: Evolution
text:
Evolution - Plot developments
This also seems to be a viable trait for becoming a guardian. Due to them knowing all of the jewels' strengths and weaknesses, they had to resist the urge to use them in the event if they were ever captured.
Master Fu had and was capable of doing it too after his incident, but it wasn't out of discipline but fear.
Alternatively, when looking at it another way the Rabbit's Watch could've been the answer to everything instead of trying to change the past Gabriel could've done the same as Bunnyx as in viewing the past. Due to him being aware that the guardians had knowledge on fixing broken Miraculous from the spellbook, he also could've viewed the past to see if there were any other ways to wake his wife without the jewels.

title: Evolution
text:
Evolution - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in Brazil on Gloob.
If the current time versions of Ladybug and Cat Noir are followed, this is first time where both heroes spend an entire episode as their hero alter egos. This is also the first time where Marinette doesn't appear in an episode as well.
It's the first episode in the series (and so far only episode) where both Adrien and Marinette don't make an appearance in their civilian forms.
This is the first and second time where two different time versions of a kwami is seen as of Barkk and Fluff.
The episode shares its name with the concept of the Rabbit Miraculous.
The concept of evolution is the process by which species adapt over time in response to their changing environment:
After gaining almost every Miraculous from the Miracle Box, Gabriel makes use of each power but struggled to adept of using too much power and the threat he imposes would make Paris adept to the dangers Monarch will unleash.
Realizing the threat of the situation, Ladybug and Cat Noir include Alix of being the holder of the Rabbit Miraculous to keep it safe and watch over them like her future self has done.

title: Evolution
text:
Evolution - Trivia
Like how the kwamis and guardians adapted over time with each time the world changes, new problems come with new owners and they further discover their powers.
During "Heroes' Day", Hawk Moth used Catalyst to evolve his powers, becoming Scarlet Moth.
As revealed in "Timetagger" and this episode, Alix evolved from just an ordinary teenager to being worthy and trusted of becoming the Rabbit Miraculous holder, the most powerful Miraculous of them all.
As of "Mr. Pigeon 72", Ladybug evolved her powers to create Magical Charms to protect against further akumatizations.
As of "Dearest Family", order to counter Ladybug's Magical Charms, Shadow Moth evolved his powers to create megakumas to destroy the charms.
In "Revolution", where Ladybug and Cat Noir had grown so much that they managed to evolve into their adult powers.
The Rabbit Miraculous represents time and the many and mysterious ways it's connected to everything and everyone.

title: Evolution
text:
Evolution - Trivia
In "Timetagger", when adult Bunnyx appeared along with the titular villain, Hawk Moth was so busy fawning over the new villain that he didn't know he had a bigger prize: adult Bunnyx herself. But it's unknown why he didn't tell Timetagger, Mayura, nor since Timetagger wasn't his villain, he could've created another after Mr. Pigeon was defeated to capture Bunnyx.
It could be that maybe Hawk Moth was counting on Timetagger, to tell him everything up to next 10 years or due to his abilities he was so confident that he could win that he didn't need the information.
Even if he wanted to capture either Bunnyx, it wouldn't do any good because the adult heroine's memory is gone nor the current Bunnyx because she hadn't lived the events yet, so in a way Cat Noir cataclysming Bunnyx's watch was a good thing has it protected both heroines and the knowledge they had.
How Felix was connected to everything involving the rest of Season 5 and after it.

title: Evolution
text:
Evolution - Trivia
Ironically, due to his relations with the Miraculouses as of his sentimonster status and origins as well as his identity as Cat Noir along with his relations with Monarch and Ladybug, Adrien is, directly or not, responsible or used as a reason for the actions and choices that had lasting consequences with the Miraculouses, the War for them in Paris and the world at large, things Adrien himself still does not know about.
Similar to rabbits, people must keep their minds open to many possibilities but at the same time be cautious and careful.
Which may also explain why Bunnyx despite knowing of Gabriel's actions and reasons, didn't do the same thing he did, because she saw no point in doing it and possibly would've led to so many time disturbances that she or even Monarch would be forced to put everything back to how it was before likely foreshadowing "The Dark Castle".
This is the first episode to have a new title card scheme where the name of the episode appears on a ladybug-themed background instead of appearing with the credits on the first scene.

title: Evolution
text:
Evolution - Trivia
In this episode, Gabriel Agreste appears for the first time in a new Monarch look, wearing all the Miraculous except the Ladybug, Cat and Peacock Miraculous.
This is the first time where Émilie talks.
This episode showed Alya and Nino's first kiss when they were trapped in a zoo pen together in "Animan".
When speaking backwards, Cat Noir said, "Thanks. The power of time is way cool!"
It's revealed that in "Backwarder", apparently Marianne had brown hair when she was younger.
Nathalie feeds all the kwamis pieces of bread, despite not being some kwamis' favorite food.
When the scene begins, she had already given a piece to some of the kwamis, and we see her give one to Pollen, Orikko, Wayzz, Trixx, Sass, Fluff, and Daizzi. She doesn't seem to give one to Mullo, however. It's unknown whether this was intentional, or if it's just an animation error.
This is the first time Ladybug and Cat Noir successfully retrieved a Miraculous back from Monarch, being the Rabbit Miraculous.
It's revealed that when a Miraculous holder wants to activate three Miraculouses from civilian form, they can say "Triple Morphosis".

title: Evolution
text:
Evolution - Trivia
This is the second time where unification is used back-to-back following "Miracle Queen" and "Truth".
This is the second time where Cat Noir unifies two Miraculous and his first since "Miracle Queen".
However, this is the first time he receives a unification sequence.
Also the name of his fusion Rabbit Noir translates to "Black Rabbit" which foreshadows Adrien learning many things about himself, his family, and friends in various episodes.
This is the first time someone other than Marinette, Adrien, or Gabriel is shown doing unification, as Alix unified the Rabbit Miraculous with the Dog while she was Canigirl.
It's unknown how Alix knew how to activate the unification abilities despite not being taught it could be that Rabbit Noir told her, she figured it out for herself or is a fast learner.
This is the second time an episode features three new unifications, following "Kwamibuster".
Likewise, it's the second episode that features three new unifications that involve a single Miraculous, which in this case, is the Rabbit Miraculous.
In addition, it is the first episode that has three new unifications, but none of them are from Marinette.

title: Evolution
text:
Evolution - Trivia
Alix's transformation sequence into Bunnyx has the same motion as her older self in "Timetagger".
However, as the symbol of the Rabbit Miraculous was changed, the symbol at the end is different, changed from a cotton tail to a rabbit head.
This is the second time where both Tikki and Plagg make a background appearance following "The Dark Owl".
Thomas Astruc confirmed on Twitter that broadcasters will be extra careful trying to air the fifth season's episodes in production order
Alim Kubdel's watch displays 8:00pm at the time of his daughter becoming a Miraculous holder.
She is the third person on Team Miraculous to debut as their hero alter-ego at night following Alya in "Sapotis" and Eagle in "Miraculous New York".
But unlike, Alya and the others until "Re-creation", Alix is the only member of the team to keep her chosen Miraculous after she got it following Ladybug and Cat Noir.
This is the first episode with no Akumatization nor Amokization.
Cat Noir using Cataclysm on Shell-ter and Monarch using Mirage is similar to the way Miraculer used it in the episode of the same name.
It is also similar to how Gamer and Ladybug used Mirage in "Gamer 2.0".

title: Evolution
text:
Evolution - Trivia
This is the first, and currently only time, Gabriel is shown transforming with any miraculous, and wearing his tie.
This is the first episode in which two or more akumatized forms of the same person appear in the same episode, being Alya, whit Lady Wifi (the civilian akumatized form) and Rena Rage (the akumatized form while transformed with Fox Miraculous), respectively.
It's revealed Alix has an interest in science and wants to study engineering after she graduates from school.
The sequence where Master Fu lends a Miraculous to Ladybug makes a reappearance since "Kwamibuster".
The only differences are that Rabbit Noir was with her, and it's done with the 1940's version of Master Fu.
This episode also starts the beginning of Alix's photo journey with her in 1940's France with Master Fu.
Also like "Timetagger" this is the second time where a Miraculous appears in three different points in time.
The writers actually gave Monarch a new name for each transformation in the script. Only one of these names is actually used in the episode, by Rabbit Noir, on a jokingly tone.

title: Evolution
text:
Evolution - Trivia
This is the first time where the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses are seen stored in the Miracle Box, however it's from a past event.
This is the only episode of season 5 where the Alliance rings do not appear, as they were only created and introduced in "Multiplication".
When Monarch views the timeline of Lady Wifi pinning Ladybug against a wall, he questions why the Miraculous wasn't taken when there was a chance. Clearly something that didn't happen when he was Hawk Moth during that event.
References
This episode features callbacks to "Lady Wifi", "The Bubbler", "Animan", "Despair Bear", "Riposte", "Style Queen", "Reverser", "Mayura", "Santa Claws", and "Backwarder".
The callbacks to "Lady Wifi", "Riposte", "Reverser", "Mayura", "Backwarder" and "Bubbler" have been reanimated.
Interestingly, all of the referenced episodes, with the exception of "Backwarder", were animated by SAMG.
The scene of Lila looking at Nathalie on the train from "Strikeback" was also reanimated and reused.

title: Evolution
text:
Evolution - Trivia
Just like Adrien in the alternate future of "Cat Blanc" and in "Lady Wifi", it's most likely Gabriel wanted both his wife to be well and all the jewels for himself or at least have the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses just in case if changing the past wouldn't work but he could only choose one and no matter which pathway he chose the consequences would've been deadly.
This is the third time the first episode of a season in production order was the same first episode that aired internationally, after "Stormy Weather" and "Chameleon".
When Ladybug and Rabbit Noir traveled back to 1940s France, they came to the night Master Fu fled Paris. It's similar to "Rocketear", it's likely Adrien was aware or told by Ladybug that the woman his former master was with is his lover.
Mentioning that he'll live in fear because of his mistakes is ironically what happened to Cat Noir being separated from his lover because of the Miraculous or because someone wants them for their own selfishness and Ladybug when she lived in fear of what Shadow Moth was trying or going to do.
Similar to what Alya did in "Sentibubbler", Ladybug and Rabbit Noir played on Monarch's greed.

title: Evolution
text:
Evolution - Trivia
And Monarch tried to pull the same trick Timetagger did in "Timetagger" striking his enemies when they're weaker.
Like with Chloé in "Miraculer" and Master Fu in "Miracle Queen", the outcome for Alix getting the Rabbit Miraculous even though it wasn't desired the way it was it was for the best.
This is the nineteenth time where Ladybug's Lucky Charm is an object that appeared in a previous episode. This time, it's a mini Miraculous box that previously appeared in "Mayura". What is also interesting is that Ladybug and the others used the same trick Hawk Moth did during that day but unlike him their trick worked.
Four transformation sequences appear in the episode: Rabbit Noir's, Canigirl's, Bunny Dog's, and teenage Bunnyx's, like in "Queen Wasp" and "Desperada".
They're surpassed by "Catalyst" and "Stormy Weather 2" with six.
Allusions
Nadja's quote "Monarch may have won this battle, but the war for Miraculous has only just begun" is a reference to the saying "You may have won the battle, but you haven't won the war".

title: Evolution
text:
Evolution - Trivia
When Bunnyx is explaining to Monarch how she is able to catch up to him, she says in her second explanation that the Burrow is like a car and them both having keys to it, this could be a possible reference to the DeLorean, which is a car-like vehicle that allows people to travel through time from "Back to the Future".
Errors
When Gabriel fuses Nooroo and Fluff, they appear as purple and bluish-white lights when with the other kwamis. But in the next scene of them entering the Miraculouses, they become pink and dark blue.
In some moments focused on Rabbit Noir, the light blue marks under his eyes disappear.
The Lady Wifi flashbacks features a bright blue sky outside the kitchen doors, despite the episode originally taking place during night-time.
Lady Wifi's line "your crush will soon be slush" has a different tone of voice both times she says it.
In the Italian dub, in the call-back to "Lady Wifi", Ladybug calls Hawk Moth "Shadow Moth", even though this name was only used during Season 4.
This happens twice, also in the call-back to "Mayura".
Throughout Ladybug and Rabbit Noir's fight with Monarch, the immobilized adult Alix can't be seen in the Burrow.

title: Evolution
text:
Evolution - Trivia
When Monarch unifies the Bee, Turtle, Fox, Dragon and Dog Miraculoses with the other ones, the Miraculouses don't turn into their charged modes.

The spots on the Rabbit Miraculous' charged mode randomly appear as either black or yellow.
