title: Evolution/Transcript
text:
Evolution/Transcript - Intro
[ Theme Song ]
Parisians: Ladybug! Ladybug! Ladybug! Ladybug! Ladybug! Ladybug! Ladybug! Ladybug! Ladybug! Ladybug!
Nadja Chamack: (off-screen) Paris is in great turmoil after the villain who now goes by Monarch has stolen almost every Miraculous from Ladybug.
Monarch: I am Monarch, more powerful than ever! Listen, I will be attacking you tirelessly! Unless someone brings me Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous!
(The Parisians start booing at Monarch.)
Nadja Chamack: Despite these threats, the population still supports Ladybug. Monarch may have won this battle, but the war for Miraculous has only just begun!
Ladybug: Hawk Moth, Shadow Moth, or Monarch — whatever your name is — you'll never steal Cat Noir's Miraculous, or mine!
Cat Noir: And we won't stop fighting until we've got every single one of the others back!
(Cat Noir leaps out and successfully breaks Monarch's Shell-ter with his staff. Ladybug hurls her yo-yo and dissolves the akumas that were summoned by Monarch's Message Transmission. With his disappearance, the Parisians started cheering.)
Ladybug: Thank you, Cat Noir.
Cat Noir: It's you and me. (he turns and waves to the crowd)

title: Evolution/Transcript
text:
Evolution/Transcript - Intro
Gabriel: My love, I have taken control over the Guardian's magic jewels. Our victory is almost complete!
Ladybug: (on the rooftop of the Trocadero) Monarch's victory will never be complete!
Gabriel: All I need now are the Ladybug and the Cat Miraculous. Once I get them, I'll combine the two and fulfill the magic wish that will bring you back to me!
Sass: (flies beside Gabriel) Please reconsider. If you bring her back, someone will have to leave in her place. It's too dangerous!
Gabriel: Silence!
(Sass' mouth magically closes shut, preventing him from speaking.)
Cat Noir: We will not be forced into silence!
Ladybug: We will not be prisoners to Monarch!
(The Parisians continue to cheer for Paris' beloved heroes.)
Gabriel: You are not my prisoners, you are my slaves! And I am your master! Do you understand, you stupid creatures?
(The Kwamis continue to shudder in terror. Gabriel brings out his phone to call Nathalie, who is still on the train.)
Gabriel: (on-call) Nathalie, Ladybug has finally faulted! Taking risks has paid off! I have nearly all of the Miraculous, including the one of Evolution, granting the power of time travel!

title: Evolution/Transcript
text:
Evolution/Transcript - Intro
Nathalie: (on the train) Gabriel, wait for me. As soon as I'm home, we'll—
Gabriel: How many times in the past was I so close to seizing Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous? By returning to the past, I'll be able to anticipate their actions and steal their magic jewels when they're at their weakest! Or rather when they were at their weakest!
Nathalie: Gabriel, there might be another solution—
(The phone call ends.)
Gabriel: Nooroo, Fluff, dual metamorphosis! (transforms into Monarch)
Ladybug: I think I've figured out how Monarch managed to steal the Miraculous.
(Behind the two heroes, a Burrow portal appears as a future version of Monarch steps out feebly from it. He then goes through another one.)
Future Rabbit Noir: He's getting tired. This is our chance!
Future Ladybug: (stepping out the portal) The watch! We have to get the Rabbit Miraculous back!
(Present Ladybug and Cat Noir look in shock as the future version of themselves went through the Burrow on the same rooftop.)
Cat Noir: What was that?
(Another portal opens behind the two.)
Bunnyx: Kitty Noir, Minibug!
Ladybug: Bunnyx! Uh— Was that really us passing through here?

title: Evolution/Transcript
text:
Evolution/Transcript - Intro
Bunnyx: Yes— No— I mean, yes, that was you but later versions of you, if all goes well.
Cat Noir: Monarch didn't waste any time using his new powers.
Ladybug: And of course, he started with the Rabbit Miraculous, the most powerful one!
Bunnyx: The most dangerous one, too! As you know, changing the past can have serious consequences in the present.
Monarch: Hah! It's time to rewrite history! (entraps the Kwamis inside his cane) Burrow! (opens a portal in front of him and enters it)
Monarch: (wanders around) Fascinating…!
(He walks to a nearby time portal, wherein events from "Lady Wifi" take place. In the time portal, Ladybug is seen pinned on the wall, trapped by Lady Wifi's pause buttons. Lady Wifi swipes her phone and a record icon appears.)
Monarch: (pauses the time pocket) Ladybug: immobilized, defenseless! That was a perfect opportunity to seize her Miraculous! If only I could go back— Oh wait, here comes the best part, I can'' go back!
Lady Wifi: If you don't get him outta there fast, your crush will soon be slush. (laughs maniacally)
(Ladybug becomes shocked as Monarch snatches Lady Wifi's phone away from her.)
Lady Wifi: Hey! What's going— (gets "paused" by Monarch)

title: Evolution/Transcript
text:
Evolution/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: Hawk… Moth?
Monarch: With a few new Miraculous, but yes, it is me. Hello, Ladybug.
Ladybug: (from the "Lady Wifi" timeline, as Monarch takes her Miraculous) No! No!!
Bunnyx: Over there! Quick! (touches the time portal and pauses time) He's traveled to your first battle against Lady Wifi!
Ladybug: That's not how it happened!
Bunnyx: But that's what will happen if we don't stop him.
(She reverts the time portal to the moment Monarch steps in to the "Lady Wifi" timeline.)
Lady Wifi: If you don't get him outta there fast, your crush will soon be slush. (laughs maniacally)
(Ladybug uses her yo-yo to pull Monarch back into the Burrow.)
Monarch: Ladybug? Cat Noir? How could you follow me through time? I'm the one with the Rabbit Miraculous!
Bunnyx: Amateur. Time is like a river with multiple streams, and the Burrow is where they all come together. You with me?
(Monarch stares blankly at Bunnyx.)
Bunnyx: Okay, I'll make it simple. The Burrow's like a car and we both got the keys. Got it?
Ladybug: And we're gonna take back the Miraculous you stole from us, right here and now!
The Kwamis: (forcibly flying out Monarch's cane) Save us, Ladybug!
(Ladybug gasps in shock.)

title: Evolution/Transcript
text:
Evolution/Transcript - Intro
Monarch: You might still be their Guardian, Ladybug, but I'm their master now! Nooroo, Fluff, Pollen, Trixx, Wayzz, unify!
(The Kwamis mentioned enter their respective Miraculouses and transforms Monarch. Lightning streaks appear upon his transformation, in which he grunts to in pain. Monarch runs away with the yo-yo around him and Ladybug gets pulled along with him. He throws Ladybug off the wall and brings out the flute.)
Monarch: Mirage! (multiple illusions of him appear, running around the heroes)
(Ladybug, Cat Noir and Bunnyx fight off the many illusions, who disappear when hit.)
Cat Noir: There's too many of them!
Monarch: (sneaks behind Bunnyx) Venom!
(Bunnyx gets touched by Monarch's Venom and becomes immobilized.)
Ladybug and Cat Noir: Bunnyx!
Monarch: Shell-ter! (a shield appears to enclose him and Bunnyx) Perfect!
Ladybug: (while she and Cat Noir run towards Monarch) If he takes her Miraculous, we won't be able to follow him through time!
Cat Noir: Cataclysm!

title: Evolution/Transcript
text:
Evolution/Transcript - Intro
(Just as Monarch is about to steal Bunnyx's Miraculous, Cat Noir touches the Shell-ter with his superpower and destroys it. Ladybug hurls her yo-yo around Monarch to capture him once again and pulls him towards her.)
Monarch: You're not going to win this time! I'm more powerful! Nooroo, Fluff, Pollen, Wayzz, Trixx, Longg, unify! (transforms once again with lightning streaks wrapping him which causes him to fall down on his knees)
Ladybug: You don't look so powerful now!
Cat Noir: Seems like you're about to lose this time, too!
Monarch: (angrily groans) Wind Dragon! (morphs into wind and flies to a nearby time portal)
Ladybug: No! (chases after Monarch but fails to go through the time portal)
(Cat Noir grabs the Rabbit Miraculous from Bunnyx, causing her to detransform.)
Cat Noir: Catch, m'lady! (throws the Rabbit Miraculous at Ladybug and she catches it) Only the holder of the Rabbit Miraculous can open a time portal.
Ladybug: (contemplates shortly then places the Rabbit Miraculous on his chest, smiling) You do it, kitty.
Cat Noir: You want me to control time?
Ladybug: It's you and me, remember?

title: Evolution/Transcript
text:
Evolution/Transcript - Intro
(The two heroes smile at each other. Cat Noir grabs the Rabbit Miraculous as Fluff appears between them.)
[Transformation Sequence]
Cat Noir: Plagg, Fluff, unify! (transforms into Rabbit Noir)
(He touches a time portal of the "Riposte" timeline and reverses it.)
Rabbit Noir: Coward! He's trying to catch us by surprise!
Monarch: (weakly) Why is this happening to me? (sneaks behind Past Cat Noir who is watching Past Ladybug and Riposte's battle)
(Present Ladybug and Rabbit Noir enter the timeline as well and manages to catch Monarch off guard, by pulling his leg with the help of Rabbit Noir's umbrella.)
Monarch: Burrow! (creates another time portal)
Ladybug: Quick, while the portal is still open!
(Ladybug and Rabbit Noir chase after Monarch through the time portal.)
Ladybug: How's that possible? You already used your power.
Rabbit Noir: Have I used it or am I going to? It looks like the Miraculous of Time is unaffected by regular time. Makes perfect sense, right?
Ladybug: That's impressive!
Rabbit Noir: (charmingly smiles at Ladybug) Mhm.
Ladybug: (gasps) He's gonna catch them— I mean, catch us in the sewers!

title: Evolution/Transcript
text:
Evolution/Transcript - Intro
Rabbit Noir: Let's take a shortcut! He's the one who will be in for a surprise!
Past Ladybug: (while running) I'll go this way. You go that way!
(The duo separate to either side of a wall. Monarch enters the timeline and sneaks once again to seize past Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous.)
Past Ladybug: Spots off!
Past Cat Noir: Claws in!
(Just in time before Monarch discovers the identities of the heroes' past versions, Present Ladybug and Rabbit Noir push Monarch into another time portal.)
Rabbit Noir: So! Who's chasing who now?
Monarch: What do you think? (kicks Rabbit Noir upwards) Burrow! (creates another time portal)
Ladybug: Hey, quick!
(Present Ladybug and Rabbit Noir fly towards the portal right before it closes.)
Rabbit Noir: He's getting tired. This is our chance!
Ladybug: The watch! We have to get the Rabbit Miraculous back!
(The earlier Ladybug and Cat Noir look in shock as the present versions of themselves go through the Burrow on the same rooftop.)
Past Cat Noir: What was that?
Monarch: When am I?
(Ladybug and Rabbit Noir steps out a time portal right after him.)
Rabbit Noir: So, Mothie-Rabbit-Turtle-Bee, and I'm not sure what else, are you lost?

title: Evolution/Transcript
text:
Evolution/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: It's over. Give us back the Miraculous!
Monarch: (grunts feebly) Nooroo, Fluff, Wayzz, Trixx, Pollen...
Rabbit Noir: We'll be here a while, m'lady.
Monarch: (feebly) ...Longg, Barkk, Unify! (Barkk enters the Dog Miraculous. He takes out the ball and makes contact with the Rabbit Miraculous.) Even if you take it back, I'll always find it! (groans and falls on his knees)
Ladybug: Didn't you know using too many Miraculous at once is dangerous?
(Monarch completely collapses flat on the pavement, unconscious. Ladybug and Rabbit Noir gasp simultaneously in shock.)
Rabbit Noir: Did we just defeat him?
(Ladybug and Rabbit Noir walk towards Monarch on the pavement.)
Ladybug: Looks like we did.
(Rabbit Noir pokes Monarch with his staff as Ladybug opens Monarch's hand holding the Rabbit Miraculous. The two heroes contemplate whether to grab it or not but Ladybug grabs it anyway, smiling triumphantly, which causes Monarch to lose one of the Miraculous' powers. Shortly after, red lights are directly pointed at the two.)
Nazi: Over there! The box! We must get the box!
(The red lights also point the younger versions of Fu and Marianne across the river.)
Ladybug: (gasps) Master Fu??

title: Evolution/Transcript
text:
Evolution/Transcript - Intro
Monarch: (weakly wakes up) Trixx, Pollen, Longg… divide! (releases the powers of Illusion, Action, and Perfection; he then uses the ball to fetch the Rabbit Miraculous from Ladybug) Fetch!
(Ladybug gasps as soon as the ball comes in contact with the Rabbit Miraculous, allowing it to reappear in Monarch's hand.)
Monarch: Shell-ter! (the superpower stated encloses him)
Ladybug: Destroy his shield!
Rabbit Noir: I've used my Cataclysm already!
Monarch: Nooroo, Barkk, Wayzz, Fluff, unify! (the Kwamis mentioned enter their respective Miraculous) Burrow! (creates a time portal beneath him, which he falls into) You'll never get that Miraculous!
Ladybug: No! (she and Rabbit Noir attempt to enter the time portal but fail as the portal closes) Now that he's touched the Rabbit Miraculous with the ball of the Dog, he's created a magical link between them! (in tears) Even if we get it from him, he'll be able to take it back!
Rabbit Noir: But he'll detransform at some point, and the link will be broken!
Ladybug: Yes, but where? When? We can't keep an eye on every spacetime at once! There's only one solution.
[Superpower Sequence]
Ladybug: Lucky Charm! (A mini Miraculous box falls into her hands.)

title: Evolution/Transcript
text:
Evolution/Transcript - Intro
Rabbit Noir: (surprised) A mini Miraculous box?
Ladybug: I've got the same one to defeat Monarch when he was still Hawk Moth back on Heroes' Day, but... I don't know how we can use it here and now.
Rabbit Noir: (puts a hand on Ladybug's shoulder) You'll figure it out, you always do. Take your time.
Ladybug: (feeling reassured, she uses his lucky vision and sees Young Fu's phonograph lights up) Of course, Bunny Cat, that's the ticket, it's not happening here or now.
Past Cat Noir: (timidly steps out of the taxi with a blanket wrapped around him) You drive like a maniac! Uh!
Past Ladybug: (talking to the taxi driver) Sorry about that! He is not quite himself right now. (closes the taxi door, with her yo-yo string stuck in it; she tries to walk away, but gets pulled back to the door)
Monarch: I remember that day. Defeating them will be child's play! (more lightning streaks appear around him and he falls, walking into an alleyway and releases Kwamis from his cane) Kwamis! What's happening? (when the timid Kwamis do not respond, he grows impatient) I order you to answer me!
Sass: (weakly) Kwamis need to be fed. Without food, we become weak, and so do your powers.

title: Evolution/Transcript
text:
Evolution/Transcript - Intro
Monarch: I know, but I've got nothing for you. I AM YOUR MASTER!
Sass: If you destroy us, you'll destroy yourself too.
Monarch: (frustratingly) Burrow! (walks into the portal)
Monarch: Reverse morphosis! (transforms back into Gabriel)
Past Gabriel: (on the phone) ...weakest! Or rather when they were at their weakest!
Past Nathalie: Gabriel, there might be another solution-
(Present Gabriel taps on her shoulder, startling her)
Past Nathalie: Gabriel?
Present Gabriel: Find food... for these useless creatures...!
Nazis: Come on, we must get that box!
(Young Marianne and Young Fu run in the opposite directions. While running, Ladybug pulls Young Fu to a safe spot.)
Ladybug: Master Fu! We need a Miraculous.
Young Fu: (suspiciously) How do you know my name? Who gave you your jewels?
Rabbit Noir: You did.
Ladybug: We meet and become friends in the future. You live in fear because of the mistakes you've made in the past but one day you'll find peace.
(Young Fu looks at both of them and becomes satisfied)
Young Fu: I believe you.(Young Fu puts the phonograph on the ground and opens the lock, revealing the Miracle Box)Young Fu: (picking up the Miracle Box) What are your names?

title: Evolution/Transcript
text:
Evolution/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: Ladybug.
Rabbit Noir: Rabbit Noir.
Young Fu: (puts the Miracle Box on the ground and opens it) Ladybug, Rabbit Noir, pick an ally you can trust to fight alongside you in this mission. Choose wisely. Such powers are meant to serve the greater good.
Young Fu and Ladybug: They must never fall into the wrong hands.(Young Fu is briefly shocked with Ladybug knowing what he would say, but smiles. Ladybug picks up the Dog Miraculous.)Young Fu: As not to disturb the river of time, you must return it to me once the mission is over.
Ladybug: You can trust us, Master.
Rabbit Noir: You will get it back in less than a second.(Rabbit Noir opens a Burrow portal and both of them walk into it. Young Fu smiles and closes his eyes and waits.)''
Alix: So what was the important thing you needed to show me, Dad?
Alim: (moves his sleeve to view his watch that is pointing five minutes before eight o'clock) It isn't now or here.
(The two walk past a hall full of portraits.)
Alim: Are you still planning to studying engineering after graduation?
Alix: Totally, Dad! Science rocks my boat!
Alim: What matters the most is doing what you love, Alix.
(The two stop in front of a large painting.)

title: Evolution/Transcript
text:
Evolution/Transcript - Intro
Alix and Alim: And loving what you do.
Alix: Just like you're doing!
Alim: Yes. Every day, I'm happy to come and work here. Among these historical treasures, I'd give anything to actually explore the past centuries firsthand and not just study their remnants.
Alix: Maybe I'll be the scientist who invents the time machine, and I'll take you to see these moments in person!
Alim: (becomes shocked for a short moment and chuckles; he kneels down in front of Alix) I'd love that.
Alix: (confused) Why are you looking at me like that?
Alim: To remember you, and this moment here… (his watch strikes eight o'clock) …and now.
(Ladybug and Rabbit Noir step out from a time portal and walks towards Alix and Alim.)
Alix: (gasps in surprise) Ladybug? So this is it, Ladybug, you finally realized how cool I am?
Ladybug: Good evening, Mr. Kubdel. I've got a big favor to ask your daughter. I hope you'll understand.
(Alim nods in agreement.)
Ladybug: (hands over the Dog Miraculous to Alix) Alix Kubdel, here is the Miraculous of the Dog, which will grant you the power to recover whatever your ball touches.
Alix: The Dog Miraculous? Wasn't my thing time travel?

title: Evolution/Transcript
text:
Evolution/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: Monarch has stolen the Miraculous of the Rabbit. We need your help to get it back.
Alix: But… Cat Noir's a rabbit?
Rabbit Noir: (nervously) Uhm, it's complicated.
(Barkk appears beside Alix as Alix wears the dog collar on her neck.)
Barkk: Hi!
Ladybug: Once we have retrieved the Miraculous of time, you won't return it to me. You'll have to continue wearing it in order to protect it, until Monarch is defeated.
Alix: Keep it? That means...
Ladybug: (crestfallen) You won't be able to return to this time right away.
Alix: (to Alim) You knew it!
Ladybug: But… how?
Alim: Because you told me, Alix. (brings out pictures from his coat) You wrote to me from all the eras you visited so I wouldn't worry about you.
(He gives Alix pictures of her as future Bunnyx with the Egyptian Sphinx, a futuristic Paris, and with a T-rex. He then reads a letter from Bunnyx in the future.)
Alix: "You were so right, Dad. It's cool doing what we love..."
Alim: "...And loving what we do."
(Alix and Alim share a heartfelt embrace.)
Alix: Ladybug and Cat Noir are the best. I'll be back soon, Dad.
Barkk: All you need to do is say "Barkk, on the hunt"!
[Transformation Sequence]

title: Evolution/Transcript
text:
Evolution/Transcript - Intro
Alix: Barkk, on the hunt! (transforms into Canigirl)
Canigirl: Canigirl, ready!
(Rabbit Noir opens a time portal and the three of them run towards it. Canigirl stops for a while and looks back at her father.)
Alim: (waves goodbye to Canigirl) See you soon, honey.
(Canigirl smiles back and proceeds to enter the time portal. The portal closes in front of Alim as soon as Canigirl enters it.)
Ladybug: Don't worry, my superpower will repair everything.
(Ladybug and Canigirl join Rabbit Noir in front of one of the time portals that is in the 1940s timeline, where Monarch completely collapses, becoming weaker because of using all the Miraculous at once.)
Ladybug: So first, with your ball, you've gotta touch the Rabbit Miraculous that Monarch stole.
Canigirl: I'm guessing he can't notice anything?
(Ladybug eagerly nods.)
(Back in the 1940s timeline, where Ladybug grabbed the Rabbit Miraculous from Monarch, a time portal subtly opens behind them as Canigirl's hand appears and touches the Rabbit Miraculous with her ball.)
Canigirl: Mission accomplished!
Rabbit Noir: Then let's head to the perfect place, or should I say the perfect time, to beat Monarch in his own game!

title: Evolution/Transcript
text:
Evolution/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: And to make sure he falls for it, we're gonna leave him a little gift. (places the mini Miraculous box on the floor at a distance) Here!
Gabriel: I can defeat Ladybug! I know it! There's got to be the perfect moment.
Nathalie: There is another way to use the Miraculous of the Rabbit. (Gabriel gasps.) You could go back to a time before Émilie used the damaged Peacock Miraculous. You can save your wife, Gabriel! (presents a flash drive) This holds the information on how to repair the magic jewel so that Émilie never becomes ill using it. You would just need to give the drive to yourself. (hands Gabriel the drive) Make the right choice. It's not too late!
Gabriel: (smiles) How did I not think of that? Thank you, Nathalie! Nooroo, Fluff, Barkk, triple morphosis! (He transforms into Monarch and extends his cane to gather all the Kwamis inside. He uses the ball and touches the Rabbit Miraculous with it and puts the Miraculous in his pocket.)
Young Émilie: (giggles)
Young Gabriel: (Opens his hand, revealing the damaged Peacock Miraculous) For you. Are you sure you're ready?
Young Émilie: Yes.

title: Evolution/Transcript
text:
Evolution/Transcript - Intro
(Young Gabriel places the Peacock Miraculous on her hand. The two stand up as Young Gabriel scoops up Young Émilie in a bridal carry. The two proceeded to walk inside the mansion, before Emilie hugs her husband.)
Monarch: (sadly) Émilie…
(He proceeds to open a time portal in the said timeline. As he is about to place the flash drive on the picnic mat, he notices the mini Miraculous box placed by Ladybug earlier.)
Monarch: (furiously) Ladybug, you're trying to trick me again??
(He places his hand with the drive inside the portal once again as he contemplates hard whether he should save his wife, or let his greed consume him by searching for Ladybug.)
Monarch: I've seen this box before… (stomps to another time pocket, rewinding time) No, no, that's not it! ...  Yes, yes! I remember! (The time pocket shows the victims akumatized by Scarlet Moth on Heroes' Day.) I know when it was!
Past Ladybug: (from the time pocket, presenting her version of the mini box) It's a sign, Hawk Moth!
(As Monarch is browsing through the time pocket, he notices the present versions of Ladybug and Rabbit Noir seemingly ready to ambush his past Scarlet Moth self.)

title: Evolution/Transcript
text:
Evolution/Transcript - Intro
Monarch: I won't let you destroy my future, Ladybug! (contemplates once more and closes his fist angrily with the drive in it, and smiles to the timeline with Émilie) I'll be right back, my love. I promise. (proceeds to enter the  Heroes' Day time pocket)
Ladybug: Canigirl, now!
Monarch: Wha- ?
(Canigirl ambushes behind a confused Monarch.)
Canigirl: Fetch! (uses the ball to take back the Rabbit Miraculous from Monarch, which makes him lose one of the powers of the Miraculous)
[Transformation Sequence]
Canigirl: Barkk, Fluff, unify! (transforms into Bunny Dog)
Monarch: Fetch! (his ball flies towards Bunny Dog)
Bunny Dog: Burrow!
(She opens a portal beneath her and jumps right into it the second before Monarch's ball touches the Rabbit Miraculous. Once again, Monarch's plan fails, as his ball rolls back to his feet.)
Monarch: No! (falls onto his knees) This can't be!
Ladybug: Oh, but it can! You've lost!
Rabbit Noir: (opens a time portal behind them) As usual!
(The two heroes enter the portal, leaving a defeated Monarch behind.)
Ladybug: Miraculous Ladybug! (throws the box up in the air, and the magic ladybugs cure Future Alix's immobilization)

title: Evolution/Transcript
text:
Evolution/Transcript - Intro
Future Alix: I knew you'd fix everything!
(Rabbit Noir returns the Rabbit Miraculous to whom it belongs and detransforms back into Cat Noir.)
Cat Noir: (says "Thanks! The power of time is way cool." backwards then realizes) Did I just speak backwards?
Future Alix: Yup, that's what happens when you mess with the time continuum.
(Fluff appears out from the Rabbit Miraculous as soon as Future Alix wears it on her waist.)
Future Alix: Glad to see you again, big ears! Fluff, clockwise! (transforms into Bunnyx)
(Bunny Dog removes the collar from her neck and the watch from her pocket, allowing her to detransform back into Alix.)
Future Bunnyx: Mini-me! I knew you'd rock it! (ruffles her younger self's hat playfully)
(Alix hesitantly and sadly gives back the present Rabbit Miraculous to Ladybug.)
Ladybug: (brings back the Rabbit Miraculous to Alix) The time has come.
(An estatic Alix wears the Rabbit Miraculous on her waist, and the present version of Fluff appears beside her.)
Alix: Ready for a long journey, big ears?
Fluff: (panics) Uh… I'm having a serious case of déjà vù, right?
[Transformation Sequence]
Alix: Fluff, clockwise! (transforms into Bunnyx)

title: Evolution/Transcript
text:
Evolution/Transcript - Intro
Bunnyx: (to her future self) See? Now I'm as cool as you are!
Ladybug, Cat Noir, Bunnyx and Future Bunnyx: (fist bump) Pound it!
Ladybug: I have one last favor to ask you, girls.
Past Rabbit Noir: You'll get it back in less than a second!
(He opens a time portal and he and Ladybug enter it. Shortly after, another time portal appears behind Young Fu and Bunnyx appears out of it, returning the 1940s version of the Dog Miraculous.)
Bunnyx: As promised, back in less than a second!
(Young Fu grabs the Dog Miraculous. Bunnyx takes a selfie with him right after and returns back into the time portal, leaving a confused Young Fu.)
Monarch: You were wrong to leave me here, Ladybug, for the future belongs to those who live in the past! I don't need the Rabbit Miraculous. I'm going to relive everything we've been through, and thanks to my Miraculous, I will defeat you!
(Future Bunnyx hops in from a time portal behind him.)
Future Bunnyx: Sorry, Mothie. Not this time either! (opens a time portal beneath Monarch)
Monarch: (falls into the portal) No!!

title: Evolution/Transcript
text:
Evolution/Transcript - Intro
Past Future Bunnyx: The most dangerous one, too! As you know, changing the past can have serious consequences in the present. (opens a time portal) Follow me!
(The three heroes rush into the portal, and upon entering the portal, another one appears not too far from the previous one. The present Ladybug and Cat Noir both fall from it, along with present Monarch from a separate time portal. The two heroes then confront him.)
Cat Noir: Right on time for yet another defeat, Monarch!
(Ladybug wraps her yo-yo around Monarch to keep him from going anywhere.)
Monarch: You will never take a Miraculous from me ever again! Time is running out for both of you now! Nooroo, Barkk, Longg, unify! (upgrades his powers) Wind dragon! (morphs into wind and flies away)
Ladybug: (chases after Monarch) No! Not again! (groans in frustration after failing to do so)
Cat Noir: We were able to get one of the Miraculous back from him.
Ladybug: And at what price?
Cat Noir: We'll get them all back, m'lady, and once we've defeated Monarch for good, Alix will be able to return.
(Ladybug smiles and nods.)

title: Evolution/Transcript
text:
Evolution/Transcript - Intro
Gabriel: (crestfallen) I could've changed everything. (on the verge of crying) Émilie, my love, can you ever forgive me…?
(The Kwamis watch Gabriel in despair. His phone rings a second later and Gabriel answers it.)
Nathalie: (on-call) Gabriel, did it work?
Gabriel: No, Ladybug tricked me! She stole the Time Miraculous from me! (Nathalie coughs from her sickness.) You have to help me! Come up with a new plan! Ladybug can't get away with this!
Nathalie: (on-call) You had the Time Miraculous. You could've chosen to save Émilie! You could've chosen to save me! (coughs) But instead, you chose your obsession with Ladybug and Cat Noir. You're insane, Gabriel!
Gabriel: (stuttering and panicking) I-It's not my fault! It was Ladybug!
Nathalie: (on-call, coughs) You don't deserve my help. You don't deserve anyone's help!
(As the call ends, Gabriel stands in complete silence. Back on the train, Lila looks at the back of the train from her seat, seeing Nathalie coughing. She then approaches her.)
Lila: Nathalie? Is everything okay?
Nathalie: Yes. Help me get back to my seat, Lila. (coughs)

title: Evolution/Transcript
text:
Evolution/Transcript - Intro
(In the crypt, Gabriel drops his phone in betrayal, to the Kwamis' terror. He becomes enraged, infuriated, anything to describe his unfathomable rage against the superheroes as he does not have anyone to support him anymore. His hands clench in rage, hands over his head)
Gabriel: (yells) LADYBUGGGGGG!

title: Fathom apartment
text:
Fathom apartment - Intro
The  was the residence of Amélie Graham de Vanily and her son Félix Fathom.

title: Fathom apartment
text:
Fathom apartment - Appearance
This apartment seems to be a duplex located on a high floor of a green London skyscraper.
The living room is very spacious. The walls are white, and the floor is smooth with two red strokes. In the middle of the room, there is a large white piano, next to which we find a white corner armchair and a small glass coffee table. In the next corner, there is a black table surrounded by eight black chairs with white cushions. Near this table there is a rectangular shelf on which a clock protected by a glass lid is arranged. There is a large multicolored canvas hanging on the wall. On the other side of everything, we find a pair of brown armchairs and a glass coffee table. A crystal chandelier is hung above the piano.
The apartment has a large bay window. From it, you can access a balcony with a green railing, but also to the wall covered with plants. We find an indoor balcony whose usefulness remains still unknown. It is accessed by a corridor leading to the bedrooms.
As seen at the end of the episode "Multiplication", next to the entrance to the apartments, there are two rooms, one of Félix, and the other obviously of his parents.

title: Fang/History
text:
Fang/History - Intro
Fang is Jagged Stone's pet crocodile.

title: Fang/History
text:
Fang/History - Before Season 1
Fifteen years before the events of "Truth", Fang started in a film called Crocodile Heart, along with his owner Jagged Stone. The film was Fang and Jagged's first movie and it wasn't that good when it first came out, according to Tom Dupain.

title: Fang/History
text:
Fang/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Pixelator", Fang, Jagged, and Penny Rolling, arrive at Le Grand Paris. At first, Mayor André Bourgeois doesn't want to let them in, but after his daughter Chloé tells her dad who he is, André welcomes him into his hotel and ask's them how he might serve them.
They asked him for a luxury suite room, with a bathtub for Fang and not a tiny water hole like the hotel across the street has. André assures Penny, thinking that she's Fang, that they have everything they need. Jagged then corrects him as a fan of Jagged named Vincent Asa sneaks into the hotel and hides behind a desk, with Fang noticing. Fang then gets loose and scares Vincent. He later leaves in the elevator, along with his owner and Penny. In the hotel room they gave them, Fang is seen practicing his tricks with Jagged.

title: Fang/History
text:
Fang/History - [[Season 1]]
Later, Fang is in the bathtub being washed by Jagged. Soon the titular villain arrives, while Fang is being dried by Jagged, whom tells him to attack. Fang then rolls over and pixelated by the villain. He is transferred to a white world inside of a photograph, the photographs themselves appearing on the villain's wall in his room. In the photograph, Fang is spotted by Adrien Agreste and Chloé Bourgeois. After Ladybug and Cat Noir defeat the villain, Fang is transported back to the hotel by Ladybug's Lucky Charm, where he makes Sabrina Raincomprix faint.
In "Guitar Villain", Fang claps with his tail after Jagged performs for him, Penny and Bob Roth. He then watched as his owner argued with Bob, with Fang growling at Bob making him agree with a request made by Jagged for Marinette Dupain-Cheng to design his new album cover. Later, Fang is seen growling at Bob again, stopping him from yelling at Jagged after their meeting with Marinette.

title: Fang/History
text:
Fang/History - [[Season 1]]
After the others are gone, Fang sleeps as Jagged watches an interview with XY on TVi. Jagged becomes so furious, that he exasperatingly rages at XY, and in fit of rage, throws his tablet into Fang's mouth and starts aggressively playing his guitar to vent his frustration, while Fang eats the tablet. Soon an akuma arrives and Fang tries to eat it, but fails. He and Jagged are then akumatized by Hawk Moth, Fang is transformed into a dragon while his owner is transformed into the titular villain.
Later Dragon Fang and Guitar Villain go down to the hotel's lobby, where Guitar Villain shoots purple energy waves from his guitar and causes Bob Roth and an interviewer in the lobby to dance uncontrollably as Dragon Fang at watched. Dragon Fang then flies out of the hotel and to the streets, knocking over a car.
Soon Cat Noir arrives, with Dragon Fang battling him by shooting green fire blasts out of his mouth. By doing this, he gets the attention of Marinette who then transforms into Ladybug and saves Cat Noir from Dragon Fang's blasts. Ladybug then throws Cat Noir at Dragon Fang, with the superhero using his staff on Dragon Fang's mouth to prevent him from attacking.

title: Fang/History
text:
Fang/History - [[Season 1]]
Dragon Fang flies away with Guitar Villain to the Eiffel Tower to start his revenge on XY, only for his ankumatized owner to realize that XY is actually a hologram. After Ladybug and Cat Noir follow and save Théo Barbot from dancing uncontrollably, Guitar Villain commands Dragon Fang to go to the TVi Tower. Dragon Fang and Guitar Villain then swoop in and take XY to the Eiffel Tower as night falls.
At XY's concert, Guitar Villain has tied-up XY and is about to make him walk the plank on top of the Eiffel Tower, while Dragon Fang flies around. Ladybug and Cat Noir are climbing up the Tower and the first decides to uses her yo-yo as a grappling hook so she can pull herself and Cat Noir up faster, but Dragon Fang appears and pulls the string away, causing both of them to fall. As Cat Noir uses his staff to prevent his fall, Ladybug tosses her yo-yo to Dragon Fang's mouth, carrying herself to the sky. Taking control of Dragon Fang, Ladybug uses the akumatized crocodile to rescue Cat Noir. Assuming that the akuma is inside the guitar and that it's too hard to get, Ladybug flies him into the top platform causing in Dragon Fang getting stuck.

title: Fang/History
text:
Fang/History - [[Season 1]]
After Ladybug defeats his owner and uses her Miraculous Ladybug, Fang is transformed back into a crocodile and is returned to the hotel. The next day, Fang watched as Marinette delivered the new album cover to Jagged.
In "Antibug", Fang is seen in a flashback, where Fang was seen in an interview Jagged was doing with Nadja Chamack. There Chloé dressed as Ladybug crashes the interview and repeatedly drops her yo-yo on his head. Fang becomes angry and bites off the yo-yo string, causing the string to fly back at Chloé's face and she runs off after being revealed to not the real Ladybug.
In "Kung Food", Fang is seen next to Jagged and Marlena Césaire on the World's Greatest Chef contest, when he is introduced by Alec Cataldi.

title: Fang/History
text:
Fang/History - [[Season 2]]
In "The Collector", while at one of Jagged's concerts, Fang along with his owner are trapped inside the sketchbook of the titular villain.
In "Troublemaker", Fang is seen in the background when Penny is speaking to Armand. He then runs out of the door with the ball, remaining unnoticed. After a while, Mayor André Bourgeois appears at the door holding Fang’s leash, saying that Fang can't run freely around the hotel, then hands back the crocodile to Penny. Later, Fang goes to Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie where his owner is filming for a TVi program, there he is seen being held by Penny on a leash.
In "Catalyst", Fang became one of the victims akumatized by Scarlet Moth, being transformed back into a scarlet version of his dragon form. He was then instructed by Scarlet Moth to head to the Eiffel Tower where he is, taking a scarlet Guitar Villain with him. At the Eiffel Tower, Dragon Fang watched as Scarlet Moth arrive and made a statement to the Ladybug and Cat Noir.
In "Mayura", Dragon Fang is seen again at the Eiffel Tower, still akumatized.

title: Fang/History
text:
Fang/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Desperada", Fang is seen on top of his owner's piano, when Jagged Stone goes to Liberty requesting that Anarka Couffaine become his new guitarist. After the titular villain arrives, Fang is turned into a sticker on the villain's guitar case offscreen. After defeats the villain, Fang is brought back by Ladybug's Miraculous Ladybug, along with Jagged and Penny.
In "Party Crasher", Fang and Jagged come by the Agreste mansion on a helicopter for Adrien Agreste's impromptu party. They enter Adrien's room through the window, there Fang stands on Adrien's piano while Jagged plays it.
In "Heart Hunter", Fang attends André and Audrey Bourgeois' 20th wedding anniversary. After the couple is akumatized into the titular villains and they shoot their magic beams at Fang and Jagged they turn into a heart, which embodies their love, which the villains then eat. They are both later brought back by Ladybug's Miraculous Ladybug.

title: Fang/History
text:
Fang/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Lies", Fang attends Prince Ali's birthday at Hôtel de Ville. Inside the party, Penny is trying to keep Fang under control as he tried to eat a piece of cake while Jagged is in the middle of playing a song for Prince Ali on his guitar. Then, the titular villain's orb enters the party and it freezes everyone who has lied before, but animals, like Fang, don't know how to lie, so Fang is unaffected. After Ladybug using the drone to see inside the orb and sees Fang, she comes up with a plan.
The drone grabs some cake and Fang follows it. The villain prepares to take Cat Noir's Miraculous, but then Fang jumps in and smashes the villain's akumatized object with his jaw. Fang then watched as the villain was transformed back into Kagami Tsurugi and then he licked Cat Noir as was unfreezes by Ladybug’s Miraculous Ladybug, to Cat Noir's disgust.

title: Fang/History
text:
Fang/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Crocoduel", Fang arrives at Liberty for the birthday of Jagged's son and daughter, Luka and Juleka Couffaine. When Jagged and Anarka start arguing as Fang sleeps, Shadow Moth sends an akuma towards them. It infects the disc, with Jagged and Anarka ripping it in a fit of rage, and they’re all akumatized by Shadow Moth back into their original akumatized selves, with Fang being transformed into a dragon again. Dragon Fang and Guitar Villain join forces with Captain Hardrock to become Crocoduel.
Dragon Fang assisted his akumatized owner as he fought with Captain Hardrock. When Ladybug arrives at the scene Shadow Moth orders the villains to seize her Miraculous, Dragon Fang chases Ladybug with Guitar Villain on the air, also shooting green fire blasts out of his mouth at the hero. Crocoduel continues to chase after Ladybug, until Captain Hardrock fires a big boulder at Ladybug and it hits her. Crocoduel corners Ladybug, but are soon interrupted when Cat Noir arrives. The heroes escape and Crocoduel chases after them. Cat Noir hits Guitar Villain with his staff, knocking off the akumatized crocodile. He then falls down, but is caught in time by Dragon Fang.

title: Fang/History
text:
Fang/History - [[Season 4]]
Later, Ladybug lands on the bow of the ship and prepares to attack, when suddenly Dragon Fang flies Guitar Villain over to her who prepares to attack her, but she dodges, landing down at the Place de la Concorde. Crocoduel leaves them there to fight again, with Cat Noir complain that they don't have any wings or a flying pirate ship. Up in the sky, Crocoduel continues to face off. Dragon Fang then flies Guitar Villain around as he attacks Captain Hardrock who attacks him back.
Later Cat Noir throws Ladybug and Purple Tigress into the sky, with the second landing on Dragon Fang. As Guitar Villain faces off against the new hero, Dragon Fang continues to fly. The two superheroines both end up getting the akumatized object from both of them and run away with it. The villains then go down through the grey clouds and start attacking all the heroes. Purple Tigress runs up a building and jumps on the roof as the akumatized villains go near the superheroine, she activates her power, Clout. She then puts her Clout'ed hand on Captain Hardrock's ship that makes it fly backwards which hits Dragon Fang and they all go up through the grey clouds which makes a little sunshine ray go though.

title: Fang/History
text:
Fang/History - [[Season 4]]
Back on the ground Cat Noit destroys the akumatized object while the three villains are up in the sky, causing all of them to transform back into their regular selves in mid-air. They then fall from the sky as Ladybug does her Miraculous Ladybug, which saves all of them from crashing into two civilians and brings them back safely to the Seine. There Fang watched as his owner and Anarka received magical charms from Ladybug.
In "Wishmaker", Fang is seen in Jagged's limo when the titular villain makes his owner's childhood dreams come true turning him into a crocodile.

title: Fang/History
text:
Fang/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Migration", Jagged gives up his fame as a rock star and tears up his contracts with Bob Roth and feeds it to Fang. After that Fang, Jagged, and Penny go to Liberty, so Jagged can tell his family. When they get there they overhear Luka saying that he needs to temporarily leave Paris for knowing Ladybug and Cat Noir's true identities, with Jagged volunteering to go with him. And after Anarka agrees to let him go, Fang and everyone else who has on the ship share a big group hug. Fang, Jagged, Luka, and Penny then leave Paris in order to protect the third from being a target to Monarch.
In "Re-creation", Fang is revealed to have gone to Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, with the others. There he allied himself with the Order of the Guardians and learned Mirakung Fu. As Jagged, Luka, Penny, and Su-Han fought with the Miraculized, Bunnyx arrives to take them to Paris through the Burrow, with Jagged calling Fang. He then comes to his owner and jumps into the Burrow. In Paris, when the Resistance evade a Miraculized mob in the Subway, but are eventually cornered, Fang jumps out of the Burrow and swipes the brainwashed civilians with his tail.

title: Fang/History
text:
Fang/History - [[Season 5]]
He then continued to take part in the fight with the Miraculized until the universe was re-created by Gabriel Agreste. One month after this, Fang went to Agreste mansion with his owner and was seen sleeping in the pool while Max Kanté was on top of him.

title: Fred Haprèle
text:
Fred Haprèle - Intro
is a recurring character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He is an assistant educator at Collège Françoise Dupont, a mime performer, the leading actor in The Mime's Extraordinary Adventures, and the father of Mylène Haprèle.
In "The Mime", when Fred was deceived by his understudy, Chris, into missing his performance, he was akumatized by Hawk Moth and became the Mime, a mime supervillain.
In "Ephemeral", Fred was re-akumatized by Shadow Moth into the Mime for an unknown reason in alternative timeline.
In "Noe", when Fred decides to confront Noé Luxus after he was tricked to be in a movie that depicts Ladybug and Cat Noir as villains, he was re-akumatized into the Mime by Chrysalis.

title: Fred Haprèle
text:
Fred Haprèle - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Fred is tall and lanky with brown hair and brown eyes and eyebrows.
Civilian Attire
He wears a white t-shirt underneath a dark green dress jacket. He also wears dark blue jeans and black and white sneakers. When he is performing as a mime, he has a black derby hat with a special pocket added in by Marinette to put a photo of Mylène.
As Mime
Mime's hair was blond, and his skin was periwinkle. His irises were dark grayish blue-violet, and he had black lining around the eyes, with a drop-shaped line below each. He still had the derby hat on his head. He wore a dark gray and white striped t-shirt underneath a bluish-gray dress jacket with two large black buttons and a dark blue collar. In addition, he wore high white pants with black lining on the pockets, and he wore high black and white sneakers.

title: Fred Haprèle
text:
Fred Haprèle - Personality
Fred is kind and hardworking. When he is working as an assistant at school, he is serious and firm about keeping people who enter the school without permission and might hurt others out, including Rogercop in the episode of the same name and Nadja Chamack and her crew in "Darkblade", but when off duty, he is very genial to other people, and he always shows his love for his daughter. However, he tends to procrastinate, such as getting his hat fixed right before he needs to leave instead of having it done earlier, and he is often late.

title: Fred Haprèle
text:
Fred Haprèle - Personality
Fred is shown as being a great father, loving his daughter Mylène more than anything, even considering her as his lucky charm, shown how he asked Marinette to customize his bowler hat with a special pocket for him to place Mylène's photo in it. His love for Mylène is what caused him to hold his career as an actor and focus on minor roles, so he could focus on raising her after his wife left. He is also very protective of Mylène as, seeing how much stressed she was getting after Noé Luxus tricked him to perform on a movie that would difamate Ladybug and Cat Noir and even caused Nadja Chamack to get fire when she tried to expose the truth, he decided to confront him about it.

title: Fred Haprèle
text:
Fred Haprèle - Personality
As Mime, he was cold and silent, fueled only by his intention of getting revenge on his crew, by ruining their show since he lost the opportunity to perform with them. Later on, on his re-akumatization caused by Chrysalis, he was again vengeful, but this time towards Noé Luxus, who had tricked him into performing in a movie meant to defamate Ladybug and Cat Noir and caused Nadja Chamack to get fired when she tried to expose the truth, even more tried to cause Caline Bustier to lose her job as mayor, remaining the same cold and silent he is. Only Mylène was able to get through to him and convince him to not seek revenge, giving him strength to reject the ultrakuma.

title: Fred Haprèle
text:
Fred Haprèle - Abilities
As a Civilian
Fred is a talented mime actor, able to act with imaginary objects and without saying a word. In "Party Crasher", he is seen playing the trumpet, implying he can play the trumpet.
As Mime
Mime was able to mime anything, and instead of it being imaginary, it worked like a real, solid, but invisible object. He could create anything, from swords, to bazookas, to working vehicles. He could also mimic strength, being able to hold up the Eiffel Tower. However, Mime could only mime one thing at a time, so if he started a new mime, whatever he previously created would cease to exist. In "Gamer 2.0", if he talked, the mime object would disappear.
In "Noe", he has the same powers, but can now mime multiple objects at once.

title: Fred Haprèle
text:
Fred Haprèle - Relationships
Family
Mylène Haprèle
Mylène is his daughter and he loves her very much. He had Marinette place a pocket in his hat so that he can keep a picture of Mylène there for good luck, and when he misses his performance, he believes he has disappointed Mylène.
Allies
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/Ladybug
Fred knows that Marinette is a close friend of his daughter and that she has a talent for sewing. Because of this, he asked Marinette in "The Mime" to fix his hat and requested that she added a small pocket on the inside.

title: Fred Haprèle
text:
Fred Haprèle - Trivia
Mime is one of the first known villains in the world of Ladybug, being one of the only three villains featured in the Ladybug PV, the other villains being Mr. Pigeon and Hawk Moth.
Mime has the same abilities as he did in the Ladybug PV, the only difference being that there are no shadows visible when he pantomimes.
Mime was such a great character in producers' eyes that when the unused concept of the Quantic Kids was being developed, they decided to replace team member Sparrow with Kid Mime, a superhero with powers like Mime.
For Mime's objects, animators would create his objects, and then they would make them invisible.
Mime's design is a reference to French mime Marcel Marceau.
Along with Horrificator, Mime is one of the two akumatized villains to not speak in season 1.
Coincidentally, they are both from the Haprèle family.
As seen in "The Mime", Fred's phone number is +33635124.
A scarlet version of Mime reappeared in the two-part special event "Heroes' Day".
* In "Gamer 2.0", Mime returns as a playable akumatized villain as part of the Gamer 2.0's powers.
A statue of the Mime appears in the Musée Grévin in "The Puppeteer 2".

title: Fox Miraculous
text:
Fox Miraculous - Intro
The  is a necklace that, whenever Trixx inhabits it, transforms the wearer into a fox-themed superhero with the power of Illusion.
To activate the necklace, the user must speak the transformation phrase: "Let's Pounce". To deactivate the necklace, the user must speak the detransformation phrase: "Let's Rest".
The necklace is currently owned by Alya Césaire, who uses it to transform into Rena Rouge. As of "Rocketear", due to Alya having to help Ladybug from the shadows, her suit changed, and she changed her hero name to Rena Furtive. It was previously stored in the Chinese Miracle Box and only lent out to her when the situation required it. But, as of "Re-creation", she posseses the Miraculous permanently.

title: Fox Miraculous
text:
Fox Miraculous - Appearance
In general, the Fox Miraculous is a necklace that appears to have a fox tail pendant attached to it. In charged mode, when Trixx inhabits it, it has a golden chain and the pendant is orange with four golden metal lines protruding from the border, dividing the pendant into five sections, and the sections change in color, from top to bottom, from orange to white with a gradient effect. The backside of the pendant is flat and gold. If a minor is using the miraculous, the necklace starts running out of power, and it makes a beeping sound, and the sections start turning black from top to bottom (one part is equivalent to one minute) that Alya (or another Fox Miraculous holder) has left.
From season 6 onwards, the pendant changes direction and the four golden lines are now triangular in shape and are orange and thinner, but keeping its golden border.
After Alya is forced to work undercover as Rena Furtive, the Miraculous changed color from orange to icy blue and white. She also occasionally had an alternate color palette of lilac and white.
In its activated mode, the sections are completely black.
From season 6 onwards, the pendant and the necklace turn completely silver.

title: Fox Miraculous
text:
Fox Miraculous - Appearance
In its camouflage mode, the necklace changes color and form depending on whose possession it's in:
In the possession of Alya Césaire, the pendant is divided into two sections, one orange and one white and in addition, the orange section is darker than the charged version.
In Season 6 onwards, the necklace in Alya's possession is now silver and the pendant is considerably straighter, with a silver chain.
When it was worn by Marinette Dupain-Cheng, the orange segment of the pendant turned pink. The metal chain also turned a rose-gold gold.
When it was worn by Gabriel Agreste, the parts of the pendant turned silver, The metal chain also turned silver.
As an akumatized object, it takes on a reddish color.
In its reforged ring form, it was a thick band with a circle surface, similar to the Cat Miraculous, inside of it was the symbol of the Fox Miraculous which glowed orange. It used to sit on the middle finger of Gabriel's right hand.

title: Fox Miraculous
text:
Fox Miraculous - Abilities
The Fox Miraculous has the ability to transform its wielder into a fox-themed superhero, granting its wielder incredible superhuman powers of speed, endurance, agility, stamina and strength. It also makes the user nearly invulnerable.
Its special weapon is an unbreakable flute, which can also be utilized as both a weapon, a communicator, and an object that can be used to breathe underwater. Its special superpower is named Mirage, which gives the user the ability to create as many illusions as they choose when their flute is played, in order to obtain their goal, like defeating a villain. Once played, an orange-white ball of energy appears at the flute's end which the wielder then throws to create the illusion. As long as the superpower isn't used by a minor, the wielder can remain transformed indefinitely. However, as soon as the superpower is used, the wielder loses power, and the transformation wears off in about approximately five minutes. The necklace also has the ability to give the wielder the costume they truly desire.

title: Fox Miraculous
text:
Fox Miraculous - History
Five thousand years ago, a mage successfully helped the kwamis to interact with humans by creating magic jewels, which were called Miraculouses. In order to repay the mage, and to live on the physical world alongside humans, the kwamis decided to help humanity by letting humans utilize their energy and powers through the Miraculous they were bonded with, which included Trixx and the Fox Miraculous.
At some point in time, all of the knowledge about the Miraculouses and their powers was written down in code in a book called the Grimoire, with very few people knowing how to decipher the code. Miracle Boxes were also created at an unknown time to store the dormant Miraculouses. To protect and distribute Miraculouses, the Order of the Guardians was formed and existed for many years. Throughout its existence, guardians trained younger generations to keep a watchful eye over the Miraculouses and the Grimoire, which were placed in the guardians' temple.
Many Fox holders throughout history used Trixx's power for good, like Húlí in China, who started the legacy, and The Pied Piper of Hamelin, a folkloric figure from Germany.

title: Fox Miraculous
text:
Fox Miraculous - History
172 years ago, after an disastrous event where a young Wang Fu used the Peacock Miraculous to create a sentimonster and his negative emotions and imaturity led to the creature rampaging through the temple and eating and destroying everything in its path, Fu was entrusted with the Chinese Miracle Box (Which included the Fox Miraculous) by a monk and was told to run away from the mess. However, on the mountain range outside the temple, in order to escape from the the monster, Fu jumped over a fissure on the ground - accidently opening the Box and spilling all of its contents on the snow. Due to his distress, Fu didnt notice he accidently left both the Peacock and the Butterfly on the mountain, alongisde the Grimoire, until it was too late and he was too far away to come back. Somewhere along the line, the Peacock got dangerously damaged, to the point of being improper for use - but, as it turns out, no one knew of this fact until it was too late.

title: Fox Miraculous
text:
Fox Miraculous - History
On a previous trip overseas with the Agrestes, Nathalie found the Butterfly and Peacock Miraculouses and gave the jewels to Gabriel. In "Representation", it was revealed that neither the Agrestes nor the Graham de Vanily couples could bear children on their own, so Émilie and Colt used the Peacock Miraculous to create Adrien and Félix respectively, but in doing so, they grew sick over time and were eventually left in a condition where they fell into an eternal slumber due to using the Peacock Miraculous in its damaged state.

title: Fox Miraculous
text:
Fox Miraculous - History
Desperate to fix his mistake, Gabriel Agreste began using the Butterfly Miraculous for evil to obtain the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses in order to gain access to their absolute power, becoming the supervillain Hawk Moth, later Shadow Moth (when unified with a now fixed Peacock Miraculous), and finally Monarch. This decision proved one of the most significant for the history of the series, as Gabriel began utilizing Nooroo's power to akumatize the civilians of Paris, France, trying to get one of them to draw out the current holders of the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses, unintenionally helping start off Marinette's and Adrien's journeys as Ladybug and Cat Noir, and later, the rest of the Miraculers.

title: Fox Miraculous
text:
Fox Miraculous - History
One of the members of the Miraculers is Alya Césaire, who was chosen by Ladybug in "Sapotis" to wield the Fox Miraculous, becoming the heroine Rena Rouge. Alya, from that point on, became a member of the team, helping Ladybug and Cat Noir during "particularly diffcult missions". From season 2 to "Optigami", Alya was a temporary holder, meaning she would only receive the Miraculous from Ladybug when she was needed for the mission, and had to give it back after the crisis was solved. However, in "Optigami", Marinette realized that Alya, who, by that point already was considered her best friend, knew her identity and was proven to be trustworthy, was more valuable as a permanent holder - after the events of "Sentibubbler", Alya decided to turn into a full-on shadow player, changing her name to Rena Furtive and adopting a new, blue-toned, artic fox-themed outfit. However, after her second identity was exposed yet again in "Strikeback", she willingly gave the Fox Miraculous back to Marinette.

title: Fox Miraculous
text:
Fox Miraculous - History
In "Kwamibuster", Marinette utilized the Fox Miraculous and fused it with the Mouse Miraculous in order to become Multifox, as part of her plan to defeat the eponymous villain and to keep her identity secret from Cat Noir.
Félix, after finding out about his true origins as a sentihuman and learning that the Peacock Miraculous could erase his and his cousin's lifes if it feel into the wrong hands, orchestrated a plan to capture all of the Miraculouses of the Chinese Box from Ladybug and traded all of them (besides the Ladybug and the Cat) for the Peacock, which included the Fox Miraculous, succeeding in "Strikeback". When Gabriel unified it with the Butterfly and other miraculouses, he became Monarch.

title: Fox Miraculous
text:
Fox Miraculous - History
In "Destruction", Gabriel used a laser machine to melt down the Miraculous into a pile of dust, and then reforged it into a special Alliance ring for transferring Trixx's power of Illusion to any akumatized villain who wore a regular Alliance ring. In "Re-creation", Marinette Dupain-Cheng manages to recover all of the Miraculous that were previously stolen. In "Miraculous London", Lila stole all of the Miraculous under Marinette's care in an alternate timeline, which included the Fox Miraculous, in order to render her truly powerless and to fuse the Ladybug and the Cat to gain her wish without her interference, but her plan was ultimately thwarted by the combined efforts of Chronobug and Bunnyx, and the event was erased from the timeline.

title: Fox Miraculous
text:
Fox Miraculous - History
After the events of "Miraculous London", Marinette, having realized both instances of all of the Miraculouses being stolen happened because all of them were kept in the same place, and with the idea that centralized power is inherently flawed, and that distributing it among members of a society is a far superior idea, restored and upgraded the Fox Miraculous by redesigning its original design and adding the Miraculous Call: a call feature that grants the holder the ability to summon other superheroes who possess a Miraculous from the Chinese Miracle Box in order to receive aid on their missions. This new feature is particularly useful, as the new holder of the Butterfly Miraculous, Chrysalis, is even more fearsome than her predecessor. After the alterations, the Fox Miraculous was given back to Alya permanently - putting Rena Rouge back on the map.
In "The Chained Titans", Marinette received the Fox Miraculous from Alya as a plan by Nino to reinforce her relationship with Adrien, and used it to transform into Renardette - after the events of the episode, she relinquished the Miraculous back to Alya, and gave up on being a Fox holder.

title: Fox Miraculous
text:
Fox Miraculous - History
In "Secret Protocol", it is revealed that Ladybug has created numerous security protocols in order to secure the Miraculers' safety. One such protocol is initiated whenever a situation where Marinette's secret identity is at risk arises. She orders Tikki to take the Ladybug Miraculous to Alya, so she can fuse it with the Fox Miraculous in order to become Rena Bug, using both powers of Creation and Illusion in the shadows to defuse the situation while creating a Mirage of Ladybug, so Marinette's identity is kept safe.

title: Fox Miraculous
text:
Fox Miraculous - Trivia
Foxes are a symbol of cunning, wisdom, and passion.
In Folklore, Foxes are known for their trickery and are known for shape-shifting in China, Korea, and Japan.
In the theme song, the Fox Miraculous briefly appears in the Miracle Box, although it is obscured by the raised middle section of the chest box with the Ladybug Miraculous and Cat Miraculous.
In "Volpina", Lila purchases a necklace with a similar design to support her lie to Adrien that she is a Miraculous holder, and it becomes her akumatized object.
Thomas Astruc reaffirmed that the necklace is from a store on Twitter, acknowledging that the scene where she gets it is very short and easy to miss.
In the Miraculous spellbook, one of the codes on the Fox Miraculous page translates to Volpina, but it's unknown if it's the name of the Fox Miraculous holder depicted or an Easter egg.
When Lila is akumatized, becoming a supervillain based off the ancient Chinese Fox Miraculous holder, she gains the power of illusion, but unlike the true Fox Miraculous, she can create as many illusions as she wants, unlike Mirage which only grants one illusion before starting the countdown of five minutes before detransforming.

title: Fox Miraculous
text:
Fox Miraculous - Trivia
As of "Sapotis", it's revealed that the power of illusions is indeed the real Fox Miraculous' power.
At the Anime Expo 2016 panel for the show, it was stated that the wielder of the Fox Miraculous (not an akumatized villain based off of them) "will be potentially a recurring character."
This was confirmed again at the panel at San Diego Comic-Con 2016, along with that the Fox Miraculous and its wielder will appear in season 2.
Unlike the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses, the active mode of the Fox Miraculous isn't that different from its disguise mode, except that its active mode has four golden metal lines dividing the pendant into five sections.
In the Miraculous spellbook, both are shown in their active modes; however, the Fox Miraculous is shown in its disguise mode.
Considering the Japanese and Korean influences in the show, along with the apparent Chinese ties to the Miraculous, it's very likely that the holders are based on the fox spirit in East Asian lore, a cunning trickster fox that uses illusions to fool humans and occasionally takes on the appearance of an attractive young woman.

title: Fox Miraculous
text:
Fox Miraculous - Trivia
The fox spirit appears as the Chinese huli jing, the Japanese kitsune, and the Korean kumiho. Each culture interprets the fox spirit's allegiance and powers differently, with the Korean myths seeing them as purely malicious, but the Chinese and Japanese viewing them as benign, malevolent, or neutral.
The holder uses a flute as their weapon, in a manner resembling that of Melodie.
Like the Ladybug and Cat Miraculous, the legacy of the Fox Miraculous dates back to Ancient China and spans over 5000 years.
The Fox Miraculous, alongside the Mouse Miraculous, was the first instance of Miraculous Unification in the series.
In “Kwamibuster”, Marinette unifies the Mouse Miraculous with the Fox Miraculous becoming Multifox.
As of "Optigami", Alya was allowed to keep the Fox Miraculous permanently, making it the first Miraculous that Marinette assigned to a permanent holder.
As seen in "Mr. Pigeon 72", the one who creates the illusion can control what the illusion says and does.
The fact the Fox Miraculous is a necklace with a fox tail shaped pendant is a visual pun for actual foxtail necklaces.

title: Fox Miraculous
text:
Fox Miraculous - Trivia

title: Flute
text:
Flute - Intro
The  is the tool of the Fox Miraculous.
The current owner of the flute is Alya Césaire, who uses it as the superhero Rena Rouge.
Previously, it was used by Gabriel Agreste when he used the Fox Miraculous with the other Miraculouses in his possession to become Monarch. It was also used by Marinette Dupain-Cheng who unified the Mouse Miraculous with the Fox Miraculous to become Multifox.

title: Flute
text:
Flute - Appearance
The flute changes color depending on whose possession it's in:
When it is used by Rena Rouge, the flute is orange with white stripes, which resembles a red fox's colors, with holes along one side.
From Season 6 onwards, the flute is rectangular. The head joint is white with a black mouthpiece on the side, the body of the flute is orange with white fingering holes, and the foot joint has an orange to black gradient effect. Every section is separated with a black stripe.
When Rena Rouge was akumatized into Rena Rage, the flute was red.
When it was used by Rena Furtive, the flute assumed the same bluish-white camouflage coloration as her costume, resembling an arctic fox's colors.
When it was temporarily used by Multifox, the flute had the same coloring as Rena Rouge's flute.
When it was used by Monarch, the flute kept the same appearance, but instead was purple.

title: Flute
text:
Flute - Abilities
The flute can be used defensively to block and offensively to strike, jab, or bludgeon; it can aid in the application of armlocks, similar to a baton.
The flute has the ability to summon the power Mirage when played, creating one hyper-realistic illusion that the wielder conceives when the holder plays. After the flute has been used, the Miraculous starts to time out, unlike Volpina's variant. Similar to Cat Noir's staff and Ladybug's yo-yo, the holder also uses the flute in hand to hand combat, and when not in use, the holder keeps the flute attached to their back.
In "Mr. Pigeon 72", it's revealed the flute can also be used as a communicator; it projects a hologram of a phone screen from the blowhole. Like Cat Noir's and Ladybug's weapons, when the flute is converted into its cellphone mode, it can take photographs. It is also revealed in "Sentibubbler" that it can be used to text other people.
As seen in "Risk", the flute can also be used as a telescope.
In "The Chained Titans", the user simply need to move their fingers and it will do the rest even if the user themself does not know how to play the flute to activate Mirage.

title: Flute
text:
Flute - Trivia
This specific kind of flute is a reed-pipe or a "pipeau" in French.
The choice of naming could be a reference to the phrase "jouer du pipeau" (to play the reed-pipe), meaning "to lie".
After decoding the Fox Miraculous page from the spellbook one of the scrambled words translates to Box and wood when combined it means "Boxwood" which was a type of wood used to make woodwind instruments and is also native to Asia hinting that the Mage could've used it to make the flute.
The Flute is the first Miraculous tool to be a musical instrument, and followed by the Snake Miraculous' lyre, the Eagle Miraculous' bullroarer and the Pig Miraculous' tambourine.
It's the sixth Miraculous tool to be revealed to be able to be used for communication, following the Ladybug Miraculous' yo-yo, the Cat Miraculous' staff, the Bee Miraculous' spinning top, the Peacock Miraculous' hand fan, and the Butterfly Miraculous' cane.

title: Fontaine du Palmier
text:
Fontaine du Palmier - Intro
The  or Fontaine de la Victoire is a monumental fountain located in the Place du Châtelet, between the Théâtre du Châtelet and the Théâtre de la Ville, in the 1st arrondissement of Paris. It was designed to provide fresh drinking water to the population of the neighborhood and it is the largest fountain built during Napoleon's reign still in existence.

title: Fontaine du Palmier
text:
Fontaine du Palmier - Description
Commissioned in 1806 by Napoleon to celebrate his victories, the Fontaine du Palmier is a monumental fountain located in the center of the Place du Châtelet. The fountain consists of a central column in the shape of a palm tree, topped by a gilded statue of Victory, the work of the sculptor Louis-Simon Boizot, La Renommée de Boizot. The column is decorated with stylized palm leaves and inscriptions commemorating Napoleon's victories, such as Austerlitz, Jena and Eylau. At the base of the column is a circular basin with four sphinxes, added in 1858 under Napoleon III, sculpted by Gabriel Davioud. These sphinxes spit water and symbolize the power and greatness of the Empire.

title: Fontaine du Palmier
text:
Fontaine du Palmier - Trivia
In the series, the fountain has been the scene of several clashes:
In "Ladybug & Cat Noir", the police attempted to arrest Stoneheart near the Fontaine du Palmier.
In "Dark Cupid", Ladybug faced the eponymous villain and Cat Noir, whose feelings had been reversed.
Additionally, it was at the foot of this fountain that Ladybug kissed Cat Noir to break Dark Cupid's power.
In "Guitar Villain", the pillar of the Fontaine du Palmier was destroyed by the powers of the eponymous villain.
In "Party Crasher", part of the fight against the eponymous villain took place at the Fontaine du Palmier and its surroundings.
In "Gabriel Agreste", Cat Noir tried to hide with Félix behind the Fontaine du Palmier to escape Senticollector, but was captured in his tablet.
In the series, the Refammée de Boizot also serves as a hideout for supervillains or akumatized people several times:
In "Mr. Pigeon", the eponymous villain prepared his attack on city and the superheroes from the top of the Fontaine du Palmier.
In "The Collector", the eponymous villain hid behind the Fontaine du Palmier statue to set a trap for Ladybug and Cat Noir.

title: Fontaine du Palmier
text:
Fontaine du Palmier - Trivia
In "Miraculer", Mayura hid behind the Fontaine du Palmier statue there to spy on Chloé and wait for her to receive the Bee Miraculous to steal it from her.

title: Fountain Pen
text:
Fountain Pen - Intro
The  is the tool of the Rooster Miraculous.
The current owner of the fountain pen is Marc Anciel who uses it as the superhero Rooster Bold.
Previously, it was used by Gabriel Agreste when he used the Rooster Miraculous with the other Miraculouses in his possession to become Monarch.

title: Fountain Pen
text:
Fountain Pen - Appearance
The fountain pen changes color depending on who owns it:
When used by Rooster Bold, the fountain pen has a gold barrel and a white feather with red spine. It also has an ornamental orange jewel with three spikes on each side. The jewel is pressed against a circular, golden plate with a thick orange circle.
From Season 6 and onwards, the feather is bigger. The ornamental jewel turns red, lacks the spikes, and the golden plate is replaced with a golden chevron.
When it was used by Monarch, the fountain pen turned all purple.

title: Fountain Pen
text:
Fountain Pen - Abilities
Like the other Miraculous tools, the fountain pen is nearly unbreakable and can be used to deflect attacks, when the Fountain Pen is used offensively, it can stab or cut.
As shown in "Miraculous Paris", the fountain pen has a form of usage when the Sublimation is activated. It can be used to write the power the user is choosing, by placing on the hands. This use is possibly for powers that are more complex than just "invisibility", "enhanced senses" or "flight" and require a more specific formulation to make sure it works the way the user wants.

title: Fountain Pen
text:
Fountain Pen - Trivia
The weapon being a fountain pen perfectly matches Marc as a Rooster Miraculous holder as he is known for his writing.
The quote "The pen is mightier than the sword.", which is used to indicate that words (commonly those which were used in written publications) can be used as a more effective tool than direct violence.
The fountain pen is also reference to Jacob Grimm and Wilhelm Grimm otherwise known as the Brothers Grimm, a pair of two late 17th and early 18th century German writers who are known for writing many classic fairy tales known as the Grimms' Fairy Tales such as Cinderella, Hansel and Gretel, Rumplestitskin, The Frog Prince, Town Musicians of Bremen, Little Red Riding Hood, Rapunzel, Sleeping Beauty, and Snow White.
It's the fourth tool to be worn as as a superhero outfit accessory, after the Turtle Miraculous' shield, the Mouse Miraculous' skip rope, and the Tiger Miraculous' bolas.
