title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Intro
(né Gabi Grassette) was one of the two main antagonists (alongside Chrysalis) of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir.
He was also the main antagonist of Miraculous World, serving as the main antagonist of Miraculous World: New York - United Heroez, the secondary antagonist of Miraculous World: Shanghai - The Legend of Ladydragon and Miraculous World: Paris - Tales of Shadybug and Claw Noir, and the posthumous overarching antagonist of Miraculous World: London - At the Edge of Time.
He was a world-famous fashion designer who created and owned the fashion brand Gabriel. He was also the husband of the late Émilie Agreste and the father of Adrien Agreste, who modelled for his brand until Season 5. He was also secretly a member of The Kingdom, a secret evil organization that is searching for the Ladybug and the Cat Miraculouses. Within the council, he was known as the Diamond.

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Intro
With the Butterfly Miraculous, when inhabited by Nooroo, Gabriel transformed into Hawk Moth (Le Papillon in the French version, translating to "The Butterfly"), a butterfly-themed supervillain with the power of Transmission, who was the main villain of the first three seasons. He wanted Ladybug's and Cat Noir's Miraculouses for himself in order to obtain the Ultimate Miraculous Absolute Power and reshape reality to bring back his wife after she used the damaged Peacock Miraculous. To achieve his goal, he used the Butterfly Miraculous' power: Akumatization. This allowed him to create and control akumas – regular butterflies imbued with the power of the Butterfly Miraculous – that can transform normal people experiencing negative emotions into akumatized supervillains.
In "The Collector", in order to divert suspicion of being Hawk Moth due to his possession of the Grimoire, he akumatized himself into the Collector, a supervillain who had the power to imprison any person or object within his magical notebook as his weapon.

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Intro
In the two-part special episode "Heroes' Day", Hawk Moth was enhanced by his akumatized assistant into Scarlet Moth as part of his plan to get the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses.
In Season 4, beginning with "Truth", Gabriel unified the Butterfly Miraculous with the now-fixed Peacock Miraculous to become Shadow Moth (Papillombre in the French version, translating to Shadow Butterfly) to be a stronger opponent against his arch-enemies.
In "Dearest Family", facing the obstacle that Ladybug's Magical Charms presented to his plans, Shadow Moth was able to create an improved version of his akumas, called megakumas, capable of breaking through the defenses of the Magical Charms and destroying them. During his successful experiment, Gabriel briefly reakumatized himself into the Collector.
In "Ephemeral", Shadow Moth acquired the Cat Miraculous from Adrien and unified it with his other Miraculouses to become Shadow Noir (Chatpillon in the French version). He was also able to steal the Ladybug Miraculous from Marinette and achieve his goal to make his wish come true. Fortunately, after Sass rewound time, this plan never came to fruition and Shadow Noir was erased from reality.

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Intro
In "Shadow Moth's Final Attack", Shadow Moth amokized himself to create Strikeback. After a bargain with his nephew Félix, who was able to steal Ladybug's yo-yo as Flairmidable, Gabriel renounced the Peacock Miraculous, trading it for all the Miraculouses in the Chinese Miracle Box (except the Ladybug and Cat) and the ring Félix had previously stolen from him. Later, he unified the Butterfly Miraculous with the Fox and Turtle Miraculouses to become Monarch (Monarque in the French version) and boast his victory over Ladybug to all of Paris.
In "Evolution", Monarch used the Rabbit Miraculous to go to the past to discover Ladybug and Cat Noir's secret identities and to prevent his wife's coma. Later, he unified them with the Turtle, Fox, Bee, Dragon and Dog Miraculouses to prevent Ladybug and Cat Noir from stopping him. He ended up losing the Rabbit Miraculous in the end, and Nathalie decided to stop helping Gabriel after he chose to go after Ladybug and Cat Noir instead of saving her and Émilie.

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Intro
In "Multiplication", he began working with Tomoe Tsurugi to create the Alliance rings. To test their ability to receive Miraculous superpowers, he akumatized Tomoe and transferred to her the power of the Mouse Miraculous. Upon her defeat, the Miraculous superpower disappeared and the kwami returned to her cage in Monarch's lair, removing the need to give and take the Miraculouses as Ladybug once did.
In "Destruction", while trying to discover the address of Ladybug's alter ego, Monarch was caught by Ladybug and Cat Noir and subjugated. In a desperate move, Monarch forced Cat Noir to use his Cataclysm on the former's left forearm, stunning his enemies long enough to unify the Butterfly and Horse Miraculouses and escape. Later on, in order to prevent himself from falling into any more traps set by Ladybug and Cat Noir and risk losing any more Miraculouses, all while still making use of their powers, Gabriel melted all the Miraculous in his possession with the exception of the Butterfly and reforged them into rings. He also adopted a brand-new form as Monarch, donning a new suit that resembles Hawk Moth, but with some upgrades.

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Intro
In "Deflagration", after finding out the identities of Scarabella and Kitty Noire, Gabriel was able to steal the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses from Alya and Zoé respectively. When he tried to unify the two Miraculous with the Butterfly Miraculous, Plagg used his Cataclysm on his Miraculous, destroying it. However, after Marinette disguised as Ladybug told him the Miraculous Ladybug was the only thing capable of bringing Plagg and the Cat Miraculous back, he unified the Butterfly Miraculous with the Ladybug Miraculous, becoming Monarch Bug. He tried to use Miraculous Monarch Bug to restore the Cat Miraculous, but was duped by Marinette's fake Lucky Charm and lost both the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses as a result.

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Intro
In the events of "Multiplication" through "Intuition", Gabriel, unbeknownst to others, was using Second Chance to rewind to the time when his akumatized villains were about to be defeated, thus giving them one more chance. However, this only accelerated the effect of the Cataclysm and made him even weaker, at the risk of his life. In his last attempt, he used this power again to sabotage the test on Tsurugi Industries's space jet to separate Ladybug and Cat Noir, using the powers of Migration, Passion, Illusion, Protection and Action as part of his plan. However, as Ladybug and Cat Noir are always unpredictable in battle, he abused the use of Second Chance, and became even weaker. Following this, Gabriel no longer uses the Snake Miraculous.
In "Representation", after Adrien disobeyed him and ran away from London to be with Marinette again, Gabriel akumatized himself into Nightormentor, a supervillain, and a new version of the Collector, who could shoot magic dust from his blowpipe to make his victims mentally experience their worst nightmare. Additionally, he granted himself the power of Migration.

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Intro
In "The Final Day", Gabriel reakumatized himself into Nightormentor, and with the powers of the Mouse, Rooster and Horse Miraculouses, he spread his nightmare dust across the world. Later, Gabriel transferred the powers of the Miraculouses to people via the Alliance rings and transformed them into the Miraculized, a group of people chasing after Ladybug and Cat Noir, after he falsely claimed that they had kidnapped his son Adrien Agreste, and Kagami Tsurugi. In the end, he lost the Butterfly Miraculous after Bug Noire knocked it right off him with her staff during the final battle, acquired the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses and used his wish to bring his assistant Nathalie back to life after realizing the error of his ways after a final plea from Marinette. This resulted in the universe being re-created and Gabriel giving up his life, joining his wife Émilie in the afterlife. Lila Rossi, who now goes by Cerise Bianca, claims his Miraculous after his death, and becomes the new holder of the Butterfly Miraculous.

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Intro
In "El Toro De Piedra", it was revealed that Gabriel left a letter for Adrien, explaining his identity as Monarch and asking him to continue his legacy to revive both himself and his mother. However, Adrien has not received the letter as Marinette and Nathalie kept it from him.

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Appearance
Physical appearance
Gabriel was a very tall middle aged man with a fair but rosy-tinted skin tone and a pointy chin. He had pale, light grayish cerulean colored eyes and combed-back light blond (or grey, depending on the episode) hair, along with grey eyebrows.
In Season 5, his hair was white and a little flatter.
In a desperate move, to escape a trap set by Ladybug and Cat Noir, he forced Cat Noir to Cataclysm him in "Destruction". Gabriel gained a hand-shaped burn-like mark on his left forearm. In "Passion", "Elation", and "Protection", the damage was revealed to be expanding, covering his whole forearm.
"Intuition" demonstrates Gabriel's damaged heart. To make matters worse, as shown in "Pretension", the injury extended up his arm and covered most of his chest.
In "Re-creation", he was seen coughing up black dust, indicating that his internal systems were succumbing. Before he made his wish, the injury had reached his chin, and small parts of his fingers were seen crumbling to dust.
Civilian attire

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Appearance
In the first four seasons, and the beginning of Season 5, Gabriel wore black-framed glasses with silver lenses. He had a white high collar dress shirt underneath a medium gray striped vest with red buttons and a cream-colored dress jacket without buttons, along with a red and white-striped ascot tie and red cufflinks. Underneath the tie, he had the Butterfly Miraculous pinned on his shirt, which was round and dark purple with black lining containing a picture of his spouse inside, lacking the wings. He also wore red dress pants and a pair of white dress shoes with black sole and red shoelaces. On the middle finger of his left hand, he had a silver band ring, which was sometimes depicted on his right hand.

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:

In Season 5, starting with "Multiplication" and "Destruction", Gabriel wore a completely white suit to conceal his Cataclysm injury. This consisted of a high-collared dress shirt paired with a vest that featured a zipper and a dress jacket without buttons. He accessorized with a tie. Beneath the tie, he had the Butterfly Miraculous pinned to his shirt. His outfit also included dress pants and dress shoes with black soles that had no shoelaces. Gabriel completed his look with white gloves that covered the reforged Miraculouses shaped like rings. He wore new glasses with rectangular lenses and a white frame. On his fingers, he retained his original silver band ring, and on the index finger of his right hand, he wore a silver band Alliance ring.

title: Gabriel Agreste

In his second transformation, Monarch only used his Butterfly Miraculous, which was located on his chest.
His suit changed regarding the last one.
It was similar to the one he had as Hawk Moth, but had a dark purple tailcoat over its jacket with a big dark purple (or black) butterfly-shaped lapel.
The lapel had white dots on either side at the upper tips and above around the neck sides.
He also wore dark purple gloves and dress shoes without laces.
On his head, he had a dark purple cowl covering the upper half of his face, with the front being shaped as a butterfly.
His ears were exposed and his hair was once again covered.
He had lilac skin and the brilliant purple scleras he had in Monarch's unified form with vivid cyan irises.
On his fingers, he had a set of dark purple (or silver when he was detransformed) rings, the other Miraculous in their reforged form, each of them having a symbol of the Miraculous that he formerly had that they represented.

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Appearance
Pressing them either allowed him to use the Miraculous superpowers or transfer the Miraculous superpowers to his akumatized supervillains, with the rings being positioned as follows: Mouse on his left thumb, Dragon on his left index finger, Bee and Goat on his left middle finger, Dog on his left ring finger, Tiger on his left pinky finger, Ox on his right thumb, Horse and Monkey on his right index finger, Fox and Snake on his right middle finger, Turtle and Rooster on his right ring finger and Pig on his right pinky finger.
He also wore a regular Alliance ring on his left index finger.
He was armed with his cane, which is now slightly longer than when he welded as Hawk Moth/Shadow Moth, and the other Miraculous tools/weapons in both transformation forms.
As Monarch Bug

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Appearance
Monarch Bug's outfit had the same design as Monarch, except it changed from dark purple to red with black polka-dot patterns. His irises' color changed from vivid cyan to vivid red, and his cowl, tailcoat, lapel, gloves and dress shoes changed from dark purple to black. The Butterfly Miraculous was still on his chest and he wore the Ladybug Miraculous on his ears. His skin, however, remained lilac, though it became much paler.
As Nightormentor

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Appearance
Nightormentor had the same appearance as the Collector, though the color scheme of his suit changed significantly, and his face. His skin was a slightly dark shade of lilac, while his visor turned into a gradation of dark blue to magenta. His hair turned blue with glowing pink stripes. His suit turned dark purple with glowing glitter everywhere on his suit. His hands, lapel, and lining were all a glowing pink, and the lined areas had gained a diamond tip in the middle on the torso, and three diamond buttons on top. The stripes on his chest turned into a single lavender one, with the rest of the upper section light blue with his tie being magenta with lighter downward bent stripes. He wielded a long, glowing pink flute with three dark magenta lines at each tip.

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Personality
Gabriel was a cold hearted, harsh, and very strict man. He was extremely protective of his son Adrien, having kept him home for most of his life. He had a possessive and distant relationship with him. He made executive decisions about how to keep his son safe without considering how he may feel, such as unjustly deeming Nino a bad influence for Adrien and forbidding him from coming to his home ever again. Gabriel missed his wife greatly and sometimes had to be reminded that his son was also grieving as well, making him oblivious to the feelings of others. According to Adrien in "Adrien's Double Life", ever since the "disappearance" of his wife, Gabriel was a changed man; one that strongly disliked taking orders from anyone, even if they were from people who were trying to help and protect him, such as Ladybug and Cat Noir. Despite this, he could be respectful and kind at times, especially when needing to act professionally.

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Personality
In his supervillain identities, he was cold and determined. After one of his akumatized supervillain's defeat, he determinedly vowed revenge and wasted little time waiting to try again. His goal was to claim the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses and to gain their absolute power necessary to achieve his secret wish, not caring if he caused people harm in the process, even to his own son. He was aware of the equivalent exchange drawback of making a wish with the Miraculouses, every wish having a reaction to maintain balance in the universe, but it did not appear to bother him, leading to him being very ignorant, cocky, and reckless about the magic he wielded or wished to obtain on several occasions. Meaning that he didn't always think things through, such as him being unaware of the after-effects of using such magic, not recalling his akuma back before he lost it in "Startrain" or when he praised Chloé for using the Miraculouses against Ladybug and Cat Noir, apparently unaware that she could have severely injured herself by doing so, painfully learning this himself the hard way in "Evolution".

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Personality
He was also very stubborn as he refused to listen to Nooroo about how the Butterfly Miraculous should be used, showing no remorse about all the damage and chaos he caused in Paris and was also very desperate to save his wife, initially anyway. At that point, he was completely obsessed with Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses. Saving his wife was merely a justification for his obsession, though this was also part of the obsession to a degree. It was the consumption of said obsessive feelings that twisted his heart so much that in the alternate future of "Cat Blanc" and "Miraculous Shanghai", it led to his own demise. However, as the battle went on to save her, he was wracked with guilt and worry for Nathalie as she used the damaged Peacock Miraculous before it was fixed. This is seen expressively in "Nathalie as seen by Gabriel".
Those said feelings are what deeply affected his moral compass, as he used them to encourage his minions to do the same.
As seen in "Truth", "Lies", "Gang of Secrets", as well as most episodes, he was fine with helping others expose the secrets of those close to them by any means necessary, but for himself, he hid the biggest secret of them all.

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Personality
On occasion, he misused the power of good emotions through his akumatized supervillains to do his bidding by force seen in "The Bubbler" and "Zombizou".
He manipulated his victims into thinking he was their supporter who could help them achieve their goals if they helped him achieve his.
Even though he convinced himself he did all this destruction for his family, Gabriel really did it for himself and his pride; as no one in their right mind would ask for this, let alone thank him for ignoring the consequences of his actions.
He also claimed that the outside world was dangerous, but he was responsible for everything and by using the Miraculouses irresponsibly, he made himself a danger to his own son.
The akumatized villains he made were his most powerful known weapon, so he tried to choose his victims carefully.
Despite this, in several episodes such as "Psycomedian" and "Crocoduel", he missed out on a great akumatization opportunity just to akumatize his original target first.
If things weren't going his way, he easily became impatient, threatening to harm almost anyone who stood in his way, be they heroes, civilians, or even the akumatized supervillains he created.

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Personality
He sometimes used puns, such as telling the akuma to draw Nathaniel into their evil web in "The Evillustrator".
He was also shown to be willing to exploit the emotions of his akumatized villains whatever Ladybug tried to reason with them, one of these examples being in "Sole Crusher", after Marinette tried to reason with the titular villain, Shadow Moth took advantage of Sole Crusher's conflicted emotions and threatened Sole Crusher of taking away her powers if she did not get Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses and leaving her "stuck with the losers" and manipulating her by saying that she was "weakening" the more she listened to Marinette, showing that Shadow Moth didn't want his akumatized villains losing focus of getting Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses and would exploit his victims' emotions and insecurities so they could continue their task.
Despite these traits, Gabriel could be merciful with those he cared about, such as when he ordered the akumatized supervillain to drop Ladybug in order to save Adrien, in "Gorizilla".

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Personality
While he was obsessed with finding a way to save his wife, he was willing to give up his evil ways to protect Adrien from being caught in the crossfire or being targeted by the akumatized supervillains he created.
This situation, along with his frustration that even Audrey, who he believed was his greatest masterpiece, made him temporarily renounce his role as a villain.
However, he decided to continue to be Hawk Moth after Audrey's daughter Chloé used the Bee Miraculous Ladybug lost during her battle with Style Queen to become Queen Bee, viewing the opportunity to akumatize a Miraculous holder as too good to pass up.
Though his goal was specifically getting Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses, Gabriel also planned to seize all of the Miraculouses so he could have unlimited powers at his disposal which he somewhat succeeded in as he possessed fifteen Miraculouses from the Chinese Miracle Box, including the Butterfly Miraculous.
It is implied that he became power-hungry due to being a villain for a long time and was addicted to yearning power to an extreme degree that he would grasp every opportunity to seize power in order to steal the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses.

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Personality
Even though he didn't know it yet, by creating situations that put the heroes in said positions, Gabriel fed his greed, such as when Alya played his greed against him in "Sentibubbler".
It is also implied in "Evolution" that using so many Miraculouses at once was affecting his sanity, such as how he eagerly used the Rabbit Miraculous out of greed and impatience which caused him to lose it, though he probably would have acted the same way without his insanity. He also made a point of using the kwamis as a constant reminder of Ladybug's mistake. He also called the kwamis useless, though it was his own choice and fault for overtaxing them. More proof of his insanity is when he forced Cat Noir to use his Cataclysm on his forearm so he could escape a trap that Ladybug and Cat Noir prepared which left him completely at their mercy. Without a way to escape, he risked his own life to make a way to get away and took Ladybug's Lucky Charm with him, the only thing capable of healing him.

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Personality
Even more so in "Intuition", when he used Second Chance while in his condition, making it worse and by not fully understanding the Snake Miraculous power, he foolishly used it in a situation he couldn't win to the point where Nathalie harshly reprimanded him about it.
One of his greatest weaknesses was that he seemed to underestimate people as he taunted Ladybug and Cat Noir for being young, but the heroes proved their worth by beating his akumatized supervillains almost every single time. He also had a habit of celebrating too soon when the heroes were weakened by his many akumatized supervillains, thinking it would get him closer to the heroes' Miraculouses. In "Cat Blanc", he said that if Ladybug truly loved Adrien, she would let him save his mother, suspecting that they would use the same tactics. As seen in "Gang of Secrets", he was shocked that Alya broke his hold, calling it impossible, believing that his link couldn't be broken. This was quite foolish since in "Miraculer", Chloé resisted him.

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Personality
This also showed his lack of trust and belief in people as of various episodes and until "Robostus", no one asked why he wanted the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses nor he didn't say, always believing his ways were right and others were wrong, without even thinking his ways could have been wrong. He continuously withheld the truth out of fear of believing no one could or would help him if it were exposed, especially with the Snake Miraculous.
Leading to his limited perspective on the Butterfly Miraculous' true meaning; as he said in "Stormy Weather 2", "People don't change, they grow". However, Gabriel failed to realize with change comes growth, and growth comes change. As Master Fu believed in the events of "The Battle of the Miraculous", he talked too much for someone who hadn't achieved much so far, meaning he did so much to change himself and others on the outside he neglected inner changes, and by letting his negative feelings run wild for too long, Gabriel wasn't only in denial or angry about the past; but afraid of it, which could also explain why he hid like a caterpillar that is afraid to come out of his cocoon and why he didn't trust Adrien with the truth.

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Personality
This is held true in "Revelation", as Gabriel kept secrets about his past hidden in a safe. Even though they both were affected by the loss of Émilie, Gabriel should've taken solace that his son has found someone to love but instead of being happy and proud for him, he was disgusted and jealous towards him, not only for Adrien falling in love with someone who wasn't a part of his class, but their happiness reminded him of what he no longer had.
His hatred for the lower class and people who "don't know their place" likely stemmed from his in-laws, who presumably shamed him for his humble background.
According to Félix's play in "Representation", Gabriel was a "humble tailor" who went by Gabi Grassette.
Despite his extraordinary talent in fashion design, Gabriel didn't have much to his name, nor was he as proud or self-confident as he was when he was alive.
His in-laws, Emil and Millie Graham de Vanily, particularly his father-in-law, were taken aback by Émilie's relationship with Gabriel, as they didn't believe he was good enough for their daughter, given that he had no money or social status.

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Personality
Even after his death, Emil continues to belittle Gabriel's occupation and Émilie's decision to marry him.
His brother-in-law, Colt Fathom, even called him an "inferior tailor", meaning to Colt, Gabriel was nothing more than just a menial servant and didn't believe at all that he and Émilie should have had a child.
Once he became rich and powerful himself, he changed his name to sound more upper-class, preferred to surround himself with higher-class people, cut all ties with his loving parents and humble origins and developed an elitist and classist attitude, not just towards Adrien's friends and Marinette in particular, but towards the world, reminiscent of his father and brother-in-laws.
Much he showed that attitude through his powers similar to how some rich people used their status and influence to turn or rig things into their favor shown in various episodes to the point where he trapped the heroes in a very tight situation to the point where they could do little about it.
In many ways, Gabriel was a hypocrite.
He stated that he was worried about Adrien's safety, but he had often put him in danger.

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Personality
He laughed at Ladybug and Cat Noir for caring about Senti-Ladybug when his son is a senti-human.
He had a problem with Adrien starting a romantic relationship with Marinette, due to him thinking she's not good enough for his son as she's just "the daughter of local bakers" when Gabriel himself came from identical, if not lower origins, than her; his in-laws didn't accept his relationship with Émilie and thought she was too good for him, resulting in Émilie giving up everything for Gabriel.
He claimed to believe that children being free to do whatever they want when he controlled Adrien's entire life.
Gabriel mocked Marinette when she said that fashion was a form of self-expression, when he used to make clothes to make people happy and help bring their dreams to life in his youth.
In "Sapotis", Gabriel believed children should be free to do whatever they wanted to do while he restricted Adrien's freedom and never allowing him to do anything or go anywhere without his approval.
Gabriel continually established that he cared for Adrien's happiness and was doing all this for him.

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Personality
Yet, he not only isolated Adrien from the world while pushing him away, but Gabriel also repeatedly hurt him and took away what made his son happy.
Nathalie pointed out that Gabriel placed his ideas of happiness onto Adrien's.
Even Bug Noire bluntly told him that Adrien not only made peace with Émilie's passing, but he meant nothing to Gabriel anymore, who was now only using his son as a justification for his madness.

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Personality
Despite his strategic brilliance, Gabriel seemed to overlook easier solutions when fixing a problem, such as when Émilie got put into a coma as a result using the damaged Peacock Miraculous. He needed a cure which he thought could only be done by using the Ultimate Miraculous Absolute Power. He was quick to use force to get what he wanted as well as impatient, leading him to doubt the use of other options but also the help and support of others. His plans were often frustrated, as he was prone to mistakes as he had an extremely limited perspective. For example, in "Miracle Queen", he had every Miraculous in his possession, but he gave them to Chloé. It is implied that Nathalie came up with most of his ideas, though he generally only used her ideas once. For example, he only once used Optigami. Like Ladybug, Gabriel too came under the stress of living a double life, not finding it easy to be himself and his alter ego mentioned in "Nathalie as seen by Gabriel".

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Personality
Gabriel's true intentions were laid bare after his confrontation with Bug Noire. He was willing to cause a high level of collateral damage akin to terrorism and showed no qualms about sacrificing anyone, like Marinette or even the world, to achieve his goals. However, after losing his powers and being reminded the hard truths of his actions for the past season, Émilie's final wishes for him and Adrien, Gabriel experienced a profound change. He broke down in tears, acknowledging Émilie's wisdom and deeply regretting the harm his actions had caused his son and were continuing to inflict on his and Nathalie's lives. Despite managing to disarm Marinette and obtain her Miraculouses, he found redemption in his final act. He made his wish, sacrificing himself in the process, with his wish being revealed as the wellbeing of his family.

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Personality
As the Collector, due to akumatizing himself, his personality was virtually unaffected. He was obsessed with collecting everything he liked to replace the Grimoire but was still determined to take Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses. He also knew that he had to protect his secret identity, referring to himself in third person by telling the already suspecting heroes that he would "give their Miraculouses to Hawk Moth" in order to throw them off his trail.
As Nightormentor, due to akumatizing himself, his personality was once again virtually unaffected. He was obsessed with finding his son after he fled his London flat, even going after his girlfriend to force her to tell him where he hid and having no qualms into attacking with his nightmare dust to his son's innocent friends to know where Marinette was. He was also not very determined or focused on wanting to get Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses but decided to change his mind when he saw that Cat Noir was teaching him how to be a good father and preventing him from completing his quest. He was even portrayed as a "coward" from Cat Noir's point of view.

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Abilities
As a civilian
Gabriel was an expert at fashion design, be it clothes, accessories, or jewelry. According to Audrey, a fashion critic known for being harsh in her evaluations, she hasn't seen talent as great as Marinette's since Gabriel. Additionally, owning the Gabriel brand, Gabriel was well-versed at running a business, including solving problems by phone concerning design issues and presenting himself professionally when around others.
Gabriel had good hindsight and suspicions about things, revealing he had suspected that there are more Miraculouses in the city and a guardian after Rena Rouge's appearance. In "Syren", he revealed that he'd suspected that Miraculouses had hidden powers after seeing Ladybug and Cat Noir in their aqua forms. He also believed that Adrien could be Cat Noir until he indirectly tricked him that he wasn't. According to Miraculous Secrets, he caused chaos in Paris in the first place, not only to find superheroes, but a guardian in the city to decipher the Grimoire.
He later noticed Ladybug's disappearances in the middle of battles to bring allies, suspecting that she went to the Guardian of the Miraculouses.

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Abilities
Despite being often outsmarted by Ladybug and Cat Noir, Gabriel proved to be a brilliant strategist and tactician. He was cautious and careful like his superheroine nemesis. An example of this is when he was under the suspicion of being Hawk Moth, he akumatized himself to fly under the radar. This showed that he was willing to use dirty or unfair tactics such as using sheer numbers to wear the superheroes down and resorting to surprise attacks, as seen in "Heroes' Day". He also noticed that both Lila and Chloé had great potential and unfinished business with Ladybug, planning to use this to his advantage not only to akumatize them, but also form alliances with them.
Since Nathalie stole Fu's tablet with the deciphered Grimoire pages, Gabriel had knowledge about the process to repair Miraculouses, several spells such as the incantation needed for the wish-granting power of the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses, and the recipes for the potions which grant more powers to the holders. However, just like Master Fu and Marinette, the former master was only able to partially decode the Grimoire, so it was likely Gabriel's understanding was more limited than theirs.

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Abilities
Gabriel had many talents, which his son later learned as well: he was very skilled at fencing, knew how to play the piano and perform a duet, and was able to speak Japanese and other languages fluently. Furthermore, Gabriel was able to grow and harvest butterflies.
As Hawk Moth
Hawk Moth had enhanced skills such as speed, agility, strength, and near-invulnerability. Despite the fact that he didn't often fight directly, Hawk Moth was a capable sword fighter, being able to defend himself and destroy miniature missiles from his own lair's defense protocol with his swordstick. His prowess was enough to overpower younger combatants like Ladybug and Cat Noir.
Even without being transformed, Hawk Moth's Miraculous allowed him to feel emotions, whether positive or negative, so he could precisely pinpoint his victims, their emotions, and the reason why they have them. Hawk Moth could control many akumas to form a swarm that made a large version of his head, which he could speak through, shown in "Stoneheart".

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Abilities
Hawk Moth's main superpower was Akumatization, the ability to charge butterflies with dark energy, transforming them into akumas and then sending them out to possess an object of someone vulnerable. He could also keep his butterflies in his cane if he needed to use an akuma in another location other than his lair. If his targets agreed to serve him, he transformed them into supervillains by corrupting their personalities and granting them a wide variety of superpowers or special abilities. He could also telepathically communicate with his akumatized supervillains through a pink or purple butterfly-shaped outline that appeared in front of his and the akumatized supervillains' faces when he does so.

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Abilities
However, he was only able to create one akumatized villain at a time over the course of an indeterminate amount of time. He needed to convince his victims to accept the powers that he granted, and the akumatized supervillains that he created still had a will of their own and could either disobey him or carry out his orders incompetently. Still, if an akumatized supervillain didn't go and retrieve the Miraculous like they agreed to, Hawk Moth could control their bodies for a brief amount of time in order to inflict pain onto them until they agreed to do so again. He was also capable of purifying an akuma himself.

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Abilities
When an akuma isn't purified by Ladybug, it will multiply and turn other people into frozen copies of the original akumatized supervillain. Hawk Moth could recall and keep the original akuma in the top of his cane in order to release it again when the victim got sad or angry once more. This turned the victim into the same akumatized villain, but it also unfroze the copies of them, which the original villain could command and control. However, once the original akuma is de-evilized, its copies vanish, reverting the duplicates of the villain back to normal. As shown in Miraculous Shanghai, Hawk Moth could reuse a released akuma instead of multiplying it, akumatizing another person when in need. Hawk Moth was capable of akumatizing any kind of being, not only humans, as long as they are capable of feeling emotions. He was able to akumatize Markov, an AI with real emotions, Master Fu's dormant sentimonster, and Mei Shi, a lion spirit.
As the Collector

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Abilities
As the Collector, he was quick and agile. His main ability was to trap objects and people in the form of drawings inside his book. He threw the book like a boomerang and was capable of going very far distances, once it captured something or someone by hitting them, it returned to him wherever he was.
He could also summon his weapon to himself at will, and utilize the book as a shield against projectiles by either opening it, holding it sturdily or waving it around, so it trapped the object being thrown towards him. Anything it encountered was trapped, no matter how big it was. However, there was a limit to how much could be absorbed, as shown when Ladybug used a makeshift conveyor belt to launch a barrage of Adrien's CDs at him and he used his book to absorb them, it was full when he tried to absorb Ladybug.
The abilities might possibly be different, unlike the original book, his tablet might implied to have infinite storage like SentiGabriel when it was his akumatized object.
As Scarlet Moth

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Abilities
In "Catalyst" and "Ladybug", Hawk Moth akumatized Nathalie into Catalyst, granting her the ability to enhance other individual's powers. Under Catalyst's influence, Hawk Moth became Scarlet Moth, which greatly augmented his akumatization capabilities. He could create as many akumas and akumatized villains as he wished, without the need to ask for their permission before akumatizing them or the risk of them disobeying him.
As Shadow Moth
As Shadow Moth, Gabriel possessed the abilities of both the Butterfly and the Peacock Miraculouses, having the ability to create akumatized champions along with sentimonsters as their allies. He also possessed both the Butterfly Miraculous' cane and the Peacock Miraculous' hand fan as a weapon, using the feathers of the latter to create his amoks. Shadow Moth could either revive dormant sentimonsters or destroy them through releasing their amoks, even if he wasn't the one who created them.
As Shadow Noir

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Abilities
As Shadow Noir, he possessed the abilities of both the Butterfly and Peacock Miraculouses in addition to the Cat Miraculous, having the ability to create akumatized supervillains along with sentimonsters as their allies, as well as being able to use Cataclysm. He also possessed the Butterfly Miraculous' cane, the Peacock Miraculous' hand fan and the Cat Miraculous' staff as his weapons.
As Monarch
Due to Monarch having all of the Chinese Miracle Box's Miraculouses, except for the Ladybug, Cat, Peacock, and, as of "Evolution," the Rabbit Miraculous, this gave him immense power, allowing him to wield the superpowers of each Miraculous. In this form, he could utilize his abilities as a Butterfly Miraculous user, along with the additional powers granted by the other Miraculouses:
Mirage to cast and communicate through hyper-realistic illusions.
Venom to paralyze anyone he touched with his stinger hand.
Shell-ter to create a nigh-unbreakable force field.
Multitude to split himself into any amount of smaller clones.
Resistance to gain immunity to other superpowers and attacks.
Clout to gain an energy boost and release it as a punch that overwhelmed anything it encountered.

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Abilities
Wind Dragon, Water Dragon, and Lightning Dragon to transform into and manipulate the elements of wind, water, and lightning.
Second Chance to rewind time to a previously marked moment, allowing him to correct any issues or mistakes that occurred in the original timeline.
Voyage to open a portal to anywhere in the universe.
Genesis to create any object he desired, but the object was mundane and lacked any superpower, magic, or mythical properties.
Uproar to manifest a toy that chaotically disrupts an opponent's superpowers when touched.
Sublimation to grant himself a super ability of his choosing.
Fetch to retrieve a previously marked item, no matter where it is, except Burrow's pocket dimension if no portals to it are open.
Gift to manifest an image of a person's happiest desire, placating them and driving away negative forces.
Prior to losing the Rabbit Miraculous, Monarch was formerly also able to use Burrow to travel through time.

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Abilities
After coming across the drawback of wearing too many Miraculouses at the same time, which took a huge toll on his body, and the loss of the Rabbit Miraculous and almost losing completely after falling for a trap prepared by Ladybug, Monarch decided to use the Miraculouses he had stolen from Ladybug in a way that didn't cause him to be negatively affected or at the risk of losing any more Miraculouses. With the help of technology developed by Tomoe and her company, Monarch melted all the Miraculouses in his possession except for the Butterfly Miraculous and reforged them into technologized rings that allowed him to use or transfer up to five Miraculous superpowers to his akumatized supervillains without the need to transform or unify any of them with the Butterfly Miraculous. He could only transfer powers as long the recipient was in possession of an Alliance, or anything designed with the rings' capability to hold the Miraculous superpowers. Any Alliance could hold one Miraculous superpower at a time, but the recipient could receive multiple powers if they had more than one.
As Monarch Bug

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Abilities
As Monarch Bug, he possessed the abilities of both the Butterfly and Ladybug Miraculouses. This allowed him to create akumatized supervillains, utilize Lucky Charm, and de-evilize his own akumas. Additionally, he could use the Miraculous Monarch Bug to revert and repair any damage with the Lucky Charm object. He wielded both the cane and the yo-yo as weapons.
Furthermore, Monarch Bug had the capability to use or transfer the Miraculous superpowers granted by his rings. He employed powers such as Venom, Multitude, Sublimation, Resistance, and Voyage to capture the Miraculouses of Scarabella and Kitty Noire, as well as during his battle against Ladybug and the Resistance.
As Nightormentor
As Nightormentor, he had the ability to make people see their worst nightmares using his pink flute. However, his powers could be neutralized by the holder of the Eagle Miraculous or by someone with strong willpower, as demonstrated by Eagle and Knightowl, respectively. Additionally, he granted himself the power of Voyage, enabling him to disappear and teleport anywhere he desired. He also wielded the pink flute as a weapon, using it to block Cat Noir's staff during their confrontations.

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Etymology
Gabriel was named after Gabrielle "Coco" Chanel, who created the French designer brand Chanel.
The name "Hawk Moth" is the common name of some moths in the family Sphingidae.
In the French dub, he is named "Le Papillon", which translates to, simply, "The Butterfly".
Hawk Moth is called "Butterfly" in some early sources.
Shadow Moth's French name, "Papillombre", is a portmaneau of "papillon" and "ombre", that latter of which translates to "shadow".
In the European Spanish version:
Hawk Moth's name is Lepidóptero, which comes from the scientific order called Lepidoptera, which contains all butterflies and moths.
Scarlet Moth is named "Escarlóptero" – the combination of the words Escarlate, which means "scarlet", and Lepidóptero.
When fusing the Butterfly Miraculous and the Peacock Miraculous, he is called "Sombradóptero" (the combination of the words Sombra, which means "shadow", and Lepidóptero).
In the Italian dub, Shadow Moth is called Falena Oscura, which means "dark moth".
Gabriel not only hid the shadows physically, he also hid in the shadows of other people when he akumatized them as well as trying to outrun his own nor sinking in his own shadow.

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Etymology
The French name of Shadow Noir, "Chatpillon", is a portmaneau of "chat", which translates to cat, and "papillon".
The name of Gabriel's final Miraculous-wielding form, Monarch, has a layered meaning:
Danaus plexippus is a species of butterfly commonly referred to as monarch butterflies or monarchs.
The word "monarch" itself means a king or queen. In various episodes, Gabriel referred to Émilie as his queen. Gabriel himself was the "King of Fashion" in Paris and a wealthy, powerful, influential, high-status man.
The lifespan of a monarch butterfly is under a year, about the same time Gabriel spent terrorizing Paris with the Butterfly Miraculous' powers and time he had left because of his cataclysm injury.

Gabriel Agreste - Development
Hawk Moth's appearance in the Ladybug PV was very different from his final design. In it, he didn't wear a mask, had white hair and silver eyes, and wore a white dress suit with a pale tan vest and bow.
In the Ladybug PV, Gabriel Agreste's name was different – he was referred to as Richard Sphinx.
The design of Hawk Moth's cowl is a reference to the supervillain Fantômas from the 1964 French film of the same name.

Gabriel Agreste - Trivia
Personal details
As seen in "Copycat", "Gorizilla", and "Party Crasher", Gabriel's phone number was +33678424.
It is revealed in "Revelation" on an old ID card that Gabriel's birth name was Gabi Grassette and that his family owned a French fry restaurant.
The papers also list his height at the time as 1.79m, which contradicts his current height of 2.20m.
Miraculous holder and akumatized villains
In some episodes, such as "Reflekdoll" and "Gabriel Agreste", Hawk Moth and Shadow Moth were depicted as taller than Gabriel, although those were probably animation errors, as every other time Gabriel transformed or detransformed, his height remained the same.
During season 1, when Hawk Moth's true identity was still unknown, there were clues suggesting that he was Gabriel:
Gabriel and Hawk Moth had the same voice actors in many dubs, including English, French, German, European and Latin American Spanish, European Portuguese, Italian, Korean and Japanese.
Gabriel's brand logo is a butterfly, which can be seen on Adrien's sneakers.

title: Gabriel Agreste

text:
Gabriel Agreste - Trivia
In "The Bubbler", it was not actually confirmed that Gabriel had been kidnapped by the bubbles of the titular villain, especially as he was the one who got Nino upset and akumatized.
In "Mr. Pigeon", Gabriel was imagined by Marinette with a purple tie resembling the Butterfly Miraculous.
In "Ladybug & Cat Noir":
The silhouette of the civilian form of Hawk Moth was very similar to that of Gabriel, and they seemed to wear the same clothes, in addition to having a picture of Émilie inside the brooch.
In the French version, when Gabriel forbids Adrien to go to school the latter asks "Why do you want to shut me off in a cocoon?".
Many clues could be found in "Simon Says":
Hawk Moth stated that "it's risky" when he heard Simon Says say he would take Gabriel Agreste. He had never shown any concern for anyone else his akumatized villains endangered.
As soon as Gabriel was left alone in that same episode, Hawk Moth appeared and was seen walking ahead, and still, in the same scene, he still seemed worried about what Simon Says was doing.
After Simon Says caught Gabriel and took him to the TVi studio, he didn't appear to be scared, instead having a neutral expression on his face.

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Trivia
When Gabriel was hypnotized, Simon Says told him that he was a butterfly.
Gabriel proved to be interested in Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses.
Hawk Moth was not seen for the rest of the episode after Simon Says was defeated.
In both "Rogercop" and "The Mime", Gabriel wasn't available when Hawk Moth is transformed.
According to Thomas Astruc, Hawk Moth's true identity was meant to be a big secret only to kids, not the teens and adults watching the show.
Hawk Moth usually revealed his name to his victims when he corrupted them. However, he never gave out his name to The Evillustrator, Lady Wifi, Darkblade, Animaestro, Miraculer, Gamer 2.0 (in their titular episodes), Stormy Weather in "Stormy Weather 2", The Puppeteer in "The Puppeteer 2", and the Punishers Trio in "Félix".
However, it was not the first time he akumatized Sabrina, Max, Aurore, Manon, Rose, or Juleka.
In "Volpina", Adrien confused a previous owner of the Butterfly Miraculous for Hawk Moth upon seeing his picture in the Grimoire.

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Trivia
Thomas Astruc once claimed that season 2 would explain how Hawk Moth found the Butterfly Miraculous, although this information was ultimately not revealed in that season, but the webisode "Nathalie as seen by Gabriel".
In some dubs, Gabriel and Hawk Moth had different voice actors. Examples include the Brazilian Portuguese (until "Sadnansi"), Russian, Polish, Hungarian (only in Season 1) dubs, and the Dutch dubs.
Gabriel held a few records revolving around Miraculouses and their use:
He was the first to unify three Miraculouses together in the series – the Butterfly, Peacock and Cat Miraculouses – in "Ephemeral" to become Shadow Noir.
He was the only known person, outside of the Order of the Guardians, to have had and worn all nineteen Miraculouses from the Chinese Miracle Box at some point in time, though never all at the same time.
Additionally, he wore the Eagle Miraculous from the Native American Miracle Box, bringing the total number of Miraculouses wore to twenty.

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Trivia
He used the most Miraculous superpowers himself, with a total of 14 – Akumatization, Amokization, Mirage, Shell-ter, Burrow, Venom, Wind Dragon, Fetch, Voyage, Multitude, Sublimation, Resistance, Second Chance and Genesis.
The only superpowers Gabriel was never seen using (despite being in possession of the Miraculouses that granted them) were Lucky Charm, Cataclysm, Uproar, Gift and Clout.
As the Collector didn't leave the lair prior to deakumatizing himself in "Dearest Family", he was the second akumatized villain, following Catalyst in both "Heroes' Day" and "Ladybug", whose akumatization Ladybug and Cat Noir were unaware of.
In all six episodes Hawk Moth's transformation was seen ("Gorizilla", "Queen Wasp", "Catalyst", "Stormy Weather 2", "Heart Hunter", and "Miraculous Shanghai"), the transformation music was different each and every time, making it the only transformation to differ in some way every time it's shown. The music from "Miraculous Shanghai" was later used for Shadow Moth's transformation in both "Truth" and "Queen Banana", although with slight changes.

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Trivia
Whenever Gabriel transformed with a Miraculous, his voice tended to become noticeably deeper. However, errors occurred in many episodes, such as "Party Crasher", "Sole Crusher", "Hack-San", "Evolution", "Intuition", "Adoration", and "Re-creation".
In Season 5, his voice became raspy due to the effects of the Cataclysm caused by Cat Noir on his body after he forced him to cataclysm him on his left forearm to escape from him and Ladybug in "Destruction". In some scenes of his appearances in the season, whenever he was transformed as Monarch or when he akumatized someone, his voice was sometimes between his deep transformed voice and his civilian voice, showing how raspier his voice became and that his vocal cords were infected by the Cataclysm.
Gabriel was responsible for more than 212 akumatizations before his death, as revealed by Marinette in "The Illustrhater".
Miscellaneous
Gabriel was one of the tallest characters in the series.
Gabriel's car could show holograms of himself, which he used to be seen outside his mansion when he was actually inside.

title: Gabriel Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Gabriel Agreste - Trivia
In "Lies", while taunting the akumatized villain and Shadow Moth, Cat Noir exclaims that the latter should name himself "Peacock Moth" instead. That name is the one Thomas Astruc originally came up for him, which was rejected for not sounding scary enough.
He is the second human villain to die permanently in the series, with the first being Colt Fathom. His temporary deaths in "Cat Blanc" and "Miraculous Shanghai" may have foreshadowed his actual death in Season 5.
Only 19 people know about Gabriel's supervillain identity: Tomoe Tsurugi, Noé Luxus, Nathalie Sancoeur, Camilo Pista, Félix Fathom, Amélie Graham de Vanily, Kagami Tsurugi, Marinette Dupain-Cheng, Cerise Bianca/Chrysalis, Alix Kubdel, Alya Césaire and the other 8 members of The Kingdom.
Twenty-one, when Luka Couffaine and Adrien Agreste/Cat Noir (his son) found out but had their memories erased.
Forty-one, if the kwamis of the Chinese Miracle Box and Liiri from the Native American Miracle Box count.
Only 5 of the Miraculers know, with those being Ladybug/Bug Noire, Argos/Flairmidable, Ryuko, Bunnyx and Rena Rouge.

Gabriel: My dear Émilie, even though it's taking longer than I expected, my plan is slowly coming to place. I had to do the unthinkable: force the person holding Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous to use them again.
Gabriel: All it took was inciting chaos in Paris. Negative emotions. This is perfect. Just what I need.
Gabriel: Ladybug and Cat Noir resurfaced as if by magic.
Hawk Moth: Ladybug, Cat Noir, give me the ladybug earrings and the cat ring now.

Gabriel: I have not yet managed to seize their Miraculous. But they still don't know my true identity. They think my plan is limited to akumatizing villains. Oh, but how wrong they are.
Gabriel: I must become someone else to lead them astray.
Gabriel: My plan goes well beyond what they could ever imagine.
Gabriel: Come to me my little akuma, and evilize me!
Gabriel: And I will destroy them.

Gabriel: Each of their moves so far has only confirmed that they have been chosen by a guardian.
