title: Félix Fathom/History
text:
Félix Fathom/History - Intro
Félix Fathom is a teenage boy and the cousin of Adrien Agreste.

title: Félix Fathom/History
text:
Félix Fathom/History - Before [[Season 1]]
Félix was born in London to the British aristocrat Lady Amélie Graham de Vanily and the late American billionaire Colt Fathom. Before he was born, his maternal grandparents and father wanted a child to be the heir of their wealth and status, but his parents had a hard time conceiving, due to his mother's infertility. Even with the best medical treatments Mr. and Mrs. Graham de Vanily offered, nothing worked. After making a deal with Gabriel Agreste, his father used the Peacock Miraculous to create him from his emotion of jealousy and placed his amok in his signet ring. However, due to it being broken at the time, Colt gained an illness from it.

title: Félix Fathom/History
text:
Félix Fathom/History - Before [[Season 1]]
Félix started becoming more of a monster than a fear to his father in his eyes. Colt tormented and controlled Félix, who made his life miserable as time went on. Félix questioned why he deserved this--why couldn't he be loved and treated properly by him; why was always forced to obey his father and whatever order he gave him, even if he didn't want to. Félix collapsed some time ago as his father's ring, the object containing his amok was cracked as Colt hit it against a wall in a fit of rage, which made him realize his life was linked to his father's ring.
Sometime in the past, his mother told him the story of the Graham de Vanily Twin Rings, which fascinated Félix.
As kids, Adrien and Félix used to be very close. They dressed up as each other, played chess, basketball, and tried magic tricks. At some point, Félix also met Chloé, whom he considered foolish and annoying. When Félix became a teenager, his father passed away from the effects of the broken Peacock Miraculous and Félix took the ring for himself, allowing him his freedom. At the same time, his aunt Émilie mysteriously disappeared.

title: Félix Fathom/History
text:
Félix Fathom/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Timetagger", Bunnyx reveals to Ladybug that in the future, she will have an entire team of superheroes, which also includes Argos, the holder of the Peacock Miraculous.
In "Félix", he visited the Agrestes with his mother to commemorate Émilie, who passed away one year ago, and attempted to retrieve the wedding bands.
Pretending to warm up to Adrien, Félix stole his cousin's phone, destroyed Plagg's goat cheese, deleted all the videos Adrien's friends sent him from his phone, and, dressed up as his cousin, recorded a nasty video message, leading to the akumatization of the Punishers Trio.
When the villains arrived at Adrien's room, he pretended not to know what was going on.
After Adrien ran away pretending to be his cousin and Nathalie fought the villains, Félix showed his face and confronted them.
He was soon brought to safety by Ladybug, whom he attempted to kiss, aware of Adrien's crush on her.
She refused and punched him when he got close then Cat Noir called him out for causing trouble.

title: Félix Fathom/History
text:
Félix Fathom/History - [[Season 3]]
During a tense moment between the heroes and villains, he snatched Lady Wifi's tablet and made a deal with Hawk Moth to help him get Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses in exchange for the rings.
The heroes escaped the situation and tied him with Ladybug's yo-yo while breaking the tablet.
Back the Agreste mansion, Félix interrupted his mother's justifications and apologized to Adrien, promising to return as a better person someday.
While shaking hands with his uncle, he stole one of the rings.
He expressed his gratitude of having Adrien as a cousin.
On the train bound to London, Félix revealed that retrieved the ring, and his mother let him keep it.
Sometime later, he made a copy of it.

title: Félix Fathom/History
text:
Félix Fathom/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Gabriel Agreste", Félix returned to Paris for a soirée his mother was invited to.
On his way to the Agreste mansion, he watched a video about the Miraculouses on the Ladyblog and expressed his hope of seeing superheroes during their stay.
Once he arrived, he noticed the brooches under his uncle's tie, but acted innocent during the family's interaction.
He enjoyed fooling Chloé into believing he was Adrien.
After submitting his phone to a machine, he followed Adrien to his room but was called by Gabriel, who demanded to return the ring.
Félix gave him a fake ring and later eavesdropped on his uncle's frustrated speech, soon to be called by Adrien.
After Chloé left the room, Félix claimed he had to speak to his mother and sneaked into Gabriel's atelier.
He reaches out to the portrait of his aunt but was interrupted by sentimonster Gabriel.
Félix revealed that he was aware of his uncle being Shadow Moth.
Gabriel denied this and threatened to destroy Félix if the latter did not reveal where the ring was.
Shadow Moth unsuccessfully attempted to akumatize Félix.
After he broke free from the akuma, he discretely ripped the bottom of the sentimonster's pants and ran.

title: Félix Fathom/History
text:
Félix Fathom/History - [[Season 4]]
Ladybug and Cat Noir fought the newly akumatized Collector, Félix faking innocence once more.
After the Collector was de-evilized, sentimonster Gabriel gave Félix a ring.
Félix confirmed that the tear was where he made it.
Later, when Gabriel left Nathalie's room, Félix saw that the pants were intact.
Off-screen, he returned to London on the next day.
In "Risk", Félix came to Adrien's rescue after seeing his disappointed face on TV, acting as Adrien get into the mansion.
He offered switching places with Adrien and promised to confront Gabriel, and Adrien (under Risk's influence) agreed.
Félix distracted the bodyguard, allowing Adrien to escape.
He helped Nathalie close her suitcase and stole the tablet from it, and was shortly asked to leave by Gabriel.
In Gabriel's atelier, he reached out a special device which detected fingerprints on Émilie's portrait.
He found the fake Butterfly and Peacock Miraculouses, as well as the buttons leading to the crypt.
He was horrified to find his aunt in a glass coffin and immediately rushed to the elevator.
He shoved his device in a corner upon hearing voices outside the atelier.

title: Félix Fathom/History
text:
Félix Fathom/History - [[Season 4]]
Once Gabriel and Nathalie enter, Félix stood up to Gabriel but was forced to listen to Nathalie, who was in possession of the ring.
On his way out, Félix received a text message from Adrien, which he instantly deleted, and drove off to the station.
Thinking he was Adrien, Ladybug insisted for him to stay, but Félix kept up his act and sadly boarded the train.
He overheard Nathalie's call to Gabriel when the train departed.
In "Strikeback", Félix travelled on the train with Nathalie and Lila.
He went to the bathroom and attempted to activate the Peacock Miraculous with the help of the tablet.
Upon failing, he realized that it was a fake.
When he left, he bumped into Pennybug, who made sure he didn't have the mark of Risk and gave him the Dog Miraculous.
They went back in time and touched Froggy's stuffed toy with the ball, and then returned to the present, where they retrieved the object and reverted the damage.
Ladybug praised the newly named hero, Flairmidable.
Ladybug and Flairmidable transformed back in the sewers, and Félix insisted on fighting Strikeback alongside Ladybug and reassured her that he would stand up to his "father".
Flairmidable was introduced to the team.

title: Félix Fathom/History
text:
Félix Fathom/History - [[Season 4]]
While Rooster Bold duplicated the Lucky Charm, Flairmidable touched the yo-yo with his ball.
Hearing Ladybug's plan, he remained where he was and sympathized with the sentimonsters, who were teleported to the sun.
He headed towards the Agreste mansion and awaited Gabriel's return.
He offered an exchange, threatening to otherwise reveal the painting's secret code to Adrien: the real Peacock Miraculous for all the Miraculouses in Ladybug's yo-yo, as well as the stolen ring.
Gabriel hesitated and agreed, and Flairmidable used his power, summoning the yo-yo.
Once they exchanged, Félix renounced Barkk and left.
On the train back to London, he examined the Peacock Miraculous, satisfied.

title: Félix Fathom/History
text:
Félix Fathom/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Multiplication", Félix returned to London and aware that Ladybug and Cat Noir would be looking for him, he told his mother that they mistakenly believed him to be a villain and asked her to pretend he hasn't returned from Paris, which she did when the heroes arrived at his house, and sometime after that, his mother reassured him she will protect him and he proceeded to put the Peacock Miraculous on and met Duusu, who asked if he was her new owner and Félix told her he was much more than that.

title: Félix Fathom/History
text:
Félix Fathom/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Emotion", prior to this, Félix wanted to prove to his mother about his uncle's true colors he enacted a plan. Aware that his uncle's Diamond Dance party was coming up, he wanted her to act like he was missing while he returned to Paris, wanting to free his cousin Adrien and while observing everyone around him, he was bristling with anger and created his first sentimonster Red Moon placing his amok in his ring. When the event came Félix continued with the rest of the plan he comes across Adrien and made him his first victim; disguising himself as his cousin once more he left for the event. He then, becomes acquainted with the Tsrugis especially Kagami, on whom he noticed something in her family ring, and then he sadly saw his mother being thrown out from the party by his uncle. While he and Kagami awaited "their" entrance, he was complimented about being late however retorted about the kiss on her hand. Confused Félix also learned that Adrien was in love with Marinette nonetheless as the party proceed he talked to her about pursuing their freedom including leaving the event she refused.

title: Félix Fathom/History
text:
Félix Fathom/History - [[Season 5]]
Then he came across Marinette who snuck into the party but only to admit how proud she was of him and her feelings then leaves but he took her hand and proceeded to the dance floor but hearing her admit how much she felt like an outcast.
Félix then dropped his facade, transformed into Argos, unleashed his sentimonster, took Marinette hostage and disappeared everyone at the event except Kagami telling her to rejoice in freedom before escaping.
Hearing Marinette's concerns about Adrien, Félix replied he was the last person he wanted to harm and found him lucky that he had a girl like her placing her in a trash bin for her safety.
Meanwhile Argos turned the whole entire city into a ghost town until he crossed paths with an angry Ladybug leading to a fight and an exchange of angry words between them where he was reprimanded by her for his actions and selfishness but retorted needing the Peacock Miraculous, then hers and Cat Noir's to make his wish wanting to recreate the world in his image a world free of oppressors.

title: Félix Fathom/History
text:
Félix Fathom/History - [[Season 5]]
But when Ladybug warned him about the price to pay, and told him he wasn't different from Monarch and refused to surrender her earrings so an angry Argos resorted to doing it himself.
When Ladybug refused to let him, he emphasized how as he had the advantage further believing it when they saw no Lucky Charm appear.
But hearing her calmly admit defeat he angrily demanded her earrings but she still refused then he took a page from her book reciting the consequences asking if she willing to pay it and yet she rebuked that only he can answer that out of patience Argos angrily snapped her away.
With his mission complete he strolled through the empty city until he was confronted by an angry Kagami, calling him a monster for disappearing her loved ones but he restored Adrien and explained his actions.
But much to his confusion, they weren't happy as all of their loved ones were gone understanding Argos replied not all and led them to where he left Marinette, only to find her gone.

title: Félix Fathom/History
text:
Félix Fathom/History - [[Season 5]]
Then he panicked when she didn't reappear horrified at the chance he erased her forever, he apologized to Adrien and Kagami and restored everyone including Marinette, and seeing the three of them reunited, Argos shamefully fled.
On a rooftop, he apologized to Red Moon, for creating her from his anger, that her power was too dangerous and much to his dismay reluctantly released her from existence, and fell to the ground sobbing.
Later he returned to London with his mother, where she said he was right about Gabriel as he didn't care and called all his associates monsters as well, to which Argos detransformed and comforted her with a hug, saying not all of them were, to his mother's surprise.

title: Félix Fathom/History
text:
Félix Fathom/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Pretension", Félix returned to Paris as Argos and went to Collège Françoise Dupont to spy on Kagami from the rooftop, and followed her to her car, where he eavesdropped on her mother Tomoe criticizing her daughter for not controlling her emotions, which made him angry, then used his hand fan to open the car's sunroof and took Kagami away to the Eiffel Tower. Understanding her aggression, Argos quickly detransformed and stopped her telling that he wasn't her enemy and that he only wanted to talk as he couldn't stop thinking about her since the dance, and felt a kinship with her, awkwardly revealing that he knew it because he followed her. To which Kagami told him he lacked social skills and couldn't go around kidnapping people, and Félix apologized for that but replied he only wanted to protect her from her mother as she couldn't talk to her that way, which surprised her.

title: Félix Fathom/History
text:
Félix Fathom/History - [[Season 5]]
However, their conversation was cut short by the titular villain that tracked him by his hand fan's feathers and viewing lens's scents. And at Ladybug and Cat Noir's arrival, Félix declared he was the only one who could protect Kagami and quickly retransformed and took her away to hide inside an alley, hearing Kagami's suggestion to leave her behind so her mother would calm down and stop attacking him, Argos refused, as he intended to free her from her mother, not abandon her but Kagami replied that she didn't need his help and was thrown on the ground by her as well as being advised to flee as her mother didn't seem to like him. But soon was confronted by Matagi, who tried to paralyze her with arrows, but Argos quickly blocked them with his fan and carried Kagami to safety, who was shocked that her own mother tried to attack her and he remarked that she never met his father who was "a thousand times worse". On a rooftop to confuse Matagi, he used his hand fan to spread its feathers and other objects throughout the city to create fake trails and being questioned by Kagami, Argos replied that her safety was his priority.

title: Félix Fathom/History
text:
Félix Fathom/History - [[Season 5]]
Hiding in the sewers, hearing Kagami's confusion as why he didn't create a sentimonster to save them, Félix asked her to not call them "monsters" and refused to be like those before him. Explaining that when someone brings a new life into the world it's their responsibility, to take care of them and to deprive them of that is monstrous, and a touched Kagami asked him if he was referring to himself too. And yet, Félix referred to both of them, but soon was cut short when they're confronted by the heroes who demanded him to release Kagami and to hand over the Peacock Miraculous, but Kagami told them that she wasn't his prisoner and defended him, stating he wasn't her enemy just misunderstood like her and smiled at him, who appreciated what she did. And when Matagi Gozen arrived there as well, wanting everyone's Miraculouses, Ladybug and Cat Noir protected both of them; Félix was surprised at Ladybug's choice to trust him, and encouraged by Kagami, he transformed and fled the scene.

title: Félix Fathom/History
text:
Félix Fathom/History - [[Season 5]]
Later, he secretly met with Kagami in a movie theater and gave her the family ring, stating that he gave her mother a fake one and that Tomoe wasn't the last of the Tsurugis, but she was and that she could make her own rules now rather than following her ancestors, to which Kagami smiled and the two held hands.
Sometime after "Pretension", Félix and Kagami began dating secretly. In "Representation", after learning Kagami was in London as well, Félix as Argos found her in her hotel balcony and drew her a heart on the window before eloping together to Paris to find Marinette in the Eiffel Tower.

title: Félix Fathom/History
text:
Félix Fathom/History - [[Season 5]]
Once seeing her, he asked Kagami if she was sure she was Ladybug and Kagami told him she couldn't believe it at first but she overheard her in "Perfection" and they didn't have choice as her mother and his uncle would never allow them to be together, to which Argos agreed and the two kissed before Argos leaped down and detransformed into Félix with clothes identical to Adrien's to lure Marinette away from the party and to Collège Françoise Dupont, where he, Kagami and Duusu felt sad for Marinette when seeing her crying for being separated from Adrien and Félix reassured Duusu they were doing this to have a happy ending, which cheered up his kwami before transforming back into Argos and amokized Kagami's ring to create the film projector-like sentibeing Once Upon a Time to tell Marinette the story of Émilie and Amélie's past; how their families came together; that he and Adrien were sentibeings created by the Peacock Miraculous due to their mothers' infertility; and how Félix was created by his cold-hearted father Colt Fathom from his jealousy towards Émilie and Gabriel being able to have a child first.

title: Félix Fathom/History
text:
Félix Fathom/History - [[Season 5]]
However, Colt was an abusive father towards Félix, especially after becoming ill from his use of the damaged Peacock Miraculous, and controlled him like a puppet with his amokized ring, and one day he damaged his ring in a fit of rage, which injured Félix and made him realize his life was linked to his father's ring and was able to take it after Colt's death, thus gaining his freedom.
However Félix also realized that the Peacock Miraculous, which gave him life, could also take it away (as his uncle previously threatened to do to him in "Gabriel Agreste"), and to protect his existence, he (to his regret) stole all of Ladybug's Miraculouses in "Strikeback" to convince his uncle to hand him the Peacock Miraculous, but now like Émilie and Gabriel, Félix and Kagami (and to an extent, Adrien and Marinette) wanted to be together and love each other and needed Ladybug's help, which woke Marinette up and after seeing Once Upon a Time's purified amok flying out from the window, she agreed to help them.

title: Félix Fathom/History
text:
Félix Fathom/History - [[Season 5]]
Meanwhile, back in London, Argos returned Kagami to her hotel balcony at sunrise where they are both confident that Marinette will have the courage to face off Gabriel/Monarch, so everyone can have a happy ending.
The two teenagers kissed again before departing.
In "Conformation", his mother fell victim to his uncle's Alliance rings. However, it's unknown how Félix reacted or if he tried to find Kagami and Adrien.
In "Re-creation", after Monarch's defeat, Félix alongside his mother visited the Agreste mansion and attended Adrien's pool party, where he reunited with his girlfriend who was sketching him and blushed when he turned to her. Sometime after Marinette restored all the stolen Miraculouses to their original forms and permanently returned them to their holders. Argos joined her restored superhero team and set off for their next adventure to protect Paris from the New villainous Butterfly Miraculous holder.

title: Félix Fathom/History
text:
Félix Fathom/History - Season 6
In "Revelator", Argos was present during the training of the rest of Paris' superheroes, where they learned not to de-transform after using their powers, but did not participate in it himself, because he apparently could already control it. Once they succeeded, they began to come up with a name for the team, and they chose "Miraculers", which was suggested by Ladybug and everyone, including Argos, happily approved of the name.
In "Yaksi Gozen", he had a videocall with Kagami talking about a hiding place for their amokized rings and became surprised but agreed with Kagami's suggestion of a safe hiding place before the two told they loved each other.

title: Félix Fathom/History
text:
Félix Fathom/History - Season 6
Later, he arrived to Paris, where he and Kagami reunited with a hug at the train station before they rushed to transform into their superhero forms to go at Marinette's house, where they explained that with Félix having the Peacock Miraculous, no one can snap him and Kagami out from existence, the two still needed a safe place to hide their rings from supervillains who could steal them to control Kagami and Félix, as they considered other options but decided on Ladybug's Yo-Yo, which Marinette doubted as that didn't prevent from losing all the other Miraculouses to Shadow Moth, to which a regretful Félix reminds her it wasn't her fault and Marinette agreed to help them and transformed but before she could take the rings, they were surprised by the arrival of her parents and Adrien, who wondered about his cousin and Kagami's sudden appareance there, then Félix, Kagami and Marinette panicked and quickly looked around the room for the rings, which were soon found by Adrien, who innocently did a magic trick on them, where he took Félix's ring and unknowingly controlled him with it, much to the latter's anger.

title: Félix Fathom/History
text:
Félix Fathom/History - Season 6
However, the four were soon interrupted by the arrival of an akumatized Tomoe, who still disapproving of her daughter's relationship with Félix, she soon paralyzed him and captured him. Inside the supervillain, a paralyzed Félix was soon approached by Chrysalis, who wanted to steal his ring to force him to be her and Tomoe's spy among the Miraculers, but she only found Kagami's ring instead, thus ruining her plan and forcing her to flee, and when Tomoe is deakumatized, Félix is soon released from his paralysis and rushed to his girlfriend, who hugged him and returned his ring to him, to which Félix returned with her own ring, which Cat Noir considered romantic and Ladybug added it was better that way, to which Félix and Kagami agreed with a nod.

title: Gabriel's tablet
text:
Gabriel's tablet - Intro
was a tablet that belonged to Gabriel Agreste.
In "Gabriel Agreste", to help Sentigabriel get the ring that Félix had stolen from him, Shadow Moth sent him an akuma that entered the tablet, causing it to become the akumatized object of Senticollector.
In "Dearest Family", in order to find a method to destroy the Magical Charm, Gabriel created a more powerful version of an akuma, called a megakuma, which he made enter the tablet, making it the akumatized object of Collector.
In "Destruction", Gabriel used the tablet to operate the machine to destroy the Miraculouses stolen by Ladybug's yo-yo in "Strikeback" and later reforge them into rings with which he could transfer the Miraculous superpowers to his Akumatized villains without giving them a Miraculous.

title: Gabriel's tablet
text:
Gabriel's tablet - Appearance
Normal
The tablet has a dark gray border around the front screen, with a silver back. The touchscreen itself is a fairly large screen.
Akumatized
Under the effects of Gabriel's akumatization into the Collector, the tablet would turn black, with a white stripe bent over with a red triangle inside, matching the Collector's color scheme.

title: Gabriel's tablet
text:
Gabriel's tablet - Abilities
Akumatized
Under the effects of Gabriel's akumatization into the Collector, the tablet had the power to imprison any person or object as a video. Additionally, when the videos were played, the captured people would tell their secrets.

title: Gabriel's tablet
text:
Gabriel's tablet - Trivia
The tablet was the first object to be akumatized for two characters, namely Sentigabriel and Gabriel Agreste, who had transformed into the same villain, even though the former was a sentimonster.
it:Tablet di Gabriel

title: Gabriel's letter to Adrien
text:
Gabriel's letter to Adrien - Intro
is a will that Gabriel had written for Adrien in anticipation of his potential defeat. In the letter, Gabriel revealed that he was Monarch and that he had been trying to obtain the Ladybug and the Cat Miraculouses in order to revive Émilie. He also wanted Adrien to become the new holder of the Butterfly Miraculous, and use the heroes' miraculouses to bring both of his parents back to life.
At the end of "Heartfixer", Marinette hid the letter in her yo-yo, because she didn't want Adrien to know his father was a villain.
In "Sadnansi", Marinette pulls the letter out of her yo-yo, because she's ready to tell Adrien the truth about his father.

title: Gabriel's letter to Adrien
text:
Gabriel's letter to Adrien - Appearance
The letter is handwritten on a piece of white paper. It was inside a white envelope with the name "Adrien" handwritten on the front. The envelope was clipped to a postcard featuring Gabriel and an Alliance ring.

title: Gabriel's letter to Adrien
text:
Gabriel's letter to Adrien - Content
"My son, if you're reading this letter, it means I'm with your mother. I sacrificed everything to save Émilie. I was Monarch. I did all I could to seize the Miraculous of the Ladybug and the Black Cat. With their powers, I could have brought your mother back, but I failed. My son, it's your turn now to continue my mission. Don't worry, you'll have help. Nathalie will explain. You will seize the Miraculous of that wretched Ladybug and her pathetic partner, Cat Noir, and you will make the wish to bring your mother and me back. You will be perfect. I know these revelations will turn your life completely upside down. It was the case for your mother and me when we first found out about the Miraculous. But we never regretted harnessing the Peacock Miraculous…"

title: Gabriel's letter to Adrien
text:
Gabriel's letter to Adrien - Trivia
Due to the fact that the letter was in the box regarding Adrien's first year of life and that the postcard featured an Alliance ring, Marinette realized that Gabriel had placed it there and prevented Adrien from discovering it by stealing it without his knowledge.
It's likely that Gabriel wrote and hid the letter sometime after he got his Cataclysm wound in "Destruction".
Nathalie became angry upon seeing this letter and wanted to destroy it to prevent Adrien from following the same path of his father, but was stopped by Marinette, who questioned if it's up to them to make this choice for Adrien.
Gabriel is responsible for everything up to now.

title: Gamer
text:
Gamer - Intro
"" is a season 1 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. According to the series' production order, it is the 12th episode of season 1, as well as the 12th episode of the series, overall.

title: Gamer
text:
Gamer - Synopsis
Marinette beats Adrien's video game tournament partner, Max, so she can replace him and spend time with her crush, but Max akumatizes into a villain.
Disney+
Ladybug and Cat Noir face their friend Max, now the Gamer.

title: Gamer
text:
Gamer - Plot
Marinette is writing in her diary, discussing how Cat Noir almost discovered her identity in an attack earlier that day. Tikki stops her, reminding her about a presentation she has to do with Alya. Marinette grabs her phone, puts her diary away, and leaves her room, heading to the school.
She enters the school's courtyard, hearing a noise coming from the school's library. Marinette goes to investigate, finding Juleka, Alix, Mylène, Alya, Miss Bustier, Denis Damoclès, Rose, Kim, Nino, Nathaniel, and Ivan watching Max and Adrien play the game Ultimate Mecha Strike III. Adrien's character is NAD03, and Max's is MX-01. Since Marinette has no clue as to why they're playing a video game, Rose cuts in and explains it to her: there's a video game competition between schools. Kim says that the qualifying round happening in the library is to determine who is to be partnered with Max since Max has been practising for months.

title: Gamer
text:
Gamer - Plot
NAD03 defeats MX-01, making Adrien the number one player in the school and Max's partner. Everyone cheers, except for Max, although, instead of brooding for long, Max congratulates Adrien and looks forward to their partnership. Marinette thinks for a moment, realizing that whoever beats Max's score will become Adrien's partner. Alya pulls Marinette to the side, telling her not to try to beat Max and not to flirt with Adrien. Marinette ignores her, asking Denis Damoclès if she can participate. Denis Damoclès mentions that the library is closing in five minutes, but Marinette persists, sitting on a chair in front of the screen.

title: Gamer
text:
Gamer - Plot
Adrien gives her his controller, which she promptly puts up against her face before lowering it hastily. Kim doesn't believe that Marinette can beat Max, but Alya responds that she's motivated to beat Adrien's high score. Max tries to explain the rules of the game, but Marinette cuts him off, explaining the rest of the rules. They shake hands after a brief flashback to Marinette destroying her father at the game while at their house. Chloé and Sabrina stand on the second story of the library, watching and wondering how someone could spend so long looking at a screen. They then pick up their phones and scroll through social media.
Alya records the match. To everyone's shock, Marinette defeats Max and becomes the 1st place winner. Max becomes disappointed because it was his dream to play the competition and he lost his spot, but tries to be a good sport and congratulates Marinette before he walks off, needing to be alone. Mr Damoclès congratulates Adrien and Marinette on being the team to go up against the competing schools. Adrien says that he will come over to see her level after school. She is unfazed by what he says and totally disregards Alya's warning.

title: Gamer
text:
Gamer - Plot
Max, on the other hand, is angry over losing to Marinette. Hawk Moth senses this anger and sends an akuma out. The butterfly landing on his glasses, Hawk Moth greets Max as "The Gamer," promising to help Max win the tournament of his life so long as Max helps him in return. Max immediately agrees, transforming into The Gamer, surrounded by the walls of his real-life MX-01 mecha.
On their way home, Tikki asks Marinette why she wanted to participate in the tournament, pointing out that there are other ways to gain Adrien's attention and that her selfishness denied Max his spot in the tournament. Marinette cedes that she was wrong, but focuses on the fact that Adrien's coming over to her house. She then pauses and freaks out, realizing that Adrien will be in her room, her room full of pictures of him. She rushes home and realizes she has time before he gets there. Immediately as she says this, the doorbell downstairs has Marinette and Tikki rushing to get rid of the pictures.
Meanwhile, inside of his MX-01, the Gamer floats around the streets of Paris shooting at the pedestrians and cars. Each thing he shoots transforms into experience points.

title: Gamer
text:
Gamer - Plot
At Marinette's house, Adrien stands at the foot of the stairs, speaking with Marinette's parents. He explains that he and Marinette are going to be participating in Ultimate Mecha Strike III tournament. Tom mentions that she trained with the best, but Sabine mentions that Marinette has never discussed an interest in the tournament. She then says that Marinette talks about Adrien quite often. Adrien is surprised by that tidbit but doesn't linger on it as Marinette steps out of her room to lead him upstairs. Both Tom and Sabine sigh contentedly as they watch them.
When Marinette and Adrien first get upstairs and sit down at Marinette's computer, they both end up reaching for the same controller and pulling back when their hands touched. It happens again making it awkward in the room. Adrien finally grabs one and Marinette the other. They start playing in silence for a while, occasionally taking short glances at each other.
Outside in the streets, The Gamer continues shooting pedestrians from inside his MX-01. Soon he gains enough experience points to transform the mecha from Level 1 to 2 and gains legs. The mecha now towers over the roads.

title: Gamer
text:
Gamer - Plot
Back at Marinette's place Marinette and Adrien are still playing the game. After just a few minutes of playing her dad brings croissants. Adrien, ready to eat one, can't get a word out when Marinette quickly shoos him away claiming they needed to practice for the competition. They continue playing as Marinette's parents both poke their heads up and she turns giving them a stern look turning around right when Adrien turns to see what's going on. A second later her dad comes back offering cookies. Marinette shoos him away. They take a break and Adrien starts claiming she is way better than him.
Marinette tells him she has a secret. She shows him a bracelet, calling it her lucky charm, to his surprise. He takes it and just then her parents offer quiche Adrien tells Marinette it is okay to take a little break. They travel to the Place des Vosges. When they get there Marinette suggests they go back when done eating. Adrien says he'll try out the bracelet. Before they get a chance to leave the Gamer shows up and tries to come after her. Adrien knocks her out the way and they continue running. They are split by a bench and run their separate ways.

title: Gamer
text:
Gamer - Plot
Adrien, knowing he is the one not being chased, goes and turns into Cat Noir to go rescue Marinette. He makes it right before she is hit and saves her. When he disappears she turns into Ladybug after being reminded by Tikki. She gets there just in time to stop him from shooting Cat Noir.
They run him to the Stade des Princes. where Cat Noir uses Cataclysm to destroy the Gamer's robot and they are rewarded with an energy orb. But the Gamer reveals that he had "saved the game" after reaching Level 3 allowing him to simply reload to recreate his mecha.
Cat Noir and Ladybug obtain a robot from the energy orb they won and have a fight. With neither side winning, Ladybug uses her Lucky Charm and gets a spray paint can. She sprays Gamer's window with paint, causing him to peek outside. She snatches his glasses and breaks them. She catches the akuma, changing it back into an average butterfly, and she uses the Miraculous Ladybug to turn everything back to normal.

title: Gamer
text:
Gamer - Plot
At the competition, Marinette decides to give her controller to Max, considering the fact that she only wanted to enter the tournament with Adrien because all that she can think about spending time with him. Adrien then gives his controller to Marinette, explaining that she is much better than him. In the end card, it shows they win the game.

title: Gamer
text:
Gamer - Plot Developments
This episode reveals that Marinette is good at video games and played them with her father.

title: Gamer
text:
Gamer - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in France but it's the fifteenth episode to air in France.
The shot of her writing in her diary appears in most episodes of Miraculous Secrets.
However, Tikki is added to that scene.
Wang Fu makes a cameo appearance in this episode. He can be seen standing in the background behind Marinette and Adrien while they're eating pie at the Place des Vosges.
Morade Rahni did the storyboards for this episode. The storyboards can be viewed here: Part 1, Part 2.
Towards the end of the storyboard, when Adrien gives up his place in the tournament to Marinette, he tries to give her bracelet back to her, but she is dragged away by Nino before she is able to grab it. Adrien is seen pocketing the lucky charm.
In an advertisement for the video game competition, it is revealed that this episode takes place between the 18th and the 21st of May.
The dates May 5th and May 18th are respectively visible in "Copycat" and "Mr. Pigeon"; thus, assuming it is the same year, these three episodes are set around the same month.

title: Gamer
text:
Gamer - Trivia
However, since the show up to its fourth season is supposed to happen in the same school year, this would make the dates impossible. It's possible that the dates are just random, and don't have any meaning.
In the French version of this episode, Thomas Astruc makes a cameo as the voice of the start menu of Ultimate Mecha Strike III. This is his only cameo in season 1.
When Ladybug says "Shoryubug!", she switches to a voice more like Cristina Vee's anime roles.
References
Marinette's diary box from "Darkblade" reappears in this episode.
Allusions
This entire episode is a reference to the production staff's favourite robot shows. Shows and other game references are as follows:
Street Fighter
Killer Instinct
Mortal Kombat
Star Wars, with game character R2D3 resembling R2D2
Gurren Lagann
Pacific Rim
Futurama, with game character WI2NY resembling Bender.
The Iron Giant, with game character IRON resembling the titular character.
UFO Robot Grendizer, airing in France as Goldorak, with the game character UFO.GR resembling Grendizer.
Multiple attack names are references to moves in the video game series Street Fighter.

title: Gamer
text:
Gamer - Trivia
The moves Gamer used mostly resembles Dhalsim with the long arms and the spinning head dive. One of Gamer's attacks is “Gamer Fire”, which is a reference to Dhalsim’s signature; “Yoga Fire.” He also called out “Gamer Crusher” which is a reference to M. Bison’s signature; “Psycho Crusher.”
The move that Cat Noir shouts — "Catouken" — is a portmanteau of "cat" with "Hadouken", the signature move of Ryu.
In French, the word is "Matouken" with "Matou" meaning "tomcat."
One of the attacks is called the "Tatsukitty" by Ladybug, referencing the Tatsumaki.
Another attack by Ladybug is "Shoryubug,", referencing the Shoryuken.
Zangief's Spinning Piledriver makes an appearance in the fight scene at the Stade des Princes.
When Cat Noir says, "Do a barrel roll," it was a reference to Peppy Hare from the video game Star Fox.
One of the Gamer's attacks is when he "teleports" from one side of the screen to the other, referencing Dhalsim twice in the episode.

title: Gamer
text:
Gamer - Trivia
In a flashback screen of Marinette and her father playing the game, the screen showed Marinette’s robot destroying her dad’s with a 95 hit combo fatality. In respectful references, the 95 hit combo represents an ultra combo referenced in Killer Instinct, and the word "Fatality" is referenced in Mortal Kombat.
When Cat Noir says "Not yet! Here comes a new challenger!", it is likely a Super Smash Brothers reference.
Errors
When Marinette first goes to the school, the camera turns from where Marinette is looking to where the entrance of the library is, but Marinette turns around too.
At the beginning of the episode, the flower on Marinette's purse is missing.
In the flashback to Marinette and Tom playing the game, R2D3's color scheme is changed from black and pink to black and purple.
When Marinette and Max are having their match in the game, Max's character name is wrong. It should be MX-01, but instead, it's 2TO.
In the scene when Tom offers the croissants, Marinette's pictures of Adrien are still on her wall. When Adrien looks around during the scene with the cookies, though, the pictures are gone again.

title: Gamer
text:
Gamer - Trivia
When the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses are displayed on the Gamer's screen, the ring is in its camouflage mode (silver) instead of being black with a green paw print.
When Cat Noir was bringing Marinette to the hotel, in most scenes, Cat Noir's staff is miscolored from green to grey.
Right before the Gamer's mech lands in the stadium, the tip of Cat Noir's right ear clips through the ground behind him.
Ladybug's eyes are miscoloured as grey during the battle against Gamer instead of them being blue.
When Gamer transforms he's facing the opposite way to the window, in the next shot, he is facing the other way.

title: Gamer/Transcript
text:
Gamer/Transcript - Intro
[ Theme Song ]
Marinette: Dear diary, guess what? I was two spots away from transforming back and revealing my true identity to Cat Noir.
Tikki: Hey Marinette, weren't you meeting Alya back at school this afternoon to research your term paper?
Marinette: Oh no, I'm late! Again!
(Marinette puts her diary in her box, grabs her purse and goes to school.)
Tikki: What's that noise?
Marinette: Hide, Tikki!
(In the Library, the students are playing Ultimate Mecha Strike III. Adrien and Max are playing while Alya records them.)
Kim: Come on, Max.
Marinette: (Sees Alya recording) What's going on, Alya? (Alya shushes her)
Rose: Try-outs for the Paris Ultimate Mecha Strike III Tournament! This school sends the two students with the highest scores!
Kim: Actually, the tryouts offer a partner to team up with Max in the Tournament.
Marinette: Why Max?
Kim: 'Cause he's unbeatable! He's a total rocksord! He's got the highest APM over anyone!
Marinette: APM?
Kim: Actions per minute? This tournament is his whole life! He's been grinding all year to level up.
(Adrien's robot, NAD03, uses his special attack on Max's robot, MX-01. MX-01 is crushed and NAD03 wins.)
Caline: Adrien is now in the lead.

title: Gamer/Transcript
text:
Gamer/Transcript - Intro
Kim: What happened, Max?
Max: Hmm. Awesome job. We're gonna make a killer combo.
(Adrien high fives him and Marinette and the rest of their class are cheering for both of them.)
Marinette: So let me get this straight. If someone manages to beat Max's score, they'll team up with Adrien at the tournament?
Kim: No one can beat Max. Or rather Max and Adrien. It's a slam dunk. They're our school's dream team!
(Alya takes Marinette by her hand and drags her to a book shelf.)
Alya: I see where you're going with this, Little lady.
Marinette: Just imagine, teaming with Adrien!
Alya: Are you out of your mind, girl? This is about stepping up and representing! Not snuggling up and snogging! This is serious business!
Marinette: Seriously Alya, you think I'd actually go through with that?
Denis Damoclès: Well, I think we have our two champions lined up for the Paris tournament.
Marinette: Wait! Uh, Is it too late... to try out?
(Kim and Rose gasp)
Denis Damoclès: Well, the library is closing up in five minutes, but...
Alya: Oh, boy...
(Marinette sits down and Adrien gives her his joypad.)
Marinette: Adrien's joypad! Ohhh...! (rubs it on her face)
Kim: Is she serious? There's no way!

title: Gamer/Transcript
text:
Gamer/Transcript - Intro
Alya: Unless the particular player has a particular motivation.
Max: The rules are elementary, You battle each other's robots with your own and...
Marinette: Please... Every time you win, you loot its items and gain XP, which upgrades your mech. I'm not a noob, thank you very much.
(A flashback of Marinette and her father playing the game is seen.)
Max: Ah, sounds like you have a sufficient amount of knowledge. Let's see if it's enough to beat me.
(They shake hands for match.)
Kim: Yeah, this will be fun.
Chloé: Seriously? How could anyone spend so much time in front of a screen?
Sabrina: I know, as if. (They start texting)
(Marinette chooses LB-03, the ladybug robot, while Max chooses MX-01.)
Kim: Come on, Max, you can do it!
(Marinette and Max start playing. The others see how Marinette is winning.)
Marinette: And now, quarter circle plus heavy kick, and Flying Hyper Storm! Triple hit combo, Marinette style! Booyah!
(Marinette wins the game.)
Marinette: Woo! Yeah! Woo hoo! I win! Uh-huh!
Kim: Wha! I can't believe it! She... she beat him?
Alya: Beat him? She pulverized him!
Rose: The king's been knocked off his throne!

title: Gamer/Transcript
text:
Gamer/Transcript - Intro
Max: I accept this defeat. I relinquish my position at the tournament. Congratulations, Marinette. And Adrien.
Adrien: Max, wait!
Kim: Oh, Max...
Max: Look. I'm fine, I lost fair and square. But if you don't mind, I'd like a little solitude.
Denis Damoclès: So, Marinette Dupain-Cheng and Adrien Agreste will represent Françoise Dupont High School at the Paris Ultimate Mecha Strike III Tournament. Good luck to both of you.
Adrien: Well, I guess I'll be coming over to practice. With my new partner. See you later.
Marinette: See... ya...
Alya: Now you gotta win and you're gonna be representing the school, not just hanging out with Adrien.
Marinette: Oh, Adrien...
Alya: Oh, brother...
(Alya facepalms)
Max: This is a travesty. An unequivocal travesty!
Hawk Moth: Ah, a competition. I know you like that, my little evil akumas. Where there's a winner, there's always a loser. (turns a butterfly into an akuma) Fly away, my little akuma, and evilize him!
Max: I should've been going to that tournament. I was the chosen one! I worked so hard for it! This is Inconceivable!
(The akuma flies into  his glasses.)

title: Gamer/Transcript
text:
Gamer/Transcript - Intro
Hawk Moth: Gamer, I am Hawk Moth. I'll help you win the tournament of your life. But in return, you must help me achieve my high score.
Max: Absolutely, Hawk Moth. Game on! Now they'll see who's the greatest gamer in Paris! (transforms into Gamer)
Marinette: Ah, training with Adrien! Adrien!
Tikki: All you wanted to do is spend time with Adrien, there are other ways to do that!
Marinette: What are you getting at?
Tikki: You know how much Max wanted to be in that tournament. Kim said he'd been training for it all year.
Marinette: You're right. All I could think about was Adrien. Hey! Adrien's coming to my house. (gasps) Adrien's coming to my house! No, this is a total disaster! I have to... clean my room!
Tikki: That's what I've been trying to tell you all along.
Marinette: Oh, this... is not... happening!!
Tikki: Calm down, Marinette. You still have time. It's not like he's gonna show up this very minute.
(With Tikki's help, Marinette takes the photos of Adrien from the wall to hide them from him.)
(The doorbell rings.)
Sabine: (downstairs) Marinette! Someone's here to see you!
Marinette: Uh... C-c-coming!

title: Gamer/Transcript
text:
Gamer/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: Marinette and I are finalists in the Paris Ultimate Mecha Strike III Tournament.
Tom: No way. Well, she did learn from the best Tom style! Booyah!
Sabine: Marinette never told us about this Tournament.
Adrien: We were just paired up today.
Sabine: You two are a pair, huh? I'm not surprised. Marinette talks a lot about you, you know?
Marinette: Mom! ...Come up, Adrien!
Adrien: Uh, very nice to meet you.
Tom & Sabine: Ohhh...
Hawk Moth: Gamer. It's time to get to the next level and show everyone that you're the best!
Gamer: No time like the present! (his ship starts trapping people in green spheres. The ship absorbs them.) Hahahahaha!
Marinette: Oh! Hahaha. Sorry.
Adrien: No, you go.
Both: I'll use the other one. (both take each other's hands) Ah! (each take their controllers)
Adrien: Your parents seem nice.
Marinette: Oh yeah, they are. But... sometimes... (sees Tikki on a photo of Adrien) Ahhhh! (takes the photo of Adrien away)
Adrien: Sometimes what?
Tom: (opens the hatch and brings tray of croissant) Everything going good? I thought just in case you wanted something to eat...
Marinette: Uh... no thanks, Papa. We're training.

title: Gamer/Transcript
text:
Gamer/Transcript - Intro
Tom: Well then, uh, maybe you could use a few tips, you know... dad style.
Marinette: Thanks, but no thanks! Papa!
(Tom closes the door.)
Marinette: Sometimes my parents could be a little nosey. (sees Tom and Sabine entering the room, they close the door) Where were we?
Gamer: I'll be at level 2 in no time! My skills are indisputable! (his ship absorbs people and vehicles) I am unstoppable! Hahahaha! (his ship evolves into a two-legged robot) Excellent! (the robot starts absorbing people, gaining more power.)
Adrien: Wow! We won again, thanks to you!
Marinette: Yeah, um, yes we did.
Adrien: We? That was practically all you. You're amazing, Marinette. I guess you wouldn't even need me. I'm so lame compared to you...
Marinette: Um, no no no, I... No, you're so good. I mean, I'm the one who's not good. I mean... I'm lucky, that's all.
Tom: (opens the trapdoor) Anyone want cookies? Baked hot from the oven!
(Adrien wants a cookie but he groans when he didn't take a cookie from the plate)
Marinette: Papa, we're trying to work here!
(Tom exits the room.)
Marinette: Actually, you know what? I've got a secret. (shows him her lucky charm) This is why I win.
Adrien: Are you messing with me?

title: Gamer/Transcript
text:
Gamer/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Try playing a match with it.
(Adrien takes the lucky charm. Tom and Sabine open the door.)
Sabine: How about a delicious salmon and spinach pie? You can tell me what you think of it?
Adrien: Uh, Marinette. A little snack wouldn't hurt, would it?
Marinette: Uh, I'm really sorry. It's impossible to get anything down with my parents around.
Adrien: It's okay. (eats his pie) I didn't know your dad made such yummy pie!
Marinette: Oh, uh, I... yeah! So, shall we go back?
Adrien: Let's see if it works. (takes out Marinette's lucky charm)
(Suddenly, Gamer's robot appears. Marinette and Adrien notice it.)
Marinette: Tell me this isn't some kind of publicity stunt for the tournament!
Gamer: Well, well. Marinette, let's see who's victorious this time.
Adrien: Doesn't look like a publicity stunt to me.
(Gamer's robot fires a laser at them.)
Adrien: (Adrien pushes himself and Marinette for defense) Look out! Uh, we better get outta here!
(Marinette and Adrien run holding their hands, but they separate and go their ways. Marinette runs out of the Park, Gamer chasing her. Suddenly, Gamer's robot stands in front of her.)
Gamer: Game over, Marinette!

title: Gamer/Transcript
text:
Gamer/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: How does he know my name? Max! (Gamer's robot fires lasers at her) I guess he really did want that spot in the tournament!
Adrien: Time to transform.
[ Transformation Sequence ]Adrien: Plagg, claws out! (Adrien transforms into Cat Noir)
(Meanwhile, Marinette still runs away from Gamer's robot. But she falls. As soon as the robot is about to fire a laser at her, Cat Noir's staff appears and hits the robot.)
Gamer: Game over!
Cat Noir: Not yet! Here comes a new challenger!
Marinette: Cat Noir! Hey! Over here!
(Cat Noir rescues Marinette while dodging the Robot's lasers. He jumps from ceiling to ceiling until he reaches the Grand Paris Hotel.)
Cat Noir: I heard Miss Video Game Champion really taked! off the final boss.
Marinette: Well it doesn't give him extra points to go transforming everyone. Hey, wait, Cat Noir! I left my friend Adrien at the park! He could be in danger, we have to go back!
Cat Noir: Uh... don't worry. Adrien's not in danger. He'll be fine. You'll be safe here. Just stay put. Don't worry, Cat Noir will take care of everything. Arch, leap, and do a barrel roll!
Marinette: Uh, he's always so over-the-top.

title: Gamer/Transcript
text:
Gamer/Transcript - Intro
Tikki: If ever there was a game to win, this is it! Let's go!
[ Transformation Sequence ] Marinette: Tikki, spots on! Ha! (Marinette transforms into Ladybug)
Cat Noir: Get away from here! As far as you can! (sees the robot) Hurry!
(The people run away.)
Cat Noir: Hey, tin can! Over here!
Gamer: My calculations indicate that your system's about to crash!
(Ladybug ties the two legs of the robot with her yo-yo.)
Ladybug: You're the one crashing, robot! (pulls the yo-yo's string, making the robot fall.)
Cat Noir: He's a life-size robot, from Ultimate Mecha Strike!
Ladybug: I know! And it's nearly at level 3. 4 is the highest level!
Cat Noir: Wait, you know that game?
Ladybug: Duh! Of course!
Cat Noir: See? You and me! It was meant to be.
(Gamer sees the bus. He absorbs it and evolves into level 3.)
Cat Noir: Uh, I think our problem just got a whole lot bigger.
Gamer: Level 3. Hahahahahaha!
Hawk Moth: If you want to be the most powerful robot in the world, you must capture Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses. Then it really will be Game Over.
Gamer: Those Miraculouses are mine! (starts attacking Ladybug and Cat Noir. He fires lasers at them, but they run away.)

title: Gamer/Transcript
text:
Gamer/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: We have to get him out of here before he destroys all of Paris!
(Ladybug looks at a billboard for the Tournament.)
Ladybug & Cat Noir: The stadium! (they go to the stadium.)
Ladybug: Where has Clunky got to?
(Gamer's robot appears behind them. Ladybug and Cat Noir throw their yo-yo and staff at him to try to defeat the robot but did it didn't work.)
Gamer: Hahahaha! (his robot tries to smash them, but Ladybug and Cat Noir dodge. They run away from its laser.)
Ladybug: Attack the robot with your Cataclysm Power! It might be enough to shock him!
Cat Noir: My pleasure. Two can play this game. Cataclysm! (uses his Cataclysm to destroy Gamer's robot)
Gamer: Nooooo!
Ladybug: Smackdown, Cat Noir!
(She gives him a high five.)
Cat Noir: Cat Noir Style! Booyah!
(A floating red sphere appears between them.)
Cat Noir: Whoa ha ha! Check out that loot!
Ladybug: System crash, Gamer!
Gamer: Hahahaha! You've forgotten the rules. I saved my last level! (touches his glasses and respawns his robot) Respawn!
Cat Noir: Aww, not the old spawn point glitch again.
Ladybug: Yeah, but did you see he pushed that button on his glasses? I bet the akuma's in there.

title: Gamer/Transcript
text:
Gamer/Transcript - Intro
(Ladybug touches the red sphere and a red and black robot appears. Ladybug and Cat Noir stand on it.)
Ladybug: Ha! We've leveled up too!
Cat Noir: (his Miraculous beeps) Okay, but I only got a few minutes left.
(Ladybug and Cat Noir enter their robot's cockpit.)
Cat Noir: I'll man it, you shoot!
Ladybug: Why do you get to man it?
Cat Noir: What do you say we flip for it?
(Ladybug and Cat Noir start controlling the robot, but Gamer's robot smashes it.)
Cat Noir: Okay, you man it and I'll fire.
Ladybug: Look out! Here it comes again...
(Gamer's robot attacks Ladybug and Cat Noir's robot. Ladybug mans the robot.)
Ladybug: Don't let it go to your head! (uses a rocket punch) Booster! (the punch knocks down the head of Gamer's robot. Gamer puts it back on.)
Gamer: Hahahahaha! Huh? (sees Ladybug and Cat Noir's robot still standing.)
Ladybug: Round two, Gamer.
Gamer: Arrrghhh... Gamer Missiles! (his robot shoots missiles out of its shoulders.)
Ladybug: Forcefield, Cat Noir!
Cat Noir: Got it. Forcefield activated! (activates the robot's forcefield, destroys the missiles) Cat Saber! (takes the robot's tail off and uses it as a saber.)

title: Gamer/Transcript
text:
Gamer/Transcript - Intro
Gamer: Gamer-Drill! (activates a drill on the robot's arm, and charges on Ladybug and Cat Noir's robot. The two are still charging.)
Cat Noir: This Gamer's way powerful. He just took out our forcefield!
Ladybug: We're gonna have to manage without. Lady Bombs! (shoots bombs out of the robot's shoulders)
Gamer: Laser Wall! (a laser wall appears and blocks the Lady Bombs)
Ladybug: Lady Helix! (the robot's two shields fly over to Gamer's robot, but his robot blocks them.)
Cat Noir: Punch! (the robot's two arms fly over to Gamer's robot, but his robot neutralizes them) Ear Thunder! (uses the robot's two cat ears to make thunder, but Gamer's robot blocks it with its own thunder.)
Ladybug: He's anticipating all of our attacks!
Cat Noir: Watch out, Ladybug! (Gamer's robot charges at them, the two robots fight.)
Gamer: Gamer Fire! (fires a blast of energy, appears next to Ladybug and Cat Noir's robot, and pushes their robot to the energy orb. Then his robot fires an eye beam to their robot.) Hahahahaha! Today I shall be victorious!
(The robot stands up, charges a blast of energy and fires it at the robot.)
Cat Noir: Catouken!

title: Gamer/Transcript
text:
Gamer/Transcript - Intro
(Ladybug and Cat Noir's robot slams Gamer's robot to the floor, but Gamer's robot disintegrates and forms again, still standing.)
Gamer: I am the strongest player in the world! Hahahaha!
Cat Noir: How are we supposed to beat him if we can't even catch him?
Ladybug: We have to beat him harder and jam the system! Tatsu-Lady! (kicks the robot with a spinning kick)
Cat Noir: Catouken! (fires a blast of energy at the robot)
Gamer: Gamer Crusher! (spins at Ladybug and Cat Noir's robot, but they dodge)
Ladybug: Shoryubug! (does a Shoryuken at Gamer's robot)
Cat Noir: Catouken! (fires a blast of energy at the robot, knocking it)
(Gamer's robot stands up. The two robots fight until Gamer's robot holds the other's hands and doesn't let it off.)
Ladybug: We've gotta get inside his cockpit!
Cat Noir: Go for it. You're in charge!
Ladybug: Take the controls, Cat Noir. I'll be right back.
Cat Noir: You'll be right back? Where are you going?!
Ladybug: (goes out of the cockpit) It's just us two now, Gamer!
Gamer: What are they...
Ladybug: Lucky Charm! (a graffiti can appears) Huh? Graffiti? Spray paint? Arts and crafts? (Ladybug uses her Lucky Vision, and the robot's left arm and eye flash) Bingo.

title: Gamer/Transcript
text:
Gamer/Transcript - Intro
(Ladybug runs to Gamer's robot. She reaches its eye and sprays graffiti on it.)
Gamer: Aghhh! You won't get away with this! (goes out of the cockpit, and Ladybug takes his glasses off)
Ladybug: Game over, Gamer. (breaks the glasses) Game's over for you too, akuma. Time to de-evilize! (captures the akuma with her yo-yo) Gotcha! (releases a purified butterfly) Bye bye little butterfly. Miraculous Ladybug! (throws the Lucky Charm into the air, and everything turns back to normal. Gamer is turned back into Max.)
Max: What am I doing here?
Ladybug & Cat Noir: Pound it!
Hawk Moth: Such pitiful insolence! The moment you challenged me was the moment you sealed your fate! This battle is not yet over...
Announcer: So remember, the High Score to beat is 24500, so gamers, hit those consoles. Game on!
Alya: You bent over backwards to be in the team and now you wanna pull out?
Marinette: It's just that I feel so bad for Max. And well, it just wouldn't be right.
Alya: (stops her) You're doing the right thing. But honestly, it's not like you get the chance to play with Adrien everyday...
Marinette: ...Max? I've thought about this a lot, and...

title: Gamer/Transcript
text:
Gamer/Transcript - Intro
Announcer: And now, representing Françoise Dupont High School...
Marinette: Well, I think you should be playing tonight, Max.
Max: What?
Marinette: Don't get me wrong! I love gaming, but it's not my heart and soul. This is your baby. It's your tournament, Max. I don't wanna take that away from you.
Nino: Dudes, make up your minds. They're waiting for you.
Marinette: I insist! (gives Max the controller)
Max: I don't know how to thank you.
Adrien: By winning the tournament... with her.
(Adrien walks over to Marinette by putting his hand on her right shoulder and she is shocked and he gives his controller to her.)
Marinette: Huh?
Adrien: Go on, Marinette. You're a hundred times better than me. You belong on the team. Win the tournament for the school. I know you can do it.
(Alya facepalms)
Nino: Go on, dudes! They're waiting for you!
(Nino takes her by the shoulder.)
Marinette: No, uh, I... only with you?
Max: Let's show them who's gold.
(Marinette nods. She and Max enter the gates as the other students cheer them on.)

title: Gabriel Agreste/History
text:
Gabriel Agreste/History - Intro
Gabriel Agreste was a fashion mogul who wielded the Butterfly Miraculous. After his wife Émilie went missing, he used the Butterfly Miraculous to turn people into villains. He was set on stealing the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses in order to obtain absolute power and his "secret wish." In pursuing this, however, he turned his back on his son, Adrien.

title: Gabriel Agreste/History
text:
Gabriel Agreste/History - Before Season 1
Before Gabriel Agreste was a wealthy and powerful fashion designer, he was Gabi Grassette, whose family owned a French fry shop called Friterie Grassette. During his teenage years, he supported the Punk movement, a style and ideology of anti-authoritarianism, whose main purpose is to give as much freedom as possible.
Before changing his name, he befriended Harry Clown and sewed one of his first designs, a French fry costume for Harry's first act. According to André Bourgeois in "Collusion", he used to be a helpful boy who created unique clothes to make people's dreams come true. He even designed André's first suit so the girl he fell in love with would finally notice him. After being discovered by Audrey, Gabriel became a huge name in fashion and founded his own brand Gabriel and became known as the "King of Fashion" and the "Greatest Fashion Designer in the World".

title: Gabriel Agreste/History
text:
Gabriel Agreste/History - Before Season 1
At some point in his life, Gabriel left the punk style and started living in an old apartment in Paris to become a fashion designer. At a certain period of his life, he met Lady Émilie Graham de Vanily, an aristocratic heiress from a British noble family who came to Paris from London for her education and they fell madly in love with each other. However, Émilie's family became outraged by their heiress' relationship with an ordinary man who did not come from the upper class. Even Colt Fathom, his brother-in-law, also didn't believe he was good enough for someone like Émilie. This resulted in Émilie giving up her wealth and rank to be with Gabriel. The couple got married with the Graham de Vanily Twin Rings, which belonged to Émilie since she was born.
During this period of his life, he moved from his old attic room to the Agreste mansion with his wife. At some point in his life, he met Tomoe Tsurugi, whom he became indebted to when he tried to destroy her greatest dream.

title: Gabriel Agreste/History
text:
Gabriel Agreste/History - Before Season 1
Émilie really wanted to have a child, but soon, it became clear that she was infertile, so the couple returned to the Graham de Vanily family to get the best medical aids. Unfortunately, no treatment worked. Desperate, the couple began searching for alternative treatments. They eventually hired Nathalie Sancoeur to help them find a mystical solution.
About a year before Adrien's birth, Gabriel learned of the Prodigious and wanted to have its powers for himself. But because the Prodigious was hidden in a secret cave that could only be accessed through a magic bracelet that was in the possession of the guardian of the Sacred Cave and the Prodigious, Wu Shifu, Gabriel secretly hired Cash to use whatever means necessary to gain ownership of Wu's school and the Sacred Cave Key, so Gabriel himself could gain access to the cave, with no one stopping him.
Their search brought them to Tibet, where Nathalie found the Butterfly Miraculous, Peacock Miraculous, and the Miraculous spellbook. The book was the last thing Émilie gave Gabriel.

title: Gabriel Agreste/History
text:
Gabriel Agreste/History - Before Season 1
Gabriel then gave the Peacock Miraculous to Émilie. She used its power to manifest her and Gabriel's emotions of love to create Adrien and placed his amok in their wedding rings. After her sister Amélie and her husband Colt heard they were having a child, Amélie and Colt wanted the same, as Amélie was also infertile. Colt and Gabriel struck a deal, and Colt used the Peacock Miraculous to create Felix in exchange for one of his best men, Placide I.T., who would later become Adrien's bodyguard.
Émilie eventually became ill from using the broken Miraculous, and Gabriel became obsessed with finding the Ladybug and Cat Miraculous to heal her, much to her worry. She fell into a coma nine months before Adrien was allowed to go to school in Season 1. Before she went into her coma, she left videos for Gabriel and Natalie to watch about looking after Adrien and letting go of her and the Miraculous, but Gabriel was so distraught over Emilie's condition that he told Natalie to delete the videos, saying that they were too painful for him. However, Natalie secretly kept all the videos on her phone and hid them in her safe.

title: Gabriel Agreste/History
text:
Gabriel Agreste/History - Before Season 1
At some point in time, after the death of Wu Shifu and the destruction of his school, Gabriel sent Nathalie to pay Cash for his services and for the key of the Sacred Cave. With all the pieces in place, Gabriel patiently awaited the next Magic Eclipse, where he would later use the bracelet he bought to take the Prodigious.

title: Gabriel Agreste/History
text:
Gabriel Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Ladybug & Cat Noir", he forced Nooroo to explain how the Miraculouses worked and how he could transform using the Butterfly Miraculous. Nooroo tried to convince Gabriel that the Miraculouses were supposed to be used for good in the world, but Gabriel ignored him and forced the transformation anyway. Hand on his cane, Hawk Moth waited in his lair for the perfect person to akumatize. Sensing Ivan Bruel's anger, he sent an akuma to him and transformed him into Stoneheart. Stoneheart went on a rampage against the city of Paris. Gabriel didn't stay to watch; Adrien disobeyed his orders to stay home and not go to public school. Gabriel went to the dining hall where Adrien was being homeschooled by Nathalie Sancoeur. He reprimanded Adrien for sneaking out, telling him that he was safe in the house where he had everything he would ever want. It's clear that Gabriel and Adrien have had this conversation several times.

title: Gabriel Agreste/History
text:
Gabriel Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
Satisfied that he properly disciplined his son, Gabriel went back into his lair and transformed back into Hawk Moth. Stoneheart fought against Paris' two new heroes, Ladybug and Cat Noir, but did not succeed in capturing either of their Miraculouses. When Ivan was freed, the akuma returned to Hawk Moth and stayed in the jewel in his cane. Hawk Moth wasn't disappointed though; the akuma multiplied and created more Stonehearts. Laughing, he stood in wait for the next opportunity to akumatize Ivan, pleased that the two people he wanted the most showed up like he predicted.

title: Gabriel Agreste/History
text:
Gabriel Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Stoneheart", Gabriel demanded that Nathalie and Placide I.T. find Adrien, who escaped the house. Gabriel then went to his lair, transformed, and waited for Ivan to lose his temper. Ivan tried telling Mylène Haprèle that he was in love with her through a song, but she rejected him. This led to Hawk Moth re-releasing the akuma to Ivan. When Stoneheart made it to the Eiffel Tower, Hawk Moth made him cough up hundreds of akuma so that he could tell Paris to give him Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses. When Ladybug captured the akumas that created his face, he grew angry. He convinced Stoneheart that Ladybug and Cat Noir were trying to take Mylène away from him, bringing Stoneheart back into the fight. However, Ladybug captured Stoneheart's akuma. Angrier, Hawk Moth soliloquized that he would defeat Ladybug and Cat Noir and achieve his secret dream. The next day, Gabriel relented with Adrien and let him attend public school on the condition that his bodyguard drive him to school every day and that he follow Nathalie's updated schedule, much to Adrien's joy.

title: Gabriel Agreste/History
text:
Gabriel Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Stormy Weather", Hawk Moth sensed Aurore Beauréal's anger and sadness and akumatized her into Stormy Weather. He helped her set up a trap for Ladybug and Cat Noir. When he lost, he soliloquized that he would someday be victorious, no matter how many enemies he had to throw at the heroes.
In "Lady Wifi", Hawk Moth sensed Alya Césaire's pain over secrets and betrayals and akumatized her into Lady Wifi. He encouraged her to discover Ladybug's identity and helped her figure out what to do with Ladybug and Cat Noir after she captured both of them. Oddly enough, Hawk Moth's plan was for Ladybug to use her Lucky Charm and wait for her to switch back. Hawk Moth vowed that Ladybug's mask would fall one day and that she would hand over her Miraculous at that moment.

title: Gabriel Agreste/History
text:
Gabriel Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
In "The Evillustrator", Hawk Moth sensed Nathaniel Kurtzberg's emotions and akumatized him into the Evillustrator. He threatened the Evillustrator by paralyzing his hand when it seemed he was getting distracted during his date with Marinette. After he was defeated by Ladybug and Cat Noir, Hawk Moth yells in defeat then insisted the Miraculous was practically his and it will be his soon. He then says that once he has them in his possession, he will rule the world then closes the window.
In "Princess Fragrance", he sensed Rose's sadness over having her note for prince Ali ripped Hawk Moth admired that every rose has it's thorns and akumatized her into Princess Fragrance. During the midst of the prince's escape he notices that Cat Noir has been taken down and praises when Ladybug arrives she'll meet the same fate. When Ladybug entered the fray he instructed the villainess to use Cat Noir in taking Ladybug's earrings.

title: Gabriel Agreste/History
text:
Gabriel Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Dark Cupid", after feeling Kim's broken heart he sent an akuma his way turning him  into Dark Cupid an angel filled with hate. Became annoyed that his villain lost Ladybug so easily and demanded him to find her quickly or else he threatened to remove Dark Cupid's powers. After Cat Noir was found under the influence of the hate arrow he advised Dark Cupid to team with him seeing Ladybug cornered Hawk Moth believed she was doomed but gained another defeat. As the window closed he cursed Ladybug and Valentines Day.

title: Gabriel Agreste/History
text:
Gabriel Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Mr. Pigeon", Gabriel held a derby hat competition at Adrien's school. The winner's hat would be used in Adrien's next photoshoot. He gave the students 10 hours to create a derby hat. In those 10 hours, Gabriel transformed into Hawk Moth and sensed Xavier Ramier's feeling of injustice and akumatized him into Mr. Pigeon. When he lost, Hawk Moth promised to destroy Ladybug and all the pigeons. Gabriel detransformed in time for his hat competition. Adrien and Denis Damoclès led Nathalie and Gabriel (who appeared only on a tablet) around the courtyard to see the hats. When confronted with two identical hats and Marinette explained that Chloé Bourgeois stole Marinette's design, he made Marinette the winner of the competition.

title: Gabriel Agreste/History
text:
Gabriel Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Pixelator", as he sensed Vincent's sadness about not getting a picture of Jagged Stone; Hawk Moth akumatizes him into Pixelator. When the musician and heroine escaped the mastermind proposed to his villain if he wanted Jagged he had to find Ladybug but when the photo villain was more focused on Jagged, he controlled Pixelator commanding him to focus on the jewels and gives him a plan. Once Pixelator arrived at the destination, Hawk Moth let the photo shoot begin and soon afterwards Ladybug arrived and was aware of her trick. And told Pixelator that Ladybug would trick him as well as gaining another defeat but Hawk Moth declared the next time they meet it won't be a photo finish and destroy the heroes.
In "Copycat", Hawk Moth sensed Théo Barbot's jealousy over Cat Noir's relationship with Ladybug and akumatized him into Copycat. When Copycat caught Cat Noir, Hawk Moth demanded that he get Cat Noir's Miraculous. He approved of Ladybug taking Cat Noir's Miraculous from Cat Noir, enjoying the irony.

title: Gabriel Agreste/History
text:
Gabriel Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
In "The Bubbler", Gabriel did not allow Adrien to have a birthday party. When Marinette dropped off a present for Adrien, Gabriel yelled at Nathalie for forgetting to get Adrien a gift from himself. He was visited by Nino Lahiffe in an attempt to change his mind about the birthday party, but he decided Nino was a poor influence on Adrien and banned him from the Agreste mansion. After Nino left, Gabriel transformed into Hawk Moth and sensed Nino's frustration over adults not listening to their children, akumatizing him into the Bubbler. He became angry when Bubbler captured Ladybug and Cat Noir and sent them into the sky instead of stealing their Miraculouses. When Bubbler was defeated, Hawk Moth vowed to catch and crush Ladybug and Cat Noir. Later that day, he received a message from Nathalie that Adrien liked his present.
In "Simon Says", Hawk Moth monitors  The Challenge as a good place for negative emotions.
Subsequently, Gabriel is contacted by the same program to be hypnotized by Simon Grimault, but Gabriel refuses, finding him and the program pathetic.
After Simon is disqualified, he akumatizes him in Simon Says.

title: Gabriel Agreste/History
text:
Gabriel Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
He is worried when he hears that the super-villain wants to capture Gabriel Agreste, but he says he gave him an idea.
Later Gabriel receives Ladybug and does not listen to Adrien's warnings about his safety.
Quietly discusses with Ladybug but proves to be intrigued by her earrings.
When Simon Says arrives with many hypnotized Parisians, he activates the house's security system at the request of Cat Noir.
It is annoying that Cat Noir gives him orders but then comments that it reminds him of someone.
After being left alone, Gabriel quickly goes to his lair, trasforms into Hawk Moth and reminds Simon Says to take Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses, because he "feels nearby".
He detrasforms in time for the arrival of Nathalie and Nino and is later captured by Simon Says.
He is taken to the TV studio and hypnotized by Simon Says to believe before being in a butterfly and then a plane.
When he is about to throw himself from the roof, he is dehypnotized thanks to the Miraculous Ladybug and shakes Cat Noir's hand, noting his ring.

title: Gabriel Agreste/History
text:
Gabriel Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
Back home, Gabriel enters his son's room and embraces Adrien, realizing at that moment his ring and leaving the room, stating that he is only happy that everything worked out for the best.
In "Gamer", after sensing Max's anger about losing his spot in the competition as well as remembering in a game there's a winner and loser he akumatized Max into Gamer. Seeing his progress Hawk Moth commended Gamer to show everyone that he was the best and continued to encourage him. He also reminding him, that if Gamer wanted to have the most powerful robot in the world he would have to succeed in their deal in getting the heroes Miraculous then it would be gamer over. Angered by another defeat Hawk Moth declared the heroes sealed their fate when they challenged him and that their game isn't over.
In "Animan", after feeling Otis' anger Hawk Moth akumatized him into Animan and instructed him to get the heroes Miraculous. After seeing that Cat Noir was subdued he told Animan to take his ring, but was defeated. Afterwards Hawk Moth believed he would be at the top of the food chain.

title: Gabriel Agreste/History
text:
Gabriel Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Darkblade", he sensed Armand D'Argencourt's anger over losing the election and sent an akuma to him which akumatized the instructor into Darkblade. When he saw that Darkblade's conquest was almost complete Hawk Moth believed the heroes were doomed. With the evil knight defeated Hawk Moth claimed their duel wasn't over and he would rule in the end.
In "The Pharaoh", Hawk Moth sensed Jalil Kubdel's frustration and disappointment over not being able to live out his "fantasy" of bringing the dead back to life and akumatized him into the Pharaoh. When the Pharaoh was about to sacrifice Ladybug to Ra, he demanded that the Pharaoh take Ladybug's earrings. Hawk Moth declared that someday, wherever Ladybug was, that he would take her Miraculous and she would be nothing.
In "Timebreaker", Hawk Moth sensed Alix Kubdel's disappointment, frustration, and negativity and akumatized her into Timebreaker. He akumatized her twice, much to his amusement. He promised to destroy Ladybug one day in the past, present, or future and become unstoppable.

title: Gabriel Agreste/History
text:
Gabriel Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Rogercop", Gabriel either forgot about Parents' Career Day at Collège Françoise Dupont, or he just didn't want to show up. Either way, he disappointed Adrien. Instead, he transformed into Hawk Moth and sensed Roger Raincomprix's negative emotions. When Ladybug tries to dissuade Rogercop he tells the villain not to listen to her and that she is lair. Once Rogercop is defeated, Hawk Moth declares he'll be ruling the world one day and that Ladybug and Cat Noir wouldn't be apart of it.
In "Horrificator", sensing Mylène's sadness and fear he sent an akuma to her turning her into Horrificator a villain that feeds off fear. After Horrificator took another hostage, he told her to feed off their fear as it will give her strength and soon he have strength too but after Horrificator's defeat. Hawk Moth said that Ladybug doesn't scare him at all.

title: Gabriel Agreste/History
text:
Gabriel Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
In "The Puppeteer", Hawk Moth sensed Manon's sadness over one of the dolls being taken away. He sent an akuma turning Manon into Puppeteer and was equally impressed on how quickly she figured things out. Once Hawk Moth saw that Puppeteer had Cat Noir under her control he commanded her to use him against Ladybug. When things turned into a five against one fight Hawk Moth believed victory was his until the heroine pulled a come from behind victory. He was so awestruck that Ladybug won with such odds that he yelled this is not possible as the window closes.
In "The Mime", after he sensed Fred Harpèle's sadness about losing his part in the performance. Hawk Moth akumatized him into The Mime. As the heroes fought against the villain on bus he instructed The Mime to grab Ladybug's earrings but after the fight at the tower Hawk Moth was handed another defeat.
In "Guitar Villain", when sensing Jagged Stone's anger Hawk Moth akumatizes him into Guitar Villain and Fang into a dragon. After a battle of Rock n' Roll music Hawk Moth was defeated once more, but told the heroes not to do a victory dance yet because soon he'll be playing the anthem of the heroes defeat.

title: Gabriel Agreste/History
text:
Gabriel Agreste/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Reflekta", after feeling Juleka's loneliness about being excluded from the class photo, he akumatized her into Reflekta. Seeing her transform so many people he couldn't wait for Ladybug and Cat Noir to show up but when he saw Reflekta transform Cat Noir he told her that she should have taken his Miraculous before she transformed him. After witnessing another defeat Hawk Moth said he'll destroy Ladybug when she least expect it.
In "Antibug", he sensed Sabrina's sadness after a mishap with Chloé and Sabrina's game and akumatized her into Vanisher.
