Cat Noir: Hey there, m'lady. Somebody is having a super villain party and didn't invite us.
Ladybug: They're looking for Marinette Dupain-Cheng, one of their classmates.
Cat Noir: Haven't we already saved her a bunch of times? Funny you'd think everybody would like her.
Ladybug: Well apparently, she's managed to alienate all her friends at once. (struggles to think about the recent event)
Cat Noir: You still there?
Ladybug: Just thinking. With five villians it's not gonna be easy finding the object that has the akuma.
Cat Noir: I bet you already have an idea, right?
Ladybug: I'm going to isolate one of the villains from the others and get her to tell me where the akuma is. Meanwhile, you find Timebreaker to stop her from going back in the past, otherwise she could really screw up my plan.
Cat Noir: Good luck, M'lady.
Ladybug: Thanks, you too.
(Timebreaker continues to touch nearby civilians, and increases her power.)
Cat Noir: Hey, it's been awhile. How's it ticking Ms. Time Keeper?
Timebreaker: It's Timebreaker. And I don't have a second to lose talking to you.

title: Gang of Secrets/Transcript
text:
Gang of Secrets/Transcript - Intro
(Timebreaker attacks but Cat Noir blocks her with his staff.)
(Ladybug breaks her phone, but it is not where the akuma is.)
Lady Wifi: Ha, bummer for you, Ladybug. I don't have the akuma.
Ladybug: No biggie, I just wanted to talk to you anyway.
Lady Wifi: I've got nothing to say to you.
(Cat Noir fights off Timebreaker.)
Shadow Moth: (with telepathy) Your friend, Lady Wifi is having some trouble with Ladybug. (all girls grunt and escape)
Cat Noir: (chasing after them) Hey! Don't you wanna play anymore?
Ladybug: Alya, from what I understand, you've been having some issues with your best friend. Her name's Marinette, right?
(The rest of the gang runs to go near Ladybug, and Cat Noir is on their tail.)
Ladybug: I don't know what happened between the two of you, but I wanna tell you about a friend of mine. She's a superhero. You know Rena Rouge right?
(Lady Wifi realizes her superhero identity)
Ladybug: Of course, we keep secrets from one another, mainly because of my secret identity, but even though we can't tell each other everything, we trust each other. And that's why we can fight side by side. You can reject the power that Shadow Moth gave you.
(Lady Wifi begins to break free)

title: Gang of Secrets/Transcript
text:
Gang of Secrets/Transcript - Intro
Shadow Moth: (from his lair) Don't listen to her Lady Wifi. If you do that, you'll never know your friend's secrets! Or Ladybug's!
Ladybug: I trust you completely Alya. And I need you! I.. need Rena Rouge! (un-tangles Lady Wifi)
(Lady Wifi struggles to break free, with Ladybug feeling hopeful. Finally, Lady Wifi screams and breaks free of Shadow Moth's control.)
Shadow Moth: (feeling pain from the break. As he gazes his head up, Shadow Moth is completely stunned that Lady Wifi completely broke his hold.) That's.. impossible!
(Lady Wifi de-transforms into Alya, nearly fainting.)
Ladybug: Wow. No one has ever done that... you're amazing!
Alya: It's 'cause you're an amazing friend, Ladybug.
Ladybug and Alya: Pound it.
(Ladybug's phone is ringing.)
Cat Noir: Ladybug, the Gang of Secrets is looking for you, I'm on it, but I don't know how long I can hold them off all by myself.
Shadow Moth: (from his lair) Your friend Lady Wifi has betrayed you, she chose Ladybug's side. Hurry up and seize his Miraculous so you can take care of the bug!
<poem>
Ladybug: Which object holds the akuma?

title: Gang of Secrets/Transcript
text:
Gang of Secrets/Transcript - Intro
Alya: It's in a bracelet. Timebreaker must have it, but you and Cat Noir will never be able to take on four villains at once.
Ladybug: I think this calls for the master of Illusion. (opens her yo-yo and takes out the Fox Miraculous)
Alya: Woah! How'd you do that?
Ladybug: There have been a few upgrades since I became Guardian of the Miraculous.
Alya: You're Guardian of the- (gasps)
Ladybug: Yeah, keep it on the down low. Not a word about it on the LadyBlog.
Alya: You know I know how to keep a secret.
(She puts on the Fox Miraculous and Trixx appears)
<center>  [Transformation Sequence]   Alya: Trixx, let's pounce!  </center>
</poem>
Reflekta: No Cataclysm to save you this time.
Ladybug: We need to hurry! Lucky Charm! (a pool lifesaver appears from the air, and Ladybug looks around for ideas.) Okay, I got a plan, listen. '
Cat Noir: At the very moment you touch it, I'll summon my power and then who knows what's gonna happen to you.
Princess Fragrance: Why bother taking it, when I can make you my slave and order you to give it to me?
Ladybug: Give them what they want, now!
Rena Rouge: Mirage!
Marinette Illusion: Cat Noir, no!
Gang of Secrets: Marinette!
Princess Fragrance: Catch her!

title: Gang of Secrets/Transcript
text:
Gang of Secrets/Transcript - Intro
(The gang starts running after the Marinette illusion)
Shadow Moth: (from his lair; angrily) No! Take his Miraculous first! Come back!
Cat Noir: Thank you, M'ladies. I was a whisker away from cat-astrophe.
Ladybug: That's what friends are for, my kitty cat. Okay, you two get to the pool, now.
Cat Noir: What about you?
Ladybug: I'll keep our guests busy. Rena Rouge will explain the rest of the plan.
(The Marinette illusion runs to the Swimming pool, along with the Gang of Secrets.)
Shadow Moth: (from his lair) Seize Ladybug! Take her Miraculous!
Timebreaker: You take care of her. I'll deal with Marinette.
(Ladybug tries to fight back, but is captured by Horrificator)
Reflekta: You're on Princess!
Timebreaker: It's time to give up your secret, Marinette!
Princess Fragrance: Soon you're going to do anything we demand of you, Ladybug. For starters, give us your Miraculous now!
Shadow Moth: (from his lair) Finally.
Timebreaker: There's nowhere to go!
(The Marinette illusion runs to avoid Timebreaker. Timebreaker nearly gets ahold of her.)
Rena Rouge: Mirage, Vanish!

title: Gang of Secrets/Transcript
text:
Gang of Secrets/Transcript - Intro
(The illusion disappears, and Timebreaker lands in the pool, confused. Aqua Noir, who is in the pool, uses the lifesaver to trap Timebreaker.)
Aqua Noir: Cataclysm! (uses to disintegrate the bracelet)
(The akuma is released. Timebreaker is de-transformed.)
(Princess Fragrance, Horrificator, and Reflekta de-transform. Ladybug catches Rose.)
Rose: Thank you, Ladybug.
(Ladybug notices the akuma)
Ladybug: No more evil doing for you little akuma! Time to de-evilize! (captures the akuma and purifies it) Gotcha! Bye bye little butterfly! (throws the lifesaver) Miraculous Ladybug!
(The Miraculous Ladybug undoes all of the damage, including the Eiffel Tower moving in a strange way. Ladybug feels guilty about abandoning her friends.)
Rena Rouge: Pound it?
Ladybug, Rena Rouge, and Cat Noir: Pound it!
Shadow Moth: You've made mistakes before Ladybug, and you'll make them again! One day, I will discover your secret! (the window closes)
Rena Rouge: Let's rest. (de-transforms and gives a high-five to Trixx.)
Alya: Thank you, Ladybug.
Ladybug: You know, without you and Cat Noir, I wouldn't have made it through today. I'm really lucky to have friends like you. So, thank you.

title: Gang of Secrets/Transcript
text:
Gang of Secrets/Transcript - Intro
(Ladybug and Alya hug each other.)
(Marinette is holding the friendship bracelet, and admits to the breakup.)
Marinette: It's true, breaking up with Luka broke my heart. And never being able to tell Adrien how I feel is just as painful. Love is too difficult. I think- I think I'm gonna stick to friendship, that's about all I can handle right now.
Rose: Take your time.
Mylène: It'll all work out.
Alya: And whatever happens, we'll always be here for you. (the girls hug Marinette)
Alix: When you're ready for love, just make sure you tell us, so we can help you with a sick new plan to win over Adrien, Luka or whoever!
Girls: (laugh)
Marinette: Girls, it's you who I love. (all the girls hug again)
Rose: Bye, Marinette.
Alix: Bye! See ya tomorrow.
(Marinette once again looks distraught; Alya notices)
Alya: You go ahead girls, I just have one last thing to say to Marinette. (closes the door to Marinette's room) You didn't tell us everything, did you? A journalist and a BFF can tell these things.
(Marinette feels guilty and sadly sits down.)
Alya: I won't try to figure it out or force it out of you. (sits beside her) If you can't tell me what's in your heart, it's your right.

title: Gang of Secrets/Transcript
text:
Gang of Secrets/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Will we still be friends?
Alya: Marinette. I'm your best friend, and I'll always be. That's why it kills me that I can't help you with whatever's making you feel so alone.
(Alya sighs, and is about to leave Marinette's room when Marinette grabs her hand.)
Marinette: Alya, wait! Stay. You're right, I am alone. (grows increasingly emotional) More than ever before. I can barely take it anymore! You know why I broke up with Luka? Not because I don't like him, he's amazing! It's 'cause there's something that I can't tell him. You know why I have to forget Adrien? For the exact same reason! You're right, I keep secrets, I lie all the time! I lie to my friends, to my parents, to everyone and the worst thing is, I can't do it any other way!
Alya: There's always another way.
Marinette: No, not this time. I have no choice. All this is bigger than us, Alya. Way too big.
Alya: If it's too big, two of us can handle it better than one.
Marinette: If I tell you, things will never be the same between us again. (shakes her head) It'll mess up everything, maybe even destroy it.
Alya: (voice breaking) Marinette, I'm your very best friend.
Marinette: And I… I'm Ladybug.

title: Gang of Secrets/Transcript
text:
Gang of Secrets/Transcript - Intro
(Alya becomes surprised, that someone, whom she admired the most was her best friend, before she hugs Marinette, with the kwamis looking on, possibly distressed and worried.)
fr:Le Gang des Secrets/Transcription

title: Gabriel Agreste (episode)/Transcript
text:
Gabriel Agreste (episode)/Transcript - Intro
[ Theme Song ]
Shadow Moth: Ladybug, ever since you became the guardian of the Miraculouses, something has been different, and believe me I will find out exactly what it is.
(The lair window closes shut.)
Gabriel: Tonight, Émilie, our rings will once again be united. I've invited your sister and Félix. I have every intention of getting back what he stole from me.
(Gabriel wears the ring.)
Alya: (v.o) The Miraculous are magical jewels that give powers to superheroes, like Ladybug's earrings and Cat Noir's ring. But supervillain Shadow Moth also has two Miraculous brooches in his possession, and they will give him his powers. We can figure out from this that the Miraculous can either make a superhero or a supervillain. It's all riding on who wears it, which is why these jewels can't fall into just anybody's hands. That's all for today, guys! See you soon, and stay connected!
Félix: (puts down the tablet) I hope we'll get to see some superheroes while we're here in Paris, mom.
Amélie: That would be pretty exciting, wouldn't it, darling? (gives a flying kiss) Mwah!
Nathalie: Yes?
(Adrien comes in with prepared food.)
Nathalie: Thank you, Adrien.

title: Gabriel Agreste (episode)/Transcript
text:
Gabriel Agreste (episode)/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: My father doesn't want me to invite my friends from school tonight.
Nathalie: But there will be some teenagers here, like Chloé and Kagami.
Adrien: Yeah, but only 'cause their parents are members of his club.
Nathalie: These club members are influential people in Paris. They are very important to your father, Adrien.
Adrien: (sadly) And my friends are very important to me.
Gabriel: Adrien, can you leave us for a moment?
Adrien: Yes, father.
(Adrien walks out of the room, closing the door. Gabriel sits beside Nathalie and takes off his spectacles.)
Gabriel: I'm having a difficult time without your help, Nathalie. I realized now how many people it would take to fill your shoes.
Nathalie: You're not thinking about cancelling the party, are you?
Gabriel: I can't, the members of the club wouldn't understand. Also, Félix will be here with Amélie.
Nathalie: I've made a list of everything that has to get done tonight.
(Nathalie hands him a tablet, while Gabriel puts on his spectacles.)

title: Gabriel Agreste (episode)/Transcript
text:
Gabriel Agreste (episode)/Transcript - Intro
Nathalie: You'll just need to follow the instructions. The most important things are in red. (Gabriel scrolls through the list of instructions, on the tablet.) Check the staffs' identities, make sure the robots are set to the proper program and don't forget to activate the cellphone scramblers, so the party stays private.
(Nathalie hands him a sandwich.)
Nathalie: Have you had lunch?
Gabriel: No. (takes the sandwich) Thank you.
Alya: Marinette. We've decided to ask Marc and Nathaniel for help. If anyone can come up with the perfect plan for you to finally tell Adrien you love him, it's them.
Marinette: What? Are you serious?
Alya: Yeah, so?
Marinette: So they all know about me and... (whispers) how I feel about you know who?
Mylène: Everyone knows that you're crushing on Adrien!
Marinette: Even Adrien?
Nathaniel: Adrien is probably the only one who doesn't know.
Marc: Of course, otherwise there would be no story.
Alya: We chose Marc and Nate, 'cause as you know, they're the experts in romantic comedies. Marc writes and Nate draws.

title: Gabriel Agreste (episode)/Transcript
text:
Gabriel Agreste (episode)/Transcript - Intro
Rose: And, since they succeeded in inventing a love story for Ladybug and Cat Noir in their first comic book, they're sure to think of the perfect plot between you and Adrien!
Marc: Your story with Adrien seems really complicated.
Nathaniel: But it's actually very simple.
Marc: It's just like a fairy tale. Nate?
(Nathaniel opens a book.)
Marc: Usually, a mean old witch imprisons a princess in a castle guarded by a dragon. And a knight in shining armour has to save her. Well, this is the same story, except you're the knight, Marinette, Adrien's the princess, the castle is his home, and the witch is his father, Gabriel Agreste.
Rose: I'd have thought his father was the king.
Alix: Or the dragon.
Zoé: His bodyguard would be the dragon, he looks the part!
Mylène: He looks more like a gorilla.
(Everyone laughs.)
Nathaniel: The main obstacle in the fairy tale could be the dragon.
Marc: Or the witch! In Marinette and Adrien's story, it's Gabriel Agreste. But the witch Agreste has made a mistake! He's been letting his son out of the castle to go to school!
Alya: And that's where the good fairies come in!
Marc and Nathaniel: Us!

title: Gabriel Agreste (episode)/Transcript
text:
Gabriel Agreste (episode)/Transcript - Intro
Marc: Every week, we'll think of a new plan, so that the knight can finally kiss the princess! And they can finally live happily ever after with buckets of hamsters! And the plan will always take place in the one and only location where the witch can't get to, which is...
Marinette: The school!
(Chloé enters through a ceiling tile.)
Chloé: A-ha! You forgot me in your ridiculous fairy tale!
(Sabrina follows her, falling down flat on her face instead.)
Rose: (screams) The terrifying ogre!
Mylène: The big bad wolf!
Alix: The ugly toad!
Chloé: Your worst nightmare!
(Chloé then shows her cellphone to them with a recording of the meeting playing.)
Chloé: Thanks to this video, I'm going to ruin Dupain-Cheng's fairy tale! Tonight, I'll show this video to his father, who will realize that you're trying to take his son away from him and make him fall in love with a baker girl! Then he'll lock Adrien up in his room forever and forbid him to come back to school, and poof! There goes your fairy tale! Adrien will never see you again! Good for him!
Marinette: I thought you're happy that Adrien was coming to school?

title: Gabriel Agreste (episode)/Transcript
text:
Gabriel Agreste (episode)/Transcript - Intro
Chloé: He'll be better off alone at home than surrounded by a bunch of lame-o's at school! And then maybe he'll be lucky enough to go back to being my Prince Charming whom I've always adored!
Marinette: Adrien was never your Prince Charming, Chloé!
Chloé: We'll see about that, Dupain-Cheng! Sabrina, ninja smokescreen!
(Sabrina throws a white powder before making their escape. Chloé hits the ceiling.)
Marinette: She won't do anything. Not tonight, or ever. The witch— I mean, Gabriel Agreste, doesn't just let anyone walk into his house.
Zoé: Normally, that's true, but actually, there's a dinner party tonight, and all his friends are invited, with their children! Chloé will be there.
Marinette: Yeah, but so will her mother, who's your mother, so you'll be there too! You'll be able to stop her, right?
Zoé: My darling half sister Chloé managed to convince her mother not to bring me with them.
Marinette: (groans) She really is a piece of work...
Marc: We just have to pretend like we're in a fairy tale! The knight simply has to go to the ball to stop the evil Chloé from showing the videos to the witch Agreste!
Zoé: The knight can't get into the ball. The ball is off-limits, tonight.

title: Gabriel Agreste (episode)/Transcript
text:
Gabriel Agreste (episode)/Transcript - Intro
(Nathaniel is drawing over the book.)
Marc: Unless, the knight is wearing...
Nathaniel: (He shows his drawn-on illustration) A disguise!
Zoé: (rudely) Jean Quinton, did my mother tell you that the dinner party is no longer at Gabriel Agreste's tonight?
Armand: Oh no! Madam didn't mention anything to me.
Zoé: A helicopter will be coming to the roof, to take you over to the Eiffel Tower.
Armand: Is mademoiselle sure about this?
Zoé: Excuse me? Are you suggesting that I might be wrong? (walks away) Ridiculous! Utterly ridiculous! (to herself) Sorry, but it's for a good cause.
Zoé: (Through the phone) The butler is out of the picture.
Marc: The knight can take his place!
(Marinette's friend help her to get in the disguise of the butler.)
Rose: (Placing mustache on Marinette's face) There, perfect!
Gabriel: (Locks his office.) Office locked, check.
(Gabriel closes the curtains.)
Gabriel: Dining room, check. Accessories, check.
(A van arrives outside the mansion.)
Gabriel: Catering, check. Activate scrambler...
(The doorbell rings. Placide I.T. goes to the door, but Gabriel interrupts him.)
Gabriel: You handle the cellphone scrambler, I'll take care of greeting my guests.

title: Gabriel Agreste (episode)/Transcript
text:
Gabriel Agreste (episode)/Transcript - Intro
(Placide I.T. goes to the table full of remotes, and presses a remote button, due to which all the window shutters starts to get open and close automatically. He presses another button due to which robots come out and start circling the bodyguard. He presses another button, due to which everything becomes normal.)
Gabriel: Welcome.
(The guests scan their fingerprints onto Gabriel's tablet, and wear the provided masks.)
Marinette: Waitress in sight.
Zoé: (in Marinette's room, through the phone) Good luck, Marinette.
Marinette: (coughs) (in a fake accent) Hi there.
Sarah: Uh...
Marinette: I'm Marino. (bows) Sorry I'm late, they let me know at the last minute that I had to take over for the regular waiter 'cause... he's sick!
Sarah: Oh! Nice to meet you. My name is Sarah. Here's the deal, this is a very private party with very important people! We have to be invisible. The only contact we'll have with Gabriel Agreste will be when he takes our fingerprints to check our identities.
Marinette: Ah— uh... check our identities?
Rose: (in Marinette's room, through the phone) Was this part of the plan?

title: Gabriel Agreste (episode)/Transcript
text:
Gabriel Agreste (episode)/Transcript - Intro
Sarah: We're just here for food prep in the kitchen and overseeing the children. The robots will be serving the adults. Follow me, everything will be fine.
Marinette: I've got the muscles, I'll carry the heavy stuff. Don't you worry, partner!
(Marinette takes the heavy box from Sarah and walks towards the mansion.)
Gabriel: Thank you.
(Sarah enters the mansion and gets her fingers scanned, but due to Marinette's hands being full with the heavy box, Gabriel doesn't bother to scan her fingerprint and thus, she passes the security check.)
Marinette: I'm in!
Zoé: (in Marinette's room, through the phone) Yes, well done!
Audrey: How come you're doing all the work tonight, Gabriel? If you needed more servants, you just have to ask us to lend you more.
Gabriel: Welcoming you is never work, dear Audrey.
(Gabriel leans to kiss Audrey's hand but Chloé stops him.)
Chloé: (waving her hand) Mr. Agreste, I need you to show you a video, it's really important that you see this!
Marinette: Woaah! Oh no!
(Marinette throws the package while Adrien catches it. Chloé tries to dodge the package but bumps into Gabriel, breaking both the tablet and the cellphone.)
Chloé: My phone!

title: Gabriel Agreste (episode)/Transcript
text:
Gabriel Agreste (episode)/Transcript - Intro
(Adrien hands over the package to Marinette.)
Adrien: I guess you dropped this.
Marinette: Thanks— (in a fake accent) Oh— I mean, thanks.
Adrien: Do I know you?
Marinette: Not likely, I don't know anyone.
(Marinette walks away. Amélie and Félix are heading toward the entrance. Gabriel adjusts his scarf to hide the brooches, but Félix notices it anyway.)
Chloé: Hey! You have to watch this, are you ready?
Gabriel: I don't have time for this, young lady.
Chloé: But—
André: Come along now, sweetheart. Gabriel is obviously busy.
Amélie: Gabriel! I'm so happy to be able to thank you in person for giving our family's ring (kisses his cheeks) back to Félix.
Gabriel: It was the sensible thing to do, Amélie.
Adrien: That was very thoughtful of you, Father.
(Sarah clears her throat to get Marinette's attention.)
Marinette: I can handle serving the youngsters, I've always been good with kids.
Sarah: I'd rather you stay in the kitchen.
Zoé: (in communicator) Show her she's making the wrong choice, Marinette!
(Marinette enters the kitchen. She crashes onto a number of objects.)
Marinette: Oh, no! I'm so clumsy!
Sarah: Okay, you take care of the kids.

title: Gabriel Agreste (episode)/Transcript
text:
Gabriel Agreste (episode)/Transcript - Intro
(Marinette comes out of the kitchen with a tray of drinks.)
Chloé: Oh look, it's the fake Adrien! If I was anyone, other than Chloé Bourgeois, you might actually have me fooled!
Félix: (imitating Adrien) You're wrong, Chloé, I am Adrien!
Chloé: (thinking he is Adrien) Oh! I'm so sorry, Adrikins!
Félix: (laughs) You're still just as foolish as ever, Chloé Bourgeois.
(Félix walks away and Chloé gets angry at him. Adrien closes the door as Kagami and her mother arrives. Gabriel locks the door from his tablet.)
Chloé: Mr. Agreste! Is now good? Do you have time to look at my film?
Gabriel: All cellphones will be secured safely for the duration of the evening.
(The robot glides in front of Chloé, and opens its tray.)
Gabriel: I'm sure you understand how essential privacy is when important business is on the line.
(Chloé takes out the memory card before inserting her phone into the robot's tray. Gabriel turns on the cellphone scrambler, which interferes with Marinette's communicator. Marinette removes the communicator.)
Alya: They've got a soundwave scrambler in the house!
Alix: I'm sure she can handle it.
Gabriel: Adrien, show your young friends up to your room.
Adrien: Yes, father.

title: Gabriel Agreste (episode)/Transcript
text:
Gabriel Agreste (episode)/Transcript - Intro
(Félix also starts to go along with them buts Gabriel stops him.)
Gabriel: Félix. May I see you for a moment?
Gabriel: Why did you steal my ring, Félix?
Félix: Mom really wanted me to have it since it belonged to her family. (taking off the ring) But you really wanted to keep it, so I planned on giving it back to you tonight.
Gabriel: (taking the ring from Félix) Hmm. Your mother will be sad if you do that.
Félix: Don't worry, uncle. (wearing another ring) She won't know. I had a copy made.
Gabriel: You're an intelligent young man, Félix.
(Félix exits the room and goes to the staircase, smiling mischievously and takes the left staircase. Meanwhile, Gabriel comes out of the room and takes the right staircase and enters Nathalie's room. Félix follows him and stands outside the room, eavesdropping on their conversation.)
Gabriel: I know each and every scratch on Émilie's ring! It's a fake ring! (angrily throws the ring) He gave me a fake ring! How dare he?!
(Outside the room, Adrien calls Félix.)
Adrien: (outside the room, waving) Hey, Félix! Are you coming?
(Félix leaves the place, waving back, and goes with Adrien.)

title: Gabriel Agreste (episode)/Transcript
text:
Gabriel Agreste (episode)/Transcript - Intro
Nathalie: Akumatize him, then make him tell you where he's put Émilie's real ring and get it back.
Gabriel: If I do that, he'll know that I'm Shadow Moth. (punches the table) Who else would want that ring?
Nathalie: You're forgetting how immense your powers are now. You can be the Gabriel who creates negative emotions and the Shadow Moth who akumatizes them at the same time.
Gabriel: Brilliant idea, Nathalie.
(He removes his glasses and places it on the table. He takes off his scarf to transform.)
Gabriel: Duusu, Nooroo, dual metamorphosis!
(He transforms into Shadow Moth and takes a feather out of his Hand Fan.)
Shadow Moth: No one tricks Gabriel Agreste. But you, my lovely amok, you will deceive that arrogant young Félix! And thanks to you, I will get my ring back!
(He amokizes his glasses and forms a sentimonster version of himself.)
Shadow Moth: (Looks at the sentimonster) You're perfect!
Chloé: (showing her mobile memory card) I need to find a phone. He has to watch my movie.
Adrien: (stopping Chloé) Chloé, you heard my father. Not during the party.
Chloé: He will thank me when he sees what I filmed.
Adrien: Chloé, No!
(Chloé walks away and Marinette tries to follow Chloé.)

title: Gabriel Agreste (episode)/Transcript
text:
Gabriel Agreste (episode)/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (handing the tray of drinks to Adrien) I will take care of it. I've always been good with young people.
(Félix sees this and also tries to get out of the room.)
Félix: (standing up) I need to speak to my mother.
(Félix walks out of the room. Adrien then offers Kagami some juice, to which Kagami still seems to be grumpy and Adrien smiles slightly.)
Sarah: (from the kitchen) Marino, why do you have a cardboard box on your head?
Marinette: (from the kitchen) Uh— it's to entertain the youngsters!
(Marinette comes out of the kitchen, with a similar cardboard box like Chloé, and enters the soirée room.)
Marinette: (searching for Chloé) Where are you Chloé? You are here somewhere.
(She searches the room and sees Chloé, taking her phone from the robot.)
Marinette: (to herself) She's looking for her phone! I won't let you do it.
Sentimonster Gabriel: (from behind Félix, surprising him) What are you looking for, Félix?
Félix: (turning around) You. I'd like to get to know you better, uncle.
Sentimonster Gabriel: It's true. You don't know me very well at all, otherwise you wouldn't have given me a fake ring. Where did you put the real ring? The one that belongs to my wife?

title: Gabriel Agreste (sentimonster)
text:
Gabriel Agreste (sentimonster) - Intro
Gabriel Agreste was the titular central antagonist of the episode "Gabriel Agreste".
He was a sentimonster in the likeness of the real Gabriel Agreste created by Shadow Moth from his own emotions of vengeance and determination to fool Félix, who thinks Gabriel is Shadow Moth, and get the ring he stole from the real Gabriel.
In "Gabriel Agreste", after failing to force Félix to tell him where he hid the ring, Shadow Moth akumatized the sentimonster into the Collector, a supervillain who had the power to imprison any person or object within his tablet as his weapon. He also received a Magical Charm from Ladybug that prevented him and his original self from getting reakumatized, which later on helped the real Gabriel to learn about and destroy the Magical Charms.

title: Gabriel Agreste (sentimonster)
text:
Gabriel Agreste (sentimonster) - Appearance
As Gabriel
Gabriel had the same appearance as the real Gabriel Agreste. He had pale, light grayish cerulean eyes and combed-back platinum blond hair. He wore Gabriel's formal attire, which he wore during the party in "Gabriel Agreste", and on the family portrait in the hall of the Agreste mansion. However, this sentimonster did not have the Butterfly or Peacock Miraculous under his tie.
As Collector

title: Gabriel Agreste (sentimonster)
text:
Gabriel Agreste (sentimonster) - Appearance
Collector had the same appearance as the real Gabriel Agreste's akumatized form as Collector, except for more magenta/purple skin and fewer/different stripes on his suit and boots. Collector's skin was pale purple. His hair stuck up at a point and was white with black vertical stripes. However, along with the back of his head and his neck was black. He wore a bluish-black pointed shouldered dress suit with a white lapel and black and red downward-bent stripes on the front. Each lower sleeve had a white stripe, and Collector's hands had white gloves. Also, he wore bluish-black dress pants and darker black high-heeled boots that were connected to them. Those high heels were cone-shaped, with downward bent white stripes. He also wielded a black tablet, with a white stripe bent over with a red triangle inside.

title: Gabriel Agreste (sentimonster)
text:
Gabriel Agreste (sentimonster) - Abilities
As Gabriel
Gabriel had the same abilities as the real Gabriel Agreste, being his imitation. As the creation of Gabriel Agreste himself, he was also likely in possession of the same memories as him.
As Collector
Collector was able to trap objects and people as videos inside his tablet by touching it to them. Anyone trapped in the tablet would reveal their secrets when their video was played. If he threw the tablet, it would return to him. Unlike the original Collector's notebook, his tablet was implied to have unlimited storage.
Additionally he was also quick, agile and able to dodge attacks easily.

title: Gabriel Agreste (sentimonster)
text:
Gabriel Agreste (sentimonster) - Trivia
This was the third sentimonster to be akumatized, the first one being Kagami Tsurugi, and the second being Feast.
After the Ladybug Sentimonster, this was the second Sentimonster based on a human, and thus also the second Sentimonster that could be viewed as a person.
He was followed by Sentialec, Sentinino, and Sentibubbler.
This was the first sentimonster to be destroyed by Shadow Moth (coincidently foreshadowing the real Gabriel's death at the end of Season 5). The next one was Sentialec.
This was the first time ever when two different people have been akumatized into the same supervillain separately.
He was the first sentimonster to receive a Magical Charm. However, this was used for the real Gabriel to find a way to learn about and destroy those charms.
This was the first and only sentimonster based on the civillian form of the creator.
This was the first sentimonster to wear glasses. This could mean that his glasses were affecting his vision, or they were just for looks to be an exact carbon copy of Gabriel Agreste.

title: Gabriel Agreste/Movie
text:
Gabriel Agreste/Movie - Intro
Gabriel Agreste is the main antagonist of "Ladybug & Cat Noir: The Movie". He is the father of Adrien Agreste and the widower of the late Émilie Agreste.
Formerly, with the Butterfly Miraculous, when inhabited by Nooroo, Gabriel transformed into Hawk Moth (Le Papillon in the French version, which translates to "The Butterfly"), a butterfly-themed supervillain. He wanted Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses to restore Emilie and his family. To achieve his goal, he used the Butterfly Miraculous' power: akumatization. This allowed him to create and control akumas, regular butterflies, imbued with the power of the Butterfly Miraculous that can transform normal people with negative emotions into akumatized supervillains. Later, after akumatizing himself, supercharging his powers, and battling the two heroes, he surrendered the Butterfly Miraculous after finding out his son is Cat Noir.

title: Gabriel Agreste/Movie
text:
Gabriel Agreste/Movie - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Gabriel is a very tall, middle-aged man whose skin tone is fair with a rosy tint. He has pale, light grayish cerulean eyes and combed-back light blonde hair. When he was younger he used to have long hair since he was a child then same as an adult before he change it to combed back light blonde.
Civilian Attire
As Gabriel Agreste, he dons a light grey collared shirt with red buttons, a multicolored tie, and a white overcoat. He also wears bright red pants and white cap toe shoes with neatly tied laces. His hair is a light grey, and his eyes are a light blue. He also wears glasses. On the middle finger of his right hand, he wears a gold ring.
As Hawk Moth
As Hawk Moth, he wore an extravagantly purple suit with a large V-shaped collar. His pants were an identical shade of purple, and he wore a grey cowl to obscure his face, with only his eyes and a small area around his mouth uncovered. The Butterfly Miraculous resided below his neck, being worn as a brooch. He was often seen wielding a dark purple cane.

title: Gabriel Agreste/Movie
text:
Gabriel Agreste/Movie - Appearance
Both of his designs were rather similar to his original counterpart, but they still had slight differences. His clothing is less bright than it was in the show, his eyebrows are light blonde instead of gray, his glasses are grey instead of black, his ring is gold instead of silver, the area of his suit where the Butterfly Miraculous is is a lighter shade of purple than the rest of his suit. Hawk Moth's mask have a more metallic finish compared to the show, and the jewel on top of his cane has a more vibrant glow. Due to the movie's art style being more realistic, his head is less elliptical, and his hair has greater detail.

title: Gabriel Agreste/Movie
text:
Gabriel Agreste/Movie - Personality
With or without the Butterfly Miraculous, Gabriel is a cold, broken man capable of great cruelty in times of desperation. He is wrathful, practically losing his mind over Ladybug and Cat Noir repeatedly thwarting his attempts at getting their Miraculous, and perfectly willing to put civilians in harm's way to achieve his goals. This eventually culminates in him akumatizing himself to defeat Ladybug and Cat Noir, putting the entire city of Paris at risk as a result.
Despite this, Gabriel is not without humanity. A key motivation for his turn to villainy is the unfortunate death of his beloved wife, Emilie, and his ultimate goal was to make a wish using the Ladybug and Cat Miraculous to resurrect her. While he is estranged and quite apathetic of his feelings, he genuinely loves his son, Adrien, being upset over his sorrow over the loss of his mother and feeling heartbroken when the latter tells him that he was a poor father for him. When he finds out that Cat Noir is his son, Gabriel is mortified, breaking down in tears over how his actions have endangered his son. This leads to him forgoing his days as Hawk Moth, turning himself in to repent for his crimes.

title: Gabriel Agreste/Movie
text:
Gabriel Agreste/Movie - Personality
At the end of the day, Gabriel Agreste is a tragic man who let his grief fester to the point where it warped his morals entirely. Once he learned that love can overcome any tragedy, he was able to see the error of his ways, redeeming himself in the process.

title: Gabriel Agreste/Movie
text:
Gabriel Agreste/Movie - Abilities
As a Civilian
Gabriel was an expert at fashion design and was well-versed in owning a business.
As Hawk Moth
Hawk Moth was granted superhuman physical abilities such as speed, agility, strength, and near-invulnerability, and wielded a cane as his Miraculous tool. He could turn people with potent negative emotions into supervillains by infecting them with Akumas, capable of creating an army of them. He could also psychically sense negative feelings across Paris, telepathically connect with akumatized victims, and project holograms of himself using Akumas to communicate with others from far away.
When he akumatized himself, he gave himself fully to the dark power of the Butterfly Miraculous, granting him immense magical power, able to control dark energy, telekinetically manipulate objects and matter, summon storm clouds, unleash a massive swarm of Akumas to attack and destroy the city, and could materialize a pair of wings made of Akumas that levitated him.

title: Gabriel Agreste/Movie
text:
Gabriel Agreste/Movie - Relationships
Émilie Agreste
At first, shown in the flashbacks, Gabriel and Émilie had met when they were kids and throughout the years together they were in love with him describing it as "two halves made whole". Then, they both shared great joy that they were going to be parents and have a family but it was short lived when Émilie died of an unknown condition. Much like his canon counterpart, Gabriel is shown to mourn and miss her a lot, believing he couldn't raise Adrien without her finding Émilie; the superior parent. So much so that he is willing to use the Butterfly Miraculous to cause chaos and get the Ladybug and Cat Miraculous to bring her back to life even if it means putting everyone (including the people he loves) in danger. Unknown to everyone except Nathalie, he kept her in a secret area in their house.
Adrien Agreste/Cat Noir

title: Gabriel Agreste/Movie
text:
Gabriel Agreste/Movie - Relationships
In the past, Gabriel used to have a good relationship with his son during the time Émilie was alive showing that they loved each other very much. Unfortunately, after Émilie died, both were greatly devastated by her death. Unlike Adrien, who was able to at least came to terms with it, Gabriel was so heartbroken that he became a supervillain to bring her back. Because of her death, they grew cold and distant, which greatly upset Adrien. Despite this, he does care for his son and asked where he had been telling his son that he as his father he worried for him. Embittered with Ladybug for rejecting him and resentful towards his father for his negligence, Adrien furiously claimed that he lost his father "a long time ago" and stormed off to his room in rage, leaving Gabriel genuinely hurt.

title: Gabriel Agreste/Movie
text:
Gabriel Agreste/Movie - Relationships
As Hawk Moth, he deeply dislikes Cat Noir and Ladybug for ruining his plans. When his final showdown with them starts, Hawk Moth grabs him and attempts to take away his Miraculous. But Cat responds by scarring him across his eye, enraging him so much that he savagely tears parts of his suit and later takes off the part of his mask off and upon giving himself a closer look at the hero, he, much to his horror, realized that Cat Noir is his son.
After he transforms back, Gabriel breaks down in tears to him, who was shocked and heartbroken to learn that his own father was Hawk Moth. When Adrien asked why would he do this, Gabriel tearfully said that he did it out of love for his mother, apologizes to Adrien and after kneeling, he wept bitterly to himself believing that his son would never forgive him for being a supervillain he despises. But to his surprise, Cat Noir comforted and forgave him saying that he had to let Émilie go. Gabriel, shocked, stood up and Cat Noir gave him a comforting and reconciling hug reconnecting, at long last. Unfortunately, Gabriel would be separated from his son for his time in jail for the damage he caused to the Paris.
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/Ladybug

title: Gabriel Agreste/Movie
text:
Gabriel Agreste/Movie - Relationships
Gabriel, as Hawk Moth, was aware that Ladybug and Cat Noir are the current holders of Ladybug and Cat Miraculous, the very Miraculous that he sought to use to bring back his wife. He was extremely frustrated and enraged that she and Cat Noir continuously foiling all of his plans. When he attacked Paris one last time, Hawk Moth, now akumatized, telepathically grabs Ladybug and took away her Miraculous. Before throwing her away, he comments that Ladybug was just a scared, little girl.
Nathalie Sancoeur
Much like his canon counterpart, they share a healthy professional working relationship. However, Nathalie wishes for Gabriel to at least spend more time with his son, but he refuses. Unknown to everyone except Nathalie, he kept Émilie's body in a secret area in their house.
Nooroo

title: Gabriel Agreste/Movie
text:
Gabriel Agreste/Movie - Relationships
Even though she provided him with the information needed to find the Miraculouses, and he misused her Miraculous for evil, he initially disregarded Nooroo's stern and serious warning through a vision. She cautioned him that if he did not abandon his dark path, he would ultimately lose everything. Upon discovering that Cat Noir was his son, Gabriel fearfully realized she had been right and surrendered her to Ladybug and then to Master Fu.

title: Gabriel Agreste/Movie
text:
Gabriel Agreste/Movie - History
Past
Once Gabriel was a kid happily living in Paris until one day, he met a girl named Émilie and fell in love. As they grew up they eventually married and had a son named Adrien. They lived a happy life together until she died from an unknown condition. Afterwards Gabriel blamed himself for her death, believing that he should have died instead of her, which left him helpless to face Adrien's sadness.

title: Gabriel Agreste/Movie
text:
Gabriel Agreste/Movie - History
Regardless as the years went by, he grew distant from his son allthewhile became a famous fashion designer and the head of his own company. Yet away from prying eyes, he searched for a way to bring Emilie back until through unknown circumstances Gabriel obtained a book called the Miraculous spellbook that led to his discovery of the Miraculous. Then, he visited a museum where the curator gave him a compass to the Butterfly Miraculous, admitting that he had never seen such a strange artifact before. He purchased it, which led him to an ancient underground cavern or catacomb. There, he found the Butterfly Miraculous, met Nooroo as well as asked for the power to restore his wife. But the kwami explained that she didn't have such power, only the Ladybug and Cat Noir Miraculouses did, and they could only be summoned in times of chaos. So Gabriel then decided to use the Butterfly Miraculous to do so.
Ladybug & Cat Noir: The Movie

title: Gabriel Agreste/Movie
text:
Gabriel Agreste/Movie - History
On Émilie's birthday, he arrived at his company building and was informed by Nathalie Sancoeur that the teams were ready for him in the showroom and that the show had been a success. He asked for the reviews before instructing some designers to make a few adjustments to a dress. In another room, he walked through a display of dresses and stopped at a particular one, recalling when Émilie had asked him for that dress. He would have done anything to see her in it. It also reminded him of the moment he discovered the Butterfly Miraculous and witnessed a vision of Paris in chaos and destruction.
He later arrived home and being informed by Nathalie of his world-fashion interview the next day as well as suggested having dinner with his son but he refused and unknown to him, that Adrien sadly overheard. In his office, Gabriel was still very sad by Émilie's death deciding that he can no longer keep the dark secret, he puts the Butterfly Miraculous on and becomes Hawk Moth to get the wielders of the Ladybug and Cat Noir Miraculouses to appear.

title: Gabriel Agreste/Movie
text:
Gabriel Agreste/Movie - History
Sensing Raymond's broken heart, he akumatized him into the Gargoyle. However, Marinette Dupain-Cheng, as Ladybug, and Adrien, as Cat Noir, managed to defeat him, leading to Gabriel being knocked out. When he woke up, he saw the news featuring the heroes, and realized his plan succeeded. But was reminded by Nooroo of his previous warnings and pleads with him to stop, or risk losing everything. However, believing he has nothing left to lose, he refused and through "Chaos Will Reign Today", he paraded through the city rooftops and catacombs about how he'll continue his plans. By the next day, he akumatized two criminals into the Magician and the Mime to rob a bank and attack the fair. Knowing the event wasn't safe, he called his son to come home. However, after Ladybug and Cat Noir defeated his villains, Hawk Moth created a giant hologram of himself and swears to the two heroes that there will be no mercy next time. As Hawk Moth continued to send akumatized villains after them, but were continuously defeated by the heroes, causing Gabriel's frustration to overcome his sanity while Ladybug and Cat Noir became Paris' heroes.

title: Gabriel Agreste/Movie
text:
Gabriel Agreste/Movie - History
Months later, with his back against a wall, Gabriel opted to tell Adrien everything, so he decided to wait for him at home, but noticed that his son hadn't returned that night and when he did. Gabriel greeted him asking where he had been since he did not come home but was rejected by an anger Adrien who snapped at him for never being there for him since Émilie died and that he lost his father a long time ago. Hurt by this, Gabriel decided to acquire the Miraculouses himself.
Becoming Hawk Moth again, he akumatized himself into becoming stronger and unleashed his final terror on Paris watching everything from the Eiffel Tower.
Until Ladybug and Cat Noir arrived but with the hero, climbing up the tower to confront him alone.
But he easily evaded the hero's cataclysm, knocking him down, causing Cat Noir to accidentally destroy the Eiffel Tower with his power, which falls apart into the river.
Seeing the hero's predicament, he wondered if cats do land on their feet, as he made his descend, the mastermind noticed the hero duo in the river turning up the pressure Hawk Moth confronted them while turning the river into lava trapping them.

title: Gabriel Agreste/Movie
text:
Gabriel Agreste/Movie - History
He easily defeated Ladybug's attempt to attack him, and stole her Miraculous then proceeded to steal Cat Noir's, but he got slashed by the hero's cataclysm, scarring his face.
Enraged Hawk Moth used his akumas to relentlessly attack a weakened Cat Noir destroying his costume and mask.
Just as he made the finishing blow, Hawk Moth struck Marinette, who came to Cat Noir's defense knocking them both out of the air.
Ready to finish this Hawk Moth lifted Cat Noir up but upon closer inspection he recognized to his shock and horror that the hero was his son.
Causing him to cease the chaos and renounces the Butterfly Miraculous in the process, thus revealing himself much to Adrien and Marinette's shock.

title: Gabriel Agreste/Movie
text:
Gabriel Agreste/Movie - History
Gabriel broke down realizing the chaos he caused, and that he almost murdered his own son. Adrien sadly asks him why he committed all these crimes. Gabriel explained that he tried to bring Émilie back with the Miraculous but now realized that he lost himself and that love is stronger than death. He received Adrien's forgiveness and they both shared a loving hug which also releases the Ladybug Miraculous back to Marinette, who used her power to restore Paris back, leaving Gabriel to be arrested offscreen.
However, unknown to everyone, Nathalie opened a secret room in the Agreste mansion where it is revealed that Émilie's body is hidden, and she is revealed to be wearing the Peacock Miraculous.

title: Gabriel Agreste/Movie
text:
Gabriel Agreste/Movie - Trivia
Differences
There are some notable differences between Gabriel's canon counterpart and his movie counterpart:
In the movie, this Gabriel does not homeschool his son Adrien, nor does he force him to learn Chinese, fence, model, or restrict him from social interactions.
Unlike his canon counterpart, whose voice noticeably deepens when he transforms with a Miraculous, the movie Gabriel retains his civilian voice without any change.
Gabriel discovers that his son is Cat Noir, which leads him to feel remorse and guilt. This causes him to relinquish the Butterfly Miraculous and turn himself in. This contrasts with his original self in the canon, whose two erased timeline versions had no qualms about akumatizing their sons.
The entire city of Paris learns that Gabriel was Hawk Moth, while his original self remained hidden as Hawk Moth/Shadow Moth/Monarch and was revered as a "hero."
Gabriel was possibly arrested for his crimes off-screen, which diverges from his original self, who was never arrested because he perished after sacrificing himself to heal his assistant Nathalie and join his wife in the afterlife.

title: Gabriel Agreste/Re-Verse
text:
Gabriel Agreste/Re-Verse - Intro
Gabriel Agreste is the tritagonist of Miraculous World: Paris - Tales of Shadybug and Claw Noir. He is the heroic counterpart of Gabriel Agreste from the Re-Verse. When Nooroo inhabits the Butterfly Miraculous, he transforms into Betterfly (Hesperia in the French dub), a butterfly-themed superhero with the power of Transmission. He is also the leader of the Resistance.
In "Miraculous Paris", he crossed the multiverse to seek help from Ladybug and Cat Noir to fight Shadybug and Claw Noir, who came to their world to steal the Butterfly Miraculous from him. After his enemies allied themselves with Ladybug's own nemesis, Monarch, and set up a trap, Ladybug comes up with a plan to counter it. Borrowing his Butterfly Miraculous to become Ladyfly, she kamikotized him into Guardian Angel, an angel-themed superhero with the power to protect his allies from any attack. After Ladybug and Cat Noir managed to reform Shadybug and Claw Noir, who became superheroes, the latter two joined Betterfly's team to fight the Supreme and bring peace to their universe.

title: Gabriel Agreste/Re-Verse
text:
Gabriel Agreste/Re-Verse - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Because he is Gabriel Agreste's counterpart in another universe, he has a similar appearance to him, but with a middle part hairstyle.
Civilian Attire
He wears a light blue vest with white buttons over a cream-colored dress shirt, a light blue violet ascot tie with a pattern of tiny lilac triangles facing downward, light khaki dress pants, cream-colored dress shoes with brown laces, and light gray round glasses. He also has a silver wedding ring on his left ring finger.
As Betterfly
Betterfly wears a light purple dress shirt, over which he wears a dark indigo jacket with lighter purple butterfly-shaped lapel-like adorn coming from the central button of his jacket. He also wears dark indigo pants and dress shoes without laces, purple gloves, a dark purple butterfly-shaped mask over his face, and a light purple cavalier shoulder cape that resembles butterfly wings, and his hairstyle is white middle part.
As Guardian Angel

title: Gabriel Agreste/Re-Verse
text:
Gabriel Agreste/Re-Verse - Appearance
Guardian Angel was similar to Gabriel in appearance, but with his body and clothes appearing to be made entirely of white feathers. He was seen wearing a tailcoat and had big white wings and completely white eyes. His kamikotized object, his glasses, seemed to be the only part of his form not made of feather.

title: Gabriel Agreste/Re-Verse
text:
Gabriel Agreste/Re-Verse - Personality
Much like his counterpart, Gabriel used to be willing to go to great lengths to get what he wanted. In order to make his dream a reality, he joined the Supreme and stole two Miraculous: the Butterfly and the Peacock. However, because of his misuse of their powers, he lost his wife. This event had a great impact on Gabriel, who decided to use the power of the Butterfly for good, creating superheroes to fight the Supreme, and bring hope to his world.
However, unlike his counterpart, Gabriel was able to move on from his wife's death, and never considered in finding a way to bring her back. Not just that, but he is able to learn from his mistakes.

title: Gabriel Agreste/Re-Verse
text:
Gabriel Agreste/Re-Verse - Personality
As Betterfly, unlike Hawk Moth/Shadow Moth/Monarch, he embodies all the ideals of hope and freedom he stands for to the heart. It is his belief that powers must be shared to the world and used for the greater good, a lesson that he learned in the hard way. Remaining true to the purpose of his Miraculous, he only uses his powers to kamikotize someone that willingly wants to help him, instead of preying on those with negative emotions or on innocent civilians. Even with his allies, unless it's a life or death situation, he asks them for permission before releasing his kamiko. An example is when he saves Marinette, as he doesn't try to kamikotize her to help him fight Shadybug and Claw Noir, despite the clear disadvantage he has.

title: Gabriel Agreste/Re-Verse
text:
Gabriel Agreste/Re-Verse - Personality
This is also evident in his fighting style, which also contrasts with that of his counterpart's. Unlike Hawk Moth/Monarch, who prefers to remain in his lair and let his akumatized villains fight for him, only fighting his enemies directly when necessary, Betterfly is more opened as he is willing to fight his battles than just watch from a distance or manipulate everyone to his advantage. Even those he kamikotizes are seen to possess powers that serve mostly as support, like Ubiquity's ability to transport him to an universe where he can get allies or Celesticat's ability to emanate a blinding light and flight to help them escape Shadybug and Claw Noir.

title: Gabriel Agreste/Re-Verse
text:
Gabriel Agreste/Re-Verse - Personality
Betterfly always prioritizes the safety of the civilians and his allies, even before his own mission to defeat The Supreme and his followers, seen how he went to put Marinette in a safe place, as soon he heard from Ubiquity that Shadybug and Claw Noir were coming, instead of taking that time to prepare an ambush. Also similar to Ladybug and Cat Noir, he was also caring and considerate even to his enemies as he tried to convince Shadybug and Claw Noir that it wasn't too late for them to change likely wanting to save them from the negative effects of their jewels. Without realizing it he also felt great empathy, unlike his counterpart, as he like Ladybug and Cat Noir knew what it felt like to be hunted and lonely.

title: Gabriel Agreste/Re-Verse
text:
Gabriel Agreste/Re-Verse - Personality
Betterfly is also very emotional and passionate about his job as a superhero. He is very dedicated to his duty to his world in such way that it actually made him have a troubled relationship with his son, who believes that his father doesn't have time for him so he can keep making clothes to help him move on from Émilie's death. But despite his estranged relationship with his son being painful to him, he knows it's the only way to keep him safe. After coming to Ladybug and Cat Noir's world and seeing how different it is from his, Betterfly became very emotional, as that only gave him more hope that his dream of turning his world into something as marvelous is still possible.

title: Gabriel Agreste/Re-Verse
text:
Gabriel Agreste/Re-Verse - Abilities
As a Civilian
In the theme song, it is shown that, like his counterpart, he has skills in the fashion industry.
As Betterfly
Like his villainous counterpart, he can use the power of the Butterfly Miraculous to give superpowers to individuals. However, unlike him, who can create Akumas to turn people into Supervillains, Betterfly creates Kamikos, which are able to kamikotize them into superheroes. It would appear that Betterfly is able to shoot the kamikos directly to his targets, instead of just directing them and let them fly naturally to them. He can also undo any transformation originated from the Butterfly Miraculous, by purifying the butterfly used on it, being it a kamiko or an akuma.
As Guardian Angel

title: Gabriel Agreste/Re-Verse
text:
Gabriel Agreste/Re-Verse - Abilities
Like a real angel, he had wings that allowed him to fly. However, his real power was his ability to protect his allies from any attack. To activate his power, he involved his allies with his wings, marking their backs with wing marks and then disappearing. As long his allies had his mark, they became protected from any attack that may have landed on them. When they were attacked, a swarm of white feathers were released from the mark and involved the assaulter completely, immobilizing them and putting them out of combat.

title: Gabriel Agreste/Re-Verse
text:
Gabriel Agreste/Re-Verse - Trivia
In the French version, Gabriel's superhero identity is Hesperia. In the English version, it is instead Betterfly.
In the European Portuguese dub, Gabriel's superhero identity is Asaluz, which is the combination of the words "asa", which is Portuguese for "wing", and "luz", which is Portuguese for "light". So his superhero name means literally "wing of light".
Gabriel's French superhero identity, Hesperia, means "evening" or "evening star" in Greek.
Hesperia is also a brand skipper of the butterfly family.
"Hesperia" also resembles the french verb "espérer", meaning "to trust", "to have faith", "to hope", as he intends to help Paris by giving it hope back.
Because of his superhero name appearing to be feminine, it was thought that was the superhero name of the Re-Verse's Alya, being it either as a Butterfly Miraculous holder or as an akumatized hero.
The name Hesperia is almost identical to Vesperia, differing only at the first letter. The two are even superhero names of Miraculous holders from two different bug themes: butterfly and bee.
Because Betterfly uses the Butterfly Miraculous for good, instead of evil like Monarch does, his own powers get a different name:

title: Gabriel Agreste/Re-Verse
text:
Gabriel Agreste/Re-Verse - Trivia
Instead of creating akumas (which are attracted to negative emotions/intentions), he creates kamikos which, despite looking identical to akumas, seem to work in reverse, being attracted to positive emotions/intentions.
By extension, the name of the power Betterfly uses is not Akumatization, but Kamikotization, which allows him to create kamikotized superheroes.
Similar to his counterpart, Betterfly stole two Miraculous from the Supreme entity of his universe that possesses them, with them being the Butterfly and the Peacock.
The relationship that Gabriel and his counterpart have with their respective sons are both similar and opposite to one another:
In the Quantic Universe, Gabriel was unable to move on from his wife's death and was obsessed with bringing her back, while Adrien was able to do it, causing the former to be very protective and demanding with the latter. Meanwhile, in the reverse universe, Gabriel was able to move on from his wife's death, while Adrien was unable to move on from his mother's death and was obsessed with bringing her back, becoming resenting towards his father for doing it and acting rebellious with him.

title: Gabriel Agreste/Re-Verse
text:
Gabriel Agreste/Re-Verse - Trivia
Both Gabriels have a distant relationship with their respective sons, but for similar and yet different reasons. The Gabriel from the Quantic Universe wants to protect Adrien from the very supervillains he creates, while also preventing him from discovering that he is a supervillain. Meanwhile, the Gabriel from the reverse universe simply doesn't want his son to get involved in his own fights and keep him safe.
Both Gabriels are unaware that their respective sons are their enemies, with the Gabriel of the Quantic Universe being unaware his son is Cat Noir and one of the reasons why he is always losing, while reverse Gabriel is unaware his son is Claw Noir who used to hunt him down to recover his Butterfly Miraculous.
Interestingly, both Gabriels ended up teaming up with their respective sons at one point. However, while Gabriel from the Quantic Universe had to akumatize his son to have him join him or take advantage of his control over him, the Gabriel from the reverse universe ended up teaming up with his son after the latter decided to become a superhero, however with both not knowing who each other are.

title: Gabriel Agreste/Re-Verse
text:
Gabriel Agreste/Re-Verse - Trivia
The main power of Gabriel's kamikotized form seem to be a mix of Resistance and Venom, with it protecting his wards, while also immobilizing the enemy in one go.
This version of Gabriel share some similarities with Spider-Man/Peter Parker when it comes to their origins: Once they'd gained their respective superpowers, they started to used them in order  to satisfy their own desires. But this resulted the loss of a person they held dear (for Gabriel it was his wife, Émilie, and for Peter it was his uncle Ben). Afterwards, they both decided to use their powers for the greater good, having learned the hard way why superpowers should never be used selfishly.
Betterfly is considered the heroic representation of Gabriel in the Quantic Universe, serving as what would happened if he went down the same path as his son, then Gabriel and Adrien would have team up and work together as superheroes, like father and son, using their powers to help others while honoring Émilie, possibly joining the French Miraculous superhero team.

title: Gabrielle Grassette
text:
Gabrielle Grassette - Intro
is a minor character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She is the romantic partner of Johnny Grassette, the mother of the late Gabriel Agreste, and the paternal grandmother of Adrien Agreste.

title: Gabrielle Grassette
text:
Gabrielle Grassette - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Gabrielle is a rather petite woman with white skin and a rather stocky build. She has long gray hair tied in a ponytail, white sideburns, and very expressive green eyes.
Civilian Attire
She wears a short, long-sleeved blue denim jacket over a black Jagged Stone blouse with a white logo, black shorts held up by a brown belt with a gold buckle with the number 66 engraved on it, purple tights, and a pair of black boots with silver flame patterns on the sides. She wears a red scarf on her right arm and a pair of gray glasses. She also has a pair of gray earrings and a gray ring on her right ring finger. She has also painted her nails pink.

title: Gabrielle Grassette
text:
Gabrielle Grassette - Personality
In contrast of her late son, Gabrielle is a gentle and sweet lady. She doesn't seem to believe in traditional social engagements and customs such as marriage, which is why she and her partner Johnny are not legally engaged.
She is shown to care greatly for her family, as shown to happily meet Adrien after many years, and wanted what was best for him, as she was the first to agree that Adrien should stay with Natalie, thinking that Natalie has taken care of him like a mother.
However, she has shown to stand her own ground if needed, as when Emil tried to force her and Johnny to give him and Milly full custody of Adrien and ban them from ever seeing him again, she called it monstrous and stood up to Emil about his arrogance towards their family.

title: Gabrielle Grassette

Gabrielle is an expert motorcyclist, capable of quickly traveling from Lille to Paris to visit her grandson. Co-owner of Friterie Grassette with her partner, she is an expert in making northern French fries.

title: Ganges
text:
Ganges - Intro
The  (Hindi: गंगा Gaṅgā, Urdu: گنگا, Bengali: গঙ্গা Gōnga) is a river 2,500 to 3,000 kilometers long that flows through the Indo-Gangetic Plain in India and Bangladesh, emptying into the Bay of Bengal. It is the holiest of the seven sacred rivers of India.

title: Ganges
text:
Ganges - Description
The Ganges at Varanasi
Varanasi was built on the left bank of the Ganges. The river flows for 6.8 kilometers through Varanasi, forming a crisscross. As a sacred river, dozens of ghats were built along its course, allowing pilgrims access to it. These ghats are particularly important because of the Hindu belief that dying in Varanasi erases sins and ends the cycle of reincarnation. Two of these ghats are dedicated to the cremation of the dead, the most famous being Manikarnika.

title: Ganges
text:
Ganges - Trivia
Due to beliefs, religious practices, but also industrial activity, the Ganges is one of the most polluted rivers in the world.

title: Gavroche
text:
Gavroche - Intro
was a character from the old, unused concept of Ladybug and Cat Noir being in a team of superheroes called the Quantic Kids. He shows up in concept art with Melodie and Kid Mime, who were members of the team. However, the concept was discarded, and so Gavroche never appeared outside concept art.
It is currently unknown if he exists in the Quantic Universe.

title: Gavroche
text:
Gavroche - Appearance
Physical appearance
Based on concept art, in his civilian form, Gavroche had dark skin, dark brown hair, and golden brown eyes.
Civilian attire
He wore a green flat cap with a white horizontal stripe towards the top and a white bill. He also wore a green jacket that had a white collar and dark gray pants. Around his neck, he had yellow-orange headphones.
As Gavroche
When in his costume, Gavroche wore silver goggles with black lines over the eyes and yellow-green lenses. He appears to have worn a green and white hoodie jacket, with the hood over his head and white stripes over his shoulders and around his hood. His hands were covered with white gloves.

title: Gavroche
text:
Gavroche - Trivia
The name Gavroche is based on the character of the same name who appears in the novel/play  Les Mis.
Gavroche's assumed civilian appearance has many similarities to Nino's appearance, including skin color, eye color, and headphones worn around the neck.
His superhero attire resembles Nino's as Carapace.
According to The Art of Miraculous, there were plans for each member of the Quantic Kids to have a fairy (an early version of a kwami) who would give them their superpowers. It's unknown what is the name of Gavroche's fairy.

title: Goat Miraculous
text:
Goat Miraculous - Intro
The  is a pair of hair clips that, whenever Ziggy inhabits them, transforms the wearer into a goat-themed superhero with the power of Passion.
To activate the hair clips, the user must speak the transformation phrase: "Bleat It". To deactivate the hair clips, the user must speak the detransformation phrase, which is currently unknown.
The hair clips are currently owned by Nathaniel Kurtzberg, who uses them to transform into Caprikid. It was previously stored in the Chinese Miracle Box and only lent out to him when the situation required it. But, as of "Re-creation", he now posseses the Miraculous permanently.

title: Goat Miraculous
text:
Goat Miraculous - Appearance
In general, the Goat Miraculous is a pair of hair clips consisting of a pair of flat pieces. In charged mode, when Ziggy inhabits it, each piece is black with gray edges and details is spiraled, and looks like goat or ram horns. If a minor is using the miraculous, the hair clips start running out of power, they make a beeping sound, and the segments start discoloring one at a time as an indication of how much time (one segment is equivalent to one minute) Nathaniel (or another Goat Miraculous holder) has left.
In Season 6 onwards, the hair clips drastically change in size and appearance, being much larger, thicker, and more metallic. The Goat Miraculous now resembles large, grey horns that curved inward with a flat surface one size.
In its activated mode, the five segments are fully discolored.
In Season 6 onwards, the clips are diamond-shaped and have a gray to white color.
In its camouflage mode, the hair clips change color and form depending on whose possession it's in:
In the possession of Nathaniel Kurtzberg, the hair clips appear as a set of flat silver-gray pieces that have edges and are spiraled to resemble a pair of goat or ram horns.

title: Goat Miraculous
text:
Goat Miraculous - Appearance
In Season 6 onwards, the hair clips are appeared as a set of flat, wavy line that curves to a point at each ends.
When it was worn by Gabriel Agreste, the hair clips appeared as a set of flat silver quadrilaterals.
When it was worn by Chloé Bourgeois, the hair clips appeared as a set of silver studded hair clips.
When it was worn by Marinette Dupain-Cheng, the hair clips appeared as a series of rose gold clip-on hair bows.
In its reforged ring form, it was a thick band with a circle surface, similar to the Cat Miraculous, inside of it was the symbol of the Goat Miraculous which glowed white. It used to sit on the intermediate phalange of Gabriel's left middle finger.

title: Goat Miraculous
text:
Goat Miraculous - Abilities
The Goat Miraculous can transform its wielder into a goat-themed superhero, granting its wielder incredible powers of speed, endurance, agility, stamina, and strength.
Its special weapon is an unbreakable Paint Brush, which can be utilized as both a weapon, a communicator, and an object that can be used to breathe underwater. Its special superpower is called Genesis, which gives the user the ability to create any object they desire to obtain their goal, like defeating a villain. As long as the superpower isn't used, the wielder can remain transformed indefinitely. However, as soon as the superpower is used, the wielder loses power, and the transformation wears off in about approximately five minutes. The hair clips also can give the wielder the costume they truly desire.

title: Goat Miraculous
text:
Goat Miraculous - History
Five thousand years ago, a mage successfully helped the kwamis to interact with humans by creating magic jewels, which were called Miraculouses. In order to repay the mage, and to live on the physical world alongside humans, the kwamis decided to help humanity by letting humans utilize their energy and powers through the Miraculous they were bonded with, which included Ziggy and the Goat Miraculous.
At some point in time, all of the knowledge about the Miraculouses and their powers was written down in code in a book called the Grimoire, with very few people knowing how to decipher the code. Miracle Boxes were also created at an unknown time to store the dormant Miraculouses. To protect and distribute Miraculouses, the Order of the Guardians was formed and existed for many years. Throughout its existence, guardians trained younger generations to keep a watchful eye over the Miraculouses and the Grimoire, which were placed in the guardians' temple.
Many Goat holders throughout history used Ziggy's power for good, like Shānyáng in China, who started the legacy.

title: Goat Miraculous
text:
Goat Miraculous - History
172 years ago, after an disastrous event where a young Wang Fu used the Peacock Miraculous to create a sentimonster and his negative emotions and imaturity led to the creature rampaging through the temple and eating and destroying everything in its path, Fu was entrusted with the Chinese Miracle Box (Which included the Goat Miraculous) by a monk and was told to run away from the mess. However, on the mountain range outside the temple, in order to escape from the the monster, Fu jumped over a fissure on the ground - accidently opening the Box and spilling all of its contents on the snow. Due to his distress, Fu didnt notice he accidently left both the Peacock and the Butterfly on the mountain, alongisde the Grimoire, until it was too late and he was too far away to come back. Somewhere along the line, the Peacock got dangerously damaged, to the point of being improper for use - but, as it turns out, no one knew of this fact until it was too late.

title: Goat Miraculous
text:
Goat Miraculous - History
On a previous trip overseas with the Agrestes, Nathalie found the Butterfly and Peacock Miraculouses and gave the jewels to Gabriel. In "Representation", it was revealed that neither the Agrestes nor the Graham de Vanily couples could bear children on their own, so Émilie and Colt used the Peacock Miraculous to create Adrien and Félix respectively, but in doing so, they grew sick over time and were eventually left in a condition where they fell into an eternal slumber due to using the Peacock Miraculous in its damaged state.

title: Goat Miraculous
text:
Goat Miraculous - History
Desperate to fix his mistake, Gabriel Agreste began using the Butterfly Miraculous for evil to obtain the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses in order to gain access to their absolute power, becoming the supervillain Hawk Moth, later Shadow Moth (when unified with a now fixed Peacock Miraculous), and finally Monarch. This decision proved one of the most significant for the history of the series, as Gabriel began utilizing Nooroo's power to akumatize the civilians of Paris, France, trying to get one of them to draw out the current holders of the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses, unintenionally helping start off Marinette's and Adrien's journeys as Ladybug and Cat Noir, and later, the rest of the Miraculers.

title: Goat Miraculous
text:
Goat Miraculous - History
One of the members of the Miraculers is Nathaniel Kurtzberg, who was chosen by Ladybug in "Penalteam" to wield the Goat Miraculous, becoming the hero Caprikid. Nathaniel, from that point on, became a member of the team, helping Ladybug and Cat Noir during "particularly difficult missions". From "Penalteam" to "Strikeback", Nathaniel was a temporary holder, meaning he would only receive the Miraculous from Ladybug when he was needed for the mission, and had to give it back after the crisis was solved.
Félix, after finding out about his true origins as a sentihuman and learning that the Peacock Miraculous could erase his and his cousin's lifes if it feel into the wrong hands, orchestrated a plan to capture all of the Miraculouses of the Chinese Box from Ladybug and traded all of them (besides the Ladybug and the Cat) for the Peacock, which included the Goat Miraculous, succeeding in "Strikeback". When Gabriel unified it with the Butterfly and other miraculouses, he became Monarch.

title: Goat Miraculous
text:
Goat Miraculous - History
In "Destruction", Gabriel used a laser machine to melt down the Miraculous into a pile of dust and then reforged it into a special Alliance ring for transferring Ziggy's power of Passion to any akumatized villain who wore a regular Alliance ring. In "Re-creation", Marinette Dupain-Cheng manages to recover all of the Miraculous that were previously stolen. In "Miraculous London", Lila stole all of the Miraculous under Marinette's care in an alternate timeline, which included the Goat Miraculous, in order to render her truly powerless and to fuse the Ladybug and the Cat to gain her wish without her interference, but her plan was ultimately thwarted by the combined efforts of Chronobug and Bunnyx, and the event was erased from the timeline.

title: Goat Miraculous
text:
Goat Miraculous - History
After the events of "Miraculous London", Marinette, having realized both instances of all of the Miraculouses being stolen happened because all of them were kept in the same place, and with the idea that centralized power is inherently flawed, and that distributing it among members of a society is a far superior idea, restored and upgraded the Goat Miraculous by redesigning its original design and adding the Miraculous Call: a call feature that grants the holder the ability to summon other superheroes who possess a Miraculous from the Chinese Miracle Box in order to receive aid on their missions. This new feature is particularly useful, as the new holder of the Butterfly Miraculous, Chrysalis, is even more fearsome than her predecessor. After the alterations, the Goat Miraculous was given back to Nathaniel permanently - putting Caprikid back on the map.

title: Goat Miraculous
text:
Goat Miraculous - Trivia
Goats symbolize faith, sturdiness, and dignity.
The Goat Miraculous shares some similarities to the Ladybug Miraculous.
These two Miraculous also possess similar powers, as they can create an object for their respective holders to use in a battle, they need their weapon to activate their power, and they both use creative energy. However, the Goat Miraculous creates anything its holder can imagine, with those objects being mundane and lacking any power/magic whereas the Ladybug Miraculous gives its user exactly the object they need, and this object can turn into many magic ladybugs that fix all the damage an akumatized person or sentimonster did.
They both have two pieces, both of which need to be worn for them to work. Otherwise, the holders will slowly detransform.
The holders of these two miraculous both have artistic capabilities.
Both of their animals symbolize determination.
The Miraculous being composed of twin hair clips shaped like horns is a reference to the horns goats, rams, and sheep have.
