text:
Guiltrip - Plot
The episode starts with Miss Bustier writing on the board as the class do their own individual activities. Suddenly, Rose gets a headache and asks Miss Bustier if she can go to the nurse. Miss Bustier replies saying that they can't keep Miss Heady waiting and asks Marinette to take her to the nurse. As she accompanies Rose, Marinette asks who is Miss Heady, and if she is an imaginary friend like Lily the Unicorn Rose had in sixth grade. Rose says Heady is a nickname she gives when her head is hurting and that reminds her to never leave Mr. Brekkie, who is the most important snack for her health. Marinette replies saying she loves how Rose can see the world with rose-colored glasses, and tells her to get to class when she can and not to forget to greet Sissy, who she jokingly says is the nurse. Rose laughs and says not to worry as she won't never take too long with Sissy and enters the nurse. Marinette returns to class and says everything is fine with Rose, while Juleka looks worried.

title: Guiltrip
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Guiltrip - Plot
At lunch, when Juleka was about to eat her meal, she gets a message from Rose. When she first reads it, she's shocked at what she sees and puts her phone down. Noticing this, Marinette tries to help her and says that if Juleka skips Mr. Mealy, an energy packed lunch, Heady might have to visit her too. Juleka then runs off crying with Marinette thinking she offended her, saying it was a joke. Juleka goes into the school's basement, while Marinette is calling out for Juleka, searching for her. Shadow Moth feels Juleka's negative emotions and sends out an akuma to evilize her. Adrien enters the school and bumps into Marinette while she was looking for Juleka. Marinette apologizes and stutters, trying to explain that she is looking for Juleka and that after she joked around with her in the cafeteria, she ran off crying. Adrien points his finger to the school basement, suggesting that she might be in there.

title: Guiltrip
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Guiltrip - Plot
They go in, but Marinette accidentally trips on Adrien, but is quickly held back from falling on to him. She stutters saying that she is worried about Juleka and that she was a fool because she didn't know if Juleka was upset about something she had said. Adrien clarifies that although not all things she says makes sense, they're never mean, and there has to be another reason and goes back to looking for Juleka. Sure enough, the two find Juleka crying. As Adrien attempts to re-assure to her, Marinette texts her classmates that Juleka was in the school's boiler room, and they immediately rush over.
Marinette apologizes to Juleka and asks if she upset her.
Juleka clarifies that she is merely worried about Rose.
Marinette is confused, and she brings up the fact that Rose was okay and she just went to get some rest in the nurse's office.
She encourages her to tell her anything and promises she won't tell anyone because they were her friends.
Juleka gets her phone out and shows a picture of Rose in a hospital bed.
When her classmates arrive and are horrified by this.

title: Guiltrip
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Guiltrip - Plot
Juleka explains to them that Rose became quite sick when she was little, and the illness can return at any unexpected moment.
Nino says that Rose has always been so bubbly and happy that they never would've thought of something like this happening to her.
Juleka also explains that she promised Rose she wouldn't tell anyone, and begs them to not tell her that she told them.
Her classmates are very understanding, with several of them admitting that the secret is safe with them.
Adrien reaches out his hand to Juleka and says that it's okay that she kept this a secret, but it was too sad of a secret for her to keep it to herself.
Juleka thanks them and Marinette says that's what friends are for.
All of Marinette's classmates present hug Juleka, causing the akuma to fly away.

title: Guiltrip

Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Guiltrip - Plot
The next day, Juleka is ecstatic to see Rose again, hugging her when they first meet up at the subway. When the two reach the school, the two notice that the students are being way nicer to Rose than usual, as a result of the class finding out about Rose's condition. While Rose is confused, Juleka is irritated as the class is showing no effort to hide it. Eventually during lunch, Rose realizes Juleka has something to tell her, so the two head to the bathroom to discuss. Here, Juleka confesses to Rose that she told the class about Rose's condition. Rose is initially worried as it means nobody would treat her the same way again, but upon noticing Juleka's guilt, she immediately stops that and tells her she shouldn't have put a burden like that onto her. After the two exit, the whole class is present, and the class agrees to act normal towards her.

title: Guiltrip
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Guiltrip - Plot
However, that changes in Science classroom, where everyone is learning about diseases. Rose sneezes in the middle of the lesson, which causes the class to panic. The class is debating on whether or not to call an ambulance, until Rose snaps and reminds the class to remember the promise they made. This makes Juleka's guilt resurface, and she runs off to the bathroom to lock herself in a stall. Rose quickly runs after Juleka. Shadow Moth, sensing Juleka's pain, charges both an akuma and amok and sends it after her.
In the bathroom, Rose begs Juleka to open the door, telling Juleka that it wasn't her fault. Juleka skims through her text messages that her classmates have started sending her, and comes to the conclusion that she is the reason everyone is feeling guilty. Rose tries to convince her otherwise, but stops when she notices the akuma and amok. The amok enters Juleka's phone while the akuma enters her right lace glove, turning her back into Reflekta and summoning a sentimonster, Guiltrip. Reflekta, still feeling immensely guilty, allows herself be absorbed by the sentimonster, to Shadow Moth's horror.

title: Guiltrip
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Guiltrip - Plot
Meanwhile, Rose bursts back into Olga Mendeleiev's class, telling everyone that Juleka is on the verge of akumatization and she needs their help. Despite Olga Mendeleiev's objections, everyone in the class, except for Chloé, Sabrina and Lila, quickly rush to the bathrooms. While everyone else is investigating, Marinette gets into a locker and Adrien goes to the boys bathroom, and the two separately transform into Ladybug and Cat Noir. In the girls bathroom, Ivan manages to get the door open, but this causes the entire class to get absorbed by Guiltrip, including Ladybug and Cat Noir.
Inside Guiltrip, the duo realize that the bubbles are causing the victims to succumb to their deepest guilts, and when they're fully enveloped, the victims turn into Reflekta copies. When Cat Noir sees Nino feeling guilt for not being able to help Adrien step up to his father, it causes him to feel guilty as well and bubbles begin to envelop him. Ladybug eventually begins to stress, causing the bubbles to come close to her too. Cat Noir summons Cataclysm and attempts to use it on himself, but Ladybug stops him in time. However, knowing the odds are against them, the two give up.

title: Guiltrip
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Guiltrip - Plot
Soon after this, Rose shows up, and is excited that Ladybug and Cat Noir have arrived. Noticing their immense gloom, she begins to feel saddened as well, but due to her positive outlook on life, she manages to repel the bubbles. This gives Ladybug an idea on how to resist, telling Cat Noir why he is the best partner she could ask for, snapping him out of his despaired trance. Now knowing the two can defeat Guiltrip, Ladybug summons her Lucky Charm, which is an ice axe. Ladybug looks around and can't seem to find what to do with it. Seeing that the two are slipping back into gloomy moods, Rose begins to cheer them on, knowing they'll save Juleka. Ladybug now knows they'll need more positivity to save the day, and gives Rose the Pig Miraculous. Rose and Daizzi are both delighted to meet each other, and Ladybug tells Rose the transformation words. She transforms into Pigella, a pig-themed superhero.

title: Guiltrip
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Guiltrip - Plot
Now that the three are ready for action, they begin to swim through Guiltrip to find the real Reflekta. The trio eventually find her surrounded by countless bubbles, constantly belittling herself for making her class feel guilty. Pigella uses her superpower, Gift, in order to show Juleka/Reflekta her biggest desire: a normal day in class with nobody overreacting to Rose's condition. This gets rid of all of the bubbles surrounding Reflekta, and allows Cat Noir to use his Cataclysm on her wrist mirror. Ladybug captures the akuma, resulting in Reflekta turning back into Juleka.

title: Guiltrip
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Guiltrip - Plot
The class has now entirely turned into Reflektas, and are after Ladybug and Cat Noir. However, Pigella fights back in order to not get zapped, and then says that what matters is to find a solution rather than fight. With this in mind, everyone begins to swim their way out of Guiltrip, but the winds make it extremely hard to do so. Ladybug uses the ice axe to cling to the walls and climb like an explorer climbing on ice from Mount Everest, and eventually get back into the bathroom. She finds Juleka's phone, smashes it with the ice axe's blade, and captures the amok. For this desire, Shadow Moth warns the heroes that they may have won the day with their positivity, but they can count on him to fill the rest of their days with more negativity, the sooner they will know. Ladybug then gives Juleka a Magical Charm to protect her from Shadow Moth's future attacks.

title: Guiltrip

text:
Guiltrip - Plot
Ladybug then uses Miraculous Ladybug, turning the students and Ms. Mendeleiev back to their regular selves. Rose thanks the heroes for saving Juleka, sneaking the Pig Miraculous into Ladybug's hand in the process. When the two heroes leave the school, Cat Noir notes how Rose will not need superpowers to be a hero until Ladybug needs her.
After the whole ordeal is behind them, Marinette starts to undo all of the chaos she did at the beginning. When Rose and Marinette begin to joke around with her condition, the entire class knows that everything will be alright in the end, with the two's performance causing everyone to laugh. This causes Chloé to curiously ask why nobody laughs whenever she says something mean, and Adrien retorts that it's because she always means the harsh comments she says, which causes the class to laugh again. Rose, glad to have her old friends back, says the class will always be like this, ending the episode.

It's revealed that Rose has had an unknown illness since childhood that causes her to have headaches and bouts of vomiting that can come back at any time.

text:
Guiltrip - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in Brazil on Gloob.
The title of this episode was first revealed by Feri González through her Miraculous Mexico Twitter account on April 14, 2021.
This is the last episode where Philece Sampler voices Olga Mendeleiev.
This is the sixth episode to be named after a sentimonster, the others being "Reflekdoll", "Félix", "Ladybug," "Gabriel Agreste," and "Mega Leech".
This is the sixth episode in which Juleka was re-akumatized into Reflekta, the first one being "Reflekta", the second one being "Reflekdoll", the third being "Félix", the fourth being "Ladybug", and the fifth being "Gang of Secrets".
This is the first episode where Reflekta's clones have her copying power, instead of just Reflekta herself.
The word Guiltrip is a combination of the term "guilt trip", which is defined as an experience of feeling guilty.
It may also reference the fact that Guiltrip's purple bubbles rip the guilt from its victims, thus "guilt rip".
"Guiltrip" is also the title of a 1995 Irish film.
This is the second 11th produced episode to introduce a new hero, following "Desperada".
This is the first time neither Tikki nor Plagg were shown in an episode.

This makes Daizzi the only kwami to appear in this episode.
This episode shows one of the few times an akumatized villain goes against Hawk Moth/Shadow Moth's wishes. This time, it was Reflekta, who let herself be captured by her own sentimonster in order to go in a guilt trip voluntarily.
Ironically, what Shadow Moth told her to do ends up happening, as her friends end up being captured by Guiltrip.
When Nino is in Guiltrip, he references "The Bubbler", as he is guilty that he couldn't help Adrien stand up against his father.
This is the first time Cat Noir attempted using Cataclysm on himself.
Had Cat Noir used the Cataclysm against himself, he would not have died immediately, but would have been seriously injured, as seen in "Miraculer".
This is the fourteenth time, where Cat Noir used his powers on someone else following "Ladybug & Cat Noir", "Dark Cupid", "Princess Fragrance", "Despair Bear", "Troublemaker", "Malediktator", "Miraculous Shanghai", "Miraculer", "Cat Blanc", "Miraculous New York", "Furious Fu", "Sole Crusher" and "Queen Banana" but the eleventh time of his own free will.

This is the third time both heroes are affected by a sentimonster, following "Reflekdoll" and "Truth".
The Pig Miraculous being worn on the ankle, its ability to grant gifts that represent one's greatest desire, and Pigella's name all allude to the classic fairy tale Cinderella (known in French as Cendrillon).
Chloé also nicknames Rose "Cinderella" in "Despair Bear" with this episode possibly foreshadowing these events.
This is one of the few episodes in which both Ladybug's and Cat Noir's transformations aren't seen.
Ladybug gives the akumatized victim the Magical Charm before using Miraculous Ladybug. This leads to her giving the charm in her special suit. It's the first known time she does this.
Cat Noir is shown to know what happens when a Sentimonster is cataclysmed, seen in "Reflekdoll", "Truth", and "Queen Banana".
This is the second episode in which an akumatized villain appears, but Ladybug and Cat Noir don't fight them, as Reflekta didn't try to fight them or obey Shadow Moth's orders following "Gigantitan".
This is the second episode after "Christmaster" in which an akumatized villain voluntarily allows Ladybug and Cat Noir to destroy their akumatized object.

title: Guiltrip (sentimonster)
text:
Guiltrip (sentimonster) - Intro
Guiltrip was the titular main antagonist of the episode "Guiltrip". It was a portal-like sentimonster manifested by Shadow Moth for Reflekta from her guilt over revealing Rose's illness to everyone, causing them to treat her differently.
In the same episode, after Ivan opened the restroom door, he and his classmates were sucked by Guiltrip into a pink, pocket dimension inside its body.

title: Guiltrip (sentimonster)
text:
Guiltrip (sentimonster) - Appearance
Physical appearance
Guiltrip's body was flat and circular, with a diameter roughly the size of the door of a bathroom stall. Its body was a brilliant raspberry color and it had four roseish black triangular ornaments along the outer border of the circle. Inside of it, there was a pinkish white circle with a pale, light grayish cerise outline and a darker cerise circle in the middle of it which was surrounded by five lighter cerise vertical and horizontal stripes.

title: Guiltrip (sentimonster)
text:
Guiltrip (sentimonster) - Abilities
Guiltrip could create a strong vacuum vortex from its mouth that sucked nearby people and objects into a magenta pocket dimension inside its body. Once someone was trapped inside it, they were overwhelmed with a strong sense of guilt over their past and current regrets and failings.
It also produced two tones of brilliant mulberry and moderate heliotrope bubbles from valves on the walls on the pocket dimension that clung to the trapped victims or objects, attracted to their feelings of guilt, and once a victim was completely covered in bubbles, they turned into a copy of Reflekta and the objects had the same patterns as Reflekta, as well as making them seek to keep other people in the guilty void. They even had the same powers as the real Reflekta.
The bubbles could be repelled by positive thoughts and emotions as this could only work if a person was thinking or feeling guilty.

title: Guiltrip (sentimonster)
text:
Guiltrip (sentimonster) - Trivia
This was the second sentimonster to be created for Reflekta, with the first one being Reflekdoll from the episode with the same name.
This was the second sentimonster to possess a pocket dimension inside its body that trapped its victims, with the first one being Wang Fu's sentimonster.
In the French dub, both the episode and sentimonster are named 'Culpabysse', a portmanteau of culpable ('guilty') and abysse ('abyss').
In the Brazilian dub, the episode and sentimonster are both called "Remorso" meaning remorse in portuguese.
This was the fourth sentimonster to act on its own, following Lollipop Boy, the Dormant Sentimonster and Ladybug. This happened because Reflekta dropped her phone, the object where the amok was, in the garbage, losing control over her sentimonster.
Guiltrip's bubbles were similar to Akumas in that they were attracted to negative emotions, repelled by positive ones, and turned those they attached to into villains.
Guiltrip was the first sentimonster to not move around like the other sentimonsters as it was stuck to one of the bathroom cells.

text:

title: Guiltrip/Transcript
text:

Marinette: (backs away) Uh, sorry! I'm just so lovesick- I mean, uh- worried sick about Juleka. That's why I'm so flustered and clumsy and...  oh, I'm such a fool! I don't know if I said something to upset her earlier.

(Marinette and Adrien walk towards a corner and hear sobbing. They hide behind a wall.)

(Marinette texts everyone; Adrien notices)
Alya: It's okay!
Nino: They found Juleka!
Mylène: She's in the boiler room.
(Everyone is shocked)
All: The boiler room?!
Marinette: I'm so sorry. I really am the worst class rep ever. But I don't get it, did I say something that upset you? (Juleka looks up; her face in tears)
Juleka: It's not you, it's Rose... (continues sobbing)
Marinette: What do you mean Rose?
Juleka: (tearfully) I'm worried about her...

title: Guiltrip/Transcript
text:
Guiltrip/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Uh, no. Don't worry, she's fine. She's just resting in the nurse's office. Juleka, you know you can tell us anything. We're your friends, I promise we won't tell anyone else.
(Juleka displays her phone. It shows a photo of Rose in a bed at the hospital with cheerful emojis. She continues sobbing.)

(Most of the other students in Miss Bustier's class appear)
Everyone: She's in the hospital?!

(Alya walks over to them)
Alya: Why is she in the hospital? (The whole class is looking pitifully at Juleka)
Juleka: She got sick when she was a little girl...
(Everyone is shocked and gasps)
Mylène: She was sick when she was little?
Ivan: But it's over now, right?
Juleka: It can come back anytime...
Alix: It can come back anytime?
Nino: But she's always so cheerful! We would have never guessed...
Juleka: She made me promise not to tell you guys...
Marinette: (guiltily) Oh, of course she made you promise not to tell us.
Juleka: Please don't tell her I said anything about it..
Adrien: Don't worry Juleka, we're not going to treat her differently or anything like that.

title: Guiltrip/Transcript
text:
Guiltrip/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Rose will never know that you told us.
Markov: I'm reprogramming my conversational software as we speak in order to avoid any future reference to this unfortunate anecdote.
Kim: Even if I get bitten by a zombie-dolphin, who takes control of my brain, I won't say a thing. (zips his mouth) Never ever.
(Adrien helps Juleka get up)

Adrien: Rose trusts you and you can trust us. We won't say anything, but now we see what you're going through. And we can help you if you need.
(Everyone hugs Juleka as the akuma flies away from them)

Juleka & Rose: Hi!
(Marinette walks past)
Marinette: Hi there, girls!
Juleka & Rose: Hi!
(Marinette suddenly stops)
Marinette: Oh! (hugs Rose) I love you, Rose! I don't say it enough.

title: Guiltrip/Transcript
text:
Guiltrip/Transcript - Intro
(Mylène walks past)
Mylène: Rose, you're our sunshine here at school.
(The rest of her friends appear)
Markov: The student population's good mood rises 95 percent in your presence.

(Juleka looks nervous)

(Seeing Rose is cheerful, Juleka feels relieved.)'

title: Guiltrip/Transcript
text:
Guiltrip/Transcript - Intro
Rose: Thank you, but I actually like writing my own notes for class.

(Rose pulls Juleka towards the girls' bathroom.)

title: Guiltrip/Transcript
text:
Guiltrip/Transcript - Intro
Rose: Hey. You know what? No big deal. I'm going to take care of this I should have told them all about it a long time ago. I'll just explain everything and it'll all go back to the way it was.

(Rose sighs)

title: Guiltrip/Transcript
text:
Guiltrip/Transcript - Intro

Not ones who carry my book, bag or embroidered cushions or worry every time I go to the bathroom. (Rose holds Juleka) I don't want you to feel sorry for me because no one is happier than I am. Okay?

(Juleka smiles)

title: Guiltrip/Transcript
text:

title: Guiltrip/Transcript
text:

title: Guiltrip/Transcript
text:

text:

Shadow Moth: You may have won the day with your positivity this time, but you can count on me to fill the rest of your days with negativity, sooner than you know. (The window closes.)
Ladybug, Cat Noir and Pigella: Pound it!
(Pigella quietly leaves, Ladybug then gives Juleka a Magical Charm.)
Ladybug: Juleka, this is a Magical Charm. It'll protect you from becoming a victim of Shadow Moth ever again. (Juleka smiles) Miraculous Ladybug! (The magical ladybugs turn everyone back to normal and they all cheer)

title: Guī
text:
Guī - Intro
The  was a Miraculous holder who is featured in the Grimoire for the Turtle Miraculous. When Wayzz inhabited the Turtle Miraculous, he transformed into a turtle-themed superhero.

title: Guī
text:
Guī - Appearance
Guī had long black hair, which he braided into a braid reaching to his hips or longer, loose strands falling over his face. It is unknown if he was wearing a mask. On his head he had a non lá of light color. The super hero was dressed in a long-sleeved tunic of light green color, which he tied with a black belt at hip level. His forearms were decorated with a black cloth wrapped around his body, the end of which hung loosely from his palm. He was also wearing dark green loose trousers, which he wrapped with a black cloth at the ankles, and black shoes. In his hand he held his weapon, that is, a shield.

title: Guī
text:
Guī - Abilities
Guī used the shield, as seen in the book illustration. And assuming that Guī's powers are the same as the recent Turtle Miraculous holder (Carapace), he would have the superpower Shell-ter, that allowed him to materialize a protective barrier. He would also had enhanced skills, such as speed, strength, and - most prominently - agility.

title: Guī
text:
Guī - Trivia
Guī (龟) means "turtle" in Chinese.
He is the earliest known Turtle Miraculous holder.
He is the first known person of Chinese origin to wield the Turtle Miraculous, preceding his successor Wang Fu.
Similar to Hippolyta and Heracles, since he and the other Chinese holders were the first Miraculous holders it's likely that they knew each other.
With his cone hat, this Turtle Miraculous holder looks similar to Jade Turtle, one of the more recent Turtle Miraculous holders.
However, his hat and shield are not the same, unlike Jade Turtle's.

title: Gustave Eiffel's office
text:
Gustave Eiffel's office - Intro
is a tourist attraction located on the third floor of the Eiffel Tower and was previously a private practice owned by Gustave Eiffel.

title: Gustave Eiffel's office
text:
Gustave Eiffel's office - Appearance
Located on the third floor of the Eiffel Tower, Gustave's office is a small room that has several windows that look out onto the outside and offer exceptional views of Paris and allow visitors to see the inside.
There is period furniture, including a library full of antique books, but especially wax statues that reproduce a scene in which Gustave Eiffel and his daughter Claire receive Thomas Edison who comes to present his phonograph at the 1900 Universal Exposition.

title: Gustave Eiffel's office
text:
Gustave Eiffel's office - Trivia
Originally, Gustave Eiffel's office had a space of 100 m2, but with the need for space for the storage of electrical installations for telephones and television, this was drastically reduced to its current size.
The wax statues of Gustave Eiffel, his daughter Claire and Thomas Edison were made and are maintained by the Musée Grévin.
In fact, the office is inaccessible to the public and is only very rarely open at exceptional events or filming.
In the series, Gustave Eiffel's office is important on several occasions:
In "Zombizou", Ladybug takes refuge there with Chloé to escape Zombizou and her horde of kissing zombies.
In "Miraculous New York", Cat Noir gives a yellow rose to Ladybug in office after defeating Mr. Pigeon 51 times.
Also in the special, Ladybug will lure Doorman, who is under the Liberation of Miraclonizer, into a trap to find the key to reach the flame of the Statue of Liberty to New York City.
In "Pretension", Argos kidnaps Kagami, brings her there and detransforms to reassure her he only wanted to protect her from her mother.

title: Good Sports
text:
Good Sports - Intro
"" is the tenth episode of Miraculous Chibi.

title: Good Sports
text:
Good Sports - Synopsis
Ladybug and Cat Noir face off in a frantic sporting challenge to determine who will be the best superhero.

title: Good Sports
text:
Good Sports - Plot
The episode begins with Ladybug looking at an envelope, attracting the attention of Cat Noir.
As it turned out, the envelope contains a drawing from a fan depicting a podium on which Ladybug stands 1st and Cat Noir 2nd.
This annoys him, as he claims that he would be the best, which makes Ladybug laugh.
Cat Noir turns his attention to the water fountain, which strongly resembles a podium.
The superheroes decide to race each other to the fountain, jumping off the roof and to the ground.
Their first obstacle is getting across a long road of traffic by jumping on top of the cars, passing the entrance to the Métro, which takes the form of the first finish line.
Cat Noir proves be the fastest and wins, with Ladybug clumsily falling into the tunnel.
They then reach the canoes and buoys on the Seine, so they jump into boats and rush to the other shore.
Cat Noir temporarily speeds ahead yet again, however, due to his inattention, does not notice the large ship he crashes into.
This allows Ladybug to sail to the finishing destination first, and sticks out her tongue cockily at Cat Noir, who swims to shore.

title: Good Sports
text:
Good Sports - Plot
The next obstacle is a tall wall; Ladybug climbs up it whilst Cat Noir wins by extending his staff.
He lands on the other side gracefully, and an exhausted Ladybug falls down awkwardly.
Noticing a crowd of pigeons, they begin to imitate acrobatic skills to get across it, however, Cat Noir collides into one of pigeons.
In the last test, desperate to win, Cat Noir begins to attacking with his weapon.
Ladybug, likewise, defends herself with a stick, and they briefly fence with each other, but he quickly disarms her by drawing a heart in the air for her, distracting her.
Running to the fountain, Ladybug jumps on top of Cat Noir's head and pushes him away, landing on the top podium of the fountain.
However, when she sees her partner upset that he lost, she holds out her hand for him, and a smitten Cat Noir joins her on the podium.
In the end, they stand on the fountain victorious, but water gushes out of the podiums, throwing them into the air.

title: Grendiaper
text:
Grendiaper - Intro
"" is a season 6 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 14th written and produced episode of season 6. It is also the 145th written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Grendiaper
text:
Grendiaper - Synopsis
TF1+
While Zoé searches for a way to stop the malicious people she encounters from doing harm, Ladybug and her team find themselves facing a series of strange events in Paris. In addition to confronting a particularly vengeful supervillain, our superheroes, the Miraculers, will have to hunt down a mysterious masked vigilante with unconventional methods.
Disney Channel
While Zoé looks for a way to stop ill-intentioned people on her path from doing evil, Ladybug is faced with a series of strange events in Paris.
Disney+
Ladybug is faced with strange events in Paris.

title: Grendiaper
text:
Grendiaper - Plot
Zoé and Pollen are getting ready for a new school year, but Zoé comes down to find André struggling to open up the theater because of his fears no one will come to watch the films because of the Internet. Thanks to Zoé's encouragement, André unlocks the doors, and wishes Zoé well as she heads out to school at Collège Françoise Dupont. Meeting up with Marinette, Alya, Adrien, Rose and Mylène, Zoé is soon dragged away by Kim to find herself face-to-face with an old bully from New York City: Ray.
Later, Sabrina sees a video from Chloé regarding her new appearance and Chloé calls it "Ridiculous.
Utterly ridiculous".
Marinette and the other girls, Nino and Adrien discover Chloé's message about Sabrina.
Zoé apologizes to Sabrina about Chloé.
They decide to post their own videos on the Zoo to show their support of Sabrina's new appearance.
Nevertheless, Ray and his buddies cause trouble around school by littering and refusing to clean it up, irritating Zoé.
Then they refuse to let Sublime take the elevator, take Sabrina's textbook, and write some disrespectful words on the bottom of Marinette's cake box for Adrien.

title: Grendiaper
text:
Grendiaper - Plot
Zoé can't interfere without Ray threatening to expose her past in NYC to everyone as blackmail.
Luckily, Zoé decides to report Raymond, Loïc Stompet, and Nelson de Glusset's actions to Principal Denis Damoclès and the principal decides to call their parents.
But Ray has already called his father.
Ray's father, Mr.
Pugnant, arrives, and Ray and his buddies get off without punishment thanks to his intervention.
When Zoé sees this, she begins to become frustrated and upset over this sense of injustice.
Marinette notices her crying and attempts to reassure her, with her kind-hearted words managing to cheer Zoé up and put her at ease.

title: Grendiaper
text:
Grendiaper - Plot
However, despite the pep talk from Marinette to cheer her up, things only gets worse when she sees other people can also be selfish, disrespectful, and inhospitable to others: a boy named Sam who doesn't like babies play loud music, causing the baby to cry, so Zoé and Sabrina find another seat for the mother away from Sam before Sabrina gets out of the tram at her stop; the tram driver doesn't stop to allow a man with a boy in a wheelchair to climb aboard, despite Zoé's protests; and Bob Roth reserves a street, preventing an old lady from entering her apartment building.
When she returns home, André is being threatened by three thugs over demanding their money back after watching one of his films, along with other benefits, and especially, no more musical films. Angered at this, Zoé ducks into another room, and has Pollen transform her into a new appearance, nicknamed Fury. However, when she sees André work out a compromise with the thugs and they leave satisfied, she powers down. Concerned for recent events, she decides to contact Marinette so they can talk as Vesperia and Ladybug. Despite Ladybug's advice, Vesperia is still unsure of what to do.

title: Grendiaper
text:
Grendiaper - Plot
Finally, fed up with what she's seen as the last straw, Zoé becomes Fury to deliver justice to everyone that she saw being disrespectful, inhospitable, and selfish, including the tram driver, Bob Roth, the thugs intimidating André, and Ray and his buddies.
However, her actions draw the attention of Max when he sees her go after the tram driver, and he contacts Marinette.
When Ladybug and Cat Noir meet up with Pegasus, he shows them the video he recorded of what happened to the tram driver.
Ladybug soon gets calls for help from Carapace, Rena Rouge, and Miss Hound as well through the Miraculous Call as they also help the other victims to Fury's actions, with Rena Rouge helping the tram driver when he's found at the zoo, fearful he was about to become panther chow, though Otis Césaire assures him the panther's enclosure was surrounded by glass to protect visitors, and Miss Hound rescues Ray and his goons from the roller coaster, only for them to run off afterwards in fear, while the park manager wonders what happened when the amusement park was closed for the night.

title: Grendiaper
text:
Grendiaper - Plot
Finally, as if things weren't not bad enough, they soon find an Akumatized supervillain attacking Paris, the Grendiaper; which reveals that Chrysalis has akumatized Sam by his negative emotions of embarrassment, anger and frustration.

title: Grendiaper
text:
Grendiaper - Plot
After an attempt to destroy the cellphone on Grendiaper's chest to find the Ultrakuma fails, Ladybug uses her Miraculous Ladybug to repair it and find out the truth. The video they look up on the Zoo reveals that Sam is the Akumatized victim, and Miss Hound confirms this. In the video, Maya, who is his younger sister, asks Sam if he's seen their baby sister Sofia's diapers, as he is secretly cutting them up for his own sadistic amusement. Sam complains, and Maya says he's been mean ever since their baby sister was born. It is then that Fury appeared, paralyzed him, cut the feed, and when it returned, Fury had punished him for cutting Sofia's diapers with dressing him up like a baby and humiliating him on the Zoo, enraging him enough for him to be Akumatized by Chrysalis. Now knowing who is the victim, Ladybug summons another Lucky Charm of Matryoshka Dolls, hinting that Sam is inside Grendiaper, piloting it. She also summons additional aid from Vesperia.

title: Grendiaper
text:
Grendiaper - Plot
With help from Rena Rouge using Mirage to create an illusion of Fury to draw Grendiaper's attention, this gives Ladybug and Cat Noir a chance to immobilize Grendiaper thanks to Vesperia using Venom and Cat Noir uses his Cataclysm to open the head to reveal Sam in the cockpit. Ladybug restrains him with her yo-yo, while Cat Noir destroys the console, freeing the Ultrakuma for Ladybug to catch and purify, before using her Miraculous Ladybug again to repair all the damage following her first use of it. In her lair in La Plage, Cerise voices her frustration at Ladybug over how she's not going to give up trying to defeat her as she writes in one of her journals.

title: Grendiaper
text:
Grendiaper - Plot
Sam is still annoyed and upset at his humiliation, but while Vesperia tries to avoid hinting she was responsible, nevertheless, Ladybug tells her the difference between talking it out and performing vigilante justice to fix the problem. Ladybug also pointed out that Fury's actions created more problems and how you can't teach people kindness by hurting them back. Despite Ladybug's advice, Sam appears unwilling to listen. Only a stern scolding from Cat Noir gets him to come around and promise to talk it out to his family and his baby sister Sofia from now on before he leaves with his Magical Charm given to him by Ladybug. After Sam leaves, there's still concern among the Miraculers about Fury and whether she could be the new Butterfly Miraculous holder or not. Although Vesperia offers a "Pound It" fist-bump, none of the other Miraculers are in the mood to share it. After some discussion, Ladybug, Cat Noir, Rena Rouge, Pegasus, and Miss Hound depart, leaving Vesperia behind as she appears remorseful that her behavior had caused all of this because of her sense of injustice.

title: Grendiaper
text:
Grendiaper - Plot
When Zoé returns to the theater the next morning, the three thugs from before are intimidating André again, but this time, he brought help in the form of Nora Césaire, whose threat of using her kickboxing moves on the guys cause them to back off, terrified of her wrath, much to Zoé's relief. When she sees Ray and Nelson trying to bully the garbage man as he does his job, luckily, Roger arrives to tell them off and let the garbage man continue his duty, satisfying Zoé that justice can prevail and she doesn't need to be a vigilante to make it happen.

title: Grendiaper
text:
Grendiaper - Plot Developments
It's revealed that André Bourgeois has stopped managing his hotel and has since bought and restored the theater, as well as moving in there with Zoé. It's unknown if he still owns the hotel or if he sold it.
It's also shown that Zoé was adopted by André, whom she now sees as her father, even calling him "Dré-Dré".
Several interactions and statements, including the reaction to Zoé's new appearance, show that the cold opening in this episode takes place before the previous season 6 episodes, at the start of the new school year.
This opening shows that Zoé met Ray again for the first time in Paris right during the first day of the new school year, meaning their interaction at the end of the episode "Daddycop" happened after this.
It also shows that Ray already met his two friends, Loïc and Nelson, before encountering Zoé again.
During the episode's cold opening on the first day of school, Sabrina can be seen wearing her seasons 1-5 outfit and sitting by herself, since it takes place before "Daddycop", when she is accepted by Marinette and her friends and changes her look.

title: Grendiaper
text:
Grendiaper - Plot Developments
Chloé seems to still follow Sabrina's on her account on Zoo, and, having not learned anything from the previous seasons, especially "Revolution", tries to demean her by insulting her new appearance since "Daddycop" in a post, but Zoé, Marinette and their other friends make posts of their own praising Sabrina's appearance to support her and oppose Chloé.
Ray, Nelson and Loïc are shown to mistreat and play awful pranks on anyone they want, not just couples like in "Sleeping Syren" and "Vampigami".
It is revealed that Ray's father, who first appeared in this episode, thinks his son's behavior makes him a 'leader', with him even complimenting his son's actions.
To prevent Zoé from interfering with his bullying, Ray is shown blackmailing her with the video that showcases Zoé's time when she was pretending to be mean. He first did it at the end of "Daddycop" and did again in "Vampigami".
Marinette comes to learn that Ray was the one who bullied Zoé back in New York, the bullying being first mentioned in "Sole Crusher".

title: Grendiaper
text:
Grendiaper - Plot Developments
The Miraculers are able to call for Ladybug (and possibly Cat Noir) by just tapping at their Miraculous. Both Zoé and Max are shown doing that, with the former calling Ladybug to seek her advice and the latter to call for Ladybug and Cat Noir after he witnessed Fury kidnapping the tram driver.
After seeing so much unfairness happening around her, including towards André, Zoé's frustration and desire to punish bullies unlock a new transformation with her Bee Miraculous other than her normal Vesperia one. With this transformation, she becomes Fury, a vigilante that uses her superpower to punish bullies through either humiliation or putting them in a critical situation.
This vigilante version of her has already appeared previously in "Sleeping Syren", during the post-endcard scene where she confronts Ray and his friends as they planned to tear another couple apart, showcasing that, chronologically, this episode happens before that.
Zoé is the fifth Miraculous holder to adopt a side identity with the same Miraculous, following Alya as Rena Furtive during Season 4, Adrien as Cat Walker in "Kuro Neko", Gabriel as Monarch in Season 5 and Marinette as Chronobug in "Miraculous London".

title: Grendiaper
text:
Grendiaper - Plot Developments
Her vigilante persona's appearance has caused the rest of the Miraculers (unaware that's her) to consider that she can be possibly the new Butterfly Miraculous holder.
This is the second time Cat Noir stops a runaway Ferris wheel with his staff, following "Anansi".
It's revealed that Maya, the little girl that was akumatized in "The Illustrhater" into the titular villain and whose dad owns Café Crème, has an older brother called Sam and a baby sister called Sofia.
Due to receiving a lack of attention because of the new baby, Sam is shown hating babies to the point of enjoying making them cry whenever he has the chance.
Besides working at the school, Nora has also started to work at André Bourgeois' movie theater as his assistant, with her main job being to chase away troublemakers.

title: Grendiaper
text:
Grendiaper - Trivia
On September 4, 2025, Ezra Weisz posted a story from a recording session for the episode.
For an unknown reason, the episode name is written in capital letters in the title card.
The episode shares an interesting similarity with "Transmission": both feature Zoé using a hero identity other than Vesperia, and a giant "immature" akumatized villain, who's akumatized off-screen after being humiliated.
This is the first episode of the entire series where Tikki doesn't physically appear and isn't mentioned.
Despite calling Ladybug as well because of Fury's actions, Carapace does not appear or help in the fight against the titular villain. It's possible that he went to deal with the other emergencies caused by the vigilante, presumably saving Bob Roth, who gets stuck on top of the Eiffel Tower.
References
The movie that Fury makes the three ruffians watch is similar to the 1965 musical film The Sound of Music.
The name "Grendiaper" and its French version "Couchorak" are a reference to the 1975 anime UFO Robot Grendizer (Goldorak in French).
Errors
Sublime is shown with the surname "Bartlett", instead of "Varlette" on Zoo.

title: Grendiaper
text:
Grendiaper - Trivia
It's possible this was caused by the fact that in the English dub, Marinette's pronunciation of the surname in "Sublimation" sound like "Bartlett", which led to confusion prior to the release of the episode's French dub.
When Sam walks towards the woman with the baby on the tram, his phone case is all black.
Throughout the episode, Fury is shown being able to move at superhuman speeds when paralyzing her victims. However, according to Thomas Astruc, this is a misunderstanding of the original intention, which was for the paralyzations to be shown from the victims' perspectives, so the screen would cut between the characters at their original location and the place Fury moved them to.
During the scene at the zoo, Cat Noir appears to have six fingers on his right hand.
In one scene, Rena Rouge's Miraculous is missing its texture.
When Ladybug talks to Miss Hound about justice on the roof, the light from the buildings changes, becoming a bit brighter.
When Adrien opens the box with the tart, the shadow inside glitches.
When Cat Noir confronts Grendiaper at the end and mocks him, some of his hair clips into the back of his neck.

title: Grendiaper/Transcript
text:
Grendiaper/Transcript - Intro
Zoé: (Looking at herself in the mirror) Soo, Pollen... beanie or no beanie?
Pollen: Regardless of your choice your beauty will light up the first day back at school, my queen.
(Zoé holds Pollen close to her cheek.)

(She leaves her room and goes downstairs with Pollen floating beside her) I just can't wait to see everyone again! Hold on, Pollen, hide. There must be someone here for the matinee.
Zoé: Hm?
(Zoé looks at André with concern as he is in the process of removing the lock to open the door.)

Zoé: (Grabs André's arm) You can't throw in the towel now. We promised each other that this new year would be different, that we'd never bury our dream in a cellar again.

title: Grendiaper/Transcript
text:
Grendiaper/Transcript - Intro
Zoé: You don't become successful by trying to do what everybody else is doing, but by being genuine. Have faith in yourself. Besides, it's time to show Paris how hard we've worked, don't you think?
(André looks at Zoé and smiles, then unlocks the doors to the cinema, and they both open the doors together and hug each other.)
André: (Hugging Zoé) You have a good first day at school, too, Zoé, dear.
(Zoé smiles at André and starts walking toward the school.)
Mylène: Yeah, and dad and I went camping in the South, and we went canoeing in rivers. It was so amazing.
Marinette: (Notices Zoé) Zoé? (The group looks at Zoé) Whoa, you look like a movie star.

Adrien: We'll be there.
Zoé: Oh, I'm so happy to see you all again.
(The six of them hug each other. But they are interrupted by Kim, who is running towards the group.)
Kim: Zoé! Zoé! You're from New York City, right? In the US, right?
Zoé: Uh, Yeah?
(Kim grabs Zoé by the hand and pulls her inside the school.)

title: Grendiaper/Transcript
text:
Grendiaper/Transcript - Intro
Kim: (While leading her) Come on, you got to meet this new guy. He's awesome. (Inside the school, Kim leads Zoé to a group of three people) Ray, here's the girl I told you about. She's from New York City, too.
Zoé: (Gasps) Ray?!
Ray: (Smiling) Zoé. (Lifts his sunglasses) It's a small world.
[ Theme Song ]
(Chloé is talking about a photo of Sabrina's new look.)

(Sabrina turns off her phone, closes her eyes, and lowers her head in sadness.)
(A group consisting of Marinette, Adrien, Sublime, Nino, Zoé, Rose, and Juleka approaches her.)
Marinette: Sabrina, what's wrong?
Sabrina: I knew I shouldn't have uploaded this.
Zoé: I'm so sorry. To think that she's my sister... I wish I could put a padlock on her mouth!
Rose: Don't let her ruin your day. I love your new look. You're beautiful.
Marinette: (Takes out her phone) That's right. We can't let Chloé have the last word. (Puts one arm around Sabrina and uses the other to lift her phone and record a video) Hi, everyone. I wanted to show you my friend Sabrina's new look. It's creative, bold, in one word, stunning (Stops recording and uploads the video).

title: Grendiaper/Transcript
text:
Grendiaper/Transcript - Intro
Rose: Amazing! (Takes a photo with Sabrina) "Sabrina, my friend, and my fashion inspiration of the day." (Meanwhile Nino takes a photo with Sabrina too) and posted (Uploads the photo).
Sabrina: (Looking at all the photos) Thanks, friends. It feels nice to be supported.
Marinette: (To Zoé) Easier than a padlock, don't you think? And just as good at shutting Chloé up.
(Zoé smiles as she looks at the photo she took with Sabrina on her phone, only to be almost knocked over by Ray bumping into her, causing her to drop her phone on the ground.)
Zoé: Ah!
(Zoé grabs her phone from the floor and stands up glaring along with her friends at the group of Ray, Loïc and Nelson.)
(Ray throws a napkin on the ground as he walks away.)
Nino: Hey, pick up your napkin, dude.
Ray: (Still walking) Why should I? People are paid to do it.
Nelson: It creates jobs.
(Zoé picks up the napkin from the ground while glaring at Ray's group.)
Zoé: Sometimes what you need isn't a padlock, but some handcuffs.
(Sublime calls the elevator, but when it arrives, Ray, Loïc, and Nelson get in before her.)
Nelson: Sorry, my dear. but there's no more room.
Loïc: Hehaha! (The elevator's door closes).

title: Grendiaper/Transcript
text:
Grendiaper/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (Angry) Those three should really-! (Stops what she was going to say after noticing Sublime)
Sublime: Take a walk?
(Marinette and Zoé look at each other, surprised by what Sublime said. Sublime starts laughing at their reactions, making Marinette and Zoé laugh with her.)
Marinette: You took the words right out of my mouth.
Zoé: You're amazing. How can you laugh when they're being so mean?
Sublime: I try not to give them too much importance.
(Zoé smiles at that.)
(Inside the classroom, Ray is searching through his bag but doesn't find what he's looking for.)
Ray: (Puts his hand up to Nelson) Nelson, Book.
Nelson: Got a textbook problem? Let's learn from the most bookish one of us then, shall we?
(Loïc blocks Sabrina from entering the classroom.)
Loïc: Hey, you, give me your book, now.
(Loïc takes Sabrina's book and hands it to Nelson, who passes it to Ray.)
Zoé: (Gasp)
(Zoé watches this from her seat and looks at them angrily. But Ray looks back at her, smiling, making her look down.)
(Sabrina sits beside Zoé.)
Zoé: Forget them. We can share mine.
(Sabrina smiles at Zoé.)

title: Grendiaper/Transcript
text:
Grendiaper/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: It just needs one final touch. (Goes to Nino's table, while Nelson is looking at her) Do you have any ribbons left?
Nino: Yeah.
Nelson: (Whispers in Loïc's hear) Write a mean message in the box.
(Nelson gives him a red crayon and Loïc smiles. Zoé sees Loïc sneaking up to Marinette's tart, carefully lifting it up and writing something underneath where it was in the box.)
Marinette: (On Nino's table) I don't know which one to pick between the two.
(Zoé gets angry and approaches to stop Loïc but is intercepted by Ray.)
Ray: Don't do it, cockroach. Unless you want everyone to find out what you did in New York City (Holds up his phone).
(Zoé looks at the phone and becomes uncertain. Meanwhile, Loïc finishes writing on the box and leaves before Marinette can see him.)
Marinette: (To Nino) Thanks for your help. I couldn't decide.
(Ray and Loïc go to their tables, leaving Zoé looking between them and Marinette, not knowing what to do.)
Marinette: (Closes the box and puts a blue ribbon on top of it) There.
(Marinette grabs the box and leaves with it. Zoé attempts to intervene, but stops herself before doing so and looks down.)

title: Grendiaper/Transcript
text:
Grendiaper/Transcript - Intro
(Adrien opens Marinette's box and sees the heart-shaped dessert inside.)
Adrien: Wow! (Grabs the tart and gives it a bite) Oh! It's absolutely delicious, Marinette.
(Zoé spies on them from behind a tree and is about to step in to stop them from seeing the message on the box, but before she can, she notices Ray watching her from behind a nearby flower arch as he shows her his phone. This makes Zoé recoil and hide again with her head down.)
Adrien: (Reading the text on the box) "Adrien, my love for you is like this tart. The only thing left of it are a few crumbs"?
Marinette: (Scandalized) Huh?!
Adrien: This is awful!
Marinette: Ah?! (Looks inside the box) I didn't write this! (Stands up and gestures frantically) I have no idea how it got here, I promise!
Adrien: Don't worry, Marinette. (Stands up and hugs her) I know you wouldn't write that. But who would do such a cruel joke?
(Zoé hears them talking behind the tree, Pollen comes from her hiding place.)
Pollen: Aren't you going to do something, my queen?
Zoé: I can't Pollen... (Gets an idea) But there is someone who might.

title: Grendiaper/Transcript
text:
Grendiaper/Transcript - Intro
Denis Damoclès: Young men, I was handed a list of wrongdoings you've been accused of. If this is accurate, this kind behavior is unacceptable. I'm sorry, but I have no other choice but to call in your parents.
Ray: Hm. Don't bother. (Holds his phone up) I've already called my father.
(Ray's father enters the office.)
Denis Damoclès: Mr. Pugnant?
Mr. Pugnant: So, Raymond, what's this all about?
Denis Damoclès: Well, I-I-I have a list here.
(Mr. Pugnant grabs the list from Damoclés's hand.)
Mr. Pugnant: (Reading the list) Hmm? Ha! This one is excellent.
Denis Damoclès: Rather unacceptable, if you ask me.
Mr. Pugnant: (Lets the list fall to the ground) Speaking of unacceptable, that tree in the yard, it prevents me from landing my chopper. I'm counting on you to deal with it. Come on, Ray, we're leaving.
Ray: It was a pleasure, Mr. Damoclés.
(Damoclés just looks down as they leave.)
(Outside, Zoé is sitting on a bench in the hallway close to the entrance, watching them leave.)
Mr. Pugnant: (Laughs) I didn't think you had it in you to be a leader, but you're finally starting to show real potential, son.
Zoé: (Surprised) No way! But how?!

title: Grendiaper/Transcript
text:
Grendiaper/Transcript - Intro
(Distraught, Zoé puts her hands on her face and weeps. Meanwhile, Mr. Pugnant and the group leave in a chopper that was parked at the school's entrance. After a while, Marinette approaches Zoé and sits next to her.)
Marinette: Something wrong, Zoé?
Zoé: (Crying) I can change continents, yet nastiness will still follow me everywhere!
Marinette: They remind you of the people who hurt you back in New York, don't they?
Zoé: (Shakes her head) It's worse than that, Marinette.
Marinette: Don't tell me, Raymond... (Gasps) is the boy who bullied you?
(Zoé uncovers her face and looks at Marinette with her eyeliner smudged. Suddenly, she hugs her tightly and cries on her shoulder.)
Zoé: Why can't we do anything about people like that?!

title: Grendiaper/Transcript
text:
Grendiaper/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: We can always do something, Zoé. We can learn to recognize them and protect ourselves from them. We can join together with the ones we love and stop them from hurting people. (Zoé calms down) And we can be an example of a better and kinder world. (Puts her hands on Zoé's shoulders) Look at everything you've already accomplished. You've learned how to believe in yourself, and they can no longer hurt you unless you let them. (Zoé smiles) What matters now is to keep their darkness from extinguishing the light inside of you.
Zoé: (Wipes away her tears and eyeliner with her sleeve) You're right. Thanks, Marinette.
(Inside the tram, Zoé and Sabrina sit together on the tram seats, in front of them sits a mother with a baby sleeping in her arms.)
Sabrina: Thanks for letting me share your book earlier. That was very... kind of you.
(A boy wearing a red jacket sits next to the woman with the baby.)
Zoé: Anytime, Sabrina.
(The boy named Sam smiles as he turns up the music on his phone, causing the woman's baby to cry.)
Sam: (Takes a selfie with the crying baby) That's one more!
Zoé: (angry) What are you doing?! You think this is funny?!
Sam: It's hilarious. I don't like babies.

title: Grendiaper/Transcript
text:
Grendiaper/Transcript - Intro
(Zoé and Sabrina escort the mother and her baby to another seat.)
Sabrina: Come with us, ma'am. There's some room over there.
Sam: That's right, get lost with your little monster. He's too loud anyway.
Zoé: I can't believe someone could be so unkind!
Sabrina: Where did he learn to act that way?
(The mother smiles at Zoé and Sabrina after calming down her baby.)
Sabrina: Ah, this is my stop. (Exits the tram) See you tomorrow, Zoé.
(Zoé waves her goodbye. Meanwhile in the background, a man pushing a boy on a wheelchair hurries trying to reach the tram station.)
Man: Hold on! Hold on! Wait! Wait!
(Zoé notices the man, but the Tram's doors close on her face.)
Zoé: (To the Tram driver) Sir, someone wants to get on!
(The Tram driver just scowls and ignores her, starting the Tram and leaving the man and boy at the station.)
Man: Wait! Stop! Wait for us!
Zoé: We can't just let them there!
(The Tram passengers, hearing Zoé, look down, but do nothing about it, leaving Zoé frustrated.)
Bob: (With a megaphone) Don't worry about the lyrics, just smile for the camera.
(XY smiles and starts striking a bunch of poses.)
Intern: (Whispering to Bob) This lady lives here, can I let her inside?

title: Grendiaper/Transcript
text:
Grendiaper/Transcript - Intro
(Zooms in on an elderly woman behind the bars of the set. The bars block her from entering the apartments.)
Bob: Hey, intern, can't you see we're in the middle of shooting? If we stop we'll be wasting time, and time is money.
(Zoé watches this happen from the Tram's window as it drives away and gets upset.)
Bela Bruty: We don't like musicals, we want our money back.
Denis Gaud: And a refund and popcorn.
(Zoé sees three men talking with André inside the cinema and hides behind a wall close to the entrance to hear them.)
André: But gentlemen, you’re the ones who chose to see this film.
Jean-Phi Loup: Would you rather we make a scene and scare your other costumers off?!
André: (Shakes his head) No, no, no, no, no, no scene please, there's no need for a scene.
(Zoé frowns angrily at this last straw, and decides to enter the cinema through the back door.)
Zoé: (Closes the door) Enough is enough! (Lifts Pollen to her face) We're up, Pollen.
Pollen: Are you sure we're the ones who should intervene, my queen?
Zoé: (Frustrated) We can't just stand by again! Pollen, Buzz on!

title: Grendiaper/Transcript
text:
Grendiaper/Transcript - Intro
(But instead of transforming into Vesperia, her costume is now completely black with a hood that covers her hair, and a mask that covers her entire face, leaving only her now yellow irises visible.)
(Zoé looks at her new suit, confused. Then the voice of André talking with the thugs draws her attention, she opens a little of the door to the reception to hear better.)
André: Gentlemen, I empathize with your complaints. The customer is always right, so let me offer you a month of free cinema.
Denis Gaud: And popcorn to go with it?
André: Of course!
Jean-Phi Loup: What about the drinks?!
(Fury frowns.)
André: (Laughs nervously) Drinks are of course complementary. My pleasure.
Bela Bruty: (Taps André on the shoulder.) There, now there's a movie theater with some great costumer service. See ya tomorrow then.
Denis Gaud: And no more musicals.
André: Of course, looking forward to it, gentlemen.
(The three thugs leave the cinema.)
(Fury closes the door through which she was eavesdropping on the conversation and detransforms. She then walks towards André as Zoé.)
André: (Notices Zoé) Ah! Ahem! I guess you saw all of that, Zoé dear.

title: Grendiaper/Transcript
text:
Grendiaper/Transcript - Intro
Zoé: Why did you agree to their demands?! They had no right!
André: I don't have a choice, if I don't do what they tell me to do they'll scare my customers away (André walks away with his head down).
(Zoé watches him leave and frowns, looking down.)
(Pollen comes out of her hiding place.)
Zoé: Pollen, my suit looked nothing like it usually does. How is that possible?
Pollen: You've had a rather... dark day. Your suit can change depending on your emotional state.
Zoé: Maybe, it's just so frustrating (Tosses her school bag on the floor) doing nothing when people act so badly! What's the point of being a Superhero if I don't stop them! (Gets an idea) You know what? I think is time to ask for advice.
(Zoé presses on her hair brooch to call someone.)
Ladybug: Vesperia, why did you call me? (Sits down next to her) Everything okay?
Vesperia: Ladybug, what are the rules for Miraculous holders? You said that unless it's an akumatized villain, we can help out without waiting for you to call on us. So, we're allowed to stop people from doing evil things, right?
Ladybug: Yes, definitely. If someone is committing harm, it's your right and your duty to act.

title: Grendiaper/Transcript
text:
Grendiaper/Transcript - Intro
Vesperia: But we're only reacting. Just earlier, three evil men were harassing Dre Dre, and threatening to do even more harm! What we need is a way to protect them from doing it ever again!
Ladybug: Well, if they do come back, you step in to keep them from being harmful.
Vesperia: What if they come back again after that?
Ladybug: Then you stop them again.
Vesperia: What if they just keep wanting to come back and be bad!?
Ladybug: I'm sorry, but no one has the magic power to make people good. That's the power of education. We, however, have the power of defense.
Vesperia: (Sad) Okay...
Ladybug: Are you going to be alright?
Vesperia: Yes, I just... needed to talk it out. Thanks, Ladybug.
(Ladybug smiles and swings away, leaving Vesperia to sadly look down on the rooftop.)
Bob: If this is the best you can do, I'll tell everyone how inept you are!
Hairdresser: But Mr. Roth, I haven't even started cutting your hair.
Bob: And you better not if you can't-!
(A flash of yellow light appears suddenly, interrupting what he was about to say, and takes him away, leaving him clinging to the top of the Eiffel Tower.)

title: Grendiaper/Transcript
text:
Grendiaper/Transcript - Intro
Bob: -even make my hair grow! (Looks down and holds onto the top tighter) Huh?! HEEEELP!!!
Ray: (Yawns) Faster, Loïc. This is going too slow.
(Roger is chasing them in his police boat.)
Roger: (With a megaphone) Stop in the name of the law! You're not old enough to pilot this vehicle!
Nelson: Everything is in order, Mr. Officer. Loïc just turned 18.
Loïc: Hehehe, that's right! I've repeated the same grade for 4 years already! Hahaha! Happy Birthday to me!
(Nelson pours a bottle of shampoo into the water behind their boat, producing several pink bubbles.)
Roger: Hm? Oh!
(Roger enters the bubble cloud and when he comes out, he has a beard and a hat made of bubbles that make him look like Santa.)
(Ray, Nelson and Loïc laugh, but a yellow streak of light appears and takes them away, the streak of light leaves them tied up in a cart on a roller coaster.)
Ray, Nelson and Loïc: Hahaha! (They realize where they are and the roller coaster starts) Hmm? AAAAAH!!!
Bela Bruty: Mmmm, that Pizza looks good. Can I have a slice?
Pizza Delivery person: But you didn't order it.
Bela Bruty: Come on, just a slice. Don't be a- (A ray of yellow light passes behind him as he gets frozen in place.)

title: Grendiaper/Transcript
text:
Grendiaper/Transcript - Intro
Jean-Phi Loup: Just wait until-! (The same happens to him)
Denis Gaud: It's not rocket sci-! (Him too)
Pizza Delivery person: (Surprised) Wha!?
(Fury looks at him from behind Denis and gestures a shushing notion at him.)
Fury: Shhh.
Bela Bruty: -pest! Uh?
Jean-Phi Loup: -til! Uh?
Denis Gaud: -ence! Uh?
(The movie begins, and it's a musical.)
Movie: Let me tell you a tale! Of a world where good people prevail! When-!
Bela Bruty: Not a musical!
(The other two just whine and groan in panic and dismay while watching and listening to the music of the movie.)
Max: (To the tram driver) Hey, that was my stop!
Tram Driver: My shift is over. I'm going home.
Max: But what am I supposed to do?!
Tram Driver: Well, you can always call a streetcar. Hahahaha! That's a good one, ha. "Streetcar"... Whoa!!
(A ray of yellow light takes him away.)
Max: Huh?
(Max sees Fury jumping across buildings, carrying a frozen Tram Driver.)
Max: (Wide eyes) Did you see that, Markov?
Markov: Affirmative. We have a huge system error on our hands.
(Max touches his glasses and calls Ladybug.)
Marinette: Pegasus?
Pegasus: The driver wouldn't let us out and this person... Uh, this superhero... showed up!

title: Grendiaper/Transcript
text:
Grendiaper/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: But where did they take the driver?
(Ladybug receives calls from the Miraculous of the Fox, Dog, and Turtle.)
Ladybug: Alerts are coming from all over the city!
Otis: I found this man on my night watch.
Tram Driver: I have no idea how I got here. I came to and suddenly I was here, face to face with a panther. I thought it was going to charge at me.
Otis: Good thing our pens are enclosed by unbreakable glass.
(Ladybug and Cat Noir look at each other with thoughtful expressions.)
Ray, Loïc, and Nelson: AAAAAH!!!
(Miss Hound finds them and throws her ball at them, the ball hits all three of them and returns to her.)
Miss Hound: Fetch!
(The three are teleported off the roller coaster and appear on the ground safely next to Miss Hound hugging each other. Realizing that they are not on the roller coaster anymore, the three run away from the area, yelling.)
Ray: You better tell me what's going on!
Nelson: Loïc was behind the wheel!
Loïc: I didn't do anything!
(Ladybug, Cat Noir, Rena Rouge, Pegasus and Miss Hound are talking with the Park manager.)
Carny: The rides were closed. I have no idea how they got here.

title: Grendiaper/Transcript
text:
Grendiaper/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: Looks like this mysterious masked person moved all these people from one location to another.
Miss Hound: Why?
Pegasus: And mostly, how?
Cat Noir: No idea. Don't ask me how!
(The ground begins to shake. In the distance, Grendiaper can be seen towering over the buildings of Paris; and it reveals that the butterfly holder has akumatized Sam for embarrassment, anger and frustration because of Fury's devious actions.)
Grendiaper: (Roaring in frustration)
(The Park manager runs away, while Ladybug, Cat Noir, Rena Rouge, Pegasus, and Miss Hound rush to stop Grendiaper.)
Grendiaper: Have you seen this person?
(Scared, the couple shake their heads in denial. In response, Grendiaper rips out the Ferris Wheel from its mount and throws it away.)
Ladybug: Look out!(The Ferris wheel heads right towards the Miraculers, but they manage to dodge it.)''
(The Ferris wheel continues rolling down the streets, Cat Noir follows it and extends his staff between two buildings, using it as a barrier to stop it.)
(Pegasus using Voyage pulls all passengers out of the Ferris wheel and moves nearby civilians, Ladybug guides them to take shelter inside the underground train station.)

title: Grendiaper/Transcript
text:
Grendiaper/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: Take shelter in there! You'll be safe until we've stopped that... (Takes a look at Grendiaper crawling through the streets) baby?
(Grendiaper grabs two cars from the street, one with a passenger inside, and shakes them.)
Grendiaper: Show me where they are or I'm going to be super-duper mad!
(Ladybug and Cat Noir run and jump across rooftops, following Grendiaper.)
Ladybug: Seems like our little buddy is also looking for someone!
Cat Noir: Think it could be the same mysterious masked figure we're after?
Ladybug: Better find out before he has a full-blown tantrum, Kitty Cat!
(Ladybug and Cat Noir leap toward Grendiaper. Ladybug grabs Grendiaper's arm with her yo-yo, preventing him from hitting a building.)
Grendiaper: (Points his free arm at her) Rattle Punch!
(Grendiaper fires a rocket shaped like a baby rattle that explodes on impact. Ladybug dodges it using her yo-yo to escape from the roof.)
Ladybug: Ahh!
(Ladybug, Cat Noir, Rena Rouge, Pegasus, and Miss Hound gather and run towards Grendiaper.)
Grendiaper: Rattle Punch!
Pegasus: Voyage!

title: Grendiaper/Transcript
text:
Grendiaper/Transcript - Intro
(The Rattle Punch is intercepted by a portal, another portal appears next to Grendiaper's head, and the Rattle Punch comes out of it, hitting him.)
Grendiaper: Ah!
(Ladybug makes a trip wire with her yo-yo, making Grendiaper trip and fall.)
(But when Miss Hound, Cat Noir, and Rena Rouge are about to attack Grendiaper while he is on the ground, he lets out a supersonic baby cry, creating a shockwave that sends them flying back and makes them cover their ears before they go deaf of hearing loss!)
Grendiaper: (Shrieking loudly in high pitch)
Rena Rouge: Ugh!
Chrysalis (Grendiaper's mind): Careful, Grendiaper. Don't damage their Miraculous before you seize them!
Miss Hound: (Stops covering her ears) Hmm? (Sees a phone on Grendiaper's chest) Where have I seen that phone before?
(Ladybug and Cat Noir land and recover from the shockwave.)
Cat Noir: (Rough landing) Urgh! Ugh! Woo! That baby robot is solid steel!
Ladybug: Yes, we need a little toy to keep him busy. Lucky Charm!
(The Lucky Charm gives her a phone protector.)
Cat Noir: You shouldn't let babies play with phones, M'lady. Am I right?

title: Grendiaper/Transcript
text:
Grendiaper/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: You're right, Kitty Cat. Especially if the phone's got an Ultrakuma inside. (Touches her earring) Miss Hound, you're up!
(Miss Hound throws her ball toward the phone on Grendiaper's chest, but he uses another supersonic cry to prevent the ball from touching him.)
(Ladybug and Cat Noir run towards Grendiaper, jumping across rooftops. Cat Noir leaps forward, extending his staff and throwing it at the villain. The staff splits in two and begins to glow green as it spins like a saw.)
Grendiaper: Orb Beam!
(Grendiaper shoots two lasers from his eyes that destroy the staff-saws approaching him.)
(Ladybug ties her yo-yo to Grendiaper's headband and delivers a devastating kick to his head. When she lands on the villain's arm, he tries to grab her, but she jumps to avoid him. However, while she's in the air, Grendiaper's other hand reaches out and grabs her.)Chrysalis (Grendiaper's mind): That wretched Ladybug is keeping you from pursuing your quest for justice. Seize her Miraculous!Grendiaper: I don't like ladybugs!Cat Noir: I'm coming, Bugaboo! Cataclysm!

title: Grendiaper/Transcript
text:
Grendiaper/Transcript - Intro
(Cat Noir uses Cataclysm on the ground, causing Grendiaper to fall into a hole. The fall makes him drop Ladybug, who takes advantage of this to quickly escape with her yo-yo.)
(Ladybug, Cat Noir, Rena Rouge, Pegasus, and Miss Hound regroup on a rooftop away from Grendiaper.)Pegasus: Voyage!
(Taking advantage of Grendiaper being trapped in the hole, Pegasus opens a portal that gives a direct view of the phone on Grendiaper's chest. Miss Hound throws her ball through the portal and hits the phone.)Miss Hound: Hm. Fetch! (The phone appears in her hand)
(Miss Hound shows the phone to Cat Noir and he uses cataclysm on it.)Cat Noir: Cataclysm!
(The phone breaks and Miss Hound lets it fall to the floor, but the Ultrakuma doesn't come out.)Cat Noir: No Ultrakuma?Ladybug: How is that possible?
(Grendiaper manages to climb out of the hole and grabs a building, searching for Fury.)Grendiaper: In there? Huh, guess not. (Sends the building flying into the air.)
(Grendiaper began to hurl several buildings into the air, but just as they were about to hit the ground, they were intercepted by Pegasus portals.)Pegasus: (Follows after Grendiaper) Urgh! Voyage! Voyage! Ugh! Voyage!

title: Grendiaper/Transcript
text:
Grendiaper/Transcript - Intro
(Cat Noir prepares to follow him, but Ladybug stops him.)Cat Noir: Huh? What should we do, M'Lady?Ladybug: It's pointless to chase him until we figure out how to defeat him.Rena Rouge: At least we know the Ultrakuma wasn't in his phone. Ladybug: (Takes the phone protector out) Wait a minute. Of course! The phone was empty, because we weren't supposed to break it. (Throws the phone protector into the air) Miraculous Ladybug!
(The Lucky Charm transforms into a swarm of ladybugs that repair all the damage caused in battle, including the phone.)
(Ladybug turns on the phone, enters its gallery, and finds a video.)Ladybug: What could be in here that's supposed to help us?
(The video thumbnail shows an angry Sam.)Cat Noir: This must be our akumatized guy.
(Ladybug plays the video. In the video, Sam is inside a room cutting a diaper with scissors.)Sam (Video): (Mockingly) Wah. Wah. The world revolves around me and my tantrums. (Grabs another diaper from a pile.)Miss Hound: (Gasp) I know that boy! He enjoys scaring babies on the bus, that's why the phone looks so familiar!

title: Grendiaper/Transcript
text:
Grendiaper/Transcript - Intro
(In the video, a little girl, Maya, enters the room where Sam is. He hides the diapers and scissors from her behind his back.)Maya (Video): Sam, have you seen Sofia's diapers? Mom can't find them.Sam (Video): (Angry) She can just use the toilet, like everyone else!Maya (Video): (Angry) You've been super-mean since Sofia was born!Sam (Video): So what? Babies are the only thing that matters in this family anymore.Maya (Video): (Angry) But you're being a baby right now! (Closes the door)
(Sam tries to cut the diapers again, but a ray of light appears behind him; when he turns around, a second ray freezes him. Fury appears in front of the camera and the signal cuts out.)

title: Grendiaper/Transcript
text:
Grendiaper/Transcript - Intro
(When the video starts again, Sam —now unfrozen— finds himself inside a baby cage in the middle of the Eiffel Tower. He is wearing a diaper, has a pacifier in his mouth, and a teething toy in his hand as the crowd watches in amusement. Noticing the phone, he immediately gets up and cuts the transmission.)Cat Noir: That's how he got akumatized!Ladybug: Yes, and now we know for sure that he's after the same person as we are.Miss Hound: Some kind of masked vigilante.Ladybug: Except humiliation and harassment have nothing to do with justice.Cat Noir: Since it wasn't his phone, where's the akumatized object?Rena Rouge: That's all he has on him.Ladybug: We must have missed something... Lucky Charm! (The Lucky Charm gives her a Matryoshka doll) Ah! (Opens the matryoshka doll and finds another smaller one inside) Hm? (Does it again and finds an even smaller one inside) Wait, what you're seeing is not the akumatized villain. title: Grendiaper/Transcript
text:
Grendiaper/Transcript - Intro
(The civilians inside the Eiffel Tower scream in fear.)
Grendiaper: Wah! Wah! Wah! Go ahead and cry! I don't care, just tell me where to find the person who dressed me up like a baby!
(Grendiaper grabs one of the Eiffel Tower's supports and throws it into the air.)
(Luckily, Pegasus, who was following closely behind, manages to intercept the fall with a portal, putting the tower back in its original place. With no major damage, the tower's lights turn on again.)
Pegasus: Voyage! Urgh! Ah!. (Heavy breathing).
(Pegasus recovers his breath, and continues chasing Grendiaper.)
Ladybug: Thanks for coming so quickly, Vesperia. Rena Rouge, you're going to create an illusion that looks like the masked person from the video.
Rena Rouge: The one he's after, got it!
Ladybug: Once he comes over to try and grab her...
Miss hound: He'll forget about everything else!
Ladybug: And we'll step in!
Cat Noir: (Bows) Still as brilliant as ever, M'Lady.
(The Miraculers separate to carry out their roles in the plan.)
Miss Hound: (Lands next to a chimney close to Grediaper) Yoohoo! Look what I found! (Points to the illusion of Fury).

title: Grendiaper/Transcript
text:
Grendiaper/Transcript - Intro
(Fury's illusion waves to Grendiaper and then turns around and runs away.)
Grendiaper: (Runs after Fury) There you are!
(Rena Rouge smiles behind a chimney, seeing that the illusion worked. Ladybug gives Pegasus a signal, and he creates a portal.)
Pegasus: Voyage!
Ladybug: You're up, Vesperia.
(Vesperia jumps inside the portal and uses her power.)
Vesperia: Venom!
(The portal teleports her above a distracted Grendiaper. Vesperia successfully lands on his shoulder and freezes him with Venom.)
Cat Noir: Cataclysm!
(Cat Noir appears and uses Cataclysm on Grendiaper's head, revealing that the human Grendiaper was inside a cabin, controlling the robot.)
Cat Noir: So, kiddo, you need a babysitter?
Grendiaper: Leave me alone!
(Ladybug arrives and ties up Grendiaper with her yo-yo while Cat Noir uses Cataclysm on the robot's control panel.)
Cat Noir: Cataclysm.
(The Ultrakuma comes out of the destroyed control panel.)
Ladybug: No more evil doing for you, Ultrakuma. (Opens her yo-yo) Time to de-evilize! (She catches the Ultrakuma) Gotcha! Bye bye little butterfly. (Releases the now white butterfly) Miraculous Ladybug!

title: Grendiaper/Transcript
text:
Grendiaper/Transcript - Intro
(The swarm of ladybugs make the robot disappear and put Sam on the ground.)
Cerise: You think you have the power to fix everything, Ladybug? But you couldn't be more wrong! No one has that power.
Ladybug: (Creates a Magical Charm and gives it to Sam) You got akumatized because you let your bad feelings win, Sam. You have to learn how to love your baby sister even if she requires a lot of attention from your parents. We all need other people's love, but if you want to receive, you also have to give. Do you understand?
Sam: No fair! It's not my fault! The bad guy's that masked person! The one who made me look like a baby!
Vesperia: That's a lie! (Gets close to Sam) I've seen videos of you on Zoo! You were bothering mothers and their babies! (Looks at Ladybug) Are we going to let him get away with it?
Ladybug: Would you rather we did the same thing to him as the mysterious person who harasses people? Then we'd be just like them.
Vesperia: If that means punishing bad people, I don't see a problem.

title: Grendiaper/Transcript
text:
Grendiaper/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: Maybe it'd make us feel better to punish them, but look at what happened today. The masked person's actions only brought about more violence. You don't teach people to be kind by hurting them back.
Vesperia: (Looks away) Hmm...
Ladybug: (Looks at a bored Sam) And you, don't do things to others that you wouldn't like done to you.
Sam: (Rolls eyes) Haaah... Yeah, Yeah, okay.
Cat Noir: (Stern tone) I wouldn't be smiling if I were you. What you did is not something to be proud of. (Comes face to face with Sam) I'd seize this chance to make amends. From now on, behave yourself, okay?
Sam: (Looks down and nods) Okay.
(Sam leaves to go home to apologize to his family and his new sister Sofia.)
Ladybug: (To Vesperia) See? It's better when you talk things through.
Cat Noir: Even though you've got to be firm sometimes.
Vesperia: (Smiles) Pound it?
Ladybug: There's still someone in town we have to stop.
(Vesperia looks at Ladybug surprised.)
Miss Hound: Yes, the masked person. Maybe he's the new holder of the Butterfly Miraculous.
(Hearing that, Vesperia is feeling down.)
Rena Rouge: He or she. Could be. Maybe they're trying to anger people so they can akumatize them.

title: Grendiaper/Transcript
text:
Grendiaper/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: Maybe, maybe not. What's for sure is that we're going to have to be more cautious than ever.
(Everyone except Vesperia leaves the area, while Vesperia remains staring at the ground.)
(Seeing them, Zoé hides behind the wall near the entrance to listen to them.)
Bela Bruty: Where's the free drinks?
André: Look, I'm not sure. You... should speak with my new assistant.
(André points his thumb toward the snack shop, revealing that Nora is the assistant.)
Nora: (Smiling) What you want, fellas? Some soda? Tea? Maybe some fruit punch?
(Seeing her, the thugs shrink back in fear. Zoé smiles when she sees this and leaves.)
(Zoé sees Ray and Nelson on a moped, repeatedly honking at a garbage collector who is blocking their way while doing his job harassing him at her window.)
Ray: Move it! Some of us have to work!
Pollen: What should we do, my queen? Wait until nightfall?
(Roger arrives and blows his whistle to scold Ray and Nelson.)
Roger: In the name of the law, leave these people in peace at once! They're working too.
(Zoé smiles, seeing that the situation has been resolved.)
Zoé: I think we're good for today. (Closes her window's curtains)
