title: Great Pyramid of Giza
text:
Great Pyramid of Giza - Intro
The , also known as the Pyramid of Cheops or the Pyramid of Khufu, is the largest of the Pyramids of Giza and Egypt. Built during the Fourth Dynasty of the Old Kingdom, it is the heart of the funerary complex of Khufu and is the last of the Seven Wonders of the World to remain today.

title: Great Pyramid of Giza
text:
Great Pyramid of Giza - Description
Built around 2570 BC, the Pyramid is the first and largest pyramid in the Giza Necropolis.
The last of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World, it is a square-based pyramid with sides of approximately 230.5 meters, more precisely 230.384 meters at the south, 230.329 meters at the north, 230.407 meters at the west, and 230.334 meters at the east, thus missing a perfect square by a few degrees.
It currently stands 137 meters tall, having lost more than nine meters since its construction due to erosion.
The Great Pyramid of Giza is a tomb forming part of the funerary complex of Khufu. It is believed to be the final resting place of Pharaoh Khufu. It is surrounded by the Queens' Pyramids and a satellite pyramid, and was part of a funerary complex that included a temple and several mastabas.
Its many architectural peculiarities and the feats achieved in its construction make it a unique pyramid that continues to challenge research.

title: Great Pyramid of Giza
text:
Great Pyramid of Giza - Trivia
The Pyramid of Cheops has been a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1979 under the title "Memphis and its Necropolis - the pyramid areas from Giza to Dahshur.
The Great Pyramid's ancient name was Akhet Khufu (Khufu's Horizon).

title: Great Sphinx of Giza
text:
Great Sphinx of Giza - Intro
The  is a monumental therianthropic statue that stands in front of the Pyramids of Giza, Giza, Egypt.

title: Great Sphinx of Giza
text:
Great Sphinx of Giza - Description
Built around 2500 BC on the Giza plateau, the Sphinx of Giza is the world's largest monolithic monumental sculpture, measuring 73.5 meters long, 14 meters wide and 20.22 meters high, carved from a natural promontory 40 meters high.
Carved from different layers of limestone, the Sphinx can be described as a chimera, the union of the god Ra by the body of a reclining lion with the head of the Pharaoh Khafre, or Khufu, wearing the nemes headdress, with the forehead adorned with a uraeus.
Throughout its existence, the Sphinx has undergone numerous alterations, notably wind erosion of the head and water erosion of the body, in addition to repeated burying in sand. It has also suffered acts of degradation, the most famous being that of its nose.

title: Great Sphinx of Giza
text:
Great Sphinx of Giza - Trivia
In Arabic, the Sphinx of Giza is called أبو الهول (Abou al-Hôl) which means "the father of terror".
In "Evolution", Bunnyx photographs herself in front of the Sphinx several centuries after its construction.
The Sphinx is in perfect condition and is not buried under the sand.
According to some researchers, the climate of Giza was not yet arid at the time of the construction of the Sphinx in 2500 BC, but more closely resembled a savannah-like climate.

title: Golden ladybug earrings
text:
Golden ladybug earrings - Intro
The  are a pair of earrings believed to belong to Fen Cheng.
In "Secret Protocol", Cerise, impersonating Wang Cheng, gave them to Marinette to convince her to remove what she believed to be the Ladybug Miraculous.

title: Golden ladybug earrings
text:
Golden ladybug earrings - Trivia
It's important to note that it's currently impossible to determine whether these earrings actually belonged to Fen Cheng.
If this were true, Cerise would have stolen them during her visit to the Thousand Delights restaurant.
If this were false, she would have purchased them from a jewelry store to carry out her plan, as she did in "Volpina" with her Fox Miraculous-themed necklace. This could be backed up with the fact that Sabine expressed genuine surprise at learning that the earrings supposedly belonged to her grandmother.
Ladybugs and the name Fen are related.
In Chinese culture, a ladybug landing on you, or two people seeing a ladybug at the same time, is a manifestation of Yuan Fen (缘分), the invisible bond that unites two souls destined to meet.

title: Heracles
text:
Heracles - Intro
(also known as Herakles and Hercules) was the greatest of the Greek heroes with the secret identity as a superhero. He was a past Miraculous holder, but it is unknown which Miraculous was his.
In "Feast", Alya theorizes that he used to carry the Lion Miraculous.

title: Heracles
text:
Heracles - Appearance
Heracles was well-built, and was quite muscular.
Heracles had a seemingly black beard and hair, and he wore a skirt and Greek sandals. He also wore a lion's pelt as a cape, with the lion's head being a hood. He also wore a wristband of some sorts. To transform, he owned a Miraculous.

title: Heracles
text:
Heracles - Abilities
When transformed, Heracles had enhanced physical abilities, a tool, and a special superpower.

title: Heracles
text:
Heracles - Trivia
Heracles appears in a painted vase at the beginning of "Ladybug & Cat Noir".
Given the myths that both he and Hippolyta are in together, they presumably knew each other in the Quantic Universe. These myths also claim the two were lovers (and in some versions, betrothed to each other) until Hera's machinations turned the Amazon army against him, resulting in Heracles killing her (whether intentionally or by accident depends on the version) possibly making this the first time two Miraculous holders opposed each other.
In Miraculous: Les Aventures de Ladybug et Chat Noir, a French comic adaptation of "Ladybug & Cat Noir", Heracles' depiction on the painted vase is replaced by hieroglyphics of an unknown Miraculous holder.
Heracles' appearance is a reference to one of twelve labor challenges involving him to slay a lion and wore it's pelt.
The real world myths of Heracles associate him with three distinct items, all of which could be associated with a Miraculous in some ways. These are the already-mentioned Lion's Pelt (which granted invulnerability), an indestructible war club and a bow-and-arrow that could not possibly miss a target.

title: Hand Fan
text:
Hand Fan - Intro
The  is the tool of the Peacock Miraculous.
The current owner of the hand fan is Félix Fathom after he acquired the Peacock Miraculous in "Strikeback". He uses the hand fan after being transformed into the superhero Argos.
It was previously occasionally used by Nathalie Sancoeur when she used the Peacock Miraculous to become the villainess Mayura, and by Gabriel Agreste when he became the villain Shadow Moth.

title: Hand Fan
text:
Hand Fan - Appearance
The fan is comprised of eighteen blue peacock feathers, resembling the spreading fan tail of a peacock when fully unfurled. The barbs of each feather's shaft have been mostly stripped away, leaving only the eye of the feather. The eye is dark blue with a light pink spot in the middle. The top edging of each feather includes small white cotton feathers. When not in use, the holder usually keeps the fan in their hand or somewhere on their suit.

title: Hand Fan
text:
Hand Fan - Abilities
The white feathers on the fan can be plucked to be turned into an Amok by Amokization. These feathers can be magically directed to a target over a distance, but otherwise have the same physical properties as normal feathers. The fan can also be used to speak to other Miraculous holders.
In "Pretension", it's revealed that similar to Cat Noir's staff, Monarch's cane or Vesperia's top, Argos' fan can break into multiple pieces as Argos used said pieces to spread his scent around making Matagi Gozen unable to track him. Argos also uses it to swat aside a Venom arrow fired by Matagi Gozen, showing that it can deflect attacks like Ladybug's yo-yo and Cat Noir's staff. In the same episode, the fan can be used for cutting, but if used on a thick material, the feathers will come off, making it easy for an enemy to locate the user.

title: Hand Fan
text:
Hand Fan - Trivia
The hand fan was first revealed when concept of Mayura holding it was in a sneak peek at a Miraculous panel at New York Comic Con 2016.
It's the fourth Miraculous tool to be revealed to be able to be used for communication, following the Ladybug Miraculous' yo-yo, the Cat Miraculous' staff, and the Bee Miraculous' spinning top.
Hand fans exist as a real-life martial art style based on the use of a metal-ribbed hand fan, or tessen, known as tessenjutsu.

text:

"" is a Season 3 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 25th written and produced episode of Season 3. It is also the 77th written and produced episode of the series, overall.
This episode is also the first part of the two-part Season 3 finale, "The Battle of the Miraculous."

title: Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1)
text:
Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1) - Synopsis
At a celebration for their twentieth anniversary, the Bourgeois couple is akumatized into Heart Hunter, a two-headed Cerberus that devours love.
Disney Channel
The Bourgeois couple gets akumatized; Ladybug and Cat Noir faces the Bourgeois couple; Now Hearthunter, a Cerberus with two heads constantly fighting each other, they devour all the love in Paris. Ladybug seeks the help of Master Fu.
Disney+
Ladybug faces the Bourgeois couple, now Hearthunter.

id: Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1)::Plot::0
title: Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1)
text:
Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1) - Plot
The episode begins with Marinette narrating about how everybody experiences different kinds of losses.
As Marinette leaves to deliver some macarons to her parents at The Grand Paris, she runs into Luka outside. Luka tells her that he's finally found the tune that matches Marinette. He plays it for her and then gives her a ride to Le Grand Paris on his bike.
At The Grand Paris, André and Audrey Bourgeois are celebrating their 20th wedding anniversary. Gabriel presents them, via Nathalie, with The Gabriel Couple Cloak he designed himself as a gift for them. The couple put it on and begin to bicker.
Marinette enters the hotel to deliver the macarons to her parents who are catering the celebration. She passes by Adrien, Kagami, Tomoe, and the Gorilla and promptly trips. Kagami and Adrien rush to help her out. After the three of them deliver the macarons, Sabine asks Marinette to take the empty trays; Tom asks her to bring them some drink umbrellas; and Adrien asks if he and Kagami can help her.

id: Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1)::Plot::1
title: Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1)
text:
Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1) - Plot
As Marinette sets about her tasks, Adrien and Kagami have a mock fencing battle in the kitchen. Tomoe realizes that the children have been gone for a long time and sends the Gorilla to find them. He enters the kitchen; Adrien and Kagami hide; and Marinette innocently asks if he's looking for something. As Marinette starts to head back out to her parents, Adrien and Kagami convince her to escape with them. The three of them escape to the roof as Nathalie is sabotaging Chloé's bee signal. When the Gorilla comes up to the roof, Adrien grabs both of the girls' hands and jumps into the pool, which has been converted into a ball pit, with them. The three of them have fun in the ball pit. Amidst the fun, Marinette's hair comes out, and Adrien comments that it's the first time he's seen her with her hair down.
Nathalie sneaks to the stairwell and calls Gabriel, telling him phase two is complete. Hawk Moth sends an akuma to the Bourgeois couple.

id: Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1)::Plot::2
title: Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1)
text:
Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1) - Plot
Adrien starts playing piano on the roof. Marinette proceeds to put her hair back into pigtails when Kagami and Adrien tell her she looks beautiful with her hair down. The Gorilla comes back up to the roof, and Marinette uses her hair elastic to distract him. They then flee the hotel. As they flee, the akuma finds André and Audrey, which transforms them both into Heart Hunter, two headed monster who devours love. Chloé runs to the roof to activate her bee signal. After watching her leave, Nathalie transforms into Mayura. She hides on the roof and watches as Chloé discovers her sabotaged bee signal.

id: Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1)::Plot::3
title: Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1)
text:
Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1) - Plot
After running out of the hotel, Marinette, Adrien, and Kagami happen upon André's ice cream care and decide to get some ice cream. André proposes three options for the trio and then asks which ice cream combination they will be getting. Adrien and Kagami defer to Marinette's judgment who asks André if she can find a blend for the three of them. André says that while he can, too many flavors may throw off the balance of the ice cream. Marinette eventually decides on the first combination and leaves Kagami and Adrien to eat their ice cream together. Kagami asks Marinette to come with her, but Marinette denies the offer saying that she can handle it alone and leaves. Adrien comes back with ice cream and asks where Marinette is, to which Kagami says she is gone, much to Adrien's surprise and disappointment.

id: Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1)::Plot::4
title: Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1)
text:
Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1) - Plot
As Marinette walks back to the hotel, she breaks down crying and becomes heartbroken that now the one whom she loved has been loved by another. While heading back to the hotel, she sees Heart Hunter and transforms into Ladybug. Hawk Moth and Mayura watch the battle from a rooftop, hoping Ladybug will seek the Guardian. Ladybug summons her lucky charm and receives a carousel token, telling her to go to the merry-go-round. When she arrives, she sees Master Fu and then notices that Mayura has followed her. She takes off trying to ditch Mayura. When she thinks she has, she returns to the merry-go-round. Master Fu points out that she didn't transform back, but she assures him that she wasn't followed. She takes the Dragon Miraculous. After she leaves, Hawk Moth confronts Fu, much to the latter's horror.

id: Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1)::Plot::5
title: Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1)
text:
Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1) - Plot
Ladybug gives the Miraculous to Kagami, who laments that she is afraid to hurt Marinette, who is the only friend she has. She is afraid to hurt her if she'll ever pursue Adrien. Kagami explains that she and Adrien are made for each other and she will not let him go, even for the sake of friendship. Ladybug realizes she feels sorry, disappointingly tells that making choices is hard, as Kagami says that they have a job to do as the girls then transform.
Back in Place Des Vosges, Hawk Moth throws Fu to the ground, takes Miracle Box, and asks Fu who Ladybug and Cat Noir are and he'll leave him alone, but Fu refuses and the old man transforms into Jade Turtle (despite Wayzz's reluctance and objections to his master due to his old age) and prepares to battle Hawk Moth. Jade Turtle starts mocking Hawk Moth for being unsuccessful in getting the Miraculous, which makes Hawk Moth angry enough to attack him as Jade Turtle fights Hawk Moth. He actives his Shell-ter, and Hawk Moth and Mayura double team him, causing his shell-ter to crack.

id: Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1)::Plot::6
title: Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1)
text:
Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1) - Plot
Chloé is still on the rooftop in patiently waiting for Ladybug, until she sees that Ladybug already has an ally, becomes upset over the decision. She insists that she needs to save Heart Hunter, because they are her parents.
While Ladybug, Cat Noir, and Ryuko fight Heart Hunter, Chloé becomes furious and throws her bee signal off of the roof, losing her hope. Much to her surprise, Hawk Moth arrives and tries to convince Chloé to join him. Chloé is reluctant at first, because he is the one who akumatized her parents. Hawk Moth asks what Ladybug has done for her, since Chloé was the one who trusted Ladybug the most as a fan. Chloé decides that Ladybug doesn't trust her to be the holder of Bee Miraculous, she joins the dark side and finally agrees. Chloé tells Hawk Moth that she'll wear Bee Miraculous, but in case, if Hawk Moth de-akumatizes her parents first. Hawk Moth accepts these conditions.

id: Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1)::Plot::7
title: Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1)
text:
Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1) - Plot
Ladybug summons her lucky charm. As she comes up with her plan, Hawk Moth de-akumatizes Heart Hunter. Ladybug and Cat Noir save André and Audrey, and Ladybug uses her Miraculous Ladybug to restore the city. Ladybug, Cat Noir, and Ryuko are confused when Heart Hunter becomes de-akumatized by itself. Hawk Moth akumatizes Queen Bee into Miracle Queen. While this is happening, Kagami gives Ladybug back the Miraculous. Once she leaves, she transforms back into Marinette and she goes to find Fu to give him back the Miraculous, but, much to her shock, Fu's gone. She becomes worried, but Tikki tells her not to worry because Master Fu is very wise, he can be anywhere.
Meanwhile, Adrien finds Kagami and asks what happened. Kagami says that Ladybug took her away because the villain was going after people who were in love. The two begin to kiss.
Back with distraught, Marinette leaves the park. Luka finds her and asks if she is okay. Marinette breaks down crying, explaining that she is "tired of putting up a front all the time". Luka sympathetically walks over and comforts heartbroken Marinette.

title: Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1)
text:
Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1) - Plot Developments
This episode reveals that Miraculous tools can be akumatized, with Queen Bee's Spinning Top becoming Miracle Queen's akumatized object.
In "Mayura", it was proven that Miraculous tools could be amokized, as the titular villain actually used the remains of Hawk Moth's cane to form the giant butterfly sentimonster.
As of this episode, Chloé Bourgeois is now an ally of Hawk Moth and is enemies with Ladybug and Cat Noir willingly.
As of this episode, Pollen becomes the third kwami being used for evil by her holder without an akuma, following Nooroo and Duusu.
The mistake Marinette makes is that she went to see Master Fu while in costume, allowing Hawk Moth to discover his whereabouts and gain the Miracle Box.
She also chooses the Dragon Miraculous to give to Kagami instead of the Bee Miraculous to be given to Chloé for personal reasons, even without Nathalie having to sabotage Chloé's Bee Signal, destroying her trust in Ladybug.
Ironically, if Marinette had detransformed, then Hawk Moth would've likely discovered her identity leading to both her and Master Fu being in serious trouble.

id: Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1)::Trivia::0
title: Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1)
text:
Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1) - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in Ukraine on PlusPlus.
Some earlier sources called the episode "Loveeater", which is a translation of the French title.
This is the first time Wang Fu transforms into Jade Turtle.
Excluding "Miraculous New York" special, this is the last episode that the Ladybug transformation theme that has been used since "Stormy Weather", with a new theme being used from "Truth" onwards.
This is the sixth time that Alya doesn't make an appearance in any way, following "Riposte", "Reverser", "Sandboy", "Weredad" and "Silencer".
This is the second time Marinette is seen with her hair down, following "Cat Blanc".
However, this is the first time in the current timeline.
This is the third time the Bourgeois couple are akumatized. However, unlike their previous akumatizations in "Style Queen", "Malediktator", and "Mayura" they get a new villain identity, Heart Hunter.
Coincidentally, each of these episodes is part of a special.
This trend is broken in "Mega Leech" and "Optigami".
This is the fourth time more than one person is akumatized at the same time with the same akuma, following "Sapotis", "Oblivio", and "Félix".

title: Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1)
text:

This is the third time two people are akumatized at the same time with the same akuma, following "Sapotis", and "Oblivio".
This is the first time at least one of the people who are akumatized with the same akuma is not part of the Césaire family.
This is the fourth time Chloé gets akumatized, following "Antibug", "Queen Wasp" and "Mayura".
However, unlike her previous akumatizations, Chloé doesn't get akumatized into Antibug or Queen Wasp, but instead into a new villain, Miracle Queen.
This is the third time that Chloé is akumatized with the activated Bee Miraculous.
The mistake Marinette makes is that she went to see Master Fu while in costume, allowing Hawk Moth to discover his whereabouts and gain the Miracle Box.
She also chooses the Dragon Miraculous to give to Kagami instead of the Bee Miraculous to be given to Chloé for personal reasons, even without Nathalie having to sabotage Chloé's Bee Signal, destroying her trust in Ladybug.
Ironically, if Marinette had detransformed, then Hawk Moth would've likely discovered her identity leading to both her and Master Fu being in serious trouble.

id: Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1)::Trivia::3
title: Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1)
text:
Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1) - Trivia
However, Ladybug wanted Cat Noir to Cataclysm the streetlamp, but since Hawk Moth de-akumatized Heart Hunter, it was never needed.
This is the third time Hawk Moth doesn't utilize a light mask when akumatizing a villain, following "Cat Blanc", and "Ladybug".
This is the second time Marinette kissed Luka, following "Frozer".
The pictures of Ladybug Adrien looks through on his phone are from "Stormy Weather", "Darkblade" and "Copycat".
This is the third time a visual representation of Marinette's thought process and her strategic planning is shown despite her not being transformed.
Next to "The Kwamis' Choice" and "The Final Day", this is the only episode in a two parter to have an end card.
Ladybug tells Cat Noir she can't be in love with him, referencing "Cat Blanc" in which she learned that their love would lead to the end of the world.
Unknown to her, in "Cat Blanc", it wasn't her and Adrien's love nor him knowing Marinette's identity that caused what happened it was actually Gabriel and his feelings that caused all of it.
In "Ladybug", Marinette is likely blaming herself and Cat Noir for something they didn't even do.

id: Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1)::Trivia::4
title: Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1)
text:
Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1) - Trivia
Hawk Moth's transformation theme is changed once again, being different from every previous one.
Excluding "Miraculous Shanghai" special, as it chronologically takes place before this episode, this marks the final appearance of Hawk Moth's transformation sequence.
Mayura's transformation theme is changed back to the original theme from "Reflekdoll".
When Cat Noir says that it hurts that Ladybug isn't giving him a chance without knowing it, he's actually doing the same thing to her by not giving "the guy" she loves a chance to be with her.
Similar to "Gang of Secrets", Marinette didn't need to break up Adrien and Kagami as they were going to in "Lies" because of Adrien's duties as Cat Noir.
This is the ninth time where Ladybug's Lucky Charm is an object from a previous episode following the token coin in "Mr. Pigeon".
The scene of Ryuko detransforming is reused from "Ikari Gozen".
The animation of Ladybug reaching to grab a Miraculous is reused from "Style Queen".
Errors
When Marinette gets out of the swimming pool, some of her hair clips through her jacket.
In a few shots, some of the feathers of the Hand Fan are light green.

title: Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1)
text:
Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1) - Trivia
For some reason, just before the akuma emerged from the heart-shaped brooch, the Palace of Westminster with the Big Ben could be seen reflected in it.
In the scene where Audrey was in mid-air after being deakumized with André, she was seen wearing her sunglasses, even though she didn't have them on in the next scene.
When Kagami gives back the Dragon Miraculous to Ladybug, she's wearing her Friendship Day pin on her jacket which she didn't wear for the episode, showing this scene was re-used from "Ikari Gozen".
When Chloé is about to get akumatized, Hawk Moth's reflection on Chloé's glasses moves as Chloé raises her head, instead of disappearing.
The episode uses the old and incorrect title "Loveeater (Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1)" on Netflix.
In the Brazilian Portuguese dub, Hawk Moth calls Miracle Queen "Rainha Milagre", even though she's called "Rainha dos Miraculous" in the next episode.

[ Theme Song ]
Marinette: Experiencing loss is a part of life; some people lose their first love...
Marinette: Some lose the harmony in their relationship...

text:

Plagg:  Ah (stuffing cheese in his mouth) you finally realized that there's more than just one type of cheese in this world.
Marinette: And some have nothing to lose...
Luka: (continues humming, hands pizza to customer) That's it! I got it! (to customer) Gotta go, enjoy your meal. (returns to bike)
Marinette: Yes, Dad I do know where the Grand Paris Hotel is. Me! Late? I'm never late! Okay yeah sure but this time I won't be late, promise. (carrying boxes, trips but catches herself and continues awkwardly out the door. Throws boxes after being startled by Luka who catches them. She walks toward him) Luka! What are you doing here?
Luka: I've been thinking of you actually, and I'm pretty sure I found your melody at last. A tune that matches you completely. Wanna hear it? (Marinette smiles expectantly, he begins playing the tune on his guitar. Marinette, impressed, gasps and blushes heavily) What do you think?
Marinette: Wow it's- it's incredible!
Luka: Mm, it's still not quite right. I can do better. I'm gonna work on it some more.

text:

Marinette: Thanks Luka! (kisses him on the cheek)

Chloé: (walks towards her parents with the gift) Hi! (waves to the crowd, hands her parents the cloak, and walks away)
Gabriel: (continuing his speech) My dearest Mr. And Mrs. Bourgeois, I hereby present you the Gabriel Couple Cloak, a symbol of eternal love and bonds of marriage. (André and Audrey put the cloak on)

André: (unconvincingly) Thank you Gabriel, it's uh.. it's..

Tom: (sees Marinette) Over here!
Marinette: (walking towards her parents, spots Adrien and stares, trips and drops boxes) Ahh!

text:

Adrien: (He and Kagami get up to try and help but are stopped by his bodyguard and Tomoe) We're not leaving, we're just gonna help a friend out over at the buffet.(Bodyguard and Tomoe let them go)

Audrey: Don't be ridiculous, give me that! (Gabriel is secretly watching them via his computer)

Marinette: Are you kidding?

Marinette: (realizing what Adrien said, starts to search for her hairbands)

id: Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1)/Transcript::Intro::6
title: Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1)/Transcript
text:
Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1)/Transcript - Intro
Hawk Moth: Love stories don't always have a happy ending. (clenches fist then opens hand, awaiting butterfly) They bring out so many uncontrollable emotions. Isn't that right, my pretty akuma? (evilizes akuma) Fly away and evilize their scarred hearts!
Kagami: (content, listening to Adrien play the piano, looks up and notices Marinette about to put her hair back up) Your hair looks beautiful. (Marinette stops, acknowledging the compliment)
Adrien: (marveling) She's right.(elavator dings and bodyguard comes out, all three hide under the piano. Marinette distracts him with a hair band and tea candle and they run out of the hotel, laughing )
André and Audrey: (simultaneously) I hate you! (akuma goes into the cloak)
Hawk Moth: Heart Hunter, I am Hawk Moth. So you no longer believe in love? Well, I'm giving you the power to destroy it! And wherever it is, whatever it's for, devour it! All I ask in return are Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous. Now feast on love!
André and Audrey: It makes my mouth water just thinking of it. (transformed into Heart Hunter )
Chloé: Daddy? Mom?!
André Heart Hunter: Haha! I am the most powerful of all the super villains.

title: Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1)/Transcript
text:
Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1)/Transcript - Intro
Audrey Heart Hunter: No, I am! You're just super annoying. (looks over at Sabine and Tom) Ugh, they're so in love. (zaps them with a laser)
Chloé: Oh, my bee signal! I've got to let Ladybug know.
André Heart Hunter: Chloé, my princess!
Audrey Heart Hunter: You're going to give us all your love.

André Heart Hunter: Of course you do, darling.

Jagged Stone: Hey hold up, heartbreakers, I'm not in a relationship, okay.

(referring to his pet crocodile, Fang )

Marinette: (gets up, turns to Kagami, still seated) André is a sweethearts' ice cream maker. The legend says that whoever shares his ice cream together will be in love forever.

Marinette: Can't you find a blend for the three of us?

title: Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1)/Transcript
text:

id: Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1)/Transcript::Intro::12
title: Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1)/Transcript
text:

Kagami: I'm honored that you've chosen me Ladybug, but I thought you couldn't give me this Miraculous again since Hawk Moth knows my identity.
Ladybug: There's no time. I need (contemplating what to say) your exceptional talent.

Marinette: The boy's famous, isn't he? You're bound to break a lot of hearts.
Kagami: There's only one person I don't want to hurt. Marinette. She's the only other friend I have. But Adrien and I are made for each other. We're so alike, (puts on Dragon choker) I can't give him up, even for the sake of friendship.

title: Harry Clown
text:
Harry Clown - Intro
is a minor character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He is a famous comedian who performs his talent shows at Grand Palais. He is also a friend of Marinette Dupain-Cheng.
In "Psycomedian", after having his movie get turned down by Bob Roth and failing to get Marinette to confess her love to Adrien through comedic ways, he was akumatized by Shadow Moth into Psycomedian, a manipulative supervillain with the power to alter people's emotions. He also received a Magical Charm from Ladybug that prevented him from being reakumatized.

title: Harry Clown
text:
Harry Clown - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Harry has greyish white hair and slight wrinkles on his face indicating that he is fairly old. He has blue eyes and brown eyebrows. His hair is pushed to the right.
Civilian Attire
He wears a brown or burgundy unzipped leather jacket with a white button-up shirt underneath. He wears a black fanny pack around his waist and a silver necklace around his neck. Harry wears blueish gray jeans.
As Psycomedian
Psycomedian wore a red hood with white outlines that covered his head and shoulders. His suit consisted of black pants, a red line at his waist, and a top split into a white half and a black half. At the center of his chest was a mask insignia, also split: a black tragedy mask on the white side and a white comedy mask on the black side. His right hand was white while his left was black, and the sleeve on both his wrists was red. At his waist was a fanny pack-like bag that was black with a red lid and white zipper. His face was obscured by a white comedy theatre mask with a red clown nose. The mask could take on a variety of expressions, such as angry, sad, and worried.

title: Harry Clown
text:
Harry Clown - Personality
Harry Clown is goofy, often demonstrating childish behavior, including jumping around a room together with Marinette. He is caring and understanding, as proven by his attempt to help Marinette get Adrien to laugh. He is also very sensitive, being deeply affected when Bob Roth tore his drawings, and he doubts himself when he fails to do something. Harry dreams of creating a serious superhero movie to help people feel more emotions than just laughter.
As Psycomedian, he wanted to wipe the smiles off everyone's faces and show everyone that he could make them feel different emotions.

title: Harry Clown
text:
Harry Clown - Abilities
As a Civilian
Since Harry Clown is a famous comedian, it can be assumed that he is an excellent candidate when it comes to performing comedic shows, despite his old age. Seeing that he created the sketches for his movie project, he appears to like drawing.
As Psycomedian
By squeaking his clown nose, Psycomedian could make people feel the emotion displayed on his mask, which he could change at will. A sign that this was happening was when their eyes briefly glowed red. However, this ability only worked when they looked directly at him. His fanny pack could also produce extra clown noses in case the one he was using was removed. He didn't necessarily have to squeak his nose when looking at someone. For example, when Ladybug stole his clown nose, he only needed to look at her with his mask to influence her, rather than squeaking his nose to activate the effect.

title: Harry Clown
text:
Harry Clown - Relationships
Friends/Allies
Gabriel Agreste
Harry knew Gabriel ("Gabi") for a long time. He calls him his "good friend" and is not intimidated by Gabriel's coldness. The latter does not take Harry seriously, but he allows Harry to visit the mansion, which few people may visit. One of Gabriel's earliest fashion designs was even created for Harry's first act several years ago.
Acquaintances
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/Ladybug
Harry is friendy towards Marinette and her family and gladly helps her get together with her crush. He was excited for her when the opportunity was granted and sympathized with her when the attempt failed.
With Ladybug, Harry admires her and wishes to have powers to be as good as her. Psycomedian sought to manipulate these "amateur's" emotions in order to obtain her Miraculous for Shadow Moth. Once de-akumatized, he was grateful towards her.
Cat Noir
Harry admires Cat Noir and wishes to have powers to be as good as him. Psycomedian sought to manipulate these "amateur's" emotions in order to obtain his Miraculous for Shadow Moth. Once de-akumatized, he was grateful towards him.
Status unknown
Bob Roth

title: Harry Clown
text:
Harry Clown - Relationships
Harry used to be enthusiatic around his producer, sharing new ideas with him. He was shocked when Bob tore his drawings, and as Psycomedian, he targeted Bob Roth, trying to get him to admit that Harry was capable of making people feel different emotions. Once de-akumatized, Harry unsuccessfully tries to compromise with his producer.

title: Harry Clown
text:
Harry Clown - Trivia
Harry Clown's design is based on the French comedian, Franck Dubosc, who also voices him in the French dub.
According to Feri González, Psycomedian has similar abilities as discarded villain Gagotor.
He's the 2nd villain to influence Ladybug's mind, following Miracle Queen in "Miracle Queen", but the 1st villain in the permanent timeline, as Miracle Queen's influence was erased.
He's the second adult character to claim to have wanted to be a superhero since youth, following Mr. Damoclès.
He hums when he pinches his nose, but it is impossible to hum with your nose pinched.

text:
Hack-San - Intro
"" is a Season 4 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 16th written and produced episode of Season 4. It is also the 94th written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Hack-San
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Hack-San - Synopsis
Being Ladybug is a huge responsibility. You must always be ready to step in and save Paris or hand a new superpower to a new superhero. But when you’re 14, there are some obligations even the greatest superheroes can’t escape: for instance, visiting your Auntie Shu Yin in London. What if Marinette had no choice but to leave Paris on the day when Shadow Moth decided to infect Max’s robot Markov with an evil virus in order to re-akumatize him? What would happen then?
Disney+
What if there was no Ladybug to face supervillains?
Netflix
When Marinette reluctantly goes on a family trip, Alya must protect Paris after Shadow Moth's new sentimonster, Hack-San, infects Markov with a virus.

title: Hack-San
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Hack-San - Plot
The episode started when Tom called Marinette to go to aunt Shu Yin's house in London in 2 hours.
Marinette came up some excuses about not being so well and told Tom to go without her.
But, Tom said he could find a hospital in London if there was the worst situation that happened.
Marinette later made up another excuse of having a terrible headache, but Tom asked if she had a stomach ache 10 minutes ago, and she said it was the worst kind of travel-ache.
Despite all of her excuses, Tom clearly known that Marinette didn't want to visit aunt Shu Yin's house, said it was inevitable and their family must go there once a year.
Tom cheered her up that they will have fun in London.
He whispered to Marinette that they will figure out how to leave aunt Shu Yin's house early, which Sabine heared it under the floor.
Marinete giggled and Tom told Marinette to get up and ready for the visit, emplying their family faces disaters together, which Sabine also heard that too.
Tom whispered to Marinette don't make him to do this alone.
Marinette hopeless tells the kwamis that she used every single excuse that she had, but unfortunately it still wasn't enough.

title: Hack-San
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Hack-San - Plot
She then tells Tikki that Ladybug cannot leave Paris, but Tikki reminds her that her family is also important and that she shouldn't leave them.
Marinette packs up and tells the Kwamis that she'll have to make up a better excuse in order to stay.
She tells the Kwamis to behave while she tries to convince her parents that she twisted her ankle, but Tom offers to carry her.
Longg then says sarcastically that even if Marinette is one of the greatest superheros, she is not matched to convince her parents to not go on vacation.
In the meantime Gabriel is trying to figure out a way to reakumatize Markov and take advantage of him. Nooroo tells Duusu that the last time Gabriel akumatized Markov, he betrayed him. Duusu worried, tells Nooroo, that he can't akumatize him again unless he wants the same thing to happen again. Nooroo comforts Duusu and tells him that if Shadow Moth is defeated they could live freely again. Gabriel startles them by reassuring them that he'll make sure that the robot doesn't betray him once again. Gabriel transforms into Shadow Moth and creates the sentimonster Hack-San.

title: Hack-San
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Hack-San - Plot
At the park, Kim and Alix are racing in a very confusing way, Kim tells Alix that he'll be able to do 100 pushups before she finishes a lap on her rollerblades, Alix tells him sarcastically that he really likes losing. Max starts the countdown, and there they start their race. In the meantime Markov is counting Kim's pushups, talking and making a new formula with Anne-Jeanne Théoxanne du Bocquale, which will revolutionize  Science, Markov simply states that he was well-programmed which looking admiringly at Max. Markov is also playing chess with Andrei who says that's he's increadible for winning again. Alix is skating by, and Alya and Nino are watching something on their tablet, Alya suddenly receives an urgent notification from Marinette telling her to meet her at Gard Du Nord, alone. Nino guesses sarcastically that Marinette is late, but Alya tells him that it was her mom and she has to go see her alone, Alya frantically runs to the Gard du Nord.
At the train station, Tom is carrying their belonging, suddenly the megaphone announces that Marinette's train is leaving soon.

title: Hack-San
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Hack-San - Plot
When she was about to board, Marinette ran off to see Alya, but Sabine stops her by saying that she is well aware that her sister is difficult, but if she spent her whole childhood with her.
Marinette could last one weekend with her.
Marinette desperately tells her that she needs a hug from Alya and insists that Alya is her best friend.
Sabine accepts but tells her to be quick.
While Marinette runs to Alya she tells Tikki that she doesn't have a choice anymore, Tikki reassures her that everything will be fine.
Marinette hugs Alya tightly, but Alya worries about how Paris will be without Ladybug.
Marinette takes of her earrings and gives them to Alya, alongside the Miraculous she also gives her a key.
Alya confused and worried, asks Marinette what she will do with the Miraculous.
Marinette calmly responds that if there isn't a supervillain around she doesn't have to do anything, but if there is she should transform, feed the kwamis.
The megaphone announces that her train is about to depart, Marinette hugs Alya once more, and tells her that she trusts her.
Before boarding she tells her to call her in case of an emergency.
Alya looks down at the earrings with a frightened emotion.

title: Hack-San
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Hack-San - Plot
Later on Alya boards a bus and puts on the Ladybug Miraculous, Tikki comes out from the earrings.
Alya excitedly tells the Kwamis that she'll be Ladybug this weekend but Trixx intervenes and tells Alya that he wasn't enough already to protect Paris.
Tikki tells him that it is the safest way, and any other would be too risky.
When Alya said that she can't be Ladybug, Trixx starts boasting until he is aware that it's because Marinette is already named Ladybug.
She starts thinking of Ladybug-ish superhero names and though gets demoralized by Trixx,  Tikki reassures her that she is up to the task, seeing as the guardian of the miraculous entrusted them to her for a reason, which annoys a disgruntled Trixx.
At the park, Alya looks around, more paranoid and anxious, which gets noticed by Nino, who asks her about her mom, and that if she was all right.
She dismisses his concerns, claiming all is well.
She goes around asking about any negativity experienced by her friends when she sees them in a situation which could potentially generate the negative energy.

title: Hack-San
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Hack-San - Plot
At Shadow Moth's lair, Hack-san initiates the plan, by sending a pop-up ad to Markov with a cute little kitten, which he mistakenly clicks as Hack-San infects him.
Markov goes rogue, ending his game with Andrei, scorns Anne-Jeanne Théoxanne du Bocquale and tells her to settle things with her boyfriend first before trying anything more ambitious, and telling off Kim for his brain-dead thinking before proceeding to claim that humans are degenerative creatures who are inferior to robots.
Shadow Moth akumatises him, revealing that his negative emotions are the result of his sentimonster, and to free him from the suffering, he must cooperate with him, to which Markov accepts.
Alya distracts Nino with an excuse about a medical condition, causing him to run off on his own, leaving Alya free to find a secluded location to transform.
On the way, Trixx mocks Alya for already lying to her boyfriend within then minutes of becoming the substitute, to which Alya retorts about the unfortunate consequences that come with the territory.
They think about her new alias for a little before she decides to transform.

title: Hack-San
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Hack-San - Plot
She comes up with more names while striking dynamic poses, though Trixx acts condescendingly, to which Alya gets it to hide in her yo-yo to draw suspicion from her true identity from Cat Noir.
On the rooftops, she repeats the same process, though is interrupted by Cat Noir, who is under the belief that she is either a sentimonster, or an akumatized person.
Alya debunks those assumptions, though Cat Noir refuses to believe such claims and tries to engage in combat with her, though he unfortunately fails as Alya overpowers him.
In a last ditch attempt, he tries to use his Cataclysm, though Alya uses her Lucky Charm to create a trash can lid to act as a shield, before placing him in a vulnerable position to prove that she is not evil by not taking his ring.
Cat Noir believes her and they find a place to de-transform and feed their kwamis.

title: Hack-San
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Hack-San - Plot
Robostus sends out a signal to hypnotize the Parisians with a message sent through their phones. This works on most, though Alya is able to think on her feet and ignore the message. On the train, Marinette sends a list of tips to Alya before the train goes dark. Her parents pick up the signal, and get hypnotized by Robostus. She avoids her father, though her mother who gives her up.

title: Hack-San
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Hack-San - Plot
Alya tries to bring Cat Noir up to speed about the situation, though Adrien refuses to engage with her, instead asking about her with the miraculous. The two bicker for a little, though quickly compose themselves to go after Robostus. Alya gets drawn by a cry for help, which Cat Noir sense is a trap, though is ignored as she chases the calls. She sees a large group of people mindlessly standing around with their phones, which causes the new duo to realize it is a trap. They try to fight it off, though are obviously out numbered, which causes them to retreat into the wax museum, which turns out to be a mistake as they run into high-profile individuals pretending to be wax statues. Alya finally decides to name herself Scarabella, and uses her Lucky Charm, which signals her to make a deal to free a trapped Marinette to help defeat him, using Cat Noir's cataclysm on her miraculous as leverage. The plan succeeds, with Robostus finding out about the new Miraculous holder, who gets introduced by Cat Noir. Alya captures the akuma, and fixes it with her Miraculous Scarabella.

title: Hack-San
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Hack-San - Plot
At the end of the episode, Marinette tells Alya about the trip, and her parents run off in front of her first. It is then when Alya tells Marinette that she should talk to Cat Noir about the miraculous swap. The two meet up, and Ladybug apologizes for the last minute decision. Cat Noir reassures her that she did nothing wrong, and expresses his concern that if something happened to her, he would never see her again. Ladybug simply reassures him, saying that she will never abandon him.

title: Hack-San
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Hack-San - Plot Developments
Through Kamikotization, when an akumatized champion is knocked out, even if they were disabled by a third party, their link with the Butterfly Miraculous holder will be disconnected.
This is the first time ever where an akumatized villain is knocked out.
Following "Queen Banana" and the other episodes, this one also gives more insight on how Miraculous holders are chosen carefully :
In Cat Noir's case, it implies that not only current or previous owners (especially disgraced heroes) may harbor emotional attachments to the superpowers that once belonged to them but also to the people that use them.
For Alya's case, so that successors don't feel pressured by their predecessors or other people when they are good or in Zoe's case, so they don't get hounded when their predecessors go bad like with Chloe in "Miracle Queen".
On that note, back then everyone in Paris (except the heroes, kwamis, Hawk Moth and Mayura) didn't remember Chloe's betrayal giving her sister a clean slate.

title: Hack-San
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Hack-San - Plot Developments
One more reason why certain people are given the Miraculouses for example like Chloe and Zoe could be because of their and the jewels personalities (in the terms of superpowers) as Chloe due to her personality and background, she always used subjection and subjugation to have everyone submit to her demands while acting with total confidence. The Bee Miraculous most likely ended up with her because fate wanted to teach her how to use subjection and subjugation in moderation and the reason for Zoe; she was far kinder but she lacked confidence.
When Alya tells Trixx "We can't let Cat Noir see you", Alya makes Trixx enter the yo-yo. This shows that kwamis can hide inside the magical yo-yo, just like the Miracle Box. Further confirmed in "Evolution", that kwamis can also hide in any Miraculous tool.

title: Hack-San

text:
Hack-San - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in Brazil on Gloob.
This is the ninth episode to be named after a Sentimonster, the others being "Reflekdoll", "Félix", "Ladybug", "Gabriel Agreste", "Mega Leech", "Guiltrip", "Optigami" and "Sentibubbler".
This is the first episode where Anne Yatco voices Sabine.
Interestingly, this episode comes before the last episode her predecessor, Philece Sampler, worked on, both chronologically and production code-wise. This is because, due to unknown issues, the episodes were distributed out of order.
There are some differences between the final version of the episode and the original script:
Marinette would hide behind all the objects captured by Robostus after Scarabella captured the akuma and before she used Miraculous Scarabella in order to avoid being spotted by Cat Noir.
Cat Noir would tell Scarabella he was right to trust her before she used Miraculous Scarabella, with her then telling him she hoped he was no longer upset with Ladybug and he could still trust her.
Scarabella would give a Magical Charm to Markov, before he commented she was not the usual Ladybug Miraculous holder.

title: Hack-San
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Hack-San - Trivia
This would explain the existance of a concept art of a magical charm with Robostus color scheme was revealed.
This would also reveal that magical charms are not exclusive to Ladybug but are accessible to any of the Ladybug Miraculous holders.
That fact had been hinted by Marinette herself in the episode, where she would tell Alya in her messages to remember to give a magical charm to the akumatized victim at the end of a battle.
It's unknown why this was cut from the final version of the episode, if it was to cut the duration of the episode or if it was to make magical charms an exclusive power to Ladybug.
This is the third time a civilian breaks an akumatized object, and the second time Marinette does so.
Prized possessions from prior episodes are seen here, such as Manon's Ladybug doll, Fu's gramophone, and so on.
This is the second time Markov gets akumatized into Robostus, following "Robostus". However, unlike before, he has different abilities this time and is cursed with anger until Hack-San is destroyed.
