title: Hack-San (sentimonster)
text:
Hack-San (sentimonster) - Intro
Hack-San was the titular main antagonist of the episode "Hack-San". It was a thumb drive sentimonster created by Shadow Moth from his own emotions of determination and ambition in the midst of his latest plan to take Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses.
In "Hack-San", Shadow Moth used the sentimonster to send a virus to Markov which forced him to be angry so that he could re-akumatize him into Robostus.

title: Hack-San (sentimonster)
text:
Hack-San (sentimonster) - Appearance
Hack-San looked like a flash drive. It had black and white stripes and a red dot in the middle which was its eye. It was shaped with a round body with one leg and 5 protuberances (two at the bottom and three at the top).
The white part turned red when Hack-San sent its virus onto a computer.

title: Hack-San (sentimonster)
text:
Hack-San (sentimonster) - Abilities
Upon being plugged into a technological device, Hack-San was able to download a computer virus with the main purpose of infecting Markov through his computer and making him unyieldingly angry so that Shadow Moth could turn him back into his akumatized form, Robostus.
The computer virus Hack-San sent to the person or machine could be disguised as a pop up email message that could fool anyone.

title: Hack-San (sentimonster)
text:
Hack-San (sentimonster) - History
Shadow Moth created Hack-San in order to prevent Robostus from turning against him like what happened the first time. Nathalie then used Hack-San to send a computer virus which infected Markov, turning his emotions negative so Shadow Moth would be able to re-akumatize him into Robostus.
After Markov was de-akumatized, with Hack-San's purpose no longer necessary, Shadow Moth released it from existence.

title: Hack-San (sentimonster)
text:
Hack-San (sentimonster) - Trivia
Hack-San's design, appearance and powers are based on X.A.N.A., an evil artificial computer virus who is the main antagonist in the French animated series Code Lyoko.
Thomas Astruc worked as a storyboarder for Code Lyoko's first season and Fred Lenoir worked as a writer for the first two.
Code Lyoko shares many subtle similarities with Miraculous Ladybug.
Odd Della Robbia and Adrien Agreste are both Blonde and are Cat-Themed Heroes.
Yumi Ishiyama and Kagami Tsurugi are both from Japan.
Strangely enough, by reversing the syllables of it's name and then removing the "ck" from "hack", it's name becomes "San-Ha" which if pronounced out loud would sound a lot like "X.A.N.A."
This was the second sentimonster partly technological, following Optigami.
The name "Hack-San" is Japanese for "Miss Hack". This fitting not only the sentimonster, but also Nathalie, because this was the second time she unleashed a sentimonster whose goal was to "hack the heroes" after "Optigami".
Hack-San shared a similar appearance to the symbol on Nino's T-shirt, although they aren't meant to be related.

title: Hack-San (sentimonster)
text:
Hack-San (sentimonster) - Trivia
It was the sixth sentimonster to be destroyed by Shadow Moth, following Gabriel Agreste, Sentialec, Sentinino, Optigami and Sentibubbler.

title: Hack-San/Transcript
text:
Hack-San/Transcript - Intro
[ Theme Song ]
Tom: Marinette! The train's in one hour! Is your suitcase packed?
Marinette: (lying on the bed) Oh! I really don't feel well, Dad! But it's okay! Just... go without me!
Tom: I'm sure it's nothing serious and if worse comes to worse, we can always find a doctor in London.
Marinette: I can't even move! My head hurts too much! (whimpers)
Tom: Wasn't it your stomach that was hurting ten minutes ago? (grabs Marinette's suitcase)
Marinette: Oh! Um.. it must be a moving ache. Those are the worst kind!
Tom': Come on. We know what's going on.
Marinette: Going on? What do you mean?
Tom: What's really going on is that you don't want to go to Auntie Shu Yin's because it's impossible. But that's just the way it is. We have to go once a year and we'll have fun in London! (whispers) I'm sure we'll figure out how to shake her off now and then.
Sabine: (from downstairs) I heard that, Tom.
Tom: (upon exiting the room) Come on. Get up and get ready. We're a family and we face disasters together.
Sabine: (from downstairs) I heard that, too, Tom!
Tom: Don't make me do this alone. (closes the trapdoor)

title: Hack-San/Transcript
text:
Hack-San/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (groans) I used up an entire month's worth of excuses in one go and it's still wasn't enough! What am I gonna do? Ladybug can't abandon Paris!
Tikki: You can't abandon your family either, Marinette!
Marinette: (groans louder and goes down from her bunk bed) I'll have to come up with a better excuse on the way. (The kwamis fly to her before she goes downstairs.) You stay here and be good. I'll be back.
(She closes the trapdoor and goes downstairs. A loud thump was heard which concerned the kwamis.)
Marinette: (from downstairs) Ow! I must've twisted my ankle! There's no way I can walk anywhere like this!
Tom: (from downstairs) I'll carry you, sweetie, don't worry.
(Marinette groans off-screen.)
Longg: Even the greatest of superheroes is no match for parents who want to go on vacation.
Gabriel: Its intelligence is not at all artificial.
Nooroo: (to Duusu) That robot turned against him last time!
Duusu: Oh no! This is terrible! He can't akumatize him again!
Nooroo: On the contrary, Duusu, it's a good thing! Once Shadow Moth is defeated, we'll be free!
Duusu: Oh, right! Awesome! Awesome! (claps)

title: Hack-San/Transcript
text:
Hack-San/Transcript - Intro
Gabriel: This time, I'll make sure that robot can't betray me. Duusu, Nooroo, dual metamorphosis!
(He transforms into Shadow Moth. He then holds a feather on his hand and turns it into an amok.)
Shadow Moth: Go, my beautiful amok, and bring my creation to life!
(The feather flies into his staff, as he extends his arms, using his power forming a dark ball of energy in front of him, creating Hack-San.)
Shadow Moth: Hack-San, you have been created with the power to hack into the emotions of a robot. Thanks to you, I will be able to re-akumatize him.
(Hack-San glows as it activates its power.)
Kim: I bet you I could do a thousand push-ups before you finish a lap on your blades.
Alix: I guess you really like losing, Kim!
Max: Ready, set, go!
(Alix dashes with her roller blades and Kim commences his push-ups.)
Markov: (simultaneously counting with Kim's push-ups) One, two, three, four, five, six...
Anne-Jeanne: (on the laptop) Markov, your new formula is about to revolutionize science! You're a genius!

title: Hack-San/Transcript
text:
Hack-San/Transcript - Intro
Markov: I'm just well-programmed here, Miss du Bocquale. (continues counting Kim's push-ups) Thirteen, fourteen... (switches the window on the laptop to the game of chess he's playing) Pawn to F-4. Checkmate, Andrei!
Andrei: Incredible! You win again, Markov!
(Markov high-fives with Max. Alix continues to roller skate around the garden. Alya and Nino are playing  on their tablet and is cut short when Alya's phone vibrates from her lap.)
Marinette: (v.o., from Alya's phone) Urgent! Meet me at Gare du Nord. Alone.
Nino: Let me guess: Marinette's gonna be late?
Alya: Uhh, no. That was... my mom. I gotta go see her. Alone. (kisses Nino and runs away)
Nino: Okay. (goes back to playing on his tablet)
Announcer: Startrain number 6966 to London is about to depart. Please step away from the platform.
(Marinette runs to see Alya until she gets caught by Sabine.)
Sabine: Marinette! Don't try to run away. I know my sister can be difficult. But if I survived my whole childhood with her, you can survive one weekend!
Marinette: Mom, I just really need a hug from Alya. She's my BFF, you know?
(Alya waves from afar.)
Sabine: Alright, but make it quick. The train's about to leave.

title: Hack-San/Transcript
text:
Hack-San/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (while running towards Alya) I don't think we have a choice, Tikki.
Tikki: (from Marinette's purse) Everything will be alright, Marinette!
(Alya and Marinette embrace.)
Alya: You can't leave Paris. What do we do if there's a supervillain and you're in London?
Marinette: Well, we'll do... (takes off her earrings and hands it over to Alya, along with her keys) this.
Alya: What do you expect me to do with these??
Marinette: If everything goes fine, nothing. Otherwise, Ladybug. And don't forget to feed the kwamis. (hugs Alya) I trust you. (runs to enter the train)
Announcer: Startrain number 6966 to London is about to depart. Please step away from the platform.
Marinette: (waves goodbye) Call me if there's a problem!
(The train door slides shut and departs, leaving a confused Alya at the train station, staring at the Ladybug Miraculous in her hands.)
Alya: Hey there, kwamis! Who's Ladybug this weekend? Yours truly!
Trixx: (sulkily) As if I was not enough to help you protect Paris.
Tikki: It's more cautious like this, Trixx.
Alya: Wait, I can't be Ladybug!
Trixx: Ha! See?

title: Hack-San/Transcript
text:
Hack-San/Transcript - Intro
Alya: Marinette is Ladybug. I need a different Ladybug-ish superhero name like... Captain Bug! Or... Wonder Bug! No, better: Super Bug!
Trixx: (sarcastic) Oh, wow. Super names. Super Bug. Now all I have to do is to be super careful all the time, keep everything super secret, take everything super seriously and not super screw up!
Tikki: Marinette's not just Ladybug, Alya. She's also the Guardian of the Miraculous! And if the Guardian trusts you, it means you have what it takes to succeed!
(Trixx becomes sulkier and mumbles words.)
Alya: You're right, Tikki. We can do this. But we won't have to 'cause this weekend will be nice and calm.
Trixx: (sarcastic) Yeah, right. Super calm.
Alya: Okay, I can do this!
(She looks around to check if there are no signs of trouble.)
Nino: Is your mom okay?
Alya: My mom? Oh, yeah! Sure! My mom's doing super well! She just wanted to give me something super not annoying and super... (She gasps as she sees Alix looks somewhat sad from behind, crouching down the pavement. She runs towards Alix to check on her.) Alix! Is everything okay? No negative emotions, I hope?

title: Hack-San/Transcript
text:
Hack-San/Transcript - Intro
Alix: I'm fine. As for negative emotions, you better check on Kim. He's the one who lost.
(Alya panics and runs to Kim.)
Alya: How are you feeling, Kim? Not too sad?
Kim: (stretches his arms) I haven't lost yet! There are three rounds to this race. Max, Markov, ready?
(Max and Markov put their thumbs up.)
Alya: Super! But don't forget: it's not about winning or losing, right? What matters is not hurting yourselves or getting upset or getting angry. (bumps her back on Nino)
Nino: You sure you're okay?
Alya: Yeah, yeah! Everything is super! My mom feels super fine, and since everyone here is super great, too, well, that's just super! How about you? You good?
Nino: Uhh... super, I guess?
Marinette: (v.o) Protip 33: When Cat Noir tells a joke, try to laugh at it even if it isn't funny. It makes him happy.
Tom: (to Sabine) We can have lunch, but we don't have to stay for dessert.
Sabine: We're bringing dessert!
Tom: That doesn't mean we have to eat it. We'll just leave it with your sister and go to the museum. The three of us. She doesn't like going to the museum anyway.
Sabine: She doesn't like cake either.

title: Hack-San/Transcript
text:
Hack-San/Transcript - Intro
(Tom looks at Marinette and shrugs. Marinette goes back messaging Alya on her phone.)
Marinette: (v.o) Pro-tip 34...
Gabriel: Hack-San behaves like a computer virus.
(Nathalie plugs Hack-San into her tablet, corrupting it.)
Nathalie: The network will make it easy for the sentimonster to find your prey.
Gabriel: Perfect.
Markov: 108, 109, 110...
(Alix continues to roller skate, as well as Alya's anxiety about any uprising negative emotions.)
Markov: 111, 112, 113, 114... (switches the laptop window to the chess game) Queen to B-3. (switches to his call with Anne-Jeanne) Have you had time to read my dinosaur theory? (switches back to the push-up counter) 120, 121, 122... (a picture of a cute kitty pops up on the laptop as he gasps in awe) Aww! What a cute kitty cat!
(Upon clicking on the window of a cute kitty, Hack-San corrupts the laptop, sending the virus travelling through the wire that is connected on Markov, ending up being corrupted as well.)
Max: Markov?
(Markov gets completely corrupted by Hack-San's virus and terminates all his current activities on the laptop.)

title: Hack-San/Transcript
text:
Hack-San/Transcript - Intro
Markov: (to Andrei) Playing chess with you is utterly uninteresting! (exits their chess game and moves to his call with Anne-Jeanne) And you, you better give up on science before science gives up on you! (cuts his call with Anne-Jeanne) As for you, Kim, instead of trying to rise to this challenge, you should try raising your IQ!
Max: Markov! What's up with you?
Alya: He didn't mean what he said. (helps Kim to stand up) Right, Markov? It was just a joke.
Markov: Humans do not make me laugh. Humans are neither funny nor intelligent. Humans do not have any good qualities whatsoever!
Max: Markov! (runs after Markov)
Nino: Wait! (grabs Alya's arm)
Alya: I have to go after him, Nino! What if Markov gets akumatized? Or Max?
Nino: If someone gets akumatized, Ladybug will take care of it! We should actually stick together in case she needs... (whispers) a turtle and a fox. (winks)
(Alya grabs her head to fake a headache, groaning.)
Nino: What's the matter?
Alya: Flash headache. It comes in suddenly when I play video games too long. And I'm out of lemon balm for my headaches. (groans)
Nino: Lemon balm? I-Is that a thing?

title: Hack-San/Transcript
text:
Hack-San/Transcript - Intro
Alya: Uhh... of course, it is! But it's very rare. Sometimes you have to go to a dozen pharmacies before you find any. And I just don't have the strength!
Nino: Okay! I'll go! I'll go! (runs away)
(As she watches Nino running away, Alya goes to run in the opposite direction to find a place to transform.)
Trixx: Great job! You've been Super Bug for ten minutes and you're already super lying to your boyfriend!
Alya: It comes with a job, Trixx!
(A corrupted Markov flies on the streets, sabotaging a traffic light, causing traffic to vehicles on the road. Markov laughs maniacally.)
Shadow Moth: Ah, I can feel the hate for humans coursing through this robot's circuitry! (creates an akuma) Fly away, my lovely akuma, and evilize his electronic heart!
(The akuma flies out of the window and is heading straight towards Markov.)
Shadow Moth: (from his lair) Robustus, I am Shadow Moth. You have been infected by Hack-San, my viral sentimonster. From now on, no matter what you do, you will feel nothing but negative emotions!
Markov: I despise you, Shadow Moth!

title: Hack-San/Transcript
text:
Hack-San/Transcript - Intro
Shadow Moth: (from his lair) As you should. Unfortunately, I'm the only one who can end your suffering by destroying Hack-San. However, I will only do that in one condition.
Markov: I'm suspecting you want Ladybug and Cat Noir's precious Miraculous!
Shadow Moth: (from his lair) That's right! And in order to fulfill your mission, I'm giving you the power to rule over humans!
Markov: Perfect!!
(The akuma completely takes control over him and transforms into Robustus. He releases a big radius of energy in the whole city of Paris, infecting all devices and gadgets with the virus that came from Hack-San.)
Marc: Markov?
(He presses to answer the call only to have his phone corrupted by Robustus, and him along with it.)
Robustus: Human, I am Robustus. Give me what you hold most valuable!
Marc: (points his phone at Nathaniel) Our manga is what we hold most valuable.
Nathaniel: What's happening to you? (gets sucked into Marc's phone)
Max: Markov? Markov, where are you? (his phone rings, getting a call from Markov) Markov? (presses to answer only to have his phone corrupted)
(Alya appears from behind Max who ran after him.)
Robustus: I am Robustus. Give me what you hold most valuable.

title: Hack-San/Transcript
text:
Hack-San/Transcript - Intro
Max: (infected by Hack-San's virus) A back-up from Markov's program is what I hold most valuable. (brings out his flash drive, which gets sucked into his phone)
Alya: (gasps) Max? (Her phone rings as well, with Markov on the screen.)
Robustus: From now on, every time I call you, you will answer and you will obey me!
Max: At your command, Robustus.
Alya: Markov's been re-akumatized? (removes her phone battery from her phone)
Marinette: (v.o) Protip 675: Once you've called out "Miraculous Ladybug", don't forget to give them the magical charm. That's all. X-O-X-O.
(The virus that Robustus spread reaches Marinette's family, making them fall off their seats and turning the lights off. Sabine scowls at Tom and Marinette.)
Tom and Marinette: It's not our fault! Promise!
(Continuous ringing of everyone's phones resonates inside their cabin, with all of them receiving a call from Markov.)
Marinette: There's something weird— Don't pick up!!
(Tom and Sabine press their phones to answer and becomes infected by the computer virus.)
Robustus: Human, I am Robustus. Give me what you hold most valuable.
Tom and Sabine: Marinette, you're what we hold most valuable.

title: Hack-San/Transcript
text:
Hack-San/Transcript - Intro
(Marinette begins to escape her computer virus-infected parents.)
Tom: Marinette, sweetie.
(A passenger brings out a bill and gives it to Robustus through his phone. Other passengers continue to be infected by the virus, giving their most prized possessions.)
Child passenger: (after inserting an item through his phone) At your command, Robustus.
(Marinette continues to escape, locking a cabin door shut to prevent her parents from catching her.)
Tom: Marinette...
Marinette: (panics) Alya, I'm counting on you! (continues to escape)
Tom: You're what we hold most valuable.
Trixx: Wow! This truly is a super calm weekend, Super Bug.
Alya: You were right, Trixx.
Trixx: (scoffs) See?
Alya: Super Bug sucks. I need a new name!
[Transformation Sequence]  Alya: Tikki, spots on! (transforms into Scarabella)
Scarabella: Stay connected, Robustus! (does a couple of poses) Bugalady is in the house! Bugalady sounds pretty cool right?
Trixx: Meh, you could do better.
Scarabella: (opens her yo-yo) Hide, Trixx. We can't let Cat Noir see you.
(Trixx huffs and flies into Scarabella's yo-yo. Scarabella swings atop the roofs.)

title: Hack-San/Transcript
text:
Hack-San/Transcript - Intro
Scarabella: (does a few poses) As free as the wind! As righteous as justice! As infinite as imagination! I am... Lady Luck! (puts her palm on her forehead) No, that's lame. I am... I am... I am... Lady—
Cat Noir: You're not Ladybug!
Scarabella: Cat Noir! How much of that did you just see?
Cat Noir: Every little bit. And you're right, it's pretty lame. (lands in front of Scarabella) That's not the least of your problems. Because there's only one Ladybug, which means you can only be... a sentimonster or an akumatized villain!
Scarabella: Woah, wait! I'm not a bad guy, I swear!
Cat Noir: Liar! What have you done to m'lady? (hits Scarabella with his baton and sends her flying to a wall)
Scarabella: (groans) It's not what you think! She trusted it to me!
Cat Noir: She'd never do that without telling me! Cataclysm!
Scarabella: Lucky Charm!
(Scarabella uses her power and receives a trash can lid. Cat Noir pounces on her and disintegrates the lucky charm object. She kicked him afterwards and punched him to the air. She hurled her yo-yo and wrapped it around him shortly after.)

title: Hack-San/Transcript
text:
Hack-San/Transcript - Intro
Scarabella: If I really were a supervillain, I would take your Miraculous. But I won't do it, because who I really am is... La Bugette!
Cat Noir: (scowls) Why would she give her Miraculous... to you?
Scarabella: Because she knows me and trusts me. And because she thought I'd laugh at your jokes.
Cat Noir: Very funny. Fine, I believe you, but change the name, okay?
Scarabella: Okay! (She releases Cat Noir and clears her throat. She once again does a few poses.) As swift as lightning! Tough as a tornado! Courageous as a cougar! I am... Scarabella!
Cat Noir: We'd better recharge our kwamis, Scarabella.
(The two of them jump onto another rooftop. They stand back-to-back from each other, with a wall "concealing" their identities.)
Cat Noir: Claws in! (de-transforms into Adrien)
Scarabella: Spots off! (de-transforms into Alya)
Alya: (after giving Tikki a macaron) You know what's going on?
Adrien: Yep. Ladybug sends a stand-in and didn't see fit to tell me about it!
Alya: I'm... sure she didn't have time!
Adrien: As usual. No need to keep the cat in the loop! (brings out a camembert)
Alya: Um... in other news, it looks like Robustus is back.

title: Hack-San/Transcript
text:
Hack-San/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: I know, thanks. I was there the first time. With Ladybug, the real one?
Alya: And that time, how did the real Ladybug get you out of that mess?
Adrien: Give me a break, Miss "I can't even come up with a superhero name"!
Alya: (sighs deeply) Okay. Robustus is forcing people to give him whatever they have that's most valuable to them. It's so that he can get—
Adrien: My favorite cat food? No way! Plagg, claws out! (transforms into Cat Noir and leaps away)
Alya: Tikki, spots on! (transforms into Scarabella and follows Cat Noir from behind)
Tom: Marinette, where are you, my precious daughter?
(Marinette comes out of a washroom.)
Sabine: (while holding out her phone) Marinette, you're what I hold most valuable. (her phone touches Marinette and gets sucked in it)
Shadow Moth: (from his lair) Looks like Ladybug and Cat Noir missed your first call, Robustus.
Robustus: Indeed. But I'm gonna make another one, and this time, the message will be much clearer!
(Robustus releases a bigger radius of energy.)
Robustus: Human! Ladybug and Cat Noir are what you hold most valuable. Find them and capture them!
Marc:  At your command, Robustus.

title: Hack-San/Transcript
text:
Hack-San/Transcript - Intro
Parisian:  Help! Please help me! Cat Noir, Ladybug! Save me!
Scarabella: This way! C'mon! (leaps away)
Cat Noir: Uh, the real Ladybug would think twice before jumping in to this!
Scarabella: Oh yeah? And the real Cat Noir is acting like a real scaredy-cat!
(Cat Noir groans in annoyance yet follows Scarabella as she swings away to the streets. Scarabella lands safely at the center of the road.)
Parisian:  Cat Noir! Ladybug! Save me!
(Scarabella runs toward the direction of the Parisian screaming for help, only ending up being greeted by a bunch of other Parisians that are infected with the computer virus.)
Scarabella: Uh... okay, my bad.
Cat Noir: (lands atop a lamppost) No kidding.
(Scarabella spins her yo-yo and hits an infected Marc away, pushing the other Parisians back. Cat Noir joins her in the battlefield yet when other Parisians appear to corner them, they begin their escape.)
Cat Noir: C'mon!
(The two heroes run across the streets, only to find that more infected Parisians are coming after them.)
Scarabella: They're coming from everywhere!
Cat Noir: Here!
(They run inside the Musée Grévin and push the main door shut.)
Cat Noir: That should hold them off for a while!

title: Hack-San/Transcript
text:
Hack-San/Transcript - Intro
(Scarabella and Cat Noir walk inside the museum.)
Cat Noir: So... you and Ladybug know each other? Are you like, friends?
Scarabella: (subtly panics) Friends? Ladybug and me? Nah, that would be a stretch.
Cat Noir: You know her secret identity?
Scarabella: Oh, well, uh, look. I really can't talk about it. These are questions you should ask Ladybug.
Robustus: (v.o, laughs) Welcome to my trap! The only way for you to get out of here is to give me what you hold most valuable, your Miraculous!
Cat Noir: That's one ridiculous trap. Since you brought us here without your army to defend you, you're the one who's about to be defeated!
Scarabella: Yeah, Robustus! Get ready to taste the wrath of the... (does a few more poses) Black Spots of Justice!
Cat Noir: "The Black Spots of Justice"?
(An infected André comes from behind Cat Noir.)
Scarabella: Watch out! (pulls Cat Noir over to her)
Cat Noir: Nice one, thanks.
(The "statues" begin to move with their phones up to corner the two heroes.)
Scarabella: Cat Noir, they aren't statues, it's a ruse! They were waiting for us!
(A bigger screen projects in front of them, showing Robustus.)
Robustus: Seize Cat Noir and...

title: Hack-San/Transcript
text:
Hack-San/Transcript - Intro
Scarabella: The Black Spots of Justice!
Shadow Moth: (from his lair) That's not the real Ladybug! She's a novice! This will make things easier for you, Robustus!
Robustus: Seize Cat Noir and (mockingly) the Black Spots of Justice's Miraculous!
Scarabella: Hey!
All the infected Parisians: At your command, Robustus.
(The battle ensues.)
Scarabella: This is just wrong! I need a better name.
Cat Noir: A shorter one, maybe?
Scarabella: Scarabella! That was better, wasn't it?
Cat Noir: (struggles fighting with André and Jagged) Now may not be the time!
Scarabella: Fine. (kicks an infected Nadja away) Lucky Charm!
(She uses her power, summoning a frying pan. She looks around the place, searching for possible solutions to use her lucky charm, but finds nothing.)
Scarabella: You're right! I'm not Ladybug!
Cat Noir: No, you're not Ladybug! You're Scarabella! And now that you have a cool name, you've gotta hang in there, cause that's what Ladybug would do! Besides, you have the best in partner in the world to help you. (does a series of poses) The funniest, incredible, Cat Noir! Meooow!

title: Hack-San/Transcript
text:
Hack-San/Transcript - Intro
(Scarabella laughs at him. She tries again to look for possible solutions and succeeds this time. She spots her frying pan, Robustus and Marinette on the screen.)
Scarabella: Okay, Robustus! You've got us trapped in here surrounded and we haven't found out where you're hiding, so looks like we lost, right?
Robustus: According to my calculations, I have a 99.98% chance of victory!
Scarabella: Hmm, so that 0.02% must be where Cat Noir cataclysms my Miraculous, then Shadow Moth won't get his hands on what's most valuable to him. And then, you won't actually have won! Am I correct?
Cat Noir: Yeah, brilliant! Cataclysm! (activates his power and points it to Scarabella's earrings)Shadow Moth: (from his lair) Watch out, Robustus! This substitute Ladybug might not be as incompetent as she seems!
Robustus: Are you suggesting we negotiate, human superhero?
Scarabella: You got it! We're not giving up until you've released all people and objects you've captured. That way, I won't have completely goofed up my first and last mission. Maybe then, the real Ladybug won't be so mad at me.
Robustus: Request granted. Now give up.
Scarabella: Nope. You empty your hard drive first.

title: Hack-San/Transcript
text:
Hack-San/Transcript - Intro
Robustus: No! You first!
Scarabella: Fine. I'll hand myself over first, then you release everything you've captured.
Cat Noir: And only then will I give myself up.
Robustus: (his face turns into a loading screen) There's a 92% chance it's a trap.
Scarabella: To prove my good faith, I'll give you my lucky charm. That way I can't use it to win.
Shadow Moth: (from his lair) Accept the deal, Robustus!
Robustus: (groans) Request granted. Now give up!(Scarabella steps forward and touches the screen in front of her and gets captured in Robustus' screen of captured humans and objects.)Cat Noir: It's your turn to keep your word, Robustus.(Robustus releases all the captives, including Marinette, who spots Scarabella on the screen, Robustus, a bucket and the lucky charm object, the frying pan as she comes up with a plan.)Robustus: Your turn, Cat Noir!
Cat Noir: I sure hope you know what you're doing, Scarabella. (steps forward and lets himself get captured as well)Shadow Moth: (from his lair) YES! My wish is about to be granted!

title: Hack-San/Transcript
text:
Hack-San/Transcript - Intro
Robustus: It's also time to honor your word, Shadow Moth, and free me fro—(Marinette hits Robustus with the frying pan.)Shadow Moth: (gasps, from his lair) What's going on?(The akuma flies out of Robustus' system and Marinette traps it with a bucket. Scarabella and Cat Noir are then released.)Cat Noir: (with a cauldron on his head) Did someone turn off the light?(Marinette releases the akuma from the bucket.)Scarabella: No more evil-doing for you, little akuma! (swipes her yo-yo open and swings it) Time to de-evilize! (captures the akuma) Gotcha! Bye bye, little butterfly! (She releases the purified butterfly.)
Scarabella: (excitedly while holding the frying pan) I always wanted to do that! Miraculous Scarabella! (She throws the frying pan in the air, relieving all the Parisians from the virus caused by Hack-San and Robustus, and brings back Marinette with her family back in the train.)''
Tom: (to Sabine) See? It wasn't our fault!
(Marinette laughs.)
Markov: (to Scarabella) You are not the usual holder of the Ladybug Miraculous.
Scarabella: Umm...

title: Hack-San/Transcript
text:
Hack-San/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: Nope, but you were lucky enough to have been saved by the one and only Scarabella, in person. I don't you understand how you solved all of this, but... (raises his fist)
Scarabella and Cat Noir: Pound it!
Shadow Moth: Hack-San, I release you from your existence.
(He snaps fingers as the amok is released from his staff and gets purified. Hack-San, who is connected to Nathalie's tablet, disappears. Nathalie frowns.)
Shadow Moth: You had beginner's luck, Scarabella. But I have experience, and I will triumph in the end!
(The lair window closes shut.)
Marinette: And that's the tower of London, where we tried to imprison Aunt Shu Yin!
Tom: But the guards didn't want her! (laughs)
Sabine: I heard that, Tom!
Tom: (runs towards Sabine) Honey! That's not what I meant!
(Alya and Marinette laugh together.)
Sabine: You better watch yourself...
Alya: (whispers to Marinette) You should talk to Cat Noir. It's important.
(Marinette's eyes widen.)
Ladybug: You... must've been pretty surprised to discover there was another holder!
(Silence. She sits beside Cat Noir.)

title: Hack-San/Transcript
text:
Hack-San/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: I'm really sorry, Cat Noir. I should've told you. I mean, if I found out that you told someone about your secret identity, I'd... probably be upset, too. I'm really sorry I hurt your feelings.
Cat Noir: You didn't hurt my feelings. You did everything right. Paris will always need a Ladybug superhero to watch over her. It's just... I realized that if one day that hero wasn't you, m'lady, since we don't know each other's identities, that means... I'd never see you again. Ever. And now, I just don't know if I can bear it.
(Cat Noir closes his eyes sadly as Ladybug frowns. She places her hand on top of his, which brought him to his surprise.)
Ladybug: I'll never abandon you, kitty cat. (smiles)

title: Heartfixer
text:
Heartfixer - Intro
"" is a Season 6 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 20th written and produced episode of Season 6. It is also the 151st written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Heartfixer
text:
Heartfixer - Synopsis
TFOU
Nelson, Loïc, and Ray are akumatized in order to destroy the love between Marinette and Adrien. The three supervillains will stop at nothing to break them up. Will Marinette and Adrien manage to withstand their attacks and protect their beautiful love story?
Gloob
Determined to destroy everything that reminds them of love, Nelson, Loïc, and Ray decide to get akumatized to put an end to Marinette and Adrien's relationship.
Disney Channel
Supervillains threaten Marinette and Adrien's relationship.
Disney+
Marinette and Adrien's relationship is threatened.

title: Heartfixer
text:
Heartfixer - Plot
In the flashback scene at the beginning of the episode, all of Marinette and Adrien's classmates adore their relationship and them being a couple... all except the bully trio: Ray, Loïc, and Nelson, who despise happy couples. Meeting privately in the school library, the three recall all the times they tried to break up Marinette and Adrien, including flashbacks to "Grendiaper", but it never works, because their bond is inseparable. And because of that, they have decided that they need Chrysalis' help. They focus on all their emotions of hatred and simulataneously hold Nelson's smartphone, and are thus willingly akumatized into the Couplewreckers, determined to end Marinette and Adrien's relationship for good.

title: Heartfixer
text:
Heartfixer - Plot
Marinette writes in her diary that she and Adrien are officially a couple and she still can't be herself around anyone by keeping her secret from Adrien that his own father, Gabriel Agreste, is Monarch. The diary is almost complete. She wants to buy a new one, but Tikki points out she already has tons of them, and encourages her to tell Adrien the truth. Marinette decides that she will give the letter to Adrien when or if he is ready. Marinette meets up with Adrien at his mansion for breakfast. Adrien notices the letter in the front pocket of Marinette's backpack and asks if she's going to give it to him; Marinette lies, telling him she'll give it to him later as they head off to school.
Unbeknownst to Marinette, Adrien, Alya, and Nino, Nelson secretly photographs them in order for him and his friends to use their shapeshifting akumatized powers.
Adrien goes to Ancient Greek class, where he meets up with Sublime; Nelson, disguised as Prem, also arrives, claiming he wants to the watch gladiator movies in their original language.

title: Heartfixer
text:
Heartfixer - Plot
"Prem" gets Adrien's attention and points outside, where Ray (disguised as Marinette) and Loïc (disguised as Nino) are romantically hanging out together in the courtyard.
Meanwhile, in the vegetable garden, Tikki, from inside Marinette's purse, encourages Marinette to ask Adrien her real question.
The real Prem is also present, recording the birds' hatchlings being born, but as soon as he tells Marinette this, she is already gone.
After Ancient Greek class, "Prem" talks to Adrien about if he and Marinette are still together, but Adrien assures him that there must be an explanation; "Prem" hugs him, wishing him good luck.
Before Marinette reaches Adrien, she bumps into Aglaé, who says that what she did was really bad.
Marinette asks Adrien her real question: how he would react if someone was hiding something from him for his own good.
Adrien doubts her and tells her he saw her in the courtyard, but Marinette informs him of her actual location earlier, and Nino and Alya approach them.
Adrien thinks Nino and Marinette are just pranking him, tells them to make their pranks less stressful next time, and goes to his fencing class, leaving his friends befuddled.

title: Heartfixer
text:
Heartfixer - Plot
Infuriated by this, the Couplewreckers determine they need to take the plan further.
Nelson has Ray and Loïc respectively impose as Nino and Marinette kissing each other, while he imposes as Alya.
In pottery class, Alya reminds Marinette that she can always be open up to her whenever she wants. In music class, "Alya" enters, telling Ms. Couffaine that Mr. Damoclès sent her to get Nino. As they exit, Nino asks what's happening, and "Alya" falsely states that she has a surprise for him and orders him to wait. Nelson then transforms from Alya into Mr. Damoclès, and interrupts Adrien's fencing duel with Kagami, asking Mr. D'Argencourt if he can borrow Adrien for a moment. As he and Adrien walk in the hallway, Adrien sees "Marinette" cheating on him with "Nino". A horrified Adrien chases after the two, who run away together and then impersonate Kim and Ivan to escape.

title: Heartfixer
text:
Heartfixer - Plot
Adrien goes outside, unable to find them. When the real Nino approaches Adrien to asks him if he's seen Alya around, Adrien accuses him of him and Marinette kissing each other, much to Nino's confusion. Marinette and Alya arrive, and Adrien furiously scolds Marinette, believing the affair is what was in the letter. Alya assumes this is what Marinette was hiding earlier too, and angrily accuses Nino of lying to her when they swore that they would never lie to each other. As Nino reassures that he would never lie to her, Alya storms off, telling him to never speak to her again. Adrien declares to Marinette that their relationship is over and runs off into the hallways, with Marinette chasing after him. The Couplewreckers, still impersonating Damoclès, Kim, and Ivan, witness the argument from afar, pleased that they've not only broken up two couples in one, but an entire group of friends. Nelson impersonates Sublime while Loïc and Ray impersonate Adrien and Alya to initiate the final stage of their plan.

title: Heartfixer
text:
Heartfixer - Plot
Marinette finds a heartbroken "Adrien" crying on the floor of the empty amphitheater. She promises to him that he is the only one she's in love with, but "Adrien" shrugs her away. "Sublime" suddenly rushes in and comforts Adrien. As the two walk out together, a helpless Marinette tries to reason with them, but "Sublime" cruelly tells Marinette that she doesn't know how to love Adrien, so she will, thus taking Marinette's place of being Adrien's girlfriend. Marinette, left all alone, breaks down into tears, absolutely devastated.
As the real Adrien walks into the vegetable garden, the real Prem comments he's not looking too good.
Adrien informs that Prem was right all along: catching up on their conversation during Ancient Greek class, he says he and Marinette are no longer together.
However, Prem clarifies he does not take that class, which Adrien rebukes by explaining he was sitting right next to him earlier.
Yet, Prem promises to Adrien that he was in the vegetable garden all morning waiting for the hatchlings, with the real Marinette also being in the vegetable garden; he shows him the video he recorded of what happened earlier.

title: Heartfixer
text:
Heartfixer - Plot
Adrien deduces that she and Nino were telling the truth all along.
He rushes inside the school to find Marinette, and notices the fake versions of himself, Sublime, and Alya.
He finds and witnesses the Couplewreckers transforming back, recording the "Sublime" incident, and celebrating their victory with Chrysalis, making him realize it was a trap all along.
The bully trio return to their normal selves as an ultrakuma leaves Nelson's phone, and since they do not remember what they did whilst they were akumatized, they watch the recorded video.
Chrysalis is revealed to be hiding in-person in the school library.
She states that it is time to move on to the next, most important part of her plan - the reason why she agreed to help the trio, who she deems as "incompetent", in the first place.
As the trio walks outside, Loïc spots an ultrakuma, snarking that he knows a girl who's about to get akumatized.
Adrien, overhearing this, transforms into Cat Noir, desperate to save Marinette before it's too late.
Marinette cannot forgive herself for what she did.
Tikki attempts to console her, only to spot the ultrakuma coming their way.

title: Heartfixer
text:
Heartfixer - Plot
Tikki warns Marinette about the approaching ultrakuma, but is interrupted by Cat Noir kicking the door in, summoning his Cataclysm, and making a mad dash to Marinette.
However, he just barely misses the ultrakuma, with it entering Marinette's purse.
In Marinette's mind, Chrysalis begins to talk to her about Adrien shattering her heart.
At a loss for what to do, Cat Noir decides to de-transform back into Adrien to have a better chance at convincing her to reject the akuma.
However, upon hearing Chrysalis saying she can give her the power to fix broken hearts and fix her relationship without hurting anyone, Marinette succumbs to Chrysalis's persuasion.
She becomes the villain known as Heartfixer, horrifying both Tikki and Adrien as she is akumatized before their very eyes.
Chrysalis requests Heartfixer to bring her Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous, which she remarks shouldn't be a problem if Heartfixer is Ladybug.
Adrien begs her to respond to him.
As she does, she states she is no longer Marinette, but Heartfixer.
As she tries to blast Adrien to fix his broken heart, he begs her to stop.

title: Heartfixer
text:
Heartfixer - Plot
Heartfixer is able to resist Chrysalis pestering her into admitting she's Ladybug just long enough for Adrien to envelop her in a hug.
Adrien convinces Heartfixer that the bully trio stole their appearances to deceive them and drive them both into despair.
Adrien asks Heartfixer for forgiveness, apologizing for not trusting her earlier.
Heartfixer states that she, of course, will forgive him.
The two kiss, with Heartfixer immediately rejecting the ultrakuma, and as a result, being restored to normal as Marinette.
Tikki and Plagg watch their owners rekindle their relationship, heartfelt.
Back in the library, Chrysalis is furious that she still gained nothing out of what happened.
She vows that she will uncover Marinette's secrets one day and leaves the library.
In the vegetable garden, the trio of bullies rewatched a video of themselves ending Marinette and Adrien's relationship, feeling satisfied with their actions.
However, they soon overheard and witnessed Marinette and Adrien leaving the school hand in hand, while their classmates celebrated the couple's relationship.
Alya and Nino approached them, and the four of them exchanged apologies, which infuriated the bullies.

title: Heartfixer
text:
Heartfixer - Plot
Meanwhile, Prem was watching the hatchlings fly for the first time.
In a moment of chaos, Nelson accidentally dropped his phone as the hatchlings flew into him and his friends.
The phone landed in the water trough, breaking in the process.
It then shorted out from the water, damaging the electrical circuits and destroying all their footage for good.
At the end of the school day, after Alya and Nino walked out together, Adrien asked Marinette if her earlier question had something to do with the letter meant for him.
Marinette confirmed it was a poem but added that it wasn't ready yet.
Back at Marinette's house, Alya points out the one good thing of what happened today is that she came up with a nickname for Nino called "My Little Canelé".
Alya notices Marinette looking sad and Marinette states that she let herself get Akumatized and cannot seem to forgive herself for doing, feeling she was no longer worthy of being a guardian or holding her Miraculous and attempted to give both to Alya, dubbing her Scarabella once again.
Alya stopped her, reminding her that she didn't put anyone in danger, and Tikki backs Alya up as Marinette was able to reject the akumatization in time.

title: Heartfixer
text:
Heartfixer - Plot
While Marinette admits they are right, it was only because of Adrien and just can't bare to think about what could have happened if he wasn't there.
Alya reassures Marinette, saying that she shouldn't blame herself for things that never occurred as everyone has moments of weakness and encourages her to be as kind to herself as she is to others.
They both share a hug.
In the epilogue, at Marinette's room, Marinette questions herself if Adrien is ready to know the truth about his father, but then realizes that it is herself who is not ready to tell him. Tikki questions why, and Marinette responds because if the truth will cause her and Adrien to split up, that could lead to Marinette becoming akumatized once more, the consequences of which would be catastrophic. She decides to transform into Ladybug to keep the letter safe in her yo-yo; where the truth will be protected at all costs.

title: Heartfixer
text:
Heartfixer - Plot Developments
Raymond Pugnant, Loïc Stompet, and Nelson de Glusset try to break up Marinette and Adrien, continuing their attempts to break up couples from "Vampigami" and "Sleeping Syren".
This is not their first attempt as they started in "Grendiaper", by writing some disrespectful words on Marinette's love letter for Adrien, which is shown in Loïc's flashback from that episode. Loïc implies they attempted several times to break them up and failed every time.
This caused them a great deal of frustration, as each failed attempt only seemed to drive the two of them even closer, realizing that breaking their relationship would have a huge effect.
To succeed, they offer themselves to Chrysalis as willing targets for akumatization.
Marinette continues to be plagued by her lie regarding Gabriel Agreste's identity as Monarch to protect Adrien. She lied to him and the world at large in "Miraculous London" as Gabriel's request at the end of "Re-creation" and was plagued by this lie for the whole season, especially in episodes like "El Toro De Piedra", "Mister Agreste", "Revelator" and later  "Lady Chaos".

title: Heartfixer
text:
Heartfixer - Plot Developments
Much like in "Mister Agreste", Marinette wanted to tell Adrien the truth by giving him the letter Gabriel wrote and left for him in "El Toro De Piedra," but didn't go through with it. While in the former, Nathalie stopped her by saying that it's too late to tell Adrien the truth, this time Marinette doesn't do it because she was still not ready for Adrien to know the truth and because if the truth would break her and Adrien up and she allows herself to be akumatized again the consequences would be catastrophic.
Adrien did see the closed letter with his name on it, but Marinette lies and says that it's an unfinished poem.
Since he is Cat Noir and his akumatization from the emotional turmoil would likewise be catastrophic, as demonstrated in "Cat Blanc" and "Ephemeral," Marinette unknowingly avoided, or at least delayed, another similar scenario.
To prevent Adrien from reading the letter until he is ready for it, Marinette decides to place it inside Ladybug's yo-yo, where it will become unreachable to anyone else, remaining in a quantic state.

title: Heartfixer
text:
Heartfixer - Plot Developments
This idea had already been proposed in "Yaksi Gozen", where Félix and Kagami asked Marinette to keep their respective amokized rings in Ladybug's yo-yo until they gave up on that idea at the end and chose to keep their rings.
This is the very first episode in the series' history in which Marinette is transformed into an akumatized villain, despite it being so for a very short time.
As of now, this makes the cousins Adrien/Cat Noir and Felix/Argos the only members of the Miraculers (both past and present) who haven't been fully akumatized, though Felix came close in "Gabriel Agreste", but he rejects it.
Counting the erased timelines in "Cat Blanc" and "Ephemeral", Félix is the only one to have never been fully akumatized.
Counting Félix's near-akumatization, Adrien is the only member of the Miraculers not to be infected by an akuma in the permanent timeline, although he unknowingly came close in "Transmission".
Also, this is the second time a current or former guardian is akumatized, following Wang Fu in "Furious Fu".
Ironically, this also makes Marinette, the last one of the Miraculers to be akumatized.

title: Heartfixer
text:
Heartfixer - Plot Developments
This is the first time ever where a kwami besides Nooroo sees their holder being akumatized rather than the usual where said person becomes akumatized first then a Miraculous holder.
The reason Chrysalis agreed to assist the Couplewreckers was she could directly akumatize Marinette to force her to divulge if she is Ladybug after being shown to suspect her in "Vampigami".
However, because Heartfixer never confirmed to her if she was Ladybug or not since Adrien helped de-akumatized her, Chrysalis still doesn't have the confirmation of her suspicions to prove that Marinette is Ladybug.
It is revealed that Chrysalis' akumatized victims can no longer hear the people around them during the akumatization process.
However, it is possible Marinette was so wrecked by despair that she toned down her awareness, since she also didn't hear Tikki's warning about the Ultrakuma.

title: Heartfixer
text:
Heartfixer - Trivia
Based on worldwide episode release order, this is the second in-person appearance of Chrysalis following "Yaksi Gozen".
Aglaé and Diane are the only known students who don't appear on Nelson's list.
Curiously, despite this, Aglaé briefly confronts Marinette over what she did not being nice.
As of this episode, all students who have been part of Miss Bustier's class in the first saga have been akumatized, although both of Adrien's akumatizations happened in now-erased timelines.
Cat Noir's transformation has been fully remade in the new art style.
This is also the third time in the whole series (and the first time in the second saga) where Adrien is sad when he transforms into Cat Noir. The first being "Santa Claws", and the second being "Rocketear".
At the end of the episode, when Marinette and Adrien walk out and reconcile with Alya and Nino, Alya saying "I'm so sorry" is much louder in the English dub compared to the French dub, in which the same line is difficult to hear.
It's revealed that Marinette has filled up multiple diaries over the seasons where she talks about her secrets, with the old ones being hidden at various locations in her room.

title: Heartfixer
text:
Heartfixer - Trivia
Two diaries, hidden under the floorboards, are from the first three seasons, before she became the guardian.
Three more, hidden behind a secret door in her wall, are from seasons 4 and 5, before Monarch was defeated.
And more than twenty diaries, hidden in a compartment behind her class photo (then in "Reflekta"), are just from when she started keeping the truth from Adrien at the end of Season 5.
According to Tikki, at least fifteen of those diaries are from the same month that this episode takes place in.
This is the second time Adrien/Cat Noir faces an akumatized villain on his own, following Nightormentor in "Representation".
However, this time, he doesn't directly fight the villain, instead he reasons with her, causing Heartfixer to break free from the akuma.
Marinette doesn't transform into Ladybug throughout the whole episode until the post-credit scene.
Previously, she didn't transform at all in "Transmission".
References
Adrien and Marinette eat breakfast together in Adrien's kitchen. In "Vampigami", they were revealed to have started doing that sometime before the episode.

title: Heartfixer
text:
Heartfixer - Trivia
When confronting Nino over him and Marinette (actually Ray and Loïc) kissing, Adrien mentions Nino's brief attraction towards Marinette in "Animan".
Marinette came close to being akumatized or appeared to be so at several points throughout the series:
She was partially akumatized in "Ladybug", "Elation" and "Derision", though none of those transformations came to fruition.
Her akumatized object as Heartfixer ended up being the same one when she was partially akumatized into Princess Justice in "Ladybug": her purse.
Like in "Elation", Adrien was instrumental in helping Marinette resist akumatization, specifically through a kiss, preventing a disaster without even knowing it.
She was nearly akumatized in "Zombizou" and "Chameleon" as well as in an erased alternate timeline in "Cat Blanc", but the akuma didn't infect her in time.
Ironically, her akumatization happened from the same reason it nearly happened in "Cat Blanc": her sadness and despair over losing Adrien.
While heartbroken, she mumbled "This is a nightmare and I can't wake up"; she did have a nightmare over losing Adrien in "Mister Agreste", though it ended with Adrien being the one akumatized.

title: Heartfixer
text:
Heartfixer - Trivia
Additionally, Adrien as Cat Noir tried to cataclysm the Ultrakuma before it reached Marinette, in a similar fashion to what he did in "Cat Blanc", but this time he failed to do so.
A fake version of her akumatized as Ladybug was shown in "Catalyst".
She briefly pretended to be akumatized into "Soapinator" in "Sublimation".
In "Miraculous Paris", she was affected by the power of an alternate Butterfly Miraculous, becoming Ladybiquity. However, instead of being akumatized and turning into a supervillain, she was kamikotized and turning into a superhero instead.
This episode has multiple parallels to "Cat Blanc", such as:
Marinette saying "It can't end like this, I love you Adrien" and Adrien saying "It can't end like this, it can't end at all".
Marinette saying "I'm not Marinette anymore, I'm Heartfixer" and Cat Noir saying "I'm not Cat Noir anymore, I'm Cat Blanc".
This, however, applies to most akumatized villains when they are referred to by their true names.
While one was akumatized, the other tried to help them fight the Butterfly holder's influence.
Adrien transformed to save his lover from an incoming akuma.

title: Heartfixer
text:
Heartfixer - Trivia
Cat Blanc accuses Ladybug of breaking his heart, while Heartfixer declares that she wants to mend Adrien's.
So much destruction was done all because someone else was being selfish.
In different ways, this episode is parallel to "Weredad", "Rocketear", "Ephemeral" and "Elation", such as:
Both Adrien and Marinette were devastated that their hearts were broken, though this time it was real, unlike "Weredad", when it was an act on Marinette's part.
Like in "Elation" with Cat Noir, Marinette was so devastated by Adrien's rejection that she fell prey to akumatization (this time fully); ironically, unknown to her, she was rejected by the same person.
Like in "Rocketear":
Both boys believed they were being cheated on by their best friends but weren't as Nino fooled himself into thinking that while Adrien got fooled by the Couplewreckers.
Both were shown evidence that revealed the truth; for Nino, it was a video illusion by Ladybug and Rena while Adrien discovered the akumatized Couplewreckers using their shapeshifting powers after Prem showed him the video of Marinette on his phone.
Like in "Ephemeral":
One found the other akumatized in the theater.

title: Heartfixer
text:
Heartfixer - Trivia
Both Adrien and Marinette's akumatizations didn't last long.
Both episodes are a reversal involving "Cat Blanc", where in that episode Adrien found out, Ladybug's identity first but in "Ephemeral", she found out first. This time, like in "Cat Blanc", this episode emphasizes the danger if Marinette is akumatized, whereas, she could spill every secret, especially her identity, which will cause the truth to come out too soon.
This would've been the same as "Cat Blanc", as both found out the truth about something but weren't given the chance to solve the problem peacefully.
Following "Ladybug" and "Representation", now Adrien without knowing it, is getting closer to understanding his partner.
Marinette's turmoil could also be from all the hard-work and pain, she had to go through to finally have Adrien as her beloved, only to watch it get destroyed in an instant. The same with Adrien in "Mister Agreste", where he felt guilty finally believing that there were no more secrets between them again (except for their identities).

title: Heartfixer
text:
Heartfixer - Trivia
Marinette's despair, emotional breakdown and desire to fix her and Adrien's relationship which led to her succumbing to akumatization can also stem from her still healing emotionally after losing her grandfather Roland Dupain in the previous episode, as she couldn't bear losing someone else (in a different way) so soon, especially not the person she loves the most.
This is the fifth time where there is no Lucky Charm following "Catalyst", "Risk", "Representation" and "Conformation".
This is the fourth episode where someone willingly set themselves up to be akumatized. Raymond Pugnant, Loïc Stompet, and Nelson de Glusset count as the sixth. Chloé Bourgeois was the first in "Penalteam", the second was Jalil Kubdel in "Reunion", and the third was Lila Rossi in "Revelation".
Their powers as the Couplewreckers are similar to Lila's while akumatized as Chameleon in the eponymous episode.
Their shapeshifting power however appears to be more powerful than Chameleon's - while she needed to kiss another person to assume their appearance, they could change freely by pressing on the image of a person they had on their akumatized phone.

title: Heartfixer
text:
Heartfixer - Trivia
Ironically, while the Couplewreckers' actions lead to Marinette's akumatization, Lila was akumatized with an akuma originally meant for Marinette.
A piano instrumental cover of "Chaos Will Reign Today" from Ladybug & Cat Noir: The Movie is heard when the fake Sublime and Adrien leave Marinette.
Errors
When Marinette starts to cry, her left hand clips through her bangs for a few shots.
When all of Marinette's diaries fall on her, her right elbow clips through her duvet.
During Adrien's transformation, his jacket reappears briefly, even though his torso should already have transformed. His staff also isn’t shown during his transformation.
In the scene where Marinette tries to give her earrings to Alya, Marinette and Tikki both zoom out, but the background does not zoom out along with them.
As Loïc is transforming into Marinette, most of her hair is missing for a frame.
In the flashback, when Loïc is shown walking away after writing the message, his pencil disappears and his hand glitches.
When Heartfixer first talks to Adrien her purse disappears form her right hand.

title: Heartfixer
text:
Heartfixer - Trivia
The official Disney Channel YouTube page's upload of what is supposed to be the Marinette and Adrien break-up scene is mistakenly a clip from the Hannah Montana episode "Oops! Meddled Again" instead.
The correct video was uploaded four days later.
In the European Portuguese dub, after undoing the Couplewreckers' akumatization and preparing for the next part of her plan, Chrysalis is heard talking with the double voice effect she uses to speak with her victims.

title: Heartfixer/Transcript
text:
Heartfixer/Transcript - Intro
Ray: The beautiful, perfect couple.
Prem: (dancing) They're so in love!
(Mylène and Ivan look at them fondly from afar.)
Rose: (dramatically swoons onto Juleka) They always knew they were meant for each other!
(Marinette puts her head on Adrien's shoulder.)
Ray: The model everyone wants to be like. So much happiness... it's unbearable, insufferable, unacceptable!
Loïc: It's not like we didn't try to break them up.
Marinette: There! (grabs the box)
Adrien: It's absolutely delicious, Marinette!
(He reads the message in the box.)
Adrien: "Adrien, my love for you is like this tart — the only thing left of it are a few crumbs." That's awful!
Marinette: Ah?! I didn't write this! I have no idea how it got here. I promise!
Adrien: Don't worry, Marinette. I know you wouldn't write that.
(The two share a heartfelt embrace.)
Loïc: But it never works!
Loïc: Worse! The harder we try, the closer they get!
Adrien: When I'm with you, I can be myself. I love you, Marinette.
(The two lean in to kiss. Their boat creates heart-shaped ripples on the lake's surface.)
Nelson: If we could couplewreck them, it'd be like destroying love itself!

title: Heartfixer/Transcript
text:
Heartfixer/Transcript - Intro
Nelson: But we need a little help to ensure our success this time.
Loïc: This is lame! It's not working at all!
Nelson: Shush, Loïc! Focus on your hatred.
(The three of them collectively grunt, until finally, the Ultrakuma infects the phone.)
Chrysalis: Hello, you three.
[ Theme Song ]
Marinette: (v.o.) Dear diary, that's it! Adrien and I are officially a couple. Even when I feel his hand in mine, I cannot believe it sometimes. But I think I know why. The truth is, I still can't be myself because I lied to him, and to the entire world, and...
Marinette: Oh, shoot! Drat! I need to buy a new diary.
Tikki: Again? But, Marinette, you already bought fifteen this month!
Marinette: (sits right up) Writing does me a lot of good, Tikki. I write whatever I can't say and, since there are a lot of things I can't say like, you know, the fact that Adrien's father was a supervillain, well I write a lot.

title: Heartfixer/Transcript
text:
Heartfixer/Transcript - Intro
Tikki: Okay, but that's a lot a "lot". Look, (opens a compartment on the wooden floor, showing two diaries) this is before you became the Guardian of the Miraculous, (opens a compartment on her wall, showing at least three diaries) this is when you became the Guardian, (opens a compartment under the class picture, which has a lot more diaries than what the last two compartments had) and this is since you've been hiding the truth from Adrien.
(After a while, the mountain of diaries comes crumbling down over Marinette.)
Tikki: Don't you think it's time to make some room in that cupboard and in your head?
Marinette: But if I tell Adrien the truth, it'll do him too much harm. And I can't bear to see him suffer, Tikki.
Tikki: And I can't bear to see you suffer like this.
Marinette: Either I suffer by lying to him and Adrien remains happy, or I tell him the truth and we'll both be very unhappy.
Tikki: But how do you know for sure that he'll be sad?

title: Heartfixer/Transcript
text:
Heartfixer/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: I don't, Tikki. (inserts the letter in one of the pockets in her backpack) So, I have to make sure whether or not Adrien is ready to know the truth. And if he is, I'll give him this letter from his father telling Adrien the whole truth about his reasons for being a supervillain. And if he's not ready, I'll keep the letter.
Adrien: (stands up from his seat) I didn't tell you. This morning, Sublime and I ran five kilometers in twenty-one minutes.
Marinette: Congrats! That's awesome!
(The couple pack up their things and grab their bags. Adrien can't help but notice the letter at the side of Marinette's backpack with his name on it.)
Adrien: Uh, is that letter for me?
Marinette: No! Uh— I mean, yes. (hides it inside her backpack's main pocket and squeaks in panic)
Adrien: Aren't you going to give it to me?
Marinette: No! Not yet, because um... first, (laughs nervously) I need to know whether...
(They walk out the door to the courtyard.)
Adrien: Know whether what?
Marinette: I need to know what would happen if, uhm, say I was bringing you chouquettes one morning, thinking that you love them and found out that you actually like croissants better, and that you hid it from me.

title: Heartfixer/Transcript
text:
Heartfixer/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: (wears his helmet) But I love chouquettes and I'm not hiding anything from you.
Marinette: I know that, but how would you react if you were me and found out that you actually don't like them? (wears her helmet)
Adrien: Are you saying that... you don't like chouquettes?
Marinette: No! I love chouquettes! But uh— ARGH! See, that's what I'm trying to say! (rides on the scooter) Now's not the time. (Adrien rides on the scooter.) I'll give you the letter later.
Adrien: Sure, okay. But you know, whether it's chouquettes or a croissant, as long as it's from you, I'll be happy.
(Marinette giggles at his remark. They both drive off from the mansion.)
Alya: Want to sit at our usual table?
(Nino agrees. An unknown student points their phone camera at Alya and Nino while they're going to their table. The student zooms in on them and takes a photo.)
Nino: Bon appétit!
Adrien: Do you want to try running the 5K in less than 20 minutes tomorrow morning?
Sublime: You'll try. I intend to succeed. ("Prem" sits at their table.) You're taking Ancient Greek, Prem?
"Prem": Yes, Princess Sublime, so I'll be able to watch Gladiator movies in their original language.

title: Heartfixer/Transcript
text:
Heartfixer/Transcript - Intro
(Adrien and Sublime share laughter. Their Greek teacher now stands before the class.)
Greek teacher: Alright. Turn your tablets on and open Folder 12 named "Socrates on Love".
(Adrien opens his tablet. "Prem" taps on his shoulder to grab his attention.)
"Prem": Psst, isn't that Marinette over there with Nino?
(He points out the window, where Adrien takes a look and sees Marinette and Nino suspiciously together. Adrien gasps in shock upon seeing them. Just then, Marinette grabs Nino and runs away with him. Adrien seems to feel... betrayed.)
Sublime: You okay, Adrien?
Adrien: Yeah, yeah. I... I thought I saw... Nothing. I didn't see anything.
Greek teacher: On love, Socrates would say it's mainly a matter of desire, and that you only desire things that you don't have.
(The camera pans to "Prem", who also seems to look quite suspicious, as he gives a menacing smile. The camera continuously pans to the rooftop garden, where Marinette is harvesting crops.)
Marinette: Obviously, my whole scenario about chouquettes and croissants wasn't clear enough.
Tikki: Maybe you should ask Adrien your real question.
Marinette: (puts an apple in her basket and stands up) You're right, Tikki.

title: Heartfixer/Transcript
text:
Heartfixer/Transcript - Intro
(Meanwhile, Prem takes a video of bird eggs that are about to hatch.)
Prem: It's time! (notices Marinette and points his camera at her) Princess Marinette! Come see this! They're about to hatch— Huh?
(Seconds later, Marinette disappears from his sight. Prem doesn't seem to mind and puts his attention back to the new bird hatchlings.)
Prem: Aren't you just the cutest baby birdies?!
"Prem": I didn't know you and Princess Marinette were no longer together.
Adrien: No, no. We're still together, Prem.
"Prem": Oh. But earlier in the courtyard, Marinette and Nino...
Adrien: I... I'm sure there's an explanation.
"Prem": (sighs and then abruptly embraces Adrien) I wish you good luck, my friend.
(Adrien looks surprised at the gesture. As "Prem" walks away, he grimaces with his back turned to Adrien.)
Aglaé: Marinette, you— what you did was really bad!
Marinette: (clueless) What did I do? (runs to Adrien) Adrien! Hey! I wanted to know how you would react if you found out that someone was hiding something from you, for your own good?
Adrien: Why? Do you have something to confess, Marinette?
Marinette: Uhh... if I did, would you really want me to tell you?
Adrien: Of course, Marinette.

title: Heartfixer/Transcript
text:
Heartfixer/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Even if it's a terrible truth to find out? Even if it has nothing to do with croissants or chouquettes?
Adrien: (gasps and scowls) Does it have something to do with what you were doing in the yard during my Ancient Greek class?
Marinette: The yard? I wasn't in the yard. I was in the vegetable garden.
(Adrien seems doubtful.)
Nino: (walks in with Alya) Hey, lovebirds! How's it going?
Adrien: Okay, I get it.
Nino: Get what now?
Adrien: You two are pranking me, aren't you?
(Nino and Marinette look at each other in confusion.)
Marinette: Huh? What are you talking about?
Adrien: I have to say, you really got me, even though I didn't find it very funny. Next time, try to come up with something less stressful. Alright, I've got to go to fencing class. (gives Marinette a kiss on her cheek) But I'll see you later! (walks away)
(On the roof, three people who appear to be Prem, Marinette, and Nino are spying on the Core Four.)
"Prem": They really are unbearable, but not inseparable. We just need to take it a little further, guys, but we're almost there.
"Nino": Nuh-uh!
(The Nino doppelgänger morphs back to what appears to be Loïc, akumatized.)

title: Heartfixer/Transcript
text:
Heartfixer/Transcript - Intro
Couplewrecker Loïc: No way! Not happening!
Couplewrecker Ray: (as Marinette) We said no kissing! (morphs back to himself)
Couplewrecker Nelson: (as Prem) Okay... (morphs back to himself) But that means we'll never succeed.
Couplewrecker Ray: (brings out the akumatized phone) Okay, fine. But Loïc's the one playing Marinette, and we'll only pretend to do it like in the movies.
Couplewrecker Nelson: (sighs) Fine.
(Ray browses the list of students in his phone, and presses on Nino's picture, which morphs him into Nino. Then, Ray tosses the phone to Loïc. Loïc presses Marinette's photo, which morphs him into Marinette.)
Couplewrecker Nelson: Believe me, it'll be worth it. (morphs into Alya) This plan cannot fail.
Marinette: Did you get why Adrien was talking about a prank earlier?
Alya: Nope. I just figured it had something to do with your convo before Nino and I showed up. What were you chatting about?
Marinette: Uhh, chouquettes and croissants.
Alya: (skeptical) Yeah, right.
Marinette: I... wanted to know which one Adrien likes best.
Alya: Marinette, what I like best is when you just say you don't want me to know what you were talking about instead of all this made-up baloney.

title: Heartfixer/Transcript
text:
Heartfixer/Transcript - Intro
(Marinette frowns as she continues molding her clay vase.)
"Alya": Sorry to disturb, but the principal sent me to get Nino.
(Nino stands up from his seat and goes out with Alya.)
Nino: What does Mr. Damoclès want with me?
"Alya": He doesn't want anything, but I have a surprise for you. (drags Nino to the other side of the corridor and pushes him to sit down)
Nino: Woah! What is it?

Nino: Okayyy.
(As Nino keeps his eyes shut, "Alya" walks away and morphs into "Mr. Damoclès". He proceeds to the school gym, where Adrien is fencing with Kagami.)
Armand: Keep your guard up, Adrien.
