(Adrien follows "Mr. Damoclès" out of the room. In the corridor, Nino is seen sticking his hand close to Marinette while she's leaning on the window, to Adrien's surprise.)
Adrien: (gasps) Marinette? Nino?!
("Marinette" kisses "Nino", which, of course, makes Adrien very, VERY shocked. "Marinette" and "Nino" pull away from the kiss as they see Adrien in shock and start running away.)
Adrien: Marinette! (chases after the two.) Hey! Hold on!

title: Heartfixer/Transcript
text:
Heartfixer/Transcript - Intro
("Mr. Damoclès" grimaces at the sight. "Nino" and "Marinette" quickly morph into "Kim" and "Ivan", respectively. Adrien catches up with them.)
Adrien: Hey, have you guys seen Marinette and Nino?!
("Kim" and "Ivan" shake their heads no. Adrien storms out in the courtyard, seeing no signs of "Nino" and "Marinette". And just then...)
Nino: Hey, buddy! You seen Alya?
Adrien: "Buddy"? Seriously?! I just saw you and Marinette kissing and you're acting like nothing happened?!
Nino: Huh? Me?! Kissing Marinette?! You're joking, right?
Adrien: Don't you try to lie to me, like you've never been interested in her!
Marinette: What are you guys talking about?
Adrien: The fact that you and Nino have fallen in love with each other!
Marinette: WHAT?!
Nino: No way, dude!
Adrien: That's what you wrote in the letter that you can't bring yourself to tell me, isn't it?! You no longer loving me is one thing. You can't control it. But you lying to me on top of it is just... HEARTLESS!
Alya: Is he telling the truth?!
Nino: Of course not!
Adrien: (tearing up) How did it come to this? I THOUGHT WE WERE ALL FRIENDS?!
Nino: Stop it! Of course, we're buddies!

title: Heartfixer/Transcript
text:
Heartfixer/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Adrien, I have no idea what's going on. You're the one I love!
Adrien: Please stop lying to me. Just say what you've actually been trying to tell me since this morning!
Marinette: But—
Alya: So that's what your whole "chouquettes and croissants" thing was all about!
Marinette: WHAT?!
Alya: Adrien is the chouquette and Nino is the croissant. You used to loveee chouquettes, but now you like croissants better. It all makes sense now.
Nino: HUH?!
Alya: And you, croissant kid! I thought we were honest about everything?! We promised we'd never lie to each other!
Nino: But, my little raisin bun, you know I'd never lie to you!
(Without a word, Alya tears up and runs away, disappointed.)
Alya: Don't ever talk to me again!
Marinette: I don't understand. What's happening...?!
Adrien: Since you can't bring yourself to say the truth, I'll do it for you, Marinette. YOU AND I ARE OVER! (storms out, heartbroken and crying)
Marinette: ADRIEN!
(She chases after Adrien. On a balcony, the Couplewreckers are seen spying on them.)
"Kim": Yeah! Two couples for the price of one!

title: Heartfixer/Transcript
text:
Heartfixer/Transcript - Intro
"Mr. Damoclès": Stay focused, guys. In order to destroy love, you've got to break both halves. (morphs into Sublime) You'll be Adrien while Ray shoots the grand finale.
("Ivan", or rather Loïc, morphs into Adrien, while Ray, acting as Kim, morphs into Alya.)
Marinette: Adrien! (sees "Adrien" sitting beside a table, crying with his head down) Adrien, I don't know what's happening but... I promise you, you're the only one I'm in love with.
(Marinette attempts to reach out to "Adrien", but he shrugs, brushing Marinette's hand off his shoulder.)
Marinette: Why won't you believe me anymore?
"Sublime": (barges in) Adrien! (to Marinette) What happened?!
Marinette: I don't know! I don't understand!
("Adrien" hugs "Sublime" and buries his head on her shoulders.)
"Sublime": Oh, Adrien... What did you do to him?!
Marinette: Nothing at all, none of this makes any sense!
("Adrien" nods. The two Couplewreckers walk away to leave the room.)
Marinette: It can't end like this! Adrien! I... I love you!
"Sublime": You don't know how to love him, so I will.

title: Heartfixer/Transcript
text:
Heartfixer/Transcript - Intro
("Adrien" and "Sublime" leave Marinette alone in the amphitheater. Alone with her heart shattered into pieces, she falls down on her knees as she cries.)
Marinette: This is a nightmare! (sobs)
Prem: Prince Adrien? You're not looking too good.
Adrien: You were right, Prem. Marinette and I are no longer together.
Prem: Huh? What are you talking about?
Adrien: The thing you showed me this morning in Ancient Greek class.
Prem: (confused) I don't take Ancient Greek.
Adrien: You were sitting right next to me?
Prem: I promise, Prince Adrien, I've been here all morning, waiting for the chicks to take flight.
Adrien: Are you playing a joke on me too?
Prem: Of course not! Ask Marinette. She was in the vegetable garden with me. (plays the footage on his phone) "Princess Marinette, come see this!" (pauses the video)
Adrien: Wait a minute... If you were here and Marinette was here too, then who was in the courtyard with Nino?
Prem: (shrugs) I don't know, considering I was here.
Adrien: Something's not right, I have to talk to Marinette!
(Adrien immediately runs back inside the school. As he reaches for the door, he sees his doppelgänger with "Sublime".)

title: Heartfixer/Transcript
text:
Heartfixer/Transcript - Intro
"Sublime": You don't know how to love him, (The real Adrien gasps.) so I will.
(Adrien notices "Alya" filming the situation the entire time. He hides behind the wall.)
"Alya": Cut!
(The Couplewreckers smugly walk after breaking Marinette. The three of them morph back into their normal selves — Loïc, Ray, and Nelson.)
Adrien: (to himself) Supervillains!
Chrysalis: (v.o.) Well done, Couplewreckers. You did it.
Couplewrecker Ray: We rock!
Couplewrecker Loïc: We broke everyone's spirits!
Couplewrecker Nelson: We destroyed love!
Chrysalis: (v.o.) Glad I could be of help.
Adrien: Plagg, claws—
(Just as Adrien is about to transform, the Ultrakuma is now flying out the door. He peeks from the door again to see what's happening.)
Plagg: WHAT THE SMELL?!
(The Couplewreckers are already stripped of their powers and are in the process of deakumatizing.)
Ray: Is it over? (flicks his hair)
Loïc: I don't remember a thing. Did it work?
Nelson: Let's find out. (plays the video on his phone)
Marinette: (in the video) It can't end like this! Adrien! I... I love you!
"Sublime": (in the video) You don't know how to love him, so I will.
(In the footage, Marinette is down on her knees.)

title: Heartfixer/Transcript
text:
Heartfixer/Transcript - Intro
Ray: We really did it!
Loïc: We wrecked them!
Nelson: No more Marinette and Adrien!
Chrysalis: It's time to move on to the most interesting part of my plan — the part that made me agree to help those three incompetents!
Nelson: No more love!
Adrien: (to himself) It was a trap!
(Adrien hides once again as the three walk out the door. They are then greeted by an Ultrakuma, which flies inside and targets its victim.)
Loïc: I know a girl who’s about to get akumatized, alright.
Adrien: Marinette!
[Transformation Sequence]
Adrien: Plagg, claws out!
(He transforms into Cat Noir.)
Tikki: Marinette, I'm so sorry. (gasps) An Ultrakuma!
Marinette: This is a nightmare, and I can't wake up!
Cat Noir: (barges in) Cataclysm!
(Tikki quickly hides. In slow motion, Cat Noir runs to destroy the Ultrakuma, but he was too late, as the Ultrakuma has already infected Marinette's purse.)
Cat Noir: NO!
Chrysalis: (in Marinette's mind) Hello. Forgive my intrusion, but I heard your cry of despair as your boyfriend shattered your heart.
Marinette: (in her mind, crying) Adrien... My Adrien... I've lost my Adrien!
Tikki: Huh?
(As Cat Noir hears Marinette's cry of despair, realization dawns upon him.)

title: Heartfixer/Transcript
text:
Heartfixer/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: Claws in!
(He de-transforms.)
Adrien: Marinette, it's me!
Chrysalis: (in Marinette's mind) You'd do anything for your Adrien to love you again, wouldn't you?
Marinette: (in her mind, shaky voice) Y-yes! I-I love him more than anything!
Chrysalis: (in Marinette's mind) If only you had the power to fix people's broken hearts, that way, your boyfriend would love you again.
Adrien: Marinette, it was a trap! Can you hear me?!
Marinette: (in her mind) And that wouldn't hurt anyone?
Chrysalis: (in Marinette's mind) Of course not. It would only allow Adrien and you to be a loving couple again. I can give you that power, only if you agree, of course. (Marinette tries to reconsider and resist, but she gives in, hangs her head, and just sobs.) What should I call you?
Marinette: (in her mind) Heartfixer.

title: Heartfixer/Transcript
text:
Heartfixer/Transcript - Intro
(Chrysalis closes her fist around Marinette, sealing the deal. In reality, the mask indicating Chrysalis' psychic link with Marinette vanishes as Marinette is engulfed in the purple ether of being akumatized. Tikki gasps in horror. Adrien takes a step back as he also looks on in horror at what he just witnessed as, still engulfed in the ether, Marinette rises back to her feet. He can't believe it — Marinette has been akumatized. The ether soon recedes to show Marinette having now become Heartfixer, with her now holding her akumatized purse in her right hand by the lanyard. Chrysalis' mask reappears as she reestablishes her psychic link with her new champion.)
Chrysalis: In exchange for your power, Heartfixer, all I'm asking for are Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous, which should you happen to be Ladybug, shouldn't be too much of a problem. Are you Ladybug, Heartfixer?
Adrien: I'm begging you, Marinette. Answer me! (places his hand on her cheek)
Heartfixer: Adrien?
Adrien: Marinette!
Heartfixer: I'm no longer Marinette. I'm Heartfixer.
Adrien: Marinette!
Heartfixer: Once I fix your heart, you'll love me again! (fires heart-shaped bolts from her purse while Adrien dodges them)

title: Heartfixer/Transcript
text:
Heartfixer/Transcript - Intro
Chrysalis: You didn't answer my question, Heartfixer.
(Ignoring Chrysalis trying to prod her into admitting she's Ladybug, Heartfixer spins her purse, as she would as Ladybug with her yo-yo, as she prepares to attack again.)
Adrien: Stop it, Marinette!
Heartfixer: Let me fix your heart, then you'll love me again! (continuously fires heart-shaped bolts at Adrien)
Adrien: (evades Heartfixer's attacks) Marinette! Stop!
(For a moment, Heartfixer ceases her assault and grits her teeth in frustration as Chrysalis contacts her again.)
Chrysalis: Heartfixer, are you Ladybug?
(Heartfixer gasps and winces with a pained groan, struggling to keep her identity a secret. As she does, Heartfixer's hand trembles, but Adrien grabs her by the hand, taking the opportunity to embrace her from behind and unknowingly distract her.)
Adrien: You don't need to fix my heart, Marinette. It's already mended.
Heartfixer: (gasps) Is it...?
Chrysalis: No, don't listen to him. He's manipulating you!

title: Heartfixer/Transcript
text:
Heartfixer/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: They were akumatized villains, Marinette — Loïc, Nelson, Ray. They stole our appearances in order to trick us. I'm so sorry. I should've trusted you. How could I ever believe that you were lying to me?! Forgive me! I love you! (Heartfixer gasps.) I'm begging you! Tell me that you still love me too!
(Heartfixer drops her weapon and places her hand on Adrien's arms. She smiles, to Adrien's bewilderment.)
Heartfixer: Of course. I love you.
(After a lover's quarrel, the couple share a beautiful, heartfelt kiss, as the power of love breaks Chrysalis' hold on Heartfixer as the mask showing Chrysalis' psychic link appears and shatters, severing her connection to Marinette. Her purse goes back to normal, as well as Heartfixer, who transforms back into Marinette. The Ultrakuma flies away from her purse and is purified by itself. Adrien and Marinette stay in their positions, hugging each other and savoring the moment. Just behind the table, Tikki and Plagg watch their holders endearingly.)
Chrysalis: I'll have the answer to my question one day, Marinette Dupain-Cheng. I'm sure that you have secrets. And one day, I'll uncover them. (walks toward the shadows)

(He drops his phone below and into a water basin, breaking the phone in the process. It then shorts out from the water damaging the electrical circuits, erasing all their ill-gotten data on everyone at school, leaving them with nothing as punishment for their cruel act.)

Haprèle apartment - Intro
The  is the residence of Mylène and her father.

title: Haprèle apartment
text:
Haprèle apartment - Appearance
Exterior
The apartment is located on the second floor of a small Parisian building. It has a small balcony that Fred and Mylène have decorated with a wall rosette and several potted roses on the railing.
Interior
The Haprèles' apartment is quite small and contains numerous houseplants in its various rooms. It has a small, white-walled vestibule serving as an entrance, furnished with a small wooden storage unit topped with a small purple vase, and a mirror with a gold frame. This vestibule provides access to the different rooms of the apartment.
Kitchen
The room is quite small with an octagonal tiled floor reminiscent of the cells of a beehive with different shades ranging from honey yellow to orange.
The kitchen area features a white and blue tiled wall with a red fridge-freezer, a sink, and a stove with an oven and a range hood. Next to the stove is a microwave. On the side of the window, which is framed by a completely white wall, is a kitchen unit with a stack of plates and condiments.

title: Haprèle apartment
text:
Haprèle apartment - Appearance
The room also contains a small square table made of greyish-white wood, with two matching chairs placed opposite each other, as well as a stool, filling the space left vacant since Mylène's mother's departure. This table is placed against the low wall, creating an opening into the living room, with a white curtain with yellow stripes allowing for separation if needed.
Living Room
he living room is the largest room in the apartment. The room has wooden parquet flooring, a blue wall on the side open to the kitchen, white walls, as well as a white ceiling with a small light fixture and a large window.
The living room features a brown sofa, a small, three-tiered coffee table on casters with various placemats folded or unfolded, and a small green vase containing a houseplant. The table is flanked by two poufs resembling djembes: a large green one with a white top and pink strings, and a smaller brown and blue one. To the right of the sofa is a wooden vanity with a gold mirror and small wooden shelves.
The whole thing faces a wooden TV unit on which a grey cathode ray tube television is installed, next to which is a large wooden bookcase filled with books.
Mylène's room

title: Haprèle apartment

Mylène's room is quite small, with gray and purple walls and wooden floors. It also has a large window overlooking the street, beneath which sits a radiator. Above this radiator, Mylène has installed a wooden shelf to hold a vase of roses and a few books.
Arranged to maximize space, the room features a large, six-shelf blue-green bookcase, filled with various books and decorations, such as flowers, a photo frame, and a globe. Opposite the bookcase is a particularly high loft bed, accessed by a wide ladder. The bed has a large mattress and a red blanket with black stripes. One of the bedposts is painted in rainbow colors. Under the bed, Mylène uses a meditation area, furnished with a red yoga mat.
Next to the ladder is a small desk with a shelf and a vase of roses, with a "Save the planet" poster hanging on the wall above a drawing of a flower. Next to the desk is another laundry cabinet, with more books and some laundry baskets. This area also features a multicolored woven rug.
Bathroom
The bathroom has walls with smooth patinated green tiles.

title: Gyeongbokgung
text:
Gyeongbokgung - Intro
(경복궁; 景福宮), also known as Gyeongbok Palace, is a royal palace located north of Seoul, South Korea. It is one of the five great palaces built during the Joseon Dynasty.

title: Gyeongbokgung
text:
Gyeongbokgung - Description
First built in 1394 during the Joseon Dynasty and destroyed several times, most notably during the Imjin War (1592.–1598.) or during the Japanese occupation in the early 20th century, Gyeongbokgung has been restored since early 1989. This palace occupies a space of 432,703 square meters in northern Seoul.
Gwanghwamun
Gwanghwamun (광화문; 光化門) is the main gate of Gyeongbok Palace. It is one of Seoul's landmarks and a symbol of the city's history as the capital of Korea during the Joseon Dynasty. After extensive restoration, it was reopened in 2010.
This gate has a structure in which a single-story wooden gate tower is raised above a stone well. The stone well is vaulted and has three gates, the central one being the largest, and the western and eastern gates of the same shape and size. The arch is an internal and external arch, with arches only at the front and rear of the gate, and the nave ceiling is flat. The roof is hipped, and the eaves are double-sided. A sign with the black hanja inscription "門化光" on a white background.

title: Gyeongbokgung
text:
Gyeongbokgung - Activities
National Palace Museum of Korea
The National Palace Museum of Korea (국립민속박물관 ; 國立民俗博物館) displays 40,000 relics, artifacts and royal treasures from the Joseon Dynasty and the Korean Empire, 14 of which are classified as National Treasures of South Korea.
National Folk Museum of Korea
The National Folk Museum of Korea (국립민속박물관; 國立民俗博物館) is a museum showcasing Korean culture. It is divided into three sections. The first presents cultural features from prehistory to the Joseon period. The second displays tools for agriculture, hunting, and fishing, as well as clothing and dwellings, while the third illustrates the various stages of life, including birth, marriage, and death.

title: Gyeongbokgung
text:
Gyeongbokgung - Trivia
Gyeongbokgung has been classified as a historic site of South Korea since 1963.
Throughout its history, Gyeongbok Palace has been destroyed and then rebuilt several times.
One of its destructions occurred during the Imjin War (1592-1598), due to a premeditated fire by the Japanese army Azuchi Momoyama.
In the series' universe, it was during this war that Mudangbeolle and Yi Sun-sin distinguished themselves as Miraculous wielders.

title: Horrificator
text:
Horrificator - Intro
"" is a season 1 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 17th written and produced episode of season 1. It is also the 17th written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Horrificator
text:
Horrificator - Synopsis
Nickelodeon
When Marinette's class makes a short horror film, the lead actress is akumatized into a slimy monster that feeds off fear.
Netflix
During the filming of a short horror movie for Marinette's class, scared star Mylène is akumatized into a slimy monster that feeds on others' fears.
Disney+
Ladybug and Cat Noir face Horrificator, alias Mylène.

title: Horrificator
text:
Horrificator - Plot
In Literature classroom, Mylène and Adrien are holding water guns and hiding behind the teacher's desk. It is momentarily revealed that they are acting for a short film that Nino is making as an entry in a contest. Mylène is playing the role of Agent Smith while Adrien is playing the role of Officer Jones, and the two are devising a plan to take down a monster. However, the filming is interrupted when Mylène panics at the sight of Ivan's monster costume and screams.
To calm herself, Mylène sings "Smelly Wolf," but she backs up into Adrien and screams again. Chloé then makes fun of Mylène, making her run away. Adrien calls Chloé out on how mean she is, but Chloé dismisses it. Ivan runs after Mylène, trying to comfort her by saying that she's a better actress than she thinks and that the other students are being too quick to judge her.
He gives her a pin from his favorite band, the Zombie Skull Crushers.
Mylène puts the pin on her hat and thanks Ivan, but is still upset, and runs away to the bathroom, crying.
Hawk Moth, sensing Mylène's distress, sends an akuma after her.

title: Horrificator
text:
Horrificator - Plot
Back in the classroom, Nino rants to the class about how they treated Mylène and how because of that they no longer have their lead actress.
Chloé then states that Mylène was a horrible actress and that she could do better; Ivan scolds Chloé for how she treated Mylène.
As the producer, Marinette decides to go find Mylène, but the other students decide that until Mylène returns someone has to fill her role.
Chloé wants to take the part because of a scene in the script where Agent Smith kisses Inspector Jones.
Both Marinette and Alya freak out at the mention of this scene—Marinette because it could lead to Adrien and Chloé kissing, and Alya because she, as the scriptwriter, never wrote a kissing scene into the script.
Nino reveals that he added the scene himself, and this infuriates Alya, who says that Nino had no right to change the script and that the new scene does not contribute to the overall story and the development of the central characters.
Marinette stops the fighting and tells the class that she will find Mylène.

title: Horrificator
text:
Horrificator - Plot
Right before Marinette enters the bathroom, the akuma arrives and embeds itself inside Mylène's Zombie Skull Crushers pin. Hawk Moth offers Mylène the chance to make others scared and afraid and she accepts, transforming into Horrificator, a creature that feeds on fear. After her transformation, she coughs pink slime onto the mirror and hides in a stall as Marinette enters the bathroom and calls out for Mylène. Walking into the room, Marinette notices the slime on the mirror and begins to investigate, but is interrupted by Alya, who enters the bathroom and warns Marinette that the scene where Chloé kisses Adrien is in the process of being filmed. Marinette and Alya return and interrupt the scene before Chloé and Adrien have the chance to kiss.

title: Horrificator
text:
Horrificator - Plot
The students continue to argue. Chloé proposes turning Agent Smith into a nurse since she claims she would look good in a nurse's outfit. This irritates most of the students, but Marinette uses this as a diversion, suggesting that Chloé should go and find a nurse costume. Chloé leaves, taking Sabrina, Kim, and Max with her. Nino complains, as once again, they have no lead actress. Alya proposes that Marinette takes over the role of Agent Smith. Marinette protests this, but Alya quietly reminds her that this would be an opportunity to kiss Adrien. Marinette reluctantly agrees to take the role but says that Mylène will get to take over as soon as she gets back.
Meanwhile, Chloé, Sabrina, Kim, and Max are leaving the school as Horrificator watches from the roof. Chloé praises herself for the idea of getting a nurse's uniform. Arriving at the school's main door, Chloé realizes that Marinette is never a fan of her ideas, and suspects that they've all been tricked. She leads Sabrina back towards the classroom and tells Kim and Max to finish finding a nurse uniform. As Chloé and Sabrina leave, Horrificator sneaks up behind Kim and Max and startles them, causing them both to scream.

title: Horrificator
text:
Horrificator - Plot
Back in the classroom, Nino starts filming Marinette and Adrien. Marinette says one line and leans in to kiss Adrien. Before they have a chance to kiss, Chloé slams open the door and interrupt, yelling at Marinette for tricking her, and saying that the movie needs her in it because her father is one of the judges. Suddenly, yelling comes from elsewhere in the school.
The students run out into the courtyard only to find pink slime and Kim's armband. Marinette realizes that the pink slime is the same as what she had seen in the bathroom, and suggests that they find Principal Damoclès to talk about what to do. She notices Nino filming the situation and tells him to stop, but he refuses, suggesting that he can use this in his movie. Adrien heads back toward the classroom, claiming to be retrieving Officer Jones' jacket. As the other students run to Principal Damoclès' office, Horrificator begins wrapping pink slime around the entire school. In the classroom, Adrien removes his shoe—to make it look like he was taken by Horrificator—and transforms into Cat Noir. Marinette has a similar plan, dropping her phone in the hallway and transforming into Ladybug in the library.

title: Horrificator
text:
Horrificator - Plot
Inside the office, the students only find pink slime and realize that Principal Damoclès is missing. They head back out into the hallway and find Marinette's cellphone, presuming her to have been taken as well. They then realize that the entire school is covered in slime and that none of their cell phones has any signal. Ladybug arrives on the scene and tries to evacuate the students, but Cat Noir explains that slime is indestructible. He pulls Ladybug aside and reiterates the situation and what they have to do; Ladybug agrees completely. Nino films the entire scene.
Meanwhile, Horrificator carries Max to her lair in a maintenance area, holding him up by her tail. She drops him in a small pod of slime. As Max screams, Horrificator grows slightly larger, and Hawk Moth encourages Horrificator to absorb the fear of the students. Horrificator covers Max's pod with slime, trapping him inside.

title: Horrificator
text:
Horrificator - Plot
As the students follow Ladybug and Cat Noir across the school, Chloé breaks away from the group with Sabrina, saying that it would be safer for them to hide and draw less attention. The students arrive back in the original classroom, where they find Adrien's shoe on the floor. Nathaniel is captured by Horrificator, who was hiding under the desk. Ladybug tells the other students to run, and all of them flee except for Juleka and Nino. Horrificator growls at Juleka, but Juleka finds Horrificator to be cool rather than scary. This causes Horrificator to shrink slightly, but she coughs slime at Juleka, who is saved at the last minute by Ladybug as Cat Noir distracts Horrificator from doing so. Nino starts to film their fight but is dragged out of the room by Ladybug. She and Cat Noir try to figure out where the akuma is hiding, but neither has any ideas.

title: Horrificator
text:
Horrificator - Plot
Ladybug, Cat Noir, and Horrificator start to fight in the school's courtyard as the students hide near another classroom. Their screams cause Horrificator to grow, and Ladybug realizes that Horrificator is feeding on their fear. She explains this to Cat Noir and rushing at Horrificator, using her yo-yo as a shield. She restrains Horrificator with her yo-yo so Cat Noir can attack from above, but Horrificator pushes back Cat Noir with a spray of slime and pins him to the railing of the upstairs balcony. Pulling on the yo-yo string, Horrificator flings Ladybug into a basketball hoop and cements her there with slime as well. With both heroes restrained, Horrificator approaches the students but is distracted by Ivan. After staring at him, she licks his face affectionately as she takes Alix as her next victim and escapes into a nearby classroom.

title: Horrificator
text:
Horrificator - Plot
Cat Noir breaks Ladybug out of the basketball hoop, expanding his staff to break the board behind her head. On the ground and free, she wraps her yo-yo around his baton and pulls him out of the slime. They try to pursue Horrificator, but are stopped by a door that has been secured shut with slime. Ladybug realizes that Horrificator is Mylène, based on how she treated Ivan. The group then realizes that Sabrina and Chloé are missing.
Meanwhile, Chloé and Sabrina are in the Science classroom. Sabrina is barricading the doors with lockers while Chloé is painting her nails and praising her own ideas. Horrificator is revealed to be in the classroom, and she captures Sabrina and roars at Chloé. Chloé screams, alerting Ladybug and Cat Noir to where she is. Ladybug and Cat Noir use the slime left behind to track Horrificator to the maintenance area, bringing the remaining students with them.

title: Horrificator
text:
Horrificator - Plot
Inside Horrificator's lair, pink slime drips in large globs from the ceiling and large pods rise from the floor. Ladybug calls out to find out who is there, hearing responses from everybody except Adrien. Cat Noir hides behind some of the pods to avoid being seen and calls out, saying that as Adrien that he is there. He then asks if Marinette is there, and Ladybug claims that everybody is fine. Both Ladybug and Cat Noir try to crack open the pods to no avail.
Horrificator enters and sprays slime on the exit, preventing anybody from leaving and dramatically landing right in front of Ladybug, who admits that Horrificator is getting quite scary. Cat Noir picks up slime pellets and throws them at Horrificator to distract her. Ladybug uses Lucky Charm, which gives her a set of guitar strings. Remembering that Horrificator is Mylène, she thinks of the song "Smelly Wolf." Off to her right, she spots a cart with industrial supplies on it and pulls it over with her yo-yo and hands out the supplies to the students while Cat Noir distracts Horrificator.

title: Horrificator
text:
Horrificator - Plot
Blocking another bout of slime and climbing a ladder up to a second-story platform, Cat Noir uses Cataclysm on the steel poles holding the platform, trapping Horrificator in a makeshift cage. He jumps down from the platform and joins the students in their makeshift band. Rose is holding two trash can lids as cymbals. Alya and Nino hold traffic cones as microphones. Ivan has a brush and dustpan. Juleka is holding a box with a lid. Cat Noir uses old water containers and trash cans as a drum set. Ladybug uses an upside-down bucket, a broom, and guitar strings to form a bass. She then asks the others if they knew Mylène's lullaby, getting confirmation from everyone.
Ladybug begins the song, everyone else joining in on the second verse. The song causes Horrificator to shrink to a very small size. She runs to Ivan and jumps into his arms. Ladybug spots the pin on Horrificator's head takes it off, and crushes it between her thumb and index finger, releasing the akuma so she can capture and purify it. Throwing the guitar strings in the air, she cleanses the entire school and frees all the captured students. Nino keeps filming as Mylène returns to normal.

title: Horrificator
text:
Horrificator - Plot
Hawk Moth, defeated again, claims he will destroy Ladybug as the window of his lair closes.
Nino films Mylène and Ivan kissing and uses this as the end of his movie. He shows it to Mr. Bourgeois, but the video is rejected from the contest due to the monster not being realistic enough. Adrien reassures Nino that this wouldn't mean the end of his career, as there are other directors who began from nothing. Alya offhandedly refers to the kiss not being the one they expected, and Marinette smiles, gazing off into the distance and the end card then appears.

text:

Mylène: You're suggesting we run, Officer Jones? After it devoured my family, my friends, even my beloved dog, Sniffles? Never! I won't run! I no longer fear it, I'm going to face it, then I'll- (Ivan looms over her in a monster mask) Waaaaah!

(Mylène hides under the desk, scared.)
Ivan: Sorry Mylène. (takes off his monster mask)
Nino: Mylène! That's like, the tenth take, and we're only on the first scene!
Alix: Fourteenth actually. But who's counting.
Nino: Ughhh...
Mylène: I'm... sorry. I'm gonna do better on the next take, I promise.
Rose: Anyone want some tea?
Nino: You're playing a hero from the special forces. You're not supposed to get all freaked out!
Mylène: I know, but... that monster mask he's wearing is so... realistic and scary!

title: Horrificator/Transcript
text:

(Mylène runs away, crying.)

(Mylène looks at him.)

Hawk Moth:  A film shoot... oh, yes. So many emotions. Some fake, yet others very, very real. (turns a butterfly into an akuma) Fly away, my evil akuma, and overpower this young, misunderstood artist.

title: Horrificator/Transcript
text:

title: Horrificator/Transcript
text:

title: Horrificator/Transcript
text:

title: Hippolyta
text:
Hippolyta - Intro
was an Amazonian queen. She was a past Miraculous holder, wielding the Ladybug Miraculous and transforming into a ladybug-themed superhero when Tikki inhabited them.

title: Hippolyta
text:
Hippolyta - Appearance
Hippolyta wore a loose red dress with black spots. Cinching the dress around her waist was armor that can be assumed to be her girdle. She wore armor on her head, forearms, shoulders, and shins. To transform, she owned the Ladybug Miraculous.

title: Hippolyta
text:
Hippolyta - Abilities
As a civilian
Since she is seen in her inkobter drawing with a horse, a bow and arrow this means she was likely skilled in horsemanship as well as archery.
As a Ladybug Miraculous holder
If this past Ladybug Miraculous holder had the same powers as the current Ladybug (Marinette), she had enhanced abilities and the superpower Lucky Charm. She even had a yo-yo, as seen in the image.

title: Hippolyta
text:
Hippolyta - Trivia
Thomas Astruc drew Hippolyta in an image created for a fan-made charity magazine. She appears in the image with Jeanne d'Arc, Mudekudeku, and Ladybug (Marinette).
Given the myths that both she and Heracles are in together, they presumably knew each other in the Quantic Universe.
Paschalítsa (Πασχαλίτσα) means "Ladybug" in Greek.
She is the first known Miraculous holder as a figure of royalty.

title: Homework Essay
text:
Homework Essay - Intro
"" is the fifth and final webisode of the series, Miraculous: Tales from Paris.

title: Homework Essay
text:
Homework Essay - Synopsis
Marinette must write a short essay on someone who inspires her but struggles to decide who. She finally finds inspiration in her parents.

title: Homework Essay
text:
Homework Essay - Plot
Marinette has to prepare an essay on a person that inspires her. She wants to choose Tikki but Marinette has to keep her a secret, so she considers some other options. Tikki gives her one - write an essay on Adrien, whom she loves. However, Marinette doesn't think that her teacher, Miss Bustier, will like her presentation based on her crush. Marinette's parents appear, saying they have finished three wedding cakes and inviting her to the cinema to celebrate. Marinette realizes how hard working her parents are and how much they inspire her. Therefore, in the end, she decides to make her essay about her parents.

text:

title: Horse Miraculous
text:
Horse Miraculous - Intro
The  is a pair of glasses that, whenever Kaalki inhabits it, transforms the wearer into a horse-themed superhero with the power of Migration.
To activate the glasses, the user must speak the transformation phrase: "Full Gallop". To deactivate the glasses, the user must speak the detransformation phrase: "Dismount".
The glasses are currently owned by Max Kanté, who uses them to transform into Pegasus. It was previously stored in the Chinese Miracle Box and only lent out to him when the situation required it. But, as of "Re-creation", he now posseses the Miraculous permanently.

title: Horse Miraculous
text:
Horse Miraculous - Appearance
In general, the Horse Miraculous are pair of dark, pince nez type glasses. In charged mode, they have gradient lenses, and five cyan light points near the right frame of the Miraculous. If a minor is using the Miraculous, the glasses start running out of power, they make a beeping sound, and the light points start disappearing one at a time as an indication of how much time (one light is equivalent to one minute) Max (or another Horse Miraculous holder) has left. In its activated mode, the five lights disappear and has no gradient lenses, making the glasses completely black.
In Season 6, the glasses are styled like a visor with a thick brown frame and large green lens. The light point went from circular to rectangular with one being long and the other 4 are small rectangles, all of them have a lighter shade than the lens. In it's activated mode, the lights are gone.
In its camouflage mode, the glasses change color and form depending on whose possession it's in:
In the possession of Max Kanté, the lens of the glasses are clear and round with black frames.

title: Horse Miraculous
text:
Horse Miraculous - Appearance
As of Season 6 and onwards, the glasses have a half-transparent frame with rectangular lenses, and rims on the top half of the lenses.
When it was worn by Gabriel Agreste, the lens of the glasses were clear with silver frames.
When it was worn by Marinette Dupain-Cheng, the lenses were circular and had silvery-gold frames along with temples.
In its reforged ring form, it was a thick band with a circular surface, similar to the Cat Miraculous, inside of it was the symbol of the Horse Miraculous which glowed brown. It used to sit on the index finger of Gabriel's right hand.

title: Horse Miraculous
text:
Horse Miraculous - Abilities
The Horse Miraculous has the ability to transform its wielder into a horse-themed superhero, granting its wielder incredible superhuman powers of speed, endurance, agility, stamina and strength. It also makes the user nearly invulnerable.
Its special weapon is an unbreakable Horseshoe which can be also be utilized as both a weapon, a communicator, and an object that can be used to breathe underwater. Its special superpower, is named Voyage, which gives the user the ability to allows the user to open portals that they can travel and exit through at any location they desire in order to obtain their goal, like defeating a villain. As long as the superpower isn't used by a minor, the wielder can remain transformed indefinitely. However, as soon as the superpower is used, the wielder loses power and the transformation wears off in about approximately five minutes. The pair of glasses also has the ability to give the wielder the costume they truly desire.

title: Horse Miraculous
text:
Horse Miraculous - History
Five thousand years ago, a mage successfully helped the kwamis to interact with humans by creating magic jewels, which were called Miraculouses. In order to repay the mage, and to live on the physical world alongside humans, the kwamis decided to help humanity by letting humans utilize their energy and powers through the Miraculous they were bonded with, which included Kaalki and the Horse Miraculous.
At some point in time, all of the knowledge about the Miraculouses and their powers was written down in code in a book called the Grimoire, with very few people knowing how to decipher the code. Miracle Boxes were also careated at an unknown time to store the dormant Miraculouses. To protect and distribute Miraculouses, the Order of the Guardians was formed and existed for many years. Throughout its existence, guardians trained younger generations to keep a watchful eye over the Miraculouses and the Grimoire, which were placed in the guardians' temple.
Many Horse holders throughout history used Kaalki's power for good, like Mǎ in China, who started the legacy.

title: Horse Miraculous
text:
Horse Miraculous - History
172 years ago, after an disastrous event where a young Wang Fu used the Peacock Miraculous to create a sentimonster and his negative emotions and imaturity led to the creature rampaging through the temple and eating and destroying everything in its path, Fu was entrusted with the Chinese Miracle Box (Which included the Horse Miraculous) by a monk and was told to run away from the mess. However, on the mountain range outside the temple, in order to escape from the the monster, Fu jumped over a fissure on the ground - accidently opening the Box and spilling all of its contents on the snow. Due to his distress, Fu didnt notice he accidently left both the Peacock and the Butterfly on the mountain, alongisde the Grimoire, until it was too late and he was too far away to come back. Somewhere along the line, the Peacock got dangerously damaged, to the point of being improper for use - but, as it turns out, no one knew of this fact until it was too late.

title: Horse Miraculous
text:
Horse Miraculous - History
On a previous trip overseas with the Agrestes, Nathalie found the Butterfly and Peacock Miraculouses and gave the jewels to Gabriel. In "Representation", it was revealed that neither the Agrestes nor the Graham de Vanily couples could bear children on their own, so Émilie and Colt used the Peacock Miraculous to create Adrien and Félix respectively, but in doing so, they grew sick over time and were eventually left in a condition where they fell into an eternal slumber due to using the Peacock Miraculous in its damaged state.

title: Horse Miraculous
text:
Horse Miraculous - History
Desperate to fix his mistake, Gabriel Agreste began using the Butterfly Miraculous for evil to obtain the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses in order to gain access to their absolute power, becoming the supervillain Hawk Moth, later Shadow Moth (when unified with a now fixed Peacock Miraculous), and finally Monarch. This decision proved one of the most significant for the history of the series, as Gabriel began utilizing Nooroo's power to akumatize the civilians of Paris, France, trying to get one of them to draw out the current holders of the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses, unintenionally helping start off Marinette's and Adrien's journeys as Ladybug and Cat Noir, and later, the rest of the Miraculers.
One of the members of the Miraculers is Max Kanté, who was chosen by Ladybug in "Startrain" to wield the Horse Miraculous, becoming the hero Pegasus. Max, from that point on, became a member of the team, helping Ladybug and Cat Noir during "particularly diffcult missions". From "Startrain" to "Strikeback", Max was a temporary holder, meaning he would only receive the Miraculous from Ladybug when he was needed for the mission, and had to give it back after the crisis was solved.

title: Horse Miraculous
text:
Horse Miraculous - History
In "Sentibubbler" and "Strikeback", Marinette fused the Ladybug and Horse Miraculous to become Pegabug. In "Strikeback", she also fused the Ladybug, Horse and Rabbit to become Pennybug.
Félix, after finding out about his true origins as a sentihuman and learning that the Peacock Miraculous could erase his and his cousin's lifes if it feel into the wrong hands, orchestrated a plan to capture all of the Miraculouses of the Chinese Box from Ladybug and traded all of them (besides the Ladybug and the Cat) for the Peacock, which included the Horse Miraculous, succeeding in "Strikeback". When Gabriel unified it with the Butterfly and other miraculouses, he became Monarch.

title: Horse Miraculous
text:
Horse Miraculous - History
In "Destruction", Gabriel used a laser machine to melt down the Miraculous into a pile of dust, and then reforged it into a special Alliance ring for transferring Kaalki's power of Migration to any akumatized villain who wore a regular Alliance ring. In "Re-creation", Marinette Dupain-Cheng manages to recover all of the Miraculous that were previously stolen. In "Miraculous London", Lila stole all of the Miraculous under Marinette's care in an alternate timeline, which included the Horse Miraculous, in order to render her truly powerless and to fuse the Ladybug and the Cat to gain her wish without her interference, but her plan was ultimately thwarted by the combined efforts of Chronobug and Bunnyx, and the event was erased from the timeline.

title: Horse Miraculous
text:
Horse Miraculous - History
After the events of "Miraculous London", Marinette, having realized both instances of all of the Miraculouses being stolen happened because all of them were kept in the same place, and with the idea that centralized power is inherently flawed, and that distributing it among members of a society is a far superior idea, restored and upgraded the Horse Miraculous by redesigning its original design and adding the Miraculous Call: a call feature that grants the holder the ability to summon other superheroes who possess a Miraculous from the Chinese Miracle Box in order to receive aid on their missions. This new feature is particularly useful, as the new holder of the Butterfly Miraculous, Chrysalis, is even more fearsome than her predecessor. After the alterations, the Horse Miraculous was given back to Max permanently - putting Pegasus back on the map.

title: Horse Miraculous
text:
Horse Miraculous - Trivia
Horses symbolize confidence, endurance, and triumph.
Despite the fact that the Horse Miraculous "concept" was claimed claimed to be Teleportation in "Startrain", some official materials stated that the concept is actually Migration, such as the Kwamis book as well as the official Miraculous Ladybug website as of September 2020.
This was later confirmed in "Migration", where it was said that the concept of the Horse Miraculous is Migration.
The Horse Miraculous is stored in a drawer in the Miracle Box below the Goat Miraculous' drawer.
Their form of sunglasses may be a reference to the fact that some of the earliest recorded instances of sunglasses originate from China, where the lenses were made from polished smoky quartz.
Incidentally, China is the world's largest producer of sunglasses in present day.
In "Mega Leech", the Horse Miraculous has a different design when Ladybug entrusts it to Max.
In "Optigami", Kaalki mentions she was the companion of several glorious heroes, suggesting the Horse Miraculous was used by a number of famous heroes before Max. The specific heroes are so far unknown.

title: Horse Miraculous
text:
Horse Miraculous - Trivia
In "Sentibubbler", Marinette unifies the Horse Miraculous with the Ladybug Miraculous and temporarily becomes Pegabug.
In "Strikeback", she unifies the Horse Miraculous with the Ladybug and Rabbit Miraculous and temporarily becomes Pennybug.
In "Destruction" and "Miraculous Paris", Gabriel unifies the Butterfly Miraculous with the Horse Miraculous and temporarily becomes Monarch.
From "Jubilation" to "Collusion", Gabriel as Monarch used its power of Voyage to teleport his megakumas to his akumatized victims faster.
It is implied that the Miraculous when worn gives the user normal eyesight.
In "Startrain" and "Strikeback", the Miraculous is shown to be foldable.
This is similar to how the Monkey Miraculous is foldable.

title: Horseshoe
text:
Horseshoe - Intro
The  is the tool of the Horse Miraculous.
The current owner of the horseshoe is Max Kanté, who uses it as the superhero Pegasus.
Previously, it was used by Gabriel Agreste when he used the Horse Miraculous with the other Miraculouses in his possession to become Monarch. And also, it was occasionally used by Marinette Dupain-Cheng when she unified the Horse, and Rabbit Miraculous with the Ladybug Miraculous to become Pegabug and Pennybug.

title: Horseshoe
text:
Horseshoe - Appearance
The horseshoe changes color depending on whose possession it's in:
When used by Pegasus, the horseshoe is chestnut brown with six cyan indentations.
From season 6 onwards, the horseshoe is thinner, there are seven silver indentations, and it has circular ends.
When it was used by Pegabug, the horseshoe kept the same appearance, but instead it was dark brown.
When it was used by Pennybug, the horseshoe kept the same appearance, but instead it was red.
When it was used by Monarch, the horseshoe kept the same appearance, but instead was purple.

title: Horseshoe
text:
Horseshoe - Abilities
Like the other Miraculous tools, the horseshoe is nearly unbreakable and can be used to deflect attacks. The horseshoe can be used offensively, by changing its form and angle, allowing the user to throw it like a boomerang.
In "Grendiaper", the horseshoe is revealed to be able to show video recordings.

title: Horseshoe
text:

The horseshoe is befitting as the Horse Miraculous tool since most domesticated horses and ponies wear horseshoes.
Similar to a ladybug, some people believe that horseshoes are a sign of good luck when pointed up.
Similar to a black cat, some people believe that horseshoes are a sign of bad luck when pointed down.

Hua Mulan - Intro
(Traditional Chinese: 花木蘭 Mandarin Chinese: 花木兰) was a Chinese female warrior from the ancient times. She was a past Miraculous holder, wielding the Dragon Miraculous and transforming into a dragon-themed superhero when Longg inhabited it.

As a superhero
Since Mulan was a Dragon Miraculous holder, she had the same powers as the current holder, she had enhanced physical abilities and the special superpower of the elements.

title: Hua Mulan
text:
Hua Mulan - Trivia
Hua Mulan was a real person who lived in China during the northern and southern dynasties period. She is known for joining the Chinese army in the place of her father and rose through the military ranks, when the emperor offered her a reward, she refused and retired to her hometown.
She is the second known person of Chinese origins to wield the Dragon Miraculous, succeeding Lóng and preceding her successor Marinette.
She is the seventh person of Chinese origins to wield a Miraculous.
Unlike Marinette and her origin predecessors who had the same Miraculous, Hua Mulan and her origin predecessors all own different jewels.
She is the second person of Asian origins to wield the Dragon Miraculous following the Ancient Chinese Dragon Miraculous holder.

is a minor character of Miraculous World: New York - United Heroez. She is a weather-themed superhero and member of United Heroez, a team of superheroes, that protects the United States of America.

title: Hurricane
text:
Hurricane - Appearance
As Hurricane
Hurricane is a woman with light complexion and dark eyes. She has short blonde hair that she combs back. Her makeup consists of dark lipstick and a storm cloud painted above her right eye.
The superheroine is dressed in a black costume that covers her entire body. The elements that stand out on the outfit are decorations resembling dark storm clouds and bright lightning bolts.

title: Hurricane
text:
Hurricane - Personality
Hurricane's personality is not exactly known. In "Miraculous New York", she is brave and courageous. She is not afraid to stand up to fight the enemy to protect people. She is also loyal to other heroes. Given that she started playing around with her powers after being hit by Liberation, she is presumably normally very responsible and serious.

title: Hurricane
text:
Hurricane - Abilities
Hurricane seems to have the ability control the weather to a limited degree. She has been seen creating small clouds, gusts of wind, and bolts of lightning.

title: Hurricane
text:
Hurricane - History
Miraculous New York
Hurricane is seen on the news with the other members of the United Heroez, where President Camilla Hombee/Victory makes a statement about the hunt for Techno-Pirate and postpones the French-American Friendship Week celebration ceremony. Later in Times Square, Hurricane flies near on a rooftop where she meets with Majestia, Knightowl, Snowflake, and Victory. She is then told by Majestia to wait until she lands to make a move.
After Majestia lands, Hurricane and the other superheroes surround Techno-Pirate, now Miraclonizer, who uses the Eagle Miraculous's power of Liberation to free all the superheroes from their ethical constraints, with Hurricane's being to use her powers usefully. Hurricane then started playing with her powers, and even played with a cloud.
She is later seen chasing Sparrow, along with the other superheroes. Once she is freed from the effects of Miraclonizer's use of Liberation by Eagle, she attends the French American Friendship celebration ceremony. There Hurricane watched as Snowflake made an ice statue of Ladybug, Cat Noir, Uncanny Valley, and Eagle as she celebrated them while flying in the air.

She is likely a reference to Storm from Marvel's X-Men.

title: Horrificator (movie)
text:
Horrificator (movie) - Intro
Horrificator is a short horror film created by Miss Bustier's class for the Parisian Student Short Film Festival. It features two main characters: Agent  Smith (portrayed by Mylène Haprèle) and Officer Jones (portrayed by Adrien Agreste).
In "Horrificator", after Myléne could not do her major role in the movie, she is later akumatized into Horrificator.

title: Horrificator (movie)
text:
Horrificator (movie) - Description
Originally, the first scene started with a dialogue between Officer Jones, suggesting to evacuate, and Agent Smith, who decides to face the monster that devoured her family, friends and pet dog, Sniffles. Later, Agent Smith would have an "emotional journey".
The script was tweaked to include a kiss between the main characters in the first scene, which, according to Alya, would not make sense story wise. Taking over the main role, Chloé decides to turn Agent Smith into a nurse.
The film's production continued despite the lead actress becoming akumatized, which resulted in the plot drastically changing. Ladybug and Cat Noir, along with the class, became the protagonists of the new film, and the battle against Horrificator was used as the story. The final scene in the movie has a kiss between Ivan and now de-akumatized Mylène.

title: Hotel Lafayette
text:
Hotel Lafayette - Intro
is a hotel that's located in East 59th Street in Manhattan, New York City. During the Manhattan field trip for both Miss Bustier's class and Professor Gate's class, they all stayed at this hotel.

title: Hotel Lafayette
text:
Hotel Lafayette - Appearance
Outside
The hotel is elevated above the road and is built out of red bricks. It has three entrances: one wide central entrance and two narrower ones on each side. Each entrance consists of stone stairs with metallic banisters and a stone arc. The left arc is rectangular with thin pillars while the right one is round with thicker pillars. The central entrance is more resemblant of the left entrance, additionally with the word "LAFAYETTE" carved on the platform formed by the arc. Each arc is decorated with French and American flags. The side doors are plain and made of wood, while the central entrance has double sliding glass doors.
The building's windows are also asymmetrical, with four windows on the left side (two small framed and two large) and three on the right (with one small framed window less). Similar patterns can be seen above the entrances, although the central rounded window is smaller on the left side. There is a large tree and a light post outside the left side. The basement of the hotel appears to be full of small shops and cafés, separated by an ornamented metallic fence.
Lobby

title: Hotel Lafayette
text:
Hotel Lafayette - Appearance
The lobby is an ample symmetrical room with beige wallpaper, red brick walls and wooden columns separating them, as well as a yellow tiled floor. The ceiling has a wooden herringbone pattern and lamps consisting of hanging platforms and open lightbulbs. The lobby as an overall rustic appearance.

title: Hotel Lafayette
text:
Hotel Lafayette - Appearance
The entrance consists of two large automatic glass doors in metallic frames. To the left and right, there are brick walls with a greyish-blue couch each and a wooden path leading to the counter, and one of the walls has a light switch. The red brick counter with a rectangular dark marble surface is located in the opposite side of the room. There is a small door on the right side (from the staff's perspective) and  a miniature Eiffel Tower over it. The word "LAFAYETTE" can be seen on the brick wall at the back, as well as two doorways behind each side of the counter, presumably reserved to the hotel's staff. The counter is decorated with a garland consisting in French and American flags. There are five vending machines around the counter: (left to right, from the visistors' view) orange, water, tomato-themed on the left, and apple and coffee-themed on the right. The vending machines are flanked by potted plants.

title: Hotel Lafayette
text:
Hotel Lafayette - Appearance
The left corridor leads to the emergency stairs. It has several greyish-blue seats, including couches, armchairs and poofs, with a few coffee tables and a yellow, black and white rectangular carpet between them. Halfway through the path to this side of the lobby is a green rubbish bin. There is a green shelf containing several books and a large monitor on the wall separating the entrance from the corridor, as well as a foosball table in the middle of the area and two arcade games, blue and green. At the back of the room there is a modern white book stand behind a counter, with larger French and American flags hanging nearby, a dart game at the very left, and two monitors: one large one in the center and a smaller one in the right corner. There are two doors on the right, which presumably lead to the hotel rooms. The left wall has large windows with metallic frames and brick pillars between them, above which a platform with smaller plants can be seen.

title: Hotel Lafayette
text:
Hotel Lafayette - Appearance
While it is not visited, the right corridor appears to be similar to the left one, with some differences being the presence of a billiard table instead of a foosball table, the absence of the arcade games, and most of the furniture being mirrored. The French and American flags are also located closer to the counter than in the left corridor.
Rooftop
The rooftop is covered with large stone tiles and is surrounded almost from every side with red bricks walls covered with even tiles, excepting the two exterior emergency ladders located at both sides of the front of the building. The indoors emergency stairs are accessed through the door on the left side of the rooftop. There is a large water tank with a green roof on an elevated platform next to the exit. It is covered in colourful graffiti and decorated with light garlands. There are two roof vents on the other side of the exit. There is a rectangular platform with a green surface and pipes next to them.
On the opposite side of the roof there are two parallel glass constructions with green metallic frames, which are illuminated at night. There is also a chimney in the corner, also decorated with light garlands.

title: Hotel Lafayette
text:
Hotel Lafayette - Appearance
The area is full of red, yellow and blue canisters, and wooden crates of different shapes and sizes, piled up to form tables. There are several checkered picnic blankets to the right of the entrance, as well as French and American flags used as table cloths, carpets and decorations all over the the rooftop.
Rooms
The rooms seen in the episode are located on the 6th floor. The corridor has brick walls with beige wallpaper and a wood strip floor with a white and green carpet. It is lit with small hourglass-shaped lamps hanging from the ceiling and decorated with potted plants, red, white and blue balloons and garlands with French and American flags. The corridor starts with two white elevators and a fire extinguisher to the left. There is an emergency exit on the opposite side of the corridor. Each room's door is made of wood and is in white rectangular frames. The doors have gold-color numbers (presumably from 601 to 608) on the top middle, and brick walls and light switches in between.

title: Hotel Lafayette
text:
Hotel Lafayette - Appearance
Each room has a double decker double bed with a wooden frame and ladder and grey and blue bedding. There is also a bookshelf to the left of the door, a wooden closet to the right, a coffee table with a lamp and telephone in the corner next to the bed, and a heater under the windows. The windows are arched and are located on the wall opposite the door and have access to outside emergency stairs. They have wooden windowsills and blue translucent blinders. The rooms are decorated with several paintings: one to the left of the windows, another at the same corner but on a neighboring wall, and a third at the same corner as the bookshelf.

title: Hotel Lafayette
text:
Hotel Lafayette - Trivia
The hotel is named after Gilbert du Motier whose last name is Lafayette.
Hotel Lafayette seems to be inspired by an actual real-life hotel that's also coincidentally named Hotel Lafayette (formerly known as Hotel Martin) which used to be located in the Greenwich Village neighborhood of the Manhattan borough of New York City. Historically, it was founded in 1902 by Raymond Orteig and it was particularly known for its restaurant, the Café Lafayette, which drew its clientele from New York's French expatriates and the bohemians of Greenwich Village. Unfortunately, unlike the fictional Hotel Lafayette from Miraculous, the real-life Hotel Lafayette is no longer in business since its closure in 1949 and the building was later demolished in the late 1950s.

title: Hotel Lafayette
text:
Hotel Lafayette - Trivia
Despite the real-life Hotel Lafayette from New York City is defunct, there're a few other real-life hotels that share the same name as the one from Manhattan that's located in other parts of the country. In fact, there's even one historical hotel building that still exists in the state of New York to this day. However, it's not located in Manhattan nor in New York City and instead, it's located at Buffalo, the second-largest city in the state after New York City.
The man at the counter can be seen in several episodes in Paris, his most prominent appearances being a metro passenger in "Queen Wasp" and a simplified driver in "Simpleman".

title: Huangpu
text:
Huangpu - Intro
The  is a 113-kilometre (70 mi) long river that flows through central Shanghai.

title: Huangpu
text:
Huangpu - Description
Rising from the confluence of the Hengliao Jing and Damao Gang in Shanghai's Songjiang District, the Huangpu heads west before turning completely north and meandering through Shanghai with an average width of four hundred meters, bordering in particular the Bund (left bank) and the Lujiazui (right bank).
The river eventually joins the Yangzi Jiang, fifty kilometers from the latter's mouth in the East China Sea.
Along its course, the Huangpu is flanked by numerous tributaries (left banks), the most important of which is the Suzhou River (simplified Chinese: 苏州河; traditional Chinese: 蘇州河; pinyin: sūzhōu hé) whose confluence is located north of the Bund, more precisely at Hangpu Park.
The river is also divided into several tributaries that pass through Shanghai and flow into Hangzhou Bay and the East China Sea.

title: Huangpu
text:
Huangpu - Trivia
The Huangpu is the largest river in central Shanghai.

text:
Hôtel de Coislin - Intro
is one of four private mansions that occupy the twin building of the Hôtel de la Marine, located on Place de la Concorde, in the 8th arrondissement of Paris.

title: Hôtel de Coislin
text:
Hôtel de Coislin - Description
The Hôtel de Coislin is the eastern corner pavilion of the building constructed in 1770 by Ange-Jacques Gabriel in symmetry with the Hôtel de la Marine. It presents, over three bays, a portico whose four columns support an entablature crowned by a triangular tympanum.

title: Hôtel de Coislin
text:
Hôtel de Coislin - Trivia
The Hôtel de Coislin has been classified as a Historic Monument since 1923 (facade) and since 1962 (living room, elevation, interior decoration).
The Hôtel de Coislin is listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site under the title "Paris, Rives de la Seine".
The Hôtel de Coislin is an important place in the history of Franco-American friendship:
On February 6, 1778, it was here that Conrad Alexandre Gérard, Benjamin Franklin, Silas Deane and Arthur Lee signed the Treaty of Alliance between the Kingdom of France and the United States, a defensive alliance following the Treaty of Amity and Commerce between the two countries, France having de facto recognized the independence of the United States;
This event is commemorated by a plaque placed on the corner of the building.

title: Hudson
text:
Hudson - Intro
The  is a 310-mile (507 km) river that flows primarily through the state of New York and forms its natural border with the state of New Jersey, United States.

title: Hudson
text:
Hudson - Description
In New York City, the Hudson River flows for almost 25 kilometers, separating the city from the state of New Jersey.
It borders the Bronx for almost 4 kilometers until it reaches the Harlem River, a strait that separates the Bronx from Manhattan. Then, it runs along the island of Manhattan for 21 kilometers before its mouth, New York Bay.
All along its path there are parks where New Yorkers take walks. Since the Hudson is a navigable river, there are many ports.
Bridge and tunnel
Despite the length of the Hudson River, there is only one bridge that connects New York City to the state of New Jersey:
George Washington Bridge
However, there are two tunnels under the river:
Lincoln Tunnel
Holland Tunnel

title: Hudson
text:
Hudson - Trivia
The Hudson is named after Henry Hudson, an English navigator working for the United Netherlands who explored the river in 1609.

title: Hotel Plaza
text:
Hotel Plaza - Description
Built in 1907 by Henry Janeway Hardenbergh, the Plaza Hotel is a 20-story Renaissance Revival building located on Fifth Avenue, facing Central Park. Standing 250 feet tall, the upper floors are covered by a mansard roof of green and copper tiles, with dormer windows and domed turrets.

title: Hotel Plaza
text:
Hotel Plaza - Trivia
The Plaza Hotel has been listed on the National Register of Historic Places (NRHP) since 1978.
The Plaza Hotel has been listed as a National Historic Site since 1986.

title: Hôtel de Ville
text:
Hôtel de Ville - Intro
The  is the city hall of Paris. It is the workplace of the Mayoress of Paris, and also serves as a venue for large events and coverups.

title: Hôtel de Ville
text:
Hôtel de Ville - Appearance
Exterior
The town hall was rebuilt from 1873 to 1882 according to the plans of Théodore Ballu and Édouard Deperthes, following a fire that completely destroyed it on 24 May 1871 during the fires started by the insurgents of the Commune.
Inspired by the previous building, the Hôtel de Ville de Paris is a neo-Renaissance style palace of 66,000 m2. Rectangular in shape, it is 143 meters long and 85 meters wide. It is distinguished by its numerous pavilions and small wings of different heights. All around, many statues representing famous Parisians adorn the building.
On the side of the Place de l'Hôtel de Ville, the main facade consists of a central forepart surrounded by two pavilions, each flanked by a projecting square turret in which there are two doors giving access to the courtyards, closed by wrought iron gates, bearing the coat of arms of the City of Paris. This central body and its two pavilions are extended on the sides by a small six-meter wing set back that ends in a corner pavilion. In each bay, on the ground floor and first floor, there are semicircular and rectangular bays surmounted by mezzanines, framed by pilasters and attached columns.

title: Hôtel de Ville
text:
Hôtel de Ville - Appearance
The main pediment is decorated with a clock above which is a coat of arms in the colors of France. Behind this clock stands the bell tower, an octagonal bell tower that reaches 50 meters in height. This is covered by a scale dome cushioned by a lantern with a wrought iron balustrade.
Interior
Entrance
Located behind the central entrance of the main facade, this lobby is a large room with a predominantly beige color. The marble floor is decorated with rectangular, rhomboidal, square or round patterns of different colors. The walls are made up of pilasters and columns. Various plaques with inscriptions are hung on it at various points.
Right in front of the entrance door, there is a semicircular gray reception desk with two office chairs and two computer monitors. Behind this desk hangs a portrait of Mayor André Bourgeois framed in gold. Further to the right, a small waiting room with leather armchairs has been set up. There are also several doors and access ramps to the other rooms on the ground floor.

title: Hôtel de Ville
text:
Hôtel de Ville - Appearance
The room also features two symmetrical staircases whose bodyguards are golden with a light gray handrail. These stairs lead to a mezzanine supported by a column that provides access to the service on the first floor of the Mairie de Paris.
On the ceiling, many golden chandeliers illuminate the room.
Office of the Mayor of Paris
The office of the Mayor of Paris is a large room in shades of brown and gold. Large wall-mounted bookcases have been installed on the side of the entrance above which we find the coat of arms of Paris.
Opposite the entrance is the mayor's desk. It is a large rectangular table made of polished wood with one side forming a semicircle. There is a black telephone, some documents and a stamp. There are two large armchairs with blue cushions and a golden frame. Behind the desk is a large black fireplace topped by a slab of light marble on which two decorative vases have been placed.

title: Hôtel de Ville
text:
Hôtel de Ville - Appearance
To the right of the desk is a model of the city of Paris. Closer to the window is a large white vase with floral motifs. On the wall hangs the painting "The Castle of Versailles" by Pierre Patel. On the left is a small relaxation area with armchairs and a low table. Some small wardrobes and small desks decorate the whole.
The floor is made of a simple wooden parquet, while the ceiling is colored and upholstered in red with decorative motifs. The room is finally illuminated by golden chandeliers that hang from the ceiling as well as by chandeliers near the door.

title: Hôtel de Ville
text:
Hôtel de Ville - Trivia
The Hôtel de Ville has been classified as a Historic Monument since 1975.
The Hôtel de Ville has been a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1991 under the title "Paris, Rives de Seine".
The Hôtel de Ville is the tallest town hall in Europe.
In real life, the Hôtel de Ville has a magnificent ballroom, a "republican" replica of the Hall of Mirrors at the Palace of Versailles.
In real life, the painting "The Castle of Versailles" by Pierre Patel is exhibited at the Museum of Versailles.
In "Malediktator", Mayor Bourgeois officiates a wedding in his office. However, this celebration normally takes place in a room designated for this purpose.
In the series, the Hôtel de Ville has been important on several occasions:
In "Rogercop", the titular villain takes over Paris from it and fights Ladybug and Cat Noir there.
In "Darkblade", Darkblade takes over the Hôtel de Ville and tries to take over Paris.
In "Reflekta", the titular villain kidnaps André Bourgeois in order to lure out Ladybug and Cat Noir.
In "Malediktator", the akumatized mayor uses the city hall as his base. Later, he uses the building's roof as his throne and attempts to enslave all of Paris.

title: Hôtel de Ville
text:
Hôtel de Ville - Trivia
In "Silencer", the titular villain has Mayor Bourgeois tied up in his office while he makes a phone call impersonating his captive.
In "Lies", the titular villain is akumatized, and attacks her first victims there.
In "Strikeback", Ladybug and her team gathered on the roof of the town hall at the same time that the sentimonster launched the Roue de Paris at them with Clout. However, Ryuko managed to divert its trajectory with her Wind Dragon.
In "Determination", Manipula confronts the Mayor and Chloé with a wax sculpture of Minotaurox.
In "Collusion", the town hall was attacked by Miss Sans-Culotte.
In "Revolution", it is in the mayor's office where Chloé was akumatized into Queen Mayor.

text:
Ice Rink - Intro
The  is an ice skating rink located somewhere in Paris, France and owned by Philippe.

title: Ice Rink
text:
Ice Rink - Appearance
The exterior of the ice rink is a large, gray building, covered with green ivy in the front. It has a black fence surrounding one side of it, and tall, rectangular windows all around its walls that extend along the entire length of the building. The windows are supported by railings that lead to the roof of the building, made of white corrugated sheet metal. To the left of the building there is a recess where information boards are hung.

title: Ice Rink
text:
Ice Rink - Appearance
The interior of the ice rink is fairly big. The walls in the room are white, shimmering with a gray-blue shade. One of the walls, near the front door, is orange. The roof is black with orange elements around the windows. The entrance door leads directly to the auditorium, where visitors can change their clothes and climb up to the panel. There is also a balcony with a railing. There is a large ring in the center that is painted sky blue with slightly darker walls with the frames of glass on them that separate the rink and the seats/benches. There are about four rows of seats that surround the entire rink and are painted a bright sky blue. The entire interior of the building, including the windows are tinted in a blue color. Only the back wall is a bright yellow-brown color.

title: Ice Rink
text:
Ice Rink - Appearance
The corridor is oblong with lamps at the top. The walls and ceiling are cream-colored, and the floor is lined with dark tiles. There is access to other rooms from the corridor. There are also restrooms on the corner - for women and men. A white door with an inscription sign leads to them. The walls in the restroom are lined with large tiles. The room is divided into two parts. There is a sink and a hand dryer at the entrance to the restroom. In the next part there is a single bathroom, which is separated by a light wood door.
The rink also has a locker room for visitors, which has a variety of lockers where they can leave their belongings. The room is located separately from the rest, and is painted in gray tones with a lot of lights and columns that hold the ceiling.

In the series, André Bourgeois threatens Philippe to turn this place into a gym for Chloé.
Funnily enough, the Espace Sportif Pailleron has a fitness and wellness area.

Ikari Gozen - Intro
"" is a season 3 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 18th written and produced episode of season 3. It is also the 70th written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Ikari Gozen
