text:
Ikari Gozen - Synopsis
Adrien is the prize in a Paris-wide Friendship Day treasure hunt, but Marinette is teamed up with Kagami, who has disobeyed her mother to participate.
Disney Channel
Ladybug must save her friend and enemy after Kagami's mother gets akumatized into Ikari Gozen and looks to punish Kagami for disobeying her.
Disney+
Ladybug faces Kagami's mother, now Ikari Gozen.

title: Ikari Gozen
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Ikari Gozen - Plot
Mireille and Aurore announce Paris annual Friendship Day where two people picked at random will go on an adventure across Paris in order to find where a celebrity is hiding, with this year's celebrity being Adrien. Adrien comes onscreen and greets everyone. Marinette, who is watching the announcement with the girls on her computer, worries that they won't get her sign up text like last year, but Alya assures her that won't happen because unlike last year, she has her friends. Mireille further explains that once she pushes the button on her tablet, a riddle will be sent to everyone that will give them a clue to their first location where they will meet their new friend. From there, the duos must find more clues in order to eventually find out where Adrien is. Adrien pushes the button, and the girls all receive texts. Alya's location is Sacré-Coeur; Rose's location is the Ménagerie du Jardin des Plantes; and Alix's location is the Louvre. Juleka mumbles her location. However, Marinette is perplexed by the riddle she received.

title: Ikari Gozen
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Ikari Gozen - Plot
Kagami practices fencing with her mother. However, she struggles against her and expresses belief that she isn't worthy of fighting against her. However, Tomoe reminds her of the story of Tomoe Gozen, who lived during a time when female warriors were so few and rarely accepted, yet she never gave up. As she fights Kagami, Tomoe explains that she relied on her speed in order to be as elusive as the wind, as powerful as the flood, and as swift as lightning. Suddenly, Kagami's cellphone beeps, and Tomoe asks her what it is. Kagami explains that it's for the Friendship Game. Tomoe is furious that Kagami signed up for it without her permission, but Kagami tells her that it must be a mistake. As they head to the car, Kagami tells her mother that Adrien is participating in the game. Tomoe says that though Gabriel Agreste has many admirable qualities, by allowing his son to participate in the Friendship Game, he's being too permissive. She then tells Tatsu to take them to Grand Palais. Unbeknownst to her, Kagami secretly records her voice.

title: Ikari Gozen
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Ikari Gozen - Plot
Adrien is revealed to be at the Musée Grévin. Aurore thanks him for his participation, adding that all they need to do now is wait for the first duo to show up. Adrien jokingly poses as a statue next to the statue of his father, causing Aurore and Mireille to giggle.
Once arriving at Grand Palais, Tomoe tells Tatsu to take Kagami home, saying that she'll return in two hours. Kagami puts two hours in her phone's timer and looks at the riddle she received. Figuring out that it's Canal Saint-Martin, she tells Tatsu to take her there, but the voice recognition fails. Therefore, Kagami uses her mother's voice, she recorded to get the car to take her there.
Marinette arrives at Canal Saint-Martin, explaining to Tikki how she figured the riddle out.
She waits for her new friend but is horrified upon discovering that it's Kagami.
She fears that if the two of them win, Kagami will get all the credit and wind up being Adrien's girlfriend.
She refuses to play the game with her and prepares to leave.
Kagami watches Marinette's antics from afar and calls her weird, but she decides that since fate has placed her in her path, she must succeed.

title: Ikari Gozen
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Ikari Gozen - Plot
Tikki tells Marinette that she isn't being fair to Kagami as she can't play if Marinette refuses to be her friend.
Marinette believes that Kagami will do fine without her and that Marinette will only slow Kagami down.
Suddenly, she realizes that she can do just that to ensure that Kagami doesn't get close to Adrien.
Tikki doesn't believe that is a good idea, but Marinette doesn't listen and meets with Kagami on the canal's bridge, claiming to be excited to play the game with her.
Kagami notes that Marinette didn't seemed happy to be her friend as she saw her try to leave earlier, but Marinette tells her that it's because she thought she got the wrong place.
The two then receive the next riddle, which tells them to go deeper for the next clue.
Marinette tells Kagami that the riddle must mean that they need to go to England, but Kagami figures that they must fish for their next clue in the Seine at Pont des Arts.
While heading there, Marinette receives a message from Alya, revealing that her new friend is Wayhem.
Marinette secretly sends Alya a message back, telling her that Kagami is her new friend and to go for the win, refusing to find Adrien as long as she's with her.

title: Ikari Gozen
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Ikari Gozen - Plot
At Pont des Arts, Kagami finds a fishing rod with a magnet attached to it and gives it to Marinette, telling her to fish.
Marinette picks up an old whistle, but Kagami figures that it isn't the clue and discards it.
She then asks Marinette if she prefers to be called by her full name or a nickname while attempting to smile.
A perplexed Marinette replies with her whole name.
Kagami thanks Marinette and compliments her hair, calling it shiny.
Marinette, confused by Kagami's behavior, thanks her and says that her hair isn't so bad either.
She fishes out an old frying pan, but Kagami discards it as well.
She also asks her what her blood type is.
Marinette doesn't know and asks if she's messing with her.
Kagami assures her that she isn't and explains that everyone in Japan knows their blood type as it tells them who they are.
She adds that hers is Type O, meaning that she's independent, optimistic, strong-willed and intuitive.
She then asks Marinette what her favorite season is.
Marinette can't decide between summer, spring, fall, or winter, causing Kagami to believe that she's Type AB as she's indecisive, scattered-brained, irresponsible and has a split personality.

title: Ikari Gozen
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Ikari Gozen - Plot
Kagami goes on to ask her what she'd do if she found out about some special chocolate ice cream and wanted to try it only to be beaten to it by someone else, giving her three options.
Marinette says that she'd just try a different flavor.
Suddenly, she manages to fish out the clue and attempts to hide it from Kagami.
Kagami asks Marinette if she'd like to get some orange juice with her.
Marinette accepts, telling her that it would be more fun than the game whilst trying to hide the clue, but Kagami sees it and awkwardly congratulates Marinette with a pat on the shoulder.
She tells her that after they win, they can go and get orange juice together.
Marinette and Kagami go throughout Paris in search of clues.
Each time, Marinette attempts to make them lose by hiding the clues or pointing in the wrong direction, but Kagami always finds them or figures out the correct way.
The last part of the game requires the two to exchange phones and take selfies in front of famous monuments before meeting back and taking selfies with each other.
Kagami gives Marinette her phone and impatiently waits for Marinette to give her hers, eventually snatching it from her and calling her indecisive.

title: Ikari Gozen
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Ikari Gozen - Plot
She tells her that they'll meet back where they were before taking off.
Marinette hides behind some nearby trees and begins looking through Kagami's phone, though Tikki is against that since Kagami had trusted her.
While looking through it, Marinette discovers that she has zero messages except the ones from the game and her only contact is her mother.
She also discovers an app with tips on how to make friends and realizes that Kagami had only been trying to be her friend.
Marinette feels awful and then realizes that Kagami might see the messages she'd been sending to Alya.
Tikki asks her if all humans look through other people's things.
Marinette gives her a guilty smile, and Tikki tells her to run.
Kagami attempts to take a selfie in front of a Parisian monument when she discovers Alya's latest message to Marinette, saying that Alya can't believe that Marinette's stuck with Kagami and will find a way to lose for sure.
Kagami is saddened at this revelation and takes a selfie with a frown.
Hawk Moth picks up on Kagami's negative emotions and sends an akuma after her.

title: Ikari Gozen
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Ikari Gozen - Plot
Kagami goes back to where she and Marinette originally were and hands her back her phone, sadly remarking that their blood types are too incompatible.
Marinette attempts to say something, but Tomoe calls and Marinette answers it.
Tomoe angrily demands to know where her daughter is, stating that she was supposed to wait for her at home.
Marinette attempts to explain the situation in a way that'll prevent Kagami from getting in trouble but only succeeds in making Tomoe angrier.
Kagami sees that Marinette is trying to defend her and smiles, making her negative emotions go away.
However, Hawk Moth isn't disappointed as he senses Tomoe's negative emotions and sends the akuma after her instead.
It infects her bokken.
Marinette pleads with Tomoe not to punish her daughter but instead hears her getting akumatized.
She promptly hangs up and tries to get Kagami away from danger.

title: Ikari Gozen
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Ikari Gozen - Plot
Tomoe is transformed into Ikari Gozen and begins looking for Kagami, completely ignoring the destruction she is causing throughout Paris. Once finding her, she scolds her for disobeying and swallows her whole, declaring that she will never go out again. A horrified Marinette runs and hides, realizing that she was wrong about Kagami. Tikki tells her that it's not too late to make things right, and Marinette transforms into Ladybug. Meanwhile at the Musée Grévin, Akuma Alert is sent out, and everyone is told to evacuate. Placide I.T. attempts to grab Adrien and flee but unknowingly grabs a wax statue of him instead. The real Adrien hides and transforms into Cat Noir.

title: Ikari Gozen
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Ikari Gozen - Plot
Ladybug fights Ikari Gozen, but Ikari Gozen declares that Ladybug will never beat her as she is as elusive as the wind, as powerful as the flood, and as swift as lightning. She throws Ladybug into a tree. Cat Noir shows up and jokingly comments that she made a new friend for Friendship Day, though Ladybug retorts that Ikari Gozen doesn't seem to like her very much. She also informs him that Ikari Gozen imprisoned Kagami as a punishment. She then calls on her Lucky Charm and receives a movie ticket. She heads to the cinema, promising to be back soon.
Marinette goes inside the cinema and gives the man at the counter her ticket. However, she quickly discovers that he's Master Fu and is surprised. Master Fu explains that he had to find a cover since Hawk Moth now knows his identity and pulls out the Miracle Box, telling Marinette to pick a trusted ally to fight alongside her and return the Miraculous once she's done. Marinette picks the Dragon Miraculous.

title: Ikari Gozen
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Ikari Gozen - Plot
Cat Noir fights Ikari Gozen until Ladybug comes back and pulls him away from her. She figures that the akuma is in Ikari Gozen's bokken and calls on her Lucky Charm, receiving a box of bath bombs. She places the box containing the Dragon Miraculous along with the bath bombs into a nearby cooler and throws them at Ikari Gozen, forcing her to swallow it. Kagami finds the cooler and opens it up. Seeing the box inside, she opens it and discovers the Dragon Miraculous and kwami, Longg, who introduces himself to her. Ladybug hopes that her plan works, and Cat Noir agrees that the sooner, the better.

title: Ikari Gozen
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Ikari Gozen - Plot
Longg is about to explain Ladybug's plan to Kagami, but she transforms before he can do so. She uses Wind Dragon to escape Ikari Gozen and then introduces herself as Ryuko to Ladybug and Cat Noir. Ladybug asks Ryuko about the plan, much to her confusion. Hawk Moth figures that Ladybug gave Kagami a Miraculous and informs Ikari Gozen, ordering her to take it. Ikari Gozen is furious at Kagami for disobeying her again and the two fight. In the middle of the battle, Cat Noir winds up getting swallowed by the villain. He attempts to escape with Cataclysm, but Ikari Gozen binds his arm in place with a seatbelt. Hawk Moth praises her for a job well done, commenting on how Cat Noir has just a few minutes before he transforms back.

title: Ikari Gozen
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Ikari Gozen - Plot
Ryuko believes that since she behaved hastily, she doesn't deserve to fight alongside Ladybug. She prepares to take off the Dragon Miraculous, but Ladybug assures her that making a mistake is no reason to give up fighting as she is the only one who can help her. She then tells her of her plan. Ryuko approaches Ikari Gozen and says that she was right. Pleased to see that she "has come to her senses", Ikari Gozen swallows her. Once inside, Ryuko uses Water Dragon to turn her entire body into water, causing the bath bombs inside of her to expand and allowing her and Cat Noir to escape. Cat Noir then uses Cataclysm on Ikari Gozen's bokken, releasing the akuma. Ladybug purifies it and uses Miraculous Ladybug to repair all the damage. A confused Tomoe wonders where Kagami is, to which Ryuko assures her that her daughter is safe and nearby. She then fist bumps with Ladybug and Cat Noir.

title: Ikari Gozen
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Ikari Gozen - Plot
Ladybug and Ryuko hide inside an alley, where the latter detransforms and gives her Miraculous back to Ladybug. Ladybug tells her that she won't be able to give her the Miraculous again. Kagami believes that it's because she wasn't good enough, but Ladybug explains that it's because Hawk Moth knows her true identity and keeping a secret identity is an important part of being a superhero as without one, family and friends would be endangered. Kagami reveals that she doesn't have many friends, but Ladybug tells her that it isn't important to have lots of friends, just true friends.
Kagami approaches her mother in the car and apologizes for not being truthful, explaining that she had really wanted to make a friend. Tomoe points out that she has Adrien, but Kagami says that it isn't the same. Tomoe tells Kagami that she understands that she wants to make friends but warns her that friendships can be disappointing sometimes. However, Kagami stands her ground, so Tomoe tells her to be home in time for dinner.

title: Ikari Gozen
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Ikari Gozen - Plot
Kagami approaches Marinette and informs her that they lost the contest. However, Marinette tells her that they can still go and get orange juice together. Kagami realizes that she was wrong about Marinette and tells her that she understands why Adrien calls her a good friend. Marinette is disappointed that Adrien only thinks of her as a friend but quickly brushes it off. The two girls head to get orange juice while talking about their Chinese Zodiac signs before the end card appears.

title: Ikari Gozen
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Ikari Gozen - Trivia
Internationally, this episode premiered in SDCC 2019.
This episode was released out of order, and it revealed new information that had to be known previously:
In "Feast", Hawk Moth discovered that Mr. Chan, aka Wang Fu, is actually the Guardian of the Miraculouses, and because of that, Master Fu needed to keep a low profile.
Given his explanation to Marinette, this episode takes place before the events of "Party Crasher".
Hawk Moth also previously discovered the existence of the other kwamis in "Sandboy" and knew they were close to the Seine, though he was unsuccessful in locating them fully.
The name of the akuma is most likely from ikari "anger" plus the honorific 'gozen' implying usually-female nobility.
In Brazil, this episode is titled Ikari Iozen, since "Gozen" is similar to a Brazilian pejorative word which most people from the country use.

title: Ikari Gozen
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Ikari Gozen - Trivia
This episode marks one of the few times a Miraculous holder's identity is revealed to another that is not Ladybug or Cat Noir, with that being Hawk Moth. At the time of episode, Hawk Moth knew the identity of two superheroes: Chloé Bourgeois (Queen Bee) and Kagami Tsurugi (Ryuko). However, unlike Chloé, Kagami's identity as Ryuko is not known by the rest of the city of Paris.
This episode has few references to "Ladybug & Cat Noir":
Much like how it happened with Adrien when he became Cat Noir, Kagami transformed before hearing her kwami's explanation fully first. In both cases, this caused some troubles during the fight against an akumatized villain.
Much like how it happened with Ladybug failing for the first time and wanting to give up, Kagami wanted to give up after failing for the first time, too. In both cases, they were encouraged by a friend to try again.
This episode shows that Kagami had no friends besides Adrien Agreste, until she became friends with Marinette Dupain-Cheng.
Ryuko's teleportation is a reference to the anime franchise of Dragon Ball.
This episode shows that as Ryuko, Kagami can call upon one of her three transformations Water, Wind, and Lightning.

title: Ikari Gozen
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Ikari Gozen - Trivia
In the English version, it's revealed that Kagami's zodiac sign is a Dragon while Marinette's is a Snake.
This most likely means that Kagami was born in 2000 and Marinette was born in 2001, meaning that all the events of the show happen in 2015/2016, as all seasons take place during the same school year.
In the French version it's stated that Marinette is a Leo, and Kagami is a Scorpio. However, according to Thomas Astruc, this is incorrect, and their Chinese signs should've been used.
Kagami reported that her blood type is O, and she also assumed that Marinette's blood type is AB.
Since Ladybug explains to Kagami that she can't give her the Dragon Miraculous again due to her identity being revealed to Hawk Moth, this episode likely happens after "Miraculer", since she gave the same explanation to Chloé Bourgeois in that episode.
As of "Heart Hunter", due to Marinette's troubled heart, she broke her own rule when she returned the Dragon Miraculous to Kagami.

title: Ikari Gozen
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Ikari Gozen - Trivia
It's the second time Miraculous related content was aired in the US before being aired in other countries after "Captain Hardrock", later being followed by "Miraculous New York", "Wishmaker", "Ladybug Saves Christmas", "Qilin", "Risk", and "Daddycop".
When Ladybug attacks Ikari Gozen, one of the animation is reused from "Stoneheart".
The thumbnail of the official trailer features Ryuko, instead of Ikari Gozen, making it the first one not to have the titular character on it.
The reason for this is currently unknown.
A poster for the movie from the episode can be seen in Nora's room.
Errors
Kagami is able to transform into Ryuko and back despite Longg not giving her the transformation words.
However, she could have told them to her off-screen.
When Kagami transforms into Ryuko, her eyes don't change. But when she escapes Ikari Gozen, her eyes become dragon eyes.
When Ladybug attacks Ikari Gozen after Adrien transforms, her foot is partially cut off.

Marinette: I feel so bad. Oh no! She's got my phone. If she sneaks a peak, she'll see the messages Alya and I were sending each other.
Tikki: Do all humans really sneak through other people's things? (Marinette smiles guilty) You better run!
Alya: (in recording) I can't believe you're stuck with Kagami. Hang in there, girl, and don't worry, I'm sure you'll figure out a way to lose. Catch you later!
(Kagami looks upset. She takes a selfie with a totally neutral facial expression.)

title: Ikari Gozen/Transcript
text:
Ikari Gozen/Transcript - Intro
Hawk Moth: How tragic it is to feel unloved. Alone, deprived of friendship. (turns a butterfly into an akuma) Fly away, my little akuma, and evilise her!
Kagami: I guess I'm not worthy of our friendship. Our blood types must be too incompatible. (sadly hands Marinette her phone back and begins to walk away)
Marinette: (Kagami's phone begins to ring, she answers it) Hello?
Tomoe: Kagami, where are you?! You were supposed to wait for me at home!
Marinette: Uhh– Hello, ma'am, I'm not Kagami, actually.
Tomoe: Who are you?! Where's my daughter?!
Marinette: Kagami! I'm a friend of Kagami's, I'm right here with her. I'll put her on the phone.
Tomoe: Kagami doesn't have any friends. Why do you have her phone?
Marinette: (Kagami starts frantically trying to grab her phone) Oh, I can assure you, ma'am, I am a friend of Kagami's. We've been teamed up together for a game.
Tomoe: A game?! But I forbade her to!

title: Ikari Gozen/Transcript
text:
Ikari Gozen/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: A game? Did I say "game"? Oh no, sorry, I meant a grab. To grab. I invited Kagami over to grab some orange juice with me. She'll be back home soon, I promise. (Kagami seems happy with the effort Marinette is putting in not getting her busted. The incoming akuma flutters off) I'll even walk her home myself.
Hawk Moth: (from his lair) One negative emotion is disappearing. But another is forming quickly. I can feel the anger of a mother whose authority has been challenged. Go, my akuma, and seek out this new prey.
Tomoe: Stop fooling around, young lady and put my daughter through. I can assure you she will not be enjoying any glasses of– (the akuma enters her bokken)
Hawk Moth: (from his lair) Ikari Gozen, I am Hawk Moth.
Marinette: Ma'am, please don't punish your daughter. Ma'am? Hello?
Tomoe: (through phone) With pleasure, Hawk Moth.
Marinette: I'm sorry, I really did try to smooth things over but I think your mom's super-duper angry now and will be looking for you. I actually think you might wanna hide someplace where she won't find you.

title: Ikari Gozen/Transcript
text:
Ikari Gozen/Transcript - Intro
(Somewhere in the streets of Paris, Tomoe's car along with herself are engulfed in purple magic and get transformed into Ikari Gozen. Eye witnesses panic and scatter.)
Ikari Gozen: Kagami! (lands near Kagami and Marinette) You disobeyed me! You will never go out again! (grabs Kagami and swallows her whole, trapping her inside her stomach)
Kagami: No! Mother! (Marinette gasps)
Marinette: I was completely wrong about Kagami.
Tikki: It's never too late to make things right, Marinette.
[Transformation Sequence]Marinette: Tikki, spots on! Wha–! (Marinette transforms into Ladybug)
Alarm voice: Akuma alert. Akuma alert. We ask all visitors to kindly evacuate the palace very calmly. Thank you.
(Placide I.T. takes the wax statue of Adrien instead of the real one.)
Adrien: We have a new mission.
[Transformation Sequence]Adrien: Plagg, claws out! (Adrien transforms into Cat Noir)
Ikari Gozen: You'll never catch me! I'm Ikari Gozen. As elusive as the wind, as powerful as the flood, as swift as lightning! (Ladybug gets thrown into a tree)
Cat Noir: I see you've already made a new buddy for friendship day, m'lady.
Ladybug: Yeah. No, I don't think she likes me all that much. We're coming, Kagami.

title: Ikari Gozen/Transcript
text:
Ikari Gozen/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: Kagami?
Ladybug: Our new friend here has imprisoned her own daughter as a punishment. Lucky Charm! (a cinema ticket drops in her hands)
Cat Noir: You really think it's time to invite me to the cinema?
Ladybug: (boops Cat Noir's nose) Sorry, kitty, only got one ticket, I'll come back soon.
Cat Noir: At least bring me back some popcorn!
Marinette: Hello, I'd like to see this movie, please.
Master Fu: Excellent choice, Marinette!
Marinette: Master Fu?
Master Fu: I had to find a cover now that Hawk Moth knows my identity. Besides, I love the movies. (grabs the Miracle Box) Marinette Dupain-Cheng, pick an ally you can trust right alongside you on this mission. Choose wisely; such powers are meant to serve the greater good.
Marinette: As elusive as the wind, as powerful as the flood, as swift as lightning. Yeah! (she picks up the Dragon Miraculous) I hope you enjoy the show, master.
Ladybug: The Akuma's probably hiding inside her bokken.
Cat Noir: In order to use my Cataclysm, we gotta bring her guard down, first.
Ladybug: We just need to be as elusive as the wind, or as powerful as the flood. Lucky Charm! (a box of bath bombs drops in her hands)
Cat Noir: A box of bath bombs?

title: Ikari Gozen/Transcript
text:
Ikari Gozen/Transcript - Intro
(Ladybug, with her Lucky Vision, sees in order: Ikari Gozen, a scooter's storage compartment, Cat Noir and the bath bombs.)
Cat Noir: You really think it's time to take a bath?
Ladybug: Not me. Kagami is gonna use it. Get ready, kitty. (with her yo-yo she retrieves the scooter storage compartment and puts the bath bombs with the box with the dragon miraculous inside) So, Ikari Gozen, how would you like to become friends?
Ikari Gozen: I don't need a friend!
Ladybug: Can't say I'm surprised. You're going about it all wrong, if you ask me. (she throws the box to Cat Noir, who then slams it into Ikari Gozen's mouth; the box drops on Kagami's lap; Kagami opens the Miraculous box and Longg appears)
Longg: Greetings, young lady and good day to you. Fear not, I am Longg, the Dragon Kwami.
Kagami: You're a what?
Longg: A Kwa-mi.
(In the meantime, Ikari Gozen is destroying more property)
Ladybug: I hope it works.
Cat Noir: The sooner, the better, too.

title: Ikari Gozen/Transcript
text:
Ikari Gozen/Transcript - Intro
Longg: Allow me to tell you all about the many feats that a magic being like myself will help you accomplish once the magic words have been spoken. (Kagami puts on the Miraculous) Ladybug has hopes that you will defeat Ikari Gozen with panache, using the element of your choosing. Wind, water or lightning. But firstly, let me tell you about her plan.
[Transformation Sequence]Kagami: Longg, bring the storm!
Longg: Wait! No! Not yet! (Kagami transforms into Ryuko)
Ryuko: Wind dragon! (steam emerges from Ikari Gozen's body and Ryuko appears) See, Mother? I can be as elusive as wind! Thank you for the Miraculous, Ladybug. Nice to meet you, Cat Noir. I am Ryuko.
Ladybug: What are you doing? This wasn't the plan!
Ryuko: What plan?
Hawk Moth: (from his lair) Ikari Gozen, Ladybug has helped your daughter escape by giving her a Miraculous. I don't know how she did it, but I want her Miraculous, too!
Ikari Gozen: Kagami! You've disobeyed me yet again! And this time with the complicity of these so-called heroes. You are all going to pay!
Ladybug: Ryuko, the plan! Surely Longg must have told you about the plan?!

title: Ikari Gozen/Transcript
text:
Ikari Gozen/Transcript - Intro
Ryuko: No, stay behind with Cat Noir. This is a personal matter between a mother and a daughter.
(Ryuko fights with Ikari Gozen. She is really good at fighting.)
Cat Noir: Watch out! (gets hit and swallowed whole)
Ryuko: No!
Cat Noir: (gets stuck just like Kagami was) Cataclysm! (a seatbelt wraps around his wrist)
Hawk Moth: (from his lair) What a masterful move, Ikari Gozen. Now, in just a few minutes, Cat Noir will transform back and his Miraculous will be mine!
(Ladybug and Ryuko run off and hide behind a monument)
Ryuko: I behaved hastily. I failed. I am not worthy to fight beside you.
Ladybug: You made a mistake, as I do every day, but that's not a reason to give up fighting. You're the only one who can help me, that's why I chose you. But we must work together as a team. We don't have much time left: here's the plan.
Cat Noir: (still stuck) Hurry up before I transform back!
Ryuko: You were right, Mother, I still have a lot to learn.
Ikari Gozen: You're starting to have some sense. That's good. (picks up Ryuko and swallows her)
Ryuko: (falls beside Cat Noir) Hold your breath. Aim at the bokken.
Cat Noir: Wow, you're a fast learner.

title: Ikari Gozen/Transcript
text:
Ikari Gozen/Transcript - Intro
Ryuko: I have good teachers. Water dragon! (Ryuko morphs into water and Ikari Gozen starts to fill up with water; the water spills out of Ikari Gozen; she spits out Cat Noir, who cataclysms the bokken; Ladybug kicks the disintegrated object and releases the Akuma)
Ladybug: No more evil-doing for you, little Akuma. Time to de-evilise! (she catches the Akuma with her yo-yo) Gotcha! Bye-bye, little butterfly! Miraculous Ladybug! (throws the bath bomb container into the air; the Miraculous Cure restores damage and turns Ikari Gozen back into Tomoe)
Tomoe: What's happened to me? Where is Kagami?
Ryuko: Your daughter is nearby, ma'am. She'll be here soon. (Ladybug and Cat Noir hold up their fists to fist bump, but wait for Ryuko; Ryuko joins them)
All three: Pound it!
Ryuko: (moved into an alley with Ladybug) Longg, open sky! (Ryuko detransforms into Kagami)
Ladybug: I have to tell you that I won't be able to give you this Miraculous again.
Kagami: I know, I wasn't good enough.
Ladybug: Quite the opposite.
Kagami: Huh?

title: Ikari Gozen/Transcript
text:
Ikari Gozen/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: You learnt fast, but Hawk Moth knows who you are now and keeping one's true identity secret is a very important rule among superheroes. Without it, you and everyone you love will become endangered. Your family, your friends.
Kagami: I don't have many friends.
Ladybug: It's not important to have lots of friends. What matters is that the ones you have are true friends. Bug out!
Kagami: I'm sorry I wasn't truthful with you, Mother. But, I really wanted to try and make a friend.
Tomoe: You already have Adrien.
Kagami: It's not the same.
Tomoe: I understand that you want to make friends, but friendships can prove disappointing sometimes. (pauses; sighs) Be home in time for dinner. (the car drives off)
Kagami: The game is over. We lost. (shows Marinette and image of Alya, Wayhem, Mireille, Aurore, Adrien and the Gorilla)
Marinette: No, we won the right to get orange juice together. If you still want to, that is. Nothing can stop us now.
Kagami: I was wrong about you, Marinette. I'm glad this game randomly put us together. Now I understand why Adrien considers you a good friend.

title: Ikari Gozen/Transcript
text:
Ikari Gozen/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Oh– uh– did he tell you that… I mean… that we're friends? (Kagami nods; Marinette manages a bitter-sweet smile; she and Kagami walk off) By the way, I've been thinking about this blood type thing. Isn't that a bit like the Zodiac thing? What's your sign?
Kagami: Dragon.
Marinette: No way! I'm snake! Do they go well together?
Kagami: Actually, I don't really believe in that stuff.
Marinette: Me neither, but you know what, I'm glad we're friends.

title: Húdié
text:
Húdié - Intro
was a Miraculous holder who is featured in the Grimoire. When Nooroo inhabited the Butterfly Miraculous, he transformed into a butterfly-themed superhero.

title: Húdié
text:
Húdié - Appearance
The Butterfly Miraculous holder had a black beard and mustache, and he wore a silver mask over most of his face. He wore a dark purple tunic and trousers that ended shortly below his knees. He had a dark purple cape collar, and in front of it, he had a large black butterfly-shaped lapel on his front. The Butterfly Miraculous brooch was placed a little bit above the lapel. Additionally, he had black cloth around his lower legs and black shoes, black gloves, and gray wristbands over of his tunic's long sleeves.

title: Húdié
text:
Húdié - Abilities
If this past Butterfly Miraculous holder had the same powers as the current holder but for the good, he had enhanced abilities and the superpower Kamikotization. He also used the cane, as seen in the book illustration.

title: Húdié
text:
Húdié - Trivia
The Ancient Chinese Butterfly Miraculous holder is a superhero, but in "Volpina", Adrien mistakes him for Hawk Moth and wonders what his page is doing in a book about superheroes.
Which is understandable because until "Catalyst", "Mayura" and Adrien being explained everything by Master Fu the heroes had never met Hawk Moth in person.
In the book, this Miraculous holder encoded is called Hawk Moth.
Húdié (蝴蝶) means "Butterfly" in Chinese.
He is the earliest known Butterfly Miraculous holder.
Similar to Hippolyta and Heracles, since he and the other Chinese holders were the first Miraculous holders it's likely that they knew each other.

title: Húlí
text:
Húlí - Intro
was a Miraculous holder who is featured in the Grimoire for the Fox Miraculous. When Trixx inhabited the pendant , she transformed into a fox-themed superhero.

title: Húlí
text:
Húlí - Appearance
As depicted in the Miraculous spellbook, the Fox Miraculous holder had long black hair and bangs that she tied into two small side ponytails and one low ponytail, the tips of her ponytails being orange and white. She wore an orange cloth band around her head, its edges tied up and pointed like fox ears, and an orange cloth covered her nose and mouth. She wore an orange sleeveless tunic that was white on one upper edge and an orange sash wrapped around her shoulders. She also wore orange trousers, black knee-high cloth over her lower legs, black wristbands, and black shoes. Around her waist and hips was a wide white sash tied with an orange string, with one orange, white-tipped part of it falling being her like a fox's tail.

title: Húlí
text:
Húlí - Abilities
The Fox Miraculous holder used the flute, as seen in the book illustration. And assuming that the past Fox Miraculous holder powers are the same as the recent Fox Miraculous holder (Rena Rouge), she would have the superpower Mirage, allowed her to create illusions. She would also had enhanced skills, such as speed, strength, and - most prominently - agility.

title: Húlí
text:
Húlí - Trivia
The akumatized supervillain Volpina's design is strongly influenced by Húlí's illustration.
In "Volpina", Lila Rossi calls her an ancient vixen superhero and lies that her name is Volpina.
However, it is unknown how Lila read the grimoire, because that is the name coded in the book and as mentioned by Nooroo in "Syren" only guardians can read it.
Given that it's unlikely that Lila can read nyctographs and knew of the holder's Chinese origins, as the book in code calls this Miraculous holder Volpina, she came up with the name Volpina as it derives from the Italian word for fox, "volpe".
Húlí (狐狸) means "fox" in Chinese and the word isn't that far off from Fuli which means "very fast" in Swahili referring to a Fox Miraculous holder's superior agility.
Hóng hú (紅狐) means "red fox" in Chinese.
She is the earliest known Fox Miraculous holder.
She is the first known person of Chinese origins to wield the Fox Miraculous, preceding Marinette, who used it once in "Kwamibuster".
Similar to Hippolyta and Heracles, since she and the other Chinese holders were the first Miraculous holders it's likely that they knew each other.

title: Ice statue
text:
Ice statue - Intro
The Ice Statue is an object d'art in Times Square in New York City. It was constructed by the superhero Snowflake to commemorate the heroic deeds of Ladybug, Cat Noir, Uncanny Valley and Eagle in defeating Techno-Pirate and his temporary sponsor, Hawk Moth during Franco-American Friendship Week.

title: Ice statue
text:
Ice statue - Appearance
The sculpture stands on a plinth approximately 1m tall and 3m across and features life-size likenesses of the heroes standing back-to-back in a four-square formation.
As the sculpture was created by Snowflake's super-powers, it is not known whether it will melt or is now a permanent feature of the city.

title: Ice statue
text:
Ice statue - Trivia
The same ice statue that was made of the young heroes was the same one shown in the beginning and ending title sequences of the special episode Miraculous World: New York - United HeroeZ.

title: Illusion
text:
Illusion - Intro
"" is a season 5 episode of the series Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 5th written and produced episode of season 5. It is also the 109th written and produced episode of the series overall.

title: Illusion
text:
Illusion - Synopsis
Even though Ladybug can no longer entrust him with a Miraculous, Nino wants to keep helping the superhero and Cat Noir. He decides to create a Resistance Network at school. The secret organization's first mission is to figure out how Monarch's new power works by deliberately triggering an akumatization. But the first members of the Resistance, Marinette, Adrien and Alya, are not convinced. Would Ladybug and Cat Noir agree with such a plan?
Disney+
What if someone decided to trigger an akumatization?
Netflix
Nino's group, the Resistance, makes a dangerous plan to uncover Monarch's secret to akumatizing without the Miraculous, despite Marinette's objections.

title: Illusion
text:
Illusion - Plot
Mr. Ramier, XY, Mr. Damoclès, and Chloé are interviewed for a TVi news report on their views of Monarch taking all the Miraculouses. While others share their positive opinions, Chloé, who still holds a grudge towards Ladybug, says that Monarch would never be able to take the Miraculouses if she was still Queen Bee. At the TVi studio, Nadja Chamack is sitting with Alec, Bob Roth and Mr. Banana for the news report. They talk about how Ladybug lost all the Miraculouses to Monarch and if she is the hero the people need. After taking each person's opinion, they take a break.
In Adrien's room, Plagg is playing with an Alliance ring. Adrien sees he has virtually become a puppet to every Alliance ring user, and he becomes annoyed at this. He takes the ring from Plagg and goes to confront his father. On his way, Adrien meets Nathalie and tells her he needs to see his father. She replies that it is a perfect time since he is also waiting for him in the kitchen, to which Adrien gets surprised. She also says that she will accompany Adrien for the parent-teacher conference, but Gabriel interrupts her from the kitchen, saying that he will go instead of her, to which Nathalie frowns.

title: Illusion
text:
Illusion - Plot
Inside the kitchen, Gabriel is shown to be cooking French toast.
Adrien enters the kitchen, and Nathalie shuts the door behind him.
Gabriel asks his son about how he likes his French toast.
When Adrien tells him his preference, Gabriel tells him to call him "Dad" instead of "Father".
Gabriel tells him that he has cleared his schedule for the parent-teacher conference since it is about his future.
Adrien becomes surprised by Gabriel's new behaviour and asks if everything is alright.
Gabriel tells him that he never felt better.
He explains that since his mother's disappearance, he allowed too much distance between himself and his son.
He expresses his disbelief that he couldn't even see that Adrien didn't want to be a model any longer.
After discussion, he tells Adrien to ask Alliance how long they have to cook eggs to be soft-boiled.
At the mention of the Alliance, Adrien tells him that he is not really comfortable with having his face on all these rings, and that's the main reason for him to quit modelling.
Gabriel explains to him that it is just an image, not the real him, and since this image frees him from his obligations, they will be able to spend more time together.

title: Illusion
text:
Illusion - Plot
But if Adrien doesn't want it, he can undo it.
Adrien understands it and replies that he is okay with it.
After that, Gabriel and Adrien continue cooking.

title: Illusion
text:
Illusion - Plot
At their respective homes, Marinette and Alya are preparing for school. Alya video calls Marinette from her Alliance ring and asks if she is late, to which Marinette denies but visibly fixes her things and packs her bag. Alya tells her she misses being Rena Rouge. Marinette replies she also misses her former superhero team, but she needs a way to get back the Miraculouses from Monarch. Alya asks if she agrees that Monarch entrusts his akumatized villains with Miraculous. As Marinette exits the bakery, she agrees but replies that when they de-akumatize them, the villains never have the Miraculous on them. Alya suggests that Monarch might have used the Dog Miraculous to get the Miraculous back. As two of them meet at the school and end their call, Marinette counters Alya by saying that she would have noticed the ball in that case. Suddenly Nino interrupts them and asks what they are talking about. They reply that they were talking about a "very tough new video game". Just then, the school bell rings, and Nino frowns in annoyance at the interruption.

title: Illusion
text:
Illusion - Plot
Inside the classroom, Ms Bustier informs the class that the afternoon classes will not be held due to parent-teacher conferences regarding post-graduation. Nino tells Adrien that he is gonna be a superhero. Adrien replies that he thought Ladybug couldn't hand out Miraculous anymore. Nino says he isn't talking about the Miraculous since Monarch will have to deal with a new enemy, the Resistance. Adrien gets surprised and asks if there is a Resistance starting up. Nino replies not yet, but Adrien can be the first recruit, Comrade Mayo, and Nino will be Comrade Ketchup. Nino tells him that he already has a plan but can't talk about it in the classroom.
Later, along with Marinette and Alya, they walk towards the cafeteria. Nino asks Adrien if his father is OK with him eating in the cafeteria. Alya further asks him if he is really coming to the conference. Nino, noticing the change in Adrien's father's behaviour, asks Adrien if he is sure his father has not been akumatized again. To this, Adrien only smiles at him but says nothing.

title: Illusion
text:
Illusion - Plot
Inside the cafeteria, as they line up, Nino explains to Adrien about the cafeteria's system. Adrien expresses his surprise at this and begins to examine the dishes. As he picks every plate on the counter, his Alliance ring bumps onto one of the plates, turning it on. After Adrien turns it off, Marinette asks him if that doesn't feel weird to have his face on all these rings. Adrien replies that it is just his image, and it allows him to spend more time with the people he cares about, like his father, his friends and also Marinette, to which she becomes flustered. Chloé sees Adrien in the cafeteria and asks if he would like to dine with her. Adrien kindly declines her offer, saying he is eating with his friends. She and Sabrina leaves Adrien and his friends alone.

title: Illusion
text:
Illusion - Plot
Nino then goes over how he and Alya were Carapace and Rena Rouge. Lila then shows up and asks if she can sit with Adrien and his friends. Adrien asks if she can wait for tomorrow in which she says yes. Lila takes a picture of Adrien dining with his friends in the cafeteria using her Alliance ring and posts it on social media. Nino goes over on how Monarch gives his akumatized villains the superpowers of the Miraculouses even though Ladybug and Cat Noir never find any on them. Nino then states they will film an akumatizion. When Alya asks how they will know the akumatizion will happen, Nino replies with they will create one.
Suddenly, people start rushing into the cafeteria, looking for Adrien, after Lila's picture goes viral. The Resistance (Nino, Alya, Marinette and Adrien) rush over to the boiler room. Lila secretly follows them. Nino then announces that Gabriel Agreste is the ideal parent for an akumatizion and he will be used. Marinette and Adrien agree to the plan, despite Alya's objections. Lila listens in on the meeting.

title: Illusion
text:
Illusion - Plot
Gabriel arrives at the school and Lila tells him about the Resistance's plans to get him akumatized. At the meeting, Miss Bustier asks Gabriel where Adrien's file is but he answers her with that Adrien has changed his wishes and he needs to help him decide. After Marinette, Adrien and Alya pretend to 'accidentally' spill food on Gabriel's suit, he takes Adrien away from school.
On the drive home, Gabriel tells Adrien he will call him Father not Dad. At the Agreste mansion, Gabriel tells Adrien to go to his room. In his secret lair, Gabriel transforms into Monarch. He then absorbs Trixx into his ring and creates an illusion of Gabriel. The Resistance calls Adrien and Nino sees an illusion of a megakuma. Adrien films the megakuma entering the illusion Gabriel's tablet. The illusion gets akumatized into The Collector. The illusion says Monarch gave him the Miraculous of the Horse.

title: Illusion
text:
Illusion - Plot
Adrien quickly runs to his room and transforms into Cat Noir. The Collector pretends to have leave the mansion and hit the gates with his tablet. Marinette runs off and transforms into Ladybug. Ladybug and Cat Noir fight The Collector and he pretends to have teleported. Nino replays the video of the illusion getting akumatized to see how Monarch transferred the quantum essence of the Miraculous of the Horse to him.
Meanwhile in his lair, Monarch absorbs Pollen, Mullo, Kaalki and Orikko into his rings. He then can feel the kwamis hoping he loses his powers but states that they will never see their guardian again. He teleports into the sewers and uses Venom. He then uses Multitude and splits into eight clones. He then uses Sublimation to make himself invisible. After The Collector teleports, Ladybug uses her Lucky Charm and is given a packet of shredded cheese. She looks around and finds nothing.

title: Illusion
text:
Illusion - Plot
Monarch uses Voyage to teleport the illusion to the sewers and Ladybug and Cat Noir go through the portal and follow him. One of the Monarchs uses immobilizes Cat Noir. Ladybug looks around and sees the Monarchs' footsteps in the sewer water. She realizes that Monarch has turned himself invisible. She spreads the cheese on the clones and the Monarchs run off. The Monarchs unite to become one person again. The Collector then tells Ladybug that he can't be saved and rejects the megakuma. The illusion falls into the sewer water and disappears. Ladybug powers up falls into the sewer water too. Monarch teleports himself to where Ladybug and detransforms. She looks around and can't find the illusion. She finds Gabriel and smiles.

title: Illusion
text:
Illusion - Plot
Nino shows Alya how if he slows the video down he can find magic lightning bolts that are invisible to the naked human eye and believes that is how Monarch gives his akumatized villains the powers of the Miraculouses. At the front of the house, Nino apologizes to Gabriel for the food being spilt on him and says it was a plan to help Ladybug and Cat Noir. He shows them his discovery. Gabriel congratulates him for spotting that. Nino asks Gabriel if Adrien can come back to school and he says yes. Nino welcomes Gabriel on the Resistance as Mr Comrade Tartar Sauce and shakes hands with him. Back in Adrien's room, Gabriel apologizes to Adrien and hugs him. Adrien asks Gabriel if it is okay with him that he doesn't wear an Alliance, to which he answers him yes.

title: Illusion
text:
Illusion - Plot
In the boiler room, Nino introduces the rest of the Resistance members and finally Comrade Sweet and Sour, Lila. Alya convinces Marinette to accept her as everyone wants to help Ladybug. Marinette shakes hands with Lila. He also states that the Resistance will never find the connection between his powers and the Alliance as the episode ends.

title: Illusion
text:
Illusion - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in France on TFOU.
The episode shares its name with the concept of the Fox Miraculous.
Like with all other episodes of Season 5, this one also follows with making connections to its concept outside of the superpowers.
Monarch mentions all the times Ladybug tricked him using illusions, which is a reference to episodes like "Sapotis", "Miraculer", "Gang of Secrets", "Mr. Pigeon 72", and "Sentibubbler", where Ladybug, thanks to Rena Rouge, tricked him using the power of Mirage. It can also be an allusion to all the times Ladybug tricked him.
The episode also shows characters trying to trick others, relations to when they trick themselves and also alluding to lies that were already told:
Nino orchestrated a situation to force an akumatization in order to study the way Monarch is giving Miraculous superpowers to his villains. However, unknowing to him, he chose the wrong target, as Gabriel Agreste is Monarch and Lila spied on him and told his plan to Gabriel himself.

title: Illusion
text:
Illusion - Trivia
Gabriel created an illusion of himself being akumatized to mislead Nino and the others from the role of Alliance in his plans to transfer the Miraculous superpowers, all while leading Ladybug and Cat Noir into a trap which is the same trick he fooled the heroes with in "The Collector".
His change in behavior is a common illusion trick usually done when someone is planning to do or had done something sneaky, bad or something bad or tough is about or going to happen to them.
He lied to everyone even his son about what really happened to Émilie and how he used them all, even Émilie to cover his own guilt.
Gabriel's overconfidence and cockiness with the Miraculouses in "Evolution" and "Destruction" but he fooled himself.
He threw himself into the illusion of a perfect world but should've accepted that no world is perfect nor last forever.
Despite doing everything for Adrien's happiness, Gabriel only reflected his own happiness.
How Gabriel went on with his "illusion of choice", with himself and others when actually like everyone else he was wrong.

title: Illusion
text:

In the end, Nino's Resistance has been infiltrated at its very beginning, as he made Gabriel Agreste himself an honorary member and Lila one of its core members. This gives the secret organization an illusion of control of its own plans.
Lila constantly fooled everyone with her lies and illusions.
As Chloé still being in denial, since she believed if she was still Queen Bee, she would've never handed Paris to Monarch, she ironically did exactly that in "Miracle Queen".
Nino went deep into his own insecurities in "Rocketear", tricking himself into the illusion that Cat Noir and Alya were in love, but they weren't.
"Revelation" shows how Adrien was fooled by the illusion of his own kindness.
The Fox Miraculous represents everything about illusions, lies and truths.
Through the current Fox Miraculous holder, Alya Cesaire as a reporter she is a seeker of the truth but as Rena Rouge, she learned you can't always believe everything you see or hear as well as what someone tells you and regardless of truths and lies they are still knowledge and must be treated with respect.

title: Hôtel de la Marine
text:
Hôtel de la Marine - Intro
is an emblematic monument of the Place de la Concorde, located in the 8th arrondissement of Paris.

title: Hôtel de la Marine
text:
Hôtel de la Marine - Description
Built between 1757 and 1774 by Ange-Jacques Gabriel as Garde-meuble de la Couronne, the Hôtel de la Marine is a Louis XV-style mansion located on the Place de la Concorde and surrounding the royal road with its double facade.
Its main facade has two bays with triangular pediments and Corinthian columns on the sides. The central part has an open portico on the ground floor. Above, there is a row of twelve Corinthian columns behind which there is a loggia offering a breathtaking view of the Place de la Concorde and adjacent to the Salon des Admirals. This facade is adorned with many carved medallions and garlands.

title: Hôtel de la Marine
text:
Hôtel de la Marine - Trivia
The Hôtel de la Marine has been classified as a Historic Monument since 1923.
The Hôtel de la Marine is also listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site under the title "Paris, Rives de la Seine".
The Hôtel de la Marine is an important place in the history of France, especially for its loggia.
On January 21, 1793, the Minister of the Navy Gaspard Monge witnessed the execution of King Louis XVI and countersigned his death certificate.
Officials witnessed the execution of Queen Marie Antoinette on October 16, 1793, then wrote her execution report and death certificate on October 24, 1793.
On October 25, 1835, Louis-Philippe 1st witnessed the construction of the Obélisque de Louxor from the loggia.
On April 25, 1848, Victor Schoelcher signed the decree abolishing slavery there.
During the Liberation of Paris in August 1944, the Hôtel de la Marine was the last place of retreat for Nazi soldiers before their surrender.
It is from the loggia that officials invited by President François Mitterrand watch the parade of the Bicentennial of the French Revolution on July 14, 1989.
In the United States, the Family Court Building in Philadelphia is a replica of the Hôtel de la Marine built in 1940.

title: Hôtel de la Marine
text:
Hôtel de la Marine - Trivia
The Parkway Central Library is a replica of the Hôtel de Crillon built in 1927, thus reproducing the design of the two Parisian buildings.
In the series, the Hôtel de la Marine is important on several occasions:
In "Sandboy", the eponymous villain and Plagg entered into the Métro lobby that was near the Hôtel de la Marine.
In "Mega Leech", it was on its roof that Ladybug and her team met before facing Malediktator and his sentimonster.

title: Hôtel de Crillon

Hôtel de Crillon - Intro
is a luxury hotel located in Place de la Concorde, in the 8th arrondissement of Paris.

title: Hôtel de Crillon
text:
Hôtel de Crillon - Description
The Hôtel de Crillon occupies the pavilion at the western corner of the twin building of the Hôtel de la Marine. Inaugurated in 1909, it features a three-bay portico whose four columns support an entablature crowned by a triangular tympanum.
A distinguished palace since its renovation in 2017, the Hôtel de Crillon has 78 rooms and 46 suites, including 10 of the highest luxury.
In particular, there are two marble fountains from the Palace of Versailles.

title: Hôtel de Crillon
text:
Hôtel de Crillon - Trivia
The Hôtel de Crillon has been classified as a Historic Monument since 1900 for its facade and since 1964 for its halls and roofs.
The Hôtel de Crillon has been a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1991 under the title "Paris, Rives de la Seine".
The Hotel is an important historical site for the history of Franco-American friendship:
On February 6, 1778, the Treaty of Amity and Commerce between the Kingdom of France and the United States was signed there by Conrad Alexandre Gérard, Benjamin Franklin, Silas Deane and Arthur Lee, France becoming the first country to recognize the independence of the United States.
The Hôtel de Crillon is a particularly famous palace, which has and continues to welcome many Heads of State during their visit to Paris.

Hạ Long Bay - Intro
(Vịnh Hạ Long) is a natural bay in the South China Sea located in the Gulf of Tonkin, north of Vietnam.

title: Hạ Long Bay
text:
Hạ Long Bay - Description
Hạ Long Bay is a 43,000-hectare seawater inlet. Located between Hạ Long City and Cát Bà National Park, this bay boasts an exceptional marine landscape with 1,996 limestone karst islands and submerged rocky peaks, along with numerous beaches, coves, inland lakes, caves, and cavities.
Hạ Long Bay boasts lush flora and fauna. It is home to 200 species of fish, 450 mollusks, 110 hard corals, and 37 soft corals. Its tropical jungle vegetation is home to many species of birds and wildlife.
Due to its unique nature, Hạ Long Bay is a hub for Vietnamese and international tourism, attracting approximately 2.5 million visitors annually.

title: Hạ Long Bay

title: Ivan Bruel
text:
Ivan Bruel - Intro
is a major character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He is the drummer of Kitty Section. He is a student at the Collège Françoise Dupont and a former student of Miss Bustier's class, before she became mayor of Paris. He is currently in a relationship with Mylène.
In "Origins", after Kim teased him for not having the guts to ask Mylène out, he got akumatized by Hawk Moth and became Stoneheart, a rock-themed golem supervillain. But, because Ladybug didn't purify the akuma after defeating him the first time, he was reakumatized in Stoneheart when Mylène ran away from him because of his loud serenade.
In "Penalteam", Ivan received the Ox Miraculous from Ladybug. When the Miraculous is inhabited by Stompp, Ivan becomes Minotaurox, an ox-themed superhero with the power of Determination who helps Ladybug and Cat Noir during "particularly difficult missions" in the fourth season.
After the events of "Strikeback", Ivan was temporarily unable to become Minotaurox after Monarch managed to steal the Ox Miraculous along with all the others contained in the Chinese Miracle Box from Ladybug's yo-yo.

title: Ivan Bruel
text:
Ivan Bruel - Intro
In "The Final Day", Ivan fell victim to Perfect Alliance believing that Ladybug and Cat Noir had "kidnapped" Adrien and Kagami Tsurugi, becoming one of the Miraculized until Nino freed him by destroying his Alliance ring. After Monarch's defeat, Ladybug recovered the stolen Miraculous and reforged them, and Ivan was given back the Ox Miraculous permanently and reunited with Stompp.
In "El Toro De Piedra", feeling unable to escape his father's villainous legacy, Ivan tried to renounce his Miraculous due to his guilt for causing his father's akumatization. After Ladybug was able to convince him otherwise, he helped de-akumatize his father and persuaded him to try and change his ways.
In "Revelator", it's shown that, after getting his Miraculous back, Ivan, along with the other secondary heroes of Ladybug's team, was trained to unlock his adult powers, no longer detransforming after using his power.

title: Ivan Bruel
text:
Ivan Bruel - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Ivan is a large and bulky Hispanic-French boy with dark gray eyes. He has light skin. His hair is short and black, except for a tuft of long, dyed blonde hair above his forehead, which slants a little to the right. His eyebrows are thick and dark brown, with the right one having a cut at the right side. He also has freckles on the bridge of his nose and cheeks.
From Season 6 onwards, the tuft is a little longer in length, almost reaching his eyelid. He also has straight forelocks.
Civilian Attire
In the first five seasons, Ivan wore a black T-shirt with a white design of two crossing bones printed on the chest. He also wore large black shorts with equal-sized belt loops and pockets, along with ankle-length white socks and light golden work boots with white soles. On occasion until "Re-creation", he wore his Miraculous as a dark gray nose ring with black spikes.

title: Ivan Bruel
text:
Ivan Bruel - Appearance
From Season 6 onwards, he now wears a black cap with the logo from his shirt. He also now wears a white shirt beneath a black hoodie with short white drawstrings. It has a blue logo composed of an ox facing the left and a thunderbolt, which are outlined in black with a white border. He pairs this up with very dull slate blue pants that have pockets containing charcoal gray hooks. Lastly, he has short black boots with a zipper at the side as footwear. He accessorizes with a silver chain necklace. His nose ring appears to be black. On his fingers, he now wears a set of silver round rings on the right thumb, right ring finger, and left index finger.
As Minotaurox
In Seasons 4-5, he retained his hair.
His eyes were surrounded by two navy, pentagonal ovals forming a sort of mask, with part of them circling around the bottom half of his face and chin.
He also had two large gray horns on either side of his head, which were curved with black tips.
He wore a navy superhero jumpsuit.
The turtleneck had a gold large ring, acting as a slider to his gold zipper, accented by the ones on the top of his lower arms and knees.

title: Ivan Bruel
text:
Ivan Bruel - Appearance
He had thick armor, which rested on his shoulders and his chest that displayed the structure of his muscles via outline, around the abdomen.
He had outlines on his forearms going diagonal and vertically toward his gloves that had armor at the back of the wrist.
There were diagonal lines going to the top of his waist, and there were pockets at the sides of his thighs.
He had small knee pauldrons with a thick outline.
His boots consisted of armor beneath the tongue, which were exposed at the sides, with a gold zipper on said tongue, and slightly pale blue toes and soles, with an indent on the middle toe to make the toes resemble ox hooves.
He wore his mallet on his back.
The Ox Miraculous is on his nose, turning navy with yellow spikes.

title: Ivan Bruel
text:
Ivan Bruel - Appearance
From Season 6 onwards, his appearance changes significantly. His tuft of hair is longer and tilts more to the left. The ovals around his eyes connect to make an actual mask, an outline being around the eye. He has a large hood over his head with dark periwinkle curved segments on either side. His horns turn more wide and straighten, the tips curving with a white gradient on top. His suit turns duller in color, specifically at the chest, waist, muscles, the sides of his torso, and the lower half of his body. There are dark periwinkle accents around the torso, elbows, shoulders, forearms, around the thighs and across the knees, and on the soles. His pauldrons turn darker on the shoulders and the symbol of the Ox Miraculous is on his back. Around his waist is a dull navy pentagonal belt, the center split with gold studs around the middle. His knuckles are adorned with gold ovals, and there are diamond-shaped leg pauldrons on his knees. His suit has less padding. His mallet has a longer handle, and remains stored on his back.
As Stoneheart

title: Ivan Bruel
text:
Ivan Bruel - Appearance
Stoneheart was a huge and muscular grayish gold rock golem with glowing chartreuse eyes. His head had a model bearing similarity to his hair, mainly a rounded rock at the base of his head resembling his tuft, and the thick rocks as eyebrows acting like his original ones.

title: Ivan Bruel
text:
Ivan Bruel - Personality
Ivan is a tough guy with a tender heart. He often appears grouchy and stubborn, particularly around situations he isn't interested in, such as while being held captive at the Bubbler's party in "The Bubbler." However, he also can sometimes be openly enthusiastic and expressive, cheering for Alix to beat Kim in "Timebreaker." Prior to Season 6, the only person so far that he shows a lot of warmth towards is Mylène.
He is willing to help others in dangerous or bad situations, such as when he fought off Zombizou's zombies so that the rest could escape.
He gets angry when he or his friends are unfairly treated or teased, sometimes standing up towards the culprit—even occasionally willing to physically fight back—and other times quietly moping about it. On the other hand, when people are kind and patient with him, he is able to open up about his inner feelings and listen to their advice.
According to Nino and Marinette in "Party Crasher", Ivan is known to be very honest to the point of being a terrible liar.

title: Ivan Bruel
text:
Ivan Bruel - Personality
He is also incredibly emotionally fragile and often has outbursts of anger. It is revealed in "El Toro De Piedra" that a huge part of these outbursts comes from his troubled relationship with his absent father, Raúl, a former criminal. Because Ivan was raised by his grandmother. he was raised a kind and gentle boy unwilling to become like Raúl, which displeased his father as he wanted his son to follow in his footsteps. This would fill Ivan with immense frustration as, despite loving his father, he simply didn't want to turn into him. He would also feel ashamed in front of his own friends, as they had parents of whom they could be proud of.

title: Ivan Bruel
text:
Ivan Bruel - Personality
He was happy when his father took part in Mayoress Bustier's New Chances program, but when Raúl decided to use that as a chance to steal the Mona Lisa painting and even demanded Ivan to help him in the heist, Ivan was filled with both disappointment and sadness to the point of missing Kitty Section's special performance to honor Miss Bustier. After his father got akumatized because Ivan didn't want to help, Ivan did not confront his father violently and instead opted to call on Ladybug, as he felt himself unworthy of being a superhero and tried to renounce his Miraculous. However, she managed to convince him that his father does not define his personhood.
As Minotaurox, Ivan has more self-confidence, especially when it comes to using his powers without being afraid of hurting others.
After finally making peace with his inner frustration and guilt, Ivan, as Minotaurox, fully embraced his heroic side, taking a stand against his akumatized father and even scolding him in his superhero form, telling him that he should try to improve as a person for his son's sake.

title: Ivan Bruel
text:
Ivan Bruel - Personality
As Stoneheart, he was extremely aggressive and furious, especially towards Kim and Chloé. He still loved Mylène, but his feelings had been clouded when it came to her and he believed that Hawk Moth would bring the two together forever.

title: Ivan Bruel
text:
Ivan Bruel - Abilities
As a Civilian
As a member of Kitty Section, Ivan plays the drums and writes song lyrics. He also sings, but others such as Mylène (prior to dating him) find his singing loud and terrifying. He is also shown to have the strength to destroy a phone by stomping on it.
As Minotaurox
Minotaurox has enhanced capabilities such as speed, agility, and strength, and he is almost invulnerable to physical damage. These abilities allow him to react to and evade akumatized villains attacks, as well as jump and leap several times his height and length. His tool is a mallet, with which he can land devastating blows.
His special power, Resistance, allows him to make himself immune to other people's attacks and powers. Initially, using his power would depower him and cause him to detransform after 5 minutes, however, in "Revelator," it is shown that Minotaurox has learned to control his adult powers, allowing him to not detransform back and use Resistance as much as he wishes.

title: Ivan Bruel
text:
Ivan Bruel - Abilities
Minotaurox, similar to Carapace, is used for protection in most of the fights he's involved in with his teammates. He is considered the first line of defense due to his power and his massive stature, which allows him to easily block attacks. In fights with armies or crowds, he leads the charge. With his power, he can hold off enemies that are empowered or imbued with magical energy.
As Stoneheart
Stoneheart was a golem endowed with superhuman strength. He had a strong grip with his hands, being able to securely hold human victims or his akumatized wad of paper. Although not very fast when running, he still had fast enough reflexes to grab things in mid-air, and could throw things like a human or vehicle with a lot of power. Additionally, when hit with an attack, he grew in size and his strength increased.
Due to Ladybug not purifying the akuma, the akuma multiplied and transformed civilians into immobile versions of Stoneheart. When Ivan became Stoneheart again, the copies of Stoneheart began to move, and they were under the original Stoneheart's control.
As Miraculized
Miraculized could use 15 superpowers in his system:

title: Ivan Bruel
text:
Ivan Bruel - Abilities
Mirage to cast and communicate through hyper-realistic illusions.
Venom to paralyze anyone who touches it with his stinger hand.
Shell-ter to create a nearly indestructible force field.
Multitude to split himself into any number of smaller clones.

Genesis to create any object they wished, but it was devoid of superpowers, magic, or mythical properties.
Uproar to manifest a toy that chaotically destroyed an opponent's superpowers when touched.
Sublimation to grant themselves a super ability of their choice.
Fetch to retrieve a previously marked object, no matter where it was.
Gift to manifest an image of a person's happiest wish, calming them and driving away negative forces.

title: Ivan Bruel
text:
Ivan Bruel - Trivia
Miraculous Holder and Akumatized Villain
Ivan is chronologically the first person to have been akumatized.
He's also the first person to have been akumatized twice in the same timeline, although it was with the same akuma both times.
This also makes him the only person to be akumatized more than once by Hawk Moth in Season 1.
A scarlet version of Stoneheart reappeared in the two-part special event "Heroes' Day".
Stoneheart appears another time in "Gamer 2.0" from Gamer's powers.
As of "Penalteam", following Alya Césaire, Nino Lahiffe, Chloé Bourgeois, Nathalie Sancoeur, Luka Couffaine, Max Kanté, Kagami Tsurugi, Alix Kubdel, Lê Chiến Kim, Adrien Agreste, Wang Fu, Zoé Lee, Mylène Haprèle, Rose Lavillant, Juleka Couffaine, Sabrina Raincomprix, Marc Anciel and Nathaniel Kurtzberg, Ivan Bruel is the nineteenth person to become a Miraculous holder and akumatized villain, excluding Gabriel Agreste, who akumatized himself, Marinette Dupain-Cheng who almost got akumatized, and Félix Fathom, who resisted the akuma.

title: Ivan Bruel
text:
Ivan Bruel - Trivia
Ivan is the third Miraculous holder whose superpower is similar to his villain identity's power, as Stoneheart and Minotaurox both have the ability to be impervious to certain attacks, after Alix and Nathaniel.
His superhero identity is based on a a mythical Greek creature portrayed during classical antiquity with the head and tail of a bull and the body of a man known as Minotaur.
Speaking of, he is the second character to have his superhero alias be based on a mythological character, the first being Pegasus.
Curiously, he is the first, and so far, the only Miraculous holder seen on the show who does not wears his Miraculous when not transformed, as he keeps his camouflaged Miraculous on his back pocket as opposed to actually wearing it on his nose.
Miscellaneous
Ivan has a desk to himself in his classes, while desks are usually shared by two students.
Ivan is the tallest of all of his friends as civilians and of the French Miraculous superhero team.
His favorite band is The Zombie Skull Crushers.
In the first issue of Miraculous Adventures, he is on a lacrosse team with Adrien, Kim, and Alix.

title: Ivan Bruel
text:
Ivan Bruel - Trivia
In "Truth", he's on the Couffaine Houseboat when Alya, Mylène, and Juleka tell the titular villain that Marinette is in love with Adrien, and assuming that he didn't know until then, it would make him the 13th student at Françoise Dupont to do so. This is later confirmed in "Crocoduel".
In "Confrontation", it is implied that Ivan wants to be a househusband when he grows up.
In "El Toro De Piedra", it is revealed that Ivan has Spanish ancestry.

title: It's Ladybug
text:
It's Ladybug - Trivia
The English version of the theme song has an alternate version with different lyrics. One version (with "It's Ladybug") is performed by Wendy Child and Cash Callaway.; the other (with "Miraculous") is performed by Brittnee Belt and Cash Callaway.
However, starting from Season 4, the Lou and Lenni-Kim version is used.
It was originally announced that the version sung by Laura Marano would be used for Season 2, although the "Miraculous" version was used in the final product.
Thomas Astruc uploaded a storyboard version of the theme song that was later changed into the final version.
At Dokomi 2017, he revealed the finished unused version of the opening.
In the original releases of the song, Wendy Child speaks Marinette's opening narration, but in later releases of the song, Cristina Vee's version of the narration, from the show's opening theme, is used instead.
In the former, Marinette's name is pronounced using a short "a" (like in "scar") as opposed to a long one (like in "bare").
The French version is performed by Marily and Noam Kaniel.
Starting from season 2, the Lou and Lenni-Kim version is used.

title: It's Ladybug
text:
It's Ladybug - Trivia
The Korean version is performed by K-pop group FIESTAR. They also made a music video for the song and performed it live at SAMG Animation's Miraculous conference on July 22 2015.
The Serbian version is performed by Milena Moravčević, with Marko Marković as a backing vocalist.
The Croatian version is performed by Nina Kraljić.
The Latin American Spanish version is perfomed by Denisse Aragón & Jair Ortomann (in seasons 1-3) & only Denisse Aragón (in season 4).
Curiously, the singer, Denisse, also sang for Marinette "The Boy That I Secretly Love" for the episode "Santa Claws" in Season 2 and The Movie.
Tumblr user jep2k3, who worked on the show, posted three gifs of rough ideas in animatic form for the theme song.
Near the end of the theme song, Nooroo and Wayzz fly with Tikki and Plagg into the Chinese Miracle Box with seven different sections, each section holding a Miraculous.
In both the second and third season openings, Trixx, Pollen and Duusu also fly into the Miracle Box.
In the one for season 4, all Kwamis from the Chinese Miracle Box fly into it, with the exception of Tikki.

title: It's Ladybug
text:
It's Ladybug - Trivia
In front of the school, Marinette runs to the school with a croissant in her mouth. This is a common trope of a character running to school with a piece of toast or another kind of food, typically breakfast-related, held in his or her mouth to indicate that the character is in a hurry and/or late, which is often seen in manga and anime.
At the beginning, Marinette can be seen stumbling to avoid a small black cat in her path.
Among the photos with the characters shown from the second season, Alya, Alix, Rose, Juleka and Mylène are shown with animal photo filters that serve to inform about the powers of the Kwamis that they would later receive throughout the series.
In "The Puppeteer", Ladybug briefly whistles the theme to herself while walking up to grab Puppeteer's wand.
In "Lies", Cat Noir briefly hums the theme to himself as he's waiting for Ladybug to start their patrol.
In the second season's opening, some prototype scenes of the first season's opening were used.
The second and third seasons both use the exact same opening.
According to Thomas Astruc, the reason for this is that the basics of both seasons are the same.

title: It's Ladybug
text:
It's Ladybug - Trivia
For an unknown reason, there are two variants of the Season 4 opening: in the first one (used in "Truth", "Gang of Secrets", "Furious Fu", "Queen Banana", and "Guiltrip", which were the first five episodes to be finished), the photo of Luka is at the bottom and the one of Kagami next to the one of Zoé, while in the second (used in all the other episodes, and throughout Season 5) their order's switched.
Before It's Ladybug was produced, two alternative theme songs titled "Ladybug, You Bring Us Luck" and "Ladybug" were composed when the show was still in production.
There are two Italian variants of the theme song. The first, used by Disney Channel, doesn't have an extended version. The second, used by Super!, has an extended version and doesn't have Marinette's initial introduction.
Similarly, the intro of the Mandarin Chinese dub aired on Le TV doesn't have Marinette's introduction. However, the intro of the dub by TeKi does feature Marinette's narration.
For an unknown reason, the Sinhala dub released by Hiru TV doesn't use It's Ladybug as its intro, instead using an intro made of clips from "Stormy Weather" and "The Bubbler" and a unique song.

title: It's Ladybug
text:
It's Ladybug - Trivia
Marinette mentions the opening first lines of the theme song briefly in "Sentibubbler", "Miraculous Paris", "Jubilation", "Elation" and "Transmission".
The Season 6 opening was originally written to have Marinette and Adrien narrate in the beginning and sing in the rest of the theme song, but the concept was changed to having the original Marinette narration.
The Season 6 opening possesses the most changes when in comparison to the previous ones:
Plagg doesn't appear in the season five opening.
He and Chloé don't appear in the season six opening.
Chloé's absence is due to her and her mother leaving Paris for London at the end of "Revolution".
The secret Marinette is now holding is no longer about her secret identity but about the truth about Gabriel Agreste being Hawk Moth/Shadow Moth/Monarch.
The photos of Marinette and her friends are removed.
Marinette and Adrien appear as a couple, while surrounded by their friends, instead of the shot of Marinette tripping, Chloé and Sabrina passing by while the former is laughing, Alya helping Marinette getting up, Adrien appearing while holding the latter’s backpack and then Chloé shoving Marinette out of the way then the latter is angry.

title: It's Ladybug
text:
It's Ladybug - Trivia
The cat that normally appears chasing the croissant Marinette drops appears holding that croissant on its mouth.
Cat Noir appears running by a roof waving at Ladybug as she swings by.
Instead of the shot of Gabriel in his villain persona, a scene of Ladybug activating her yo-yo to call upon her allies, followed by the latters' shots shifting from their civilian identity to their superhero one as their Kwamis pass by, with the entire team appearing together and then dispersing.
The last moments show Ladybug and Cat Noir fist bumping, then the both of them saying goodbye to one another with a high-five, running to opposite directions, only to then reunite in their civilian form and then kiss, advancing then to the title of the opening where all the heroes appear together, where Chrysalis' akumatization form appears and crushes them in her fist.
