title: Jagged Stone
text:
Jagged Stone - Intro
is a recurring character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He is a popular rock star. He is also the father of Luka and Juleka Couffaine.
In "Guitar Villain", after he was insulted on television by XY, he was akumatized by Hawk Moth and became Guitar Villain, a guitar-playing villain.
In "Crocoduel", after arguing with Anarka Couffaine about their separation, he was reakumatized by Shadow Moth into Guitar Villain again, and alongside Captain Hardrock, the two villains formed Crocoduel, a duel of two supervillains who wanted to prove one of them was right. He also received a Magical Charm from Ladybug that prevented him from being reakumatized.
In "Migration", Jagged gave up his fame as a rock star after watching his son stand up to Bob Roth, even he tore up the contracts and fed it to Fang. After that, he, Luka, Penny Rolling, and Fang left Paris in order to protect the second from being a target to Monarch who discovered Luka knows Ladybug and Cat Noir's secret identities.
In "Re-creation", after having joined up with Su-Han and the Order of the Guardians, Jagged returns to Paris to help out in the fight against the Miraculized, along with Luka, Penny, and Fang.

title: Jagged Stone
text:
Jagged Stone - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Jagged Stone is tall fair-skinned man in a stocky build with moderate turquoise eyes. He has medium-length spiky black hair with dyed purple tips like his daughter Juleka Couffaine, a black beard, and a mustache which connects with his beard. His eyebrows are black and split in two at the sides.
Civilian Attire
He wears heavy, dark eyeshadow and eyeliner. His outfit includes a sparkly black jacket with yellow accents and yellow epaulets. Underneath, he wears a black zero collared undershirt. His pants are yellow with black vertical stripes, similar to a bee. He wears lacy, black finger-less gloves on both hands. His shoes are black heeled boots with a design on the soles. Around his neck is a necklace comprised of two golden wings with a pendant of a skull in between the wings.
As Guitar Villain

title: Jagged Stone
text:
Jagged Stone - Appearance
Guitar Villain's hair was in long dreadlocks and was light fuchsia colored with light cerise at the tips. On his face, he had black shiny face paint around his eyes, and his eyes were brilliant cerulean/turquoise. He wore a dark gray sleeved turtleneck top with pointed edges over the shoulders, a black collar, and a vertical yellow leaf shape on each side of the front. His sleeves underneath the top were purple with a black fishnet pattern. He had a dark gray belt with purple spikes, and his pants were dark gray with yellow flame designs from his upper legs to his knees. His gloves and medium heeled boots were dark gray with two purple spikes attached to each one, the backs of his hands and the front of his feet. His guitar was shiny and purple with two black pointed tips on the soundboard.

title: Jagged Stone
text:
Jagged Stone - Personality
Jagged Stone is wild, proud, and expressive. When he isn't on-screen or performing, he is relaxed and natural. But he prefers exciting things, like owning a crocodile for a pet, and he likes getting lots of attention, especially from his fans, as long as they give him enough space. He gets bored if nothing interesting is going on, and he doesn't like losing attention. However, while he likes being noticed, he believes that the most important thing about music is expressing himself, not the fame and fortune that comes with it. He is usually kind toward others, even being quite patient with the people he truly likes, but if he feels like he is being wronged by someone, he stands up for his beliefs and isn't afraid to get into heated disagreements with them.

title: Jagged Stone
text:
Jagged Stone - Personality
For years, Jagged let his love for music be bigger than the one for his own family to the point he let Anarka raise their twin children (Luka and Juleka) all by herself, with the latters not even knowing who their father was. After reconnecting with Luka (and later Juleka), he started to spend more time with his children and have his love for them grow even more. By "Migration", Jagged's love for his children became so strong he was able to cut ties with Bob and his company (basically giving up all the fame he spent years to accomplish) after being inspired by Luka's refusal in becoming just another pawn in Bob's plans to become richer.
As Guitar Villain, he was even wilder and crazier, and would express rage towards people he disliked. He wanted to make XY pay for insulting him, and he enjoyed using his powers to make people rock out to his music, or in some cases to make them suffer.

title: Jagged Stone
text:
Jagged Stone - Abilities
As a Civilian
Jagged Stone is an accomplished singer and guitarist. As seen in "Pixelator", he is also skilled at playing the piano. While under the control of Kung Food in the episode of the same name, Jagged is capable of proficiently wielding a large club made of seafood.
In "Re-creation", Jagged learned Mirakung Fu from Su-Han after joining the Order of the Guardians.
As Guitar Villain
Guitar Villain used his guitar, which was the akumatized object, as his weapon. He was able to shoot energy waves of weaponized sound from his guitar, which had different powers according to the chord he plays:
The purple wave, which he called the "Rockin' Riff, Baby!", caused those it hit to begin to dance uncontrollably and shout like they were at a rock and roll concert. This wave even worked on animals and non-living things, such as cars.
The orange wave, which he called the "Awesome Solo," was a concussive blast, able to destroy things and injure people, and was powerful enough to crack a solid stone.
The green wave, which he called the "Ultimate Solo," could cause tremendous earthquakes.
He also used it as a melee weapon when fighting with Cat Noir.

title: Jagged Stone
text:
Jagged Stone - Abilities
A connected aspect to Guitar Villain was that Fang was transformed into a dragon by his akumatization. Fang could fly, and he could shoot blasts of green smoke at enemies. Guitar Villain also used him to transport him anywhere and to protect him from the superheroes.

title: Jagged Stone
text:
Jagged Stone - Trivia
When Jagged was deakumatized, he had a pen on him.
Jagged Stone is the favorite rock star of both Marinette and Adrien.
In the Serbian dub, his name is changed to Roki Stoun (Rocky Stone).
Also in the Serbian dub, Jagged and XY are voiced by the same voice actor, Mateja Vukašinović.
In the Irish dub, his name is changed to Géaráin Scolb.
In the Welsh dub, his name is changed to Maen Miniog (Sharp Stone).
In the French dub, Jagged Stone has an American accent.
Jagged's voice actor in the French version, Matthew Géczy, is American in real life.
Lex Lang giving Jagged a Cockney accent in the English dub is a likely reference to Mick Jagger.
Jagged Stone's name is a pun on the music genre "hard rock."
Penny and Jagged's last names are a reference to the rock band The Rolling Stones.
Jagged Stone's villain name, Guitar Villain, is a pun on "Guitar Hero," a title that, in France, is given to expert guitarists.
It could also reference the video game series Guitar Hero.
Jagged's ownership of a crocodile while being a rock star might be a reference to the iconic Elton John song Crocodile Rock.
Jagged likes the smell of leather and sweat.

title: Jagged Stone

Guitar Villain's hairstyle is similar to that of Drago Bludvist, the main antagonist of How To Train Your Dragon 2. Coincidentally, both have dragon allies, Fang and Drago's Bewilderbeast.
It's revealed in "Troublemaker" that Jagged Stone is allergic to non-organic flour, which causes him to sneeze.
A scarlet version of Guitar Villain appeared in the two-part special event "Heroes' Day".
Statues of Guitar Villain and Jagged Stone appear in the Musée Grévin in "The Puppeteer 2".
In "Truth", it is revealed that Jagged is Luka and Juleka Couffaine's father, but he left his family because he felt like he wouldn't be a good father.
Prior to said episode, there have been hints suggesting this:
Juleka's hair color has the same shade as his, while Luka's eyes are the same color as his.
Luka's shirt below his jacket has a drawing of his face.
They had the same musical style as him.
In "Desperada", Jagged states that he and Anarka used to be very close and they also performed together.

title: Jagged Stone
text:
Jagged Stone - Trivia
In "Lies" it is revealed that Jagged Stone has lied to his fans about his age.
Although having only one akumatized form throughout the series, Jagged comes in fourth place, alongside Rose, Alya and Philippe, for being akumatized the most times behind Mr. Ramier, Chloé, Kagami, Juleka, Lila and Roger, having become Guitar Villain 6 times. ("Guitar Villain", "Catalyst", "Crocoduel" and three other off-screen akumazations as seen in "Mr. Pigeon 72").
As seen in "Crocoduel", Jagged is the fourth person to break an akumatized object, instead of a Miraculous holder, following Fang in "Lies", Marianne Lenoir in "Furious Fu" and Anarka Couffaine in "Crocoduel".
He is also the third human to destroy an akumatized object, following Marianne Lenoir in "Furious Fu" and Anarka Couffaine in "Crocoduel".
It is revealed in "Wishmaker" that Jagged's childhood dream is to become a crocodile.
A variant of Jagged Stone appeared in the Ladybug & Cat Noir: The Movie continuity, but he is only seen in a picture where he's akumatized as Guitar Villain.
He is the first known member of the guardians to have a pet.

text:
Jagged Stone's guitar - Appearance
The guitar is a metallic lavender color, while the neck and headstock of the guitar are a darker shade, with a brass-colored pick guard. The top of the head is shaped into a drop. The nut, pickups, and bridge are copper colored, and the volume and tone controls are white. A brass-colored design of his face is below the bridge.
As an akumatized object, it was a shiny dark purple color with rounded edges and two black roundly-pointed tips at the bottom end of the soundboard. The pickup was round and silver, the nut and bridge were silver, and on each side of the head, there were dark purple rounded points.

title: Ivan (webisode)/Transcript
text:
Ivan (webisode)/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Dear diary, today after gym class, I ran into Ivan in the locker room. He was sitting on the floor, all alone. He looked really upset. He told me was regretting not entering the school poetry contest because he was too afraid to share his work.
Marinette: The first prize was two concert tickets to see his favorite band, The Zombie Skull Crushers, and he wanted to go with Mylène. That's so cute!
Marinette: I tried to comfort him and told him he could enter the next contest, but he was really bummed out.
Ivan: (sighs) I'm no good with words, anyway.
Marinette: True, he doesn't talk much, combined with the fact that he looks like a giant, can sometimes give the impression that he's a big bully.
Chloé: Once a monster, always a monster.
Marinette: But get to know him, and you'll quickly discover he's really a gentle giant. Just looking at him with Mylène makes it obvious how sweet and gentle Ivan really is.
Marinette: Besides, I've read some of his poems, and he's actually pretty good. He could even become famous, you know! He just needs to take the plunge.

title: Ivan Bruel/History
text:
Ivan Bruel/History - Intro
Ivan Bruel is a teenage boy who attends Collège Françoise Dupont.

title: Ivan Bruel/History
text:
Ivan Bruel/History - Season 1
In "Ladybug & Cat Noir", Ivan was one of the students joining Miss Bustier's class. After class, Kim gives him a note teasing him about his inability to tell Mylène how he feels about her, angering him. He almost attacks Kim, but Miss Bustier notices and sends him to the principal's office. Upset, he becomes the perfect victim for Hawk Moth and was akumatized into Stoneheart. After causing mass destruction in Paris, he went to the field where Kim was and was about to attack him when Ladybug and Cat Noir showed up. After a brief battle, he was defeated and returned to normal. Ladybug approaches Ivan telling him that he shouldn't be afraid to tell Mylène how he feels, though Ivan was confused as to how Ladybug knew his name. At the end of the episode, Ivan was sitting sadly on the steps of Collège Françoise Dupont.

title: Ivan Bruel/History
text:
Ivan Bruel/History - Season 1
In "Stoneheart", after the events of his previous akumatization, Ivan was approached by several of his classmates who ask him about it. When Chloé makes fun of Ivan and calls him a monster, he angrily storms off. His emotions almost become negative enough for reakumatization, but Marinette approaches him in the locker room and gives him advice as to how to approach Mylène. He decides to write her a song, though when he attempts to sing it to her, his loud voice scares her off and Ivan becomes angry enough to be reakumatized. Stoneheart bursts into Miss Bustier's classroom, kidnaps Chloé and Mylène, and heads to the top of the Eiffel Tower with his stone army. When the mayor demands that Stoneheart return his daughter, he threw her from the tower, though Ladybug fortunately catches her in time. Just then, Stoneheart was forced by Hawk Moth to cough out a ton of akumas and then passes out as he delivers a message to Ladybug, Cat Noir, and the citizen of Paris. When Hawk Moth's threats fail to intimidate Ladybug, Stoneheart regains consciousness and was told by Hawk Moth that Ladybug and Cat Noir are attempting to take Mylène away from him.

title: Ivan Bruel/History
text:
Ivan Bruel/History - Season 1
He and his stone beings fight the two superheroes, but eventually he loses and is returned to normal. He nearly falls off the Eiffel Tower, but Ladybug catches him in time. After Miraculous Ladybug is used, Ivan admires the magical ladybugs swarming the city. When Ladybug shows Mylène Ivan's song lyrics and Mylène compliments them, Ivan apologizes for scaring her and promises to be gentle, earning him a hug from her. The next day, he witnesses Marinette stand up to Chloé and is amused.
In "The Bubbler", Ivan was forced by Bubbler to attend a surprise birthday party for Adrien. Unlike most of the party guests, Ivan doesn't bother pretending to have fun and stands against a wall pouting. When Bubbler notices and asks him why he isn't having fun, Ivan tells him that it's none of his business, prompting Bubbler to trap him inside a floating bubble, though he is later freed after Bubbler's defeat.
In "Mr. Pigeon", while in class Ivan heard of the derby hat designing contest and was talking to Juleka and Alix while in courtyard.

title: Ivan Bruel/History

However, at the end of the race, Alix's pocket watch winds up broken and she is akumatized into Timebreaker, who begins stealing people's energy and causing them to fade from existence in order to be able to go back in time. Ivan runs away from her and tries to hide behind a bush, only for Timebreaker to see him. She nearly steals his energy, but Ladybug stops her before she can.
In "Copycat", Ivan was taking his seat in Miss Bustier's class.
In "Lady Wifi", he was in Miss Bustier's class until heard Marinette's outburst about Chloé being Ladybug any yet upon seeing the school under attack by Lady Wifi Ivan left the school in fear.

title: Ivan Bruel/History
text:
Ivan Bruel/History - Season 1
In "Horrificator", Ivan played the role of a monster in the short film Miss Bustier's class was making, though the shoot constantly keeps getting interrupted when Mylène gets frightened of the mask he's wearing Ivan assures Mylène that it's just him underneath.
However, when Chloé makes fun of Mylène, she gets upset and ran out of the classroom in tears.
Ivan goes after her and tries to convince her to come back by giving her a pin from his favorite band, but Mylène sadly refuses and rushes to the bathroom.
He returns to the classroom and hears Chloé call Mylène lame.
Angry, he tells Chloé that she's the lame one as Mylène was crying in the bathroom because of her.
Despite this, he continues to help make the movie until Horrificator begins kidnapping students.
He accompanies Ladybug, Cat Noir, and the non-kidnapped students as they try to find the monster, though many wind up captured along the way.
However, when Horrificator sees Ivan, instead of kidnapping him, she affectionately licks him.
Eventually, he and the others find where Horrificator took those she captured and works with Ladybug and Cat Noir to defeat the monster.

title: Ivan Bruel/History

Later, when Chloé invites her classmates to City Hall to get autographs from Jagged Stone, Ivan goes. However, City Hall soon gets surrounded by Darkblade and his knights, so Ivan comforts a frightened Mylène. When Marinette tells everyone what to do in order to prevent Darkblade from entering, Ivan goes along with what she says and then heads upstairs with his classmates. He is briefly transformed into a knight, but after Darkblade's defeat, he is returned to normal. Not long after, he learns that Chloé stole Marinette's diary and was displeased, but even more so when Chloé blames Sabrina. He listens to Marinette's campaign speech and votes for her the next day.

He lifts a table and prepares to throw it, only for Cat Noir to intervene. Despair Bear then let's go of Ivan and Ivan is surprised to see Cat Noir in front of him. After Despair Bear's defeat, Ivan bakes macarons with his friends. When Chloé makes fun of Mylène's macarons and causes her to cry, Ivan retaliates by throwing a bowl over her head.

text:
Intuition - Intro
"" is a season 5 episode of the series Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. Based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 15th written and produced episode of season 5. It is also the 119th written and produced episode of the series overall.

title: Intuition
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Intuition - Synopsis
Monarch is really unlucky when it comes to the power of Intuition. Either Ladybug's Lucky Charm keeps adapting to the situation, or Cat Noir's unpredictability spoils everything at the last second! But when the Tsurugi technologies decide to test their new spaceplane, Monarch senses a unique occasion to get a real second chance. He is ready to do anything, even if it means that this could be his last chance to seize the Miraculous.
Disney+
What if Monarch kept having second chances?
Netflix
Determined to stirp Ladybug of her Lucky Charm, Monarch uses the power of Second Chance, but repeatedly resetting time wreaks havoc on his health.

title: Intuition
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Intuition - Plot
The episode begins when Ladybug and Cat Noir were battling against Glaciator. Suddenly Glaciator hears a ring and sees a giant bell filled with firecrackers in it above him. The bell falls on top of Glaciator, as the firecrackers melt his ice cream body. Meanwhile, in his lair, Monarch taps the Snake Miraculous and uses the power of Viperion's Second Chance to go back to the moment when Glaciator was searching for Ladybug and Cat Noir.
Monarch tells Glaciator to watch out from what could fall from the sky, but sees nothing. Suddenly, from behind him, Ladybug and Cat Noir are running towards Glaciator, holding a shield connected to Cat Noir's staff. They push Glaciator with the shield into buses on fire, and he melts again.

title: Intuition

text:
Intuition - Plot
Using the Snake Miraculous once again, Monarch tells Glaciator to go to a building and sees Cat Noir. The parasol seen in "Elation" is thrown and it is opened, blocking Glaciator's sense of sight and he is pulled toward the buses on fire. Monarch, in his lair is furious that this time is unsuccessful also and when he is about to create another alternate timeline, he suddenly feels pain in his cataclysmed left arm. This then becomes the permanent timeline when Cat Noir throws his staff at André's ice cream scoop and releases the megakuma.
In Nathalie's room, Gabriel explains to Nathalie about how the power of Second Chance is useless to the mission as the Lucky Charm always changes to adapt to the situation. As Nathalie tells him to strip Ladybug of her yo-yo to prevent her from using her power, but Gabriel tells Nathalie he has attempted that before.

text:

The scene flashbacks to "Derision". Ladybug uses her power and receives a piping bag, which she ties around with her yo-yo and blinds Dark Humour. He trips and falls down due to the balls created by Cat Noir when he got hit by one of Dark Humour's arrows. The eyepiece is broken as the megakuma flies away. Monarch uses the Miraculous of Intuition to go back to when people were falling down due to the balls being created by Cat Noir. Monarch tells Dark Humour to use one of his arrows to hit Ladybug's yo-yo to prevent her from summoning up a Lucky Charm. He does as Monarch instructs him to and succeeds, as the yo-yo becomes a balloon. Cat Noir hits the balloon toward Dark Humour's face, distracting him. Ladybug runs off to hide behind a pillar, detransform and use her Lucky Charm. She receives the toilet bowl as this timeline becomes part of the permanent as well.

text:

The scene returns to the present, where Gabriel is frustrated, saying that Cat Noir is always there whenever Ladybug is about to lose as the scene flashbacks to "Passion" where Safari has immobilized Ladybug and Mister Bug uses his Lucky Charm. The scene once again returns to the present where Gabriel pulls up his sleeve as the dark mark caused by the cataclysm worsens and spreads around throughout his body as it is revealed that the Snake Miraculous has been used in "Elation", "Derision" and "Passion". Nathalie listens in on Gabriel's heartbeat and hears that the cataclysm has spread to the point where it has reached his heart. Nathalie then tells Gabriel about finding a solution for Adrien and it may be time to stop chasing after Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses so Adrien does not wind up alone.

Just when Adrien is about to answer his question, his phone is ringing and sees that it is from Marinette. As Adrien is talking to Marinette, Gabriel suddenly feels the same pain he felt when he was about to use the Snake Miraculous in "Elation", but the pain is going on for much longer though. He overhears Marinette talking about the space jet created by Tomoe Tsurugi. Adrien hears a sound as he turns around and sees Gabriel falling and helps him back up.

Gabriel goes into The Crypt and talks to Émilie about the great danger he has never put himself in before, telling her even though she wouldn't like his plan, that if he does manage to succeed, they will both be saved. He goes into his lair, transforms into Monarch and absorbs Sass into the Snake Miraculous and marks the moment. He uses his Alliance ring to video call with Mrs Tsurugi. He tells her he needs the control codes for her space jet. She asks him what he is not telling her and uses the Snake Miraculous. After failing once more, he calls her for the third time and Mrs Tsurugi notices his heartbeats are not normal. She gives him the control code as Monarch taps the ring once more.

text:
Intuition - Plot
Monarch watches the news about Claudie Kanté flying on the space jet. She introduces an A.D.A, an AI on the jet to Miss Bustier's class. He enters the code Tomoe sent him and has control over A.D.A. A.D.A. manages to pass the first test by using Mrs Kanté's stress levels and emotions. Mrs Kanté is ejected out of the ship and A.D.A. flies off to rescue her for the second test. Monarch taps the Snake Miraculous to mark this moment and shuts off all of A.D.A's sensors. As Mrs Kanté is back into the ship, A.D.A. asks her where she is and believes the test is a failure.
Monarch absorbs Kaalki into his ring as A.D.A. believes it is dangerous and will fly to the end of the universe and flies off. He also absorbs Trixx, Wayzz and Ziggy into his rings as well. He teleports to the top of Tour Montparnasse and uses the power of Genesis to draw an meteorite in space. The meteorite is slowly heading toward Earth and then he uses the power of Mirage to create an illusion of one of his message transmissions. The transmission tells Ladybug and Cat Noir they have to choose between stopping the meteorite or rescuing Mrs Kanté in space.

He uses this opportunity to transform into Cat Noir. Adrien transforms into Cat Noir and uses the purple potion to transform into Astrocat and flies off. After walking out of the nurse's office, she runs off and transforms into Ladybug and also uses the purple space potion to transform into Cosmobug and flies off also. Cosmobug and Astrocat meet up and decide that Astrocat deals with the meteorite and Cosmobug deals with Mrs Kanté. They split up as Monarch watches it is part of his plan and opens a portal as he uses the power of Voyage and goes into it. Cosmobug finds Mrs Kanté's jet and tries to convince A.D.A. to let her help her. A.D.A. refuses, saying she does not need to be fixed.

Monarch, in his lair, detects A.D.A's emotions and creates a megakuma. He teleports it to where the jet is and the megakuma infects A.D.A's CPU. Mrs Kanté and Cosmobug become shocked as they see A.D.A. become akumatized into Bugfighter. Cosmobug tries to use her Lucky Charm, but Bugfighter blasts it, making it disappear. One of Bugfighter's robotic arms has Cosmobug trapped as another arm reaches closer to her and tries to take her earrings. Meanwhile Astrocat cataclysms the meteorite and the pieces start going to Earth.
Monarch uses the power of Shell-ter and tries to trap Astrocat in it, but he just manages to dodge the shield when he hears Cosmobug's calls for help. Monarch uses the Snake Miraculous to go back to when he was about to shut off A.D.A's sensors. He manages to trap Astrocat in his shield this time and receives Cosmobug's help as he sees Monarch's hand through a portal, trying to get Astrocat's Miraculous. He sees the Snake Miraculous and taps it, bringing Monarch back to when he was going to shut off A.D.A's sensors.

Gabriel wakes up as Adrien looks concerned and Nathalie stands behind him, looking frustrated and cross. He claims he was out due to him being tired and not having enough rest. When Adrien leaves the room, Nathalie scolds him for taking a huge risk only for a disastrous result and the only thing accomplished is accelerating the cataclysm's damage on his body. He asks her how much time he has left, only for Nathalie to answer him by saying he does not have much time left. Ladybug and Cat Noir sit with each other on the top of a building, talking about that it is strange how they believe Monarch never uses the power of Second Chance as they stare into the sunset as the episode ends.

Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Intuition - Plot Development
It is revealed that Monarch had been using the power of Second Chance in many of his battles against Ladybug and Cat Noir:
In "Passion", he used the power at least one time to direct Safari to first immobilize Ladybug with her guided Venom shots, failing due to Cat Noir being able to evade her Venom shots and discover their weakness to affect them in their civilian forms.
In "Elation", he used the power at least two times to warn Glaciator about any incoming attacks from the heroes or direct him to where they are, but failing due to the adaptability of Ladybug's Lucky Charm, who becomes different after Monarch directs Glaciator to counter it.
In "Derision", he used the power at least one time, directing Dark Humor to affect Ladybug's yoyo with Uproar at the right time in order to prevent her from using Lucky Charm, but failing due to Cat Noir's unpredictability that interfered with his plan, distracting Dark Humor long enough for Ladybug to de-transform and transform again to recover her yoyo.

title: Intuition
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Intuition - Plot Development
The episode also reveals that Monarch chose not to transfer the Snake Miraculous power to any akumatized villain, because they would have sole power over time and memory of said events, and if they were to use the power of Second Chance foolishly, it could majorly compromise Monarch's plans and risk losing everything.
The episode shares its name with the concept of the Snake Miraculous and reveals much about the power of Second Chance:
The power must never be used while the user is sick or hurt, resulting that any wound/illness they may suffer on their bodies before or during the loop will not revert to how they were before the activation of Second Chance, otherwise their afflictions will speed up. It is unknown if that also includes aging.

title: Intuition
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Intuition - Plot Development
But for aging and taking this episode, "Desperada", "Wishmaker" and "Ephemeral" into account, it seems like age wasn't affected because none of them involved using Second Chance the number times needed to induce aging. The longest time is "Desperada", with 25,913 Second Chances which equals almost 3 months, and about a year or more of aging is needed for a person. The power would have to be used more than 103,652 times which is about under a year (359.90 days).
However, it is possible that the reason why Second Chance doesn't affect Gabriel's body is because Cataclysm is one of the two most powerful Miraculous powers. Being the power of Destruction, it probably makes it immune to the effects of other Miraculous powers, only being balanced by the powers of the Ladybug Miraculous.
This is further confirmed in "Pretension", where even the energy of 14 Kwamis combined could barely make the wound fade away.

title: Intuition
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Intuition - Plot Development
In a fight against Lucky Charm, it is imperative that the user either activates Second Chance after the Ladybug Miraculous superpower is used or finds a way to prevent the holder to activate it, as, if Lucky Charm is used before Second Chance is activated, it will only adapt to the situation and become something different, due to its ability to give its user an object that the holder needs to solve the current situation.
Because Second Chance had been used by Viperion, who is an ally of Ladybug, and before the Snake Miraculous was stolen by Monarch, whenever it was used before the activation of Lucky Charm, the object was always the same, as Viperion would always find a way for the object to be used for its intended use.
In a fight against Cataclysm, it is imperative that similar to the Lucky Charm that the user either activates Second Chance after the power is used or before the black cat holder touches something/someone as precaution. But as already established, this is ineffective on the Snake Miraculous holder themselves if they're already hit with Cataclysm.

title: Intuition
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Intuition - Plot Development
Also, anyone can trigger the power, not just the user, although if someone else, the same thing still happens as everyone else would forget while the Snake Miraculous holder would remember.
Similar to the Rabbit Miraculous holders, the Snake Miraculous holders must also be careful on what information they give to others because if it is the wrong kind then they can put a great hindrance to their plans.
Finally, there are some situations that are simply unwinnable, even with infinite chances. Monarch tried to help his Akumatized villains by giving them multiple Second Chances, but no matter what he tried, Ladybug's cunning and Cat Noir's unpredictability always got the best of him.
This weakness is partially Monarch's fault, because due to him creating different villains, the heroes were put in so many different situations and outside of commanding his villains or taking their powers away, he never knew what it was like to fight against them therefore he wasn't trained or practiced in unpredictability. So despite the Butterfly Miraculous holder being able to give powers to their victims, it doesn't always guarantee they know how to beat them.

title: Intuition
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Intuition - Plot Development
As ironic as it sounds, Gabriel actually handed the heroes their victory by messing with A.D.A. sensor's it was his own undoing.
This episode reveals some more details about other Miraculous powers besides the one that takes central stage on the episode:
It is revealed that the Shell-ter barrier can even be erected from many kilometers away and be casted like a beam.
When using the power of Genesis, the user can create the object they desire anywhere, but depending how roughly they make the object's shape its size can be way off.
Taking in the situation with Astrocat, had Monarch taken his ring, then he would've known he left Adrien like Ladybug with no air in space. Meaning Gabriel would have to get son back to earth quickly and the voyage portal is the fastest way, but having his son in his lair let alone the crypt are the last places where he wants Adrien to go. That means Monarch would have to think of another end destination portal while he was pulling Astrocat through, but it is unknown if the Horse Miraculous holder can do so under said conditions.

title: Intuition
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Intuition - Plot Development
It was revealed that the Space power-up suits come with high tech visors and that the jetpacks can easily catch up with A.D.A. meaning that said packs can go up to 6000mph or more.
It was revealed that Monarch's sickness has spread to his internal organs, with even his heart rate being affected.
It is revealed that Nathaniel sits in front of Lila in class, after Ivan started sitting next to Mylène, which was first seen in "Illusion".

title: Intuition
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Intuition - Trivia
Due to the focus of the Snake Miraculous and the number of times Monarch has used Second Chance, Marinette and Adrien, as well as their alter-egos: Ladybug and Cat Noir, have a relatively minor role in this episode. Making this the third episode where neither of them are the main focus, following "Sentibubbler" and "Guiltrip".
Beside the power of Second Chance, the concept of intuition, intuitiveness and how short-sided as well as how right it can be is expressed and how someone's intuitiveness should never be doubt:
Luka Couffaine, as the current Snake Miraculous holder Viperion, has a calm, observant, focused and opened mind.
How Ladybug's instinct and intuition had become so sharp that she was right about her enemy's actions in various episodes as such in "Miraculer", "Furious Fu", "Sentibubbler" and "Destruction".
André has good intuition when it came to matching people with his ice cream and their situations but in "Elation", it was short-sided as he wanted his love vision to be true so much that he didn't think about what those actions would cause for everyone else.

title: Intuition
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Intuition - Trivia
As well as in "Glaciator 2", as he had forgotten that like the heroes and everyone else he had no idea who they were and his intuition was short-sided as he jumped conclusions again as he thought Marinette and Cat Noir were in item when actually they weren't.
When Monarch used Second Chance the first time with Glaciator, he tried to warn him about a bell falling from the sky and called it intuition. This is due to how the power of Second Chance makes its user appear to other people to possess a great intuition for knowing things that are about to happen.
Both Tomoe and A.D.A. had an intuition that Monarch was lying to or hiding something away from them.

title: Intuition
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Intuition - Trivia
Due to the desperation of getting the Ladybug and Cat Miraculous and the little time he has left, Monarch should've followed his intuition that he would succeed in one last use of Second Chance by applying everything he had learned through his previous uses of the power: destroy Ladybug's yo-yo so she couldn't use Lucky Charm, put her in a situation where she cannot replace it, all while separating her from Cat Noir. However, that same desperation diminished his intuition to the point where he used the Snake Miraculous' power in a situation he couldn't win, resulting in the acceleration of the advance of Cat Noir's Cataclysm on his body.
Tomoe Tsurugi had the intuition that Monarch was hiding something from her, then was able to hear his accelerated heartbeat, causing him to tell her he didn't had much time left to seize the Miraculous.
A.D.A's intuition was manipulated by Monarch and she hastily headed off into space had Claudie thought of what Ladybug had suggested earlier herself then she wouldn't need to be save.

title: Intuition
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Intuition - Trivia
Because of their conditions, Gabriel and Nathalie feared of Adrien being alone had they used their intuition they would've realized Adrien being alone would've been the least of their problems.
Ladybug thought it was strange Monarch hasn't used Second Chance against them, only for Cat Noir to consider it lucky he hasn't used it. In a way, both of them were right, they didn't know about the previous times Monarch used it and how he thought it was too risky to transfer the power to his akumatized villains, and when his Cataclysm injury caught to him, he permanently cease using Second Chance.
Adrien's intuition was right in "Oni-Chan" and other episodes as he warned Lila, if she continued lying to everybody she would eventually get caught in "Confrontation".
Master Fu's intuition about Chloé's betrayal as Queen Bee in "The Battle of the Miraculous, as well as about Hawk Moth seizing all of the Miraculous from "Kwamibuster" came true mentioned above and in "Strikeback".
When Cat Noir warned Chloé about getting her powers under Hawk Moth would turn into a nightmare in "Miraculer" and by "Miracle Queen" and "Revolution" came true.

title: Intuition
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Intuition - Trivia
Monarch's intuition was also right too upon realizing the situation with the Snake Miraculous; had he given it back that included Sass too, he would've told the heroes everything which is similar to "Destruction".
Émilie's intuition about Gabriel's actions was true as she didn't want many to suffer for their mistake.
The Snake Miraculous' superpower title, Second Chance, refers to how many of those conditions that were lost, gone, not given, people didn't take or they did:
Adrien took his chance to use the Snake Miraculous becoming the holder Aspik to prove to himself that he could do or be something on his own without his status as Cat Noir or his father looming in his shadow.
He mentioned in "Derision", to Chloé how Ladybug and Cat Noir gave her a chance with Bee Miraculous.
For Adrien in "Reflekdoll" and Alya in "Hack-San", both were excited at the chance to use Ladybug's powers.
After Gabriel told Adrien the truth about his identity as Hawk Moth, he didn't give him a chance to handle it on his own following "Cat Blanc" and "Ephemeral".
He and Nathalie had many chances to realize what they were doing was wrong and own up to what they have done.

title: Intuition
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Intuition - Trivia
Despite talking to an illusion of him in "Mayura", Ladybug and Cat Noir gave Hawk Moth a chance to help him fix his mistake, but he didn't.
In "Passion", Nathalie while akumatized had the chance to tell Lady Noir and Mister Bug everything had she acted on it then things wouldn't been different.
While holding his hand through the voyage portal, Astrocat had the chance to remove some of the miraculous rings from Monarch, especially the Horse Miraculous (who had Kaalki inside of it and is located at the same hand as the Snake Miraculous) and Astrocat could've used it himself to get out of barrier imprisoning him.
But in "Re-creation", Bug Noire shockingly discovered that Monarch remade them so only he, the akumatized, and the Miraculized can use them. Even if she nor Astrocat took them in either occasion then they would've discovered this sooner. Despite getting any of them back neither side couldn't use them (at least until Monarch got them back).
Both Lila and Félix had the chance to tell Ladybug and Cat Noir who Monarch was, but chose not to acting out of selfishness.

title: Intuition
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Intuition - Trivia
Prior to "Representation", he had many chances to tell Marinette and Adrien (thereby extension their alter-egos) the story of their family history allowing them to act sooner.
Lila and Chloé had and were given many chances to repent for their actions, but they didn't.
Even though André knew that Chloé's behavior was wrong, he took a chance and hope she would change but he had many chances to discipline her and stand up to Audrey to make it so.
Nathalie had many chances to show Adrien the tapes she and Gabriel had hidden away.
As well as Master Fu: if he had known that the Butterfly and Peacock Miraculouses were intact sooner, he could've used the opportunity to find them.
After Rena and the others as of "Miracle Queen", had their identities exposed to Hawk Moth because of Chloé, Ladybug gave them all another chance to continue as their alteregos.

When Ladybug approaches the space jet, A.D.A. can hear her, which means her microphone is still working. That means A.D.A. should've heard Claudie even if her other sensors were disabled.
However, Monarch could have only turned off the sensors inside the ship, but not outside the ship.
The fact Monarch was able to akumatize A.D.A. when she was in Space is an inconsistency regarding what was established in "Startrain", regarding how he needs to be at a certain range from his akuma in order to communicate with his akumatized villains, otherwise they will act on their own.
However, there are a few explanations for that inconsistency:
It is possible that he only needs the distance to make contact and, once that happens, the connection remains intact. Since Monarch can use Voyage, he can use it to not only send his megakumas quickly, but also to counter the limit regarding distance.

title: Intuition

Since, in "Startrain", he was detransformed when Claudie was akumatized into the titular villain, he was unable to contact her. However, since the Butterfly Miraculous holder can communicate with any akumatized person, even those not created by them, that explanation may be unlikely.
At last (and the most likely explanation), it must be noticed that when the limited range of his control over his akumas was revealed, Monarch was still Hawk Moth and he hadn't created the megakuma yet. Because of that, it is possible that the megakuma possesses a much bigger range than the normal one.
When Monarch finally gives up and transforms back, all the kwamis except Nooroo go back to their cages. title: Intuition/Transcript
text:
Intuition/Transcript - Intro
__NOTOC__
[ Theme Song ]
Glaciator: You'd no longer be superheroes! You wouldn’t have to defend Paris, you’d be free! Free to be happy and in love!
(A sound of a huge firecracker-filled Lucky Charm bell is heard which is then dropped on Glaciator to trap him.)
Glaciator: AHHH! I'm-a melting! I'm-a melting!! It's not fair!
(Ladybug retracts her yo-yo.)
Ladybug: Guess he wasn't saved by the bell!
Cat Noir: Hope he'll warm up to it!
Monarch: (from his lair) Don't be so hard on Glaciator. He deserves a second chance!
(As Monarch triggered Second Chance, time reverts back to when Glaciator was giving his ultimatum.)
Glaciator: You’d be free! Free to be happy and in love!
Monarch: (from his lair) Get away from that roof, Glaciator! And beware of what might fall from the sky!
Glaciator: (looks above and sees nothing) What makes you say that?
Monarch: (from his lair) Let's just call it... an intuition.
(From behind, Ladybug and Cat Noir are seen charging Glaciator with a ginormous shield plate with the help of Cat Noir's staff. They push Glaciator with it towards the fire.)
Glaciator: AHHH! I'm-a melting! I'm-a melting!! It's not fair!!

title: Intuition/Transcript
text:
Intuition/Transcript - Intro
(As Glaciator's ice cream shell continues to melt, Monarch once again uses the power of Second Chance.)
Glaciator: You’d be free! Free to be happy and in love!
Monarch: (from his lair) Not this way! They're hiding behind that building!
(Glaciator turns around, stomping his way towards where Monarch pointed him to. Cat Noir comes out from behind the rubble.)
Cat Noir: Glaciator, you win! I'll give you my Miraculous!
(Glaciator continues his way towards Cat Noir. On the other side, Ladybug throws a huge parasol, impaling it into Glaciator and blocking his sight as it opens.)
Glaciator: What’s going on? I cannot see anything!
(Altogether, Ladybug and Cat Noir pull the wire attached to the parasol that is pierced through Glaciator and pulls the villain towards the fire, melting his ice cream shell.)
Glaciator: Stop! What are you doing? (gets pulled on a car and falls down near the fire) You’re melting my butt!
Monarch: (from his lair, furious) You're kidding! (grunts as his cataclysmed arm strikes him in pain) No! Not now!! You can't do that!
Glaciator: (sobs) I'm-a melting! I'm-a melting!! It's not fair!!

title: Intuition/Transcript
text:
Intuition/Transcript - Intro
(Cat Noir throws his staff at Glaciator’s ice cream scooper to break it and release the Megakuma.)
Gabriel: This power of Second Chance is of no use to me against Ladybug's magical luck! Every single time, her Lucky Charm adapts!
Nathalie: Deprive her of her yo-yo. Without her Lucky Charm, she won't stand a chance against you.
Gabriel: I've tried that before...
Cat Noir: Sorry you have to bounce so soon!
(Other people slip on the scattered tiny balls. Witnessing all this on a bird's eye view, Dark Humor laughs maniacally.)
[Superpower Sequence]
Ladybug: Lucky Charm! (receives a piping bag)
(Ladybug uses her Lucky Vision and pinpoints the piping bag in her hands, her yo-yo, Dark Humor's eyepiece, and the tiny balls on the ground. Commencing her plan, Ladybug wraps her yo-yo around the piping bag and lassoes it towards Dark Humor, squeezing out the icing inside which causes to block Dark Humor's sight.)
Dark Humor: Hey! It's not funny when I get hit! (trips over the tiny balls and breaks the eyepiece containing the Megakuma)
(In his lair, Monarch taps on his ring, triggering Second Chance.)
Cat Noir: Sorry you have to bounce so soon!

title: Intuition/Transcript
text:
Intuition/Transcript - Intro
(The Parisians trip on the tiny balls scattered on the ground. Dark Humor laughs from the sky.)
Monarch: (from his lair) Now aim at her yo-yo!
[Superpower Sequence]
Ladybug: Lucky Charm!
(Dark Humor disrupts Ladybug's Lucky Charm by shooting an arrow and turning it into a balloon.)
Ladybug: No!!
(Dark Humor cackles triumphantly.)
Monarch: (from his lair) This is where your luck runs out, Ladybug!
Cat Noir: (as he continues to scatter tiny balls around the area) Balloon... YAY! Come on, buddy! Let's play ball! (tosses the balloon towards Dark Humor, blocking his sight)
Dark Humor: Hey!
Ladybug: (after hiding behind a pillar) Spots off! (de-transforms...) Spots on! (...and transforms back to reactivate her power) Lucky Charm!
Dark Humor: Wait! How did she do that??
Monarch: (from his lair) She had time to transform back and forth, you fool!
(Ladybug receives a toilet bowl.)
Gabriel: If I deprive her of her Lucky Charm, she replaces it! And when we manage to stop her altogether, Cat Noir is right there!
[Flashback Montage]
(Scene one: In "Passion", where Ladybug got hit by Safari's Venom and gets rescued by Cat Noir.)
(Scene two: Mister Bug activates his Lucky Charm.)

title: Intuition/Transcript
text:
Intuition/Transcript - Intro
[End of Flashback]
Gabriel: I'm wasting my time, Nathalie... (rolls up his sleeve with his cataclysmed arm) ...and time is something I can't afford to lose. Every time I use Second Chance, time rewinds for Ladybug, Cat Noir and the rest of the world, but not for me. I remember every one of those attempts... and so does my body.
Nathalie: (gasps and puts her ear on Gabriel's chest to check on his heart) Gabriel, your heart has been hurt! You can never use the power of Second Chance again!
Gabriel: And who will use it, then? (sarcastically) You, perhaps??
(Nathalie scowls at Gabriel and coughs.)
Gabriel: Forgive me. As for using an akumatized villain, it's too dangerous. They'd hold sole power over time and memory of the events. And if they foolishly compromise that power, we could lose everything!
Nathalie: So far, you're the one who acted foolishly — risked everything and lost everything! Your use of the Miraculous is condemning us!
(Gabriel had nothing to do but to look down. Nathalie softens her expression.)

title: Intuition/Transcript
text:
Intuition/Transcript - Intro
Nathalie: Gabriel, you may only have a few weeks left like this... and I don't have much more than that. Maybe it's time to stop chasing after the Miraculous and start looking for a solution for Adrien. Make sure he's not alone once we're gone.
(Hearing these words, Gabriel's eyes start to fill with sadness. Nathalie places her hands over Gabriel's.)
Nathalie: Do it. For Émilie.
Gabriel: Tell me, Adrien... Besides Nathalie and me, is there anyone else you like to spend your time with?
Adrien: Well... (his phone rings) Fancy that! Marinette! I like spending time with Marinette. (picks up his phone)
Marinette: (on-call) Guess what I'm calling for: nothing! Can you believe it? I'm calling you randomly, totally out of the blue, for no reason at all!
Adrien: So you didn't write down everything you might need to say to me based on everything I might say to you?
(From behind, Gabriel is seen agonizing once more caused by the stabbing pain of his cataclysmed arm.)
Marinette: Not at all! Well... I did. I really tried not to, you know, but it was too hard! Anyhow, I limited myself to fourteen possible conversations, including this one!
Adrien: Congratulations!
Marinette: (on-call) Thank you!

title: Intuition/Transcript
text:
Intuition/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: And did you prepare questions for science class?
Marinette: (on-call) Not-a-one! Not even for the live video conference we're doing with Max's mom on the super awesome Tsurugi space jet! I, Marinette, will improvise questions, unpredictably, without planning anything!
(With so much pain, Gabriel drops to his knees on the floor.)
Adrien: Dad! (to Marinette) I have to go! (to Gabriel) Dad...
Gabriel: I'm fine, Adrien. I just got distracted. So, did I hear that your school is hosting a video conference for the Tsurugi space jet test this afternoon? That's absolutely wonderful!
Gabriel: My love, I'll be putting myself in danger like I've never had before. I know you wouldn't like it, but if I succeed, we'll be saved! Together, at last! In order to unite us, I'm going to break up Ladybug and Cat Noir forever!
Gabriel: Nooroo, dark wings, rise! (transforms into Monarch)
Sass: Didn't you say... "never again"?

title: Intuition/Transcript
text:
Intuition/Transcript - Intro
Monarch: What are you complaining about? With me, you'll always get a second chance! Sass, your power is now mine! (absorbs his power) Second Chance! (taps on his ring containing the power of Intuition) Alliance, (a hologram of Alliance Émilie shows upon his command) please call Ms. Tsurugi. (Tomoe's hologram pops in front of him) Tsurugi-san, I need the control codes for your space jet.
Tomoe: (on-call) Why now? Are you planning something I don't know about? What is it you're not telling me, Gabriel?
(Encountering a miscalculation, Monarch taps on his ring, triggering Second Chance. As he reverted time, Monarch calls Tomoe for the second time.)
Monarch: Tsurugi-san, I'm worried about the space jet test this afternoon. I'd like to make sure there are no security breaches in the system and—
Tomoe: Gabriel, I've allowed you to choose the color of the seats on the plane, but computer security is my concern. Besides, why are you asking me that question? Unless there is something you're not telling me...
(Another miscalculation calls for another time for a Second Chance. Triggering the power of Intuition, Monarch calls Tomoe for the third time.)

title: Intuition/Transcript
text:
Intuition/Transcript - Intro
Monarch: Tsurugi-san, I order you to give me the codes to your space jet!
Tomoe: Have your Monarch powers gone to your head? You can't intimidate me! There must be something you're not telling me!
Monarch: Never! All I want is—
Tomoe: Silence! Let me listen.
(Tomoe listens the abnormality in Monarch's, or rather, Gabriel's heartbeat.)
Tomoe: Your heart. It's beating abnormally, Gabriel-san. You're feeble. What are you hiding from me?
(Monarch hesitantly prepares for another Second Chance, but feeling that his body could not handle it anymore, he proceeds with his plan.)
Monarch: My fighting has weakened me. I don't have long left.
Tomoe: I want the Miraculous as much as you do. I want a new world, too.
(Tomoe types in the hologram the password for the space jet read as 'K1s3k1_n0_Sh1n_J1d41.' )
Monarch: Thank you, Tsurugi-san.
Tomoe: May luck be with you, Gabriel.
(The transmission closes.)
Monarch: It already is.
(His ring where the power of Intuition is at blinks.)
(In another hologram, Monarch watches the news broadcast about the Tsurugi Space Jet test.)

title: Intuition/Transcript
text:
Intuition/Transcript - Intro
Nadja Chamack: She's incredible! Claudie Kanté, at the commands of Tsurugi Industries' most sophisticated Space Jet, and with minutes to go before test launch, still makes time to answer questions from her son's classmates!
Claudie: In space, the jet will be flying at well over six thousand miles per hour! Any more questions? (Marinette raises a hand) Marinette!
Marinette: You said the Space Jet was equipped with artificial intelligence. Can you explain how it works?
Claudie: Of course, Marinette! You're right, I haven't introduced A.D.A. yet. In fact, I'll let her introduce herself.
A.D.A.: Hello, I am A.D.A., Affective Decision Assistant System.
Markov: In a way, A.D.A.'s like my little sister! (smiles)
A.D.A.: More like your updated, improved sister. He-he.
Markov: That's what all little sisters say. Ha-ha, ha-ha!
(As the live broadcast of the video conference continues, Monarch begins to take every piece of data he could get to execute his plan, starting off with booting A.D.A.'s program on his monitor.)
Marinette: You wrote a program for Mrs. Tsurugi's Space Jet?
Max: No, I just made Markov's tech available for free on the internet, and Tsurugi Industries decided to use it.

title: Intuition/Transcript
text:
Intuition/Transcript - Intro
Claudie: Thanks to special sensors spread across the jet, A.D.A. can track my presence and everything I'm feeling!
Kim: Did you bring a swimsuit?
(The whole class laughs at Kim's question.)
A.D.A. System Control: Welcome to the A.D.A. System. Please enter your password.
(Monarch enters the password Tomoe gave him, 'K1s3k1_n0_Sh1n_J1d41'.)
Kim: What? I heard there were pools on Mars!
Claudie: I'm sorry, Kim, but there aren't pools on Mars. Just water in the form of ice.
Kim: In that case, I don't see the point of going there.
Claudie: Also, we're not going to Mars, Kim. At least, not yet. We're doing all these tests so we can go there someday. Today, for example, we'll be testing how a pilot and an AI like A.D.A. can support each other in stressful situations. This would be very helpful for a trip to Mars!
Kim: Ooh, right... so that's when you'll be taking your swimsuit! (shows his trunks on camera)
(The whole class is filled with laughter. Monarch continues to watch the broadcast.)
A.D.A.: Claudie, I'm sensing that you're emotionally ready, enthusiastic and confident. Initiating test sequence.
(Monarch, now gaining access to the A.D.A. System, taps on the Claudie's vital data.)

title: Intuition/Transcript
text:
Intuition/Transcript - Intro
Claudie: Let's do this, A.D.A.! Test number one!
(Upon Claudie's command, the thrusters on the space jet powers down and begins its descent towards the Earth's surface. On Monarch's monitor, he can see Claudie's vitals going haywire.)
A.D.A.: My sensors can detect your stress accurately, Claudie, and at this point, you are no longer able to maneuver the aircraft safely. I'm taking command.
(The space jet is once again reactivated and is now back on track. Claudie's vitals return to normal, as seen on Monarch's monitor.)
A.D.A.: Your stress level's back to normal, so I'm relinquishing control back to you.
Claudie: Test number one is a success! (The whole class cheer.) Congratulations, A.D.A.! And now, on to test number two!
(For test number two, Claudie gets ejected into outer space.)
A.D.A.: The sensors in your suit tell me you've ejected out of your aircraft, Claudie. I'm bringing you back.
(The space jet automatically flies towards where Claudie was ejected and catches her in her pod... and the perfect time for Monarch to use Second Chance. Monarch taps on the ring, triggering the power of Intuition and disables every sensor in Claudie's space jet.)

title: Intuition/Transcript
text:
Intuition/Transcript - Intro
A.D.A. System Control: All sensory connections are down.
(The whole class cheer loudly as Claudie slides in safely back into her pod.)
A.D.A.: Claudie?
Claudie: Congratulations, A.D.A.!
A.D.A.: Claudie, where are you?
(Claudie gasps at the malfunction.)
A.D.A.: Claudie, I can no longer sense your vitals. Claudie?
Claudie: What? I'm here! A.D.A.! A.D.A., can you hear me?
Monarch: For that to happen, she'd have to still have her ears.
A.D.A.: Test number two has failed. The pilot was not recovered and currently outside my detection range. With no humans on board... I am resuming control of the plane.
Claudie: A.D.A., no! I'm here!
Max: A.D.A.! My mom is still on board! The test is a success!
Monarch: In space, my friends, no one can hear you scream!
Nadja: What's going on? Claudie Kanté's Space Jet is leaving Earth's orbit!
Monarch: (turns to his Kwami cage) Kaalki, your power is now mine! (sucks her power in his ring)

title: Intuition/Transcript
text:
Intuition/Transcript - Intro
A.D.A.: Today, at 14:37, I lost my pilot in space. Test number two has determined that I am a dangerous invention. To protect humans from my failures, I will fly the Space Jet to the ends of the universe. For your safety, do not attempt to retrieve me. End of transmission.
(The Space Jet flies away into oblivion.)
Monarch: Trixx, your power is now mine!
Max: (starts typing frantically) A.D.A.! A.D.A.!! It's as if... she couldn't hear anything!
Markov: I'm 100% sure that someone hacked into the Space Jet remotely to cut off all the sensor's feedback circuits!
Marinette: Max, can you fix it?
(Max continues to type on his laptop.)
A.D.A. System Control: Welcome to the A.D.A. System. Please enter your password.
Max: I don't have it! (continues to type frantically) I don't have the password to Tsurugi Industries! I can't access the controls!
Monarch: Wayzz, your power is now mine! (gains the power of Protection)
Alya: Don't worry, Max. Ladybug and Cat Noir will fix this!
Monarch: I'm counting on it! Ziggy, your power is now mine! (absorbs the power of Passion) Voyage!

title: Intuition/Transcript
text:
Intuition/Transcript - Intro
Monarch: (forcefully, in pain) Genesis! (The Paint Brush appears in his hand and he creates a meteor falling to Earth. He brings out his flute afterwards) Mirage!
(Using the power of Illusion, he creates an image of him formed by his akumas by the Eiffel Tower. A civilian brings out his Alliance and films it.)
(At the school, the alarm system on everyone's Alliance activate simultaneously.)
Alliance automated voice: Monarch alert! Monarch alert!
(Marinette brings out her phone to watch Monarch at the Eiffel Tower who is about to give his ultimatum.)
Monarch: Ladybug! Cat Noir! You're going to have to choose: will you stop this huge meteorite threatening the people of Paris or rescue Claudie Kanté trapped inside her out-of-control space jet?
(The whole class rush to the nearby window and notice the falling meteor in the sky.)
Monarch: Of course, you could also choose to give me your Miraculous and save everyone by letting me help you.
(Marinette and Alya turn to look at each other to create an escape plan for Ladybug to show up.)
Miss Bustier: Everybody stay calm. Ladybug and Cat Noir are going to take care of the problem.

title: Intuition/Transcript
text:
Intuition/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (fakely) Oh, Alya... I'm not feeling very good. I think I should go see the nurse.
Adrien: I'll take you over there, Marinette.
(Marinette begins to stutter at the sudden change of plans. Alya couldn't do anything but shrug at them.)
Marinette: (in a high-pitched voice) Uh— Okay. Thanks, Adrien.
(The two of them head to the clinic.)
Marinette: Thanks for walking me over, Adrien.
Adrien and Marinette: (to each other) Be careful, okay?
(They smile at each other goodbye as Marinette enters the nurse's office. Adrien takes a deep breath and runs to another room to transform.)
Adrien: Plagg, claws out! (transforms into Cat Noir)
Cat Noir: Power up! (transforms into Astrocat and flies away) WIEEEE~
(Back at the clinic, Marinette makes another excuse to stall the nurse.)
Sissy: (off-screen) Shall we call your parents?
Marinette: Just seeing you has made me feel all better. Thank you, nurse! (looks around and rushes to another room to transform) Tikki, spots on! (transforms into Ladybug)
Ladybug: Power up! (transforms into Cosmobug and flies away)
Cosmobug: Can you cataclysm it?
Astrocat: This could possibly be an illusion to waste our time!

title: Intuition/Transcript
text:
Intuition/Transcript - Intro
Cosmobug: We can't take that risk. I'll deal with the space jet. You deal with the meteorite. We'll stay in touch!
Monarch: Exactly as planned! Now that you've split up, you are at my mercy! (enters a portal)
Cosmobug: Hello! Don't worry, we're going to come up with a solution together.
A.D.A.: I don't want your help. I have failed.
Cosmobug: A.D.A you didn't fail. Claudie is inside the cockpit. You can't detect her because your sensors have been disabled. But if we get back to Earth and fix them—
A.D.A.: No. I don't need to be fixed. I need to disappear.
Monarch: How fortunate that an artificial intelligence can suffer so much. (corrupts a butterfly into a Megakuma) Voyage, my Megakuma! (creates a portal, teleporting his Megakuma to space to akumatize A.D.A. in her core) Bugfighter. I am Monarch. The only reason Cosmobug wants to help you is so humans can test you again and again, even if it means losing more pilots.
A.D.A.: I refuse to go through that pain again.

title: Intuition/Transcript
text:
Intuition/Transcript - Intro
Monarch: I understand. If you accept my help, you will have the ability to stop them. All I ask in return is her Miraculous, (shows Ladybug's earrings in the monitor) the magical little earrings that give Cosmobug her powers.
A.D.A.: If her powers endanger my pilots, they must be taken from her. (succumbs into the akumatization and transforms into Bugfighter)
Bugfighter: (scans Cosmobug) Cosmobug, enemy identified.
Ladybug: No! I'm your friend, A.D.A.!
Bugfighter: I am no longer A.D.A.. I am Bugfighter, and I have no friends.
Cosmobug: Lucky Charm!
(Bugfighter fires at Cosmobug's yo-yo, disrupting it.)
Cosmobug: No!
Monarch: (from his lair) Finally, your luck has turned, Cosmobug! Here you are trapped in space where you can't even transform back!
(Bugfighter uses its mechanical arm to capture her, with another mechanical arm about to reach and steal her earrings.)
Cosmobug: (grunts) You're making a mistake, Bugfighter!
Claudie: No, A.D.A., stop!!
Bugfighter: (as one of its mechanical arms reach for Ladybug's Miraculous) Enemy of humanity, your reign ends here!
Monarch: (from his lair) Nobody will come to help you, Cosmobug. Least of all Astrocat!

title: Intuition/Transcript
text:
Intuition/Transcript - Intro
Astrocat: Cataclysm! (disintegrates the meteorite)
Monarch: Shell-ter!
Cosmobug: (from Astrocat's communicator) Astrocat!
Astrocat: Cosmobug?
Cosmobug: I could use a helping paw right about now!
Astrocat: Coming, my cosmo-lady! (coincidentally dodges Monarch's Shell-ter) Hey! What's going on?
Monarch: You're not going anywhere, kitten!
(Upon using Second Chance, time reverts back to when Monarch disabled the sensors in Claudie's Space Jet.)
A.D.A. System Control: All sensory connections are down.
A.D.A.: Claudie, I can no longer sense your vitals. Claudie?
Nadja: What's going on? Claudie Kanté's spaceship is leaving Earth's orbit!
Monarch: (in the video in Marinette's phone) Ladybug! Cat Noir! You're going to have to choose: will you stop this huge meteorite threatening the people of Paris or rescue Claudie Kanté trapped inside her out-of-control space jet?
Astrocat: Cataclysm! (disintegrates the meteorite)
Monarch: (from his lair) Shell-ter!
(This time, Monarch successfully captures Astrocat inside the shield.)
Astrocat: Hey!
Cosmobug: Astrocat!
Astrocat: Cosmobug?
(A small portal appears behind Astrocat as Monarch's right hand appear out of it to steal Astrocat's Miraculous.)

title: Intuition/Transcript
text:
Intuition/Transcript - Intro
Cosmobug: I could use a helping paw right about now!
Astrocat: (while fending off Monarch's hand) Right! Uh, I'll see what I can do. (gasps as he notices the rings on Monarch's hand) Monarch is using Second Chance!
Cosmobug: What??
Astrocat: You know what, I'd like a second chance, too!
(After Astrocat taps on Monarch's ring, Second Chance is triggered for the second time. Time reverts back to when Monarch is about to disable the sensors in Claudie's Space Jet.)
Monarch: No! I was almost there! Well then, if he wants to play that game... Pollen, your power is now mine! (absorbs Pollen into his ring)
(On his monitor, Monarch disables all the sensors in Claudie's Space Jet.)
A.D.A. System Control: All sensory connections are down.
A.D.A.: Claudie, I can no longer sense your vitals. Claudie.
(The Space Jet goes into oblivion.)
Monarch: (in the video in Marinette's phone) Ladybug! Cat Noir!
(In space, Bugfighter grabs Cosmobug with its mechanical arm and attempts to steal her Miraculous.)
Bugfighter: Enemy of humanity, your reign ends here!
Astrocat: Cataclysm! (disintegrates the meteorite)
(Astrocat gets captured by Monarch's Shell-ter.)
Astrocat: Hey!
Cosmobug: Astrocat!

title: Intuition/Transcript
text:
Intuition/Transcript - Intro
Astrocat: Cosmobug?
(Through a small portal, Monarch manages to immobilize Astrocat.)
Cosmobug: I could use a helping paw right about now!
Monarch: Finally, luck has changed sides!
(Monarch deactivates Venom and reaches his hand out to where Astrocat is in attempt to steal his Miraculous, and while he's at this, Cosmobug struggles to escape as Bugfighter is very close to stealing her Miraculous. Luckily enough, Cosmobug comes up with a plan upon using her Lucky Vision, pinpointing Claudie, the windshield and the emergency hammer inside the jet.)
Cosmobug: Claudie, smash the windshield with the emergency hammer! Come out and help me! She won't attack you!
(Claudie breaks the windshield with the emergency hammer and steps out the jet.)
Bugfighter: Internal damage detected. Monarch, how can my windshield break if there's no one inside?
(Having been caught in the act, Monarch quickly thinks of an excuse.)
Monarch: A-An asteroid is attacking you! Destroy it!
(Claudie continues to pull out the wires inside the jet one by one.)
Cosmobug: She cannot detect you! That's the flaw!

title: Intuition/Transcript
text:
Intuition/Transcript - Intro
Bugfighter: I'm not detecting any asteroid around... but I am picking up the vibrations of deceit... Is Claudie still here?!
(Bugfighter's mechanical arms deactivate, freeing Cosmobug.)
Cosmobug: Yes, she is!
Bugfighter: Monarch! You lied to me! (rejects the Megakuma)
Monarch: No!
(A montage begins: Monarch triggers Second Chance multiple times, starting with Monarch disabling the vital sensors in the space jet, the space jet going into oblivion, Monarch's illusory ultimatum at the Eiffel Tower terrorizes parisians, Cosmobug getting captured by Bugfighter, Astrocat getting trapped in Monarch's Shell-ter...)
Astrocat: Hey!
(...and getting immobilized by Monarch's Venom.)
Monarch: Bugfighter, destroy the emergency hammer inside your cockpit!
Bugfighter: Why would I do that if there's no  one inside the craft? (A beat; Monarch attempts to quickly find an excuse.) I'm picking up the vibrations of deceit. Claudie is still inside, isn't she?

title: Intuition/Transcript
text:
Intuition/Transcript - Intro
(The montage continues. Monarch triggers Second Chance once again, starting with Monarch disabling the vital sensors in the space jet, the space jet going into oblivion, Monarch's illusory ultimatum at the Eiffel Tower terrorizes parisians, Cosmobug getting captured by Bugfighter, Astrocat getting trapped in Monarch's Shell-ter...)
Astrocat: Hey!
Cosmobug: Astrocat!
Astrocat: Cosmobug?
(...and getting immobilized by Monarch's Venom.)
Monarch: Bugfighter, immobilize your pilot with your seatbelts!
Bugfighter: What do you mean, "my pilot"?
(The montage continues. Monarch disables the vital sensors...)
Bugfighter: Claudie?
(...triggers Second Chance, disabling the sensors again...)
Bugfighter: Claudie?
(...and again...)
Bugfighter: Claudie?
(...and again...)
Bugfighter: Claudie?
(...and again, until Monarch drops on the ground, exhausted.)
Claudie: (from the monitor in Monarch's lair) Test #2 is a success!
Monarch: Reverse morphosis! (de-transforms into Gabriel)
Claudie: (from the monitor) Congratulations, A.D.A.!
A.D.A.: (from the monitor) You and I make a wonderful team, Claudie!
(The whole class applaud.)
Ziggy: Is it over...?

title: Intuition/Transcript
text:
Intuition/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (from the monitor) Max! You're the greatest genius the world has ever seen!
Max: (from the monitor) Only up to 99.86%!
(The class continues to cheer for Max.)
Adrien: Dad? Dad! Are you okay?
Gabriel: It's nothing. I'm just a bit tired. Between the launch of the Alliance ring, the new fashion line... I haven't had a moment of rest.
(Nathalie glares down at Gabriel, giving him a stern look. Gabriel sits up on the couch.)
Gabriel: I can't do this anymore. I spend way too much time working and not enough time with you, Adrien. I'm going to do everything I can to change that.
Adrien: (gasps as he turns to look at Nathalie and back to Gabriel) Really?
Gabriel: It's my greatest wish.
(Adrien smiles. His phone rings momentarily.)
Adrien: Marinette...
(Seeing him hesitate to take the call, Gabriel reaches out to Adrien.)
Gabriel: You can take your friend's call, Adrien.
(Adrien smiles once again and walks away as he takes the call.)
Adrien: Marinette! My father is fine, thank you. You want to improvise our conversation? Sure we can! (exits the room)

title: Intuition/Transcript
text:

Nathalie: You took a huge risk, for a disastrous result! All that your attempts have accomplished is to accelerate the effect of Cat Noir's cataclysm!
Gabriel: How much more time do I have?
Nathalie: (her face shifts to a worried one as she sighs and sits down) Probably very little.

title: Irupé
text:
Irupé - Intro
is a character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She is a Brazilian girl who lives in Rio de Janeiro, and a close friend of Luka Couffaine who she's pretending to be in a relationship with.
When her Hummingbird Jewel is inhabited by Maino'li, she becomes Beija-Flor, a hummingbird-themed superheroine.

title: Irupé
text:
Irupé - Appearance
Physical appearance
Irupé is a Brazilian teenager of medium height and dark skin. She has long, wavy brown hair pulled back into a French braid and brown eyes.
Civilian attire
She wears a white T-shirt with a pink flower over a green two-piece swimsuit with large white flowers and the Hummingbird Jewel around her neck.

title: Irupé
text:
Irupé - Personality
Irupé is friendly, comforting Luka whenever he's worried and showing affection with small pecks. She's supportive and kind, caring for Luka and those who are close to him, even accepting to be his pretend girlfriend for Marinette's sake.

title: Irupé
text:
Irupé - Relationships
Friends
Luka Couffaine
Since Luka's arrival in Rio de Janeiro, Irupé has formed a friendship with him. She's very considerate and even agreed to pretend to be his girlfriend to throw Marinette off the scent, since Luka lied to her about the real reason for his departure. She's encouraging him to be honest with her.
However, Irupé supsects that Luka has many secrets, and when she sees Ladybug come to visit him, she decides to discover them.
Marinette Dupain-Cheng
Irupé seems to like Marinette, greeting her cheerfully, and having agreed to give Luka a chance in his lie by pretending to be Luka's girlfriend.
Maino'li
Irupé has a friendly relationship with her magical creature, with who she discusses about Luka's connection to Ladybug and the possibility of him being a Miraculous holder.

title: Irupé
text:
Irupé - History
Before season 5
At some point, Irupé was entrusted as a permanent holder of the Hummingbird Jewel and became the superheroine Beija-Flor.
Season 5
At some point during the time Luka stayed in Brazil, Irupé befriended him. Also, Irupé met Marinette.
Before season 6
When Luka returned to Brazil, Irupé agreed to be his pretend girlfriend, knowing about his feelings for Marinette.
Season 6
In "Mister Agreste", Irupé was at the beach with Luka when he was giving a guitar lesson to Marinette through video call, greeting the girl and displaying affection with him to put up the act of being his girlfriend before she went for a swim. When she returned, she suggested him to get an açaí bowl with her, which he refused and preferred to be alone. Noticing his distress, she questioned Luka if it wouldn't be easier to tell her the truth about his feelings. She encouraged him with a kiss on the cheek before leaving.
After getting her açaí bowl, Irupé saw Ladybug arrive at the beach to speak with Luka from behind the trees. Suspicious, she discussed with Maino'li about his connection to Ladybug and the possibility of him being a Miraculous holder.

title: Irupé
text:
Irupé - Etymology
The name Irupé comes from the Guarani word yrupé or irupé, from y ("water") and rupé ("path, surface"), meaning "that which covers the water" or "path over the water," in reference to the giant water lily (Victoria cruziana) whose leaves float like a carpet on rivers and lagoons. In Guarani culture, the irupé is also linked to a legend in which a young girl, in love with the moon, threw herself into the river and was transformed into the great water lily.
Her superhero identity Beija-Flor comes from the Portuguese word for hummingbird beija-flor.

title: Irupé
text:
Irupé - Trivia
Irupé is the second character to possess a magical jewel that is inhabited by a creature that is related to the kwamis, while not being one themselves, the first being Fei Wu.
At the Miraculous panel at CCXP 2025, Thomas Astruc revealed that Irupé is going to play an important role in the future of the series.

title: International Space Station
text:
International Space Station - Intro
The , shortened to ISS, is a space station in low Earth orbit. Since 2000, it has been continuously inhabited by an international crew dedicated to scientific research in microgravity and the space environment. Claudie Kanté will be part of a future crew.

title: International Space Station
text:
International Space Station - Description
The International Space Station orbits Earth at an average altitude of 400 kilometers. Traveling at 28,000 km/h, it completes one orbit around the globe every 92 minutes, for a total of 15 orbits per day.
Assembled between 1998 and 2011, with expansions and upgrades continuing until 2021, the ISS is the largest structure ever built by man in space.
It measures approximately 108 meters long and 74 meters wide, with a mass of nearly 450 tons.
The station is recognizable for its immense photovoltaic system, particularly the eight monumental pairs of solar panels on the American segment that power the station.
The interior consists of 16 pressurized modules offering a total volume of 900 m³, with approximately 400 m³ of habitable space. It includes state-of-the-art laboratories, habitation modules, airlocks and international docking ports, for a crew of up to 7 astronauts.

title: International Space Station
text:
International Space Station - Trivia
The International Space Station is equipped with an IP phone that can call any number on Earth, but cannot receive calls.
This was the phone Thomas used to call Claudie from the space station in the opening scene of "A Fairy Good Night".
