title: Jessica Keynes
text:
Jessica Keynes - Intro
Jessica "Jess" Keynes is one of the two deuteragonists (alongside Aeon) of Miraculous World: New York - United Heroez. She is a student in Professor Gate's class at Armstrong High School. She is also a superhero in the United States of America and Knightowl's partner and daughter.
She was initially known as Sparrow, being the latest in a line of teacher and student who have worn the masks of the legendary hero duo, Knightowl and Sparrow.
After the Eagle Miraculous was recovered from Miraclonizer, she used it to free the American superheroes from the Miraculous' power. Ladybug allowed her to keep the Eagle Miraculous, believing it would be in good hands. When the talon pendant is inhabited by Liiri, Jess transforms into the super-heroine Eagle, gaining the power of freedom.

title: Jessica Keynes
text:
Jessica Keynes - Appearance
Physical appearance
Jessica is a girl of average height and build with light brown skin, gray eyes, and black hair. Her hair is parted down the middle, braided at the sides, and wrapped in leather. Eye shadow is applied to her eyes and a birth mark can be seen under her left one, her fingernails are painted with a metallic blue nail polish. Her eyebrows are sharply curved at the outer ends.
She is Native American, specifically an Oglala Lakota, a subtribe within the Očhéthi Šakówiŋ (Seven Council Fires).
Civilian attire
Dangling from her ears are round beadwork earrings, colored red, white, and blue. She wears a white long-sleeved shirt with red sleeves, and the shirt's design shows a circular formation of eight blue triangles, a simplified rendition of the original Oglala flag. Her pants are jeans and her shoes are brown high-heeled boots.
On each of her wrists are two different bracelets: her right wrist has a beadwork bracelet, which also has the colors red, white, and blue; her left wrist has two golden bands, one thick and one thin.
As Sparrow

title: Jessica Keynes
text:
Jessica Keynes - Appearance
Sparrow had a dark gray mask, with a voice modulator so that she could hide her true gender, covering her face, with the top of the mask being dark brown. Over her mask, she wore goggles with gray straps and circular red lenses. She also wore a brown hooded jacket. The hood was worn over her head, and it was designed after the head of a sparrow, having a dark gray beak, white markings on its forehead and the sides, and an eye with a dark brown pupil.
Underneath her jacket, she had a white suit, and over it, she had dark gray buckles around her torso. On her upper left leg, there is a dark brown bag with pockets, and she wore gray gloves.
As Eagle
When transformed into Eagle with the assistance of Liiri, Jessica's costume reflects her true self as she no longer hides her entire face and voice, as well as her Lakota heritage. It is a two piece costume which includes a brown and white tailcoat and dark gray pants. Her gloves have stayed gray and her boots are now a bright yellow.

title: Jessica Keynes
text:
Jessica Keynes - Appearance
The ends of her sleeves, shirt, and pant legs end jagged, with the sleeve and leg ends embroidered with white, gray, black, and brown beadwork. The sleeves of the jacket are edged with decorative wings as to resemble eagle feathers, the entire underside of them being filled in with beadwork.
Her mask, white with a yellow beak shielding her nose, covers only part of her face in contrast to her Sparrow costume. The transformation also alters Jessica's earrings into more elaborate gold, blue, and gray beadwork with a strip of beads dangling from the circle.

title: Jessica Keynes
text:
Jessica Keynes - Personality
Jessica has a strong desire to prove herself as a hero, sometimes leading her to being disobedient towards her superiors. She also enjoys helping others such as helping Adrien and Marinette admit their feelings. Like her mother, she can be a bit judgmental as she overestimated Ladybug and Cat Noir. Jessica is also quite reasonable and acceptable when needing help from others.
As Sparrow, she hates being bored and sitting around when she's assigned boring missions. She envies Ladybug and Cat Noir because they have more freedom and they can act whenever they want and don't need permission to engage in battle; they're independent and effective. She strives to achieve her goals to prove that she's valuable in the fight against their enemies.
As Eagle, most of her personality remains the same and Jessica was able to adapt quickly to her new powers.

title: Jessica Keynes
text:
Jessica Keynes - Abilities
As a civilian
Jess is as skilled at playing the guitar as she was able to play the music from Chloé's party. She is also skilled at riding a skateboard.
As Sparrow
Sparrow was physically fit, having enough stamina and skill to keep up with Ladybug and Cat Noir while they were running and to jump from edge to edge down a huge crack in the ground. She also possessed Boomerangs which she could use to throw at her enemies and was able to fly with a wingpack.
As Eagle
When transformed into Eagle, Jess possesses enhanced strength, speed and agility. She is also given the power to use Liberation, which allows her to either free a person from their self-imposed limitations (being them mental or emotional). She can also nullify its effect. As seen in "Re-creation" Jess can use her miraculous power multiple times without de-transforming.
She also possesses a bullroarer as her special weapon.

title: Jessica Keynes
text:
Jessica Keynes - Trivia
Prior to her debut in "Miraculous New York", Sparrow was originally part of the first conception of the Quantic Kids, a team of teenage superheroes composed of Ladybug, Cat Noir, Mercury, and Melodie. Sparrow was replaced with Kid Mime by producers in a later stage of production. However, the entire concept was ultimately discarded.
Thomas Astruc commented on Twitter that Sparrow was his favorite superhero created for Quantic Kids, and he considered Kid Mime to be a weak replacement for him.
As the character was referred to with masculine pronouns at the time, it can be assumed that this was a different version of Sparrow.
In concept art, it appears that Sparrow throws a kind of dart/weapon. The way she held her left arm back and had her index and middle finger positioned is like how archers hold back a bowstring.
In European falconry, a 'Jess' is a leather cord used to bind a bird of prey's talons to its handler's glove whist being carried.
Her surname may be a reference to John Maynard Keynes, who wrote a book using the term "animal spirits" to describe the instincts, proclivities, and emotions that influence and guide human behavior.

title: Jessica Keynes
text:
Jessica Keynes - Trivia
As revealed in "Miraculous New York", the current Knightowl and Sparrow are legacy superheroes, as the original versions of them (a father and son team) were long gone before the events of the series and many generations had passed since then.
Just as Knightowl was based off of Batman, Jessica's alter ego Sparrow shares some similarities with The Dark Knight's partner Robin (Dick Grayson).
Both were partners of the main heroes.
They both started out as a sidekick/partner before changing into their independent heroes, Robin to Nightwing, Sparrow to Eagle.
Jessica's alter ego Sparrow is also somewhat similar to Falcon from the Marvel Cinematic Universe.
Both possess backpacks with wings that allow them to fly.
She is the second known female to wield the Eagle Miraculous following Ying.
She is the third known person (country wise in US) of North American origins to wield a Miraculous following Gilbert, Colt and preceding Zoé Lee.
Continent wise she is actually the sixth person of North America to wield a Miraculous following Micazoyolin, Gilbert, La Mariquita, Colt Fathom, Alya and Zoé Lee.

In "Miraculous Tokyo", Eagle is shown seemingly being able to fly, but it's unclear whether she's using the Space power-up or has achieved that some other way, like technology from the United Heroez.

title: Jalil Kubdel
text:
Jalil Kubdel - Intro
is a minor character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He is a young historian and Alix Kubdel's older brother.
In "The Pharaoh", after his theories about an ancient Egyptian scroll were disregarded by his father, Jalil was akumatized by Hawk Moth and became the Pharaoh, a supervillain with the powers of each ancient Egyptian god.
In "Reunion", when Jalil was upset over Alix's absence and resentful with Ladybug and Cat Noir for being the reason why his sister was away, while being determined to bring Alix back to the present, he summoned Monarch to reakumatize him into the Pharaoh and received the Turtle Miraculous superpower through his Alliance ring.

title: Jalil Kubdel
text:
Jalil Kubdel - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Jalil is a tall young man with chin-length moderate tangelo hair and brilliant phthalo blue eyes.
From season 6 onwards, he ties his hair with an orange hairband.
Civilian Attire
He wears glasses, an orange scarf, a scarab pendant, a white shirt with a golden Eye of Horus on it, a grayish-green jacket, light yellowish gray jeans and sandals.
As Pharaoh
Pharaoh was tall and muscular, his pupil-less eyes glowed pale, light grayish cyan and his skin was rose-ish black, like the ancient dioritic statues of the pharaohs. He wore golden bands on his wrists, ankles and biceps, a golden mask (which resembles Tutankhamun's funerary mask) with a nemes, a fake beard and a cobra on the top, a golden shendyt (a kilt-like garment) and two necklaces. One necklace had three lines of beads (alternating light blue and white) connected by golden pieces. The second necklace was his old scarab pendant that considerably changed after getting akumatized: it became light blue, flat and winged and had a sun disk above its head.

title: Jalil Kubdel
text:
Jalil Kubdel - Appearance
When the Pharaoh used the power of a god, his face became the one of the god's sacred animal or appearances: when using the power of Thoth he got a dog ape face, for Sekhmet a lioness, for Anubis a jackal, for Horus a hawk, and for Maat a woman.

title: Jalil Kubdel
text:
Jalil Kubdel - Personality
Jalil is very passionate about his job: he is able to translate an ancient papyrus by himself and wants to perform the spell that is written on it. According to Marinette Dupain-Cheng, he jumps straight to conclusions, just like Alya Césaire. He is also willing to take the scepter from the exhibition to prove it, despite the spell being a theory and his father's job being at stake if he touches it.
Another example of his tendency to jump straight to conclusions is when he got convinced by the haters of social media that Ladybug and Cat Noir are the real villains, while Monarch is a misunderstood hero that is just trying to do good by taking their Miraculous, all because he resents the heroes for being the reason why his sister had to be away from the present. This caused him to willingly ally himself with Monarch to get the Ladybug and Cat Miraculous and have them to bring Alix to the present.
He's also a bit clumsy, as shown when he runs to the exhibition and bumps into Marinette and Alya, dropping everything he's holding in the process.

title: Jalil Kubdel
text:
Jalil Kubdel - Personality
As Pharaoh, he seemed to believe that he was the ancient pharaoh Tutankhamun, and he tried at all costs to perform the ancient resurrection ritual for his wife Nefertiti: he was even willing to transform a hundred people into mummies and to sacrifice Alya to Ra.
During his second akumatization as Pharaoh, he was determined to force Ladybug and Cat Noir to bring Alix back to the present using the power of Maat, that asked people trivial questions. By having the heroes being asked a question about any event in the past or future, they would eventually need Bunnyx's help and she would need to come to the present. However, his anger towards the heroes and obsession in bringing his sister back caused Pharaoh to miss the most obvious way to get the truth by simply asking his book that had the power of Maat.

title: Jalil Kubdel
text:
Jalil Kubdel - Abilities
As a Civilian
Jalil is able to translate ancient Egyptian hieroglyphs and knows a great deal about Egyptian history.
As Pharaoh
As Pharaoh, he got supernatural strength, the power of telekinesis and the ability to perform an ancient resurrection ritual, which consisted of using 100 mummies and a pure soul as a sacrifice to please the sun god Ra, who would then bring Nefertiti back from the dead. The ritual required Tutankhamun's scepter to shoot a ray towards a pyramid (like the one at the Louvre), which would then direct it towards the sky creating a black cloud, where the human sacrifice was supposed to go.
He was also able to use the power of an ancient Egyptian god at choice by saying their name and then asking that god for their power:
Thoth, the god of knowledge, gave him the power to create time-slowing bubbles that trapped people. This may have been due to the fact that Thoth is also the god of time measurement, and he once won 5 days gambling with Khonsu, the Moon, making the year of 365 days instead of 360.

title: Jalil Kubdel
text:
Jalil Kubdel - Abilities
Sekhmet, the goddess of fire, war, dance, love, the desert wind and medicine, gave him even more strength, making him able to create powerful shockwaves only by clapping his hands and casually bends metal bars. This power may come from Sekhmet's name: "sekhem", in ancient Egyptian, means "power or might", so Sekhmet's name means "the (one who is) powerful".
Anubis, the god of funerary rituals and (in more ancient depictions) death itself, gave him the power to shoot rays from his eyes that turned people into undead mummies under his control.
Horus, the god of the sky and kingship, gave him the power to fly.
Maat, the goddess of truth, allowed him to transfer his power to a living book that would ask trivia questions, being them questions from the past or the future, and imprisoned those who answered incorrectly. The book could also answer with the truth to any question done to it.
In "Reunion", Pharaoh received from Monarch the power of Shell-ter, the superpower of the Turtle Miraculous, through his Alliance ring. With it, he could use the Turtle Miraculous shield to conjure protective barriers that were nearly invulnerable, save for Cat Noir's Cataclysm.

title: Jalil Kubdel
text:
Jalil Kubdel - Relationships
Family
Alim Kubdel
Jalil usually respects his father, but sometimes he doesn't when he is overconfident in his own theories, even to the point of willing to risk his father's job to prove them. At times, he has a hard time trusting his father. He believed his father was lying about Alix willingly traveling through time to protect the Rabbit Miraculous.
Alix Kubdel
It is heavily implied that Jalil cares about his sister, because in "Reunion", he missed her dearly and was determined to get her back as he was reakumatized into the Pharaoh. But without knowing it, he put his sister in terrible danger as he fell into Monarch's trap. And upon discovering the truth about his sister, he rejected the villain's influence.

title: Jalil Kubdel
text:
Jalil Kubdel - Trivia
In the original French language, the pharaoh the akumatized villain based himself on is Akhenaten, a genuine Egyptian pharaoh. This is perhaps ironic, as Akhenaten is remembered as the ruler who attempted to overthrow worship in the old gods and install a sun cult religion in Egypt, yet the Pharaoh actively called on those same ancient pantheon gods, not Akhenaten's "Aten" sun disk god.
Akhenaten is also the father of history's famous boy-king Tutankhamun, also known as King Tut.
Although Jalil is the older sibling, Jalil's father gave the family heirloom watch to Alix instead of him.
In the French version, Alim Kubdel says that the youngest child on his/her fifteen birthday inherits the watch.
According to Thomas Astruc, Alim didn't give it to him, since he knows that Jalil is too much "in his own world".
However, it's also possible Alim gave it to Alix due to knowing that was the Rabbit Miraculous and Alix was fated to become its holder.
In "Evolution", that is confirmed, as Bunnyx had informed her father in the past about what would happen in order to prepare him for the day she would be chosen.

title: Jalil Kubdel
text:
Jalil Kubdel - Trivia
Despite the fact that the series states that Nefertiti was Tutankhamen's wife, she was actually one of his father Akhenaten's wives.
In the original French version, the mentioned pharaoh is not Tutankhamen, but rather is father, Akhenaten, whose queen was in fact Nefertiti.
In the Korean version of the show, Pharaoh tried instead to resurrect Ankhesenamun, Tutankhamun's half-sister and wife. However, this is still historically inaccurate because Tutankhamun died before Ankhesenamun.
Even though Thoth is represented as a baboon when he uses his power, Thoth was more commonly depicted as an Ibis in Egyptian mythology, although some Egyptians did believe he was a baboon too.
In "Gamer 2.0", Pharaoh returns as a playable akumatized villain as part of the Gamer 2.0's powers.
As revealed in a tweet by Thomas Astruc, Jalil is a college/university student.
According to "Party Crasher", it appears that Jalil plays a djembe drum, a goblet drum from West Africa.
This is most likely a reference to the fact that he and his family are supposed to be of Amazigh (Berber) origin.

title: Jalil Kubdel
text:
Jalil Kubdel - Trivia
Jalil is the sixth person to voluntarily akumatize themselves following Gabriel Agreste, Nathalie Sancoeur, Lila Rossi, Chloé Bourgeois, and Tomoe Tsurugi.
However, he's the only one not to side with the villains either before or after the akumatization.
In "The Dark Castle", Jalil is shown attending the Collège Françoise Dupont. However, despite the fact the school is now equipped to teach students from a very wide range of eductional levels, due to his age and the fact he is a student of higher education, it's unknown if he goes there as a student or as part of the staff (like a teacher or an assistant).
Jalil is the fifth character to reject akumatization after being fully akumatized, doing so in "Reunion". The previous ones were Alya Césaire in "Gang of Secrets", Nino Lahiffe in "Rocketear", Sabine Cheng in "Qilin", and Chloé Bourgeois in "Penalteam".
Due to Jalil's akumatizaton being consensual, it might explain how he was able to break off his link with Monarch more easily, as he realized he lied to him.

title: Jardins du Trocadéro
text:
Jardins du Trocadéro - Intro
The  (Trocadero Gardens) are an open space in Paris, located in the 16th arrondissement of Paris, bordered to the northwest by the wings of the Palais de Chaillot and to the southeast by the Seine and the Pont d'Iéna. The Eiffel Tower is located directly across the Seine.

title: Jardins du Trocadéro
text:
Jardins du Trocadéro - Description
Laid out for the 1937 Universal Exhibition under the Palais de Chaillot, the Jardins du Trocadéro cover an area of ​​93,930 m2.
They consist of several islands of greenery including many trees, sculptures, winding paths, small waterfalls and bridges, separated by motorized opedestrian traffic lanes.
In the center of the gardens, just down the steps from the Parvis des droits de l'homme and in the axis of the Eiffel Tower, we find the Fontaine du Trocadéro of monumental architecture.
In one part of the garden there is a carousel.

title: Jardins du Trocadéro
text:
Jardins du Trocadéro - Trivia
The gardens are home to the Paris Aquarium, which notably held an exhibition featuring the characters from "Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir" from July 7 to September 1, 2019;
In the series, the Jardins du Trocadéro have been important on several occasions:
In "Timebreaker", it is in the Jardins du Trocadéro where the eponymous villain stole the energy of civilians and her friends, including Alya and Ivan, so she could go back in time to prevent the damage to her watch that her father had given her for her 15th birthday.
In "Gigantitan", it is in the Jardins du Trocadéro where part of the fight between Ladybug and Cat Noir against the eponymous villain took place.
In "Mayura", the Jardins du Trocadéro were the place where Ladybug, Cat Noir, Rena Rouge, Carapace and Queen Bee had fought against Scarlet Moth's Scarlet Army, before Ladybug and Cat Noir escaped into the sewers.
In "Chameleon", the eponymous villain tried to kiss Ladybug by taking the form of a small child, but ended up kissing Cat Noir instead.
In "Miracle Queen", it is in the Jardins du Trocadéro where Dragon Bug and Snake Noir fought against the eponymous villain and the superheroes she was mind-controlling.

title: Jardins du Trocadéro
text:
Jardins du Trocadéro - Trivia
In "Hack-San", it is in the Jardins du Trocadéro where part of Miss Bustier's class met to spend a quiet afternoon together and where Markov was later infected by a sentimonster virus.
In "Ephemeral", Ladybug and Cat Noir discussed in front of the Jardins du Trocadéro how to fix the time distortions caused by Sass' Second Chance before using the space potions to fly into space and fix time via the UTC Sync Satellite.
In "Strikeback" and "Evolution", the Parisians gathered in the Jardins du Trocadéro to support Ladybug after Monarch stole the Miraculouses contained in her yo-yo thanks to the betrayal of Flairmidable.

title: Jeanne d'Arc
text:
Jeanne d'Arc - Intro
, also known as Joan of Arc, (January 6, 1412 - Unknown) was a French warrior who lived approximately 600 years ago (at the present day of the show). She helped to put Charles VII on the French throne during the Hundred Years' War. She was a past Miraculous holder, wielding the Ladybug Miraculous and transforming into Scarlet Fate, a ladybug-themed superhero, when Tikki inhabited the earrings.
She was given her Miraculous as a means to restore the balance of power, when the English knight who wielded the Cat Miraculous, Dark Grimalkin, was sent by his nations regent to subjugate France. They clashed many times, but eventually they fell in love, much to the displeasure of the cruel monarchs they served. After Jeanne escaped her public execution, she and Dark Grimalkin both renounced their Miraculouses and left everything behind to be together.

title: Jeanne d'Arc
text:
Jeanne d'Arc - Intro
In "Ephemeral", after Sass uses Second Chance to go back in time and prevent Shadow Moth from using the Ultimate Miraculous Absolute Power, it causes temporal anomalies which included living or non-living things from the past to appear in the present. Jeanne d'Arc was one of those anomalies, where she appears for a few seconds at the top of the Eiffel Tower, meeting the current holder of her Miraculous, before returning back to her time.
In "Reunion", through the use of the kwagatama, Marinette is able to establish contact with the memory of Jeanne d'Arc, who tells her about her love story with the Cat Miraculous holder of her time, Dark Grimalkin.

title: Jeanne d'Arc
text:
Jeanne d'Arc - Appearance
Physical appearance
Jeanne has white skin with scars over her right and left eyes, a cross scar on right cheek and the right side of her upper lip. She has dark brown hair in a pixie cut and dark green eyes.
Civilian attire
From a painting of Jeanne's memories during her execution, she wore a white tunic long sleeve shirt and dress.
As Scarlet Fate
She wore silver armor with a ladybug-print tunic over the chain mail. She also wore the Ladybug Miraculous, which she used to transform.

title: Jeanne d'Arc
text:
Jeanne d'Arc - Personality
Jeanne's most obvious trait is her great confidence and courage. Tikki describes her as being "hot tempered", what is well-fitting as Jeanne has an avid passion for battle and has a tendency to attack first and ask questions later. Unlike the current Ladybug Miraculous holder, Marinette Dupain-Cheng, who is a thinker, Jeanne was a fighter.
She also bears the status of her holder legacy with honor and pride and expect her successors to do the same. After her memory is explained the reason why Marinette called for a reunion with her, Jeanne's memory becomes very upset with that, finding it insulting that one holder of her Miraculous would call for a reunion with a past holder just to ask trivial questions, demanding Marinette to cease the reunion immediately. But due to her memory being limited to her time as a past holder it could be implied that maybe she was sensitive about it as it hurt her that she couldn't remember.

title: Jeanne d'Arc
text:
Jeanne d'Arc - Personality
However, despite her hot-tempered demeanor, Jeanne had a great sense of morality and sacrifice, being willing to sacrifice herself to protect the innocent, especially those caught in the crossfire of her battles. It was this traits that allowed Dark Grimalkin, her own adversary in the war, to fall in love with her and she with him. Their love was so strong they were willing to abdicate their own Miraculous just so they would be together.

title: Jeanne d'Arc
text:
Jeanne d'Arc - Abilities
As a civilian
Since she is seen with a sword, it's likely that she was trained on how to fight with it.
As Scarlet Fate
If Scarlet Fate had the same powers as the current Ladybug, she had enhanced abilities and the superpowers Lucky Charm and Miraculous Scarlet Fate. She also had a yo-yo.

title: Jeanne d'Arc
text:
Jeanne d'Arc - Relationships
Tikki
Despite her being hot tempered, Jeanne got along well with Tikki to the point where their friendship got so strong that she received a kwagatama from her and upon being reunited with her in spirit memory form she affectionately called her vile little gargoyle.
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/Ladybug
Upon meeting her successor, Jeanne hoped she called a reunion in needing her help with fighting a dragon or a war but upon hearing she was summoned for love advice Jeanne was furious with Marinette and refused to talk to her any further wanting the reunion to end. However her opinion about her successor began to change when she saw Marinette in action as Ladybug as she had no problem in embarking her knowledge and coming face to face with The Pharaoh this is where she realizes the difference between them finding that her current successor likes to think and use reason. Seeing that saved it her successor's black cat and vanquished the villain Jeanne praised Marinette for a job well done and finally told Marinette her love-story.

title: Jeanne d'Arc
text:
Jeanne d'Arc - Relationships
Of how she came across her black cat Dark Grimalkin while on opposite sides of the Hundred Years War. title: Jeanne d'Arc
text:
Jeanne d'Arc - Relationships

title: Jeanne d'Arc
text:
Jeanne d'Arc - Trivia
Thomas Astruc drew Jeanne d'Arc in an image created for a fan-made charity magazine. She appears in the image with Hippolyta, Mudekudeku, and current Ladybug.
The way Thomas depicts her hair is different from how historians agree her hair was. Most historians credit the bob hairstyle to Jeanne.
The way Thomas depicts her hair may differ in style, but it should be noted that this is one of the few depictions of her in fiction with a more accurate hair color. Reputable sources state that her hair was black, or at least dark, not blonde.
She is the first known person of French origin to wield the Ladybug Miraculous, preceding her successors Aramis and Marinette becoming the first of Paris' superheroes.
She is the first past Ladybug Miraculous holder to have any known family preceding her successor Mudangbeolle.
In the French dub, Jeanne d'Arc's supperhero name is Parque Écarlate, which is French for "Scarlet Fate".
In the Spanish dub, her superhero name is Suerte Escarlata, which is Spanish for "Scarlet Luck".
In the European Portuguese dub, her superhero name is Morte Escarlate, which is Portuguese for "Scarlet Death".

title: Jeanne d'Arc
text:
Jeanne d'Arc - Trivia
The image of her slaying a dragon is a modified version of a stained glass window depicting Saint George slaying a dragon, located in St. George's Hall in Liverpool, England.
Since dragons were once real in the Quantic Universe, the painting could imply that this happened before or after Plagg used his powers to make the rest of them go extinct, meaning that these creatures were around until the 15th century or after.
With him using his powers during that time it's likely Plagg was active with an owner and in "Reunion", it's revealed that Jeanne knew Plagg's holder at that time as Dark Grimalkin.
She is the first Ladybug Miraculous holder from a distant past that Ladybug meets personally.
She is also the first Ladybug Miraculous holder whose memory was accessed by Ladybug with her kwagatama.
Out of all the past ladybugs she made the second most appearances including pictures or photos being succeeded by Khepri.
It's revealed in "Reunion" that, unlike her real world counterpart, Jeanne d'Arc managed to escape the stake and went to live her love with Dark Grimalkin after they renounced their Miraculous.

Jeanne d'Arc - Trivia
Jeanne d'Arc was said to hear voices and have visions, signs interpreted as being from God. In the Miraculous universe, these were possibly due to when she was brought to modern Paris by Sass' Second Chance or when she went to reunite with past holders of her Miraculous, as only the holder and respective kwami can see and hear them.

title: Jardin des Tuileries
text:
Jardin des Tuileries - Intro
(literally "Tuileries Garden" in English) is a public garden located between the Louvre Museum and the Place de la Concorde in the 1st arrondissement of Paris. Created by Catherine de' Medici as the garden of the Tuileries Palace in 1564, it was eventually opened to the public in 1667 and became a public park after the French Revolution. In the 19th and 20th centuries, it was a place where Parisians celebrated, met, strolled, and relaxed.

title: Jardin des Tuileries
text:
Jardin des Tuileries - Description
The Jardin des Tuileries is a huge rectangular park of over 25 hectares. It has many wide avenues lined with elms, lime trees and two white mulberry trees.
The garden has many ponds. The two main ones, the large round pond to the east and the octagonal pond to the west, are surrounded by chairs to allow visitors to sit near them.
The layout of the park creates small spaces separated from the others. In these there are statues, Exèdre ponds, restaurants, a children's playground, but also a carousel.
Finally, at the western ends of the garden, there are two museums with similar architecture:
To the northwest, the Jeu de Paume, an exhibition museum of contemporary art.
To the southwest, the Musée de l'Orangerie, museums of impressionist and post-impressionist paintings.
From the central nave, one can have a perspective view of the Arc de Triomphe du Carrousel and the Louvre Palace to the east, or of the Place de la Concorde and its Obélisque de Louxor, but also the Roue de Paris, to the west.
Statues
The Tuileries Garden has many statues distributed in various places. The following statues are visible in the series:

title: Jardin des Tuileries
text:
Jardin des Tuileries - Description
At the entrance to the Place de la Concorde, we find the group of statues La Renommée astride Pegasus and Mercury astride Pegasus by Antoine Coysevox.
Around the octagonal basin, we find Pomone and Vertumne by François Barois, Cérès ou l'Été by Guillaume I Coustou, L'hiver by Jean-Melchio Raon and Véturie by Pierre II Legros.

title: Jardin des Tuileries
text:
Jardin des Tuileries - Trivia
The Jardin des Tuileries has been classified as a Historic Monument since 1914.
It has also been classified as a natural site since 1975.
It is also part of the UNESCO World Heritage Site under the title "Berges de Seine".
Every summer, on the Rue de Rivoli side, the garden hosts the Tuileries Festival on the Esplanade des Feuillants, a funfair that allows visitors to enjoy sixty rides without sound.
Since 2018, the Christmas market in Paris, Magic of Christmas at the Tuileries, has taken place on the Esplanade des Feuillants, mixing stalls selling objects and rides.
The Jardin des Tuileries seems to be the favorite training ground for Kagami and her mother. They are seen there during the episodes "Oni-Chan", "Ikari Gozen", "Lies", "Mr. Pigeon 72", "Protection" and "Emotion".
It is also in this garden that Kagami and Lila had friendly encounters.
In the series, the Jardin des Tuileries has been important on several occasions:
In "Backwarder", the eponymous villain briefly fought Ladybug and Cat Noir in the garden before being defeated by the duo.

title: Jean-Pierre Monlataing
text:
Jean-Pierre Monlataing - Intro
is a minor character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He is an art professor who works at Collège Françoise Dupont.

title: Jean-Pierre Monlataing
text:
Jean-Pierre Monlataing - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Jean-Pierre is a tall man with fair skin and grayish green eyes. He has short, puffy gray hair he keeps swept back from his forehead.
From season 6 onwards, he has more disheveled curly hair and massive gray eyebrows.
Civilian Attire
Jean-Pierre wears a very dark cornflower blue vest over a white long-sleeved shirt that is stained with paint. He also sports a brown belt, with dark brown pants and a pair of dark boots.
From season 6 onwards, the buttons on his shirt become white. There are water spots on his pants, and Jean-Pierre wears a large gray watch on his left hand.

title: Jean-Pierre Monlataing
text:
Jean-Pierre Monlataing - Personality
Jean-Pierre is quite relaxed and calm, encouraging students to develop their artistic skills by inviting them to come to his classroom whenever they want to work on art projects. However, he stands firm when he notices someone being negative, such as when Chloé Bourgeois mocks Nathaniel Kurtzberg's drawings of Ladybug. He responds to this by telling her that she is welcome to work on her art project, but nothing other than that. He is nevertheless sad when Chloé leaves when it seemed that she had a project to present until Alix accurately guessed her project was another collage of selfies.
When under Reverser's influence, he led the students in destroying art and music.

title: Jean-Pierre Monlataing
text:
Jean-Pierre Monlataing - Etymology
Jean's full name might be a reference to the French expression J'en perds mon latin ("I'm losing my Latin over it"), which means "this completely baffles me"; an equivalent English expression would be "It's all Greek to me".

title: Jean-Pierre Monlataing
text:
Jean-Pierre Monlataing - Trivia
He is based on Thomas Astruc's former teacher named Jean-Pierre.
So far, he is the only employee seen on screen at the Collège Françoise Dupont who has not yet been akumatized.

title: Jardins des Champs-Élysées
text:
Jardins des Champs-Élysées - Intro
The  are a set of green spaces in the city of Paris located in the 8th Arrondissement.

title: Jardins des Champs-Élysées
text:
Jardins des Champs-Élysées - Description
Located in a large area west of Place de la Concorde and inspired by English gardens, the Jardins des Champs-Élysées mark the beginning of the Avenue des Champs-Élysées up to the Rond -Point des Champs-Élysées.
These are divided into several "squares" 300 to 400 meters wide and rectangular:
North of the Champs-Élysées we find the Carré des Ambassadeurs, the Carré de l'Élysée and the Carré Marigny.
South of the "most beautiful avenue in the world", we find the Carré Ledoyen, the Grand Carré du Battoir and the Carré du Rond-Point.
Inside its squares there are numerous fountains, statues and cultural buildings.
Furthermore, the Grand Palais, the Petit Palais and the gardens surrounding them (Square Perrin, Jardin de la Nouvelle-France and the gardens around the Petit Palais) are included in the Jardins des Champs-Élysées.

title: Jardins des Champs-Élysées
text:
Jardins des Champs-Élysées - Trivia
The Carré des Ambassadeurs owes its name to the hotels built on the Place de la Concorde, which were once intended to host foreign ambassadors.
Also, this square is located in front of the US Embassy, separated from it by Avenue Gabriel.
Until 2017, the Jardins des Champs-Élysées hosted a Christmas Market, but by decision of the Paris City Council, it was moved, for reasons of safety and renewal of the type of festivities, to the Jardin des Tuileries, on the Esplanade dei Foglianti.

title: Jean-Pierre Monlataing/History
text:
Jean-Pierre Monlataing/History - Intro
Jean-Pierre Monlataing is an art professor who works at Collège Françoise Dupont.

title: Jean-Pierre Monlataing/History
text:
Jean-Pierre Monlataing/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Reverser", Jean-Pierre discusses with Nathaniel Kurtzberg, in the art classroom, about his drawing of Ladybug and Mightillustrator fighting Queen Wasp at the Louvre. Jean-Pierre tells him he should make a comic book with his concept and that he should team up with a creative writer to do so. Marinette Dupain-Cheng then brings in Marc Anciel and introduces him to Jean-Pierre, who had previously heard of him always writing thanks her.
Jean-Pierre welcomes Marc, telling him he can come here anytime he wants. He also explains to him that anyone can create anything they want here, providing Marc with examples while introducing him to Rose Lavillant, Alix Kubdel, and Nathaniel. Within moments, Chloé Bourgeois and Sabrina Raincomprix arrive, with the first making fun of Nathaniel's drawings of Ladybug. Nathaniel then starts packing up his stuff but is stopped by Jean-Pierre.

title: Jean-Pierre Monlataing/History
text:
Jean-Pierre Monlataing/History - [[Season 2]]
He tells Chloé that he had already told her before that if she had to work on a project she was welcomed to work on it in the art classroom, but if not she needed to leave. Chloé then starts talking about her project but is interrupted by Alix before she says what it is. After an annoyed Chloé leaves with Sabrina, Jean-Pierre tells Alix that, if she did actually a project, it was terrible that they didn't give her a chance to show it. He then tells Marc that Nathaniel is looking for a creative writer to team up with, but he runs away.
Sometime after, Jean-Pierre was seen working in the background as Marinette gave Marc's dairy to Nathaniel. Later on, when Marc is transformed into the titular villain by Hawk Moth and went out looking for Nathaniel and Marinette, Jean-Pierre was in the art classroom with Rose and Juleka Couffaine when he showed up asking for the two students. Ignoring his questions, Jean-Pierre asked if would like to join the class. The villain then reverses him and the other two students who were in room. They all soon started destroying everything in the art classroom.

title: Jean-Pierre Monlataing/History
text:
Jean-Pierre Monlataing/History - [[Season 2]]
After the villain is defeated and Ladybug does her Miraculous Ladybug, Jean-Pierre was turned back to normal. The next day in the art classroom, Jean-Pierre reads Nathaniel and Marc's comic book, telling them they did a good job. The boys then tell everyone they dedicated the comic book to Marinette, saying she'd make a great hero "if she wasn't such a klutz". Jean-Pierre, along with everyone else in the room, soon laughed.

title: Jean-Pierre Monlataing/History
text:
Jean-Pierre Monlataing/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Gang of Secrets", Jean-Pierre talked to Chloé and Sabrina in the art classroom when Princess Fragrance and Reflekta come in. They ask if anyone had seen Marinette, with everyone shaking their heads signaling them that they hadn't. The two villains then used their powers on them, turning Jean-Pierre and everyone else into obedient clones of Reflekta. Later, after the villains are defeated and Ladybug does her Miraculous Ladybug, Jean-Pierre was returned back to normal, along with everyone else.
In "Queen Banana", Jean-Pierre starts an initiative with Thomas Astruc to make a student film called Kreatika funded by the city of Paris. He was seen on the TVi broadcast talking to Mayor André Bourgeois and overseeing various students, such as Nathaniel, Nino Lahiffe, Lê Chiến Kim, and Max Kanté, in the art classroom. Later, Jean-Pierre watched as Zoé Lee and Mylène Haprèle rehearsed a scene for the movie when Chloé and Sabrina arrived complaining about the whole student film.

title: Jean-Pierre Monlataing/History
text:
Jean-Pierre Monlataing/History - [[Season 4]]
Jean-Pierre tries to remind Chloé that she was also offered the chance to participate in the student film, but she refused. He then pulled out a notebook, with all the reasons Chloé didn't want to be apart the student film, which were all written down when Chloé had stated them before. Jean-Pierre reads "Mylène's sweater is too ugly, Nate draws like a 2-year-old, Alya is useless and Marinette is ridiculous, utterly ridiculous", to which Chloé ask if she actually said that. Jean-Pierre tells her that she did but less politely. Chloé then said she still meant all of it before she demanded Zoé's role in the student film and leaving.
The next day, when Jean-Pierre and everyone else go to producer Bob's office, they are shocked to see Chloé sitting in Bob's chair. This is because André has convinced Bob to give Chloé a major role in the student film in order for her to take part in it by making Zoé take on another role that is off-screen. The next morning, Jean-Pierre oversaw the work being done by his students on the set of the student film at Jardin des Tuileries. There he took part in all the revisions made to the story in order to satisfy Chloé and her wishes.

title: Jean-Pierre Monlataing/History
text:
Jean-Pierre Monlataing/History - [[Season 4]]
After Chloé gets tired of everyone and leaves, Marinette persuades everyone to film the movie with their original script. The next day, Jean-Pierre goes to Le Sorbonne for the screening of Kreatika, which everyone had finished filming the day before. Everyone adored the student film and applaud in joy when credits are rolled. Soon, Chloé arrives and is furious with everyone as Gabriel Agreste had decided to personally fund this version of the student film himself, instead of depending on a funds from the city (which was why she could force her influence on it).
When Chloé is transformed into the titular villain and is given Banana Boom-Boom by Shadow Moth, she tears of the roof of Le Sorbonne looking for Zoé and turns everyone in the theater into bananas, including Jean-Pierre. After she is defeated and Ladybug does her Miraculous Ladybug, Jean-Pierre was returned back to normal, along with everyone else who was turned into a banana.

title: Jean-Pierre Monlataing/History
text:
Jean-Pierre Monlataing/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Perfection", when Nathaniel and Marc have Marinette and Adrien Agreste set up under the guise of helping them with their story in the art classroom, Jean-Pierre was seen reading sheet music with Rose, Juleka, and Nino. He then looks at the couple as Marinette attempts to hold Adrien's hand but accidentally destroys part of the set.
In "Confrontation", Jean-Pierre takes part in the teachers conference to decide the fate of Caline Bustier's students. Class representative, Lila Rossi shocks the teachers with the students' files, which were all, unbeknownst to them, forged by Sabrina. Later, outside of the temporary girls restroom, Jean-Pierre watched in shock as Lila was exposed for all her lies thanks to Sabrina and Marinette. Sometime after when Denis Damoclès get fired from being Collège Françoise Dupont's principal, Jean-Pierre is among everyone who cheers him on as he exits the building.

title: Jean-Pierre Monlataing/History
text:
Jean-Pierre Monlataing/History - [[Season 6]]
In "El Toro De Piedra", he was in the audience during Caline Bustier's homage and Juleka Couffaine's show.
In "The Ruler", in the art room, Jean watched as the printer released the color proof of the comic Sun-Heart and Rain-Piercer. He saw Marc and Nathaniel get excited upon seeing the colors of the test. When he noticed that everything had gone as planned, Jean said that they could start the final printing. Later, he saw Marinette asking to keep the proofs and both authors sign them, Jean placed the finished comics on the table and announced that the comic would be distributed everywhere.

title: Jean Tretiens/History
text:
Jean Tretiens/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Gorizilla", while working at the Place des Vosges, Jean notices Adrien Agreste and Marinette Dupain-Cheng in the fountain. He then took a picture of the two teenagers and posted it online, with the caption stating "Adrien and his girlfriend in the fountain." This post was viewed by people such as Gabriel Agreste, Wayhem, Mrs. Rossi, Alya Césaire, and Placide I.T..
In "Sapotis", Jean is seen dumping a garbage can into the back of a garbage truck at night. When he does this, to his surprise, Jean finds numerous clones of the titular villains inside the garbage can, scaring him.
In "Sandboy", the titular villain brings Jean's greatest fear to life, which is shown to be garbage cans coming to life. He was seen on streets running from these living inanimate objects.

title: Jean Tretiens/History
text:
Jean Tretiens/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Feast", Jean was seen in his truck driving through the streets before he got out it and ran away, after almost crashing into the titular villain, whom was chasing Wang Fu.
In "Party Crasher", Jean is asked by Roger Raincomprix to come by the Agreste mansion with his leaf blower for Adrien's impromptu party. He then turns on his leaf blower as Max Kanté dumps a bucket of confetti in front of it, causing it to fly everywhere. Soon, Armand D'Argencourt notices Adrien's Stationation record and is intrigued since it reminds him of his youth. André suggests doing the Holiday-a Camp dance, but Fire Captain Hessenpy tells them they can't.
Roger asks him why they can't and Jean tells him there's nothing dangerous in doing the dance. Hessenpy then pointed out that while they do have a fencer, ice cream man, police officer, and fireman, they are missing a mustachio Biker. This makes all of them upset. However, Adrien introduces them to Marino, who had a mustache and a helmet on, causing them all to cheer.

title: Jean Tretiens/History
text:
Jean Tretiens/History - [[Season 3]]
The six of them then began performing the Holiday-a Camp dance, with the Stationation record playing in the background, for all the party guests. However, they were forced to stop when Marino fell down after doing a spin, revealing to everyone that he was actually Marinette in disguise. After the titular villain arrives, Jean is captured by him and trapped in his disco ball hands offscreen. Later when King Monkey uses his Uproar on the villain and messes up his powers, Jean and everyone else that the villain captured is freed. After this, Jean and everyone who was not a Miraculous holder fled the scene.

title: Jean Tretiens/History
text:
Jean Tretiens/History - [[Miraculous New York]]
Jean is sent by Mayor André Bourgeois to clean up all the damages made by Robostus through Paris. This happened because Ladybug and Cat Noir weren't present in Paris, as they were in New York, to go up against Robostus or fixed all the damages he caused.

title: Jean Tretiens/History
text:
Jean Tretiens/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Glaciator 2", Jean reading was seen reading a magazine at the Place des Vosges, featuring an article on how Ladybug and Cat Noir were voted "Couple of the Year". The actual two heroes then arrived and started shielding Jean from the titular villain's ice cream blasts. Before noticing what was going on behind him, Jean remarks that love is great, which annoys Ladybug, who asks what is up with people these days and says they are not in love.
Jean soon went up to Cat Noir and asked him for an autograph. The hero takes the magazine he was reading and learns that he and Ladybug have been voted "Couple of the Year", much to Ladybug's fury. Jean then continued to watch as the villain declared that this is proof that his ice cream never lies and that the two heroes are made for each other, which infuriates Ladybug once more and explains that the photos taken are out of context. The villain then fires more ice cream blasts at them, with Cat Noir pushing Jean out of the way.
In "Simpleman", Jean is simplified by the titular villain, causing him to start throwing whole garbage cans into the back of a garbage truck as it is much simpler than dumping the trash in.

title: Jean Tretiens/History
text:
Jean Tretiens/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Dearest Family", on Three Kings Day, Jean stand in line to buy a galette outside of Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie, waiting for them to open. After they opened, Marinette came out and gave samples of the galette to customers, including Jean, making him amazed at its taste.
In "Kuro Neko", while mowing the grass at the Stade des Princes, Jean was asked by Ladybug to put all the grass he had mowed into her lucky charm. After he did this and the titular villain showed up, Jean fled the scene by driving away in his truck while screaming in fear.
In "Risk", Jean was marked by the titular villain, forcing him to take risks, as he was getting onto a garbage truck.

title: Jean Tretiens/History
text:
Jean Tretiens/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Action", Jean is seen in the background removing one of the vending machines for the Morpho Fans and putting it in to a van with another guy. This happened as André was being interviewed by TVi news.

text:
Jardin des Tuileries/Movie - Trivia
The Jardin des Tuileries has been classified as a Historic Monument since 1914.
It has also been classified as a natural site since 1975.
It is also part of the UNESCO World Heritage under the title "Berges de Seine".
In "Ladybug & Cat Noir: The Movie", the Jardin des Tuileries hosted the Luna Park des Tuileries, a summer and winter amusement park.
In fact, and since 2018, this amusement park has hosted the Roue de Paris, previously installed in the Place de la Concorde.

title: Juleka Couffaine
text:
Juleka Couffaine - Intro
is a major character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She is a student at the Collège Françoise Dupont, a former student of Miss Bustier's class (before the latter became mayor of Paris), and the younger twin sister of Luka Couffaine. She is currently in a relationship with Rose Lavillant.
In "Reflekta", after being locked in the restroom by Sabrina Raincomprix under orders from Chloé Bourgeois to prevent Juleka from participating in the class photo, she was akumatized by Hawk Moth and became Reflekta, a flamboyant supervillain who could transform people into lookalikes of herself.
In "Reflekdoll", after Juleka backed out of modeling in the photoshoot for Marinette Dupain-Cheng's design and was not given a chance to explain herself, Hawk Moth re-akumatized her into Reflekta. She was also amokized by Mayura, which caused her frustration and misery to form Reflekdoll, a doll-themed sentimonster that could also transform people into Reflekta lookalikes.

title: Juleka Couffaine
text:
Juleka Couffaine - Intro
In "Félix", after being fooled by the titular character into thinking that Adrien didn't appreciate his friends' kind videos, Juleka was reakumatized into Reflekta yet again alongside Princess Fragrance and Lady Wifi. The three formed the Punishers Trio, a group of akumatized supervillains who wanted to get revenge on the disguised Félix, who later convinced Hawk Moth to let him help them, as he was after some jewelry too.
In "Gang of Secrets", after Marinette kept hiding secrets from her friends, Juleka was reakumatized by Shadow Moth into Reflekta alongside Lady Wifi, Princess Fragrance, Timebreaker and Horrificator. These five supervillains formed the Gang of Secrets, a group of supervillains who wanted to reveal Marinette's secrets.

title: Juleka Couffaine
text:
Juleka Couffaine - Intro
In "Guiltrip", Juleka revealed a secret to the class involving Rose: she has a medical condition, occasionally requiring hospital care because of it. After Rose snapped at the class for being too overprotective, Juleka, racked with guilt, was reakumatized for the fifth time and re-amokized into Reflekta by Shadow Moth, with her guilt and sadness forming Guiltrip, a portal-like sentimonster that made people feel guilty. After being de-akumatized and de-amokized, she received a Magical Charm from Ladybug that prevented her from being re-akumatized or re-amokized.
In "Crocoduel", after her parents were re-akumatized into Captain Hardrock and Guitar Villain who formed the titular akumatized supervillain group, Juleka was lent the Tiger Miraculous from Ladybug. When it's inhabited by Roaar, Juleka becomes Purple Tigress (Tigresse Pourpre in the French version), a tiger-themed superhero with the power of Elation: Clout, which allows the user to perform a powerfully devastating punch.

title: Juleka Couffaine
text:
Juleka Couffaine - Intro
After the events of "Strikeback", Juleka was temporarily unable to become Purple Tigress after Monarch managed to steal the Tiger Miraculous along with all the others contained in the Chinese Miracle Box from Ladybug's yo-yo.
In "Confrontation", when she found out that she would repeat her school year again from her false study options form, Juleka was once again re-akumatized into Reflekta and was given the power of the Tiger Miraculous through her Alliance ring. She also received a new Magical Charm from Ladybug after her first one got destroyed.
In "Re-creation", Juleka was reunited with Luka during the fight against Monarch. After Ladybug recovered the stolen Miraculous and reforged them following Monarch's defeat, Juleka was given back the Tiger Miraculous permanently and reunited with Roaar.
In "Revelator", it's shown that, after getting her Miraculous back, Juleka, along with the other secondary heroes of Ladybug's team, was trained to unlock her adult powers, no longer detransforming after using her power.

title: Juleka Couffaine
text:
Juleka Couffaine - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Juleka is a slender pale-skinned teenage girl who stands at a medium height (albeit slightly taller than most other girls at her school). She has brilliant red eyes with dark eyeshadow and long black hair with dyed purple tips at the end and bangs that covered the left side of her face. In the first five seasons, she wore a very soft magenta lipstick and her fingernails were painted grayish pink with black nail art of intricate patterns on each one with different designs on each hand.
From season 6 onwards, she now has her hair and bangs swept on her left side. Her bangs are more spiked out and a little more out of her left eye with a half shaven undercut on the right dyed light fuchsia, the dyed tips also being light fuchsia, and there being a forelock in front of her left ear. She wears acid green lipstick with matching nails and dark magenta eyeshadow.
Civilian Attire

title: Juleka Couffaine
text:
Juleka Couffaine - Appearance
In the first five seasons, Juleka wore a black turtlenecked, swan-necked tunic with a sea green lined collar and hemline, side pockets, and short black mesh sleeves with a flower pattern with black trimming. She also wore brilliant purple jeans and triangular mesh at the bottom sides with a similar flower pattern with rips above the knees and black high top sneakers with white soles. On her hands, she had black fingerless lace gloves that had a diamond pattern design that right ended halfway up the forearm, while the left was slightly shorter as compared to the right one. On her right hand, she sometimes wore an arctic blue wrist mirror with a royal blue gemstone in the center. On occasion until "Re-creation", she wore her Miraculous on her right hand as the chain, rings and bracelet were black and sported a purple jewel that was attached to all chains.

title: Juleka Couffaine
text:
Juleka Couffaine - Appearance
From season 6 onwards, her tunic is modified to have the mesh extend to her chest, while the torso remains black, this time being trimmed in thick darker black, while the collar is more open and the sleeves gain extra sea green lining, and her fingerless gloves no longer have the wrist mirror. She retains her jeans but they're now cuffed at calf-length with smaller rips closer to the knees and replaces the high tops with black combat boots and matching laces. Her accessories are black rectangular bar earrings and a small round jade pendant necklace with a black string. Her Miraculous is altered to have a brown bracelet that has a small black chain, and the gemstone turns dull pink.
As Purple Tigress
In Seasons 4-5, Purple Tigress wore a strong crimson swan-necked superhero outfit with a pale, light grayish fuchsia front, back of her arms, and palms of her hands and fingers which ended at the middle of her shins, with pale, light grayish fuchsia toe caps resembling paws and golden soles.
The suit had dark cerise lace stripes with gold lining and similar patterns to her lace glove, as they were around her limbs, the toe cap, and on the torso.

title: Juleka Couffaine
text:
Juleka Couffaine - Appearance
The torso stripes were V-shaped with three of them lined vertically on the zip-line.
Her dark cerise collar was outlined in gold with a zipper at the front.
Her right hand, where she wore the Tiger Miraculous, sported a bejeweled black glove with swirling gold lines accented by silver beads in the swirls and on the jagged end of her glove that was lined in gold, and feline-like fingers with golden claws.
She had strong crimson tiger ears with pale, light grayish fuchsia insides, like Cat Noir's, that were in her hair, which turned violet with deep fuchsia highlights, bound in a ponytail.
Her bangs were rounded and split in the middle.
Her eyes were a brilliant orange with light yellow sclerae, with a strong crimson, black bordered mask which bore pale, light grayish fuchsia marks on her eyelids and eyebrows, with a point down toward the nose in the middle.
She also had dark grayish blue-violet lipstick.
At her waist was the bolas, a long whip-like tool with three weighted striped balls at the end, worn like a belt with a gold ring in the center.
From season 6 onwards, her appearance alters significantly.

title: Juleka Couffaine
text:
Juleka Couffaine - Appearance
Her hair covers her left eye again and spikes a little more, with the right side of her bangs curving up.
Her tiger ears gain a black gradation on top.
Her mask is more angular and stretches to the sides of her face, with three black stripes on either side, and a pink gradation in the bottom corners.
She also has black waterlines and the zipper is gold.
Some of the stripes on her suit thicken.
The torso ones now shrink in a gradated manner, with only two smaller ones on the shoulders, the arm ones relocated to the top of the arms, and two thick ones below each elbow pit with another stripe below.
The leg stripes also now come in vertical rows of four, leading down to her now black ankles lined in gold.
Her glove is simplified with multiple charcoal gray straps and the jagged ends are gone, accenting her new short boots that have golden claws to retain the paw resemblance.
Her bolas is now hanging to the ring with three ropes connected to each ball, the ring acting as a buckle to her new black belt with gold spikes, with the emblem of the Tiger Miraculous being engraved on the buckle.

title: Juleka Couffaine
text:
Juleka Couffaine - Appearance
Her fingers on her left hand also fade to black with small claws, the front and back of her arms, along with the palms blur to blend in with the outfit design.
Her Miraculous also alters, with the chains turning into solid crisscross pieces connecting to the gem that loses its paw symbol, and it turns more crystal-like in texture.
As Reflekta
Reflekta's face was pale pink and she had light brilliant rose circle markings around her eyes, along with strong amber colored eyes and moderate purple lipstick.
On the tips of her eyelashes, there were small light green spheres.
Her hair was shiny and brilliant red colored-with light purple stripes, and two twisted ponytails stuck upward on each side of her head.
She had choppy-like side bangs with the rest of her hair out of her face, and at the center of the forehead, there was a white upward almond-shaped eye with a light purple outline and a pink pupil.
She wore a brilliant red colored ruff-like collared dress with light purple chevron stripes around her stomach to waist, and eyes like the one on her hair around her puffed sleeves and skirt.

title: Juleka Couffaine
text:
Juleka Couffaine - Appearance
The tips of the ruff and the skirt had light pink edging, and her arms and legs had brilliant red gloves and stockings.
Her long pale, light grayish sea green fingernails stuck out of the end of her gloves, and on the back of her right hand, she had a pink eye design with a black outline, the center being a black jewel that opened up to reveal a small circular mirror, her akumatized object.
At the bottom of her feet, she had brilliant red rectangular platform dress shoes with triangular wedges and miniature eyes without pupils appearing above the feet that covered her entire feet.

title: Juleka Couffaine
text:
Juleka Couffaine - Personality
Juleka is a shy, introverted, reserved, and nervous girl with a soft voice in the presence of others, but she is very understanding and kind. She doesn't speak as often as the rest of her classmates, and when she does, she responds briefly with a low murmur or shakes her head to indicate agreement or disagreement. She has difficulty expressing her true opinions and feelings, needing the help of others to be able to express herself properly and stand up for herself. Although she is rarely particularly expressive, she enjoys group activities and can join her friends in social situations, enjoying spending time with them (mostly spending time with Rose Lavillant) or joining some of her classmates in group cheers. She is also very talented, being one of the two guitarists in Kitty Section and wanting to become a model someday, with her friends recognize her potential and support her in achieving her goals.

title: Juleka Couffaine
text:
Juleka Couffaine - Personality
She is very sensitive and, as such, tends to break down easily and refuse comfort from her friends, which allows Gabriel Agreste to akumatize her. Juleka feels like no one ever notices her and forgets she is around, as seen in "Reflekta" where, after Chloé Bourgeois and Sabrina Raincomprix exclude her from the school photo, she is so distressed by being left out that she rejects Rose's support and runs to the park to cry after declaring herself invisible. In "Reflekdoll", despite initially being excited, she ends up feeling anxious at the prospect of taking part in a photo shoot that she ends getting replaced from said photo shoot by Marinette Dupain-Cheng, which makes her shoo away everyone else in order to be left alone to cry at her inability to overcome her fear. In "Guiltrip", overwhelmed and unable to hide her concern for Rose's well-being when she is hospitalized, Juleka tells her classmates about Rose's illness, and when this causes everyone to treat her differently, she feels guilty, believing she has ruined everything for Rose.
Juleka also has a deep fear of abandonment and is afraid that her loved ones will leave her.

title: Juleka Couffaine
text:
Juleka Couffaine - Personality
In "Crocoduel", she feels neglected by her father, believing that he loves her brother more than her, a thought that almost leads to her being akumatized.
Although she and Jagged later talk about their problems, realizing that her father loves her, she fears disappointing him, to the point that it's revealed in "Representation" that upsetting him is her greatest fear.
Her fears increased when Luka, whom Juleka felt she could talk to and was someone who understood her, decided to return to Rio de Janeiro despite Monarch's defeat.
In "Vampigami", she felt jealous of the close friendship between Rose and Prem, fearing that her girlfriend would leave her for him, and tried to hide her discomfort at them going to see a vampire movie without her.
Confused about what to do, she calls Luka for advice, but dissatisfied with his words, her anger takes over and she hangs up on him even though Luka tried to calm her down, ending up hitting a pillow over and over in sheer anger, mostly at herself.

title: Juleka Couffaine
text:
Juleka Couffaine - Personality
After Prem's de-akumatization, Juleka confesses to Rose that she fears losing her and apologizes for feeling jealous of her friendship with Prem, with both Rose and Prem assuring her that her fears are unfounded.
Despite her insecurities, she is aware that there are people that care about her, to whom she expresses compassion and gentleness. Juleka can be affectionate with those close to her, being loving and protective of them, even taking attacks from akumatized villains meant for her loved ones, such as Rose in "Truth" and Luka in "Migration." She is also not easily frightened and even seems to like scary things or be unafraid of such, as she is the only student not to fear Horrificator, calling her "awesome", and keeps her from getting akumatized when Hawk Moth tries to terrify the city in "Catalyst". She doesn't hesitate to help and be a source of support for her friends, even if it means putting herself in danger and challenging villains, as seen during the attacks by Darkblade, Befana, Gigantitan, Truth, and Sole Destroyer.

title: Juleka Couffaine
text:
Juleka Couffaine - Personality
In "Crocoduel", thanks to being chosen by Ladybug as the holder of the Tiger Miraculous and the heroine encouraging her not to be afraid to speak up, Juleka gained enough confidence to express her opinions clearly to others, reprimanding her parents for their constant fighting after being de-akumatized, embarrassing them so they would reconcile. After "Confrontation" and from season six onwards, revealing that she has received psychiatric help from Dr. Psiquat due to her speech impediment, Juleka speaks much more clearly and is more open with her feelings. This is further showcased in "El Toro De Piedra", where, encouraged by her friends and kissed by her girlfriend, she performs on her own in front of the whole school an acoustic song she herself wrote.

title: Juleka Couffaine
text:
Juleka Couffaine - Personality
As Purple Tigress, Juleka is more confident, brave, and fierce, speaking normally instead of stuttering as she does in her civilian form. Like a tigress, she is fearless and ferocious, using her powers to uplift and energize those around her. Also, just like in her civilian version, she is very cooperative and gets along well with her teammates. In her first appearance as Purple Tigress, when her parents are akumatized into Guitar Villain and Captain Hardrock respectively, she fights them to de-akumatize them and get them to talk through their problems instead of arguing, working as a team with Ladybug and Cat Noir to save her parents and help them get along better.

title: Juleka Couffaine
text:
Juleka Couffaine - Personality
As Reflekta, she was proud, arrogant, and vengeful because no one ever paid attention to her, she wanted everyone to look like her so that she would never be unnoticed again. In particular, she wanted to transform Chloé because she prevented her from being in the class photo causing her first akumatization. She was quite vain, constantly telling everyone that they'd look better once they ware changed and reassures them that they look amazing once they are. Due to her arrogance, she believed her victims liked their new looks, when they clearly did not. Without a second thought, Reflekta was ruthless, even transforming people who were nice to and noticed her, including Rose.

title: Juleka Couffaine
text:
Juleka Couffaine - Personality
Throughout the series, Juleka kept her akumatized alterego Reflekta, usually going after who or what upsets her. During her second time as Reflekta in "Reflekdoll", she retained her vanity and pride but wanted to get back at her friends for excluding her from the photoshoot even though Marinette pointed that she said she didn't want to be in it, but claimed she didn't let her explain. When her sentimonster went out of control, she panicked and begged for the superheroes' help but didn't show gratitude and tried to transform them afterwards. Then in "Félix", along with Lady Wifi and Princess Fragrance, she wanted revenge on Adrien Agreste for sending an ungrateful message. However, after learning it was his cousin Félix, the Punishers Trio aimed their anger at him for making Adrien look like a monster and would also "punish" anyone who got in their way, such as transforming Nathalie Sancoeur into a copy of herself.

title: Juleka Couffaine
text:
Juleka Couffaine - Personality
Then once more along in "Gang of Secrets", with Lady Wifi, Princess Fragrance, Horrificator and Timebreaker, wanting to expose Marinette's secrets in hopes of saving her and their friendship by forcing her to give them up so they can comfort her. She and the group had no qualms putting bystanders in danger to find Marinette, such as transforming some people into images of herself. Her desire to persevere their friendship was so intense that that they all chased after an illusion of Marinette instead of taking Cat Noir's ring.
But during her fifth time in "Guiltrip", unlike before, Reflekta lost her usual behavior, being consumed by immense guilt by letting herself get sucked into her sentimonster, and continued sulking, even losing her will to fight when Ladybug and Cat Noir found her. When Pigella gave her Gift, Reflekta became happy again and even willingly allowed the heroes to de-akumatize her.

title: Juleka Couffaine
text:
Juleka Couffaine - Personality
However, when akumatized a sixth time as Reflekta in "Confrontation", she again thought that no one has ever paid attention to her and she wanted everyone to start understanding her perfectly by thinking exactly like her, with accepting Nino Lahiffe's idea of always being together because if they were all the same no one would stop them from being together forever.

title: Juleka Couffaine
text:
Juleka Couffaine - Abilities
As a Civilian
Juleka seems to be skilled at applying makeup, as she is the makeup artist for Nino Lahiffe's short film in "Horrificator" and she became a model in "Reflekdoll". It is shown in "Sole Crusher", that Juleka knows/is able to dye hair as she dyes a strand of Zoé Lee's hair alongside Rose Lavillant.
She has a natural talent for music, playing bass and being the bassist for her band Kitty Section. In "Migration", it's revealed that Juleka has a beautiful singing voice, something that's confirmed in "El Toro De Piedra" where she performs a solo and fascinates her viewers.
She also has strong confidence and doesn't get scared by things very easily, she can handle family feuds, and in "Confrontation" Juleka said that she wanted to be a mortician when she grows up.
As Purple Tigress

title: Juleka Couffaine
text:
Juleka Couffaine - Abilities
Purple Tigress has enhanced capabilities such as speed, agility, and strength, and she is almost invulnerable to physical damage. These abilities allow her to react to and evade akumatized villains attacks, as well as jump and leap several times her height and length. Her tool is a bolas, a whip-like weapon with three weighted, striped balls on one end; it can be worn as a belt when not in use, functioning like a tail.
Purple Tigress's special superpower, Clout, allows her to charge her fist with powerful, pure concussive energy. When Purple Tigress punches something, she completely overpowers it and sends the person or object she targeted flying, the massive shockwave of energy being of great help in dispelling huge crowds or breaking through enemy defenses. She also can cause a great deal of damage when she hits, for example, surfaces, as when she hit the ground where some of Penalty's copies were in "Penalteam", she created an enormous crater and temporarily incapacitated the copies.

title: Juleka Couffaine
text:
Juleka Couffaine - Abilities
Initially, using her power would depower her and cause her to detransform after 5 minutes, however, in "Revelator", it is shown that Purple Tigress has learned to control her adult powers, allowing her to not detransform back and use Clout as much as she wishes.
As Reflekta

title: Juleka Couffaine
text:
Juleka Couffaine - Abilities
Reflekta was able to shoot rays from the jewel she has on her right hand, which transformed people into an identical physical copy of herself. Those transformed by her retained their regular voices and minds but didn't have her powers and lost their own abilities. However, if someone acquires a Miraculous after being transformed by Reflekta, they could use it to transform as normal. It is unknown if detransforming in this state would turn them back to normal or if it would return them to being a clone of Reflekta. As clones, people were immune to subsequent hits from her ray. Reflekta was implied to be able to reverse the transformations as well, as she says to Hawk Moth that she would take care of getting Cat Noir's Miraculous after getting the Ladybug Miraculous, despite having transformed him. She seemed to be able to float, as seen when she jumped around. She also was very strong and fast, quickly throwing multiple lockers in front of a door in the span of a couple of seconds and breaking free from a basketball hoop around her body.

title: Juleka Couffaine
text:
Juleka Couffaine - Abilities
Reflekta was cunning as she figured out Ladybug's plan to catch her and persuaded a transformed André Bourgeois that she'd turn him back to normal if he tricked Ladybug and Cat Noir into believing he was her. Similarly, she was good at hiding, which she could use for sneaky attacks while akumatized.
In "Reflekdoll", Reflekta was able to pilot a gigantic doll-like sentimonster that fired a much stronger version of the same kind of beam from her mouth and turned people into copies of herself. She also had Reflekta's cunning and speed, as shown when she was quickly throwing a car.
In "Guiltrip", in addition to her usual power of transforming other individuals into copies of herself, the copies also gained this ability themselves.

title: Juleka Couffaine
text:
Juleka Couffaine - Abilities
In "Confrontation", in addition to having her regular powers as Reflekta, she also gained the quantum essence of the Tiger Miraculous through her Alliance Ring, and was able to use its superpower, Clout, to charge her fist with energy and deal devastating, explosive blows to whatever/whoever she punched. The Reflekta copies became obsessed with searching and transforming other people with slats from her origami-styled hand fan so they could "stay together forever". The copies were also able to summon and use Clout, like the original Reflekta.
