title: Juleka Couffaine
text:
Juleka Couffaine - Etymology
The name Juleka might be a variant of the name Julika, a diminutive of the name Julie, which descends from the Latin nomen Julius (of unclear meaning). In French, Jule means "jewel".
All the Couffaines's names so far end with "-ka".
In the Serbian and Croatian dubs, her name is changed to Julija.
In the Brazilian Portuguese dub, her name is changed to Juleika.
In the Irish dub, her name is changed to Seosaimhín, which is Irish for Josephine.
Juleka's surname Couffaine is a combination of "couffin" (French for "coffin") and the French suffix "-aine" (meaning "of or from a place"), ultimately meaning "of/from the coffin".
It is also a pun, sounding like the French word "acouphène" (meaning "tinnitus").
Tigresse Pourpre means Purple Tigress in French.
Tigress is also what someone calls a female tiger or a woman that is beautiful, strong and can handle themselves with any problem.
With her becoming Purple Tigress in "Crocoduel", she is the second temporary Miraculous holder to receive a magical charm before becoming one following Zoé.
Purple Tigress, alongside her older twin brother, Viperion, making them the first superheroes to be siblings.

title: Juleka Couffaine
text:
Juleka Couffaine - Etymology
She is the third Miraculous holder to be biologically related to another holder following Hawk Moth/Shadow Moth/Monarch to Cat Noir and Flairmidable/Argos and Vesperia to Queen Bee.
In the European Portuguese dub, her superhero name is Tigre Lilás, which is Portuguese for "Lilac Tiger".
In the Italian dub, her superhero name is Tigre Viola, which also means "Purple Tiger".

title: Juleka Couffaine
text:
Juleka Couffaine - Trivia
Revealed by the Staff
Juleka was originally supposed to be two years younger than her brother. However, this was later changed and they were changed to be twins; Thomas Astruc noted in a tweet that she failed a grade and had to repeat a year. This makes her and Luka around 15/16, at least a year older than the rest of her classmates.
In the original French version, Juleka's dialogues are sometimes purposely made impossible to understand, while the English dub makes what she says clearly understandable. In the Dutch version, she even talks out loud more than in any other dub. According to Thomas Astruc, this modification ruins the character.
Juleka's earlier concept design was different in many ways, including her shorter purple hair, black and white striped leggings, and dark purple boots.
She also owned a purple bass guitar with a pink strap.
Miraculous Holder and Akumatized Villain
In the openings of season 2 to 4, Juleka has tiger stickers on her face, foreshadowing that she would become the owner of the Tiger Miraculous.
Juleka's akumatized supervillain name may be a reference to the Reflekta camera.

title: Juleka Couffaine
text:
Juleka Couffaine - Trivia
Reflekta negates Cat Noir's Cataclysm with her powers by transforming him into her image, making his Miraculous disappear and preventing him from using his Miraculous superpower.
In "Reflekta", Juleka, akumatized into the titular villain, revealed that she hates cats.
Reflekta was originally supposed to reappeared in the two part special event "Heroes' Day", according to early concept art.
In "Gamer 2.0", Reflekta returns as a playable akumatized villain as part of the Gamer 2.0's powers.
A scarlet version of Reflekta briefly appeared in "Ladybug", but her akumatization was interrupted.
That also makes Juleka one of the few characters whose akumatization (one of the many at least) has been interrupted before fully accepting Hawk Moth's offer. The others being Marinette, Sabine, Denis Damoclès, Miss Bustier and Rose.
Juleka is the only character to be akumatized and amokized at the same time twice, the first sentimonster being Reflekdoll and the second being Guiltrip.
Juleka, alongside Zoé Lee, Nino Lahiffe, Kagami Tsurugi, Lê Chiến Kim, and Sabrina Raincomprix, are the only current members of the Miraculers to whom Ladybug gave a Magical Charm.

title: Juleka Couffaine
text:
Juleka Couffaine - Trivia
In "Crocoduel", Juleka and all her family and friends get together to celebrate her birthday, making her the sixth member of the Miraculers to celebrate a birthday after Adrien in "The Bubbler", Alix in "Timebreaker", Nathaniel in "The Evillustrator", Marinette in "Befana" and Luka also in "Crocoduel".
As of "Crocoduel", following Alya Césaire, Nino, Chloé, Nathalie Sancoeur, Luka, Max Kanté, Kagami, Alix Kubdel, Lê Chiến Kim, Adrien, Wang Fu, Zoé, Mylène Haprèle and Rose, Juleka is the fifteenth person to become an akumatized supervillain and a Miraculous holder, excluding Marinette and Félix Fathom whose akumatizations were unable to be completed and Gabriel, who akumatized himself.
As seen in "Crocoduel", Purple Tigress is the ninth person to break an akumatized object, instead of Ladybug and Cat Noir, following Queen Bee, Rena Rouge and Carapace in "Mayura", Fang in "Lies", Marianne in "Furious Fu", Polymouse in "Mega Leech" and Anarka and Jagged in "Crocoduel".

title: Juleka Couffaine
text:
Juleka Couffaine - Trivia
In "Confrontation", Juleka became the fourth and final member of the Miraculers to receive the power of their primary wielded Miraculous through their Alliance Ring, following Kagami Tsurugi in "Perfection", Lê Chiến Kim in "Derision", and Sabrina Raincomprix in "Adoration".
As of this episode, Juleka is also the only character that has been regularly akumatized, amokized, akumatized in a group of akumatized villains, akumatized in her scarlet version and akumatized with a superhero power.
Miscellaneous
In the intro for season 1, Juleka's face is blocked by Nino Lahiffe's hand, foreshadowing the conflict in her episode "Reflekta".
In "Reflekta", Juleka and Rose Lavillant both reveal that they think that Juleka has a "curse" that causes her to be obscured in photos. At the end of the episode, they believe it has been broken thanks to Marinette and their classmates.
Starting from season 2, her face is completely shown, as her jinx is broken in "Reflekta".
In "Mr. Pigeon", during the derby hat competition, Juleka and Rose are standing next to a derby hat with gears attached to it, suggesting one or both of them made the hat.

title: Juleka Couffaine
text:
Juleka Couffaine - Trivia
In "The Evillustrator", Juleka sits next to Nathaniel Kurtzberg in science class, instead of her usual seat next to Rose.
In "Copycat" and "Rogercop", Juleka is wearing white clothes instead of her usual dark gray clothes.
According to Thomas Astruc, this is an error.
In "Confrontation", it is revealed that Juleka wants to be a mortician when she grows up.
In "Wreckless Driver", it is revealed that Juleka has received help from Dr. Psiquat with her inability to speak up.
In "El Toro De Piedra", it is revealed that Juleka knows enough English to compose and sing a whole song in the language.
When "Vampigami" was aired in Russia, Rose and Juleka's relationship was censored. Rather than Juleka being jealous of Prem due to his closeness and similarities to Rose, she is jealous of Rose and has a crush on Prem, due to Russian anti-LGBTQ+ laws.

title: Juleka Couffaine/History
text:
Juleka Couffaine/History - Intro
Juleka Couffaine is a teenage girl who attends Collège Françoise Dupont.

title: Juleka Couffaine/History
text:
Juleka Couffaine/History - Before Season 1
Ever since when Juleka was little, whenever someone tried to take a picture of her, something would get in the way, and so she believed she has jinx. She attended Collège Françoise Dupont for at least one year before the current year, and she also was friends with Rose Lavillant beforehand.
At one point when she was younger, she failed a grade and had to repeat the year.

title: Juleka Couffaine/History
text:
Juleka Couffaine/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Ladybug & Cat Noir", Juleka was seen in taking one of the seats in the back of the classroom.
In "Stoneheart", Juleka like all the other students were curious about what happened to Ivan when he was akumatized but saw him leave in a huff because of Chloé. Then, when Ivan gets akumatized again. Juleka remains in the school library with the rest of students watching Ladybug's and Cat Noir's brave actions from the news, cheering for their success. Later on, she laughs in amusement when Marinette told Chloé off.
In "The Bubbler", Juleka attended Adrien's birthday and was forced to have fun under the Bubbler's threats doing a slow dance with Kim. After Ladybug crashes the party she fled to safety with the others and heard Ladybug and Cat Noir vouch for the adults but was shocked when the Bubbler sent them flying. Even after that she refused to party but cheered upon the heroes return, however, she was captured in a bubble and sent skywards. Once the Bubbler was defeated Juleka was freed along with everyone else.
In "Mr. Pigeon", Juleka was partnered with Rose during the derby hat contest.

title: Juleka Couffaine/History
text:
Juleka Couffaine/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Timebreaker", she was one of the cheering students during the race between Kim and Alix, telling Kim they were tired of his dares. But as the race gets underway Alix's watch gets broken and she sees her get akumatized into Timebreaker but flees to safety. In the new reality, she flees to safety again thanks to the Future Ladybug.
In "Copycat", she was seen in the seats in the back of Mrs. Bustier classroom.
In "Lady Wifi", after Mrs. Bustier's class was over she was in the courtyard with Rose and gets asked by Alya if either of them had seen Marinette but she shakes her head no. But when Alya gets akumatized into Lady Wifi, Juleka leaves the school with the other students.
In "The Evillustrator", she was in the back seats of the science class.
In "Rogercop", Juleka was watching the Career Day presentations until Chloé accuses Marinette of stealing her bracelet.
In "Dark Cupid", Juleka was learning the purpose of love in literature stories being taught in Mrs. Bustier's class until it ends and she returns home.

title: Juleka Couffaine/History
text:
Juleka Couffaine/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Horrificator", she had the job of make-up artist for a movie the whole class was preparing for a movie contest. However, the movie was put on hold when Kim and Max went missing as well as seeing the whole school covered in slime. She followed Ladybug and Cat Noir's lead with other students as the duo searched for Horrificator. In one of the classrooms they come across the villain but unlike the others, Juleka found Horrificator awesome. Following the creature to the maintenance room, they find all the missing students and when the creature blocks off the exits, Juleka and her friends watched the fight from a safe distance, until Ladybug tosses to them makeshift instruments. Using them they all sang Mylène's favorite song and calmed Horrificator down after that everything was returned to normal.

title: Juleka Couffaine/History
text:
Juleka Couffaine/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Darkblade", when Juleka heard that Marinette was running for class representative she offered Marinette some ideas along with her other friends, although her suggestion was hard to understand. Once she hears that Jagged Stone is at City Hall, Juleka goes there for an autograph. But when Darkblade attacks, she, like everyone else, looks to Chloé for help. But ended up following Marinette's lead in barricading the doors. Then, she followed everyone upstairs to safety after Darkblade was defeated she heard that from Chloé that she had Sabrina stolen Marinette's diary. Seeing that Marinette wanted to win by fair means Juleka praised Marinette for her speech and victory as class representative.
In "The Mime", Juleka was watching the fight between Cat Noir and The Mime with Rose.
In "Princess Fragrance", during science Juleka was listening to Rose swooning over Prince Ali's arrival in Paris.
In "Pixelator", Juleka was one of the few students who had the job of a cook for job experience day at the Le Grand Paris Hotel.
In "Gamer", Juleka was in the library watching some of her classmates try out for spots in an upcoming video-game tournament.

title: Juleka Couffaine/History
text:
Juleka Couffaine/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Reflekta", it was class picture day and everyone was excited except for Juleka, who believed that she was cursed when it came to photographs. However, Rose and Marinette believed she wasn't and promised to help her break the curse. When it was time for Ms. Bustier's class photo and Juleka was almost she was excluded but was pointed out by Marinette and was put right in the center, next to Adrien and the spot Chloé wanted. During a brief intermission, Juleka was excluded from the class photo because Sabrina locked her in the bathroom. It was all a part of Chloé's plan. She was found by Rose after the pictures were taken, but she left the school crying and asking her friend to forget her. She got akumatized into Reflekta, returning to the school she turns everyone into copies of herself using her hand-mirror.

title: Juleka Couffaine/History
text:
Juleka Couffaine/History - [[Season 1]]
She faced off against Cat Noir but turned him into her copy of herself too. She then found Chloé and turned her into her look alike as punishment but came face to face with Ladybug. Their confrontation almost ended up with her taking Ladybug's Miraculous, however, thanks to a distraction from Cat Noir, Reflekta escapes and starts transforming people all over Paris. Making her way to City Hall she even transforms the mayor and hears of the heroes plan to stop her but she retorts by making a plan of her own. Using the mayor as bait to lure the heroes she tries to transform Ladybug but gets blocked a transformed Cat Noir. After Ladybug destroys her hand-mirror Juleka returns to normal and was taken back to school by the mayor.
Then, she joins her classmates for another class photo in the park after Marinette convinced the photographer. Convinced that her curse is broken Juleka thanked Marinette for everything.
In "Antibug", Juleka was doing her schoolwork until she saw something going with Chloé.
In "Volpina", Juleka was talking with Rose at the school's entrance.

title: Juleka Couffaine/History
text:
Juleka Couffaine/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Santa Claws", she was celebrating Christmas with her family until she was alerted that Adrien was missing. Once he was safe and sound at home she joined Adrien and her classmates at the Agreste mansion for dinner.
In "The Collector", Juleka heard that Adrien was banned from going school by his father and rejoiced with her friends when he returned.
In "Despair Bear", she was watching Marinette's father teach a cooking class. Until the fire alarm got pulled by Chloé which resulted in everyone cleaning the courtyard as punishment. Then some later Juleka, Rose, and Mylène went to Marinette's house for a mini fun photoshoot and then get invited to a party being hosted by Chloé, which they attended.

title: Juleka Couffaine/History
text:
Juleka Couffaine/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Befana", yesterday Juleka was at her locker holding a bicycle pump until she got startled by Marinette. On Marinette's birthday she worked with her classmates on putting together Marinette's party. With decorations complete Juleka and her classmates wished her a happy birthday and everything goes well. Until Befena crashed the party following Alya's lead and agreeing that Marinette was cool Juleka worked with everyone to protect her but got turned into coal statue. After Juleka was revived with Miraculous Ladybug she enjoyed rest of the party.
In "Robostus", Juleka was getting ready for science and like her classmates she was amazed at Markov.
In "Gigantitan", Juleka was invited to Marinette's house to help her pull off a romantic outing with Adrien. Like the others who came, she was already aware of Marinette's crush on him. She worked together to pull everything off at the Trocadéro and all went well until Gigantitan appeared. After Juleka and Rose made it to safety, they shared a group hug with Alya and Mylène. Noticing that Marinette wasn't with them they all went looking for her, but fled when they were seen by Gigantitan.

title: Juleka Couffaine/History
text:
Juleka Couffaine/History - [[Season 2]]
When Ladybug was in the villain's grip Juleka and her friends worked together in getting Gigantitan to let her go. After keeping the baby villain distracted for as long as they could she and the others abandoned the rickshaw and fled to safety. After August was returned to normal and his mother she and the others were relieved to find Marinette alright.
Seeing Adrien not far away Juleka and everyone was happy that they could still pull off their plan, but Marinette decided to get straight to the point. Watching with her friends nearby, Juleka pushed Marinette into agreeing to Adrien's offer for a ride home. However, she became disappointed when Marinette declined the offer but praised her for making an effort. She then took a rickshaw ride home.
In "Gorizilla", Juleka arrived at the pool with Mylène, Rose, and Alya. While waiting for Marinette through a series of social media posts they discovered she was with Adrien after receiving more Juleka agreed with Rose with that they looked so cute together. When Alya called Marinette, like her friends she wanted the details of what happened while still waiting at the pool for Marinette.

title: Juleka Couffaine/History
text:
Juleka Couffaine/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Captain Hardrock", Juleka and her friends were helping her mother, Anarka Couffaine, set up for the Paris music festival. But the performance was halted when Officer Roger said their music was way too loud. But becomes saddened with her brother Luka to see their mother akumatized into Captain Hardrock. When everyone refused to play their music Juleka ends up as one of the prisoners below the ship. Thanks to Ladybug and Cat Noir, Juleka was set free and getting the okay sign from Officer Roger Juleka performed in the festival with her family and friends.
In "Frightningale", Juleka was heading to Clara Nightningale's music shoot with Rose, Alix, Mylène, Marinette, and Alya to have fun as extra's in her video. She supported Marinette when Clara picked her to be Ladybug in the video, but when she turned down the offer, Juleka and the others gave her friend a group hug. But when Marinette changed her mind, she continued to show support and was completely in awe on how much Adrien and Marinette physically resembled Paris' favorite superheroes.

title: Juleka Couffaine/History
text:
Juleka Couffaine/History - [[Season 2]]
But she becomes disappointed when Chloé cancels Clara's shoot but fled to safety when the singer was akumatized into Frightningale. After she was defeated and under Ladybug's asking, Juleka and everyone was included in Clara's new music video.
In "Zombizou", Juleka asked Rose what she got Miss Bustier's birthday and Juleka was impressed by Marinette's gift. After making it to Miss Bustier's class she and her friends discover that Marinette's gift was ruined by no other than Chloé. But things go from bad to worse she saw her favorite teacher akumatized into Zombizou. Thanks to Ladybug's intervention she and her friends escaped to the locker room and after being found by the heroine they all escaped to the school roof.

title: Juleka Couffaine/History
text:
Juleka Couffaine/History - [[Season 2]]
Then, they all evacuated to a nearby bus but when Chloé missed her mark and Rose tried to save her. Juleka told her not to go and showed great concern for her watching Rose almost become Zombizou's next victim. Once Rose was inside the bus, Juleka comforted her asking if she was okay but arriving at the Eiffel Tower she became infected too remaining on the bus with Rose and Alix. After Zombizou was defeated and everyone returned to normal Juleka, Rose and Alix joined together for a group hug. She went to Miss Bustier's class the next day
In "Syren", she was already in the theater and watched a movie with her friends. Upon seeing Alya and Marinette, Juleka and Rose gestured them over but before the movie could start. The theater became flooded with water Juleka and everyone else evacuated to the roof.

title: Juleka Couffaine/History
text:
Juleka Couffaine/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Reverser", Juleka was a part of the Art Club along with Marinette, Rose, Alix, and Nathaniel. She was introduced to Marc who was hesitant on joining and some time later she, Rose and the teacher were approached by Reverser demanding to know to where Marinette and Nathaniel are. But they were hit by the villain's arrows into destroying everything in the Art Room until being returned to normal by the Miraculous Ladybug. The next day, Juleka was given a copy of the boys comic about Ladybug sharing in a laugh that Marinette would've made a great hero if she wasn't a klutz.
In "Style Queen", Juleka attended Gabriel's fashion show with her friends to support Adrien and Marinette but was horrified when Style Queen attacked the event and turned Adrien into a glitter statue.

title: Juleka Couffaine/History
text:
Juleka Couffaine/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Malediktator", after laughing at Chloé about her presentation during her actions Queen Bee, Juleka like everyone else was ecstatic about her leaving Paris and celebrated with a party until Malediktator crashed the event and was instructed by the villain to destroy the school. But thanks to the heroes, Juleka and everyone was returned to normal with the Miraculous Ladybug and then attended a new party honoring Queen Bee.
In "Frozer", after Marinette began to doubt her relationship with Adrien, Juleka like her friends wouldn't accept that and started thinking of ideas to have Marinette continue her romantic pursue.
In "Catalyst", Juleka was getting ready for Heroes' Day with her classmates until she becomes devastated by watching a live video feed of Ladybug being akumatized and destroying Cat Noir. Then, soon things went from bad to worse when a swarm of red akumas attack the school, she was shocked when Rose was re-akumatized into Princess Fragrance and tried to run from the akumas. But by taking Marinette's advice, she was able to calm down and resist akumatization.

title: Juleka Couffaine/History
text:
Juleka Couffaine/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Mayura", after Hawk Moth's army was defeated Juleka went to a picnic as a thank you present for Marinette due to her being their everyday Ladybug. As Adrien left she was surprised to see Marinette plant a thank you kiss him and cheered for her progress.

title: Juleka Couffaine/History
text:
Juleka Couffaine/History - [[Miraculous Shanghai]]
In "Miraculous Shanghai", Juleka peacefully sits at the back of the class, and pays close attention to Caline Bustier's lesson. Later, she can be seen at a picnic accompanied by most of her classmates.

title: Juleka Couffaine/History
text:
Juleka Couffaine/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Chameleon", during another day in Miss Bustier's class Juleka got a new seat and with everyone else eagerly welcomed back Lila still believing her stories. But when Alya and Nino move back to their original seats so does she.
In "Backwarder", a sleepy Juleka and her friends came to Marinette's house on Saturday because she was freaking over Adrien falling in love with Kagami over their time in London during a wedding. In the midst, of thinking of ideas on how to stop the two from falling in love Juleka bluntly suggested kidnapping Kagami which everyone quickly shoots down due to how much trouble they'd get into. And yet, agreed with Alya's option of having Marinette write a letter to Adrien explaining her feelings. On Monday at school, Juleka and the others wait in anticipation to see Marinette's gift from Adrien and was surprised to see that it was constipation capsules.

title: Juleka Couffaine/History
text:
Juleka Couffaine/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Gamer 2.0", Juleka was practicing with her bands until they were approached by Max asking if one of them would try his video game but politely refused leaving for Marinette's house. While checking out Marinette's new shirt designs Juleka along with everyone else was taken prisoner by Gamer 2.0 in their akumatized forms. Then, she was picked to be one of Cat Noir's avatars easily defeating Gamer 2.0 as Rogercop. After Ladybug defeated the titular villain in the final round Juleka and the others were set free.
In "Silencer", she was getting ready to perform with her band and afterwards when Juleka hears that Bob was looking for new talent the group uploads their video. However, they discovered that it was just a ploy to promote is son XY, so they went to the studio to confront him. So Juleka and the others distracted the guards while Luka and Marinette went inside. After Bob revealed the truth Juleka and her band got to perform on live TV.
In "Oni-Chan", Juleka was heading home from school and was about to get onto her bike until Marinette asked to borrow it.
In "Miraculer", Juleka was seen in school's courtyard.

title: Juleka Couffaine/History
text:
Juleka Couffaine/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Oblivio", Juleka was seen sitting on the bus beside Rose and played Super Pengiuno with her.
In "Party Crasher", she was planting trees with her friends until they all got a message saying that the boys couldn't make it.
In "Ikari Gozen", Juleka along with her friends participated in the Friendship Day Game and along with Alya, Rose, Mylène and Wayhem won the prize to hang out with Adrien.
In "Reflekdoll", Juleka was fixing her hair but she believed that Marinette would  never pick her to be model reminding her brother Luka that she dreamed of being one and was encouraged to try. While at school and since Ms. Mendeleiev's class was cancelled they were all out an hour early, when Alya asked her friends about any takers for the modelling offer for Marinette's website. Juleka stepped up surprising everyone and soon she and her friends left for Marinette's house, however as everything went underway she  tried to tell them she wasn't so sure about this but they all left before she could finish.

title: Juleka Couffaine/History
text:
Juleka Couffaine/History - [[Season 3]]
Filled with anger once again she was akumatized into Reflekta but this time aided by her owner sentimonster Reflekdoll created by Hawk Moth's ally Mayura. With the her sentimonster she started transforming everyone into her own image and started looking for her friends. Upon, finding them Reflekta started changing everyone and taunting them as she asked them how does it feel to left out of the picture. Soon Reflekta was up against the heroes but this time with their jewels swapped as Mister Bug and Lady Noir. As she fought against them she climbed up the Eiffel Tower after them in Reflekdoll, at first she was briefly stunned by Mister Bug when he reflected her beam but was still coming.

title: Juleka Couffaine/History
text:
Juleka Couffaine/History - [[Season 3]]
But thanks to Lady Noir using Cataclysm on her guardian, she was sent plummeting down and lost control of the sentimonster and called the swapped heroes for help. Upon being taken out of her guardian, Juleka thought the heroes looked ridiculous in their new look and attempted to change them but was de-akumatized before she could. But was struck by her own out of control guardian and yet thanks to the heroes Juleka and everyone else were returned to normal. Afterwards, she reunited with her friends and heard Marinette apologize for her mistake and accepted her friend's offer finishing the photoshoot.

title: Juleka Couffaine/History
text:
Juleka Couffaine/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Desperada", Juleka was hanging out with her brother Luka and friends on their houseboat until she and everyone were surprised that Kagami and Adrien came. Soon she heard her mother and went up to the deck to see what was going on and she was surprised that Jagged Stone was here. Even more so along with Luka that their mother had a history together. But she heard her mother turn down Jagged's offer because he had a habit of firing his guitarist. Soon Jagged's guitarist Vivica arrived akumatized as Desperada and Juleka along with everyone else except her brother, Marinette and Adrien ended up captured. Until she and everyone were set free by the heroes.
In "Ladybug", Juleka was getting ready for the Mock Exams in Miss Bustier's class. She was surprised that Marinette was accused of stealing the answers. But like her other classmates, she knew that Marinette would never cheat or steal, being sad that in that it ended with her friend being expelled from school it led to Juleka almost being akumatized again but it was cancelled.

title: Juleka Couffaine/History
text:
Juleka Couffaine/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Startrain", Juleka was getting ready for her class field trip to see Big Ben in London and sat next to Rose during the train ride reading a book. During the ride she and Rose were directed to Marinette and Adrien who were sleeping peacefully by Mylène which she found awesome. However, their class field trip took a surprise trip to space when Max's mom was akumatized into the titular villain being in zero gravity she found it spacey. Then, followed Marinette's lead in trying to takeover the train but it backfired however, Juleka and everyone became excited that Ladybug and Cat Noir were onboard and to ensure their safety, they were led to the back of the train by Miss Bustier. After the heroes defeated Startrain they were all lead back to earth.

title: Juleka Couffaine/History
text:
Juleka Couffaine/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Félix", she was with her friends on her family houseboat aware that this was the anniversary of Adrien's mother going missing, Juleka agreed with Marinette's idea that everyone should send a video message making a video package. However, after hearing Felix disguised as Adrien leave a nasty message. Juleka and everyone were hurt, confused and doubted their friendship with him to the point of her, Alya and Rose being akumatized into their villain alter egos again.
Despite some interference from Ladybug, Reflekta and her friends left to find him upon entering Adrien's room they were surprised to find two of him realizing they had been tricked. Wanting the one that sent the nasty message they almost attacked Adrien until Nathalie rushed to his defense but made quick work of her and directed to Felix by Hawk Moth. Fighting Ladybug and Cat Noir on the roof of the Le Grand Hotel, the villainous trio had them in a three way crossfire and heard that Felix had his own demands through Hawk Moth they said they'd work something out. And yet, to Ladybug using a whipped cream spray can it led to a chain reaction with that Juleka and her friends being de-akumatized.

title: Juleka Couffaine/History
text:
Juleka Couffaine/History - [[Season 3]]
She was with Rose and Luka until they along with their friends received a video from the real Adrien, who explained what happened and received a thanks from him.
In "Cat Blanc", Juleka was hanging out with her friends while playing her guitar at the same time wondering how Marinette was doing in delivering her gift to Adrien but like the others was disappointed when she was her comeback worried about rejection. And yet, she was surprised when Rose shouted out a burst of confident for Marinette to try again and cheered her on as she left. In an alternate future, Juleka and her friends cheered for Marinette as she delivered her gift but was more surprised when Adrien appeared. When the two admitted their feelings for each other everyone cheered on with joy. However, due to certain "secrets" being unveiled leading to Cat Noir's akumatization she and everyone on the planet were destroyed but thanks to Ladybug changing the past so did the future. After Marinette gets back Juleka heard that she couldn't deliver the gift because Adrien wasn't home but embraced her for the effort.
In "Miracle Queen", after Miracle Queen's defeat Juleka was enjoying time with her friends by the Seine.

title: Juleka Couffaine/History
text:
Juleka Couffaine/History - [[Miraculous New York]]
In the school library, Juleka, accompanied by her class, watches a short film made by her and her class. Juleka seems quite happy to be going on a trip to New York but is saddened by the fact that Caline Bustier can't go and the class has to go accompanied with Miss Mendeleiev instead. Later, Juleka listens to Marinette go on and on about Adrien, and accompanies her in helping Adrien come to New York City with their classmates. They succeed, and are joyed.
Juleka sits on the bus ride to the airport next to Rose. On the plane, Juleka is seen alongside Rose, asleep with a blanket covering their knees. Later in the flight, they are both really surprised to see the United Heroez ensure them a very safe flight after supposedly defeating Techno-Pirate.
While in New York City, Juleka seems to enjoy her time there except for the moment that Adrien almost left New York for good.

title: Juleka Couffaine/History
text:
Juleka Couffaine/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Truth", Juleka is seen in Alya's room, reading a magazine with Rose when Alya calls Marinette. She liked the idea of the squishies that Marinette mentioned but was confused why she was acting slightly mad on the video call. On hearing Luka's name before she accidentally drops her phone on the keyboard and ends the video call, she is relieved that she wasn't baffling over Adrien anymore.
Later, Juleka performs "I Love Unicorns" alongside her band members but after the performance and the members and audience are ready to leave, they are swiftly interrupted by the titular villain. While Truth shoots his beam at Rose and Lighteye points their light at her, Juleka has no hesitation in protecting Rose and instantly jumps in front of her to protect her.

title: Juleka Couffaine/History
text:
Juleka Couffaine/History - [[Season 4]]

Then the application is cut off as a falsified video of Ladybug and Cat Noir kidnapping Adrien and Kagami out of jealousy is uploaded, causing the nightmares to return.
Alya attempts to convince everyone that Ladybug and Cat Noir have done so much good for Paris, there's no way they would stoop that low, but while Juleka is among those that heed Alya's advice and gets rid of her Alliance Ring, Ivan falls victim to becoming a Miraculized, forcing Juleka and the others to have to pin him down until they could remove his Alliance Ring and return him to normal.

However, despite the added reinforcements, including civilians who take up arms against the Miraculized, the odds are still looking extremely grim for Juleka and the others as the Miraculized still vastly outnumber them.

title: Kaalki
text:
Kaalki - Intro
is a supporting character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She is the kwami of Migration who is connected to the Horse Miraculous. With her power, Kaalki's wearer can use the glasses to transform into a horse-themed superhero.
Kaalki and her Miraculous are currently owned by Max Kanté, who uses it to transform into the superhero Pegasus.

title: Kaalki
text:
Kaalki - Appearance
Kaalki is 10 centimeters (or 4 inches) tall and is gray with a white mane, muzzle, arms, legs, and underbelly. She also has light green eyes, eyelashes, pointed horse ears with white insides, and a thick white tail that curves outwards. Unlike other kwamis, her arms and legs are not humanoid but instead resemble hooves.
As of season 6, most of her appearance remains the same except for her mane and tail being more detailed, she has brownish marking on her hooves resembling coronets and she has a visible nose.

title: Kaalki
text:
Kaalki - Personality
Kaalki is very polite and speaks eloquently with proper grammar, although she's an elitist, given that she asked Max if he was someone glorious and famous. She favors people of renown to wield her Miraculous. That said, this does not come at the expense of her refusing to work with those who don't meet her preferences.
She's quite prideful, as in "Optigami", she got offended at the thought of being called "a horse" instead of "a noble steed", all while bragging about how she was a faithful companion of the most glorious heroes.  Kaalki also believes that her power, when used by her, can only set off exceptional events and not catastrophes, despite the fact a kwami's power, when used without an owner, will always cause a major calamity of some kind.
Due to her having belonged to very noble heroes, Kaalki has come to be quite spoiled, being very critical when things are below her own expectations and standards. An example of that is how she complains about the custom-made bedroom Max made for her in his drawer, as she used to sleep on silk cushions embroidered with gold. Even the other kwamis, like Tikki, find Kaalki to be quite hard to please.

title: Kaalki
text:
Kaalki - Abilities
General Skills
As her holders have to be good at remembering faces of people and places when using Voyage, it's likely that Kaalki has a good memory.
As a Kwami
Kaalki can fly, levitate, and phase through solid objects. She can also carry objects that are larger and/or heavier than herself. Kaalki is also able to transform the holder of the Horse Miraculous into a horse-themed superhero, with the power of Voyage. She, like other kwamis, are also not able to be filmed/photographed, as seen in the episode “Kwamibuster”.
Kaalki's version of Voyage is unrestrained. However, like Max as Pegasus, she too can open portals to anywhere or anyone she is thinking about, but it can temporarily create a vacuum effect that sucks in things that are nearby and scatter them to different locations randomly, those locations being either close by or as far away as outer space itself.
It can also open a massive portal in a different location that can teleport gigantic structures to random locations.

title: Kaalki
text:
Kaalki - Relationships
Friends
Ziggy
Kaalki and Ziggy are seen dancing together at the party that celebrates Nooroo's birthday in "Sandboy". After they broke their connection with Hawk Moth, Ziggy is seen attending to Kaalki, which shows that the two kwamis are possibly close friends, or simply get along with each other.
Max Kanté
When Kaalki and Max met for the first time in "Startrain", he was friendly with her and only vaguely surprised at the sight of a kwami for the first time; but being that Kaalki was rather picky about holders, she immediately asked him if he was someone glorious and famous, only to stop when Ladybug assured her that Max was fit for the job. As of "Party Crasher", the two continue on working together in helping their allies against Hawk Moth. In "Miracle Queen", she was likely worried that Max was wearing the Miraculous to be used against his friends.

title: Kaalki
text:
Kaalki - Relationships
In "A Fairy Good Night", it's shown that Kaalki's prideful nature can sometimes clash with Max's particular sensibilities, with her finding some annoyance in some of her holder's everyday routines, like how he goes to sleep early. She also doesn't appreciate the fact he has her sleep in a drawer (even if he customized it for her). However, despite that, Kaalki truly loves Max, admiring how he knows the exact coordinates of every city in the world, and seeing great potential in him as a holder stating how she wants him to have more recognition (even if that is partly so she herself can have a piece of it).
Markov
They first met when Max received the Horse Miraculous in "Startrain", but, due to the urgency of the situation, there were no interactions between them. However, after Max became the permanent holder of her Miraculous, she and Markov came to interact with one another, after Kaalki allowed herself be detected by him. It would appear that the two of them mostly act as the angel and devil on Max's shoulder, with Kaalki trying to get Max to deviate from his rituals, while Markov does the opposite.

title: Kaalki
text:
Kaalki - Trivia
Kaalki was first revealed from a second season trailer on August 31, 2017.
Her name was confirmed in the credits of the Latin American Spanish dub of "Sandboy".
Some of the things that a horse is a symbol for have also been used as methods of transportation for millennia.
The horse is the seventh animal of the Chinese zodiac.
In the English dub, she speaks with a British Received Pronunciation accent.
In the European Portuguese dub, Kaalki's pronouns have changed twice: in seasons 2 and 3, she used male pronouns, in seasons 4 and 5, she used female ones, and in season 6, she returned to the male ones.
Her name is a reference to Kalki, the tenth Avatar of the Hindu God Vishnu who is depicted riding a white horse.
It's possible that Kaalki's concept is linked to the concept of wormhole, which is a speculative structure linking disparate points in spacetime.
Because wormholes are said to link different points in both time and space, it's possible that Kaalki's power, Voyage, is related to Fluff's, Burrow, which is further supported for how both powers create portals that allows the user to travel through space and time respectively.

title: Kaalki
text:
Kaalki - Trivia
Kaalki's preference for famous and glorious wielders may be a reference to the horse's association with famous and valiant knights in history and culture.
In "Truth", Kaalki was amazed by all the cars that were outside replying that there wasn't even one horse pulled carriage implying the last time she had an owner they used said carriages to get around.
This may imply that she, before Max, didn't have an owner ever since, at least, until the late 17th century to end of the early 20th century.
Kaalki is the third Kwami to use her power without a holder. The other two are Plagg and Trixx.
Unlike the other Kwamis, Kaalki was told to use her powers despite the risk of causing a catastrophe. Fortunately, the damages she caused were minimal, compared to the ones caused by Plagg and Trixx.
As of "Optigami", Kaalki is the Kwami who has used her power the most on screen, with a total of 6 times.
Next to Tikki, Kaalki is the only kwami to appear in all episodes of Season 5, except in "Derision", "Protection" and "Emotion".
However, just like Kaalki, Tikki was also absent in 2 episodes which were "Migration" and "Intuition".

In "A Fairy Good Night", it's shown that, despite the kwamis normally being undetected by technology, Kaalki allows herself to be detected by Markov.

is a smartphone owned by Juleka Couffaine.

In "Hack-San", Juleka gets hypnotized by Robostus after receiving a message on her phone. She later attempted to use it to trap Scarabella and Cat Noir.

title: Juleka's cellphone
text:
Juleka's cellphone - Appearance
In the first five seasons, Juleka's phone was black with white edges. It had three white-gray cameras on the top, one camera on the bottom, and another on the back of the phone.
From season 6 onwards, Juleka's cellphone has a black cover with flowers and petals drawn on it with pink/purple edges. On the top side of the screen, it has a small round camera, and on the back, on the top left, it has four round cameras arranged in a square.

title: Juleka's cellphone
text:
Juleka's cellphone - Trivia
Juleka's cellphone is the second object, after her hair clip, to become Reflekta's amokized object.
Errors
In "Catalyst", the smartphone is gray and flat.

title: Jiao
text:
Jiao - Intro
is a minor character of Miraculous World: Shanghai - The Legend of Ladydragon. He is a Chinese boy who lives in Shanghai. He is also a big fan of Adrien Agreste.

title: Jiao
text:
Jiao - Appearance
Physical appearance
Jiao is a tall, lanky young man with black hair with grayish cyan highlights with thick bangs that hang over the left side of his forehead. A small beard is also visible.
He wears a pale, light grayish opal button-up shirt with light crimson flowers. He wears the top button undone. He wears a dark vermilion jacket over his shirt which he wears unbuttoned. He wears black jeans and white sneakers.

title: Jiao
text:
Jiao - Personality
Jiao is a noble and brave individual who is not afraid to fight evil on the streets. He also dared, unafraid to fight the henchmen who were directed by Cash.

title: Jiao
text:
Jiao - Abilities
Jiao seems to have minimal knowledge of martial arts, but seems to be mostly untrained. Even so, he was able to hold off a common street thug. Also, when he and Kang went to look for Marinette, you can see that he is driving a bike.

title: Jiao
text:
Jiao - Relationships
Lian & Kang
Jiao, Lian and Kang are good friends, fighting alongside one another to defend the streets from evil as the "Street Vigilantes". They are always together, even when they ran after Fei, fighting with criminals and looking for Marinette to return her to the Kwagatama.
Fei Wu
His exact relationship with Fei is unknown. Jiao tries to catch her because he knows she is robbing innocent people on the street. When he and his friends find her, they chase the girl and engage in battle to stop her. Although they don't treat her positively when Fei needs help, the boys aren't shy and want to help her. By the end of the episode, his attitude towards Faye changes. When he sees her playing the accordion, he looks at Fei and develop a crush on her.
Adrien Agreste
Jiao is a big fan of Adrien. Teenagers recognize him on the street and ask him to share a photo with their idol. In the finale of special, Jiao communicates with Adrien and shows him something on his phone.
Marinette Dupain-Cheng
Jiao and his friends don't know Marinette very well. When Kang find her Kwagatama, they try to find the girl to return her jewelry. They follow her until they manage to recover the girl's property.

title: Jiao
text:
Jiao - History
Miraculous Shanghai
Jiao, Lian, and Kang spot Adrien Agreste as he walked along the Bund district and then go over to him. Jiao then pulls out his phone and asks for a photo with Adrien in Mandarin. Adrien agrees to this after his bodyguard lets him and the group then take a couple of photos.
Later, Jiao, Lian, and Kang see Fei Wu stealing from Marinette Dupain-Cheng. They then chase her into an alley. There, Fei confronts the three boys and defeats them without even physically touching them. Fei then runs off, leaving Jiao and the others on the floor. They then get up and continue to chase her.
That night, Jiao and Kang go looking for Marinette on a motorcycle to give her back her "necklace". They find her but she runs away with Fei. The two boys follow them on the motorcycle but the eventually lose them. Later, Jiao, Lian, and Kang face Cash's henchmen in another alley after finding Marinette and Fei.

title: Jiao
text:
Jiao - History
Sometime after, Jiao, Lian, and Kang go to the Thousand Delights restaurant and return Marinette's "necklace" to her. Wang Cheng then invites the three boys in, where the watch Fei play the accordion. After she finishes, the three boys blush as Fei looked at them confused. Jiao and Kang then continue to interact with Adrien. Sometime later, Jiao and the others then attended a fashion show, where they watch Adrien and Gabriel Agreste pose for the cameras.

title: Jiao
text:
Jiao - Trivia
Jiao, Lian and Kang are members of their own group against evil "Street Vigilantes". It may be similar to the previous The Resistance, which also fought for evil.

title: Juleka's bass guitars
text:
Juleka's bass guitars - Intro
are bass guitar owned by Juleka Couffaine. She uses them to perform songs, as well as to play in Kitty Section.
One of the guitars was formerly owned by Jagged Stone until he gave it to his daughter on her birthday in "Crocoduel".

title: Juleka's bass guitars
text:
Juleka's bass guitars - Appearance
The first guitar has a burgundy soundboard, a long neck, a black neck head and white pegs. The guitar's fingerboard is white with a blue outline. The guitar has a volume control, a timbre block and a bridge. Juleka also glued stickers with a butterfly and the Kitty Section band logo.
Jagged Stone's bass guitar, a gift from his daughter, is a plucked string instrument. Its headstock is blackish in color with four turning machines. It is constructed with basswood that is white and lightweight. Beneath the basswood holds the volume and tone knob with the addition of the output jack. The guitar encloses an opaque finish masking its basswood's appearance.

title: Juleka's bass guitars
text:
Juleka's bass guitars - Trivia
In the series, it is shown that in addition to a bass guitar, Juleka possesses an electric guitar similar to Luka's guitar, as seen in "Sole Crusher" and "Determination". She also has a similar guitar with the logo of her father in "Desperada".
Also on the end card of "Desparada", Anarka Couffaine plays on Juleka's bass guitar.
In "Representation", it turns out that Juleka's nightmare is that her father is mad at her for breaking the bass he gave her in "Crocoduel".
It is unknown whether Juleka uses her father's gift after the events of the "Ephemeral". From season 5, she has been playing her maroon bass guitar.
In "El Toro De Piedra", Juleka played the bass and performed her song Our Legacy, which became the final part of the concert for Mayoress Caline Bustier.
Errors
In some episodes, such as "Reverser", "Desperada", and "Adoration", Juleka's bass guitar is painted pink or violet instead of burgundy. This may mean that Juleka has several electric and bass guitars, during the first appearance in "Captain Hardrock", but it may also be an animation error.

title: Jubilation
text:
Jubilation - Intro
"" is a season 5 episode of the series Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. Based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 4th written and produced episode of season 5. It is also the 108th written and produced episode of the series overall.

title: Jubilation
text:
Jubilation - Synopsis
Marinette is surprised to discover that a former schoolmate, Socqueline, is passing herself off as Ladybug. She tries to dissuade her from endangering herself this way, but Monarch comes after Socqueline, convinced that she is the real Ladybug. He entrusts an akumatized villain with the power of the Miraculous of Jubilation, which shows people their deepest desires. Will the real Ladybug and Cat Noir escape that dangerous power?
Disney+
Our heroes face a jubilating villain.
Netflix
A classmate pretending to be Ladybug winds up in Monarch's grasp while Marinette fends off an akumatized villain who makes people's true desires appear.

title: Jubilation
text:
Jubilation - Plot
Marinette is jogging over a bridge when she sees the ad for the Alliance rings. Tikki sees Adrien in the ad and tells Marinette that she thought Adrien was no longer a model. Marinette explains that it is just a digitized 3-D model of Adrien. When Marinette smiles at him, Tikki says that she is still in love with the real Adrien, but Marinette denies it since she almost lost all Miraculouses because of love. As she jogs ahead, she sees The Owl climbing on a billboard to rescue a cat. But the cat runs away, and The Owl loses his balance causing his mask to fall and break. Marinette runs to save him, but suddenly, a person wearing a Ladybug costume appears and saves him, almost falling in the process. When Marinette approaches both, she identifies the unknown person as Socqueline Wang, her former schoolmate. But Socqueline denies it, saying she is just a superhero and runs away, along with the Owl. Tikki asks Marinette whether she knows Socqueline, to which Marinette replies that she has to buy some paint, leaving Tikki more confused.
Marinette reaches home and asks her mother if she needs paint.
She replies she has enough, but Marinette still goes to buy it.

title: Jubilation
text:
Jubilation - Plot
She arrives at Les Olympiades on her scooter and explains to Tikki that she thinks the other Ladybug is Socqueline Wang, her former schoolmate, and she wants to convince Socqueline to stop taking such risks.
Marinette enters an art and craft store owned by Socqueline.
Both greet each other, and Socqueline asks Marinette about her school life.
Marinette replies that everything is fine and continues talking to her.
Mr.
Denis Damoclès enters the shop and begins searching for a new mask.
Marinette indirectly asks Socqueline about her Ladybug activities, but she manages to dodge them.
When Socqueline asks her the purpose of her visit, Marinette replies she wants some paint.
Socqueline enquires about the paint stock with the help of the Alliance ring, and Marinette expresses her amazement at seeing an Alliance ring first time in person.
Socqueline explains every feature of it and gives it to Marinette to try.
Socqueline says that it is like a dream to have Adrien for herself.
Marinette replies it's weird since there is hardly any difference between this Adrien and the real Adrien.
Socqueline expresses her surprise and asks if Marinette has met Adrien.

title: Jubilation
text:
Jubilation - Plot
Marinette replies that she is just his classmate.
She proceeds to explain about Adrien, how she helped him to confront his father about modelling and how they become closer.
When Socqueline suggests that Adrien and Marinette are together, Marinette denies it by saying they are only friends, just like Socqueline, who only helps her mother, to which Socqueline gets nervous.
At this point, Mr.
Denis Damoclès interrupts them while searching for a mask.
Marinette tells Socqueline that, like Mr.
Denis Damoclès is just a principal.
She further says that nobody should try to be a superhero if they haven't any superpowers.
Socqueline replies it could be a relief to Ladybug to have help.
But Marinette denies it by saying that it is dangerous and that if they put themselves at risk, it would be riskier for Ladybug to save them.
Mr.
Denis Damoclès thinks Marinette is jealous of superheroes, which angers Marinette, and she exclaims that everyone should be happy with their normal life and not try to be a superhero.
This statement subtly offends Mr.
Denis Damoclès, which makes him sad.
Seeing her outburst, Socqueline tells her that she will help Mr.

title: Jubilation
text:
Jubilation - Plot
Denis Damoclès to find his mask, and they can continue their discussion afterwards.
Marinette goes behind a shelf and talks to Tikki about the possibility that the fake Ladybug was Socqueline.
She proceeds to check Socqueline's Alliance ring for proof, despite Tikki's protests and finds a recording of the morning encounter, proving that the fake Ladybug was indeed Socqueline.
Suddenly a news report pop-ups on the Alliance ring, showing Nadja Chamack reporting on flying dinosaurs created by Anne-Jeanne Théoxanne du Bocquale, who are creating havoc on Paris.
Seeing this, Marinette transforms into Ladybug and swings away while still wearing the Alliance ring.

title: Jubilation
text:
Jubilation - Plot
Back inside the store, Socqueline is helping Mr. Denis Damoclès to buy a new mask, but he is still upset about what Marinette said. He says what if he is doing more harm than help. Socqueline tries to cheer him up, but Mr. Denis Damoclès says it is all pointless. As he leaves, she gives a mask to him as a gift for being the principal of Françoise Dupont High School. He leaves the store as Marinette rushes back in, greeting him along the way. Marinette explains to Socqueline that she forgot to lock her scooter. Socqueline laughs at it and asks her to return the Alliance ring. As Marinette gives it to her, it suddenly activates and congratulates Marinette on covering a hundred and thirty kilometers in fifteen minutes, which hints toward her alter ego activities. Seeing this, Socqueline asks what she did to her ring. Marinette panics and says that she must have screwed up the controls. Socqueline believes it and proceeds to reset the settings.

title: Jubilation
text:
Jubilation - Plot
Meanwhile, at Gabriel's atelier, Gabriel gets an alert on his Alliance ring, so he proceeds to his lair. On arriving, he asks the ring what happened. His ring avatar revealed to be his wife, Émilie, replies that superhuman capabilities have been recorded on Socqueline's Alliance ring, which is 135 kilometers covered between 11:02 am and 11:12 am. When he asks about Ladybug's latest appearance, she replies that it is of the same period. Seeing this, Gabriel believes that he has found Ladybug's real identity. He transforms into Monarch and listens to the civilians' negative emotions, and finds Mr. Denis Damoclès. Satisfied by his negative emotion, Monarch absorbs Kaalki, with the help of his Miraculous rings, and uses her power to create a Voyage portal, to send a Megakuma to Mr. Denis Damoclès' location.

title: Jubilation
text:
Jubilation - Plot
At Les Olympiades, the Megakuma exits the Voyage portal and infects Mr. Denis Damoclès' mask. With the connection established, Monarch tells him that the girl who discouraged him from being a superhero is none other than Ladybug. When Mr. Denis Damoclès expresses his surprise, Monarch provokes him further by saying Ladybug and Cat Noir believe that only they have the right to be a superhero. But unlike them, Monarch likes to share, so he absorbs Daizzi and transfers the power of Jubilation to Mr. Denis Damoclès through the Alliance ring. After the transfer of power, Mr. Denis Damoclès transforms into Darker Owl; the powerful version of Dark Owl.
At the Arts and Crafts shop, Socqueline is resetting her Alliance ring. Marinette tries to leave, but Socqueline stops her and gives her the paint. As Marinette exits, Tikki complains that she didn't convince her friend to stop pretending to be Ladybug. Marinette replies how can she explain her without really unmasking her? But when Tikki glares at her, Marinette complies and returns to the store.

title: Jubilation
text:
Jubilation - Plot
At the store, Darker Owl barges in and demands the Ladybug Miraculous from Socqueline since he believes her to be the real Ladybug. On seeing him, Socqueline quickly turns on her Alliance ring and records the part where she says that the Megakuma is in his mask. After that, she drops it and pushes it under a shelf. As Darker Owl chases her, she constantly denies that she is not Ladybug. Marinette arrives at the scene and she thinks that Monarch is after Socqueline since she has played Ladybug too many times. She runs away to transform into Ladybug. Darker Owl uses Gift on Socqueline to immobilize her. The Gift shows her an illusion of Ladybug and Cat Noir, who thank her for help. Darker Owl snatches her earring while she's trapped in the illusion. But he sees that the earrings are not the Ladybug Miraculous and realize that she is not the real Ladybug. Regardless, Monarch decides that she is still helpful to them. Ladybug arrives at the store but finds nobody. She sees that Socqueline's Alliance ring plays the recording while Darker Owl holds her hostage.

title: Jubilation
text:
Jubilation - Plot
Meanwhile, in Adrien's room, which is in disarray for some reason, Adrien is sadly playing a video game while Plagg is playing with his Alliance ring. Suddenly the Alliance ring broadcasts a transmission of the Darker Owl. Through the transmission, he declares that he has Socqueline as a hostage, and she is hanging above a can of paint. He orders Ladybug and Cat Noir to bring their Miraculouses, or he will drop Socqueline below. As the transmission ends, Adrien transforms into Cat Noir.

title: Jubilation
text:
Jubilation - Plot
At Les Olympiades, Socqueline is hanging upside down, struggling to break free. Ladybug arrives and begins to battle Darker Owl. Soon Cat Noir also enters the scene and warns Ladybug to be cautious. Suddenly, Darker Owl presses his remote control, which releases Socqueline from her captivity. Due to this, she begins to fall head first to the ground, much to Ladybug's panic. She yells at Cat Noir, and he jumps to save Socqueline. Ladybug uses Lucky Charm and gets an alarm clock, but when she uses her Lucky Vision, she finds nothing. Meanwhile, Cat Noir saves Socqueline and tells her to hide. As Darker Owl prepares to attack him with his hook, Ladybug warns him about it. As a result, both topple each other, much to Darker Owl's advantage. He quickly fires his gun with the Pig Miraculous' power at Ladybug and Cat Noir, using the power of Jubilation.

title: Jubilation
text:
Jubilation - Plot
Since both are hit by Gift, their greatest desire appears in front of their eyes. In their dream, Ladybug dodges the attack and throws the alarm clock at Darker Owl, which breaks his mask and releases the Megakuma. Ladybug captures it and de-akumatizes Mr. Denis Damoclès. They search for the Pig Miraculous, but find a fancy business card in Mr. Denis Damoclès' pocket. They see that it contains Monarch's address.
The scene shifts to Monarch's Lair, where Ladybug and Cat Noir simultaneously punch Monarch and knock him down. Ladybug triumphantly grabs the Butterfly Miraculous from him. Later at the Eiffel Tower, Ladybug puts all the stolen Miraculouses into the Miracle Box, and the Parisians cheer for the two heroes.

title: Jubilation
text:
Jubilation - Plot
After that, they together visit the cinema and talk about Monarch's defeat and how they can continue their relationship since Monarch is no longer a threat. They are about to kiss when suddenly, a humongous alarm clock begins the ring, and Mr. Denis Damoclès yells at them to shut it off. While all this is happening, back in reality, Darker Owl slowly and menacingly approaches the two heroes to snatch their Miraculous. But due to the effect of Gift, the heroes are blankly staring at the ground.

title: Jubilation
text:
Jubilation - Plot
Back in the dream, Ladybug shuts off the alarm clock, and she and Cat Noir finally kiss. The scene shifts to a church, where Ladybug and Cat Noir come out as newlyweds and the rest of the heroes are outside cheering for the two of them. Ladybug turns around and throws her bouquet behind her. But Rena Rouge catches an alarm clock instead and all the heroes cover their ears from the sudden loud ringing, and Rena Rouge shuts off the alarm clock. In back to reality, Darker Owl is only an inch away from Ladybug's Miraculous. Again back in the dream, the duo, along with some other heroes, are standing on the rooftops while a lot of alarm clocks fly in the sky. Cat Noir is holding a knapsack, which contains a baby. Ladybug gives him a milk bottle and warns him not to cataclysm the bottle. In reality, Darker Owl is slowly approaching her earrings.

title: Jubilation
text:
Jubilation - Plot
In the dream, the duo are resting on a beach with their babies. Suddenly, the alarm clock begins to ring, but Ladybug shuts it off and continues to rest. The scene again shifts to Pont des Arts, where Ladybug secures the stroller's seatbelt on one of the babies. Cat Noir hands her ice cream, and they share a lovely moment while watching the sunset. But Ladybug spits out a small alarm clock. She sees several giant alarm clocks ring behind the buildings, float by the river, and even the babies turn into alarm clocks. Ladybug realizes that everything is only temporary, a dream. She explains it to Cat Noir, who becomes heartbroken and devastated by this. Ladybug and Cat Noir share a kiss, due to which they wake up from the dream.

title: Jubilation
text:
Jubilation - Plot
Back into reality, Ladybug has finally released herself from the dream and locks the Darker Owl's arm behind him to keep him immobile. Still trying to win, the Darker Owl fires his hook gun and ricochets back at Ladybug, which she dodges quickly. The Darker Owl kicks Ladybug off the wall. Cat Noir charges towards the Darker Owl and furiously tries to cataclysm the Darker Owl for playing with his feelings. But with Ladybug's warning, Cat Noir manages to restrain himself and cataclysms the mask and releases the Megakuma. On being de-akumatized, Daizzi is brought back to the pod in Monarch's lair. Ladybug walks toward Mr. Denis Damoclès but fails to find the Pig Miraculous (or the business card with Monarch's address like in a dream). Upon giving him a magical charm, she uses the Miraculous Ladybug superpower to bring everything back to normal.
In Monarch's lair, Daizzi weakly comments that he is hungry. Angrily, Monarch snaps his fingers, which provide him with pet food and vows that he will soon have their Miraculouses.

title: Jubilation
text:
Jubilation - Plot
At Socqueline's arts and crafts store, Socqueline apologizes for impersonating her. Ladybug forgives her by saying that she should help her without putting herself in danger. After that, Marinette goes to her home and gives the paint supplies to her mother. Sabine thanks her and gives her an Alliance ring as a gift for being the most wonderful daughter. But Marinette declines it since it will be more helpful for Sabine in taking orders. When Marinette reaches her room, Tikki asks why she refused the gift. Marinette explains that after today's incident, she realized it would be too dangerous to wear as Ladybug. Back downstairs, Sabine begins setting up her Alliance ring.
In the epilogue scene, on the top of the Rooftops of the Jardins du Trocadero, Ladybug and Cat Noir are sitting beside each other, discussing their recent fight. They are confused about how Monarch gave the Power of Jubilation without giving the Pig Miraculous. When asked about their dream, Ladybug replies that Monarch must have altered the power somehow since their dream about their wedding and babies would be totally weird. Cat Noir agrees to this, and both continue to ponder over their dream.

title: Jubilation
text:
Jubilation - Plot developments
It's revealed that the power of Gift can force its targets to actually live their deepest wishes/dreams, instead of just showing them, rendering them completely vulnerable.
It can also affect multiple targets at the same time, and, when this happens, their deepest dreams are combined into one, evidenced by how Ladybug and Cat Noir's dream is the only one with traits of their respective desires: Ladybug's wish to defeat Monarch and recover all the Miraculous, and Cat Noir's wish to have Ladybug fall in love with him, marry her and have a family with her.
This episode shows how the powers of the Pig Miraculous can be used for evil, as it forces people to live their wildest dreams in a way that becomes real to them and, once they wake up in reality, they are left in a profound state of sadness, the exact opposite of its intended purpose.
Which is also understandable too because within the dreamworld anyone can have anything they desire so easily without rules, consequences or obstacles (physically) in the way as compared to be with the real world where we can't have everything we desire yet in a sense people feel stuck deciding between: can our dreams become real or not.

title: Jubilation
text:
Jubilation - Plot developments
In Ladybug's dream, she and Cat Noir intend to retrieve every Miraculous Monarch stole from them in their original form, unaware that in real world, Monarch turned them into rings until "Deflagration".
In "Emotion", Cat Noir as Adrien finally had his partner as his girlfriend and Marinette as Ladybug, finally had her dream come true in the "The Final Day".
Even though Ladybug isn't completely aware of it yet, she figured out that Monarch was using the Alliance rings to track her and Cat Noir, but didn't know that's how Monarch transferred the captive kwamis' powers at least until the "The Final Day".
It's revealed that Monarch is able to transfer the powers of the Miraculous by forcibly absorbing the kwamis from their cages into their respective rings and then sending them to his target's Alliance. After the villain is defeated, the kwami returns to its respective cage and are then fed by him.
The cages are fitted with feeders that dispense what looks like generic pet food.

title: Jubilation
text:
Jubilation - Plot developments
It's also revealed that the Alliance rings, which not only serve for Monarch to transfer the powers of the kwamis, but also to inform him whenever their owners do something that is humanly impossible to do, like going through a big distance in a very short period of time.

title: Jubilation
text:
Jubilation - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in Brazil on Gloob.
The episode shares its name with the concept of the Pig Miraculous.
Socqueline dreams of Ladybug and Cat Noir being grateful to her for all of her help as a superhero. Her wish does become true since she helps Ladybug realize that when she transforms into Ladybug while still wearing the Alliance ring, it records all of her activities. Seeing this, she realized that if she continued to use the Alliance ring, someone could discover her alter ego.
Some characters are expressing great happiness for themselves or others and in other episodes:
Socqueline is happy for Marinette for her confidence and knows Adrien Agreste.
She also admires Ladybug for her protection over Paris where she dresses up like her to help others.
Like "The Evillustrator" and other episodes where it was suppose to be a day of joy like a birthday.
Gabriel was overjoyed to learn from an Alliance ring and believed Socqueline was Ladybug, but was unaware Marinette had her Alliance ring at that time.
In "Sapotis", Alya felt great joy at becoming a superhero and working alongside Ladybug.

title: Jubilation
text:
Jubilation - Trivia

title: Jeu de Paume
text:
Jeu de Paume - Intro
is an art center dedicated to the exhibition of contemporary art dedicated to the image and photography located in the Jardin des Tuileries, at the Place de la Concorde in Paris.

title: Jeu de Paume
text:
Jeu de Paume - Description
Located at the northwestern end of the Jardin des Tuileries, the Jeu de Paume is a neoclassical building built in 1861 at the request of Napoleon III to house tennis courts.
Based on the plans of the Musée de l'Orangerie, of which it is the counterpart, the Jeu de Paume is a building 80 meters long, 13 meters wide and with a surface area of ​​2,754.50 m2. On the Place de la Concorde side, the entrance consists of a rectangular door with a rounded top surrounded by two columns supporting a decorated triangular pediment.
The sides consist of a two-story portico closed by bay windows on the south side and walls on the north side. Its roof is a hipped slate roof and has a few windows.

title: Jeu de Paume
text:
Jeu de Paume - Trivia
Despite its evocative name, this place has nothing to do with the place where the Serment du Jeu de Paume took place, the decisive prequel moment of the French Revolution of 1789.
The Salle du Jeu de Paume in question is located in Versailles (78).
Since its construction, the Jeu de Paume has had several uses:
Tennis courts from 1861 to 1909.
Exhibition space for works belonging to the Louvre Museum and the Musée de l'Orangerie from 1909 to 1922.
Exhibition space for contemporary works from foreign schools from 1922 to 1940.
During the Second World War and until the liberation of Paris in August 1944, the Jeu de Paume was requisitioned by the Nazis to house works of art stolen from Jews and other deportees.
From 1947 to 1986, the Jeu de Paume exhibited paintings by the Impressionists.
From 1991 to 2004, it became the Jeu de Paume national gallery dedicated to modern and contemporary art in all its forms.
Since 2004, the Jeu de Paume has been an exhibition space for contemporary photography and video.

title: Jeu de Paume
text:
Jeu de Paume - Trivia
The appearance of the Jeu de Paume differs slightly in the series compared to reality. In the series, it is a perfect copy of the Musée de l'Orangerie, while in reality there are several, especially with regard to the bay windows and the type of entrances.

title: Johnny Grassette
text:
Johnny Grassette - Intro
is a minor character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He is the father of the late Gabriel Agreste, the romantic partner of Gabrielle Grassette, and the paternal grandfather of Adrien Agreste.
In "Werepapas", when Milly Graham de Vanily gets akumatized into the Ringmaster, she transforms Johnny and Emil Graham de Vanily into Werepapas, a boxing-themed werewolf duo. He and Emil are forced to fight with each other for their grandson's custody.

title: Johnny Grassette
text:
Johnny Grassette - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Johnny is an average height man. He has pale, light grayish cerulean colored eyes and white long slick back hair with a goatee.
Civilian Attire
Johnny sports a black t-shirt with a white Jagged Stone imprint and black jeans flared with flames at the bottom, a brown belt with a golden buckle that has an engraved 59, and a silver chain on his left. On his left wrist he has a rubber bracelet with metallic silver spikes; on his right hand he wears a silver ring. He has a grayish arctic denim jacket with a red bandana tied around his left arm over the jacket as well as classic metallic silver shoes.

title: Johnny Grassette
text:
Johnny Grassette - Personality
In contrast with his late son, Johnny is a very chill and liberated man who takes great pride in his family legacy of selling french fries. He doesn't seem to believe in traditional social engagements and customs such as marriage, which is why he and his partner Gabrielle are not legally engaged.
Although he is usually calm, he can also be very quick to anger, which is showcased in "Werepapas", when he got extremely confrontational over Lord Emil insulting his family lineage. He also seems very helpful, as instead of just giving Marinette his ballotins to put them in the oven, he opted to do it himself.

Jéola - Etymology
The name Jéola is of Hebrew origin and is considered a variant of the name Joel, meaning "Yahweh is God" or "God is willing".
Interestingly, in the credits for "Miraculous Tokyo", her name is listed as Jeolla, which may be a reference to a province in Korea.

title: Jéola
text:
Jéola - Trivia
Jéola can be associated with the Virgo sign in various ways:
The Virgo constellation is depicted as a virgin, a person who has never engaged in impure activities or is inexperienced in some sort of matter.
It can also relate to Christianity because of the birth of Jesus. Jesus was a virgin in Bethlehem, so he is symbolically connected to Virgo. Because of the Virgo sign's religious ties with Jesus, and he is the son of God, the etymology behind Jéola's name is quite meaningful.
Jéola's theme color is teal, which is a theme color the Virgo sign can represent as an earth sign.
However, the Virgo sign is also associated with the color brown.
Jéola's attire seems to cover her up quite a lot. It could make sense that this would tie her in with the Virgo sign because people who are a Virgo tend to be introverted.
