title: Jessica Keynes/History
text:
Jessica Keynes/History - Intro
Jessica Keynes is a student in Professor Gate's class at Armstrong High School. She is also a superhero in the United States of America and the partner and daughter of Knightowl. She is also the current holder of the Eagle Miraculous, using it to transform into Eagle.

title: Jessica Keynes/History
text:
Jessica Keynes/History - [[Miraculous New York]]
She was initially known as Sparrow, being the latest in a line of teacher and student who have worn the masks of the legendary hero duo, Knightowl and Sparrow. Working with Knightowl alongside the mother-daughter duo of Majestia and Uncanny Valley, Sparrow protects the aircraft carrying a class from College Francois Dupont in Paris from the American super-villain Techno-Pirate, helping to subdue him and take him into custody.
Later, Jessica is assigned with Aeon to watch over the French class during their stay in New York at the hotel they were checked into. To further help the French students mingle with the American students from Armstrong High in Queens, Aeon and Jessica get some help from Hot Dog Dan to make that happen, even starting to take special interest in Marinette and Adrien and trying to bolster their relationship into a legit boyfriend-girlfriend couple.

title: Jessica Keynes/History
text:
Jessica Keynes/History - [[Miraculous New York]]
However, when Techno-Pirate is spotted infiltrating a nearby museum, Jessica and Aeon disobey orders with calling for backup from Majestia and Knightowl and go to confront him alone, soon joined by the French Miraculous Duo in Ladybug and Cat Noir, as they realized that Techno-Pirate had been Akumatized by their arch-enemy, Hawk Moth, into Techlonizer.
Unfortunately, before Ladybug and Cat Noir joined them, Uncanny was stripped of her third eye and most of her weapons by Techlonizer, leaving only her rockets and physical strength to fight him with, putting Uncanny and Sparrow at a disadvantage.
Techlonizer then escapes outside, forcing Uncanny, Sparrow, Ladybug, and Cat Noir to pursue him until confronting him on a rooftop.
During their confrontation on the roof, Cat Noir lowers his guard when Ladybug chews him out over breaking her trust by coming to NYC to help her after she told him to stay in Paris and alert her of any trouble there from Hawk Moth or Mayura, and Techlonizer takes advantage to hurl him towards Ladybug, threatening to kill her with his still-active Cataclysm.
Uncanny takes the hit herself, mortally wounding her.

title: Jessica Keynes/History
text:
Jessica Keynes/History - [[Miraculous New York]]
Sensing it, Majestia and Knightowl immediately rush to the scene, and Techlonizer ends up being punched through several buildings by a grief-stricken Majestia as she doesn't hold back punishing him for harming her surrogate daughter.
Knightowl recovers Marquis de Lafayette's saber that Techlonizer had stolen from the museum, and Hawk Moth uses the opportunity to have Techno-Pirate escape with him, while also having secured his target in the Miraculous of the Eagle.
Though Ladybug is able to restore Uncanny using her Miraculous Ladybug, Knightowl is furious with Sparrow for disobeying her orders, and grounds her from further action, while demanding that Ladybug and Cat Noir hand over their Miraculous for interfering in United Heroez business and won't get them back until they leave New York.
Refusing, Ladybug and Cat Noir flee, to Knightowl's chagrin and fury, and she attempts to pursue them, but they escape into the sewers before Knightowl finds them and revert back to Marinette and Adrien to throw her off their trail.

title: Jessica Keynes/History
text:
Jessica Keynes/History - [[Miraculous New York]]
Later, Jessica and Aeon ask Olympia and Barbara for another chance to go after Techno-Pirate, but Barbara sternly refuses, and Olympia has to agree with her. Jessica calls her mom out for her stubbornness and being adamant that Jessica and Aeon are not ready to be on their own, separate from the adult United Heroez yet, but Barbara refuses to change her mind because of the earlier incident, and considers the matter closed as she and Olympia head off to attend the press conference with President Hombee to announce that the Franco-American Friendship Festival is postponed until Techno-Pirate is brought to justice. Despite Jessica's frustration with their mothers, Aeon agrees that they can still try to help. They just have to bend the rules a little bit.

title: Jessica Keynes/History
text:
Jessica Keynes/History - [[Miraculous New York]]
However, when Techno-Pirate, Akumatized again as Techlonizer, and then given the Eagle Miraculous to become Miraclonizer, uses the Miraculous' power of Liberation to send the adult United Heroez on a rampage with them free of their moral and ethnical restraints, Jessica is forced to disobey orders again as, joined by Ladybug, she tries to manage damage control in NYC, despite having another encounter with Knightowl, who again loses her temper at Sparrow disobeying her.
Joined by Uncanny, who managed to get Cat Noir to help them again, they trick Doorman to provide a way for them into the Statue of Liberty, where Miraclonizer was preparing to launch a nuclear missile he commandeered from Victory under Hawk Moth's orders if Ladybug and Cat Noir refused to surrender their Miraculous to him.
Working together, Sparrow, Uncanny, Ladybug, and Cat Noir manage to outsmart Miraclonizer and take back the Eagle Miraculous, turning him back into Techlonizer.
Upon being given the Eagle Miraculous herself, and encouraged by the Eagle Miraculous' Kwami Liiri, Jessica sheds her Sparrow costume as she activates the Eagle Miraculous and becomes the Miraculous superheroine Eagle.

title: Jessica Keynes/History
text:
Jessica Keynes/History - [[Miraculous New York]]
She then reverses the effects of Liberation on the adult United Heroez, returning them to normal just in time.
The nuke launches, as Cat Noir and Ladybug look on in horror as Hawk Moth makes good on his ultimatum, but Majestia is able to intercept it and hurl it into the Sun, preventing a potential nuclear war.

title: Jessica Keynes/History
text:
Jessica Keynes/History - [[Miraculous New York]]
After that, Knightowl, Eagle, Ladybug, Cat Noir, and Uncanny, manage to defeat and de-Akumatize Techno-Pirate, leaving him to be arrested and taken to prison as he's handed over to the NYPD Emergency Service Unit SWAT team to be hauled off to Riker's Island Penitentiary. When Eagle fears Knightowl will be furious with her again for disobeying her, Knightowl realizes her folly in being too strict with Sparrow, and agrees to allow her to have some more freedom, and voices how proud she is of her and her efforts with becoming a Miraculous user, also deciding to shed her Knightowl costume and its voice changer to take a different stance on her role. Both Knightowl and Majestia also thank Ladybug and Cat Noir for inspiring Eagle and Uncanny, and apologize for their earlier prejudice against them due to their overprotectiveness of their daughters, leading to Ladybug and Cat Noir having Uncanny and Eagle join them in their trademark "Pound It!" fist-bump after a victory.

title: Jessica Keynes/History
text:
Jessica Keynes/History - [[Miraculous New York]]
After the French Heroes return home, Uncanny Valley and Eagle are about to ambush a group of criminals in an alleyway before a man — a Guardian with the Native American Miracle Box — appears and demands the Eagle Miraculous be returned. Eagle proposes that, instead, he should help start a new generation of heroes in New York.

title: Jessica Keynes/History
text:
Jessica Keynes/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Re-creation", she, along with the rest of the United Heroez, fought against the Miraculized, first in New York, rescuing as many of the American citizens that they can, with Eagle using her power of Liberation to free them from Nightormentor's nightmares that turned them into Miraculized in the first place, then in Paris when Uncanny realizes that Ladybug and Cat Noir may be in trouble, joining the Guardians, Resistance, and Ladydragon in trying to fight off the Miraculized with those citizens free of being Miraculized trying to help, but they were still outnumbered vastly, and when Majestia somberly reports she was unable to find Ladybug or Cat Noir after Uncanny sent her out earlier to look for them, it looks like things are extremely grim for Eagle and the other allies of Ladybug and Cat Noir as the Miraculized keep coming and vastly outnumber all of the good guys and civilians helping them.

title: Jessica Keynes/History
text:
Jessica Keynes/History - [[Season 5]]
However, as shown in "Miraculous London", after Gabriel makes his wish, and Ladybug fixes everything with Miraculous Ladybug, Eagle and the rest of the United Heroez are saved as the Miraculized are reverted to normal with no memory of what happened. Afterwards, the United Heroez returned to the USA, and later learned via the news from Ladybug of Gabriel's sacrifice to end Monarch's threat once and for all. Unknown to them, Ladybug had lied to them, as Gabriel was Monarch, but Ladybug had upheld Gabriel's last request to her that no one, not even Adrien, ever found out or knew of his evil actions.

title: Jessica Keynes/History
text:
Jessica Keynes/History - [[Miraculous Tokyo]]
Eagle makes a cameo appearance at the end of Miraculous Tokyo, as she, Knightowl, Majestia, Uncanny, and Cat Noir are dealing with their own threat of some giant monster emerging over New York from a portal, the first thing being its six-fingered hand reaching out towards them as they tense for battle.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Intro
(剣 かがみ, Tsurugi Kagami in Japanese order) is one of the two tritagonists (alongside Luka Couffaine) of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She is also one the two main protagonists (alongside Marinette Dupain-Cheng) of "Miraculous World: Tokyo, Stellar Force". She is a human-sentimonster created by her mother Tomoe Tsurugi through her vision of a perfect child from her emotion of pride. Though initially only a student of Armand D'Argencourt's fencing class, she later enrolled fully at the Collège Françoise Dupont starting from season 6. She has attracted the attention of Adrien Agreste as his fencing rival.
In "Riposte", after losing a fencing battle with Adrien due to Marinette's decision as referee, she was akumatized by Hawk Moth into Riposte, a fencing-themed supervillain.
In "Oni-Chan", after seeing a picture of Lila Rossi kissing Adrien, Kagami was akumatized into Oni-Chan, an oni and rose-themed supervillain.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Intro
In "Ikari Gozen", after she was imprisoned by the titular akumatized supervillain, Ladybug gave her the Dragon Miraculous in order to both free her and defeat Ikari Gozen. When the Miraculous is inhabited by Longg, Kagami becomes Ryuko (龍子 in Japanese), a dragon-themed superhero with the power of Perfection who helps Ladybug and Cat Noir "during particularly difficult missions" in the third season and beyond.
In "Lies", after realizing and confronting Adrien about how she thought he'd been lying for not spending his time with her, Kagami was akumatized by Shadow Moth into Lies, a ghost-like supervillain with the ability to permanently paralyze anyone who has ever lied in their whole life. The next day, Adrien asked if he and Kagami could still be friends. Kagami said she would let him know when she was ready to see him again.
After the events of "Strikeback", Kagami was temporarily unable to become Ryuko after Monarch managed to steal the Dragon Miraculous along with all the others contained in the Chinese Miracle Box from Ladybug's yo-yo.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Intro
In "Perfection", after being tricked by Lila into thinking that Marinette didn't think of her as a friend, Kagami was akumatized by Monarch into Ryukomori, a giant supervillain made of clouds that was unable to see or hear anyone and who received the Dragon Miraculous superpower through her Alliance ring. She also received a Magical Charm from Ladybug to prevent her from being reakumatized.
In "Protection", when Lila persuades Kagami into believing that Marinette was a liar, Kagami was akumatized by Monarch into Riposte Prime, an upgraded version of her previous akumatized form Riposte, who received the Turtle Miraculous superpower through her Alliance ring. She also received a new Magical Charm from Ladybug after her first one got destroyed, which she initially refused to take as it was no match for Megakumas, but Marinette and Adrien eventually convinced her to accept it.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Intro
In "Pretension", Kagami properly met Félix and eventually, they ran off, so much so that her mother voluntarily got akumatized to find her while Kagami also got to know him better. After Félix recovered the ring used to control Kagami and returned it back to her, they developed feelings for each other and became a couple in secret.
In "Representation", it is revealed that Kagami knows that Marinette is Ladybug after overhearing her talking to Alya on Liberty. She was taken by Argos to Paris again and informed him of it. She then allowed herself to be amokized by Argos and their desire to tell the truth to Marinette formed Once Upon a Time, a projector-themed sentimonster, and they told the story of the Agreste, Graham de Vanily, and Fathom families. After telling her Gabriel Agreste was Monarch, they urged her to stop him, so everyone could be free and have a happy ending. After returning to London, the two were confident that Marinette would stop him.
In "Re-creation", after Marinette recovered the stolen Miraculous following Monarch's defeat, Kagami was given back the Dragon Miraculous permanently and reunited with Longg.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Intro
In "Miraculous London", Kagami was released from her prison room in London by Bug Noire, and, at her request, she hid from Adrien the fact that his father was Monarch and also decided to talk with her mother about her role as Monarch's accomplice.
In "Miraculous Tokyo", it's revealed that Kagami used to be part of a group of friends back when she lived in Tokyo, but never really felt like she belonged in it, with her only real connection being with a boy named Kazuno for whom she had a crush on.
In "Sleeping Syren", it's shown that Kagami, as Ryuko, has been meeting Félix, as Argos, midway between Paris and London, while using the space power-up.
In "Revelator", it's shown that, after getting her Miraculous back, Kagami, along with the other secondary heroes of Ladybug's team, was trained to unlock her adult powers, no longer detransforming after using her power.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Appearance
Physical Appearance
In the first four seasons, Kagami is a tall Japanese teenage girl of average height. She has light skin, a lighter dusting of light-brown freckles on her cheeks and the bridge of nose, sharp, slanted moderate vermilion eyes and thick straight black hair with blue reflections with bangs swept to the left in a face-framing bob that levels with her chin, with dark blue tints.
From Season 6 onwards, Kagami's hair becomes slightly shorter and is now styled in pixie cut with heavy bangs in the front and a fringe in the back.
Civilian Attire

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Appearance
In the first four seasons and throughout "Miraculous Tokyo", Kagami wore a white long-sleeved blazer as part of her Kano Academy uniform. The blazer featured black outlines around the collar, extending to the hem, cuffs, and two black accents on the top of the outer pockets. It had two gold pockets around the waist and at the cuffs. On the top right of her chest, there was a logo shaped like a reuleaux triangle, which included her family's crest. This crest displayed the gold kanji character for female (女, on'na) on top of green, white, and red fabric, all framed with a gold outline. Underneath the blazer, she wore a black collared button-up blouse with gold buttons, paired with a red, white, and blue pleated necktie.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Appearance
Kagami also wore a red skirt with an asymmetrical texture that had blue and white intersecting vertical and horizontal lines. She wore tight black leggings and a pair of red sneakers with white toecaps, laces, a black logo on the heel counter and black soles. On the ring finger of her right hand, she wore a black ring that has her family's crest, and it had two long outward spikes stretching from the mark resembling a saber. On occasion until "Re-creation", she wore the Dragon Miraculous as a black string with a red pendant as a choker.
At the end of "Miraculous Tokyo" and from Season 6 onwards, Kagami's new outfit is an open white cropped Perfecto-styled leather jacket over a black collared shirt and a red top below. Her red plaid skirt is a pleated mini, with a white pin attached to the left side. Her shoes are red buckled cloafers with black platforms and black tights. She seems to still be wearing a ring on the ring finger of her right hand. Her Miraculous alters into having a thinner string, and the bead turns dark red with dark chartreuse splotches.
As Ryuko

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Appearance
In Seasons 3-5, Ryuko wore a vivid red and black dragon-themed superhero jumpsuit with the image of a spiked black dragon's tail, outlined in brilliant golden yellow, curling from her left leg up to her chest. The end of the tail curves around the symbol containing the images that represent the three elements she controls: lightning, wind and water, each being yellow, light silver, and blue respectively with darker outlines. She also had a black collar/turtleneck with a flame-like bottom and gold lining on top (where she had her choker that is now black with five red vertical lines), black forearm-length gloves and black legs starting in the middle of her lower legs, both with yellow outlining. On the back of her head, she had four red dragon-like horns with yellow tips with black outlining and, on her back, she had a holder for her sword. On her face, she wore a vivid mask around her eyes with yellow and black outlining at the base of the sides to resemble fangs. Her eyes also become moderate amber with vivid yellow scleras.
From Season 6 onwards, Ryuko's costume undergoes some changes.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Appearance
Her jumpsuit gets more black, with it being on her inferior members, back, left shoulder, right forearm, the bottom half of her right upper arm, and the lower half of her body, while the front of her torso, left arm, right shoulder, the top half of her right upper arm, and right leg are bright red with gold trimming.
Her inferior members have also bright red circling them: the left one on the thigh and the right one on the leg.
She possesses golden shoulder pads and a golden outline separating the black and the bright red, with that outline curving on the right side of her chest around the symbol containing the images that represent the three elements she controls: lightning, air and water.
It has four spikes on the top to resemble a dragon's tail.
Her four horns are also longer and arched.
Her right arm has golden lining resembling the tip of a flame.
The accents on her torso also are widely spiked diagonally, looking like flames a lot more, including the bright red flame-shaped patch on her left leg that has a swirl near the tip.
Her soles are black on the right leg and red on the left leg.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Appearance
Her collar is more open with red an black split sides, while the Miraculous alters in design, turning into a golden eye-shaped pendant with a dark mulberry circle in the middle and five curved dark gold spikes on top.
On her back, she has the symbol of the Dragon Miraculous, which is more intricate and gold.
Her hair grows slightly longer making it a bob-cut and has two sidelocks framing her face.
As Riposte/Riposte Prime
Riposte had a striking appearance, with silver sclerae and skin contrasted by her red eyes. She wore a silver helmet featuring angular sides and a red circle at the center of her forehead, adorned with the Tsurugi crest. Her armor was also silver, consisting of a breastplate, pauldrons, and tassets, while her arms were entirely silver.  Her dress shoes featured two downward chevron stripes on the ankles and were paired with her silver leggings, which ended in cone-shaped high heels. On her right hand, she sported a sword-like extension complete with a triangular guard, which also featured a red circle centered with the Tsurugi crest.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Appearance
When she was akumatized into Riposte Prime, her appearance remained similar to that of Riposte. However, she wielded a large saber sword with a red edge in her hand, and her right hand reverted to a normal hand. She wore a silver Alliance ring on the index finger of her right hand.
As Oni-Chan
Oni-Chan had wild, pointy, black hair, and her face was obscured by a white Japanese ogre's mask, which had protruding tusks. From the forehead protruded a red horn, with black lines along the bottom. The eyes and mouth are outlined by thick, black lines, and her eyes were moderate crimson and she had moderate purple lipstick. She had a white super-suit with blue-violetish black vine shaped-stripes and her insignia (a black rose with a red horn) on the chest. Red spikes with black spirals donned her shoulders and elbows with black lines in the middle of the spikes. Her forearms and legs from the knee down were all black. Her hands. turtleneck, and feet were red as well. Her soles were black. She wielded a bokken with a black and white handle with the blade made from red thorny vines twisting together.
As Lies

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Appearance
Lies was a ghost-like humanoid completely transparent and light cyanish-gray with a lighter gray outline from head to toe. She was holding Marinette's lucky charm on her wrist. Her hair was more flattened than her civilian form with
curly bangs on her face's sides. She also seemed to wear a jumpsuit with a circular collar around her neck, an almost invisible mask, hidden wedged knee-high boots on her feet, and fingerless gloves on both her hands. On her torso was a logo with three circles stacked together, the center one being bigger with dots within the other ones, and a ring in the middle one.
As Ryukomori
Ryukomori had a gigantic size and her body was completely made of clouds, all while keeping the shape of her body which seemed to be naked. Normally, the clouds that made her body were white, but they became dark gray whenever she got angry.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Personality
Kagami is a fierce and thoughtful girl who is dedicated to accomplishing any commitment she makes. Taught by her mother to be a relentless perfectionist by placing high expectations on her, she dedicates herself to anything she has an interest in until she masters it without a flaw. This also causes her to be quite confident, while also being somewhat reluctant and quite stubborn, willing to go out and take risks, regardless of what is at stake for her. Her perfectionism also causes her to possess a very strong competitive spirit, causing her to be quite emotive and rage-prone in spite of her composed exterior, whenever she loses. However, she learns from her mistakes, knowing there are times she isn't the winner. When it comes to those she cares about, she is very brave and protective, willing to put herself in danger to keep her loved ones safe.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Personality
Kagami is an aggressive fencer, being unforgivable whenever her opponents show her any opening. While she doesn't like to lose, she is able to downplay her upset feelings and respect her rivals, like Adrien Agreste. That competitive nature also causes her to search for bigger challenges, resulting on her to taunt her opponents whenever they show weakeness against her, in this way trying to spice them up and motivating them to do better, so that she can also do better as well. Her agressiveness only increases whenever her emotional state becomes more intense, as evidenced in "Lies", after her akumatization into the titular villain, as she was still upset with Adrien for lying to her and discharged her anger on him during their practice duel.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Personality
Despite her wits, Kagami has a small habit of jumping to conclusions and/or being quick to judge a person's character with an initial contact, something possible learned from her mother. Before trying to approach her in "Ikari Gozen", Kagami quickly assumed that Marinette Dupain-Cheng was uncompatible with her in terms of friendship due to her more unusual nature. In "Oni-Chan", upon seeing a picture of Adrien (whom she had a crush on) and Lila Rossi together, she immediately assumed that Lila was the girl he told her about in "Frozer". However, after learning more about friendship with Marinette, Kagami came to try to look through appearances in order to know about a person's true nature.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Personality
She comes across as blunt and willing to speak her mind, telling Philippe that she didn't want to take skating lessons multiple times and even speaking for Adrien when asked. This bluntness of hers, combined with her initial ineptitude for socialization, would cause her to speak up observations that would come up as offensive to others, even if she never meant to, while also being very literal. This was seen in her very first interactions with teenagers her age where she ended up creating some intense rivalry with Miki and being willing to "earn" her friendship through a competition. However, despite this, Kagami is a very hospitable person who ironically forms friendships with people after they both approach each other and solve their conflicts, suggesting an understanding side.  This is more evident when she advises Marinette to stop hesitating.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Personality
In "Ikari Gozen", Kagami is shown to be a bit lonely as she always wanted friends, and she admitted to Ladybug that she doesn't have any. Yet, she was willing to reach out to Marinette, someone she was uncertain about at the time, in an attempt to be friends with her. However, much like when Adrien started studying at school and making new friends, Kagami, because of her mother, initially didn't know much about how to bond with others. This is shown when she tries to befriend Marinette, only resulting in awkward moments, and using an app about how to make friends. These attempts include traditional Japanese friendship tropes such as blood typing, horoscopes, personality compatibility, and a forced smile when attempting to discuss any of them.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Personality
Through having friends and being outside of her mother's strict rules, Kagami started to become more playful and fun-loving and enjoys being disobedient at times as seen in "Heart Hunter". Just like Adrien, Kagami started to value the new friends she would make, not wanting to hurt or lose them. However, no matter how much it pained her, she wasn't willing to abdicate her own happiness for them. This is seen in her resolution on the same episode in pursuing Adrien romantically, despite knowing that would hurt Marinette, as she knew that, no matter who ends up with him, someone would be heartbroken over it and, thus, isn't willing to let him go, even for the sake of friendship, showing a realistic side. She would still like to be able to date Adrien and stay friends with Marinette at the same time, though.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Personality
In "Lies", Kagami showed that, in terms of friendship, she still had a lot to learn about it as one needs to accept their friend's flaws and what they like about them. Despite not knowing about Adrien's alter ego, she called him silly when he posed at her attempt at drawing him, calling his civilian self an image of perfection mostly implying like every other fan girl she's looking at him through the image Gabriel Agreste created of him.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Personality
In "Perfection", Kagami shows how much she treasures her friendship with others, especially Marinette, her very first real friend. As she was saddened that Marinette kept avoiding her to the point where she hastily believed Lila in thinking if she didn't want to be her friend, she came to believe that, if she couldn't have Marinette as a friend, she would not be able to have any at all, what caused her to feel depressed and alone, leading to her akumatization. But after seeing how much her friends did care about her, she was able to break free from it. After her de-akumatization, a talk between the girls allowed Kagami to realize that having more friends doesn't mean the friendship is divided between them, but rather multiplies. It also allowed both of them to realize that even though they are from different social classes, they have the same problem: striving for perfection out of fear of not being good enough for someone else.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Personality
As shown in "Protection", because of the pressure placed on her by her mother to be perfect, Kagami has a hard time understanding and controlling her own emotions. Finding herself in a conflictive position as she loves both Adrien (romantically) and Marinette (as her best friend), but the two of them love each other, Kagami feels a lot of emotional pain, as she, despite wanting try to conquer Adrien's love, doesn't want to hurt Marinette and lose her friendship. Being unable to deal with her feelings, she represses them, leading her to become very vulnerable to the manipulation of others, like Lila, who was able to turn her against Marinette. After finally opening up to Adrien and Marinette about her feelings and allow herself to feel the sorrow she had been repressing, Kagami was finally able to find an emotional stability and be able to accept Adrien would possibly never love her the same way she loved him.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Personality
In "Miraculous Tokyo", it's showed that Kagami's insecurities when it comes to friendship come from her very first attempt at it when she convinced her mother to let her attend a school for the first time. At first, Kagami didn't know how to interact with others, needing them to make the initiative. She initially tried to "earn" Miki's friendship through a competition and only for a determined period of time, which was something that didn't pleased her after she beat her in an "unfair" way. It was only when Kazuno stepped up to volunteer to be her friend that Kagami started to experience true friendship. Thanks to Kazuno, she even managed to integrate herself in a friend group, even if she never dared to get any closer to anyone but Kazuno whose will to be her friend without any obligation and/or interest allowed Kagami to experience emotions she never felt before that later turned into romantic interest. But the culmination of Kazuno not reciprocating her romantic feelings and her departure for Paris caused Kagami to close herself to friendship again until she met Marinette.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Personality
The way she left things with Kazuno continued to haunt her in such way that she would still feel a great deal of pain, especially after seeing how her harsh final words to him actually affected him to a great extend that prevented him from working together with his superhero team and defeat kaijus. Unable to stand it anymore, Kagami decided to fix her mistakes and solve her issues with Kazuno, even bringing Marinette with her, hoping she would be able to inspire not only Kazuno, but the rest of Stellar Force. When faced with no other choice and motivated by Ladybug, Kagami finally gathered the courage to express her true feelings to Kazuno and the real reason why she cut her ties with him when she left Tokyo, which allowed her to finally heal their friendship.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Personality
In "Emotion", it's revealed that Kagami, similar to Adrien, desires to have freedom to choose whatever she wants to do and break from her mother's influence. However, much like Adrien, she is unable to do so due to the expectations her mother placed on her during her entire life, something that, due to her very strict upbringing, got so rooted in her that, even when in control of her own freedom (due to holding her amokized ring), she would still obey her mother at most time due to believing it's what she needed to do. But when Félix Fathom, as Argos, used Red Moon to make her mother disappear, she shows that, despite wanting freedom, she wants it in her own way and time as well as wanting to share it with those she loves.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Personality
In "Pretension", inspired by Marinette's decision to talk with Gabriel to solve any possible misunderstanding between them, Kagami finally stands up to her mother and tells her to stop controlling her behavior and that embracing her own emotions is not a weakness. After she is taken by Argos, Kagami shows how much she had evolved in terms of social interations, as she reprimended Félix for stalking and kidnapping her just so he could get to know her better. She also shows she had overcome her more judgemental side, as she came to learn more about Félix and understand the reasons that led to his actions.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Personality
The more she came to know Félix better, she came to fall in love with him and reciprocate his feelings. Now free from the internal conflict between winning Adrien's affections and keep her friendship with Marinette, Kagami came to realize the real meaning of Marinette's talk with Alya in "Perfection" and realize that her best friend was Ladybug. Through Félix, Kagami came to learn about Gabriel being the supervillain Monarch and her own mother was helping him. Realizing that she and Félix would never be able to be together as long her mother and Gabriel would keep on force her and Adrien to become a couple at the eyes of the public, the couple decided to trust on Ladybug (Marinette), revealing to her all the truth and hoping she would be able to put an end to Monarch so they could be together.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Personality
In "Miraculous London", after Gabriel made his wish and Bug Noire came to free her and Adrien, Kagami showed skepticism over the superhero's decision to not tell Adrien about his father being Monarch, thinking that her love for Adrien was blinding her. This shows that Kagami was willing to accept the full extention of the consequences of the truth, even if that meant for her mother to face justice due to being Monarch's accomplice. However, due to both trusting and respecting Bug Noire, she decided to accept her decision to keep the lie about Gabriel being the hero that defeated Monarch for Adrien's sake. Also, inspired by Adrien's ability to change and challenge his own father and to also prevent Tomoe from using the truth about Gabriel being Monarch, Kagami decided to talk with her mother and try to help her change as well.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Personality
Despite her mother's despicable actions, both to the world and as a parent, Kagami still loves her very much and hopes that Tomoe will stop trying to control her and be grateful to Ladybug for giving her a second chance. However, she doesn't hide her anger and frustration, as shown in "Yaksi Gozen" when her mother tries to get back Kagami's ring to regain control over her and force her to stay away from Félix. Kagami also feels herself a little self-conscious about the trust Marinette placed on her, due to Tomoe. Despite the fact her mother helped Gabriel and put the entire world in danger and despite how risky it is due to them living under the same roof, Marinette still entrusted her with the Dragon Miraculous.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Personality
As Ryuko, although she starts out somewhat as an individualist, both due to her innate perfectionism and desire to prove herself, she eventually learns that she can't handle everything on her own. Like a dragon, she is fierce and strong-willed, respectful and protective of her teammates and loved ones. Similar to her civilian self, she is quite competent in mastering her abilities and capable of making quick decisions to help her teammates during battles. Due to her superpowers, she is quite flexible in combate, acting as both a spear and a shield to her team, while also being able to easily dodge from any attack or contain her opponets. Ryuko is also very open about her secret identity, transforming in front of others or telling those close to her when the situation calls for it.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Personality
As Riposte, she was furiously obsessed with getting a rematch with Adrien and winning it, even if he was in no condition to fight due to his injured ankle, and she considered people that she viewed as not being good enough fighters unworthy, such as Ladybug. Riposte was also arrogant and didn't have a problem with outright attacking her opponents when they had no chance of defending themselves. Because of her obsession, Kagami had, without possibly knowing it, forgotten one of a competitor's true trademarks is good and true sportsmanship. However, despite this, she followed Hawk Moth's commands without question, even if they conflicted with her own goals.
As Oni-Chan, she was obsessed with tracking down Lila and getting her to renounce Adrien in order to have Adrien be hers.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Personality
As Lies, after Adrien continuously lied to her to go somewhere else, especially when she had lied to spend time with him, she decided to rid the world of lies, even if that meant paralyzing everyone else, including the ones she cared about, like her mother. It may have seemed that she had a black and white view about lies and the truth believing lies to be bad and the truth to be good but most know that it's not that simple.
As Ryukomori, she wanted nothing more than to reach complete perfection. In order to achieve this, she roamed around Paris to find the most serene place she could find where she would be able to reach perfection without being disturbed. Because she didn't want anyone to prevent her from finding perfection, she ignored everyone around her, especially because she was unable to see or hear anyone else. However, she was willing to attack anyone that tried to stop her.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Personality
As Riposte Prime, she, motivated by Lila's manipulation, became determined to "save" Adrien from Marinette's influence, believing the latter was deceiving him and everyone so that she could get him as a boyfriend, deciding to trap her inside of Shell-ter forever. Her obsession on her objective prevented her from hearing anyone that tried to dissuade her and she was also not above attacking anyone that tried to protect her target.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Abilities
As a Civilian
Kagami is extremely skilled in fencing, both in defensive and offensive movements. She is also very agile, doing several acrobatic feats while dueling. Her prowess is equal or probably superior to Adrien's. Another sword-based sport she is masterful in is kendo, just like her mother. Her mother also personally oversees her kendo practice. Also as shown in "Oni-Chan" that she was able to slice through a thin tree, breaking her wooden sword in the process. It is not known whether this was for dramatic effect or she was actually able to cut through that tree with her physical strength. In "Pretension", it is revealed that Kagami knows martial arts and can use this ability to defend herself. She used a hold to knock down Argos.
Kagami considers archery a "noble art" alongside fencing, so it is possible that she also excels at it, though it has yet to be shown. According to Marinette, she is very smart and observant, something especially seen during the contest in "Ikari Gozen". She is a quick learner as a superheroine.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Abilities
Kagami is notably skilled in ice skating, proficient enough to do a combination spin, even though she only does it "just for fun". Also she is very good at drawing and sketching, even for a girl at her age, moreover she has acknowledge of certain artists like Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec.
As Ryuko
Ryuko has enhanced capabilities such as speed, agility, and strength, and she is almost invulnerable to physical damage. These abilities allow her to react to and evade akumatized villains attacks, as well as jump and leap several times her height and length. Her tool is a sword that enhances her natural swordsmanship by allowing her to destroy anything she attacks, and which she can use as a communication device to contact any superhero on her team.
Her superpowers, Elemental Dragons, allow her to transform into and manipulate air, water, and lightning, respectively. This highly versatile power, combined with her outstanding swordsmanship and bravery, make her an excellent member of the team.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Abilities
Initially, she could only use one superpower once per transformation, however, in "Revelator" it is shown that Ryuko has learned to control her adult powers, allowing her to not detransform back and use  Elemental Dragons as much as she wishes.
As Riposte
Riposte wielded a sword in combat, and her sword was directly attached to her hand, making it impossible to remove. She used the sword to strike at incredible speeds and slice through any material. She could create shock waves with her sword to slice objects from a distance. Also, she was capable of leaping great distances, and she was durable, quickly recovering from having an entire chimney collapse on her.
As Oni-Chan
Besides possessing heightened abilities, like speed, strength and agility, Oni-Chan possessed a sword that could wield powerful red energy. When she touched someone with it, they grew a horn like hers. The horn seemingly worked as a cell tower and sent messages to anyone with a mobile phone that was near the person with the horn, allowing her to trade places with the ones who got her messages and continually tracked said person as a result.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Abilities
However, it would appear that Oni-Chan didn't have full control over this power, as she wasn't able to prevent her from trading places with a firefighter when she was about to take Ladybug's Miraculous or trade places with Ladybug, who was tied up to a light post. Another effect of the horn was that, when the person afflicted with it lied, the horn grew bigger.
As Lies
Lies could create a massive white aura sphere around her, which paralyzes anyone caught within it, as long as they've told a lie at some point in their lives. This aura followed her wherever she goes, leaving its victims frozen even after they have exited the sphere. However, her weakness is that she can't freeze those who are incapable of lying, such as animals, like Jagged Stone's crocodile Fang, or machines, as they don't have the capacity to lie.
As Ryukomori
Ryukomori had a gigantic size and, because she was made out of clouds, she couldn't be touched by anyone, while she became also blind and deaf to the presence of everyone else. However, despite being unable to see or hear anyone, she was still aware of the rest, like vehicles, such as helicopters.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Abilities
She also received from Monarch the superpower of the Dragon Miraculous through her Alliance ring. With it, she was able to manipulate the elements of a storm being: wind, water and lightning.
As Riposte Prime
Riposte Prime wielded a sword in combat, and unlike her Riposte one, her sword wasn't directly attached to her hand. She used the sword to strike at incredible speeds and slice through any material. She could create shock waves with her sword to slice objects from a distance. Also, she was capable of leaping great distances, and she was durable.
She also received from Monarch the superpower of the Turtle Miraculous through her Alliance ring. With it, she was able to trap her enemies in red Shell-ters, by touching them with her sword. The Shell-ters could be easily destroyed by Cat Noir's Cataclysm.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Etymology
The name Kagami means "mirror, looking glass" (鏡).
In several Romance-language dubs, her name was adapted because "Kagami" sounds phonetically similar to vulgar forms or conjugations of the verb "cagar" (to defecate) in those languages — such as "cagami" (Italian slang for a crude demand for attention), "caga-me" or "cagando" in Portuguese/Spanish contexts — which could lead to unintended jokes or awkwardness in a children's series.
In the Brazilian Portuguese dub, her name is changed to Kyoko, which also means "mirror" (when written with the kanji 鏡子), keeping the symbolism.
In the European Portuguese dub her name is changed to Kadami, a slight alteration of the original name.
In the Latin American Spanish dub, her name was temporarily changed to Agami (seasons 1–2). According to Tomás Rojas, Adrien's Latin American voice actor, this was explicitly done by the reason mentioned above. This change was reverted from season 3 onwards, returning to Kagami.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Etymology
In the Italian dub, her name is changed to Katami, which could possibly mean "memento" or "souvenir". The kanji "Kata" means "martial arts" in Japanese, which is also a reference to "Katana", a Japanese sword. The name Katami also has a secondary meaning, which is "remember" or "I remember".
In Japanese culture, the Yata no Kagami is a sacred mirror and symbol of truth or wisdom (as mirrors only reflect what is shown).
The superhero name Ryuko means "dragon" (龍/竜) (ryu) and "child" (子) (ko), which is a common ending for Japanese girl names.
Since the long vowel in the first part of the name can be variously romanized as ryuu, ryū or ryû, Kagami's superhero name has also been written as Ryuuko, Ryūko or Ryûko (the last one being the most common, especially in French sources).
Ryuko is also the name of the protagonist from the Kill la Kill anime series. Ryuko and Kagami even have similar color schemes, prominently featuring dark blue and red.
Kagami's surname Tsurugi means "sword, blade, saber, bayonet, sting, clock hand" (剣).
Tsurugi (劔) is a type of Japanese sword.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Etymology
The Kusanagi-no-Tsurugi is a legendary sword that represents the virtue of valor. Both are part of the three Imperial Regalia of Japan, along with the Yasakani-no-Magatama, a sacred jewel that represents benevolence.
In fencing, the word "riposte" refers to a quick return thrust following a parry.
A colloquial use of the word refers to a quick, witty retort to an insult or criticism. Another definition related to this is a "retaliatory maneuver or measure."
Oni-Chan is the word Oni (鬼), which roughly translates as "demon" or "troll" with the diminutive suffix -Chan (ちゃん). It is also a pun on the phrase Onii-chan (お兄ちゃん), which literally means "older brother", but it is also used as a way to address a boy or young man whose name is not known to the speaker.
Ryukomori could be a combination of Ryuko and Kumori (曇り), meaning "cloudy weather".
It could also be a combination of Ryuko and Hikikomori (ひきこもり or 引きこもり) meaning "pulling inward, being confined".

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Trivia
Revealed by the Staff
Kagami was revealed in a season 2 synopsis from TFOU on August 31, 2017.
She was teased as a new inhabitant of Paris in a Brazilian synopsis for Season 2 on O Universo da TV.
Feri González noted that both Kagami and Luka Couffaine are "charming, rounded characters" who are not limited to roles as alternate love interests.
Riposte was first revealed in a promotional video for Season 2 from TFOU.
Kagami's outfit in season 6 was inspired by Kenji Ohba.
Miraculous Holder and Akumatized Villains
A scarlet version of Riposte reappeared in the two-part special event "Heroes' Day".
All of Kagami's non-civilian identities, with the exception of Lies and Ryukomori, wield swords as their main weapon.
She also uses a sword as a civilian in her fencing class.
Kagami is the fourth known person of Japanese origin to wield a Miraculous, succeeding Tomoe Gozen, Tentomushi and Sasuke Sarutobi, and the first of these origins to wield the Dragon Miraculous specifically.
Overall, continent-wise she is the 24th known person of Asian origins to wield a miraculous.
Kagami is the only member of the Miraculers to receive her Miraculous from Ladybug without an accompanying speech.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Trivia
Kagami is the second superhero whose civilian identity is known by Hawk Moth with the first being Chloé Bourgeois as Queen Bee.
Kagami, alongside Zoé Lee, Juleka Couffaine, Nino Lahiffe, Lê Chiến Kim, and Sabrina Raincomprix, are the only current members of the Miraculers to whom Ladybug gave a Magical Charm.
Kagami has been akumatized into 4 unique forms and a second variant of her first akumatized form: into Riposte in "Riposte", "Catalyst" and "Mayura", into Oni-Chan and Lies in the titular episodes, into Ryukomori in "Perfection" and into Riposte Prime in "Protection". With a total of 7 akumatizations, she shares fourth place for the highest number of akumatizations alongside Juleka and Roger and behind Mr. Ramier, Chloé, and Lila/Cerise.
In "Perfection", she became the first member of the French Miraculous hero team to receive the power of their Miraculous through their Alliance ring.
In "Protection", she became the first and only member of the French Miraculous team to receive the power of a different Miraculous  than their primary wielded one through their Alliance ring, as she received the power of the Turtle Miraculous.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Trivia
She is the third person to reject a Magical Charm, following Chloé Bourgeois and Bob Roth.
Unlike Chloé who did it out of hatred and anger and Bob who did so because he saw it as something that wouldn’t make him rich, she did it because the first Magical Charm given to her in "Perfection" had failed her and she didn't think it could help her with her problems. But with the help of her friends, she accepted the Charm.
Kagami was the first sentimonster to be akumatized by Hawk Moth.
By extent, she was also the first sentimonster known to ever be akumatized.
Kagami is the second member of the Miraculers (besides Ladybug and Cat Noir) to have an active role as a superhero in a Miraculous World special, becoming a relevant character as Ryuko in "Miraculous Tokyo", following Bunnyx in "Miraculous London".
Kagami and Félix are the second couple to learn each other's secret identities, after Alya and Nino in "Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part 1)" and Marc and Nathaniel later in "The Ruler".
Miscellaneous

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Trivia
Contrary to popular belief, Kagami was never a student at Collège Françoise Dupont. Instead, she only arrives at Françoise Dupont to attend Armand D'Argencourt's fencing classes. However, it's unknown if she's homeschooled or used to attend another collège.
This is first hinted on "Miraculous on Instagram" when Alya responded to a comment on her post that Kagami "doesn't even go [to Françoise Dupont]".
This is later confirmed in "Determination" when Marinette gave Kagami a ride to the school.
Due to her proficiency and high skills in the art of fencing and kendo, it's highly possible that Kagami is well trained and skilled in the arts of kenjutsu, the traditional fighting art of samurais and even possibly knows to a stent Ninjutsu.
As mentioned in "Ikari Gozen", Kagami's blood type is "O" and her Chinese Zodiac sign is the Dragon, meaning that she is a few months or a year older than Marinette Dupain-Cheng whose Chinese Zodiac sign is the Snake.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Trivia
Kagami being up to one year older than Marinette and still being in the same grade as her can be explained by the fact that the Japanese school year starts at the beginning of April for children born between April of the former year and March of that year, unlike in European and North American countries (where it begins in September/October).
In "blood type personality theory", a pseudo-scientific Japanese belief, those with type-O blood are said to be "confident, self-determined, ambitious, competitive, and athletic", but also "unpredictable, self-centered, cold, aggressive, arrogant, and envious."
In the French dub of "Ikari Gozen", it's stated that she's a Scorpio in the Western Zodiac. According to one of Marinette's Instagram posts, her birthday falls on November 20th.
According to Thomas Astruc, any time the series specifies a date, it is a mistake.
Kagami's running gag is her awkward smile, which is regarded as a meme, and can also be seen in the intros of seasons 4 and 5.
In "Glaciator 2", it is revealed that she reads mangas.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Trivia
In "Emotion", it's revealed that Kagami is a descendant of a family of samurai women and she always follows her mother because it is tradition for her to obey.
In the card game Miraculous Secrets, it's revealed that Kagami has drawn a manga about her childhood in Japan, but she hasn't dared to publish it yet.
Before Thomas Astruc has confirmed that she is a sentimonster on BlueSky, there have been hints and speculations about this in season 5.
In "Perfection", Tomoe became furious at Gabriel for akumatizing Kagami directly through her amokized object (the ring), stating he endangered her, since there was a risk Kagami would cease to exist, if Ladybug managed to reach her akumatized object (the ring) and break it.
In "Protection", Gabriel said that Adrien and Kagami are "of the same design", and Tomoe said that they were "made for each other, just as planned". This implies that the two of them were "conceived" with plans for them to be together.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Trivia
In "Emotion", Félix (who has the Peacock Miraculous in his possession) was startled when he saw Kagami's ring, the same way Nathalie sensed Master Fu's sentimonster's amok in it while detransformed. In the same episode, Félix tried to instigate Kagami to disobey her mother and later, as Argos, spared Kagami, while making her mother disappear and proclaming she was free.
In "Pretension", Argos wanted to free Kagami from her mother's control and succeeded by returning Kagami her real ring, while giving Tomoe a fake one he had been able to switch with during the time he was with her. In that same episode, Félix tells her he feels they're both the same and have things in common.
In "Representation" in the story made by Félix for Marinette, it was stated that the son (Félix) then met a girl like him, which is narrated while both Félix and Kagami take off their masks.
She also never said what happened to her father, if she ever had one.
In "Yaksi Gozen", Tomoe further implies Kagami not having a father by expressing her disappointments with the opposite gender.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Trivia
In "Yaksi Gozen", it's revealed that Tomoe was the one who used the Peacock Miraculous to create Kagami, at the cost of her eyesight.
It's further revealed that the reason why Tomoe only lost her eyesight, while Émilie Agreste and Colt Fathom died, was because the emotion she used was connected to her eyes, as she wanted a child that could be perfect on her eyes.
Currently, most characters know that Kagami is Ryuko: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/Ladybug, Adrien Agreste/Cat Noir, Félix Fathom/Argos, Tomoe Tsurugi, Nozomi Tsurugi, Shinobu, Nathalie Sancoeur, Cerise Bianca/Chrysalis, and all of the members of the Stellar Force superhero team (Kazuno/Capricorn, Miki/Leo, Nikko/Gemini, Bulgan/Taurus, Kiss/Libra, Pili/Aries, Ryo/Aquarius, Anglia/Scorpio, Jéola/Virgo, Karelia/Pisces, Mayotte/Sagittarius, and Yu Lu/Cancer).
Kagami is one of the few people who know Marinette is Ladybug, alongside Alya Césaire, Su-Han, Luka Couffaine, Félix Fathom, Gabriel Agreste, Nathalie Sancoeur, Alix Kubdel, Sabine Cheng, and Tom Dupain.

title: Kagami Tsurugi
text:
Kagami Tsurugi - Trivia
She's also one of the few people aware of Gabriel's identity as Monarch alongside Nathalie Sancoeur, Félix Fathom, her mother, Lila Rossi/Cerise Bianca, Marinette Dupain-Cheng, Alix Kubdel, Noé Luxus, Camilo Pista, and Alya Césaire.
She is the third known Sentimonster to have control of herself, following the Dormant Sentimonster and Félix Fathom.
She is one of the five characters that is good at drawing. The first four are Nathaniel Kurtzberg, Gabriel Agreste, Marinette Dupain-Cheng, Plagg followed by Maya.
Kagami, Alix, Luka, and Félix, are the only members of the Miraculers who aren't in the Resistance, possibly due to not attending the Françoise Dupont at the time of its formation, as the school was both its birth location and acted as the main meeting point for its members.

text:
Kagami as seen by Marinette/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Dear diary, today Kagami has asked me to come and cheer her on at a fencing tournament this weekend. I know, things have changed a lot since I first met her. Remember?
Marinette: She had shown up at school as a mysterious, masked fencer. She was really good, problem is I'm not the only one who was impressed that day. Adrien, my Adrien completely fell under her spell! And even worse I helped him get closer to her!
Adrien: I was just asking you what you thought I should do about Kagami.
Marinette: The ice queen?
Adrien: What?
Marinette: The ice rink! Yeah that's what I said, no better place to break the ice than the ice rink.
Adrien: The ice rink?...
Marinette: And they see each other all the time because their parents are friends. Remember when they went to London together?
Marinette: What if Adrien is blown away by her awesome dress and hairstyle, and if they dance together at the reception, and what if they tour the city on a romantic horse and buggy ride? It would be the end of the world!
Marinette: And I was right. It did bring them closer. Kagami was even akumatized because of her feelings for Adrien.

title: Kagami Tsurugi/History
text:
Kagami Tsurugi/History - Intro
Kagami Tsurugi is a teenage girl who was chosen by Ladybug to wield the Dragon Miraculous and become the hero Ryuko.

title: Kagami Tsurugi/History
text:
Kagami Tsurugi/History - Before [[Season 1]]
Kagami was born in Tokyo, Japan, as the daughter of Tomoe Tsurugi: a world-class fencing champion (the same as her grandfather) and tech tycoon of Tsurugi Industries, who is part of a secret organization along with fashion designer Gabriel Agreste, and his assistant Nathalie Sancoeur. In reality, she is a human-sentimonster manifested in Tomoe's womb using the power of the damaged Peacock Miraculous that the latter borrowed from the Agreste family, placing an amok into her family ring and using her emotion of pride through her vision of the perfect daughter to create Kagami at the cost of her eyesight.
She descends from the Tsurugi clan, a clan of female samurai descendants and prominent fencers, and is trained by her mother to be her perfect successor in the family's traditions. According to the Miraculous Secrets card game, Kagami has drawn a manga about her childhood in Japan but she hasn't dared to publish it yet. Kagami's grandmother also operates as a food vendor who sells dorayaki with her partner Shinobu.

title: Kagami Tsurugi/History
text:
Kagami Tsurugi/History - Before [[Season 1]]
Having been raised in a sheltered life away from the outside world, Kagami was kept secluded with only tutors to educate her and was only allowed outside to compete in fencing competitions. On her fourteenth birthday, however, Kagami asked her mother to allow her to attend school as she wished. When Tomoe initially rejected her request, Kagami refused to accept her answer, much to the former's surprise. Her mother issued a challenge to her - to not let her amokized ring touch the ground as she throws it up into the air. Kagami succeeded in catching the ring with a bow and arrow. Her mother granted her request and allowed her to attend Kano Academy in Tokyo, an international school that combines sports and studies.
On her first day attending, Kagami met Kazuno, Miki, and their friends. She was then challenged by Miki to compete in an obstacle course, only to win by throwing her fencing foil at the button at the end, much to the latter's frustration at her technicality. When she and Miki argued, Kazuno stepped in to break the two up and agreed to be Kagami's first friend.

title: Kagami Tsurugi/History
text:
Kagami Tsurugi/History - Before [[Season 1]]
Both Kagami and Kazuno played rhythm and dance games at the local arcade and opened up to each other. Kagami eventually developed a romantic interest for Kazuno, but Kazuno did not reciprocate his feelings for her as he had feelings for Miki. Eventually, Tomoe announced that they would be moving to Paris, France, which broke Kagami's heart. She wrote a love letter to give to Kazuno for their final meeting; however, Kagami instead lied, saying she hated their dance sessions, and ended her friendship with him, much to her own heartbreak. She then departed for Paris alongside her mother and began attending Collège Françoise Dupont as a new student.

title: Kagami Tsurugi/History
text:
Kagami Tsurugi/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Riposte", she came to the school's fencing tryouts to be enrolled onto the team and demanded Armand D'Argencourt to bring out his class's best fencer to prove her skill. Soon she was in a duel with Adrien but saw that they weren't getting any results with the machine, she proposed having a freestyle match. The two dueled so fiercely and quickly that they ended it the library. After dealing the final blow, Kagami asked Marinette who won, and she said Adrien did. She accepted her defeat and left but was approached by Adrien wanting to offer another match. However, Kagami told him her family doesn't give second chances and drove away.

title: Kagami Tsurugi/History
text:
Kagami Tsurugi/History - [[Season 2]]
She informed her mother of what happened over the phone, then was akumatized into Riposte. Upon finding Adrien, she accepted his offer, but he refused to fight in her current condition. She was intercepted by Ladybug, but Riposte found her as an inferior opponent. However, the heroine managed to escape with Adrien. Riposte found the pair among the rooftops where she calls out the rules of their match, despite Ladybug and Adrien trying to reason with her. Riposte said the damage was done and declared to the both of them that she was the best fencer which Adrien agreed too but wasn't convinced.
In "Frozer", she was seen ice-skating with Marinette, Adrien and Luka. She also gave Marinette some friendly advice of not hesitating.
In "Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part 1)", Kagami was getting ready for Heroes' Day until Lila's deception as Volpina made her vulnerable to Scarlet Moth's akumatization, transforming into Scarlet Riposte. She joined with the rest of the mastermind's minions in meeting Scarlet Moth at the Eiffel Tower.

title: Kagami Tsurugi/History
text:
Kagami Tsurugi/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)", she fought against the heroes during the battle and was briefly deakumatized but thanks to Dark Cupid and Scarlet Moth, Kagami was reakumatized again into her villain counterpart. It wasn't until the heroes deakumatized Hawk Moth that she and everyone was set free.

title: Kagami Tsurugi/History
text:
Kagami Tsurugi/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Animaestro", she was seen with Adrien and her mother, Tomoe. It was also revealed that she and Chloé Bourgeois hate each other, due to the former's crush on Adrien.
In "Backwarder", she was boarding the train with Adrien as they were heading to London to attend a royal wedding, but before they left, she saw Marinette arrive and nervously give him a letter, finding his friend awkward. After Backwarder was defeated, she left for London and returned back to Paris on Monday.
In "Gamer 2.0", Kagami was practicing her fencing with Adrien until she and several other people were taken prisoner by Gamer 2.0. In her akumatized form, she was the titular villain's first avatar but was beaten by Ladybug as the Mime. After the heroes played through every character and defeated Gamer 2.0, she and everyone else was set free.
In "Oni-Chan", she was akumatized into the titular villain after seeing Lila kissing Adrien. As Oni-Chan, she tried to attack Lila in revenge.

title: Kagami Tsurugi/History
text:
Kagami Tsurugi/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Desperada", after meeting up with Adrien, the two were supposed to go practice their fencing but went to meet their friends at the Couffaine family houseboat instead. However, she mistakenly called Luka Marinette's boyfriend. Then, they heard a commotion above deck and saw Jagged Stone asking Anarka to join his band again, but Anarka refused. Soon things went from bad to worse when Vivica appeared as Desperada wanting revenge on Jagged. However, when he pointed out that Adrien was his new guitarist, the music villain turned her weapons on him. Furious, Kagami tried to defend him but was the first of villainess's victims, and it wasn't until Ladybug and Cat Noir and their new ally Viperion defeated the music villain that Kagami and everyone else were set free.
In "Ikari Gozen", she had Marinette Dupain-Cheng as her partner. She was later given the Dragon Miraculous by Ladybug and transformed into Ryuko after her mother was akumatized into the titular villain.
In "Feast", she was seen practicing her fencing skills in the park.

title: Kagami Tsurugi/History
text:
Kagami Tsurugi/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Félix", Kagami was on video chat with Marinette and the rest of their friends who were trying to figure out how they could make Adrien feel better on the anniversary of his mother going missing. They agreed with Marinette's idea of them sending a package of care videos.
In "Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1)", she was seen with Marinette and Adrien as the three were having fun in Le Grand Paris. She was later recruited again by Ladybug to stop Heart Hunter.
In "Miracle Queen (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 2)", she was seen as one of the royal guards of the titular villain. However, she did not transform as she had already given the Dragon Miraculous back to Ladybug.

title: Kagami Tsurugi/History
text:
Kagami Tsurugi/History - Season 5
In "Representation", Kagami, along with Adrien, is sent to London and the two are presented to the British media as the perfect couple in love with each other (via their avatars) by their parents. Disgusted with the lies, she's ready to throw the remote at the television when Félix appeared at her hotel balcony. It's revealed the two are in a secret relationship but knowing her mother and Gabriel Agreste will never allow them to be together, need Ladybug's help. The two head back to Paris to ask for Marinette's help (Kagami discovered she is Ladybug after overhearing her and Alya in "Perfection" on the Liberty), seeing this as her only opportunity to be free from her mother. With Félix's help, the two tell Marinette the truth about Gabriel being Monarch, the origins of the Graham de Vanily, Agreste, and Fathom families and why Félix betrayed her. They urge her to stop the supervillain for everyone to have an happy ending since she was the only one who could. She and Félix return to London, confident that Marinette will stop him and they kiss. Unfortunately, due to her escape, she's locked up in a white cell.

In "Conformation", still in her cell, Kagami is annoyed that her image is not just being used in the ads and commercials with Adrien but also used in Monarch's final plan with her mother to take Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses.
In "Re-creation", after Monarch's defeat, Kagami attended Adrien's pool party, where she reunited with her boyfriend and she sketches him. Sometime after Marinette restored all the stolen Miraculouses to their original forms and permanently returned them to their holders, Kagami is given back the Dragon Miraculous permanently and reunites with Longg and the team set off for their next adventure to protect Paris from the new villainous Butterfly Miraculous holder.

title: Kagami as seen by Adrien/Transcript
text:
Kagami as seen by Adrien/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: (narrates over the scene) Sometime ago, a mysterious masked fencer showed up halfway through class.
Kagami: Which one of you is the best combatant?
Adrien: (narrates) I must admit that I had never faced such a talented opponent before.
Mr. D'Argencourt: Adrien, please give our visitor a lesson in chivalry. Allez! (Adrien and Kagami duel each other.)
Adrien: Hey, wait! Your saber! (narrates) When she finally took off her helmet, and I saw her for the first time... Truth is, I was momentarily stunned.
Adrien: (narrates) And when I saw Kagami again in the next class-
Mr. D'Argencourt: You sure take your time Mr. Agreste.
Adrien: (narrates) I felt things for her that I'd never felt before.
Kagami: En garde!
Adrien: (narrates) I didn't know what to do—
Adrien: (narrates) But luckily my good friend Marinette was here. (in the scene) Marinette!
Marinette: Ohh!
Adrien: Perfect timing!
Marinette: Huh? You think so?
Adrien: Actually, what I meant was, I need some advice right now. Can we talk? Okay, well, I'm sorry, this is a bit awkward for me.
Marinette: Uh, what?
Adrien: I was just asking you what you thought I should do about Kagami.

title: Kagami as seen by Adrien/Transcript
text:
Kagami as seen by Adrien/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: The ice... rink! Yeah, that's what I said! No better place to break the ice than the ice rink!
Adrien: The ice rink...
Adrien: (narrates) And everything went really well. Kagami is the kind of girl who knows what she wants.
Kagami: Did you invite them because you were scared of being alone with me?
Adrien: Of course not, it's just that I asked Marinette to help me.
Kagami: Help you with what?
Adrien: Uh, to perfect my figure skating skills!
Kagami: But you don't need her for that.
Adrien: (narrates) Ever since she arrived in Paris, we've been seeing each other quite often, because my father and her mother...
Adrien: (narrates) ...occasionally do business together. We even spent a whole weekend in London together, and I feel like it brought us closer...
Adrien: (narrates) Because since then, she's sometimes proven pretty protective of me.
Oni-chan: Adrien, I am Oni-chan. You and I were made for each other, Adrien.
Adrien: Kagami?
Oni-chan: I will protect you from anyone who tries to harm you.
Adrien: Kagami, no! (narrates) I think she may actually have feelings for me... but this is awkward, because the girl I have feelings for...
Adrien: (narrates) ...is m'lady. But...

title: Kagami as seen by Adrien/Transcript
text:
Kagami as seen by Adrien/Transcript - Intro

Cat Noir: I know m'lady, but—
Adrien: (narrates) Even though she doesn't know about Ladybug, maybe Kagami's right.
Kagami: Adrien, the biggest mistake a fencer can make isn't choosing the wrong technique, it's choosing the wrong target. Change targets.
Adrien: (narrates) Maybe it's time to change targets.
Adrien: (narrates) We're attending Chloé's parents' anniversary together soon. I guess we'll see.

title: Kagami's ring
text:
Kagami's ring - Intro
is a ring owned by Kagami Tsurugi.
In "Riposte", after Kagami misunderstood that she lost the fencing match against Adrien, Hawk Moth sent her an akuma that entered her ring, causing it to become the akumized object of Riposte.
In "Catalyst", after witnessing Volpina's illusion, sensing her sadness over the heroes' "defeat", a scarlet akuma entered her ring, causing it to become the akumatized object of Scarlet Riposte.
In "Perfection", after being tricked by Lila into believing that Marinette doesn't consider her a friend, Monarch sent her a megakuma that entered her ring, causing it to become the akumatized object of Ryukomori.
In "Representation", with Kagami's approval, her ring briefly becomes the amokized object of Once Upon a Time, to tell Marinette the truth about Adrien and Félix's origins.

title: Kagami's ring
text:
Kagami's ring - Intro
In "Yaksi Gozen", the ring is revealed to contain the amok that was used to create Kagami. After Tomoe tries to take it by force, only failing due to Kagami transforming into Ryuko, the latter considered giving her ring to Ladybug for safekeeping in her magical yo-yo to prevent it from being stolen or destroyed. However, due to Adrien briefly losing it after doing magic tricks on it, and the titular villain's akumatization which gets the ring almost stolen, Félix picks it up and returns it to Kagami, who decided to keep it.

title: Kagami's ring
text:
Kagami's ring - Appearance
Normal
Kagami's ring is silver with a logo on top of the Japanese kanji for "female" (女) and has two long prongs extending outward from the mark resembling a saber.
Akumatized (Riposte)
Under the effect of Kagami's akumatization in Riposte, the ring had become a silver sword-like extension with a triangular guard and a red circle bearing the Tsurugi crest in the center of the guard.
Akumatized (Scarlet Riposte)
Under the effect of Kagami's akumatization in Scarlet Riposte, the ring had become a scarlet sword-like extension with a triangular guard and a red circle bearing the Tsurugi crest in the center of the guard.
Akumatized (Ryukomori)
Under the effect of Kagami's akumatization into Ryukomori, the ring's akumatized form was unknown, as Ryukomori's entire body had transformed into clouds.

title: Kagami's ring
text:
Kagami's ring - History
It has been told that the ring has been passed down from generations of female family members, at the present time, held by Kagami Tsurugi.

title: Kagami's ring
text:
Kagami's ring - Trivia
Before it was confirmed that Kagami is a Sentimonster, there were several hints suggesting that the ring was her amokized object:
She doesn’t wear it while fencing, as it could easily break.
In "Perfection", Tomoe becomes furious with Gabriel for endangering Kagami. She specifies that the Megakuma entered her ring, indicating that if Kagami hadn’t deakumatized herself, Ladybug and Cat Noir could have broken it, releasing both her akuma and amok.
In "Emotion", Félix, disguised as Adrien, is shocked when he sees her ring. As established in "Feast," a Peacock Miraculous holder can sense amoks, even when not transformed. Kagami shows him her ring, explaining that her family obeys orders because it is a choice they make.
In "Pretension", Tomoe tells Kagami that the family crest on the ring dictates her behavior. After Kagami helps the heroes defeat Matagi Gozen, Gabriel informs Tomoe that Kagami is not under her control. Tomoe then takes the ring, declaring that she will force Kagami into obedience. Later, Félix is revealed to have taken the real ring and gives it back to Kagami, stating that she is now free to make her own rules.

title: Kagami's ring
text:
Kagami's ring - Trivia
Kagami's ring is the third object to be akumatized and amokized separately, after August's pacifier and Nathalie's tablet.
Wilfried Pain initially stated that the black ring seen in "Riposte" was a separate ring that Kagami wears only when fencing. However, Thomas Astruc would later state that wasn't the intention..
