title: Kaalki/History
text:
Kaalki/History - Intro
Kaalki is the kwami connected to the Horse Miraculous. Currently, she lets Max Kanté transform into Pegasus.

title: Kaalki/History
text:
Kaalki/History - Before [[Season 1]]
When the concept of Migration came into existence, Kaalki came into existence. Before the Miraculous jewels were created, Kaalki and the other kwamis traveled all over the universe unable to interact with humans. Then, thousands of years ago, a mage created the Miraculouses. Kaalki started out with Mǎ in China. When her Miraculous was not being worn, Kaalki was dormant in the Horse Miraculous, which was stored inside the Miracle Box.
Somewhere in between 400 – 100 years ago, Kaalki had unknown owner that used horse drawn carriages as a mode of transportation.

title: Kaalki/History
text:
Kaalki/History - Season 1
During Season 1, Kaalki was dormant in the Horse Miraculous.

title: Kaalki/History
text:
Kaalki/History - [[Season 2]]
During Season 2, Kaalki was dormant in the Horse Miraculous.
In "Sandboy", Kaalki was celebrating Nooroo's birthday in the Miracle Box with the other kwamis and she was excited when Tikki and Plagg arrived. She marveled at the gift Tikki brought, a marker, and she played with the other kwamis. When the time came to find Nooroo, Kaalki got into position in an effort to contact him, but the kwamis contacted his wielder instead. Upon hearing his voice, she shuddered at the thought of being his slave, but they prevented him from discovering their location by cutting off the connection. They realized if they contacted Nooroo's wielder, rather than Nooroo, then someone must have been akumatized and that Tikki's and Plagg's wielders were in danger. Kaalki instructed Tikki, Plagg, and Wayzz to find their owners.

title: Kaalki/History
text:
Kaalki/History - [[Season 3]]
During season 3, Kaalki was dormant in the Horse Miraculous.
In "Startrain", while Kaalki was dormant inside her Miraculous, she was temporarily given to Marinette by Master Fu, allowing her go on a school field trip to London and return to Paris if there was trouble while she was away. However, trouble didn't come to Paris but stowed away on a train causing Claudie's akumatization into Startrain and blasting everyone into space. Needing to capture the Akuma and saving everyone who was boarding the train at the same time, Kaalki was activated and introduced herself to her holder, Max Kanté, who transformed into the hero Pegasus. With her power of Voyage, Ladybug, Cat Noir and Pegasus was able to stop Startrain and bring everyone back down to earth. Afterwards, Kaalki and her Miraculous was returned to Ladybug.

title: Kaalki/History
text:
Kaalki/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Kwamibuster", Kaalki was activated along with her fellow kwamis to help Multimouse enact her plan of rescuing Tikki and Plagg. During the confrontation, Kaalki was one of the kwamis that was captured but was later set free with the help of Multinoire's Cataclysm. After Kwamibuster's defeat, Kaalki and the others cheered for Marinette as their plan was a success and she and the Horse Miraculous were returned to Miracle Box.
In "Miracle Queen", she was activated by a brainwashed Max, transforming him into Pegasus and her powers being used against the heroes until they managed to de-akumatize the Miracle Queen. After Hawk Moth and Mayura escaped and the role of the guardian was passed on to Ladybug, Kaalki and her Miraculous were retrieved and returned to the Miracle Box.

title: Kaalki/History
text:
Kaalki/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Truth", Kaalki was accidentally released from the Miracle Box when Marinette tried to figure it out and explored Marinette's room. Then, she looked out at Marinette's window amazed that there was no longer horse drawn carriages advising the others to come out until she was grabbed by Marinette. During a video call on Marinette's computer, she and the others surrounded the screen in amazement. When Marinette leaves for her date with Luka, she and her siblings hid within the Miracle Box. After Truth's defeat, Kaalki and the others saw that Marinette was sad about breaking up with Luka to the point of tears, she didn't know exactly how to help but joined with her siblings in giving their new guardian a group hug.
In "Gang of Secrets", Kaalki was seen talking with the other kwamis until their guardian arrives home. Later, Kaalki hears Marinette voiced her distress about being condemned to a life of secrets and lies forever because of her alter ego. When they heard someone coming, the kwamis hid in the Miracle Box and after the Gang of Secrets had been defeated, Kaalki and the others look on as Marinette unveils her secret identity to Alya.

title: Kaalki/History
text:
Kaalki/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Mr. Pigeon 72", Kaalki was seen in Marinette's room watching along with Longg and Xuppu as Marinette paced herself crazily in an attempt to figure out how to stop future re-akumatizations. Then, seeing some of her siblings playing with one of Marinette's designer hats she decided to join the fun. Afterwards, Kaalki and the kwamis help to clean up Marinette's room.
In "Furious Fu", hearing that Master Fu was returning, Kaalki along with the other kwamis expressed dear desire to see him despite Marinette trying to keep them hidden for their safety. When Marinette is concerned about leaving the Miracle Box unguarded. She realized if someone stayed to guard the box, the others could go. But they cheated their way out by voting that Marinette will guard the box so all of the kwamis can go. Unfortunately, they were stopped by Marinette, so they decided to use the "puppy dog eyes" on her and Marinette reluctantly agreed. Despite Kaalki and her siblings are having a hard time trying to keep quiet while being in Marinette's bag, they heard that Master Fu is doing well and become a great painter.

title: Kaalki/History
text:
Kaalki/History - [[Season 4]]
When they returning home, Kaalki realized that Su-Han had returned to reclaim the box as he was the previous guardian before the Master Fu's incident and with Su-Han's strictness, she sadly returned to the box. After seeing Ladybug's valiant actions against Furious Fu, Su-Han realized that Master Fu's choice wasn't so bad, then re-allowing her and the others to stay with Marinette.
In "Sole Crusher", upon hearing that their guardian had been captured, Kaalki got permission from Tikki to use her powers to find Cat Noir and warn him of the situation that the Guardian was unable to transform. After the message had been delivered, she returned back to Marinette's room.
In "Optigami", Kaalki helped Ladybug, Rena Rouge and Adrien to travel to different places, like Marinette's room and an elevator. However, because she used Voyage without an owner, it caused structures to get teleported to random places, like the bottom of the ocean, inside an active volcano, and the moon.
In "Sentibubbler", Marinette unified Kaalki and Tikki and becomes Pegabug and use Voyage to escape Sentibubbler

title: Kaalki/History
text:
Kaalki/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Wishmaker", after hearing her guardian explain what career was and yet seeing Marinette being indecisive about her future, Kaalki along with her fellow kwamis came up with many suggestions until she and the others were silenced by Sass suggesting they should listen to their guardian still being indecisive, Kaalki and the other kwamis see Marinette leave for the Career Expo.
In "Simpleman", Kaalki was hiding while Marinette was babysitting Manon and her friends. She hears Marinette offer to play hide and seek. She along with Xuppu and Stompp, knowing it's a bad idea, shook their heads. However she, Fluff and Xuppu were found by the kids and being passed off as plush toys and with Kaalki being called "sock" until Marinette found another way to pacify them.

title: Kaalki/History
text:
Kaalki/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Dearest Family", after Tikki ate the pieces of galette Marinette brought for them, the kwamis quickly realized what she did. Kaalki huddled together with the others when they realized the danger Tikki's hunger for candy can represent, despite the kwami of Creation refusal at that. When Tikki and Marinette left, the kwamis flew around in a panic. Shortly after she watched Marinette, realizing that Sass warning was real and transforms to stop Tikki only to be affected by Tikki's hunger, which scared her.
Hearing a commotion downstairs, Kaalki and the others were commanded to hide. After Ladybug saved her family, Kaalki and the kwamis see her return with pieces of galette for them. They were still nervous regarding Tikki, but Marinette ensured them that Tikki will control herself. The kwamis then ate the pieces of galette happily.
In "Ephemeral", during the fight against Moolak, Kaalki and her Miraculous were given to Max to become Pegasus.

title: Kaalki/History
text:
Kaalki/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Kuro Neko", during the fight against Gigantitan, Kaalki and her Miraculous were given to Max to become Pegasus again. Later, Kaalki and the other kwamis tried to comfort Marinette after Cat Noir gave up on his Miraculous and was surprised to learn that she intended to replace him with someone who doesn't love her.
In "Penalteam", Kaalki and her Miraculous were used again by Max to become Pegasus and help Ladybug, along with many other heroes to defeat Penalteam.
In "Risk", Kaalki and the other kwamis watched Marinette search for different ways to sabotage Adrien and Lila's journey, unaware that she was under the influence of Risk's superpowers.
In "Strikeback", Marinette unified Kaalki with Tikki and Fluff to transform into Pennybug, then used Voyage to transport herself to the train and give the Dog Miraculous to Félix, disguised as Adrien. Later, she also fused Kaalki with Tikki to become Pegabug to use Voyage and teleport the Strikeback clones to the sun. Then, after Flairmidable betrayed Ladybug by stealing her yo-yo and Kaalki's Miraculous, along with all the others, her Miraculous was given to Gabriel Agreste in exchange for the Peacock Miraculous.

title: Kaalki/History
text:
Kaalki/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Evolution", after her and her fellow kwamis siblings are captured, she along with them, find out who Monarch really is and the reason for his actions.
In "Multiplication", after Monarch de-transforms back into Gabriel, he threatens Kaalki and the rest of the kwamis by telling them he will use their powers to get to Ladybug's and Cat Noir's Miraculouses.
In "Destruction", Gabriel unified Kaalki and Nooroo to help him transform into Monarch and get the pieces of paper for Ladybug's scavenger hunt.
In "Jubilation", Monarch absorbs Kaalki’s power and uses Voyage to teleport his megakuma to Denis Damoclès.
In "Illusion", Monarch absorbs Kaalki's power along with Mullo's, Pollen's, and Orriko's, power to aid him in getting Ladybug's and Cat Noir's Miraculouses.

Creation
To transform humans or animals into kaijū, Moddler and his henchmen use "Modules" and positioning them directly over the target. From that moment on, the transformation into kaijū takes effect. The transformed person retains no memory of what occurred during the process.
Defeating a Kaijū
To defeat a kaijū, the Stellar Force initially resorted to the direct use of force, employing powerful weapon summons to eliminate it. However, defeating a kaijū in this way put the victim's life at risk.

title: Khepri
text:
Khepri - Intro
Khepri was an Egyptian woman who lived around 5,000 years ago.
She was a past holder of the Ladybug Miraculous, transforming into La Déesse Coccinelle (The Ladybug Goddess), a ladybug-themed superhero when Tikki inhabited the earrings.
She stopped Pharaoh Akhenaten from sacrificing an innocent woman to the sun god Ra in a ritual of one hundred mummies in order to resurrect his deceased wife, Princess Nefertiti. There is depiction of her and Tutankhamun's ritual as hieroglyphics on an ancient papyrus in the ancient Egypt exhibit at the Louvre.
In "The Pharaoh", Marinette learns of her existence (and of the long lineage of different Ladybugs throughout history) while preventing the same event that this past Ladybug dealt with, the akumatized villain Pharaoh trying to use a sacrifice to resurrect Nefertiti.

title: Khepri
text:
Khepri - Appearance
As depicted in the hieroglyph, to transform, she owned the Ladybug Miraculous. She also wore a kalarisis with spots on the fabric and collar usekh around her neck, as well as an Egyptian wig.

title: Khepri
text:
Khepri - Personality
Although not much is known about Khepri she would be described as a bit like Sabine protective and clever as she choreographed her events in a papyrus scroll as a warning to protect future generations from those who'd be foolish enough reenact the ritual. And yet shows she was hopeful in case if someone ever was foolish enough to do it another Ladybug would be there to stop it.

title: Khepri
text:
Khepri - Abilities
If this past Ladybug had the same powers are the current Ladybug (Marinette), she had enhanced abilities and the superpowers Lucky Charm and Miraculous Ladybug. She also used the yo-yo, as shown in the hieroglyph.

title: Khepri
text:
Khepri - Trivia
She was the first past Ladybug revealed to and discussed with Marinette, with her mission to prevent a sacrifice being explained by the Pharaoh until the Ancient Ladybug Miraculous holder in "Feast".
In the drawing by Feri González, she is referred to as the Oracle of Khepri, the Egyptian god of creation, rebirth, and the rising of the morning sun, who is depicted as a scarab beetle.
daesuqa (دعسوقة) means "ladybug" in Arabic.
Since her time as a holder matches the time the Miraculouses were created, it's possible that Khepri was the second to own the Ladybug Miraculous, being the immediate successor of Piáo Chóng, the very first holder.
There are a few historical differences between the Quantic Universe and the real world.
She was active and stopped Tutankhamun around 5,000 years ago in the Quantic Universe, however, in the real world, Tutankhamun actually ruled Egypt approximately 3,000 years ago.
In the real world, Princess Nefertiti was actually the wife of Pharaoh Akhenaten, who ruled Egypt until a couple of years before the ascension of Tutankhamun.
In the original French dub, the pharaoh that she faced was actually Akhenaten and not Tutankhamun.

title: Kenya's father
text:
Kenya's father - Intro
is a man who lives in New York with his daughter Kenya.
As established in the Miraculous Adventures story "Battle for New York", after coming into contact with mysterious black goo while retrieving his daughter's favorite toy, Mr. Squid, he transforms into the Trash Krakken, a giant destructive monster.

title: Kenya's father
text:
Kenya's father - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Kenya's father has brown skin, light brown eyes and light brown hair.
As Trash Krakken
Trash Krakken is made out of mud and trash. It has lime green eyes, a huge slimy, green body with various types of objects absorbed onto its body, multiple tentacles that are dangling on its back, and large pointy teeth sticking out of its mouth.

title: Kenya's father
text:
Kenya's father - Personality
He is a caring and loving man, concerned for his daughter's well-being. He is willing to go into the sewers to find his daughter's precious toy.
As Trash Krakken, he is mindless but ferocious, creating damage everywhere and lashing back at anything it considers a threat. He was solely focused on destroying New York and defeating the superheroes trying to stop him. After destroying the villain's garbage shell and losing Mr. Squid, he desperately tries to get his toy back.

title: Kenya's father
text:
Kenya's father - Abilities
As a Trash Krakken
Trash Krakken can dig into the earth, creating a huge crack within New York City. Like a "living quicksand", it absorbs anything that it comes into contact with, from trees and banana peels to human beings, and it is invulnerable to a wide variety of attacks. It can also attack others with its tentacles, which, like the rest of its body, absorb what they touch.

title: Kenya's father
text:
Kenya's father - History
Miraculous Adventures
Before the events of "Silurus", in the moning man carried his daughter, Kenya, in his arms to the hospital, but the road leading there was blocked. Kenya dropped her stuffed animal Mr. Squiad into a manhole, which made her very upset. Her father carried her to the hospital and promised his daughter he would get her lost toy back. He went down in the sewers and searched for a long time, until finally found Mr. Squiad, soaked in a puddle of what looked like tar with blitter in it. When he picked it up, the puddle started moving, as if it was alive. Then it reared up like a wave and went inside Mr. Squaid and man was transformed into giant destructive monster.
According to Victory, Trash Krakken appeared before noon and started digging under the city, creating deep cracks which led to explosions, fires, water damage, and thus "the cancellation of the basketball championship finale". The villain also absorbed some of the superheroes who fought him.

title: Kenya's father
text:
Kenya's father - History
In "The Big Leagues", after President Camilla Hombee, as known Victory, arrives by helicopter, she showing a scanned photo of the Trash Krakken and explaining the entire backstory, planning to destroy it with a powerful attack that could destroy half the United States. However, Ladybug decides to neutralize the villain without destroying everything. Along with Cat Noir, Knightowl, and Sparrow, she jumps into the pit created by the villain. The superheroes come face to face with the monster.
In "Battle for New York", heroes devise a plan to extract Mr. Squid from the Trash Krakken to see if it will restore the monster to normal. They launch an attack, but their attempts to stop the creature prove futile, and it also absorbs Sparrow. Eventually, they come up with a new plan: Ladybug, having obtained gum from her Lucky Charm, asks Knightowl to chew it and then attaches it to her yo-yo, allowing her to extract Mr. Squid from the monster. Meanwhile, Cat Noir destroys the Trash Krakken from the inside with Cataclysm, freeing the trapped superheroes and man, who is desperately searching for Mr. Squiad.

title: Kenya's father
text:
Kenya's father - History
Only after Ladybug cleanses Mr. Squid of the strange substance does he regain consciousness. When Ladybug questions him, he tells his story, after which he remembers nothing. The heroes thank him for the information. After Ladybug uses her Miraculous Ladybug and all the damage was repaired, Kenya's father goes to the hospital and returns the toy to his daughter.

A van that closely resembles the Mystery Machine from the Scooby-Doo franchise is seen stuck in the Trash Krakken's body in the third issue.

title: Kamikotized heroes
text:
Kamikotized heroes - Intro
are people (or other sentient beings) transformed into superheroes by the holder of the Butterfly Miraculous, with Kamikotization, the good version of the superpower of the Butterfly Miraculous.

title: Kamikotized heroes
text:
Kamikotized heroes - Transformation
Whenever a person has strong emotions, the holder of the Butterfly Miraculous senses it and can charge a butterfly with Nooroo's power, Transmission, transforming it into kamiko. The kamiko then flies away to the targeted person and possesses an important object that belongs to the person.
Once the object is possessed, it immediately creates a telepathic link between the holder and the other person, allowing them to communicate through a butterfly-shaped light mask that appears in front of their faces.
Once the connection is established, the holder gives them a new name for their superhero identity and explains to the person that they'll give them the ability to accomplish their goals.
When the person agrees, a dark purple ether appears from the possessed object and surrounds the person. Once it recedes, it reveals the victim has transformed into a superhero.
Unlike with akumatized villains, kamikotized heroes are given a feeling of hope by the holder, which allows them to accept the power and convinced to do good with it, either by saving people or fighting villains.

title: Kamikotized heroes
text:
Kamikotized heroes - Transformation
The Butterfly Miraculous holder cannot control them nor read their minds. However they can sense their feelings, allowing them to feel what they are feeling. If he needs to, the holder can control their bodies for a brief amount of time in order to inflict pain on them, typically with this ability being to ensure that the kamikotized superheroes don't abuse of their powers or use them for evil purposes. Hawk Moth, however uses this ability in order to inflict pain on them until they agree to do as he commands.
The holder can revoke the kamiko or akuma, removing the champion's powers. Sometimes he also uses this as a threat against their allies if they start to stray from the path of goodness or when the kamikotized mission is over which makes transformation only temporary. The holder can revoke any kamiko or akuma, with that holder being either a hero or a villain. The holder can if needed transfer the Kamiko or akuma to another champion if the current champion is unable to handle a task with the current powers.
Any sentient creature with emotions can be kamikotized or akumatized, including robots, spirits, and sentimonsters.

title: Kamikotized heroes
text:
Kamikotized heroes - Transformation
The mental connection is dependent on proximity. If the Butterfly Miraculous holder and the champion are too far away from each other, the communication can't be established, and they can't contact the champion or revoke the power.

title: Kazuno
text:
Kazuno - Intro
is one of the two deuteragonists in Miraculous World: Tokyo - Stellar Force (alongside Miki) and the animated spin-off series Miraculous Stellar Force. He is a student at Kano Academy, a superhero, and member of the Stellar Force. title: Kazuno
text:

Physical Appearance
Kazuno is a fair-skinned Japanese teenage boy of short-to-medium height and slender build. He has short messy jet-black hair that sticks out unevenly at the sides, along with a small, split ahoge at the side, its side slightly thicker than the other. His thick bangs frame his face with a piece hanging in the middle. He has thick eyebrows with a zigzag cut at the upper sides. He has round green eyes with a vermilion ring around the pupil.
Civilian Attire
Kazuno wears a jet black hoodie with the hood big and surrounding his neck. It has a charcoal gray trim and lighter zipper and zipline, There are charcoal gray lines around the shoulders, angularly going down the torso, and at the sides of the middle pocket. His slightly baggy pants are dull navy and rolled up to the calf with thick lighter cuffs, white socks, dull navy loafers, and lighter soles.
As Capricorn

title: Kazuno
text:

Capricorn wears a jumpsuit shared with his teammates: a black jumpsuit with rectangular-detailed white elbow trim, abdomen, thigh trim, and shins. On his chest is a black four-point star. title: Kazuno
text:

Described by Miki, Kazuno is kind, smart and altruistic. He is very friendly, evident when he opened up and welcomed Kagami as she came to the academy, who, like Adrien, learned from his friends outside of his parents to reach out to others. Kazuno did the same for Kagami and one of things he enjoyed was dancing. Similar to Marinette, he is very clumsy. He devotes himself to his friends and is hardworking.
However, after Kagami ended their friendship, Kazuno lost his zeal for the art. As part of the Stellar Force, Kazuno acts a bit like his star sign, a Capricorn - reserved and always separating himself from the team. He's not attentive, resulting in Leo chiming in because of his lack of focus. Fortunately, after he reunites with Kagami and learns her true feelings, Kazuno's passion is restored and he fully integrates himself with the team.

title: Kazuno
text:

Kazuno is skilled in judo and hand to hand combat, even enough to be on par with Miki and her kickboxing, and what is equally matched by his fighting skills is his dancing.

Capricorn has enhanced physical abilities, such as speed, combat, agility and strength. With the help of the Capricorn Sprite, he can summon his weapon, which is unknown. He also has the ability to see where modules on Kaijūs are.

title: Kano Academy
text:
Kano Academy - Intro
The  (狩野アカデミー, Kanō akademī) is an international academy based in Tokyo specializing in sports studies. It was the former school of Kagami Tsurugi.

title: Kano Academy
text:
Kano Academy - Appearance
Kano Academy is a prestigious institution, built on a small hill slightly overlooking Tokyo.
The main building consists of a two-story structure of red brick and white stonework, topped with an iron railing on the roof. Each floor is punctuated by different sets of windows: a pair of wide, four-paned windows sits alongside a third, three-paned window, perhaps marking the location of the professor's office.
The central part of the building is a rectangular tower that rises one story above the rest of the structure. Also built of red brick, it features a large circular clock with a white face and black numerals and hands. Below the clock is a long, narrow vertical window that spans at least two stories. This tower likely houses the staircases and provides access to the roof.
Courtyard
The courtyard (Nakaniwa) of Kano Academy is a small, intimate space. It has a smooth, beige-colored flagstone floor. Near the buildings, bushes grow in trapezoidal flowerbeds, sheltered by a pair of wooden benches. Two majestic trees stand in the center of the courtyard, each in the middle of a flowerbed bordered by a wide edge of smooth gray stones.
Gymnasium

title: Kano Academy
text:
Kano Academy - Appearance
The gymnasium (Taiikukan) is a large and spacious building, easily exceeding one hundred meters in length. The interior features a metal structure with wooden or blue carpeted walls and a roof structure with dozens of lights. Large windows allow natural light to flood the building, while the sliding doors serving as emergency exits are indicated by illuminated signs.
The building boasts a very wide wooden floor, suitable for numerous indoor sports, both individual and team. Among these is basketball, with three courts running the full width of the building and wall-mounted hoops, as well as lines for two handball courts, badminton courts, and volleyball courts. The floor also houses various equipment for different sports, such as an obstacle course for combat.
The gymnasium isn't exclusively for sports. It features a raised stage, surrounded by red curtains, used primarily during high school general assemblies or for artistic and theatrical performances.

title: Kano Academy
text:
Kano Academy - Uniforms
Like most majority of Asian middle/high schools, Kano Academy possessed a dress code that compelled its students to wear a uniform during school time. It uses a blazer-type uniform.
Both Genders
A white long-sleeved blazer with black outlines around the collar, running all the way to the bottom to the hem, cuffs and two black accents on the top of the fastened outer pockets. The pockets have gold buttons and each cuff have two golden cufflinks. On the top right of the chest there's an attached logo shaped as a reuleaux triangle, with the gold sign of Japanese kanji for female (女, on'na) fastened on top of green, white and red fabric with a gold outline surrounding the logo;
A black collared gold buttoned button-up blouse;
A red, white, and blue pleated neck tie.
Boys
White pants with black outlines around the pockets
Black sneakers
Girls
Red skirt with an asymmetrical texture that had blue and white intersecting vertical and horizontal lines.
Tight black leggings or white knee-high socks.
White sneakers (when wearing the black leggings) or black sneakers (when using the white socks).

title: Karelia
text:
Karelia - Etymology
The name Karelia is of Finnish origin. It comes from the name Karjala which is a combination of the Proto-Finnic word "karja" meaning "herd", which was borrowed from the Proto-Germanic word "harjaz" meaning "army", and the suffix "-la", meaning "earth". It overall means "herd of the earth".
The name could be derived from the ethnic group "Karelians."
It could also be a reference to the historical province Karelia, which is now divided between Russia and Finland.

Karelia's name, as mentioned in the etymology, could tie into the titular historical province. Said historical province is said to be rich in fish, lakes, and minerals, thus it would fit Karelia to represent the Pisces zodiac.

Located just past the front door, with a gray mailbox, the vestibule (genkan , 玄関) has white walls. The tataki (threshold) is blue and includes a burgundy umbrella stand. Beyond it is the wooden agari-kamachi (threshold), which marks the final entrance to Kazuno's Apartment. After this passage, there is a small cabinet with a light blue inkwell, opposite a front-loading washing machine and below a framed Japanese print.
Next, there is a dish cabinet with a gray frame and brown drawers, containing a sink, a flip-up shelf, and a towel rack, all facing a brown wooden door.
Living room
The apartment's main room is modern, with parquet flooring, beige walls, and a bay window with yellow pleated curtains. In the center of the room, there is a green rug with a white and green rectangular checkered pattern.

title: Kazuno's apartment
text:
Kazuno's apartment - Description
The living room is characterized by a green sofa with several green, yellow, and orange cushions, facing a large flat-screen television positioned on a wooden stand. Above the television, there is a wall shelf with various books and stationery supplies. To the left of the television, there is a wooden desk with metal legs, on which there is a box of paints and decorative arts materials, accompanied by a blue chair. Next to the sofa, near the bay window, there is a coffee table with two potted plants. The walls of the room are decorated with various photographs and paintings, as well as a map. An air conditioning unit is located near the bay window.
Balcony
The apartment balcony is typical of the building. It features gray and white colors, with a gray metal railing. The wall is made of red bricks. A metal clothesline hangs directly under the edge of the roof, with a small blue clothesline attached. The balcony is decorated with three green plants: one in a planter attached to the railing and two others in pots on the floor.

title: Kazuno's apartment
text:

An apāto (アパート), short for apātomento (アパートメント), is an apartment in a wooden structure, usually two stories high, built with relatively thin walls.
This type of apartment is usually inhabited by single people or families with a limited budget.
This is the first and only known residence of a Stellar Force member.
The presence of women's clothing on the balcony drying rack suggests that Kazuno lives in this apartment with a female member of his family.

title: Kid Mime
text:
Kid Mime - Intro
was a character from the old, unused concept of Ladybug and Cat Noir being in a team of superheroes called Quantic Kids along with Melodie and Mercury, replacing Sparrow. However, the concept was discarded, so Kid Mime never appeared outside concept art.
He was made to replace Sparrow because producers thought that the Mime was a great character and they didn't want to keep him as an adult villain only. He wasn't developed as a character before the superhero team concept was discarded, however.
Currently, it is unknown if Kid Mime exists in the Quantic Universe.

title: Kung Food
text:
Kung Food - Intro
"" is a season 1 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 25th written and produced episode of season 1. It is also the 25th written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Kung Food
text:
Kung Food - Synopsis
Nickelodeon
When Chloé sabotages a famous chef's dish, he gets akumatized into Kung Food, and those who taste his soup are under his control.
Netflix
When his dish at a competition is sabotaged, Marinette's great-uncle, chef Wang Cheng, becomes Kung Food, who recruits henchmen with his cooking.
Disney Channel
A chef's recipe is sabotaged by Chloé, and soon people who eat his meals become troublemakers.
Disney+
Ladybug faces her Chinese great-uncle, now Fung Food.

title: Kung Food
text:
Kung Food - Plot
Marinette is at her home, waiting for her mother's uncle, Wang Cheng, to arrive. Wang is Chinese, so Marinette uses an app on her phone which helps her with the pronunciation. She has a bouquet of flowers for him but worries that it might not be good enough. It is revealed that Wang is a cook with a global reputation and is in Paris for a cooking competition called "The World's Greatest Chef".

title: Kung Food
text:
Kung Food - Plot
When Wang arrives, Marinette rushes to the door and tries to greet him in Chinese but fails. She gives him the bouquet (from which he starts to pluck out the petals) while she uses the phone to translate the greeting for her. The phone does that but also translates (and repeats) the "Ugh, this is so lame!" that Marinette had said immediately after. Then, after Marinette manages to silence the phone and invites her uncle inside, she calls Alya to ask for help. Alya reassures her and says she has an idea and then hangs up. A few minutes later, Adrien arrives at the door. Marinette, after an initial surprised reaction, asks him what he's doing there. Adrien explains that Alya called him and asked him to act as an interpreter since he knows Chinese. Marinette asks where Alya is, and Alya promptly texts her saying that Marinette now owes her.
Wang, Marinette, and Adrien then ride in Adrien's limousine to Le Grand Paris, where the competition will take place. While Adrien and Cheng Shifu are conversing in Chinese, Wang reveals that he knows a little bit of their language, but he's a very bad speaker.

title: Kung Food
text:
Kung Food - Plot
Once they arrive, the Mayor warmly greets Wang, and the TV host, Alec Cataldi, asks him which dish he will prepare. Wang answers, "Celestial Soup". After the interview, Wang begins to cook and leaves Adrien alone. Marinette uses the opportunity to apologize to him since the fact her uncle spoke their language meant that she didn't need an interpreter after all. Adrien accepts the apologies and even thanks her for giving him the opportunity to practice his Chinese. Adrien also says that he's honored to have met Wang since he is a "shifu", which means "master".

title: Kung Food
text:
Kung Food - Plot
Soon, Chloé shows up and starts criticizing Cheng Shifu's choice to make a soup instead of sushi like everyone else. Adrien replies that Cheng Shifu is Chinese and that sushi is a Japanese dish, but Chloé brushes him off. She then reveals that she is a member of the jury for the competition and states that she will refuse to give a high vote for Wang's dish. So Marinette steps up and tells Chloé that she has no taste at all and that Cheng Shifu doesn't need Chloé's vote because all the other judges will love his dish. Angered, Chloé storms off. Adrien then compliments Marinette for defending her uncle and says that he would have been proud if he had been there. However, Marinette answers that she's not so sure and that she fears that her uncle might not like her as he even ruined the bouquet she prepared for him. Adrien reassures her, saying that Cheng Shifu told him that he would use the flowers for the soup and that he is always happy when surprise ingredients come into his life. Adrien suggests that Wang showed Marinette his respect in his own way.

title: Kung Food
text:
Kung Food - Plot
Chloé, angry about Marinette's previous statements to her, storms into the kitchen where Wang is making his meal for the jury and tells him that Marinette is outside and wants to talk to him. Once Wang leaves the kitchen, Chloé mixes several random ingredients into the soup in order to ruin the flavor and get a negative response from the jury. Wang renters the kitchen and says that Marinette wasn't there, but Chloé brushes him off, saying that she "doesn't speak Japanese", much to Wang’s confusion.
Next, the five jury members are introduced: André Bourgeois, Chloé, Jagged Stone, Marlena Césaire, and Alec. When Wang presents the sabotaged dish to the judges during the live broadcast, they all react with disgust and give him scores that Alec says are the lowest scores ever seen on the show. Marinette apologizes to Wang for provoking Chloé and causing this, but Wang leaves, ashamed over his loss.

title: Kung Food
text:
Kung Food - Plot
Hawk Moth senses Cheng Shifu's frustration and sends an akuma after him. Wang realizes that Marinette is right about Chloé, and the akuma possesses his chef hat. Hawk Moth offers Wang the chance to be the world's greatest chef and seek revenge on Chloé and transforms him into Kung Food. The judges who tasted his dish earlier come under his control, and he makes them capture Chloé. They then pour indestructible caramel over the entire building, trapping Adrien and Marinette inside.
Marinette realizes that Kung Food is actually Wang. Meanwhile, the brainwashed judges are making an enormous pot of soup in the rooftop pool, which Chloé is suspended above. Marinette and Adrien transform into their respective superhero forms; encounter each other in the lobby; and run to the elevator so they can go to the roof, but a flying onion-shaped security camera is monitoring them, allowing Kung Food to see what they are doing. After asking Hawk Moth about the two superheroes, Kung Food decides to also cook Ladybug and Cat Noir in the soup, and sends Jagged Stone to go capture them. Kung Food reveals to Chloé that she is going to be cooked in the soup as well.

title: Kung Food
text:
Kung Food - Plot
Inside, Cat Noir has trouble opening the elevator doors. Kung Food appears on the monitor to reveal his plan. The elevator doors open and reveal Jagged Stone, who wields a sword made entirely out of seafood. Ladybug and Cat Noir easily defeat Jagged Stone by locking him in a closet and go up the elevator.
When Kung Food realizes that the heroes defeated Jagged Stone, he sends André Bourgeois to fight them. When the elevator stops, the Mayor appears in front of Ladybug and Cat Noir, wielding a string of sausages and potatoes. Before Ladybug and/or Cat Noir attack him, he attacks with the string and manages to restrain Cat Noir, but before he can grab Cat Noir's Miraculous, Ladybug tricks him into copying her yo-yo moves with his string, causing him to accidentally bring down a chandelier on top of himself. The fallen chandelier creates a hole in the ceiling, which Ladybug and Cat Noir use to ascend to the floor above.

title: Kung Food
text:
Kung Food - Plot
Kung Food then orders both Alec and Mrs. Césaire to attack the heroes. The two of them meet the heroes and attack, respectively, with a crossbow that shoots exploding stinky cheese bombs and a bow that shoots cake arrows. After winning the fight, Ladybug and Cat Noir use the elevator to go up to the roof and save Chloé from being boiled alive.
Angry that his soup is ruined, Kung Food begins to fight the heroes. Ladybug assumes the akuma is in Kung Food's chef hat and promptly uses Lucky Charm, which gives her a credit card machine. After mocking her for trying to defeat him with a piece of paper, Kung Food takes a giant sword made of pizza from his bag and resumes his fight with Cat Noir. After figuring out what to do, Ladybug soaks the paper from the machine in Kung Food's soup and wraps the damp paper around him, trapping him. Cat Noir uses his Cataclysm on Kung Food's bag, and Ladybug grabs the chef hat and tears it apart, revealing the akuma. Ladybug catches the akuma and purifies it. She then tosses the check machine in the air and cleanses the city, returning everything, including the judges and Cheng Shifu, back to normal.

title: Kung Food
text:
Kung Food - Plot
Later, in the kitchen, Marinette asks Wang if he can teach her how to make Celestial Soup. Chloé then appears in the doorway and insults Wang for making the soup again. Irritated, Adrien asks her if her father had kicked her out of the jury because she sabotaged Wang Cheng Shifu's Celestial Soup. Chloé denies this, saying that she had resigned of her own accord.
During another broadcast of The World's Greatest Chef, Wang makes the Celestial Soup again (indicating that after learning of Chloé's sabotage, they decided to give Wang a second chance), getting very positive reactions from the judges. Wang tells the judges that he no longer calls it Celestial Soup but, rather, Marinette Soup after his grandniece. Adrien, Marinette and her uncle also eat the soup.

title: Kung Food
text:
Kung Food - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in France on TFOU.
The title is a pun of the word "kung fu".
Both Ladybug's and Cat Noir's transformation sequences are sped up and slightly cut.
In the Chinese version, Master Cheng speaks Cantonese as his native language.
References
Adrien's ability to speak Chinese, which is first mentioned in "The Bubbler", is seen in this episode.
This is one of the six episodes of Season 1 in which Ladybug and Cat Noir don't do their signature "Pound it!", the other five being "Princess Fragrance", "The Pharaoh", "Timebreaker", "Animan" and "Stoneheart".
Allusions
Kung Food's facial markings are a reference to the Monkey King Sun Wukong from the chinese novel Journey to the West.
His design also has similarities to Goku, with his hair akin to a Super Saiyan, from Dragon Ball Z, who is based on the same character.
The pizza sword is a reference to Final Fantasy VII's Buster Sword.
Jagged Stone, while under Kung Food's control, and Ladybug each run with their arms behind their backs for a moment, which is the way that ninjas run.

title: Kung Food
text:
Kung Food - Trivia
Bruce Lee was considered a reference for the moves Ladybug and Cat Noir use when they are fighting others to get to Kung Food.
The title of the episode also shares a name with a vintage fighting video game for the Atari Lynx in which the protagonist has to fight mutated food.
Kung Food trying to cook Chloé into "Brat Soup" is a form of cannibalism.
Errors
When Ladybug and Cat Noir throw Jagged Stone into the closet, the door handle is backward.
When Ladybug pulls on Cat Noir's arm to go to the elevator, the spots on her right arm switch.
As Ladybug and Cat Noir hold on to Cat Noir's staff to get into the room above them, Ladybug's right leg phases through the pole twice.
As Cat Noir was fighting Kung Food, his staff was in his hand but it was still shown attached to his back.
Throughout half of the episode, all sound effects were misplaced.
In one frame when Ladybug is tying her yo-yo around Jagged Stone's leg, one of her pigtails becomes transparent.
When Ladybug ties her yo-yo around Jagged Stone's leg, a second yo-yo can be seen being attached around her hips.

Before Kung Food is reverted back to Wang Cheng, his chef hat can be briefly seen on his head despite having been destroyed seconds earlier by Ladybug.
When Kung Food is on the floor, his left arm is a flesh color even though he was still akumatized.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature - Intro
(Lê Chiến Kim Ature in eastern order), is a supporting character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He is a student at the Collège Françoise Dupont and a former student of Miss Bustier's class, before she became mayor of Paris. He is currently in a relationship with Ondine.
In "Dark Cupid", after being rejected and humiliated by his former crush Chloé Bourgeois, he was akumatized by Hawk Moth and became Dark Cupid, a hate-spreading supervillain.
In "Party Crasher", in order to defeat the titular villain who managed to capture Ladybug and her team, Kim received the Monkey Miraculous from Master Fu. When the Miraculous is inhabited by Xuppu, he becomes King Monkey (Roi Singe in the French version), a monkey-themed superhero with the power of Derision.
After the events of "Strikeback", Kim was temporarily unable to become King Monkey after Monarch managed to steal the Monkey Miraculous along with all the others contained in the Chinese Miracle Box from Ladybug's yo-yo.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature - Intro
In "Derision", after Adrien and Ondine reprimanded him because of his cruel pranks that were the reason behind Marinette's trauma towards love, Kim was akumatized by Monarch into Dark Humor, a new version of his previous akumatization form Dark Cupid, and was given the power of the Monkey Miraculous through his Alliance ring. He also received a Magical Charm from Ladybug that prevented him from being reakumatized.
In "Re-creation", after Ladybug recovered the stolen Miraculous and reforged them following Monarch's defeat, Kim was given back the Monkey Miraculous permanently and reunited with Xuppu.
In "Sleeping Syren", after being tricked by Ray, Loïc and Nelson into hurting Ondine's feelings, thus causing her to get akumatized, Ladybug is prompted to not call Kim on the mission and almost considers taking away his Miraculous. However, when Kim refuses to sit idly by following the heroes, he put himself in great danger. Seeing his determination to save his girlfriend, Ladybug allowed him to keep his Miraculous and enlisted his help to deakumatize Ondine.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature - Intro
In "Revelator", it's shown that, after getting his Miraculous back, Kim, along with the other secondary heroes of Ladybug's team, was trained to unlock his adult powers, no longer detransforming after using his power.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Kim is a Vietnamese-French boy who is muscular and taller than the average student at school. He has light olive skin and gray eyes. He has his hair, which is black with the ends dyed gold, styled into a sharp quiff. He has thin eyebrows.
From Season 6 onwards, he wears a silver stud earring on his right ear and his hair has become more brown instead of black, but the tips of his quiff are more blond, albeit they are a little more smaller in the gradient, as there is more brown down to the bottom than before.
Civilian Attire
In the first five seasons, he wore a vivid red, short-sleeved, draw-stringed hoodie with a big front pocket. The drawstrings were white and short on the hood with matching-colored diagonal outlines below around the torso, and on top of his sleeves as well as the sides of the large pocket. On the front of the hoodie, there was a white logo, which was a downward-pointing pentagon outline outside of a smaller, filled-in pentagon with a vivid red corner at the bottom right and a matching-colored star. At the bottom of the hoodie were knotted white drawstrings at a short height. Below was a sharp angular swan-necked vivid red top.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature - Appearance
He paired this with navy blue track sweatpants that are puffed up at the ends and rolled up to the ankle, and sports shoes that were mainly vivid red with black laces and metallic accents around the sides, and white toes and horizontal lines around the black tongue.
He wore the Monkey Miraculous as a pair of orange and blue banded swimming earplugs that he wore on occasion until "Re-creation".
From Season 6 onwards, his attire is slightly different; he swaps his short-sleeved hoodie for one with longer sleeves and a short asymmetrical zipper, located on the left side and being left unzipped. The inside of the hoodie is charcoal gray. His hoodie's logo is smaller and on the right side, the outlines retained. However, he no longer has drawstrings anywhere, and the top of the hoodie is swan-necked and outlined in white.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature - Appearance
He wears a white shirt underneath and his sweatpants are slimmer and are more rolled down to the foot, with a white line running down on each side. His sports shoes have a different design: while the red is retained, the tongue is also red with black laces and accents at the sides of the toe and back, and the toes have a more trapezoidal cut and the horizontal lines are retained, but there is white trimming on top of the shoes, mainly behind the tongue.
He wears the Monkey Miraculous around his neck as a pair of red swimming earplugs with a white stripe on each plug that he uses as a collar outside the pool.
As King Monkey
In Seasons 3-5, King Monkey wore a metallic gold mask and a dark brown area around his head that had a circular area at the chin. It covered up most of his head, except the eyes, mouth, nose, ears, and hair. He also gained tangerine swirled eyebrows.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature - Appearance
His Miraculous turned gold and swirly with five black squares on the back, diving his mask and hair that was now spiked at the top of his head, resembling a fire with a two-toned gradation of red and orange at the tip, the roots brown. He wore a light brown costume resembling a track suit, separated in two. His top had a center covering his stomach and pectorals, colored light tan. A gold zipper and zip-line rested at the base of the top, just underneath the collar. The hood was a slightly dull tan with gold diagonal zipped up pockets. He had dark brown shoulder pads that extended down to his upper arm with gold borders, accented by the ones at the sides of his thighs and his anklets, which have two light beige bands, the top ones going diagonally. all of which had dull orange segmented lines. He wore gloves that extended off of his suit that were golden at his fingers, dark brown at his wrist, and light brown at the rest, and had tan cuffs.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature - Appearance
A golden belt with multiple holes featuring a dark brown buckle and brown rope-like spots on either side of his hips rested at his waist, separating the top from the bottom. At the back of his belt was a rope attached to a hook with a golden tip that resembled the tail of a monkey, some of it having been tucked beneath the belt. His boots were similar to his gloves, extending away from the body. Like Carapace, there was a division between his big toe and the rest of his foot. His soles reached up to the top of his foot and were golden, with brown highlights and the cuffs of his boots golden. He carried the Ruyi Jingu Bang on his back or kept it in his hands.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature - Appearance
From Season 6 onwards, his appearance has slight alterations. Instead of wearing a face mask, his skin turns metallic gold. Additionally, his irises turn amber. His Miraculous gains long, thin dark vermilion pieces resembling pheasant tail feathers that curve inwards in the middle, with an orange gradient tip. His armor gains scalloped gold bordering and dots in-between, as well as on the top of his vambraces. His gloves now expose his fingers and palms. His torso gains thin golden swirls at the sides, and the zipper takes on a golden three-tiered zigzag shape. The symbol of the Monkey Miraculous is placed on his back with a golden border and brown interior. The brown padding on the sides extend to the armpits. His belt is now golden and the rope held around his belt also seems to be wider with the holes farther at the sides, the boots gaining light brown feet and gold parts around them.
As Dark Cupid

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature - Appearance
Dark Cupid wore a black and red cupid-themed outfit, along with large black wings attached to his back, each feather-like end tipped with two red stripes. On the sides of his neck, there were black lightning bolts. He wore a black head cover, the areas covering the top of his hair and around his eyes being red, but his eyes remained the same and his hair seemed to have a visible but more solid shape beneath the covered areas. The top of his suit was red, with a large white broken heart on his chest outlined in black.
From the waist down to the knee, the suit was black, having a lightning-like cut through the middle to likely resemble a heartbreak or thunder, similar to the neck accents. From the elbow down to the hand was black, and from the knee down, it was red with a few strands of cloth sticking out above the back of each ankle.
On his back was a black, red, and white striped quiver, which carried red arrows. On the quiver strap across his chest, the brooch, which was red and black, was attached to it. His archery bow was based on a breaking heart. The handle was white with red heart halves at the ends, and on each side of the bow, there were two large gray and white spikes.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature - Appearance
As Dark Humor
Dark Humor had the same appearance as Dark Cupid, though the colors of black and red on his jumpsuit, head cover, and wings were swapped, and the coloring of his sleeves were mixed in-between. The broken heart on his torso changed to a deep-pinkish red with a white outline. The black strap which had his brooch on from his previous akumatization as Dark Cupid has changed to deep red. He also wore a red, translucent lens on his right eye, similar to Félix's revealer lens. When he shot his arrows from his bow, the arrows had squeaky toys summoned from the power of Uproar, at the tips of the arrow.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature - Personality
Kim is the "king of competitions." He enjoys making dares, much to the frustration of his classmates, and he is also very confident in himself and his athletic abilities, thus most of his dares involve using the person's body. Over-confident and proud, Kim sometimes boasts about his abilities and doesn't always take facts into consideration, believing he can beat a panther in a race in "Animan." He isn't afraid to tease others, either, as he gives Ivan a note telling him that he isn't brave enough to act on his romantic feelings. But, even if he loves teasing and pranking others, he normally remains in good terms with his classmates, who have come to see him for his real self and end up tolerate his antics, with some, like Alix, being able to keep him humble, as seen in "Timebreaker" and "Hack-San". However, behind his bravado, there are a few insecurities, like his fear of being humiliated and rejected, noticed for the many times he tried to flirt with Chloé only to be constantly rejected by her and sometimes even humiliated.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature - Personality
While hot-headed and rude sometimes (traits that are mostly a product of confidence and love for pranks), Kim is generally kind and appreciative, appreciating Marinette's encouragement to confess his love to his crush in "Dark Cupid". When not teasing and pranking others, Kim is shown to be caring and loveable, with the primary drive behind his pranks being that he wants to make people laugh. He is also willing to help those in need, as seen in "Party Crasher", when he helped Master Fu when he fell, without a second thought, with that being the reason that led him to receive a Miraculous. Kim is also very integrous, especially on his promises. This is seen in "Sleeping Syren", when Kim gives back the expensive flippers Ray gave him due to breaking his promise to him to not speak to girls and also when he refused to transform into King Monkey when Ondine was akumatized and wanted to warn Ladybug and Cat Noir to not kiss her.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature - Personality
In "Derision", Kim is revealed to have a more darker side when it comes to his goofy personality, something that was more evident in his eighth grade year, where he has a tendency to play cruel pranks on others without realizing how those pranks can actually hurt his targets emotionally and affect them. Despite doing those pranks out of good intentions (thinking people will find them funny as well), the truth is that Kim remained oblivious to the consequences of his actions. An example of that was when, after being manipulated by Chloé, Kim played a mean prank on Marinette when she had just admitted her feelings for him, resulting in a tremendous humiliating moment for her that traumatized her deeply and caused her to have problems to fully dedicate herself to romance. After being deakumatized as Dark Humor and being told how hurtful his pranks can be, Kim promises that he will change and be more mindful with his pranks.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature - Personality
Even his good and fun-loving nature can work against him, as both cause Kim to be quite oblivious and an airhead to the things around him that don't revolve around the things he enjoys. Because of that, Kim becomes unaware of the feelings of the others. This is seen in "Syren", where he was not able to perceive Ondine's feelings for him, despite her attempts to tell him that, needing a more explicit confession for him to realize it. Another example of that is seen in "Sleeping Syren", how Kim failed to realize Ondine's sadness regarding his inability to act romantic with her, including giving her a kiss. He can also come across as very naive believing in most of things people tell him. One example of that is in "Derision", how he believed in Chloé's claims Marinette would appreciate a prank from him when she would try to express her feelings for him. Another example is how he fell for Nelson's lies about kissing Ondine being dangerous for him, which ended up leading Kim to hurt her feelings. Nevertheless, he is capable of learning from his mistakes and become a better person as a result.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature - Personality
In "Syren", Kim is showed being a great admirer of Ladybug and Cat Noir, so much that he wants to be a hero himself and is curious about how to become one.
Then during "Party Crasher", his curiosity was answered upon receiving the Monkey Miraculous.
As King Monkey, most of Kim's personality traits remain the same.
However, as seen in "Party Crasher", Kim is a little goofier and sillier while he goes one-on-one with the titular villain, albeit everyone else had been defeated.
He is also heroic and it can be assumed he is loyal as after Party Crasher is defeated, he is seen without the Miraculous, which means he must have returned it to Ladybug or back to the place he found it for Master Fu to take it back.
He also appears to become more focused as King Monkey, as seen in multiple occasions where he follows Ladybug's intructions without fail or how he is showed being a competent superhero on his own.
However, this becomes especially true when the ones he cares about are in danger.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature - Personality
This is seen in "Sleeping Syren", where King Monkey becomes relentless in saving Ondine, facing her most powerful guardian (a water dragon) without cowarding and/or goofing off and also being able to figure out a way to release the ultrakuma with his superpower showcasing that he can be perceptive when needed.
As Dark Cupid, he was greatly bitter at love and sought to avenge his broken heart by destroying all the love in Paris with his arrows. He was still very prideful but had no issues teaming up with one of his victims, like Cat Noir, to succeed.
As Dark Humor, unlike his previous akumatization as Dark Cupid (where he wanted to turn love into hate, forcing people to hate their loved ones), he forced people to share more of his cruel and twisted sense of humor, shooting his arrows powered by the power of the Monkey Miraculous to do just that. However, just like Dark Cupid, he was still very prideful and had a great confidence on his skills, falling for Ladybug's trick when she pretended to have been hit by one of his arrows.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature - Abilities
As a Civilian
Kim is a talented athlete that excells in most sports, showcasing a great deal of speed, strength and resistance for his age. He is a very fast runner, being able to almost keep up with Alix, who was wearing roller skates, when they raced in "Timebreaker" and "Hack-San", despite the fact she herself is a very fast rollerblader, and,  in "Animan", Kim states that he came in first place in the County Athletics Tournament. As seen in "Syren", Kim seems to partically excell as a swimmer, being the sport that he shows the greatest interest as seen in "Confrontation", where it is implied that Kim wanted to be a swimming instructor.
In "Syren", it's shown that Kim can use his own feet to hold things, as if they were hands.
In his eighth grade year, where he has a tendency to play cruel pranks on others despite doing those pranks out of good intentions. It would make sense that Kim has a creative, cunning, and clever side like Marinette/Ladybug.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature - Abilities
King Monkey has enhanced capabilities such as speed, agility, and strength, and he is almost invulnerable to physical damage. These abilities allow him to react to and evade akumatized villains attacks, as well as jump and leap several times his height and length. Like a monkey, he can runs on all fours and jump around in fights.
His tool is a Ruyi Jingu Bang, with which he can swing and defend himself against villain attacks. He can also use it to activate his power Uproar, which allows him to summon an item that, upon contact with someone, makes that person's abilities malfunction. This power makes him very valuable to the team by giving him a role of disruptor/wallbreaker against tricky enemies.
Initially, using his power would depower him and cause him to detransform after 5 minutes, however, in "Revelator" it is shown that King Monkey has learned to control his adult powers, allowing him to not detransform back and use Uproar as much as he wishes.
As Dark Cupid
Dark Cupid could fly with his wings. Using his bow and rose-shaped black arrows, he shot people, turning their feelings of love and friendship into hate.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature - Abilities
The effect of the arrows varied from person to person; for example, Alya became mean-spirited to Marinette, while Cat Noir got filled by the desire to destroy Ladybug. The lips of people affected by his arrows gained black lipstick.
Similarly to fairy tales with enchanted spells, the effect of the arrows could be reverted by a true love's kiss.
As Dark Humor
Just like Dark Cupid, Dark Humor could fly with his wings and used a bow and arrows. However, unlike his previous akumatization, Dark Humor's arrows were powered by the superpower of the Monkey Miraculous, "Uproar", mixing it with his power to turn love into hate to create arrows that, not only could interfere with other superpowers (either by hitting their user directly or the tools they use to activate it), but could also force them to become extremely mischievous and pull pranks on others without any concern for their physical and emotional safety.
Dark Humor also had an eyescope (his akumatized object) that he used to be able to shoot his arrows at the right angle in order to hit his target.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature - Etymology
Kim has two dads and takes the family names of both of his dads. One of his dads, Mr. Lê, is of Vietnamese heritage. As such, his name follows Vietnamese naming conventions. His other dad, Mr. Ature, has a name that follows western order. Kim's family names follow the orders of his respective dads.
In order, "Lê" is one of his family name; "Chiến" is his middle name; "Kim" is his first name; and "Ature" is his other family name.
Originally, Kim's name was just Lê Chiến Kim.
According to Thomas Astruc, for a reason he himself doesn't know, his surname was temporarily changed to just Ature in the French dub, and Nguyễn in the English and some of the other dubs. He didn't have an issue with the change to Nguyễn, but he did not like the change to Ature, as unlike Nguyễn, it's not a Vietnamese surname.
This is seen in "Optigami", as he's referred to using his changed surname by Nathalie. Interestingly, his name is listed as it was originally in the credits of the short film the class made in "Miraculous New York", and his career form in "Confrontation".
Eventually, the name was changed to where it included both the original and the changed last names, likely to clear up inconsistencies.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature - Etymology
In the Irish dub, his name is changed to Cian.
His superhero name, King Monkey, is a reference to the literary and religious character of King Monkey, also known as Sun Wukong.
His supervillain name, Dark Cupid, is based off of Cupid, a mythical character in Roman mythology, who is believed to have the power to bring people together with his love arrows.
However, his powers operate opposite to Cupid's, as he breaks people apart.
His French name, Dislocoeur, is intended to be a pun, with "-cœur" meaning "heart" and "dis-" alluding to "disloquer", meaning "break".
His other supervillain name, Dark Humor, references his other villain name by keeping the word "dark," and simply refers to the type of humor called dark humor, which is humor that makes light of taboo subjects.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature - Trivia
Miraculous Holder and Akumatized Villains
A scarlet version of Dark Cupid reappeared in the two-part special event "Heroes' Day".
Dark Cupid appeared another time in "Gamer 2.0" for Gamer's powers.
Kim is the third person to be chosen to receive a Miraculous directly from Master Fu.
Much like how it happened with Marinette and Adrien, Kim showed that he was worthy by helping Master Fu when he was in a tight situation.
Unlike how it happened with Marinette and Adrien, Master Fu actually was in a tight situation when he was helped by Kim, instead of faking it like he did with the other two.
This makes Kim one of three Miraculers not to be chosen by Ladybug with the other two being Adrien and Felix.
Following Alya Césaire, Nino Lahiffe, Chloé Bourgeois, Nathalie Sancoeur, Luka Couffaine, Max Kanté, Kagami Tsurugi, and Alix Kubdel, Kim is the ninth person to become a Miraculous holder and akumatized villain, excluding Gabriel Agreste, who akumatized himself.
Kim is the second known person of Vietnamese origin to wield a Miraculous, succeeding his Miraculous predecessor Bọ rùa, who wielded the Ladybug Miraculous.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature - Trivia
He is the fourth known person of Asian origins to wield the Monkey Miraculous following the Ancient Monkey Miraculous holder, Sun Wukong, and Sasuke Sarutobi.
Overall, he is the 25th known person of Asian origins to wield a Miraculous.
In "Kuro Neko", King Monkey was running on all fours.
Kim, alongside Zoé Lee, Juleka Couffaine, Nino Lahiffe, Kagami Tsurugi, and Sabrina Raincomprix, are the only current members of the Miraculers to whom Ladybug gave a Magical Charm.
In "Derision", he became the second member of the Miraculers to receive the power of their primary wielded Miraculous through their Alliance Ring, following Kagami Tsurugi in "Perfection".
Kim's superhero form seems to be based off of Sun Wukong (孙悟空), the legendary Chinese mythical monkey king who is known for being mischievous and rebellious.
King Monkey has long spiky hair, just like Sun Wukong.
When King Monkey posed at the end of his transformation, it is a pose Sun Wukong is often seen doing.
Miscellaneous
The official Miraculous Ladybug website also refers to him as Kim Ature.
It was later confirmed Kim has two fathers and two names.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature - Trivia
In "Sleeping Syren", both of them make a physical appearance, showing that one of them is an athlete (just like Kim) and the other is a physician.
It's possible that Kim has arachnophobia (fear of spiders) as mentioned in "Darkblade".
However, considering Kim used spiders on his prank towards Marinette in a flashback in "Derision", it's possible that either that was a lie invented by Chloé to threaten him or he developed the phobia later on.
While it is unknown what sports Kim plays specifically, Kim has made references to playing soccer in the French version, which is called football outside of the US. In "Darkblade", he is holding a basketball.
Kim also makes a baseball metaphor in the English version of "Dark Cupid".
Kim revealed he won the County Athletics Tournament in "Animan".
In the first issue of Miraculous Adventures, Kim is on a lacrosse team with Adrien, Ivan, and Alix.
Kim can stick his big toe on his foot into his ear and also manages to give Ondine a pen with his other foot, representing how monkeys use their feet like hands.

Kung Food: This Brat soup is going to be Kung Food's masterpiece!
Chloé: Do you have to tie me up above this foul-smelling liquid! My designer clothes are going to stink of grease!
Kung Food: Soup not greasy at all! Kung Food soup very well-balanced. Hahahaha!
(A projector then displays Jagged Stone, locked in the closet.)

title: Kung Food/Transcript
text:
Kung Food/Transcript - Intro
Jagged Stone: Get me out of here! Come on!
Kung Food: Bad sous chef. (sees Ladybug and Cat Noir enter the elevator, and then points to Mayor Bourgeois) You! Do me justice!
Mayor Bourgeois: Yes, Master. (dashes)
Cat Noir: Ladybug, come on. It's just you and me together. We could go places.
Ladybug: Uh, yeah. Like up.
Cat Noir: Exactly! We've got nowhere to go but up!
(The elevator short circuits.)
Ladybug & Cat Noir: Wahhh!
Ladybug: You spoke too soon!
Cat Noir: (tries the buttons and fails) I think the electricity between us short-circuited the elevator.
Ladybug: You wish. More like us getting ourselves into a sticky situation. (the elevator door opens)
Mayor Bourgeois: Royal hotpot with its giant string of smoked sausages! (swings it around)
Ladybug: Looks like a food fight is coming our way.
Cat Noir: I prefer my sausages with mashed potatoes.(They fight, and Mayor Bourgeois flings the heroes into a hotel suite.)Mayor Bourgeois: Welcome to the world famous Suite 36 of this hotel.
Ladybug: If we're not careful, we'll be the mashed potatoes!

title: Kung Food/Transcript
text:
Kung Food/Transcript - Intro
Mayor Bourgeois: You're no competition, Ladybug. (he charges them, and Cat Noir gets captured)Hawk Moth: (from his lair) Time to pick up the bill, Kung Food. Grab Cat Noir's Miraculous. His ring. Bring it to me! Do it now!
Ladybug: You've got the wrong superhero, Bourgeois! I bet you don't know how to do this. (does a move with her yo-yo)Mayor Bourgeois: Really, Ladybug? (copies the move, but gets his weapon caught in the chandelier. It falls and his weapon traps him)Cat Noir: Nice work, m'lady. Shall we go and find the head chef?
Kung Food: (watching from a projector) Pea-brain! Useless! My recipe not perfect without those two! (points to Marlena and Alec) Capture them, and don't mess up or you'll end up in soup, too!
Alec & Marlena: Yes, master. (they run off)''
Chloé: My hair is ruined! Do you know how long it took to style it this morning?
Kung Food: That won't be a problem soon.
Chloé: Ladybug, help me!
Kung Food: Ehehehehe!
Ladybug: We're almost there.
Cat Noir: Great. All this fighting has made me hungry!
Kung Food: (from a projector) Kung Food is generous. No need to choose between cheese and dessert, you get to have both! (the elevator bell rings)

title: Kung Food/Transcript
text:
Kung Food/Transcript - Intro
Alec: Watch the spectacular demonstration of the famous thousand flying cakes! (Marlena charges the heroes) Oh ho! Our guests seem to have a few tricks up their sleeves, but how will they fare against the blinding stinging cheese bombs! (shoots several cheese bombs, Cat Noir hits one of them with his staff and releases it's smoke)
Cat Noir: Ow, he's right. The cheese really does sting your eyes.
(They continue fight. Marlena shoots arrows at Ladybug, but she dodges them.)
Alec: (to Cat Noir) Ha-ha! You're no match for my... (gets interrupted Ladybug, who accidentally goes near him and touches in order to escape arrows. Marlena accidentally shoots at Alec, making him drop one of the cheese bomb and exploding in front of Marlena)
Ladybug: I think it's about time we got to the second course. (they take the elevator to Kung Food)
Kung Food: Ah, temperature is just right. Time to add main ingredient!
Chloé: (she begins to be reeled into the soup) Oh, no no no no noooo! Ah! (Cat Noir's staff cuts the rope, and Ladybug catches Chloé) Ladybug, what took you so long!? Just wait until I tell everyone you—
Ladybug: (drops Chloé) Oops.
Kung Food: Oh no! My Brat Soup will be so flavorless.

title: Kung Food/Transcript
text:
Kung Food/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: I know you're more honorable than this, Cheng Shifu!
Kung Food: I am-I'm not Cheng Shifu, I am Kung Food — the Greatest Chef in the world! And nobody will stop me from finishing my Brat Soup! (pulls out a weapon)
Ladybug: Get back Chloé! (Chloé runs off and the heroes charge Kung Food)
Kung Food: I take care of you two myself! (they fight)
Ladybug: Cat Noir! The akuma must be in his chef's hat! Try to grab it!
Cat Noir: (gets hit with powder) Ow! It burns!
Kung Food: Haha! Like it spicy?
Ladybug: Lucky Charm! (A check dispenser appears) A... check?
Cat Noir: And I think it's gonna be a steep one.
Kung Food: (pulls out a giant Pizza Sword, making the heroes gasp) You think you can beat me with a piece of paper!?
Cat Noir: You're one to talk, Kung Food. You've been trying to defeat us with sausages and cheese! Without any luck, I might add.
Kung Food: Grr! (swings at them)
(Everyone fights. Kung Food throws Ladybug and fights Cat Noir alone. then Ladybug uses her Lucky Vision and spots the soup and the check dispenser. she dips some of the check paper into the soup, to use as a weapon. She captures Kung Food.)
Ladybug: Cat Noir, all his weapons come from his bag. Destroy it.

title: Kung Food/Transcript
text:
Kung Food/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: Got it. Cataclysm! (destroys the bag and Kung Food falls over)
Kung Food: Noo!
Ladybug: Your days are over akuma! (picks up his hat and rips it, the akuma emerges) Time to de-evilize! Gotcha! Bye bye, little butterfly. (releases the purified butterfly) Miraculous Ladybug! (everything turns back to normal. Kung food turns back into Wang Cheng and gets confused while Ladybug gives him the chef hat)
Hawk Moth: (from his lair) This evil dinner was almost perfect. Revenge is a dish that's best served cold, so watch yourself, because I'll be ready to strike again!
(The window closes.)
Marinette: Could you teach me how to make Celestial Soup, Cheng Sifu?
Wang Cheng: With pleasure, Marinette. (takes the bouquet)
Adrien: Cooking needs no words.
Chloé: (from behind Adrien and he gets surprised) Seriously? Still making soup? I told you I hate soup! You think the jury is going to approve of this?
(Adrien gets mad at Chloé for her comment about soup.)
Adrien: Didn't your father kick you off the jury?
Chloé: No he didn't! I... uh... I... I resigned.
Adrien: I think Cheng Shifu and Marinette have got this covered. Why don't we let the real jury decide?

title: Kung Food/Transcript
text:
Kung Food/Transcript - Intro
Chloé: Ridiculous! Utterly ridiculous! (leaves the kitchen)Adrien: (giggles while scratching his head)(Cut to "The World's Greatest Chef" on air.)Alec: Cheng Shifu. Your delicious Celestial Soup has received the highest marks of all, making you the final winner! (Adrien and Marinette looked at each other and they gave applause)Mayor Bourgeois: (tasting the soup) Ah, and it will soon be the Mayor's Special on the restaurant menu of my prestigious hotel!
Jagged Stone: Rock n' Roll! I can't wait to get home and write a song about soup!
Wang Cheng: (bows to jury) Thank you, but no longer Celestial Soup. Now called: Marinette Soup.
Marinette: Huh? 谢谢 (Thank you)!
Wang Cheng: You're welcome.
Alec: (to Marinette) Come over here and stand alongside your uncle, the "World's Greatest Chef"! (Adrien happily gestures Marinette to go to her uncle. Then Marinette and Wang Cheng both hug)(The end card shows: Adrien, Marinette and her uncle eating the soup. "The World's Greatest Chef"'s logo in the center and Ladybug on the left side, Cat Noir on the right side.)''
