title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - Intro
Lê Chiến Kim is a teenage boy who attends Collège Françoise Dupont.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - Before Season 1
A year prior in the 8th grade, Kim was invited to go swimming at the pool by Marinette, whom was in his class at the time. However, he was influenced by Chloé to gift Marinette a box of spiders as prank, believing that she'd also find it funny. As a result, Kim pulled the prank on Marinette when she confessed her feelings for him on the pool's diving platform. Due to the spiders, Marinette panicked and fell backwards off the diving board and into the water below. Kim, not understanding the consequences of his actions, laughed and declared the scene "hilarious". Afterward, He headed towards the changing rooms to talk to Marinette, still laughing about what he assumed was a joke they were both in on. Subsequently, he was shooed away by Socqueline.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Ladybug & Cat Noir", Kim began a new school year at Collège Françoise Dupont in Miss Bustier's class. After class, Kim handed Ivan a hurtful note before heading off to attend Mr. D'Argencourt's PE class. Upon Stoneheart's arrival at Stade des Princesses later that day, he fearfully fled the scene.
In "Stoneheart", Kim and his classmates inquired if Ivan remembered being a supervillain. During roll call in Miss Bustier's class, he witnessed Stoneheart suddenly barge in and abduct Mylène and Chloé. In response, Kim hid in the corner of the classroom along with Juleka, Alix, and Max. Later in the library, he watched the broadcast of Hawk Moth's demands and rejoiced at Ladybug's proclamation to defend the city. After the debacle, Kim was amused when Marinette stood up to Chloé before class.
In "Lady Wifi", Kim took Alya's phone and handed it over to Chloé upon witnessing Alya sneakily photograph Chloé's locker while in the locker room before class. Afterward, Kim was present in Mr. Damoclès' office when Chloé got Alya suspended from school for a week. Later in Miss Bustier's class, he evacuated the school after witnessing Lady Wifi's sudden broadcast.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 1]]
In "The Evillustrator", Kim witnessed Nathaniel get sent to the principal's office for drawing in Ms. Mendeleiev's class. Later, he was doing research for his assigned group particle physics presentation in the school library until the Evillustrator appeared and attacked Chloé.
In "Princess Fragrance", Kim witnessed Ms. Mendeleiev send Rose to the principal's office for using perfume and her cellphone in class.
In "Dark Cupid", Kim attended Miss Bustier's class on Valentine's Day and met with Max after school to discuss to "Operation Valentine's Day". During their meeting, Max handed Kim a brooch to give to Chloé at Pont des Arts. After receiving encouragement from Marinette and Alya and Max's instructions, he thanked them and then ran off. Upon Chloé's arrival at the bridge, Kim nervously presented his gift and affection to Chloé to no avail. Not long after Chloé's rejection, Hawk Moth akumatized Kim into Dark Cupid.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 1]]
Kim, as Dark Cupid, happily inflicted damage on the affairs and friendships of others as he darted throughout the streets of Paris. As the day progressed, Dark Cupid continued on to attack Chloé, but was intercepted by Ladybug. As a result, he switched his focus onto Ladybug and managed to hit Cat Noir instead when he caught the two heroes off guard. At Hawk Moth's command, Dark Cupid teamed up with a newly corrupted Cat Noir to crush Ladybug and take her miraculous. Afterwards, he and Cat Noir attacked Ladybug, Chloé, and Sabrina at Le Grand Paris hotel. As Cat Noir chased Ladybug, Dark Cupid pursued Chloé and briefly held her at arrow point before deciding against it.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 1]]
At Fontaine du Palmier, Dark Cupid reunited with Cat Noir and rescued him from Ladybug's lips. As Ladybug carried out her plan, he was struck by Ladybug's candy apple lucky charm. After successfully removing the sticky food item from his body, Dark Cupid was forced to use the nearby fountain to clean his hands and bow. Shortly after, he was caught off guard by a cleansed Cat Noir and crashed into the ground. He remained helpless as Cat Noir used Cataclysm on his quiver strap and took his brooch to hand over to Ladybug. Dark Cupid was promptly de-akumatized back into Kim after Ladybug broke his brooch.
In "Mr. Pigeon", Kim was present during the announcement of the derby hat design contest that was being hosted at school that day and partnered with Max for the event.
In "Pixelator", Kim and his classmates were having job experience day at the Le Grand Paris hotel where he was assigned to be a doorman. Later, he posed for a photo when he was approached by Pixelator, but became imprisoned in the villain's photo dimension until he was set free by Ladybug and Cat Noir.
In "Copycat", Kim was waiting for Miss Bustier's class to start when Marinette returned Adrien's phone to him.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 1]]
In "The Bubbler", Kim was one of the many students that was invited to Adrien's surprise birthday party by the Bubbler. However, he and everyone else were forced to party. When Ladybug and Cat Noir arrived to crash the party, Kim fled from the Bubbler along with the other partygoers and was horrified upon witnessing the heroes being sent skywards in a bubble. Soon after, he rejoiced at their return and was imprisoned in an ascending bubble as a result. After the Bubbler was defeated, Kim was brought back down to earth via Ladybug's Miraculous Ladybug.
In "Rogercop", Kim was attending an in-class Career Day with his classmates. After Chloé's bracelet went missing, he grew furious when Marinette accused him of theft along with the rest of his classmates just before Rogercop appeared.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Gamer", Kim watched the try-outs in the library for Françoise Dupont's team of representatives to participate in Paris' Ultimate Mecha Strike III tournament. In addition to trying out himself, he was shocked to witness that both Adrien and Marinette managed to push Max out of both slots for the school's representative team. Later at the tournament, Kim cheered on Max and Marinette as they went to compete and when they won the tournament.
In "Animan", Kim visited the zoo with Max to see the new panther exhibit. Shortly after taunting the panther and angering the exhibit's zookeeper, he was chased by the now akumatized zookeeper and his animals until Ladybug and Cat Noir saved him. After his second encounter with Animan, Kim took refuge in a nearby building for the remainder of the attack as instructed by the heroes.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Darkblade", Kim briefly expressed interest in running for class representative, but decided against it after being blackmailed by Chloé. Later, he attended Chloé's campaign launch party at city hall to receive a free autographed Jagged Stone album. After Darkblade's attack on city hall commenced in pursuit of Mayor Bourgeois, he worked together with his classmates and Mayor Bourgeois to ensure their safety. After Darkblade managed to plant his flag atop city hall, Kim was transformed into one of Darkblade's knights when the villain's dark cloud beam touched him. Fortunately, he was quickly restored back to normal by Ladybug's Miraculous Ladybug. Afterward, Kim helped clean up city hall and witnessed Marinette confront Chloé about her stolen diary. Upon hearing Marinette's campaign speech, he voted for Marinette and Alya as the new class representative and deputy.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Timebreaker", Kim raced Alix on foot as part of a bet at Trocadéro. After losing the race, he attempted to rematch Alix just before noticing Alix's now broken heirloom pocket watch. Soon after Timebreaker's appearance, Kim attempted to flee the scene but got hit by Timebreaker and faded from reality. In a second timeline, Ladybug's Miraculous Ladybug brought him back.
In "Horrificator", Kim assisted his class in producing a short film by holding a boom microphone. After Chloé replaced Mylène as lead actress in the film, Kim, alongside Max and Sabrina, accompanied Chloé to the nurse's office to acquire a nurse uniform for the film. Outside of the nurse's office, he, alongside Max, was caught off guard by Horrificator's sudden appearance. Afterwards, Kim was taken to the boiler room and held captive in a hardened slime cocoon until Ladybug's Miraculous Ladybug saved him from confinement.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Reflekta", Kim was participating in picture day at his school until it was put on hold when Juleka was akumatized into Reflekta. During Reflekta's onslaught, Kim was transformed into a Reflekta when he attempted to run away. Fortunately, he was restored back to normal by Ladybug's Miraculous Ladybug. After Juleka was de-akumatized, Kim went to Place des Vosges with his classmates to retake the class photo.
In "Antibug", Kim, like everyone else, noticed that Chloé was acting differently in class one day.
In "Santa Claws", Kim was celebrating Christmas with his family until he learned that Adrien had gone missing. After Kim was informed that Adrien was found, he joined everyone at the Agreste mansion for Christmas dinner.
In "Volpina", Kim was talking with Max and Nino at school about the exploits of the new exchange student Lila.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 2]]
In "The Collector", Kim heard that Adrien was banned from school for losing his father's important book, and was delighted when Adrien was permitted to return to school.
In "Despair Bear", Kim was at school observing Mr. Dupain's macaron baking demonstration with his classmates until it was interrupted by Chloé secretly calling the fire department. As a result, he and the other students (except Chloé) cleaned the school's courtyard as punishment for wasting the fire department's time. Later that evening, Kim attended Chloé's party at Le Grand Paris hotel. During which, he requested a slow dance song and danced with Chloé, despite a brief rejection. However, when Chloé angrily broke away due to Marinette and Adrien, Kim noticed Armand and Mr. Cuddly and then promptly pointed out Chloé's teddy bear to the whole room, laughing mockingly at the revelation. Not long after, Kim attempted to defend Chloé from a Despair Bear controlled Sabrina, but was taken over by the villain instead until Ladybug and Cat Noir intervened. After Despair Bear's defeat, he took part in Mr. Dupain's macaron baking lesson at Chloé party.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Befana", Kim helped out in setting-up Marinette's surprise birthday party at Place des Vosges with the other attendees. When Alya arrived with Marinette, he and the others greeted her. After Befana crashed the event, he followed Alya's lead in defending Marinette by attempting to grab the villainess' blaster. However, he was turned into a coal statue until he was restored by Ladybug's Miraculous Ladybug. Afterwards, Kim resumed celebrating Marinette's birthday and helped lift her so she could blow out the candles on her birthday cake.
In "Robostus", Kim was getting ready for science class when he saw Mr. Damoclès attempt to fix Ms. Mendeleiev's computer issue. Soon after, he witnessed a virus destroying the school's data until Max and his robot friend Markov managed to neutralize the threat. Afterward, Kim and his classmates were fascinated by Markov and decided to take a closer look at him just before class began. Later when Robostus and his army of animate machines suddenly attacked, he fled to safety with the rest of the school.
In "The Dark Owl", Kim asked Paris' newest superhero, The Owl, for a photo-op along with Alix and Max.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Syren", Kim was spending time with his friend, Ondine, at the swimming pool. During which, he played a game of secrets with her until he was reminded that he wanted to see a movie with his friends. After arriving at the cinema, Kim headed inside with Max, saddened from the fact that Chloé wasn't there as he hoped. When Paris was suddenly flooded, Kim was forced to retreat to the city's rooftops with everyone else. Excited by the sight of the now flooded city, he dived into the water and was captured by Syren shortly after. While with Syren, Kim was impressed by her aquatic abilities and underwater domain, and later learned of Ondine's feeling for him. However, he was soon rescued when Aquabug and Aqua Noir confronted Syren. Subsequently, he was hidden above water on Paris' rooftops for the remainder of the battle. At the pool after Syren's defeat, Kim asked Ondine out to the movies.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Zombizou", Kim and his classmates (except Chloé initially) all brought gifts for Miss Bustier's birthday and wished her a happy birthday in class. Later when Zombizou appeared in front him and his classmates, he grew fearful and fled when she and her growing army of underlings begun to attack everyone. Shortly after, Kim regrouped with his uninfected classmates and Cat Noir on the school rooftop after being saved by Ladybug. In order to protect Chloé from the kissing zombies, he and Max sacrificed themselves. After Zombizou's defeat, Kim was later restored to normal by Ladybug's Miraculous Ladybug.
In "Style Queen", Kim attended the Gabriel brand's fashion show at the Grand Palais during fashion week with his classmates. However, when Style Queen suddenly interrupted it and attacked Adrien, he fled the building with everyone else in the crowd.
In "Queen Wasp", Kim resumed watching the Gabriel brand's fashion show, post Style Queen's defeat, with his classmates and witnessed Gabriel Agreste's unexpected public appearance.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Frightningale", Kim took part in Clara Nightingale's new music video about Ladybug and Cat Noir, and watched the final result with his classmates in the school's library.
In "Malediktator", Kim attended Miss Bustier's class and laughed at Chloé's attempt to exaggerate the competence of her superhero persona, Queen Bee, in her class presentation. Later, Kim celebrated in the school courtyard with everyone else upon hearing Chloé announce her departure to New York City to the entire school.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Catalyst", Kim was in Miss Bustier's class video chatting with Lila alongside Miss Bustier and his fellow classmates. He, believing Lila's lies, was impressed to hear about Lila's "stay" in the Kingdom of Achu and her plans for Heroes' Day. Kim was also impressed to hear of his other classmates' good deeds for Heroes' Day, especially Marinette's school-wide pastry tasting. Later that day after a combination of Volpina's heart-wrenching illusion and Catalyst's power enhancement, Scarlet Moth released a swarm of Scarlet Akumas to prey upon the vulnerable Parisians. As a result, Kim was akumatized into Scarlet Dark Cupid and further influenced the widespread scarlet akumatizations in Paris by inciting public fear and unrest around him.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Mayura", Kim, as Scarlet Dark Cupid, played a key role in Scarlet Moth's scheme due to his power to shoot arrows that create negative emotions in the hit target. Under Scarlet Moth's command, he assisted the akumatizations of André and Audrey Bourgeois and Armand at Le Grand Paris. Later, he was ordered to assist the re-akumatizations of the de-akumatized scarlet villains at Trocadéro. Shortly after, Scarlet Dark Cupid also managed to assist the akumatizations of Rena Rouge, Carapace, and Queen Bee. Later, he was positioned near the Eiffel Tower to play a role in Scarlet Moth's plan to akumatize Ladybug and Cat Noir. However, he missed his targets and was de-akumatized when Cat Noir destroyed his button. After the debacle ended, Kim attended the picnic at Place des Vosges hosted by Marinette, and was excited for her when she kissed Adrien's cheek.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Miraculous Shanghai]]
Kim attended a potluck picnic at Place des Vosges with his friends while on holiday break.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Chameleon", Kim welcomed Lila back to class and believed her claim about having tinnitus. After Lila's emotional manipulation in response to Marinette's complaints towards the new seating arrangement, he glared at Marinette with the other students. During lunchtime in the cafeteria, Kim, under the assumption that Lila had a sprained wrist, assisted Lila by getting her dessert from the lunch line. Afterward, when Marinette tried to expose her by throwing a napkin, he was momentarily shocked until Lila claimed she did it to save Max's eye. Kim then scolded Marinette under the impression that she made Lila's wrist even hurt more. Directly after, he was assured by Lila that Marinette was justly simply giving her a napkin. Kim was shocked as he watched Marinette storm out of the cafeteria. Post Chameleon's defeat, Kim, like his classmates, was fascinated by Lila's experience with Ladybug. Afterward, he and everyone else returned to Miss Bustier's class.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Oblivio", Kim visited Tour Montparnasse with his classmates whilst on a class field trip. During the excursion, he laughed at the revelation of Alya and Nino playing Super Penguino after they were caught. After Oblivio's defeat, Kim was present on the bus to hear Alya and Nino's apology to the class.
In "Startrain", Kim was traveling on the Startrain with his classmates on a class field trip to see Big Ben in London. Whilst aboard the Startrain, Kim passed the time by looking out the window, making faces with Alix, and sleeping. Upon hearing Ms. Kanté announce that the Startrain would be underwater via the Channel Tunnel, Kim grabbed his duffel bag excitedly and left his seat to change into his swimwear in the train's restroom. Afterwards, he and everyone else aboard the Startrain were abruptly launched into space due to a stray akuma turning Max's mother into the titular villain.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 3]]
Now in space, Kim stayed behind while some of his classmates took up the task of reaching the train's operator cab to convince Max's mother to reject her akuma. Not long after, he, like the rest of his class, was shocked to see Ladybug and Cat Noir aboard the train to save them. Directly after, Kim then followed Miss Bustier to the back of the train as directed. After the train was teleported into Big Ben, he and everyone else on the train were transported back to Gare du Nord in Paris via Ladybug's Miraculous Ladybug. After the commotion died down, Kim and everyone else re-boarded the Startrain to London.
In "Kwamibuster", Kim attended Miss Bustier's class one day, but he, like his fellow classmate, became distracted by the sound of Ms. Mendeleiev chasing Tikki and Plagg beneath him. The next day, Kim was excited to hear the news that Ms. Mendeleiev would be appearing on the television show "Alternative Truth" due to potentially making a scientific discovery. He then proceeded asked if his class could watch her appearance on the show. In the library, Kim constantly blurted out during the show, much to Mr. Damoclès' annoyance.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Gamer 2.0", Kim finished taking a history test in Miss Bustier's class. After class, he was asked by Max if he could test his new video game. Despite wanting to accept the offer, Kim declined and went to meet Ondine at the pool for swimming practice. Soon after, he was one of the several people taken hostage by Gamer 2.0 to convince Ladybug and Cat Noir to play with him. Kim's akumatized form, Dark Cupid, was chosen to be the titular villain's avatar. Despite Gamer 2.0 extreme confidence, Dark Cupid was easily beaten by Cat Noir's chosen avatar, Mr. Pigeon. After Gamer 2.0's defeat, Kim was set free by Ladybug's Miraculous Ladybug.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Party Crasher", Kim, along with Nino, Max, and Ivan (and also Nathaniel and Marc), decided to take advantage of the advent of fashion week in Tokyo to hang out with Adrien at his house. To do so, he texted an alibi to Rose to explain his absence to his female classmates planting trees along the Seine. Afterwards, Kim, and his friends bribed their way into the mansion and convinced Adrien to allow guy time to take place in his room. Directly after, he and his friends marveled at the luxuriousness of Adrien's room. Kim was also particularly amazed by Adrien's jet stream bathtub and went for a dip. During the all boys party, he saved Wang Fu from falling and then went swimming in Adrien's bathtub again.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 3]]
Kim continued swimming in Adrien's bathroom until he noticed a small box drop in front of him. Upon opening it, he was amused to meet Xuppu, whom he confused for a flying monkey plushie. Offended, Xuppu introduced himself by retorting back with his own insult and funny face causing Kim to do the same. Afterwards, Kim transformed into King Monkey with Xuppu and the Monkey Miraculous. He then confronted Party Crasher outside of the Agreste mansion and used Uproar to free everyone from the villain's disco ball gauntlets. Soon after, King Monkey followed Ladybug's plan to screw up Party Crasher's powers and defeat him. Post Party Crasher's defeat, Kim returned the Monkey Miraculous and helped clean Adrien's room by removing trash. Afterward, he left the mansion with his friends to plant trees.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Félix", Kim recorded a message for Adrien to make him feel better along with the rest of Adrien's friends. After Félix posed as Adrien to stir trouble, he grew skeptical of Adrien's character. After Juleka, Alya, and Rose got akumatized, Kim became subjected to Princess Fragrance's perfume and was forced to fight Ladybug but was easily subdued. After the situation resolved, he happily viewed the real Adrien's response video while doing pushups.
In "Ladybug", Kim was in Miss Bustier's class and shockingly heard that Marinette cheated on the Mock Exams and was called to the principal's office.
In "Miracle Queen", Kim was spending time with Ondine at the pool when he was stung by Miracle Queen's wasps. At Miracle Queen's behest, he and the other affected miraculous holders gathered at the titular villain's location of Trocadéro. Under Miracle Queen's command, he transformed into King Monkey and used his powers against the heroes until they managed to de-akumatize Queen Bee. Afterwards, he was returned to normal and brought back to the pool and Ondine by Ladybug's powers.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Queen Banana", Kim spent his vacation time to help produce a movie with his friends. Despite Chloé's insistence to take the lead role from her half-sister Zoé and hijack the production by force, Kim managed to play a role as an extra in the final and original version of the short film. The next day at the cinema, he was amazed by the film and applauded it. Shortly afterward, Kim watched Chloé angrily question everyone and storm out of the theatre. Not long after, he witnessed Queen Banana and Banana Boom-Boom attack the cinema whilst targeting Zoé.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Mega Leech", Kim was attending Miss Bustier's class when he learned that Mylène and Ivan were being escorted home by Officer Raincomprix for protesting at Place des Vosges. Upon hearing about the plan to rehabilitate Place des Vosges, Kim expressed confusion due to not knowing what "rehabilitate" means. After Miss Bustier ordered Officer Raincomprix to bring Mylène and Ivan back to Place des Vosges, he excitedly lined up to leave the classroom for a hands-on civics lesson. At Place des Vosges, Kim was present when Miss Bustier questioned Mayor Bourgeois' plan to "rehabilitate" the park. After viewing a commercial for Project Oxygen, he was easily swayed until Marinette managed to reveal Mayor Bourgeois' ruse.
Soon after, Kim witnessed the akumatization and amokization of Mayor Bourgeois and was hijacked by one of the mini Malediktators created by Mega Leech. Under the villain's command, he terrorized trees and was later ordered to subdue Cat Noir to no avail. Kim was later freed from Malediktator's control by one of Polymouse's clones. After the crisis, Kim was present at Mayor Bourgeois' public announcement to protect the park.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Guiltrip", Kim was present in Miss Bustier's class when Rose asked to go to the nurse's office. Later that day at lunchtime, Juleka's sudden departure to the boiler room led to him and his classmates learning that Rose was hospitalized due to a childhood illness. Upon Juleka's request, Kim and his classmates swore he would not tell Rose that they're aware of her condition. Despite that, he, like his other classmates, decided to give Rose special treatment. Eventually, Kim and his classmates indirectly gotten Juleka akumatized and amokized by making her feel increasingly guilty due to revealing Rose's secret.
When Kim and his classmates left Ms. Mendeleiev's class to comfort Juleka in the girls restroom, they encountered Guiltrip and were sucked into the sentimonster. Inside Guiltrip, Kim was turned into a guilty, regretful Reflekta. After Reflekta's de-akumatization, Kim and the other Reflektas attacked Ladybug, Cat Noir, and Pigella on route to Guiltrip's Amok. After Ladybug managed to eliminate Guiltrip, Kim was restored back to normal due to Miraculous Ladybug. After the commotion died down, Kim and his classmates reverted back to the status quo.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Optigami", Kim, due to his secret identity as King Monkey, was specially invited alongside many other miraculous holders to attend Style Queen magazine's fashion icon of the month award ceremony. In the lobby of Tour Montparnasse, Kim decided to race the elevator by running up the nearby stairwell and asked Max to time him. Much later, he encountered Style Queen upon exiting the stairwell outside of Style Queen magazine's headquarters. Due to exhaustion, Kim was immediately turned into a pile of glitter by Style Queen. After ordeal ended, he was restored by Miraculous Ladybug.
In "Glaciator 2", Kim was a spectating a fencing competition at Françoise Dupont that Adrien managed to win.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Hack-San", Kim challenged Alix to skate a lap around Trocadéro before he managed to do 1,000 pushups and lost the first of three rounds of their competition. After being emotionally checked-up on by a stressed Alya, he was ready to begin another round. In the middle of another round, Kim was taken by surprise when an abnormally harsh, virus afflicted Markov insulted him. Next, He expressed fear when Markov begun speaking ill of the human species. During Robostus' attack, Kim fell victim and sought out Cat Noir and Scarabella as ordered. After Robostus' defeat, Kim was restored by Scarabella's Miraculous Scarabella.
In "Wishmaker", Kim attended class when Miss Bustier and Mr. Damoclès talked to the whole class about future careers. He was given an after school study questionnaire to fill out, and was also informed that the Paris Careers Expo was being held soon throughout the city.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Ephemeral", Kim, as King Monkey, was enlisted (alongside Carapace, Viperion, Pegasus, Ryuko, Vesperia, Polymouse, Pigella, and Purple Tigress) by Ladybug to help subdue Moolak due to Cat Noir's absence that evening. After the Moolak's defeat, Kim returned the Monkey Miraculous back to Ladybug. In a timeline erased by Sass' Second Chance, he attended Miss Bustier's class the next day and laughed with the class when Adrien humorously answered a literature question.
In "Kuro Neko", Kim, as King Monkey, was selected (alongside Ryuko, Polymouse, and Purple Tigress) to help Ladybug neutralize Rogercop without Cat Noir. After Rogercop's defeat, he very briefly greeted Cat Noir before needing to relocate himself in order to return the Monkey Miraculous to Ladybug. At his rendezvous point atop Paris' rooftops, King Monkey exhausted his time limit and forcibly detransformed while Ladybug had to urgently backtrack to Cat Noir. After Ladybug returned to their rendezvous point, Kim returned the Monkey Miraculous back to Ladybug.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Penalteam", Kim was attending Miss Bustier's class at Stade des Princesses to play soccer for a special lesson in teamwork with Mr. Didier. During the game, Kim expressed annoyance at Chloé's unwillingness to play and witnessed her akumatization into Penalty not long after. As a result, he fled after Penalty victimized several players and spectators. Soon after, Kim, as King Monkey, was selected to fill Ladybug's lineup to take on Penalty and her Penalteam. When the Penalteam's kick managed to destroy the heroes' goal, he expressed confusion just before the opposing team moved the goals to the Arc de Triomphe and Hôtel de Ville for a city-wide match. After a devastating first half, King Monkey and his teammates changed their strategy to play more cohesively. As a result, he and his teammates managed to out score the Penalteam by the end of the second half.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 4]]
Due to Penalty's change of rules, King Monkey and his teammates were forced to continue the game at Trocadéro and the Eiffel Tower. During the final stage of the match, he and his teammates followed Ladybug's plan to annoy the Penalteam enough to make them forfeit. To that end, King Monkey struck a decisive blow by using Uproar on Penalty. Due to the superpower's disruptive effects and chaotic nature, Penalty and her Penalteam became increasingly aggravated. As a result, Penalty gave up her akumatization out of sheer irritation. After the match's conclusion, Kim returned the Monkey Miraculous back to Ladybug and his class resumed at the stadium.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Risk", Kim, as King Monkey, was called (alongside Carapace, Viperion, Ryuko, Pigella, and Purple Tigress) to assist Ladybug and Cat Noir during a mission. After the mission's end, he relocated to a predesignated rendezvous point to return the Monkey Miraculous back to Ladybug. Later that night, Kim, and the rest of Paris, was unknowingly marked by Risk. The next morning, he attended Mr. D'Argencourt's PE class. During that time, Kim was sad to see Adrien and Lila depart for modeling work abroad and was touched by Lila's words. At lunchtime, he had lunch with some of his friends and witnessed Marinette attempt to make a plan to save Adrien from modeling for his father's fashion brand. However, Kim doubted Marinette's reasoning and was surprised to see her leave to save Adrien herself. Soon afterward, he was influenced by Risk to jump into the Seine and attempt to swim the entire river with Max opting to join him.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Multiplication", Kim was in Miss Bustier's class when Alix's father announced that Alix was chosen by Ladybug to wield the Rabbit Miraculous. Additionally, Kim learned that Alix would be absent to further protect the Rabbit Miraculous from Monarch.
In "Illusion", Kim attended school the day the post-graduation parent-teacher conferences occurred. Later, he joined Nino's newly formed Resistance group as "Comrade Burgundy".
In "Passion", Kim was in Ms. Mendeleiev's class when Safari's Mirage of Timetagger triggered his Alliance ring's Megakuma alert function. After seeing the illusory supervillain "mark" Françoise Dupont, he and his classmates fled the school to avoid being "attacked" further.
In "Reunion", Kim and his friends were invited by Mr. Kubdel to meet at the Louvre due to Alix's letter. While there, he listened to Alix's father read the letter detailing some of Alix's experiences while photos of her travels were passed around. Kim was shocked When Alix's older brother Jalil suddenly interrupted to protest against his father's judgement to allow Alix to leave with the Rabbit Miraculous.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Transmission", Kim attended a party held in the art classroom with his friends thinking Marinette and Adrien were finally becoming a couple. Later, when they discovered that Adrien and Marinette's romance did not work out, he joined the planning committee to get the two together.
In "Deflagration", Kim attended a meeting of the Resistance and listened to Nino's coverage of the plan for their Anti-Akumatization System at school. During which, Kim's role would be working with Ivan and Mylène to evacuate students from the building. At lunchtime, Kim witnessed Zoé stand up to Chloé for attempting to ridicule Marinette for trying to get closer to Adrien. As a result, Chloé was akumatized into Sole Destroyer. Subsequently, Kim rushed out of the cafeteria to perform his duty. Later, when the Resistance showed up to fight Monarch at Arènes de Lutèce, he helped nullify Monarch's invisibility by blasting him with condiments. After Adrien managed to take back the Ladybug Miraculous, Kim helped restrain Monarch to allow Ladybug time to escape and transform.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Perfection", Kim and his friends tried to help Marinette confess her feelings to Adrien by setting up scenarios for her. After some failed attempts, he attended the Kitty Section concert aboard the Liberty. When Adrien arrived with his song for Marinette, Kim jumped in to try and help him perform it. He focused very intently on the line about riding a dolphin, and subsequently searched for a dolphin for Adrien's song. When Adrien finally performed the song, Kim ran across the stage with a dolphin whilst shouting "Dolphin!" the moment it was mentioned in the song. After Kagami de-akumatized herself, Kim was one of the friends that added himself to her contacts.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Derision", Kim was swimming at the pool with Ondine when Adrien and Marinette arrived. When Marinette suddenly freaked out and ran off, Kim asked what prank Adrien pulled on her to cause her to do that. Due to Adrien and Ondine confusion, Kim told them a story from a year prior. Upon hearing it, Adrien and Ondine grew enraged at him. Kim tried to explain that it was all just a joke, but they vehemently disagreed. As a result, Kim got annoyed, blamed them for not understanding his sense of humor, and swam away. At that moment, Monarch decided to akumatize Kim into Dark Humor, and gifted him the power of the Monkey Miraculous to aid him.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 5]]
Kim, as Dark Humor, terrorized the citizens of Paris by making them play cruel jokes on each other. When confronted by Ladybug and Cat Noir at Jardin des Tuileries, he was attacked by Cat Noir relentlessly and was nearly hit by Cataclysm out of sheer anger. When Ladybug managed to restrain Cat Noir, Dark Humor took advantage of the moment to hit Cat Noir with an Uproar powered arrow. Next, Dark Humor switched to focus on Ladybug and managed to disrupt her Lucky Charm. Due to Cat Noir's interference, he was distracted long enough for Ladybug to obtain a toilet bowl lucky charm by quickly redoing her transformation. Dark Humor then launched a barage of arrows as Ladybug darted away to put her plan into motion. Believing he managed to successfully hit Ladybug, Dark Humor proceeded to chase down "Ladygag" and Cat Noir at Monarch's command to take their miraculouses. However, he was thwarted when Ladybug attached the glue-lined toilet bowl lucky charm to his head, and then proceeded to break his reticle lens. Afterwards, Kim was promptly de-akumatized and recieved a magical charm from Ladybug.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 5]]
Back at the pool, Kim expressed remorse for what he may have done while akumatized due to having no memory of it. Ondine then pointed out that he does terrible things regardless of being akumatized. In response, Kim attempted to defend himself again but was reminded that ignorance is not a valid excuse to dismiss someone's feelings. Finally, Kim relented and vowed to change his behavior. He then apologized to Marinette, which she gladly accepted. Ondine, proud of Kim, kissed him on the cheek.
In "Intuition", Kim joined the rest of his class in asking Claudie Kanté questions before of her tests in space with A.D.A. aboard the Tsurugi space jet. Afterwards, Kim and his class watched Ms. Kanté and A.D.A. run the tests and celebrated their success.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 5]]
In erased timelines created by Monarch's use of Second Chance prior to giving up, Kim and his class were horrified when A.D.A. sensors couldn't detect Claudie's presence after the second test. As a result, he was stunned to see A.D.A. end her transmission with the class after deeming herself dangerous. Subsequently, he watched Max frantically attempt to gain access to A.D.A.'s controls. Shortly after, Kim was alerted of Monarch's presence via his Alliance ring and heard his broadcasted ultimatum.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Revelation", Kim and his classmates approached Adrien and Marinette out of concern for their relationship due to the Alliance ring's updated digital assistant depicting Adrien and Kagami in a relationship. In Miss Bustier's class, he listened to Lila and Marinette's bids for class representative at Lila's insistence to relieve Marinette of her position and was shocked that Lila picked Chloé to be her deputy. Soon after Lila abruptly left the classroom pretending to be emotionally distressed, Kim was victimized by Hoaxer via his Alliance ring and went to hunt down Marinette, and later Ladybug and Cat Noir, with all the other Alliance ring users in Paris. After Hoaxer's self de-akumatization, he voted for Lila and Chloé as the new class representatives and congratulated them on their win.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Confrontation", Kim, alongside Max, submitted his career form for the upcoming teacher rep meeting. Later, he attended a meeting of the Resistance to discuss how to proceed with the Resistance due to their upcoming graduation from Collège Françoise Dupont. After Lila and Chloé sabotaged and presented his career form, Kim was given a future as a physiotherapist. He was also stunned to learn his classmates' paperwork was messed up as well. As a result, Kim witnessed Juleka's akumatization into Reflekta due to being set to repeat the 9th grade. After Reflekta's defeat, Kim and his classmates were appalled to learn that Lila and Chloé ordered Sabrina to forge their career forms, and that Lila has been repeatedly lying to everyone. Not long afterwards, Kim and his classmates helped Mr. Damoclès successfully purify an akuma with his magical charm by motivating him. Afterward, Kim and his classmates were permitted to redo their career forms as Mr. Damoclès' last act as principal.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Collusion", Kim attended Miss Bustier's class and became annoyed when Chloé disrupted the history lesson and got Miss Bustier sent to acting principal Mendeleiev's office. Upon Miss Bustier's return, he and his classmates vouched for Marinette when Chloé attempted to frame her for assault. Later, Kim met with his classmates aboard the Liberty to discuss the unfair dismissal of Mr. Damoclès, Miss Bustier, and Marinette at school due to Chloé. During which, he and his classmates watched Mayor Bourgeois' "confession" on the news.
In "Revolution, Kim and the Resistance protested the dismissal of Miss Bustier and Mr. Damoclès from Collège Françoise Dupont. Later, he attended Queen Mayor's public address and joined the rest of the Resistance in standing up against Queen Mayor and protecting Ladybug and Cat Noir. After Chloé was de-akumatized and overthrown as mayor, he supported Miss Bustier running in the upcoming mayoral election.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Representation", Kim attended the end-of-year dance on the Eiffel Tower and showed concern for Marinette. After Nightormentor disrupted the party to track down Adrien and Marinette, Kim joined the Resistance to help defeat Nightormentor. When the Resistance intervened in the fight between Cat Noir and Nightormentor, Kim, alongside Max, helped encourage Cat Noir while the rest of the Resistance distracted Nightormentor.
In "Conformation", Kim, like everyone else around the world, was given nightmares by Nightormentor as part of Operation: Perfect Alliance. As a result, Kim downloaded the new Perfect Alliance app on his Alliance ring help calm himself and forget about his frequent nightmares. When his Alliance ring depicted Ladybug and Cat Noir kidnapping Adrien and Kagami, he was initially convinced until Alya was able to convince him otherwise. Shortly after, Kim removed his Alliance ring after witnessing Ivan transform into a Miraculized that's determined to track down Ladybug and Cat Noir to save Adrien and Kagami. Afterward, Kim leapt onto Ivan to help restrain him.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Re-creation", Kim and the Resistance managed to remove and break Ivan's Alliance ring. Afterwards, he fought alongside the Resistance, United Heroez, Ladydragon, and Su-Han and his disciples against the Miraculized. At some point later in the summer, Kim swam with Max and Fang in the pool at the Agreste manor prior to watching a special broadcast featuring Mayoress Bustier. After Marinette managed to restore all the miraculouses later that summer, Kim was permanantly reunited with Xuppu and the Monkey Miraculous.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - Before Season 6
On the first day of the new school year at Collège Françoise Dupont, Kim excitedly escorted Zoé to meet Ray, a new student whose also from New York City.
At some point, Kim, as King Monkey, attended a team-wide training session held by Ladybug and Cat Noir. With Ladybug and Cat Noir's guidance, he managed to "evolve" his powers by unlocking the adult miraculous abilities of unrestrained superpower usage and remaining transformed. Soon after, King Monkey joyfully celebrated the adoption of "The Miraculers" team name with his fellow teammates.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 6]]
In "Climatiqueen", Kim attended a cooking class at school. Later that day, he was ate lunch in the school cafeteria with Ondine and some of his friends when a concerned Aglaé rushed over to their table to ask about Aurore. Upon hearing Aurore wasn't in good shape that morning, Kim cracked an insensitive joke and was instantly called out by Ondine. Next, he unintentionally stressed Aglaé out whilst trying to clarify what was meant by "not in good shape." As a result, Kim was promptly scolded by Ondine a second time. Shortly after, Kim grew confused by circulating gossip involving Marinette and Adrien's relationship.
In "Sleeping Syren",
In "El Toro De Piedra", Kim joined his some of his friends on stage to commemorate Mayoress Bustier at the Kitty Section concert held at Collège Françoise Dupont.
In "The Dark Castle", Kim joined his friends and Alix's family in filming a video to wish Alix a happy birthday. Later that day, he attended Alix's birthday party at Place des Vosges.

title: Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History
text:
Kim Chiến Lê-Ature/History - [[Season 6]]
In "Wreckless Driver", Kim attended a gardening class on the school rooftop. Later that day, he ate lunch with some of his friends in the school courtyard when Aglaé succumbed to her fear of insects and ran off. As a result, he and his friends followed Aglaé to the school's cafeteria to help her. Consequently, he witnessed his friends recommend that Aglaé consider visiting Dr. Psiquat for help with overcoming her fear.
In "The Ruler", Kim attended a gardening class on the school rooftop.
In "Noe", Kim was playing with Ondine and Max on the beach of Île aux Cygnes.
In "A Fairy Good Night", Kim attended a Q&A with Claudie Kanté during a science class hosted in the school's amphitheater. During the event, he learned that Claudie would soon be sent on a space mission to the International Space Station and wondered where Max would live. Upon hearing Marinette's suggestion to stay with a friend instead of the European Space Agency, Kim was one of the many students who offered to host Max during his mother's mission in space.

title: Kreatika
text:
Kreatika - Intro
"" is one of the films inside the Paris cinema. The main characters are Kreatika who is played by Zoé Lee and Destroyica who is played by Mylène Haprèle.
In "Queen Banana", the movie was shown in cinemas causing Chloé Bourgeois to be akumatized into Queen Banana.

title: Kreatika
text:
Kreatika - Description
The movie features two main characters, Kreatika, the superhero of creation, and Destroyica, the supervillain of destruction. Kreatika fights her sister, Destroyica, to free people from a magical eternal slumber. Destroyica believes that humanity has brought destruction on to the planet and she doesn't want them to be awakened. Destroyica fails to defeat Kreatika and all the people are awakened in the very end, but she later reconciled with her sister.
Kreatika has magical powers such as "Harmonic Wind" and a light lime green sword to fight with her sister Destroyica, who has magical powers such as "Ultimate Nightmare" and a cotton candy pink sword.

text:
Kuro Neko - Intro
"" is a Season 4 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 23rd written and produced episode of Season 4. It is also the 101st written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Kuro Neko
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Kuro Neko - Synopsis
Vesperia! Viperion! Carapace! Pigella! Purple Tigress! Pegasus! Ladybug’s got a Dream Team together to combat a new villain… without Cat Noir! For a while now, our hero has been feeling a bit left out. More and more convinced that he’s less important in her eyes now that his Lady has a whole gang of superheroes, he finally gives her back his Miraculous. Ladybug can’t stop him and finds herself a bit lost without her kittycat. But Plagg is there to cheer her up and help her find a solution. He suggests that she recruit a new Cat Noir!
Disney+
Ladybug and a new ally face Kuro Neko.
Netflix
When Marinette keeps calling on other heroes to help her save the city, Adrien hatches a plan to show her that she really needs him.

title: Kuro Neko

Kuro Neko - Plot developments
It's revealed that Nathalie is now using some sort of technical leg braces that enable her to walk as her condition continues to get worse.
It's revealed that Ladybug has not called on Cat Noir for several fights, making him depressed so he surrenders his Miraculous until Plagg returns convincing Adrien to resume his mantle.
The magic behind the costumes is further explained by Plagg, who reveals that the costume a holder normally shows is a natural reflection of their personality. However, they can change their costume by focusing only on their certain personality traits. When Adrien focused on being perfect, just like his civilian form with his father, he became a brand new superhero.
With Tikki being aware of Plagg's plan to return to Adrien and knowing of his identity; most likely when Adrien returned as Cat Walker she sensed him in the suit aware that Plagg taught him how to change his suit suggesting that all kwamis are aware of these transformations meaning that they've done the same thing with previous owners.

text:
Kuro Neko - Plot developments
Adrien uses the Cat Miraculous to become a brand new hero that is not Cat Noir, becoming Cat Walker. In which he acts a lot more focused, proper and professional compared to his original identity.
This makes him the second Miraculous holder to possess more than one identity for the same Miraculous, followed by Alya Césaire, who used to transform into Rena Rouge with the Fox Miraculous, before changing her suit to better fit her new role and becoming Rena Furtive.
It's revealed that the Peacock Miraculous holder can either possibly see through any sentimonster's perspective (even without holding their amok) or through their amokized target, as Shadow Moth heard Ladybug's lament, about Cat Noir being akumatized, despite the fact he was not the one holding the amok at the moment. However, in consideration that both the Peacock and Butterfly Miraculouses establish a telepathic link between the holders of those Miraculous and their targets, it's very likely the latter is the most possible.
It's revealed that even when the Ladybug Miraculous user uses their yo-yo to tie something up, they can still lose their grip on it.

It's revealed that the Shell-ter doesn't have to resemble a sphere or a half-sphere, as the one Carapace uses to capture Gigantitan is a long spheroid.
This episode and few others give more insight about the relationship between the powers of Creation and Destruction from the wielder's perspective:
As of Ladybug and Cat Noir's behavior towards each other and how they were both wrong:
By constantly calling her allies and because of her fears, Ladybug didn't fully understand how she made Cat Noir feel which caused him to leave.
Even though, Adrien needed attention too he couldn't force Ladybug to give it and knowing that she did her best to look after everyone as leader but she needed looking after too which is why they act as each other's shields.

text:
Kuro Neko - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in Brazil on Gloob.
This episode was supposed to premiere on PlusPlus in Ukraine on December 22nd, 2021, but was pushed back for unknown reasons.
Interestingly, Anastasiya Zharnikova-Zinovenko, Marinette's Ukrainian voice actress, posted on her Instagram story about her recording the lines for the episode on December 28, almost a week after the episode's original premiere date, which could imply that the dubbing wasn't finished on the 22nd, and was the reason the episode was postponed.
In this episode, a new character is introduced, Rythm. She was a girl who visited the Zag Studio thanks to the Make-A-Wish Foundation, where she designed a concept of herself.
However, her concept was changed during production.
This is the second time that a hero other than Ladybug and Cat Noir use their ear communicators, following "Ephemeral", with Ryuko and Polymouse calling Ladybug after she picks up the Cat Miraculous.
This is the second time Adrien renounces his Miraculous and Plagg, after "Miraculous New York".
This is also the third time Adrien gives up a Miraculous after "Desperada" and "Miraculous New York".

Both temporary teams didn't have a good start. In "Hack-San", due to high expectations Alya as Scarabella acted like a rookie and someone she wasn't. While having emotional attachments to Cat Noir and yet being distracted by Cat Walker; Ladybug wasn't acting like herself.

text:
Kuro Neko - Trivia
Concept art of a Magical Charm with Kuro Neko's color scheme was revealed, which could indicate one of two things:
Kuro Neko was originally intended to be an Akumatized villain instead.
The magical charms were originally intended to also protect against amokization.
The same reason why the kwamis had been waiting a very long time for an owner is repeated again a holder harboring emotional attachments.
This episode also runs parallel in comparing Adrien to Chloé in "Battle of the Miraculous":
As both let their worst fears blind and consume them from the real purpose of Ladybug's actions. Chloé's was being useless and abandoned after she lost her powers by exposing her identity, but it was for her own and by extension the whole team's safety. Adrien's was feeling unneeded because Ladybug constantly called their allies despite that most importantly she still needed him as she said, "Just because I doesn't always need you doesn't mean I never will". And just like his father, Adrien didn't fully understand how bad Ladybug's emotional state was.
Both got selfish with their personal desires wanting Ladybug to choose them over everything and everyone else.

title: Kuro Neko
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Kuro Neko - Trivia
Unlike Chloé, Adrien understood his actions and showed remorse really understanding what it meant in later episodes.
Both received their fears from their parents Adrien from his father and Chloé from her mother.
When both realized they couldn't get what they desired from their parents, Adrien and Chloé tried to get what they desired from the one they were driven to.
Both actions caused something drastic to happen such as Chloé's betrayal and Adrien's departure.
Both were separated from their jewels, but Chloé lost hers permanently while Adrien lost his temporarily.
This is the third time Venom is used on a akumatized villain, following "Malediktator" and "Optigami".
Allusions
Kuro Neko, when written as 黒猫, means Black Cat in Japanese.
Kuro Neko, the sentimonster, was inspired by a Maneki-neko, a Japanese beckoning or lucky cat.
This inspiration also explains the Japanese name.
Before coming up with the name "Cat Walker", Adrien and Plagg think of other names, including:
Serious Cat
Silky Kitten
Night Whiskers
Kid Kitty
Cat of the Night
Citizen Cat
Obscure Kitty
Super Cat
Black Kitten
Feline Kitty
Cat Man

text:
Kuro Neko - Trivia
Interestingly, "Super Cat" is Cat Noir's name in the Russian and Ukrainian dubs.
Citizen Cat is most likely a reference to the movie "Citizen Kane".
Cat of the Night is probably a reference to the song in "Santa Claws".
Cat Man may be an homage to Batman.
The game Adrien plays on his TV is a parody of Super Mario.
Errors
In one scene, Ladybug, Ryuko, Polymouse, King Monkey, and Purple Tigress are shown running past Adrien's bedroom window in that order. However, in the next shot Purple Tigress is shown to be in front of King Monkey.
In one shot, Polymouse's hair can be seen clipping through her hoodie.
When Cat Noir detransforms, his index finger is bigger than the other fingers.
When King Monkey de-transforms, the Monkey Miraculous doesn't appear right away. It appears just as Kim loses his grip on the surface above him.
The drawing of the "New Cat Noir" that Plagg shows Adrien appears out of nowhere.
When Plagg convinces Adrien to change his personality, Adrien nods a little. When he pulls his head back, the shine of his hair lags.
Marinette is seen scribbling the same image twice.
The grass in the truck constantly differs.
