title: Knightowl (Actionverse)
text:
Knightowl (Actionverse) - Intro
Knightowl is a superheroine in the United States of America and a member of the American superhero team with her partner Sparrow.

title: Knightowl (Actionverse)
text:
Knightowl (Actionverse) - Appearance
Physical appearance
Outside of her superhero disguise, Knightowl is a tall woman with a large build. She has light brown eyes, long flowing brown hair, and small red lips.
As Knightowl
Knightowl wears a dark brown cowl with golden spikes akin to an owl's eyebrows over her eyes and a long cape. Underneath, she wears a bodysuit that covers her entire body, including her mouth and chin that aren't covered by the cowl. The suit's shoulders, upper chest, and legs are a darker shade of brown, and on the upper chest, there is a logo of an owl's face comprised of gold lines. Also, she wears brown gloves with gold talon-like claws on the fingers, and she wears a golden belt around her hips. With her mask on, she has dark green irises in her eyes.

title: Knightowl (Actionverse)
text:
Knightowl (Actionverse) - Personality
Knightowl is serious, irritable, and straightforward. Saving others in danger is important to her, which makes her frustrated and stern towards anyone who doesn't take the task as seriously, jokes around, or disobeys orders. Preferring solid, perfect plans without a chance of failing, Knightowl doesn't like questionable or risky suggestions, having little faith in them if they're not based on strong evidence or reasoning. Sometimes, she is willing to put her stubbornness aside to try alternate options and work together with people she doesn't agree with.
Liking to take the lead and being good at commanding a team, while she can get impatient with others, Knightowl takes them seriously and gives them clear, strong orders to follow. Tending toward a negative disposition, she judges others harshly, and bluntly gives her opinions of them without consideration. However, Knightowl is experienced, thus knowing the dangers of her job, and calming new fellow superheroes in difficult situations. She also has a softer side, laughing with Majestia and Sparrow about Ladybug and Cat Noir's budding romance.

title: Knightowl (Actionverse)
text:
Knightowl (Actionverse) - Abilities
Knightowl is physically fit, having enough stamina and skill to keep up with Ladybug and Cat Noir while they're running, and to jump from edge to edge down a huge crack in the ground. She throws boomerangs based off of her logo with great strength and precision. Additionally, Knightowl is a skilled strategist, devising the initial destructive plan to destroy the Trash Krakken and giving commands to Ladybug, Cat Noir, and Sparrow when they're about to battle him.

title: Knightowl (Actionverse)
text:
Knightowl (Actionverse) - History
Miraculous Adventures
In the end of "Silurus", Sparrow and Knightowl meet Cat Noir on the roof of a building in New York after Doorman uses his powers to open a passage between the cities. Cat Noir walks to the edge of the roof and joins the other heroes as they admire the view of the city destroyed by the villain names as the Trash Krakken. However, Ladybug and Cat Noir running off to detransform, thus surprising their new allies before parting ways over the rooftops.

title: Knightowl (Actionverse)
text:
Knightowl (Actionverse) - History
Later in "The Big Leagues", when Ladybug and Cat Noir are late, she says angrily "they're too French", after which they return to Majestia, Knightowl, Sparrow, Uncanny Valley, and Doorman fifteen minutes after they originally left. After Camilla Hombee arrives by helicopter and reveals herself to be Victory, she mocks Cat Noir, dismissing him as nothing more than Ladybug's sidekick whos' just there to make jokes. Afterward, Knightowl is instructed to stand by for a signal from Victory when everything begins. As soon as the instructions were given, Ladybug and Cat Noir decide to run into battle with the villain, much to Knightowl's anger, who calls them irresponsible. Knightowl and Sparrow are forced to follow them, whereupon they jump into a crevice and come face to face with Trash Krakken, welcoming them to the big leagues.

title: Knightowl (Actionverse)
text:
Knightowl (Actionverse) - History
In "Battle for New York", Knightowl initially disagrees with Ladybug's plan, but later reluctantly agrees, giving 10 minutes to complete the plan. She instructs the young heroes on what to do and how to behave. She actively participates in the fight while also keeping an eye on the rest of the team. After losing Sparrow, she receives a signal from Victory and orders Ladybug and Cat Noir to retreat, knowing they're running out of time. After summoning Lucky Charm, Ladybug asks Knightowl to start throwing gum. She initially refuses, fearing his identity will be revealed. In the end, she agrees, on the condition that Ladybug and Cat Noir don't reveal the secret to anyone. She attaches the rubber band to the yo-yo. At the same time, she uses the cellphone app to order Majestia to stop, claiming they have a solution to the problem. Thanks to their teamwork, the superheroes obtain the stuffed animal, thereby destroying Trash Krakken. Knightowl, carrying Sparrow and Cat Noir on his shoulders, thanks the previously infected man for all the information.

title: Knightowl (Actionverse)
text:
Knightowl (Actionverse) - History
Afterward, while on the roof with the other heroes, Knightowl declares that Ladybug is wonderful. He congratulates the Parisian heroes and says goodbye.

title: Knightowl (Actionverse)
text:
Knightowl (Actionverse) - Relationships
Friends/Allies
Sparrow
Knightowl treats Sparrow as a sidekick, seeing him in a similar but less judgemental fashion to Cat Noir. She trusts him enough to listen to him and his advice, such as begrudgingly agreeing to stray from her original plan for ten minutes when he persuades her to try Ladybug and Cat Noir's plan. Though close to him, Knightowl continues the mission after his apparent demise, thinking of it as a way of honoring his sacrifice.
Acquaintances
Ladybug and Cat Noir
Knightowl is aloof and critical of Ladybug and Cat Noir, displeased with them when they run off briefly so they can detransform, and when they jump down a hole to confront the Trash Krakken instead of following Victory's direction. In particular, she finds Cat Noir annoying, thinking of him as a sidekick who mainly goofs off. However, she knows how important Ladybug is in the mission and relies on Cat Noir to calm her down after the apparent demise of Sparrow.
Despite her criticism of them, after they explain how they want to try taking Mr. Squid from Trash Krakken, Knightowl relents and works with them to execute the plan, though not without disagreements along the way.

title: Knightowl (Actionverse)
text:
Knightowl (Actionverse) - Trivia
Knightowl's design is similar to the design of famous comic book superhero Batman.
Knightowl's name and design are also similar to Nite Owl (specifically, the Daniel Dreiberg incarnation), a superhero from the Watchmen comics who is partially based on Batman.
In the fourth issue of Miraculous Adventures, it is revealed that Knightowl keeps her identity and true gender a secret from the other heroes.
To communicate with her allies, Knightowl has a special phone, painted in the colors of her costume.

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - Intro
are the deuteragonistic faction of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. They are cosmic, spirit-like entities who embody "abstract" concepts. They give certain powers to people with Miraculouses, transforming them into animal-themed superpowered beings.
They are “cousins” of Renlings, other spirit-like beings who embody human values.
In "Mister Agreste", another one of their "cousins", Maino'li, is shown.

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - History
Kwamis are divine beings that are formed whenever a new abstract idea, concept, or emotion comes into existence in the universe, such as creation, love, beauty, and mathematics. The very first Kwami ever to come into existence is Tikki, the Kwami of Creation, who came into existence upon the creation of the universe.
The concept of creation not only created the Quantic Universe, it also created a near infinite number of other universes alongside it, with each universe having its own set of Kwamis, that is to say, the Kwamis exist in all the universes simultaneously, and have the knowledge and memories of all their counterparts from the other universes, though they don't usually bring up this topic with mortals, as there isn't enough time in such a short lifespan to explain even the tiniest bit about it.

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - History
All of the Kwamis know each other and journeyed across the universe for eons. During their travels, they found their way to Earth and at some point discovered their magical powers, born from the abstract concepts that they respectively embody, with Plagg using his powers to cause the extinction of the non-avian dinosaurs. That's when the Kwamis realized, even though their powers were great, they were too strong and unfocused, leading to great damage. During their ancient past, the Kwamis witnessed the rise of humanity and with it, from five to seven million years ago, the birth of their "cousins" the Renlings.
However, the Kwamis were spirit-like, and thus couldn't be perceived by regular, tangible lifeforms, such as humans, and were therefore unable to interact with them. Despite that, they had a deep yearning to learn more about humans by observing them.

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - History
Until one day, five thousand years ago, a Chinese mage figured out how to create special magical jewels, the Miraculouses. These jewels allowed the Kwamis to manifest in physical form, finally allowing them to communicate with mortal lifeforms, though the physical form can only be manifested when a Kwami's respective Miraculous is in the possession of an owner. In return for the privilege of having the ability to be perceived by mortals, the Kwamis were able to grant superpowers to their Miraculous owners. Through said owners they had discovered that their powers are far more manageable.
But soon despite observing humans, the kwamis knew they would need the help of humans to navigate the world besides their humans owners. So they also witnessed the rise of the Order of the Guardians, a group of people chosen and trained to help the kwamis and also protect their secrets.

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - History
From that point on, Kwamis helped the wearers of their Miraculouses transform into heroes and achieve good all around the world. There were instances where they became stuck with villainous owners and were forced to help them with their diabolical schemes due to being bound to their Miraculous owner's every command, such as Nooroo and Duusu currently in the series. Some of them have made long-lasting and meaningful bonds of friendship with their owners and to commemorate that special bond, they'd give their owner a jewel, known as a Kwagatama.
A long time ago (long enough for some Kwamis to forget), a magical spell was cast upon them. They are physically incapable of speaking their owners' names to each other or any Miraculous owners other than their own. However, if another Miraculous owner already knows their owner's identity, then the Kwami can speak their owner's name freely. The spell also prevents Kwamis from speaking the name of the Guardians of their Miraculouses.
On occasion, incidents where an active Kwami would get separated from their owners or find them in trouble would occur, and often used their powers to protect them, but only as a last resort.

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - History
In "Sandboy", it is revealed that active Kwamis collect items from the outside world and bring them inside the Miracle Box to give as presents to inactive Kwamis for entertainment.
Sometimes on occasions, through unknown means or without the need for an owner, a Kwami can find their way out of the Miracle Box.
Just as Miraculous holders were taught about the powers of the jewels, so were the Kwamis, such as the Miraculous potions, that allowed them and their owners to change into their elemental forms. However, even though they were curious about how their powers could be modified, they were forbidden by the Guardians to know as a precaution in case if they ever fell into evil hands.

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - History
Over time, the Kwamis also became aware that they could unify their powers as well as the danger that came when one holder fused too many jewels together, as seen in "Miracle Queen", when Stompp, Roaar and the others refused to share their activation commands after seeing Chloé's rude and selfish behavior. They also knew that Chloé could've severely hurt herself, so they refused for her own safety. They also were aware of the Guardian's Code and sometimes, like their owners, shared meaningful bonds with the Guardians of their boxes.
In rare instances, not all Kwamis know the identity of the Guardian that has ownership of the Miracle Box that their Miraculous came from, such as Nooroo and Duusu not knowing much about Master Fu before they were separated.
Sometimes, depending on certain situations or emergencies, Kwamis would often return to the home cities, towns, countries of their previous owners, but come under the ownership of new holders, like in the case with Tikki.
Throughout the thousands of years of working with owners they also learned a variety of other skills that either pique their interest, their powers or situations.

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - History
Even though, Kwamis can be renounced by their owners in "Transmission", it's revealed that they can do their own form of "renouncing". As with Tikki's and Plagg's case, if the task of being a wielder is too great for them or least if the holder doesn't meet the Kwamis' expectations they can convince their owners to surrender their jewels without saying the renounce command. Afterwards the Kwamis begin their search for new owners under their own judgement if a Guardian doesn't or can't intervene or has their permission.

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - Recent
Main Universe
From then on, the Kwamis were all safe with their Miraculouses inside the Miracle Boxes at the Guardian's Temple until the Order fell 172 years ago because of a mistake Fu made, as a young apprentice Guardian at the time. While undergoing a trial of watching over a Miracle Box for 24 hours without eating, he used Duusu's power in an attempt to create a small Sentimonster to go to the kitchen to get him some food, but he accidentally manifested a ravenous Sentimonster that devoured the monks and most of the Miraculouses and the Kwamis as well. Except for the last remaining Miracle Box, which was the same one Master Fu was guarding. However, during Fu's escape, Nooroo and Duusu were separated, buried in the snow near the temple's ruins. Meanwhile, the remaining seventeen Kwamis hid with Master Fu to parts unknown.

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - Recent
Up until sometime ago, Wayzz was activated and became Master Fu's companion as they travelled the world together. Then, before World War II they were in France where their existence was known to Master Fu's friend and eventual lover Marianne Lenoir however even with the Order gone the kwamis and their powers were still being hunted. During WWII, the kwamis and their master were being pursued by the Nazis in order to escape them they fled with him to London and after the war was finished they made their way back to Paris.

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - Recent
Meanwhile unknown to them, 15 years ago, before the rise of Ladybug and Cat Noir both Nooroo and Duusu were found on a previous trip overseas by the Agrestes and Nathalie. In "Representation", due to the Agrestes nor the Graham de Vanily couples not being able to bear their own children, as well as the Tsrugi's disappointment in men Émilie, Colt and Tomoe used Duusu's power to create Adrien, Félix and Kagami respectively, but due to Duusu's state of his damaged Miraculous in doing so, they grew sick over time and were eventually left in a condition where they fell into an eternal slumber  meanwhile Tomoe survived. Afterwards, Gabriel forbid the use of it and hid it away. Desperate to fix his mistake, he began using Nooroo's for evil to obtain Tikki and Plagg in order to gain access to their absolute power, reawakening the legend once more. Soon a new generation of holders began again this time with the kwamis being paired in the hands of teenagers of Paris, France.

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - Recent
In "Feast", after the titular supervillain was defeated by Ladybug and Cat Noir, the former's Miraculous Ladybug is able to bring back the guardians' temple, along with all the monks, Miraculous and kwamis that were eaten. In "Miracle Queen", Ladybug became the kwamis new guardian when Master Fu gives up his role.
During French-American Friendship Week in "Miraculous New York", Ladybug and Cat Noir discover one of the lost kwami Liiri of the Eagle Miraculous, in the Gilbert du Motier exhibit in the New-York history museum.
As of "Strikeback", all of the kwamis from the Chinese Miracle Box except for Tikki, Plagg and Duusu have fallen into the hands of Gabriel Agreste due to him trading his nephew Félix the Peacock Miraculous for all the others in the Chinese Miracle Box and Gabriel's wedding ring.
In "Evolution", thanks to Monarch's greed, the heroes managed to save Fluff and her Miraculous. In "Destruction", Monarch melted the remaining Miraculouses except the Butterfly Miraculous into rings with the ability to gives his akumatized villains the Miraculous superpowers of the Miraculouses without needing to give them the actual jewelry while the kwamis were put in cages.

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - Recent
In "The Kwamis' Choice", after Tikki and Plagg's choice to free their owners from the responsibilities their Miraculouses put on them, Monarch discovers the identities of the new holders of the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses, Alya and Zoé, and steals their Miraculouses from them while they're in their civilian identities. But thanks to the efforts of the two kwamis and the Resistance, Marinette and Adrien retrieved them, allowing Ladybug and Cat Noir to return.
Despite Monarch finding at least one user of for almost all the kwamis he can grant except Sass, deeming his power too dangerous to grant to his akumatized supervillains, he still couldn't defeat the heroes. In "Intuition", he used Sass himself, but found out the hard way that he couldn't make it work due to Ladybug's adaptability and Cat Noir's unpredictability. To make matters worse for Monarch, his repeated usage of Second Chance worsened his Cataclysm induced injury, forcing him to never make use of the Snake Miraculous again.

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - Recent
From "Re-creation", during the scuffle Nooroo and his Miraculous was free but lost again as Gabriel was making his wish he relinquished his remaining Miraculouses to Ladybug and she reforged the jewels to their original forms and the Kwamis are freed from the Kwami cage and Gabriel's control for good, since the Kwami cage was destroyed by Marinette. Then, the kwamis were returned to all of the inactive members making them like herself and Cat Noir full time members along with their newest addition Argos. Unknown to them that Nooroo was captured by Cerise Bianca who swam in the Agreste Mansion crypt and plans to use it for an unknown reason to destroy our heroes.
Reversed Universe

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - Recent
At some point, The Supreme got hold of all Miraculous in existence and has used them to dominate the world. No one knows about the existence of the Miraculous and the Kwamis, except for those the Supreme entrusts a Miraculous with. Since the Supreme is showed as being a villainous entity, all Kwamis may have been enslaved by him, forced to help the Supreme and his followers. It is unknown if this applies to all kwamis, but it is known for sure that at least Tikki and Plagg had been given seals on their mouths that not only prevents them from speaking, but also prevents anyone from summoning Gimmi and using the Absolute Power.
At some point in time, Gabriel Agreste, a fashion designer, joined the Supreme in order to steal two Miraculous so he could get his greatest wish, only to lose his wife in the proccess. Despite the loss, Gabriel decided to fight the Supreme, using the Butterfly Miraculous to transform into Betterfly and use its power to bring hope to his world. To counter that, the Supreme gave the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses to Marinette Dupain-Cheng and Adrien Agreste, who became Shadybug and Claw Noir, so they could recover the stolen Miraculous from Betterfly.

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - Appearance
Generally, Kwamis are small, being around 10 centimeters (4 inches) in height, with large heads, big eyes, tails in different sizes, and tiny bodies. They have arms and legs, and though they lack fingers and toes, Kwamis are still able to grab things. The animal theme that they display is reflected in their Miraculous; for example, Plagg is black with green eyes and has cat-like ears and a cat-like tail. Fittingly, his Miraculous is the Cat Miraculous.
After consuming certain potions made from the Miraculous spellbook, their appearances will change. If the aqua mode potion is used, the kwami will gain fins and a fishtail. In "ice mode", the Kwamis gain crystals on their bodies.
In "Re-creation", with Tikki and Plagg it's revealed that Kwamis have one other form under the command "Kwami, Reveal Yourself", they assume their original forms becoming humanoid giants with multiple arms.

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - Abilities
Kwamis are divine beings of great cosmic power. They are immortal beings that have existed since the birth of the universe billions of years ago.
Kwamis each have a unique superpower, each power corresponding to the abstract concept that the Kwami embodies. However, the Kwamis powers are far too strong and uncontrolled. When a Kwami uses their superpower without a Miraculous holder to channel and focus it, it results in some kind of catastrophe, potentially resulting in the destruction of whole cities and the extinction of entire species. And yet, on occasion they can also have some degree of control when using their powers.
Also mentioned in "Style Queen", kwamis don't need a physical form to use their powers as Plagg used his Cataclysm to make the non-avian dinosaurs go extinct, long before the jewels were made, meaning that kwamis are capable of using their powers in their spirit forms or since they started their lives as cosmic and/or spirit like beings, Kwamis are born with their powers.

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - Abilities
Due to their bodies being of spiritual nature, they are able to levitate and freely fly through physical space, even up in the sky at great heights, as seen in "Weredad". Kwamis are also able phase through physical matter, making it impossible to capture them. As seen in "Miracle Queen", and given the fact that they once flew across the vacuum of space, Kwamis do not require air, even if they're underwater.

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - Abilities
Despite the Miraculouses granting them physical form, Kwamis don't appear on cameras, photos, videos, or screens, as observed in episodes like "The Collector" and "Truth". They also can't be seen or perceived by artificial intelligence, such as robots and androids, like Aeon/Uncanny Valley. However, in episodes such as "Kwamibuster" and "Optigami", depictions of Kwamis, like drawings, remain visible when displayed through technology. This visibility also applies when a living being's vision is transmitted to a screen. Additionally, as shown in "Conformation", their voices can't be recorded by technology. Nonetheless, Kwamis can choose to be detected by technology; for instance, in "Optigami," the Kwamis use a cellphone to communicate with Marinette.Also in A Fairy Good Night, Kaalki allowed herself to be detected by Markov while talking to Max.

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - Abilities
Even though they are small, Kwamis appear to have a human level of strength. They have displayed the ability to hold and lift things that are larger and/or heavier than themselves. Despite said size, there seems to be no limit to the amount of food they can eat; in "Dearest Family", Tikki was able to eat multiple galettes and still not get full.
According to "Ladybug & Cat Noir" and "Timebreaker", kwamis are capable of sensing the power of other kwamis and even their own when active under certain circumstances like time travel. When done that way the kwamis can vouch for the authenticity of their owners telling the difference between friend nor foe other times just like a person, time travel can give a kwami a sense of deja vu or at least make them aware of some events despite them not knowing all the details such as when 1940's Barkk briefly went into the future she was aware that some of her siblings were going to get owners as well as the world being in danger or that someone is going to be after the jewels again but Barkk in "Furious Fu", thought the sense of danger was coming from Su-Han but she learned it was from Monarch.

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - Abilities
They can also perform a ritual for their Miraculous owners where they create a Kwagatama inside their bodies from the hairs of their past and current owners. It allows their current holder to summon and communicate with spirits of the Miraculous holders of the past. They present the charm to their current bearer for a special occasion, such as a birthday.
Kwamis can communicate with each other from afar on a Kwami's "cycle" (the Kwami equivalent of a birthday) if they gather in the Miracle Box at a specific time and all sing together. The more Kwamis there are, the stronger the connection is, and the more likely it is to work. They can also completely dispel the connection if they need to. If the Kwami being contacted is powering a Miraculous at the time, the other Kwamis will contact the Miraculous' wearer instead.

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - Abilities
Similar to a genie or sentimonster, kwamis are bound to the commands or restrictions of anyone who wears their connected miraculous no matter what it is. At first, most holders don't know about this ability implying that they don't take it lightly wanting the bonds with their owners to be built on trust, friendship and companionship like with Marinette and Tikki or Adrien and Plagg however once a holder knows about the ability it's their choice to use it or in case of emergencies or crisis.

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - Abilities
Kwamis are under a magical spell that prevents them from revealing the real names of their Miraculous owners to one another. When they attempt to do so, bubbles emerge from their mouths. Additionally, they cannot disclose the real names of their holders to other Miraculous holders, as demonstrated in episodes like "Sandboy", "Reflekdoll", and "Destruction". However, in "The Collector", this restriction appears not to apply if the holder already knows the other holder's identity; for example, Wayzz was able to mention Master Fu's name to Marinette. It also seems that having multiple Kwamis share the same holder is an exception to this rule. After Marinette became the Guardian, the Kwamis could say her name to each other, as seen in "Furious Fu", "Sole Crusher", and "Kuro Neko".

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - Abilities
Yet it seems in "Reflekdoll" and "Oblivio", they can say the real names of their owners as long as they're not in close proximity to another individual and despite other kwamis knowing the identities of other holders, the spell seems to work regardless of any condition, but they can say any version of their holder's hero name just fine. It's also unknown if the guardians placed the spell on the kwamis starting with their first owners or after an incident that led to a Miraculous holder's identity being discovered leading to troubling results. In "Destruction", kwamis can say the real names of Miraculous holders who have renounced their jewel, however, even if the Miraculous is stolen, the holder whom the miraculous was stolen from still counts as a holder, as long as they never actually renounced the Miraculous.
As seen by Plagg in "The Puppeteer 2" and Tikki in "Captain Hardrock", Kwamis aren't only able to just inhabit Miraculouses; they can also possess or inhabit other objects like a wax figurine head and locks.

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - Abilities
Due to the fact that they and their Miraculouses have been used by people across the world throughout history, the Kwamis are able to automatically speak and understand any human language, which is essential due to them not knowing who their next Miraculous owners might be. As seen by Tikki in "Miraculous Shanghai" as she could fluently speak Chinese, meaning that the phrases used to transform and the use of their powers can be said in any language. As seen by Tikki in "Miraculous Tokyo", kwamis can also help their owners understand and speak other languages by entering their owner's heads.
In "Volpina", "Reflekdoll" and "Ephemeral", the kwamis are able to find their way home sometimes returning to their chosen owners or their guardian if they become lost or separated. According to Marinette, since the kwamis don't know what an address is they use their other senses to find their way home.

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - Abilities
In "Re-creation", it's shown that kwamis can reveal their real form if their owners ask them, and even combine into one new entity. However, it's unknown if that's a unique trait for Tikki and Plagg, who are the embodiment of the first concepts to exist in the universe, and so, can obtain the Absolute power.
In "Miraculous Paris", it's revealed that there are billions of parallel universes, and kwamis live their lifetimes in all these universes simultaneously.
Miraculous Transformation
When a specific command is given, a Kwami will be pulled into their respective Miraculous, even if they do not want to. When a Miraculous owner transforms, the Kwami transforms into pure energy to charge the Miraculous and give the user their power, thus, resulting in the Kwami disappearing into the Miraculous. While the Kwami inhabits their Miraculous, the person wearing it will transform into an animal-themed superhero, the animal theme corresponding to the animal that the Kwami resembles.

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - Abilities
The transformed person gains greatly enhanced physical abilities and become nearly invulnerable. They also acquire an Omni-purpose tool and the ability to use a more controlled version of the unique superpower that their Kwami possesses.
As shown by "Mr. Pigeon 72", "Dearest Family" and "Sublimation", the theory of proving that Miraculous holders can have unlimited powers is true and yet it's unknown if when a holder creates a new power while transformed if the new ability will be transferred to the kwami too.

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - Abilities
The Miraculous transformation can last indefinitely, but if the holder is underage, once the special superpower is used, they are left with only five minutes until they detransform back to their normal form and the Kwami leaves the Miraculous, completely out of energy. As seen in "Anansi", just summoning the power can drain the Kwami's energy, even if the power is not used on anything. To regain their strength for another transformation, the Kwami needs to refuel by eating food. Any food will work, though some have a preference for specific foods. Plagg is an example, as all he ever seems to eat is Camembert cheese and is barely shown eating anything else. In "Timetagger", just staying transformed takes a toll on them if the transformation is held for a very long period of time.
When the Miraculous is worn by an adult owner, the kwami can maintain the transformation, even after the special power is used, and the power can be used multiple times. This is because when a kwami is paired with an adult holder, they can feed off their energy, sustaining themselves for far longer, also meaning they don't have to be fed as much.

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - Abilities
They are aware of the actions of the people who use their Miraculous when transformed, but they cannot communicate with their owners during that time. At the same time, the extent of the events that they can be aware of when their Miraculous is used is uncertain: after the battle with Stoneheart, Tikki and Plagg were unaware that Ladybug forgot to capture the Akuma. In "Emotion", it's revealed that they don't only have an awareness to their owner's actions also to the actions of others around their holders. As Tikki was aware of Felix's caring but aggressive methods, his powers, the situation and knowing he needed to see the real outcome of his desires which ended up in Tikki not giving her owner an object.
If a holder wears the Miraculouses of two Kwamis' or more, their unification capabilities are activated creating a hybrid Miraculous holder and yet it's unknown if constantly fusing two Miraculouses or more will have lingering or harmful effects for the kwamis.
According to Plagg in "Mister Agreste", when a kwami is absorbed into their miraculous upon transformations, they are put in a quantic state making their awareness limited.

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - Abilities
In "Heartfixer", it is revealed that Kwamis can't be affected by akumatization if they're outside of their Miraculouses.
Weaknesses
Despite their god-like nature, Kwamis can get sick, as seen in "Princess Fragrance" when Tikki became sick after helping Marinette defeat a villain in the pouring rain or snow. Although, it is hard to imagine a cosmic being getting sick, it was done to Tikki because despite her and siblings power being great, their physical forms are surprisingly fragile and when they crossed the border realm into the mortal world, they also gained the weaknesses that come with a mortal form. A Guardian can assist in their recovery and heal them. Apart of it, involves reading a kwami's cosmic energy trying to fix any misalignments so both kwami and holder can transform properly.

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - Abilities
It's unknown if a Kwami can only get sick while inside a Miraculous or to what extent this could harm them or affect their wielders and their powers but it could be possible that the powers won't work, the transformations won't hold or glitch. However, when a Kwami is not fed properly leading to their powers becoming weak and ineffective it's likely if they transform when sick, then their owner's powers will be too.
According to "Ladybug & Cat Noir" and "Timebreaker", kwamis are capable of sensing the power of other kwamis and even their own when active under certain circumstances like time travel. However, it seems that their range can be limited or they can't sense the powers of another Kwami when they're not active, as Wayzz was unable to sense Duusu when he was activated prior to the years before Nooroo was. As well as sense the aura of other beings, including humans, done by Liiri in "Miraculous New York".

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - Abilities
However, if and when paired with a bad owner, the command ability can be used to take advantage of the kwami limiting what they can do depending on restriction showing the lack of trust between the pair such as when Kwamis are told to shut up, be quiet, or just "Silence!", their mouths are sealed until the holder snaps their fingers. For example, Gabriel had gave Nooroo the restriction not to be too far away from him not only showing his controlling nature but his fear if Nooroo's gets away from him as well as finds the heroes or guardian telling them about his plans leaving them to be ruined. And yet, Nooroo could've looked at it differently despite the ill treatment he got he still cared for Gabriel seeing him as someone who needs help.
In "Miraculous London", it's revealed that a Kwami can also be paralyzed with their holder snapping their fingers.

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - Abilities
As abstract entities, they have been around since before the creation of the Miraculouses, meaning even if their Miraculous is destroyed or erased from the timeline, they will return to their natural state, in which case they cannot be perceived by mortal senses under normal circumstances; even though they do not cease to exist. If a Kwami's connected jewel is destroyed first, then they go back to their original forms but it's unknown if the same holds true when or if the kwami is destroyed first.
When Kwamis are powering their owners, they have some level of resistance to an Akumatized villain's attacks, as seen in "Dark Cupid". However, if their owner is attacked by an Akumatized villain's powers and detransform afterward, the effects will transfer to the Kwami, as seen in "Oblivio", "Miraculer", and "Psycomedian". However, if they are already outside their Miraculouses, they can be immune to certain villain attacks, like Nightormentor's spell as seen in "Conformation".

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - Abilities
Even though their intangibility makes them impossible to catch it does have their limits. The only known exception to this rule is magical means, such as the Miraculouses, or Kwamibuster's vacuum. In "Mr. Pigeon 72", it is implied that even though kwamis can make themselves intangible, they can't do so for objects, including even their own Miraculous they are connected to, as noted when Tikki said, "The earrings won't go through the bubble" in "Sentibubbler". Which is fully confirmed in "Conformation", as Plagg flew back to Paris with his miraculous in tow upon finding his guardian's hiding place in the Agreste mansion he phased right through the cabinet but the ring didn't come with him.

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - Abilities
In "Truth", it's revealed that a damaged Miraculous is dangerous for a kwami as well but to a lesser extent in the case with Duusu. Along with his personality change, he described it with his mind being trapped in chaos and living in a nightmare. But whether it's the same for each kwami is unknown, varying between their personalities and how their connected jewels get damaged or if there are more side effects. Since kwamis feed off the energy of their adult wielders it's also likely that they feed off more when their connected Miraculous is damaged to sustain themselves which would explain the cases with Nathalie and Émilie. Or if it's possible that the kwamis can still use their version of their powers or let alone be more out of control than normal when the Miraculouses are damaged. The result in a broken jewel also messes up a kwamis cosmic energy causing the flow to be disrupted when they transform, then the kwamis are put under a strain just to hold the together.

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - Abilities
In "Dearest Family", it is revealed that when a Kwami gets a strong craving for a certain type of food, it can cause them to mad with hunger. The Kwami will do whatever it takes to get as much of the food as possible, they even go as far as to show themselves in front of humans and use their special superpowers, despite the potential disaster. To make matters worse, if the Miraculous holder transforms while their Kwami is in a food-hungry state, the extreme craving will pass on to the holder.

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - Abilities
In "Evolution", it's revealed that the kwamis power depends on the energy they possess, before or during transformations. In case their energy starts to diminish, through the use of a single Miraculous or a unification, it is reflected in the performance of the powers given to their holders. With young holders, the single use of a Miraculous' power (with the exception of the Rabbit and Snake Miraculouses), causes the kwamis to lose their energy, preventing the holder from using their power and causing the transformation to have a time limit before being undone. With adult holders, an excessive use of the powers ends up making them weaker. When under unification, for both young and adult holders, the combined use of the powers places a great strain on the kwamis and holder's energy, draining  and debilitating both much faster. For that reason, it's imperative that the kwamis are well fed between each transformation and that the holder doesn't do constant combinations of too many Miraculous at one time.

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - Abilities
According to Sass, it also presents a great danger to them with him warning Monarch "If you destroy us then you destroy yourself" heavily implying that they could lose their physical forms that way.
In "Destruction", even though, the spell prevents the kwamis from saying their holder or guardian's real names to others, but it doesn't prevents the kwamis from telling where the holders or guardians live, if the kwami knows where their owner's location/home, their homing instinct can be used by anyone with dark intentions.
Also because of their concepts being so unique once a kwami is born their concept nor powers can't be copied by another despite their powers being somewhat similar.
It's revealed that kwamis can actually be directly affected by the powers of other kwamis, as Monarch was able to use Venom, Pollen's power, on both Plagg and Tikki. Not just that, but they remained affected by the power even after returning to their respective Miraculous and so after Monarch took them and then put them on, summoning the two kwamis who were still immobilized.

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - Abilities
In "Miraculous Paris", is showed that Tikki and Plagg from Shadybug and Claw Noir's universe have seals put on them by the Supreme that prevent them from talking and also prevents anyone from summon Gimmi and use the Absolute power. Just like their owners due to their powers being activated with a simple trigger word if the kwamis can't talk then they can't even active their powers to defend themselves.
Power-ups
The Miraculous spellbook contains recipes for potions that can alter a kwami's appearance and form, either by drinking the potion directly or consuming something edible that contains the potion. After the Kwami has ingested a potion, the kwami's Miraculous wielder will get new abilities and appearances in their superhero form, depending on the potion the kwami consumed. These extra powers last for only a single transformation. These power-up potions can also be digested by the holder if they are transformed.
Known Potions
The known power-ups are:
Aqua - The Kwami's legs are replaced with a fishtail, and their hands are replaced with flippers. It allows the kwami to grant underwater abilities to their holder. The potion's color is green.

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - Abilities
Ice - The Kwami grows three ice shards somewhere on its body. In some cases some part of the body will be slightly altered, such as Tikki's spot which turns into a hexagon. It allows the kwami to grant ice-related powers to their holder. The potion's color is blue.
Space - It is unknown what a kwami looks like in this form. It allows the kwami to grant space-related powers to their holder and the power to fly. The potion's color is purple.

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - Trivia
The concept of the Kwamis was created by Bandai. A Kwami is a "quantic (small) kami". In Japanese, kami (神) often refers to a god or certain kinds of spirits.
Wilfried Pain noted in a Twitter response that Kwamis are "some kind of god" and don't exactly have genders. He also mentioned that the Kwamis are supposed to look very cute.
While they don't have genders, kwamis would address each other with either masculine ("he/him"), feminine ("she/her"), or neutral ("they/them") pronouns. In "Sandboy", Plagg referred to his fellow Kwamis as "brothers and sisters".
The Kwamis' official pronouns are the ones they have in the French dub, as the franchise originated from France. However, some dubs give some of the kwamis different vocal ranges which leads to them having different pronouns. For example, Duusu has a masculine voice and uses "he/him" in the French dub, but has a feminine voice and uses "she/her" in the English dub.

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - Trivia
Interestingly, there are rare cases where a dub would change voice actors for some kwamis later during the show's run. This resulted in some kwamis having their preferred pronouns changed later in the show. For example, in the English dub, Roaar was originally given a masculine voice, thus being given "he/him" pronouns in "Sandboy". But Roaar now has a feminine voice following "Miracle Queen", thus being given "she/her" pronouns.
Another interesting case is some kwami's alternate variant(s) within the multiverse. In the English dub, Nooroo has a masculine voice and uses "he/him" pronouns in the Quantic Universe. But the kwami has an alternate variant who has a feminine voice and uses "she/her" pronouns in the Ladybug & Cat Noir: The Movie universe.
In the English dub, individual kwamis are commonly addressed as either "he/him" or "she/her". However, Ezra Weisz, the voice director, once revealed on TikTok that he prefers addressing the individual kwamis as "they/them".
Daizzi is the first kwami to be addressed as "they/them" in the English dub, which is in "Guiltrip".

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - Trivia
According to Thomas Astruc during a Miraculous panel at Ludicomix 2018, some kwamis being inspired by the Chinese zodiac signs is because he wants the world to get to know the elements of Chinese culture.
According to Thomas Astruc, the name of every kwami has to be a short name with double letters in it. All kwamis have at least one set of double letters in their name (Tikki, Trixx, Mullo,...). The only known kwami which has more than one set of double letters in its name is Nooroo, with two.
Interestingly, each of the concepts the kwamis represent all end with the suffix -ion. The only exceptions to this is Liiri, who is from the Native American Miracle Box.
Kwamis are like Aladdin's genie, having to obey their holder's desires. They aren't genies themselves; however, genies do exist in-universe, according to Plagg in "Ladybug & Cat Noir".
According to Jeremy Zag, Season 2 would include an episode revealing the origins of the kwamis.

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - Trivia
The New York Comic Con 2016 panel additionally noted that there would be Miraculous Secrets webisodes that focus on the kwamis, notably Tikki and Plagg (revealed as "Tikki" and "Plagg"), and that there may be more than one episode in new seasons that centers on them. "Sandboy" is one such episode.
The official Miraculous Ladybug Twitter account noted that while more kwamis would be seen in Season 2, it wouldn't be all of them.
Duusu ended up being introduced in Season 3's "Reflekdoll".
According to Tikki in "Sandboy", a kwami's cycle, or birthday, is equivalent to several hundred human years.
Even though some kwamis don't have noses, they seem to have a sense of smell; for example, in "Stormy Weather" Plagg said he could "smell Camembert in his sleep".
In "Oblivio", he was seen sniffing Adrien's shirt, smelling the Camembert within.
According to Tikki in "Félix", Kwamis live forever, meaning that they are immortal.
In "Feast", since the sentimonster's destruction returned the Guardians and the destroyed Miraculous, it means that not only are there more Miraculouses but, also, more Kwamis.

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - Trivia
In "Miraculous Shanghai", it is revealed that Kwamis are slightly color blind, since Tikki sees things in a pink tint. However, it is not known if this is the case for all Kwamis, or if so, whether every Kwami sees things in pink, or in a different color.
It is revealed in "Truth" that Kwamis squeak when their heads are touched.
In "Gang of Secrets", it is revealed that Kwamis don't fall in love.
Although in "Sandboy", Plagg flirts with Tikki like how Cat Noir regularly does with Ladybug.
Otherwise, this seems understandable as Kwamis are immortal and accordingly there is no need for them to fall in love with their own kind.
It seems only when they're active kwamis get to experience loving and caring bonds with the owners they receive.
Although kwamis can't speak to their owners directly when transformed, it's seems in "Lies", they can do so through their owner's Miraculous tools.
Even though the kwamis have known each other for a great amount of time, not even they know or possibly remember everything about each other's powers.

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - Trivia
As of "Miraculous New York", "Queen Banana", "Hack-San" and the many past holders, there are many potential reasons as to why the kwamis had to wait a very long time for an owner:
What, who, where, when is the threat in the world and how long it will last.
What Miraculous and person is best suited to handle the job.
So that no previous or (if any) disgraced superheroes harbor any jealousy or grudges towards new holders when they are chosen, due to the emotional attachments they have towards the superpowers that used to belong to them.
As well as due to harboring emotional attachments to the people that use them.
So that their successors don't feel overshadowed by the holders that came before them.
Just like people, the kwamis may also need time to heal from the abuse or misuse from evil owners. As well as when it comes to losing or saying goodbye owners they were proud to have.
To know the meaning of companionship with others creatures.
According to Thomas Astruc, the form the kwamis have now isn't their only one and that Kwamis can take multiple forms to adapt to the people they interact with.

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - Trivia
It's also unknown how the kwamis gained the animal forms they were based on. However due to them having the ability to transform their wielders through the jewels, it's likely before that they used their transformation powers to turn themselves into the forms they have now.
Usually when changing appearances especially into animal ones the kwamis could have:
As they became fascinated with humans, the kwamis could've been fascinated with the animals that roamed the earth themselves and even though they couldn't be seen it's likely they wanted to blend in.
After that they observed the animals they picked but since most of the current animal forms they have now didn't exist at the time they arrived to earth. It's possible that some of them started with the animal ancestors of their current animal forms then over the millions of years as animals evolved the kwamis used their powers to modify their appearances while there were others that had to wait before they could transform.
It wasn't until "Re-creation", some kwamis' true forms were revealed - they are gargantuan humanoid giants with multiple arms.

title: Kwamis
text:
Kwamis - Trivia
Despite their age, the Kwamis seem to possess a childlike innocence, but they still seem to be very wise.
Kwamis have their own variant of Eeny, meeny, miny, moe, called Kwami-Kwa-Who! It goes: "Kwami-kweeny-koomy-who, the special chosen one is you!".
All Kwamis cannot be seen on cameras, videos, screens or by robots, much like how vampires have no reflection in mirrors.
However, unlike vampires, Kwamis do have reflections in mirrors, as seen in "The Bubbler" and "Truth".
The only way for this rule to be bent is through the use of magic. When Mayura created a sentimonster (Optigami) that could record anything it spied into her tablet, she was able to capture kwamis in video. Applying that idea, it's possible that robots, when powered by a magical source, can perceive Kwamis as well.
Even though Kwamis had owners throughout the centuries they are not pets despite them looking like animals most people would own as pets, on a farm, they'd find in a zoo, sanctuary, reverse park or the wild.
With their small size and cuteness, Kwamis can easily look like toys or plushies as seen in "Princess Fragrance", "Miraculous Shanghai", "Furious Fu" and "Simpleman".

title: Lady Wifi
text:
Lady Wifi - Intro
"" is a season 1 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. According to the series production/written order, it is the 3rd episode of season 1, as well as the 3rd episode of the series, overall.

title: Lady Wifi
text:
Lady Wifi - Synopsis
Falsely believing that Chloé is Ladybug, Alya gets suspended from school for her nosiness and becomes akumatized into the villain Lady Wifi.
Disney+
Ladybug faces her best friend Alya, now Lady Wifi.

title: Lady Wifi
text:
Lady Wifi - Plot
Alya cuts Ladybug's face out of a photograph during class. She holds the picture up to her classmates' faces to look for the perfect fit, trying to find out who Ladybug is. She stops on Chloé, who points at Miss Bustier, who is standing in front of Alya's desk. Once she realizes the entire class is watching her, she puts the picture away. Miss Bustier asks if Marinette is still in the girls room since she has not returned to class. Alya shrugs. When class ends, Miss Bustier gives Alya the homework to pass on to Marinette.

title: Lady Wifi
text:
Lady Wifi - Plot
After school, Alya calls Marinette but is forwarded straight to voicemail. Alya then notices Chloé pulling several Ladybug-themed items from her locker (including a costume and yo-yo similar to Ladybug's) and putting them in her bag. Falsely believing Chloé to be Ladybug's secret identity, Alya calls Marinette, only to be directed to voicemail again. She sees Nino and drags him with her to explain what she found out. Nino sympathizes with Alya's inability to contact Marinette, as Adrien also disappears for hours on end when he tries to call him, although Nino blames it on Mr. Agreste's strictness. Alya checks her phone and finds a news report that Ladybug has once again saved Paris. The news report focuses mainly on Ladybug, with Cat Noir in the background behind reporter Nadja Chamack.
Alya recognizes the yo-yo in Ladybug's hand as the yo-yo Chloé took out of her locker and tells Nino that she's figured out Ladybug's secret identity and whispers it in Nino's ear: Chloé is Ladybug. Nino laughs at her revelation, saying Chloé is too narcissistic to be a hero.

title: Lady Wifi
text:
Lady Wifi - Plot
Marinette comes home and finds that Alya has dropped off her book bag and tablet with Sabine at the bakery. Alya also left a note, telling Marinette to call her because she figured out who Ladybug is. Marinette is a little panicked, but when she tries to call Alya back, she finds that she doesn't have any signal. She wanders onto the roof to find a workman, who tells her that they're updating the service. Marinette spends the rest of the day doing her homework.
When she wakes up at her desk the next morning, Marinette realizes that she's already an hour late to school. Meanwhile, Nino is still skeptical that Chloé is Ladybug, but Alya has him distract Chloé while she tries to take a picture of the evidence in Chloé's locker. However, Sabrina and Kim catch Alya snooping, and she and Chloé wind up in Principal's office. Mr. Damoclès gives Alya detention after school, but by citing her right to privacy and the school's theft policy, Chloé uses her father's name Mayor Bourgeois to blackmail Mr. Damoclès into suspending Alya for a week.

title: Lady Wifi
text:
Lady Wifi - Plot
Alya storms out of the school just as Marinette runs in, Alya swears to expose Chloé and tarnish her reputation as Ladybug. In his lair, Hawk Moth senses Alya crying and her anger, sending an akuma her way. The akuma lands on her cellphone and transforms her into Lady Wifi.
Marinette sneaks into Miss Bustier's class but disrupts it by shouting, "What?!" twice when she learns that Alya was suspended for trespassing in "Ladybug's" locker. Miss Bustier sends Marinette to the principal's office, where she finds Mr. Damoclès frozen in his seat with a pink pause sign on his chest. Just then, Lady Wifi uses the school projector system to play a recording of herself. She introduces herself as the deliverer of truth and promises to show all of Paris who Ladybug really is. Recognizing Alya from the charm on her phone, Marinette transforms into Ladybug to save her best friend.

title: Lady Wifi
text:
Lady Wifi - Plot
Miss Bustier dismisses her class for their safety. Adrien runs to the restroom to transform into Cat Noir, reasoning that Lady Wifi will no doubt pay Chloé a visit if she really is Ladybug. Later that evening, Cat Noir ran on all fours and waits on a rooftop across the street from Le Grand Paris and watches Chloé through her window. He finds her dressed as Ladybug while practicing throwing her yo-yo and panics, thinking that he might have fallen for Chloé. However, the real Ladybug shows up beside him and reassures him by explaining that Chloé is just a huge fan.
Chloé's cellphone rings. When she answers, Lady Wifi uses the phone to teleport into the room. She freezes Chloé with a pink pause icon and opens a video recording icon to broadcast Chloé's unmasking to the public. Cat Noir and the real Ladybug arrive on the scene and Lady Wifi realizes her mistake. When she tries to freeze them, they escape into the stairwell and lure her toward the basement of the building where there's no signal.

title: Lady Wifi
text:
Lady Wifi - Plot
Lady Wifi catches onto their plan and leaves to set a trap. Ladybug and Cat Noir then run back up all the stairs, only to find that the door on every floor has a lock icon on it. Meanwhile, Cat Noir wants him and Ladybug to get to know each other outside the costume, but she brushes him off because they have more important things to worry about. They finally reach an unlocked floor and kick the door open, finding themselves in the hotel's dining area. All the tables have a phone on them. They soon learn that Lady Wifi can use them to teleport around the room. Ladybug starts smashing the phones with her yo-yo and Lady Wifi flees into the kitchen, where she locks the door, trapping Ladybug in the kitchen with her. Cat Noir uses the service elevator in the dining area to get into the kitchen.

title: Lady Wifi
text:
Lady Wifi - Plot
Lady Wifi manages to corner Ladybug against the wall and locks her hands down. She then re-opens the video recording icon and proceeds to try and take off Ladybug's mask. It appears to be glued on and won't come off. Just then, Cat Noir arrives in the food elevator to rescue Ladybug, but Lady Wifi traps him in the freezer and locks the door. The impact knocks the ring off Cat Noir finger, and he transforms back into Adrien and is unable to find the ring. Plagg refuses to help Adrien, stating that it's too cold.
Hawk Moth advises Lady Wifi to force Ladybug into using Lucky Charm. When her time runs out, the video recording will broadcast her detransforming, and Lady Wifi can take her Miraculous. Lady Wifi unlocks Ladybug's hands, but leaves the recording on, disappearing and leaving her in the kitchen to rescue Cat Noir from the locked freezer.

title: Lady Wifi
text:
Lady Wifi - Plot
Chloé manages to escape the building and join her father, Mayor Bourgeois and the police waiting outside. When her phone rings, she answers, and Lady Wifi teleports from the phone onto the hotel's roof, forcing Paris to watch as Ladybug tries to save Cat Noir. Trying to kick the door down doesn't work, so she uses Lucky Charm, and a frozen meal appears. She spots the non-microwaveable icon on the box, the lock icon on the freezer door, and a nearby microwave oven. She puts the non-microwaveable dinner in the microwave and blows it up to diffuse the signal. The door unlocks just as Adrien, nearly frozen to death, finds his ring and transforms back into Cat Noir. When Ladybug opens the door at last, he passes out and falls on top of her, worn from the cold. However, he awakens quickly, and realizes Ladybug has used Lucky Charm, shortening their time to defeat Lady Wifi.

title: Lady Wifi
text:
Lady Wifi - Plot
Because she is running out of time, the heroes have to work quickly to stop Lady Wifi. The kitchen door is still locked, but Ladybug suggests blowing up the signal receiver on the roof. Cat Noir covers the camera icon with a pot and uses the food elevator to get out while Ladybug waits in the kitchen. Growing suspicious, Lady Wifi returns and chases Cat Noir onto the roof. He distracts her by throwing his staff at her and then uses Cataclysm to destroy the signal receiver. Lady Wifi loses her powers, the recording and lock icons in the kitchen downstairs dissolving as Ladybug's earrings beep down to two spots. Ladybug escapes the kitchen and shows up on the roof soon after. She uses her yo-yo to yank the phone out of Lady Wifi's hand, smashing in on the ground. She captures the akuma and returns everything back to normal with Miraculous Ladybug.

title: Lady Wifi
text:
Lady Wifi - Plot
Lady Wifi turns back into Alya, who is thrilled to see Ladybug and Cat Noir. However, Ladybug is about to detransform, so they escape from the roof before Alya can get an interview. They run into the hotel lobby and Ladybug ducks inside a closet. Cat Noir tries to stop her, promising not to tell anyone who she is, but she says that "nobody must know who we really are, not even us". The closet door swings between them just as her transformation wears off and Cat Noir is tempted to open the door. Conflicted, he ultimately decides not to betray her trust and leaves, closing the door for her.
Adrien runs outside of the hotel and opens up his jacket. Plagg flies out and questions Adrien. He says that "the love of his life" was right there. He asks why he shut the door for her, and what he was thinking. Adrien replies saying that he can't think when he's with Ladybug.

title: Lady Wifi
text:
Lady Wifi - Plot
The next day, Marinette and Tikki are talking about secret identities. Both deem it safer that her being Ladybug should remain a secret. Not long after, Alya appears on Marinette's balcony. Alya has a new phone and has noticed that when she draws a costume over a picture of Adrien, he kind of looks like Cat Noir. Marinette is offended that Alya would compare Adrien to someone like Cat Noir. Marinette jokes that Alya should send the photos of Adrien to her. She grabs Alya's phone, laughing as Alya chases her around.

title: Lady Wifi
text:
Lady Wifi - Plot Developments
Chloé, after telling off Aurore's outfit, says that Halloween is next month, suggesting that this episode takes place in September.
If this is true that also suggest that Ladybug, Cat Noir and Hawk Moth were around for a few weeks.
This episode confirms that Ladybug and Cat Noir don't know each-other's secret identity. Until he suggests to Ladybug that they might know each other in normal life, which she finds hard to believe. However, unknown to both, it wasn't until "The Dark Owl" that Plagg discovered that the possibility was true.
In this episode, we can see Cat Noir running on all fours like a cat, he also runs like that in other episodes meaning Miraculous holders can also develop the movement patterns of the animals their jewels are based off of.
When a Miraculous holder transforms, their mask can't be removed (at least by physical contact) and according to Ladybug, it's because of magic implying that they are magically glued to a holder's face.
This episode along with "Rogercop" and "Princess Fragrance", starts to explain the dangers of improper miraculous transformation from the kwami aspect.

title: Lady Wifi
text:
Lady Wifi - Plot Developments
This time unlike, Tikki who was physically sick, when Cat Noir's transformation was undone, both were put through a flash freeze and with Plagg also being smaller than Adrien, it hit him harder messing up his cosmic energy freezing it, but instead of getting hurt and their situation right now they both must have agreed to a forced transformation before Plagg completely froze and restarted his alignment.
If Lady Wifi had removed Ladybug's earrings, then the heroine's true identity would have been revealed to Hawk Moth and all of Paris.
And yet, it is understandable to why the creators did not have this happen, as the show was still in its beginning stages at the time of this episode. If an identity reveal were to happen that early, it would lead to many complications further down the road for both the characters and the creators of the show.
Yet, for the creators, they would have to salvage or rework the plot they already have or make a whole new one, let alone new character designs nor the show wouldn't be so far as it is now.
Which also shares a resemblance to "Miracle Queen", in the terms of some events happening sooner and some not happening at all.

title: Lady Wifi
text:
Lady Wifi - Plot Developments
Interestingly, as such everything that happened to Chloe, Luka and Alix in later seasons also would have happened to Marinette all at once.
Because of what Alya had done, there would have been no Rena Rouge thereby leading to the extension of there being no Miraculers.
She would've learned the hard truth about honesty in superhero world of being deadly.
It would have just been easier for Hawk Moth to get the jewels and make his wish sooner.
Plus Ladybug and Cat Noir were still green with everything,
Ironically as Lady Wifi, Alya said that superheroes shouldn't have to hide their identities but through her adventures as Rena Rouge, she started to understand why most heroes follow that rule. As of "Optigami" and "Sentibubbler", when Shadow Moth used the trust and feelings she had for Nino and her family to get to Ladybug.

title: Lady Wifi
text:
Lady Wifi - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in Korea.
Although it's the sixth one to air to do so and the fourth to air in France.
At the beginning of the French version of the episode, Miss Bustier reads a poem by Victor Hugo called "La Coccinelle" ("The Ladybug"), which is completely absent in the English dub.
In the Korean version of this episode, the picture that Alya cuts Ladybug's face out of is from an old promotional picture, as seen with the red tips on Ladybug's hair. This is corrected to an updated picture in the French and English versions.
The note Alya attached to Marinette's tablet is written in French and it says: "Appelle moi. Je sais qui est la VRAIE LADYBUG!!", which roughly translates to "Call me, I know who the REAL LADYBUG is!!".
Despite being written after the episode, this episode takes before "The Evillustrator" as Lady Wifi appears in Nathaniel's dream along with Stormy Weather.

title: Lady Wifi
text:
Lady Wifi - Trivia
At the end of the episode, when Marinette and Tikki discuss secret-keeping and being a superhero at the balcony, there's a significant difference between the English and French versions. In the former, Marinette is seemingly considering telling Cat Noir her secret identity, while in the latter, it's Alya who she's struggling to lie to.
This is one of Carrie Keranen's favorite episodes, along with "The Pharaoh".
The building on which Ladybug and Cat Noir stand when they stakeout Le Grand Paris is the Agreste mansion.
This is the first time a holder gets separated from their Miraculous, as Cat Noir drops his ring and reverts back to normal.
Plagg did not disappear when the Cat Miraculous fell off of Adrien's hand because he did not want Plagg to leave, nor did he purposefully remove his Miraculous.
While Alya is being akumatized, Hawk Moth's theme when the window door opens plays and is heard low pitched.

title: Lady Wifi
text:
Lady Wifi - Trivia
When Lady Wifi locked Ladybug's hands, she wanted to take off her mask but could not. However, neither she or Hawk Moth even considered removing Ladybug's earrings, which she could have done. If Lady Wifi had done so, Ladybug's true identity would have been revealed to Hawk Moth and all of Paris.
Unknown to her and against her will in a sense, Alya nearly sold out her best friend, let alone all of Paris and possibly the world's best hope to be free from Hawk Moth's tyranny just to know the truth.
In "Evolution", when Hawk Moth, as Monarch at that point in time, did not make the same mistake when he time traveled back to that event, and would have succeeded if not for the intervention of a future Ladybug and Cat Noir, as well as Bunnyx.
In this episode, Ladybug uses her only Lucky Charm to rescue Cat Noir, which would not be done again until "Daddycop".
References
A perfume bottle similar to Rose's from "Princess Fragrance" can be seen in Chloé's locker.
In the episode, Lady Wifi uses four icons: Stop, Pause, Lock, and Broadcast. But in "The Puppeteer", she can use one more icon, Fast-Foward (which she uses as a hoverboard).

title: Lady Wifi
text:
Lady Wifi - Trivia
Ladybug makes a joke about Chloé being a copycat. This may be a reference to Théo Barbot.
In the French version, she says that Chloé is an admirer, a bit like Cat Noir.
In the Korean version, she compares Chloé to a cosplayer instead.
Due to Ladybug indirectly mentioning Copycat this episode takes place after the episode of the same name.
In the French version, however, there's no reference to the villain from the episode of the same name.
Allusions
When Alya tries to convince Nino that Chloé is Ladybug, the latter says that if she's a superhero, then he's the Wizard of Oz.
In the French version, he says that he's Hawk Moth.
Lady Wifi going for the mask is a classic trope when someone wants to find out a hero's identity.
The name of the way, Cat Noir was moving is a specialized movement discipline called "quadrobics".
Errors
Adrien's and Cat Noir's hair is miscolored dirty blonde throughout most of the episode.
When Alya is in class without Marinette, Adrien is present, even though he is supposed to be with Ladybug fighting an Akumatized villain.
At the beginning of the episode, Max is not wearing his glasses.
However, when he's seen running away from the classroom, he has them on.

title: Lady Wifi
text:
Lady Wifi - Trivia
When the camera first panned over Marinette's tablet in the beginning of the episode, it was on. When the camera switched, it was off.
When the camera zooms Marinette's phone to show low signal indicators, there is an animation glitch of these indicators for a couple of frames.
When the akuma enters Alya's phone, it remains the same and does not become engulfed in purple.
When Alya accepts her akumatization, the sound effect for the akuma light mask can be heard a second time, despite the mask already appearing on her face.
Although it's around ten in the morning when Marinette and Adrien transform, when they meet in front of Le Grand Paris, it's almost dark.
This is most likely due to them staking out Le Grand Paris after a series of several hours.
When Cat Noir spies on Chloé, the Eiffel Tower is visible behind Le Grand Paris, but when Ladybug shows up, it is behind her instead. The tower is supposed to be behind Ladybug the entire time because the Tower is behind the Agreste mansion.
Also, in the same scene, when Cat Noir first zooms in on Chloé, Chloé's hair is brown. But when she changes her pose, her hair turns back into her original color. This happens a second time too.

title: Lady Wifi
text:
Lady Wifi - Trivia
When Chloé is in her room surprised by Lady Wifi, her hair is miscolored dirty blonde for a while.
Later, when Cat Noir and Ladybug enter the restaurant, this error occurs again.

After Cat Noir spies on Chloé, Ladybug appears. When Cat Noir looks at Ladybug, he has two staffs: in his hand and on his back.

When the smoke comes out of the service elevator, two microwaves are seen next to it, even though they weren't there when Ladybug grabbed the first one.
The picture that Marinette and Alya take together right before the end card has Le Grand Paris in the background. Normally, this would be fine, but the angle is impossible from where they're standing, which is Marinette's balcony.
At the beginning of the scene where Chloé comes into the school, it is morning. It's then mid-day in the next shot. Two shots later, it looks like morning again.
During the scene where Alya tries to find out who Ladybug is, Sabrina's hair turned red.

text:
Ladyblog (website) - Intro
The Ladyblog is a blog created by Alya Césaire about Ladybug.
In "Deflagration", Alya temporarily changes the name of the blog to Scarablog after she became the temporary Scarabella when Marinette renounces her Miraculous.

title: Ladyblog (website)
text:
Ladyblog (website) - Features
On the blog, Alya uploads information about Ladybug, including, but not limited to, the traditional cultural symbolism of ladybugs, theories on Ladybug's origin and the source of her powers, interviews from people who have interacted with Ladybug in various contexts, and attempts to discover Ladybug's secret identity. The Ladyblog can also provide other, unrelated information and it can mess with Ladybug’s work, as shown in The Pharaoh and Feast.
After finding out that Marinette is Ladybug, Alya's content on the blog changes and now focuses on not finding her secret identity, as well as talking about other superheroes.

title: Ladyblog (website)
text:
Ladyblog (website) - Trivia
Marinette and Adrien visit the Ladyblog, as seen in "The Pharaoh", where they watch a video of Alya hypothesizing that Ladybug could be a teenager because of a history book she dropped, and in "Oblivio", where they're looking at the photo of Ladybug and Cat Noir kissing.
The name of the blog itself is a portmenteau of the words "ladybug" and "blog".
It is unknown if Alya is paid to be a blogger, or does it as a hobby.
The webisode "Ladyblog" is focused on the Ladyblog, with Alya describing in detail some of the things she has to do to run the blog.
Despite the fact that the Ladyblog focuses on Ladybug, Alya sometimes streams unrelated things, like the fashion show in "Queen Wasp".
Not all of the videos uploaded to the Ladyblog are true and accurate, as Alya uploads an interview where Lila talks about being saved by Ladybug in "Volpina" which, unbeknownst to Alya, is a lie.
This is painfully ironic, considering Alya's dislike of sharing lies and false information.
The Ladyblog logo is based off an old version of the series logo.
Whenever a date for the day of the episode is shown on the Ladyblog, it's always May 21.

title: Ladyblog (website)
text:
Ladyblog (website) - Trivia
In "Gang of Secrets" at the end of the episode, Marinette reveals that she is Ladybug to Alya, therefore, Alya now has one of these goals done.
