title: LadyLion
text:
LadyLion - Intro
is an upcoming character who would appear in Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir.
As of 2024, it's currently unconfirmed if LadyLion is still planned to appear in the Miraculous Ladybug franchise since she's going to have a feature film.

title: LadyLion
text:
LadyLion - Appearance
Physical Appearance
She has black skin with pink lips.
As LadyLion
She wears a white skintight suit with black and gold bands around her ankles and wrists along with two black and golden bands her waist. Including three golden bands around her neck, along with white mask with three black diamond markings above it her hair is pure white pulled into a floor length ponytail with braids that have little black and gold hair bands tied at the ends with white cat ears with black and gold accents.

title: LadyLion
text:
LadyLion - Trivia
The character was first introduced on November 10, 2020 by Jeremy Zag. On an Instagram caption, he wrote "The real chief of the jungle is not a king but a Queen! LadyLion. You will meet her in the Miraculous adventures! in Africa!!!". This hinted that LadyLion is going to be a Miraculous Ladybug character.
On April 17, 2021, it was announced via a Licensing Russia panel that LadyLion would appear in "Miraculous Dakar" and her own television series would served as a spin-off for the special.
As of June 2022, it was confirmed that LadyLion would be in a feature film that is going to be a co-production between ZAG Animation Studios and Cross Creek Pictures. However, it's currently unknown if the film is connected with "Miraculous Dakar" and the spin-off series, or if it's a retool that is separated from the Miraculous Ladybug franchise.
She is the second known African superhero following Mudekudeku.
She also bears similarities to the heroes the White Tiger and Black Panther from Marvel Comics.
Like the Black Panther, she is too is of royalty.
They both live Africa as the rulers/protectors of their kingdoms.
All three of their costumes are based off of rare or endangered animals.

title: Kwami cage
text:
Kwami cage - Intro
The  was a set of technological cages that Monarch used to hold the Kwamis after creating the Alliance rings.
Monarch could make any one of the fishbowl-like cages levitate toward him by speaking the Kwami's name and speaking the phrase: "your power is now mine". He could also call multiple cages at once by speaking the names of all the Kwamis he wants to bring forward and speaking the phrase: "your powers are now mine". He could also then plug the corresponding Miraculous ring into the Miraculous symbol at the base of the Kwami's cage, causing the Kwami to be absorbed into the ring. Once an akumatized villain has been defeated, the Kwami would return to its cage with its energy used up and in need of food.
The cages were also able to dispense food for Kwamis when Monarch snaps his fingers.

title: Kwami cage
text:
Kwami cage - Intro
In "Miraculous London", after Gabriel's sacrifice and death, Marinette, with the help of a reformed Nathalie, managed to find the Kwamis that were held captive and trapped in the cages in Gabriel's lair. Once Nathalie released the Kwamis, Marinette destroyed the cages using Cat Noir's Miraculous by Cataclysm, freeing them from their prison, ensuring that they didn't fall into the wrong hands and destroying any evidence of Gabriel having been Monarch.

title: Kwami cage
text:
Kwami cage - Appearance
The cage array was dark silver, large and circular, divided into three rings. There were 18 floating fishbowl-like cages within these rings; 8 in the outer ring, 8 in the middle ring, and 2 in the center. The holes at left, right, top and bottom resemble a butterfly. At the base of each cage is a platform with the corresponding Kwami's Miraculous symbol on the front.

title: Kwami cage
text:
Kwami cage - Features
The cages were designed to contain the Kwami. Special tubes connected to each cell allowed Monarch to drain the Kwamis' energy using a remote control. These tubes also created a certain protection and didn't allow the Kwami to get free. As seen in "Miraculous London", the device counted Nathalie's prints, after which all the tubes were disconnected.

title: Kwami cage
text:
Kwami cage - Trivia
The two cages in the inner ring were empty, as were those in the "outer ring, bottom half, right side, lower space" and the "middle ring, top half, left side, lower space." If these cages were not merely for the sake of symmetry, they were likely reserved for Tikki, Plagg, Duusu, and Fluff, should Monarch ever captured their Miraculouses.
It's unclear why the Kwamis couldn't phase through the glass of the cages.
Given that the Kwamis captured by Kwamibuster couldn't phase through the canister of her vacuum cleaner due to being empowered by magic, it's possible that the cages were imbued with a mix of technology and magic to prevent the Kwamis from escaping. Alternatively, it could simply be because Monarch commanded them not to escape.
In "Pretension", the cages were briefly connected to a device to unsuccessfully try to reduce Gabriel's Cataclysm wound with the Kwamis' energy.

title: Kwamis/Movie
text:
Kwamis/Movie - Intro
Kwamis are the deuteragonistic faction of Ladybug & Cat Noir: The Movie. They are divine, spirit-like beings who give certain powers to people with Miraculouses, transforming them into animal-themed super-powered beings.

title: Kwamis/Movie
text:
Kwamis/Movie - Appearance
Generally, kwamis are small, being around 10 centimeters (4 inches) in height, with large heads, big eyes, tails in different sizes, and tiny bodies. They have arms and legs, and unlike their show counterparts, they don't lack fingers and toes and are capable of grabbing things. The animal theme that they display is reflected in their Miraculous.
They can also take on the real appearances of the animals that reflect their Miraculouses.

title: Kwamis/Movie
text:
Kwamis/Movie - Abilities
Just like their original counterparts the kwamis can fly and levitate as well as have great amounts of strength for their size as Tikki was able to pull Marinette to a mirror just by her finger. They even have intangibility allowing them to pass through solid matter. They also can control their Miraculouses while laying dormant inside. But they can also transform into their connected Miraculous and visa versa as shown by Tikki. The kwamis also have the ability to transform into the animals their connected Miraculous are named after such as Tikki transforming into an actual ladybug and Plagg into an actual cat.
Miraculous Transformation
Just like their original counterparts the kwamis can also enact the miraculous transformations of their owners either waiting for them to say transformation words but unlike original counterparts they can do and undo it themselves by entering their wielder's hearts or leaving them. They can also speak with their owners while transformed or even if their miraculous are taken by someone else such as Tikki being able to communicate with Marinette despite being taken by Hawk Moth.

title: Kwamis/Movie
text:
Kwamis/Movie - Weaknesses
Despite them having a greater influence while in their jewels their intangibility doesn't pass to their jewels as Tikki and Plagg went under the door in Master Fu instead of through it.

title: Kwamis/Movie
text:
Kwamis/Movie - Trivia
Unlike their TV series counterpart, Kwami can stick their heads out of their Miraculous.
As mentioned above how the kwamis do it is similar to ghost/spirit possession to some level but the holders are still in control of their actions.

title: Lady Chaos
text:
Lady Chaos - Intro
"" is a season 6 episode of the series Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. Based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 22nd written and produced episode of season 6. It is also the 153rd written and produced episode of the series overall.

title: Lady Chaos
text:
Lady Chaos - Synopsis
Gloob
When Adrien decides to produce a documentary about his father, Gabriel Agreste, Marinette does her best to protect his secrets.
Disney Channel
When Adrien decides to make a documentary about his father Gabriel Agreste, Marinette does her best to protect his secrets.
Disney+
Adrien decides to make a documentary about his father.

title: Lady Chaos
text:
Lady Chaos - Plot
As the episode opens, Adrien is with Dr. Psiquat, discussing his issues with his father, Gabriel, and how he was always controlling Adrien's life, not letting him go to school or have any friends, and even refusing to let Adrien be with Marinette. It is as Adrien is discussing this, a image is shown of Cat Noir destroying the statue of Gabriel with Cataclysm, due to his own contempt for his father. Dr. Psiquat suggests comparing Adrien's feelings to a puzzle to help him sort through it.

title: Lady Chaos
text:
Lady Chaos - Plot
Later, Adrien wants to do a documentary about his father, but when Marinette learns of this, she starts to panic and speaks privately to Nathalie about it. As Marinette goes into a tirade about the cover story she had to spin about Gabriel sacrificing himself to stop Monarch and what will happen if Nathalie tells the truth to Adrien, Nathalie assures Marinette that she knows what to say to keep the truth buried. After Nathalie is interviewed by Adrien and Nino and tells her details about Gabriel, despite Adrien's contempt about his father's change in personality to being cold and distant, Adrien still wants to interview people, and suggests speaking to Tomoe Tsurugi. Marinette excuses herself to get some ice cream, allowing her to go see Tomoe herself as Cosmobug to warn her of Adrien coming to interview her about Gabriel and reminding her of the circumstances regarding how Ladybug and Kagami lied to keep Tomoe from being incarcerated for the rest of her life. Tomoe agrees to maintain the ruse and only tell Adrien of how Monarch blackmailed her and Gabriel in working for him to protect Adrien and Kagami.

title: Lady Chaos
text:
Lady Chaos - Plot
After the interview with Tomoe, Adrien then suggests speaking to his aunt, Lady Amélie Graham de Vanily, to get more details about his dad. Again, panicking at the thought of Amélie telling Adrien the truth, Marinette excuses herself, especially after learning that Amélie is in Paris looking for a new apartment so she and Felix can be closer to Adrien.
Amélie is about to sign the deed for a new apartment when another potential tenant arrives just in time to sign the deed instead, despite being late.
And the estate agent easily hands over the deed after it is learned that pets are forbidden in the building.
Amélie is very upset, but then gets Marinette's call asking for help.
Despite her own contempt for Gabriel and what he did to ruin her sister Émilie's life, Amélie agrees to the interview, but Marinette has to help her remember not to say anything that would reveal the truth about Gabriel to Adrien, much to Amélie's chagrin as she tries to restrain herself from telling the truth to Adrien.
Thankfully, she manages to make it through without telling the truth, and Marinette excuses herself, Adrien, and Nino.

title: Lady Chaos
text:
Lady Chaos - Plot
Nevertheless, Adrien now wants to ask Ladybug about his father's final moments, and Marinette excuses herself to go into the bathroom, where she calls Alya and pleads with her to become Rena Rouge and use an illusion of Ladybug to tell Adrien the cover story of what she told the world.
Alya is hesitant, but agrees to do it.
Nino also becomes Carapace to send Ladybug a voicemail through the Miraculous Call to let her know of Adrien's request.
Meanwhile, when Amélie discovers the tenant who screwed her out of a new apartment has a Dalmatian, despite the "no pets allowed" rule, realizing she got duped out of the apartment by a lie about the "no pets" thing, she becomes frustrated, allowing Chrysalis to infect Amélie's stamper with an Ultrakuma and convince her to be akumatized into Lady Chaos. Using her power, Lady Chaos turns anyone who enters her dome she surrounded herself with into her agents to spread chaos through Paris, with the estate agent being her first victim, and as she infects more people, her power, and her dome, grow.

title: Lady Chaos
text:
Lady Chaos - Plot
In the meantime, Rena Rouge arrives on a roof across from the Agreste mansion and sends her Ladybug illusion to speak to Adrien. With Rena speaking simultaneously with her illusion, the Ladybug illusion tells Adrien of his father's final moments before he used Gimmi and the Ultimate Miraculous Absolute Power, with his final request being an apology to Adrien for his behavior and that he loves him. This appears to put Adrien very much at ease, and just in time, as Rena spots Lady Chaos' attack, and has her Ladybug illusion explain that duty calls before leaving. Nino also becomes Carapace to go lend a hand, and Marinette excuses herself to leave the mansion, find an alley, and after talking with Tikki, transform into Ladybug. Adrien decides to finish editing the footage later as he has Plagg transform him into Cat Noir. Meeting up with Rena Rouge, Ladybug thanks her for the help, and though Rena tells her she wasn't comfortable lying to Adrien and wants Ladybug to promise to never make her do that, she nevertheless tells Ladybug they are good as they head to join Cat Noir and Carapace to deal with Lady Chaos.

title: Lady Chaos
text:
Lady Chaos - Plot
As Lady Chaos continues her rampage, Roger attempts to stop her with a roadblock of several police cruisers, but once the roadblock is engulfed in Lady Chaos' dome, Roger and his fellow lawmen are turned into more of Lady Chaos' minions and attempt to stop several civilians from fleeing so they can join their ranks by moving their roadblock to cut them off. Carapace arrives to save the civvies with Shell-ter, which also protects him and the civvies from when they enter Lady Chaos' dome, allowing Carapace to send video footage of Lady Chaos to Ladybug, Cat Noir, and Rena Rouge. After having Carapace get out of the dome with the civvies and then have them run to safety as soon as he lowers his Shell-ter, Ladybug summons a Lucky Charm of a remote-controlled toy car, and thanks to her Lucky Vision, has Cat Noir and Carapace hand her Cat Noir's belt and Carapace's camera for her to use on the RC car to investigate the dome without putting themselves at risk of becoming more of Lady Chaos' minions.

title: Lady Chaos
text:
Lady Chaos - Plot
Once the RC car shows them what they needed, while Ladybug restrains Lady Chaos with her Yo-yo by tying it around two trees and Lady Chaos' ankle to immobilize her, Cat Noir, protected by Carapace's Shell-ter and with Rena Rouge providing decoys with Mirage, enters the dome to attack Lady Chaos and destroy her scepter with Cataclysm.
Once close enough, despite the danger, Carapace lowers the Shell-ter and Rena dispels her Mirage, and although Cat Noir is then affected by the dome, he manages to Cataclysm the scepter and free the Ultrakuma.
After the dome shatters and Lady Chaos is reverted back into Amélie, unfortunately, still under Lady Chaos' effects, Cat Noir prepares a massive Cataclysm that could destroy the city, if not the planet.
Carapace and Rena frantically shout for Ladybug to use her Miraculous Ladybug before it's too late, and retrieving her Lucky Charm, she quickly does, snapping Cat Noir back to his senses upon being freed of the spell, who immediately powers down his attack while having a look of mortified shock at what he almost did on his face.

title: Lady Chaos
text:
Lady Chaos - Plot
Ladybug then sees to capturing and purifying the Ultrakuma, before then going to talk to Amélie with Cat Noir, Rena Rouge, and Carapace, offering her a Magical Charm and words of wisdom before sharing a "Pound It!" with her fellow Miraculers.
Later, back at the Agreste mansion, after reviewing the footage, Adrien asks Marinette to draw a picture of his father smiling since all the photos he still has of Gabriel are him with that stern, unemotional scowl on his face. Marinette agrees, but back at her house, as she hesitates to start on the drawing, despite Tikki's encouraging words about her relationship with Adrien, it is clear the guilt of keeping the truth from Adrien is still gnawing at Marinette.
In the stinger, Amélie finds a new apartment for her and Felix to be closer to Adrien that overlooks the Eiffel Tower, and they both agree that they must be there for Adrien when he learns the real truth about his father and his evil acts as Hawk Moth/Shadow Moth/Monarch so they can support him when that time comes. She also mentions that Félix is lucky Kagami's mother isn't incarcerated for her involvement with Monarch.

title: Lady Chaos
text:
Lady Chaos - Plot developments
Adrien has a therapy session with Dr. Psiquat, after his first session in "Wreckless Driver".
Adrien's suspicion about Gabriel sacrificing himself to defeat Monarch first appeared in "Mister Agreste", and briefly reappeared in "Wrecklees Driver".
During his session, it is revealed that Adrien, as Cat Noir, vandalized the statue of Gabriel Agreste because he saw him as a villain more than a hero (which he was right about), and hid the truth from Ladybug.
This fact had been mentioned back in "Mister Agreste", where Théo Barbot tried to remake the statue, but bigger.
Cat Noir can be seen in his old hero suit, indicating the destruction of the statue happened sometime before the events of season 6.
To discover more about his father and reconcile the image of the selfless Gabriel who sacrificed himself with the harsh and cold father he knew, Adrien helped by Nino and (supposedly) Marinette, interviewed people who knew Gabriel well, such as Nathalie, Tomoe Tsurugi and his aunt, Amelie, as well as Ladybug, who was there when Gabriel sacrificed himself.

title: Lady Chaos
text:
Lady Chaos - Plot developments
Nathalie spoke about a good version of Gabriel that existed before the start of the series (supposedly before Émilie became sick) while Amelie, in turn, remembers Gabriel as selfish and cold form the start (but was convinced to lie by Marinette).
Upon hearing Adrien's plan, Marinette desperately tries to circumvent his efforts to keep him from finding out the truth about Gabriel.
She talked with Nathalie, Tomoe (as Ladybug) and Amelie to make sure they talk about a good, selfless Gabriel to make sure their statements match Ladybug's lie.
During her talk with Nathalie, Marinette rants about Gabriel's actions during the first five seasons.
During Marinette's monologue, three of the heroes' fights against Monarch are shown. Two of the drawings reference Season 5 episodes ("Destruction" and "Deflagration"), while the third one depicts Cat Noir fighting Monarch in his second form, which was never actually seen in the show.
During her rant to Nathalie, Marinette criticizes Gabriel's pancakes again, after herself in "Pretension", Adrien in "Collusion" and "Mister Agreste" and Nathalie in "Climatiqueen".

title: Lady Chaos
text:
Lady Chaos - Plot developments
When confronting Tomoe, she asks Ladybug how she knew about Adrien's documentary, implying she is starting to believe Chrysalis' theory in "Vampigami" that she might be Marinette.
As Marinette personally contacted Amélie by phone and Amélie either recognized Marinette's number or voice, it is shown that the two got acquainted off-screen sometime before this episode, as they never had any proper interactions outside Ladybug (and Cat Noir) questioning her about Felix' whereabouts in "Multiplication".
This probably happened at the pool party briefly seen in "Re-creation".
She tries to stop Adrien from talking to more people every time he finishes an interview and interrupts and corrects Tomoe's and Amelie's statements to make them align with her lie about Gabriel/Monarch.
She makes Alya/Rena Rouage create a Ladybug illusion that tells him Gabriel did sacrifice himself to stop Monarch and and that he loved Adrien.
Alya complies, but protests that she does not like to lie; this, along with her and Amelie's dislike of liars, is a callback to "Revelator".

title: Lady Chaos
text:
Lady Chaos - Plot developments
However, Alya quickly forgives Marinette for making her do it, likely because what she told her to do was not (in her perspective) technically a lie, as, while she doesn't know about the whole story of Gabriel, she was just retelling what Marinette told her, but in a way that would make Gabriel look more of a saint than what he really was.
When she once learned of Gabriel's identity as Monarch in "Revelator", she was furious and was unsure of keeping the secret as she doesn't like lying, resulting in Cat Noir using Miraculous Cat Noir to erase her memories.
Marinette/Ladybug reacting with guilt during these situations also implies she remembers, and is still affected by, Alya's reaction in "Revelator".
While Marinette acts like this mostly to make Adrien happy, she also doing it because she can't bear to lose him if he founds the truth, and the resulting sadness and despair will cause her to be akumatized again; she realized this after she was first akumatized in "Heartfixer".
Amélie and Félix move to an apartment in Paris to be closer to Adrien.

title: Lady Chaos
text:
Lady Chaos - Plot developments
This also confirms Amélie not only knows that Gabriel was Monarch, something that was already implied in "Emotion", but also that Tomoe was his accomplice. Likewise, since she already knows that her son is a sentimonster, she also knows Adrien is one as well.
This could potentially be the reason why Amélie didn't like Gabriel at all. Despite knowing he loved her sister, she acknowledges him as the reason behind her death and suffering, especially after he never respected her decision to stop looking for a cure for her condition and was never there for her and their son.
Amélie and Félix moved to Paris because once Gabriel's secret is revealed and Tomoe is exposed, the two will provide emotional support for Adrien once he knows the truth.
Félix's reason for wanting to move to Paris, besides to be close to his cousin, is also to deal with the major obstacle of his relationship with Kagami: the literal distance between them. With he now living in Paris, he and Kagami no longer need to meet midway between Paris and London. He can also be a more active member of the Miraculers.
But to lend Marinette/Ladybug his support too, for not helping her any sooner.

title: Lady Chaos
text:
Lady Chaos - Plot developments
However, it is unknown if Amélie knows Marinette is Ladybug. Kagami told Félix, but it is not known if Félix told his mother. Additionally, during the interaction between her and Marinette, Amélie didn't show a clue that she knows her identity.
This continues Felix's arc starting from "Emotion": that he is on the next step to fixing what his family had done wrong, knowing like Marinette in "Revelator", that Gabriel's secrets will come to light soon.

title: Lady Chaos
text:
Lady Chaos - Trivia
Flashbacks from "Multiplication" are seen, redone in the new style with new models.
Interestingly, at the unveiling ceremony for the Alliance rings, Adrien is shown in his all-white outfit, unlike in the original episode where he wore his everyday outfit.
This is the second episode of season 6 not to have an end card. Instead, the last shot only focuses on Marinette's blank page.
Tomoe Tsurugi is revealed to be lactose intolerant.
However, it's unknown if this is true or if she said that just to refuse Marinette's offering.
At the beginning of Amélie's akumatization, Chrysalis doesn't say her usual "Forgive my intrusion".
At one point of the sequence, she also looks directly into the audience, breaking the fourth wall.
Amélie becomes the first character introduced in the show's first saga to be akumatized for the first time in the second saga.

title: Lady Chaos
text:
Lady Chaos - Trivia
In the original version of the episode, the frog jigsaw puzzle from Adrien's therapy session featured an image seemingly created using generative AI, causing criticism from fans and Thomas Astruc himself. When the episode was released by TF1 in France two weeks later, the image was changed. The new version has been used by other TV channels and is also featured in the clips uploaded by the official YouTube channels.
Despite this, the original version of the image was kept on Disney+, similarly to what had previously happened with episodes like "Ephemeral" and "Sublimation".
During Amélie's interview, the sounds she makes by tapping her stamper seem to spell out "colere" in Morse code, which means "anger" in French.
References
During his therapy session, Adrien mentions Gabriel's behavior towards him during the first 5 seasons, as well as Gabriel's constant travels away from home; Gabriel (along with Nathalie) was seen returning from one such trip and immediately ignoring Adrien in a flashback at the end of "Werepapas".

title: Lady Chaos
text:
Lady Chaos - Trivia
Amelie's defeat as Lady Chaos was similar to Kagami's defeat as the titular villain in "Lies": being spied on with a machine that is unaffected by her magical sphere and requiring Cat Noir to be affected for the akumatized object to be broken.
Ironically, both villain are the two closest women to Felix, his mother and his girlfriend.
Cat Noir charging his Cataclysm when under Lady Chaos' influence resembles what he did in an alternate future in "Cat Blanc" as well as when Cataclysm was used by Claw Noir in "Miraculous Paris".
Errors
In the scene where Cosmobug confronts Tomoe, her yo-yo does not have glowing white spots and instead appears as Ladybug's regular yo-yo.
In the second close-up of Carapace in the chaos zone, the lighting is different compared to the first close-up.
This was corrected in the French airing of the episode.
When Lady Chaos shouts at Cat Noir to stay away, her lips don't move.

title: Lady Chaos/Transcript
text:
Lady Chaos/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: When I was a child, my father was always traveling. He didn't care about any of my interests, he decided them all for me. Piano, Chinese lessons, fencing... ('looks down in sadness)
Dr. Psiquat: I'm listening, Adrien. You can tell me anything you want.
Adrien: I wasn't allowed to go to school, I wasn't allowed to have any friends. And when I was finally allowed to go to school, he didn't want me to be in love with Marinette.
(Background visuals show Gabriel and Adrien in the Agreste mansion on one side, while the other side shows Marinette walking sadly down the stairs outside with Adrien's hand leaving hers, just like in Pretension.)
Adrien: The only time he actually listened to me was when I told him I no longer wanted to be a model.
(Visuals change to show Adrien confronting Gabriel in his study, as seen in Multiplication.)
Adrien: The truth is he pretended to agree before digitizing me in order to keep using my image, without any concern for my feelings.
(Visuals now show Gabriel watching Adrien get scanned in the Tsurugi Labs, and Adrien looking sadly at his father during the Alliance advertisement event, both from the episode Multiplication.)

title: Lady Chaos/Transcript
text:
Lady Chaos/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: And now everyone says that he's saved Paris, (The original Gabriel statue is visualized.) that he sacrificed himself to help Ladybug defeat the super villain, Monarch. Except I cannot believe that he suddenly became this good man, and a hero at that...
(Visuals now show Cat Noir using his Cataclysm on the statue, completely destroying it.)
(Dr. Psiquat looks down sadly, then spots something and smiles again, bringing a table with a puzzle of a frog closer to Adrien that has one piece missing.)
Dr. Psiquat: Hmm. Imagine a jigsaw puzzle depicting your father. If I understand correctly, it's like you can't assemble all of the pieces. Maybe because you're missing some? Once you have all the pieces, you'll be able to put together a picture of your father that'll make sense to you.
Adrien: Yeah, perhaps... (looks down in sadness)
[ Theme Song ]
Marinette: Woah, woah, woah, wait a sec. You want to make a documentary about your father? But... why?

title: Lady Chaos/Transcript
text:
Lady Chaos/Transcript - Intro
Nino: Because it's awesome, duh! (walks over to Adrien and puts a hand on his shoulder) It's going to help Adrien figure out how the man who wouldn't let his son celebrate his own b-day with anyone could also be the surprise hero who saved Paris, 'cause that's weird, right?
Marinette: Uh... yes (nervous laughter) it's weird.
Nino: Get over here, dude. (takes out his phone and starts recording him and Adrien while putting on a dramatic deep voice) In search of the real Gabriel, a documentary by Adrien Agreste and Nino Lahiffe. Coming soon! (stops recording) Anndd... post!
Adrien: You see, Marinette? I want to make the documentary because I'd like to be able to finally see my father the same way other people did, those who knew him and say that he was kind and altruistic, that he was a hero.
Marinette: Yeah, you just got to find those people if they exist... I mean of course they exist somewhere!
Adrien: We could ask Nathalie to start. (Marinette looks nervous at that suggestion) She's known my father for a long time, even before I was born.

title: Lady Chaos/Transcript
text:
Lady Chaos/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Of course! Nathalie is 'exactly' the kind of person who'd think your father was kind, altruistic, and heroic! I'll go tell her and be her stylist. You’ve got to look the part when you're being featured in a documentary!
Nino: Good idea!
Adrien: Thank you, Marinette.
(Marinette shuts the door, and as soon as she's out of sight, starts panicking.)
Marinette: Ahh!
Marinette: This is a disaster, Nathalie! Adrien's going to ask you to say positive stuff about his father, and you'll have nothing to say!!!
Nathalie: Calm down, Marinette.
Marinette: What are you going to do? He was a horrible person! You can't tell him the truth and be all like, (putting on a dramatic voice narration) "Well Adrien, your father couldn't stand to lose your mother, so like in a fairytale, he kept her suspended in a glass case while he looked for a magic spell to bring her back to life! And do you want to know what your perfect father did next?"
(Visuals behind her show drawn art of Gabriel crying at an unconscious Émilie that changes to Gabriel at the glass case with Émilie inside and butterflies around them. The visuals then change to show Hawk Moth.)

title: Lady Chaos/Transcript
text:
Lady Chaos/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: "He thought 'Hey, what if I used my miraculous to become supervillain Monarch and terrorize Paris?' All so he could seize the magic jewels of the black cat and the ladybug and make a wish to bring his wife back to life! Such a kind and doting daddy-kins."
(Visuals show Hawk Moth, and then Monarch, in various scenarios battling Ladybug and Cat Noir, including when he got cataclysmed by Cat Noir in Destruction.)
Marinette: "You see, Adrien, one could've thought that being defeated over and over again by Ladybug and Cat Noir would've made your father see reason, but NOOOOOO!"
(Visuals show Monarch and Tomoe with all of the Miraculized victims as Marinette describes the events of "Conformation".)
Marinette: "He became even more obsessed and akumatized the entire world with help from his evil accomplice Ms. Tsurugi!"
(Drawn visuals of Bug Noire tying her yo-yo around a cataclysmed Gabriel's foot, just like in "Re-creation".)
Marinette: "And when Ladybug managed to defeat him once more, do you think he thought: (Visuals show Adrien and Gabriel walking happily in the sunset.) 'All things considered, I'd rather live a quiet life and take care of you my son?' NUH-UH!"

title: Lady Chaos/Transcript
text:
Lady Chaos/Transcript - Intro
(Visuals show Gabriel paralyzing Marinette with Venom and taking the ladybug and black cat miraculous from her)
Marinette: "He stole the miraculous from Ladybug and actually made his wish!"
(Visuals show Gabriel and Émilie floating in the air together in the The Crypt.)
Marinette: "He wished to make off with his wife and left us behind with all his secrets!"
(Visuals show the scene of Gabriel talking to Marinette while in front of Gimmi.)
Marinette: "'Okay, Marinette, Adrien couldn't handle to know the truth, so be a dear and make sure that he never finds out that I was the big baddie and that he only remembers me as the best great dad ever.'"
(Visuals show Ladybug giving a statement in front of a bunch of reporters, like in Miraculous London.)
Marinette: "Lucky for him, Marinette is Ladybug, so she figured everything out and came up with a MASSIVE LIE that Gabriel sacrificed himself in order to defeat Monarch (Visuals show Gabriel fighting Monarch) WHEN THAT'S NOT THE TRUTH AT ALL!" (breathing heavy) And his pancakes were bland, too.
Nathalie: You're right, we're not going to say any of that.

title: Lady Chaos/Transcript
text:
Lady Chaos/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: But if you don't say something he'll go and ask other people, and if he asks other people someone might say something that'll lead him to figure out that we lied to him!
Nathalie: Marinette, I know it's hard to imagine, but there has been a good version of Gabriel Agreste. I can tell him about that Gabriel, maybe it'll be enough to appease Adrien.
(Marinette still looks worried.)

title: Lady Chaos/Transcript
text:
Lady Chaos/Transcript - Intro
Nathalie: When your father met your mother, they fell madly in love. Their deepest wish was to have a child, so when you came along, their happiness was complete. (Marinette looks over at Adrien) For several months it was... pure bliss. But sometime later your mother started feeling tired, her heart grew weak. Your parents saw the best doctors, but none could find an explanation for her ailment or a solution to cure her. Gabriel however wasn't one to submit passively to his fate, he asked me to travel the world with him in search of a remedy of any kind. Each travel was a heartbreak to him, for long periods of time he was leaving behind his wife and son, the two people he loved more than anything in the world, (Marinette looks over at Adrien again) but he was willing to do anything in order to reclaim the happiness of those early days.
Adrien:(sadly) Except all that was for nothing. Mom left us anyway. My father became icy, and I grew up alone in solitude. (Marinette and Nathalie give each other a sad look.)
Nathalie: Your father may not have made all the right decisions, but one thing is for sure, he was ready to do anything out of love.

title: Lady Chaos/Transcript
text:
Lady Chaos/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Well, there you go! A great documentary that's allowed you to discover another facet of your father (stands up and walks around the mattress to be in front of it) and a super positive one too, right? (she awkwardly laughs and then closes the laptop) Anyway, what should we do now? Let's do something nice.
Adrien: I think I'd like to speak to Ms. Tsurugi.
Marinette: That's not exactly what I meant by 'something nice.'
Adrien: Nathalie's words about my father made me feel better. Ms. Tsurugi also knew him, they worked together. She can tell me more about his good side.
Nino: Of course, awesome!
Marinette: Yes! Great idea! (nervous laugh)
Adrien: Shall we go now? (he and Nino stand up)
Marinette: Okay! But first, we've got to recharge our batteries. (starts walking backwards to the door) I don't know about you but that interview's worn me out. You know what? I'm going to go uh... get some ice cream! I'll meet you guys at Ms. Tsurugi's, okay? See yaaa!
(She shuts the door, looking exhausted and panicked when no one sees her.)
Cosmobug: (sternly) Adrien Agreste and his friends are coming to you with questions about Gabriel's past.
Tomoe: And how do you, Ladybug, know this?

title: Lady Chaos/Transcript
text:
Lady Chaos/Transcript - Intro
(Cosmobug pulls out her yo-yo to show the recording of Adrien and Nino from earlier.)
Nino (recording): In search of the real Gabriel, a documentary by Adrien Agreste and Nino Lahiffe. Coming soon!
Cosmobug: You know what you have to do?
Tomoe: I don't appreciate being told what to say.
Cosmobug: Maybe. But if you tell him that Gabriel was Monarch, Adrien will figure out that you were his accomplice.
Tomoe: You're an accomplice, too.
Cosmobug: No. I only hid the truth about Gabriel Agreste so that your daughter Kagami wouldn't grow up with an incarcerated mother.(Tomoe is shocked at hearing this.)
Tomoe: (closes her laptop) Don't worry, Ladybug. I can be convincing.
(Cosmobug flies away)
(Cuts to a later time, where Tomoe is now being recorded by Nino's phone in her office as Adrien and Nino are interviewing her.)
Tomoe: And that's why Monarch—
(Marinette suddenly bursts through the door, holding 3 ice creams in her hand. Nino stops the recording.)
Marinette: Who wants ice creaaaammmm?
Nino: Cut!
Marinette: Oops, sorry, my bad. (slight chuckle as she gives Adrien two of the ice creams)
Adrien: Thanks, Marinette.
Marinette: (offering Tomoe) Ice cream?
Tomoe: I'm lactose intolerant.

title: Lady Chaos/Transcript
text:
Lady Chaos/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Sorry, sorry! (awkward giggle before sitting down) Don't mind me.
Nino: Okay, let's do this again. Action in 3, 2,...
(Marinette suddenly interrupts him by loudly slurping her ice cream)
Marinette: (sets the ice cream down) Oops! I'm done. I'm not even here.
Nino: Except you are here, Marinette... 3, 2, 1, action! (begins recording again.)
Tomoe: As I was saying, Gabriel and I were being shamelessly blackmailed by Monarch.
Adrien: My father never mentioned this. Why didn't you report this to the police, or warn Ladybug and Cat Noir?
Tomoe: Because Monarch threatened to go after our children if we told anyone.
Marinette: Your father really was a hero, wasn't he? I mean, I feel like he was, am I right Ms. Tsurugi?
Tomoe:(dryly) ...Yes.
Marinette: CUT! Amazing! I think we can drop it— (starts walking near the door)
Adrien: Actually, I think I'd like to interview more people.
Marinette: More people? But... NO! I mean, what more people? (awkward giggle) We interviewed everyone who knew your father well.
Adrien: No, there's also my mother's sister, Amélie.
Marinette: Lady Amélie?
Nino: Duchess of Westches-what's-her-name?
Marinette: But she lives in London.

title: Lady Chaos/Transcript
text:
Lady Chaos/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: Turns out she's in Paris right now. She's looking for a new place to move into.
Marinette: O...kay then! But first I have to... go and thank the ice cream man! I mean he really outdid himself today, phew!
(She shuts the door behind her, facepalming and looking annoyed when no one sees her.)
Realtor: You're lucky the other client who had his eye on the apartment was a no-show, haha. Please sign here, m'lady. (shows her the contract paper)
Amélie: With delight. This apartment will be perfect for me and my little prince.
(But just as she's about to put her stamp on the deed, the other client suddenly barges into the apartment.)
Realtor: Huh?
Mr. López: (breathing heavily) It'll be perfect for me too.
Realtor: Ah, Mr. López, you came after all. I'm afraid this changes things.
Amélie: Of course not, it doesn't change anything. I was here first.
Mr. López: Yes, but I'm here now.
Amélie: But this is unfair! You were late.
Realtor: Certainly, but now we have to decide between the two of you. Let's see, do either of you own a pet?
Amélie: Uh, no. But I'm thinking of getting a cat to keep me company when my son is all grown.
Mr. López: Well, I hate pets.

title: Lady Chaos/Transcript
text:
Lady Chaos/Transcript - Intro
Realtor: Then it's settled. Sorry but pets are not allowed in the building. The apartment is yours Mr. López!
Mr. López: Hahahaha! (signs the deed) Wonderful.
Amélie: (gasps)
Realtor: Good luck with your apartment hunting. (walks away with Mr. López)
Amélie: Wait, I—
(Cuts to Amélie walking out of the building looking sad. She then hears her phone ringing and pulls it out of her purse.)
Amélie: Hm? Marinette?
Amélie: The answer is no, dear Marinette.
Marinette: (gasps)
Amélie: A real Lady never lies. It's a matter of principle.
Marinette: I'm not asking you to lie, Lady Amélie, only to focus on the good things you knew about Gabriel and not to mention the negative ones, even though—
Amélie: Even though he was a horrible man who destroyed my darling sister's life?
Marinette: Look, it'd really be helping Adrien to have a better image of his father.
Amélie: Just because you lie doesn't mean the truth ceases to exist.
Marinette: Please, please! (takes her hands) Adrien really needs this right now. (gives the biggest, pleading, puppy-dog eyes.)
(Amélie sighs, looking to the side, then tilts her head down and closes her eyes.)

title: Lady Chaos/Transcript
text:
Lady Chaos/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: Nathalie told me that dad would do anything out of love, Ms. Tsurugi told me how heroic he was, but you auntie, you knew him at the start when mom first fell in love with dad. What do you remember about him?
Marinette: Like, for example, any qualities?
Amélie: "Qualities"? Hahahaha! (drops her stamp on the table)
(Marinette gives her an angry glare)
Amélie: Oh, um, qualities. Right. Uh. I can't think of any.
Marinette: Any that would accurately sum up his character. (nervous laughter as Adrien smiles at her)
Amélie: Indeed. One could say that he was uh... stubborn as a mule.
Adrien: Stubborn?
Marinette: (looks annoyed but quickly goes back to smiling) Of course! Lady Amélie means that he refused to give up and he was ready to do anything.
Amélie: So ready to do anything that he was ready to abandon you.
Marinette: Abandon you some of the time. (nervous giggle) right, Lady Amélie?
Amélie: (annoyed) You could put it that way, yes...
Adrien: Was there something remarkable about him?
Amélie: You mean like the fact that he was incredibly harsh?
Marinette: On himself!
Amélie: Or that he couldn't be trusted.
Marinette: To keep quiet when it came to condemning injustice.

title: Lady Chaos/Transcript
text:
Lady Chaos/Transcript - Intro
Amélie: (starts continuously knocking on the table with her stamp out of annoyance) Or that the only thing that mattered to him was his own—
Marinette: (puts her hands on Adrien's shoulders) ...family?
(Amélie continues knocking on the table with her stamp, looking up to see Adrien's smile and then lightly throwing the stamp back on the table.)
Amélie: Yes, right. What Marinette says.
Marinette: Well, we won't take up anymore of your time. Thank you! Besides Nino's camera battery is dead.
Nino: No it's not?
Marinette: Yes it is! And we've already got more than enough to make a beautiful documentary (puts the circle used for lighting in Adrien's hands) on the many qualities of Gabriel Agreste sooo... awesome.
Adrien: Thanks, auntie.
Marinette: Thank you for your time, Lady Amélie. (pushes Adrien and Nino out of the café with her) And now off to the editing room we go! You know what they say, edit the movie while it's hot!
Adrien: Wait, Marinette. There's still one person left, the only one who can tell us about my father's final heroic deed.
Marinette: Come on, not Ladybug!
Adrien: Why not?

title: Lady Chaos/Transcript
text:
Lady Chaos/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Hm? I mean, well, 'cause Ladybug's super busy. Besides do you even have her number? How are you supposed to get in touch with her?
Adrien: You're right...
Nino: You two seem to be forgetting that I'm part of her team. I can contact Ladybug if you want.
Adrien: You'd do that?
Nino: (puts an arm around Adrien) Of course, dude.
Adrien: Thanks, Nino!
Marinette: (under her breath) Yeah. Thanks a lot...
(As the three of them walk away, Amélie is still sitting at the café booth playing with her stamp until she sees Mr. López walk by with a dalmatian dog.)
Amélie: Huh? Uh!? But— (walks out of the place to confront him) You have a dog!?
Mr. López: That's right.
Amélie: So you lied!
Mr. López: Urh, yup, but now I have a flat. C'mon Rex, say goodbye to the little lady.
(Rex barks as him and his owner walk away.)
Amélie: I don't believe this!
(An ultrakuma flies in above her before going down and entering her stamp.)
Chyrsalis: Hello dear Lady Amélie. I sensed a strong feeling of dejection come over you.

title: Lady Chaos/Transcript
text:
Lady Chaos/Transcript - Intro
Amélie: (tears fall from her eyes) I'm so tired of this cruel, unfair world where lying and selfishness are rewarded. (continuously bumps her stamp onto her knee) Where villains pass for heroes!
Chrysalis: I understand only too well. It feels pointless to behave well when you're surrounded by unscrupulous people. And the worst thing is that there is nothing you can do about it. It'll never change.
Amélie: You... you think so?
Chrysalis: I do. Unfortunately, that's the way the world works. So, you can either let people ruin your life (A bunch of Chrysalis visions appear in the mindscape, one even pointing at Amélie.) or (snaps her fingers to make the other visions disappear) you ruin theirs. I can give you that power, only if you agree.
Amélie: ...If nothing else can be done.
Chrysalis: What should I call you?
Amélie: Lady Chaos.
(Chrysalis closes her palm over her.)
(She spins her staff around, laughing manically and hitting her staff on the ground.)
Lady Chaos: Ahahaha!
(The red light from the staff forms a chaos dome around her. She then continues walking forward while the dome moves with her.)
Adrien: Okay, let's hope Ladybug has a few minutes to spare.

title: Lady Chaos/Transcript
text:
Lady Chaos/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Yes! Yeah! Phew! Fingers crossed.
Nino: Don't worry, dude. Ladybug's the most helpful person I know.
(Adrien nods.)
Nino: Wayzz, (Wayzz comes out of hiding) shell on! (transforms into Carapace)
(Carapace opens the Miraculous Call system on his Shield and presses on the ladybug icon. Marinette gets a signal from the Turtle Miraculous in her earrings which makes her awkwardly smile.)
Ladybug (voicemail): You've reached Ladybug's voicemail. Please leave a message.
Carapace: Hey, Ladybug. I know this is kind of unusual, but my best bud Adrien Agreste would love to ask you a few questions about his father. If you got a sec, we're at his place. (closes the call system) And now we wait.
Marinette: (starts backing away into the bathroom) Well while we wait for Ladybug I'm going to go... deal with the pipes in your bathroom! I noticed earlier that the sinks are kind of clogged. (closes the door and covers her face with her hands)
Adrien: You don't need to lock yourself in there just to deal with the sink you know Marinette. Besides, I could give you a hand.
Marinette: (through the door) No! No no no no need! I just uh... don't like being watched when I'm fixing the plumbing!

title: Lady Chaos/Transcript
text:
Lady Chaos/Transcript - Intro
(Adrien walks away from the door.)
Marinette: It's simple, Adrien can't grasp the idea that Gabriel the mean father he knew and Gabriel the hero are the same person. And I get it because it was a total surprise to us all right? So, all you have to do is tell him stuff that'll help him believe it and feel better about it all.
Alya: But I don't know what happened exactly. You were there.
Marinette: That doesn't matter, just come up with something nice that's all.
Alya: What? You want me to lie? Are you out of your mind?!
Marinette: I'm begging you, please please please please! Just one teensy tiny story to make my boyfriend finally happy so your BFF is also happy! Besides, you won't be lying. Your Ladybug illusion will be.
Alya: (sighs) Come on! Why can't I make an illusion of Marinette instead and you go as Ladybug yourself? If you want to feed him fibs, don't you think you should be the one taking responsibility?
Marinette: No! What if he feels so moved that at some point he tries to kiss the Marinette illusion. POOF! It'll all go up in smoke and my secret identity along with it! No, no, no, no, it has to be an illusion of Ladybug!
Alya: Ughhhh. Girl!

title: Lady Chaos/Transcript
text:
Lady Chaos/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Besides, Ladybug was unconscious when Gabriel Agreste defeated Monarch anyway, so I don't know the whole story either.
Alya: (sighs) Fine, I'll make your illusion just give me some time to get there.
Adrien: Are you okay, Marinette?
Marinette: Yup! I'm great! And your pipes are all clear. (walks over to the wall of windows and opens one of them up) So, what about Ladybug? Any news?
Nino: I'm sure she'll show up, don't worry.
Marinette: Oh, I'm not worried! Not at all! (leans on the window frame) Not one bit. (She awkwardly giggles then frowns.)
Realtor: The flat is yours. Enjoy!
(The couple go inside while the Realtor walks away and unlocks his car. Suddenly, Lady Chaos' dome appears in front of him.)
Realtor: Hm?
Lady Chaos: You were a real estate agent, but from now on, you will be my agent of chaos!
(She continues walking towards him until the Realtor is inside of the dome. A glowing red ring appears around her staff. Once Lady Chaos walks past him and he's no longer in the dome, the Realtor's eyes flash red for a second and he starts uncontrollably laughing, running towards the apartment he just sold.)
Realtor: Hahahaha!
Woman: We're going to be so happy here.

title: Lady Chaos/Transcript
text:
Lady Chaos/Transcript - Intro
Realtor: (suddenly bursts through the door) Shoo! Get out of here!
Woman: But this is our new home!
Man: (shows the document papers) We signed the lease!
Realtor: (rips the papers up) There! No more lease ahahaha!
Woman: But that can't be possible.
Realtor: (jumps down and makes a snow angel in the pieces of ripped up paper) Oh, but anything is possible! (starts dancing with the man) Because everything is CHAOS!
Man: Woah! (passes through dome) Ahahaha!
(A second ring appears on Lady Chaos' staff.)
Woman: Yeah, that's the thing I love— woahh! (Dome passes through her and her friend.)
(A third ring appears on Lady Chaos' staff.)
(The dome passes through another woman, making a fourth ring on the staff.)
(The dome passes through a man, making a fifth ring on the staff. The staff then starts glowing red and Lady Chaos hits it on the ground.)
Lady Chaos: Hiiyahhh!
(The red light forms the Graham De Vanily crest under her and makes her chaos dome even bigger. She continues walking throughout Paris.)
Rena Rouge: Okay, here we go. Mirage! (She hits her flute on the side of the building and creates an illusion of Ladybug, which jumps to the open window at Adrien's room.)

title: Lady Chaos/Transcript
text:
Lady Chaos/Transcript - Intro
Marinette, Adrien, and Nino: Hm?
Adrien: Ladybug, thank you for coming!
Ladybug illusion: No problem, Adrien. (sees Adrien sticking a hand out to her) Only, um, I'm on patrol so I don't have much time.
Nino: (starts recording on his phone) Rolling! Go ahead, dude.
Adrien: Ladybug, you're the only person who witnessed my father's final moments. You told me that he sacrificed himself, but you never told me how he was heroic in his act. I mean, I just can't picture it.
Ladybug illusion: I understand. Look, the moment when your father faced Monarch before he passed is still a blur to me too. I was badly injured... (Scene depicts Rena Rouge dictating the illusion's words by talking into her flute.) But before I passed out your father spoke to me.
Adrien: And? What did he say?
Ladybug illusion: (words dictated by Rena Rouge) He told me... that he hoped you could forgive him one day for being such a harsh father. That everything he did, he did to protect you.
(Adrien looks surprised.)
Ladybug illusion: He said... that he loved you.
(Adrien smiles.)
(Rena Rouge, still hidden behind the chimney, looks down in guilt before she hears someone screaming.)
Person: Ahhhh!
Rena Rouge: Huh?

title: Lady Chaos/Transcript
text:
Lady Chaos/Transcript - Intro
(The illusion and all three people in Adrien's room also look towards the source of the scream. Rena Rouge uses her flute to zoom into a nearby street, seeing Lady Chaos' chaos dome passing through random civilians.)
Lady Chaos: Welcome to my chaos! Ahahaha!
Ladybug illusion: Something's wrong I have to go.
(Rena Rouge's flute zoomed onto Adrien.)
Adrien: Thank you for everything Ladybug.
Marinette: Yes, thanks a bunch! (tilts her head towards Nino, who Rena Rouge's flute turns towards.)
Rena Rouge: Oh, right! Uh, Nino.
Ladybug illusion: I'm going to need Carapace's help.
Nino: You got it!
(The illusion swings away on her fake yo-yo and starts running on the rooftops with Rena Rouge.)
Rena Rouge: Reality.
(The Ladybug illusion vanishes.)
Nino: Wayzz, shell on! (transforms into Carapace) See you two later! (jumps out of the window to join the fight)
Marinette: (pulls her phone out of her pocket and brings it to her ear) Yes mom? Okay, sure, I understand. I'll be right there. (puts her phone down) My mom's worried, she wants me to come home.
Adrien: Be careful, Marinette.
Marinette: Ladybug's on the case, I'll be okay... Are you going to be okay too?

title: Lady Chaos/Transcript
text:
Lady Chaos/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: I feel better, yes. Don't worry about me. I'll take this time to finish editing.
(They both kiss before Marinette runs out of the Agreste mansion.)
Tikki: Adrien seems to be feeling much better thanks to the things you asked people to tell him.
Marinette: I'm not sure I did the right thing, but sometimes you're willing to do anything for the people you love. And other times you have to confront people who will do anything to destroy Paris. Tikki, spots on! (transforms into Ladybug)
Rena Rouge: So how did that go?
Ladybug: You were great. Adrien feels a lot better about his father thanks to you.
Rena Rouge: Nah, girl, I mean the way I got Nino out of your hair.
Ladybug: Oh! That was great too, nice job.
Rena Rouge: Because the lying to Adrien thing wasn't cool in my book. Promise you'll never make me do that again.
Ladybug: I'm really sorry, Alya... about everything.
Rena Rouge: (puts her hand on her shoulder) Hey, we're good, girl. C'mon, we've got a lot on our plate.
(Both heroes start running back towards the battle scene.)
Adrien: The editing will have to wait. (Plagg comes out of hiding) Plagg, claws out! (transforms into Cat Noir.)

title: Lady Chaos/Transcript
text:
Lady Chaos/Transcript - Intro
Lady Chaos: No one will escape my chaos!
(The police have created a blockade in front of the Arc de Triomphe using their police cars. Roger speaks to the villain through a megaphone.)
Roger: I command you to stop in the name of the law!
Lady Chaos: You were a police officer, from now on you'll be my agent of chaos!
(The chaos dome passes through Roger and the police cars, growing bigger as the police cars drive out and form another blockade closer to the Arc de Triomphe. Roger now speaks to the civilians through his megaphone.)
Roger: I command you to stop in the name of chaos! Join us!
(Carapace jumps down in front of civilians right in front of the dome, lifting his shield up.)
Carapace: Shell-ter! (puts a force field around him and the other civilians)
(Ladybug, Cat Noir, and Rena Rouge jump down on the Arc de Triomphe, watching the chaos dome pass through Carapace's shield.)
Ladybug, Cat Noir, and Rena Rouge: Carapace!
Ladybug: Carapace are you okay?
Carapace (through Ladybug's earpiece): Don't worry, gang, all good! My shield protects us from the chaos zone.
Ladybug: Can you show us what's going on inside?

title: Lady Chaos/Transcript
text:
Lady Chaos/Transcript - Intro
(Carapace takes a little device off of his shield and starts recording Lady Chaos.)
Lady Chaos: You tried to ruin my life? (spins her staff with five rings on it) Well now you'll be ruining people's lives for me! Ahahaha! (She hits her staff down again, making the red Graham de Vanily crest which makes the dome bigger. Ladybug is able to see all of this through Carapace's recording on her yo-yo.)
Cat Noir: Maybe the ultrakuma's in her weapon.
Rena Rouge: Yeah, but if we enter her chaos zone to get to her, she'll instantly turn us into her agents.
Ladybug: (touching her earpiece) I've seen enough. Carapace, get out of there!
Carapace: (puts his device back into his shield and turns to the other people in the shield) Come with me!
(Carapace and the civilians start running out of the zone, the shield around them following them. They burst through all the police cars, making Roger go flying as well.)
Carapace: Unshield! (The force field disappears.) Run away as far as you can! (The civilians do as told while Carapace jumps up to the Arc de Triomphe to join his team.)
Ladybug: I think we need a little boost.

title: Lady Chaos/Transcript
text:
Lady Chaos/Transcript - Intro
[Superpower Sequence]Ladybug: Lucky Charm!(She gets a toy jeep with a remote control.)
(Ladybug's vision highlights the toy jeep, Cat Noir's belt, and Carapace's shield.)
Ladybug: Cat Noir, give me your belt. Carapace, I need to borrow your camera.
(They both hand her their objects. Ladybug puts Carapace's camera device on the Lucky Charm jeep and wraps them together using Cat Noir's belt. Ladybug then jumps down to be in front of the zone, putting the toy jeep down and seeing what Carapace's camera is recording through her yo-yo.)
Ladybug: Let's try to see more clearly into all that chaos and restore a little order.
(She presses a button on the remote control to make the toy jeep go forward, into the chaos zone. She sees Lady Chaos through her yo-yo and then throws her weapon, wrapping it around a tree nearby until it goes into the chaos zone, wrapping around the villain's ankle and then another tree inside the zone to stop her from moving.)
Lady Chaos: Who dares to disrupt my chaos??
Ladybug: (touches her earpiece) Miraculers, you're up!
Carapace: Shell-ter! (puts a shield around Cat Noir, who jumps down with it to be in front of the chaos zone as well)

title: Lady Chaos/Transcript
text:
Lady Chaos/Transcript - Intro
Rena Rouge: Mirage! (She creates a bunch of illusions of Cat Noirs with Shell-ters around them, all of them running into the chaos zone.)
Cat Noir: Cataclysm!
Lady Chaos: What is that!? Back off! Get away! (She uses her staff to fling a scooter, a bike, and a car at the illusions, making some of them disappear. One illusion jumps at her, while another sneaks up behind her. She then starts getting rid of more illusions by hitting them with her staff when they get close to her.)
Cat Noir: (touches his earpiece) Now!
Rena Rouge: Vanish! (All the other illusions disappear.)
Carapace: Unshield! (The shield around Cat Noir disappears.)
Cat Noir: (His eyes glow red for a second, but his Cataclysm touches Lady Chaos' staff, destroying it and releasing the ultrakuma.) Hahaha!
(The chaos zone breaks apart and disappears. Ladybug brings her yo-yo back to her.)
(Lady Chaos turns back into Amélie.)
Amélie: What... happened to me?
Cat Noir: (in a completely crazy voice) CATACLYSM! HAHAHAHA! (His Cataclysm keeps growing until it's big enough to destroy the entire world.)
Carapace: No! Cat Noir!
Rena Rouge: Ladybug, hurry!

title: Lady Chaos/Transcript
text:
Lady Chaos/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: (quickly uses her yo-yo to bring the toy jeep to her) Miraculous Ladybug!
(The magic ladybugs fly off to fix all the damage, including turning Cat Noir back to normal as he turns off his powers.)
Ladybug: No more evildoing for you, ultrakuma! (opens up her yo-yo) Time to de-evilize! (catches the ultrakuma) Gotcha! Bye bye, little butterfly! (releases the butterfly)
Amélie: I... I think I let my emotions get the best of me. When you have certain principles, it can be so hard to put up with evil people who are liars.
Rena Rouge: Especially liars, am I right?
Ladybug: Yes, well... (pulls a Magical Charm out of her yo-yo and gives it to Amélie) I know it's hard, but this Magical Charm will help you remember that we absolutely need people like you who stick to their principles. (looks over at Rena Rouge who nods)
The Miraculers: Pound it!
Ladybug illusion: (recording): He told me... that he hoped you could forgive him one day for being such a harsh father. That everything he did, he did to protect you. He said... that he loved you.
Adrien: For the first time I feel like I actually know my father. Do you feel that way too? I mean, he wasn't kind to you either.

title: Lady Chaos/Transcript
text:
Lady Chaos/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Uh, yes, yeah. I feel exactly the same as you, of course.
Adrien: Thank you for your company on this journey, Marinette.
Marinette: Well, of course. I'm glad this is over. I mean— uh, I'm glad you have closure.
Adrien: Actually, can I ask one more favor? I only have portraits of my father where he looked stern and uncaring. Would you mind making a drawing of him for me? One that actually looks like him, now that we both know him better.
Marinette: Sure, if it makes you happy.
Adrien: Thank you, Marinette.
(They both kiss.)
Tikki: Everything's back to normal, Marinette. Adrien has made peace with his memory of his father. You two can live an incredible love story now.
Marinette: Right... an incredible love story.
(The screen zooms into the blank paper.)
Félix: It's perfect. I'm so glad we're moving back to Paris soon, and more importantly living so close to Adrien. I've missed my cousin.
Amélie: Yes, it's the right time. Even though Ladybug decided to lie in order to keep your fiancée's mother out of prison, the truth always comes out. And when it does, your cousin will need his family's support.

title: Lady Chaos/Transcript
text:
Lady Chaos/Transcript - Intro
(They both continue to look out at the Eiffel Tower, pondering on the future.)

title: Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)
text:
Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1) - Intro
"" is a season 1 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 22nd written and produced episode of season 1. It is also the 22nd written and produced episode of the series, overall.
This episode is also the first part of the Season 1-based 2-parter, "The Origins Story".

title: Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)
text:
Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1) - Synopsis
Nickelodeon
Each story has its beginning. Discover how Marinette Dupain-Cheng and Adrien Agreste, two high school students practically like everyone else, became Ladybug and Cat Noir, and why Hawk Moth is their sworn enemy.
Netflix
In a flashback, Ladybug and Cat Noir's origins are revealed, as Marinette befriends Alya and meets Adrien, a famous model with an overprotective dad.
KidsClick
Every story has a beginning. Discover how Marinette and Adrien became Ladybug and Cat Noir.
Disney+
Learn how our heroes became Ladybug and Cat Noir.

title: Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)
text:
Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1) - Plot
The episode begins with Nooroo recounting the story of the Miraculouses, and explains that the Ladybug Miraculous and the Cat Miraculous are more powerful than the others and that whoever controls both Miraculouses will have absolute power. Nooroo is interrupted by a man holding a brooch with a picture of a woman inside. The man proclaims that he wants that absolute power. Nooroo states that no one knows where the Ladybug or Cat Miraculouses are, but the man says he found the brooch, which is revealed to be a Miraculous, and asks Nooroo to remind him of the power of the Butterfly Miraculous. Nooroo explains the power of the brooch is to grant other people superpowers, and the man declares his intent to use it to create supervillains, thus drawing out the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses with users to stop him and take the Miraculous. Nooroo protests, saying the Miraculouses are not intended to be used for evil. However, the man insists and forces Nooroo to submit to him, as he holds the Butterfly Miraculous. He attaches the Butterfly Miraculous to his chest, and he transforms into Hawk Moth.

title: Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)
text:
Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1) - Plot
Wayzz wakes up and flies out of a gramophone to Master Wang Fu, who promptly dismisses a man lying on a mat. As soon as the door closes, the kwami explains that he felt the negative energy of the Butterfly Miraculous. The brooch was originally thought to be lost forever. Determined to get Nooroo back, Wang Fu holds up his arm, with the Turtle Miraculous on his wrist. He calls Wayzz's name to transform but freezes in pain. When he stands up again, he comes to the conclusion that a new hero is needed. Walking to the gramophone, he presses several buttons, resulting in the gramophone revealing the Miracle Box of Miraculouses.
Inside her bedroom, Marinette wakes up. Turning off the alarm on her cellphone, she goes downstairs, kissing her mother on the cheek. Making breakfast, she bemoans her first day of school, expecting Chloé Bourgeois to be in her class for the fourth year in a row.

title: Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)
text:
Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1) - Plot
Her mother tries to reassure Marinette that she doesn't have bad luck, right before Marinette accidentally causes a chain reaction making a mess of all the food on the counter. Sabine silently reassures Marinette and helps her clean up. In the bakery below, Tom Dupain presents Marinette with a box of macarons to share with her class. Marinette hugs her father, kisses both her parents and runs out the bakery.
Marinette comes to a pedestrian crosswalk, waiting for the light to change. As she waits, Wang Fu crosses the street. Noticing a car heading towards Wang Marinette lunges forward and drags him onto the sidewalk. In the process, Marinette drops the macarons, and people step on them without noticing. She offers one to Wang, going on her way to school. Wang holds a box in his hand, picking up his cane and walking past the bakery.

title: Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)
text:
Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1) - Plot
Marinette runs past Fred Haprèle and into Literature classroom. Miss Bustier is at the front of the class, telling Nino to move to the front row. He gets up as Marinette sits down, groaning. Chloé Bourgeois approaches Marinette and orders her to move, claiming the spot Marinette had sat in for the past few years is her spot, and that she wants to sit behind Adrien.  Backed up by Sabrina, Chloé orders Marinette to sit in the front row next to Alya, a new student. Alya approaches, accosts Chloé and grabs Marinette's arm, dragging her away. In the process, Marinette trips over her own feet, dropping the box of macarons. When Marinette sits down next to Alya, Miss Bustier begins class. Marinette admits she fears she'll never be able to stand up to Chloé, and Alya replies with a quote from her favorite superhero, encouraging Marinette to stand up to evil. Marinette breaks apart the single remaining macaron giving half to Alya, as the two introduce themselves to each other.

title: Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)
text:
Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1) - Plot
Outside the building, Adrien runs toward the school, but a car swings around to meet him. Nathalie Sancoeur shouts at him to stop, as his father did not allow him to go to school. Adrien protests, but notices an old man is on the ground with his cane out of his reach. Adrien runs past Nathalie and his bodyguard to give the cane to the man and help him to his feet. When he turns around, Nathalie and the bodyguard block the stairs, ushering Adrien back into the car and driving him home. Wang Fu nods to himself, puts his cane on his shoulder, and walks away.
Back in Literature classroom, Miss Bustier dismisses her class. As the students leave, Kim hands Ivan a note. Ivan reacts angrily, and Miss Bustier sends him to see Denis Damoclès.
Hawk Moth senses Ivan's anger and sadness and sends out his first akuma.

title: Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)
text:
Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1) - Plot
Outside the school, Mr. D'Argencourt leads Kim, Max, Alix, Nino, and Rose to class. Inside the school, Ivan opens the door to Principal's office. Because he did not knock, Denis Damoclès makes Ivan leave the room and knock on the door. Angrily, Ivan leaves the room, and an akuma flies into the crumpled note. Almost immediately, Ivan accepts Hawk Moth's proposal of taking revenge on those who hurt him, and he transforms into Stoneheart. Denis Damoclès asks Ivan if he's knocking, and the door flies off its hinges. Stoneheart enters the room shouting Kim's name. The crash makes Denis Damoclès fall over, and students in the library also fall over with each step Stoneheart takes.

title: Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)
text:
Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1) - Plot
The students scream as they run toward the television in the library, Alya picks up Marinette and drags her by the hand. On the top left screen is Stoneheart, shouting Kim's name. In his office, Denis Damoclès calls the police and the army. Marinette has no clue what's happening, nor why the monster has Ivan's voice. Alya, on the other hand, claims that a superhero will show up to fight the villain, and leaves Marinette behind in the library, to chase after Stoneheart. Before Stoneheart leaves the school grounds, he picks up a car and chucks it at the school, knocking out the camera.

title: Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)
text:
Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1) - Plot
Wang Fu stands outside the Agreste mansion with a small box in his hands, smiling. Inside the mansion, Nathalie is asking Adrien questions about history, but Gabriel Agreste interrupts her, reprimanding Adrien for sneaking out and telling him that he has everything he could ever want in the mansion and that the outside world is too dangerous. Nathalie then states that they could be done with the homeschooling for the day if Adrien wished. Before she finishes speaking, Adrien runs from the room to his bedroom. Adrien lies on his bed crying, face in a pillow, but runs outside when he hears rumbling crashes. He sees police cars and hears sirens. The police ready their weapons as Stoneheart approaches, firing on Roger Raincomprix's command. When they fire, Stoneheart glows yellow, curling in on himself before growing in size. He picks up a police van and throws it as the officers scatter.

title: Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)
text:
Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1) - Plot
Marinette watches a news broadcast about Stoneheart's attack, terrified. Simultaneously, she and Adrien look down at the tables in front of them, each finding a small, hexagonal, black and red box. When they open the boxes, each flashes with light. They both flinch backing away from the lights. From inside each box emerges a large sphere of light, pinkish-red for Marinette's and greenish-yellow for Adrien's. Tikki manifests in front of Marinette, who panics at the sight of a 'talking giant bug-mouse' and starts chucking everything within reach at her. Plagg appears in front of Adrien, who reacts with curiosity as Plagg flies around the room looking at shiny objects. Marinette calms down and questions Tikki, who begins to explain the situation. Adrien captures Plagg, who also begins to explain the situation. Marinette calls out to her parents, but Tikki tells her to stop, expressing friendship she asks Marinette to trust her. Tikki reveals to Marinette that she is the only one who can stop Stoneheart.

title: Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)
text:
Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1) - Plot
In Wang Fu's shop, while Wang Fu hides the jewelry box with its remaining Miraculouses, Wayzz asks Wang if he had made a mistake. Wang responds that he's only made one mistake in his life and he doesn't intend on making a second.
Marinette tells Tikki that she doesn't feel qualified to be a superhero and recommends Alya as an alternative, but Tikki insists that Marinette was chosen. Adrien tells Plagg that he can't be a superhero if he can't leave his house, but Plagg insists that can change. Marinette puts on the Ladybug Miraculous, and at Tikki's request says "Spots on!", panicking as she begins to transform.  Adrien puts on the Cat Miraculous and eagerly transforms prior to Plagg protests that he hasn't finished explaining.
Ladybug expresses her distaste at her new costume, and asks Tikki for advice, but can't find Tikki and is distracted by news footage of Alya following Stoneheart. She goes to the roof and throws her yo-yo forward, leaping into the air above the city.

title: Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)
text:
Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1) - Plot
Cat Noir walks along his staff between two buildings. He pauses as he hears screaming, and Ladybug falls from the sky and crashes into him, her yo-yo wrapping around them both, suspending them from his staff. They dangle as Ladybug apologizes. Cat Noir recognizes her as the partner Plagg had mentioned and introduces himself as Cat Noir.  Ladybug tugs on her yo-yo to free it and it comes crashing down on Cat Noir's head. When she introduces herself, she calls herself "Madly Clumsy." Cat Noir forgives her for accidentally hurting him. Loud thumping interrupts them as a tall building crashes down. Cat Noir extends his staff and vaults up to Paris' rooftops, intent on saving the city. Ladybug reluctantly follows, screaming all the while.
At the Stade des Princesses, the students are finishing up their class. Stoneheart jumps onto the wall of the stadium, shouting Kim's name. The students flee as Stoneheart chases after Kim, who trips over his feet and falls to the ground. Cat Noir's staff stops Stoneheart from touching Kim and gives Kim time to flee. Cat Noir goads Stoneheart into attacking him.
In his lair, Hawk Moth states that everything is going according to plan.

title: Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)
text:
Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1) - Plot
Cat Noir hits Stoneheart with his staff, and Stoneheart grows in size. Cat Noir avoids Stoneheart's next blows as Ladybug watches in horror from the top of the stadium's wall. Stoneheart wrenches a soccer goal from the ground and throws it at Cat Noir. It bounces, arcing toward Alya, who is hiding and filming. Cat Noir acts fast, throwing his staff and extending it. The goal post bounces off it, missing Alya. This distraction gives Stoneheart the opportunity to catch Cat Noir.  Alya spots Ladybug, asking her what she is waiting for. Ladybug winces and dives into the stadium. She hooks her yo-yo around Stoneheart's legs and slides to a stop in front of him. Unbalanced, Stoneheart releases Cat Noir. Ladybug runs to Cat Noir's side as he prepares to attack Stoneheart again. Ladybug stops him and reminds him of Stoneheart's ability to grow stronger with each hit.

title: Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)
text:
Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1) - Plot
Cat Noir suggests that they use their powers, and he summons his Cataclysm, testing it on one of the goal's posts, which rusts and dissolves. Excited, Cat Noir runs out to Stoneheart, placing his hand on Stoneheart's foot. When nothing happens, Stoneheart kicks him back to Ladybug, who berates him, telling him he has only five minutes left before he transforms back into his civilian self.

title: Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)
text:
Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1) - Plot
Ladybug summons her Lucky Charm, a wetsuit, and explains the akuma to Cat Noir, who points out that they don't know where the akuma is. Ladybug realizes that Stoneheart keeps his right fist closed, and suggests the akuma is hidden in his fist. She ties the open ends of the wetsuit together and ties a water hose into the neck of the suit. Asking Cat Noir to trust her, she wraps her yo-yo around his legs and throws him at Stoneheart, who catches Cat Noir in his left fist. Ladybug taunts Stoneheart and throws herself at him, wetsuit in hand. When Stoneheart catches her, he drops the crumpled note, which is now a purple rock. Ladybug then yells at Alya to turn on the hose, which allows the wetsuit to fill up with water and forces Stoneheart's hand open. Ladybug runs over to the purple rock and stomps on it, freeing the akuma, which flutters off as Ivan turns back to normal and drops Cat Noir to the ground. The crumpled note returns to its paper form.

title: Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)
text:
Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1) - Plot
Ivan has no clue what's going on or why he is at the Parc de Princes. Ladybug and Cat Noir pound fists, complimenting each other. Cat Noir leaves before his Miraculous runs out. Ladybug turns to Ivan, reading the note she finds it contains a taunting message from Kim to Ivan for not telling Mylène he loves her. Ladybug consoles Ivan as Alya films the entire scene. Alya asks Ladybug many questions as she's walking away and in response, she tells Alya to call her "Ladybug". Taking out her yo-yo, the hero now known as Ladybug swings up and out of the stadium.
In her room, Marinette watches a review of the fight on her computer. Her father calls her down from her room for dinner. The television in the living room shows a press conference from Mayor Bourgeois, stating that he will be hosting a grand party in Ladybug's and Cat Noir's honor. Adrien watches the same press conference in his room. While Plagg searches through the four covered dishes set in front of the television for food. He lifts the cover of the fourth one, revealing a dessert. Disgusted, he tells Adrien such and that his palate is more refined.

title: Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)
text:
Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1) - Plot
The free akuma lands on the top of the Eiffel Tower. It multiplies, sending out streams of its copies into Paris.
Marinette is washing dishes when the news reports on multiple citizens turning into Stoneheart. Tom and Sabine hold each other in horror as Marinette rushes to her room. At the same time, Adrien laments that he's going to smell like stinky old cheese because of Plagg's affection of Camembert. The news interrupts his lament explaining the situation with the people turning into Stoneheart duplicates, inactive and immobile.
When they question their kwami on what went wrong, Plagg and Tikki ask the same question: "Did you capture the akuma?" Tikki explains that the akuma can multiply itself and seek out people who have negative emotions. This can create an army of akumatized villains. Marinette blames herself, saying it's all her fault and that she's too clumsy to be a superhero.

title: Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)
text:
Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1) - Plot
Tikki tries to tell Marinette that it's only her first time fighting, that she'll fight Stoneheart again and win next time. Marinette doesn't listen, insisting that she makes everything worse for everyone. She even states that Cat Noir would be better without her. Simultaneously, Marinette and Adrien learn that Cat Noir cannot purify akumas: only Ladybug can do it. But Marinette still tells Tikki to look for another Ladybug. She takes her earrings out, much to Tikki's protest. Before Tikki can say anything to dissuade Marinette, she disappears. Marinette puts the earrings back in their box and hides the box away in her vanity. She kneels at the foot of the vanity, upset.
Hawk Moth declares that Ivan's sensitive heart will allow him to be akumatized again. The akuma flies back through the open window, landing on Hawk Moth's cane and resting in its jewel. As the episode ends, Ivan sits on the steps of the collège, Adrien worries in his room, Marinette regrets her decisions in front of her vanity, and Hawk Moth cackles as his window closes.
