title: Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)
text:
Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1) - Plot Developments
This episode begins the "Agreste Arc" of the series:
Where Marinette and Adrien began their adventures as Ladybug and Cat Noir as well as Gabriel's path to darkness.
With "Feast" it's revealed that Master Fu gave the Cat Miraculous to Adrien because he saw himself in the boy being thrown or stuck into a world he didn't want and being unable to change it but gave him the power to do so.
Alya is revealed to be a new student in Marinette's class; they have not met before this episode.
It is revealed that Hawk Moth's powers stem from a Miraculous, more specifically the Butterfly.
Where the heroes learn about their powers and abilities such as Lucky Charm, Cataclysm, and Akumatization, and what to do with akumas.
Based on Tikki's knowledge of them, it's implied that one had gotten away and multiplied before most likely during her time with one of her previous owners.
Where the audience learns why Gabriel wants the duo's powers because of their combined ability to grant wishes.
Once after Marinette relinquishes her earrings unknown to her that future self takes them in "Miraculous London", where Tikki's faith began with Marinette as her owner.

title: Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)
text:
Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1) - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in South Korea on EBS1.
The title for the French version is "Ladybug et Chat Noir (Origines - Partie 1)".
This was one of Thomas Astruc's favorite episodes to direct.
In the English dub, after Marinette first transforms into Ladybug, she tells her mother she got home alright, but Sabine doesn't hear her. In the French dub, she runs to her balcony without answering her mother.
Mélody Cisinski did the pre-layout and cleaned this episode while it was in production.
Rather than being the season finale, Thomas considers this episode and its second part to be "a special 2-parter to be watched after the series".
This is the only Season 1 episode that is not named after an akumatized villain.
It is also the only Season 1 episode in which the akuma isn't captured and the Miraculous Ladybug power isn't used.
This is the first episode in the series not to be named after a featured antagonist. Excluding Season 5, which has a unique naming scheme for its episodes, it was the only episode to be so for 10 years until "Secret Protocol."
Ivan is revealed to be the first person to have ever been akumatized by Hawk Moth.

title: Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)
text:
Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1) - Trivia
Marinette's first transformation sequence is different than all the others: she's frightened and doesn't pose.
Adrien, on the other hand, transforms like he does in every episode. However, the music for his transformation is different and is extended slightly.
Plagg unrolls at least four toilet paper rolls in Adrien's room.
Ladybug almost calls herself "Marinette" when she meets Cat Noir, and to cover it up, she calls herself "Madly Clumsy" instead. In the French version, she calls herself "Maladroit," which means clumsy in French.
Since Master Fu mentions that he is 186 and half years old and the French duo's journey starts at the beginning of September with the first day of school, this would imply that his birthday is around early March.
References
Like "Stormy Weather," this episode doesn't have an end card.
Allusions
There are two French songs hummed in this episode.
The first is "La Marseillaise", hummed by Tom right before Marinette leaves for school.
The second is "Frère Jacques", hummed by Master Fu right after Adrien is forced to return home.
In the gramophone, Wayzz can be seen sleeping in a matchbox with the book cover of Le Chat Noir.

title: Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)
text:
Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1) - Trivia
In-universe, Adrien chose the name "Chat Noir" as his superhero name because it was also the name of a hero in a story his mother used to read to him, as revealed in the Miraculous Secrets card game.
Next to the matchbox, there are real-life French stamps depicting the Eiffel Tower, the Trocadéro, the Place de la Concorde (which would be introduced in Season 2), the Notre-Dame de Paris, and the Dôme des Invalides, which hasn't appeared in the show.
Alya asks Ladybug if she was bitten by a radioactive ladybug when she got her powers, a theory she mentions in the webisode "Ladyblog" most likely to be a reference to the famous Marvel superhero, Spider Man.
Before this episode aired, a fan made a comic similar to Spider-Man's origin story, which used to be the header on Thomas Astruc's Twitter.

title: Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)
text:
Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1) - Trivia
The creature one of the previous Miraculous bearers fights in the Greek Vase style drawing seems to be a mix of several mythological creatures. The snake hair is from the Medusa, the stinger tail is from a manticore, the wings are probably from the Sphinx. The human face can be either from the Sphinx or a manticore, while the leonine body can be from the same as well as the Chimera. None of the four were known to use tridents.
Errors
Before Marinette decides her superhero name, Hawk Moth calls the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses "Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous", implying that he already knows that. In the French dub, however, he just calls them "the Miraculouses of the Ladybug and the Black Cat".
When Adrien is lying on his bed, he is wearing the ring even though he hasn't seen the box yet.
When Adrien jumps onto the couch, he grabs the TV remote from beside him. However the remote is not visible as he jumps onto the couch.
When Adrien tries to catch Plagg, he is wearing the Cat Miraculous, even though he hasn't put it on yet. This error happened again after Adrien grabs Plagg.

title: Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)
text:
Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1) - Trivia
The earrings have their transformed colors when Marinette puts them on, but in the next shot, they are in their usual solid black color. However, this may be that the miraculous simply turned to its camouflage mode.
When Cat Noir throws his staff to save Alya, it reappears on his lower back, even though he was nowhere near her to retrieve it.
When Ladybug is holding Cat Noir’s belt, a small portion near Cat Noir’s body is uneven despite the fact that the way Ladybug is pulling would make the whole belt straight.
When Plagg lifts the cloche to inspect the food Adrien is offering him, the cloche goes behind the TV.
There are many more errors in the French version of the show than in the subsequent versions. These errors include certain objects glowing (the Butterfly Miraculous) or being transparent (the Cat Miraculous). This is due to the show's staff still working on the episodes at the time they aired. Many errors have since been corrected in subsequent versions of the show.
When Master Fu mentions how he "only got it wrong once", the Peacock Miraculous appears in its place in one camera angle but disappears in the next.

title: Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)
text:
Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1) - Trivia
Despite Miss Bustier referring to herself as "Mademoiselle" (Miss, indicating she is not married) in the French dub, the abbreviation for "Madame" is written on the chalkboard. This is fixed in the comic adaptation.
When Kim first writes on the paper to give to Ivan, there doesn’t appear to be any ink. But when he gives it to Ivan, the ink appears on the paper.
In one frame when Ladybug tosses Cat Noir to Stoneheart, her hair appears in front of Cat Noir.
When the footage of Ladybug transitions to a TVi news report, Nadja Chamack doesn't appear in the news report for eight frames.
In the beginning, when the Miracle Box is first shown during Nooroo's narration, the Turtle, Fox, and Peacock Miraculouses are in camouflage mode, while the Butterfly, Bee, Ladybug and Cat are in charged mode.
When Ladybug's yo-yo wraps around the tiger statue's ear, the bottom half appears to be missing.

title: Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)/Transcript
text:
Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)/Transcript - Intro
[ Theme Song ]
Nooroo: Many centuries ago, magic jewels bestowing extraordinary powers were created. These were the Miraculous. Throughout history, heroes have used these jewels for the good of the human race. Two of these Miraculous are more powerful than the others; the earrings of the Ladybug, which provide the power of creation; and the ring of the Black Cat, which grants the power of destruction. According to legend, whoever controls both these jewels at the same time will achieve absolute power.
Male voice: I want that absolute power, Nooroo. I must have those Miraculous!
Nooroo: But nobody knows where these Miraculous are!
Male voice: I found you though, my little Nooroo. Your Miraculous... remind me of its powers again.
Nooroo: The Moth Brooch allows you to give someone their own superpowers and to make that person your devoted follower!
Male voice: And when it comes to luring superheroes, what could be better than creating supervillains?
Nooroo: But master, the Miraculous are not meant to be used for evil purposes!

title: Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)/Transcript
text:
Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)/Transcript - Intro
Male voice: I must have this absolute power! Your Miraculous is in my control! (pointing at Nooroo causing him to stun) I am your master now, and you must obey me.
Nooroo: (lowering his head sadly) Yes, master.
Male voice: (puts on the brooch) Nooroo,(Butterflies swarm over and covering him.) dark wings rise! (Nooroo enters the broach and the male voice transforms into Hawk Moth) From this day on, I shall be known as...(Open his eyes) Hawk Moth! (laughs evilly)
Wayzz: Master, Master! (customer hears Wayzz, looks up)
Wang Fu: Master, master. Chanting, it's all part of the treatment. Master, master. (begins pushing customer out door) Thank you for coming, see you again next week!
Wayzz: Master, the Moth Miraculous, I felt its aura.
Wang Fu: I thought it had been lost forever!
Wayzz: But Master, it's a negative aura. I fear it may have gotten into the hands of a dark power!
Wang Fu: We must find Nooroo and his Miraculous. If it has gotten into the wrong hands, there's no telling what evil will come upon the world! (shows his Miraculous) Time to transform! Wayzz... (doubles over in pain)
Wayzz: Please, Master. Be reasonable. You are–

title: Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)/Transcript
text:
Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)/Transcript - Intro
Wang Fu: Still young! I'm only 186. But you're right, Wayzz. I can no longer do it alone. We'll need some help. (opens the gramophone, revealing the Miraculous box)
Sabine: (from downstairs) Marinette! Your alarm's been going off for fifteen minutes! You're going to be late for your first day back at school!
Marinette: (crawls out from underneath bed covers) Got it, Mom! (walks down stairs) Coming! I bet you anything, Chloé will be in my class again.
Sabine: Four years in a row, is that possible?
Marinette: Definitely. Lucky me!
Sabine: Don't say that! It's the start of a new year, I'm sure everything will be just fine!
(Marinette smiles and nods, setting down the cocoa. Several things get knocked over, spilling and falling to the floor. Marinette groans, but her mother comforts her.)
Tom: (sings La Marseillaise as he works)
Marinette: Dad, these are so awesome!
Tom: Glad you like them.
Marinette: Thank you Dad, my class will love them! You're the best!
Tom: We're the best, thanks to your amazing designs. (Marinette hugs Tom, dropping the box. He catches it on his foot and tosses it up in the air, catching it before handing it to her)

title: Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)/Transcript
text:
Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (giggles) Thanks. (Sabine hands Marinette her school bag and Marinette kisses her cheek. Tom leans down and Marinette kisses his cheek as well before rushing towards the door) See you tonight!
Marinette: (sighs in relief) Aah... (sees Wang Fu crossing the street slowly with his cane and a car fast approaching) Uuuhhaawh? (looks around at the other people stopped at the crossing, but everyone is distracted by their phones. Marinette runs onto the street and grabs Fu's wrist, hurrying him off the road as fast as she can. They manage to make it to the sidewalk in time, barely missing the car. Marinette trips on the curb while trying to get off the road, dropping the box of macarons and faceplanting onto the concrete.) Bleh.
Wang Fu: Thank you, Miss. (looks at the open box of macarons, at least seven of which have been knocked out of the box and sit amongst broken pieces of another macaron splayed out across the sidewalk in front of Marinette. Fu covers his mouth) Oh! What a disaster.

title: Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)/Transcript
text:
Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (people start crossing the street. Marinette cries out and reaches her hand towards one of the macarons on the ground as a pedestrian crushes it under his shoe, looking at his phone. Marinette grabs the box and stands up) Don't worry, I'm no stranger to disasters. Besides, there are still a few left. (tilts the box towards Fu, offering for him to try one of the remaining macarons)
Wang Fu: (takes a macaron from the box and bites into it) Mmmh. Delicious! (looks up at Marinette with a grateful smile. Marinette smiles back as she shuts the box. Suddenly, the school bell rings)
Marinette: (hears the bell at her school Oh no, I'm gonna be late! (turns back to Fu, standing up straight. She bows slightly) Ah, have a nice day, sir! (runs across the street towards the school.)
Wang Fu: (watches Marinette run off and looks down at a black box sitting in his palm with red markings on the lid) Thank you very much, young lady. (pockets the box and walks off past the bakery, holding his cane behind his back)
Caline: Nino, Why don't you have a seat in the front row this year?
Chloé: Marinette Dupain-Cheng.
Marinette: Ugh. Here we go again.
Chloé: That's my seat.

title: Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)/Transcript
text:
Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: But Chloé, this has always been my seat.
Sabrina: Not anymore! New school, new year, new seats!
Chloé: So why don't you just go and sit beside that new girl over there? (points at Alya)
Marinette: But...
Chloe: Listen. Adrien's arriving today and since that's going to be his seat, this is going to be my seat. Get it?
Marinette: Who's Adrien?
Chloé: (she and Sabrina laugh) Can you believe she doesn't know who Adrien is? What rock have you been living under?
Sabrina: He's only a famous model.
Chloé: And I am his best friend. He adores me. Go on, move!
Alya: Hey! Who elected you Queen of Seats?
Chloé: Oh. Look, Sabrina! We've got a little do-gooder in our class this year. What are you gonna do, super newbie? Shoot beams at me with your glasses?
Alya: Wouldn't you like to know? (walks away and grabs Marinette by the hand) Come on.
Marinette: (trips and falls, spilling all but one macaron) Sorry, sorry, sorry.
Miss Bustier: Alright, has everyone found a seat?
Alya: Chillax, girl. No biggie.
Marinette: I so wish I can handle Chloé the way you do.

title: Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)/Transcript
text:
Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)/Transcript - Intro
Alya: You mean the way Majestia does it. (shows her a picture of Majestia on her phone) She says all that is necessary for the triumph of evil is that good people do nothing. (pointing at Chloé) Well, that girl over there is evil, and we are the good people. We can't let her get away with it.
Marinette: Well, that's easier said than done. She likes to make my life miserable.
Alya: That's cause you let her, girl! You just need more confidence!
Marinette: (grabs a macaron from the box and gives half to Alya) Marinette.
Alya: Alya.
Miss Bustier: For those of you who don't yet know me, I'm Miss Bustier. I'll be your teacher this year.
Chloé: Ugh, he should have been here by now.
Nathalie: Adrien, please reconsider! You know what your father wants!
Adrien: But, this is what I wanna do! (sees Wang Fu trying to get up and helps him)

title: Ladybug Miraculous
text:
Ladybug Miraculous - Intro
The  is a pair of earrings that, whenever Tikki inhabits them, transform the wearer into a ladybug-themed superhuman with the power of Creation.
To activate the earrings, its user must speak the transformation phrase: "Spots On". To deactivate the earrings, its user must speak the detransformation phrase: "Spots Off". To activate the earrings for evil purposes, the user must speak the transformation phrase: "Blots On". To deactivate the earrings, the user must speak the detransformation phrase: "Blots Off".
The earrings are currently owned by Marinette Dupain-Cheng, who uses them to transform into Ladybug.

title: Ladybug Miraculous
text:
Ladybug Miraculous - Appearance
In charged mode, the Ladybug Miraculous is a pair of domed stud earrings with silver bezels. The domes are red with five black spots in a quincunx pattern. Their shape and pattern resemble a ladybug's elytron. If a minor is using the earrings and they've activated Lucky Charm, it'll start running out of power, making a beeping sound with one spot flashing before disappearing every minute as an indication (one spot is equivalent to one minute) Marinette (or another Ladybug Miraculous holder) has left before they de-transform.
In Season 6, the domes now appear with a glittery finish.
When worn by Chronobug, the earrings are yellow with five white spots in a quincunx pattern.
However, during the transformation the spots are miscolored black.
In its activated mode, it's the same as it's charged mode with exception of the domes being completely red.
In Season 6, the domes now appear with a glittery finish.
When worn by Chronobug, the earrings are yellow.
In its camouflaged mode, the Ladybug Miraculous changes form depending on who wears it:
When worn by Marinette Dupain-Cheng, the earring are the same as in their charged and activated modes, but the domes are black.

title: Ladybug Miraculous
text:
Ladybug Miraculous - Appearance
In Season 6 onwards, the domes are dark red with the glittery finish from the charged and activated modes.
When Marinette got akumatized into Heartfixer, the earrings were purple shaded similar to her skin.
When worn by Adrien Agreste, the earrings were silver and flatter.
When worn by Alya Césaire, the earrings were orange and flatter.
As a Kamikotized object, they grew bigger and were colored purplish-black with the spots glowing white, resembling a pair of either earmuffs or headphones.

title: Ladybug Miraculous
text:
Ladybug Miraculous - Abilities
When it's used to transform, the Ladybug Miraculous grants its holder a ladybug themed costume that they truly desire as well as incredible superhuman powers of strength, speed, agility, and endurance. Its special weapon is a yo-yo, which can be utilized as a weapon, a communicator, and a rebreather. Its special superpower is called Lucky Charm, it gives its user the ability to create a useful arbitrary object in order to obtain their goal, like defeating a supervillain. However, if the Ladybug Miraculous holder is a child, using Lucky Charm will force them to de-transform after five minutes. An evil holder can override this and use Lucky Charm indefinitely, but at a great cost.
The Ladybug Miraculous can also purify anything "corrupt or malignant".
Using the yo-yo, the holder traps the infection, an infected creature, or an infected object, so the yo-yo cures it. When the yo-yo opens, the infection is gone, and if there was an infected animal or object, it is healed or clean. The person can use the Miraculous' purification power on various things, like akumas created with the Butterfly Miraculous or an unknown black substance, as seen in fourth issue of Miraculous Adventures.

title: Ladybug Miraculous
text:
Ladybug Miraculous - Abilities
The other power is the Miraculous Ladybug. If there is damage caused by a supervillain, Cat Noir's Cataclysm, or any other Miraculous superpower, no matter the amount of damage, the holder throws the Lucky Charm object in the air and says Miraculous [the hero's name of the Ladybug Miraculous holder], the Lucky Charm turns into a swarm of magic ladybugs with restoration power that repair all damage from the recent crisis in an instant. The restoration power is also capable of healing those who are hurt by supervillains or their own powers, even going as far as to bring people back from non-existence.
If the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses are used together along with a special invocation, their holder will achieve the absolute power to alter reality to their wishes. However, because the universe must maintain balance, every action has an equal and opposite reaction; for instance, a wish to become human would result in someone else losing their humanity.
In "Troublemaker", Cat Noir suggested that when Ladybug lost an earring it weakened her powers but it's unknown if that is completely true.

title: Ladybug Miraculous
text:
Ladybug Miraculous - Abilities
Any user of the Ladybug Miraculous can use any Lucky Charm to summon Miraculous Ladybug even if they didn't summon the object, as seen with Ladybug in "Sandboy" and "Deflagration".
In "Mr. Pigeon 72", it's revealed that Ladybug Miraculous holders' powers are limited only by the limits they put on themselves and can develop new powers simply by allowing themselves to do so. Once Marinette Dupain-Cheng|Ladybug learned of this, she invented a new superpower for the Ladybug Miraculous: the ability to create Magical Charms to ward away akumas from anyone who is wearing them, protecting them from future akumatizations.
With this new power, whenever she summons a Lucky Charm, her costume gets upgraded, and it lasts until she throws the object to summon the Miraculous Ladybug. Once this is done, she is able to conjure a Magical Charm from her yo-yo.
The earrings also have the ability to give the wielder the costume they truly desire.

title: Ladybug Miraculous
text:
Ladybug Miraculous - Abilities
After Tikki consumes one of several special potions or a food made with one, and the Ladybug Miraculous holder transforms, or if they consume a special potion or a food made with them after they've transformed, they are able to unlock power-ups, an additional specific ability granted by each potion. So far, only seven potions have been shown, each with a unique color:
The green potion transforms Tikki into "Aqua Tikki" and grants its user the ability to breathe underwater and improves their swimming capability with flippers added on their feet.
The cyan potion transforms Tikki into "Stalac Tikki" and grants its user the ability to resist cold temperatures and to move freely on ice with ice skates on their feet.
The purple potion transforms Tikki into an unknown space form and grants it user the ability to move freely and breathe in high altitudes and space.
A red potion that grants unknown powers.
A yellow potion that grants unknown powers.
An orange potion that grants unknown powers.
A pink potion that grants unknown powers.

title: Ladybug Miraculous
text:
Ladybug Miraculous - History
Five thousand years ago, a mage successfully helped the kwamis to interact with humans by creating magic jewels, which were called Miraculouses. In order to repay the mage, and to live on the physical world alongside humans, the kwamis decided to help humanity by letting humans utilize their energy and powers through the Miraculous they were bonded with, which included Tikki and the Ladybug Miraculous.
At some point in time, all of the knowledge about the Miraculouses and their powers was written down in code in a book called the Grimoire, with very few people knowing how to decipher the code. Miracle Boxes were also created at an unknown time to store the dormant Miraculouses. To protect and distribute Miraculouses, the Order of the Guardians was formed and existed for many years. Throughout its existence, guardians trained younger generations to keep a watchful eye over the Miraculouses and the Grimoire, which were placed in the guardians' temple.
Many Ladybug holders throughout history used Tikki's power for good, including Piào Chóng in China, who started the legacy. Others include La Déesse Coccinelle, Scarlet Fate, Mudekudeku, and La Coccinelle.

title: Ladybug Miraculous
text:
Ladybug Miraculous - History
172 years ago, after an disastrous event where a young Wang Fu used the Peacock Miraculous to create a sentimonster and his negative emotions and imaturity led to the creature rampaging through the temple and eating and destroying everything in its path, Fu was entrusted with the Chinese Miracle Box (Which included the Ladybug Miraculous) by a monk and was told to run away from the mess. However, on the mountain range outside the temple, in order to escape from the the monster, Fu jumped over a fissure on the ground - accidently opening the Box and spilling all of its contents on the snow. Due to his distress, Fu didnt notice he accidently left both the Peacock and the Butterfly on the mountain, alongisde the Grimoire, until it was too late and he was too far away to come back. Somewhere along the line, the Peacock got dangerously damaged, to the point of being improper for use - but, as it turns out, no one knew of this fact until it was too late.

title: Ladybug Miraculous
text:
Ladybug Miraculous - History
On a previous trip overseas with the Agrestes, Nathalie found the Butterfly and Peacock Miraculouses and gave the jewels to Gabriel. In "Representation", it was revealed that neither the Agrestes nor the Graham de Vanily couples could bear children on their own, so Émilie and Colt used the Peacock Miraculous to create Adrien and Félix respectively, but in doing so, they grew sick over time and were eventually left in a condition where they fell into an eternal slumber due to using the Peacock Miraculous in its damaged state.
Desperate to fix his mistake, Gabriel Agreste began using the Butterfly Miraculous for evil to obtain the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses in order to gain access to their absolute power, becoming the supervillain Hawk Moth, later Shadow Moth (when unified with a now fixed Peacock Miraculous) and finally Monarch. This decision proved one of the most significant for the history of the series, as Gabriel began utilizing Nooroo's power to akumatize the civilians of Paris, France, trying to get one of them to draw out the current holders of the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses.

title: Ladybug Miraculous
text:
Ladybug Miraculous - History
Marinette Dupain-Cheng was ultimately chosen by Wang Fu to wield the Ladybug Miraculous in "Ladybug & Cat Noir", using it to transform into the heroine Ladybug, tasked with stopping Kawk Moth and his akumatized villains and recovering the Butterfly Miraculous back to the side of good. Throughout her journey as Ladybug, Marinette unified the Ladybug with the Mouse, Dragon, Bee, Horse, Rabbit, Butterfly (from the Re-Verse), Cat and Snake Miraculouses to transform into Multibug, Dragon Bug, Ladybee, Pegabug, Pennybug, Bunnybug, Bug Noire, and Viperbug. During the events of "Miraculous London", she briefly used Chronobug as her temporary identity while she, alongside Bunnyx, fought against Timestalker.
In "Reflekdoll", the earrings were used by Adrien Agreste, who used them to transform into Mister Bug, making him the second known male Ladybug Miraculous superhero. Adrien continues to utilize the Miraculous in special, highly specific situations whenever a swap is needed, like during "Passion".

title: Ladybug Miraculous
text:
Ladybug Miraculous - History
In "Cat Blanc", in an alternate timeline, Marinette and the Ladybug Miraculous were both accidently destroyed by a Cataclsym let out by the eponymous villain during a gigantic meltdown - however, the event was erased from existence after the intervention of Bunnyx.
In "Hack-San", Alya Césaire used the earrings to transform into Scarabella, and, after this episode, she became the official Ladybug holder stand-in during situations where Marinette would be unable to transform for whatever the reason, such as a trip or as part of a plan, like the one during "Revelation". In "Transmission", Alya became the primary holder of the Ladybug Miraculous after Tikki had set Marinette free from her mission so she could be in love with Adrien, but in "Deflagration", she had to renounce the offical title and relinquish the Miraculous back to Marinette after her own secret identity was compromised.

title: Ladybug Miraculous
text:
Ladybug Miraculous - History
Moreover, "Miraculous Paris" revealed other parallel universes and the users of the Ladybug Miraculous in them: an evil-turned-good alternate version of Marinette who was once Shadybug and then later became Ladybug; an alternate version of Alya Césaire who uses the earrings to transform into Scarabella; and an alternate version of Adrien Agreste who uses the Miraculous to become Mister Bug. Also in this special, to prevent Monarch from obtaining the Ladybug and Cat Miraculous from other universes, Betterfly sent a kamiko into Ladybug's earrings, causing them to become the kamikotized object of Ladybiquity.
In "Deflagration", Gabriel unifies the Ladybug Miraculous with the Butterfly Miraculous to become Monarch Bug, but he later lost them to the Resistance, so that Marinette could reclaim them to become Ladybug again.

title: Ladybug Miraculous
text:
Ladybug Miraculous - History
In "Re-creation", Gabriel managed to steal both Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses from Marinette and used them to summon Gimmi and make his wish of restoring Nathalie's health, at the cost of his own life, with Marinette recovering them both after the wish had been made. In "Miraculous London", Lila stole all of the Miraculous under Marinette's care in an alternate timeline, which included the Ladybug Miraculous, fusing it with the Cat to make her wish come true, but her plan was ultimately thwarted by the combined efforts of Chronobug and Bunnyx, and the event was erased from the timeline.

title: Ladybug Miraculous
text:
Ladybug Miraculous - History
After the events of "Miraculous London", Marinette, having realized both instances of all of the Miraculouses being stolen happened because all of them were kept in the same place, and with the idea that centralized power is inherently flawed, and that distributing it among members of a society is a far superior idea, upgraded the Ladybug Miraculous by adding the Miraculous Call: a call feature that grants the holder the ability to summon other superheroes who possess a Miraculous from the Chinese Miracle Box in order to receive aid on their missions. This new feaure is particularly useful, as the new holder of the Butterfly Miraculous, Chrysalis, is even more fearsome than her predecessor.

title: Ladybug Miraculous
text:
Ladybug Miraculous - History
In "Secret Protocol", it is revealed that Ladybug has created numerous security protocols in order to secure the Miraculers' safety. One such protocol is initiated whenever a situation where Marinette's secret identity is at risk arises. She orders Tikki to take the Ladybug Miraculous to Alya, so she can fuse it with the Fox Miraculous in order to become Rena Bug, using both powers of Creation and Illusion in the shadows to defuse the situation while creating a Mirage of Ladybug, so Marinette's identity is kept safe.
In "Nemesis", the Ladybug Miraculous became an integral part of a plan devised by Marinette, alongside Alya, to deal a direct attack against Chrysalis.
After creating an illusion of Marinette and giving it physical properties through Rooster Bold's Sublimation, Rena Rouge channeled her discontent after finding out about the lie Marinette told everyone and thus, created a perfect bait to attract Chrysalis' ultrakuma, transforming the tangibilized illusion into the titular villain; after a brief fight, Nemesis took the then-petrified earrings off a petrified Ladybug and, under Chrysalis' orders, took to the Fontaine du Trocadéro and left them inside the water; then.

a shapeshited Chrysalis came over in the form of a little boy, took the earrings off the water and put them inside a candy wrapper, taking the Miraculous across town all the way to the Parisian Catacombs - leaving the wrapper in specific locations and coming back as different forms to take it further to her lair in order to avoid being followed; when she finally reached the Catacombs, she ordered Nemesis to depetrify Ladybug and thus the earrings, becoming shocked and delighted as they turned out to be the real thing after Tikki was ejected from them; her victory was short-lived tho, as a Polymouse shrunken duplicate was revealed to be hidden onto the back of one of the earrings the whole time and had activated her shared location to the rest of the Miraculers; immediatly, Miss Hound's Fetch was activated, and she recovered the earrings, and they were finally given back to Marinette.

title: Ladybug Miraculous
text:
Ladybug Miraculous - Trivia
In the theme song, the Ladybug Miraculous are in the raised center of the Mother Box with the Cat Miraculous, both of their sections creating a yin-yang symbol inside the box.
The Ladybug Miraculous is in the yin section (like in every yin-yang symbol there's also some of each in the other). Some of the things that yin represents are coldness, darkness, passiveness, and intuition (which interprets the Cat Miraculous).
Ladybugs are known to be symbols of good luck, resilience, and love.
In "Volpina", the legacy of Ladybug Miraculous holders dates all the way back to Ancient China.
The Ladybug Miraculous and the Goat Miraculous are so far the only known Miraculouses that have two or more pieces, all of which need to be worn for them to work.
As seen in "The Dark Owl", if one of the earrings is taken, the suit will slowly dematerialize, though the yo-yo remains.
When the left earring was taken, the dematerialization began with the right side of the mask and the right hand, showing Marinette's bare skin.

title: Ladybug Miraculous
text:
Ladybug Miraculous - Trivia
In "Troublemaker", the left earring was taken, and the dematerialization began with the left side of the mask, both forearms, and both shins. Additionally, a high pitch beeping was emitted from the earrings. As the suit dematerialized, Marinette's body, excluding the face, was covered with pink energy. When the earring was returned, the missing parts completed themselves, and the beeping stopped.
In the early concept for the series, including before kwamis were created, the earrings gave pure luck to its wearer. However, as Thomas Astruc explained, "it only works when [the wearer uses] it for others. Otherwise, it backfires".
Because broadcasters believed pure luck as a power was "too abstract for kids", Thomas figured out a different superpower, Lucky Charm.
In "Re-creation", Monarch said that he couldn't akumatize Marinette because of her outrageous good luck, when actually, she described it as "Luck is something you make", meaning that the Ladybug Miraculous doesn't actually bless the user with good luck, but teaches the user to use their creativity, ingenuity, adaptability and more to make their own luck.

title: Ladybug Miraculous
text:
Ladybug Miraculous - Trivia
The design of the earrings was different in the Ladybug PV and early CGI animation. In them, the earrings had gold outlines around the edges of the earring and the black spots.
In "The Pharaoh", Ladybug gives Pharaoh a fake pair of earrings that more closely resemble the earlier design.
Then again, for a staged battle for Mr Damoclès as The Owl in "The Dark Owl", Marinette creates a fake replica of the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses, which she later used as Ladybug to trick Mr. Damoclès' akumatized form and Hawk Moth.
The Ladybug Miraculous is sometimes called The Earrings of the Ladybug.
Thomas Astruc stated that he might include previous Ladybugs into the show if he finds a good story for them.
Like for Khepri as La Déesse Coccinelle in "The Pharaoh", when Tikki mention the past Ladybugs in "Befana", Jeanne d'Arc as Scarlet Fate, who appears in the present due to the side-effect of Sass' Second Chance in "Ephemeral" as well as in spirit memory in "Reunion" and the Ancient European Ladybug Miraculous holder in "Feast".
In the NYCC 2016, the Ladybug Miraculous seems to have other magical abilities. These abilities seem to be related to objects known as Stones and Pearls.

title: Ladybug Miraculous
text:
Ladybug Miraculous - Trivia
Stone of the Sun - Flying power
Pearl of the Mysteries - Infinite Lucky Charms
Pearl of the Heart - Cure the akumatized
Pearl of the Sea - Breathe and swim underwater
Stone of the Moon - Fly and breathe in space
However, Thomas later confirmed on Twitter that the Pearls and Stones are a concept that won't be featured in the show anymore. The Pearl of the Sea power was replaced by the green Miraculous potion and the Stone of the Moon power was also replaced by the purple Miraculous potion.
Micazoyolin is the first male known to have wielded the Ladybug Miraculous, Adrien Agreste is the second known male to have wielded the Ladybug Miraculous when he used it to turn temporarily into Mister Bug after an incident causes a mix up of the Miraculous in "Reflekdoll". Gabriel became the third known male to wear the Ladybug Miraculous when he unified it with the Butterfly Miraculous, becoming Monarch Bug in "Deflagration".
Marinette is the only Ladybug Miraculous holder who's also a guardian, due to the rule against guardians wearing Miraculous.
The Ladybug Miraculous users are the only ones who can purify akumas and amoks.

title: Ladybug Miraculous
text:
Ladybug Miraculous - Trivia
The Ladybug Miraculous is the second Miraculous that has been unified with the most Miraculouses at seven: the Mouse, Dragon, Bee, Horse, Rabbit, Butterfly, and Cat Miraculouses.
The Ladybug Miraculous is also the Miraculous with the most seen unifications with eight: Marinette as Multimouse unified the Mouse with the Ladybug to become Multibug in "Kwamibuster", as Ladybug, she also unified the Ladybug with the Dragon to become Dragonbug in "Miracle Queen" and “Sleeping Syren”, the Bee to become Ladybee in "Optigami, "the Horse to become Pegabug in "Sentibubbler", the Horse and Rabbit to become Pennybug in "Strikeback", the Butterfly to become Ladyfly in "Miraculous Paris", the Cat to become Bug Noire in "The Last Day", the Snake to become Viperbug in “Mister Agreste”, and the Rabbit to become Bunnybug in “The Dark Castle”. Gabriel as Monarch also unified the Butterfly with the Ladybug to become Monarch Bug in "Deflagration".
It's unknown if all Ladybug Miraculous users were chosen to stop evil Miraculous users like Marinette with Hawk Moth.

title: Ladybug Miraculous
text:
Ladybug Miraculous - Trivia
In "Reunion", what is mentioned above is not always the case as Scarlet Fate and Dark Grimalkin were tricked into fighting each other when they figured that out they stopped fighting. Not just that, but Scarlet Fate was chosen to wield the Ladybug Miraculous in the first place to level the scales of the war between England (that had a Miraculous holder as a champion) and France (that had no Miraculous holder).
This means that some of the Ladybug Miraculous holders were chosen to balance the actions of other holders, being it for evil or not: Scarlet Fate to counter Dark Grimalkin's power of Destruction (possibly to prevent it from going too far) and Ladybug to counter Hawk Moth's akumatized villains (as only her power could purify akumas and fix all the damages caused by them).
In "Cat Blanc", the Ladybug Miraculous was destroyed alongside Marinette due to the titular akumatized supervillain's Mega Cataclysm hitting her and Ladybug from the past accidentally causing her to disintegrate in an alternate timeline. However, the timeline was then fixed by Ladybug from the past, making so that it was never destroyed in the current timeline.

title: Ladybug Miraculous
text:
Ladybug Miraculous - Trivia
As of "Mr. Pigeon 72", Marinette is the first Ladybug Miraculous holder to develop new superpowers, let alone figure out that her power is limitless.
It's the seventh Miraculous used for evil, even if briefly and/or in an alternate reality following
The Butterfly Miraculous by Gabriel as Hawk Moth in season 1, 2, and 3, as Shadow Moth in Season 4 and as Monarch in Season 5.
The Bee Miraculous briefly by Chloé as Queen Bee when she was akumatized into Queen Wasp in "Queen Wasp" and "Heroes' Day" and when she was akumatized into Miracle Queen in the episode of the same name.
The Fox Miraculous by Alya as Rena Rouge when she was akumatized into Rena Rage in "Heroes' Day".
The Turtle Miraculous by Nino as Carapace when he was akumatized into Shell Shock in "Heroes' Day" and by Sentinino as Senticarapace in "Optigami".
The Peacock Miraculous by Nathalie as Mayura in the episode of the same name, "Reflekdoll", "Miraculer", "Feast", "Ladybug", and "Battle of the Miraculous" followed by Shadow Moth.

title: Ladybug Miraculous
text:
Ladybug Miraculous - Trivia
The Cat Miraculous in the alternate future by Adrien as Cat Noir when he was akumatized into Cat Blanc in the name sake episode and by Gabriel as Shadow Noir in an alternative timeline in "Ephemeral".
The Eagle Miraculous by Mike Rochip as Miraclonizer in "Miraculous New York".
Alongside the Ox Miraculous, it is unknown if the wearer actually needs to have pierced ears in order to wear the Miraculous, or if the pins just pass through the wearers ears magically, though since Adrien and Gabriel (despite not having ear piercings) were having no trouble wearing the earrings in "Reflekdoll", "Passion", "Deflagration" and "Re-creation", it's most likely not necessary for either of the jewels.
At the very least, Marinette is confirmed to have pierced ears in "Secret Protocol", as she's seen wearing earrings other than the Ladybug Miraculous.
The Ladybug Miraculous is the only Miraculous in the Chinese Miracle Box to not get an episode titled after its concept in season 5. However, the finale is called Re-creation.

title: Ladybug (episode)
text:
Ladybug (episode) - Intro
"Ladybug" is a season 3 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "Ladybug" is the 24th written and produced episode of season 3. It is also the 76th written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Ladybug (episode)
text:
Ladybug (episode) - Synopsis
Marinette's scheming nemesis Lila manipulates all of her friends into turning against her and even gets Marinette expelled from school.
Disney Channel
Lila manipulates all Marinette's close ones, who turn against her, but an even bigger problem awaits Marinette; she is going to have to face a sentimonster that has taken the appearance of Ladybug.
Disney+
Ladybug faces... Ladybug!

title: Ladybug (episode)
text:
Ladybug (episode) - Plot
In a flashback taking place before the events of "Befana", Adrien makes a lucky bracelet for Marinette. He asks Plagg what he thinks of it, but Plagg insists that a gift that doesn't have a scent or can't be eaten is no good. At dinner, Adrien asks his father what he thinks of the bracelet, explaining that it is a birthday gift for Marinette and that his whole class is organizing a surprise party for her. Gabriel reminds Adrien that he never gave him permission to go to the party, but when Adrien pleads with him, he agrees.
In the present, Gabriel approaches Lila at the park in his car and reminds her that she was supposed to be protecting Adrien from Marinette, the one she called a bad influence. Lila says that her plan is taking longer than expected but promises that he won't be disappointed. She also asks if he'll keep his promise if she succeeds. Gabriel insists that he always honors his agreements and then leaves. In the car, Nathalie tells Gabriel that he works too hard, but Gabriel tells her that it isn't the time to ease up.

title: Ladybug (episode)
text:
Ladybug (episode) - Plot
As Miss Bustier's class enters the classroom, Marinette overhears Lila tell Nathaniel that she's friends with the best manga publisher in Japan and can talk to him about his comic. Marinette calls Lila a liar, but Alya tells her to stop obsessing over her. Miss Bustier announces that she graded the class's mock exams, but before she can hand them back, she needs to check Marinette's schoolbag for something. After Marinette brings her bag to her, Miss Bustier reveals that someone left an anonymous note claiming that she'd stolen the test answers. Looking inside Marinette's bag, she finds the answers there. The whole class is shocked, but Marinette insists that she didn't steal anything and that someone put those answers in her bag.

title: Ladybug (episode)
text:
Ladybug (episode) - Plot
However, Miss Bustier points out that Marinette answered every question correctly. Marinette insists that's because she studied, and Alya points out that Marinette always does well on tests. When Lila tells Marinette that she's usually so well-behaved, Marinette realizes that she's the one who put the answers in her bag and calls her out on it. Lila pretends to be offended, and Miss Bustier tells Marinette that she can't accuse someone without proof. Though Marinette insists that Lila stole the test answers, Miss Bustier doesn't believe her since Lila got the lowest grade in the class. The entire class comes to Marinette's defense, pointing out that she'd never cheat, so Miss Bustier sends Marinette and Lila to the principal's office to straighten everything out.
On the way there, Lila reminds Marinette that she'd promised to make her life miserable. Marinette tells Lila that she won't fall for any of her traps, but Lila whispers that she already has. She goes to the bottom of the stairs and pretends to have hurt her leg, claiming that Marinette had pushed her. Denis Damoclès hears this and angrily tells Marinette to come into his office.

title: Ladybug (episode)
text:
Ladybug (episode) - Plot
In the principal's office, though Marinette insists that she didn't do anything, Lila tells Denis Damoclès that she doesn't understand why Marinette doesn't like her as she always calling her a liar and pushed her down the stairs. She also claims that Marinette stole a fox pendant she'd received from her grandmother. Tom and Sabine refuse to believe that their daughter stole anything, so Lila takes them to the locker room to prove her claims. Denis Damoclès tells Marinette to open her locker, and when she does, Lila's pendant is found inside. Marinette insists that Lila is lying and turns to Adrien for help. He almost says something to Denis Damoclès, but Denis Damoclès expels Marinette from school, much to the shock of all her classmates.

title: Ladybug (episode)
text:
Ladybug (episode) - Plot
Hawk Moth is pleased with the chaos Lila has created. As part of the next phase of his plan, he akumatizes Nathalie into Catalyst, and Catalyst turns Hawk Moth into Scarlet Moth. Scarlet Moth makes multiple akumas and sends them after Marinette and her friends. The akumas infect several students and staff inside the locker room, including Marinette and Sabine. While the others are turned back into their akumatized selves, Scarlet Moth prepares to turn Marinette and Sabine into Princess Justice and Verity Queen with the power to expose the truth in exchange for Ladybug's and Cat Noir's Miraculouses. Marinette almost removes her earrings, but Catalyst then begins to cough violently. Scarlet Moth rushes to her aid and drops his transformation, resulting in everyone being deakumatized.

title: Ladybug (episode)
text:
Ladybug (episode) - Plot
In Marinette's room, Tikki tells Marinette that if she'd been akumatized, nothing would have stopped her from handing her Miraculous over to Hawk Moth. Marinette knows that she's right and insists that she won't let neither Lila nor Hawk Moth win. She vows to prove her innocence but wishes that Alya could help her. Tikki points out that Alya hadn't been akumatized and is sure it's because she trusts her, so Marinette calls her. Alya points out the facts: Marinette is accused of stealing the mock exam answers, and the evidence is that the answers were found in her bag. Marinette is also accused of pushing Lila down the stairs, and although no one saw this, they did see Lila at the bottom of said stairs. Furthermore, Marinette is accused of stealing Lila's pendant as it was found inside her locker.

title: Ladybug (episode)
text:
Ladybug (episode) - Plot
Marinette sarcastically thanks Alya for her help, but Alya insists that she trusts her and is just pointing out that the evidence is stacked against her. However, she offers to investigate the matter, and Marinette happily thanks her. Sabine then comes in and asks to speak to Marinette, so she hangs up. Sabine tells Marinette that although she and Tom love her, the whole situation is very complicated, and until they find a new school for her, she should help with the bakery. Marinette insists that she didn't do anything and asks how she'll be able to prove her innocence if she's spending all her time in the bakery. Tom insists that it's fun and hands her an apron.
At the Agreste mansion, a doctor tells Gabriel to make sure Nathalie gets a lot of rest. After she leaves, Nathalie tells Gabriel that he can still take advantage of the chaos Lila created, but Gabriel says that plan is pointless without her. He decides that there should be no more Catalyst or Mayura as the damaged Peacock Miraculous is affecting her health badly. Nathalie insists that she doesn't care as she wants to help him, but Gabriel refuses. Meanwhile at Collège Françoise Dupont, Alya investigates for Marinette.

title: Ladybug (episode)
text:
Ladybug (episode) - Plot
Later, when Gabriel is asleep, Nathalie takes the Peacock Miraculous from him, buys an Eiffel Tower keychain at Place des Vosges, and then goes down the sewers. She puts the Peacock Miraculous on, and Duusu is delighted to see Nathalie feeling better, though he takes his comment back when Nathalie starts coughing. Nathalie tells Duusu that she's going to create a very powerful sentimonster. Duusu tells her not to as she should be resting, but Nathalie declares that she wants to be the one to give Gabriel Ladybug's and Cat Noir's Miraculouses. Duusu calls Nathalie's dedication romantic, and Nathalie transforms into Mayura. She then creates an amok and places it inside the Eiffel Tower keychain, creating a sentimonster that is an identical copy of Ladybug. Mayura tells her that she's Cat Noir's true teammate with one goal: to get a hold of the Miraculous. Sentimonster Ladybug agrees.

title: Ladybug (episode)
text:
Ladybug (episode) - Plot
At the bakery, Tom teaches Marinette how to bake. In the middle of his lesson, Alya calls. Marinette asks if she can answer, but Tom hangs up and tells Marinette that they aren't finished. Alya leaves a message for Marinette claiming that she found no fingerprints or evidence. Adrien overhears and immediately realizes that Lila is behind Marinette's expulsion. He prepares to confront her, but then he hears that Ladybug is fighting Mayura at Arc de Triomphe. So he hides inside Ms. Mendeleiev's classroom, transforms into Cat Noir, and heads to Arc de Triomphe. He witnesses Mayura injure Ladybug and rushes to her aid, unaware that she is a sentimonster.

title: Ladybug (episode)
text:
Ladybug (episode) - Plot
While working at the bakery, Marinette hears that Ladybug is fighting Mayura at Arc de Triomphe. Recognizing it as one of Hawk Moth's traps, Marinette looks for a way to get out of baking. She covers herself in flour and asks her dad if she can wash up, but Tom says that getting dirty is alright and she can wash up after she's done decorating the gingerbread men. So Marinette quickly decorates them. Meanwhile, the sentimonster pretends to be injured and "confesses" to Cat Noir that she's always had feelings for him. She leans in for a kiss while secretly trying to steal his ring, but then the real Ladybug shows up and stops her. However, the Ladybug sentimonster insists that she's the real Ladybug. Cat Noir believes that the real Ladybug is just an illusion and throws his staff at her, but Ladybug catches it and says that she's real before throwing the staff back at him. Cat Noir is perplexed by the appearance of two Ladybugs.

title: Ladybug (episode)
text:
Ladybug (episode) - Plot
The sentimonster claims that the other Ladybug is a fan akumatized by Hawk Moth. Frustrated that Cat Noir keeps falling for her manipulation, the real Ladybug "admits" to being a fake but tells Cat Noir that she won't let him Cataclysm her earrings. Cat Noir prepares to do just that, but Mayura comes out and shouts at him not to damage the earrings, revealing which Ladybug is real. Mayura orders the sentimonster to steal the Miraculouses and not to hold back, so she calls on her Senti-Charm and receives a large blaster. Ladybug calls on her Lucky Charm and receives a fork. The four then engage in battle.
Gabriel wakes up and is shocked to discover that Nathalie is missing. He then takes his phone, and sees the news that Mayura is fighting Ladybug and Cat Noir. He asks Nooroo why he didn't wake him up, to which Nooroo says that he couldn't bring himself to as Gabriel was sleeping so peacefully, much to Gabriel's annoyance. Meanwhile at Arc de Triomphe, Ladybug uses the fork to scratch a piece of glass, creating a noise so loud that it forces both of her enemies to cover their ears, causing the latter to drop the keychain that allows her to control the former.

title: Ladybug (episode)
text:
Ladybug (episode) - Plot
Ladybug seizes the opportunity to grab the Eiffel Tower keychain. She prepares to remove the amok. She then realizes that there is nothing monstrous about Sentimonster Ladybug as whoever possesses the object holding the amok controls the sentimonster and she couldn't help but follow orders. Ladybug gives her doppelganger the keychain, declaring her free, and asks for her help in defeating Mayura. The Ladybug sentimonster agrees and the new trio of heroes advance on Mayura. Cat Noir becomes joyful now with two of his crushes. However, the cornered Mayura reacts by using her powers to revoke the amok, effectively destroying her in front of the horrified Ladybug and Cat Noir.
Furious with Mayura for destroying sentimonster Ladybug, Cat Noir lunges to attack her, but Hawk Moth shows up and kicks him away.
He mocks the two for being sentimental about a sentimonster, though Cat Noir calls him the real monster.
The duo fight him, and Hawk Moth winds up getting a hold of Cat Noir while Ladybug gets a hold of Mayura.
Hawk Moth prepares to take Cat Noir's ring, but Cat Noir calls on Cataclysm before he can.

title: Ladybug (episode)
text:
Ladybug (episode) - Plot
Ladybug tells Hawk Moth that she's going to take the Peacock Miraculous from Mayura, but Hawk Moth reminds her that all he has to do is wait a few minutes until the two of them transform back.
Therefore, Hawk Moth throws Cat Noir while Ladybug throws Mayura.
Ladybug and Hawk Moth run after their own friends, before both glaring angrily at each other.
While Hawk Moth goes to get Mayura, Ladybug catches Cat Noir.
Cat Noir tells Ladybug that she had Mayura right where she wanted her and that he could've managed by himself, but Ladybug insists that Ladybug by herself doesn't sound right.
Cat Noir leans in for a kiss, but Ladybug reminds him that she's still in love with someone else.
She then uses Miraculous Ladybug to fix the damage.
However, Cat Noir notes that Miraculous Ladybug couldn't bring back the sentimonster, and Ladybug disappointingly agrees that the Peacock Miraculous is even more cruel than the Butterfly Miraculous when used wrongly.

title: Ladybug (episode)
text:
Ladybug (episode) - Plot
At the Agreste mansion, an upset Gabriel scolds Nathalie for disobeying him and putting herself in danger for nothing. Nathalie coughs a bit as her glasses fall to the ground. Gabriel takes the glasses and puts them back on her. He admits that her plan was brilliant, but she does not need a Miraculous to help him. Nathalie reminds Gabriel that he also needed Mayura to help him find the guardian and gives him the Peacock Miraculous, stating that if he ever needs Mayura again, she'll be there for him.

title: Ladybug (episode)
text:
Ladybug (episode) - Plot
Later, Adrien goes to his photo shoot and is surprised to find Lila there. Vincent explains that she is Gabriel's new muse and will be doing the photo shoot with him. Adrien asks for a few minutes alone with her. Still upset with her for hurting the one he loves, he sits besides her and tells Lila that she didn't listen to his previous warning as she hurt his friend, Marinette, which he doesn't find okay. Lila attempts to insist that she didn't do anything, but Adrien tells Lila that although he can't prove she lied because she's really skilled at it, he forces her to tell another lie to prove Marinette's innocence. Lila asks why she'd do that, to which Adrien replies in a threatening way by reminding her that they're friends. Lila looks towards Nathalie, who approvingly nods.

title: Ladybug (episode)
text:
Ladybug (episode) - Plot
At Collège Françoise Dupont, Lila tells Denis Damoclès that she has a rare disease that sometimes causes her to lie compulsively and apologizes to Marinette. Denis Damoclès is touched by Lila's "confession" and allows Marinette back into school. Outside his office, Marinette tells Lila that although she doesn't know why she felt the urge to start drama and then later fix it, she's glad to see that at least she can occasionally come to her senses. However, Lila reminds Marinette that it's like she said: "things aren't always what they seem to be at first sight", confirming that their war isn't over.
Later at Marinette's house, Tom bakes a cake to celebrate Marinette's return to school, stating that he knew all along that she was innocent. However, Marinette sees on TV that Lila was in Adrien's latest photo shoot and is shocked, though Sabine is happy to see that Lila's "disease" doesn't stop her from achieving her dreams. The end card then appears.

title: Ladybug (episode)/Transcript
text:
Ladybug (episode)/Transcript - Intro
[ Theme Song ]
Adrien: What do you think, Plagg?
Plagg: (smells it) Ugh, what's the point of giving someone something that can't be eaten and doesn't have a scent? If you gave me that, I'd be seriously offended.
Adrien: Maybe I should get a second opinion.
Gabriel: What is it?
Adrien: It's a gift I've made for Marinette. We're organizing a surprise birthday party for her.
Gabriel: Marinette?
Adrien: You know, the girl who won the fashion contest? She made the hat I wore for your show. She's a really awesome girl. She loves helping others-
Gabriel: I don't remember giving you permission to go to your friend's birthday party.
Adrien: Please, Father! Marinette deserves to have all her friends there.
(Gabriel glances at Nathalie and she nods)
Gabriel: Alright then.
Adrien: Thank you, Father.
Marinette: Ah...
Adrien: I always carry the lucky charm you gave me wherever I go, and I think it works pretty well. So..
(Lila angrily watches the party from her bedroom window)
Gabriel: I thought you were supposed to protect Adrien from Marinette. The one you said was a bad influence.

Lila: My plan is taking a little longer than expected, sir. But you won't be disappointed.
Lila: Will you keep your promise if I succeed?
Gabriel: I always honor my commitments. (car drives away)

Gabriel: Now's not the time to ease up, Nathalie.

I need to check something. (Marinette does so) Today, someone placed an anonymous note in my mailbox, claiming that you'd stolen the exam answers, and it looks like the anonymous person was right! (Everyone gasps)
Marinette: But that's not true! Someone must've planted that piece of paper in my bag!

title: Ladybug (sentimonster)
text:
Ladybug (sentimonster) - Intro
Ladybug was the titular secondary antagonist of the episode "Ladybug".
She was a human sentimonster in the likeness of the real Ladybug manifested by Mayura from her own dedication to Hawk Moth with the intention of tricking Cat Noir. The latter considered her to be the most powerful sentimonster that had ever existed. However, after receiving her freedom, she betrayed Mayura and sided with the real Ladybug and Cat Noir. Her Amok was revoked shortly after by her own creator, releasing her from existence.

title: Ladybug (sentimonster)
text:
Ladybug (sentimonster) - Appearance
Physical appearance
Like the true Ladybug, the Ladybug sentimonster had light scarlet lipstick on her lips, light freckles on both sides and the bridge of her nose, vivid azure eyes, and medium-length black hair with dark blue reflections. Her hair tied back in two pigtails, with red ribbons holding them. She wore a red turtlenecked ladybug themed-jumpsuit covered in black spots with a black collar. On her face was a red mask with five black spots that were in a symmetrical design. Her earrings were red with five black spots in a quincunx pattern.

title: Ladybug (sentimonster)
text:
Ladybug (sentimonster) - Personality
Compared to other sentimonsters, the Ladybug sentimonster was far more advanced, capable of complex thought and emotion and showing a highly developed degree of sentience and even free will. While she followed Mayura's orders and acted as Cat Noir's dream partner to manipulate him, she didn't have a choice. Once she was granted her freedom, she was grateful for her freedom and decided to help the heroes defeat her creator, at the cost of her own short life.

title: Ladybug (sentimonster)
text:
Ladybug (sentimonster) - Abilities
As sentimonster
Being a sentimonster created with the emotion of dedication, the Ladybug sentimonster had the same abilities as the real Ladybug, including enhanced speed and agility. She had her own yo-yo, which she used both offensively and defensively.
Also, like the real Ladybug having the Lucky Charm, the Ladybug sentimonster had her own special superpower to summon objects called "Senti-Charm." Unlike the Lucky Charm, which gives the real Ladybug random, inherently ordinary objects, her Senti-Charm gave her dangerous things. In "Ladybug" she got a large blaster that shot red and black ball-like rockets filled with an adhesive substance.

title: Ladybug (sentimonster)
text:
Ladybug (sentimonster) - Trivia
She was the first character in the series to be both directly and permanently killed by a villain.
She was the first Sentimonster to possess a humanoid/human appearance and intelligence.
This is due to her uniqueness of being the most powerful Sentimonster ever created, as stated by Mayura before she created her.
Aside from Robostus, she was the second supporting villain/monster turned to betray a main villain.
She is the only known Sentimonster to do that, although the Dormant Sentimonster briefly rebelled.
She is also the first supporting villain/monster to side with the heroes.
​​She was the fourth known Sentimonster to have control of herself, at least at the end, following the Dormant Sentimonster, Félix Fathom and Kagami Tsurugi.
While faking to be injured by Mayura, she told Cat Noir: "Cat Noir, I don't feel so good.", which is a reference to Spider-Man's quote in Avengers: Infinity War where he says the exact same thing to Iron Man after a certain event instigated at the end of the movie.

title: Ladybug & Cat Noir: The Movie/Transcript
text:
Ladybug & Cat Noir: The Movie/Transcript - Intro
Tikki:♪ There's no time ♪♪ If you don't know, I do ♪♪ You are Ladybug ♪(Tikki flies into Marinette's heart changing her into Ladybug)
(Marinette looks at herself in the mirror as Ladybug and touching her cheeks, screams in terror)
Night Guard: The one night. The one night I have off and they call me.
(Looking around the area)
Night Guard: There's gonna be hell to pay, I tell ya! Oh, yeah! They're gonna hear me tomorrow.
(Hearing a noise)
Night Guard: Huh? (scoffing) There's nothing to report. What a waste of my time! Wait... (hearing a noise) What is that? (looks to the villain and shrieks)
Ladybug: Wow...
(Noticing a yo-yo she tries to toss it but it does nothing)
Ladybug: First a song, now a yo-yo? What's next, a tea set?
(Then the yo-yo starts to move on it's own twirling around her and sending her through a chimney.)
(Ladybug screams out of a chimney as she's rushing to the Notre Dame.)
(Ladybug slams into Cat Noir, and they both crash through a stained glass window, and get trapped by Ladybug's yoyo.)
Ladybug: (confused) Where... am I?
(Looks below and screams)
Cat Noir: (clears throat) Bonjour.
(The yoyo loosens, sending the heroes plummeting to the ground of the Notre Dame.)

title: Ladybug & Cat Noir: The Movie/Transcript
text:
Ladybug & Cat Noir: The Movie/Transcript - Intro
(Cat Noir lands effortlessly, while Ladybug lands on her face. Bats fly away.)
Ladybug: (groans and sits upright)
Cat Noir: (somewhere out of sight) What do you think you're doing?
Ladybug: (looks around and stands up) I'm...
Cat Noir: This is a dangerous place for a young lady.
Ladybug: (slightly annoyed) Excuse me, I'm no damsel in distress. (looks around some more) Who even are you?
Cat Noir: Name's Cat Noir.
Ladybug: Do I know you?
Cat Noir: I'm the new hero in town. Here, to save the world.
Ladybug: (snorts and makes air quotes with hands) HA! With what, furballs?
Cat Noir: (appears to Ladybug's left) And what are you supposed to be? A watermelon?
Ladybug: (glares daggers) EXCUSE ME?
Cat Noir: (walks away) Guess... that'll work for a sidekick.
Ladybug: (infuriated) What?! I'm... here to save the world. (huffs as flung up yoyo bonks her on the head) ...Too.
Cat Noir: (amused) I can see that. (jumps from a statue back to the ground.) Coming in here all loud and messy, (knock down a vase) giving away your every move.
(Cat noir knocks over a large candle holder, which lands on the ground with a loud clang. Ladybug looks panicked.)
Ladybug: So much for the element of surprise!

title: Ladybug & Cat Noir: The Movie/Transcript
text:
Ladybug & Cat Noir: The Movie/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: Ever heard of a decoy?
Ladybug: I don't understand what's happening. This is all wrong.
Cat Noir: All you have to do is follow my lead sidekick.
Ladybug: I'm not a side-
(Hearing a noise)
Cat Noir: Shhhh.... Don't move.
(Gargoyle growling as it's shadow is outside but the heroes turn around to see nothing there.)
Ladybug: (quietly) Do you have a plan?
Cat Noir: A plan? (scoffing) Do I have a plan? I have more than a plan.
(Ladybug smiles)
Cat Noir: I have nine lives.
(She then frowns)
(Then a footstep is heard)
Cat Noir: (Showing off) The devastating power of Destruction.
(The gargoyle slinks closer)
Cat Noir: Night Vision.
(Leaning towards Ladybug)
Cat Noir: Sharp senses! (imitating a cat then backs away) Nothing can sneak up on me.
(Ladybug tries to point out to Cat Noir that something is behind him.)
Cat Noir: Not to mention my weapon. (pulling out his stick) This all in one thingamajiggy (extending it) Ready for take down.
(Realizing he poked the nose of a gargoyle with it)
Cat Noir: RUN!
(The hero runs with the gargoyle chasing him)
Cat Noir: Yelp, not on the first date.
Ladybug: It looks like you guys have it off pretty well.

title: Ladybug & Cat Noir: The Movie/Transcript
text:

Cat Noir: I've got this, sidekick! (ducks and the gargoyle crashes into it)
Cat Noir: (standing up chuckling) And the winner is (vocalizing) Cat Noir!
(But the gargoyle slams into him knocking Cat Noir and heading to the other side of the room with the hero ending up on its back)
Cat Noir: (Hanging on) Sidekick! What are you doing back there? Help me! It's my first time.

Ladybug: Huh?

(crowd gasps)

Cat Noir: Told ya.
(The gargoyle takes off into the sky taking the heroes with him)
Ladybug: For a so-called cat you don't seem to land on your feet.
(The gargoyle crashes through church buildings with Ladybug still tailgating behind but she hits slams into several church bells)
Cat Noir: That's music to my ears!
(Ladybug screams)

title: Ladybug & Cat Noir: The Movie Original Soundtrack
text:
Ladybug & Cat Noir: The Movie Original Soundtrack - Intro
(in French "Miraculous: Le Film, La Bande Originale") is the official soundtrack to the animated musical, released by Muzeek One under the TF1 Musique label and ZAG.
The French soundtrack was released on June 30, 2023 in France and contain 15 songs from the movie and the opening theme song from the series.
The English soundtrack was released on July 5, 2023 in the Netherlands by IDOL and contained 10 songs from the movie, including a remix of the opening theme of the series and 28 compositions from the movie by Jeremy Zag.
A second version of the English soundtrack with slightly different vocal recordings and mixing for the songs was released in the US and internationally on July 28, 2023 by 22D Music, also containing the same 38 titles.

title: Ladybug Miraculous/Movie
text:
Ladybug Miraculous/Movie - Intro
The Ladybug Miraculous is are earrings that, whenever Tikki inhabits them, transforms their wearer into a ladybug-themed superhero/supervillain with the power of Creation.
The earrings are currently owned by Marinette Dupain-Cheng, who uses them to transform into Ladybug.

title: Ladybug Miraculous/Movie
text:
Ladybug Miraculous/Movie - Appearance
In charged mode, the Ladybug Miraculous is a pair of domed stud earrings with silver bezels. The domes are red with five black spots in a quincunx pattern. Their shape and pattern resemble ladybug elytron.
In camouflage mode of Marinette Dupain-Cheng, it's the same as its charged mode, but the domes are black.

title: Ladybug Miraculous/Movie
text:
Ladybug Miraculous/Movie - Abilities
When it's used to transform, the Ladybug Miraculous grants its holder a ladybug themed costume that they truly desire as well as incredible superhuman powers of strength, speed, agility, and endurance. Its special tool is a yo-yo, which can be utilized as a weapon. If the Cat Miraculous holder needs to communicate or help of the Ladybug Miraculous holder, it will start to glow constantly a bright pink as a sign to transform.
The Ladybug Miraculous can also purify anything corrupt or malignant.
Using the yo-yo, the holder traps the infected creature, so the yo-yo cures it. When the yo-yo opens, the infection is gone, and if there was an infected animal, it is healed or clean. The person can use the Miraculous' purification power on various things, like akumas created with the Butterfly Miraculous.

title: Ladybug Miraculous/Movie
text:
Ladybug Miraculous/Movie - Abilities
Its special superpower is called Miraculous Ladybug. The holder charges their hands with an aurora like pink energy that spreads out to repair all damage from the recent crisis in an instant, no matter its cause, be it damage caused by a supervillain, Cat Noir's Cataclysm, or any other Miraculous superpower. The restoration power is also capable of healing those who are hurt by supervillains or their own powers.
If the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses are unified, their holder will achieve the absolute power to alter reality to their wishes..

title: Ladybug Miraculous/Movie
text:
Ladybug Miraculous/Movie - Differences
It's possible the Lucky Charm doesn't exist at all.
But it's unknown if the warning system still works if only one is activate while the other isn't.

title: Ladybug's Secret
text:
Ladybug's Secret - Intro
(French: Le secret de Ladybug) is a film project produced by Noé Luxus. Inspired by real events, this film told the true story behind the reign of Gabriel Agreste and Hawk Moth.

title: Ladybug's Secret
text:
Ladybug's Secret - Synopsis
One dark night, a journalist overhears a conversation between Ladybug, Cat Noir, and Hawk Moth. He thus discovers the truth behind Hawk Moth's reign and the true Machiavellian nature of Ladybug and her henchman. The journalist then embarks on a fight for the truth, gaining the support of Gabriel Agreste. Unfortunately, Ladybug and Cat Noir are willing to do anything to maintain their illusion, even committing the irreparable. But the journalist's fight will not be in vain.

title: Ladybug's Secret
text:
Ladybug's Secret - Trivia
This film was supposed to be Fred Haprèle's first major role.
This film was intended to vilify Ladybug and Cat Noir and make them hated by Parisians, particularly by presenting the events depicted as true.
This was reminiscent of various positions taken during season 5, particularly the akumatized form of Lila in "Revelation", or the ticket inspector and Chloé in "Revolution".
While the elements depicted in the film were false regarding Ladybug and Cat Noir, they were true regarding Shadybug and Claw Noir, who had actually worked with Monarch.
Nadja's attempt to sue the film was the reason for her dismissal from TVi, as Noé Luxus had become a stockholder in the company.
The film project was ultimately abandoned.

title: Le Grand Paris
text:
Le Grand Paris - Intro
is a luxury hotel that André Bourgeois used to own and resided in with his estranged daughter, Chloé. The hotel also contains an exquisite restaurant, where Alya Césaire's mother Marlena Césaire worked.

title: Le Grand Paris
text:
Le Grand Paris - Appearance
Outside
Le Grand Paris is a six-story building painted white with red fabric awnings on all windows except the ones on the uppermost floor.
The building is roughly square with one corner rounded to make room for the main entrance and balcony.
The ground floor windows are large arches and the main entrance is similar in shape but with an intricate iron frame around its automatic glass doors and a large red doormat beneath.
There are red tables, chairs, and parasols for people to sit outside, hedges, and various potted trees.
The second to the fourth floor have basic double casement windows with small balconies and red flowers.
The fifth floor is the balcony for Chloé's room with long windows, a wooden floor, and numerous chairs and potted trees.
Above these is the main sign of Le Grand Paris made of stone with the writing colored gold.
The sixth floor has square windows running around most of the hotel.
The roof's main feature is a large swimming pool with a retractable glass pool cover, around it, are deck chairs and parasols for guests and an elevator and stairway entrance under a black dome.

title: Le Grand Paris
text:
Le Grand Paris - Appearance
To one side are a row of potted trees, an entrance to the main stairway, and a Wi-Fi signal receiver.
Lobby
The lobby is on the ground floor and is entered from the main entrance with a white tiled floor and several square pillars supporting the ceiling. To the left of the entrance are the reception, a red desk with several drawers and a white top, a telephone, computer, guest books, and several red pigeonholes where the room keys are stored. At the far end of these is a supply closet next to an entrance to the main stairway. To the right are several sets of armchairs and tables for the guests to sit at, three elevators at the far end, and around these are many desktops, lamps, and vases of red flowers. In the center is a large vase of red flowers on a glass table, in the middle of an eight-sided cross and circle decorative marking, with rose-like markings on each arm of the cross, on the floor.

title: Le Grand Paris
text:
Le Grand Paris - Appearance
Towards the back is a set of stairs going up forwards before splitting to the left and right, all with iron banisters of similar patterns to the window frames and a red carpet underneath. At the top of these stairs is a level with several doors to the left and right and the in the center is the name of the hotel, its logo and five stars all painted in gold across the wall. Four lights are positioned about these to illuminate them. All around the room are lamps with lampshades of gold eight-sided frames and square gaps, vases containing either red or purple flowers, and red and gold paintings. The room is illuminated by several chandeliers of similar design to the lampshades.
Restaurant

title: Le Grand Paris
text:
Le Grand Paris - Appearance
The restaurant and kitchen are located on the sixth floor above Chloé's room with large windows facing outwards to the city. The restaurant has red flower-patterned wallpaper, a white decorative square tiled floor, several vases with red flowers, and many white circular and square tables with red chairs. The main stairway and elevator are to one corner near a spiral stairway leading to the rooftop and another elevator to downstairs or the rooftop. Next to this is a bar with several yellow and red lanterns behind it on the wall and at the other corner is the double-doored entrance to the kitchen. The kitchen floor has simple square black and white tiles, the sides have worktop with various pots, pans, and other utensils and in the middle is the main section of gas kitchen stoves and ovens. A service elevator links the kitchen with all the floors on the hotel bar on the ground floor.
Rooms

title: Le Grand Paris
text:
Le Grand Paris - Appearance
The standard rooms of the hotel are located on the second, third, and fourth floors. A standard room is entered through white double doors and is split into two main segments, the center where people enter and the left side with the bed and bathroom. The room is primarily white on the floor and ceilings and red on the walls, either as light red paint or dark red patterned fabric with gold outlines. The center section is dominated by a large red circular couch around a circular orange table. Above the table is a gold chandelier hanging from the ceiling and red rings with gold outlines outline the sofa on the floor. There is a door to the right of the room and several green colored paintings adorn the walls along with several desks with vases of red flowers.

title: Le Grand Paris
text:
Le Grand Paris - Appearance
The left side has a pair of red curtains and gold decorative markings on the white floor at the entrance. To either side of the curtains are decorative mural patterns of red outlines and colored yellow and white and the floor on the left and right walls are black with gold markings. To the left are two yellow paintings, two desks with vases of red flowers, and two doors, one of which leads to an en suite bathroom with white square floor tiles, a large bathtub, and a large mirror next to the bathtub. At the end of the room is a large double bed raised above the rest of the room with red duvet covers and white pillows. Large gold frames of patterned fabric align the walls next to the bed, two on either side and a large one in the middle with four yellow paintings on it. Two bedside tables with lamps are on either side of the bed and this area of the room is illuminated by several lights running along the edges of the ceiling.
