title: Le Grand Paris
text:
Le Grand Paris - Trivia
Le Grand Paris is based off of the Hôtel Plaza Athénéé, and even the official website used to call it that.
Tom Dupain and Sabine Cheng celebrate their twentieth wedding anniversary at the restaurant there in "Timebreaker".
Alix Kubdel also celebrates her fifteenth birthday with her father there at the same time.
In seasons 4 and 5, Chloé seems to have started calling the hotel "the Palace". It's unclear if this is an official name change, or just what Chloé calls the hotel.
As seen in "Antibug", the hotel has several security cameras positioned both inside and outside the building including three in the lobby and one on Chloé's balcony.
Multiple battles between the heroes and akumatized villains take place at Le Grand Paris.
In "The Evillustrator", The Evillustrator attacks Chloé in her bedroom, and Ladybug and Cat Noir show up to stop him.
In "Lady Wifi", Lady Wifi believes Chloé is Ladybug and attacks her in her bedroom. She also fights Ladybug and Cat Noir in the restaurant, the kitchen, and on the roof.

title: Le Grand Paris
text:
Le Grand Paris - Trivia
In "Princess Fragrance", the titular villain enters Le Grand Paris and attacks Chloé, André, Prince Ali, Miss Soraya Khan, the hotel employees and several interviewers throughout the hotel.
In "Dark Cupid", the villain with the same name attacks Chloé and Sabrina in the lobby.
In "Mr. Pigeon", Ladybug follows a flock of pigeons to the rooftop. She and Cat Noir fight Mr. Pigeon before going to the Grand Palais.
In "Pixelator", Pixelator actively seeks out Jagged Stone in the hotel and pixelates anyone in his way.
In order to escape Gamer, Cat Noir leaves Marinette on the roof in "Gamer".
Jagged Stone is akumatized in his room alongside his pet crocodile Fang in "Guitar Villain".
In "Kung Food", Wang Cheng is akumatized in the hotel kitchen. He also covers the hotel in caramel, makes the rooftop pool a giant pot of soup, and makes the entire hotel his battleground.
In "Antibug", Vanisher attacks Chloé repeatedly throughout the hotel. Also, Chloé is akumatized into Antibug and fights Ladybug and Cat Noir on the hotel rooftop.
In "Santa Claws", Santa Claws briefly appears in the hotel restaurant to ruin the Bourgeois family's Christmas dinner and presents.

title: Le Grand Paris
text:
Le Grand Paris - Trivia
In "Despair Bear", Armand is akumatized in the hotel kitchen. The battle with Despair Bear occurs in the hotel restaurant and on the rooftop.
In "Prime Queen", Prime Queen walks into Chloé's room via TV and wraps a cable around her. Later, Prime Queen tricks Ladybug and Cat Noir into entering into the hotel kitchen's freezer just to be tricked into being trapped in there too.
In "Robostus", shortly after Markov's akumatization, the machines in the kitchen go rogue on the restaurant staff and guests. Later on, the living machines from the kitchen threaten Marlena Césaire and Butler Jean at the hotel entrance prior to Ladybug and Cat Noir instructing them to hide on the hotel rooftop with Xavier Ramier and other victimized civilians.
In "Queen Wasp", Queen Wasp confronts Ladybug and Cat Noir in the hotel's lobby.
In "Miraculer", Sabrina gets akumatized in the elevator. Later, Ladybug, Cat Noir, Rena Rouge, Carapace and Queen Bee fought Mayura and Miraculer on the roof.
In "Heart Hunter", Audrey Bourgeois and André Bourgeois were akumatized in the dining area.
In "Truth", Truth and Lighteye arrive on the hotel rooftop to find out if Luka is the son of Jagged Stone.

title: Le Grand Paris
text:
Le Grand Paris - Trivia
In "Psycomedian", the titular villain chases Bob Roth to Chloé's room.
In "Sole Crusher", Zoé Lee was akumatized in Sole Crusher on the hotel rooftop.
In "Adoration", Sabrina was akumatized into Vanisher again and secretly touches Marinette's drawings with her whistle in Zoé's room.
Whenever there was an akumatized villain, Chloé waited for Ladybug to give her the Bee Miraculous on the roof.
As of season 6, it's unknown what had become of the hotel after André and Zoé renovated the theater and moved into it.

The French name of this webisode is "Ladybug Seen by Adrien".
The webisode contains scenes from "The Bubbler", "Timebreaker", "Lady Wifi", "Copycat", "Rogercop", "The Evillustrator", "Dark Cupid", and "The Mime".
The webisode was first uploaded to Nickelodeon's website with the name "Adrien's Letter to Ladybug", but the name was changed to "Ladybug as seen by Adrien" when it was uploaded to the official Miraculous YouTube channel.
In the English version, the letter Adrien is writing does not have the same content as the one Marinette finds in "Dark Cupid".
However the letter he writes in the French version has similar content to the one Marinette finds, and he uses the same descriptions in the webisode as he does in the French version.
This is one of three known occasions where Adrien directly mentions the possibility that he and Ladybug know each other as civilians. The other two are in "The Pharaoh" and "Lady Wifi".

Something like: "I can hardly wait for our missions together, for the chance to fight by your side!"

OK, I should just tell her how I feel. Keep it simple. "My Lady, I wish I knew who you were behind your mask..."

Maybe you've seen some pictures of me on posters around Paris." What am I saying, I can't write that! Nobody can know who I really am.

title: Ladybug in Halloween
text:
Ladybug in Halloween - Trivia
When asked why the Halloween special is never produced, Thomas Astruc revealed that it's due to the show's budget. According to him, a Halloween special would mean multiple characters would have to wear a costume. But that would require the animators having to create new CGI models for each characters wearing their Halloween costume for the special, which is "too expensive" for the crew.
Because it was announced prior to the Miraculous World TV movie series, it's likely the Halloween special was going to be an episode within a season like "Santa Claws" for Season 2 and not a standalone special like "Miraculous Shanghai".

title: Le Sorbonne
text:
Le Sorbonne - Intro
is a theater located near the Sorbonne, in the Place de la Sorbonne, in Paris. In season 6, André Bourgeois purchases the theater and becomes its owner. He and Zoé move into a residence located on the upper floors of the same building, with the theater situated on the ground floor.
In "Animaestro", the theater hosted the world premiere of Thomas Astruc's new movie, Les aventures de Ladybug & Chat Noir.
In "Vampigami", it hosted the only screening of The Vampire Horrific Musical Show in the world for the golden 50th anniversary of its release.

title: Le Sorbonne
text:
Le Sorbonne - Appearance
Exterior
The external facade is black, and has three signs, two in red that recall its nature, and another in white that gives it its name.
Around its signs there are yellow stars with black interiors, but also several posters of the films being shown, next to or between the signs of the film in the foreground.
The entrance consists of a simple double French window that leads directly to the theater ticket office.
Interior
After going to the box office, spectators find themselves inside a large room with predominantly purple walls on which numerous film posters are framed. There is also a counter for drinks and desserts, tables and red armchairs. From this room there is also access to a small internal terrace on which tables have been set up.
One of the theaters itself is rectangular and has red seats with blue sides. It also has two emergency exits, one of which leads to a staircase leading to the roof of the building.

title: Le Sorbonne
text:
Le Sorbonne - Trivia
The external facade seems to be inspired by that of the Le Champo theater, one of the many theaters in the Latin Quarter of Paris.
In "Rocketear", a poster says that the theater has five screening rooms.
The theater screened various films during the series:

Title Card
Stormy Weather: Listen up, children, it's me, Stormy Weather. I will not allow Christmas this year. No trees and no holiday dinner!

title: Ladybug Miraculous/Re-Verse
text:
Ladybug Miraculous/Re-Verse - Intro
The Ladybug Miraculous is a pair of earrings that, whenever Tikki inhabits it, transforms the wearer into a ladybug-themed superhero with the power of Creation.
To activate the earrings for evil purposes, the user must speak the transformation phrase: "Blots On". To deactivate the earrings with evil purposes, the user must speak the detransformation phrase: "Blots Off".
The earrings are currently owned by Marinette Dupain-Cheng, who uses it to transform into the superhero Ladybug and formerly used it for evil purposes to transform into the supervillain Shadybug.

title: Ladybug Miraculous/Re-Verse
text:
Ladybug Miraculous/Re-Verse - Appearance
In charged mode, the Ladybug Miraculous is a pair of domed stud earrings with silver bezels. The domes are red with five black spots in a quincunx pattern. Their shape and pattern resemble a ladybug's elytron. If a minor is using the earrings and they've activated Lucky Charm, it'll start running out of power, making a beeping sound with one spot flashing before disappearing every minute as an indication (one spot is equivalent to one minute) Marinette (or another Ladybug Miraculous holder) has left before they detransform. However if the Ladybug Miraculous is used for evil, the user can override the safety countdown but this can also drain the kwami and user's energy.
In its activated mode, it's the same as it's charged mode with exception of the domes being completely red.
In camouflage mode, the Ladybug Miraculous changes form depending on who wears it:
When worn by Marinette Dupain-Cheng, it's the same as its charged and activated modes, but the domes are pink.

title: Ladybug Miraculous/Re-Verse
text:
Ladybug Miraculous/Re-Verse - Abilities
The Ladybug Miraculous grants its wielder superhuman characteristics such as speed, strength, and agility.
Its special weapon is a yo-yo wtih retractable blades which increase its offensive abilities.
If the Miraculous is wielded by a minor who used it for evil purposes, the user would be able to override the security countdown, thus creating many Lucky Charms as many times the user wants, but only one at once and in the shape of any weapon the user wants, but also at the cost of slowly draining the kwami and the owner's energy, which is noticeable as a series of black veins growing on the user's face.
Also, like its counterpart, the user could use the Lucky Charm to summon a Miraculous Ladybug to fix all damage caused by its use, and is also able to heal the affliction for overuse of a Miraculous.
However, unlike its main counterpart, due to the Supreme's blocking seal on Tikki, the Miraculous is unable to activate the Ultimate Miraculous Absolute Power when fused with the Cat Miraculous, and any attempt to use it will result in the seal causing pain on the Kwami, a backlash and also accelerating the affliction on a minor user.

title: Ladybug Miraculous/Re-Verse
text:
Ladybug Miraculous/Re-Verse - Abilities
The Miraculous is also able to grant its owner the costume they desire.

title: Ladybug and Cat Noir: Welcome to Paris
text:
Ladybug and Cat Noir: Welcome to Paris - Intro
"" is a 13-minute special episode of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir released by Air France in partnership with Mediawan that was available exclusively on the board long-haul flights.

id: Ladybug and Cat Noir: Welcome to Paris::Synopsis::0
title: Ladybug and Cat Noir: Welcome to Paris
text:
Ladybug and Cat Noir: Welcome to Paris - Synopsis
Follow the adventures of the two heroes of the series on a thrilling adventure through the City of Light. Their quest is to foil the plans of the sinister Hawk Moth, who is trying to make all the city's monuments disappear, offering an educational insight into the heart of the French capital.

id: Ladybug and Cat Noir: Welcome to Paris::Plot::0
title: Ladybug and Cat Noir: Welcome to Paris
text:
Ladybug and Cat Noir: Welcome to Paris - Plot
The special begins with a narrator welcoming the flight passengers to Paris, introducing them to a presentation by Ladybug, Cat Noir, and Air France that will take them across the city.
The next scene opens to Nadja Chamack in the TVi Studio, who tells the passengers that they will be given tours and anecdotes about Paris' monuments, with Ladybug and Cat Noir as the guides. However, the superhero duo are absent from the program. The studio worries that they've been stood up, but Nadja assures the audience that they won't be long. Meanwhile, the heroes' respective true identities, Marinette and Adrien, are in their bedrooms, ogling at photos of their respective crushes, Adrien and Ladybug, on their phones. They suddenly receive notifications reminding them of appearing on Nadja's set. Realizing they forgot and are running late, they quickly transform into Ladybug and Cat Noir, and head to the studio to take their seats, with Ladybug arriving a little later than Cat Noir. Unbeknowst to them, Hawk Moth mischieviously watches the program from his lair, prepared to turn the trip into a nightmare.

id: Ladybug and Cat Noir: Welcome to Paris::Plot::1
title: Ladybug and Cat Noir: Welcome to Paris
text:
Ladybug and Cat Noir: Welcome to Paris - Plot
Vincent Asa enters the TVi building, asking if he can take pictures of Ladybug and Cat Noir, only to be kicked out by Penny Rolling, as no unauthorized photos are allowed.
Finding his first victim, Hawk Moth re-akumatizes Vincent into Pixelator, demanding him to take pictures of Paris' monuments to make them disappear.
As the program continues, Nadja states that Ladybug and Cat Noir are on their way to the Arc de Triomphe; the heroes arrive to the monument much to the Parisians' excitement.
The heroes reveal the Arc's history - it used to be named the Place de l'Étoile, "étoile" meaning "star" in French, and this was due to the twelve avenues radiating from its huge traffic circle.
The Arc stands at the end of the Champs-Élysées, where the beginning of the festivities for Bastille Day occur every year, on July 14.
Unfortunately, Pixelator arrives on the scene to make the Arc disappear, trapping many citizens and Cat Noir.
Ladybug summons her Lucky Charm, and receives a powder compact.

id: Ladybug and Cat Noir: Welcome to Paris::Plot::2
title: Ladybug and Cat Noir: Welcome to Paris
text:
Ladybug and Cat Noir: Welcome to Paris - Plot
Just as Pixelator fires his eye beam at the Arc de Triomphe, Ladybug launches the powder compact's mirror in front of the ray, causing said ray to bounce back at Pixelator, zapping him and leaving the akumatized object, his visor, behind.
Ladybug destroys the visor, causing the akuma to fly out, captures and purifies the akuma, and throws the powder compact into the air, bringing back all the people who were hit by Pixelator's rays, including Cat Noir and a de-akumatized Vincent.
As the tour continues, Hawk Moth vows that he'll akumatize more people.

id: Ladybug and Cat Noir: Welcome to Paris::Plot::3
title: Ladybug and Cat Noir: Welcome to Paris
text:
Ladybug and Cat Noir: Welcome to Paris - Plot
Ladybug and Cat Noir arrive at the Louvre Pyramid, located in the Cour Napoléon. Cat Noir mentions that in the Louvre, visitors get to admire the famous Mona Lisa painting. Alim Kubdel arrives, explaining that the museum hosts over 400,000 works ranging from Napoléon's coronation, Liberty leading the people, Medusa's wrath, and sculptures like the Venus de Milo, and exhibitions like Egypt's pharoahs. Alim's son, Jalil, is fascinated by Tutankhamun's scepter, but Alim warns him yet again not to touch anything, saddening Jalil. Hawk Moth re-akumatizes him into the Pharoah, who uses the power of Anubis to transform several Parisians into mummies. Ladybug and Cat Noir quickly take care of the situation; they trap the Pharoah's mummy army in a public bus and destroy the Pharoah's akumatized object, his pendant. Ladybug yet again de-evilizes the Pharoah and the akuma, and uses Miraculous Ladybug to convert all the mummies back to people.

id: Ladybug and Cat Noir: Welcome to Paris::Plot::4
title: Ladybug and Cat Noir: Welcome to Paris
text:
Ladybug and Cat Noir: Welcome to Paris - Plot
The heroes then arrive at the Place des Vosges, where the mayor, André Bourgeois, is struggling planting trees. Hawk Moth re-akumatizes him into Malediktator, who believes there are too many trees in the city, and plants a building right in the middle of the park. Ladybug and Cat Noir beat up Malediktator, breaking his akumatized object, his sash, in the process. Ladybug yet again turns everything back to normal. André explains that Paris cherishes its green spaces, and aims to keep the city clean and green. Cat Noir believes strong preperation gardens are so romantic, and daydreams about having a romantic outing with Ladybug in one.

id: Ladybug and Cat Noir: Welcome to Paris::Plot::5
title: Ladybug and Cat Noir: Welcome to Paris
text:
Ladybug and Cat Noir: Welcome to Paris - Plot
The heroes arrive at the final location: the Eiffel Tower. As they witness many citizens climbing up its long stairs, they tell the passenger that the tower has 1,665 steps before reaching the top, which is why Gustave Eiffel designed the tower so it would have an elevator from the very start. The tower is over 900 feet high, and rumor has it that whenever there's hot temperatures, it expands by a few millimeters. No matter how anyone reaches the top, a view of the Jardins du Trocadéro, "a skater's paradise", awaits. Suddenly, the tour is interrupted by breaking news: Nadja reports that a protest is occuring outside Bertrand King's company, as people are criticizing the excessive waste he produces with his plastic-made products; an unconvinced Bertrand is severely irritated by this. Hawk Moth takes advantage of his negative emotions and re-akumatizes him into King of Plastic, who turns the Eiffel Tower into plastic, causing it to dance in a strange way. Cat Noir attacks King of Plastic, distracting the villain long enough for Ladybug to trip him and destroy his akumatized object, his lance, all with her yo-yo. Ladybug yet again turns everything back to normal.

id: Ladybug and Cat Noir: Welcome to Paris::Plot::6
title: Ladybug and Cat Noir: Welcome to Paris
text:
Ladybug and Cat Noir: Welcome to Paris - Plot
Disgruntled that all his akumatized villains from across the day failed him, Hawk Moth decides to take matters into his own hands. He de-transforms into Gabriel and re-akumatizes himself into the Collector. The program concludes; Nadja, Ladybug, and Cat Noir say their goodbyes and await to see the flight passenger in Paris to admire the city's wonders with them. Out of the blue however, the Collector traps several of Paris' monuments as drawings in his notebook, including the Eiffel Tower, the Louvre Pyramid, the Notre-Dame, the Sacré-Cœur, the Palais Garnier, and the Arc de Triomphe. Ladybug and Cat Noir attempt to battle the Collector, but the villain makes a quick escape. The heroes chase him by riding on top of one of the public buses, commenting that Paris' public transportation works very well. The Collector hides in the Agreste mansion, but Ladybug and Cat Noir arrive, fight him, and destroy his akumatized object, his notebook. Ladybug yet again converts everything back to normal, restoring all the monuments.

id: Ladybug and Cat Noir: Welcome to Paris::Plot::7
title: Ladybug and Cat Noir: Welcome to Paris
text:
Ladybug and Cat Noir: Welcome to Paris - Plot
As the Parisians congratulate the heroes, Ladybug mentions it would be a shame to visit Paris without seeing any of the monuments. Cat Noir tells the flight passenger that if they would like to see them, they should not hesitate to go on a flight with Air France. Night falls, and Ladybug and Cat Noir watch the litten up Eiffel Tower from a nearby rooftop, commenting that "Paris will always be Paris", and pound it.

title: Le Grand Paris restaurant
text:
Le Grand Paris restaurant - Intro
The  is a luxury restaurant located in André Bourgeois' hotel. Marlena Césaire, Alya's mother, works in the restaurant's kitchen as the head chef.

title: Le Grand Paris restaurant
text:
Le Grand Paris restaurant - Appearance
The restaurant and kitchen are located on the sixth floor above Chloé's room with large windows facing outwards to the city. The restaurant has red flower-patterned wallpaper, a white decorative square tiled floor, several vases with red flowers, and many white circular and square tables with red chairs. The main stairway and elevator are to one corner near a spiral stairway leading to the rooftop and another elevator to downstairs or the rooftop. Next to this is a bar with several yellow and red lanterns behind it on the wall and at the other corner is the double-doored entrance to the kitchen. The kitchen floor has simple square black and white tiles, the sides have worktop with various pots, pans, and other utensils and in the middle is the main section of gas kitchen stoves and ovens. A service elevator links the kitchen with all the floors on the hotel bar on the ground floor.

title: Le Grand Paris restaurant
text:
Le Grand Paris restaurant - Trivia
In "Timebreaker", Tom and Sabine celebrated their twentieth wedding anniversary at the restaurant of the hotel.
In the same episode, Alix celebrated her fifteenth birthday with her father.
Multiple battles between the heroes and the akumatized villains have taken place at Le Grand Paris:
In "Lady Wifi", the eponymous villain briefly fought Ladybug and Cat Noir in the restaurant before entering the kitchen and blocking the exits with her cellphone, Ladybug against the wall, and Cat Noir in the kitchen freezer, causing him to drop his Miraculous and nearly freeze to death.
In "Princess Fragrance", the eponymous villain sneaked into the restaurant and attacked Chloé, her father, Ali, Soraya Khan and several interviewers.
In "Kung Food", Wang was akumatized in the hotel kitchen.
In "Prime Queen", the eponymous villain tricked Ladybug and Cat Noir into entering the hotel kitchen's freezer, only to be trapped there as well.
In "Despair Bear", Armand was akumatized in the hotel kitchen and briefly fought Ladybug and Cat Noir in the restaurant.

title: Le Grand Paris restaurant
text:
Le Grand Paris restaurant - Trivia
In "Robostus", shortly after Markov's akumatization, the electrical appliances in the kitchen came to life and attacked the restaurant staff and guests.
In "Santa Claws", the eponymous villain briefly appeared in the hotel restaurant to ruin the Bourgeois family's Christmas dinner and presents.
In "Heart Hunter", Audrey and André were akumatized in the restaurant and attacked everyone at their wedding anniversary.
In "Sole Crusher", the eponymous villain attacked Armand and everyone in the restaurant.

title: Lahiffe apartment
text:
Lahiffe apartment - Intro
The  is the residence of Nino Lahiffe and his family.

title: Lahiffe apartment
text:
Lahiffe apartment - Appearance
The Lahiffe apartment is located on an upper and elevated floor of a building that is part of a real estate complex consisting of several residential towers in Paris.
The apartment has a fairly small surface area with light brown wood flooring and the windows of several rooms overlook other residential towers in the area, without having a balcony.
The apartment features a large living area. The lounge area has white walls. It contains numerous decorative green plants, including bamboo, as well as a black wooden bookshelf with a few books, and a large yellow sofa. Near the window, there is a small desk for a laptop, separated from the rest of the apartment by a gray screen.
A narrow corridor, with white walls, one of which has a photograph of a red inselberg hanging there, as well as a green wall surrounding a green door, and doors of different colors, two blue, one white and one burgundy.
Kitchen
The kitchen area is defined by a small open wall with a display shelf for dishes. The room contains a square black wooden table for four, surrounded by four brown chairs with black cushions on the backs and seats.

title: Lahiffe apartment
text:
Lahiffe apartment - Appearance
By the window, there is a kitchen sink with a dishwasher built into the cabinet. On the left side of the kitchen, there is a cooktop with a built-in oven directly below, all topped by a black range hood, itself partially recessed into a corner burgundy wall cabinet. The kitchen area continues with the cabinetry, featuring various compartments for storing plates and cutlery, as well as a food preparation area containing a blender, various kitchen utensils, and, most importantly, the jar containing the money given by the guests at Nordine and Vita's wedding.
The refrigerator is located at the entrance to the kitchen, opposite a long grey storage unit on which there are some books, a branch of flowers, and a plant next to it.
Nino's room
Nino's room is quite spacious. It has blue walls, a white ceiling, and a wooden floor with two blue rugs, one in the middle and the other near the door. It has a large rectangular window made up of three square, gray, opening panes that offer a view of the surrounding towers, and a radiator under one of the windows.

title: Lahiffe apartment
text:
Lahiffe apartment - Appearance
The room features a high mezzanine bed accessed via a solid wood staircase with a small built-in shelf. Next to the bed frame with its blue cover is a small wall shelf with a few books, lamps, and a small speaker.
Under the bed are two blue corner storage drawers; the drawer closest to the wall contains a small white mattress with three yellow cushions, while a spotlight rests on the other.
Opposite the bed, in the corner of the room, there is first a synthesizer located under a poster for an electronic music festival, under the central door a huge speaker, and a computer desk with two monitors, one large and the other curved, as well as a wide green gaming chair.
The room also has a wall shelf with some books and green plants, as well as a large wooden wardrobe with a blue-grey curtain.

title: Lahiffe apartment
text:
Lahiffe apartment - Trivia
As revealed in "The Chained Titans", Nordine and Vita moved into this apartment in 2001, newly married, with Vita several months pregnant with Nino.
Although the akumatizations of Chris in "Christmaster" and of Nordine and Vita in "The Chained Titans" occurred off-screen, these akumatizations actually took place in this apartment.

Sir , also known as Lancelot du Lac (French for Lancelot of the Lake) was King Arthur's close companion and one of the greatest Knights of the Round Table, as well as a secret lover of Arthur's wife, Guinevere. He was also a past Miraculous holder, but it is unknown which Miraculous was his.

text:
Les aventures de Ladybug & Chat Noir - Trivia
The film's art style and poster is similar to the Ladybug PV. Additionally, the trailer for the film uses clips from the Ladybug PV as well.
This is the second time the art style has been used, after a DVD cover seen in "Sapotis".
In Simpleman, at least one art difference between the movie and the PV can be seen: PV Hawk Moth is unmasked when talking to The Mime, but movie Hawk Moth has his cowl on.
In real life, the movie poster is designed by Marina Tsuzuki, a concept artist of Method Animation.
Three of the sketched posters feature Tikki and Plagg. However, there isn't any confirmation that the two kwamis have appeared in the film canonically, as the synopsis doesn't specifically name them.
The synopsis of the movie is: "Their mission: to capture the Akumas of the mysterious Hawk Moth who has the ability to transform Parisians into super-villains. Thanks to their kwamis, little magical creatures, the two teenagers transform into superheroes: Ladybug and Cat Noir. Will they succeed in saving Paris from this terrible threat?"
The movie is recommended for people that are 12+.
The movie lasts for 2 hours and 32 minutes.

title: Liberty
text:
Liberty - Intro
The  is a boat that is used and owned by Anarka Couffaine, the mother of Juleka Couffaine and Luka Couffaine. She serves as the residence of the Couffaine family.
In "Captain Hardrock", after Agent Roger banned her from playing at the National Music Festival, Anarka was akumatized by Hawk Moth into Captain Hardrock, transforming the boat along with her.
In "Crocoduel", after she argued with Jagged about their separation, Anarka was reakumized into Captain Hardrock, once again transforming the boat along with her.
In "Action", the boat was converted into a wastewater treatment plant to try to clean her of the plastic objects that polluted her, especially Bertrand King's Morpho fans.

title: Liberty
text:
Liberty - Appearance
Normal
The Liberty is large and very colorful. The port and starboard sides are painted in many colors. On the bow you can see the painted face of an unidentified creature with green eyes, red lips and protruding teeth. There are eight round portholes on both sides, located just above the water surface. The boat has two masts. On one of them Anarka hung a sign with the word "Liberty" in English. One of the deck segments, near the bow, has no roof and is intended for a stage and seating. In the second segment of the vessel, near the side, there is a covered terrace with glass windows, a passage room with orange walls, a control room and a balcony with yellow floor and railings. The deck is decorated with green and pink graffiti. The seating area is equipped with a light green carpet decorated with a crossbones pattern.

title: Liberty
text:
Liberty - Appearance
At the stern there is a glass covered terrace. The wall structure is orange and yellow. The room is equipped with a sofa and an armchair made of dark wood. The furniture is covered with bright floral fabrics. There are many plants around that are planted in pots, such as a fern and a cactus. In the center of the terrace you can see a tree that exceeds the roof in height. There is a stage at the front of the boat. Right next to the terrace there is a black table with a DJ console and a sound system. The farthest space is occupied by a white stage with a black carpet, on which all the instruments are placed. All around there is a white metal structure from which black speakers and lamps hang. In the left corner there is an orange speaker several meters high. Garlands were hanging everywhere. Flower pots are hanging on both sides of the stage. In the lounge area, right at the bow, there is a wooden table in the shape of a reel and two fabric loungers. On the sides there are the instrument slots and a sound system. A basketball hoop is hung on the mast.

title: Liberty
text:
Liberty - Appearance
Above the terrace is the wheelhouse, accessed by stairs from the bridge. The structure of the room is made of wood. There are windows on each wall. The room has a steering wheel and a built-in orange compass. On one of the shelves is a metal figurine of a hand made in the sign of the Horned Hand. From the rear window of the control room you can see the balcony. This small space was developed for entertainment purposes. In the center is a ping-pong table and near the railing is a deck chair.

title: Liberty
text:
Liberty - Appearance
In the lower part of the ship are the cabins with the rooms for the residents and a lounge. The rooms are separated only by walls and pillars. The floor and ceiling of each room are the same: colored and short panels. After going down the stairs you enter directly into the living room. The walls of the room are cream colored, with red wallpaper at the bottom and a black and white checkered border. Right next to the entrance is a kitchen area that resembles a bar. There you can see the refrigerator, sink, kitchen appliances and dishes. On the highest shelf are a microwave oven and cups. The whole thing is separated by a bar table with a wooden top and four bar chairs of different colors. Against the wall to the right of the kitchen is a video game console called a Blasterotron. In front of it is a corner sofa with blue upholstery and a wooden table in the shape of a reel, on which a potted flower is placed. Next to it is also a speaker that serves as a seat. There are many different posters hanging on the walls. In the room are also many small things, such as a surfboard and covers, as well as various instruments: drums, keyboard, percussion, guitar.
Luka and Juleka's room

title: Liberty
text:
Liberty - Appearance
Further on is Luka and Juleka's room.
In Luka's part of the room, one of the walls is blue, while in front of it is a light wall with orange stripes.
Between the pillars and the walls, you can see empty spaces from another room.
Luka has a single wooden bed with white sheets, under which is a spacious drawer.
Above the bed, there is a light bulb and a wooden cabinet.
On the left side of the wall, there is a brightly colored floral curtain.
Between the windows, the boy hung a poster of his idol, Jagged Stone, and a collection of guitar picks.
The second part of the room is Juleka's room.
The walls are decorated with purple patterned wallpaper, while on the floor is a purple patterned carpet.
Juleka's section is decorated similarly to her brother's.
There is a bed with white sheets, a wardrobe, and a floral curtain on one of the walls.
On the locker are the class photos taken in "Reflekta".
There are two lamps hanging on the wall and on the ceiling.
Also, right next to the bed is a purple nightstand with three drawers.
Next to it is a dark wooden table that serves as a desk and a pink chair.

title: Liberty
text:
Liberty - Appearance
On the table are a blue pad, a pink laptop, a lamp, her doll, toys and various accessories, such as a hair clip.
Akumatized
Under the effect of Anarka's akumatization into Captain Hardrock, the Liberty became a real pirate ship with a red hull and whose appearance from the sky resembled a guitar. She had a red bowsprit with white parts with black strings, several decks, one of which had cannons. The rear deck was raised and had a rudder. The rear part of the ship was equipped with thrusters that resembled fence deflectors, more or less large, with one very large on each side.
Finally, this ship had a large gray-white sail also with speaker deflectors, but also a large stylized white skull symbol with a pair of gray-white glasses and a hairstyle reminiscent of her owner.

title: Liberty
text:
Liberty - Abilities
Normal
Following the modifications made by the Resistance, the Liberty was equipped with a full-fledged wastewater treatment plant to collect waste, especially plastic, from the Seine. However, the excess waste, due in particular to the Morpho fans from Bertrand King's company, caused this system to explode, rendering it unusable.
Akumatized
Under the effect of Anarka's akumatization into Captain Hardrock, the Liberty acquired many powers. Under the orders of her captain, she became capable of sending chains to very specific targets to imprison them, firing cannonballs capable of breaking large bridges, as well as sound waves.
During Anarka's second akumatization into Captain Hardrock, the Liberty also gained the ability to fly.

title: Liberty
text:
Liberty - Trivia
The boat was probably called Liberty to show how much Anarka loved freedom and the absence of rules.
Thomas Astruc once joked on Twitter that she was his favorite ship, in response to a fan question.
In the series, the Liberty has changed positions several times:
In "Captain Hardrock", the boat was moored on the right bank of the Seine, near the TVi Tower.
In "Frozer", the boat was moored on the right bank of the Seine, facing the Square du Vert-Galant.
In "Silencer", the boat was moored on the left bank of the Seine, in front of the TVi Tower.
In "Desperada" and "Action", the boat was moored on the right bank of the Seine, near the Trocadéro.
In "Félix" and "Perfection", the boat was moored on the right bank of the Seine, near the Place du Châtelet.
In "Truth" and "Lies", "Determination" and "The Final Day", the boat was moored in the Canal Saint-Martin.
In "Sole Crusher", the boat was moored on the right bank of the Seine, near the Le Grand Paris.
In "Crocoduel" and "Migration", the boat was moored on the north pier of the Île de la Cité, in front of the Collège Françoise Dupont.

title: Liberty
text:

The Liberty is the third item, after Roger's police car in "Rogercop" and "Daddycop" and Gina's motorcycle in "Befana" and "Dearest Family", which was akumatized together with its owner.
In "Action", the boat had transformed into a plastic-cleaning boat to try to clean the Seine of waste caused by Bertrand King's products.

title: Liiri
text:
Liiri - Intro
is the overarching protagonist of Miraculous World: New York - United Heroez. He is the kwami of Freedom who is connected to the Eagle Miraculous. With his power, Liiri's holder can use the talon pendant to transform into an eagle-themed superhero.
Liiri and his Miraculous are currently active and owned by Jessica Keynes, who uses it to transform into the superheroine Eagle.

title: Liiri
text:
Liiri - Appearance
Liiri is a small creature that is 10 centimeters (or 4 inches) tall and has a tiny dark blue body with a large grayish blue head with a tuft of feathers in the back. He possesses grayish blue feet and neck and tail feathers, as well grey eyes and a yellow beak. Liiri appears to be based off of a harpy eagle, the most powerful eagle in the world.

title: Liiri
text:
Liiri - Personality
Liiri is both formal and casual, as he used to address Gilbert du Motier, his former owner, by both his first name and his title. Liiri can be easily intimidated, as the mere presence of Gabriel is able to make him so nervous that he ends up blabbing what his powers can do without his new master even asking him. When in the possession of an owner he feels comfortable with, he becomes rather confident and is immediately ready for a transformation.
Liiri is a little forgetful about some facts involving humans, such as when he was activated by Gabriel he expected to see Gilbert again unaware that over 240 years had passed since they last saw each other and humans aren't immortal like kwamis.

title: Liiri
text:
Liiri - Abilities
As a kwami, Liiri can fly, levitate, and phase through solid objects. Liiri can also carry objects that are larger and/or heavier than him.
As a kwami, Liiri is able to transform the holder of the Eagle Miraculous into an eagle-themed superhero. Liiri grants the wearer of the Eagle Miraculous the special power Liberation which, when used on someone, frees them from any mental or emotional restrictions that limits their actions. In the hands of an evil holder, this leads to the person becoming uncontrolled, following their every whim without any concern for the consequences.

title: Liiri
text:
Liiri - Relationships
Friends
Gilbert du Motier
Not much is known about Liiri's relationship with Gilbert, except Liiri was very civil and formal with him, while also being quite close with him, addressing him by his first name and also by his title, while he was his owner. It's also unknown if Liiri was told what happened to him after they parted.
Gabriel Agreste/Hawk Moth
Despite his meeting being brief, Liiri could sense something dark about him to the point where he fearfully revealed the use of his powers to him and was horrified to know that his powers were being used for evil by him. He got very frightened when Gabriel revealed his plans.
Jessica Keynes/Sparrow/Eagle
Upon his first meeting and sensing Jessica's calm, compassionate and determined aura, Liiri happily appears from his jewel, affectionately calling her "fledgling", and helps her transform into the Miraculous heroine Eagle. After Technolizer's defeat, it's implied that Liiri felt great joy that he got to stay as Jessica's kwami.
Monk
Not much is known about Liiri's relationship with Monk, but Monk was determined to retrieve Liiri and return him and his Miraculous to the Native American Miracle Box.
Enemies

title: Liiri
text:
Liiri - Relationships
Mike Rochip/Techno-Pirate/Technolizer/Miraclonizer
Lirii doesn't have much interaction with Technolizer except when he is wearing the camouflaged Eagle Miraculous. He is very scared of him and clearly unwilling to serve his new master.

title: Liiri
text:
Liiri - History
When the concept of freedom came into existence, Liiri came into existence. Before the Miraculous jewels were created, Liiri and the other kwamis traveled all over the universe unable to interact with humans. Then, thousands of years ago, a mage created the Miraculouses. The first holder was from Ying.
Liiri and his Miraculous were a part of a set of jewels that belongs to the Native American Miracle Box, but due to unknown circumstances, Liiri, along with his Miraculous, were lost. Until one day, 240 years ago, Liiri and his Miraculous were found by Gilbert du Motier, and helped him transform into an eagle-themed superhero, fighting in the American Revolution alongside George Washington. After the revolution, Liiri laid dormant within the Eagle Miraculous, which was given by du Motier to Washington until it was put in a museum, along with the former's saber, to symbolize peace and friendship between North America and France.
Miraculous New York
Liiri continued to stay dormant in the Eagle Miraculous as it was being displayed in a museum, along with Gilbert's saber, in honor of French-American Friendship week.

title: Liiri
text:
Liiri - History
However, as the young heroes were being distracted by Techlonizer, Hawk Moth sneaked into the museum and stole the Eagle Miraculous.
When activated, Liiri was unexpectedly happy to be working with his old owner, Gilbert du Motier, but he became scared upon sensing Gabriel's threatening aura, and he easily blabbed the use of his powers.
Then, Liiri and his Miraculous were given to Techclonizer who used it to transform into Miraclonizer, who in turn used his powers to make the adult superheroes go wild.
Thanks to the quick thinking and creativity of Ladybug, Cat Noir, Sparrow and Uncanny Valley, they were able to retrieve the kwami and the Miraculous.
Upon being activated by Sparrow, Liiri happily appeared, affectionately calling her fledgling and helped her transform into the superheroine Eagle.
By reversing the effects of Liberation, all the adult heroes were returned to normal, and they were able to defeat Miraclonizer, who had detransformed into Techlonizer at that point, thus saving the city.
Afterwards, Liiri continued to help Jessica protect New York.

title: Liiri
text:
Liiri - Trivia
Liiri is the first known kwami whose concept does not end in "-ion", with the second being Gimmi.
Liiri is the first kwami from the Native American Miracle Box to appear in the series.
Liiri's name is based on the Albanian word for freedom, "liri".
In the end credits of Miraculous New York, his name is misspelled as Liri.
The animal he symbolizes, the eagle, is also part of the Albanian flag.
The eagle is said to symbolize guidance, wisdom, and freedom.
Liiri is also currently the only known kwami from the Native American Miracle Box to have an owner.
Liiri is one of four kwamis to have emotion-related powers, the others being Nooroo, Duusu and Daizzi.
Unlike them, however, Liiri's power does not involve infusing an object with energy that can possess an object.
Liiri is the only one among these kwamis whose Miraculous doesn't originate from the Chinese Miracle Box.

title: Liiri
text:
Liiri - Trivia
Liiri is the fifth kwami to be used for evil, though briefly, following Nooroo, Duusu, Plagg (in an alternative timeline in "Cat Blanc" and "Ephemeral") and Pollen (briefly in "Miracle Queen"). Liiri and his Miraculous were used for evil in "Miraculous New York" by Miraclonizer, who used them to create chaos in New York City.

title: Lighteye
text:
Lighteye - Intro
(Pharo in the French version) was the secondary antagonist of the episode "Truth". It was a giant eye Sentimonster manifested by Shadow Moth for Truth from his feelings of betrayal from his girlfriend refusing to be honest with him in "Truth". It temporarily went berserk because of Cat Noir's Cataclysm but was defeated by Ladybug's de-evilization process.

title: Lighteye
text:
Lighteye - Appearance
Physical appearance
Lighteye was a giant floating angry eyeball. Its outer body was a black eyelid that covered its entire body except the front. Its iris was brown, and it had a white vertical slit in its pupil.

title: Lighteye
text:
Lighteye - Abilities
Lighteye could shine a giant light beam from its eye that would immobilize anyone it shone on, including Truth himself. An immobilized victim would still be able to speak. A victim would be able to move again once the light was no longer on them. Lighteye also seemed to have the ability to send telepathic messages to Truth and receive his commands remotely.

title: Lighteye
text:
Lighteye - History
In "Truth", after Marinette was unable to explain why she kept disappearing, Luka was akumatized and amokized by Shadow Moth, who created a sentimonster named Lighteye for him. Lighteye's purpose was to assist its owner and carry out his every command.
First, Truth comes aboard the Liberty, and Lighteye paralyzes Marinette's friends, demanding that they reveal their friend's biggest secret. Later, due to a moment of inattention, Ladybug also falls under the beam, but Cat Noir saves her at the last moment. After they leave, Lighteye paralyzes Luka's mother, Anarka, who reveals that Luka is the son she had with Jagged Stone. Upon learning the truth, the villains head to the roof of Le Grand Paris. Meanwhile, Jagged is rehearsing a song for Prince Ali's birthday before he, too, is caught in the beam of truth.

title: Lighteye
text:
Lighteye - History
Immediately afterward, the superheroes arrive on the scene and engage in battle. Ladybug and Cat Noir manage to escape, but Lighteye sets out in pursuit. He makes his way to Place de la Sorbonne, where he captures cardboard versions of the superheroes, unaware that he's walking into an ambush. After the heroes find Truth in Marinette's room, Lighteye, at his owner's command, bursts into the Dupain-Cheng residence, immobilizing Cat Noir with his beam. Ladybug rescues her comrade, who uses his Cataclysm on the Sentimonster. Lighteye flies into a rage and begins to act uncontrollably. Ladybug jumps on him and directs his beam toward an umbrella, which reflects the light and directs it at Truth. After de-evilize the akuma and amok, Lighteye ceases to exist.
In "Lies", Lighteye appears briefly in the background as its light paralyzes Ladybug on the Liberty.

title: Lighteye
text:
Lighteye - Etymology
In the French dub, Lighteye is called Pharo, possibly derived from the Greek word pharos, meaning "lighthouse".
In the Brazilian Portuguese dub, Lighteye is called Ocular, derived from the Latin word oculus, meaning "eye".

title: Lighteye
text:
Lighteye - Trivia
Lighteye had similar abilities to some Akumatized villains:
Like Lady Wifi, Timebreaker, Glaciator and Queen Wasp, it was able to freeze its target in place.
Like Princess Fragrance, Simon Says, Kung Food, Puppeteer, Despair Bear, Befana, Frightningale, Zombizou, Reverser, Malediktator and Miracle Queen, it was able to force its target to act differently.
Lighteye was the second sentimonster to get cataclysmed, following Reflekdoll.

title: Lies
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Lies - Intro
"" is a Season 4 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 2nd written and produced episode of Season 4. It is also the 80th written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Lies
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Lies - Synopsis
Ever since Adrien met Kagami, he has found a new form of independence, without his superhero suit. With a life as strictly planned as Adrien's, Kagami knows how to create magical moments where they escape together, in secret. But when Adrien needs to turn into Cat Noir, he has no choice but to lie to Kagami. And she becomes aware of it. Heartbroken, she turns into Lies, an implacable supervillain who wants to rid the world of lies and those who tell them… including superheroes!
Disney+
Ladybug and Cat Noir face Lies.
Netflix
Despite Adrien's strict schedule, Cat Noir must pounce into action suddenly. His disappearances make Kagami suspicious and vulnerable to evil influences.

title: Lies
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Lies - Plot
In her bedroom, Marinette tries to decode the message that Master Fu gave to her before departing to London. Tikki tells her that it's not a big deal and that Fu put the hidden meanings there to protect the secret of their magical powers. Marinette still feels distressed, but Tikki continues to try encouraging her by saying that even Master Fu had a hard time figuring it out, and that she helped him discover the recipe to the aqua power up. Then, Marinette regains her self-confidence. Mullo and Xuppu carry a red apple to Marinette's computer, which turns on the news. Nadja was in the middle of discussing Prince Ali's birthday. Xuppu and Mullo walk across the keyboard while trying to carry the apple, switching the channel to Alec doing an exclusive report on Adrien's life. Marinette watches in awe as Alec discusses Theo making a statue of Adrien, his modeling career with Vincent and practicing tongue twisters with Sarah. Then, Marinette fawned over him, and says that Adrien must have a perfect life.

title: Lies
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Lies - Plot
Back at Adrien's room, Adrien is exhausted after the day he had, with Plagg adding that they didn't even get a lunch break. Then, Adrien plays some piano on his cellphone to transform into Cat Noir and escape without anyone noticing.
Cat Noir leaves his house, only to notice that Ladybug isn't around. Then, he sends her a voicemail using his staff. He later on waits for Ladybug, but she doesn't show up. Cat Noir checks his messages again, but she did not reply. He comes to the conclusion that since she's the guardian now, she has more important things to do. Cat Noir then decides to start doing patrols. Some fans notice him and begin shouting his name. He jumped down, and the boys took a few selfies with him. They thanked him and ran off. Cat Noir checks his messages again, but there were none.

title: Lies
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Lies - Plot
Sometime later, Cat Noir is at the park sitting beside Xavier Ramier, who is feeding pigeons, and Mr. Banana, who is reading a newspaper. Cat Noir tries stirring up some small talk between Mr. Banana, but he ignores him. He then began talking to Xavier, attempting to get him akumatized so Ladybug could show up. Xavier tells him that he's actually been in an excellent mood lately, so Cat Noir leaves. Xavier tells him to say "hi" to Ladybug for him, to which Cat Noir agrees if she ever showed up. He checks his messages one more time but Ladybug still hadn't answered.
Cat Noir goes to Le Grand Paris for a cup of milk. Armand asks how Ladybug was doing, considering that she wasn't around. Cat Noir sighs about how calm it was, but then turns over to Chloé and Sabrina. Chloé is enraged at Sabrina for losing her purse. Sabrina repeatedly tries telling Chloé that she had her purse on her, but she won't listen. Cat Noir gets excited, and hopes for either Chloé or Sabrina or both of them to get akumatized. However, Chloé notices her purse was on her and lectures Sabrina for not noticing it. Cat Noir mopes again and asks Butler Jean for another cup of milk.

title: Lies
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Lies - Plot
Cat Noir is on another rooftop and checked his messages, and Ladybug had still not replied. Cat Noir began sending her another voicemail, but then overheard Kagami and her mother fencing. The two were going over a lesson of not being surprised, with Tomoe telling her that she needed to be prepared for anything if she wanted to excel Adrien. Kagami confidently tells her mother that she wouldn't worry about him. Then, Cat Noir sends Ladybug another voicemail, this time telling her that the patrol was over.
Cat Noir goes back to his house and detransforms. Plagg then tells Adrien to not worry because there could be a surprise in store. Adrien begins eating lunch by himself. He receives a voicemail from Nathalie, who tells him that Tomoe changed the fencing schedule and that they would have to attend the classes an hour early. Then, Adrien happily wonders what Kagami had in store for their next class.

title: Lies
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Lies - Plot
Kagami is now being taken to her next fencing lesson, as Tomoe tells her that the schedule changes by the Agrestes are tiring. Then she tells her daughter to make the most of it so they could practice learning Russian. In the Agreste's car, Gabriel tells Adrien the same thing while he is being taken to the fencing lesson, saying that the schedule changes by the Tsurugis are exhausting and that he should make sure he is ready for his next photoshoot.
Both cars pull up to Collège Françoise Dupont. Kagami and Adrien enter the building, only for Fred to tell them that they arrived an hour early and that Mr. D'Argencourt didn't arrive yet. Kagami insists that the schedule was right. Then, Mr. Haprele tells them they couldn't stay in the school alone. Kagami agrees and pretends to leave with Adrien, only for her to take him to the art classroom.

title: Lies
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Lies - Plot
Adrien asks why Kagami brought her here, prompting Kagami to explain that she wanted to show him her talent in art. She explains how art never lies, and how the poses people make reflect their personalities, but her mother never let her draw because she didn't think she was good enough. Adrien then tells her that she was talented. Then, Kagami tells Adrien to make a pose so she can draw him. However, Kagami doesn't like them, saying that Adrien was making model poses. She asks him to pose over and over, but she still feels that the poses he made didn't reflect the real him. Then, Adrien decides to do a pose similar to the one he does at the end of the transformation sequence as Cat Noir. Kagami then says that he is acting silly. Adrien tried convincing her that acting silly was the real him, but Kagami doesn't agree. Then, she backs him against a wall, making Adrien nervous. Kagami states that this is the real Adrien, but Adrien isn't sure. Kagami leans in for a kiss, but then their phones ring to notify them about the fencing lesson. Adrien delightfully leaves.

title: Lies
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Lies - Plot
In the courtyard, D'Argencourt has his students fence against one another. Adrien and Kagami begin fencing. Kagami stops, lifts her mask and gives Adrien's mask a kiss. Then, he takes off his mask and leans in to kiss her. But from the corner of his eye, Adrien notices Ladybug chasing after some pigeons. Then, Adrien lies about forgetting something in the locker room and leaves.

title: Lies
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Lies - Plot
Cat Noir goes to the top of the TVi Tower as a flock of pigeons in the shape of an airplane drops substances that appeared to look like bombs. Cat Noir reaches the top and notices Ladybug on her phone listening to one of Cat Noir's voicemails. Then, Cat Noir startles her, and she throws him off the building. Ladybug grabs Cat Noir's ankle with her yo-yo, causing him to hit his face against a window. Ladybug reprimands him for pranking her, to which Cat Noir replis by saying that she left him alone during their patrol. Ladybug apologizes and explains to him that she was busy nowadays, with Cat Noir replying that she amazes him and that with great power came great responsibilities. Ladybug then promises to never forget their patrols again. Then, they take off to fight Mr. Pigeon. Kagami is waiting for Adrien at the Seine. Then, Adrien arrives for their little date. André hands the couple some ice cream. But then, Adrien notices Ladybug fighting Lollipop Boy, prompting Adrien to leave again.

title: Lies
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Lies - Plot
Adrien finishes school, exiting the building alongside Alya and Nino. Marinette and Luka then leave on Luka's bike. Adrien checks his phone, noticing that Kagami had sent him a message. Then he bids his friends goodbye and goes into the car. The Tsurugi car pulls up to the Agreste car and Kagami opens her window. They lean in for another kiss, but then Adrien draws his attention to Ladybug, who was chasing an akuma. Then, Adrien claims to have forgot something in class and leave, so Kagami had the car drive off and Cat Noir leaps into action.

title: Lies
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Lies - Plot
On the Liberty, Kitty Section finishes playing another song. Kagami, Marinette, Alya and Nino cheer for them once the song was over. Nino then tells Adrien that he caught it all on camera and that they did an excellent job. Adrien denies it, stating that he missed the intro. Ivan and Rose say that they can repeat the song, but Kagami tells him that they have to attend Prince Ali's birthday party. Adrien asks if he could have five more minutes, but Kagami shakes her head. Then, they both leave. Kagami grabbs Adrien's hand, making him drop his bag. They both pick everything up and leaves but then Kagami noticed Adrien's lucky charm and picks it up.

title: Lies
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Lies - Plot
When they depart from the Liberty, Adrien points out that their cars didn't arrive and how he could've performed the song again. Kagami notes that they'll have more time together, but Adrien shakes it off, saying they will spend plenty of time together at the party. Kagami then says that she meant she wants to spend time with just him and how he makes her happy. She notices Adrien looking behind her and also looks, so Adrien lies about thinking there was a wasp behind them. Kagami asks if he loves her as well, but Adrien didn't pay attention. She asks what the matter was, and Adrien lies again, saying that he forgot something on the boat and that she should go without him. The Tsurugi car pulls up as Adrien leaves, and Kagami goes in.

title: Lies
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Lies - Plot
Adrien notices Lighteye and hides behind a building. Plagg says that he hopes to go to the party since they have the best cheese. However, Adrien says that Ladybug needs him and transforms. Cat Noir pulls out his phone and receives a voicemail from Ladybug explaining that Hawk Moth merged the Butterfly and Peacock Miraculouses to become Shadow Moth. Cat Noir goes over to the Liberty, watching as Lighteye immobilizes Ladybug and Truth asks about her identity. Right before Ladybug reveals herself, Cat Noir shoves her into the water so she couldn't finish her sentence.
Meanwhile, at the town hall, Kagami arrived at the party just as Mayor Bourgeois announces that it was an honor to celebrate Prince Ali's birthday with him. Tomoe questions why Kagami hadn't arrived with Adrien, as her and Gabriel agreed on it. Kagami then lies to her mother, saying that Adrien is answering questions for journalists. Then she goes outside, sits on the steps and clenches the bracelet in her fists.

title: Lies
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Lies - Plot
Ladybug and Cat Noir finish fighting Truth. Cat Noir says that he never had so much fun, to which Ladybug teases him about enjoying fighting Truth and Lighteye. Then she jokes around about wondering what his life is like. Cat Noir then asks Ladybug if fighting an akumatized villain and an amokized sentimonster along with Shadow Moth's debut was exciting. Ladybug responds by saying that Shadow Moth could change his name all he wants, but they will still defeat him in the end. Cat Noir says that she could count on his jokes, and Ladybug tells him that he wouldn't have to joke around much longer. Then, Cat Noir states that he had so much fun with her. He takes off, detransforms and runs to the town hall.

title: Lies
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Lies - Plot
Adrien arrives, telling Kagami that he didn't want to make her wait so long. Then, Kagami asks if he found what he was looking for. Adrien says he did, but then Kagami asks what it was. Adrien lies about how he was looking for the lucky charm Marinette gave him and tries taking it out of his pocket, only to realize that he genuinely lost it. Then, Kagami holds out the lucky charm, shocking Adrien. She then says that she also lied to see each him several times this day. Kagami pointed out that they are both liars, although while she lies to get closer to Adrien, he lies to get away from her. Adrien tries stopping her, but Kagami says that she'd rather be alone, and goes inside.

title: Lies
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Lies - Plot
Shadow Moth senses Kagami's despair over Adrien repeatedly lying to leave her. Then, he sends an akuma to akumatize her. Kagami holds out the bracelet again with sadness. Then, the akuma infects it. Shadow Moth offers her the ability to rid the world of liars like Adrien in exchange for the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses. Kagami complies and says that no lie will be tolerated. Adrien opens the door to come inside just as Kagami transformed. He then shuts the door and Lies makes an orb. Adrien admits that it was all his fault Kagami was akumatized and transforms into Cat Noir.

title: Lies
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Lies - Plot
Inside the party, Jagged Stone is in the middle of playing a song for Prince Ali on his guitar while Penny is trying to keep Fang under control. Then, Lies' orb enters the party. Everyone panicks and Lieutenant Roger pulls out his tazer, asking what it was. Lies then asks if Roger lies. He denies it, saying that a policeman never lies. However, Lies decides that he does lie and freezes him. Then, Lies asks if Tomoe lies. Tomoe responds by saying she doesn't permit her daughter to do this, but Lies freezes her as well. More people try escaping but become freezed as well. Then, Cat Noir comes in, urging Lies to stop. Just as she is about to freezes XY and Bob Roth, Lies decides to attempt paralyzing Cat Noir. He says that that he will be able to defeat her, and Jagged Stone says he will help too. Cat Noir tells Jagged to leave, but he doesn't listen. Then, Bob called out that Jagged lies about his age, and he is paralyzed as well along with XY and Bob Roth.

title: Lies
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Lies - Plot
Cat Noir runs out of the town hall and Lies' orb grows bigger. Cat Noir prepares to fight her, but Ladybug grabs him with her yo-yo and tells him that he can't go in there unless they've never lied. And they have lied before due to being superheroes. Then, Ladybug uses her Lucky Charm which grants her a drone. Since the drone can't lie, due to being a machine, Ladybug plans on making the drone go inside to get an idea of how to defeat the villain. Meanwhile, Cat Noir distracts Lies by shouting a bunch of lies.

title: Lies
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Lies - Plot
Using the drone, Ladybug sees the charm bracelet on Lies and deducts that's where the akuma is. Lies starts following Cat Noir to paralyze him. The two talks through their pyra-pods, saying that they can't destroy her akuma unless they use someone who's great at telling the truth. Then, Ladybug sees Fang through her drone and comes up with an idea: animals, like Fang, don't know how to lie, so Fang is unaffected. The drone grabs some cake and Fang follows it. The orb becomes bigger, and more Parisians get freeze, so Cat Noir sacrifices himself and jumps in to distract Lies. Lies prepares to take his miraculous, but then Fang jumps in and smashes it with his jaw. Then, Lies is deakumatized and Shadow Moth screams in defeat.
Ladybug de-evilizes the akuma and uses her Miraculous Ladybug to let people move again. Ladybug comes up to Cat Noir and reprimands him for sacrificing himself yet again. Cat Noir makes a joke out of it and they do their pound it. Then, Cat Noir transforms back, sighing romantically over Ladybug. Plagg makes a reference to how while he loves many cheeses, he usually sticks to his favorite, camembert.

title: Lies
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Lies - Plot
It's another day and D'Argencourt hosts their next fencing match. Kagami and Adrien are paired up again. However, Kagami's style this time is much more aggressive. D'Argencourt stops her before she can strike, saying that this isn't the time for solving personal problems. The class ends and Adrien and Kagami sit beside each other in silence. Then, Adrien apologises for hurting Kagami's feelings and admits that he actually enjoyed spending time with Kagami. She says that she knows he is hiding something, but there is also some sincerity in Adrien. He wonders if she's saying they can't be friends, to which she replies by saying they can't since she can't trust someone who lies to her. Kagami gives Adrien the bracelet back and tells him that when she's ready to see him again, she'll let him know.
During the midnight time, Ladybug and Cat Noir are chatting on a rooftop. Cat Noir then disappointedly says that they have to hide secrets from everyone, including each other. But Ladybug looks on the brighter side and says that they can trust each other. The two then fist bump, ending the episode.

title: Lies
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Lies - Plot Developments
Each episode focuses on the relationship the focus character has with another character, though in a different light, sharing the following with each other:
In this episode, Adrien's relationship with Kagami becomes strained and broken because of the latter's discovery and assumption that the former has been lying for not spending time with her which leads her to become a supervillian that paralyzes and silences anyone who has lied, forever.
In "Truth", Marinette's relationship with Luka becomes strained and broken when she is unable to open up to him about the truth for his own safety leading him to become a supervillian that forces people to open up about their truth.
The way each relationship is broken off is handled differently as well:
When Marinette suggests that it's best if she and Luka break up, the latter is completely understanding and willing to wait until she is ready to open up to him.
Whereas Kagami is still hurt from Adrien's lying that she decides she can't even be friends with him at the present time but she will let him know if she ever wants to see him again.

title: Lies
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Lies - Plot Developments
It's revealed that a Miraculous holder that fuses the Butterfly and Peacock Miraculouses will use the combined light mask regardless of whether or not they've used both powers.
Lies' akumatization is one of the shortest out of all titular villains, lasting only around 5 minutes.
It's also the shortest time an akumatized identity has appeared in the episode they're introduced in, only being longer than the one in "Ephemeral", in which the time between the titular villain's first and last appearance is only 20 seconds.
It's shown that Kagami is a very good artist and is learning the Russian language.
Kagami mentions that her mother thinks that she isn't a good artist, despite the latter being blind. According to Thomas Astruc, it says a lot about Tomoe's character.

title: Lies
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Lies - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in Switzerland on RTS Un.
Starting from this episode chronologically, Cat Noir has a new transformation theme, first introduced in "Miraculous Shanghai".
This is the first time Lauren Landa voices Sabrina Raincomprix in Season 4 and would voice her from then on.
At the start of the episode, Marinette is seen working on decoding the grimoire.
Tikki also references how Marinette helped Master Fu in deciphering the aquatic potion recipe.
It's unknown exactly how Marinette got copies of the grimoire's pages if Nathalie stole Wang's tablet back in "Miracle Queen", it's likely before passing his role he gave them to her as another precaution.
This is the second time where Kagami and her mother appeared in the season's second episode, following "Animaestro".
Events from this episode also take place in the episode preceding, "Truth":
Each episode focuses on the relationship the focus character has with another character, though in a different light, sharing the following with each other:

In "Truth", Marinette's relationship with Luka becomes strained and broken when she is unable to open up to him about the truth for his own safety leading him to become a supervillian that forces people to open up about their truth.
The way each relationship is broken off is handled differently as well:
When Marinette suggests that it's best if she and Luka break up, the latter is completely understanding and willing to wait until she is ready to open up to him.
Whereas Kagami is still hurt from Adrien's lying that she decides she can't even be friends with him at the present time but she will let him know if she ever wants to see him again.
Both episodes contain scenes that are present in the other, such as Mr. Pigeon's re-akumatization, Ladybug nearly revealing her identity and her and Cat Noir's conversation after Truth has been defeated.

title: Lies
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Lies - Trivia
Two of said scenes are introduced from different perspectives. Adrien's in this episode and Marinette's in the following one.
Which is piggybacked on the fact that Marinette has little to no focus in this episode.
According to Feri González, "Truth" and "Lies" don't necessarily happen on the same day, although they are parallels and focus on the same conflict, from both Marinette's and Adrien's side.
However, judging by the fact that "Lies" contains reused and different angle shots of events in "Truth", it is more likely that both episodes depict the events of the same day.
In fact, by the time this episode and "Lies" aired on Disney Channel in Asia, it's been labelled as a Disney Channel movie, and by the time this episode is over, it went to "Lies" afterwards.
This is the second time more episodes, which aren't part of a special, happen on the same day, following "Volpina" and "The Collector".
Judging from the end of "Miracle Queen" and the beginning of "Truth", this is the first time three episodes occur, at least partly, on the same day, excluding flashbacks.

title: Lies
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Lies - Trivia
This is the first time an episode happens simultaneously with a previous episode, instead of beginning right after the last one ends.
In the French dub of the episode, Cat Noir whistles the theme song while he is waiting for Ladybug on the roof.
This is the second time that Adrien's lucky charm is used as an akumatized object following "Gorizilla".
This is also the first time an akumatized object is exactly the same for two different villains.
It's revealed that a Miraculous holder that fuses the Butterfly and Peacock Miraculouses will use the combined light mask regardless of whether or not they've used both powers.
Lies' akumatization is one of the shortest out of all titular villains, lasting only around 5 minutes.
It's also the shortest time an akumatized identity has appeared in the episode they're introduced in, only being longer than the one in "Ephemeral", in which the time between the titular villain's first and last appearance is only 20 seconds.
This is the first episode in which an akumatized object is destroyed by a non-human character, in this case, by Fang.

title: Lies
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Lies - Trivia
This is also a rare episode that focuses exclusively on Adrien, with Marinette only having a minor role throughout. This has also been done in episodes such as "The Bubbler", "Simon Says", "Gorizilla", "Oni-Chan", "Félix" and partially "Party Crasher".
This is the first time where Marinette is a minor character in the permanent timeline and she has the least amount of screen time she's ever had in an episode.
It's shown as Cat Noir, that Adrien always comes to the Le Grand Palais Hotel when he's feeling down.
It's shown as Ladybug, Marinette knows how to operate a drone.
It appears the voice lock on Kagami's car was disabled, as Kagami was able to command it without using her mother's voice, unlike in "Ikari Gozen".
It's shown that Kagami is a very good artist and is learning the Russian language.
Kagami mentions that her mother thinks that she isn't a good artist, despite the latter being blind. According to Thomas Astruc, it says a lot about Tomoe's character.
It's shown that Fang also likes cake which shouldn't be a part of a carnivore's natural diet.
Adrien and Kagami's fencing duel at the end of the episode is recycled animation from "Riposte".

title: Lies
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Lies - Trivia
Ladybug warned Kagami when taking the mantle of a hero, a lot of hearts would be broken with the heroine referring to herself in "Heart Hunter", "Truth" and "Gang of Secrets" as well as Kagami felt in this episode.
When Kagami lied so she could be with Adrien and felt that he did the same thing but not to be with her it's likely that she assumed Adrien went off to be with another girl but actually unknown to her Adrien is the hero Cat Noir. Meaning he did want to be with her but couldn't be (or with any other girl) until Hawk Moth was defeated.
Each time Cat Noir opens his messages, Plagg's message "Don't forget my cheese!" becomes more and more aggressive, seemingly implying that kwamis can communicate to their transformed holders through their weapon-phones.
However, in the French version, his voice is always said in the exact same way each time, suggesting it was a pre-recorded message.
The French title of the episode is "Mensonge", meaning "Lie".
Interestingly, the official trailer and the clips uploaded by the official French YouTube channel refer to it as "Mensonges", or "Lies" in English.

title: Lies

This is the last episode to be animated by Indian studio DQ Entertainment. After this, they filed for bankruptcy, which was caused by financial problems due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

Throughout the whole episode, the Peacock Miraculous on Shadow Moth's chest is in its activated mode, not its charged mode.
During Kitty Section's performance, Luka doesn't wear his guitar pick necklace.

[ Theme Song ]
Marinette: Tikki, I'm so confused! These riddles Master Fu translated are too cryptic.

Marinette: Yeah but what good does it do if even the Guardian of the Miraculous, can't figure them out?

Marinette: (stands up, determined) You're right, I'm gonna figure this out! (Xuppu and Mullo grab an apple)
Tikki: (to Xuppu and Mullo) What are you doing? (They drop the apple on the keyboard, turning on the news)
Nadja: (on computer) The city of Paris is getting ready to celebrate the famous Prince Ali's birthday— (Xuppu and Mullo step on keys of the keyboard while struggling to move the apple and turn it to another news segment)
Alec: (on computer) This special report on the fascinating life of Adrien Agreste!
Marinette: (Marinette stops what she's doing and watches dreamily) Adrien…
Alec: We were able to spend the entire day with this famous, young model! (Adrien yawns while posing for a wax statue)

title: Lies/Transcript
text:
Lies/Transcript - Intro
Vincent: (taking pictures of Adrien while he poses) Perfect! Just-a Stunning! Mwah! I need a smile more al dente! Haha!
Adrien: (performing on stage. Talking with a pencil in his mouth) How much wood would a woodchuck chuck if a woodchuck could chuck wood?
Sarah: (judging Adrien) Not bad but could you do it for me with a bit more… orange? (Adrien laughs awkwardly)
Marinette: (sighs and smiles) What a fascinating life.
Adrien: (sighs) What a boring day.
Plagg: Without even a lunch break. Ridiculous!
Adrien: (plays piano music from his phone to make it seem like he's practicing) Finally! Free at last! Plagg, claws out!

Ladybug: (voicemail) Hi! It's Ladybug, leave a message!
Cat Noir: (leaving message) Hey, Bugaboo. Well here I am, your faithful companion at our rendezvous point just like always. It's time for our daily patrol, I hope you haven't forgotten. (waits awhile for Ladybug to show but she never does)
Plagg: (from phone) No messages. Don't forget my cheese!
Cat Noir: What could she be doing?

title: Lies/Transcript
text:
Lies/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: (voicemail) Hi! It's Ladybug, leave a message!

I'm just the Cat for this job. I'll start without you. Hope to meet up with you later. Let me know. (looks disappointed again but starts his patrol)

Don't ya kind of miss being Mr. Pigeon? You haven't been feeling a bit depressed or desperate or angry? Annoyed maybe? Not even a little perturbed?

title: Lies/Transcript
text:

Mr. Ramier: Thank you for asking Cat Noir but I am in the best of spirits, really!
