title: Lies/Transcript
text:
Lies/Transcript - Intro
Chloé: Hmm? (notices she's wearing her purse) Oh my purse! (to Sabrina) You dingbat! (hits Sabrina with the purse) You could have told me that I was wearing it!
Sabrina: (attempts to explain) But I wasn't allowed to speak to you—
Chloé: (interrupts) And you still aren't.
Sabrina: Uh—
Chloé: Shh! (walks away, Sabrina follows her)
Cat Noir: (sighs, disappointed. Turns back to counter) Make that (pushes empty glass towards Jean) a large milk pal. (Jean gets out a pitcher and fills it with milk)
Plagg: (from phone, frustrated) No messages. Don't forget my— (Cat Noir clicks away before he finishes)
Ladybug:  (voicemail) Hi! It's Ladybug, leave a message!
Cat Noir: (leaving another message for Ladybug, slightly annoyed) Hi again, Bugaboo. Guess who this is. Give up? It's the guy you stood up— (stops abruptly upon hearing Kagami)
Kagami: Yes, never let yourself be weak, mother. I know that lesson well.
Cat Noir: Huh? (observes the practice from the roof)
Tomoe: And never be—
Kagami: Taken by surprise.
Tomoe: (aggressively attacking with her bokken) Don't apply these principles to fencing, you'll never be as good as Adrien Agreste!

title: Lies/Transcript
text:
Lies/Transcript - Intro
Kagami: Adrien? Don't worry mother. (makes Tomoe momentarily lose grip of her bokken, but she manages to catch it) I've got everything I need to succeed with him.
Cat Noir: (watching with a smile, leaving message) Patrol's over, Bugaboo! (closes phone and heads back to his room)
Cat Noir: Claws in.
(Adrien picks up his phone, stops music and longingly looks at the picture of Ladybug he uses as his phone's background)
Plagg: (over a picture of Adrien's fencing class where Kagami stands out in her red uniform) So your favorite cheese is missing from the plate and it's as if the others don't exist? Try another type, you might be surprised how much you like it!
Nathalie: (alerting Adrien by tablet) Ms. Kagami Tsurugi called to inform you that the time of your fencing has been changed to one hour earlier this week.
Adrien: (happy) Huh, thank you, Nathalie. (warmly) Kagami, Kagami…
Tomoe: (on phone, speaking to Kagami) All these scheduling changes requested by the Agrestes are annoying. But you can use it to fit in another hour of Russian.
Kagami: (weakly) Yes, mother.

title: Lies/Transcript
text:
Lies/Transcript - Intro
Gabriel: All these scheduling changes requested by the Tsurugi are annoying. When you get home, make sure you try on the outfit I've just completed for your next photoshoot.
Adrien: (weakly) Yes, father.
Mr. Haprèle: Kagami? Adrien? Your fencing class doesn't start for an hour. And Mr. D'Argencourt hasn't arrived yet.
Kagami: Oh really? And I was sure I wrote down the correct hour this time!
Mr. Haprèle: I'm sorry but you can't—
Kagami: (predicting what Mr. Haprèle was about to say) Stay at school without adult supervision? No problem, Mr. Haprèle. We'll come back for the class in an hour.
Adrien: What are you up to this time?
Adrien: The arts and crafts room? What are you planning to do in here?
Kagami: (unzips her bag and pulls out a sketchbook) I've never told this to anyone but… I love to draw. I always have. (flips through pages of her art) Drawings never lie. The poses that people make are always a reflection of their personality. (Adrien gasps, surprised and impressed)  But my mother won't let me do it, according to her, I'm not good enough…
Adrien: You're super talented Kagami!
Kagami: You really think so?
Adrien: Mmhm

title: Lies/Transcript
text:
Lies/Transcript - Intro
Kagami: (takes his hand and directs him to the platform in the room) Pose for me, I want to sketch you.
Adrien: How do you want me to pose?
Kagami: However makes you comfortable. (Adrien does one of his model poses. She starts drawing) I really admire Toulouse Lautrec. I'd like to draw you just like the characters he painted. Did you know he often signed his drawings with a monogram like many Japanese artists did? (looks at her drawing, unsatisfied) This isn't right, it's not you. (tears paper from sketchpad)
Adrien: Can I see it?
Kagami: (crumples paper and tosses it in the trash) Try a different pose. It should be easy to do a beautiful sketch of you because you're so handsome but what I want is to capture the real you inside. (Adrien tries another pose. Kagami starts drawing but stops) No, still not good. Change again (throws it away and Adrien attempts another pose) These are all modeling poses! (throws another away) Try something that's more natural, more you.
Adrien: Hmm, what about MEOW! (strikes Cat Noir pose, Kagami looks unimpressed) Uhh… (awkwardly) I mean now? (laughs nervously)
Kagami: No, you're not at all natural.
Adrien: (earnestly) Yes, I am. I promise, this is me!

title: Lies/Transcript
text:
Lies/Transcript - Intro
Kagami: NO! (stands up, slamming sketchpad on table) That's you when you're being silly!
Adrien: (conflicted) What if when I'm being silly, I'm really me?
Kagami: (Kagami stares then walks towards Adrien. She takes his hand and moves it to his chest then pushes him back to the wall) There. This is really you.
Adrien: (timidly) Do you really think?…
Kagami: Yes, you're, perfect. (Kagami tries to kiss him but gets interrupted by the alert on both their phones)
Adrien: (checks his phone. Kagami does the same) Now it's really time for our fencing class. (Both he and Kagami smile)
Mr. D'Argencourt: En garde! Prèt, allez!
Kagami: (they fence, then Kagami takes off her mask and kisses Adrien's) Touché.
Adrien: (Adrien takes off his mask and tries to kiss her) En garde. (sees Ladybug pass the school, chasing Mr. Pigeon's pigeon plane) Uh… sorry. (backing away) I forgot something in the locker room… (he leaves and Kagami gives a small smile)

title: Lies/Transcript
text:
Lies/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: (Ladybug listening to Cat Noir's message on her phone) —Just like always. It's time for our weekly patrol. I hope you haven't forgotten! (sneaking up behind Ladybug while she is completely distracted) Buga-Boo! (Ladybug reflexively throws him) waaah!
Ladybug: Hi-ya!  (realizing) Cat Noir? (catches his leg with her yoyo)
Cat Noir: Wah! (slams into the window of the tower, cracking it) Oof!
Ladybug: Will you cut it out with your practical jokes? I could have really hurt you.
Cat Noir: (answering while hanging by the yoyo) M'lady, the only thing that really hurts me is when you make me go on patrol by myself. (sighs, relaxing his posture) I even missed your little angry pout.
Ladybug: Sorry Kitty Cat, I'm a bit over my head at the moment (pulling him up)
Cat Noir: I bet! "Guardian of the Miraculous", big name, big responsibility!
Ladybug: (helping him up) I promise to never forget our patrols again. (Cat Noir winks at her, both head to defeat the villain)
Cat Noir: Woohoo!

title: Lies/Transcript
text:
Lies/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: (runs to meet Kagami) Kagami! (Takes ice cream but sees Ladybug fighting Lollipop Boy so he gives it to Kagami) I gotta get going my father's probably worried. (leaves, Kagami looks down, disappointed)
Adrien: (to his classmates) Bye guys! (Adrien gets into his car, Kagami's pulls up beside it. They roll down their windows and attempt to kiss but he sees Ladybug) Uh… forgot something in my classroom, (opens car door and runs back inside) call ya later!
Kagami: (frustrated, sighs) Tatsu, let's go!
Cat Noir: (appears from the roof, launches himself with his staff) Wee!
Rose: (Finishing a song) Yeah!
Marinette, Nino, Alya: (Stand up, cheering. Kagami claps) Yeah! Woohoo!
Nino: (runs over to Adrien, showing him his phone) I got it all on video dude! You guys were awesome!
Adrien: (critical of himself) I wasn't Nino. I messed up the intro.
Ivan: We can go over it again if you want, Adrien?
Rose: Yeah, let's play it again.
Kagami: Adrien, it's time!
Adrien: Five more minutes?
(Kagami shakes her head)

title: Lies/Transcript
text:
Lies/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: Well… I'll be better next time, I promise. See you guys. (Kagami takes his hand, he drops his bag in shock. Kagami helps him with it. They walk off the boat. Unaware Marinette's bracelet fell out of his pocket, Kagami notices and grabs it)
Adrien: Our cars aren't here yet. That's too bad; we could have played the song again.
Kagami: But this way we have a little time together.
Adrien: (not understanding) We'll have plenty of time together when we go to Prince Ali's birthday.
Kagami: Together (takes his hand) just the two of us, I mean. I'm so happy when I'm with you. (Adrien sees Ladybug and gets distracted) I have a feeling we're a lot alike. Do you feel the same way? Do you also- (realizes Adrien isn't paying attention, turns around to see what he was looking at) Huh?
Adrien: Sorry, I thought I saw a wasp.
Kagami: (softly) Do you love... me too?
Adrien: (still distracted) Excuse me?
Kagami: (becoming upset) Adrien what's going on?
Adrien: I… forgot something on the barge, when my bag fell. Don't wait up for me. Let's meet up at Prince Ali's birthday. (leaves)
Kagami: (car pulls up and Kagami gets in, upset) Tatsu, take me to the city hall.

title: Lies/Transcript
text:
Lies/Transcript - Intro
Plagg: I hope we can still celebrate Ali's birthday. Fancy parties always have the best cheese boards!
Adrien: Later, but right now Ladybug needs me! Plagg, claws out! (plays message from his staff phone)
Ladybug: (from message) Cat Noir, Hawk Moth's merged his powers with the Peacock to become Shadow Moth. He's created a supervillian and a sentimonster at the same time. I need you out here!
Truth: Now you must tell the truth to anyone who asks you a question, I'll do the honors. Who are you Ladybug?
Ladybug: I… am…
Cat Noir: (interrupts and pushes Ladybug into the water) A super swimmer!
André: (shaking hands with Prince Ali) Dear Prince Ali, on behalf of the city of Paris we all wish you a very happy birthday.
Tomoe: (somehow notices Kagami walk up beside her) Didn't I arrange with Gabriel Agreste that his son would accompany you here?
Kagami: Oh um… he's here mother. A journalist's interviewing him outside. I'll go and find him. (leaves room)
Cat Noir: Woo hoo! (sighs) M'lady, it's been awhile since I've had that much fun.
Ladybug: (laughs) If battling a supervillian with three eyes and a giant monster buddy is your idea of fun, I can't imagine what your other days are like…

title: Lies/Transcript
text:
Lies/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: A baddie, a sentimonster, and Shadow Moth. It's even more exciting with his new name don't ya think?
Ladybug: He can change his name as often as he likes, he'll still never win.
Cat Noir: You can count on me and my jokes, Bugaboo.
Ladybug: Well… you don't have to overdo it.
Cat Noir: Truth is, I only ever have this much fun with you. Catch ya later! (vaults away) Wee!
Cat Noir: Claws in. (detransforms)
Adrien: (runs to meet up with Kagami) Kagami. I hope I didn't keep you waiting too long.
Kagami: (hiding the charm behind her back) And I hope you found what you were looking for.
Adrien: Huh?
Kagami: Back at the barge.
Adrien: (nervously) Uh, the barge right. (gives thumbs up) Yeah I found it thank you.
Kagami: What was it?
Adrien: (dismissively) Oh you know just that thing, that Lucky Charm that Marinette gave me. (attempts to take it out of his pocket to show her but realizes it's not there, worried) Ah no, did I lose it?! (attempts to cover up his accidental admission) Again…

title: Lies/Transcript
text:
Lies/Transcript - Intro
Kagami: You mean… (shows him the charm in her hand) this one? (Adrien is shocked) You know, I lied too. I lied to my mother so that we could see each other. I even lied to her when I said you came here with me tonight. I lied at every fencing lesson so we could spend more time together. You see, we're both a couple of liars. Except I lie because I want to be with you. (points at him accusingly) You lie… because you don't want to be with me.
Adrien: (outstretches his arm) Kagami!
Kagami: I'll go in first. (opens door and sighs)
Shadow Moth: One simple lie and trust crumbles to nothing. And what if in the end everything in our world is just a lie? Fly away my evil akuma and plague that deceived heart!
<poem>
Shadow Moth: Lies, I am Shadow Moth. I bestow on you the power to rid the world of liars. All I ask in return are Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous! Do I have your word?
Kagami: Trust me, no more lies will be allowed in my new world Shadow Moth.
Adrien: (opens door, sees the akumatized bracelet) No!… (closes door; Lies starts creating a sphere) This is all my fault. I've gotta save Kagami!
<center> [Transformation Sequence]  Adrien: Plagg, claws out!  </center>
</poem>

title: Lies/Transcript
text:
Lies/Transcript - Intro
Jagged Stone: ♫ Oh Prince Ali you're one year older but to us you're still a real rock and roller ♫
(the audience claps; Penny attempts to stop Fang from eating the guests' cakes)
Roger Raincomprix: (notices Lies' sphere) In the name of the law, what is that! (aims his taser at it)
Lies: I am Lies! Have you ever told a lie, Agent Roger?
Roger: Of course not… a policeman never lies.
Lies: You are a liar!
Roger: Help! (Officer Roger is paralyzed)
Lies: And you, mother, have you lied as well?
Tomoe: Kagami, I will not allow this! (attempts to stop Lies, but is paralyzed)
(André hides in a corner but is paralyzed; Prince Ali tries to run away but trips; Bob Roth and XY attempts to hide behind some boxes)
Cat Noir: Kaga— (stops himself) Lies! Stop this right now!
Lies: Oh look, let's see if this new candidate can pass my lie detector test.
Cat Noir: I'm not lying when I say I'm gonna free you from that evil Shadow Moth.
Jagged: And I'm gonna help ya. Yeah!
Cat Noir: Get away, Jagged.
Jagged: I'm not afraid, I'm an artist. I'm always keeping it real with my fans.
Bob Roth: That's not true! You lie about your age! (uses the box covering XY to cover himself)

title: Lies/Transcript
text:
Lies/Transcript - Intro
Jagged: Hey, this is not rock and roll! ("disappears, Lies starts to come closer to Cat Noir")
Lies: A world without lies will have no need for superheroes, Cat Noir!
Cat Noir: (attempting to summon his power) Cata— (Ladybug stops him)
Ladybug: No! If you touch the sphere, you'll freeze.
Cat Noir: Not if I've always told the truth.
Ladybug: Yeah, but is that the case?
Cat Noir: Hardly. How 'bout you?
Ladybug: Of course not Kitty, we're supposed to lie. If only to keep our identities a secret. And if we touch that thing they'll be no one left to stop her from swallowing all of Paris!
Cat Noir: Okay, so what do we do?
Ladybug: Lucky Charm! (receives a box larger than her; she opens it to reveal a camera drone with a remote) Uh..
Cat Noir: I can't wait to see what you're gonna do with a drone.
Ladybug: Okay, we can't go inside, but I doubt this machine ever lied. Which means… keep her busy while I send this spy bird inside! We'll stay in touch. (puts in earpiece)

title: Lies/Transcript
text:
Lies/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: (puts in earpiece) Your wish is my command, M'Lady. And that's no lie. (teasing Lies from the top of an advertising column) Yoohoo! My name isn't Cat Noir, I'm not a superhero, I hate Ladybug, and I think Shadow Moth should have been called Peacock Moth! Way funnier! I forgot, my favorite dish is cauliflower with béchamel sauce.
Shadow Moth: Lies, catch that deceiving Cat and seize his Miraculous!
Lies: You have my word Shadow Moth. (Ladybug discovers Lies' bracelet) Liars will always have to pay in the end!
Ladybug: I know what the akumatized item is.
Cat Noir: Great, so break it!
Ladybug: How do I do that when I can't touch it?
(Ladybug, through the drone's camera, notices all the guests at Prince Ali's party paralyzed, except for Fang)
Cat Noir: You're right, only someone who's never lied can get into that sphere and do it but that doesn't exist!
(Ladybug notices Fang, four slices of cake, and the drone's remote)
Ladybug: Yes, it does Cat Noir! It does exist! Fang! Jagged Stone's crocodile. He's never lied. He's an animal, he wouldn't know how!
Cat Noir: You're right!
Ladybug: It's working!
Citizens: (screaming) Ah! Help! Help!

title: Lies/Transcript
text:
Lies/Transcript - Intro
(Lies stops at the Montparnasse Tower, which is now shorter than her sphere. Cat Noir extends his staff so he can be safe above the sphere.)
Ladybug: But if Lies sees him coming we're toast!
(Fang gobbles one of the cakes)
Cat Noir: There are only two liars left in Paris and one of them knows the ultimate way to catch her attention.
Ladybug: No way! Don't do it! What if I fail?!
Cat Noir: You know what? I trust you.
(Cat Noir detaches himself and deliberately falls into Lies' sphere)
Ladybug: Cat Noir no! You're completely crazy!
Cat Noir: Crazy about you, M'lady.
Ladybug: No, just plain crazy… reckless…
(Lies spots the paralyzed Cat Noir)
Shadow Moth: The moment of truth is near! Grab Cat Noir's Miraculous, then it'll be Ladybug's turn!
Ladybug: Hurry up!
(As Lies begins to take Cat Noir's ring, the drone drops the last cake near her bracelet. She screams as Fang bites it, also breaking the akumatized object)
Shadow Moth: NOOO!!!
Ladybug: No more evil doing for you little akuma! Time to de-evilize! Gotcha! Bye bye little butterfly! Miraculous Ladybug!
(The Miraculous Cure unfreezes everyone, including Cat Noir, who reacts in fear as Fang licks him)
Citizen: Yeah!

title: Lies/Transcript
text:
Lies/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: (yo-yos over to Cat Noir, frustrated) Seriously, you've got to stop doing this to me!
Cat Noir: (teasing) Yeah, but I can't resist this angry little pout of yours when you bring me back. (Ladybug's frustration subsides)
Ladybug and Cat Noir: Pound it.
Cat Noir: Claws in.
Adrien: (sighs, dreamily) Ladybug.
Plagg: Oh how romantic! I get it, even if I do love every cheese on the plate, I always come back to my favorite, Camembert. (Adrien takes out a wedge of Camembert, Plagg takes and eats it)
Mr. D'Argencourt: En garde, prèt, allez!
Adrien: (Kagami fences very aggressively and forcefully knocks him into a pole) Ugh ah ouch!
Mr. D'Argencourt: (blocks Kagami's saber) Stop it! This is a fencing class here, not a joust. Fall out!
Adrien: I'm really sorry I hurt you Kagami. You know, all those wonderful times we had together… they weren't lies.
Kagami: I know. I know that you're hiding something but I also know that there is sincerity in you too.
Adrien: So… can we still be friends?
Kagami: How can you trust someone who's lied to you? (hands him his charm) When I'm ready to see you again, I'll let you know. (she leaves; Adrien stares down at the charm, sadly)

title: Lies/Transcript
text:
Lies/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: You know the difference between us and the rest of the world M'Lady? We can't be completely honest with each other. We keep secrets and… sometimes we have to lie.
Ladybug and Cat Noir: But we always trust each other. (they pound it)

title: Lian
text:
Lian - Intro
is a minor character of Miraculous World: Shanghai - The Legend of Ladydragon. He is a Chinese boy who lives in Shanghai. He is also a big fan of Adrien Agreste.

title: Lian
text:
Lian - Appearance
Physical appearance
Lian has brown hair, reddish brown eyes and dark skin. He wears a pair of rectangular brown glasses.
He wears a blue long sleeve shirt underneath a red t-shirt with a blue collar and a white video game skull on the front. He wears brown sweatpants and black and white converse sneakers.

title: Lian
text:
Lian - Personality
Lian is a noble and brave individual who is not afraid to fight evil on the streets. He is also prideful and refuses to take advice from thieves, even if said thief is trying to save them. He also dared, unafraid to fight the henchmen who were directed by Cash.

title: Lian
text:
Lian - Abilities
Lian seems to have minimal knowledge of martial arts, but seems to be mostly untrained. Even so, he was able to hold off a common street thug.
He is also bilingual, able to speak French in addition to his native language, Mandarin.

title: Lian
text:
Lian - Relationships
Jiao & Kang
Lian, Jiao and Kang are good friends, fighting alongside one another to defend the streets from evil as the "Street Vigilantes". They are always together, even when they ran after Fei, fighting with criminals and looking for Marinette to return her to the Kwagatama.
Fei Wu
His exact relationship with Fei is unknown. Lian tries to catch her because he knows she is robbing innocent people on the street. When he and his friends find her, they chase the girl and engage in battle to stop her. Although they don't treat her positively when Fei needs help, the boys aren't shy and want to help her. By the end of the episode, his attitude towards Faye changes. When he sees her playing the accordion, he looks at Fei and develop a crush on her.
Adrien Agreste
Lian is a big fan of Adrien. Teenagers recognize him on the street and ask him to share a photo with their idol. After taking pictures, Lian decides to show Adrian the sights of the city.
Marinette Dupain-Cheng

title: Lian
text:
Lian - Relationships
Jiao and his friends don't know Marinette very well. When Kang find her Kwagatama, they try to find the girl to return her jewelry. They follow her until they manage to recover the girl's property. In the finale of special, he returns her to the Kwagatama and talks to her sweetly.

title: Lian
text:
Lian - History
Miraculous Shanghai
Lian, Jiao, and Kang spot Adrien Agreste as he walked along the Bund district and then go over to him to ask him for a photo. Adrien agrees to this after his bodyguard lets him and the group then take a couple of photos.
Later, Lian, Jiao, and Kang see Fei Wu stealing from Marinette Dupain-Cheng. They then chase her into an alley. There, Fei confronts the three boys and defeats them without even physically touching them. Fei then runs off, leaving Lian and the others on the floor. That night, Lian, Jiao, and Kang face Cash's men in another alley after finding Marinette and Fei.
Sometime after, Lian, Jiao, and Kang go to the Thousand Delights restaurant and return Marinette's "necklace" to her. Wang Cheng then invites the three boys in, where the watch Fei play the accordion. After she finishes, the three boys blush as Fei looked at them confused. Lian then continue to interact with Marinette. Sometime later, Lian and the others then attended a fashion show, where they watch Adrien and Gabriel Agreste pose for the cameras.

title: Lian
text:
Lian - Trivia
Between him, Jiao, and Kang, Lian is the only one out of the group to speak the same language as Marinette and Adrien.
He is one of the few characters on the show to know more than one language, after Fei Wu.
Lian, Kang and Jiao are members of their own group against evil "Street Vigilantes". It may be similar to the previous The Resistance, which also fought for evil.

title: Liberty Island
text:
Liberty Island - Intro
(formerly known as Bedloe's Island) is a federally owned island located in Upper New York Bay in the United States. The island is where the Statue of Liberty is located in the state of New York. It is also an exclave of the New York City borough of Manhattan, surrounded by the waters of Jersey City, New Jersey.

title: Liberty Island
text:
Liberty Island - Trivia
Historically, it was originally known as Bedloe's Island before it was renamed to its current name by an act of the United States Congress in 1956.
The island is where Ladybug, Cat Noir, Uncanny Valley, and Sparrow/Eagle all fought Techlonizer/Miraclonizer together. It is also where the heroes all recovered the Eagle Miraculous from the akumatized villain.

title: Leo Sprite
text:
Leo Sprite - Intro
is the Sprite connected to the Leo Fragment of the Stellar Force and allows its holder to transform into a Leo constellation themed superhero.
It is currently used by Miki to transform into Leo.

title: Leo Sprite
text:
Leo Sprite - Appearance
The Leo Sprite is the same as it's sprites siblings: robotic, serpentine creatures with their bodies and tails resembling the strap of a watch. It's long head is trapezoidal and resemble the facets of a watch, with black screens and glowing pale green eyes, though they lack other facial features. It's "ears" are rectangular components with dark tips and have articulated arms but the color scheme is black. There is a small slot beneath its head serves as the insertion point for the Stellar Matrix fragment to which it is bound.

title: Leo Sprite
text:
Leo Sprite - Abilities
The Leo sprite has the ability to take on two different forms: their normal forms, and their watch forms. They can also grant their holders superpowers.
Similar to Kwamis, the Leo Sprite are capable of transforming it's owners into a constellation themed-superhero, it attaches itself to the wearer's wrist, taking the form of a watch, and allows them to transform into a Stellar of the Leo constellation.
When its holder wishes to summon a weapon, personal or group, the Leo Sprite displays the symbol on its screen, allowing the materialization of the weapon in question.

is located west to Ipanema in the upscale district of Leblon, in Rio de Janeiro.

title: Leblon Beach
text:
Leblon Beach - Description
The Leblon Beach follows Ipanema's coastline, separated from it by a canal. It contains stations 11 and 12.
On the city side, similar to Copacabana, the beach is bordered by a long Portuguese promenade with black and white mirrored wave pattern, with a spot of the opposite color in the middle of the pattern. The beaches are bordered by Pedra do Arpoador to the East, and Dois Irmãos Hill to the West.

text:

In "Mister Agreste", this is where Luka hangs out with Irupé and has a guitar lesson with Marinette. Ladybug later visits Luka and tries to tell him the truth about Gabriel.
In "Riginarazione", Gina is seen watching the beach from her motorcycle with the mice.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Intro
Cerise Bianca (real name unknown, first introduced as Lila Rossi) is one of the two main antagonists (alongside Hawk Moth) of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir.
She is a minor antagonist in Miraculous World: New York - United Heroez, a cameo antagonist in Miraculous World: Shanghai - The Legend of Ladydragon and Miraculous World: Paris - Tales of Shadybug and Claw Noir, and the main antagonist of Miraculous World: London - At the Edge of Time.
She is the daughter of Tomoe Tsurugi and the sister of Kagami Tsurugi. She is a former student in Miss Bustier's class at Collège Françoise Dupont. She is the love rival of Marinette Dupain-Cheng (and Ladybug), competing for Adrien Agreste's affection. Her masterful manipulation tends to cause trouble for Ladybug and Cat Noir, especially after she allied herself with Hawk Moth.
In "Volpina", Ladybug humiliated her in front of Adrien by exposing her lies about them being close friends and her owning the Fox Miraculous. As a result, she was akumatized by Hawk Moth into Volpina, a fox-themed supervillain who was a master of illusions.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Intro
In "Catalyst", after Gabriel Agreste called Volpina a false hero in comparison to Ladybug on TV, she was re-akumatized into Volpina. Afterwards, she took part in Scarlet Moth's plan to acquire the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses.
In "Chameleon", in a new attempt to get revenge on Ladybug, she willingly akumatized herself and became Chameleon, a shapeshifting supervillain.
In "Ladybug", Lila made a deal with Gabriel Agreste. She framed Marinette for stealing the Mock Exam answers, cheating on a test, pushing her down the stairs, and stealing her necklace, resulting in her rival getting expelled. Though Marinette eventually returned to school, as a reward, Gabriel made her the new female face of his brand.
In "Emotion", Lila is revealed to be aware of Gabriel's supervillain identity.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Intro
In "Revelation", it is revealed that Lila possesses multiple families and identities. Besides Mrs. Rossi, an Italian ambassador, she has two other mothers: Mrs. Bianca, who believes she is in Africa helping endangered animals, and another who is deaf and communicates with sign language. In the same episode, after being replaced by Kagami Tsurugi as the female face of the Gabriel brand and campaigning to replace Marinette as class representative, she was willingly akumatized by Monarch into Hoaxer, a variation of her akumatized identity as Volpina, and received the superpower of the Fox Miraculous through her Alliance ring. Using her ability to control minds, she manipulated Nathalie Sancoeur into sending her pictures of all of Gabriel's secrets, including photos and documents related to his past, his contracts with Tomoe Tsurugi, pages from the Miraculous spellbook, the location of Émilie Agreste's body and one of the Graham de Vanily Twin Rings that Nathalie wears.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Intro
In "Confrontation", Lila, along with Chloé, planned to frame Marinette for forging her classmates' study option forms to get them to turn against her. However, her plan backfired when she fell into a trap set up by Marinette and Sabrina and accidentally exposed her true nature in front of her entire class and the school faculty, leading to her expulsion from the school. Following this, she discarded her identity as Lila and took on an old one as Cerise Bianca, a student at Collège Paul Bert who is also the class representative and claims to be a movie star.
In "Collusion", it is revealed that Cerise and Chloé stayed in contact after the former was expelled. She communicated with Chloé from her lair through an earpiece. She guided Chloé in their plan to take revenge on Marinette and Miss Bustier, arranging a situation that would have resulted in the former's expulsion and the latter's dismissal. She also advised her to accept a proposal made by Gabriel Agreste, leading to Chloé becoming the new mayor of Paris.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Intro
In "Revolution", Cerise kept advising Chloé in secret, telling her to accept an alliance with Monarch. After Chloé was removed from power, she grabbed Tomoe Tsurugi's briefcase, brought it to her hideout, and began to work on unlocking it.
At the end of "Re-creation", after Gabriel Agreste's sacrifice, Cerise somehow obtained the Butterfly Miraculous, succeeding him. Not only that, but she enrolled at the same school Marinette and her friends are going to for the upcoming school year.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Intro
In "Miraculous London", Cerise (now using a new, unknown identity) akumatized herself into Timestalker, a time-travelling supervillain, so that she could discover Ladybug's identity. Later on, she akumatized herself again, but this time into Spectral Looter, a ghost-themed supervillain, so she could steal all the Miraculous in Marinette's possession, including the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses. She used the latter two Miraculous to summon Gimmi and make an unknown wish that would have reconfigured the universe and resulted in the destruction of the timeline. However, her efforts were thwarted by Chronobug and Bunnyx, who prevented her from discovering the former's identity and Spectral Looter was erased in the current timeline.
From Season 6 onwards, Cerise fully assumes her role as the new Butterfly Miraculous villain, using it to transform, whenever Nooroo inhabits the Miraculous, into Chrysalis, a butterfly-themed supervillain using her own improved version of akumas, known as ultrakumas. Unlike her predecessor, Chrysalis doesn't let anyone know anything about herself, including her gender, her age or even her intentions.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Intro
In "Vampigami", it is revealed that Cerise is an ally of Tomoe Tsurugi. In "Yaksi Gozen", it is revealed that their alliance predates Gabriel's defeat. Sensing Tomoe's distress following an argument with Kagami, Cerise appears and transforms into Chrysalis to assist her, aiming to help Tomoe regain control over Kagami's life and trust. Concurrently, they plan to capture Félix Fathom and force him into spying on the Miraculers, leveraging Chrysalis' knowledge of his identity. However, the scheme fails when they discover that the captured Félix possesses Kagami's amok object rather than his own.
In "Heartfixer", Chrysalis was summoned by Nelson de Glusset, Raymond Pugnant, and Loïc Stompet to akumatize them into Couplewreckers in order to separate Marinette and Adrien. After succeeding, Chrysalis took advantage of Marinette's vulnerability to akumatize her and transform her into Heartfixer, intending to interrogate her and confirm her suspicions about whether she was truly Ladybug. However, her plan failed when Adrien managed to use his love for Marinette to help her reject the Ultrakuma.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Intro
In "Secret Protocol", Cerise takes her scheme directly into Marinette's home by disguising herself as Marinette's uncle, Wang Cheng. Infiltrating the Dupain-Cheng residence under the guise of helping with Sabine's birthday, Cerise works to gather intelligence and confirm whether Marinette is secretly Ladybug. To escalate the situation, she akumatizes herself into Kung Food to trap Marinette. However, when her deceit is exposed, Cerise rejects her own Ultrakuma and flees—though the intense confrontation ultimately forces Marinette to reveal her superhero identity to her parents.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Intro
In "Nemesis", it is revealed that Chrysalis possesses the power to impersonate others, though how she acquired this ability and how it functions remain unknown. During the episode, Chrysalis fell into a trap set by The Miraculers to akumatize an illusion of Marinette and briefly obtain Ladybug's Miraculous, leading them directly to her lair. Cerise used her shapeshifting power to transform into a child, a firefighter, and a pregnant woman. However, after being ambushed by the Miraculers in her lair, Chrysalis managed to escape by disguising herself as King Monkey, successfully deceiving the Miraculers and fleeing. After this, she was forced to abandon the Parisian Catacombs, setting it on fire to destroy any evidence that could allow Ladybug to discover her identity.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Appearance
Physical Appearance
As Lila Rossi
As Lila, she was a slender teenage Italian girl of average height with light tan skin. She wore grayish chartreuse green contact lenses, pale vermilion lipstick, and a long, hip-length auburn wig with blunt bangs and two shorter pieces framing her face, all of which was loosely tied near the ends with orange bands.
As Cerise Bianca
As shown in "Confrontation", her natural eye color is hazel-brown, while she has short rosy brunette hair styled into a shaggy pixie cut. She also has lighter skin and medium coral pink lips.
From Season 6 onwards, her skin is light tan.
Civilian Attire
As Lila, she had multicolored wristbands with triangular patterns and knots on her right arm. She wore a brilliant vermilion jacket over a frilly dark gray romper that had tiny light silver spots and a knot formed at the top at the chest. Additionally, she wore light gray leggings and brown ankle-length high heel boots. In "Chameleon", it was shown that she also had silver hoop earrings, with the right one decorated with a pearl.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Appearance
As Cerise, she replaced her romper and jacket with identical ones colored moderate purple and brown respectively. The romper had more fainter lighter polka dots. She keeps her wristbands, leggings, and boots.
In "Collusion", she wore a black wig in a bun, and green contact lenses as Lila. Her lips were the same vermillion color as her old persona, and she wore a white long sleeved shirt, a dark blue vest, and a long skirt and heels.
In her disguise in "Re-creation", she wore blue contact lenses, a black bob cut wig, and glasses. She replaced her purple romper with a pink shirt and wore blue pocketless jeans similar to Alya's, a black jacket like Zoé's, and a light vermillion pink lip-gloss.
In "Miraculous London", she wore a blonde wig tied into a low bun with a black hair band and violet contact lenses. She wore a black sleeved sweater with a white-collar shirt beneath, and a matching black pleated skirt with gray tights and gray ankle-length boots. Also her skin had a slight tan.
"In "Queen of the Dreadzone", she wore this outfit and wig except she has blue contact lenses when Cerise went to Shanghai.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Appearance
In Season 6, she regularly changes her outfit, wearing different clothes every time she's seen.
In "Yaksi Gozen", she is fully shown and she still wears her Cerise outfit but no longer wears gray leggings.
As Chrysalis
Real Costume
Her real costume is similar to what Hawk Moth used to wear, consisting of a pair of dark purple dress pants and a jacket with a black butterfly-shaped lapel and triangular sleeves. Under the jacket, a purple vest is visible, where the Butterfly Miraculous is placed, right in the middle, where it is used as a button of the lapel at the center of her body. Underneath it, a light purple dress shirt with black lines forming butterfly wings at the center and accents of white is worn .They feature a butterfly-shaped hem, and the former has a section of the lower back, shaped like a butterfly, which, combined with the purple of the vest, forms the Butterfly Miraculous symbol.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Appearance
She wears very high dark purple heels (that make her look much taller) with butterfly-shaped clips, and her mask is large and very wide with a butterfly shape, standing out from her face, and being purple in color with black lines around the edges and eyes and white accents, transparent at the edges. Her skin turns lilac, and her eyes entail bright lilac sclera and emerald green irises. Her hair is white and styled in a bouffant at the front, while the back is in a braid like a cocoon, with purple jewels adorning it similar to butterfly scales. She has bright purple lipstick and her nails are dark purple and with lilac butterfly wings.
Like her predecessor Hawk Moth/Shadow Moth/Monarch, she is armed with a dark purple cane, except the cane's gemstone is now lilac with a butterfly on the side of it and part of the cane is decorated with a thin purple spiral.
Mental Image

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Appearance
To her victims, Chrysalis presents herself as a purple glowing silhouette with a simplified butterfly-outlined mask and glowing white eyes with no pupils, speaking with what sounds like a mix of different voices. As Volpina

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Appearance
Volpina wore an orange mask with black edges, and her hairbands were black. On top of her head, two fake orange ears with white and black insides were attached. The top of her hair was black and then quickly ombréd down to light brown with the tips white. She also had orange lipstick, and her eyes remained green. The necklace with a foxtail hanging off of it was worn around her neck, mimicking the Fox Miraculous. She wore an orange jumpsuit with a white section going down the front. Wrapped around her waist was an orange sash that looked like a foxtail, the borderign between the orange and white sections being pale orange in a zigzag fashion. The edges of her collar and the tops of her upper arms had black lines, and her forearms and lower legs were solid black, with the soles of her feet being white with an orange fox foot printed on each. She had a swan-neck with a black border. Her weapon was a replica of the flute.
As Chameleon
After being akumatized into Chameleon, she retained her normal form. However, she could change herself into whoever or whatever she kissed. She took the form of Adrien, a little boy, Cat Noir, and an oyster by accident.
As Hoaxer

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Appearance
Hoaxer was mainly an enhanced version of Volpina. However, the highlights in her hair changed to brilliant scarlet, as well as many parts of the costume being recolored shades of scarlet and red. The most notable changes were the cross on her chest that turned red when overlapping on the black front instead of the fake Fox Miraculous pendant. The zigzag lining on the sash also turned black, while the forearms and lower legs remained the same, the insides of the fox ears scarlet. She was no longer armed with her flute.
As Timestalker

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Appearance
Timestalker wore a dark blue jumpsuit that covered her entire body and head with darker gear patterns on her legs and forearms, with even larger ones at the side of her torso. Her forehead had a black gear symbol with the hands of a clock. She had black armor on the sides of her head, two-layered chest armor on her torso with two studs, pauldrons on her shoulders, long fingerless gloves with dark blue fingers, and long boots with another darker layer on top connecting to pauldrons on the knees resembling hexagons, as well as rectangular pieces around the foot. Her soles had a rectangular part in front of the foot, and there was white angular padding resembling eyes over her actual eyes with black bordering.
As Spectral Looter

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Appearance
Spectral Looter wore a navy two-piece suit covering her face and body. The upper portion consisted of a hooded jacket that ended at the waist with a central division featuring black trim, creating a tail. The lower portion consisted of pants that extended to her boots. She had a darker piece of armor on her chest with thick angular linear pieces around the abdomen. Her shoulder pauldrons were light periwinkle, as well as her palms being fluorescent cyan on the inside. Her chest had a glowing cyan logo resembling a skull, while her boots had light periwinkle borders on her knees with downward points, and short boots with a cyan tab on the tongue. Her hood covered her face, which featured a light periwinkle section with sharp slit black eye-like spots with cyan dots for pupils. The top of the hood had a light periwinkle skull in the middle. When using her powers, she turned translucent.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Personality
Lila is proud and loves attention, which she is willing to obtain with her pathological lies. This means going beyond words to do this, such as buying a necklace similar to the Fox Miraculous to convince Adrien that she is a descendant of the fox-themed superhero, or cause situations that can discredit whoever can threaten her lies. She easily becomes envious if someone gets more attention or love than her and does not appreciate it when someone reveals that her lies aren't true, showing no remorse for lying. If anyone attempts to expose her, she won't hesitate to try to make them miserable or break them down just to get them out of her way. She also doesn't take advice from those who try to make peace with her or encourage her to be honest like Ladybug or Adrien. At first glance, it appeared that the reason why she acts like this was probably because her "mother" is away a lot with her busy schedule, making Lila feel disheartened and using lies to cover up that loneliness to her "mother" and others that are around her.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Personality
Whenever Lila deceives others, she often ignores the danger she puts herself in, acting somewhat possessive and demanding. It's best seen in "Emotion", where after she became a female co-model of the alliance, she thought it earned her a one way ticket into Gabriel's party. She also proves to be ungrateful in "Oni-Chan", where she showed no gratitude to Ladybug when she saves her from the titular villain. Due to her talent to create the most convincing lies, Lila is extremely intelligent and observant, being able to notice the most subtle details, especially when she is motivated by her hatred and grudge. Similar to Félix, Lila was able to deduce Gabriel was Monarch and used that information in her favor, manipulating the supervillain for her gain, like convincing him to akumatize Kagami again to separate Adrien and Marinette in "Protection".

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Personality
Lila possesses a great desire for vengeance, something that evidences her real wicked nature. Lila doesn't easily forgive people who she feels wronged her, harboring a great deal of resentment against them and wasting no chance to get back at them in any way possible. The biggest example is her resentment against Ladybug, still being furious at her for ratting her out harshly and ruining her chance to woo Adrien, despite the superhero later apologizing to her. When Marinette tried to expose Lila's lies after the latter returned to the school and refused to submit to her, Lila made the decision to ruin Marinette's life. Her drive to hurt the ones that wronged her is so great she is willing make alliances that make that easier, like her formal alliance with Gabriel Agreste that would allow her to both get closer to Adrien and have fame, but also convince Gabriel that Marinette was a bad influence. Chloé also became another ally for her for better torment Marinette in a more active way, while also manipulating the former for her own interests.
Lila hates being betrayed.
When that happens, Lila focuses her attention on the person who committed just that.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Personality
This is seen when Gabriel Agreste spitefully dismissed her as the female face of his brand, not even warning her about Kagami replacing her.
This drove Lila to formulate a plan to get back at him, luring Gabriel to akumatize her by channeling her anger against Marinette and then using his powers as Hoaxer to uncover Gabriel's secrets and planning to steal the Butterfly Miraculous from him.
Creating a complex scheme of many steps that involved manipulating Chloé and preying on Gabriel's obsession with defeating Ladybug, she (as Cerise) managed to get the tools she needed to infiltrate the Agreste manor during Monarch's fight against Bug Noire and get the Butterfly Miraculous after it was lost during the battle.
She refuses anyone's help to try to become a better person, preferring to do things her own way and fulfill her desires, as when Ladybug called a truce with their feud in "Chameleon".
While Lila appeared to accept the offer, she returned to intense hatred of the heroine, and whenever Adrien, Marinette and their friends have tried to help Lila be a good person with their good nature, she decides to use people's goodness in their hearts for her personal desires.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Personality
Lila is not afraid to get her enemies' friends against them by manipulating and lying, portraying her enemy as the villain, and not having any care for the consequences that her lies may have on others, as she doesn't feel any remorse after almost causing some of her classmates and teachers to be akumatized by Scarlet Akumas and getting Marinette expelled. Another example of this is shown in "Perfection" and "Protection" when she manipulates Kagami into thinking Marinette is a bad person. Later on, in "Confrontation", she has no problem in ruining her classmates' study paths just to turn them against Marinette.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Personality
The extension of her lies goes further than her school and social life, as they also extend into her family. It's revealed that Lila has at least three identities, along with three different mothers, keeping them ignorant of the existence of each other by making them believe she does a lot of travel around the world due to works such as acting and conservation of endangered species. That also proves how vile she is, pretending to travel around the world doing charity work as well as filming a movie. She excessively tries to hide her true name and identity behind her different alter egos. Her true identity is still a mystery as well as her objectives.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Personality
After obtaining the Butterfly Miraculous, Cerise wasted no time in using it against Ladybug, demonstrating a much greater proficiency and intelligence than Gabriel in wielding its powers. In her first use, during "Miraculous London," instead of following Gabriel's usual tactics, she chose to akumatize herself. Cerise devised a plan to discover Ladybug's identity and capture both the Ladybug and Cat Miraculous. She was clever enough to avoid being captured herself; she didn't wear the Butterfly Miraculous or her akumatized object, ensuring that Ladybug couldn't take it back or deakumatize her during their confrontation and even disguised herself with a new civilian identity to avoid being recognized in case that the heroes somehow manage ro deakumatize her. Cerise also transformed into supervillain forms that concealed her gender and remained silent while fighting Ladybug.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Personality
Cerise displayed consistently abusive behavior toward Nooroo, indicating that she sees him merely as a power source for the Miraculous. As seen in "The Illustrhater," Cerise completely immobilizes Nooroo when she isn't transformed. Cerise disregards Nooroo's concerns when he urges her to consider the moral implications of her actions and questions why she is causing chaos in Paris. Instead, she silences him without explanation, highlighting the darkness in her heart, which extends even to those who have ever genuinely cared for her. This is evident when Nooroo expresses relief that her world-ending plan failed in "Miraculous London." In "Daddycop," when he tries to reason with her, Cerise immediately paralyzes Nooroo simply for speaking to her and refers to him as "kwami" with disgust. She doesn't consider Nooroo as a living being at the slightest. Furthermore, while Cerise's intended wish to Gimmi remains unknown, it is hinted to have the potential to destroy the entire universe.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Personality
Cerise gets angry when her plans fail or others cancel her. This was evident when Chronobug altered her notebook, specifically the page that revealed her secret identity, which caused Cerise to have a fit of fury and even to scold Nooroo to silence him after he celebrates her plan's defeat.
As Chrysalis, she is extremely secretive.
She refuses to disclose her villain name, even to her enemies, going as far as to conceal her gender and age from them.
By maintaining this, she can seamlessly blend in with the other Parisians, allowing her to observe her enemies without being detected.
Chrysalis is much more manipulative than Hawk Moth in her interactions with her  minions.
Upon first contact, she adopts a different approach by pretending to care about their needs.
Instead of immediately revealing her minions' names, she allows them to choose, which prevents them from rebelling.
Chrysalis lets her supervillains act freely and subtly convinces them to target Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous, whenever the heroes interfere.
This strategy makes the heroes appear as the villains in the eyes of the akumatized villains.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Personality
However, she is quick to drop that façade the moment her minions start to stray away from her orders or reveal something about her towards the heroes, threatening to remove their powers, even if they're in a position which would make it dangerous for them.
In "El Toro De Piedra", it is shown that she is able to very quickly get a grasp of what her victims want to hear, as demonstrated by her taking on a more forceful demeanor after Raúl Bruel got angry at her during his akumatization.
As shown in "Yaksi Gozen", she's aware of Félix being a sentibeing and willingly conspires with Tomoe Tsurugi to steal Félix's amok to force him to be their spy, showing no remorse at the idea. Chrysalis does not improvise and sticks to her plan, something that lowers suspicion over herself and her allies. This is showed when, at the chance of getting Kagami's ring or even the Peacock Miraculous, Chrysalis opted to abandon the plan after the original objective was compromised, as, if she had done it, the heroes could have suspected of Tomoe Tsurugi and potentially connect both of them.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Personality
Chrysalis is very elusive and strategic, and she takes advantage of situations, as shown in "Heartfixer," where she agreed to akumatize Ray, Loïc, and Nelson to separate Marinette and Adrien, and then akumatize Marinette herself to interrogate her about whether she was Ladybug, openly admitting that this was the only reason she helped the three whom she referred to as incompetent. When her plans fail, unlike Hawk Moth, Chrysalis remains unfazed, using her defeats to study her enemies and be more strategic the next time.
In "Nemesis", Chrysalis demonstrates how meticulous she is in reaching her lair without raising suspicion, impersonating several civilians to arrive undetected. She also knows how to act quickly when things get complicated, as shown when the Miraculers ambushed her in her hideout. Chrysalis used the tunnels of the Paris catacombs to mislead them and impersonated King Monkey to deceive Ladybug and escape successfully. She burned all her diaries to prevent the heroes from obtaining any evidence that could reveal her identity, not caring at all about destroying weeks of research, as long as she remained in the shadows undetected.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Personality
As Volpina, when she was akumatized for the first time, she proved to be determined and vengeful, driven by the desire to settle scores with Ladybug. Deeply humiliated after being exposed as a liar, she channeled her resentment into a meticulously calculated plan to deceive and manipulate, showing a complete lack of scruples. She used sophisticated illusions to create chaos, such as when she threatened to collapse a building on civilians or emotionally manipulated Ladybug by using Adrien, aiming for Ladybug's surrender. Volpina demonstrated a notable ability to avoid direct physical confrontation. She preferred to use her cleverness and illusions to attack without engaging in combat, like when she created multiple copies of herself to confuse Ladybug and Cat Noir, or when she simulated a missile threat to intimidate Ladybug and force her to comply with her demands.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Personality
In her second akumatization, Volpina became more willing to collaborate with Hawk Moth, actively participating in his plan to turn Heroes' Day into chaos. Her ability to create illusions remained, but that time her goal was broader: to become a nightmare for the entire city. Her most impactful illusion was that of an evil Ladybug destroying Cat Noir, aiming to undermine public trust in the heroes.
In her third akumatization, her resentment toward Ladybug remained the driving force behind her actions. Once again, she collaborated with Scarlet Moth and devised an even more elaborate strategy, creating an illusion of him to deceive the heroes, showing how calculating she could be. Although her plan ultimately failed, this only fueled her fury, as Volpina never stopped questioning the justice and power of Ladybug and Cat Noir, challenging them with the idea that they could have used their abilities to improve the world in a more meaningful way.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Personality
As Chameleon, because she was akumatized voluntarily, her personality remained the same, using her powers to get even with the ones that she believed wronged her. For example, she took Adrien's form to make him look bad and at the same time to lead Ladybug into a "trap". Her desire to defeat Ladybug was so great that she preferred to advance to battle her than take an unconscious Cat Noir's Miraculous to Hawk Moth.
As Hoaxer, her vengeful personality became much more intense, as she used her power to convince everyone that Marinette was Monarch to turn them against her, as well as convincing them that Ladybug and Cat Noir were aliens that would destroy the ozone layer to defeat them, as the superheroes would not have used their powers against civilians. Not just that, but Hoaxer showed to be very intelligent, keeping herself inside the system of the Alliances to avoid physical confrontation and even using her pursue over the superheroes to keep Monarch distracted and prevent him from realizing the vengeance she was about to enact on him by manipulating Nathalie into delivering her all of his secrets.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Personality
As Timestalker, she showed herself to be stealthy and determined to discover and record her enemies' secrets like Gabriel's wish and accomplices and Ladybug's secret identity in her notebook to keep to herself after losing her memory following her deakumatization, also, she wanted to steal the other Miraculouses but refrained from doing so to avoid being discovered, and when confronted by Chronobug, she cleverly hid herself in places where Chronobug couldn't appear without exposing herself and changing the timeline and remained unfazed when Chronobug briefly captured her with her Yo-Yo, knowing the heroine couldn't deakumatize her, albeit she became shocked when Chronobug revealed she was aware of Timestalker being the new Butterfly holder. Also, she refrained from speaking in this akumatized form to prevent Chronobug and Bunnyx from discovering her identity or gender.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Personality
As Spectral Looter, she was determined to steal all the Miraculouses in Marinette's room and remained unfazed when confronted by Chronobug, knowing the heroine couldn't stop her or even attack her with her intangibility and took pleasure in taunting Chronobug for her failure before escaping with the stolen Miraculouses.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Abilities
As a Civilian
Lila is a highly crafty and cunning liar. She skillfully uses her lies to manipulate people into doing what she wants. When her deceitful tactics fail, she often resorts to making others feel pity for her in an effort to gain emotional leverage. Even Tikki, a being who has existed since the universe's creation, believes that Lila is the best liar she has ever encountered. Lila's mastery of lying and manipulation is so profound that she can maintain three different lives by weaving an intricate web of falsehoods, allowing her to make any of her personas vanish for extended periods and reappear without raising suspicion. The only people who see right through her deception are Marinette (Ladybug), Adrien (Cat Noir), Tikki, and Plagg.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Abilities
She was shown to be very stealthy, like taking the test answers without anyone noticing and placing them in Marinette's bag. She also managed to return home from the Eiffel Tower unseen during the events of Heroes' Day. Also, she was able to sneak into the Agreste mansion and steal the Butterfly Miraculous unnoticed. Lila possesses a sort of indomitable will due to her undying hatred for Ladybug and will do anything to bring her down. She seems to be able to know the sign language used by the mute and the deaf as we see her communicating with one of her three mothers who is just that.
Lila is also a master of disguise, as she was able to disguise herself as her many personas and also as a Le Grand Paris waitress and infiltrate without being recognized. She is capable of making herself stand out and then be able to blend in with great ease.
As Chrysalis
As Chrysalis, she has enhanced skills such as speed, agility, strength, and near-invulnerability. She also has a cane which she can use to fight or to store akumas inside of it.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Abilities
Her superpower is akumatization, the ability to charge butterflies with dark energy, transforming them into Ultrakumas and then sending them out to possess an object of someone vulnerable and transform them into supervillains, granting them a wide variety of superpowers or special abilities. However, in order to akumatize them, she needs their consent. If they refuse, then she can't akumatize them or the akumatization is reversed (in case they have already been akumatized). She can akumatize herself as well.
She can also telepathically communicate with her akumatized supervillains through a purple butterfly-shaped outline that appeared in front of her and the akumatized supervillains' faces. Through the akumatized villain's perception, they communicate in a purple-colored mindscape, where Chrysalis presents herself with a disguised avatar in the form of a purple glowing silhouette with a simplified butterfly mask and speaking with a mix of voices. The conversations between them can happen at the speed of thought.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Abilities
However, her disguised voices can revert back to her real one if she becomes scared, as shown in "El Toro De Piedra", when she accidentally enrages Raúl Bruel during his akumatization.
Unlike Hawk Moth, Chrysalis has been able to evolve her powers to conjure butterfly-shaped energy beams called antikumas which she is able to cast through the light mask of her akumatized supervillains against other Miraculous holders. When they hit them, the transmission of powers between holder and Miraculous is severed, leaving them powerless and only with their suit. However, she needs her akumatized villain to look directly at the holders and the effects are temporary and can be reversed by detransforming.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Abilities
Chrysalis' powers are revealed to have evolved significantly by the events of "Nemesis". She is able to alter both her physical form and voice, thus shapeshifting into other people, such as Uncle Wang, King Monkey and various other civilians. However, it's unclear whether that power is connected to her use of the Butterfly Miraculous, or granted by a different source. Also seen in "Nemesis", she can shapeshift while someone is akumatized and can telepathically communicate with them while in other people's forms.
As Volpina
Like Rena Rouge, Volpina could play a tune on her flute with an idea in mind to create a glowing orange ball of energy. She could throw the orange ball of energy anywhere with her flute and create whatever incredibly lifelike illusion that she wanted. However, the illusions were intangible, and when touched would disappear in an orange cloud.
Volpina's flute was long enough to wield as a staff.
As Chameleon

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Abilities
Chameleon could transform into another person after kissing them, causing her victims to fall asleep. As long she remained in their form, her victims remained asleep. Once Chameleon took another form, they woke up. When turned into a Miraculous holder, Lila could use their powers, like when she fought Ladybug in Cat Noir's form and her power allowed her to utilize the Cataclysm.
Even if she couldn't take the form of a Miraculous holder, she was very agile, as shown while pretending to be Adrien she was able to jump up the Eiffel Tower.
As Hoaxer

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Abilities
Hoaxer possessed the ability to enter the Alliance rings system and pop in and out of the real world as she pleased. She also possessed the ability to, aided by the power of the Fox Miraculous, create highly elaborated and life-like illusions that appear on the holographic screen of any Alliance, and anyone who looked at them would get mind-controlled and believe whatever she said to be the truth even if it was highly illogical and would do her bidding as she ordered them to, as when she ordered the civilians to go after Marinette after showing them an illusion of her secretly being Monarch. The Alliance tracking system enabled Hoaxer to locate anyone wearing an Alliance and alerted her if someone under her control had their Alliance removed. She could also appear in the real world and the Alliance ring system simultaneously.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Abilities
However, her control over someone was canceled if the person's Alliance ring was removed or destroyed, such as when both Roger and Alya were freed when the heroes removed their Alliances. Her mind-control powers also did not work on anyone not wearing an Alliance, even if they saw her on someone else's ring, as Ivan, Mylene, and Adrien were not affected despite seeing her on their friends' Alliance rings.
As Timestalker
Timestalker could travel through time using a smartwatch on her wrist. Thanks to that ability, she was able to spy on past moments. However, because she needed to activate her smartwatch manually to travel, she would become vulnerable in close combat, especially against adversaries who could travel through time as well. To counter this weakness, Timestalker used her smartphone (her akumatized object) to act as a failsafe to bring her back to a moment soon after she left, while also having spare smartwatches in case the one she was wearing was taken, broken, or destroyed. She proved to be very skilled in hand-to-hand combat and was able to best Chronobug on multiple occasions.
As Spectral Looter

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Abilities
Spectral Looter shared the same abilities as Troublemaker, allowing her to phase through solid matter and become intangible to any attack, much like a real ghost. However, unlike Troublemaker, she could float and use her fingertips to make anything she touched intangible as well. This unique ability enabled her to steal anything she desired, even if those objects were being worn by someone else.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Etymology
The name "Lila" means "beauty", as well as "lilac" in Italian.
"Lila" is pronounced as "lee-lah" in the French dub, and "lie-lah" in the English dub. It is possible that the name "Lila" was chosen due to its first syllable sounding like the word "lie".
In the Irish dub, her name is changed to Líle De Róiste. This still fits the floral theme of this false identity since "líle" is Irish for "lily".
In the Welsh dub, her name is changed to Leila.
The surname "Rossi" means "red" in Italian.
Lila is sometimes associated with said color, wearing a red jacket and red accessories.
Cerise is the color of deep, bright red with pink tint, as well as "cherry" in French. But the name also refers to a type of flower known as a "cerise queen".
The surname "Bianca" means "white" in Italian.
Volpina is similar to the word volpe, which is Italian for "fox". The suffix "-ina" indicates "small" and is often used in feminine names among friends, as a form of nickname or pet name. Roughly translated, "Volpina" means "Vixen" or "Small Fox" in Italian.
A Chrysalis is the pupal stage of butterflies, when caterpillars transition into its adult stage.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Etymology
The name "Chrysalis" remains unknown to the public and has not yet been revealed within the series. However, it is featured in the end credits of season 6 episodes.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Trivia
Revealed by the Staff
Lila was first revealed when Wilfried Pain posted a drawing of her as Volpina on his Twitter. When a fan page on Facebook shared the image, Thomas Astruc added a comment where he revealed her akumatized name.
Later, Thomas posted a picture on Twitter as a sneak peek of Lila (as Volpina) with the caption "Una ragazza italiana in Pariggi," meaning "An Italian girl in Paris."
When Mélody Cisinski was asked on Tumblr if Volpina would show up eventually before season 1 ended, she replied "Yes and no."
Thomas noted that he intentionally made Lila to be unlovable.
Miraculous Holder and Akumatized Villain
Volpina's abilities are based on those of the Fox Miraculous and its holders, similar to how Copycat has Cat Noir's powers, Antibug has powers similar to Ladybug's and Queen Wasp is similar to Queen Bee.
She is the first:
akumatized villain to have amplified Miraculous superpowers, as it's revealed in "Timetagger" that prolonged and multiple uses of said powers only occur when a holder grows into an adult.
to direct the akuma to an object.
to introduce herself to Hawk Moth instead of the other way around.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Trivia

She is the third:
akumatized villain who doesn't appear in the theme song or its animatic in season 1. The others are Animan and Kung Food, both of whom appear in the animatic.
person to be akumatized voluntarily.
known Miraculous holder to upgrade her powers, creating the ultrakumas that allow her to shoot antikumas. Ladybug was the first with the creation of the magical charms and the second was Shadow Moth with the creation of the megakumas.
However, she is the second to make a power upgrade that is not an enhancement of a pre-existing power. Shadow Moth's megakumas are just more powerful akumas that are strong enough to break through Ladybug's magical charms.
Ironically, Chrysalis' antikumas have a reverse effect than her ultrakumas, being able to remove powers.
She is one of the few people, alongside Gabriel Agreste, Nathalie Sancoeur (before Season 5), Tomoe Tsurugi, and, after "Miracle Queen", Chloé Bourgeois, that sees Ladybug as her enemy even while not akumatized.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Trivia
As of Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2), following Alya Césaire, Nino Lahiffe, Chloé Bourgeois, Nathalie Sancoeur, Luka Couffaine, Max Kanté, Kagami Tsurugi, Alix Kubdel, Lê Chiến Kim, Adrien Agreste, Wang Fu, Zoé Lee, Mylène Haprèle, Rose Lavillant, Juleka Couffaine, Sabrina Raincomprix, Marc Anciel, Nathaniel Kurtzberg, and Ivan Bruel, Cerise is the twentieth person to become a Miraculous holder and akumatized villain, excluding Gabriel Agreste, who akumatized himself and Félix Fathom, who resisted the akuma.
She is the second person:
to akumatize herself. The first was Gabriel.
to rival Marinette for Adrien's affections, behind Chloé Bourgeois.
In "Catalyst", she becomes the first previously akumatized victim to be re-akumatized with the same supervillain identity but a different akuma.
The akuma that affected her is the first to be seen de-evilized by Hawk Moth himself and removed on-screen. That happened again to André and Audrey Bourgeois in "Heart Hunter" and Chloé Bourgeois in "Deflagration".
Her smirk after being de-evilized in "Catalyst" implies she may have been the first person to be willingly akumatized other than Hawk Moth himself and his assistant Nathalie.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Trivia
Despite her third akumatization being caused by Scarlet Moth, she didn't have a red-colored appearance.
According to Thomas, this was an animation error.
In "Gamer 2.0", Volpina returns as a playable akumatized villain as part of the Gamer 2.0's powers.
A statue of Volpina appears in Musée Grévin in "The Puppeteer 2".
Her akumatization into Chameleon marks the first time a villain doesn't change their appearance upon akumatization; however, this quickly changes after she uses her powers on Adrien.
"Timetagger" featured hints that she would get the Butterfly Miraculous, as the titular villain said that the Hawk Moth of the future isn't Gabriel, and Chris thought Lila was cool.
As seen in "Mr. Pigeon 72", she has been akumatized into Volpina five times. ("Volpina", "Catalyst", "Mayura" and two off-screen akumatizations).
With her akumatizations into Chameleon, Hoaxer, Timestalker and Spectral Looter, she has been akumatized 9 times in total.
With her 9 akumatizations, she comes in third place for having been akumatized the most number of times, behind Mr. Ramier and Chloé.
She is also the person with the second most unique akumatized forms at 5, behind Chloé at 7.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Trivia
She is the last member of Miss Bustier's class to gain possession of a Miraculous.
Timestalker is the fifth akumatized villain to have time-related powers after Timebreaker, Backwarder, Timetagger and Ephemeral.
In-universe, she is the third, as Timetagger is from the future, making him the fourth, and Ephemeral only happened in an alternate timeline which got erased.
Based on Timestalker's smartphone timestamps, she started her plan to find Ladybug's identity at 2:30 PM, meaning Bug Noire and Monarch's fight happened earlier that day, between late morning and early afternoon. By 10:10 PM, Cerise was in her lair, reading her old notes and akumatizing herself into Spectral Looter preparing to steal Marinette's miraculous.
Chrysalis' akumatization avatar has an appearance reminiscent of Oblivio and Solitude.
Similarly to Gabriel in "Ladybug & Cat Noir", her face as a civilian isn't shown throughout Season 6, although unlike Hawk Moth, her identity has been known since the beginning.
Miscellaneous
Interestingly, her two known identites follow a naming scheme. The first name is the name of a flower in French, while the surname is a color in Italian.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Trivia
Cerise's last name "Bianca" was first revealed in the game Miraculous™ RP: Ladybug & Cat Noir.
In "Chameleon", Tikki claimed to have never seen anyone as skilled at lying as Lila, which says a lot to say the least, since the Kwami of Creation has existed since the very creation of the universe itself.
As seen in "Catalyst", her room as Lila is decorated with masks, which symbolize hiding the truth.
She tells several stories assumed to be lies:
Her name is Lila Rossi.
She knows Prince Ali and flew with him in his private jet.
Jagged Stone wrote a song about Lila.
She knows all of the Hollywood directors, and promised she'd introduce Nino to Steven Spielberg.
Ladybug saved Lila's life, and the two of them are best friends.
She loves superheroes.
She claims to be a descendant of a Fox Miraculous holder seen in the Miraculous spellbook, calling her Volpina. According to her, Volpina is "one of the most important superheroes, more powerful and celebrated than Ladybug". She also claimed that her grandmother gave her the Fox Miraculous, showing a similar-looking trinket she bought in a gift shop after seeing the Miraculous in the Grimoire.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Trivia
As Volpina, most of the things she said were lies. For example, she told Adrien and all of Paris that she was a true superhero.
She has a close relationship with Prince Ali.
She saved Jagged Stone's kitten.
She knows a famous manga artist.
She had tinnitus.
She once saw a guy in India have their eye gouged out by a napkin.
She knows several foreign languages.
She has a ball-related phobia.
She once starred in a Hollywood movie.
Despite her claims of being a descendant of a fox-themed superheroine being false, her identity as Lila physically looks like the holder of the Fox Miraculous illustrated in the Miraculous spellbook.
In "Style Queen", she appears in the audience, but according to Thomas Astruc, it was an animation mistake and she wasn't supposed to be in the episode or its use as a clip in "Queen Wasp".
She is one of the few people aware of Gabriel's supervillain identity alongside Nathalie Sancoeur, Félix Fathom, Tomoe and Kagami Tsurugi, Marinette Dupain-Cheng and Alix Kubdel.
In the "Miraculous Secrets" card game, it is confirmed that Lila Rossi is not her real name.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Trivia
She currently knows the secret identities of four of the Miraculers while suspecting three of the Miraculers, those being:
Bunnyx, Ryuko, Argos, and Pegasus. She is shown to know Bunnyx's secret identity in "Multiplication", Ryuko and Argos in "Yaksi Gozen",  and Pegasus in "A Fairy Good Night".
She also suspects Ladybug, Minotaurox, and Caprikid. Cerise suspected Ladybug in "Climatiqueen", "Vampigami", and "The Dark Castle", Minotaurox in "El Toro De Piedra", and Caprikid in "The Ruler", but she can't prove it yet. She nearly succeeded in learning Ladybug's identity in "Heartfixer", but Adrien used his love for Marinette to help her break free of the akumatization.
Only two characters are confirmed to be aware of Cerise's supervillain identity as Chrysalis:
Alix Kubdel/Bunnyx, who found out in the Burrow after the events of "Miraculous London", albeit she refrains from reveal it to Ladybug to avoid risking the timeline.
Tomoe Tsurugi, as she was working with Lila since Season 5, which wasn't revealed until "Yaksi Gozen".
In "The Illustrhater", Cerise mentions in her journal that several people know who she is, and that The Miraculers will know nothing about them.

title: Lila Rossi
text:
Lila Rossi - Trivia
As seen in both "Revelation" and "Confrontation", she has created a great web of lies that involve multiple identities and mothers which she appears to juggle with little effort.

title: List of Lucky Charm objects
text:
List of Lucky Charm objects - Trivia
Like the Ladyblog logo, the "Miraculous Ladybug" branding on the box of the Ladybug costume is similar to an old concept of the show's logo. However, unlike the Ladyblog, the branding is an exact copy. In addition, the earrings that came with the costume appear to be based on the PV design.
According to a tweet by Thomas Astruc, the most complex Lucky Charm was the pipe in "Backwarder".
This is also confirmed in-universe by Ladybug herself, as she calls it "the most complicated ever".
The least complex Lucky Charm used in combat was the glitter in "Antibug".
The least complex in general is the helmet in "Psycomedian".
All Lucky Charm objects are red with black spots, like a ladybug pattern, with the exception of the car key from "Syren".
Funnily enough, while lacking the usual pattern, the car keys are black with a single red button - effectively having the same color palette.
The mecha summoned in "Miraculous Tokyo" is the largest Lucky Charm summoned by a Miraculous holder yet.

title: List of Lucky Charm objects
text:
List of Lucky Charm objects - Trivia
The coin in "Mr. Pigeon", the balls in "The Evillustrator" and "Simpleman", the windup toy in "Darkblade", the glitter container in "Antibug", the merry-go-round token in "Heart Hunter" and the watch and weight in "Ephemeral" are the smallest Lucky Charms that are summoned by a Miraculous holder.
The biggest Lucky Charm summoned was the galette by Tikki in "Dearest Family".
The rocket launcher from "Malediktator" and the ray gun in "Qilin" marked the only times Ladybug's lucky charm produced actual weapons.
"Catalyst", "Risk", "Representation" and "Conformation" are the only episodes in which Lucky Charm is not used.
Coincidentally, "Catalyst", "Risk" and "Conformation" are all the first parts of a season finale two-parter.
The tape roll from "Prime Queen", "Crocoduel" and "Confrontation" is the only object to have appeared in more than two episodes.

This is a list of Akumatized objects. Sometimes, an object will also end up being the akumatized villain's weapon or tool. Ladybug and Cat Noir have to break, damage, or destroy the object in order to release the akuma.

The general items include: Alix's sneakers, Fred's derby hat, Sabrina's glasses, Nadja's microphone, Ivan's backpack, Max's cellphone, Rose's cellphone, Placide's cellphone, and Mylène's, Fred's, Rose's, Aurore's, Jalil's, Roger's, Kagami's, Otis', and Kim's "Heroes Day" pins.
