title: List of akumatized objects
text:
List of akumatized objects - Trivia
In order to release the akuma so that Ladybug can capture it, every akumatized object must be broken.
After a person has been transformed by an akuma, their akumatized object will change appearance and sometimes, size and shape.
Usually, an akumatized object would generate the villain's powers, but there are numerous exceptions.
Sometimes the akumatized object is replaced after the villain is defeated.
Alya buys a new cellphone in "Lady Wifi".
Chloé gives Sabrina a new brooch in "Antibug".
Reflekta's akumatized object is replicated onto people she turns them into her copies, but hers is the only one to contain an akuma or to have the power to transform people. When trying to release Reflekta's akuma, Ladybug accidentally destroys André Bourgeois' copy of the bracelet.
In "Timebreaker", when both Timebreakers' rollerblades were broken, there were two akumas.
A similar event happens in "The Puppeteer". The titular villain created three new objects: Rogercop's whistle, Evillustrator's stylus, and Lady Wifi's cellphone, but none of them contained akumas, as Ladybug discovered when she destroyed the cellphone.

title: List of akumatized objects
text:
List of akumatized objects - Trivia
In "Sapotis", the titular creatures multiplied every time they ate, creating many clones and hats, but only the original hat had the akuma, which Ladybug figured out when she destroyed the hat of a clone.
In "Gamer 2.0", the point of Miraculous All-Star Brawl is to destroy the akumatized villains object, but only Gamer 2.0 had the real akuma.
However, this isn't always the case. In "Mega Leech", all the mini Malediktator clones created by the titular sentimonster had their own akumas and amoks.
This is likely because Malediktator was cloned by a sentimonster, which is created from a different miraculous power.
None of the statues in Musée Grévin brought to life by Puppeteer in "The Puppeteer 2" have akumatized objects, instead having to be broken in some way, for the statue to be destroyed, similarly to akumatized objects.
In "Santa Claws", after the akumatized object, Santa's hat, is destroyed to release the akuma, it is never seen again, destroyed or fixed, afterwards, followed by the twins' hats in "Sapotis", the rose Cat Noir gave to Tom in "Weredad", XY's mask that he stole from Kitty Section's idea in "Silencer", and Future Chris Lahiffe's spray can in "Timetagger".

title: Lindalee Rose (character)
text:
Lindalee Rose (character) - Intro
Lindalee Rose was an upcoming character who was going to appear in a few webisodes of Miraculous: Tales from Paris, but the series was later cancelled.

title: Lindalee Rose (character)
text:
Lindalee Rose (character) - Appearance
Physical appearance
Lindalee is short with blue-green eyes. She also has long blonde hair with bangs.
Civilian attire
In one concept art, her hair is tied into two high ponytails with a red bow each. She wears a short-sleeved white top with a ladybug logo as the graphic design located at the center and a black-spotted red short skirt. The top has a black neck collar, and she wears a black underskirt. She wears gray opaque thigh highs and black Mary Jane shoes.

title: Lindalee Rose (character)
text:
Lindalee Rose (character) - Trivia
Lindalee was going to be played by and based on the YouTuber Lindalee Rose.
Because of the cancellation of Miraculous: Tales from Paris, it's unknown how far the production was for the webisodes that featured her.
According to Lindalee, the web series didn't get "far enough to put [her character] in". This implies that she hasn't recorded her lines for her character nor the webisodes that featured her are finished.
Lindalee hopes her character would make her official on-screen appearance someday in a different Miraculous Ladybug media.
The character was first revealed in a video her voice actress uploaded on the official Miraculous Ladybug YouTube channel about Los Angeles Comic Con 2016.
Jeremy Zag mentioned that she would have been featured in a webisode where she would interview Ladybug and Cat Noir in Paris while they are in action.
Several concept art of her character were revealed on April 15, 2019.

title: List of Marinette's creations
text:
List of Marinette's creations - Intro
This is a list of Marinette's creations. Many of these creations by Marinette Dupain-Cheng are fashion-related, but there are other types of things she has made, from album covers to dolls. A good number of her creations are also gifts for other people.

title: List of Marinette's creations
text:
List of Marinette's creations - Objects
Season 1=
Object First appearance Description ImageMarinette's purse"Stormy Weather"Marinette often wears this purse throughout the series.
Tikki usually hides in it while they're in public.
In "Guitar Villain", she tells Placide I.T.
that it is a talking purse.BoaterMarinette asks Manon to stop playing with this hat, as it isn't finished yet.Chaise lounge"The Evillustrator"Marinette tells Zoé in "Adoration" that she made it from salvaged parts.Pizza delivery disguise"Princess Fragrance"Marinette takes a red helmet, a pink cape and a pizza box and uses them to sneak into the Le Grand Paris, so she can take back Tikki from Chloé.Valentine's Day card"Dark Cupid"Using a card Alya Césaire gets her, Marinette writes a poem on this card as a response to the letter she believes Adrien Agreste wrote for her.Marinette's derby hat"Mr.
Pigeon"This hat is the winner of a design competition judged by Gabriel Agreste.
Marinette's inspiration for it comes from Xavier Ramier and pigeons.

title: List of Marinette's creations
text:
List of Marinette's creations - Objects
It also got her the attention and praise from Audrey Bourgeois and an invitation to work with her in New York City, but Marinette rejects her offer.Jagged Stone's glasses"Pixelator"As requested by Jagged Stone and after failing to get him glasses that he liked, Marinette creates this unique pair of glasses for him, which he is ultimately pleased with.Adrien's schedule"Copycat"A chart showing the schedule of Adrien Agreste's daily activities.Adrien desktop background"The Bubbler"A collage of pictures of Adrien with pink, transparent, swirly hearts Marinette uses as her desktop background.Adrien's birthday scarfMarinette made this scarf as a birthday present for Adrien Agreste.
However, Nathalie Sancoeur removes her name from it and tells Adrien that it is a gift from his father.Marinette's lucky charm bracelet "Gamer"A bracelet that Marinette owned for good luck.

title: List of Marinette's creations
text:
List of Marinette's creations - Objects

title: List of minor characters/Animals
text:
List of minor characters/Animals - Intro
This is a list of minor animals that have appeared in the television series, the comic books, or anything else related to Miraculous. Make sure to add animals who have appeared as background characters, minor characters, or in one specific episode.

title: List of minor characters/Animals
text:
List of minor characters/Animals - Bears
A bear is in an exhibit at the zoo in Ménagerie du Jardin des Plantes. When Otis is akumatized into "Animan", he releases the bear. While free, the bear uses a car as a back scratcher (a reference to the Jungle Book) while its owner is trying to prop it up with a carjack. While akumatized, Otis also turns into a bear form to fight against Ladybug and Cat Noir.

title: List of minor characters/Animals
text:
List of minor characters/Animals - Catfish
Multiple catfish live in the Seine. In the Miraculous Adventures story "Silurus", after a fisherman is akumatized into the villain Silurus, he gains the ability to control said catfish. One giant catfish lands with its mouth open onto Chloé, who complains she is being swallowed by a "too fresh piece of sushi".

title: List of minor characters/Animals
text:
List of minor characters/Animals - Cats
A black cat appears in the theme song when it runs in front of Marinette while she is running to school. Black cats are believed to cause bad luck, causing her to trip and fall.
While Marinette as Ladybug is trying to record a new video for Alya with Alya's cellphone in "The Mime", a gray cat comes by and knocks the placed cellphone into the garbage can below.
In "Kuro Neko", Rythm becomes one of Shadow Moth's victims, promising her "the biggest cat in the whole wide world". When Ladybug convinces her to get rid of Kuro Neko, she cries about her losing her cat. Cat Walker then appears and returns Rythm's cat to her. Overjoyed, Rythm and her cat run around the Stade des Princes together.
Whiskers
Whiskers is a gray cat owned by Mrs. Michelle.
In "Simon Says", Marinette thinks back to when as Ladybug she saved Whiskers in a tree.
In "The Dark Owl", Whiskers ran away from Mrs. Michelle. Mr. Damoclès, in his persona of The Owl, tries to save him stuck in a tree, but when Whiskers bites him, they both fall off the tree and Ladybug and Cat Noir catch them.
In "Jubilation", Whiskers returns only instead of getting stuck in the tree and getting stuck on the billboard.

title: List of minor characters/Animals
text:
List of minor characters/Animals - Cats
In "The Illustrhater", Whiskers again climbs a tree next to Canal Saint-Martin, after which he is saved first by Ladybug, and then by Miss Hound with the help of her ball.

title: List of minor characters/Animals
text:
List of minor characters/Animals - Dogs
In "Yaksi Gozen", a golden retriever steals Adrien's beef ribs.

title: List of minor characters/Animals
text:
List of minor characters/Animals - Crocodiles
A crocodile is in an exhibit at the Ménagerie du Jardin des Plantes zoo. When Otis is akumatized into Animan, he releases the crocodile. Jagged Stone also owns a crocodile named Fang.

title: List of minor characters/Animals
text:
List of minor characters/Animals - Eagles
An eagle is in an exhibit at the Ménagerie du Jardin des Plantes zoo. In "Animan", after Otis is akumatized into the titular villain, he releases the eagle. There is also a Miraculous based on the animal, which Liiri inhabits, and is currently being used by Jessica Keynes.

title: List of minor characters/Animals
text:
List of minor characters/Animals - Elephants
An elephant is in an exhibit at the Ménagerie du Jardin des Plantes zoo. When Otis is akumatized into Animan, he releases the elephant.

title: List of minor characters/Animals
text:
List of minor characters/Animals - Flamingos
A flock of flamingos fly over the Île aux Cygnes in "Silurus".

title: List of minor characters/Animals
text:
List of minor characters/Animals - Giraffes
A giraffe is in an exhibit at the Ménagerie du Jardin des Plantes zoo. When Otis is akumatized into Animan, he releases the giraffe, who snatches and eats a potted tree plant from someone's balcony while free.

title: List of minor characters/Animals
text:
List of minor characters/Animals - Gorillas
Gorillas are in an exhibit at the Ménagerie du Jardin des Plantes zoo. In "Animan", after Otis is akumatized into the titular villain, he releases the gorillas. During their time out of the cages, the gorillas mess around in the Métro. A gorilla also appears at the beginning of "Syren".
In "Gorizilla", Placide is akumatized by Hawk Moth into Gorizilla, a gorilla-themed supervillain.
In "Queen Banana", Shadow Moth creates a Gorilla-themed sentimonster, Banana Boom-Boom, from Chloé Bourgeois' emotions.

title: List of minor characters/Animals
text:
List of minor characters/Animals - Horses
Santa Claus owns two brown horses that pull his sleigh through the snowy streets of Paris in "Santa Claws". When Santa is akumatized into Santa Claws, his horses are transformed into black reindeer.

title: List of minor characters/Animals
text:
List of minor characters/Animals - Ladybugs
A ladybug lands on the Valentines' Day card that Marinette is writing for Adrien in "Dark Cupid", Alya calling it a good omen. She mentions this because at the time of the episode, she had uploaded to her Ladyblog, saying ladybugs mean 'good luck' and 'new beginnings'. Alya implies Marinette doesn't read her blog when Marinette has no clue of what Alya is talking about. When Adrien receives the card later, he doesn't know who it's from because Marinette forgot to sign it. Another ladybug lands on it, and Adrien assumes it means that the card is from Ladybug.

title: List of minor characters/Animals
text:
List of minor characters/Animals - Panthers
Panthers are an exhibit at the Ménagerie du Jardin des Plantes zoo. In "Animan", after Otis is akumatized into the titular villain, he releases a panther. In "Syren", the Panthers escape the zoo but are later captured by Ladybug and Cat Noir.

title: List of minor characters/Animals
text:
List of minor characters/Animals - Pigeons
Pigeons are a recurring species of bird that live in Paris, France. They are currently being fed by Xavier Ramier. The pigeons are fond of Mr. Ramier because of his frequent feedings for them. The pigeons fall under his control whenever he is akumatized into Mr. Pigeon. However, the pigeons stop listening to him if they see available food.
In "Mr. Pigeon", after Mr. Ramier is akumatized into the titular villain, he uses his whistle to control all pigeons in Paris. In "Mr. Pigeon 72", after Mr. Ramier is re-akumatized for the 72nd time into Mr. Pigeon, he blows on his whistle, turning all pigeons that lives in Paris into raven-pigeon hybrids, with the ability to also turn humans into villainous pigeons.
One pigeon is watching Marinette, Alya, and Tikki on the balcony of Marinette's room at the beginning of "The Mime". When Alya is confused about who Marinette is talking to when she returns, Marinette claims she was talking to the pigeon, calling it Jacques.
A pigeon blocks Juleka Couffaine's face in a photo of her with Rose Lavillant, as seen in "Reflekta".
A couple of pigeons perch on Antibug's sword after Cat Noir throws it and it gets stuck on the Eiffel Tower in "Antibug".

title: List of minor characters/Animals
text:
List of minor characters/Animals - Pigeons
In "Volpina", some of Volpina's illusions are ruined by pigeons. One pigeon is hit by the comet illusion, and another hits a piece of rubble of the falling building illusion.
In "Reverser", after Reverser hit Xavier Ramier with a paper airplane, his pigeons start fleeing from him.
In "Desperada", some pigeons are seen eating the bread on Luka's guitar.
Edgar
Edgar is Xavier's favorite pigeon and is currently being fed by him.
In "Mr. Pigeon", after Xavier is akumatized into the titular villain, he uses his whistle to control him and other pigeons in Paris.
In "Mr. Pigeon 72", Mr. Ramier gave Edgar the task to deliver the rose to Adrien which means that he is really skilled with holding objects. Later, after Xavier is re-akumatized into Mr. Pigeon 72, he blows on his whistle turning Edgar into a villainous pigeon.

title: List of minor characters/Animals
text:
List of minor characters/Animals - Rats/Mice
Rats are omnivorous mammals that mainly live in sewers, less often on the streets. In "Timetagger", it is revealed that in the future an akumatized villain, Mr. Rat, will be able to control them at will.
Despite the fact that the sewers appear in the series many times, the rats have appeared only three times, and only twice in the sewers ("Silencer" and "Illusion").
In "Timetagger", a rat appears on the Pont des Arts and Mr. Ramier really likes it, who finds it even more beautiful than a pigeon. In this same episode, Bunnyx reveals to Ladybug and Cat Noir that they will be fighting an akumatized man, who's name is Mr. Rat.
Charlotte, Marie-Louise, and Marguerite
Charlotte, Marie-Louise, and Marguerite are the three mice of Roland Dupain who help him while making bread as seen in "Bakerix".
In "Riginarazione", the three mice are taken under the care of Gina Bianchi and went with her to Rio de Janeiro, following Roland's passing.
They might be a reference to the Slovene story Pekarna Mišmaš, where the baker was helped by mice.

title: Lion Miraculous
text:
Lion Miraculous - Intro
The  is a ring that, whenever the lion kwami inhabits it, transforms the wearer into a lion-themed superhero.
It was an unused concept from the old animatic of the theme song. It was however, brought up in "Feast"; Alya Césaire theorizes that the Lion Miraculous is a real Miraculous which was once wielded by the legendary Greek hero, Heracles, potentially confirming its existence.

title: Lion Miraculous
text:
Lion Miraculous - Appearance
The Lion Miraculous is a gold ring. On its face is the head of a lion facing left. It is currently unknown what it would look like in its camouflage mode.

title: Lion Miraculous
text:
Lion Miraculous - Abilities
The Lion Miraculous grants its wielder enhanced superhuman physical abilities, including strength, speed, and agility. It also makes the user nearly invulnerable.
The Miraculous also grants an unknown special superpower.

title: Lion Miraculous
text:
Lion Miraculous - Trivia
Lions symbolize pride, strength, and leadership.
It is possible that it does still exist in the Quantic Universe and it was wielded by Heracles, who is wearing a lion-themed garment, as seen in pottery in "Ladybug & Cat Noir".
This possibility is further explored in "Feast", as Alya posits the hypothesis of Heracles being a Lion Miraculous holder.
The fourth Miraculous jewel to be based off of a ring following the Cat, Ox and Rooster Miraculouses.
It is the third Miraculous jewel to be based off a feline, Following the  Cat and Tiger Miraculouses.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - André's father
He is the father of André Bourgeois, the grandfather of Chloé Bourgeois, the step-grandfather of Noé Luxus and Zoé Lee, and the ex-father-in-law of Audrey Bourgeois who was only mentioned in "Collusion". André revealed that his father was a politician.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Vadim Ature
Vadim Ature is the husband of Minh Cường Lê and Kim's adoptive father, who first appeared in "Sleeping Syren".

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - August's mother
This unnamed woman is a woman who lives in Paris and is the mother of August.
In "Gigantitan", after August is de-akumatized, she makes sure that August is safe and okay. When others help her and her son, she shows gratitude and appreciation, thanking Marinette for helping her get her son's stroller up the stairs and thanking Ladybug and Cat Noir for reverting August back to normal.
In "Miraculer", she walks through the Place des Vosges with her son. August demands a lollipop, but his mother refuses, saying that he is too small for a lollipop. Later, Lollipop Boy appears right in front of them. Seeing him, she turns around and runs away with her son.
Also, in the series, her background model is used in the series as background supporting characters. It is unknown whether any of those characters is meant to be August's mother.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Steven Besielberg
Steven Besielberg is a Hollywood director. In "Volpina", Lila lies that she has met him. She also tells Nino that she can introduce him to Steven. He is based off of the famous movie director Steven Spielberg.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Petrochk Borrotchek
Petrochk Borrotchek is a famous pianist, who was only mentioned in "Chameleon". Lila pretends he's her uncle to impress Adrien.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Chloé Bourgeois (Re-Verse)
Chloé Bourgeois is Marinette Dupain-Cheng's bully, and also an alternative version of Chloé Bourgeois from the Re-Verse who was only mentioned in "Miraculous Paris".

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Mrs. Bruel
Mrs. Bruel is the wife of Raúl Bruel and the mother of Ivan Bruel who was only mentioned in "El Toro De Piedra".

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Bela Bruty
Bela Bruty is a thug who only appeared in "Grendiaper".

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Bob's chauffeur
This unnamed man is the personal chauffeur of Bob, who transports him around Paris by driving his limousine.
In "Sublimation", he waited for his boss in front of the Stade des Princes. However, upon seeing him being chased by the eponymous villain who was trying to force him to sponsor her daughter. After his boss got into the limousine, he escaped. However, his escape was short-lived, as once they reached the Canal Saint-Martin, Sublimation stopped the vehicle and destroyed it, causing him to run away in fear and leaving his boss alone.

id: List of minor characters/Humans::British TV reporter::0
title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - British TV reporter
This unnamed man is a BBD News news anchor in London, England.
In "Representation", he delivered the news of the election of a new mayor of Paris, the main candidates for which were Caline Bustier and Armand D'Argencourt, as well as the arrival of Adrien Agreste and Kagami Tsurugi in London.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Bus driver
This unnamed man is a driver of RATP bus company in Paris.
In "Bakerix", as he passes near a bus stop, he crosses paths with Bakerix and stops the bus when the villain lands suddenly in front of it.
In "Feast", during Ladybug, Cat Noir and Feast's chase after Wang Fu, he stops the bus and blocks the way to help the heroes.
In "Qilin", despite Sabine offering him chouquettes, he did not intervene to inform the ticket inspector of the situation, letting the woman be abused by police.
In "Glaciator 2" and "Revelation", he allows Cat Noir and Lila to ride on the bus without a ticket, due to the fact that they are celebrities.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Captain Redlight
Captain Redlight is a New York City superhero who deals with traffic in Manhattan who was only mentioned in "Miraculous New York" by Hot Dog Dan.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Carny
This unnamed man is a fairground worker who works at the Luna Park des Tuileries.
In "Grendiaper", he witnessed Raymond Pugnant, Loïc Stompet, and Nelson de Glusset getting stuck on the roller coaster despite the fact the rides at the fairgound are closed. After Miss Hound used her powers to get them off the roller coaster, the carny informed her that he had no idea how Ray, Loïc, and Nelson ended up there in the first place.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Cash's henchmen
These unnamed men are Cash's henchmen as well as criminals.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Fen Cheng
Fen Cheng is the mother of Wang and Yan Cheng, the paternal grandmother of Sabine Cheng and the maternal great-grandmother of Marinette Dupain-Cheng, who was only mentioned in "Secret Protocol".

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Sabine Cheng (Re-Verse)
Sabine Cheng is the mother of Marinette Dupain-Cheng, and also an alternative version of Sabine Cheng from the Re-Verse who was only mentioned in "Miraculous Paris".

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Chris
Chris is a mime performer and Fred Haprèle's understudy for The Mime's Extraordinary Adventures.
In "The Mime", to take the lead role, Chris calls Fred and tells him false information about the meeting place, which Ladybug later admits. Later, he reconciles with Fred and performs with him.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Cléo
Cléo is Sabrina's former best friend who was only mentioned in the Miraculous Secrets card game.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Darkblade (ancestor)
Darkblade was a swordsman who lived in medieval Paris, the ruler of Paris for a period of time, and an ancestor of Armand D'Argencourt who was only mentioned in "Darkblade". Nadja Chamack suspects that Darkblade's story is what motivated Armand to run in the election against André Bourgeois, although Armand denies this.
During the medieval times, Darkblade took over Paris, ruling over it with an iron fist. However, later, a wealthy Frenchman won Paris' citizens over with underhanded means, overthrowing Darkblade and ending his reign.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Jean Duparc
Jean Duparc is a student in Ms. Mendeleiev's class at Collège Françoise Dupont.
At the start of "Princess Fragrance", it is revealed that he was akumatized off-screen and turned into the Magician of Misfortune, a supervillain who threatens to make the Eiffel Tower disappear.
In "Mr. Pigeon 72", Rena Rouge used Jean Duparc as an illusion who appeared to be Cat Noir after he took off his ring to not reveal Cat Noir's actual secret identity and also distract Shadow Moth and Mr. Pigeon.
Also, in the series, his background model is used in the series as background supporting characters. It is unknown whether any of those characters is meant to be Jean.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Aurélie Dupoint
Aurélie Dupoint is a ballet dancer and teacher who has been giving lessons to Chloé Bourgeois for 8 years who was only mentioned in "Frightningale" by Chloé Bourgeois.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Déborah's father
This unnamed man is the father of Déborah who was only mentioned in "A Fairy Good Night"

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Destroyer
Destroyer is an akumatized villain Ladybug, Cat Noir, Rena Rouge and Carapace fought at the beginning of "Miraculer".

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Dino Huggie
This unnamed man is a man who was transformed into a giant dinosaur huggie in "Wishmaker". His name became Dino Huggie.
As a child, he always dreamed of becoming a member of the Dino Huggie Gang. Even in adulthood, he still gushes at sight of a stuffed animal in the likeness of a dinosaur. After Wishmaker transformed him, he became very giddy and sought to spread joy by giving people hugs.

id: List of minor characters/Humans::Employee of Bertrand King::0
title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Employee of Bertrand King
This unnamed man is a employee for Bertrand King, who works at his plastic warehouse.
In "Action", he brings boxes of plastic bags filled with sweets for the Dupain-Cheng bakery, and also calmly shows his staff where his boss's office is located.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Florist
This unnamed woman is a florist and the owner of a flower shop in Paris.
In "Qilin", Marinette buys a bouquet of flowers from her for her mother on Mother's Day.
In "Adoration", she helps Marinette and Zoé to create a ball gown first for the prom. Later on the Eiffel Tower, she shows herself especially disappointed when she deceptively thinks that the teenager stole flowers from her, telling her that she could have told her. She is then reassured when it turns out that Marinette did nothing.
In "Confrontation", she is in the flower shop when Reflekta appears and is about to turn her into her clone, but Ladybug saves her.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Froggy's parents
This unnamed man and woman are the parents of Froggy. Froggy's mother shares the same model as Quentin's mother.
In "Risk", after Froggy escaped from them and they tried to catch up with him, he is akumatized and attaches tags to them, after which they start taking risks and let him go.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Gardening teacher
This unnamed woman is a gardening teacher at the Collège Françoise Dupont. In "The Ruler", she taught an outdoor gardening lesson on the school roof.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Denis Gaud
Denis Gaud is a thug who only appeared in the "Grendiaper".

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Gilbert
Gilbert is a flour delivery man by Farine 1930 who delivers for Roland Dupain as seen in "Bakerix".
Also, in the series, his background model is used in the series as background supporting characters. It is unknown whether any of those characters is meant to be Gilbert.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Hairdresser
This unnamed man is a hairdresser who runs a small salon in Paris.
In the cold opening of "Vampigami", he is seen fitting a new wig for Rose shortly before the new school year begins.
In "Grendiaper", he is about to give Bob Roth a haircut when Fury paralyzes Bob and carries him away to the top of the Eiffel Tower.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Mrs. Haprèle
Mrs. Haprèle is the wife of Fred Haprèle and the mother of Mylène Haprèle who was mentioned in "Derision" and "Noe".

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Ignoblia
Ignoblia is the evil sister of Majestia who was only mentioned in "Timetagger" by Bunnyx.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Ivan's grandfather
Ivan's grandfather is the father of Raúl Bruel and the grandfather of Ivan Bruel who was only mentioned in "El Toro De Piedra".

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Ivan's grandmother
Ivan's grandmother is the grandmother of Ivan Bruel and his legal guardian who was only mentioned in "El Toro De Piedra".

id: List of minor characters/Humans::Ivan's little sister::0
title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Ivan's little sister
Ivan's little sister is the daughter of Raúl Bruel and Mrs. Bruel and the little sister of Ivan Bruel who was only mentioned in the Miraculous Secrets card game.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Jagged's mother
Jagged's mother is the mother of Jagged Stone and the grandmother of Juleka Couffaine and Luka Couffaine who was only mentioned in "Pixelator".

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Japanese teacher
This unnamed woman is the Japanese teacher at the Collège Françoise Dupont.
In "Climatiqueen", she held a Japanese lesson in her Japanese classroom.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Kagami's grandfather
Kagami's grandfather is the ex-husband of Nozomi Tsurugi, the father of Tomoe Tsurugi and the grandfather of Cerise Bianca and Kagami Tsurugi who was only mentioned in "Riposte".
In "Yaksi Gozen", a scroll seen in the Tsurugis' Tokyo apartement features a Japanese proverb, "父の思历 山よりも高く 母の愛ら 海よりも深し", which translates to "A father's goodness is higher than the mountain, a mother's goodness deeper than the sea." in English. This implies that Tomoe's father was one of the men she's been disappointed by.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Kazuno's neighbor
This unnamed woman is Kazuno's neighbor, who lives next door to his apartment.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Ketchup Boy
Ketchup Boy is a superhero from New York City and one of Hot Dog Dan's sidekicks who was only mentioned in "Miraculous New York".

id: List of minor characters/Humans::Mr. and Mrs. Lavillant::0
title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Mr. and Mrs. Lavillant
Mr. and Mrs. Lavillant are the parents of Rose Lavillant who were only mentioned in "Guiltrip".

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Mr. Lee
Mr. Lee was Audrey Bourgeois' former lover who she had an affair with and the biological father of Zoé Lee, According to Audrey in "Sole Crusher", Mr. Lee has a tendency to prioritize his work above the wellbeing of others, although it is unclear how valid this is, given that Zoé briefly falters when this is said.

id: List of minor characters/Humans::Le Grand Paris Doorman::0
title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Le Grand Paris Doorman
This unnamed man is a doorman at Le Grand Paris. His model was later reused as the base for Dean Gate/Doorman in "Miraculous New York".
In "Princess Fragrance", he doesn't let Marinette enter the building when she didn't give him enough reason to. Later, when she introduces herself as a pizza delivery guy for Chloé, he calmly lets her in. He was also fascinated by the charms of the eponymous villain.
In "Pixelator", he and Kim willingly allowed the titular villain to take a photo of them.
In "Guitar Villain", the eponymous villain hit him with his powers by making him dance.
In "Malediktator", he takes Chloé's packed things to the roof, and later escorts Audrey and Chloé out of the hotel with the rest of the staff.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Lifeguard
This unnamed man is a lifeguard at the swimming pool.
In "Syren", he appears in the pool with Ondine and Kim, when Ladybug, Cat Noir and Rena Rouge tried to catch escaped panthers from the zoo, admiring the heroes.
In flashback of "Optigami", he oversees the training of Kim and Ondine, which was overseen by a sentimonster created by Mayura.
In "Derision", When Marinette remembers the past, he was particularly worried about her when she fell into the water following Kim's cruel joke, but also very angry at the people who caused this fall. Later, he tries to chase away the akumatized villain, but falls under his spell.

id: List of minor characters/Humans::Lollipop Boy (alternative universe)::0
title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Lollipop Boy (alternative universe)
Lollipop Boy is a lollipop sentimonster that was manifested by an unknown Peacock Miraculous holder from an alternate universe, where he was defeated by Scarabella and Kitty Noire in "Miraculous Paris". It is also an alternative version of Lollipop Boy from an alternative universe.

id: List of minor characters/Humans::Loafamix the Gaul::0
title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Loafamix the Gaul
Loafamix the Gaul is the ancestor of Roland Dupain, who was mentioned in "Bakerix" and "Riginarazione".

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Jean-Phi Loup
Jean-Phi Loup is a thug who only appeared in "Grendiaper".

id: List of minor characters/Humans::Minh Cường Lê::0
title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Minh Cường Lê
Minh Cường Lê is the husband of Vadim Ature and Kim's adoptive father, who first appeared in "Sleeping Syren".

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Mr. López
Mr. López is a man who owns a dalmatian.
In "Lady Chaos", he buys the apartment Amélie Graham de Vanily is interested in by lying to the realtor.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Maya's father
He is the owner of the Café Crème, located in the Place de la Sorbonne and father of Sam, Maya and Sofia.
In "The Illustrhater", when Phong sees that Adrien apparently has not paid for the meal and it doesn't bring money, he gets very angry and scolds his employee, and also hypocritically ignores his own daughter when he compares customers with children.
In "Revelator", he gets hit by the titular villain and it is broadcasted to Paris that he eats his own boogers. It is unknown if this was reversed by the Miraculous Cat Noir.
In "Riginarazione", he gets hit by the titular villain and aged by her when she asked him to open his bar at night.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Maya's mother
She is the mother of Sam, Maya and Sofia who was only mentioned in "Grendiaper".

id: List of minor characters/Humans::Mayor of Mouscron::0
title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Mayor of Mouscron
This unnamed man is the mayor of the city of Mouscron. He is grateful to Sublime and her successes, which made her the pride of the city. At the moment he has only appeared in photographs.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Mrs. Michelle
Mrs. Michelle is a woman who lives in Paris with her son.
In "The Dark Owl", when her cat Whiskers climbs a tree, The Owl tries to save him, but she realizes that his faulty gadgets and an attempt to climb a tree won't work, and decides to call the fire department instead.
In "The Illustrhater", near the Canal Saint-Martin, her cat climbs the tree again and she asks for help when Ladybug and Miss Hound come to her rescue.
In the series, her background model is used in the series as background supporting characters. It is unknown whether any of those characters is meant to be Mrs. Michelle.

id: List of minor characters/Humans::Mrs. Michelle's son::0
title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Mrs. Michelle's son
This unnamed young boy is Mrs. Michelle's son. In "The Dark Owl", he is next to his mother when their cat climbed a tree.
Also, in the series, his background model is used in the series as background supporting characters. It is unknown whether any of those characters is meant to be this young boy.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Miki's parents
They are the parents of Miki who was only mentioned in "Miraculous Tokyo".

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Mr. Mouleux
Mr. Mouleux is a mechanic who works at a repair shop.
In "Daddycop", he was called by a worried Marinette who insisted on him fixing her scooter, but he hung up on her because of her rudeness. He was later surprised when Miss Hound brought him the scooter via her superpower.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Mustard Justice
Mustard Justice is a superhero from New York City and one of Hot Dog Dan's sidekicks who was only mentioned in "Miraculous New York".

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Nino's grandfather
Nino's grandfather is the grandfather of Nino Lahiffe and Chris Lahiffe who was only mentioned in "The Chained Titans".

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Nino's grandmother
Nino's grandmother is the grandmother of Nino Lahiffe and Chris Lahiffe who was mentioned in "Party Crasher" and "The Chained Titans".

id: List of minor characters/Humans::Nora's biological father::0
title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Nora's biological father
This unnamed man is the father of Nora Césaire who was only mentioned in "Sadnansi"

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Pharmacist
This unnamed woman is an employee at pharmacy in Paris.
In "Backwarder", she gently told Ladybug after mistakenly receiving Master Fu's statement that she was already engaged and was not named Marianne Lenoir.
In the series, her background model is used in the series as background supporting characters. It is unknown whether any of those characters is meant to be this unnamed woman.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Phong
Phong is a waiter at Café Crème.
In "The Illustrhater", he serves Adrien and Marinette during their date. After Adrien leaves the cafe and his money flies away, Phong reports this to his boss and is reprimanded.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Placide I.T. (Re-Verse)
Placide I.T. is Adrien Agreste's bodyguard and also an alternative version of Placide I.T. from the Re-Verse.
In a flashback of "Miraculous Paris", he fulfills Adrien's request by purchasing pastries from the Dupain-Cheng bakery.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Quentin
Quentin is a small child who was separated from his mother and impersonated by the titular villain in "Chameleon".
In the series, his background model is used in the series as background supporting characters. It is unknown whether any of those characters is meant to be Quentin.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Quentin's mother
This unnamed woman is the mother of Quentin. She was looking for her son, only to find out that he was impersonated by the titular villain in "Chameleon".
In the series, her background model is used in the series as background supporting characters. It is unknown whether any of those characters is meant to be Quentin's mother.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Realtor
He is a real estate agent for apartments in Paris.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - School nurse
This unnamed woman (nicknamed Sissy by Marinette) is a nurse who works at the infirmary of the Collège Françoise Dupont to provide care and attention to each student.
She was mentioned in "Horrificator", "Chameleon", "Guiltrip" and "Revelation", but the voice was heard only in "Intuition".
In "The Ruler", she accompanies Gine Jinet after meeting Nathaniel's mother, Shirel Kurtzberg.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Sofia
Sofia is the baby sister of Sam and Maya who was only mentioned in "Grendiaper".

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Solitude
Solitude is a hologram supervillain created by Aeon in "Miraculous New York".
Jessica Keynes came up with the idea of creating a supervillain who kidnaps people who are loved by no one, as part of a plan to get Marinette to confess her love to Adrien.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Startrain conductor
This unnamed man is a conductor who works on the Startrain.
In "Backwarder", Gabriel Agreste severely intimidates him to prevent Startrain from leaving so that he can akumatize Marianne in the bathroom. He is scared by Gabriel and his status as a fashion icon.
In "Hack-San", he is seen on the platform before the train departs for London.

id: List of minor characters/Humans::Mr. Sweet Tooth::0
title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Mr. Sweet Tooth
Mr. Sweet Tooth is a man who likes meringues.
In "A Fairy Good Night", he was seen buying meringues at the Dupain-Cheng bakery; later, he has a nightmare about a giant meringue that compels him to eat it.
In "Queen of the Dreadzone", he was buying meringues again when a giant poster of Chloé appeared in the sky.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - The Beyond
This unnamed man is a member of The Kingdom, an evil organization that is looking for the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses. Within the council, he is known as The Beyond.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - The Mask
This unnamed man is a member of The Kingdom, an evil organization that is looking for the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses. Within the council, he is known as The Mask.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - The Scepter
This unnamed man is the leader of The Kingdom, an evil organization that is looking for the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses. Within the council, he is known as The Scepter.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - The Truth
This unnamed man is a member of The Kingdom, an evil organization that is looking for the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses. Within the council, he is known as The Truth.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Thomas
Thomas is an astronaut of the European Space Agency currently on a mission to the International Space Station.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Ticket inspector
This unnamed man is an employee of Paris's local transportation company.
In "Qilin", when Sabine is left without a ticket and tries to explain the situation, he considers her a migrant and tries to get her into trouble with the law. Later, he manipulates Roger Raincomprix into arresting her. After Sabine is akumatized and subsequently defeated, he admits that he jumped to conclusions and becomes much less irritable.
In "Revolution", he is interviewed for his opinion after Chloé Bourgeois's announcement as the new mayor of Paris.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Toy sculptor
This unnamed man is a sculptor and wooden toy seller who exhibits his craft at the craft stands of the Paris Career Expo.
In "Wishmaker", when the titular villain turns him into his childhood dream, it's revealed that he wanted to become Santa Claus, who started trashing Paris with his gifts.

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Tram driver
This unnamed man is a tram driver who is particularly uncaring towards his passengers.
In "Grendiaper", after intentionally ignoring several passengers who tried to reach his tram, he is paralyzed by Fury and taken to the zoo in front of a glass cage (albeit it was made of unbreakable glass), to be face to face with a panther, scaring him. He was soon found there by Otis Césaire, Ladybug, Cat Noir and Rena Rouge, to whom he explained what happened to him.

id: List of minor characters/Humans::Unnamed candy villain::0
title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Unnamed candy villain
This unnamed villain is an akumatized villain who appears briefly in the episode "Wreckless Driver".

title: List of minor characters/Humans
text:
List of minor characters/Humans - Mrs. Wang
Mrs. Wang is the mother of Socqueline Wang who was only mentioned in "Jubilation". She owns an art shop in the district of Les Olympiades.

title: Lila's first room
text:
Lila's first room - Intro
is Lila Rossi's room in the apartment of her first mother.

title: Lila's first room
text:
Lila's first room - Appearance
The room seems to be messy, with things such as papers and textbooks on the ground. Lila has a zebra-striped bed in the corner with the poster that she used to fool Miss Bustier's class with, stating that she is in Achu.
Each wall of her bedroom is painted a different color, with magenta, purple, sky blue, and possibly black or dark purple. A single tall window is located on the pink wall, along with many masks. Next to that, on the sky blue wall is her poster of Achu. A small drawing of a person lies next to that, with her bed below. A dresser is located at the foot of her bed with many products.
Her bedroom door is painted a light purple with colorful frames outlined in dark brown and pink with a white square inside.
On the floor, there is a rectangular magenta rug with papers and notebooks scattered around it. There are also notebooks, papers, hats, blankets, textbooks, and blankets spread around the room.
On her bed, she has a zebra-striped comforter with 2 pink pillows. A lamp and a stuffed bear are also located on each side of her bed. In the end, there is a pink striped blanket dangling over the end with various items scattered around below.

title: Lila's first room
text:
Lila's first room - Trivia
The room is heavily shadowed and has many masks decorating the wall, alluding to Lila's lying tendencies.
The masks on the wall might allude to the fact that Lila has multiple disguises and identities.
There is an Italian flag on the wall, showing Lila's heritage.
Lila has a sort of dark paradise poster behind her, which she used in "Catalyst" to make her classmates believe that it was in Achu.
There is an soloistic piece written for the piano where Lila's room being the central theme.
It is unknown what became of this room after Cerise abandoned her Lila Rossi identity in "Confrontation".

text:
Lila (webisode)/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Dear diary, ulch, you'll never guess who's back at school. Lila
Lila: (enters classroom) Hi, everyone.
Class: Hi, Lila.
Marinette: (narrates over the scene) Remember her? She showed up out of nowhere and managed to trick everyone into thinking that she was Ladybug's best friend.
Lila: (on Alya's cellphone) Ladybug and me? We're like this (crosses her fingers).
Marinette: (narrates over the scene) She didn't fool me, of course. But I couldn't tell anyone without compromising my secret identity!
Marinette: (narrates over the scene) Still, I couldn't help but confront her as Ladybug.
Ladybug: Miss Show-Off here was trying to impress you and everyone around her.
Marinette: (narrates over the scene) And after such a humiliation, she disappeared.
Marinette: (narrates over the scene) She tried to have us believe that she had gone away on vacation with Prince Ali.
Lila: Prince Ali invited me and my parents.
Marinette: (narrates over the scene) And I can't tell anyone about it.
Marinette: (narrates over the scene) When she got back, she tried to become friends with me. But I told her that I can see right through her.
Marinette: (narrates over the scene) And now, we're at war.

title: Lila (webisode)/Transcript
text:
Lila (webisode)/Transcript - Intro
Lila: You will lose your friends and wind up all alone.
Marinette: (narrates over the scene) And believe me, I'm not going to let her win.
Marinette: (narrates over the scene) Although, on second thought, she might need an ally rather than an enemy. Because if she continues down this path, she will become the perfect prey for Hawk Moth!
Lila: Oh, no, Ladybug knows me so well.
Marinette: (narrates over the scene) Okay, I'll make an effort to try and help her. Maybe I could ask Adrien to give me a hand. I know he doesn't believe her lies either.
Marinette: Lila is–
Adrien: A liar. Yes, I know.
Marinette: (narrates over the scene) I know it won't be easy, but maybe together, the two of us can save her.
Marinette: Wish me luck! Good bye for now, dear diary.

title: Lila's necklace
text:
Lila's necklace - Intro
is a necklace that Lila wears.
In "Volpina", Lila gets the necklace from a jewelry shop after seeing a drawing of the Fox Miraculous in the Grimoire and tries to convince Adrien Agreste that she inherited this from her past generations and that she is one of the Miraculous holders. Later in the same episode, the necklace becomes her akumatized object.
In "Ladybug", Lila put the necklace in Marinette's locker to frame her for supposedly stealing it. After finding it in Marinette's locker, Marinette is expelled from Collège Françoise Dupont in front of all of her peers and her parents, causing her akumatization.

title: Lila's necklace
text:
Lila's necklace - Appearance
Normal
Just like the Fox Miraculous's camouflaged form, it has a golden chain with a white-tipped orange fox tail pendant attached to it.
Akumatized
Just like the Fox Miraculous when worn by Alya, it gains four golden metal lines protruding from the border, dividing the pendant into five sections, and the sections change in color, from top to bottom, from orange to white with a gradient effect.

title: Lila's necklace
text:
Lila's necklace - Trivia
In "Ladybug", Lila placed the necklace in Marinette's locker to frame her for supposedly stealing it. After finding it in the latter's locker, she is expelled from school by Mr. Damoclès in front of her entire Miss Bustier's class and her parents, causing her near akumatization into Princess Justice.
It is unknown if Cerise still has this necklace after abandoning her Lila Rossi identity in "Confrontation".
Since it is not with her in La Plage, it can be assumed that either she doesn't, or she left it at the residence of one of her identities.

title: List of Magical Charms
text:
List of Magical Charms - Trivia
Prior to "Dearest Family", in which Shadow Moth manages to break the Magical Charms, "Sentibubbler" and "Hack-San" are the only episodes where a Magical Charm isn't given out.
"Optigami", "Strikeback", "Illusion", "Migration", "The Dirtifiers" and "The Chained Titans", are the only episodes in which Ladybug gives out a Magical Charm, but the sequence isn't featured.
"Crocoduel" is the first and only episode where two Magical Charms are featured when Ladybug presents the Charms.
"Dearest Family" is the first episode where a different scene is featured when Ladybug presents four Magical Charms.
In "Dearest Family", Roland's and Sabine's original Magical Charms from "Simpleman" and "Qilin" respectively are destroyed by Shadow Moth's Megakuma.
As of "Dearest Family", all of Marinette's relatives living in Paris have received Magical Charms.
"Jubilation" is the only episode where Ladybug has a sad expression when presenting a Magical Charm.
"Sleeping Syren" is the only episode where Dragonbug presents a Magical Charm.
As of "Optigami", the entire Bourgeois family have received Magical Charms.
However, Chloé's Magical Charm gets destroyed in "Penalteam".

title: List of Magical Charms
text:
List of Magical Charms - Trivia
Only six members of the Miraculers (Zoé, Juleka, Nino, Kagami, Kim and Sabrina) have received Magical Charms so far. Kagami and Juleka also receive replacement Magical Charms after their first ones get destroyed in "Protection" and "Confrontation" respectively.
Gabriel's Magical Charm is the first to be destroyed.
"Gabriel Agreste" marked the first time a sentimonster received a Magical Charm, later Kagami would also receive a Magical Charm in "Perfection" and "Protection".
In "Illusion", Gabriel had obtained a second Magical Charm from Ladybug according to the episode's original script, this spell would later reappear in "Conformation" as part of the plan called "Operation: Perfect Alliance".
Sabine, Gabriel, André and Juleka are the only characters who have received two charms with the same design.
However, Gabriel's second Magical Charm was destroyed in "Conformation".
Roland, Kagami, Tomoe and Gina are the only characters who've received two charms with different designs.
Chloé, Bob Roth and Kagami are the only characters who have refused a Magical Charm from Ladybug in "Queen Banana", "Migration" and "Protection", respectively.

text:

Bob is also the only character who couldn't be persuaded (or tricked) to keep his Magical Charm.
Chloé has refused a magical charm for the second time in "Queen of the Dreadzone".
Mr. Damoclès is the first civilian to purify a megakuma with his Magical Charm.
Chloé is the only character whose magical charm is in the possession of another person.

title: Lila's cellphones
text:
Lila's cellphones - Intro
Cerise's cellphones are smartphones owned by Cerise Bianca and used in her villaineous schemes. She often keeps one in her messenger bag.
In "Miraculous London", as part of her plan to get the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses, she places an akuma in one, becoming her akumatized object as Timestalker.

title: Lila's cellphones
text:
Lila's cellphones - Appearance
Normal
Cerise's cellphones is differently colored with white edges. They have three white-grey cameras on the top, one camera on the bottom and another in the back of the cellphone.
Akumatized
When an akuma entered a phone and becomes Timestalker's akumatized object, it takes on a more refined form. It is voluminous in black and probably with buttons for turning on and sound around the edges. The phone has a blue background with gears, and in the middle is a villain emoji, which is an arrow indicating the time.

title: Lila's cellphones
text:
Lila's cellphones - Abilities
Akumatized
When an akuma entered a phone and becomes Timestalker's akumatized object, it became the villain's guide to the time frame. The emoji in the middle was an arrow that showed the specified time. Timestalker could also connect one of the three clocks to it, through which it tracked the return at a given time. If the watch somehow stopped working, then the phone started to turn red and the villain returned to the original place and time.

title: Lila's cellphones
text:
Lila's cellphones - Trivia
Surprisingly, as seen in "Oni-Chan", Lila has everyone's contacts in her class and even other people that Marinette knows such as Kagami.
In "Revelation", as Hoaxer, Lila hypnotized Nathalie into sending her photos with all of Gabriel Agreste's secrets to one of the phones which was stored in the locker room at Collège Françoise Dupont.

title: Lila's mothers

title: Lila's mothers
text:
Lila's mothers - Mrs. Rossi
Mrs. Rossi is a minor character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She is an Italian woman who works at an embassy in Paris and also is the possible adoptive mother of Lila Rossi.

title: Lila's mothers
text:
Lila's mothers - Appearance
Physical appearance
She is a woman with average adult height. Her brown hair is pulled back into a bun. She has light brown eyes.
Civilian attire
She wears a dark blue, long-sleeved jacket with a white top underneath it. She also wears a dark blue skirt and red high heels.

title: Lila's mothers
text:
Lila's mothers - Personality
She is shown to be a kind and loving mother. However, she is also gullible as she believes Lila's lies about Adrien being her boyfriend and the school closing down from all the akumatizations. She spends a lot of time working at the embassy, which leads to her spending very little time with her daughter.

title: Lila's mothers
text:
Lila's mothers - Relationships
Family
Lila Rossi
She loves her daughter, but she is unaware of her deceitful nature as she believes her lies. She doesn't seem to be aware of Lila's other mothers or identities.

title: Lila's mothers
text:
Lila's mothers - History
In "Catalyst", when Lila finishes talking to the class, she enters Lila's room. She asks if the school is still closed because of the akuma attacks, and Lila confirms the lie. Suddenly, she gets a call from the principal. Lila, not wanting her mother to answer the cellphone, makes up that he was also a victim of akuma, who was not saved by Ladybug. She promises to talk about the attacks at the embassy. She says goodbye to her daughter and promises to return quickly.
In "Oni-Chan", she leaves a voicemail for Lila about how she will stay late at work and where to find her dinner.
In "Illusion", she attends the parent-teacher conference for Miss Bustier's class, the theme of which is to choose the direction that students want to follow after studying at the Collège Françoise Dupont. She, like her daughter, sits on the last bench.

title: Lila's mothers
text:
Lila's mothers - Trivia
In "The Dark Owl", she and Clara Contard used the same background model. According to Thomas Astruc, they are not the same character, and it was an animation mistake that both characters use the same model.  However, in all of Clara's future appearances, the correct model is used.
Also in the series, her background model is used in the series as background supporting characters. It is unknown whether any of those characters is meant to be Mrs. Rossi.
As seen in "Catalyst", her phone number is +33645859.
It is unknown if she still has contact with her daughter after she discarded her "Lila Rossi" identity at the end of "Confrontation".

title: Lila's mothers
text:
Lila's mothers - Mrs. Bianca
Mrs. Bianca is a minor character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She is the possible adoptive mother of Cerise Bianca.

title: Lila's mothers
text:
Lila's mothers - Appearance
Physical appearance
She is a woman with average adult height. She has long, curly brown hair, and light blue eyes.
Civilian attire
She wears a white sleeveless halter-top, melon-colored pants, and light sandals. She wears a lot of jewelry, including large hooped earrings and multiple bracelets.

title: Lila's mothers
text:
Lila's mothers - Personality
She is shown to be a kind and loving mother. However, she is also gullible, as she believes Cerise's lies.

title: Lila's mothers
text:
Lila's mothers - Relationships
Family
Cerise Bianca
She loves her daughter, but she is unaware of her deceitful nature as she believes her lies. She isn't aware of Cerise's other mothers or identities. Also, she trusts her daughter when she can't turn on the camera, allegedly because she's on a mission in the savanna.

title: Lila's mothers
text:
Lila's mothers - History
In "Risk", she leaves Cerise at the Gare du Nord, saying goodbye to her when she is about to leave on a train with Adrien.
In "Revelation", she speaks with Cerise over the phone about the latter's supposed stay in Africa. Lila hangs up when her third mother comes into the room.

title: Lila's mothers
text:
Lila's mothers - Trivia
She is seen with Cerise when she is using her Lila identity in "Risk". However, it's established that Cerise has a much shorter hairstyle and a different eye color.
This also implies that Mrs. Bianca is aware of Cerise's role as Gabriel brand's female face. However, that would mean that she would be aware of the Lila Rossi identity.
It's possible that Cerise has told her that she decided to wear a wig and contact lenses and use a fake name (like many celebrities do) in order to hide her real appearance and be able to pass unnoticed by the fans.
In the series, her background model is used in the series as background supporting characters. It is unknown whether any of those characters is meant to be Mrs. Bianca.

title: Lila's mothers
text:
Lila's mothers - Lila's third mother
Lila's third mother is a minor character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She is a woman who lives in Paris, and also the possible adoptive mother of Lila Rossi.

title: Lila's mothers
text:
Lila's mothers - Appearance
Physical appearance
She is a woman with average adult height. She has shoulder-length wavy black hair and blue eyes.
Civilian attire
She wears a dark jacket over a light blue top. She also wears a dark blue jeans.

title: Lila's mothers
text:
Lila's mothers - Personality
She is shown to be a kind and loving mother. However, she is also gullible, as she believes Lila's lies, such as shooting a movie in Mexico.

title: Lila's mothers
text:
Lila's mothers - Relationships
Family
Lila Rossi
She loves her daughter, but she is unaware of her deceitful nature as she believes her lies. She isn't aware of Lila's other mothers or identities.

title: Lila's mothers
text:
Lila's mothers - History
In "Revelation", she enters her daughter's room, finding her talking through her Alliance ring. Lila hangs up and lies to her mother that she talked to her agent and will miss her during the filming of the movie in Mexico. The woman does not want Lila to leave her again, but Lila promises that soon they will see each other again.

title: Lila's mothers
text:
Lila's mothers - Trivia
She's the second character who has a physical disability, after Tomoe Tsurugi.
She's also the first deaf and mute character to appear in the series.
Although it hasn't been confirmed, Placide I.T. has never spoken, which could imply that he is also mute, making her the second mute character.
It's currently unknown which name Lila/Cerise uses when she interacts with this mother.

title: Lila's second room
text:
Lila's second room - Intro
is Lila Rossi's new room in the apartment of her third mother who was appeared in season 5.

title: Lila's second room
text:
Lila's second room - Appearance
The room was not shown completely, but only its sleeping part. The room has white glossy floors. The exact color of the walls is unknown; it is only known that one of the walls is white and the other is orange. In Lila's new room there are longitudinal windows (probably the entire length of the wall) with gray frames that end a dozen/several dozen centimeters above the floor and under the ceiling.
Next to one of the walls there is a large bed with white linens. On the left is a small cream-colored bedside table with metal legs. The girl puts her books on the table. A lamp with a curved white shank can also be seen standing by the bed. A lampshade of the same color as the stem hangs directly over the pillow. On the same side is a blue pouf.
A cream-colored desk was placed to the right of the bed. There is a black monitor on the countertop. Also a black armchair without armrests. Above the table and a little further along the same line along the bed hang two ceiling lamps with an openwork shade.

title: Lila's second room
text:
Lila's second room - Trivia
Lila's new room is the second room after Zoé's room, which appears in the season 5.
This new room seems to be in a building with more comfort than her first room.

Public Enemy
Public Enemy is a person who lives in New York City. His associates are: Killabee, Metal Face D, Ghetto Blaster, Shaolin Soul, and Breaker.
In "Silurus", he is seen helping endangered citizens of a destructed New York caused by Trash Krakken. He also stumbles across Marinette and helps her out with her situation by providing her with food and clothes.
Public Enemy can come off as intimidating and threatening, but he is actually good-natured, serious, and caring. He genuinely wants to help others, and he apologizes whenever he over-reacts to a situation. When anyone needs help or information, like Marinette, he willingly and kindly offers it to them, and he occasionally teases others, saying Marinette is "so French" in amusement when she departs to transform.

title: List of minor locations
text:
List of minor locations - Intro
This is a list of all minor locations that have appeared, but hold no significant or recurring role in Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir.

title: List of minor locations
text:
List of minor locations - Monuments
Cheminée du Front de Seine
The Cheminée du Front de Seine, or Cheminée de Grenelle, is a chimney built in 1971 in the Front de Seine district, in the 15th arrondissement of Paris.
It appeared only on some of the intertitles of the first season episodes. However, it also appeared in the background in "Penalteam".
Front de Seine
The Front de Seine is an urban area located along the Seine River in the 15th arrondissement of Paris. Situated downstream from the Eiffel Tower, it boasts one of the largest concentrations of skyscrapers in the capital.
It appeared only on some of the intertitles of the first season episodes. However, it also appeared in the background in "Penalteam".
Dois Irmãos Hill
The Dois Irmãos Hill (Two Brothers Hill) is a 533 meter high mountain composed of twin peaks, located west of the Leblon Beach. It appeared in the background in "Re-creation".
Pedra do Arpoador
The Pedra do Arpoador is a rocky peninsula located in Rio de Janeiro between Copacabana and Ipanema beaches. It appeared in the background in "Mister Agreste".

title: List of minor locations
text:
List of minor locations - Businesses
Cocoashock factory
The Cocoashock factory is a food production factory specializing in chocolate located in Paris.
In "Qilin", there was a fire, but Ladybug and Cat Noir prevented the explosion of the turbine.
Dimsum Delight
Dimsum Delight is an Asian restaurant in Paris.
In "Qilin", Sabine and Marinette go for lunch there.
Eiffel Tower restaurant
The Eiffel Tower restaurant is a restaurant on the first floor of the Eiffel Tower where Sophie works.
In "Chameleon", the final part of Ladybug and Cat Noir's fight against the titular villain takes place there.
Flower shop
The flower shop is a shop dedicated to the sale of flowers and floral or vegetable bouquets, managed by the florist.
In "Qilin", Marinette went to the flower shop to buy some flowers for her mother.
In "Adoration", Vanisher steals some of the flowers as part of Chloé's plan to frame Marinette.
Friterie Grassette
Friterie Grassette is a family-run fry shop belonging to the Grassette family located on the Grand'Place in Lille.
It appeared in "Revelation" in a photograph that was part of Gabriel's "secrets". It's also revealed that it inspired the french fry costume of Gabriel's friend Harry Clown.

title: List of minor locations
text:
List of minor locations - Businesses
In "Werepapas", after resolving the conflict between the two families, the Grassettes invited Emil and Milly Graham de Vanily to their shop, alongside Adrien, Marinette, Nathalie and Placide.
Gabriel stores
The Gabriel stores are stores which sell clothes, accessories and perfumes from Gabriel, located in different cities, for example, as in Paris and Shanghai.
In "Multiplication", "Jubilation" and "Illusion", one appears in the commercial for the Alliance rings.
Jewelry store
The jewelry store is a store which sells jewelry, including designs from Gabriel, located on Place de l'Hôtel de Ville.
In "Volpina", Lila Rossi buys a necklace which looks like the Fox Miraculous, and it later becomes her akumatized object.
In "The Dark Owl", trying to stop the eponymous villain, Cat Noir crashed into a store sign.
Le Café du Coin
Le Café du Coin is a bar-restaurant in Paris, located next to Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie and Place des Vosges.
In the series, the café appeared exclusively in the background, but it makes a brief appearence in the movie.
Mouleux Auto Repair shop

title: List of minor locations
text:
List of minor locations - Businesses
The Mouleux Auto Repair shop (also known as Garage) is a shop that repairs various vehicles, run by an unnamed mechanic.
In "Daddycop", Miss Hound used her superpower to take Marinette's scooter to the repair shop to get it repaired.
Paris prison
The Paris prison is a penitentiary facility in Paris. It was the place of detention of Raúl.
In "El Toro De Piedra", Ivan went to the prison to visit his father believing he had changed, only to find out that he wanted his help in carrying out a robbery at the Louvre.
Pharmacy
The pharmacy is a shop which provides pharmaceutical drugs and other products, managed by the pharmacist.
In "Backwarder", Ladybug visits it to buy the medicine Master Fu needs, but having mixed up the pieces of paper, she gives the pharmacist Fu's love letter for Marianne.

title: List of minor locations
text:
List of minor locations - Educational institutions
Collège Françoise Dupont
Japanese classroom
The Japanese classroom is the classroom where the Japanese teacher holds his Japanese courses at the Collège Françoise Dupont.
In "Climatiqueen", Marinette tried to take a Japanese lesson with Adrien, but she struggled to pronounce the sentence in Japanese.
Collège Paul Bert
Collège Paul Bert is a secondary school that is part of the Cité Scolaire Paul Bert, in the 14th arrondissement of Paris. This is the school of Cerise.
It was only appeared in "Confrontation", when Cerise returned there after being exposed for her lies at the Collège Françoise Dupont.
Lycée Claude Monet
Lycée Claude Monet is a public high school that Socqueline Wang attends.
In "Jubilation", it appeared in a photograph when Gabriel's Alliance ring detailed the profile of Socqueline.
Lycée Jacques de Trémeuse
Lycée Jacques de Trémeuse is a general and technological high school in Paris.
In "Confrontation", it was revealed that Nino had expressed the desire to enroll in this high school after finishing his studies at the Collège Françoise Dupont. He also expressed the desire for his friends to join him there so as not to disband their resistance group against Monarch.

title: List of minor locations
text:
List of minor locations - Residences
Bertrand's appartment
This unknown residence is a pink plot with a house and a swimming pool, which possibly belongs to Bertrand King. It only appeared in a commerical for the Morpho fans in "Action".
Beauréal apartment
The Beauréal apartment is the residence of Aurore and her parents.
In "Climatiqueen", Aurore shot videos for Chloé's Bee Community contest on Zoo in her apartment kitchen.
Chamack appartment
The Chamack appartment is the residence of Nadja Chamack and her daughter Manon.
In "The Puppeteer 2", after a tour of the Musée Grévin, Adrien's bodyguard and friends return Manon to her mother.
Gabriel and Émilie's room
Gabriel and Émilie's room is the bedroom of Gabriel Agreste and Émilie Agreste, located in the Agreste mansion.
It first appeared in "Conformation", when Ladybug opened the doors of the room to get inside in order to escape the Miraculized, only to immediately close them again when she saw that they had already entered.
As of season 6, much like Gabriel's atelier, the room has been abandoned, with the lights off and the furniture and bed covered in white sheets.
Gabriel's New York apartment

title: List of minor locations
text:
List of minor locations - Residences
Gabriel's apartment is an apartment in New York City, located in the borough of Manhattan, near Central Park.
In "Miraculous New York", Gabriel, as Hawk Moth, uses it as his lair. There, he akumatizes Mike Rochip into Technolizer and endowed him with the power of Eagle Miraculous.
Kubdel apartment
The Kubdel appartment is the residence of Alim Kubdel and his children Jalil and Alix, located in the Louvre.
In "Reverser", Nathaniel went to Alix's house to tell her what had happened to him with Marinette and Marc at the Place des Vosges.
Lê Ature residence
The Lê Ature residence is the residence of Vadim Ature and Lê Cường Minh, and their son Kim.
In "Santa Claws", Kim is at home on Christmas eve when Adrien goes missing and they start looking for him.
London Hotel
The London Hotel is a hotel located in London, United Kingdom.
In "Revolution", Gabriel and Tomoe sent Adrien and Kagami to this hotel in London, so they would be safe during the Operation: Perfect Alliance.

title: List of minor locations
text:
List of minor locations - Residences
However, after they both escaped from the hotel in "Representation" (Kagami thanks to Argos and Adrien thanks to his space power-up), Gabriel and Tomoe decided to move their children to the cells of the Tsurugi Labs in London, so as to always keep an eye on them.
Rose's room
Rose's room is Rose Lavillant's bedroom, located in an unknown apartment in Paris.
It only appeared in "Climatiqueen", when Rose posted a video on Zoo.
Sabrina's room
Sabrina's room is Sabrina Raincomprix's bedroom, located in her father's apartment in Paris.
In "Daddycop", it appeared when Sabrina was seeing Chloé's Zoo posts on her cellphone and later threw away all the items that reminded her of her.
In "Queen of the Dreadzone", it's seen in a flashback when Sabrina receives a letter from who she thinks is Chloé.
Tom and Sabine's room
Tom and Sabine's room is the bedroom of Tom Dupain and Sabine Cheng, located in the Dupain-Cheng residence.
In "Conformation", while sleeping, Tom and Sabine were hit by Nightormentor's nightmare dust, which he spread to begin Operation: Perfect Alliance.
Vincent Asa's room
Vincent Asa's room is the room of Vincent Asa, where he enshrines his idol, Jagged Stone.

title: List of minor locations
text:
List of minor locations - Residences
In "Pixelator", the titular villain traps the people he takes a photo of and puts them in frames on the walls of his room. Ladybug finds the photographer's address and comes to him, where he notices Mireille and Théo, as well as Chloé and Adrien.
As seen in "Revelator", the room now features a dual screen computer through which he edits his videos, with sticker notes on the wall behind it. The place is messy and unkempt, seen by the full trash bin and the sink stacked with many unwashed dishes.
Wayhem's room
Wayhem's room is Wayhem's bedroom, located in an unknown apartment in Paris.
It only appeared in "Party Crasher", when Wayhem was talking to Adrien via a video call.

title: List of minor locations
text:
List of minor locations - Workplaces
Bertrand's office
Bertrand's office is the office of Bertrand King where he runs his company from, located inside the Tour Montparnasse.
In "Action", The Resistance visit it to try to convince Bertrand to stop producing single-use plastics, without any success. Later, he is akumatized into the supervillain King of Plastic.
Bob's office
Bob's office is the office located inside the Tour Montparnasse where Bob Roth works and keeps the various awards won by the artists of his record company.
In "Queen Banana", the students of Miss Bustier's class go there to have a meeting with Bob Roth about their film.
Police station
The police station is a building that houses the Parisian police brigade, located opposite the Hôtel de Ville.
Despite the fact that the Place de l'Hôtel de Ville has appeared several times since season 1, it never appeared until the season 4 in "Qilin".
In "Qilin", a ticket inspector takes Sabine there after she rides on a bus without a ticket.
Théo's studio
Théo's studio is an art studio owned by Théo Barbot. The workshop sign reads "L'Atelier", which translates into "The Workshop".

title: List of minor locations
text:
List of minor locations - Workplaces
Théo has a maneki-neko inside his workshop that bears a resemblance to Néko, the main antagonist of Kobushi, which is another ZAG-produced show.
In "Copycat", the eponymous villain trapped Cat Noir and later fought him and Ladybug, subsequently losing to the heroes.
In "Hack-San", Robostus used it as a refuge while waiting for Parisians under his control to hand him the Ladybug and Cat Miraculous.

title: List of minor locations
text:
List of minor locations - Actionverse
American hospital
This hospital is a multi-specialty hospital located in New York City that provides care for children, pregnant women, the elderly, and other patients. Kenya is one of the patients being treated there.
In Miraculous Adventures, after significant damage caused by the Trash Krakken, a local group of Americans began evacuating hospital visitors due to a shortage of necessary transportation. After defeating the villain, Ladybug used her superpower to fix the damage, including the hospital and its surroundings, thus returning Kenya and the other patients.
