Gare de Lyon
The Gare de Lyon are landscape gardens located in the 6th arrondissement of Paris.
In "Miraculous: Paris Under Siege", is in the Gare de Lyon where the final battle between Ladybug and Cat Noir against Lady Wifi took place.
Jardin du Luxembourg
The Jardin du Luxembourg are landscape gardens located in the 6th arrondissement of Paris.
In "Miraculous: Paris Under Siege", is in the Jardin du Luxembourg where the final battle between Ladybug and Cat Noir against Sole Crusher took place.
Père Lachaise Cemetery
The Père Lachaise Cemetery it is a Parisian cemetery located in the 20th arrondissement.
In "Miraculous: Paris Under Siege", is in the Père-Lachaise Cemetery where the final battle between Ladybug and Cat Noir against Truth took place.
Square Jean Moulin
The Square Jean Moulin is a square in the city of Paris. In "Miraculous: Paris Under Siege", Wang Fu lives in an apartment there.

title: List of food
text:
List of food - Intro
This is a list of food that have appeared in Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir.

title: List of food
text:
List of food - Bakery Products
Chouquettes
Chouquettes are a type of food made by the Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie. It's implied that they're Adrien's favorite pastry.
As seen in "Qilin" and "Revelation", Sabine always serves them to the students in her class.
In "Revolution", it's revealed that Chloé Bourgeois likes chouquettes.
Cookies
Cookies are a type of food made by the Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie and it's one of Tikki's favorite foods, along with macarons.
In "Gamer", for their daughter's special guest, Adrien, Tom and Sabine baked cookies, but Marinette asked her not to interfere.
In "Miraculous RP: Ladybug & Cat Noir", only on Bastille Day, Tom and Sabine sell food to the player. One of the foods is a scallop-shaped cookie.
In "Revelator", while training to unlock his Turtle Miraculous adult powers, Nino gave Wayzz a cookie.
Croissants
Croissants are a type of food made by the Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie. Сroissants also appears on bakery showcase window.
After Marinette Dupain-Cheng became Guardian of the Miraculouses, following the smell of Croissants became the Kwamis method of finding their way home.

title: List of food
text:
List of food - Bakery Products
As shown in the "Miraculous Ladybug & Cat Noir", they're Pollen's favorite food.
Dorayaki
Dorayaki are Japanese sweets made by Nozomi Tsurugi that she sells at her dorayaki shop.
According to Kagami, the dorayaki sold by her grandmother are the best in Tokyo.
Eiffel Tower cake
Eiffel Tower cake is a special cake made on request by the Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie.
In "Timebreaker", Nadja had requested one for a special occasion, but had to wait outside the bakery since Marinette wasn't there.
Galettes
Galettes are a type of food made by the Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie only for the Three Kings Day.
In "Dearest Family", the galettes cooked by Tom and Roland had driven Tikki crazy with hunger, and she started eating all the galettes she found in her path, which led her to create a giant galette that almost destroyed the entire world.
Macarons
Macarons are a sweet meringue-based confection made by the Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie. The treat is often seen inside the display cases of bakery.
Starting from the end of "Despair Bear", Marinette's pink macarons with white dots would become Tikki's go-to power up treat.

title: List of food
text:
List of food - Bakery Products
Starting from the end of "Syren", Master Fu gives Marinette power-up vials who bakes them into macarons.
In "Reflekdoll", after Lady Noire detransforms into Marinette, she gives Plagg a macaron before he leaves with the Cat Miraculous.
In "Climatiqueen", during Marlena's cooking class in the cafeteria kitchen of the Collège Françoise Dupont, Adrien attempted to make macarons, though with no small amount of disaster.
Parisian Croûte
The Parisian Croutê is a special bread created by Roland and Marinette in "Riginarazione". The bread's recipe was made up by Roland on the spot while Marinette made it, and was initially a ruse by Roland so he could spend some time with Marinette while avoiding telling her the truth about his declining health.
After Roland's off-screen passing, the croutê started being sold at Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie, as a tribute to Roland.

title: List of food
text:
List of food - Other
Açaí bowl
Açaí bowl is a Brazilian dish made with the frozen and mashed fruit of the açaí palm, often served with fruits.
In "Mister Agreste", Irupé suggested getting one for breakfast with Luka after her swim in the ocean, but, upon his refusal, she only got her own.
Ballotines
Ballotines are a French dish that Johnny often cooks.
In "Werepapas", Johnny and Gabrielle brought a basket of ballotines for lunch at Agreste mansion with Adrien's maternal grandparents, although Johnny let them burn. However, even though they looked like charcoal, the inside was still edible.
Milly has similar tastes in food to Plagg, as they were the only two seen enjoying the ballotines that Johnny and Gabrielle brought to the mansion.
Camembert
Camembert is a stinky, ancient type of cheese which is Plagg's favorite food. As seen in "Mr. Pigeon", it is yellow on the inside.
Despite Plagg's constant love for Camembert, he often claims of getting tired of eating only cheese. Also, Plagg often claims his Camembert is stinky, and indeed the show sometimes portrays it with wisps of what is obviously stink.
In "Stormy Weather", Plagg states that he can smell Camembert in his sleep.

title: List of food
text:
List of food - Other
Starting from the end of "Syren", Master Fu gives Adrien Camembert shaped power-ups.
In "Reflekdoll", after Mister Bug detransforms back into Adrien, he gives Tikki a slice of Camembert before she leaves with the Ladybug Miraculous.
Since Plagg adores cheese, especially camembert, Adrien had to convince Nathalie that he is obsessed with camembert.
Candy apples
Candy apples are a treat made by Tom Dupain at the bakery for Valentine's Day.
In "Dark Cupid", the titular supervillain is inspired to attack Marinette and Alya when he sees the latter holding two candy apples. Later, Ladybug's Lucky Charm creates a candy apple, which she uses to defeat Dark Cupid by making his hand too sticky to fire arrows.
Chicken yassa
Chicken yassa is one of the national dishes of Senegal. Another name for chicken yassa is yassa ganaar. The term "yassa" refers to the cooking method (marinating and stewing), while "guinar" means chicken in Wolof, the national language of Senegal.
In "A Fairy Good Night", it was revealed that it is Max's favorite dish, cooked by his mother.
French fries

title: List of food
text:
List of food - Other
French fries are a dish served at Friterie Grassette in Lille, consisting of stick cut fried potatoes in a cone folded paper.
In "Werepapas", Adrien, Marinette, Nathalie, Placide I.T., Emil and Milly Graham de Vanily had French fries when they visited the fry shop.
Ice Cream
Ice Cream is a type of sweet frozen treat that comes in a variety of flavors.
André sells ice cream at his cart. It is said that André's ice cream has the magical power help people find true love, and that couples who share André's ice cream will be in love forever.
It's revealed in "Glaciator" that Tom proposed to Sabine by hiding the ring in a scoop of vanilla ice cream. Later in this episode, the ice cream was akumatized along with André and became the giant snowman that Glaciator was inside of.
In "Heart Hunter", it is stated that there is a legend that says whoever shares André's ice cream together will be in love forever.
Lollipops
Lollipops are a type of food in the Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie.
With the Peacock Miraculous, Mayura and Shadow Moth were able to create a sentimonster made entirely of lollipops.
Marinette Soup

title: List of food
text:
List of food - Other
Marinette Soup is a soup created by Wang Cheng. After winning the World's Greatest Chef contest, the soup becomes a part of the menu of Le Grand Paris. The dish was originally called "Celestial Soup", but after the events of "Kung Food", Wang renames the soup in Marinette's honor.
While Wang is akumatized into Kung Food, anyone who had previously eaten the soup, namely André Bourgeois, Jagged Stone, Marlena Césaire, and Alec Cataldi, are brainwashed into becoming his servants.
Pancakes
Pancakes are a dessert baked by Gabriel Agreste in season 5 for Adrien when he was trying to be a better father. Starting from season 6, Adrien makes them for himself and Nathalie when they have breakfast.
According to Marinette, the pancakes that Gabriel made weren't good because they had no flavor.
According to Nathalie, the pancakes that Adrien makes are much better than Gabriel's because they are sweet and delicious.

title: Louvre
text:
Louvre - Intro
The  , also called Louvre Museum, is a Parisian museum of art and antiquities located in the Louvre Palace in the 1st arrondissement of Paris. Inaugurated on August 10, 1793, it is the largest museum in the world, but also the most visited. Among its most famous works are the Mona Lisa, the Venus de Milo, the Red Scribe, the Nike of Samothrace and the Code of Hammurabi.
Alim Kubdel works there as director of the Department of Egyptian Antiquities.

title: Louvre
text:
Louvre - Description
Entrance
The entrance to the Louvre Museum is through the Louvre Pyramid located in the center of the Hall Napoléon.
Hall Napoléon
The Hall Napoléon is a huge two-story hall located directly beneath the Louvre Pyramid. The revolving entrance door leads directly to a spiral staircase wrapped around a column and an escalator that leads to the lower level of the hall. Empty cabinets and bas-reliefs can be seen near the wall, and in the distance the entrance to the rest of the museum. The main decoration is the numerous posters promoting the current exhibitions in the museum.
Department of Egyptian Antiquities
Directed by Alim Kubdel, this department presents collections representative of the civilization that evolved on the banks of the Nile from the end of prehistory (4,000 years before our era) to the Christian period (4th century). It has 66,300 works distributed over three floors of the Sully wing, in about thirty rooms, nineteen of which form a thematic tour of Pharaonic Egypt.

title: Louvre
text:
Louvre - Description
One of the works appears to be an papyrus that illustrates and tells the legend of the existence of a sacrificial ritual prepared by Akhenaten to resurrect Nefertiti, but also of the intervention of a Ladybug to prevent this ritual from taking place.
Department of Paintings
This department has 7,500 works of art in the Louvre, 3,400 of which are on public display. These paintings cover a period from the Middle Ages to 1848. They represent the different major schools of painting in Europe during these periods, especially the French, Northern (Flanders, Netherlands and Germany) and Italian schools.
The works are displayed in large thematic rooms, including the famous Red Rooms. As the name suggests, these huge, rectangular rooms have red walls with gold decorations to make the paintings, often in brown tones, stand out. Illuminated by the glass ceiling, there are works by great French masters, as well as grandiose large-format paintings.

title: Louvre
text:
Louvre - Description
In one of these rooms are exhibited: The Mona Lisa by Leonardo da Vinci protected by glass and whose perimeter wall is white, Liberty Leading the People by Eugène Delacroix, Charging Officer of the Light Cavalry of the Imperial Guard and The Raft of the Medusa by Théodore Géricault, The Coronation of Napoleon and the Portrait of Madame Récamier by Jacques-Louis David, etc.
Other rooms
The Louvre Museum has other rooms without a particular theme.
However, one of them seems to house many works, actually hiding the stories of ancient bearers of the Miraculous, including a statue of Jeanne d'Arc, but also the Lady with a Rabbit by Ridolfo Ghirlandaio, which seems to be the portrait of a previous holder of the Rabbit Miraculous.

title: Louvre
text:
Louvre - Trivia
The Louvre Museum has been classified as a historical monument since 1890.
The Musée National Eugène-Delacroix, located in the 6th arrondissement of Paris, depends on the Louvre Museum.
The Louvre Museum is Nathaniel's favorite place. He spends a lot of time there with Alix.
The Egyptian papyrus with hieroglyphics that tell how the Ladybug of ancient Egypt prevented a pharaoh from sacrificing an innocent woman is featured in the museum's Egyptian exhibit.
In the series, The Mona Lisa is displayed in a Red Room, but in reality it is displayed in the Salle des Etats.
In the series, the Louvre Museum displays "Lady with a Rabbit" by Ridolfo Ghirlandaio, while this painting is displayed at the art gallery of Yale University, in the United States.
This painting hides a sign of the Order of the Guardians, thus opening the power of the Reunion.
As seen in the episodes "The Pharaoh", "Feast" and "Reunion", the Louvre Museum houses artifacts of historical figures who were also previous Miraculous holders.
In the series, the Louvre Museum has assumed some importance on several occasions:

title: Louvre
text:
Louvre - Trivia
In "Copycat", the eponymous villain entered the museum to steal the Mona Lisa in order to undermine the reputation of Cat Noir. The police tried to lock the hero away, but ended up having to fight them in the Hall Napoléon.
In "The Pharaoh", while Marinette and Alya went there to see the Egyptian exhibit, Jalil was akumatized and fought Ladybug and Cat Noir inside and outside the museum.
In "The Puppeteer", Nathaniel was transformed into the Evillustrator thanks to the powers of the eponymous villain.
In "Riposte", Ladybug hid Adrien in a sarcophagus in the Egyptian section, before fighting the eponymous villain with Cat Noir throughout the museum.
In "Robostus", the eponymous villain took control of all the electronic devices in the Louvre.
In "Reverser", Nathaniel and Alix were approached by the heroes of Paris in the museum to help them defeat the eponymous villain.
In "Feast", the Louvre unveiled a new exhibit featuring an ancient statue discovered in Tibet, which was actually a dormant sentimonster. Later, Mayura entered the museum at night to wake up the sentimonster and allow Hawk Moth to akumatize it.

title: Louvre
text:
Louvre - Trivia
In "Timetagger", Ladybug and Cat Noir took refuge in the museum to recharge. Later, with Alix's help, they discovered an adult version of Alix, who possessed the Rabbit Miraculous, imprisoned for several millennia inside an obelisk. Additionally, due to Timetagger sending several parisians into the past, some of the museum's ancient artifacts and paintings have changed to resemble different citizens, such as: Jagged Stone, Nadja Chamack, Caline Bustier, Denis Damoclès, André Bourgeois, and André the ice cream man.
In "Evolution", Alim Kubdel took Alix to a room with paintings to discuss the future, but more importantly, to fulfill her destiny of becoming a superhero, tasked with leaving her family to stop Monarch from keeping the Rabbit Miraculous.
In "Reunion", most of the episode took place in the museum, including Jalil's fourth akumatization into the Pharaoh. Due to the Pharaoh's new powers, the museum was covered by a giant pyramid.

title: Literature classroom
text:
Literature classroom - Intro
The  is a classroom in Collège Françoise Dupont. Caline Bustier taught her students here, although other teachers will sometimes teach here as well.

title: Literature classroom
text:
Literature classroom - Appearance
The classroom has pale brick walls, brown wooden baseboards, and a pale brown wooden floor. Large windows are on two parallel walls, one showing the courtyard within the school and the other showing the landscape outside the school. There are three doors to the room: one goes into the school hallway, one is led up to by wooden stairs to the right of the chalkboard at the front wall, and a third is on the left of the back wall. The front wall of the classroom has a large chalkboard, and the other walls have maps attached to them.
The front of the classroom includes a chalkboard and desk with a chair and a computer for the teacher. The floor goes up in levels across from the front of the classroom. Four wooden desks with attached benches, with enough room for two students each, are on each side of the leveled floor, with walkways running between them and on their sides, and brown flooring placed underneath them. There is a light red carpet under the desks. The back of the room is largely covered by wooden bookshelves well-stocked with a variety of different books.

title: Literature classroom
text:
Literature classroom - Trivia
It has been the site of multiple akumatized villain attacks.
In "Rogercop", the titular villain enters the classroom while looking for André Bourgeois.
In "Horrificator", the titular villain hides under Miss Bustier's desk, captures Nathaniel, and fights Ladybug and Cat Noir.
In "Stoneheart", Stoneheart breaks down the classroom door, grabs Mylène and Chloé, and leaves through the wall, leaving an enormous hole.
In "Antibug", Vanisher pesters Chloé during class.
In "Zombizou", the titular villain bursts into the classroom and attempts to infect Chloé with a kiss, only for Chloé to use Sabrina as a human shield and have the kiss infect her instead. Later, Ladybug fights three of Zombizou's zombies in the classroom.
In "Chameleon", Marinette was almost akumatized in the classroom after being told to move to the back so Lila could sit with Adrien.
In "Confrontation", Juleka was akumatized in the classroom after finding out that she will have to repeat a year thanks to Lila and Chloé's plan to revolt her friends against her.
In "Antibug" and "Revolution", Ms. Mendeleiev uses it, instead of hers.

title: Longg
text:
Longg - Intro
is a supporting character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She is the kwami of Perfection who is connected to the Dragon Miraculous. With her power, Longg's wearer can use the choker necklace to transform into a dragon-themed superhero.
Longg and her Miraculous are currently owned by Kagami Tsurugi, who uses it to transform into the superheroine Ryuko.

title: Longg
text:
Longg - Appearance
Longg is 10 centimeters (or 4 inches) tall and red with four black horns on her forehead: a black horn on each side of her face, and red horns from the upper back of her head with black spirals. Additionally, Longg has golden eyes, small nostrils, a whisker on each cheek next to her mouth, two small black spikes on her lower back, and a long tail with three black tips at the end.

title: Longg
text:
Longg - Personality
Longg is a bit formal, calling Kagami "young lady", has an eloquent approach and is quite informative and patient explaining her powers. She has a tendency to ramble on a bit, not seeing that her wielder is trapped inside an akumatized villain but knows not to rush as she tried to tell Kagami about Ladybug's plans.

title: Longg
text:
Longg - Abilities
Longg can fly, levitate, and phase through solid objects. She can also carry objects that are larger and/or heavier than her.
As a Kwami, Longg is able to transform the holder of the Dragon Miraculous into a dragon-themed superhero.
Longg gives the wearer of the Dragon Miraculous the power to use the elements of water, wind, and lightning. The wearer can transform into one of these elements by saying either water, wind or lightning dragon. After all three elements have been used, Longg loses energy, giving the wearer five minutes until they transform back. Longg can fuse her powers with Tikki's to create the hybrid wielder, Dragon Bug.

title: Longg
text:
Longg - Relationships
Friends/Allies
Kagami Tsurugi/Ryuko
As Longg and Kagami meet, she tells her the abilities she will grant her as Ryuko, but she is cut short as Kagami activates her before Longg can fully inform Kagami of Ladybug's plan. In "Heart Hunter", she is happy to see Kagami again.
In "Strikeback", Kagami is saddened to discover that Longg is now Monarch's prisoner.
In "Perfection", the two were briefly reunited when Kagami got akumatized as Ryukomori, even though she doesn't remember, they couldn't communicate, but it's likely she's proud of her for rejecting the Megakuma.
In "Protection", Longg sees Monarch akumatize Kagami again, and probably worried about her.
In "Re-creation", she is reunited with her holder, Kagami, to which they both are excited.

title: Longg
text:
Longg - Relationships
In "Yaksi Gozen", after getting back together with Kagami, Longg learned that she was now dating Félix and accepted him upon realizing that she truly loved him. Realizing that her mother knows about her identity as Ryuko, Longg defends Kagami's relationship with Félix. She also learned that she and Félix were Sentimonsters and that their existence and freedom were tied to their rings. After Tomoe attempted to forcibly take Kagami's ring, Longg helped Kagami transform into Ryuko and use her power to stop her, later agreeing with Kagami and Félix's plan to hide their rings in Ladybug's yo-yo.
In "The Dirtifiers",
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/Ladybug/Dragon Bug
Longg knew Ladybug's plan to defeat Ikari Gozen, as she had tried to tell it to Kagami before she activated the Miraculous, indicating that Ladybug might have gone over it with Longg before sending the Dragon Miraculous. The fact that she knows the kwami's name when she asked Ryuko if Longg had indeed gone over their plan with her is further indication of this.

title: Longg
text:
Longg - Relationships
Marinette puts on Longg's Miraculous in "Kwamibuster", so she and the other kwamis can help her save Tikki and Plagg from the titular villain, while she uses the power of the Mouse Miraculous to become Multimouse. The Dragon Miraculous is one of the few Miraculouses that the temporarily mouse-themed heroine didn't use, but she did hide herself in Longg mouth for a short time. In "Heart Hunter", because of Marinette's failed sabotage attempt, Longg was the only other kwami that was saved from Hawk Moth's grasp. After the events of "Miracle Queen", Marinette became the new Guardian tasked with safeguarding Longg's Miraculous, along with the rest of the Miraculouses.
In "Strikeback", thanks to the power of Flairmidable, Gabriel manages to steal the Dragon Miraculous from Ladybug's yo-yo, separating Longg from her guardian.
In "Re-creation", Ladybug managed to defeat Monarch and restore Longg's Miraculous to its original form, then sent Longg to live permanently with Kagami.
Félix Fathom/Argos

title: Longg
text:
Longg - Relationships
Although Longg initially held a grudge against Félix for stealing her Miraculous and leaving her in Monarch's service, Longg learned from Gabriel that Félix now had the Peacock Miraculous and overheard Gabriel and Tomoe's plans to steal it from him.
After returning to Kagami, Longg learned that she was dating Félix and accepted it, seeing that it was true love.
Tikki

Longg and her other companions knew that Duusu was lost along with Nooroo in the destruction of the Miraculous Temple. Years later, they learned that she was now being used by Mayura and later Shadow Moth to create Sentimonsters in Paris.
Longg and her other companions wished they could free her.
After Félix stole her Miraculous and all the others, Longg learned that Duusu was now in Félix's custody and became worried when Gabriel spoke of recapturing her.
In "Yaksi Gozen", Longg was overjoyed to see Duusu after Kagami and Félix detransformed.
Enemies
Gabriel Agreste/Hawk Moth/Monarch
At first Longg did not know Hawk Moth's identity, but she knew that Nooroo was under his command and she wanted to free him along with her other Kwamis companions.

title: Longg
text:
Longg - Relationships
In "Heart Hunter", when Ladybug took the Dragon Miraculous to separate Adrien and Kagami, she ended up preventing Hawk Moth from obtaining the Dragon Miraculous.
However, in "Strikeback", because Félix betrayed Ladybug, Gabriel ended up obtaining all the Miraculouses, leaving Longg under his service and discovering his motives.
In "Evolution", he uses Longg's power twice to escape Ladybug's Yo-yo.
In "Destruction", Longg and her companions are forced to reveal to Gabriel the location of her guardian, but they end up taking him to a trap that Ladybug had prepared to recover Longg and her companions, but she ended up failing, later Gabriel melts her Miraculous and turns it into an Alliance ring to transfer Longg's power to any akumatized villain he desires and imprisons Longg and her companions in cages.
In "Passion", Monarch loaded Longg's power into one of the projectiles created by Safari from Genesis, allowing Safari to use Longg's power.
In "Perfection", Monarch akumatized Kagami into Ryukomori and transferred Longg's power to her.
In "Protection", Longg sees Monarch akumatize her owner again.

title: Longg
text:
Longg - Relationships
In "The Final Day", Monarch transfers Longg's power, along with that of the other caged Kwamis, to the Miraculized. After Bug Noire's Battle against Monarch, Longg was freed from his control.
Tomoe Tsurugi
After being captured by Gabriel Agreste along with the other Kwamis, Longg learned that Kagami's mother was an accomplice of Monarch and helped him destroy her Miraculous and reforge it into an Alliance rings.
Longg subsequently observed their alliance and subsequent plans.
After being freed from Monarch's control and returning to Kagami, Longg realized that Tomoe knew Kagami's identity as Ryuko and still harbored a grudge against her for her actions.
In "Yaksi Gozen", Longg overheard Tomoe criticizing Kagami's relationship with Félix, and Longg harshly told her that Kagami and Félix were in love, and that love didn't wait. When Tomoe tried to forcefully take Kagami's ring, Kagami transformed into Ryuko to prevent her from doing so.

title: Longg
text:
Longg - Trivia
Longg was first revealed in a second season trailer on August 31, 2017.
Thomas Astruc confirmed her name on Twitter on November 11, 2018.
Longg was the only known Kwami to be based on a mythical animal until the reveal of the Thunderbird Kwami in "Miraculous New York".
However, in "Furious Fu", Su-Han revealed that dragons were once real in the Quantic Universe, before Plagg made them go extinct.
This could explain how it is possible that Longg is based on a dragon, since a Kwami may not have the appearance of an animal which does not actually exist.
Chinese dragons symbolize good luck, prosperity, heroism, boldness and more.
The dragon is the fifth animal of the Chinese zodiac.
Longg's name is based on the word "lóng" (龙/龍), which means "dragon" in Chinese.
Despite using female pronouns and having a feminine voice in the French dub, Longg is voiced by a man in the English dub.
As seen in concept art, Longg was originally going to use Tikki's eye design before they were changed to be similar to Plagg's.

title: London
text:
London - Trivia
In Master Fu's flashback in "Backwarder", it was revealed that he fled to London to avoid the Miracle Box from falling into Nazi hands during World War II.
At the end of "Backwarder", Marianne left for London to avoid giving too much information to Hawk Moth in case he akumatized her again.
Also, after Fu lost his memory in "Miracle Queen", he went to live in London with Marianne.
In  "The Final Day", London is one of the cities that Nightormentor travels through during Operation: Perfect Alliance.
From the end of "Revolution" until "Re-creation", London became the place of residence of Adrien and Kagami.
As of the end of "Revolution", it is also the new place of residence of Chloé and her mother.
In the series, London has been important on several occasions:
In "Backwarder", Gabriel and Tomoe, along with Adrien and Kagami, went to London for a royal wedding.
In "Startrain", Miss Bustier's class went to London to visit the Big Ben.
In "Hack-San", Marinette and her parents went to London to visit Shu Yin Cheng, Sabine's sister and Marinette's aunt.

In "Miraculous Paris" (which happens the same night as "Multiplication"), Cosmobug, Astrocat, Alya and Betterfly went to London to prepare their plan to stop Shadybug and Claw Noir.

title: Longg/History
text:
Longg/History - Intro
Longg is the kwami connected to the Dragon Miraculous. Currently, she allows Kagami Tsurugi to transform into Ryuko.

title: Longg/History
text:
Longg/History - Before [[Season 1]]
When the concept of Perfection came into existence, Longg came into existence. Before the Miraculous jewels were created, Longg and the other kwamis traveled all over the universe unable to interact with humans. Then, thousands of years ago, a mage created the Miraculouses. She started out with Lóng in China, then returned to China 2,000 to 2,500 years later. When her Miraculous was not being worn, Longg was dormant in the Dragon Miraculous, which was stored inside the Miracle Box.

title: Longg/History
text:
Longg/History - Season 1
During season 1, Longg was dormant in the Dragon Miraculous.

title: Longg/History
text:
Longg/History - [[Season 2]]
During season 2, Longg was dormant in the Dragon Miraculous.
In "Sandboy", Longg was celebrating Nooroo's birthday in the Miracle Box with the other kwamis, and they were excited when Tikki and Plagg arrived. The kwamis marveled at the gift Tikki brought, a marker, and played with each other. When the time to find Nooroo came, Longg got into position in an effort to contact him, but the kwamis contacted his wielder instead. Upon hearing his voice, the kwamis shuddered at the thought of being his slave and prevented themselves from being discovered when they all cut off the connection. They realized if they contacted Nooroo's wielder rather than Nooroo, then someone must have been akumatized and that Tikki's and Plagg's wielders would be in danger.

title: Longg/History
text:
Longg/History - [[Season 3]]
During season 3, Longg was dormant in the Dragon Miraculous.
In "Ikari Gozen", Longg and her Miraculous were loaned to Kagami as a "special delivery" from Ladybug. Upon meeting her, she tried to explain her powers and Ladybug's plan to her wielder but became surprised when Kagami said the magic words, instantly transforming her into Ryuko, before she could divulge Ladybug's plan fully. After the trio saved her wielder's mother, Longg and her Miraculous were returned to Ladybug and then to Master Fu.
In "Kwamibuster", she was activated along with the other kwamis to help Multimouse enact her plan of rescuing Tikki and Plagg. During the confrontation, she revealed Multimouse to a disguised Cat Noir, who informed him of Ladybug's plan. However, Longg was one of the few kwamis captured, but this was actually part of the plan as she unveiled her stowaway wielder, and with the help of Multinoire, Longg was eventually set free. After Kwamibuster's defeat, Longg and the others cheered for Marinette as their plan was a success and was returned to Miracle Box.

title: Longg/History
text:
Longg/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Heart Hunter", she was once again loaned to Kagami. Once again reactivated, she was happy to see Kagami again and transformed her into Ryuko so she could aid in the fight against Heart Hunter. After the titular villain was deakumatized, Longg and her Miraculous were returned to Ladybug. Unaware of what happened to the Guardian, she was also unknowingly saved by the heroine.
In "Miracle Queen", after avoiding Miracle Queen's hornets, Longg was reactivated again by Ladybug, and after recharging, she was ready to help. She fused her powers with Tikki's, transforming Ladybug into Dragon Bug, and combined the power of the Water Dragon and the yo-yo to form a water barrier, protecting the heroes from Miracle Queen's hornets. After fighting the titular villain's minions and deakumatizing her, Longg defused with Ladybug. After Ladybug regained the Miracle Box, she returned to her Miraculous.

title: Longg/History
text:
Longg/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Truth", Longg was accidentally released from the Miracle Box when Marinette tried to figure it out, she eagerness excitedly explored Marinette's room. When Marinette leaves for her date with Luka, she and her fellow kwamis hid with the Miracle Box, but they heard the titular villain broke into Marinette's room. After the titular villain's defeat, Longg and the others saw that Marinette was sad about breaking up with Luka to the point of tears, she didn't know exactly how to help but joined with the other kwamis in giving their new guardian a group hug.
In "Gang of Secrets", Longg was seen talking with some of the other kwamis until her guardian arrives home and was upset seeing her so sad and moves with Barkk to remove Marinette's pictures until they were halted from doing so. Later, she and the others hear Marinette voiced her distress about being condemned to a life of secrets and lies forever because of her alter ego. When they hear someone coming, the kwamis hide in the Miracle Box and after the Gang of Secrets had been defeated, Longg and the others look on as Marinette unveils her secret to Alya.

title: Longg/History
text:
Longg/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Mr. Pigeon 72", Longg was seen in Marinette's room watching along with Kaalki and Xuppu as Marinette paced herself crazily in an attempt to figure out how to stop future akumatizations. Then, seeing some of her siblings playing with one of Marinette's designer hats, she decided to join the fun. Afterwards, Kaalki and the kwamis help clean up Marinette's room.
In "Furious Fu", hearing that Master Fu was returning, Longg along with her fellow kwamis expressed dear desire to see him despite Marinette trying to keep them hidden for their safety and when her new guardian voiced concerns about leaving the Miracle Box unguarded. Longg realized if someone stayed to guard the box, the others could go but when they cheated their way out so all of them can go. Unfortunately, they were stopped by Marinette with no choice they used the "puppy dog eyes" on her and Marinette reluctantly agreed. However, Longg and and the others had a hard time keeping quiet while in Marinette's bag but heard that Master Fu is doing well and become a great painter.

title: Longg/History
text:
Longg/History - [[Season 4]]
But returning home, Longg realized that Su-Han had returned to reclaim the box as he was the previous guardian before Master Fu's incident and with Su-Han's strictness, she and the other kwamis sadly returned to the box. After seeing Ladybug's valiant actions against the titular villain, Su-Han realized that Master Fu's choice wasn't so bad allowing Longg and the kwamis to stay with Marinette.
In "Crocoduel", Longg and her siblings were listening to Alya trying to convince Marinette to come to the Couffaine Twins birthday party and to also talk to Luka.
In "Optigami", she was talking to Kaalki inside the Miracle Box until she heard the phone ringing, answering they find out that Marinette needs help and that Kaalki's power was needed but upon seeing their guardian end the call, Longg and the others believed Marinette will call again.
In "Wishmaker", when Marinette explained what a career was, Longg and the other kwamis voiced ideas on what she could do in life until Sass silenced them asking Marinette himself what she wanted to do; then saw her leave for the Paris Career Expo.

title: Longg/History
text:
Longg/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Dearest Family", after Tikki ate the pieces of galette, Marinette brought for them, the kwamis quickly realized what she did. Longg huddled together with the others when they realized the danger Tikki's hunger for candy can represent, despite the kwami of Creation refusal at that. When Tikki and Marinette left, the kwamis flew around in a panic. Shortly after she watched Marinette, realize that Sass warning was real and transforms to stop Tikki only to be affected by Tikki's hunger, which scared her.
Hearing a commotion downstairs, Longg and the others were commanded to hide. After Ladybug saved her family, Longg and the kwamis see her return with pieces of galette for them. Despite that they were still nervous regarding Tikki, until Marinette ensured them that Tikki will control herself and the kwamis ate the pieces of galette happily.

title: Longg/History
text:
Longg/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Ephemeral", during the fight against Moolak, Longg and her Miraculous were given to Kagami and transformed into Ryuko. After the battle, Longg and her jewel were returned to Ladybug. Later, they briefly met Sass owner Luka when he came into Marinette's room, but their introductions were cut short; when Luka received a message from Ladybug allowing Sass use his power to go back to the last marked time.
Soon Longg discovered why as she and everyone noticed the Absolute Power being activated meaning Shadow Moth obtained the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses and started his wish. Sass explained to Luka the consequences of it and the latter hurried the former to use his power, which he does causing their encounter with Luka to be erased.
In "Kuro Neko", during the fight against Rogercop, Longg and her Miraculous were given to Kagami to become Ryuko again. Later, Longg and the other kwamis tried to comfort Marinette after Cat Noir gave up on his Miraculous and was surprised to learn that she intended to replace him with someone who doesn't love her.

title: Longg/History
text:
Longg/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Penalteam", Longg and her Miraculous were used again by Kagami to become Ryuko and help Ladybug, along with many other heroes, to defeat Penalteam.
In "Risk", Longg and her Miraculous were briefly given back to Kagami. Later, Longg and the other kwamis watched Marinette search for different ways to sabotage Adrien and Lila's journey, unaware that she was under the influence of Risk's superpowers.
In "Strikeback", Longg and her Miraculous were given to Kagami to become Ryuko and helped Ladybug, Cat Noir and the rest of the heroes to defeat Strikeback. Later, after Flairmidable betrayed Ladybug by stealing her yo-yo, her Miraculous, along with all the others, was given to Gabriel Agreste in exchange for the Peacock Miraculous.

title: Liv Baker
text:
Liv Baker - Intro
is a superhero from Manhattan, New York City. She is also the younger sister of Andy Baker. Using the power of her Ectocap, when inhabited by Octocat, Liv transforms into the superheroine Myst, a hero with the power to create portals. She is also a member of the Ghostforce team.
For more information, visit the Ghostforce wiki's article about the topic: Liv Baker

title: Liv Baker
text:
Liv Baker - Appearance
Physcial appearance
Liv has blue-green eyes and long straight dark hair that's dyed in pink streaks. Her hair is tied up in a ponytail. She has a fair skin tone and light red lips.
Civilian attire
As a civilian, Liv wears a black shirt with various pink heart and bat designs, one of the hearts in the shirt is blue. She also wears pink shorts and a pink cap with a picture of a cloud with a lightning bolt.
As Myst
Myst dons a a black and pink jumpsuit with a full cover mask, gloves, and knee-high boots. On her chest is the Ghostforce emblem, a white ghost in a teardrop shape.

title: Liv Baker
text:
Liv Baker - Abilities
As Myst
As a superhero, Myst has the ability to fly and phase through objects. And with the help from Octocat, her special power is portal creation. This allows her to generate and control portals that she and others can travel through. Her portals are called Spectral Gate. Myst's can hold multiple portals at a time, which can range from small to large, but the portals severely drain her Boo Energy. Her unique weapon is a bow and arrow, the Spectral Bow/Spectral Arrow. Through her mask, she can communicate with Miss Jones and the other members of the team.

title: List of minor objects
text:
List of minor objects - Intro
This is a list of minor objects that have appeared in Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir.

id: List of minor objects::Clothes and accessories::0
title: List of minor objects
text:
List of minor objects - Clothes and accessories
Adrien's beret
Adrien's beret is a hat made by Marinette for Adrien on Saint Athanase's day. It is a black beret with Adrien's shirt pattern and a white heart embroidered on it.
In an alternative future (from "Cat Blanc"), it briefly became a part of Adrien's daily attire, and it's what lead to Adrien learning Ladybug's true identity.
August's pacifier
August's pacifier is a pacifier owned by August. It is a purple circle with an round, orange place to hold it. The part that August puts in his mouth seems to be yellow.
The pacifier is the first object to be akumatized and amokized separately, being followed by Félix's ring, Nathalie's tablet, and Kagami's ring.
In "Weredad", it first became an akumatized object for August to transform into Gigantitan.
In "Miraculer", the pacifier later got amokized by Mayura to created Lollipop Boy, a lollipop sentimonster.
Caline's bracelet

id: List of minor objects::Clothes and accessories::1
title: List of minor objects
text:
List of minor objects - Clothes and accessories
Caline's bracelet is a bracelet that Chloé gave to Caline in box at the end of "Zombizou" for her birthday. It is a golden bracelet that has strands that twist around each other to make them look like a chain. When akumatized, the bracelet transformed into a thick golden chain that wrapped around her entire left forearm, and had a huge guillotine blade, also with Greco-Roman designs embossed on the end, that she threw at her targets using her right arm.
In "Collusion", after watching an edited video of Mayor Bourgeois admitting to using his position to limit the citizens' freedom, Monarch sent her an megakuma that entered the bracelet, causing it to become the akumatized object of Miss Sans-Culotte. After she was de-akumatized, the bracelet looked aged, as if the oxidation process had been accelerated.
Caline's cosmetics bag
Caline's cosmetics bag is a cosmetics bag made by Marinette Dupain-Cheng that she gifted to Caline Bustier for her birthday in "Zombizou". It is pink with white polka dots, and it has a black zipper.

id: List of minor objects::Clothes and accessories::2
title: List of minor objects
text:
List of minor objects - Clothes and accessories
Later in the episode, the bag got vandalized by Chloé Bourgeois by scribbling a caricature of Marinette and crossed out the latter's birthday message undeneath it. This ultimately ends up being an object for Caline's akumatization.
In "Mega Leech", her cosmetics bag was pictured in a photo on Roger's cellphone.
Chloé's bracelet
Chloé's bracelet is an expensive bracelet owned by Chloé Bourgeois. It is golden with a swirly pattern surrounding round sapphire in between the loops engraved into it. Chloé brags to Marinette that the value of the bracelet would be around the entire value of Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie.

id: List of minor objects::Clothes and accessories::3
title: List of minor objects
text:
List of minor objects - Clothes and accessories
In "Rogercop", at first Plagg tries to eat the bracelet in Chloé's school bag thinking it was Camenbert, and while playing with it the bracelet gets stuck on his head. Plagg was unable to use his power of intangibility to pass through this bracelet. Not knowing what actually happened, Chloé accuses Marinette Dupain-Cheng of stealing her bracelet. Who in turn tries to prove herself innocent, ends up accusing everyone else in her class in the process. Because of the argument of who stole the bracelet, André Bourgeois fires Roger Raincomprix from being a police officer, causing Roger's akumatization.
During said episode, Nathaniel Kurtzberg drew the bracelet. A larger version of the drawing briefly appears in "Dark Cupid" on a display board that Nathaniel has.
As of "Revolution", it's is unknown if Chloé still owns this bracelet after she and her mother Audrey moved to London.
Fred's derby hat
Fred's derby hat is a hat that Fred Haprèle wears. It is a simple black hat with a dark gray band that goes all around it. At his request, Marinette fixed it is and save the pocket on the inside for Mylène's photo. When akumatized, the hat had taken on a purplish color.

id: List of minor objects::Clothes and accessories::4
title: List of minor objects
text:
List of minor objects - Clothes and accessories
In "The Mime", after his understudy caused him to lose his part in show, Fred was akumatized by Hawk Moth into Mime, transforming his derby hat along with him.
In "Catalyst", after witnessing Volpina's illusion, sensing her sadness over the heroes' "defeat", a scarlet akuma entered his derby hat, causing it to become the akumatized object of Scarlet Mime.
In "Gamer 2.0" and "Ephemeral", it is also his akumatized object and a winning object in Miraculous All-Star Brawl.
Jalil's pendant
Jalil's pendant is a necklace that belongs to Jalil Kubdel. It is dark cyan with the shape of a scarab, golden edges and details and has a black string. When akumatized, the pendant turns light blue and teal, becomes flat and the shape changes so that the scarab now has spread its wings. It also has a sun disk above its head.
The appearance of the pendant after its corruption is the same as the one from another necklace that Jalil was holding when he bumped into Alya and Marinette.
In "The Pharaoh", after his theories about an ancient Egyptian scroll were ignored by his father, Hawk Moth sent his an akuma that entered his necklace, causing it to become the akumatized object of Pharaoh.

id: List of minor objects::Clothes and accessories::5
title: List of minor objects
text:
List of minor objects - Clothes and accessories
In "Catalyst", after witnessing Volpina's illusion, sensing his sadness over the heroes' "defeat", a scarlet akuma entered his necklace, causing it to become the akumatized object of Scarlet Pharaoh.
Marianne's brooch
Marianne's brooch is a brooch that belongs to Marianne Lenoir. Fu gave it to her with the promise that he would get it back once they met again. It is yellow brooch with a simplified Chinese ideogram (爱), which means love. When akumatized, the brooche remained the same, but she took out the two hands that served as the watch face, which stood on her chest out.
In "Backwarder", after mistakenly thinking that Fu no longer loved her and that she had waited so long for nothing, Hawk Moth sent her an akuma that entered her brooch, causing it to become the akumatized object of Backwarder.
Xavier's bird call
Xavier's bird call is a bird call currently owned by Xavier Ramier. It is made out of wood with a carving of a bird on top. When akumatized, the bird call becomes black with magenta and teal lines.
Because of Mr. Pigeon's frequent akumatization, the bird call breaks the record for the most time an object get akumatized with a total of seventy-three times.

title: List of minor objects
text:
List of minor objects - Cell/Smart phones
Alec's cellphone
Alec's cellphone is a smartphone owned by Alec Cataldi. It shares the same design as Marinette Dupain-Cheng's.
In "Optigami", Alec plays a game in Tour Montparnasse's toilet, before he sees his doppelganger and stays here with Shadow Moth.
In "Hack-San", Alec got hypnotized by Robostus after receiving a message from his phone. He later attempted to use it to trap Scarabella and Cat Noir inside.
In "Wishmaker", Alec uses it for the show, showing an app with which practice playing the guitar.
André's cellphone
André's cellphone is a smartphone owned by André Bourgeois. It shares the same design as Marinette Dupain-Cheng's.
In "Mayura", after the start of The Battle of the Scarlet Army, André gives a speech before he answers his ex-wife's call to fly out of Paris as soon as possible. The phone's cover is colored white.
In "Mega Leech", after his "Project Oxygen" to redevelop the Place des Vosges was boycotted by Miss Bustier's students and various Parisians, André had tried to call Gabriel, who had answered from the computer in his atelier.

title: List of minor objects
text:

text:

In "Feast", Fu uses it to show Marinette a page about sentimonsters. Later, in "Miracle Queen", Nathalie says that the images are on his tablet. This means that they were probably transferred between the two devices.

title: List of minor objects
text:

Nathaniel's cellphone is a smartphone owned by Nathaniel Kurtzberg. It shares the same design as Marinette Dupain-Cheng's.
In "Horrificator", the phone is briefly seen when Nathaniel checked for any phone signal while he and his classmates were trapped inside Collège Françoise Dupont by the titular akumatized villain.
In "Reflekta", it is also briefly seen while Nathaniel and his classmates are waiting for Vincent to finish taking Olga Mendeleiev's class picture.

In "Guiltrip", Nathaniel received a text from Marinette that she and Adrien found Juleka Couffaine in the school's boiler room.
Philippe's cellphone
Philippe's cellphone is a smartphone owned by Philippe. He uses it to take selfies of celebrities and posts them on social media to promote the Ice Rink. The phone shares the same design as Marinette Dupain-Cheng's.
In "Hack-San", Philippe got hypnotized by Robostus after receiving a message from his phone. He later attempted to use it to trap Scarabella and Cat Noir inside.

title: List of minor objects
text:
List of minor objects - Cell/Smart phones
In "Destruction", he used his phone to take a selfie with Monarch and posted it on his social media. Here, it's revealed that his Instagram (or at least the in-universe equivalent of the real-world social platform) page is "ice_rink.off". He also posted photos with Nadja Chamack, Ladyice, Jagged Stone and Clara Nightingale.
Ray's cellphone
Ray's cellphone is a smartphone owned by Raymond Pugnant. On his cellphone, Ray has compromising videos of Zoé. Ray's cellphone has a completely blue cover with a gold stripe drawn on it that goes from top to bottom. On the top side of the screen it has a small round camera and on the back side at the top left it has four round cameras arranged in a square.
In "Daddycop", he used those videos to threaten Zoé into showing them to her new friends.
Roger's cellphone
Roger's cellphone is a smartphone owned by Roger Raincomprix. In the first five seasons, the cellphone shared the same design as Marinette Dupain-Cheng's. From season 6, Roger's cellphone has a black cover. On the top side of the screen it has a small round camera and on the back side at the top left it has four round cameras arranged in a square.

title: List of minor objects
text:
List of minor objects - Cell/Smart phones
In "Stormy Weather", the phone is briefly seen when Roger was trying to call back-up firefighters to rescue Alya and Manon who are both trapped inside a giant ice dome created by the titular akumatized villain.
In "Silencer", the phone is briefly seen when Roger called André Bourgeois from the TVi Tower elevator to let him know that he has successfully arrested Bob Roth, not realizing until the very next moment that the titular akumatized villain had stole the mayor's voice and tricked him.
In "Oni-Chan", Roger received a message from the titular akumatized villain and inadvertently switched places with her, so Oni-Chan can capture Lila Rossi.
In "Mega Leech", Roger received a call from Caline Bustier after he escorted Mylène Haprèle and Ivan Bruel from protesting Project Oxygen at the Place des Vosges.
Sam's cellphone
Sam's cellphone is a smartphone owned by Sam. Sam often uses this phone to play loud music or record videos of him bothering babies.
Tom's cellphone
Tom's cellphone is a smartphone owned by Tom Dupain. As seen in the "Copycat" and "Timebreaker", Tom's number is +33602423.

title: List of minor objects
text:
List of minor objects - Cell/Smart phones
In the first five seasons, the cellphone shared the same design as Marinette Dupain-Cheng's. From season 6, Tom's cellphone has a black cover. On the top side of the screen it has a small round camera and on the back side at the top left it has four round cameras arranged in a square.
In "Timebreaker", Tom received a call from Nadja Chamack who complained to him about the bakery being closed after she arrived early to pick up her Eiffel Tower cake.
In "Hack-San", Tom got hypnotized by Robostus after the phone received a message from him. The akumatized villain ordered him to "give [Robostus] what [Tom] hold most valuable", which Tom used his phone to trap Marinette.
Tomoe's cellphone
Tomoe's cellphone is a smartphone owned by Tomoe Tsurugi. The phone shares the same design as Marinette Dupain-Cheng's.
In "Ikari Gozen", Tomoe called her daughter's cellphone with her cellphone asking where she was, but was surprised and angry to find out from Marinette that Kagami had disobeyed her to participate in the Friendship Day's game, and was akumatized.
Wang's cellphone

title: List of minor objects
text:
List of minor objects - Cell/Smart phones
Wang's cellphone is a smartphone owned by Wang Cheng. It shares the same design as Marinette Dupain-Cheng's. His phone number is +86642891.

title: List of minor objects
text:
List of minor objects - Miscellaneous
Aurore's parasol
Aurore's parasol is a parasol that belongs to Aurore Beauréal. It is a light sky with cloud-shaped patterns, the inside of its ochre-yellow. When akumatized, the parasol acquired a dark purple color, turning into a brighter purple color at the tip, and had a black handle with a double spear tip at the bottom.
In "Stormy Weather", after losing the contest of KIDZ+ to become Miss Weather, Hawk Moth sent her an akuma that entered her parasol, causing it to become the akumatized object of Stormy Weather.
In "Catalyst", after witnessing Volpina's illusion, sensing her sadness over the heroes' "defeat", a scarlet akuma entered her parasol, causing it to become the akumatized object of Scarlet Stormy Weather.
In "Stormy Weather 2", after being bullied by Chloé for her poor grades, Hawk Moth sent her an akuma that entered her parasol, causing it to become Stormy Weather's akumatized object again.
In "Climatiqueen", after finding herself losing Chloé's contest on her Bee Community on Zoo, thus losing her chance to win an autographed copy of Claudie's book, Chrysalis sent her an ultrakuma that entered her parasol, causing it to become the akumatized object of Climatiqueen.

title: List of minor objects
text:
List of minor objects - Miscellaneous
Cash's hand fan
Cash's hand fan is a hand fan owned by Cash. It is white with detailed gold lacing and a destinctive Chinese pattern across it. It has a white shelling with red coverage and made out of wood. When akumatized, the fan is a dark blue fan detailed with fold patterns simlair to it's normal form, except it is now solid gold and also has a yellow end that lights up when he sends his blades out from it.
In "Miraculous Shanghai", after Fei made Cash frustrated, Hawk Moth used his to akumatize him, making it his akumatized object.
Chloé's statue
Chloé's statue was a statue built at Mayoress Chloé's request and placed above the Arc de Triomphe. It was a monumental statue made of pure gold, mounted on the Arc de Triomphe, which became its foundation. She represented the self-proclaimed mayoress of Paris, triumphant in a Roman toga covering her civilian clothes.
In "Revolution", after being awarded the title, she began to modify the monuments of Paris according to her wishes. Eventually, after the uprising of Parisians and superheroes, Chloé was banished from the city, and the statue was quickly destroyed to restore the original appearance of the Arc de Triomphe.

title: List of minor objects
text:
List of minor objects - Miscellaneous
Gentlemen's Camembert
Gentlemen's Camembert is a food magazine specializing in cheese and is Plagg's favorite magazine.
Geography
Geography is a textbook used by students at Collège Françoise Dupont.
Although Olga is a chemistry teacher, in "Miraculous New York" she was holding a Geography book when she left the hotel room.
Jalil's binder
Jalil's binder is a binder that belongs to Jalil Kubdel. It is yellow. When akumatized, the binder had become a black book with gold edges with many Egyptian hieroglyphics. After Pharaoh had transferred the power of Maat into the book, it had gained the face of Maat.
In "Reunion", after thinking that Ladybug was just a coward for sending her sister alone into the Burrow to protect the Rabbit Miraculous, Monarch sent him an megakuma that entered the binder, causing it to become the akumatized object of Pharaoh.
Le Journal
Le Journal is an information and news magazine published in Paris. The title page shows a shot from the extermination of Message Transmission by Ladybug from "Stoneheart", André's portrait and photo of Le Grand Paris from "Lady Wifi". There are also photos of akumatized villains: Timebreaker, Rogercop, Gamer and Dark Cupid.

title: List of minor objects
text:
List of minor objects - Miscellaneous
In "Sole Crusher", Audrey Bourgeois was reading a magazine at the Grand Paris' restaurant before Zoé came to visit her.
In "Qilin", the pages of the magazine can be seen on the stands near the flower shop.
As seen in "Collusion", Cerise Bianca hung a magazine clipping from the main page on board in her lair.
Luka's Jagged Stone guitar pick
Luka's Jagged Stone guitar pick is a Jagged Stone themed guitar pick that was owned by Luka Couffaine. He later gave it to Marinette. It is a purple guitar pick with an image of Jagged Stone printed on it.
Marc's notebook
Marc's notebook is a little notebook owned by Marc Anciel. He uses it to write stories. It is black with white pages where he can write anything he wants. When akumatized, the notebook became a black and white paper airplane.
In "Reverser", it became an akumatized object for Marc to transform him into Reverser.
Nathaniel's sketchbook
Nathaniel's sketchbook it's a sketchbook that belongs to Nathaniel Kurtzberg. It is black with blank pages in which he can write whatever he wants. When akumatized, the sketchbook became a black graphics tablet.

title: List of minor objects
text:
List of minor objects - Miscellaneous
In "The Evillustrator", after Chloé mocked his art and his crush on Marinette, he was infected with an Akuma by Hawk Moth and became the Evillustrator, also turning the sketchbook along with him.
Physics and Chemistry
Physics and Chemistry is a textbook used by students at Collège Françoise Dupont.
Although Olga and her students were never seen with this book, it is possible that they used it.
Rose's notebook
Rose's notebook is a notebook that belongs to Rose Lavillant. It is light pink with darker pink spine and corners. On the front of the book is a white label for writing a name or title on, and the notebook includes an attached red bookmark ribbon.
It only appears in the Miraculous: Tales from Paris webisode "The Notebook".
Rose's perfume bottle
Rose's perfume bottle is a perfume bottle that belongs to Rose Lavillant. It is a transparent pink teardrop-shaped flask containing a liquid that is sprayed by pressing from a white tube, thanks to a bag. When akumatized, the perfume bottle dark purple with rounded light pink glass with leaf-shaped edges, the handle and trigger are twisted with metal threads.

title: List of minor objects
text:
List of minor objects - Miscellaneous
In "Princess Fragrance", after Chloé teased her and tore up her letter to Prince Ali, Hawk Moth sent her an akuma that entered her perfume bottle, causing it to become the akumatized object of Princess Fragrance.
When Rose become akumatized again in "Heroes' Day", "Félix" and "Gang of Secrets", the perfume bottle becomes her akumatized object again.
Tomoe's bokken
Tomoe's bokken is a bokken owned by Tomoe Tsurugi. It is made out of wood with a white handle and a white tip. It is held together with white bands. When akumatized, the bokken becomes a long sword with a red blade and a black handle, and also a red bow.
In "Ikari Gozen", "Multiplication" and "Pretension", Tomoe got akumatized and the bokken becomes her akumatized object.
It is was the first akumatized object to transform into two different weapons during its akumatization. Also, it is the third akumatized item, after Kagami's keychain in "Protection" and Sabrina's whistle in "Adoration", to become a weapon to activate a Miraculous superpowers, in this case the Bee Miraculous's superpower and the Tiger Miraculous's super power.

title: List of minor objects
text:
List of minor objects - Technology
Adrien's tablet
Adrien's tablet is a tablet that belongs to Adrien Agreste. He uses it for his chinese lessons. It has a white case and a fairly large screen.
In "Startrain", when he and his class traveled to London, Adrien set his tablet's screen image to Big Ben.
In "Queen Banana", just as Nathalie used her tablet as a substitute for Gabriel Agreste in several episodes, such as "Mr. Pigeon" and "Animaestro", Adrien used his tablet to let his father watch the film made by his class and shown at Le Sorbonne.
Alec's microphones
Alec's microphones are microphones owned by Alec Cataldi. He uses the microphone to host various television programs, including the World Greatest Chef competition in "Kung Food", You Gotta Be Kidding? in "Wishmaker", and Live Your Childhood Dream in "Re-creation".
In "Wishmaker", the microphone became Alec's akumatized object and transformed him into the titular akumatized villain. With the effect of Alec's akumatization into Wishmaker, the microphone became an all-black scepter.
When Alec began hosting Live Your Childhood Dream, he uses a gold-colored microphone that resembles a walking cane.
Avion

title: List of minor objects
text:
List of minor objects - Technology
Avion is a French international airline that operates short, medium and long haul flights. It therefore offers flights to French, European and international cities such as New York City, Shanghai and Tokyo.
It is an aircraft with a white fuselage and a blue company name, the fin and rudder have a red, white and blue part. The interior of the cabin is white with blue floor and offers spacious white seats with blue cushions and armrests. Each place is equipped with a screen that allows access to different French channels, but also to a wide selection of films in French and English, such as Dévastation, Nature, Les aventures de Ladybug & Chat Noir of Thomas Astruc and Big Bang of Clara Nightingale.
In "Miraculous New York", Marinette and her class took it to New York for French-American Friendship Week. Later, it was attacked by Mike Rochip and saved by United Heroez.
Bob's limousine
Bob's limousine is Bob's personal limousine, driven by his chauffeur.

title: List of minor objects
text:
List of minor objects - Technology
In "Sublimation", Bob used the limousine to escape from the eponymous villain who was chasing him to force him to sponsor her daughter. However, the escape was short-lived as Sublimation stopped and destroyed it near the Canal Saint-Martin.
Bourgeois' helicopter
Bourgeois' helicopter is the private transport helicopter of the Bourgeois family. It is white and has blackout windows, allowing its occupants to maintain their anonymity.
At the end of "Queen Wasp", Audrey invitato invited Marinette to board this helicopter to join her for her journey back to New York.
In "Malediktator", Chloé announced to the students of Collège Françoise Dupont her departure for New York from this helicopter in flight.
In "Mayura", André and Audrey prepared their escape from Paris with this helicopter, before being hit by Scarlet Cupid's arrows and then being akumatized by Scarlet Moth.
Chloé's bee signal
The Bee Signal is a searchlight formerly owned by Chloé Bourgeois. She used to use it to alert Ladybug that there's a villain and that she can help. It is a big circular searchlight with the Bee Miraculous icon in the middle, so when turned on, it makes a bee symbol in the sky.

title: List of minor objects
text:
List of minor objects - Technology
The Bee Signal's design and use are an obvious reference to the Bat-Signal.
In "Catalyst", the Bee Signal is first seen when Chloé used it to alert Ladybug that she wants to help deal with the scarlet akumas. Though, Cat Noir arrived instead and handed her the Bee Miraculous.
In "Miraculer", the Bee Signal is seen being used twice. The first time was in the beginning of the episode where Chloé tried to alert Ladybug and Cat Noir that she wants to help them defeat Destroyer. On the next day, Chloé tried again when Lollipop Boy attacked Paris.
The Bee Signal can be seen on one of Chloé's Instagram photos in "Miraculous on Instagram".
In "Stormy Weather 2", Chloé wanted to alert Ladybug that she wants to help her and Cat Noir defeat Stormy Weather despite Ladybug suspended her from becoming Queen Bee for her safety after the events of "Miraculer".

title: List of minor objects
text:
List of minor objects - Technology
In "Heart Hunter", the Bee Signal is seen being used twice. The first time was in the beginning when Chloé once again tried to alert Ladybug and Cat Noir for help to no avail. The second time is when Chloé wanted to help the heroes defeat her parents who are both akumatized by Hawk Moth. However, upon seeing that Ladybug chose Ryuko instead of her, Chloé reached her breaking point and angrily threw the Bee Signal from the rooftop of the Le Grand Paris, causing it to break.
Due to an animation error, the Bee Signal briefly appeared in "Miracle Queen" when Hawk Moth gave the titular akumatized villain the Miracle Box.
Clara's microphone
Clara's microphone is a microphone that belongs to Clara Nightingale. It is a purple with a protruding tip and a celesta star with white dots attached to it. When akumatized, the microphone became a wand with a blue twisted handle, a rounded pink lower tip, a black star at the top and a pink circle with white edges between the star and the handle.
In "Frightningale", after Mayor Bourgeois banned her from filming her music video, Hawk Moth sent her an akuma that entered her microphone, causing it to become the akumatized object of Frightningale.

title: List of minor objects
text:

In "Catalyst", after witnessing Volpina's illusion, sensing her sadness over the heroes' "defeat", a scarlet akuma entered her microphone, causing it to become the akumatized object of Scarlet Frightningale.
Graham de Vanily's plane
Graham de Vanily's plane is a private plane that belongs to the Graham de Vanily family.
In "Werepapas", Emil and Milly used this plane to fly from London to Paris in order to meet Adrien and gain custody of him.
Lila's laptop
Lila's laptop is a laptop that belongs to Lila Rossi/Cerise Bianca.
In "Catalyst", Lila threw her laptop against the wall of her room after hearing Gabriel Agreste talk in a interview with Nadja that Volpina was just a mediocre heroine compared to Ladybug.
In "Re-creation", Cerise used her laptop to hack Tomoe's laptop so she could break into the Agreste mansion to steal the Butterfly Miraculous.
Marinette's laptop
Marinette's laptop is a laptop that belongs to Marinette Dupain-Cheng.
In "Simpleman", Marinette put Thomas Astruc's animated movie on her laptop to keep Manon, Chris, Ella and Etta busy.

title: List of unproduced episodes
text:
List of unproduced episodes - Intro
Unproduced episodes are planned episodes and media concepts mentioned by the crew of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir that were never made for the franchise. These unproduced episodes were either cancelled from production or were never greenlighted due to a lack of interest from executives.
Disclaimer: This list only collects episodes and media concepts that were confirmed to be cancelled or shelved from production. Please don't add anything that contains rumors and speculations without a source. Because concepts, ideas, and plans change over time in production, please update this page once there is confirmation that an episode or media has been greenlighted into production and remove it from the list.

id: List of unproduced episodes::''[[Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir]]'' episodes::0
title: List of unproduced episodes
section: ''[[Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir]]'' episodes
text:
List of unproduced episodes - ''[[Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir]]'' episodes
"Le Gourmangeur"
"Le Gourmangeur" (English name unknown) is an episode Thomas Astruc wrote at the very beginning of the show's production. It would've followed a little diabetic boy who didn't understand his disease.
On August 25, 2024, Thomas Astruc revealed that the topic was rejected by executives because food and disease are quasi-taboos.
"Gagotor"
"Gagotor" was a planned episode for Season 2 featuring Dany Boon.
On August 6, 2019, Wilfried Pain confirmed on his Twitter that the episode was cancelled for unknown reasons.
"Ladybug in Halloween"
"Ladybug in Halloween" is a scrapped 52-minute Halloween-themed episode.
On November 1, 2023, Thomas Astruc revealed that the Halloween episode was never produced due to requiring new CGI models created for characters wearing a costume. As a result, it's "too expensive" for the crew to produce it under the show's budget.

id: List of unproduced episodes::''[[Miraculous World]]'' television spin-offs::0
title: List of unproduced episodes
text:
List of unproduced episodes - ''[[Miraculous World]]'' television spin-offs
Because the Miraculous World TV movies introduce new heroes from other parts of the world, Thomas Astruc wanted to produce spin-offs and comic books based on the characters. However, aside from "Miraculous Stellar Force", none of the spin-offs were greenlighted yet.
Ladydragon
Thomas confirmed on Twitter that he wrote a bible for an unproduced Ladydragon TV spin-off starring Fei Wu that would have been set in Shanghai, China.
The planned series was first announced via Licensing Russia in April 2021, initially expected to premiere in 2022.
On August 11, 2021, Jeremy Zag hinted at the idea of the TV series in an Instagram post.
In July 2022, it was revealed via Licensing Russia that the series was slated for a 2024 release.
On October 2022, a website owned by ZAG revealed a concept art that featured the official logo for the spin-off series.
However, Thomas confirmed on April 29, 2024, that the project still didn't get greenlighted.
Miraculous: Resistance
Thomas Astruc mentioned on October 21, 2023, that a spin-off with the characters from "Miraculous Paris would be "too expensive" to produce, despite wanting to see them again.

id: List of unproduced episodes::''[[Miraculous World]]'' television spin-offs::1
title: List of unproduced episodes
text:
List of unproduced episodes - ''[[Miraculous World]]'' television spin-offs
On September 16, 2024, he stated that a comic book series was in the works.
On September 2, 2026, he confirmed that the project was ultimately cancelled, and revealed a short synopsis: Shadybug and Claw Noir want to stop their world's Supreme. But since their world has become too dangerous, they are hiding in parallel universes to devise their plan, encountering different versions of Ladybug and Cat Noir along the way.
Miraculous: Bunnyx & the Time Hoppers
On May 16, 2026, Thomas Astruc on Ludicomix stated he would like to create the series about Alix Kubdel/Bunnyx fighting a mysterious villain in different time periods in different countries where she meets several historical heroes. Creating it in 3D animation is difficult because it has to cover different time periods and the need to create a lot of backgrounds and characters would make it expensive; 2D animation would be possible but it's still expensive. The best option might be comic books but they would need to start the comic book company.
Miraculous United Heroes
Thomas Astruc revealed on Twitter that he had pitched a series with Jessica/Eagle, Aeon/Uncanny Valley and Fei/Ladydragon, but it hasn't been greenlighted.

id: List of unproduced episodes::''[[Miraculous: Tales from Paris]]'' webisodes::0
title: List of unproduced episodes
text:
List of unproduced episodes - ''[[Miraculous: Tales from Paris]]'' webisodes
Miraculous: Tales from Paris were originally planned to have a total of twenty-six webisodes released for the series.
However, the web series ended after releasing only five episodes because the crew shifted focus on the production of Miraculous Chibi.
On December 14, 2016, Ezra Weisz, the English dubbing director, revealed on Instagram that he received the scripts for the web series. He later confirmed on a Periscope live stream that there are eleven unreleased webisodes with some having finished animation.
Three voice actors have confirmed to record lines for their characters who were going to appear in the unreleased webisodes.
On December 22, 2016, Ezra mentioned that Kira Buckland came to record her lines for a webisode that featured Alix.
On January 6, 2017, Michael Sinterniklaas came to record his lines for a webisode that featured Nathaniel.
On January 18, 2017, Ezra indirectly revealed that Grant George came to record his lines for a webisode that featured Kim.

title: London Eye
text:
London Eye - Intro
The , also known as the Millennium Wheel, is a Ferris wheel located in London, on the south bank of the Thames between Westminster Bridge and Hungerford Bridge.

title: London Eye
text:
London Eye - Description
Opened to the public in March 2000, the London Eye is a large white wheel built on the right bank of the River Thames. It is 135 metres high with a diameter of 120 metres and has 32 air-conditioned and sealed cabins. It therefore offers a unique panorama of London and its monuments, including Big Ben.
At night, the wheel is illuminated by LED lighting.

title: London Eye
text:
London Eye - Trivia
Since its opening, the London Eye has changed names several times due to corporate sponsorship:
British Airways London Eye (2000 to 2005).
Merlin Entertainments London Eye (2007 to 2011).
EDF Energy London Eye (2011 to 2015).
Coca-Cola London Eye (2015 to 2020).
Lastminute.com London Eye (since 2020).

title: Louvre/Movie
text:
Louvre/Movie - Intro
The Louvre , also called Louvre Museum, is a Parisian museum of art and antiquities located in the Louvre Palace in the 1st arrondissement of Paris. Inaugurated on August 10, 1793, it is the largest museum in the world, but also the most visited. Among its most famous works are the Mona Lisa, the Venus de Milo, the Red Scribe, the Nike of Samothrace and the Code of Hammurabi.

title: Louvre/Movie
text:
Louvre/Movie - Description
Entrance
The entrance to the Louvre Museum is through the Louvre Pyramid located in the center of the Hall Napoléon.
Hall Napoléon
The Hall Napoléon is a huge two-story hall located directly beneath the Louvre Pyramid. The revolving entrance door leads directly to a spiral staircase wrapped around a column and an escalator that leads to the lower level of the hall. Empty cabinets and bas-reliefs can be seen near the wall, and in the distance the entrance to the rest of the museum. The main decoration is the numerous posters promoting the current exhibitions in the museum.
Department of Paintings
This department has 7,500 works of art in the Louvre, 3,400 of which are on public display. These paintings cover a period from the Middle Ages to 1848. They represent the different major schools of painting in Europe during these periods, especially the French, Northern (Flanders, Netherlands and Germany) and Italian schools.

title: Louvre/Movie
text:
Louvre/Movie - Description
The works are displayed in large thematic rooms, including the famous Red Rooms. As the name suggests, these huge, rectangular rooms have red walls with gold decorations to make the paintings, often in brown tones, stand out. Illuminated by the glass ceiling, there are works by great French masters, as well as grandiose large-format paintings.
In one of these rooms are exhibited: The Mona Lisa by Leonardo da Vinci protected by glass and whose perimeter wall is white, Liberty Leading the People by Eugène Delacroix, Charging Officer of the Light Cavalry of the Imperial Guard and The Raft of the Medusa by Théodore Géricault, The Coronation of Napoleon and the Portrait of Madame Récamier by Jacques-Louis David, etc.

title: Louvre/Movie
text:
Louvre/Movie - Trivia
The Louvre Museum has been classified as a historical monument since 1890.
The Musée National Eugène-Delacroix, located in the 6th arrondissement of Paris, depends on the Louvre Museum.

title: Lone Tigress and Cub
text:

is a Japanese film by Yuki Misumi.
In "Daddycop", Kagami showed this film to her friends during their monthly movie night.
In "The Dirtifiers", Kagami once again attempted to watch the film with her friends.

title: Lone Tigress and Cub

The film poster features a black-and-white image of a woman dressed in traditional feudal Japanese attire. It includes kanji characters in various fonts and colors.

title: Lone Tigress and Cub

Lone Tigress and Cub - Synopsis
This is the story of a samurai's wife who is betrayed but manages to escape with her son, whom she must protect from the henchmen of a notorious lord.

This was the first movie that Sabrina watched during the monthly movie night with her new group of friends.
