title: Louvre Palace
text:
Louvre Palace - Intro
The  is a former royal palace located on the right bank of the Seine in Paris, between the Jardin des Tuileries and the church of Saint-Germain l'Auxerrois. It houses the Louvre Museum in the center of the courtyard.

title: Louvre Palace
text:
Louvre Palace - Description
The Louvre Palace covers a built area of ​​over 135,000 m2, making it the largest palace in Europe.
Built under the Ancien Régime, the palace was the long-time Royal Residence of the King of France who had it built and renovated over five centuries. It was built on a rectangular plan in Renaissance, Classical and Neoclassical styles, with many internal courtyards, open or closed. The palace has a bright facade and a blue roof.
Access to the Louvre Palace is through several passages. The most important are the Louvre stalls. These are large vaulted openings that allow entry, but also exit, into the interior courtyards of the palace. These stalls directly overlook the Place du Carrousel.
To the west of the square are the Jardin du Carrousel and the Arc de Triomphe du Carrousel, which open onto the Jardin des Tuileries. To the east is the Cour Napoléon. This courtyard is particularly famous for the Louvre Pyramid built in its center, the entrance to the Louvre Museum.

title: Louvre Palace
text:
Louvre Palace - Activities
Louvre Museum
The largest museum of art and antiquities in the world, the Louvre is the most visited museum in the world with nearly 10.2 million annual visitors. It is the most visited paid cultural site in France. Among its most famous works are the Mona Lisa, the Venus de Milo, the Red Scribe, the Nike of Samothrace and the Code of Hammurabi.
Decorative Arts
They are a French cultural institution that brings together museums, educational institutions and libraries around the art of living, decorative arts, design, fashion and textiles, advertising and graphics.
At the Louvre Palace, this institution occupies the Rohan and Marsan wings (107 rue de Rivoli). There is the Museum of Decorative Arts, the Museum of Fashion and Textiles, the Museum of Advertising, but also the Library of Decorative Arts.
There are also the Ateliers du Carrousel. They offer several workshops at different levels to learn and improve the techniques of drawing, painting, modeling, etc.
École du Louvre

title: Louvre Palace
text:
Louvre Palace - Activities
It is a French higher education institution created in 1882, dependent on the Ministry of Culture. This school offers training in art history, archaeology, epigraphy, history of civilizations, anthropology and museology. It is located in Paris, in the Flore wing of the Louvre Palace.
Research and Restoration Center of the French Museum
Occupying the site of the Carrousel and the Pavillon de Flore, it is the State operator in the field of research and restoration concerning museum collections.
Carrousel du Louvre
It is an underground shopping center located between the Louvre Museum and the Tuileries Garden, under the Pyramide Inversée of the Louvre which forms the roundabout of the Place du Carrousel.
This shopping center is 16,000 m2 and has more than 50 shops and stores.
Paris Expo "Carrousel du Louvre"
These are four rooms dedicated to hosting prestigious events.

title: Louvre Palace
text:
Louvre Palace - Trivia
The Louvre Palace has been classified as a Historic Monument since 1890.
The Louvre Palace has been the site of multiple attacks by akumatized villains:
In "The Pharaoh", the palace was used as a sacrificial site for Alya by the eponymous villain.
In "The Mime", the eponymous villain was akumatized here and later attacked Théo Barbot.
In "Volpina", the eponymous villain created the illusion of a meteor and introduced herself to the Parisians as their new savior.
In "The Collector", the eponymous villain imprisoned the Louvre Pyramid inside his notebook.
In "Riposte", after Ladybug hid Adrien in a sarcophagus in the Egyptian exhibit at the Louvre Museum, the eponymous villain showed up to attack them both.
In "Bakerix", the eponymous villain trapped Ladybug and Cat Noir in the glass pyramid.
In "Timetagger", the square was used by the eponymous villain to travel through time and space.
In "Penalteam", Penalty's team and Ladybug's team used the square as a soccer field.
In "Reunion", the Pharaoh covered the palace with a giant golden pyramid.

title: Louvre Palace
text:
Louvre Palace - Trivia
In "The Dark Castle", when Armand D'Argencourt got akumatized into the eponymous villain, he became the palace itself and controlled everything inside it, and became a giant made out of the palace.

The love letter is a poem written by Adrien Agreste for Ladybug as a means to confess his love on Valentine's Day. He dislikes the poem thinking he can do better and throws it away, only for it to be retrieved by Marinette after class.

title: Luka Couffaine
text:
Luka Couffaine - Intro
is one of the two tritagonists (alongside Kagami Tsurugi) of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He is the older twin brother of Juleka Couffaine and the guitarist of Kitty Section who attracts the attention of Marinette Dupain-Cheng.
In "Silencer", when Bob Roth threatened Marinette after she accused him of stealing Kitty Section's design for XY's new song, Luka was akumatized by Hawk Moth into Silencer, a voice-stealing supervillain.
In "Desperada", after Adrien Agreste gave up being Aspik for not being able to help Ladybug against the titular akumatized supervillain for the 25,913th time, she decided to give Luka the Snake Miraculous. When the Miraculous is inhabited by Sass, he becomes Viperion, a snake-themed superhero with the power of Intuition who helps Ladybug and Cat Noir during "particularly difficult missions" in the third season and beyond.

title: Luka Couffaine
text:
Luka Couffaine - Intro
In "Truth", when Marinette couldn't tell him why she disappeared all the time, Luka was akumatized and amokized by Shadow Moth into Truth, a three-eyed supervillain that forced people to tell the truth. His sentimonster was Lighteye, a giant floating eye that could shine a spotlight that prevented people from being able to move.
In "Wishmaker", during the fight against the titular villain, Luka, as Viperion, discovered the true identities of both Ladybug and Cat Noir, who were exposed after being affected by the titular akumatized supervillain's powers. Because of his power to go back in time, this didn't happen in the main timeline, leaving everyone, including the two main heroes unaware that Luka knows who they are, but Luka didn't tell them of his knowledge as to not give them something else to worry about.
After the events of "Strikeback", Luka was temporarily unable to become Viperion after Monarch managed to steal the Snake Miraculous along with all the others contained in the Chinese Miracle Box from Ladybug's yo-yo.

title: Luka Couffaine
text:
Luka Couffaine - Intro
In "Migration", after Bob Roth tricked Kitty Section to sign a contract only for him to fire everyone except for Luka so he can get rich with his talent and take ownership of the band's name, songs, and everything they've created and will create, Luka was almost reakumatized by Monarch into Silencer. However, Luka was able to reject the megakuma, but not before Monarch sensed his vehement resistance and correctly deduced the reason why: he knows Ladybug and Cat Noir's true identities. After Bob Roth was deakumatized, Luka told everyone that he needed to temporarily leave Paris for knowing Ladybug and Cat Noir's true identities, going away with Jagged, Penny, and Fang until Monarch is defeated.
Between "Migration" and "Re-creation", Luka, along with Jagged and Penny, joined the Order of the Guardians and trained with Su-Han in Rio de Janeiro.
In "Re-creation", after having joined up with Su-Han and the Order of the Guardians, Luka returned temporarily to Paris to help out in the fight against Monarch. After Marinette recovered the stolen Miraculous and reforged them following Monarch's defeat, Luka was given back the Snake Miraculous permanently and reunited with Sass.

title: Luka Couffaine
text:
Luka Couffaine - Intro
In "El Toro De Piedra", it is revealed that Luka is currently in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
In "Mister Agreste", Ladybug, using the Snake Miraculous, reveals to Luka that she lied to the world that Gabriel Agreste was a hero and that he was actually Monarch. Surprised and desperate, he asks to borrow Ladybug's Miraculous, saying he knows things she doesn't and that he's the only one who can solve the situation, but doesn't tell her what he would do. However, she uses Second Chance to erase this event.
In "Revelator", it's shown that, after getting his Miraculous back, Luka, along with the other secondary heroes of Ladybug's team, was trained to unlock his adult powers, no longer detransforming after using his power.

title: Luka Couffaine
text:
Luka Couffaine - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Luka is a tall and slender teenage boy. He has a Roman nose, pale pink lips, luminous cyan colored eyes, and medium-length black hair that has dyed cyan tips. He has full bangs in front of his bangs, the tips slightly flared out. He also has thick curved forelocks framing his face.
From Season 6 onwards, his hair is slightly more messier and spiky. He has more visible thick clumps of hair atop his head.
Civilian Attire
In Seasons 2-5, his attire included a white t-shirt with a black Jagged Stone imprint and ripped-like patterns at the bottom and black jeans ripped at the knee. On his right wrist, he also wore a brown leather bracelet, and yellow and orange wristbands, and his fingernails were painted black. He had a grayish cerulean denim jacket with a strong blue elbow-length sleeved hooded cardigan underneath, as well as black high-top converse sneakers with different colored patterns. He wore a black ring with silver outlining on his left index finger and circular black earrings in his ears. Up until "Re-creation", on occasion, he wore the Snake Miraculous as a silver band with ridges.

title: Luka Couffaine
text:
Luka Couffaine - Appearance
From Season 6 onwards, his attire has slight changes. He keeps only his hoodie now, with the hood black as well as the drawstrings. His shirt loses the Jagged Stone imprint and ripped designs, accessorized with a charcoal gray belt that has a silver buckle. His pants retain the rips, but said rips are now on the top of the right leg than in the middle of both legs, as well as the pant legs rolled up to the ankle. His sneakers are replaced by dark brown boots with darker soles and laces, and on his left wrist is a white bracelet and a cyan green bracelet which is possibly the Snake Miraculous, the others retained.
As Viperion

title: Luka Couffaine
text:
Luka Couffaine - Appearance
In Seasons 3-5, Viperion gained a shiny deep green muscular-looking bodysuit. He had dark turquoise lower arms, upper front torso, shoulders, sides of the abdomen, and lower legs with a snake-like texture and dark sea blue trimming. The top of the swan-neck, hands, middle of the stomach down to the sides of the thighs, and feet were vivid cyan, the stomach having spiky lines down the middle to resemble the underbelly of a snake with matching dark sea blue trimming on the aforementioned body parts. The soles and two lines around the feet were also dark sea blue, while on the chest was a bright lime diamond with a scale pattern and dark green bordering. His mask was dark turquoise with a scale pattern at the top, vivid cyan with dark blue vertical lines at the bottom, deep green angular spots around his eyes, and dark green nostril-like designs, complete with bright lime fangs at the bottom. His eyes were brilliant spring green, and the dyed ends of his hair changed to a moderate sea green. His Miraculous was a bangle and turned vivid cyan with a snake face on top and a light lime tongue and eyes, worn on his left wrist. He wielded his lyre as his weapon.

title: Luka Couffaine
text:
Luka Couffaine - Appearance
From Season 6 onwards, Viperion's appearance changes significantly.
His costume turns dark blue with grayish green shoulders and neck, the chest having square-like segments around the top.
The neck had a rounded swan-neck at the bottom with a dark blue turtleneck part on top lining the bottom of Viperion's chin with fang-like parts above, emulating the lower jaw of a snake.
He also gains a hexagonal scaly sea green pattern on his front torso and inner arms, the pattern coiling around the torso to the right thigh, resembling a snake's body.
The diamond on his chest turns gold with deep green triangular pieces jutting at either side of the bordering, as well as a slit in the middle of the diamond resembling a snake's eye.
His eyes seem to turn gold with mint green sclera, as well as his mask turning grayish green and simpler, but it retains similar fang-like details and has an angular shape.
His Miraculous also turns into a teal downward V-shaped bracelet, now worn on the right wrist.
He also gains grayish green parts at the sides of his lower legs down to the middle of the toe, and vivid cyan soles with triangular pieces on top connecting to the sides of said toe.

title: Luka Couffaine
text:
Luka Couffaine - Appearance
His hair also gains light cyan dyed ends.
As Silencer
He had brilliant cobalt blue skin and vivid emerald green eyes, retaining his civilian hair beneath his helmet. His helmet was black with a spiked brilliant purple part at the top lined in moderate heliotrope, with a black curved cylindrical part on top, metallic moderate heliotrope circular parts at the sides with fuchsia insides, and the bottom of the helmet looked like a jagged mouth with a fuchsia inside and moderate heliotrope lining at the bottom. His bodysuit was black with a brilliant purple front up to the sides of the upper chest, accented by brilliant heliotrope trimming, matching-colored angular details on the top of his lower limbs and around the foot with a horizontal mark on top, and a black jagged mouth-like design on the torso with brilliant purple sides and light heliotrope accents on the top and bottom, and a black inside with a horizontal pattern of diamonds with a brilliant purple and light heliotrope gradient resembling sound volume.
As Truth

title: Luka Couffaine
text:
Luka Couffaine - Appearance
He wore a sapphire bluish-black full-bodysuit with a hidden wedge on his feet which covered all of his body with dark grayish cornflower blue accents on the chest, shoulders, and around the round eye symbol on both of his knees, wrists, and top of his shoulders, the accents having triangular points jutting out, the chest details connecting to the sides of the abdomen's accents, as the chest design is an upside-down triangle. His boots and bracelets were dark grayish cornflower blue. He had three pupil-less eyes and they were cornflower bluish-white, the main ones having triangular parts at the sides and his third eye was on his forehead with three various points, two of which go diagonally and one going horizontally in the middle at the top (similar to Mylène Haprèle's form as Horrificator) and carried an eye necklace on his chest that accented the eye designs but in a triangular shape, the akumatized version of the guitar pick Marinette Dupain-Cheng gave him that he made into a necklace.

title: Luka Couffaine
text:
Luka Couffaine - Personality
Luka is a friendly, polite, playful, charming, and flirtatious boy who is very mature and wise for his age. Like his twin sister Juleka, he is a music lover and a talented guitarist, rarely seen without his guitar by his side. Although everyone assumes he wants to be a rock star when he grows up, given his love of rock music and that his father is Jagged Stone, he is actually drawn to the art of crafting stringed instruments and wants to dedicate himself to making them so that others can express their emotions through music. True to how Marinette Dupain-Cheng described him in his dedicated webisode, Luka is intuitive and attentive to the people around him, able to read others' emotions and express them through music, as when he cheers Marinette up shortly after meeting her.

title: Luka Couffaine
text:
Luka Couffaine - Personality
He is very caring and generous, especially with his friends and family, but also with people he has just met, easily winning the goodwill of those around him. Thanks to his emotional maturity, Luka can get to the root of people's problems and offer advice to help them, becoming a reliable source of emotional support for his loved ones. He is welcoming, empathetic, and encouraging, urging those he loves to do things they feel insecure about and to be more open with their feelings. Luka is also brave and not easily frightened, willing to put himself in danger to protect others or help stop villains, as shown in "Mayura", where he is inspired by Ladybug and Cat Noir's determination to join the rest of Paris's citizens in the battle against the army of scarlet akumas and show his support for the heroes. Admiring his bravery and determination to protect his friends, Adrien Agreste recommends to Ladybug that she choose Luka as the holder of the Snake Miraculous instead, knowing that he would make better use of the Miraculous's powers.

title: Luka Couffaine
text:
Luka Couffaine - Personality
He is also very understanding and patient, always willing to listen to anyone who needs it. After ending his relationship with Marinette in "Truth", despite being sad, he decides to respect Marinette's willingness to keep secrets and support her in her crush on Adrien. Upon discovering Marinette and Adrien's identities as superheroes in "Wishmaker", aware of the rules and the need for heroes to maintain secrecy, Luka understood that the city needed Ladybug and Cat Noir and resolved to protect their identities. In "Migration", Luka had no problem acting as the mediator for his family and friends making time for each one and he's willing to give those who have done wrong or bad a second chance but to the point of naivety as he was tricked by Bob Roth into signing his contract without reading it first. Upon realizing his mistake, he refused to work for Bob to fill his endless greed nor leave his friends behind to where he resisted his own akumatization to protect Ladybug and Cat Noir.

title: Luka Couffaine
text:
Luka Couffaine - Personality
Despite his calm and relaxed nature, he sometimes loses his calm if he feels that he and mainly his friends are being wronged, demonstrating that he has his limits when it comes to patience in certain situations. In "Silencer", when Bob Roth stole his band's music, dance, and outfits and claimed them to be XY's, Luka joined Marinette to confront them. Although he remained somewhat composed, realizing they couldn't reason with him, witnessing Bob threaten Marinette with ruining her future in the fashion industry only fueled Luka's frustration and desire to make them pay grew to the point that he was akumatized. In "Mister Agreste", when Viperbug confesses that Gabriel Agreste was Monarch and the lies she has told the world about what happened in their final fight for fear that Adrien could be akumatized if he discovered the truth, Luka loses his temper and impulsively asks Marinette for the Ladybug Miraculous in an attempt to solve the situation, but Viperbug uses Second Chance before he can do anything.

title: Luka Couffaine
text:
Luka Couffaine - Personality
Although he is usually self-assured, he can sometimes be insecure and hides his own feelings so as not to upset the one he loves. His greatest source of insecurity lies in his crush on Marinette, since, as Marinette herself notes, Luka gets akumatized twice because of his feelings for her and ends up very depressed after their breakup in "Truth". He is saddened by Marinette's avoidance of him to the point of almost being akumatized in "Crocoduel", something that is prevented with the help of his friends, later reconciling with Marinette and continuing as friends. In "Mister Agreste", it is revealed that Luka returned to Rio de Janeiro despite Monarch's defeat because he still has feelings for Marinette, but since she and Adrien are together and happy, he fears that this could lead to jealousy and ruin their friendship, as well as making him a victim of an akuma from the new holder of the Butterfly Miraculous, asking Irupé to pretend to be his new girlfriend in front of Marinette to make her believe he has moved on from her.

title: Luka Couffaine
text:
Luka Couffaine - Personality
As Viperion, most of Luka's personality remains intact, especially his wisdom, which he uses to offer ideas and suggestions to his allies during missions. Like a snake, he is focused and observant, using his abilities strategically in battle to ensure victory. As the oldest of the Miraculers, he often acts as a support for his teammates and isn't afraid to put himself in danger to protect them from villain attacks.
As Silencer, his main goal was to make Bob Roth tell the truth regarding the fact he stole the Kitty Section's song as he took the voices of anyone that could serve his purposes or get in his way. Despite his villainous nature, he still retained his care for Marinette, as she was the only person whose voice he spared, and he reassured her he would make "justice" for her and Kitty Section.

title: Luka Couffaine
text:
Luka Couffaine - Personality
As Truth, his views on trust and honesty were warped. He was shown to be desperate to know Marinette's secret, interrogating anyone that could possibly know it, like her best friends and her parents while proclaiming he always told the truth. He was shown to get frustrated quite easily when they kept telling him a secret he already knows. However, he could prioritize other secrets when they had a much bigger meaning to him, like when he made his mother confess to him who his father was. He was violent and aggressive as he was upset about Jagged Stone being his father and abandoning him to where he threw Jagged away off a roof, and wouldn't hesitate to attack anyone who got in his way of knowing someone's secret.

title: Luka Couffaine
text:
Luka Couffaine - Abilities
As a Civilian
Luka is excellent at playing his guitar, claiming to have played guitar since he was a baby, and similar musical instruments like the violin and he seems to have a specialty for fingerstyle guitar. He is particularly good at creating melodies through people's emotions.
In "Frozer", Luka was shown to be very good at ice skating, as well as fairly strong, lifting Marinette with ease. Luka can also ride a bike, as shown when he was delivering pizzas in "Heart Hunter", and the numerous times he has given Marinette a ride. In "Wishmaker", Luka is a good swimmer, as he was able to save his dad from drowning.
Sometime after "Migration" but before "Re-Creation", Luka met Su-Han and the Order of the Guardians. From them, he learned Mirakung Fu after spending time with the order and briefly returned to Paris as a martial artist who can go toe-to-toe with Miraculized villains without any superpowers.
As Viperion

title: Luka Couffaine
text:
Luka Couffaine - Abilities
Viperion has enhanced capabilities such as speed, agility, and strength, and he is almost invulnerable to physical damage. These abilities allow him to react to and evade akumatized villains attacks, as well as jump and leap several times his height and length. Like a snake, he also has enhanced senses like hearing, smell, and infrared vision. His tool is a lyre, which allows him to defend himself against enemy attacks and use it as a communication device to contact any superhero on his team.
His special superpower is Second Chance. With this, he marks a moment in time by sliding back the snake head on his Miraculous, and the snake head slowly returns to its place over the course of five minutes. Then, when needed, he slides the snake's head back again, reversing time to the point he marked. This gives him the opportunity to change the outcome of a recent event. He is able to go back to the marked moment as many times as he wants before the snake's head returns to its original position.
This power, together with his natural inteligence and intuition, makes Viperion a force to be reckoned with in the team.

title: Luka Couffaine
text:
Luka Couffaine - Abilities
Iniatially, using his power would depower him and cause him to detransform after 5 minutes, however, in "Revelator" it is shown that Viperion has learned to control his adult powers, allowing him to not detransform back and use Second Chance as much as he wishes.
As Silencer
Silencer could steal people's voices by touching their lips with his two fingers and making a shushing motion; the voice would then escape from the person as a jellyfish-like entity. Once their voices were out, he could store them inside his helmet, and then he could talk with them using his hands, like a hand puppet. He could also use more than one voice at a time. If his power was used on a Miraculous holder, he could render them virtually powerless unless he said the invocations in their place. However, the victims could reclaim their voice if they got the jellyfish-like entity before he did or If his helmet was destroyed, all the voices were freed from within it.
As Truth

title: Luka Couffaine
text:
Luka Couffaine - Abilities
Truth was able to shoot beams from his third eye on his forehead, which forced people to tell them the truth. Those hit by the beam had bigger sclera, smaller pupils, and white lipstick, similar to the black lipstick worn by the victims of Dark Cupid. Once hit, the victim would have to answer truthfully to any question Truth asks. He had total control over his sentimonster who let him immobilize anyone he enlightened, allowing Truth to listen to his victim without them trying to leave or escape.

title: Luka Couffaine
text:
Luka Couffaine - Etymology
His full name means "light of/from the coffin".
The name Luka is an Eastern European variant of a name that derives either (or both) from the name of a region in Italy or from Latin lūx, lūcis, meaning "light".
In the Russian dub, his name is changed to Luke.
Luka's surname Couffaine is a combination of "couffin" (French for "coffin") and the French suffix "-aine" (meaning "of or from a place"), ultimately meaning "of/from the coffin".
All the Couffaine's names so far end with "-ka".
However, it is actually a pun, as a matter of fact in French it sounds like "acouphène" which means "tinnitus".
When the official Miraculous Ladybug website got updated in September 2020, the official character description has his surname incorrectly spelled as Couphène.
Viperion's name is likely a portmanteau of viper (a family of venomous snakes) and Hyperion, a Titan of Greek mythology associated with the sun and daytime.
In Greek mythology, the priestess of the oracle at Delphi was known as Pythia, stemming from the giant snake slain by Apollo (another god of the sun) "in the strength of Hyperion (day)".
Apollo is also known to have a lyre.

title: Luka Couffaine
text:
Luka Couffaine - Trivia
Revealed by the Staff
Luka was first revealed in a French synopsis for Season 2 on Le Figaro.
He was later revealed to be Juleka Couffaine's older brother in a Brazilian synopsis for Season 2 on O Universo da TV.
Lindalee Rose hinted at the possibility that Luka and Juleka's father is Jagged Stone, which is revealed and confirmed in "Truth".
Thomas Astruc had originally stated that Luka is approximately two years older than Juleka. This was later changed to them being twins. However, he is still older than the rest of the main cast, as Juleka failed a year of school and thus had to repeat it. At the very least, he and his twin sister are around 15/16.
According to Feri González, Luka is a handsome boy, and people "are going to fall in love with him."
She also noted that both Luka and Kagami Tsurugi are "charming, rounded characters" who are not limited to roles as alternate love interests.
Viperion was first revealed in concept art shown at the 2018 Comic-Con Experience panel on December 6, 2018.
Miraculous Holder and Akumatized Villains

title: Luka Couffaine
text:
Luka Couffaine - Trivia
Following Alya Césaire, Nino Lahiffe, Chloé Bourgeois, and Nathalie Sancoeur, he is the fifth person to become a Miraculous holder and akumatized villain, excluding Gabriel Agreste, who akumatized himself.
Luka proves to be a better user of the Snake Miraculous and its power than Adrien, as Adrien wasn't able to beat Desperada after 25,913 times, while Luka was able to defeat her after 4 times. Although an exact number wasn't directly confirmed, it was definitely in a faster time span in comparison to Adrien's attempts. However, this might also be because Cat Noir was helping Luka while Cat Noir couldn't help Adrien (because they're the same person).
Also Adrien was distracted and love-struck while Luka was more cool, calm, observant and focused which is the exact description Master Fu used to describe the Snake Miraculous.
Both Hawk Moth (in "Party Crasher") and Ladybug (in "Miracle Queen") have said that Viperion is one of the most difficult superheroes to be against because of his superpower.

title: Luka Couffaine
text:
Luka Couffaine - Trivia
Luka is the third person to try to resist Akumatization, following Caline Bustier and Chloé Bourgeois, but is unable to prevent it from happening, much like how it happened with Miss Bustier in "Zombizou". However, in "Migration" he was able to resist akumatization by destroying his akumatized object.
Truth is the only villain who still identifies as his civilian identity despite being akumatized, calling himself "Luka Couffaine" in front of Jagged Stone.
Although he could have introduced himself as such to be specific and receive a clear answer from Jagged.
Additionally, this may or may not tie in with his line to Shadow Moth, "I always tell the truth".
As of "Wishmaker", he is the fifth member of the French Miraculous superhero team (and 2nd chronologically) to know Ladybug's civilian identity.
The others are Alya Césaire, Kagami Tsurugi, Félix Fathom and Alix Kubdel (the latter will find out in the future).
He is the 1st of the French Miraculous superhero team to know Cat Noir's civilian identity.
He is also the only member of the French Miraculous superhero team to know both Ladybug and Cat Noir's civilian identities.

title: Luka Couffaine
text:
Luka Couffaine - Trivia
He is the second human to know both Ladybug and Cat Noir's civilian identities, the first being Master Fu, although Fu has forgotten due to his amnesia, making Luka the only person to know both identities.
Unlike other people, both Ladybug and Cat Noir were unaware that Luka had discovered their civilian identities until the events of "Migration". They only knew one of those people they knew and that was the previous guardian, Master Fu.
Following Master Fu and Marinette, Luka is the third person to become a Guardian and Miraculous holder.
So far, Luka, Zoé and Marc are the only members of the French Miraculous superhero team that have not met nor interacted with Lila/Cerise, who in Season 6 onwards becomes the supervillain Chrysalis.
Currently, five characters know Luka is Viperion: Adrien, Marinette, Nathalie, Chloé, and Su-Han.
Adrien was the one who suggested Ladybug give the Snake Miraculous to Luka in "Desperada", and following Adrien's suggestion, Ladybug gave the Snake Miraculous to Luka.
Nathalie and Chloé found out in "Miracle Queen".
Gabriel also found out in "Miracle Queen", but due to him sacrificing himself, he no longer is alive and only five people know.

title: Luka Couffaine
text:
Luka Couffaine - Trivia
Su-Han sees Luka return the Snake Miraculous to Ladybug in "Ephemeral".
Luka is the first and so far the only Miraculous holder known to date who knows Mirakung Fu.
Luka is the first known Miraculous holder to deliberately ask Ladybug to lend him her own Miraculous to resolve a situation.
The way Luka borrows Ladybug's Miraculous is similar to Chrysalis's mental silhouette when she asks the akumatized person to choose their villain name.
Miscellaneous
Internationally, Luka debuted in "Captain Hardrock". However, the episode was released out of order and Luka's actual debut in production order was a background appearance in "Frightningale".
The same happened with Marc Anciel, who originally appeared for the first time in "Reverser".
As shown in "Heart Hunter", Luka works as a pizza delivery guy.
As of "Crocoduel", he's the only member of the Couffaine family who doesn't own a Magical Charm.
He is also the only member of his family to have two akumatized forms, Silencer and Truth.
It is revealed in "Wishmaker" that Luka goes to a different school unlike the other main characters who go to Collège Françoise Dupont.

title: Luka Couffaine
text:
Luka Couffaine - Trivia
He is the eldest of all of his friends as civilians and of the French Miraculous superhero team.
Luka, Alix, Kagami, and Félix, are the only members of the Miraculers who aren't in the Resistance.
In "Miraculous: Paris Under Siege", after André Bourgeois cancelled the Aset exhibition due to the centerpiece being broken, due to the anger at his hard work going to waste he was reakumatized into Truth alongside Lady Wifi, Sole Crusher, and The Bubbler, working with Stormy Weather to take over Paris using Aset's power.
In "Mister Agreste," Luka becomes the first person to discover the truth about Gabriel Agreste being Monarch after his death, besides those who already knew it prior to his passing. He's also the first person Marinette reveals the truth of her lie to, although he doesn't remember it, as Viperbug used the power of the Second Chance to reveal it to him and then rewinded the timeline, erasing the event.

title: Luka Couffaine
text:
Luka Couffaine - Trivia
After him, Rena Rouge also discovered the truth in "Revelator", although she doesn't remember it either, as her memory was erased by Cat Noir. Interestingly, their reactions to discovering the truth were quite different: While Luka was completely surprised and desperate by the revelation, Rena Rouge, in turn, was completely angered by Ladybug's lie, with their relationship even being affected.
It seems pretty clear that Luka's reaction was based on the fact that he knows Adrien is Cat Noir, and that this fact makes the situation even more complicated than Ladybug believes, to the point where he asks her to lend him the Ladybug Miraculous so he can fix everything, though he doesn't reveal to her what he intends to do.
Luka and Alix are the only members of the Miraculers who do not currently live in Paris.

title: Luka's guitar pick
text:
Luka's guitar pick - Appearance
Normal

Necklace

Akumatized

title: Luka's guitar pick
text:
Luka's guitar pick - Trivia

title: Louvre Pyramid
text:
Louvre Pyramid - Intro
The  is a monument in Paris built in the middle of the Napoleonic courtyard of the Louvre Palace in 1989 by Ieoh Ming Pei at the request of President François Mitterrand. Since its inauguration, it has been the main entrance to the famous Louvre Museum.

title: Louvre Pyramid
text:
Louvre Pyramid - Description
The Louvre Pyramid is a transparent laminated glass pyramid composed of 603 rhombuses and 73 triangles. This glass covering is supported by a metal structure of steel and aluminum. It measures 21.64 meters in height, and is 35 meters wide at the base. Being square in shape, the surface area under the pyramid is 1,254 m2, the same size as the Pyramid of Cheops.
On the west side of the pyramid is the entrance to the Louvre Museum, which lights up the Hall Napoléon.
Three 5-meter-high replicas are placed on the sides of the main pyramid, which allows the entrances to the museum's collections to be lit. The whole is surrounded by triangular basins. At night, the Pyramid is lit up by thousands of luminaries.

title: Louvre Pyramid
text:
Louvre Pyramid - Trivia
There is a fourth replica of the Louvre pyramid, called Pyramide Inversée.
This pyramid, 7 meters high, is located inside the Carrousel du Louvre.

it:Piramide del Louvre

title: Louvre Palace/Movie
text:
Louvre Palace/Movie - Intro
The Louvre Palace is a former royal palace located on the right bank of the Seine in Paris, between the Jardin des Tuileries and the church of Saint-Germain l'Auxerrois. It houses the Louvre Museum in the center of the courtyard.

title: Louvre Palace/Movie
text:
Louvre Palace/Movie - Description
The Louvre Palace covers a built area of ​​over 135,000 m2, making it the largest palace in Europe.
Built under the Ancien Régime, the palace was the long-time Royal Residence of the King of France who had it built and renovated over five centuries. It was built on a rectangular plan in Renaissance, Classical and Neoclassical styles, with many internal courtyards, open or closed. The palace has a bright facade and a blue roof.
Access to the Louvre Palace is through several passages. The most important are the Louvre stalls. These are large vaulted openings that allow entry, but also exit, into the interior courtyards of the palace. These stalls directly overlook the Place du Carrousel.
To the west of the square are the Jardin du Carrousel and the Arc de Triomphe du Carrousel, which open onto the Jardin des Tuileries. To the east is the Cour Napoléon. This courtyard is particularly famous for the Louvre Pyramid built in its center, the entrance to the Louvre Museum.

title: Louvre Palace/Movie
text:
Louvre Palace/Movie - Activities
Louvre Museum
The largest museum of art and antiquities in the world, the Louvre is the most visited museum in the world with nearly 10.2 million annual visitors. It is the most visited paid cultural site in France. Among its most famous works are the Mona Lisa, the Venus de Milo, the Red Scribe, the Nike of Samothrace and the Code of Hammurabi.
Decorative Arts
They are a French cultural institution that brings together museums, educational institutions and libraries around the art of living, decorative arts, design, fashion and textiles, advertising and graphics.
At the Louvre Palace, this institution occupies the Rohan and Marsan wings (107 rue de Rivoli). There is the Museum of Decorative Arts, the Museum of Fashion and Textiles, the Museum of Advertising, but also the Library of Decorative Arts.
There are also the Ateliers du Carrousel. They offer several workshops at different levels to learn and improve the techniques of drawing, painting, modeling, etc.
École du Louvre

title: Louvre Palace/Movie
text:
Louvre Palace/Movie - Activities
It is a French higher education institution created in 1882, dependent on the Ministry of Culture. This school offers training in art history, archaeology, epigraphy, history of civilizations, anthropology and museology. It is located in Paris, in the Flore wing of the Louvre Palace.
Research and Restoration Center of the French Museum
Occupying the site of the Carrousel and the Pavillon de Flore, it is the State operator in the field of research and restoration concerning museum collections.
Carrousel du Louvre
It is an underground shopping center located between the Louvre Museum and the Tuileries Garden, under the Pyramide Inversée of the Louvre which forms the roundabout of the Place du Carrousel.
This shopping center is 16,000 m2 and has more than 50 shops and stores.
Paris Expo "Carrousel du Louvre"
These are four rooms dedicated to hosting prestigious events.

title: Loïc Stompet
text:
Loïc Stompet - Intro
is a supporting antagonist in Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir, introduced in season 6. He is a student at Collège Françoise Dupont and also Ray Pugnant's and Nelson de Glusset's friend.
In "Heartfixer", after failing to separate Marinette and Adrien several times, Loïc was voluntarily akumatized, alongside Ray and Nelson, by Chrysalis into Couplewreckers, a trio of supervillains capable of copying the appearance of any person which they photographed.

title: Loïc Stompet
text:
Loïc Stompet - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Loïc has short grey hair on top with black undercut and short bangs, which is cut neatly and styled forward. He has olive skin and two warts on his face. His face is narrow with a defined jawline, straight nose, thin lips, and thick eyebrows. His build is lean and athletic with an average teenage height.
Civilian Attire
He is dressed in a bright yellow T-shirt with a black emblem on the chest, layered under a dark blue padded jacket with orange lining and orange detailing on the sleeves. The jacket is unzipped, leaving the shirt visible. On his wrist, he wears a black band or watch.
As a Couplewrecker

title: Loïc Stompet
text:
Loïc Stompet - Appearance
He wore a dark purple, skin-tight suit with a light pink broken heart emblem on his chest, along with hot pink boots and gloves. The boots extended up to his knees, while the gloves reached his elbows. He also appeared to wear briefs over the suit in the same color as the boots. His hair turned platinum blonde. The tops of the boots and gloves formed a heart shape, and his belt featured the same broken heart emblem as his chest. His skin was light purple, and his eyes turned cerise. He wore a inward pointing mask that extended past his cheekbones, leaving the mouth and the rest of his head exposed with a gradient in the middle — hot pink on top and purple on the bottom. He wore a hot pink cape with an open collar.

title: Loïc Stompet
text:
Loïc Stompet - Personality
Loïc is cocky, sharp-tongued and ruthless, viewing himself as above others. He speaks with confidence and arrogance, constantly trying to outshine the people around him. His bold attitude makes him reckless, and he rarely cares about the fallout of his actions as long as he gets to prove himself right. Alongside Ray and Nelson, he is a willing troublemaker. He actively joined their plan to break Kim and Ondine apart to find entertainment in the drama and conflicts.
As shown at the end of "Sleeping Syren", his composure snaps and he bursts into a childish tantrum when things don't go his way.

title: Loïc Stompet
text:
Loïc Stompet - Abilities
As a Civilian
Being the lackey of his trio with Ray and Nelson, Loïc is good at following out what his friends tell him to do. This includes bullying, spying on and recording others, and driving a boat. (Although it is not known how well he can really drive, considering he was stopped quite quickly by Fury.)
As a Couplewrecker
Whichever image on the phone he clicked on became the person he transformed into, taking on their appearance, voice, and sometimes even mannerisms. He also seemed to posses a certain amount of superhuman agility that persisted when transformed, as he and his companions talked atop the terrarium cupula, a place the majority of regular people wouldn't be able to access with no help, as well as some degree of speed.

title: Loïc Stompet
text:
Loïc Stompet - History
Before Season 6
On the day of Aglaé's return to school, Loïc and his friends met her and learned of her fear of butterflies, and decided to take advantage of it. They left her in the butterfly garden alone, cruelly laughing at her as she panicked. Later, after Aglaé was akumatized into Lady Butterfly from the incident, she sought revenge on the bullies and trapped them in cocoons. They were later freed by Ladybug's magical ladybugs.
Season 6
In, "Sleeping Syren," Loïc was sent by Ray and Nelson to spy and record Ondine’s conversation so they could gather enough information to break up her and Kim. After listening to the recording, The trio played rock paper scissors to decide who was going to be the first to try breaking up Kim and Ondine, which Ray won because he cheated.
After Ray’s failure to separate the couple, Loïc tried to convince Kim to stop speaking to Ondine by telling him he should never touch, talk, or look  at her again because he says so. This ultimately failed as well, and Loïc returned to his friends defeated. Nelson took the lead, convincing Kim that kissing was dangerous, and that led to him unintentionally insulting Ondine and causing her akumatization.

title: Loïc Stompet
text:
Loïc Stompet - History
In the post-end card scene, Loïc destroyed a soda can in frustration from failing to couplewreck Kim and Ondine, but was reassured by Ray that there was still, "plenty of couples to wreck." Before Loïc could finish his next sentence, he was cut off by Fury showing herself atop a lamppost and jumping down towards them.

title: Loïc Stompet
text:
Loïc Stompet - History
In "Grendiaper," Ray, Nelson, and Loïc purposely antagonized the main cast in the beginning of the episode, with Ray littering right in front of them. When asked to pick up his trash, he claimed, "people are paid to do it." and Nelson added, "it creates jobs." The three then waited for Sublime to call for the handicapped elevator, and quickly stepped inside before she had the opportunity to, mockingly laughing at her. Once settled in class, Ray told Nelson to get him a book, and Nelson passed that request onto Loïc, who proceeded to steal one from Sabrina. In baking class, Nelson saw Marinette making a pastry for Adrien, and told Loïc to write a mean message in the pastry box. Zoe attempted to stop him, but was blackmailed into silence by Ray. The three were then called into the principal’s office and threatened with punishment, but none of them were phased. Ray called his father, and the trio left in his helicopter without punishment.

title: Loïc Stompet
text:
Loïc Stompet - History
Later in the episode, Loïc was seen again driving Ray and Nelson on an unauthorized motorboat. They were confronted by Officer Roger, but again, did not care about the threat of punishment. Instead, Nelson dumped a bottle of bubbles into the lake, which covered Roger’s face, and the three boys broke out into hysterical laughter. They were venomed by Fury mid laugh and brought to the top of a roller coaster. Ms. Hound used later used her powers to rescue them, and the trio held eachother in fear before running off into the distance.

title: Loïc Stompet
text:
Loïc Stompet - History
In "Vampigami," Loïc, Nelson, and Ray harass Prem and Rose by stealing a vampire origami he crafted for her, and passing it around out of their reach. They eventually had to stop once Loïc missed, and it fell into a water bucket, allowing Marinette to grab the origami and return it to Prem. Ray and Loïc laughed at them, but Nelson instead apologized, which baffled his friends. He then revealed he was going to give a, "gift" of a two movie tickets to Prem, which confused Ray and Loïc even more. After giving the tickets to Prem, the three waited in the bushes to watch Juleka become slightly jealous of him, because he and Rose were now going to the movies together.
At the end of the episode,  Loïc and his friends are in another bush yet again because they were spying on the people who attended the movie. They witnessed Marinette and Adrien kiss after the show ended, and Loïc was disgusted by it, but Nelson instead seemed the opposite, viewing more couples as more opportunities to cause heartbreak.

title: Loïc Stompet
text:
Loïc Stompet - History
In a flashback during the episode, "Wreckless Driver," he is shown with Nelson and Ray near the school’s butterfly greenhouse. They saw Aglae struggling with a fear of butterflies, and offered to help her get over it by going with her into the garden. Once she was inside, the three cruelly shut the door on her and laughed at her fear. This directly caused Aglae’s akumatization into Lady Butterfly, and she targeted the trio first, trapping them inside of cocoons.
In the present time of the episode, Loïc is sitting with his two friends, eavesdropping on Marinette’s group conversation. Max recommends Aglae therapy, in which Ray interrupts saying, "That sounds so lame. I’d never go."

title: Loïc Stompet
text:
Loïc Stompet - History
In "Heartfixer," Nelson convinced Loïc and Ray to willingly become akumatized into the Couplewreckers. The trio sat in the library and placed two fingers on their phone to summon an akuma. Loïc hardly kept his hand there before becoming frustrated and saying, "This is lame, it’s not working at all!" and quickly being shushed by Nelson. Eventually, the akumatization worked and they begin their plan by taking photos of other students to gain the ability to shapeshift into them. Loïc and Ray disguised as Nino and Marinette, and held hands outside of Adrien’s classroom to make him believe Marinette is cheating on him. When this doesn’t work, Nelson tells the two they need to take things a bit further and kiss in front of Adrien. They reluctantly agree, but Ray forces them to swap roles, disguising himself as Nino and making Loïc play Marinette. He also says they’d only pretend to kiss like in the movies. The kiss successfully convinced Adrien that Marinette was cheating, and they continued with the last part of the plan.

title: Loïc Stompet
text:
Loïc Stompet - History
Loïc disguised as Adrien, Nelson disguised as Sublime, and Ray recorded in disguise as Alya. Loïc pretended to cry and leave her for Sublime in front of an already heartbroken Marinette. After their plan had succeeded, they deakumatized themselves and cheered for the breakup of Adrien and Marinette, mocking her while they watched an akuma head towards her direction.
Once Marinette was deakumatized, she got back together with Adrien, shattering the trio’s victory. Loïc angrily jumped up and down having a tantrum, while Prem’s newly hatched birds took flight, causing him to swat at them and knock his friends over. Loïc falling onto Nelson made him drop his phone off the second story and into a pool of water, destroying it.

title: Loïc Stompet
text:
Loïc Stompet - Relationships
Friends/Allies
Raymond Pugnant and Nelson de Glusset
Loïc is friends with Ray and Nelson, and they are known to cause trouble around and perhaps outside school grounds. While Loïc gets along with them very well and vice versa, he is the lowest of the group's hierarchy and often does much of the menial work for the other two.Chrysalis
In "Heartfixer," Loïc, Ray, and Nelson purposely summoned an akuma and required help from Chrysalis to achieve their plan to break up Marinette and Adrien. Chrysalis agreed to akumatize them, but secretly viewed the three boys as, "incompetents."
Enemies
Fury
When Loïc, Ray, and Nelson were discussing their failure to break up Kim and Ondine, Ray reassured that they would succeed next time, as there were still many couples to break up, to which Fury, who had suddenly appeared before them, said that there would be no next time and attacked them.
In "Grendiaper", after Loïc, Ray, and Nelson were on an unauthorized motorboat on the Seine and disrespected Roger Raincomprix's orders to stop, Fury utilized her Venom and super speed to paralyze the trio and strap them to a moving roller coaster train in the amusement park, in order to teach them a lesson.

title: Loïc Stompet
text:
Loïc Stompet - Relationships
Aglaé
In "Wreckless Driver", it is revealed that on their first day of school, Loïc, Ray, and Nelson decided to mock Aglaé for her fear of butterflies. They pretended to be kind to her but then locked her in the butterfly enclosure. This made Chrysalis sense her negative emotions and akumatize her into Lady Butterfly. When Loïc and his friends tried to escape, the akumatized villain sealed them in cocoons, but they were ultimately rescued by Ladybug.
In "Vampigami", Loïc, Ray, and Nelson took Prem's paper vampire bat. Aglaé was among those who chose to stand up for him, but the trio was too arrogant to back down. When Nelson admitted they had gone too far, Aglaé suggested that they should make amends to Prem.
Marinette Dupain-Cheng
Because Loïc is openly a bully, he and Marinette have a hostile relationship with each other.
In "Vampigami", Loïc, Ray, and Nelson see Marinette and Adrien kissing and very much in love and think that the more couples there are, the more fun it is to break them up, which hints that they are showing interest in targeting Marinette and Adrien's couple as well.

title: Loïc Stompet
text:
Loïc Stompet - Relationships
In "Grendiaper", Ray prevents Zoë from preventing Loïc and Nelson from pranking Marinette by changing her letter to Adrien, which was rude to him. However, they were unable to separate them because Marinette was sincere when she said she didn't write it, and Adrien believed her.
Sabrina Raincomprix/Miss Hound
In "Grendiaper", Ray needed a textbook that he didn't have, so Loïc takes it from Sabrina for him.
When Fury kidnaps the trio and puts them on a fast roller coaster, which scares them, Miss Hound saves them using Fetch and they run away in terror.
Sublime Varlette
In "Vampigami", Loïc, Ray, and Nelson took away the paper vampire bat that Prem made, and this happened in front of his friends, among whom was Sublime, and she told the trio that they should be ashamed of themselves.
In "Grendiaper", Loïc, Ray, and Nelson entered the elevator before Sublime and made fun of her for it, which angered Marinette, but Sublime calmly said that they should "take a walk", and also mentioned that she doesn't pay attention to such moments.
Roger Raincomprix

title: Loïc Stompet
text:
Loïc Stompet - Relationships
In "Grendiaper", Loïc, Ray, and Nelson were riding on the river at night, but Officer Roger tried to stop them because they weren't old enough to drive, to which Nelson claims that Loïc just turned eighteen because he was the one driving it, and then adds shampoo to the water to make Roger foamy, which makes the gang laugh.

title: Loïc Stompet
text:
Loïc Stompet - Etymology
The name "Loic" is of French and Breton origin that means "famous warrior".
The surname "Stompet" is a likely a pun based on the words "stomp it", which alludes to Loic's aggressive and temperamental attitude.

title: Loïc Stompet
text:
Loïc Stompet - Trivia
As of season 6, Loïc, along with Raymond Pugnant and Nelson de Glusset, replaced Chloé Bourgeois, Sabrina Raincomprix, and Lila Rossi as the troublemaking trio of the Collège Françoise Dupont.
Loïc, Ray, Nelson, Jean Duparc, Marc Anciel, Aglaé, Prem and Marinette Dupain-Cheng are the only known students of the Collège Françoise Dupont to have only been akumatized once.
It's unknown if Nelson told the truth or was lying when he said Loïc just turned eighteen. Therefore, it's possible that Loïc is actually in his late teens, making him the oldest of the trio.

title: Lyre
text:
Lyre - Appearance
When used by Viperion, the lyre is forest green with six light green strings running down the middle of it. The Lyre also has light green diamond patterns with black borders on the lower edges resembling snake's scales.
From Season 6 and onwards, the lyre is teal with blue strings, the diamonds are sharper with bright yellow, and the borders on the lower edges are dark blue.
When used by Viperbug, the lyre was brilliant velvet with a cerise tinge, and the diamonds are hot pink with cerise borders on the lower edges.

title: Lyre
text:
Lyre - Abilities
The music played on the Lyre can be used to distract enemies, providing an opportunity for the Snake Miraculous owner's allies to strike. In close combat, it can be used to bind a person's hands in between the strings and can be thrown for long-range attacks. The Lyre can also be used to deflect attacks as seen in "Wishmaker".
In "Ephemeral", it is shown that the Lyre can also be used for communication and it has a detachable earpiece communicator. It also has a digital timer to work in tandem with Second Chance.

title: Lyre
text:
Lyre - Trivia
The Lyre first appeared in concept art of Snake Noir at the 2018 Comic Con Experience panel on December 6, 2018.
The Lyre has six strings and six diamonds on it. This may be because the snake is the sixth animal of the Chinese Zodiac.
The Lyre is the second Miraculous tool to be a musical instrument, following the Fox Miraculous' flute, and followed by the Pig Miraculous' tambourine.
