title: Luka Couffaine/History
text:
Luka Couffaine/History - [[Season 2]]
Luka is first introduced in "Captain Hardrock". He first meets Marinette when she stumbles into his room, carrying a message from his mother to get him ready for the music festival. He startles her by accident and instantly finds this amusing, teasing her for her stuttered reaction. However, upon seeing her embarrassment, apologizes for doing so and claims that he "often makes more sense with [his guitar]". She is marveled by his musical talent and he lets her keep a one of his Jagged Stone guitar picks. Luka takes an immediate liking towards Marinette. Luka and Marinette establish an instant connection, which lasts throughout the episode; they repeatedly glance at each other during band testing.

title: Luka Couffaine/History
text:
Luka Couffaine/History - [[Season 2]]
Luka tests his guitar by strumming a note, but the speaker volume was so loud that it caused damage in the city, hence alerting the police. Officer Roger ordered them to turn down the volume, but Luka's mother refused, insisting that the band be allowed to play any way they wanted as it was the music festival. When he refused, she was akumatized into Captain Hardrock. Both Luka and Juleka were shocked by their mother's akumatization. Luka, along with the other members on the ship, refused to obey her orders, resulting in being chained and held prisoner in the ship's cabin.
With the help of Tikki, Marinette successfully broke the chain restraining her and Luka, setting them free. Once again, Luka is impressed. Upon hearing the captain's footsteps approaching the hold, the two set up a scene: Marinette hid in the drawer of a sliding bed, while Luka acted as bait to lure his akumatized mother away and was recaptured. Later on, he asked a now-transformed Ladybug about Marinette's whereabouts, to which she replied that Marinette was safe and the one that alerted her. Hearing this, Luka compliments Marinette, calling her "unbelievably brave".

title: Luka Couffaine/History
text:
Luka Couffaine/History - [[Season 2]]
After the defeat of Captain Hardrock, Adrien is granted permission to attend the music festival. He trips over a keyboard and gets excited after learning its model number, claiming that he can play it. Luka introduces himself to Adrien and the two forge a friendship.
In "Frozer", Luka accepts Marinette's offer to accompany her to the ice rink with Adrien and Kagami. Once there, he consistently looked after her and guided her on the ice. He appears to be skilled in skating, being able to keep balance while lifting Marinette with ease. The two share a happy moment together despite Marinette's watchful eye over Adrien and Kagami. At the end of the episode, after the akuma was captured and they all had to go home, Luka was not fazed when Marinette wanted to confront Adrien. In fact, he encouraged her to speak with him, despite his obvious feelings for her.
In "Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)", Luka took part in the Paris Rebellion in effort to help Ladybug and Cat Noir defeat Scarlet Moth.

title: Luka Couffaine/History
text:
Luka Couffaine/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Silencer", Luka was practicing with his band and heard that Bob Roth was looking for new talent but soon discovered that it was ploy to steal Marinette's designs and have XY claimed them as his own. He and everyone left for the studio to reason with him, but when Bob Roth refused to negotiate let alone at admit the truth and worst of all threaten Marinette. Luka became so angry that he was akumatized by Hawk Moth into the titular villain, then took XY's voice away and had his eyes set on Bob. Marinette tried to reason with him and not go after his target in the name of revenge. Before Silencer left, he declared his love to her, soon he came across Ladybug and due to Bob's interference, he took her voice too.
Soon he was instructed by Hawk Moth, not to let Ladybug get away and assured him he wouldn't but wanted to have his revenge. Upon searching he admitted that Bob was good at hiding but knew how to flush him out, once he tricked Officer Roger into bringing Bob to him Silencer took his voice away as well. After backing him into a corner, Luka set everything up but was interrupted by a mute Ladybug and Cat Noir and fought against the hero until he noticed that Bob was gone.

title: Luka Couffaine/History
text:
Luka Couffaine/History - [[Season 3]]
Upon, hearing Cat Noir believe that he lost Ladybug, he used her voice to lure him out unaware he was playing into the heroes trap by activating the heroine's Lucky Charm. During a brief fight with Cat Noir he took his voice too, but seeing Ladybug suck his voice into a vacuum cleaner, Luka dropped his guard leading to his helmet being a destroyed and deakumatized coming too he was assured by Ladybug that everything was fine.
Then, heard Bob accused Ladybug of tying him and imprisoning him and as well as hear him boast about admitting what he did to Kitty Section. Leading to him smiling because Bob admitted what they needed to hear and became surprised that Bob actually does give them a chance to perform. But Luka went on stage he was asked by Marinette if he really meant what he said as Silencer, Luka answers that he doesn't remember and yet hoped he didn't say anything bad. When she replied that he didn't; Luka was relieved and unknowingly said the same love confession he admitted to her when he was akumatized before leaving to perform with his band.

title: Luka Couffaine/History
text:
Luka Couffaine/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Party Crasher", Luka was one of the many people invited to the All Boys party for Adrien at the Agreste Mansion. Until Party Crasher disrupted the event, then he and everyone else managed to escape. Seeing Cat Noir in danger he received the Snake Miraculous that, when inhabited by Sass, helped him transform into Viperion and joined him, Pegasus and Carapace to defeat the titular villain and save Ladybug. Setting his power of Second Chance he was ready to fight Party Crasher, but upon seeing Carapace captured he rewind time and tried to save him but ended up captured instead. Soon he was enjoyed by the other heroes until they were all freed by their newest ally King Monkey, following Ladybug's lead and moving with the music the team was able defeat Party Crasher. Afterwards, he returned the Snake Miraculous, helped clean the aftermath of the party and joined the girls at the Seine.
In "Reflekdoll", Luka was playing his guitar and heard his sister Juleka doubt herself about having the potential to be a model or taking Marinette's offer for modeling in her upcoming website despite that he still encouraged her to try.

title: Luka Couffaine/History
text:
Luka Couffaine/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Desperada", Luka was playing music for his friends on his family's houseboat and attempted to teach Marinette, then noticed Kagami and Adrien coming in surprised as everyone else that they were here. Upon hearing his mother, he was surprised to see Jagged Stone at their houseboat and even more so along with Juleka that Jagged and their mom had a history together. And yet, his mother refused knowing that he had a habit of firing his guitarists, and soon Vivica arrived akumatized as Desperada and soon was under fire. After saving Adrien, they both found a place to hide and was thanked for the save but noticing that Ladybug was alone he wondered where Cat Noir was but with Adrien believing that he wouldn't make in time.

title: Luka Couffaine/History
text:
Luka Couffaine/History - [[Season 3]]
Luka decided to help the heroine by distracting the villain by playing his guitar and yet was under fire again but saved by Adrien. Soon the boys followed Ladybug into the sewers where he was scalded by the hero but thanked for the save. After seeing the heroine summoned her Lucky Charm and received a gong he was curious to know what she was going to do with it. Before she left Ladybug asked if she could borrow his guitar and Luka was surprised that knew how to play as well as followed her instructions to find a place to hide.

title: Luka Couffaine/History
text:
Luka Couffaine/History - [[Season 3]]
Luka took Adrien's suggestion to hide the storage room locker while he found another place and hoped that his friend would stay safe. Afterwards, he was found by Ladybug and Cat Noir asking if they defeated Desperada and where Adrien was but heard from Cat Noir if he was hiding somewhere then he'd would find him. Having enough of waiting, Luka went off to find Adrien and ran into him with Ladybug relieved he was safe. Upon seeing Ladybug kiss him and heard being recommended for something Luka wondered if he missed something, then was offered the Snake Miraculous by Ladybug under the agreement that it must be returned after the mission. Wanting to save his friends and family he agreed to help and was greeted by his kwami Sass who helped him transform.

title: Luka Couffaine/History
text:
Luka Couffaine/History - [[Season 3]]
He met up with Cat Noir introducing himself as Viperion; when he heard the cat's playful banter about starting with a horseshoe for good luck he calmly replied that Ladybug had enough luck for both of them. Following the heroine's lead, they took away the villainess' vantage point and was tasked with preventing Desperada from playing her instruments. Agreeing he set his power in motion, while rewinding the clock to save his allies he tried to figure out a way to defeat Desperada. During his third use of Second Chance he saw that she gets distracted by music and rewinds time once more. This time he takes the lead by acting as the distraction with his lyre. By using a saddle to restrain the villainess the trio managed to defeat her and save everyone. Afterwards Luka returned the Snake Miraculous to Ladybug thanking her for trusting him. Then, he returned to home and played along with Jagged Stone and his friends.

title: Luka Couffaine/History
text:
Luka Couffaine/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Cat Blanc", in an alternate reality Luka was seen playing music on his family's houseboat as Marinette and Adrien danced together. However, due to certain "secrets" being unveiled leading to Cat Noir's akumatization, he and everyone on the planet were destroyed, but thanks to Ladybug changing the past, so did the future.
In "Félix", he supported Marinette and her friends decision in wanting to send Adrien a video care package, after everyone makes their videos he went below deck to play his guitar. Then, he heard Marinette rant on in fear about being rejected and makes himself known to her aware of her crush on Adrien he fully supported her if they ended up together. As well as be here for her if she and Adrien didn't work out hearing Marinette say that Adrien replied they decided to listen to his message but became shocked that "Adrien", said those terrible things. He agreed with Marinette that their friend wouldn't say those things, afterwards Luka along with Juleka and Rose received a thank you video from the real Adrien.

title: Luka Couffaine/History
text:
Luka Couffaine/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Heart Hunter", Luka was working on his song for Marinette and bike rode to her house to let her hear a sample but hearing her say that she had to hurry to the Le Grand Paris hotel Luka gave her a ride. However, sometime later, he came across Marinette again asking if she was okay and sadly saw that she wasn't. Hearing her voice out her frustrations about not being her true self around one and Luka says that she can always be herself around him, as well as telling him anything or nothing as he embraced her.
In "Miracle Queen", afterwards Luka was still aware that Marinette still had feelings for Adrien but their moment was ruined with a swarm of hornets coming for them and he protected Marinette. Then was instructed by the titular villain to come to her by following Miracle Queen's command to transform taking the Snake Miraculous turning into Viperion and used his powers against the heroes. Until Dragon Bug and Cat Noir managed to retrieve his Miraculous and after Miracle Queen was defeated he and the others were set free. Spending time at the Seine Luka was asked by Marinette to play his song for her which he does on his guitar.

title: Luka Couffaine/History
text:
Luka Couffaine/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Truth", Luka is over at Marinette's house to pick her up for their date to watch Jagged Stone's movie at the movie theaters. Playing a mini trivia game with Marinette on their way to their seats. Though when they are about to kiss, it is interrupted by an akumatized Mr. Pigeon, leading to Marinette having to abruptly leave to go fight off the villain.
Once the battle with Mr. Pigeon is complete, Marinette rushes back to the theater where Luka stayed, only to come back to the movie finishing up. Later, Luka and Marinette are found getting ice cream at Andre's ice cream stand, but as Marinette sees Lollipop Boy she immediately leaves to go defeat the threat. The next day, after school, Marinette and Luka begin to leave on Luka's bike until Marinette sees an akuma passing by, causing her to pause their bike ride and leave Luka.

title: Luka Couffaine/History
text:
Luka Couffaine/History - [[Season 4]]
Following, on the Couffaine Boat Luka dedicates a song to Marinette, although she is not there on time to witness it, which leads to Luka running out of patience. After the Kitty Section performance, Luka tells Marinette that he never knew his father since he was born and that he would like to know where Marinette disappears to. When Marinette explains that she can't tell him the truth, Luka's heart shatters from not being trustworthy enough for Marinette to tell him the truth. Causing him to transform into Truth along with gaining a Sentimonster, Lighteye.

title: Luka Couffaine/History
text:
Luka Couffaine/History - [[Season 4]]
As Truth, he uses his powers to try to find out Marinette's secret from her friends but they each answer that she's in love with Adrien. When he strikes his mother, he asks about the identity of his father and learns Jagged Stone is his father. After a brief but interrupted fight with Ladybug and Cat Noir, Truth locates Jagged stone and once more hears confirmation that the rock star is his father and his reason for staying away was because he felt his career causing him to travel so much prevented him from being a proper father to the twin siblings. Truth once more battles against Ladybug and Cat Noir when he moved the fight to Marinette's home as he continued to learn her truth.
Ladybug and Cat Noir are able to stop him and free Luka from the akuma. Later, Luka hears Marinette tell that she can't tell him everything about her at the time but Luka accepts that she is not ready to let him in but will wait until she is. As he heads home, Luka finds Jagged waiting for him. After sharing a hug, Luka accepts his father's offer to create songs together to begin a family bond.
In "Lies", Luka is seen leaving the bridge as Adrien runs to get ice cream with Kagami.

title: Luka Couffaine/History
text:
Luka Couffaine/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Gang of Secrets", Juleka tells her friends that Luka is still upset about Marinette breaking up with him and shows them a photo of him looking very sad.
In "Crocoduel", With Luka still heartbroken about Marinette not being here after the events. Their friends suggest plans to get Luka and Marinette to be friends again, finally deciding on the idea of having the twin's birthday party here at the houseboat.

title: Luka Couffaine/History
text:
Luka Couffaine/History - [[Season 4]]
Later after Juleka's talk with Marinette, Juleka goes to Luka on the boat and begins telling him that Marinette is coming to their birthday party but she doesn't want Luka to be there. But as Luka's eyes sparkle in joy as Juleka even mentions that Marinette is coming, Juleka nervously ends the conversation. Luka starts to feel that Juleka is sad but as he starts to ask her, they are interrupted by Jagged Stone who comes in through the window, who originally wanted to meet Luka. Both of them start to discuss about music, letting Juleka go by unnoticed. While they are talking, Anarka appears and interrupts their conversation to get Jagged off the boat because she doesn't want outsiders. Luka asks if Jagged can also come to the birthday party but Anarka claims she'd only allow it if Juleka approves as well.
Later when the party is taking place, as Luka attempts to greet Marinette, Marinette runs off claiming she has something urgent to take care of. With Luka feeling that Marinette doesn't like him anymore and that she doesn't want to be friends with him, Luka sadly sits back and strums sad music on his guitar.

title: Luka Couffaine/History
text:
Luka Couffaine/History - [[Season 4]]
As an Akuma makes its way to akumatize Luka, the friend group comes to accompany Luka and cheers him up. With his negative emotions vanished, the akuma is ordered to stay at the party to find another victim
In "Optigami, Luka is found trying to escape Style Queen, who has been akumatized once again, along with Wayhem in a vent. But is then immediately turned to glitter once Style Queen finds them.
In "Wishmaker", Luka was attending the Paris Careers Expo event to run his school's booth of crafting stringed instruments. Later, after Marinette arrives and speaks with André about how he decided he wanted to sell ice cream, Andre then lends Marinette an ice cream to share with Luka even if they aren't in love. Luka is told by Marinette that she thought he already knew what he wanted to, which Luka then explains his purpose at the event. As the two teens approach Luka's booth, Luka grabs one of the guitars to play some music and asks Marinette why she's there.

title: Luka Couffaine/History
text:
Luka Couffaine/History - [[Season 4]]
After Marinette explains that she doesn't know what she wants to do, she then begins to compliment Luka about how great it is that he knows what he wants to do. Luka starts to hand over the guitar to Marinette but is interrupted by Alec, who mocks Luka by stating that it'd be easier for folks to just download a guitar app to play music, immediately masters playing music on the app and claims that Luka's job is useless. Luka, unbothered, takes a guitar and tells Marinette, Alec and the cameraman to follow him outside to the Île aux Cygynes. While there, the cameraman films Luka once he raises the guitar as the wind blows, closes his eyes and lets the strings produce music.
When Wishmaker begins forcing people to live their dreams, Ladybug seeks Luka's help as Viperion to fix the issue at hand and to keep her and Cat Noir from having their identities exposed. During several resets, Luka is stunned to discover that Marinette is Ladybug and Adrien is Cat Noir. However, he is able to help Ladybug solve the Lucky Charm riddle and restore everything back to normal and lies to Ladybug that no one learned the heroes real identities.

title: Luka Couffaine/History
text:
Luka Couffaine/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Ephemeral", Luka and the nine other heroes were assisting Ladybug in defeating the villain, after the battle, Ladybug took back every Miraculous except the Snake Miraculous as they were interrupted by the celestial guardian.
Su-Han suddenly showed up, and tells Ladybug that she has to find out who hides behind the cat mask or she'll have to fight him.
Both destransform, Marinette tells Luka, that they could not tell each other their identities because Shadow Moth could take advantage of one of them.
She says that someone can know one of them, but definitely not both.
Unknown to Marinette, Luka knew both due to the events of Wishmaker.
Ladybug's plan was for her to ask Cat Noir his real identity, but Luka insisted that he could do it, but Ladybug objected by saying that Cat Noir will only tell it to her.
She told Luka to rewind the time when their timers hit 1:05 or he'll lose he won't be able to go back in time anymore.
While Ladybug was standing on the Eiffel Tower, Luka worried that he won't tell it to her, but Ladybug reassured him by saying that he wanted to do it for a long time now.

title: Luka Couffaine/History
text:
Luka Couffaine/History - [[Season 4]]
Unfortunately, when Cat Noir revealed himself to be Adrien Agreste, Ladybug confused and mesmerized, forgot to tell Luka to rewind the time, Luka worried, hoped that Ladybug knows what she's doing.
Later on, Marinette and Adrien are discovered to be Ladybug and Cat Noir by Gabriel who successfully steals their miraculous to make his wish. Before she de-transformed, Ladybug was able to send a message to Luka that Sass is hiding in her sewing box. Luka wastes no time in hurrying to the bakery and tells Sass about Marinette's message just before Gabriel makes his wish and the changes begin taking place. With no time to lose, Luka urges Sass to return to the past when the latest Second Chance was set to warn Ladybug and Cat Noir.
In "Penalteam", when Chloe is akumatized into Penalty and forms the Penalteam, Luka is given the Snake Miraculous to participate in the game to stop her. Unfortunately, he is one of those touched by Penalty's cleats and is imprisoned. Unable to use his Second Chance ability, he is forced to watch the game take place until Ladybug's team eventually succeeded.

title: Luka Couffaine/History
text:
Luka Couffaine/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)", he is briefly seen being shocked from Monarch's message that he captured all the other Miraculouses from Ladybug.

title: Luka Couffaine/History
text:
Luka Couffaine/History - Season 5
In "Determination", Luka teams up with Kagami to help Marinette confess her feelings to Adrien. They arrange a trip to the wax museum and manage to lock Marinette and Adrien in the Heroes Hall to talk things out.
His wax statue of him as Viperion is brought to life to attack Ladybug and Cat Noir.
In "Migration", Luka tries to act as a neutral help to everyone regarding concerns and secrets they cannot express, firstly with Marinette who questions how Luka was able to love her in the first place. Luka explains that he feels Marinette didn't break his heart like she believes and instead feels like his heart was enriched by their time together and he has been able to create beautiful songs because of it.
With Marinette in a better mood, Luka is right away sought for by Adrien when he pretends one of the keys on his keyboard isn't working properly. Hearing Adrien's concern about Marinette hiding part of herself, Luka says how he himself is different depending on who he is around but that each version is still the real Luka but it still means they can be good friends. Relieved, Adrien thanks Luka for his help and friendship.

title: Luka Couffaine/History
text:
Luka Couffaine/History - Season 5
As soon as Adrien is gone, Jagged Stone appears in the window with the false claim he needs help with a guitar pick. Hearing Jagged want to be a better father to him and Juleka, Luka makes it clear that they are all aware that there is no expectation of Jagged and Anarka getting back together and that the best thing Jagged can do is simply spend time with them.
Grateful for his son's advice, Jagged has to hastily retreat when Penny is heard calling for him. Luka offers help to her when Penny vents how Jagged's chaotic and immature personality is threatening his music but still finds herself loving him more and more. Luka states that her unknown reasons are how she knows she loves Jagged and should just be happy at how happy he makes her.

title: Luka Couffaine/History
text:
Luka Couffaine/History - Season 5
Bob Roth then interrupts things and tries to sign Kitty Section into a contract but Anarka is openly cautious of letting the deal go through and tosses Bob off the boat for the second time. Luka advices his mother to give people a second chance so she won't be so angry. Bob again tries to sign the group and Luka agrees with his bandmates to sign despite earlier uncertainty. However, in true Bob fashion, he goes back on the deal instantly and fires everyone but Luka whom, since earlier learning of his relation to Jagged, he wants to make the new face of music since Jagged isn't bringing in money like he used to.
In his guilt of what has happened, Luka is nearly akumatized into Silencer, but Monarch hesitates when he senses Luka knows the real identities of Ladybug and Cat Noir. Resisting Monarch's offer before the secrets are revealed, Luka destroys his akumatized guitar and vows to never make music again if it means Bob ending the contract.

title: Luka Couffaine/History
text:
Luka Couffaine/History - Season 5
When Bob is turned into Gold Record and starts turning his friends into records that reveal their inner thoughts and feelings, Luka makes things convenient for Marinette and Adrien to transform but heavily implies to Adrien that he knows he's Cat Noir. As Cat Noir distracts Gold Record, Ladybug gets Luka somewhere safe but momentarily tunes him out about his concern of sharing his secrets until he makes her acknowledge he knows who she and Cat Noir really are. He eases her panic about this by assuring her he trusts her to find a solution and goes off to distract Gold Record. Sacrificing himself to become a record as part of Ladybug's plan, Luka nearly sings the identities of Ladybug and Cat Noir, but Gold Record is changed back before it happens.
With Bob and his contracts dealt with, Luka reveals to the others that he knows who Ladybug and Cat Noir are and that it would be too risky for him to stay in Paris since Monarch sensed he knows this information. Anarka is understandably cautious of letting Luka leave since he is so young but when Jagged arrives and explains he tore up his contract and is willing to look after Luka, Anarka agrees and Luka leaves Paris.

title: Luka Couffaine/History
text:
Luka Couffaine/History - Season 5
At some point during his stay in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, Luka met Irupé and befriended her.
In Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2), Luka is revealed to have joined the Order of the Guardians and learned the special martial arts under the celestial guardian Su-Han. He put these new abilities to use when people turned into Miraculized attacked the group in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. When Su-Han has a nightmare, Luka tells him not to let it affect him. Thanks to Bunnyx providing a way back to Paris, Luka and the group head back to Paris just as their friends are nearly attacked, but they too are quickly overwhelmed. He protected himself when Lady Dragon was Venomed by them en masse. When surrounded by a group of them, Luka has a nightmare. After the fight ends, Luka is seen playing his guitar with his father at Adrien's pool party at his mansion. Later, returning home, Luka finds he was left the Snake Miraculous permanently and he is last seen with the other Miraculous holders.

title: Luka Couffaine/History
text:
Luka Couffaine/History - Before Season 6
Luka, still in love with Marinette, decided to leave for Brazil again, afraid that his feelings for her would turn the joy he felt about seeing her and Adrien together into jealousy and ruin their friendship. He sat with her by the Seine, trying to hand the Snake Miraculous back because he would have to leave again since there was a new butterfly villain and he still knew Ladybug and Cat Noir's identities, but she refused. He then transformed into Viperion and began to explain his reasoning, activating Second Chance before revealing the truth, then apologizing before going back to the point where he revealed that there was more to his decision to leave, telling Marinette that he met an awesome girl in Brazil.
At some point, Luka asked Irupé to be his pretend girlfriend to put up his lie about having found a girl, letting her know the truth regarding his feelings for Marinette.

title: Luka Couffaine/History
text:
Luka Couffaine/History - [[Season 6]]
In "El Toro De Piedra", Luka showed up on a projected screen through video call to rehearse remotely with his electric guitar from a beach in Rio de Janeiro for Kitty Section's song for Caline Bustier. Facing connection issues, he suggested his bandmates to look for new talent in Paris. Later, on a video call with Juleka, he supported his sister's suggestion for her to sing acoustic.
In "Vampigami", he was video called by Juleka when she was feeling insecure about Rose going to the movies with Prem, aggravated by her brother's distance. He tried to comfort her, reassuring that he was still there to talk regardless and still had Rose around, but she was too distressed to listen and hung up on him. Concerned, Luka called Rose to ask what happened.
In "Mister Agreste", Luka was giving Marinette a guitar lesson through video call. Noticing her distress, he encouraged her to talk to him about what was troubling her. After she said she'd go personally talk to him and ended the call, Luka refused Irupé's offer to grab an açaí bowl for breakfast, recalling the moment he tried to confess to Marinette that he still had feelings for her.

title: Luka Couffaine/History
text:
Luka Couffaine/History - [[Season 6]]
When Cosmobug arrived and turned back into Ladybug, Luka was dragged by her to a secluded spot, asking to borrow his miraculous. After she fused the Ladybug and Snake Miraculouses to become Viperbug and activated Second Chance, he encouraged her to tell what was going on. As she revealed the truth about Monarch's identity, Luka was in shock, and, in a hurried panic, asked for her earrings, revealing that he knew things she didn't, that he loved her and needed to be the one to protect her. Before he could say more, she rewound and handed his miraculous back, hugging Luka before leaving.

title: Magical Charms
text:
Magical Charms - Intro
The  are a set of anti-akumatization charms created by the current Ladybug Miraculous holder: Ladybug with the leftover magic from the akumas she purifies. Their purpose is to prevent future akumatizations of previously transformed victims.

title: Magical Charms
text:
Magical Charms - Appearance
The Magical Charms are small, round, and modeled after a ladybug's shell with a string attached to the top. Each individual charm is unique, taking on the coloration and designs of their recipient's akumatized form. The string can be extended to an unknown length, allowing the charm to be worn as a necklace or tied to clothing.

title: Magical Charms
text:
Magical Charms - Creation
Once the holder of the Ladybug Miraculous captures and purifies an akuma, its essence can be converted into a Magical Charm. The object is taken out of the holder's yo-yo and given to the previously akumatized recipient. The akuma essence is essential for the creation of a Charm; it cannot be made without it. Due to this, a Charm cannot be created if the akuma purifies itself when it is rejected (or removed by the Butterfly holder themself).  Additionally, multiple Charms can be created from the essence of a single akuma - their amount depends on how many people were transformed into supervillains in a single akumatization.

title: Magical Charms
text:
Magical Charms - Abilities
When worn, the Magical Charms prevents the Butterfly Miraculous holder from akumatizing a person again. The Butterfly Miraculous wielder can still sense the negative emotions of a person in possession of a Charm, as well as send akumas to them. However, once the akuma gets close to an object it wants to infect, a transluscent pink force field will manifest around it, blocking the butterfly. This field will also purify it.
A new ability of the Magical Charms is unveiled in "Confrontation". The Magical Charms react to emotions - they start glowing once their owner feels empowered by emotional strength from others and lose power if their mood worsens. Once the person with the Charm gains enough positivity, the object expands into a large shield, one capable of purifying and warding away Megakumas upon contact. After purifying the Megakuma, the Magical Charm shield will revert back to its original form. It is unknown if this would work on Ultrakumas.

title: Magical Charms
text:
Magical Charms - Weaknesses
For a Magical Charm to work, it has to be worn at all times by its recipient.
In "Dearest Family", Shadow Moth boosts his own powers and gains the ability to create Megakumas, which can break through the barrier of the Magical Charms. Magical Charms are ineffective against Megakumas without transforming into shields and even those created from the essence of a Megakuma can't protect their owners from them.

title: Magical Charms
text:
Magical Charms - Trivia
For a time, Shadow Moth was unaware of the Magical Charms. In "Queen Banana" he didn't understand why he couldn't akumatize Chloé Bourgeois a second time. Later in "Gabriel Agreste" he becomes aware of them and obtains one from his sentimonster clone.
The Magical Charms bear a resemblance to the mini Ladybug charm Alya keeps on her phone. Given that Alya is Marinette/Ladybug's best friend, and that she indirectly helped her create them, it's possible that this is deliberate, if subconscious inspiration on Ladybug's part.
In "Kuro Neko", "Perfection", "El Toro De Piedra" and "Wreckless Driver", Ladybug may have given August, Rythm, Xavier Ramier, Raúl Bruel and Aglaé Magical Charms off-screen.
As of "Riginarazione", seven characters have received replacement Magical Charms: Sabine, Roland, André, Kagami, Tomoe, Juleka and Gina. Roland, Kagami, Tomoe and Gina are also the first to have more than one Magical Charm design, while Sabine, André and Juleka received Charms with the same design.

title: Magical Charms
text:
Magical Charms - Trivia
It's unknown whether the Magical Charms protect their owners from Amokization, as all of Shadow Moth's victims who have been amokized and own a Magical Charm, were also akumatized when receiving it (Chloé in "Queen Banana", Mayor Bourgeois in "Mega Leech", and Juleka in "Guiltrip").
However, in "Representation", Argos was able to manifest an amok into Kagami's ring. It's unknown whether Kagami had a Magical Charm with her at the time.
Chloé has refused a magical charm for the second time in "Queen of the Dreadzone".
It's also unknown if the Magical Charms also prevent Kamikotization (the good version of akumatization). Since kamikos have a benevolent nature, it's possible they are able to bypass the Magical Charm's protection and/or strengthen it.
Of the Miraculers, six members have their own Magical Charms: Zoé, Nino, Kim, Kagami, Sabrina, and Juleka.
It's unclear whether Chrysalis' ultrakumas can be affected by the Magical Charms created against Shadow Moth/Monarch's megakumas, as in "Daddycop" and "Riginarazione", Sabrina and Gina's charms weren't shown being destroyed at the beginning of their akumatizations.

title: Magical Charms
text:
Magical Charms - Trivia
It's unclear what happens with a magical charm if its owner passes away, such as Roland in "Riginarazione".
Chloé is the only character whose magical charm is in the possession of another person.
It is unknown if there are negative counterparts to Magical Charms much like how Akumas are the negative counterparts to Kamikos. If there are, then their purpose when used by an evil Ladybug Miraculous holder would be to prevent any future Kamikotizations.
The purpose of the Magical Charms seems to have changed overtime. In seasons 4 and 5, Ladybug gave the Magical Charms to people so they wouldn't get akumatized again but in seasons 6, she gives them to remind the person previously akumatized that there are better ways to handle their emotional crisis. The reason for this is most likely because Ultrakumas can completely bypass a magical charm.
It is unknown if someone would still be protected from an akumatization if they possessed a Magical Charm that isn't their own.

Luka's room
Luka's room has two walls, one in beige color and the other being covered with a blue and beige wallpaper. On the first, a white canvas with flowers and a small checkered frieze above a red part. title: Luna Park des Tuileries
text:
Luna Park des Tuileries - Intro
The  is an amusement park that takes place every summer inside the Jardin des Tuileries, in the 1st arrondissement of Paris.

title: Luna Park des Tuileries
text:
Luna Park des Tuileries - Description
The Luna Park des Tuileries takes place in the summer on the Esplanade des Feuillants of the Jardin des Tuileries and is accessible from the Place de la Concorde and the rue de Rivoli. It is a family amusement park with 60 attractions. Bumper cars, ice palaces, ghost trains, roller coasters, a ferris wheel and other attractions and games of skill allow Parisians and tourists to have fun.
Like any amusement park, the Luna Park des Tuileries offers numerous food stands to satisfy visitors.
Being an amusement park located in the heart of the city and to respect the tranquility of the Jardin des Tuileries, the Luna Park des Tuileries does not have a sound system.

title: Luna Park des Tuileries
text:
Luna Park des Tuileries - Trivia
Admission to the Luna Park des Tuileries is free, with paid rides.
The Luna Park des Tuileries is accessible to people with disabilities (motor, mental, visual and hearing).
In fact, since summer 2019, the Luna Park des Tuileries has housed the Roue de Paris which was formerly installed on the Place de la Concorde.
This change is due in particular to legal problems between the Paris City Hall and the owner of the Roue de Paris, who is also one of the organizers of the Luna Park des Tuileries.
Some rides, including the Roue de Paris, are being reinstalled for the Tuileries Christmas Market which takes place in the same location.

title: Manon Chamack
text:
Manon Chamack - Intro
is a minor character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She is the daughter of Nadja Chamack, and is a girl that Marinette babysits. Starting from season 6, she is a student at Collège Françoise Dupont.
In "The Puppeteer", after being accused by her mother of stealing one of Marinette's dolls, even though it had actually been lent to her, Hawk Moth akumatized her into the Puppeteer, a body-controlling supervillain who could control anyone whom she controlled the doll of.
In "The Puppeteer 2", after feeling ignored during a visit to Musée Grévin and thinking that nobody wanted to play with her, she was reakumatized by Hawk Moth into the Puppeteer, possessing even stronger abilities than before.

title: Manon Chamack
text:
Manon Chamack - Appearance
Physical Appearance

Civilian Attire
She wears a white t-shirt with rolled-up sleeves about the elbows, light violet rolled-up denim overalls with a purple belt around the waist and a light purple and magenta flower pattern, and red Mary Jane dress shoes with black soles.
As Puppeteer

title: Manon Chamack
text:
Manon Chamack - Appearance
Puppeteer's skin was blue-violetish gray, and her eyes were strong orange with vivid fuchsia sclerae. Her hair was black, the tips of her ponytails pale, light grayish cerulean with long white spikes sticking out of each. She wore a black mask over her eyes. She also wore a black turtlenecked fairy dress, light cyan V-necked sleeveless blouse with pale, light grayish cerulean design and two points at the skirt top, and matching butterfly sleeves with black edges over black puff sleeves at her shoulders with light brilliant arctic blue zigzag ends. Long, black, fingerless gloves adorned her hands. On her legs and feet, she had black stockings and shoes that are connected to them. Her wand was black with a black star at the end. The tip of the handle and the tips of the points of the star were light arctic blues.

title: Manon Chamack
text:
Manon Chamack - Personality
Manon is rambunctious, energetic, kind, stubborn, exuberant, hyperactive, and naïve. She loves to have fun, but she doesn't like it when people don't keep their promises or are being unfair — whether it's in her eyes or it's true. She's also a bit capricious, getting angry when she doesn't get what she wants, and she can be disobedient at times to her mother or her babysitter. She sometimes tries to use baby doll eyes to win others over, although it doesn't always work, while she gets emotional about things she doesn't like, over time, she usually recovers from it in normal circumstances.
Manon is shown to be very brave, independent, and courageous when she participated in the Paris Rebellion in "Mayura".
Even though Manon and her friends love to play, she knows that there are times to be serious. In "Simpleman", upon seeing Ladybug and Cat Noir acting like her age and fighting so poorly to the point of them giving up their Miraculouses, she knew what would happen if Shadow Moth got them so she and friends came up with a plan to defeat the titular villain.

title: Manon Chamack
text:
Manon Chamack - Personality
Like Ladybug and Cat Noir, she can also be understanding towards others like Roland, when he admitted that he was having a hard time adapting to things that are new.
As Puppeteer, she was greedier, arrogant, and less controlled, wanting things to go the way she believed they should. While smart with how to use her puppets, she still thought and acted like her young age. She was impatient and threw fits of anger when searching for the dolls.
Although she is childish, she can be serious sometimes.

title: Manon Chamack
text:
Manon Chamack - Abilities
As a Civilian
If Manon wants something very badly, like a balloon or doll, she is skilled at using her "baby doll eyes" expression to attempt and convince a person. As seen in "Stormy Weather", Manon is very fast for someone her age being able to outrun Marinette for a while and can be pretty stealthy.
As Puppeteer
Puppeteer unleashed a glowing pale, light grayish cerulean energy from her wand at a doll representing a person. As the doll rose into the air, she zapped it again, commanding it to come to life. The person the doll was based on became her real-life puppet, which she controlled in a manner similar to how voodoo dolls function. With this power, Puppeteer could even speak through the doll, causing the real person to say the same words. The puppet's actions and movements could either be directed by Puppeteer herself or conveyed to them as commands, which they would follow without her direct control.

title: Manon Chamack
text:
Manon Chamack - Abilities
A unique aspect of her abilities was that if the doll represented a person's akumatized villain form, she could transform the individual back into the villain with another wave of glowing pale, light grayish cerulean energy. This process would restore all of their powers, but they would still retain their weaknesses; for example, Lady Wifi's powers were negated when Cat Noir destroyed the Wi-Fi antenna on top of the bakery.
Puppeteer had the ability to fly and hover. She also utilized telekinesis to keep the puppets floating and moving alongside her after they were zapped.
In "Gamer 2.0", although she only possessed a doll of Cat Noir, Puppeteer was able to maintain control over Copycat as well. It is possible that the doll was intended to represent Copycat instead.
In "The Puppeteer 2", her powers expanded, allowing her to bring wax figures to life and control them using her wand, even animating only parts of them. Any wax figure representing someone with superpowers would acquire those same powers.

title: Manon Chamack
text:
Manon Chamack - Relationships
Family
Nadja Chamack
Manon loves her mother deeply, and she usually obeys her. Despite this, she doesn't always like it when her mother doesn't allow her to do what she wants. In "Prime Queen", Manon wishes her mother the best of luck when working on her tv show with Ladybug and Cat Noir.
In "Gamer 2.0", Manon spends time with her mother at the park and they embrace each other after Ladybug returns everything to normal.
Friends/Allies
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/Ladybug
Manon enjoys Marinette as a babysitter, but she doesn't always like to obey Marinette's requests or respect her actions. She is willing to use her baby-doll eyes on Marinette if she wants something badly enough, and she is upset when Marinette wins while they are playing dolls. However, she doesn't have any bad intentions towards her, and she will agree with her ideas in particular cases. She even attends Marinette's birthday party in "Befana" with Marinette's other friends. During "The Puppeteer 2", she comes with Marinette and her friends to the wax museum beginning to suspect that Marinette and Adrien are boyfriend and girlfriend.

title: Manon Chamack
text:
Manon Chamack - Etymology
The name Manon is of French origin and is a diminutive of Marie, derived from the Hebrew Miryam, traditionally interpreted as "beloved" or "lady".
In the Serbian and Croatian dubs, her name is changed to Mia.
In the Irish dub, her name is changed to Máire.
In the Slovene dub, her name is changed to Moni.

title: Manon Chamack
text:
Manon Chamack - Trivia
Manon was the youngest character to be akumatized in season 1.
As of season 2, she is the second youngest character, after August in "Gigantitan" took that title.
According to "Peril in Paris", a chapter book adaptation of "Stormy Weather", Manon was four during the events of the episode.
According to Wilfried Pain, if a person's doll is brought to life and the person is halfway across the world, the person will still become a puppet and still try to make their way to the Puppeteer.
Also according to Pain, despite missing the Ladybug doll and not being at full power, Puppeteer can be considered the strongest supervillain in the first season, especially if she had reached her true potential of obtaining all the dolls.
Puppeteer is the only villain who knew Hawk Moth wanted the Ladybug and Cat Miraculous before the first time she was akumatized.
Like August's mother and other minor characters, several background characters are recolors of Manon's model, with differences in hair, eye, and skin color.
In "Prime Queen", it's revealed she is ticklish.
In "Gamer 2.0", Puppeteer returns as a playable akumatized villain as part of the Gamer 2.0's powers.

title: Majestia Issue 56
text:
Majestia Issue 56 - Intro
Majestia Issue #56 is the 56th issue of the Majestia comic book series from Quantic Comics.

title: Majestia Issue 56
text:
Majestia Issue 56 - Appearance
Majestia Issue #56 is laid out as a traditional 6.625 inch print comic book as seen in mass market or "pulp" retail markets. The cover has a golden title with a thick red outline on the top, and the red corner box to the left includes the Quantic Comics logo, the issue number in a white square, and the comic's price in euros. The bar code is in the bottom right corner, all elements corresponding to the comic industry-standard layout.
The cover art is Majestia with a generic city background, which appears to be a photo manipulation. Majestia has blonde pixie cut hair and blue eyes.  Her costume is a modern design with full pants and a coattail style cape; though the suit's red, blue, and gold color scheme strongly recalls traditional American comic book superheroes, particularly Wonder Woman, with the prominent gold chest design and boots.

title: Majestia Issue 56
text:
Majestia Issue 56 - Trivia
The comic book cover was released as a teaser by Thomas Astruc for a future episode.
Which happened to be "Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)".
Quantic Comics is a reference to the Quantic Universe.
Majestia's appearance is very similar to that of Wonder Woman, Power Girl, Supergirl and the Carol Danvers incarnation of Ms. Marvel.
Thomas described Majestia as a "fusion between Superman and Wonder Woman."
The pose of the cover is specifically designed after the cover of Wonder Woman #5 from 2007.
The phrase that Alya quotes from Majestia paraphrases Edmund Burke's quote: "The only thing necessary for the triumph of evil is for good men to do nothing."
Alya has a poster of the cover in her room.
As Majestia is revealed to be a real person in "Miraculous New York", it is unknown if the comics are based on her adventures in real life or fictionalized tales about her similar to the heroes of "Mighty Med".

title: Marinette's Double Life/Transcript
text:
Marinette's Double Life/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Dear diary, today Cat Noir and I managed to stop a supervillain once again! The Magician of Misfortune wanted to make the Eiffel Tower vanish in a puff of smoke! Can you imagine? Luckily, we were there to stop him, but I was late for school, and I arrived in the middle of a test with Miss Bustier!
Miss Bustier: That’s it Marinette. Go to the principal’s office!
Marinette: She gave me a note for my parents to sign, again.
Sometimes it's hard being both Marinette and Ladybug. Of course, I love being a superheroine and it’s awesome to protect Paris against Hawk Moth and save all these innocent victims. But on the other hand, I always have to come up with excuses to explain why I'm late or absent to Mom and Dad, to my teachers and even to my best friend Alya. I can't even tell you how many stories I have to make up since school started!
Besides, every time a new villain shows up, I have to disappear discretely and go and fight them! When I find a place to hide, I say "Tikki, spots on! Yeah!"
And BAM! I turn into Ladybug! With my super suit made out of indestructible fabric and my magic Yo-yo!

title: Marinette's Double Life/Transcript
text:
Marinette's Double Life/Transcript - Intro
I can't let anyone see Tikki, my kwami, who never leaves my side. Without Tikki, I can't transform. She gives me my powers.
And I can do incredible stuff with my Yo-yo! The string goes on forever and I can use it to move around or tie up my opponents– I can even make it super fast to use it as a shield!
My mission's to capture the Villain's Akuma to stop them. The Akuma is an evil black butterfly that turns people into bad guys.
But with my magic Yo-yo, I can conjure up an item that will help me. I just have to say "Lucky Charm!"
Each time, something weird appears.
Ladybug: A bath towel? A record?
Marinette: And I have to understand how to use it.
Ladybug: A spoon? No more evil doing for you, little Akuma!
Marinette:  Then, I can capture the Akuma with my magic Yo-yo.
Ladybug: Time to de-evilize!
Marinette: And transform it back to a harmless butterfly.
Ladybug: Gotcha!
Ladybug: Miraculous Ladybug!
My ultimate power is that once I defeated the Villain, I throw my Lucky Charm in the air to save Paris! You see, there’s no time to get bored between my missions, school, my parents, my friends, Adrien and the supervillains, I’m always on the run. But being Ladybug is really amazing!

title: Marinette's Double Life/Transcript
text:
Marinette's Double Life/Transcript - Intro
Mom and Dad are back home. I have to ask them to sign the note I got this morning for being late. What am I going to tell them? Well I'll find something– I'm starting to get used to it. Bye for now, dear diary!

title: Malediktator
text:
Malediktator - Intro
"" is a season 2 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 22nd written and produced episode of season 2. It is also the 48th written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Malediktator
text:
Malediktator - Synopsis
When Chloé considers leaving Paris, her father, Mayor Bourgeois, turns into Malediktator, a powerful villain who wants her to stay at any cost.
Disney+
Ladybug and Cat Noir face Mr. Bourgeois, now Malediktator.

title: Malediktator
text:
Malediktator - Plot
Chloé presents to her class a video of her dressed as Queen Bee and Ladybug talking to one another.
However, the class realizes that the Ladybug in the video is Chloé, not the real one, and laugh at her.
Miss Bustier asks Chloé why she made her assignment about herself, to which Chloé responds by reminding the teacher that the assignment was to pick an important person in French history, believing that she herself saved France as Queen Bee, even showing a part of her video where "Ladybug" compliments her.
However, Alya says that it's obvious that it's really Chloé dressed as Ladybug, even sarcastically pointing out the difference in hair color.
Chloé claims that Ladybug dyed her hair blonde to look like her, but this just earns her more laughs from the class.
Sitting back down, Chloé tells her classmates that they don't deserve to see the rest of her video.
Marinette sarcastically replies that it's a shame, which is overheard by the class, who all laugh, including Sabrina.
Chloé catches Sabrina laughing and "fires" her.

title: Malediktator
text:
Malediktator - Plot
Sabrina is saddened that she betrayed her best friend, but Alya tells her that she has every right to laugh, even pulling up a video where Ladybug and Cat Noir scold Queen Bee for creating a subway train incident.
Alya declares that Ladybug and Cat Noir were the heroes, not Chloé, and Alix even adds how Chloé had superpowers for five minutes and went out of control.
Marinette tells Chloé that while they don't deserve to see her "documentary", she doesn't deserve to be called a superhero.
This angers her so much, that she storms out of class while Marinette points out that she will never change.
Later, André Bourgeois finishes marrying a couple, only for Chloé and Audrey to storm in and kick everyone out.
Audrey demands that André close down the school and Chloé demands that he banish Marinette from Paris.
Audrey claims that Marinette hurt Chloé's feelings, to which Chloé adds that Marinette got the entire class to gang up on her.
André protests that he can't do that but offers to shut the school down for a few days.
However, that's not good enough for Chloé and Audrey, demanding him to shut the school down forever.

title: Malediktator
text:
Malediktator - Plot
André tells Chloé that while he loves her, she's asking too much from him this time and says that he's only the mayor.
Chloe asks him about the use of his sash if he can't use power, claiming it's riduculous.
André tells Chloe that she's too good for her classmates, and suggests she simply change schools.
This doesn't satisfy Chloé and Audrey either, and the two decide to move to New York instead.
As the hotel servants pack the duo's bags, André says he can't be the mayor of Paris if he's living in New York and suggests moving someplace closer, but Chloé believes that it won't make a difference veiwing him as powerless and Audrey is displeased that André is refusing to come with them.
In an effort to change Chloé's mind about moving, André presents her with a diamond-encrusted phone case, but Chloé rejects the gift.
Sensing André's sadness over not being able to give Chloé what she wants, Hawk Moth sends an akuma to him, which infects his sash just as Chloé and Audrey leave for the airport on a helicopter. Hawk Moth offers André absolute power and authority in exchange for Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses. He accepts the deal and is transformed into Malediktator.

title: Malediktator
text:
Malediktator - Plot
The students are all eating lunch at school when suddenly, the Bourgeois' helicopter appears and Chloé announces to everyone that she is going to New York with her mother and leaving them all behind, even tossing multiple flyers of her in New York City.

title: Malediktator
text:
Malediktator - Plot
The students and staff realize that Chloé is leaving forever, take a moment to process this and immediately burst into joyous celebration, complete with music,  fireworks, and confetti from nowhere, students and teachers hugging each other and a few students even breaking into a conga line. Marinette realizes that without Chloé around, Paris will be filled with less negative emotions and akumatizations. Adrien arrives at the scene and wonders what everyone is celebrating. Marinette happily tells him that Chloé left Paris and is moving to New York, but is surprised when Adrien doesn't share her enthusiasm, even wondering why she would celebrate a thing like that. Marinette points out how Chloé is a brat to everyone and calls her useless, but Adrien believes no one is useless, not even Chloé. He sadly explains that Chloé was his only friend growing up and he cannot celebrate her unhappy departure from Paris. With that, Marinette begins to regret driving Chloé away and unintentionally hurting Adrien's feelings.

title: Malediktator
text:
Malediktator - Plot
The Bourgeois' helicopter flies above Malediktator, who uses his powers to make the pilot land. Chloé and Audrey are then confronted by Malediktator, who tells his daughter that he now has the power to shut down the school and banish those who were mean to her. While Chloé is concerned for her father, Audrey criticizes her husband's akumatization, stating that it doesn't make him a cool or hip father. While she's ranting, Malediktator turns her into a devoted wife who's happy to stay in Paris. Audrey runs over to Malediktator and happily hugs and kisses him. Chloé, however, is disgusted by this and sneaks away into a subway station when no one is looking. When Malediktator finds that Chloé is no longer inside the helicopter, Hawk Moth tells him that in order to find his daughter, he must first cause chaos in Paris and suggests starting with the school, to which Malediktator agrees.
While everyone else is still celebrating, Alya approaches Marinette and tells her that she doesn't need to get upset just because Adrien is.
However, Marinette thinks she was a bit harsh on Chloé and wonders if she's not just a brat.

title: Malediktator
text:
Malediktator - Plot
Just then, Malediktator appears and turns the school into a demolition site, causing the students and staff to begin destroying the building.
Marinette and Adrien hide and transform into Ladybug and Cat Noir.
The duo then confront Malediktator and Cat Noir jokingly asks if he has a demolition permit, to which Malediktator replies that he doesn't need a permit since he's all-powerful and Paris is his city.
Ladybug retorts that Paris belongs to everyone, and the duo engage him in combat.
Ladybug calls on her Lucky Charm and receives an abacus.
While she tries to figure out what to do with it, Cat Noir proceeds to attack Malediktator.
Ladybug realizes that the Lucky Charm is telling her to go to Master Fu, but is too late to stop Cat Noir, whose instincts turned into into those of an actual cat.
Audrey finds the cat-like Cat Noir adorable and begins petting him, much to his liking.
Ladybug is concerned for Cat Noir, but when Malediktator attempts to take his Miraculous, Cat Noir prevents him from doing so.
Relieved that "kitty still has claws," Ladybug promises Cat Noir that she'll be right back before taking off.

title: Malediktator
text:
Malediktator - Plot
Malediktator prepares to go after her, but Hawk Moth tells him to let her go, knowing she'll be back soon, and instead instructs him to take Cat Noir's Miraculous.
However, Audrey begs Malediktator to let her keep him a little longer, to which he agrees.
Hawk Moth threatens to take away his powers if he fails, but Malediktator assures Hawk Moth that Cat Noir is completely helpless and that taking his Miraculous will be easy.

title: Malediktator
text:
Malediktator - Plot
Arriving at Master Fu's, Marinette explains to him how Malediktator turned Cat Noir into a literal cat. Concerned, Master Fu thinks that Marinette shouldn't have left him alone, but she explains that her Lucky Charm led her to him. Knowing that Lucky Charms don't fail, Master Fu takes out the Miracle box and allows her to choose a Miraculous and a trusted ally to help her as long as she returns the Miraculous when the mission is over. Knowing that she must choose someone who isn't impressed by those in power and can help her trap Malediktator, Marinette thinks of Chloé and prepares to take the Bee Miraculous, but then begins to doubt if it's such a good idea. However, Tikki encourages Marinette to follow her instincts and she picks up the Bee Miraculous. Master Fu asks Marinette if she's sure about entrusting the Miraculous to Chloé, to which Marinette assures him that she knows how to make good use of the Miraculous.

title: Malediktator
text:
Malediktator - Plot
Malediktator arrives at the Dupain-Cheng bakery and orders Tom and Sabine to tell him where their daughter is. When they don't, Malediktator uses his power to make them leave Paris forever. Meanwhile, Marinette begins looking for Chloé when she runs into her parents, who tell her that Malediktator was looking for her and that they're leaving Paris forever. Realizing the seriousness of the situation, Marinette looks over at the video Chloé had presented to the class and notes how she mentions a "secret lair". Figuring out where it is, Marinette heads over there.
Back at Le Grand Paris hotel, Chloé hides from Malediktator, who says that he's done everything she wanted so that she can stay in Paris with him.
However, the villain gets frustrated with her when she keeps sneaking away from him.
Armand tells Malediktator that he cannot find her, but he insists that he keep looking and to contact him when he finds her.
As Chloé runs away, she bumps into Ladybug, who asks her why Malediktator is so upset.
Chloé at first attempts to blame Marinette for the situation, but Ladybug asks her if it's really all Marinette's fault.

title: Malediktator
text:
Malediktator - Plot
With some prying from Ladybug, Chloé admits that she hurt her father's feelings by wanting to leave Paris forever.
Ladybug asks her if it's because of what happened at school, but Chloé tearfully explains that it's because she has no reason to stay since no one likes her and she has no friends, even calling herself useless.
Ladybug, however, assures Chloé that no one is useless, but Chloé reminds Ladybug that she's a superhero who serves a purpose.
Ladybug tells Chloé that she can serve a purpose if she wants, to which Chloé says she does.
Ladybug then presents her with the Bee Miraculous as her second chance after she lost it from the battle of the Eiffel Tower against Style Queen, which Chloé accepts.
She opens the box and is greeted by Pollen.
Ladybug tells Chloé that she must return the Miraculous when the mission is over.
Chloé promises not to disappoint Ladybug and transforms into Queen Bee.
As Ladybug and Queen Bee head over to Malediktator, the latter talks about how she's always dreamed of working with Ladybug.
Ladybug reminds Queen Bee to stay focused, to which she says she will since she's been practicing since forever.

title: Malediktator
text:
Malediktator - Plot
Meanwhile, Roger and the police surround Malediktator and demand that he surrender his akuma, but Malediktator turns them all into his shield instead.
When Ladybug and Queen Bee arrive, Ladybug is about to suggest a plan when Queen Bee calls out for her father and apologizes for hurting his feelings.
She also asks him to return Audrey back to normal and even calls his powers ridiculous.
This only angers Malediktator, who attacks the duo.
However, Ladybug and Queen Bee manage to dodge his attacks, so Hawk Moth suggests that Malediktator use absolute power.
He agrees and prepares to turn everyone in Paris into his slaves.
Ladybug calls on her Lucky Charm and receives a giant machine gun, which Queen Bee calls effective.
However, Ladybug realizes that she only needs the laser part and discards the rest.
She then points the laser at Cat Noir, who chases it and knocks down all of Malediktator's guards.
Queen Bee then uses her Venom power to paralyze Malediktator and hands his sash over to Ladybug, who releases and purifies the akuma and uses her Miraculous Ladybug power to return everything to normal.

title: Malediktator
text:
Malediktator - Plot
With Malediktator defeated, Queen Bee transforms back into Chloé, who gives her Miraculous back to Ladybug and pounds it with her. Chloé then approaches her mother and father and requests that they go home. Once they've left, Cat Noir apologizes to Ladybug about not being able to help, but Ladybug tells him that he was key in defeating Malediktator and promises to give him the details next time. She then heads over to Master Fu, who comments on the big risk Marinette took by entrusting Chloé with the Bee Miraculous, asking her if she really thinks she's got what it takes to be a superhero. Marinette says that being Ladybug has made her a better Marinette, so maybe being Queen Bee will make Chloé better, too. Master Fu finds this to be noble.

title: Malediktator
text:
Malediktator - Plot
Butler Armand prepares to clean up Chloé's lair, but Chloé tells him that she'll do it herself, much to his surprise. While cleaning, Chloé is surprised to find Marinette waiting for her. She takes her to the school and shows her that everyone is throwing a party in honor of Queen Bee. Sabrina hugs Chloé, happy that she has come back. Though Chloé tells Sabrina that she's wrinkling her jacket, she secretly enjoys the hug and then shows off her new diamond-encrusted phone case. Adrien tells Marinette that it was nice of her to throw Chloé a party since she saved Paris. Alya comments on how Rena Rouge and Carapace saved Paris yet no one threw them a party, but Marinette reminds Alya that it's because no one knows their secret identities, and if Chloé feels useful, her attitude may slowly begin to change. The end card appears as Chloé takes a selfie of herself in front of a Queen Bee poster.

title: Malediktator
text:
Malediktator - Plot Developments
Although this episode is self-contained, it continues the story-line of the Bourgeois family and takes place sometime after "Queen Wasp (Queen's Battle - Part 2)".
In spite of this, the trailer for the episode was put up before the first two parts of Queen's Battle even aired; Thomas Astruc took to Twitter and advised fans to watch the two-parter first and then Malediktator, as it would "ruin the experience".
This episode shows how everyone in the school, even the adults, hates Chloé so much that everyone except Adrien and later Marinette celebrated her leaving for New York.
Alya mentions of Rena Rouge and Carapace at Chloé's honor meaning that this episode takes place after "Sapotis" and "Anansi".
Master Fu's reasonable doubt about Chloé foreshadows her betrayal in "Miracle Queen".
This episode is the first time where Ladybug's Lucky Charm gave her an actual weapon later followed by "Qilin". Following "Troublemarker", the object comes in multiple pieces and when done so in this situation, the holder doesn't need the whole object to activate the restoration.

title: Malediktator
text:
Malediktator - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in Canada on Family Channel.
This episode was first revealed in a promotional video for Season 2 released by TFOU on August 31, 2017.
Some of the English cast read through a part of this episode at a panel at San Diego Comic-Con 2018.
On Chloé's flyers, the Statue of Liberty can be seen behind her and an embroidered United States flag on her cap.
During Chloé's transformation, Queen Bee's theme uses a deeper pitch compared to her transformation during "Queen Wasp".
Not counting episodes which don't have end cards, this is the second episode to have an end card in which Marinette and Adrien don't appear, following "The Collector".
It's later followed by "Migration", and "Intuition".
It and "Migration" are also the only ones out of the four to not feature Gabriel in any way.
References
Cat Noir intended to use Cataclysm in this episode but he got hit by Malediktator before he could do so.
Also his transformation sequence isn't used.
The second time where his power of completely nullified following "Reflekta".

title: Malediktator
text:
Malediktator - Trivia
This is the fifth time, where Cat Noir used his powers on someone else, but unlike "Dark Cupid", "Princess Fragrance", "Despair Bear" and like "Troublemaker" this is the second time of his own free will.
Plagg does not appear in any sort of way in an episode for the third time following "Despair Bear" and "Prime Queen" .
This is fifth episode from Season 2 that doesn't have a new character, following "Queen Wasp", "Zombizou", "Troublemaker" and "The Collector".
Allusions
The French title of this episode is "Maledikteur". The name was originally "Malediktor".
The name is a portmanteau of the French words "mal," meaning "bad," and a corruption of "dictateur," meaning "dictator."
It also phonetically sounds like "malediction", which is a synonym for "curse."
Malediktator's design may be based on Napoleon Bonaparte, the first Emperor of France, who is known as a very courageous general during the Napoleonic Wars.
Errors
Six people are shown when André is marrying a couple. However, when Chloé shoves everyone out, only five people are shown.

title: Malediktator

Ladybug's arm proceeds to phase through the leaves of the plants at Chloé's rooftop during her pep talk to Chloé.
Malediktator has his sash on him right before detransforming even though Queen Bee took it off earlier and threw to Ladybug.
After Chloé walks over to her parents and they leave, Audrey's hat suddenly reappears as they are seen walking away in the distance.
When Chloé receives the Miraculous, the Mini Miracle Box is high, but then after Ladybug knots, the Box is shorter than usual.
When the school pupils read the notes Chloé gave them and Marinette and Alya smile to each other before all the pupils jump, confetti just appears immediately.
Queen Bee's Miraculous has inverted colors.
When Chloé put on the Bee Miraculous, it was in the right front of her hair, however after transforming the Miraculous was on the farther right of her hair.

text:

title: Malediktator/Transcript
text:

Alya: Chloé, it's so obvious that's you dressed up as Ladybug. You didn't even bother to match her hair color.

(Marinette rolls her eyes with an annoyed glare)

title: Malediktator/Transcript
text:
Malediktator/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: (on the screen, down in the Métro, to Queen Bee; dialogue from the episode Queen Wasp) You're the one who paralyzed the Métro driver, aren't you? You used your power to create this situation!
Alya: She wasn't the hero; it was Cat Noir and Ladybug!

Chloé: (gets up) This is ridiculous.

Marinette: Ugh— seriously? She'll never change.
André: By the power vested in me, I now pronounce you husband and wife.
Audrey: (bursts through the door with Chloé) Oh, good. You're married. Now get out!
Chloé: (shoves five people right out the door) Shoo! (slams door) (he wipes his hand on his hand)
André: What in the world is going on, my sweetie pie?
Audrey: (slams table) I demand that you close the school down for good!

title: Malediktator/Transcript
text:
Malediktator/Transcript - Intro
Chloé: (slams table) And I want you to banish Marinette Dupain-Cheng from Paris!
Audrey: (cradles Chloé's head) That monster hurt your little girl’s feelings.
Chloé: She got the whole class to gang up on me. They all have to pay.
André: But I just can't! I mean… I could close the school for a few days… a week at most.
Audrey: (slams table) Not good enough!
Chloé: (slams table; André stumbles backwards) Shut it down forever!
André: Ugh— But that’s impossible! I love you, Chloé, but you’re asking too much of me this time. I’m only the mayor.
Chloé: Precisely. (indicating with her hand) What’s the use of this stupid sash you're wearing if you can’t actually use power? This is ridiculous!...
Chloé and Audrey: Utterly ridiculous!
André: You’ve always been too good for your classmates. Maybe you should switch schools? (Chloé throws a tantrum)
Audrey: Change schools? Ugh— forget it! We need to change cities, that’s what. We’ll go to New York!
André: But wait!
Chloé: Don't forget my Tourbillon stilettos, Jean-Marc.
Armand: Of course, Miss.
André: I can’t be the mayor of Paris if we’re living in New York. It’s… too far! Why don't we go and live closer in Versailles, instead?

title: Malediktator/Transcript
text:
Malediktator/Transcript - Intro
Chloé: Well, it won’t make the slightest bit of difference since you’re so powerless, anyway!
Audrey: Not only are you incapable of solving a simple problem for your daughter, you’re also refusing to come with us?
André: No! Not at all. I… I… Ah. Look at this, my sweetie. It’s for you. (opens a jewelry box with a luminescent jewel inside)
Chloé: What is it? It’s tiny!
André: Yes, but very expensive! It’s a diamond-encrusted phone case. Are you sure you don’t want to stay after all?
Chloé: (slaps the box out of her father's hands) I don’t want that thing! What kind of daddy are you if you can’t even give me what I want?
André: (whimpers) But… what more can I do?
Hawk Moth: A man of power feeling helpless as a father. I sense very strong negative emotions from him. (turns a butterfly into an akuma) Fly away, my little akuma, and evilize him!
André: Nooo! (falls on his knees, crying; the akuma flies closer and merges with his sash)
Hawk Moth: (from his lair) Malediktator, I am Hawk Moth. Your wife and daughter think you're weak and useless? Well, I shall give you absolute power. Anything you declare will happen!

title: Malediktator/Transcript
text:
Malediktator/Transcript - Intro
André: By the power vested in me, I shall prevail as Malediktator! (transforms)
Chloé: (from the helicopter, through megaphone) Hey there, losers! I'm headed to New York with my mom. (throws flyers) I'm leaving you all behind in your pathetic little school and your pathetic little city. Adieu! (laughs)
(Marinette picks up a flyer showing Chloé in front of the Statue of Liberty.)
Nino: Chloé's leaving?
Nathaniel: Forever?
Marinette: Looks like it.
Alya: Yeah.
(Everyone jumps in the air out of happiness; confetti appears out of thin air and there are fireworks for no reason at all. Everyone, including Denis Damoclès, dances and parties.)

Tikki: And less akumatizations.
(Adrien walks up to Marinette from behind.)

Marinette: Chloé’s gone! She’s moving to New York!

Marinette: (still excited, not realizing that Adrien is not sharing everyone else’s enthusiasm) Yeah! Isn’t it great?

title: Malediktator/Transcript
text:
Malediktator/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (frowns) But, Chloé’s a total brat to everyone. She was useless anyway.
Adrien: Nobody's useless, not even Chloé. When I was little and wasn't allowed out, she was the only friend I had.
Marinette: Ow— well, uh… shoot.
Adrien: She left angry and unhappy. I can't celebrate that. (walks off sadly)
Marinette: Uh— (contemplates going after him, but decides against it) I'm really sorry, Adrien.
Malediktator: By the power vested in me, I order you to land! (a yellow orb of light materializes on top of two of his fingers; he sends it towards the helicopter; the helicopter pilot is surprised as he sees the orb while it disappears into his chest. He lands the helicopter immediately)
Audrey: (departs the helicopter) This is not the airport. What is the meaning of this?
Malediktator: Chloé, my daughter, you are not leaving for New York.

Malediktator: You see, I have the power to shut down the school and banish all those nasty students who were mean to you. Come with me! (extends his hand)

title: Malediktator/Transcript
text:
Malediktator/Transcript - Intro
Audrey: André, getting yourself akumatized like everybody else in this town does not make you a cool or hip father. In fact—
Malediktator: By the power vested in me, I declare that you will be devoted to this family and remain in Paris with me and Chloé. (creates a yellow orb and shoots it at Audrey)
Audrey: (sprints towards Malediktator) Oh yes, my dear hubby. I’m so happy to stay here. (wraps arms around Malediktator and kisses him)

(sneaks out of the helicopter and hides in a Métro entrance) Well done, Chloé, now you just have to— (sniffs the air) Ew! What a stench! Come on, you're a hero! (holds her nose and slowly descends the stairs; muffled, as she's holding her nose) You… can… do… this.

title: Malediktator/Transcript
text:

title: Malediktator/Transcript
text:

title: Malediktator/Transcript
text:

title: Malediktator/Transcript

title: Malediktator/Transcript
text:
Malediktator/Transcript - Intro
Malediktator: (sighs) If it makes you happy.
Hawk Moth: (from his lair) Don’t let me down Malediktator, or I’ll take away your powers!
Malediktator: (pointing at Cat Noir, who is lying on his back, clawing at Audrey's necklace) He's completely harmless now. Taking his Miraculous would be like taking candy from a baby.

Choose wisely; such powers are meant to serve the greater good. Once the mission is over, you'll retrieve the Miraculous from them.

title: Malediktator/Transcript
text:

(Marinette smiles at Tikki and picks up the Bee Miraculous.)

title: Malediktator/Transcript
text:
Malediktator/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: I know, but I've got find Chloé first. I can't do this alone. She talked about her secret lair in her documentary. (taps on the interview video on her phone) Hmm. Wait a minute. Huh! (camera zooms in on a parasol in the background) I know where her lair is!

Come on, Chloé; you don't want to upset me... (peers over the chair he heard the noise come from before) ...do you?! (he finds nothing) Huh? (Chloé runs outside) My patience has its limits, Chloé. Don't make me show all of Paris just how powerful I can be!

(Chloé is hiding behind a wall; she peers around the corner.)

(Malediktator quickly turns around, and Chloé hides behind the wall just in time. Then Malediktator and Jean leave the room. Chloé runs off.)
(Chloé emerges from the stairs and sees Ladybug, then falls on her derrière trying to stop in time.)

title: Malediktator/Transcript
text:
Malediktator/Transcript - Intro
Chloé: Ladybug, finally! You're going to help me, right?
Ladybug: I'm fine with helping you, Chloé, but first… I need you to tell me what happened. Why is your father— I mean, Malediktator, so mad?
Chloé: It's because of this super lame loser named Marinette Dupain-Cheng. She's this horrible girl in my class and she hates me. (Ladybug looks angry, but then contains her feelings) She's ganged everyone up against me and she—
