Chloé: Uh! Ugh. Okay, it wasn't totally Marinette's fault. She is really mean to me sometimes, but actually, this time, Daddy got angry all by himself.
Ladybug: (not buying it) All by himself?
Chloé: Yeah, because… there was something he couldn't do…
Ladybug: (puts a hand on Chloé's shoulder) Chloé, it's me, Ladybug. You can trust me. You can tell me the truth.
Chloé: I— I—
Ladybug: Mm-hmm.
Chloé: It— it was me. I hurt my daddy's feelings. Because I want to leave Paris, forever.
Ladybug: Because of what happened in school? I'm sure Marinette probably didn't exactly mean what she said.

title: Malediktator/Transcript
text:
Malediktator/Transcript - Intro
Chloé: Oh, it's not just her— actually, I don't even care about her— it's because I have no reason to be here: nobody likes me; I have no friends. I'm… useless.
Ladybug: (remembering what Adrien told Marinette earlier at school about Chloé) A friend once told me: nobody is useless, Chloé.
Chloé: It's easy for you to say that. You're Ladybug, a superhero. You serve a purpose.
Ladybug: Yes, I can fix up all the messes. You said it yourself in your documentary.
Chloé: (gasps) You saw it?!
Ladybug: (nods) Mm-hmm.
Chloé: Oh! I'm so embarrassed. That film's ridiculous. Utterly ridiculous. I realize that now.
Ladybug: Don't worry Chloé. You can fix your own messes, if that's what you want. You, too, can serve a purpose, but you have to want to.
Chloé: (sniffles) I do want to.
Ladybug: Chloé Bourgeois, (holds out the Miraculous box) here is the Bee Miraculous, which grants you the power to immobilize your opponent. You will use it for the greater good.
(Chloé hesitates; Ladybug nods approvingly; Chloé takes the box and opens it; a yellow ball of light flies around her and Pollen appears.)
Pollen: At your service, my Queen.

title: Malediktator/Transcript
text:
Malediktator/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: Once the job is complete, you will return the Miraculous to me. Can I trust you, Chloé?
Chloé: (puts the haircomb in her hair) I won't disappoint you this time, Ladybug.[Transformation Sequence]Chloé: Pollen, buzz on! (Chloé transforms into Queen Bee for the first time… again.)
Queen Bee: I've always dreamed of doing this… with you!
Ladybug: We must work together as a team, all right, Queen Bee?
Queen Bee: Yes, yes, don't worry. I've been practicing since forever.
(Ladybug pulls Queen Bee aside, before she can run into a chimney. They keep running.)
Roger: (through megaphone) Mr. Mayor— I mean, Malediktator— you are surrounded. Please renounce your akuma and… we'll forget this ever happened.
(Some of the heavily armored policemen barge into André's office, where Malediktator, Audrey and Cat Noir are.)
Audrey: (looks at the policemen) Oh! Would you like some tea?
Malediktator: It's okay, honey. They've got more important things to do. By the power vested in me, I declare that you are my shield. (makes a yellow orb and shoots it through all policemen in the office)

title: Malediktator/Transcript
text:
Malediktator/Transcript - Intro
(In the next shot, Malediktator is sitting atop the Hôtel de Ville, surrounded by shielded policemen at night time. Ladybug and Queen Bee land across from the building on a roof.)
Roger and other guards: None shall pass, Malediktator.
Ladybug: Here's the plan—
Queen Bee: (shouting) Here I am, Daddy! I'm sorry I hurt your feelings the way I did. Stop all this nonsense at once!
Audrey: My honey pie, you look so pretty in that suit!
Queen Bee: Ugh! And please put Mom back to normal. I can't bear to see her like this. Your powers are ridiculous. Utterly ridiculous.
Malediktator: (growls) That's enough! Now you're going to do what I tell you to do. By the power vested in me, give me your Miraculous!

title: Malediktator/Transcript
text:
Malediktator/Transcript - Intro
(Scene description: Malediktator shoots two orbs the heroes' way. Both Ladybug and Queen Bee jump up and launch their respective weapons at Malediktator. Both attacks get blocked by a wall of shields. They both have to dodge the orbs again. Ladybug moves in, trying to kick this time, but gets blocked by shields again, she then has to dodge the orb again. Queen Bee is fighting some policemen and winning, but she then has to retreat to get away from the pursuing orb. Ladybug swings herself around the building and launches herself in the air, attempting an attack from above. The attack is, however, blocked again by shields.)
Hawk Moth: (from his lair) You won't pull it off like that! People only respect absolute power!
Malediktator: You're right, Hawk Moth. By the power vested in me, I declare you all MY SLAVES! (makes a gigantic orb)
Queen Bee: That bubble is going to be a tough one to dodge!
Ladybug: He's gonna take over the whole city!
(She and Queen Bee both try attacking again, but alas, the shields do their job well.)
Ladybug: You need to get past his guards. Lucky Charm! (a huge gun with laser sight appears)
Queen Bee: Well, that's an effective Lucky Charm!

title: Malediktator/Transcript
text:
Malediktator/Transcript - Intro
(Ladybug uses her Lucky Vision to highlight: Malediktator, Cat Noir, the gun's laser sight and Queen Bee; she grabs the laser sight off the gun and chucks the rest of it off the building.)
Ladybug: No way I'd use one of those.
Queen Bee: Are you sure?
Ladybug: Yeah! You just need to take the sting out.
Queen Bee: Venom!
Ladybug: Focus on Malediktator; I'll deal with the guards.
(Malediktator laughs in an evil manner. Ladybug shines her laser pointer in front of Cat!Cat Noir who starts chasing it while making cat noises. He jumps on the back of every policeman to throw them off the building. Malediktator notices but can't intervene as he is still making the orb.)
Malediktator: No, no! Oh! (after Cat Noir is done, only he, Malediktator and Audrey are still on the elevated platform) But! But!
Queen Bee: Sorry, Daddy! (stings Malediktator in his sash; he lets out a girlish squeal; the orb he was creating disappears) Your turn, Ladybug. (throws the sash to Ladybug, who catches it and breaks it in half like it's nothing; the akuma flutters out)

title: Malediktator/Transcript
text:
Malediktator/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: No more evil-doing for you, little akuma. Time to de-evilize! (catches the Akuma) Gotcha! (releases the white butterfly) Bye, bye, little butterfly. Miraculous Ladybug!
(The Miraculous Cure does its thing, curing the people at Collège Françoise Dupont, teleporting Marinette's parents back to the bakery, turning Cat Noir back to normal and teleporting the policemen, Malediktator and Audrey back down, after which Malediktator transforms back into André.)
Audrey: (her old self again) Wha—? What are we doing here?! What have you done this time, André?
Cat Noir: Ah, bummer; don't tell me I missed out on the party.
Ladybug: Yep, you missed Queen Bee and Ladybug saving Paris, for real this time.
Queen Bee: I understand, Ladybug. Buzz off. (transforms back into Chloé)
Chloé: (gives back her Miraculous) Being a superhero isn't only about fixing messes. (Ladybug holds up her hand in a fist; Chloé gasps and smiles)
Chloé and Ladybug: (fist-bump) Pound it!
Audrey: Utterly ridiculous.
Chloé: Daddy, Mommy! Come on, let's go home. (the Bourgeoises leave)
Cat Noir: Sorry, M'Lady. Feel like I was pretty useless this time around.

title: Malediktator/Transcript
text:
Malediktator/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: Actually, you were totally key in defeating Malediktator.
Cat Noir: Really? Tell me all about it!
Ladybug: (her Miraculous beeps) Next time. Bug out! (swings off)
Master Fu: You took a big risk entrusting this Miraculous to Chloé Bourgeois. Do you really think she's got what it takes to be a superhero?
Marinette: Yes, I do. Ladybug has made me a better Marinette. So, perhaps being Queen Bee will make her a better Chloé, too!
Master Fu: That's very noble of you, Marinette.
Chloé: It's okay, Jean-Yves; I'll take care of it.
Armand: Mademoiselle, are you sure?
Chloé: Yes, I need to do it myself.
Marinette: Chloé?
Chloé: (gasps) Dupain-Cheng?
Chloé: All right, I came to your stupid party… now what?
Marinette: Look there, we're having a party in honor of the girl who saved Paris: Queen Bee!
Chloé: (gasps; gasps again) But— Queen Bee is… me. You're— you're having a party… for me?
Sabrina: (running up) Chloé! I thought I'd lost you! (hugs Chloé)
Chloé: (relatively nicely) Okay, no need to make a big thing of it. Ugh! Besides, you're wrinkling my clothes.
Sabrina: Sorry…

title: Malediktator/Transcript
text:
Malediktator/Transcript - Intro
Chloé: (smiles) All right, all right, let me go. I wanna show you the diamond phone case Daddy gave me. (pulls out the glowing phone case as she is suddenly wearing sunglasses; everyone is shielding their eyes from the bright light) Your daddy wouldn't be able to buy you one of these, would he?
Adrien: (to Marinette) It was really cool of you to put this party together for Chloé.
Marinette: Well, she did save Paris, so… she just may be able to save herself, too. Am I right?
Alya: Rena Rouge and Carapace helped Ladybug save Paris, but nobody threw them a party. (rolls her eyes)
Marinette: That's because we don't know their true identities, unlike Chloé. If she feels like she can be useful, I'm sure she'll change her attitude.
Alya: Mm-hmm?
Marinette: Well… baby steps… baby steps.

title: Marc Anciel
text:
Marc Anciel - Intro
is a supporting character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He is a student at Collège Françoise Dupont and a former student of Olga Mendeleiev's class, before Mayor Bustier reformed the school. He is currently in a relationship with Nathaniel Kurtzberg.
In "Reverser", after Nathaniel disregarded him and his writing and ripped his journal in half, he was akumatized by Hawk Moth into Reverser, a vengeful inverting supervillain.
In "Penalteam", Marc received the Rooster Miraculous from Ladybug. When the Miraculous is inhabited by Orikko, Marc becomes Rooster Bold (Coq Courage in the French version) a rooster-themed superhero with the power of Pretension who will help Ladybug and Cat Noir during "particularly difficult missions" in the fourth season.
After the events of "Strikeback", Marc was temporarily unable to become Rooster Bold after Monarch managed to steal the Rooster Miraculous along with all the others contained in the Chinese Miracle Box from Ladybug's yo-yo.
In "Re-creation", after Ladybug recovered the stolen Miraculous and reforged them following Monarch's defeat, Marc was given back the Rooster Miraculous permanently and reunited with Orikko.

title: Marc Anciel
text:
Marc Anciel - Intro
In "Revelator", it's shown that, after getting his Miraculous back, Marc, along with the other secondary heroes of Ladybug's team, was trained to unlock his adult powers, no longer detransforming after using his power.
In "The Ruler", when Marc expressed his worry about Nathaniel putting himself in danger for him, the latter, in order to put him at ease, reluctantly revealed himself as Caprikid. Touched by this revelation, Marc decided to reveal his identity as Rooster Bold to him to show the same level of trust.

title: Marc Anciel
text:
Marc Anciel - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Marc is a fairly tall and slender teenage boy with tan skin and a somewhat feminine appearance. Marc has a slender face with a pointed chin and pink lips. He has messy rock-style black hair with blue reflections and long bangs split in the middle, vivid green eyes with visible lashes, thick eyebrows, and black painted fingernails.
From Season 6 onwards, his hair is messier, a little thicker, and a bit longer. He has a few more clumps of hair brushed to the front of his head as his bangs and thick forelocks. He has red eyeshadow with a dark blue lightning bolt-shaped design next to it with a lighter gradated tip at the bottom on his left eye. His lips seem to lose their pink color.
Civilian Attire

title: Marc Anciel
text:
Marc Anciel - Appearance
In the first four seasons, he wore a V-neck rainbow tie-dye T-shirt which displayed the colors in a ripple pattern originating from the center. The collar was cerise. Over his t-shirt, he wore a bright red hoodie with white drawstrings, and a pink inside. He also wore moderate azure jeans with the bottoms rolled above the ankle and a number of horizontal rips around his knees. He wore a pair of short black boots with faint "oil slick" rainbow blotches and dark mauve laces that also wrapped around the top of the boots. Below were red socks.
He also wore a pair of black leather fingerless gloves and collar around his neck, and a silver square-nail belt with a solid square as the buckle. Hanging from his belt were a pair of square-nail chains around his thighs. Up until "Re-creation", he wore his Miraculous on occasion as the tip was gone and it was silvery gray with two links connected by a chain on his left thumb.

title: Marc Anciel
text:
Marc Anciel - Appearance
From Season 6 onwards, he keeps his outfit, but his tie-dye shirt has a spiral pattern that goes down to his belt, and he wears a red, clasp button jacket with pockets on both sides of his chest. The jacket has a colorful print of a rainbow and lightning bolt that are merged together on the back and his boots have a slightly different design. His pants are also more higher.
His fingerless gloves are shorter and have a cutout window on the back. He also has an sliver feather earring on his left ear and the Rooster Miraculous is still on his left thumb, but it's now golden and has only one link.
As Rooster Bold
In Seasons 4 and 5, Rooster Bold's eyes turned brilliant red with light gold sclera. His black hair was slicked back and he had a brilliant red mohawk resembling a rooster's comb. He wore a short vivid red ascot and mask with a golden beak-like feature over the bridge of his nose, accented by a matching gold diamond-shaped marking on the top of the mask, and the mask stretched to the sides of his face.

title: Marc Anciel
text:
Marc Anciel - Appearance
He wore a very dark cobalt blue, full-body, skin-tight outfit covered by a moderate orange tailcoat with a blue-violets black inside and multiple long feather-like tails going down from around his waist, resembling a rooster's tail. The coat had a swan neck lined in gold, as well as multiple segments on his arms gradating to vermilion, and dark brown feather-shaped sections in the middle ending at his waist, lined in gold. At the bottom of the feathers, a single brown chain at either side trailed to the back and under the tailcoat. His golden boots had three straight spikes on the front and one spike that curled upward at the back, accented by V-shaped segments and a thick dark cobalt blue trimming on top, resembling a rooster's legs and the spurs that real roosters have.
He also had two flat rectangle hoop earrings on his left ear and he wore the Rooster Miraculous on his left thumb, which was gold with two segments and a sharp tip, as well as five orange markings in the middle. He had scarlet bracelets with gold bordering, with a small gold holster embedded on the left bracelet and two scarlet straps to hold his Fountain Pen.

title: Marc Anciel
text:
Marc Anciel - Appearance
From Season 6 onwards, his appearance changes significantly. His mohawk lengthens a little, while his mask gains an orange gradient on either side, no longer stretching out, accented by dark cobalt blue sides that point at the bottom and a little at the top, and angular gold markings around his eyes, which regain their white sclera but with orange eyes. The diamond on top of the mask is also now gone, except the beak. His studded earrings turn gold with an additional third one on the left ear. His right ear also has three gold studded earrings.

title: Marc Anciel
text:
Marc Anciel - Appearance
He keeps his suit, but his coat is replaced by a dark cobalt blue vest trimmed in gold on the top, with a metallic gold swan-necked top beneath with same-colored lining. His ascot is less ruffly and more wide and flat, accented by a tiny red diamond-shaped brooch lined in gold. On top is a long, very dark cobalt blue jacket with gold lining and a dull blue gradient at the ends, the ends reaching the knee. There are also gold outlines around the upper arm with an upward point, and similar-designed pockets with a diamond at the end. The folded collar is large and red with an orange gradient at the sides to accent his mask, and a gold dot at the tips, which also has the rooster miraculous symbol.
His bracelets turn gold and metallic with a diamond-shaped piece on the back of the hand, and the holster gains two red markings on top. The boots also have small alterations, mainly the spike that curled upward at the back turning into a partial heel.
As Reverser

title: Marc Anciel
text:
Marc Anciel - Appearance
Reverser was in a checkerboard patterned turtleneck suit with a hood that was attached to it, styled in a geometric way with short boots and fingerless gloves. He had diamond-shaped shoulder pauldrons and lined segments on his joints, mainly on the knees and below the shoulder. The right side was white with a black glove and boot, as well as part of his circular logo on his chest. The other side was inverted entirely, primarily black with white accents. His face was black on the right with white eyelashes, pupil, lip, and hair, the other side being inverted as it was white with black accents. His civilian hair was retained. Reverser's weapons were small black and white paper airplanes that could reverse the abilities or the personality of the person who is hit. He rode on a large paper hoverboard.

title: Marc Anciel
text:
Marc Anciel - Personality
Marc is a quiet, introverted, and kind boy who suffers from anxiety. He is very shy and reserved, as seen in "Reverser" where he hides under the school stairs and dislikes being the center of attention, becoming uncomfortable when Marinette Dupain-Cheng pulls him into the art room to introduce him to everyone. Marc is a natural writer and enjoys creating superhero stories, being a fan of Ladybug and taking inspiration from her fights against villains to create comics with Nathaniel Kurtzberg, who illustrates the comics they create. He's also has a great passion for romance, writing superhero love stories and helping to devise various manga-inspired plans to help Marinette and Adrien Agreste's relationship progress. After befriending Nathaniel and getting closer to his schoolmates, Marc becomes more sociable and outspoken but still maintains his timidness in certain moments.

title: Marc Anciel
text:
Marc Anciel - Personality
Similar to Marinette, Marc is quite clumsy and nervous, especially when he’s around someone he has feelings for. After being asked to write with Nathaniel for the first time, Marc runs away in embarrassment and into a pillar, dropping his notebook without realizing it. As Marc notes, he is similar to Marinette when she's with Adrien, as he gets very flustered and insecure around Nathaniel since he has feelings for him.
Thanks to his sweet, friendly, polite, innocent, and generous nature, Marc wins the goodwill of those around him and makes friends easily, forming a close bond with the normally solitary Nathaniel and getting along well with extroverted people like Marinette, Alix Kubdel and Zoé Lee. Marc is understanding and empathetic, always willing to listen and help his friends when they need it. In "The Ruler", despite wanting to publish the next issue of his comic 'The Adventures of Sun-Heart & Rain-Piercer', he understood Nathaniel's doubts about the comic and assured him that nothing would change between them if he didn't want to illustrate it, motivating his (boy)friend to draw with his heart and not abandon his passion for comics just because his mother says otherwise.

title: Marc Anciel
text:
Marc Anciel - Personality
He dislikes conflict and has a forgiving heart, as he doesn't hold grudges and forgives those who hurt him, directly or indirectly, when they acknowledge their mistakes and regret what they did.
Marc is also brave and loyal, putting aside his fears to help and protect others. In "Mayura", Ladybug and Cat Noir's determination inspires him to join the rest of Paris's citizens in the battle against the army of scarlet akumas and show his support for the heroes. In "The Ruler", he tries to save Nathaniel from being attacked by the titular villain without his powers as Rooster Bold, which inspires Nathaniel to fight his akumatized mother.
Observant and quick thinker, Marc can easily pick up on social cues, being one of the few to realize that Marinette is not well during the end-of-year party at "Representation", and noticing the types of conflicts that Nathaniel has with his strict mother by noticing how he hid his drawings from her in "The Ruler".

title: Marc Anciel
text:
Marc Anciel - Personality
Marc has a great lack of self-confidence, feeling insecure about his abilities and fearing rejection, with Marinette/Ladybug noticing that he is too hard on himself. Before becoming friends with his schoolmates, he felt self-conscious and uncomfortable at the idea of ​​others reading his stories, refusing to show them to Marinette and Nathaniel in "Reverser", believing that his writing wasn't very good. In "Penalteam", despite his interest in soccer and his admiration for Didier Roustan, he initially hesitates his abilities to play the sport enough to join Miss Bustier's class for a soccer match. Later, when Chloé Bourgeois is akumatized into Penalty and Ladybug recruits him to join her team of Heroes to defeat her, Marc is unsure about accepting the Rooster Miraculous, still doubting himself until Ladybug reassures him that he has more talent than he thinks.
As Rooster Bold, he gets the confidence he needs to show off his abilities and use them to better help his team when in danger.

title: Marc Anciel
text:
Marc Anciel - Personality
As Reverser, he was demanding and clever, realizing that Ladybug's graceful agility made her difficult to strike. He endangered civilians in order to make Ladybug an easy target when she went to help the affected cyclist. He was also confident, leaning on a bit overconfident. After he struck Ladybug and Cat Noir with his airplanes, he saw the heroes as harmless and believed he had time to obtain his revenge on Nathaniel and Marinette before dealing with them. He was also cruel, reversing anyone even those who haven't done anything to him, like with making the art club hate art and music, and making André Bourgeois send the dumpsters that were in space back to Paris, terrifying the citizens. Despite his villainous nature, Reverser did sympathize with those who are mistreated, like with what happened between him and Nathaniel, as he saw how Chloé treated Sabrina Raincomprix like a slave so he struck both of them to make Chloé tend to Sabrina instead.

title: Marc Anciel
text:
Marc Anciel - Abilities
As a Civilian
Marc is an excellent creative story writer. His Ladybug stories, based on Nathaniel's drawings, impress Marinette (the real Ladybug) so much that she pushes him to work with Nathaniel to make the Ladybug/Mighty Illustrator comic. Since the two of them complete the comic, it is implied that Marc's writing skills are strong enough for him to write well in script style as well as in short story style.
In "Penalteam", it is revealed that Marc is very good at soccer, and in "Re-creation", he plays with Sabrina.
As Rooster Bold
Rooster Bold has enhanced capabilities such as speed, agility, and strength, and he is almost invulnerable to physical damage. These abilities allow him to react to and evade akumatized villains attacks, as well as jump and leap several times his height and length.

title: Marc Anciel
text:
Marc Anciel - Abilities
If Rooster Bold says Sublimation, he activates his power, which is the ability to add another super ability to anything he is doing, whether it is an enhanced ability, or an actual superpower. Initially, he could only use one superpower once per transformation, but in "Revelator", Rooster Bold has learned to control his adult powers, allowing him to not detransform back and use Sublimation as much as he wishes.
As Reverser
Reverser had enhanced physical characteristics: speed, agility and strength. Reverser rode on a large paper hoverboard, which had the ability to fly around at will. He could also make small black and white paper airplanes with the ability to reverse the abilities or a personality trait to its opposite, by calling out what trait he wished to reverse and shouting "Reversion!". Notable examples are when he made Ladybug become extremely clumsy after hitting her with a paper plane, or when he made Cat Noir a coward (which explains why Reverser called them Ladyclutz and Scaredy Cat). This could also affect specific actions, as Reverser was able to make André Bourgeois bring the trash containers in space back to Earth.

title: Marc Anciel
text:
Marc Anciel - Etymology
Marc's full name, Marc Anciel, is a play on the French word "arc-en-ciel", which translates to "rainbow" in English. This wordplay both references his multicolored outfit and him being a part of the LGBTQ+ community.
Coq (in Coq Courage's name) is the French word for a rooster.
His English name, Rooster Bold, may be a reference to DC superhero Booster Gold.
This name was changed in the English dub due to concerns about using inappropriate sounding words.
In the European Portuguese dub, Marc's superhero name is "Galo Bravura", which, when literally translated, means "Bravery Rooster".

title: Marc Anciel
text:
Marc Anciel - Trivia
Revealed by the Staff
His first name was revealed in a UK episode synopsis on May 19, 2018.
His akumatized form was first seen in a photo taken by Jeremy Zag of the show's production for Season 2.
On May 21, 2018, Thomas Astruc revealed on Twitter that a (at the time unspecified) character was based on a personal friend of his named Hope Morphin, who is genderfluid and bisexual. A few hours after "Reverser" premiered on Family Channel, Morphin themself revealed that the character Astruc was referring to was Marc, and also that Marc is androgynous.
Feri González confirmed this, and also later confirmed on Twitter that Marc identifies as part of the LGBTQ+ community and has a "fondness" for Nathaniel.
Astruc confirms that Marc and Nathaniel are officially a couple.
Hope Morphin has confirmed that Marc's three favorite animals are the sheep, peacock, and goat.
Ironically, his partner uses the Miraculous of the Goat, which is sometimes replaced by a Sheep (another of his favorite animals) in the Eastern Zodiac, whilst he has a peacock-themed enemy-turned-teammate in Argos.
Miraculous Holder and Akumatized Villain
Reverser's voice is noticeably deeper than Marc's normal voice.

title: Marc Anciel
text:
Marc Anciel - Trivia
Reverser is probably based on some of Spider-Man's villains.
His glider and propensity towards throwing weapons brings to mind The Green Goblin.
His black and white scheme and his ability to "invert" other people resembles Mister Negative.
Reverser appears another time in "Gamer 2.0" for Gamer's powers.
Marc is the second person in Ms. Mendeleiev's class who uses a Miraculous, the first being Zoé.
As of "Penalteam", following Alya Césaire, Nino Lahiffe, Chloé Bourgeois, Nathalie Sancoeur, Luka Couffaine, Max Kanté, Kagami Tsurugi, Alix Kubdel, Lê Chiến Kim, Adrien Agreste, Wang Fu, Zoé Lee, Mylène Haprèle, Rose Lavillant, Juleka Couffaine, and Sabrina Raincomprix, Marc Anciel is the seventeenth person to become a Miraculous holder and akumatized villain, excluding Gabriel Agreste, who akumatized himself, and Marinette Dupain-Cheng who almost got akumatized.
Rooster Bold's superpower, Sublimation grants the user any ability they want. This is a reference to Marc's love for writing, essentially writing his own story using his powers.

title: Marc Anciel
text:
Marc Anciel - Trivia
Excluding Félix, who has never been fully akumatized, Marc and Marinette are the only members of the French Miraculous superhero team who has been akumatized only once.
Marc, Marinette, Jean Duparc, Aglaé and Prem are the only known students of the Collège Françoise Dupont to have only been akumatized once.
Although Nathaniel and Zoé have not been akumatized again on-screen, "Mr. Pigeon 72" reveals that Nathaniel has been akumatized into the Evillustrator five times, and Zoé has been re-akumatized into Sole Crusher in the video game "Miraculous: Paris Under Siege".
So far, Marc, Zoé, and Luka, are the only members of the French Miraculous superhero team that have not met nor interacted with Lila/Cerise, who in Season 6 onwards becomes the supervillain Chrysalis.
In "The Ruler", Marc and Nathaniel reveal their superhero identities as Rooster Bold and Caprikid to each other, becoming the third couple to learn each other's secret identities, after Alya and Nino in "Catalyst" and Kagami and Félix in "Miraculous Tokyo".
Miscellaneous
He is possibly the youngest of all of his friends as civilians and of the Miraculers.

title: Marc Anciel
text:
Marc Anciel - Trivia
Internationally, Marc debuted in "Reverser". However, the episode was released out of order and Marc's actual debut in production order was a background appearance in "Frightningale". He similarly made a background appearance in "Frozer"
The same happened with Ondine and Luka, who originally appeared for the first time in "Syren" and "Captain Hardrock", respectively.
His visible eyelashes and pink lips may imply that he wore makeup even before Season 6.
In "Gabriel Agreste", Marc is missing top part of his hair in multiple parts of the episode.
In "Penalteam", it is revealed that Marc is an avid fan of soccer and a gifted player as well.
Excluding honorary members, Marc, along with Zoé, Nathaniel, and Sabrina, are the only members of the Resistance whose code names are unknown.
He and Zoé are the only members of the resistance who aren't in Miss Bustier's class.
Marc was the last of the Miraculers to join the Resistance.
In "The Ruler", it is shown that Marc's parents support his passion for writing and his relationship with Nathaniel.

title: Marianne Lenoir
text:
Marianne Lenoir - Intro
is a minor character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She is an old comrade and wife of Master Wang Fu.
She and Fu separated during World War II, when Marianne wanted to use the Miraculouses to fight back, but Fu didn't want to risk being defeated and letting the Miracle Box fall into the wrong hands, and wanted to flee to England. Marianne decided that she wanted to do her part, with or without the magic jewels. She waited patiently for decades for the day they could reunite.
In "Backwarder", after Marinette Dupain-Cheng mistakenly gave her the wrong letter, which made her believe Fu didn't love her anymore, she was akumatized by Hawk Moth into Backwarder, a time-stealing supervillain who wanted to recover lost time. While she was akumatized, she revealed Master Fu's real name to Hawk Moth and that she knew him. After she was de-akumatized, she knew it was no longer safe for her to stay in Paris now that Hawk Moth knew that she was acquainted with the Guardian, so she went into hiding.
In "Miracle Queen", after Fu named Marinette the new Guardian and lost his memory as a result, he and Marianne reunited and moved to England.

title: Marianne Lenoir
text:
Marianne Lenoir - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Marianne is a very petite elderly woman with green eyes, light amaranth lipstick and grey hair that is tied in a bun.
Civilian Attire
As a civilian, Marianne wears a yellow blouse with a tan trench coat. She wears a yellow skirt, yellow earrings. yellow dress shoes, and yellow brooch with the Simplified Chinese ideogram (爱), which means love on it, given to her by Fu on her shirt.
As Backwarder

title: Marianne Lenoir
text:
Marianne Lenoir - Appearance
Backwarder had pale purple skin with yellow eyes, pale amaranth sclerae, and light brilliant heliotrope lipstick. Her helmet was black and teardrop-shaped with a yellow circle in the center of each side (not including the front or back), a large yellow key resembling that of a wind-up toy on top, and an upside-down teardrop-shaped pale purple face mask with holes for her eyes and mouth. She also had a small nose with two black dots beneath each eye hole, and a golden heart on the forehead, resembling a porcelain doll's face. Each time an object was touched with her sword, one of the cracks on the face of her helmet disappeared. The main body of her costume was yellow and black, with a rounded shape resembling a clockwork doll. Her chest had a stylized clock face on the front where her akuma lied, with her brooch acting as the dial. On each of her shoulders, there was a yellow spherical pauldron. Her arms were mostly black, with accenting yellow "gloves" and "boots" both having scalloped ends. Her cane had also been transformed into a black sword with a golden tip resembling a clock hand, which she used to activate her powers.

title: Marianne Lenoir
text:
Marianne Lenoir - Personality
Marianne is a strongly nostalgic person as she desires to repeat the past and make up for her lost time with Wang Fu. She is confident and patient, being prepared to confess her feelings to Fu without hesitation, waiting years for him to be ready to come to her, while she continually came to the same spot in Paris.
Marianne is shown to be a very brave, selfless, and heroic person, as she was not afraid to stay in Paris under the siege during World War II and help fight back with the resistance, allowing Fu time to escape with the Miracle Box. Years later, she decided to hide herself this time so Hawk Moth couldn't use her to track Fu.
She is also reasonable and helpful towards others like Ladybug in helping the heroes deakumatize her husband.

title: Marianne Lenoir
text:
Marianne Lenoir - Personality
As Backwarder, she became quite aggressive and ruthless. She had no qualms using her powers on civilians and bystanders, despite the danger it might have put them in, as shown when she reversed a car and a woman with her stroller, causing the two to almost collide. Similar to how she was as Marianne, she desired to reverse her age in order to make up for her lost time with Wang Fu. However, as Backwarder, she was willing to go to any lengths to accomplish this goal. She displayed a large amount of confidence in her abilities, which leads to her downfall, as she ignored Cat Noir once she made him go backwards, deeming him no longer a threat and choosing to go after Ladybug instead, unaware this was Ladybug's plan from the beginning.

title: Marianne Lenoir
text:
Marianne Lenoir - Abilities
As a Civilian
Marianne is strategic and clever, understanding that if she used her power as Backwarder, she could force Ladybug to lead her back to Fu and the Miracle Box.
As Backwarder
Wielding her clock-hand sword, anything or anyone that is touched by the tip of the sword began to move and talk backwards in time, repeating their earlier actions. She used this ability to grow stronger with every tap and redirect attacks. However, it seemed that she could not stop the things that she touched from going back in time, even if she didn't intend to use her power on them, as shown when Ladybug pushed her into a trash can to save Cat Noir, tripping her up and accidentally causing her to tap the trash can, causing all the trash to fly back out at her.
Backwarder had great speed, strength and agility, allowing her to leap great distances, as shown when she jumped to the top of a Ferris wheel with minimal effort.

title: Marianne Lenoir
text:
Marianne Lenoir - Relationships
Family
Wang Fu
Marianne met Fu years ago when he came to Paris. They started out as friends, and soon their relationship turned into love. She was trusted with knowing his secret as the Guardian of the Miraculous. When the Nazis invaded Paris looking for them while trying to escape, Marianne encouraged Fu that they could fight back, wanting to take the Ladybug Miraculous. However, he refused and wanted to escape to England with her. Understanding her lover's responsibility, she respected his decision to leave while she fought. Before parting ways, she told him to speak his heart when he returned and was given his brooch, being told he'd be back for it and her.
In "Backwarder", Marianne eagerly waited for Fu's arrival after many years. However, upon receiving the wrong letter by mistake from Ladybug, she believed that Fu didn't love her anymore and her "futile" waiting to reunite with him left her vulnerable to akumatization. In her akumatized form, she desires to reverse her age in order to make up for her lost time with him.

title: Marianne Lenoir
text:
Marianne Lenoir - Relationships
After she was de-akumatized, Marianne accepted Fu's apology of waiting too long to return and understood his fear and his isolation as the last guardian. She then warned him that during her akumatization, Hawk Moth was one step closer to finding him. Aware that her knowledge would put him and the world in danger, she understood that it was her turn to hide. The same as before when Fu wanted to attempt to say his feelings for her, she told him to wait until she got back.
In "Miracle Queen", Marianne returns for Fu, and the two are reunited. Despite his memory loss, she was happy that Fu felt like he had known her forever. With that, she encouraged him to trust his heart, and they board the train out of Paris.
During their time together, she finally married Master Fu and lived a peaceful life in London. When they leave London in "Furious Fu", they were enjoying their time together until Su-Han disrupted them, resulting in her husband's akumatization. Despite that, she tried to convince him that going after Su-Han was not worth it, and she was willing to help de-akumatize him. Afterwards, they leave Paris.
Allies
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/Ladybug

title: Marianne Lenoir
text:
Marianne Lenoir - Relationships
Not knowing Marinette personally, Marianne seemed to be aware of her alter ego, knowing of Fu's secret. She was happy that Ladybug had a letter to give to her from Fu. However, because of a letter mix-up, she was akumatized into Backwarder. After being de-akumkatized, she forgave Ladybug for the mishap and received the right letter.
Marinette was present when Marianne and Fu boarded a train out of Paris. She probably is one of the few individuals who knows Ladybug's true identity.
She was happy to reunite with Marinette again in "Furious Fu", enjoying a great picnic as well as thanking her for returning Master Fu to her after his "boating accident". She was also willing to assist Ladybug in de-akumatizing her husband.
As Backwarder, she was obsessed with striking the heroine with her powers in an attempt to find her lover. Due to that obsession, she believed that the heroine was a coward when she sacrificed her partner, unaware it was part of her plan.

title: Marianne Lenoir
text:

Before Season 3

Season 3

title: Marianne Lenoir
text:
Marianne Lenoir - History
In "Backwarder", Marianne eagerly waited for Fu's arrival. However, upon receiving the wrong letter by mistake from Ladybug, she thought that he didn't love her anymore and waited too long to reunite with him, which left her vulnerable to akumatization by Hawk Moth. As the titular villain, she spent the whole time trying to reverse her age to make up for lost time, and upon seeing Ladybug, she attempted to use her powers to lead her to her lost love. However, thanks to Ladybug's complex plan, she was de-akumatized by the heroes, after which Marianne was given the proper letter by the heroine. Reuniting with Fu, she accepted his apology of waiting too long to return and warned him that during her akumatization, Hawk Moth was one step closer to finding him. Aware that her knowledge would put him and the world in danger, Marianne understood that it was her turn to hide. The same as before when Fu wanted to say his feelings for her, she told him to wait until she got back.

title: Marianne Lenoir
text:
Marianne Lenoir - History
In "Miracle Queen" after Master Fu gave up his role as the Guardian of the Miraculous to Marinette, Marianne returned to Paris for him. Upon seeing him, she heard him say that even though they "just met" (Fu thought so because he had lost his memory as a result of giving up his Guardianship) Fu felt like he had known her forever. With that, she encouraged him to trust his heart, and they boarded the train out of Paris.
Season 4
In "Furious Fu", she and Fu are revealed to be married. They arrive back in Paris, to reunite with Marinette for a picnic, after a while their peaceful time was interrupted when Su-Han stole her husband's cane leading to Wang's akumatization despite that she urged Wang not to go after him. During the skirmish, Marianne received a call from Ladybug saying she needed her help when the fight ends in a stalemate; Marianne arrives at the football stadium unnoticed and breaks Furious Fu's paintbrush. Then, she returns to London with Wang.

title: Marianne Lenoir
text:
Marianne Lenoir - Etymology
Her name is a homage to the grandmother of Frédéric/que Engel Lenoir, one of the writers of the show. Their grandmother was a resistance fighter during World War II.

title: Marianne Lenoir
text:
Marianne Lenoir - Trivia
Marianne is aware of the Miraculouses, the Miracle Box, and Fu's duty as the Guardian.
She is the second akumatized villain with time related powers, the first being Timebreaker.
Coincidentally, both were indirectly made vulnerable to akumatization by Marinette while she tried to juggle three things at the same time: supporting her friends, fulfilling a task by an adult, and spending time with Adrien.
Marianne's name is similar to Marinette's, both including "Mari" and ending in e with double letters in front of it.
In "Furious Fu", Marianne becomes the first civilian to destroy an akumatized object, and the second non-hero, after Fang in "Lies".
Along with her husband, with them both being over 180 years old, they are the oldest known people to be akumatized.
As seen in "Backwarder" and "Evolution", she had red hair when she was younger.
In "Miracle Queen" and "Furious Fu", it's implied that she knows that Marinette is Ladybug. However, it's unknown whether she's aware of Cat Noir's secret identity.

title: Marianne Lenoir
text:
Marianne Lenoir - Trivia
In the Italian version, Marianne's akumatized identity is named Nostalgia. Both Disney Channel (when it was active) and the official Youtube channel, however, list the episode as "Viceversa", which is a translation of her English name "Backwarder". It's most likely an oversight, as in the episode's opening, its title is effectively confirmed as "Nostalgia".

title: Mallet
text:
Mallet - Intro
The  is the tool of the Ox Miraculous.
The current owner of the mallet is Ivan Bruel, who uses it as the superhero Minotaurox.
Previously, it was used by Gabriel Agreste when he used the Ox Miraculous with the other Miraculouses in his possession to become Monarch.

title: Mallet
text:
Mallet - Appearance
The mallet changes color depending on who is holding it:
When used by Minotaurox, the mallet is dark blue with gold circles on the cheek, it has a gold neck, an engraving on the head, and golden horns resembling the head of an ox. It has a curved handle adorned with a gold line on both sides and an ovular foot. Like Cat Noir's staff when not used, Minotaurox keeps it on his lower back and it resembles an ox tail.
From Season 6 and onwards, the mallet is a brighter shade of blue, the face and horns have become silver, the back has silver on it, the mallet now lacks the neck but the gold is still present and more intricate. The chamfer has gold details and the headpiece is larger with gold on the bottom. The handle has grown longer, straighter, and it has an ox hoof at the bottom. When not in use, Minotaurox keeps it on his back.
When it was used by Monarch, the mallet kept the same appearance, but instead was purple.

title: Mallet
text:
Mallet - Abilities
Although it's unknown what the full abilities of the mallet are, it's implied that like the other Miraculous tools; the mallet is nearly unbreakable and can be used to deflect attacks.
From Season 6 and onwards, to better fight the akumatized villains sent by the holder of the Butterfly Miraculous, Ladybug added a function to the mallet that allows the holder to call on any of her Miraculous Heroes (including Ladybug & Cat Noir) by picking one of their sigils from the mallet. After the holder clicks on the sigil, it sends an empathic signal to the designated hero which tells them that the holder needs their help and where to find them.

title: Mallet
text:
Mallet - Trivia
The weapon being a mallet perfectly matches Ivan as a Ox Miraculous holder due to his strength and musical capabilities.
It's the fifth tool to be worn as as a superhero outfit accessory, after the Turtle Miraculous' shield, the Mouse Miraculous' skip rope, the Tiger Miraculous' bolas and Rooster Miraculous' fountain pen.

title: Marc Anciel/History
text:
Marc Anciel/History - Intro
Marc Anciel is a skilled writer who enjoys writing down his stories in his notebook. He is a student at the Collège Françoise Dupont and a former student of Olga's class before Mayor Bustier reformed the school. He is also the current holder of the Rooster Miraculous, which he uses to transform into Rooster Bold.

title: Marc Anciel/History
text:
Marc Anciel/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Frightningale", Marc participated in Clara Nightingale's music video as one of the dancers.
In "Frozer", Marc was seen sitting with Nathaniel in the school's courtyard.
In "Reverser", Marc was under the stairs with his notebook, writing an installment called "Diary of Ladybug" and using Natheniel's art as inspiration. Then, he was found by Marinette who encouraged him to share his idea with everyone in art class. Marc went to the art club and met some of the members but was drawn to Nathaniel and his art. He soon rushed out of the class but didn't notice he dropped his writing journal. To his embarrassment, Marinette had read the journal and suggested Marc show his work to Nathaniel with the idea of the two teaming up to make a Ladybug comic book. However, Marc was hesitant to do so out of fear of Nathaniel not liking his writing and he would then have to avoid the artist.

title: Marc Anciel/History
text:
Marc Anciel/History - [[Season 2]]
He agreed to let her show Nathaniel his writings while not informing Nathaniel who wrote them so he would give it a chance. Unfortunately, Nathaniel thought the book was actually written by Ladybug and became angry at Marc at thinking he and Marinette were playing a prank on him and destroyed Marc's writings. Devastated, Marc became so upset that Hawk Moth was able to akumatize him into Reverser, a villain determined to get revenge on Marinette and change Nathaniel so he would agree to make a comic with him.
After Marc was deakumatized, he and Nathaniel cleared up the misunderstanding and started to make a comic book together and, in the end, became boyfriends.
In "Mayura", he participated in the battle against the akumatized army. After Scarlet Moth is defeated, he attends the picnic organized by Marinette and is seen sitting next to Nathaniel.

title: Marc Anciel/History
text:
Marc Anciel/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Gamer 2.0", like everyone else, he was asked by Max to test out his new game, but Marc declined his offer as he and Nathaniel were working on their latest comic with a deadline approaching. They were both captured by Gamer 2.0 as characters in his game. Reverser appears again as the final character Gamer 2.0 changes into. After Ladybug managed to defeat him, Marc and everyone were set free.
In "Party Crasher", Marc and Nathaniel are spotted by Marinette entering the Agreste estate despite an earlier text message to Alix claiming they were working on gaining back lost work for their latest comic. They are greeted by their friends inside and join in the guys only party until Party Crasher arrives. During the chaos, Marc is momentarily shown to have been captured by Party Crasher until King Monkey freed them.
In "Félix", Marc is seen with Nathaniel and Alix as everyone is planning to send Adrien videos in the hope of comforting him on the day of his mother vanishing.
In "Miracle Queen", Marc is seen sitting with Nathaniel among other couples.

title: Marc Anciel/History
text:
Marc Anciel/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Sole Crusher", Zoé was a new student in his class with miss Mendeleiev and in the end of the episode, he becomes Zoe's new friend.
In "Gabriel Agreste", he and Nathaniel come up a plan to get Marinette and Adrien together. They made a fairy tale story about a knight and a princess.
In "Guiltrip", when Rose is discovered to have an unknown ailment, Marc is one of those who begins giving her special treatment to make things easier for her.
In "Hack-San", he was making a comic book with Nathaniel when an akumatized Markov sent a wave of calls out to hypnotize those who answered. Marc answered the call and was ordered to give his most valuable possession to Robostus. Marc turns the phone to Nathaniel while claiming the manga they're working on is his most treasured item, Nathaniel being absorbed as well. For most of the remainder of the episode, Marc is trapped in the trance and is ordered to catch Cat Noir and Scarabella. Near the end, everything is returned to normal and Marc and everyone else that had been hypnotized are freed.
In "Rocketear", Marc and Nathaniel are in a classroom together when everyone hears the fight between Rocketear and Cat Noir taking place outside.

title: Marc Anciel/History
text:
Marc Anciel/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Penalteam", Marc is seen dragging Nathaniel to a soccer stadium where a game is about to begin. He tries convincing Nathaniel that soccer is more enjoyable than he thinks and doesn't need to worry about hurting his hands. When Nathaniel is unwavering in his decision, he asks Marc to provide an excuse for him not to attend the game. Marc begrudgingly agrees and tells the teachers an excuse why Nathaniel won't be attending. Now a player short, Mr. Didier offers an invitation for Marc to join them. The writer is hesitant to accept as he believes he is not good at the sport but, when asked to pass the ball to the journalist, shows nifty skills that make the red team quickly insist he should join them.
After Chloe became Penalty and Ladybug seeks others to help in the soccer match, Ladybug offers Marc the Rooster Miraculous. Marc doesn't feel confident to become a holder, but Ladybug reminds him how he is more talented than he realizes. He accepts the Miraculous and meets Orikko. He and the rest of the new miraculous holders show up and he named himself Rooster Bold.

title: Marc Anciel/History
text:
Marc Anciel/History - [[Season 4]]
As the first match with Penalteam didn't go so well, Ladybug admitted to forgetting they are a team, and she was playing a solo match. Rooster Bold and Miss Hound shared their doubts of being needed but Ladybug assured them they are excellent players. Rooster Bold quickly became one of the biggest threats to the Penalteam thanks to a combination of his own skills and the Sublimation ability guaranteeing him to score every time he has the ball. The Ladybug team won in the end. When everyone agreed that Chloe did not have to play if she did not want to, Marc is joyful when Nathaniel willingly offers to play and, with an arm around each other, watch as Sabrina stands up to Chloe in wanting to stay in the game.

title: Marc Anciel/History
text:
Marc Anciel/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Strikeback", Marc was one of those marked with the symbol of Risk. Rooster Bold helped Ladybug and friends beat the sentimonsters by using his special ability to make copies of the Lucky Charm sunglasses. When Flairmidable had stolen Ladybug's yo-yo and gave all the remaining miraculous to Gabriel, this would make it temporarily impossible for Marc to become Rooster Bold again. While many of the other holders are shown reacting to Shadow Moth's announcement of having the other Miraculous, Marc is not seen reacting.

title: Marc Anciel/History
text:
Marc Anciel/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Reunion", Marc joins Miss Bustier's class in looking at photos and listening to the letter Alix left her father detailing people she has met during her travels. Like the others, he is surprised when Alix's brother has an outburst of his disappointment of their father allowing Alix to leave with the Rabbit miraculous.
In "Transmission" Marc, Nathaniel, and their friends were trying to make a plan for Marinette and Adrien's meeting.
In "Deflagration", Marc was defending Marinette while she was bullied by Chloe.
In "Perfection", he was helping with the others for Marinette confessing his feelings to Adrien.
In "Migration", he joined to Juleka and Luka's reunion for Kitty Section's show. He witnessed when Bob Roth tricked the band into signing contracts but only kept Luka. When the producer was akumatized, he and the others tried to stay clear of his records. At the final, he felt sad about Luka leaving Paris.
In "Protection", he and Nathaniel made a comic about Marinette and Adrien confessing their feelings to each other and helping try to get together. But nothing was working. Marc felt bad about Marinette.

title: Marc Anciel/History
text:
Marc Anciel/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Adoration", he is the class's deputy and announces the class had elected Zoe to be the class representative for an upcoming dance.
In "Representation", he joined the Resistance, celebrating the end of school at the Eiffel Tower. He was holding hands with Nathaniel when Marinette accidentally interrupted. At seeing she is crying, Marc questioned if she is alright.
In "Conformation", he and others were attacked by nightmares with Alliance rings.
In "Re-creation", he and the others helped the people to take out the Alliance rings. After Gabriel Agreste's death, he was having fun at the Agreste mansion with all of his friends and played soccer with Sabrina.
After Marinette repaired all of the Miraculous, he got back the Rooster Miraculous, becoming the permanent owner of his miraculous, taking care of his kwami, Orikko, and will save Paris with the Miraculers.

title: Marc Anciel/History
text:
Marc Anciel/History - [[Season 6]]
In "Climatiqueen",
In "Revelator", Marc is seen with the other Miraculous holders trying to evolve their powers to be able to use them as long as he wants. He is seen successfully achieving this goal.

title: Marc Anciel/History
text:
Marc Anciel/History - [[Season 6]]
In "The Ruler", Marc and Nathaniel were working to release a new and popular comic but Nathaniel undergoing familial problems put things on hold. Although Marc understood the situation, he agreed to make changes to their project that neither one wanted to do and later encouraged Nathaniel not to abandon his passion. When Mrs. Kurtzberg was akumatized and tried to force Nathaniel away, Marc right away jumped into action to prevent this from happening. Being stamped by The Ruler and ordered to stay away was what caused Nathaniel to finally stand up to his mother and help Lady Bug and Cat Noir. With the fight done, Marc accompanied Nathaniel for support when getting his parents reactions of their latest comic. With Nathaniel's parents finally accepting Nathaniel's choices, the two teens later talk about how their comic got such reactions. When Marc and Nathaniel promise to always be there for each other, Marc asks that Nathaniel not put himself in danger for him since he doesn't have superpowers. With Nathaniel revealing he is Caprikid, Marc's surprise quickly turns to joy before he reveals he is Rooster Bold.

title: Manhattan
text:
Manhattan - Intro
is a borough of New York City. It is the historical, economic, cultural and touristic heart of the city. Manhattan is famous worldwide for its skyscrapers and its emblematic places.

title: Manhattan
text:
Manhattan - Description
Located largely on an island bounded by the Hudson to the west, the Harlem River to the north, the East River to the east and the New York Bay to the south, Manhattan is a municipality with an area of ​​56.98 km2.
The borough is the iconic area of ​​New York City. In addition to the skyscrapers that testify to the economic and financial power of the city, Manhattan is rich in historical and cultural places of international importance. All this makes Manhattan one of the main destinations and tourist destinations in the United States.

The name Maino'li has no attested origin and can be interpreted in different ways.

title: Manikarnika Ghat
text:
Manikarnika Ghat - Intro
The  are Hindu places of worship erected on the bank of the Ganges, in Varanasi, India.

title: Manikarnika Ghat
text:
Manikarnika Ghat - Description
Ghats are series of stairs, or steps, leading down to the water, most often built on the banks of sacred rivers, such as the Ganges. Hindus go there to perform ritual ablutions, offerings to the deities, and also funerary rites.
The ghats of Varanasi are the most popular and attract many pilgrims. There are 84 of them and they are important because of the Hindu belief that dying in Varanasi erases sins and ends the cycle of reincarnation. Thus, two of these ghats are dedicated to the cremation of the dead, the most famous of which is Manikarnika, one of the oldest and most sacred in Varanasi.
As a result, the gaths are built very close to the buildings and many boats are moored there.

title: Manikarnika Ghat
text:
Manikarnika Ghat - Trivia
Because of their importance and the various Hindu rites performed there, the ghats are responsible for some of the pollution of the Ganges.

title: Majestia (Actionverse)
text:
Majestia (Actionverse) - Intro
Majestia is a superheroine in the United States of America and a member of the American superhero team.

title: Majestia (Actionverse)
text:
Majestia (Actionverse) - Appearance
Physical appearance
Tallish in height, Majestia has short blonde hair and blue eyes.
As Majestia
She wears a red sleeveless vest with a swan-necked collar, three gold stars and two jagged gold lines on the front, and a zipper-like line down the center of the front, along with a long coattail. Underneath the vest, she has a blue suit with exposed shoulders and long sleeves, and she wears red knee-high boots with two jagged gold lines around the upper edge.

title: Majestia (Actionverse)
text:
Majestia (Actionverse) - Personality
Majestia is brave, friendly, and reliable. She kindly explains information to Ladybug and Cat Noir, such as the need to defeat the Trash Krakken. While she can get impatient and annoyed on occasion, Majestia has a positive, understanding and determined outlook in general about a situation. This allows her to get along well with the superheroes she knows.

title: Majestia (Actionverse)
text:
Majestia (Actionverse) - Abilities
Majestia can fly even at extremely great heights.

title: Majestia (Actionverse)
text:
Majestia (Actionverse) - History
Miraculous Adventures
In the end of "Silurus", after Doorman opens a portalfrom Paris to New York for Ladybug, Majestia greets he Parisian superheroine, announcing that America needs her help. Majestia approaches the edge of the roof, showing Ladybug and Cat Noir what the city destroyed by the villain names as the Trash Krakken. However, Ladybug and Cat Noir running off to detransform, thus surprising their new allies before parting ways over the rooftops.
Later in "The Big Leagues", she notices that Ladybug and Cat Noir are late, after which they return to Majestia, Knightowl, Sparrow, Uncanny Valley, and Doorman fifteen minutes after they originally left. Camilla Hombee arrives by helicopter and reveals her secret identity as Victory, Majestia congenially notes that Victory doesn't need to wear the mask as everyone knows her secret identity. President talking with Ladybug, after which the Parisian superheroine feels awkward. Majestia tries to calm her down. After explaining the plan to defeat the villain, Victory instructs Majestia to launch the Uncanny Valley into orbit around the planet. The women obey, joining the other superheroes waiting in space.

title: Majestia (Actionverse)
text:
Majestia (Actionverse) - History
In "Battle for New York", Sparrow is captured by the villain, after which Knightowl calls Victory to begin the operation. She signals everyone to prepare. Majestia and the other heroes head toward Earth. Moments later, she receives orders from Knightowl to stop, as they can solve the problem another way. Majestia stops the others. After defeating the Trash Krakken, the American superheroes, still on the same rooftop, thanked Ladybug and Cat Noir for their help, did the "Pound It". Majestia congratulates the young heroes on a job well done. Before leaving, the Parisian heroes thank them and say their goodbyes.

title: Majestia (Actionverse)
text:
Majestia (Actionverse) - Relationships
Friends/Allies
Camilla Hombee/Victory
Majestia follows Victory's commands loyally, trusting in her judgement to cause a lot of damage in order to stop the Trash Krakken despite temporarily stopping it after getting a less risky plan. When Victory reveals herself in her superhero costume, Majestia congenially notes that Victory doesn't need to wear the mask as everyone knows her secret identity.
Acquaintances
Ladybug and Cat Noir
Majestia supports and assists Ladybug and Cat Noir, informing them about the Trash Krakken situation and other superheroes. Their sudden departure to de-transform confuses her. She becomes irked when they come back later than promised, but she doesn't hold it against them for long. In particular, Majestia strongly believes that Ladybug is important to the success of stopping the Trash Krakken, noting that they're all counting on her. She trusts Ladybug and Cat Noir with their own plan to the point of stalling and halting Knightowl's plan at Cat Noir's request. Also, Majestia considers Ladybug and Cat Noir's feelings toward each other as "young love", much to the annoyance of Ladybug.

title: Majestia (Actionverse)

To communicate with her allies, Majestia has a special phone, painted in the colors of her costume.

title: Marinette's derby hat
text:
Marinette's derby hat - Intro
(also called a bowler hat) is a hat designed by Marinette Dupain-Cheng. In "Mr. Pigeon", it won a fashion competition judged by Gabriel Agreste at Collège Françoise Dupont and the prize is that the hat will be worn by Adrien Agreste during his next photo shoot.

title: Marinette's derby hat
text:
Marinette's derby hat - Appearance
The derby hat is dark gray with fabric overlapped on the crown to look like feathers. The black band has a golden squiggly line on it, part of it actually making Marinette's name, which is seen when the hat is flipped upside down. There is also a light gray bow attached to one side of the hat, along with a pigeon feather attached onto the bow with a moderate orange button.
Following the contest, Marinette swapped the pigeon feather with a synthetic feather to prevent Adrien from sneezing whilst wearing the hat in the future.
In "Style Queen", when Adrien was turned into a statue by Style Queen, the derby hat became completely gold.

title: Marinette's derby hat
text:
Marinette's derby hat - Trivia
Tikki's observation in Xavier Ramier inspired Marinette in the hat's creation.
The hat possesses a unique design that utilizes Marinette's own signature, a helpful way to ascertain authenticity.
Because of the real pigeon feather originally used in the hat, Adrien, who is allergic to feathers, has an allergic response to it.
However, by the time of his photo shoot, Marinette replaced it with an artificial feather.
Chloé Bourgeois makes Sabrina Raincomprix steal Marinette's design and makes a replica of the derby hat, but because of Marinette's signature, it is revealed that Chloé is not the designer of the hat.
In her instagram she was proud to have it featured in her first magazine feature.

title: Marinette's diaries
text:
Marinette's diaries - Intro
are notebooks that Marinette uses as a diaries. Along with appearing in the regular series, they are featured in Miraculous Secrets whenever Marinette writes in them.

title: Marinette's diaries
text:
Marinette's diaries - Appearance
Marinette's diaries are semi-circled notebook when not opened. They are pink with white polka-dots and black edges that closes with black, pink-edged strap. They are accompanied by a black pen with a golden clip that Marinette uses to write with.

title: Marinette's diaries
text:
Marinette's diaries - Trivia
In "Darkblade", Marinette makes a matching magic box with the same shape to keep the diary safe from being read and revealing her secrets. If someone except for Marinette tries to steal her diary, it clamps shut on their hand and the only way for it to be opened after that is to be unlocked by a key only Marinette has.
Marinette's diary contains all her secrets. If anyone else were to read it, her identity would be revealed, which an akumatized Luka nearly does in "Truth" and what Marinette Dupain-Cheng of an alternate universe does in "Miraculous Paris".
It was also by Marinette's diary that Shadybug learned about the Ultimate Miraculous Absolute Power.
In "Heartfixer", it's revealed that Marinette has filled up multiple diaries over the seasons, with the old ones being hidden at various locations in her room.
Two diaries, hidden under the floorboards, are from the first three seasons, before she became the guardian.
Three more, hidden behind a secret door in her wall, are from seasons 4 and 5, before Monarch was defeated.

title: Marinette's diaries
text:
Marinette's diaries - Trivia
And more than twenty diaries, hidden in a compartment behind her class photo (then in "Reflekta"), are just from when she started keeping the truth from Adrien at the end of Season 5.
According to Tikki, at least fifteen of those diaries are from the same month that the episode takes place in.

text:
Marinette's bracelet - Intro
, also known as Marinette's lucky charm, is a bracelet that Marinette owned for good luck.
In "Gamer", she gives it to Adrien to cheer him up, claiming that it provides good luck.
In "Gorizilla", Placide I.T. is akumatized, and the akuma lands on the bracelet he's holding and it becomes his akumatized object.
In "Lies", after Kagami confronts Adrien for lying to her, it becomes her akumatized object.

title: Marinette's bracelet
text:
Marinette's bracelet - Appearance
The bracelet is made from red string, which is bent into a loop on one side when the bracelet is not tied onto a wrist. The bracelet has eight beads: a light blue bead, a large pink bead, a small yellow bead, a small black bead, a square green bead engraved with a four-leaf clover, a sky-blue bead, a tiny red bead, and a second large pink bead slightly smaller than the first.

title: Marinette's bracelet
text:
Marinette's bracelet - Trivia
In a deleted scene of "Gamer", as seen towards the end of the storyboard (Part 2), when Adrien gives up his place in the tournament to Marinette, he tries to give the bracelet back to her, but he's dragged away by Nino before she's able to grab it. Adrien then pockets the lucky charm.
In a post on Adrien's instagram, he mentions that he wore it during two fencing matches.
The bracelet has become the akumatized object of two different akumatized villains, with those being Gorizilla and Lies.
This is the only object that has been akumatized twice with their holders being different villains.

title: Marinette's dolls
text:
Marinette's dolls - Intro
are five plush dolls made by Marinette Dupain-Cheng. They are based on Ladybug, Cat Noir, Lady Wifi, Evillustrator and Rogercop.
In "The Puppeteer", when Manon was akumatized into Puppeteer, she uses these dolls to control the people they are based on.

title: Marinette's dolls
text:
Marinette's dolls - Appearance
The dolls are made out of cloth and felt, and their eyes are black round buttons. Their arms are attached to their bodies with white string, and they have round heads.
The dolls' designs are simplified versions of Ladybug, Cat Noir, Lady Wifi, Evillustrator, and Rogercop.

title: Marinette's dolls
text:
Marinette's dolls - Trivia
Despite the fact that Marinette created these dolls, random children can be seen with similar dolls.
With that it's possible that Marinette made more than one set or someone else admired the dolls and decided to have them manufactured so other kids could have their own.
In "Catalyst" and "Hack-San", the Ladybug doll has appeared in various situations, being a copy of the doll created by Marinette.
In "Miraculous Paris", Claw Noir briefly plays with the Ladybug and Cat Noir dolls while mocking his and Shadybug's good counterparts.
The official ZAG store is currently selling real-life replicas of these dolls.
The Ladybug doll is available as of April 26, 2022.
The Cat Noir doll is available as of August 01, 2022.
The Lady Wifi doll is available as of April 03, 2023.
The Evillustrator doll is available as of April 05, 2023.
As of January 2024, it's unknown when the ZAG store would start selling the Rogercop doll.

title: Marinette's purse
text:
Marinette's purse - Intro
is a purse made and owned by Marinette Dupain-Cheng. She used the purse to put Tikki in so that she can transformed into Ladybug.
In "Ladybug", after Marinette is expelled from school for being framed for stealing the Mock Exam answers, cheating on a test, pushing Lila down the stairs and stealing Lila's necklace, it becomes her akumatized object which was supposed to transform Marinette into Princess Justice.
In "Heartfixer", after Adrien breaks up with her and refuses to hear her explanations, it becomes her akumatized object as Heartfixer.

title: Marinette's purse
text:
Marinette's purse - Appearance
Normal
In the first saga, the purse is light pink with white polka-dots and a golden clasp. The inside is red, and on one side, there is a light pink, white, and black flowery design, with an M initial inside of a circle. Connected to both sides of her purse is a black cord strap.
From season 6 onwards, the purse now has a different shade of pink, and it has a new flower design, while the cord strap is now dark burgundy. The inside is now pink.
Gina's design
The purse was made out of an infant's T-shirt Gina Bianchi got Marinette for her fourteenth birthday, having mistaken her age. It is tan with a stylised owl on it. The owl has nine black lines protruding from its head, each topped with a yellow circle. Nine more black lines protrude from its body and are topped with red circles. Five red puffs on stiff strings hang from the bottom of the purse. Like Marinette's usual purse, the purse made out of the T-shirt has a golden clasp with red baubles on it and a black cord strap.
Akumatized
Under the effect of Marinette's akumatization in Heartfixer, the purse had transformed into a mauve crystal heart.

title: Marinette's purse
text:
Marinette's purse - Trivia
Tikki usually hides in the purse, Plagg also hid in the purse briefly in "Miraculous New York".
Marinette's purse also carries:
Her phone.
Snacks for Tikki.
Money. This is first shown in "Stormy Weather" where she uses money from her purse to pay for the balloon she buys for Manon Chamack.
Her ID card. This was shown in "Oblivio" and later in "Miraculous Shanghai".
In "Befana", Marinette designs her purse with a pattern from a shirt that her grandmother Gina Bianchi gave to her as a birthday present.
In "Ladybug", the purse is infected by a scarlet akuma, which almost leads Marinette to get akumatized into Princess Justice.
Errors
In many episodes of the series, the flower logo is sometimes missing, especially in the early episodes of Season 1.
In many shots of episodes, the entire purse actually disappears and reappears between camera cuts.
The purse often clips through Marinette's clothes or switches sides (usually it's on her left, but it flips to her right in some errors).
At times the purse appears or disappears:

title: Marinette's purse
text:
Marinette's purse - Trivia
In "Stormy Weather", when Marinette arrives at the park, the purse is missing, but after the following scene where Mireille Caquet gets iced by Stormy Weather, Marinette's purse appears.
In the final scene in "The Evillustrator", when Marinette was talking to Adrien, her purse disappears, but after a few frames later, it suddenly reappears.
In "The Bubbler", when Marinette transforms into Ladybug for the first time, she doesn't have her purse. However, after she uses Lucky Charm and de-transforms, she has it.
In "The Mime", when Marinette detransforms at the beginning of the episode, she can be briefly seen wearing her purse. However, the very next shot has the purse disappeared.
In "Guitar Villain", when Marinette is working on her first version of Jagged Stone's new album her purse is absent after the scene shifts focus on XY's album for a few frames and then it returns to her.
In "Volpina", When Marinette enters the school library, her purse is missing.
In "Gorizilla", in most shots in the episode, Marinette has her purse, although she wasn't supposed to.
In "Frozer", when Marinette runs up to Adrien, the purse disappears for a few shots, then reappears a few seconds later.

title: Marinette's purse
text:
Marinette's purse - Trivia
In "Miraculous New York", the purse disappeared for a few seconds on the plane to New York.
In "Miraculous Shanghai", In a few scenes, especially after having her purse stolen, Marinette is wearing her purse, when it should've been at Cash's store.
In "Sole Crusher", Marinette did not have her purse when she was in her room at her sewing machine working on a design, but when Chloé came up while escaping the eponymous villain, Marinette is shown to be wearing her purse, but when it cuts to her when Chloé asks her to help her barricade the door, her purse disappeared. The same error happens when Cat Noir arrives and jumps on a rooftop of a building and unknowingly interrupts Marinette in the middle of trying to reason with Sole Crusher, Marinette wore her purse for a brief moment despite her not having it on prior when Sole Crusher grabbed her. In the next shot, when it cuts to Marinette after she yells at Cat Noir and she continues to try to reason with Sole Crusher, the purse disappeared once again.
In "Representation", before Marinette puts her dress on her mirror, she had her purse, but after she put her dress on the mirror, it disappears.

title: Marinette's purse
text:
Marinette's purse - Trivia
When she detransforms in "Re-creation", she doesn't have it, despite wearing it throughout the previous episode.
In "Revelator", When Marinette and Adrien arrive at the theater, Marinette has her purse even though she didn't have it earlier when they enter the theater, but when they exit the theater, her purse disappears.

Starting from season 6, Marinette's cellphone has a completely pink case with small five-petaled flowers of a slightly darker pink drawn on it. On the top edge of the screen, it has a small round camera, and on the back, on the top left, it has four round cameras arranged in a square.

title: Marinette's cellphone
text:
Marinette's cellphone - Trivia
As seen in "Mr. Pigeon", "Lady Wifi" and "Miraculous Shanghai", Marinette's phone number is +33653257.
In "Kung Food", Marinette has an app on her phone that teaches her how to speak Chinese. She used it to talk to his uncle when he came to Paris to participate in a gastronomic competition.
In "Oblivio", Marinette's phone wallpaper is a picture of Adrien.
In "Miraculous Shanghai", it is shown that Marinette has an unknown social network and a GPS on her phone.
Also in "Miraculous Shanghai", after Fei stole Marinette's purse that contained her cellphone, she destroyed her SIM. This means that, after retrieving her cellphone and then returning to Paris, Marinette bought a new SIM card and put all her friends and parents' numbers back on her cellphone.
In "Elation", it's shown that Marinette has an mobile application created by Max Kanté on her phone which allows her to find André's ice cream cart.
Marinette's cell phone in the first saga looks like a Samsung Galaxy S3 a 5, apart from a few minor differences.
In the second saga, the cell phone resembles a Motorola from the Moto G or Edge line, because of the four cameras on the back.

title: Marinette's magic box
text:
Marinette's magic box - Intro
is a wooden box that Marinette Dupain-Cheng made to store her diary. Its purpose is to prevent anyone from stealing the diary and discovering important secrets, such as her being Ladybug.

title: Marinette's magic box
text:
Marinette's magic box - Appearance
The magic box is a semi-circular chest with a similar shape and color theme as the diary with a keyhole located on the edge. The inside is colored red with an oval-shaped mirror on the top half in the center. The chest comes with a yellow key with a red ribbon that Marinette carries with her. Its lock is designed similar to a ladybug but with a pink shell instead of red.
If someone tries to pick up Marinette's diary while the chest is open, it will close and lock, trapping the invader's hand inside. The only way to unlock it is with a key that Marinette keeps with her.

title: Marinette's magic box
text:
Marinette's magic box - Trivia
In "Darkblade", Sabrina Raincomprix tries to steal Marinette's diary for Chloé Bourgeois, but the box traps her hand. At the end of the episode, Marinette frees Sabrina's hand.
In "Darkblade", Marinette unlocks the box for Sabrina via the lock on top of the box, but in "Gamer", she locks it via the hole that the arm gets trapped in.
In "Miraculous Paris", Shadybug tore off the lid of the box, thus getting hold of the diary while avoiding getting her hand trapped. It is possible that she made her own box and therefore knew about its purpose.
But uses the Miraculous Ladybug superpower to fix the magic box.

is a balcony that is used and owned by Marinette Dupain-Cheng, located above and accessible from her room in the Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie.

title: Marinette's balcony
text:
Marinette's balcony - Appearance
Marinette's balcony can be accessed via a trapdoor located directly above her bed and has a grand view of the Notre Dame Cathedral, as well as overlooking the Place des Vosges park across the street. The terrace is in a hexagonal shape and encompassed by a wrought iron railing with an intricate design. A flower box of roses embellishes the left side.
Colorful ornament lights wrap around a white triangular awning, and below them is a pink striped deck chair. A white box and a terracotta pot of blue flowers are situated in front of it. On the other side of the trapdoor are the wifi tower and an arrangement of plants, in order from tallest to shortest. In the center of the terrace is a spool tea table. The smaller furniture that adorns the balcony is varying, sometimes including additional flower pots or boxes.
As of season six, her balcony is more decorated than the seasons of one to five.
