Lady Ice, in addition to her original powers, also has enhanced skating capabilities as well as the ability to handle extremely low temperatures.
As Cosmobug
Cosmobug, in addition to her normal powers, also has the ability to survive at high altitudes and in space as well as the ability to move freely and quickly while up in the air due to her jetpack; indeed she can use her jetpack to fly from Paris to London and back in less than a night. Furthermore, much like in space, having her helmet on also allows her to breathe and survive underwater, at least for a brief time. To transform back to Ladybug, she says Retrogradation.
As Lady Noire
Lady Noire had the same abilities as her partner, such as more enhanced skills, like speed, agility, and strength, that she was almost invulnerable to physical damage. She had enhanced senses such as hearing, smell, night vision, and super stealth like a cat.
Like Cat Noir, Lady Noire could use her staff efficiently, wielding it as a sword, being able to spin it at high speeds to form a shield, and taking advantage of its length-changing features. To travel long distances, she used her staff and its variety in length to vault over obstacles.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng
text:

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng - Etymology
The name "Marinette" is a diminutive of the name "Marine" which means "of the sea" in French, recalls the meaning "little sailor girl" and Sailor Moon's title, which Miraculous is heavily inspired by.
In the English version, the pronunciation of the name Marinette with "mar" as in "marry" is used, and in French, the pronunciation is as in "Maximum", and in other countries, the pronunciation with "mar" as in "margin" is used.
In The Mini Menace Ladybug, her original name was Marietta.
In "Befana", Gina Bianchi (Marinette's paternal grandmother) calls her Marinetta.
Marinette's surnames Dupain & Cheng each have meanings to them.
The French surname Dupain means "of the bread" or "bread" (a reference to her father's job as a baker and both his and Marinette's own skills at baking).
The Chinese surname Cheng can mean "completed, finished, succeeded" (成) or "sincere, honest, true" (诚).
However, Cheng is usually written as "程" when used as a surname in Chinese.
The "completed" meaning of Cheng might reference Ladybug's battles against Gabriel and his Akumatized villains.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng - Etymology
Which foreshadowed Marinette's final battle as Bug Noire against Gabriel as Monarch and, especially, how not "Ladybug" or "Bug Noire" succeeded in beating Monarch, but she did by reaching out to him and making him change his wish to end in a positive result.
The "honest" meaning of Cheng is somewhat ironic because Marinette while she is generally honest and actually dislikes liars, her duty as Ladybug and later as Guardian forced her to lie to the world, especially to those closest to her.
Ladybug, Marinette's main superhero name, references the type of small beetle on which the eponymous Miraculous is based on.
Since this name contains the word "Lady", Cat Noir, who's known to make puns, came to affectionately refer to her as "M' Lady".
Aquabug is a portmanteau of her "Ladybug" superhero name and "aqua" which is the Latin word for "water" and references how she activates "Aqua Mode" to breathe underwater,
Ladyice is a portmanteau of her "Ladybug" superhero name and "ice", referencing how she activated "Ice Mode" to survive at low/freezing temperatures.
She is mistakenly called "Icebug" by Clara Contard in "Stormy Weather 2".

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng - Etymology
The name is spelled as "Lady Ice" by Philippe in a flashback in "Destruction".
Interestingly her name Icebug, despite being a mistake, comes from not only a footwear company that sells cold weather shoes but it's also the name of a rare family of bugs that live in the cold.
She is known as "Snowbug" in Bandai merchandise, but it's unknown if it was an early name before being changed later in production, and the name was accidentally left in the toyline.
Lady Noire's name translates to "Black Lady", referring to the black of her costume.
Lady Noire's nickname "She-Cat Noir" given by Reflekta is a reference to She-Hulk from Marvel Comics.
In "Reflekdoll", Mister Bug (Cat Noir using the Ladybug Miraculous) jokingly "accused" her of taking this name so he could still refer to her as "M'Lady".
Lady Noire's name is a nod to the fan ship name given to the relationship between Ladybug and Cat Noir.
Both the official Instagram and the Miraculous Ladybug & Cat Noir running app spell this name as "Lady Noir".
Multimouse comes from a mouse's high reproductive rate.
On the official YouTube channel, Multimouse's name is spelled "Multi Mouse".

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng - Etymology
Her name was originally meant to be Polymouse, but due to a mistake during production, she became Multimouse, and Mylène Haprèle later took the name Polymouse for her own hero identity.
Multifox is a portmanteau of her "Multimouse" superhero name and "fox", referencing how she unified the Mouse and Fox Miraculouses.
Multinoire is a portmanteau of her "Multimouse" and "Lady Noire" superhero names as she is a fusion of the two forms.
Multibug is a portmanteau of her "Multimouse" and "Ladybug" superhero names as she is a fusion of the two forms.
Dragon Bug is a portmanteau of her "Ladybug" superhero name and "dragon", referencing how she unified the Ladybug and Dragon Miraculouses.
Depending on the official sources, the name of her Ladybug-Dragon fusion form can be spelled as either "Dragon Bug" or "Dragonbug"
Cosmobug is a portmanteau of her "Ladybug" superhero name and "cosmos", which is another word for universe, whose volume is mostly represented by "outer space", an empty vacuum that exists between celestial bodies like planets, and references how she activates "space mode" to be able to travel through the cosmos and survive in the vacuum of space.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng - Etymology
Lady Bee's name is a portmanteau of her "Ladybug" superhero name and "Queen Bee" which was Chloé's hero name before she lost her powers permanently and is also a term used to describe a woman who dominates, leads a group or is in a favored position; while in Chloé's case, the term signifies her dominating personality and former position of power as the mayor's daughter, in Ladybug's case, it emphasizes her position as the leader of Team Miraculous.
In one of the first concept art of the Lady Bee fusion, her name was originally BeeBug.
Pegabug's name is a portmanteau of her "Ladybug" superhero name and "Pegasus", the superhero name of Max Kanté while transformed with the Horse Miraculous.
Pennybug's name is a combination of three hero names – "Pegasus", "Bunnyx" and "Ladybug".
Ladyfly is a portmanteau of the name "Ladybug" and the word "butterfly".
Ladybiquity is a portmanteau of her "Ladybug" superhero name and "Ubiquity", the name of the kamikotized hero form of Marinette's friend Alya as well as Alya's counterpart from the Re-verse.
Bug Noire's name translates to "Black Bug".

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng - Etymology
Since Bug Noire is the fused form of Marinette's superhero variations with the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses, respectively, whose names both include the term "Lady" (Ladybug and Lady Noire), accurately, her name is a combination of the second halves of both names (Ladybug and Lady Noire).
As well as her connection to Cat Noir as the fused form is a combination of the second halves of both their names (Ladybug and Cat Noir). Reminding her that they are always together as friends, teammates and lovers.
Chronobug is a portmanteau of her "Ladybug" superhero name and "Chronos", the name of the Primordial God of time from Greek and Roman mythology, referencing how she took this form to travel through time and stop Timestalker from finding out her identity while helping Bunnyx differentiate her from her other counterparts from different moments in time.
While the original Ladybug's red coloring is based on the known red variation of the insect, Chronobug's yellow coloring is based on yellow-colored ladybugs, which are a color variation of the Chinese ladybird, a specific type of ladybugs. This is fitting, since Marinette herself is half-Chinese.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng - Etymology
Viperbug is a portmanteau of the word "viper" and the name "Ladybug."
She likely used the word viper because of its use in the name of Viperion, the regular owner of the Snake Miraculous.
Bunnybug is similar to Pennybug in that it combines the word "bunny" and the name "Ladybug."
Bunnynette is a portmanteau of "bunny" and her civilian name, Marinette.
Interestingly, both Marinette and Alix used the same system to make their Rabbit Miraculous superhero names.
Renardette is a portmanteau of "rena" (French Creole for "fox" and first half of Alya's Fox Miraculous holder identity) and her civilian name, Marinette.
Interestingly, the "ette" part of the name is also a female suffix used in French to refer to a small version of something, causing her name to mean "little fox".

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng - Development
Thomas Astruc created Ladybug around 2005 when he was exchanging drawings on post-it notes with another worker and made one with the superheroine.
Marinette's design has changed over time from the original Ladybug PV version.
Her anime design included jean shorts.
As Ladybug, she had a red face mask without black spots and two long red ribbons attached to each pigtail. She also lacked freckles.
In the PV, Marinette's earrings were always red with five spots, no matter if she was Ladybug or Marinette. She only wore them as a civilian when needing to transform.
PV Ladybug's costume differs from the CGI Ladybug as well, with PV Ladybug's spots being found only on her torso (her legs and feet were completely red, as well as the mask) and wearing a ladybug-themed bag instead of having a yo-yo. PV Ladybug's hair and hair ribbons are also significantly longer than the current version of Ladybug, and she has an ahoge, which means "foolish hair" in Japanese.
The yo-yo didn't exist; PV Ladybug fought using hand-to-hand combat.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng - Development
PV Ladybug was less shy around her crush, as she's able to be very close to Félix Agreste without panicking or being nervous. She even asks him out while slightly blushing and looking right at him, although Félix coldly refuses.
Although her name in the PV was Marinette, many fans of the early version call her "Bridgette" to differentiate the two.
In "The Art of Miraculous", from early designs Ladybug was supposed to use her yo-yo "in more dynamic and diverse ways".
Marinette's CGI design seems to have gone through a change as well. Earlier footage and images of Marinette included dark bluish-black hair, red tips of hair at the end of her pigtails, and gray eyes.
In a placeholder animation, Ladybug was seen wielding a sword. Whether or not this was to be used as a new weapon or a Lucky Charm object is unknown.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng - Development
During the earlier stages of development, Ladybug wasn't allowed to abuse her powers of good luck, or else something bad would happen to her. As of now, it is unknown if she still has this issue since, as seen in "The Bubbler", all that happens when she selfishly uses Lucky Charm is that she runs out of power and loses her transformation, which is no longer the case after she gained access to her adult powers in "Revolution".
Both prototype versions of Marinette have her mask be the last piece of her costume to materialize during her transformation. In the final version, her mask is instead the first piece to materialize.
In the designs for Ladybee:
Before the bands and borders in her costume were yellow they started as metallic gold.
Back when Marinette's Bee Miraculous holder was Beebug her suit was completely yellow.
In the designs for Chronobug her suit was originally half yellow with white spots and the other half being her normal suit.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng - Trivia
"Plastic - The Story So Far", which is the first, and so far only time Marinette in any form is absent in any Miraculous media.
According to Thomas Astruc, the reason for the simplicity of Ladybug's first suit is that she wasn't ready to become a hero. That's also the reason why it was upgraded after unlocking new powers in season 4.
The new costume Ladybug receives in "Mr. Pigeon 72" is identical to one of Thomas Astruc's designs for an adult Ladybug costume and her new transformation is actually a reference to the old, 3D Ladybug from 2014.
Marinette holds a few records related to the Miraculouses and their use:
She's the first person to be a Guardian of the Miraculous and an active Miraculous holder at the same time.
She's the first ever female Guardian.
She has used the most Miraculouses out of any (living) person, with 9: the Ladybug, the Cat, the Mouse, the Fox, the Dragon, the Bee, the Horse, the Rabbit and an alternate version of the Butterfly. Gabriel Agreste held this record before his passing in "Re-creation".

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng - Trivia
Except for the Peacock, Dragon, Turtle and Monkey Miraculouses, she is the second person of Chinese origins to use, let alone wear, all of the Miraculouses of a single box following the first owners.
Whereas with the Monkey, Turtle and Dragon Miraculouses, she was the third person of Chinese origins to wear them following their original owners, Sun Wukong, Hua Mulan and Master Fu.
If power-up forms (Aquabug, Lady Ice and Cosmobug) and alternate identities (Chronobug) are counted, Marinette holds another record – for the most Miraculous transformations, with 13.
In "Miraculous Paris", Marinette becomes the first known Miraculous holder to fuse two Miraculouses from different worlds – her own Ladybug Miraculous with Betterfly's Butterfly Miraculous.
As of "Miraculous London", she is also the first known person to use both Unification and an alternate mode at the same time as Cosmobugnoire.
Lady Noire's debut was foreshadowed in the second and third seasons' opening, in which she is shown with cat ears, a snout, whiskers, and a tail.
It's also a homage to a deleted inktober drawing of a female Cat Miraculous holder.
She is also the first known female wielder to use the Cat Miraculous.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng
text:

The second person of French and Chinese origins to use it following Hei Mao and Cat Noir.
Following her father's side of her family tree, she is actually the first Italian Black Cat Miraculous wielder.
In "New Powers", Marinette mentions out of all the new abilities she has tried so far, her favorite time was when she tried Cat Noir's powers as Lady Noire.
Lady Noire, Multimouse, Multifox, and Dragon Bug were first revealed in concept art shown at the 2018 Comic-Con Experience panel on December 6, 2018.
Out of every superhero, Ladybug faced a villain with identical powers as herself the most often, with 7 times, those being:
Chloé Bourgeois as the titular villain in "Antibug".
A villainous copy of herself brought to life as Cat Noir's worst fear by the akumatized villain in "Sandboy".
A giant doll animated by Christmaster.
Miraculer, who absorbed Ladybug's powers.
A sentimonster clone of herself created by Mayura.
Her villainous Re-verse counterpart.
A life-size wax statue of herself from Musée Grévin, animated and empowered by Manipula.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng - Trivia
Marinette Dupain-Cheng is the first and so far, only known person to wield both the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses at the same time in the current universe.
In "Kwamibuster", she used the real Miraculouses, but due to being split, the Miraculouses were not used by the same individual.
In "Gamer 2.0", she used a digital replica of the Cat Miraculous, and it is unknown if it possesses all of the real Miraculous' powers.
During the New York special, Marinette was briefly given the Cat Miraculous, however she did not use or even wear it.
She briefly has the jewel in "Kuro Neko", when Cat Noir gave it up, but like before, she didn't use or wear it.
After being retrieved from Monarch in the events of "Deflagration", she again temporarily obtains the gem until she asks Plagg to return it to Cat Noir.
She used both jewels as Bug Noire in her final battle against Monarch in "The Final Day".
Excluding Félix, who has never been fully akumatized, Marinette and Marc are the only members of the French Miraculous superhero team who have been fully akumatized only once.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng - Trivia
Although Nathaniel Kurtzberg and Zoé Lee have not been akumatized again on-screen, "Mr. Pigeon 72" reveals that Nathaniel has been akumatized into the Evillustrator five times, and Zoé was re-akumatized into Sole Crusher in the video game "Miraculous: Paris Under Siege".
Marinette's akumatization as Heartfixer bears some resemblances to her Ladybug alter-ego:
Both have very simple and yet functional designs;
Heartfixer uses her weapon (her purse) in the same way Ladybug uses her yo-yo;
Both have the power to "fix", with Ladybug being able to fix all the damages done during the battle against a villain and Heartfixer being supposed to be fix broken hearts.
As of Heartfixer, following Alya Césaire, Nino Lahiffe, Chloé Bourgeois, Nathalie Sancoeur, Luka Couffaine, Max Kanté, Kagami Tsurugi, Alix Kubdel, Lê Chiến Kim, Adrien Agreste, Wang Fu, Zoé Lee, Mylène Haprèle, Rose Lavillant, Juleka Couffaine, Sabrina Raincomprix, Marc Anciel, Nathaniel Kurtzberg, Ivan Bruel and Cerise Bianca, Marinette is the twenty-first person to become a Miraculous holder and akumatized villain, excluding Gabriel Agreste, who akumatized himself and Félix Fathom, who resisted the akuma.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng
text:

In production order, Marinette is the first character introduced in the first saga to be akumatized for the first time in the second saga. The second is Amélie.

Miscellaneous
Marinette's hair color is a homage to old comic books that would use blue highlights on black hair.
Currently, twelve characters know that Marinette is Ladybug: Plagg, Alya Césaire/Rena Rouge, Su-Han, Luka Couffaine/Viperion, Alix Kubdel/Bunnyx, Marinette's counterpart from a parallel universe and that same universe's version of Adrien, Kagami Tsurugi/Ryuko/Riposte Prime, Félix Fathom/Argos, Nathalie Sancoeur, Tom Dupain and Sabine Cheng. The number rises to seventeen if characters who lost this knowledge or died are counted – Master Fu/Jade Turtle, Adrien Agreste/Cat Noir/Cat Blanc, Alec Cataldi/Wishmaker, Gabriel Agreste/Shadow Moth/Monarch and Cerise Bianca/Timestalker/Spectral Looter.

title: Marinette's sewing box
text:
Marinette's sewing box - Intro
is a machine that was made by Marinette Dupain-Cheng as a way to hide the current Chinese Miracle Box.

title: Marinette's sewing box
text:
Marinette's sewing box - Appearance
Outside
On the outside, the box resembles a square-shaped pale amaranth picnic basket. It has white polka dots on it's lid, and Marinette's logo on one of its sides. It has a red handle. The red handle is attached to a divider between the blue and purple spools.
Inside
When opened, there are eight rows of 52 spools in a rainbow pattern. If they're pressed in the correct order, the Miracle Box is revealed. If they are pressed in the wrong order, the box will not open.
There are two compartments next to the spools. The top one has a red pin cushion with pearl needles in it. The bottom one has a pink measuring tape, scissors, sewing needles, a thimble, safety pins, a different spool of yellow thread, and a white object.

title: Marinette's sewing box
text:
Marinette's sewing box - Trivia
The only people that know the code to open the sewing box are Marinette and Alya.
It's similar to Fu's gramophone: they have the same purpose and works in similar ways.
The code is: amberish gray - moderate spring bud - brilliant amber - light sea green.
In "Mr. Pigeon 72", however, probably errorenously, the third one Alya presses is strong olive.

text:

The costume of Lady Noire was very similar to Cat Noir; she wore a dark gray catsuit with fluorescent green accents on her knees, forearms, waist, and neck. She had black gloves on her forearms with claws and a fluorescent green band that went down a bit and a black ball, and her black collar was a little open at the neck and had a fluorescent green band that went down to the poitrine and a black ball in the lower part of the neck. Around the waist, there was a black belt with a fluorescent green band in the middle at the right leg, a black button with a fluo-green cat, and a fluorescent green son with a black ball hanging. Her black fluo-green boots went all the way up to the knee, with a small flowing green band in the heel, and ended with small black triangular platform shoes. She had floor-length black hair that was styled in a single braid, which made it look like a tail (similar to Cat Noir's belt). She also had cat ears on her head with fluorescent green accents and a black mask. Lady Noire had the same green eyes as Cat Noir, with the green sclera and slitted pupils. title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/Alternative Universe 2
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/Alternative Universe 2 - Abilities
As Lady Noire
Lady Noire had the same abilities as her partner, such as more enhanced skills, like speed, agility, and strength, that she was almost invulnerable to physical damage. She had enhanced senses such as hearing, smell, night vision, and super stealth like a cat.
Like Cat Noir, Lady Noire could use her staff efficiently, wielding it as a sword, being able to spin it at high speeds to form a shield, and taking advantage of its length-changing features. To travel long distances, she used her staff and its variety in length to vault over obstacles.
She also has the special power Cataclysm, which allows her to destroy any object she touches.
As Ladybiquity Noire
Ladybiquity Noire's main power was the ability to be omnipresent in all the universes where she had a counterpart there. She did this by connecting to any of the counterparts and turning them in Ladybiquity Noire. Once she did that, she could see, hear, talk and act through her counterparts. When she was in control, her counterparts had no idea what was happening, only regaining it once the real Ubiquity was not using their bodies.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/Alternative Universe 2
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/Alternative Universe 2 - Abilities
Her second power was the ability to open portals between universes through her cape which became covered in stars, simulating an universe, when activated. By connecting herself with her counterparts, she could create a bridge between her world and her counterpart's. Since she could act through all her counterparts, she could open portals from and to any universe she desired.
Because she could act through all of her counterparts by turning them into her, her kamiko was also present in the same object of that counterpart, similar to when an akumatized villain used Multitude while holding their akumatized object, with the akuma being able to be freed by breaking only one of the cloned objects.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/Alternative Universe 2
text:

That her and Mister Bug had the same lives until their version of the events in "Reflekdoll", but decided to make the Miraculous switch permanent.
If she is the guardian of the Mother Box in this universe, Mister Bug is, if Fu remained the guardian nor if someone else is the guardian altogether.
It is uncertain whether she is human like her Quantic Universe counterpart. This seems unlikely if she shares a life with Adrien from the Quantic Universe, who is a Sentimonster, meaning this Marinette might be a Sentimonster too.

text:

As Ladybug
Like her Quantic Universe counterpart, Ladybug has enhanced physical abilities, such as speed and agility. Ladybug has remarkable talent with wielding her yo-yo, like using it as a grappling hook, a rope to restrain others, a projectile, a slicer even against solid materials, and a shield if she spins it fast enough.
Her special power, Lucky Charm, creates an object that helps her to achieve her goal, often being to stop a villain. Once the villain is dealt with, Ladybug can throw her Lucky Charm object into the air and use the Miraculous Ladybug, which will make it revert to an enormous swarm of ladybugs and fix all of the damage done since the villain appeared. She is also able to erase her Lucky Charm without using the Miraculous Ladybug.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/2D-Verse
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/2D-Verse - Abilities
Ladybiquity's main power was the ability to be omnipresent in all the universes where she had a counterpart there. She did this by connecting to any of the counterparts and turning them into Ladybiquity. Once she did that, she could see, hear, talk and act through her counterparts. When she was in control, her counterparts had no idea what was happening, only regaining it once the real Ubiquity was not using their bodies.
Her second power was the ability to open portals between universes through her cape which became covered in stars, simulating an universe, when activated. By connecting herself with her counterparts, she could create a bridge between her world and her counterpart's. Since she could act through all her counterparts, she could open portals from and to any universe she desired.
Because she could act through all of her counterparts by turning them into her, her kamiko was also present in the same object of that counterpart, similar to when an akumatized villain used Multitude while holding their akumatized object, with the akuma being able to be freed by breaking only one of the cloned objects.

title: Marinette in Paris/Transcript
text:
Marinette in Paris/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Dear diary, today at school, Miss Bustier asked us to list our top 3 favorite monuments in Paris. And it made me think of everything I love most about my city.
For number 3, I picked the Louvre Palace. It started out as a royal fortress, but today it's one of the greatest museums in the world. Whenever Cat Noir and I have to fight villains here, we're not just saving people, we're also protecting a one of a kind place filled with incredible works of art. Then again we never have time to enjoy the Mona Lisa.
My second favorite Parisian monument is the Trocadéro. Me and my friends from school hang out there all the time. It's also where I go whenever I need inspiration for my new creations. And the Trocadéro esplanade offers the best view of my favorite monument, the Eiffel Tower.

title: Marinette in Paris/Transcript
text:
Marinette in Paris/Transcript - Intro
The Eiffel Tower proudly stands at 1,063 feet high. Looming over the whole city like a gigantic lighthouse. When you're up on it, the people down below look like little ants. I recently learned that the Eiffel Tower was built for the 1889 World's fair, and that it was almost torn down. Can you imagine? Luckily it stood the test of time. So I think the thing I love the most about the Eiffel Tower is that it's indestructible, like superheroes.
Every day I think about how lucky I am to live in Paris, and I'm even luckier for getting to see all those places through Ladybug's eyes. No one knows the city like Cat Noir and I do. Even when we're on a mission, we can't help but stop for a minute and marvel at the magical city we live in. Actually, a top ten isn't enough; I forgot Notre-Dame, the Grand Palais, the Champs-Élysées...
All this talk about Paris has put me in the mood for a stroll in the sunshine. Bye for now, diary.

title: Marinette and Fashion/Transcript
text:
Marinette and Fashion/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Dear diary, today at school, Miss Bustier asked us what we wanna be when we grow up. Many of my friends had no idea, but I've known for a while. My dream is to become a fashion designer like Gabriel Agreste, my role model. He's Adrien's father, and he's also the best designer in the entire world! He created the Gabriel brand.
Adrien models for him. He's in every advertising campaign, in fashion magazines, on posters in town, the whole deal!
But what I love most of all is creating. I really like inventing, designing, sewing. I've already created hats, clothes, accessories like jewelry, and even some glasses for Jagged Stone, the famous rock star.
Most of the time, I'm wearing my own designs. This little purse I carry everywhere, for instance. I made it. I love to stroll around Paris for inspiration. I could spend hours watching people, and what better place then Paris to be inspired!
Being Ladybug also helps me to see things from a different perspective, to create in a different way. One time, for instance, I was inspired by a villain's costume to create a unique hat.
Gabriel: Miss Marinette, very exquisite creation. You definitely have the laboring hands of a hat maker.

title: Marinette and Fashion/Transcript
text:
Marinette and Fashion/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: I'm incredibly lucky. I really hope that one day, I'll have my own brand, and that people will like my designs. In the meantime, I try to get better every day by learning new techniques and making presents for my family and friends.
Oh, that reminds me, Alya's birthday is coming up, and I'd love to design something for her. I've already thought of a special case for her smartphone. I just need to buy the equipment so I can get to work. Goodbye for now, diary.

title: Marinette and Adrien/Transcript
text:
Marinette and Adrien/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Dear diary: I can't believe I made such a blunder! I'll just die of shame this time for sure! I had a presentation to do with Adrien—my Adrien!—and since I was done with my heart, I called to let him know. I had some serious ladybugs in my stomach, but I took my courage in both hands and just did it! The thing is, it went to his voicemail, and from this moment on, full blown disaster!
Marinette: Well then, enjoy your afterday! Uh, I mean—see you sooner! I mean—no! I—see you at the pool. Ugh! At school! (hangs up the phone) Ugh! That's awful! Now he’s going to think that I'm a super dummy!
Marinette: But it's not my fault! He's so amazing that I completely freak out every time I talk to him! I mean, seriously…he's super smart, he plays the piano, he's a great fencer, he speaks Chinese, and he's so cute too!
Adrien is a model for his father, Gabriel Agreste, the best fashion designer in Paris, and probably the world. But he never brags about it, because he's perfect! Well, uh, he does have one major flaw. He kind of gets along with Chloé the brat. But he's friends with everyone, so…this doesn't count. I mean, it almost doesn't.

title: Marinette and Adrien/Transcript
text:
Marinette and Adrien/Transcript - Intro
Anyway, I have to do something awesome now to prove to Adrien that I'm not a total loser. But how am I going to make him notice me and fall in love with me? Hmm…I could text him a really beautiful poem, or maybe write a letter! But, I'm not very good with words. I'm more into fashion and creating things!
Of course—I know! It's his birthday soon! I checked on the table I made of his detailed schedule.…what? I like to know where he is during the day! I'll design an amazing gift for him. He'll be super impressed, see that I'm an incredible girl, and will fall head over heels in love with me! Hehe, I can't wait! I'll get to it right this minute. There's not much time left till D-Day! Goodbye for now, dear diary. Wish me luck.

title: Marinette and Alya/Transcript
text:
Marinette and Alya/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Dear diary, something amazing happened today. I absolutely have to tell you!
I was in the park near home with Alya, and... oh my... I bumped into Adrien. With the sun reflecting in his hair and everything, he looked so good that I almost fainted!
I couldn't even say a simple hello. It's a good thing Alya was here to support me. Alya and me, we're BFF's. It's so amazing to have a best friend like her. She's always there for me. We're super close, you know? We can talk about everything. We laugh all the time and we do a lot of stuff together!
For example, we'd love to go to the cinema and talk about the movies afterwards. It's always so interesting, because Alya often notices things I didn't see at all, in movies, and in real life.
She's the most observant person I know. And she has an interest in everything! She's also very curious. Maybe too curious. But this is why she'll be a great journalist. That's what she wants to be in the future.
She also created a blog 100% dedicated to Ladybug, the Ladyblog. She's a huge fan. She even has a special alert on her phone, so she can be on the scene whenever something happens and film everything for her blog.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - Intro
Marinette Dupain-Cheng is a teenage girl who was chosen by Master Fu to wield the Ladybug Miraculous and become the superhero Ladybug. At first, she was reluctant to do the job, even going as far as to try to give her new friend, Alya, the Miraculous, but she gradually grew into the role.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - Before Season 1
Marinette Dupain-Cheng was born to Sabine Cheng, a Chinese-born woman, and Tom Dupain, a French-Italian man. Her parents own the best bakery in Paris. Since she learned to sew, Marinette made sweaters for her father every year on his birthday.
Marinette attended Collège Françoise Dupont for three years and an unnamed elementary school the year before, always sharing a class with Chloé Bourgeois.
Back in 8th grade, Marinette wasn't as confident before she was Ladybug as she was always bullied and picked on by Chloe's constant pranking, so much that she tried to convince her mom to let her stay home, but was told to remain hopeful as there were a few weeks until the school year ended and the chances of Chloé sharing a class with Marinette for the fourth year in a row was slim. However, she doubted that her luck would change and accidentally spills her breakfast.
Afterwards Marinette ran to the school doors, attempting to get to class while avoiding Chloé along the way.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - Before Season 1
Which she seems manage until she gets to her locker finding a rude awakening as she opened, a swarm of bugs decorated the inside of her locker causing her to panic setting off another chain reaction joke caused by Chloe regardless she tried to leave for class, but was stopped by the principal, Denis Damoclès, who was informed by Chloé that she'd be out of class.
Then was ordered by him to come to his office for her being out of class without permission.
After her chat with Denis Damoclès, she finally went to class only for her science teacher, Ms.
Mendeleiev, to scold her for being late and demanding her to go to her desk quietly and she obeys her as Chloé mocks her for the prank she pulled on her earlier.
She dejectedly took a seat only for her to yelp as she sat on a paint tube, wrecking her favorite pair of pants only to be mocked Chloé again for the nasty prank she pulled.
Marinette figured out Chloé was the one who placed the paint tube on her seat, but Ms.
Mendeleiev scolded her of accusing a student without evidence, not to yell, and to go to the principal's office for her actions only to be mocked by Chloé once again.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - Before Season 1
Later Marinette exits the principal's office with an additional three hours of detention on Saturday. Then was consulted by her friends explaining Chloé's actions towards her. When Chloe tried to torment Marinette again this time she was defended by her best friend Socqueline. But she was told about needing to stand up to Chloé on her own, as she won't be around to protect her much longer as she will graduate next year. And yet, Marinette remarked that everyone feared Chloé but then noticed Kim nearby and had a crushed on him much to Socqueline's disbelief that her friend could have a crush on Kim, asking her what she saw in him. Marinette believed she liked him for his kindness but Socqueline believed she was confusing kindness for foolishness regardless she decided to invite Kim to the swimming pool with her.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - Before Season 1
On her way to the pool with Socqueline, Marinette shared her plans: if all goes well and there's a moment that's right, she intends to confess her feelings to Kim. While having a splendid time at the pool with Kim, she decided to reveal her love for him. But she responded after opening a gift revealing spiders, that freaked Marinette out and sent her hurtling to the pool below. Seeing Chloe with a camera as she fell, Marinette realized that she and Kim pranked her (unaware that Chloe tricked him too) devastated and traumatized from this experience, she was found by Socqueline, crying in tears that she was right about everything and how it so changed her outlook on love. From that point onward, she decided to know everything about anyone she fell in love with and made sure they're not friends with Chloé.
The next day at school, Marinette heard that Socqueline was suspended from school for the rest of the school year just for trying to defend her, Marinette caught Socqueline before she left and felt remorseful for how things ended up this way but was told keep fighting and doing the right thing regardless.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - Before Season 1
Since then, she styled her hair to resemble Socqueline's so she could stand up to Chloé, during the next school year, she met Adrien Agreste who came to her class.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - Season 1
In "Ladybug & Cat Noir", on Marinette's first day of school in her last year of middle school, she woke up late. Worried about Chloé being in her class again for the fourth year in a row, she didn't want to go to school. Her mother reassured her that no one can be that unlucky and she would be fine. Marinette then lost what luck she had, spilling her breakfast and making a mess in the kitchen. She then left for school, bringing with her a box of macarons. While waiting at the crosswalk outside, she saw a man crossing the street and pulled him to safety, losing some of her macarons and making her late to school in the process.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - Season 1
Unsurprisingly, she was in the same class as Chloé once more, immediately being bullied by her to move seats. Alya saw this and helped Marinette, pulling her to sit next to her in class. Before Marinette could make it to her new seat, she tripped, spilling all but one macaron and splits it with Alya, the two becoming friends. After the first class, she and Alya were in the library when they saw the rock monster Stoneheart shouting for Kim. Alya rushed off, leaving her behind. Marinette returned to her home, finding a small box in front of her computer. When she opened it, a flash of light entered the room and she met Tikki, a talking kwami. Tikki convinced Marinette to put on the Ladybug Miraculous and to transform into a superhero. Afraid, Marinette didn't want to be a hero, but with no way to remove the costume, she left her room, swinging her yo-yo and flew across Paris.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - Season 1
Still learning how to control the yo-yo, Marinette landed on Cat Noir while falling out of the sky. She followed him to fight Stoneheart, still afraid and nervous. In the Stade des Princes, Marinette hesitated before joining the fight, but accepted her role as Ladybug and helped Cat Noir take down Stoneheart with her Lucky Charm wet suit and turned him back into Ivan. She returned to her room before she detransformed however, she forgot to capture the akuma. This failure on her end resulted in the akuma multiplying and infecting innocent Parisian citizens. Her confidence plummeted and she rejected the Ladybug Miraculous out of guilt. She took them off, hiding them in her vanity until she could give them away.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - Season 1
In "Stoneheart", the next day, Marinette watched the news report about the Stonehearts, with her confidence gone. She took the Ladybug Miraculous to school to give to Alya, believing that she would make a better hero. At the same time, she kept Ivan from being akumatized at first by helping him build his confidence toward Mylène Haprèle. Arriving to class, she saw Adrien poking at the gum on her seat and accused him of putting it there. She decided not to trust him, believing him to be the same as Chloé.
When Stoneheart busted down Literature classroom's door and took Mylène and Chloé captive, Marinette tried giving Alya her bag with the Ladybug Miraculous so that she could run and hide, but Alya left it behind. She chased after Alya and saw her nearly die when a car was thrown at her. With Cat Noir captured and Alya trapped, Marinette decided that she had to be Ladybug. She transformed, freed Alya, grabbed Cat Noir's staff, and went after him. Freeing Cat Noir, they went after the original Stoneheart who was on the Eiffel Tower.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - Season 1
Ladybug caught Chloé when she was thrown off the Tower then tried to stop the police from firing on Stoneheart, but Agent Roger reminded her that she failed, agreeing with him that it was her fault, but Cat Noir encouraged her to try again. When Hawk Moth told her to give up her Miraculous, she reminded him that he was the villain and that they would take him down and swung her yo-yo at his akuma-face and captured all of them. Then promised Paris that she and Cat Noir would keep them safe and ran up the side of the Eiffel Tower, deciding the only way to free Mylène was to bring her and Ivan closer together. She summoned her Lucky Charm and received a parachute. Using her yo-yo Ladybug made Mylène kiss Ivan, causing him to drop his akumatized object. She broke the object and changed Ivan back to normal. To save Mylène, she dove off the Tower, grabbed her, captured the akuma and set her on the ground with help from the parachute. Using Miraculous Ladybug, she freed the other Stonehearts and returned the city to normal.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - Season 1
The next day, she and Alya sat behind Nino and Adrien, until Chloé demanded her to move. After battling Stoneheart, Marinette gained the confidence to stand up to her until she moved. By the end of the day she ignored Adrien but accepted his apology for the gum incident. It was then that she fell in love with his kindness. Marinette finds herself stammering to say goodbye and Tikki playfully teases her about her crush. After that using the umbrella he gave her, she went home.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - Season 1
In "Stormy Weather", Marinette babysat Manon Chamack for Nadja Chamack but found it hard to keep her under control. Until Alya convinced her to take Manon to the park so that she could watch Adrien's photoshoot. She tried to get Adrien's attention and somewhat succeeded but watched from the sidelines. Marinette bought Manon a balloon when she shouted at her interrupting the shoot. After Manon led her away to the carousel, Alya stepped in and made Marinette join Adrien's photoshoot. She offers to find her but upon needing another actor Chloé volunteers leaving Marinette horrified and left to find her friend, she looks for Mylène in the bathroom but finds slime instead. However, the investigation was put on hold when Alya calls her and says that the kissing scene is about to start and stops the movie, using Chloé's desire to change the script as a diversion Marinette takes the acting role of Agent Smith. Chloé caught onto her trick until they heard scream from outside only to find more slime along with Kim and Denis Damoclès missing understanding that there's an akumatized villain she drops her phone and transforms into Ladybug. Quickly meeting the students she tries to have them evacuate but that was easier said than done since the school was closed off. With Cat Noir and the students the duo went in search of their missing friends during their fight against Horrificator they discover that the monster fed off fear and due to it's attraction to Ivan she discovers that it was Mylène.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - Season 1
Ladybug and Cat Noir followed Horrificator to the maintenance room and found the missing students but can't set them free. With exit closed off, they try to fight the monster off but was too strong, summoning her Lucky Charm she received a pair of guitar strings, trapping Horrificator with Cat Noir's Cataclysm and everyone playing along using Mylène's favorite song they calmed her down. With the akuma purified and returned everything to normal but their movie didn't make the cut because of the monster not being realistic.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - Season 1
In "The Puppeteer", Marinette was playing dolls with Manon and says that she always win because she has the Ladybug and Cat Noir dolls saying it's the rules of the heroes but not wanting Manon to be sad, she lets her have one of the dolls. When Nadja comes to pick her daughter up she told her to give the doll back and that's when Marinette told her that she could have it but Nadja said that she has many toys. But the Ladybug doll rips and said Marinette could fix it, and saw Manon and her mother leave. However, she notices Manon come quickly back up to her room forgetting her bag and asking for the Ladybug doll but Marinette retorts reminding her of Nadja's warning and Ladybug needed fixing. But giving into Manon's baby doll eyes she gives her the Lady Wifi doll after that Tikki points out to Marinette if every villain they faced had baby doll eyes, then Ladybug would be powerless.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - Season 1
Then their trip to the movies was halted when Alya turned into Lady Wifi but acted like a puppet. Leaving the train, she was approached by Cat Noir asking for information and once giving him her address Marinette disliking the idea of her partner in her room, transformed into Ladybug, once Lady Wifi was defeated the duo discovers Puppeteer had the real akuma. They head off to the news studio to confront her; despite being outnumbered by mind controlled villains including Cat Noir. Ladybug manage to defeat them all and reunite Manon with her mother. The next day she apologized to Nadja about what happened the other day and Nadja reminded her that Manon can be pretty persuasive with her "baby doll eyes". After Manon told her mother bye Marinette suggests going to the zoo not falling for her tricks this time leaving to see the new panther.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - Season 1
In "The Mime", after another akuma attack Ladybug rushed home, detransforms and was praised by Tikki for what she did for Alya. Then, she soon heard Alya arrived, explaining what happened and leaves her phone with Marinette. Tikki pops out asking to see the video but she accidentally deletes it. Afterwards she panics and thinks Alya will be mad, but devised a plan to fix it but resulted in her stealing Alya's phone and Tikki advised her to come clean now before transforming into Ladybug.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - Season 1
While trying to redo the video Ladybug saw a police car flying and caught it with her yo-yo then discovered that The Mime was Mylène's father. She offered to talk with him but was soon under fire and quickly defended herself until she came across Adrien's car telling everyone to get to safety. But got caught until a quick assist from Cat Noir however The Mime puts them in a cage but after he gets away the bars disappear. They followed him to discover that he's after the theater troupe bus while Cat Noir worked as a distraction Ladybug got everyone to safety. Seeing Cat Noir in trouble she rushed to his aid using a shoe box and The Mime's powers against him, she caught the akuma and cleansed the city. Once she retrieves Alya's phone she heads to the Tower and watched the performance then after the show Marinette explained what happened but Alya wasn't mad and said she had a surprise for her. Marinette quickly transformed into Ladybug giving Alya a quick interview and detransforms, then playfully teases her best friend about wanting to see the video.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - Season 1
In "Guitar Villain", Marinette was assigned the task of designing Jagged Stone's new album cover but due to the musician's manager she was stuck designing a cover and developed a distaste for XY's music. Knowing that Jagged's style was different that's when Tikki advised Marinette to follow her instincts and starts to complain about being under pressure. That's when Tikki reminded her that they work under pressure on a daily basis saving the world and got back to designing however, after Marinette showed Jagged the cover she explained that it was his manager's idea. But was told by Jagged to follow her own style and gets further encouragement from Adrien who liked Jagged Stone; this time Marinette decides to follow Tikki's advice. Soon Adrien's bodyguard, eyed her to talking to Tikki and she tried to pass her bag off as a talking bag from Japan.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - Season 1
But designing the new cover was put on hold when Jagged Stone was akumatized into Guitar Villain. After transforming into Ladybug and meeting up with Cat Noir they discovered that the villain was after XY and went to the television studio. However, it was too late and Guitar Villain kidnapped the musician heading for the Eiffel Tower, once there they tried to save XY as the duo climbed up the tower but was stopped by Fang. After using her yo-yo as a pair of reins Ladybug temporarily rode him, rescued Cat Noir and by using a can of hair fixing spray the heroes were able to stop Guitar Villain's concert and save XY. Afterwards, Marinette returned home and finished Jagged Stone's album one that she and the rock star approved of.
The next day while Marinette was at school she was approached by Adrien who nervously asked her if he could have an autograph. She signed the cover and Adrien expressed his thanks; once he was gone she started to swoon over the fact that she had the best day ever.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - Season 1
In "Reflekta", Marinette was excited for class picture day but heard that Juleka had the photo jinx and became determined to break it. As everyone was set in place Marinette noticed that Juleka wasn't here and pointed her absence to the photographer. She started to tell her friend that her jinx was broken as she was in the middle next to Adrien which left Chloé irritated but when Juleka didn't return Marinette along with Rose found her in the bathroom because of Chloé's tricks. Then, broke into the principal's office to replace the photo but Tikki told her it was a bad idea and got caught by Chloé and Sabrina despite giving them an ultimatum. Marinette fled the office to discover that Juleka got akumatized into Reflekta because of Chloé, afterwards she transforms into Ladybug. And had a face off with the villain but doesn't find it easy which almost ended in her Miraculous being taken but was prevented by Cat Noir.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - Season 1
Ladybug was asked by the students if she was going to help them and says she will and was separated by her partner who already got face lift but she thanked him for the save. When Ladybug noticed that Cat Noir's powers were gone she only believed he'd slow her down however the cat reminds her just because someone can't use their powers doesn't mean they're not helpful. Taking Cat Noir's advice they went to the tv studio and advised everyone to where a disguise to lure Reflekta there but caught the mayor instead. When Reflekta appeared behind them Ladybug was almost turned into a Reflekta copy but was shielded by Cat Noir. Using a camera she was able to blind the villain, catch and purify the akuma, returning to school Marinette agreed with Tikki that taking the memory card was a bad idea and comes up with a better way. After gathering in the park everyone took another class picture in the park where Juleka thanked her for breaking her photo curse.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - Season 1
In "Antibug", when Chloé was attacked by an invisible entity in Science classroom, Marinette left to transform to find out what was going on. Ladybug and Cat Noir visied Chloé at Hôtel de Ville. Once in her room, she was cheerfully embraced by Chloé, who was oblivious to her annoyance. She asks Chloé questions, trying to figure out who was attacking her but was told that everyone adores her but seeing that Chloé wasn't going to talk they decided to talk to Jean instead. From him they learned that Chloé and Sabrina had a fallout during one of their games leading to Chloé ignoring her. Leaving the hotel, she was noted by Cat Noir that it was going to be hard to fight someone they can't see but at her partner's warning Ladybug defended herself against Vanisher.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - Season 1
But the fight was increasingly difficult when Chloé entered the fray trying to help without listening to her about where the akuma was at first Ladybug believed it was in Sabrina's bag but saw it wasn't there. But using a jar of glitter and grabbing the right item they were to deakumatize Sabrina. When Cat Noir asked her why didn't she believe Chloé, Ladybug replies she doesn't believe in those in lie but it soon turns out that her disbelief in Chloé caused her akumatization into Antibug and that she was about to detransform back. Seeing the trouble she caused Marinette admitted her mistake and listened to Tikki's advice about listening to others. Then, hurried to find Tikki something to eat and seeing her partner in danger she told Tikki to hurry, but was instructed to save Cat Noir on her own but Marinette was hestaint to do so without her suit. With further encouragement from Tikki and her phone she got an idea, with Antibug distracted she freed Cat Noir and with Tikki back up to full power they retransformed into Ladybug.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - Season 1
Meeting with Cat Noir, she thought the akuma was in Chloé's yoyo but listened to him about it being in her earrings. By using a bag of marbles Antibug lost her sword, despite that the villainess taunted them but Ladybug says that she and Cat Noir were a team and deakumatized Chloé. After repairing everything, she made up with Chloé, encouraged her to make up with Sabrina and hears that her rival goes back to being her number one fan. Before leaving she thanks Cat Noir for the advice agreeing that they were unstoppable as a team. Then, seeing Sabrina and Chloé make up the next day at school, Marinette knew they'd be best friends in their own way.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - Season 1
In "Kung Food", Marinette tried to learn Chinese so she could speak with her great uncle who's coming to Paris for a cooking contest at Le Grand Paris. Then, when he arrived she tried giving her uncle the flowers she had for him but when things don't go well she called Alya having an idea and heard a knock on the door seeing Adrien. Slightly flustered at his presence she asked why he was here he explained that Alya called him saying that she needed a translator. On their way to the contest Adrien spoke to Marinette's uncle in Chinese but was surprised that Wang Cheng could speak English.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - Season 1
At the hotel, Marinette apologized to Adrien for the inconvenience but he didn't mind it as he saw it as a great experience to practice with a master. When she doubted that her uncle even liked her and mentioned the flowers he ripped apart, Adrien clarified that he liked Marinette and being an artist he was going to use the flowers in his dish in her honor making her happy. As the contest got underway Marinette was shocked to see that her uncle lost and suspected Chloé sabotaged the dish. She tried to informed Wang Cheng about it but was disappointed that he solely took the blame. Shortly after being comfort by Adrien the hotel became in cased in caramel and then saw that her uncle got akumatized into Kung Food as well as admitting she shouldn't have rattled up Chloé. But was comforted by Tikki knowing she'll find a way to fix things before transforming Ladybug. With Cat Noir, they battle Kung Food's minions while heading to top the way of the hotel. Together with a check they manage to save Chloé, Marinette's uncle and return everything to normal.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - Season 1
After being informed of Chloé's trick Wang Cheng got another chance to compete. Marinette asked her uncle if he could teach her how to make Celestial Soup he agreed. This time Wang Cheng won the contest and also named his soup after Marinette with her thanking him.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - Season 1
In "Volpina", while at school Marinette from Alya begins to hear her talk about the life of an amazing girl named Lila who had enrolled the school. Upon reading Alya's blog she found a video about her saying she was saved by Ladybug. Which left Marinette shocked because she never met Lila as her alter ego but was even more jealous of her when she saw her hanging out and trying to flirt with Adrien. Observing the two she and Tikki discovered that the book they had was special and having enough Lila's lies she transformed into Ladybug and chewed her out for deceiving everyone including Adrien. Which led to her being akumatizied into Volpina at first she had a tough time accepting her as an ally but after discovering that she was in league with Hawk Moth and battling through Volpina's illusions, Ladybug and Cat Noir managed to save "Adrien." Afterwards she tried to apologize for her rude behavior but Lila denied her attempt at peace. Then, remembering Adrien she wanted to check on him and by talking with him through his bathroom she discovers that he was fine and leaves.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - Season 1
Returning home Marinette hoped that the book would help her talk to Adrien without her mask but knew she wouldn't be returning it. Then heard Tikki say that its information is invaluable and was taken to someone who's been looking for it.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Santa Claws", Marinette babysat Manon and helped her parents in their bakery by giving out Christmas logs to the customers who donated to Ladybug's and Cat Noir's charity fund. When Adrien's chauffeur walked in to take a Christmas log, Marinette ran to her room, grabbed the present she made for Adrien, and gave it to the driver to give to Adrien.
Around midnight, she received a phone call from Nathalie, informing Marinette and her family that Adrien was missing. Marinette's family went to search for Adrien while Marinette transformed into Ladybug. She found the damage as result of Cat Noir's cataclysm and the note she left in Adrien's present. She then concluded an akumatized villain was after Adrien and that Cat Noir was protecting him. She followed the footprints she found in the snow and was eventually led to the Agreste mansion, where Adrien was outside the gates with a Santa Claus.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 2]]
Assuming the Santa Claus was an akumatized villain, she attacked him. However, her attack resulted in him becoming an actual akumatized villain known as Santa Claws. Santa Claws dumped a present full of bats on Ladybug before running off, forcing her to chase him. She and Cat Noir chased him across Paris before they were flunged into Alya's house. Ladybug summons her Lucky Charm (a box), takes some supplies from the Césaires, and sets up a trap at the Eiffel Tower, tricking Santa Claws and removing his akuma. After the damage caused by Santa Claws is fixed, Marinette and her family eat Christmas dinner at the Agreste mansion.
In "The Collector", Marinette meets the guardian of the Miraculous, Master Fu, and showed him the Miraculous Spellbook.
When Master Fu told her that he believes that whoever owned the Spellbook must also have the Peacock and Butterfly Miraculous, she feared that this meant Adrien was Hawk Moth.
And lied telling Master Fu that she didn't know who it belonged to.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 2]]
However, after learning that Adrien had been banned from school after losing an important book belonging to his father, Marinette realized that the important book was the Miraculous Spellbook and concludes that Gabriel was likely Hawk Moth.
As Ladybug, she sent Cat Noir a message saying that she knows who Hawk Moth was and after he meets her, the two of them go to Gabriel's house to investigate.
However, they instead find Gabriel akumatized into The Collector.
After an intense battle in the Agreste mansion, Ladybug and Cat Noir manage to defeat The Collector by filling up his book with CDs (unknown to her she was right).
Afterwards, Marinette goes to Master Fu telling him the truth about the Miraculous Spellbook, but also voices disappointment over Adrien never being allowed back in school.
Master Fu, however, offers a solution.
He takes pictures of the book's pages with his smartphone and then Marinette returns the book to Gabriel.
Happy that Adrien was allowed to return to school.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Prime Queen", Marinette was approached by a worried Tikki about her secret identity being revealed on Nadja's tv show. However, she assured her that she only agreed to ensure the citizens safety but Tikki warned her to be careful tonight. Surprised Marinette thought it wasn't till tomorrow but the video claimed the show was tonight the same time she had to babysit Manon. Shortly after Manon was dropped off Marinette called Alya and once she arrived Marinette said she had to talk with her parents and be back soon. But actually she was talking to Tikki deciding whether or not to go to the show but had her kwami's support of either choice. She transformed into Ladybug and went to the television studio.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 2]]
The show went well until they saw a picture of themselves in love but Ladybug explained they weren't a couple. When Nadja pried too much about the heroes' personal lives they left under the excuse that there was an akuma attack that led to the show's cancellation. On the roof of the building the heroine was asked by the cat of who needed saving. She answered they were ones who needed it because they were superheroes not stars and are suppose to remain a mystery. Due to the show being cancelled Nadja was akumatized into Prime Queen.
Afterwards the duo saw that Prime Queen had captured and trapped Chloé on a speeding train. However the heroine was hesitant to jump through the screen but was reminded they didn't have a choice. Once there Prime Queen demanded that the heroes admit their love but Ladybug refused. And yet, temporarily giving into her demands she only admits it to have her stop the train landing on top of her partner shocked to hear him purring, when Cat Noir tried kiss her she denied it and Chloé was saved. But they discovered that Prime Queen trapped Alya in a sarcophagus in the museum and left to save her but ended trapped in a freezer instead.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 2]]
Cat Noir offered to use his Cataclysm but Ladybug denied it after summoning her Lucky Charm she received masking tape by covering the tv screen they lured Prime Queen to them. Ladybug and Cat Noir were able to capture the akuma and used the Miraculous Ladybug to return Chloé and Alya home. Afterwards Marinette returned home was relieved that she was fine and shared a hug, by morning she watched a video of Alya with her and Manon about the Ladyblog congratulating her for the success and asked for an autograph.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Glaciator", Marinette transformed into Ladybug along with Cat Noir they saved people from a runaway bus as they let people off she was asked by the hero about having a dinner date with him but even though she was touched Ladybug spoke of other plans. Returning home Marinette was having dinner with her parents afterwards she spoke of going André's for ice cream with her friends. When they easily figured that out they asked her who the lucky guy was which left Marinette to leave in a huff. Then, met up with Alya and her friends at André's ice cream stand when but was disappointed that Adrien wasn't coming. But Marinette was encouraged by Tikki that she could still have fun and was asked if she could have some ice cream too.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 2]]
She was called out by André about being in love with someone and was offered a cone but denied it at first but accepted. After Marinette dropped it confusing Adrien with someone else she became so depressed that she believed that André's ice cream wasn't special and walked away. Later that night, she was disappointed in herself for her attitude towards André but was comforted by Tikki telling her that she just had a bad night and will have another chance. Wanting some time alone, Marinette went up to her balcony and was approached by Cat Noir surprised to see him, she asked if he had hero stuff to do but he didn't. Seeing that he didn't want to be alone she welcomed his company through their conversation the two had common ground about love problems. Then Marinette discovered that Cat Noir's feelings for her alter ego were real and was curious on what his surprise was; once there she was amazed but seeing Cat Noir sad she tried to cheer him up but was soon attacked by Glaciator. Then, discovered that the villain was André and escorted back home before Cat Noir left she thanked him for cheering her up.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 2]]
After seeing a new side of Cat Noir; Marinette thought she was wrong about him and transformed into Ladybug. Meeting with her angry partner, she received a cold shoulder from him about missing their date, while fighting the villain they discovered that Glaciator didn't attack couples. After apologizing the heroes pretended to be a couple to get close enough to him to see that André was inside the monster. Using her Lucky Charm Ladybug received a helmet, with a motorcycle and a makeshift propeller they were able to save Paris from being buried in a mountain of ice cream.
Arriving at the date spot, Ladybug was amazed but not wanting to lie to her best friend, she admitted she was in love with another guy but refused to say anything else knowing their personal lives must be kept secret. She expected Cat Noir to be angry but he respected her honesty and was given a kiss and rose by him which left her blushing. The next day, Marinette arrived at André's ice cream stand and when asked by André if his ice cream had the magic touch she told him to have a good day and shared some with Tikki.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Despair Bear", during a cooking class given by her father Tom; Marinette commented that her father loves it when he comes over to her school to Alya. While she was took the bowl to the kitchen she told Tikki to wait and control her sweet tooth. But after hearing the fire alarm she told Tikki to hide and saw her classmates leaving the classroom where her father hoped it was fire drill.
During Denis Damoclès' interrogation, Marinette informed Alya that this was Chloé's doing and yet she didn't have any proof. Then, Chloé tried to pin the blame on her but was vouched for by Alya and Adrien when Chloé tried to avoid the blame Marinette wanted to step up but was halt by her friends. Nonetheless, she and everyone else were stuck cleaning the courtyard as punishment once done Marinette along with Alya, Rose, Juleka and Mylène head to her house for a photoshoot for Alya's blog. Until everyone got invited to a party hosted by Chloé however Marinette was skeptical because of her rival's nature but changes her mind when Adrien was invited.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 2]]
As everyone came together for a slow dance and Marinette was pushed by Alya to dance with Adrien until he asked her nervously accepting. During the party the akumatized villain Despair Bear attacked after their quick escape she was reminded by Tikki of the task at hand before transforming. Despite with Cat Noir's help, the villain's constant hopping around didn't make him easy to catch and soon Ladybug fought against a controlled Cat Noir but thanks to Chloé's help they were able to free the cat and stop the villain. Afterwards, Marinette and Adrien both agreed that Chloé would never fully change when Adrien commented that her baking was has good as her dancing she blushed.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Riposte", Marinette was in the locker room looking for helmet and was complimented by Tikki that she looked good in fencing gear and yet was hesitant on not being able to make the team but was assured she'll do great. During the tryouts she was looking for Adrien who approached her while thanking her for the compliment. While being taught the rules of fencing a mysterious fencer walks in demanding to be enrolled seeing the mystery fencer's skills Marinette thought she was going to lose the spot on the team. As the duel between Adrien and the mysterious fencer was underway the battle was so fierce that she was the only one to witnessed it.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 2]]
When they turned to her to see who was the victor Marinette became so flustered and picked Adrien but wasn't completely sure herself on who won. She felt bad about making the decision but was reminded by Tikki that she had a chance to get on the team. Afterwards, she noticed an akuma and quickly transformed into Ladybug to catch it but it already akumatized the mysterious fencer into Riposte who was after Adrien. Upon confronting the villain Ladybug discovered that the weapon was merged with her hand and got into a duel with her but was completely outmatched and almost skewered until she was saved by Adrien. Briefly escaping, she knew it was hard for her to protect him and fight at the same time and made a call to Cat Noir but received no answer.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 2]]
When the villain found them they tried to reason with her but it didn't work out and she battled her again on the rooftops. After trapping Riposte the two made their way to Louvre Museum and warned the people of an incoming akuma. Needing a safe place to hide Adrien she put him in the sarcophagus in the History Exhibit, and with Cat Noir they fought Riposte once more but during the duel she discovered something was wrong with him and ended up separated. Ending up back in the History exhibit, Ladybug looked on in horror as Adrien was finished but saw that he wasn't there and using a radiator along with Cat Noir they defeated Riposte. She led the mysterious fencer out of the museum and quickly found Adrien who hid somewhere else in the midst of talking about Cat Noir, Ladybug admits that he was better than her at fencing.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 2]]
Just as her time was almost up Ladybug encouraged Adrien to make amends with the mysterious fencer whose name was Kagami. After detransforming as Marinette secretly watched the two and she heard Adrien consider her a great friend which wasn't what she wanted. When Tikki said that Marinette may need to work on her fencing she engaged the kwami in a playful fencing match.
In "Befana", some time prior Marinette noticed her friends were acting strange. She was happy that today was her birthday and eagerly waited for a call from Alya. While she was distracted Tikki spoke of a gift for her and received a kwagatama. Marinette heard her say that she didn't like the gift but wanted to spare her feelings but she apologized telling Tikki that she was waiting for Alya who was planning her surprise birthday party. Then, Marinette explained all the clues to Tikki and walked in to find her parents surprised at her arrival but when she heard a knock at the door Marinette was surprised to see her grandmother Gina Bianchi.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 2]]
Throughout the day Marinette spent time with her grandmother doing the things when she was little, looking sadly at the candy Gina gave her Tikki asked why she didn't tell her she didn't like it. Replying that she wanted to spare her grandmother's feelings and soon received a call from Alya informing her grandmother about where she was going. At the party everyone wished Marinette a happy birthday but things got worse when her grandmother got akumatizied into Befana and attacked the celebration. Under fire she tried to run but was cornered and saw Alya and Kim get turned into coal statues while trying to protect her, she tried to transform but was interrupted by Cat Noir and they escaped. On their way to the Eiffel Tower, she was commented by the cat about being a lucky girl to have so many friends protect her and was asked why her grandmother was freaking out Marinette says she wanted to spend more time with her. Arriving at the tower she was assured by the cat he would get her grandmother back safe and wished a happy birthday finally alone Marinette transformed into Ladybug.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 2]]
She met up with Cat Noir finishing his song and fought against Befana's angels; Ladybug was told by him that they had to prevent Befana from heading to the tower. When she knew why, the heroine almost revealed the truth but stopped herself as the fight continued they noticed that Befana couldn't touch her own candies. Realizing where the akuma was she summoned her Lucky Charm receiving a tuba but soon they were surrounded needing to separate Befana from her minions Ladybug pretended to surrender once separated she took care of the angels. Using the instrument and a Cataclysm on a fire hydrant the duo saved Marinette's grandmother. Back at the party, Marinette loved the gift Adrien gave her, although Tikki found it strange when Marinette said the same thing about hers causing Tikki to become irritated. But revealed to her as a necklace she cherished her gift too explaining what matters wasn't the gift but the person who gave it.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Robostus", while at school Marinette forgot her bag going back to the Locker Room to get it. Then, with Tikki she noticed Max talking to his best friend in his bag which was strange.
