text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 2]]
Knowing where the akuma was she suggested using Cat Noir's Cataclysm to destroy it but they had to get close without getting stung. By avoiding the swarm underwater and having Chloé come to an understanding the Bee Miraculous was restored and retrieved. Afterwards, Marinette comes to the Hotel to talk with Chloé knocking on her rival's bedroom door, Marinette heard her response and refused to leave. Approaching Audrey, Marinette says that she declines her offer by saying that there's so much of her life in Paris, the Fashion Queen retorted believing she was making a mistake. However, she answers back by saying the same thing and reveals Chloé behind her seeing her rival still hesitant she pushed her on. Adding on to their conversation Marinette points that Chloé is exceptional like her mother and returns home. Playing video games with her parents and Alya she told them her heart and family was here.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Reverser", she finds Marc hiding under the stairs and asked him to join their Art Club. But when he leaves out of nervousness Marinette saw that Marc dropped his book. After Marinette and Tikki read the Diary of Ladybug book they were both amazed by the boy's story and knew he and Nathaniel would work well together. Upon returning the book she gives Marc the idea of writing a comic book with Nathaniel by showing Marc's book to him. But not wanting to reveal his identity Marinette erases the name and gives it to Nathaniel saying that someone special wrote while they were watching the two were discovered by Adrien. Marinette nervously says that they were working on a surprise for him instead. However, during Operation Comic Book as they watched from her balcony the plan took a turn for the worst when Marc was akumatized into Reverser.
After evading Reverser's arrows they transform into Ladybug but in the middle of their confrontation the heroine got struck by an arrow causing her to become very clumsy.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 2]]
Even with Cat Noir arriving the hero became a scaredy cat because of Reverser causing them to fall into the river. Pulling themselves to shore they knew the villain was after Nathaniel and Ladybug had an idea where to look but Cat Noir was too scared to move encouraging her partner to come along they realized they weren't going anywhere. Taking a cab to the school they saw that Reverser had beaten them there but discovered where Nathaniel was by eyeing his drawings and found him along with Alix at the Louvre Museum.
After showing them the feed on the news she asked for his help and when Alix wanted to come Ladybug said no but was quickly reminded of her and Cat Noir's conditions and accepted her help. Arriving at the Eiffel Tower the group saw the trash entering the atmosphere, she quickly comforted her partner knowing they were in it together. Summoning her Lucky Charm she received a bamboo roll, making a makeshift kite with Cat Noir tied to it and Alix doing the stirring they were able to save Marc. After being returned by to normal by the Miraculous Ladybug, Ladybug had Marc and Nathaniel make up.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 2]]
Then, the next day, she was given the boy's first comic book as a way to thank her as Marc and Nathaniel believed Marinette would make a great hero if she wasn't a klutz causing her to laugh with everyone.
In "Anansi", Marinette was with Adrien (through video chat) who both were watching Alya and Nino marvelling that they were in complete sync. Then she voiced her dissappointment to Adrien about not letting his father come over. Then, heard Alya's sister Nora come in (who wishes to called her boxing ring name Anansi), however, when Alya mentioned about seeing the Fifa Cup fireworks Marinette was surprised that Alya was told stay put because of the many akumatized people running around. As the sisters argued she informed Adrien while out Nora attacked someone that she though was akumatized and it turned out to be someone in a costume.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 2]]
However hearing that Nora will let Alya go out with her friends if Nino beats her in an arm wrestle to which she agreed to and with her "helping" Nino win the match they leave to see the Fifa Cup fireworks. They group enjoy the display on top of the ferris wheel until the trio was attacked by Nora who was akumatized into Anansi realizing her mistake and needing to save her friends Marinette transformed into Ladybug. Even with Cat Noir's help, Anansi was too strong to handle. After a lucky charm, candle was summoned noticing her predicament she asked Nino to hold off the villain until she returned, but when he seemed doubtful Ladybug told him that it doesn't take strength alone to be a hero but courage and determination.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 2]]
Arriving at Master Fu's shop, Marinette and Tikki detransformed and explained the situation to the master. Aware of the villain's strength, she needed a protective miraculous and chose the Turtle Miraculous returning to save Nino; Ladybug asked for his help again this time giving him the Turtle Miraculous, he transformed into their new ally Carapace. Receiving a pair of boxing gloves and by challenging Anansi to duel along with Carapce's protective powers the trio was able to defeat Anansi thus save Alya. Upon hearing the villain's remark about Cat Noir, she mentioned to her partner that he was irreplaceable, after retrieving the jewel and returning it to Master Fu. Marinette reunited with her friends and explained to Nora what really happened but she didn't take too personal and had fun at the ice rink.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Malediktator", Marinette was watching Chloé's documentary about her adventure as Queen Bee but wasn't impressed and agreed with everyone else that she didn't deserve to be called a hero. Afterwards, she and her friends heard a helicopter above the school to see Chloé aboard and leave for New York. Then, her shock turned into joy and because less people would be akumatized. Soon she saw Adrien asking what the party was about and explained that Chloé left fort New York and asked if he was glad. But when Adrien said he wasn't Marinette asked why, that's when she heard that Chloé was his only friend growing up and couldn't celebrate her unhappy departure upon hearing that she apologized to him.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 2]]
Seeing Adrien unhappy Marinette wondered if there was more to Chloé than she originally thought. But the party was halted when Malediktator appeared, quickly hiding she and Tikki knew that Chloé akumatized one last victim before she left and Marinette believed she was partly to blame but transformed into Ladybug. Even with Cat Noir's help, through an abacus the heroine knew they needed more and told her partner to wait but was horrified that Cat Noir was defenseless. At first, she wanted save to him but found out he still had claws and sought out Master Fu. At his shop, after she explained the situation again, Marinette was allowed to pick an ally taking the Bee Miraculous again but was doubtful and yet was reminded by Tikki trust her instincts. Knowing what happened previously, Master Fu expressed doubt but Marinette was assured on knowing how to use it. Afterwards, in looking for Chloé, she saw that Malediktator had struck her parents too and through Chloé's presentation they knew where her lair was and retransformed.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 2]]
Finding her at the hotel, she was fine with helping Chloé but needed to know why her father was so angry. Keeping a cool head, she calmly told her that maybe Marinette wasn't totally to blame but upon seeing her rival's hesitation she gently reminded Chloé that she could tell her anything. Ladybug heard Chloé admit that she hurt father's feelings because she threatened to leave Paris forever because she served no purpose. Sympathetic towards her, Ladybug says that everyone serves a purpose and gave Chloé a chance to fix her mistake if she wanted too agreeing the heroine gave her the Bee Miraculous again. Heading over the rooftops to find Malediktator, she says that they had to work together and pulled Queen Bee away from colliding with a chimney.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 2]]
After finding him, she tried to tell Queen Bee the plan but thanks to her blowing their cover they were in an instant fight but found it tough to penetrate through his security guard shield even more so while avoiding the villain's declaration bubbles. Summoning her Lucky Charm again, Ladybug received a big machine gun and laser pointer but knowing she'd only needed the laser pointer she threw the rest of it away assuring Queen Bee of her plan. After advising her to take "the sting out", with the laser pointer Ladybug had Cat Noir take out the security guards with Malediktator defenseless and paralyzed Ladybug purified the akuma and returned everyone to normal.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Sandboy", Marinette noticed that Tikki was being really quiet and asked what's wrong. Tikki explained that today was Nooroo's birthday and he was all alone. But Marinette assured her that they would free him one day making it a promise when the kwami spoke of a faster way. Marinette was informed that kwamis are able to speak with their kind on their birthday or cycle however if the chance was missed they would have to wait a really long time for the next one. However, when Tikki mentioned that the opportunity was tonight Marinette was surprised that she wasn't told sooner. Because they knew that kwamis weren't allowed to leave their wielder's side in case of danger.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 2]]
And yet, she listened to Plagg's plan that Tikki and Plagg would go join with the other kwamis while Wayzz kept lookout. Agreeing Marinette gave Tikki the permission to leave and was hugged by her promising not to disappoint her and left through the window with a marker while she slept. Soon Marinette was woken up by a noise and though Tikki was back but horrified to be living her worst nightmare of Adrien raving on about loving Chloé. Escaping to her balcony she that an akumatized villain named Sandboy was turning Paris into a living nightmare. Needing to find Tikki she made her way to Master Fu's shop and tried to contact her kwami to no avail.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 2]]
Upon waking up Master Fu, she saw the guardian live his nightmare and was told to transform but couldn't. And was informed by Tikki that the plan didn't work, afterwards they transformed to find Sandboy. Despite her best efforts with Cat Noir, she was hit with the villain's sand causing Ladybug to live her nightmare being powerless. While being protected by Cat Noir she found that he didn't have the same fear she did but instead saw an evil version of herself out to get him. But with some quick thinking Sandboy was defeated and she asked the young boy what happened explaining he had nightmare from scary movie and was akumatized by Hawk Moth.
Before returning the boy home she asked Cat Noir about his nightmare and was relieved he didn't think she was evil calling her the girl of his dreams. She returned to Master Fu taking responsibility for what happened along with Tikki and Wayzz. Tikki also apologized to her for failing but Marinette comforted her understanding that she had good intentions and will always have her trust as they embraced each other.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Catalyst", after dealing with a late night akumatized villain, Marinette and Tikki returned home and detransformed. But just as the two went to sleep they were instantly woken up and was informed it was Heroes' Day. While at school, still niffed that everyone else believed Lila's lies, Marinette bit off more than she could chew with a lie of her of own.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 2]]
Sometime later Marinette was bake the macarons she promised for her Heroes Day good deed but seeing that she was getting nowhere she suggested using her powers. But was reminded gently by Tikki that her powers as Ladybug weren't meant for personal gain, then left to admit to her parents about her mistake and was gently reminded to be honest. After shortly arriving at the school, she was approached by Adrien being informed that he could come too and they walk inside together. But the two are alerted to the most troubling news Ladybug being akumatized and Cat Noir being destroyed then things got worse when the school was being attacked by a swarm of red akumas and many people being reakumatized. Marinette and Tikki transformed into Ladybug, understanding that she was being followed the heroine dove into the sewers and dealt with Vanisher, hearing Sabrina's explaination she understood this was Volpina's doing.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 2]]
Afterwards they detransformed and went to Master Fu's shop, once again Marinette was offered to choose an ally seeing the seriousness of the situation Tikki suggested using all the jewels but seeing that there was little time Marinette only took the Fox, Bee, and Turtle Miraculouses. Afterwards, they transformed into Ladybug upon finding Nino and Alya she called upon their help again and apologized for revealing their identities and met up with Cat Noir and Queen Bee. Despite everyone else being ready to fight Ladybug was left to wonder.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Mayura", despite the team putting up a good fight and after summoning a Lucky Charm; Ladybug and Cat Noir lost their allies as well as about to detransform back. But thanks to him using Cataclysm on the ground below them the duo escaped, afterwards she gave Tikki a macaroon and expressed doubt on how to beat Hawk Moth. After receiving encouragement from Cat Noir, being found by the army Marinette and Tikki retransformed into their Aqua Mode. Resurfacing she released a swarm of white butterflies to give the people hope and this time with the Paris rebellion's help. On their way to the Eiffel tower she and Cat Noir saw the reason why to keep hope alive the duo managed to corner Hawk Moth. Summoning her Lucky Charm again she received a miraculous box. At first, she believed it was a sign of Hawk Moth's defeat, after hearing his plan about making a wish their jewels Ladybug reminds him with every wish there's a price to pay and wanted to know his wish first.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 2]]
Closing in on Scarlett Moth, being sympathetic she tells him that it's not too late for him to change and do good with them. However, upon seeing another Scarlett Moth ready to attack thanks to the charm, she pushed Cat Noir out of the way to discover that the one they were talking to was just an illusion. Despite battling him two on one she and Cat Noir were defeated but saved by Rena and the others. But their archenemy managed to escape thanks to Mayura despite that the team managed to save the city and returned the Fox, Turtle, and Bee Miraculouses to Master Fu.
Marinette went to a picnic with her friends and nervously told Adrien that he could sit next to her. However, when he had to leave to attend his father charity ball she heard Adrien speak of her kindness and of her helping everyone everyday being called their everyday Ladybug. Moved by Adrien's compliment Marinette worked up the courage to admit her feelings to him by giving him a kiss on the cheek expressing her thanks. As her friends cheered for Marinette was shocked that she stepped in pie as the fireworks went off.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - "[[Miraculous Shanghai]]"
Summer vacation had come and Marinette was enjoying her free time with her friends and Cat Noir, especially due to the fact that Hawk Moth wasn't here, but she knew he was up to something sneaky, but didn't know what.
While attending a picnic she received the sad news that Adrien couldn't come because he left with his father to Shanghai.
Wanting to follow him and being aware of her Uncle Wang and his birthday coming up, she asked her parents if she could go.
To her surprise, they revealed that they have been saving money for said trip.
While at her uncle's restaurant, the Thousand Delights, she learned of her family's heritage even more so about Tikki, when the kwami revealed that her species was multilingual, which was a necessary as their owners were always a mystery.
In the midst of exploring the streets looking for Adrien, Marinette saw an unknown person getting chased a by group of mystery boys.
She tried to help, but noticed to her horror that her things were stolen, including her Miraculous and Tikki.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - "[[Miraculous Shanghai]]"
With that, she desperately tried to find her, but with the language barrier and her phone missing, she was lost in the city until she was found by the boy trio, and yet, misreading their intentions, she fled and bumped into Fei, recognizing her from earlier.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - "[[Miraculous Shanghai]]"
At first, she was disheartened if could Fei understand her, but to Marinette's surprise, she did. After escaping the boys that caught up to her, Marinette explained her situation to Fei, in which she explains the same thing about having something taken too. While following Fei to section of pawn shops in disguise, she learned more about her, like how her father owned a school and admired the French language. Arriving at Cash's shop, Marinette was ecstatic to find her earrings, but the shop's owner, Cash, wanted a hefty price, and seeing the negotiations go south, regardless, reuniting with Tikki, she assured Tikki that she'd get her out. Once outside the shop, Marinette saw that Fei was well ahead of her in getting the earrings back, swapping the earrings with fake ones, to which she found less favorable as Fei did not approving of stealing. But that would have to wait. Soon, the pair were chased after by Cash's goons, to which she saw Fei easily fight them off, but the goons refused to quit until they got help from the mysterious boy trio, making their escape.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - "[[Miraculous Shanghai]]"
Afterwards, Marinette was brought to Fei's home, where Fei explained her own hardships, but before she could explain any further, they were interrupted by Cash, who revealed Fei's deception, leaving Marinette devastated. Regardless, she was still threatened by Cash's demands for money until Fei came to her defense, then trouble was added on when an akuma appeared, but seeing Fei beg for her forgiveness, she fled, but before transforming, Marinette was skeptical about Fei's sincerity. Despite that, she transformed into Ladybug. Before entering the fray, she received a message from Cat Noir about looking for her alter ego. After explaining the situation and rescuing Fei, Ladybug followed her to the sacred cave where she heard Hawk Moth and Cash mention something called the Prodigious, which left her confused, being told it was Fei's job to guard the cave, but didn't know what was in it.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - "[[Miraculous Shanghai]]"
Regardless, knowing she couldn't let Hawk Moth get the Prodigius, Ladybug headed into a 2 against 1 fight until Fei entered the fight using the Prodigious to become Ladydragon. As the battle continued to heat up, she saw that her new ally could change into animals as long as the user fulfilled the requirements. Then, she summoned her Lucky Charm, receiving a basketball. Unsure of how to use it, the fight went on until she noticed that Fei couldn't transform into a dragon and once hearing Mei Shi's and Fei's explanation, the heroine commented that revenge and justice aren't the same. The girls continued on until Ladybug was horrified to see Ladydragon buried under debris, believing Fei got crushed by the debris. Backed into a corner again, yet getting her Lucky Charm back, looking around, she saw that Cat Noir had arrived, and with the ball, the heroes deakumatized Cash.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - "[[Miraculous Shanghai]]"
With Ladydragon and Cat Noir's help, Ladybug managed to corner Hawk Moth, but the fight wasn't over. He then akumatized Mei Shi into YanLuoShi, but the trio were devastated to see even Hawk Moth eradicated by his minion, believing it he didn't deserve it. After a quick recharge, despite the trio's best efforts, without the dragon's power there wasn't much they couldn't do stop Mei Shi. But seeing Ladydragon so devastated at the destruction, she flees, leaving Ladybug and Cat Noir alone to fight YanLuoShi. With no choice left to them, Ladybug watched as Cat Noir tried to stop him with his Cataclysm, but was devastated as he was eradicated too. Seeing Fei land closely and emotionally crushed, she untransformed to reconcile with her, accepting her forgiveness, but Fei retorted, believing that she didn't deserve it after going back on her father's teachings until Marinette reminded her of what she needed to fix.
And not a moment too soon, as YanLuoShi found them again, causing the building side to crumble at their feet and cause them to fall, but Marinette was saved by Fei understanding the dragon's value.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - "[[Miraculous Shanghai]]"
When she retransformed and used her Lucky Charm again, she received a Chinese vase.
This time, with Ladydragon's help, Ladybug formulated a plan to free Mei Shi of his akumatization, and diving into the belly of the beast, they were able to de-akumatize Mei Shi and restored the city and everyone to normal.
Afterwards, she shared a quick embrace with Cat Noir as well as heard of Fei's congratulations from Mei Shi about being the new Renren.
Then, she followed Ladydragon back to the Sacred Cave to reprimand Cash.
Once that was done, upon hearing Cat Noir's concern about Marinette, she heard from Ladydragon that Marinette was safe.
So she heads back to her Uncle Wang's restaurant, then Marinette heard someone at the door, surprised to see the boy trio from before, thinking they were going to harm until they clarified wanting to return her necklace, which she accepted.
Then from Adrien, she learned that Lian and his friends were friendly and suggested he help her learn Chinese and enjoyed her uncle's party.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Chameleon", Marinette was rushing off to school and saw that there was something different about the sitting arrangements and found out to her surprise that Lila was back. Throughout the day she becomes furious that Lila lied to everyone and left to confront her, seeing her enemy's true nature, Marinette was mortified after hearing what Lila planned to do if she exposed her lies. To the point of tears she was comforted by Tikki telling her not to let Lila get to her. Then, her emotions didn't go unnoticed by Hawk Moth and an akuma was sent her way but was encouraged by Tikki and drives the butterfly off, They transformed into Ladybug to catch before it akumatizes someone. However, the akuma infects Lila turning her into Chameleon, and despite her shape shifting Ladybug and Cat Noir deakumatize her.
When she heard Lila's lies Marinette attempted to expose her Adrien talked her down saying that humiliating her won't set her straight. When everyone returned to Ms. Bustier's class everyone to their original seats, afterwards Marinette was approached by Lila saying they were at war but Marinette calmly walks away saying we'll see.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Animaestro", Marinette was watching the new movie trailer about her superhero alter ego. Until she was asked by Tikki if she was going to the premier answered she wasn't going to seek stardom but when Marinette heard that Adrien was going to be there she changed her mind. After Marinette was done talking with her parents Tikki saw her take out a special macaron. Then, the pair went off to the movie showing, in the midst seeing Adrien and Kagami being so close. Marinette was shocked that Chloé knew about Kagami too and became paranoid so much that she went along with her in an effort to stop them from being together.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
But when the plan turns into a fiasco, Marinette mentioned that the macaron Thomas had was a passionfruit one leading to her revealing her crush on Adrien. Then things got worse when Thomas Astruc was akumatized into Animaestro, but was praised by Tikki for not listening to Chloé and transformed into Ladybug. However, defeating the animation villain wasn't easy with him constantly changing but thanks to her lucky charm a head camera she and Cat Noir discovered Animaestro's weakness if no one was watching him he stops moving. By telling everyone around them to close their eyes, cutting off the live feed and then with their eyes closed they were able to stop Animaestro.
Returning to the theather, Marinette begged Chloé not to tell Adrien her secret and yet heard her rival refuse to do it. Then, was given Thomas Astruc's movie pass so she could enjoy the event and to her surprise she was sitting next to Adrien hearing him apologize about not trying her macaron but Marinette didn't take it too hard and enjoyed the movie premier.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Bakerix", it was Tom's 40th Birthday and Marinette was making her annual sweater for him as well as listening to the unveiling of the new Startrain which left Tikki amazed and curious about it as how was it going to get to the U.K. when Marinette spoke of the train using a tunnel under the English Channel explaining that people made it with machines. And yet, she had trouble trying to figure out what to get her father Tikki wasn't worried as she always comes up with something perfect. Then, as Marinette went downstairs she saw her mother talking to her grandfather Rolland Dupain on the phone, but seeing the conversation end on a sour note she realized he wasn't coming. So she tried to ask her family why her grandfather has never left the house but didn't receive any answers.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
Noticing the look on her wielder's face Tikki knew she had the idea of getting Marinette's grandfather and father to make up after finding the address they leave for Rolland's bakery. Arriving there, Tikki was surprised that Marinette was giving so easily but she finally got in posing as a flour delivery girl. And yet, Tikki thought it wasn't the best idea for Marinette pose has someone else unaware how her grandfather would react. However, when Rolland discovered Marinette was his granddaughter he felt betrayed and was akumatized into Bakerix.
Then she and Tikki transformed into Ladybug and along with Cat Noir they followed Bakerix to the Startrain. By using a ketchup bottle and other ingredients to make a non traditional sandwich as a lure and trapping him in a wind turbine, the duo was able to save Marinette's grandfather and have him make up with Tom.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Backwarder", Marinette was talking with her friends on how to express her feelings to Adrien foolishly thinking that he and Kagami will fall in love over their weekend trip and follows her friends suggestion to write a letter soon after they leave Marinette was approached by Wayzz telling them that Master Fu needs help. But remembered the last time Fu called them for help it was about his lost house keys with that Tikki thought it was time that he learned to text and write a note. Upon making it to the Master's shop, she saw the guardian lying in bed after the doctor leaves, Marinette heard Master Fu choose her to be new guardian aware he won't live forever. Also in picking up his medications, they find out that Master Fu has a sweetheart for someone else.
However with three letters and little time Tikki advised Marinette to choose but to have enough time for everything they transformed into Ladybug.
First, she arrived as Ladybug meeting her master's lover to give her the former's letter, then at the train station Marinette detranformed and dropped off the "letter" for Adrien, Tikki praised her for taking the plunge.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
But upon making to the pharmacy Marinette was shocked to discover she gave the receptionist the wrong letter.
Due to the accidental letter mix-up Master Fu's friend Marianne Lenoir was akumatized into Backwarder, then Marinette transformed into Ladybug.
Using a pipe and having Cat Noir struck with the villainess' powers they were able to destroy the brooch and save Ms.
Lenoir.
After giving her the correct letter they watched Master Fu and Marianne talking and wondered why he wouldn't express his love to her and when Marinette said the time wasn't right.
Then, she was asked about her doing the same thing with Adrien that's when Marinette answered she'll have to find out if she's still alive, returning to school the next day Marinette heard from Adrien that he was thinking about while he was gone and received something from him which was constapation packets much to her suprise.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Gamer 2.0", with the help of Tikki; Marinette was swamped with a multitude of things until she was advised by Tikki to take a break but refused with everything being due tomorrow. Until, she was asked by her father to join them for video game date despite wanting to she refused and continued working until she fell asleep. Then, the next day continuing to be swamped with so many things Marinette heard that Max had a new game to test and like everyone else she turned down his offer. Until she was interrupted by a broadcast from Gamer who wanted to play with that she transformed into Ladybug.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
Meeting up with Cat Noir, Gamer invited them in but aware that it might be a trap the duo remained in contact. Once the rules were explained Ladybug as the Mime defeated Gamer 2.0 easily and was expected to be released until being told that she and Cat Noir had to defeat all the villains. After the first few rounds she was struggling believing she forget how to play, by watching Cat Noir and being reminded it was alright to have fun she started to enjoy herself. One by one heroes managed to beat them all but for them to defeat Gamer they had to fight each other. Having no other choice but refusing to fight Ladybug, watched in shock as the kitty sacrificed himself by elimination. During the final fight along with a few accessories including Cat Noir's ring and a bag of flour Ladybug defeated Gamer and freed everyone.
Outside of the stadium, she asked Cat Noir how does he still have fun and heard that he has the most fun when with her. Returning home, Marinette brought Max with her telling her parents about his new game and after experiencing today she decided to join them.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Weredad", late at night Marinette transformed into Ladybug to deal with Gigatitan again and along with Cat Noir followed him to her parent's bakery. While trying to deal with him, she summoned her Lucky Charm receiving a giant plastic donut but it ended up in her bedroom, despite that the duo managed to deakumatize August with little time she destransformed. But then, saw Cat Noir appear right behind her and aware that she was near every time her alter ego disapppeared hastilying believing he figured out her identity she told him he was in love with him unfornately it was heard by Marinette's father Tom, who was going to set up a breakfast between them much to her dismay. Then, was reprimaned by Tikki for lying about her feelings towards Cat Noir. While waiting for the hero the next day Tikki asked Marinette what will she do if Cat showed up and yet she was remembered that he was in love with her alterego. Until the kwami ruled out the possibility of Cat Noir actually being in with Marinette for real because of Ladybug's several rejections. Soon seeing Cat Noir coming Marinette panicked believing Tikki could be right and asked for her help but was speechless.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
Going on with the date was akward enough, especially with Tom pushing them on, but when Cat Noir told them about remaining to true to his feelings for Ladybug, Marinette put on a convincing act that she was heartbroken (but secretly happy).
However, Marinette's convincing act in front of her parents led to Tom's akumatization, her ending up separated from Tikki and trapped high up in a prison maze of thorny vines.
Despite hearing each other they couldn't find each other.
While Cat Noir battled Weredad on the outside, Marinette made it through the guanlet of trials and plucked the akumatized rose from it's pedestal deakumatizing her father but caused the thorn maze to start falling from the sky along with them.
Upon being reunited Tikki, Marinette finally transformed and by making a hang glider from a sailboat they were able to save Tom and Cat Noir arriving safely on the ground.
After pounding it with a weakened Cat Noir and restoring everything she saw the hero and her parents rush inside to check on her and was hugged tight by a relieved Tom but seeing that he was still angry at the hero for breaking her heart.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
Marinette calmed him down and accepted that Cat had feelings for Ladybug and wasn't heartbroken, much to the hero's happiness that he admited that he thought she was a fan of his due to her constant appearances surprising her that was what he wanted to say before she jumped him.
With everyone calmed Tom offered Cat Noir a job to work at the bakery to win Ladybug over much to Marinette's annoyance but everyone else's laughter.

Or so they thought, to their shock; Bob took everything from the band just to promote his own son XY, not letting him get away with this they head to his company. While Juleka and others distract the guards, Marinette and Luka made their way inside to confront Bob Roth. However the neogiations go south leading to Luka's akumatization into Silencer. Once everyone else had their voice taken or fled, Marinette thought Luka was going to hurt her too but instead she heard his love confession to her before he left to find Bob leaving her shocked.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
Once alone with Tikki in the bathroom, both suspected that it was Luka's true feelings for her, nonetheless, Marinette transformed into Ladybug but thanks to Bob the first confrontation with led to the heroine being muted by the villain. So she texted for Cat Noir's help, upon him arriving she texted him her condition of being stuck her in hero form and unable to call on her powers if they don't stop Silencer. Outside of City Hall, upon hearing Cat Noir imitate her voice despite being annoyed it gave her the idea to trick Silencer into doing the same. So they followed Silencer to the TVi studio.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
Arriving there seeing Bob on camera, but was against forcing Bob to tell the truth knowing it'd be meaninglesss, so they commenced the plan while Cat Noir distracted the villain, Ladybug took Bob to another room and made a fake Lucky Charm. Rejoining Cat Noir, they tricked Silencer into activating the real one; receiving a vacuum cleaner with it and Cat Noir destroying Silencer's helmet with Cataclysm they deakumatized Luka and retrieved their voices. As well as got Bob to admit that he stole everything from Kitty Section on live television. After Bob tried to save face by letting the band perform but before they did, Marinette heard Luka admit the same love confession to her when he was akumatized.
