When she heard Lila denying the possibility of humiliating Marinette and she wanted to transform out of retaliation, but Tikki halted her from doing so. Shortly after Lila's photo for attention caused Kagami's akumatization, she allowed Marinette to transform into Ladybug.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
However catching Oni-Chan was going to be tricky with her constantly teleporting everywhere Lila was. That's when Ladybug found out that Lila's horn acted as a beacon and after being tied by the heroine's own Lucky Charm a hose Ladybug decided to use it to her advantage. By bringing Lila close and answering the villain's call they switched places and in doing so Ladybug and Cat Noir stopped Oni-Chan and saved Lila.
In "Miraculer", after dealing with Destroyer and Marinette's conversation, Tikki advised her to talk to Chloé as Ladybug knowing she will only listen to her alter ego. But talking to Chloé was going to be a lot harder when Sabrina was akumatized into Miraculer. With the whole team on deck they were able to stop Miraculer, keep the Bee Miraculous safe and have Chloé come to an understanding. The next day, when Marinette voiced concerns hoping she didn't hurt Chloé's feelings too bad. Tikki comforted her by saying it was the right thing by protecting Chloé they were protecting themselves and everyone else which was the duty of being a heroine.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Oblivio", during Marinette's class field trip to the Tour Montparnasse when Alya and Nino were akumatized into Oblivio, she and Tikki transformed into Ladybug. However, their first fight with Oblivio resulted in Ladybug using her Lucky Charm and being struck by the villain. While in the elevator she woke up not remembering who she was let alone her partner (Cat Noir) but felt like they were suppose to know each other. But they both became alarmed by their beeping jewelry and noticed a pair of strange creatures appearing (their kwamis). However, she was scared of them and hid behind Adrien but upon hearing that Tikki was in the same condition as well as being very hungry Marinette felt sympathetic towards her seeing it best to stay together.
Upon noticing that the elevator was collapsing they tried to escape and do so thanks to their kwamis.
The amnesic pair tried to find a way out of the building but all the exits were blocked then hearing that a villain was after them they hid in the bathroom.
The duo tried to recap what happened, after Marinette fed Tikki a macaron she noticed her ID tag in her bag remembering her name and was greeted by Adrien (who remembered his name).

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
Marinette realized that they still had their phones but were locked, hearing Oblivio coming for them they hid in the stall and escaped through the air vent and she admired Adrien's compliment about her creativity.
Moving to another part of the building they resumed their phone problem.
After unlocking hers Marinette called her mother; from her and eying a poster of them dressed as they were earlier.
She discovered they were the heroes and afterwards explained the situation to Adrien.
Aware of her identity as a hero Marinette figured that they must known about each other's identities eying the many pictures of Adrien in her phone and him showing his they believed that they were a couple.
Despite that Oblivio was closing in on them again by having another diversion they manage to escape believing even without their powers they made a great team.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
From her phone Marinette learned what happened earlier and saw she left a message for herself, contacting Master Fu they figured out how to restore their powers. Upon seeing Oblivio's giant bubble and transforming again she didn't feel any different and while studying the user's guide she accidently activated her powers receiving a tea pot. Before facing Oblivio she was halted by Adrien believing they were stronger together but noticing that he was powerless without Plagg she wanted him out of harms way understanding her feelings for him. Leaving to fight Ladybug does a quick recap of her powers despite getting the hang of it she was cornered by Oblivio until Cat Noir tried to rescue her but were cornered again.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
Thanks to Plagg's return both heroes were back in action and they defeated Oblivio. Curious on what to do about the remains of his power Ladybug informed Cat Noir that she had a second power allowing her to revert everything back to normal. Shocked he asked her if they were going to remember any of this but sadly answers they won't. Realizing they'll forget being in love, Ladybug allows them to share a kiss and embrace before their memories were restored. However once everything was fixed they ask Nino and Alya if they seen Oblivio and answered that it was them. Being reminded of Cat Noir's good couple remark she told him that she was in love with someone else, seeing Alya's photo of them she freaked out about everyone seeing it. Was once again told her they were meant to be together and that she was only one didn't see it, but scolded Cat Noir saying this conversation was not over. Afterwards Marinette and her class heard of Alya and Nino's explaination and apology for what happened. Returning home Marinette was still freaking out about kissing Cat Noir and wondered how that happened, with Tikki believing that she still had things to learn about him.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Party Crasher", when Party Crasher crashed Adrien's party; Tikki and Marinette transformed into Ladybug. However, she along with Marinette end up being caught by the villain until they were freed by a new ally King Monkey. Along with their allies they were able to defeat Party Crasher and save Wayhem.
In "Christmaster", Marinette was babysitting Nino's little brother Chris she had a hard time keeping him under control but took it too far when she Chris sneaking into her stash of gifts for Adrien to cover it she lied to him that she was one of Santa's helper. Accidently exciting the boy believing she could call him and ask Santa about his gift but Marinette reminded that Santa was very strick about his rules making an exception for the most behaved kid in the world believing that her alter ego desired that title. Then, after Chris was taken home by Nino, she was chasitied by Tikki about her lie but Marinette retorted that she didn't want him to know about the gifts hopefully that Chris would learn patience.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
Then afterwards, Marinette worked on her next gift for Adrien until she fell asleep. And yet, was surprised to see that it was snowing outside and there was an army of toys everywhere, believing it was a dream she tried to go back to bed until Tikki pulled her hair telling her it wasn't and transformed into Ladybug. Finding Santa's crashed sleigh she received a message from Cat Noir about him hiding with Santa Claus at the ice rink. Hearing Santa explain everything, especially his sternness on Christmas rules, Ladybug realized the story she told Chris was half true and he was akumatized into Chrismaster with Philleppe's help and Cat Noir as the decoy the heroine and Santa Claus, managed to find Nino which confirmed the heroine's suspicion. Then, by summoning her lucky charm she received stationary supplies knowing that a gift was needed to solve all this she asked Santa for it but Saint Nick was still stern on tradition until eying his list they discovered that the most well behaved kid in the world was the heroine.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
Using the gift as bait Ladybug was led to Christmaster's hiding place and also where he saw the villain's toy minions captured Cat Noir but soon freed him and the duo fought against Christmaster's army including toy versions of themselves. By striking a deal with the young villain's ultimate gift on the line, Ladybug willfully gets the akumatized object and returned everything to normal. When Marinette had to babysit Chris again Marinette apologized for earlier making a promise with Chris to be more honest. When she finally told him who the presents were really for about her crush on Adrien, Chris covered his ears in disgust about romance as Marinette continued on.
In "The Puppeteer 2", Marinette was babysitting Manon until she was called by Alya about being invited to the Wax Museum. On the way there she was shocked that Nino found out about her crush on Adrien but was informed that Alya didn't tell him.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
Heard of Alya's plan to leave her alone to talk with him in which Marinette didn't feel comfortable with it, then continued while she and Adrien were in the wax making room. Nervously telling him that he wasn't a good friend hurrying to the bathroom believing that everything wasn't going well because she was afraid of rejection. So Marinette was advised by Tikki to be cool and calm like her alter ego upon leaving she discovered Adrien's statue and then she went on to gushing out her feelings even trying to plant a kiss on him. However upon discovering that it was the real him, Marinette freaked out
However, that would have to wait when Manon was reakumatized into Puppeteer but this time being able to control the wax figurines and yet the two transformed. By making a forgery of the villain's wand the duo was able to deakumatize Manon. Then, she and Adrien apologized to each other for their pranks and confusion but from Adrien, Marinette heard that he had a crush on another girl leaving her saddened by the news but upon returning home Marinette was encouraged by Tikki not to give up on Adrien yet.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Stormy Weather 2", after hearing Marinette possibly agree with Chloé about not changing Tikki thought otherwise believing that she had changed a lot since the beginning of the school year. Reminding Marinette of all the times she spent with Adrien albeit some of them were awkward but in the end she admits that Adrien had become a true friend. When Marinette admits about her ability to talk to him about anything except her feelings Tikki accepted that it was better nothing. Soon when Stormy Weather was on the loose again she and Marinette transformed into Ladybug. Even with Stormy Weather's increased power the duo still managed to defeat her. Afterwards, Tikki encouraged Marinette to drop off the notes for Adrien and when she did Tikki was happy to see an improved Marinette.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Timetagger", Marinette was at the park along with Alya as they were watching Ella, Etta, and Chris. Soon after she noticed that Mr. Ramier was akumatized again for the 24th time leaving under the excuse of helping her father taste test a new macaron flavor but was commented by Tikki that it wasn't her best one. Regardless they transform into Ladybug and make quick work of him afterwards she and Cat Noir were treated to ice cream by Mr. Ramier for the trouble. But soon they had to deal with another villain from the future Timetagger.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
But were short on time, recharging in lavatory at the Lourve; Marinette expressed doubt on how to defeat Timetagger, but Tikki assured her that every problem has a solution and retransformed. Then, she and Cat Noir bumped into Alix who had a message through her family watch with it saying, "Dig deep into past and you'll find the rabbit's burrow". With Cat Noir's joke in mind, the trio heads off to the Eygptian Exhibit after checking a hollow obelisk, the cat used Cataclysm revealing a future Miraculous holder named Bunnix inside. From her, Ladybug learns that she was apart of her's and Cat Noir's team of heroes in the future explaining that she was the heroine of the last resort coming to the rescue when everyone else fails including them. Shocked they were informed by Bunnix that in the future that one of her partner's cataclysms will damage her jewel, being given the damaged Miraculous.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
And yet, Ladybug wondered what they were going to do without it but to her surprise she saw that Alix's watch was actually the Rabbit Miraculous in camoflague mode and that Bunnix was Alix's future self. However, knowing this left her more confused as she never gave either of them the jewel until Bunnix confirms one day she would. Aware that Bunnix was from the future Ladybug believed that she knew how to beat Timetagger due to younger self seeing it. But due to the aged heroine being in a stone slumber for so long she couldn't remember anything except for her younger self playing a vital role. As they leave they see all the damage Timetagger had done to the timeline. Ladybug believed that she wasn't very powerful in the future until Bunnix told her the opposite about becoming the greatest leader and hero ever. Realizing her status in the future Ladybug wondered how she'll ever get to be like that and Bunnix answers by growing up.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
But once outside, the team had seen the damage and despite that they were ready to face Timetagger but was told by Bunnix to stay put. During the confrontation both she and Cat Noir witnessed Bunnix's mastery over her powers and stopped the hero from doing anything foolish. Believing that Timetagger was beaten Ladybug and the others bid their friend goodbye, however the fight wasn't over. As it dragged on she realized Bunnix needed help and summoned her Lucky Charm receiving a notepad, putting on the act of giving up she asks someone for a pen wanting to write an apology note to her future self (but drew a plan instead). Still putting on the act, she told Bunnix to return to the future when she refused Ladybug told her to trust her and Cat Noir it's time to surrender giving him a wink about her plan.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
She smiled when Timetagger was where he needed to be and with the help of their future selves the group defeated him. When Bunnix returns for him, she was surprised that the villain was Future Chris and complimented by herself saying they'll always come through and bids Bunnyx goodbye. With the damage repaired she tells Alix they'll see each other soon and yet, sometime later she and Cat Noir fought and defeated Mr. Pigeon again. While doing so, she made a call to Alya about not being able to babysit but was happy she found someone else. This time even though they didn't find a solution to stop Mr. Ramier's akumatization they knew they would next time. Upon hearing Cat Noir suggest that Mr. Ramier get attach to another animal, they take their leave, while walking she listens to him talking about everything Bunnix had told them.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Ikari Gozen", Marinette and her friends were participating in the Friendship Day Games, she was praised by Tikki for figuring out the first clue. But shrieked when she saw Kagami as her new friend aware that she too had a crush on Adrien. Believing that Kagami would take all the credit for winning the contest Marinette wanted to back out but was convinced by Tikki to give him a chance. Rather than win the contest Marinette decided to sabotage it so they'd lose.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
During the event, she was asked weird questions from Kagami while at the same time voicing her frustations to Alya about being paired with her. For the next part she and Kagami swapped their phones, still filled jealously towards her Marinette looked inside her phone despite Tikki's protest. Upon seeing it Marinette discovered that it had no other contacts except for her mother's and Kagami was using app on how to make friends. Feeling guilty she attempted to find her and apologize but upon reuniting Marinette saw it was too as Kagami saw her messages. Hearing Kagami's phone, she attempted to talk things over with her mother, but when she heard her being akumatized over the phone. Marinette attempts to hide her but were easily found and Kagami was held prisoner realizing she was wrong about her. Marinette transforms determined to save her friend, once explaining the situation to Cat Noir, Ladybug summoned her Lucky Charm receiving a movie ticket, racing to the cinema she was surprised to see Master Fu and once again was allowed to a Miraculous along with a trusted ally taking the Dragon Miraculous.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
Reuniting with her partner they knew that the akuma was in her bokken but had to bring down Ikari Gozen's guard first. In summoning another charm this time using a box of bathbombs she sends them along with the Dragon Miraculous' Kagami's way. Seeing her appear as Ryoku, Ladybug tried to tell her that Longg should've informed her about the plan, but was aware that she didn't listen and during the fight she saw Cat Noir get captured. Regrouping she heard Ryoku apologize for her hastiness and believes she wasn't worthy to work with them until she retorted saying that failing on the first try was no reason to quit and still needing her she advised them to work together telling her the plan.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
This time with Ryuko following along the trio were able to deakumatize Kagami's mother, and included her in their trademark pound it. After she receives the Dragon Miraculous back, Ladybug sadly tells her that she can't have the Miraculous again. At first Kagami believed wasn't good enough until Ladybug told her otherwise. Now that Hawk Moth knows her identity she told her that keeping one's identity was very important because it will lead to Kagami's loved ones being in danger. But when Kagami mentions about not having many friends, Ladybug tells her when it comes to friends it isn't about quantity but quality.
After returning the Dragon Miraculous to Master Fu, Marinette meets up with Kagami despite losing the contest she opts to go out with her for orange juice if she still wanted to in which Kagami agreed. She also heard Kagami mention of Adrien's opinion about her being a good friend and the two walk off together.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Reflekdoll", after finishing another akumatized villain, Ladybug talked with Cat Noir about their respective roles as a team about her being the serious one and him being of being the humorous one. Shortly after that she went off to school but due to one of their classes being cancelled Marinette and her friends were let out early. With the free time, she decided to work on her modelling website and along with Alya asked if one of her friends took her offer and was surprised that Juleka offered as well as when Adrien agreed to help. Back Marinette's house everyone was getting upon seeing Juleka have a breakdown Marinette opts to take her place and quickly accepts.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
During the change she was advised by Tikki not to take off her Miraculous for the photoshoot. However, Marinette assured her kwami, that she would be watching them for safe keeping. Arriving at the photoshoot, things went well until everyone saw that Juleka was re-akumatized, armed with a Reflekdoll sentimonster as well as very angry at Marinette for taking her role. Like everyone else, she was turned into a Reflekta copy, and amongst the commotion, noticed Plagg, then barraged him with questions, but was told it was a long story. Seeing the severity of the situation, and deciding she couldn't wait to find Tikki and the Ladybug Miraculous, she took the Black Cat ring and transforms herself into Lady Noire, reversing her transformation by Reflekta and Reflekdoll into a Reflekta copy. Soon she was rejoined by her partner, who also reversed his own transformation into a Reflekta copy when he used Tikki and the Ladybug Miraculous to become Mister Bug, being affectionately called Lady Noire. During the commotion, she realized that they had to take on Hawk Moth and his partner.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
But became annoyed that, like her during their first mission, Mister Bug had trouble controlling his yo-yo, informing him that he had to capture one akuma and amok. Avoiding Reflekdoll's blast, she stopped her partner from using his Lucky Charm aware that he didn't know enough about his opponent and yet remembered where the akuma was hiding. Upon hearing him ask for a mirror, she told him that her powers don't give the user what they want but was shocked when he received a mirror and called it beginner's luck. But seeing his attempt not work, she also reminded him that he had to figure how to use it, warning that Mister Bug had five minutes before transforming back, calling him Bugaboy. Hearing him retort back, she called herself funny, cunning, and ultra charming, using her Cataclysm on the sentimonster, but seeing it act up Lady Noire asked if that was normal, but heard that Mister Bug wasn't sure since he never did it.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
Seeing the sentimonster go berserk, they continued on and pulled Reflekta out of Reflekdoll, but when she mocked them for their looks, Lady Noire heard Mister Bug admire their new looks. Seeing the akuma, she reminded him about purifying the akuma, which he excitedly does, leading to Juleka's deakumatization, but seeing her instantly revert back upon being hit by a beam from her now berserking sentimonster, also reminded Lady Noire and Mister Bug that they had to stop Reflekdoll first. In trying to stop the sentimonster, they both admitted using each other's powers wasn't easy. When Mister Bug asks on how to use his Lucky Charm, seeing a hatch on the creature, she realizes that they can use the mirror to open it, releasing the amok.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
Once Reflekta was defeated and Reflekdoll destroyed, and everyone turned into Reflekta copies were restored to normal by Mister Bug and his Miraculous Mister Bug, Lady Noire and Mister Bug had a better understanding of the roles they played. Going their separate ways. Marinette detransformed and returned the ring to Plagg, thrilled by the experience and was happily reunited with Tikki. After rejoining her friends, Marinette apologized to Juleka, giving back her role and finishing the shoot.
In "Desperada", after Desperada attcked them on the houseboat when Marinette asked why she gave Adrien the guitar, Tikki replied that Marinette has a troubled heart. After escaping Desperada with Luka and Adrien and summoning her lucky charm receiving a gong the two detransform and leave for Master Fu's shop. Tikki then, saw Marinette take the Snake Miraculous retransform and with the help of their ally Viperion and Cat Noir destroying the villain's vantage point the trio was able to stop Desperada and save everyone.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Ladybug", Marinette nearly gets akumatized by Hawk Moth because Lila's deception got her expelled from school. Luckily, before it could happen and Marinette could become "Princess Justice", Hawk Moth called off the plan when Mayura collapsed from the effects of her illness and recalled his scarlet akumas. In her room, she was warned by Tikki of what could've happened if her akumatization was finished, refusing to let Hawk Moth or Lila get away with what they did or almost did, she heard that Marinette was going to prove her innocence. Agreeing, Tikki advised her to talk to Alya, noticing that she resisted being akumatized due to still believing in Marinette. While working at the bakery, from the news, they noticed Mayura fighting Ladybug, but knowing it was one of Mayura's traps, Tikki and Marinette transformed into Ladybug and went to save Cat Noir. After explaining to the hero that that the Ladybug imposter was actually a sentimonster, using a fork, Ladybug gained control of the creature, but instead of destroying her she asked for her help.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
But before the trio could get the Peacock Miraculous, the Ladybug sentimonster was destroyed in cold blood by Mayura, and soon the duo fought against Hawk Moth until their fight ended in a stalemate. And yet both sides valued their partners more knowing they could get the Miraculous of their enemies another day.
In "Startrain", after a late night fight; Marinette returned the Fox Miraculous to Master Fu until she was reminded by Tikki about her upcoming field trip to see Big Ben in London. She told him of their trip but Marinette knew she couldn't because of Hawk Moth until Master Fu gave them a way to go by taking the Horse Miraculous with them in case of emergency. The next day, on their way to the train station, Marinette saw Adrien believing this was going to be a great field trip. When Max's mom Claudie offered them an exclusive look into the operator cab which, she, Alya and Max agreed too but was shocked that Alya started another blog. During the train ride she sat next to Alya and became so sleepy that she let out a yawn so loud that left her embarrassed.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
Then, she was asked by Alya about what she did last night, she passed it off as trying to think of ways to tell her feelings to Adrien. However was advised just to be herself during the ride Marinette fell asleep on Alya's shoulder. Soon enough unknown to her she was sleeping on Adrien's shoulder which she didn't notice until she woke up seeing him asleep as well. However, Marinette was quickly woken up when an akuma unknowingly snuck aboard the train and akumatized Max's mother into the titular villain sending everyone up into space. Then she asked Max to convince his mother to turn the train around but when she refused, Marinette and everyone tried to ambush her but ended up separated using the chance she transformed.
With having to capture the akuma and teleport everyone back to earth at the same time the duo called upon their newest allies Pegasus using his powers of teleportation and Markov. The group battled their way through the train and made their way back to earth.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Feast", Tikki and Marinette went to Master Fu's under the worry that Alya figured out the secret of the Order of the Guardians. But she and the others were surprised that Master Fu was afraid of a statue to which he explained was a dormant sentimonster he created long ago out of his hunger and anger. So much so that the guardians and the temple were destroyed with him being the soul survivor. Realizing what Hawk Moth would do Tikki was returned to her Miraculous and placed back in the Miracle Box. But thanks to Marinette showing her bravery in the face of danger Tikki was reunited with her owner and they transformed into Ladybug. Armed with a metal detector the heroes dove into the belly of the beast they were able to destroy the sentmonster and restored the Order of the Guardians.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Kwamibuster", Marinette was having a lecture in Ms. Bustier's class until she and everyone heard a commotion downstairs until her teacher redirected their attention. During the night she was writing in her diary, upon noticing Tikki the kwami believed that Marinette didn't want to her read her secrets but she retorts that they have no secrets between them and fell asleep. However upon seeing her Science teacher show a picture of Tikki and Plagg on a tv show the next day Marinette left for the bathroom giving a slight scalding to Tikki about keeping secrets.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
Then to make matters worse, Marinette figured out that Plagg was there too leading to her believing that Cat Noir was one of the boys at her school. Despite being calmed by Tikki, Marinette was still disappointed and yet, didn't take it too hard as Tikki was trying to protect her aware of what would happen if their identities got out. Seeing that their little adventure caused Ms. Mendeleiev's akumatization they transformed into Ladybug and upon meeting Cat Noir, she gave him a scolding towards his kwami's recklessness wanting him to assure this would never happen again. But during the fight Ladybug was struck by Kwamibuster, she and Tikki were separated but thanks to Cat Noir, Marinette escaped.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
Frantically making it to Master Fu's shop, she explained the situation, aware of the danger. This time, Marinette was allowed to choose another Miraculous for herself. Aware of Mullo's ability to multiply, she took the Mouse Miraculous along with the remaining jewels, which left Master Fu very concerned because of the danger it posed. Marinette, however, assured that she was going to use only the Mouse Miraculous, but with essential help from the other kwamis. By using the powers of Multiplication and Unification, she, now Multifox, went back to battle, and enticed Kwamibuster with the rest of the kwamis she so desired. While Kwamibuster did capture the kwamis, she was too following Multimouse's plan. Inside of Kwamibuster's canister, Multimouse unified Tikki and Plagg at the same time, becoming Multibug and Multinoir. Then, Multinoir cataclysmed the canister, releasing all of the kwamis, as well as Kwamibuster's akuma. Multibug called up her Lucky Charm, able to rescue Tikki and Plagg, protect her identity, as well as hear Cat Noir's apology for the trouble his kwami caused.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
Afterwards, she returned all of the jewels to Master Fu, Tikki apologizing for what happened, saying that if she had to give up being Ladybug because of her, she wouldn't forgive herself. And yet, Marinette comforted her, understanding that everyone makes mistakes, and was a true friend she could rely on, leaving Master Fu's shop.
In "Cat Blanc", hearing the conversation among Marinette's friends, Tikki asked Marinette if she was really going to do this. But upon being denied entry into the mansion and hearing her wielder want to transform, Tikki once again tried to warn Marinette that her powers must not be used for personal gain. However, she agreed under the notion of being quick, but took too long as Ladybug and was spotted by Adrien. A serious mistake was caused leading to the duo being retrieved by Bunnyx and brought to an alternate future where everything and everyone in Paris was destroyed. Then after defeating an akumatized Cat Noir and by fixing a mistake in the past, Ladybug was able to save him and change the future.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
While in that apocalyptic future, Ladybug found the Cataclysmed and petrified remains of Hawk Moth, and herself. When she tried to touch her own body, it instantly disintegrated into ash, horrifying her that this was her fate because of what she had done earlier, and convincing her that she needed to fix what would lead to this fate in the past, before it could come true.
In "Félix", aware that it was anniversary of Adrien's missing mother and on the Couffaine houseboat Marinette was brainstorming ideas with her friends how to support Adrien and they all agreed to send a video message to him. However, when it was her turn to say something for Adrien's video care package, she wanted to her's in private but no idea what to say. And turned to Tikki for advice on what to say in situations like this and was told to speak from the heart. Afterwards, when Marinette was having second thoughts about deleting the message, Tikki halted her from doing so believing that her message could turn Adrien's sad day into a happy one.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
Then, she was found by Alya but had a hard time giving her tablet advising her best friend not to tell anyone about her message causing to faint. And moreso debate whether or not to stay and hear Adrien's message but ended up running away and babbled on about her predicament until she was surprised by Luka having his support if her relationship with Adrien works out or not. Upon hearing that Adrien replied back their excitement turned into horror as he replied with a nasty message like Nino; Marinette believed that Adrien would never say such terrible things. Then, left going to the upper deck trying to convince her friends not to believe the message but was too late as three of her friends akumatized into their alter egos.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
Understanding that Adrien was in terrible danger, Marinette transformed Ladybug and left for his home. Arriving in time she pulled "Adrien" out of danger taking "him" to Le Grand Paris Hotel, but she becomes surprised that "Adrien" tried to kiss her but feeling there was something wrong Ladybug told "him" to back off to the point of punching him aware that he wasn't the real Adrien. After being informed by Cat Noir that the imposter was Adrien's cousin Félix, aware that the trio was coming, she summoned her lucky charm getting a can of whipped cream but during the scuffle the duo found themselves in a three crossfire. Seeing Félix grab the tablet she told him to smash it but was surprised he didn't and was trying negotiate with Hawk Moth despite that by setting off a chain reaction with the can they were able to save him and deakumatize her friends. Sometime later, Marinette heard Adrien's thank you message for their support commenting she loved him.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1)", after dealing with Heart Hunter and Marinette on her way to return the Dragon Miraculous, Tikki saw that the place that they met Master Fu has been ransacked. Despite that she tried to assure Marinette that he was fine, unaware that he was captured.
In "Miracle Queen (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 2)", upon seeing a swarm of hornets coming after them, to escape Tikki activated her Aqua powers and they retransformed into Aquabug. Reuniting with Aqua Noir, the duo discovered that Chloé was akumatized again into Miracle Queen but to make matters worse, all their allies and Master Fu were captured and Hawk Moth was in possession of the Miracle Box. Through the powers of fusion as Snake Noir and Dragon Bug, they were able to save their allies, stop Hawk Moth, Mayura and reclaim the Miracle Box.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - "[[Miraculous New York]]"
After Mr.
Ramier was akumatized into Mr.
Pigeon for the 51th time, Marinette transformed into her new space form Cosmo Bug to stop him from using the Eiffel Tower as a rocket ship to the Moon, aided by Astro Cat.
Afterwards, they de-transformed and upon noticing Marinette taking photos of Adrien's advertisement, she was reminded by Tikki about giving up her romantic pursuit of her friend but she retorted it was for research purposes.
While hearing that Marinette and her class were going to New York for French American Friendship Week, Tikki wondered how her wielder was going to protect the city while she was gone, but was assured everything was taken care of, by having Cat Noir stay in Paris and warn her of trouble.
Marinette also learned that, due to her now being pregnant with child, Ms.
Bustier would not be joining them on the trip, with Ms.
Mendeleiev subbing for her alongside Principal Damocles joining the class.
However, during the flight, the plane was attacked by the wanted American super-villain Techno-Pirate, but was saved by the arrival of several members of the United Heroez, consisting of Majestia, Uncanny Valley, Knightowl, and Sparrow.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - "[[Miraculous New York]]"
While Marinette is attempting to socialize with Adrien, with a little help from Aeon, Jessica, and Hot Dog Dan, double trouble came when Hawk Moth was in New York too and akumatized Techno-Pirate into Techlonizer before the NYPD could take him to prison, to serve as a decoy so that Hawk Moth could acquire one of the Miraculous of the Native American Miracle Box that was on display in the museum for the Franco-American Friendship Week events.
In this case, the one that Marquis de Lafayette gave to George Washington at the end of the American Revolutionary War with his saber as a token of friendship between the newly-independent fledgling United States and France, the Miraculous of the Eagle.
Despite the young heroes defeating him, it led to Uncanny Valley's temporary demise when Cat Noir, who had come to New York to aid Ladybug, gets into an argument with her as she was upset he had left Paris unguarded and broken her trust, and using the distraction to his advantage, Techlonizer threw Cat Noir towards her, with his Cataclysm still active.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - "[[Miraculous New York]]"
Uncanny stepped in between her and Cat Noir and sacrificed herself to save Ladybug, which caused Majestia and Knightowl to return, ending the fight, with everyone joining Majestia, grief-stricken over Uncanny's death, as Majestia asked Cat Noir in heartbreak how could he do this, leaving him extremely remorseful and guilt-ridden.
Despite Ladybug managing to restore Uncanny with her powers, to which a grateful Majestia thanked her, they were harshly reprimanded by Knightowl for their recklessness and demanded that they surrender their Miraculous until they leave New York City but, the duo retreated into the sewers.
While there, they discovered that with no heroes to protect Paris, their home was wrecked by Mayura's sentimonster and with no chance of repairs due to the creature being dismissed, rendering any attempt to use Miraculous Ladybug useless.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - "[[Miraculous New York]]"
Detransforming, both Marinette and Tikki heard Cat Noir admit his guilt and take responsibility for everything that happened regarding both cities, and worst of all, hear him renounce his role and ring for not only breaking her trust in him, but also out of fear of what his destructive power did to Uncanny and for what he could've did to her, leaving the pair alone in the sewers.
Later, returning to the surface, Marinette watched as Adrien was ordered by Gabriel to take the next flight home to Paris, having changed his mind about letting him come to New York with Marinette and her class.
Sadly, she heard Adrien's heartfelt apology about her trying so hard to get him here as well as wouldn't have minded wanting to spend more time with her and watched him leave.
But with some convincing from Alya, she chased after him, but was unable to do so, sadly professing her love for him as he was driven away.
Following Adrien's departure, she was joined by Plagg in her bag until they were approached by Uncanny Valley, asking for Ladybug's help.
Despite trying to dissuade her, both Marinette and the kwamis were shocked that Uncanny had discovered her identity as Ladybug.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - "[[Miraculous New York]]"
Upon hearing the robotic heroine asking for her and Cat Noir's help, she was disheartened, believing she couldn't be her alter ego without her partner, but as hope would have it, she heard that Uncanny could find Cat Noir.
She gave the Black Cat Miraculous to Uncanny to give to Cat Noir.
Meanwhile, Marinette retransformed into Ladybug and helped Sparrow with damage control in the city.
In doing so, they realized that Techno-Pirate was reakumatized into Miraclonizer, with the comment from Sparrow, they discovered that what also Hawk Moth stole from the museum was the Eagle Miraculous, and with it's power sent the adult United Heroez into a rampage by freeing them of their moral and ethnical restrictions, causing destruction all over the city.
Then, they are reunited with Cat Noir and Uncanny, to whom she hugged Cat out of joy while he apologized for his dishonesty.
Then, through a live broadcast, the group heard that Hawk Moth was responsible for everything as well as declared a threat of war with a nuclear missile that Miraclonizer captured from Victory if Ladybug and Cat Noir did not surrender.
So the young heroes devised a plan with a keychain.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - "[[Miraculous New York]]"
The group realized since they couldn't face Miraclonizer directly, they had to be sneaky by using Doorman's powers, but with him reversed like the others, Ladybug turned his curiosity against him with her and Cat Noir making their way inside the Statue of Liberty.
Climbing their way up the tower, they retrieved the Eagle Miraculous and tossed it to Sparrow, who used it and Liiri to turn into their newest ally Eagle, who returned the adult heroes to normal.
With their help, they managed to de-akumatized Techno-Pirate and saved New York, as the nuke Hawk Moth threatened to use was thrown into the Sun by Majestia, preventing a potential World War.
Afterwards, with the job done, seeing Eagle attempting to return her Miraculous, Ladybug allowed her to keep it, knowing it would be safe with her, as well as received an apology from Majestia and Knightowl for misjudging them and thanks for a job well done.
Reuniting on Liberty's torch, she spoke concern about their identities, but was assured by Uncanny after their meeting that the knowledge would be erased from her memory, but before that, she thanked the robotic heroine for bringing her and Cat Noir back together.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - "[[Miraculous New York]]"
Seeing the pair fly off, Marinette joined her friends in finishing Franco-American Friendship Week while watching a video from Nadja back in Paris as thanks for their part in saving New York, and the world. She and Cat Noir were honored by the United Heroez with an ice sculpture of them with Uncanny and Eagle. Meanwhile, Marinette was found by Alya asking about her love problems with Adrien, but decided to deal with it once they're home.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Truth", Tikki was trying on hats while telling Marinette about the Miracle Box when her holder asked if it's she ever gets lonely while in there she retorts that there is a whole magically universe inside the box. When her holder discovered accidently how to open the box they both were surprised that her siblings got out and when Marinette asks how it happened Tikki answered that the box was in her likeness full of surprises and chased after Mullo when she stole her hat. Upon answering a video call Tikki explained to Marinette that kwamis can't be filmed or photographed. Soon due to constant calls of needing Ladybug and Marinette's refusal to share her secrets it led to Luka's akumatization. Even with a handicap Ladybug and Cat Noir manage to a deakumatize Luka, knowing how hurt her owner was about the breakup Tikki and her siblings gave Marinette a group hug.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Lies", however the night wasn't over for them yet when the same problem with lies caused Kagami akumatization into the titular villain paralyzing everyone who has lied but thanks to the help of Jagged's crocodile and a drone the heroes managed to deakumatized her. Meeting with Cat Noir at night they talked about much their hero life's had affected personal lives but assured that they could trust each other.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Gang of Secrets", Tikki stayed transformed by an overstressed Marinette until after being convinced by Trixx to do so which the kwami sensed that she was doing better than her owner. Despite talking to Marinette, the kwami was hastily transformed again until Marinette's friends came in and they sadly leave Tikki came out of hiding to console her. Things got worse when Marinette's friends were akumatized into the Gang of Secrets but after freeing Lady Wifi and with Rena's help, Marinette's girlfriends were freed. After the girls, made up, Marinette was stressed out by the pressure of being Ladybug and the Guardian of the Miraculous, she told her best friend - Alya her secret idenity as Ladybug. Alya was suprised at first, and hugged her, promising that she will be along with Marinette when she was needed.
In "Mr.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:

Pigeon 72", Tikki and Marinette were still transformed as Ladybug, as an added safety precaution, alongside wearing a bathrobe and towel like a lab outfit with safety goggles, while her owner was working on one of the power potions and how to find a way to limit Shadow Moth's supply of akumatized victims, trying to decode the information she had from the Miraculous spellbook to find a means to prevent Shadow Moth from akumatizing anyone again.
When it was time for a break after a couple of failed attempts that had explosive results, they de-transformed and Tikki was fed a piece of croissant while in her owner's purse and left for the pool, having been told by Alya that Adrien and Kagami had broken up, giving Marinette reason to try to get them back together, thus avoiding her own feelings for Adrien again.
However, in trying to get Kagami and Adrien back together, it resulted in Mr.
Ramier's 72th akumatization into Mr.
Pigeon, but this time armed with the power of turning people into pigeons, including Adrien.
Hiding inside the changing room, Marinette transformed into Ladybug, but couldn't risk leaving and being caught by Mr.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 4]]
Pigeon, so with a hand drill, Plagg, and Rena's help, she was able to de-akumatize Mr.
Ramier.
Even further, with Rena's insight, Ladybug enhanced her powers, creating the first magical charm, and after everyone else left, the pair head home.
Marinette discovered her power of creation potential and create "Magical Charms" - objects that can prevent further Akumatization from Shadow Moth.
In "Psycomedian", Tikki attended the show of Harry Clown with Marinette until the comedian was akumatized into the titular villain. Soon enough Tikki and Marinette transform into Ladybug, however, by guessing the wrong object the heroine was struck by the villain, becoming very angry. But when their transformation ended, Marinette's condition transferred to Tikki, making her very angry as well. Then, by following Cat Noir's lead, the duo de-akumatized Harry and were restored to normal from their angry state by Miraculous Ladybug, and returning to the show she convinced her owner to be herself.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Furious Fu", Celestial Guardian Su-Han asked Marinette giving up the Miracle Box that Master Fu gave her, saying she was not the legitimate Guardian. In the end of the episode, Su-Han recognize Marinette as a legitimate Guardian of the Miracle Box, but he will keep an eye on her: If she fails, he will take the Miracle Box back from her.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Sole Crusher", Marinette transformed into Ladybug and was out on patrol with Cat Noir, then met Zoé when she was carrying apples into her parent's bakery and bumped into each other. Hearing Marinette voice concerns about her new friend Zoé's behavior at school, Tikki suggested that she talk to her with honesty. Then, sometime later she and the other kwamis watched Marinette working on another project until hearing a commotion outside and Chloé coming up through the door causing the kwamis to hide, but seeing her owner captured by Sole Crusher, Tikki commanded Kaalki to use her powers and find Cat Noir while she followed after Marinette, during that time, Marinette tries to reason with Sole Crusher (who is Zoé akumatized) and is almost successful with it, but Shadow Moth managed to convince Sole Crusher otherwise. Once Marinette was freed, they transformed into Ladybug, by finding the right pair of shoes, they deakumatized Zoé and welcomed her to Paris.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Queen Banana", Tikki was at the cinema with Marinette and her classmates until Chloé's anger akumatized her into the titular villain. Upon receiving a motorbike with a repair kit inside via Lucky Charm but Ladybug realized that something was still missing but upon hearing Zoé the heroine discovered that they needed her help and along with Vesperia and playing on Queen Banana's ego Chloé was deakumatized.
In "Gabriel Agreste",
In "Mega Leech", Tikki was sleeping with Marinette until they were awakened by the construction noise going on outside and see both Ivan and Mylène protesting but being taking away by Roger as well as Marinette asking to transform to help team. She advised not too as the police deal with normal civil problems then they left for school. But when the stress of the protesters increased causing Mayor Bourgeious' akumatization into Malediktator again but this time aided with a sentimonster creating Malediktator clones. By transforming into Ladybug and with the help of many including a new hero named Polymouse the villain and sentimonster were beaten.
In "Guiltrip",

text:

In "Crocoduel", Marinette was invited to a party for Juleka and Luka's on a houseboat but finds out its a trap for getting her to talk to Luka. She asks Juleka to tell Luka to not be at the party then she said yes and she delighted. But the party was put on hold when Anarka's and Jagged's arguing over who broke up their family caused a double akumatization. With the help of the team's newest member Purple TIgress and a high sky battle the hero trio were able to deakumatized Juleka's and Luka's parents.
In "Optigami",

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Sentibubbler", Tikki was sleeping on Marinette until she was flunged off by her owner was having nightmares about leaving the Fox Miraculous with Alya. Like her siblings she agreed that Alya was worthy of being a Miraculous holder but was worried Trixx and his mischief leading Marinette to panic even more when Xuppu brought up Trixx causing a past incident leading Tikki to follow her panicked owner to Alya's house. However a bit after they got there the pair end up trapped in Sentibubbler's bubbles held for ransom like Alya's family but Tikki expressed trust in Alya and encouraged Marinette to do the same. As things went on needing Ladybug, Marinette suggested that Tikki look for a new owner but the kwami informed her that the earrings couldn't come with her. However seeing an illusion of Ladybug they were aware that Rena's plan was in action but had to warn Cat Noir afterwards they saw Shadow Moth in person after luring the villain away. Soon Cat Noir gets captured too then being covered with an illusion to cover Tikki, Kaalki and Marinette transform into Pegabug and along with the hero saved Alya's loved ones.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Glaciator 2", Tikki and Marinette transformed into Ladybug to deal with Glaciator again and some time later after hearing Kagami mentioning Marinette praticing her love affairs with a partner she suggested to do it until Marinette politely turn down the offer. Noticing Cat Noir nearby she found it strange to see him, and seeing her owner getting the idea of using him as a partner Tikki went into hiding. But the pratice session was halted when André was akumatized again after being led to safety Tikki was shocked about André's condition thinking that her owner gave him the magical charm earlier however Marinette replied she didn't so they transformed into Ladybug once more. With the help of a sports car and Cat Noir using a Cataclysm on a turbine cover the duo saved André.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Hack-San", when Tikki heard that Marinette and her family were leaving for London for the weekend the kwami encouraged her not to abandon her family, but not wanting a repeat of what happened in New York, Tikki and her Miraculous were lent to Alya. With the Kwami of Creation having total confidence in her owner's best friend despite Trixx's objections, came the chance for Alya to be Ladybug when Markov was akumatized into Robostus again. So they transformed into Scarabella however they forgot about minor detail a suspicious and angry Cat Noir but after calming him down and quick recharge the two heroes had a rocky start at working together. But then by embracing their true selves the duo were able to deakumatize Markov and save everyone and after Marinette returned from her weekend trip, Tikki returned to her.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Rocketear", because Shadow Moth knew of Alya's reemergence as Rena Rouge, Marinette has her go undercover under the new alias "Rena Furtive" to continue her duties helping Ladybug and Cat Noir, but warns her that she can't tell anyone, not even Nino, of her new secret identity or it could compromise her again. Shadow Moth uses Nino's jealousy of thinking Alya was seeing Adrien now to turn him into Rocketear. After he is returned to normal, Alya goes behind Marinette's back and tells him the truth of her new identity of Rena Furtive.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Wishmaker", when Alec was akumatized into Wishmaker to grant everyone's childhood wishes, Marinette becomes Ladybug, and has Luka become Viperion again in case Wishmaker causes her or Cat Noir to reveal their civilian identities to Shadow Moth. Indeed, during the fight, Ladybug is accidentally hit by one of Wishmaker's attacks, and involuntarily reverts back to Marinette to live out her childhood dream of being a magical knitting fairy. Viperion reverses what happened with Second Chance, and after doing it again when Cat Noir blows his cover, the third time proves successful in de-akumatizing Alec without giving away Ladybug or Cat Noir's civilian identities to Shadow Moth. However, Luka still knows the truth that Ladybug is Marinette and Cat Noir is Adrien, but keeps it to himself and doesn't tell Marinette.
In "Simpleman",

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Qilin", during the middle of the night Tikki and Marinette transformed to deal with saving Paris from a rancid chocolate factory explosion then returned home. Then, the pair transformed for a second time dealing with Lollipop Boy sentimonster. While having a day out with Sabine, Tikki admired her for her calmness and organization skills, however, an accidental mishap happened causing Sabine's akumatization. Luckily, Ladybug and Cat Noir are able to talk Qilin down and get her to become Sabine again, and Marinette later explains everything to Roger and the racist ticket inspector that caused Sabine's akumatization in the first place, forcing the ticket inspector to apologize, and Marinette offers to pay off her mom's fine.
In "Dearest Family", Marinette finds herself struggling to contain Tikki when she becomes obsessed with the new dessert that Marinette's family baked.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 4]]
Worse still, Shadow Moth manages to upgrade his powers with the Butterfly Miraculous to create Megakumas that could bypass and destroy Ladybug's Magical Charms, using his first one to turn Tom, Sabine, Roland, and Gina into their akumatized forms again to terrorize Paris as they tried to hunt down Marinette because of their conflicting intentions for her well-being.
Not even becoming Ladybug restrains Tikki as Marinette becomes possessed by Tikki's cravings as Ladybug.
It all culminates in Tikki using her powers of Creation to create a massive galette over Paris, threatening to crush the city.
Cat Noir stops it with Cataclysm, and before Tikki can try again, Marinette calls her out on her behavior.
Ashamed, Tikki apologizes for her actions, and after Marinette assures her they can help Tikki fight off her cravings together, they become Ladybug again, find the source of the Megakuma that created Dearest Family, and have Cat Noir destroy it with Cataclysm, catching both heroes by surprise when they see the Megakuma for the first time before Ladybug catches and purifies it before giving new Magical Charms to the Dupain-Chengs.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 4]]
Afterwards, despite Marinette's gratitude for her new motorcycle that Gina got her, she opts for an electric scooter for now until she's old enough to drive the motorcycle.
In "Ephemeral",

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Kuro Neko", after seeing Plagg return to Marinette with Cat Noir's ring, Tikki heard her counterpart give her owner an earful about her treatment towards Cat Noir and why he left. With no choice, Tikki was shocked to hear along with her siblings that a new Cat Noir would be chosen. But seeing Marinette having a rough time doing so and knowing that their owners needed to talk things out, Tikki wasn't very happy about following Plagg's plan in convincing Marinette to let him choose his owner when night came Tikki and Marinette transformed into Ladybug ready to meet their new partner the gallant and refined Cat Walker soon they were called into action when the Kuro Neko sentimonster appeared. Despite the duo's best efforts every plan went wrong even causing the hero's Cataclysm to strike creature causing it to rampage. But seeing Cat Walker leave the heroine understood that this problem could be solved alone and this time Cat Walker accepted it after that the big bad cat was tamed then the pair returned home.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Penalteam", Tikki went with Marinette and her class to the stadium for a soccer match until Chloe's sour attitude akumatized her into Penalty with a team of clones. Answering the call she and Marinette transformed into Ladybug then summoned the whole team along with 4 new members Miss Hound, Caprikid, Rooster Bold and Minotuarix to meet her challenge. During the first half of the match Team Miraculous doesn't do so well when Ladybug acted like a bad team captain realizing the heroine's mistake and by uniting the team as well as turning Chloe's fondness for cheating against her Team Miraculous won the soccer match and deakumatized Chloe.
In "Risk", she transformed into Pennybug to get back Adrien, under the effect of the titular villain.
In "Strikeback", she fought alongside side the French Miraculous superhero team to defeat the titular villain, but she would make a fatal mistake.
She recruited a new Dog Miraculous holder; who she thought was Adrien Agreste, but was actually his cousin, Félix.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 4]]
She gave him the miraculous to fight alongside the other heroes, but sometime during the chaos, he subtly used Fetch to be able to access Ladybug's yo-yo, unbeknownst to her or anyone else.
The team defeated Strikeback, but when she went back to the Agreste mansion to get back the Dog Miraculous, the actual Adrien didn't know what she meant, and she realized her mistake.
Before she could stop anything else from happening, Félix fetched her yo-yo, giving Gabriel an opportunity, immediately taken, to get the Miraculous.
She started to hyperventilate and panic, but she de-transformed and re-transformed to get her yo-yo back.
When she had checked to see if there was anything left, she was met with disappointment, regret, pain, and sorrow, as there were none left.
She was too late.
Shadow Moth had already captured all of the Miraculous from the Chinese Miracle Box except for hers and Cat Noir's, meaning he now had both the Miraculous, and their Kwamis, at his beck and call.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 4]]
Later, Shadow Moth, now known as Monarch, sent a message with the power of Transmission to the citizens of Paris, that Ladybug and Cat Noir had lost, and that he would relentlessly cause chaos if he didn't receive Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous.
Ladybug could do nothing but collapse into a crying fit at having failed to protect the Miraculous and allowed Monarch to become much stronger than before, but Cat Noir reminded her that she still had him, ending the season.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Evolution", after "Strikeback", she fought alongside Cat Noir and Bunnyx to re-gain the stolen Miraculous, but was unsuccessful in doing so, as she only regained one Miraculous, that being the Miraculous of the Rabbit, which was a good thing as that was one of the most dangerous Miraculous to be in the hands of evil due to how it could be used to alter the past and change the present and future. Once the Rabbit Miraculous was recovered, it was entrusted to Alix Kubdel, who became Bunnyx permanently, joining her future self to protect the timeline from being altered in anyway. Ladybug's success in getting the Rabbit Miraculous back also causes Nathalie Sancoeur to cut ties with Monarch, seeing that he is beyond redemption now as he chose power over helping save her and his wife when he had the chance to do so in the past before losing the Miraculous. At the end of his rope because of Nathalie's abandonment, Gabriel screams Ladybug's name in rage and fury.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Multiplication", Marinette was still feeling guilty about losing the Miraculous, mistaking Félix for Adrien, and failing her mission, but Alya assured her that it wasn't her fault, and that Félix would have fooled anyone. Marinette, however, believed this meant that she didn't know Adrien at all. Alya tried to assure her that she did know Adrien, reminding her of the times they had together, including their kiss at the Musée Grévin, even though she thought he was a statue.
In "Destruction", months prior, Marinette taught the kwamis on what to do in the event that they were captured, which came when Monarch voyaged into her room during their sleepover with Alya. Tikki hid in Marinette's bed and once the mastermind left after receiving the gift, Tikki understood what it meant and transformed with Marinette into Ladybug. Then, they left for the wax museum to enact their plan, but it failed with no freed kwamis and a Cataclysmed Monarch, who Ladybug could not reverse the damage on because he escaped with her Lucky Charm, preventing her from using her Miraculous Ladybug, so the pair returned home.
"Miraculous Paris"

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 5]]
After the duo's failed plan and Monarch's Cataclysm induced injury, Marinette was in her room discussing the recent events with Alya until she watched in shock that Alya transformed into an unknown superheroine, then opened a portal for a parallel universe Butterfly Miraculous user, named Betterfly, to come through. Explaining his actions, she heard that he came seeking her universe's bearers of the Ladybug and Black Cat Miraculous, but Marinette told him that his search was in vain. Once Alya was in control of her body again, Marinette was confused on to how to tell her what happened, with Betterfly explaining that he kamikotized the Alya of his universe into Ubiquity, and thereby extension Alya, enabling him to travel between their universes to seek help. But before anymore could be explained, the pair were warned that Betterfly's enemies were coming, so Marinette was taken to safety by the hero.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 5]]
Later at the Eiffel Tower, with further explaining from Betterfly, she learned that the enemies pursuing him were the evil bearers of the Ladybug and Black Cat Miraculous from his universe, Shadybug and Claw Noir. After she was safe, from Tikki, Marinette learned that everything said by Betterfly was true, as well as information the kwamis kept secret of parallel universes, each with their own Miraculous and kwamis, but never was told about it due to it being too complex and time consuming to explain. But noticing something different about the darker duo, from Tikki, Marinette also learned it was because the dark heroes used their powers for evil, giving them unlimited powers, but at the cost of their lives. After being told the gist of it, she transformed into Ladybug to protect Betterfly from the dark holders, soon to be joined by Cat Noir, only to horrifyingly watch when Claw Noir deliberately has Cat Noir hit him with his Cataclysm to injure him. Seeing that they were being overpowered, thankfully, due to Betterfly, Cat Noir was kamikotized into Celesticat, flew them both to safety, temporarily losing Shadybug and Claw Noir.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 5]]
Regrouping and recharging in the sewers, they heard more about Betterfly's universe and of it being ruled by The Supreme, who possessed all of the Miraculous and gave them to those he saw worthy under a corrupt system, to which Betterfly was apart of, wanting to use the jewels to get what he desired until it cost him something dearly, but convinced him to use his Miraculous for good and not evil, which caused The Supreme to strike back by assigning Shadybug and Claw Noir to hunt him down and recover the Miraculous. However, Marinette told him not to get his hopes up because their world isn't so great either as Monarch stole the Miraculous she was protecting, wondering how she could give hope to Betterfly's world if she couldn't protect her own. Upon hearing Betterfly's words of encouragement, the duo heard they were fighting the dark incarnations of themselves.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 5]]
Resurfacing, they scoured the city looking for Shadybug and Claw Noir, only to find them gigantic. At first, the heroes believed they were akumatized, but seeing Betterfly's power to be ineffective proved they were not and had to be illusions made with the Fox Miraculous' power of Mirage. From Alya, the hero trio learned that the dark duo have allied with Monarch to try and draw them out. At first, Ladybug had no idea how to handle the situation, but thanks to her allies' encouragement, she does: First, they left for London, thus being out of Monarch's sensing range. Second, Betterfly re-kamikotized Alya into Ubiquity again, opening a portal to Betterfly's universe. Then, by using Betterfly's Miraculous, Ladybug unified herself into Ladyfly to kamikotize the Re-Verse Gabriel into Guardian Angel to protect her and Cat Noir from Monarch, while stashing his kamikotized object out of Monarch's reach in Betterfly's universe. With the plan made, Ladyfly, Cat Noir, and Ubiquity returned to Paris.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 5]]
Thanks to Ladyfly's plan, Monarch's plan failed, allowing her and Cat Noir to deal with their dark counterparts personally, with the pair ending up at the school. As the fight heats up, she summoned a Lucky Charm: a hand mirror, commenting about it, but her counterpart couldn't care less. Upon hearing Shadybug ranting about how different their lives were made, Ladyfly realized Shadybug read her diary. Understanding what the mirror meant, she calmly replied about being the same until Shadybug retorted otherwise. Understanding her plight, Ladyfly de-transformed to continue reasoning with Shadybug, explaining no matter how much darkness there is, as long as there is light in yourself, others, and in the world around you, anything could be fixed. But hearing her counterpart hesitate to do so, Marinette lightly encouraged her as by doing it, you fix yourself too. With that, she watched Shadybug use her Miraculous Ladybug to fix all the damage to Paris, which healed her and Claw Noir of their condition from their jewels as well as saw Shadybug undergo a costume change and they shared an embrace.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 5]]
By morning, Ladybug and her counterpart rejoined with Betterfly, Cat Noir, Claw Noir, and Alya, who were impressed by the reformed Shadybug's new outfit, then saw Claw Noir do the same with his costume, renaming himself Paw Noir, while her counterpart took her name to honor her. With everything fixed, and the Re-Verse team made stronger than ever, Betterfly kamikotized Alya into Ubiquity again to return them home. But before they left, Ubiquity alerted them to a great disturbance of saying someone else was trying to travel between universes, with Ladybug deducing it was Monarch, who used the stolen Rooster Miraculous to give himself the power through Sublimation to travel between universes, and allow him to steal the Ladybug and Black Cat Miraculous from other universes instead. To counteract this, Ladybug was kamikotized into the superheroine Ladybiquity.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 5]]
Using her new powers, she synchronized with her other universe counterparts, stopping Monarch in his tracks. With the parallel universes protected, Ladybug was de-kamikotized. The parallel teams thank each other as they both restored what they had lost: Hope. Believing they'll retrieve the rest of their Miraculous back from Monarch someday, the teams shared a "Pound It" fist bump with each other before leaving. Back home, after everything that happened, Marinette reminiscences on how thankful she was to have Alya and everything in her life. Soon they went downstairs, joining Marinette's parents for breakfast with Sabine and Tom, while planning for Monarch's plan thanks to the renewed hope they got from Betterfly, Paw Noir, and Re-Verse Ladybug.
Post-"Miraculous Paris"
In "Jubilation", Marinette was explaining to Tikki that Adrien quit being a model, and that a digitized 3D model was instead taking his place, being unusually realistic.
Just then, Marinette saw someone dressed up as Ladybug attempting to save Mr.
Damoclès.
While this fake was successful in doing so, Marinette ran up to her questioning if she was actually Ladybug, knowing she wasn't.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 5]]
The fake nervously denied the question, and ran away, noticeably without using her yo-yo.
The fake was Socqualine Wang, the upper classman who protected Marinette from Chloe and Sabrina previously, and was Marinette's inspiration for why she wore her hair now.
When Marinette later spoke to Socqualine and asked her to be more careful with imitating Ladybug, Mr.
Damocles overhears and feels hurt by Marinette's words.
Monarch takes advantage and akumatizes him into Darker Owl, along with granting him the power of the Pig Miraculous' power of Gift through his Alliance Ring.
When Ladybug and Cat Noir are affect by Gift, they are trapped in a vision of beating Darker Owl, then Monarch, thus getting the Miraculous back, then getting married, having kids, and still protecting Paris with the restored team.
All the while, Ladybug is constantly pestered by her Lucky Charm of an alarm clock, before finally coming to her senses, as does Cat Noir, snapping out of the vision, and being forced to stop Cat Noir before he attempts to actually kill Darker Owl with Cataclysm in a blind rage.
They then de-akumatize Mr.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 5]]
Damocles, gift him a new Magical Charm, and later discuss the vision that they suffered from Gift and how Monarch pulled it off in the first place, wondering if that vision truly was what they want in the future or not, or just a trick so Monarch could get their Miraculous.
Marinette also refuses to wear an Alliance Ring, fearing Monarch could find her if she does wear one.
In "Illusion", Marinette video calls Alya to talk about how they miss being superheroes.
In "Determination", Marinette is once again struggling with her growing affection for Adrien, when Musée Grévin curator Véronique is akumatized by Monarch into Manipula, empowered with the Ox Miraculous' power of Resistance, to take revenge on Mayor Bourgeois for threatening to close the wax museum if she opened the new exhibit of Ladybug and Cat Noir with all their allies in the French Miraculous Superhero Team.
As Ladybug and Cat Noir fight the wax figures of their teammates brought to life by Manipula, they also find that the Megakuma was divided between the museum brochures that brought the figures to life, and they have to destroy all of them before they can capture and purify the whole Megakuma.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 5]]
When they find Manipula at City Hall, Chloe berates Ladybug, saying this wouldn't have happened if she was still Queen Bee and not replaced by Vesperia.
Though Manipula manages to pin Ladybug down herself while the wax Minotaurox restrains Cat Noir, Ladybug elbows Manipula hard enough to force her to let her go as Manipula recoils in pain, before being knocked out cold and senseless by the Mayor's office chandelier falling on her thanks to Ladybug's Lucky Charm, giving Ladybug time to finish collecting the Megakuma's essence, purify it, and fix everything with Miraculous Ladybug, before convincing Mayor Bourgeois to agree to open the French Miraculous Superhero Team exhibit after all, much to Chloe's ire.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Passion", Tikki was working on a drawing in the art the Art room until she was approached by a flustered and worried Plagg upon about the love between his owners getting serious and if they get any closer it will end in diaster but the kwami of creation calmed his nerves being told of his guardian's failed love attempts. Later, seeing that Timetagger had returned Tikki and Marinette transformed into Ladybug, joined Cat Noir but only that Timetagger was just an illusion and that Safari was real villainess but soon they become paraylzed by a venom bolt but was carried to safety by the hero ending up in the sewers. After Cat Noir detransformed and then removed Ladybug's miraculous both Tikki and her owner were freed from the paralysis but the kwami remained in the earrings.
Then, after hearing Adrien explain the situation heroes figured out they could fight as their partner alter egos so Tikki went Adrien leading to the return of Mister Bug and Kitty Noir together they managed to save Nathalie and soon reunited with Marinette afterwards. Arriving back home Tikki along with Alya heard Marinette continue to gush over Cat Noir.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Reunion", during their trip at the Louvre, Tikki was asked by Marinette if any of her previous owners fell in love their Cat Noirs even though the kwami speaks of a pair but she remarked that they didn't have an evil Miraculous holder intended on stealing their powers nor did she know much about romance. Then, Tikki directed Marinette in telling her the true power of her Kwagatama when coming into contact with a guardian symbol with a relic in the museum allowing her to talk with her predecessors. But as they proceeded Tikki wasn't sure about it until Marinette reassured her and once the magic was activated Tikki showed that Jeanne's portrait was the one Marinette wanted upon selecting it Tikki was happy to be reunited with Jeanne and easily explained her current owner's situation to her former. But she heard her former owner refused to answer Marinette's question but it would have to wait as Jalil was reakumatized into the Pharoah and Tikki and Marinette transformed into Ladybug.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 5]]
Fighting a battle of wits through the museum with Cat Noir and Jeanne, the heroine discovered the reason for Pharoah's actions and by convincing him to use his powers to seek the truth it led to Jalil's deakumatization. Then, she heard Jeanne explain her love story to Marinette but the story ended on a bittersweet note and Tikki explained that the reunions only allow the current holders to talk to past versions of their former owners only with their memories as Miraculous holders intacted with that the reunion ends. But when Marinette asks that to have a love story if she'll have to give up her Miraculous Tikki looked on in concern.
In "Elation", she explored her love for Cat Noir (Marichat) further, and when André discovered this, he was heartbroken, making way for his re-akumatization into Glaciator. She and Cat Noir were about to share a kiss, but before this could happen, she stopped herself and started to spiral. Determined, Monarch attempted to akumatize Marinette, but Cat Noir stepped in by kissing Marinette, effectively saving her from being akumatized. She pretended that everything was fine, but in her room, she said that she doesn't know how to work "this love thing" out.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Transmission", Marinette was stressed too much by exploring her love for Adrien; figuring out how to confess her love, and how not to stumble when trying to do so; being Ladybug and getting the Miraculous back, and having to keep her identity a secret, Adrien feeling the same.
