Eventually, Tikki and Plagg decided that being Ladybug and Cat Noir was too much of a burden on them, and they renounced their miraculous. Monarch, realizing this, attempted to akumatize them, but when they realized they were free, they no longer felt the burden, and were no longer stressed. Meanwhile, Tikki and Plagg found new holders; Alya as Scarabella, and Zoé as Kitty Noire.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Deflagration", during the catastrophic events of Tikki using her unstable Lucky Charm, and Plagg cataclysming his Miraculous, she had to step in and retrieve her Miraculous from Monarch, who unified it and his Miraculous, making him Monarchbug. With the help of the Resistance, she got her earrings back. She used the previously summoned Lucky Charm, and as Monarch went to snatch the Cat Miraculous, she intercepted him, to realize that the other Miraculous had been reformed. She got the Cat Miraculous back, but Monarch had escaped. At the end of the episode, she and Cat Noir declared that they're the only perfect pair.
In "Perfection", Marinette was still trying to tell Adrien her true feelings for him with Alya but is unintentionally putting off Kagami, making her question their friendship. After defeating her as Ryukomori, with Kagami's help, Marinette realizes that she always freak out is because she doesn't think she's good enough for Adrien and thanks her, calling her just as much of a best friend as Alya.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Migration", while Ladybug was taking a breather and thinking of how to beat Gold Record, Luka assured her that she was going to defeat him, but she didn't realize what he was saying. When he clarified, she didn't understand at first, but then it hit her that Luka knew her secret identity as Ladybug, and furthermore Cat Noir. She began to panic at first, but when Luka assured her that she was doing great, she kept on.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Derision", Marinette had randomly started panicking, her thinking that she was just hungry and needed something to eat but even after she ate, the feeling was still there. Even then, she kept on, and had her first date with Adrien, only to have even more panic attacks, where she realized that something was wrong. She had an outburst at Adrien, soon feeling apologetic, and ran into the locker room, where Monarch attempted to akumatize her into Panic. Marinette knew that she had to figure out what was wrong, where she remembered what had happened to her in her past, caused by Kim at Chloé's request that led to her present state of mind with wanting to know everything about the boy she's crushing on before going steady with him. By remembering that incident, she made peace with her past and ended her panic attacks, preventing her akumatization.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 5]]
With great joy, she ran to tell Adrien the news only to find Kim akumatized into Dark Humor striking people into playing dirty tricks on others with Adrien providing cover she transformed into Ladybug however she was met upon with a furious Cat Noir mad at the titular villain (unaware he wanted to avenge her alterego). Watching him attack the titular villain so recklessly she tried to calm him down to no avail even restraining him when he attempted to use his Cataclysm on Dark Humor.
She fights off Kim as Dark Humor and she accepts his apology for what he did to her last year, thus making amends with him as he also wanted to atone for being duped by Chloé and making Marinette the girl she was today.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Intuition", Monarch akumatized A.D.A. into Bugfighter, while using the Snake Miraculous and its power of Second Chance, stranding her pilot, so Marinette transformed into Cosmobug alongside Astrocat to de-akumatize Bugfighter and save Claudie. She was unable to do so, but Bugfighter realized that Monarch had been deceiving them, so Monarch kept using Second Chance, but every time he tried, Bugfighter realized his lie. He realized that Bugfighter would keep finding that he had disabled their sensors, so he eventually gave up, effectively making the akumatization and all of its related events not happen, though this was only after he used Second Chance so much, he suffered a heart attack from his Cataclysm necrosis, forcing him to abandon the plan altogether. Meanwhile, on a rooftop with Cat Noir, with the effects of Second Chance having affected them, the heroes lamented that Monarch hadn't used it yet, unaware that he did, but their adaptability and unpredictability defeated him every time, while it only brought Monarch closer to death's door from his Cataclysm injury in the process.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Protection", Marinette has a picnic date with Adrien at the Agreste mansion, but it's soon interrupted by an akumatized Kagami as Riposte Prime; all part of Gabriel's plan to break up Adrien's romantic relationsip with Marinette and force him back with Kagami. After deakumatizing Kagami, Marinette finds out why she attacked her. After Adrien defends Marinette from Lila's accusations, Kagami ends up crying and the two comfort her and tells her not to suppress her emotions anymore but to embrace them.
In "Adoration", Marinette is planning the end-of-the-school-year dance with Zoé. During which, she is framed and also expelled from school for stealing items to help make her dress for the event. She defeats an akumatized Sabrina and Zoé admits her feelings for Marinette. This inspires Marinette to finally tell Adrien she loves him. They are about to kiss when Adrien suddenly backs off. She's weirded by it but at least she's glad she told Adrien how she feels.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Emotion", despite Marinette and Adrien becoming a couple, she found it strange that Adrien ran off every time they got close until while talking to Nino and Alya, she discovered that she freed Adrien from modelling but not his father's expectations including him attending the Diamond's Ball. Which she found out was a party for the richest people in Paris but aware of Zoe's status and that she was at the movies.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 5]]
Once there, Marinette asked her friend why she wasn't going to the event, Zoe replied that she didn't enjoy those parties even back in New York where she had to pretend to be someone she wasn't and she realized it was the same for Adrien. Wanting to talk to him but realized she didn't have an invite until she was given Zoe's. Marinette went to the event but Tikki found it strange that they were going to a party that wasn't their place only until Marinette clarified they were only going so she could express her feelings to Adrien and then leave. Once there, she was dressed in disguised and briefly came across Chloe pretending to be friendly but upon spotting "Adrien" and Kagami she approached them, then admitted to him how proud she was  and that he didn't have to keep anything hidden from her as well as told "him" enjoy the party.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 5]]
After Marinette was shielded from the sentimonster Red Moon by being tossed in a trashcan by Argos, Tikki was shocked that Felix was Duusu's new owner and he disguised himself as Adrien again. Refusing to let Felix get away, she and Tikki transformed into Ladybug, and as the heroine fought Argos, they heard the reason for his actions, saying that he traded her siblings to get Duusu's power so he then could get their and Cat Noir's Miraculouses to create a world free from oppressors. Aware of Felix's caring heart, but aggressive methods, his powers, the situation, and needing him to see the true outcome of the world he created, the heroine received no Lucky Charm. But knowing what was needed to be done, Ladybug calmly admitted defeat and accepted her fate as the enraged Argos used Red Moon on them and they both disappeared, putting their faith and trust in others. After Argos was set straight by Kagami and Adrien, Tikki and Marinette were restored along with everyone else, and once de-transformed, reunited with their friends.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Pretension", she finally stood up to Adrien's father, Gabriel Agreste, and had a heart-to-heart with him. Instead, Gabriel, at first, tried to bribe her with his connection and clout into becoming the next big fashion designer in exchange of Marinette breaking up with Adrien before threatening her to do so or she'll have nothing. Marinette starts to leave, only to defy Gabriel, went up to Adrien's room, hugged him and telling him that she loves him and promises to never abandon him and will always be there for him. She and Cat Noir fight off Matagi Gozen while wanting the Peacock Miraculous back from Argos after he kidnaps Kagami. The two superheroes are confuse when Kagami urges them to let Félix go and protect him when Matagi Gozen, allowing him to escape with the Peacock Miraculous and defeat the akumatized villainess. Little did she know that at the end of the episode, Adrien doesn't have the heart to tell her that his father is sending him to London when the school year is over.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Revelation", Lila and Chloe requested another class representative election, much to the dislikes of Marinette and Adrien. Marinette and Lila debated about the role of class representative, the former trying to expose the latter's lies, and the latter manipulating Marinette's words, and guilt tripping the class. Lila ran out of the classroom in fake tears, in an attempt to frame Marinette as the villain. Knowingly, she was akumatized into Hoaxer, a supervillain that can hypnotize, travel, and communicate through Alliances.
She made a "revelation"; she said that Marinette is secretly Monarch, and ordered her newly earned disciples to get Marinette, who transformed into Ladybug. She realized that the Alliances are how Hoaxer hypnotized people, and took one from Roger, breaking his gaze. Hoaxer, realizing this, made another revelation: "Astrocat and Cosmobug are aliens from Saturn that fart bubbles which destroy the ozone layer". By the end of the episode, Hoaxer deakumatized herself after getting what she wanted and Marinette and Adrien have a heart-to-heart, still having hope that one day they'll expose Lila; Marinette even lets her and Chloé have the win to be class reps.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Confrontation", after finally having enough of Lila's lies, Marinette made a plan to finally expose Lila with the help of Sabrina.
After the class had filled out their career forms, she and Alya, the former reluctantly, gave the forms to Lila and Chloé, with them promising that they won't disappoint their classmates in their new position.
However, unknowingly to the rest of the class, they threw away and replaced the forms with fake ones, completely different from the careers that the class chose.
Their plan was to blame this on Marinette, using Sabrina's ability to imitate others' handwriting.
Unbeknownst to them, Sabrina had informed Marinette about what they were planning to do, so Marinette formed a plan to counter their plan, and she was successful in doing so, finally revealing to her classmates, Ms.
Bustier, and Principal Damocles of Lila's true personality and behavior and that she had been right about her all along.
Ms.
Bustier and the class apologize to Marinette for being duped by Lila for so long, while a very upset Damocles expels Lila and Chloé on the spot.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 5]]
However, Chloé whines to her father, Mayor Bourgeois, again, and he threatens to fire Damocles if the expulsion is not overruled and the forged career forms processed.
She also discovers that the Magical Charms have a special effect when reacted to positive emotions as the support of the class, minus Lila and Chloé, allow Damocles to use his Magical Charm to protect himself from a Megakuma send to akumatize him.
After which, Marinette sees Damocles off with her classmates as he quits as principal, refusing to bow to Chloé's demands or those of her father because he's Mayor any further, with his final act being to allow the kids to resubmit their career forms before resigning, freed of having to defy his morals any further.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Collusion", Marinette vows to take down Chloé as she did with Lila. When trying to calm down Ivan when Chloé insults Mylène, she is falsely accused of assaulting her, despite he and her classmates vouching her innocence. Acting principal Olga Medenleiev has no choice but to expel Marinette and fire Ms. Bustier to placate Chloe and Mayor Bourgeois. She and Cat Noir fight an akumatized Ms. Bustier. By the end of the episode, while Mayor Bourgeois resigns from his position, with his final act being overturning Ms. Bustier's termination of employment and Marinette's expulsion, Ladybug, Cat Noir, and Monarch are declared outlaws by Chloé after she becomes the new Mayoress of Paris by force with the help of Gabriel, Tomoe's police robots, and Lila, now going by the name Cerise.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Revolution", Ladybug and Cat Noir try to take down Chloé, now secretly akumatized as Queen Mayor, but are captured by the police robots and start to transform back to their civilian identities, threatening to expose themselves to all of Paris, especially Chloé. Inspired by all the work the two heroes have done, everyone rebels against Chloé and her tyranny. Inspired by this as well, Ladybug and Cat Noir get their adult powers and will never have to de-transform again unless they use their power down command to revert back. Although Ladybug attempts to give Chloé another Magical Charm, ex-Mayor Bourgeois intervenes, accepting it was time for him to atone for his own mistakes, and drags Chloé off to be punished, exiling her and Audrey from Paris, rendering them persona non grata and barred from ever returning to the city again. Unfortunately, the celebration is bittersweet as Adrien tearfully announces that he's been forced to leave Paris for London.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 5]]
Heartbroken over this, but refusing to give up on her promise to never abandon Adrien and to always be there for him, Marinette races to the airport to say her final goodbye to Adrien, sharing their first kiss before being forcibly separated on Gabriel's orders.
Arriving at the school year dance, she gets a call from Chloé and warns her that she's not in the mood, but Chloé starts gloating about her "secret": Adrien's departure.
Marinette refuses to put up with Chloé anymore and turns the tables on her.
Marinette first tells Chloé to shut up as she knows her "little secret" because Adrien told her and he will also always love her, no matter what.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 5]]
Marinette also slaps the hard truth about how far Chloé has fallen, telling her she no longer has any power over anything or anyone anymore, especially Marinette, as she's done being bullied by Chloé, and tells Chloé that she is now the "utterly ridiculous" one and to enjoy her trip before hanging up, leaving Chloé to stare in shock for a few seconds before the truth finally sinks in and she breaks into tears, finally realizing she's lost everything that mattered to her and hit rock-bottom as, if Marinette was able to stand up to her and tell her off, refusing to be bullied by her anymore, she has nothing left to allow her to still be the brat that she's been all year.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Representation", Marinette tried to enjoy the end-of-the-school year dance, but was distracted by Félix, who has disguised himself as Adrien, and she followed him. Ending up at the school's art room, after seeing a picture of her and Adrien, she broke down crying again and ends up falling asleep. She wakes up and was told the story of the Graham de Vanily, Agreste, and Fathom family histories by Kagami and Félix. She learned of Monarch's identity and why Félix betrayed her. They told her she is the only one who could face Monarch and defeat him, so everyone can have a happy ending since he's at his endgame. Later, she finds a message from Cat Noir, who defeated his father as the self-akumatized Nightormentor with the help of the Resistance and did a fist bump in his absence.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Conformation", Marinette was still reeling from the previous night while suffering from the nightmare dust inflicted by Nightormentor as part of Gabriel's last plan with Tomoe in Operation: Perfect Alliance to receive the two coveted Miraculous he sought in the Ladybug and Black Cat. She decided to talk to Gabriel as Ladybug to negotiate for Adrien, but ends up in Nathalie's room and found proof of her involvement. She witnessed Gabriel de-transform as Monarch and tried to send Cat Noir a text about it, but for one reason or another, she couldn't.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 5]]
Finding Nathalie, before she succumbed to her illness of using the broken Peacock Miraculous, she was told by her to save Adrien and do whatever it took to stop Monarch; she even gave her Emilie's cell with all her videos and warned her of Monarch's plans. Soon, she was surrounded by some of the Miraculized army, but managed to get away from them and de-transforms in the kitchen, forcing them to leave after they lost her scent since they could only track her if she was Ladybug, not Marinette. She hid there until Plagg found her and Tikki, telling them about Cat Noir's situation and asked why she's here. Marinette says it's Monarch's house, leaving Plagg shocked and frightened. Quickly picking up and slipping on the Black Cat ring, she was found by Monarch, discovering her identity, but she unified the Ladybug and Cat Miraculous to become Bug Noire, ready to have her final showdown with him.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Re-creation", Bug Noire and Monarch fight their final battle; starting from the kitchen to the foyer and ending up in The Crypt. There, Bug Noire is shocked to find Mrs. Agreste's comatose body and is also disgusted by just how far Monarch is causally willing to cause this level of violence and havoc to have his crazy dreams come true; all to have his wife back, heal the Cataclysm wound he forced Cat Noir to inflict on him, and for Adrien and Kagami to be the new world order's eternal icons.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 5]]
Bug Noire condemned him for using his family as excuses to justify his madness and how he doesn't care about Adrien as a person anymore; not as long they give him excuses to continue to do what he's doing. Monarch argues that he's thrown away and sacrificed too much to give up now and turn back, and he's crossed the point of no return. Bug Noire finally defeats Gabriel, and drops the hard truth about being able to repair the damage he's done to the world, turning everything back to normal, but him only having a few hours left to live, which she is unable to fix. To prove her point, she shows him Emilie's last video about moving on after her passing, moving him to tears, and apparently finally realize how badly he's ruined Adrien's life, and that of the world, in his mad obsession to have his wife back so he can have back the life taken from him when she fell into her coma from using the damaged Peacock Miraculous.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 5]]
She's willing to work with him to come up with a solution, but was paralyzed via Venom by him after she de-transforms and he took the two Miraculous from her, forcing Tikki and Plagg to reveal their true selves and become Gimmi, the Kwami of Reality. The Venom's effects wear off, and  Marinette witnessed this, pleading with him not to do it and make a wish with Gimmi and the Ultimate Miraculous Absolute Power. Surrendering the rest of the Miraculouses and double wedding rings, unknown to her, Gabriel acknowledged her as the victor and as the wish commenced, as a last request, she was promised by Gabriel not to let Adrien know about any of this, or his evil acts as his alter egos. The world was soon recreated and Marinette continued her relationship with Adrien, even giving him the double wedding rings containing his amok and kiss.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 5]]
Marinette recovered the stolen Miraculous and the Miraculous Grimoire, and used the book to restore the Miraculous to their original forms, but was saddened that there's still no trace of the Butterfly Miraculous. Despite this, she gave the Miraculouses full time to their owners and will remain the Guardian rejoining with the whole team heading off into their next adventure.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - "[[Miraculous London]]"
Taking place shortly after "The Final Day", after Gabriel made his wish to Gimmi and the Ultimate Miraculous Absolute Power was invoked, Marinette found herself alone with Adrien's parents gone, and the Miraculous and Graham de Vanily Twin Rings lying in front of Emilie's now-empty cryo-pod.
Finally retrieving them at long last, Marinette was reunited with Plagg and Tikki, but sadly she asked them what Gabriel wished for, with the kwamis answering that he gave up his life to heal Nathalie.
Then they were interrupted when a fully-healthy Nathalie descends into the Crypt with her crossbow, presumably to try and confront Gabriel again, causing the trio to transform into Bug Noire for another fight, only for Nathalie, who overheard everything, to surrender, explaining that she should've stopped him years ago before his mad obsession led to now, and admits she knows Marinette's secret identity, having just watched her transform moments ago.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - "[[Miraculous London]]"
At that point, she broke down crying, blaming herself for leaving Adrien an orphan now, before telling Nathalie that she should've used the Ultimate Miraculous Absolute Power and Gimmi and sacrificed herself to ensure Adrien still had a parent in his life.
She was assured by Nathalie that she made the right choice by rekindling the goodness that was still in Gabriel's heart, and she saved everyone, and Adrien was not alone as he still had them.
Despite Nathalie's words, Marinette still collapsed into her embrace as she cried her heart out in guilt and grief.
Afterwards, Marinette recovered the Miraculous Alliance Rings, then asked about the kwamis to which she followed Nathalie to their location.
In Gabriel's lair, she saw what he said was true, horrified to see the kwamis in cages, but upon seeing them voice concern about Nathalie, Bug Noire assured them that Nathalie was on their side, and proved it by freeing the kwamis once and for all, happy to be reunited with their Guardian.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - "[[Miraculous London]]"
Afterwards, Bug Noire used her restoration power to undo the effects of Operation: Perfect Alliance, freeing everyone of Nightormentor's nightmares, ending the threat of the Miraculized, and saving all her allies, as well as learned of Tomoe's willing cooperation with Gabriel's endgame.
But when Nathalie and Marinette asked each other if Adrien knew either of their identities, both said no, with Marinette wanting to tell him only after the Butterfly Miraculous was safely back in her possession, but with it still out there, and possibly end up with someone else as evil as Gabriel, or worse, Marinette couldn't tell Adrien the truth.
Then, hearing Nathalie's intention to turn herself in for her own crimes as Mayura, Marinette advised against it, knowing Adrien will have no one left to look after him.
But when Nathalie retorted that he'll still have her, Marinette explained that is not the same.
Knowing Adrien needed a mother figure in his life, and knowing of Nathalie's relationship with Adrien, she opted her to look after him, which Nathalie accepted.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - "[[Miraculous London]]"
When asked what to do next, despite the huge burden, Marinette will tell Adrien and the world that Gabriel died a hero stopping Monarch, while only a select few will know the actual truth, and keep it buried.
So she flew to London to free Kagami and Adrien from their imprisonment there, but the events of the final battle with Monarch still weighed heavily on her heart and mind feeling great guilt and remorse for not doing more in saving Gabriel. As she arrived and entered Kagami's room, the news reported the aftermath of Operation: Perfect Alliance, where the world thanks Ladybug for saving all of them from Monarch's endgame. Still feeling regret, Bug Noire recalled her final conversation with Gabriel and his last request before he made his wish to Gimmi and invoked the Ultimate Miraculous Absolute Power. Sadly telling Kagami that it was really "over over", as well as being aware that Kagami's mother was a willing accomplice to Monarch's mad schemes, Marinette admits afterwards she has no intention of turning her over to the authorities, not wanting Kagami to lose her only parent. However, realizing Tomoe's situation, Kagami offered to handle it.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - "[[Miraculous London]]"
Together, they went to Adrien's cell, and when inside, Bug Noire revealed with deep regret and hesitation, the grim truth to Adrien, and Placide, that Gabriel was dead, having sacrificed himself to use the Ultimate Miraculous Absolute Power to save her and Nathalie from Monarch by using the wish to give up his life, and Monarch's. Equally devastated, she tried to comfort him, informing that she tried everything to save Gabriel, but upon hearing Adrien wished he could've been there, Bug Noire assured him there's nothing he could've done to prevent his father's sacrifice, and as Adrien collapsed and sobbed in grief, comforted by Kagami, Bug Noire made it clear she wanted to tell him first before he found out some other way, and nearly broke down crying herself as she apologized. Then, Bug Noire returned home to Paris, where upon returning to the Agreste Mansion to regroup with a healed Nathalie, Marinette reverted back to normal and ran into Nathalie's embrace as she cried over lying to Adrien to protect the truth, per Gabriel's last request.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - "[[Miraculous London]]"
Later, Bug Noire saw to the The Crypt's destruction, using her Cataclysm to destroy everything, thus sealing it so it will never be found. Then, as Aquabug, she dove into the crypt's water to find the Butterfly Miraculous missing. Later, as just Ladybug, she then called a press conference to announce that Gabriel sacrificed himself to end Monarch's threat for good, but she was unable to recover the Butterfly Miraculous, nor unmask Monarch, so his true identity remains anonymous, and she doesn't know what has become of the Butterfly Miraculous either. She left when the interviewers attempt to press further for answers. Back home, she lets the Kwamis out, then called Alya, to inform her of the situation, wrote in her diary, then went to sleep. However, with the day she's had, Marinette was extremely worn out, and asked Tikki and Plagg if she made the right choice lying to Adrien. The Kwamis were skeptical to answer, but was told by Tikki to get some sleep, hinting that she's going to need it soon.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - "[[Miraculous London]]"
Marinette woke up later to find, to her horror, that someone had invoked Gimmi and the Ultimate Miraculous Absolute Power again and made a wish, finding she's not wearing the Miraculous, meaning someone stole them again. But before the wish could affect her, she was rescued by Bunnyx and pulled into the Burrow. As Marinette asked Alix what was happening, she explained that, whoever made the wish, it affected the universe so badly that all the time windows in the Burrow were disappearing, changing the future, causing her to panic, but was assured by Bunnyx they can fix it. Upon being given a yellow safety vest to wear, Bunnyx replied it was so that she could track and not confuse her for another Marinette. But with the earrings stolen in the present, Marinette decided to use the earrings from the past, retrieving them from "Origins". Doing so, she was reunited with Past Tikki, and after explaining the situation to her, they transformed into Chronobug.
Starting with when she was asleep with the Kwamis, Chronobug and Bunnyx discovered that an akumatized supervillain, Spectral Looter, slipped into Marinette's room and stole all the jewels.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - "[[Miraculous London]]"
So Chronobug tried to stop them, but couldn't land a blow thanks to villain's intangibility and even her Lucky Charm object, a calendar, was no use.
Moving to the Parisian rooftops, she lost sight of them, spots a purified akuma butterfly flittering away, and then saw the Ultimate Miraculous Absolute Power being triggered again, forcing her to return to the Burrow.
Realizing that whoever Spectral Looter was, they found out about Marinette being Ladybug, making the pair realized the problem needed to be fixed in the past.
So they rewind to the final battle with Monarch to figure out how they did it.
To their despair, not long after Nooroo was freed, he was found by another new evil owner that snuck into the mansion, and this person akumatized themselves into Timestalker, eavesdropped on Bug Noire, and wrote everything down in a journal to remember later.
Chronobug attempted to fight Timestalker, but they escaped, forcing Chronobug to regroup with Bunnyx and see that the Burrow was still disappearing, knowing the villain still got the knowledge.
Next was when Past Bug Noire was taken to the chamber where the Kwami cages were held.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - "[[Miraculous London]]"
At this point, she and Bunnyx attempted to intervene and prevent Timestalker from learning Ladybug's identity, but although they caught them, and destroyed what they thought was the akumatized object, Timestalker was still here, making the pair aware the object was far away, meaning the chase was still on for them.
After watching that scene play out, Chronobug was reminded by Bunnyx that they still need to stop Timestalker.
Thus, their next destination was London when Bug Noire freed Kagami and Adrien from their solitary confinement.
As they watched past Bug Noire descend into the facility, Chronobug realized in horror when noticing the condition of the lights: That Timestalker beat her there and was lying in wait the whole time.
She quickly intercepted them in another room while Past Bug Noire and Kagami had their conversation, but despite her best efforts and receiving a Lucky Charm object of hand sanitizer, she was kicked back into the Burrow.
Frustrated that Timestalker kept getting away, Chronobug looked at her Lucky Charm object and realized it's purpose.
She returned to her room in the present, and after grabbing the necessary supplies, then returned to London.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - "[[Miraculous London]]"
She managed to steal Timestalker's journal before retreating to the Burrow.
Using the cotton swab and the hand sanitizer, Chronobug altered Timestalker's last entry to fool them.
With her sabotage complete, she returned moments after she escaped with the journal, and toyed with Timestalker, taunting them that she'll get the Butterfly Miraculous back, before she was sent back into the Burrow before the last time window closed, trapping her and Bunnyx inside with nothing to do but wait.
After some time, as Bunnyx and Chronobug continued to wait and see if her plan worked, they soon get their answer when the time windows reappeared as the Burrow was restored, indicating Timestalker gave up, and the timeline was saved.
As they celebrated, Bunnyx's older selves reappeared, now with their future existence secured, and congratulated the younger holders on their success.
However, Chronobug asked Bunnyx to stay in the Burrow since this new Hawk Moth was much more dangerous than Monarch, but before restoring everything, she asked for the Bunnyxs' advice as to if she made the right choice of lying to Adrien.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - "[[Miraculous London]]"
They assured her that any choice she made will always have good and bad outcomes, but it was up to her how to handle the burdens that come with them.
They also assured her that it wasn't her Lucky Charm that saved the universe, but her mind, that ensured the universe's survival.
Grateful to Alix's advice, Marinette shared a goodbye hug with her before using her Miraculous Chronobug to return the Ladybug Miraculous to its place in time in "Origins" without her past self realizing it was gone, while she returned to her bedroom in the present with the knowledge of her adventure intact.
Once there, Marinette was happy to see that the Miraculous and all the kwamis were safe again, hugging Tikki and Plagg happily.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - "[[Miraculous London]]"
Later, Marinette was working hard at re-forging the Miraculous back to their original forms, as well improving them. She also explained to the kwamis that, because of the incidents with the new Butterfly Miraculous holder, and what happened with Felix back in "Strikeback", she had entrusted them permanently to their holders. The kwamis are overjoyed, but will miss being with their Guardian. Marinette shared the sentiment, and as they hugged, she then gave the Black Cat Miraculous to Plagg to take back to Cat Noir, but not before the kwami shared a quick hug with her himself before returning to Adrien.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - "[[Miraculous London]]"
Afterwards, Ladybug sat alone overlooking the Eiffel Tower in a glum mood until Cat Noir joined her and congratulated her for beating Monarch. Then, she asked him for advice about if he's ever felt like keeping a secret, but the burden was so bad you just want to cry and tell someone about it. He understood where she was coming from, and they embraced in a hug as Cat Noir apologized for not being there to help beat Monarch with her while she apologized for not being able to explain why. But she was assured by Cat Noir that, no matter what, at least the world, and Paris, was safe from Monarch now that he was finally defeated. But when Ladybug mentioned losing the Butterfly Miraculous, Cat Noir assured her they'll get it back, just like old times, offering a fist bump to prove it. Wiping her eyes, she agreed, returning the gesture, and rests on his shoulder as they look out at the Eiffel Tower, knowing they will soon have the whole team helping them again, this time, for good.
Then, Marinette was seen on her balcony with a new outfit sleeping with a book on her face.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Miraculous Tokyo]]
Marinette was in her room talking to Adrien on her phone, while the latter was currently visiting New York City again, and hearing Adrien play the tune that was performed during their class trip back in Miraculous New York, asked her if she cared to dance. Just as she was about to, she was startled by Ryuko's arrival. Quickly giving him an excuse to hang up, Marinette was then told by Kagami that Ladybug was needed in Tokyo, being shown a video feed of an attack in the city that was stopped by Tokyo's own new superhero team, the Stellar Force. Before Marinette could explain things to her parents, she and Kagami were already on their way there through Tsurugi's private jet. After Kagami assured them that Marinette would be safe with her and they would be staying at her grandmother Nozomi's home, Marinette fixed up a new blazer for her to wear over her pajamas as she didn't bring anything with her. Then, she was shocked to hear that Kagami was former friends with several members of the Stellar Force, because Kagami never mentioned anything about her past. Out of earshot of her, Marinette whispered to Tikki that Kagami must have an ulterior motive for their trip.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Miraculous Tokyo]]
Once they arrived, Marinette and Kagami went to Nozomi's house.
After introductions and dinner, they relaxed in a bath, while doing so, she learned more of Kagami's backstory.
At first, Marinette believed there was a romantic relationship between Kagami and Kazuno, but the former denied it.
Then, were alerted of Tokyo being under siege by a Kaiju, so they transformed into Ladybug and Ryuko, and watched the Stellar Force's attempt to fight the monstrosity.
However, noticing the team's lack of teamwork as well as recklessness, at first, the heroine understood it because the Stellar Force were new, but hearing Ryuko's suggestion to lead them, Ladybug was outright hesitant and refused because it wasn't their place.
Regardless, she summoned a Lucky Charm and received an Effiel Tower keychain believing it was telling them to go home.
Until, Ladybug then realized that the Kaiju was the taxi from earlier, knowing what the Stellar Force was about to do, the duo tried to stop them but it was too late finally interventing she chewed them out for their actions and used her Miraculous Ladybug to restore it.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Miraculous Tokyo]]
Following Capricorn's mentioning of several symbols on the Kaiju's body from before, she had him mark the locations for the Stellar Force to strike and destroy at once, causing the Kaiju to revert back to the taxi it was created from.
Ladybug was thanked by the driver for saving his life, and left the Stellar Force needing to rethink about their future actions.
Back at Nozomi's, seeing a disheartened Kagami, Marinette deduced from her earlier suspicions that she was also here to help Kagami as moral support in fixing things with Kazuno which the latter confirmed but didn't know how, yet Marinette comforted her believing they'll find a way before sleeping.
Getting an idea, Marinette borrowed her cellphone to invite the Stellar Force to the upcoming festival that Nozomi would be attending.
Arriving the next day, Marinette officially met them, but noticed Kazuno wasn't here so she left with Miki to pick him up.
During the trip, she learned a bit more about Miki especially her crush on him, but made it clear he had to earn hers the hard way.
At Kazuno's, they were soon shocked to see Tokyo under siege again by five giant Kaiju.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Miraculous Tokyo]]
Inside Marinette was sworn to secrecy, surprised in watching Miki and Kazuno transform into their Stellar Force identities of Leo and Capricorn in front of her before heading off to help the rest of the team.
Right behind them, Marinette became Ladybug again, summoned a Lucky Charm of a motorcycle and helmet, and drove off to help as well, catching up but found Capricorn and Ryuko in an awkward moment.
Yet, was interupted by a Kaiju attack sending her, Ryuko, and Capricorn flying, with Ladybug crashing onto a rooftop.
Recovering, she contacted Ryuko giving her the time to patch things up with Capricorn while she helped the Stellar Force with crowd control.
By using her Miraculous Ladybug to restore many of the smaller Kaiju back to their original selves, but the constant use left her exhausted.
Until Capricorn and Ryuko returned, with the hero's self-confidence restored, the Stellar Force summoned a giant mech to face the giant Kaiju being joined by Ladybug summoning a Lucky Charm mech of her own and with Ryuko's Lightning Dragon to power it.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Miraculous Tokyo]]
Together, they defeated and restored the giant Kaiju back to normal, and afterwards, the Stellar Force use their own Miraculous Stellar Force to repair all the damage to the city.
Together, the Stellar Force, Kagami, and Marinette, enjoyed the festival, before the pair returned to Paris. On the flight home, she was inspired by the trip to design her new everyday outfit and her bodysuit as Ladybug. As well as she remembered to send a voicemail to Adrien, having forgotten to do so after she spoke to him before leaving for Tokyo with Kagami.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 6]]
In "Revelator", Ladybug and Cat Noir were overseeing the efforts of their teammates in unlocking their own adult powers with their respective Miraculous and bypass the five-minute failsafe that triggers when using their special power the first time after transforming. After some effort, every member succeeded in doing so. Then they try to decide on a group name for their team, Ladybug settled on "The Miraculers" after some thought, and everyone agrees.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 6]]
Later at the beach, Marinette was showed Alya's photos on the Ladyblog of the Miraculers doing heroic deeds around Paris as a secondary job to their duty fighting the victims of the new Butterfly Miraculous holder, and being joined by Adrien and Nino, even as Adrien was being consoled by other beachgoers over Gabriel's sacrifice. However, later, when Marinette returns to her home, and discovers the outside walls of the bakery covered in graffiti depicting her in a negative light, Tom and Sabine close the store before showing Marinette the videos from Vincent Aza putting her down and blaming her for Adrien's fall from grace with being replaced in the fashion media by other hopefuls, especially Chloe. After looking over the videos, and speaking with Adrien and Alya in a video phone conference, Marinette decides to speak to Vincent personally. Tom goes with her in case of trouble, and during the meeting, they are joined by Adrien with Placide, having had the same idea.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 6]]
Vincent offers to podcast interview Marinette and Adrien to get the facts straight, and it seems everything goes well. However, the next day, when Marinette and Adrien go to the movies, other guests begin to put Marinette down and show more of Vincent's videos that influenced their behavior and opinion towards her, forcing her and Adrien to leave. When Marinette shows the doctored and edited footage to Alya, fed up with Vincent's slander of Marinette, Alya decides to become Rena Rouge and use her Mirage to disguise herself to get close to Vincent and collect the evidence needed to expose his lies. Despite her hesitation regarding what she told the Miraculers about their powers, Marinette agrees to go along with the plan, and becomes Ladybug to use a hidden Lucky Charm camera to record the interview between Alya/Rena and Vincent as she watches on her yo-yo. Once they have enough footage and edited it, Alya uploads it to the Ladyblog before the footage is later aired on the TVi News by Nadja, exposing Vincent, turning him into a social pariah for his slander of Marinette.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 6]]
Unfortunately, this gave Chrysalis incentive to akumatize him into Revelator. When Marinette and Alya saw the footage Revelator posted to everyone in Paris, including their cellphones, they transformed into Ladybug and Rena Rouge to confront him. During the fight, however, she was struck by Revelator's laser, coughing up a crystal containing her deepest secret. She did everything she could to keep Revelator from capturing it, and as well as stop Cat Noir from using his powers on it, quickly learning from him it will be revealed regardless. Despite her best, Ladybug was devastated to see an angry Rena that learned she had lied to Adrien and the world about Gabriel and about him being their original arch-enemy in Monarch. Thanks to Cat Noir's intervention and Rena's Mirages, the friends talked privately, arguing about the knowledge, putting them odds with each other despite each side having valid points, and Ladybug still felt even more guilty and ashamed, as this was why she did not want to tell Rena, knowing she would be very upset with her.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 6]]
They then returned to the fight and caught Revelator by surprise, so Ladybug restrained him while Rena subdued him, allowing Ladybug to de-akumatize Vincent. Afterwards, eyeing her Lucky Charm eraser, after a suggestion from Cat Noir, but scorning from Rena, she tried using her Miraculous Ladybug to fix everything, but as like in "Cat Blanc", everything was fixed physically, not mentally, as Rena still knew her secret. With that, Ladybug realized that, to fix things, sometimes things have to be destroyed. Despite Cat Noir's hesitation, Rena's assurance made it clear that it was best for everyone to forget. Thus, through her encouragement Ladybug saw Cat Noir unlock a new power, his Miraculous Cat Noir, for the first time, using its destructive energy to erase Rena's memories. Afterwards, she gave Vincent a Magical Charm, along with some advice from the three Miraculers about his video blog that he should consider in the future.
Back at the beach, Marinette was assured by Alya that she would never be upset with her and can trust her, before they joined their boyfriends in the water.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 6]]
In "Riginarazione", Marinette was cooking with her grandmother Gina until the latter excused herself after being alerted to a possible medical emergency with Roland. Later, she finished soccer jerseys for herself, Adrien, and her grandparents, but as she went out to join Adrien for a date, she received a call from Roland, and was encouraged by her family  to see him. Once at Roland's house, she was told they were making a new recipe from scratch, while doing so she didn't get what her grandfather was trying to tell her upon being finished she left, to meet up with Adrien, until Roland stopped her and where Marinette learned the shocking truth: due to Roland's failing heart was dying. So she was given his yeast container to continue his family's legacy, but distraught and devastated Marinette fled the house, transformed into Ladybug in an alley, and swung through Paris with tears before touching down on a rooftop and reverting back. Despite Tikki's consoling efforts, Marinette knew no magical power, not even Gimmi and the Ultimate Miraculous Absolute Power, could save her grandfather from his inevitable fate and calls it unfair.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 6]]
Then, her heartbreak manifests during a foosball match with Adrien, where she aggressively dominates him until she finally confessed what's wrong. After consoling her, they go to Roland and Gina's 75th birthday party and the event was pretty happy and enjoyable, but when her grandparents attempted to blow out the candles on their birthday cake, Roland overexerted himself and nearly blacked out from the strain. Marinette, her parents, and Adrien took him back upstairs, but when they all returned, they were shocked to find Gina akumatized as Riginarazione, who de-aged Roland and Tom before kidnapping her husband for a night on the town. Meanwhile, Marinette had Adrien stay with her  while she heads out, transforms into Ladybug, and went after her grandparents. However, while confronting Riginarazione at a DJ party hosted by XY, Ladybug was hit by Riginarazione's aging rounds and transformed into an adult with a pixie cut hairstyle but ends up buried under debris, while the villainess escaped with Roland again.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 6]]
When the adult Ladybug caught up to them again, she's joined by Cat Noir, who was impressed by her older appearance, but during their next clash, Cat Noir was de-aged to a baby, and Riginarazione escaped with Roland again while Ladybug protected her younger partner. Luckily, Roland left them a trail to follow, and after summoning a baby carrier as her Lucky Charm, Ladybug confronted Riginarazione again during a tug-of-war, she was struck by more shots that further aged her into an elderly woman, even with Riginarazione threatening to go as far as continuing to blast Ladybug until she's nothing. Thankfully, she got close enough for Cat Noir to Cataclysm the ammo jar on Riginarazione's gun, freeing the Ultrakuma for Ladybug to catch and purify, despite her feeble state. After entrusting Cat Noir to the restored Gina to hold, she feebly performs her Miraculous Ladybug to restore herself, everything and everyone to their proper ages. She then gave Gina a Magical Charm, shares her "Pound It!" fist-bump with Cat Noir, then hung back to watch Roland and Gina head home together, offering a final goodbye to her grandfather before leaving herself.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 6]]
Later, following Roland's departure to the afterlife, as everyone get back to their normal lives, Marinette accepted keeping her grandfather's yeast container, along with a photo of her, Roland, and Gina, as her computer's new desktop background, but still she missed her him very much.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 6]]
In "Heartfixer", Marinette continued to find herself a victim of having her relationship with Adrien put in jeopardy by Ray, Loic, and Nelson when they willingly had Chrysalis akumatize them into the Couplebreakers to break them up. By having the trio disguise themselves as her and everyone else, they made the school believe that Marinette and Nino were together, leaving Adrien distraught. Meanwhile, at the time, Marinette was also trying to find a way to present Gabriel's letter to Adrien, but couldn't find the right opportunity to do so. As a result, the letter, combined with the Couplebreakers' actions, caused not just Adrien to end their relationship with her and storm off in heartbreak, but heard that Alya also ended things with Nino as well, as both pair were being disloyal. Marinette tried to follow him to ask what is going on, but the Couplebreakers get there first and shatter her hopes of resolutions by making it look like Adrien wanted nothing to do with her anymore, and with Sublime consoling him, becoming his new girlfriend because of Marinette's betrayal, leaving her completely crushed and devastated.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 6]]
While devastated, Marinette was being consoled by Tikki, even being warned by an approaching Ultrakuma that was heading right for her.
Unknown to her, a remorseful Cat Noir burst into the scene attempting to destroy the butterfly with Cataclysm, but it infected her purse.
Within her mindscape, she was contacted by Chrysalis, to whom offered Marinette the power to repair Adrien's broken heart, and distraught and in a moment of weakness, she accepted the offer, being renamed "Heartfixer".
Now as Chrysalis' champion, Heartfixer, like all the other akumatized supervillains, was asked to retrieve Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous, but also if she actually was Ladybug.
However, instead of answering Chrysalis, she focused her attention on Adrien, who had returned and continued to plead with her as she attacked him in an attempt to "fix" his broken heart.
During the struggle, she was pulled into Adrien's embrace, telling her they were deceived by Ray, Loic, and Nelson, apologizing, begging for Marinette's forgiveness, and admitting he still loved her.
After hearing all that, Heartfixer dropped her purse.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 6]]
With achieving his love again, they shared a kiss which caused Marinette to break her akumatization and link with Chrysalis, reverting to normal as the Ultrakuma emerged from her restored purse and flew away purified, with Marinette happy to know she and Adrien are back together again and the bullies' attempt to break them up failed.
They later explained everything to Alya and Nino, and recieved a hug from an apologetic Alya for her earlier misjudgment and anger over thinking Marinette and Nino had betrayed her.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 6]]
Later, Marinette explained everything to Alya and about how she was akumatized. Feeling disappointed with herself for showing weakness and being akumatized for the first time in her life, she decided to step down as Ladybug and Guardian, passing her Miraculous to Alya and dubbing her Scarabella again. However, Marinette was encouraged by Alya and Tikki to remain Ladybug and Guardian, reminding her they all had moments of weakness and to just be kind to herself. After everything that happened, Marinette realized it wasn't only Adrien that needed to be ready, but her too, transforming into Ladybug and placing the letter in her yo-yo until she has the courage to present it to Adrien.
In "Lady Chaos", when Adrien wants to learn more about his father, and decides to interview Nathalie, Tomoe, and even his aunt, Lady Amelie, Marinette panics and has to coax Tomoe and Amelie into speaking only positively of him and not give away the truth of Gabriel's evil actions.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 6]]
When Adrien then wants to talk to Ladybug about his father's last moments alive, Marinette has to beg Alya to, as Rena Rouge, create a Mirage illusion of Ladybug to speak to Adrien with, despite Alya's hesitance to fudge the truth.
Nevertheless, she goes through with it, and the Ladybug illusion tells Adrien that his father wanted to apologize for his treatment of him and still loved him very much, putting Adrien at ease and giving him closure.
In the meantime, Lady Amelie, because she had to speak half-truths about Gabriel to Adrien, thus defying of her morals, along with being swindled out of an apartment, causes her to be akumatized into Lady Chaos.
When Rena sees this, she has her Ladybug illusion hint to Marinette that it is time to go transform to stop the supervillain, and they'll need Carapace's help, so Nino transforms to go assist as well.
After Marinette transforms into Ladybug and meets up with Rena, Rena scolds her for what she had to do and requests that Ladybug never has her do it again, before forgiving her.
Ladybug works with Cat Noir, Carapace, and Rena Rouge, to deakumatize Lady Amelie.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 6]]
Afterwards, Adrien asks Marinette to draw a portrait of Gabriel smiling, since all of Adrien's photos he has of Gabriel are of him frowning or looking stern all the time.
Although she agrees, Marinette finds herself hesitant to carry it out later in her bedroom.
This carries over into "Sadnansi" as, with the weight of her guilt growing more and more, as Marinette works on her sketch of Gabriel, she always seems to draw him as she remembers him with being cold, ruthless, and evil, all the while talking to herself about what Gabriel has forced on her with keeping his evil actions a secret from Adrien.
When she finally appears to get it right with him smiling, she suffers a hallucination as he begs her to uphold the lie she told Adrien and the public about him as they both want what's best for Adrien.
Marinette tries to refuse, wanting to tell Adrien the truth and have an honest relationship, and it culminates in when, once Tikki snaps her out of her hallucination, after seeing her tears fall on her sketch, which now shows Gabriel looking sad, Marinette snaps and rips it to pieces in a fit of anger.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 6]]
Before she can process dealing with her guilt any further, she's called into action when Alya's half-sister Nora is attacking Paris after being akumatized again into the titular supervillain, Sadnansi.
Having Tikki transform her into Ladybug, Marinette is soon joined in battle by Cat Noir, Rena Rouge, and Carapace.
Together, when they spot Twig among Sadnansi's forces, Ladybug and Rena capture him and take him to the top of the Eiffel Tower, where Rena uses her Mirage to force Sadnansi into dropping her akumatized object by threatening to drop Twig off the tower, and conjure several copies that force Sadnansi to use all six of her arms to try and catch them.
The ruse works, and Cat Noir destroys the object, allowing Ladybug to catch and purify the Ultrakuma and repair everything, freeing everyone from being under Sadnansi's control.
After Twig apologizes for being responsible for Nora being akumatized, and Ladybug gives Nora a Magical Charm, when Ladybug turns to look back at her fellow Miraculers, they notice her crying.
Ladybug assures them she's fine, and after sharing their "Pound It!" fist-bump, she returns home.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 6]]
There, Ladybug retrieves Gabriel's letter to Adrien from her yo-yo before powering back down into Marinette and Tikki.
When Tikki asks Marinette what she's going to do now, Marinette decides to tell Adrien the truth, and heads to the Agreste Mansion to do so.
Let in by Nathalie and Placide, when she enters Adrien's room, spotting Froggy on his bed, she once again can't bring herself to tell him the truth or show him the letter, and breaks down crying in his embrace as she tells him how much she loves him and he reassures her.
In the meantime, Alya, as Rena Rouge, uses her Mirage to review Bug Noire's final clash with Monarch, trying to figure out how Gabriel could have pulled off his heroic sacrifice if Monarch had managed to overpower and severely injure Marinette beforehand to get the Ladybug and Black Cat Miraculous, vowing to find the truth so she can take some of that burden off Marinette's shoulders.
In "Queen of the Dreadzone", Marinette was shocked and horrified when she discovered that her former bully, Chloe Bourgeois, was back in Paris.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 6]]
Chloe was trying to film a movie, and had commandeered the school, barring any of her former classmates or the other students from entering.
Although Marinette was terrified of Chloe being back, when Sabrina believed that Chloe had changed after getting a letter addressed to her that appeared to be from Chloe, Marinette joined her and Zoe with getting inside to confront Chloe.
However, once Chloe revealed she was still the same as she always had been, after she goes into a tirade about what she planned to do regarding the girls' roles in her film, Marinette laughed in amusement.
When Chloe demanded an explanation from "Baker Girl", Marinette revealed that she was no longer scared of Chloe, now that she no longer had her father Andre's authority as Mayor to get what she wanted anymore, and once again turned Chloe's catchphrase back on her, calling her the "ridiculous, utterly ridiculous" one.
Unfortunately, this enraged Chloe enough to be self-akumatized into Dread Queen, trapping Marinette, Zoe, Sabrina, and many others in her Dread Zone, where the closer Dread Queen got to them, the more terrified they became.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 6]]
Nevertheless, Marinette became Ladybug to fight her, but with her or Cat Noir unable to get close without being cowed into total fear of Dread Queen, they called on Vesperia and Miss Hound to help defeat and de-akumatize Chloe.
Afterwards, when Ladybug tried to give Chloe another Magical Charm, Chloe smacked it away, still upset and resentful of Ladybug kicking her of the team for her past betrayal.
However, as Chloe stormed away after Mayoress Bustier and Lieutenant Raincomprix told her that Noe's paperwork was revoked and further resistance would be met with fines, Ladybug slipped the Magical Charm into Chloe's purse without her knowing it.
When Chloe found it later, it ended up in Noe's hands, giving him a valuable tool to use in The Kingdom's plans.
In "Secret Protocol", with the threat that the new Butterfly Miraculous holder had with trying to find her secret identity, Ladybug gathered the Miraculers to let them know she had developed over 2,700 security precautions to protect their secret identities from being discovered. Marinette had also developed a security system to make certain no one could steal Tikki and the Ladybug Miraculous again.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 6]]
When it appeared that her great uncle, Wang Cheng, had traveled from Shanghai to Paris to join Marinette and Tom with celebrating Sabine's birthday, his behavior at several points began to raise Marinette's suspicion, including when she was alerted to someone being inside her bedroom. When Wang presented her with a pair of golden ladybug earrings that were said to be from Grandma Fen, Marinette took no chances, and covertly sent Tikki and the Ladybug Miraculous to Alya while she put on a decoy pair. This worked in her favor when Wang was akumatized into Kung Food again and took her hostage, confiscating the decoy earrings under the surmise they were the Ladybug Miraculous. When the decoy Ladybug summoned by Renabug appeared, Kung Food focused on her, but still kept Marinette as a hostage. Luckily, Cat Noir's intervention saved the ruse from being exposed, and once Polymouse arrived with the missing gift for Sabine that caused Wang to become Kung Food again, he willingly rejected his akumatization and reverted back, offering an apology for his actions. Rena Rouge later returned Tikki and the Ladybug Miraculous to Marinette now that the danger had passed.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 6]]
However, that night, as Marinette prepared to go out with her parents for dinner to continue Sabine's birthday festivities in a beautiful qipao dress, they get a phone call from Fei Wu and Wang from the Thousand Delights back in Shanghai. The call caused the Dupain-Chengs to realize something is horribly wrong, and Marinette quietly changed her earrings from Grandma Fen's back to the Ladybug Miraculous, before telling her parents to stay there while she checked the guest bedroom. After some hesitation, she opened the door, only to find the room empty, with no sign of Wang whatsoever, much to her horror. When Tom and Sabine arrived and discovered this as well, seeing the fear and terror on her parents' faces, Marinette made one of the most difficult and life-changing decisions of her life, and revealed to her parents that she was Ladybug, transforming with Tikki into her superheroine form right in front of their eyes.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 6]]
As a result, in the season finale of "Nemesis", it is seen that Tom and Sabine have taken learning that their daughter was Ladybug fairly well, and continued to support her, though still worried for her safety when she was out dealing with the akumatized victims, probably reminding them of when they fought her when they were akumatized as Weredad and Qilin respectively.
However, Marinette had not revealed to Adrien that she's Ladybug, and her parents don't try to press the issue.
Shortly after they've left her alone in private, Marinette ignored calls from Adrien and Alya, still guilty and remorseful of lying to them all this time.
When Adrien calls again, Marinette steeled herself to answer, and when Adrien revealed that he intended to convert part of his home into a museum to honor Gabriel, when he asked Marinette about the portrait of his father he asked her to draw, she went into a tirade about how Gabriel tried to keep them apart.
Realizing something was wrong, Adrien tried to ask Marinette about it, but then decided to give her some space for the time being and hung up.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 6]]
Alya then arrived, transformed into Rena Rouge, and using her Mirage, revealed to Marinette that she knows now that Gabriel couldn't have beaten Monarch as Ladybug told the world, but instead was Monarch the whole time.
After justifiably knowing that Marinette would do anything to protect Adrien, even at the cost of her own happiness and well-being, Rena watches as Marinette has an emotional breakdown, explaining that if she had just recovered the Butterfly Miraculous from Gabriel as the original Hawk Moth, they would not be dealing with a new Hawk Moth now that's more dangerous than Gabriel ever was, even endangering her and her own family as Marinette had never seen Tom and Sabine so terrified before in their lives.
Marinette knows they've got to stop the new Hawk Moth now before Marinette reached her breaking point and can't go any further, as herself or Ladybug, but they don't have a single shred of evidence as to who the new Hawk Moth is, or what they want.
As Rena offered her a reassuring hand on her shoulder, Marinette confessed that she had come up with a dangerous and highly risky plan, but wasn't sure Alya would agree to it.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 6]]
After Alya reassured her that, if the plan can save Paris, she would want to know what it is, Marinette explained that the first step was to create two Mirage illusions of her.
After becoming Ladybug, she and Rena then discussed the plan with the rest of the Miraculers.
One Marinette illusion, serving as the "authentic" Marinette, would stay at home, where she would be safe, while a second one would be used as bait to draw out the new Butterfly holder by acting so emotionally distressed that they would be akumatized.
To ensure the illusion would not disperse if touched, Ladybug had Rooster Bold use his Sublimation to give himself the power to create a shield of air around the illusion, that way, it could be touched without dispelling it.
Once the illusion was akumatized, Ladybug would "lose" to it in battle and have her Miraculous earrings taken.
However, she had Miss Hound touch them with her ball so that they can be recalled with Fetch later.
Once the earrings were taken, Ryuko and Polymouse would wait until the akumatized illusion delivered them to the new Butterfly holder, then tail them back to their lair.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 6]]
Once the lair was discovered, they would signal Rena, and the rest of the team would converge via Pegasus' Voyage to corner and capture the new Butterfly holder.
With everyone in agreement, and the trap ready, it was time to set the bait, but before doing so, Ladybug used her Lucky Charm ahead of time, and summoned a caterpillar keychain.
Unsure of what it meant at first, Ladybug entrusted it to Rena for the time being.
The plan began as Rena had the illusionary Marinette become so emotionally distraught over Alya having apparently "betrayed" their friendship, Chrysalis detected it with her Empathy, and took the bait, akumatizing the illusion into Nemesis.
During the fight that followed, Pigella and Caprikid were petrified by Nemesis, and recovered by Pegasus, Cat Noir was incapacitated by an Antikuma, and Ladybug soon after is knocked down and stunned, allowing Nemesis to petrify her as well.
Before Pegasus could recover her, Nemesis took the Ladybug Miraculous and delivered it to the Fontaine du Trocadéro, where she was directed to drop them off for Chrysalis to pick up later.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 6]]
Ladybug remained petrified, but was recovered by Pegasus and returned to Marinette's balcony, placed in one of the boxes the Miraculers used when unlocking their adult powers previously, so no one saw her de-transform when she was un-petrified.
When Chrysalis then ordered Nemesis to revert the petrification to confirm if the Ladybug earrings were the authentic ones, Ladybug was returned to normal, but then powered down back into Marinette due to having lost her Miraculous, but only for a short while.
As soon as Polymouse signaled her location, Miss Hound recovered the earrings with Fetch, and passed them to Rena to give back to Marinette, who then took them, put them back on, and transformed into Ladybug again.
Once transformed again, she wanted to discuss something with Rena, but Rena was in no mood to talk, before signaling Pegasus to open a Voyage portal for them to join the raid.
Once in the catacombs, Ladybug and Miss Hound split off from Rena, but then Ladybug split off on her own after spotting Chrysalis, only to bump into King Monkey, who told her where he last saw Chrysalis, before splitting off from him again.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 6]]
However, due to the maze that the catacombs were designed to be, Ladybug lost her way, but then heard a door slam, saw an orange glow and smoke slithering across the ceiling, and going to check, discovered that Chrysalis had sealed and set her lair ablaze to deny the Miraculers any valuable evidence they could use against her.
Trying to resume the pursuit, Ladybug soon reached a crossroads, but couldn't tell which way to go next.
Upon being joined by Purple Tigress, Carapace, King Monkey, and Miss Hound, they all realized that Chrysalis had slipped through their fingers and escaped.
With little else to go on, Ladybug decided to return to the fight with Nemesis and "convince" her to de-akumatize herself to avoid raising any suspicion.
Rena returned the Lucky Charm to Ladybug, who then used it to undo the petrification of Pigella and Caprikid with her Miraculous Ladybug.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 6]]
Returning to Marinette's room, after Rooster Bold and Rena dispel their powers now they they were no longer needed, Ladybug and Rena revert back to Marinette and Alya, and Alya confronted her BFF over lying to her about Gabriel being Monarch. Although Alya was very upset with Marinette over lying to Adrien about his father, and how she should not be the one making these decisions for Adrien, once Marinette confessed about how stuck she is now with the lies and deceit, and tried to apologize, Alya decided to leave Marinette with the final say on telling Adrien the truth. However, she made it clear to her BFF that she's done playing her lying game to Adrien. Alya departed Marinette's room with Trixx, reassuring Marinette that she'll remain Deputy Guardian, Rena Rouge, and Marinette's stand-in for Ladybug as Scarabella, but if Marinette wanted to remain BFFs with her from now on, don't ever lie to her again, leaving their friendship irreparably damaged.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 6]]
When the Miraculers met later, when Ladybug confronted King Monkey regarding the raid to capture Chrysalis, when he tells her he never bumped into her during the pursuit in the catacombs, nor spoke to her until now, Ladybug made a horrifying discovery as she recalled her Lucky Charm, that the other Miraculers soon realized as well: The new Butterfly holder can shapeshift, meaning they can take on the appearance of anyone, even one of the Miraculers in their civilian or superhero appearances. With this revelation, the Miraculers had to set up new precautions to counter this, as their war with the new Butterfly holder is just getting started now.

title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History
text:
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/History - [[Season 6]]
In the meantime, Marinette met with Adrien at his house one night to discuss her feelings about Gabriel with him. Unfortunately, when Adrien told her how happy he was about their relationship being built on being honest with each other, Marinette took that moment to leave and go home. However, after she left Adrien's after once more admitting she loved him, she sat down at the top of some steps and confessed to Tikki that she can't go on like this and Alya was right: Either she tells Adrien the truth, or she can't keep going with her relationship with him by lying to him, deciding that their relationship is over as she broke down crying as it began to rain, symbolically showing the somber tone that Marinette's future might be taking from this point on.
