Marinette: (narrating) Well, for his age. When he was my age he was chosen to become a Guardian and became Master Fu, but he made a mistake and lost two of the Miraculous: the Peacock and the Butterfly. And because of him, the last Guardians disappeared. Cat Noir and I have a great responsibility. We must help Master Fu get the lost Miraculous back. I really hope I can help Master Fu fix his mistake one day and thank him for changing my life when he picked me to become Ladybug. I barely know him, but I can feel that he has a lot to teach me. Don't worry little diary, I'll tell you everything. Goodbye for now!

title: Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)
text:
Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2) - Intro
"" is a Season 2 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 25th written and produced episode of Season 2. It is also the 51st written and produced episode of the series, overall.
This episode is also the second and final part of the two-parter, "Heroes' Day".

title: Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)
text:
Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2) - Synopsis
Ladybug and Cat Noir face one of their most fearsome opponents when Hawk Moth sets a sinister plan into motion by akumatizing his assistant.
Disney+
Scarlet Moth's villains face Ladybug and her team.

title: Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)
text:
Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2) - Plot
Prime Queen announces on live TV that everyone will witness the victory of Scarlet Moth and Heroes' Day will become Villains' Day.
As his army of villains are chanting his name, Scarlet Moth is informed by Catalyst that the time has come, and he announces to Ladybug and Cat Noir that if they want to save Paris and all its inhabitants, they must surrender their Miraculouses to him.
Cat Noir asks Ladybug what she thinks, and she replies that she knows that Hawk Moth has likely been planning this for a long time and wonders if they're really prepared.
Cat Noir assures her that they are since they've defeated all of his akumatized villains before and reminds her that they are five supers now.
Assured, Ladybug announces to Hawk Moth that she hopes he enjoyed Volpina's illusion because the real Ladybug will never surrender her Miraculous to him.
Cat Noir steps in and he suggests that Hawk Moth will give his Miraculous to the five supers.
Rena Rouge and Carapace also add that even though Hawk Moth has an army of supervillains, they are a super team (who's called "superhero team") and Queen Bee says that Hawk Moth is "going to wish that he never wore that utterly ridiculous costume".

title: Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)
text:
Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2) - Plot
Therefore, Scarlet Moth orders Guitar Villain and Frightningale to play thunderous music while the other super-villains fight the super team.

title: Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)
text:
Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2) - Plot
As the supers and the Akumatized super-villains run towards each other, Ladybug reminds everyone that their main objective is to defeat Hawk Moth. They fight the super-villains and manage to deakumatize Pharaoh, Princess Fragrance, Riposte, and Mime. Scarlet Moth watches the battle unfold and says that everything is going according to plan, with Catalyst adding how amusing it is watching the supers think that victory is possible when the future has already been decided. Scarlet Moth then sends Dark Cupid after the Bourgeois family, as André is giving a speech to the citizens of Paris telling them they will not give in to villainy, before being called by his wife to join her in leaving Paris. André wonders where his daughter is, and Audrey says that she is likely "playing super" again. Just then, Dark Cupid shoots his arrows arrow at them and Armand, causing their emotions about Chloé being a super to become negative, saying Chloé shouldn't be playing the super-heroine, and should be punished. Scarlet Moth sends an akuma after each of them, and in offering them the power to punish Chloé for her disobedience turns them back into Style Queen, Malediktator, and Despair Bear.

title: Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)
text:
Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2) - Plot
The super team manage to deakumatize Stormy Weather and Rogercop. Ladybug announces to Hawk Moth that his days of hurting innocent people will soon be over. She then summons her Lucky Charm and receives a tennis racket. Quickly coming up with a plan, Ladybug tells everyone to get ready. But before she can implement it, Dark Cupid shoots arrows at all the deakumatized, causing their emotions to become negative and therefore become reakumatized. Cat Noir and the other heroes realize that Hawk Moth is using Dark Cupid to create negative emotions in order to akumatize people. As the five heroes continue to fight, Scarlet Moth sends a swarm of akumas into the battlefield.

title: Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)
text:
Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2) - Plot
Dark Cupid prepares to shoot Carapace with his arrow, but Rena Rouge jumps in the way and takes the hit instead. With that, her emotions become negative and she angrily begins insulting Carapace. Ladybug tries to convince Rena Rouge not to give into negative emotions and Carapace even restrains her, but this does no good. Queen Bee promises Ladybug that she will never let negative emotions take her over, but Scarlet Moth says that she should never say never as Style Queen and Malediktator appear before the superhero. Meanwhile, Rena Rouge pushes Carapace away and allows an akuma to infect her Miraculous, turning her into Rena Rage. Saddened that he couldn't save her, Carapace is also akumatized into Shell Shock. Despair Bear sneaks behind Queen Bee and holds her in place while Dark Cupid shoots an arrow at her. An akuma then enters her Miraculous, turning her into Queen Wasp. Cat Noir suggests that Ladybug use her Lucky Charm, but Ladybug says that it won't work because it required everybody's help. So instead, Cat Noir uses his Cataclysm on the ground, allowing him and Ladybug to escape underneath.

title: Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)
text:
Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2) - Plot
Ladybug and Cat Noir escape into the sewers and run on opposite sides of the sewers and transform back into their civilian alter egos. As they feed their kwamis, Marinette comments on how Hawk Moth has never reakumatized so many people at once and notes that something has changed. Adrien believes that he has figured out a way to boost his powers, just like them. Marinette wonders if they'll be able to beat him without a team, but Adrien assures her that they can. Just then, the duo hears the akumatized villains heading towards them, so they quickly feed their kwamis the aqua power-ups and jump inside the sewer waters as they transform. They are soon met by Syren and Animan, but they start a duel and manage to deakumatize them. As they head back up, Frozer uses his powers to turn some of Paris into ice, causing the sewer waters to freeze. Fortunately, Ladybug and Cat Noir escape this just in time and transform into their normal superhero forms and deakumatize Frozer. Ladybug then announces to all of Paris that the real Ladybug is back and releases all of the purified akumas, giving the citizens hope. With that, Scarlet Moth angrily orders Prime Queen to stop filming.

title: Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)
text:
Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2) - Plot
But seeing Hawk Moth's army, the duo retreat and come across a blockade made up by the people of Paris who have come to support them. Ladybug and Cat Noir thank them but tell them to be careful heading for Scarlet Moth. Along the way, they see the reason why they shouldn't give up. Scarlet Moth then tells Catalyst that the heroes are more resistant than he expected, but Catalyst tells him they still have the last part of their plan. With that, Scarlet Moth walks to the other side of the Eiffel Tower.
The duo then see Scarlet Moth and come up from behind him.
Ladybug tells him that it's only the three of them.
Cat Noir summons his Cataclysm, and Ladybug summons her Lucky Charm and receives a replica Miraculous box, which she believes is a sign that Hawk Moth's Miraculous will end up in that box.
Scarlet Moth asks the supers if they're sure that they're not making a mistake, as his wish is something beneficial.
Ladybug says that every wish has a price to pay, and Cat Noir believes that no matter what his wish is, it must be evil considering the chaos he's causing.
The supers are unaware of it, but the Scarlet Moth they are confronting is an illusion made by Volpina.

title: Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)
text:
Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2) - Plot
The supers approach Scarlet Moth's illusion and Ladybug tries to convince him to do the right thing by handing over the Butterfly Miraculous, but then she sees the reflection of the real Scarlet Moth behind her through the Miraculous box as he fires an akuma after each of them while Dark Cupid shoots his arrows.
She and Cat Noir dodge the attack and deakumatize Dark Cupid.
Scarlet Moth rages over his failure of akumatizing the two heroes.
Calling him a coward, Ladybug and Cat Noir fight Scarlet Moth in a duel.
Scarlet Moth is about to hit Cat Noir with his cane, but then Ladybug takes the cane with her yo-yo and Cat Noir destroys it, reverting Scarlet Moth back into Hawk Moth and deakumatizing all the super-villains.
Angry that the plan failed, Catalyst exits Hawk Moth's lair, goes into Gabriel's safe, and takes the Peacock Miraculous.

title: Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)
text:
Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2) - Plot
Seeing that he has nothing left to lose, Hawk Moth fights Ladybug and Cat Noir and easily overpowers them. He comments on how inexperienced they are since they lose their transformations shortly after they use their superpowers. As he is about to take their Miraculous, Carapace, Rena Rouge, and Queen Bee rejoin Ladybug and Cat Noir and stop him. The five supers corner Hawk Moth and Queen Bee summons her Venom in an attempt to paralyze him.

title: Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)
text:
Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2) - Plot
Now as Mayura, Nathalie plucks a feather from her fan and, after infusing it with energy, sends it into Hawk Moth's now destroyed cane. She offers him her help, to which Hawk Moth agrees reluctantly. A giant purple moth creature appears and manages to distract the supers long enough for him to escape, leaving his cane behind. The team begins to suspect that the Peacock Miraculous holder is helping him. They decide to use the cane to track him down, but when he detransforms, the cane fades away. However, as Ladybug and Cat Noir are about to detransform, Ladybug uses Miraculous Ladybug to fix the damage. As the mission is over, Ladybug takes the Fox Miraculous and the Turtle Miraculous from Alya and Nino while Cat Noir takes the Bee Miraculous from Chloé.
Back at the Agreste mansion, Gabriel speaks to a drained Nathalie and reminds her that he'd told her never to use the Peacock Miraculous. Nathalie says that she had no choice as he was in trouble, but Gabriel retorts that the Miraculous is damaged and too dangerous. Nathalie responds that she wanted to help no matter the price. Grateful, Gabriel thanks Nathalie and comforts her.

title: Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)
text:
Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2) - Plot
In the evening, Miss Bustier's class has a picnic while Lila angrily observes from her apartment because the plan failed. Adrien attempts to sit beside Alya and Nino, but Alya says that the seat is taken and suggests that he sit by Marinette instead. However, Adrien soon receives a phone message saying that he has to go attend a charity event. Before he leaves, he tells Marinette that she is always helping others, which is why the class agreed to help her organize the picnic. He calls her their everyday Ladybug and he called her "Super Marinette", bidding her farewell. As he walks away, Marinette runs over to Adrien and thanks him by kissing him on the cheek. Adrien smiles and leaves. Once he's gone, the whole class except for Chloé cheers for Marinette as the end card appears.

title: Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)
text:
Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2) - Plot Developments
As of this episode, all of the seven Miraculous holders teased in the Season 2 opening have appeared.
This episode confirms that Hawk Moth can stay transformed even after using his superpower and it's implied that Ladybug and Cat Noir can as well, but they don't have the experience to do so until "Revolution".
This episode reveals that the Peacock Miraculous has been somehow damaged.
Further more is learned about the Miraculous when used while damaged foreshadowing several events in Season 3 and beyond.
This is the first time that Ladybug isn't able to use a Lucky Charm in the way she wanted to.
Which further reveals another weakness of the Lucky Charm, if the holder doesn't have a pieces to make the object work, then the plan will be ineffective.
Ironically, if Ladybug and the team had deakumatized Kim first, then they would've cut off the Scarlet Army supply of negative feelings meaning they would've had to go through the army once and without Mayura's intervention. Then, the Miraculous team probably would've won.

title: Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)
text:
Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2) - Plot Developments
In that sense, Ladybug's second Lucky Charm revealed another ability serving as a double meaning as  the mini miracle box was a sign of danger and victory foreshadowing the Miraculers retrieving a miraculous just not Hawk Moth's but Bunnyx's in "Evolution".
Then for the sense of danger it may have been on Tikki's part following from "Simon Says" and "Style Queen", this time knowing what happened before the heroes weren't going to fall for the same trick twice.

title: Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)
text:
Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2) - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in Switzerland on RTS Deux.
This is the second episode that has a name of a Miraculous holder in the title, the previous being "Ladybug & Cat Noir".
Up until "Re-creation", this episode showed the most character appearances in the series in a single episode.
Alya and Nino (in their superhero forms) become the second and third people to be akumatized while in their superhero forms after Chloe.
As of this episode, all of the seven Miraculous holders teased in the Season 2 opening have appeared.
This episode is the first in which a regular black and purple akuma does not appear.
The regular akuma makes an appearance in all other episodes of seasons 1, 2 and 3.
This is the second time Ladybug and Cat Noir use their aquatic powers, following "Syren".
Neither Ladybug nor Cat Noir's transformation sequences were shown.
In Adrien's speech, he states that Rose stated that Marinette is always helping people, this is actually never said in either episode.
Plagg shares his Camembert with Adrien at the sewers, despite him not liking the smell of it.
This is the second time a Miraculous holder gets akumatized, following Queen Bee from "Queen Wasp".

title: Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)
text:
Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2) - Trivia
Coincidentally, the three Miraculous holders that get akumatized in this episode are akumatized in the order that they become heroes (Rena Rouge being first, followed by Carapace and Queen Bee being akumatized last).
Despite Alix being akumatized into Timebreaker in "Catalyst", she is never seen fighting the heroes and doesn't appear until the picnic at the episode's end.
The end card of this episode is similar to the end card in "Re-creation"; it has a rainbow (or colorful in general) background in triangular sections, with the heroes that appeared in the episode jumping out in a direction triumphantly.
References
This is sixth one of the episodes from Season 2 that doesn't have a new character, following "Malediktator", "Queen Wasp", "Zombizou", "Troublemaker" and "The Collector".
Adrien recalls the events of "Reflekta", "Reverser", and "Gorizilla" in his speech near the end of the episode.
Rena Rouge taking an arrow for Carapace is similar to what Cat Noir did for Ladybug in "Dark Cupid".

title: Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)
text:
Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2) - Trivia
This is the seventh time two people have been akumatized in one day (being that it's the same day as "Catalyst"), the previous times having been in "Lady Wifi", "Princess Fragrance", "Antibug", "Volpina" (same day as "The Collector"), "The Queen's Battle", and "Catalyst".
Interestingly, this is the first time when more than two people have been akumatized in one day with a total of four.
Allusions
Mayura is the Sanskrit word for peacock, which is one of the sacred birds in Hindu mythology. It is also a contemporary Hindu name used in many parts of India.
While the titular villain is female, Mayura is specifically the term for males, with Mayuri being the term for females.
The scene where the Parisians rise against the akumatized villains is a reference to "Liberty Leading the People" painting by Eugène Delacroix.
The painting itself can be seen in the background of that scene.
Before the citizens of Paris fought against the akumatized villains, Nora said "We could be heroes, just for one day!", which is a reference to David Bowie's 'Heroes'.
Errors
The Scarlet Pharaoh's necklace has its normal colors just before getting hit by Queen Bee; when it is hit, it becomes fully red.

title: Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)
text:
Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2) - Trivia
André's hair is miscolored white when he was meeting up with Audrey.
Later, his hair disappears in the following scene.
Butler Jean's hair is miscolored purple.
Queen Bee pulls the string of her spinning top, however it is also attached to her hip when the villains are re-akumatized and they are preparing to battle again.
In one shot, Cat Noir's staff can be seen on his back, despite being in his hand.
When Gabriel detransforms, he is wearing his tie, although he took it off in the previous episode.
Additionally, Gabriel detransforms despite not saying "Nooroo, dark wings fall", which isn't possible for an adult.
This might not be an error, as in several episodes, miraculous holders have transformed back without saying the detransformation phrases.
During Ladybug’s and Cat Noir’s power-up scene, they fed their kwamis the ice power-ups instead of the aqua power-ups for their aquatic transformations when they dived into the water underneath the sewers system. The ice power-ups are blue coloured and the aqua power-ups are green coloured.

title: Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)
text:
Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2) - Trivia

title: Maya
text:
Maya - Intro
is a minor character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir.
In "The Illustrhater", after Maya felt sad because no one wanted to see her drawings, she was akumatized by Chrysalis into the Illustrhater, an artistic supervillain whose drawings become real. She also received a Magical Charm from Ladybug that prevented her from being akumatized again.

title: Maya
text:
Maya - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Maya is a short Asian-French toddler girl with light skin, light blue eyes, and short indigo-colored hair tied in two pigtails.
Civilian Attire
Maya wears an outfit that includes a pair of bright green overalls with button straps and a heart-shaped pocket at the front, layered over a short-sleeve yellow and white striped T-shirt. Her hair is tied into two low pigtails, accented by green hair ties with pink pearls. She wears pink socks and a pair of blue and white shoes.
As Illustrhater
Illustrhater had a very pale purple face, divided by a light lilac forehead with outward curled segmenting in the middle of her head. Her eyebrows became solid dark mulberry and very curly, drawn in an exaggerated narrow fashion as if she was incredibly angry. This accented the paintbrush-shaped markings beneath her eyes. The sclerae became pale mint, with brilliant cerise irises. Her hair was a shiny, solid, dark mulberry base with inward curls as her "bangs" and tiny forelocks. The rest of it was styled in a pair of sharp pencil-esque headpieces with white scalloped segmenting and brilliant cerise tips.

title: Maya
text:
Maya - Appearance
Illustrhater wore a two-piece dark purple-and-white striped suit. The upper piece was a top with symmetrical droplets in the middle, the top one smaller than the other, and scalloped cerise trim to match the thicker one on her split, large, sharp dark purple turtleneck collar. Her sleeves were puffy with cerise sharp scalloped gloves attached to them, accenting the pant legs, which were puffy with striped boots that further gave off the resemblance to a pencil. She wielded a pen and sketchbook that matched her appearance, though the sketchbook had a white spot in the corner.

title: Maya
text:
Maya - Personality
Maya loves to draw and enjoys showing her artwork to others. That's why she felt very disappointed and sad when no one seemed interested in them. However, she quickly cheered up after Ladybug, Cat Noir, Rena Rouge and Carapace praised her drawings. Like most kids her age, Maya hates seeing people eat their boogers and even finds it disgusting, something made quite clear when she saw, through the sphere created by Revelator, her father eating his own boogers, prompting her to throw it away with a look of disgust.
Despite her young age, Maya appears to be very responsible, as seen when she helps her father at work. Another example of this is that unlike her brother Sam, Maya helps her parents with Sofia, her and Sam's baby sister.
As Illustrhater, she would be rather enthusiastic about showing people her drawings, although on an amplified scale due to the nature of her drawings coming to life. Ladybug and Rena Rouge attempted to ask the Illustrhater about Chrysalis, but Chrysalis threatened to take away her powers if she said anything. Due to this, she also was resistant at first to show the superheroes her sketchbook.

title: Maya
text:
Maya - Abilities
As a Civilian
Maya seems to be a skilled artist for her age.
As Illustrhater
Illustrhater had the ability to make whatever she drew in her sketchbook come to life when she threw the page into the air. From a single sketch, she could bring multiple objects to life, as she was able to create multiple yo-yos from one drawing. She could also mimic teleportation by drawing a door that connected to any location she pleased, and fly by drawing a creature or a cloud that carried her through the air.

title: Maya
text:
Maya - Relationships
Family
Her father
She enjoys showing her drawings to her father and even drawing with him. However, when he doesn't give her the attention she wants, like when he doesn't take notice of her drawings, Maya gets really sad.
In "Revelator", when her father is attacked by the titular supervillain, Maya discovers that her father eats his own snot in secret, much to the girl's disgust.
Sam
Sam is Maya's older brother, but their relationship has become tense due to his unpleasant behavior, which seems to have started after the birth of their younger sister, Sofia. Maya isn't afraid to confront Sam about it, thinking that he acts more like a baby than Sofia.
Sofia
Maya cares deeply for her little sister and likes to help their mother with her, unlike Sam who's jealous of Sofia. Because of this, Sam doesn't help with taking care of Sofia, which Maya is unhappy about.
Acquaintances
The Miraculers

title: Maya
text:
Maya - Relationships
Maya is showed as being a great admirer of the Miraculers, with them being her primary drawing subject, as seen when she draw Rena Rouge and Carapace and went to show her drawing to other people. But Ladybug seems to be the hero she most admires, as she was excited, as Illustrhater, to show Ladybug her drawing of her. After being de-akumatized, Maya became very happy for having her drawings complemented by the heroes and showed her gratitude by giving Ladybug a drawing of her.
As Illustrhater, after getting to know the Miraculers, she wanted to take away her powers by doing anything she could to stop them. However, she would talk to them nevertheless, as Rena Rouge would try to discover from her more information about the mysterious Butterfly Miraculous holder. But, with the latter pressuring her not to tell anything, Illustrhater didn't say anything.
Cerise Bianca/Chrysalis
Cerise, probably using another unknown identity at the time, was one of the people Maya wanted to show her drawings to, but she silently dismissed her with a wave of her hand, which upset the little girl.

title: Maya
text:
Maya - Relationships
After feeling down for being ignored and no one wanting to see her drawings, Maya became a target towards Chrysalis. Putting on a façade about caring for the girl, Chrysalis managed to convince Maya to accept her power by telling her this way she would be able to show everyone her drawings. After becoming the Illustrhater, she caused great havoc through the city. When the heroes try to question the akumatized villain about the new holder of the Butterfly Miraculous, Chrysalis hasted to tell Illustrhater not to reveal anything about her and, when the heroes persisted, she threatened to remove her powers, telling her if she wanted to keep her powers forever she would need to take the heroes' Miraculouses. However, Ladybug managed to trick Illustrhater into giving her the akumatized object, despite Chrysalis' warnings towards the latter.
Unbeknownst to Maya, she actually attempted to show her drawings to an unmasked Chrysalis, only for Chrysalis to deliberately upset Maya so she could akumatize her.
In "Revelator", their paths partially cross again when Maya witnesses Chrysalis akumatize Vincent into the titular villain.
Vincent Asa

title: Maya
text:
Maya - Relationships
Maya saw Vincent ordering from her father's café and she waved at him in a friendly manner. However, everyone immediately saw Alya's revelation on TV about Vincent, proving that he was lying in his blogs, causing him to be kicked out of the café. Maya and the others witness Vincent being akumatized in Revelator by Chrysalis. The villain uses his power on Maya's father, revealing that he eats his own snot, which disgusts the girl.

title: Maya
text:
Maya - History
Season 6
In "Revelator", she is in her father's arms when Vincent Asa visits the café. When they see Alya on the TV news exposing Vincent, Maya witnesses him being kicked out of the café and then akumatized into the titular villain by Chrysalis. When Revelator used his power on Maya's father, she is disgusted to learn that he eats snot, despite forbidding her to do the same.
In "Grendiaper", as shown in a video recorded on her brother's phone, she enters Sam's room to ask him if he has seen their baby sister, Sofia's missing diapers, and then scolded him for his mean behavior since their sister was born before leaving the room.

title: Maya
text:
Maya - Etymology
Her name Maya might be a reference to Autodesk Maya, the engine which was used to animate the first five seasons.
Curiously, in the credits for "The Illustrhater", her name is listed as being "Kaya" instead of Maya, despite her being called Maya in the episode. This is most likely a spelling error.
However, in the Italian and European Portuguese dub, her name is said as being Kaya.

title: Maya
text:
Maya - Trivia
Maya's akumatized villain form, Illustrhater, had the same powers as Evillustrator.
Coincidentally, their respective episodes are the second produced episodes of their respective seasons, and both episode titles are plays on the word "illustrator".

title: Mayotte
text:
Mayotte - Intro
is a secondary character in Miraculous World: Tokyo - Stellar Force and the animated spin-off series Miraculous Stellar Force. She is a student at Kano Academy, a superheroine, and member of the Stellar Force. She is the current bearer of the Sagittarius Fragment, which allows her to become Sagittarius and one of the guardians who possess a fragment of the Stellar Matrix.

title: Mayotte
text:
Mayotte - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Mayotte is a teenage girl of short height and slender build. She has dark rosy skin, round gold eyes with two wings on each side, and dark grayish-indigo hair with bangs parted at left, styled in an afro. She has pastel pink lips. Her eyebrows are thick.
Civilian Attire
Mayotte wears a sleeveless blue jumper with a folded collar, gold trim, big zipper, zipline, and baggy legs with the cuffs rolled up to the the ankle. Her boots are navy and her arm warmers are pastel blue. Her glasses are blue and her hooped earrings are gold.
As Sagittarius
Sagittarius wears a jumpsuit shared with her teammates: a black jumpsuit with rectangular-detailed white elbow trim, abdomen, thigh trim, and shins. On her chest is a black four-point star. Her lower arms (except her fingers), torso, shoulders, inner thighs, sides of her knees, and feet are all blue with black fingers and rectangular soles. Her helmet is black with a blue chin, silver components covering her ears, followed by blue angular rectangles on top with black tips, and a model made of blue dreads atop her head resembling her afro. On her left wrist is her blue and black watch, the Sagittarius Sprite.

title: Mayotte
text:
Mayotte - Personality
Mayotte is easily excitable, evident when she first met Ladybug as a big fan of the heroine. She's talkative, full of questions, and informative, as she was able to identify Kagami was a fencer from just her sabre. She is also honest, intellectual, and respectful of different cultures.
Mayotte is always open to the contribution of others. For instance, when Marinette was learning about Kagami's friends, who were discussing who'd lead the group in the chat, Mayotte insisted they worked together rather than choose who'd take the shots as a reply to Miki.

title: Mayotte
text:
Mayotte - Abilities
As a Civilian
As a result of attending Kano Academy, Mayotte is an expert in an unknown sport.
As Sagittarius
Sagittarius has enhanced physical abilities, such as speed, combat, agility and strength. With the help of the Sagittarius Sprite, she can summon her weapon, which is her Sagittarius Armor.

Mayotte - Relationships

Miki/Leo
Mayotte and Miki are friends. However, they are sometimes prone to disagreeing, like when they were deciding the leader of the group in the chat. Mayotte was more open in that matter.

title: Mayotte
text:
Mayotte - Etymology
The name Mayotte comes from a small island in Africa, from the north of Madagascar. According to island locals, it is called Mahore. The name means "the island of death" in Arabic because it's surrounded by dangerous coral reefs.
From French terms, it's also an alternate to the name Maillot or Mailhot meaning "big mallet".

title: Mayotte
text:
Mayotte - Trivia
Mayotte has several traits associated with the Sagittarius sign:
Like other Sagittarians, Mayotte is intellectual, open-minded, and honest.
Mayotte's theme color is blue, which is a color the Sagittarius sign can represent.
However, the Sagittarius sign's mostly associated with the color purple.
Her name appears to have certain ties to death, fate, and danger itself.
Since the Sagittarius constellation is depicted as an archer/centaur who never misses a target with his bow and arrow, this could possibly fit Mayotte's name and the zodiac she represents.

title: Max's room
text:
Max's room - Intro
is the bedroom of Max Kanté, located in his mother's apartment.

title: Max's room
text:
Max's room - Appearance
Max's bedroom has white walls. There is a window with gray sills, under which sits a small wooden chest of drawers. To the side, there is a green bookcase with books near a section of wall painted green with black polka dots. This room also contains a chess table.

title: Max's room
text:
Max's room - Trivia
Max's room is fifth room to appear in season 6 following Sabrina's room in "Daddycop", Zoé's room in "Grendiaper", Nathaniel's room in "The Ruler", and Mylène's room in "Noe".

title: Melodie
text:
Melodie - Intro
was a character from the old, unused concept of Ladybug and Cat Noir being in a team of superheroes called the Quantic Kids. She existed in concept art that included Mercury and Sparrow (who was later replaced with Kid Mime), the other members of the team. However, the concept was discarded, and so, Melodie never appeared outside of concept art.
It is currently unknown if she exists in the Quantic Universe.

title: Melodie
text:
Melodie - Appearance
Physical appearance
Based on concept art, Melodie had long blonde hair that she wore in a single braid except for her bangs. Her eyes were blue.
Civilian attire
In her civilian form, she wore a white shirt with a purple vest. She also wore dark purple jeans.
As Melodie
Thomas's original early design for Melodie's outfit was a jumpsuit with a white torso and black lower half. On her torso is a massive black treble clef on a staff. At the base of her jumpsuit was a series of white musical notes, which made an infinity symbol. She had white boots and dark gray gloves. Across her face was a white mask.
Later designs tried different features, like a black bent eight note around one of her eyes on the mask, black dots attached to lines on her chest instead of a treble cleft and over her hands, and a white band covering or beside her braid.

title: Melodie
text:
Melodie - Abilities
As Melodie
Melodie used a flute as a weapon. In concept art, it appears that she could create a narrow line of fire from the end of the flute, which she could fight with.

title: Melodie
text:
Melodie - Sightings
Comics and books
Other

title: Melodie
text:
Melodie - Trivia
An image of Melodie used to appeared in the Super Lady Luck slot game.
According to The Art of Miraculous, there were plans for each member of the Quantic Kids to have a fairy (an early version of a kwami) who would give them their superpowers. It's unknown what is the name of Melodie's fairy who gives her music superpowers.
Like Volpina, Rena Rouge, and the other Fox Miraculous holders, her weapon is a flute.
Melodie's civilian design shares many similarities to Chloé Bourgeois' early designs in concept art, including their hair color, eye color, and apparel.

title: Mercury
text:
Mercury - Intro
is a minor character of Miraculous World: New York - United Heroez. He is a superhero and member of United Heroez, a team of superheroes, that protects the United States of America.

title: Mercury
text:
Mercury - Appearance
As Mercury
As a superhero, Mercury has blue skin with white lightning bolt-like markings starting from his legs and arms, connecting around his torso. He has several large white dots intersecting the markings: two on each of his knees, two on his hip bones, on on his abdomen, two between his pectorals and collarbone, two on each shoulder, and two on each hand. His palms are white, as well as the soles of his feet. His hair and eyebrows are white and have a similar lightning motif. His eyes are also completely white.

title: Mercury
text:
Mercury - Personality
Mercury's personality is not exactly known. In "Miraculous New York", he is brave and courageous. He is not afraid to stand up to fight the enemy to protect people. He is also loyal to other heroes. Given that he started playing around with his powers after being hit by Liberation, he is presumably normally very diligent and active.

title: Mercury
text:
Mercury - Abilities
Mercury's abilities were not well represented. It is known that he can run very fast. While running, he also produces electrical charges, but it has not been found whether he can control them.

title: Mercury
text:
Mercury - History
Miraculous New York
Mercury is seen on the news with the other members of the United Heroez, where President Camilla Hombee/Victory makes a statement about the hunt for Techno Pirate and postpones the French American Friendship celebration ceremony. Later in Times Square, Mercury and the other superheroes surround Techno Pirate, now Miraclonizer, who uses the Eagle Miraculous's power of Liberation to free all the superheroes from their ethical constraints, with Mercury's being to be quick on his feet and to help people.
Mercury then pulls up a folding chair and began to lounge lazily. Once he is freed from the effects of Miraclonizer's use of Liberation by Eagle, he attends the French American Friendship celebration ceremony. There Mercury watched as Snowflake made an ice sculpture of Ladybug, Cat Noir, Uncanny Valley, and Eagle as he celebrated them while standing on a huge rose created by Thorn.

title: Mercury
text:
Mercury - Concept and Development
Mercury was developed as a character for the old, unused concept of Ladybug and Cat Noir being in a team of superheroes called the Quantic Kids. In this version, he appears to be the same age as Ladybug and Cat Noir, instead of his older appearance in Miraculous New York, and the lightning bolt-like lines across his body had light blue edges. The team consisted of Ladybug, Cat Noir, Melodie, and Sparrow. However, the concept was discarded, and this iteration of Mercury never appeared outside concept art.

title: Mercury
text:
Mercury - Trivia
While an image of Mercury appeared in the first version of the Super Lady Luck slot game, he doesn't appear in the current version. The slot game has since been discontinued.
The Super Lady Luck version of Mercury also had blue irises with black sclera, instead of the completely white eyes he's usually depicted with.
His name, abilities, and color palette are reminiscent of the DC Comics Speedster, Max Mercury.

title: Mei Cheng
text:
Mei Cheng - Intro
is the mother of Sabine Cheng and Shu Yin Cheng and the maternal grandmother of Marinette Dupain-Cheng.

title: Mei Cheng
text:
Mei Cheng - Appearance
Physical appearance
Mei has brown hair, brown eyes and red glasses.
Civilian attire
She wears a white shirt and a jacket with white and red stripes, a skirt with the same pattern as that of her jacket: white and red stripes, and silver ballet flats.

title: Mei Cheng
text:
Mei Cheng - Trivia
Her model is based on a common Shanghainese background character.

title: Micazoyolin
text:
Micazoyolin - Intro
was an Aztec warrior. He was a past Miraculous holder, wielding the Ladybug Miraculous and transforming into a ladybug-themed superhero when Tikki inhabited it.

title: Micazoyolin
text:
Micazoyolin - Appearance
Micazoyolin was muscular, and he had long black hair. Over his upper face, he had red face paint with a black bottom underline and three black dots on each cheek below. Red paint was also on his lower arms, and his body and upper arms were painted with black spots. He wore a headdress with a golden headband that had engraved details, red feathers that had black spots, green leaves, and ladybug stones/jewels on the band over each ear. His cape was dark red with black spots with golden edges. Underneath, there was a black garment that included a thin yellow stripe, a thin red stripe, and small green leaves on the edges. He also wore a thin golden armband on each upper arm, a thick golden wristband on each wrist, and a red skirt-like loincloth, which he wrapped and tied the yo-yo over.

title: Micazoyolin
text:
Micazoyolin - Abilities
If this past Ladybug Miraculous holder had the same powers as the current Ladybug (Marinette), he had enhanced abilities and the superpowers Lucky Charm and Miraculous Ladybug. He also had the yo-yo for a weapon.

title: Micazoyolin
text:
Micazoyolin - Trivia
Feri González revealed the character as her seventh Inktober drawing, noting that he was created by Thomas Astruc.
He is the first known person of Mexican origin to wield the Ladybug Miraculous, preceding La Mariquita.
The first Miraculous holder to live in the Western Hemisphere following La Mariquita, Eagle and Vesperia.
And yet, continent wise he is the first person of North America to wield Miraculous following Gilbert, La Marquita, Jessica and Zoe.
Micazoyolin's name comes from the Nahuatl word for "ladybug".
Micazoyolin, unlike most Ladybug Miraculous holders, was male, not female, making him the first one before Mister Bug.
He was succeeded by Mister Bug who used the Ladybug Miraculous temporarily.
On her Tumblr blog, Feri Gonzalez created a partner to Micazoyolin, a female Cat Miraculous holder named Mistontli. However, because she wasn't created by Thomas Astruc, her canonicity is disputed.

title: Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
[ Theme song ]
Prime Queen: Don't be bemused, it's just the news! Thank you for joining us for this very special program. You will have the chance to witness the victory of our great leader, Scarlet Moth!
Akumatized villains: Hail Scarlet Moth! Hail Scarlet Moth! Hail Scarlet Moth!
Prime Queen:  Today shall be known as... Villains Day!
Catalyst: It's time, Scarlet Moth.
Akumatized villains: Hail Scarlet Moth! (stop when Scarlet Moth raises his cane)
Scarlet Moth: Ladybug. Cat Noir. I can feel your close presence. If you want to save Paris and all its people, I'll give you one last chance. Give yourselves up and bring me your Miraculous!
Cat Noir: Penny for your thoughts, M’lady?
Ladybug: It's like he's been preparing for this for a long time. But we...we're not prepared for this.
Cat Noir: Yes, we are! We've already fought them all and we won! And there are five of us this time!
(The other three nod)
Ladybug: If we want to win, we have to defeat Hawk Moth, even though we've never fought him before. (stands up) Hawk Moth! I hope you enjoyed Volpina's illusion because the real Ladybug will never hand you over her Miraculous!

title: Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: (stands up) And we've got a better idea! You're gonna give us your Miraculous!
Carapace: (stands up along with Rena Rouge) You may have an army of akumatized warriors...
Rena Rouge: ...but we're a whole team of superheroes!
Queen Bee: (stands up) You're going to wish you never wore that utterly ridiculous costume!
(The heroes bring out their weapons and pose)

(The other akumatized villains charge towards the Miraculous Supers)
Prime Queen: And so it begins. The Scarlet Army is on its way to crush these pathetic Miraculous holders.

Cat Noir: Well, it's a simple plan then. Go for the big bad boss.

Carapace: I'll cover you!
Queen Bee: You can count on me, Ladybug.
Stormy Weather: Cyclone! (makes a huge twister appear)
The Pharaoh: Horus! Give me your wings! (flies and picks up Princess Fragrance)

title: Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:

(Cat Noir charges towards the akumatized villains with his staff)

(Princess Fragrance aims at Cat Noir, but Carapace blocks the attack)

(Queen Bee hits the Pharaoh's pendant with her spinning top, breaking it and releasing the akuma)

(Ladybug captures the akuma)
(Cat Noir and Carapace deakumatize Riposte and Mime while Ladybug captures their akumas)
Cat Noir: We make a pretty cool team.
Ladybug: Not bad! But it's not over yet.
Scarlet Moth: It's all going to plan, Catalyst.

title: Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Catalyst: Nothing's more delightful than leading them to believe that they actually have a chance of winning when their future has already been decided!
Scarlet Moth: Over to you, Dark Cupid.
André: People of Paris. Just like our superheroes, we will never give in to evil and villainy. Together we shall resist! Together we will triumph! (receives phone call) Huh? Ahem. Yes, honey?
Audrey: What are you doing? Hurry up, André!
André: Yes, yes, my dear. I'm on my way. (hangs up and slowly backs away) Meanwhile, I will supervise Paris' defense... from my helicopter! (goes inside the hotel) Thank you! (runs off)
André: (runs towards Audrey and Butler Jean) Audrey, my darling. Where's our Chloé?

(Dark Cupid fires an arrow at André, Audrey, and Butler Jean, causing their emotions about Chloé being a superhero to become negative.)
André: Chloé shouldn't be playing the superheroine!
Audrey: It's unacceptable! Utterly unacceptable!
Butler Jean: Mademoiselle will have to be punished.
Scarlet Moth: Nice work, Dark Cupid. The Bourgeois family is now in place to follow my plan. (sends scarlet akumas to Le Grand Paris) Hahahaha!

title: Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Scarlet Moth: Style Queen, Malediktator, Despair Bear.
Scarlet Moth: Chloé never does what she's told, huh? Well now I'm giving you the power to punish her once and for all! (Audrey, André, and Butler Jean are turned back into Style Queen, Malediktator, and Despair Bear)

Rena Rouge: (throws her flute at Rogercop's whistle, breaking it and releasing the akuma)
Ladybug: Your days of attacking innocent people will soon be over, Hawk Moth. Lucky Charm! (receives a tennis racket and looks at her surroundings) Get ready! I'm gonna need all of you!
Scarlet Moth: The time has come, Dark Cupid.
(Dark Cupid fires arrows at all the de-akumatized: Rose, Kagami, Aurore, Jalil, Roger, and Fred, giving them negative emotions and allowing Scarlet Moth to re-akumatize them on, Princess Fragrance, Riposte, Stormy Weather, Pharaoh, Rogercop, and Mime)

title: Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: What?
Prime Queen: What an incredible twist! Those lousy heroes didn't even see it coming!
Cat Noir: Hawk Moth is using Dark Cupid to create all the negative emotions he needs.
(Dark Cupid fires an arrow at Ladybug, but she dodges and the heroes continue to battle the akumatized villains while Dark Cupid fires more arrows)
Carapace: It's a nightmare!
Ladybug: Stay focused, guys! Villains must never prevail!
Scarlet Moth: Fall on them like rain, my scarlet akumas! (sends a swarm of scarlet akumas towards the Supers)
Ladybug: Huh? (notices the scarlet akumas) Watch out!
Cat Noir: Oh no.
Prime Queen: (as the superheroes battle the akumas) Now watch Scarlet Moth's relentless plan to get rid of your precious protectors. Mwahahahaha!
(The Pharaoh begins to overpower Carapace; Rena Rouge notices that Dark Cupid is aiming an arrow at Carapace, who kicks the Pharoah away.)
Rena Rouge: Carapace, watch out! (Dark Cupid fires an arrow at Carapace, but Rena Rouge jumps in the way and takes the hit instead)
Carapace: Rena? No! Not you!
Rena Rouge: (her lips becomes black and she starts to growl) Hands off! (pushes Carapace away from her) You flyweight!

title: Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: (notices an akuma approaching Rena Rouge and captures it) Rena Rouge, don't let any negative emotions take over you, or you might get akumatized too, and that's exactly what Hawk Moth wants!
(Rena Rouge struggles to reject the arrow's influence.)
Carapace: (slowly approaches Rena Rouge) Hold on!
Rena Rouge: You are not cut out to be a hero! (lunges at Carapace, but he restrains her) Let go of me, you weakling! (tries to fight herself out of Carapace's grasp)
Carapace: Shh. Easy.
(Princess Fragrance fires her perfume at Rena Rouge and Carapace, but Queen Bee blocks the attack with her top)
Queen Bee: You don't have to worry about me, Ladybug! I'll never let my emotions get the better of me!
Scarlet Moth: You should never say... "never".
Style Queen & Malediktator: Chloé! (appear in front of her)
Queen Bee: Daddy? Mommy?!
Ladybug: Queen Bee! Focus! (gets attacked by the Pharoah) Ugh!
Malediktator: By the power vested in me, stop playing superheroes! (he and Style Queen attack Queen Bee, who blocks their attacks with her top)
Rena Rouge: (pushes Carapace away and happily allows an akuma to infect her Miraculous) I am now... Rena Rage!

title: Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Carapace: NOOOOOO! (saddened, an akuma infects his Miraculous)
Ladybug: Carapace, no!
Shell Shock: There is no more Carapace... there is only Shell Shock! (throws his shield at Ladybug, she dodges)
Despair Bear: (latches onto Queen Bee, who still is fighting Style Queen and Malediktator) Stop! (holds her in place, allowing Dark Cupid to shoot an arrow at her and an akuma to infect her Miraculous)
Cat Noir: Queen Bee!
Queen Wasp: That's Queen Wasp to you, cockroach! (throws a punch at Cat Noir, but he dodges)
Cat Noir: (avoids several akumatized villains' attacks) This might be a good time to use that Lucky Charm of yours, don't you think?
Ladybug: (avoids several akumatized villains' attacks) I need all of us to make it work! I can't do anything with it now!
(The akumatized villains begin to surround Ladybug and Cat Noir. Frightningale and Guitar Villain continue to play music)
Scarlet Moth: Game, set, and match, Ladybug.
Cat Noir: I don't see how we're going to get out of this one, M’lady.
Ladybug: We can't lose hope, or we'll get akumatized, too.
Cat Noir: Pretty cataclysmic situation, huh?
Ladybug: (gasps) Cataclysm! That's it! Beneath us, Cat Noir!

title: Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: Of course. Cataclysm! (uses Cataclysm on the ground below them, allowing him and Ladybug to escape)
Prime Queen: No more Ladybug and Cat Noir! Have they destroyed themselves, or...?
Ladybug: I'm about to transform back. I'll go this way. You go that way. (she and Cat Noir run on opposite sides of the sewer)
(Ladybug detransforms into Marinette)
Marinette: That was a close one. (reaches into her bag and pulls out a macaron for Tikki)
Cat Noir: Claws in! (detransforms into Adrien)
Adrien: (pulls out a piece of cheese from his pocket) Enjoy it, but don't take too long. We don't have much time.
Plagg: Let's share it. (splits the cheese in half) You're gonna need it, too.
Adrien: Thank you, Plagg. (takes the cheese)
Scarlet Moth: Animan, track down Ladybug and Cat Noir. They must not escape. (Animan shapeshifts into a panther)
Adrien: You okay, Ladybug?
Marinette: Hawk Moth has never re-akumatized so many people in one go. Something's changed.
Adrien: Maybe he's figured out how to boost his powers, just like we did.
Marinette: You still think we can win?
Adrien: (smiles) Like you said, we can't lose hope. People are relying on us.
Marinette:  But our team crumbled.

title: Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: Then let's go back to what's always worked. A duo. You and me against the world, m'lady.
Marinette: (smiles but then gasps upon hearing a noise) They're coming!
(Several akumatized villains head their way)
Adrien: You like water rides? (runs towards the sewer waters)
Marinette: (runs in the same direction) Don't forget to put your diving gear on. (jumps into the water with Adrien, eyes closed) Tikki, power-up! (tosses Tikki the aqua power-up)
Adrien: Plagg, power-up! (tosses Plagg the aqua power-up)
(Marinette and Adrien transform into Aquabug and Aqua Noir and swim through the sewer pipes until they come across Syren)
Aquabug: Syren!
Animan: (jumps into the water and shapeshifts into a giant catfish)
Aqua Noir: Better get fishing. (swims towards Syren while Aquabug swims towards Animan)
(Aqua Noir breaks Syren's bracelet while Aquabug breaks Animan's pin, releasing the akumas)
(Aquabug captures the akumas and Syren and Animan are turned back into Ondine and Otis, who have trouble breathing underwater until Aquabug and Aqua Noir give them their yo-yo and staff to use as a breathing device)

title: Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Aqua Noir: It's gonna take a lot of time to de-akumatize all these villains one by one.
Aquabug: Which is exactly why we have to take on Hawk Moth directly. He's using his cane to re-akumatize his victims. If we can destroy it, he won't have an army fighting for him anymore. (gasps upon finding that the sewer water is starting to freeze; she and Aqua Noir retreat)
Scarlet Moth: (laughs maliciously as Frozer begins to freeze all of Paris) Behold my triumph, Parisians! Your champions are trapped!
Aquabug & Aqua Noir: (jump out of the freezing water) Spots Off!/Claws In! (transform back into regular form)
Ladybug: (aims her yo-yo at Frozer's ice skates, breaking them and releasing the akuma, which she then captures) You sure don't want to miss what's coming next! Time to show everyone that the real Ladybug is back! (releases all the captured akumas)
Nora: Look! The heroes are back.
Scarlet Moth: Stop filming, Prime Queen!
Darkblade: No more escaping for you knaves. Down with the enemy!
Ladybug: I suggest we take a little detour.
Cat Noir: Couldn't agree more, M’lady.
Cat Noir: Any miraculous ideas, M’lady?
Ladybug: Besides running and surviving you mean?

title: Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
(The two reach a barricade which they jump over. The Scarlet Army stops. Suddenly, various citizens like Marinette's parents, Anarka, Luka, and others, led by Nora, come up onto the barricade)
Nora: Parisians, we can be heroes just for one day!
Parisians: Yeah! Yes! Yes!
Darkblade: What? A revolution?! Charge!
(Darkblade's Army charges at the rebelling Parisians.)
Gina: Are you okay? (Ladybug grabs her hand and stands)
Marlena: It's awesome seeing you guys again!
Gina: Parisians are all on your side.
Marlena: We will slow them down. You two go save the world!
Ladybug: You are all fantastic. Thank you! Take care!
Cat Noir: Thank you! (The two heroes run off)
Scarlet Moth: Get them my giants. Destroy Ladybug and Cat Noir! And anyone else who tries to stand in your way!
Scarlet Giants: (salute Scarlet Moth)
Parisian: Hey! (calls the attention of Gigantitan using a car)
Gigantitan: Car... Vroom! Vroom!
Cat Noir: People are amazing!
Ladybug: That’s precisely why you should never give up hope, kitty!
Scarlet Moth: They’re more resistant than I expected.
Catalyst: But we still have the last phase of our plan.
Scarlet Moth: (walks away)
Ladybug: Take care of the ice cream man, Cat Noir!

title: Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: With pleasure! All this fighting has made me hungry.
(Ladybug and Cat Noir deakumatize Glaciator, then head for Scarlet Moth on the Eiffel Tower)
Scarlet Moth (Illusion): (gasp)
Ladybug: It's down to the three of us, Hawk Moth!
Cat Noir: Cataclysm!
Ladybug: Lucky Charm! (receives a miniature Miraculous box) It's a sign, Hawk Moth. A sign that your Miraculous will wind up inside this box!
Scarlet Moth (Illusion): Are you sure you're not making a serious mistake? How would you know if the wish I was planning to make with your Miraculous wouldn't have been beneficial to everyone?
Ladybug: If you were to make a wish, there'd be a price to pay. Why don't you tell us your wish, Hawk Moth?
Scarlet Moth (Illusion): Give me your Miraculous and you'll find out.
Volpina: Unlike you, I'm not afraid to use these powers.
Scarlet Moth (Illusion): Since you are so good, why didn't bother to try and change the world for the better?
Ladybug: We are changing the world every day by our actions. Not just by wishing it at the expense of innocent citizens!
Cat Noir: Whatever your wish it can only be evil judging the by the havoc you wreak.

title: Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
(The heroes head towards the illusion Scarlet Moth while the real Scarlet Moth sneaks behind them)
Catalyst: The time has come! You are about to triumph at last.

Scarlet Moth: No!
Ladybug: You're such a coward, Hawk Moth!
Cat Noir: But there's no hiding this time!
(Ladybug and Cat Noir fight Scarlet Moth and eventually manage to grab his cane, which Cat Noir destroys with his Cataclysm, turning Scarlet Moth back into Hawk Moth and de-akumatizing all his akumatized villains)
Hawk Moth: No!
Catalyst: NO! Argh! Ah!
Hawk Moth: Alright, kids. Watch what a man who's got nothing to lose can do!
(While he fights Ladybug and Cat Noir, Catalyst goes into Gabriel's safe and takes out the Peacock Miraculous)

title: Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Hawk Moth: (after overpowering the duo) You're never going to win. Not today or any other day. You're still so green, young superheroes. You can't even stay transformed after you've used your powers. (nearly grabs their Miraculous, but is stopped by Carapace, who throws his shield at him)
Rena Rouge: Need a hand?
Ladybug: (uses her yo-yo to create a net around the Eiffel Tower) You're caught in our net, Hawk Moth. You're not going anywhere!
Queen Bee: Venom! I'll paralyze him, then he'll be all yours, Ladybug. (The five superheroes approach Hawk Moth)
(Nathalie, now as Mayura, plucks a feather from her hand fan, charges it with energy, transforming into an Amok and sends it to the Eiffel Tower.)
Mayura: (from Hawk Moth's lair) Hawk Moth. (Hawk Moth gasps) I am Mayura. You're up against the wall, plagued by your deepest, darkest despair. Let me help you.
Hawk Moth: No, don't do that!
Mayura: Let your despair be embodied in a powerful protection.
(Hawk Moth reluctantly accepts Mayura's help, manifesting a giant purple moth to appear and use its wings to push the heroes away.)

title: Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: What is that monster? (latches onto it with her yo-yo, but before she can attack it, Mayura uses her power to make it vanish)
Ladybug: (notices a feather coming out of Hawk Moth's cane) A feather! The second Miraculous that Master Fu lost...
Cat Noir: ...was a Peacock!
Queen Bee: Ladybug! Hawk Moth! (The five Supers find that Hawk Moth is gone)
Cat Noir: He must've escaped when that monster appeared.
Ladybug: Hawk Moth is no longer working alone. He had help from the owner of the Peacock Miraculous. (Queen Bee hands her Hawk Moth's broken cane) Maybe this will help us track him.
Hawk Moth: (de-transforms, exhausted)
Nooroo: Master?
(The cane in Ladybug's hand fades away)
Rena Rouge: There goes our last chance of finding him.
Ladybug: He must have de-transformed. (notices her earrings are flashing) We've got to split guys. But before that, Miraculous Ladybug!
(Ladybug throws the miniature Miraculous box in the air, then takes off with Rena Rouge and Carapace and collects the Fox and Turtle Miraculous from them while Cat Noir collects the Bee Miraculous from Chloé)
Master Fu: (puts the Fox and Bee Miraculous inside the Miracle Box) Thank you, Marinette.

title: Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Gabriel: I told you never to use the Peacock Miraculous!
Nathalie: I had no choice, sir. I had to save you! (coughs)
Gabriel: It's damaged. It's way too dangerous.

Gabriel: (glares at her but then smiles) Thank you, Nathalie. (puts his hand on top of hers) For everything.
Chloé: (to Sabrina, who offers her a plate of cookies) There's no way I'm trying your homemade stuff. Too risky! (eats a platter of sushi instead while Sabrina cries)
(Adrien attempts to sit down next to Nino, but Alya sits there instead)
Alya: Taken. (Adrien tries to sit on the other side, but Alya jumps there too) Taken as well, but there's a free seat over there. (points towards Marinette)
Mylène: Here! Here! Here! (stops when she notices Marinette staring at her)

title: Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:

Adrien: Thanks. (sits besides Marinette but soon receives a phone message and then notices his bodyguard waiting for him from afar) Oh no. My father wants me to attend a charity event he's throwing. I can't stay. (stands up and looks down at Marinette) I wanted to tell you. Rose was right earlier. You're always helping people. Like that day you helped Juleka overcome her class photo curse. Or when you partnered Nathaniel and Marc together to make that comic book. Or when you helped me get to the movies so that I could see my mother on the screen. That's why everyone jumped at the chance to help you with the picnic. So today, it was our turn to help you. You're our everyday Ladybug. Have a good evening, Super-Marinette. (walks away)

Miss Bustier's class: (gasps)
Marinette: (kisses Adrien's cheek) Thank you!
Adrien: (smiles) You're welcome, Marinette. (waves goodbye and walks away as the whole class cheers for Marinette, not noticing that she was standing on top of a pie)

title: Mike Rochip
text:
Mike Rochip - Intro
is the secondary antagonist of Miraculous World: New York - United Heroez. He is an infamous supervillain from New York City known as Techno-Pirate.
During "Miraculous New York", after being defeated and captured by the United Heroez, he was akumatized by Hawk Moth into Techlonizer, a technology-stealing supervillain who he used to acquire the Eagle Miraculous.
After learning that Ladybug and Cat Noir were in New York, Hawk Moth reakumatized him into Techlonizer before putting the Eagle Miraculous on him, who used it to transform into Miraclonizer, an eagle-themed supervillain, when Liiri was inhabiting it.

title: Mike Rochip
text:
Mike Rochip - Appearance
Physical appearance
Mike is a large, tall man with moderate opal-colored skin that has a circuit board pattern running from his hands and arms up to his chest and all the way to his head. He also has moderately thick turquoise eyebrows and a mohawk of matching hair, his eyes are moderate aquamarine.
Civilian attire
He wears a short sleeved and folded collared orange prison bodysuit with a zipper that reaches to his crotch on the front. On the right side of his outfit are the numbers 7239. Underneath, he wears a white sleeveless tank top, and large metal bracelets on his arms.
As Techlonizer
Techlonizer still wore the harness and cuffs he was wearing in the prison transport, but they and his body were a moderate sapphire blue with light cerulean circuit board patterns and accents running across him. He also had a mohawk of light cerulean hair and matching eyebrows, and his sclera were dark cornflower blue with light cyan irises. His prison bodysuit was an azureish white, and from the center of his lower back extended four long mechanical arms with blue accents. At the end of each arm were two sets of four sharp claws.
As Miraclonizer

title: Mike Rochip
text:
Mike Rochip - Appearance
His appearance was similar to when he was Techlonizer, except his body was black with white circuit board patterns, and white hair and eyebrows. He had a yellow beaked nose guard in the center of his eyebrows, and his suit was a brownish color with gold accents, as well as a feather pattern and an eagle symbol on the front. He also had large bracelets on his arms and two wings sprouting from his back. His eyes ware normal colored but had a gold coloring around them.

title: Mike Rochip
text:
Mike Rochip - Personality
Techno-Pirate enjoys taking control of technology, not caring about who he puts in danger. As Techlonizer and Miraclonizer, he became more destructive and menacing, even being determined to get Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous after Hawk Moth found out they were in New York.

title: Mike Rochip
text:
Mike Rochip - Abilities
As Techno-Pirate
As his normal super-villain self, Techno-Pirate appears to have some sort of technopathy that allows him to shut down any piece of technology so he can steal it. He also possess super-strength, as he was able to sustain the weight of an airplane turbine.
As Techlonizer
Following his akumatization, he gained the ability to steal and duplicate the structure and function of any piece of technology he touched. It even worked with more primitive forms of technology, such as cannons. He also had four long robotic arms coming from his back. When he stole Uncanny Valley's ability he was shown to turn one of his arms into multiple wires to grab her.
As Miraclonizer
In addition to his abilities as Techlonizer, he wielded the Eagle Miraculous, which allowed him to use the special superpower, Liberation, allowing him to free people from any emotions or character traits that limited their full potential. He also had wings, which allowed him to fly.

title: Mike Rochip
text:
Mike Rochip - Relationships
Hawk Moth
Hawk Moth akumatized him in order to free him so he could steal Lafayette's saber. Mike couldn't understand why he wouldn't want something like an atomic bomb, but goes along with it as Techlonizer. After he is de-akumatized and having no memory of what happened while he was Techlonizer, becomes frustrated and angered with Hawk Moth for keeping him prisoner, before being re-akumatized again. After he is de-akumatized a second time, Mike doesn't have any recollection of what happened while he was Miraclonizer.

title: Mike Rochip
text:
Mike Rochip - History
Very little is known about Techno-Pirate.
During "Miraculous New York", when the plane with Marinette's class is about to arrive in New York for the French-American Friendship Week, Techno-Pirate appears and tries to steal one of the turbines, unbalancing the plane. Fortunately, Majestia, Knightowl, Uncanny Valley and Sparrow appear and manage to defeat and capture him, while putting the turbine back in its place. Techno-Pirate is then placed in custody, but during transportation, he is Akumatized by Hawk Moth into Techlonizer to create a diversion while Hawk Moth steals the Eagle Miraculous and later gives it to Techno-Pirate after re-Akumatizing him, and he uses it to become Miraclonizer. He is defeated thanks to the combined efforts of Ladybug, Cat Noir, Uncanny Valley, Sparrow (later Eagle) and Knightowl, being put back in jail after being de-Akumatized.

title: Mike Rochip
text:
Mike Rochip - Trivia
Mike Rochip's akumatized identity as Techlonizer seems to be based on Dr. Otto Octavius, also known as Dr. Octopus (Doc Ock for short), a supervillain from Marvel, as both of them possess and control four mechanical arms that serve as both weapons and transportation.
He is the first villain to be akumatized and wear a Miraculous who already has powers of his own.
His name is a pun on the word "microchip".

title: Mei Shi
text:
Mei Shi - Intro
is the final antagonist turned tritagonist of Miraculous World: Shanghai - The Legend of Ladydragon. He is the lion protector of the Prodigious.
In "Miraculous Shanghai", he was akumatized by Hawk Moth into Yanluoshi, a giant supervillain that destroyed any Renren he thought was unworthy of the Prodigious. At the end of the special, he transformed into a kwami-like creature.

title: Mei Shi
text:
Mei Shi - Appearance
As a statue
Mei Shi was a humanoid lion navy blue colored statue covered in black armor with gold markings, had a cyan sphere at the top of his head with cyan eyes while holding a golden orb in his hand.
As a Kwami-like spirit
Mei Shi is a lion with a navy blue body, red and green eyes, cyan blue mane, tail tuff and a small circle with a vortex symbol on his head.
As Yanluoshi
Yanluoshi's appearance remained mostly the same except his color changed to vivid red, purplish black, and dark violet and was much taller.

title: Mei Shi
text:
Mei Shi - Personality
He is protective, duty bound, stern towards the rules and a judge of character as he wishes to test each chosen Renren to see if they are worthy of weaving the Prodigious and when they are he'll respect them as the true wielder until the next chosen one rises.
Mei Shi is also quite knowledgeable knowing what it takes to master each renling's powers, as he sensed Fei Wu's inability to use Long Long's power and patiently told her the true value of the dragon. After he was deakumatized Mei Shi was horrified at the destruction he caused calling it a breach in his duty and was proud that Fei Wu finally mastered the power of the dragon.
After taking his Kwami-like form, he becomes more friendly and chatty.
As Yanluoshi, he was extremely destructive, violent and furious on taking the Prodigious back. He even eradicated Hawk Moth who gave him his powers.

title: Mei Shi
text:
Mei Shi - Abilities
As a statue
As a statue, Mei Shi could sense when a human touched the Prodigious and how they felt when trying to use the jewel he guards. From Nooroo's description, Mei Shi's a dreadful opponent with powerful magic implying that if angered he can be a fierce fighter.
As a Kwami-like spirit
As a kwami-like spirit creature, Mei Shi can fly, levitate, and phase through solid objects. Mei Shi can also carry objects that are larger and/or heavier than he is. It's unknown if he can give superpowers or a suit like the other kwamis.
As Yanluoshi
As Yanluoshi, he was able to shoot beams from his eyes that eradicated anything and anyone that they touched by making them crumble to dust. Even Miraculous wearers and the Miraculous they were wearing had no immunity against the beams, as seen by him easily eradicating Hawk Moth and Cat Noir. He also possessed gigantic size.

title: Mei Shi
text:
Mei Shi - Relationships
Friends
Fei Wu
When the Prodigious ends up in Fei's possession, Mei Shi puts her under his judgement. Sensing her inability to use the dragon, he tells her that as the Renren her actions must be noble and just for it to work. But hearing Fei wanting to use the dragon's power as means of revenge Mei Shi retorts that the dragon's value is justice and that her judgement and intentions are clouded. Once deakumatized, he asked if she ascended to the power of the dragon to which she did with Ladybug's help; sensing that her revenge was gone and fulfilled all the required values Mei Shi found her as worthy Renren. After reclaiming the Sacred Cave Key, Mei Shi appeared to Fei again as a kwami and her Renren advisor.
In "Re-creation", he along with the rest of the Renlings, comforted Fei and reminded her that she's worthy of the Prodigious and transformed her to fight against the Miraculized.
As Yanluoshi, his judgement becomes clouded, therefore he becomes furious with Fei and finds her unworthy of the Prodigious and demands it back.
Ladybug

title: Mei Shi
text:
Mei Shi - Relationships
As Yanluoshi, he expressed a negative aura towards Ladybug, likely due to her supporting Fei, who did not provide the Prodigious back to him. This was the underlying reason in which he was akumatized by Hawk Moth and despised Ladybug during this period. However, after being saved by Fei, Mei Shi expressed neither negative nor positive emotions to Ladybug, meaning apathy.
Cat Noir
As Yanluoshi, he expressed a negative aura towards Cat Noir, likely due to him supporting Fei, who did not provide the Prodigious back to him. This was the underlying reason in which he was akumatized by Hawk Moth and despised Cat Noir during this period and had no qualms with eradicating him. However, after being saved by Fei, Mei Shi expressed neither negative nor positive emotions to Cat Noir, meaning apathy.
Renlings

title: Mei Shi
text:
Mei Shi - Relationships
Not much is known about the Mei Shi's relationship with the renlings except that he was knowledgeable on what it took for the Prodigious user to master the renlings human values properly and he is pretty adamant on protecting the Prodigious thereby extension the renlings and as Yanluoshi, he was very fierce upon getting them back willing to cause destruction until he does. After, he was deakumatized and saw that Fei had fulfilled all the requirements to be the new renren; Mei Shi was happy that the Prodigious and renlings were in good hands.
Enemies
Hawk Moth
Mei Shi is aware that Hawk Moth has the Sacred Cave Key and allows him entry into cave, instructing him to face his judgement under the Prodigious but when Hawk Moth refused Mei Shi was angry that he disrespected the rules. But as Yanluoshi, when he was going to attack Shanghai, Hawk Moth gets worried about Adrien's safety and threatens him to stop or he'll remove his powers, Yanluoshi quickly eradicated him saying he takes orders from no one.

title: Mei Shi
text:
Mei Shi - Trivia
Mei Shi is the third non-human to be akumatized, with first being Markov in "Robostus", followed by the Dormant Sentimonster in "Feast".
Yanluoshi is the third akumatized villain who disobeyed Hawk Moth, following Gigantitan and Robostus.
He is also the first akumatized villain to temporarily cause Hawk Moth's demise, the second being Cat Blanc in an erased timeline.
Both deaths were later undone thanks to Ladybug's Miraculous Ladybug.
He is the second akumatized villain to cause the death of many, following Timebreaker and preceding Cat Blanc.
He is the first kwami-like creature to have two forms, using his statue form to guard the Prodigious when not in use and changes into his kwami-like form when it is in use watching over each chosen Renren.
The orb symbolizes that he is one of the only kwami/kwami-like creatures to not have a genderless profile as orbs were to represent male lions in Ancient China.
He is also the biggest of the akumatized villains.

title: Mei Shi
text:
Mei Shi - Trivia
Upon becoming akumatized, Mei Shi compares himself to Yama, the Buddhist god of death, the underworld and, as he himself puts it, the 'king of the infernal'. This comparison is also reflected when he's akumatized, for Yanluoshi, contains 'Yanluo', another name for Yama.
He is the first akumatized villain to see the damage they caused after they've been deakumatized.
There are a number of possibilities for what this character's name means:
Chinese phrases pronounced "meishi" (with varying tone markers) include: 沒事 "no problem / all right / nothing to do"; 美事 "good/beautiful/fine thing" or "laudable act / worthy deed"; 每事 "everything"; 美食 "delicious food / culinary delights".
One work by Qing Dynasty poet Mei Qing is titled Mei Shi Anthology (梅氏诗略), 梅 meaning "plum" or as in the poet's family name with 氏 "family / clan / lineage".
He's the fourth kwami-like creature who's based on a feline, following Plagg, Roaar and Hu Hu.
He's the second akumatized villain whose voice is pitched down compared to their normal one, after Stoneheart.
