title: Mega Leech
text:
Mega Leech - Intro
"" is a Season 4 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 10th written and produced episode of Season 4. It is also the 88th written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Mega Leech
text:
Mega Leech - Synopsis
Focused on her double life, Marinette has not realized how important Mylene’s commitment to the ecological cause is to her friend. A development project of the Place des Vosges square initiated by Mayor Bourgeois and against which Mylene fights opens her eyes. Marinette and her friends join forces with Mylene to save the trees of Place des Vosges. But when Mayor Bourgeois gets reakumatized into Malediktator and gets help from Sentimonster Mega Leech, Ladybug and Cat Noir will have to commit to save the Place des Vosges… and all of Paris!
Disney+
Our heroes and a new ally face Malediktator.
Netflix
Mylene avidly protests a proposed redevelopment, but Ladybug must intervene when an infuriated Mayor Bourgeois transforms into the evil Malediktator.

title: Mega Leech
text:
Mega Leech - Plot
The episode starts with Mylène who is afraid of protesting against the mayor, but Ivan tells her not to be afraid and supports her. Meanwhile Marinette who is in her bedroom, is woken up by the noises in the nearby park as Mayor Bourgeois announces that he is keeping his word about keeping Paris clean continuing on from "Reverser" by unveiling plans for Project Oxygen. He starts by saying that he is building a tower that can reduce pollution and produce filtered oxygen for Parisians. The construction of the building would replace the park of Place des Vosges, which prompts Ivan and Mylène to arrive at the Place des Vosges to protest against it. The mayor gets disturbed by Ivan and Mylène and order Roger to keep them away as they are protesting against him. Mylène and Ivan refuse to back down, and end up being escorted home by Officer Roger. Marinette witnesses this and asks Tikki if she should transform to help them out. Tikki replies that the police normally take care of bad guys and is then cut off by Tom calling for Marinette.
Marinette then notices she is getting late for school and immediately arrives in Collège Françoise Dupont.

title: Mega Leech
text:
Mega Leech - Plot
When she arrives in Miss Bustier's class, Miss Bustier questions her about Mylène and Ivan's whereabouts and is informed that they were protesting against the Mayor in the park and taken home by Roger.
Alya explains that Mylène and Ivan were trying to stop the Mayor's plan to destroy the park and replace it with artificial oxygen and a tower.
Miss Bustier tells the class she thinks Officer Roger made a big mistake, then calls him.
Picking up the call, Roger asks if there's a problem with Sabrina, and Miss Bustier says she has a problem with Ivan and Mylène being escorted by police home for protesting against the destruction of the park.
She requests that the two be driven back to the park and angrily hangs up to bring the whole class to the building site.
Along with Miss Bustier the whole class arrives at the Place des Vosges and protest against the mayor together by blocking the trees.
Mayor Bourgeois then tries to convince everyone it would result in less pollution on which Mylène replies the trees are a natural source of oxygen, and they shouldn't be replaced by artificial means.

title: Mega Leech
text:
Mega Leech - Plot
Mayor Bourgeois then shows the commercial for their oxygen project which features the Gabriel and Tsurugi brand.
After watching the commercial, everyone falls for it except Adrien.
He is confused because he was told by his father it was just an advertisement for Gabriel's next perfume.
Kim believes that's rehabilitating looks like, Nino, tells Mylène that there's nothing wrong with the project, and Rose that that Project Oxygen will make the city fresh.
Mylène tells everyone that the Mayor of Paris is showing these advertisements just to manipulate them, and just wants to make money out of it.
She says that while Project Oxygen seems great, it doesn't look good enough when they look closer at the details.
Marinette, then just to show everyone the mayor is actually wrong about the benefits of his project, explains to the mayor that Mylène and Ivan may have misunderstood and says that trees and fresh air is free, but the Mayor wants to replace the natural park with artificial oxygen taken from polluted air so it could be cleaned and sold in plastic bottles that will end up in landfills.
André replies that Marinette is right and panics when the crowd becomes astonished by his idea.

title: Mega Leech
text:
Mega Leech - Plot
Alya then spreads the message via her Ladyblog and tells her viewers that the park is being closed.
Miss Bustier then says that if Mylène and Ivan want to stop it then she is with them.
André attempts to get Roger to stop the students but Roger admits that he actually agrees with them.
Various civilians show up to join the protests and everyone gathers together to protect the trees.
Mayor Bourgeois is overwhelmed by reporters and is badgered by Nadja Chamack about the project.
Shadow Moth senses the anger and frustration of the Mayor, then akumatizes him into Malediktator once again with a sentimonster to assist via amokization, Mega Leech who can shrink and multiply.
Malekdiktator then jump into his sentimonster's stomach, Mega Leech, and commands it to make millions of clones of himself. Everyone attempts to flee but Mega Leech's Malediktator clones spread out and enter the eardrums of various civilians. Ivan takes a hit for Mylène and she fearfully escapes. Adrien hides behind a pillar nearby to transform.

title: Mega Leech
text:
Mega Leech - Plot
Marinette attempts to transform in an alley but is stopped by Mylène who suggests that they hide in the sewers. Marinette then makes an excuse that she can't hide in sewers because she is afraid of them. Mylène reveals that she is afraid of the dark, humidity, germs and even mice and was also scared of protesting against the mayor but she overcame them and found the courage to move on and accepts that it is a natural reflex. Mylène then gives her a badge that she always carries with her all the time in case she gets scared. Marinette accepts the badge and goes inside the sewers. Marinette acts like a mind controlled victim of Malediktator and scares Mylène off. Tikki appears and Marinette admits that she didn't have a choice then quickly transforms.

title: Mega Leech
text:
Mega Leech - Plot
Ladybug meets up with Cat Noir and immediately summons her Lucky Charm and gets an ice skate. The ice skate is then used to destroy the nearest clone's sash, releasing an akuma and amok. Ladybug was just about to use her Miraculous Ladybug but she is stopped by Cat Noir, who points out that Mega Leech and the Malediktator clones are still causing havoc. Ladybug then realizes when Malekdiktator used his sentimonster to clone himself, the Amok and Akuma might have multiplied too. Ladybug asks Cat Noir to distract the clones so she can buy some time. Cat Noir questions why he is always the one distracting others, but Ladybug leaves without saying anything.
In the Sewers, Mylène is crying and blaming herself for this problematic situation.
Ladybug consoles Mylène and reveals that she knows how to defeat Malediktator.
As she begins to give Mylène a Miraculous, Mylène stops her by admitting that she has so many fears and she isn't worthy because of them.
Ladybug then tells her that she has overcome many of those fears and all the badges she ever used are like the Miraculous and she fights every day to protect a cause without being noticed like having a secret identity.

title: Mega Leech
text:
Mega Leech - Plot
Additionally, Ladybug tells her that Mylène is already a superheroine and she just needs the last charm.
Mylène finally accepts the Mouse Miraculous and immediately Mullo frightens her, causing Mylène to cower behind Ladybug.
Ladybug tells Mullo that is not cool and tells Mylène that "true bravery is not the absence of fear, it is to continue even with fear".
Mylène finally transforms into Polymouse.
Polymouse then inquires about the plan to which Ladybug replies that she is going to take care of the sentimonster and Polymouse will take care of the clones.
As she came around the sewers end, she overcomes her fear and activates Multitude, her power.
Polymouse uses her power to multiply herself and the ice skate which Ladybug got via her lucky charm.
She then frees all of the people under the clones' control while Ladybug meets back up with Cat Noir, unaware that he also fell prey to Malediktator's control.
Polymouse quickly gets rid of the clone.
After all the civilians are freed from Malekdiktator's control Ladybug gathers the rest of the team, but excludes Rena Rouge, Viperion and King Monkey.

title: Mega Leech
text:
Mega Leech - Plot
Cat Noir, after seeing the team gathered he asks for them to wait for him to make a group pose.
Ladybug then tells Pegasus to teleport Vesperia over the sentimonster so she can paralyze it.
Vesperia leaps through the Voyage and appears above Mega Leech and stuns it with Venom.
Meanwhile Polymouse defeats the last of the clones.
Ladybug commands Ryuko to gather the akumas and amoks into a swarm to contain them.
Ryuko uses the wind dragon to create the swarm.
Ladybug then gestures for Carapace to use Shell-ter and together they defeat the sentimonster.
Polymouse after defeating the clones, ends her Multitude and gives back the ice skate.
Ladybug uses her Miraculous Ladybug to revert everything back and repair the damage caused by the supervillain.
Ladybug creates a Magical Charm for André.
Before leaving, Ladybug advises André to do what is right for Parisians and leave the Place des Vosges alone.
All the temporary heroes give back their Miraculouses to Ladybug.
Back in the sewers again, Ladybug arrives with Polymouse to take back the Miraculous from Mylène.
Before leaving, she tells her she was super brave today, and she should be super proud.

title: Mega Leech
text:
Mega Leech - Plot
Shadow Moth in his lair gives his usual revenge spiel. The mayor announces that after listening to the young Parisians, he is cancelling Project Oxygen. After all they are the future, and in future trees would continue to filter the fresh air. The Mayor announces that he is to plant a tree in the park. Marinette congratulates Ivan and Mylène on winning their protest. The Mayor struggles to plant the tree and the students offer to help. In the Agreste mansion, Adrien arrives back and is asked by Gabriel why he stood up against him at the protest. Adrien argues that he was just against the project his friends proved was bad for Paris and for the planet. Gabriel interrupts and orders him to go to his room. Adrien sadly obeys. Gabriel turns around and twists Émilie's ring on his finger before the end card appears.

title: Mega Leech
text:
Mega Leech - Plot Developments
It's revealed that Ivan sometimes calls Mylène "little mouse", which is a coincidence as Ladybug later gave her the Mouse Miraculous.
It is also revealed that Mylène calls Ivan "Teddy Bear".
It's revealed that Mylène's badges, pins, and pendant serve to help her overcome her many fears. She also is shown to do a special ritual before any big event (like a protest) to give herself courage to face her fears.
Her fears include the dark, humidity, germs, protesting, and ironically, mice.
Her Ladybug badge reminds her of her fear of water, while her panda badge reminds her of her fear of bees, and her pendant helps her get over her fear of badges.
It is revealed that Mylène and Ivan have been doing a protest against Project Oxygen for six months.
More insight about the Mouse Miraculous is revealed:
The holder of the Mouse Miraculous can summon the power of Multitude without using the skip rope.

title: Mega Leech
text:
Mega Leech - Plot Developments
On an interesting note when Marinette used Multitude in "Kwamibuster", despite her wearing the remaining Miraculouses weren't copied over to the other clones but when Polymouse used the power the Lucky Charm object duplicated with her it's unknown why, but there are speculations that the Miraculous can't be copied or duplicated but any other object can.
However, when Monarch used Multitude in "Miraculous Paris", the inactive Miraculouses were duplicated along with him. Also, in "Illusion" and "Deflagration", the Miraculouses reforged into rings were duplicated, and each of the copies were able to use Venon and Sublimation.
Meaning that the power is capable of multiplying objects (outside of the Miraculouses) as long as the user is holding or wearing them.
It's also unknown if there is a way to tell the difference between the original and the clones.

title: Mega Leech
text:
Mega Leech - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in Brazil on Gloob.
Despite Shadow Moth knowing the identities of Nino and Max, as well as Kagami, Ladybug still entrusts them with the Turtle, Horse, and Dragon Miraculous respectively as she needed their help to contain Mega Leech and the akumas and amoks it replicated.
This is the sixth episode where an akuma swarm appears, after "Ladybug & Cat Noir", "Stoneheart", "Catalyst", "Mayura" and "Ladybug".
This is the first episode where amoks are also in the swarm.
The thumbnail of the official trailer features Malediktator, making it the fourth one to have some other character other than the titular one on it, following "Ikari Gozen", "Félix", and "Ladybug".
This also makes Malediktator the fifth character to appear in more than one thumbnail, following Mayura, Lady Wifi, Princess Fragrance, and Reflekta, as he appears in the one for "Malediktator".
This is the third time André Bourgeois gets akumatized into Malediktator, following "Malediktator" and "Mayura" and including his akumatization into Heart Hunter, it's his fourth overall akumatization.

title: Mega Leech
text:
Mega Leech - Trivia
This is the fifth episode to be named after a sentimonster, the others being "Reflekdoll", "Félix", "Ladybug" and "Gabriel Agreste".
Mylène Haprèle receives the Mouse Miraculous in this episode to become the superheroine "Polymouse".
However, despite becoming a superhero in this episode, her superhero name is not mentioned, making her the seventh shown Miraculous holder who’s superhero name is not stated in the show, following Master Fu as both the holder of the Peacock and Turtle Miraculouses, Multimouse's unifications with the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses, Cat Noir's unification with the Cat and Snake Miraculouses, and Ladybug's unification with the Ladybug and Bee Miraculouses. Though, Mylène's superhero name is mentioned in the later episode "Penalteam".
Mylène is the second new Miraculous holder accompanied by several Miraculous holders (besides Ladybug and Cat Noir), followed by Kim in "Party Crasher"
This is one of the few episodes where Marinette isn't in the very first scene.
Mayor Bourgeois mentions a space dumpster program, as seen in "Reverser".

title: Mega Leech
text:
Mega Leech - Trivia
According to the project's commercial, Project Oxygen was a collaboration between the City Hall, Gabriel, and the Tsurugi brand.
This is the fourth time in Season 4 where Cat Noir transforms on-screen, following "Lies", "Psycomedian", and "Gabriel Agreste".
This is one of the few episodes where Cat Noir transforms on-screen and Ladybug doesn't.
Coincidentally, this also happens in the previous episode, "Gabriel Agreste".
This episode makes it the third highest superpower count at eight individuals (Shadow Moth having two Miraculous simultaneously), with "Strikeback" being the highest.
This is the third time when the Miraculous Ladybug superpower is stopped following "Reflekdoll" and "Oblivio".
Unlike in "Sapotis", where the original villains only had the akuma while the clones didn't the opposite happened where all the Malediktator clones had both akumas and amoks.
Like "Malediktator", Cat Noir ended up mind controlled and didn't fight Ladybug but only held her captive just to take her Miraculous.

title: Mega Leech
text:
Mega Leech - Trivia
This is the fourth time an akumatized object is destroyed by someone other than Ladybug and Cat Noir, following Rena Rouge, Carapace and Queen Bee in "Mayura", Fang in "Lies" and Marianne Lenoir in "Furious Fu".
This is the first time an akumatized object was destroyed by a superhero other than Ladybug and Cat Noir.
This is the second time a kwami scares its owner upon meeting them, after Marinette in "Ladybug & Cat Noir".
Unlike how it happened between Marinette and Tikki, where the latter scared the former unintentionally, Mullo scared Mylène on purpose.
This is the second time a holder rejects a Miraculous before it is given to them, following Marinette Dupain-Cheng in "Origins" and Zoé Lee in "Queen Banana".
This is the fourth time where someone else other than Ladybug uses her Lucky Charm following "Queen Wasp", "Reverser" and "Reflekdoll".
This is the 7th time in the series that someone kisses someone on the lips. Following "Oblivio", "Cat Blanc", "Dark Cupid", "Zombizou", "Chameleon", and "Horrificator".

title: Mega Leech
text:
Mega Leech - Trivia
This is the tenth time, Cataclysm isn't used followed by "The Mime", "Darkblade", "Syren", "Stormy Weather 2", "Félix", "Heart Hunter", "Lies", "Mr. Pigeon 72" and "Gabriel Agreste".
The way Marinette pushed Alya is similar to what she did with Kagami in "Mr. Pigeon 72".
This is the sixth time where Ladybug's Lucky Charm resembles an akumatized villain's object before it got akumatized following "Pixelator", "Reflekta", "Frightningale" "Sandboy", and "Miraculer".
This is one of the few episodes with obvious sociopolitical themes. It deals with corrupt businessmen destroying the environment, government collusion with corporations, cover-ups and downplaying of controversies by politicians, activism, and the disruption of protests by police.
In a way, the theme of this episode is similar to the Dr. Seuss story "The Lorax" and its 2012 film adaptation. Both feature young characters going against adults who cut down trees and sell oxygen.
Interestingly, the show was originally meant to be written for teens and would've featured more political themes.
This is the third time someone ends up inside a sentimonster following "Reflekdoll" and "Feast".

title: Mega Leech
text:

The scene where Ladybug and Cat Noir land on the ground and spin around as they prepare to face an akumatized villain is reused for the third time following "Stoneheart" and "Stormy Weather 2".

title: Mega Leech/Transcript
text:
Mega Leech/Transcript - Intro
[ Theme Song ]
Mylène: (places her hand on her badge) I'm not scared, I can do this. (places her hand on her chest) I'm not scared, I can do this. I'm not scared, I can do this. (inhales and exhales) I'm not scared, I can do this.
Mylène: Sorry, it took me so long, Teddy Bear.
Ivan: No worries, you were quicker than ever. You keep getting better and better at this. I love you, little mouse.
(They kiss each other.)
Mayor Bourgeois: Some time ago, during our Space Dumpster Program, I promised Parisians the end of pollution. And now I'm keeping that promise with Project Oxygen! (He indicates the Project Oxygen. The audience shots some photos.) (Marinette suddenly hears and looks at Mylène and Ivan protesting while holding the signboards at the corner.)

Mylène and Ivan: Stop Project Oxygen! Stop Project Oxygen! Stop-
Roger: Kids, uh, you need to leave now.

title: Mega Leech/Transcript
text:
Mega Leech/Transcript - Intro
Mylène: We can't, Officer. This is too important. They're planning to cut all these trees down.
Roger: Yeah, but ultimately, there'll be less pollution.
Mylène: (in anger) No, there won't! That's just what they want you to think.
Mayor Bourgeois: (from the distance) Roger! Your job is not to chit-chat with the troublemakers but to maintain order.
Roger: Come on, kids. Let's be reasonable.
Mylène and Ivan: (pauses for a while and continues to protest) Stop Project Oxygen! Stop Project Oxygen! (Roger sighs.)
Roger: (enters the car) Sorry, kids. I don't have a choice. I'm escorting you home to your parents. (starts to drive)
Marinette: Tikki, what should I do? Should I transform?

Tom: (voiceover) Marinette!

Miss Bustier: Marinette Dupain Cheng? (Marinette screams after opening the door and falls down)
Marinette: (raises her hand) Present. (goes to her seat)
Miss Bustier: Mylène Haprèle? (The entire class startled up when they didn't see Mylène.) Mylène?

title: Mega Leech/Transcript
text:
Mega Leech/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: She's not here. Officer Roger took her and Ivan home because, they were holding a sit-in and blocking a bulldozer.
Miss Bustier: What? (The class all gasp.)
Alya: (looks on her phone) Well, they must have been protesting the city's plan to rehabilitate Place des Vosges.
Kim: (gasps) (whispers to Max) What does rehabilitate mean?
Alya: (reads the news article) It says here, Project Oxygen will be a breath of fresh air for Paris.
Marinette: A breath of fresh air? It's weird that Mylène and Ivan would be against it.
Miss Bustier: (slams onto the desk) Regardless, Officer Roger has made a huge mistake. (calls Roger)
(Meanwhile in the police car, there is a call on Roger's phone and answers it.)
Roger: Miss Bustier, is there a problem with Sabrina?
Miss Bustier: No, your daughter is fine. However, there is a problem with Ivan and Mylène. They weren't doing anything wrong, were they?
Roger: Well, it's complicated. I'm escorting them home, just following orders.

title: Mega Leech/Transcript
text:
Mega Leech/Transcript - Intro
Miss Bustier: Well, I'm ordering you to bring them back to Place des Vosges. I'm coming to get them. (ends call) (to the entire class) Follow me, children. Today's class will be dedicated to civics education with real-life practical experience. (The class eagerly starts to line up in front except Alya who starts to record a video from her phone.)Alya: (on the video) Hey, Ladybloggers! Just because there aren't any supervillains attacking Paris right now doesn't mean there's nothing super going on. (shows Miss Bustier opening the door)'' We've never seen Miss Bustier so worked up, so get ready to see some action. Stay connected, peeps!
Hessenpy: The chainsaw is in good condition. (checking the chainsaw) It will be operated only by an adult who has read the instruction manual. (gives the chainsaw and a helmet to him) Everything's in order, you may proceed. (thumbs up)
(Mayor Bourgeois is about to cut down a tree when Miss Bustier speaks abruptly.)
Miss Bustier: Mr. Mayor, what are you doing?!
Mayor Bourgeois: I am rehabilitating the Place des Vosges square.
Miss Bustier: By cutting down a tree?!
Mayor Bourgeois: Yes, but, I- (Mylène and Ivan continues to protest.)

title: Mega Leech/Transcript
text:
Mega Leech/Transcript - Intro
Roger: Shh! Shh! Uhhh, Miss Bustier told me to do it.
Mayor Bourgeois: Who pays your salary, Roger?!
Roger: You do, Mr. Mayor. I, I mean, Paris City Hall does.
Mayor Bourgeois: You obey me! Take those troublemakers right back home!
(Roger is about to turn around to Mylène and Ivan when Miss Bustier stops him.)
Miss Bustier: Roger, don't do this!
Roger: (looks at the two, confused) Whose orders am I supposed to follow?
Mylène: Stop Project Oxygen!
Mayor Bourgeois: You see? I can't rehabilitate in peace. They're disrupting my ceremony.
Mylène: That's because your project is unethical and uneco-friendly!
Mayor Bourgeois: Nonsense! Look here! (clicks on the remote)
(They all gasp when they're about to see the commercial. The commercial starts with the Tsurugi brand and the Gabriel brand. Smoke is around caused by the cars and the factories belching.)

title: Mega Leech/Transcript
text:
Mega Leech/Transcript - Intro
Commercial: Because air is life, the city is teaming up with Paris's most significant investors. (The smoke slowly covers the sky, which the mom and her daughter felt hopeless. The Oxygen Tower releases the breeze of fresh air.) To transform pollution into pure fresh air, that will then be sold in unique container designed by fashion mogul, Gabriel Agreste. (Adrien is floating over the clouds spraying some fresh air around him.)
Adrien: Oxygen isn't just a breath of fresh air. It's life itself. (sprays the entire screen)
Commercial: Oxygen! Get a whiff of life. (It ends with the Oxygen Tower with Adrien and the Oxygen Tower.)
Marinette: (lovestruck) He is so beautif- (Alya points out Marinette to Adrien.) Oh, I meant, it… is so beautiful, your commitment… to save the planet.
Adrien: Father told me it was an ad for a new cologne.
Kim: So that's rehabilitating? It actually looks kinda cool.
Nino: Yeah, what's not ecological about it, Mylène?
Rose: It's super eco-friendly, it'll de-pollute the air in Paris and make it fresh! (spins around frantically)

title: Mega Leech/Transcript
text:
Mega Leech/Transcript - Intro
Mylène: (sighs disappointedly) You're letting yourselves be fooled by pretty pictures shown like that. Project Oxygen seems great, but when you look closer at the details, it just doesn't hold up. In reality, they're cutting down (indicates the trees around them) our best natural filters, trees. (indicates the Oxygen Tower) And replacing them with artificial filters, their tower, and making us pay for all of it. (turns to Mayor Bourgeois) Mr. Mayor, instead of destroying all these trees, wouldn't it be better to build more parks?
Mayor Bourgeois: Well-
Chloé: (interrupts) Who cares about a lame ugly tree when you can have a gorgeous designer container from Adrikins' daddy, Gabriel Agreste instead? (Adrien looks down) Besides, there'll be a tree on the label, much prettier than the real thing.
Mayor Bourgeois: And the floor in the tower will be built with recycled wood from the trees we cut down. Very eco-friendly.
Chloé: And real trees have to be watered. Talk about wasting water! (Mylène starts to get scared when Marinette puts an arm on her shoulder.)

title: Mega Leech/Transcript
text:
Mega Leech/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Mayor Bourgeois, perhaps Mylène and Ivan have misunderstood your project. Do you really want to take away the trees, a natural and cost-free air filter, and replace them with a tower that will absorb polluted air? So that afterwards, you can clean the air and sell it back in plastic bottles. The same bottles which will become trash and pollute our oceans?
Mayor Bourgeois: Yes, that’s it. (All of them gasp; Marinette smirks.)  Uh, I mean, no. Of course not! It’s not that simple. Ecology is complicated, especially for children your age. Leave these things to the adults.
(Alya continues to film and faces the camera on Mayor Bourgeois)
Alya: So actually, your project is all about cutting down our trees and closing our favorite park. (faces the camera on Miss Bustier)
Miss Bustier: And if Mylène and Ivan are trying to stop this, then we are on their side.
Marinette: It’s true. The Mayor’s solution for fighting pollution is misguided.

title: Mega Leech/Transcript
text:
Mega Leech/Transcript - Intro
Mylène: Like so many other so-called miracle solutions that are supposed to deal with ecological problems, the thing is there’s never just one simple solution that can fix everything. What we need are lots of small solutions that can tackle the problem all at the same time. That’s why there has to be a lot of us all working together.
Marinette: Good thing you and Ivan got involved to stop this, but why didn’t you guys tell us about it? The whole class would have come with you. (Ivan comes to Mylène, both looking sad and disappointed.)
Mylène: We did, Marinette. (shows the flashbacks of them protesting while schoolmates are having a conversation outside the school, Max and Kim are carrying their lunch, and Alix is listening with her headphones) We've been demonstrating against Project Oxygen for the past six months and we did everything we could to get your attention.
Marinette: We're so sorry. We were just so busy doing... I don't know what it was we were doing.
Rose: We're so lame.
Mayor Bourgeois: This is all very touching but I've got a project to launch.

title: Mega Leech/Transcript
text:

title: Mega Leech/Transcript

title: Mega Leech/Transcript
text:
Mega Leech/Transcript - Intro
Shadow Moth: A powerful man rendered powerless. His plans disappear into thin air. This calls for the strongest of actions. (pulls out a feather and creates an amok and creates an akuma) Amok, akuma, go forth and evilize our dear Mayor. (the akuma and amok flies out)

title: Mega Leech (sentimonster)
text:
Mega Leech (sentimonster) - Intro
Mega Leech was the titular main antagonist of the episode "Mega Leech". It was a giant grub worm-like sentimonster created by Shadow Moth for Malediktator from his stress and anger over the citizens of Paris protesting his construction project. It was immobilized by Vesperia's Venom and defeated by Ladybug's de-evilization process.

title: Mega Leech (sentimonster)
text:
Mega Leech (sentimonster) - Appearance
Mega Leech was a large floating round blob-like grub worm sentimonster. Its body was colored shaded blue and it had multiple red eyes of varying sizes across its body, except on its belly. The red eyes had purple-white sclera followed by a purple skin outline, resembling Malediktator's sash. It also had a large, open mouth with swollen dark blue lips.

title: Mega Leech (sentimonster)
text:
Mega Leech (sentimonster) - Abilities
Mega Leech could multiply anyone who entered its mouth into tiny clones who were able to enter people's ears and take control of them via a tiny podium inside of their brain. Once inside someone's head, these small beings could see though the person's eyes, talk through the person's mouth, and act through the person's body. When cloning an akumatized and amokized supervillain, Mega Leech could also duplicate the Akuma and Amok they were holding.
Mega Leech was also able to float in the air. However, it is unknown if it could control how it flew.

title: Mega Leech (sentimonster)
text:
Mega Leech (sentimonster) - Trivia
This was the second sentimonster to be immobilized, the first being Banana Boom-Boom.
Mega Leech was the third sentimonster based on an animal, after the Butterfly Sentimonster and Banana Boom-Boom.
Mega Leech's ability to replicate seemed to be very similar to Multitude, the superpower of the Mouse Miraculous, as it divided and cloned one person.
Differences for Multitude is that, if an Akumatized object is duplicated with the user, only one needs to be broken, damaged, or destroyed in order to release the Akuma. One clone will be deakumatized and return to their normal self, while the rest of the clones will disappear. While Mega Leech, all the Amoks must be purified before the sentimonster can disappear.

title: Migration
text:
Migration - Intro
"" is a season 5 episode of the series Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. Based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 13th written and produced episode of season 5. It is also the 117th written and produced episode of the series overall.

title: Migration
text:
Migration - Synopsis
There are many sides to Luka. Sure, he's Juleka's twin brother, but he's also like a big brother to his friends, including Marinette and Adrien. They both like to seek his advice, as Luka always has an inspiring quote to give them. Lastly, Luka is the guitarist of the band Kitty Section, and the son of a celebrity. And this side of Luka's will pique the interest of label owner Bob Roth, who's ready for anything to make money! But Bob Roth underestimates Luka, who's ready for anything to defend his values and his friends.
Disney+
Luka piques special interest in Bob Roth.
Netflix
As a sympathetic ear to Marinette and Adrien, Luka has information precious to Monarch – but when Luka resists akumatization, Monarch finds another mark.

title: Migration
text:
Migration - Plot
The episode starts off with Marinette rushing to the Couffaine houseboat Liberty, where she awkwardly greets all of her friends. She then rushes off to Luka, stuttering over her words, and then finally says that she needs to talk about the new stickers that she designed for Kitty Section. Luka then smiles at her, and creates an excuse to allow him to talk to Marinette in private. Then, while the two are in Luka's room Marinette starts talking about her problems; she admits that she struggles to find the right words when she's with Adrien, but also struggles with herself. Marinette pauses for a moment and then covers her face with her hands, stating that she's the worst because she is talking about her love life to Luka when she broke his heart. But Luka then proceeds to look down at his guitar, and then kindly reassures Marinette. The conversation ends with him saying "You know where to find me".

title: Migration
text:
Migration - Plot
While Marinette is leaving the room, she sees Adrien, holding a keyboard, walking towards her. As they both greet each other, she attempts to walk past him, but ends up being stuck in between Adrien's Keyboard, and the wall. For a brief moment, the camera changes to Luka's perspective, but Marinette and Adrien quickly fade into the costumes of Ladybug and Cat Noir; reminding the audience that Luka knows the superheroes secret identities. After Adrien tries talking to Marinette, Marinette hurriedly runs away, still feeling "unsafe" around Adrien. Adrien then enters the room, stuttering over his words, just to say that he believes his keyboard is faulty. Luka smiles, and then the scene changes to a similar scene from earlier, except this time Adrien is sat opposite Luka, in Marinette's place. Adrien starts by thanking Luka; because of him, he found his "inner tune" and his love for Marinette, but he was scared that Marinette still couldn't find hers. Luka then reassures Adrien, and the conversation ends with him saying "You know where to find me".

title: Migration
text:
Migration - Plot
Out of nowhere, the window behind Luka pops open, with Jagged Stone behind it! Jagged Stone stutters over his words, and then finally states that he has a "super important question about um this guitar pick". Luka smiles and then the scene changes to a similar scene from earlier, Luka is on the bed, and his father is sat opposite him. Jagged Stone then admits that he wants to become a better father, but he has no clue how to. Luka then reassures him, saying that all he needs to do is spend time with his family. The conversation then ends with Luka saying "You know where to find me, Dad". (do you see a pattern)

title: Migration
text:
Migration - Plot
A familiar voice starts shouting Jagged's name. Luka's father then proceeds to exit through the window, after realising that Penny was looking for him. Penny then enters the room, in a rush, stating that she needs to find jagged because Bob Roth wants him to be recording for a new album. Luka then smiles, and the scene changes to the two sitting on the bed, facing each other. Penny then admits that she is in love with Luka's father, but she has no clue why. She then states a long list of childish things about Jagged, and why "he's a walking disaster". Luka then reassures her, saying that love is always unexplainable, and that's probably why she's confused. But when Luka is about to say "you know where to find me", Bob Roth interrupts him and starts shouting at Penny, bombarding her with questions regarding Jagged's whereabouts. Penny then admits that she is looking for Jagged, and she expected to find him with his son. Amazed by the fact that Jagged Stone has a son, Bob Roth walks towards Luka, laughing at the fact that "only a fool" would have a kid with that "good for nothing".

title: Migration
text:
Migration - Plot
Unexpectedly, Anarka appears behind Bob, saying that the "fool" would be her. Angrily, she stated that Bob had boarded her ship without permission, and the setting suddenly changes to a cartoonish scene where Bob Roth is thrown off of the boat into the Seine, whilst wearing a duck floatie. The scene quickly changes, and the band Kitty Section start rehearsing one of their many songs, but now the focus is drawn towards Luka entering the surface of the boat, the former then proceeds to look at Adrien and Marinette, who are sitting by themselves, separate from the group. Like the scene from earlier, Marinette and Adrien slowly fade into the costumes of Ladybug and Cat Noir, again reminding the audience that Luka knows the identities of Paris' beloved superheroes.

title: Migration
text:
Migration - Plot
Out of nowhere, Bob Roth appears on the edge of the boat, and he, unexpectedly starts clapping at Kitty Section's performance, and then offers the group to sign a contract with him. The group suddenly pauses, but then Luka bravely speaks up, stating that Bob Roth had already offered them a contract, but he never went through with the deal. Unconvincingly, Bob tries to say that he never forgot about the deal and that he was just waiting for the right time, but before he can finish, Anarka comes and throws him off of the boat, with the same scene from earlier. Luka then confronts his mother, kindly saying that she should try to give him a chance.

title: Migration
text:
Migration - Plot
Moments later, Bob Roth walks back on board the ship, agreeing with Luka, on how "everyone deserves a chance", and "anyone can change". To prove his point, he admits that he wasn't very honest in the past, but now he has changed and wants to sign a real contract with the group. He starts to rant about how this new contract will "fill their pockets", and "protect them no matter what". Out of excitement, the members of the band start happily squealing about how they are to have their first album with a record company. The scene quickly changes to a short montage of each band member happily signing the contracts, until Bob Roth interrupts them and says "You're all fired except for Jagged Junior" while putting on a diving suit. In confusion, Luka stated that he would never work for both without his friends and that he can't force him to do his work.

title: Migration
text:
Migration - Plot
With a cheeky smile, Bob replies saying that he obviously can, and that's what the contracts were for. Without a moment to pass, each member of the band stares at their contracts, as each of them gasps in unison. Without a care in the world about what is going to happen next, Bob starts to tease and mock the group, and the former says that "they should've listened to the old pirate", and "never should've signed". He then proceeds to put his swimming goggles over his eyes, and puts his thumbs up, signaling to Anarka that he's ready to get thrown off the boat. The cartoonish scene from earlier then appears, proceeded by the group reading over the contract, and realizing what they had just done. The scene quickly zooms into Luka, who is quickly reading over the contract, and he proceeds to admit that everything is his fault.

title: Migration
text:

In Monarch's lair, with Monarch evilizing a megakuma to send to Luka. The scene changes to Luka, almost getting akumatized via his guitar. To avoid the akumatization, Luka immediately tried to resist, only to destroy his guitar to completely resist. Out of confusion on why he was resisting so strongly, Monarch soon finds out that Luka knows the secret identities of Ladybug and Cat Noir. Luka tells all his friends to hide below deck, except Marinette, whom he tells to hide in the cabin. Marinette transforms into Ladybug. Gold Record then also sends Anarka's record to space.

title: Migration
text:

Now below deck Adrien starts worrying about Marinette and whether she's been captured. Luka tells Adrien that he can't help Marinette, but Cat Noir can, heavily implying he knows Cat Noir's identity and proceeds to place Adrien in the closet to hide. Gold Record teleports below deck and attempts once again to hit Luka with his record but this time Juleka jumps in the way and thus was transformed into a record and starts to sing. All the teens stare in awe as she sings, but Gold record still sends her to space. The villain almost hits Luka with the record but he was pulled out of the way by Ladybug.
Cat Noir falls out of the closet and Gold Record takes another throw at Luka but hit a rubber duck toy, which transformed and Gold Record sends it to his record wall. Gold Record then proceeds to chase Cat Noir around Paris via teleportation and continuously tries to hit him with his record. He hits a pigeon with the record then continues to pursue Cat Noir.

title: Migration
text:
Migration - Plot
Ladybug and Luka are under a bridge and as she uses her Lucky Charm, and asks Luka if he's willing to risk himself to defeat the supervillain. Luka obliges, but also warns Ladybug that if he's caught he'll reveal everything. She brushes off his concern and Luka then proceeds to call Ladybug "Marinette" but she fails to notice until he calls her "Marinette" a second time, much to her shock and horror. She asks if he knows Cat Noir's identity too, then realizes the full risk, but moves forward with the plan regardless.
Luka begins playing guitar on the Eiffel Tower, drawing Gold Record's attention. Ladybug messages Cat Noir not to intervene as it's "part of the plan". Gold Record teleports behind Luka, and finally strikes his initial target, who transforms into a record and begins to sing. Ladybug uses her pencil lucky charm along with a make-shift miniature bow and shoots Gold Record's record out of the his hand and directly toward Cat Noir, who then cataclysms the record just before Luka's song reveals their identities. Ladybug purifies the megakuma and uses her Miraculous Ladybug, returning everything to how it was.

title: Migration
text:

At Liberty, where Ladybug attempts to give Bob his magical charm, but he takes the contract papers for Cat Noir who recovered them after he call the magical charm "a trinket" as he drops it, refuse to take it. Bob proceeds to try to take advantage of "Jagged Jr" so that he can make lots of money and attempts to use Ladybug and Cat Noir to protect him from Anarka. The two superheroes leaves and Anarka throws Bob off the boat once more.

title: Migration
text:
Migration - Plot
Back in Monarch's lair, where he declares he'll get Luka to reveal the heroes' identities then shifts back to the boat, where Luka rips up the contracts. He then tells the Kitty Section group that he cannot stay in Paris because he knows Ladybug's and Cat Noir's identity, Marinette and Adrien try to reassure him that Ladybug and Cat Noir will keep him safe, but to no avail. He tells the group not to worry about Kitty Section because his sister, Juleka is so talented. Anarka tells Luka he can't leave without an adult, then Jagged jumps in and says that he will go with Luka. Anarka doesn't believe Jagged is willing to give up all his fame for his son, Jagged tells her that he already has and that he tore up his contracts. He asks for a chance to be a real father to his son and Penny offers to help Luka with his schoolwork. Anarka agrees to let Luka leave.

title: Migration
text:
Migration - Plot Development
The episode shares its name with the concept of the Horse Miraculous.
The episode reveals how the power of Voyage is used for attacking, by allowing the user to appear from anywhere they can fight and attack from anywhere. Then, once that's done enough times the opponent will be totally exhausted.
Voyage also has one more weakness before the portal opens and something or someone can go through it gives off a sound that can alert someone to their allies or enemies' location.
Luka is shown to have become a major confident to many characters like Marinette, Adrien, Jagged and Penny, who ask him for his wise advice that are able to calm their hearts and clear any doubt they are having.
Marinette and Adrien find out that Luka knows their secret identities, which he learned in "Wishmaker".
Similar to Rena in "Strikeback", despite Luka not knowing the identities of his other allies along with Ladybug and Cat Noir (except for Alix, Kim, Sabrina, Max and Kagami) they all know that he knows he's been hiding the secret of Ladybug's and Cat Noir's identities.

title: Migration
text:
Migration - Plot Development
This episode sets yet another consequence from the events of "Miracle Queen", as Hawk Moth/Monarch knew that Luka was the current Snake Miraculous holder as Viperion, and is fully aware of Second Chance (as revealed in "Party Crasher"), so it's possible Monarch guessed that Luka knew Ladybug and Cat Noir's identities from the erased alternative timelines from "Wishmaker".
Following from the events of "Sentibubbler", this episode is the second time where a team member is put in danger because of Chloé's actions.
Ironically, the same thing would've happen to Chloé as she too would have to leave Paris (along on with the Bee Miraculous) on the notion that her identity was exposed or if she made her mind to stay then someone else would have to the power in her place.

title: Migration
text:
Migration - Trivia
Besides the use of its power, Voyage, there are some characters going on a migration, with that ones being Luka, Jagged and Penny who left Paris after Monarch realizes the former knows Ladybug and Cat Noir's identities.
The concept of migration was also applied in a few other episodes and people:
In "Feast", Master Fu migrated to avoid detection and then with his lover to London after he surrendered his title.
With Zoé moving from New York to Paris to be with her family in "Sole Crusher".
How the kwamis, their miraculouses and guardians migrated all over the world to protect it from crisis.
When it came Gabriel akumatizing different victims in various episodes.
Before Jagged gave up his music career he traveled all over the world for it.
For the ways of love for various people:
In "Animan", Nino had a crush on Marinette before he migrated to his true love with Alya.
In "Dark Cupid", Kim had a crush on Chloé, then he moved to Ondine in "Syren".
From "Evilustrator", Nathaniel had a crush on Marinette, then to Ladybug and Marc.

title: Migration
text:
Migration - Trivia
Like how Marinette's first crush was Kim in "Derision", she moved onto Adrien, then Luka and then Cat Noir just to get back to Adrien unknown to her that both boys are the same person.
And the same for Adrien as he started his love advances for Ladybug, then moved onto Kagami and then to Marinette just to arrive at the same situation as her.
The Horse Miraculous reminds people to be quick on your feet as well as your mind, think about others when in those situations (knowing when to run and when you can't), how quickly things can change and be aware that the fastest way isn't always the best.
Max Kante as the current Horse Miraculous holder, Pegasus and with Voyage, he's the fastest of Team Miraculous as well as with his mind in calculations and numbers.
In "Pixelator", such as Marinette took a shortcut to do her task but it backfired.
Ladybug is the fastest when dealing with akumatized villains, sentimonsters and plans on the battlefield.
Marinette when she tried to run from her feelings out of fear of her or someone she cares about getting hurt again.

title: Migration
text:
Migration - Trivia
When Ladybug's problem piled up she ran away from Cat Noir out of fear for him but realized she should've ran to him and yet, she mentally understood and accepted things a lot faster than him.
Gabriel obsessively believed that the Miraculouses and the wish were quickest way to deal with his problems but he forgot that it was using them the way he did he ended up right back where he started.
He and Colt using the Peacock Miraculous to create their families despite being the fastest it was also the most dangerous aside from the jewel being damaged they should have been aware of other considerations that could've gone wrong as well as ran away in fear of everyone knowing the truth and unable to control the outcome.
When doing things in a haste or assumptions people end up making serious mistakes that follow the problem spiraling out of control which was seen in various episodes.
"Prime Queen", when it came to rescuing Chloé, Cat Noir easily accepted that Prime Queen's methods was the fastest as the duo didn't have all night to search the Metro Station system for Chloé.

title: Migration
text:
Migration - Trivia
Such as Ladybug and Cat Noir when they faced Hawk Moth they knew they couldn't run if it meant leaving everyone else behind nor he or those akumatized were going to hunt them down no matter where they went which was confirmed true in the "Last Day".
Master Fu tried to run away from his sentimonster and his mistake but soon realized it was pointless to do so and he had to face it.
Félix as he took the Peacock Miraculous and fled leaving the heroes and the people of Paris to deal with the consequences and also by extension made Duusu leave the rest of his kwami family behind.
By Colt, Chloé, Gabriel and Lila, because of their actions they continued to run away or be in denial from the consequences they created until it caught with them to the point where they had nowhere to go.
In "Daddycop", Sabrina has a fastest record time in rejecting an ultrakuma with 9 seconds.
Like a horse and many other creatures including humans one of their abilities is speed but sometimes it won't mean anything if they can't move, don't know where they're going, but even if they run some might not be able to stop at least without help or become lost once they do in more ways than one.

title: Migration
text:
Migration - Trivia
"Miraculous Shanghai", Marinette ended up physical lost in Shanghai.
Such as Marinette in "Crocoduel", where she figured Alya's plan to get her to talk to Luka.
From "Wishmaker", where she and Adrien were indecisive about their futures.
Gabriel was emotional lost without Emilie.
In "Ephemeral", when Pegasus couldn't go through the voyage power.
In "Deflagration", as Marinette found Alya paralyzed in a small space.
It's revealed that Jagged and Penny are dating.
This confirms that Jagged cheated on Anarka, which is probably why he left her family and Luka.
This is the second time Bob Roth gets akumatized, following "Ephemeral". This time however he gets akumatized into a new form, Gold Record.
Bob Roth is the second character to have refused a Magical Charm from Ladybug. The first was Chloé in "Queen Banana", and Kagami became the third in "Protection".
When he said, "Again" and that "the Magical Charm didn't work", could imply that Bob was akumatized back in "Ephemeral" and saw for himself the Magical Charm didn't work.
Luka is the second member of the French Miraculous superhero team that had to be sent away to protect the team following Alix in "Evolution".

title: Migration
text:
Migration - Trivia
Marinette voiced having Ladybug and Cat Noir willingly protect Luka, is callback to "Reunion".
It is revealed that Penny found out that Jagged has two children offscreen.
Luka is the second akumatized victim to break his akumatized object by himself, following Penalty in "Penalteam".
However, he broke his before he was fully transformed, while Penalty did so when she was already akumatized.
The way Luka and the others signed Bob's contract without reading it is similar to how all of Monarch's victims agreed to his deal without knowing what they were getting into.
Bob Roth says "I'll make his (Luka's) little friends' lives hell", marking one of the few times profanity is used in the show.
However, some broadcasters instead replaced the line with "a living nightmare".
At the endcard of the episode, Luka is shown in pictures describing places where he, Jagged and Penny are or are passing through. One of those pictures show a place called Pico da Neblina, the highest peak in Brazil above the sea level, located at the state of Amazonas. This means that Luka may be or may have passed through Brazil.

title: Migration
text:
Migration - Trivia
This is Bob Roth's Last appearance in Season 5 as he never appeared after this episode for the rest of the season.
This episode marks the second time that Gabriel isn't featured in a Season 5 episode, after "Determination", and followed by "Derision".
References
Luka is the fifth character to not get fully akumatized after being infected by an Akuma, following Chloé in "Miraculer", Marinette in "Ladybug", "Elation" and "Derision", Sabine in "Ladybug" and Félix in "Gabriel Agreste".
He is almost akumatized into his first akumatized identity Silencer. If Monarch had managed to successfully do so, it would have been the second time Luka would have turned into Silencer.
Not counting episodes which don't have end cards, this is the third episode to have an end card in which Marinette and Adrien don't appear, following "The Collector" and "Malediktator".
These three, alongside "Félix" and "Multiplication" are the only ones in which Marinette doesn't appear.
It's later followed by "Intuition".
It's and the one of "Malediktator" are also the only ones out of the four to not feature Gabriel in any way.

title: Migration
text:
Migration - Trivia
This is the fourth time Monarch is listening for targets, after "Risk", "Jubilation" and "Transmission".
This episode bears resemblances to many episodes:
From "Crocoduel", the akumatized object was a record disc but unlike the former episode this one was comprised of multiple pieces combined into one and yet both records were destroyed the same way: Cat Noir's Cataclysm.
Then, in "Captain Hardrock", the scene where Luka and Marinette first met is reused.
Similar to "Silencer", both akumatizations were caused by Bob Roth.
Like Chloé in "Miracle Queen", Bob Roth teamed with Monarch out of selfish actions that allowed Gabriel to take advantage of the situation resulting in both Master Fu renouncing his title as Guardian and his memories to protect Ladybug, Cat Noir, and the Miraculous as well as Luka moving out of Paris to keep the duo safe.
However unlike Alix in "Evolution", Luka's whole family and friends knew about his departure, and shared a hug before he left.
Bob also repeated Ladybug's, "Here kitty kitty" line from "Reverser".
This is the third time that a portal destination created by Voyage has been in space, following "Miracle Queen" and "Strikeback".

title: Migration
text:
Migration - Trivia
This is the fourth time Marinette kisses Luka on the cheek, after "Frozer", "Heart Hunter" and "Miraculous New York".
This is the fifth time a character sings outside of a performance or recording, following "Princess Fragrance", "Befana", "Santa Claws" and "Deflagration".
Anarka, Juleka and Luka sing for the first time.
Luka ripping up Bob's contract is similar to how he rips Harry's script from "Psycomedian".
This is the third episode someone gets akumatized when something is ripped after "Reverser" and "Psycomedian".
This is the third time Tikki doesn't make an appearance, following "Gabriel Agreste" and "Guiltrip".
This is the fifth episode of seasons 4 and 5 not to have a polka-dotted pattern on its end card, following "Rocketear", "Penalteam", "Determination", and "Reunion".
When sensing Luka's despair, Monarch remarks another person is suffering due to Bob Roth's greed, likely referencing "Silencer", "Mr. Pigeon 72", "Psycomedian", and "Queen Banana".
Allusions
The episode refers to famous late rockstar David Bowie's song "Rebel Rebel" and several famous album covers, such as Nirvana's Nevermind.
Rose's song sounds similar to Toto's "Rosanna".

title: Migration
text:
Migration - Trivia
Gold Record says "In space, no one will hear you sing", which is a reference to the tagline of the film Alien. A similar reference was made by Mr. Pigeon in "Miraculous New York" and Monarch in "Intuition".
Errors
Much like in "Truth", Luka's skin tone and hair colour fluctuate greatly throughout the episode.
When Marinette first arrives on the Liberty, Juleka's hair is slightly deformed.
Marc's model quickly slides into the scene when Bob Roth appears on the boat the third time.
While Marinette is talking to Luka, Marinette's torso is deformed in one shot.
When Luka is talking with Adrien in his room, Luka's neck is deformed in one shot.
When Monarch taps the Horse Miraculous ring to transfer its power to Gold Record, it glows orange instead of brown.
Adrien and Luka somehow know Gold Record's name even if he didn't say it.
When Cat Noir is done talking to Ladybug on his staff, the screen disappears instantly instead of sliding closed.
Monarch mispronounces "hook" in his closing monologue, making it rhyme with "fluke".
When Monarch is akumatizing Luka, the screen gets darker for no reason.
When Bob complains at Luka for ripping up his contract, his alliance is missing.

title: Migration/Transcript
text:
Migration/Transcript - Intro
[ Theme Song ]
Nino: Why is she running like that? She's not late.
Alya: Creature of habit. (everyone laughs)
Marinette: Hi, hello, hey there!
Everyone: Hi Marinette!
Marinette: (starts walking to everyone and greets them one by one) Hi, Rose! Hi, Ivan! Hey, Juleka, Anarka! Luka— I was looking for you! (laughs nervously) I— I wanted to talk to you about... (rubs her hair) about... the new Kitty Section stickers! See, uh, the thing is, I put the logo of Bob Roth's record company on them, seeing as he promised you the record contract and all, but (giggles) since the deal never came through, uhm, I was wondering if we should keep them, throw them away, or—
Luka: You sure that's really what you wanna talk to me about?
Marinette: (blushes and says) Weeeell...
Luka: (to everyone) I forgot to grab my capo and picks. I'll be right back. (walks away with Marinette)

title: Migration/Transcript
text:
Migration/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: There's a problem with me, but... I don't know what it is. As you know, there are things I can't tell Adrien, but it turns out, there are also things I can't even tell myself. And if I can't tell myself, how am I supposed to tell Adrien? (pauses) Oh, no! I'm the worst! It's so selfish of me talking to you about my love life when I broke your heart! I'm so terrible! I don't know how you even could've fallen in love with someone like me, or anyone could have!
Luka: (starts to play a ballad on his guitar) You didn't break my heart, Marinette. You enriched it with new songs. Ones that are sometimes cheerful, and sometimes sad. The only thing that breaks my heart is seeing such a miraculous buddy be so hard on herself.
Marinette: So, you're saying that... I'm not cruel... or pathetic? Oh, thank you, Luka! (hugs Luka) I feel so much better! I don't know what I'd do without you! (kisses Luka on the cheek)
Luka: If you need me, you know where to find me.
(Marinette and Luka walk toward the stairs.)
Marinette: Thanks, Luka...
(As both proceed to leave the room, Marinette spots Adrien coming down the stairs with his "damaged" keyboard piano, which leaves Marinette panicking...)

title: Migration/Transcript
text:
Migration/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: WAHH!
Adrien: Hel-lo there, Marinette!
Marinette: (stutters) H-Hey, Adrien! What a surprise! (attempts to push Adrien's piano out of the way) We're stuck. (laughs awkwardly) How silly being stuck! We should try to loosen up!
(In Luka's point of view, he sees Adrien and Marinette as Cat Noir and Ladybug, respectively.)
Adrien: It's ok to be stuck sometimes, (holds Marinette's hand) I can help you—
Marinette: (blushes upon contact of Adrien's hand on hers) Loosen up? Nah, no, no no, no, no, no, no. It's okay. I can do it myself! (runs away, flustered)
Adrien: (continues to go down the stairs) Luka! I was looking for you. Uh, something's wrong with my keyboard: one of the keys is acting weird. (presses one of the "broken" keys)
Luka: You sure that's what you really want to talk to me about?
(Back in Luka's room, Adrien now sits with Luka.)
Adrien: Thanks to you, Luka, I can finally hear my inner tune and I heard my love for Marinette. But I feel like Marinette still can't hear hers, or maybe she just can't find a way to express it. It's like there's something inside that she... can't get out, like a secret side that wants to remain hidden.
Luka: And that scares you?

title: Migration/Transcript
text:
Migration/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: What scares me is that this might be making her feel upset and... I wonder also if you could love someone fully when you don't know them completely.
Luka: You know, I'm not always the same person when I'm with you or Marinette, or when I'm with the gang, my mom, my sister or my father. Which Luka's the real one? All of them, I guess? So you don't know me completely, either. And yet, we're still close friends, right?
Adrien: (hugs Luka) I don't know what I'd do without you!
Luka: (gives back the keyboard to Adrien) Looks fine to me.
Adrien: Thank you Luka! (grabs his keyboard and walks out the room)
Luka: You know where to find me!
Jagged Stone: (appears from the window behind Luka) Hey, son! I, uh, have a super important question for you about, uh... (tries to find an excuse) this guitar pick!
Luka: You sure that's what you really want to talk to me about, Dad?
(Cuts to Luka and Jagged Stone sitting down on Luka's bed.)

title: Migration/Transcript
text:
Migration/Transcript - Intro
Jagged Stone: Actually, I'm wondering how I could become a better father. What can I do for my kids and that kind of stuff, you know? Should I take you on a trip? To a theme park? I can't even write you songs 'cause the ones you're doing with Kitty Section are better than mine.
Luka: (plays a slow-rock riff on his guitar) You could just spend time with us.
Jagged Stone: But I can't stay here, son, 'cause, you know, it's not like I'm getting back together with your mom. And besides, things have been really cool with Penny.
Luka: No one expects you to get back together with Mom, least of all, her. But that doesn't mean you can't come here whenever you want to see us.
Jagged Stone: Okay, son. I don't know what I'd do without you.
Luka: You know where to find me, Dad.
Penny: (off-screen) Jagged?!
Jagged Stone: Uh-oh, sounds like Penny knows where to find me. (sneaks out the window where he came in) I'm supposed to be working at the studio!
Penny: Luka! Have you seen your dad? We've been looking for him everywhere, he needs to be recording new songs right now, and Bob won't get off my back and—
Luka: You... sure that's what you really want to talk to me about?

title: Migration/Transcript
text:
Migration/Transcript - Intro
Cuts to Luka and Penny sitting down on Luka's bed.)
Penny: No, I don't know why I'm in love with your father. He's disorganized, childish, selfish, and musically speaking, he's no David Bowie. Truth be told, your dad's a walking disaster. So why do I love him?
Luka: Hmm. (plays an upbeat riff on the guitar) Does he make you happy, Penny?
Penny: Yeah. I just can't figure out why!
Luka: That's actually how you know it's love. It's there, but you can't explain it.
Penny: You're right. Thanks, Luka. What would I do without you?
Luka: You know where t—
(Bob Roth barges in Luka's room.)
Bob: Penny! Where's Jagged? Why aren't you answering my calls. He's supposed to be recording a new album for me! It's in his contract!
Penny: I-I'm looking for him, Bob. I thought I'd find him with his son but he's not here.
Bob: His son?? (walks to Luka and grabs his face) Jagged Stone has a son? I can't believe someone would be foolish enough to have a kid with that good-for-nothing.
(Anarka enters the room.)
Anarka: That "fool" would be me, Bob, and you boarded my boat without my permission!
Bob: (mockingly) Oh, yeah? And what are you going to do about it?
(Anarka cracks her knuckles furiously.)

title: Migration/Transcript
text:
Migration/Transcript - Intro
Anarka: So, shall we begin rehearsal?
(On Ivan's signal, the band starts playing their song.)
Rose: ♪ You don’t need to skyrocket ♪♪ Don’t need no deep pockets ♪
(As the band continues rehearsing, Luka walks by and looks at Adrien and Marinette sitting beside each other on the floor, and once again, in his point of view, he sees them as Ladybug and Cat Noir.)
Rose: ♪ To be a prince or princess if you need tenderness ♪♪ You don't need no fancy clothes ♪♪ No romance or roses ♪♪ No amazing comeliness ♪♪ If you need a caress— ♪
(Bob claps off-stage, interrupting their rehearsal.)
Bob: Wow! Amazing, kids! It's hot! It rocks! It's a moolah maker! How would you like to sign a contract with me?
Luka: Actually, Bob, you already offered to sign us...
Marinette: And you never followed up. Did you forget? (shows Bob a Kitty Section sticker with the record company logo)
Bob: Huh? Uh... of course! I remember! I was just waiting for the right reason, uh, I mean, the right time! I was waiting for the right time to have you guys sign the contract! (brings out sheets of papers containing the contracts)

title: Migration/Transcript
text:
Migration/Transcript - Intro
Anarka: (stepping in) There's no way I'm letting the kids sign anything with a shark like you, Bob!
Bob: Nobody asked you, skipper! So why don't you make yourself useful and get us a pen, so we can sign the contracts?
(Anarka cracks her knuckles once again and throws Bob overboard.)
Luka: Mom...
Anarka: I know. I should stop throwing people overboard. But they get on my nerves. Everyone does. Now that I think of it, you and your sister are the only people I’ve never felt like throwing overboard.
Luka: Then, you should try to think of people the same way you think of us. Everyone deserves a chance, Mom. Even the worst people. Anyone can change...
Bob: (off-screen, walking aboard the houseboat) Jagged Junior's right, Anarka. What would we do without that kid, huh?!
(Upon hearing his voice, Anarka cracks up her knuckles again, preparing to throw Bob overboard for good, but stops as she sees Bob panic.)
Bob: He's right! I've changed! And I'll prove it to you. Granted, I wasn't always straight up with you in the past. When I said I’d sign you up... I was lying.
(Everyone gasps.)

title: Migration/Transcript
text:
Migration/Transcript - Intro
Bob: But that's all over now! Today, I listened to you, and your super sounds opened my heart and, not an easy thing to do, my wallet too! Which is why I've got a whole new deal for you! (pulls out a bunch of contracts) A contract that won't just protect you: it's going to spoil you! Come on! Just sign this so we can put our little differences behind us and move forward!
(Luka seems to look confused. Rose and the others are enthused.)
Rose: I mean... a first album...
Ivan: ...with a record company...
Juleka: (mumbles) Yeah, that'd be so cool!
Marinette: (to Luka) Do you think you guys can trust him?
(Luka turns to look at Bob, grinning, in which he returns a suspicious look back at him.)
Luka: Let's give him a chance.
(Bob spreads the contract sheets on top of his briefcase, point at it to let them sign it.)
Bob There. Sign here, here, here and there.
(After Rose, Juleka, Ivan and Luka sign the contracts, they share a group hug.)
Rose: We're making a record!!!
(Record screech. Bob is now seen dressed up in a scuba outfit.)

title: Migration/Transcript
text:
Migration/Transcript - Intro
Bob: RIGHT! You’re all fired except for Jagged Junior! Jagged Senior is no use to me anymore! All he wants to do is spend time with his family instead of making me new albums, and since he's not bringing in the moolah anymore... Jagged Junior will replace him! You can always turn a celebrity’s kid into a celebrity! The rest of you useless zero-talent kids can clear out!
(A wide-eyed Luka objects.)
Luka: You can't make me work for you without my friends.
Bob: Of course, I can! That’s what contracts are for! Read it and you'll see!
(The gang shift their eyes on the contract in their hands and collectively gasp in realization.)
Bob: Oh, boohoo! You should see your faces! You shouldn’t have signed! You should have been more careful and listened to the old pirate! But you didn't, and now it’s too late! (wears his goggles and snorkel as Anarka throws him overboard yet again) Don't-care-I-got-the-contraaaaaaacts!!!! (returns to the houseboat shortly after) You can throw me overboard as many times as you like... but you signed. You’re mine.
(The gang re-reads the contract.)
Anarka: It's full of small print and ambiguous phrasings — he really tricked you.

title: Migration/Transcript
text:
Migration/Transcript - Intro
Ivan: He can fire us whenever he wants?
Bob: Yep, and I just did, by the way.
Rose: The name Kitty Section belongs to him?!
Bob: Yep. It’s ugly, but it’s mine.
Marinette: He owns everything you’ve made and will make over the next thousand years!?
Bob: Gotta cover all bases.
Zoé: Marinette's costumes, the music video Nino shot, the website Mylene runs...
Bob: All mine!
Adrien: And you can’t even start another band together?
Bob: Course not, that’d be unfair competition! EVERYTHING belongs to me! Everything you are, everything you say, everything that’s in your hearts belongs to me! I own E-VE-RYTHING!!!
(Luka, after being bombarded by Bob Roth's contract plot twist, whispers to himself:)
Luka: (gasps) It's... all my fault...
Monarch: A pure soul shattered once again by good old Bob's greed. The weeping of an artist is music to the ears of my megakumas. Kaalki, (Kaalki's pod flies towards Monarch) your power is now mine! (absorbs the power of Migration and creates a megakuma in his hands) Voyage, my megakuma!

title: Migration/Transcript
text:
Migration/Transcript - Intro
Bob: Don’t look so sad, Jagged Junior! I've fired all your buddies, but I'm keeping you! And you’re about to get rich! RICH! Who needs friends when you’ve got cold hard cash? (the megakuma is now seen flying towards them) You won’t be rich as me, but there’s nothing I can do about that -- blame the contract.
(The Megakuma enters Luka's electric guitar.)
Monarch: (from his lair) Silencer, I am Monarch. This unscrupulous producer wants to steal your voice, but I can give back your old powers and allow you to silence him for good! All I ask for in return are Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous.
Luka: (while resisting the akumatization) No— No!! (grunts)
Monarch: (from his lair) I sense something else. Panic... fear... Why are you resisting so strongly? Do you have something to hide...? Could it be that you know...?! YOU know the identities of Ladybug and Cat Noir!!
Luka: (continues to resist) No, I'll never tell you!! (grabs his guitar) NEVER!!!! (smashes his guitar on the wooden floor and breaks his connection with Monarch as the Megakuma flies out of the guitar and enters a portal)

title: Migration/Transcript
text:
Migration/Transcript - Intro
Monarch: (from his lair) NO!!! I was about to find out who Ladybug and Cat Noir really are! I must find a way to make that boy talk!!
Luka: I’d rather never make music again than make it for you. If silence is the only way to escape from you, so be it. (tears the contract in half)
Bob: You can't do that! I was gonna make you a star! And that contract you're ripping up was gonna make you millions!
Luka: Money and contracts are just paper.
(As Anarka walks toward Bob again, Luka steps aside and lets her do her thing: throw Bob overboard.)
Bob: I don't care; I got duplicates! You're miiiine! (splashes into the water)
Monarch: (from his lair) Anger, frustration, and greed! That will suffice! Voyage! (Monarch opens a portal)
(The Megakuma comes out of a portal, flying towards and landing into Bob's pile of contracts.)
Monarch: (from his lair) Gold Record, I am Monarch. This young "rebel-rebel"'s refusing to sing for you? Well, I'll give you the power to force him to! He will give you everything that's in his heart. There will be nothing he can refuse you or hide from me! Not even his secrets! All I want in return are—

title: Migration/Transcript
text:
Migration/Transcript - Intro
Bob: Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous. You got yourself a deal, Monarch! Sign me up! (succumbs to the akumatization and transforms into Gold Record)
Monarch: (from his lair) To help you, I'm also giving you the essence of the Miraculous of Migration. It will allow you to teleport anywhere you want as quickly as you desire. Transfer! (taps on the re-forged Horse Miraculous, transmitting the power of Migration to Gold Record through his Alliance ring)
(Back on the houseboat, Luka picks up his broken guitar.)
Marinette: Can you fix it?
Luka: (bitterly) No. No one can. (smiles) But Bob Roth didn't break me. He can't buy my inner tune or make me betray my friends.
(A portal created by Gold Record appears in front of them and steps out, threatening them.)
Gold Record: Maybe I can’t buy it, but thanks to this gold record, I can steal it and become RICH! (throws his disc like a boomerang, targeting Luka)
Rose: Luka, watch out! (She steps in to keep the disc from hitting Luka, which hit her instead and gets trapped inside a record. And just like that, a song is created to let out all her secrets, that is, by singing her heart out.)
Rose: ♪ All my heart, I love Juleka ♪

title: Migration/Transcript
text:
Migration/Transcript - Intro
(Juleka smiles and blushes.)
Rose: ♪ Luka, Ivan, Marinette and Alya ♪♪ And everyone and all my friends ♪♪ And unicorns! And bunnies! And I even love the people I don't like! ♪
Gold Record: (as Rose continues singing) Lame! I knew this band was worthless! Come on, Voyage! Voyage into oblivion! (snaps his fingers, transporting Rose's record into outer space) HAHAH! There! In space, no one can hear you sing!
Anarka: (stomps towards Gold Record...) Run, kids! I'll take care of that shark! (...and eventually gets touched by Gold Record's disc, trapping her inside a record as well)
♪ If I had to forget every song, every rhyme ♪♪ Every word that I use... ♪
(Luka turns to look at Marinette, and knowing her superhero identity as Ladybug, he quickly looks for a way to get her to transform.)
Luka: Quick! Follow me!
(The gang immediately runs to follow him.)
Anarka:♪ ...from morning to night time ♪♪ And I could only save one last word, a beacon ♪♪ Then that last word would be "freedom" ♪
Luka: Come on! Go hide! Quick!
(Marinette, being the last one to go below the deck, gives Luka an opportunity to...)
Luka: Stop! (blocks Marinette) The hold is full. Go hide in the cabin!

title: Migration/Transcript
text:
Migration/Transcript - Intro
(Marinette, as intrigued as she is, nods anyway and does what Luka said. Luka proceeds to run downstairs, leaving Marinette to do what is needed to do:)
Marinette: (hidden)  Tikki, spots on! (transforms into Ladybug)
Anarka:♪ Would be, would be... freedom ♪
Gold Record: Voyage! (sends Anarka's disc into outer space)
Adrien: (running towards Luka) Luka, where's Marinette? Have you seen her??
Luka: She must've hidden somewhere...
Adrien: Or got captured by Gold Record! I've got to go help her!
Luka: If she's been captured, the only ones who can help her are Cat Noir (Adrien gasps, figuring out Luka knows his secret identity) and Ladybug! Come on, hide here.
(He shoves Adrien to hide in a closet, leaving both him and Plagg stunned by Luka's sudden actions. Running again to hide, Gold Record teleports in his room shortly after and blocks his way.)
Gold Record: You can't escape me, Jagged Junior! Your music is MINE!! (throws his gold disc at Luka, but this time, Juleka protected him and gets trapped in a purple disc)
Juleka:♪ Like a flower, you drift in the silence ♪♪ You float on the water and you dance ♪♪ The ripples on the surface leave traces of you ♪

title: Migration/Transcript
text:
Migration/Transcript - Intro
Gold Record: Wow... So with you people, it's like the lamer, the better. That thing will never make me rich. Come on, voyage, voyage! (snaps his fingers and teleports Juleka's disc into space) It's time to record that album you owe me, Jagged Junior! (throws the gold disc again, and just before Luka gets hit, Ladybug wraps her yo-yo around Luka and pulls him towards her, avoiding the disc)
Ladybug: We need to get out of here! (pushes Luka out of the door, escaping Gold Record)Gold Record: Two for the price of one! You can sing a duet! (He attempts to throw the gold disc at Ladybug and Luka as Cat Noir comes out of the closet and quickly throws a rubber duck to keep anyone from being hit by Gold Record's disc. The rubber duck turns into a yellow disc and starts quack-singing.)
Gold Record: Ah, this one's a hit! No way I'm sending you to space, Ducky. Voyage, voyage! (teleports duck disc into his office)Cat Noir: I'm warning you: I'm a terrible singer.
Gold Record: It's fine, kitty. You can just dance! (throws his gold disc at Cat Noir)Cat Noir: (evades the gold disc) Missed! You're as terrible a villain as you are a music producer. (leaps out the boat)''

title: Migration/Transcript
text:
Migration/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: Hey, it's starting to look like your record's broken. (attacks Gold Record with his staff) It's your turn to dance now!
Gold Record: Voyage! (escapes to a teleport and appears on Cat Noir's blind side, catching his gold disc and escapes again)
Cat Noir: I really hate the powers of the Miraculous when a supervillain is using them.
(Gold Record returns and throws his gold disc at Cat Noir as the feline evades it successfully.)
Gold Record: Here, kitty, kitty!
(Cat Noir evades the disc and leaps away.)
Cat Noir: Hey, no fair! I can't play both cat and mouse!
(Gold Record throws his disc at him again as Cat Noir makes his run. The gold disc hits a pigeon this time, trapping it in another disc and plays pigeon sounds. By the subway, Cat Noir manages to escape Gold Record and catches his breath. He opens his ringing cat phone.)
Ladybug: (on the phone) Cat Noir, it's me. You gotta keep Gold Record busy long enough for me to come up with a plan to defeat him.
Cat Noir: Don't worry, m'lady, we're getting along like cats and dogs!
(Upon closing his cat phone, Gold Record peeks his head through a portal, finding Cat Noir yet again.)

title: Migration/Transcript
text:
Migration/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: (sighs) It's not gonna work if I say "time out"?
(Gold Record shakes his head 'no', smiling.)
[Superpower Sequence]
Ladybug: Lucky Charm!
(receives a knitting needle)
(Ladybug uses her Lucky Vision to spot a fiddle, a guitar, the speakers and Luka.)
Ladybug: I've got a plan. But to make it work, I need to use you as bait. Are you willing to take that risk?
Luka: Of course, Ladybug. I trust you. But do you realize the risks? If Gold Record captures me, I'll reveal everything that's in my heart.
Ladybug: I'm sure whatever's in your heart is no problem.
Luka: (worried) It is, Marinette. In this case, it is.
Ladybug: And if you're worried you'll reveal the name of someone you're in love with, that's okay! It's no big deal!
Luka: You're not listening, Marinette.
Ladybug: Everyone's allowed to be in love, even when things get complicated and— (shocked; and realizes that Luka has been addressing her as her civilian self) What... did you just call me...?
(Luka shrugs with a bitter smile.)

title: Migration/Transcript
text:

Ladybug: (recalled her grievous mistake of living her childhood dream from the battle with Luka as Viperion against Alec Cataldi in the episode Wishmaker) How could I—?! I was careful! I would never—!
Luka: It's not your fault, or Cat Noir's. You didn't make any mistakes, and you won't make any today, either. I trust you.
