(He throws his gold disc at Cat Noir, causing him to fall off to another roof after he evades the disc. The disc touches a chimney where Cat Noir is hiding from behind, trapping it inside another disc and plays a song.)
Cat Noir: That's an artist that's sure to go up in smoke real soon!
Gold Record: Maybe, but guess who will be on the b-side of that record?
(A guitar riff is heard from afar, making Gold Record to shift his head to the sound, which is coming from the Eiffel Tower. Luka is then seen playing the guitar on top of the Eiffel Tower.)

(Cat Noir opens his cat phone.)

title: Migration/Transcript
text:

Luka:♪ I'll tell you all, you know ♪♪ I'll tell you who— ♪
(Luka's record stops playing upon Cat Noir's Cataclysm.)

title: Migration/Transcript
text:
Migration/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: No more evil-doing for you, Megakuma! (opens her yo-yo) Time to de-evilize! (captures the Megakuma) Gotcha! (frees the purified butterfly) Bye-bye, little butterfly!
Cat Noir: (leaps to the Eiffel Tower to join Ladybug) If you'd, please, m'lady? (gives Ladybug the knitting needle)

[Superpower Sequence]
Ladybug: Miraculous Ladybug!
(She throws the knitting needle in the air, restoring all the damages caused by Gold Record, as well as freeing the people trapped in discs. Cat Noir holds up the broken akumatized object, reverting it back to a bunch of contracts. Gold Record is back to his normal self.)

(Luka smiles at them at a distance.)
Ladybug: Bob Roth. This Magical Charm will protect you from Monarch. (places the Magical Charm in Bob's hand)
Bob: Again with that trinket! I don't want it, it's worthless! (drops the Magical Charm on the floor and spots the bunch of contracts in Cat Noir's hand) Aha! Now this is gonna win me a fortune! Thank you for fixing everything, Ladybug! (laughs maniacally)
Anarka: (storms in behind Bob) Give me that contract, Bob!

title: Migration/Transcript
text:
Migration/Transcript - Intro
Bob: Never! Jagged Junior's going to sing for me, or I'll make his little friends' lives hell.
Luka: Mom, I acknowledge that you made an effort to remain calm and you tried to give him a chance.
Bob: You think I'm afraid of you when we got two superheroes whose job is to protect Paris' citizens? (cackles) Dream on! You can't touch me! I got the law on my side and I can do whatever I want!
Cat Noir: (with a hint of sarcasm) Oh no, m'lady, I'm afraid I'm about to transform back. I've gotta run!
Ladybug: (sarcastic) Dear me, so am I! Such a shame. Oh, well... bug out!
Cat Noir: Woohooo!
(The heroes leap away, leaving poor Bob with a wounded pride.)
Bob: (stutters) Wait! Come back! I could draw up a contract for you, too!
(Anarka throws a comically screaming Bob to the banks of the Seine, for good this time.)
Monarch: You defeated me today, Ladybug. But your time is running out! Now that I know the young musician holds the secret to Ladybug and Cat Noir's identities, I'm not going to let him off the hook, and believe me, I will make him sing!!
(The lair window closes.)
Rose: You saved Kitty Section, Luka!
Mylène: You guys can play gigs again!

title: Migration/Transcript
text:
Migration/Transcript - Intro
Luka: Thank you, my friends. I'm so happy that Kitty Section's adventure will go on. But I have something important to tell you. I can't be a part of this adventure anymore. (Everyone gasps.) I can't stay in Paris. I'd be a threat to everyone I love here because I know the secret identities of Ladybug and Cat Noir.
Adrien: But if no one finds out, you're safe!
Luka: Monarch sensed that I knew when he tried to akumatize me.
Marinette: Ladybug and Cat Noir will always protect you.
Luka: I can't become the priority, not when they have to defeat Monarch to free Paris.
(The gang clamors simultaneously.)
Zoé: (interposing) We can't write Kitty Section's music without you!
Marc: (interposing) Who's going to listen to us?
Ivan: (interposing) But what are we going to do without you?
Mylène: (interposing) You're like an inspiration to us...
Luka: The music can be written without me. Kitty Section's and your inner tunes. I know you can already hear what's in your heart. And as for the band, trust Juleka. (The gang turns to her.) From what we heard earlier, she's the most talented one in the family.
Juleka: I mean- I... don't really think I'm all that good—

title: Migration/Transcript
text:
Migration/Transcript - Intro
Anarka: Woah woah woah woah! Let's slow down with the big heroic sacrifices! You're still a teen, Luka, and you'll do as your mother says. There is no way I'm letting you run around the world without adult supervision.
Jagged Stone: (off-screen) I'll go with him!
(Anarka cracks her knuckles.)
Luka: Give him a chance, Mom.
Anarka: Jagged, you old pirate! You don't expect me to believe you're willing to give up on the rockstar life? The five-star hotels? The money? The fame?
Jagged Stone: I already have, Nanarky. When I saw Luka stand up to Bob, I knew my son was right. I tore up my contracts too and fed the scraps to Fang.
(Fang growls in agreement.)
Jagged Stone: So, if you give me a chance, I'd like to try and be a father. For once.
Anarka: (to Penny) And you're okay with this?
Penny: Yes. And I can help Luka with schoolwork when we're on the road.
Anarka: I thought your guitar was your only family!
Jagged Stone: Well, from now on, my family will be my only guitar.
(Anarka turns to look at Luka and sighs deeply. She then extends her arms out for a hug, to which Jagged responds to, exhilarated.)
Jagged Stone: Ha-hah! Awesome! (hugs Anarka)

title: Mike Collins
text:
Mike Collins - Intro
Michael "Mike" Collins, Jr. is a superhero from Manhattan, New York City. He is the son of the great basketball player Michael Collins. Using the power of his Ectocap, when inhabited by Gromax, Mike transforms into the superhero Krush, a hero with the power to generate ice. He is also a member of the Ghostforce team.

title: Mines of Paris
text:
Mines of Paris - Intro
The  comprise a series of abandoned underground mines beneath Paris, France, connected to each other by tunnels.
During seasons 5 and 6, Cerise/Chrysalis used some of the rooms as her supervillain lair.

title: Mines of Paris
text:
Mines of Paris - Appearance
TBA
La Plage
In season 5, it was inhabited by Cerise, who used it as her temporary refuge.
La Plage is a rectangular room. Its ceiling is made of rock, covered with graffiti in various colors. Right next to the walls is a small brick wall in sand color, while the walls themselves are have a pink-orange color, like the sky at sunset, and decorated with a painting of blue sea waves, inspired by the woodcut Great Wave in Kanagawa Hokusai Katsushiki. The room is illuminated by two black spotlights standing on tripods. In the right corner there is a large black box, a black suitcase and a Cerise bag, while the left corner is occupied by three white mannequin heads standing on the wall, on which three wigs are worn – a straight, brown, reaching to the shoulders, a long blond with a straight bangs, and red and slightly wavy. In addition, at the wall there is a black table with another wig, glasses, multi-colored lenses, a laptop and other items on her desk, at which stands a black director's chair with a yellow star on the back. Further on, we can also notice a yellow cushion, which is usually located next to a large terrain poster similar to the one in "Re-creation".

title: Mines of Paris
text:
Mines of Paris - Appearance
The most important and central element of the shelter is a large cork board suspended in the middle of the wall. It has a map of Paris pinned to the corners with four red pins. Attached to the plaque are excerpts of unknown texts and photographs of many people important to Cerise's plans and those of her enemies, including Gabriel Agreste/Hawk Moth/Monarch, Nathalie Sancoeur/Mayura, Marinette Dupain-Cheng/Ladybug, Adrien Agreste/Cat Noir, Kagami Tsurugi, Rena Rouge, Queen Bee, André and Audrey Bourgeois, Nadja Chamack, Ms. Bustier and Mr. Damoclés. Between the photos of people are drawn red and black lines. In addition, on the map are attached newspaper clippings, lime-green Self-Adhesive cards. Some locations in the city are marked with black icons, and some photos have captions.
Cerise's underground refuge
In season 6, Cerise had made it her secret hideout, where she kept all her diaries, which she used to write down the information she gathered during her plans, before abandoning it following the Miraculers' plan to track her down.

title: Mines of Paris
text:
Mines of Paris - Appearance
Accessible from a labyrinth of underground caves in Paris, this hideout had a sealed, reinforced door with a small window. The interior, with its smooth and textured brown brick walls, was surprisingly spacious.
Cerise had set up a wooden desk with a large, fine wood chair with a purple seat, surrounded by stacks of diaries filled with information she had collected. She had also created a corner where she stored her wigs and makeup.
In "Nemesis", Chrysalis fell into a trap set by the Miraculers to take them to her lair. However, she managed to escape and set fire on her lair to prevent them from discovering her research, leaving her lair abandoned.

title: Mines of Paris
text:
Mines of Paris - Etymology
La Plage means "the beach" in French.

title: Mines of Paris
text:
Mines of Paris - Trivia
This area is part of the underground quarries of Paris. Originally used to mine Lutetian limestone and gypsum, they are now controlled and maintained by the inspection générale des carrières (IGC) of Paris.
There are around 300 kilometers worth of underground quarries in Paris.
The larger network of quarries, the Grand Réseau Sud de Paris (GRS), is located below the 5th, 6th, 14th and 15th arrondissements of Paris.
There are also smaller networks of quarries separate from the GRS under the 13th and 16th arrondissements.
People who explore the forbidden underground quarries are called "Cataphiles".
La Plage is located under the 14th arrondissement of Paris.
In general, La Plage is a famous return place for cataphiles.
In La Plage there is a graffiti written on the ceiling of the room called "Marina" and that same graffiti is also one of several graffiti of the titular villain of "Timetagger". It is unknown if this could be Cerise's real name or if it is just common graffiti.
Many rooms in the underground quarries of Paris are converted former shelters, such as the German bunker (the shelter of the Lycée Montaigne), the PTT room, the FACO room, etc.

text:
Mines of Paris - Trivia
In some of these rooms, the doors and other equipment are still functional.

title: Milly Graham de Vanily
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Milly Graham de Vanily - Intro
Lady  is a character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She is the wife of Lord Emil Graham de Vanily, the mother of Émilie Agreste and Amélie Graham de Vanily, and the maternal grandmother of Adrien Agreste and Félix Fathom.
In "Werepapas", after having enough of her husband and Johnny Grassette arguing over with whom Adrien would live with following his parents' death, Milly is akumatized by Chrysalis into the Ringmaster, a referee/ringmaster-themed supervillain with the power to turn people into werewolves and force them to fight each other. She also received a Magical Charm from Ladybug that prevented her from being akumatized again.

title: Milly Graham de Vanily
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Milly Graham de Vanily - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Milly possesses a striking resemblance to her twin daughters. Her hair is light gray that she styles it with a bun behind her and her eyes are green.
Civilian Attire
Milly wears a white jacket with a white bow at the front, a white skirt, and white kitten heels. She has round golden earrings, a three-stringed pearl necklace with a golden ornament, as well a golden ring with a solitaire, large light-cream pearl on the middle finger of her right hand.
As Ringmaster
Ringmaster had light lavender-blue skin and intense turquoise-blue eyes, framed by slate by rings, navy sclera, and a black facial mask pointing at her nose, vlus very sharp white eyelashes, and black lipstick. Her hair was black with platinum white streaks, styled into a high mohawk with strands cascading down her back and a lock in front of her forehead. She wore black round earrings at the bottom of her ears, which had lengthened, rounded appendages.

title: Milly Graham de Vanily
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Milly Graham de Vanily - Appearance
She wore a black jumpsuit with pointed shoulders and white vertical lines running along the torso, reaching a downward white line at the waist, accompanied by a four-pointed black bowtie. The upper part of her arms was white, extending down to her thumbs, with the hands completed by a black section. She wore black high-heeled shoes with white heels that seamlessly connected to the jumpsuit. Additionally, two silver floating rings hovered around her wrists, matching her finger ring with sharp, clawed fingers.

title: Milly Graham de Vanily
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Milly Graham de Vanily - Personality
Through the way Félix and Kagami presented her in "Representation" during their play, Milly appears to be a traditional woman that cared about the legacy of her family but in contrast to her husband, she is much easier going and attempts to befriend Gabriel's parents. Emil worried about Émilie's lack of interest to the family's legacy, Milly believed she would fall in line eventually. When Émilie decided to give up everything for Gabriel, who went by Gabi Grassette, a humbled tailor, at the time, she was gobsmacked but despite it, she was willing to help the couple conceive a child and allowed them to stay at their Parisian home.
After coming to Paris to visit her grandson, Adrien, after both his parents had passed, Milly is shown to be very similar to her daughters in personality, being kind, gentle, and open-minded. This is shown when she is really happy to finally meet Adrien and how she was willing to greet Johnny and Gabrielle Grassette upon meeting them. However, all those traits of hers are overshadowed by her submissive relationship towards her husband, similar to her younger daughter Amélie towards Colt.

title: Milly Graham de Vanily
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Milly Graham de Vanily - Personality
Even with her meek personality while in the presence of Emil, Milly is not without a temper. She hates arguments, especially when they are loud and pointless, as shown when the argument between her husband and Johnny led to her akumatization. The reason for it is most likely tied to her submissive relationship with her husband, who always hushes her when she tries to talk and how he raises his voice to her whenever she does or says something he doesn't approve. When driven beyond her limit, Milly is capable of storming out, as seen when she runs away to Gabriel's atelier with the Twin Rings when Emil and Johnny fought over them.
Despite being from the aristocracy, Milly does enjoy pleasures that aristocrats see as "lower" than them (not fancy or extravagant) and she is not afraid of showing it, despite the fact that her husband always criticizes her for it. This is shown as she is curious and later delighted by the Grassettes' ballotines.
Milly uses a few canine based anecdotes in her speech such as referring to Emil "barking" at her and would growl when frustrated.

title: Milly Graham de Vanily
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Milly Graham de Vanily - Personality
After being deakumatized by Ladybug and being motivated by her, Milly was able to finally take a stand and determine that Adrien should be the one to choose where he wants to live, while also starting to set herself free from Emil's dominance.
As the Ringmaster, she is determined to silence the argument between Emil and Johnny by forcing them to fight over Adrien's custody, not caring much about the outcome, despite her preference for the two of them to destroy one another so Adrien could finally be free to choose. She also hates when someone tries to interfere, as she tried to stop Ladybug from ceasing the fight between Emil and Johnny, first herself and later forcing those two to fight her.

title: Milly Graham de Vanily
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Milly Graham de Vanily - Abilities
As Ringmaster
As Ringmaster, she is capable of using her bowtie, which she can toss, to transform people into werewolves, controling their bodies as she pleases, including making them fight each other or others. The ones affected by her power are still aware of their actions. She is also capable of giving them weapons. She is also able to imprison people into a giant trophy, from where the prisoners are able to see through, but not be seen.
She is also capable of summoning an entire arena that she can bring up to the sky on a giant pillar and create holes for one to fall through. She is also able to teleport anyone to the arena, including herself.
She also possesses enhanced abilities, like super-strength and super-agility.

Family
Emil Graham de Vanily
Milly is Lord Graham's wife. We know very little about how they act in private with each other. However in public, their relationship does not seem to be very healthy as Emil is incredibly cruel and dominant over his wife.
In "Werepapas", it is showcased how controlling he can be, as throughout the episode he constantly throws out mean and belittling comments towards her, mentioning how she should suffer in silence as she usually does and that no one cares about her opinions. When she tries to convince him of Nathalie's importance, he does not take her opinion into account, telling her how useless it is and to keep them to herself. Before getting akumatized, she yells at him to stop demeaning her. At the end of the episode, she finally stands up to him, being more assertive.
As Ringmaster, she loses all her respect for him telling Ladybug how his and Johnny only want to fight so they should fight like wolves.
Émilie Agreste

title: Milly Graham de Vanily
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Milly Graham de Vanily - Relationships
Milly had high expectations for Émilie as she entrusted her with the family's legacy. She worried about her defiant nature growing up. Still, Milly believed she would get her act together and sent her to Paris for both her education and discipline. When Émilie willingly renounced her rank, wealth, and family to be with Gabriel Agreste, who was Gabi Grassette, a wholesome tailor, it made her and Emil furious. Despite this, they were willing to help the two conceive a child and gave them their Parisian estate.
Amélie Graham de Vanily
Amélie was the opposite of Émilie, who was more well-behaved and obedient growing up. After Émilie renounced everything to be with Gabriel, Amélie became the heiress. Not wanting her to make the same mistake as her sister, Milly and Emil arranged a marriage between her and Colt Fathom, a wealthy but cold billionaire. She and Emil tried to help the couple conceive a child, but with no success.
Adrien Agreste

title: Milly Graham de Vanily

After her deakumatization, Milly, like her daughter Émilie, believed that Adrien should decide for himself with whom he wants to live and handed the Graham de Vanily Twin Rings over to him and she smiled when seeing him hug Nathalie, stating he wants to live with her and Milly told her grandson he needed a mother more than a family crest and welcomed him to visit her and Emil whenever he wants.
Gabriel Agreste
Milly didn't believe Gabriel was the right choice for Émilie, due to his family background and occupation. Despite this, she and Emil were willing to help the couple have a child and gave them their home in Paris.
Colt Fathom
Due to his wealth and success, a marriage was arranged between him and their younger daughter, Amélie, and the couple tried conceive a child, but with no success.

Milly Graham de Vanily - Trivia
In "Werepapas", it is revealed she is the Duchess of Westchester-Munster.
Milly has a similar food palette to Plagg as they were the only two seen enjoying the ballotines Johnny and Gabrielle brought.
Her necklace bears resemblance to the Three Row Pearl Bas Relief Choker by Vivienne Westwood.
Aside from being a fashion designer, Westwood was also a notable political activist who was notoriously anti-establishment. This, coupled with the fact Milly had been silenced into submission to her husband's patriarchal, antiquaded worldviews and demeanor, as well that her necklace is a choker, could be a visual indicator she felt trapped and silenced in a life she wasn't comfortable in, only finding her voice after the events of "Werepapas".
She and her husband's names combined form the names of their twin daughters, Émilie and Amélie.
Curiously, while Emil and Milly are married, neither of them actually wear wedding bands.

title: Miki
text:
Miki - Intro
is one of the two deuteragonists in Miraculous World: Tokyo - Stellar Force (alongside Kazuno) and the animated spin-off series Miraculous Stellar Force. She is a student at Kano Academy, a superheroine, and member of the Stellar Force. She is the current bearer of the Leo Fragment, which allows her to become Leo and one of the guardians who possess a fragment of the Stellar Matrix.

title: Miki
text:
Miki - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Miki is a slender girl of medium height with fair skin. She has short messy honey-blonde hair styled in a bob with upward spiky ends. Her bangs are parted near right with a curved left piece in the middle, curly forelocks framing her face, and slit, sharp, deep mint eyes with three wings on the upper lid and two on the lower lid.
Civilian Attire
Miki wears a V-neck white crop top with a brilliant yellow star logo that has a black border. On top is a brilliant yellow, short jacket with short sleeves, a folded collar, and jet black upper shoulders. She also wears bright yellow skinny athletic shorts with jet black sides and waistband, and white drawstrings, the right shorter than the other. Her sneakers are white with a single strap. She also wears white fingerless short gloves with thick cuffs, a star on the palm, and a pointing layer. Miki accessorizes with brilliant yellow nail polish on her fingers.
As Leo

title: Miki
text:
Miki - Appearance
Leo wears a jumpsuit shared with her teammates: a black jumpsuit with rectangular-detailed white elbow trim, abdomen, thigh trim, and shins. On her chest is a black four-point star. Her lower arms (except her fingers), torso, shoulders, inner thighs, sides of her knees, and feet are all light yellow with black fingers and rectangular soles. Her helmet is black with a light yellow chin, silver components covering her ears, followed by yellow angular rectangles on top with black tips, and a large yellow six-point star at the back resembling her civilian hairstyle and possibly a lion's mane as well. On her left wrist is her yellow and black watch, the Leo Sprite.

title: Miki
text:
Miki - Personality
Miki is bold, headstrong, competitive, and brash. She is quick to the point, such as when she challenged Kagami to a contest when they first met. She is also blunt when she was easily beaten, yet claimed that Kagami had cheated. She is also straightforward, deliberate, puts herself first as she views herself as the best, arrogant, short-tempered, and can't make friends easily. This is because she learned to detach herself from befriending others when being moved around constantly as a child.
Miki has a bit of a "victory must be earned" attitude as she doesn't like easy victories and is honorable, especially in her relationship with Kazuno. Despite both having feelings for each other, she respectfully waits for him to come to her, showing her patience. In rare instances, Miki can be humble. After following Ladybug's lead, she and everyone else begin to realize the mistake they made and thank the heroine.

title: Miki
text:
Miki - Abilities
As a Civilian
Miki is skilled in hand-to-hand combat and kickboxing.
As Leo
Leo has enhanced physical abilities, such as speed, combat, agility and strength. With the help of the Leo Sprite, she can summon her Leo Blade.

title: Miki
text:
Miki - Relationships
Love interests
Kazuno/Capricorn
Miki is aware that Kazuno has been in love with her since they were young. She shares the same feelings for him. For the most part, she views him as kind, smart, and altruistic. She finds him cute when he's blushing, seizing her heart, just as he sees his victories in judo. She refuses to reciprocate these feelings, since Kazuno never dared to confess, believing victories must be earned.
Friends
Mayotte/Sagittarius
TBA
Yu Lu/Cancer
TBA
Pili/Aries
TBA
Kagami Tsurugi/Ryuko
Ever since Kagami arrived at Kano Academy, Miki had seen her as more of a rival. When she learned that she specialized in fencing, she challenged her to a duel, which she lost. She insisted that Kagami had cheated, even though she hadn't fully explained the rules. She was also irritated by her new acquaintance's straightforwardness and directness. Despite this, she seemed to have no problem with Kazuno adding her to their group.

title: Miki
text:
Miki - Relationships
She was rather distrustful of Ryuko and looked down upon her. She refused to accept help and contemptuously called her "Frenchie." When she saw that Kazuno had taken a certain interest in Ryuko, she was clearly jealous of her. During a fight with the fish-like Kaijūs, she learned that Kagami was Ryuko. After defeating the threat, with the help of Ryuko and Ladybug, she remains on relatively good terms with Kagami, though this isn't widely shown.
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/Ladybug
Miki was distrustful of Marinette at first because she pretended to be Kagami in a text. She also knew why Marinette was trying to get Kagami and Kazuno to talk. She was comfortable enough to talk to Marinette about her crush, but believes that victories, such as telling someone you love them, have to earned.  She found Marinette's overly emotional behavior funny and did trust her enough to keep her hero identity a secret.
Enemies
Moddler

title: Miki
text:
Miki - Relationships
While Miki was unconscious and turned into a kaiju, the Moddler was about to take her Stellar Matrix, when Ladybug's Miraculous Ladbug turns her back to normal and she wakes up just in time to see him. She quickly prevents the Moddler from taking her matrix while calling him a "Thing". After the Moddler escapes using his magma teleportation portal after getting knocked down by Miki, she claims how they know each other now and she now knows he's responsible for turning people into kaijus.

title: Miki
text:
Miki - Etymology
The name Miki is combination of Japanese kanji "mi" (美) meaning  "beautiful" and "ki" (木, 希, 姫) meaning "tree", "hope", or "princess" respectfully. It can overall mean "beautiful hope".
It also can be derived from the name Michael (feminine version Michelle) from Western culture meaning "Who is like God?".

title: Miki
text:
Miki - Trivia
Miki was initially revealed in Stellar Force, and her dedicated series was presented at Mipjunior in Cannes 2024 by Andy Yeatman, CEO of Miraculous Corp.
However, her name wasn't revealed until a few months later.
Miki has traits normally associated with the Leo constellation:
She is confident, a natural leader and competitive, even if she's somewhat arrogant, which would make sense for the zodiac she represents.
Her theme color is yellow, which is a color the Leo zodiac represents since it's a fire sign.
Her bob cut appears to be quite spiky, with a model similar to it at the back of her helmet.
It could resemble a lion's mane, as the Leo constellation is depicted as a lion.
Miki is quite similar to Kagami:
Both struggle with making friends, but they each have different histories in regards to that matter.
They both use swords as their weapons.

title: Miraculous: Tales from Paris
text:
Miraculous: Tales from Paris - Trivia
The webisodes were originally planned to come out in late October 2016, but they were delayed to January 2017.
The series was originally announced to be designed by Nathanaël Bronn.
Early concept art of the series was labeled with the title Miraculous: Adventures of Ladybug. The same title was used on concept art for a CGI villain, Style Queen.
YouTuber Lindalee Rose was originally going to appear in some of the webisodes as a young interviewer. However, because of the series' cancelation, it's unknown how far the production was for the webisodes that featured her.
Ezra Weisz received the scripts for the web series on December 14, 2016.
The five known webisodes aren't released in production order. As seen from a photo of the script Ezra posted on Instagram, "Repetition" is actually the first webisode produced but the third to be released. Ezra further confirmed this during a Periscope live stream on December 19, 2016. However, it's unknown what is the production code for the remaining four released webisodes.

title: Miraculous: Tales from Paris
text:
Miraculous: Tales from Paris - Trivia
On December 19, 2016, Ezra revealed on a Periscope live stream that he managed to see the finished animation of the first five webisodes of the series and got sixteen scripts before the cast start dubbing them. It's unknown exactly how many webisodes have been completely animated and dubbed prior to the series' cancellation. Because those webisodes were never released nor there was any behind-the-scenes footage of the cast recording them surfaced, they are considered lost media.
Three voice actors have confirmed to record lines for their characters who were going to appear in the unreleased but completed webisodes.
On December 22, 2016, Ezra mentioned that Kira Buckland came to record a webisode that featured Alix.
On January 6, 2017, Michael Sinterniklaas came to record a webisode that featured Nathaniel.
On January 18, 2017, Ezra indirectly revealed that Grant George came to record a webisode that featured Kim.
Despite there's no official confirmation if Ben Diskin has recorded his lines for Max, it's likely he was also going to appear in an unreleased webisode.
Reba Buhr started recording the webisodes on January 2, 2017.

title: Miraculous: Tales from Paris
text:
Miraculous: Tales from Paris - Trivia
On January 5, 2017, the Dubbing Brothers USA Instagram indirectly revealed that Mela Lee and Ben Diskin arrived at the studio to record some of the webisodes.
Ezra Weisz (credited as "Ethan Murray") is listed as part of the voice cast in the end credits. However, it's unknown what character(s) he was going to voice in the web series.
Lila Rossi and Ivan Bruel are the only characters in the class whose voice actors aren't listed in the end credits. However, it's unknown if Lisa Kay Jennings and Max Mittelman have recorded their lines for their characters despite both Lila and Ivan appearing in the title cards.
Plagg appeared in concept art, but it's unknown if he's going to make any physical appearance in the series due to his voice actor being uncredited.
The web series was going to mainly focus on the civilian life of Marinette and Adrien. As a result, their superhero identities, Ladybug and Cat Noir, don't appear in the web series.
The webisodes have been confirmed to be canon to the main show by the official Miraculous Ladybug Tumblr blog.
All the five released webisodes have been adapted into comics for the Miraculous Adventures series.

Issue 5 adapts "Inspiration", "Busy Day", "Homework Essay" and "The Notebook" into a single comic.

title: Miraculer
text:
Miraculer - Intro
"" is a season 3 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 9th written and produced episode of season 3. It is also the 61st written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Miraculer
text:
Miraculer - Synopsis
Sabrina, angry at Chloé for the attention she gives to Ladybug, becomes Miraculer, who can steal powers away from superheroes.
Disney Channel
Sabrina gets akumatized by Hawk Moth; now Miraculer, she can steal their powers from superheroes and is determined to show Chloé that she is just as worthy of her interest than Ladybug.
Disney+
Ladybug and her team face Sabrina, now Miraculer.

title: Miraculer
text:
Miraculer - Plot
As Ladybug, Cat Noir, Rena Rouge, and Carapace battle Destroyer, Chloé runs up to Le Grand Paris rooftop with Sabrina and turns on her Bee Signal. As Nadja Chamack reports on the ongoing battle, Chloé remarks that without her, the heroes look ridiculous. Sabrina calls out for Ladybug to come fetch Chloé, though when Chloé nudges her, Sabrina corrects herself and says Queen Bee. Meanwhile, Hawk Moth communicates with Mayura, who is waiting beside Le Grand Paris in case Ladybug hands Chloé the Bee Miraculous.
Nadja reports that Ladybug has called on her Lucky Charm and received a rubber duck. As Chloé watches this, she anxiously waits for Ladybug to get the Bee Miraculous, but instead, the heroes end up using the rubber duck to defeat Destroyer, much to Chloé's frustration. Sabrina remarks that's not cool, but Chloé retorts that Ladybug only calls on her for serious supervillains before looking at a photograph of her and Ladybug together.

title: Miraculer
text:
Miraculer - Plot
Ladybug collects the Fox and Turtle Miraculous from Alya and Nino before reminding them to keep their identities secret. She then joins Cat Noir on top of the Eiffel Tower. He asks her if she's spoken to Chloé, to which Ladybug reminds him that using her is dangerous because her identity is public knowledge. Cat Noir agrees but says that Chloé probably doesn't know that her time as Queen Bee is over. With some insistence from Cat Noir, Ladybug agrees to talk to her.

title: Miraculer
text:
Miraculer - Plot
Gabriel enters his atelier and says that Chloé must become Queen Bee again. Nathalie asks him if he's sure about making her an ally as Ladybug has become reluctant in giving her the Bee Miraculous. Gabriel says that in that case, he'll make Chloé force Ladybug to give her the Miraculous by making her lose faith in the hero so that he can akumatize her. The two decide to use Lila to help them with this task. They approach Lila in their car at the park, where she thanks Gabriel for trusting her to protect Adrien but claims to be saddened by some of the people in his life such as Nino, Marinette, and Chloé. She also expresses irritation at how Chloé is always bragging about Queen Bee but says that Adrien couldn't care less about that because he's so perfect. However, Gabriel informs Lila that Adrien and Chloé have had an unbreakable friendship for a long time, thanks her for the information, and takes off. Once gone, Gabriel tells Nathalie that he's confident that Lila will help him implement his grand plan.
At school, Chloé tells Adrien, Nino, Alya, and Marinette that Rena Rouge and Carapace are tacky and she doesn't understand why Ladybug keeps calling on them.

title: Miraculer
text:
Miraculer - Plot
Lila suddenly enters the scene and greets everyone, but Marinette only stares at her bitterly before telling Alya that they should study for their test.
Nino is confused as to what test, to which Adrien reminds him about the science test they have in the afternoon, much to his frustration.
Adrien offers to help him.
Once they leave, Lila approaches Chloé and asks her if she was talking about Ladybug.
Chloé asks her who she is, to which Sabrina reminds her that Lila is in their class.
Chloé remarks that Lila didn't make much of an impression on her, but Lila laughs this off and says that Ladybug has mentioned her a few times.
Chloé is shocked that Lila has talked to Ladybug, to which Lila claims that she and Ladybug are very close and she has a magic command that she uses to summon Ladybug whenever she needs her.
When Chloé asks about it, Lila says that it's like Chloé's Bee Signal except hers works all the time.
Though Chloé appears a bit jealous, she brushes this off and walks off.
However, when Lila asks her if she'd like to know what it is, Chloé agrees to listen.
Lila whispers it in her ear and then says that if Ladybug doesn't come to her with that, she's not a true friend.

title: Miraculer
text:
Miraculer - Plot
The bell then rings and everyone heads to class.
Marinette tells Alya to go ahead as she'll meet her and then approaches Chloé.
She tries to talk to her, but Chloé refuses to listen and even yells at her before walking away.
Tikki reminds Marinette that Chloé only listens to Ladybug, to which Marinette agrees.
Meanwhile in his lair, Hawk Moth takes note of how Chloé's emotions are already starting to become negative and tells Mayura to get ready.

title: Miraculer
text:
Miraculer - Plot
After school, Marinette hides and transforms into Ladybug. Meanwhile, Mayura notices a baby August asking his mom for a lollipop. When she says no, August starts sobbing and therefore Mayura sends an amok his way. It infects his pacifier and causes a giant lollipop sentimonster to appear. Ladybug notices it and decides to take care of it before talking to Chloé. Chloé also notices the sentimonster and rushes up to Le Grand Paris rooftop to put on her Bee Signal. When Adrien and his bodyguard spot the sentimonster, the bodyguard quickly carries Adrien to his room, where Adrien thanks him and assures him that he'll be safe. Once the bodyguard leaves, Plagg suggests that they stay inside and wait for a Camembert monster instead. Adrien assures Plagg that if they ever run into one, he'll save him a chunk and then transforms into Cat Noir.

title: Miraculer
text:
Miraculer - Plot
As Ladybug and Cat Noir fight the sentimonster, Ladybug notices that there's no akumatized victim and guesses that it's on its own. Meanwhile, Chloé turns on her Bee Signal and anxiously waits for Ladybug while watching Nadja's news broadcast about the battle. Sabrina suggests that if Ladybug doesn't show up, they can play Ladybug and Cat Noir with their costumes, to which Chloé dismissively tells her to fetch them. Chloé suddenly remembers the magic command Lila told her about and, although she finds it ridiculous, she decides to give it a try. She hops on one foot, closes her eyes, and calls out for Ladybug. However, she instead finds her butler standing next to her with Mr. Cuddly. Chloé angrily tells him to leave, and Armand tells Sabrina, who has returned wearing her Cat Noir costume and holding Chloé's Ladybug costume, that Chloé needs some time to herself.

title: Miraculer
text:
Miraculer - Plot
Ladybug manages to knock the sentimonster to the ground and then notices August's pacifier. She breaks it, releasing the amok, and then purifies it with her yo-yo. She then uses Miraculous Ladybug to fix the damage. Chloé is devastated that Ladybug didn't come to her despite doing the magic command and realizes that Lila had lied to her. As she tearfully stares at her photograph of her and Ladybug, Hawk Moth senses Chloé's sadness and sends an akuma after her.

title: Miraculer
text:
Miraculer - Plot
Sabrina tells Chloé that it's okay as they can still play Ladybug and Cat Noir. However, an upset Chloé refuses, remarking how she is a superhero while Sabrina isn't and bitterly says that they have nothing in common, causing Sabrina to run away in tears. The akuma then infects Chloé's photograph and Hawk Moth offers to empower her so that she may recover the Bee Miraculous. However, Chloé refuses, causing the akuma to fly out of her photograph.  Hawk Moth takes note of how unique Chloé is, yet isn't disappointed as he senses Sabrina's sadness and sends the akuma after her instead. It infects her Cat Noir staff and Hawk Moth offers her the ability to steal other's superpowers in exchange for Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses. Sabrina agrees and is transformed into Miraculer.

title: Miraculer
text:
Miraculer - Plot
Miraculer shows up just as Ladybug and Cat Noir are fist-bumping. She scolds the heroes for neglecting Chloé, prompting Cat Noir to ask Ladybug if she worked things out with her. Ladybug says that she was about to but then gets irritated when Miraculer mimics her. Ladybug attacks the supervillain, but she manages to touch her with her stick, effectively stealing her superpowers. Miraculer calls on Lucky Charm and receives a giant sword. Cat Noir realizes that Miraculer stole Ladybug's superpower and therefore calls on his Cataclysm. However, Miraculer soon manages to steal this superpower and uses it against Cat Noir, breaking his ribs in the process. Miraculer happily exclaims that Chloé will love their new powers, to which Hawk Moth agrees and tells her to go find her. When Miraculer takes off, Cat Noir hides inside a nearby alley and detransforms. Plagg, now knowing what it's like to be Cataclysmed, promises never to call the dinosaurs "a bunch of wusses" again. Adrien tells Plagg that there's Camembert in his jacket and they can rest for a while until Ladybug returns.

title: Miraculer
text:
Miraculer - Plot
Master Fu takes out the Miracle Box and tells Marinette to pick a trusted ally to help her. Marinette deduces that since Miraculer has stolen both hers and Cat Noir's superpowers, everyone is needed, including Chloé. When Ladybug shows Cat Noir the Bee Miraculous, Cat Noir asks her if she's sure, to which Ladybug says that although it may be her last mission, Chloé is definitely needed. She hands him the Bee Miraculous and Cat Noir prepares to take off, though his broken ribs slow him down. Ladybug shows concern and promises to heal him once Miraculer is defeated.

title: Miraculer
text:
Miraculer - Plot
Miraculer approaches Chloé and reveals that she now has Ladybug and Cat Noir's superpowers, asking her if she would like Ladybug's. Chloé refuses, saying that she doesn't want to be Ladybug as there is only one Ladybug. Cat Noir suddenly shows up with the Bee Miraculous in hand. However, before Chloé can grab it, Mayura shows up and snatches it away. Chloé demands to know who she is, to which Mayura introduces herself and tells Chloé that if she teams up with her and Miraculer, all her dreams will come true. Cat Noir remarks that their dream sounds more like a nightmare, though Miraculer tells him that he'll be the one living the nightmare. Meanwhile, Ladybug approaches Alya and Nino and offers them their Miraculouses.
While Cat Noir battles Miraculer and Mayura, Chloé remarks that they wouldn't be in their current situation if he and Ladybug had gotten her sooner. Cat Noir sarcastically thanks Chloé for her help, though Chloé retorts that if she had her Miraculous, she could've helped. She is suddenly pulled aside by Ladybug, Rena Rouge, and Carapace, who have a plan.

title: Miraculer
text:
Miraculer - Plot
As Cat Noir continues battling the supervillains, Chloé suddenly approaches Miraculer and says that she's changed her mind, asking for Ladybug's superpowers. Miraculer delightfully agrees and gives her them, only to discover that she is really Ladybug disguised using an illusion. Ladybug thanks Miraculer for giving her her powers back while Chloé is indignant that her best friend mistook her for an illusion. A furious Miraculer attacks Ladybug, but Carapace uses Shell-ter to block the attack. Miraculer uses Cataclysm on the shield and battles Ladybug while Mayura battles Cat Noir. She pins him down and prepares to take his ring, only to be stopped by Ladybug. Cat Noir apologizes to Ladybug, claiming that he held out for as long as he could.

title: Miraculer
text:
Miraculer - Plot
Miraculer battles Carapace and Rena Rouge and manages to steal both their powers. Meanwhile, Hawk Moth tells Mayura to come back as she has the Bee Miraculous and Miraculer will take care of Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses. Mayura takes off, but Cat Noir knocks the Bee Miraculous out of her hand with his staff and Ladybug catches it with her yo-yo. Tossing it towards Chloé, she tells her to follow Mayura as she is likely heading back to Hawk Moth. Chloé agrees, catches the Miraculous, and transforms into Queen Bee.

title: Miraculer
text:
Miraculer - Plot
Queen Bee follows Mayura but doesn't see her anywhere, fearing that Ladybug will think of her as incompetent if she fails. However, she soon spots Mayura behind her and attempts to land a kick or punch on her, only for her to dodge every attack. Mayura pins Queen Bee down and asks her if she enjoys being Ladybug's servant and having to wait for her to loan her a Miraculous, also asking if she'd rather have boundless powers of her own. She offers her a chance to join her and be Queen Bee whenever she likes, but Queen Bee refuses. Mayura promises that she'll regret that and prepares to take her Miraculous, only for Queen Bee to escape her grasp and hold her down. She prepares to take the Peacock Miraculous from her, but Mayura manages to get her off of her and escape, much to Queen Bee's frustration.

title: Miraculer
text:
Miraculer - Plot
Back at the battle, Miraculer uses Mirage to create multiple illusions of herself, but Carapace and Ladybug quickly destroy the illusions with their weapons. Ladybug wraps her yo-yo string around Miraculer's waist. Miraculer prepares to use Cataclysm on it, but Ladybug pushes it back towards her before she can and Carapace, Rena Rouge, and Cat Noir restrain her. Carapace attempts to grab her staff, only for Miraculer to use Shell-ter on it. Therefore, Ladybug calls on her Lucky Charm and receives a pillow. While wondering what to do with it, Rena Rouge and Carapace attempt to force Miraculer into using Cataclysm on the Shell-ter, only for her to remove it before they can. Miraculer also manages to kick Cat Noir off of her. Queen Bee then shows up and assists in restraining Miraculer, also suggesting to Ladybug that she use tickles. This gives her an idea. She rips apart the pillow and uses one of the feathers to tickle Miraculer's armpit, forcing her to use Shell-ter on it instead. This allows Ladybug to grab her staff and break it, releasing the akuma. She purifies it and then uses Miraculous Ladybug to fix the damage.

title: Miraculer
text:
Miraculer - Plot
Queen Bee tells Ladybug that Mayura escaped her and apologizes. Ladybug tells her that it's okay and prepares to take the Bee Miraculous from her. Queen Bee remarks that if she had given it to her earlier, they may have defeated Hawk Moth. Ladybug apologetically agrees and tells Queen Bee that she may never be able to give her the Bee Miraculous again as her identity being public knowledge puts her and her loved ones in danger. Queen Bee detransforms and gives the Miraculous back, saying that she understands but is sure that Ladybug will need her again. Ladybug thanks Chloé and takes off along with Rena Rouge, Carapace, and Cat Noir. Sabrina asks Chloé if this means that she'll never want to play with her again. Chloé says she will, but she doesn't want to be Ladybug anymore. Ripping apart her photograph of her and Ladybug, she tells Sabrina that she can keep the costume if she'd like. Meanwhile, Mayura apologizes to Hawk Moth for failing, but Hawk Moth says that they've set the stage for the future, confident that Queen Bee would change her mind.

title: Miraculer
text:
Miraculer - Plot
The next day at school, Chloé confronts Lila about her fake magic command, asking if it was just a joke. Lila denies this and asks Chloé if she was with Ladybug the other day. Realizing that this is true, Chloé is convinced that the magic command is real and tells Lila that she's not completely useless. Marinette observes this and expresses hope that she didn't hurt Chloé's feelings too much. Tikki reminds Marinette that it's for Chloé's own good and by not letting her be Queen Bee anymore, she is protecting Ladybug and Cat Noir. Marinette agrees and heads to class before the end card appears.

title: Miraculer
text:
Miraculer - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in Spain on Disney Channel.
According to Feri González, "Miraculer" takes place after the episode, "Reflekdoll".
This is further implied as Ladybug says that Lollipop Boy is on its own, opposite of what happened in the aforementioned episode.
Mayura is shown to act as an enforcer for Hawk Moth.
She is shown to recuperate faster after using the Peacock Miraculous or has developed certain resistance to its effect, as she got worse in later episodes.
Rena Rouge's detransformation phrase is revealed to be "Let's Rest".
After the battle against Lollipop Boy, Ladybug uses "Miraculous Ladybug" without summoning a Lucky Charm for the second time following "Weredad".
This is the first time a person is able to resist Hawk Moth's akumatization, that person being Chloé.
Although Miss Bustier is shown trying to resist akumatization in "Zombizou", she fails in doing so.
It is shown that if an akuma leaves the object after a person resists, both the victim and their object will be left unaffected.
This is the third time Sabrina gets akumatized following "Antibug" and "Catalyst".

title: Miraculer
text:
Miraculer - Trivia
However, unlike her previous akumatizations as Vanisher, her new supervillain identity is Miraculer.
This is the first time Sabrina's villain name is the title of the episode that she is akumatized in.
The first Lucky Charm Miraculer summons is the sword that Antibug, Nightmare Ladybug and Toy Ladybug summon in "Antibug", "Sandboy", and "Christmaster".
This episode reveals more insight about the Cat Miraculous and Cataclysm:
It is revealed that if Cataclysm is used on a transformed Miraculous holder, they will not die immediately. It will simply leave them injured where they were hit, such as Cat Noir's ribs being broken as a result of it being used on him.
However, it is possible that it's only this weak on the Cat Miraculous holder, the way that the Snake Miraculous holder will still remember cancelled timelines that are erased from the minds of everyone else.

title: Miraculer
text:
Miraculer - Trivia
In "Destruction", Hawk Moth (at this point called Monarch) is Cataclysmed by Cat Noir, but it only left the point of impact broken, in this case his left forearm. However, because this was not healed by Ladybug's Miraculous Ladybug, Monarch later died because of the effect of the Cataclysm. Regardless death from a Cataclysm is still possible, but is greatly delayed.
Unless the person uses Second Chance like Monarch did prior and too "Intuition", instead of reversing his injury the power made it worse on top of it he didn't bother to put a time marker before he got struck.
When used on a humanoid sentimonster because of their physical nature instead of going out of control they'll react in pain and agony.
In "Catalyst", Volpina creates an illusion where Cataclysm is used on a Miraculous holder. Miraculer shows that her illusion is contrary to reality.
And yet, at same time her illusion isn't contrary to reality as she didn't know she copied Plagg's version and that the kwami versions of the Miraculous superpowers are far stronger or possible the adult version of Cat Noir's powers.

title: Miraculer
text:
Miraculer - Trivia
Since she didn't know the full effects of Cataclysm when used on a person it's most likely she guessed that was going to happen.
However, by Cat Noir's own remarks, that someone hit by Cataclysm will eventually die if they are hit in a vital area or not which is actually proven in "Intuition".
According to Plagg's remark this is first time Cataclysm has ever been used on a Cat Miraculous holder.
However, with Plagg having many holders it's highly likely that Cataclysm was used on other people or holders (that at least weren't his) in the past.
The second time this power was used on a living being and first on a person but not by Cat Noir.
This is the seventh time, where Cat Noir attempted to use his powers on someone else following "Dark Cupid", "Princess Fragrance", "Despair Bear", "Troublemaker", "Malediktator" and "Miraculous Shanghai" but this is the fourth time he did it of his own free will.
Miraculer says the same lines as Nightmare Ladybug in "Sandboy" when taunting Cat Noir.
Additionally, she swings a giant sword Lucky Charm the same way as Nightmare Ladybug, and Cat Noir slides back very similarly to how he moved in "Sandboy".

title: Miraculer
text:
Miraculer - Trivia
This episode shows Hawk Moth's team taking another Miraculous, though they lose it not long after.
This is the second time where an amok and akuma had to be captured following "Reflekdoll".
When the episode was originally released, the effect when Miraculer gave Ladybug's powers to "Chloé" was slightly different.
This is the very first episode in which a character other than Chloé or Audrey Bourgeois speaks the sentence "Ridiculous! Utterly Ridiculous!".
This is the fifth time where Ladybug's Lucky Charm resembles an akumatized villain's object both before it got akumatized following "Pixelator", "Reflekta", "Frightningale" and "Sandboy".
This is the third time where a Lucky Charm object breaks (excluding the broken plate in "Troublemaker") before "Robostus" and "Weredad". Any yet, this is first time Ladybug breaks a Lucky Charm herself.
Errors
As Ladybug's yo-yo closes to capture the amok, the feather disappears.
When Ladybug releases the feather, the glow in the yo-yo is missing, revealing the inside of the yo-yo.
When Marinette goes to Master Fu, she has knowledge that Miraculer has stolen both her and Cat Noir's powers, despite being absent when Cat Noir's power was stolen.

title: Miraculer
text:
Miraculer - Trivia
When Mayura steals the Bee Miraculous from Cat Noir, she folds up her fan before introducing herself and offering Chloé to team up. But when Miraculer reassures her by saying that Mayura is on their side, the latter's fan is once again unfolded. And in the next shot, we see Mayura again handing the Bee Miraculous to Chloé, her fan folded.
When Miraculer uses Shell-ter to protect her tonfa, Carapace's hand goes through the barrier.
When Miraculer's left shoulder blade was shown before summoning Mirage, one of the emblems was erroneously shown as the ladybug icon with a neon green background.
Just like in "Malediktator" and "Catalyst", when Chloé transforms into Queen Bee, her glasses disappear and only reappear when she destransforms.
When Hawk Moth sends the akuma out of his lair, the Butterfly Miraculous is missing from his chest.

title: Miraculer/Transcript
text:

Hawk Moth: Perfect. Be ready in case Ladybug goes and hands her the Bee Miraculous.

title: Miraculer/Transcript
text:
Miraculer/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: You know how dangerous it is to use Chloé. Everybody knows that she was Queen Bee, everyone including Hawk Moth. He can use it to trap us. That's why our identities must remain a secret.
Cat Noir: And the best kept secrets are the ones you don't share, yeah-yeah, I know. I don't think Chloé knows that her time as Queen Bee is over, though.

Gabriel: Then I will get Chloé to force Ladybug to give it to her. All I need is for her to lose all hope in Ladybug. To become angry enough so I can akumatize her. (smirks evilly)
Nathalie: (smiling evilly) Maybe it's time we bring Lila Rossi's psychological talent into the plan.
Gabriel: Excellent idea, Nathalie...

title: Miraculer/Transcript
text:
Miraculer/Transcript - Intro
Lila: I really want to thank you for trusting me, Mr. Agreste. I'm very honored to be able to protect Adrien. But I'm saddened by all the people around him. Your son deserves better than that friend of his Nino. Not to mention all the girls clamoring to catch his eye, especially that Marinette dummy and that stuck-up Chloé. Chloé! Pfft! She won't stop bragging about being Queen Bee, but Adrien couldn't care less about these girls. He's just so perfect.
Gabriel: I don't think Adrien's completely indifferent to Chloé. They've had a very strong friendship ever since they were young - a relationship that no one can ruin. Thank you, Lila. I'll see you tomorrow. (car drives away)

Gabriel: I'm sure that this young lady will help us implement our grand plan.

Marinette: (glares at Lila) Yeah, let's go study for that test. (grabs Alya by her arm and they leave)

Nino: (groans)

text:

text:

title: Miraculer/Transcript
text:

title: Miraculer/Transcript
text:
Miraculer/Transcript - Intro
(Sabrina sighs in the elevator as the akuma enters the staff of her costume)
Hawk Moth: (from his lair) Miraculer, your friend has rejected you because she is only interested in other people's powers. Well, I'm giving you the power to steal those powers from them, and win back your friendship. And in return, you will bring me Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous.
Sabrina: Thank you, Hawk Moth. Chloé and I will be a real team at last! (transforms into Miraculer)

(Miraculer appears on top of the merry-go-round)

Cat Noir: (to Ladybug) I guess you didn't work things out with her, did you?
Ladybug: I was about to, but...
