title: Miraculous Chibi
text:
Miraculous Chibi - Trivia
The chibi series was originally announced to be canon to the Quantic Universe on the official Miraculous Ladybug Tumblr. However, this was later retconned by character designer Angie Nasca.
The chibi series being a separate universe makes sense due to its premise heavily containing slapstick, characters becoming comic reliefs, and not everything being taken seriously. For example, despite akumatized villains being threats, neither Ladybug nor Cat Noir are seen fighting Stormy Weather in "Panic at the Park" and she behaves like a nuisance at best.
In addition, their Quantic Universe counterparts are officially dating in their civilian identities as of Season 5. The dynamic between the two heroes in the chibi universe doesn't change to reflect their main counterpart's new relationship status; Chibi Adrien is oblivious to Chibi Marinette's feelings since he's in love with Chibi Ladybug.
The show was first announced by Jeremy Zag on his Instagram on March 5, 2017.
The drawing with the announcement was done by Angie Nasca, the character designer for this show.
On March 14, 2017, a 3D render of Chibi Ladybug was released on Zag's Instagram.

title: Miraculous Chibi
text:
Miraculous Chibi - Trivia
Another 3D render of chibi Ladybug's chibi form was posted on March 31, 2017, along with an image of chibi Pixie Girl from Fairy Force. An image of Cat Noir's chibi form in 3D was later released on April 7, 2017.
The Ladybug and Cat Noir 3D models were designed by Axel Blanc as references to produce the art figures that were later released at the ZAG Store.
The 3D chibi designs were based on Angie Nasca's design for the chibi emojis from the ZAG Heroez sticker app.
An animatic for the episode "Rooftop Dinner" was first revealed during a Miraculous live event on May 17, 2017.
On August 31, 2017, a part of "Fatal Posy" was released by Jeremy Zag on Instagram, involving Cat Noir stopping a giant flower from attacking an unaware Ladybug.
A fully animated clip of "Catnip Fragrance" featuring cats chasing Cat Noir was released on Jeremy Zag's Instagram on January 21, 2018.
Production for Miraculous: Tales from Paris has ceased to focus on the chibi series.
The first seven webisodes only featured Ladybug and Cat Noir, with Adrien appearing in pictures. Starting in the revival series, their civilian identities as well as more characters appear.

title: Miraculous Chibi
text:
Miraculous Chibi - Trivia
Despite appearing in concept art, Hawk Moth, Tikki, Plagg, Alya, Chloé, and Nino haven't appeared in the initial run of webisodes. But Chloé eventually appears in the revival series.
None of the webisodes have spoken dialogues and it, instead, has the characters making vocal effects. The vocal effects were provided by their French voice actors.
Because of a lack of spoken dialogues, the French voice actors can be heard in many international releases of the web series.
The first seven webisodes were all later released on the Disney Now website in the USA on April 11, 2021.
This is the first piece of Miraculous Ladybug media that has a revival after its initial cancellation. In this case, the web series has been revived after a five-year hiatus between "Scarybug" and two new webisodes.
The web series was initially cancelled which resulted in it being put on a five-year hiatus after the release of "Scarybug". But it's implied that production for the revival occurred so it could promote a recent line of chibi-themed figures and playsets produced by Playmate Toys.

title: Miraculous Chibi
text:
Miraculous Chibi - Trivia
Because the web series has been revived with more webisodes confirmed to be released, it's unknown if the revival will continue the original plan to have thirty webisodes total.
Various merchandise for Miraculous Chibi were released. This includes plushies and playsets manufactured by Playmate Toys, art figures and pins on the official ZAG store, pillows manufactured by Zag Play, and a Burger King kids meal promotion in August 2018.
Interestingly, the merchandise featured chibi forms of Rena Rouge, Carapace, Queen Bee, Hawk Moth, and Vesperia, despite none of these Miraculous holders appearing during the initial run of the web series.
The revival features a lot of changes from the original run:
As part of the rebranding for the web series, the logo has changed from "ZAG Chibi" to "Miraculous Chibi".
The webisodes are now animated by 2 Minutes, the name of a French animation studio, instead of Digital eMation.
Some webisodes feature the civilian life of Marinette and Adrien instead of their superhero identities. More characters, like akumatized villains, are added to the series instead of solely featuring the main duo.

title: Miraculous Chibi
text:
Miraculous Chibi - Trivia
The opening sequence and end credits have been updated, with the former showing both the civilian and superhero identities of the main duo.
The revival was originally presented as "season two", but with the announcement of the full season, the webisodes were changed to be the second part of season one.

title: Miraculous - Lou and Lenni Kim music video
text:
Miraculous - Lou and Lenni Kim music video - Intro
The French Miraculous music video is a music video of "It's Ladybug" performed by Lou and Lenni-Kim. It premiered at the press conference by TF1 on September 22, 2017 in a live performance. It is currently available on Spotify as a single in France only, and it is also available for purchase on iTunes.  In the United States, it was released on the deluxe version of Lou's album "Danser sur tes mots".  The music video was released on Lou's YouTube Channel on November 21, 2017.
The English version of the theme song premiered on the Miraculous Ladybug YouTube channel on November 25, 2017.
The French version of the "It's Ladybug" is used as the French version's theme song for Season 2.

title: Miraculous All-Star Brawl
text:
Miraculous All-Star Brawl - Intro
is a player vs. player fighting video game created by Max Kanté.

title: Miraculous All-Star Brawl
text:
Miraculous All-Star Brawl - Description
There are several rounds of one-on-one battles between akumatized villains. To win, you must either force the opponent out of bounds (only counts if the player actually touches the ground outside of the battlefield; the air and sides of the platform are safe) or break the opponents akumatized object.
The player who wins in a round is awarded the akumatized objects of both avatars added to their inventory.
This continues until all of the akumatized characters have been used. Each character can only be used once, even the other player cannot select them after they have been used.
Gamer 2.0 version
Once all of the supervillain characters have been used, Ladybug and Cat Noir fight each other to determine which one will go on to fight the final boss, Gamer 2.0. However, this may not be the case in the actual game.
After Ladybug and Cat Noir fight, the winner can select four items from their inventory of akumatized objects which they looted from their previous victories against the akumatized characters. These items will allow the player to use the powers of those villains in addition to their own.

title: Miraculous All-Star Brawl
text:
Miraculous All-Star Brawl - Description
Once the player has selected their equipment, they will fight Gamer 2.0, who, as the game master, can transform into any of the playable characters, even ones who were beaten by the other player, and switch between them at will.

title: Miraculous Cruise
text:
Miraculous Cruise - Intro
The  is a cruise through Paris based on the Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir.

title: Miraculous Cruise
text:
Miraculous Cruise - Description
|-| First Edition =
Embark on the Miraculous Cruise and discover Paris with Ladybug and Cat Noir!
An unforgettable cruise! Discover Paris on a one-hour cruise on the Seine with Ladybug and Cat Noir, the heroes of the phenomenal series Miraculous. Hop on board at the foot of the Eiffel Tower for a fun and immersive cruise aboard the Bateaux Parisiens.
A ride on the Seine that combines immersive theatre and a treasure hunt... Enjoy a relaxing hour of fun from one bridge to another with your favourite heroes, taking in the most beautiful monuments, and (re)discover Paris like you never have before along its most beautiful avenue, the River Seine. The journey begins at the foot of the Eiffel Tower.
|-| Second Edition =
Embark on the Miraculous Cruise and discover Paris with Ladybug and Cat Noir!
An unforgettable show! Discover Paris on a one-hour cruise on the Seine with Ladybug and Cat Noir, the heroes of the phenomenal series Miraculous. Hop on board at the foot of the Eiffel Tower for a fun and immersive show aboard the Bateaux Parisiens.

title: Miraculous Cruise
text:
Miraculous Cruise - Description
A ride on the Seine that combines aventures and immersive theatre... Enjoy a relaxing hour of fun from one bridge to another with your favourite heroes, taking in the most beautiful monuments, and (re)discover Paris like you never have before along its most beautiful avenue, the River Seine.The journey begins at the foot of the Eiffel Tower.

title: Miraculous Cruise
text:
Miraculous Cruise - Plot
|-| First Edition =
Ladybug is in pursuit of an enemy who travels through Paris with the aim of removing all the monuments of the city. During this race, Ladybug and Cat Noir requisition the Parisian Boats where the players are to pursue the enemy and will ask them for help by entrusting them with a very special mission: save the capital!
The investigators, real little heroes assistant to Ladybug and Cat Noir, will have to show logic, observation and analysis to be able to save Paris from an enemy who threatens to make the emblematic monuments of the capital disappear. From Notre-Dame Cathedral, to the National Assembly via the Grand Palais or the unmissable Eiffel Tower, they will have to protect Parisian monuments from the powers of the enemy, while seeking to discover its weak point. Ladybug, with the help of Cat Noir, will guide them by telling them the puzzles to solvealong the way.
|-| Second Edition =
Ladybug and Cat Noir are informed that they must counter an attack from a time-traveling acquaintance of theirs, a supervillain who wants to erase some of Paris' iconic history.

title: Miraculous Cruise
text:
Miraculous Cruise - Plot
The mission incumbent on the two heroes: to prevent the disappearance of several bridges and historical monuments of the Seine. To counter the supervillain, Ladybug and Cat Noir must find out when she intends to act. They benefit from the help of a group of passengers present on a boat. When they arrive, they receive a Journal of historical events from the Seine to help the heroes save the history of the capital!

title: Miraculous Cruise
text:
Miraculous Cruise - Trivia
This is the fourth Miraculous event following Aquarium de Paris, Musée Grévin and an virtual tour with the creators of the show.
The originally planned end of the first cruise on August 31 was extended to November 6, 2022 due to extraordinary success and great interest with adapted schedules during school periods (only Wednesdays, Saturdays and Sundays) or school holidays (excluding Mondays).
After a successful first edition, the Cruise returned in the summer of 2023 from June to August (except July 14) with a brand new adventure.
After another succes the cruise was extended to November 5.
In 2022, the price was €17 for children under 11 and €22 for children over 12, with children under 3 admitted free.
In 2023, the price increased by €2, with children under 3 admitted free (originally there wasn't free entry).

title: Miraculous (movie song)
text:
Miraculous (movie song) - Trivia
The French version differs vastly from the English version, removing Adrien/Cat Noir from the chorus completely, making him only sing his single verse.
All adlibs have been removed and the last Miraculous shout in the song has been completely removed.
The movie version in French is also vastly different from the English version and actually has part of the English chorus mixed into the first French chorus.
Instead of Ladybug and Cat Noir each getting a short solo, Cat Noir's full solo plays in the part of Ladybug's.
The last Miraculous shout was also adapted from the English dub, as it is not present in the French version of the song.
The opening instrumental is not present and starts abrubtly after Nadja Chamack finishes speaking.

title: Miraculous Ladybug OVA
text:
Miraculous Ladybug OVA - Intro
The  was a planned original anime series based on Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. It was going to be produced and animated by Toei Animation.
As of April 2017, the anime series was confirmed to have been cancelled from production due to a lack of interest from French broadcasters preventing it from being greenlighted.

title: Miraculous Ladybug OVA
text:
Miraculous Ladybug OVA - History
The OVA was first hinted at on Jeremy Zag's Instagram on December 21, 2015, when he was at Toei Animation studios in Japan for the project's development process.
During an interview with Krystal Kitsune, Jared Wolfson revealed that an anime version of Miraculous Ladybug was "something [the crew members] wanted to potentially put out".
On June 21, 2016, Wilfried Pain confirmed on Twitter that the OVA was in the writing process.
On April 3, 2017, the official Miraculous Ladybug Tumblr confirmed that the development for the anime series was cancelled.
On April 28, 2024, Thomas Astruc revealed on Twitter that the OVA had been cancelled due to the lack of interest from Western broadcasters and the cultural differences between Western animation and Japanese animation within the industry.

title: Miraculous Ladybug OVA
text:
Miraculous Ladybug OVA - History
According to Astruc, storyboards were created to pitch the project to broadcasters. However, because "the way Japanese animation studios work hardly matches with how Western broadcasters work", the French broadcasters refused to greenlight the OVA because they found it "too complicated" to understand the animation process shown on the storyboards. He explained despite the quality of 2D animation, "nobody wanted to buy the show" in the anime style. So, the crew was forced to switch to animating in CGI since the broadcasters found it "more appealing to people outside [of] anime fans" and "anime was considered a niche market by Western industry". As a result, they were only able to have the "French version" (Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir) greenlighted.

title: Miraculous Ladybug OVA
text:
Miraculous Ladybug OVA - Trivia
It's unknown if the OVA is part of the Quantic Universe continuity or a separate continuity.
Thomas Astruc hinted that the anime series might take place in a separate continuity due to the differences in art style.
Thomas mentioned that the crew brought in an interpreter to explain the animation process to the broadcasters so they could greenlight it to no avail.
Because of the lack of interest from broadcasters, he "still [hopes] that one day [they]'ll have an anime version" and believes "popular demand would help" convince them to greenlight it.
Unlike the Ladybug PV, Cat Noir was going to be Adrien instead of Félix.
Even though the OVA was never greenlighted by the French broadcasters, Toei Animation later acquired the rights in 2020 to create a manga series based on the TV series. As of 2021, the manga series was published by Kodansha.

title: Miraculous New York
text:
Miraculous New York - Intro
"Miraculous World: New York, United Heroez" (or simply "Miraculous New York") is a 60-minute special TV movie of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the writing and release order, "Miraculous New York" is the first movie in the Miraculous World series. Its world premiere was on September 25, 2020 (at 8:00 p.m ET/PT) on Disney Channel USA.

title: Miraculous New York
text:
Miraculous New York - Synopsis
Disney Channel
Marinette's class is headed to New York, the city of superheroes, for French-American Friendship Week, but the American superheroes may find themselves in need of help while there class is headed to New York, the city of superheroes, for French-American Friendship Week, but the American superheroes may find themselves in need of help while there.
Disney+
Marinette's class is headed to New York, the city of superheroes, for French-American Friendship Week. The whole class is there...except Adrien, whose father refuses to let him go!
Netflix
Visiting New York City, Ladybug and Cat Noir team up with American superheroes to stop Hawk Moth from stealing an ancient necklace holding untold powers.

title: Miraculous New York
text:
Miraculous New York - Production History
On July 25, 2016, Jeremy Zag, on Instagram, hinted at the possibility of a crossover special between Miraculous and two other ZAG Heroez shows that take place in New York City, Pixie Girl and Ghostforce.
On February 13, 2017, Jeremy revealed concept art for it and its title, noting that it is "coming soon." However, later information from the official Miraculous Twitter account states that the crossover may not involve Ghostforce.
On October 19, 2019, ON Animation Studios and Method Animation announced that they were looking for crew members to help create storyboards for the latest special episode. It was added at the time that it would be a new 52-minute episode set in New York City and titled "Miraculous New York".
On March 20, 2020, Thomas Astruc said that despite the coronavirus epidemic they are still working on the special and revealed a new character.
One day later, on March 21, Thomas Astruc posted on his Twitter a few seconds of animation with a new character that will appear in Miraculous New York special. Feri González confirmed it to be Sparrow, one of New York's superheroes.

title: Miraculous New York
text:
Miraculous New York - Production History
On March 22, 2020, Thomas Astruc posted part of a model of a new female character and added that she is his favorite future character. It was unknown where or when she would appear until Wilfried Pain confirmed that she would be in this episode.
On June 15, 2020 Jeremy Zag revealed a poster for this special with information that it will be released in 2020. On the same day, Disney France announced that the episode was scheduled to air between September 1 and October 2, 2020. The synopsis for the episode was also revealed.
On June 18, 2020 Thomas Astruc confirmed that Majestia will appear in this special.
On July 1, 2020 during TFOU conference were released some designs for new heroes as well as another synopsis for special.
On July 6, 2020 French news La Libre announced that TF1 will air both the New York and Shanghai specials during Christmas 2020.
On July 22, 2020, Thomas Astruc confirmed on his Twitter that the special will not include a crossover with Pixie Girl and Ghostforce.
On July 23, 2020, it was announced that Disney France will air NY special on September 26, 2020.

title: Miraculous New York
text:
Miraculous New York - Production History
On August 7, 2020, Mundo Gloob announced that on Miraculous Day actors will read a part of the script from the NY special.
On August 8, 2020, during Brazilian Miraculous Day, voice actors read a scene from this special: the scene where Cat Noir tries to give Ladybug a yellow rose. He explains that Ladybug refused the red rose because it symbolized love, while white represents purity. This time she needs to accept the yellow rose because it represents friendship, and Cat Noir proposes a toast for their friendship.
On September 6, 2020, Disney Channel France released the first promo for the special, using clips from season 3.
On September 11, 2020, Disney Channel France released the second promo video for the special, also with clips from season 3.
On September 12, 2020, spoilers from the NY special were revealed by Lévanah SOLOMON's Family YouTube Channel.
On September 16, 2020, Disney Channel France released the third promo video for the special, now with spoilers. On the same day, the Miraculous conference/masterclass was held with the participation of the creator of the show, Thomas Astruc, and the main screenwriter, Sébastien Thibaudeau to promote the NY special.

title: Miraculous New York
text:
Miraculous New York - Production History
On September 17, 2020, Disney Channel France released the fourth promo video for the special.
On September 18, 2020, Disney Channel France released the fifth promo video for the NY special.
On September 19, 2020, Disney Channel US released a teaser trailer for the NY special.
On September 20, 2020, Disney Channel US released a trailer for the Frozen Apple Special event, which included a marathon of Miraculous episodes, the New York special and the Disney feature film Frozen.
On September 21, 2020, the official Miraculous Youtube Channel released the official trailer for New York special.
On September 24, 2020, Swiss TV channel RTS released a promo for the NY special. On the same day, Brazilian channel Gloob released a teaser for the special, which didn't include any spoilers.

title: Miraculous New York
text:
Miraculous New York - Plot
The episode begins as Ladybug and Cat Noir are battling Mr. Pigeon for the fifty-first time, the villain and all of his pigeons carrying the Eiffel Tower up into the sky with the intention of taking over the moon, "where no one can hear them coo." Ladybug and Cat Noir use their space power up to chase after him. Alya Césaire is documenting the battle from the ground, dubbing the heroes Cosmobug and Astrocat in their space forms. After the villain is deakumatized in the office at the top of the Eiffel Tower, Cat Noir gives Ladybug a yellow rose which symbolizes friendship. She at first rejects it, sarcastically asking, "Are you sure yellow roses don't represent jealousy?". This makes Cat Noir flustered, questioning which rose actually symbolizes jealousy. Ladybug then assures Cat Noir that he doesn't have to give her flowers because he is the best partner ever.

title: Miraculous New York
text:
Miraculous New York - Plot
To celebrate the friendship between France and the United States, Marinette's class is traveling to Manhattan, New York City. Unfortunately, Caline Bustier would not be able to go, as she has just learned that she is pregnant. While everyone is happy for her, the students immediately become upset when they find out that Ms. Mendeleiev would be chaperoning instead. The students don't hesitate to complain about how much they don't like her, which Ms. Mendeleiev overhears. Everyone is excited for the trip. However, Adrien is sure that his father will refuse to let him go. Determined not to let Adrien stay alone in Paris with Lila Rossi, Marinette declares her intention to speak to Adrien's father and convince him to let Adrien go.

title: Miraculous New York
text:
Miraculous New York - Plot
Meanwhile in Agreste mansion, Gabriel Agreste sees a video of a necklace that Marquis de Lafayette gave to George Washington during the Revolutionary War and Nathalie Sancoeur realizes Gabriel it might be a lost Miraculous: the Eagle Miraculous. The conversation disturbed by the doorbell, Gabriel sees through his security cameras and it's Adrien Classmates. When Marinette comes to speak with him about letting Adrien go on the trip to New York, he doesn't hesitate to permit Adrien to go. Since Gabriel is also secretly going to New York to take the Eagle Miraculous, he won't have to worry about explaining his absence, and he'll be able to keep an eye on Adrien. Marinette and the other classmates really get happy because they think Marinette is the reason Gabriel is letting Adrien go to New York.

title: Miraculous New York
text:
Miraculous New York - Plot
While coming back to home, Tikki get worried about Paris' villain and Cat Noir on which Marinette tells Tikki she has an idea. In anticipation of her departure, Ladybug asks Cat Noir to watch over Paris but does not specify the reasons for her absence. She gives Cat Noir a device that can signal her to come home immediately if there is trouble, and he should take the mission very seriously. Cat Noir accepts it, unknown to him his father has plans for him to go to New York. After finding out that he can go on the trip, Adrien doesn't know what to do; he wants to go with his friends, but Ladybug had placed her trust in him to watch over Paris. After some convincing from Plagg, Adrien ultimately decides to abandon Paris to accompany his friends.

title: Miraculous New York
text:
Miraculous New York - Plot
When boarding the plane, Marinette is flabbergasted to find out that she will be sitting next to Adrien. Knowing that she won't be able to emotionally handle sitting next to Adrien for several hours, she tries to get a new seat, but Ms. Mendeleiev refuses. After hearing that Miss Bustier would have agreed, Ms. Mendeleiev gives Marinette her own seat. During the flight over while most of the passengers are asleep, Marinette and Adrien watch a sunset through a window, and Adrien thanks Marinette for convincing his father to let him come to New York. The plane is suddenly attacked by the American supervillain Techno Pirate, but they are rescued by American superheroes Majestia, Knightowl, Uncanny Valley, and Sparrow.

title: Miraculous New York
text:
Miraculous New York - Plot
The plane safely lands in Manhattan; the students take in the sights; and they attend a rooftop party, hosted by the Armstrong High School students from Queens who are also attending the same field trip as the French students, after curfew and without the permission of Ms. Mendeleiev who earlier that evening had ordered a strict lights out. The next day, the French and American students visit a museum, covertly observed by Uncanny and Sparrow in their civilian identities of Aeon and Jess. Meanwhile, Hawk Moth akumatizes Techno Pirate as he is being taken to prison and sends the newly-dubbed Techlonizer to steal the Marquis de Lafayette's sword. While Techlonizer is breaking into the museum, Adrien gets a news update on his phone, saying that Robostus is rampaging through Paris. Adrien wonders how it could be as Max had brought Markov to New York with them. Marinette immediately deduces that it had to be a sentimonster created by Mayura.

title: Miraculous New York
text:
Miraculous New York - Plot
Uncanny, Sparrow, Ladybug, and Cat Noir attempt to subdue Techlonizer. Sparrow tries to call for backup, but Techlonizer damages her communicator. Sparrow doesn't care for long, though, seeing this as a chance for her and Uncanny to prove themselves. Meanwhile, Hawk Moth's true plan has been a success: While the heroes were busy fighting Techlonizer, he was able to walk in and steal the Eagle Miraculous unopposed. The heroes manage to get the upper hand, Cat Noir apologizes to Ladybug for not telling her that he was with her. Ladybug angrily decides to never trust him since he left Paris defenseless. Cat Noir becomes stunned by this word, while he's been distracted, Technolizer grabs Cat Noir and throws him and Cat Noir accidentally destroys Uncanny with an errant Cataclysm. Majestia finds out and yells a giant "NOOOOOOOOO" while flying down from the stratosphere and then punches Techlonizer, making him smash through several buildings.

title: Miraculous New York
text:
Miraculous New York - Plot
Majestia then cries over her dead daughter. Ladybug uses her Miraculous Ladybug to revive her, but an angered Knightowl suspends Sparrow for disobeying protocol and demands the French heroes surrender their Miraculouses. The two flee into the sewers, where Ladybug breaks down sobbing upon knowing that they had taken too long to deal with the sentimonster: Paris had been wrecked; and since Mayura had already destroyed the sentimonster, she couldn't fix the damage. A broken Cat Noir, feeling guilty for all the mistakes he had made and letting Ladybug down, renounces the Cat Miraculous as penance for his failures, leaving Ladybug crestfallen and alone. After deakumatizing and picking up Techno Pirate and returning to his hotel room, Gabriel tests the pendant, and to his satisfaction, it is, in fact, the Miraculous of the Eagle.
Majestia and Knightowl, in their civilian forms, bring Aeon and Jess back to the hotel and they forbids them from tracking down Techno Pirate again for good for making mistakes earlier.
Hawk Moth again akumatizes Techno Pirate and gives him the Eagle Miraculous on top of that.

title: Miraculous New York
text:
Miraculous New York - Plot
Meanwhile, the class spots Marinette and Adrien outside the hotel. A car pulls up, and inside, over video chat, is Gabriel Agreste, who tells Adrien to get in the car and that he should've never let him come to New York. Adrien tells Marinette that he would've liked to stay with a friend like her and then drives away. Alya asks Marinette if she is really fine with letting Adrien leave. Marinette tries to argue that Adrien made his choice, but Alya argues that Marinette's feelings are just as important. So Marinette runs after Adrien, crying for him to come back and, as she stumbles, tearfully confesses that she loves him.
At Times Square, Techlonizer, now Miraclonizer, uses the Eagle's power of Liberation to free the American heroes from their ethical constraints, causing them to go berserk. With the heroes incapacitated, Miraclonizer uses his technopathy to project Hawk Moth's message across every screen in Manhattan, telling Ladybug and Cat Noir to hand over their Miraculouses.

title: Miraculous New York
text:
Miraculous New York - Plot
Uncanny, able to see through other people's identities, goes to recruit Ladybug and Cat Noir while Sparrow tries to contain the crisis. Uncanny finds and recruits Marinette, then goes to return the Cat Miraculous to Adrien. At first, Adrien is hesitant, but Uncanny plays back a recording of Marinette saying that she can't be Ladybug without him. Adrien becomes Cat Noir again and flies back to New York with Uncanny but notes that he had to get back before the plane lands.
Once Cat Noir and Uncanny rendezvous with Ladybug and Sparrow, they come up with a plan to manipulate Doorman into helping them infiltrate the Statue of Liberty, where Miraclonizer is waiting to launch a missile on Hawk Moth's order if Ladybug and Cat Noir don't surrender.
They manage to get the Eagle Miraculous, and Sparrow, now Eagle, uses the power of the Eagle Miraculous to dispel the effects of Miraclonizer's use of Liberation. The villain manages to fire the missile, but it is stopped and destroyed by Majestia.

title: Miraculous New York
text:
Miraculous New York - Plot
The four young heroes defeat and deakumatize Techno Pirate and restore everything to normal. Ladybug tells Eagle to keep the Eagle Miraculous, knowing that it's in good hands. Majestia and Knightowl congratulate their protégés and admit that they should give them more freedom to grow.
The French and American students enjoy the big festival and fireworks show on the final day of their trip, and back in Paris, the repair work has begun. Hawk Moth realizes there are more lost Miraculouses he can travel the world to claim.
After the French Heroes return home, Uncanny Valley and Eagle are about to ambush a group of criminals in an alleyway before a man — a Guardian with the Native American Miracle Box — appears and demands the Eagle Miraculous be returned. Eagle proposes that, instead, he should help start a new generation of heroes in New York. Though his answer remains unknown, the man seems genuinely intrigued by the idea.

title: Miraculous New York
text:
Miraculous New York - Plot Development
The events of this special take place between season 3 and season 4, therefore it's the second special in main Miraculous series chronologically.
Since various footage of the movie was removed and some of it mentions Chloé visiting her mother it's likely Audrey returned to New York some time after celebrating her 20 year marriage with André in "Miracle Queen".
With no appearance of Hawk Moth as Shadow Moth and with Nathalie still bedridden and her using the Peacock Miraculous offscreen that means the Peacock Miraculous either wasn't fixed yet or Gabriel didn't use it yet.
Additionally, Adrien and Kagami are shown to be in a relationship, carrying over from the ending of "Miracle Queen".
However, there is no mention of Marinette being the Guardian, nor does she seem concerned about leaving the Miracle Box at France, contrary to "Hack San".
The space power-up is shown for the second time, following "Miraculous Shanghai", and the names for these forms are revealed to be Cosmobug and Astrocat respectively.
It's also revealed that when Ladybug and Cat Noir power up, they don't need to feed the power up potion to their Kwamis, but instead can eat it themselves while transformed.

title: Miraculous New York
text:
Miraculous New York - Plot Development
This episode reveals the existence of another Miraculous, the Eagle Miraculous, and by extension, the Eagle Kwami, named Liiri. It also confirms that, while the Chinese Miracle Box is located in Paris, there are many more Miraculous that exist all over the world.
This also confirms that the Dormant Sentimonster created by Master Fu didn't actually eat all the Miraculouses (with the exception of the ones in the Chinese Miracle Box), as there are lost Miraculous spread around the world, having only eaten the ones existing at the temple at that moment.
Some plot holes and questions from the show's beginning are made clearer or answered in this special:
Kwamis not only don't show up in films or photographs, but can't be observed by any form of human technology such as artificial intelligence like Uncanny Valley and Markov.
The Miraculous have an ability to magically disguise the identity of the wearer to human observers. However, advanced AI is not affected by this, which is why Uncanny Valley was able to recognize Marinette and Adrien as Ladybug and Cat Noir.

title: Miraculous New York
text:
Miraculous New York - Plot Development
Ladybug's Lucky Charm gives her an object to use against a specific threat, and when Miraculous Ladybug is used with that object, it repairs all damage caused by that threat. This explains why Ladybug was able to repair the damage done by Techlonizer, but couldn't do anything about the damage caused by the Robostus sentimonster in Paris.
Even after the villain is de-akumatized, as in "Weredad", "Kwamibuster" and "Miracle Queen", Ladybug is still able to summon a Lucky Charm and repair the damage done by the villain because those objects were used for a different purpose.
For the Ladybug Miraculous holder to fix damage that has been caused by other forms of Miraculous magic despite a time gap, the villain or sentimonster must still exist in some shape or form.
The only other way a Lucky Charm object could repair damage done by multiple villains would be if they were all akumatized at the same time or by the same akuma seen in "Miraculous Shanghai" and "Félix".

title: Miraculous New York
text:
Miraculous New York - Plot Development
Also, on an interesting note, if a holder activates a Miraculous superpower, then in turn loses the jewel to another person and said new holder deactivates it, it's unknown if the timer will be activated leading to the new holder detransforming as well.
Like with Ladybug and the Magical Charms, Gabriel had put a hindrance to his own operations at the episode's end he mentioned that he would scour the world to find the other missing jewels. However he may have forgotten the events of "Feast" by freeing the guardians and yet being so obsessed with the French Duo he allowed them to get a head start in finding the jewels that are already missing. To top that off he doesn't even know which ones are still missing.

title: Miraculous New York
text:
Miraculous New York - Trivia
Originally, this special was titled "Ladybug in New York City".
It has also been called "Miraclonizer", after the main villain of the episode.
The first concept art seen for "Miraculous New York" is almost an exact replica in structure to Pixie Girl's promotional art where Pixie Girl looks down on New York City.
This is one of eleven episodes that are at least partly set in locations outside of Paris, including "Startrain", "Miraculous Shanghai", "Multiplication", "Representation", "Conformation", "Re-creation", "Miraculous Rio", "Miraculous Dakar", "Miraculous London" and "Miraculous Tokyo".
Caline Bustier is revealed to be pregnant.
Just as Gilbert gave the Eagle Miraculous to George Washington as a sign of friendship and trust, Ladybug and Cat Noir allowed Eagle to keep it for the same reason.
The American superhero team is shown onscreen for the first time.
Although it's never mentioned within the special, the borough where both Miss Bustier's class and Professor Gate's class visited for their field trip is Manhattan.
It is revealed that Placide I.T. has a fear of flying.

title: Miraculous New York
text:
Miraculous New York - Trivia
When Marinette touches Adrien after quickly entering a room, she immediately moves her hand from the latter and they both look toward to the camera breaking the fourth wall.
According to Thomas Astruc, the first version of the script could have made a two hour movie. Story arcs were planned for Ms. Mendeleiev, Mr. Damoclès and Chloé, but they had to be cut. Despite the story arcs being removed from the movie, it's unknown if they'll be used in future episodes or not.
As revealed in a video posted on the official Miraculous YouTube channel, these story arcs included the relationship between Sabrina and Delmar, Chloé visiting New York to see her mother, and Mr. Damoclès discovering the city's night life. Another deleted scene would have Adrien and Marinette trying to comfort Chloé after the party on the hotel roof.
This special marks the beginning of Zeno Robinson voicing Nino.

title: Miraculous New York
text:
Miraculous New York - Trivia
The cities targeted by missiles were Atlanta, Baltimore, Boston, Charlotte, Chicago, Cincinnati, Cleveland, Dallas, Denver, Detroit, El Paso, Houston, Indianapolis, Kansas City, Los Angeles, Miami, Minneapolis, Orlando, Philadelphia, Phoenix, Pittsburgh, Portland, Sacramento, Salt Lake City, San Diego, San Francisco, Seattle, St. Louis, Tampa, and Washington D.C. Had these missiles reached those cities, the explosions would have spread to Canada and Mexico as well and Hawk Moth and Techno-Pirate would have been named the largest mass murderers in history. In addition, the destruction would have crippled the US as a functioning nation and had global economic and political repercussions.
Hawk Moth's actions in this special (threatening to launch a nuclear missile unless given the Miraculous) would have resulted in him being labelled a nuclear terrorist, as his actions could have sparked a nuclear world war.

title: Miraculous New York
text:
Miraculous New York - Trivia
In the French dub, it is revealed that Dean Gate/Doorman is a teacher at Armstrong High School and by extension, Jessica and Aeon are both his students. When Jessica was texting to Doorman so she could trick him into helping the four young heroes infiltrate the Statue of Liberty, she refers to him as "professeur" which is a French word for either "professor" or "teacher". However, in the same exact scene for the English dub, it was never revealed and Jessica instead refers to him simply as "sir".
This is the first time where the people of Paris had to clean up the damage caused by a villain or sentimonster.
The ice statue of the young heroes was the same one shown in the beginning and ending of the film.
This version of the Statue of Liberty has a torch platform that Ladybug and Cat Noir were able to access just fine, but the real one's torch platform has been off limits for about a century.
According to the beginning scene that zooms out to the world, other Miraculouses and Miracle Boxes besides Paris and New York are in Greece, Norway, Egypt, Tibet, China, India, Australia, Maldives, and numerous other places around the world.

title: Miraculous New York
text:
Miraculous New York - Trivia
Some of those said locations are the home of past Miraculous holders, like the first holders from China (Húdié, Piáo Chóng, Hēi Māo, Húlí, Mìfēng, Kǒngquè), Hippolyta from Greece and Khepri from Egypt.
Animators Alex Hirsch (creator of Gravity Falls) and Dana Terrace (creator of The Owl House) both have cameos in the special. Disney Channel airs all three of the cartoons.
This special marks the last time to have Cassandra Lee Morris as the voice actor for Sabrina Raincomprix and Pollen, as she left the show due to issues regarding low payment royalties.
In the Thai dub, Olympia calling Barbara "Honey" was censored on Disney Channel, but is included on Disney+.
Possibly because the line was added afterwards, the former's seemingly voiced by a different actress.
References
This is the third time Adrien has to be in two places at once following "Simon Says" and "Gorizilla".
Cat Noir giving Ladybug a rose is a callback to the episode "Frozer". Though this time, it is not in an act of flirting and more of (as he specifies) an act of friendship, as he offers a yellow rose which in floriography represents friendship.

title: Miraculous New York
text:
Miraculous New York - Trivia
It's the third time Miraculous related content was aired in the US before being aired in other countries after "Captain Hardrock" and "Ikari Gozen", later being followed by "Wishmaker", "Ladybug Saves Christmas", "Qilin", "Risk", and "Daddycop".
Adrien briefly renounces Plagg and his Miraculous before giving it to Ladybug. He had threatened to do so before in "Syren", but this is the first time he actually goes through with it.
This is also the fifth time Adrien is separated from his Miraculous following "Lady Wifi", "The Dark Owl", "Reflekdoll" and "Feast".
Unlike "Lady Wifi" and "Feast" but like "The Dark Owl" and "Reflekdoll", Adrien willingly removed his ring.
This marks the fourth time someone who is not Marinette is seen wearing pajamas, being Nathalie, following Alya and her younger sisters in "Sapotis".
It is revealed that Nathalie lives in the Agreste mansion. It's not clear whether she has always lived there or only does so because she's bedridden from excessive use of the Peacock Miraculous.
This is the fifth time where a character or characters are killed on screen, following "Timebreaker", "Miraculous Shanghai", "Cat Blanc", and "Ladybug".

title: Miraculous New York
text:
Miraculous New York - Trivia
This is the tenth time where Cat Noir used his powers on someone else following "Dark Cupid", "Princess Fragrance", "Despair Bear", "Troublemaker", "Malediktator", "Miraculous Shanghai" "Miraculer", "Cat Blanc", and "Ladybug".
This is episode marks the most uses of Ladybug's powers, with a total of three times.
In the summoning of her last Lucky Charm, a new summoning background was shown.
This is the second time since "Weredad" where she didn't summon her Lucky Charm in usual position as Ladybug was sitting down instead of standing up.
This is the eleventh time where Ladybug's Lucky Charm is an object from a previous episode. She receives a keychain, just like in "Miracle Queen".
This is the fourth time where we see things from a character's perspective following "Stormy Weather", "Miraculous Shanghai" and "Oblivio".
Cat Noir states a sentiment already shared by Master Fu in "Stoneheart" — that Marinette and Adrien were made for each other.
Upon seeking Ladybug and returning Adrien's ring, Uncanny Valley recites the same line her mother did in Miraculous Adventures Issue 2.

title: Miraculous New York
text:
Miraculous New York - Trivia
The slow-dance song, as with "The Bubbler" and "Despair Bear", has a distinct auditory resemblance to the guitar solo in "I Won't Hold You Back" by Toto.
This is second time following "Startrain" where an akumatized villain went out of Hawk Moth's range.
This the tenth episode in which Cataclysm is summoned twice, after "Simon Says", "Copycat", "The Dark Owl", "Mayura", "Santa Claws", "Miraculous Shanghai", "Weredad", "Oblivio", and "Cat Blanc".
Allusions
As seen in a flashback, Jessica and her mother are the fifth generation of Knightowl and Sparrow. The first generation of the pair are shown as cowboy partners; the first cowboys didn't appear until the 1880s, which would mean that the legacy of Knightowl and Sparrow is (as of the special's timeline) about 136 years old.
Present-day Knightowl and Sparrow, despite both being female, disguised themselves as male referring to what Hua Mulan did in both Disney versions of Mulan. This was also to carry on the Knightowl tradition that started back in the 1880s.
Errors
The Eagle Miraculous temporarily disappears after Techlonizer breaks into the museum.
Clara Contard's eyelash and brows are miscolored gray.

text:

On the map of US Major cities that the nuclear missiles were meant to be sent at, some major cities are missing such as Austin, Birmingham, Buffalo, Columbus, Fort Worth, Jacksonville, Lexington, Louisville, Milwaukee, Nashville, San Antonio, and Tucson.

title: Miraculous New York
text:
Miraculous New York - Trivia
This is probably for the better, as if more cities were hit, then the US and neighboring countries would have suffered greater losses.
When surrounding Techlonizer on the roof and Ladybug summons her Lucky Charm, she yells "Lucky Charm!" without opening her mouth, the sequence seemingly being reused from "Silencer".
When Marinette puts her hand on the left side of the door, Aeon uses her powers to open it. In the next shot, Marinette's hand is on the right side.

At the end of the special, the wrong flag of France was shown. The red part is touching the flagpole, when in reality the blue one should.
Throughout the whole episode, the area around Hawk Moth's eyes is darker than usual, making it look as if he's wearing eyeliner.

title: Miraculous New York
text:
Miraculous New York - Trivia
When Cat Noir returned to Ladybug, he detransformed out of his Astro form but didn't say the words to deactivate it. Maybe when a young holder grows they don't need to say the detransformation words to remove their powered up transformations just like how an adult doesn't need a trigger word to activate their superpowers.
When Ladybug is saving Sparrow from Victory's missles, she can be seen with another yo-yo wrapped around her waist.
When Alya sees Marinette outside, Camilla Hombee's eyes and eye sockets are all black.
However, it may be because she wears black eyeshadow.
In one scene where the French American Heroes were trying to chase Sparrow, both Hurricane and Sting's suit were miscolored.
In one shot inside Marinette's purse when she is walking sadly after Adrien's renunciation of his Miraculous, Plagg is gone; in his place seems to be a creepy, discolored Nooroo.
When Juleka and Rose are looking at Majestia through the airplane window, Juleka's hair goes through her shoulder.
When Sparrow landed on the plane, she had wings as part of her suit. However, she didn't have any wings as part of his suit throughout the rest of the special.

title: Miraculous New York
text:
Miraculous New York - Trivia
When Doorman opens a portal to help the kids escape, his glasses are missing the pink glass in them.
Normally in New York City, the streets are packed. Yet in this episode there was no one except the main characters on the street.
This can also be said for Paris in the rest of the episodes, as it has 2 million inhabitants and many more tourists, yet there seem to be no more than 30 people in any given scene.
This is averted in "Miraculous Shanghai", where there are considerably more people in scenes set in the city.
At the end, in the scene with fireworks where the flags of USA and France are shown, the French flag is shown colored in reverse, with the red part being on the hoist side (the side near the flagpole). In the correct orientation the red part should be on the fly side (the part flying away from the flagpole) and the blue part should be near the flagpole.
In this case hoist side and fly side mean respectively left and right as the French flag (as well as almost all national flags) is hoisted on the left side, flying to the right from the flagpole.

title: Miraculous New York/Transcript
text:
Miraculous New York/Transcript - Intro
Mr. Pigeon: Since Paris doesn't want us, we'll just go to the Moon, just like in Jules Verne's book!
(Ladybug and Cat Noir fly up and follow him, latched on to the floating Eiffel Tower via Ladybug's yo-yo.)

Ladybug: (she then looks at her Lucky Charm)
Mr. Pigeon: Come, my dear pigeons! In space, NO ONE CAN HEAR YOU COO!

(Ladybug and Cat Noir use the purple space power-ups.)

title: Miraculous New York/Transcript
text:
Miraculous New York/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: (shows Ladybug a yellow rose) There you go! Oops, you've said that already!
Ladybug: (distressed) Cat Noir, I've told you to stop bringing me flowers!
Cat Noir: Yeah, I know. When I tried to offer you a red rose, you told me that red symbolizes "passion", so you refused it! And I offered you a white rose, but you said that white stood for "pure love", and you refused it too! So now I'm offering you a yellow rose, because I've looked it up and yellow represents friendship. Here's to a perfect partnership.
Ladybug: Are you sure yellow roses don't represent jealousy?
Cat Noir: Uh- No. That would be blue roses? Hang on! No, purple!! Or was it orange? (Ladybug looks amused)
Ladybug: (chuckles) You don't need to give me flowers! I already know you're the best partner ever, Cat Noir. (smells the rose) It smells really good anyway. Thanks, kitty! (uses her yo-yo and swings away)
Cat Noir: (sighs dreamily as Ladybug leaves) She's so amazing. And so am I, by the way. I should be giving myself flowers!
[Detransformation Sequence]Ladybug: Spots off!(Ladybug detransforms back into Marinette)

title: Miraculous New York/Transcript
text:

(Tikki breathes heavily, Marinette gives a cookie to Tikki and puts her to her bag and runs off to school.)

I can even look into his beautiful green eyes without getting mesmerized! (looks at an Adrien poster. After a while, she grins, nervously, and lovingly) Eeee... ah....

title: Miraculous New York/Transcript
text:

Miss Bustier: (clapping her hands with Mr. Damoclès) Congratulations! That truly was a sensational student film!

(All students cheer in excitement except Adrien.)

title: Miraculous New York/Transcript
text:

Lila: (leans back) I'm stuck in Paris too! I have obligations because of my charity work, but we could see each other, if you'd like.
(Marinette, watching from afar, growls angrily)
Adrien: (chuckles nervously) Thanks, Lila!
Marinette: NO!
(Everyone gasps at Marinette.)
Marinette: (forced) Uh-? I mean... no! We made that film together, all of us! Which means Adrien must come with me! Uhh... I mean, us! He's our friend and you don't let a friend down! Just like in the film, when sock-Lafayette comes and helps his friend sock-Washington find freedom. (points at Adrien) Adrien, you're our sock-Washington!! You're our friend! And as your friend, it is my duty to go and see your father and convince him to let you come with us!!
(Lila looks angry)
All students: YEAH!!!
Rose: And we're coming with you!
Adrien: Thank you, Marinette. But my father's a difficult man to convince.
Marinette: I will never let a friend down!
Alya: Adrien? Your friend?
Marinette: Absolutely! It was time I moved on! It was so painful, not being able to tell him how I felt. It made me act completely crazy!
Alix: (clears throat) No kidding!

title: Miraculous New York/Transcript
text:
Miraculous New York/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (lovingly) Oh! It's so liberating to finally just be Adrien's friend instead of "The girl who's in love with Adrien"! I no longer get lost in his beautiful green eyes, and no longer spray his Adrien number four cologne on my pillow, and I even stopped binge-watching my montage of his best ads!

Clara: That's right, Nadja! For the first time ever and only until Sunday, the museum is putting Lafayette's sabre on display, as well as the  eagle-talon necklace he gave George Washington.
Nathalie: (in call on bed in her room) This is no mere jewel. Eagle talon is without a doubt a lost Miraculous.
(Doorbell rings. He sees Marinette and her friends on the security camera outside.)

title: Miraculous New York/Transcript
text:
