(Marinette appears in Gabriel's mansion.)
Marinette: And that's what makes our friendship so precious! And since your son is my friend- I mean our friend, that means he has to come to New York with us!
Gabriel: Young lady, I-
Marinette: I WON'T leave this place UNTIL you've-
Gabriel: I've decided to let Adrien go along with his classmates!
Marinette: Um- You have? But usually...
Gabriel: You've convinced me. You really are a good friend to my son.
(Outside, they cheer at Marinette. Nathalie and Gabriel watch them from Nathalie's window)
Nathalie: She just unknowingly offered you an unexpected opportunity.
Gabriel: Yes. Letting Adrien go to New York will be simpler than hiding my absence here from him. Besides, this will allow me to continue keeping an eye on him.
Kagami: What's wrong, Adrien?
Adrien: My whole class is going to New York tomorrow. I wish I could be going with them.
Kagami: I'm sad for you, but happy for us. This'll give us more time to practice. When you're as weak as you were today, the pleasure of beating you is lessened. (kisses him) I'll see you tomorrow.
Adrien: See you tomorrow, Kagami. (sighs)

title: Miraculous New York/Transcript
text:
Miraculous New York/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (singing)♫ New York, New York, ♫♫ I'm going to New York with Adrien Agreste! ♫
(Tikki looks at Marinette.)
Marinette: Uh... As friends, of course! (giggles nervously)
Tikki: By the way, Marinette, who's going to protect Paris while we're in the US for the week?
Marinette: All taken care of, my Tikki!
Cat Noir: You're going away?!
Ladybug: Only for a few days. It's nothing important, kitty-cat! But I can't tell you anymore, in-
Cat Noir: In order to protect our secret identities. I know the drill, M'Lady.
Ladybug: But in case, anything happens in Paris, an akumatized villain, a Sentimonster, anything... All you have to do is click here and I'll come back as fast as I can. (Cat Noir presses the remote button several times in excitement, making the toy in Ladybug's hand squeak) For emergencies only, of course!
Cat Noir: Of course! Just go and rest easy. I'll be Paris' substitute guardian! Am I not the perfect partner after all?
Ladybug: I'm counting on you. No funny business, OK?
Cat Noir: Have I ever struck you as the funny kind? I'm as serious as they get! (presses button again)
(Ladybug groans in annoyance)
Adrien: I... I can go to New York? Really??

title: Miraculous New York/Transcript
text:
Miraculous New York/Transcript - Intro
Gabriel: You can thank your friend Marinette for convincing me.
Adrien: But... Actually, I hadn't planned on... What about my fencing lessons? And Chinese?
Gabriel: Nathalie has already packed your bags. Your bodyguard will go with you. You take off this afternoon.
(The Gorilla retches.)
Adrien: Uh... Yes, very well, Father.
Plagg: I've been dreaming about this ever since the special New York Addition of the Gentlemen's Cheese came out! Blue Marble Jack, Cougar Gold, the legendary Monterrey... All those wonderful American cheeses are just waiting for us to taste them!
Adrien: We can't go, Plagg. I promised Ladybug I'd watch over Paris, and I don't wanna let her down.
Plagg: But your father will never let you stay! You want more freedom, and, for once, your father is letting you have fun! Enjoy!! You'll be in New York with your friends!
Adrien: She's gonna be so disappointed.
Plagg: Of course not! She can't be if she doesn't know! Besides, she told you not to call unless a supervillain shows up. See any supervillains in the house?
Adrien: What if something happens while we're gone?
Plagg: Don't you have an Akuma alert on your phone?

title: Miraculous New York/Transcript
text:
Miraculous New York/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: Of course! And in case of emergency, I can transform into Astrocat to fly back quickly!
Plagg: Perfect! And then you can tell Ladybug!
Adrien: That way, she'll never be disappointed!
Plagg and Adrien: (they fist bump) POUND IT!
Gabriel: My love, being far away from you will be nothing short of torture. But I may have found a piece of jewellery in New York, (places a red rose on her glass coffin) which might enable me to beat Ladybug and Cat Noir, to get their Miraculous and to make the wish that will bring you back to me. (walks away)
(Alya, inside the bus, looks worried and tries to call Marinette. Meanwhile, the bus is being chased by Luka and Marinette, who are riding on his bike.)
Marinette: Oh, I'm sorry, Luka. We'll never catch up to the bus!
Luka: Of course, we will! I know how important this trip is to you.
Marinette: You're saying it's important because of Adrien, right? But what's important is not at Adrien will be there, you know? I mean, it's important to me, it's important to Adrien, because it's an important trip, but it's not important to me, 'cause he's just a friend!
(Alya is seen on the bus and sighs and looks at Marinette and Luka. She gasps)

title: Miraculous New York/Transcript
text:
Miraculous New York/Transcript - Intro
Alya: Look! Marinette!
(Mr. Damoclès and Olga Mendeleiev look at Marinette and Luka riding the bike. The bus stops. Marinette takes her suitcase and takes her helmet off.)
Luka: You know what's important, Marinette? That this trip helps you get some clarity.
Marinette: Thank you, Luka. (kisses him)
(Marinette hops in the bus and looks at his friends except Adrien. Marinette blushes nervously and walks in. The bus leaves as Luka stands with his bike. The camera pans upwards as the bus continues to drive away.)
Chloé: Yes, turns out you're in luck, I'm coming. (Everyone gasps) But only because I decided to. (nervous chuckle) But there is no way I'm travelling in these conditions. I'm going to sit down in first class! (walks away with Sabrina)
(Adrien sees a "Ladybug and Cat Noir" magazine and replaces it. He browses all movies, "Les aventures de Ladybug & Chat Noir", "Natura", and "Devastation". Adrien gasps and sees the "Miraculous Music Video" and groans. He notices Marinette looking for her seat.)
Adrien: Hey, Marinette! What's your seat number?
Marinette: Baby... uh- BBB! 32B..
Adrien: Oh, great! You're sitting next to me!
(Marinette is shocked with a loud gasp.)

title: Miraculous New York/Transcript
text:
Miraculous New York/Transcript - Intro
Alya: Awesome, Marinette! Go and sit next to your friend! So you two can enjoy a nice flight together! (smiles super smug; with a teasing voice-tone) A very loooong flight.
Marinette: Uh-? Sure! Next to my husband... I mean friend... no problem! (chuckles grinningly)
(Adrien picks up Marinette's suitcase and takes a seat.)
Marinette: He's a friend. Just a friend. He's just a friend. (sits down while breathing heavily)
Adrien: Um, everything OK?
Marinette: Oh, yeah, yeah, great! WOO-HOO! It's a little hot in here, isn't it! (giggles nervously) I just-...
Adrien: Here. Let me help you.
(Marinette gasps in shock and drops into her seat. Her seat falls and completely reclines, causing Adrien to trip and fall on top of her as well. Marinette's face turns red)
Adrien: Oh, sorry!
Marinette: No, I'm fine!!
Adrien: Are you feeling cooler now?
Marinette: Gee! No! Not at all! It must be the seat! It's a warming seat, right? Ooh! It's burning hot!
Adrien: Um... No... It's a regular seat. But you can have mine if you like. Come on, let's switch!
(Marinette quickly runs away.)
Marinette: Help, Alya! I can't sit next to him! I might need more training to be just his friend after all!!

title: Miraculous New York/Transcript
text:
Miraculous New York/Transcript - Intro
Alya: There's still time to get off the plane, because New York is THE most romantic city in the world, after Paris, obviously.
Alya: (o.s.) New York is, like, carriage rides with pretty white horses, little dogs and kittens on your lap, the sun setting over Central Park, the ferry to Liberty Island!
Marinette: AAAH!!!! I HAVE TO GET OUTTA HERE!!
Olga Mendeleiev: (shouting from Marinette) What's going on?!
Alya: Marinette gets airsick. It would be better if she could sit at the centre at the plane.
Olga Mendeleiev: Out of the question! Each student is to keep the seat they have been assigned!
Alix: (appears) Oh, Ms. Bustier would've totally have said yes!
Rose: Please, Olga Mendeleiev? This is a plane, not a classroom!
Olga Mendeleiev: Wha-...? All right, fine! You may have my seat, Marinette.
Adrien: Guess I'll see you later, then?
Marinette: Right! Later! Much later! I mean, see you later!
P.A.: We are about to take off. Please put up your tray tables and fasten your seatbelts.

title: Miraculous New York/Transcript
text:
Miraculous New York/Transcript - Intro
Soothing Voice on Gorrila's phone: On a scale of one to ten, how would you rate your fear of flying? (The Gorilla types in 10) Select the relaxation level you require. (The Gorilla types in 10) You are a dolphin, leaping from wave to wave in an ocean of tranquillity.
(Marinette picks up a magazine and gasps fearfully.)
P.A.: We are about to take off. Please put up your tray tables and fasten your seatbelts.
(The plane quickly takes off.)
(By midnight, everybody is sleeping and snoring except Marinette, who is woken up by the popcorn spilled by Mr. Damoclès. Marinette gets out of her seat, turns to look at Alya and Nino sleeping and sadly walks off to go to the bathroom. The seatbelt signs are suddenly switched on as the plane experiences turbulence.)
Marinette: (offscreen) Whoa! Oh! Shoot..
(Marinette then gets out of the bathroom, with a paper towel stuck in her hair and her shirt splattered with water, and gets back to her seat, only to find Mr. Damoclès lying down on her seat with the popcorn. Marinette tries to wake him unsuccessfully, sighs, then decides to look at the sunset. Adrien arrives, to her shock.)
Adrien: It's beautiful, isn't it?

title: Miraculous New York/Transcript
text:
Miraculous New York/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (she gasps, hears a huge thud and accidentally bumps into Adrien) AAH! (muffled) Sorry! (normal voice) I-I mean... sorry!
Adrien: Sorry, Marinette.
(Marinette chuckles. She and Adrien look at the sunset. Alya wakes up and notices Marinette and Adrien and smiles. She then wakes up Nino.)
Adrien: My father told me everything. The only reason I can enjoy this beautiful sunset is you. I thought it would be impossible, but you believed in it. You're always willing to take a chance on something or someone, even when no one else is. You've got something, Marinette.
Marinette: Some- something?
Adrien: Yeah, there. In your hair. (plucks what looks to be toilet paper out of Marinette's hair; Marinette gasps.)
Alya: I can't decide whether they're the cutest people I know, or the most embarrassing!
Nino: Yup. I love Adrien, but he's like a baby chick that's just started cracking out of his egg. He has a hard time understanding the signals people send him.
Alya: What signals? Marinette isn't exactly sending them clearly. I mean, look! What is she doing with her arms? Telling him what to do in case of an emergency landing or something?
(Marinette talks indistinctly and laughs.)

title: Miraculous New York/Transcript
text:
Miraculous New York/Transcript - Intro
Nino: (sighs) If only this trip could help Adrien finally come out of his shell.
Alya: (airily) And if only it could help Marinette be more honest with herself and clearer about her feelings!
(An idea strikes both of them)
Nino: Operation New York?
Alya: Operation New York!
Nino: Let's help them loosen up!
Alya: After all, isn't the United States the land of the free? (They fistbump)
(Back to Marinette and Adrien)
Marinette: OK, then... so, uh....
(Marinette and Adrien return to closely look at the sunset.)
Adrien: Well, what I meant to say was... thanks for managing to convince my father. (hugs her)
Marinette: Oh! Uh, sure thing! (laughs) Don't mention it! That's what friends are for! For holding each other really tightly in the delicious aroma of cologne. (hysterical laugh)
(Suddenly a huge thud can be heard. Marinette and Adrien shake and fall down. Alya and Nino peek at their window. The American supervillain Techno Pirate appears.)
Alya: Oh, no! That's Techno-Pirate, the supervillain who steals technology!
(The plane is about to go upside down as they fall at the wall. Uncanny Valley apears outside where Marinette and Adrien are)

title: Miraculous New York/Transcript
text:
Miraculous New York/Transcript - Intro
Uncanny Valley: Don't worry, sweethearts! We have the situation under control! (in call from the plane) Dear passengers, the United Heroes are here to protect you!
Alya: (she gasps) Uncanny Valley?! The first superhero gynoid with artificial intelligence created by Majestia! (gasps) Which means?!...
(Majestia flies faster than the speed of light then stops and she's about to push the plane wing up with super-strength. Everyone is safe.)
Alya: WOW! Majestia in person! SO COOL!
Mr. Damoclès: (hurries to the bathroom) It's time to show those American superheroes how French superheroes do it! HOO-HOO! (goes into the bathroom)
(Techno-Pirate is about to break the plane and throws the bomb towards Uncanny Valley as Majestia blows it up into the sky and a big explosion appears. Knightowl appears)
Knightowl: (deep voice) Techno-Pirate, you're under arrest! Watch and learn! (Sparrow appears)
Alya: The legendary Knight Owl and Sparrow!
Knightowl: Your runaway ends here!
(Uncanny Valley manages to fix the plane as she flies to Majestia.)
Majestia: Were you hurt, sweetheart?
Uncanny Valley: I'm 100% operational, Mother. (They hug)

title: Miraculous New York/Transcript
text:
Miraculous New York/Transcript - Intro
Majestia: (appears to the students) I'd like to welcome you to the United States, and enjoy your stay!
(The American superheroes Majestia, Knightowl, Uncanny Valley, and Sparrow fly away with Techno-Pirate in tow)
Mr. Damoclès: (appears from the bathroom, dressed as The Owl) It is now the hour of... The Owl! HOO-HOO! (Everyone applauds as he leaves, dejected that he missed his chance)
Marinette: Wow! That all happened so fast! I didn't have time to transform or help out! (Tikki whimpers)
Adrien: Good thing the American superheroes were here. I couldn't have transformed here. I'm supposed to be in Paris!
Plagg: Relax, Adrien! Let the local superheroes handle their own problems.
Adrien: (checking his phone) So far, nothing to report from Paris.
(Techno-Pirate goes to the police car. Scene moves down to the street The bus stops.)
Marinette: Hey! What's that guy doing?
Alya: Oh, it's just Captain Redlight, organizing the traffic. There's a superhero for everything here, you know! So... what happened on the plane with your "friend" Adrien?
Marinette: Nothing! We just watched the clouds and the sunset. But only as friends! Watching sunsets is typical to do on the plane!

title: Miraculous New York/Transcript
text:
Miraculous New York/Transcript - Intro
(Alya growls angrily.)
Nadja: Paris is safe from supervillains! Have Ladybug and Cat Noir put an end to Hawk Moth's activities? A segment by Clara Contard.
Nino: Forget about Paris, dude! You're in New York now! Your old man's not here, and when the cat's away, the mice will play! Open your eyes, know what I mean? Take it all in!
(Adrien starts smiling.)
Adrien: It is beautiful...
Sparrow: (deep voice) The Little Croissants are en route.
Knightowl (over communicator): Good. Don't leave them.
Uncanny Valley: Roger that! Meet you in the lobby! (detransforms into Aeon and runs away)
(Sparrow uses his grappling guns to swing away. Aeon uses her X-ray vision to scan the French students.)
Aeon: Two of them are missing. Oh! There they are!
(Marinette bangs herself in the door and falls down and as Adrien catches her she gets back up, recoiling nervously. Aeon presses her button with her X-ray hand as Marinette falls down. The other students notice them, and one of the group approaches Marinette and Adrien)

title: Miraculous New York/Transcript
text:
Miraculous New York/Transcript - Intro
Boy from Queens: Hey! You guys the cool French kids that made that sock puppet movie! We're from Armstrong High in Queens! (Marinette and Adrien touch hands as they pack the things that fell out of the suitcase.)
Jess: Ugh.. Babysitting some tourists and their socks? I mean, don't they have anything better for us to do? (crosses her arms)
Aeon: Those two are made for each other.
Jess: Seriously, Aeon? Not again!
Aeon: But I am programmed to help people, Jess!
Jess: Just stop meddling with people's private lives!
Aeon: You're right! Let's just follow the orders and protect the tourists and their socks! (Ms. Mendeleiev claps, gaining the class attention.)
Ms. Mendeleiev: Listen up, students! You'll go into your rooms by groups of four! Everyone come take your itinerary. And when I come up in two and a half minutes, you had better be in your rooms, with the lights out! (Students complain.)
Delmar: Hey! Sock buddies! We're throwing a little party on the rooftop if you're interested. Hang with us, but be quiet, okay? (winks at Sabrina as she blushes, Alya nudges her.)

title: Miraculous New York/Transcript
text:
Miraculous New York/Transcript - Intro
Alya: I think there's an American boy who'd love to see you there, Sabrina. And you might make a friend! (she nudges Marinette then laughs.)
Sabrina: You.. you think so?
Chloé: Ugh, a rooftop party at this slum?!! You want me to catch lameness and cooties?! That's ridiculous! SABRINA! SUITCASE! (storms away)
Alya: Group D. Awesome! At least we're in the same room! (Marinette opens the door revealing both Chloé and Sabrina.)
Marinette: Ugh! As Chloé!!
Chloé: CESAIRE AND DUPAIN-CHENG?! THAT IS THE LAST STRAW!! (throws a plushie at Marinette, but it is swiftly caught before entering the room)
Jess: (sarcastically) Oh no! This could go wrong! What do you think, Aeon? Should we do something?
Aeon: You think we should?
Jess: NO! I was just kidding! This whole situation is just plain boring!
(They're about to close the door)
(Ms. Mendeleiev checks the hall before turning the lights out, turning into her room when the kids sneak out of their rooms.)
Ms. Mendeleiev: What's that noise?!

title: Miraculous New York/Transcript
text:
Miraculous New York/Transcript - Intro
(Everyone screams, and the kids run and hide in separate rooms. Ms. Mendeleiev goes to check the hall again to see it empty, again returning to her room. Marinette, breathing heavily, and Adrien lean up against the door listening when Marinette realizes she's touching him, immediately pushing away from Adrien only for Aeon and Jess to look at them.)
Adrien: Oh sorry! We're so sorry!
Marinette: Uh- hi! I'm Marinette and this is my very good friend Adrien, who's just a friend! (Aeon leans into Jess)
Aeon: See?! They're made for each other!
Jess: (groans in disgust) Fine! If you want to get to the roof without attracting attention, there are stairs outside. (Both Marinette and Adrien look out of the window to the fire escape.)
Aeon: Why'd you do that? I thought we weren't supposed to meddle?
Jess: (leaves the bed and picks up a guitar) Well, if we're going to watch over them, there might as well be something to watch! Isn't that what you wanted?
(Aeon becomes happy.)
(Chloe lays in bed with a pillow over her head looking annoyed, eyes closed. Sabrina looks sad. Delmar opens the window invitingly for Sabrina. The two walk together onto the fire escape.)
Marinette: Is it a bird?

title: Miraculous New York/Transcript
text:
Miraculous New York/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: Is it a plane?
Delmar: No! It's Hot Dog Dan!
(Hotdog Dan lands on the roof.)
Hotdog Dan: HEY HEY HEY! Hot Dog Dan is here, so GET IN THE MOOD! I'm the hero of picnics and tasty foods! (starts handing out hotdogs.)
Jess: Hmm. Usually he teams up with Ketchup Boy and Mustard Justice, but looks like he's patrolling solo tonight. You should hurry if you wanna try one of his magic hotdogs.
(Scene changes to show people having magical reactions.)
Alya: Go Sabrina!
(Sabrina has long hair like Rapunzel.)
Hotdog Dan: Sorry guys. I only have two hotdogs left for the four of you.
Nino: Not a problem. My girl and I will take one, and you two take the other! (holds out the hot dog for them to take)
Alya: Between friends. (rips the hotdog in half and gives the other half to Nino)
Marinette: It's all yours, Adrien, my pleasure as your friend. (she hands him the hotdog as he pushes it back)
Adrien: No, take it Marinette. (Nino steps in.)
Nino: C'mon now, one hotdog for two, coming up!

title: Miraculous New York/Transcript
text:
Miraculous New York/Transcript - Intro
(He splits the hotdog in half handing them each one. They smile and take a bite before they begin to float up into the air, the remains of the hot dogs dropped and forgotten about. Adrien grabs Marinette's hand as they begin to float away)
Nino: Finally! My chicks wings are growing! (in a high pitch tone, Alya laughs in the same tone)
Jess: You were right, they really seem to be made for each other.
Alya: Yeah, no. With those two, the situation's are far from simple. Hey! You play the guitar! Maybe you could give them a hand! Do you know this song? (shows her phone to Jess before she starts playing the guitar)
(Up in the sky, with the moon alight.)
Adrien: Oh! That's the song we danced to at Chloe's birthday party, remember?
Marinette: Ooh, yes! (chuckles)
Adrien: Then, will you? (offers his hand to dance, Marinette freaks out and floats away, Adrien grabs her hand) Here!
(He pulls her close as she gives in to him. With arms wrapped around each other, they float/dance in the night's sky.)
App's voice: Picture yourself a beautiful sunflower.
Alya: It was so romantic, you two dancing in the moonlight, wasn't it?

title: Miraculous New York/Transcript
text:
Miraculous New York/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Yeah so ro- Friendly! Friendly! It was a very friendly dance! (Alya shakes her head disapprovingly until she notices Doorman.)
Alya: Hey look! That teacher over there! That's Dean Gate, a.k.a. Doorman! He can turn any door into a teleporting passage! Oh superheroes don't necessarily need to hide their true identities in America! AMAZING!! I'm going to ask him for a quote for the Ladyblog!!
Aeon: Those two seem to exhibit repetitive behaviours!
Marinette: (waving crazily) Tough luck, right? We always end up together! I mean, stuck together. Haha! (sighs in relief)
Adrien: I don't mind being stuck somewhere with a friend like you.
Marinette: Right! Uh- As friends! Uh- It's all good!
Jess: I know what to do! If anything's gonna change between them, they'll need to find themselves in a seriously dangerous situation.
Alya: What?! Are you out of your mind!?
Aeon: Statistically speaking, two humans confronted with extreme situations often cause their feelings for each other to become stronger.

title: Miraculous New York/Transcript
text:
Miraculous New York/Transcript - Intro
Jess: We need to make them believe they'll never see each other again! And that is the last chance they'll ever get to tell each other how they truly feel! Here's what we're gonna do: During the visit, you're going to get them to go to the Lafayette room alone! BOOM! That's when supervillain Solitude shows up and threatens to kidnap any person that nobody loves! He threatens Adrien, and in order to save him-
Aeon: "No, don't kidnap him, I love him!!"
(Nino stares amazingly)
Alya: Okay.... It's so stupid, it could actually work.
Nino: WOW! Cool impression! Hey, hold on! A supervillain? How are you...? (They hear a thud and look in the doorway again)
(Marinette and Adrien are now on top of each other through the now erratic automatic doors, blinking in confusion as the doors repeatedly slam into them.)
Jess: Trust us! Get them to the room and we'll take care of the rest.
(Jess and Aeon walk away.)
Aeon: For someone who didn't want me to meddle with other people's lives, you seem deeply involved.
Jess: This is more fun than babysitting socks!

title: Miraculous New York/Transcript
text:
Miraculous New York/Transcript - Intro
Dean Gate: This is the famous sabre of the Marquis de Lafayette. And here the necklace he presented to George Washington as a symbol of friendship between the French and the American people. Careful! The security system is very sensitive! You don't wanna be accidentally setting off the alarm. Let's carry on to the next room, where we'll see the Statue of Liberty!
Gabriel: The Marquis de Lafayette was 19 when he participated in the War of Independence. So young, and already gifted with an incredible ability to galvanize people. He helped Washington's troops win the Battle of Yorktown. Everyone thinks it was all due to Lafayette's exceptional potential. I think it was also due to something special -- A Miraculous! Nathalie, you take care of Paris. I'll take care of New York.
[Transformation Sequence]Gabriel: Nooroo, Dark Wings Rise!(Gabriel transforms into Hawk Moth in the car as the car drives away.)
(Techno-Pirate is about to be put in the prison transport by the NYPD as the akuma appears and lands in Techno-Pirate's handcuffs. Techno-Pirate is Akumatized.)

title: Miraculous New York/Transcript
text:
Miraculous New York/Transcript - Intro
Hawk Moth: Techlonizer, I am Hawk Moth. You were robbed of you technological arsenal by those heinous "superheroes". I can give you the power to steal and clone any technology so you can get your revenge on them! In exchange, you will bring me Lafayette's sabre.
Techno-Pirate: Wouldn't you rather have an atomic bomb?!
Hawk Moth: No! I want the sabre.
(Techno-Pirate shrugs. He is promptly akumatized into Techlonizer. Terrified, the NYPD officers run away screaming.)
Dean Gate: France gave the Statue of Liberty to America in 1886. Gustave Eiffel himself built the armature for the inside of the statue!
Alya: Marinette, could you go and take a quick pic of Lafayette's sabre? I completely forgot and I gotta film Dean Gate!
Marinette: Of course! (walks away)
Dean Gate: The real Statue of Liberty has a hollow stone in its base, or a copy of the U.S. decoration of the Declaration of Independence.
Nino: (hides his headphones) Dude, I can't find my headphones! Could you go check the other room and see if I left them there? I'll look here.
Adrien: No problem. I'm on it!

title: Miraculous New York/Transcript
text:
Miraculous New York/Transcript - Intro
Dean Gate: In this hollow stone, there's also a safe that contains various artifacts left by the people who unveiled the statue. No one's opened it since. I don't know about you all, but I, for one, would love to know what's inside that safe!
Alya: Uh, excuse me, sir, but, um, why don't you use your superpower to enter the door that leads to the hollow stone?
Dean Gate: Superpowers should never be used for personal gain, only for the greater good! Besides, even if I got inside, I wouldn't be able to open the safe, because its key is in Paris, inside the Eiffel Tower!
All students: (looking at the Eiffel Tower) WOW!
(Marinette sees her phone as Adrien appears.)
Marinette: Huh? Uh...? A-Adrien?
Adrien: Marinette?
(Aeon uses her X-ray hand to slam the doors shut, trapping Adrien and Marinette inside.)
Marinette: (gasps) What's happening?!
Adrien: (pulls at the doors) That's strange!
(Adrien gets a notification on his phone.)
Nadja: Akumatized villain, Robostus, is spreading panic in Paris. And, so far, no sign of Ladybug and Cat Noir!
Adrien: Robostus?! But Markov can't have been akumatized in Paris, he's right here with us in New York!!
Jess: What are they doing?

title: Miraculous New York/Transcript
text:
Miraculous New York/Transcript - Intro
Aeon: I'm not sure -- but their stress levels are high enough to engage Phase 2!
Jess: Okay! GO!
(Jess throws her weapon at a lightswitch, causing the lights to go out.)
Marinette and Adrien: (shocked) Huh?! (Aeon makes a hologram of a supervillain)
Solitude: I am Solitude, and I am here to take captive of those who are loved by no one!

text:

text:

text:

text:

text:

text:

Knightowl: It doesn't matter anymore. With this new suit, everyone now knows Sparrow is a female, not a male. And that the legendary original Knightowl and Sparrow are long gone. (takes off her mask) (deep to normal voice) Maybe it's a sign. That the time has come to embrace who we really are!
Majestia: And even though it still worries us, the only way for you to grow is for us to let you take chances. Thank you for inspiring them.
Knightowl: And please forgive us for misjudging you.
Ladybug, Cat Noir, Eagle and Uncanny Valley: POUND IT!
Hawk Moth: My theory was correct. There are other lost Miraculous. And wherever they are in the world, they will be mine!
Ladybug: Uncanny, what about our secret identities?
Uncanny Valley: Don't worry! Once we say goodbye, I'll erase this information from my memory.
Ladybug: Thank you for bringing us back together. (hugs her)

title: Miraculous Ladybug COVID-19 Special
text:
Miraculous Ladybug COVID-19 Special - Intro
The "" (also known as Miraculous Barrier Gestures CLIP) is a 2-minute special video of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir created by ZAG and ON Kids & Family with participation of Paris and UNICEF France as part of the prevention of the COVID-19 pandemic infection.
The French version was released worldwide in France on TF1, myTF1 website, on the youth SVOD platform TFOUMAX and the official French Miraculous YouTube channel on May 18, 2020, and later on Disney Channel.
The English version was released worldwide on the official English Miraculous YouTube channel on May 28, 2020.

title: Miraculous Ladybug COVID-19 Special
text:
Miraculous Ladybug COVID-19 Special - Trivia
According to Cristina Vee, she recorded her lines for this clip from her recording studios at her own home.
Ezra Weisz confirmed in an Instagram Story that Bryce Papenbrook recorded his lines from his home studio as well.
The Japanese dub of the special is titled "レディバグとシャノワールからみんなへのお願い", which translates to "A request from Ladybug and Cat Noir to everyone". This title represents the content of the special better and was seen as a more direct message to the viewers about safety during the pandemic.
There are also a handful of changes in the Japanese version:
The opening features a short clip from the series intro, the panning shot of the Eiffel Tower.
The splash screen has a zooming in animation, has the title narrated over it, and does not feature the Paris and UNICEF logos.
The ending was slightly altered in the international version.
The color animation going around the screen is not present.
The end screen shows Ladybug and Cat Noir laughing full-frame, instead of the Paris logo.
The Miraculous logo is shown in the end, before the credit of UNICEF.
Errors
Throughout the video, the Turtle Miraculous is a darker shade of green, and thicker than it usually is.

text:
Miraculous London - Intro
"Miraculous World: London, At the Edge of Time" (or simply "") is a 50-minute special TV movie of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the writing and release order, it is the fourth movie in the Miraculous World series.

title: Miraculous London
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Miraculous London - Synopsis
TF1
In the Burrow, Bunnyx sees the windows of time disappear one by one... The future is fading away. What's happening? At the same time, Marinette wakes up at home and discovers that someone has just made a wish in Paris thanks to the Miraculouses of the Cat and the Ladybug.
Quickly, she must transform into Ladybug... but she realizes that she no longer has her earrings!
Fortunately, Bunnyx comes to get her just before the wish erases everything.
Together, Bunnyx and Marinette, who has become Chronobug, will have to save the future by finding out who discovered that Marinette was Ladybug, when, and how this person managed to steal her Miraculous. Marinette realizes that the Butterfly Miraculous now has a new owner! All that remains is to hope for one thing: that Ladybug succeeds in defeating her opponent, otherwise it will be the end of Ladybug for good.
Disney Channel France

text:
Miraculous London - Synopsis
To save the future, Marinette, now Chronobug, must team up with Bunnyx to solve the mystery of who discovered Ladybug's secret identity. Because this person also managed to get hold of the Ladybug Miraculous, and all those in the Miracle Box. During their adventures, the heroines learn that the thief who discovered the ultimate secret is also the new bearer of the Butterfly Miraculous. Marinette's only hope is to succeed in finding this adversary who is hiding somewhere in time. Otherwise, it will be the end of Ladybug.
Disney+
To save the future from a terrible fate, Marinette becomes Chronobug and teams up with Bunnyx to defeat a mysterious opponent who travels through time. Who is this new supervillain, and why are they obsessed with exposing Marinette's secret superhero identity? Marinette's only hope is to defeat her new opponent to prevent the end of Ladybug and time itself!

title: Miraculous London
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Miraculous London - Production Timeline
The special was first announced during a Comic Con Experience (CCXP) panel on December 5, 2020.
On April 18, 2021, it was revealed during a Licensing Russia panel that the special was slated for a 2024 release. It was also revealed that Miss Rose, an upcoming television series, would serve as a spin-off for the special. However, both projects were pushed back because the script for the special wasn't written yet.
As revealed on Fred Lenoir's resume, the script was eventually written in 2022, before "Miraculous Paris" and Season 6.
Sometime later in the year, the Hachette Jeunesse book adaptation of the special was added to Amazon, with a release date of June 1. The date was most likely an error, as the special in its current form hadn't even been announced at that point and was early in its production, but it implies that it was greenlit.
As revealed on Antoine Poirine's and Louise Reynaud's LinkedIn profile, the storyboard was done between May and August 2023.
During 2023, the special was added to the ISAN registry as "The End of Ladybug", with a tentative release date of August 31, 2024.

title: Miraculous London
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Miraculous London - Production Timeline
In the March issue of Licensing Magazine, it was mentioned that the special was set to be released in the fourth quarter of the year.
On May 21-23, two posters and the final title were unveiled at the Las Vegas Licensing Expo.
On May 25, ZAG Ambassador Angrien Agreste revealed in a post that Ladybug's new form would be called Chronobug.
On June 11, a trailer for the special was shown at the Annecy International Animation Film Festival, and an updated release date of Autumn 2024 was revealed. The same information and trailer would be shown at Licensing Con on August 28-29.
On August 12, Cristina Vee posted an Instagram story at Dubbing Brothers in which an unfinished shot from the special can be seen in a window's reflection.
On September 4, TF1 revealed a synopsis for the special and the full French title.
On September 5, in an interview with ¡Despierta América!, Cristina Vee stated that the special was set to release in the USA around Thanksgiving (November 28).
On September 17, TF1 released a recording of its Back-to-school conference to the internet, revealing a new trailer. On the same day, Disney Channel France announced the special's global premiere for October 5.

text:
Miraculous London - Plot
The special begins in La Plage, where the table of Cerise Bianca is seen; on the table are outstanding items, including a book holder with a note, three jewelry boxes with watches, a time travel device, two phones, a map, a trapped Nooroo and his Miraculous. Nooroo attempts to escape, but is stuck in a magical bubble. Timestalker then appears, de-akumatizing herself, revealing herself to be Cerise Bianca under a new blonde identity. She looks in her notebook and smirks, then reakumatizes herself into Spectral Looter, a ghost-themed supervillain. Nooroo tries warning her of the consequences, but Spectral Looter ignores him and disappears into the ground. Nooroo then sadly says to himself, "This is the end."

title: Miraculous London
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Miraculous London - Plot
After the opening, Bunnyx and her two future selves are seen playing a variant of chess in the Burrow. Granny Bunnyx emerges as the winner, boasting about her impressive record of 12,123 wins, while both the adult Bunnyx and the present Bunnyx have neither won any games, which understandably frustrates adult Bunnyx and present Bunnyx since Granny Bunnyx never lets neither of them win. Suddenly, both Granny Bunnyx and the adult Bunnyx start to fade away. The adult Bunnyx tells her younger self that it's the end of time. Panic sets in for Bunnyx, and she wishes she had received a heads-up from her future selves before they vanished. She then looks at a short recap of the series's events through the Burrow, from "Origins" to "Re-creation", focusing on Marinette, Adrien, and Gabriel.  Just then, the circular window she was looking at disappears. Bunnyx tries to find another window, but one by one, they all fade out. Eventually, she finds one that shows a worried Marinette, likely in response to another wish being made. At that moment, Bunnyx realizes there is a significant problem.

title: Miraculous London
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Miraculous London - Plot
Meanwhile in the current timeline, Cosmo Bug Noire is flying to London to set Adrien and Kagami free, and inform them of Gabriel's death.
However, her face is frozen in an unemotional flat mask, as if she has completely locked her emotions away after what happened with Gabriel during her final battle with him and when he made his wish to Gimmi.
She then arrives at the building and proceeds to Kagami's room, blasting the door open with her Cataclysm.
Inside, Bug Noire watches the news from Paris regarding the events of Operation: Perfect Alliance, her face still locked in that unemotional flat mask as she recalls her final conversation with Gabriel and what he asked of her before making his wish to Gimmi.
Kagami (addressing the superheroine as Marinette) asks her if "it" is over.
A melancholic Bug Noire then replies with a yes, but Kagami wants to be sure, to which the heroine responds with "over over".
Then she tells Kagami that Adrien cannot know about his father being a supervillain, but Kagami then tells Bug Noire that she is blinded by love, but if that is her wish, then she'll honor it.
Bug Noire proceeds to reveal to Kagami that her mother was Monarch's accomplice.

title: Miraculous London
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Miraculous London - Plot
However, Bug Noire has no intention of revealing this information, as it would mean Tomoe would go to prison, and Kagami would lose her only parent, and with the situation that if her mother had nothing to lose, she could reveal that Gabriel Agreste was Monarch, which would lead to Adrien finding out.
Bug Noire is informed by Kagami that Adrien changed when he tried to confront his father and that she changed when she met her, saying she'll talk to her mother afterwards and convince her to keep all knowledge of her alliance with Gabriel buried.
They then head to Adrien's room.
Bug Noire attempts to Cataclysm the door, but Placide stops her, and scans the door with a keycard himself, making the door automatically open.
Adrien questions why Bug Noire was here and not his father.
Bug Noire then sadly reveals to Adrien that Gabriel is dead, calling him a hero.
Adrien is in complete shock and can't believe what he's just heard.
Placide is also horrified to learn that his benefactor is dead and worries for Adrien's well-being, since this means he's lost both of his parents now.

title: Miraculous London
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Miraculous London - Plot
Bug Noire then proceeds, lying to Adrien that Monarch had held his father and Tomoe Tsurugi hostage and forced them to create the Alliance rings, so that he could Miraculize every single Alliance holder around the world to hunt down her and Cat Noir for their Miraculous.
Adrien claims he saw the magic ladybugs, so he knew Monarch has been defeated.
Bug Noire continues, saying that Monarch was about to make a wish, but then Gabriel pounced on him, took the Miraculous from Monarch and made a wish exchanging his and Monarch's lives for Nathalie's and Bug Noire's.
Adrien lashes out, asking aggressively if Bug Noire's magic ladybugs are supposed to repair everything, and there's no way his father could not be saved, but Bug Noire replies that she tried everything.

text:
Miraculous London - Plot Developments
More features of the Burrow, the Miraculous Ladybug superpower, Kamikotization and conditions are revealed:
The Burrow portals function like a touchscreen: they can be made to "fast-forward", "pause" or "rewind" by swiping one's hand across it, but it's revealed they have "zoom in" feature allowing the holder to see a specific area of the place and time it's showing, as well as alter the user's point of view the user allowing them to see it from and rotate to a different angle.
From "Cat Blanc", it's confirmed that the "fast-forwarding" and "rewinding" features does not simply show the previous events that happen in a certain location, but rather follows one's expectations, allowing the user to track a target through time as well as observe their personal history.
Similar to "Cat Blanc", if something happens to the timeline that causes it end of everything the portals can also go black and fade out turning the Burrow into an empty white void.
When traveling through time, if the Rabbit holder has a companion with them, they need to mark them with something to tell them apart.
The magic ladybugs cannot revert anything that has been altered by the Ultimate Miraculous Absolute Power.

Chronobug summons a Lucky Charm while being tied up with her yo-yo, and it's revealed that the yo-yo will fly out, freeing the holder.
It's explicitly confirmed that all akumatized villains lose their memories while being akumatized and after they are de-akumatized, even if they are self-akumatized.
It's unknown if the same happens for kamikotized heroes. Although not completely proven yet "Jubilation" might suggest that kamikotized heroes do keep their memories, at least in Cat Noir's case. As the hero was kamikotized in "Miraculous Paris" which was before that episode and likely in their shared dream after securing the Butterfly Miraculous, Ladybug told him everything. Then, in their wedding both were in white costumes but for it to be either one of them had to remember it and "Miraculous Paris", was the most recent.
Despite this contradicting what has been implicated in the series, there are ways to explain them:
When Gabriel self-akumatized himself into The Collector for the first time in the episode of the same name, his objective was to sway Ladybug and Cat Noir from his real identity, so he didn't need to remember his time while akumatized.

More simple and straight forward he was just acting that he didn't remember.

For the eventuality he does remember, it must due to the fact he kept the Butterfly Miraculous with him, implying that, as long one holder has the Butterfly Miraculous with them.

The special takes place during Season 5, during the events of "Re-creation".
If we take in consideration the times Timestalker uses on her smartphone to serve as anchors for her, Lila/Cerise initiated her plan to discover Ladybug's identity at 2:30 pm, meaning that Bug Noire and Monarch's fight happened between late morning and early afternoon. The second anchor is marked as 10:10 pm, with her arriving to her lair, reading what she had written as Timestalker, akumatizing herself into Spectral Looter and going to steal the Miraculous from Marinette soon after. This means that Cerise Bianca's unknown event is during the night because it was not shown throughout the movie happening nor was it mentioned what happened in Cerise's hideout.
Interestingly timewise, from an in-universe perspective, this special is a total of 7 hours and 40 minutes, being second behind or at least tied with "Miraculous Paris".

The content of the special was originally planned to be at the end of the season, similarly to the "Origins" two parter in Season 1.
On April 17, 2021, it was announced via Licensing Russia that Miss Rose, a character from the upcoming titular television series, would appear in this special. However, as of the finalized version of special released in 2024, she does not make an appearance in any shape or form.
A year before it was announced that Miss Rose is connected to the London special, Jeremy Zag indirectly revealed in an interview for Toys & Family Entertainment magazine that the television series would serve as a "true follow-up" to Miraculous Ladybug.
According to the Licensing Russia panel in 2021, the Miss Rose television series was going to serve as a spin-off to the London special.
However, as of 2023, it was confirmed in a behind-the-scenes video for Ladybug & Cat Noir: The Movie that the Miss Rose television series is still in development. So, it's unknown if the television series is still planned to be a spin-off connected to Miraculous Ladybug or if plans were later changed to make it separated from the franchise.

But they still have no idea that they're Ladybug and Cat Noir and then Gabriel Agreste sending his son to protect him right before he akumatizes the whole world to defeat Ladybug and Cat Noir.
Mrs.
Tsurugi, his ally has done the same with her daughter, Kagami.
(continues scrolling) Nothing's changed.
This is when Ladybug gets proof Gabriel Agreste is Monarch.
Nothing's changed either.
Next, Bug Noire defeats Monarch and takes down the Miraculous of the Butterfly.
Ugh, ultimate blunder.
Come on, faster.
Where is it?
That's how it happened and how it's still happening so so far, nothing's wrong.
Gabriel makes his wish, history's still on course.
(suddenly the window turns black) Huh?
What's going on?
Why's there nothing?
(tries to scroll but nothing works) There's nothing left, nothing at all!
(suddenly the window shrinks and disappears) HEY!
What?

title: Miraculous London/Transcript
text:
Miraculous London/Transcript - Intro
(jumps towards another window) Ugh, I scrolled too fast, I must've missed something!
(suddenly that window turns black and disappears too and jumps towards another one, fast forwarding and showing that someone made the wish with Marinette on her balcony)
Bunnyx: Okay... We have... a huge problem.
Nadja Chamack: (voiceover) We have a live report from Clara Contard who is flying in our helicopter from Paris. Can you confirm everything's over?
Bug Noire: (opens the door and walks in. Bug Noire is seen to have an unemotional expression on her face, as if nothing mattered anymore and she was just completing her mission.)
Clara Contard: (voiceover) Yes Nadja, we just saw Ladybug's magic ladybugs fly by. All the damage has been repaired. This nightmare is finally over.
Nadja Chamack: (voiceover) That's excellent news, bound to make the people of Paris and I'm sure the world feel better. (the lights suddenly turn off) Stay with us we'll be back after a quick news recap. (Kagami is seen in her room via a screen on her door) Hello and welcome if you're tuning in now. Today's main event is of course, the unprecedented chaos of our entire world was just plunged into.

title: Miraculous London/Transcript
text:
Miraculous London/Transcript - Intro
Bug Noire: (suddenly walks in by destroying the door as Kagami looks over to her)
Nadja Chamack: We still don't know how any of this was possible but it turns out supervillain Monarch has successfully akumatized every single Alliance ring owner.
Bug Noire: (face remains locked in a flat mask of unemotional turmoil)
Bug Noire: If you meant what you said earlier, then we both want the same thing: we want Adrien to be happy.
Nadja Chamack: (on TV) Billions of people were Miraculized, that's nearly the entire world population, appointed evil superpowers in order to capture Ladybug and Cat Noir.
Bug Noire: (closer zoom of her unemotional face, still showing no reaction whatsoever to the news)
Bug Noire: Power of any nature should only be used for the greater good. But we can think and work out a solution on our own human scale, even though it won't be as perfect as we want it to be. (Finally, Gabriel nods in agreement, as well as Bug Noire. She lets go of her hand on Gabriel's and de-transforms.) Spots and claws away. (de-transforms back to Marinette)
Nadja Chamack: Luckily, Ladybug saved not only Paris but the whole world too.

title: Miraculous London/Transcript
text:
Miraculous London/Transcript - Intro
Bug Noire: (Even closer zoom of her unemotional face, still remaining unresponsive to Nadja's report)
Gabriel: (turns around to Marinette) Marinette, make sure that Adrien never knows about the villain that I was, (puts down the twin rings on the ground) but instead, that he remembers the times I tried to be a good father.
Nadja Chamack: This time, more than ever Ladybug, we thank you. (the report ends)
Kagami: So it's over?
Bug Noire: Yes.
Kagami: Over over?
Bug Noire: Over over. But Adrien... cannot find out.
Kagami: You're blinded by love, Marinette. But if this is your wish, I'll honor it.
Bug Noire: There's still one last problem. Your mother, Kagami, she was Monarch's accomplice. She put the world in danger. Normally, I should bring her to justice but I don't wanna make you suffer.
Kagami: If she has nothing else to lose anymore, she could admit everything and reveal that Gabriel Agreste was Monarch.
Bug Noire: And Adrien would find out about his father.
Kagami: Adrien changed when he tried to confront his father. And I've changed since I met you. Everyone can change, my mother as well. I'll talk to her.
Bug Noire: You sure?

title: Miraculous London/Transcript
text:
Miraculous London/Transcript - Intro
Kagami: Let me at least try. (they both walk out of the room)
Bug Noire: (puts hand on the door handle) Catacl-
Placide: (suddenly grabs her wrist to prevent her from doing so as Bug Noire gasps, looks at him before he pulls out a keycard and unlocks the door for her)
Adrien: Ladybug?
Bug Noire: (approaches him as she stutters, trying to get the words out) Uh...uh... (bites her lower lip in anxiety)
Adrien: (gets up) My father's not here? Why aren't you saying anything?
Bug Noire: Your father... your father... was...(Adrien gasps, realizing something horrible has happened to his father) was... a hero. Your father was a hero.
Adrien: (stumbles back, taken back)
Placide: (Puts his hand over his mouth in horror, realizing his benefactor is deceased, then looks at Adrien with deep concern)
Bug Noire: The truth is... Monarch was forcing your father and Mrs. Tsurugi to work for him. He forced them to design the Alliance rings in order to turn the entire world against me and Cat Noir. If they said no, Monarch threatened to go after you and Kagami.
Adrien: But I saw your ladybugs fly by, which means you defeated Monarch.

title: Miraculous London/Transcript
text:
Miraculous London/Transcript - Intro
Bug Noire: I did face him, in your home, he... he had taken Nathalie and your father hostage and I fought as hard as I could but he was too mighty and Monarch had too many powers, too many Miraculous. He severely injured me. I couldn't stop him from taking the Miraculous of the Ladybug and the Black Cat. Monarch was about to make a wish and that's when your father... that's when your father become a hero. (Adrien breaks down, sobbing) At the last minute, your father pounced on Monarch, seized the Miraculous and made a wish in his place. He saved Nathalie's life and mine in exchange for Monarch's life and his own. (approaches him to try and console him)
Adrien: (angrily through tears as he swats her hand away) Why didn't you save him?! And even if something had happened to him, aren't your magically ladybugs supposed to repair everything?! This is impossible, you have to be wrong!
Bug Noire: I swear I tried everything.
Adrien: (looks at Bug Noire's hand and sees the Black Cat Miraculous and Turtle Miraculous Alliance Ring) If he hadn't locked me in here, I could've saved him...
Bug Noire: Believe me, there's nothing you could've done.
Adrien: (through sobs) Dad...

title: Miraculous London/Transcript
text:
Miraculous London/Transcript - Intro
Bug Noire: That's why your father had sent you and Kagami to London, to protect you. (Kagami walks over to him while hugging and consoling him) I'm so sorry, there was no good way of telling you all of this. I wanted to be the one to say it before you found out some other way. I'm... (voice breaking) I'm... so... so sorry, Adrien. I-
Kagami: Thank you, Ladybug. Surely you have many other things to deal with.
Bug Noire: Yes... (walks away before looking back and exiting the room)
Bug Noire: (looks at Nathalie with an expression of deep remorse and sadness before she runs towards Nathalie and de-transforms back into Marinette as they both embrace in a hug)
Interviewer: (voiceover) Ladybug! Can you explain what really happened? The fight took place at the famous fashion designer Gabriel Agreste's home, is there a connection between Mr. Agreste and Monarch?
Ladybug: (voiceover) The man who went by Hawk Moth, Shadow Moth and lastly Monarch (Cataclysms the Kwami Cages and it collapses, as the levitating fishbowls get affected too and fall to the ground) had forced Mr. Gabriel Agreste and Mrs. Tsurugi to design the Alliance rings. He planned to Miraculize...

title: Miraculous London/Transcript
text:
Miraculous London/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: (voiceover) ...the entire world to seize the Miraculous of the Ladybug and the Black Cat.
Interviewer: But why was he after your Miraculous?
Ladybug: I haven't got a clue.
Interviewer: Ladybug! You defeated Monarch, which means you uncovered who he was beneath the mask, right?
Ladybug: No. We'll never know about his secret identity. But thanks to Gabriel Agreste's heroic sacrifice...
Ladybug: (voiceover) ...we're finally free from Monarch. (walks while cataclysming the catwalk behind her)
Interviewer: (voiceover) Is it true you couldn't reclaim the Miraculous of the Butterfly?
Ladybug: Y-yes but...
Interviewer: (voiceover) Did you lose because you had to face Monarch alone?
Ladybug: I'm sorry but there's nothing more I can say. Bug out. (swings away using her yo-yo)
Interviewer: Ladybug!, LADYBU-!
Adrien: (cries when the train doors open, running up to Nathalie and hugging her)
Kagami: (walks up to Tomoe as she walks off without saying a word as she follows her)
Adrien: (sees Marinette as he runs up to her and they embrace in a hug)

title: Miraculous London/Transcript
text:
Miraculous London/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (puts down her purse and opens it as the Kwamis fly out, takes out the Miraculous rings calls Alya and talks to her and writes in her diary)
Marinette: Bug out. (locks away her diary, puts the Miraculouses in the drawer, walks away from her desk and goes to bed with Tikki and Plagg flying after her) I did the right thing, didn't I?
Tikki: About what?
Marinette: Lying to Adrien. I couldn't tell him that his father was Monarch. I had no choice, you understand, right?
Tikki: Well... (looks at Plagg as the two look at each other) None of us is the kwami of Truth, Marinette.
Plagg: So I'm not sure we can answer your question truthfully.
Marinette: I lied to Adrien and Alya and the whole world. I know it was for a good cause but I can't help but feel terrible about it.
Tikki: Stop thinking and get some rest. You probably need it. (Marinette closes her eyes) And you will need it. (falls asleep with Plagg)

title: Miraculous London/Transcript
text:
Miraculous London/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Ugh... What's happening? (goes outside and gasps upon realizing someone has made a wish) Tikki! Plagg! Someone's making a wish but (puts hands out in front of her to avoid being blinded by the lights) how could anyone do that without the Mira- (gasps when seeing that she's not wearing the Black Cat Miraculous) Cat Noir's ring! (touching earlobes and notices she's not wearing her Miraculous) My earrings! (just before it's too late, Bunnyx opens a portal and pulls her inside the Burrow)
Bunnyx: Over here!
Marinette: Someone's made a wish!
Bunnyx: Not just any wish, this one will reshape the universe in a way no-one's ever seen before!
Marinette: (noticing most of the portal windows are black) Uh why are they all... black?
Bunnyx: It's... it's like we're at the movies and the film has ended. There's nothing more to see.
Marinette: The end of our universe?
Bunnyx: That's a bit dramatic but yeah.
Marinette: (panics)
Bunnyx: We'll figure something out to fix this, don't worry. But first... (slips on her a yellow safety vest)
Marinette: What am I supposed to do with this?

title: Miraculous London/Transcript
text:
Miraculous London/Transcript - Intro
Bunnyx: Time travel is always a complex matter. With this, at least we'll always know it's you, present-time Marinette. (grabs her hand and walks her over to the window) I came and grabbed you at the very last second of the timeline I had access to. (starts scrolling) Good thing a second here in the Burrow can last for a while.
Marinette: Which gives us time to figure out what went wrong earlier! (suddenly the window turns black and disappears)
Bunnyx: Yeah well, as long as there's a portal left. (grabs Marinette's arm and walks her over to another window)
Marinette: But I don't have my earrings. I won't be any help without my Miraculous.
Bunnyx: You don't have your earrings now but you did once.
Marinette: Of course. You can't access the future anymore but you can still go back in time.
Bunnyx: Nailed it! Except...
Adult Bunnyx: (flashback) You don't mess with the timeline just for fun, mini me. Interfering with events-
Bunnyx: Can have serious consequences. We've gotta be very careful not to mess with the course of history.
Marinette: You sound just like adult you.
Bunnyx: Ha! No kidding.

title: Miraculous London/Transcript
text:
Miraculous London/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: I know! There was this one, single time when I renounced my Miraculous. Nothing will change if I take it from that specific moment.
Bunnyx: I'm listening. (taps on window) Tell me where, and when.
Past Marinette: If Cat Noir can't capture the akumas, then... just find another Ladybug. I told you, I'm not cut out to be Ladybug! (takes her earrings off) I'm sorry Tikki.
Past Tikki: No, don't do that!
Past Marinette: ...Tikki? (puts the earrings back in the box and puts the box in the drawer) I'm really sorry, Tikki...
Past Sabine: (from downstairs) Marinette! Breakfast is ready!
Past Marinette: Coming.
Past Tom: (downstairs) Did you see how the new superhero (Marinette opens the doors and goes downstairs) fought against the stone monster? Oh, that was something! What's her name again?
Past Marinette: Ladybug.
Past Sabine: You look so gloomy, Marinette. (Present Marinette jumps in the room from the Burrow portal) Did supervillain Hawk Moth scare you?
Past Tom: Don't worry, sweetheart. I'm sure that young Ladybug will fix everything.
Past Marinette: Yeah, sure Dad. (Present Marinette grabs the Miracle box from the drawer, closes it and returns to the Burrow with it)

title: Miraculous London/Transcript
text:
Miraculous London/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Woah, I feel like that was like ten years ago. (opens it as Past Tikki comes out of it)
Past Tikki: (sees Marinette and Bunnyx) Marinette? When are we?
Marinette: We're at a point in time where someone stole my Miraculous. We need to figure out who, when and how. Then I'll bring you back to the Marinette you just met. (puts on Ladybug Miraculous) That is if I succeed.
Past Tikki: I'm sure you will succeed.
Marinette: (chuckles) I hope you're right. Tikki...
[Transformation Sequence]Marinette: Spots on! Yeah! (transforms into Chronobug)
Chronobug: (looks at her suit) Isn't this a bit... flashy?
Bunnyx: Not at all, I love it! Let's check the timeline once again, Chronobug. (scrolls through a window as the two observe intently)
Chronobug: There!
Bunnyx: Where, I didn't see anything!
Chronobug: Go back a bit. Slowly... Stop! There. Look! (Spectral Looter is visible in the window)
Bunnyx: Is that a ghost?
Chronobug: There's no such things as ghosts. (Bunnyx plays the window)

title: Miraculous London/Transcript
text:
Miraculous London/Transcript - Intro
Spectral Looter: (makes sure Marinette is asleep as she hovers, checking everywhere for the Ladybug and Black Cat Miraculous in boxes, drawers but finally, she detects the Miraculous rings. Interested, she touches them as they become intangible and wears them all with the sleeping Kwamis dissappering as she puts the rings on, goes up to Marinette, touches the Ladybug and Cat Miraculous as they become intangible with her before floating off)
Bunnyx: (touches window to pause)
Chronobug: Okay stop, we've seen enough. Go back some more right before the ghost shows up. (the window now shows right before Spectral Looter appears)
Bunnyx: Shall we?
Chronobug: No, you stay here. (pulls out earbud from yo-yo and puts it in her ear) What if the ghost manages to seize my Miraculous and yours? Then things would really be over. We can stay in contact.
Bunnyx: (pulls out earbud from umbrella and wears it) Alright. Good luck, Chronobug.
Chronobug: (takes a few steps back before running into the window and arriving at the setting of the robbery)
Bunnyx: (via earpiece) Watch out, here they come!
Spectral Looter: (floats into Chronobug and starts the search as she watches)

title: Miraculous London/Transcript
text:
Miraculous London/Transcript - Intro
Chronobug: (leaps at Spectral Looter but due to her intangibility, she leaps past her as Past Marinette moves slightly)
Spectral Looter: (turns to her, laughs and continues looking for the Ladybug and Cat Miraculous as Chronobug tries to attack her but nothing works as she tries to capture her with her yo-yo but still to no avail)
Past Marinette: (stirs slightly but doesn't wake up as Spectral Looter and Chronobug look at the bed, worried)
Chronobug: Ugh! There's nothing I can do against a ghost!
Bunnyx: (over headpiece) You faced a similar villain before.
Chronobug: Troublemaker! (Spectral Looter steals the Miraculouses) Lucky Charm! (creates a calendar) How am I supposed to catch a ghost with a calendar?
Bunnyx: (over earbud) Maybe the villain's allergic to dates?
Chronobug: No, no, no, no! (tries to grab Spectral Looter but it fails once more)
Spectral Looter: (puts on the Miraculous rings, waves tauntingly to Chronobug and floats away)

title: Miraculous London/Transcript
text:
Miraculous London/Transcript - Intro
Chronobug: (leaps out of the room from the window, looks around for Spectral Looter before noticing a purified akuma flying away) A butterfly? (gasps) Bunnyx! The ghost must be an akumatized villain! (uses yo-yo to her hoist herself up on the rooftop while running on them)
Bunnyx: (over earpiece)  Creative. Someone who got their hands on the Butterfly Miraculous.
Chronobug: And someone who knows who I really am! (she looks as she can see that the wish has been made) The wish...! (jumps in a portal back to the Burrow right before it's too late)
Bunnyx: Let's go back. (starts scrolling)
Chronobug: It's pointless.
Bunnyx: Hm?
Chronobug: We can chase that villain all we want but we'll never catch up to them, we can't even touch them!
Bunnyx: So... what? Is this... the end?
Chronobug: (looks at the calendar and uses her Lucky Vision as it highlights it and a window) No. Nothing's over 'til we've tried everything. We may not find them but... there must be a way to stop them from finding... me.
Bunnyx: What do you mean?

title: Miraculous London/Transcript
text:
Miraculous London/Transcript - Intro
Chronobug: The reason why this akumatized villain was able to steal the Miraculous from me was because they knew my secret identity. But, if we can stop them from finding out who I am...
Bunnyx: Then they'll have no way of attacking you!
Chronobug: Precisely.
Bunnyx: Now we just need to figure out how your secret was uncovered. (they both leap to a window)
Chronobug: I can only think of one possible moment. During my final battle against Monarch.
Bunnyx: You mean when Gabriel Agreste become a hero. (Chronobug suddenly looks sad) Sorry, that wasn't funny. (scrolls back)
Chronobug: Wait! (the window shows the Butterfly Miraculous on the edge of the catwalk, right before it fell) Hold on. I could retrieve the Miraculous of the Butterfly and everything would be back to normal.
Bunnyx: I'm not gonna lie, it was an ultimate blunder and it's gonna haunt you for a long time but it's too late. If you did that now, you'd change the course of history and like adult me would say...
Adult Bunnyx: When you're trying to solve a problem, don't go and cause more problems.
Chronobug: You're right, you and other you.

title: Miraculous London/Transcript
text:
Miraculous London/Transcript - Intro
Bunnyx: Let's stick to figuring out who discovered Marinette as Ladybug. (plays the window)
(The Butterfly Miraculous falls off the edge of the platform. Gabriel makes an attempt to grab it only to be stopped by Bug Noire, as she ties her yo-yo on his ankle. And by this, the platform is shaken, causing the Butterfly Miraculous to fall in the water below as Bug Noire runs at him.)
Gabriel: Nooroo,-
Chronobug: Stop! Go back just a little. Careful... There!
Bunnyx: (shows another supervillain, Timestalker hiding behind the rubble in the back, gasps while looking at Chronobug and zooms in on Timestalker)
Chronobug: Maybe they're the one who took the Miraculous of the Butterfly. Go back some more. (rewinds a few seconds earlier as Timestalker suddenly appears out of nowhere in the scene as she climbs over the rubble and sees Bug Noire and Gabriel) That's how they found out who I am.
Gabriel: Veno— (aims his fist towards Bug Noire, but is blocked by her bare hand)

title: Miraculous London/Transcript
text:
Miraculous London/Transcript - Intro
Bug Noire: If you meant what you said earlier, then we both want the same thing: we want Adrien to be happy. (Timestalker spies and eavesdrops in from a distance) There's no such thing as a perfect wish. Every time the power is used for personal gain, it causes disasters. Power of any nature should only be used for the greater good. But we can think and work out a solution on our own human scale, even though it won't be as perfect as we want it to be. (She lets go of her hand on Gabriel's and de-transforms) Spots and claws away. (de-transforms back to Marinette and stands up as Timestalker observes from a distance)
Chronobug: Let it roll, I need to figure out what they want.
Bunnyx: (resumes the clip)
Tikki: This is impossible!
Plagg: Marinette, don't trust him! (And Marinette was wrong in trusting him...)
Gabriel: (grabs Marinette's hand...) Venom! (...and paralyzes her and takes off her earrings and wears it on his earlobes.) I already have my solution, Marinette. (wears the Cat Miraculous as Tikki and Plagg huddle in on each other in fear) Gimmi, reveal yourself! (As they can't disobey their holder, Tikki and Plagg transform into their true, celestial forms.)

title: Miraculous London/Transcript
text:
Miraculous London/Transcript - Intro
Gimmi: I am Gimmi, the Kwami of Reality. (Marinette is relieved from her paralysis)
Marinette: Gabriel! NO!! (slams her fist against the force field) Don't do this!!
Gabriel: (turns around to Marinette) Marinette, make sure that Adrien never knows about the villain that I was, (puts down the twin rings on the ground) but instead, that he remembers the times I tried to be a good father. (turns back to Gimmi)
Gimmi: What do you wish for?
Gabriel: Read my heart.
Gimmi: What do you sacrifice?
Gabriel: Read my soul.
Gimmi: So be it.
(A bright pink light shines upon them. Emilie levitates from her pod as Gabriel floats with her in midair, reuniting with her. The Ladybug and Cat Miraculous fall off from him and he embraces Emilie in his arms as both of them disappear in the light as Marinette and Timestalker use their arms to block themselves from the blinding light. When it fades, it appears that Gimmi's power barely changed anything as the Crypt remains the same, and Marinette is safe and sound.)
Marinette: (gasps, looks around before walking towards the now-empty cryogenic pod)

title: Miraculous London/Transcript
text:
Miraculous London/Transcript - Intro
Timestalker: (eyes the Miraculous rings, his Alliance ring, the double rings, and the Miraculouses Gabriel left but right before she can go and take them, Marinette turns around as she hides back behind the debris pile)
Marinette: (puts the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses back on as Tikki and Plagg emerge out of them)
Timestalker: (hears something in the back, turns around and sees Nathalie sliding down into the room via a crossbow and the giant hole in the ceiling)
Marinette: What did Gabriel Agreste wish for?
Plagg: (sadly) He... gave up his life.
Tikki:(sadly) In return for Nathalie's, knowing she was gravely ill.
Nathalie:(shocked) He... did that? (Walks in with her crossbow aimed at Marinette as the two kwamis and Marinette turn to her at the sound of her voice)
Marinette: Tikki, Plagg, unify! (transforms into Bug Noire and swings yo-yo around as a shield, prepared for a battle)
Nathalie: I'm not here to fight. I was expecting to find Gabriel here, not you. (Bug Noire gasps) I should have stopped him. Years ago. (throws crossbow on the ground as Bug Noire gasps and stops spinning her yo-yo) I'm not like him, Marinette.

title: Miraculous London/Transcript
text:
Miraculous London/Transcript - Intro
(Seeing there's no hiding her secret since Nathalie saw her transform back into Bug Noire, Marinette stands up, and her eyes begin to fill with tears as her guilt and heartbreak begin to set in)
Bug Noire: I tried to save him, I tried to reason with him. For Adrien's sake. Surely, we could've worked out a solution together and now, Adrien no longer has a father, all because of me. (breaks down) Adrien's all alone all because of me.
Nathalie: (walks to her) What did you want to do?
Bug Noire: The wish... I should've made the wish. For Adrien.
Nathalie: And what would you have sacrificed?
Bug Noire: ...Myself.
Nathalie: (squats down to her) By rekindling what was still good in Gabriel Agreste, you saved us all. Besides, Adrien isn't alone, he has you.
Bug Noire: ...And you too. (the two embrace in a hug as Bug Noire continues crying before putting on the Miraculous rings and looks around) The kwamis... Where are the kwamis?
Nathalie: Follow me. (walks off as Bug Noire follows and as Timestalker writes down in her notebook before pressing on their watch and disappearing)
Bunnyx: Wow. (presses the window as it closes) Like we need another supervillain.

title: Miraculous London/Transcript
text:
Miraculous London/Transcript - Intro
Chronobug: They're not another supervillain.
Bunnyx: Huh? How do you know?
Chronobug: Because they wrote everything down in a notebook.
Bunnyx: And?
Chronobug: If they were just any akumatized villain, they'd only need to tell what they saw to the new Hawk Moth who would then send a new akumatized villain after me to steal the Miraculous.
Bunnyx: Makes sense.
Chronobug: But they had to write everything down because they knew that they wouldn't remember once they transformed back. So, they needed to keep a record of what they saw. Because they're operating all alone, without having anyone to share information with.
Bunnyx: Are you saying that...
Chronobug: The superspy and the superghost are the same person. The person who retrieved the Miraculous of the Butterfly.
Bunnyx: They gave themselves the power to uncover your secret and another power that allowed them to steal the Miraculous from you.
Chronobug: Exactly.
Bunnyx: Wow. And you figured this out just by seeing the notebook, Detectivebug?

title: Miraculous London/Transcript
text:
Miraculous London/Transcript - Intro
Chronobug: Elementary, my dear Bunnyx. Now go back in time to right before I de-transform in front of Gabriel Agreste. (gets rid of Lucky Charm) We're gonna stop them from finding out I'm Ladybug.
Gabriel: Veno— (aims his fist towards Bug Noire, but is blocked by her bare hand as Chronobug steps out of a portal behind Timestalker)
Bug Noire: If you meant what you said earlier, then we both want the same thing: we want Adrien to be happy. (Chronobug slowly walks up to her and swings her yo-yo at Timestalker as she quickly turns around kicks her away and goes below as the two quietly fight. Timestalker jumps above, presses on her smartwatch and disappears right before Chronobug can get her) There's no such thing as a perfect wish. Every time the power is used for personal gain, it causes disasters. Power of any nature should only be used for the greater good. But we can think and work out a solution on our own human scale, even though it won't be as perfect as we want it to be. (Chronobug looks around but after finding nothing, she jumps back into a portal Bunnyx opens)
Chronobug: They got away.
Bunnyx: Maybe. But this time, they did not find out that you're Ladybug.

title: Miraculous London/Transcript
text:
Miraculous London/Transcript - Intro
Chronobug: Except the future isn't back. Which means they'll somehow figure it out another time.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Intro
"Miraculous World: Paris, Tales of Shadybug and Claw Noir" (or simply "Miraculous Paris") is a 44-minute special TV movie of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. "Miraculous Paris" is the fifth written and third released movie in the Miraculous World series. The film premiered worldwide in France on October 21, 2023.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Synopsis
Extended Summary
Miraculous holders from another world appear in Paris. They come from an alternate universe where everything is reversed: the holders of Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses, Shadybug and Claw Noir, are the supervillains, and the holder of the Butterfly Miraculous, Betterfly, is a superhero. Ladybug and Cat Noir will have to help Betterfly counter the attacks of their evil doubles and prevent them from seizing the Butterfly Miraculous. Can our heroes also help Betterfly make Shadybug and Claw Noir better people?
Short Summary
Ladybug and Cat Noir find out that there is a parallel world where the holders of the Miraculous of the Ladybug and the Black Cat are the villains and the holder of the Miraculous of the Butterfly is a hero.
Hachette Jeunesse
While Marinette and Adrien are wondering about their powers, which are becoming heavier and heavier to carry, two supervillains from a parallel universe, Shadybug and Claw Noir, land in their world to seize the Butterfly Miraculous. Ladybug and Cat Noir will have to face their evil doubles to prevent them from doing evil, and to show them that a better world is possible...
Canal+

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Synopsis
Shadybug and Claw Noir come from a parallel universe where everything is reversed. They use the Miraculouses to serve their own interests and do evil things. When they arrive in Paris to wreak havoc, Ladybug and Cat Noir will do everything in their power to put things right and send them back to their own world.
Disney+
Miraculous carriers from a parallel world appear in Paris. Shadybug and Claw Noir seem to be chasing Betterfly, just as Ladybug and Cat Noir usually do... except that for them, everything is reversed. And it's for the wrong reasons that Shadybug and Claw Noir want to take over Betterfly's Miraculous. Can Ladybug and Cat Noir help Betterfly make Shadybug and Claw Noir better people?
Netflix
Dark doubles of Ladybug and Cat Noir from another world invade Paris to steal the Butterfly Miraculous, sparkling a showdown for the powerful jewel.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Production Timeline
As revealed on Fred Lenoir's resume, the script was written in 2022, between "Miraculous London" and Season 6.
As revealed on Manon Desveaux's, Alban Rodriguez's, and Chloé Sutter's LinkedIn profiles, the storyboard was done between October 2022 and January 2023.
Through the Summer 2023 issue of the Total Licensing magazine, a poster was released, revealing the title, a new design for Alya (later revealed to be Ubiquity) and a Q4 release date.
On June 27, TF1 released a synopsis and a trailer as part of their back-to-school conference.
By August 12, the novel adaptation by Hachette Jeunesse was made available to preorder on Amazon, set to release on October 4. A new synopsis was also revealed.
At an unknown time, the special was added to the Entertainment Identifier Registry (EIDR) under the title "Miraculous World: Into The Re-Verse" with an expected release on November 18 on Disney Channel.
On September 14, Disney Channel France's schedule for October was released, revealing a synopsis, four renders and a release date of October 21.
On September 16 and 17, Ezra Weisz posted photos of the first page of the script he had just received.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
