On September 21, Disney Channel France released the final poster.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Plot
In an alternate universe, Betterfly and Alya watch the news broadcast in his lair, displayed by Maxkov, relaying the events of "Strikeback" to them. Betterfly asks Maxkov if they have a chance to jump to this universe, in which Maxkov answers that they have a 92.7% chance of succeeding. Shortly after, the two turn to Nino, who runs onto the catwalk and warns them that Shadybug and Claw Noir are arriving. After Alya reasons that they have no other choice, Betterfly kamikotizes her into Ubiquity. Shadybug and Claw Noir destroy the pathway and leap before a terrified Nino.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Plot
Back in the Quantic Universe, Gabriel returns to his lair and reels in pain as he holds his Cataclysmed arm after escaping the Musée Grévin. He exits out of the news on his phone and attempts to contact Nathalie, only to be directed to her voicemail, much to his frustration. He leaves his lair and stands in front of Adrien's door. Adrien is seen sitting on his couch, watching the news on mute. Though he reaches to knock on his door, his sleeve slides down, showing off the scar left by the Cataclysm. Gabriel immediately pulls it up and walks back to his study room. In Adrien's room, Adrien expresses his worries about his power to Plagg. Though Plagg relates through his love for cheese at first, after realizing Adrien's concern was genuine, he decides to comfort him, assuring him that destruction is a path to build anew.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Plot
Back in Marinette's room, Marinette and Alya share the same discussion as in the end of "Destruction", with their talk ending with a hug between them. While Tom and Sabine watch the news in their living room, Tikki flies down to a plate of macaroons and takes a bite of one, catching Tom's attention. Tom alertedly looks at the plate, but shortly relaxes. He confesses to Sabine that now that Monarch has stolen all of the Miraculouses, and he isn't sure of he'll ever stop worrying. Sabine reassures him that Ladybug and Cat Noir have already recovered the Rabbit Miraculous, and that things will return to normal. After she finishes off the macaroon, Tikki flies back to Marinette's room.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Plot
Marinette confides in Alya that she isn't sure what she can do now that Monarch has all the Miraculouses, leaving her and Cat Noir to face him without them. Alya consoles her, saying that she can't lose hope, before suddenly standing up and stepping away. Alya abruptly transforms into Ubiquity, with Betterfly jumping through her cape immediately after. Betterfly pleads with Marinette to take him to Ladybug and Cat Noir, but Marinette, unsure to whether trust him, declines his request, denying any knowledge of their whereabouts. Alya briefly regains consciousness and wonders if he's Monarch, but Betterfly begins explaining that Alya is an ally in his universe and created a portal connection between his and their world. Alya is soon taken over by her alternate counterpart once more, alerting them that Shadybug and Claw Noir forced her to reopen the portal and warns them to run.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Plot
Betterfly scoops Marinette into his arms and jumps out of her balcony door before Shadybug and Claw Noir step through the portal, holding a destroyed Maxkov and Nino hostage. After Claw Noir shoves Nino back through the portal, Shadybug rips his belt off and restrains Ubiquity with it. Shadybug has a quick look around the room, voicing her distaste at the various images of Adrien, who she deems a "perfect, stuck-up brat". Claw Noir is quick to defend him, to which Shadybug claims he must be a huge fan of his. She jumps on Marinette's bed and briefly glances at her photo board before looking up at the balcony, stating Betterfly must've gone out through there. Claw Noir summons his Cataclysm and blasts the bedroom wall with it before leaping out of it, which consequently alerts Tom and Sabine. Shadybug orders Ubiquity to stay where she is before swinging out.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Plot
Betterfly runs along the rooftops with Marinette in his arms as Ubiquity informs him that Shadybug and Claw Noir had tied her up. Betterfly thanks her for her effort before removing her power, returning the original Alya back. Sabine knocks on the bedroom door and asks if the girls are okay. Alya quickly reassures her that they are and that the loud noise was caused by a video game with the volume too high. Sabine tells her to not stay up too late, which Alya promises they won't. Alya then searches the room and finds her phone, which is completely cracked from Betterfly’s visit. She rushes to Marinette's computer and calls her through it. Once Shadybug and Claw Noir meet each other on top of a skyscraper, Claw Noir complains that the city is too big to be able to find Betterfly. Shadybug then calls her Lucky Charm and uses it to locate Betterfly. She informs Claw Noir that it's a pair of special binoculars that can detect the scent of a kamiko. After a short squabble between the two, Shadybug eventually picks up the scent of a kamiko making its way towards the Eiffel Tower.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Plot
At the Eiffel Tower, Betterfly leaps his way to it while still carrying Marinette. He jumps up it, before setting Marinette down on a step of one of its staircases. He tells her to stay here where it is safe. The kamiko flies into Betterfly's cane as Marinette is surprised that it is not an akuma and Betterfly is confused as to what that is. Suddenly, the Eiffel Tower is being destroyed as debris starts falling to the ground as Claw Noir and Shadybug have found where Betterfly and Marinette are hiding. Claw Noir cataclysms the staircase Betterfly and Marinette are on as they fall.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Plot
Betterfly lands safely and catches Marinette just in time. Asking whether or not Marinette is okay, she nods. Betterfly escapes the area with Marinette still in his arms, Shadybug and Claw Noir arrive at the ground too late. They call out for Betterfly to reveal himself as he and Marinette are hiding behind a wall quite a distance away. Claw Noir threatens if not, he will destroy the entire planet as he activates a huge Cataclysm (reference to "Cat Blanc"). Shocked and scared, Betterfly tells Marinette to be safe as he comes out of his hiding spot, running towards the two supervillains as he yells out at them to stop, telling them that the people from this universe have done them no harm. Claw Noir withdraws his Cataclysm as Shadybug summons up a sword as her Lucky Charm. They fight as Marinette watches. Just then, Alya video calls Marinette as she picks up. Alya concerningly asks Marinette if she managed to escape Betterfly, Marinette responds by informing Alya that she believes Betterfly may actually be another Butterfly Miraculous holder who is a superhero instead of a villain as she shows the duel between Shadybug, Claw Noir and Betterfly as she gasps in surprise.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Plot
Meanwhile, Betterfly tries to tell the villains that it is possible for a better world.
Shadybug and Claw Noir ignore his words as he is sent flying due to being hit by one of Shadybug's Lucky Charms.
Astonished the supervillain duo has the same powers as Ladybug and Cat Noir, Alya is confused as Tikki explains that Shadybug and Claw Noir are from just one of the many upon billions of parallel universes in the Multiverse.
She elaborates further that there is not enough time in any human's lifetime to even explain just the basics of the Multiverse and its parallel universes.
Back to the fight, Betterfly's attempts to convince the supervillains that they are being manipulated by The Supreme.
Marinette asks Tikki how these underage villains can repeatedly use their powers without transforming back.
She tells Marinette that using the power comes from vital energy from the kwami but also the user and that there is a security system.
However, thanks to the Miraculouses being used for evil, the countdown is overridden and that the two villains are paying a terrible cost.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Plot
After instructing Alya not to let her parents enter her room, Marinette transforms into Ladybug and decides to join in on the fight.
Just as he is trapped, Betterfly tries to plead to the villain duo to join The Resistance, but they refused. About to grab the Butterfly Miraculous from him, Ladybug swings her yoyo at Shadybug's arm as she looks confused. Presenting herself, she orders the supervillain pair to set Betterfly free. Trying to persuade the two to relinquish their Miraculouses as they are meant to be used only for the greater good, Claw Noir charges towards Ladybug and starts to try to attack her with his staff. Shadybug creates a car, kicks it and traps both Betterfly and Ladybug with it. Just as Claw Noir is about to kick the heroes, Cat Noir comes in the nick of time and kicks Claw Noir. Cat Noir threatens to cataclysm Claw Noir if he doesn't give up. Instead, Claw Noir forces the hero to Cataclysm him and now having a crack in his chest, Cat Noir stumbles back, shocked and horrified. While Claw Noir kicks Cat Noir and sends him flying into a building.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Plot
Noticing how the villains can use their powers multiple times with no limitations, Cat Noir ponders how such a thing is possible. Introducing himself, Butterfly shows himself to Cat Noir as he is perplexed. Ladybug promises to explain the entire thing to him. The heroes and the villains fight. With no other choice, Betterfly charges up a kamiko and kamikotizes Cat Noir, who understandably refuses it at first. Trying to tell him that he is a good person and is trying to help his situation, Cat Noir accepts the power offered and is kamikotized into Celesticat, an white angelic cat superhero. He grabs Ladybug and Betterfly and flies off. Shadybug uses her yoyo to grab on to Celesticat by his belt, but using her Lucky Vision, Ladybug undoes his belt as Shadybug falls to the ground as Claw Noir pretends to caught her. Unconscious due to the impact, Claw Noir attemps to grab her Miraculous but she wakes up and grabs his finger, twists it and prevents her just in time. Celesticat continues carrying Betterfly and Ladybug and flies, dropping them off in the sewers. Betterfly dekamikotizes Celesticat as his kamiko is revoked and he turns back into Cat Noir.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Plot
Meanwhile, in the crypt, Gabriel is talking to Émilie as he talks about though his powers have increased, his time is decreasing much less now. He hears the anger from Shadybug and Claw Noir. They fight, arguing and shouting at about how they have tried to steal each other's Miraculous. Gabriel, who detects these negative emotions decides this may lead to the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses finally being in his possession.
In Monarch's lair, Gabriel who unifies the Butterfly and Horse Miraculouses becomes Monarch and creates a megakuma. Using the power of Voyage, the megakuma is transmitted to the area where the fight is occurring. Shadybug who sees the megakuma panics and believing it to be a Kamiko, uses Claw Noir as a shield. Cataclysming it, they argue over whose fault it was that they got angry and made Betterfly to detect their emotions. Calming down by taking deep breaths, Shadybug announces she has a plan as to what the next step is. Monarch who is in his lair, notices his trace of the megakuma is non-existent as well as their negative emotions and detransforms back into Gabriel.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Plot
In Marinette's bedroom, Alya notices the yo-yo entering it and quickly jumps off Marinette's computer and hurries off to hide. She sees Shadybug and Claw Noir entering it and searching through Marinette's belongings for a clue. She breathes a sigh of relief that she hasn't been found out yet.
In the sewers, Cat Noir and Ladybug detransform to feed their kwamis and to recharge. And Betterfly (hiding around a corner) breaks down, sobbing. Upon hearing his cries, Marinette inquires as to what is the matter. Betterfly compliments Ladybug and Cat Noir's world, saying how they're partners and help each other and how in his, helping other people is considered a crime. Betterfly goes on that ordinary civilians are unaware of the existence of the Miraculouses as they are a secret. He explains how The Supreme uses them to perpetuate his evil rule on the alternate universe where Butterfly is from. Admitting he did indeed steal two Miraculouses and used them for the wrong reasons and accidentally he hurt someone he loved dearly (referring to his wife) and decided he needed to use his powers for good.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Plot
Meanwhile, in Marinette's room, Shadybug continues to look around for any clues or anything particularly interesting, finding Marinette's secret diary. Seeing Claw Noir play around with Ladybug & Cat Noir Dolls, she reads Marinette's diary. In the sewers, Butterfly tells Marinette that he realizes his greatest dream isn't too far away and that they can help him make his dream become reality. But she tells Butterfly that their universe isn't all that perfect as Monarch had recently stole the Miraculous she was responsible to guard.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Plot
Shadybug continues reading Marinette's secret diary, becomes touched and cries upon reading how Marinette's life is filled with joy, friendships and happiness with those near her that support and help her in any kind of situation imaginable. She reads about how the Ultimate Power and the wish can be unlocked and the price that comes with it. Alya who sneaks back downstairs, exits as Claw Noir yawns. Quietly, creating a pair of handcuffs as a Lucky Charm, she sneaks up behind Claw Noir, taking him by surprise and handcuffs him as he falls to the ground. Unfortunately for him, Shadybug takes off his Miraculous just before he finishes activating his power. Rendering him powerless, Shadybug discovers to her shock that the secret identity of Claw Noir is none other than Re-Verse Adrien Agreste.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Plot
Downstairs, Alya sneaks downstairs, finding Tom and Sabine sleeping together on the couch as the show on TV blares. Seeing Sabine's cellphone, she decides to take it. The cheering of the show on TV wakes Sabine up as she puts her feet up, covering her phone and as Alya facepalms in frustration. In Marinette's bedroom, Shadybug puts on the Cat Miraculous and detransforms into Re-Verse Marinette, surprising Re-Verse Adrien who remembers how he saw Re-Verse Marinette in the bakery back in his universe from his car. Smiling that he knows who Shadybug is and that it is the girl he loves, he blushes when Re-Verse Marinette asks him if he knows her. She makes Tikki and Plagg reveal themselves. Now in their revealed forms, she tries making Gimmi reveal themselves to wish to switch lives with her good counterpart only to fail due to a magical seal being placed on the kwamis' mouths.
Back downstairs, Alya manages to take Sabine's phone just as she wakes up from watching television.
She turns it off, and she and Tom decide to head to bed.
In Marinette's bedroom, Re-Verse Marinette and Adrien hear the Supreme's voice declaring that only he can change reality, and that reality is the Supreme.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Plot
As Tikki and Plagg revert to their original forms, Marinette stumbles back in shock and accidentally breaks a mirror.
Sabine, hearing the noise from downstairs, asks Re-Verse Marinette if everything is okay.
Posing as her counterpart, Re-Verse Marinette replies that her sewing machine is broken while noticing dark veins on her face from her wish attempt.
Sabine reassures Re-Verse Marinette that anything broken can be repaired.
Wishing Sabine a good night, Re-Verse Marinette transforms into Shadybug and releases Re-Verse Adrien from the handcuffs.
She throws the Cat Miraculous back to him, and Re-Verse Adrien transforms into Claw Noir.
He tries to comfort Shadybug and asks why The Supreme never told them that merging their kwamis would grant them any wish they desired.
Shadybug, crying, explains that the Supreme never mentioned this because using their Miraculouses could lead to misuse, and that no wish could save them from their fate.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Plot
Just then, Monarch who steps out of a Voyage portal behind them and tells them Ladybug's and Cat Noir's Miraculouses will definitely get them their wish. Summoning up a sword for her Lucky Charm and calling upon his Cataclysm, Shadybug and Claw Noir attempt to use their powers on Monarch, only for both of their attempts to fail. He tells the duo that he is unaffected to their powers due to using the Ox Miraculous as well as he is the best chance for both of them to have their wishes granted, unaware that they are secretly being filmed by Alya. With no other choice, they agree to do Monarch's plan.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Plot
Back in the sewers, Marinette and Adrien transform into Ladybug and Cat Noir. They go up to Betterfly and decide to help him. Alya rushes out of the bakery, riding Marinette's mini scooter and calls Marinette without success. The three heroes race through the city, searching for Shadybug and Claw Noir. They stop when they hear and see giant versions of Shadybug and Claw Noir calling for them. Initially, they believe this is the result of Monarch akumatizing them. Betterfly snaps his fingers to undo the akumatization but soon realizes that they are not akumatized villains. Just then, Betterfly, Ladybug, and Cat Noir hear Alya calling out for Ladybug. Alya jumps down and plays the video she recorded on Sabine's phone, revealing Monarch's plans.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Plot
Back on the Eiffel Tower, the three supervillains wait for the heroes to take action. Monarch reassures Shadybug and Claw Noir that Ladybug and Cat Noir will arrive, as they always do. Meanwhile, Alya shows the superheroes the footage she has recorded, revealing that the giant versions of Shadybug and Claw Noir are merely illusions created by the Fox Miraculous. Ladybug devises a plan to defeat Monarch. She explains that the Butterfly Miraculous has a limited range, so they need to travel to London, which is far enough away to be out of Monarch’s reach. Once there, Betterfly will use his powers to kamikotize Alya back into Ubiquity. After that, Betterfly will lend Ladybug his Butterfly Miraculous, allowing her to combine it with her own Ladybug Miraculous to transform into Ladyfly. With her new powers, Ladybug will then kamikotize Re-Verse Gabriel into Guardian Angel. His kamikotized object will be sent to a parallel universe, making it inaccessible to Monarch, who will not be able to undo Re-Verse Gabriel's kamikotization. Guardian Angel will protect both Ladybug and Cat Noir, and they will use their earpieces to stay in touch during the mission.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Plot
On the Eiffel Tower, Monarch shows Shadybug and Claw Noir, Ladyfly, Cat Noir, and Ubiquity rush towards them. Monarch then removes Ubiquity's powers as the heroes' plan unfolds. Ladyfly destroys the Shadybug illusion, feigning surprise as Monarch teleports Shadybug to her. The two holders of the Ladybug Miraculous engage in battle. Meanwhile, Cat Noir swings in and destroys the illusion of the giant Claw Noir, pretending to be unaware of it. Monarch then uses the power of Voyage to teleport the real Claw Noir next to Cat Noir. He unifies the Butterfly Miraculous with the Horse, Mouse, Bee, and Rooster Miraculous while eliminating the Fox and Ox. Finally, he divides himself into three clones, with two of them using the power of Sublimation to become invisible.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Plot
Claw Noir and Cat Noir engage in a fierce battle, during which Claw Noir uses his cataclysm ability to destroy Cat Noir's earpiece, cutting off his communication with Ladybug. At the same time, a confrontation unfolds at Collège Françoise Dupont between Shadybug and Ladybug. One of the invisible Monarchs attempts to use Venom on Ladybug, but his effort fails due to the protection of Guardian Angel. Instead, he becomes paralyzed and is covered in white feathers. Meanwhile, another invisible Monarch clone tries to use Venom on Cat Noir, but his attempt is also unsuccessful, and he ends up being covered in feathers as well. At the Eiffel Tower, the Monarch brings the three clones together. Realizing that he cannot find any signs of kamikotization, he realizes that it was a trap. In response, he uses his Voyage ability to teleport himself back to his lair.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Plot
At the school, Ladyfly summons a mirror as her Lucky Charm. Shadybug confides in Ladyfly about her difficult life, explaining that nobody is there to help her, and all she experiences is pain and suffering, especially from Chloé, who has made her life miserable. Despite this, she recalls how The Supreme entrusted her with the Miraculous. Ladyfly then detransforms back into Marinette as Shadybug watches her, tears in her eyes. Meanwhile, at the swimming pool, Cat Noir and Claw Noir are engaged in a fight. Cat Noir questions Claw Noir about why he is pursuing a Miraculous he already possesses. Claw Noir replies that his and Shadybug’s powers don’t work, but his and Ladybug’s do. He then reveals that losing his mother has deeply affected him, and he wants to use the wish to bring her back. At the school, Marinette tells Shadybug that she loves the world around her, despite how harshly it treats her. She explains that she has found happiness everywhere, and she believes that she doesn’t need any magic to feel fulfilled.
At the pool, Claw Noir pins Cat Noir and removes his Miraculous, revealing that Adrien is Cat Noir.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Plot
Adrien explains to Claw Noir that he briefly considered making a wish but ultimately decided against it because everything comes at a cost.
He shares how he has moved on from the loss of his mother and encourages Claw Noir to repair the mistakes he made regarding Nino.
As the sun begins to rise at the school, Shadybug looks at Marinette, who nods.
Shadybug uses her Miraculous Shadybug  and throws her Lucky Charm into the air, reversing all the damage caused during the fight.
Shadybug gains a new appearance and admires herself for a few moments before hugging Marinette and laughing.
Back at the pool, Adrien helps Claw Noir up, and the Cataclysm mark on his chest and the dark veins on his face disappear.
Claw Noir returns Adrien's Cat Miraculous, which Adrien gratefully accepts.
The heroes gather near the Eiffel Tower, and Claw Noir and Cat Noir join the other heroes.
Claw Noir compliments Shadybug on her new look, and she suggests it wouldn't hurt Claw Noir to get a new outfit, too.
Concentrating, Claw Noir grunts and transforms, rebranding himself as Furry Paw, and announces his new appearance.
Meanwhile, Shadybug declares that she will now be known as Ladybug.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Plot
Alya is rekamikotized into Ubiquity once again.
In Monarch's lair, Monarch uses Sublimation to gain the power to travel to any universe. Ubiquity senses this opening, and Ladybug realizes that Monarch is utilizing the Rooster Miraculous. Betterfly becomes frightened by the fact that Monarch can now travel across universes, and Cat Noir states that he will attack every Ladybug and Cat Noir in existence. However, Ladybug decides to handle the situation herself. Ubiquity is de-kamikotized as Betterfly transmits the kamiko to Ladybug, who catches it as it flies into one of her Ladybug earrings, as she's kamikotized into Ladybiquity.
In a parallel universe where Scarabella and Kitty Noire are the main heroes of Paris, Scarabella reverses all the damage caused by Lollipop Boy, successfully repairing the Eiffel Tower.
Kitty Noire joins her, and they share a triumphant "Pound it!" fist-bump, just as a portal opens behind them, created by Monarch.
Monarch suddenly kicks Kitty Noire aside and tosses Scarabella to the ground, attempting to steal her Miraculous.
However, Ubiquity (Marinette) intervenes, delivering a punch to Monarch, causing him to stumble backward through the portal.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Plot
Monarch then tries to escape to another parallel universe, one depicted in an anime style.
He pokes his head out of the portal, only to be spotted by the Ladybiquity and Cat Noir from that universe.
Ladybiquity swiftly kicks Monarch in the stomach and then in the face, sending him flying out of the portal and landing in his lair.
Determined, Monarch creates a new portal and enters a comic book universe.
There, he is met by another Ladybiquity, who hits him in the face with her yo-yo.
Monarch is propelled into yet another universe, where Adrien and Marinette are holding each other’s Miraculouses.
Upon seeing Ubiquinoire from this universe, Monarch gasps in shock and fear.
As she runs, jumps, and strikes him with her staff, he is finally sent back to his own universe.
As Monarch detransforms back into Gabriel, Nooroo and Orikko emerge from their respective Miraculouses.
Defeated, he vows to destroy Ladybug and every other Ladybug across all parallel universes before collapsing in defeat.
Meanwhile, Ladybiquity is dekamikotized back into Ladybug as the kamiko flies out of her earrings.
She states that Monarch won't be traveling to any other world anytime soon.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Plot
Ladybug, Cat Noir, and Alya are determined to find a way to defeat Monarch once and for all, even though they haven't figured out how to do it yet.
Betterfly reassures Ladybug that she will succeed and thanks her for her help.
In turn, Ladybug expresses her gratitude to Betterfly for helping them regain their hope.
Furry Paw suggests that they need a team name.
However, Re-Verse Ladybug is worried that they won’t be laughing when The Supreme realizes they are no longer on his side.
Betterfly responds that The Supreme won’t be laughing either.
He believes they will become stronger now that they are united.
Ladybug and Re-Verse Ladybug hold hands, and the former reminds the latter that she has friends in this world.
Furry Paw and Cat Noir share a hug before letting go, with Cat Noir reminding Furry Paw that they have more friends waiting for them on the other side.
Alya, who is once again rekamikotized into Ubiquity, levitates as Betterfly, Re-Verse Ladybug, and Furry Paw walk toward Ubiquity, preparing to return to their universe to confront The Supreme as a united team.
Before leaving, they all do a "Pound it!" fist bump.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Plot
After that, Re-Verse Ladybug, Furry Paw, and Betterfly walk through Ubiquity to return to their universe.
Ubiquity is then dekamikotized back into Alya as the kamiko is purified and flies away.
At the bakery, Alya deletes the video from Sabine's phone.
Marinette and Alya then head downstairs for breakfast, which has been prepared by Sabine.
Both girls yawn, still feeling the effects of last night's battle, as the special comes to an end.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Plot Development
The special is set within "Destruction", starting after Gabriel's arm is wounded by Cat Noir's Cataclysm, but before he reconfigures the Miraculouses into rings, in the overlapping events of "Multiplication", but before the events of "Jubilation".
This also increases the record for the most episodes happening on the same day and night, now six, including "Risk", "Strikeback", "Evolution", "Multiplication", "Destruction" and this special.
This special is what ends the night where Gabriel gets all the Miraculous and is Cataclysmed by Cat Noir, as it ends when the sun rises and the next morning.
This episode reveals more insight about the Cat Miraculous and Cataclysm as well as the Ladybug Miraculous and the Lucky Charm:
It is revealed that if Cataclysm is used on a transformed unrestricted Cat Miraculous holder, they will not die. It will simply leave an uninjured mark where they were hit, such as Claw Noir's chest being wounded as a result of it being used on him.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Plot Development
However, one has to consider that the Cataclysm only wounds a transformed Miraculous holder, taking between weeks and months for the wound to become fatal, and that, at the end of the battle, Shadybug used her Miraculous Shadybug to fix all the damages caused since the moment they arrived to Ladybug and Cat Noir's world, including his Cataclysm wound Claw Noir forced Cat Noir to inflict to him.
The Cataclysm can also be used to blast through objects. As Claw Noir was blasted through the roof of Marinette's room.
Shown that it can also be deactivated without having to touch something.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:

It's also revealed that the transformation phrase for a Butterfly Miraculous holder that is a superhero is "Nooroo, light wings rise" and the de-transformation phrase is "Nooroo, light wings fall".
It's revealed that in the show, there are billions of parallel universes, and kwamis live their lifetimes in all these universes simultaneously.
In one of those universes, an entity called "The Supreme" possesses all the Miraculous and has used them to dominate the world, with the existence of the Miraculous being unknown to everyone except the ones The Supreme entrusts them with.
Gabriel Agreste joined the Supreme and stole two of their Miraculous (Butterfly and Peacock) so he could get what he wanted most, only to lose his wife, which led him to want to prevent anyone else to suffer, becoming the holder of the Butterfly Miraculous called Betterfly, who uses his kamikos to fight the Supreme.
According to the Betterfly theme song, Émilie used to be the holder of the Peacock Miraculous (like her counterpart). But it's unknown if she used it to become pregnant with Adrien nor if that is the real reason why she died, as it's unknown if the Peacock Miraculous also got damaged in that world.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Plot Development
In the alternate universe, Marinette never had friends and the severe bullying of Chloé led her to join the Supreme and become Shadybug. She also hates Adrien Agreste and doesn't get along with Claw Noir.
Additionally, Adrien was not able to move on from his mother's death, unlike his father, and also joined the Supreme, becoming Claw Noir. He also has a crush on Marinette and doesn't get along with Shadybug.
The Supreme has given Shadybug and Claw Noir the mission to recover the two Miraculous Gabriel had stolen.
Despite the fact that the Ladybug and Cat Miraculous are able to summon Gimmi, the kwami of reality, to allow someone to have a wish, that ability has been sealed by the Supreme, in order to prevent the holders they choose to wear it from using it, not even telling them about it. So, despite the fact that the holders can still force Tikki and Plagg to reveal their real forms, they cannot have them merge themselves.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:

Because both Tikki and Plagg exist in all universes, whenever they fuse together to form Gimmi and grant a wish, that wish only reshapes the universe they belong to. It's unknown what would happen if one version of Gimmi were summoned outside of their respective universe or if one version of them would be able to affect more than just one universe depending on the wish.
In another universe, Alya and Zoé are the holders of the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses respectively, becoming Scarabella and Kitty Noire who fight a supervillain who, at least, is the holder of the Peacock Miraculous.
In another universe, Marinette and Adrien have switched Miraculous, with her being Lady Noire and him being Mister Bug as their status quo.
Two other universes were shown, referencing the original Ladybug PV that preceded the current series and the many comic book adaptations.
Yet, it's unknown how the kwamis knew the existance of parallel universes however as done by both Gabriels it could be that Nooroo's or Orikko's powers were used once used to do it before.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Plot Development
It's revealed that the reason why underage Miraculous holders need to de-transform back after summoning their superpowers once is because the use of the Miraculous takes energy from both the kwami and the holder, enabling a countdown timer that prevents them from using their powers before they are ready.
It's revealed that, besides growing up, akumatization and using time-related Miraculous, the only other way to override the countdown is for using a Miraculous for evil, which allows the young holders to use their powers multiple times, but with that taking a great toll on their bodies, causing a magical necrosis similar to those caused by the effects of Cataclysm. However, if the young holders reform and with the Miraculous Ladybug (superpower), then the corruption is reversible.
Which would explain why the kwamis warned their owners of never using their Miraculouses for selfish or evil reasons and yet, it's also unknown why Team Miraculous or at least Ladybug and Cat Noir didn't ask why they couldn't access their full powers a lot sooner.

title: Miraculous Paris

It could be for what they did wasn't completely evil (in the terms of what they wanted) so neither of them had enough evil or sadness within them to override the security measures on the miraculous and yet it could also be that the duo were able to get the jewels away from them or have them repent their ways before the condition could take effect.
It should be noticed that the only times Chloé used the Bee Miraculous unintentionally for evil purposes, she had been akumatized (into Queen Wasp in "Queen Wasp" and into Miracle Queen in "Miracle Queen", where Hawk Moth manipulated her into betraying the duo for his goals in the latter). title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Trivia
Production for the special started in 2022, along with Season 6 & Miraculous London. The script first started being written in the same year.
During production, the special was known as "Into the Re-Verse" (referencing Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse) or just "Re-Verse".
The planned Miraculous and Ghostforce crossover was scrapped in favor of this special.
The official synopsis and French title of special were revealed on June 27, 2023, in the TFOU 2023-2024 programming presentation.
The first teaser - then labeled "work in progress" - was shown in the related conference the next day. It was later officially released on September 30, 2023, via Disney Channel France.
Prior to its broadcast, a 144-paged novel adaptation of the special was released on October 4, 2023 in France by Hachette Jeunesse.
This is the first movie special to take place entirely at night and then sunrise at the end.
According to Thomas Astruc, a spin-off featuring characters from the Re-Verse would be "too expensive" to produce, but the universe would be seen again in the future.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Trivia
This is the first piece of Miraculous media to have ZAG's, Method Animation's, Mediawan Kids & Family's (formerly On Kids & Family), De Agostini KidsMe's (formerly De Agostini and DeA Kids), Disney's, and SAMG's new logos in its credits.
Despite the first half of all three "Miraculous World" intros being nearly identical, there are differences between this one and the previous two:
The Miracle Box in Ladybug's hands disappears and she gets sad.
The old design of the Miracle Box is seen in the other shots, and has the Supreme's symbol on its bottom side.
Unlike the previous two "Miraculous World" specials, this special has two different intros: the first one is a remake of the series' intro song centered on Betterfly, and the second one is the normal "Miraculous World" intro.
In the first few lines of his song Betterfly says "Fear is a cage", which might be referring to his counterpart Monarch who gave into or fell into so many fears and destroyed everything.
This could also refer to when Monarch is going to put the kwamis in cages showing his dominance but also the fearful position of the kwamis.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Trivia
According to Thomas Astruc, Betterfly's opening had a very limited budget, so executives wanted to scrap it. However, they ultimately managed to include it by using static images instead of 2D animation.
This is the second special following "Miraculous Shanghai" to have a cold open and no post-end card scene.
Between both universe versions, this episode breaks the record for the most uses of Lucky Charm, Cataclysm and Akumatization (or Kamikotization) used in a single episode.
When Alya video-calls Marinette through her computer, a PDF file can be seen. Judging from the file name "anglais", this appears to be an English test.
This is the first special where Ladybug, Cat Noir and Monarch's transformation sequences aren't shown.
This special shows Monarch creating a megakuma while on his first version for the first and only time.
Interestingly, while there were empowerings in this episode, they were all kamikotizations. Not a single akumatization was shown. This was possibly because Monarch knew that using akumatization would be pointless, since Betterfly would be able to undo it meaning both kamikotization and akumatization are the same power.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Trivia

This is the only time Monarch tried to akumatize someone in his Pre-Rings suit.
Counting alternate timelines, this is technically the second time a Cataclysm has been used directly on an Akuma/Megakuma, following "Cat Blanc".
This is the second time Cat Noir's night vision is seen, following "Stormy Weather".
This is the first time ever where a Miraculous fusion is done in a TV movie special and the first one, in general, to involve a Miraculous from another universe.
As well as where the other kwamis from the Chinese Miracle Box make an appearance in a miraculous special for the first time.
This is the first time a Miraculous tool ear communicator is broken.
In Sabine's contact list, Gina's contact is with what seems to be her maiden name Bianchi. Since she is listed with her maiden name, it's possible to that she started using it after splitting up with Roland.

This is the sixth time Gabriel is after another Miraculous that wasn't just the Ladybug or Cat, he sought to take the Butterfly Miraculous from the Re-Verse from his alternate self following "Sandboy", "Ikari Gozen", "Miraculous New York", "Miraculous Shanghai", "Sentibubbler", "Reunion" and "Pretension".
All photos of Adrien on Marinette's board, except the one in the bottom left corner, are from "Lies".
This is the fourth time where we see two Ladybugs are seen at the same time following "Timebreaker", "Sandboy" and "Cat Blanc", but unlike the other three, this time it's a result of multiuniverse travel also through it, we see two Cat Noirs at the same time for the first time.
Allusions
When Betterfly saying "stronger together" may be a reference to the tagline used in the promotion Ladybug & Cat Noir: The Movie. Master Fu also says it when he met Ladybug and Cat Noir in act 2.
Shadybug/Ladybug calls Claw Noir/Furry Paw "Fleabag", like Ladybug in "Ladybug & Cat Noir: The Movie".
Shadybug grabbing Claw Noir's middle finger is a reference to the Mortal Kombat 11 announcement trailer where Raiden breaks Scorpion's finger

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Trivia
When the endcard appears the sound effect is similar to Super Smash Brothers Ultimate Newcomer splash screen.
After Cat Noir makes the giant Claw Noir illusion disappear, he says "Could it be that, it's just an illusion", referencing the song "Just an Illusion" by Imagination.
Errors
The mouse cursor on Marinette's computer is shown to be black, even though it was white in "Gorizilla".
Marinette could've simply just changed it after said episode.
When the Miraculous Shadybug passes over the Eiffel Tower, nothing changes.
When Claw Noir asks Adrien why he didn't try to use his and Ladybug's Miraculouses to bring his mother back, Adrien explained if he did that, someone else's mother would have to take her place. However, he only learned the benefits and consequences of Ultimate Miraculous Absolute Power weeks later in "Passion" with Marinette's explanation.
It's possible Master Fu told him before losing his memory.
If Betterfly used the Butterfly Miraculous for evil in the past, and yet when he changed, he started calling the butterflies kamikos, he shouldn't have been confused when Marinette called them akumas. However, there could be a few reasons for this:

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Trivia
It could be that like his original counterpart he didn't know that his power had an opposite side.
What he said was true and apart of his commitment to change was that he vowed to never use the dark name of his power again.
Depending on how long he has been using the jewel for good maybe he forgot its dark name.
When Betterfly joined the Supreme at first maybe he was given a different jewel but when he defected and stole the Butterfly and Peacock jewels like he said but lost the jewel used in his plan while fleeing with the other two.
He may have originally called them kamikos in the first place.
There are many errors related to Monarch throughout the special:
When Monarch transforms in his lair, he switches positions between shots, having his arms out. Additionally, his tie is missing for his hand.
When he is transformed, the Miraculouses that he doesn't use are in their camouflaged modes instead of activated modes.
When he de-transforms after Claw Noir Cataclysms his Megakuma, he says "Dark Wings Fall" instead of "Reverse Morphosis".
When he adds Mullo, Pollen and Orikko to the unification at the top of the Eiffel Tower, he forgets to mention the names of Trixx and Stompp.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Trivia
Also after this addition, the Fox and Ox Miraculouses suddenly return to their camouflaged modes and he no longer has the Fox Miraculous' Flute or the Ox Miraculous' Mallet, as if they got automatically disabled.
However, it is possible that this is not an error, since this could be a way of adding new kwamis and releasing other kwamis at the same time. By not mentioning the names of active kwamis (in this case Trixx and Stompp) when calling for unification, he did not need them for the transformation, so he automatically deactivated their Miraculouses when he unified the others.
Also, when he activated the Rooster Miraculous, he automatically gained the power of invisibility, without manifesting it by speaking Sublimation.
When Monarch uses the Mouse Miraculous to multiply himself, he says "Multiplication" instead of "Multitude".
When Monarch multiplies himself, the other two versions have all the Miraculous with them too. But as seen in "Kwamibuster" when Multimouse uses her power, her versions don't have any other Miraculous except the Mouse one.
In the scenes where Monarch seems to be using the Rooster Miraculous, it is actually in its activated mode instead of charged mode.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Trivia
When Monarch unifies Nooroo and Orikko lastly in his lair to travel across universes, he reaches the Fountain Pen on his back but in reality it was on his right arm, so he couldn't take the pen with just only one hand from his arm.
When Shadybug gives back the Cat Miraculous to Adrien, the ring is initially in its camouflaged mode then enters its activated mode. It should've initially been in its activated form, and then turn into the camouflaged one.
In the flashbacks of Adrien about Marinette in the Re-Verse, and when Shadybug gives the Cat Miraculous back to Adrien, his miraculous has different camouflage modes.
Deneen Melody isn't listed in the English credits, despite Kitty Noire speaking in the first alternate universe Monarch visits.
Keith Silverstein is also not listed as voicing The Supreme.
Shadybug calls her Lucky Charm without saying the words several times throughout the special.
According to Thomas Astruc, they have a rule on this, but it would be too long to explain by a tweet.
In the end card, Ubiquity's skin is lighter than usual.
After Ladyfly de-transforms in front of Shadybug, Nooroo is missing.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Trivia
In Gabriel's lair, Mullo is miscolored white and has the wrong ears.
Cat Noir proclaims that he'll send Shadybug and Claw Noir back to their world, despite Ladybug not having yet explained to him who they are.
When Claw Noir tries to steal Shadybug's miraculous shortly after she fell from the sky, she grabs the former's index finger but in the next shot it is shown to be his ring finger.
Mister Bug's eyes from the alternate universe are like Cat Noir's, instead of normal green eyes.
When Monarch went to parallel universes and Marinette's kamikotized forms followed him, he forgot that he could take away her powers like he did with Alya/Ubiquity earlier to prevent her from stopping him, because, as stated by him and Betterfly, as long as they have the same miraculous, one holder can undo the other's power.
It could be like in "Evolution", where his emotions made him forget that the heroes could follow him.
Or he suspected that the akuma/kamiko would be too far from him to sense anything.
When the special was first released on Disney Channel in Latin America, an unfinished version was aired with a lot of errors:

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Trivia
There are no backgrounds during Ladyfly's unification, the 2D universe, and the end card.
While he's in the background, Maxkov doesn't have his face, instead just having Markov's eyes.
When Betterfly is kamikotizing Alya in his lair, a strangely edited light mask appears on her face after the close-up shot of the elevator.
A device's screen is doubled in three separate scenes: when Tom and Sabine are watching TV, when Marinette and Alya speak from the bottom of the Eiffel Tower, and when Alya shows the heroes her recording of Monarch's plan.
A black screen briefly appears before Cat Noir accepts being kamikotized.
There are no special effects over Tikki's and Plagg's revealed forms.
A shade (seemingly Hawk Moth's) is seen behind Gabriel before he transforms to send an akuma after Shadybug and Claw Noir.
Guardian Angel disappears for a frame while marking Ladyfly and Cat Noir, and Ubiquity doesn't have a portal effect at the bottom of her cape. Furthermore, during the whole scene in London, the flashback effect is missing.
While going after Ladybug and Cat Noir, Monarch is only partially invisible.
When Scarabella fixes everything, no ladybugs appear.

title: Miraculous Paris
text:
Miraculous Paris - Trivia
Multiple errors occur in the Latin American dub of the special:
The Scarabella from the alternate universe is voiced by Marinette's voice actor.
Shadybug uses Ladybug's detransformation phrase, instead of a unique one.
In the version aired on Channel 5 in Mexico, the voiceover "reads" the first logo as "Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir".
In all broadcasts, the voiceover calls the special "Miraculous Ladybug: Escape from the Re-verse".
For an unknown reason, Ladybug's angry Lucky Charm sequence from "Psycomedian" is used, instead of the usual one.
The tables in Gabriel's lair appear and disappear between scenes.
