title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
Betterfly's Theme Song
Nadja Chamack: Hello and welcome. If you're tuning in now, today's event is, of course, the new attack of Shadow Moth in Paris. Luckily, Ladybug and Cat Noir have saved Paris yet again. Clara, you're live...
Betterfly: Is it ready? Can we make the jump?
Maxkov: There's a 92.7% statistical chance of landing in a world where these source images originated.
(An explosion is heard, turning the lair into a hue of orange. Betterfly and Alya see the lair's hatch going down, and Nino comes out running in panic while holding a gun.)
Re-Verse Nino: I'm sorry- I can't stop them! They're coming!
(The lair ceiling begins to crumble.)
Re-Verse Alya: (to Betterfly) We don't have a choice!
Betterfly: (Creates a kamiko) Fly, my kamiko, and magnify the glimmer of hope that shines in Alya Césaire's heart! (the kamiko enters Alya's eyeglasses) Ubiquity, I am Betterfly. I give you the power to connect to the parallel world we have located so we can find help. With this gift, I'm exposing you to many perils and placing a great burden on your shoulders. Do you accept it for the greater good?
Re-Verse Alya: I do. (Transforms into Ubiquity.)

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
(Claw Noir activates his cataclysm and breaks the glass hatch as the two villains break into the lair, making Nino cower in fear.)
Nadja: (in a news broadcast) After months of battle, supervillain Monarch, who once went by Hawk Moth, as well as Shadow Moth, has managed to seize the Miraculous that Ladybug had been guarding. Monarch now threatens to attack Paris relentlessly.
(The kwamis huddle together in fear as Gabriel starts to remove all the Miraculous from his body onto the table.)
Barkk: We're heading straight for disaster! I knew it! I told you!
Orikko: Shh! Be quiet, Barkk! You're gonna jinx everything!
(Gabriel glares at the kwamis, causing them to be terrified much more. He shifts his head back to the table and turns off the broadcast from his phone and searches Nathalie on his list of contacts, and calls her.)
Nathalie's voicemail: You've reached Nathalie Sancoeur's voicemail. I am not available at the moment. Please leave a message.

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
(Gabriel ends the call, furious. He puts his eyes on the Miraculous pooled on the table and puts them all into his suit pocket, he takes a deep breath and steps on the hatch as he glared upon the kwamis again, signalling them to follow him. In the mansion, he walks down the stairs towards Adrien's room whilst holding his cataclysmed arm. Inside the room, we see Adrien on the couch, watching the news broadcast as well. Gabriel decides to knock, but as soon as his sleeve slides down to reveal his blackened arm, he retracts and confines himself in his office instead.)
Adrien: This power's so heavy, Plagg. I feel like I'm losing control.
Plagg: I feel the same every time I see a slice of Saint-Nectaire. It fades away eventually. (gobbles up a slice of camembert.)
Adrien: But for real, Plagg... What if I ended up destroying everything around me without even meaning to?
Plagg: For real? (frowns) Sometimes, destroying is the best path to build anew. Trust me. It works for me more often than not.
(Adrien looks at his ring again.)
Alya: (v.o.) You really showed some self-control, Marinette.
Marinette: (v.o.) You... You think...?
Alya: (v.o.) Of course!

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
(Camera switches inside Marinette's room.)
Alya: You didn't get the kwamis back but it's only a matter of time. I know it.
(Marinette smiles bittersweetly.)
Alya: And here I was wondering how I would help you without superpowers but (scoffs) you don't even need me.
Marinette: (grabs Alya on her shoulders) Of course I need you. The one superpower you'll never lose (embraces Alya) is the power to be the best BFF ever.
Nadja: (on TV) After months of battle, supervillain Monarch, who once went by Hawk Moth, as well as Shadow Moth, has managed to seize the Miraculous that Ladybug had been guarding. Monarch now threatens to attack Paris relentlessly.
(In the kitchen, Tikki sneakily flies in to grab a bite on a plate full of macarons. As Tom hears rustling noises, he quickly mutes the television and turns to Sabine.)
Tom: Did you hear that?
(Tikki, on the verge of getting caught, stops from eating one of the macarons, and so she quickly escapes by phasing under the table, leaving the bitten macaron on the table. Tom and Sabine look at the table where the macarons are, only to find no one there.)
Tom: Now that Monarch has all the Miraculous, I don't think I'll ever stop worrying.

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
Sabine: (gives Tom a kiss on his cheek, reassuring him) Ladybug's already got one back. Before you know it, everything will be back to normal.
(Tom smiles and unmutes the broadcast. Tikki comes back to finish the macaron and as she flies back upstairs, she sees the footage of the Parisians cheering for Ladybug and Cat Noir on television, making her smile before she finally comes back to Marinette's room.)
Marinette: I'm not sure I can do it this time, Alya. Monarch's got all the Miraculous and Cat Noir and I... it's just the two of us again. I feel like I've tried everything. I just don't know what to do anymore!
Alya: Marinette, it's normal for you to have your doubts, but you can't give up hope and—
(A whirring sound makes Alya squint her eyes in pain.)
Marinette: Alya?!
(As Alya continues to experience extreme pain in her head, she stands up from the chaise lounge and drops her phone, and drops down on her knees in agony.)
Marinette: (runs towards Alya) Alya!

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
(Just then, a flash of light envelops Alya as she transforms into Ubiquity and opens up a portal right in front of Marinette. Then, Betterfly jumps out of the portal, making Marinette reach out one of her hands to her earrings as an instinct to protect it, and Tikki shakes her head "no".)
Betterfly: Forgive my intrusion, young lady. Please, don't be scared. My name is Betterfly. I need someone to lead me to the holders of the Miraculous of the Ladybug and the Black Cat in your world.
Marinette: Ladybug and Cat Noir? But... I-I don't know how to find them. I... I don't know them. I'm just Marinette, just a normal girl.
Betterfly: I beg you, please. They're my last hope!
Marinette: I'm not sure there's anything to hope for from Ladybug. (looks down)
(Betterfly sighs. The other purple-themed heroine closes her portal and holds on one of the room's wood beams to keep her from falling.)
Ubiquity: Marinette? What just happened?
Marinette: You transformed into... (makes hand signs)
Betterfly: Ubiquity. In the universe where I come from, Alya Césaire's my ally. She connected her power to you in order to open a gateway between our two worlds.

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
Ubiquity: (confused) Uh— uh— Is this another one of Monarch's schemes?
Betterfly: (tilts his head in confusion) "Monarch"?
(A painful whirring sound brings Ubiquity back in pain once again and re-opens the portal against her will.)
Ubiquity: I'm sorry! They made me open again! I can't hold it for long! RUN!
Betterfly: You can't stay here! They're merciless! (carries Marinette in his arms and leaps out to the balcony as Tikki follows them from behind)
Marinette: Hey! Let go of me!
(Betterfly leaps from building to building in order to escape. Meanwhile, inside Marinette's room, a silhouette appears from Ubiquity's portal who appears to be Ladybug's evil doppelgänger, Shadybug, who is holding a robot's head and throws it on the side. She is then followed by Cat Noir's evil counterpart, Claw Noir, while holding Re-Verse Nino and shoves him back to the portal.)
Claw Noir: There! You can have your boyfriend back! (Shadybug pulls out his belt) Hey! (Shadybug uses the belt to tie Ubiquity and keep her captive.) Don't yank the tail!

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
Shadybug: At least now it's being put to good use. (stares at Marinette's wallpaper of Adrien in her monitor) Even in this world, we find pictures of that self-centered Adrien Agreste.
Claw Noir: Obviously, he can only be perfect here, too.
Shadybug: A perfect stuck-up brat. No wonder you're a fan of his. (jumps up on Marinette's bunk bed and looks at her board full of pictures of her friends, and notices the open trapdoor above her) They must've gone out this way!
Claw Noir: I'd rather go out with a bang!
(He activates his Cataclysm and destroys one of the walls of the room, causing distress between Tom and Sabine. Sabine goes up to look. Back in the room, Shadybug and Claw Noir prepare for their departure.)
Shadybug: (to Ubiquity) And you are our ride back. Don't move. (swings away with her yo-yo)
Ubiquity: Betterfly, they tied me up!
Betterfly: You carried out your mission perfectly. Thank you for everything. I release you from the power I gave you.
(Ubiquity de-transforms into Alya as the kamiko flies away.)
Alya: Marinette? Marinette?!
(Sabine knocks on the trapdoor)
Sabine: Everything okay, girls?

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
Alya: Uhh, we're fine! (throws away Claw Noir's belt) Everything's fine, Ms. Dupain-Cheng! We just uh... we started playing a video game and the sound was too loud. That's all!
Sabine: Very well. Don't stay up too late, okay?
Alya: Sure thing! No worries!
(Sabine goes back down the stairs. Back in the room, Alya sighs in relief and looks for her phone, but groans as she realizes her phone was broken. She looks for other solutions around the room and eyes Marinette's monitor.)
Alya: Yes!
(She quickly dashes to the monitor and contacts Marinette.)
Claw Noir: Argh, which way did he go?! He could be anywhere! The city is too big! We'll never find him!
[Superpower Sequence]
Shadybug: Lucky Charm!
(summons a pair of binoculars)
Claw Noir: What is it this time?
Shadybug: A butterfly tracker... kind of. These binoculars can detect butterfly pheromones — their smell, in a way.
Claw Noir: Don't bother pretending to have a smart plan when all you have is luck.
Shadybug: And what's your plan besides showing off and destroying everything? (In her point of view in the binoculars, she sees a purple streak coming from Betterfly's purified kamiko.) Ah... there it is.

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
Betterfly: Whatever happens, stay here where it's safe. No one should suffer because of a battle that isn't theirs. (Opens his cane to receive his purified kamiko) Thank you for your help, little kamiko.
Marinette: (Pointing to the kamiko) That's not an akuma?
Betterfly: An "akuma"?
(A loud creaking sound is heard surrounding the tower as Claw Noir's Cataclysm signals his and Shadybug's arrival.)
Betterfly: What in the—
(The tower is quickly becoming covered in rust and collapses, sending Betterfly and Marinette falling down. Betterfly quickly catches Marinette successfully.)
Betterfly: Are you okay?
(Marinette nods.)
Claw Noir: (jumping down from above with Shadybug) You use your Lucky Charm, I prefer intentional harm, more direct!
Shadybug: But not discreet and even less clever.
Claw Noir: He can't be that far. (yelling) Boogerfly, We know you're hiding here!
Shadybug: Show yourself! Otherwise...
(Camera shows Betterfly and Marinette hiding behind a concrete wall.)
Claw Noir: We'll turn this lousy world to ash! (activates his Cataclysm once again, creating a massive black hole underneath the Eiffel Tower, to Betterfly and Marinette's horror)

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
Betterfly: (To Marinette) I'm sorry that you got involved in this fight. Please, take care of yourself. (leaps out the concrete wall) Stop! The people of this world haven't harmed you!
Claw Noir: (retracts his cataclysmic black hole) You know what to do then.
Shadybug: (uses her Lucky Charm and summons a weapon) Hand over the Miraculous you stole!
(The battle ensues between Betterfly, Shadybug and Claw Noir, while Marinette stays hidden behind the concrete wall.)
Tikki: Are you okay, Marinette?
Marinette: Yes. No... I don't know, Tikki!
(Marinette's phone rings, getting a call from Alya.)
Alya: Marinette! Did you get away from that supervillain?
Marinette: I think he's the holder of the Miraculous of the Butterfly, Alya. Except, a superhero, not a villain!
Alya': (her eyes become wide in shock) HUH?
Betterfly: (as his back got slammed against a car) Look around you! A better world than ours is possible!
Claw Noir: The only thing I'm interested in looking at is your destruction! (charges Betterfly with his Cataclysm, but Betterfly evades it quickly, and so Claw Noir ends up disintegrating the vehicle instead)

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
Shadybug: And your imminent defeat! (changes her Lucky Charm object into another weapon and uses it to send Betterfly flying to the side)
Alya: They have the same powers as Cat Noir and you?!
Tikki: They're the holders of the Miraculous of the Ladybug and the Black Cat from one of the billions of parallel universes in existence, and those two are not very nice versions.
Marinette: Parallel universes? Why didn't you tell me about this?
Tikki: It's just, I've lived for billions of years in every single one of these universes simultaneously, and there simply aren't enough hours in your lifetime to tell you even the tiniest bit about it... so, I choose to stick to the basics and make the most of the time we have together.
Betterfly: (offscreen) The Supreme is manipulating you!
Shadybug: It's your fault! (throws her weapon at Betterfly) You shouldn't have stolen the Miraculous from him!
Betterfly: (pulls out the weapon impaled on the metal wall) The Supreme abuses his powers!
(Shadybug creates another Lucky Charm object, a rolling pin, and throws it at Betterfly.)
Betterfly: Power must be shared!
Marinette: How can they use their powers repeatedly without transforming back?

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
Tikki: Using the power of the Miraculous draws vital energy from the Kwami, but also from the holder. So, there is a security system to protect those who are still a little too young, like you and Cat Noir. You transform back before it becomes dangerous for you.
Marinette: But... for them...
Tikki: They use their Miraculous for evil purposes. It overwrites the "security system" — no more automatic de-transformation. But the price to pay for that is...
Marinette: (concerned) ...Terrible? (pauses briefly) Alya, don't let my parents go into my room before Ladybug's fixed everything.
Alya: You can count on me!
Marinette: Thanks. (hangs up) Tikki, spots on! (transforms into Ladybug)
(Betterfly lies on the concrete and is cornered by the two villains.)
Claw Noir: Trapped like a bug, (uses his staff to keep Betterfly from standing up) you ugly butterfly.
(As Shadybug is about to grab hold of the Miraculous of the Butterfly, Betterfly tightly grips on her wrist as he pleads...)
Betterfly: Join the Resistance! Everything can change! This world is the proof of it! It's not too late for you!

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
Shadybug: (gasps and groans) The Resistance ends here... with you! (creates another weapon for her to use to finish Betterfly... and just in time for Ladybug's entrance, as she hits Shadybug's wrist, knock the weapon from her grip) What in the—
(Ladybug's yo-yo retracts back to her and the camera zooms out to reveal Ladybug herself. Shadybug gasps in disgust and shock.)
Ladybug: I never thought I'd ever say this but... let go of the butterfly man!
Claw Noir: Another polka-dotted bug?!
Ladybug: The name's Ladybug!
Shadybug: Whatever, pest! (brings out her yo-yo)
Ladybug: Hand over your Miraculous! They shouldn't be used for evil, only for the greater good!
Claw Noir: Ugh! How corny! (retches) I'm going to barf out a hairball! (pulls out his staff and converts it into nunchucks with cat claws on both ends as he charges towards Ladybug with it)
(Claw Noir attempts to attack Ladybug but she narrowly escapes by jumping out of the way of his bladed-nunchucks. Shadybug then ties her up in her yo-yo and swings her around violently before throwing her at the tower, however Betterfly catches her and brings her back down to the ground.)
[Superpower Sequence]
Shadybug: Lucky Charm!

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
(Shadybug one again activates her Lucky Charm which forms into a car. She expertly spins around in the air and kicks the car at Ladybug and Betterfly, pinning them to the wall.)
Betterfly: Push! (They try to push the car off from them)
(Claw Noir jumps down towards Betterfly and Ladybug to attack them, but is intercepted by Cat Noir who finally arrives at the scene.)
Cat Noir: (Slides between Claw Noir's legs to avoid his attacks before grabbing him by the arm and using his free hand to activate his Cataclysm, threatening Claw Noir.) Easy kitty, I'm trying to keep my cool.
Claw Noir: (Manically smiles at Cat Noir) Think you're the cool cat?!
(Claw Noir flips the situation by grabbing Cat Noir's hand and holding his other hand with the active Cataclysm towards himself.)
Claw Noir: (mockingly) Awwhh, is the itty bitty kitty scared he might hurt me with his cute wittle claws? (he progressively pulls Cat Noir's hand to his chest)
Cat Noir: (horrified) Don't do it!
Claw Noir: (He smiles crazily again before forcefully placing Cat Noir's hand on his chest, cataclysming himself by proxy.)
Ladybug:(horrified) No!
Betterfly: (gasps in horror)

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
Claw Noir: (He groans in pain as Cat Noir steps back in fear, he then presents the cracking on the front of his suit with a smile.) No black cat is as cool as this black cat!
(Claw Noir then rushes towards Cat Noir and flings him far beyond the tower and into a nearby rooftop as Betterfly and Ladybug finally push the car off of themselves, now free.)
Ladybug: Enough is enough! The Miraculous were not created to cause harm! (ties Claw Noir up in her yo-yo)
Claw Noir: And what makes you so righteous, cockroach? (he cuts her yo-yo off of himself) Are you with the superpower police?!
[Reused Superpower Sequence with Ladybug's angry expression from Psycomedian]
Ladybug: Lucky Charm!
(Ladybug activates her Lucky Charm and it forms into a traffic cone.)
Ladybug: A traffic cone?
Claw Noir: (mockingly) Oh no, I'm so scared! (He uses his nunchucks to bat the Lucky Charm over to himself.) Cataclysm! (He then dissolves the Lucky Charm object)
Cat Noir: (He lands next to Ladybug.) Why do these akumatized heroes get all the magical powers and we don't? It's not fair!
Ladybug: They're not akumatized.
Cat Noir: Then what are they?
Betterfly: (popping his head up) They're Shadybug and Claw Noir.

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: (surprised) And who the cat are you?!
Betterfly: (extends his hand) Betterfly, it's an honor.
Cat Noir: (shocked) Huh?
Ladybug: (sighs) I know. I'll explain everything to you later.
(Shadybug starts throwing Lucky Charm heels at Betterfly who jumps out of the way, she then reshapes it into a rocket launcher, shooting a rocket at Betterfly)
Ladybug: (Ladybug uses her yo-yo to bat away the rocket while also parrying Claw Noir's attacks and then kicking him in the face whilst Cat Noir jumps up and kicks the flying rocket towards Shadybug herself, to which she simply dissipates her Lucky Charm and reshapes it into a helmet which she swings around with her yo-yo, trying to hit Ladybug and Betterfly.)
Cat Noir: They're gonna wish they were back in their world faster than a whip of my tail! (He jumps toward Shadybug with his staff equipped, prepared to attack her.)
Shadybug: (She reshapes her Lucky Charm into a gun ready to shoot Cat Noir.)
Ladybug: Watch out Cat Noir!

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
(Betterfly then creates and quickly sends a kamiko towards Cat Noir, which lands inside his staff, surprising him as the telepathic light mask appears. Time seems to slow as the pigeons nearby move very slowly and Shadybug's fingers on the trigger move slowly too)
Cat Noir: (telepathically, shocked) Hey! What're you-
Betterfly: Celesticat, I am Betterfly.
Cat Noir: (understandably scared) No, get out of my head!
Betterfly: I'm not your enemy, I only want to entrust you with the power to save us.
Cat Noir: (telepathically) How do I know you're telling the truth? I don't know you.
Betterfly: I only work for the greater good, like you Celesticat. Do you accept this gift I am offering you for the greater good?
Cat Noir: (telepathically) I do. (Cat Noir is then fully kamikotized into Celesticat, his suit shining a bright white light which blinds Shadybug and Claw Noir.)
Celesticat: Brace for takeoff! (He grabs Ladybug and Betterfly's arms and takes off into the night sky away from Shadybug and Claw Noir.)
Claw Noir: They're getting away!

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
Shadybug: (She reshapes her Lucky Charm into sunglasses) From you maybe kitty-catty. (Her yo-yo wraps around Celesticat's tail and she is pulled along with him) Later, loser!
Celesticat: (He, Ladybug and Betterfly notice Shadybug's presence and he tries to shake her off of him by flying erratically in the air.)
Shadybug: Aaaah! (She groans as she is flipped around in the air, she then reshapes her Lucky Charm into the same gun from before, trying to aim at Celesticat.)
(Ladybug's vision shows Celesticat's belt as the way out of this situation.)
Ladybug: Dear passengers, you may now unbuckle your seatbelt! (She unhooks Celesticat's belt, making Shadybug fall to the ground.)
Celesticat: The cat-ptain and his crew hope you had a pleasant flight!
Claw Noir: I'll save you! Don't worry, cockroach, I'll catch you! (He squats in place ready to catch Shadybug, but moves out of the way last minute, letting her hit the ground) Oooh! Too bad, I was this claw-se!
(Shadybug groans in pain before apparently fainting. Claw Noir then kneels in front of her and moves to take her Miraculous, but then...)
Shadybug: (She grabs his finger and twists it, sitting upright) Try that again, fleabag!

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
(Celesticat flies into the sewers and places Ladybug and Betterfly down before being de-kamikotized back into Cat Noir, the kamiko returning inside Betterfly's cane.)
Gabriel: (Gabriel kneels next to Emilie's cryogenic pod with one hand on it) I have to pull myself together, Emilie. I may have more Miraculous than Ladybug now, but not as much time.
Shadybug: Useless cat! (Gabriel, using the empathetic abilities of the Butterfly Miraculous, hears Shadybug and Claw Noir arguing)
(Back in the streets, Shadybug and Claw Noir are still arguing while Gabriel is listening in.)
Shadybug: (She pushes Claw Noir) Why are you always trying to steal my Miraculous!
Claw Noir: Like you never try to steal mine!
Shadybug: (she slaps away his hand that was pointing at her accusingly) I'm just trying to get rid of you fleabag! I'd be better on my own!
Claw Noir: Oh yeah?!
Shadybug: Yeah!
Claw Noir: Yeah?!
(We switch back to Gabriel)
Gabriel: Ah.. I feel a dual source of anger and despair! The magical jewels of the Ladybug and the Black cat may finally be within my reach, my love.
(The camera cuts to Monarch's Lair where Gabriel is looming as the window opens)

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
Gabriel: Nooroo, Kaalki, Dual Metamorphosis! (transforms into Monarch and then creates a Megakuma)
Monarch: Fly to these hearts that are as black as mine Megakuma! Voyage! (he opens a portal for the Megakuma to quickly reach Shadybug and Claw Noir)
Shadybug: I'll be the one to seize the Miraculous of the Butterfly in the end and I'll be the one The Supreme spares!
Claw Noir: In your dreams!
Shadybug: (Shadybug notices the Megakuma) Huh?! A kamiko! (she then uses Claw Noir as a human shield away from the Megakuma)
Claw Noir: Cataclysm! (Claw Noir destroys the Megakuma)
Shadybug: (She then pushes him away) If you didn't make me so angry, Betterfly wouldn't have detected our emotions kitty-catty!
Claw Noir: (Angrily) Then DON'T get angry!
Shadybug: Argh! (Shadybug takes a deep breath and calms herself down before glaring at Claw Noir)Claw Noir: Fine, fine, lets calm down. So then, what do we do now.
Shadybug: It's a good thing I still have a brain, and a lead.(Both Shadybug and Claw Noir leave the streets using their tools)Monarch: I don't feel the emotions anymore, or my Megakuma! Hm, Dark Wings Fall! (detransforms back into Gabriel.)''

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
Alya: (Alya hears Shadybug's yo-yo hit the wall of Marinette's room, three circular blades protruding out of it keeping it firmly attached to the wall.) Ah! (She quickly turns off the computer and hides behind a frame.)
Shadybug: She's freed herself.
Claw Noir: She can't be far. (Claw Noir picks up and reattaches his belt before walking over to the trapdoor and starts to open it.)
Shadybug: Where do you think you're going? Stay here and help me search for a clue. If the portal between our worlds opened here there must be a reason.
Claw Noir: You're not the boss of me, detective cockroach.
Shadybug: Ugh!
(Shadybug starts to search around Marinette's room while Claw Noir sits on the chaise.)
Cat Noir: Claws In! (detransforms into Adrien and feeds Plagg some camembert.)
Ladybug: Spots Off! (detransforms into Marinette and feeds Tikki a macaroon.)
(Meanwhile, Betterfly is a few feet away behind a wall. He kneels and begins to weep.)
Marinette: What's wrong?
Betterfly: Your world is so different, so beautiful. You help each other, you're partners! In mine.. any form of mutual aid is a crime.
Marinette: Yet... you use your Miraculous for good!

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
Betterfly: In my universe ordinary people don't even know about the Miraculous, it's a secret. They all belong to The Supreme who uses them only to perpetuate his own power.
Adrien: "The Supreme"?
Betterfly: The name of the evil being who rules the world where I come from.
Adrien: How did you find out about the Miraculous if it's a secret?
Betterfly: Sometimes, he entrusts them to the powerful of my world, all of whom have sworn loyalty to him. I too was a part of this corrupt system in order to get something I wanted more than anything. I stole two.. but I misused them (Facepalms in shame) .. and hurt the people I loved. To redeem myself, I became Betterfly because like a moth I have no choice but to fly in the shadows in order to give people hope. Someone has to show them that we must revolt, that a better world is possible, provided that power is shared between all.
Shadybug: (Shadybug opens a drawer and finds Marinette's diary box, she breaks it open and starts to read the diary. She opens to a page displaying a photo of Marinette and Alya, surprising her. However her focus is drawn to Claw Noir who has started to play with Marinette's dolls)

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
Claw Noir: (mockingly) I'm Ladybug! But my real name's Lazybug, because I'm lazy in every single dimension! I wish you were Claw Noir because he's the real cool cat!
(Shadybug pulls down Marinette's Adrien board to separate herself from Claw Noir so she can read Marinette's diary. She sits on one of the wooden beam supports in Marinette's room and starts to read.)
Marinette: (voiceover) Dear Diary, I can't believe I made such a blunder! I'll just die of shame this time for sure! I had a presentation to do with Adrien, my Adrien!
Shadybug: (disgusted) Eugh! How can anybody be so disgustingly sweet?.. (She flips a page)
Marinette: (voiceover) Uh, Cat Noir. We haven't known each other very long but it feels like we've been together forever.
Shadybug: (Widens her eyes in realization) Ah! Ladybug. Of course, I should've known.
Marinette: (voiceover) I mean that we've been fighting villains together right? Because there's absolutely nothing between us! He's just my partner Ah- my teammate is what I mean!
Shadybug: (Shadybug looks over to Claw Noir for a moment who is throwing and catching his staff periodically) Ugh! (She flips a page.)

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
Betterfly: Now that I've seen your world, I know that my dream is not just a Utopia! And you can help me reach it!
Marinette: (sadly) You know, our world isn't all that perfect.. The one who holds your Miraculous here uses it for evil. And he just stole the Miraculous I've been guarding! If I can't manage to defeat Monarch to save my world, how could I possibly help you save yours?
Betterfly: Because the values you stand for are good, because you are the positive incarnations of Shadybug and Claw Noir. It may seem like they have more power than you, but they don't have your strength, because they know nothing about trust and friendship (Marinette and Adrien smile when hearing this). I should be as distraught as you, in my world I am hunted relentlessly, no one believes in heroes. Everyone is afraid of The Supreme, I am so lonely..
Marinette: How do you keep from giving up?
Betterfly: I hold onto the one thing I have, hope. The hope for a better world, the hope that people can evolve. For a single decision that can change an entire lifetime!
Adrien: Plagg, do you think that the other holder of my Miraculous could be that other world's me?

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
Plagg: Well y'know, when two cheeses are made from the same milk, they can taste very different depending on how matured they are! So, I guess thats a possibility, yes.
Marinette: Tikki, do you really think that the person behind that evil Shadybug's mask could be, me?
Marinette: (voiceover) The girls were here for me, as always. They really are the best! They inspire me everyday, each one in their own way.
Shadybug: (Shadybug makes a small smile as she reads the words on the page, before she shakes her head to stop. She then continues reading)
Marinette: (voiceover) Alya and me, we're BFF's, it's so amazing to have a best friend like her. We're super close y'know, she's always there for me.
Shadybug: (She sniffles slightly as she turns the page)
Marinette: Tikki quickly became my friend, she always looks on the bright side and restores my confidence when I feel all is lost.
Shadybug: (tears start to form in Shadybug's eyes which she wipes away to continue reading.)
Marinette: (voiceover) The first thing that comes to my mind when describing my mom is how calm and gentle she is.

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
(Shadybug smiles at this page while tearing up slightly and chuckling a little before wiping away her tears again, this time she flips ahead quite a bit into the diary.)
Marinette: (voiceover) Dear diary, I finally know why Hawk Moth wants our magic jewels so badly! By combining my Miraculous of the Ladybug with the one of the Black cat, you get to make a wish. But for that wish to come true, there would be a price to pay. For example, if a robot became human, then someone would have to lose their humanity in return. That's why we can never give up on our Miraculous, no one must make a wish, the balance of the universe is at stake!
Shadybug: (Takes the picture with the instructions out of the diary and then jumps down from the wooden support as Claw Noir observes Marinette's Adrien board.)
Alya: (Alya manages to escape Marinette's room when Shadybug is distracted.)
Shadybug: (quietly) Lucky Charm. (Shadybug activates her Lucky Charm in the form of handcuffs while Claw Noir yawns. She quickly moves the board upwards and handcuffs his wrists while she swipes his leg causing him to fall.)

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
Claw Noir: Ca- (Claw Noir attempts to activate his Cataclysm but Shadybug is quicker and steals his Miraculous, causing him to detransform back into Adrien, who quickly turns away from her to avoid recognition.)
Shadybug: (kneels down) Shhh..
(Re-Verse Adrien turns towards her with an angry glare, she knows Claw Noir's identity.)
Shadybug: (shocked) Adrien Agreste?!
Alec: (In a TV broadcast) Tonight, on "Never too Late to do Good", we receive one of the most influential people in all of Paris! Mister Mayor André Bourgeois!
Alya: (Alya tries take Sabine's phone, however Sabine is awoken by the cheering from the TV. To which she quickly hides. Luckily Sabine falls back asleep.)
Shadybug: (She wipes away some makeup from Adrien's face revealing some black veins from his use of the Miraculous) Ugh, makeup. Obviously, I should've guessed. (She places the Cat Miraculous on her right ring finger and turns around while Adrien looks on curiously.) Blots Off. (Detransforms back into Marinette, much to Adrien's surprise.)

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
Re-Verse Adrien: Ah.. (Now that Adrien knows Shadybug's identity, he remembers watching her from his car outside the bakery, not taking his eyes off of her even when his food was given to him by his bodyguard.)
Re-Verse Marinette: (seeing Adrien smiling at her, dryly) You, know me?
Re-Verse Adrien: (stutters in embarrassment, blushes and ends up just shrugging his shoulders)
Re-Verse Marinette: Nevermind. (She reads the instructions before commanding) Tikki, Plagg, reveal yourselves! (The two kwamis with a magical seal on their mouths hug each other in fear before obeying the command.)
(Marinette and Adrien are enveloped in bright green and pink lights as Tikki and Plagg transform into their true forms, the room becoming transparent and full of pink sparkles.)
Re-Verse Marinette: Why fight to get a better life, when I could just switch with someone else's in another world. (Marinette reads the instructions again.) Gimmi, reveal yourself!
(A dark red symbol appears beneath Marinette as Tikki and Plagg kneel over in pain with their hands on their heads.)
Alya: (Alya this time acquires Sabine's phone successfully but quickly hides as Sabine is once again awoken by the TV.)

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
Sabine: (Sabine switches off the TV) Tom?.. Tom? We fell asleep.. come on, let's go to bed. (They get up to leave but Sabine returns) Hold on, I forgot my phone.
The Supreme: (voice-over) Only The Supreme defines reality, reality is The Supreme.
(The room flashes white for a few seconds before the Wish completely fails, the recoil sends Marinette flying into the mirror and shatters it.)
Sabine: (Hearing the sound from downstairs) Marinette? Is everything alright?
Re-Verse Marinette: (angrily) Yeah, whatever just get off my back!
Sabine: (surprised with her outburst) Are you sure you're okay, sweetheart?
Re-Verse Marinette: Yes! I'm okay I- (She looks at Adrien, who looks sadly at her and softens, pretending to be her counterpart) Sorry.. Mommy dear I- I just.. dropped my sewing machine, but it's fine it's just.. slightly damaged. (Looks at her reflection in the shattered mirror, the veins on her neck are extremely visible now, reaching up to her face.)
Sabine: Don't worry sweetie we'll take care of it! Broken things can always be fixed. Goodnight sweetie, I love you! (Marinette looks surprised at this)
Re-Verse Marinette: (sadly) I.. love you too.. Mom.

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
Sabine: Wish Alya a goodnight for me! (Sabine leaves to go to bed)
Re-Verse Marinette: ... Tikki, Blots On.. (transforms into Shadybug)
(Shadybug walks to the hole in the wall of Marinette's room and snaps her fingers, with that her Lucky Charm disappears, freeing Adrien's hands.)
Shadybug: Get to work Mouser... (She throws the Cat Miraculous back to him) We've gotta take the Butterfly Miraculous back, that's all we have left anyway.. (Cries in heartbreak)
Re-Verse Adrien: (He puts on the ring) Plagg, Daggers Out. (Transforms back into Claw Noir and walks towards Shadybug, now feeling sympathy for her.)
Claw Noir: How come The Supreme never told us that merging our kwamis would grant us any wish we wanted? (Tries to put his hand on her shoulder to comfort her.)
Shadybug: (She shoves away his hand that he placed on her shoulder) For the same reason that he never told us that using our powers would slowly destroy us. No wish will save us.
Monarch: (off-screen) Not with your Miraculous, no. (He steps through a Voyage portal into the room) But with Ladybug and Cat Noir's, most definitely.
Claw Noir: Cataclysm!
Shadybug: Lucky Charm!

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
(Both Claw Noir and Shadybug attempt to attack Monarch, however with Resistance active Claw Noir's Cataclysm and Shadybug's Lucky Charm sword were ineffective, much to the rogue holders' shock)
Monarch: I am Monarch, invulnerable to your powers thanks to the Miraculous of the Ox, and I am also your best chance at having your wishes granted (Shadybug and Claw Noir look surprised at hearing this). Are you willing to work with me? Or would you rather keep on playing with your measly powers?
(Shadybug and Claw Noir look at each other and Alya opens the trapdoor slightly and recorded the three Miraculous holders as Shadybug and Claw Noir stepped down and agreed to work with Monarch.)
Monarch: Delightful. It seems like we'll get along just fine. My plan is simple.
Marinette: Tikki, Spots On! (transforms into Ladybug)
Adrien: Plagg, Claws Out! (transforms into Cat Noir)
Ladybug: We'll try to help you Betterfly.
(Betterfly smiles)
Alya: (Alya puts on a helmet while next to Marinette's moped, she tries to call her but receives her voicemail instead.) Ugh..
(Alya drives down the street as Ladybug, Cat Noir and Betterfly jump onto the rooftops.)
Ladybug: They could be hiding anywhere!

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
Betterfly: And they will do anything to get their hands on my Miraculous.
Cat Noir: Even in the darkest of nights, they won't escape my sight.(We get to see what he sees with his green tinted Night Vision.)
Claw Noir: Betterfly!
(Ladybug, Cat Noir and Betterfly stop at the sight before them.)
Giant Shadybug: If you don't want us to destroy this world-
Giant Claw Noir: Then come out, come out wherever you are! You and your new buddies!
(Shadybug and Claw Noir appear to be gigantic by unknown means.)
Cat Noir: I guess they're not hiding after all!..
Ladybug: Monarch must've akumatized them!
Betterfly: What a holder of the Butterfly Miraculous has done, another can undo. (Betterfly hides behind some chimneys and snaps his fingers at the Giant Shadybug, however nothing happens) They're not akumatized villains!
Cat Noir: You think Monarch could've lent them a Miraculous?
Ladybug: If that's true, we'll never defeat them!
Alya: Ladybug! Ladybug!
Ladybug: Wait for me here. (Ladybug jumps down into the street to deter Alya to safety.) Alya! You can't stay here it's dangerous and- ah! Is that my mom's phone?

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
Alya: It's a long story, your mom is fine but check this out! (Alya shows Ladybug the recording of Monarch, Shadybug and Claw Noir.)
(Atop the Eiffel Tower; Monarch, Shadybug and Claw Noir loom to figure out where the trio of heroes were.)
Shadybug: Still nothing.
Claw Noir: Are you sure your "simple plan" is gonna work, Your Highness?
Monarch: My plan is foolproof, they will show up. Ladybug and Cat Noir always show up in the end.
(Back in the streets, in an alleyway, Alya shows Cat Noir and Betterfly the recording too)
Betterfly: That's the room where I first arrived!
Alya: I was there for a sleepover at my friend Marinette's.
Cat Noir: Your friend Marinette, is she safe?
Betterfly: Yes, I made sure of that.
Alya: And she's confirmed with me that she's okay. (gives Ladybug a knowing look.)
Cat Noir: So the two giants out there are illusions?
Alya: Created to trap you by forcing you two to split up!
Ladybug: This is only the beginning of their trap, and even though Alya recorded it all, no matter how much I think about it, play it back to myself, I can't find any plan against a trap like this!

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: M'lady, I know you're having a hard time right now, you may not believe in yourself anymore but I believe in you more than ever! You're the best at finding the craziest ideas even when everything seems lost. It's like your Lucky Charms, they never make any sense, but they work every time!
Betterfly: He's right, don't lose hope. I'm sure there's a solution.
Ladybug: (Ladybug tenses a little) I.. do have an idea but I'm afraid it might be too convoluted..
Betterfly: We're all ears, Ladybug.
Ladybug: Okay.. so first of all, the Miraculous of the Butterfly has a limited range, past a certain distance he can't keep in touch with the akumas or the people he akumatized! We'll need to get far enough away from Paris to be out of Monarch's reach, so Betterfly can turn Alya into Ubiquity again!.
Cat Noir: As long as we're far away, he won't be able to remove her power!
Ladybug: Thats right Cat Noir! Next, Betterfly will lend me the Butterfly Miraculous, this way I'll create a second superhero with a specially crafted superpower designed to protect Cat Noir and I!. Next we'll hide the object into which the kamiko will have landed into the parallel world!

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: Where it will be inaccessible to Monarch!
Ladybug: That way Monarch won't be able to remove your powers during the battle.
Betterfly: And my power will protect you from the final treacherous blow Monarch plans to inflict upon you. Brilliant!
Cat Noir: Haha! Now that's M'lady! (He and Ladybug high five)
(Ladybug and Cat Noir power up into Cosmobug and Astrocat, and help fly Betterfly and Alya all the way to London, to be out of Monarch's reach. Then Betterfly opens his cane and a kamiko flies out and into Alya's glasses, kamikotizing her into Ubiquity once more, he then goes behind a chimney stack and detransforms.)
Betterfly: Light wings fall! (detransforms back into Gabriel and places the Butterfly Miraculous beside Ladybug.)
(Ladybug puts on the Butterfly Miraculous and unifies it with the Ladybug, transforming into Ladyfly.)
Ladybug: Unify! (transforms into Ladyfly.)
(Ladyfly kamikotizes Gabriel into Guardian Angel, who places his kamikotized eyeglasses into the parallel world via Ubiquity's portal amd marks both Ladyfly and Cat Noir on their backs with his wings.)

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
Ladyfly: The strength of teamwork! (She and Cat Noir dispense earpieces from their tools to communicate remotely)
Monarch: See? They can't help themselves, they always have to save the world. (He gestures to the trio of heroes they've been waiting for as Shadybug and Claw Noir observe from the railing too.)
(Ladyfly, Cat Noir and Ubiquity are jumping across rooftops)
Shadybug: Maybe, but there are three of them, and Ladybug is wearing the Miraculous of the Butterfly.
Claw Noir: Your supposedly "simple" two person plan no longer works, Your Majesty.
Monarch: On the contrary, now it will be even simpler to seize both their Miraculous and the one of the Butterfly. As for the holder of the Butterfly Miraculous, whatever he has done regardless of his universe, I can undo it.
(Monarch snaps his fingers, which de-kamikotizes Ubiquity back into Alya again.)
Alya: I'm sorry Ladybug.
Ladyfly: Thank you for your help Alya. (Both she and Alya wink at each other then she and Cat Noir nod at each other to split up) It's you against me, Giant Shadybug!

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
(Ladyfly runs and swings into the air, using her yo-yo to hit the Giant Shadybug, which causes the illusion to disappear as Ladyfly lands on the ground.)
Ladyfly: (pretending) Oh no! It was an illusion!
Monarch: (To Shadybug) It's your move. Voyage! (Shadybug jumps through the portal he creates for her)
Shadybug: Surprise, Ladybug.
Ladyfly: (she turns around towards Shadybug who appeared behind her) Ladyfly actually, nice to meet you! I love surprises.
(Ladyfly throws her yo-yo forward to hit Shadybug, who grabs it and yanks it forward as she and Ladyfly battle.)
(Cat Noir then uses his staff to propel himself in the air and lands on the Giant Claw Noir, causing the illusion to disappear as he lands on the ground)
Cat Noir: (pretending) Oh! Could it be that, it's just an illusion?
Monarch: Voyage! (he creates a portal for Claw Noir to jump through)
Claw Noir: See you soon, my dear good king!
(Claw Noir jumps through the portal)
Monarch: Nooroo, Kaalki, Mullo, Pollen, Orikko, Unify! (Monarch unifies the five Miraculous while automatically deactivating the Fox and Ox Miraculous) Multiplication! (He splits himself into three clones while using Sublimation to make them invisible.)

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
Claw Noir: (Claw Noir appears in front of Cat Noir, jumping on top of him and pinning him down) I hope you like a paw-sitively claw-some cat fight! (He activates his cataclysm, however Cat Noir extends his staff, throwing Claw Noir off of him and then kicking him into a sign)
Cat Noir: Are you kitten me? The only thing worse than your fighting is your claw-ful puns.
Claw Noir: With the right cat-itude anything is paw-sible! (he brandishes his nunchucks again as they battle each other)
Cat Noir: I litter-ally can't believe we're the holders of the same Miraculous!
Claw Noir: You're a sly cat! (appears behind Cat Noir, activates his Cataclysm and hits him, however Cat Noir ducked at the right time, making Claw Noir hit his fake cat ear with the earpiece, cutting off his communication with Ladyfly)
Cat Noir: Ladybug?!
(Ladyfly is sent flying through walls into the school. She lands on the second floor, now aware of her cut connection with Cat Noir.)
Ladyfly: Cat Noir? Cat Noir?!
Shadybug: Are you lost without your little house pet?! (Shadybug wields her Lucky Charm in the form of a hammer)

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
(Shadybug tries to squash Ladyfly, however, she moves out of the way and they continue battling in the courtyard.)
Ladyfly: Just because we're not together doesn't mean we're not working as a team!
(One of Monarch's invisible clones attempts to use Venom on Ladyfly, however Guardian Angel's power prevents this and covers the clone in feathers, leaving him paralyzed as well)
Claw Noir: You're definitely not the cat's meow!
(One of Monarch's invisible clones makes Cat Noir trip and attempts to use Venom on him, however Guardian Angel's power prevents this and covers the clone in feathers)
Cat Noir: And you shouldn't count your cats before they've scratched!
Monarch: Fall in. (The three Monarch clones form together as one on the Eiffel Tower) Where is this power coming from? I can't feel any trace of akumatization. Huh!? (Monarch realizes it is a trap) It's a trap! Voyage! (Monarch opens a portal beneath him and falls into it)
Ladyfly: Lucky Charm!
(Ladyfly gets a mirror and Shadybug tries to attack her)
I wouldn't break a mirror if I were you, that's seven years of bad luck, you know?

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
Shadybug: You think it'd be any different from how it is now? Guess what, I don't have your nice little life, in the world where I'm from there are no awesome girl friends to inspire me everyday!, NO AMAZING BFF, LET ALONE A CALM AND GENTLE MOM OR A BOYFRIEND WHO DOESN'T THINK I'M A TOTAL LOSER!
Ladyfly: (realizes) You read my secret diary...
(Ladyfly figures out how to use the Lucky Charm) So you we're the same, you and I.(holds up the Lucky Charm mirror which shows Shadybug on its reflection)
Shadybug: Are you kidding? I'm the opposite of you! All I've got is pain and suffering, from that horrible Chloé Bourgeois, who made me suffer my entire life!, until The Supreme entrusted me with the Miraculous! Now, no one will hurt me anymore!, WE HAVE NOTHING IN COMMON! (She summons another charm and smashes her counterpart's Lucky Charm mirror.)
Ladyfly: You're wrong. (Ladyfly dissolves the Lucky Charm) Reverse morphosis. (Ladyfly de-transforms back into Marinette as she looks at Shadybug, smiling while Shadybug looks at Marinette in tears)
Cat Noir: You know it's just a legend, right? (Cat Noir hits Claw Noir with his staff as he flies backwards and runs into the swimming pool)

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
Claw Noir: (Claw Noir runs into the swimming pool, chasing after Cat Noir) YES I KNOW! I KNOW, I KNOW I'M A LEGEND!
Cat Noir: I meant the one about cats not liking water! (Cat Noir kicks Claw Noir into the drained swimming pool)
Claw Noir: (Claw Noir stands up) Cats don't like water. (runs to where Cat Noir is)
Cat Noir: (Cat Noir is sitting on the lifeguard's chair) Well that's not true. (Claw Noir jumps to where Cat Noir is but Cat Noir jumps just in time) Some cats like myself are excellent swimmers. (Claw Noir throws his staff in Cat Noir's direction but misses as it hits a wall instead) I even have an aquatic version of my suit. (Claw Noir jumps and tries to get his staff out) Don't you? (Cat Noir uses his staff to go to the next level)
Claw Noir: I hate water and swimming pools. And conceded cats. (Claw Noir cataclysms the floor and jumps up to the level where Cat Noir is. Claw Noir kicks down a locker door but doesn't find Cat Noir inside. He sees the row of locker doors across the hallway and activates his Cataclysm)

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: (Cat Noir is hidden in one of the lockers as Claw Noir walks towards him) Conceded cats, conceded cats. Hmmm... Hey now, I don't hear a pun there. (Claw Noir is cataclysming every locker door, looking for Cat Noir inside any of the lockers inside and walks off to the next door when he finds out Cat Noir isn't in the lockers) That's purr-etty unusual coming from you. (Claw Noir puts his ear closer to a locker door and determines Cat Noir is in the locker, cataclysming it. He looks up, seeing Cat Noir hiding up there thanks to his staff. Cat Noir jumps down, putting a lifebuoy on Claw Noir)
Claw Noir: You wanna pun?! (Claw Noir breaks free from the lifebuoy and destroys it and runs towards Cat Noir.) Brace yourself because until I get your Miraculous, I promise to dog your footsteps relentlessly! (Claw Noir jumps on Cat Noir's staff before jumping back, hitting Cat Noir with his own staff as he falls off the diving board, jumping after Cat Noir and attempting to hit him before missing.)
Cat Noir: Why do you have to have a Miraculous that you already hold? (Cat Noir misses Claw Noir as he jumps towards him.)

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
Claw Noir: Don't you know?! (Claw Noir chases after Cat Noir as Cat Noir hides behind a wall) We can make a wish by merging it with The Cockroach's! (Claw Noir swings his staff around while Cat Noir steps out with a pool noodle and charges towards Claw Noir from behind and starts to attack him with the pool noodle.)
Cat Noir: So you need Ladybug's Miraculous, not mine!
Claw Noir: It doesn't work with our own but with yours... (Claw Noir is on a slide)
Cat Noir: You have no idea! (Cat Noir charges towards Claw Noir and traps him on the slide by pushing him down and by using his own staff.) Merging these two Miraculous's too powerful! There would be a great price to pay!
Claw Noir: (Claw Noir frees himself from the slide as Cat Noir flies and hits a nearby wall.) Nothing is too powerful! There's no price too high to pay if it would bring my mother back! (Claw Noir grabs his staff)
Cat Noir: (Cat Noir gets up.) Your mother?...

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
Claw Noir: She's gone! (Claw Noir destroys some lounge chairs with his staff as he goes towards Cat Noir) And my father doesn't care, he's too busy designing dresses and costumes, busy creating things (Claw Noir hits Cat Noir as he flies into the pool) like he's already moved on! But he has no idea how much I miss her.
Cat Noir: (Sadly) I know.
(Shadybug is still in tears)
Marinette: If you read my diary, then you'd know, it's not all that easy. Everything often hangs by a thread. I too was very angry, I too was hurt. I too was scared. (Shadybug removes her Lucky Charm, creates a sword and walks over to Marinette) And I still struggle with all of this (Shadybug pins Marinette to a wall) everyday. (Shadybug grabs the Butterfly Miraculous) You don't need any magic jewel. Powers didn't change my life. I changed the way I saw myself. I decided to love myself. To love the world around me. And I decided that I could fix what was wrong in it. I'm sure that if you changed the way you see yourself and your world, you'll be able to fix what's wrong with it too. Just like I do here, every time. You can fix it all.

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
(Shadybug lets go of the Butterfly Miraculous, lets Marinette go and wipes her tears.)
Shadybug: I don't want to do that corny stuff.
Marinette: By doing it, in a way, you'll also fix yourself. (Shadybug wipes her eyes and looks at her Lucky Charm in her hand.)
Claw Noir: If I make a wish, I'll have the chance to get the only thing I want, (Claw Noir runs towards Cat Noir and uses kung fu as Cat Noir dodges) I'll bring her back to life. (Claw Noir puts one of his feet on Cat Noir's arm, pinning him to the ground) I'll see my mother again.
(Claw Noir takes off Cat Noir's Miraculous as Cat Noir de-transforms back into Adrien as Claw Noir activates his Cataclysm and is about to use it on Adrien.)
Adrien: I know. (Claw Noir stops) I know you, you know.
Claw Noir: No, you don't. Don't pretend to be me or else you wouldn't be friends with The Cockroach. If you were me, your mother would also be-
Adrien: She is.
Claw Noir: But... If you knew about the wish, why haven't you tried it?
Adrien: I won't tell you never thought about it. Of course I thought about it. But... Everything comes at a price. If my mother came back-

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
Claw Noir: (Claw Noir puts his hand closer to Adrien's face) Our mother...
Adrien: In order to bring our mother back, someone else would have to lose theirs. And that, I can't wish on anyone. (Claw Noir puts his hand away as Adrien sits up) Me, I managed to go on living, trying to be happy, as she wanted me to. I have my friends to comfort me. I'm okay now. I'm as well as I can be anyway. It must be painful for someone who doesn't have any close friends. Or anyone to comfort them.
Claw Noir: (crying) Someone? Like me?
Adrien: Only you can decide not to be alone. (Claw Noir deactivates his Cataclysm as his hand and Adrien's touch) I can tell you about my friends from this world. You should meet them in yours. You'd probably get along. Take Nino, for example.
Claw Noir: Nino? I don't think he'd want to be buddies with me considering how I treated him.
Adrien: He's the most understanding person I know. Just apologize and invite him to the movies. His favorite film (here anyway) is called "Space Mutants vs Go Shark".
Claw Noir: (Claw Noir laughs) It sounds terrible.
Adrien: (The sun begins to rise) Let's say it's the film with the most improbable storyline I've ever seen.

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
Claw Noir: And yet, you're really making me want to watch it.
(The sun begins to rise Shadybug looks at Marinette as she nods.)
Shadybug: Miraculous Shadybug! (throws her Lucky Charm in the air as it reverts all of the damage caused during the fight and Shadybug gains a new appearance. She looks at herself for a few seconds before hugging Marinette and laughing.)
(Adrien helps Claw Noir up as the Cataclysm that was used on his chest and the dark veins on his face are gone. He gives Adrien back his Cat Miraculous and Adrien takes it)
Adrien: Thank you.
(Cat Noir and Claw Noir arrive to join with the other heroes)
Claw Noir: Hey, (Furry Paw goes over to Ladybug from the other universe) I like your new look, Fancybug.
Re-Verse Ladybug: It wouldn't hurt you to do the same.
Claw Noir: Can I?
Cat Noir: You're the one who chooses your costume. What do you want the new Claw Noir to look like?
Furry Paw: (Furry Paw grunts while concentrating and gains a new outfit) Me-ow! And now I'll be called Furry Paw or The Wonderwhiskers or Mane of Justice or awww, I just can't pick one. (Ladybug, Re-Verse Ladybug, Cat Noir, Betterfly and Alya all laugh.)
Alya: What'll be yours?

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
Re-Verse Ladybug: Hmmm... I'll call myself... Hm. Ladybug.
Furry Paw: (Furry Paw pretends to cough) Awful! (Furry Paw continues to pretend to cough)
Ladybug: Hey!
Re-Verse Ladybug: (Re-Verse Ladybug puts a hand on Ladybug's shoulder) The best there is.
Betterfly: It's time. Alya Césaire, if you'll allow me. (Alya nods as Betterfly charges up a kamiko as it flies into Alya's glasses, kamikotizing her into Ubiquity.)
Monarch: It's far from over, Ladybug. (Monarch closes the Grimoire) You may have escaped once again in this universe but it's only one among an infinity of others! (The kwamis look afraid) Nooroo, Orikko, unify! (Monarch gains the power of Pretension and pulls out the Fountain Pen) Sublimation! (The Fountain Pen glows bright orange) The power of Pretension allows me to choose a super ability (Monarch writes the power he wants using the Fountain Pen on the palm of his left hand) and I choose access to any other (Monarch touches his torso with his left hand as an orange glow can be seen) existing (Monarch opens an orange portal nearby) universe!
(Ubiquity grabs her head in pain and groans)

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
Ubiquity: I'm feeling a disruption! Like another connection between universes is opening at the same time as mine!
Ladybug: Monarch.
Furry Paw: But how?
Ladybug: He has the Miraculous of the Rooster now and can use it to create whichever superpower he wants.
Betterfly: (scared) Will he be able to travel across universes?
Cat Noir: And attack every Ladybug and Cat Noir in existence?
Ladybug: I'll handle it. (Ubiquity is dekamikotized as Betterfly transmits the kamiko to Ladybug as it flies into one of the Ladybug earrings and Ladybug is kamikotized into Ladybiquity in purple ether)
Scarabella: Miraculous Scarabella! (Scarabella reverts all of the damage caused by Lollipop Boy as the Eiffel Tower is repaired and Kitty Noire jumps in)
Scarabella and Kitty Noire: (in unison) Pound it! (Scarabella and Kitty Noire fist bump as the portal created by Monarch behind them opens. Monarch kicks Kitty Noire out of the way and throws Scarabella to the ground, reaching over for her Miraculous)
Monarch: Your earrings are mine! (Just before Monarch can grab them, the Ladybiquity from this universe grabs Monarch's arm as he sees her)

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
Ubiquity (Marinette): It's not gonna happen in this world, Monarch! (Kitty Noire sees this, smiles happily and Ubiquity punches Monarch as he falls through a portal)
(Monarch falls out of a portal in his lair, opens another one and walks into it)
(Monarch sticks his head out of the portal into the new universe only for the Ladybiquity who is from this universe and Cat Noir to spot him)
Ladybiquity: Not here either! (Monarch yells out in fear) Hai! (She kicks Monarch in the stomach) Yah! (Monarch is kicked in the face) Eh! (Monarch is kicked near the face)
(Monarch flies out of a portal in his lair and lands on the ground. He then once again, creates a new portal and enters it)
Ladybiquity: No matter how far you get, you'll never, EVER win! (Ladybiquity who is from this world hits Monarch in the face with her yoyo and he goes into another universe)
(Monarch yells out in shock and fear and jumps back slightly at the sight of the Ubiquinoire who exists here as she runs, jumps and hits Monarch with her staff, sending him back home to his universe)
(Monarch lands on the floor of his lair, defeated and on his knees)

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
Monarch: Reverse morphosis. (Monarch detransforms back into Gabriel as Nooroo and Orikko fly out of their respective Miraculouses)
Gabriel: Ladybug, I will destroy you! You, and every other Ladybug in all the parallel universes! (falls over)
(Ladybiquity is dekamikotized back into Ladybug as the kamiko flies out of her earrings)
Ladybug: Monarch won't be going to any other world other than this one anytime soon. And here, Cat Noir, me and our friends will make sure to put an end to his reign. Even though we haven't figured out how to yet.
Betterfly: I am certain you will succeed. (Furry Paw and Re-Verse Ladybug nod in agreement) I thank you for your help.
Ladybug: Thank you, Betterfly. You helped us get back something precious that we had lost. (Betterfly frowns and looks confused) Hope. (Betterfly smiles) And you two gained new teammates.
Furry Paw: Yeah, by the way, we're gonna need a team name. Like, The Supremovers. Y'know, a blend of "Supreme" and "Removers". Get it? Get the joke?
Re-Verse Ladybug: (Re-Verse Ladybug pats Furry Paw's cheek) Don't get smart, fleabag. When The Supreme figures out that we're no longer on his side, we won't be laughing.

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
Betterfly: (Betterfly puts his hands on Re-Verse Ladybug and Furry Paw's shoulders) He won't be laughing either, believe me. Because we'll be stronger now that we're together. (Ladybug and Re-Verse Ladybug hold hands)
Ladybug: Remember that you have friends here. (They hug) (Furry Paw and Cat Noir hug before letting go)
Cat Noir: And that more friends are waiting for you on the other side. (Ubiquity levitates as Betterfly, Re-Verse Ladybug and Furry Paw are walking towards Ubiquity)
Ladybug: Wait! (The three heroes stop and turn around, looking at Ladybug) In our world, we always to a little something when things end well.
Ladybug, Cat Noir, Re-Verse Ladybug, Furry Paw and Betterfly: (In unison) Pound it! (The five heroes fist bump together before Re-Verse Ladybug, Furry Paw and Betterfly walk through Ubiquity back to their universe. Ubiquity is dekamikotized back into Alya as the kamiko is purified and flies away.)
(Alya deletes the video from Sabine's phone as Marinette lies down)
Alya: You ok, girl?

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Yeah, I was just thinking, life can really go in any which way. (Alya lies down with Marinette) If we hadn't found ourselves sitting next to each other at the start of the school year, I don't know if I would've become confident enough to become Ladybug. And who knows what would've happened today?
Alya: You made all the right choices, Marinette.
Marinette: Do you remember what you told me on the first day of school? "All that is necessary for the triumph of evil-"
Marinette and Alya: (In unison) "-is that good people do nothing!"
Marinette: I only made the right choice because you're a good person, Alya.
Alya: Oh, Marinette. (The two girls hug and they kiss each other’s cheek) What if we made the right choice now and got some delicious breakfast?
Marinette: Excellent choice and then, we're gonna take a little nap. (Marinette yawns)
(Sabine is pouring milk into a cup of coffee as Marinette and Alya climb down the stairs)
Sabine: Hello, girls. How'd you sleep? (Marinette yawns)
Marinette: Very well, Mom.
Alya: Hey, Mrs. Dupain-Cheng, isn't that your phone over there? (Alya points to her phone which is on the couch)

title: Miraculous Paris/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Paris/Transcript - Intro
Sabine: Thanks, Alya. I couldn't find it anywhere. (Sabine walks over and grabs her phone as Marinette and Alya fist bump and both yawn before laughing.)

title: Miraculous Movie x Flik Flak/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Movie x Flik Flak/Transcript - Intro
(Marinette is hiding behind the lockers which is near the school library.)
Marinette: I'm not sure I can do this, Tikki. (Tikki flies out of Marinette's backpack.) Especially on the first day back to school.
Tikki: We went over this all summer. You're Ladybug. You can't be scared to ask someone out.
(Marinette and Tikki both notice Adrien leaving the school library.)
Marinette: That's him.
(Tikki grabs Marinette's backpack straps.)
Tikki: Go for it.
Marinette: Uh...
(Tikki pulls Marinette out of her hiding place and makes her stand in front of Adrien. While Tikki hides behind the backpack, Adrien notices Marinette.)
Adrien: Hey Marinette.
(Tikki gently nudges Marinette.)
Marinette: (stammers) So...  stupid question because you're probably busy and stuff so. I mean why would you say "yes" anyway. Like, who goes to the movies anymore?
Adrien: Uh... what's the question?
Tikki: (facepalms) Oh my. Stop! (Time literally stops around Marinette and Tikki. Everybody, except the two, stops moving) That was a total catastrophe!
Marinettte: My life is over.

title: Miraculous Movie x Flik Flak/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Movie x Flik Flak/Transcript - Intro
Tikki: Relax. I'm not supposed to do this. Three seconds should be enough. (Tikki literally reverse time by using Marinette's Flik Flak watch.) Ready? Breathe and to the point.
(Tikki hides behind Marinette's backpack again. Time resumes back to normal.)
Marinette: Adrien, come to the movies with me next weekend?
Adrien: Okay.
Marinette: Wait, you said "okay"?
Adrien: Coolio. See you then.
(Adrien walks away. As soon as he is left, Marinette feels happy.)
Marinette: Yes!
(Adrien, though, is embarrassed.)
Adrien: Coolio? Did I just say that?
(Plagg flies out of Adrien's bag. He chuckles.)
Plagg: You're such a dork.
Adrien: Let's do it again, Plagg. Please just one more try.
(Plagg is frustrated.)
Plagg: This is it!
(Plagg literally reverse time by using Adrien's Flik Flak watch. Adrien is back to when Marinette is in the middle of asking him out. However, time is still frozen.)
Adrien: Actually, can you back up some more?
(Plagg becomes even more frustrated and growls.)

title: Miraculous Secrets
text:
Miraculous Secrets - Intro
, also known as A Miraculous Message and Marinette's Video Diary, is a web series featuring clips from the main series. It features Marinette as the narrator, writing in her diary to explain information about herself, people she knows, and more. Sometimes guest narrators are featured as well, such as Adrien, Alya, Chloé, or Gabriel who narrate episodes on occasion. Season 4 features two currently unknown narrators. The webisodes are available in French on TF1+ and in English on the official YouTube channel.
The return of the webseries was hinted at Mipcom Junior in Cannes on October 12, 2025. On June 4, 2026, Thomas Astruc confirmed that new webisodes would be released soon. On June 26, 2026, the official Miraculous YouTube channel released the trailer and confirmed return of the series after a long hiatus.

title: Miraculous Secrets
text:
Miraculous Secrets - Series overview
Season 4
In the heart of Paris, a legend is unmasked. Behind the glittering city and its darkest threats lies Marinette Dupain-Cheng — a seemingly ordinary girl chosen to bear an extraordinary destiny. Balancing classrooms and friendships by day, and protecting millions as Ladybug by night, her double life unfolds in a way the world has never seen. Through the voice of an unseen narrator, secrets are unveiled, sacrifices revealed, and the untold saga of Paris's bravest hero finally comes to light.

text:
Miraculous Secrets - Trivia
Nickelodeon first uploaded the web series under the name Miraculous Secrets, but when uploading the webisodes to their website, they changed the name to A Miraculous Message.
However, the webisodes on the official Miraculous Ladybug YouTube channel are still titled Miraculous Secrets.
Out of the original first 36 webisodes, 27 are narrated by Marinette, four by Adrien ("Adrien's Double Life", "Ladybug as seen by Adrien", "Plagg", and "Kagami as seen by Adrien"), two by Gabriel ("Gabriel", and "Nathalie as seen by Gabriel"), one by Alya and Chloé ("Ladyblog", and "Marinette as seen by Chloé", respectively), and "Feelings", in which there isn't any narration.
Starting from "Master Fu" (the first of Season 2), each webisodes's title card consists of the show's logo, the title of the webisode, and a render of the character(s) mentioned in the title. However, there are a few exceptions:
Alix and Mylène are missing from the title card of "Friends".
Marc is not seen on "Nathaniel & Marc"'s title card.
Marinette is absent from "Chloé as seen by Marinette"'s title card.

title: Miraculous Secrets
text:
Miraculous Secrets - Trivia
However, this could be so the webisode isn't mistaken for "Marinette as seen by Chloé", as well as the fact that unlike the other "as seen by" webisodes, this one is similar to the other webisodes for the other classmates, in which Marinette talks about her classmates. This could also imply that there might be another webisode about Chloé, as seen by someone else, (for example Adrien) in the future.
Rena Rouge, Carapace, and King Monkey are all missing from the title card of "New Heroes".
However, King Monkey is probably absent because this webisode is before "Party Crasher", as Marinette never mentions him, nor any flashbacks from "Party Crasher" or any episodes after it are shown.
When "Master Fu", and "Tikki" were originally released, their title cards were different than the rest. However, they have now been updated, as seen by the title cards used by Disney Channel UK and Disney+.
Out of the webisodes which have been released, there is a webisode for all of Marinette's classmates, with the exception of Juleka and Kim.
Disney+ lists Season 2 and Season 3 together as Season 2.
