title: Miraculous holders
text:
Miraculous holders - Intro
are people who use the Miraculouses to transform into animal-themed superhumans with the help of the kwamis.

title: Miraculous holders
text:
Miraculous holders - History
After the Miraculous jewels were made, it was the job of the Order of the Guardians to protect and distribute them to people for the good of mankind.
In Ancient China, many people became the first Miraculous holders.
Each miraculous and their respective abilities were kept in a book written by the guardians in their special code so they could prevent those who had evil intentions from misusing the book.
For the next 5000 years, many people throughout the history of the world were picked by the guardians to become an owner.
These recipients would be chosen through passing a test that showed their best personal characteristics and qualities, such as Marinette, for her willingness to help others, and Adrien, for his kindness.
However, just as there are good people who were gifted with the Miraculouses, there are also bad people who sought the jewels' powers for their own gain, putting the world in danger, such as the present-day Hawk Moth.
In such cases, it's been the task of some Miraculous owners to assist in helping the Guardians retrieve the lost jewels and stop the people who misuse them, in addition to protecting the world from other dangers.

title: Miraculous holders
text:
Miraculous holders - History
Once their task was complete or when they couldn't continue their responsibilities as Miraculous owners, the jewels were returned to the Guardians, or new owners were chosen to act in their stead with the Guardian's permission or if the Guardian couldn't intervene first.
During their adventures, some Miraculous owners have experienced other powers and abilities with their jewels when needed or under great emergency, like the Miraculous potion power ups used by Piáo Chóng and other owners, as well as new fusion forms and other powers. In doing so, some wielders have made long lasting bonds with their kwamis, receiving a kwagatama as a sign of friendship between them. Through, their charms Miraculous holders, discovered that they can use them to talk to their predecessors. And yet, there have been incidents where holders were separated from their kwamis and sometimes during said separation some have witnessed the unconstrained version of their companion's powers. Most of their accomplishments and monuments have been recorded throughout history, but was erased by the Guardians for unknown reasons except for the few that have made their way to museums.

title: Miraculous holders
text:
Miraculous holders - History
However, in 1843, when Fu was young, he was unhappy with his life as a Guardian. During one of his training sessions, he grew hungry and used the Peacock Miraculous to manifest a Sentimonster to get him a snack. But the creature, born from his combined hunger and anger caused him to lose control of it, and in its rampage, the Sentimonster destroyed the temple, swallowed the remaining Guardians and all, but one of the Miracle Boxes. Wang tried to escape the creature with the last box and Spellbook in tow, but lost the book along with the Peacock and Butterfly Miraculouses. Fu felt so guilty about what happened that he suspended the use of the jewels for the next 172 years leaving the world without Miraculous holders.
Recent to present
On a previous trip, 15 years ago overseas to Tibet with the Agrestes, Nathalie found the Butterfly and Peacock Miraculouses and gave the jewels to Gabriel.
Afterwards, the miraculous holders returned when the Agrestes nor the Graham de Vanily couples couldn't bear children of their own; they used the Peacock Miraculous to create their families.

title: Miraculous holders
text:
Miraculous holders - History
The Agrestes made Adrien out of love while the Vanilies (especially Colt refusing to be outdone) made Felix out of jealously; but they both made a terrible and naive mistake in discovering that the jewel was damaged.
Then, its state was inflicted onto Émilie and Colt, leaving them in a condition where they were inevitably going to fall into an eternal slumber.
But before that Adrien's parents endlessly searched for the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses, but found nothing, allowing their conditions to catch up to them.
Not long after they were created, Gabriel also gave the damaged jewel to Tomoe so she could have an heir, Kagami, and came under the same effects but survived.
Afterwards, Gabriel forbid the use of the Peacock Miraculous and hid it away.
Desperate to fix his mistake, he began using the Butterfly Miraculous for evil to obtain the absolute power by trying to steal the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses.

title: Miraculous holders
text:
Miraculous holders - History
Under the state of emergency, Master Fu gave the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses to Marinette Dupain-Cheng and Adrien Agreste in an effort to stop him. Over time, the two of them did a great job protecting Paris on their own and eventually gained allies, creating the French Miraculous superhero team. However, thanks to Chloé's betrayal, Ladybug and Cat Noir (with the exception of Bunnyx) returned back to a duo with Ladybug as the new guardian.
Through their adventures, they discovered other Miraculouses and jewels related to them, such as the Prodigious in Shanghai, China. The duo learned that Hawk Moth had desired its ancient powers in his continuing quest for obtaining the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses. Along the way, Ladybug and Cat Noir meet the guardian of the Sacred Cave, Fei, despite them keeping the Prodigious out of Hawk Moth's hands. The mastermind akumatized the jewel's guardian Mei Shi into YanLuoShi sending him into a rampage eradicating Cat Noir and Hawk Moth in the process. With Ladybug's help, Fei understood the true meaning of the dragon, and they manage to calm Mei Shi and prove Fei was worthy of being the next Renren and the duo's first out of the country ally.

title: Miraculous holders
text:
Miraculous holders - History
While in New York, they find the Eagle Miraculous by allying themselves with the American Heroes. Ladybug and Cat Noir were able to stop Hawk Moth and Miraclonizer from misusing it, which gave rise to a new hero, Eagle, who had previously been Sparrow. Like Gilbert and Washington, they allowed Sparrow to keep it as a sign of friendship and trust. Shortly after, Eagle and Uncanny Valley were approached by a guardian who demanded the Eagle talon back, but was seemingly convinced by Eagle instead to stay and raise a new generation of heroes in North America.
As the fight continues, Ladybug and Cat Noir notice that Hawk Moth is using the repaired Peacock Miraculous under the alias Shadow Moth to attack the city and them with sentimonsters and becoming more deceptive than ever. Understanding the severity of his attacks and knowing that this isn't a time for rules, the French Duo continue to receive help from their old and new allies.
Through betrayal and trickery, Hawk Moth manages to gain all of the other jewels except the Ladybug, Cat and Peacock Miraculouses, making most of the French Miraculous superhero team inactive and returning Ladybug and Cat Noir to a duo once more.

title: Miraculous holders
text:
Miraculous holders - History
However, thanks to their enemy's greed, the duo called on Bunnyx and with her help they were able retrieve the Rabbit's Watch but still had a long way to go. Soon, they are against Monarch by changing the stolen Miraculouses into rings he could transfer the jewel's powers to others without the need to give them away.
Before that Monarch in "Destruction", still hyped at having all the Miraculous, demanded the kwamis to tell him Ladybug's identity, but they couldn't due to the magic spell. Yet anticipating the mastermind's plan, the heroes set up a scavenger hunt all over Paris ending at the Wax Museum, finally capturing him; however, in a desperate bid to escape, Monarch forced Cat Noir to use Cataclysm permanently injuring him and no freed kwamis.
After their plan failed, the French Duo began losing hope they would defeat Monarch but just as someone loses hope others are seeking it.

title: Miraculous holders
text:
Miraculous holders - History
As the Miraculous world expands again this time, they learn that Miraculouses and wearers exist across the multiverse (thereby learning one of the kwamis kept secrets) when a mysterious Butterfly holder named Betterfly appears seeking their aid, but they realize that he didn't come alone as a mysterious pair of villains named Shadybug and Claw Noir followed him.
Seeing how much the dark duo's powers differ from theirs, Ladybug and Cat Noir learn why the kwamis advised their owners to use their jewels carefully (especially minors) because it breaks the security system that protects them but their dark counterparts did so by using their jewels for evil thereby hurting themselves.
After the Duo and Betterfly hide in the sewers, they see something that hasn't been done with the Butterfly Miraculous: it being used for good.
From him, they learn compared to their world his is a nightmare ruled by an entity named the Supreme and that he controls the Miraculouses under a corrupt system which Betterfly used to be apart of, until he learned the hard way with great power comes great responsibly and set up the Resistance.

title: Miraculous holders
text:
Miraculous holders - History
Up top with help from Alya, the hero trio learned that the dark duo teamed up with Monarch, with the help of Ladyfly and Guardian Angel; they pretend to fall for his scheme so they could deal with their counterparts. By talking with them, Ladybug and Cat Noir discovered how dark their lives would be if they fell into despair and anger, as well as encouraged the dark duo to believe in themselves to seek better lives. So, Shadybug and Claw Noir used it to change their costumes, heal their affliction, were renamed Ladybug and Furry Paw and joined the resistance. However their joy was short lived when Monarch refused to give up since couldn't have his world's Miraculous, he tried to steal them from across the multiverse but was stopped by the heroes. With the other worlds safe, both pairs thank each other for giving something they both needed: the hope to keep fighting.

title: Miraculous holders
text:
Miraculous holders - History
The duo continued to learn about the restrictions of their jewels such as what's the point of having power and responsibility if you can't enjoy love as Marinette began holding herself up in her room upset because of her failures in love as well as because of her letting Monarch use it against her. Meanwhile Adrien, finally accepting that Marinette is the one he wants he works up the courage to tell her only to get rejected; refusing to see their owners unhappy Tikki and Plagg released them from their duties giving to the return of Scarabella and rise of Kitty Noire. However, their successors don't last long when Monarch used his alliance rings to hunt them down causing the kwamis to activate their powers in self-defense, feeling the call of the hero inside of them, the duo along with the resistance stand up against Monarch and retrieve the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses allowing Ladybug's and Cat Noir's return.

title: Miraculous holders
text:
Miraculous holders - History
Despite Monarch finding at least one user of for almost all the Miraculous superpowers he can grant all except one Second Chance, deeming it too dangerous to grant to his akumatized supervillains, he still couldn't defeat the heroes. In "Intuition", he attempted to make use of Second Chance himself, but found out the hard way that he couldn't make it work due to Ladybug's adaptability and Cat Noir's unpredictability. To make matters worse for Monarch, his repeated usage of Second Chance worsened his Cataclysm induced injury, forcing him to never make use of the Snake Miraculous again.
In "Emotion", through Ladybug, Adrien and Kagami; Felix was taught the difference between using the Miraculouses power for personal desire as well as hate and using them out of love. Finally opening his eyes to the damage his family had done with the jewels and now makes a serious effort to fix it.
From "Confrontation", the duo learned even if one develops new powers they can still continue to grow in the most surprising of ways.
In "Revolution", Ladybug and Cat Noir make the final transitions to having their adult powers.

title: Miraculous holders
text:
Miraculous holders - History
From "Representation", both Ladybug and Cat Noir, discovered how the problems with the other truly began.
From "Re-creation", during the scuffle, Nooroo and his Miraculous was free but lost again as Gabriel was making his wish he relinquished his remaining Miraculouses to Ladybug and she reforged the jewels to their original forms. Then, they were returned to all of the inactive members making them like herself and Cat Noir full time members along with their newest addition Argos.
But before that in "Miraculous London", the jewels were stolen once more including Tikki and Plagg along with their power a wish was made that disrupted the timeline again. This time with the help of Bunnyx and Past Tikki, Ladybug as Chronobug, discovered that Nooroo's power was being used for evil again with a new evil Butterfly Miraculous holder spying on everything that happened after Gabriel's wish but with a little trickery the future was saved.
After the jewels were returned to their true owners, Ladybug outfitted them with new abilities such as easier communication and along with Cat Noir in "Revelator", helped the rest of the team achieve their adult powers.
Future

title: Miraculous holders
text:
Miraculous holders - History
Sometime in the future, the Butterfly Miraculous will be used for evil again by a new "Hawk Moth", while Marinette and Adrien continue their roles as their hero alter-egos as adults with the heroine as the leader of their future team and Adrien as second-in-command.

title: Miraculous holders
text:
Miraculous holders - Parallel universe Miraculous holders
As the kwamis live together in all the billions of parallel universes simultaneously so do their owners in a way. According to Plagg, it's like a pair of cheeses despite being made from the same milk both can taste different based upon how much they've matured. Such as Ladybug, Cat Noir, Monarch and their counterparts going through the same pain but ended up totally different based upon their choices or outcome of events in their worlds. Sometimes when traveling between parallel universes the holder(s) may end up confused upon seeing how different the worlds are. Such as when Betterfly traveled to the Quantic Universe, he was confused when Marinette called his butterfly an akuma when he calls them kamikos as well as when Shadybug and Claw Noir confused a kamiko for an akuma not knowing that's what the butterfly is called when used for evil.
Unlike the kwamis who knew of their parallel counterparts most Miraculous holders don't know anything about theirs because the kwamis choose not to divulge it with them unless of strange circumstances or emergencies.

id: Miraculous holders::Reasons why holders are picked carefully::0
title: Miraculous holders
section: Reasons why holders are picked carefully
text:
Miraculous holders - Reasons why holders are picked carefully
Aside from the guardian's system, various circumstances give a deeper insight on why holders are chosen so carefully. With many people being chosen throughout time and history being separated by years and miles apart but being gifted a jewel for a different reason. After the problem is correctly deduced by the guardians, they choose the best miraculous and holder to handle the problem for the greater good but if the jewel ends up with the wrong person it could make the problem worse. Some holders like Ladybug and Cat Noir, are chosen through a personality test or they have something the people and world need or have forgotten.
Predecessors vs. Successors
Speaking of time it's another reason why holders are spread far apart: so the land can heal itself from a finished crisis, to deal with crises in other places and so the people can learn not to be too dependent on miraculous holders or their powers.
But there will be cases where holders of the same jewel are close together like in "Anansi", "Reflekdoll", "Queen Banana" and "Hack-San".

id: Miraculous holders::Reasons why holders are picked carefully::1
title: Miraculous holders
section: Reasons why holders are picked carefully
text:
Miraculous holders - Reasons why holders are picked carefully
Usually this means something may have happened to the previous or current holder so that they can't continue their job, like Master Fu and his bad back; he bore no ill will towards Nino being his successor.
Sometimes, a holder may end up with a jewel from another (even temporarily) and may need time to adapt to the powers of their comrades.
Other times is when a holder isn't living up to a guardian's or kwamis expectations, realizes for themselves they aren't the right match or breaks the oath they took to protect those with the jewels for personal desires, the giver may take it back and choose someone who is a better match.
When done like this a former or disgraced holder may bare resentment or judgement to the new charge because of their emotional attachments to the jewel being too strong to the point where they become obsessive of them.
Such as with Chloé, Zoé and the Bee Miraculous, when Chloé had the Bee's Comb, she became so attached and entitled to it believing she deserved it regardless of the consequences but when Ladybug took it away after her betrayal, she bore a grudge towards her former idol for doing so and her successor for replacing her.

id: Miraculous holders::Reasons why holders are picked carefully::2
title: Miraculous holders
section: Reasons why holders are picked carefully
text:
Miraculous holders - Reasons why holders are picked carefully
Sometimes when a holder is replaced temporarily and the other members aren't informed about their missing comrade, then they may attack their new ally upon suspicion, danger, or worry and not wish to work with them. For example, when Cat Noir met Scarabella for the first time, he was extremely worried for Ladybug believing she was hurt or in danger. Unlike Chloé, who was attached to Bee Miraculous for its power, he was attached to the Ladybug Miraculous because of his strong bond to Ladybug. For others, it's so they can find their own way like Vesperia, being free from criticism after she took over her sister's role. She wasn't criticized or judged for Miracle Queen's actions, and due to Chloé's betrayal being erased from everyone's memory, Zoé got a clean slate as her own hero. In Alya's case, she had to live up to the expectations of her best friend, Cat Noir and everyone in Paris as the temporary Ladybug feeling huge pressure and made mistakes trying to be perfect.

id: Miraculous holders::Reasons why holders are picked carefully::3
title: Miraculous holders
section: Reasons why holders are picked carefully
text:
Miraculous holders - Reasons why holders are picked carefully
If a jewel ends up with a holder that wasn't intended by a guardian then said holder may have to prove their worth to them in order to keep the jewel along with being the kwami's temporary caretaker until its intended owner or the guardian has returned to reclaim the jewel.
So that the successors don't make the same mistakes as those before them such as Félix, like his family and Nathalie except for Adrien, he too used the the jewels especially Peacock Miraculous for selfish, desperate and vengeful reasons to get what he wanted but like before it cost him and others something dearly. Aside from his father and aunt who didn't have other holders to watch over them, Nathalie's and Gabriel's actions with the jewels were stopped by Ladybug and Cat Noir preventing them from going too far. But in "Emotion", when Felix realized he couldn't bring Marinette back and that she was gone forever he was horrified that he did the one thing his didn't achieve: more permanent deaths of innocent lives by the hands of a miraculous with Ladybug, Kagami and Adrien making him realize he was no better.

id: Miraculous holders::Reasons why holders are picked carefully::4
title: Miraculous holders
section: Reasons why holders are picked carefully
text:
Miraculous holders - Reasons why holders are picked carefully
Aside for successors and predecessors, it's not only them who get weighed down or hurt by expectations but also the people they protect. Such as if a disgrace holder breaks the vow or if an evil one just had been recently defeated but their miraculous is put in back circulation too soon then there may be complications. For example, in "Malediktator", when Marinette realized she and Cat Noir needed the Bee Miraculous again thereby extension Chloé, she was hesitant to use it after what happened before. When Betterfly sought help from Ladybug and Cat Noir, the duo (especially Ladybug) were hesitant to help because he used the same powers as Monarch and all he did was cause harm.
Specific powers and holders

id: Miraculous holders::Reasons why holders are picked carefully::5
title: Miraculous holders
section: Reasons why holders are picked carefully
text:
Miraculous holders - Reasons why holders are picked carefully
However some Miraculouses have powers that are so strong or unique that they need specific holders with the right physical, emotional and mental requirements to handle them properly to the point where they have to learn the traits themselves or already have them like in "Desperada" and "Evolution", both the Rabbit and Snake jewels have powers that are affiliated with time. However they couldn't be given to just anyone as Master Fu said they have to go to someone who won't manipulate time for their own gain or sometimes when a power isn't used right or for the wrong reason it could be ineffective hindering the user and their allies.

id: Miraculous holders::Reasons why holders are picked carefully::6
title: Miraculous holders
section: Reasons why holders are picked carefully
text:
Miraculous holders - Reasons why holders are picked carefully
For some holders they can be matched with a jewel personality wise to learn important lessons to become better people but it's also their job to maintain said lessons. Such as Chloé and Zoé, due to her personality and background, Queen Bee always used subjection and subjugation to have everyone submit to her demands with acting with total confidence but she lacked in moderation and reason with the Bee Miraculous while Vesperia was far kinder but she lacked confidence. Such as Félix, he was hurt by the pain of the past and angry at oppressors but obsessed with wanting freedom that he did it in a manner that made him no different than his predecessors until Ladybug, Adrien and Kagami set him straight.
Different roles

id: Miraculous holders::Reasons why holders are picked carefully::7
title: Miraculous holders
section: Reasons why holders are picked carefully
text:
Miraculous holders - Reasons why holders are picked carefully
When Miraculous holders are chosen in a group some of them can have specific roles or tasks to do such as guardians can give a miraculous to another to keep the balance in the cases of a miraculous hero is being manipulated by people in power such as Dark Grimalkin and Scarlet Fate. In the case with Ladybug, as it wasn't only her job to balance the actions of her equal Cat Noir but also other holders evil or not like Monarch. On occasions some holders have roles that last longer or shorter than others but they are no less important such as with Chloe's role it was her job to learn to have power in moderation and use it in reason and yet she also had a more important role to test Ladybug's and Cat Noir's growth as heroes and leaders.
Before the jewels were given to Ladybug, Cat Noir and their team, they were strictly used by adults only.
Bad Miraculous holders

id: Miraculous holders::Reasons why holders are picked carefully::8
title: Miraculous holders
section: Reasons why holders are picked carefully
text:
Miraculous holders - Reasons why holders are picked carefully
Bad Miraculous holders are opposite from the good ones as Cat Noir and Ladybug were chosen by Master Fu and use the jewels for the greater good. These holders aren't chosen by a guardian and get their miraculouses by other means such as finding missing ones or stealing them from the chosen wielders or guardians and instead they use them for themselves. However, despite the destruction it is rather limited without the guardian's or holder's knowledge or guidance which often tends to lead them into trouble. For example, there are a few wielders that know of the unconstrained version of their kwami's powers which is understandable outside of being dangerous, it just in case if a kwami ever got stuck with a bad owner they'd keep their version of their powers to themselves so their owners wouldn't get any ideas about using it. As well as most holders not knowing about the magical spell placed on the kwamis so they don't get any ideas about finding loopholes or messing around with it which could result in complications.

id: Miraculous holders::Reasons why holders are picked carefully::9
title: Miraculous holders
section: Reasons why holders are picked carefully
text:
Miraculous holders - Reasons why holders are picked carefully
Regardless, the transition from good to bad and vica versa can be done by everyone and anyone for whatever means or reasons necessary varying such as with Chloe, Gabriel or Felix. However, just because a holder makes a bad choice doesn't always mean they're evil but maybe hurt, angry, desperate or confused as they don't believe or see the right way out of their problems. When it came to people like them even though they weren't chosen by the guardians to have one, it could be that they were chosen by the world itself as a way of teaching them a lesson despite learning it some to most may not maintain them.

id: Miraculous holders::Reasons why holders are picked carefully::10
title: Miraculous holders
section: Reasons why holders are picked carefully
text:
Miraculous holders - Reasons why holders are picked carefully
One of the reasons some may think they deserve to have a miraculous or to use one is because they believe themselves to be better than those who were chosen sometimes which enables them to act out of jealously or anger when they don't get one or if it's taken. For others, they may feel like they are entitled to have one like Chloe when she found the Bee Miraculous in "The Queen's Battle", and Ladybug demanded it back after she and Cat Noir stopped the spending train but Chloe enacted "finders keepers", when done in this manner some may see the jewels as a means to get what they desire which may cause them not to surrender it because they believe if they do then their desires will vanish with them or even in "Miracle Queen", Chloe judging Ladybug's choice in holders. Such as Gabriel and Émilie as they both used the Peacock Miraculous to make their family but at the cost of her coma, Gabriel was desperate and fearful to fix his mistake which led to his intentions being pure (starting out) but over time his intentions and actions became the opposite as he used the Butterfly and the remaining jewels selfishly to steal the heroes jewels even though he didn't do anything to deserve them.

title: Miraculous holders
text:
Miraculous holders - Abilities
Transformations
In order for a Miraculous owner to transform, they need to be wearing the Miraculous and have the kwami connected to the Miraculous present to be absorbed. Through transformation, they change into an animal-themed superhuman. In these forms, the Miraculous owner gains enhanced physical abilities, an omni-purpose tool (such as Ladybug's yo-yo), and a Unique superpower (such as Cat Noir's Cataclysm).
However, as revealed in "Miracle Queen", if the owner doesn't know the kwami's name or the right commands, they won't be able to transform.
In "Miraculous New York", it's revealed by Uncanny Valley that when Miraculous holders are transformed, they are protected by a layer of magic called quantuam masking that makes them unrecognizable to the human eye. During "Destruction", it's so strong that even the powers of Sublimation cannot undo it because it's a part of the kwamis magic. In "Pretension", the quantum masking that hides a Miraculous holder's appearance can also mask their scent as well.

title: Miraculous holders
text:
Miraculous holders - Abilities
According to Plagg, the suit that the Miraculous transformation creates is "what you really want deep down" or a natural reflection of a holder's whole personality. Upon transforming, some owners with impairments, like poor eyesight, will have them modified or fixed completely, like with Alya when she transforms into Rena Rouge and Nino when he transforms into Carapace. The transformations of a holder's suit is further explained in "Rocketear", the design of them can also be based on what role they play or have like with Alya needing her to be "behind the scenes" until Hawk Moth's defeat, giving her suit a new camouflaged look. Or Adrien in "Kuro Neko", if one focuses on certain parts of their personalities their costumes will change as he focused on an image of perfection becoming the prestigious Cat Walker.

title: Miraculous holders
text:
Miraculous holders - Abilities
Furthermore some elements of a transformed Miraculous holder's costume (such as Ladybug's and Cat Noir's masks) cannot be removed. According to Ladybug in "Lady Wifi", it's because of magic, implying that they are magically glued to a holder's face likely resulting in the effects of Kwami magic or it could the holder's desire in their costume. While there are elements can be removed, like Cat Noir's tail, that can be detached. These said elements, made to look like real animal parts such as Cat Noir's, Rena Rouge's and Bunnyx's ears. Despite being fake, they can enhance a wielder's senses or respond to how they feel. But for Miraculous holders that don't have certain elements as a part of their costumes, they can be replaced by Miraculous tools, like how the shield acts like Carapace's shell, how the jump rope of the Mouse Miraculous is used as Multimouse and Polymouse's tail, and how the bolas on the Tiger Miraculous is used as Purple Tigress' tail when not in use.
Additionally, a user's suit can temporarily change depending on the user's mood, as told to Zoe by Pollen in "Grendiaper".

title: Miraculous holders
text:
Miraculous holders - Abilities
Not only that, the owners also gain the abilities of the animals the Miraculous is based off of, such as Cat Noir's hearing, smell, and night vision, and using his clawed gloves like actual claws to climb surfaces, as well as Ladybug's ability to walk on walls like a bug. On occasion, a wielder will also show the behavioral patterns of the animals the Miraculous is based off of such as Cat Noir purring like a domestic cat in "Prime Queen".
In "Startrain", when Miraculous users are transformed, they can temporarily handle lack of oxygen and survive temperatures of absolute zero degrees.
Miraculous owners seemingly don't age or look affected by lack of food or thirst while transformed, as Bunnyx was able to remain in the obelisk for thousands of years in "Timetagger" before being released from a deep sleep. However, it is unknown if this ability is exclusive to Rabbit Miraculous owners, applies to all Miraculous owners, or if it is simply just an ability of the obelisk she was trapped in. In "Cat Blanc", as Cat Noir was akumatized and alone for months but remained the same being unaffected by said condition.
Control over kwami

title: Miraculous holders
text:
Miraculous holders - Abilities
Miraculous owners can restrict their kwamis to certain commands, as seen in "Sandboy". However, it is as of yet unknown whether this is some outside ability of Gabriel or a benefit of being a Miraculous wielder, and if it is, it seems that it's a matter of a wielder's personal choice. It seems they can undo their commands with just a simple word or snap of their fingers but only works when they untransformed.
Unification
Miraculous owners can use more than one Miraculous at the same time, which is why Hawk Moth desires both the Ladybug Miraculous and Cat Miraculous. This allows the wearer to utilize the powers of both, as well as utilize a new, more powerful fusion superpower. It also creates a costume that combines the aspects of both animal themes.

title: Miraculous holders
text:
Miraculous holders - Abilities
In "Kwamibuster", in order to fuse two Miraculous, the owner, while transformed with one of the miraculous, must say the name of the kwamis they want to fuse and say "Unify" while intertwining the hands. To unfuse, the owner must say the name of the kwami they want to let go and say "Divide" or to sat the kwami's detransformation phrase. When under the powers of fusion, Miraculous wielders can combine their weapons with other miraculous superpowers. As seen in "Miracle Queen", when Ladybug, as Dragon Bug, used her yo-yo combined with the Water Dragon to make a water sphere shield. It is unknown whether the unified Miraculous holders are still under the effect of the timer.
Miraculous power potions
In "Syren", it's revealed that Miraculous holders can gain access to extra powers using certain potions from the Miraculous Spellbook:
When in Aqua Mode, the holder has the ability to swim and breathe underwater.
When in Ice Mode, the holder has ice skating abilities and withstand very cold temperatures.
When in Space Mode, the holder gains a spacesuit version of their original costumes and the ability to breathe and move freely in space.

title: Miraculous holders
text:
Miraculous holders - Abilities
The holder can either first feed their kwami the potion and directly transform into their power-up form, or consume the potion while they're already transformed and quickly gain the power-up suit. They can also either revert back to their base form by "powering down", or detransform fully into a civilian.
Upgraded to adult abilities
There are some Miraculous abilities don't reveal themselves to their users until they become of age, like with Ladybug and Cat Noir still being "too green" with their powers.
With each superpower being different, the full range of powers and the way the holders master them could vary such as figuring out the secret or the meaning of the power and with a deeper level of understanding it can result in gaining a new power(s) or a change in their costumes as with Ladybug in "Mr.
Pigeon 72".
However, one of them Miraculous owners can gain is being able to maintain their transformations even after using their superpowers and prolong the use of them, revealed by Hawk Moth in "Mayura" and by Alix's future self, Bunnyx, in "Timetagger".

title: Miraculous holders
text:
Miraculous holders - Abilities
Furthermore when adult holders transform they can use their energy to sustain their kwamis meaning they don't have to feed them as much or, they don't always need a voice command to activate them; as Bunnyx fought Timetagger, she used her powers without saying the word "Burrow" the same number of times.
Older holders could also have further control of their powers.
For example, when the Rabbit Miraculous was struck with a Cataclysm by the Future Cat Noir, it was cracked (or it's possible that it didn't receive a full blast) compared to the Bee Miraculous when it was completely destroyed by Cat Noir in "Queen Wasp".
In "Cat Blanc", Hawk Moth is shown to be able to call for his cane from afar. It's possible when a Miraculous owner gets older, they share a mental connection with their weapons or some, like Ladybug's yo-yo string, are connected to their holder's willpower. Due to being young, it's possible that their mental connection grows with time, but if the weapon is damaged or broken, then so will the link.

title: Miraculous holders
text:
Miraculous holders - Abilities
Also on an interesting note, if a holder activates a Miraculous superpower, then in turn loses the jewel to another person and said new holder deactivates it, it's unknown if the timer will be activated as in the case with Eagle and Miraclonizer in "Miraculous New York".
In "Revolution", it seems for an underage Miraculous holder to be able to do this, they must not only spend time practicing their powers but understanding them, as well as learn what it truly means to be a hero. As Ladybug and Cat Noir let their enemies take advantage of their moral code, they realized even with and without powers on both sides of the line it was still their job along with everyone to stand up for what is right. With that mentally in mind the holders detransformations will slow down and by seeing the people fight for their freedom and then followed suit and by focusing their will and determination they channeled their energy to unlock their adult powers. Also, not only will a minor obtain the adult powers of the Miraculouses they've been assigned to, but to other Miraculouses, if not all as Bug Noire, Marinette not only used Lucky Charm multiple times but Cataclysm too.

title: Miraculous holders
text:
Miraculous holders - Abilities
In "The Illustrhater", it is possible for newly permanent heroes like Nino Lahiffe to eventually get their infinite powers if they've already learned what it truly means to be a hero with prior experience.
Baby Miraculous holders
From "Riginarazione", as seen with Cat Noir, the miraculous superpowers work the exact opposite for a baby as they do teenagers. Instead of activating when the holder intents to and use once per transformations, for baby holders, they have no control over their powers and can use them multiple times. And yet, their enhanced abilities remain intact.

title: Miraculous holders
text:
Miraculous holders - Weaknesses
While they are almost invincible while transformed, they aren't exempt from everything, such as drowning, unless they're in Aqua Mode or using their weapons as breathing devices. While not transformed, the Miraculous has no effect. As seen in "Gorizilla", a Miraculous owner could not survive jumping off a high building while not transformed. In "Miraculer", they do have some resistance to their own powers while transformed, but it will leave them injured and possibly on the verge of death if struck in a vital area, as with Cat Noir and his Cataclysm.
In "Destruction", it turns out when not struck in a vital area with a Cataclysm the transformed holder's suit will have cracks or rips. But if the holder is not healed by Ladybug's restoration powers it will leave a huge terrible black scar on them and if left untreated in "Jubilation" and "Illusion", the recipient's injury will be similar to necrosis. As of "Intuition", if the injury continues then their pain becomes worse and spread to their organs causing even more damage especially if they misuse time miraculouses causing their injuries to speed up and shorten their time.

title: Miraculous holders
text:
Miraculous holders - Weaknesses
While they are almost invulnerable, minor miraculous owners must be wise about how and when they use their superpower because after it is used, the kwami begins to lose the energy needed to keep the transformation, and in five minutes, the Miraculous owner detransforms back to normal as the kwami emerges from the jewel. If they want to transform again, they need to help their kwami regain energy by feeding them. Not only that, some powers are strictly linked to a owner's weapons, likes Ladybug's Lucky Charm and her yo-yo. This can also be a weakness, meaning that while an owner is using their weapons to summon their powers, they can't use them to attack or defend, leaving them vulnerable, as seen with Ladybug in "Sandboy".
In "Miraculous Paris", reveals the full reason why underage Miraculous holders need to de-transform back after summoning their superpowers once is because the use of the Miraculous takes vital energy from both the kwami and the holder, enabling a countdown timer that prevents them from using their powers until they are ready.

title: Miraculous holders
text:
Miraculous holders - Weaknesses
Besides growing up, akumatization and using time-related Miraculous, the other way to override the countdown is using a Miraculous for evil, that allows young holders to access their powers similar to adults, but it takes a great toll on their bodies, causing a magical necrosis similar to those caused by the effects of Cataclysm until it slowly destroys them. However, if the young ones renounce their ways to the greater good then the corruption is reversible through the powers of the Ladybug miraculous holder.
When Miraculous jewels are damaged or negatively impacted, it can result in damaging the wearer's powers, leading to them not working the way they are supposed to, or at all, go completely out of control.
Other negative effects can be done on the wearer themselves; when an adult holder uses a broken jewel they expend more vital energy causing the kwamis to feed off more than normal them to sustain themselves at first, leading to fatigue and health problems, as seen with Nathalie in "Mayura".

title: Miraculous holders
text:
Miraculous holders - Weaknesses
In this condition, they can overcome the afflictions, if the jewels are used sparingly, but only for a while, because even if a broken Miraculous is fixed, or its use is stopped entirely it doesn't stop the holder's condition from deteriorating until they end up in an endless slumber, or even dead.
It's unknown if the same effects will happen with a younger Miraculous holder.
In "Representation", one use of a damaged Miraculous (at least the Peacock Miraculous) results in the holder having 15 years to live, but if overused the holder will have less than a year.
As it's unknown if all of them have the same effect or not.
However, if they just transform with a damaged jewel and remain inactive, like Bunnyx who was in a stone slumber, they won't be affected.
Like the jewels, a wielder can transform with a sick or hurt kwami.
However, they, too, must use extreme caution, since it's the kwamis that give their owners their powers and transformations.
If they transform under these conditions, it's likely they won't be able to hold it for long, let alone give their owners their powers or their powers will be weakened.

title: Miraculous holders
text:
Miraculous holders - Weaknesses
Another negative effect is the owner being stuck in their superhero form, as seen in "Timetagger", until said jewel can be repaired or by removing them if their voices are taken away, as "Silencer", shows how important a Miraculous owner's voice is while they're transformed. Since they use their voices to activate their superpowers and transformations, if an owner can't speak, then they can't summon their powers or if they get cancelled out, as seen with Ladybug therefore they can experience improper prolonged transformations. If it happens before they transform, they can't transform at all. It's unknown how long they can stay transformed under normal circumstances and yet, if they decide to do so for long time periods it will lead too many unanswered questions or if any have unknown side effects. All vocal commands of an owner's powers can only be done by the voice of the person who's actually wearing the jewel, meaning that a Miraculous owner can't activate the powers of another owner unless they switch their Miraculous or when they come into the possession of another jewel, like Ladybug with Cat Noir's ring in "Gamer 2.0".

title: Miraculous holders
text:
Miraculous holders - Weaknesses
According to Master Fu, the use of or merging too many Miraculouses, either activated or in camouflage mode, may have consequences both to the body and mind of the owner. It's also unknown what the full damage could be if a damaged Miraculous is fused with another jewel. If a holder fuses four or more together and overuses the jewels powers it will result in electrical discharges causing the holders great pain.
Even though the quantum masking of the Miraculous works pretty well it has it's limits as the magic only confuses human minds but not robots such as Uncanny Valley. However, the magical protection is useless if the holder transforms in the open or reveals themselves willingly or not such as in "Cat Blanc", "Miracle Queen", "Ephemeral" and others as it makes it easier for someone else to steal the jewels. Despite it being strong a holder must do what they can or need to conceal their identities because civilians can figure out who's behind the mask on their own if suspicious enough such as with Alya figuring out Cat Noir and Carapace identities.

title: Miraculous holders
text:
Miraculous holders - Weaknesses
The holders can transform while under the effects of an Akumatized villain if their powers are minor, like amnesia in "Oblivio", or appearance changes, like in "Reflekdoll", as long as they remove the Miraculouses before they get affected.
In "Dearest Family", it's also very dangerous for a wielder to transform when a kwami enters a "food-hungry" state after they eat delicious and unique individualized sets of foods. Because the holder will be affected by their kwami's hunger and craves, but by exerting willpower, the holder can resist them.
In "Evolution", when any holder are paired with a kwami, it's their job to keep them well fed between each transformation. Because the effectiveness of their powers depends on how much energy their kwami possess, before or during transformations. If not fed, an excessive use of the powers ends up making them weaker. When under unification, for both young and adult holders, the combined use of the powers places a great strain on the kwamis and holder's energy, draining and debilitating both much faster but giving them too much food will give too much power.

title: Miraculous holders
text:
Miraculous holders - Weaknesses
In "Conformation", that if a Miraculous holder leaves anything behind that has their quantum imprint then it can be tracked anywhere.

title: Miraculous holders
text:
Miraculous holders - Trivia
The physical appearance of the Miraculous holders from their transformations varies between the individual, the time, and the place.
And according to Plagg in "Frightningale", it is influenced by the holder's tastes and desires.
Miraculous holders choose what kind of costume they desire and must accept if they are ready to be a hero. According to Thomas, the reason why Ladybug's costume is simpler than the others is for that very reason.
The transformation sequences of Miraculous holders and the poses they make at the end are "just for fun" and are purely symbolic.
The transformation sequences are about sixteen seconds.
Each Miraculous holder is able to choose their own name/superhero identity.
Which is mostly true, but sometimes a superhero identity can be given to a Miraculous holder by another holder, as done in "Startrain" and "Reflekdoll".
While transformed, holders cannot experience pain and have some level of invulnerability to physical damage, although the extent of this invulnerability is unclear.

title: Miraculous holders
text:
Miraculous holders - Trivia
However, if holders get hurt before they transform, they will still be hurt afterwards, like when Adrien hurts his ankle and retains the injury after becoming Cat Noir in "Riposte".
If their endurance and stamina is pushed to the limit, they will experience some level of fatigue or pain, as seen in "Robostus" and "Mayura".
In "Weredad", Cat Noir briefly held his arm and also collapsed on Ladybug's shoulder out of exhaustion.
It turns out in "Miraculer" that the invulnerability of a Miraculous holder reaches its limit if they're on the receiving end of a Cataclysm or powers that can cause them harm, leaving them very weak and lethargic afterwards if not healed by the Miraculous Ladybug in time if struck in a vital area.
But if area is non vital, then the Miraculous holder that gets struck will be marked with a black nasty scar and if not healed by Ladybug's powers then in "Multiplication" and other episodes it causes irration and spread all over the person's body.
In "Mayura", Hawk Moth reveals that Miraculous wielders can stay transformed even after using their superpower, however, it isn't fully explained how.

title: Miraculous holders
text:
Miraculous holders - Trivia
As of "Timetagger", it's revealed that the ability to stay transformed after using their powers and multiple or prolonged use of said powers develops upon reaching adulthood.
The only known way a young Miraculous owner could bypass that rule would be if they had their powers amplified by Akumatization.
As seen by Ladybug in "Sandboy" and "Silencer", another way younger Miraculous owners can experience prolonged transformations albeit incorrectly would be if their powers are/were cancelled out or if they are unable to activate them.
Well prolonged transformations can be done by personal choice of the wielder regardless of any age as long as younger ones don't use their powers, but it would still lead to many unanswered questions as well as exposure of said holder's identity while at the same time it's unknown if there are any side effects to prolonged transformations for younger Miraculous holders.
Until, "Timetagger", the longest time a Miraculous holder can be transformed was set by Bunnyx who held her transformation for a total of 5,000 years.

title: Miraculous holders
text:
Miraculous holders - Trivia
From "Desperada", "Evolution" and "Miraculous Paris", there are other ways younger Miraculous owners can have unlimited use of their powers or prolonged transformations outside of being akumatized or waiting until adulthood.
That time powered related Miraculouses such as the Snake and Rabbit Miraculouses can give the user such abilities due to it's nature with time.
Albeit more dangerously if a minor holder breaks the security system of the jewels by using them for evil.
According to Thomas Astruc, the reason why adults don't detransform after using their powers is because they can "feed" the kwamis with their energy. This also explains why their kwamis don't need to eat as often, and haven't been seen being exhausted after powering their holder for long periods of time.
That would also explain why Sass looked exhausted when after Adrien detransformed from Aspik in "Desperada" and due to him being young Sass could not feed on his energy.

title: Miraculous holders
text:
Miraculous holders - Trivia
It's unknown if a kwami connected to a damaged Miraculous has to feed off more of their adult holder's energy to sustain themselves. However that's what likely happened to Nathalie in "Mayura" and if so to Émilie too, Dusuu took so much of her energy that it resulted in her being put into coma or if the same effects will happen with a younger Miraculous holder.
Wielders can voluntarily detransform, even if the time limit has not been reached.
Miraculous holders can continue owning their Miraculouses to any age as long as they're using them and their bodies are capable.
Miraculous holders can be akumatized, as revealed in "Queen Wasp".
Thomas Astruc explained that the crew's plan is to continue expanding the universe by adding new characters and revealing more about all of the Miraculouses in the Chinese Miracle Box, while still having Ladybug and Cat Noir be the main focus.
According to Master Fu, until "Kwamibuster", no Miraculous holder has ever had the mental and physical abilities to handle the use of so many Miraculouses at once.
As of "Mr. Pigeon 72", no known Miraculous holder was ever seen unlocking the secret or meaning of their powers.

title: Miraculous holders
text:
Miraculous holders - Trivia
Notably, among her predecessors, her 3 successors, as well as all known Ladybug holders from alternate universes including herself variants, Marinette from the Quantic Universe is the only one to have upgraded her powers and create Magical Charms. Her predecessors were not aware that the Miraculous' powers are theoretically limitless, her successors did not have enough experience with this Miraculous, while it is unknown if any alternate Ladybug user can unlock this ability.
It's completely unknown why the Guardians erased the knowledge of the Miraculous holders, but it's likely they did it to protect current and/or the future ones from those with evil intentions.
According to the synopsis of "Miraculous New York", Ladybug and Cat Noir will discover that Miraculouses exist in the United States, too, so it's likely that they'll meet or hear of North American Miraculous holders which is confirmed to be true. Not only did the heroes discover one of the missing jewels, the (Eagle Miraculous), but they also worked with its new owner and Ladybug discovered that Gilbert was previous Miraculous holder.

title: Miraculous holders
text:
Miraculous holders - Trivia
According to Su-Han in "Furious Fu", the Miraculouses were never meant to be used by children or teenagers making Ladybug and Cat Noir (also by extension their team) are the youngest owners in Miraculous history.
Excluding most the current Miraculous holders as well as Master Fu, Jeanne d'Arc and Mudangbeolle while including Mayura, Pigella, and Rooster Bold, most of the other past holders don't have any known family.
As of "Stoneheart", "Mayura", "Miracle Queen", "Miraculous New York" and "Emotion", no other Miraculous holder brought disgrace to their legacy holder name.
