title: Miraculous Rio
text:
Miraculous Rio - Trivia
The special has been announced and postoped multiple times. It thus holds the record for the longest time between the script being written (2021) and its release (2028), as well as the longest gap from the release of the previous special ("Miraculous Tokyo" premiered in 2025).
The reason behind this is unknown. Frédéric Engel Lenoir once theorized in an Instagram comment reply that "maybe [the rest of the production crew] were just being careful or making sure the Rio [special] gets good animation & stuff".
It's also unknown why the special was promoted as including the heroine Lady Butterfly, as the script had been written in early 2021 without her, and according to Thomas Astruc, she was never intended to appear.
In July 2022, it was announced on Licensing Russia that a TV spin-off featuring the Brazilian hero was planned and was slated for a 2025 release.
On April 28, 2024, Thomas confirmed on Twitter that he wrote a pitch bible for the spin-off. However, because the Rio special hadn't been greenlighted at that time, it caused the spin-off to get delayed before eventually being rejected by executives.

title: Miraculous Tokyo
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Miraculous Tokyo - Intro
"Miraculous World: Tokyo, Stellar Force" (or simply "Miraculous Tokyo" ) is a 48-minute special TV movie of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. It is the sixth written and fifth released movie in the Miraculous World series.
The special will be followed by a spinoff called "Miraculous Stellar Force", which is set to premiere in 2027.

title: Miraculous Tokyo
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Miraculous Tokyo - Synopsis
TF1
When Ladybug travels to Tokyo, she meets Miki and Kazuno, Kagami's old friends, members of the Stellar Force, a Japanese superhero team. Together, they join forces to stop a new supervillain from wreaking havoc in the city.
Throughout this journey, alongside Kagami, Marinette discovers there's much she hasn't yet discovered about her friend's past.
After New York, Shanghai, Paris, and London, Ladybug flies to the other side of the world for adventures more spectacular than ever alongside a band of heroes with unprecedented powers!
Disney+
When Ladybug travels to Tokyo, she reunites with Miki and Kazuno, who are old friends of Kagami and part of the Stellars, a team of Japanese superheroes. Together, they join forces to prevent a new supervillain from wreaking havoc on the city. Throughout this journey, alongside Kagami, Marinette discovers that there is much about her friend's past that she has yet to uncover.

title: Miraculous Tokyo
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Miraculous Tokyo - Production History
The Tokyo special was first announced during CCXP 2020 on December 5.
Sometime in 2022, the book adaptation of the "Origins" two parter by Little, Brown and Company was added to the Edelweiss catalog, and the description revealed that three TV specials had entered production that year. The first two would later be revealed to be "Miraculous Paris" and "Miraculous London".
On January 11, 2024, a Variety article once again mentioned that two specials were in production at that time.
On May 1, Thomas Astruc confirmed on Twitter that the special hadn't been greenlighted by executives yet.
As revealed on Jun Violet's LinkedIn profile, the special entered production in June.
On July 5, Sébastien Thibaudeau revealed that he and Thomas Astruc were working on the script for the special, and that the special's codename starts with "J".
On October 1, LoliRock creator Jean-Louis Vandestoc revealed he was working on the special, referring to it as an OVA.
On October 8, Jeremy Zag mentioned the special in an interview, revealing that its theme song will be in Japanese and that LadyTiger won't appear in it.

title: Miraculous Tokyo
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Miraculous Tokyo - Production History
On October 19, Miraculous Corp. CEO Andy Yeatman revealed at MIPJunior that the special is expected to be delivered by the end of the next year, and that a spinoff tentatively called "Miraculous Stellar Force" is planned.
On June 7, 2025, a Variety article revealed more information about the spinoff series, the special's full title, and reiterated the 2025 release date.
On June 10, at the Annecy International Animated Film Festival, two short scenes were shown to attendees.
On July 2, at the TFOU Back-to-school conference, a full synopsis and both storyboard and completed scenes were revealed.
On July 24, at San Diego Comic Con, a full storyboard scene was shown to attendees.
On October 6, a new poster was released, showing the Stellar Force's mecha designs.

title: Miraculous Tokyo
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Miraculous Tokyo - Plot
One evening during the summer between seasons 5 and 6, Argos and Ryuko, in their space forms, meet for one of their usual gatherings over the English Channel, reflecting their budding relationship. After they part ways, Ryuko uses her Wind Dragon to return to Paris. Meanwhile, Marinette is on a call with Adrien, who is currently in New York City for a few days. As Marinette reminisces on their visit there during their class trip back in "Miraculous New York", Adrien sends her a link for the song that was played during their dance on the rooftop while they were there. Just as Marinette is about to kiss him in her dream upon hearing the music and Adrien inviting her to dance, she suddenly has to hang up when Ryuko arrives, transforming back from her Ryuko space form to Kagami, and asks Marinette for help in her former home of Tokyo. Marinette is confused, until Kagami shows a video feed from Nadja Chamack on the news of an attack on the Tokyo City Hall that was halted by Tokyo's new superhero team, and Kagami requests her help again, thinking that Ladybug would be of help with getting the new superhero team working in sync.

title: Miraculous Tokyo
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Miraculous Tokyo - Plot
Confused by Kagami's request, Marinette tries to explain the situation to her parents, Tom and Sabine.
However, it's soon revealed that Kagami and Marinette have already left on the Tsurugi's private jet to Tokyo, to the shock of Tom and Sabine.
However, once Kagami has Tatsu transmit the coordinates of her grandmother's home to Marinette's parents so they know where Marinette and Kagami will be staying in Tokyo, Tom and Sabine give their consent, and wish them a safe trip.
After Marinette hangs up, she realizes she had forgotten to pack her suitcase or any clothes, as she's still in her pajamas.
She quickly sews a blazer to wear over her pajamas for the flight.
During their journey, Kagami shows Marinette a voice chat and identifies each person in the chat by name.
Unfortunately, Marinette can't understand Japanese.
Thankfully, Tikki has an idea and flies into Marinette's ear, while Longg reveals that Kwamis have the ability to help their owner speak and understand other languages, so Tikki can help Marinette understand and speak Japanese fluently.
As the conversation continues, it's clear there is some conflict within the group.

title: Miraculous Tokyo
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Miraculous Tokyo - Plot
The last person to speak, Kazuno, seems focused on protecting people, which contrasts with Miki's argument, suggesting a different approach.
Stepping away to get something to drink, Marinette speaks privately with Tikki over how she believes their trip to Tokyo isn't just to help Kagami's former friends.
When Marinette returns and asks Kagami how different Tokyo is to Paris, Kagami tells her it is very different, just before the plane makes its final descent into Tokyo's Narita International Airport, where Marinette soon sees the Tokyo Tower, which Kagami explains was built and designed based off that of the Eiffel Tower.
Once there, Marinette's passport is stamped, and she and Kagami take a taxi to Kagami's grandmother Nozomi's home, befriending the taxi driver, who is a big fan of Paris and Ladybug.

title: Miraculous Tokyo
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Miraculous Tokyo - Plot
Meanwhile, deep under Tokyo, in a mysterious spaceship crashed in the magma, the leader of a group of villains is reviewing footage of the new superhero team with their recent fight with a Kaijū, and points out how the black armored member was arguing with the leader in the yellow armor about protecting the people, when she argues they won't be in danger if they defeat the Kaijū faster.
The leader realizes this is their advantage: The black armored member's weakness for protecting human lives, as a result, he later gets into the taxi Marinette and Kagami rode in earlier, and begins to sabotage it.
As the driver asks in fear what he is doing, the leader simply says he is upgrading it before attaching another of his devices to the driver.

title: Miraculous Tokyo
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Miraculous Tokyo - Plot
Back with Marinette and Kagami, after arriving and having dinner with Grandmother Tsurugi, the two enjoy a warm bath in the backyard, where Kagami begins to share some of her past with Marinette, talking about her former classmates and friends in Tokyo before Tomoe moved them to Paris, including Kazuno, who introduced her to love and romance, including playing at the local arcade, and also revealed that he already had a crush on Miki, unaware that Kagami was starting to crush on him as well, before Tomoe decided to move them to Paris.
Marinette and Kagami are enjoying their bath time when it is abruptly interrupted by what Marinette initially thinks is an earthquake.
To their shock, they discover that a massive Kaijū is attacking the city.
Without hesitation, they transform into Ladybug and Ryuko and rush off to confront the creature.
Then, Tokyo's own superhero group, the Stellar Force, are the first to arrive to the scene.
As members of the team include Leo, Capricorn, Sagittarius, Cancer, and Aries, but they were all still too green in  facing the Kaijū.

title: Miraculous Tokyo
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Miraculous Tokyo - Plot
As early in the battle, Leo showed a troubling lack of concern for civilian safety which Sagittarius admonishes her for after she nearly causes harm to a mother and child due to her recklessness.
Meanwhile, Capricorn observes something unusual about the Kaijū but is ignored by the others.
Then, soon Ladybug and Ryuko arrive watching everything admitting that despite their lack of teamwork they can learn, but when Ladybug asked specifically what she needed to do, Ryuko wanted the former to use her guardian status to make the Stellar Force work more cohesively, but the heroine hesitated, worried how the Stellar Force would react to a stranger telling them what to do with Ryuko believing they came for nothing.
Regardless, Ladybug summoned her Lucky Charm, at first believing they weren't needed, but Ryuko protested.
When Capricorn is in danger again, Ryuko is forced to intervene to help him, but then gets on Leo's bad side due to it.
When Leo wants to do the unification spell, Capricorn balks, having apparently lost his self-confidence, and goes to help the civilians instead.

title: Miraculous Tokyo
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Miraculous Tokyo - Plot
On the other hand, Ladybug notices a taxi light on top of the Kaijū and realizes that it's the same taxi she and Kagami rode in and where they befriended the driver from before.
Horrified, she warns Ryuko to stop the Stellar Force opening fire, but it's too late; as Leo, Sagittarius, Cancer, and Aries fire their giant blaster at the Kaijū, destroying it and inadvertently killing the driver in the process.
Ladybug calls them out for their actions, and they are shocked to learn that a human was inside the Kaijū.
Using her Miraculous Ladybug for intuition, she restores the Kaijū.
But Leo is still unwilling to listen to reason, despite Ladybug and Ryuko's claims.
Nevertheless, thanks to Capricorn, who identifies and marks the weak spots on the Kaijū using Ladybug's second Lucky Charm, the Stellar Force struck at said spots, breaking the spell and reverting the Kaijū back into the taxi.
Ladybug checks on the driver, who thanks her for saving him before driving off to continue his work.

title: Miraculous Tokyo
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Miraculous Tokyo - Plot
The Stellar Force learn a valuable lesson about the importance of not destroying said monsters without considering the safety of innocent humans, especially Leo, realizing that Ladybug and Ryuko were right, and begins to reconsider the team's combat strategy against Kaijū in the future.
Afterwards, all the heroes return home for the night, Kazuno feeling especially down, beginning to doubt his capabilities of being a Stellar despite his Sprite telling him otherwise.
Meanwhile, finding Kagami still sad, Marinette joins her mentioning that Kazuno is Capricorn, to which the former confirms, and Marinette further pushes on confirming her own suspicions that they weren't only here to help the Stellar Force, but also she was here to help Kagami as emotional support in her relationship with Kazuno as well as commenting that she couldn't fully help if she didn't know what was going on.
On that note, Kagami hesitates, believing that she made everyone suffer.

title: Miraculous Tokyo
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Miraculous Tokyo - Plot
Comforting her, Marinette retorts the opposite, believing if Kagami hadn't found the strength to find friendship and love, then she would've been under her mother's influence, being ruthless and cold, leading to the real suffering and that she was the only one who was.
However, Kagami wasn't so sure, blaming herself for how the Stellar Force was functioning because of how she broke off her relationship with Kazuno, further explaining that, before she and her mother moved to Paris, Kagami had something really important to tell Kazuno, but backed out.
Marinette gently pushed her saying maybe it was time that she finally talked to him, but when Kagami didn't know how, Marinette believed they'll find a way.

title: Miraculous Tokyo
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Miraculous Tokyo - Plot
Meanwhile, back in his ship, the villain leader, now known as Moddler, is contacted by The Supreme, the ruler of the Re-Verse in Miraculous Paris, who is currently dealing with Betterfly, their own Ladybug, and Furry Paw, along with their rebellion. The Supreme reveals that he is aware of Ladybug and Ryuko, including the rest of The Miraculers, and instructs Moddler to continue his plans to acquire the Stellar Matrix, which would enable The Supreme to cross into the Quantic Universe and allow Moddler to escape Earth and go home. To do this, Moddler attacks a Japanese fishing boat with one of his henchmen and transforms the crew and cargo into more Kaijū to launch further assaults on Tokyo, since he himself wants to be off Earth as he can't take being trapped there forever.
Meanwhile, Marinette tries to help Kagami reunite with her old friends by secretly inviting them to an upcoming festival where Kagami's grandmother and roommate will be selling their products.
The friends are excited to see Kagami again, providing her with an opportunity to mend relationships, especially with Kazuno.

title: Miraculous Tokyo
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Miraculous Tokyo - Plot
This is significant because she left Tokyo for Paris without informing them due to her mother's orders.
When Kazuno fails to show up with the others, Miki takes Marinette to find him.
During their trip, she realizes that Marinette was the one who sent the invitation message and confesses her own unreciprocated crush on Kazuno.
Upon reaching Kazuno's house, Marinette attempts to explain the situation about Kagami, but Kazuno notices Moddler's imminent attack on Tokyo as the civil defense sirens wail.
Subsequently, the festival is besieged by a five giant new Kaijū unleashed by Moddler, who can transform people into smaller Kaijū just by touching them, who can then spread the effect to others.
Kagami and her friends attempt to fight them off, but Kagami is forced to transform into Ryuko in front of her grandmother, Shinobu, and old friends, shocking them with the revelation of her identity as Ryuko of The Miraculers.
She urges them to keep her identity a secret.
Back at Kazuno's apartment, Kazuno and Miki, after asking Marinette to keep quiet about what she is about to witness, transform into their Stellar Force forms: Capricorn and Leo.

title: Miraculous Tokyo
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Miraculous Tokyo - Plot
They leave to rejoin the fight while Marinette transforms back into Ladybug and heads out on a Lucky Charm motorcycle.

title: Miraculous Tokyo
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Miraculous Tokyo - Plot
Unfortunately, during the battle, despite having whole the team, the Kaijū keep multiplying. Sagittarius then whispers to Capricorn that Ryuko is Kagami, catching him by complete surprise. As a result, as Kazuno and Ryuko stare at each other in silence as Ladybug arrives and notices the awkward situation, a giant Kaijū knocks him, Ladybug, and Ryuko away. Leo barely has time to react to seeing what happened to her teammate, before the same Kaijū smashes her and renders her unconscious. One of Moddler's henchmen takes advantage of this by turning Miki into a Kaijū, incapacitating her so that she can be taken to Moddler, who wants to learn the secrets of the Stellar Matrix. In the meantime, when Kazuno learns that Miki was captured, he becomes distraught and powers down. Realizing what's going on, Ladybug tells Ryuko she's got to talk to Kazuno and sort everything out with him as that was the reason they came to Tokyo in the first place: So Kagami could make amends with Kazuno for breaking his self-confidence with leaving without saying goodbye and telling him why. Understanding what Ladybug means, Ryuko heads off to find Kazuno to apologize and fix things with him.

title: Miraculous Tokyo
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Miraculous Tokyo - Plot
Meanwhile, despite some uncertainty with trying it, when Ladybug activates her Miraculous Ladybug, it reverses the effects of what turned many people into Kaijū, restoring many victims back to normal, including Miki. Miki, now revived, fights off Moddler, protecting her watch and the Stellar Matrix, ultimately forcing him to retreat—though she now knows who the mastermind behind the attacks is, and upon seeing the magic ladybugs, thanks Ladybug for saving her life and the Stellar Matrix. Meanwhile, Ryuko regroups with Kazuno, powers down into Kagami, and explains the events that led to the fallout between the Stellar Force and herself before moving to Paris, also handing him the letter she couldn't give him originally before moving away. Her confession and reading her letter helps Kazuno regain his resolve and fighting spirit, which had been shaken by his guilt over Miki's capture and Kagami's previous words that had broken his self-confidence upon hearing her say something so harsh and heartbreaking to him. Thanks to Kagami's explanation and her heartfelt apology for contributing to his self-doubt, he finds renewed strength, and together they return to assist the others.

title: Miraculous Tokyo
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Miraculous Tokyo - Plot
Ladybug is growing exhausted from summoning Lucky Charms and using her Miraculous Ladybug to restore everyone, but with Kazuno's return and renewed resolve, he's able to help the Stellar Force free the rest of the victims, before turning to the giant Kaijū the fishermen were turned into.
Together, now that Kazuno was able to coordinate with them again, the Stellar Force summon a robot Kaijū of their own to fight them, and Ladybug is able to summon one of her own with Lucky Charm, but requires Ryuko's Lightning Dragon to energize it.
Together, they are able to locate the weak spots on the Kaijū and destroy them, restoring the fisherman back to normal.
Afterwards, following after Aries gives the team their new name that they all agree with, the Stellar Force use their own version of the Miraculous Ladybug, the Miraculous Stellar Force, to repair all the damage to Tokyo, before sharing a "Pound It!" fist bump with Ladybug and Ryuko.

title: Miraculous Tokyo
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Miraculous Tokyo - Plot
As for Moddler, as he gripes about being able to go home now thanks to this latest defeat, The Supreme reappears, assuring him that the newfound confidence of the Stellar Force makes them all the more vulnerable to taking them out and getting the Stellar Matrix from them.
With the city safe for now and peace restored, Marinette, Kagami, Miki, Kazuno, and the others are able to enjoy the festival, with even Marinette wearing a kimono like the others for it. Some time later, Marinette and Kagami depart Narita International Airport to return home to Paris on the Tsurugi private jet, where Kagami now sports her new hairstyle and civilian outfit, and Marinette is inspired by Japanese fashion with some new ideas for herself in terms of her everyday clothing and her bodysuit as Ladybug. Marinette then remembers Adrien and sends him another voice mail telling her he loves him, while Kagami decides to do the same for Félix.

title: Miraculous Tokyo
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Miraculous Tokyo - Plot
In the stinger, Adrien receives Marinette's voicemail, but doesn't appear to be in the mood to send her a reply back. Shortly after, he is joined by Uncanny Valley, who asks if he is alright. As he hangs up from listening to Marinette's voicemail and puts his cellphone away, Adrien expresses his concern for Marinette and sending her a reply later as he lets Plagg out from his jacket, if he, Plagg, and Uncanny make it through their impending fight. Uncanny reassures him that they will be okay. Trusting her words, Adrien transforms into Cat Noir and joins Uncanny as well as the rest of the United Heroez, which includes Majestia, Knightowl, Eagle, and Mercury. Together, they prepare to confront a threat—a giant, six-fingered hand emerging from a dimensional rift, accompanied by crackling lightning from the portal.

title: Miraculous Tokyo
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Miraculous Tokyo - Plot Development
The events of the special coincide with the Hoshimatsuri, also known as Tanabata, a festival that is celebrated on the seventh day of the seventh month, which is either in July or August, depending on the calendar (solar or lunar) which is used to calculate the date. Considering the events happen between "The Final Day"/"Miraculous London" (which take place on the first day of the 2016 summer break) and Season 6 (which is fully set during the new school year), this places the special sometime in late July or early August.
More about Kagami's past is revealed in this special:
Kagami's grandmother owns an onsen, where the former would occasionally reside. She lives with her partner (French compagne) Shinobu.
It's unclear how they are related to Kagami's grandfather who was mentioned in "Riposte". However, since he's seemingly absent, it might be related to Tomoe's dislike of men.
It's revealed that Kagami, much like Adrien, lived most of her life at home, being homeschooled and only leaving to attend fencing competitions.
When Kagami turned 14, she asked her mother to go to school, which she allowed as long Kagami would earn it, which she did.

title: Miraculous Tokyo
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Miraculous Tokyo - Plot Development
She attended a school that was focused both on academics and sports, with her attending as a fencing student.
She met a group of twelve friends, where she befriended a boy from that group called Kazuno, for whom she fell in love with, but her feelings were not reciprocated. Kazuno was her very first friend, but, due to her leaving to Paris, she had to part ways with him, with her severing their friendship in order to spare herself the pain of being away from her first friend and love.
Interestingly, Kazuno is shown being very similar to Marinette, not just physically, but also in terms of personality, with both being kind, yet very clumsy individuals. They were also Kagami's first real friends, with Kazuno being Kagami's very first friend, while Marinette was her first real friend in Paris.
It's revealed that a kwami can share their ability to understand, speak and read any language with their owner by simply entering their head. Tikki uses this to help Marinette communicate in Japan.

title: Miraculous Tokyo
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Miraculous Tokyo - Plot Development
In the Japanese dub of the special, so this detail still makes sense, Miki speaks in English when Kagami first plays her voice message instead. This is in line with Kano Academy being an international school for people of different backgrounds.
A new superhero group called Stellar Force is introduced in this special:
They are a recently formed group of superheroes who fight Kaijūs in Tokyo.
All of them had already been a group of friends who went to the same school as Kagami back when she lived in Tokyo and were familiar with her.
Their powers come from bracelet-like creatures and a crystal from what is called the Stellar Matrix and are based on each of the Western zodiac constellations, with each member being named after their respective zodiac signs.
Each have individual weapons and, when they combine their powers through a specific choreography, they can form many different types of more powerful weapons and, when they do it all twelve together, a giant combat robot.
They fight Kaijūs created by the villain Moddler, who wants to obtain each of the Stellar Force's respective pieces of the Stellar Matrix.

title: Miraculous Tokyo
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Miraculous Tokyo - Plot Development
His identity was unknown to Stellar Force until Leo faced him after Ladybug managed to revert her from her monstrous form in time to prevent him from taking her piece of the Stellar matrix.
Moddler is similar to both Hawk Moth and Chrysalis in the matter they are both the nemesis to a superhero team who want to collect their power source, with the latter two wanting the Miraculouses (especially Ladybug's and Cat Noir's) and the former wanting the Stellar Matrix.
At the special's end, Kagami adopts the new outfit that she wears in Season 6, with Marinette also having ideas to update her own outfit as well, showcasing that her current outfit first seen at the end of Miraculous London was based on her experiences of Tokyo.
Kagami is the second of the Miraculers to be seen undergoing the change from their previous looks to their current one, following Sabrina in "Daddycop".
However, Kagami is chronologically the first of the Miraculers to be seen undergoing the change from their previous looks to their current one, since this takes over summer vacation.

title: Miraculous Tokyo
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Miraculous Tokyo - Plot Development
Marinette helping Kagami with her emotional problems foreshadows the former helping others like Sabrina in "Daddycop" and Ivan in "El Toro De Piedra" and as well as Marinette not knowing yet from them she has been receiving clues on dealing of her own problems involving Adrien in "Mister Agreste" and "Revelator".

title: Miraculous Tokyo
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Miraculous Tokyo - Trivia
Earlier sources claimed that the character LadyTiger would be introduced in the special.
In July 2022, it was announced on Licensing Russia that a TV spin-off was planned and was slated for either a 2026 or 2027 release.
On July 7, 2024, Jeremy Zag revealed that a character called Tiger Force would be introduced to the series' universe soon. It's likely she's a new version of LadyTiger.
This is the first Miraculous World special not to feature Gabriel Agreste/Hawk Moth/Monarch in any way, as the events take place a couple of weeks after his death.
This is the first special where a Butterfly Miraculous holder is completely absent and isn't one of the villains and no akumatized or kamikotized person.
This is fitting, as the events occur before Chrysalis' first public attack on the first day of school, as mentioned in "Wreckless Driver".
Now for sure it's revealed that the Miraculous Ladybug can revert any damage or destruction done outside of other Miraculous superpowers.
The opening of this special shares some differences from the previous ones:

title: Miraculous Tokyo
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Miraculous Tokyo - Trivia
Unlike the previous specials, Ladybug is shown at the top of the Eiffel Tower with Ryuko, instead of being alone with (without) the Miracle Box.
The Ladybug and Dragon Miraculouses appear alone under the constellations, instead of the whole Miracle Box, similarly to Gimmi in "Miraculous London".
Unlike the previous specials, which have unique ending themes, a slightly remixed version of the melody from the credits of "Miraculous Paris" is used.
Chronologically, this the first time where other Miraculous holders besides Ladybug and Cat Noir are using Miraculous power-ups as Argos and Ryuko are shown in their space suits, meeting over the English Channel.
They have already been pictured in imaginary sequences in "Sleeping Syren" and "Yaksi Gozen".
Which implies that maybe after the Miraculouses were restored and returned to the other Miraculers, the duo also gave the Miraculous power-ups to the other team members.
A character called the Supreme is introduced in this special, being an ally of Moddler who is helping him obtain the pieces of the Stellar Matrix in exchange of the latter freeing him from his confides. He also seems to be aware of the "work" of Ladybug and her team.

title: Miraculous Tokyo
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Miraculous Tokyo - Trivia
It's unknown if this character is the same one as the one that rules over the Re-Verse, as mentioned in "Miraculous Paris".
In case it's the same character, it's possible this is the Quantic version of the Supreme from the Re-Verse.
Unlike his Re-Verse version, he is bound by an unknown force that prevents him from doing damage in this universe and he seeks the stellar matrix for his freedom.
This special shows the most on-screen uses of the Miraculous Ladybug, at least seven, due to Ladybug using it continuously to revert back all transformed civilians and ease the load on the Stellar Force, while Kagami dealt with her issues with Kazuno, so the latter could join his team fully.
This special also breaks the record for the most Lucky Charm objects summoned by Ladybug, although the absolute record for most objects by any holder is still held by Shadybug.
The final object, the mecha, is also the biggest Lucky Charm object ever seen.
This is the second time Ladybug gets a spray can as a Lucky Charm object, after "Gamer".
Coincidentally, both times it was used against a villain in a mecha.

title: Miraculous Tokyo
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Miraculous Tokyo - Trivia
This is the third time where a keychain appeared as a Lucky Charm object following "Miraculous New York" and "Miracle Queen".
While this special is the second to have Adrien/Cat Noir as a minor character following "Miraculous London", in the former, he appeared at multiple points throughout the special, while here, he's only seen in the scenes before the title card and after the end card.
Since he is seen with the United Heroez in New York, it could mean that Uncanny Valley learned Adrien's identity as Cat Noir again but like before she likely deletes the information after every encounter to protect him and the other Miraculers.
Or Uncanny Valley lied about deleting it the first time as the ending also implied that Eagle, Majestia and Knightowl are aware of who Adrien/Cat Noir is.
Eagle is shown seemingly being able to fly, but it's unclear whether she's using the Space power-up or has achieved that some other way, like technology from the United Heroez.
Similar to "Miraculous London", this is the second movie to include another Miraculous holder, this time with Ryuko.

title: Miraculous Tokyo
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Miraculous Tokyo - Trivia
There are some minor differences between the version of the special initially aired in France and in the USA, primarily in the lighting of the CGI scenes.
This is the first special in which three cities appear physically, being Paris, New York and Tokyo.
However, in "Miraculous London", a TV report briefly showed eighteen cities around the world as the Miraculous Ladybugs passed over them.
The image in the Ladybug and Cat Noir game in the Game Center is from the episode "Bakerix".
References
This is the third Miraculous World special to include two different art styles, after the Multiverse sequence in "Miraculous Paris" and post-end card scene of "Miraculous London".
Interestingly, "The Chinese Legend" (the precursor of "Miraculous Shanghai") was planned to be in 2D during its early stages, due to its cost.
Unlike Season 6, which is only animated by Dwarf Animation, the special's 3D scenes were handled by Stim Studio.
Marinette and Adrien mentioned the moment they danced in the air during the special "Miraculous New York", with the two of them recreating the moment, even if remotely.

title: Miraculous Tokyo
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Miraculous Tokyo - Trivia
Kagami recites the same line, Uncanny Valley said in "Miraculous New York", about somewhere needing Ladybug.
After dealing with the Taxi Kaijū, Marinette told Kagami that she couldn't help unless she fully understood what was happening in reference to the events in Paris involving Gabriel. It wasn't just Marinette, Adrien, and Felix who felt guilty about those events; Kagami also felt responsible for how the Stellar Force was functioning. Determined to face her past and prevent them from meeting the same fate as Gabriel, she decided to go back and confront her feelings.
When Kazuno and Miki try to pick up the same fruit but end up hitting each other in the head and Marinette commenting about it references her doing the same with Adrien in "Animan".
Allusions
This special shows references to Japanese animation and the tokusatsu genre:
From the moment Marinette and Kagami land in Tokyo until the moment they leave, the special is animated in 2D akin to Japanese animation.

title: Miraculous Tokyo
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Miraculous Tokyo - Trivia
The Stellar Force is based on Super Sentai, a team of people who transform into superheroes and gain superpowers, color-coded uniforms, signature weapons, sidearms, and fighting skills and battle a group of otherworldly supervillains that threaten to take over the planet.
Even though it's inspired by Super Sentai as a whole, the Stellar Force seems to draw even more direct inspiration from Uchu Sentai Kyuranger, as it features a twelve-member team with a space theme focused on constellations.
Ladybug's Lucky Charm helmet and motorcycle reference Kamen Rider, a group of motorcycle-riding superheroes with an insect motif who fight supervillains. She also executed an Akira Slide while riding the motorcycle.
Kaijūs (giant monsters) and mechas (like the one summoned by the Stellar Force and Ladybug's final Lucky Charm) are also part of the tokusatsu genre.
Errors
Throughout the special, whenever Ladybug activates the Miraculous Ladybug, her upgraded suit doesn't revert back to the basic version.
Furthermore, when she summons the spray paint can Lucky Charm, she's briefly seen in her basic suit.

title: Miraculous Tokyo
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Miraculous Tokyo - Trivia
Despite the special chronologically happening before the flashback in "Revelator", when Ryuko gains her adult powers and Kagami has her new design, she is seen her old design and doesn't need to detransform.
When Marinette does her little dance pose before Ryuko comes into her room, her left leg glitches into her right leg.
When Ryuko stands behind a car with some of the members of the Stellar Force her sole is red even though it should be golden.
Kagami isn't seen wearing the Dragon Miraculous throughout the whole special, even before she transforms.
At the end, when Marinette sends Adrien a voice message, his image on her phone uses his new (Season 6) design, despite the events occurring before the change, and the old design physically appearing in other scenes.
In one scene, Ryuko's foot is colored black even though it should be red.
Sometimes Mayotte's lips aren't drawn properly.
When Leo and Capricorn are in the robot and the camera moves up, they are misaligned on the platforms they're standing on.
When Capricorn makes the lightning spots on the Kaijū during the first battle, the circles disappear on the front side of its body in a few scenes.

text:
Miraculous Tokyo - Trivia
In the plane scene where Marinette says to Kagami "You had friends?", Longg's tail is hanging down, but in the next scene it's pointed up.
Nikko's first voice message in the group chat is shown to have been sent at 10:16, despite it being between messages sent at 10:09 and 10:10.

title: Miraculous Paris: Tours of Ladybug and Cat Noir
text:
Miraculous Paris: Tours of Ladybug and Cat Noir - Intro
The  was an official virtual tour to Paris with the creators of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. It was launched on April 15, 2022 and ended sometime at the end of 2022.

id: Miraculous Paris: Tours of Ladybug and Cat Noir::Description::0
title: Miraculous Paris: Tours of Ladybug and Cat Noir
text:
Miraculous Paris: Tours of Ladybug and Cat Noir - Description
From the comfort of your sofa you'll be able to join a virtual tour to Paris, and get to know the city of lights, the Miraculous way. Get to visit real Parisian monuments, learn why they found their way into the show, hear behind the scenes secrets about key moments from the show, all these while playing games and interact with Miraculers around the globe!
GUIDE TO PARIS
With a Miraculous city map in your hand, you'll learn about the city of lights, about its history, culture and delicious food.
ORIGINAL CONTENT
Hear from your beloved heroine about the Paris she grew up in, about her favorite places in the city, both as Marinette and as Ladybug.
BEHIND THE SCENES
Hear from the creators of the show how the city became source of inspiration, and why it has become an integral character in the show.
PLAY GAMES
Think you know all there is to know about the show? Participate in friendly trivia games, answer riddles and guess what comes next. Up for challenge?

id: Miraculous Paris: Tours of Ladybug and Cat Noir::Events::0
title: Miraculous Paris: Tours of Ladybug and Cat Noir
text:
Miraculous Paris: Tours of Ladybug and Cat Noir - Events
The tour begins after purchasing an event on the official website of the service. Then the Miraculer will join other people to a tour or can choose an private event and share it with a friends: (NO LONGER AVAILABLE)
Kids & Families – price: 39 USD per Family:
An event for families (up to 25 families per event),
One screen for one family,
A family getaway to Paris,
These events take place during weekends and after school,
Story is tailored for a young audience. Learn about Paris in a playful way,

A hangout for adult fans (up to 25 guests per event),
One screen for one Miraculer,
An after hours cosplay event,
Compete against others who is the absolute #1 fan of the show,
A slightly longer event with more emphasis on the history and culture of the city,

An unlimited screens for unlimited guests,
Choose the guests,
Customize a special event,
Special shoutout to the organizer, can includes the Miraculer's favorite moments,
The tours are in English.

title: Miraculous holders/Movie
text:
Miraculous holders/Movie - Intro
Miraculous holders are people who use the Miraculouses to transform into animal-themed superhumans with the help of the kwamis.

title: Miraculous holders/Movie
text:
Miraculous holders/Movie - History
According to Master Fu, for over the centuries the Miraculouses have been watched over by the guardians who were tasked with giving the magic jewels to the world's greatest heroes every time the world was in crisis or danger. But just as there great heroes there were also those that wanted the jewels for their own desires bringing great danger. However when it came to choosing these great holders it was decision that the guardian and the needed kwamis (to battle the crisis) needed to make together but that's not always the case as Tikki and Plagg flew off on their own to choose their owners themselves.

title: Miraculous holders/Movie
text:
Miraculous holders/Movie - Abilities
Most of the abilities of the Miraculous holders is the same with enhanced speed, agility, strength and endurance but each holder has their own unique Miraculous superpower and tool.

title: Miraculous holders/Movie
text:
Miraculous holders/Movie - Weaknesses
While they are almost invincible while transformed, like their original counterparts they aren't exempt from everything, such as drowning, as Cat Noir took a falling dive from Eiffel Tower as it collapsed causing him to be knockout upon impact with the water and being hit by fallen debris if he wasn't saved by Ladybug. The suits they wear can be damaged if hit with other forms of miraculous magic.

title: Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript - Intro
Astro Argos: I love you Kagami, living so far apart is hard. I miss you more everyday.
Astro Ryuko: It's an ordeal we'll get through.
Astro Argos: We'll see each other again next week then? Same spot, same time?
Astro Ryuko: If all goes well.
(Astro Ryuko and Astro-Argos's hands separate from each other. Astro Ryuko and Astro-Argos fly away to their respective places.)
Astro Ryuko: Wind Dragon! (transforms into her Wind Dragon form and dashes to Paris.)
Marinette: I miss you so much, Adrien. It's hard, you being so far away...
Adrien: I miss you too Marinette. I'm only staying in New York for a few days. I'm coming back to you soon.
Marinette: Oh, I wish I was there with you. We could be dancing together like we did on our school trip, remember?
Adrien: Hold on... (types something)
(Notification sound.)
Marinette: What is it?
Adrien: Click on the link and you'll see.
Marinette: (she does, and music begins to play.) Ah! It's our song!
Adrien: Care to dance?

title: Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript - Intro
(Marinette and Adrien fantasize about being together. In her imagination, Marinette takes Adrien's hand and they hug, and just when they are about to kiss, Marinette's fantasy is interrupted by Ryuko entering her room through the window in Wind Dragon form.)
Marinette: I'm sorry, I gotta go. I promised my parents I'd read them a bedtime story tonight.
Adrien: (confused)You read bedtime stories to your-?
Marinette: Gotta go, talk soon! (ends the call)
Ryuko: Storm Subsides.
(Destransforms into Kagami.)
Tikki and Longg: Yay! (hug each other)
Kagami: Marinette, Tokyo needs you. Or rather it needs Ladybug.
Marinette: Tokyo?
(Kagami shows Marinette the news on her phone.)
Nadja: A giant monster destroyed Tokyo's city hall in Japan, but fortunately a new hero team whose name remains unknown managed to stop it before it could do any more damage.
Marinette: Well, if everything is taken care of, they don't need Ladybug.
Kagami: They do, but I'll explain later. We have to leave right away.
Marinette: Right away? As in, like, right now? But is your mother okay with this?
Kagami: I didn't give her a choice. (shrugs)
Marinette: And what will you tell your boyfriend?

title: Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript - Intro
Kagami: Nothing. Felix is in London anyway. He won't even know I left Paris.
Marinette: But what do I tell my parents?
(Sabine's phone rings waking her and Tom up.)
Sabine: (picks up the call) Marinette?
Marinette: Mom. Dad. I just wanted to ask you... Uh, could I go to Tokyo for a few days with Kagami?
Sabine: Well, Uh... Tickets to Japan are quite expensive you know, honey?
Marinette: Kagami's mother has a private jet, it wouldn't cost a thing.
Sabine: But, when would you leave?
Marinette: Well, actually, um... I already have?
(Sabine and Tom both gasp in surprise and shock when Marinette reveals that she's already heading for Tokyo.)
Kagami: Good evening, Mrs. and Mr. Dupain-Cheng. Don't worry, we will be staying at my grandmother's. Tatsu, transmit Obaa-san's coordinates.
Sabine: Uh... We were going to say yes anyway.
Tom: Have fun, girls.
Marinette: (squeal) Thank you so much! Love you, mom! Love you, dad! You're the best! (Kisses the phone and closes the call.) Tokyo, here we come! (realizes she is still in her pajamas) Shoot! In all the rush, I completely forgot to pack my clothes.
Kagami: Don't worry, I have clothes.

title: Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript - Intro
(Kagami approaches a button, and after pressing it, a closet full of clothes opens; curiously, each outfit is identical to the one Kagami is currently wearing.)
Marinette: Uh, yeah! Thanks, that's great, Uh... but is there any chance you have a sewing machine on board?
Marinette: Ta-da!
Kagami: Marinette, I want you to hear a conversation between members of this Japanese superhero team.
(Kagami plays a voice message with her phone and shows the screen to Marinette.)
Miki: Tōnamento o teian shimasu. Katta ga watashi no rīdā ni narimasu.
Marinette: (awkwardly) Uh, I don't know Japanese you know?
Kagami: Ah, that's a problem.
Tikki: I've given it some thought and I might have a solution. (Tikki enters Marinette's ear.)
Marinette: Hey! Tikki, what are you doing!?
Longg: Tikki will help you understand Japanese and speak it too.
Marinette: Hontoni? Are? Sugoi! (becomes surprised at what she has said) Uh, I mean- so cool!
(Kagami puts her phone in the table to show her the voice messages of the superhero group.)
Miki: I propose a tournament. Whoever wins becomes our leader.
Kagami: That's Miki.
Mayotte: We don't need a leader, we're a group. We all decide together.
Kagami: Mayotte.

title: Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript - Intro
Pili: If it's anything like finding our team name we are in trouble.
Kagami: That's Pili.
Nikko: I've got a name! The Super Rainbow Cockroaches! Hehe!
Kagami: Nikko.
Yu Lu: Cockroaches?
Kagami: Yu Lu.
Nikko: What? Cockroaches are cute.
Miki: If everyone had taken part in the invocation, we'd have beaten that monster faster.
Kazuno: We have to protect the people!
(Kagami pauses voice messages.)
Marinette: And, who is he?
Kagami: Kazuno.
Marinette: Kazuno, okay?
Kagami: Yes, well... (Kagami plays the messages again.)
Miki: Why do you always refuse to do the summonings with us?
Kazuno: I have no sense of rhythm anyway.
Miki: Come on, I've seen you dance before.
Kazuno: I don't wanna dance anymore. (Kagami clenches her fists.)
Kagami: Do you see the problem now? They're too divided, they'll never make it on their own.
Marinette: Ah! (Tikki comes out of Marinette's ear.) But how come you're in these Japanese superheroes's group chat?
Kagami: They forgot to remove me.
Marinette: You know these superheroes?
Kagami: They used to be my friends.

title: Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: You used to have friends?! (Kagami glares.) I mean- you had friends in Japan, which makes sense, right? (Marinette laughs nerviously.) Before we meet, before we became friends. Why did you say "Used to be friends"? You aren't friends anymore?
Kagami: It's ancient history.
Marinette: Go on, tell me.
Kagami: There's nothing to tell.
Marinette: Oookay? I'm gonna have some orange juice, want anything?
(Marinette gets up from the table.)
Kagami: No, thanks.
(Marinette puts on the clothes she just made while going for the orange juice. She pours herself a glass of juice while glancing at Kagami.)
(Kagami looks out the airplane window, takes a crumpled letter out of her jacket, but puts it back.)
Marinette: I'm not sure these Tokyo superheroes need Ladybug, Tikki. Something tells me it's more a case of Kagami needing Marinette. (Marinette sits back down with Kagami at the table.) Anywho, what's Tokyo like compared to Paris?
Kagami: Different. Very different.
Marinette: Wow! It's huge! Oh... (View of the Tokyo Tower.) It's not that different after all.
Kagami: It's the Tokyo tower. Its architect was inspired by the Eiffel Tower.

title: Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript - Intro
(The plane arrives at the airport, the airport procedures are done quickly, then finally Marinette and Kagami get in a taxi.)
(Views of various tourist sites of Tokyo pass by.)
(Marinette is taking photos of the views with her phone.)
Marinette: Wow! So beautiful!
Taxi Driver: You're French?
Marinette: I am, but Kagami was born here.
Taxi driver: Oh, I love France! Look! (Touches his Eiffel Tower car hanging decoration and it plays "La Marseillaise".) The Eiffel tower, croissants, cheese, accordion music and Ladybug! Ah! Miraculous Ladybug!
(Marinette and Kagami chuckle.)
(They reach Kagami's grandmother's house.)
Kagami and Marinette: Thank you and goodbye, sir.
Taxi driver: Goodbye girls, and Vive la France! (He drives away while "La Marseillaise" plays.)
Kagami: This is where my grandmother lives. (View of the house. Marinette gets closer to the front stant, looks like is a shop.)
Marinette: It smells so good! What's this?
Kagami: Dorayaki, a local pastry. (View of the Dorayaki.) Obaa-san makes the best in Tokyo.
Marinette: Wow!
(Kagami and Marinette enter to the house.)
Kagami: Tadaima, Obaa-san!
Nozomi: Okaerinasai, Ka-chan. You must be Marinette. Bienvenue.

title: Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript - Intro
(Kagami closes the door and takes off her shoes.)
Marinette: Pleased to meet you, ma-! (Kagami stops her from entering the living space by stepping on her slippers and glares at her.) Huh? Oops, sorry! Hehe... (Takes off her slippers.) I forgot, no shoes when entering a Japanese person's house. Hehehe...
Nozomi: I'm so happy to finally meet one of Kagami's friends. You must be very hungry. I've prepared a little something for you.
(Three creatures are watching a video feed of a monster destroying a car.)
Rigger: There! A weak point!
(Moddler hits his throne in frustration with his fist.)
Moddler: It's not a weak point, it's a car, you stupid... Argh! You're no use to me at all.
Mapper: Well, if that's what you wanted you should have modeled us a brain, master.
(Moddler groans. Then changes the video.)
Capricorn (In the video.): If we all take part in the Ultimate Summoning, who will protect the people!?
Leo (In the video.): The faster we beat the bad guy, the sooner people will be out of harm's way!
Moddler: There's the weak point.
Skinner: Which one's the weak point? The boy or the girl?
Moddler: These humans are weak, because they want to protect other humans.

title: Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: This is what you call "a little something"?
(Shows a table full of delicious looking food. Marinette stares at it dumbfounded.)
Nozomi: Please, enjoy your meal.
Marinette and Kagami: (Grab the chopsticks.) Itadakimasu!
Nozomi: Bon appétit to you too.
Marinette: (Munch.) Huh! It's so good! (Eats a lot in anime style.)
Nozomi: (To Kagami.) What a nice surprise to see you here.
Kagami: (Hesitating) I wanted to show Marinette Tokyo.
Nozomi: Well, you're in luck then. Because tomorrow is the Hoshi Matsuri. We'll have a booth.
Marinette: (with food in her mouth.) The what?
Kagami: The Hoshi Matsuri, it's a traditional festival. (Marinette swallows.)

title: Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript - Intro
Nozomi: In Japan, we have a very rich folklore filled with fantastical creatures, like Yōkai for example. We have many legends, such as that of Princess Orihime and Hikoboshi the cowherd, two lovers condemned to live far apart, each on one side of the Celestial River, but who are allowed to meet once a year. That's the legend we celebrate during the Hoshi Matsuri. (Marinette is touched by the story as she continues eating, Kagami looks to the side.) Ah, it's such a romantic festival! You'll probably run into your old classmates and your old boyfriend. (Marinette stops in the middle of a bite and looks at Kagami surprised.) What was his name again? Kazuno?
Kagami: He wasn't my boyfriend and I wasn't planning on going to the Matsuri. I have other plans.

text:

title: Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript - Intro

(after a while, Marinette wearing her yukata opens the door to leave the room.)

Marinette: (Whimpering)

(Marinette continues whimpering while holding the flashlight.)

Marinette: Gotcha!

title: Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript
text:

Marinette: Aaah~
(Tikki and Longg relax bath in their own small hot tub too.)
Tikki: Aaah~
Longg: Hmm...

Marinette: Wasn't the bath supposed to be a time for sharing?
Kagami: (Looks at Marinette) If Adrien told you about his childhood, you can easily imagine what mine was like. Like him, I was raised away from the outside world. Teachers came to the house. I only went out for fencing competitions. I had no friends, and then... My 14th birthday arrived.
(Kagami enters the room, Tomoe is working with a laptop on a table in the middle of the room.)Kagami: Mother? Tomoe: I'm working.Kagami: I'm turning 14 today.Tomoe: (Still working) What do you want?Kagami: To go to school.Tomoe: (Still working) No, pick something else.

title: Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript
text:

The arrow pierces the center of the ring mid-flight and lodges itself in one of the wooden pillars next to Tomoe, successfully preventing the ring from hitting the ground.)''

text:

text:

title: Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript
text:

text:

text:

title: Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript
text:
