Marinette: Hm... (Puts Tikki back in her ear with her finger.) Free Dorayaki for everyone!
(The group starts messaging.)
Miki: Kagami?!
Mayotte: How long have you been in this chat?!
Yu Lu: (Gasps) Does she know our secret?
Pili: I told you we should have created a new chat for the Ultimate Defenders of the Earth.
Jéola: The Ultimate what?
Anglia: The Ultimate cheesy team name.
Marinette: (Sparkly eyes) Ah! It's working!
Longg: Aren't you gonna answer them?
Marinette: Kagami will answer them herself later today. In the mean time, I'll turn off the notifications. (Turns off the notifications and giggles.)
(Marinette quietly puts Kagami's phone back where it was without waking her up.)
Marinette: (Happily walking down the stairs.) Hello, Ms.Tsurugi! (She runs into Shinobu again and gets spooked by her.) AHHHHHHHHHHH!
Shinobu: (Ignoring Marinette's scream.) Ohayo, Kid.
Marinette:(Sweatdrop.) Uh... Ohayo to you too.
Nozomi: (Holding a box.) Did you sleep well, Marinette?
Marinette: Yes, thank you! Kagami and I were thinking that we'd love to help you to set up the Matsuri booth, to thank you for having us!
Nozomi: That's so sweet of you. Thank you, Marinette.

title: Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (Cat smiles.) Meow. (Returns to Kagami's room and slams the door open smiling.) KAGAMI!!
Kagami: (Wakes up with her hair all messed up.) Uhhh?
Marinette: (Very excited.) Wake up! Your grandmother needs us!
Kagami: (Still sleepy.) Uh huh... (Marinette suddenly grabs her by her pajamas.) Wah!
(Marinette and Kagami are sitting in a cart with several boxes being pulled by a motorcycle driven by Shinobu, with Nozomi sitting behind her and holding onto her.)
(Marinette is eating a Dorayaki while looking at Kagami and smiling.)
Kagami: Marinette, you're smiling like you do whenever you're up to one of your strange plans.
Marinette: (Stops eating.) Oh, me? Nonsense!
(They arrive at the festival site and Marinette looks at the entrance in amazement.)
Marinette: Wah!
(Marinette sighs and cleans her sweat after moving a box.)
Mayotte: Kagami!
(Kagami turns to see Miki, Mayotte, Yu Lu, and the others, to her surprise.)
Yu Lu: You're back!
Pili: Why did just dup and leave last year?
Jéola: Disappearing without a trace like a professional hacker.
Nikko: Without even a goodbye party!
Miki: Yeah, without even granting me a rematch?!

title: Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript - Intro
Anglia: I was concerned with your disappearance, almost.
Kagami: You were?
Ryo: Sure! We're so happy to see you again. (Karelia gives Kagami a big hug.) Even if it doesn't help your carbon footprint.
(Marinette giggles beside Kagami, and Kagami deadpans at her.)
Marinette: (Sparkly eyes.) I heard so much about you all! Aren't you gonna introduce me to your friends?
Kagami: (Showing the person when she says their name.) Mayotte, Miki, Yu Lu, Pili, Ryo, Jéola, Nikko, Bulgan, Karelia, Kiss, Anglia, meet Marinette.
Marinette: (Bows.) Hello, nice to meet you all!
The Group: Hi!
Kiss: Is this the new trend in France? (Starts to inspect Marinette's clothes closely.) Quite surprising, but you wear it well.
Marinette: (Blushing.) What? This? No! I left my suitcase at home and, uh... anyway! Kagami also mentioned, Kazuno! (Kagami blushes.) He's not here?
Mayotte: (Looking at her phone.) He hasn't answered in the chat.
Marinette: Oh, then we should go get him, right?
Miki: Why do you wanna go get him?
Marinette: Well, because "The more the merrier!", as we say in France.
Miki: (Unsure.) Mhm hm... Okay, I'll take you. (Walks past Kagami.) We'll have our rematch when I get back.

title: Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript - Intro
(Marinette follows Miki.)
Bulgan: By the way, Kagami... Didn't you promise free Dorayaki? (Kagami looks at him spechless.)
Fisherman: Roll the nets!
(Fishermen are working on the boat catching and storing fish.)
Moddler: Hey there.
Fishermen: (Look at him.) Huh?
Moddler: (Looks at them from the mast of the boat.) Nice catch.
(Skinner appears behind the fishermen, scaring them.)
Skinner: Hehe...
(While they are distracted by Skinner, Moddler throws disc-shaped devices at the fishermen that stick to their bodies and produce a substance that covers them. Skinner drops several of these devices where they stored the fishes, and the fishes are also covered by the substance, producing a beam of light.)
Marinette: And, uh... were Kagami and Kazuno close friends?
Miki: No need to beat around the bush with me, Frenchie. I know you sent that message to the group chat.
Marinette: (Embarassed.) How did you guess?
Miki: Kagami never sent a message before, and if she had, she wouldn't have written it the way you did.
Marinette: Do you know if something happened between Kazuno and Kagami before she left Tokyo?

title: Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript - Intro
Miki: (Crosses her arms.) Kagami had a crush on my Kazuno. Unfortunely for her, he's been in love with me since we were kids. I feel sad for her.
Marinette: Your Kazuno? (Shakes her head.) Hold on! Does this mean you're in love with him too?!
Miki: Of course, he's the best. Kind, smart, altruistic... And he is so cute when he blushes. He seized my heart, just like he seizes victories in judo.
Marinette: But are you two together?
Miki: (Looks at Marinette like she's the odd one.) No.
Marinette: Why not, if you're both in love with each other?
Miki: Because ''hes never dared to confess his feelings to me.
(The taxi stops.)Driver: We have arrived.Marinette: Have you told him that you love him?Miki: No! (Points at Marinette.) And he cannot find out!Marinette: Why not?!Miki: Victory, must be earned. (Gets out of the taxi and shuts the door.)Marinette''': And they say that I'm complicated.
(Miki rings the doorbell of Kazuno's apartment.)
Marinette: (Sigh.) He's not home? Shot, we're out of luck.
(Miki rings the doorbell of Kazuno's apartment several times. An elderly woman who lives in the apartment next door comes out to see what is happening.)
Old Lady: What do you want?

title: Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript - Intro
Miki: We're looking for Kazuno, Obaa-san.
Old Lady: Kazu-kun? He's running some errands for me.
(Kazuno arrives at the residential complex while looking at his phone carrying the old lady's errands in a bag.)
Kazuno: (Lifts his head from the phone.) Eeek!
(Suddenly, he notices Miki and blushes, dropping the bag full of oranges. The sound of the bag falling catches Miki and Marinette's attention, and they turn to look at him.)
Miki: (Notices an orange rolled close to her feet.) Uh?
Kazuno: (Notices the orange too and goes to pick it up.) Oh, sorry!
(Miki and Kazuno try to pick up the orange at the same time, but end up hitting each other on the forehead.)
Miki and Kazuno: Ugh!
Marinette: Huh?
Kazuno: (Blushing.) Sorry, Miki.
Miki: Ugh... (Smiles at him and blushes.)
Marinette: (Marinette looks at both of them and smiles thoughtfully.) They remind me of someone.
(Kazuno gives the bag full of oranges to the old lady.)
Old Lady: Arigatou Gozaimashita. (Enters her apartment.)
Miki: Didn't you get Kagami's message, Kazuno?
Kazuno: Kagami didn't write it.
Marinette: Okay, you're right, I did. I'm Marinette, a friend of Kagami's.
Kazuno: Is Kagami here?

title: Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Yes, and if you come with us, you'll be able to talk to her.
Kazuno: (Looks down.) I've hurt her, I'll never dare to face her again.
Marinette: (Confused.) Huh? But that's exactly what Kagami tells me! (Shakes her head.) I mean the opposite, like, she tells me what you're saying but from her point of view- (Frustrated scream.) Argh! She thinks she hurt you. What happened between you two?
Kazuno: (Looks behind Marinette.) A kaiju.
Marinette: A what?
(A large fish-like monster taller than the apartments appears walking behind Marinette and Miki.)
Kazuno: (Points to the Kaiju.) There! A kaiju!
(View of the Kaiju roaring while walking through the city.)
Miki: (Points to another fish-like kaiju.) There too, there's another one.
(View of several giant Kaijus resembling aquatic creatures walking toward the city of Tokyo, the view zooms to show several small Kaijus running through the streets.)
(A small Kaiju arrives at the Hoshimatsuri festival site and touches a nearby man, covering him with a substance.)
Man: Aaaah!! (Flash of light.)
(The scream catches the attention of Kagami, Mayotte, Pili and Yu Lu.)
Pili: (With a Doriyaki in his mouth.) Huh?

title: Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript - Intro
(The man is transformed into a crab-like small Kaiju.)
(Seeing this, civilians begin to flee the area, but they are pursued by the Kaijus, and when the Kaijus touch them, they are also transformed into one.)
(One of the Kaiju tries to touch Pili, but he dodges it and counterattacks by hitting it on the knee, then the chin and then kicking it in the abdomen, sending it flying.)
(Mayotte does a backflip to enter a corndog stand, slams the table where the corndogs are displayed, lifting them slightly, then kicks them towards the mouth of a nearby Kaiju, stuffing its mouth to throw it off balance, and then kicks it in the throat.)
(Yu Lu rips off a sign from a stand to get a makeshift ribbon, which she uses to stop a Kaiju that was about to touch a civilian without letting it touch her. The exchange ends with her sending the Kaiju flying and the cornered civilian fleeing.)
(Inside their stand, Shinobu and Nozomi are hugging each other as they are cornered by another Kaiju, but Kagami jumps in between them in a fighting stance to protect them.)
Kagami: Huh! Uh.

title: Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript - Intro
(The Kaiju roars at her, Kagami finds a soup ladle and grabs it to fight the Kaiju. Kagami blocks and dodges several blows from the Kaiju with the ladle, using it like a foil sword, and ends up hitting it on the head.)
(Several Kaijus appear and surround her and the stand, with Shinobu and Nozomi hugging each other scared behind her.)
(The Kaijus roar and attack her at the same time.)Kagami: Longg, bring the storm!(Kagami transforms into Ryuko in front of everyone.)Mayotte and Yu Lu: (Looks at Ryuko.) Huh?!
Nozomi and Shinobu: (Gasp.)Ryuko: Wind Dragon! (She makes a tornado that blows away all the Kaijus surrounding her.)''
Mayotte: So, you're Ryuko?!
Ryuko: Promise me you'll never tell anyone.
Miki: Kazuno, we gotta go. Marinette, you can never tell anyone what you're about to see, okay?!
Marinette: Huh? What am I about to see?
Miki: (Points at Marinette.) Do you promise?!
Marinette: (Trying to apeace her.) Yes, Yes, Yes. (Sits on a sofa.) You can count on me. I'm really good at keeping secrets.
(Kazuno and Miki nod at eachother and let their Sprites come out.)
Marinette: (Surprised.) Uh?!
[ Leo Stellar Matrix Transformation Sequence ]

title: Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript - Intro
(Leo Sprite transforms into a wristwatch and attaches itself onto Miki's wrist.)
Miki: (Puts a yellow fragment inside her Sprite-wristwatch.) Miki, present! Stellar Conection!
Leo: Roar of Justice! Stellar Leo!
[ Capricorn Stellar Matrix Transformation Sequence ]
(Capricorn Sprite transforms into a wristwatch and attaches itself onto Kazuno's wrist.)
Kazuno: (Puts a black fragment inside his Sprite-wristwatch.) Kazuno, present! Stellar Conection!
Capricorn: Cosmic Balance! Stellar Capricorn!
(With both transformed, Leo and Capricorn rush to the apartment's balcony and leap out to chase after the Kaijus.)
Leo: Hah!
Capricorn: Huh!
Marinette: Wow, their transformation is so cool!
Tikki: (Comes out of Marinette's ear.) Are you really going to stay here and wait, Marinette?
Marinette: No... I have to make sure that Kagami finally talks to Kazuno. (Stands up from the sofa.) He needs to regain his confidence so we can save Tokyo! Tikki, Spots On! (Transformation lights.)

title: Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: (Comes out to the balcony and sees the giant Kaijus at the distance.) Lucky Charm! (The Lucky Charm gives her an insect-themed helmet, but then a motorcycle that matches the helmet also falls into the parking lot of the apartment complex. She looks at the motorcycle with sparkly eyes.) Cool!
(Ladybug puts on the helmet and gets on the motorcycle, and drives towards the area where the Kaijus are.)
(Civilians flee the area while the already in their superhero forms friend group fight the small Kaijus.)
(Capricorn arrives, grabs a Kaiju, and throws it against a pillar. After the Kaiju hits the ground, disoriented, Capricorn notices a mark on its body.)
Capricorn: It looks like the signs I saw on the Kaiju before.
(Capricorn touches his wristwatch and shares his vision with the rest of the group. The vision shows that all the Kaijus have atleast one mark.)
Sagittarius: Yeah, I see the signs too!
Cancer: (Fighting a crap-like Kaiju in a roof.) These aren't Kaiju, but another type of creature!
Leo: (Intercepts a Kaiju that was going after Cancer.) But created with a similar technique. Aim for the symbols!

title: Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript - Intro
(Leo punches and destroys the mark of the Kaiju she was fighting, throwing it from the roof to the floor. In a flash of light, the Kaiju transforms into a person.)
Man: Huh?
(The group begins to destroy the marks of several Kaijus, transforming them back into humans.)
Sagittarius: It's working!
(More Kaijus appear and surround them.)
Cancer: There are too many of them! (More Kaijus arrive.) We're not gonna make it like this!
Leo: Should we split into two teams?
Capricorn: It's not two teams we need, it's a dozen! Since every time they touch someone, their numbers grow.
Leo: There's gotta be something or someone behind this! (Rigger chuckles behind a pillar close to the group.) We have to find out! Otherwise we'll keep being overwhelmed!
(The group runs toward the Kaijus surrounding them and fight them off to get to a more open area. But when they arrive, they are surrounded once again by more Kaijus.)
(Ryuko is fighting a Kaiju on the roof of a nearby temple. With her sword, she blocks one of the Kaiju's blows and sends it flying away. She realizes that the group is surrounded by Kaijus and sheathes her sword.)

title: Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript - Intro
Ryuko: Storm Dragon! (Electrocutes all the Kaijus in the area, knocking them out.)
Capricorn: Wow!
Sagittarius: You're not gonna believe this, Ryuko is Kagami! How cool is that?
Capricorn: Huh? Kagami?
Ryuko:  Kazuno...
(While Capricorn and Ryuko are distracted staring at each other, the rest of the group fights against the Kaijus that have surrounded them once again.)
(Ladybug arrives on the scene, passing between Capricorn and Ryuko while performing an "Akira Slide" with her motorcycle.)
Ladybug: (Watches Capricorn and Ryuko still staring at each other.) Uh...
(A giant tentacle appears out of nowhere and strikes Capricorn, Ryuko, and Ladybug, sending them flying out of the festival site.)
Ladybug, Ryuko and Capricorn: Ahhhhh!
(Ladybug crash-lands on the roof of a building.)
Ladybug: Argh! Agh!
(Ryuko smashed into the window of a skyscraper, going through it and rolling across the offices inside before crashing into a wall.)
Ryuko: Wah! Argh! Ugh!
(Capricorn crashes into a window of the Tokyo Tower and crashes into a wall inside.)
Capricorn: Ahhh! Ugh!
Leo: (Looking in the direction they were thrown.) Kazuno!

title: Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript - Intro
(While Leo was distracted, the giant tentacle crushes her, leaving her unconscious. Rigger takes advantage of this to attach a device to her that transforms her into a yellow fish-like small Kaiju.)
Sagittarius: Leo!
(Sagittarius and Cancer try to get closer to Leo and Rigger, but Rigger picks Leo up on his shoulders and quickly jumps away, as Sagittarius and Cancer are stopped from going after him by more Kaijus surrounding them.)
Capricorn: Ugh.
Sagittarius (Through earpiece.): Leo's been captured!
Capricorn: Huh?! Miki? It's all my fault... (Destransforms.)
Ladybug: (Takes off her helmet and speaks through an earpiece.) Ryuko, there's a misunderstanding between you and Kazuno. (View of Ryuko in front of the broken window of the skycraper she landed on.) I don't know what happened between you two, but you've really have to talk to each other. Otherwise, we won't be able to save Tokyo! That's the reason why we're here, isn't it? I'll help your friends in the meantime.
Ryuko: Hm. (Jumps towards the Tokyo Tower.) Huh!
(On a random street, Rigger lands in front of Moddler and shows him the unconscious Kaiju he's carrying, which is Leo.)
Rigger: She is one of them!

title: Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript - Intro
Moddler: (Grabs Leo's wrist and sees that she has a Stellar Matrix.) Ah, perfect. Go back and bring me all pieces of Stellar Matrix.
(Ryuko arrives at Tokyo Tower and stands in front of Kazuno, looking at him.)
Kazuno: (Without looking at Ryuko.) Leo's been captured because of me.
Ryuko: Storm Subsides. (Destransforms.)
Kazuno: (Looks at Kagami.) Kagami...
Ladybug: (Watching the Kaijus from a roof.) No one can save that many victims at once. (Looks at her Lucky Charm helmet.) Unless, they're just victims! That, I should be able to fix. It could work, it will work. (Throws the helmet into the sky.) Miraculous Ladybug!
(The helmet transforms into a group of ladybugs that turn the small Kaijus back into people, including Leo.)
(Leo, now human, recovers her consciousness and realizes that Moddler is holding her by her arm.)
Leo: Huh? (Sees Moddler.) Who are you?
Moddler: (Surprised.) Huh?!
Leo: (Realizes Moddler was about take her wristwatch.) Hey! (Grabs Moddler's wrist.) Don't touch my watch, you thing!
Moddler: I'm not a thing, I'm the Moddler. And I want my Stellar Matrix!
(Leo wraps her legs around his neck and throws him to the ground, freeing herself from his grip.)

title: Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript - Intro
Moddler: Argh!
(Leo runs towards Moddler, but he summons a puddle of lava and sinks into it to escape before Leo can reach him.)
Leo: Moddler, now we know each other. (A swarm of Miraculous Ladybug flies by in the background.) I owe you one, Ladybug. (Jumps away.) Huh!
Kagami: I owe you an explanation, Kazuno.
(Kagami takes a crumpled letter out of her jacket and hands it to Kazuno so he can read it. Kazuno takes the letter, opens it, and reads it.)
Kagami (Voiceover.): Dear Kazuno, I had never danced with anyone before...
Kagami (Voiceover.): But I feel like I've been lucky enough to have met the best person to learn from.
Kazuno: (Looks up from his phone.) I thought you wouldn't come! Hm? (He notices that Kagami seems down.) Is everything okay, Kagami?
Kagami: (Nods while holding a letter behind her back.) Hm...
(Kazuno inserts one token in the console to activate it, gets on the dance pads, and starts dancing when the music starts, but after a while he realizes that Kagami is missing all her inputs.)
Kazuno: Huh? (Looks at Kagami.) Why aren't you dancing?
Kagami (Voiceover.): I wish I could have danced with you my whole life, but for me... the music stops today.

title: Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript - Intro
Kagami: (Looking down.) I don't wanna dance anymore.
Kazuno: But why not?
Kagami: It's pointless.
Kazuno: I don't understand.
Kagami: My mother wants us to move to Paris.
Kazuno: (Gasp.) Oh...
Kagami (Voiceover.): I don't feel sad. I always knew it would end, one day or another.
Kazuno: That's okay, you know. We can still dance together online, remotely.
Kagami: It'd be even worse.
Kazuno: Worse? Worse than what? Did I do something wrong?
Kagami (Voiceover.): You dream of dancing with Miki, not me. I hope one day you find the strength to ask Miki to dance. Thank you for these few steps with you, Kazuno.
Kagami: (Crumples the letter with her hands.) I've made a mistake, Kazuno. I shouldn't have come.
Kazuno: What? but-
Kagami: Dancing with you is a suffering.
Kazuno: (Gasps and shudders.)
(Kagami runs away from Kazuno, while he stands in front of the game in shock.)
Stellar Dance: GAME OVER!
Kagami: Dancing with you was anything but a suffering Kazuno.
(Kazuno looks at Kagami and gasps.)

title: Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript - Intro
Kagami: I'm the one who made you suffer. I should have told you how I was really feeling, but it was sad to leave... and I had feelings for you. Even though I love someone else today, I had to heal the wound that I'd inflicted upon you. I hope you can forgive me... (Tears appear in her eyes.) and dance again.
(Kazuno stands up with tears in his eyes and hugs Kagami. Kagami hugs him back, and they both cry in each other's arms.)
Ladybug: Miraculous Ladybug! (A bunch of small Kaijus get turn back into humans by the ladybugs.) Lucky Charm! (Gets a plate and throws it into the air.) Miraculous Ladybug! (More small Kaijus get turn back into humans by the ladybugs.) Lucky Charm! Miraculous Ladybug! Miraculous Ladybug! Miraculous Ladybug! (She breathes heavily while watching the giant Kaijus still destroying the city from a roof.)
Leo: (Jumps next to Ladybug, while holding her right arm.) A single Ladybug cannot destroy so many opponents. We need something bigger and more powerful! The proper summoning requires all of us to do the choreography together, but I'm not sure everyone is ready for that.
(Capricorn and Ryuko arrive to the roof.)
Capricorn: I am now.

title: Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript - Intro
Leo: (Looks at Capricorn worried.) Are you sure?Capricorn: Yes. (Looks at Ryuko.) I think I've regained my taste for dance. (Ryuko smiles at him.)Leo: In that case... (Through her earpiece.) Friends! Let's rise to our opponent's level so we can defeat them! Ready?
(Everyone gathers and do the dance together.)Group: Celestial Sphere Complete!
(In a spectacular light show, they summon a Giant Robot.)
(Ladybug and Ryuko look at the giant robot in surprise.)Ladybug: (Smiles.) See? You should never be afraid to express your feelings.Ryuko''': (Nods and smiles.)'' Hm.
Leo: Hey, Ladybug. Don't tell me you can't make your own robot.
Ladybug: Challenge accepted, Leo! Lucky Charm!
(The Lucky Charm gives her a Giant Robot too, but it falls down anticlimactically because it's not turned on.)
Ladybug: (Sweat drop.) Ryuko, a little help please?
Ryuko: Lightning Dragon!
(Ryuko enters the robot in the form of a lightning bolt and energizes it, making it stand up.)
Ladybug: (Already inside the Lucky Charm robot and controling it.) So, what do you think?
Leo: (From inside of the Stellar robot.) Okay, not bad. Now let's see which one is the best!

title: Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript - Intro
(A giant Kaiju attacks the Stellar Robot from behind, while another Kaiju does the same to the Lucky Charm robot, making both robots collide with each other, activating both robots' alarms.)
Capricorn: Ugh!
Leo: Woah!
Ladybug: Ugh!
(The Kaijus continue to push both robots against each other, but the two robots break free by lifting the Kaijus onto their shoulders and throwing them in opposite directions.)
(Another Shark-like Kaiju hits the Stellar Robot with its tail, but the robot blocks it with its arm. Then, an Octopus-like Kaiju attacks the robot with its tentacles, but the robot catches both tentacles firmly. Taking advantage of the position, the robot spins with the Kaiju lifting it into the air and throws it making it crash with the Shark-like Kaiju, knocking both Kaijus down.)
Leo: (From inside of the Stellar Robot.) Capricorn, tell us where the Kaiju's spots are. Everyone else, stand ready. We need to hit them all at the same time!
Capricorn: Hmm. (Finds several marks on the Kaijus surrounding them.) Transmiting targets.
(The transmitted information reveals the locations of the marks on the Kaijus to the other members of the Stellar Robot group.)
Leo: Now!

title: Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript - Intro
(Both robots get into position to attack and run toward a Kaiju, striking its marks simultaneously and destroying them. Then they run toward the other Kaijus around them and, in a display of great coordination, destroy the marks on every Kaiju. This causes them to explode in a beam of light, and transform back into the fishermen.)
(When the battle ends, it is already dusk. Everyone gathers on a rooftop to see the results of the fight with the robots behind them.)
Leo: Sagittarius, which would you say was the best robot?
Sagittarius: Honesly, Leo... They were both equally awesome.
Ladybug: I think that's called teamwork.
(Everyone looks at the city destroyed by the fight.)
Leo: It's gonna be a lot of work fixing everything.
Ladybug: I can help if you want.
Leo: You won't always be here to help us, and I'm sure that we can do it too. Especially now that we are a real team.
Aries: Yes! The Stellar Force! (Strikes a pose, but everyone else just stares at him, making him feel embarrassed.) Stellar like the stone that gives us our powers. (The group looks at each other.) (Sighs.) That name is lame too, isn't it?
Cancer: No, not at all. It's an awesome name!

title: Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript - Intro
Aries: (Looks at Cancer.) Really?!
Stellar Force: (Lift their arms into the sky.) Miraculous Stellar Force!
(This creates a beam of light that repairs all the damage caused by the battle.)
All: (Celebrate and laugh.) Yay! Hahaha! (They bump their fists together.) Pound it!
Moddler: Those humans have gotten organized. How am I supposed to win and go home now?
(The Supreme appears.)
The Supreme: Humans think they've won the war, but it was a mere battle, Moddler. You can count on me to help you divide them again. Now that they think themselves victorius, they'll be all the more vulnerable.
(Marinette and Kagami are inside the festival wearing kimonos.)
Marinette: (Marveling at the views.) Oh, wow!
(Marinette and Kagami visit several different food stands, take photos, and enjoy the festival's activities and games.)
(Marinette, Miki, Pili, Mayote, and Yu Lu come together in a group to talk.)
Miki: Now we know who our opponent is and that he is after our Stellar Matrixes.
Pili: (Eating dorayaki.) Moddler's a dumb name, Hahaha!
(Everyone laughs.)
Mayote: In any case, thanks to Ladybug, we've turned into a real team! (Fist bumps with Miki.)

title: Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (Nerveus.) Lucky she was in Tokyo, right? Hahahaha....
Miki: (Looking at Marinette with a knowing glance.) Yeah, super lucky, as they say.
Yu Lu: (To Marinette.) Did you know that Kagami's a superhero?
Marinette: Me?! (She frantically shakes her head and then gestures with her arms.) No! Not at all! No clue! Besides, no one knows who's who, huh? Am I right? And you're not supposed to know either. That's the thing with superheroes, usually... Atleast in France, I mean. Hehe. 'cause here looks very different, since you all know who you are and...
Miki: (Surprised by Marinette's gestures.) Are all French people as funny as you, Marinette?
Marinette: Uh, I don't know.
(All minus Marinette laugh, after a while Marinette laughs nervously.)
(Kazuno and Kagami watch the group laughing from a short distance away.)
Kagami: I don't understand how you can love a girl like Miki. It seems like she doesn't like anybody.
Kazuno: You're saying that because you don't know her. Miki has moved around a lot due to her parents's jobs, so she's learned to not get too attached to people. That way it doesn't hurt when she has to leave again.

title: Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript - Intro
Kagami: Then, I hope you'll find the courage to tell Miki that you love her, one day.
Kazuno: Hm, promise me you won't be afraid to share your feelings again. Or confess your waeknesses.
Kagami: (Nods.) Hmm.
(Fireworks explode in the distance. Kazuno and Kagami see it.)
Kazuno: (Takes Kagami's hand and runs to reunite with the group.) Come on!
Marinette: (Watching the fireworks.) Woah!
(The whole group watches the fireworks together.)
(A plane takes off from it and the animation becomes 3D again.)
Marinette: I like the new Kagami. Her new style suits her very well.
Kagami: Japanese hairdressers are very renowned. You could have tried a new haircut too.
Marinette: Oh, I like my pigtails, you know? Maybe someday I'll try something new, but in the meantime Japanese fashion has given me lots of ideas for a new outfit! I'll start desingning it as soon as we're back in Paris!
Kagami: Before or after you see Adrien again?
Marinette: Before, so I can surprise him when he gets back from New York. (Gasp.) Oh no!
Kagami: What?
Marinette: The last time I talked to Adrien on the phone. I didn't tell him that I love him!
Kagami: (Smiles.) Hmph.

title: Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript
text:
Miraculous Tokyo/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (To her phone.) Hey, Adrien. I hope things are good in New York, I guess it's night time where you are, you must be sleeping. I... I just wanted to tell you that... I love you. And that I can't wait to see you again. (Sends the voice message, sighs and looks at the plane's window.)
Kagami: I too have to sent a message. (Grabs her phone.) Félix, it's always hard for me to say these things, but it's time I did it anyway. I miss you too, I too can't live so far away from you. I hope we'll find a solution to see each other more often, I love you. (Sends the voice message and looks up from her phone.) Huh?
(Marinette, Tikki and Longg: (Looking at Kagami.) Awwwwww!
(Kagami chuckles at their antics and looks through the window.)
Marinette (Voice message.): ...I love you. And that I can't wait to see you again.
Uncanny Valley: (Lands behind Adrien.) Everything all right, Adrien?
Adrien: Yes, I will reply later, if we make it through (Let's Plagg come out.).
Uncanny Valley: (Puts a hand on Adrien's shoulder.) I'm sure we'll be okay.
Adrien: Plagg, Claws Out! (Transforms into Cat Noir.) Hmph.

title: Mireille Caquet
text:
Mireille Caquet - Intro
is a minor character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She is a student at Collège Françoise Dupont and a former student of Olga Mendeleiev's class, before Mayor Bustier reformed the school, and she is the KIDZ+ weather forecaster after winning a competition. She is very popular, getting a lot more votes than the other final contestant, Aurore Beauréal.

title: Mireille Caquet
text:
Mireille Caquet - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Mireille is a fair-skinned slender teenage girl standing at a medium height with pale, light grayish scarlet lipstick, chin-length black hair with dark blue reflections in a face-framing bob with straight cut bangs slightly divided into three sections and upturned, almond-shaped dark tangelo eyes.
Civilian Attire
She wears a long-sleeved pale, light grayish cerulean sweater with a gray cloud design with three dark gray clouds printed the front, white jeans, and orange dress shoes adored with bows and moderate gamboge soles.

title: Mireille Caquet
text:
Mireille Caquet - Personality
Mireille is shy and kind. She is happy to win the KIDZ+ competition, and according to Manon, she is way better than Aurore. She is also forgiving as seen by becoming friends with Aurore despite being frozen by her as Stormy Weather.

title: Mireille Caquet
text:
Mireille Caquet - Etymology
The name "Mireille" most likely means "to admire". The French word "caquet" means "cackle" or "chatter", as in hens or gossip. Thus, Mireille's name points toward how she speaks admiringly of others.
Interestingly, in the Brazilian Portuguese dub, her name and surname are changed to Mirella Tagarela.
In the Irish dub, her name is changed to Máirín.

title: Mireille Caquet
text:
Mireille Caquet - Trivia
In "Dark Cupid", Mireille appears crying over Adrien's poster when Chloé is showing it off, suggesting that she is also a fan of him.
In "Pixelator", the titular akumatized villain traps Mireille in a photo with Théo Barbot.
Mireille, Socqueline Wang, Diane and Sublime Varlette are the only known students of Collège Françoise Dupont not to have been akumatized in any way.
Although Adrien Agreste has never been akumatized in a permanent timeline, he has been akumatized twice in two alternate timelines.
