Repairing a Miraculous

title: Miraculous spellbook
text:
Miraculous spellbook - Contents
The book provides instructions on how to repair a damaged Miraculous jewel by creating an adhesive potion. Each recipe for fixing a broken Miraculous is unique. However, all recipes must include Meteorite dust and Molten Gold, as stated in the book: "Dust from the sky, now precious, will fix the wings of the injured animal."
Each recipe also includes a potion, which contains a secret ingredient that varies for each Miraculous. This ingredient is often related to the animal associated with the Miraculous; for example, the secret ingredient for the Peacock Miraculous is a feather.
Once a drop of the potion is applied to the damaged area, the command "Miraculous, repair yourself" must be spoken.
Repairing the Peacock Miraculous
When Gabriel repairs the Peacock Miraculous, he mixes dust of meteorites with molten gold and adds a peacock feather. He then applied a drop of the mixture to the cracks on the back of Peacock Miraculous. When the repair command was spoken, the cracks were sealed and repaired, returning the Peacock Miraculous back to normal.

Miraculous spellbook - Trivia
Master Fu and Gabriel Agreste also call the spellbook the Grimoire.

Marinette and Tikki take it from Lila after she drops it in a trash can.
As of "Backwarder", since Master Fu has chosen Marinette to be the next guardian of the Chinese Miracle Box, it is possible that he also taught her how to read and decipher the spellbook's contents.
Just like the Miraculouses, it's likely the book was created through divine means as well, which would explain why it appears almost brand new despite possibly being thousands of years old.

title: Miraculous spellbook
text:

But according to Tikki in "Volpina", Master Fu had been looking for the book for a long time meaning that it was intact implying that it didn't fall into the lava or it must have other defenses besides the code written inside.
The 1st holders, the Ancient Chinese holders helped the guardians create the contents of the spellbook since they are recorded inside and through examples started to discover the secrets of the jewels. Then, throughout the generations new information about them was included and so on.
Confirmed by Alya in "Mr. Pigeon 72", what's written in the spellbook is only what the Order of the Guardians have learned about the Miraculouses so far, and therefore is not a fixed set of rules.
In "Gabriel Agreste", it's shown that at the end of the grimoire are blank pages, also confirming that it's everything the Guardians know about the Miraculouses.

The book does not include that Miraculous holders can develop new superpowers, such as Ladybug developing the power to create akuma warding Magical Charms and Shadow Moth developing the power to create megakaumas that bypass and break the Magical Charms protection against akumas simply by allowing themselves to do so.
In "Feast", Master Fu says that a monk gave him the grimoire he managed to save, implying that there may be other spellbooks in the Guardians' temple.
The text of the spellbook at first is written in Nyctography, a substitution cipher developed by Lewis Caroll for the purpose of writing down information without requiring sight. Many of the spellbook's text translates to gibberish, while some pages contain legible French words and sentences.
Since the guardians are the ones that made the code they know how to read it properly implying that it takes more than translating nyctographic.
Since there is information about how to fix broken Miraculouses, it's likely the guardians were aware of the effects of them when used in that state. If so, they may have developed a cure for the wielders who end up in such a state, placing it in the spellbook as well.

title: Miraculous tools
text:
Miraculous tools - Intro
, also known as Miraculous weapons, are special omni-purpose tools that come with their respective Miraculouses. Whenever a Miraculous owner transforms, they possess a tool specific to whichever Miraculous they're wearing.

title: Miraculous tools
text:
Miraculous tools - History
For the sake of seeing and communicating with the kwamis, a mage in ancient times created the magical jewels known as Miraculouses. At the same time of making them, the mage created tools to go with each one.
Since each tool was used by different people throughout time and history, it's not uncommon for them to change in their appearances like the staff of the Cat Miraculous - when being used by Hēi Māo in Ancient China, the weapon appeared to be made out of bamboo or another type of wood; and while being used by Cat Noir in modern-day Paris, it appears to be made out of metal.
Besides their Miraculous weapons, wielders can also fight with additional weapons if they want to, like Tentomushi with her nekode, La Coccinelle with her rapier, and Ladybug with Kagami's saber in "Riposte".
Also, during rare instances, sometimes Miraculous tools would end up being separated from their intended users and would be used by other holders, enemies, or even civilians.

title: Miraculous tools
text:
Miraculous tools - Appearance
Each tool is a different object, like Ladybug's yo-yo and Cat Noir's staff. These tools come in a great variety of different forms, including toys, musical instruments and actual weapons. Usually, the tool is a size that can easily be carried by hand, and most tools can be worn when they aren't in use, such as Ladybug wrapping her yo-yo around her hips or Cat Noir having his staff attached to his back. For some, they can even take the place as added accessory to the holder's costume, looking like parts of the animals their Miraculouses were based off, of such as the skip rope of the Mouse Miraculous acting like Polymouse's and Multimouse's tail.
The color of each tool corresponds to the color scheme of the Miraculous: green for the turtle tool (the shield), navy for the peacock tool (the hand fan), etc. Sometimes, when fusion powers are used, Miraculous tools can change color, like how the skip rope's color pallete changed from light pink and black to orange and black, red and black and full-on black upon the Mouse Miraculous being fused with the Fox, Ladybug, and Cat Miraculouses, respectively.

title: Miraculous tools
text:
Miraculous tools - Appearance
Also, the tool's appearance can change according to its users preferences, as the Turtle Miraculous's shield has different forms when used by Carapace and Jade Turtle, along with the Bee Miraculous's spinning top having different forms when used by Queen Bee and Vesperia. The user can also change the design of their tool at will, which most often than not happens when they change their overall supersuit - this happened with most of the Miraculers in the in-between time from seasons 5 to 6.
As seen in "Evolution", when Unification is invoked, a Miraculous tool will change color to match the color scheme of the users primary Miraculous. However, that isnt always the case - when Gabriel unified the Butterfly and the Peacock Miraculous during the entirity of season 4, the hand fan didnt change its color scheme at all; when Marinette unified the Ladybug and the Cat Miraculous, both of their tools changed colors: the yo-yo became black with green spots and the staff became black with red details.

title: Miraculous tools
text:
Miraculous tools - Appearance
As when using a Miraculous transformation power up form, Miraculous tools can also change their appearance, such as when Ladybug changed into her ice form, the spots on the yo-yo changed into hexagons.

title: Miraculous tools
text:
Miraculous tools - Abilities
The tools are used as weapons, being incredibly handy for both offense and defense. Some tools are capable of being used as a mode of transportation. An example of this is when Ladybug uses her yo-yo to swing from place to place, while Cat Noir can vault himself with his staff.
There are some tools that can split into or be made of multiple pieces such as Cat Noir's staff, Hawk Moth's cane, Vesperia's spinning top and Argos's hand fan allowing the users to dual wield, communicate with someone else while occupied seen in "Oni-Chan" and more.
The tools also have technological features, including a phone, a camera, a GPS and a search engine, among a number of other features  The features of the Miraculous tools semm to "update" in accordance with the technologies of the time, as both Su-Han in "Furious Fu" and Scarlet Fate in "Reunion" became suprised at Ladybug using her yo-yo as a phone. When the owners are in too quick of rush to learn about their powers from the kwamis, the weapons, when converted into their phone forms, also have a user's guide.

title: Miraculous tools
text:
Miraculous tools - Abilities
It has been shown that the tools can be used as a breathing device underwater when a holder is in or out of aqua mode. In aqua mode only, the tool can also be used by other individuals as a breathing device.
The tools also have detachable features, such as tracking devices and earpiece communicators. The tools also have storage capabilities which are connected to the user's non-super method of storage (ex. when the miraculous owner stores something in their purse, the item is relocated to the tool upon transformation). The same rule applies to pictures taken using a tools camera function. When the Miraculous owner is detransformed, the photographs will transfer to their regular phone.
Sometimes under certain conditions, the tools can be used by regular people and other miraculous holders if the owner becomes separated from them such as Ladybug using Cat Noir's staff seen in several episodes, with Nino using the staff in "Anansi" and Alix in using Ladybug's yo-yo in "Reverser".

title: Miraculous tools
text:
Miraculous tools - Abilities
For some Miraculous owners, they need the tool to use their special superpower. For example, the Ladybug Miraculous owner tosses the yo-yo into the air when utilizing the Lucky Charm, the Fox Miraculous owner plays the flute to cast Mirage, the Turtle Miraculous owner holds up the shield to engage Shell-ter, the Bee Miraculous owner spins the spinning top and catches it to use Venom, and the Peacock Miraculous holder plucks feathers from the hand fan to Amokization.
A Miraculous owner can call their weapon back to them from afar, though this has only been displayed by an owner who already has their adult powers. Some younger Miraculous owners have displayed the ability to mentally control their tools, so it could be possible that the connection strengthens upon adulthood. However, if the weapon is destroyed, then the mental connection will be broken leaving the holder unable to call them back.

title: Miraculous tools
text:
Miraculous tools - Abilities
When the Miraculouses are used conjointly through Unification, the weapon of one Miraculous can be combined with the superpower of the other jewel, creating a new effect. Like as Dragon Bug, Ladybug combined the powers of the Water Dragon and her yo-yo causing the shield making ability to expand to not only protect her but Cat Noir as well as protecting them from the titular villain's wasps. But to what other effects the weapons could have when under the power fusion is unknown.
As shown in "Gang of Secrets", if a Miraculous holder becomes a Guardian, they can summon the Miraculouses under their protection from the Miracle Box to them via their tool. For a Ladybug Miraculous holder, they must open their yo-yo, like when purifying an akuma, then place their hand within it to retrieve the Miraculous they want.
Seen in "Hack-San" and "Evolution", if a Miraculous holder has any additional miraculouses being worn, but not in use, the kwamis can hide inside their owner's tools.
In "Ephemeral", it's also revealed that the Miraculous tools have synced digital clocks that aren't affected by GPS time satellites.

title: Miraculous tools
text:
Miraculous tools - Abilities
In "Jubilation" and "Passion", it is shown that when an akumatized victim had been given the power of a Miraculous through the Alliance rings, they didn't need the intended tool of the Miraculous to use their power - instead they could channel the superpowers through other weapons or even through their own bodies.
As shown in "Miraculous Paris", despite Shadybug and Claw Noir's weapons working mostly the same as their counterparts, the darker duo were using the bladed features of their weapons - implying when someone uses a Miraculous for evil, they also activate the dark side of their weapons.

title: Miraculous tools
text:
Miraculous tools - Abilities
In season 6, the Miraculous tools of the Chinese Miraculous Box can now be used to call on other holders even when they're not transformed through the Miraculous Call, a new feature added by Marinette after the events of "Re-сreation" and "Miraculous London": by opening or clicking on their tools and then clicking on the Miraculous symbols, the user sends a telephatic signal to desired holder; the holder then senses who's calling them and their location. This is particularly useful as of season 6, the heroes are all responsible for their own Miraculous, and they needed a reliable way to communicate to one another for aid on their missions.

title: Miraculous tools
text:
Miraculous tools - Weaknesses
The tools are indestructible; the only thing that can break them is the powerful magic of a Miraculous, such as the Cat Miraculous's Cataclysm and Butterfly Miraculous's power in Simon Says' command card, or the force of a Miraculous owner's super strength.
However, when the tools are used to summon their superpowers, the owners can't use them to attack or defend themselves, which leaves them in a vulnerable position, requiring timing and awareness to not be caught in a bad spot. If a minor is attacked during the process, the powers will be canceled out - however, it's unknown if the same effect would happen to an adult holder. If an owner becomes separated from their weapon, they flat out can't summon their special power.
As seen in "Reunion", same as a regular smartphone, a Miraculous tool cannot connect to the internet if there is no available service.

title: Miraculous tools
text:
Miraculous tools - Trivia
When Théo Barbot and Chloé Bourgeois get akumatized into copies of Cat Noir and Ladybug respectively, they possess identical versions of the original superheroes' tools with the same features.
A sentimonster can also have the same powers as another hero, as shown in "Ladybug".
Lila Rossi's akumatization into a replica of a Fox Miraculous holder includes her possessing a copy of the flute.
The real flute in "Sapotis" has the same abilities as Volpina's flute, but Rena Rouge's flute can only create one illusion as opposed to Volpina's many illusions. After the flute has been used once, the Fox Miraculous starts to time out when a teen is using, but for an adult, & Volpina's Miraculous replica doesn't.
As depicted in art in "Ladybug & Cat Noir", Heracles had a spear and Tomoe Gozen had a naginata, although it's uncertain if these weapons are the tools to their unknown Miraculouses or additional weapons.
Miraculous tools can also be destroyed by Cataclysm as seen in "Mayura" except the staff that belongs to the holders of the Cat Miraculous.

title: Miraculous tools
text:
Miraculous tools - Trivia
In "Mayura", Ladybug wanted to used Hawk Moth's cane to track him, implying that Miraculous tools can be used to find their owners when lost, although Hawk Moth detransforms before they could.
In "Miracle Queen", it is shown that miraculous tools can be turned into akumatized and amokitized objects.
But, for amokization, the sentimonster can still exist even if the user has detransformed, as shown in "Hack-San". This could imply the tool simply disappears from the physical word when the kwami leaves the jewel, but it doesnt necessarily means it ceases to exist entirely.
In "Gang of Secrets", it's revealed in Ladybug's case that, if a Guardian uses a Miraculous tool that can hold many objects or has infinite storage, they can access the Miracle Box directly from them.
But it's unknown why this is the case, as in "Furious Fu", Su-Han reveals Guardians should not wear Miraculouses at any time.
This is something new as Marinette was the second known guardian to wear a Miraculous at any time following Master Fu in "The Battle of the Miraculous".

title: Miraculous tools
text:
Miraculous tools - Trivia
In the cases of the Cat's staff, the Fox's flute, the Turtle's shield, the Snake's lyre, the Horse's horseshoe, the Monkey's ruyi jingu bang, the Rabbit's umbrella, the Pig's tambourine and the Butterfly's cane, these weapons are attached to backs - and yet the tools are never seen falling off. It implies that holder's suits are covered in a special adhesive or due to the magical properties of suit that allow the objects to stay attached.
In "Mr. Pigeon 72", when a Miraculous holder gains experience or a deeper understanding of their powers, their weapons can adapt to express new abilities such as Ladybug's yo-yo being able to create Magical Charms.
In "Lies", the Kwamis can communicate to their transformed holders through their weapon-phones, as Plagg's seemingly pre-recorded message of "No Messages. Don't forget my cheese." gets more aggressive each time Cat Noir opens his messages.
Since the tools are also a combination of technology and magic the kwamis can be heard through them, just like they can be seen through magical means in "Optigami".

title: Miraculous tools
text:
Miraculous tools - Trivia
As seen in "Mayura" and "Strikeback", when the Miraculous owner de-transforms, the tool disappears with the rest of their costume, even if it has been left behind or taken by someone else. Additionally, when they transform again, the tool will be back in their possession and in perfect condition even if it was previously damaged.
But this is not always the case however, as shown in "Pretension", both Argos and Cat Noir's weapons remained in existence and stayed in its current location when they detransformed and when they transformed again, the weapon returned back to them.

title: Miraculous potions
text:
Miraculous potions - Intro
The  are potions that can modify the powers of a kwami who ingests them and provide extra abilities to their Miraculous holders which will help them to survive and compensate in different environmental conditions. The extra powers will only last for a single transformation.
After the potion has been ingested, in order to activate the extra powers, the Miraculous user must speak the activation phrase: Power Up. To deactivate the effects of the potion and return to their regular superhero form, the Miraculous user must speak the deactivation phrase: Power Down.

title: Miraculous potions
text:
Miraculous potions - Description
When the transformation is activated, the holder gains the extra powers and a new suit with attributes that correspond to the extra abilities. When the holder is in this powered-up Miraculous form, they can use an alternate method of deactivating the potions effects and detransform into their regular Miraculous form by speaking the detransformation phrase of their Miraculous.
If the holder is already transformed, they can ingest the potions themselves in place of their kwami in order to activate the power up.
The potions don't have to be in liquid form. They can be contained in any vessel, such as pastries and cheeses. The only thing that matters is that all of the ingredients are present.

title: Miraculous potions
text:
Miraculous potions - Recipes
The recipes for the potions are found within the Grimoire. Kwamis are not permitted to know the recipes as a precaution should their Miraculous ever fall into the wrong hands, so as to ensure that a villainous Miraculous user cannot access the extra powers without the help of a Guardian.
In addition to the grimoire being written in the guardians secret alphabet, the ingredients of each recipe are written as codenames; for example, seaweed is written as "a branch from the dragon king's garden", and oyster pearl is written as "secret kept in a shell". However, some ingredients are written as what they actually are such as the ingredient "a tear of joy".
A tear of joy is an ingredient in almost every potion.

When Marinette was working on one of them, she said that one of the ingredients was a "spicy little rock", which is confirmed to not be pepper.

title: Miraculous potions
text:
Miraculous potions - Trivia
It appears they can be used by all holders and kwamis, as Wayzz remembers tasting the green potion and Nooroo's insistence that he doesn't know the recipe, implying he's familiar with the potions.
The potions for Tikki are mixed into macarons, called "Magicaroons", and those for Plagg into cheeses.
While trying to decipher the "tear of joy" ingredient, Master Fu mentions a few possibilities for what he though it might be; including dancing ant honeydew, water from the laughing fountain, melted snow from the mountain of jubilation, and drops of pure chocolate extract.
After he tasted Master Fu's attempt to do the aqua potion, Wayzz comments that it needed "a little more salt". This is a hint to the fact the last ingredient is literally a tear of joy, since tears are salty.

title: Miraculous potions
text:
Miraculous potions - Trivia
The Miraculous potions appear to be a reworked concept from the Pearls and Stones. At the NYCC 2016, the Ladybug Miraculous was revealed to have other magical abilities. These abilities seem to be related to objects known as the Stone of the Sun, the Stone of the Moon, the Pearl of the Sea, the Pearl of the Heart, and the Pearl of the Mysteries; however, Thomas Astruc later confirmed on Twitter that the Pearls and Stones are a concept no longer intended to feature in the show. The stones would have granted powers as follows:
Pearl/StonePotion ColorPower and abilitiesPearl/Stone Color  Stone of the SunUnknownFlying powerYellowPearl of the MysteriesUnknownInfinite Lucky CharmsLilacPearl of the HeartUnknownCure the akumatizedPinkish-PurplePearl of the SeaGreenBreathe and swim underwaterAquaStone of the MoonPurpleFly and breathe in spaceWhite
According to Marinette in "New Powers", one of the power ups gives a Miraculous holder space powers. Similarly like how the aqua potion replaced the Pearl of the Sea, this potion replaced the Stone of the Moon as seen in "Miraculous New York", its color is purple.

title: Miraculous potions
text:
Miraculous potions - Trivia
Like with teaching Marinette on how to decode the spellbook, it's also likely Master Fu taught her on how to make the potions before he lost his memory.
However there had been incidents seen in "Miraculous Shanghai", "Miraculous New York", and "Gang of Secrets", when the holder is in a powered up form they can turn back to their basic transformation form without saying the phrase and back to their civilian form after saying the detransformation phrase.
When powered up with a potion, heroes tend to go by alternate code names; for example, when using the space potion, Ladybug and Cat Noir are known as Cosmobug and Astrocat.
It is revealed in "Destruction" that the Ice Potion power up does not hinder the user from walking normally when not on ice.
In "Mayura", after Scarlet Moth sends out his scarlet akumas, Adrien says "he must have found a way to boost his powers like we did". This suggests there is a potion that allows a Miraculous holder to conjure multiple superpowers at once.
Due to concerns that children might try to play with fire, broadcasters are hesitant about showing the fire power-up.

title: Miraculous potions
text:
Miraculous potions - Trivia
"Miraculous London" is the first time a potion is seen used by an unified holder, that being Cosmobugnoire, who unified the Ladybug and Cat Miraculous.
In "Mister Agreste" Ladybug used the Space Potion to fly from Paris to Brazil. According to her, she arrived there in an hour and fourteen minutes.
By contrast, a real world commercial flight from Paris to Brazil would take somewhere between eleven and twelve hours.

title: Miss Rose
text:
Miss Rose - Intro
Miss Rose is a character who was planned to appear in Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She is a magical spy living in London, England with her estranged sister.
As of 2024, it's currently unconfirmed if Miss Rose is still planned to appear in the Miraculous Ladybug franchise since her series "Double Rose" is still in development.

title: Miss Rose
text:
Miss Rose - Appearance
Miss Rose has long dark brown hair and brown eyes. She also wears hot pink lipstick.
For her spy attire, she wears a white polo shirt with a black necktie underneath her pink jacket. She wears darker pink trousers and dark brown heels. She also wears a pink fedora with a lighter pink brim.

title: Miss Rose
text:
Miss Rose - Personality
While it's unknown what her personality is, Miss Rose is depicted as a serious and no-nonsense individual in recent concept art for her television series.

title: Miss Rose
text:
Miss Rose - Abilities
By using a mysterious magical object, Miss Rose has the abilities of a magical spy. As seen in various concept art for her television series, Miss Rose wields a katana.

title: Miss Rose
text:
Miss Rose - Trivia
Since she's a spy, it's heavily implied "Miss Rose" is a codename for this character.
On April 17, 2021, it was announced via a Licensing Russia panel that Miss Rose would appear in "Miraculous London" and her own television series would serve as a spin-off for the special.
However, as of 2023, it was confirmed in a behind-the-scenes video for Ladybug & Cat Noir: The Movie that the Miss Rose television series is still in development. So, it's unknown if she still planned to appear in "Miraculous London" or if plans were later changed to make her television series separated from the franchise.
In some early pieces of concept art, Miss Rose would be depicted in a grayish-blue outfit instead of pink.
Assuming Miss Rose would appear in Miraculous Ladybug, she would be the second superhero to wield a sword after Ryuko.

title: Miraculouses/Movie
text:
Miraculouses/Movie - Intro
The Miraculouses are a variety of magical jewelry, possessing the ability to transform their wearers, with the help of the kwamis, into animal-themed superpowered beings.

title: Miraculouses/Movie
text:
Miraculouses/Movie - History
Like the jewels main counterparts, they were created at an unknown point in history, where people like Master Fu were tasked with guarding them. Throughout the centuries they were given to people who would become heroes that would protect the world from crisis and danger. While there were others that sought the jewels for their own desires and purposes, becoming supervillains putting the people and the world in danger.

title: Miraculouses/Movie
text:
Miraculouses/Movie - System
Usually, a Miraculous is assigned to an appropriate user with good intentions by a guardian, a human tasked with watching over the Miraculous and keeping them in a safe place when not being used. But when the world is in danger, the guardian and the needed kwamis usually work together to find the next destined holders but sometimes that isn't always the case as kwamis can go off to pick their owners themselves.

title: Miraculouses/Movie
text:
Miraculouses/Movie - Abilities
According to Master Fu, the magic of the Miraculouses are a power greater than death.
Transformations
This version of the jewels work almost the same as their original counterparts the holder has put on their assign jewel and say the trigger words to active the transformation words like "Spots On" and the deactivation words like "Spots Off" when they want to transform back. Except in addition, if the holder can't talk or if they're unwilling to transform the kwamis can activate the transformations themselves by entering their wielder's heart and leave them to change back.
In addition to the costume itself, some Miraculouses, while active, may alter the wearers physical characteristics, such as the color of their eyes and the shape of their pupils, the color, length and style of their hair, and/or even their skin pigment. Furthermore, the costume can also compensate for impairments; for example, Gabriel wears glasses, however the transformation gives him the ability to see clearly, by fixing their vision completely. Although the impairments return upon their detransformation.

title: Miraculouses/Movie
text:
Miraculouses/Movie - Abilities
Additionally, the Miraculous have the ability to magically disguise the identity of the wearer to human observers, regardless of how similar their civilian and costumed forms appear. However, even though the quantum masking is still in effect this version seems to be weaker when Hawk Moth tore half of Cat Noir's mask away he was able to recognize the hero as his son which may suggest that at least this version of the masks can be removed by enhanced Miraculous superpowers but whether it can be done by physical contact is unknown. Regardless, they (or at least in Cat Noir's case) will still retain characteristical changes until they detransform back.
If a Miraculous falls off or is removed from the holder while they are transformed, then they will immediately detransform back to their civilian self.
Enhanced Physical Abilities

title: Miraculouses/Movie
text:
Miraculouses/Movie - Abilities
An active Miraculous grants the wearer enhanced physical abilities, like strength and agility, as well as near invulnerability. Although, it is noteworthy that the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses provide their users with means to compensate. If a person is already a natural in a physical ability, the Miraculous will enhance it even further, such as Adrien being naturally fast and become even faster as Cat Noir.
Some of them also give the owners the abilities of the animals they are based on, like how Cat Noir has enhanced hearing and night vision.
Tools
Same as their counterparts, the Miraculous will provide the user with an omni-purpose tool which functions as a weapon, a communication device, and in some cases, a mode of transportation.
These tools are indestructible and can be used for defense. Each one is unique to the Miraculous and they come in a variety of forms, including toys, musical instruments, weapons, and more.
Superpowers

title: Miraculouses/Movie
text:
Miraculouses/Movie - Abilities
Possibly the greatest benefit of the Miraculouses is that each one grants a unique superpower that corresponds to the abstract concept that the respective kwami embodies. Some of the Miraculouses' powers follow the theme of the symbolism that animal represents, like the Ladybug Miraculous, with the power of creation, having the superpower Lucky Charm and ladybugs are symbols of good luck. The kinds of powers a Miraculous has aren't limited to the animal theme, though.
Kwami Dominion
A kwami is under the command of their Miraculous holder. When their Miraculous is not in use, a kwami can roam freely outside of the Miraculous. And yet, when active but awake inside their jewels but not worn by anyone the kwamis have greater influence making the jewels fly and levitate. While activated or if the jewels are stolen they can still communicate with their owners regardless and when transformed.

title: Miraculouses/Movie
text:
Miraculouses/Movie - Modes
The Miraculouses were made as various types of jewelry, ranging from earrings to necklaces to rings to brooches to hair combs to pocket watches and more. However, all of the Miraculouses have three distinct modes: charged, activated and camouflaged.
Charged
In its charged mode, which happens when the Miraculous is inhabited by its kwami, meaning that either the Miraculous isn't being used by anyone, or that its holder is transformed, the Miraculous takes on a more colorful, exotic design in this mode that better resembles the animal that it represents.
Camouflaged
In its camouflaged mode, which occurs when the kwami is outside the Miraculous, meaning that its possessed by a holder who is not currently transformed, the Miraculous takes on a more dull appearance.
Activated

title: Miraculouses/Movie
text:
Miraculouses/Movie - Modes
In its activated mode, a kwami isn't inhabiting the Miraculous and the Miraculous hasn't yet been claimed by an owner, meaning that if they have the Miraculous but have not accepted it yet, it will be in activated mode. When a Miraculous is in its activated mode, it looks similar to how it does in its charged mode, as it has not yet taken on a camouflaged form that matches the holders style, but with the animal symbol being dark or absent.
A Miraculous will also enter the activated mode if the wearer has spoken the transformation phrase, but before the kwami has actually entered the miraculous.
Additionally, when the miraculous holder is wearing multiple Miraculouses, but doesn't use all of them, the ones which are not used change into their activated mode.
Miraculouses

title: Miraculouses/Movie
text:
Miraculouses/Movie - Trivia
It's unknown if the miraculouses were created by a mage like their original counterparts.
But like their original counterparts it's still unknown what they're made out of material wise.
Also the kwamis, can freely switch between their kwami and jewel forms.

title: Miraculous tools/Movie
text:
Miraculous tools/Movie - Intro
Miraculous tools, also known as Miraculous weapons, are special omni-purpose tools that come with their respective Miraculouses. Whenever a Miraculous owner transforms, they possess a tool specific to whichever Miraculous they're wearing.

title: Miraculous tools/Movie
text:
Miraculous tools/Movie - Appearance
Similar to the original counterparts each tool is a different object, like Ladybug's yo-yo and Cat Noir's staff. These tools come in a great variety of different forms, including toys, musical instruments, and actual weapons. Usually, the tool is a size that can easily be carried by hand, and most tools can be worn when they aren't in use, such as Ladybug wrapping her yo-yo around her hips or Cat Noir having his staff attached to his back.
The color of each tool corresponds to the color scheme of the Miraculous, green for the turtle tool, blue for the peacock tool, etc. The only other difference is that some of the weapons can get an extra or greater details.

title: Miraculous tools/Movie
text:
Miraculous tools/Movie - Abilities
Mostly similar to their original counterparts the tools are used as weapons, being incredibly handy for both offense and defense. Some tools are capable of being used as a mode of transportation. An example of this is when Ladybug uses her yo-yo to swing from place to place, while Cat Noir can vault himself with his staff.
For some Miraculous owners, they need the tool to use their special superpower. For example, the Ladybug Miraculous owner using the yo-yo to purify the akuma. A Miraculous owner can call their weapon back to them from a certain distance and when the owner is in distress or danger like their Miraculous the weapons will vibrate and glow warning other holders of their endangered comrade.

title: Miraculous tools/Movie
text:
Miraculous tools/Movie - Weaknesses
Some Miraculous owners depending on their weapons have displayed the ability to mentally control their tools, but it depends on how strong their mental control is if the user's mind is wild and unfocused then the weapon will act on it's own accord or least through the kwami's influence. If the distance is too great between the holder and their weapon then the tool won't could to them until they are in a close enough range.

title: Miraculous tools/Movie
text:
Miraculous tools/Movie - Trivia
It's unknown if these versions of Miraculous tools can be destroyed with a Cataclysm or not.
Or if the danger warning only works with the users of the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses or all of them.

title: Mireille Caquet/History
text:
Mireille Caquet/History - Intro
Mireille Caquet is a student in Ms. Mendeleiev's class at Collège Françoise Dupont, and she is the KIDZ+ weather forecaster after winning a competition. She is very popular, getting a lot more votes than the other final contestant, Aurore Beauréal.

title: Mireille Caquet/History
text:
Mireille Caquet/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Stormy Weather", Mireille was a contestant in the KIDZ+ competition to find a new weather girl, with 5000 other contestants. She managed to become one of the two finalist, along with Aurore Beauréal. On the final day of the contest, the two girls rode a limousine to the TVi Tower. As they arrive, they both wave at their fans who cheer from them.
They then are seen with Alec Cataldi as introduced them both to the viewers watching at home. Mireille then watched as Alec told viewers to the viewers to text one for Aurore and two for her to determine a winner. When the voting was done, Alec announced that Mireille had won by a landslide with 82% of the votes, to her surprise.
With her trophy in hand, Mireille enters an elevator heading down. Before she can reach her designated floor, an akumatized Aurore, now the titular villain, appears. The villain then introduces herself and tells Mireille that she's the only weather girl who always gets the forecast right. The villain then attacks with her parasol and traps Mireille in the elevator, freezing it open with ice. Mireille then screams for help as the villain runs off.

title: Mireille Caquet/History
text:
Mireille Caquet/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Lady Wifi", Mireille is seen walking with another student at Collège Françoise Dupont, when Chloé Bourgeois bursted out of her limousine. Mireille then watched as Chloé told the student she was with that he look totally fab and as she insulted Aurore.
In "Dark Cupid", Mireille is seen outside of Collège Françoise Dupont, along with Aurore and some other girls, admiring a pillar with one of Adrien Agreste's new posters on it, with Mireille hugging the pillar. Just then Chloé and Sabrina Raincomprix arrive, with Chloé telling Mireille and the girls to stop gushing over Adrien as he now belonged to her.
Mireille then watched as Sabrina unrolled a poster that Adrien had unwittingly signed earlier. It is a copy of the one on the pillar, only it says, "To Chloé, the most wonderful girl of the universe and the love of my life", signed by Adrien. This causes Mireille and the girls to burst out crying.

title: Mireille Caquet/History
text:
Mireille Caquet/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Pixelator", while strolling the Champs-Élysées with Théo Barbot, Mireille and him were pixelated by the titular villain. She and Théo were then transferred to a white world inside of a photograph, the photographs themselves appearing on the villain's wall in his room. When Ladybug arrives, Mireille and Théo beg her for help and tell her how they got pixelated. Later, after Ladybug makes a deal with the villain about him freeing half the people in exchange for a private photo shoot with Jagged Stone, Mireille and Théo are transported out of the photograph.
In "Guitar Villain", Mireille is seen talking to two other students at Collège Françoise Dupont, when Adrien asked Marinette Dupain-Cheng for an autograph.
In "Reflekta", Mireille is seen with her class taking a class photograph in the courtyard of Collège Françoise Dupont. Vincent the photographer tells the class to look at the camera and say spaghetti, which everyone does. Mireille is then seen taking to four other students before the titular villain arrives.

title: Mireille Caquet/History
text:
Mireille Caquet/History - [[Season 1]]
Mireille then witnessed one of the students she was talking to be transformed into a duplicate of the villain, making her run away in fear. She then attempts to get out of the school, but the villain throws a bunch of lockers so that no one can leave the school. Mireille then tuns away and goes into the locker room, where she sits on the floor to hide from the villain.

title: Mireille Caquet/History
text:
Mireille Caquet/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Despair Bear", Mireille goes to Le Grand Paris for Chloé's party and is seen sitting down in a chair in the lobby.
In "Style Queen" and "Queen Wasp", Mireille is seen when she arrives at at the Grand Palais, where the fashion show of Gabriel Agreste takes place, with Alec as they both walk the red carpet. There Mireille sat on the front row, next to Alec and Clara Nightingale. She is also seen when the fashion show was interrupted by the first titular villain and in a recording of that on the news. She is also present when Gabriel Agreste arrives and hugs his son, Adrien.

title: Mireille Caquet/History
text:
Mireille Caquet/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Animaestro", Mireille attends the movie premiere of Thomas Astruc's animated movie about Ladybug and Cat Noir. She is seen walking the red carpet with Alec as they arrive. Later, Mireille is seen talking to other guest at the event various times throughout the episode, such as Thomas Astruc.
In "Ikari Gozen", Mireille and Aurore announce Paris' annual Friendship Day on TV, where two people picked at random will go on an adventure across Paris in order to find where a celebrity is hiding, with this year's celebrity being Adrien. Mireille then further explains that once she pushes the button on her tablet, a riddle will be sent to everyone that will give them a clue to their first location where they will meet their new friend and from there, the duos must find more clues in order to eventually find out where Adrien is.
She then joins Adrien and Aurore as the first pushes a button that releases all the riddles. At the Musée Grévin (which is the secret hideout of Adrien during the game), Mireille watched as Aurore thanked Adrien for his participation. Then Adrien makes a statue pose next to the statue of his father, making Mireille and Aurore giggle at him.

title: Mireille Caquet/History
text:
Mireille Caquet/History - [[Season 3]]
While Mireille was having a drink, the Akuma alert goes off in the museum, making her stop what she was doing and exit the building. Later when it was safe, she returned to the museum and posted for a picture with the winners of the game: Alya Césaire and Wayhem, along with Adrien, Aurore, and the bodyguard.

title: Mireille Caquet/History
text:
Mireille Caquet/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Sole Crusher", Mireille is present when Mr. Damoclès enters Science classroom with Zoé Lee. Mireille then watched as the principal introduced Zoé to the entire class after threatening to call her stepfather, Mayor André Bourgeois, if she wasn't admitted into school.
In "Hack-San", after Robostus sends out a signal to all Parisians with a message sent through their phones, Mireille is hypothesized offscreen. She is then sent by Robostus to the Musée Grévin, positioning herself where her statue used to be. There after Scarabella and Cat Noir arrive, Mireille unfreezes from his position. She then pulls out her phone and moves towards the heroes.
Mireille is commanded to seize the Ladybug and the Cat Miraculouses, along with the other high-profile hypothesized individuals. As she moved in on Cat Noir, she was knocked back by the hero's staff various times. Mireille then got back on her feet and watched as Scarabella and Cat Noir delivered themselves to Robostus. Later, Mireille is freed from Robostus' control by Scarabella's Miraculous Scarabella.

title: Mireille Caquet/History
text:
Mireille Caquet/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Perfection", Mireille goes to Liberty for Kitty Section's performance of Adrien's love song to Marinette. There she is seen standing next to Aurore and behind to Marc Anciel as she witnessed Marinette panic and run away after she tried to confess her feelings to Adrien.

title: Miraculous on Instagram/Timeline
text:
Miraculous on Instagram/Timeline - Intro
This page covers the sequence of events that occurred on "Miraculous on Instagram" in the form of a timeline.
The content posted on the character Instagram pages are referenced in the Quantic Universe, with a few images starting to appear in Season 4 episodes of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. However, despite the posts were uploaded in 2019 and 2020 in the real world, the dates have no direct correlation to the timeline of the TV series.

text:

Chloé unprivated her Instagram account and created her first public post in her bedroom.
Alya and Marinette hang out with each other around Paris. While visiting Collège Françoise Dupont, she posted a selfie with Marinette at the school entrance. She revealed in the caption that the girls have been reading all the comments from her first post; her new followers wanted Marinette to join Instagram.
Marinette created an Instagram account and uploaded her first post in her room.
A user commented: "why are you only following alya 🥺🥺🥺"
Marinette replied: I'm looking for recommendations! I mean... I guess I could follow Chloe......."

title: Mister Agreste
text:
Mister Agreste - Intro
"" is a season 6 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 9th written and produced episode of season 6. It is also the 140th written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Mister Agreste
text:
Mister Agreste - Synopsis
Disney Channel
Marinette finds it increasingly difficult to keep a secret from Adrien… and the arrival of a supervillain who looks just like her old enemy won't help!
Gloob
When they ask for Adrien's consent to erect a statue in memory of his father, Gabriel Agreste, Marinette finds it increasingly difficult to keep her secret from Adrien.
TF1
While Adrien must give his consent for a new statue to be erected in memory of his father, Gabriel Agreste, Marinette is finding it increasingly difficult to hide from him the secret she is protecting about the latter... And the arrival of a supervillain in the image of his old enemy will not help him!
Disney+
Ladybug and Cat Noir face a larger-than-life villain.

title: Mister Agreste
text:
Mister Agreste - Plot
In a flashback that takes place sometime after the events of "Migration", Ladybug and Cat Noir, dressed in their original suits, observe as Luka Couffaine bids farewell to his twin sister Juleka and their mother.
He is preparing to leave Paris with Jagged Stone and Penny to go into exile in Rio de Janeiro.
Luka believes this is necessary to protect Ladybug and Cat Noir, as he knows their secret identities and cannot risk being akumatized by Monarch, which could reveal their secrets.
Cat Noir expresses doubt about Luka's reasoning, but when Ladybug confesses that Luka told her he knows who she is under the mask, Cat Noir becomes anxious.
When he asks about his own identity, Ladybug denies having been told who he is, explaining that knowing would put both of them at risk.
Nonetheless, Cat Noir is still worried that Luka might know his true identity.
Cat Noir decides to follow Luka's taxi to the airport.
After reverting to his identity as Adrien, he tries to stop Luka from boarding his flight to Brazil.
Despite Adrien's attempts to persuade him to stay, Luka insists that remaining in Paris would only endanger Ladybug and Cat Noir further, reducing their chances of defeating Monarch.

title: Mister Agreste
text:
Mister Agreste - Plot
He hints that he does know Adrien is Cat Noir.
In a final plea, Adrien urges Luka to reconsider, but Luka expresses his confidence in both Adrien and Ladybug.
He assures them that he will return once Monarch is no longer a threat before boarding his flight.
Marinette is seen running around the Liberty, searching for Adrien while Gabriel's voice haunts her with a reminder of her promise to fulfill his last request: that no one, not even Adrien, knows about his evil actions.
When she returns to inside the ship, she is back in her upgraded suit as Ladybug.
The reporters from her earlier interview in "Miraculous London" ask her the same questions about her final fight with Monarch at Gabriel's mansion and whether there is a connection between Gabriel and Monarch.
Overwhelmed, she flees and finds herself back in her pajamas, ducking into Luka's room as Gabriel calls out to her again.
Luka then appears from under the bed sheets to reassure Marinette that she can tell him anything.
Stressed, Marinette confesses that she lied to everyone: Gabriel was Monarch all along.

title: Mister Agreste
text:
Mister Agreste - Plot
However, the comforting presence of Luka suddenly shifts to Adrien, who is furious to discover that his own father has been the madman terrorizing Paris and the world.
Enraged by Marinette's deception, Adrien declares that their relationship is over.
At that moment, one of Chrysalis' Ultrakumas flies over and goes into Adrien's ring, akumatizing him instantly, despite Marinette's desperate attempt to stop it.
Suddenly, Marinette wakes up back in her own bed, drenched in cold sweat and shock, realizing that the entire ordeal was a nightmare—one of several she has experienced recently, as Tikki has noticed.
Even worse, Marinette is so stressed that she stumbles over her words, saying "evilize" instead of "energized" before correcting herself.
Nevertheless, when she looks at her picture of Adrien, she seems to relax, feeling comforted as she transfers a kiss from her lips to the picture with her fingers.

title: Mister Agreste
text:
Mister Agreste - Plot
At his mansion, Adrien is having breakfast with Nathalie, but appears to have lost his appetite. Nathalie notices, realizing that the meeting he's going to with her today is probably bringing up some painful memories, and offers to go alone, but Adrien insists since he is Gabriel's son, and assures her he'll have Marinette to support him.
At the Dupain-Cheng Bakery, Marinette is having breakfast with Sabine, but again finds herself mincing her words when she says "Monarch" instead of "from me" before catching and correcting herself, and even calling Tom "Senti-Dad" before correcting herself to "Super Dad", leaving Sabine puzzled and Tom not even taking notice. However, as Marinette boards her electric scooter, Tikki attempts to convince her to tell Adrien the truth as the guilt is eating away at her. Only after Marinette minces her words again does Tikki point out that if she doesn't, she'll probably tell him the truth by accident. Realizing Tikki is right, Marinette calms down and tries to focus, assuring Tikki she's got this as they drive to the Agreste Mansion.
In his room, Adrien is looking at Froggy again as he has it play the recording from Gabriel with his knock-knock joke.

title: Mister Agreste
text:
Mister Agreste - Plot
Plagg takes notice and asks him what's wrong.
Adrien confesses that, as Cat Noir, he was obligated to help Ladybug defeat Monarch, but instead, his father sacrificed himself to end Monarch's threat forever, and Adrien can't comprehend how the man who made his life so miserable also gave up his life to save the world from Monarch.
Plagg reminds him that Ladybug told him all the details of her final clash with Monarch and what happened, but Adrien feels like she's not telling him the whole story and should have been there when she faced Monarch.
It is then he realizes that Plagg was there since Ladybug unified the Ladybug and Cat Miraculous to become Bug Noire, so he must know what actually happened.
Knowing Adrien is right as he was supporting Marinette during her final clash with Gabriel as Bug Noire, Plagg is able to hide the truth by saying he was in the Cat Miraculous at the time in a magical energy state, but the details are a bit blurry for him to remember.
Thankfully, before Adrien can press the issue further, Marinette arrives, but again, suffers a mincing with her words when she asks if he's ready to "deceive" before correcting herself to "leave".

title: Mister Agreste
text:
Mister Agreste - Plot
Not catching the slip-up, Adrien assures her he is now that she's here, but as he heads out, Marinette has a look of sadness on her face before following.
At City Hall in the Hôtel de Ville, Marinette, Adrien, and Nathalie are with Mayoress Bustier and architect Théo Barbot as, due to the recent vandalism to the Statue of Gabriel Agreste, Théo plans on creating a new, and larger, one to place outside City Hall, with the funding already supplied by Tomoe Tsurugi and Tsurugi Industries.
Théo seems to be very engrossed in his praise and worship of Gabriel, due to the fact he explains that he worked with Gabriel on several projects before his passing and was like a mentor to him.
Adrien scornfully attempts to explain to Théo about how miserable Gabriel made his life with keeping him from loving Marinette, which does cause Théo to be taken aback.

title: Mister Agreste
text:
Mister Agreste - Plot
Marinette also tries to convince Adrien otherwise, but when she nearly minces her words again with saying "moth", Nathalie shoots her an angry glare to remind her to keep her mouth shut about the real truth regarding Gabriel, and Marinette quickly corrects herself with reminding Adrien that his father did save Ladybug, but Adrien reminds her of how bland and tasteless Gabriel's pancakes were, but this only causes Théo to praise Gabriel more with being a good cook as well.
Fed up, Adrien tells Théo he needs to think the plan over, and departs with Marinette, while Nathalie tells him and Mayoress Bustier that they will get back to them on the final decision for the statue.
Outside the Mayor's office, as Adrien heads down the stairs, Marinette tries to catch up to him and ask him what's going on.
Adrien knows that Marinette met his father before, and asks how he could be both the man that saved Paris and the man that tried to keep them separated.

title: Mister Agreste
text:
Mister Agreste - Plot
Although Marinette reassures him that Gabriel loved Adrien in his own way, Adrien is unconvinced, still upset at the harm he caused to the two of them, and hearing Théo talk his mouth off with speaking so highly of Gabriel is like they are talking about someone else, and not the man Adrien knew his father as, wondering if that makes him a bad son.
Marinette assures him is doesn't and he's done nothing wrong, but Adrien still believes that if he had been there to help Ladybug against Monarch, he could have saved Gabriel.
Marinette lets slip the same thing she told him as Bug Noire in that there's nothing he could've done to save his father, but Adrien asks her how could she know that since neither of them were there when it happened.
Before Marinette has a chance to realize she nearly broke her promise to Gabriel and told Adrien the truth, Nathalie intervenes and tells Adrien they should head home.
Marinette and Adrien nod in agreement and head for the exit, but Nathalie glares after Marinette, deeply troubled by how Marinette almost broke their promise to Gabriel to keep the truth buried.

title: Mister Agreste
text:
Mister Agreste - Plot
When they return to the Agreste Mansion, Placide lets Adrien in. Once he's inside, Marinette tells Nathalie out of earshot of Adrien that she can't continue hiding the truth. Nathalie, however, reminds her that they made a promise to Gabriel, and there's no turning back now. Marinette will have to endure the situation. Later, at home, while practicing her guitar with Luka through the Zoo application, Marinette meets his new girlfriend from Brazil, named Irupé. Overwhelmed by her emotions, Marinette finally decides that she will travel to Rio to see Luka in person.

title: Mister Agreste
text:
Mister Agreste - Plot
As he waits for Marinette, Luka reflects on the time he was given the Snake Miraculous again after Marinette restored it by using the information in the recovered Miraculous Grimoire to restore all the Miraculous that Monarch took from her. He confesses to her that he is leaving Paris for Rio because he fears his joy at seeing her and Adrien together could turn into jealousy. He worries that this jealousy might lead him to be akumatized by the new wielder of the Butterfly Miraculous and turn against them. Consequently, as Viperion, he apologizes for what he is about to do next. He tells Marinette he is going to lie to protect her and activates his ability, Second Chance. During the replay, he tells Marinette that he has a new girlfriend in Rio, which makes her happy for him.

title: Mister Agreste
text:
Mister Agreste - Plot
After his flashback, Cosmobug arrives and transforms back into Ladybug. She takes Luka to a secluded spot under an open umbrella by the supply shack to keep them hidden. Sass, the kwami of the Snake Miraculous, asks his Guardian what’s wrong. Ladybug requests the Snake Miraculous from Luka, and recalling Sass into the bracelet, he hands it over. Ladybug unifies Sass with Tikki, transforming into Viperbug. As she prepares to use Second Chance herself, she confesses to Luka that Gabriel is Monarch and reveals her struggle to keep this secret from Adrien and how much it is tearing her apart inside. She fears he could be akumatized if he learned the truth. After listening to her, Luka acknowledges that he knows some things as well and asks Marinette for the Ladybug Miraculous so he can help fix the situation. However, Viperbug resists his request. Despite his pleas, she activates Second Chance. After the reset, she divides the Miraculous and hands Sass and the Snake Miraculous back to Luka, encouraging him to be happy with Irupé and not to worry about her, which he accepts.

title: Mister Agreste
text:
Mister Agreste - Plot
Back in Paris, Mayoress Bustier informs Théo that Nathalie and Adrien have refused to authorize the construction of the new statue of Gabriel. Upon hearing this, Théo becomes enraged and storms out of the Hôtel de Ville, muttering that Adrien is an ungrateful son. One of Chrysalis' Ultrakumas then infects the model of the Gabriel statue he's holding. As Chrysalis contacts him and offers him a chance for revenge, he accepts. Initially hesitant to choose a name, he is encouraged by her to ask to be called "Mister Agreste," and she grants his wish. As Théo gets akumatized, he is engulfed in the purple ether of Transmission, which encases him inside a giant living clay statue of Gabriel, and it storms off to find Adrien.

title: Mister Agreste
text:
Mister Agreste - Plot
When Adrien and Plagg see the living statue of Gabriel approaching, Nathalie enters the room to try to get Adrien to safety. However, the statue bursts through the wall, burying her under debris. Horrified, Adrien hides in his bathroom, transforms into Cat Noir, and rescues Nathalie, urging her to escape. When she warns him that Adrien is still trapped inside his room after he fled into the bathroom, he reassures her that he'll free him and tells her to save herself. Nathalie manages to escape while Cat Noir tries to confront the statue but struggles, still bitter and upset about how Gabriel had changed over the years—transforming from Papa Corn to the cold and heartless man he had become before sacrificing himself to rid the world of Monarch. Realizing he needs help, Cat Noir opens his staff and uses the Miraculous Call to contact Ladybug for assistance.
Before she can arrive, the statue buries him under debris at a subway entrance, leaving his hand with the Cat Miraculous exposed.
The statue attempts to claim it, forcing Adrien to revert back to his civilian form.

title: Mister Agreste
text:
Mister Agreste - Plot
Fortunately, before the statue can discover his identity, he manages to crawl through the debris and escape into the subway, much to the statue's annoyance.
Ladybug arrives to fight the statue, but like Cat Noir, her attempts to damage it only result in its severed parts regenerating.
This leads her to wonder whether the statue is invincible.
She summons several Lucky Charms for assistance, starting with a rapier sword and ending with a megaphone.
Unfortunately, she is soon captured, but just before the statue can claim the Ladybug Miraculous, Adrien emerges and commands the statue to stop.
The statue decides to delay claiming the Ladybug Miraculous to speak with Adrien.
As Adrien confronts the statue, he expresses how Gabriel has ruined his life.
Ladybug encourages him to use her dropped Lucky Charm to continue his speech.
Adrien poses questions to the statue that address his father's controlling behavior: Why did he want to control Adrien's every move?
Why was he always traveling the world instead of staying with Émilie while she was sick?
Why did he not want Adrien to meet his grandparents, attend school like everyone else, or fall in love with Marinette?

title: Mister Agreste
text:
Mister Agreste - Plot
The most piercing question he asks is why Gabriel stopped being "Papa-corn" and became a cold, heartless statue.
As he voices his bottled-up anger, Mister Agreste begins to stop moving and starts to dry and crack, literally shattering Théo's praise and worship of Gabriel as he hears how severely Gabriel has harmed Adrien's life.
By the time Adrien has expressed all his pent-up emotions, the statue has cracked so much that it ultimately crumbles, freeing Théo and the Ultrakuma.
Ladybug catches both of them before they hit the ground and gives Théo a Magical Charm to remind him that it is better to idolize the ideas Gabriel left behind rather than the man himself for Theo will never truly know him or anyone else.
Theo confidently gives Ladybug the Cat Miraculous and she has Plagg return the Cat Miraculous to Cat Noir.
She thanks Adrien for showing a great deal of courage for letting go of his anger toward his father and that she wouldn't have made it without him and they share a "Pound it!" fist bump, and she leaves.

title: Mister Agreste
text:
Mister Agreste - Plot
Later, the two Miraculous users meet at their usual hangout spot overlooking the Eiffel Tower. Cat Noir apologizes for not being in the right state of mind during their latest battle. Ladybug reassures him that it's all good, and they head home to their respective residences. When Adrien returns home, he reverts back to his civilian form and while Plagg tries to reassure him as he finally let his feelings about his father out, Adrien knows that how he feels won't bring his father back nor will it help him figure out who he was either and realizes that he will have to accept the painful truth that he will have unanswered questions regarding his father. As he walks away, Plagg looks after him with concern. Meanwhile, Marinette returns home and transforms back from Ladybug. Looking out over her balcony towards the Notre-Dame Cathedral, she calls Adrien to see if he's alright. After he assures her he's okay and hangs up, Marinette voices her concerns to Tikki about how Nathalie was right: she made her choice and now has to stick to it—there's no turning back.

title: Mister Agreste
text:
Mister Agreste - Plot
In the stinger, we return to the moment when Cosmobug approached Luka to speak with him. Ladybug takes Luka to a nearby building for a private conversation. Meanwhile, at the side of the beach, Irupé watches them while holding an açaí bowl. Neither Ladybug nor Luka were aware that Irupé had seen them. She is accompanied by her own Kwami-like partner, Maino'li, and they both begin to wonder what secrets Luka might be hiding from them if he knows Ladybug.

title: Mister Agreste
text:
Mister Agreste - Plot developments
More about Luka after he left Paris to go to Brazil is revealed following "Migration" and again in "Re-creation":
Before he boarded the plane to Brazil to be out of Monarch's reach, Adrien was the last person he spoke to, confirming to him that he knows his identity as Cat Noir.
After Monarch's defeat when Ladybug gave him the Snake Miraculous permanently, Luka tried to return it to her (as Marinette), as he was planning to go to Brazil again.
The reason why he decided to return to Brazil, is because of fear of being akumatized by Chrysalis due to still being in love with Marinette. He is afraid that the joy he feels for her and Adrien would turn into jealousy and ruin their friendship.
Despite these confessions, he does it using Second Chance, rewinding time and instead lied to her about having a girlfriend in Brazil.
In other words, Luka didn't want to act like Gabriel: being jealous nor angry towards Marinette and Adrien over something he doesn't have anymore and do anything as his akumatized alterego to break them up or put them in danger just so he could be happy which is exactly what Gabriel tried to do.

title: Mister Agreste
text:
Mister Agreste - Plot developments
And if he did Luka would be feeling extremely guilty over what he had done most likely Alya would be feeling the same thing if she exposed Marinette back in "Lady Wifi".
The only way for Luka to be safe or at least halfway involves the duo's identities being erased from his mind so this episode foreshadows Cat Noir getting that power in "Revelator" and doing just that to Alya.
This episode also gives a little more insight to the identities of Miraculous holders in Luka's case; usually when a Miraculous holder has their identity exposed to anyone, even a villain, they have to surrender their jewel so it doesn't get stolen, but depending on how their identity comes out, they not only run the risk of exposing themselves to one enemy but to any and all future enemies.
Which also gives another advantage to the Butterfly Miraculous holder when used for evil, if the victim goes through something traumatizing, has unanswered questions, unresolved or lingering feelings and they can't vent properly, then the target becomes easier to akumatized or another way they can vent their feelings safely is that the victim has to be out of the Butterfly Miraculous holder's sensing range.

title: Mister Agreste
text:
Mister Agreste - Plot developments
Luka has asked a girl named Irupé to be his pretend girlfriend in front of Marinette, so that she wouldn't worry about him and think he had moved on from her.
This is the first time Marinette vents her problems involving her alterego to someone, aside from Master Fu, Alya nor Tikki; this time is Luka.
Uniquely all her problems stem around or involve Adrien not his alterego Cat Noir:
In romantics aside from being in love with someone else and their identities Ladybug couldn't tell Cat Noir else why they couldn't be together until "Cat Blanc", except for mentioning of her fear of his akumatization in "Strikeback". Also she had no way else to prove it and even if she did tell him there's no guarantee he'd believe her or he'd be devastated at the weight of the truth leading to his akumatization.
During Ladybug's guardianship, she was consumed by stress, fear and Gabriel's relentless hunting that caused her to push everyone away including Cat Noir and if she didn't there wasn't much else either one could do turning to a long game of patience.

title: Mister Agreste
text:
Mister Agreste - Plot developments
The knowledge of Gabriel's secrets, if/when Adrien learns everything nor it gets out to the world, it might be difficult for Ladybug and the others to prove Adrien's innocence.
Marinette unifies the Ladybug and Snake Miraculous, becoming Viperbug.
This becomes the first new unification of season 6.
Her reason to do so mirrors that of Luka using Second Chance after Marinette gave him back his Miraculous, as both did that to vent what they are feeling to each other without that knowledge becoming permanent.
Both also rewound time when the other tried to stop them, with them wanting to help the other: Viperion rewound time when Marinette tried to stop him as she tried to prevent Luka from leaving Paris because of his feelings for her; meanwhile, Viperbug rewound right when Luka tried to convince her to give him a chance to fix her problems.
Luka becomes the first person to learn the truth about Gabriel Agreste being Monarch, aside from those who already knew. He is also the first person Marinette tells herself.
Alya would briefly discover this in "Revelator," although the episode aired out of order.

title: Mister Agreste
text:
Mister Agreste - Plot developments
After Luka learns the truth, he is shocked by the revelation but does not hold it against Marinette. Instead, he asks her to lend him the Ladybug Miraculous, believing he can fix everything. However, Marinette interprets his request as a sign that it was a mistake to come talk to Luka, and she rewinds time before he can say anything else.
This is a completely different reaction compared to Alya's, as she got upset with Marinette for keeping it a secret from her, especially since she would had to lie to Adrien as well. However, their situations are not the same, as Luka, besides knowing Marinette's identity as Ladybug, also knows Adrien's identity as Cat Noir, giving him a much wider perspective.
Irupé, Luka's Brazilian friend and pretend girlfriend, is revealed to possess the Hummingbird Jewel, a necklace inhabited by Maino'li.
She also comes to learn that Luka knows Ladybug on a more personal level, suspecting that he may be a Miraculous holder.
This is the first time Chrysalis manages to obtain Ladybug or Cat Noir's Miraculous, this time being the Cat ring (albeit briefly).

title: Mister Agreste
text:
Mister Agreste - Plot developments
This would technically be the second time she obtained his Miraculous if the erased events of "Miraculous London" were to count.

title: Mister Agreste
text:
Mister Agreste - Trivia
At San Diego Comic Con 2025, two scenes from the episode were shown to attendees.
This episode was released first on the Brazilian channel Gloob, but was aired in English with Portuguese subtitles.
It's revealed that the original statue of Gabriel Agreste located on the Place des Vosges and made with the melted Alliance rings was vandalized, causing the request for a new statue made by Théo Barbot, who took the initiative to propose a much bigger statue of Gabriel and place it in front of the Hôtel de Ville.
The request for the statue was eventually denied by Adrien, who couldn't come to terms that his father had saved the world despite not being a good father to him.
However, it has been never revealed who was behind the vandalism, and why Gabriel statue was vandalized throughout the episode, but later revealed to be Adrien as Cat Noir in Lady Chaos because he saw him as a villain more than a hero (which he was right about), and hid the truth from Ladybug.
Théo is re-akumatized again after 132 episodes, being the second longest period, after Vincent Asa's 135 episodes between "Pixelator" and "Revelator".

title: Mister Agreste
text:
Mister Agreste - Trivia
Both his akumatizations involved imitating someone: Copycat had the same appearance and powers as Cat Noir, while Mister Agreste's appearance and behavior was modeled after Gabriel Agreste.
Marinette/Ladybug, Adrien/Cat Noir, Luka/Viperion, and Juleka are seen in their old designs, but in the new animation style.
Viperion's old outfit has a slight difference, with his pupils being snake-like instead of circular.
Unlike Chrysalis' other victims, Théo hesitates before saying his akumatized villain name.
References
This is the third time Marinette wakes up from a nightmare, Tikki is catapulted to the end of her bed, after "Sentibubbler" and "Conformation".
Cat Noir feels guilty after cataclysming Mister Agreste's left arm, paralleling what he had done to Monarch in "Destruction", not knowing that he was his father.
This is the second episode ever where an akumatized villain learns that the duo's powers can grant wishes, following "Robostus".
This is the third time Ladybug gets a weapon as a Lucky Charm object, following "Malediktator" and "Qilin".

title: Mister Agreste
text:
Mister Agreste - Trivia
Mister Agreste is very similar to Glaciator, with both civilians remaining untransformed after being akumatized, and instead being covered by a material which they can shoot as projectiles and regenerate when cut or destroyed.
This is the sixth episode that an akumatized villain holds a person captive, following "Stoneheart", "Robostus", "Gorizilla", "Catalyst", "Gang of Secrets" and "Sole Crusher".
This is the fifth time that Marinette/Ladybug got captured and held captive by an akumatized villain, following "Robostus", "Gorizilla", "Gang of Secrets" and "Sole Crusher".
If his intentions were to make a wish, then Luka is the third member of the Miraculers to attempt to use the ultimate wishing power following Ladybug in "Robostus" and Adrien in "Passion".
Yet, it's unknown how is a wish going to help out of this problem, best to worst case scenairo, is that Luka rewrites how Gabriel's identity gets exposed so either Marinette doesn't discover it alone, Gabriel comes clean himself or someone else exposes him. Thereby extension a real memory would have to come out so another would be implanted in creating an alerted or fake memory let alone an alerted event(s) in time.

title: Mister Agreste
text:
Mister Agreste - Trivia
Fourth, if Félix is counted back in "Emotion" but he wasn't apart of the team yet.
Or if making a wish wasn't Luka's intentions it could be that he only asked for Marinette's earrings to prevent her from rushing off in a huff, if he chose to reveal everything he knows to her or at least (Cat Noir's identity), in the hope so she could get a grasp upon how serious their problem is. So similar to Adrien with his family, Marinette knew there is a problem she didn't know the scope of it.
Allusions
The poses that Chrysalis assumes when she communicates telepathically with Théo are references to many famous statues: The Thinker by Auguste Rodin, David by Michelangelo, Woman Bitten by a Serpent by Auguste Clésinger, Psyche Revived by Cupid's Kiss by Antonio Canova, and the Mattei Athena by an unknown ancient sculptor.
When Mister Agreste crumbles and falls to pieces, the pose he assumes is based on the sculpture Écoute by Henri de Miller, symbolizing that Gabriel never listened to Adrien's true wishes.

title: Mister Agreste
text:

Throughout the episode, the Place de l'Hôtel de Ville has no vegetation, but during the scene of Marinette and Adrien talking near the door of the Hôtel de Ville, the landscape outside showed the square filled with trees.
Both Irupé and Luka don't seem to have belly buttons, despite all other characters having them in other episodes.
In the flashback, when Luka uses Second Chance, he does not say the power's name, despite having his original suit, meaning that he was yet to gain his adult powers.

To divide Sass, Viperbug only says "Divide", instead of "Sass, Divide" or "Scales Rest".
When Viperbug is venting to Luka, the camouflaged Snake Miraculous can still be seen on Luka's arm, despite him having already lent the Miraculous to Ladybug.
When Marinette walks past the bench in her balcony, more flowers form out of nowhere on the plant behind her head.

title: Mister Agreste/Transcript
text:
Mister Agreste/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: M'Lady, look. That boy is saying goodbye to his family. He's leaving his entire life behind!
Ladybug: There's no other way, Kitty. Luka Couffaine knows our secret identities.
Cat Noir: Are we really sure about that? Has he told you who you are?
Ladybug: (Beat) Yes.
Cat Noir: What about me? Did he tell you who I really am?
Ladybug: Of course not! I can never know who you are just like you can never know who I am.
Cat Noir: What if he's wrong about me?
(Luka's car drives away. Cat Noir extends his staff, lifting him off.)Cat Noir: Claws in!
(He detransforms and runs to Luka.)
Adrien: Hey, wait! Don't go Luka!
Luka: I have to go.
Adrien: Maybe you don't! You say you know Ladybug and Cat Noir's secret identities, but how can you be sure? Maybe you're wrong, and you're leaving for Brazil over nothing!
(Luka hugs Adrien.)
Luka: If I stay, I'll only make it harder for Monarch to be defeated by Ladybug. And you.
(A security guard comes over towards Adrien.)
Guard: Hey, you're not allowed to be here!
(Luka starts boarding the plane.)
Adrien: Luka, wait!
Luka: I have faith in you both, Adrien! I'll be back soon.

title: Mister Agreste/Transcript
text:
Mister Agreste/Transcript - Intro
[ Theme Song ] Nightmare Gabriel: (Voiceover) Remember your promise, Marinette.
Nightmare Marinette: (Calling out) Adrien?
(Nightmare Marinette runs back inside and is suddenly surrounded by reporters as Ladybug.)
Nightmare Reporter 1: Ladybug, can you explain what really happened? The fight took place at famous fashion designer Gabriel Agreste's home.
Nightmare Reporter 2: Is there a connection between Mr. Agreste and Monarch?
(Nightmare Marinette runs away, now back in her pajamas.)
Nightmare Gabriel: (Voiceover in furious emotions): Marinette!!!
(Nightmare Marinette runs into Luka's room and curls up. Nightmare Luka appears from under the sheets with his guitar.)

Nightmare Marinette: I don't know how much longer I can do this! I lied to everyone, Luka! I told them that Gabriel Agreste was a hero, but the truth is he was the supervillain! He was Monarch!
(Suddenly it's Nightmare Adrien that Nightmare Marinette is talking to.)
Nightmare Adrien: What? My father was Monarch?! How could you hide this from me Marinette?! You lied to me!! You and I are over!!!

title: Mister Agreste/Transcript
text:
Mister Agreste/Transcript - Intro
(An ultrakuma flies over and goes into Nightmare Adrien's ring, akumatizing him.)
Nightmare Marinette: NOOOOO!!!!!Tikki: Another nightmare, Marinette?
Marinette: Ughhh...not at all! I slept like a log! I feel completely evilized—I MEAN—energized!
Tikki: Are you really sure you're okay?
Marinette: It's fine! I'll be fine! It's all gonna be wrong—I MEAN—alright!
(Marinette looks to her picture of Adrien and smiles, kissing her fingers and pressing it.)Nathalie: Is everything okay, Adrien? You only ate the cheese.
(Adrien feeds Plagg behind his back.)
Adrien: I'm not that hungry, Nathalie.
(Nathalie places her hand over Adrien's.)
Nathalie: I understand. This morning's meeting is bound to bring up painful memories. I can go alone, if you want.

(Nathalie nods.)Sabine: Give Adrien a big kiss for me, okay?

(Marinette kisses her mother's cheek and runs out of the house.)
Marinette: Bye Mom, de-evilize you later!
Sabine: Huh?
Marinette: See you later. Love you.Tom: Say hi to Adrien for me!
(Tom hands her a bag of chouquettes.)

title: Mister Agreste/Transcript
text:
Mister Agreste/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Thanks for the chouquettes, Senti-Dad—I MEAN—Super Dad!
Tom: See you tonight, Sweetheart!Tikki: Marinette, maybe you should consider telling Adrien the truth about his father. It's eating away at you!
Marinette: No! I promised Monarch—I MEAN—Gabriel Agreste that I would say nothing.
Tikki: If you keep mixing up your words, you'll end up telling him everything by accident!
Marinette: (Beat) You're right, Tikki. I have to focus. But don't worry. I've got this.Froggy: Knock knock.
Adrien: Who's there?
Froggy: Papa.
Adrien: Papa who?
Froggy: Papa corn.
Plagg: What's wrong, Adrien? You're as pale as a camembert rind!
Adrien: I'm Cat Noir. I was supposed to stop Monarch, but instead my father sacrificed himself to defeat him. I can't believe he and the hero who saved the world were the same person. It's like I'm missing something key here to understand, like who he really was.
