Adrien: Yes, but I can feel she's not telling me everything. If only I'd been there when she faced Monarch. (Beat) Hold on Plagg! You were there! You can tell me what really happened!

title: Mister Agreste/Transcript
text:
Mister Agreste/Transcript - Intro
Plagg: I was there, I was there! I...was inside the black cat ring in a magical energy state, kinda like cheese in a fondue pot. Needless to say, things were a bit blurry.
(There is a knock at the door.)
Adrien: Come in!
(Marinette enters.)
Marinette: Delivery of chouquettes and Marinette!
Adrien: Just what I needed!
Marinette: Are you talking about me or the chouquettes?
(Adrien laughs and kisses Marinette on the cheek.)
Marinette: Are you ready to deceive—I MEAN—leave?!
(She embraces him.)
Adrien: I am, now that you're here.
(He eats a chouquette. Marinette makes a sad expression behind his back.)Mayor Bustier: This is the proposal selected by the city of Paris to replace the vandalized statue honoring Gabriel Agreste. Similar to the previous proposal, this statue will be financed by Mrs. Tsurugi and Théo Barbot will be in charge of creating the sculpture.
Théo: Upon reconsideration, the first statue at the Place des Vosges square didn't do justice to your father's presence. This one will be erected right outside city hall, and will be more than ten meters high!
Adrien: Ten meters? That sounds pretty high, don't you think?

title: Mister Agreste/Transcript
text:
Mister Agreste/Transcript - Intro
Théo: Of course not! Nothing's too high to illustrate the greatness of your father, Adrien! A man who was able to combine talent, presence, and courage!
Adrien: You knew my father?
Théo: Of course! I worked with him on several occasions. He was like a mentor to me. A man who defeated evil and poor taste with his nimble fingers! A man who—
Adrien: Tried to stop me from loving Marinette.
Théo: Sorry?
Adrien: My father might've been a hero, but I think you're seeing him as greater than he really was.
(Théo is taken aback.)
Marinette: Your moth—
(Nathalie glares at Marinette.)
Marinette: DAD! Your dad did save Ladybug.
Adrien: Don't you remember the taste of his pancakes, Marinette? As dry and rigid as him.
Théo: Are you telling me that he was also a good cook? Such a model father!
Adrien: Sorry, I need to think about it.
(Adrien leaves the room, with Marinette following behind him.)
Théo: What about my statue? All good? You agree to it?
Nathalie: We will get back to you with our answer.Marinette: Wait up!
(She catches up with him.)
Marinette: Adrien, what's going on?

title: Mister Agreste/Transcript
text:
Mister Agreste/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: Marinette, you knew my father. Can you believe that he could've been both the man that saved Paris and the man who tried to keep us from loving each other?
Marinette: I'm sure he loved you, in his own way.
Adrien: Even though I loved him too, I can't just forget the harm he caused us! And now, hearing the way everyone talks about him, I feel like they're talking about someone else. I refuse to see him the way everyone else does! Does that make me a bad son?
Marinette: No, of course not! You've done nothing wrong!
Adrien: If only I'd been there. Maybe I could have saved him.
Marinette: There's nothing you could have done.
Adrien: How do you know that? Neither of us were there.
Marinette: Adrien, I...
Nathalie: Let's go home, Adrien.
(Marinette and Adrien nod, and walk off together, Nathalie glaring at Marinette.)Marinette: If you want, I can cancel my liar lesson—I MEAN—guitar lesson!
Adrien: No, no. Go ahead. Say "hi" to Luka for me.
(Marinette begins to leave, but once she sees Nathalie she runs back up to her.)
Marinette: I can't take it anymore! We have to tell Adrien the truth!
(Nathalie looks around and then takes Marinette by the arm, further away from the mansion.)

title: Mister Agreste/Transcript
text:
Mister Agreste/Transcript - Intro
Nathalie: Have you lost your mind? You want to tell him that you're Ladybug?
Marinette: What do you mean?
Nathalie: Only Ladybug would know that Gabriel Agreste was Monarch! Not Marinette Dupain-Cheng!
Marinette: Well, I could tell him everything as Ladybug.
Nathalie: And let him figure out that I was Monarch's accomplice? We have determined a truth. We're sticking to it. You need to grin and bare it, Marinette. It's too late to go back!
(Nathalie re-enters the mansion.)
Adrien: Everything okay, Nathalie?
Nathalie: Yes. Marinette simply thought she lost the keys to her scooter.
(Adrien nods and heads up to his room. Nathalie's smile fades once he leaves.)Luka: Try strumming the strings with your fingers, Marinette. You don't need to hit them.
Marinette: I swear I sounded better when I practiced yesterday. I'll akumatize again—TRY again. I'll try again!
(A girl named Irupé sits next to Luka.)
Girl: Bom dia, Marinette! How are you?
Marinette: Hey, Irupé. Tudo bem. Things are great. Why wouldn't they be? (laughs)
Irupé: I'm going for a swim.
(She kisses Luka on the cheek, takes off the shirt she has over her bathing suit, and throws it at Luka.)

title: Mister Agreste/Transcript
text:
Mister Agreste/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: You two make such a cute couple. There's clearly a Monarch.
Luka: Monarch?
Marinette: A spark! I meant there's a spark!
(She grins painfully.)
Luka: You can talk to me if something's wrong, you know, Marinette.
Marinette: No! That's the thing! I can't tell you! (She cries dramatically.) Unless...of course! I could totally tell you! I'll be right there!
Luka: What? Like, now? In Brazil?
Marinette: Yes. I'll be there in an hour and fourteen minutes. Don't go anywhere. I'm on my way.
(Marinette ends the call. Irupé returns.)
Irupé: Shall we get breakfast? I could go for a big açaí bowl!
Luka: Uhhh...No thank you. I'd rather be alone for a while.
(He begins to strum his guitar.)
Irupé: Luka, I agreed to be your pretend girlfriend to put up the pretense, but if it's hurting you, don't you think it would just be easier if you told Marinette the truth?

(Luka looks down sadly.)Luka: I'm sorry. I can't accept it.
(He opens his hand which is holding the Snake Miraculous.)
Marinette: What? But you're the only one I can entrust with it!
Luka: I'm heading back to Brazil, Marinette.

title: Mister Agreste/Transcript
text:
Mister Agreste/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: But Monarch's been defeated! There's no need to go—
Luka: There's a new butterfly villain. I don't wanna risk being akumatized and revealing your and Cat Noir's secret identities.
Marinette: This is crazy! Why would you get akumatized?
(Luka looks at her sadly.)
Luka: Sass, scales slither.
(He transforms.)
Marinette: What are you doing?
Viperion: Marinette, the truth is...(He deploys Second Chance.),,,I'm not leaving because of the new butterfly villain.
Marinette: But then...why are you leaving?
Viperion: You and Adrien finally listened to your inner melodies, and today, they're forming a beautiful symphony. I'm happy for you two...but I'm still in love with you Marinette. You're so radiant, so strong. How could I stop loving you? If I stay, I'm scared this pain will turn the joy I feel about seeing you together into jealousy and ruin our friendship. That's why I'm leaving.
Marinette: Luka...
Viperion: It's going to be hard being away from you.
Marinette: Please, stay! Adrien and I will make sure not to be too close when you're around! Just...please, don't go!
Viperion: I apologize in advance for what I'm about to do.
Marinette: What are you about to do?

title: Mister Agreste/Transcript
text:
Mister Agreste/Transcript - Intro
Viperion: I'm about to lie to you. For the good of the three of us.
Marinette: No, no, don't do that!
(Viperion reverses time.)
Marinette: Then, why are you leaving?
Viperion: Because...I've met an awesome girl in Brazil!
Marinette: You have? That's amazing!
Viperion: I'll be your friend forever, Marinette. You can always count on me.
(They embrace.)Irupé: Luka? What did you tell Marinette?
Luka: I couldn't bring myself to tell her anything.

(She kisses him on the cheek and leaves.)Adrien: Nathalie, I've thought about it. And I think I'd feel more comfortable if there were no statue.

Nathalie: Hello, madam mayor? Cosmobug: Power down!

(He takes off his bracelet and gives it to Ladybug who puts it on.)

title: Mister Agreste/Transcript
text:
Mister Agreste/Transcript - Intro
(She transforms into Viperbug and instantly deploys Second Chance.)

And I'll never, ever, EVER let anyone hurt him! I have to keep this promise and hide the truth from him, even if it burns my lips and my heart every day until the end of time. Do you think I did the right thing?

title: Mister Agreste/Transcript
text:

Luka: Marinette, I love you! You're the strongest person I've ever met but this time I'm the one who needs to protect you! (He grabs her wrist.) You have to trust me!

(Viperbug reverses time.)

title: Mister Agreste/Transcript
text:

title: Mister Agreste/Transcript
text:

title: Mister Agreste/Transcript
text:

Cat Noir: Cataclysm! (Destroys the projectile into tiny pieces.) You're just a giant talking statue!

title: Mister Agreste/Transcript
text:

Ladybug: (gasps) What did you do to Cat Noir!?

title: Mister Agreste/Transcript
text:
Mister Agreste/Transcript - Intro
(Ladybug and Mister Agreste start fighting, with her swinging around on her Yo-yo and him throwing pieces of himself which Ladybug dodges or cuts through. She then wraps her yo-yo around his arm and cuts it off, but he simply regenerates it back. He continues to throw pieces of himself but then she wraps her yo-yo around his waist and cuts his top half off, but he simply regenerates his body back again.)
Ladybug: Is he invincible or something? Lucky Charm! (She gets a fencing sword which she uses to slice through more pieces of Mister Agreste.) Lucky Charm! (She then gets a perfume bottle and dodges another attack.) Lucky Charm! (This time she gets a megaphone.) What am I supposed to do with all of these? Ahh! (Gets grabbed by Mister Agreste as he laughs and drops the megaphone.)
Chrysalis: (voice) Go ahead, take off her earrings. I want to see who Ladybug is!
Ladybug: No, no, no!
(As Mister Agreste goes to grab the earrings with a tiny hand, Adrien runs back up and sees what's happening.)
Adrien: Leave her alone! (He picks up a metal pipe and starts hitting Mister Agreste's foot with it.)
Mister Agreste: Adrien!
Chrysalis: (voice) Who cares? Seize Ladybug's earrings now!

title: Mister Agreste/Transcript
text:
Mister Agreste/Transcript - Intro
Mister Agreste: First I have to talk some sense into this unworthy son.
Chrysalis: (voice) Education first, I understand. But remember that we have a deal.
(Mister Agreste goes to grab Adrien, causing him to drop the metal pipe, run away, and fall over behind the lucky charm megaphone.)
Adrien: If you were such a good father then why didn't you want me to have any friends?!
Mister Agreste: (starts cracking) Huh? You don't know what you're saying, you ungrateful son.
Ladybug: Of course, how did I not figure it out sooner? Adrien Agreste, use the megaphone on the ground!
Adrien: (picks up the megaphone) Why did you want to control my every move?
Mister Agreste: What are you talking about?
Adrien: Why were you always traveling around the world instead of staying with mom when she was sick?!
(Mister Agreste continues to crack.)
Adrien: Why didn't you want me to meet my grandparents?
Mister Agreste: (continues to break apart while in disbelief) I... I didn't... he couldn't be like that...
Adrien: Why didn't you want me to go to school like everyone else? Why didn't you want me to be in love with Marinette?!

title: Mister Agreste/Transcript
text:

Mister Agreste: (continuing to break apart, with Théo's voice also being able to be heard.) You're lying, you're talking nonsense!
Adrien: Why did you stop being Papa-corn and become...this! (Mister Agreste breaks apart more.) A cold...(Mister Agreste breaks even more) ...heartless... (Mister Agreste falls to his knees.) ...statue!
(Mister Agreste stops moving and his head falls off. Adrien drops the megaphone as the giant statue begins to completely crumple apart, with Théo and the ultrakuma falling out and Ladybug being able to escape.)

[Superpower Sequences]Ladybug: Miraculous Ladybug!(She throws the megpahone into the air, and ladybugs shoot out from it, reverting the damage done by Mister Agreste.)
Théo (holding the Cat ring.) What have I done?

title: Mister Agreste/Transcript
text:

Ladybug: (Creates a magical charm and gives it to Théo.) Sometimes, it's better to put ideas rather than people on a pedestal, for you never truly know someone. Hurry and take it back to Cat Noir.

Ladybug: Thank you, Adrien. You've shown a great deal of courage, and I wouldn't have made it without you.
Ladybug and Adrien: Pound it! Cat Noir: Good thing you were there, m'lady. I wasn't at the top of my game today.

title: Mister Agreste/Transcript
text:

Tikki: At least you're no longer mixing up your words, Marinette.

title: Moddler
text:
Moddler - Intro
is the main antagonist of Miraculous World: Tokyo - Stellar Force and the animated spin-off series Miraculous Stellar Force. An alien from a distant planet, he is a supervillain seeking to obtain the fragments of the Stellar Matrix to use them for his own advantage.

title: Moddler
text:
Moddler - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Moddler is a tall alien with blue skin. He has eyes with slightly red sclera and black pupils, as well as long white hair and a black beard.
As Moddler
He wears full red armor with black panels on his arms, fingers, stomach, and legs, all partially covered by a white robe that conceals part of his body. He also wears a black mask connected to a green tube that splits in two and extends toward his back.

title: Moddler
text:
Moddler - Personality
Moddler is evil. He is extremely irritable and quick-tempered. He also has a calculating side, seeking to find weaknesses among the members of the Stellar Force to steal their fragments of the Stellar Matrix.

title: Moddler
text:
Moddler - Abilities
Moddler is a formidable opponent with the ability to change his appearance, such as taking on the form of a Japanese woman to deceive potential victims. He can create magma teleportation portals using both hands. By utilizing modules, Moddler is able to create molded minions that serve him, as well as kaijū, to spread chaos and destruction throughout Tokyo.

Moddler is the first extraterrestrial threat in the series, as most of the villains have either been Miraculous holders, akumatized citizens or Sentimonsters.

title: Mouse Miraculous
text:
Mouse Miraculous - Intro
The  is a coin pendant that, whenever Mullo inhabits it, transforms the wearer into a mouse-themed superhero with the power of Multiplication.
To activate the necklace, the user must speak the transformation phrase: "Get Squeaky". To deactivate the necklace, the user must speak the detransformation phrase, which is currently unknown.
The coin pendant is currently owned by Mylène Haprèle, who uses it to transform into Polymouse. It was previously stored in the Chinese Miracle Box and only lent out to her when the situation required it. But, as of "Re-creation", she now posseses the Miraculous permanently.

title: Mouse Miraculous
text:
Mouse Miraculous - Appearance
The Mouse Miraculous is a coin pendant, when Mullo inhabits it, is circular and dark gray with lighter gray markings and five pink mice in a circle on the front of it, attached by light orchid pink bead which is hung on a bead-colored string. If a minor is using the miraculous, the pendant necklace will start running out of power, it’s makes a beeping sound, and the pink mice start running out of power as an indication of how much time (one mice is equivalent to one minute) Mylène (or another Mouse Miraculous holder) has left.
In Season 6 onwards, the five pink mice changed to five pink pearls.
In its activated mode, the mouse symbols turn black.
In its camouflage mode, the pendant changes color and form depending on whose possession it's in:
In the possession of Mylène Haprèle, it appears as a jade pendant tied to a greenish blackish string.
In Season 6 onwards, the necklace is a gold coin with a blue string.
When it was worn by Gabriel Agreste, it was a silver pendant with lighter silver markings, attached by light silver bead which was hung on a dark silver string.
When it was worn by Chloé Bourgeois, it appeared as a golden pendant tied to a yellow string.

title: Mouse Miraculous
text:
Mouse Miraculous - Appearance
When it was worn by Marinette Dupain-Cheng, it appeared as a dark grayish brown Chinese coin tied to a black string.
In it's reforged ring form, it was a thick band with a circular surface, similar to the Cat Miraculous, inside of it was the symbol of the Mouse Miraculous which glowed grey. It used to sit on the thumb of Gabriel's left hand.

title: Mouse Miraculous
text:
Mouse Miraculous - Abilities
The Mouse Miraculous has the ability to transform its wielder into a mouse-themed superhero, granting its wielder incredible superhuman powers of speed, endurance, agility, stamina and strength. It also makes the user nearly invulnerable.

title: Mouse Miraculous
text:
Mouse Miraculous - Abilities
Its special weapon is an unbreakable skip rope, with each end of the rope appearing to have handles attached, which are black with large, silver-colored spheres.  This can be also be utilized as both a weapon, a communicator, and an object that can be used to breathe underwater. Its special superpower is named Multitude, which gives the user the ability to shrink down and create numerous clones of themselves for an indeterminate amount of time in order to obtain their goal, like defeating a villain and also shown in "Strikeback" the holder of the Mouse Miraculous can also split into smaller clones of themselves after they have already used it. It is also implied that it's possible that the timer starts only after the holder grows back to their original size, or that the countdown doesn't count while the miraculouses are unified. As long as the superpower isn't used by a minor, the wielder can remain transformed indefinitely. However, as soon as the superpower is used, the wielder loses power and the transformation wears off in about approximately five minutes. The pendant necklace also has the ability to give the wielder the costume they truly desire.

title: Mouse Miraculous
text:
Mouse Miraculous - History
Five thousand years ago, a mage successfully helped the kwamis to interact with humans by creating magic jewels, which were called Miraculouses. In order to repay the mage, and to live on the physical world alongside humans, the kwamis decided to help humanity by letting humans utilize their energy and powers through the Miraculous they were bonded with, which included Mullo and the Mouse Miraculous.
At some point in time, all of the knowledge about the Miraculouses and their powers was written down in code in a book called the Grimoire, with very few people knowing how to decipher the code. Miracle Boxes were also created at an unknown time to store the dormant Miraculouses. To protect and distribute Miraculouses, the Order of the Guardians was formed and existed for many years. Throughout its existence, guardians trained younger generations to keep a watchful eye over the Miraculouses and the Grimoire, which were placed in the guardians' temple.
Many Turtle holders throughout history used Mullo's power for good, like Lǎoshǔ in China, who started the legacy.

title: Mouse Miraculous
text:
Mouse Miraculous - History
172 years ago, after an disastrous event where a young Wang Fu used the Peacock Miraculous to create a sentimonster and his negative emotions and imaturity led to the creature rampaging through the temple and eating and destroying everything in its path, Fu was entrusted with the Chinese Miracle Box (Which included the Butterfly Miraculous) by a monk and was told to run away from the mess. However, on the mountain range outside the temple, in order to escape from the the monster, Fu jumped over a fissure on the ground - accidently opening the Box and spilling all of its contents on the snow. Due to his distress, Fu didnt notice he accidently left both the Peacock and the Butterfly on the mountain, alongisde the Grimoire, until it was too late and he was too far away to come back. Somewhere along the line, the Peacock got dangerously damaged, to the point of being improper for use - but, as it turns out, no one knew of this fact until it was too late.

title: Mouse Miraculous
text:
Mouse Miraculous - History
On a previous trip overseas with the Agrestes, Nathalie found the Butterfly and Peacock Miraculouses and gave the jewels to Gabriel. In "Representation", it was revealed that neither the Agrestes nor the Graham de Vanily couples could bear children on their own, so Émilie and Colt used the Peacock Miraculous to create Adrien and Félix respectively, but in doing so, they grew sick over time and were eventually left in a condition where they fell into an eternal slumber due to using the Peacock Miraculous in its damaged state.

title: Mouse Miraculous
text:
Mouse Miraculous - History
Desperate to fix his mistake, Gabriel Agreste began using the Butterfly Miraculous for evil to obtain the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses in order to gain access to their absolute power, becoming the supervillain Hawk Moth, later Shadow Moth (when unified with a now fixed Peacock Miraculous). This decision proved one of the most significant for the history of the series, as Gabriel began utilizing Nooroo's power to akumatize the civilians of Paris, France, trying to get one of them to draw out the current holders of the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses, unintenionally helping start off Marinette's and Adrien's journeys as Ladybug and Cat Noir, and later, the rest of the Miraculers.

title: Mouse Miraculous
text:
Mouse Miraculous - History
In "Kwamibuster", due to a confrontation with the eponymous villain, Marinette was rendered unable to transform into Ladybug as Tikki had been stolen - this caused Fu to allow Marinette to use the Mouse Miraculous until she could rescue her. She proceded to use it to transform into Multimouse. As part of her plan, she would later fuse it with the Fox, Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses, becoming Multifox, Multibug and Multicat respectively for part of the episode. After her identity was "accidently" "leaked" to Cat Noir, Marinette never used the Mouse Miraculous again.
Later, the next and current holder of the Mouse Miraculous is Mylène Haprèle, who was chosen by Ladybug in "Mega Leech" to become the heroine Polymouse. Mylène, from that point on, became a member of the team, helping Ladybug and Cat Noir during "particularly difficult missions". From "Mega Leech" to "Strikeback", she was a temporary holder, meaning she would only receive the Miraculous from Ladybug when she was needed for the mission, and had to give it back after the crisis was solved.

title: Mouse Miraculous
text:
Mouse Miraculous - History
Félix, after finding out about his true origins as a sentihuman and learning that the Peacock Miraculous could erase his and his cousin's lifes if it feel into the wrong hands, orchestrated a plan to capture all of the Miraculouses of the Chinese Box from Ladybug and traded all of them (besides the Ladybug and the Cat) for the Peacock, which included the Mouse Miraculous, succeeding in "Strikeback". When Gabriel unified it with the Butterfly and other miraculouses, he became Monarch.

title: Mouse Miraculous
text:
Mouse Miraculous - History
In "Destruction", Gabriel used a laser machine to melt down the Miraculous into a pile of dust, and then reforged it into a special Alliance ring for transferring Mullo's power of Multiplication to any akumatized villain who wore a regular Alliance ring. In "Re-creation", Marinette Dupain-Cheng manages to recover all of the Miraculous that were previously stolen. In "Miraculous London", Lila stole all of the Miraculous under Marinette's care in an alternate timeline, which included the Mouse Miraculous, in order to render her truly powerless and to fuse the Ladybug and the Cat to gain her wish without her interference, but her plan was ultimately thwarted by the combined efforts of Chronobug and Bunnyx, and the event was erased from the timeline.

title: Mouse Miraculous
text:
Mouse Miraculous - History
After the events of "Miraculous London", Marinette, having realized both instances of all of the Miraculouses being stolen happened because all of them were kept in the same place, and with the idea that centralized power is inherently flawed, and that distributing it among members of a society is a far superior idea, restored and upgraded the Mouse Miraculous by redesigning its original design and adding the Miraculous Call: a call feature that grants the holder the ability to summon other superheroes who possess a Miraculous from the Chinese Miracle Box in order to receive aid on their missions. This new feature is particularly useful, as the new holder of the Butterfly Miraculous, Chrysalis, is even more fearsome than her predecessor. After the alterations, the Mouse Miraculous was given back to Mylènè permanently - putting Polymouse back on the map.

title: Mouse Miraculous
text:
Mouse Miraculous - Trivia
Mice symbolize adaptability, cleverness, timidity, and perseverance.
Its power, Multitude, is a reference to the rapid rate at which rodents reproduce.
Under the power of Multitude, the Mouse Miraculous is the only one that can duplicate.
The Mouse Miraculous is stored in a drawer of the Miraculous box below the Ox Miraculous' drawer.
It is possible this is a reference to Mylène's and Ivan's relationship, as the former is the current holder of the Mouse Miraculous and the latter is the current holder of the Ox Miraculous.
The way the Mouse Miraculous holder is wrapped with the skip rope while using Multitude might be a reference to the way Arthur shrinks in Arthur and the Invisibles.
It's the second Miraculous being a pendant or locket, the first is the Fox Miraculous.
Coincidentally, they are the first Miraculous to be shown combining in the series.
In "Kwamibuster" Marinette Dupain-Cheng borrows the Mouse Miraculous from Wang Fu so she could become the mouse-themed heroine, Multimouse, after Tikki and Plagg were captured by the titular villain. Multimouse also unifies the Mouse Miraculous with the Fox, Cat, and Ladybug Miraculouses to become Multifox, Multinoire, and Multibug.

title: Mouse Miraculous
text:
Mouse Miraculous - Trivia
According to Thomas Astruc, the names of the two Mouse Miraculous holders were mixed up. Mylène was to be called "Multimouse" and Marinette was to be called "Polymouse". However, somewhere down the line, Marinette was referred to as "Multimouse", so Mylène's name had to be changed as well.

To activate the circlet, the user must speak the transformation phrase: "Show Time". To deactivate the circlet, the user must speak the detransformation phrase, which is currently unknown.
The circlet is currently owned by Lê Chiến Kim, who uses it to transform into King Monkey. It was previously stored in the Chinese Miracle Box and only lent out to him when the situation required it. But, as of "Re-creation", he now posseses the Miraculous permanently.

title: Monkey Miraculous
text:
Monkey Miraculous - Appearance
In general, the Monkey Miraculous is a circlet traditionally depicted on the Monkey King in Chinese mythology. In charged mode, when Xuppu inhabits it, is long, thin and gold where two of its sides bend inward like the temples on glasses, and the edges curl inward in a spiral-like manner. The middle of the Miraculous also bends, and it has five light brown square pieces on one side. When worn, it is unfolded and put on the wearer's head as they say the transformation phrase to transform. If a minor is using the Miraculous, the circlet starts running out of power, they make a beeping sound, and each gold band starts to turn black as an indication of time (one band is equivalent to one minute) Kim (or another Monkey Miraculous holder) has left.
In Season 6 onwards, the headband is an open hoop that now features two dark vermilion feathers with the edges curled in a diamond-like manner.
In its activated mode, the gold circlet has black bands on the back.
In Season 6 onwards, the headband lacks the two feathers.
In its camouflage mode, the circlet changes color and form depending on whose possession it's in:

title: Monkey Miraculous
text:
Monkey Miraculous - Appearance
In the possession of Lê Chiến Kim, it is a pair of orange and blue banded swimming earplugs.
In Season 6 onwards, it is pair of red swimming earplugs with a white stripe on each plug that he uses as a collar outside the pool.
When it was worn by Gabriel Agreste, it appeared as a silver band with an indent in the front.
When it was worn by Marinette Dupain-Cheng, it appeared as a striped pink headband.
In it's reforged ring form, it was a band with a circle surface, similar to the Cat Miraculous, inside of it is the symbol of the Monkey Miraculous which glowed gold. It used to sit on the intermediate phalange of Gabriel's right index finger.

text:

Its special weapon is an unbreakable Ruyi Jingu Bang which can be also be utilized as both a weapon, a communicator, a method of transportation and an object that can be used to breathe underwater. As long as the superpower isn't used by a minor, the wielder can remain transformed indefinitely. However, as soon as the superpower is used, the wielder loses power and the transformation wears off in about approximately five minutes. This new feature is particularly useful, as the new holder of the Butterfly Miraculous, Chrysalis, is even more fearsome than her predecessor. After the alterations, the Monkey Miraculous was given back to Kim permanently - putting King Monkey back on the map.

title: Monkey Miraculous
text:
Monkey Miraculous - Trivia
Monkeys symbolize honor, instinct, swiftness, and playfulness.
When the power of the Monkey Miraculous was first introduced in "Party Crasher", Thomas Astruc originally stated that the concept of the miraculous was Jubilation. However, following the world premiere of "Guiltrip" where the concept of the Pig Miraculous is introduced, he stated that the concept of the miraculous is Derision, and that the concept of the Pig Miraculous is Jubilation.
Prior to the release of "Guiltrip", the "concept" being Derision is still kept on some official materials, such as the Kwamis book as well as the official Miraculous Ladybug website as of September 2020.
The Monkey Miraculous bears many similarities to the character Sun Wukong in the classic Chinese text "The Journey To The West."
The oldest known wielder of the Monkey Miraculous bears the name Sun Wukong.
The Monkey Miraculous takes the form of a headband or circlet, similar to the circlet that Sun Wukong is given in order to tame him in the Journey To The West.
King Monkey can run on all fours.

title: Monkey Miraculous
text:
Monkey Miraculous - Trivia
The current wielder of the Monkey Miraculous, Lê Chiến Kim, calls himself King Monkey when in his superhero form. The Chinese name "Sun Wukong" can be translated to mean "Monkey King." Sun Wukong also bears the title of "King of the Monkeys" in The Journey To The West.
Lê Chiến Kim bears a similar confident, athletic and hot-headed personality to Sun Wukong. Xuppu, the inhabitant of the Monkey Miraculous, is also quite mischievous, another notable trait of Sun Wukong.
The activation phrase is also a reference to when people performed plays about the Monkey King.
Until "Kwamibuster", it's depicted in the Miracle Box as black with brown squares.

title: Mr. Banana
text:
Mr. Banana - Intro
is a minor character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He is an in-universe fictional mascot entertainer in Paris. Cat Noir also used his costume in "Kwamibuster" when Plagg gets captured and he needs to hide his identity, and also used this costume in "Feast" when Master Fu took the Cat Miraculous away for the same reason.

title: Mr. Banana
text:
Mr. Banana - Appearance
Physical appearance
Mr. Banana is tall and thick, with lemony peel and arms. As the name suggests, he looks like a banana except with facial features, and arms and legs. His arms and legs are significantly more spindly than his torso.
Attire
Apart from his regular banana-peel body, Mr. Banana is often seen with yellow and green skin-tight leggings and yellow crocs. It is suspected that his eyes occupy the space between his "teeth". He is always seen with an open-mouthed, toothy grin.
From season 6 onwards, he now wears white gloves.

title: Mr. Banana
text:
Mr. Banana - Personality
He seems to like parties, as seen in "Party Crasher". He is also shown to be a serious member of the jury in the show "Alternative Truth", not giving his votes to Vincent Asa and Olga Mendeleiev.

title: Mr. Banana
text:
Mr. Banana - Abilities
Mr. Banana is spry and has nimble legs, allowing him to jump several feet into the air and land calmly on both feet, as shown in the episode "Party Crasher".

title: Mr. Banana
text:
Mr. Banana - Relationships
Adrien Agreste
Mr. Banana is seen to be an active fan of Adrien, shown through both his distributing Adrien: The Fragrance leaflets in "Anansi" and his enthusiastic leap into Adrien's party during "Party Crasher".
Nadja Chamack
Mr. Banana and Nadja can be friends. He always appears as a guest in various shows hosted by TVi studio. Nadja also interviewed him, as shown in "Collusion".

title: Mr. Banana

The identity of the person wearing the banana costume is currently unknown.
In "Anansi", Marinette mentioned that one time Nora attacked Mr. Banana under the impression that he will turn Alya into a "banana zombie".
In "Party Crasher", he attends Adrien's party.
He is shown to be a judge on Alternative Truth in "Kwamibuster".
In both "Kwamibuster" and "Party Crasher", the man who wears the Mr. Banana costume was voiced by Bryce Papenbrook.
Coincidentally, Bryce also voiced Adrien who was forced to wear the banana costume in both "Kwamibuster" and "Feast" so he could hide his secret identity as Cat Noir after he got separated from Plagg.
However, as of "Wishmaker", he is now voiced by Ezra Weisz.
It was shown in "Wishmaker" that he wished to be a cucumber when he was younger.

title: Monk
text:
Monk - Intro
is a minor character of Miraculous World: New York - United Heroez. He is a member of the Order of the Guardians and the possessor of the Native American Miracle Box.

title: Monk
text:
Monk - Appearance
Physical appearance
The Monk is an old man with a strong jaw, a big nose, and noticeable wrinkles. He has long gray hair, big bushy gray eyebrows, and a mole under his left eye.
Civilian attire
He wears a dirty-red tunic with black rims and a symbol on the front, a black belt wrapped around his waist, and a pair of dirty light-green shorts. He has black tape wrapped around his lower legs and wears a pair of elf shoes with soles partially broken off. He also wears white earrings and carries a staff.

title: Monk
text:
Monk - Personality
Not much is known about this guardian's personality, but it is implied that he comes off as stoic, stern, and very serious. However, he seems open to new ideas, as he appeared interested in Eagle's idea of staying in New York and helping to form a new team of Miraculous-wielding superheroes.

title: Monk
text:
Monk - Abilities
As a Guardian
Because he is a guardian, he was trained in Mirakung Fu, a fighting style specifically designed for dealing with rogue Miraculous wielders.
He can decipher the code in the Miraculous spellbook. He can probably also improve the health and read the energies of kwamis.
He also wields a staff equipped with a magic compass that can lead him to the Native American Miracle Box if he is ever separated from it.

title: Monk
text:
Monk - Relationships
Jessica Keynes/Eagle
With the rediscovery of the Eagle Miraculous and being its guardian, this unnamed guardian approached Eagle and requested that she give it back without any fuss, as he was not in the mood to fight. Despite showing to be worthy of the Miraculous, Jess understood the duty of the guardian and offered him the possibility of building a new superhero team with Miraculous holders, something the guardian seemed interested in.
Aeon/Uncanny Valley
With the discovery of the Eagle Miraculous and being its guardian, Uncanny Valley vouched for Eagle's worthiness of the Miraculous.

title: Monk
text:
Monk - Trivia
He is the second member of the Order of Miraculous to appear, the first being Wang Fu.
Technically, the Monk is the first known guardian who is actually an official guardian, as Master Fu never completed his training before the temple was destroyed, and Marinette never trained at the temple at all.
The Monk is the only known Guardian who is non-Chinese and the only known Native American Guardian so far.

title: Mr. Banana/History
text:
Mr. Banana/History - Intro

title: Mr. Banana/History
text:
Mr. Banana/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Anansi", while distributing Adrien: The Fragrance leaflets, Mr. Banana was attacked by Nora Césaire, whom thought he was akumatized and that was gonna turn Alya Césaire into a "banana zombie".

title: Mr. Banana/History
text:
Mr. Banana/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Kwamibuster", broadcasting live, Alec Cataldi announces the jury of the newest segment of Alternative Truth, Mr. Banana being one of them, along with XY and Manon Chamack. He and the other judges then watch as Olga Mendeleiev says that what the viewers are about to witness is proof of the existence of interdimensional creatures (which are actually Kwamis) that like to eat cheese. She shows them a recording she'd made earlier but interdimensional creatures didn't show up on it, with Mr. Banana laughing at her.
Later, Alec announces that it's time for Mr. Banana and the other judges to decide whether the theories they heard are true or false. Jalil Kubdel hypothesized that Egyptian pyramids are actually alien spaceships that crashed onto Earth, which Mr. Banana and the other judges decide to be true. Vincent Asa hypothesized that snow is boogers from a giant in the clouds. Manon and XY believe this to be true, but Mr. Banana isn't convinced.

title: Mr. Banana/History
text:
Mr. Banana/History - [[Season 3]]
As for Olga's hypotheses, Mr. Banana and the other judges is convinced to be false. Olga is exasperated and insists that her discovery is true, but everyone believes her video is fake and Alec has her escorted offstage, with Mr. Banana and everyone else laughing at her. Soon after Olga is akumatized by Hawk Moth into the titular villain and she arrives on stage, with Mr. Banana still sited with the rest of the judges. Mr. Banana then took off his costume in his dressing room, which was later used by Adrien Agreste to hide from the villain.
In "Party Crasher", Mr. Banana comes by the Agreste mansion for Adrien's impromptu party. He enters Adrien's room, where he soon seen swinging from the ceiling on a rope. After the titular villain arrives, Mr. Banana is captured by him and trapped in his disco ball hands offscreen. Later when King Monkey uses his Uproar on the villain and messes up his powers, Mr. Banana and everyone else that the villain captured is freed. After this, Mr. Banana and everyone who was not a Miraculous holder fled the scene.

title: Mr. Banana/History
text:
Mr. Banana/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Heart Hunter", Mr. Banana attends Mayor André and Audrey Bourgeois' 20th wedding anniversary inside Le Grand Paris. There he witnesses the couple be akumatized into the titular villains.

title: Mr. Banana/History
text:
Mr. Banana/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Lies", Mr. Banana is seen sitting reading a newspaper on bench besides Cat Noir and Xavier Ramier at the Place des Vosges. There, Cat Noir tries stirring up some small talk with him, but Mr. Banana ignores him and continues reading his newspaper.
In "Wishmaker", it's revealed that Mr. Banana's childhood dream was to be a cucumber and he was turned into one when the titular villain fired a flying rainbow star at him offscreen, making his childhood dream become a reality. As a cucumber, Mr. Banana is seen rolling down the road behind an annoyed Cat Noir. He continued to roll on the streets, until the superheroes defeated the villain and Ladybug did her Miraculous Ladybug, which turned Mr. Banana back to normal.

title: Mr. Banana/History
text:
Mr. Banana/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Illusion", Mr. Banana is one of the invited experts of the talk show, Leading Questions, Honest Answers. Mr. Banana, along with Nadja Chamack, Alec, and Bob Roth, talk about how Ladybug lost all the Miraculouses to Monarch and if she is the hero the people need. After the second and third give their opinion, Nadja asked Mr. Banana to share his, with him just saying to stay peachy.
In "Collusion", while at an TVi interview with Nadja about his autobiography called Stay Peachy that is being made into a movie, Mr. Banana is touched by the blade of Miss Sans-Culote and is transformed into a red singing balloon who obeys her every command.
A singing balloon version of Mr. Banana then goes with Miss Sans-Culote to Hôtel de Ville, where he and the other singing balloons attacked Ladybug and Cat Noir. Miss Sans-Culote rejects her megakuma and Ladybug does her Miraculous Ladybug, Mr. Banana is turned back to normal, along with the others.

Mr. Banana goes on Never too Late to do Good, a night talk show hosted by Alec on TVi. text:
Monument to the Heroes of the Black Army - Intro
The  is a monumental statuary group erected on the Place de la Liberté, in Bamako, Mali.

id: Monument to the Heroes of the Black Army::Description::0
title: Monument to the Heroes of the Black Army
text:
Monument to the Heroes of the Black Army - Description
Erected in 1924 by Paul Moreau-Vauthier, the Monument to the Heroes of the Black Army is a tribute from France to the soldiers of the Colonial Army Corps who died in combat during the First World War, particularly during the defense of the city of Reims.
Located on Liberty Square, it is presented as a statuary group representing four bronze riflemen soldiers on a granite pedestal several meters high.
It bears the inscription: "In recognition of the children adopted by France, who died fighting for freedom and civilization."

id: Monument to the Heroes of the Black Army::Trivia::0
title: Monument to the Heroes of the Black Army
text:
Monument to the Heroes of the Black Army - Trivia
A twin monument stands in the city of Reims.
This monument was cast from the same mold, but was destroyed during World War II in 1940 by the German army, before finally being rebuilt in 2013 with a new pedestal.

title: Moon
text:
Moon - Intro
The  is a satellite that orbits Earth.

title: Moon
text:
Moon - Description
The Moon is a natural satellite of planet Earth. It has a diameter of 2,500 kilometers and a surface area of 37,871,220.85 km2. Lacking an atmosphere and magnetic field, it orbits at an average distance of 384,402 kilometers from Earth, around which it rotates synchronously, thus always showing the same side, called the "Near Side of the Moon". This synchronous rotation has a revolution of 27 days and a synodic period of 29 days. During these days, it is described as composed of different phases, which form a lunar cycle, including the New Moon and the Full Moon.
Gray in color, but appearing white on Earth due to the reflection of sunlight, the Moon has many prominent impact craters and pale plateaus that stand out in areas called lunar maria, which are darker and composed of volcanic rock.
Its gravitational influence on Earth produces ocean tides, terrestrial tides, a slight lengthening of the day, and the stabilization of the Earth's axial tilt.
One of its eclipses, called the Magical Eclipse, allows the Sacred Cave to open and access the Prodigious.

title: Moon
text:
Moon - Trivia
The Moon has been prominent a few times in the series:
In "Miraculous Shanghai", one of its eclipses, dubbed the Magical Eclipse, allowed access to the Sacred Cave.
In "Cat Blanc", in an alternative timeline, the Moon was destroyed by a Megacataclysm by the villain of the same name.
In "Miraculous New York", under the effect of Miraclonizer, Majestia used her powers to bring the Moon to Earth, causing sea levels to rise worldwide.
In "Optigami", the Arc de Triomphe and the Grand Palais were sent there by different uses of Kaalki's Voyage.
In "A Fairy Good Night", the battle with a Fairy Good Night took place on the moon.

title: Mount Fuji
text:
Mount Fuji - Intro
(富士山, Fujisan) is a mountain and active stratovolcano in central Japan, located on the southern coast of Honshu Island, southwest of the Tokyo metropolitan area. Reaching a height of 3,371 meters, it is the highest point in Japan and one of its most important symbols.

title: Mount Fuji
text:
Mount Fuji - Description
Mount Fuji is a stratovolcano 3,371 meters high, the highest point in Japan, located 100 kilometers from the megalopolis of Tokyo. It is surrounded by the Five Fuji Lakes (Fuji-goko) — Kawaguchiko, Yamanakako, Saiko, Shojiko, and Motosuko.
Mount Fuji is world-famous for its almost perfectly conical shape. Its slopes are exceptionally regular and harmonious. From November to May approximately, the summit is usually covered in snow, creating the famous image of the volcano with a "snow cap" (Yuki-gasa).
The mountain is considered one of the Three Sacred Mountains of Japan (Sanrei-zan), alongside Mount Tate and Mount Haku. It is revered in Shintoism and Buddhism.
Thus, it has become one of the major symbols of Japan, and has greatly inspired Japanese artists in many works.
Moreover, in good weather, it is visible from Tokyo.

title: Mount Fuji
text:
Mount Fuji - Trivia
Mount Fuji was listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2013 as a "cultural site".
Although Mount Fuji physically appeared for the first time in "Miraculous Tokyo", it had appeared several times in the series:
In "Ladybug & Cat Noir", it is shown on a painting picturing Tomoe Gozen, inspired by "The Great Wave off Kanagawa".
In Season 5, it appears on the walls of Cerise's headquarters in La Plage, as part of a mural based on "The Great Wave off Kanagawa".

title: Mr. Pigeon
text:
Mr. Pigeon - Intro
"" is a season 1 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. According to the series' production/written order, it is the 6th episode of season 1, as well as the 6th episode of the series, overall.

title: Mr. Pigeon
text:
Mr. Pigeon - Synopsis
The akuma fighters try to apprehend Mr. Pigeon, a bird lover who has kidnapped all the park keepers in Paris, but Cat Noir's allergies interfere.
Disney+
Ladybug and Cat Noir face Mr. Pigeon, alias Xavier Ramier.

title: Mr. Pigeon
text:
Mr. Pigeon - Plot
Mr. Damoclès is in Literature classroom, telling the students about a design competition being hosted at the school. The objective of the competition is to design and create a derby hat, which will be judged by fashion designer Gabriel Agreste. The winner of the competition will have their design worn by Adrien at his next photo shoot.
Marinette flips through her design diary, searching for a derby hat, only to discover that she has never made one. Alya watches as Marinette paces the courtyard, slowly becoming tenser. She states that she has made silky ram hats, bell hats, berets, and sombreros, but never a derby hat. While worrying, Marinette develops a worst-case scenario of her tripping over the hat, knocking over Mr. Agreste, earning hate from Adrien, and losing her dream of becoming the world's best fashion designer. Marinette dramatically cries into Alya's lap before Alya cheers her up, asking to look through Marinette's sketchbook.

title: Mr. Pigeon
text:
Mr. Pigeon - Plot
Setting the sketchbook down on the bench, Alya turns away from Marinette as Marinette brings her knees to her chest. Adrien, seeing the open book, glances at the pages and compliments Alya for her sketches. Alya corrects him, telling him that it was actually Marinette, who is hiding behind the bench. Adrien congratulates her on her designs, telling her that he thinks she has a good chance of winning the contest. This compliment gives Marinette the confidence she needs to make her design, and she runs off.
At the same time, Chloé and Sabrina overhear what Adrien says to Marinette. This distresses Chloé, so she resolves to have Sabrina steal designs from Marinette's sketchbook.
Hawk Moth, in his lair, wonders who is up to the task of stealing Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses, claiming that they must be his.

title: Mr. Pigeon
text:
Mr. Pigeon - Plot
Marinette sits outside at the Trocadéro with her sketchbook open on her lap. She sketches various versions of derby hats before ripping them out and crumpling them beside her. As she becomes more dejected, a man appears, moving his arms like wings and cooing to the pigeons. Xavier Ramier sits on a bench and calls the pigeons to him with a whistle. He then brings out a bag of bird food, tossing it to the pigeons.
Officer Roger stalks over and yells at Xavier for feeding the pigeons, stating that, if he continues to feed them, they will crowd the park and leave their droppings everywhere. Confiscating the bird food, Roger kicks Xavier out of the park. Marinette feels sorry for him. Tikki gives her the idea to make the hat based on pigeon feathers. Inspired, Marinette hurriedly sketches the idea.

title: Mr. Pigeon
text:
Mr. Pigeon - Plot
Meanwhile, Xavier sits on a bench overlooking the Seine, dejected. Hawk Moth senses Xavier's sorrow and sends an akuma to him, which enters his bird call. Hawk Moth tells Xavier that the police and park keepers should not be allowed to stop him from taking care of his pigeons and offers him the chance to take revenge on them. Xavier grins, turning into the villain, Mr. Pigeon. He takes off, flapping his arms and cooing.
At the same time, Marinette finishes her sketch. When she holds up her book to admire it in the light, Sabrina takes a picture of the sketch with her phone, handing it to Chloé. Sabrina asks Chloé when she'll design the hat, but Chloé says that her father, Mayor André Bourgeois, will pay someone to make it.

title: Mr. Pigeon
text:
Mr. Pigeon - Plot
Marinette returns to her house, making the hat in her room. Tikki helps her, giving Marinette an apple to replenish her energy. At 1:21 pm, Marinette freaks out, realizing she forgot to grab a feather for the hat. She and Tikki run back to the Eiffel Tower, disturbing the pigeons until Marinette grabs a feather. Elated that she has one, she skips off, bumping into officer Roger before returning home. Roger, however, goes on his merry way after Marinette apologizes and departs. A dark cloud of birds hovers over him, taking him away.
While Marinette is on the bus, she asks the driver why they can't go faster. The driver says that they have a situation and tells the people to get off the bus. Marinette sees that pigeons are causing the traffic jam, along with other problems all over Paris.
Nadja Chamack, on a nearby screen, reports on the pigeons and is then told that Mr. Pigeon will make an announcement: Paris belongs to the pigeons. Marinette runs to the subway, wasting no time before transforming into Ladybug.

title: Mr. Pigeon
text:
Mr. Pigeon - Plot
Ladybug runs along Paris' rooftops until she sees hordes of pigeons flying in the sky, all in the shape of airplanes. Just then, Cat Noir appears, lounging on a rooftop. He sneezes, rolling down to Ladybug. This is due to his allergy to feathers. Cat Noir tells Ladybug that the park keepers in all of Paris are disappearing. Ladybug states that they must find Mr. Pigeon. Cat Noir asks where, and while Ladybug doesn't know where they can find him, she knows where he can find them.
They go to the Place des Vosges and have Cat Noir pose as a park keeper, keeping an eye out for Mr. Pigeon. He whistles the anthem of France and starts to dance. Ladybug tells him to act natural, or Mr. Pigeon will never appear. Cat Noir responds, saying that he is acting naturally, still dancing. A pigeon sees him and flies off to report to Mr. Pigeon. Mr. Pigeon praises the pigeon for telling him. A flock of pigeons takes Mr. Pigeon away.

title: Mr. Pigeon
text:
Mr. Pigeon - Plot
Ladybug wonders where Mr. Pigeon is. Suddenly, Cat Noir sneezes, and a flock of pigeons takes him away. Ladybug follows the cloud to the ceiling of the hotel Le Grand Paris. Cat Noir sneezes again, now free, and sees that the pigeons are watching him. Suddenly, Mr. Pigeon appears, standing on a flock of pigeons. He blows his bird whistle, and the pigeons surround Ladybug and Cat Noir, trapping them in a massive bird cage.
Mr. Pigeon, under Hawk Moth's command, tells Ladybug and Cat Noir to give up their Miraculouses or the pigeons will attack them with poop. Cat Noir uses his Cataclysm, making the metal bars of the cage rusty. The cage falls apart and they are freed. As soon as they come close to Mr. Pigeon, he escapes by walking off the side of the hotel, shouting, "Merry Christmas". He sends the remaining pigeons to attack the two heroes.

title: Mr. Pigeon
text:
Mr. Pigeon - Plot
Ladybug and Cat Noir run inside, slamming the door shut on the pigeons. They head downstairs, but Cat Noir's ring beeps; he has 4 minutes left before his transformation deactivates. They head to the ground floor finding Mayor André Bourgeois. He tells them that if the pigeons keep invading Paris, all the tourists will leave and he will lose money. He asks them to stop the pigeons, which Ladybug and Cat Noir agree to do.
During this, Cat Noir is bouncing up and down in a hurry. He tells Mayor Bourgeois that he has an urgent need. Mayor Bourgeois picks up on this and allows Cat Noir to use the Royal Suite. He also has camembert delivered to Cat Noir's room. Cat Noir turns back into Adrien, and an exhausted Plagg falls on the bed. Adrien gives Plagg the Camembert, which is unpasteurized and had matured for two years.
Ladybug, at a higher vantage point, glances out a window and sees that the pigeons are flying in the same direction. Cat Noir appears in an elevator and they follow the pigeons. They reach the Grand Palais and find the park keepers caged inside. They climb up to the roof to enter the Palais from a window.

title: Mr. Pigeon
text:
Mr. Pigeon - Plot
However, Cat Noir sneezes, causing Mr. Pigeon to notice them and beginning the battle. He attacks with his pigeons, sending Ladybug and Cat Noir into the park keepers' cage's bars. Ladybug uses her Lucky Charm, and a coin appears. Using her lucky vision, Ladybug spots a support beam and a vending machine. Ladybug runs toward Mr. Pigeon, sliding underneath him while her yo-yo wraps around his ankle. She then jumps up to the support beam, swinging over it once, wrapping up her yo-yo's string. Ladybug runs ahead, putting the coin into the vending machine and buying a small bag of popcorn. She throws the bag in the air and Cat Noir uses his staff to break it. Most of the popcorn lands on Mr. Pigeon.

title: Mr. Pigeon
text:
Mr. Pigeon - Plot
The pigeons surround Mr. Pigeon and eat the popcorn off of him. As he is distracted, Ladybug yanks on her yo-yo, pulling Mr. Pigeon into the air. The bird call slips from his neck, landing on the ground. Cat Noir goes to grab it, but he sneezes, throwing it away accidentally. Ladybug, Cat Noir, and Mr. Pigeon go after it. They grab it simultaneously, Mr. Pigeon's hand directly on top of it, then Cat Noir's, then Ladybug's. Ladybug grabs Cat Noir's hand and smashes it down on Mr. Pigeon's hand, breaking the bird call. The akuma flies out from it. Ladybug catches it, purifies it, and uses Miraculous Ladybug to return everything back to normal. Mr. Pigeon turns back into Mr. Ramier. Hawk Moth swears revenge on Ladybug and pigeons.
Marinette, at her house, finishes creating her derby hat. At the school, the design competition is about to begin. Nathalie introduces herself to Mr. Damoclès, and he wonders where Mr. Agreste is. Nathalie shows that he is going to be judging via her tablet. Gabriel orders Adrien to take Nathalie around the school. Chloé and Sabrina notice him, turning their faces aside with posh expressions.

title: Mr. Pigeon
text:
Mr. Pigeon - Plot
Gabriel begins to judge the derby hats when Marinette arrives. Alya wonders where she has been, but Marinette doesn't answer. Marinette sets her hat on the podium, and Alya points out that it is identical to Chloé's. Mr. Agreste sees Marinette's hat and sees it is identical to Chloé's hat. Chloé fakes innocence and pretends Marinette stole her design. However, Marinette proves that her hat is original by showing her signature on the hat. Chloé runs away crying, calling for her father. Mr. Agreste then declares Marinette the winner of the competition. Adrien congratulates her, moving to put on the hat. When it is near his nose, he freezes and sneezes. As Adrien walks away, Marinette jumps for joy, ending the episode.

title: Mr. Pigeon
text:
Mr. Pigeon - Plot Developments
It is revealed in this episode that Adrien is allergic to feathers.
In this episode, it is revealed that Marinette's secret garden of inspiration is the Trocadéro.

title: Mr. Pigeon
text:
Mr. Pigeon - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in Korea.
This episode was the sixth to air in France and the fifth in Korea.
This is the first episode where Hawk Moth appears before his akumatized victim.
In this episode, it is revealed that Marinette's secret garden of inspiration is the Trocadéro.
This is the second episode in which Cat Noir's transformation isn't seen, following "Dark Cupid", but when following the original production, they go in reverse.
References
Mr. Pigeon and his use of pigeons as an attack appeared previously in the Ladybug PV.
When Marinette opens the bag before she transforms, it's a recycled scene from "Stormy Weather" with an edit to the lighting.
A part of this episode appears in an Akuma Alert cut scene in the mobile game Miraculous Ladybug & Cat Noir, but mirrored.
The scene of Ladybug jumping over the buildings is reused in "Dark Cupid".
Allusions
While Cat Noir is posing as a park keeper, he is whistling "La Marseillaise", the French national anthem.
Some of his dance moves during this scene are Michael Jackson's Moonwalk and PSY's Gangnam Style dance.

title: Mr. Pigeon
text:
Mr. Pigeon - Trivia
When Ladybug tells Cat Noir, "You're the cat don't you eat these things for breakfast?", she's referring to the dietary habits of a cat as there are some domesticated to feral cats that will occasionally eat birds and small rodents.
Errors
Despite being childhood friends with Adrien, Chloé introduces herself to Gabriel Agreste as if they have never met.
When Chloé snatches Sabrina's phone out of the latter's hand and looks at it, the camera lens is under her right hand. However, in the next scene, the lens switches to the other side under Chloé's left hand.
Somehow, Ladybug has her Lucky Charm object in her hand while it should still be in the vending machine.
When she puts the coin in the vending machine, the colors were inverted.
Right before Cat Noir detransforms, when he is opening the door the second time, he vanishes for a very brief shot.
During the design competition, Max is seen without his glasses.
Inaccuracies
The average pigeon can only carry up to 75 grams on their back, meaning that, at the very least, it would take several thousand pigeons to support Mr. Pigeon's weight.

title: Mr. Pigeon
text:
Mr. Pigeon - Trivia
All of the pigeons look exactly the same. In real life, rock pigeons have many different color and pattern mutations.

title: Mr. Pigeon/Transcript
text:
Mr. Pigeon/Transcript - Intro
[ Theme Song ]
Denis Damoclès:  You only have one day to work on your fashion piece, and it must be your own design. In ten hours your fittest presentation will be judged by none other than the great fashion designer Gabriel Agreste, the father of our very own student Adrien Agreste. In fact, Adrien will model the winning design in his next photoshoot. And now, to announce this year's theme: derby hats.
Marinette:  Derby hats? (Chloé looks at them and makes a thumbs-down gesture)
Marinette:  Derby hat, derby hat, derby hat, derby hat...! I don’t have any derby hat designs. I’ve got top hats, caps, even two-horned hats! Need a beret? I’m your girl. A sombrero? No problem-o. But a derby?! You know what? It won’t even matter, 'cause I’ll probably make a total fool of myself at the event, most likely trip over my stupid derby and collapse on Mr. Agreste; give him a full-blown concussion and Adrien will hate me! I'll never be a world-renowned fashion designer. MY LIFE IS OVER!
Alya:  All this over a derby hat? Let me see your sketchpad, girl. There must be something in here.
Marinette:  Forget it, I’m a disaster zone. I’ll probably mess everything up in the end. (Adrien walks over)

title: Mr. Pigeon/Transcript
text:
Mr. Pigeon/Transcript - Intro
Adrien:  Wow, Alya, (Marinette panics and hides behind the bench) those are some awesome designs. I didn’t know you had such mad skills.
Alya:  Uh, thanks Adrien, but I can’t take the credit. These sick designs belong to Marinette. (Marinette gives a weak, embarrassed wave) Off the chain, right?
Adrien:  You're super talented, Marinette. You seriously have a good chance of winning.
Marinette:  Well, um, yeah! I... like-- um, designs that-- um, (Alya makes motions to Marinette, who tries to interpret them) go... upwards? Um, while stopping... I mean, uh-- uh, um, thanks?
Adrien:  Sure, and uh-- good luck. Maybe I’ll be wearing your derby at father’s next photoshoot. (leaves)
Alya:  Girl, you gotta get a grip next time. But did you hear? Adrien thinks you’re good enough to win! (they cheer)
Sabrina:  Did you hear how impressed Adrien was with Marinette's desi--
Chloé:  Of course I heard! Her? Win the contest? As if. When Adrien sees my design he'll convince his father to award me the winner. Hm!
Sabrina:  I'm sure he will, Chloé. You’re a born champion. Your design will blow everyone else's out of the water!
Chloé:  Yeah, it will. As soon as I can get my hands on this sketchpad!

title: Mr. Pigeon/Transcript
text:
Mr. Pigeon/Transcript - Intro
Alya:  (back at the bench; checking her phone) Only have nine hours until show time.
Marinette: Yikes! I'm off to my secret garden of inspiration. I’ll see you later. (runs into a wall) AH! I'm okay. I'm okay, I'm okay.
(Marinette almost runs into another wall, then screams. Alya chuckles.)
Hawk Moth: The time has come for us to find our next victim, my wicked little akumas, and to prey upon Ladybug and Cat Noir. Their Miraculouses must be mine!
Marinette: Geez, it’s hard to be creative under pressure.
Tikki: Marinette, you save the world under pressure. I think designing a hat should be a piece of cake!
Marinette: Hmm, a cake derby hat. Stylish and tasty! (they chuckle. Marinette keeps drawing new designs and ripping them out. After a while, she gets tired and looks up. A man walking like a bird sits down on a bench ahead of her. He takes out a brown paper bag and blows his bird call. A cluster of pigeons approaches. Marinette dodges one)
Xavier: (throwing food for the pigeons) Well, happy day, happy day! Splendid is the afternoon day. Ah, Edgar, you fancy one. Fantastic, dazzling performance. (a police officer approaches him)

title: Mr. Pigeon/Transcript
text:
Mr. Pigeon/Transcript - Intro
Roger: Scram, you winged rats! How many times do you need to be told, Mr. Ramier? No! FEEDING! The pigeons! It’s strictly forbidden. If everyone feeds them, they’ll leave their waste everywhere!
Xavier: But, who’s going to feed my poor pigeons?
Roger: All the park keepers know about you, Mr. Ramier. You’re banned from every park in Paris. Leave now or I’ll call the authorities. Oh, wait. I’m the authority. GET OUT! (Mr. Ramier walks away sadly)
Marinette: Sheesh, I almost feel sorry for that man.
Tikki: What a unique character! He was like, a human bird. All he needed was a feather jacket to complete the look.
Marinette: A feather jacket, hmm. Nice thinking, Tikki. (starts drawing again)
Hawk Moth: Poor Mr. Ramier, (scene switches to Hawk Moth's lair) the feeling of injustice, such easy prey for my akuma. (turns a butterfly into an akuma) Fly away, my little akuma, and evilize him! (the akuma flies to Mr. Ramier and enters into his bird call.) Mr. Pigeon, I’m Hawk Moth. Neither this police officer, nor any other of the park keepers, should stop you from taking care of your friends. What would Paris be without pigeons? What would pigeons be without you?

title: Mr. Pigeon/Transcript
text:
Mr. Pigeon/Transcript - Intro
(Xavier chuckles, and transforms into Mr. Pigeon, who flaps his arms, makes pigeon noises, and runs off.)
(Cut to Chloé secretly watching Marinette as she is drawing. She signals Sabrina, who sneaks behind Marinette, to take a picture of the design from her sketchpad.)
Marinette: (sketching) Yes! (she holds up a drawing of her finished design, which Sabrina snaps a photo of)
Tikki: Now that’s a derby!
Marinette: Thanks, Tikki.
Sabrina: (showing the picture on her phone to Chloé) We're so awesome.
Chloé: (coldly) We? (snatches the phone)
Sabrina: (with a small hurt look) Oh right, sorry! You're so awesome, Chloé. When are we-- uh, you, going to make the hat?
Chloé: And ruin these nails? Of course not. Daddy’ll pay someone to do it. (walks off. Sabrina follows her)
(When the hat is almost finished, Marinette seems to realize something is missing. She looks under her desk.)
Tikki: What are you looking for?
Marinette: A feather! I forgot to pick up a pigeon feather for the hat! It has to have a feather!
(Marinette runs back to the Trocadéro. The pigeons scatter, dropping feathers.)
Marinette: (picking up a feather) Yes!
(As she leaves, she accidentally runs into Roger.)

title: Mr. Pigeon/Transcript
text:
Mr. Pigeon/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Uh, sorry mister officer, sir. (leaves)
(As Roger walks away, a swarm of pigeons descends on him and attacks him. He cries out.)
Marinette: (impatiently) Come on! Can’t we go any faster?!
Bus driver: Sorry folks, we have a situation here. (cars are being held up by a cluster of pigeons.) You’ll need to get off the bus now.
Marinette: (startled by pigeons) Ah! Uh, this is weird.
(As Marinette gets off the bus, she sees the streets littered with pigeons. She walks down the street and sees a bunch of people gathered near a screen.)
Nadja: (from screen) Pigeons have taken over Paris. This is just one of the many alarming situations giving authorities cause for major concern. (touches her earpiece) Yes, I’ve just been told that someone named "Mr. Pigeon" is making an announcement.
Mr. Pigeon: (from screen) Oh, dreary day, poor Parisians. (makes pigeon noises) Sorry to ruffle your feathers, but Paris now belongs to the pigeons! Flap flap! (makes pigeon noises)
(Marinette runs down to the subway entrance to commence her transformation.)
Marinette: Paris needs us!
[ Transformation Sequence ]Marinette: Tikki, spots on! Yeah! (Marinette transforms into Ladybug)

title: Mr. Pigeon/Transcript
text:
Mr. Pigeon/Transcript - Intro
(Ladybug sees airplane shapes made out of pigeons flying through the sky.)
Ladybug: Now this is weirder than weird.
Cat Noir: (from a ledge above her) Birds of a feather, flock together. (sneezes and falls down to where Ladybug is) I’m allergic to feathers. (sneezes again)
Ladybug: That's helpful.
Cat Noir: Tell me about it. (almost sneezes, but stops himself) These birds are only part of the problem. The park keepers in Paris are vanishing without a trace.
Ladybug: What? We have to track down Mr. Pigeon ASAP.
Cat Noir: Where are we gonna find him?
Ladybug: Hmm, I don't know where we can find him, but I do know where he can find us.
Cat Noir: (starts to whistle "La Marseillaise" and then starts to dance)
Ladybug: Act natural or he'll never show up!
Cat Noir: What do you mean? I am acting natural.
(A pigeon watches him and flies back to Mr. Pigeon.)
Mr. Pigeon: (to pigeon) Ladybug and Cat Noir? Job well done, buddy-boy. Pigeons will reign supreme! Power to the pigeons! (jumps off his ledge, and the pigeons form a platform to carry him off)
(Back in the park, Ladybug and Cat Noir are still waiting.)
Ladybug: Where is he? He should've been here by now.

title: Mr. Pigeon/Transcript
text:
Mr. Pigeon/Transcript - Intro
(Pigeons start flying overhead. Cat Noir sneezes. A bunch of pigeons form a big ball and start carrying Cat Noir away.)
Ladybug: What the- (runs after them)
(The pigeons reach the roof of the Le Grand Paris hotel and drop Cat Noir off. Cat Noir sneezes again, and the pigeons look at him. Ladybug arrives.)
Cat Noir: Where's that bird-brain Mr. Pigeon?
Ladybug: He's gotta be here somewhere... (Mr. Pigeon is lifted by a swarm of pigeons behind them)
Hawk Moth: (from his lair) If you want to give Paris back to the pigeons for good, you must first rid the city of those two pests. (Mr. Pigeon blows his bird call and the pigeons start to circle around Ladybug and Cat Noir)
Ladybug: Call me crazy, but I feel like bird seed all of a sudden. (the pigeons form a shield to keep them in)
Cat Noir: Got any bright ideas, bug?
Ladybug: You're the cat, don't you eat these things for breakfast? (a gigantic cage is brought down over them, imprisoning them) Look!
Mr. Pigeon: (makes bird noises) Turpy day. I'm so ruthless. (chuckles)
Hawk Moth: (from his lair) Excellent. Now take their Miraculous!

title: Mr. Pigeon/Transcript
text:
Mr. Pigeon/Transcript - Intro
Mr. Pigeon: (makes bird noises) Your Miraculous. Give them to me or face the wrath of my feathered friends. (blows his bird call and some pigeons start banging on the top of the cage, while others turn around and point their behinds at Ladybug and Cat Noir) Dada-dee, on the count of three, my beloved pigeons will commence fire. You can still say you're sorry skins by handing me your Miraculous. One, two...
Ladybug:  Cat Noir, the bars!
[ Superpower Sequence ]Cat Noir: Cataclysm!
(Cat Noir uses his Cataclysm to destroy the bars of the cage. Mr. Pigeon cowers back toward the edge of the rooftop while Ladybug and Cat Noir advance on him.)
Cat Noir: Well, well. Looks like the pigeon's really a chicken.
Mr. Pigeon: (makes bird noises) Me? I'm not flying away. I'm just killing two birds with one stone. (blows his bird call and jumps over the edge of the roof. Some pigeons catch him, lift him back up and take him away)
Mr. Pigeon: (makes bird noises) Merry Christmas!

title: Mr. Pigeon/Transcript
text:
Mr. Pigeon/Transcript - Intro
(A group of pigeons dives towards Ladybug and Cat Noir, who run inside and close the door behind them to stop the pigeons. A bulge forms in the door as pigeons slam the door at them but Ladybug and Cat Noir fall down the stairs.)
Ladybug and Cat Noir: Ah!
Mr. Pigeon: I'm not done with you yet! (makes more bird noises, as his pigeons ride them away)
(Ladybug and Cat Noir start running downstairs. Cat Noir's ring beeps. He only has four minutes left.)
Cat Noir: I've gotta get out of here before my secret identity's revealed!
Ladybug: Yeah, you wouldn't want to let the cat out of the bag.
Cat Noir: Ha ha, very funny.
(Ladybug and Cat Noir make it to the first floor and start to head out the building. On their way out they see a crowd gathered on the entrance.)
André: Ladybug, Cat Noir! I'm in great danger-- of losing big bucks if my guests leave Paris! You are going to get rid of those pigeons, aren't you? (Cat Noir’s ring beeps again and he's getting nervous)
Cat Noir: (fidgeting) Of course we are. But before we do, I have an urgent need.
André: An urgent need? I see! Head to the royal suite. There's paper in there, but perhaps you would prefer... a litter tray?

title: Mr. Pigeon/Transcript
text:
Mr. Pigeon/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: Uh...? Oh right, no need for litter. But, um, could I have some Camembert? (Mayor Bourgeois looks back at Ladybug. She shrugs)
Cat Noir: 'Scuse me, sorry! (slams the door) It's an emergency! (hears knocking on the door. Cat Noir opens it)
Armand: How do you like your Camembert?
Cat Noir: Runny! (slams the door again. There's another knock and he opens it again. Armand is holding a cloche)
Armand: Unpasteurized Camembert, matured for two years. (hands Cat Noir a cloche)
Cat Noir: Thanks! (slams the door again. His transformation runs out and Cat Noir turns back into Adrien. Plagg spirals out of the ring and lands on the bed)
Plagg: Oh, the exhaustion! My poor aching body! I can't move a muscle!
Adrien: You wanna bet? (walks over to Plagg and he removes the cloche from the plate to reveal the Camembert)
Plagg: (gasps) Ah, my gooeyness... (starts devouring the cheese)
Adrien: Eat up, buddy. Ladybug needs help.
Ladybug: Great, I can get a much better view from up here. (walks up to a window.) Odd, the pigeons are flying in the same direction. Better go follow them. (the elevator dings. Cat Noir is inside)
Cat Noir: Ready when you are, LB.
Ladybug: (entering) Let's go!

title: Mr. Pigeon/Transcript
text:
Mr. Pigeon/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: So that's where Mr. Pigeon's keeping the park keepers he abducted.
Cat Noir: The Grand Palais. (starts to sneeze, Ladybug stops him) My pigeon radar is on high alert.
Ladybug: Either your radar is on the brink or Mr. Pigeon's left the park keepers unattended.
Cat Noir: Let's set the cat among the pigeons.
Ladybug: Hold up, kitty. It's... too easy. I've got a plan.
(They run around the outside. A pigeon flies into the building.)
Mr. Pigeon: Perfect timing, hootie ho! We're ready to greet them, aren't we? They're going to fall right into my trap. It won't be long before you get your Miraculous, friend.
Hawk Moth: (from his lair) I can't wait, my dear Pigeon.
(Cut to the roof. Ladybug and Cat Noir are running up on the roof of the building.)
Ladybug: If we can destroy that bird call, we'll be able to capture the akuma. Okay, you open the window, I'll grab him and yank him up onto the roof, then you snag his bird call away from him.
Cat Noir: Let's go! Early bird gets the worm!
(Cat Noir opens a skylight on the roof, but a draft of feathers hits him and he sneezes, so when Ladybug throws her yo-yo, she misses Mr. Pigeon. He turns around.)

title: Mr. Pigeon/Transcript
text:
Mr. Pigeon/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: So much for the element of surprise. (they jump inside to next to Mr. Pigeon, who jumps back and lets the pigeons carry him. They chase Mr. Pigeon until he blows his bird call, and the pigeons form two spheres where his hands are)
Mr. Pigeon: Deedly-dee dee, come closer, I have a bone to peck with you.
Cat Noir: I'd be honored. (Mr. Pigeon hits both Cat Noir and then Ladybug back towards the cage)
Roger: Get us outta here, Ladybug!
[ Superpower Sequence ]Ladybug: Lucky Charm! (a coin appears)
Ladybug: A coin? What am I supposed to do with this? (Ladybug uses her Lucky Vision and it shows her a beam, a vending machine and the coin)
Mr. Pigeon: You can't buy yourself out of here! (Mr. Pigeon throws a sphere of pigeons at them)
(Ladybug starts running towards him, slides, and uses her yo-yo to wrap around his left ankle. She jumps up to the beam and back down, making a pulley. She runs to the vending machine at the far end, uses the coin to get a bag of popcorn.)
Ladybug: Cat Noir!
Cat Noir: Yeah! (she throws the bag in the air. Cat Noir throws his staff, which bursts opens the bag)
Ladybug: Snack time, pigeons! (the pigeons go after the popcorn landing on Mr. Pigeon)

title: Mr. Pigeon/Transcript
text:
Mr. Pigeon/Transcript - Intro
Mr. Pigeon: No! (Ladybug pulls on her yo-yo and lifts Mr. Pigeon up by the ankle. His bird call falls to the ground) My bird call! Nooo!
Ladybug: Cat Noir, grab it! (He grabs it, but then he sneezes and throws it upward)
(Ladybug runs to get it, dropping Mr. Pigeon, who also runs for it. When Cat Noir recovers, he runs toward it too. They all lunge for the bird call. Mr. Pigeon's hand lands on it first, then Cat Noir's, then Ladybug's. Ladybug uses Cat Noir's hand to break the bird call.)
Ladybug: Yes!
Cat Noir: Ow!
(Cat Noir holds the aching hand that Ladybug used to break the bird call. Mr. Pigeon faints. The akuma flies out of the broken bird call.)
Ladybug: No more evil-doing for you, little akuma. Time to de-evilize! (captures the akuma) Gotcha! Bye bye, little butterfly. (releases the purified butterfly)
[ Superpower Sequence ]Ladybug: Miraculous Ladybug! (throws the Lucky charm in the air and restores everything back to normal)
(Mr. Pigeon turns back into Xavier Ramier.)
Xavier: Huh? What happened? Where am I?
Ladybug and Cat Noir: Pound it!
Hawk Moth:  Wretched pigeons, wretched Ladybug. I'll destroy every one of you!
(The window closes.)

title: Mr. Pigeon/Transcript
text:
Mr. Pigeon/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: There's no time to lose. I have less than an hour. (Marinette keeps working on her hat)
Alya: Where is that girl?
Nathalie: Hello, Mr. Damoclès, I am Mr. Agreste's executive assistant Nathalie.
Mr. Damoclès: Hello, miss. Pardon me, but where is Mr. Agreste? (She holds up a tablet)
Gabriel: (from tablet) I'm here.
Mr. Damoclès:  Ah, uh, hello Mr. Agreste. Welcome to our school.
Gabriel: (from tablet) Adrien, take Nathalie around.
Chloé: Ah, there's Mr. Agreste! He's coming this way. (Mr. Damoclès, Nathalie and Adrien go up to see Juleka and Rose's hat)
Mr. Damoclès: As you'll see, Mr. Agreste, our students have poured their hearts and souls into their projects. (Marinette rushes in and carries her box over to Alya. Marinette lets out a sigh of relief)
Alya: Where have you been?! You got your hat?
Marinette: Yep, here. (takes off the lid. Alya marvels at it, then her expression darkens) What?
Alya: But, it's the same as Chloé's.
Marinette: What?! (the judges walk over to see Chloé and Sabrina's hat)
Chloé: Uh, hi Mr. Agreste. I'm, I'm Chloé Bourgeois. You know my father, André Bourgeois, the mayor?
Marinette: Ugh, that thieving little brat!

title: Mr. Pigeon/Transcript
text:
Mr. Pigeon/Transcript - Intro
Alya: Do you want me to take care of it?
Marinette: I think I can handle this. (the judges reach Marinette's hat)
Gabriel: Hm, turn the tablet back to Ms. Bourgeois' hat. (they turn) Is this a joke?
Chloé: No fair! Marinette copied my design! It's scandalous, how could you do that? (fake cries)
Marinette: I apologize for the situation Mr. Agreste, but I can prove that this derby hat is MY original design.
Gabriel: Go ahead.
Marinette: Um, everything on my derby hat is hand-made-- from the embroidery, to the weaving of the band, to the stitching of the brim. (Chloé recoils) All done by myself. And last, there's a special design element that only the true designer knows about: (flips the hat upside down) I signed mine. (Chloé knocks over her derby hat stand. Everyone turns to look at it on the ground, and it shows Marinette's signature. Chloé runs out crying)
Chloé: Daddy!
Gabriel: Very exquisite creation. You definitely have the laboring hands of a hat maker, Miss...
Adrien: Marinette. (Adrien puts his hand on Marinette's shoulder)
Gabriel: Congratulations on your demonstration, Miss Marinette. You're the winner. (she looks at Alya and gasps)
