title: Mudekudeku
text:
Mudekudeku - Intro
was an OmuHimba girl. She was a past Miraculous holder, wielding the Ladybug Miraculous and transforming into a ladybug-themed superhero when Tikki inhabited them.

title: Mudekudeku
text:
Mudekudeku - Appearance
Mudekudeku wore a traditional calfskin skirt and jewelry that depicts her social status. On her ankles were jewelry that protected her against venomous animals. Because her entire body was red with black spots, indicating the area protected by the Ladybug Miraculous — which she used to transform — it can be assumed that the magic acted like otjize paste. She had several otjize hair plaits.

title: Mudekudeku
text:
Mudekudeku - Personality
Since she is called the voice of nature in her inktober drawing it's implied that Mudekudeku is respectful, loving and protective towards nature.

title: Mudekudeku
text:
Mudekudeku - Abilities
If this past Ladybug Miraculous holder had the same powers as the current Ladybug (Marinette), she had enhanced abilities and the superpowers Lucky Charm and Miraculous Ladybug. She also had the yo-yo for a weapon.

title: Mudekudeku
text:
Mudekudeku - Trivia
Thomas Astruc drew Mudekudeku in an image created for a fan-made charity magazine. She appears in the image with Jeanne d'Arc, Hippolyta, and Ladybug (Marinette).
Her name means "The Great Ladybug" in Bantu.
Because her hair is not acting as a veil, it can be assumed that she has passed the age of puberty. Since she does not wear an Erembe in her hair, it can additionally be assumed that she is not married. Likewise, she is not considered a woman among her people.
She is the second superhero to appear in Africa, followed by Khepri and LadyLion.

title: Mullo
text:
Mullo - Intro
is a supporting character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She is the Kwami of Multiplication who is connected to the Mouse Miraculous. With her power, Mullo's wearer can use the pendant necklace to transform into a mouse-themed superhero.
Mullo and her Miraculous are currently owned by Mylène Haprèle, who uses it to transform into the superheroine Polymouse.

title: Mullo
text:
Mullo - Appearance
Mullo is 10 centimeters (or 4 inches) tall and is light gray with a small body, two whiskers and a thin tail. She has brilliant amaranth eyes and gray ears with the insides being pink.
From Season 6 onwards, most of her appearance remains the same except that her ears are more teardrop shaped with gray insides.

title: Mullo
text:
Mullo - Personality
Like the other Kwamis, Mullo is very playful and immature. However, she can sometimes be compassionate, as shown in "Truth" and "Gang of Secrets" when she attempted comforting Marinette. Mullo can also take things seriously, as she tries communicating with Nooroo to help him in "Sandboy", and sees akumatized villains as serious matters in "Truth".
An example of her mischievous behavior is her delight in scaring others, as shown when Ladybug gives her Miraculous to Mylène and Mullo gives her a scare when summoned and laughs at it.

title: Mullo
text:
Mullo - Abilities
Mullo can fly, levitate, and phase through solid objects. She can also carry objects that are larger and/or heavier than herself.
As a Kwami, Mullo is able to transform the holder of the Mouse Miraculous into a mouse-themed superhero.
Mullo can grant the wielder of the Mouse Miraculous the power of Multitude, which allows them to shrink down and split themselves into multiple miniature clones, and fuse back into one. The smaller individuals can also fuse powers with other kwamis and create hybrid wielders (such as Multifox, Multinoire, and Multibug).

title: Mullo
text:
Mullo - Relationships
Friends
Mylène Haprèle/Polymouse
Initially, when they first met, Mullo scared Mylène, as Mullo's mischievous nature did not mesh well with Mylène's naivety.
However, in "Noe" it is shown that spending more time together had a positive effect on both of them, helping Mullo to calm down a bit and giving Mylène more confidence. Throughout the episode, she unconditionally supports Mylène and tries to calm her down when she gets too upset. After Mylène discovers she unintentionally caused Nadja Chamack to be fired and that her father is forced to act in a role he does not want, she emotionally shuts down, leading to Fred's reakumatization. Mullo, however, successfully encourages her to save her father.
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/Ladybug
TBA
Enemies
Gabriel Agreste/Monarch
TBA
Tomoe Tsurugi
After being captured by Monarch, Mullo discovered that Tomoe was Gabriel's ally and helped him destroy her Miraculous and reform it into a ring. Mullo then witnessed their alliance from her cage, and in "Pretension," Tomoe akumatized herself to steal Felix's Peacock Miraculous. Monarch transferred Mullo's power to Tomoe to help her, but it was ineffective.

title: Mullo
text:
Mullo - Relationships
In "Miraculous London", after being freed by Bug Noir and Nathalie, Mullo overheard Nathalie revealing the truth about Tomoe to her guardian. However, Ladybug decided not to bring her to justice and instead gave her a chance to change after she had hidden the truth about Monarch from the world.

title: Mullo
text:
Mullo - Trivia
Mullo was first revealed from a second season trailer on August 31, 2017.
Thomas Astruc revealed her name on Twitter on November 11, 2018.
Mice are symbols for many things, including success, ambition, kindness, and resourcefulness.
The mouse is the first animal of the Chinese zodiac.
It is more commonly interpreted as a rat, but Mullo's species was changed to a mouse probably to make her more appealing to children.
Mullo's name is a reference to mulot, a French word for "field mouse".
Mullo's name was originally "Toppo" (based on the Italian word for mouse, topo) before being changed during development.
Mullo's original name was accidentally used in one scene of the English dub of "Kwamibuster".
Mullo's Miraculous has the second most unification transformations, tied with Kaalki.
Mullo has three unifications, with first place going to Tikki.
Along with Orikko, Mullo is also the only known Kwami who does not have a speaking role until season 4 as she remained in the background in both seasons 2 and 3.
Her favorite food being Emmental cheese is a reference to mice liking cheese.

Musée d'Art Moderne de la Ville de Paris - Description
Belonging to the city of Paris, this museum presents the municipal collection of modern and contemporary art since Fauvism. This collection is rich in over 15,000 works, mainly focused on artistic movements linked to the capital, and more recently on the European art scene.

title: Mr. Pigeon 72
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Mr. Pigeon 72 - Intro
"" is a Season 4 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 4th written and produced episode of Season 4. It is also the 82nd written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Mr. Pigeon 72
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Mr. Pigeon 72 - Synopsis
Since Marinette became Guardian of the Miraculous, she has given up on romance to focus on how to stop Shadow Moth from re-akumatizing people. Even when Alya tries to take her mind off things by dropping that Adrien and Kagami have split up, Marinette obsesses over getting them back together instead of taking her own chance! But her catastrophic plan leads to the 72nd re-akumatization of Mr. Pigeon, whose birds turn people into villainous pigeons... as well as Kagami and Adrien! Will Ladybug's battle stop Xavier from being akumatized again?
Disney+
Ladybug faces Mr. Pigeon... for the 72nd time!
Netflix
When Kagami and Adrien break up, Marinette stops at nothing to get them back together. But the akumatized Mr. Pigeon threatens to muck up her plan.

title: Mr. Pigeon 72
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Mr. Pigeon 72 - Plot
The episode starts with Marinette, transformed into Ladybug, wearing safety goggles, along with a bathrobe and towel like a lab coat and hat, in her room with Alya, trying to brew up a potion and decipher the Grimoire while going over Shadow Moth's previous victims, which are all listed up on a pin board on the wall. Each villain's photograph has post-its with star stickers attached on them, the stars representing the number of times the respective villain had been akumatized so far. Alya remarks that Shadow Moth akumatized her on four occurrences so far as Lady Wifi, because Marinette keeping secrets from her had driven her crazy. Ladybug sadly remarks that she had no choice but to hide it, and Alya cheers her up, saying that she knows that and that now that she knows Marinette's secret, she's here to help her.

title: Mr. Pigeon 72
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Mr. Pigeon 72 - Plot
Then, Alya realizes with shock that Mr. Ramier had been akumatized on 71 cumulative occasions. Ladybug says sadly that Mr. Ramier is just a gentleman with no history, and that she thinks it's unfair to him. She then reveals that she had promised to find a way to protect him from being re-akumatized again, but that she doesn't know how to do it. Ladybug groans in frustration, saying she doesn't understand anything in the Grimoire. Wayzz speaks up, telling her that Master Fu didn't understand much either, but instead succeeded by taking his time and resting. Ladybug gets excited, not really listening to the kwami, telling him to wait and that she thinks she's found it.
Then, she proceeds to add pepper to the potion, and it explodes in a puff of purple smoke with a loud bang. Below in the bakery, her parents look up, startled, and then exchange worried glances.

title: Mr. Pigeon 72
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Mr. Pigeon 72 - Plot
The scene changes back to Marinette's bedroom, and shows Alya and Ladybug lying on the floor, surrounded by smoke, having been blown over from the force of the explosion, and left in shock, before Ladybug recovers with a frustrated groan at the failed attempt. Photos of Adrien are falling off Marinette's walls to the floor, knocked off by the explosion as well. The scene shows that Marinette's room is rather messy and in chaos now. Ladybug is the first to get back to her feet, walking back to the cauldron she had been brewing the potion in and saying that she could've sworn that the "spicy little pebble" in the Grimoire was pepper. Trixx flies up to Alya, asking her to bring Ladybug back to her senses, obviously concerned for her wellbeing. Alya approaches Marinette, asking her how long she had been trying. Ladybug replies that she doesn't really know, saying she thinks that it might be about six, seven, maybe even ten days. She tells Alya that it's spring break, so she finally has the time to focus on deciphering the Grimoire.

title: Mr. Pigeon 72
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Mr. Pigeon 72 - Plot
Alya, concerned, looks down to the floor, seeing Marinette's sewing utensils in the corner, looking rather abandoned. Alya asks Ladybug since when doesn't she work on her creations anymore, and Ladybug quickly says that she keeps making stuff, showing Alya a security system and a hat that allows her to know what's going on in her room even when she isn't there.
Alya walks up to her and yells into her ear that she's losing her mind, and that whenever she, Alya, is obsessively searching for something, she gets stuck. She then tells her that she needs a break. Ladybug says she won't stop until she's found a way to prevent Shadow Moth from re-akumatizing people, and adds something to the cauldron out of frustration to see if that works, causing another explosion. It knocks her parents down below off their feet and they express their concern for her and reveal that Marinette had told them not to interrupt her "science presentation".

title: Mr. Pigeon 72
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Mr. Pigeon 72 - Plot
The latest backfire manages to blow Ladybug's hat, headphones, and towel turban of her head, and the towel falls back down over her face, leaving her feeling humiliated and defeated. Alya tries a different method to get Ladybug to take a break and reveals to her that Adrien and Kagami had broken up. Ladybug whirls around, expressing her shock and says that she has to go console Kagami, surprising Alya. Alya asks her if Adrien shouldn't be the one who needs consoling, and Ladybug insists that she has to console Kagami, saying that she's her only friend in Paris and that she no longer has any feelings for Adrien.

title: Mr. Pigeon 72
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Mr. Pigeon 72 - Plot
After being reminded by Alya that she's still suited up as Ladybug, she powers down back into Marinette, and then is reminded that she's still in her pajamas since transforming to work on decrypting the Grimoire, so she can change into her normal outfit before heading out. She leaves to find Kagami, telling her parents that she's taking a break from her science presentation and receives pastries, giving a piece of one to Tikki due to Marinette's stomach growling. Once she finds Kagami, she jumps on her, and hands her mother the brioche, insisting that it's the perfect opportunity for her to try it. Then she drags Kagami away, telling her that Adrien is at the pool, shooting an ad and that it's the perfect chance for Kagami and Adrien to reconcile. Kagami tells her she doesn't want to reconcile with Adrien, and that she was the one who decided to break up. Marinette insists that she should try and reconcile and pushes her to the swimming pool, without listening to Kagami's protests.
Once there, they discover that the swimming pool had been closed for the shoot. Kagami tries to leave, but Marinette keeps her there.

title: Mr. Pigeon 72
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Mr. Pigeon 72 - Plot
The scene changes to Adrien running into the changing room, and once they're hidden in there, Plagg appears and yells at Adrien that he's lost his mind, scolding him for going out early to swim, however he is quickly silenced when Adrien opens his pool bag, which is filled entirely with cheese. Plagg takes his outburst back and digs in, and Adrien swiftly changes and leaves the room. Then, Adrien is seen to stand on a high diving board, and the camera pans to Bob Roth, with Mr. Ramier standing behind him. Bob Roth is excitedly explaining his plan (which involves Adrien being surrounded by doves when he jumps) for the ad to Gabriel Agreste, who is watching from his tablet, which is propped up in a pool chair. Gabriel points out that Mr. Ramier's birds are not doves, but pigeons, and Bob Roth flips the tablet over, assuring him that they're doves. Mr. Ramier attempts to protest, but Bob Roth silences him, revealing that he has a deal with Mr. Ramier: If the shooting goes well, he will convince the mayor to make a pigeon sanctuary.
They shoot the ad, but Gabriel is unsatisfied, and asks it to be reshot because something is missing.

title: Mr. Pigeon 72
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Mr. Pigeon 72 - Plot
Meanwhile, outside the pool building. Marinette takes a picture of the Gorilla, posting it online and calling Wayhem and Adrien's other fans to distract the Gorilla, and they sneak in. Gabriel determines what is missing and instructs for one of the "doves" to carry up a red rose to Adrien, which he will have in his teeth before diving into the water. Mr. Ramier brings up one of his pigeons with a rose, gets snapped at by Bob Roth for calling it a pigeon, and Adrien protests that he's allergic to pigeons. Bob Roth snaps at him that nothing will happen because they're doves, and Gabriel Agreste states that he, Bob Roth, has 30 minutes to set things up and then proceeds to hang up.
The scene changes to Marinette and Kagami. Marinette unpacks her pool tools, showing them to Kagami, who asks her if she always carries them around. Marinette nervously says she does, and unpacks the swimsuits, running off with Kagami to change.
It switches back to Adrien, who is climbing the stairs to go to the diving board again, and the camera pans to Marinette dragging Kagami along the corridor and hiding behind a pillar.

title: Mr. Pigeon 72
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Mr. Pigeon 72 - Plot
They peak around it, and Marinette excitedly exclaims that she bets Kagami is already falling in love with Adrien again. Kagami indignantly tells her that she isn't, and Marinette says it's because she hasn't seen him in action yet.

title: Mr. Pigeon 72
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Mr. Pigeon 72 - Plot
Adrien jumps, but he sneezes as soon as the pigeon comes up close to him and falls into the water. Bob Roth blames it on Mr. Ramier, who protests that his pigeon was scared by the sneeze. Adrien surfaces from the water, sitting on the pool side and again tries to reason with the other two men that he's allergic to pigeons, but is broken off by another sneeze. Marinette gushes to Kagami about how cute he is and asks Kagami if she feels jittery. Kagami deadpans that she only feels bad for the pigeon trainer and Marinette says it's because her and Adrien's eyes did not meet. Bob Roth gives Adrien something to pinch his nose with so that he won't sneeze, and he jumps again. This time, he again gets distracted in the jump by seeing Kagami and Marinette and falls. Bob Roth scolds Mr. Ramier, and Adrien stands up for him, saying it's his fault, but since Bob Roth does not see Kagami and Marinette as they have hidden again, he insists on blaming it all on Mr. Ramier. He threatens to ban pigeons all over Paris if Mr. Ramier causes his ad to fail.

title: Mr. Pigeon 72
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Mr. Pigeon 72 - Plot
The scene changes to Kagami and Marinette; Marinette is excitedly looking at Kagami, and Kagami just exasperatedly tells her that she just felt extremely uncomfortable, and for Adrien as well because the situation is embarrassing to them. She then tries to leave but Marinette again pulls her back. She decides that Kagami and Adrien are not close enough and has another idea. Gabriel Agreste calls again and asks Bob Roth if everything is ready.

title: Mr. Pigeon 72
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Mr. Pigeon 72 - Plot
Just before Adrien is about to jump, Marinette pulls a resisting Kagami out from behind him. While they are bickering, Kagami's arms slip out from her, and she falls onto Adrien. Adrien expresses surprise that she's there, and she falls onto him in the water, dragging Mr. Ramier's pigeon with them. Mr. Ramier quickly fishes his pigeon out of the water and tries to resuscitate it. Meanwhile, Adrien asks Marinette what she's doing here, and she stammers out a barely sensical reply, and then asks Adrien what he's doing. Adrien, looking resigned but not mad, tells her they're shooting an ad and that the pool should be closed off today because of that. Marinette fakes surprise and understanding that that was why nobody was at the reception, and then stutters that she blames herself for embarrassing him and says she will leave him alone now. While leaving, she slips on the pool and knocks over a few baskets of yellow balls, which fall into the water.

title: Mr. Pigeon 72
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Mr. Pigeon 72 - Plot
Gabriel Agreste tells Bob Roth that the shoot is a failure. Bob Roth attempts to blame it on Mr. Ramier, who protests angrily, telling Bob Roth that his pigeon is the best pigeon in the world, and Gabriel Agreste remarks that it is a pigeon, not a dove. Bob Roth pretends to have been fooled, and yells at Mr. Ramier, firing him and telling Gabriel Agreste that he knows a really good shark trainer. Gabriel hangs up after coldly telling Bob Roth not to disappoint him anymore. In his mansion, he remarks that while the ad shooting was a fiasco, they might be able to get something out of it and enters his lair. Bob Roth takes his anger out on Mr. Ramier, firing him and yelling at him to leave. Outside, Mr. Ramier gets re-akumatized into Mr. Pigeon by Shadow Moth and is given the power to transform people into pigeon minions.

title: Mr. Pigeon 72
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Mr. Pigeon 72 - Plot
He immediately transforms the Gorilla and Adrien's fans into pigeons. Inside the pool building, Marinette is hanging from Kagami's foot, who is trying to leave, and is being dragged across the floor, begging Kagami excitedly to try again, saying she wants to recreate the moment they fall in love. Fed up with Marinette's efforts and refusal to accept that she can try to go steady with Adrien again now that Kagami broke up with him, Kagami attempts to tell her off, but she is turned into a pigeon before she can, much to Marinette's horrified shock, and she noticed the scene and sees Bob Roth get transformed, and spots Adrien running away from those hybrids.
Quickly, she hides in a changing room and the scene changes to Plagg in Adrien's bag, eating his cheese. Plagg notices the commotion and looks out, then expressing his disappointment seeing as they were supposed to have a good time.

title: Mr. Pigeon 72
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Mr. Pigeon 72 - Plot
Marinette transforms into Ladybug, and uses her yo-yo to get to where Adrien is, attempting to save him, but he sneezes by some pigeons, crashing into the wall and is transformed, much to Ladybug and Plagg's horror. Ladybug quickly hides in another changing room, and the pigeons attack the door, trying to transform her into copy of them as well. She calls Cat Noir, asking him to come and that she can't do it alone, but Plagg phases through the wall and tells her that Cat Noir got himself attacked by Mr. Pigeon.
She calls on her Lucky Charm and receives a hand drill, causing Plagg to snidely remark that she won't fit through the very small hole it'll make.

title: Mr. Pigeon 72
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Mr. Pigeon 72 - Plot
Ladybug concentrates and finds a solution, her inner thought process focusing on Plagg, her yo-yo's phone screen, the balls in the water, Alya in her room, and then finally, the drill. She assures Plagg that they don't need to escape. The scene changes to Alya in Marinette's room. Alya seems to have finally understood how to prevent people from getting re-akumatized, but is pulled out of her delight when she realizes that the room is surrounded by pigeons trying to get in. She checks the news, which shows Nadja Chamack hiding behind a car, announcing that Mr. Pigeon is back for the 72nd time and that people are being transformed into his army of raven-pigeon hybrids, before getting transformed herself. Alya then gets a call from Ladybug, who tells her she's stuck at the pool. Alya asks if she should get her out of there, and Ladybug tells her that is too dangerous now, and that she needs Ladybug and Cat Noir to lure Mr. Pigeon to the pool.

title: Mr. Pigeon 72
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Mr. Pigeon 72 - Plot
Alya says she understands, and opens the Miracle Box, getting out the Fox Miraculous and transforming into Rena Rouge. She immediately uses her superpower, causing an illusion of Cat Noir and Ladybug on the rooftops of Paris, looking for Mr. Pigeon. Rena tells Ladybug that the illusions are on their way and receives a thank you. The scene changes to one where Mr. Pigeon's pigeons turns the mayor and two men alongside him into pigeons. Mr. Pigeon watches, ravishing in his work, saying that there is no need for the mayor's permission to create a pigeon sanctuary with the mayor himself as a one of his pigeon friends. Shadow Moth reminds him of having to stop Ladybug and Cat Noir and Mr. Pigeon declares that he will defeat them and turn every person on the world into a pigeon.
Rena's illusion of Cat Noir and Ladybug arrive, challenging Mr.
Pigeon and then fleeing to the pool.
Mr.
Pigeon gives chase, and Ladybug warns Rena to not let anybody touch the illusions, as they will disappear if they're touched.
Ladybug then tells Plagg that it's his turn, who complains about hating water before phasing out of the changing room and into the water.

title: Mr. Pigeon 72
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Mr. Pigeon 72 - Plot
Once the illusions arrive in the pool, Rena lets the illusions get cornered, and they declare their defeat, taking off their Miraculous and de-transforming into Jean Duparc and an unnamed civilian (neither Adrien nor Marinette).
The illusions throw the Miraculous into the pool, and Mr.
Pigeon remarks that his bird friends are bad swimmers, but he is a good swimmer and jumps into the water.
Before he falls in, Plagg bursts out of it, stealing his bird whistle.
Mr.
Pigeon falls into the water, and the illusionary Ladybug and Cat Noir disappear, as well as the Miraculous in the water, causing Shadow Moth to yell in frustrated defeat when he realizes Mr.
Pigeon was tricked and fell for it.
Mr.
Pigeon surfaces, directing his pigeons to get his whistle back from Plagg, and they give chase.
Meanwhile, the real Ladybug drilled a hole into the door of her changing room, and Plagg slips through it with the bird whistle.
She destroys it, quickly purifying the akuma and activates her Miraculous Ladybug, turning everyone back into their old selves again.
In his lair, Shadow Moth swears his usual revenge over being defeated again and his akumatized minion being restored to normal.

title: Mr. Pigeon 72
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Mr. Pigeon 72 - Plot
Plagg returns to Adrien and teasingly asks him if he's still allergic to pigeons. A feather lands on Adrien's shoulder, making him sneeze, and Adrien tells him that he's allergic to them more than ever.
Down next to the pool, Mr. Pigeon reverts back into Mr. Ramier, and Ladybug lands next to him, helping him up. Mr. Ramier sadly realizes that he had been akumatized again, and Ladybug tells him that she wishes she could tell him it was the last time, but admits that she doesn't know how to make that happen. Rena Rouge enters unexpectedly, telling them that she thinks Ladybug can indeed make it happen. She then tells Ladybug that she was so focused on her role as the Guardian that she forgot that she's Ladybug, and proceeds to explain that there isn't anything in the Grimoire, because it is not just a book of rules and solutions, but also a book containing all the information the Guardians found out about the Miraculous until now.
Ladybug summarizes that because she is Ladybug and her power is the power of Creation, she can create, and Rena Rouge nods her on, telling her that the only limits she has are the ones she sets for herself.

title: Mr. Pigeon 72
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Mr. Pigeon 72 - Plot
Ladybug then concentrates, activating a new power that transforms her suit. Her fingertips turn black, and the red part of her suit with black spots changes to a red dotted black design. Additionally, her suit's black neck piece is replaced with a red one featuring a zipper adorned with a Ladybug charm. She then pulls out a black Magical Charm from her yoyo. Rena Rouge, excitedly inquiring about the changes, asks Ladybug what happened to her suit and what she is holding. Ladybug explains that it’s a Magical Charm. She hands it to Mr. Ramier, instructing him to keep it with him at all times to prevent him from being re-akumatized. Overjoyed, he eagerly tells his pigeons that they won’t be acting like Paris’ villains anymore, and he leaves with a spring in his step, taking his pigeons with him. Rena Rouge and Ladybug share their trademark "Pound It" fist bump. Meanwhile, Adrien, who had been watching, dreamily remarks that Ladybug is truly miraculous.
The scene changes again to dark clouds and rain; Marinette is standing outside with Kagami, holding a black umbrella over them.

title: Mr. Pigeon 72
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Mr. Pigeon 72 - Plot
Tatsu arrives and opens the door for Kagami, but Kagami doesn't leave; instead, she tells Marinette that she felt the beating heart, and everything Marinette wanted her to feel, but not in her, saying that instead, she felt it all in Marinette.
Smiling genuinely, she tells her that she thinks Adrien is perfect for Marinette, and then leaves with Tatsu.
Adrien then comes out of the pool and realizes that the umbrella Marinette is using is the one he gave her at the start of the year from "Stoneheart", and expresses his pleasant surprise that she kept it the entire time.
Marinette stammers that she can give it back now, but Adrien tells her that she needs it to get home, and then offers to drop her off as the Gorilla arrives to take Adrien home.
Marinette nods, going next to him, and then asks if he would like to walk home with her.
Adrien looks tempted, but then saddens, saying that he has his Chinese classes and that his father is demanding.
He quickly perks up again, telling her that he'll see her tomorrow in school.
She says her goodbye, and Adrien runs to the car, getting in while looking at her.

title: Mr. Pigeon 72
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Mr. Pigeon 72 - Plot
Not paying attention, he hits his head on the car roof, and they both giggle, and he leaves after they wave goodbye.
Kagami, who had been watching, smilingly remarks that they were made for each other, and tells Tatsu to leave. Tikki then appears out of Marinette's purse, asking her if she's alright, and Marinette assures her than everything is fine, and tells her that a friend told her that life is not about waiting for the storm to pass, but about learning to dance in the rain, referencing Alya's advice at the beginning of the episode. Marinette excitedly jumps into a puddle, ending the episode.

title: Mr. Pigeon 72
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Mr. Pigeon 72 - Plot Developments
In this episode Ladybug learns about Magical Charms and gets a new outfit.
It's revealed that the Ladybug Miraculous holders are the ones that set the limits of their own power. With her determination to prevent any more re-akumatizations, Ladybug is able to awaken a new power that gives her a new outfit and the power to create magical charms that are able to protect those they are given to from being reakumatized.
The way Marinette figured it out is one of the most common ways most fictional superheroes or protagonists have or gotten one step closer to mastering their powers or solving their problems.
According to Alya, the grimoire is only filled with what the Guardians knew thus far. Meaning that Ladybug is the first Miraculous holder to transform her powers into new ones.
Which explains why Master Fu taunted Hawk Moth in "Miracle Queen", unlike Hawk Moth but like Marinette, he understood the meaning of the butterfly and until Gabriel learns to let it go of his pain as well as improving himself from the inside for the better, he won't have his full power.
As stated by Ladybug, this episode happens during the spring school break.

title: Mr. Pigeon 72
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Mr. Pigeon 72 - Plot Developments
It has never been confirmed or denied if the Quantic Universe school system in Paris, France follows the same zoning system as it real counterpart. But if it does, then due to Paris being apart of the C section school zone, their spring break would be near April's end to early May.
Just as Hawk Moth can control his akumatized villains and Mayura with her sentimonsters at a distance, Rena Rouge can do the same with her illusions (humanoid ones) at a distance too but it's unknown what happens when said illusions get too far from a Fox Miraculous user.
Marinette, Adrien, and Kagami are seen in swimsuits for the first time. This is also the first time Adrien is seen shirtless.
This is the second time Cat Noir is not seen physically throughout the whole episode, following "Style Queen".
Similarly, the reason why he doesn't appear is because Adrien can't transform, due to being disabled in some way by the titular villain.
It's revealed that Marinette has a map of Paris in her room which plots every akumatized villain's appearance. Post-its with star stickers beside them indicate how many times they've appeared (by the beginning of the episode)

title: Mr. Pigeon 72/Transcript
text:
Mr. Pigeon 72/Transcript - Intro
[ Theme Song ]
Ladybug: Sure, it's amazing being Ladybug. I've got these powers, kwamis, but can you imagine I could've prevented Shadow Moth from creating villains in the first place?! Ha! He'd be ruined! Have you noticed that Shadow Moth seems to re-akumatize people much more often these days? Do you know why? Because he gets to know them and figures out how to manipulate them better!
Alya: You're right. I was akumatized four times as Lady Wifi because I was obsessed with with you! I knew you were hiding something from me and it drove me crazy.
Ladybug: I had to keep it a secret.
Alya: I know girl. But now that I know the truth, I've got your back! (notices the large amount of times Xavier Ramier has been akumatized on the billboard) What? Mr. Pigeon has already been akumatized 71 times?!
Ladybug: He's just a harmless guy trying to take care of his pigeons. It's so not fair! I'd promised him I'd find a way to keep him safe from Shadow Moth, but I just can't figure it out. (groans) I don't understand a thing in this spell book!
Wayzz: Master Fu didn't understand much in it either, but he was able to do it with proper time and rest!

title: Mr. Pigeon 72/Transcript
text:
Mr. Pigeon 72/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: Oh! Hold that thought, Wayzz. I think this is it! (sprinkles some pepper into the pot with a confident smirk, only to cause an explosion)
Ladybug: Ugh, I was sure that "spicy little rock" would be pepper.
Trixx: Alya, help us reason with her, please!
Alya: Marinette, how long have you been working on this?
Ladybug: I dunno, six-seven days, maybe ten. Now that we're on spring break, I finally have time to put my whole heart into it!
Alya: When was the last time you worked on one of your own designs?
Ladybug: I do loads of designing! Look! (pointing to the contraption at her door) I designed a security system so that nobody can enter my room when I'm not in it. And if I put on this hat (puts on modified hat, complete with headphones to cover her ears that are attached by wires to homemade satellite dishes sticking out of the sides of the hat) I hear everything that's going on in here, even when I'm out of the room.

title: Mr. Pigeon 72/Transcript
text:
Mr. Pigeon 72/Transcript - Intro
Alya: I'm gonna have to break it to you because I'm the only one who can. (shouting in Marinette's ear, causing her to stumble back in shocked surprise) THIS IS TOTALLY INSANE! Girl, trust your BFF. When I'm researching something obsessively and I can't think of anything else, that's when my mind can get really blocked. You know what you need most right now? A break!
Ladybug: No way! No breaks until I find out how to keep Shadow Moth from re-akumatizing people! (opens jar and pours contents into the pot with a frustrated, gritted teeth, scowl on her face, causing another explosion)
Sabine: Tom, this science experiment is starting to worry me.
Tom: But you know that she asked us not to bother her.
Alya: I get that you wanna see the end of Shadow Moth, but you know what my grandmother always says? "Life is not waiting for the storm to pass, it's learning to dance in the rain."
Ladybug: Dance? But Alya, how can I dance when I know Shadow Moth's going after the people I love?!
(Trixx looks at her, concerned. Alya, noticing the pictures of Adrien on the ground)
Alya: I bet you had no idea Adrien and Kagami aren't seeing each other anymore.

title: Mr. Pigeon 72/Transcript
text:
Mr. Pigeon 72/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: (quickly turns around) What?! Are you serious?! (Trixx and Alya wink at each other) I have to go and console Kagami! (Trixx and Alya, surprised) Poor thing, she must be devastated!
Alya: Hang on, don't you mean you have to go and console Adrien?
Ladybug: Why would I console Adrien?
Alya: The house-and-three-kids-and-a-hamster-named-whatever and all that? Does that ring a bell?
Ladybug: There's no way we could be together anyway, I can't even talk to him! And besides... I have... no more feelings for Adrien... I don't love him anymore, there! And Kagami is perfect for him. I mean she has no problem talking to him. And they fence together. (looking down at the Adrien picture in her hand) Poor girl, she must be so upset.
Alya: This is a joke, right? Or maybe all those days locked in your room, breathing magical fumes, must have gone to your brain?
Ladybug: Alya, Kagami doesn't have any friends in Paris besides me. I have to go and console her.

title: Mr. Pigeon 72/Transcript
text:
Mr. Pigeon 72/Transcript - Intro
Alya: Fine! Go console Kagami if you want to. As long as you're outside, getting some fresh air, and thinking about something else, it's all good. Meanwhile, I'm gonna go through all these notes and see if I can make any sense out of it.
Ladybug: Huh! You would do that?
Alya: You're not alone anymore, Marinette. I've got your back, remember?
Ladybug: (hugs Alya before attempting to head out of her room) Thanks, Alya.
Alya: (grabs Ladybug's arm and pulls her back) Aren't you forgetting something?
Ladybug: (realizing she's still transformed) Oops, spots off. (de-transforms, catches Tikki and puts her in her purse)
Alya: Aren't you still forgetting something?
Marinette: Why? No. (gasps) Of course! My pool bag!
Alya: Uh, Marinette... (points to her clothes)
Marinette: (realizing) Oh! My pajamas!
Sabine: (sees Marinette running to the door) Ah, sweetie! That science project of yours is finally done?
Marinette: Yes I- (stomach growls) I mean, no, but Alya's helping me so I'm gonna go take a break. (stomach growls again)
Tom: (holds up basket of pastries) Maybe you should take something to eat on the road. (Marinette grabs the basket)

title: Mr. Pigeon 72/Transcript
text:
Mr. Pigeon 72/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (muffled by a croissant in her mouth) Thanks, Dad! (runs outside)
Marinette: (finishes her croissant and hands a piece to Tikki) Now, let's go cheer up Kagami!
Kagami: (practicing with her staff. Her phone rings, she answers) Hello?
Marinette: (over phone) Kagami! Where are you?
Kagami: In the Tuileries Garden.
Marinette: Perfect! Don't move. I'm on my way!
Kagami: Actually now is not a good time to— (Marinette interrupts)
Marinette: I'll always be there for you, Kagami. (Kagami puts her phone in her pocket. Marinette jumping on her from behind, much to her surprise.) Kagami!!! Ooh! Would you like a brioche, Mrs. Tsurugi? (sets basket on Tomoe's lap)
Kagami: Mother, you remember Marinette?
Tomoe: (calmly) Yes, I distinctly remember your very... "unique" friend.
Marinette: I'll bring your daughter back in an hour. Oh! Try those brioches stuffed with fresh fruit. It's one of my dad's new recipes! They're delish!
(Tomoe sees the girls leaving and notices the basket with food. She tries one and likes it.)
Tomoe: Mmm.
Marinette: Adrien is at the pool, getting ready to shoot his next big ad campaign! It's the perfect place for the two of you to make up!

title: Mr. Pigeon 72/Transcript
text:
Mr. Pigeon 72/Transcript - Intro
Kagami: You know Adrien's schedule by heart?
Marinette: Yeah, for the next three years, duh! But who cares? 'Cause today's the day that I'm getting you two back together.
Kagami: I don't want to get back together with Adrien. I was the one who decided to break up and—
Marinette: Of course you did! You felt that somehow you weren't worthy of him, but you're wrong, Kagami. You're strong, you're perfect! He's perfect!
Kagami: Marinette!
Marinette: You're meant for each other! Right now I get it, it's out of sight, out of mind. But the second you lay eyes on him again, you'll both blush and stutter, talk nonsense about big houses, three kids, and a hamster, and everything will be wonderful! (Kagami calls Marinette's phone) Sorry. Hello?
Kagami: Marinette, I don't want to be with Adrien anymore. He let me down. (ends phone call)
Marinette: Just trust me! I can prove that he's worthy of you! Of course, makes sense. They've closed the pool to rehearse the commercial in private.
Kagami: Perfect. Let's go. (Kagami tries to walk away, but Marinette stops her)
Marinette: Absolutely! Let's go... inside! By distracting the bodyguard.

title: Mr. Pigeon 72/Transcript
text:
Mr. Pigeon 72/Transcript - Intro
Plagg: I'm gonna have to break it to ya 'cause I'm the only one who can. (screams into the screen) This is totally insane!! (faces Adrien) Jumping into freezing water first thing in the morning when we could be peacefully eating cheese? (Adrien opens his pool bag, revealing that it is filled with camembert. Plagg gasps and happily dives in.) I take back everything I said! Everything is great! Just great!
Bob Roth: Okay, now picture it, Gabe. Adrien is on top of the Eiffel Tower, bathed in sunlight. He jumps off, slow motion. Doves flutter all around him as if his fall would never end. The catchphrase, "dive into romantic, magical, eternal Paris!" And then splash! Right into a giant glass of sparkling golden juice! Backshot! "Splash, the new fragrance by Gabriel."
Gabriel: (on tablet) Those birds are not doves, they're pigeons.
Bob Roth: Not at all! They're doves!
Mr. Ramier: My birds aren't do-

title: Mr. Pigeon 72/Transcript
text:
Mr. Pigeon 72/Transcript - Intro
Bob Roth: Listen, Ramier, I know those are pigeons, but it is in both of our best interests if Agreste believes they're doves! Mine, because he's paying me a lot of money. And yours, because I can convince the mayor to create a space specifically dedicated to pigeons in Paris. So, for today, your pigeons are doves! Got it? Okay everybody, places! Action!
(Adrien goes to the diving board and dives into the pool as he is surrounded by pigeons)
Gabriel: Something... is missing.
Marinette: (snaps picture and makes a post, giggling mischievously)
Wayhem: Adrien's at the pool! There!
(Wayhem and Adrien's fans try to enter, but Adrien's bodyguard stops them; Marinette and Kagami make their way inside unbeknownst to the bodyguard)
Gabriel: We've got "magical Paris" and "eternal Paris" but we're missing "romantic Paris." A red rose! I want one of these doves to bring a rose in mid-flight to my son. He'll take it between his teeth before he enters the water. Then it will be perfect!
(Mr. Ramier sounds his bird call and one of the pigeons immediately flies over to his suitcase and takes a rose; then flies onto his shoulder)

title: Mr. Pigeon 72/Transcript
text:
Mr. Pigeon 72/Transcript - Intro
Mr. Ramier: You can count on Edgar! No animal's more obedient than this sweet little pigeon.
Bob Roth: Dove! They're doves!
Adrien: Hang on, I'm allergic to pigeons. If they get too close-
Bob Roth: Nothing is gonna happen because they're doves!
Gabriel: I'll give you thirty minutes to set this all up. (disconnects)
Bob Roth: You heard the man, Ramier. You better not let me down!
Marinette: And now, time for camouflage! (takes out different items)
Kagami: Do you always carry these things with you?
Marinette: Of course! I have to be rea- I mean you have to be ready for any opportunity whenever you run into Adrien. Everything is retractable and folds up neatly. Even this fancy ball gown. You'll be needing it when you get back together with Adrien. (Kagami shakes her head) Here are the swimsuits! No time to lose! (pulls Kagami off-screen)
Marinette: (giggles) I bet you're already starting to fall in love with him again.
Kagami: No.
Marinette: That's just 'cause you haven't seen him in action yet.
Bob Roth: Action!
(Adrien jumps off the diving board but gets too close to Edgar, causing him to sneeze)
Adrien: Aah! (falls into pool)

title: Mr. Pigeon 72/Transcript
text:
Mr. Pigeon 72/Transcript - Intro
Bob Roth: Your pigeon isn't up for the job! He's not supposed to come back with the rose!
Mr. Ramier: The sneeze frightened him.
Adrien: I told you, I'm allergic to pigeons! (sneezes)
Marinette: Did you see how handsome he is? Did you feel your heart beat faster? Did you get the shivers? Tingles in your fingers?
Kagami: What I felt was sorry for that poor pigeon tamer.
Marinette: It's because you haven't looked into each others' eyes yet! Oh! I've got an idea!
Bob Roth: Here, for your allergy to the doves. (hands Adrien a nose clip)
(Adrien once again dives into the pool, but not before seeing Marinette carrying a protesting Kagami)
Kagami: What are you doing? Put me down right now!
Marinette: I'm helping your eyes meet! There, he's looking at you! Look at him! Look at him!
(Adrien unknowingly splashes into the pool)
Bob Roth: This cannot be happening. How complicated is it to deliver a rose in mid-flight to a model in mid-dive?!
Adrien: It's my fault. I thought, I saw one of my friends from school. (Adrien and Bob Roth look in the direction where Marinette and Kagami were, but they hid somewhere else)

title: Mr. Pigeon 72/Transcript
text:
Mr. Pigeon 72/Transcript - Intro
Bob Roth: Well, I don't see anyone, except a stupid bird that's incapable of doing what it's been asked to do and that's gonna get banned from all of Paris, if it continues to ruin the rehearsals for my commercial!
Marinette: (Smiling akwardly)
Kagami: No, Marinette, I didn't feel anything, except for shame for me, for Adrien, and for this ridiculously embarrassing situation. I'm leaving.
Marinette: But, it's because you were too far apart. When you're close together, that you really feel it. Oh, I got an idea!
Gabriel: (on tablet) Are you ready?
Bob Roth: Of course! (Looks angrily at Mr. Ramier)
Mr. Ramier: (To Edgar) Remember Edgar, if Mr. Roth is happy, he will have a word with the mayor and pigeons will live in Paris happily ever after.
Bob Roth: Action!
(Mr. Ramier once again sounds the bird call. Just as Adrien is about to leap into the pool, the door behind him opens and Marinette is pulling Kagami)
Kagami: Marinette, stop it! This is completely crazy!
Marinette: Love is crazy! So, stop thinking too much and dive in!
(Marinette accidentally lets go of Kagami and bumps into Adrien, causing them both to fall off the diving board.)
Adrien: Marinette?

title: Mr. Pigeon 72/Transcript
text:
Mr. Pigeon 72/Transcript - Intro
(Marinette and Adrien fall into the swimming pool. Edgar also gets bumped by Adrien and crashes into the pool as well.)
Mr. Ramier Edgar!
(Mr. Ramier tries to resuscitate him as Marinette and Adrien get out from the pool.)
Adrien: Marinette, what on earth are you doing here?!
Marinette: Me? Well um- I just came here to do a few laps and wind you up- I mean, unwind... How about you?
Adrien: Well, we're in rehearsal for a commercial. The pool is supposed to be closed.
Marinette: To the post? Oh well, that's why there was no one at the front desk. Oh boy, I wouldn't want to kiss you- I mean, keep you, keep you from your job. So I'll be on my way. (trips into a stack of crates, causing everything in them to fall out)

Bob Roth: It's not my fault! It's his fault!
Mr. Ramier: (angry) How dare you?! Edgar is my best friend! The most intelligent and loyal pigeon there ever was!
Gabriel: (on tablet; uninterested) So, it is a pigeon!
Bob Roth: What?! This is a pigeon?! Ramier, how dare you cheat me out of the real thing?! So sorry, Gabriel, I'm gonna find a replacement immediately! I know a very good shark trainer!

title: Mr. Pigeon 72/Transcript
text:
Mr. Pigeon 72/Transcript - Intro
Gabriel: (on tablet) Do not disappoint me again.
(Uninterested, Gabriel coldly cuts the connection, which surprises Bob.)
Gabriel: This commercial is turning into a fiasco, but maybe we can salvage something beneficial from it after all, my love. (enters his lair)

(Deeply hurt, Mr. Ramier leaves the pool sadly, along with Edgar.)

Shadow Moth: I sense that this time, Mr. Ramier's distress has reached new depths. Fly my lovely akuma and evilize his unhinged heart!
Shadow Moth: Mr. Pigeon, I am Shadow Moth. Since humans and pigeons cannot live together in harmony...
Mr. Ramier: I will turn every human into a pigeon!
(Mr. Ramier is re-akumatized into Mr. Pigeon for 72nd time. Once the transformation is complete, he sounds his bird call, causing all of the pigeons to be turned from medium gray to very dark gray and now look like ravens.)

title: Mr. Pigeon 72/Transcript
text:
Mr. Pigeon 72/Transcript - Intro
Shadow Moth: (voiceover) What would Paris be without its pigeons, and without Mr. Pigeon?
Mr. Pigeon: From now on, everyone will have to accept us my friends, because everyone will be just like us!
(The raven-pigeons start turning other people into raven-pigeon hybrids)
Marinette: Kagami, please just one last try! Now I know what I got wrong! I haven't gone far back enough in time! We have to recreate the moment when you two first fell in love!

Marinette: Kagami?! (notices all the raven-pigeon hybrids all around the pool) Adrien! (She gasps in fear and hides in a changing room)

Marinette: Tikki, spots on! (She transforms into Ladybug in a flash of purple and swings away to save Adrien)
(Adrien tries to run away but sneezes due to the pigeons and runs right into a changing room door. A raven-pigeon hybrid strikes him.)
Ladybug and Plagg: Adrien!
Ladybug: This is not the time to get trapped! (shuts door to changing room)
Ladybug: Cat Noir, hurry up, I'm not gonna make it through this without you!

title: Mr. Pigeon 72/Transcript
text:
Mr. Pigeon 72/Transcript - Intro
(Plagg phases through a wall)
Plagg: You're gonna have to, Ladybug. Cat Noir's been feathered! (Ladybug gasps)
Ladybug: Lucky Charm! (receives a hand drill)

Nadja Chamack: (news report on Alya's phone) Mr. Pigeon is back for the 72nd time, and now he's transforming Parisians- (gets turned into raven-pigeon hybrid)
(Alya's phone rings. She answers the phone.)

Alya: You want me to get you out of there?

<poem>

title: Mr. Pigeon 72/Transcript
text:

Alya: Got it! (opens Marinette's sewing box and takes the Fox Miraculous) Ladybug needs us.

text:

title: Mr. Pigeon 72/Transcript
text:
Mr. Pigeon 72/Transcript - Intro

title: Mr. Pigeon 72/Transcript
text:

You're the one blushing and stuttering and saying silly things every time that you see Adrien. You're the one who knows his schedule by heart for the next three years. You're right, Marinette. Adrien is perfect. He's perfect - for you.

text:

(Kagami doesn't say anything and gets into Tatsu, closes the door and drives away just as Adrien gets out of the pool and sees Marinette)

(Marinette becomes shocked and gasps)

text:

title: Mudangbeolle
text:
Mudangbeolle - Intro
was a Korean woman who lived during the Imjin war. She was a past Miraculous holder, wielding the Ladybug Miraculous and transforming into a ladybug-themed superhero when Tikki inhabited it.

title: Mudangbeolle
text:
Mudangbeolle - Appearance
Physical appearance
She had pale skin and long black hair.
As Mudangbeolle
Mudangbeolle wore a jumpsuit with black waist and legs with a red top with black spots. The edges of the upper side of the suit (inspired by the hanbok) are black and white, and there are two ladybug-like ornaments at the front with a red ribbon that falls down her waist. Her hair is tied in a ponytail with a red barrette with black spots, and she has red spot-like marks on her face: two on her cheeks and one at her forehead.

title: Mudangbeolle
text:
Mudangbeolle - Abilities
If this past Ladybug Miraculous holder had the same powers as the current Ladybug, she had enhanced abilities and the superpowers Lucky Charm and Miraculous Ladybug. She also had the yo-yo for a weapon.

title: Mudangbeolle
text:
Mudangbeolle - Trivia
Her husband had been kidnapped during the Imjin war.
She met a Korean admiral Yi Sun-sin who was also a Miraculous holder.
"Mudangbeolle" means "Ladybug" in Korean.
It is also a pun on "mudang", Korean shamans who also have spot-like marks on their faces.
She is the second past Ladybug Miraculous holder to have any known family following Jeanne d'Arc.
She is the fourth known Asian Ladybug Miraculous holder, being the third chronologically, following Piáo Chóng and Tentomushi and preceding Bọ rùa and Marinette.
For some reason she does not make a cameo appearance in "Reunion".

title: Multiplication
text:
Multiplication - Intro
"" is a season 5 episode of the series Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. Based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 2nd written and produced episode of season 5. It is also the 106th written and produced episode of the series overall.

title: Multiplication
text:
Multiplication - Synopsis
When Marinette becomes convinced that her feelings for Adrien caused her defeat against Monarch as Ladybug, she decides to give up on her love for the young schoolboy. Besides, as Ladybug, she's getting ready to fight a more powerful than ever Monarch, with Cat Noir's help. But as the days go by, not a single akumatized shows up to torment Paris. Could Monarch possibly have given up?
Disney+
For the first time, our heroes have no one to face!
Netflix
Upset that her love for Adrien led to losing the Kwamis, Marinette grows closer to Cat Noir as they battle a foe intent on destroying Paris' monuments.

title: Multiplication
text:
Multiplication - Plot
At sunset, on the rooftops of the Jardins du Trocadéro, Ladybug watches a live TVi channel broadcast on her yoyo about the heroes being defeated by Shadow Moth in "Strikeback". Ladybug zooms in on Flairmidable from a recording to show it to Cat Noir, mentioning that although she thought she had given Adrien the Dog Miraculous, she did not know it was actually Félix. While Ladybug goes on the internet to search for more information about Félix, a furious Su-Han appears, accusing Ladybug for failing as a Guardian for losing all the Miraculous.
In his lair, Monarch de-transforms back to his civilian self.
He tells the helplessly terrified Kwamis that Fluff is in the possession of Bunnyx, but assures them that he still has plans in store for the rest of them.
Meanwhile, Ladybug and Cat Noir argue back against Su-Han, accusing him of not trusting them enough.
This causes Su-Han to breakdown and apologize, as him being distracted by what the modern world has to offer has caused him to fail guiding the duo.
Ladybug assures him that everyone makes mistakes, but Su-Han decides to head back to the temple to get reinforcements.

title: Multiplication
text:
Multiplication - Plot
Ladybug and Cat Noir decide to track down Félix by eating their space power-ups, transforming into Cosmobug and Astrocat respectively.
Whilst travelling, Cosmobug visits Félix's Wikipage to find out more info about him; as it turns out, he was the son of an American billionaire named Colt Fathom.
In the evening, they enter Félix's apartment in London and speak to his mother, Amélie Graham de Vanily, about her son's whereabouts.
Amélie claims that her son was not home when she woke up because Félix was supposed to go to Adrien's house, but she thanks the heroes for their help.
As they are about to go back to Paris, Cosmobug asks Astrocat if he thinks Félix could have been a victim of Monarch, and Astrocat replies that he is uncertain.
A crestfallen Cosmobug says Félix was their only lead on getting back the Miraculous.

title: Multiplication
text:
Multiplication - Plot
In Paris, Cosmobug de-transforms back into Marinette in the sewers and gives Tikki a macaroon and goes back to her room, having memories of the Kwamis roaming around her room. She sadly puts her sewing box with the Miracle Box inside away in her chest drawer; after giving Tikki a reassuring smile, she eventually calls Alya to invite her over for a sleepover. Astrocat de-transforms into Adrien in his bathroom, giving Plagg a piece of cheese, then has an envisioned memory of Félix telling him that they were going to dress up as each other like they did when they were younger. Adrien, realizing that he should've taken Marinette's advice of standing up to his father instead of agreeing with Félix, goes to Gabriel's atelier to tell Gabriel that he doesn't want to be a model anymore firmly. Gabriel, despite being busy, accepts this with no worry whatsoever, causing a disbelieved Adrien to leave him be.

title: Multiplication
text:
Multiplication - Plot
During their sleepover, Marinette tells Alya about everything that had happen, and Alya tries to reassure her but Marinette believes this is all her fault, declaring she will have to try to stop loving Adrien because he distracts her from doing her duty, and she has to stop now more than ever. Just then, Adrien suddenly video calls Marinette, who is afraid of answering, so Alya picks up the phone instead. Marinette tells Alya to tell Adrien that she is not there, but when Adrien informs Alya that his father let him stop being a model, an overjoyed Marinette grabs the phone to congratulate him. The call ends with Adrien admitting that he really appreciates everything Marinette has done for him ever since he started school. Before he goes to bed, Adrien realizes how special Marinette truly is. Later, Gabriel looks out from his office window and sees that Nathalie has returned from the train, although they do not directly interact with each other due to their fallout. Shortly after, Nathalie goes to check on Adrien, who is already fast asleep. Grinning at him, she walks out of his room.

title: Multiplication
text:
Multiplication - Plot
The next day at Collège Françoise Dupont, Alim Kubdel comes to Miss Bustier's class to announce that Ladybug had authorized him to say that his daughter Alix has been chosen to be Bunnyx; she will be travelling back in time to protect her Miraculous, and she will return once Monarch is defeated. An evidently pregnant Miss Bustier assures everyone that not everyone needs to be a superhero to support Ladybug and Cat Noir in these hard times, but Mylène expresses her fear of Monarch, and even Max states that Monarch has 78.95% of the Miraculous and it's unknown if he is going to win. Ivan promises to protect Mylène, and that she can get past her fears by doing Yoga. However, Chloé argues that because Ladybug and Cat Noir won't give up their Miraculous already, they're putting everyone in danger, and that she could've helped them if she was still Queen Bee, but Lila dejects this, mentioning that everyone makes mistakes, and the young Ladybug, who has many burdens and responsibilities, should be forgiven for hers. The entire class agrees to support Ladybug.

title: Multiplication
text:
Multiplication - Plot
A montage showcases the events of the next few weeks: to resist Monarch's reign, Mylène teaches her own yoga class, Nora teaches Alya and Nino how to defend for themselves, and Ladybug and Cat Noir do various patrols. However, disinterest increasingly grows as no akumatization occurs; less and less people attend the yoga class, with only Ivan eventually being the only person to attend; Nora and her standees play video games instead; Ladybug and Cat Noir even pass their patrol times with card games. During all of this, Adrien grows more affectionate towards Marinette, attempting to kiss her whenever they meet at school; Marinette, still trying to grow out of her crush on Adrien, rejects these kissing attempts through offering handshakes, irritating Alya and Nino. Meanwhile, Adrien grows suspicious of his father seemingly allying closer with Tomoe Tsurugi. In an unknown tech scanning place, Gabriel handles an operation in which Adrien and Lila take turns standing in the middle of the room, lifting their arms for a the scanning machine to process them.

title: Multiplication
text:
Multiplication - Plot
A few days later, when Adrien tries to kiss Marinette again with Alya's help this time, Ikari Gozen appears at Françoise Dupont, claiming she wants to destroy the old Paris and create a brand new city. Marinette and Adrien hide in an alleyway and metro station respectively to transform. Marinette, who is still shaken from her losing the Miraculous, is motivated by Alya and later Tikki, with Tikki assuring her not to let doubt get to her.

title: Multiplication
text:
Multiplication - Plot
Ladybug and Cat Noir begin to battle against Ikari Gozen, to no success. On the rooftops, Ladybug tells Cat Noir that only his Cataclysm can destroy Ikari Gozen's akumatized object - her sword - but Cat Noir can't reach her because she is too fast. Unexpectedly, Ikari Gozen uses the power of Multitude to multiply herself into twelve clones to fight Ladybug and Cat Noir. Now jokingly dubbed "Ikari Dozen", she continues to destroy countless buildings and even the Eiffel Tower. Ladybug deduces that Ikari Gozen must have the Mouse Miraculous, and the duo aim to get that Miraculous back next. Summoning her Lucky Charm, Ladybug gets a fishing rod. She lures the clones to the school, where Ikari Gozen thrusts her sword into a window, causing it get stuck in a room. Cat Noir Cataclysms the sword; it gets destroyed, releasing the Megakuma, which Ladybug captures and purifies. When Tomoe is deakumatized, Ladybug and Cat Noir ask her if she has the Mouse Miraculous, but as it turns out, she does not.

title: Multiplication
text:
Multiplication - Plot
As she and Cat Noir are about to detransform, Ladybug restores the damage with her Miraculous Ladybug, and gives Tomoe a Magical Charm. While driving away in Tatsu, Tomoe, via a smartring, tells Gabriel that "the prototype worked". At a tech conference, Gabriel makes an announcement of his latest creation: smartrings called Alliance. As it turns out, Adrien and Lila are the rings' virtual assisstants; this was the reason why Gabriel had scanned them, to effectively relieve Adrien of his modelling career. The rings also include akuma alerts created by Tomoe. Adrien, Gabriel, Lila, and Tomoe are congratulated onstage for their participations.
In a post end card scene, in their home in London, Amélie knocks on a bedroom door to tell someone that it is tea time: said person is Félix. Amélie assures Félix not to worry, claiming she'll protect him from those who think he is a villain. After his mother leaves, Félix wears the Peacock Miraculous and Duusu appears, asking where Nathalie is, and Félix if he is his new holder. Félix claims he is much more than that.

text:

Some details can be detected from the article about Félix on the Wikipedia copy shown on Ladybug's yo-yo:
The image of Félix is this wiki's header image of Félix when this episode was still in production.
The family tree on that site is almost identical to the Agreste family tree as seen on this wiki. It is unknown if this is a deliberate nod to this site or not.
According to it, he is a triple medalist in kung fu and horsemanship, a chess prodigy, and the youngest to graduate high school in England.
The words on the Wikipedia copy are also backwards. Once translated backwards, they identify as the English words Born, Nationality, Family and Activity.
The first half of this episode occurs on the same day as most of "Risk" and the total duration of "Strikeback" and "Evolution".
This holds the record for most episodes happening during the same day, being four.
The vision callbacks of Marinette and Félix in "Risk" were reused and reanimated.
Before Su-Han arrives, Ladybug mentions they should use "hyper speed", which possibly suggests one of the Miraculous potions grants speed powers.

Furthermore, this reveals that the events of season 4 have occurred within four or so months.
It's revealed that Félix's last name is Fathom, and that his father was Colt Fathom, an American billionaire.
It's also revealed that Colt Fathom died in the previous year, making it the first time death is explicitly mentioned in the show.
It's revealed that the Graham de Vanily family is part of the British aristocracy, with Amélie having the noble title of "Lady".
Since Émilie is also part of the Graham de Vanily family, it's possible she also held the title of "Lady" like her sister.

title: Multiplication
text:

Despite Amélie telling Ladybug and Cat Noir that she doesn't know where her son is at the beginning of the episode, it's revealed in the post-endcard scene that she lied to them; Félix had returned home, yet she was doing her best to protect her son from the superheroes who think he is a villain.
Due to her being unaware that Cat Noir is Adrien, she technically lied right in front of her own nephew.
Her naivety was similar to Shifu's from Kung Fu Panda as both were blind from what their love for their children was turning them into.
She acted just like her brother-in-law and Tomoe condemning their children in situations or consequences most parents should never put their children.

title: Mullo/History
text:
Mullo/History - Intro
Mullo is the kwami connected to the Mouse Miraculous. Currently, she lets Mylène Haprèle transform into Polymouse. She temporarily allowed Marinette Dupain-Cheng to transform into Multimouse.

title: Mullo/History
text:
Mullo/History - Before Season 1
When the concept of Multiplication came into existence, Mullo came into existence. Before the Miraculous jewels were created, Mullo and the other kwamis traveled all over the universe unable to interact with humans. Then, thousands of years ago, a mage created the Miraculouses. When their Miraculous was not being worn, Mullo was dormant in the Mouse Miraculous, which was stored inside the Miracle Box.

title: Mullo/History
text:
Mullo/History - [[Season 1]]
During season 1, Mullo was dormant in the Mouse Miraculous.

title: Mullo/History
text:
Mullo/History - [[Season 2]]
During season 2, Mullo was dormant in the Mouse Miraculous.
In "Sandboy", Mullo was celebrating Nooroo's birthday in the Miracle Box with the other kwamis, and they were excited when Tikki and Plagg arrived. She marveled at the gift Tikki brought, a marker, and played with the other kwamis. When the time came to find Nooroo, Mullo got into position in an effort to contact him, but the kwamis ended up contacting his wielder instead. Upon hearing his voice, the kwamis shuddered at the thought of being his slave and prevented themselves from being discovered, they all cut off the connection. They realized if they contacted Nooroo's wielder rather than Nooroo, then someone must have been akumatized and that Tikki's and Plagg's wielders would be in danger.

title: Mullo/History
text:
Mullo/History - [[Season 3]]
During season 3, Mullo was dormant in the Mouse Miraculous.
In "Kwamibuster", after Tikki and Plagg had been captured by the titular villain, Mullo's Miraculous was activated by Marinette so she could become Multimouse. Along with the other kwamis, the power of Multitude, and the fusion of some other Miraculouses, they were able to save Tikki and Plagg, deakumatize Olga Mendeleiev and keep the heroes identities safe. Upon dividing Mullo, the other kwamis praised Ladybug as the plan was a success and returned to the Miracle Box and Master Fu.
In "Miracle Queen", Mullo was activated alongside Stompp, Roaar, Ziggy, Daizzi, Barkk, Orikko and Fluff by Queen Bee with the intent to use them against Ladybug and Cat Noir. After being commanded to transform her, they collectively withheld their transformation phrases to prevent Queen Bee from abusing their power. Upon hearing Master Fu renounce his title, she and the others protest, but Master Fu does so anyway, resulting in the Miracle Box changing shape and form. After failing to escape, Queen Bee throws off their respective Miraculouses, and they, alongside their kwamis are returned to the Miracle Box by Ladybug.

title: Mullo/History
text:
Mullo/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Truth", Mullo was accidentally released from the Miracle Box when Marinette tried to figure it out, she stole Tikki's hat with Tikki chasing after her. During a video call on her new guardian's computer, Mullo and the others surrounded the screen in amazement. When Marinette leaves for her date with Luka, Mullo and the other kwamis hid with the Miracle Box. After the titular villain's defeat, Mullo and the others saw that Marinette was sad about breaking up with Luka to the point of tears. She didn't know exactly how to help but joined with the other kwamis in giving their new guardian a group hug.
In "Lies", Mullo was seen with Xuppu and came across an apple by Marinette's computer. Trying to play with it, they both dropped it on the keyboard. She and Xuppu couldn't agree on how to move it and stepped on the keyboard changing the screen.

title: Mullo/History
text:
Mullo/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Gang of Secrets", Mullo was seen talking with the other kwamis until Marinette arrives home. Later, she hears Marinette voicing her distress about being condemned to a life of secrets and lies forever because of her alter ego. When they hear someone coming, the kwamis hide in the Miracle Box and after the Gang of Secrets has been defeated, Mullo and the others look on as Marinette unveils her secret to Alya.
In "Furious Fu" hearing that Master Fu was returning, Mullo along with the other kwamis expressed dear desire to see him despite Marinette trying to keep them hidden for their safety, and when Marinette voiced concerns about leaving the Miracle Box unguarded, Mullo realized if someone stayed to guard the box, the others could go. When they cheated their way out so all of them could go, they were stopped by Marinette. With no other choice, they used the "puppy dog eyes" on her, and Marinette reluctantly agreed. However, Mullo and the kwamis had a hard time keeping quiet while in Marinette's bag but heard that Master Fu is doing well and had become a great painter.

title: Mullo/History
text:
Mullo/History - [[Season 4]]
Returning home, Mullo realized that Su-Han had returned to reclaim the box as he was the previous guardian before Master Fu's incident. With Su-Han's strictness, they sadly returned to the box. After seeing Ladybug's valiant actions against the titular villain, Su-Han realized that Master Fu's choice wasn't so bad, allowing Mullo and the others to stay with Marinette.
In "Sole Crusher", she heard Marinette voiced concerns about Zoé's earlier behavior and agreed with Tikki that if Marinette spoke with honesty then she'll get her answer.
In "Queen Banana", Mullo along with Daizzi was helping Marinette as she added the finishing touches to a pair of costumes she was making for a class movie project.
In "Mega Leech", Mullo and her Miraculous were lent to and activated by Mylène Haprèle in order to transform her into the superheroine Polymouse and defeat Malediktator and the titular sentimonster by using Mullo's Multitude. After Mylène's task was completed, she gave the Miraculous back to Ladybug who, in turn sent Mullo and the necklace back to her own residence.

title: Mullo/History
text:
Mullo/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Optigami", when Marinette received an invite to Audrey's event, Mullo and the other kwamis were excited to go to but was reminded by Marinette, no owner, no leaving.
In "Sentibubbler", Mullo along with most of her siblings were woken up when Marinette woke up from having a nightmare leading her guardian doubting about leaving the Fox Miraculous and Trixx with Alya.
In "Hack-San", Mullo and the kwamis were aware that Marinette was leaving for a trip to London, but heard her making an excuse to stay. Not wanting to leave Paris unguarded and when Mullo heard that Marinette pretend to break her leg. Mullo was shocked but was informed by Longg about that trick never working especially if parents want to go on vacation.
In "Wishmaker", after hearing Marinette explain what a career is and yet seeing Marinette being indecisive about her future, Mullo along with her fellow kwamis came up with many suggestions until she and the others were silenced by Sass suggesting they listen to Marinette, Mullo and the other kwamis see Marinette leave for the Career Expo.

title: Mullo/History
text:
Mullo/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Simpleman", Mullo and the other kwamis were shaken up and was about be found by Etta and Ella and Manon, until Marinette intervened, saving them.
In "Dearest Family", after Tikki ate the pieces of galette, Marinette brought for them, the kwamis quickly realized what she did. Mullo huddled together with the others when they realized the danger Tikki's hunger for candy can represent, despite the kwami of Creation refusal at that. When Tikki and Marinette left, the kwamis flew around in a panic. Shortly after she watched Marinette, realize that Sass warning was real and transforms to stop Tikki only to be affected by her hunger, which scared her.
Hearing a commotion downstairs, Mullo and the others were commanded to hide. After Ladybug saved her family, Mullo and the kwamis see her return with pieces of galette for them. Despite that they were still nervous regarding Tikki, until Marinette ensured them that Tikki will control herself and the kwamis ate the pieces of galette happily.

title: Mullo/History
text:
Mullo/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Ephemeral", during the fight against Moolak, Mullo and her Miraculous were given to Mylène, and after she transformed into Polymouse, she tried to distract the supervillain to allow Vesperia to paralyze him with her weapon.
In "Kuro Neko", during the fight against Rogercop, Mullo and her Miraculous were given to Mylène to become Polymouse again. Later, Mullo and the other kwamis tried to comfort Marinette after Cat Noir gave up on his Miraculous and was surprised to learn that she intended to replace him with someone who doesn't love her.
In "Penalteam", Mullo and her Miraculous were used again by Mylène to become Polymouse and help Ladybug, along with many other heroes to defeat Penalty.
In "Risk", Mullo and the other kwamis watched Marinette search for different ways to sabotage Adrien and Lila's journey, unaware that she was under the influence of Risk's superpowers.

title: Mullo/History
text:
Mullo/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Strikeback", Mullo and her Miraculous were given to Mylène to become Polymouse and helped Ladybug, Cat Noir and the rest of the heroes to defeat Strikeback. Later, after Flairmidable betrayed Ladybug by stealing her yo-yo, her Miraculous, along with all the others was given to Gabriel Agreste in exchange for the Peacock Miraculous.

title: Multiverse
text:
Multiverse - Intro
The  is a quantum construct comprised of billions of different universes, with one of them being the Quantic Universe where the story of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir takes place.

title: Multiverse
text:
Multiverse - Summary
The Multiverse was created alongside Creation itself and is comprised of an infinity of different universes (at least billions of them according to Tikki). Each one is unique; some are almost identical to each other, others very different from one another. The reality itself in each universe can vary, going from three-dimensional to two-dimensional, or even being like a drawing from a comic book.
While all individuals that possess counterparts in different universes are their own person and have different lives from one another, Kwamis are omnipresent in the Multiverse, meaning that they live simultaneously in all the universes, having memories of their alternate lifetimes in them. That being said, they choose not to bring up their other individual lives with mortals in each of the universes, as there is not enough time in the human lifespan to explain even a little bit about it. The kwamis prefer to enjoy the time they have with their human partners.

title: Multiverse
text:
Multiverse - History
When the concept of Creation came to be, an infinity of universes were created together, each one varying in its history and reality. Because Kwamis are the embodiment of abstract concepts that exist in all universes, they are omnipresent, being able to live simultaneously in all of them. Even though they are aware of all of their many simultaneous counterparts' different lives, the Kwamis choose not to diverge their other lifetimes to mortals, as there isn't enough time in such a short lifespan to explain even the tiniest bit about it.
In "Miraculous Paris", in order to get help to fight Shadybug and Claw Noir, the villainous holders of the Ladybug and Cat Miraculous respectively in his universe, Betterfly kamikotizes Alya Césaire into Ubiquity to get to the universe where Ladybug and Cat Noir live. In their efforts to acquire his Butterfly Miraculous, Shadybug and Claw Noir follow him there, where they face their respective counterparts.

title: Multiverse
text:
Multiverse - History
After failing to get Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses, Monarch, unwilling to admit defeat, uses the power of Sublimation to get the ability to travel to other universes in order to get the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses. However, he is stopped by Ladybug who, thanks to Betterfly's Kamikotization, acquires the ability to manifest herself in her many counterparts and, in this way, prevents the villain from completing his objective. When Monarch finally gives up, Ladybug is dekamikotized, so that Betterfly, Ladybug (alternate) and Furry Paw can return to their home universe.
