title: Multiverse
text:
Multiverse - Trivia
As demonstrated by Monarch from the Quantic Universe, anyone who travels to another universe would be depicted in the same art style as its environment. Monarch is three-dimensional in the Quantic Universe, so he became two-dimensional upon arriving at the Giuliaverse and the 2D universe.
Thomas Astruc mentioned that the crew established a rule that most universes would have different animation and art styles, but not all of them.
Because both Tikki and Plagg exist in all universes, whenever they fuse together to form Gimmi and grant a wish, that wish only reshapes the universe they belong to. It's unknown what would happen if one version of Gimmi were summoned outside of their respective universe.
Let alone if one version of them would be able to affect more than just one universe. Because of that, it's unknown if Marinette's wish to trade lives with her counterpart in the Quantic Universe would be possible to accomplish.
If not that means the wish alternate Marinette tried to make with her Tikki and Plagg, best case scenario it would only allow her to switch lives with only someone else that already is apart of her world/universe leaving her counterpart's world alone.

title: Multiverse
text:
Multiverse - Trivia
The same with alternate Adrien too upon learning that his counterpart lost his mother the best thing the wish could do is bring back one of their mother's back not both.
What's also interesting if Gabriel had stolen all the Tikki's and Plagg's, he could across the multiverse and only that their wishing power could only alter the worlds their connected too then, he would've found out he stole them all for nothing except that may have caused a serious disturbance that could've thrown the multiverse out of balance.
As well as if Gimmi can be formed by other versions of Tikki and Plagg that belong to different universes.
It's unknown if it's possible to consider alternative timelines as part of the multiverse as their own universe or just versions of one universe since some universes seem to mirror each other as what would happen if some individuals had made different choices of the one they had made.
An example of that is the Quantic Universe and Re-Verse, where the latter's Marinette became a villain because she never made any friends and, therefore, was unable to stand up against Chloé Bourgeois, continuing to be a target of her heavy bullying.

title: Multiverse
text:
Multiverse - Trivia
The Re-Verse's Adrien, unlike his counterpart from the Quantic Universe, was not able to move on from his mother's death, resulting in him resenting his father for moving on and becoming bitter with his life.
The Re-Verse's Gabriel Agreste was able to move on from his wife's death, which inspired him to become Betterfly and use his power for good, unlike his other counterpart, whose inability to move on and obsession with bringing her back is what led him to become the villain he was.
It's possible that Scarabella's universe may be a product of what could have happened if Master Fu had chosen Alya to be the holder of the Ladybug Miraculous, as he did consider choosing her before settling with Marinette.
There are numerous adaptations of episodes and movies in the franchise, such as chapter books and graphic novels. These adaptations are canon as long as they are faithful to the original source material. If there is an adaptation that either deviates or contradicts a source material, then it is considered a separate continuity.

title: Multiverse
text:
Multiverse - Trivia
Examples of faithful adaptations include the Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir comic series published by Action Lab Comics, Miraculous Fiction published by Five Mile, the French chapter book series published by Hachette Jeunesse, and the American chapter book series published by Little, Brown and Company.
Meanwhile, the manga series is an example of a media adaptation that deviates from a source material. While it contains adaptations of existing episodes of the TV series, there are several events in the manga series that never occurred in the original episodes. Two examples include the Evillustrator visiting the Agreste mansion to confront Adrien in the manga adaptation of the titular episode; and Luka Couffaine first appearing in the manga adaptation of "Dark Cupid". This makes the manga series take place in a different universe instead of the Quantic Universe.
The franchise has several episodes and media ideas that are unable to get green-lighted into production.
Had the Ladydragon TV spin-off, "Miraculous Rio", and a spin-off featuring the Brazilian superhero from the Rio special made their official release, then they would be part of the Quantic Universe.

title: Multiverse

Thomas Astruc hinted that the cancelled Miraculous Ladybug OVA would have taken place in a separate universe.
There are live-stage shows for the Miraculous Ladybug franchise. However, it's unconfirmed if any of them are officially also part of the multiverse.
It's unknown if any conceptual ideas are also part of the multiverse. This includes: The Mini Menace Ladybug, Miraculous Lady Bug, the Ladybug PV (and by extension, the Quantic Kids and Null), the first CGI promotional videos, "Ladybug in Halloween", and "Gagotor".
A live-action adaptation is confirmed to be in development. However, it's unknown if the film and/or the TV series are part of the multiverse.
It's unknown if the upcoming graphic novel series that would be published by Mad Cave Studios is part of the multiverse.

title: Musée de l'Orangerie
text:
Musée de l'Orangerie - Intro
is a national museum dedicated to Impressionist and post-Impressionist painting located in the Jardin des Tuileries, on the banks of the Seine, in the 1st arrondissement of Paris.

title: Musée de l'Orangerie
text:
Musée de l'Orangerie - Description
Located at the southwestern end of the Jardin des Tuileries and on the banks of the Seine, the Musée de l'Orangerie is a building constructed in 1852 to a design by architect Firmin Bourgeois and Louis Visconti to house the orange trees of the Tuileries Garden.
Its two ends, especially the one on the side of the Place de la Concorde, consist of large entrances surrounded by two columns surmounted by a sculpted triangular pediment. Built like a greenhouse, the Musée de l'Orangerie has large rectangular windows on the Seine side to receive sunlight, while its north facade is closed. Its roof is a slate hipped roof and has few windows.
Becoming a museum in 1890 and annexed to the Musée d'Orsay in 2010, it exhibits 157 pieces, including 146 paintings by Impressionist and Post-Impressionist masters. There are works by Pablo Picasso, Claude Monet, Paul Cézanne, Pierre-Auguste Renoir and Henri Matisse. It also hosts numerous temporary exhibitions.
The museum is accessible from the Place de la Concorde through an arcade.

title: Musée de l'Orangerie
text:
Musée de l'Orangerie - Trivia
The Jeu de Paume was built according to the same plans to maintain symmetry within the west side of the Jardin des Tuileries.
In the series, the Musée de l'Orangerie is important on several occasions:
In "Captain Hardrock", it is on the roof of the museum that Cat Noir waits and taunts the eponymous villain before engaging in battle against her.

title: Mr. Pugnant
text:
Mr. Pugnant - Intro
is a minor antagonist in Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He is a member of high society and the father of Raymond Pugnant.

title: Mr. Pugnant
text:
Mr. Pugnant - Appearance
Physical appearance
Mr. Pugnant is a man of average height with a slender build and fair skin. He has long blond-gray hair slicked back, amber-colored eyes, and slightly protruding ears. He also sports a pair of thin blond mustaches with darker roots.
Civilian attire
He wears a gray suit made of a silky, elegant fabric. The blazer features the family crest and includes a royal blue pocket square with a golden fleur-de-lis, as well as gold cufflinks. The blazer is worn over a light gray vest, partially covering a white long-sleeved polo shirt and a carefully tied pink tie. He also wears pink socks and a pair of brown shoes with gold laces. A gold signet ring adorns the ring finger of his left hand.

title: Mr. Pugnant
text:
Mr. Pugnant - Personality
Mr. Pugnant is a particularly pedantic and arrogant man. He considers himself superior to others, including his own son, Raymond. Instead of recognizing his son's wrongdoings for what it truly is, he interprets it as something excellent — proof that Ray is beginning to act like a leader and demonstrate his great potential. As such, he exacerbates and encourages Ray's behavior toward his classmates and authority figures.

title: Mr. Pugnant
text:
Mr. Pugnant - Relationships
Family
Raymond Pugnant
He takes pride in the cruel acts committed by his son, claiming they are excellent and that they are finally leading Ray to behave like a leader by fully exploring his potential. Therefore, he encourages him to continue down this path. No matter what happens, he will always cover up Ray's actions to prevent him from facing the consequences.

title: Mr. Pugnant
text:
Mr. Pugnant - Trivia
Due to his fleur-de-lis pocket square, he is the second character in Paris, after Armand D'Argencourt, to be a monarchist.
Although he doesn't seem to have a canonical first name, as his model sheet just refers to him as "Mr. Pugnant", Thomas Astruc reacted positively to a fan's speculation that it might be "Honoré", which would feature the "répugnant" pun from his son's name.

title: Music classroom
text:
Music classroom - Intro
The  is the classroom where Anarka Couffaine holds her music lessons at Collège Françoise Dupont.

title: Music classroom
text:
Music classroom - Appearance
The music classroom is located on the first floor of the Collège Françoise Dupont. It is a room with white walls, a wooden floor, and a lower level of wood. There are several ottomans and stools to sit on, as well as musical instruments, some installed, such as a synthesizer against the wall or a violin and cymbal on a shelf.

title: Music classroom
text:
Music classroom - Trivia
In "Sublimation", Marinette entered the music classroom to get some musical instrument strings with the intention of helping Sublime repair the string on her harp that had broken, although it ultimately didn't help as Sublime had used one of her own hairs as a replacement.

title: Mylène Haprèle
text:
Mylène Haprèle - Intro
is a major character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She is a student at the Collège Françoise Dupont and a former student of Miss Bustier's class, before she became mayor of Paris. She is currently in a relationship with Ivan Bruel.
In "Horrificator" after feeling humiliated for getting scared easily while filming Nino Lahiffe's movie, she got akumatized by Hawk Moth and became Horrificator, a monstrous supervillain.
In "Gang of Secrets", after Marinette kept hiding secrets from them, Mylène was reakumatized by Shadow Moth into Horrifcator alongside Reflekta, Princess Fragrance, Timebreaker and Lady Wifi. The five supervillains all formed the Gang of Secrets, a group of supervillains who wanted to reveal Marinette's secrets.
In "Mega Leech", in order to defeat Malediktator and his titular sentimonster, Mylène received the Mouse Miraculous from Ladybug. When the Miraculous is inhabited by Mullo, Mylène becomes Polymouse, a mouse-themed superhero with the power of Multiplication who helps Ladybug and Cat Noir during "particularly difficult missions" in the fourth season.

title: Mylène Haprèle
text:
Mylène Haprèle - Intro
After the events of "Strikeback", Mylène was temporarily unable to become Polymouse after Monarch managed to steal the Mouse Miraculous along with all the others contained in the Chinese Miracle Box from Ladybug's yo-yo.
In "Re-creation", after Ladybug recovered the stolen Miraculous and reforged them following Monarch's defeat, Mylène was given back the Mouse Miraculous permanently and reunited with Mullo.
In "Revelator", it's shown that, after getting her Miraculous back, Mylène, along with the other secondary heroes of Ladybug's team, was trained to unlock her adult powers, no longer detransforming after using her power.
In "Noe", when Mylène starts panicking with anxiety because of the script that Noé Luxus had made was a fraud, she was almost akumatized by Chrysalis, but Mylène immediately rejects the Ultrakuma moments later. She was hesistant at first to help deakumatize her father but after some encouragement from Mullo she decided to transform.

title: Mylène Haprèle
text:
Mylène Haprèle - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Mylène is a quite short and chubby teenage girl with honey blonde hair styled into dreadlocks. She has a light skin-tone. In the first five seasons, she had her hair pulled back into said dreadlocks, with some strands dyed strong malachite green, vivid cornflower blue, and brilliant rose. A dreadlock on the left side of her head had a purple cat bead with basic eyes, and a few gold and dull blue beads; another dreadlock on her right side had a golden loop and another dull blue bead, shorter than the left one. She has moderate gamboge eyes and wore pale magenta lipstick.
From Season 6 onwards, she has bangs sticking out at the front, with a gap at the left and unkempt tips. A few of her dreads gain striped patterns, with some of them now ombre fuchsia-lilac, blue-cerulean, lime-gold, and orange-yellow. She accessories with lime green eyeshadow and her lipstick is rose in color.

title: Mylène Haprèle
text:
Mylène Haprèle - Appearance
In the first five seasons, she wore a pink bandana to hold her hair back, and she had a necklace with a teal stone pendant. She wore a brilliant azure T-shirt with a white silhouette design on the front of a pigeon holding a olive tree branch with 3 leaves, which was underneath an grayish lime green jacket with a hood. There were pins attached to her jacket: on the right side, she had a daisy pin; on the left side, she had a ladybug pin, a panda pin, and a yellow pin with a green tree emblem circled by a ring. Additionally, she wore moderate tangelo jeans rolled up to the knee, brown leggings, and dark purple sneakers with white toe caps and soles, the laces having been dark purple.
She was often seen wearing the pin that Ivan Bruel gave her in "Horrificator". On occasion until "Re-creation", she wore her Miraculous as a light green coin pendant with a brown string.

title: Mylène Haprèle
text:
Mylène Haprèle - Appearance
From Season 6 onwards, her bandana is moved to the back, and her necklace is replaced with her Miraculous, which has a gold coin pendant with a diamond hole in the middle, the string being black. Her T-shirt and shorts are replaced with denim overall shorts and the same design as her original shirt. She now wears a T-shirt as the same color as her original jacket. She has 6 pins, attached to the straps of her overalls: on the right, she has a peace symbol pin with Rasta colors, a recycling symbol pin, and a red and yellow smiley face pin; on the left, she has a black and green hourglass pin, a pride pin, and her ladybug pin. Additionally, she wears black tights with multicolored segments below; the right leg has brown, orange, forest green, dark vivid brown, light pink, striped and dark green patterns; and the left leg has polka dotted dull blue, brown, dull pink, polka dotted mint, striped green-and-black, and light red patterns. Below are short lilac legwarmers, black grunge boots with dotted bordering, and tan soles. She wears a grayish lime scrunchie around her right wrist with a gold gradient at the top, and a black bracelet with an orange-indigo-black wristband around it.

title: Mylène Haprèle
text:
Mylène Haprèle - Appearance
As Polymouse
In Seasons 4 and 5, Polymouse had moderate green eyes, and her hair was still braided, but was light brilliant rose-colored and shorter, tied into two pigtails at the back of her head with her bangs in front of her face, which was hidden by a medium gray jacket with light silver trimming and a hood which bore mouse ears with light pink insides. She wore a medium gray mouse-themed turtlenecked jumpsuit with a pale pink front, starting from her collar to her thighs, and pale pink gloves and boots with light amaranth borders, fingers and soles, which had magenta-ish black mouse footprint markings, and a light gray face mask with pale pink eyelids and borders, and a brilliant crimson accent on the bridge of her nose, resembling a nose. The skip rope, when not in use, was tied around her hips, resembling a mouse's tail, which was silver with pink spiraled lining and a pink rope. The gray material of her costume seemed to be iridescent as it shined pink in some lighting. Her Miraculous turned silver with pink five mouses circling it and a pink string. Her suit had a hexagonal pattern.

title: Mylène Haprèle
text:
Mylène Haprèle - Appearance
From Season 6 onwards, Polymouse's costume undergoes some changes. Her jumpsuit gains a faint pink tint, gaining a white outline running through the middle of her front, chest and shoulders to accent the hoodie's lining. Her boots extend to the sides of the thighs with rounded tops, lined in white. On her back, she has an altered, more realistic symbol of the Mouse Miraculous in a dark gray circle with a white outline. Her eyes turn moderate gamboge. Her white accents also glow a pale pink.
As Horrificator

title: Mylène Haprèle
text:
Mylène Haprèle - Appearance
Horrificator was a large salamander-like monster with a long brilliant purple tail. The top half of her body was mainly brilliant fuchsia, and the bottom half, along with her forearms, were the same color as her tail. She had three brilliant amaranth eyes with light brilliant gold sclera, the eyes being very tiny within the sclera and the third eye in the middle of her forehead, and had very pale blue tentacles with spots on the back of her head, resembling her dreadlocks. Her head had freckles, her mouth had sharp, jagged white teeth, and her tongue was pale, light grayish arctic blue. She had dark purple claws on her hands, while the claws on her feet were brown, the toes being pale, light grayish gamboge. The pin that Ivan gave her was attached next to one of her head tentacles but hidden by her slimy goo.

title: Mylène Haprèle
text:
Mylène Haprèle - Personality
Mylène is a gentle, kind, cordial, helpful, and adorable girl who suffers from anxiety. She appreciates kindness and speaks fondly of her loved ones, thanking those who help her and being very friendly to anyone she meets. She also is noble and generous, always willing to help others whenever she has the chance, showing support to her friends in difficult times for them. According to Marinette Dupain-Cheng in the webisode of the same name, Mylène is always there for her friends and tries to see the best in people. Despite wanting to have a positive outlook on others, even she has her limits, refusing to excuse the despicable behavior of people like Chloé Bourgeois and Gabriel Agreste.

title: Mylène Haprèle
text:
Mylène Haprèle - Personality
Although Mylène tries to be brave, she is easily frightened by anything that she sees as scary, which she is ashamed of and even cries. In "Stoneheart", she was initially frightened by Ivan Bruel's intimidating appearance and his use of rock music to express his feelings, but after getting to know him and seeing his tenderness, his appearance no longer terrifies her, and she develops a strong love for him. She is sensitive to teasing and hurt by cruel comments from others, being affected by Chloé's insults and anxious at the thought of disappointing her friends and making them feel let down. In "Horrificator", Mylène starred in a short film that Miss Bustier's class was preparing, but because the monster mask Ivan wore constantly frightened her, she became so depressed from fear that she was akumatized.

title: Mylène Haprèle
text:
Mylène Haprèle - Personality
Thanks to the support of her friends, Mylène gradually gains more self-confidence and puts aside her fears to fight for what is fundamental to her, demonstrating a protective instinct when it comes to protecting her friends. Her struggle to overcome her fears and her willpower to achieve her ideals led to her being chosen by Ladybug as the holder of the Mouse Miraculous, and although at first she rejects being a heroine because she believes her fears make her unsuitable for the role, when Ladybug tells her that her true courage lies not in the absence of fear, but in her bravery to fight it, Mylène is inspired to become a superheroine. After "Mega Leech" and from season six onwards, revealing that she has received psychiatric help from Dr. Psiquat due to her many phobias, Mylène better controls her fears and becomes a support for vulnerable people to overcome their own fears.

title: Mylène Haprèle
text:
Mylène Haprèle - Personality
Hardworking and determined, Mylène is very passionate about caring for the planet. She is interested in politics and wants to make Paris a better place for the people, demonstrating courage and intelligence in her fight for environmental causes. She doesn't hesitate to challenge those who harm the environment for selfish reasons and tries to convince others to fight for what is right and not be manipulated by advertising. In season 5, she's one of the few people who isn't swayed by the popularity of Alliance rings and refused to buy one because they are made of unsustainable materials. In "Noe", it is revealed that, with Caline Bustier being elected as the new mayor, Mylène has become the face of Parisian youth, promoting to the world the positive changes implemented by Miss Bustier in Paris.

title: Mylène Haprèle
text:
Mylène Haprèle - Personality
Mylène can also be very strategic, as shown in "Noe", when her father gets a role he does not want and contractually cannot back out from, she remembers Marinette's close relationship with Nadja Chamack and convinces her to report on the harm the movie may cause. After Nadja is fired and the movie goes into production anyway, she completely shuts down, showing that, despite everything she's accomplished, she sometimes regresses in her behavior, although Mullo was later able to encourage her to face her akumatized father.
In "Derision", Mylène reveals that like Chloe she deals with her mother's estrangement, but unlike the former, she didn't take her sadness about it on others.
Mylène's feelings of anxiety and inadequacy stem from her mother's departure. The experience instilled within her a sense of powerlessness, as she felt that since she could not stop her mother from leaving, she would not be able to change the world in any meaningful way. She also has a tendency to overthink when not busy with something, she was incredibly worried when her father was late from his movie audition and was scared he might've not gotten the role.

title: Mylène Haprèle
text:
Mylène Haprèle - Personality
As Polymouse, Mylène's personality mostly remains the same, but she shows more confidence and bravery. She is caring and considerate towards her teammates as well as her power works best when it comes to surprise attacks or tight spaces seen in "Wreckless Driver".
As Horrificator, she relished in making everyone scared (as opposed to her being scared). Aggressive and menacing, she attacked everyone and didn't like it if any of them aren't freaked out by her. Despite this, she retained her feelings towards Ivan and refused to harm him. When she was calmed down by the song Smelly Wolf, her bravado and confidence were gone, leaving her terrified by the others and running into Ivan's arm for comfort and protection.

title: Mylène Haprèle
text:
Mylène Haprèle - Personality
When akumatized a second time as Horrificator in "Gang of Secrets", she, along with Lady Wifi, Reflekta, Princess Fragrance and Timebreaker, wanted to expose Marinette's secrets in hopes of saving her and to be friends again by forcing her to give them up. While Lady Wifi claimed Horrificator would keep Ladybug and Cat Noir, she did want to save Marinette so they could be friends again. She and the Gang of Secrets had no qualms putting bystanders in danger to find Marinette, such as scaring others to make herself stronger so she'd capture Marinette. Her desire to persevere their friendship was so intense that she, Princess Fragrance, Reflekta, and Timebreaker chased after an illusion of Marinette instead of taking Cat Noir's ring.

title: Mylène Haprèle
text:
Mylène Haprèle - Abilities
As a Civilian
Mylène is a talented actress, being chosen for the leading roles in her class's film projects. However, it's hard for her to stay in character when she is scared by something, like Ivan's mask in "Horrificator".
Mylène is interested in politics and wants to make Paris a better place for the people, leading protests for the sake of the environment and having some experience in politics. She is one of the most loyal supporters of Miss Bustier's mayoral campaign, and from Season 6 onward, she has become the face of the youth of Paris, promoting the changes implemented by the mayor to improve Paris.
As seen in "Multiplication", Myléne is skilled in yoga, it's one of her coping strategies, and she even teaches it.
As Polymouse
Polymouse has enhanced capabilities such as speed, agility, and strength, and she is almost invulnerable to physical damage. These abilities allow her to react to and evade akumatized villains attacks, as well as jump and leap several times her height and length. Her tool is a Skip Rope, with which she can strike and tie up enemies.

title: Mylène Haprèle
text:
Mylène Haprèle - Abilities
Her special power, Multitude, allows her to turn into a number of tiny clones of herself. The clones are small, a lot smaller compared to the Kwamis. Upon activating her power, her body glows and clones smaller than herself started to appear. As the original size started to shrink and decrease, Polymouse had the ability to divide herself into smaller clones.
Initially, using her power would depower her and cause her to detransform after 5 minutes, however, in "Revelator", it is shown that Polymouse has learned to control her adult powers, allowing her to not detransform back and use Multitude as much as she wishes.
Polymouse is not just useful in combat, since her power allows her to simultaneously be in many places at the same time and to shrink enough to be nearly imperceptible, she can be used in an array of different situations, such as locating the real Noé Luxus when he tried to trick The Mime by using different identical cars to confuse him (as she could check all the cars at once to locate where he was hiding) or when she talked her father down by speaking to him in his ear as one of her clones posing as her own disembodied voice.
As Horrificator

title: Mylène Haprèle
text:
Mylène Haprèle - Abilities
Horrificator could spit a very resistant purple goo that she used to block exits and trap people. Whenever she caught people, she brought them to her lair and trapped them inside hardened cocoons. Whenever people screamed in fear upon seeing her, she grew larger, but if they weren't scared, stayed calm or calmed down, she shrunk and eventually became as small as a house cat. The larger she was, the stronger she got, and she could make use of her tail by grabbing people with it.

title: Mylène Haprèle
text:
Mylène Haprèle - Etymology
Mylène's first name may be a French variation of the name "Milena", which translates into "dearly". Alternately, it may be a combination of "Marie" (perhaps "sea" or "bitter" or "beloved, or reference to any of a number of literary Marys) and "Hélène" (likely "torch" or the electrical-discharge light show now commonly known as "St. Elmo's fire", or reference to any of a number of literary Helens).
In the Irish dub, her name is changed to Muireann.
In the Serbian dub, her name is changed to Milena.
Mylène's superhero form, Polymouse, was originally called Multimouse, as Marinette's form with the Mouse Miraculous was originally going to be named Polymouse. However, the names got mixed up in production.
In the Italian, Polish and Ukrainian dubs, she's effectively called Multimouse instead of Polymouse.
In the Welsh dub, her name is changed to Polylygoden.
In the European Portuguese dub, her name is changed to "Polirato", which is the literal translation of Polymouse.
The prefix "Poly" from her superheroine name "Polymouse" means more than one.

title: Mylène Haprèle
text:
Mylène Haprèle - Trivia
Miraculous Holder and Akumatized Villain
Her akumatization appears to be heavily influenced by the movie the class makes in "Horrificator", as well as reshaping the movie.
Her akumatized form looks similar to the mask Ivan is wearing for the film.
Since her akumatized form is named after the movie's monster, this makes Mylène one of the villains that Hawk Moth technically doesn't name.
Along with the Mime, Horrificator is one of the two akumatized supervillains without a speaking role in Season 1. Coincidentally, they are biologically related as father and daughter.
Horrificator is probably based on the Xenomorph from the Alien film series.
A scarlet version of Horrificator appeared in the two-part special event "Heroes' Day".
Horrificator appeared another time in "Gamer 2.0" for Gamer's powers.
As seen in "Mr. Pigeon 72", Mylène has been akumatized into Horrificator three times ("Horrificator", "Catalyst" and "Gang of Secrets").
In the openings of Seasons 2 and 4, Mylène has mouse stickers on her face, foreshadowing that she would become the owner of the Mouse Miraculous.

title: Mylène Haprèle
text:
Mylène Haprèle - Trivia
As of "Mega Leech", Mylène is the second known person of French origins to wield the Mouse Miraculous succeeding Multimouse.
Following Alya Césaire, Nino Lahiffe, Chloé Bourgeois, Nathalie Sancoeur, Luka Couffaine, Max Kanté, Kagami Tsurugi, Alix Kubdel, Lê Chiến Kim, Adrien Agreste, Wang Fu and Zoé Lee, Mylène is the thirteenth person to become a Miraculous holder and akumatized villain, excluding Gabriel Agreste, who akumatized himself.
As seen in "Mega Leech", Polymouse is the sixth person who isn't Ladybug or Cat Noir to break an akumatized object, following Queen Bee, Rena Rouge, and Carapace in "Mayura", Fang in "Lies", and Marianne Lenoir in "Furious Fu".
In "Noe", she became the second person and Miraculer to reject an ultrakuma, after Sabrina Raincomprix in "Daddycop".
She also holds the record for fastest akuma rejection in less than 8 seconds, breaking Sabrina's record of 9 seconds.
Miscellaneous
As seen in "Stoneheart", she is scared of heights.
Whenever she needs to feel better, she sings "Smelly Wolf" to herself. Ladybug uses the song to stop Horrificator by singing it to her with Cat Noir and their remaining classmates.

title: Mylène Haprèle
text:
Mylène Haprèle - Trivia
In her webisode, "Mylène", it is revealed that she is interested in politics and would like to make Paris a better place for its inhabitants.
As seen in "Mega Leech", Mylène's politics-related activities include student protests and environmental activism.
In "Confrontation," it is implied that Mylène wants to be an ecologist when she grows up.
Mylène is somewhat similar to Luigi from the Super Mario Bros franchise, as both have a loveable scaredy-cat persona, but are willing to face their fears in order to help others.
Also, both Mylène and Luigi have a sidekick that resemble something they're scared of: For Mylène it's Mullo, the Mouse Kwami, and for Luigi it's his ghost dog, Polterpup.
In "Wreckless Driver", it is revealed that Mylène has received help from Dr. Psiquat with her many phobias.

title: Nadja Chamack
text:
Nadja Chamack - Intro
is a recurring character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She is a former TVi news reporter and Manon Chamack's mother.
In "Prime Queen", after Arlette canceled her show, she was akumatized by Hawk Moth into Prime Queen, a television and media controlling supervillain who was able to travel through screens.
In "Noe", Nadja was fired from TVi after she tried to expose the defamatory nature of the movie approved by Noé Luxus, who had become a new stockholder to the network, towards Ladybug and Cat Noir. At the end of episode, she started her new show on Zoo network.

title: Nadja Chamack
text:
Nadja Chamack - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Nadja is an average tall woman with pale skin, moderate red eyes, and small lips with deep raspberry colored lipstick. Her hair is neck-length in a grown out pixie cut and has swept bangs on her forehead which is burgundy colored.
From Season 6 onwards, her lipstick is redder than before and her hair is now dark plum-purple.
Civilian Attire
She wears a cuffed moderate blue blazer with a deep purple button and lining. Underneath, she wears a moderate mulberry-colored blouse. She has rose gold earrings. Around her neck, she has a gold chain necklace with a pale, light grayish-green five-petaled flower charm. She also wears a white watch on her right wrist, white jeans, and ankle-length deep scarlet high-heeled red shoes.
From Season 6 onwards, her earrings are now green, she has a different necklace and her blazer has a purple outline at the collar.
As Prime Queen

title: Nadja Chamack
text:
Nadja Chamack - Appearance
She wore a pixel-textured head helmet with a light blue visor, while her hair, being stiff, shinier, and wilder, was on the outside. Because of the visor, her lips and pupils were glowing pink while the rest of her face was blue. She wore a deep cornflower blue pixel-textured shoulder pad jumpsuit with a pattern of glowing light blue rectangular outlines connected with lines. Her lower arms and lower legs were vivid cerise, and around her legs above the ankles was a thicker band with a glowing blue edge. The bottom of the suit combined with vivid cerise triangular wedge heeled-dress shoes.

title: Nadja Chamack
text:
Nadja Chamack - Personality
Nadja is nice, informative, and interested in getting the details of an event to Paris. She gets impatient if she has to wait too long, and she sometimes goes too far in her quest for news, being insensitive with Armand when she tries to interview him after his election loss to André Bourgeois in "Darkblade". However, she is fearless in her quest to spread the word, even willing to interview the titular villain of "Pixelator" and calling herself the reporter who "spreads the villains' voice." Through all of her reports, she is professional and formal, but at the same time, she willingly expresses concern or happiness during particular instances. She is friendly to others, and she is very motherly to her daughter. She is also able to remain professional for the most part; when her clothes were insulted by Audrey Bourgeois in "Style Queen", she looked rather cross and offended but did not otherwise react.
She is also very understandable and forgiving to others too such as with Marinette in "The Puppeteer". As well as with Ladybug and Cat Noir, upon figuring out that they were helping the American Heroes defeat Hawk Moth in New York.

title: Nadja Chamack
text:
Nadja Chamack - Personality
Prime Queen, while good at onscreen presentation and strategics, was haughty and demanding, wanting Ladybug and Cat Noir to announce that they were in love. Her obsession with the heroes made her more than willing to force them to reveal their identities on live television for Hawk Moth, and she blackmailed them by endangering civilians Chloé and Alya without remorse. However, her desire for answers made her act rashly, her aggravation of not being able to see Ladybug and Cat Noir detransformed and kiss driving her to travel to them, falling for their trap.

title: Nadja Chamack
text:
Nadja Chamack - Abilities
As a Civilian
Nadja is a very persistent news reporter in her job, using whatever means necessary to find a story even if it gets into others' personal lives.
As Prime Queen
Prime Queen's power allowed her to travel between television screens. Any television affected by her power could be used by others to travel from place to place. For communicating with others, she could control television screens to broadcast her actions from another television screen. However, if the television screen was destroyed, she couldn't use it to teleport or broadcast anymore.
Additionally, she was decently skilled in combat, and she was effective at tying Chloé up in a blue power cord.

title: Nadja Chamack
text:
Nadja Chamack - Relationships
Family
Manon Chamack
Manon is Nadja's daughter, whom she loves. While she can be very stern with her, like when she finds out Manon has one of Marinette's dolls and mistakenly believes she stole it, she means well, caring about her safety and wanting her to learn good virtues. Although Nadja has gotten used to Manon's baby doll eyes, she notes that Manon can be "very persuasive." She also worries greatly when she can't go and find Manon in "The Puppeteer", and she is relieved once she reunites with her.
In "Gamer 2.0", she spends time with her daughter at the park and they embrace each other after Ladybug returns everything to normal.
Friends
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/Ladybug

title: Nadja Chamack
text:
Nadja Chamack - Relationships
Nadja appreciates that Marinette babysits Manon for her, and she understands Marinette's difficulty with Manon sometimes and her intentions to do the best she can with her. She forgives Marinette for her giving Manon a doll against her orders in "The Puppeteer", and although she gets impatient waiting for cake delivery at Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie that Marinette is supposed to retrieve for her in "Timebreaker", she is content once Marinette shows up, apologizes, and gives her the cake. In Marinette's latest Instagram post, Nadja comes to her asking for help in brainstorming ideas making a bridal reception dress for her niece.

title: Nadja Chamack
text:
Nadja Chamack - Relationships
With Ladybug, Nadja is grateful for her and Cat Noir's work to keep Paris safe. Many of Nadja's news reports are related to the villains that create trouble and the heroes that defeat them. During Manon's akumatization, Nadja feels slightly better after Ladybug reassures her that they'll find her daughter, and she thanks her when she is with Manon once more. Her interest in Ladybug also extends to knowing if she and Cat Noir are dating, but her asking and prodding push Ladybug too far in "Prime Queen". It becomes her obsession to see the duo romantically together while being Prime Queen. She later accepts with calm understanding when Alya tells her that the superhero duo isn't dating "yet."
At first, she was stunned that Ladybug and Cat Noir didn't show up to defeat the Robostus sentimonster but quickly understood their absence upon hearing about them stopping Hawk Moth in New York on the news.

title: Nadja Chamack
text:
Nadja Chamack - Etymology
The name Nadja is of Slavic origin, a diminutive of Nadezhda meaning "hope", and also has Arabic roots from Nadiyyah meaning "tender" or "delicate".
Her name has occasionally been spelled or pronounced as Nadia.
The surname Chamack is likely of North African (Arabic or Berber) origin, possibly meaning "to rise" or "proud". In Hindi/Punjabi, chamak means "shine" or "brilliance", and a similar English surname, Cammack, refers to a "crooked hill".

title: Nadja Chamack
text:
Nadja Chamack - Trivia
In "Timebreaker", she ordered a cupcake cake in the shape of the Eiffel Tower from Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie, which Marinette helps her get while her parents are gone.
Despite being Manon's mother, it is never explained if she has a partner.
She and Sabine Cheng are good friends, and she occasionally has Sabine's daughter, Marinette, babysit Manon.
Her catchphrase is "Don't be bemused, it's just the news!" as seen in various episodes.
A scarlet version of Prime Queen appeared in the two-part special event "Heroes' Day".
Prime Queen appeared another time in "Gamer 2.0" through Gamer 2.0's powers.
Nadja's broadcasts have been interrupted several times by akumatized villain attacks, often with her getting attacked or transformed by the villain in question.
She was zapped and captured by Pixelator.
She was turned into a knight by Darkblade.
She was absorbed into the Collector's book.
She was tackled by a number of Sapotis.
She was chased off the stage by rogue equipment under Robostus' control.
She was infected by Zombizou's kisses.
She, Jagged Stone and Clara Nightingale were akumatized by Scarlet Moth's scarlet Akumas in "Catalyst".
She had her memories wiped by Oblivio.

title: My Birthday Party/Transcript
text:
My Birthday Party/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Dear diary, it's my birthday on Saturday! Mom and Dad said that I can have some friends over. It's going to be awesome! So, who am I inviting?
Alya. That's a no-brainer. There's no way I could celebrate my birthday without my BFF! I'd so love to invite Adrien too! The only problem is, I don't know if I could ask him in person without turning bright red and stuttering like crazy. Oh well. If I can't do it, I'll ask Nino for help. He's a really great guy. So, Alya, Adrien and Nino. That makes three.
Then, Rose and Juleka! They're not at all alike. Both are super nice. I can also invite Ivan. He's a bit of an old grump, but he's always nice to me, so... yeah. I'll invite him too. It'll make Mylène  happy, because I think she's got a bit of a crush on him.
Then there's Kim, the class jock, and Max. Kim is always challenging people, and Max is only into math. But they're both pretty cool. I'll also invite Alix, the other sporty one in our class.

title: My Birthday Party/Transcript

Okay, I think I got everybody. Oh, I can't wait! It's going to be so great!

title: Métro
text:
Métro - Intro
The Paris  is a subway system that traverses underneath Paris, France.
Starting from season 6, the Métro appears to be abandoned, as there is graffiti on the walls and the posters are half torn off, most likely due to Mayor Bustier's reform to add tram. As seen in "Revelator", it appears that The Miraculers uses it as a base or hideout.
In "Riginarazione", it appears that maybe the whole Metro wasn't completely abandoned and only a section of it was. From "The Chained Titans", the section the Miraculers used purposely remodeled by Mayor Bustier for use by the Miraculers being named the Miracle Station.

title: Métro
text:
Métro - Appearance
The outside entrances to Métro stations have handrails and small canopies leading down into the métro. The Métro stations are brightly lit with gray concrete walls and floors. There are advertisements, including for the Gabriel brand, on the walls. The Métro cars are brightly lit with green benches and yellow poles.

text:

Signs in stations and on trains reference lines 17 and 28, neither of which exist in real life.
A line 17 is expected to open in the next decade, but there is currently no planned line 28.

title: Mylène Haprèle/History
text:
Mylène Haprèle/History - Intro
Mylène Haprèle is the daughter of Fred Haprèle. She is an environmental activist, a student at the Collège Françoise Dupont and a former student of Caline's class, before she became mayor of Paris. She is also the current holder of the Mouse Miraculous, which she uses to transform into Polymouse.

title: Mylène Haprèle/History
text:
Mylène Haprèle/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Ladybug & Cat Noir", she was one of the new students in Miss Bustier's class.
In "Stoneheart", Mylène watched from afar as many students crowd Ivan after his previous akumatization. Later, as she was rushing to class, she bumps into Ivan, who attempts to sing her a song he wrote, only for his loud voice to scare her off. When Ivan gets akumatized into Stoneheart, Mylène winds up captured by him along with Chloé and taken to the Eiffel Tower. She was eventually freed after Ladybug deakumatizes him and was amazed by her Miraculous Ladybug. Ladybug then shows her the lyrics of Ivan's song, which she finds beautiful. Ivan apologizes for scaring her earlier and promises to be more gentle, to which Mylène hugs him in response.
In "The Bubbler", Mylène was one of the many people Bubbler forced to attend Adrien's surprise birthday party. Though she dances at the party, she was just as miserable as everyone else. When Ladybug and Cat Noir arrive, Mylène and the others cheer for them, angering Bubbler and prompting him to trap her and everyone else in floating bubbles, though she was later freed after Bubbler's defeat.

title: Mylène Haprèle/History
text:
Mylène Haprèle/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Mr. Pigeon", she heard of the derby hat competition their school was hosting and was in the courtyard walking with Nino.
In "Timebreaker", Mylène and the others cheer for Alix as she and Kim raced. When Alix was akumatized into Timebreaker after her watch gets broken, Mylène was one of the many people she causes to disappear from existence, though she was brought back after Timebreaker's defeat.

title: Mylène Haprèle/History
text:
Mylène Haprèle/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Horrificator", Mylène played the leading role in a short film Miss Bustier's class was working on, but she constantly got scared of the monster mask Ivan wore. When Chloé made fun of Mylène's tendency to get easily frightened, she bursts into tears and ran out the classroom. Ivan attempts to cheer her up by giving her a pin from his favorite band, but Mylène believes that she wasn't right for the lead role and went to the bathroom, where she wonders out loud why she's so easily scared all the time. Her emotions become negative enough that she is akumatized by Hawk Moth into Horrificator, a slimy monster who grows bigger the more people are afraid of it. Horrificator captures several students in the school and traps them in slimy cocoons, all while feeding on their fear. However, she was eventually defeated by Ladybug, Cat Noir, and several of the non-captured students that helped the duo. Once deakumatized, Mylène shared a kiss with Ivan.

title: Mylène Haprèle/History
text:
Mylène Haprèle/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Darkblade", she heard that elections for class representative were happening and was happy that Marinette chose to run against Chloé. When Mylène heard that Jagged Stone was signing autographs at City Hall she rushed over to get one. However, she expressed fear when Darkblade and his nights tried to break in but she was comforted by Ivan.
In "The Mime", Mylène and her father Fred went to Marinette's house to retrieve the hat Marinette was fixing for the latter. She expressed pride at the fact that her father will be playing the leading role in The Mime's Extraordinary Adventures and was flattered when he says that he keeps a photo of her in his hat for good luck. Later, she spends a little time with Marinette and Alya before leaving with the latter. When Alya wants to show Mylène a video she had recorded earlier but can't find her phone, Mylène calls Marinette and asks her if she has Alya's phone.

title: Mylène Haprèle/History
text:
Mylène Haprèle/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Despair Bear", Mylène watched Tom Dupain's cooking lesson with the rest of her classmates until it is interrupted by the fire alarm going off. When Mr. Damocles punishes the whole school as a result, Mylène sweeps floors and angrily glares at Chloé, knowing that she's most likely the one who called the fire department in the first place. Later at Marinette's house, she helps Marinette by modeling a hat she designed until she receives an invite to a party from Chloé. At first she believes that someone hacked her phone, but then concludes that Chloé wanted to say sorry for earlier and suggests that maybe deep down, she is nice. While at Chloé's party, Mylène approaches Chloé and asks her where the ice cubes are, to which Chloé rudely tells her to get herself and makes fun of her sweater. Shocked, Mylène is nearly akumatized, but she calms down when Chloé takes back her comment and gets the ice cubes for her. She slow dances with Ivan at the party, and after Despair Bear's defeat, bakes macarons at Tom Dupain's cooking lesson, though she bursts into tears after Chloé makes fun of them.

title: Mylène Haprèle/History
text:
Mylène Haprèle/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Befana", Mylène attends Marinette's birthday party and gives her a fashion book as a gift. When Befana arrives attempting to turn Marinette into coal, Marinette dodges the shot and it hits Mylène instead, turning her into a coal statue. She is later returned to normal after Befana's defeat and continues celebrating Marinette's birthday.
In "Robostus", she was in Science class with her friends and becomes amazed at Max's robot friend Markov.

title: Mylène Haprèle/History
text:
Mylène Haprèle/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Gigantitan", Mylène along with Juleka, Rose, and Alix are called by Marinette and Alya to a meeting at Marinette’s. When Alya reveals that she has a big scoop, the girls first think that Alya knows who Ladybug is, but when Alya says that Marinette has a crush on someone, the girls reveal that they already know it’s Adrien, with Mylène pointing out how obvious it is. Mylène agrees to help set Marinette on a romantic date with Adrien, commenting on how she can always be counted on. As part of the plan, Mylène is given the codename “Sunflower” and is put in charge of alerting Officer Roger of Adrien’s bodyguard’s illegal parking after Juleka puts a fake NO PARKING sign by his car. But the mission goes awry and as a result, baby August is akumatized into Gigantitan. When Gigantitan grabs Ladybug and nearly puts her in his mouth, Mylène and the girls help Ladybug by distracting Gigantitan with a giant sign that looks like a lollipop. After Gigantitan’s defeat, Mylène and the others reunite with Marinette and then watch her failed attempt at asking Adrien on a rickshaw ride. Once Adrien leaves, Mylène shares a rickshaw ride with her friends.

title: Mylène Haprèle/History
text:
Mylène Haprèle/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Glaciator", Mylène goes with Ivan, Nino, Alya, and Marinette to get ice cream at André’s. She shares an ice cream with Ivan, but the night is cut short when Marinette, heartbroken over Adrien not being able to come, sadly rejects the ice cream André tries to give her and walks away.
In "Gorizilla”, Mylène goes with Alya, Rose, and Juleka to the swimming pool, and the four girls wait for Marinette to arrive. While waiting, she and the others are kept entertained by multiple photos posted online of Marinette with Adrien.

title: Mylène Haprèle/History
text:
Mylène Haprèle/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Captain Hardrock", Mylène helped Kitty Section set up their equipment on the Couffaine houseboat for the music festival. When the band does a soundcheck, Mylène gives everyone earplugs, commenting on how they’d need them. She then witnesses a confrontation between Anarka and Officer Roger over the volume of their music and is as shocked as everyone else on board when Anarka is akumatized into Captain Hardrock. When everyone refuses to play music for the supervillain, Captain Hardrock chains everyone up and throws them below deck, with Mylène being chained against Ivan. She is later freed by Ladybug and, after Captain Hardrock’s defeat and Officer Roger’s approval of the music volume, watches Kitty Section perform.

title: Mylène Haprèle/History
text:
Mylène Haprèle/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Frightningale”, Mylène went with Marinette, Alya, Rose, Juleka, and Alix to audition as extras in Clara Nightingale’s music video. When Marinette is offered the role of Ladybug, Mylène is happy for her, though when Marinette turns down the offer to be with her friends, Mylène hugs her and playfully calls her crazy. However, when Marinette changes her minds after Clara almost gives Chloé the role of Ladybug, Mylène cheers her friend on but is disappointed when Chloé causes the shoot to be canceled. When Clara is akumatized into Frightningale as a result, Mylène finds a safe place to hide. After Frightningale’s defeat, Mylène participates in a new version of Clara’s video and watches it with her classmates, commenting on how everyone gets to be in it.

title: Mylène Haprèle/History
text:
Mylène Haprèle/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Zombizou", for Miss Bustier’s birthday, Mylène explains that her gift is a braid of hair inspired by the breathing classes that help her to be less scared of akumas. She appears disappointed upon learning that Chloé didn’t get Miss Bustier anything but is indignant when she later learns that Chloé sabotaged Marinette’s gift. When Zombizou bursts into the classroom, Mylène is surprised and runs away with the rest of her classmates when Ladybug begins fighting the supervillain. However, Sabrina, who had been infected by Zombizou, kisses her, she turns into a kissing zombie. After Zombizou’s defeat, she is returned to normal and shares a kiss with Ivan.
In "Frozer", after Marinette explains her dilemma with Adrien and Kagami, Mylène offers up the excuse of having to finish an essay on Periwinkle’s migration in order for her to get out of it. However, she is surprised when Marinette reveals that she’d rather not cancel. When Marinette expresses her belief that she and Adrien may be better off as just friends, Mylène and the other girls disagree and quickly get into an argument.
In "Style Queen", Mylène was seen in the front row of Gabriel Agreste’s fashion show.

title: Mylène Haprèle/History
text:
Mylène Haprèle/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Queen Wasp", Mylène is seen in the front row of Gabriel Agreste’s fashion show.
In "Reverser", Mylène was seen alongside Ivan and several other protesters fighting against Mayor Bourgeois’ space dumpster program. However, she was horrified when Reverser showed up and made it so that the mayor sends all the dump back into Paris.
In "Malediktator”, Mylène and her classmates laugh when Chloé presents a video of herself dressed as Queen Bee to the class for a school assignment. Later, when Chloé announces that she was leaving Paris, like many other students and staff, Mylène is delighted at the news and celebrates. However, the party is soon crashed by Malediktator, who makes it so that Mylène and several other people at the school begin destroying the building. After Malediktator’s defeat, Mylène attends a party honoring Queen Bee.

title: Mylène Haprèle/History
text:
Mylène Haprèle/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Catalyst", like most of her classmates, Mylène believes Lila when she says on a video chat that she’s in the country of Prince Ali and will be meeting with him to get his approval on a pollution-reduction project for Heroes Day. Mylène then listens as Mr. Damocles praises Ladybug and Cat Noir’s heroism. When Miss Bustier asks her students what they'll be doing for Heroes Day, Mylène is excited when Marinette claims to be organizing a macaron tasting with many delicious treats for the whole school. However, Mylène is devastated upon learning that an akumatized Ladybug destroyed Cat Noir with his own Cataclysm (unaware that it was an illusion created by Volpina). When a bunch of scarlet akumas swarm the school, one of them turns Mylène back into Horrificator then follows the other akumatized villains to the Eiffel Tower.
In "Mayura", Horrificator and the other akumatized villains praised Scarlet Moth until he signals for them to stop. She then fought the French Miraculous superhero team, but after Scarlet Moth is reverted back into Hawk Moth, she was returned to normal. Later, she attends a picnic in honor of Marinette and all her good deeds.

title: Mylène Haprèle/History
text:
Mylène Haprèle/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Chameleon", like most of her classmates, Mylène believes Lila’s lie about having tinnitus and needing a front row seat, so she changes seats so that she sits next to Ivan. When Marinette complains about having to sit in the back and supposedly upsets Lila, Mylène and the other students glare at her, forcing her into the back. Later at lunch, Mylène believes Lila when she claims to have a sprained wrist and can’t carry her own tray, so she and several of her other classmates bring her food for her. When Marinette reveals that Lila’s wrist isn’t sprained by throwing a napkin at her and making her catch it with the “sprained” wrist, Mylène is momentarily shocked, but when Lila claims that she’d wanted to catch the napkin before it hit Max’s eye, Mylène buys it and angrily asks Marinette if she’s proud of herself. After the defeat of Chameleon, Mylène gathers with her classmates as Lila continues to lie about her friendship with Ladybug. Back in class, when Lila claims to no longer need a front row seat due to Ladybug curing her tinnitus, Mylène and the others decide to go back to their original seats.

title: Mylène Haprèle/History
text:
Mylène Haprèle/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Animaestro", she along with Ivan had their eyes closed in an effort to help Ladybug and Cat Noir defeat Animaestro.
In "Backwarder”, Mylène and the other girls are called for an emergency meeting at Marinette’s house, though because it is so early in the morning, they were exhausted. When Marinette reveals that Adrien is going to the royal wedding in England with Kagami and asks the girls how to prevent a potentially romantic weekend between the two, Mylène suggests that they organize a demonstration to make the trains go on strike, though Alya points out that they’d likely just take a private jet or helicopter. The girls all agree that the best way would be for Marinette to just tell Adrien how she feels. At school the next day, Mylène and the others ask Marinette how everything went. Marinette tells them that she wrote him a note, and Mylène and the others cheered for her. When Adrien approaches Marinette, Mylène was ecstatic but even more delighted when he gave Marinette something. However, she was perplexed upon discovering that it’s constipation capsules.

text:

was a Chinese boy who wielded the Bee Miraculous. He was a Miraculous holder keeper who appears in the Miraculous spellbook for the Bee Miraculous. When Pollen inhabited the Bee Miraculous, he transformed into a bee-themed superhero.

title: Mìfēng
text:
Mìfēng - Appearance
The holder of the Bee Miraculous wears a large black sash, a yellow long-sleeved T-shirt with a high collar, a yellow belt, yellow pants, black baggy socks, and black sneakers.

title: Mìfēng
text:
Mìfēng - Abilities
The titular Bee Miraculous used the spinning top, as seen in the book's illustration. And assuming the Bee Miraculous holder's previous powers are the same as the recent Bee Miraculous holder (Vesperia), he would have the superpower Venom, which allowed him to immobilize his opponents by stinging them. He would also have enhanced abilities such as speed, strength, and - most notably - agility.

title: Mìfēng
text:
Mìfēng - Trivia
He is the earliest known Bee Miraculous holder.
Mìfēng (蜜蜂) means "Bee" in Chinese.
Similar to Hippolyta and Heracles, since he and the other Chinese holders were the first Miraculous holders it's likely that they knew each other.
He is the first male to use the Bee Miraculous, Monarch would later do the same in "Transmission".
Even though the page is said Queen Bee, there is no such thing as a "King Bee".

text:

title: Nadja's cellphone
text:

In "Timebreaker", Nadja called Tom Dupain to complain to him that she arrived at Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie early to pick up her Eiffel Tower cake but the bakery is closed. Here, the phone cover is pink like Rose Lavillant's.

In "Queen Wasp", Nadja received a call from Queen Bee who wants her to head to the Métro and have her crew film the superheroine "rescuing" the passengers of a train.
In "Qilin", the phone is briefly seen when Nadja received a call during Sabine Cheng's painting class while she's watching Ladybug and Cat Noir fighting Lollipop Boy.

title: Mylène's room
text:
Mylène's room - Intro
is the bedroom of Mylène Haprèle, located in her father's apartment.

title: Mylène's room
text:
Mylène's room - Appearance
Mylène's room is quite small, with gray and purple walls and wooden floors. It also has a large window overlooking the street, beneath which sits a radiator. Above this radiator, Mylène has installed a wooden shelf to hold a vase of roses and a few books.
Arranged to maximize space, the room features a large, six-shelf blue-green bookcase, filled with various books and decorations, such as flowers, a photo frame, and a globe. Opposite the bookcase is a particularly high loft bed, accessed by a wide ladder. The bed has a large mattress and a red blanket with black stripes. One of the bedposts is painted in rainbow colors. Under the bed, Mylène uses a meditation area, furnished with a red yoga mat.
Next to the ladder is a small desk with a shelf and a vase of roses, with an "I Love Planet" poster hanging on the wall above a drawing of a flower. Next to the desk is another laundry cabinet, with more books and some laundry baskets. This area also features a multicolored woven rug.

title: Mylène's room
text:
Mylène's room - Trivia
Mylène's room is fifth room to appear in Season 6 following Sabrina's room and Max's room in "Daddycop", Nathaniel's room in "The Ruler" and Zoé's room in "Grendiaper".

title: Nathaniel Kurtzberg
text:
Nathaniel Kurtzberg - Intro
, also called Nathan, Nate and Nath, is a supporting character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He is a student at the Collège Françoise Dupont and a former student of Miss Bustier's class, before she became mayor of Paris. He is currently in a relationship with Marc Anciel.
In "The Evillustrator", when Chloé mocked his art and his crush on Marinette, he was infected with an Akuma by Hawk Moth and became the Evillustrator, an artistic supervillain whose drawings became real.
In "Penalteam", Nathaniel received the Goat Miraculous from Ladybug. When the Miraculous is inhabited by Ziggy, Nathaniel becomes Caprikid, a goat-themed superhero with the power of Passion who helps Ladybug and Cat Noir during "particularly difficult missions" in the fourth season.
After the events of "Strikeback", Nathaniel was temporarily unable to become Caprikid after Monarch managed to steal the Goat Miraculous along with all the others contained in the Chinese Miracle Box from Ladybug's yo-yo.
In "Re-creation", after Ladybug recovered the stolen Miraculous and reforged them following Monarch's defeat, Nathaniel was given back the Goat Miraculous permanently and reunited with Ziggy.

title: Nathaniel Kurtzberg
text:
Nathaniel Kurtzberg - Intro
In "Revelator", it's shown that, after getting his Miraculous back, Nathaniel, along with the other secondary heroes of Ladybug's team, was trained to unlock his adult powers, no longer detransforming after using his power.
In "The Ruler", it's revealed that Nathaniel's parents are the root of his insecurity about his art, with his mother initially trying to forbid him from pursuing his passion for comics, only realizing her mistake after being de-akumatized and defeated. In the same episode, when Marc expressed his worry about Nathaniel putting himself in danger for him, the latter, in order to put him at ease, reluctantly revealed himself as Caprikid. Touched by this revelation, Marc decided to reveal his identity as Rooster Bold to him to show the same level of trust.

title: Nathaniel Kurtzberg
text:
Nathaniel Kurtzberg - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Nathaniel is a Jewish-French teenage boy, who is fairly short with turquoise eyes, and face-length red-orange hair. It is slightly messy with a few strands sticking out. He has long bangs that are brushed to the left side of his face, covering most of his left eye.
As revealed in the card game "Miraculous Secrets", Nathaniel's natural hair color was chestnut brown before Alix dyed it to its current color. It's erroneously seen like that in some episodes from Season 1, e.g. "The Bubbler", "Darkblade" and the "Origins" two-parter.
From Season 6 onwards, his hair is of a darker shade of red, similar to its natural color, styled more neatly, and being a little longer in length. His bangs are pushed more to the left, allowing his left eye to be more visible. Locks of his hair are pulled to the sides of his head and clipped in place by the Goat Miraculous, which was a set of light silver flat, wavy lines that curve to a point at each ends. Nathaniel sports light freckles across his nose and cheeks.
Civilian Attire

title: Nathaniel Kurtzberg
text:
Nathaniel Kurtzberg - Appearance
In the first five seasons, he wore a red-orange T-shirt with a black logo design on the front, similar to that of the band Magma, which has a crescent, a vertical point, and a circle in the middle. Over his shirt, he wears a dark gray dress jacket with a folded collar and sleeves, and side pockets. He wore purple jeans that are rolled up at the bottom revealing a light purple bottom, and his shoes were gray with three white horizontal laces and a white section where his toes would be. The soles were mauve. On occasion until "Re-creation", he wore his Miraculous as a set of flat silver-gray pieces that have edges and are spiraled to resemble a pair of goat or ram horns on top of his head.
In the 8th grade class photo in "Reflekta" and a flashback of "Derision", his shirt was purple.

title: Nathaniel Kurtzberg
text:
Nathaniel Kurtzberg - Appearance
From Season 6 onwards, Nathaniel swaps his T-shirt for a longer-sleeved one with a wider neckline, but his logo remains on his chest. He traded his jeans and dress jacket for a pair of slim, dark grey overalls with a slight washout look. The overalls has a big pocket on the front and smaller pockets on the sides and behind. Nathaniel does not wear the right strap of said overalls, letting it dangle loose on his side without putting his arm through it and causing the part of the bib to droop down. He swapped his sneakers for purple loafers and wears no socks. Both his overalls and shoes are spattered with pink, purple, and blue paint in random places.
As Caprikid
In Seasons 4 and 5, Caprikid had redder, thicker and neater hair, fully covering his left eye and being slightly longer in length.
His Miraculous also turned black and had white outlines in the shape of a ram's horns, moved to the far sides of his head.
He wore a skin-tight, collared full-body outfit suit with a long zip-line on top of gray bordering going down to his stomach.

title: Nathaniel Kurtzberg
text:
Nathaniel Kurtzberg - Appearance
The suit was mostly black, except for two thick white lines on the front of the torso that gone up diagonally from the bottom of his zipper to his shoulders.
The upper back also was largely white and formed a V-shape section.
There was bushy white fur that draped around his neck, shoulders, and at the ends of his sleeves, accented by similar cuffs around the wrists and in the middle of his boots.
The zipper itself was a hollow white triangle and was zipped all the way up to the neck.
His mask was mainly white, with a V-shaped black section in the top center.
He also wore white gloves and long black boots that had white soles and pointing tips at the top.
He had two gray goat-like horns going up with a small curve off the top of his head, with the Goat Miraculous behind them.
When not in use, his Paint Brush was attached to his lower back.

title: Nathaniel Kurtzberg
text:
Nathaniel Kurtzberg - Appearance
From Season 6 onwards, his appearances changes significantly. His hair becomes slightly longer, messier and curls upward, flaring out from the back and sides of his head. Instead of the horns being separate from the Goat Miraculous, they sprout from the Miraculous itself and resemble metallic grey horns that curve inward with a flat surface. Instead of a one-piece bodysuit, the suit is now composed of black pants and a jacket with full-length sleeves that encompass his hands. His mask stretches to the sides of his face and the sections are inverse in color, now mainly black with a V-shaped white section on the top center. The jacket has pockets and retains the zipper, but said zipper is left partially unzipped, the bordering now being gone. The lines on his chest and back remain, but they seem to be made of sturdier material and create a thick seam borderline. The white section V-shape on his back has extended all the way to the jacket's coattail, which ends in short, angular cut.

title: Nathaniel Kurtzberg
text:
Nathaniel Kurtzberg - Appearance
The more intricate, black-colored symbol of the Goat Miraculous is located on Caprikid's back and is surrounded by a double ring indention that has two lines from the circle and goes all the way down to the tailcoat. The bushy fur becomes neater, and the color becomes a gradient of white and black. The fur around the neck and shoulder are at a considerably shorter length, the cuffs around the wrists and knees being gone in place of thick white V-shaped lines around the lower arms, and there being fur on the pants that flare vertically from above the knees down to the hem, the length of the fur increasing the further down it goes, with a matching gradient to compliment the fur around his neck. Caprikid's black boots also gain white platform soles that are shaped like goat hooves. The brush also turns more simple in color and design, the handle being white in the middle and black at the ends, and a metallic piece on top with a larger charcoal gray bristle.
As the Evillustrator

title: Nathaniel Kurtzberg
text:
Nathaniel Kurtzberg - Appearance
The Evillustrator's skin was pale purple, and his spiky, flared out hair was brushed back and colored orange with purple tips. On his head, he had a dark purple beret, and on his face, he had a deep violet butterfly-shaped mask, and his eyes were moderate cyan.
He wore a white jumpsuit with dark purplish-black stripes and solid dark purple legs that became red halfway down his lower legs. On his chest, there was a black circle with smaller red, yellow, and blue glowing circles inside. The yellow one was on the bottom, the red one was on the top left, and the blue one was on the top right. His swan-necked collar was similar to Juleka Couffaine's usual shirt, with a red turtleneck underneath. A black drawing tablet was attached to the back of his right forearm. His pen was silver towards the tip, the end being black with a red stripe in the middle.

title: Nathaniel Kurtzberg
text:
Nathaniel Kurtzberg - Personality
Nathaniel is an introverted, kind, and sensitive boy who is quite imaginative and artistic. While he is friendly with his classmates, being good friends with the extroverted Marinette Dupain-Cheng and Alix Kubdel, and enjoys group activities, he is quiet and shy in class, as well a bit of a loner. He seems to be quite easily lost in his fantasies, such as when he is daydreaming about his crush, Marinette, and ends up not focusing in class in "The Evillustrator". His introverted nature is the root of his individualism, as he prefers to work alone and dislikes team sports. This changed partly after he met Marc Anciel, an excellent creative writer, and the two started working together to create their comic books, forging a friendship that would eventually turn into romance. In "Nathaniel & Marc", Marinette notes that Nathaniel used to rarely talk to anyone but has gradually become more sociable and open with others.
Nathaniel can be rather observant of details around him, including goo left by Horrificator in the episode of the same name and the details of Chloé Bourgeois's bracelet in "Rogercop".

title: Nathaniel Kurtzberg
text:
Nathaniel Kurtzberg - Personality
Self-conscious and afraid of being judged, he prefers to be secretive about his art and second-guesses whether anyone would like it. If he is accused of something, he becomes nervous, and, if the accusations are true, deeply embarrassed. He is easily terrified in some scary or stressful situations, as in "Horrificator", but in other situations, he is willing to stand up for himself, such as when others accuse him of stealing Chloé's bracelet. In his drawings, he creates "Super Nathan", a courageous superhero version of himself, as a way to imagine himself as being more brash and outgoing. This demonstrates Nathaniel's inner wish to be stronger and more confident in himself.

title: Nathaniel Kurtzberg
text:
Nathaniel Kurtzberg - Personality
Nathaniel's self-doubt towards his drawings and his own identity is revealed in "The Ruler" to have come from the influence of his own parents. His father thinks he should be more compliant to what people may want and/or expect, and his mother disapproves of him making comic illustrations, thinking he needs to focus on a more serious artform. Although his father is more supportive towards his son's ambition for illustration, his mother is more firm in her beliefs, which causes a strain in her relationship with her son. Nathaniel wants nothing but to prove himself to her, but he falls short under her harsh criticism and rigidity, seriously affecting his self-esteem.

title: Nathaniel Kurtzberg
text:
Nathaniel Kurtzberg - Personality
In "Reverser", Nathaniel shows a habit of being emotionally impulsive, thus losing control of his temper, and jumping to conclusions. When he assumed the book Marinette gave him came from Ladybug, but learned it actually came from Marc, he believed the two were making fun of him, and angrily tore Marc's book without giving him the chance to explain. This trait is once again showcased in "The Ruler," in which Nathaniel wavers over publishing his latest comic with Marc, but ended up agreeing do so, hoping to prove himself to his parents. When his mother voices disapproval of the comic and goes as far to threaten to separate him from Marc, Nathaniel runs back to the school in tears and shreds all of the comic books created by him and Marc. However, thanks to the support of his friends, Nathaniel becomes more assertive, allowing himself to stand up to his controlling mother.

title: Nathaniel Kurtzberg
text:
Nathaniel Kurtzberg - Personality
Although his asocial nature might make him seem unfriendly, he is not malicious and is willing to learn from his mistakes and correct them. In "Reverser", upon realizing that rejecting Marc and ripping up his notebook caused him to be akumatized, Nathaniel is completely shocked and ashamed of what he did, teaming up with Alix to help Ladybug and Cat Noir de-akumatize Marc and subsequently make peace with him after realizing the misunderstanding. Despite being introverted and somewhat solitary, he is peaceful and considerate of his loved ones, setting aside his individualism to join his friends in helping and defending anyone in need. Nathaniel is also very protective of his boyfriend Marc, becoming furious when someone hurts him. In "The Ruler", when his akumatized mother brainwashes Marc and tells him to stay away from Nathaniel, he gives her a defiant stare and tells her that she shouldn't have taken her anger out on him.

title: Nathaniel Kurtzberg
text:
Nathaniel Kurtzberg - Personality
As Caprikid, he retains most of his personality, especially his creativity, which he utilizes when invoking his power to create any object he wants. Like a goat, he is stubborn and defiant, cleverly using his artistic skills against his enemies. He is also a team player, using his powers to fight alongside Ladybug and the rest of her team in a very effective way. Although as a civilian he was afraid to confront his controlling mother, upon seeing her attack Marc as The Ruler, Nathaniel finds the courage to transform into Caprikid to confront and de-akumatize her.

title: Nathaniel Kurtzberg
text:
Nathaniel Kurtzberg - Personality
As the Evillustrator (who was based on "Super Nathan"), he was more confident and direct, such as when he barged into Marinette's bedroom and asked her out to celebrate his birthday with him. Even when akumatized, he still genuinely cared for her, promising her that he would stop attacking Chloé and even defying Hawk Moth for a while when his date was at stake. However, he was furious when humiliated or tricked and he could be short-tempered and reckless. He accused Marinette of being just like Chloé when he discovered she had tricked him into helping Cat Noir get his akuma, immediately renouncing his kindness toward her and going after Chloé to get revenge, annoyed that Ladybug and Cat Noir would defend someone as despicable as her.

title: Nathaniel Kurtzberg
text:
Nathaniel Kurtzberg - Abilities
As a Civilian
Nathaniel is an artist, skilled in drawing pictures with pencil, pen, and marker, and creating digital art on his tablet. He is good at drawing still life, such as Chloé's bracelet, and drawing comics with human figures and costume designs. From season six onward, Nathaniel's art could rival that of even a seasoned professional.
In "Zombizou", Nathaniel is also shown to be skilled in painting, as he made one for Caline Bustier for her birthday. In "Re-creation", Nathaniel is seen using spray paint to create graffiti art as well.
In his titular episode, Nathaniel as the Evillustrator is shown "drawing" musical notes to create a melody, suggesting he has some musical knowledge or talent as well.
As Caprikid

title: Nathaniel Kurtzberg
text:
Nathaniel Kurtzberg - Abilities
Caprikid has enhanced capabilities such as speed, agility, and strength, and he is almost invulnerable to physical damage. These abilities allow him to react to and evade akumatized villains' attacks, as well as jump and leap several times his height and length. His tool is a paint brush, which he can use like a staff to defend himself. He can also use it to activate his power, Genesis, which allows him to create any object he can imagine. However, his creations are mundane and lack any kind of magic.
Caprikid loves to integrate his love for art into his fighting style, creating art supplies as weapons and shields when fighting supervillains. He is also shown to be very adept as a solo hero, as when his teammates are temporarily out of commission, he can quickly find a solution to defeat the villain. He can also be of great help to Ladybug, due to his ability to create anything that is necessary for Ladybug's Lucky Charm to work.

title: Nathaniel Kurtzberg
text:
Nathaniel Kurtzberg - Abilities
Initially, using his power would depower him and cause him to detransform after 5 minutes, however, in "Revelator", it is shown that Caprikid has learned to control his adult powers, allowing him to not detransform back and use Genesis as much as he wishes.
As the Evillustrator
The Evillustrator had the power to draw whatever he wanted onto his drawing tablet to make it appear and exist in real life. The objects he created could levitate and move freely in the air. He could also erase objects, both real-life objects and his own drawings, such as erasing a hole into a wall. However, in order to draw, the Evillustrator needed light, rendering him unable to use his powers in darkness.
In addition to regular physical objects, he could create cages made from an unknown, transparent blue material as well as living creatures. He could also play music by drawing musical notes, suggesting his creations could be non-physical as long as it has a visual representation. In "The Puppeteer", he drew Lady Wifi a new phone as her weapon, suggesting the objects could have magical abilities.
