title: Nathaniel Kurtzberg
text:
Nathaniel Kurtzberg - Etymology
The name "Nathaniel" is a variant of "Nathanael", derived from the Hebrew נְתַנְאֵל (Netan'el), which means "God/El has given" or "Gift of God/El".
Nathaniel's name is an homage to Nathanaël Bronn, the chief art director of the show.
A Miraculous promotional French document from TF1PRO released on September 23, 2015 spelled his name as Nathanaël, but Thomas Astruc later confirmed the correct spelling of his name to be Nathaniel when he released multiple characters' full names on July 18, 2016.
Nathaniel's surname "Kurtzberg" is variant of "Kurzberg", which means "short mountain" in German and Jewish origins.
His last name Kurtzberg is a reference to the famous American comic book artist Jack Kirby, who was born as Jacob Kurtzberg.
Caprikid's name may be derived from the sea goat constellation, Capricornus and/or the astrological sign, Capricorn, that is also represented by a sea goat.
The "kid" part may come from the word "kid", which means a baby goat.
The name of Nathaniel's akumatized form Evillustrator is a combination of the words "evil" and "illustrator".

title: Nathaniel Kurtzberg
text:
Nathaniel Kurtzberg - Etymology
In the French dub of the show, the Evillustrator's name is Le Dessinateur, meaning "the illustrator", "the cartoonist", or "the designer".
In the Korean dub, the Evillustrator's name is Evil Artist.
The name of Nathaniel's fictional, heroic persona of his akumatized form "Mightillustrator" is a combination of the words "might(y)" and "illustrator".
In the Chinese dub, his name is changed to 纳森 meaning "Nathan", and his akumatized form's name, 恶雷特 meaning "Elet".
In the Irish dub, his name was initially changed to Nioclás, but from season 2 onwards, it was changed to Naoise. This was most likely due to the introduction of Santa Claus in said season, who received the localized name San Nioclás.
"Nioclás" is the Irish variant of Nicholas, derived from the Greek name "Νικόλαος (Nikolaos)" meaning "victory of the people".
Naoise is a unisex name, derived from the Irish warrior Naoise from Irish mythology.

title: Nathaniel Kurtzberg
text:
Nathaniel Kurtzberg - Trivia
Revealed by the Staff
Nathaniel is Jewish, as supported by Thomas Astruc, as Jack Kirby was also Jewish. Thereby extension, he is the first Jewish Miraculous holder.
Since Nathaniel is Jewish and is about 13-15 years old, he must have already done his Bar Mitzvah.
His shirt symbol is based on the French rock band Magma. Both Thomas Astruc and Nathanaël Bronn are fans of the band.
Nathaniel sits behind Ivan in class to draw without being noticed.
He and Ivan are the only students in his class to not share their desks with another student.
In "Chameleon", Lila started sitting next to him.
Due to Alix's departure in "Evolution", Ivan moves next to Mylène, and Natheniel takes his place, leaving him and Lila alone once again.
After Sabrina helps Marinette expose Chloé and Lila in "Confrontation", and the latter leaves the school, Sabrina moves next to Nathaniel, who openly accepts her even after everything she did as Chloé's helper.
Nathaniel's drawing of Ladybug is actually an edited version of the issue #10 cover of The Mini Menace Ladybug, a series of fake comic covers drawn by Thomas Astruc.
Nathaniel's comic artwork in "Gabriel Agreste" and "The Ruler" are drawn by Gaëlle Geniller.

title: Nathaniel Kurtzberg
text:
Nathaniel Kurtzberg - Trivia
Miraculous Holder and Akumatized Villain
In Korea, SAMG Animation's NAVER blog hosted a Wallpaper event poll with the Season 1's akumatized villains, with the Evillustrator winning in first place.
In the Chinese dub, Nathaniel is voiced by a woman and has a feminine sounding voice, but when he transforms into the Evillustrator, he's voiced by a man and has a more masculine sounding voice.
The Evillustrator tries to avoid following Hawk Moth's orders to get the Miraculouses. As punishment, Hawk Moth briefly controls his body and almost prevents him from preparing for his date with Marinette.
This is one of two times Hawk Moth has used this ability, the other time being in "Pixelator".
Both of Nathaniel's personas inspired creations based on them, which often used by other characters to access his powers.
Marinette made a Evillustrator doll, which is used by Puppeteer as a conduit to transforms him into the Evillustrator in the episode "The Puppeteer".
The Evillustrator appears another time as part of Max Kanté's Miraculous All-Star Brawl in "Gamer 2.0", with Ladybug using him in one of her matches.

title: Nathaniel Kurtzberg
text:
Nathaniel Kurtzberg - Trivia
A statue of the Evillustrator appears in the Musée Grévin in "The Puppeteer 2", which was used by Puppeteer.
A statue of Caprikid appears in the Musée Grévin in "Determination", which is animated by Manipula's powers.
As seen in "Mr. Pigeon 72", Nathaniel has been akumatized into the Evillustrator five times. ("The Evillustrator" and four off-screen akumatizations)
Nathaniel is the second Miraculous holder whose superpower is similar to his villain identity's power as the Evillustrator and Caprikid both have the ability to create objects by drawing, after Alix.
As of "Penalteam", following Alya Césaire, Nino Lahiffe, Chloé Bourgeois, Nathalie Sancoeur, Luka Couffaine, Max Kanté, Kagami Tsurugi, Alix Kubdel, Lê Chiến Kim, Adrien Agreste, Wang Fu, Zoé Lee, Mylène Haprèle, Rose Lavillant, Juleka Couffaine, Sabrina Raincomprix and Marc Anciel, Nathaniel Kurtzberg is the eighteenth person to become a Miraculous holder and akumatized villain, excluding Gabriel Agreste, who akumatized himself, and Marinette Dupain-Cheng who almost got akumatized.
In the Season 6 outro, Caprikid's hair color was white in "The Illustrhater" and "Sublimation", but was fixed to red in "Daddycop".

title: Nathaniel Kurtzberg
text:
Nathaniel Kurtzberg - Trivia
In "The Ruler", Nathaniel and Marc reveal their superhero identities as Caprikid and Rooster Bold to each other, becoming the third couple to learn each other's secret identities, after Alya and Nino in "Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part 1)" and Kagami and Félix in "Miraculous Tokyo".
Miscellaneous
Only four people know Nathaniel's superhero identity: Marinette/Ladybug, Adrien/Cat Noir, Marc/Rooster Bold, and Alix/Bunnyx.
Nine characters, including kwamis like Tikki, Fluff, Plagg, Ziggy and Orikko.
Marinette (as Ladybug) entrusted the Goat Miraculous to Nathaniel in "Penalteam".
Adrien (as Cat Noir) was shown to know his secret identity in a flashback featured in "Revelator", when the other Miraculers unlocked their adult powers.
Alix (as Bunnyx and to extension, Fluff) found out in the Burrow.
Marc and Orikko found out in "The Ruler", when they revealed their secret identities to each other.
Nathaniel seems to be ambidextrous to some extent:
When he wakes up at the beginning of "The Evillustrator", he is holding a pencil with his right hand and can be seen using his right hand in the background of many episodes and other media artworks.

title: Nathaniel Kurtzberg
text:
Nathaniel Kurtzberg - Trivia
He is left-handed when he's the Evillustrator, as his drawing pad is on his right arm and he draws with his left hand.
In "Robostus", Nathaniel is notably shown drawing a sketch of Markov with his left hand.
In "Reverser", Nathaniel can be seen drawing with his left hand while talking with Alix.
In "Reverser", "Queen Banana", "Hack-San", and "Guiltrip", he can be seen tossing things to Alix and drawing with his right hand.
In "Zombizou", Nathaniel was the only member of Miss Bustier's class apart from Marinette who was not affected by the titular villain's powers, at least not on-screen.
Nathaniel, along with Marinette, Adrien and Juleka, were the only members of Ms. Bustier's class not to be akumatized on "Heroes' Day.
As of "Ladybug", Nathaniel and Adrien are the only students in Ms. Bustier's class to not have been affected by a scarlet akuma.
Excluding honorary members, Nathaniel, along with Zoé, Sabrina, and Marc, are the only members of the Resistance whose code names are unknown.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur - Intro
is one of the two secondary antagonists (alongside Tomoe Tsurugi) of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir.
She is also a major antagonist in Miraculous World: New York - United Heroez, a supporting antagonist in Miraculous World: Shanghai - The Legend of Ladydragon, a minor character in Miraculous World: Paris - Tales of Shadybug and Claw Noir, and the tritagonist of Miraculous World: London - At the Edge of Time.
She is a former treasure hunter of magical objects and Gabriel Agreste's assistant who manages his fashion work, his mansion, and takes care of his son, Adrien, of whom she has been the legal guardian since season 6. She is the daughter of Camilo Pista, a member of The Kingdom, an evil organization that is after the Ladybug and the Cat Miraculouses, of which she is also a member under the name of Shadow of the Diamond, before becoming the Shadow of the Machine.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur - Intro
In "Heroes' Day" special, Nathalie was voluntarily akumatized by Hawk Moth into Catalyst, a power-enhancing supervillain. In order to save Hawk Moth from the The Miraculers, Nathalie used the Peacock Miraculous. When the Peacock Miraculous was inhabited by Duusu, she became Mayura, a peacock-themed supervillain with the power of Emotion who helped Hawk Moth by creating allies for akumatized villains.
In "Ladybug", Nathalie was reakumatized into Catalyst in an attempt to help Scarlet Moth, but due to being ill, she was de-akumatized shortly after.
Throughout Season 4, due to using the damaged Peacock Miraculous, Nathalie was left very weak and stuck in bed, but was eventually well enough to get back to work, with the aid of robotic leg braces that help her walk.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur - Intro
In "Evolution", after Gabriel failed to fix the Peacock Miraculous by giving the recipe to do it to his younger self, in that way preventing Émilie, Nathalie and Tomoe from using the damaged Miraculous and getting sick, all because of his fixation to get Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous, Nathalie, feeling betrayed by him, decided to break ties with him and stop helping him, leaving Gabriel frustrated that she had abandoned him for his failure.
In "Passion", with Adrien in risk of becoming alone due to both hers and Gabriel's terminal situation and to honor Émilie's wishes, Nathalie let herself to be akumatized by Monarch into Safari, a hunter-themed supervillain with the power to never miss her target and received the power of the Goat Miraculous superpower through her Alliance ring. She also wanted to take the Ladybug and Cat Miraculous herself in order to prevent Gabriel from using them to mold the universe into his own madness.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur - Intro
In "Representation", Nathalie's illness from the Peacock Miraculous got worse, as there were visible eye bags under her eyes and the red highlights in her hair turned white. Gabriel also took the other half of the double wedding ring from her, as he said that she was unworthy of upholding the legacy of the Agrestes.
In "The Final Day", Nathalie attempted to do a video message for Adrien, but failed to do so. She also tried to stop Gabriel, but passed out, after Gabriel transformed into Monarch and attacked her with his cane. He took Nathalie to her room, where Ladybug was hiding. Once Gabriel left the room, Ladybug questioned Nathalie about where Adrien was. Nathalie informed her that he was safe and implored her to stop Monarch at all costs before she succumbed to her illness. After Gabriel sacrificed himself and made the wish to heal Nathalie and to redeem himself, she recovered from her illness.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur - Intro
In "Miraculous London", after awakening from her coma, Nathalie confronted Bug Noire, in this way discovering her secret identity as Marinette, and learned about Gabriel's sacrifice, and helped the heroine release the imprisoned Kwamis while revealing Gabriel's plan. At Bug Noire's request, she decided not to tell Adrien about his father being Monarch or her role as Mayura to take care of Adrien.
In "Werepapas", Nathalie has taken on the role of Adrien Agreste's legal guardian following the death of his father. This marks a significant shift in Adrien's life, as he is no longer under his father's strict control. Nathalie, who had always been loyal to Gabriel and cared deeply for Adrien, now steps up to ensure his well-being. Given her past as Mayura and her deteriorating health due to overuse of the Peacock Miraculous, it remains to be seen how she will handle this new responsibility and what it means for Adrien's future.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur - Intro
In "El Toro De Piedra", it's revealed that Nathalie is part of The Kingdom, a secret organization that has as their main objective to acquire the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses, being Gabriel's (who was part of its council as The Diamond) "shadow". As of this episode, she becomes the "shadow" of Tomoe Tsurugi, another member of the council called The Machine.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Nathalie stands at an average adult height. She looks about in her early 30's, has pale skin with wrinkles under the eyes, bluebell eyes and straight black hair with dark blue reflections and a streak on the left side of her head that was dyed a red color. Her hair is pulled back into a bun with the bangs parted at right on top and a piece of it hanging over her face in the middle.
However, from "Representation" to "Conformation", due to her illness, her dyed streak became white and she got dark eye bags.
From Season 6 onwards, Nathalie's hair is now styled shoulder-length  has an ombre from black to red, is down, and now reaches the nape of her neck. She is seen with red lipstick. The bottom of her hair is rounded inwards and she has dark mauve reflections in place of her dark blue reflections and cerise nail polish. In the post-credits of "El Toro De Piedra" and "Noe", she has her hair pulled back into her initial bun-style when she had a private discussion with the council of The Kingdom and during a meeting with Noé Luxus,
Civilian Attire

title: Nathalie Sancoeur
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur - Appearance
In the first five seasons, Nathalie had glasses with black and red striped frames and she wore very pale blue eyeshadow. She wore a red turtleneck sweater, a black dress jacket, a charcoal gray collar, black pants, and black medium-heel shoes. She also had round creamy-white earrings. From "Risk" and onwards, she wore Émilie's wedding ring, which was entrusted to her by Gabriel, until he took it from her in "Representation".
From Season 6 onwards, she wears a dark red dress shirt, has her dress jacket unbuttoned with two lighter buttons at the left and pockets, the same pants from before, and dark red ankle strap high-heeled sandals. Her suit also gets a pinstripe pattern on it. She also wears sharper, angular glasses with the frames now slightly dull burgundy, which also circle the lens at the top and sides. She also no longer wears her earrings. In the post-credits of "El Toro De Piedra" and "Noe", she is shown to wear her original black shoes when she had a private discussion with the council of The Kingdom and during a meeting with Noé Luxus.
As Mayura

title: Nathalie Sancoeur
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur - Appearance
Mayura's skin was light indigo, and she had short, strong blue hair, part of which curled up underneath her left eye. Her eyes had light magenta irises and vivid violet sclerae, and there was black eyeliner around her eyes, resembling glasses.
She wore a peacock-feather-like cocktail hat, which was blue and teardrop-shaped with a light pink mark in the center and a light blue, translucent veil over her right eye below. She wore a blue dress with a fuzzy black collar and sleeves that end in a point on the back of her hand. The dress appeared to have a set hexagonal texture, as well as the Peacock Miraculous in the center, which turned blue and black at the tip with the feathers pale cerulean and blue with cerise marks. The bottom of the dress had a front-slit skirt, and the end of the skirt had rounded points with dark blue, light-pink-centered spots, resembling a peacock's tail feathers. The rounded points were edged with translucent light blue material. Underneath the dress, she had translucent indigo tights that were opaque from the knees down, and black high-heeled boots with laces. She also held a blue hand fan as her tool which resembled the patterns on her skirt.
As Catalyst

title: Nathalie Sancoeur
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur - Appearance
Catalyst had pale, light grayish blue skin. Over her head, while leaving her mouth exposed, she wore a dark grayish cornflower blue helmet with a red thin visor that is jagged at the ends, with dark grayish cornflower blue edges and a red gradient spike pointing towards the back of her head. Catalyst also wore a dark grayish cornflower blue dress suit with pointed shoulders acting as a collar, including a dark red front and swan neck collar that featured a red downward-arrow-shaped section in the center. The sleeves covered her entire arms, with the tips of her fingers red. Also, Catalyst had pocket-like ridges on each side of her hips, and her pant legs came down to her feet, having red high-heels, soles, and tiny triangular tips.
As Safari

title: Nathalie Sancoeur
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur - Appearance
As Safari, she looked a lot like her civilian form. However, she had pale light grayish purple skin, vivid red eyes with dark purple sclera, dark purple lips, a pair of pince nez glasses with silver frames and red lenses, and her now black hair was slicked back with her red streak being more evident and vibrant at the left, followed by a slightly thick red strand bending downwards in front of her face, slanting at left. She wore a dark purple turtleneck short-sleeved sweater, a crimson camouflage hunting short-sleeved jacket and shorts rolled up to the thigh with a white belt accented by dark mauve rectangular straps, the left one having a silver dot to accent the similar charcoal gray square button with another dot on top near the shorts ends, dark purple fingerless lower arm-length gloves, and dark mauve knee high boots with laces at the front and slightly higher tan socks below. Her right glove had a black circular pod-like device around the wrist. She was also armed with a light lavender crossbow with light red accents.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur - Personality
Nathalie is a serious and formal woman who works very diligently as Gabriel Agreste's assistant. She has a cold and distant demeanor as she doesn't openly show her emotions around others most of the time. Her will is strong, remaining unfazed even when people of greater authority like Audrey Bourgeois yell at her, knowing the aforementioned couldn't affect her and smiled with satisfaction after the event. Objective, sensible, and understanding, Nathalie can reason with both Gabriel and Adrien whenever they are acting inconsiderately or emotionally, sometimes in relation to each other. While not warm, she can be cordial and polite.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur - Personality
However, in situations where she is dealing with Gabriel, Nathalie becomes nervous, being afraid to disappoint him. Her desire to be on his good side leads her to unfair actions, such as giving Adrien a birthday gift and claiming it is from Gabriel when it is actually from Marinette. Despite this, she doesn't always obey Gabriel's orders or has acted rebelliously, as seen in "Oni-Chan" when she let Lila enter with the intention to help Adrien, not knowing she was being manipulated in that moment. This was seen again in "Ladybug" but to a more dangerous step, as she used the then damaged Peacock Miraculous despite her more delicate condition.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur - Personality
Although she doesn't usually openly show it, Nathalie desires what is best for the Agreste family and often hopes that Gabriel would pass more time with Adrien instead of acting as a villain. However, her concern is limited to the Agreste family only and she doesn't seem to care about the other Parisians' well-being. In fact, Nathalie obeys Gabriel's orders and helps him with his plans with fierce dedication and loyalty, no matter how morally wrong they are, so he could accomplish his goal and thus finish his time as Hawk Moth. She takes sadistic joy in fooling the heroes into thinking they can win.
Even though she has a cool and calm demeanor, Nathalie can lose her temper on occasion and would disregard any detrimental consequences as a result. She can get frustrated by the fact that her boss is failing and even goes as far as letting herself be harmed in order to success, which actually make many plans successful. Despite this, Nathalie admits that the job is sometimes too much.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur - Personality
As shown in "Ladybug", Nathalie apparently sees the sentimonsters she creates as Mayura only as tools to do her bidding and has no qualms with revoking their amoks if they defy her as she did with the Ladybug sentimonster, effectively murdering a living, sentient being and showing no remorse for having done so.
However, like Gabriel, she didn't think things the whole way through, as in "Evolution", they both didn't fully understand the consequences of time travel. Even if Gabriel managed to give himself the recipe to fix the Peacock Miraculous before it was used by Émilie, it would create a time paradox that could put in danger the entire time-continuum.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur - Personality
Despite initially being extremely loyal to Gabriel (as she helped him in many dangerous and risky plans to get the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses and even put her life on the line while using the damaged Peacock Miraculous), Nathalie was not above noticing the madness forming in Gabriel's mind. This is shown at the moment he came up with the plan to force Ladybug to take risks so she would make a mistake. However, it is when she realizes that Gabriel's obsession in defeating Ladybug and Cat Noir is far bigger than his wish to heal Émilie and herself that she finally understands his madness and puts a strain on their friendship, refusing to help him any longer. However, despite no longer supporting Gabriel as Monarch, she would still work for him as his secretary and live at the mansion in order to keep Adrien safe.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur - Personality
After learning about Gabriel's Cataclysmed arm that was fated to spread and kill him, and that this would cause Adrien to become alone (as Nathalie was fated to die as well because of the magic illness she got from using the damaged Peacock Miraculous), Nathalie comes to a decision to continue to help Gabriel in his plans, even letting him akumatize her. However, instead of helping to give him the Miraculous, she would use him to get the Miraculous for herself so she would be the one to make the wish to bring Émilie back, in order to prevent Gabriel from using them to mold the universe to his madness. Failing to do just that, Nathalie decided to spend the rest of the time she had left to enjoy Adrien's company and ensure his future and happiness.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur - Personality
As Nathalie started to dedicate herself fully to Adrien, the very remaining loyalty she still had for Gabriel started to disappear, as she saw her boss abusing the control he had on Adrien. This is seen when Gabriel, after realizing Adrien was dating Marinette instead of Kagami, forced his son to stop seeing Marinette. This led Nathalie, after seeing how miserable Adrien was because of the conflict he was feeling about obeying his father and his love for Marinette, to incentivize him to not let anyone tell him who he should love, something that angered Gabriel. Since that moment, Nathalie started to do her best to protect Adrien's happiness from Gabriel's control, something that is slowly turning Gabriel against her as well.
After Gabriel launched his final plan, Nathalie, despite her illness, decided to stop him from taking someone else's life away to revive Émilie, knowing she wouldn't have agreed to that and warned Ladybug of his actions, urging her to stop him.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur - Personality
In "Miraculous London", it's showed that, despite Gabriel healed her with the wish, Nathalie was still willing to confront him and stop him, becoming surprised to learn that he had sacrificed his own life for her and yet relieved that, in the end, Gabriel, thanks to Marinette/Bug Noire, was able to rekindle with his humanity and do the right thing.
However, while assuring Marinette/Bug Noire that she was now on her side, she did regret not stopping Gabriel years ago and was not like him.
When Bug Noire tearily confessed to feeling guilty and heartbroken about the Agreste family to the point where she admitted that she wanted to sacrifice herself, Nathalie comforted her.
She began making her amends by telling her where the kwamis were, destroying evidence linking Gabriel to Monarch, informing her about Tomoe Tsurugi's role as his ally, and where Adrien and Kagami were being kept in London.
Nathalie was willing to tell the truth, even if that meant turning herself in to the authorities for her actions as Hawk Moth's accomplice, showing she's willing to accept the consequences of her actions.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur - Personality
However, Bug Noire advised her not to, stating Adrien still needed her to be a mother figure to him, which surprised her because she is not his parent, but presumably thought of Émilie's words of being there for Adrien and to take care of him as a mother.
From that moment on, Nathalie fully assumed the role of Adrien's legal guardian. Although she initially doubted her ability to fill the void left by Émilie, Marinette's support, Adrien's grandparents' approval, and, above all, Adrien's express wish to stay with her, allowed her to gain confidence and accept her new responsibility. Nathalie also is shown to have a dry sense of humour in Vampigami, after having been woken up early for the third morning in a row by Marinette coming over for breakfast with Adrien.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur - Personality
However, Nathalie is also determined to prevent the fragile balance they have achieved from collapsing. This led her to resolve to keep the truth about Gabriel and his identity as Monarch a secret, as she fears that Adrien will feel deeply betrayed upon discovering both the truth about his father and her own involvement. This decision led her to keep a close eye on Marinette and forbid her from revealing the truth to Adrien when Marinette regretted having kept it from him, stating that an irreversible decision has been made and it is too late to turn back.
Having recovered from her Peacock Miraculous illness, Nathalie was forced to resume her collaboration with The Kingdom. However, it is made clear that she does so against her will. Nathalie deliberately deceives the members of the organization, making them believe she is unaware of what happened during the final battle between Ladybug and Monarch, and conceals both her knowledge of Ladybug's secret identity and her direct involvement in the events surrounding Ladybug's deception. Despite this, on her father's orders, she is forced to attempt to obtain Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous and deliver them to him.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur - Personality
Her discomfort and contempt for the other members of The Kingdom is evident in "Noe", when Noé Luxus tried to buy the Gabriel brand from Adrien and when Adrien asked for her opinion, Nathalie exchanged a tense and angry look with Noe, but assured Adrien that it was an offer worth considering. Her body language makes clear her rejection of Noe and the organization's intentions, reinforcing the idea that Nathalie no longer acts out of loyalty, but out of obligation and strategy.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur - Abilities
As a Civilian
Nathalie is an effective assistant, able to take care of Gabriel's fashion work, look out for superheroes and potential akuma victims, and organize Adrien's strict schedule. Additionally, Nathalie has capable teaching abilities, as shown during Adrien's homeschool period.
Like her boss, Nathalie is insightful and cunning. She had the idea to use Lila's lying ability to cause stress to Chloé, who indirectly caused a very powerful akumatized villain and caused eventual doubt in the former superheroine. In the episode "Félix", she displayed notable unarmed combat skills.
Her plan of impersonating Ladybug with the Sentimonster Ladybug to get the Cat Miraculous had a considerable chance to succeed, but ultimately failed.
Throughout most of her appearances, Nathalie has proved to be talented with the element of stealth. She is good at hiding herself and take advantage of distractions to sneak without anyone noticing. This ability allowed her to evade professional guards and steal Fu's tablet with the deciphered spellbook pages.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur - Abilities
Due to her experience as a treasure hunter, she knows how to use a crossbow, as she tried to use it against Gabriel to stop him, only failing due to her illness.
After being given Émilie's ring (which cointained half of Adrien's amok) in "Risk", she was able to influence Adrien. However, she only used it when seeing Gabriel abusing his own control on his son, and she motivated Adrien to seek his own happiness as seen in "Protection" until Gabriel took the ring back from her in "Representation".
As Mayura
Mayura had enhanced physical characteristics: speed, strength, and agility. She showed considerable hand-to-hand combat skills against more experienced combatants.
However, her illness started to weaken her physical prowess even in her enhanced state.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur - Abilities
Mayura was able to infuse a feather plucked from her hand fan with her power, transforming it into an Amok, and sending it out to possess an object owned by a chosen target, with whom she could communicate telepathically. While she was communicating, a blue curved peacock mask appeared in front of her and her target's faces. Her actions then gave an emotion from her target a physical form of that person's choosing, which acted as the target's ally until recalled via a snap of her fingers, which destroyed it.
Even if she didn't create them, Mayura could either bring back to life dormant sentimonsters or destroy them through their amoks. This ability was first seen in "Feast".
As Catalyst

title: Nathalie Sancoeur
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur - Abilities
Catalyst had the power to multiply/enhance/augment/increase someone's powers; infusing scarlet energy into an object belonging to her target, similar to an akumatized object. When affected, the person gained a red-colored outfit. In Hawk Moth's case, this power allowed him to akumatize multiple butterflies and transform multiple people at once. Catalyst could also communicate with the person she enhanced, during which a red sharp-edged butterfly mask appeared in front of both of their faces, similar to Hawk Moth.
As Safari
Safari's main power was to be able to always hit her target. From Monarch, she received the power of Genesis, which allowed her to create her own set of weapons: a crossbow with five projectiles, each with the ability to hold a Miraculous power, and were charged by Monarch with other Miraculous superpowers: Mirage, Venom, Gift, Elemental Dragons and Clout; a tracker that she used on her right wrist to guide her projectiles and also a whip that she could use to throw objects at her target, with those objects following them due to her innate power.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur - Etymology
The name Nathalie comes from a Latin root meaning "birth" or "born". Its use as a name is typically taken from the Latin phrase natale domini, meaning "birth of the Lord", referring to Christmas Day.
Nathalie's surname Sancoeur ("sans cœur") means "heartless" or "without a heart" in French.
Despite the noun cœur being spelled with the ligature œ, Nathalie's surname is usually written with the sequence oe even in sources which use diacritics in other characters' names, including Thomas Astruc himself. There are exceptions, however, such as Gabriel's contact list in "Miraculous Paris".
In the Irish dub, her name is changed to Nainsí; Irish for Nancy, which means "grace", "favored", or "pure".
The name Mayura means "peacock" in Sanskrit, one of the sacred birds in Hindu mythology. It is also a contemporary Hindu name used in many parts of India.
While the villain is female, Mayura is specifically the term for males while Mayuri is the term for females.
In the Bulgarian dub for "Mayura", her name is changed to Mayra. However, throughout season 3, she is referred to as Moyra.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur - Trivia
Revealed by the Staff
Mayura was revealed at the Miraculous panel at New York Comic Con 2016 under the name "Le Paon" (French for "The Peacock").
Earlier, at a panel at San Diego Comic Con, Thomas Astruc pointed to an image of her in the sneak peek collage image, commenting that she will be a new recurring supervillain that will be Hawk Moth's ally.
Her final name was revealed at a TF1 press conference advertising the upcoming Season 3.
Mayura's civilian identity was revealed by the end of season 2.
There were also clues about her in the opening theme song for the season.
Nathalie's akumatized form, Catalyst, was first revealed in a promotional video for Season 2 from TFOU.
She is also the first akumatized villain who didn't directly fight Ladybug and Cat Noir until "Passion".
In a video interview held on August 25, 2018, Jeremy Zag mentioned that the new main villain will make Hawk Moth appear like "a baby" in comparison. It is unknown if this villain is Mayura.
She was said to appear as Hawk Moth's "boss" in season 3.
Miraculous Holder and Akumatized Villains

title: Nathalie Sancoeur
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur - Trivia
Nathalie is the first character to explicitly be willingly akumatized (aside from Gabriel Agreste akumatizing himself in "The Collector"), although Lila Rossi's smirk after her de-evilization implies she may have also been willing to serve his scheme.
Nathalie used to suffer from prolonged health issues as a result of using the Peacock Miraculous in its damaged state.
She's the second Miraculous holder to use their power for evil after Gabriel Agreste.
She is the first villain in the series to both directly and permanently kill another character by voluntarily taking back the Ladybug Sentimonster's Amok after she betrayed her to side with the real Ladybug and Cat Noir.
She's the first Miraculous holder whose skin tone changes color when she transforms.
Following Alya Césaire, Nino Lahiffe, and Chloé Bourgeois, Nathalie is the fourth person to become a Miraculous holder and akumatized villain, excluding Gabriel, who akumatized himself.
Catalyst also shares a resemblance with the Collector's design as they both have purplish skin, red glass over their eyes and black dress suits with stiff shoulders.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur - Trivia
Catalyst is so far the only akumatized villain not to be defeated by the French Miraculous superhero team and the only one they are not aware of.
Catalyst is also the first akumatized villain to enter Hawk Moth's lair, aside from The Collector.
Despite knowing the Peacock Miraculous was damaged, she still used it to the point that her health condition was dangerously close to Émilie Agreste's condition from the Miraculous. If she hadn't stole Wang Fu's tablet to fix the Peacock Miraculous in "Miracle Queen", she might have ended up like Émilie. However in "Conformation" she fell in an endless sleep due to her illness, but is revived in "Re-creation" due to Gabriel's wish.
Catalyst's telepathic mask when estabilished has the same sound effect of Hawk Moth/Shadow Moth/Monarch's, but seven steps higer pitched.
Miscellaneous
Nathalie appears to be left-handed as she does most things with her left hand like holding a stylus in her left hand during "Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)".

title: Nathalie Sancoeur
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur - Trivia
Without her, Gabriel never would have found both the Peacock and Butterfly Miraculouses. As such, she can be considered largely responsible for the events of the show happening in the first place, aside from Master Fu when he created the Dormant Sentimonster.
Nathalie was the only person in the present who knew that Gabriel Agreste was Hawk Moth, the only person other than Félix Fathom to know he was Shadow Moth, and was among the few people to know his identity as Monarch along with Félix Fathom, Tomoe Tsurugi, Lila Rossi/Cerise, and eventually Kagami Tsurugi, Marinette Dupain-Cheng and Alix Kubdel. The members of The Kingdom knew about his identity as Monarch as well but when they were informed of him being the Butterfly Miraculous holder is unknown.
Nathalie bares some similarities to Nastasia from Super Paper Mario, both in appearance and personality.
She is the seventh person confirmed to discover Marinette's identity as Ladybug in the permanent timeline, following Alya Césaire, Su-Han, Luka Couffaine, Kagami Tsurugi, Félix Fathom and Alix Kubdel.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur - Trivia
However, it's possible that she is the eighth person to discover Marinette's superhero identity, if we assume that Marianne Lenoir knows about it.
In "Conformation", Gabriel also discovered Marinette's superhero identity in the permanent timeline, bringing the number to nine, but he died after granting his wish.

title: Nathaniel & Marc/Transcript
text:
Nathaniel & Marc/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Dear diary, you won't believe what happened to me today. I got akumatized! (chuckles) Don't worry. It was just one of Nath's comics.
Marinette: (narrates over the scene) Our relationship has changed a lot since the start of the school year, you know. He used to be so shy, he didn't talk to anyone. He would just be off alone in his corner always drawing his comic books.
Olga Mendeleiev: What are you drawing?
Nathaniel: Wha, wha---
Olga Mendeleiev: And these artistic endeavours are clearly why you are failing science.
Marinette: (narrates over the scene) The first time I got to talk to him was when he got akumatized by Hawk Moth.
Marinette: Are you going to hurt me?
Evillustrator: You? You're Marinette! You're beautiful and sweet and... you're perfect and I could never hurt you!
Marinette: (narrates over the scene) I felt pretty awkward. Sure, it was touching, but a bit weird coming from a super villain.

title: Nathaniel & Marc/Transcript
text:
Nathaniel & Marc/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (narrates over the scene) Luckily, when he became Nathaniel again after Ladybug saved him, he was no longer in love with me, but with Ladybug! And he used that impossible love as an inspiration to create a new comic book. Nathaniel has a real talent for drawing stories.
Marinette: (narrates over the scene) But he needed someone to write them. So I introduced him to Marc Anciel. Marc reminds me so much of Nathaniel at the beginning of the school year. He's just as shy as Nath used to be.
Marinette: (narrates over the scene) And he's really talented too, except his thing is writing. Plus, Marc is a big fan of Nath.
Marinette: (narrates over the scene) But being the shy guys that they are, the two of them needed a little help to actually meet. And that's where I stepped in.
Marinette: Someone gave me this for you.
Marinette: (narrates over the scene) True, it didn't really work, at first. Let's just say, my plan was a little bit overcomplicated.
Marc: I-I just want.. to make.. a comic book, if you want to, that is.
Nathaniel: A comic book? Us!? ''Together?! Never! (rips Marc's pages out of his book)
Marc: Ah!

title: Nathaniel & Marc/Transcript
text:
Nathaniel & Marc/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (narrates over the scene) But they ended up realizing that they were made to create comic books together.
Ladybug: By now you realize there was a big misunderstanding, but if you give each other a chance, I'm sure you'll find out how well you can work together.
Marinette: (narrates over the scene) And they become friends.
Marinette: (narrates over the scene) Since then, it seems like Nath has been more interested in the manga contest they're entering together than his feelings for Ladybug.
Marinette: (narrates over the scene) Which is a good thing, because Ladybug's heart only beats for one person. But you already know that, don't you?
Marinette: (narrates over the scene) Anyway, I'm off to see Nath and Marc. They're meeting with the publisher today to submit the comic in which they've akumatized me.
Marinette: I'm sure it's going to be a success and their work will finally be published. Don't worry, I'll tell you everything. Goodbye for now, dear diary.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur/History
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur/History - Intro
Nathalie Sancoeur is the assistant of Gabriel Agreste. She is in charge of taking care of various tasks for him as well as taking care of his son, Adrien. In the Season 2 premiere, it is revealed that she is aware that Gabriel is Hawk Moth and in the Season 2 finale, she uses the Peacock Miraculous to become the villain Mayura and throughout Season 3 when it takes its toll on her, due to it being damaged. She continues assisting Gabriel throughout Season 4 until the Season 5 premiere when she realize his obsession with the Miraculous has gone too far but still resides at the mansion for Adrien. She falls into a deep coma but is revived when Gabriel uses the Ultimate Miraculous Absolute Power to bring her back to life in exchange for his life.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur/History
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur/History - Before Season 1
Nathalie fought snakes in her youth along with Gabriel and went on adventures. She fell in love with Gabriel but saw that he was falling in love with Emilie as Gabriel and Emilie grew closer. She is said to have also found the Peacock Miraculous along with the Butterfly high in the Tibetan mountains with Gabriel and Emilie there too.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur/History
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)", as Adrien attempts to enter Collège Françoise Dupont, Nathalie along with Adrien's bodyguard stop him, reminding him that his father doesn't want him going to school, though Adrien insists that's what he wants. When Adrien spots Master Fu tripped and unable to reach his cane, he runs to help him, therefore allowing Nathalie and the bodyguard to block the steps leading into the building and take him back home. Later, Nathalie, while homeschooling Adrien, quizzes him on history until Gabriel interrupts and firmly tells Adrien that he will not be going to school before exiting. Nathalie offers to end the homeschooling for the day, though Adrien sadly runs up to his room before she can finish.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur/History
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Stoneheart (Origins - Part 2)", Nathalie notices that Adrien is not in his room and informs Gabriel, who scolds her and the bodyguard for failing to notice Adrien leave. Just as Adrien is about to enter the school, Nathalie begs him not to as his father will be furious, though Adrien tells her to tell him that she came too late and enters. Nathalie tells the bodyguard she'll handle it. The next day, per request by Nathalie, Gabriel allows Adrien to continue going to school, to which Adrien thanks both her and his father.
In "The Bubbler", after giving Adrien his schedule, Adrien asks her if his father approved his request for a birthday party, to which Nathalie informs him that he didn't and wishes a saddened Adrien a happy birthday.
Later, Nathalie answers the doorbell when Marinette comes over to the Agreste mansion to deliver her birthday gift to Adrien, telling her to put it in the mailbox.
Gabriel asks her through an intercom who was there, to which Nathalie tells him that it was a friend of Adrien's delivering him a birthday gift.
Gabriel therefore asks Nathalie if she got Adrien a gift on his behalf.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur/History
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur/History - [[Season 1]]
Nathalie nervously claims that Gabriel never asked her to do that, though Gabriel yells at her that he did.
Nathalie agrees to get it done, and after Gabriel hangs up, she decides to pass off Marinette's gift as Gabriel's.
Then Nino comes by and Nathalie witnesses him requesting that Gabriel allow Adrien to have a birthday party and Gabriel's cold refusal.
After Nino is akumatized into Bubbler, Nathalie is one of the many adults seen floating in bubbles in the sky.
After Bubbler's defeat, Gabriel asks Nathalie if Adrien liked his gift, to which Nathalie says that she'll check.
She then approaches Adrien and hands him Marinette's gift, claiming that it's a birthday present from his father.
In "Mr. Pigeon", during Gabriel Agreste's derby hat competition, Nathalie introduces herself to Mr. Damocles and presents Gabriel, who is judging the competition via video chat on her tablet. She takes Gabriel around as he observes all the hats and eventually declares Marinette the winner.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur/History
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur/History - [[Season 1]]
In "The Mime", Nathalie is sitting next to Adrien in the backseat of the Agreste car as they head to the premiere of The Mime's Extraordinary Adventures. She receives a phone call from Gabriel informing her that he will not be able to make it to the show. After hanging up, Adrien asks her if his father is flaking, to which Nathalie says yes but also informs him that his father reserved front row seats. Then Ladybug shows up as she battles Mime and tells everyone in the car to get out and find a safe hiding spot. Nathalie is then seen running away along with the bodyguard.
In "Volpina", after Adrien snoops into his father's safe, Nathalie enters the atelier and alerts Adrien that he'll be late for school.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur/History
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Santa Claws", Nathalie and Adrien are decorating a tree for Christmas when Adrien asks if his father is coming.
Nathalie suggests that they give him a few minutes, though Adrien believes that his father won't come and sadly heads to his room.
Therefore, Nathalie approaches Gabriel in his atelier and reminds him that it's Adrien's first Christmas without his mother.
Gabriel agrees and promises to go see him, claiming to just need a little time, which Nathalie understands.
Later, when Nathalie, Gabriel, and the bodyguard discover that Adrien isn't in his room, they immediately set out searching for him, with Nathalie making phone calls to the police and Adrien's friends.
Eventually, Adrien returns home and Nathalie informs him that his father does want to spend Christmas with him and had gone to see him earlier only to find him gone.
She then makes Adrien's bodyguard escort Adrien back to his room and ensure he'll stay there.
Later, Nathalie is in the atelier where Gabriel tells Adrien he can't bear the thought of losing him until the doorbell rings.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur/History
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur/History - [[Season 2]]
Answering the door and seeing many of Adrien's friends and their parents, Nathalie reveals that she informed everyone that Adrien was safe and sound.
She warmly wishes Adrien a Merry Christmas and joins everyone in sharing a huge Christmas feast.
In "The Collector", Nathalie and Gabriel discover that Adrien had taken the Miraculous Spellbook from Gabriel's safe and confront him about it in his room.
As punishment, Gabriel informs Adrien that he will start homeschooling with Nathalie again before the two exit the room.
In his atelier, Nathalie asks Gabriel what he'll do without the Miraculous Spellbook, to which Gabriel replies by handing her a blank sketchbook and telling her to put it where it belongs.
While Gabriel begins destroying his atelier, Nathalie guards the door.
Adrien hears the noise from his room and rushes downstairs with his bodyguard to see what it is, but Nathalie stops them and tells Adrien that his father is very busy before sending him back upstairs to practice his piano.
When Gabriel akumatizes himself into Collector, Nathalie is the first person he collects into his sketchbook.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur/History
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur/History - [[Season 2]]
After Collector is defeated and Gabriel gets the Miraculous Spellbook back, Nathalie watches as Gabriel scrolls through a digital copy of the book and asks why he went through so much trouble if he already had a copy of the book.
Gabriel informs her that he had to keep his identity safe.
Nathalie then watches as Gabriel enters his lair.
In "Glaciator", Nathalie approaches Adrien as he finishes eating dinner and informs him that his father will be eating dinner in his office. As Adrien sadly goes up to his room, Nathalie reminds him to practice his piano before he goes to bed.
In "Gorizilla", once Gabriel sees that his son isn't in his room, he calls for Nathalie, who immediately appears. She and the bodyguard are scolded by Gabriel for letting Adrien leave without either noticing and ordered to find him. Nathalie quickly takes off.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur/History
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Captain Hardrock", Nathalie listens as Adrien plays piano for his father until he makes a mistake, causing Gabriel to decide that Adrien should practice more instead of attend his friends' concert. She then exits the room with Gabriel. Later, Nathalie and Gabriel come back to listen to Adrien play, though when Adrien requests that his father play with him and he accepts, Nathalie can't help but smile.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur/History
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Style Queen (Queen's Battle - Part 1)", at Gabriel Agreste's fashion show, she catches Marinette as she attempts to sneak out and leads her to the dressing rooms. On the way, Marinette bumps into Audrey Bourgeois, who notices Marinette's hat and asks what it is, though Nathalie informs her that they must keep going before Marinette can deny that the hat is hers. Once they arrive inside Adrien's dressing room and Marinette gives Adrien the hat, Nathalie leads Marinette to the front row seats. She spots Audrey and tells her that she has a second row seat, which infuriates Audrey as she only accepts front row seats. She attempts to fire Nathalie, but Nathalie reminds her that she works for Gabriel, not her. Audrey attempts to call Gabriel but he doesn't answer, prompting Nathalie to comment that she assumes she isn't fired, causing Audrey to furiously storm out and be vulnerable for akumatization into Style Queen by Hawk Moth. After Style Queen’s defeat, Nathalie contacts Gabriel and comments on the big risk he took involving his son getting turned into a glitter statue.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur/History
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Queen Wasp (Queen's Battle - Part 2)", when Gabriel decides to quit being Hawk Moth and sadly sulks over his wife, Nathalie notices and hugs him. Later on, when Gabriel changes his mind about quitting being Hawk Moth, Nathalie confronts him about it. Gabriel tells her that he can’t give up, as he misses his wife too much. Though Nathalie understands, she can’t help but feel sad for him.
In "Sandboy", Nathalie is shown wishing Gabriel a goodnight before leaving his atelier.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur/History
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part 1)", after informing Adrien that she reserved the Chinese and fencing classes for him like he requested and reminding him that he must make an appearance at the Agreste Foundation Heroes Day Gala, Nathalie approaches Gabriel as he is staring at a stone statue of Emilie. After Gabriel tells her that he won't forgive himself if his plan fails, Nathalie reminds Gabriel of his promise to his wife and that he's risked so much for the chance to bring her back. She also informs him that Lila has been harboring her rage against Ladybug for months and it will be peaked now that everyone is celebrating her on Heroes Day. When Gabriel asks Nathalie if she's sure she wants to go through with it, Nathalie insists that she will always be there for him and they will succeed.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur/History
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur/History - [[Season 2]]
While waiting for the first part of their plan to unfold, Nathalie receives a message from Adrien requesting to go to a picnic and informs Gabriel, who agrees. Once Lila's rage hits a breaking point after witnessing an interview in which Gabriel calls Volpina a mediocre imitation, Nathalie watches as Gabriel transforms into Hawk Moth and akumatizes Lila into Volpina. Once Volpina succeeds in creating negative emotions throughout Paris, Hawk Moth deakumatizes her and creates another akuma for Nathalie. When asked if she's ready, Nathalie declares that she will go to any length to end the reign of Ladybug and Cat Noir. Satisfied, Hawk Moth akumatizes Nathalie into Catalyst, a villain who can boost his own power. Catalyst then infects Hawk Moth's cane, turning him into Scarlet Moth and allowing him to create as many akumas as he desires. After Scarlet Moth gains an army of akumatied villains and heads on top of the Eiffel Tower, Catalyst wishes Scarlet Moth good luck.
In "Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)", Catalyst tells Scarlet Moth that the time has come.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur/History
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur/History - [[Season 2]]
While observing the battle between his villains and the French Miraculous superhero team, Scarlet Moth tells Catalyst that everything is going to plan, to which Catalyst claims to enjoy watching the heroes think victory is possible.
Later, as part of the final phase of their plan, Volpina creates an illusion of Scarlet Moth to distract the heroes while the real Scarlet Moth prepares to sneak up behind Ladybug and Cat Noir and akumatize them.
Before attempting to do so, Catalyst tells him that he is about to triumph, though when the plan fails and Ladybug and Cat Noir revert Scarlet Moth to Hawk Moth (therefore deakumatizing all his villains), Catalyst becomes angry and rushes towards Gabriel's safe to retrieve the Peacock Miraculous.
She uses it to become Mayura and sends an amok towards Hawk Moth, which infects his cane.
She offers him her help, and although Hawk Moth begs her not to at first, he reluctantly agrees and a giant moth creature is formed.
The moth creature uses its giant wings to push the superheroes away, therefore allowing Hawk Moth to escape and detransform.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur/History
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur/History - [[Season 2]]
Later, a drained Nathalie is confronted by Gabriel, who reminds her that she was told never to use the Peacock Miraculous as it is damaged.
However, Nathalie says that she wanted to help him all the way to the end, earning her Gabriel's gratitude.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur/History
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Animaestro", Nathalie told Adrien at the movie premiere that he must greet the Tsurugis. She holds the tablet in which Gabriel is video chatting as the Agrestes and Tsurugis greet one another. She then leads Tomoe to an empty table where the two sign agreement papers.
In "Weredad", Nathalie approached Adrien as he was eating and informs him that he has 24 minutes to finish his meal before he has to review his Chinese lessons. When asked by Adrien if his father is too busy to eat with him, Nathalie tells him when his next scheduled meal with his father was. Therefore, a saddened Adrien heads up to his room while Nathalie can't help but feel sorry for him.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur/History
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Oni-Chan", Nathalie notices that Adrien has come home with Lila and begins to remind him that his father doesn't like visitors. However, Lila interrupts her and asks if it would be okay to ask Adrien's father directly, though Nathalie tells her that he is very busy and must not be disturbed. However, Nathalie agrees to let her inside when Lila dupes her into thinking that Adrien needs help with his math, giving her and Adrien half an hour. Once the half an hour is over, Nathalie informs Adrien and Lila that Lila has to go. However, when Gabriel discovers that Lila was in his home, he is furious and scolds Nathalie for letting her inside. Nathalie claims that she'd thought it would be good if Lila helped Adrien review his math, but Gabriel angrily tells her that only he decides what's good for his son and reminds her that she'd been fooled by Adrien's friends before. Surprised, Nathalie asks Gabriel if he wishes to take Adrien out of school, though Gabriel says no and claims to just want to make sure Adrien isn't influenced by his friends.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur/History
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Miraculer", Mayura waits besides Chloé's house as the rest of the French Miraculous superhero team battles Destroyer in case Ladybug hands her the Bee Miraculous. When this doesn't happen, Nathalie asks Gabriel in his atelier if he's sure about making Chloé an ally as Ladybug has become reluctant in giving her the Bee Miraculous, noting how very careful she's being. Gabriel decides that in that case, he will make Chloé force Ladybug into giving her the Miraculous by making her lose all faith in the hero so that she can be akumatized, and Nathalie suggests that they use Lila to help him with the task and Gabriel agrees.
After manipulating Lila into trying to sabotage Chloé, Mayura sent an amok to a crying baby August, creating a giant lollipop sentimonster.
While the plan to akumatize Chloé ultimately fails, Hawk Moth is able to akumatize Chloé's best friend Sabrina into Miraculer, a power-stealing supervillain.
Due to the villain stealing both Ladybug's and Cat Noir's powers, Ladybug decides that she needs everyone -- including Chloé.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur/History
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur/History - [[Season 3]]
However, before Cat Noir can hand Chloé the Bee Miraculous, Mayura snatches it and tells Chloé that if she joins them, all her dreams will come true.
During the battle between Miraculer and the French Miraculous superhero team, Hawk Moth tells Mayura to come back to him as she has the Bee Miraculous.
However, when Mayura begins to take off, Cat Noir knocks the Bee Miraculous out of her hands and Ladybug snatches it.
As she ran away, Ladybug gave the Bee Miraculous to Chloé and tells her to follow Mayura, to which Chloé agrees and transforms into Queen Bee.
She engages Mayura in combat, though she manages to pin her down trying to convince her to join her team by promising that she can be Queen Bee whenever she likes.
However, Queen Bee refuses and escapes Mayura's grasp.
She nearly succeeds in taking the Peacock Miraculous off her, but escaped and apologized to Hawk Moth for failing, but he told her that it's okay confident that Queen Bee will change her mind.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur/History
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Party Crasher", Nathalie drove a hologram of Gabriel to the airport for Tokyo’s fashion week. While she was contacted by the real Gabriel asking if everything was going to plan, to which she says that he will be spending the entire week in Tokyo and no one will suspect that he’s actually at home.
In "The Puppeteer 2", Nathalie enters Adrien’s room while he’s practicing piano and informs him that it was time to go to Musée Grévin. When Adrien asks if he could invite a friend, she allows him to do so. However, when he winds up inviting four friends, Nathalie allows it.
In "Timetagger", after Gabriel expressed sadness over the fact of him not being Hawk Moth in the future meaning he most likely failed, Nathalie points out that it could also mean he succeeded as the future isn't set in stone.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur/History
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Stormy Weather 2", while helping Gabriel write a letter to Tomoe Tsurugi, Nathalie reveals that she regrets taking her job, as it has become too much for her. She also admits to feeling affection for Adrien while watching him grow over the years, sadness for Emilie as she falls deeper into an endless sleep, and admiration for Gabriel, which has morphed into romantic feelings. She claims that she would do anything for him, no matter the cost. She suddenly begins coughing violently and falls to the floor, though when Gabriel asks her if she's alright, Nathalie gets back up and says she's fine.
In "Reflekdoll", Nathalie appears in Hawk Moth’s lair. She puts on the Peacock Miraculous and transforms into Mayura to help Hawk Moth into giving the negative emotion he is sensing “a new dimension”. She creates an amok and sends it to Juleka, along with an Akuma. Both Hawk Moth and Mayura create a magical transmission to talk to Juleka and give her her powers as Reflekta and a Sentimonster named Reflektdoll.
In "Ladybug",

title: Nathalie Sancoeur/History
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Gabriel Agreste", Nathalie is seen sitting in her bed reading a book when Adrien enters, bringing her a rolling tray with a meal on it. She thanks him. He says that his father doesn't want him to invite his friends to his business party. Nathalie reminds him that Chloé and Kagami will be there, but Adrien is still said because they're only coming because their parents are members in the club. Nathalie says the club members are the most influential people in Paris and that they're very important to Gabriel. Gabriel enters and tells Adrien to leave him and Nathalie alone for a moment. When he leaves, he tells Nathalie that he realizes that he's having problems without her and that it would take many people to fill her shoes. Nathalie asks his he is thinking of canceling the party, but Gabriel says no because the members of the club wouldn't understand. He also mentions to her that Félix will be there with Amélie.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur/History
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur/History - [[Season 4]]
Nathalie says she has made a list of everything that must be done at the party and hands him a tablet. She tells him everything important is in red. He must verify the staff's identities, ensure the robots are set up to the proper program, and to activate the cellphone scramblers for privacy. Then she offers him lunch and he thanks her.
Later at the night of the party, Gabriel enters Nathalie's room after Félix gives him the ring. His starts angrily yelling about how he knows the ring is a fake to her. Nathalie suggests that he akumatizes him and make him reveal where the ring is, but Gabriel says if he does that, he'll know Gabriel is Shadow Moth. Nathalie says that he's forgetting how immense his powers are and that he can be the Gabriel who creates negative emotions in him and the Shadow Moth who akumatizes him at the same time. Gabriel says it's a brilliant idea. She watches him turns into Shadow Moth and create a sentimonster version of Gabriel Agreste.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur/History
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur/History - [[Season 4]]
After he tries to akumatize Félix with the sentimonster, it doesn't work. Nathalie suggests that he use his anger to akumatize the sentimonster Gabriel. At the end of the episode, Shadow Moth is still with Nathalie and Senti-Gabriel who gives him the lucky charm that Ladybug gave him. He releases Senti-Gabriel from existence and un-transforms. He gives Nathalie the lucky charm and says he wants to know how Ladybug was able to create the charm. Nathalie says she hasn't read anything about it in the spellbook. Gabriel says it's probably because the spellbook is only a chronicle of what has been discovered about the Miraculous until now, and Nathalie realizes why there are blank pages at the end. Gabriel says that this means that the power of the Miraculous is stronger than he thought, and Nathalie reminds him that his is also as powerful as well.

Nathalie believes that since Ladybug managed to create magical charms, Gabriel too could evolve his powers, as the information recorded in the grimoire states that the limits of the Miraculous are set by their own holders. Putting more effort this time, Shadow Moth is still unsuccessful and starts to lose faith. But Nathalie encourages him to not give up and reminds him why he is doing this. Shadow Moth tries again to create a more powerful Akuma by channeling his desire to bring back his wife. Nathalie looks surprised by the energy emitting from his body. title: Nathalie Sancoeur/History
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Evolution", while still on the train, Nathalie received a phone call from Gabriel who informed her to have almost all Miraculouses on his hands due to Félix's betrayal to Ladybug and she became worried when Gabriel told her of his intentions of using the Rabbit  Miraculous to travel back in time to steal Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses, to which Nathalie tried to convince him to wait for her to arrive, but he ignored her and transformed into Monarch, and after several unsuccessful attempts to steal Ladybug and Rabbit Noir's Miraculouses and also becoming weak due to his overuse of the kwamis, Gabriel traveled back to the moment he told Nathalie of his victory and approached her in the train, much to her surprise, and Nathalie soon got a sandwich to feed and recharge the kwamis and told Gabriel there was another way to use the Miraculous of the Rabbit to save Emilie, by travelling to the day he gave Emilie the damaged Peacock Miraculous and giving himself an USB she had with information to fix it so Emilie and herself wouldn't get sick, and Gabriel thanked her and transformed to do so, but before he could do it, he decided to purse Ladybug and Rabbit Noir instead, whom with the help of Canigirl, managed to retrieve the Rabbit Miraculous from Monarch.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur/History
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur/History - [[Season 5]]
After a while Nathalie called Gabriel to ask if the plan worked, but Gabriel sadly told her no, and that Ladybug took the Rabbit Miraculous from him and asked her for a new plan, but Nathalie became angry and reminded him he had the Time Miraculous and he could have chosen to save Emilie and her, but instead he chose his obsession with Ladybug and Cat Noir, called him insane and told him he didn't deserve her or anyone else's help before hanging up on him, and soon had a coughing fit, which was noticed by Lila who asked Nathalie if she was ok, and Nathalie told her yes and asked her to help her to get back to her seat.
In "Multiplication", Nathalie returned to the Agreste mansion and angrily glared at Gabriel who saw her returning home from his window but didn't say anything, Nathalie then went to Adrien's room and smiled when seeing him asleep.
In "Miraculous Paris", just after Gabriel barely escaped Ladybug and Cat Noir's trap with a Cataclysmed arm, he tries to call Nathalie but he got only her voicemail, as she refused to answer his calls after their fallout, much to his frustration.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur/History
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Destruction", after Gabriel failed to find Ladybug's true identity and returned to the Agreste mansion, Nathalie was present when he made a bussiness deal with Tomoe Tsurugi to reforge all the Miraculouses in his possession into Alliance rings to avoid losing another Miraculous. And when Adrien wanted to talk to his father, Nathalie stopped him, saying it wasn't the right moment.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur/History
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Passion", Nathalie woke up and went to Adrien's room, and became worried when she found him missing, only to see him in the kitchen with Gabriel, who prepared him pancakes and Nathalie criticized him for not making the right type of pancakes that Adrien liked, to which Gabriel calmly told her she could tell him how she would like hers as they were family and asked her to call him for his name, to which Nathalie reluctantly did and then Gabriel put a hand on her shoulder, and after Adrien left for school, Nathalie quickly trapped Gabriel into an armlock, angry telling him to never do that again and made it clear she only stayed to protect Adrien from him and urged Gabriel to stop his pursuing of the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses and to accept Emilie's fate as she did in her video recordings, but her anger soon changed into horror when Gabriel revealed to her his Cataclysmed arm, revealing he doesn't have much time either and if she didn't help him, Adrien would be all alone.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur/History
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur/History - [[Season 5]]
Returning to her room, Nathalie saw Emilie's video recordings asking her to convince Gabriel to stop his pursuing of the Miraculouses and trusting her to take care of her son, making Nathalie cry for having failed her and promised Emilie to stop Gabriel from getting the Miraculouses and reshaping the universe in his mad image. But soon was cut short by Adrien, who told her he was in love with a girl, and asked her about her first romance, to which Nathalie explained she spent her youth fighting snakes and looking for artifacts and falling in love for her was complicated, but then started to cough, much to Adrien's concern and asked her if what happened to his mother was going to happen to her too, but Nathalie lied saying no and told him it was late to school.
Later Nathalie went to the reposiitory, telling Gabriel he wasn't alone and that she arrived to his mansion with the promise of getting the magical artifacts he wanted and wanted to fulfill her promise, but Gabriel with concern refused at first saying she risked herself too much, to which Nathalie insisted to risk it all and asked him to akumatize her.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur/History
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur/History - [[Season 5]]
Monarch akumatized her as Safari, with the power of tracking her prey, using an illusion of Timetagger, she lured the heroes out to track them and paralyze them with Venom, forcing the heroes to switch their Miraculouses and become Lady Noir and Mister Bug, with the latter questioned Safari's motives of getting their Miraculouses, to which she answered she wanted to get a wish, which made Monarch suspicious of what she tried to do, and Safari replied if he wanted her to reveal the truth about him to the heroes.
When Mister Bug deduced where her akumatized object was, he alongside Lady Noire, went to Nathalie's room and destroyed her mannequin, deakumatizing her, and she heard Mister Bug calling Monarch a monster for akumatizing Nathalie in her fragile state, when Gabriel arrived in concern.
Later, Adrien visited Nathalie and apologized to her for asking about her illness (as he believed it to be the cause of her akumatization), but Nathalie reminded him that he didn't meant any harm, and Adrien hugged her saying he would be always there for her and Nathalie smiled and told him she would also be there for him while she can and asked him to tell her more about the girl he likes.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur/History
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Reunion",

In "Intuition",
