Gabriel confronts Nathalie for giving Adrien a counter-order and she replies he doesn't have control over Adrien's love life. This soon becomes a quiet battle for control over Adrien.
In "Adoration",

title: Nathalie Sancoeur/History
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Emotion", During the start of the Diamonds' Dance, Nathalie and Gabriel quietly argue about Adrien's love life, stating he has the right to be with Marinette when Amélie Graham de Vanily, barges in and Nathalie is ordered to escort her out. She deeply regrets having to do so, saying she doesn't have a choice and thinks about Amélie's words about how there's always a choice. At the end of the episode, when Gabriel forbids Adrien from mentioning Marinette in his presence, he complains to her that she's causing him as much trouble as Ladybug.
In "Pretension", Nathalie is first seen Gabriel attempting to fix his wound via the kwamis but fails and overhears his conversation with Tomoe. She's seen having dinner towards the end of the episode when Gabriel announces in a smug manner his intention to send Adrien to London to keep him away from Marinette, angering him and Nathalie.
In "Revelation", Nathalie falls victim to Hoaxer via her Alliance ring and is used by the akumatized villainess to get Gabriel's secrets.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur/History
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Collusion", Nathalie is seen watching one of Emilie's recordings, unaware Gabriel is watching her from behind and later when she helps Adrien stand up to his father, stating Gabriel placing his happiness onto Adrien's.
In "Revolution", When Adrien is now forced to leave Paris for London, she tells him that even though he can't disobey his father, he still has the freedom to love Marinette.
In "Representation", A bed-ridden Nathalie is watching another one of Emilie's recordings when Gabriel barges in and demands to know where Adrien is after he escaped from London. Despite not knowing but replies she hopes Adrien will get far away from him, he takes back Emilie's ring, declaring full control over Adrien and she says he will soon be free from him.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur/History
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)", Inspired from watching Emilie's recording and having a nightmare about Gabriel claiming the Miraculouses, Nathalie tries to make a recording for Adrien but stops. Instead, she tries to stop him herself with a crossbow. She confronts him about using the wish to bring Emilie back but is too weak and is taken back to her room by him. There, Gabriel takes away her tablets and reprimands her for "betraying" him for allowing Adrien and Marinette's romantic relationship and leaves her with her Alliance ring, hoping she will be loyal with him to the end and make her a part of his Miraculized army. Marinette as Ladybug turns it off and confronts her about Adrien. She tells her that he's safe but she and Cat Noir aren't, warning her about Monarch's global plan. She admits to using the Peacock Miraculous while it was in its damaged state and gives her Emilie's phone with all her recordings and tells her to transform back, so the villain nor his army would find her before succumbing to her illness, much to the superheroine's sadness.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur/History
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)", after Bug Noire managing to defeat Monarch, Nathalie is mentioned to being a victim to his madness before Gabriel uses the wish to bring her back to life in exchange for his. She's seen next to Amélie at Adrien's pool party and are served drinks by the bodyguard.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur/History
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur/History - Miraculous London
Shortly after Gabriel's wish, a now healed Nathalie went down to Gabriel's repository armed with a crossbow and overheard Tikki and Plagg telling Marinette that Gabriel used the wish to save Nathalie's life in exchange of his own, much to Nathalie's shock, who when noticed by Marinette, the latter transformed back into Bug Noire but Nathalie tells her she didn't come to fight as she expected to find Gabriel not her and throwed her crossbow aside, stating she wasn't like Gabriel, and Bug Noire revealed she tried to reason with Gabriel and broke down crying that Adrien no longer has a father because of her and stated she should have made the wish herself. But Nathalie comforted the superheroine saying she saved everyone by helping Gabriel to find the good inside him and that Adrien wasn't alone as he still had Marinette and Bug Noire told that he still had Nathalie too.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur/History
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur/History - Miraculous London
Nathalie then took Bug Noire to Gabriel's lair, where the former released the Kwamis from their cages and revealed that Tomoe Tsurugi was Gabriel's accomplice and that she sent Adrien and Kagami to London to protect them from Monarch's plan and that Adrien was unaware of Gabriel being Monarch and thar Emilie still was into a coma, then Nathalie considered turning herself to the police, but Bug Noire stopped her saying that Adrien needed a mother, as both his parents are gone and that they'll tell him that Gabriel died saving them from Monarch, and Bug Noire proceeded to destroy all evidence of Gabriel being Monarch in the Agreste mansion, like Emilie's capsule and the Kwamis' cage. Unknown to both, they were secretly spied by a self-akumatized Lila.
Hours later, Adrien and Kagami arrived back to Paris to the train station, where they were greeted by Nathalie and Tomoe, with the former embracing Adrien after he cried in heartbreak after learning of his father's death and then Nathalie smiled when seeing him reunited with Marinette.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur/History
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur/History - [[Season 6]]
In Climatiqueen", Nathalie eats the pancake Adrien made for breakfast, calling them delicious and even better than Gabriel's. She reminds him that he's free to do whatever he wanted now that he doesn't have a schedule.
In Werepapas", Nathalie finds Adrien outside his parents' room and he hugs her, but she struggles to return it. Soon, she gets a call from Adrien's grandparents, Emil and Milly Graham de Vanily and Johnny Grassette and Gabrielle Grassette, who want to meet him. Nathalie allows Marinette to join in on the lunch as a maid but announces she will not be joining. She stands outside the dining room with Placide I.T., overhearing what was going on. When Emil announces his plans to take custody of Adrien, Marinette and Adrien want her to stand up for herself but she hesitates. Soon, Milly is akumatized.
In El Toro De Piedra", Nathalie is on her laptop, speaking to someone who requests her presence at an upcoming meeting.
Nathalie assures the person she'll be there, but the person warns her that there won't be another chance for her if she doesn't show up, before quickly ending the call and closing her laptop as Marinette comes in, urgently needing to speak with her.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur/History
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur/History - [[Season 6]]
Nathalie initially refuses, but when Marinette reveals she found a letter addressed to Adrien, Nathalie reacts with shock, before telling Marinette not to discuss it here, escorting her to Gabriel's atelier to look at it there.
Reading it together, they find it to be Gabriel's last will and testament to Adrien, admitting his identity as Monarch, asking Adrien to take up his mantle to acquire the Miraculous of the Ladybug and Black Cat, and use the Ultimate Miraculous Absolute Power to bring Gabriel and Emilie back.
Gabriel goes further, explaining that Nathalie will help Adrien, and neither Gabriel, nor Emilie, regret using the Miraculous in the first place when they used the Peacock Miraculous to give birth to Adrien.
However, that last part is cut off when Nathalie and Marinette hear Ivan knock over his drums in a moment of frustration.
Afterwards, Nathalie decides to tear up and destroy the letter, but Marinette takes it from her, deciding to show it to Adrien when she feels the time is right.
When Adrien enters, looking for Marinette, Nathalie takes her leave from them, presumably to prepare for her meeting she was notified about earlier.

title: Nathalie Sancoeur/History
text:
Nathalie Sancoeur/History - [[Season 6]]
At the meeting, The Kingdom discusses what they know about Gabriel's death.
They already know the truth that Ladybug lied to the world about Gabriel sacrificing himself to end Monarch's threat as they all know he was Monarch from the very beginning.
When they press Nathalie for answers, she tells them she was unconscious at the time and knows nothing of his final moments.
She only came to when the wish healed her, but suggests that The Machine might know more.
When The Machine also has little to nothing to offer regarding Gabriel's death, she then asks the group to focus back on the Perfect World Project and acquiring the Ladybug and Black Cat Miraculous, offering to have Nathalie be reassigned as her "Shadow" from this point on.
After a vote of confidence, where all the other members vote in agreement, Nathalie is reassigned to The Machine, and the council is adjourned.
After everyone else leaves, the last member, known as The Stomach, speaks to Nathalie in private, asking her if she remembers who to give the Ladybug and Black Cat Miraculous to once they are acquired.
Nathalie replies in acceptance, revealing The Wheat to be Camilo Pista, her father.

text:

Gabriel (narrating): My dear Émilie, I'm wracked with guilt. Nathalie has used the Miraculous of the Peacock, just like you did before her. She did so knowing the risks.
Gabriel: I told you never to use the Peacock Miraculous.
Nathalie: I had no choice, sir! I had to save you. (She coughs.)
Gabriel: It's damaged. It's way too dangerous.
Nathalie: I want to help you... all the way to the end.

Gabriel (narrating): I shouldn't have kept this cursed jewel.
Gabriel (narrating): She did it to save me... to save us.
(Mayura blows the amok away.)

title: Nathalie as seen by Gabriel/Transcript

(Hawk Moth transforms into Scarlet Moth.)

(Mayura lands next to Miraculer.)

title: Nathalie's tablet
text:
Nathalie's tablet - Intro
is a tablet owned by Nathalie Sancoeur.
In "Catalyst", to complete Hawk Moth's plan, the latter sent an akuma into Nathalie's tablet, causing it to become the akumatized object of Catalyst.
In "Ladybug", in order to turn Hawk Moth into Scarlet Moth again so that he could akumatize Marinette, her family, friends and teachers all at once, Hawk Moth sent an akuma into Nathalie's tablet, causing it to become the akumatized object of Catalyst again.
As seen in "Optigami", Mayura had inserted an amok after the events of "Miracle Queen" to create the titular sentimonster and spy on Ladybug and her allies.
In "Risk", the tablet is briefly stolen by Félix and in "Strikeback", it is shown to have a copy of the grimoire, which Félix uses to try to activate the Peacock Miraculous he stole from his uncle's safe before discovering the jewel was a fake.
In "Conformation", Gabriel took it from Nathalie, along with Fu's tablet.

title: Nathalie's tablet
text:

title: Nathalie's tablet

Before the events of season 5 finale, Nathalie often carried her tablet as a substitute for Gabriel Agreste, who replaced real-life appearances with video calls.
Adrien and Gabriel appeared to have tablets in some episodes; it is unknown if it was the same tablet. However, in "Queen Banana", they both appeared to have the same type of tablet.
Nathalie's tablet was the second item, after August's pacifier, to be akumatized and amokized separately.
As shown in "Conformation", the tablet holds information about the deciphered grimoire and also about the secret identities of several of Ladybug's superhero allies which both Nathalie and Gabriel discovered in "Miracle Queen", like Alya Césaire, Nino Lahiffe, Lê Chiến Kim, Max Kanté, Kagami Tsurugi, Luka Couffaine and Chloé Bourgeois.

title: Nathalie's room
text:
Nathalie's room - Appearance
Nathalie's room is decorated in warm colours. It can be accessed from the main lobby by entering through a black door with white, geometric patterns. The floor is made of wooden panels. The walls are cream in color, and the protruding elements are decorated with wood. The bottom of the walls is decorated with plates made of green stone. The ceiling is white with concave decorations in The Shape of squares.

title: Nathalie's room
text:
Nathalie's room - Appearance
To the left of the entrance is a double bed where a woman sleeps. The furniture has a brown backrest made of wood, which is lined with orange material with yellow dots on the side of the mattress. The bed is black with white stripes and one black stripe in between. There are bedside tables on both sides of the bed. On one of them you can find a night light and a white vase, while on the other-an old, albeit small monitor with a white case. A TV was hung above the bed. To the left of the bed and on the wall next to it are wooden bookcases filled with books. Between them were mounted a black door with white, geometric ornaments that lead to an unknown room; just next to the door were placed two sculptures made of black stone with gold ornaments that resemble cats. Near the bookcase, near the bed, you can see a wooden chest of drawers, a wooden chair with white material and probably boxes. It is possible that a place for a small desk was organized near the library. There is also a green carpet on the floor.

title: Nathalie's room
text:
Nathalie's room - Appearance
At the entrance and in front of the bed, two more carpets are laid on the floor: the first is colored with a floral motif, the second is gray with blue, yellow and black geometric patterns. In the further part of the room you can see another colorful carpet with stripes and geometric patterns, which is located by the white fireplace. There are also two chairs made of wood with white trim; between them is a small coffee table made of wood, on which a chessboard with pawns is left.
To the left of the fireplace is a cabinet made of dark wood, which contains vases, weapons and artifacts such as the Anch, the Egyptian symbol of life. A silver shield was placed on top of the cabinet, which rests against the wall. In the further part there is another library, and next to it in a specially prepared display case you can see an outfit consisting of a white T-shirt, a beige shirt, brown trousers and belts. Vases were placed on the fireplace, and on the wall, just above it, hung many paintings depicting many motifs and landscapes, placed in brown and gold frames.

title: Nathalie's room
text:
Nathalie's room - Appearance
Among other things, Natalie has a mannequin with her hiking clothes, which is in a glass cabinet. Above the fireplace there is a portrait painting with the Agreste family, which hides a secret safe with various items.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - Intro
Nadja Chamack (called Nadia Chamack in some episodes) is a TVi news reporter and Manon Chamack's mother.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Ladybug & Cat Noir", Nadja reports on how Paris was being unbelievably attacked by a supervillain named Stoneheart. She then went on to talk about how the police were struggling to keep the situation under control.
Later on, after Stoneheart was defeated by the two heroes, Nadja presented the footage filmed by Alya Césaire, which revealed to the names of the two heroes: Ladybug and Cat Noir. Soon, Nadja comes back to report on the new wave of panic being caused across the capital as dozens of people were being transformed into Stoneheart duplicates, inactive and immobile. Commenting on the situation, Nadja stated it was unbelievable.
In "Stoneheart", Nadja reported on how all the Stoneheart duplicates were scattered all over Paris, showing no signs of movement. She then went on to talk about how the police had cordoned off those areas and how they are now relying on their two new heroes to save them all.
In "Stormy Weather", Nadja leaves her daughter Manon Chamack in the care of Marinette Dupain-Cheng, the daughter of her friend Sabine Cheng.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Lady Wifi", Nadja was first seen reporting on how Ladybug and Cat Noir had once again saved Paris from another unidentified villain. She was later seen outside of Le Grand Paris with a cameraman as Chloé Bourgeois reunited with her father Mayor André Bourgeois after being held hostage by the titular villain.
In "Princess Fragrance", Nadja reported on how Ladybug and Cat Noir have saved Paris once again when Jean Duparc was akumatized by Hawk Moth into Magician of Misfortune and threaten to make the Eiffel Tower vanish in a puff of smoke. She later came on to report on how Prince Ali, heir to the throne of the kingdom of Achu, was visiting Paris to host a toy fundraiser for the sick children at a hospital.
Sometime later, Nadja goes to Le Grand Paris, where she watched as Prince Ali and Soraya Khan were greeted by André and Chloé. Within moments, Nadja started interviewing his Royal Highness. She asked him if  he had anything to say about his visit to Paris, with Prince Ali saying he was very happy to be here. They interview is then interrupted by a disgusting smell appearing out of nowhere. Nadja and everyone, turn their backs to Chloé, who was the one carrying the smell.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 1]]
They all then hear a blast. They turn and see the mind-controlled paparazzi bowing down for the titular villain. Nadja then watched as she introduced herself and said to Prince Ali that he will belong to her once she sprays him from her perfume gun. Out of nowhere, a mysterious person activated a button from a synthesizer to launch the confetti to prevent the villain from shooting his Royal Highness. It is unknown what happened to Nadja after this.
In "Mr. Pigeon", Nadja is seen at the Trocadéro, reporting on how pigeons have taken over Paris and are giving the authorities major concern. She then turns things over to the titular villain at the Eiffel Tower as he has announcement.
In "Pixelator", Nadja is seen hiding behind a car with a cameraman at the Champs-Élysées when she calls out for the titular villain. She nervously asks him for an interview with a reporter who spreads the villains' voice, to which he agrees to. After the villain threatens Jagged Stone, he pixelates Nadja. She was then transferred to a white world inside of a photograph, the photographs themselves appearing on the villain's wall in his room.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Copycat", Nadja reports on a theft committed by the titular villain, whom she believes to be Cat Noir, at the Louvre.
In "Animan", Nadja reports on how animals are invading Paris, with the police trying to contain the situation. She then advises everyone to stay home and remain calm before saying that André will address the city at some point.
In "Darkblade", Nadja is first seen reporting on how Ladybug and Cat Noir had saved Paris again. She then talks about how André was re-elected as mayor of Paris for the fourth consecutive term. Nadja then mentions that Armand D'Argencourt, one of André's opponents and fencing instructor at Collège Françoise Dupont, was pummeled in the polls. She then states that Armand had acquired the least number of votes in Paris history.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 1]]
Later, Nadja goes to Collège Françoise Dupont with a cameraman to get footage of Armand. She watches from outside as he defeats Adrien Agreste while fencing with a special attack developed by my ancestor Darkblade. Armand then began telling Adrien about how his ancestor Darkblade conquered Paris and ruled over it with an iron fist, until he was overthrown. Nadja then entered the school with the cameraman and asked him if that was he ran in the election, thinking it was to seek revenge on your ancestors behalf.
After he ignored her question, she asked him if he had anything to say about his quote un-quote landslide defeat to André. Nadja and the cameraman were then noticed by Fred Haprèle, who kicked them out. Later, as Armand is exiting the building, Nadja finds him again. She tells him the it had been said that he was "stuck in the dark ages like a stubborn old rusted battle-axe" and asked what he had to about that. Armand then told her to go away, calling her a poisonous wretch.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 1]]
Armand soon bumps into a poster of André and angrily slashes it to pieces, surprising Nadja and the cameraman behind him. They both then witnessed Armand be akumatized by Hawk Moth into the titular villain. After this, Nadja nervously ask him if had anything to say about his transformation before cut off by the villain. He then uses his sword to turn both Nadja and the cameraman into his mind-controlled knights.
In "Timebreaker", Nadja orders an Eiffel Tower cake at Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie. When she comes by to pick it up, no one is there and Nadja calls Tom Dupain to see where they are as she desperately needed the cake right away. Tom tells her that he and his wife Sabina were not there right now and that Marinette is going to give her the cake. He then hanged up on Nadja to try an contact Marinette.
Later, after the titular villain turns back time, Nadja once again finds nobody at the bakery and calls Tom. This time, Marinette managed to make it in time and Nadja hanged up on Tom, telling him it was fine. Marinette then wrap the cake in a pig box and gave it to Nadja, apologizing for making her wait.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 1]]
In "The Puppeteer", Nadja leaves Manon in the care of Marinette once again. When she comes back to pick her up, Manon goes up to her complaining about how Marinette didn't let me win a game they were playing with the dolls of Ladybug, Cat Noir, and various former akumatized villains. Nadja explains to Manon that she can't always win and instructs her to return the Ladybug doll she was holding to Marinette.
Manon refuses as Marinette told her she could borrow it, with Nadja thanking the latter for her generosity but refusing her offer as her daughter already had a lot of toys at their home. She then attempts to take the Ladybug doll away, but Manon pulls the doll and accidentally rips it's arm. Nadja apologizes to Marinette and gives her back the doll for her to fix. She then tells her daughter to say goodbye, but instead Manon yells at her, saying she wanted the doll.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 1]]
Nadja tells her she can play with it the next time she comes and picks her up. She then asked Manon to say goodbye once again, which she eventually did, and they went downstairs, where Nadja gets a call from Alec Cataldi. Manon to starts to go back upstairs, with Nadja turning her back to see her. She then explains she had left her backpack up there, with Nadja telling her to go get it quickly.
When Manon comes back down, Nadja and her go to the TVi Tower as she need to get a file for Alec. There she apologizes to Alec as she taught she had given him the file, with him telling her it wasn't an issue. Nadja then asks the receptionist if she could keep an eye on her daughter for her while she goes to look for the file.
Soon, she notices Manon playing with a Lady Wifi doll belonging to Marinette. Nadja believes her daughter took the doll without Marinette's permission and scolds her. She then punishes her for disobedience by taking the doll and directing her daughter to stay in place until she comes back. Nadja leaves in the elevator with Alec. They go to a studio, where Nadja eventually finds the file and gives it to Alec.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 1]]
Later, while going back to get Manon, Nadja gets a call from Ladybug. The heroine asks her about her daughter and tells her to not leave the TVi Tower as she was on her way. After she arrives and checks the cameras for the villain, who is actually an akumatized Manon, Ladybug tells everyone to evacuate outside, with Nadja refusing as she wanted to find her daughter. However, Ladybug convinces her that Manon would be fine and Nadja does as she is told.
After Manon turns back to normal and Ladybug does her Miraculous Ladybug, Nadja comes back and reunites with her daughter, thanking the heroine. Sometime later, Marinette apologized for giving Manon the Lady Wifi doll to her as she fell victim to her baby doll eyes, with Nadja saying that her daughter can be persuasive sometimes. Nadja then gets a kiss on the cheek by Manon before leaves her in the care of Marinette once again.
In "The Mime", after Ladybug rescues a child that was in the care of August's mother near the Louvre, Nadja tries to get a quick interview with the heroine. However, she is ignored by Ladybug who then went over to Alya before leaving.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Guitar Villain", Nadja does an interview with XY, where she asked him why he was number one on the charts. After he finished answering the question, Nadja asked XY what he taught about Jagged Stone, with him replying by making fun of his career and his age. She then reported on how XY was going to be giving a very special one-time concert from the top of the Eiffel Tower, to celebrate his album's success, and thank his awesome fans.
Later, when Alec was interviewing XY, Nadja got a call from Ladybug who said that they were all in danger. Sometime after, she reported on Jagged Stone's new album hit the charts at number one, knocking XY off the position. Nadja then welcomed him back.
In "Antibug", Nadja is first seen in a flashback, where she goes to Le Grand Paris for an interview with Jagged Stone about his upcoming album. There she and everyone else notice Armand the butler as Big Mustachio. They then watched him as he hid behind the service elevator when Ladybug and Cat Noir, who are actually Chloé and Sabrina Raincomprix, came running out from the stairwells. Ladybug sees Jagged and approached him, sitting between him and Nadja.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 1]]
She tells them that she is here to meet with Jagged. Noticing her hair was different, he asked what she did with it, her reply is that she needed a new hair style. Ladybug then takes over Jagged's interview, forcing Nadja to direct questions to her. Cat Noir, however, finds Big Mustachio and accidentally reveals that Chloé is pretending to be Ladybug.
Nadja and Jagged then become very angry at being deceived, with Chloé protesting that she was Ladybug. Her proof was her taking her yo-yo and bouncing it up and down, hitting Fang's head each time. Annoyed, the crocodile bit the yo-yo's string and ate it, the remaining string hitting Chloé in the face. Nadja and Jagged Stone laugh as Chloé ran off crying.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 1]]
In present day, which takes place a day after the flashback, Nadja returned to Le Grand Paris for André's press conference about the attack on his daughter. She later reported on how Ladybug and Cat Noir defeated Vanisher. After, the heroes come out of the hotel with the former supervillain, Nadja manages to get an interview with them. After this, Ladybug attempts to leave, with Nadja thanking her for her time. She then witnesses Chloé, now the titular villain, arrive. Nadja squats down behind a car and starts reporting on the fight between Cat Noir and the villain, without Ladybug who had left.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 2]]
In "The Collector", while she was introducing herself to the camera, Nadja was trapped inside the sketchbook of the titular villain.
In "Prime Queen", Nadja receives her own talk show on TV 5 called Face to Face and manages to get an exclusive interview with Ladybug and Cat Noir for their first edition, in which "sizzling hot information" about the two heroes will be revealed. The day of it's premiere, Nadja goes to leave Manon in the care of Marinette who tells her she just watched the advertisement for her show. She quickly thanks her for watching her daughter as she is running late.
Nadja then gives Marinette a bag with a bunch of Manon's things as she will be staying the night. She expresses her gratitude towards the young teenager for being free tonight. Nadja states that she has got a lot writing this interview and needs all of Paris in front of the screen tonight. She then allowed Manon, just for to tonight, to watch some television with Marinette. Nadja soon leaves and tells Marinette to tell her friends to watch the show.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 2]]
At a studio in the TVi Tower, Nadja and the staff are getting ready, with her eating a chouquette in excitement. Her boss Arlette talks to Nadja through her earpiece headset, putting pressure on her by telling her that she'd better keep her promise of attracting the largest amount of viewers in the entire year if she wants to keep her show on prime-time in the future.
At that moment, Cat Noir arrives, and jokingly tells Nadja that he secretly loves chouquettes. Upon hearing this "secret", Arlette continues to pressure Nadja with threats of canceling her show if her "sizzling hot info" is inadequate. As Face to Face is about to start and Arlette begins to lose confidence in Nadja, Ladybug burst into the studio and sits down next to Cat Noir.
Arlette tells Nadja that it is now her job to boost the ratings, symbolized by a meter on her watch that turns more green based on the number of viewers watching. The show begins, and Nadja starts to interview Ladybug and Cat Noir. She brings up a viewer call screen, with Chloé on the receiving end. Chloé ends up having no real questions to ask, causing the ratings to drop and forcing Nadja to cut her transmission short.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 2]]
Alya then calls and asks Ladybug for an interview on the Ladyblog. Manon then pops up on screen, surprising Nadja who asks where Marinette is. Her daughter then tells her she had to go tell her parents something. Annoyed, Arlette pressures Nadja into skipping to her big scoop. Nadja then questions Ladybug and Cat Noir's relationship, stating that many believe them to be dating as well as fighting supervillains together.
While Ladybug and Cat Noir deny this (although Cat Noir suggests that they aren't a couple, yet), Nadja brings up an image of the two kissing on Valentines Day. Cat Noir has no memory of this happening, and Ladybug states that she kissed him in order to save his life, not out of romantic feelings. Delighted with the rising viewers, Nadja continues to show "romantic" images of Ladybug and Cat Noir together. Frustrated with Nadja and embarrassed, Ladybug angrily leaves the studio and drags Cat Noir along.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 2]]
With Ladybug and Cat Noir gone, Arlette cancels Face to Face, leaving Nadja miserable and sobbing on the floor. Hawk Moth senses Nadja's distress and sends an akuma into her watch. Hawk Moth offers Nadja the power to get the scoop she wants by stealing the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses from them. Once Nadja accepts, she is transformed into Prime Queen, a television and media controlling supervillain who is able to travel through screens.
Prime Queen soon gets herself on all television sets in Paris and announces her plans to force Ladybug and Cat Noir to admit their love for one another. She proceeds to go through Chloé's television, ties her up, kidnaps her, and takes her to a train. After frightening everyone on board out, Prime Queen speeds up the train, telling Ladybug and Cat Noir that they must come through the screens to save Chloé.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 2]]
After the heroes eventually jump through the large television screen left open, Prime Queen, who was waiting in there for them, tells Ladybug and Cat Noir that their gonna be the starts of the highest-rated show in all of television history. Ladybug then attempts to break her watch with her yo-yo, but fails as she goes into a screen. Prime Queen then comes back on screen and tells the heroes that if they want her to stop the train, they must admit that they're in love, but Ladybug refuses.
Soon, Ladybug decides to play along with Prime Queen and "admits" to her that she and Cat Noir are dating, which gets her to stop the train. Then after being advised to do so by Hawk Moth, Prime Queen orders the heroes to give her their Miraculouses in order to prove that they're in love. Cat Noir comes up with an idea to prove to Prime Queen that he and Ladybug have feelings for one another by having them kiss. However, Ladybug refuses to do so, infuriating Prime Queen.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 2]]
Going offscreen, Prime Queen kidnaps Alya and takes her to the Louvre, where she ties her up and traps her in a mummy coffin. She warns Ladybug and Cat Noir that they must give her their Miraculous or else she'll mummify Alya. Ladybug and Cat Noir find a screen affected by Prime Queen and jump through it. This was a trap however, with them being teleported into Le Grand Paris' freezer.
Prime Queen once again tells the heroes that they must give her their Miraculouses, and threatens to drop Alya through a television screen underwater if they don't. Ladybug then uses Lucky Charm to come up with a plan to tape a pizza box over the television screen so that they're covered and then tricks Prime Queen into going through it by saying she and Cat Noir are about to take off their masks.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 2]]
Once Prime Queen arrives, Cat Noir destroys the television screen with his staff so that Prime Queen is stuck with them. Ladybug pins Prime Queen down and Cat Noir breaks her watch, releasing the akuma, which is then purified. Prime Queen then transforms back into Nadja, after Ladybug does her Miraculous Ladybug. Sometime later, Nadja is given a new talk show called Side by Side and gets Alya to appear as a guest. The pair look back over Cat Noir and Ladybug's greatest feats. Arlette then compliments Nadja on the really high ratings, telling her that she has earned her prime-time show. This makes Nadja smile as the show continues.
In "Troublemaker", Nadja is seen outside of Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie, reporting on how the appearance of the titular villain. Just then, Cat Noir arrives and everyone watches as he struggles in vain to lift the security shield covering the entrance. After the villain is defeated and Ladybug does her Miraculous Ladybug, Nadja is still seen outside.
In "Riposte", Nadja is seen walking with a man near the Seine.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Robostus", Nadja reports on how the titular villain has made inanimate objects come to life, taking control of Paris. She then turns things over to the new mayor, André's desk lamp, at the Hôtel de Ville for a new declaration. This was that "Humans will soon be treated the same way as objects", which was stated in morse code. Nadja then returns and says that their only hope now are Ladybug and Cat Noir. However, before she can say the second's name, Nadja runs out-of-frame when a camera starts chasing her.
In "Sapotis", Nadja is seen reporting on how the titular villains were attacking more and more people throughout Paris. Numerous clones of these villains then attacked Nadja while she was speaking, and replace her with one of their own.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 2]]
In "The Dark Owl", Nadja reports on how the exploits of Ladybug and Cat Noir have inspired some people to act as superheroes themselves, questioning if it was a good good thing. She then turns things over to Clara Contard, who interviews The Owl. When Nadja returns, she wonders who The Owl really is, calling him the clumsiest hero in all of Paris. The next day, after The Owl's secret identity is revealed, Nadja reports on how he is actually Denis Damoclès, the principal of Collège Françoise Dupont.
In "Syren", Nadja goes on a helicopter to report on how Ladybug, Cat Noir, and new heroine Rena Rouge are trying to catch escaped animals from the Ménagerie du Jardin des Plantes.
In "Zombizou", Nadja reports on how people are turning into zombies seeking to kiss and hug other people, spreading through Paris. She then turns things over to André at Hôtel de Ville who is making an announcement. Entering from off-screen, Roger Raincomprix jumps at André, kissing him on the cheek causing them to fall over. The footage cuts back to a scared and confused Nadja. Soon, the titular villain arrives at the studio and Nadja is turned into a zombie.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Captain Hardrock", from outside of the Hôtel de Ville, Nadja reports on how for this year's National Music Festival, the mayor's office has organized numerous free concerts featuring big stars in some prestigious locales. André then comes on-screen and tells the audience about the line-up of stars, also mentioning the many concerts and gigs given by the people of Paris across the city.
Nadja express her excitement by saying that this was likely the most incredible National Music Festival since the first one was held, in 1982. Later, Nadja reported on the arrival of the titular villain at the Seine. She advised everyone to take shelter as the villain was attacking all the National Music Festival concerts.
In "Style Queen", Nadja is at the Grand Palais, reporting on how the place is hosting the fashion show of Gabriel Agreste. She then talks about the list of prestigious guests attending the event, such as André and his wife Audrey Bourgeois, a highly respected world-renowned fashion designer and director of the fashion magazine, Style Queen. Later, after reporting on her arrival with André and Chloé, Nadja interviews Audrey.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 2]]
She asks her what was in good taste this year, with Audrey criticizing the way she was dressed, commenting that it was obvious that she didn't even the answer to her own. This made Nadja mad as Audrey told her the trend this year was glitter. She then asked her if it feels nice to be with her family in Paris as she spends a lot of time in New York.
Chloé intervenes and answer Audrey's question for her, saying she was very happy to see her. Nadja then watched as Chloé tried to give her mother a present, with Audrey telling her she was fired for the wrapping paper she used and André defending his daughter. Nadja intervenes and asks Audrey how long she will be staying in Paris. She then tells as short as possible before walking off.
After she thanks Audrey for her time, Nadja tells her audience that Gabriel's fashion show just might be one of the most important in his career, as evidenced by Audrey's presence. She then wonders if Gabriel who never appears in public will show up for the occasion, telling te audience to stay tuned to find out.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Queen Wasp", still at the Grand Palais from the previous episode, Nadja reports on how the fashion show was delayed after Audrey was akumatized into the previous titular villain. She then announced that everything was back on schedule thanks to Ladybug saving the day once again. Later, Nadja came back on to report on how Gabriel had made his first public appearance since the disappearance of his wife Émilie Agreste.
While doing this, she noticed Chloé opening up a box revealing the Bee Miraculous and it's kwami Pollen. Nadja then witnessed her transform herself into Queen Bee in front of everyone. After Queen Bee leaves, Nadja reports on how Paris had just received a new self-proclaimed heroine, telling her audience her not-so-secret identity. As she and her cameraman were packing up to leave, Nadja gets a call from Queen Bee who tells her that she has got to film how she's about to rescue the passengers of a train that's in peril.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 2]]
Nadja and her cameraman then go to the train station, when the train passes them quickly. They soon go to another station, where they find Cat Noir waiting. Nadja questions his presence there, with Cat Noir saying he was waiting for the next train. After the hero jumps into the moving train, Nadja and her cameraman leave once again. They then go to another station, where they arrive just in time to witness Ladybug and Cat Noir save everyone, including Queen Bee.
Nadja and everyone else then watched as Ladybug angrily confronted Queen Bee for using Venom to paralyze the train, scolding her for selfishly using her powers. While this was going, Nadja got her tablet and video called Audrey to ask her if she had anything to say on the situation with Queen Bee, with her dismissing her daughter as irresponsible. Soon, when Queen Bee runs away, Nadja and her cameraman follow Ladybug and Cat Noir out of the train station to look for her.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 2]]
They follow the heroes to Le Grand Paris, where Nadja and her cameraman witnessed Ladybug and Cat Noir fighting Queen Bee, now the titular villain. Later after she is defeated near the Seine and Ladybug does her Miraculous Ladybug, Nadja and her cameraman arrive with Audrey on video call, asking her to tell them how she feels about what had just happened. She then reaffirms an earlier comment she about Chloé not being exceptional. Nadja then watched as Ladybug and Cat Noir then reassure a saddened Chloé and convince her to give back the Bee Miraculous to them.
In "Reverser", Nadja reports on how André will later talk about his new space-dumpster program at the Hôtel de Ville, with protesters gathered under the slogan "Space is no dump". She then stated the protesters were walking towards the Hôtel de Ville, causing traffic jams in the center of the city. Later, Nadja reports on how ten thousand tons of garbage have been released from space by André, after he was reversed by the titular villain. She then turns things over to the villain who makes an ultimatum.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Catalyst", on Heroes' Day, Nadja is first seen interviewing Gabriel on Side by Side. He announces that he is funding a tribute to Ladybug due to her saving him and his son countless times. Gabriel also says that Volpina is a false hero in comparison to Ladybug.
Later, after Volpina creates an illusion of an akumatized Ladybug that uses Cat Noir's own Cataclysm against him causing him to be destroyed, Nadja on the situation and interviewing Jagged Stone and Clara Nightingale. They all ultimately come to the conclusion that there was no point in celebrating Heroes' Day anymore, with the two artists canceling a concert they had planned.
Then suddenly, a swarm of scarlet akumas fly into the scene, making Jagged and Clara run away. Leaving her all alone, Nadja falls victim to one of Scarlet Moth's scarlet akumas, which goes into her microphone when she tries to fend it off. She is transformed back into a scarlet version of Prime Queen, also transforming TVi news into Akuma TV news. She celebrates Scarlet Moth with Jagged, now Guitar Villain, and Clara, now Frightningale.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 2]]
She was later instructed by Scarlet Moth to head to the Eiffel Tower where he is. At the Eiffel Tower, Prime Queen watched as Scarlet Moth arrive and made a statement to the Ladybug and Cat Noir, with her sending one of her camera drones for him to do so.
In "Mayura", Prime Queen thanks her audience for forcefully joining her, telling them they'll have the chance to witness the victory of Scarlet Moth. She soon declared that Heroes' Day will know be known as Villains' Day. Prime Queen then reported various events that went down during the battle between the French Miraculous superhero team and the Scarlet Army.
Later, when Ladybug and Cat Noir escape the freezing sewers just in time and deakumatize Frozer, Prime Queen was seen filming with her camera drones from the Eiffel Tower. Ladybug then announces to all of Paris that the real Ladybug is back, releasing all of the purified akumas she had stored in her yo-yo. With that, Scarlet Moth angrily orders Prime Queen to stop filming.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Santa Claws", on Christmas Eve, Nadja once again leaves Manon in the care of Marinette. When she goes to Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie to pick her, Marinette hands Manon over to her with a Christmas log for the both of them, wishing them a merry Christmas.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Chameleon", Nadja goes to the the Eiffel Tower, where at the top Adrien is about to fall off. She reports on the situation and cheers when Ladybug saves him. Nadja then witnessed a fight break out between Ladybug and Adrien, who is revealed to be the titular villain. The heroine believes the akuma to be in the cap the villain is wearing and rips it, but nothing comes out. When the villain escapes because of that, Nadja watches as Ladybug furiously leaves to look for them.
In "Animaestro", Nadja reports on the upcoming premiere of Thomas Astruc's animated movie about Ladybug and Cat Noir, mentioning numerous guest that will be attending the event, such as Jagged Stone, Gabriel Agreste, and his son Adrien the voice of Cat Noir. The next day, Nadja goes to Le Sorbonne for the movie premiere. There she reports on the arrival of Clara Nightingale, the one who sang all the songs for the movie. Soon, after she enters Le Sorbonne, Nadja is seen talking to Alec and Clara.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 3]]
Later, Nadja leaves Le Sorbonne and gets a camera crew to go on the scene, where Ladybug and Cat Noir are battling with the titular villain. Her arrival makes Ladybug realizes that a lot of people must be watching them at home, and while Cat Noir distracts the villain, she approaches Nadja and the camera crew to tell the audience to stop watching the villain to make him stop moving.
However, the villain tells her that there will always be at least one person watching him, to referring to Hawk Moth. Therefore, Ladybug breaks their camera and apologizes to Nadja for cutting the live footage. Nadja and the camera crew then cover their eyes, along with the rest of Paris, leaving Ladybug and Cat Noir the only ones left that could see him.
In "Bakerix", Nadja is seen at the Gare du Nord, where she reports on how André will soon be unveiling the Startrain, a high-speed train that travels between France and the United Kingdom. Later, she reports on how the titular villain was wreaking havoc in Paris while still at the Gare du Nord.
In "Backwarder", Nadja reports on the arrival of the titular villain.
In "Silencer", Nadja is seen talking on her talk show, Side by Side.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Miraculer", Nadja reports on how Ladybug and Cat Noir had called upon Rena Rouge and Carapace to help them defeat the Destroyer. Soon, she notices the Eiffel Tower explode, reporting it on the news as well. Nadja then tells her audience about how Ladybug called on her Lucky Charm and got a rubber duck, wondering what she was going to do with it. Within seconds, she announces the heroes' victory against the villain as Ladybug did her Miraculous Ladybug.
In "Oblivio", Nadja goes on a helicopter to report on the battle between the heroes and the titular villains on top of the TVi Tower, with her mentioning on how Ladybug and Cat Noir were struggling as they are seen arguing. She then tells the audience about how the heroes were soon hit with the villain's blasts.
After this, Nadja was also hit by the villain's blasts, making her lose her memory. She then goes to the TVi studio, where Clara hands her a tablet to read off. She then reports on how the villain has been erasing the memories of everyone he comes across and how Ladybug and Cat Noir were tracking him down.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Christmaster", while reporting on how Paris was being invaded by giant toys looking for Santa Claus, Nadja is interrupted by Major Teddiski and his soldiers, who take over the broadcast and threaten to blow up the city.
In "Startrain", Nadja reports on how an observation satellite took some pictures of an akumatized Startrain traveling through space.
In "Kwamibuster", Nadja reports on how Olga Mendeleiev, a teacher from Collège Françoise Dupont, had been transformed into the titular villain and was threatening to drop Alec, who was been held hostage in a safe, from the top of the TVi Tower.
In "Feast", Nadja goes the Louvre to report on the unveiling of a mysterious statue carved from hardened lava, which was recently discovered on the highest mountaintops of Tibet by Alim Kubdel.
Sometime later, Nadja reports on the mysterious reappearance of a temple in the highest mountaintops of Tibet that had gone missing one hundred seventy-two years ago. She then turns things over to Clara, who is on a helicopter flying over the temple. She also adds to Nadja's statement by saying that all the monks who used to live in the temple also reappeared.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Gamer 2.0", on a Sunday, Nadja goes to the Place des Vosges with Manon, who asks her if she can go on the carousel. She tells her that she can go on it as many times as she would like, making her daughter cheer in joy. The next day, Nadja and Manon go back to the Place des Vosges, where the former sat down on bench to take a call and the latter played with action figures of Ladybug and Cat Noir.
She and her daughter were then zapped by the titular villain into his video game dimension, as they were both former akumatized villains. Prime Queen (played by the titular villain) fights Princess Fragrance (played by Ladybug) and is easily defeated. After the villain is defeated by Ladybug and Cat Noir, Nadja and the others are freed by Ladybug's Miraculous Ladybug. She then reunites with Manon, giving her a hug.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Stormy Weather 2", Nadja reports on how the Earth had shifted from it's axis, moving away from the sun. She then puts on scarf and hat as the temperature kept on get colder, explaining that this was thanks to the planet moving away from the sun. Nadja soon turns things over to Clara, who reports from the scene where Ladybug and Cat Noir were fighting the titular villain. Eventually, the screen freezes and stops working, with Nadja asking Clara if she was still there. Clara says yes and soon announces the defeat of the villain.
In "Timetagger", Nadja is sent to the past by the titular villain.
In "The Puppeteer 2", Nadja leaves Manon in the care of Marinette once again. The teenager later drops by to return her daughter to her. Manon gives a hug to Marinette, before she goes over to Nadja to do the same thing. The mother and daughter then wave at the teenager as she leaves.
In "Cat Blanc", in an alternate timeline, Nadja reports on how Marinette and Adrien start dating.
In "Ladybug", Nadja goes to the Arc de Triomphe, where she squats down behind a car to report on the battle between Ladybug and Mayura.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Miraculous New York]]
Nadja is first seen reporting on how the New-York Historical Society kicked off French American Friendship Week with a special exhibition. She then turned things over to Clara in New York City, who reports that the "necklace" that the Marquis de Lafayette gave to George Washington during the Revolutionary War was put on display for the first time. Sometime later, Nadja reported on how Paris had been safe from akumatized villain attacks for awhile, wondering if Ladybug and Cat Noir had put an end to Hawk Moth's activities.
The next day, Nadja went on the streets to report on the arrival of Robostus and he was spreading panic throughout Paris, mentioning the absence of Ladybug and Cat Noir. Later, Nadja went back to the TVi studio, where she reported on how the villain ultimately disappeared on his own before turning things over to Clara. Sometime after, Nadja came back on to report that André had sent his workers to work on repairing the damages that Robostus had caused. She then talked about how Ladybug and Cat Noir were busy saving New York at the time of the earlier attack.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Truth" and "Lies", Nadja reports on how Prince Ali is celebrating his birthday in Paris at the Hôtel de Ville.
In "Gang of Secrets", Nadja reports on how a strange phenomenon had just hit the Eiffel Tower, making it dance. She the advised everyone to stay home.
In "Mr. Pigeon 72", Nadja squats down behind a car to report on how the titular villain was back for the seventy-second time. She then mentioned how people were being transformed into his army of raven-pigeon hybrids, before getting transformed into one herself.
In "Queen Banana", Nadja is seen turning things over to Clara, who reports on a student film called Kreatika from Collège Françoise Dupont.
In "Mega Leech", Nadja goes to the Place des Vosges to report on André's Project Oxygen. When everyone starts turning against him, Nadja tells André that it seemed like everyone was opposed to Project Oxygen. She then asked him is he was going to resign, with André first saying yes and then no, doubting both of his answers.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 4]]
Within moments, Nadja announced that citizens were banding together all over Paris to protect the trees. She then asked André if he had anything to say on the situation while other reports also asked him questions, overwhelming him. Nadja soon witnessed André be transformed into Malediktator.
After the villain gets cloned by the titular villain into miniature versions of himself, a miniature Malediktator goes into Nadja's eardrums and takes control of her. She then runs off and starts trying to kick down a tree. Later, while roaming around the streets, Nadja spots Cat Noir and runs after him to try and get his Miraculous.
In "Sentibubbler", Nadja reports on how some bubbles holding various civilians were floating in the air, with no hero in sight. She then turns things over to Clara, who mentions that the bubbles resemble those of the Bubbler, but yet in one of them was the original akumatized victim. Nadja soon tells Clara to keep her distance and not take any risks, until Ladybug and Cat Noir arrive.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Glaciator 2", Nadja reports on how all the images showing Ladybug and Cat Noir together had disappeared from the Ladyblog after the couple had been voted "Couple of the Year", wondering if the heroes were no longer an item.
In "Hack-San", after Robostus sends out a signal to all Parisians with a message sent through their phones, Nadja is hypothesized offscreen. She is then sent by Robostus to the Musée Grévin, positioning herself where her statue used to be. There after Scarabella and Cat Noir arrive, Nadja unfreezes from his position. She then pulls out her phone and moves towards the heroes.
Nadja is commanded to seize the Ladybug and the Cat Miraculous, along with the other high-profile hypothesized individuals. As she moved in on Cat Noir, she was knocked back by the two heroes various times. Nadja then got back on her feet and watched as Scarabella and Cat Noir delivered themselves to Robostus. Later, Nadja is freed from Robostus' control by Scarabella's Miraculous Scarabella.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Simpleman", Nadja leaves Manon in the care of Marinette once again, hours before, she is simplified by the titular villain. When she goes on the news, Nadja introduces herself, telling the viewers that she is the reporter inside their television sets that tells them all the things happening around them. She then turns things over to Clara, after mentioning how today things were going badly.
Later, when she is simplified again by the villain, Nadja starts speaking gibberish on the news. She introduces herself as Na-Na and informed everyone that Cla-Cla (Clara) was no longer there. Nadja then screamed "Paris is all broken", asking Bug-Bug (Ladybug) and Meow-Meow (Cat Noir) for help.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Qilin", Nadja is first seen reporting on how, last night, Ladybug and Cat Noir successfully prevented the explosion of a turbine of a cocoa shop factory, saving Paris from drowning in rotten chocolate. Later, she goes to her painting class with Sabine at Collège Françoise Dupont's art classroom. There Nadja and the other students, such as Lila Rossi, paint using chinese paintbrushes, which, according to Sabine, allow them to easily master the five shades of ink: dry, concentrate, thick, clear and diluted.
While Sabine was saying that to her students, she walks over to Nadja and fixes the position of her paintbrush. Suddenly, the tables shake and a loud thud occurs from outside the building. The whole class then got up to look out the window. They find Ladybug and Cat Noir battling against Lollipop Boy. After the heroes defeat the villain and Ladybug does her Miraculous Ladybug, Nadja gets on call, with presumably someone from the TVi, and talks about how she was watching the fight.
In "Kuro Neko", Nadja reports on how a temperamental August was transformed into Gigantitan again and took Clara hostage, with Ladybug, Carapace, Pegasus, Pigella, and Vesperia saving the day.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Risk", Nadja reports on how Gabriel had taken the world by storm. This was as he had presented a new advertisement campaign, a project that will be filmed all over the world, starting his son Adrien and Lila, as an homage to the universal truth of first love.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Evolution", following the events of Strikeback, Nadja reports on how Paris was in great turmoil after Monarch (previously known as Hawk Moth, Scarlet Moth, and Shadow Moth) had stolen almost every single Miraculous from Ladybug. She then talks about how, despite the threats, everyone still supports Ladybug. Nadja soon tells her audience that Monarch may had won that battle, but the war for Miraculous had just begun.
In "Multiplication", Nadja reported on how it had been weeks since any akumatized villain had last attacked Paris, wondering if that could mean that Monarch was no longer a threat.
In "Destruction", it's revealed that Nadja had previously gone to the ice rink and taken a picture with Philippe, which he posted on his website.
In "Jubilation", Nadja reports on how another experiment of Anne-Jeanne Théoxanne du Bocquale had gone wrong as her tyrannosaurus-pigeon hybrid dinosaurs were on the loose, wondering this will reopen the debate on the need for the flying beasts.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Illusion", Nadja is seen hosting a talk show called Leading Questions, Honest Answers with invited experts, which include Alec, Bob Roth, and Mr. Banana. They talk about how Ladybug lost all the Miraculouses to Monarch, with Nadja asking them if she is the hero the people need. After all the experts give their own opinions, they take a break and cut to commercials.
In "Deflagration", Nadja reported on how Paris now had two new heroines with strong personalities named Scarabella and Kitty Noire, wishing them the best of luck in thier mission against Monarch.
In "Intuition", Nadja reports on how Claudie Kanté, the astronaut at the commands of Tsurugi Industries' most sophisticated space jet in space, made time to answer questions from her son's class, with minutes to go before test launch. Later, when Claudie is ejected out of the ship and A.D.A. flies off to rescue her for the second test, unbeknownst to everyone, Monarch taps the Snake Miraculous to mark the moment and shuts off all of A.D.A's sensors.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 5]]
As Claudie is back into the ship, A.D.A. asks her where she is and believes the test is a failure. Nadja was seeing this from Earth and reported on the situation, wondering what was going on. She then announced how A.D.A. had decided to fly the space jet to the ends of the universe, with Claudie still inside. Nadja would do this again multiple times as Monarch used the Snake Miraculous to go back to the marker, in which he was about to shut off A.D.A's sensors.
In "Revelation", while at her painting class, Nadja's alliance ring, along with everyone else's, updates as the avatar of Lila was replaced by the avatar of Kagami Tsurugi. Everyone then turn over to see Lila, who tells them she forgot to tell about the update that she suggested. Lila explains that she decided to quit to fully dedicate herself to her passion for painting, thanking Sabine for inspiring her by giving her a hug. Nadja and everyone else, who had witnessed all of this, then applauded for her.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Collusion", Nadja interviews Mr. Banana about his autobiography called Stay Peachy that is being made into a movie. Suddenly, Mr. Banana is touched by the blade of Miss Sans-Culote and is transformed into a singing balloon who obeys her every command. Soon, Nadja is turned into a blue singing balloon off-screen.
A singing balloon version of Nadja then goes with Miss Sans-Culote to Hôtel de Ville, where she and the other singing balloons attacked Ladybug and Cat Noir. After Miss Sans-Culote rejects her megakuma and Ladybug does her Miraculous Ladybug, Nadja is turned back to normal, along with the others.
In "Revolution", Nadja is seen interviewing Mayor Chloé about how she has outlawed super-offenders Monarch, Ladybug, and Cat Noir. Seeming concerned, she asks her if this is going to last long, which Chloé affirms. However, she then retracted her statement and promised to elaborate in a meeting.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 5]]
Chloé soon finishes by announcing the start of "Chloé's Law", which will be enforced by her police robots all through Paris. Later, Chloé, now Queen Mayor, sends Nadja to detention, a large maze-like corridor with rounded edges set up in the Stade des Princes. There she was forced to walk around in circles and listen to Queen Mayor from numerous large screens.
In "Conformation", Nadja reported on how it was the first day of summer break in Paris. She tells her audience about the being of the mayoral elections and the arrival of tourists from all over the world, taking advantage of the good weather. Nadja then talked about how Adrien and Kagami had arrived in London the previous day, mentioning how the couple would be pursuing their modeling careers there before cutting for commercials.
That night, Gabriel transformed himself back into Nightormentor and used the powers of Multitude, Voyage, and Sublimation (power to fly) to spread his nightmare dust to everybody across the globe, including Nadja. Once Nadja and everyone were suffering, Gabriel released a new tranquillity app on the alliance rings that has the power to calm them down with Adrien and Kagami's images.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 5]]
Once as Nadja was hooked on the app through her alliance ring, Gabriel broadcast a fake video of Ladybug and Cat Noir's kidnapping Adrien and Kagami, thus disabling the app and causing Amelie's nightmares to return. Nadja then went on the news to report on the kidnapping of the "perfect" couple.
In "Re-creation", following the events of the previous episode, Nadja reports on the emergence of the Miraculized, who are after Ladybug and Cat Noir as they were thought to have kidnapped Adrien and Kagami. She was then cut off by the cameraman, who had become one of the Miraculized.
When one month had passed since the universe was re-created by Gabriel, Nadja reported on how there only a few days left before school started up again. Wanting to look back on the worldwide nightmare epidemic that happened in the summer, she introduced Anne-Jeanne, who talked about the effects of Ladybug's victory over Monarch and the importance of controlling one's negative emotions.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Action", while her dressing room with Manon, Nadja was visited by Marinette, who asked her if she can report on how Bertrand King's practices were causing a large amount of pollution. She tells the teenager that she can't report his practices because it's Bertrand's money that lets TVi's television channel thrive as the money from his advertising allowed them to exist.
Marinette states that it is essential that Paris knows about the pollution and that it's for the world Manon's will grow up. Nadja replied to her by saying that the world Manon would grow up in would be a world where her mother wouldn't have a job. She then sadly leaves to go on the air before apologizing to Marinette.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Season 5]]
Sometime later, when she came on the news to introduce Clara, who was going to report on the heat wave that had settled in Paris, Nadja was cut from the air as Marinette and her friends had hacked the broadcast to send a global message, explaining their problem and showing the terrible consequences that pollution had on the Earth. The next day, Nadja reported on the effects the hacked broadcast had on the public, finishing off by saying that she and her team will be tracking the progress of this anti-plastic revolution within the coming days.

title: Nadja Chamack/History
text:
Nadja Chamack/History - [[Miraculous Paris]]
Nadja is seen reporting on how Ladybug and Cat Noir managed to save Paris from Shadow Moth yet again. She talks about how, after months of battle, supervillain Monarch, who once went by Hawk Moth and Shadow Moth, managed to seize all the Miraculous that Ladybug had been guarding, threatening to attack Paris relentlessly. Nadja then tells the audience how no one has lost hope as everyone still supports Ladybug. This happens following the events of "Destruction", starting after Gabriel's arm is wounded by Cat Noir's Cataclysm.

text:
Nathaniel's room - Intro
is the bedroom of Nathaniel Kurtzberg, located in his parents' apartment.

title: Nathaniel's room
text:
Nathaniel's room - Appearance
The walls are white and support beams are grey. A dark green curtain hangs over the door to Nathaniel's room and tied back by the tassel.  The room has a large window that overlooks the Notre-Dame de Paris with black curtains and two large beige potted plants on each side of the room. There is another window plane on left side room with black curtains past the large desk space.
To the right of the door, is a wooden closet, small desk with single draw, a blue chair and green lamp, and abstract monochrome painting above the small desk. Further along the right side, a dark brown double doorway that likely connects to a bathroom or closet. Next to it is a table with a potted plant and a large, abstract monochrome painting above it.

title: Nathaniel's room
text:
Nathaniel's room - Appearance
Nathaniel's platform bed is in the center of the room, facing the the door. The bed's headboard is very wide, surpassing the bed in length and have a shelf on each side. Two decorative lamps with intricate patterns resembling sunlight coming out of light bulbs hang above the bed. The bedding is light beige and the pillows are black. A single wooden bench with a white cushion is pressed against the end of the bed. There is also a blue and white rug with a fancy pattern of geometric shapes in front of the bed.
Further the left, there is a wide desk space with multiple upper and lower drawers and shelves attached to wall. Some of the desk's shelves have no doors and many are different sizes. Many items such books, bags, and spray cans are all over the space, while some areas are empty.

title: Nathaniel's room
text:
Nathaniel's room - Appearance
The desk is filled with art supplies, including: graffiti spray, paint, markers, crayons, brushes, paint tubes, hairspray, pastels, pencils, erasers, ink, and more. Other items includes cup holders, a black, two-tier letter organizer, a whiteboard behind it, two books, a black computer screen with mini camera on top, two adjustable lamps, and a green folder with a black leopard print. On the wall itself are Nathaniel's drawings from "Gabriel Agreste", which depict Marinette as a knight saving Adrien disguised as a princess from his father. Nathaniel's swivel armchair is bright orange and has a second, backless swivel chair with the same color.

Nathaniel's room - Trivia
Nathaniel's room is the third room to appear in Season 6 following Sabrina's room and Max's room in "Daddycop", Zoè's room in "Grendiaper" and Mylène's room in "Noe".

text:
Nathalie's flash drive - Intro
is a flash drive that contains the recipe to repair the Peacock Miraculous.

title: Nathalie's flash drive
text:
Nathalie's flash drive - Appearance
The flash drive is blue with one end rounded with a white button, and the other end with the USB connector. A detachable blue cap with a round tip covers the connector when the drive is not connected to a device. On one side, there is a black measuring bar with dark gray lines on one side, the measurement goes from red to green depending on how full the drive is.

title: Nathalie's flash drive
text:
Nathalie's flash drive - Trivia
If Gabriel had managed to give his younger self the knowledge of how to repair the Peacock Miraculous contained in the flash drive, it would have created a paradox; if Émilie had never gotten sick from using the damaged Miraculous, then Gabriel would never have become Hawk Moth and turned people into akumatized villains, meaning that Ladybug and Cat Noir would never have received their Miraculous and the events that led to Gabriel possessing the Rabbit Miraculous, which would mean he would never have gone back in time to give his younger self the knowledge of how to repair the Peacock Miraculous. But because of the heroes who stopped him, there is no telling what paradox he would have created.
If Gabriel had succeeded, he would've also saved Colt Fathom's life and prevented Tomoe Tsurugi from losing her eyesight and Nathalie from becoming sick and falling into her coma, thus also saving Gabriel himself from sacrificing his own life with the wish to revive her.

title: Narita International Airport
text:
Narita International Airport - Intro
(成田国際空港, Narita kokusai kūkō) is an international airport located in Narita, Chiba Prefecture, Japan.

title: Narita International Airport
text:
Narita International Airport - Description
Opened in 1978, Narita International Airport is located about 60 kilometers east of Tokyo. The second international airport serving the Japanese capital, it has two runways, one 4,000 meters long and the other 2,500 meters long, allowing it to receive most international flights, with destinations such as Amsterdam, Mexico City and Shanghai.
Terminal 1
Narita Airport Terminal 1 (成田空港第) is the largest and first terminal built at Narita Airport. It is a modern and spacious building divided into three main sections: the Central Building (中央ビル, chūō-biru), the North Wing (北ウイング, kita-uingu) and the South Wing (南ウイング, minami-uingu).
The Central Building has a large illuminated sign with the inscription "Narita Airport Terminal 1 ·成田空港第", while the wings have the same type of displays, but smaller.
Terminal 1 is divided into 4 floors. 4F is the main departure hall of the terminal. Directly accessible via a road viaduct, it has a wide metal mesh canopy that extends over the road and sidewalk, protecting the entrance from the elements.

title: Narita International Airport
text:
Narita International Airport - Description
The main hall is a glass and metal structure. Large windows extend along the facade, offering glimpses of the airport's bright interiors. Sunlight reflects off these windows.

title: Narita International Airport
text:
Narita International Airport - Trivia
Narita Airport is the busiest airport in Japan in terms of international passenger and cargo traffic.
Narita Airport does not allow passenger flights to or from Paris, these flights take place at the Tokyo-Haneda International Airport.
In "Miraculous Tokyo", Marinette Dupain-Cheng and Kagami Tsurugi arrive at and depart from this airport as part of their trip to Tokyo.
They are seen getting into the Tokyo taxi driver's taxi from the main hall of 4F. However, this is inaccurate, since 4F is the departures floor, while floor 1F is dedicated to international arrivals.
