(In Rena's Mirage, Monarch is seen standing before a frail Bug Noire. Gabriel is then seen sneaking behind Monarch and hits him with a beam, but Monarch did not budge.)
Rena Rouge: That's not it. Vanish. (dissolves the current illusion) Mirage. (creates another illusion)
Marlena: (off-screen) Alya, dinner's waiting. The chicken's running cold!
Rena Rouge: Coming, Mom.
(In the illusion, Monarch brings out a chicken drumstick as a weapon.)
Ella and Etta: (off-screen) Alya! Are you coming?!
Rena Rouge: Yes, yeah, give me a second! (sighs) I'm going around in circles. Vanish. (dissipates the illusion, which makes Gabriel and Monarch for a split-second to merge into one) Let's rest.
(Rena Rouge transforms back into Alya. She stops by the door.)
Alya: What if... Trixx, let's pounce.
(Alya transforms again into Rena Rouge and heads back to her bed.)
Rena Rouge: Mirage!
(The superheroine creates another illusion. This time, the illusion shows that Monarch took both the Miraculous of the Ladybug and the Black Cat, causing Bug Noire to de-transform into Marinette. After grabbing the Miraculouses, Monarch de-transforms into Gabriel as well. Rena Rouge makes a shocking discovery.)

title: Nemesis/Transcript
text:
Nemesis/Transcript - Intro
Rena Rouge: Shoot! That's actually... (scowls) possible!
[ Theme Song ]
Tom: (off-screen) Are you back, cupcake?
Ladybug: Yes, it's all good. Don't worry.
(Tom and Sabine enter her room's trapdoor with a tray of chouquettes, a croissant, and a glass of milk.)
Ladybug: Oh, thanks! (kneels down) Spots off.
(She de-transforms into Marinette. Tikki floats beside her.)
Marinette: You didn't have to, you know?
Sabine: (puts the tray of treats on the floor) We don't want to bother you, sweetie. But we thought you'd probably be hungry returning from a mission.
Tom: And if there's anything else we can do, like cleaning your outfit maybe, just tell us, okay?
Marinette: Thank you, but it's a magic suit — it cleans itself. I'm going to get some rest, okay?
Sabine: Marinette, we wanted to tell you. Thank you for trusting us.
Tom: We can't imagine what a superhero must be like but whatever happens, we're always here for you.
(Marinette shoots them a smile after Tom and Sabine gave her the reassurance she needs. Just then, her phone rings right after. She grabs it from her purse.)
Marinette: It's Adrien.
Tom: He was probably worried, too.

title: Nemesis/Transcript
text:
Nemesis/Transcript - Intro
Sabine: Of course, he's not worried! And we're not worried either! Not at all! (chuckles)
Marinette: Adrien doesn't know that I'm Ladybug anyway. Only you and Alya do.
Sabine: Really?
Tom: Why wouldn't you tell him?
Sabine: That's her business, Tom. Okay, we'll let you get some rest, sweetheart.
(Tom and Sabine exits the room. Marinette's phone still keeps on ringing.)
Tikki: It was the right idea to tell your parents that you're Ladybug, Marinette. Now you no longer have to hide.
Marinette: I don't know if it was, Tikki. (stands up) I did it to reassure them. But now, whenever an akumatized villain shows up, they get super worried. (She puts down her phone and glances at her torn sketch of Gabriel on her desk. Her phone rings again, showing a missed call notification from Adrien and a message from Alya. She taps on Alya's notification and plays her voice message.)
Alya: (from the voice message) Can I come over for a quick chat?
Tikki: Why aren't you answering the phone?
Marinette: Because it's making me anxious, Tikki.
Tikki: You don't like talking to your boyfriend and your best friend anymore?
Marinette: I do. It's just that everything I tell them these days are lies.

title: Nemesis/Transcript
text:
Nemesis/Transcript - Intro
Tikki: But Marinette, you didn't want Adrien to be devastated, knowing the truth about his father. Aren't you happy you've succeeded?
Marinette: How could I be happy? I will always know that his father is Monarch.
Tikki: Then, maybe you should tell him the truth?
Marinette: No! Because if I did, then he'd be the unhappy one. It would destroy him now more than ever!
Tikki: What about Alya? You've always felt so much better after confiding in her.
Marinette: No. Alya is good friends with Adrien. If I'd burden her with my lie, she'd have to lie to him too. And she hates lying. It'd be selfish of me.
(Marinette's phone rings again — it's a call from Adrien.)
Tikki: I think he really wants to talk to you.
(Marinette takes a deep breath and finally picks up the call.)
Adrien: Hi, Mari— Is something wrong, Marinette?
Marinette: (immediately puts on a fake smile) No, no! Everything's great! How about you?
Adrien: I wanted to show you what I've been working on lately. (pans his camera to the room of what seems to look like a work-in-progress sculptures) I have this idea.
Marinette: You do?

title: Nemesis/Transcript
text:
Nemesis/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: Now that I finally understand my father and his heroic sacrifice thanks to you, I'd like to pay tribute to him. (shows a blueprint) I'm going to turn some of the rooms of the mansion into a museum so people can learn about him.
Marinette: Oh! Mhm?
Adrien: Remember the statue that City Hall offered to erect in homage to him? I'm gonna say yes, and suggest they put it in the garden! (Marinette simply nods with a side of doubt.) And in the study, we can hang some of the sketches and display the jewels he designed! And I already know what image I want for the poster. Something that would show my father's true face. We'd use it on the flyers and admission tickets. It'd be the centerpiece of the museum!
Marinette: (with a strained smile) What are you talking about?
Adrien: You know, the portrait of my father that your drawi–
Marinette: NO WAY! (Adrien was taken aback.) I mean, uh... I can't!
Adrien: Why not?
Marinette: (pauses) Because I can't forget what he did! I mean, (circles around her room) the way he forbade you from going to school, or having friends, or how he did everything in his power to keep us from being together!

title: Nemesis/Transcript
text:
Nemesis/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: But he was only doing it to protect us, Marinette. Remember the documentary we made together? That's what everyone who knew him explained to us.
Nathalie: (from the video documentary) One thing is for sure: he was ready to do anything out of love.
(Marinette simply groans.)
Adrien: I also had a really hard time seeing the person that he was. I couldn't let go of the bad memories. But thanks to you, I've made peace with it all and—
Marinette: Now you're building your life around your father's shadow.
Adrien: But... it makes me feel better thinking about him in this way.
Marinette: I'm not sure if that's such a good thing.
Adrien: I don't understand your reaction, Marinette. You told me I was the only one who got to decide what to do with my life, and now that I finally feel like I could move forward, you seem to be bothered by it instead of just being happy for me.
Marinette: I'm sorry I'm not reacting how you'd like me to.
Adrien: Yeah, well, I guess I'll talk to you later, Marinette. Bye.
(Just right after Adrien hangs up, Alya knocks on her door.)
Alya: Marinette, open up. It's me.

title: Nemesis/Transcript
text:
Nemesis/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Alya? (opens her trapdoor, Alya goes in the room) Sorry, I didn't have time to get back to you. I just got home and I-I was about to take a nap.
Alya: Trixx, let's pounce!
(She transforms into Rena Rouge.)
Rena Rouge: I know you have a secret. I know it's about Adrien and I know you didn't want to tell me about it. But you know me, I can't help but search for the truth. I've tried to reenact the scene you told me about, where Gabriel supposedly sacrificed himself in order to defeat Monarch, but nothing's made sense... except this. (pulls out her flute) Mirage!
(She re-creates the mini illusion of Monarch grabbing Bug Noire's Miraculous. Monarch is depicted to de-transform into Gabriel Agreste. Marinette is close to surrendering to the truth.)
Marinette: Why would I have done that? Why keep it a secret that Gabriel Agreste was Monarch?
Rena Rouge: To protect Adrien.
Marinette: You really think I could lie to my boyfriend like that... and to my BFF... and to the WHOLE world?!!?
Rena Rouge: Do I think Marinette Dupain-Cheng would do anything in order to protect other people, even if it means ruining her own life? (Beat. Close-up of Rena's face) Yes.

title: Nemesis/Transcript
text:
Nemesis/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Don't you think my life is enough of a disaster as it is?
Rena Rouge: (expression changes to concern) Why would you say that?
Marinette: Because, really... everything's falling apart! I couldn't defeat Hawk Moth and get his Miraculous back. So, now there's this... holder of the Butterfly Miraculous — a new Hawk Moth, who's more dangerous than ever!! They even attacked me and my family!! I've never seen my parents so afraid. I'm scared too, Alya! We have to stop them, before I can't go on anymore. But we have nothing on them— we know NOTHING about this Butterfly Miraculous holder! Whether they're a man, or a woman, or what their name is, OR WHAT THEY ULTIMATELY WANT!! (Rena, seeing just how upset and close to an emotional breakdown her BFF is, dissipates her illusion and walks toward Marinette, placing a reassuring hand on her shoulder.) I've had this idea but... it's very dangerous, and I don't know if you'd want to hear about it.
Rena Rouge: If it can help save Paris, of course, I want to know.
Marinette: (wipes her tears) Here's the plan: you'd have to create two illusions of Marinette.

title: Nemesis/Transcript
text:
Nemesis/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: Marinette works so hard for me to have positive memories of my father. It's not like her to react this way. What do you think?
Plagg: Oh, I... I have to admit that I agree with Marinette. A cheese museum would've been a lot more interesting in my opinion.
(Adrien lets out a sigh. After an abrupt moment, Ladybug alerts his Miraculous, signalling trouble.)
Adrien: Ladybug needs me. The cheese museum would have to wait. Plagg, claws out! (transforms into Cat Noir)
Pegasus: Uh, hello! Ladybug, why are we here?
Ladybug: (on the call) It's all part of the plan, Pegasus. Marinette Dupain-Cheng has signed on to help us capture the new holder of the Butterfly Miraculous.
Cat Noir: Huh? Why her?
Marinette: Because I've had it! (comes out to reveal herself as a copy of Marinette in the room) The new holder akumatized my whole family, including me, so I wanted to help you guys.
(Rooster Bold, Cat Noir, and Pegasus are all flabbergasted.)
Pegasus: Am I seeing double?!!?
Rena Rouge: (on the call) You are. The Marinette who welcomed you is an illusion.
Marinette: And I'm the real one.
(Cat Noir, astonished, approaches the Marinette illusion.)

title: Nemesis/Transcript
text:
Nemesis/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: (on the call) Careful! If you touch the illusion, it will disappear.
Cat Noir: I know, M'Lady. It's just really convincing! Okay, what's the rest of the plan?
Ladybug: (on the call) We're going to grab the new Hawk Moth's attention to make them akumatize the illusion of Marinette.
Cat Noir: Since when is it possible to akumatize an illusion?
Rooster Bold: Even if it could be done, it only takes someone touching the illusion for it to disappear.
Rena Rouge: (on the call) Maybe not, Rooster Bold, and that's precisely where you come in.
Ladybug: (on the call) We need you to give yourself a superpower that would make it possible to touch the illusion without it vanishing. Think you can make that happen?
Rooster Bold: In theory, I can give myself any power I want but I'd have to picture exactly how it would work.
Ladybug: I trust your imagination.
Rooster Bold: Hmm, how about... Okay, I think I've figured it out. (grabs his quill) Sublimation! I'm giving myself the power to protect Marinette's illusion with a layer of air. That way, whenever someone tries to touch the illusion, they'll actually only touch the layer of air, meaning she won't vanish.

title: Nemesis/Transcript
text:
Nemesis/Transcript - Intro
(Rooster Bold walks toward "Marinette". With his newly created powers, he wraps "Marinette" around with an orange aura, giving her a shield. Rooster Bold holds his hand up high for a high-five to test the layer of air he created around Marinette. The illusion gives him one, and nothing happens. The illusion does not dissipate thanks to his shield.)
Cat Noir: It works!
Ladybug: (on the call) Good job. Next, we'll need Marinette's illusion to experience a strong enough emotion for the new Hawk Moth to akumatize her.
Rena Rouge: (on the call) I'll make sure she does.
Ladybug: (on the call) Meanwhile, the real Marinette will hide here.
Cat Noir: (to "Marinette") Are you sure you'll be okay? Do you want someone to stay with you?
"Marinette": No! No need, thanks.
(Cat Noir notices the torn pieces of the Gabriel portrait Marinette had worked on.)
Ladybug: (on the call) As for me, I'll pretend to be defeated by the akumatized illusion, and... uh... Cat Noir, you still with us?
Cat Noir: Uh— Yes, I'm here, M'Lady!
Ladybug: (on the call) So, once the akumatized illusion has defeated me, I'll let it seize my Miraculous.

title: Nemesis/Transcript
text:
Nemesis/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: (surprised) But, uh... you mean a fake Miraculous, right, M'Lady?
Ladybug: (on the call, her expression now dead serious) No, I mean the real one; otherwise, the villain won't believe us.
Cat Noir: (panics) Meow! Meow! Cat alert! Isn't that a teeny bit dangerous?!
Rooster Bold: You'll transform back!
Pegasus: And everyone will find out your secret identity!
Ladybug: (on the call, reassuringly) Don't worry, we've thought of everything.
(Rena Rouge pans the camera to show Miss Hound using her ball to touch Ladybug's earrings.)
Miss Hound: (on the call) Now that my ball has touched Ladybug's earrings, I'll be able to retrieve them as soon as we'll need to.
Rena Rouge: (on the call) So, when Marinette's akumatized illusion takes Ladybug's earrings, the new Hawk Moth will order her to bring them to them.
Ladybug: (on the call) That's when Ryuko and Polymouse step in. (Another screen appears to show Ryuko and Polymouse elsewhere in the city, ready to do their part) Marinette's akumatized illusion will lead Polymouse and Ryuko right to the Butterfly villain, and once they found their hiding place, they'll relay the location to us.

title: Nemesis/Transcript
text:
Nemesis/Transcript - Intro
Rena Rouge: (on the call) And finally, the other Miraculers will show up via Pegasus's portal to capture the villain. Voilà!
(To emphasize that, another screen appears showing Minotaurox, Carapace, Vesperia, Caprikid, Pigella, and Purple Tigress, waiting for the signal at the Miracle Station.)
Cat Noir: Sounds like the perfect plan, M'Lady! But you've missed one tiny detail: what about your favorite kitten?
Ladybug: (on the call) You, kitty cat, will pretend to fight Marinette's akumatized illusion. Of course, we won't let her seize your Miraculous. That'd be way too dangerous.
Cat Noir: Got it! You can count on me, Bugaboo!
Ladybug: (on the call) Any questions?
Miraculers: We're ready!
Ladybug: (on the call) Then, let's do this! But first, before I purposely fall victim to the akumatized villain... Lucky Charm! (She summons a caterpillar keychain into her hand) A caterpillar keychain? Okay, why not? (gives the keychain to Rena Rouge) You keep it for me, just in case. (Rena Rouge nods.)
"Marinette": (sobbing, holding a photo of her and Alya) How could Alya lie to me after all this time?! (rips the photo in half) I thought we were best friends!

title: Nemesis/Transcript
text:
Nemesis/Transcript - Intro
(Scene reveals Rena Rouge controlling the illusion behind a wall of flowers.)
Rena Rouge: (while controlling the illusion) ...But she betrayed me!
(And Chrysalis finally sensed the negative emotion in her catacombs with her Empathy, looking up with a surprised gasp upon detecting it.)
Chrysalis: Well, well... Marinette Dupain-Cheng, you seem quite unhappy, but don't worry, I'll comfort you.
(She opens her cane and releases an Ultrakuma from the top, which flitters off to carry out its duty, seeing another chance to akumatize Marinette after her previous attempt in "Heartfixer". Back at the balcony, the Ultrakuma flies towards "Marinette" and infects the half of the torn photo in her left hand. "Marinette" gasps with a look of shock on her face as Chrysalis' mask appears around her eyes and the camera zooms into her mindscape as Chrysalis' illusion appears next to her.)
Chrysalis: Forgive my intrusion, but I've sensed a considerable distress from a broken friendship.
Rena Rouge: (as "Marinette") The one person I thought would never hurt me was Alya.

title: Nemesis/Transcript
text:
Nemesis/Transcript - Intro
Chrysalis: Oh, how I understand. There's nothing worse than a friend who lies to your face. Do you know what would be fitting (embraces "Marinette") for you to be able to teach her a lesson?
Rena Rouge: (as "Marinette") I wish the hardness of her stone-cold heart would be shown on her face!
Chrysalis: I can give you that power if you agree. What should I call you?
Rena Rouge: (as "Marinette") Nemesis!
(Chrysalis closes her fist around "Marinette", sealing the deal. Back in reality, her mask disappears from around the decoy's eyes, while "Marinette" has a look of anger on her face now before being engulfed in the purple ether of being akumatized. When the ether recedes, Marinette's illusion has now been akumatized into Nemesis.)
Rena Rouge: (as Nemesis) And you? What should I call you?
Chrysalis: It doesn't matter. I'm just a friend who means you well.
(Rena shakes her head "no" to Ladybug for not getting the villain's name.)
Ladybug: It's okay. Keep going! (Miss Hound nods in agreement, knowing they have to keep the ruse going to fool Chrysalis)
(Nemesis springs into action, leaps into the air to take flight, and begins to search for her victim.)

title: Nemesis/Transcript
text:
Nemesis/Transcript - Intro
Nemesis: Alya Césaire, I'll find you!! (crashes into the Césaire apartment) Alya, show yourself, you traitor! How did you think I wouldn't figure this out?!
(Scene switches to Rena and Ladybug.)
Rena Rouge: (to Ladybug while still acting as the illusion) I never thought my best friend would ever lie to my face!
(As Rena Rouge frustratingly drilled those words to Ladybug, Ladybug is lost for words and jumps into action.)
(Back in the Césaire apartment, Nemesis is still looking for Alya.)
Ladybug: (landing on the balcony fence) Nemesis, you must control your anger!
Nemesis: I can't! Her betrayal is too great!
Ladybug: Maybe you are wrong!
Nemesis: I am NOT WRONG!! (She charges into Ladybug, sending her flying onto the pavement. Just as Ladybug stands on her feet, Nemesis gives her a beating and Ladybug crashes against a wall, pinned to it by Nemesis using her shield to restrain her.) Don't try and stop me. Fake friends only deserve one thing — to be PUNISHED!!

title: Nemesis/Transcript
text:
Nemesis/Transcript - Intro
(Her eyes and mouth light up and attempts to shoot a beam at Ladybug, only for the superheroine to escape. Ladybug throws her yo-yo at Nemesis, but she deflects it, ricocheting it back to Ladybug and throws her again right into a garbage truck, denting it from the impact. Ladybug flees away and hides among the rooftops.)
Nemesis: Believe me, Alya Césaire, wherever you're hiding, I will find you!! (She rises back into the air and zips away to continue her search, as Ladybug hides behind a rooftop chimney, out of her sight) I bet she's hiding away at her boyfriend's place! Nino!!!
(Nemesis stops flying as Cat Noir blocks her path, joined by Pigella and Caprikid.)
Nemesis: You blocking my path only makes you the liar's accomplices!
Ladybug: (swings in) Calm down, Nemesis. Maybe Alya Césaire had good reasons to do what she did!
Nemesis: There's never a good reason to lie. (flies towards Pigella) Lying means betraying people! (shoots a beam at Pigella, turning her into stone. Pigella whimpers in fear and horror upon seeing what's happening to her before her face and head are affected.)
Ladybug: Pegasus, evacuation!

title: Nemesis/Transcript
text:
Nemesis/Transcript - Intro
(Pegasus opens a portal to rescue a petrified Pigella. Ladybug and Cat Noir continue to battle Nemesis on the rooftops. Caprikid attempts to attack, but gets petrified by Nemesis as well. Pegasus opens another portal to rescue Caprikid. He takes Caprikid back to the Miracle Station and places him next to Pigella. Nemesis shoots a beam at Cat Noir, but he spins his baton as a shield. Chrysalis' mask appears on Nemesis' face, as she shoots an antikuma directly at Cat Noir. It lands a direct hit, knocking him backwards, and disabling his Miraculous powers temporarily.)
Chrysalis: Cat Noir has lost his powers. Seize his Miraculous, Nemesis!
(Just before Nemesis could catch Cat Noir, Pegasus opens yet another portal to rescue him.)
Nemesis: Just missed him!
Chrysalis: It's okay. Focus on Ladybug!
Nemesis: Poor, little Ladybug. Your friends have abandoned you too.
Ladybug: No, they just faced defeat. Real friends never abandon you!
Nemesis: Wrong! Completely wrong!!!

title: Nemesis/Transcript
text:
Nemesis/Transcript - Intro
(The battle continues between Ladybug and Nemesis. Nemesis chases after Ladybug, and the polka-dotted superheroine escapes her petrifying beams. Just as Nemesis catches up with Ladybug, the villain tips her off with her wings, causing her to fall down. Nemesis grabs the opportunity to shoot a beam at her and does it successfully. Ladybug looks on helplessly with horrified, fearful gasps as she begins to be turned to stone like her teammates.)
Chrysalis: Perfect! Seize her Miraculous now! Hurry, before they withdraw like what they did with the others!
(As Pegasus opens a portal underneath Ladybug, Nemesis quickly flies toward a half-petrified Ladybug and manages to successfully grab her earrings before the petrification finishes and Pegasus recovers her. Back in Marinette's balcony, Pegasus places a petrified Ladybug in a half-open box, similar to what the Miraculers used when unlocking their adult powers back in "Revelator". Then, back to Nemesis, who is grinning from ear-to-ear now that she got Ladybug's Miraculous.)

title: Nemesis/Transcript
text:
Nemesis/Transcript - Intro
Chrysalis: Excellent! Now that you've got Ladybug's Miraculous, Nemesis, bring it to me at the Fontaine du Trocadéro. That is, if you want me to further help you get back at your… former best friend.
Rena Rouge: (as Nemesis) More than ever! (as herself, to Ryuko, who is standing by at the scene) Ryuko, Nemesis is heading for the Fontaine du Trocadéro.
Ryuko: Got it! (leaps away)
Nemesis: Where are you?
Chrysalis: I'm afraid you and I won't be meeting. Put the Miraculous in the hole in the fountain. (Nemesis obeys the order and places the earrings in the fountain, underwater.) Excellent job, Nemesis! Now focus on seizing Cat Noir's Miraculous. You will be duly rewarded.
(Nemesis flies away. Ryuko is shown to be spying underwater, lying by the earrings in her Water Dragon form.)
Ryuko: I'm in position, Rena. The holder of the Butterfly Miraculous should be here soon. (A child shows up playing by the edge of the fountain.) I see a child. It can't be him.
Rena Rouge: We'll know soon enough.
(The child grabs the earrings from underwater, places them in a candy wrapper, and runs away with them.)
Ryuko: He has the earrings in a candy wrapper. He's leaving now.

title: Nemesis/Transcript
text:
Nemesis/Transcript - Intro
Rena Rouge: Follow him, Ryuko.
(Ryuko sneaks behind the child in her Water Dragon form. On the streets, the same child walks casually, with Ryuko spying among the water puddles in the gutters, out of sight of prying eyes. Then, the child leaves the candy-wrapped Miraculous on top of a mailbox.)
Ryuko: He left the wrapper behind. If I follow the kid, I'll lose sight of the Miraculous.
Rena Rouge: You're right. It's too risky. Stay with the earrings.
(Ryuko hides back in the puddle. A fireman grabs the candy-wrapped earrings on the mailbox.)
Ryuko: I got a fireman in sight. He's taking the wrapper.
Rena Rouge: Don't lose him.
(Ryuko peeks by the gutter and sees more firemen, losing sight of the fireman with the candy wrapper once he entered the fire station.)
Ryuko: I've lost him!
Rena Rouge: Don't worry, we've got it from here.
(Ryuko retreats back into the puddle to disengage from the pursuit. The fireman goes through a door.)
Chrysalis: (as the pregnant lady) Nemesis, I need to make sure that it's the real Miraculous. Unpetrify Ladybug!
Nemesis: At your command.

title: Nemesis/Transcript
text:
Nemesis/Transcript - Intro
(Nemesis flashes her eyes to deactivate her petrification on Ladybug. At the balcony, Ladybug becomes unpetrified and de-transforms into Marinette, and at the same time, the Ladybug Miraculous on Chrysalis' hand, and Tikki comes out of the earrings, who is shocked to see Chrysalis before her.)
Chrysalis: It is the REAL Miraculous!
(The plan isn't in vain yet — as one of Polymouse's Multitude clones is seen hiding in the earrings. She jumps out of Chrysalis' hand and sends her location to Rena Rouge while glaring furiously up at the villain.)
Rena Rouge: We have her location!
Miss Hound: Got it! Fetch!
(Her ball flies quickly to where the Ladybug Miraculous' location is, as well as Chrysalis' — in the sewers. The ball retrieves the earrings, to Chrysalis' horror, as her plan is being foiled as Tikki disappears as well, returning with the Miraculous to Miss Hound's possession.)
Chrysalis: (gasps) What just—?!
Rena Rouge: Good job! (takes the earrings from Miss Hound and takes out her flute) Miraculers, ATTACK!!!
Chrysalis: No... No, no, NO!!! (runs away)

title: Nemesis/Transcript
text:
Nemesis/Transcript - Intro
Polymouse: Fall in! (Her Multitude clones merge back with the one that was with the Ladybug Miraculous, returning her to normal, as Minotaurox joins her through a Voyage portal) She went that way! (She and Minotaurox take off in pursuit)
(Vesperia appears, as well as Rooster Bold. Back in the balcony, Rena returns the earrings to Marinette.)
Marinette: Tikki, spots on!
(She transforms into Ladybug. She steps out the box.)
Ladybug: We need to talk.
Rena Rouge: I've said my piece. We're ready, Pegasus!
(Ladybug, Rena Rouge, and Miss Hound teleports to the catacombs.)
Rena Rouge: Let's split up.
(Rena goes to the left, while Ladybug and Miss Hound go right. The Miraculers are now searching for Chrysalis in a maze. In King Monkey's line of view, he encounters Chrysalis, still in the form of the pregnant lady. Right after, Ladybug chases after her too. But she bumps into King Monkey.)
Ladybug: Did you see her?
King Monkey: She was right over there, but then I lost sight of her!
Ladybug: Hurry! You go right, I go left!

title: Nemesis/Transcript
text:
Nemesis/Transcript - Intro
(Ladybug and King Monkey split up. Ladybug hears a door slam, and seeing an eerie orange glow, and heavy smoke slithering across the ceiling, heads to a path that leads her to a room in flames, which appears to be the room that contained Chrysalis' notebooks, indicating she set fire to them intentionally to keep them out of the Miraculers' hands. Ladybug runs to search again, but finds herself in the middle of the maze, appearing lost. Miss Hound, Purple Tigress, Carapace, and King Monkey meet up with her.)
Miss Hound: We've lost her!
Cat Noir: I didn't see anyone!
Minotaurox: Me neither!
Ladybug: But that's impossible! How did she get away?!
Rena Rouge: (through the communicator) Should I stop the illusion?
Ladybug: Y-Yes. It's no use to us anymore— Wait! Let's pretend that we actually defeat her so we don't arouse suspicion!
Nemesis: Cat Noir, where are you hiding?!
(Ladybug, Miss Hound, and Pegasus Voyage to the rooftops and confront Nemesis.)
Ladybug: Nemesis, listen! Best friends all make mistakes, but a real friend is for life. If you don't want to lose her, then you just have to find in yourself to forgive her. I know you can do it!

title: Nemesis/Transcript
text:
Nemesis/Transcript - Intro
Nemesis: You're right, Ladybug. I want to do it. I want to... forgive.
(The villain puts her sword and shield down, folds in her wings, and rejects the Ultrakuma, de-akumatizing herself as "Marinette". The Ultrakuma is purified by itself and flitters away. Rena Rouge arrives in the scene and hands over the caterpillar keychain to Ladybug.)
Ladybug: Thank you. (Rena replies with a scowl, to which Ladybug did not take lightly.) Miraculous Ladybug! (She throws the caterpillar keychain in the air, un-petrifying Caprikid and Pigella.)
Ladybug: We're good, Rooster Bold.
(From the Miracle Station, Rooster Bold brings out his quill.)
Rooster Bold: Degradation!
(Back in Marinette's room, the layer of air that protects "Marinette" disappears. The other "Marinette" steps out of hiding as well.)
Rena Rouge: Reality!
(The two Marinette illusions vanish. Ladybug de-transforms into the real Marinette.)
Rena Rouge: Let's rest.
(She de-transforms into Alya.)
Alya: I was right earlier, wasn't I? Gabriel was Monarch.
Marinette: I never lied to you.

title: Nemesis/Transcript
text:
Nemesis/Transcript - Intro
Alya: Technically, you didn't. You just kept the truth from me and manipulated me so you wouldn't have to answer my questions. (sarcastically) Wow, thanks, Marinette. So, this is what being BFFs is like?
Marinette: I didn't want to burden you with all my secrets.
Alya: It's not just me. You lied to Adrien, too. Every day!
Marinette: If I tell him the truth, it'll break his heart!
Alya: You don't get to decide for other people what's good for them!
Marinette: I'm so sorry. I don't know how else to do it! I... just feel stuck now.
Alya:  I won't tell Adrien the truth. You're the one who should do it. But don't count on me to play your lying game. I'm still your stand-in. But if you want to stay my best friend, don't ever lie to me again.
(Marinette is left in the room full of tension, as Alya leaves the room with a crack in her heart.)
Ladybug: We still know nothing about the holder of the Butterfly Miraculous.
Rena Rouge: What about the pregnant lady?
Ladybug: She had no superpowers.
Cat Noir: Except escaping from us.
Ladybug: King Monkey, did you notice anything special when you saw her?
King Monkey: I didn't see her.
Ladybug: Yes, you did. That's what you told me.

title: Nemesis/Transcript
text:
Nemesis/Transcript - Intro
King Monkey: I didn't tell you anything.
Ladybug: Sure, you did, when we ran into each other in the gallery.
King Monkey: What do you mean? I didn't see you until we ended up at the same place.
Ladybug: But you did! We ran into each other!
King Monkey: We didn't! I promise I'm not lying, Ladybug!
Ladybug: But if it wasn't you I met in the gallery... (horrified gasp as she recalls her Lucky Charm) Of course, that's the key! The caterpillar... turns into a butterfly, then, the new Butterfly villain...!!
Ryuko: The child...!
Rena Rouge: The fireman...!
Polymouse: The pregnant lady...!
Pegasus: King Monkey?! (King Monkey gasps in horror himself)
Cat Noir: The new holder of the Butterfly Miraculous can take the appearance of anyone they want!
Ladybug: Including one of us!
Carapace: But how are they doing it?!
Ladybug: I don't know, but now we have an edge over them, and we have to develop a new secret protocol!
(Flash of lightning and crack of thunder as the Miraculers form up around and behind Ladybug as they know their war with Chrysalis has only just begun now, their faces locked in grim determination and resolve)

title: Nemesis/Transcript
text:
Nemesis/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: What you told me earlier about my father... Why didn't you say something sooner, Marinette? Why did you agree to draw his portrait if you didn't want to?
Marinette: I wanted to try. I really did!
Adrien: You know, I get that you're angry at my father, but you should be able to talk to me about it.
Marinette: I'm so afraid of hurting you.
Adrien: You won't. I feel fine, and it's largely thanks to you. I love you, you know? (Marinette gives him a bittersweet smile, and share a bittersweet kiss.) I'm glad we had this heart-to-heart. I think that's what makes our relationship so beautiful. We can be completely honest with each other. (Marinette frowns at his remark and stands up.) You're leaving already?
Marinette: Yes. There's something I need to do. (opens the door and pauses for a while, turning around to look at Adrien) I love you, Adrien.
(Adrien gives her a reassuring smile. Marinette walks out and closes the door. Now outside, Marinette sits in a dark alley, lit by streetlight, and sits on the top of the stairway and breaks down.)
Marinette: (sobbing) I can't do this anymore, Tikki.
Tikki: What are you talking about, Marinette?

title: Nemesis/Transcript
text:
Nemesis/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Alya's right. I can't be with Adrien and keep lying to him, and I can't tell him the truth either! I don't have a choice! We're over!
(As Marinette cries, it begins to rain with a rumble of thunder, symbolizing her downcast and heartbroken state over what her future with Adrien might be coming to.)

title: Nelson de Glusset
text:
Nelson de Glusset - Intro
is a supporting antagonist in Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir, introduced in season 6. He is student at Collège Françoise Dupont and also Ray Pugnant's and Loïc Stompet's friend.
In "Heartfixer", after failing to separate Marinette and Adrien several times, Nelson was voluntarily akumatized, along with Loïc and Ray, by Chrysalis into Couplewreckers, a trio of supervillains capable of copying the appearance of any person which they photographed.

title: Nelson de Glusset
text:
Nelson de Glusset - Appearance
Physical appearance
Nelson is a boy of average height, with tan skin, short, light caramel brown hair with messy bangs on his forehead and emerald green eyes. He has a long, straight nose and small tooth gap.
Civilian attire
He wears a white long sleeved sweatshirt with red and blue lines around the neckline and leather elbow patches. He also wears a red scarf that is just hanging losely on his neck without looping the scarf, rolled up jeans and brown leather loafers. He wears a silver bracelet and a watch on his left wrist.
As a Couplewrecker

title: Nelson de Glusset
text:
Nelson de Glusset - Appearance
He wore a dark purple, skin-tight suit with a light pink broken heart emblem on his chest, along with hot pink boots and gloves. The boots extended up to his knees, while the gloves reached his elbows. He also appeared to wear briefs over the suit in the same color as the boots. His hair retained its messy bangs, but its color changed to light blonde instead of the usual strawberry blonde. The tops of the boots and gloves formed a heart shape, and his belt featured the same broken heart emblem as his chest. His skin was light purple, and his eyes were cerise. He wore a inward pointing mask that did not cover his nose, mouth, neck, or hair; it was half hot pink and half purple, with a gradient in the middle—hot pink on top and purple on the bottom. He still had his scarf, now tied to resemble a cape, and it was hot pink. His hair turned platinum blonde.

title: Nelson de Glusset
text:
Nelson de Glusset - Personality
Nelson is a a quiet and reserved boy, but he hides a cunning, manipulative, and cruel personality, especially when it comes to interfering in other people's relationships. He enjoys provoking emotional conflicts, as evidenced when he deceives Kim about Ondine in order to separate them.
Like Lila Rossi, Nelson frequently resorts to lying to achieve his goals, showing no concern or remorse for the consequences of his actions.
Also, as seen in "Heartfixer", after being de-akumatized and having broken up Adrien and Marinette's relationship, Nelson, along with Loïc and Ray, were satisfied with their success and didn't care at all about having emotionally hurt Adrien, Marinette, Alya, and Nino, or even leaving Marinette vulnerable to akumatization.
Unlike Ray and Loïc, who tend to act more impulsively or aggressively in their mischief, Nelson prefers a calculated approach. He usually takes the lead in his plans, standing out for his patience and ability to wait for the right moment to act. Even after failing, as seen in "Vampigami," he remains calm and redirects his efforts toward new goals.

title: Nelson de Glusset
text:
Nelson de Glusset - Personality
However, as seen in "Heartfixer", he can lose his temper when his well-laid plans fail, as seen when he saw Marinette, Adrien, Alya, and Nino reconcile despite having strategically tricked them with his voluntary akumatization.
As Couplewrecker, because he was akumatized voluntarily, his personality did not change, and he was only interested in achieving his goals of separating Marinette and Adrien, and even another couple like Alya and Nino. He proved to be an expert actor, being able to realistically replicate the personality of the person he was imitating.

title: Nelson de Glusset
text:
Nelson de Glusset - Abilities
As a civilian
Due to his intelligence and suave charm, he can be a quite convincing person. This temperament enables him to manipulate individuals so he, alongside Ray and Loic, can prank them and ruin their relationships.
As a Couplewrecker
Whichever image on the phone he clicked on became the person he transformed into, taking on their appearance, voice, and sometimes even mannerisms. He also seemed to posses a certain amount of superhuman agility that persisted when transformed, as he and his companions talked atop the terrarium cupula, a place the majority of regular people wouldn't be able to access with no help, as well as some degree of speed.

title: Nelson de Glusset
text:
Nelson de Glusset - History
Before season 6
On the day of Aglaé's return to school, Nelson and his friends met her and learned of her fear of butterflies, and decided to take advantage of it. They left her in the butterfly garden alone, cruelly laughing at her as she panicked. Later, after Aglaé was akumatized into Lady Butterfly from the incident, she sought revenge on the bullies and trapped them in cocoons. They were later freed by Ladybug's magical ladybugs.
Season 6
In "Climatiqueen," he and Raymond Pugnant fell under the influence of the titular villain and began boosting her rankings in a competition hosted by Chloé Bourgeois on the social network Zoo.
In "Sleeping Syren", Ray, Nelson, and Loïc attempted to break up Kim and Ondine. After the other two’s attempts failed, Nelson manipulated Kim by lying to him about dangers of kissing.
In "Grendiaper", after Ray, Nelson, and Loïc were on an unauthorized motorboat on the Seine and disrespected Roger Raincomprix's orders to stop, Fury utilized her Venom and super speed to paralyze the trio and strap them to a moving roller coaster train in the amusement park, in order to teach them a lesson.

title: Nelson de Glusset
text:
Nelson de Glusset - Relationships
Friends/Allies
Ray and Loïc
Nelson is friends with Ray and Loïc, and they are known to cause trouble around and outside school grounds. Nelson gets along with them very well and vice versa, with Nelson being second in the group's hierarchy and acts as the brains of the group.
Enemies
Zoé Lee/Fury
In "Grendiaper", after Nelson, Loïc, and Ray were on an unauthorized motorboat on the Seine and disrespected Roger Raincomprix's orders to stop, Fury utilized her Venom and super speed to paralyze the trio and strap them to a moving roller coaster train in the amusement park, in order to teach them a lesson.
In "Sleeping Syren", when Nelson, Loïc, and Ray were discussing their failure to break up Kim and Ondine, Ray reassured that they would succeed next time, as there were still many couples to break up, to which Fury, who had suddenly appeared before them, said that there would be no next time and attacked them.
Aglaé

title: Nelson de Glusset
text:
Nelson de Glusset - Relationships
In "Wreckless Driver", it is revealed that on their first day of school, Nelson, Loïc, and Ray decided to make fun of Aglaé by teasing her about her fear of butterflies. They pretended to be kind to her but ultimately locked her in the butterfly enclosure. This caused Chrysalis to sense her negative emotions and akumatize her into Lady Butterfly. While Nelson and his friends tried to escape, the akumatized villain sealed them in cocoons, and they were eventually rescued by Ladybug.
In "Vampigami", when Nelson, Loïc, and Ray took Prem's paper vampire bat, Aglaé was one of the few who stood up for him. However, the trio was too arrogant to back down. When Nelson realized they had gone too far, Aglaé insisted that they should make amends to Prem.
Marinette Dupain-Cheng
Because Nelson is a bully, he and Marinette have a hostile relationship with each other.
In "Vampigami", Nelson, Loïc, and Ray see Marinette and Adrien kissing and very much in love and think that the more couples there are, the more fun it is to break them up, which hints that they are showing interest in targeting Marinette and Adrien as well.

title: Nelson de Glusset
text:
Nelson de Glusset - Relationships
In "Grendiaper", Ray stops Zoë from trying to stop Nelson and Loïc on pranking Marinette by changing her letter to Adrien, which was rude to him. However, they were unable to separate them because Marinette was sincere when she said she didn't write it, and Adrien believed her.
Sublime Varlette
In "Vampigami", Nelson, Loïc, and Ray took away the paper vampire bat that Prem made, and this happened in front of his friends, among whom was Sublime, and she told the trio that they should be ashamed of themselves.
In "Grendiaper", Nelson, Loïc, and Ray entered the elevator before Sublime and made fun of her for it, which angered Marinette. Despite that, Sublime calmly commented that they should "take a walk" while mentioning that she doesn't pay attention to such moments.
Roger Raincomprix
In "Grendiaper", Nelson, Loïc, and Ray were riding on the river at night, but Officer Roger tried to stop them because they weren't old enough to drive, to which Nelson claims that Loïc just turned eighteen because he was the one driving it, and then adds shampoo to the water to make Roger foamy, which makes the gang laugh.

title: Nelson de Glusset
text:
Nelson de Glusset - Etymology
The name "Nelson" is of English, Irish, and Scottish origins that means "son of Neil". "Neil" can means "champion", "passionate", or "cloud".
For the surname, the  "de"  is French preposition that  express possession, origin, or description ("of", "from", "about"). "Glusset"  is a likely a pun based on the word "Gusset", a piece material sewn into a seam to provide reinforcement, add breadth, or allow for greater movement, which may allude to Nelson's posh attire.
His surname could also be a pun on the French word "Glousser", which means "chuckle" or "giggle".

title: Nelson de Glusset
text:
Nelson de Glusset - Trivia
In Season 6, Nelson, along with Raymond Pugnant and Loïc Stompet, replaced Chloé Bourgeois, Sabrina Raincomprix, and Lila Rossi as the troublemaking trio of the Collège Françoise Dupont.
Nelson is the equivalent of Lila/Cerise - like her, he preys on people's weaknesses to manipulate and exploit them, and it is his deceptive and manipulative tactics that lead his victims to akumatization.
In the end of "Grendiaper", it is revealed that he has a mini scooter.
Nelson, Ray, Loïc, Jean Duparc, Marc Anciel, Aglaé, Prem and Marinette Dupain-Cheng are the only known students of the Collège Françoise Dupont to have only been akumatized once.

title: Necker–Enfants Malades Hospital
text:
Necker–Enfants Malades Hospital - Intro
The  is a hospital in Paris specializing in pediatric care.

title: Necker–Enfants Malades Hospital
text:
Necker–Enfants Malades Hospital - Description
The Necker–Enfants Malades Hospital is a hospital dedicated to the medical care of children and adolescents. The world's first pediatric hospital, it boasts numerous specialized departments for pediatric pathologies, surgery, and an emergency room.
The hospital also has a maternal and child ward dedicated to the care of pregnant women and new mothers, as well as several specialized services for adults.
The hospital also houses the Paris Emergency Medical Services (SAMU) call center and a mobile intensive care unit (SMUR).
Main entrance
The hospital's main pedestrian entrance is located on Rue de Sèvres, near the Breteuil Pavilion, one of the hospital's historic stone buildings. It features a monumental arched portal with a gray gate and a triangular pediment above.
The entrance façade extends before joining the two wings of the Breteuil Pavilion, two symmetrical two-story buildings. This entrance provides access to all the hospital buildings and its gardens.
Necker Square

title: Necker–Enfants Malades Hospital
text:
Necker–Enfants Malades Hospital - Description
Necker Square was designed by architect Jean-Jacques Huvé between 1837 and 1852. It is a quadrilateral surrounding a garden directly inspired by 18th-century military hospitals and the London Hospital. It is the oldest part of the hospital.
The garden consists of four pentagonal lawns with cylindrical shrubs and a row of flowerbeds bordering the sides. There are also green benches and, in the center of the garden, a pond for carp and goldfish, with water lilies and reeds.
This creates a small oasis of peace for patients and their families. It is in this garden, in particular, that outdoor entertainment events are organized for sick children, such as parties with inflatable structures or shows.
Rooms
One of the hospital rooms has a large hospital bed with a white sheet, a blanket, and a large blue pillow. Next to it is a blue bedside table with a landline telephone available for the patient's use.

title: Necker–Enfants Malades Hospital
text:
Necker–Enfants Malades Hospital - Trivia
In "Princess Fragrance", Ali visited the hospital as part of a toy distribution for the hospitalized children.
In the episode, it was implied that Rose participated in this visit.
In "Guiltrip", it was revealed that Rose has suffered from an illness since early childhood and that a flare-up of this illness, characterized by intense migraines, may lead to her being admitted to this hospital.
It is likely that Caline underwent prenatal checkups and even gave birth to Harmonie at this hospital.

title: Nikko
text:

is one of the minor characters in Miraculous World: Tokyo - Stellar Force and the animated spin-off series Miraculous Stellar Force. She is a student at Kano Academy, a superheroine, and member of the Stellar Force. She is the current bearer of the Gemini Fragment, which allows her to become Gemini and one of the guardians who possess a fragment of the Stellar Matrix.

title: Nikko
text:
Nikko - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Nikko is a teenage girl of short stature and slim build. She has olive skin, wide, sharp green eyes, and two wings on the top and lower lids. She has shoulder-length black hair styled in pointy, big pigtails on the top and smaller ones beneath, choppy forelocks, and straight-cut bangs, all of which have dark magenta highlights and brilliant orange ends.
Civilian Attire
Nikko wears an orange minidress with a black lower half and magenta jagged trim in-between. On top is a black leather jacket with lighter trim on the collar, forearm-length sleeves, and charcoal gray fingerless gloves. Her thigh-high socks are white with thick magenta stripes on the right and black spots on the other. Her boots are black. She accessorizes with a charcoal gray choker, white bows in front of all her pigtails, a gray thick headband with lighter spikes, a green triangle eyeshadow on her right eye and a magenta one on the other, sparkle-shaped prints on the corner of her eyes matching each eyeshadow, and magenta lipstick.

title: Nikko
text:
Nikko - Etymology
The name Nikko is derived from a Japanese onomatopoeia "nikoniko" (ニコニコ), which means "smiling" or "grinning".
It can also be derived from the Greek name Nikolaos, which combines "nike" meaning "victory", and "laos" meaning "people", essentially meaning "the victory of people".
However, it's more of a male name than a female one.
It could also be a combination of the Japanese kanji "nichi" (日) meaning "sun, day, sunlight", and "ko" (光) meaning "light, ray, shine". The name overall would mean "sunlight" or "sunshine". It's quite fitting for her personality.

title: Nikko
text:
Nikko - Trivia
Nikko has several traits associated with the Gemini sign:
Her theme color is orange, which is a color the Gemini constellation can represent.
However, the Gemini sign mostly represents the colors yellow and green, and sometimes blue and orange.
Nikko appears to have four pigtails with each pair being different sizes from the other.
This could possibly allude to her representing the Gemini sign because this sign's often depicted as a pair of twins, and twins can sometimes have differing traits from one another. It could also apply to two things having similarities and differences.
This could also apply to the duality between her name's bright and positive associations, and her more edgy, punk style, further emphasizing her zodiac. Her eyeshadow is also two different colors to add to this fact.

title: Nightmaker
text:
Nightmaker - Intro
(real name unknown) is a minor character who appears in the promotional episode in collaboration with BYD "Miracle Power". Not much is known on his civilian life.
In "Miracle Power", he was akumatized into Nightmaker, a supervillain who threatens to drain all of Paris' electricity.

title: Nightmaker
text:
Nightmaker - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Nightmaker is a tall, muscular man with a shaved head and a sharp jawline.
As Nightmaker
Nightmaker had a fully light gray, fabric jumpsuit covering most of his body besides his head. He wore metal shoulder-pads and kneepads with white accents. He wore a white, polygonal chestplate with a jetpack attached to it covering his metallic torso underneath. He wore a pair of light blue, triangular, opaque shades; obscuring his eyes. The ends of his arms and legs glow a bright blue color. And he wielded a mechanical blaster with a tube inside showing how much electricity has been charged inside.

title: Nightmaker
text:

As Nightmaker
Nightmaker had the power to drain the electricity from buildings and from electrical devices such as electric cars and suck it all up into his blaster. Once his blaster is charged with electricity, he can use it to shoot out electric beams at anything and anyone; electrocuting them. He can also fly at incredible speeds with his jetpack.

title: Nooroo
text:
Nooroo - Intro
is a major character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He is the Kwami of Transmission who is connected to the Butterfly Miraculous. With his power, Nooroo's wearer can use the brooch to transform into a butterfly-themed superhero.
Nooroo and his Miraculous are currently owned by Cerise Bianca, who uses it to transform into the supervillain Chrysalis with the same goal as Gabriel Agreste, to obtain Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses.
Previously, Nooroo and his Miraculous were used by Gabriel Agreste to transform into the supervillain under the alias of Hawk Moth, Shadow Moth, and finally Monarch, in order to take Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses.
In the Re-Verse, Nooroo and his Miraculous are active, being owned by Gabriel Agreste, who uses it to transform into the superhero Betterfly.

title: Nooroo
text:
Nooroo - Appearance
Nooroo is a light purple, butterfly-like creature who is 10 centimeters tall. He has butterfly wings that have a long tail with a tip at the end of each lower wing and dark purple eyes. There is a slightly dark purple spiral mark on his forehead and one on each lower part of the back of his wings.
From Season 4 onwards, he now has eyelashes.
From Season 6 onwards, the purple spiral mark on his forehead becomes a protrusion, his eyes now have black pupils with two white dots inside them and he has darker wings and they have a pattern, but this only happens when he is paralyzed, as they are bright white when Nooroo moves.

title: Nooroo
text:
Nooroo - Personality
Nooroo is a knowledgeable, helpful, and empathetic kwami. He shows a bit of his curious side in "Gorizilla" when Gabriel thought Adrien might be Cat Noir. Like Wayzz, Nooroo has a formal side, calling his holder Master instead of his real name. Despite his intellect, Nooroo apparently can be too trusting for his own good as he apparently provided Gabriel with most of the information he desired without realizing his wicked intentions until it was too late.
Though he reluctantly succumbs to Gabriel's demands to help him get the Ladybug Miraculous and Cat Miraculous, Nooroo was distressed that he is helping someone use the Butterfly Miraculous for evil reasons. When Gabriel later learned that there are more kwamis and tells him that he wants to find them all, Nooroo was scared and concerned for his friends. But despite being afraid and worried deep down he felt great joy when his fellow kwamis were saved in "Battle of the Miraculous". Meaning that he never gave up hope that he'd be saved someday showing that Nooroo is hopeful.

title: Nooroo
text:
Nooroo - Personality
In "Stormy Weather 2", Nooroo demonstrates a remorseful side, being aware of the damage that's been happening with his powers. He has also stated to Gabriel several times that his powers are not meant to be used in the way Gabriel is using them, showing a responsible side.
In addition to this, Nooroo was sometimes scared of Gabriel and was quite meek with him, such as in "Syren", when Gabriel interrogated him on how to obtain more powers. In "Sandboy", when he attempted to sneak away but was caught by Gabriel, he appeared frightened and meekly tried to explain his motives.
Just like Tikki who took on some of Marinette's personality traits in "Hack-San", it seems that Nooroo is taking on Gabriel's habit of using drastic measures to fix problems. Remembering the encounter with Robostus, Nooroo hoped with him akumatized again they'd be free meaning like Gabriel he isn't thinking things through.

title: Nooroo
text:
Nooroo - Personality
After being freed from Gabriel’s control only to be captured by Cerise Bianca, Nooroo is devastated to once again be forced into serving someone evil. However, unlike before, Nooroo shows much greater courage by confronting Cerise directly, trying to persuade her to abandon her dark plans. Cerise, in turn, treats him with disdain, seeing him as nothing more than a power source. She forbids him from addressing her and cruelly immobilizes him every time he tries to speak. Despite the abuse, Nooroo holds onto hope and even rejoices with genuine happiness when one of Cerise’s plans to uncover Ladybug’s secret identity ends in failure.
For that it could also be the reason why he speaks up now like Marinette and the others, Nooroo, despite not having the best relationship with Gabriel, he felt guilty how things ended by not trying harder to stop him. Like everyone else it wasn't completely, Nooroo's fault either as both his owners put him in a box where he could do so little help.

title: Nooroo
text:
Nooroo - Abilities
General Skills
As Nooroo's holders has a telepathic link to an akuma or kamiko, it's likely he has it too as well as have a good memory.
As a Kwami
Nooroo is able to fly, levitate, phase through solid objects, and carry things that are larger and/or heavier than him.
As a Kwami, Nooroo possesses and grants the wielder the power of Kamikotization, transforming his wielder into a butterfly-themed superhero by entering the Butterfly Miraculous.
Like his fellow Kwami, Nooroo can automatically speak any and all languages in the world, as he does not know who his next holder will be; not being able to speak the same language would cause problems for both parties, due to language barriers.
Similar his owners just as they can create akumas or Kamikos as well as give and take away powers from their champions that means it's likely that Nooroo is able to do it too but it's unknown what his version of akumatization or kamikotization, the reverse process even looks like, or if he can create Megakumas.

title: Nooroo
text:
Nooroo - Etymology
Nooroo's name is an African variant of the name Nuru meaning "born in daylight" or "light" referencing that butterflies are diurnal. His name also means "the time of night", referencing from his moth based appearance and that most moths are nocturnal.
The word Nuru also means "to paint; to plaster; to lacquer; to varnish; to spread; to smear; to put up (wallpaper)" in Japanese.
The word Noro also means "source of life" in Malagasy.

title: Nooroo
text:
Nooroo - Trivia
Nooroo is also the name of a locality in northern New South Wales, Australia, northwest of the town of Stroud.
Both the butterfly and the moth symbolize change or personal evolution. This is likely in connection with his ability to corrupt and transform others into his henchmen.
The swirl on Nooroo's head and the lower part of his wings resembles the proboscis of a moth or butterfly.
In his new design for season 6 onwards, the swirl on his head had become an appendice.
As of "Sandboy", Nooroo is the youngest of the known kwamis.
In Miraculous: Les Aventures de Ladybug et Chat Noir, Nooroo states that he grants the power of generosity.
In "Hawk Moth and the Akumatized Villains", Marinette had plans for Nooroo once he was freed, intending to use his powers for good after defeating Hawk Moth.
However, these plans did not come to fruition, as Cerise Bianca now possesses the Butterfly Miraculous after Hawk Moth's defeat.
Nooroo is the fourth Kwami to have his Miraculous destroyed as of "Miraculous Shanghai", following Fluff and Plagg in "Timebreaker" and Pollen in "Queen Wasp".

title: Nooroo
text:
Nooroo - Trivia
Nooroo is one of four known Kwamis to grant emotion-related powers, the other three being Duusu, Liiri and Daizzi.
Nooroo is the only Kwami from the Chinese Miracle Box who never met his current Guardian, Marinette Dupain-Cheng, personally.
However, Nooroo from the Re-Verse met her in "Miraculous Paris".
Since all Kwamis live simultaniously in all the universes of the Multiverse, Nooroo (from the main universe) has knowledge about her Guardian.
Unlike Orikko, Nooroo can grant powers which already belong to other Kwamis, as long they fall into necessities of the kamikotized/akumatized champion.
Despite gaining eyelashes in "Truth", he keeps appearing without them in some episodes as animation errors, especially when the episodes are animated by SAMG Animation, alongside Wayzz. This is often due to asset oversight.

title: Nora Césaire
text:
Nora Césaire - Intro
is a minor character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She is Alya's older half-sister and a kickboxer. Starting from season 6, she is also the cook at the cafeteria at Collège Françoise Dupont with her mother, and from "Grendiaper" she is also the security at Le Sorbonne.
In "Anansi", after Alya got fed up with Nora's overprotectiveness and refused to listen to her advice, she was akumatized by Hawk Moth into Anansi, a spider-themed supervillain.
In "Re-creation", Nora fell victim to Perfect Alliance, becoming a Miraculized until Eagle and Knightowl freed her by destroying her Alliance ring.
In "Sadnansi", following her confession to Twig days before going to Shanghai to train with Marinette's great-uncle in Cook Fu, she found herself conflicted over choosing between love and her dream. This caused her to get akumatized by Chrysalis into Sadnansi, an upgraded version of her previous form Anansi, who could shoot webs that caused her targets to forget about love. She received a Magical Charm from Ladybug that prevents her from being akumatized again.

title: Nora Césaire
text:
Nora Césaire - Appearance
Physical appearance
Nora is a dark-skinned tall teenage girl who  appears to be have a muscular build and has broad shoulders with long dark brown hair styled in dreadlocks that are pulled into a high ponytail. She has striking amber eyes, a visible slit in her left eyebrow, and a beauty mark beneath her right eye. Her fingernails are painted black.
From season 6 onwards, her dreadlocks are dyed blonde and styled to resemble the legs of a tarantula.
Civilian attire
Nora wore a cropped yellow tank top that features white trim and a black spider design on the front. Her hands and wrists were wrapped in white bandages that resemble spider webs, and she had black elbow pads on. She paired this with yellow shorts that had a white waistband adorned with the word "Anansi" written in black capital letters. The shorts had two horizontal black stripes, downward-bent black lines on each side, and white trim along the legs. Beneath the shorts, she wore short black leggings, and knee-high black boots with yellow toe caps and heels, which featured a yellow spider emblem on the shins.

title: Nora Césaire
text:
Nora Césaire - Appearance
From season 6 onwards, she wears a yellow cropped  hoodie with a spider web design on the right and a spider on the back in a bare midriff. She sometimes has her boxing gloves around her neck, with a similar design to her hoodie. She wears gray shorts with yellow vertical stripes and a magenta armband on her lower right arm.
As Anansi
Anansi was a tall and skinny supervillain. She gained four extra pairs of arms, shoulders, and hands, six pupiless orangish-white eyes with a black outline, and a very deep brown jumpsuit. On each limb were thick brilliant yellow stripes with a very deep brown section in-between (which was darker than the jumpsuit), matching the colors of her hands and feet. She had a brilliant yellow neck and collarbone, and wore a very deep brown helmet around her head, with the face left exposed. The top part of it and border were brilliant yellow, with fang protrusions near the jaw and a spiky ponytail at the back, resembling a spider. On her torso was a small yellow circle with black trim and spider. Her eyebrows were much thicker, connecting to the eyelid.
As Sadnansi

title: Nora Césaire
text:
Nora Césaire - Appearance
Sadnansi served as an upgrade to Anansi's apppearance. Her eyes glowed pastel yellow, same for the ones on her helmet. The top part of it pointed down and turned metallic very deep brown, while the sides were pointing at her cheekbones. Her eyebrows were thinner and she gained very deep brown triangular markings beneath her eyes, matching her lipstick. The ponytail model behind her helmet turned metallic, grew larger, and curved in shape. Her jumpsuit was bulkier and lost all of its details. The only exception was the spider emblem, which grew larger on her chest, turned metallic gold, and had angular lines spread to her collarbone, sides of her neck, armpits, and the sides of her navel. The lines ran down the middle of her limbs, with metallic gold boxing gloves for each hand.

title: Nora Césaire
text:
Nora Césaire - Personality
Nora is strong and caring but also somewhat overprotective, especially when it comes to her family, believing that strength is needed to carry someone through. She is very confident in her abilities and has little regard for superheroes, doubting that they will always be around to save everyone when there is danger, which is not an entirely irrational fear. She calls Alya's friends by nicknames, such as referring to Nino as "Cappie." Once she calms down, Nora can be humble and reasonable when admitting her mistakes.
Due to her toxic past relationship with her ex, Nora has developed a sense of hesitation toward love and romantic relationships. In "Sadnansi", after her co-worker Twig confessed his deep admiration for her, she became upset, asking him why he had to overcomplicate things between them. She revealed that his confession made her feel conflicted about her departure to Shanghai.

title: Nora Césaire
text:
Nora Césaire - Personality
As Anansi, she was overconfident in her abilities, believing conflicts would always end in a single punch, and she underestimated her opponents, whether they were civilians or superheroes. When angered, she was easily distracted and could lose her cool. Her motives became confusing, similar to how Rogercop sought justice through revenge and how Hawk Moth blurred love and pain. She crossed the line between protector and captor by holding Alya prisoner and deliberately trying to make Paris appear dangerous, either to prove a point or to justify her actions.

title: Nora Césaire
text:
Nora Césaire - Abilities
As a civilian
Nora is excellent at kickboxing. She is very fit and strong, easily able to defeat others in arm wrestling unless tricked. In "Stormy Weather 2", she is strong enough to pick up and hold her sisters and Nino with ease.
As Anansi
Anansi could shoot webs from her mouth, which she used to trap people. She was able to climb vertical surfaces with her sticky grip. Because she was a spider-themed villain, she had six arms and two legs. She also possessed immense strength.
As Miraculized
As Miraculized, she could use 15 Miraculous powers in her system:
Mirage to cast and communicate through hyper-realistic illusions.
Venom to paralyze anyone they touched with their stinger hand.
Shell-ter to create a nigh-unbreakable force field.
Multitude to split themselves into any amount of smaller clones.
Resistance to gain immunity to other superpowers and attacks.
Clout to gain an energy boost and release it as a punch that overwhelmed anything it encountered.
Wind Dragon, Water Dragon, and Lightning Dragon to transform into and manipulate the elements of wind, water, and lightning.

title: Nora Césaire
text:
Nora Césaire - Abilities
Second Chance to rewind time to a previously marked moment, allowing them to correct any issues or mistakes that occurred in the original timeline.
Voyage to open a portal to anywhere in the universe.
Genesis to create any object they desired, but the object was mundane and lacked any superpower, magic, or mythical properties.
Uproar to manifest a toy that chaotically disrupts an opponent's superpowers when touched.
Sublimation to grant themselves a super ability of their choosing.
Fetch to retrieve a previously marked item, no matter where it is.
Gift to manifest an image of a person's happiest desire, placating them and driving away negative forces.
As Sadnansi
Sadnansi had the same abilities as Anansi, but could also spit cobwebs that, upon touching a person, would turn them into her servant. People affected by her cobwebs could spit those with the same effect as Sadnansi's and become aggressive, seeking to infect more people and strip them of their ability to love, similar to the effects of Dark Cupid's arrows.

title: Nora Césaire
text:
Nora Césaire - Relationships
Family
Alya Césaire
Nora cares deeply about her younger half-sister, but this concern often led her to be overly protective. She showed a strong fear for Alya's safety due to the repeated dangers caused by akumatized villains and even tried to forbid her from going to the Ferris wheel with her friends, believing an attack could happen at any moment.
As Anansi, she went to extreme lengths to prove to Alya how dangerous Paris truly was.
Ella and Etta Césaire
Much like with Alya, Nora showed deep affection for her youngest half-sisters and a strong desire to protect them from harm.

In "Sadnansi", it's revealed that the two of them used to be a couple, but their relationship was apparently toxic, which led them to break up.

title: Nora Césaire
text:
Nora Césaire - Relationships
Nora is aware that Marinette is Alya's best friend and calls her "Baguette", unaware that she helps Nino win the match. After being de-akumatized and when Marinette tries to explain what happened, Nora quickly forgives her.
As for Ladybug, Nora, like many people in Paris, has heard of her and her heroism. However, she is doubtful that Ladybug will always be around or able to protect everyone. Over time, she treats the heroine with respect and support, as seen during the events of "Heroes' Day".

title: Nora Césaire
text:
Nora Césaire - Relationships
When Nino tells Nora that he can protect Alya from danger, Nora laughs at him, believing he is incapable of such a thing, though she allows him to arm wrestle her to prove his worth. Although he wins the match (thanks to Marinette's help, unbeknownst to her), Nora insists that he cheated, finding it hard to believe that Nino could beat her. After being de-akumatized, she apologizes for overreacting and spends time with him and the others at the ice rink.
As Anansi, she constantly taunted him, calling him weak. She toyed with him when he fought her using Cat Noir's staff, but became angered when he landed a hit on her face.

title: Nora Césaire
text:
Nora Césaire - Etymology
Nora's stage name and akumatized form, Anansi, comes from the African folktale character of the same name, who tries to trick others. In African folktales, Anansi often takes the shape of a spider and is considered the spirit of all knowledge and stories.

title: Nora Césaire
text:
Nora Césaire - Trivia
Her character was officially introduced after Thomas Astruc designed her and posted preliminary sketches on his Twitter on August 13, 2016.
Nora's existence was first teased in an earlier tweet by Thomas Astruc, where he asked the question, "Afraid of spiders?", foreshadowing her spider-themed akumatized form.
On a computer screen in a production photo posted by Jeremy Zag on his Instagram, an unfinished reference model of Nora's civilian form can be seen.
Thomas Astruc considers Nora his "favourite girl", as well as "buff and beautiful".
She gives several characters nicknames:
Marinette's nickname is Baguette.
Ladybug's nickname is Beetle.
Adrien's nickname is Cellphone Boy.
Cat Noir's nicknames are Mr. Whiskers and Kitten.
Hawk Moth's nicknames are Mothy, Butterfly Man, and Fly.
Nino's nicknames are Cappie, Flyweight, and Lightweight.
As a supervillain, Anansi is one of the few villains Hawk Moth does not name, since "Anansi" is Nora's stage name in her kickboxing matches.
Anansi was originally supposed to reappear in the two part special event "Heroes' Day", according to early concept art.

title: Nora Césaire
text:
Nora Césaire - Trivia
In "Gamer 2.0", Anansi returns as a playable akumatized villain as part of the Gamer 2.0's powers.
Despite being his stepdaughter, Nora still has Otis' last name, Césaire, which indicates that, at some point, he fully adopted her, a legal process that not only allowed her to take her new father's last name but also gave him full parental authority, cutting her ties to her biological father.
