title: Nino Lahiffe/History
text:
Nino Lahiffe/History - Intro
Nino Lahiffe is a teenage boy and friends with Adrien Agreste. He loves playing music and is a fan of Ladybug and Cat Noir. He is also Alya Césaire’s love interest. On occasion he helps Ladybug and Cat Noir as the Turtle Miraculous superhero Carapace.

title: Nino Lahiffe/History
text:
Nino Lahiffe/History - Before Season 1
Nino went to Collège Françoise Dupont for at least one year previously. He, Marinette Dupain-Cheng, and Chloé Bourgeois were in the same class.

title: Nino Lahiffe/History
text:
Nino Lahiffe/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Ladybug & Cat Noir", Nino was forced to move to the front row of the classroom by Miss Bustier. He ignored Chloé when she sat behind him and fought with Marinette. He went to Stade des Princes for PE with Mr. D'Argencourt. He was not seen again after Stoneheart attacked Lê Chiến Kim.
In "Stoneheart", Nino didn't greet Adrien when he first entered the classroom because he thought he was rude like Chloé. After he saw Adrien try to get the gum off Marinette's seat, Nino introduced himself and decided Adrien needed better friends. When Stoneheart reappeared, he was the first person to run. He along with his classmates in the library cheered for the heroes success. The next day, he greeted Adrien and encouraged him to talk to Marinette.

title: Nino Lahiffe/History
text:
Nino Lahiffe/History - [[Season 1]]
In "The Bubbler", Nino was upset that Adrien wasn't allowed to have a birthday party. He decided that he should visit Mr. Agreste and try to change his mind. Nino managed to change Gabriel's mind, but not in the way he wanted; instead of succeeding in getting Adrien permission to throw a birthday party, he succeeded in being banned from being Adrien's friend. Upset, Nino went to the park to try to calm down, but he only became angrier when he saw parents not letting their kids have fun. Hawk Moth sensed Nino's frustration and anger and akumatized him into the supervillain, Bubbler. The first thing Bubbler did was bubble all the adults and send them into space. The second thing he did was throwing Adrien a birthday party. When Ladybug and Cat Noir interrupted the party, he bubbled them, but they came back. The second time, he bubbled the other kids at the party and then chased after the heroes. Ladybug and Cat Noir caught Bubbler, captured his akuma, and returned the city to normal. The next day, he and Adrien walked into school together, their friendship solidified.

title: Nino Lahiffe/History
text:
Nino Lahiffe/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Mr. Pigeon", Nino sat by Adrien in class and supported him when the derby hat competition was announced and during the competition itself.
In "Timebreaker", Nino cheered on Alix and Kim. He helped Marinette hold the banner she made, but because he was cheering so enthusiastically, he ended up making her drop Alix's watch. Timebreaker made him disappear in one timeline, but he escaped to safety with the other students in the new timeline.
In "Copycat", Nino discussed Adrien's missing phone with Adrien. Deciding Adrien needed a break, he invited Adrien to the movies. Alya invited herself and Marinette along with them.

title: Nino Lahiffe/History
text:
Nino Lahiffe/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Lady Wifi", Alya dragged Nino out of the school to tell him her theory about Ladybug's identity. They bonded over their best friends being missing and then Alya told Nino she thought Ladybug was Chloé. Nino did not believe her. Alya roped him into helping her prove that Chloé was Ladybug. Nino had to distract Chloé while Alya took a picture of Chloé's locker. He was successful in distracting her, but Alya was caught anyways. When Marinette arrived, he told her about Alya's theory and that Alya was suspended for a week. He ran home, worried after Lady Wifi attacked the school.
In "The Evillustrator", Nino was paired up with Adrien and Alya for their particle physics presentation.
In "Rogercop", Nino attended Career Day then, when he saw Adrien returned to his seat he asked if his father was coming Adrien said no and he comforted him. He was recording all presentations until Chloé's bracelet went missing Marinette suggested looking at Nino's video to see what happened. The mayor wanted to the have the tape analyzed by professionals but Nino refused to turn over the camera.

title: Nino Lahiffe/History
text:
Nino Lahiffe/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Dark Cupid", Nino was in class learning how about true love happens in stories and when class was finished he heads home. But sometime later he receives an embarrassing picture of Kim from Chloé through his phone.

title: Nino Lahiffe/History
text:
Nino Lahiffe/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Horrificator", Nino was the director of a monster movie he and his classmates were making for a film contest. During the process, he altered the movie by adding a kiss scene which caused Alya to become irritated. Until they all heard a scream to discover that Max and Kim were gone. Nino decided to keep filming as he thought this would be great for the movie and when everyone tried to call for help through their phones Nino warned them that cellphones wouldn't work in scenarios like this to which he was right. But became equally excited with Alya when Ladybug and Cat Noir arrived and remained a safe distance with the rest of his friends but noticed that Adrien was missing. Following everyone to the maintenance room they found their captured friends and after Ladybug's asking Nino and everyone played Mylene's favorite song to calmed Horrificator down and filmed Mylene returning to normal. Afterward, Nino submitted to the video to the mayor and told his friends that the monster wasn't realistic enough and was comforted by Adrien believing that's how all directors start out.

title: Nino Lahiffe/History
text:
Nino Lahiffe/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Darkblade", when Nino heard that Marinette was running for class representative he and his friends gave her some ideas as he wanted everyone to listen to their favorite music in the library. Then, sometime later he went down to City Hall to get Jagged Stone's autograph but soon Darkblade and his knights attacked hearing Cat Noir fight them outside he hoped that they haven't gone too medieval on him. After Darkblade was defeated he along with everyone else was shocked to that Chloé had Sabrina steal Marinette's diary and wouldn't share the blame. After hearing Marinette's speech for class representative he cheered for his friend's victory.
In "Princess Fragrance", Nino was in science class and watched Rose get sent out of the classroom for playing with her perfume. Then, waited outside of the school for Adrien who finally arrived. He witnessed Adrien catch Marinette after she tripped over the stairs but was relieved that she was okay before heading home.

title: Nino Lahiffe/History
text:
Nino Lahiffe/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Animan", Nino was eyeing Marinette and Alya nearby until Adrien snuck up behind him where he informed Adrien of his crush on Marinette. But when Nino tried to ask Marinette to the zoo he froze like a statue and Adrien had to vouch for him and when the girls agreed the two boys walked away. However, Nino was nervous about the date but Adrien said he had nothing to worry about and yet he didn't want to be left alone and asked Adrien to coach him. However, during the conversation with Marinette, his responses got jumbled up and that he had a crush on Alya surprising his friends and Marinette offered to set up a date between them.
Noticing Animan's animal army stampeding Nino ran away but was pulled to safety by Ladybug and placed in the same cage with Alya and said hello to her. Afterward, he went to the Marinette's parents bakery with Alya to tell Marinette that he now had a crush on Alya due to the two having so much in common. When he heard of Marinette's crush on "certain guy" he offered to put a word in for her but was halted by Alya.

title: Nino Lahiffe/History
text:
Nino Lahiffe/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Simon Says", Nino made an appearance as a contestant on the show "The Challenge" where he got the mayor to dance and received the chance to make a reappearance on the show next week. When Simon Says had an army people under control he quickly hid and was found by Ladybug. The two arrived where Cat Noir had recently subdued Adrien's bodyguard (who was forced to act like a gorilla by Simon Says). Cat Noir accidentally readied to attack Ladybug after thinking she was Simon Says, Nino confirmed them of the situation.
Noticing that Adrien wasn't here Nino wanted to find to him. But when Cat Noir tried to dissuade them not to look for him because he could be hypnotized, Nino disagreed and continued looking after Cat Noir left. After the two find Adrien, Nino joyfully greets him. After Ladybug and Adrien finish greeting each other, the trio ran to the Agreste mansion. When they arrived, Nino and Adrien are sent to Adrien's room once inside, Nino comments on friend's room's immense size.

title: Nino Lahiffe/History
text:
Nino Lahiffe/History - [[Season 1]]
Nino was listening to music on his phone through his headphones when the lockdown defense system was initiated. When Ladybug and Nathalie are in the room to take Adrien and Nino out, he was asked by Ladybug where Adrien is. Nino told her that he was in the shower, Nathalie then takes him downstairs. After they meet with Gabriel, he asks where his son is and Nino replies that he's with Ladybug. The next week, Nino returned to "The Challenge" and invited Ladybug and Cat Noir to dance to his music for the challenge.
In "Pixelator", Nino and his classmates were having job experience day at the Le Grand Paris hotel where he was assigned as one of the cooks in the kitchen. Since Chloé and Adrien were nowhere to be found Nino covered from them, studying his Math book while waiting. He soon became startled when the two friends appeared out of nowhere and ask Adrien where has he been but Adrien tells Nino he'll explain later and gets asked to cover from him. But Nino retorts by saying he's been covering for him, by the end of the day Nino and his classmates get rewarded with Jagged Stone concert tickets for their hard work. He had a great time at the concert.

title: Nino Lahiffe/History
text:
Nino Lahiffe/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Gamer", Nino was in the library cheering for Adrien who secured a spot as Max's partner in the upcoming video game tournament. At the tournament, Nino urged Marinette and Max to hurry up. He did it once again when Adrien gave Marinette his controller to play in the tournament. He cheered with the rest of his friends when Marinette and Max were going into the playing area.

title: Nooroo/History
text:
Nooroo/History - Intro
Nooroo is a kwami that is connected to the Butterfly Miraculous, and with his power, his wearer can use the brooch to transform into a butterfly-themed superhero. The current owner is Cerise Bianca, who uses it for an unknown evil purpose.

title: Nooroo/History
text:
Nooroo/History - Before Season 1
When the idea of transmission came into existence, Nooroo came into existence as well. Before the Miraculouses were created, Nooroo and the other kwamis traveled all over the universe, unable to interact with humans, until thousands of years later, when an mage created the Miraculouses.
For the next 5,000 years, Nooroo had been dormant in the Butterfly Miraculous, stored in the Miracle Box at the temple of the Order of the Guardians, helping people all over the world with his powers, starting in China. He later spent time with an unknown female holder.
However, 172 years ago, Master Fu's mistake resulted not only in the destruction of the temple, but also in the loss of the Butterfly and the Peacock Miraculouses. At some point in recent times, Nathalie found Nooroo and the Butterfly Miraculous and gave them to Gabriel, who took them with him back to Paris.

title: Nooroo/History
text:
Nooroo/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)", Nooroo told Gabriel about the Miraculouses and the absolute power one can achieve when wielding the Ladybug Miraculous and the Cat Miraculous at the same time. Then, after Gabriel asked him, he explained how the Butterfly Miraculous worked. When Gabriel proclaimed that he would use its power to create supervillains instead of superheroes, Nooroo tried to tell him that the Miraculous was not meant to be used for evil purposes, but Gabriel refused to listen and told Nooroo that he was his master and that he must obey him. Nooroo sadly obliged and entered the Butterfly brooch.
Since then, Nooroo's powers have been used against his will for evil.

title: Nooroo/History
text:
Nooroo/History - [[Season 2]]
In "The Collector", after Hawk Moth created an akuma, he detransformed, revealing his secret identity. When Nooroo asked his master why the akuma was still in his lair, Gabriel explained that he had to throw Ladybug and Cat Noir off his trail. To Nooroo's surprise, Gabriel renounced him, albeit temporarily, and Nooroo returned to the Butterfly Miraculous. Later, after his plan worked, Gabriel released him and transformed into Hawk Moth once again.
While Gabriel entered his lair in "Gorizilla", Nooroo curiously questioned whether his master believed that Adrien was Cat Noir. After Gabriel explained his suspicions and plan, he transformed into Hawk Moth.
In "Syren", after witnessing Syren's defeat due to Ladybug and Cat Noir's new powers, Gabriel demanded that Nooroo tell him how he could acquire new powers for himself. However, Nooroo stated that kwamis did not know the recipes, which Gabriel deduced were inside the spellbook. Gabriel then asked if Nooroo could read the spellbook's code, but Nooroo insisted that only a Guardian could do so, leading Gabriel to declare that he needed to find the Guardian.

title: Nooroo/History
text:
Nooroo/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Sandboy", Nooroo tried to sneak away from Gabriel, but due to his wielder's commands, he could not. He attempted to explain that he wanted to go out for his birthday, but he was refused. When Gabriel sensed someone's negative emotions, they both went to the lair and transformed into Hawk Moth. In the midst of Sandboy's rampage, they both felt the presence of the other kwamis' connection, but after failing to track them down and following Sandboy's defeat, Nooroo was questioned by Gabriel about whether he liked his gift. His concern turned into fear when Gabriel expressed his desire to capture all of the kwamis.
In "Style Queen", Nooroo saw Gabriel talking to his wife, Emilie, about his next akumatized villain being his masterpiece, after which they transformed into Hawk Moth once again.
In "Queen Wasp", when Style Queen failed, Nooroo heard Gabriel renounce him, and he returned to the Butterfly Miraculous. However, he was released again when Gabriel realized he had a chance to akumatize someone using another Miraculous, which shocked Nooroo as Gabriel transformed into Hawk Moth. Later, after Queen Wasp's defeat, Nooroo overheard Gabriel speaking to his wife.

title: Nooroo/History
text:
Nooroo/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Catalyst", Nooroo helped Gabriel transform into Hawk Moth to initiate his ultimate plan. By using Volpina to instill doubt in Ladybug and akumatizing Nathalie into Catalyst to amplify his powers, they transformed into Scarlet Moth. After an army was assembled at the Eiffel Tower, Scarlet Moth made an appearance and, through the news feed, demanded that the heroes surrender, before challenging them to an all-out war.
In "Mayura", during the battle against the French Miraculous superhero team, Scarlet Moth turned the heroes' allies against Ladybug and Cat Noir. He was surprised to see all of Paris rise up against them. Despite attempting to akumatize the heroes, his cane was destroyed, and they detransformed back into Hawk Moth, losing the akumatized army. Although the villain managed to defeat the duo in combat, he was halted before finishing them off by Rena Rouge, Queen Bee, and Carapace. Backed into a corner, he received help from Mayura and escaped. At the base of the tower, they detransformed, and Nooroo later expressed worry about Gabriel after returning to the mansion.

title: Nooroo/History
text:
Nooroo/History - [[Miraculous Shanghai]]
He was seen traveling with Gabriel to find the Prodigious, but he was later vaporized by YanLuoShi. He was subsequently restored by the Miraculous Ladybug.

title: Nooroo/History
text:
Nooroo/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Backwarder", Nooroo was traveling with Gabriel and his son to attend a wedding in London. However, when Gabriel sensed Ms. Lenoir's negative emotions after devising an excuse to delay the train, they transformed into Hawk Moth and akumatized her into Backwarder.
In "Party Crasher", Nooroo, along with Gabriel, went down into their secret room, where they gathered more white butterflies. However, just as they were about to leave, Adrien's growing secrecy caused a power outage.
In "Stormy Weather 2", when Gabriel sensed familiar negative emotions, Nooroo suggested that it might have been Adrien trying to convince Gabriel to spend more time with him. Gabriel retorted that he was doing this so Adrien could be happy again, but Nooroo warned him about the danger of losing his son if he continued down this dark path and once again tried to convince Gabriel to use his powers for good. He was silenced by his master, and they transformed.

title: Nooroo/History
text:
Nooroo/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Timetagger", after Mr. Pigeon was defeated once again, Hawk Moth attempted to detransform but soon sensed the presence of another villain from the future named Timetagger. When the mastermind believed the Miraculous had finally been obtained, they were informed that the Hawk Moth who had akumatized Timetagger was not Gabriel. Once Timetagger was defeated, Nooroo and his master detransformed. Nooroo tried to speak but was silenced by Gabriel as they left the lair.
In "Reflekdoll", after the defeat of Reflekta and her sentimonster, Nooroo and Gabriel detransformed, followed by Nathalie and Duusu. Nooroo was taken aback by Duusu's enthusiasm and grew worried about her mental state.

title: Nooroo/History
text:
Nooroo/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Ladybug", they transformed into Hawk Moth once again, and by akumatizing Nathalie into Catalyst, they powered up into Scarlet Moth. This time, they sent a swarm of scarlet akumas to the school in an attempt to akumatize everyone. However, when Nathalie's condition worsened, the plan was called off and they detransformed. Some time later, Gabriel awoke and saw Nathalie transformed, asking Nooroo why he had not been awakened. Nooroo explained that he could not, as Gabriel had been sleeping peacefully, and they retransformed to save Mayura. Once back at the mansion, Nooroo heard Gabriel declare that Nathalie's time as Mayura was over.

title: Nooroo/History
text:
Nooroo/History - [[Miraculous New York]]
Nooroo was seen traveling with Gabriel during his trip to New York.

title: Nooroo/History
text:
Nooroo/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Truth", Nooroo watched as Gabriel repaired the damaged Peacock Miraculous and briefly reunited with Duusu. However, it was not long before they were both forced to transform Gabriel into a more powerful version of Hawk Moth, Shadow Moth.
In "Queen Banana", Nooroo, alongside Duusu, heard Gabriel's plan to akumatize Chloé, after which the two kwamis transformed him into Shadow Moth.
In "Glaciator 2", after sensing the sadness of his next potential victim, Shadow Moth prepared an akuma, but upon realizing that the emotions belonged to Adrien, he detransformed to see what was wrong. Some time later, Nooroo and Duusu retransformed Gabriel into Shadow Moth, allowing him to akumatize André into Glaciator once again.
In "Hack-San", upon hearing his master's desire to re-akumatize Markov into Robostus again, Nooroo retold Duusu the events of "Robostus", this time expressing hope that if Markov rebelled, they might be freed. However, after hearing that Gabriel had another idea to prevent the robot's rebellion, Nooroo and Duusu transformed their master into Shadow Moth.

title: Nooroo/History
text:
Nooroo/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Dearest Family", Nooroo and Duusu repeatedly transformed Gabriel into Shadow Moth in an attempt to create a more powerful version of an akuma. This plan succeeded, and Shadow Moth was able to create a megakuma capable of breaking through the magical charms barrier.
In "Ephemeral", Nooroo and Duusu transformed Gabriel into Shadow Moth after he discovered his son's identity. He then fused his powers with Duusu's and Plagg's, transforming into Shadow Noir to confront Marinette, who was also Ladybug.

title: Nooroo/History
text:
Nooroo/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Evolution", Nooroo was frightened after realizing that his fellow kwamis were being held captive by Gabriel.
In "Destruction", he was unable to reveal Ladybug's identity due to the Guardians' rules.
In "Miraculous Paris", he was seen alongside the other kwamis after escaping Ladybug's trap. He appeared throughout the episode and was later shown looking saddened with the others when Gabriel vowed to destroy every Ladybug and Cat Noir across existence, only to sigh in defeat, realizing the futility of his words.
In "Illusion", he was briefly seen before Gabriel transformed.
In "Elation", he was shown shortly before returning to the Miraculous.
In "Transmission", he appeared in a cameo.
In "Deflagration", he was shown in Gabriel's lair before the latter decided to use the other kwamis to steal Zoé and Alya's Miraculouses.
In "Intuition", he was seen alongside Gabriel in his lair.
In "Revelation", he was shown looking upset after Gabriel blamed Marinette and vowed to make her pay for ruining his plans.
In "Confrontation", he was seen after Gabriel vowed to take revenge on the children.
In "Action", he was shown shortly before Gabriel transformed.

title: Nooroo/History
text:
Nooroo/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Collusion", he appeared in a few scenes.
In "Revolution", Nooroo was asked by Gabriel why Ladybug and Cat Noir were able to unlock their adult powers while still being teenagers. Nooroo explained that they had mentally matured.
In "Representation", Nooroo was distressed, realizing that Gabriel had gone too far in his search for Adrien after deciding to pursue Marinette.
In "Conformation", he was last seen before returning to his Miraculous.
In "Re-creation", although not shown on-screen, Gabriel called out to Nooroo and ordered him to retrieve the Butterfly Miraculous after it fell into the water. However, Bug Noire stated that Marinette was still the Guardian and reclaimed the Miraculous from him. With Gabriel no longer being its holder, Nooroo would obey the next person to use it, chosen by the Guardian. By the end of the episode, the Butterfly Miraculous was stolen by Cerise Bianca, who planned to use Nooroo for evil purposes against Marinette.

title: Nooroo/History
text:
Nooroo/History - [[Miraculous London]]
In the cold open prologue, Nooroo was trapped inside a forcefield bubble by Cerise Bianca, who had somehow stolen the Butterfly Miraculous during the fight in the alternate timeline. Nooroo begged Cerise not to read the notebook, explaining that, like any other akumatized person, once she transformed back she would forget everything she saw, including what she had written. His pleas fell on deaf ears, as Cerise discovered that Ladybug was her former classmate, Marinette Dupain-Cheng, and then reakumatized herself into Spectral Looter before heading to Marinette's house. Believing everything was lost, Nooroo lamented that this was the end and succumbed to despair over the impending wish.

title: Nooroo/History
text:
Nooroo/History - [[Miraculous London]]
In the end, thanks to Marinette and Alix (as Bunnyx and Chronobug), events changed. Nooroo once again warned his holder not to read the notebook, but he was surprised and relieved when Cerise's journal was altered to state that Ladybug was his former owner, Gabriel Agreste. This enraged Cerise, as she knew Gabriel Agreste was dead and realized something had gone wrong with her plan, causing her to throw a furious tantrum. Nooroo briefly celebrated that Marinette's secret identity was safe, but the moment was short-lived. Cerise snapped her fingers, paralyzing him, and after calming down, she put on the Butterfly Miraculous and transformed. The last time Nooroo was seen, he was returning into the Miraculous as Cerise became the new villainous holder of the Butterfly Miraculous.

title: Nooroo/History
text:
Nooroo/History - [[Season 6]]
In "The Illustrhater", Nooroo was seen in the cold open, paralyzed on Cerise's table.
In "Daddycop", Nooroo asked Lila if everything she had done was really necessary, but she paralyzed him and scolded him for addressing her directly, having previously made it clear that he was not allowed to speak to her, referring to him simply as "kwami" instead of using his name..

title: Nora's room
text:
Nora's room - Intro
is the bedroom of Nora Césaire located in the Césaire apartment.

title: Nora's room
text:
Nora's room - Appearance
Nora's room has warm yellow tones. The light brown floor is mostly covered with a blue carpet with black edges, decorated with a blue star located in the middle. The walls are painted yellow, and the ceiling is white. Opposite the door there is a window covering the curtains of the sea color. Right against the wall there is a single bed made of light wood with a drawer at the bottom. Sea-colored bed linen. On the wall posters depicting films or those related to martial arts, as well as a map. On the right wall there is square-shaped furniture. There were lamps along the top row of cabinets, and right under them were two shelves on which Nora holds books, and a stand with two katanas. On the lower cabinet and on the wall, in the free space of furniture, there are various types of weapons, such as katanas, nunchucks or tonfa-type batons. In addition, the girl keeps a barbell and weights in the room. A punching bag is also suspended in front of the front door.

title: Nora's room
text:
Nora's room - Appearance
In "Risk", right at the front door, Nora has a ladder hanging on the wall on which she can train. There is also a low shelf next to it, which Nora decorates with a stand with three bokken of different sizes, from the largest to the smallest. There is also an oblong chest of red color on the floor, but it is not known what is inside it. To the right of the entrance door, on the wall, a beige-brown decoration, although it was not exactly shown how it looks and what it is.

title: Nora's room
text:
Nora's room - Trivia
The movie from the poster on the wall is later seen in "Ikari Gozen" in Le Sorbonne.
In "Anansi", here Nora was akumatized by Hawk Moth into the titular villain.
In "Sentibubbler", the titular sentimonster hid in the room to attack the members of Césaire family and Marinette to allow Shadow Moth to convince Alya to tell him everything about Ladybug.

was a Miraculous holder who is featured in the Grimoire for the Ox Miraculous. When Stompp inhabited the Ox Miraculous, they transformed into a ox-themed superhero.

title: Nooroo/Movie
text:
Nooroo/Movie - Intro
Nooroo is a major character of "Ladybug & Cat Noir: The Movie". She is the kwami who is connected to the Butterfly Miraculous. With her power, Nooroo's wearer can use the brooch to transform into a butterfly-themed supervillain.
Nooroo and her Miraculous were owned by Gabriel Agreste, who used it to transform into the supervillain Hawk Moth. Until after finally being reasoned with Ladybug and Cat Noir managed to retrieve the jewel returning it Master Fu.

title: Nooroo/Movie
text:
Nooroo/Movie - Appearance
Nooroo looks almost identical to her TV counterpart except that her wings are not a solid purple but with swirls and tear drops marks and she has eyes with purple irises and black pupils.

title: Nooroo/Movie
text:
Nooroo/Movie - Personality
Nooroo is knowledgeable and helpful, but less meek and more serious about Gabriel using her powers, warning him he would lose everything including his son. Knowing how serious she was it could imply that every time she gets a bad owner her visions always come true.

title: Nooroo/Movie
text:
Nooroo/Movie - Abilities
She has the same abilities as Tikki and Plagg such as flight, levitation, intangibility, super strength, controlling her miraculous and can change into a real butterfly. And like her siblings, she too can transform her owner into butterfly or moth themed superheroes or supervillains.
And yet, Nooroo's power could be implying is that she when inside her Miraculous she could sense the emotions of the person who touches it and then change it into a vision of the future based on them.

title: Nooroo/Movie
text:
Nooroo/Movie - Relationships
Gabriel Agreste/Hawk Moth
Despite her being compelled to give Gabriel the information he needed to find the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses, sensing his dark emotions, Nooroo was stern and serious with her warning. Even giving Gabriel a vision that if he didn't turn from his dark path, he would lose everything and upon seeing him collapsed on the ground as well as hearing the news angrily she huffed at her master saying she warned him. It's likely when Gabriel finally understood, Nooroo felt great joy and as a sign turned into a flurry of white butterflies to symbolize the hope that everything would be all right.
Adrien Agreste/Cat Noir
Despite not knowing Adrien too well, Nooroo knew that the former is Gabriel's son and cared for him to a degree sensing Gabriel's dark emotions, she did warn him through a vision that if he didn't turn from his dark path, he would lose everything including Adrien. Sadly, Nooroo watched Gabriel concoct his plan putting everyone in danger including him, yet she was equally happy that the people were protected by Ladybug and Cat Noir.

title: Nooroo/Movie
text:
Nooroo/Movie - Relationships
Unknown to her, was that Adrien was the hero in question her master was hunting, it wasn't until that Gabriel akumatized himself and dealt with the heroes personally that she found out her vision/warning had come true causing her master to discover thereby extension her that Adrien was Cat Noir. After detransforming she finally heard Gabriel explain everything to his son and upon hearing Adrien's forgiveness, Nooroo felt great joy and as a sign turned into a flurry of white butterflies to symbolize the hope that everything would be all right.

title: Nooroo/Movie
text:
Nooroo/Movie - History
Like the rest of her siblings when an unknown concept was created, Nooroo was born, then along came the Miraculous, for thousands of years Nooroo and his kind used their powers to work with people and to safeguard the world from evil.
But through unknown situations, Nooroo's power was revered as the most dangerous being separated and sealed away in a cave or catacomb.
Until one day, she was found by Gabriel, who demanded the kwami to give him the ultimate power to save his wife, but the kwami quietly retorted that she didn't have such power only her siblings of the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses did but could only be summoned in times of chaos.
Then, while still inside her jewel Nooroo was briefly given to a curator by Gabriel and upon his return for it, she gave the latter a vision of Paris in chaos, lightning and lava if he continued his path.

title: Nooroo/Movie
text:
Nooroo/Movie - History
But unfortunately back at the mansion, Nooroo's power was activated by the broken man transforming them into Hawk Moth and after her master's first villain was created and defeated, they detransformed watching the news she huffed angrily telling an consciousness Gabriel about her earlier warning and advised him to turn back before he lost everything.
Regretfully she watched Gabriel refuse and transform into Hawk Moth, through the song "Chaos Will Reign", she heard how her owner would use her power to sow chaos through Paris until he got the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses despite Nooroo still trying to convince him otherwise. As several months went by, Nooroo saw that Gabriel made good on his word sending countless villains but was equally happy that the people were protected by Ladybug and Cat Noir.

title: Nooroo/Movie
text:
Nooroo/Movie - History
And yet, near the end game, Nooroo felt Gabriel concoct his final plan transforming into Hawk Moth one last time and akumatized himself, she likely looked upon in sadness that what she envisioned had come true Paris being enveloped in fire and lightning. As well as Gabriel nearly losing everything, including his son especially during the final confrontation that she felt Gabriel use her powers and nearly killed Cat Noir which left her shocked when they both discovered the boy was the hero in question. With her master finally realizing it, they detransformed and now with Gabriel broken she listened to her former master explain everything to Adrien and once Gabriel has his son's forgiveness Nooroo felt great joy and as a sign turned into a flurry of white butterflies symbolizing the hope she felt that everything would be all right, then changed into her Miraculous returning along with Tikki to Ladybug and then from her to Master Fu.

title: Nooroo/Movie
text:
Nooroo/Movie - Trivia
Nooroo is the first known character from the movie who has a different voice actor from her TV series counterpart in the English dub, while Vincent is the second.
Unlike her TV series counterpart, who has a falsetto masculine voice, this version of Nooroo is given a feminine voice.

title: Noe
text:
Noe - Intro
"" is a season 6 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 16th written and produced episode of season 6. It is also the 147th written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Noe
text:
Noe - Synopsis
Marinette is delighted. For some time now, everything seems to be going well in Paris. What if it was time to relax and enjoy the joy of being with Adrien and his friends? But she learns from Mylène that a film is being prepared whose screenplay discredits Ladybug and Cat Noir. And this film could well change everything if, for Parisians, this story woven of lies took on the face of truth.
Disney Channel
A film is being developed, with a script that discredits Ladybug and Cat Noir. If the people of Paris came to see this web of lies as the truth, this film could change everything.
Disney+
Ladybug tries to get a tight-lipped villain to talk.

title: Noe
text:
Noe - Plot
The very first scene shows Marinette Dupain-Cheng's classmates and others enjoying themselves on the beach: playing, running, and relaxing. Ice cream man André is also visible in the background. Marinette herself, along with Adrien, is lying on the same beach. Marinette mentions that sometimes, there are days when everything is perfect, like this one. Adrien, however, says that every day with Marinette fits that description.
Suddenly, Adrien receives a message from Nathalie, informing him that someone wants to discuss his father's inheritance with him. Marinette supports him and expresses her sympathy for Adrien's heavy workload. As he leaves, Adrien buys Marinette an ice cream. When Tikki asks if Marinette is okay, she replies that she is. She also mentions that she hid from Adrien the fact that his father was a villain. She also mentions that Paris became calm after she gave away all the Miraculouses. She believes she did the right thing.

title: Noe
text:
Noe - Plot
Suddenly, a video appears, presumably created by Mylène Haprèle. It's about Paris flourishing after Caline Bustier became mayor. The video mentions: producing local food; free public transportation; and people's desire to better understand the world. It also mentions that Miss Bustier created a children's council, and everyone has the right to speak. Mylène advises the world to emulate the feats of Paris.
The next frame is the Kingdom's reaction to the video. It has already garnered billions of views, which they claim is "dangerous" for their business, most likely their Perfect World Project. The Scepter decrees that it is time to regain control. It's still unclear how they plan to do this as they sign off to consider their options.

title: Noe
text:
Noe - Plot
Afterward, Fred, Mylène's father, is shown entertaining children with his mime skills. Among the "kids" are also several of Marinette's classmates (perhaps they simply came along with Mylène). After the street performance ends, Sarah approaches Fred and offers him a role in a secret film. She says this role will boost his career in a positive way. Fred mentions that he's no longer chasing fame and is devoting more time to his family, but after Mylène tells him she's old enough to take care of herself, he finally agrees. It turns out that Marinette has been asked to babysit Manon that day. While seeing Adrien off, Manon thinks he'll be his nanny too, and they'll play daughter (Manon), mother (Marinette), and father (Adrien). But just a few seconds later, Adrien leaves for his house. Adrien also promises Marinette he'll call her if he needs her.

title: Noe
text:
Noe - Plot
At Marinette's house, she and Manon are playing a game: one person says what they do, and the other guesses who it is. But Manon is irritated by Marinette constantly looking at her phone, waiting for a message or call from Adrien. Suddenly, Marinette receives a call from Nadja Chamack, who says she'll be back later than usual. Meanwhile, Noé Luxus, the CEO of Luxus Corp., arrives at the Agreste mansion to discuss the future of the Agreste brand with Gabriel's heir, Adrien. He offers to add the Gabriel brand to his ever-growing group of enterprises under the Luxus Corp. label and make him its centerpiece. He also mentions that Adrien's father was his "role model". He suggests Adrien sell his brand, as Noé was willing to take responsibility for his legacy. Adrien asks Nathalie what she thinks of this. She believes it's an opportunity worth pursuing, but secretly glares with suspicion at Noé.

title: Noe
text:
Noe - Plot
At the same time, Mylène appears, worried about her father, who left for an "interview" and never returned, even though it was late. Mullo tries to reassure her. Suddenly, her father comes home, saying, "This is a disaster..." Mylène begins to get nervous and afraid, but a few seconds later, she realizes her father was just playing a prank on her with a sad face. He said it was a disaster, because he'd have to memorize the script, which meant he had the part, and he'd passed the interview. He'd even already signed the contract. Mylène mentions that if her mother was still there, she'd be proud of her husband and how he cared for Mylène. Judging by the emotion with which they remember her, she was a good person. Suddenly, Marinette gets a call from Adrien. He asks if he can come over to her house, to which she agrees.

title: Noe
text:
Noe - Plot
Fred plays the role of a journalist fighting for the truth. After reading the script, Mylène is furious: the film is about the Monarch, Ladybug, and Cat Noir all working together, essentially vilifying Ladybug and Cat Noir as being in league with Monarch, rather than against him. Furthermore, it mentions that it's "based on a true story." The screenwriter, in fact, is also unknown. Fred refuses to take the role, but Sarah says the contract is already signed, and he can't escape. But then, Mylène hatches a plan. Meanwhile, Marinette advises Adrien not to rush into selling his brand. Manon, continuing to play the game, asks, "Which hero defeated the Monarch?", which upsets Adrien again. Suddenly, Mylène calls. Asking if Manon has been picked up yet, she also says that she needs to come see them.

title: Noe
text:
Noe - Plot
When the entire team is assembled: Marinette, Adrien, Nadja Chamack, Manon, Mylène, and Fred, the latter two begin to explain the plot of the film. Marinette and Adrien say that "if" they were Ladybug and Cat Noir, they would be outraged at being portrayed as villains and not heroes. Arriving at the TVi studio, Arlette introduces Nadja to their new stockholder: Noé Luxus. Nadja immediately recognizes Noé as someone he's not.
Having gotten excited, expecting the bitter truth about the film to be revealed on TVi, they are disappointed to discover Nadja was not on the show, replaced by Mr.
Banana as the anchorperson, who proclaims himself the new host.
Presumably, Nadja was fired after explaining what she wants to do.
Suddenly, Nadja comes to Mylène's house and confirms that it is true and she was terminated from TVi, presumably by Noé since he was their stockholder now and thus their boss.
Meanwhile, Mr.
Banana is saying complete nonsense on TV, claiming that Miss Bustier deceived everyone to become mayor, taking her words out of context.
He also introduces Noé, describing him as a new luxury star in love with Paris.
He pledges to run for mayor of Paris to unseat Miss Bustier.

title: Noe
text:
Noe - Plot
Adrien mentions that he's the one who wants to buy out his father's brand.
He also owns the company producing the film.
Everything falls into place.
Mylène is extremely upset that she can't do anything about it and has a meltdown, fearing all their efforts with Mayoress Bustier to make Paris more eco-friendly are about to be undone.
Mylène runs into her room and locks it.
Mullo tries to calm her down, but is unsuccessful.
Mylène is possessed by an Ultrakuma, but after a few words from Chrysalis, she rejects it, saying, "No!
I'll never listen to you!
Go!
Leave me alone!" Fred, thinking she was talking to him, becomes even more upset.
Furious at what Noé has done, he goes to "speak kind words" to Noé.
Along the way, out of extreme anger, he is possessed by an Ultrakuma, transforming once more into The Mime, a supervillain who can create invisible objects for him to use personally.

title: Noe
text:
Noe - Plot
Marinette notices the Ultrakuma flying after Fred. Realizing the danger, she runs, ostensibly to calm him down, but in reality, to transform. Adrien does the same when he sees Mime appear. She also mentioned that she hates lying to Adrien. Mime initially tries to refuse Chrysalis's power, but eventually agrees. Mime heads to the television studio, where Noé is presumably located. Seeing her father akumatized, Mylène hides under a table, unable to calm down.
Ladybug and Cat Noir intercept Mime, but he still reaches his destination. Mime is surrounded by Noé's bodyguards and security guards, wasting his time while Noé escapes in a black car sporting his company logo, along with several decoys to throw Mime off his trail. Seeing this, Mime begins chasing and destroying the decoys as he tries to find the authentic one that Noé is in. The heroes realize that the Ultrakuma is in his hat, and Mime also realizes that they have figured out where it is, so he hid his hat in an invisible safe under the bridge, so they would never find it. Chrysalis praises him for his choice and sends him after Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous.

title: Noe
text:
Noe - Plot
The heroes realize they can't de-akumatize him without the hat, so they need to push him into doing it themselves. To do this, they want to find the one Mime is looking for first. Ladybug summons Polymouse and Minotaurox. Mylène doesn't want to transform, but Mullo persuades her. Ivan also hesitated to transform due to his concern for Mylène, but once she reassures him she'll be alright, he goes to the bathroom and has Stompp transform him into Minotaurox. The heroes capture Mime thanks to Minotaurox's Resistance, Cat Noir's Cataclysm, and Ladybug's Lucky Charm. Ladybug asks Polymouse to find a car with a certain logo, but she doesn't know which one. Polymouse multiplied and found it quickly enough.

title: Noe
text:
Noe - Plot
After bringing them both to the TVi tower, Noé is only disappointed in Ladybug, pointing out that she captured him, thus validating why he envisioned her and Cat Noir as villains in the film script. They force Noé to apologize to Mime. Realizing that both sides hated each other, Ladybug told Polymouse to multiply and approach Mime unnoticed, so he would hear his daughter's voice but not see her, and so no one would know Polymouse was Mylène. Whispering in Mime's ear, he feels incredibly sorry for his daughter and refuses to be akumatized, reverting back into Fred while the Ultrakuma is released from his hat where he left it and is purified as it flitters away. Noé apologizes to Fred, saying he was also "tricked" with this scenario. Ladybug then uses her Miraculous Ladybug to puts everything back in order.

title: Noe
text:
Noe - Plot
It is revealed that Nadja Chamack is now on Zoo (presumably a "youth" messenger) and has arranged an interview with Miss Bustier there, where it is proven that she was elected into office fair and square and there was no evidence of foul play regarding it. Sarah apologizes to Fred for dragging him into this. Marinette expresses concern about Noé Luxus, and has a sixth sense that she needs to be wary of him, as do the rest of the Miraculers. In the end, it turns out that Noé is another one of Audrey Bourgeois' kids, and he says, "It's done, Mother. Now everyone in Paris knows who I am. The next phase can begin." Audrey commends him on his efforts, calling him, "My diamond dear", before smirking wickedly at having begun her plan for revenge against Paris for the events back in "Revolution" and carrying out the will of The Kingdom.

title: Noe
text:
Noe - Plot Developments
The Kingdom takes action after they witness how mayoress Caline Bustier is changing Paris in ways they don't approve, with those changes being a threat for their respective businesses, sending their newest member, Noé Luxus, the new Diamond and Gabriel's successor, to regain control of the situation.
Noé approves a script for a movie meant to defame Ladybug and Cat Noir and have Parisians believe they are supervillains that have allied themselves with Monarch to make Paris worship them as heroes and that Gabriel Agreste was a martyr trying to stop their plans.
Noé also tries to buy the Gabriel brand from Adrien and becomes a stockholder for TVi, using it to spread rumors about Caline Bustier fixing the elections to turn the Parisians against her and promote himself.
He pulled the same move as his sister Chloé did in "Collusion", making the heroes look like bad guys when they really weren't.
It's revealed that his actions were meant mainly to promote himself as the new King of Luxury to the public and that the one to help him do it was Audrey Bourgeois, who is revealed as not only part of the Kingdom, but also his mother.

title: Noe
text:
Noe - Plot Developments
Audrey being part of the Kingdom has been hinted back in "Feast", where she is shown watching the news about the appearance of the temple of the Order of the Guardians.
Since The Kingdom knows that Gabriel was the holder of the Butterfly Miraculous, it is likely Audrey, including Noé, are aware about Gabriel's identity as Hawk Moth/Monarch.
More about the changes brought to Paris by Caline Bustier are shown in this episode.
Public vegetable gardens were created to allow people to grow their own food.
Public transportation has become completely free of charge.
Young people got better access to information so they can understand the world better.
A youth council was created to give voice to young citizens of Paris and allow them to participate in the government of the city.
More about Mylène and her father Fred is revealed:
Mylène has become the face of the youth of Paris, promoting the changes done by Caline Bustier in Paris.
Fred used to go away from home on occasion due to his job as actor, however, after his wife left him and Mylène, he put his career on hold and only accepted minor acting jobs in order to raise his daughter.

title: Noe
text:
Noe - Plot Developments
Despite Mylène's mother leaving her and her dad, they seem to still have a good relationship, shown by how Mylène expressed that she would be happy for Fred for advancing his career.
It's revealed that Audrey Bourgeois had a son before marrying André called Noé Luxus, making the latter Chloé and Zoé's older half-brother.
This is the second episode to reveal a secret child from Audrey, with the first being "Sole Crusher".
Nadja Chamack is fired from TVi after she tried to expose the defamatory nature of the movie approved by Noé Luxus, who had become a new stockholder to the network, towards Ladybug and Cat Noir, being replaced by Mr. Banana as the new anchorperson.
Nadja later starts a new show on Zoo.
Even though Noé claims that he too was deceived by the movie script, Marinette is not convinced that he was telling the truth and decides to be more cautious.

title: Noe
text:
Noe - Trivia
There are multiple interesting aspects to the episode's name:
It is tied with the Miraculous Secrets webisode "Max" for having the shortest titles in the franchise, with three letters each.
The French given name Noé is usually written with an acute accent, similarly to Chloé and Zoé, but both the English and French title are without one.
This is unlike "Félix" which does have the correct accent in both versions.
It is the first episode to be titled after someone that is not an akumatized villain, a sentimonster or a miraculous holder (with the exception of the entire fifth season, whose episodes are titled after concepts).
Despite not being named after an akumatized villain or sentimonster, it is still titled after the real villain of the episode, who is connected to the Miraculers' other silent enemy, The Kingdom.
Prior to this episode, two episodes were seemingly named after civilians ("Félix" and "Gabriel Agreste"), before the titular characters were revealed to be sentimonsters.
Months before the premiere of the English dub, clips of it were included in a YouTube Short released by the official Miraculous Ladybug channel on December 11th and 14th, 2025.

title: Noe
text:
Noe - Trivia
Mylène becomes one of the few people to reject an akuma before being akumatized and the second to reject an ultrakuma, following Sabrina in "Daddycop".
The way she was almost akumatized mirrors the same way Sabrina's almost akumatization, as both girls were targeted by Chrysalis after they found themselves in a very vulnerable state, but quickly rejected the ultrakuma, only for their respective father to be akumatized in their place due to their respective daughter being distressed.
Mylène breaks Sabrina's record for the fastest akuma rejection. Sabrina's record was nine seconds while the former is at less than eight seconds.
Arlette, Nadja Chamack's boss, has a new model with a unique design. During her previous appearance in "Prime Queen", she had the same model as Clara Contard.

title: Noe
text:
Noe - Trivia
The script that portrays Ladybug and Cat Noir as allies helping Hawk Moth ironically mirrors Shadybug and Claw Noir when they initially teamed up with Monarch in "Miraculous Paris". Also, the journalist and Gabriel Agreste being portrayed as heroes, even though everyone believes Gabriel was a hero in his universe, it actually mirrors Gabriel Agreste from the Re-Verse where he helps people as Betterfly and the journalist likely references Alya in the same universe as she aids Betterfly in stopping Shadybug and Claw Noir.
Considering the script is clearly false, it also references how no one, except Marinette, Adrien, Tikki, Plagg, Gabriel, Alya, knows about the events that happened.
References
The way Ladybug used the Lucky Charm is similar to "Rogercop", binding both villains' hands so they couldn't use their powers.
Errors
There are multiple errors in Polymouse's transformation sequence:
Even though her arms are already transformed, when the shot moves up to transform her legs and head, she still has her scrunchie around her wrist.
Sometimes the miraculous clips through her neck.
Her shirt clips through her back as the shot moves towards her face when she gets the mask.

title: Noe
text:
Noe - Trivia
As she is preparing to pull her hood up, the miraculous appears to be split into two pieces.
When she jumps around with the skip rope in the air, her eyes are miscolored blue.
When Polymouse throws Noé on the ground at the TV studio, the rings on her jump rope are somewhat deformed, looking differently that they usually do.
When Marinette and the others are getting ready to watch TV, Mylène's hair is colored black in the reflection in the mirror.
In the same mirror, when Adrien realizes Noé is the same person who wanted to buy his father's brand, his hair turns brunette, Nadja's looks a lighter shade of red and Marinette's looks black despite looking blue on screen.
When Adrien calls Marinette while she's with Manon, the portrait in the background is different from the one in the other scenes.
When Ladybug looks sternly at Noé and tells him they only serve the truth, her forehead clips slightly through her mask.
The tree that the Mime cuts down is normal again in the next scene.

title: Noe/Transcript
text:
Noe/Transcript - Intro
(Mylène and Ivan are playing Chicken Fight with Rose and Juleka in the water. André gives an ice cream to a child while some people go to the water.)
(Marinette and Adrien are lying on a blanket sunbathing side by side under some palm trees.)
Marinette: Some days, everything's just perfect.
Adrien: That's what I call a day spent with you.
(Marinette hums, closes her eyes and the two get comfortable, but the moment is interrupted by Adrien's phone receiving a notification.)
Adrien: Hm?
(Adrien sits up and picks up his phone.)
Marinette: (Sits up) Something wrong?
Adrien: It's from Nathalie. Someone wants to meet with me to talk about my father's legacy.
Marinette: Oh, here I am talking about how great everything is when you're dealing with so much, I'm so sorry.
Adrien: (Shakes his head smiling) Don't worry about it, Marinette. I get sad when I think about my parents no longer being here obviously, but I'm also ready to move on. (Kisses Marinette's cheek) And I'm here for you. Hey! How about some ice cream to make this perfect day even more perfect?

title: Noe/Transcript
text:
Noe/Transcript - Intro
(Adrien stands up from the blanket and goes to get ice cream.)(Marinette smiles as she watches Adrien go, but after a while her mood plummets.)Marinette: Ugh.
Tikki: (From Marinette's purse) Is there something wrong Marinette?
Marinette: No, no, everything's great, actually. Sure, I lied to Adrien by not telling him that his father was a supervillian, but it was only to protect him, and since I've handed out every Miraculous, Paris has never been quieter. (Looks up)'' So maybe I'm actually doing something... right?
[ Theme Song ]
(A logo of a green heart with white silhouettes of the Eiffel Tower appears, thus beginning a documentary video.)
(In the video, Mylène waves at the school garden that's on the roof of the building.)
(Mylène picks up a lettuce and shows it to the camera.)
Mylène: Now anyone can grow their own food in Paris!
(Nino and Ivan work with the pumpkins in the background.)
(Scene Change. A bus station)
(The bus arrives to the station, Max and Mylène enter the bus.)
Mylène: (As she enters the bus) All public transport in Paris is free of charge!
[Scene change. A school sitting area.]

title: Noe/Transcript
text:
Noe/Transcript - Intro
(Mylène talks to the camera while her friends are sitting down, up to their usual activities.)
Mylène: People want to understand how the world works.
Mylène: Since she became mayor, Ms. Bustier has established a youth council. Now everyone in Paris has a voice!
(Alya, Marc, and Diane come up behind her to wave to the camera.)
[Scene Change. A green background that fades into the front of City Hall, with all of Mylène's friends in front of the building.]
Mylène: What we've done here in Paris can be done anywhere in the world, just don't give up, and remember to cultivate joy. It's joy that gives us the energy to fight.
(The group cheers.)
(The logo appears again and the documentary ends.)
The Scepter: How many views did it get?
The Truth: Several billions.
The Stomach: This is dangerous for our business.
The Beyond: It's worse than dangerous. It's out of control.
The Scepter: Then it's up to us to regain control.
(All the members of The Kingdom disconnect to prepare their wicked plan.)

title: Noe/Transcript
text:
Noe/Transcript - Intro
(Fred performs several tricks and the audience laughs and applauds him. Sarah watches the show from the side.)(The show ends and Fred is packing up his equipment. Adrien, Marinette and Manon come to see him.)Marinette: Congratulations, Mr. Haprèle.
Adrien: Yes, it was really amazing.(Mylène puts her arms around her father.)Sarah: (Applauding) Fred, my man. (Everyone looks at her) it's been a minute.
Fred: What are you doing here?
Sarah: Does your favorite agent need an excuse to visit her future superstar? Listen, Fred, your acting career is finally about to explode. I've just seen THE role for you.
Fred: I don't think so, I'm done chasing after the big time. I'd rather have smaller roles, (Puts his hand on Mylène's shoulder) and still be here to take care of my family.
Mylène: (Smiles) Dad! I'm old enough to manage on my own. Besides, if being in the movies makes you happy, then it makes me happy too!
Fred: Guess there's no harm in auditioning. What film is it?
Sarah: That's top-secret information, but there's one thing I know. It could be for the role of a lifetime.
Mylène: (Looks at Fred excited) Ah!
Fred: (Smiles)'' Huh.

title: Noe/Transcript
text:
Noe/Transcript - Intro
Manon: (To Adrien) Are you babysitting me too tonight? We could play House! You'd be the daddy, and Marinette would be the mo-!
(Marinette suddenly covers Manon's mouth with both hands to interrupt her.)
Marinette: (Nervously) Okay, yes, yeah yeah! I think we get the idea!
(Adrien kneels down to Manon's height.)
Adrien: I'd be happy to another time, Manon. But right now I have an important meeting. (Nathalie and Placide I.T. are waiting in the car to take Adrien to the meeting) Not very fun grown-up stuff.
(Manon pouts while Marinette places her hands on Manon's shoulders and looks at Adrien.)
Marinette: Call me if you need me, okay? Promise?
Adrien: I promise.
(Adrien gets into the car and drives away.)
Manon: Being a grown-up doesn't sound fun at all.
Marinette: (Grabs a card) Next question Ms. Manon. Who is the anchor on the news channel?
(Marinette puts a toy microphone close to Manon.)
Manon: Easy, it's Mommy!
(Marinette nods and Manon giggles. Manon grabs a card and Marinette gives her the microphone.)

title: Noe/Transcript
text:
Noe/Transcript - Intro
Manon: Who is the... (Marinette looks at her phone) most famous... (Marinette gets anxious) fashion... (Marinette grabs her phone and opens it to check and start updating her chat with Adrien) designer in Paris. (Manon realizes that Marinette isn't listening to her and gets angry) Hey! You're not even listening!
Marinette: (Drops her phone and sits up straight) Uh, yes, I am! (Nervous laugh) You asked who the most famous fashion designer in Paris is!
(Manon faces away from her and crosses her arms.)
Manon: You keep checking your phone while we're playing.
Marinette: (Looks down) Sorry, Manon. It's because I'm worried about Adrien. (Marinette's phone receives a call, so she quickly picks it up and rushes to answer without even checking the contact) Adrien, is everything okay?! (Calms down) Oh, um, hi Nadja.
Nadja: I'm sorry, Marinette. We're running a bit late.
Marinette: Yes, I understand. Don't worry. I don't mind. (Closes the call) That was your mommy. She'll be coming to get you a little later than expected, but that means more time for us to play, right? (Shows Manon a hand of cards).
Manon: (Excited) Yeah! And I get to have the same bedtime as grown-ups!

title: Noe/Transcript
text:
Noe/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: See? There are some fun things about being a grown-up.
Fred: Hello, Fred Haprèle.
(Video of the Gabriel logo joining a map of several brand logos.)
Noé: As you can see, the Agreste brand would be joining our group. It would be the jewel at our core. Dear Adrien, your father was my role model. His demise has devastated me. (Opens a briefcase) So I can only imagine your grief, (Adrien looks down) but I know how much the fashion world weighed on you. (Noé shows Adrien a contract) If you did me the honor of selling me the brand, I would make it my utmost duty to assume responsibility for his legacy.
Adrien: (Grabs the contract) Thank you. What do you think, Nathalie?
(Adrien gives the contract to Nathalie.)
Nathalie: Hm, I think this is... (Glares at a smiling Noé) an opportunity that deserves some thought. (Gives the contract back to Adrien and continues glaring at Noé).
Mullo: Uh, why are you walking around in circles?
Mylène: (Walking in circles) Dad is still not home!
Mullo: (Sitting on a glass) So, walking around in circles is good for...?
Mylène: Nothing! (Suddenly screams, surprising Mullo)
Mullo: (Falls inside the glass) Eeek!

title: Noe/Transcript
text:
Noe/Transcript - Intro
Mylène: But dinner is cooked and on the table, (Returns to walking in circles) and since I don't know what else to do, I'm thinking, and thinking gets me worried, and worrying makes me scared, so I need to do something, so I don't realize that I'm scared, but I can't come up with anything, so I'm walking around in circles. (Someone enters through the door) Dad?
(Mylène smiles and goes to see her father, while Mullo hides, but when she reaches the door, she looks at him worriedly because Fred has his forehead against the door with a defeated look on his face.)
Fred: It's a disaster! A complete disaster... See? (Mylène puts her hands over her mouth in distress)
Because... (Fred suddenly changes his mood to a cheerful one and shows Mylène the movie's script) I'm going to have to read this huge script!
Mylène: Whoa! So that means you got the part?

title: Noe/Transcript
text:
Noe/Transcript - Intro
Fred: I already signed the contract. Can you believe it? (Mylène happily laughs as she gives Fred a hug) Jean informed me that it's a common practice with these kinds of projects. (Mylène and Fred enter the kitchen and sit down on the table) They're so scared of people leaking the story, (Mylène takes the plates with the dinner and puts them in the microwave) so no contract means no script. I wish I could have talked it over with you first, as this affects the whole of our family, but...
Mylène: (Takes the plates out of the microwave) Don't worry, I'm so happy that you're happy. I'm just... (Puts the now hot food on the table) Sorry you had to pause your career for so long to take care of me.
Fred: (Smiles) No role can compare to the precious moments you and I have shared. (Looks down) I just wish I could have figured it out earlier. I'll never make up for the time I spent away from you and your mother when you were little.
Mylène: If Mom were still here, she'd be proud of you, for the role and for being a super dad.
Fred: (Smiles) Hm. Sometimes I feel like she's right here with us. Don't you?
Mylène: (Nods) Mhm.
Manon: Which superhero holds the Miraculous of Illusion?

title: Noe/Transcript
text:
Noe/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (Puts her fingers on her chin) Hm...
(Marinette's phone rings, catching her attention. Seeing that it's Adrien calling, she reaches for it, but Manon quickly stops her by grabbing it first.)
Manon: (Keeping the phone away from Marinette) First, answer the question.
Marinette: Rena Rouge! It's Rena Rouge!
Manon: Correct! (Lets Marinette grab her phone)
Marinette: Adrien! How'd it go?

(Adrien pulls his phone away from his ear due to Manon's sudden scream.)

title: Noe/Transcript
text:
Noe/Transcript - Intro
(Timelapse of Mylène and Fred reading the script. As time passes, it becomes clear that they don't like it, with Mylène even covering her face with a pillow at one point.)
Mylène: Argh! (Slams the script on the table angrily) This is horrible! It can't be based on real-life events!
Fred: Don't worry sweetie. There must be some mistake.
(Time skip to Fred on a video call with Sarah)
Fred: I was told this was an inspiring superhero story, but this? (Lifts the script) This is nonsense. We can't tell these lies to the audience!

title: Noe/Transcript
text:

Adrien: On one hand, I'd be relieved to move on, but on the other, a little voice is whispering to me that this is all going too fast.
