(The phone keeps ringing as Marinette thinks about the question.)
Adrien: It was my father, Gabriel Agreste.
Manon: Correct, hehe!
(Marinette lifts Manon, and Adrien grabs Marinette's phone from under her and together respond to the call.)
Mylène: (Distressed) Marinette, did Nadja Chamack pick up Manon already?
Marinette: No, not yet.
Mylène: I have something important to show Nadja. Can I come over?

title: Noe/Transcript
text:
Noe/Transcript - Intro
(Adrien and Marinette look at each other in confusion.)
(After a timeskip, Nadja, Fred and Mylène arrive to Marinette's room. Adrien, Marinette and Nadja with Manon in her lap sit together to hear what Fred and Mylène have to tell them.)
Manon: (Applauds) I love movies!
(Fred and Mylène look at each other and nod, then start reading aloud the script. The background illustrates what's happening as they read.)
Fred: Outside, alley way, night. The Journalist is hiding. All he can see are Ladybug, Cat Noir and Hawk Moth's giant shadows dancing on the walls. Ladybug says...
Mylène: "Thanks to your fearmongering, Hawk Moth, the Parisians have put their trust in Cat Noir and me."
Fred: "My pleasure! When people are scared, it's easier to manipulate them!"
(Adrien and Marinette frown hearing this, Manon gets scared.)
Manon: But mommy, aren't Cat Noir and Ladybug the good guys?
Nadja: They are, sweetheart. Don't worry, it's just a made-up story.
Marinette: (Frowning) Who wrote that script?
Mylène: We don't know, and everything's like this. (Turns to another page) Inside Gabriel Agreste's study. Night. The Journalist tells Gabriel Agreste...

title: Noe/Transcript
text:
Noe/Transcript - Intro
Fred: "No one will believe me if I say that Ladybug and Cat Noir are Hawk Moth's allies! This is why I need a powerful ally, someone whose word is respected by all, you Mr. Agreste!"
Mylène: Gabriel Agreste replies...
Fred: "I will support you. You can count on me."
Mylène: (Turns the page) Now the worst one... Ladybug and Cat Noir walk over to the Journalist, cornered against a wall. Next to them, we see ash statues of Gabriel Agreste and Hawk Moth. Ladybug threatens the Journalist... "The world will never know the truth, because there will be no one to tell it!"
Fred: "I'll never be silenced!"
Mylène: "Cat Noir, you're up."
Fred: Cat Noir calls up his Cataclysm and puts his hand on the ground, which opens up under The Journalist's feet swallowing him up!
(Manon hugs Nadja scared of the story, Adrien and Marinette just get more upset)
Fred: Luckily, the brave journalist has already sent his article to the film director, who turned it into a movie, the movie you've just seen.
Marinette: (Angry) If I were Ladybug, I'd be outraged.
Adrien: (Angry) If I were Cat Noir, I'd want to Cataclysm that script.
Nadja: No one will believe it's the truth. (to Manon) Honey, it's just a movie.

title: Noe/Transcript
text:
Noe/Transcript - Intro
Mylène: It's not just a movie, it's a lie disguised as the truth, and that's very dangerous!
Marinette: Nadja, people should know! They should lobby to prevent this shameful film from ever happening! Could you report about it in your program?
Nadja: You're right!
Nadja: Arlette! I have a huge scoop for tonight's news!
Arlette: (Sighs) Yeah, Yeah, great Nadja. Let me introduce our newest stockholder, Noé Luxus.
(The chair at the end of the table spins around, revealing Noé.)
Noé: I can't wait to hear about your scoop, Ms. Chamack.
(Nadja looks angry.)
(Mylène, Ivan, Marinette, Adrien and Manon are all sitting around the TV. Fred gives Manon popcorn and sits down with them.)
Manon: It's time for mommy's show!
(The TVI intro starts up, only to reveal Mr. Banana as the news anchor.)
Mr. Banana: Hey there, friends of fruits! I'm your new anchorman (Mylène and Ivan look shocked) and believe me I only serve 'appealing' news! (giggles)
Nadja: He's anything but an anchorman.
(Everyone is shocked to see her in the room)
Marinette: Why are you here Nadja?
Nadja: They fired me. (Marinette covers her mouth)
Mylène: You mean they refused to listen to you!

title: Noe/Transcript
text:
Noe/Transcript - Intro
Mr. Banana: Ms. Bustier is suspected of having cheated on the latest local elections. Oh my, oh my! Some fruit is rotten in Paris!
Ms. Bustier: (In the news program) That's not true! The elections were held with total transparency!
Mr. Banana: Here to comment on this segment is Noé Luxus, new star of luxury business, and a great lover of Paris! Mr. Luxus, you're cool as a cucumber for showing up tonight. What are your thoughts on this news?
Noé: I am devastated. Ms. Bustier was the embodiment of so much hope. If this accusation turns out to be true, I commit to running for mayor of Paris so its people can regain faith for the future.
Mr. Banana: Finally, some peachy news!
Adrien: That's the man who wants to buy my father's brand! (Picks up the script from the table in front of him and notices the same L Corp logo.) Looks like he also owns the company that's producing this movie.
Marinette: So, he's responsible for that script full of lies. (Mylène starts to shake and hyperventilate.)''
Ivan: (Gasps) Are you okay?

title: Noe/Transcript
text:
Noe/Transcript - Intro
Mylène: It's like everything we built together is collapsing! Like an ultra-powerful force is taking control over everything again, and there's nothing we can do about it! There's nothing I can do about it! (Runs to her room)
Ivan: Mylène!
Marinette: Wait! I'm sure we can come up with a solution!
Fred: (Knocks on her bedroom door.) Sweetie, it's me. You don't have to bear the weight of this alone. I'm here. We're all with you.
Mullo: You're feeling powerless, but surely there's something you can do if you can just calm down first. Breathe in (inhales) and out (exhales).
Mylène: I can't do it, Mullo. That enemy is just too strong. Too strong for me!
''(An Ultrakuma flies in and enters Mylène's ladybug pin).
Chrysalis: Hello. Forgive my intrusion but your anguish was so deep that it called out to me.
Mylène: No! I'll never listen to you! (Breaks out of the akumatization) Go, leave me alone!
Fred: I'm going to talk to that guy Noé Luxus. (Puts on his hat) No one chases hope out of my little girl's heart.
(Marinette gasps and runs out to the balcony to watch Fred walk away. She then sees an Ultrakuma flying towards him!
Marinette: (Gasps) I'll go with him! He might need help!

title: Noe/Transcript
text:
Noe/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: I'm coming with you! (They both run down the stairs but then Marinette pretends to get a cramp in her ankle and fall down. Adrien kneels beside her.)Marinette: Ow!
Adrien: Are you okay, Marinette?
Marinette: I'll be fine. Go on Adrien, catch up with Fred. That's what's most important right now. (Adrien nods and runs off. Marinette stands up and Tikki comes out of hiding.)''
Marinette: Ugh, I hate lying to Adrien! Tikki, spots on! (Transforms into Ladybug)
(An Ultrakuma flies up and enters Fred's hat.)
Chrysalis: Hello. Forgive my intrusion but your anger was so fierce that it called out to me.
(Fred slaps a Chrysalis figure in front of him away, making it disappear.)
Fred: I don't need you! I just want to talk to Noé Luxus and get him to see that he's wrong. What would my daughter think of me if I gave into anger!?
Chrysalis: What would your daughter think if you were unsuccessful?
Fred: He'll listen to me. I'll find the right words.

title: Noe/Transcript
text:
Noe/Transcript - Intro
Chrysalis: It's commendable of you to want to talk things out, but you know as well as I do that the power you're facing is too great. Words are useless. (Fred stops walking and so do the Chrysalis figures around him.) I can give you the power to make your actions speak for themselves. Only if you agree of course.
Fred: You're right.
Chrysalis: What should I call you?
Fred: The Mime. (Zips his lips)
(Chrysalis closes her palm.)
(He mimes out a vechile and zooms off, right in front of Adrien who runs off to hide.)
(She gasps and goes to hide under her desk with Mullo.)
(Cat Noir runs towards him, vaulting off his staff and kicking him off the invisible vechile.)
Cat Noir: Argh!
(The Mime quickly stands back up and puts his hat back on, miming out a door. Cat Noir runs towards him again but gets the invisible door closed on his face, making him hit it and fall over.)
Ladybug: (Swinging over on her yo-yo) Cat got your tongue, kitty?
Cat Noir: Seeing you tends to make me speechless, M'lady.
(The heroes both run after the villain.)
Noé: You can always reach out if you have any issues.

title: Noe/Transcript
text:
Noe/Transcript - Intro
(The room starts shaking as The Mime bursts in through the wall swinging invisible nunchucks. Everyone in the studio starts to run away, except for Noé.)
Mr. Banana: Woah! This banana is going to split!
Noé: (Dodges an attack, making The Mime hit a spotlight) Who are you!? What do you want? (He pushes a button that calls in a bunch of security guards who run in through the door or slide in through ropes on the ceiling. Some of the guards escort Noé out.)(The Mime mimes out double nunchucks and starts using them against the guards.) (In the studios garage complex, a guard helps Noé get into a Luxus car. Noé puts on his seatbelt and activates something on his phone, making several Luxus cars light up and exit the building.)''
(Cat Noir, who was hiding near a nearby building, jumps after him and attempts to pull his hat off with his staff.)
Cat Noir: Watch out for unmimed flying objects!
(The Mime takes a turn, losing him, but is about to end up in a giant web made by Ladybug's yo-yo. He quickly gets rid of the parachute and falls down, miming a vehicle and driving after the Luxus cars.)
Cat Noir: (Ladybug jumps over and joins him) Seems like he cares a great deal about his hat.

title: Noe/Transcript
text:
Noe/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: The Ultrakuma must be inside.
(While the heroes run off, The Mime watches them while hiding under a bridge. He mimes out a safe and puts his hat inside, making it invisible.)
Chrysalis: (Voice) Good thinking, Mime. Ladybug and Cat Noir will never find your hiding place, but you will have every opportunity to seize their miraculous.
(The Mime mimes out a vehicle and helmet and drives off. He ends up next to a Luxus car and mimes a sword, slashing it open, but nobody is inside. He sees another Luxus car in the distance and mimes binoculars to zoom in, then jumps into the water and mimes a speedboat to follow the car.)
Ladybug: There he is!
Cat Noir: Is he mad at black cars or something?
Ladybug: He's probably looking for someone who's inside a similar looking car. Let's sandwich him! (Swings off and kicks The Mime off of his invisible speedboat, making him land at a waterfront deck where Cat Noir is.)Cat Noir: So, Mime, who is it you're looking for?
Ladybug: Where'd his hat go!?

title: Noe/Transcript
text:
Noe/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: I don't know but I can guarantee he isn't going to tell us where he hid it. (The Mime mimes out a saw and cuts a tree down, making Cat Noir dodge it while it's falling. He then mimes out a grappling hook and gets away.)Ladybug: (Holding Cat Noir's wrist) Wait, we need a strategy. Without the Mimes hat we can't deakumatize him. (Chibis visualize what the heroes are saying)
Cat Noir: So, we have to make him deakumatize himself.
Ladybug: And to do that we need to help him speak his mind to the person he's looking for.
Cat Noir: AKA the person who's in one of the black cars. But how can we find the car before The Mime does?
Ladybug: We're going to need some help. (Ladybug opens the Miraculous Call system on her yo-yo and presses the icons of the mouse and ox.)''
(He hears his miraculous beeping and takes it out of his pocket, realizing that Ladybug is calling him.)
Mullo: Aren't you going to transform?
Mylène: This battle is too great for me, Mullo.
Mullo: You get worried when you feel powerless, but this is your chance to do something. Your father needs you.
Ivan: (Calling out through the door) Mylène, talk to me...
Ivan: ...You know that I'm here for you!

title: Noe/Transcript
text:
Noe/Transcript - Intro
Mylène: I'll be okay, teddy bear. I just need to be alone for a while, but I'll call you later tonight.
Ivan: Mylène's feeling better, so...(puts on his nose ring) Stompp, make way! (Transforms into Minotaurox) [Transformation Sequence ]
Mylène: Mullo, get squeaky! (transforms into Polymouse)
(Minotaurox lifts the car back up. The Mime goes to attack him with a mimed sword, but Minotaurox blocks him and is unaffected thanks to Resistance. The Mime is launched back.)
Ladybug: Lucky Charm! (Creates a ribbon)
Cat Noir: Cataclysm! (Touches the ground, making The Mime fall over when he touches the destroyed concrete.)
Ladybug: It's all fun and games until your hands are tied, Mime! (Uses the ribbon to tie The Mimes hands together while Minotaurox picks him up. Polymouse joins her fellow heroes) Polymouse, we've got to find The Mime's target. They're in a black car with a logo on it. We don't know which car.
Polymouse: Got it. Can you lift me up, Cat Noir?
Cat Noir: (Extends his staff) Always happy to give a friend a lift.
Polymouse: (Gets on the staff while its extending upwards) Woah! Multitude!

title: Noe/Transcript
text:
Noe/Transcript - Intro
(Polymouse jumps up, splitting into a bunch of tiny clones that fall onto each Luxus car from the sky. One clone finds Noé in the back of one of the cars.)
Polymouse: (Through earpiece) Target located!
Ladybug: We'll meet you at the TV Tower.
Polymouse: We can begin shooting.
Cat Noir: (At the camera) We're rolling!
(Polymouse joins Ladybug, who turns a spotlight onto Noé. Minotaurox brings a kicking Mime forward.)
Noé: The script was telling the truth. You are the villain's accomplices!
Ladybug: No, we only serve the truth.
Cat Noir: And communication between people.
Noé: Ha-ha! And how are you supposed to communicate with a Mime who won't talk?
Polymouse: He won't talk because he thinks talking is useless, but if you're willing to listen to him maybe everything will work out.
(Minotaurox groans, struggling to keep holding onto the villain.)
Ladybug: (To Polymouse) Perhaps he'll listen to you.
Polymouse: (Nods and goes under the table) Multitude!
(A tiny Polymouse clone climbs on Minotaurox and then jumps behind the Mime's ear.)

title: Noe/Transcript
text:
Noe/Transcript - Intro
Polymouse: Dad, it's me. (The Mime looks around in confusion) I know. I know how awful it is feeling powerless, how unbearable it is watching your values get trampled. It petrified me earlier and made you angry. I understand. (A bunch of other tiny Polymouse clones are watching from the soundboard) With me, you always found the right words. To comfort me when mom was gone, reassure me when I feared I wasn't capable of fighting for a better world. I know that vengeance is not your weapon, dad.
(The Mime, tearing up, breaks out of the akumatization and turns back into Fred. The Ultrakuma is released from the hat under the bridge and turns back into a white butterfly. All of the Polymouse clones fuse into her normal self again as she remerges from under the desk. Her and Ladybug smile at each other.)
Fred: (The ribbon drops and releases his hands as Minotaurox puts him down) Where...where am I?
Ladybug: You fell victim to an akumatization.
Fred: I didn't mean to let my anger overwhelm me. I'm sorry.
Ladybug: But you managed to reject the Ultrakuma, and now you have a chance to express yourself. Paris is listening.

title: Noe/Transcript
text:
Noe/Transcript - Intro
Fred: (To Noé) Hm. You tricked me with a contract that would force me to be in a movie that makes Ladybug and Cat Noir out to be villains. You have a moral responsibility as a story producer to tell the truth which is that Ladybug and Cat Noir are real heroes. And if there's only one thing you should remember, remember Ladybug and Cat Noir just saved you from my anger.
Noé: You're right, and I want to deeply apologize. I too was duped by this script. I will personally see to it that it is rewritten. (Both men shake hands)
Cat Noir: Cut! That's a wrap, thank you!
Ladybug: Miraculous Ladybug!
(The magic ladybugs repair all the damage caused by The Mime, including the slashed Luxus cars where the police are investigating.)
Roger: Secure the perimeter.
(Fred's hat is transported back on his head.)
The Miraculers: Pound it!
Nadja: True facts at last, here's my newscast! From now on you'll find me here on the Zoo network. For my very first broadcast I'm happy to welcome Ms. Bustier. After an investigation proved that the elections were held lawfully, I'm so pleased that you will remain the Mayor of Paris.

title: Noe/Transcript
text:
Noe/Transcript - Intro
Sarah: Hey Fred, I uh ended up reading the script after all. It was horrible. I'm really sorry I brought you into this mess. How can I make up for it?
Mylène: By finding him a genuinely good part?
Manon: Oh, yes! A new Mr. Mime show!
Adrien: Some moments are just perfect, don't you think?
Marinette: Almost perfect. Your glass is empty. (She walks into the kitchen with both her and Adrien's drink glasses and starts looking worried. Tikki comes out of hiding.)
Tikki: You look worried, Marinette.
Marinette: I wanted to believe that everything was fine, but a new danger arose in Paris. And even though it all ended well this time I don't think were done with Noé Luxus. A little voice is telling me to be very careful.
Noé: It's done, mother. Now everyone in Paris knows who I am. The next phase can begin.
Audrey: You were brilliant, my diamond dear.
(Audrey evilly smirks.)

title: Nordine Lahiffe
text:
Nordine Lahiffe - Intro
is a minor character from Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He is the husband of Vita Lahiffe (currently in the process of divorce) and the father of Nino Lahiffe and Chris Lahiffe.
In "The Chained Titans", after an argument with Vita Lahiffe about their wedding money, Nordine and his wife were akumatized by Chrysalis into the Chained Titans, two colossal supervillains physically linked together who constantly attempted to walk away from each other while causing widespread destruction across Paris. He also received a Magical Charm from Ladybug that prevents him from being akumatized again.

title: Nordine Lahiffe
text:
Nordine Lahiffe - Appearance
Physical appearance
Nordine is a middle-aged man of average height with a slim build and tan skin. He has long brown hair, usually brushed back in a slightly messy style, brown eyes, and a fairly full beard.
Civilian attire
He wears a long-sleeved blue denim polo shirt with the collar open and sleeves rolled up, gray knee-length shorts with large pockets, mismatched gray socks (one with red stripes), and gray hiking shoes. He also wears a black sports watch on his left wrist and a cap.
As a Chained Titan
He became a colossal marble-like titan standing several hundred meters tall. His physique became much more muscular, with shorter, stylized hair and a beard resembling ancient Greek sculptures. He wore a loincloth and had a loop of chain attached to his back, linking him to the other titan.

title: Nordine Lahiffe
text:
Nordine Lahiffe - Personality
Nordine is a kind and caring person, especially towards his sons, whom he deeply loves. He has a strong curiosity about the world and dreams of traveling to discover new places and landscapes.
However, he is also frustrated by being stuck in Paris. His desire for adventure clashes with Vita's preference for stability, leading to frequent arguments. Because of this, he can be short-tempered, particularly when discussing their differences.

title: Nordine Lahiffe
text:
Nordine Lahiffe - Abilities
As a Civilian
Nordine appears to have some agility and subtlety, as shown when he can take food without being noticed. He is also knowledgeable about places he wishes to visit.
As a Chained Titan
As one of the Chained Titans, Nordine possessed colossal strength due to his immense size, allowing him to unintentionally cause large-scale destruction across Paris. He was capable of carrying the jar that linked him to the other titan.
Even after being reduced to a smaller size by Cat Noir's Cataclysm, he could grow back to his colossal form.
He could not break the chain linking him to the other titan, although he was capable of detaching it.

title: Nordine Lahiffe
text:
Nordine Lahiffe - Relationships
Family
Vita Lahiffe
Nordine and Vita were in love for several years and got married while she was pregnant with Nino Lahiffe. However, their relationship deteriorated over time due to their different life goals. Nordine's desire to travel conflicted with Vita's preference for stability, symbolized by their wedding money.
Their arguments became frequent, and after their akumatization and Ladybug's advice, they decided to divorce on good terms.
Nino Lahiffe
Nordine cares deeply for his eldest son and tries to provide the best for him. However, Nino resented the constant arguments between his parents.
Later, he is shown to be both sad and relieved when his parents begin an amicable divorce.
Chris Lahiffe
Nordine is very affectionate toward his youngest son and often shows care through small gestures. However, Chris becomes worried, believing that his parents no longer love each other.

title: Nordine Lahiffe
text:
Nordine Lahiffe - Etymology
Nordine is a name of Arabic origin derived from "din", meaning "light of faith" or "illumination of religion".

title: Nordine Lahiffe
text:
Nordine Lahiffe - Trivia
Nordine works for an unknown company or organization located on the Île de la Cité.
His outfit, particularly his red and white cap, may reference Ash Ketchum from Pokémon.

title: Olga Mendeleiev
text:
Olga Mendeleiev - Intro
is a minor character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She is the teacher of physics, science and mathematics at the Collège Françoise Dupont.
In "Kwamibuster", after nobody believed her after she tried to prove the Kwamis' existence on TV, she was akumatized by Hawk Moth into Kwamibuster, a paranormal hunter-themed supervillain.
From "Collusion" to "Representation", Olga temporarily became the principal of Collège Françoise Dupont, replacing Denis who was fired by Mayor Bourgeois. At the end of "Re-creation", she relinquished the position of principal to Denis after the latter was reinstated as principal of the new and restructured Collège Françoise Dupont by Mayor Bustier.

title: Olga Mendeleiev
text:
Olga Mendeleiev - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Olga is a tall pale skinned slim woman with short messy dark plum-purple hair, deep cornflower blue eyes, prominent pink lips, a beauty mark on her left cheek, and a pointy chin.
Civilian Attire
She wears black square-framed glasses, along with a purple V-necked dress shirt with a white scientific scribble pattern and popped collar, underneath a white lab coat. She also wears a brown watch on her right wrist, blue jeans, a brown leather belt, and red high heel shoes.
As Kwamibuster
Kwamibuster had light purplish gray skin and brilliant fuchsia hair. Her hairstyle was unchanged. She had a gray mask and black goggles with light chartreuse green lenses over her eyes, and her eyes were brilliant amaranth. She wore a medium gray, black, and dark gray armor-like jumpsuit with a light green and gray vacuum cleaner on her back like a turtle's shell.

title: Olga Mendeleiev
text:
Olga Mendeleiev - Personality
Olga is a strict, sharp-tongued, and grouchy teacher who expects her students to be hardworking, focused, and well-behaved, and she becomes cross with her students who are not. She is easily irritated by people bossing her around, but she shows some fear if she finds herself in serious trouble, like with Rogercop in the episode of the same name. She can also be incredibly stubborn and rude, as shown in "Robostus", in which she refuses to believe both Max Kanté and Markov when they claim the latter has real, human emotions. Despite this, she can be tricked somewhat easily, finding herself dumbfounded after Marinette Dupain-Cheng manipulates her into letting her see Denis Damoclès in "Robostus".

title: Olga Mendeleiev
text:
Olga Mendeleiev - Personality
Despite her more anti-social tendencies, she cares deeply for her students and is devoted to her job of educating them. She is also brave and willing to put herself in danger to protect her students, as shown when she tried to protect Max from a marauding akumatized Markov, an act which nearly got her killed had Ladybug not saved her. However, she also showed signs that she felt hurt when her students showed regret that it would be her accompanying them to New York, rather than Miss Bustier, implying that she knows that her colleague is more well-liked than she is. Despite that, she was upset to be forced to unfairly fire Miss Bustier from her teaching job when she briefly became principal but reluctantly goes along with it due to being ordered by Mayor Bourgeois.
As Kwamibuster, her desire for success increased drastically as she stopped at nothing to capture and study the Kwamis.

title: Olga Mendeleiev
text:
Olga Mendeleiev - Abilities
As a Civilian
Ms. Mendeleiev teaches high school math and science, suggesting that she is well versed in these subjects.
As a member of the school faculty, she has the authority to confiscate a student's personal property, as well as give them detention. Her reputation as a mean teacher is something she weaponizes to get kids to behave.
As Kwamibuster
While Kwamibuster didn't have any superpowers, she wielded a vacuum-like gun attached to a canister on her back. Any Kwami hit by the beam from her vacuum would be sucked in and trapped in the canister, unable to phase through. It would even work on a Kwami inside a Miraculous.

title: Olga Mendeleiev
text:
Olga Mendeleiev - Relationships
Denis Damoclès
TBA
Caline Bustier
Olga knows Caline Bustier as a colleague of hers at the school.
In "Zombizou", she was angry when her class was interrupted by an akumatized Caline, albeit she didn't recognize her in her akumatized form and demanded to know who was she, however, Zombizou uses her powers against Olga and her students, turning them into zombies.
In "Miraculous New York", Olga became genuinely sad upon hearing that her students liked Caline more than her.
In "Collusion", after Olga became the new principal, she hears Chloé demanding her to fire Caline from her teaching job, and when the latter asked Olga to not follow with it, a regretful Olga apologized to her but was unable to due to Mayor Bourgeois.
Following Mayor Bourgeois's resignation and Caline becoming the new mayor, it's likely that both women made amends.

title: Olga Mendeleiev
text:
Olga Mendeleiev - Trivia
Her surname resembles Dmitri Mendeleev, a Russian chemist who was the founder and compiler of the modern periodic table of elements.
Despite having her own classroom, in "Antibug", she teaches Miss Bustier's class in Miss Bustier's classroom.
She also has her own class, but she teaches Caline's class in her own classroom for particular subjects in some episodes like "The Evillustrator" and "Princess Fragrance".
Ms. Mendeleiev's known students are Aurore Beauréal, Mireille Caquet, Jean Duparc, Marc Anciel, and Zoé Lee.
Ms. Mendeleiev's appearance and personality strongly resemble that of Miss Battle-Axe from the Horrid Henry series, in that they are both strict and acerbic teachers with little patience for misbehaviour from their charges. However, Ms. Mendeleiev is much nicer in comparison, has purple hair as opposed to grey like Miss Battle-Axe and wears square-rimmed glasses rather than horn-rimmed.
Ms. Mendeleiev's akumatized persona, Kwamibuster, is an obvious reference to the Ghostbusters franchise.

title: Notre-Dame de Paris
text:
Notre-Dame de Paris - Intro
The , also known as Notre Dame Cathedral or simply as Notre-Dame, is a historic Catholic cathedral on the eastern half of the Île de la Cité in the fourth arrondissement of Paris, France.

title: Notre-Dame de Paris
text:
Notre-Dame de Paris - Description
Mainly built of cut stone from the old quarries of Paris, Notre-Dame is a religious building of Gothic architecture. Like most French cathedrals, it was built on a Latin cross plan.
Numerous gargoyles and various statues adorn the exterior of the cathedral.
Towers
The two towers of the cathedral culminate at 69 meters high each. Being the bell towers, it houses the bells of the building. These towers were built on the same plan, but they are not twins, the north tower is wider and thicker than the south tower.
West facade
The entrance has three portals with two doors each. Above these is the west rose window of the building, the smallest, which represents the Virgin Mary, the labors of the months, the signs of the zodiac, the virtues and vices as well as the prophets.
Side facades
The side facades were made with the construction of large buttresses that supported the walls of the nave, and also served as a drainage channel for water from the roofs.
Many stained glass windows adorn these two side facades, but especially the two large 13-meter rose windows that adorn the transept.

title: Notre-Dame de Paris
text:
Notre-Dame de Paris - Trivia
Notre-Dame has been classified as a Historic Monument since 1862.
Notre-Dame has been a UNESCO World Heritage Site (under the title "Rives of the Seine") since 1991.
In the series, Notre-Dame is located across the Seine from the Collège Françoise Dupont.
Additionally, the Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie overlooks the cathedral's north façade, with Marinette's balcony boasting a magnificent view of the cathedral and the Seine.
During season 1, this view is on the south façade.
From season 2 onwards, the view changes to the north façade.
On April 15, 2019, the real-life counterpart of the cathedral was severely damaged by a fire that engulfed the structure, but it was re-opened on December 8, 2024.
The Parvis Notre-Dame - Place Jean-Paul II is the Kilometer zero of the road network of France.

title: Olympia Hill
text:
Olympia Hill - Intro
is one of the two tritagonists (alongside Barbara Keynes) of Miraculous World: New York - United Heroez. She is a superheroine in the United States of America known as Majestia.

title: Olympia Hill
text:
Olympia Hill - Appearance
Physical appearance
Olympia has short golden blonde hair styled into a pixie cut and blue eyes. She also wears bluish-black eyeshadow and red lipstick.
Civile attire
She wears a green set, which consists of smooth trousers and a jacket richly decorated with a floral motif, revealing her neckline. She has black sandals with straps on his feet. Her neck is decorated with a massive necklace with cream, large, golden beads in the middle and smaller ones in red and brown. She covers her eyes with sunglasses that are gradient, vertically pink to yellow.
As Majestia
Majestia wears a red sleeveless vest with a swan-necked collar, three gold stars and two jagged gold lines on the front, and a zipper-like line down the center of the front, along with a long coattail. Underneath the vest, she has a blue suit with exposed shoulders and long sleeves, and she wears red knee-high boots with two jagged gold lines around the upper edge.

title: Olympia Hill
text:
Olympia Hill - Personality
Majestia is brave, friendly, and reliable. She kindly explains information to Ladybug and Cat Noir, such as the need to defeat the Trash Krakken. While she can get impatient and annoyed on occasion, Majestia has a positive, understanding and determined outlook in general about a situation. This allows her to get along well with the superheroes she knows.
When under the influence of Liberation, she starts acting reckless, testing out her powers without any concern for the civilians.

title: Olympia Hill
text:
Olympia Hill - Abilities
Majestia has immense super strength, able to punch a supervillain with enough force to send him flying through multiple skyscrapers, lift up a falling airplane, halt the flight of a missile with one hand before throwing it all the way to the Sun and even push the Moon out of orbit, albeit with significant effort. Majestia has the power to fly, even into Earth's orbit. Additionally she has tremendous speed, able to fly from Earth to the Moon in a matter of minutes. She can also survive in the vacuum of space without a suit.
Her super breath is capable of blowing away several buildings, a feat that she herself described as being "too easy". It can be assumed that Majestia is also virtually invulnerable, as she stated that no matter what new powers Techno-pirate may have gained, she was the only one he wouldn't be able to harm.
Outside of her superpowers, she has great knowledge engineering, programming, and robotics, as she was able to create a humanoid combat robot with a highly advanced AI. She has super hearing, as she heard Cat Noir accidentally destroy Uncanny Valley from far away.

title: Olympia Hill
text:
Olympia Hill - Abilities
So far, her only known weakness is that she seems to have no more defense against an akumatized villain's mind manipulation powers than anyone else.

title: Olympia Hill
text:
Olympia Hill - Relationships
Family
Barbara Keynes/Knightowl
Barbara is Majestia's romantic partner and wife, as they are very close, they always fight together against the villains of New York. They both share the same protective nature of training their daughters. However, seeing how the young heroes were able to handle themselves, she agrees with Knightowl, despite being afraid of letting their daughters become more independent.
Aeon/Uncanny Valley
Despite having no children of her own, she treats her creation, Uncanny Valley, as her daughter, caring greatly for her to the point of being a bit overprotective. She can be a bit stern with her when orders are disobeyed. However, seeing her accidentally destroyed by Cat Noir, she held her close breaking down to the point of tears. She was relieved and grateful when she was fixed. After being returned to normal and seeing how Uncanny and her friends handle things on their own, she let her "daughter" become more independent.
Acquaintances
Ladybug and Cat Noir

title: Olympia Hill
text:
Olympia Hill - Relationships
In "Miraculous New York", she was horrified that Cat Noir accidentally destroyed her "daughter" but was extremely grateful towards Ladybug for repairing her. After being returned to normal and Miraclonizer's defeat, she praised the young heroes for a job well done and learned from them that when training young heroes, they need make their own way and take their own chances. To honor the young heroes as well as a sign of friendship and gratitude, Majestia leads the adult heroes in making an ice statue of them.
In "Re-creation", she, along with the rest of the United Heroez, fought in defense for the French duo against the Miraculized.
In the last scene of "Miraculous Tokyo", Majestia and Cat Noir were revealed to have teamed up to fight against an unknown villain.

title: Olympia Hill
text:
Olympia Hill - Etymology
Her name, Olympia Hill, is a reference to Mount Olympus, which in Ancient Greek religion and mythology was the home of the Twelve Olympian gods. Majestia herself has god-like powers.
The name Majestia is likely derived from the Latin word maiestas, meaning "greatness" or "dignity".

title: Olympia Hill
text:
Olympia Hill - Trivia
Thomas Astruc described Majestia as a "fusion between Superman and Wonder Woman."
Additionally, her appearance is similar to that of Power Girl, Supergirl and the Carol Danvers incarnation of Ms. Marvel.
Much like Superman and Wonder Woman, Olympia seems able to use glasses as a disguise in her civilian identity.
Alya Césaire is a fan of Majestia, reading comic books about her and referencing a quote from her in order to encourage Marinette in "Ladybug & Cat Noir".
Majestia's first appearance in the television series is on the cover of a comic book about her that Alya has on her cellphone.
Alya also has a poster of her in her room.
As seen in "Sapotis", Alya has a pajama top with a design based on Majestia's costume.
Animaestro impersonated her in cartoon form.
Her original superhero name was Superbia.

title: Obélisque de Louxor
text:
Obélisque de Louxor - Intro
The , translated in English as Luxor Obelisk, is a 23 m Egyptian obelisk standing at the center of the Place de la Concorde in Paris, France.

title: Obélisque de Louxor
text:
Obélisque de Louxor - Description
Made of pink Aswan granite, the obelisk is 23 meters high and weighs 220 tons, 240 tons with the pedestal.
The pedestal of the obelisk has four sides. On the first two there are illustrations showing the removal of the obelisk, its transport and then its reassembly. The other two present an inscription that explains Louis Philippe's (the last king of France) contribution to the project, but also France's commitment to Egypt starting from Napoleon I.
In the main part there are many hieroglyph inscriptions, including a cartridge in which Ramses II makes an offering to the god Amon-Ra. Finally, the top is crowned with a pointed sparkling pyramidion with a height of 3 meters 60 and covered with bronze with electro-dye. On the ground you can find Roman signs, lines and numerals, inlaid with metal, which give the obelisk its role as the gnomon of a sundial.

title: Obélisque de Louxor
text:
Obélisque de Louxor - Trivia
The obelisk was originally located at the entrance to Luxor Temple in Egypt.
The obelisk first appeared as a drawing in a stamp attached to Fu's gramophone, where Wayzz slept in "Ladybug & Cat Noir".

title: Ondine
text:
Ondine - Intro
is a recurring character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She is a swimming student. Starting from season 6, she is a student at Collège Françoise Dupont. She is currently in a relationship with Lê Chiến Kim.
In "Syren", after Kim accidentally ignores her feelings, she was akumatized by Hawk Moth into Syren, a mermaid supervillainess.
In "Ephemeral", during an alternate timeline, Ondine was reakumatized by Shadow Moth into Syren.
In "Sleeping Syren", when Kim rejected a kiss from Ondine, she was akumatized by Chrysalis into Sleeping Syren, an upgraded version of her previous akumatization form Syren. She also received a Magical Charm from Dragonbug that prevented her from being akumatized again.

title: Ondine
text:
Ondine - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Ondine is a light skinned teenage girl with short bright red hair in a pixie cut, brilliant turquoise eyes, and several freckles on her face and body. She is also quite tall for her age, being slightly taller than Kim and shown to be physically stronger than other girls.
Civilian Attire
The only attire she's shown wearing is a red-and-black one-piece swimsuit, black swimming goggles with dark blue lenses, and a black swimming cap while barefoot.
From Season 6 onwards, she now has a white seashell necklace accented by a milk blue pearl and mint gems, orange starfish earrings, and a white beaded anklet on her right ankle. She also wears an off-shoulder, loose, puffy-sleeved white dress with a sky blue sash featuring white patterns around her waist, and wedged sandals with white lace and tan soles. She occassionally wears a light yellow sunhat.
As Syren

title: Ondine
text:
Ondine - Appearance
As Syren, she had brilliant crimson skin, black freckles on her shoulders and elbows, and a lighter crimson face with smaller dark freckles. She had short vivid amaranth hair, a grayish magenta dorsal fin on her back, and two silver circular horns sticking out of the top of her head. Her eyes were brilliant amaranth with light arctic blue sclerae. Her jet black strapless skin-tight suit had a fish-scaly look (except her hips and upper chest sections) and a light pink lining. Her feet faded into a two-pointed pink fin.
As Sleeping Syren
Sleeping Syren's appearance served as an upgrade to her previous form as Syren, with significant differences. Her skin turned pale periwinkle with her freckles white. Her sclerae were pale pink with the same eye color as her civilian form, retaining her civilian hairstyle. Her horns were thinner, rounded, glew a pale cyan, and were accented with white beads and coral, the beads matching the tiara across the middle of her head and her earrings (though for the earrings, there was a smaller bead beside the bigger bead). She wore golden lipstick as a result of using her akumatized object.

title: Ondine
text:
Ondine - Appearance
She wore a flailing white dress with dark orange trim and details around the chest, detached sleeves that opened in the front and were very long and flowy in the back to match her floor-length skirt, and several beads around the shoulders, navel, and arms, as well as a two-beaded necklace. Her tail was pale pink and behind her were several flowing pieces of what appeared to be pale blue fabric.

title: Ondine
text:
Ondine - Personality
Ondine is a sweet and fun girl who enjoys playing games and swimming. She stays cheerful for the most part, although she can become incredibly upset and distressed when faced with huge disappointment, like Kim unintentionally ignoring her attempts to go out with him and showing interest in Chloé instead. She has a huge crush on Kim, even though he does not realize this for the most part, and is shown being overjoyed when Kim asks her to go out to the movies with her.
As revealed in "Sleeping Syren", Ondine seems to suffer from low self-steem, as, per her poem to Kim, she seems to be conscious of her appearance: she recognizes she's significantly taller and has broader shoulders than most girls her age, and she seems self-conscious of her freckles.
As Syren, her love for Kim became very possessive and obsessive, and she was determined to make him her prince. If anyone threatened her relationship with Kim, such as Ladybug or Cat Noir, she was easily provoked into attacking them. She was completely indifferent to the effects her actions had on others, never once considering the citizens trapped or hurt because of her flooding of Paris.

title: Ondine
text:
Ondine - Personality
As Sleeping Syren, she is mainly passive and spends most of the time asleep, likely waiting for her brave knight to save her. As with her water soldiers, she was deeply offended by what Kim said about why he refused to kiss her.

title: Ondine
text:
Ondine - Abilities
As a Civilian
Ondine is an excellent swimmer. In "Sleeping Syren", she's shown to have great strength and is able to beat Kim in an arm wrestle by flipping him over the table.
As Syren
Syren had the power to flood all of Paris with her tears and turn it into her own personal domain. She was able to swim incredibly fast and breathe underwater and was also able to blow bubbles filled with air, allowing others to breathe underwater. She said a kiss from her would turn Kim into a merman, allowing him to breathe and live underwater without a bubble, although it is unknown if Syren could utilize this ability.
As Sleeping Syren

title: Ondine
text:
Ondine - Abilities
Sleeping Syren was an upgraded version of Syren, being more powerful with different abilities. She was able to create an ocean of tears that submerged Paris to the rooftops. She could manipulate her tears to create figments made out of water to either guard her or test people such as water knights and a dragon. She could also give them special abilities, such as how she gifted her knights with the power to transform whoever their spears touched into toads, and for her dragon to generate hugely pressurized water geysers. She was also equipped with an enchanted lipstick, which would send her into an enchanted sleep that could only be awoken by a kiss.

title: Ondine
text:
Ondine - Relationships
Romances
Lê Chiến Kim/King Monkey
Ondine shows romantic interest in Kim in "Syren", but he is oblivious to her feelings. When akumatized into Syren, she plans to make Paris an underwater kingdom for the two of them. She has apparently tried to confess to him many times before but has never been successful. He did realize her feelings for him when she was akumatized, and at the end of the episode, he asked her to go to the movies with him, much to her joy.

title: Ondine
text:
Ondine - Relationships
In "Derision", after Kim tells her and Adrien about the mean prank he and Chloé pulled on Marinette last year, Ondine was outraged that her boyfriend could do something so rotten. She scolded Kim, telling him that he had no right hurting people with cruel pranks. She was later shocked to see that Kim had been akumatized into Dark Humor. After Kim was deakumatized, he points out that he hoped he didn't do too many awful things as a villain, but Ondine tells him that the worst thing is that he does awful things even when he's not akumatized. When Kim said that he had no idea how his prank affected Marinette, Ondine helps him to realize that his pranks have consequences, and that the pain he caused Marinette traumatized her. Kim promise to be more mindful of his pranks and apologizes to Marinette for his actions. Hearing this, Ondine embraces Kim, remarking "that's the boy she fell in love with".
In "Climatiqueen", it's shown that Ondine is now making sure that Kim's words doesn't affect the people, scolding him when he doesn't realize the harm that he's making.
In "Sleeping Syren",

Ondine seems to be good friends with Marinette. In "Derision", Ondine got concerned when Marinette suddenly had a panic attack, and showed sympathy for her when she learned about the cause of said panic attack.
When it comes to Ladybug, Ondine has not explicitly talked about her, but when she sees her and her allies jumping above the pool as they work to gather some escaped animals, she doesn't appear to be scared. In "Frightningale", she appears in Clara Nightingale's music video wearing a Ladybug mask, implying she likes Ladybug to some extent.

Adrien Agreste is way too innocent to be wary of her. Of course she'll persuade Ladybug and Cat Noir to stop you from accomplishing your duty. You must therefore bring me their Miraculous, to punish them for their naivety.
Kagami: Yes, Hawk Moth. (transforms into Oni-Chan)
Oni-Chan: Adrien. I am Oni-Chan. You and I were made for each other, Adrien.
Adrien: Kagami?
Oni-Chan: I will protect you from anyone who tries to harm you. I'll protect you from Lila. (shows him a photo of Lila on her phone.)
Adrien: She's not dangerous. She just craves attention.
Oni-Chan: She doesn't deserve your attention. What she deserves is punishment! (takes off)
Adrien: Kagami, no!
Marinette: (lines the trash bins together but then sees Oni-Chan) Can I transform now?
Tikki: Yes, Marinette.
Marinette: (hides inside a trash bin) Tikki, spots on!
Plagg: Wow. With all these girlfriends chasing you, I guess it was only a matter of time before they ended up fighting each another.
Adrien: (annoyed) I don't have any girlfriends!

title: Oni-Chan/Transcript
text:
Oni-Chan/Transcript - Intro
[Transformation Sequence] Adrien: Plagg, claws out! (transforms into Cat Noir)
Oni-Chan: Lila. (A spooked Lila runs and hides) Lila Rossi!
Lila: Ah!
Oni-Chan: I forbid you to go anywhere near Adrien. (slices car with bokken) Give up on him and I will spare you.
Lila: Adrien? I don't know anyone named Adrien.
Oni-Chan: Don't lie to me!
Lila: I'm really sorry, but I always get what I want. It's not my fault.
Oni-Chan: Well this time you're gonna have to give in. Otherwise you'll really get it, whether you want it or not.
Cat Noir: Don't you think you should ask the lucky guy what he thinks? (Oni-Chan begins attacking him) Hey, I'm just trying to help.
(As Cat Noir fights Oni-Chan, Ladybug shows up besides Lila)
Ladybug: C'mon, this way! (drags Lila to Place des Vosges)
Lila: I don't need you, Ladybug. I was perfectly capable of defending myself. Besides, that ugly horned girl doesn't stand a chance with Adrien.
(Cat Noir lands in front of Ladybug and Lila)
Oni-Chan: Are you really sure I don't stand a chance? (kicks Ladybug out of the way and then points her bokken at Lila's forehead)
Ladybug: Back off! (grabs the bokken with her yo-yo)

title: Oni-Chan/Transcript
text:
Oni-Chan/Transcript - Intro
Oni-Chan: (notices Lila running away) It's no use running. Wherever you go, I'll find you.
Cat Noir: Not before we capture your akuma anyway.
Lila: Please stop! Oh, officer, I'm being followed by a supervillain and Ladybug's failing miserably. You're the only one who can help me! Please protect me!
Roger: Get in. I can protect you down at the police center. (Lila gets into the car and Roger drives off)
Ladybug: The akuma must be in her bokken, Cat Noir!
Roger: Unfortunately, there's not much I can do about your forehead problem, though.
Lila: What forehead problem? (sees a horn on her head) Ah! What is this disgusting thing? (horn glows)
Roger: (receives a message on his phone and stops to look at it) What kind of a message is this? (swaps places with Oni-Chan)
Ladybug: What just happened?
Roger: Where’s my car? What happened to the young lady with the horn on her forehead? The one being chased by that supervillain?
Ladybug: Lila?
Cat Noir: Since when does she have a horn? (Ladybug and Cat Noir take off)
Oni-Chan: Go ahead and run. As fast and as far away as you can, Lila Rossi.
Ladybug: There! (points out police car and she and Cat Noir jump in front of it)

title: Oni-Chan/Transcript
text:
Oni-Chan/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: I feel like she's taunting us.
Ladybug: She won't be laughing for long. (wraps yo-yo around car)
Lila: Help! There's a monster chasing me!
Sabine: You have something on your forehead. (Lila's horn glows and Sabine receives a phone message) Oh, what a strange message!
Ladybug: We've got her! (the inside of the car begins to glow)
Cat Noir: Not again! (Oni-Chan swaps places with Sabine)
Oni-Chan: So, you still think you can get away from me?
Tom: Honey? (opens the door and is shocked to find Oni-Chan)
Ladybug: Mo- uh, Miss Dupain-Cheng?
Sabine: I was in the bakery when this teenager with a horn came running in.
Cat Noir: Lila.
Ladybug: Oni-Chan must be there already. (to Sabine) Stay here! (she and Cat Noir take off)
Oni-Chan: All you have to do is give up on Adrien, and all of this will stop.
Tom: (taps on Oni-Chan's shoulder, angrily) Ahem. Nobody attacks customers at the Dupain-Cheng bakery. And where is my wife? (Lila runs out and Oni-Chan prepares to follow her) Wait!
Cat Noir: (jumps in front of Lila along with Ladybug) Lila, are you okay?

title: Oni-Chan/Transcript
text:
Oni-Chan/Transcript - Intro
Lila: You're rushing to my rescue even after all those nasty things I said to you? I really misjudged you, Ladybug! You're the only one who can help me! (hugs Ladybug and her horn grows)
Cat Noir: I knew she'd wind up liking you in the end. (winks)
Ladybug: (pushes Lila away and then receives a message on her yo-yo) What kind of message is this? (swaps places with Oni-Chan)
Cat Noir: Hey! Not cool! The girls were just starting to get along! (fights Oni-Chan)
Tom: Ladybug! My wife answered the phone, and then POOF, she disappeared! And then that villain showed up, and now you're here, and-
Ladybug: Don't worry. Your wife is in a police car, safe and sound. (goes to look out the window) The supervillain sends evil phone messages and swaps places with the person who looks at them. And Lila's horn acts as a kind of cell tower. That's how the villain always tracks her down. I know how to defeat her now, thanks to you!
Tom: (confused) Oh?
Oni-Chan: Give Adrien up!
Lila: And let you get your monster paws on him? No way!

title: Oni-Chan/Transcript
text:
Oni-Chan/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: (hits Oni-Chan with his staff, he is disappointed about being chased around as his true persona) Adrien, Adrien, Adrien. All the girls are fighting over him. No one's fighting over me. Yet I'm so much more sophisticated, funnier, and definitely better dressed than him.
Oni-Chan: (furiously charges towards Cat Noir) How dare you compare yourself to Adrien, you cursed cat! Adrien is perfection personified! He's the only one who's worthy of me! And the only one I will ever love!
Cat Noir: (shocked) What? (thrown into an Adrien billboard, irritated) What are you smiling at?
Oni-Chan: Do you get it now? I'll hunt you down wherever you go. Just give up on Adrien, and I'll stop tracking your every move.
Lila: Alright. I'll give up... on Adrien. (horn grows)
Oni-Chan: You're an awesome actress, but you're lying. Your horn betrays you, see? It will only disappear once you've sincerely given up on Adrien.
Lila: But how could I possibly give Adrien up? I love him so much! It's too hard for me, honestly! You can't ask me to do that. The only thing that would persuade me to give him up if you got rid of Ladybug for me. (smiles sinisterly. Oni-Chan smiles, very impressed.)

title: Oni-Chan/Transcript
text:
Oni-Chan/Transcript - Intro
Hawk Moth: (from his lair; intrigued) This Lila girl is... astounding!
Oni-Chan: If that's the only thing that will make you give him up, I'll do it. (attacks Ladybug)
Ladybug: Cat Noir, if anyone receives a text message, you can't let them open it. That's how Oni-Chan teleports herself. (Oni-Chan attacks the duo)
Lila: Help, Cat Noir! It hurts so much! I think I might've broken something! (horn grows)
Cat Noir: M'lady, I have an emergency. I won't be long.
Ladybug: Are you sure she's not pulling your leg?
Cat Noir: She wouldn't do that now. She really looks like she's in pain. (takes off with Lila)
Ladybug: Then I'm going to need a helping hand here. Lucky Charm! (receives coiled-up plastic tubing, which Oni-Chan snatches)
Cat Noir: Could you take this girl to the nearest hospital, please?
Oni-Chan: You've been hosed, Ladybug. Adrien will be mine now, forever! (reaches for her earrings)
Ladybug: NO!
Hawk Moth: (from his lair) Yes! Take her Miraculous!
Ladybug: (kicks Oni-Chan away from her) Back off!
Hessenpy: Well, this is what happens when you don't wear knee pads. (Lila's horn glows and Hessenpy receives a message)
Cat Noir: No, don't look at your phone!

title: Oni-Chan/Transcript
text:
Oni-Chan/Transcript - Intro
Hessenpy: But what if it's an emergency?
Cat Noir: Her leg's an emergency!
Hessenpy: You sure it's not her forehead instead because her leg looks fine.
Cat Noir: (to Lila) You just wanted me to leave Ladybug alone with the villain? (begins to get upset) You hate Ladybug... that much?
Lila: Me? Of course not. Why would you say that? Is it because she's been left alone to fight Oni-Chan all by herself? (horn grows)
Cat Noir: (enraged) What you just did is really terrible. You should be ashamed of yourself. (turns to Hessenpy) Answer your phone, Mr. Hessenpy.
Lila: No! Don't do that!
Cat Noir: Yes, it's an emergency!
Hessenpy: Uh oh.
Hessenpy: Ladybug?
Cat Noir: Surprise, Oni-Chan.
Hessenpy: What am I doing here? And how did you get all tied up like that? (attempts to untie Ladybug) These hoses are so strong, it once took us two full hours to get a kid untangled.
Ladybug: Really? (thinks) Wait! I’ve got a plan.
Cat Noir: (to Ladybug, on the phone) Yes, M’lady? (to Oni-Chan) It’s the girl of my dreams. (to Ladybug) Sure, I’ll bring her over to you right now. (Oni-Chan charges towards him but he kicks her out of his way and then grabs Lila) Hurry!

title: Oni-Chan/Transcript
text:
Oni-Chan/Transcript - Intro
Lila: (while being dragged by Cat Noir) Hey! Oh, easy! My leg!
Cat Noir: (shows up where Ladybug is with Lila) Need a helping paw, M'lady?
Ladybug: No, just a little phone call. (Lila’s horn glows)
Oni-Chan: NO! (swaps places with Ladybug, who then grabs her bokken with her yo-yo)
Ladybug: Cat Noir!
Cat Noir: Cataclysm! (uses it on the bokken, breaking it and freeing the akuma)
Ladybug: No more evil-doing for you, little akuma! Time to deevilize! (captures akuma) Gotcha! (releases purified butterfly) Bye, bye, little butterfly. Miraculous Ladybug! (Miraculous Ladybug repairs all damage and Oni-Chan turns back into Kagami)
Cat Noir: Kagami. (gives Kagami her rose back)
Ladybug: Pound it!
Cat Noir: I'll take her back home. (carries Kagami) Keep an eye on Lila. She’s as sly as a fox. (takes off)
Ladybug: Your leg looks better.
Lila: Being around you superheroes has toughened me up.
Ladybug: You'll be okay to go home by yourself, then. You don’t need me. (takes off)
Hawk Moth: I think I was mistaken. I shouldn’t chase that girl away. She could make a very good ally.
Lila: Hey, Adrien? Could you help me with my homework after school?

title: Oni-Chan/Transcript
text:
Oni-Chan/Transcript - Intro
Alya: (notices that Marinette isn’t spying on Adrien and Lila) What? You don’t have Adrien under surveillance anymore?
Marinette: I trust him, Alya. Adrien could never love a girl like Lila, not in a million years.
Adrien: Sorry, I’ve got fencing. Besides, I think you’re already light years ahead of me when it comes to calculus.
Lila: Actually, I have memory loss after all this traveling I’ve done. I need to learn everything again from scratch.
Adrien: (angrily) Nathalie and my bodyguard got reprimanded last time because of you.
Lila: I’m sorry, Adrien. Please, I didn’t mean to.
Adrien: Lila, you can always count on me. But not if you hurt the people I love. (walks away)
Lila: (receives a call from an unknown number, which she answers) Hello?
Kagami: Congratulations. You’re at your best again, I see.
Adrien: I’m only trying to be worthy of you.
Kagami: (blushes)
Lila: Thank you for inviting me here, Mr. Agreste.
(Cut to Gabriel. He is still upset with Lila for entering his house unauthorized by lying and manipulating his own son.)
Gabriel: (scornfully) You got into my house without my authorization. By lying and manipulating my son.

title: Oni-Chan/Transcript
text:
Oni-Chan/Transcript - Intro
Lila: I only meant well. Adrien needed to talk. You do such a good job of shielding him from bad influences that he actually feels very alone.
Gabriel: Hm. You’re opening my eyes to a problem I didn’t even know existed. What would you do in my position?
Lila: I think he needs a friend his age. Someone who understands him, who can protect him from negative influences. Someone you can trust, too.
Gabriel: You and I think the same way. See you again very soon, Lila. (shakes hands with her)
Lila: See you soon, Mr. Agreste.

title: Oblivio
text:
Oblivio - Intro
"" is a season 3 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 10th written and produced episode of season 3. It is also the 62nd written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Oblivio
text:
Oblivio - Synopsis
Ladybug and Cat Noir lose their memories, will they be able to defeat Oblivio so that the villain becomes just a bad memory?
Disney Channel
Ladybug and Cat Noir have lost their memory... and a mysterious villain is prowling around Paris. Will our amnesiac heroes manage to defeat Oblivio and turn him into just a bad memory?
Disney+
Ladybug and Cat Noir face the mysterious Oblivio.

title: Oblivio
text:
Oblivio - Plot
Ladybug and Cat Noir awaken in an elevator without memories of either their civilian or superhero lives. All they know is they're stuck in an elevator, where one wall has a drawing of a phone and a turtle apparently made with a tube of red lipstick that Ladybug is holding, itself apparently the result of the Lucky Charm, although they are unaware of these details. Their Miraculouses begin to beep, and they soon detransform into Marinette and Adrien. As their kwamis come to, Marinette and Adrien question what the creatures are. Tikki and Plagg try to present themselves, but they can't remember who they are either, or even what they are, knowing only that they're hungry. The elevator begins to shift when something starts trying to pound through the ceiling, and with Tikki's help, Marinette and Adrien manage to escape before the elevator crumbles completely.

title: Oblivio
text:
Oblivio - Plot
The group soon discovers that they are in a building with the exits blocked and the place in chaos. They realize they're being pursued by something, and they hide in a bathroom. Plagg says he smells something in Adrien's shirt, which turns out to be Camembert, which he then eats. Marinette gives Tikki a macaron she finds in her purse. Marinette and Adrien learn their names from the ID cards they're carrying. They try to use their phones to call for help, but they can't remember their phones' passwords. Still being pursued, the two, along with their kwamis, hide in a stall and try to find a way out. They finally escape through an air vent and find themselves in a stairwell, which they quickly ascend to reach an office floor where they can hide.

title: Oblivio
text:
Oblivio - Plot
Marinette and Adrien return to their phone problem, Marinette finally using her breath to reveal their passcodes, which leads to Adrien divulging that he, though oblivious to it, is enamored by her. They both soon realize that their phones have low battery. Adrien tries to call his father, but it goes to voicemail. Marinette reaches her mom, who though worried, tells her to stay put wherever she is, safe, until Ladybug and Cat Noir have defeated the villain. Just as she hears all of this, Marinette sees a poster of the Ladybug and Cat Noir animated film on the wall of the office. After hanging up with her mom, Marinette reveals her understanding to Adrien: they're being pursued by a supervillain who is being fought by Ladybug and Cat Noir, but they themselves are the said superheroes, now powerless.

title: Oblivio
text:
Oblivio - Plot
With the two assuming that no one knows their identities except for themselves and with both of them having pictures of each other in their phones, they conclude that they're a couple. They're stymied, however, because they don't know how to obtain their powers again and how the two tiny creatures relate to them. Plagg grows bored from the situation and leaves, but not before Tikki calls him a selfish coward. The remaining three are soon tracked down by Oblivio. Marinette manages to come up with a plan to elude Oblivio without revealing their identities involving the use of Adrien's phone to trick Oblivio into thinking that they were hiding somewhere they weren't before running to the stairs. After misleading Oblivio back in the stairwell with Tikki's help, they return to the office, figuring he won't search for them there again. The use of Adrien's phone in their escape made its battery dead. Plagg, meanwhile, flying across Paris, starts to feel pangs of guilt from seeing advertising posters of Adrien everywhere.

title: Oblivio
text:
Oblivio - Plot
Determining that she and Adrien must discover how to become superheroes again in order to defeat Oblivio, Marinette decides to look for hints in news coverage of what happened before they lost their memories. Seeing herself drawing in the elevator, Marinette remembers what she saw there after waking up and discovers Master Fu's contact in her phone, which earns her romantic appraisal from Adrien. After Fu's brief shock that Marinette and Adrien know each other's identities, he assures them everything will be fine once they've defeated Oblivio. Marinette's phone is about to run out of battery so she asks Fu to hurry. This leads to him explaining to Marinette and Adrien what kwamis are, their names, and how to call upon their powers. Adrien mentions that Plagg has left them, with Fu warning he won't be able to transform without him, just before the battery on Marinette's phone dies, ending the call.

title: Oblivio
text:
Oblivio - Plot
Up on the rooftop of the building, Oblivio schemes to draw out the heroes by forming a giant rumbling bubble in the sky above, with which he will wipe out the memories of everyone in Paris. Plagg hears the noise in the sky, and upon seeing the looming threat, recalls Tikki's chiding words calling him selfish and a coward. Covering his feelings of guilt, Plagg declares to himself his desire to return to Adrien in the hope that the boy will have more Camembert and starts back toward the building.

title: Oblivio
text:
Oblivio - Plot
Back in the building, Marinette transforms into Ladybug and uses her yo-yo to learn about her powers from the built-in emergency user's guide. This leads to her accidentally call upon her Lucky Charm, resulting in a teapot, much to her confusion. With Adrien's help, she concludes that it must be a piece of a puzzle. As Ladybug leaves to fight Oblivio, Adrien pleads to accompany her, since they're a team. Ladybug reminds him that without his powers, there would be little he could do, and his identity would be exposed. This saddens him, but she tells him that most of all, she cares for him deeply and doesn't want him to get hurt, and she'll protect him. She kisses him on the cheek and leaves to face Oblivio.

title: Oblivio
text:
Oblivio - Plot
Ladybug finds the villain on the roof and defends herself. She finds out how the Miraculous enhances physical abilities and is soon being hunted down by Oblivio before falling off the building, saving herself by using her yo-yo. Adrien sees Ladybug's distress from the window of the office. He uses his own vision (representing his thought process) to see some cardboard boxes, scissors, and tape lying around the office and gets to work cutting and taping the boxes together. Meanwhile, Ladybug is fighting Oblivio but soon trips over her yo-yo string and is cornered, until Adrien, dressed as Cat Noir with cardboard boxes, arrives to help her. Without his powers, Adrien is unable to do much before he is forced to retreat. Ladybug rescues him, and the two hide. Plagg finally reappears, and Adrien, wasting no time, transforms into Cat Noir.

title: Oblivio
text:
Oblivio - Plot
The duo confronts Oblivio, Ladybug deflecting shots as Cat Noir tries to understand his own abilities and powers with his staff. Ladybug saves him from wasting his Cataclysm as she keeps protecting them from Oblivio's blasts. When Ladybug finally comes up with a plan, including how to use the teapot, she orders Cat Noir to distract Oblivio. While he does so, Ladybug slides towards the villain and with her yo-yo, manages to trap his hand with the teapot, preventing him from using his powers any longer. Cat Noir now calls upon his Cataclysm and destroys the object in which the akuma resides. Ladybug purifies the akuma, revealing that Oblivio was Nino and Alya, who are now rather dazed.
Cat Noir questions what to do about the giant bubble in the sky.
Ladybug explains that her second power is to cleanse the city with her Miraculous Ladybug, which in the process will wipe their memories of each others' true identities.
Saddened by this, Cat Noir asks Ladybug's permission, and the two share an intimate, heartfelt kiss.
At this point, Alya and Nino are aware again and are astonished to see their heroes kissing, with Alya taking a picture of the two in the moment.

title: Oblivio
text:
Oblivio - Plot
Ladybug finally uses Miraculous Ladybug, and before it cleanses everything, she and Cat Noir share a romantic hug.
Once the spell is over, the two, surprised, separate somewhat awkwardly.
When they see Alya and Nino, the heroes admit they can't remember what happened and ask where Oblivio is.
The couple reveals that the villain is already defeated and that they themselves were the ones akumatized.
Though they can't remember the events, the superheroes fist bump.
Cat Noir asserts that they make a good couple, which is what enables them to always win.
Ladybug quickly argues that they are merely a team, not a couple, as she is in love with someone else, and Cat Noir's flirtatiousness was to blame for the dire predicament they'd been in.
Cat Noir just keeps smiling and shows her Alya's picture of their kiss.
Ladybug freaks out, but her and Cat Noir's Miraculouses begin to beep.
Still angered, Ladybug assures him the conversation isn't over and leaves.
Ultimately, Hawk Moth won't soon forget it to Ladybug and Cat Noir, because the love they secretly have for each other will be their downfall for good!

title: Oblivio
text:
Oblivio - Plot
Later on, Alya and Nino reveal to their classmates why they'd been akumatized and apologize, with a kind reminder from Miss Bustier that while forgiven, they must behave themselves. The class accepts their apologies, with Adrien, as usual, being kind to Nino. While Marinette does the same for Alya, she's still wrecked from the earlier events.
At home, Marinette is distraught with the Ladybug and Cat Noir kiss posted on the Ladyblog. She can't fathom why she would kiss him, with Tikki suggesting that maybe she has more to learn about Cat Noir. From Adrien's end, though he's glad for the kiss, he anguishes at not remembering it. Plagg teases him that it's unlucky, but Adrien muses optimistically that if she had fallen for him, even if he can't remember, there is still hope for him and Ladybug to end up with each other.

title: Oblivio
text:
Oblivio - Plot Developments
This episode reveals that Marinette has Master Fu's phone number, listed in her cell phone as simply a turtle icon. This is clearly a reference to Master Fu wielding the Turtle Miraculous.
Another feature of the Miraculous tools is a built-in users guide and when the tools are converted to phone form they can be voiced activated.
This episode reveals that kwamis can also be affected by akumatized villains when fused with their owners but the effects only manifest upon de-transforming.
However, in "Dark Cupid", despite being fused together when being struck by the villain's arrow, Plagg could remember everything while Adrien couldn't. Comparing the two incidents in the former Ladybug was able to change Cat Noir before he detransformed thereby transferred to Plagg.
Hawk Moth is given the impression that Ladybug and Cat Noir are in love with each other.
It is revealed that the wielder of the Ladybug Miraculous does not need to throw the yo-yo into the air to activate the Lucky Charm.
Instead, the wielder can just say "Lucky Charm" to activate it.
This episode bears some resemblance to "Optigami":
Marinette and Adrien end up trapped in an elevator and are released by a kwami.

title: Oblivio
text:
Oblivio - Plot Developments
Both share a tender moment when their hands touch.

title: Oblivio
text:
Oblivio - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in UK & Ireland on Disney Channel.
This is the second time two people are akumatized with one akuma, following "Sapotis".
Coincidentally, both times a member of the Césaire family is involved with the akumatization.
Unlike "Sapotis", where two separate villains were created with one akuma, this time, the akuma merges two people into one villain's body.
Despite them not remembering what happened, Tikki and Adrien interact again, the first time being when they first met in "Reflekdoll".
Ladybug and Cat Noir also discover each other's civilian identities until the Miraculous Ladybug reverts their memories to before they got amnesia, erasing the knowledge.
A visual representation of what a supervillain sees when Hawk Moth is talking to them is shown when he communicates with Oblivio.
This is the first time a visual representation of Marinette's thought process and her strategic planning is shown despite her not being transformed.
This is also the first time Adrien's thought process is shown, with the objects being highlighted with stripes of the same colors as his civilian shirt print.

title: Oblivio
text:
Oblivio - Trivia
This is the second time Ladybug and Cat Noir share a kiss, following "Dark Cupid". Unlike the first time, they both forget it; however, similar to "Prime Queen" they recall the kiss through a photograph and are shocked by it.
Unlike in "Dark Cupid", the true love's kiss does not break the effect of the akumatized villain's power.
Throughout the whole episode, Oblivio claims to be Ladybug's and Cat Noir's best friend, which is ironic, since Alya and Nino are Marinette's and Adrien's best friends, respectively.
Even though, Alya and Nino knew that Marinette had feelings for Adrien, without knowing it as their akumatized alter ego they put the heroes together.
However, no one, aside from Master Fu and the kwamis, knows the real identities of the heroes.
However, after Master Fu's amnesia after giving the Miracle box to Marinette, Alya (only knows Marinette's identity) and Luka (knows both Adrien and Marinette's identities (despite the fact that Marinette nor Adrien don't know that Luka has this knowledge).

title: Oblivio
text:
Oblivio - Trivia
When Alya and Nino are de-akumatized, when Ladybug and Cat Noir ask where Oblivio is, Nino says: "You've defeated her already." Alya says: "Actually, he was us." Alya says Oblivio is male, when Nino says Oblivio is female.
References
There are some references from previous Miraculous episodes:
There's a reference to "Ladybug & Cat Noir" when Marinette screams and calls Tikki and Plagg "bug-mice", and Adrien calls them genies.
Marinette also calls Tikki "a thing" just like what Alya called Trixx in "Sapotis".
This is also referenced with the Lucky Charm being a teapot. However, unlike the one in "Sapotis", Ladybug uses this one to stop Oblivio.
This is the fifth time where Ladybug's Lucky Charm is an object from a previous episode.
The poster of the Ladybug and Cat Noir movie from "Animaestro" is in the office room Marinette and Adrien hide in.

title: Oblivio
text:
Oblivio - Trivia
The picture Adrien pulls up of Ladybug from his phone is the exact one Théo Barbot based the statue of her off of in "Copycat". Some of the other photos he has were from "Kung Food", "Gigantitan", "Horrificator", "Reflekta", "Darkblade", "Gorizilla", "Prime Queen" and "Stormy Weather", revealing that "Oblivio" came after all of these episodes.
Plagg starts seeing Adrien's posters everywhere just like the titular villain in "Gorizilla".
Adrien calling Marinette amazing with and without the costume is similar to what Tikki said to her in "Antibug".
Adrien disguising himself in a cardboard version of his hero suit references back to what Alya did in "The Dark Owl".
After their memories are restored Ladybug once again tells Cat Noir that she's in love with another guy as she did in "Glaciator" and "Frozer".
Marinette kisses Adrien on the cheek as she did in "Mayura".
When Ladybug says to Cat Noir that they are a team, she said the same thing to Chloé in "Antibug".
At the end of the episode, Cat Noir saying that he and Ladybug are meant to be is referencing what Master Fu said about them at the end of "Stoneheart".

title: Oblivio
text:
Oblivio - Trivia
Plagg babbling when he is transforming Adrien into Cat Noir is a reference to when he transformed Adrien in "The Bubbler".
Alya and Nino are both akumatized for the third time.
However, unlike their previous akumatizations, they are not akumatized into Lady Wifi or Bubbler, their first akumatized forms, or into Rena Rage and Shell Shock, their akumatized forms while transformed with their Miraculouses, but rather, into Oblivio.
Oblivio's akumatization is not shown, making this the fifth time this happens, after Magician of Misfortune in "Princess Fragrance", Vanisher in "Antibug" and the Unnamed boy in "Sandboy", August akumatization in "Weredad".
This also the sixth episode where Ladybug and Cat Noir use their powers twice following "The Dark Owl", "Mayura", "Miraculous Shanghai", "Reflekdoll" and "Weredad".
This is the fourth time Tikki and Plagg are seen interacting together onscreen following "The Dark Owl", "Sandboy", and "Reflekdoll".
Allusions
It is revealed that most of Miss Bustier's class plays the game Super Penguino, the game itself being a reference to Super Mario.

title: Oblivio
text:
Oblivio - Trivia
It was previously mentioned that Nino and Alya play Super Penguino back in issue #2 of the Miraculous Adventures comic series.
Cat Noir references The Lion King when he says "I have no idea what the 'Hakuna Matata' is, but I trust you."
When Marinette and Adrien trick Oblivio with the phone, he finds a crude drawing of a donkey. This maybe a reference to calling someone a jackass.
Errors
In the bathroom when Adrien is talking about Plagg and Tikki, his ring is black when it should be silver.
When Marinette blows on Adrien's cellphone to show the password, a space is missed.
From both times she looks at them, the contacts shown on Marinette's cellphone are (as shown, in order): Adrien, Alya, Nino, Sabine Cheng, Wang Fu, and Tom Dupain. The order she lists them, at least in the English version, is: "Agreste, Césaire, Couffaine, Dupain-Cheng Sabine".
From losing her memory, she would not know the last names of her contacts (apart from Adrien).
She would also have no reason to prefix "Dupain" to Sabine's last name.
This error doesn't occur in the French dub.

title: Oblivio
text:
Oblivio - Trivia
When Cat Noir transforms, he is shown to be in his civillian clothes, despite wearing the cardboard suit in the previous shot, as he had only taken off the helmet.
When Cat Noir uses Cataclysm on Oblivio's akumatized object, the paws on his ring are miscolored blue.
At that same moment, the teapot blocking Oblivio's right hand is gone. During their de-akumatization, however, the teapot is back in place, as well as the akumatized object being seen on their hand when it had been destroyed by Cat Noir's Cataclysm moments ago.
When Ladybug picks up the teapot after defeating Oblivio, the lid is missing; when Cat Noir grabs her arm, it reappears.
Hawk Moth's mask is miscolored dark gray/black throughout the episode.
Cat Noir smiles at the image Alya took, however, he doesn't seem to look at it at all.
