title: Notre-Dame de Paris/Movie
text:
Notre-Dame de Paris/Movie - Intro
The Notre-Dame de Paris, also known as Notre Dame Cathedral or simply as Notre-Dame, is a historic Catholic cathedral on the eastern half of the Île de la Cité in the fourth arrondissement of Paris, France.

title: Notre-Dame de Paris/Movie
text:
Notre-Dame de Paris/Movie - Description
Exterior
Portals
Iconographically representing the judgement of God where the damned are punished and the blessed are welcomed to eternal life, the portal of the Last Judgement is the main portal of the Notre-Dame de Paris cathedral.
The sculpture of the tympanum represents Jesus in glory surrounded by two angels carrying the instruments of his crucifixion, the spear and nails for one, the cross for the other, all with Mary and Saint John kneeling on the sides. Below, on the upper architrave, the archangel Michael is depicted weighing the souls with two demons trying to tip the scales. In the lower architrave, the dead rise and come out of their tomb. The angels play the trumpet. These characters include a pope, a king, women, warriors and an African man.
The lower keys of the arches are occupied, on the side of the damned, by infernal scenes, and on the side of the elect, by the patriarchs, among whom we see Abraham holding the souls in a fold of his cloak.

title: Notre-Dame de Paris/Movie
text:
Notre-Dame de Paris/Movie - Description
The embrasure features the sculptures of the twelve apostles, while Christ is on the trumeau between the two wooden doors. Below the apostles, twenty-four bas-reliefs, arranged in two superimposed rows, illustrate twelve "virtues" to which the "vices" refer.
Of the same model, but older and smaller, are the other two portals of the main facade of the cathedral, depicting the Virgin Mary and Saint Anne (mother of the Virgin Mary and grandmother of Christ).
Interior
The interior architecture of the cathedral is built on three levels, illuminated by large stained glass windows. A double ambulatory rotates around the nave. The Gothic style is characterized by the ribbed vault.
Around the central space, beyond the row of columns, there is a space for the faithful to wander. This space is called the ambulatory. Notre-Dame Cathedral is characterized by a double row of columns that form the side aisles. When the building was enlarged in the 13th century, chapels were placed around the side aisles. These double naves and the double ambulatory of the choir are a unique example in medieval religious architecture.

title: Notre-Dame de Paris/Movie
text:
Notre-Dame de Paris/Movie - Description
Like most churches, the cathedral has a Latin cross plan. The transept forms the horizontal arm of the cross. The space at the intersection of the cross is called the transept crossing. This volume is proportional to the size of the cathedral. Liturgical celebrations take place in this space. The two arms of the transept are also called crosspieces. In the 13th century, Pierre de Montreuil treated the lower walls as external facades, inserting a decorative system of arches, curves and friezes to reinforce the wall. The north rose window has preserved the original 13th-century stained glass windows almost intact, while the south rose window, offered by Saint Louis, was largely restored in the 18th and 19th centuries.
Choir
The liturgical choir is dedicated to the religious rite. On the outside, it corresponds to the apse of the cathedral. Christian churches are oriented east/west. This part is oriented towards Jerusalem, the city of the crucifixion of Jesus Christ. The choir is formed by four rectilinear bays closed by a pentagonal semicircular apse. It has the same elevation elements as the nave. It has a double ambulatory as in the central nave.

title: Notre-Dame de Paris/Movie
text:
Notre-Dame de Paris/Movie - Description
Rose windows and stained glass windows
The Cathedral of Notre-Dame de Paris is illuminated by over 120 glass roofs dating back to the period between the 12th and 20th centuries. The only medieval stained glass windows still existing are those of the three west, north and south roses, dating back to the 13th century.

title: Notre-Dame de Paris/Movie
text:
Notre-Dame de Paris/Movie - Description
It has eighty-four panels distributed on four circles. Their number is based on the symbolic numbers four, twelve and twenty-four. The twelve apostles are divided into the two circles. They are intermingled with martyr saints often honored in France including Laurent, Denis (first bishop of Paris), Pothin (bishop of Lyon), Marguerite, Blandine, Georges, Ambroise, Eustache. The third and fourth circles depict scenes from the New and Old Testament, the flight into Egypt, the healing of a paralytic, the judgment of Solomon and the annunciation. Nine scenes from the life of Saint Matthew date back to the end of the 12th century. The two pendentives represent on one side the descent into hell, surrounded by Moses and Aaron (top) and the temptation of Adam and Eve (bottom); on the other, the resurrection of Christ, with Saint Peter and Saint Paul (bottom), Saint Magdalene and Saint John (top).

title: Notre-Dame de Paris/Movie
text:
Notre-Dame de Paris/Movie - Trivia
On April 15, 2019, the real-life counterpart of the cathedral was severely damaged by a fire that engulfed the structure, but it was re-opened on December 8, 2024.
The Parvis Notre-Dame is the kilometer point 0 of the road network of France.
The Notre-Dame de Paris is the location of the very first akumatization in the movie, replacing the Collège Françoise Dupont in the TV series.
Differences
Unlike the movie, the interior of the cathedral has not yet appeared in the television series.

title: Nouveau Monde
text:
Nouveau Monde - Intro
is a television program created and presented live by Alec Cataldi.

title: Nouveau Monde
text:
Nouveau Monde - Concept
During this new show, Alec invites people who have made changes in the world, or more precisely in Paris. He kindly allows them to expose their actions.

title: Nouveau Monde
text:
Nouveau Monde - Participants
Host
Alec Cataldi
Guests
Caline Bustier, mayor of Paris.
Harmonie, daughter of Caline.

title: Nouveau Monde
text:
Nouveau Monde - Trivia
During this program in "Re-creation", several pieces of news were revealed:
It was revealed that Caline was elected as the new mayor of Paris after defeating Armand D'Argencourt in the municipal elections, and that in the space of a few weeks (or two months) she initiated many changes in Paris.
It was revealed that the Alliance rings were recycled to build a silver statue of Gabriel in the Place des Vosges for his "sacrifice" that allowed Ladybug to defeat Monarch.
It was revealed that Caline gave birth to a baby girl, whom she named Harmonie.
At the end of the broadcast, Mayor Bustier revealed her plan to create a school that will welcome children of all ages and will be directed by Denis Damoclès.

title: Noé Luxus
text:
Noé Luxus - Intro
is one of the overarching antagonists of season 6 of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug and Cat Noir. He is the chairman and CEO of Luxus Corp. and the son of Audrey Bourgeois, and thus the older half-brother to Chloé Bourgeois and Zoé Lee. He is also a member of The Kingdom, succeeding Gabriel Agreste as The Diamond.

title: Noé Luxus
text:
Noé Luxus - Appearance
Physical appearance
Noé is a tall, handsome fair-skinned young man with short combed-back honey-blonde hair, vivid sapphire blue eyes, and a Greek nose.
Civilian attire
Noé wears a white blazer with thin reflective silver lines and a black high-neck top, along with a diamond necklace and silver diamond earrings, matching trousers of his blazer, and golden high heeled boots.

title: Noé Luxus
text:
Noé Luxus - Personality
Much like his mother Audrey and half-sister Chloé, Noé is cruel towards others and their feelings. He is willing to do anything for his own objectives, even if that means twisting the truth. This is seen in his intent to stain the reputations of Ladybug, Cat Noir, and Caline Bustier before all of Paris, or causing Nadja Chamack to get fired when she tried to expose the truth behind his defamatory movie script.
However, unlike his mother and half-sister, who prefer more aggressive tactics, Noé portrays himself as a very charismatic young man with a likable personality in order to lure others in. He uses this along with his cunning nature to lie his way out of facing consequences, such as after the attack of The Mime revealed the truth about the movie he intended to produce.

title: Noé Luxus
text:
Noé Luxus - Abilities
A very wealthy and shrewd businessman, he is the chairman of Luxus Corp., a highly successful conglomerate. To increase his influence, he possesses the financial power necessary to acquire companies and incorporate them into his group, or even become their majority stockholder, as in the case of the TVi Group.
He is therefore capable of radically altering the objectives and image of these companies. For instance, he orchestrated the dismissal of Nadja from TVi to prevent the release of her exclusive reports on the true nature of the film "Ladybug's Secret", which he produced. Consequently, he also uses these companies to promote his own narrative and career, and he is prepared to use them to become mayor of Paris by spreading false information about the latest municipal elections.

title: Noé Luxus
text:
Noé Luxus - Relationships
Family
Audrey Bourgeois
Unlike his sisters, Noé seems to have a very positive relationship with Audrey, being her favorite out of her children, possibly due to the fact that, unlike Chloé (who brought shame to Audrey around the end of season 5) and Zoé (who turned out to be opposite of her mother and siblings), he is a successful businessman that helped advanced the Kingdom's plans.
It is shown that Noé can easily convince and reason with his mother.
Chloé Bourgeois
Chloé is Noé's younger maternal half-sister from their mother's relationship with her ex-husband.
In "Queen of the Dreadzone", Noé is revealed to be the one managing Chloé's career as an influencer. He takes advantage of the fact that her attitude is too comical to be noticed as unacceptable, which brings her a lot of followers across the world. Noé is very supportive of her ideas, encouraging everything she says and even convincing Audrey to accept them. In turn, he's become the person she calls when things don't go her way, such as when the Mayoress informed that she could no longer shoot her movie at the school.
Zoé Lee
Zoé is Noé's youngest maternal half-sister from their mother's relationship with Mr. Lee.

title: Noé Luxus
text:
Noé Luxus - Relationships
In "Queen of the Dreadzone", Noé witnessed Zoé enter the school alongside Sabrina and Marinette, although the nature of their relationship remains unknown.
Friends/Allies
Arlette
TBA
Enemies
Adrien Agreste/Cat Noir
Noé tries to convince Adrien to sell him Gabriel in order to continue his father's legacy, using seemingly reasonable arguments to manipulate and persuade him to accept the deal.
Noé harbors clear disdain for Cat Noir, going so far as to produce a film solely to discredit him in the eyes of Parisians, hoping they would come to hate him. This hostility is clearly shown when the Miraculers arrive with Mime at the TVi Tower.
Ladybug
Noé holds a strong dislike for Ladybug, even producing a film purely to tarnish her reputation in the eyes of Parisians, hoping they would despise her. This resentment becomes fully evident when the Miraculers arrive with Mime at the TVi Tower.
Despite his antagonism, he seems to hold respect for Ladybug. After Chloé's banishment from Paris, he finds the charm Ladybug created for her, but before it can be thrown away, he takes it, and admires its power.
Fred Haprèle/The Mime

title: Noé Luxus
text:
Noé Luxus - Relationships
Noé wanted Fred to be the lead actor in his upcoming movie. Through this role, he intended for Fred to embody his defamatory message against the Parisian superheroes.
Fred was particularly reluctant after reading the film's script and attempted to expose Noé's actions through Nadja. However, following the journalist's dismissal and his daughter's distress, Fred was akumatized by Chrysalis with the goal of making Noé reconsider his film.
Nadja Chamack
After becoming the main stockholder of the TVi Group, Noé orchestrated Nadja's dismissal from her position as news presenter, as he did not want her to air a report against "Ladybug's Secret", which would have ruined his plan to discredit the superheroes.

title: Noé Luxus
text:
Noé Luxus - History
Season 6
In "Yaksi Gozen", Noé was named the new Diamond in the Kingdom, replacing the late Gabriel Agreste.
In "Noe", he showed up at the Agreste mansion for a reunion with Adrien Agreste and Nathalie Sancoeur, where he proposed the purchase of the Gabriel brand into his conglomerate, where it would become the jewel at the core, trying to convince him by remarking the weight of the fashion world on Adrien and promising to honor the legacy of his late father, letting him keep the contract papers so he could give it some thought before signing. Later, he showed up at the TVi Tower to present himself as their new stockholder. When Nadja Chamack showed up to try reporting "Ladybug's Secret", he was involved in firing her from the channel, as it would affect his plans alongside the Kingdom. He replaced her with Mr. Banana as the news anchor, getting presented live on the TV as the new star of luxury business to give his opinion on the accusations against Caline Bustier's election, claiming to be devastated and offering to run for Mayor of Paris himself.

title: Noé Luxus
text:
Noé Luxus - History
When Mime broke into the TVi Tower, Noé promptly summoned a team of bodyguards to defend him, escaping from the building by car, along with several identical to the one he was in. He was eventually located by Polymouse, the heroes bringing him back to the building and putting him on the spotlight in front of a camera to speak out about the movie script so they could deakumatize the villain. He continued to argue that the script told the truth about the heroes being Monarch's accomplices. After the Mime was deakumatized, Fred confronted Noé about his responsibility as a story producer to portray Ladybug and Cat Noir as the true heroes they are. He apologized and claimed to have been fooled by the script, saying that it would be rewritten (though Marinette wasn't convinced that he's telling the truth). Later, he entered a car to join his mother, announcing that Paris now knew him and the next phase of their plan could begin.

title: Noé Luxus
text:
Noé Luxus - History
In "Queen of the Dreadzone", Noé stood by his mother's side at Collège Françoise Dupont as they watched the setup and shooting of Chloé's movie. Despite Audrey trying to reprimand and cut off Chloé's ideas that went against their initial plans, such as wanting to chop down the tree and allow Marinette, Sabrina and Zoé into the school, Noé encouraged her, showing and convincing Audrey that it would actually help them by earning her way more followers, reaching closer to becoming the world's number-one influencer and explaining how her caricature-like personality makes evil become a fun trend rather than her actions being noticed as unacceptable. They witnessed Chloé's interaction with the girls, exchanging glances the moment she was about to get akumatized. Later on, inside the private jet on their way to London, Noé asked the assistant to give him the magical charm Chloé had received from Ladybug, admiring the artifact in his hand.

title: Noé Luxus
text:
Noé Luxus - Etymology
Noé follows the same first-name structure as his half-sisters, Chloé and Zoé, as all three have names that end in -oé.
The given name Noé comes from the Hebrew name Noach (נֹחַ), which is commonly understood as meaning "rest" or "comfort".
The surname Luxus comes from Latin luxus, meaning "luxury", "excess", or "extravagance".

title: Noé Luxus
text:
Noé Luxus - Trivia
Despite Noé's name having an acute accent, the episode named after him is spelled without it, in both English and French.
This is unlike "Félix", which is spelled with the diacritic in both versions.
Long before Noé's introduction, Thomas Astruc joked in a tweet from 2021 about Chloé having a secret brother also named Noé.
However, the premise of the joke was that Zoé is Marinette and Noé's daughter from the future whose goal is to break her "mother" and Adrien up.

title: Nozomi Tsurugi
text:
Nozomi Tsurugi - Intro
is a minor character in Miraculous World: Tokyo - Stellar Force. She is owner of a dorayaki shop in Tokyo. She is also Tomoe's mother and Kagami's grandmother.

title: Nozomi Tsurugi
text:
Nozomi Tsurugi - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Nozomi has a slim and petite build, with a small body and slightly rounded proportions. Her oval face features soft cheeks and fine wrinkles, while her large, almond-shaped eyes are bluish-gray. She has a small, slightly rounded nose, thin lips, and small ears framed by short light pink hair. Her hairstyle is a pixie cut with darker roots, with softly lifted ends that leave her forehead completely uncovered.
Civilian Attire
She wears a purple yukata with a light pink lining and an orange obi tied around her waist, along with a pair of gray tabi over zori sandals with a black strap and white sole.

title: Nozomi Tsurugi
text:
Nozomi Tsurugi - Personality
In contrast to her daughter, Nozomi is a sweet and kind woman. She enjoys meeting Kagami 's friends. She greatly appreciates Japanese legends and the festivals that celebrate them. She attends the various matsuri held at Sensō-ji Temple, especially the Hoshi matsuri .

title: Nozomi Tsurugi
text:
Nozomi Tsurugi - Abilities
Nozomi runs the famous dorayaki shop. According to Kagami, she makes the best dorayaki in Tokyo . She is therefore able to prepare these sweets and then sell them in her shop or stall at Sensō-ji.

title: Nozomi Tsurugi
text:
Nozomi Tsurugi - Relationships
Family
Tomoe Tsurugi
It's not known much about Nozomi's relationship with her daughter, but it's apparently a distant one as Tomoe clearly has cut her off from her life, due to not mentioning her often nor Nozomi did ask about her while her granddaughter visited her in "Miraculous Tokyo".
And it's likely that Nozomi is unaware of her daughter previously aiding the supervillain Monarch.
Kagami Tsurugi/Ryuko
Contrary to her daughter, Nozomi is affectionate towards Kagami, speaking to her calmly. She is happy when Kagami brings Marinette with her. She had also noticed Kagami's feelings for Kazuno, unaware that they were not reciprocated.
Kagami seems to love her grandmother very much. At events where she wears yukata, she wears shoes that her grandmother gave her.
Nozomi finds out her granddaughter is Ryuko after Kagami transformed to protect herself, Nozomi and Shinobu.
Love interests
Shinobu
Nozomi is Shinobu's partner. They both work together at Tsurugi's Dorayaki Shop, with Shinobu as her delivery girl. Nozomi seems to trust her partner a lot and seems to enjoy holding her by the waist during their rides on their tricycle rides.
Acquaintances
Marinette Dupain-Cheng

title: Nozomi Tsurugi
text:
Nozomi Tsurugi - Relationships
Nozomi is overjoyed to meet a friend of Kagami's. To celebrate, she has prepared a delicious meal, which Marinette can't resist devouring. Nozomi is delighted by Marinette's interest in the Hoshi Matsuri, explaining the legend behind the festival at length.

title: Nozomi Tsurugi
text:
Nozomi Tsurugi - Etymology
The name Nozomi has two different combinations of Japanese kanji:
One being "nozo" (希) meaning "hope" , "mi" (実,美,海) meaning "fruit", "beautiful" or "sea" respectfully.
Another one being "nozomi" (望) meaning "wish, desire, hope".

title: Nozomi Tsurugi
text:
Nozomi Tsurugi - Trivia
As Kagami's grandfather was mentioned in "Riposte", it is unknown whether she is widowed or divorced.

title: Nozomi's house
text:
Nozomi's house - Intro
is the traditional family home of the Tsurugi family in Tokyo.

title: Nozomi's house
text:
Nozomi's house - Appearance
Exterior
Nozomi Tsurugi's house is a traditional Japanese house located just behind the Tsurugi's Dorayaki Shop, accessed through a wide sliding wooden lattice door on the side of the store. It is protected by a pristine white perimeter wall with a protective gray base and topped by a small dark tile roof (Kawara) with a thin red line running beneath it.
The building itself adheres to the standards of noble architecture: a solid wood structure with Shinkabe-style walls, filled with a white Shikkui plaster, applied according to the Sakan tradition. The roofs are massive, covered with dark tiles, and feature wide eaves that protect the facade.
The house rises two stories. On the second floor (Nikai), the main room (Nikaibeya) is bathed in the twilight, its windows partially shaded by bamboo blinds (Sudare). The whole is surrounded by a large garden, whose lush vegetation can be glimpsed extending beyond the perimeter wall.
Interior
The interior of the building adheres to the Sukiya-zukuri style. The rooms are arranged in Washitsu, featuring tatami floors and sliding paper (Shoji) partitions that filter the light, as well as sakan walls.

title: Nozomi's house
text:
Nozomi's house - Appearance
Each centerpiece features a Tokonoma, a traditional decorative alcove found in Japanese houses.
The house opens to the outside with Engawa, polished wooden verandas forming exterior corridors that act as transitions between rooms. Sheltered by the building's eaves, they offer direct access to and views of the garden.
Finally, the garden seems to have a very zen section, with stone steps, a potted shrub, and another much larger section with more imposing trees.
Vestibule
Behind the lattice door (Koushi-do), the vestibule of the house (Genkan) features a floor (tataki) of natural stones with an Andon-type light fixture illuminating the room.
Once their shoes are removed, visitors can use the shikidai, an intermediate wooden step that reflects the noble character of the residence, to facilitate the ascent to the agari-kamachi. This particularly tall and entirely wooden structure marks the definitive boundary with the interior of the residence, as well as the prestige of its occupant. To the right of the agari-kamachi, one can see a round window with a wooden latticework, a Marumado.
Living room/Ima

title: Nozomi's house
text:
Nozomi's house - Appearance
The living room of the house, the Ima (居間), is accessed from the engawa through two sliding shoji screens. The room is arranged around a Chabudai, a rectangular wooden table surrounded by four scarlet Zabuton cushions. The space is illuminated by a hanging lantern, which creates a warm atmosphere while highlighting the various decorative arrangements.
This central room features a clean and elegant tokonoma. This decorative alcove houses a Kakejiku, a hanging scroll, depicting Mount Fuji and overlooking two Ikebana floral arrangements: the first composed of white flowers and a budding branch in a terracotta vase, and the second with much taller and more slender branches that rise towards the ceiling in a large grey-beige vase.
To the left of the tokonoma, there is a set of Chigai-dana-style shelves, with a flared bowl on the top shelf, a decorative fan (sensu) on a stand, and a slender vase and a few stacked books on the bottom shelf. These shelves appear to form a larger piece of furniture with a flat-screen television in the center.
Washing area/Araiba

title: Nozomi's house
text:
Nozomi's house - Appearance
The washing area, Araiba, is a room entirely paneled with dark wood and shoji screens to close off access to the bath, as well as gray tiled flooring. It has two modern showers, one opposite the bath entrance and the other to one side, each with a removable shower head mounted on an adjustable bar and a wooden stool (furo-isu) used during washing.
On the right, a large open storage unit, also made of wood, holds toiletries, towels, and baskets where owners and guests place their personal belongings.
Rotenburo
Rotenburo is nestled in the garden of the house, sheltered by a wide overhanging roof and surrounded by rocks. The basin is made of smooth stone with a dark wooden frame. Hot water flows into the basin through two narrower pipes on either side, creating a soothing sound. Two traditional stone lanterns, Tōrō (灯籠), cast a warm orange glow in the evening. A small bucket, which can be filled with water, is attached to the corner of the wooden frame.
Discreet lighting fixtures provide a soft glow to the vegetation, including a bonsai tree and pine trees (Niwaki), to create an even more soothing atmosphere around the bath.
Kagami's room

title: Nozomi's house
text:
Nozomi's house - Appearance
Like the rest of the house, Kagami's room is in the Washitsu style. It's a very simple room with a shelf containing manga, a few books, and a framed photo of her friends from Kano Academy. Nearby is a tokonoma (a wall-mounted display) with a woodblock print, a mannequin bust wearing the top part of Kagami's red fencing outfit, two fencing swords on stands, and a third sword hanging on the wall.
Further on, there's a desk with a two-drawer filing cabinet, a cabinet with a door, and a work surface with a desk lamp, a green pen holder, a small red clock, and a small stack of books, along with a purple-seated office chair. Against the wall, there's a small green plant, and to the side, fixed to the wall above the desk, is a small wall shelf with green, orange, and yellow books. The room also has a white screen and a white lampshade on the ceiling.
Kagami's bed has a very thin mattress and a red blanket, with a second similar mattress that can be set up if Kagami has a guest.

This is the second house of a grandparent of The Miraculers to appear in the series, the first one being Roland's residence in "Bakerix".

title: Office of the Mayor of Paris
text:
Office of the Mayor of Paris - Intro
The  is the room where the mayor of Paris works, located inside the City Hall of Paris.
Until "Collusion", the office belonged to André Bourgeois, who used it for his mayoral duties. At the end of the episode of the same name, after André resigns as mayor, Chloé proclaims herself mayor of Paris.

id: Office of the Mayor of Paris::Appearance::0
title: Office of the Mayor of Paris
text:
Office of the Mayor of Paris - Appearance
The office of the Mayor of Paris is a large room in shades of brown and gold. Large wall-mounted bookcases have been installed on the side of the entrance above which we find the coat of arms of Paris.
Opposite the entrance is the mayor's desk. It is a large rectangular table made of polished wood with one side forming a semicircle. There is a black telephone, some documents and a stamp. There are two large armchairs with blue cushions and a golden frame. Behind the desk is a large black fireplace topped by a slab of light marble on which two decorative vases have been placed.
To the right of the desk is a model of the city of Paris. Closer to the window is a large white vase with floral motifs. On the wall hangs the painting "The Castle of Versailles" by Pierre Patel. On the left is a small relaxation area with armchairs and a low table. Some small wardrobes and small desks decorate the whole.
The floor is made of a simple wooden parquet, while the ceiling is colored and upholstered in red with decorative motifs. The room is finally illuminated by golden chandeliers that hang from the ceiling as well as by chandeliers near the door.

id: Office of the Mayor of Paris::Trivia::0
title: Office of the Mayor of Paris
text:
Office of the Mayor of Paris - Trivia
In "Robostus", thanks to the powers of the eponymous villain, the lamp on André's desk temporarily came to life and declared on live television that humans would be treated like objects.

title: Otis Césaire
text:
Otis Césaire - Intro
is a minor character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He is a zookeeper at Ménagerie du Jardin des Plantes. He is also the husband of Marlena Césaire, the father of Alya, Ella and Etta, and the step-father of Nora Césaire.
In "Animan", as a result of Lê Chiến Kim's mockery at the zoo, Otis was akumatized by Hawk Moth and became Animan, an animal shapeshifting supervillain.

title: Otis Césaire
text:
Otis Césaire - Appearance
Physical appearance
Otis is a plump man with grayish tangelo eyes, and light brown skin tone. He has short brown hair with a full beard and sideburns.
From season 6 onwards, his hair is now tied in a bun and his beard is connected with the sideburns of his hair.
Civilian attire
He rests glasses with large black frames on his forehead, but never wears them. He appeared to be wearing a Hawaiian shirt that is pale yellow with pale pink and light amaranthtish gray palm designs. On his left wrist, he wears a bracelet that features a animal tooth. He also wears pale green jeans and brown work shoes.
From season 6 onwards, he also wears a different flower-patterned shirt and starts wearing his glasses.
As Animan
Animan could transform into any animal with tails in different sizes he chose, but retained glowing brilliant blue-violet eyes and the akumatized bracelet on his wrist. The most common form he took was a black panther.

title: Otis Césaire
text:
Otis Césaire - Personality
Otis is very serious about his job as a zookeeper and he feels that the animals there deserve respect. He doesn't like it when someone insults him and/or the animals. At the same time, Otis is loving and helpful, caring about his wife and daughters. This is especially seen how he loves Nora (his step-daughter) the same he does with Alya, Etta and Ella, even if there's no blood bond between them. He helps in the search for Adrien Agreste, who is missing, in "Santa Claws", and he and his family come to check on him once he is safe at home.
As Animan, he supported the animals, setting them free. He went for revenge against Kim for making fun of him and the zoo's new panther. Animan carefully chose the animals he shapeshifted into to help him succeed, whether to get Kim or defeat Ladybug and Cat Noir.

title: Otis Césaire
text:
Otis Césaire - Abilities
As a Civilian
As a zookeeper, Otis is trained to work with and take care of a wide variety of animals, like panthers.
As Animan
Animan could transform into any animal he desired, including extinct species such as dinosaurs. He also possessed the ability to communicate clearly with other animals. However, frequent transformations would tire him out.

title: Otis Césaire
text:
Otis Césaire - Relationships
Otis seems to dislike Kim to some extent. In "Animan", Kim and his friend, Max are looking at the new panther as she eats her food. Max tells Kim how fast the panther can move and he replies that he could easily beat the panther. Otis, the zookeeper grows aggravated by this comment and tells Kim not to bother the animal. Kim continues to taunt both the zookeeper and the panther by boasting about winning the County Athletics Tournament. Max pointed out that it would be much more likely for the panther to eat Kim rather than chase him, but Kim ignores the comment. Once again, Otis tells Kim to stop bothering the panther but he seemingly doesn't care about what Otis says. However though, Kim just remains persistent in mocking the "poor tomcat" and her "cranky nanny" as he and Max go away. Later, Otis was so upset by Kim's mockery that he gets akumatized by Hawk Moth.
As Animan, he goes for revenge against Kim for making fun of him and the zoo's new panther.

title: Otis Césaire
text:
Otis Césaire - Etymology
Otis' name is a reference to Otis Redding, just as the rest of his family's names are references to jazz singers.
Animan is a play on the words animal and man.
In the Turkish dub, Animan's name is Bakıcı, which translates to Keeper.

title: Otis Césaire
text:
Otis Césaire - Trivia
His name is never mentioned in "Animan".
Even though his name has been confirmed to be Otis Césaire, his name tag reads "Otis R." in the aforementioned episode.
Along with Wang Cheng and Lila Rossi, Otis is one of three characters who gets akumatized but does not appear in the season 1 theme song. However, he and Wang Cheng make an appearance in the theme song animatic.
When asked what Otis' relationship is to Alya's family, Thomas Astruc jokingly replied that he is "Alya's younger brother."
A scarlet version of Animan reappeared in the two-part special event "Heroes' Day".
In "Sadnansi", it's revealed that Nora is not his biological daughter, making him her stepfather. However, considering she still has his last name, it's very likely that he fully adopted her.

title: Orikko
text:
Orikko - Intro
is a supporting character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He is the kwami of Pretension who is connected to the Rooster Miraculous. With his power, Orikko's wearer can use the thumb ring to transform into a rooster-themed superhero.
Orikko and his Miraculous are currently owned by Marc Anciel, who uses it to transform into the superhero Rooster Bold.

title: Orikko
text:
Orikko - Appearance
Orikko is 10 centimeters (or 4 inches) tall and has burnt orange skin, the color getting lighter the further down his body, with orange eyes and yellow sclerae. He has a rooster comb on his head, a yellow beak, and a rooster-like tail with three tips.
In most episodes, Orikko's eyes appear partially open (almost like he is squinting), but in season 5, he's usually seen with his eyes fully open.

title: Orikko
text:
Orikko - Personality
Orikko appears to be a very prideful kwami, being easily offended, evidenced when Gabriel called him "useless" when he was told of the limitations of the kwami's power. The other kwamis inclusively said to Gabriel that he shouldn't have insulted Orikko as it appears that he becomes unwilling to cooperate when that happens. When he was first introduced to Marc, Orikko appeared eager to assist in the soccer match.

title: Orikko
text:
Orikko - Abilities
Orikko can fly, levitate, and phase through solid objects. He can also carry objects that are larger and/or heavier than himself.
As a kwami, Orikko is able to transform the holder of the Rooster Miraculous into a rooster-themed superhero, giving the wearer the power of Sublimation, allowing the user to give themself any superpower they choose. However, as revealed in "Destruction", Orikko's superpowers do have some limitations. Sublimation cannot take the form of a wish, it has to be an ability. Orikko also can't give a power that already belongs to another kwami, since each kwami represents a unique concept and a concept can only exist once in the universe. Finally, Orikko can't give a power that would disrupt another kwami's magic, like the power of finding a miraculous user's secret identity, the quantum masking is part of the kwami's power.
However, Orikko's version of the power is unknown but stronger and will cause a catastrophe if used without a holder.

title: Orikko
text:
Orikko - Relationships
Friends/Allies
Marc Anciel/Rooster Bold
Although their interactions are not seen much, they appear to be good friends as Orikko eagerly greeted Marc when they first met and was seen nuzzling Marc's cheek when they were reunited.
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/Ladybug
Like the other kwamis of the miracle box, Orikko was aware that his sister Tikki had an owner, and officially became acquainted with Marinette in "Kwamibuster". Then, by "Miracle Queen", became his new guardian and thereby is good friends with her and enjoyed the freedom she allowed them to have in her home. He was also supportive and caring of her emotions as both a regular girl and the new guardian.
Nathaniel Kurtzberg/Caprikid
He was aware that Nathaniel was his owner's lover and in "The Ruler" cutscene, officially got to meet him as his hero alter ego Caprikid discovering that the boy is Ziggy's owner.
Ziggy
Orikko and Ziggy get along well and in "The Ruler", they meet each other's owners,
Other kwamis
Orikko is shown to get along very well with the other kwamis. He both supports them and receives their support in return.
Enemies
Gabriel Agreste/Monarch

title: Orikko
text:
Orikko - Relationships
Like the other kwamis, he was aware that Gabriel, was using Nooroo's power for evil, then in "Sandboy", shared a desire to contact Nooroo during his cycle but contacted the villain instead. From Season 5, Orikko did not enjoy having to serve Gabriel and lend his powers to his plans to get the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses until "Re-creation". where he and his siblings expressed joy of being freed from him.
Tomoe Tsurugi
After being captured by Monarch, Orikko discovered that Tomoe was Gabriel's ally and helped him destroy his Miraculous and reform it into a ring. Orikko then witnessed their alliance from his cage, and in "Pretension," Tomoe akumatized herself to steal Felix's Peacock Miraculous. Monarch transferred Orikko's power to Tomoe to help her, but it was ineffective.
In "Miraculous London," after being freed by Bug Noir and Nathalie, Orikko overheard Nathalie revealing the truth about Tomoe to her guardian. However, Ladybug decided not to bring her to justice and instead gave her a chance to change after she had hidden the truth about Monarch from the world.

title: Orikko
text:
Orikko - Trivia
Orikko was first revealed in a second season trailer on August 31, 2017.
Orikko's name was confirmed in the credits of the Latin American Spanish dub of "Sandboy".
The rooster is the tenth animal of the Chinese zodiac.
Roosters represent pride, honesty, watchfulness, flamboyance.
Roosters are male chickens, despite kwamis not having genders.
The Gallic rooster is the unofficial national symbol of France as a nation. Its association with France dates back to the Middle Ages due to the coincidental homonyms of the Latin words Gallus (inhabitants of Gaul) and gallus ("rooster").
Orikko's name is a reference to "Cocorico", the French onomatopoeia for the sound a rooster makes (the equivalent of English's "cock-a-doodle-doo").
Orikko is the only kwami that has three syllables in his name, while the other kwamis have one or two syllables.
"Cocorico" is sometimes used as an expression of French national pride.
Orikko, Mullo, and Longg are the only kwamis whose voices can only be heard in the background of "Sandboy".
Until "Destruction", Orikko had the lowest number of lines out of any kwami, only two, one in "Queen Banana" and one in "Penalteam".

title: Orikko
text:
Orikko - Trivia
Interestingly, Chloé is akumatized in both episodes.
Orikko's proud nature could be a reference to the saying "Proud as a rooster".
Orikko and Daizzi were the only kwamis of the Chinese Miracle Box that did not appear in the sixth season, however they do appear in the theme song, and Orikko made an off-screen appearance in "The Ruler".

title: Ox Miraculous
text:
Ox Miraculous - Intro
The  is a nose ring that, whenever Stompp inhabits it, transforms the wearer into an ox-themed superhero with the power of Determination.
To activate the nose ring, the user must speak the transformation phrase: "Make Way". To deactivate the nose ring, the user must speak the detransformation phrase, which is currently unknown.
The nose ring is currently owned by Ivan Bruel, who uses it to transform into Minotaurox. It was previously stored in the Chinese Miracle Box and only lent out to him when the situation required it. But, as of "Re-creation", he now posseses the Miraculous permanently.

title: Ox Miraculous
text:
Ox Miraculous - Appearance
In general, the Ox Miraculous is a nose ring with an open section with the tips of the edges being rounded. In charged mode, when Stompp inhabits it, it is dark blue with five pale yellow spikes around its outer edge. If a minor is using the miraculous, the nose ring starts running out of power, and it makes a beeping sound, and the spikes start discoloring (one spike is equivalent to one minute) Ivan (or another Ox Miraculous holder) has left.
In its activated mode, the spikes are black.
In Season 6 onwards, the spikes are absent.
In its camouflage mode, the nose ring changes color and form depending on whose possession it's in:
In the possession of Ivan Bruel, it turns dark gray, and the spikes turns black.
In Season 6 onwards, the ring loses all the spikes and turns grey.
When it was worn by Gabriel Agreste, it turned silver and lost the spikes.
When it was worn by Chloé Bourgeois, it turned gold and had 3 yellow gemstones.
When it was worn by Marinette Dupain-Cheng, it turned rose gold and lost the spikes.

title: Ox Miraculous
text:
Ox Miraculous - Appearance
In it's reforged ring form, it was a thick band with a circle surface, similar to the Cat Miraculous, inside of it was the symbol of the Ox Miraculous which glowed navy blue. It used to sit on the thumb of Gabriel's right hand.

title: Ox Miraculous
text:
Ox Miraculous - Abilities
The Ox Miraculous has the ability to transform its wielder into an ox-themed superhero, granting its wielder incredible powers of speed, endurance, agility, stamina and strength.
Its special weapon is an unbreakable Mallet which can be utilized as both a weapon, a communicator, and an object that can be used to breathe underwater. Its special superpower is called Resistance, which gives the user the ability to be immune to any other abilities in order to obtain their goal, like defeating a villain. If the wielder is not an adult, as long as the superpower isn't used, they can remain transformed indefinitely. However, as soon as the superpower is used, the wielder loses power, and the transformation wears off in about approximately five minutes. The nose ring also has the ability to give the wielder the costume they truly desire.

title: Ox Miraculous
text:
Ox Miraculous - History
Five thousand years ago, a mage successfully helped the kwamis to interact with humans by creating magic jewels, which were called Miraculouses. In order to repay the mage, and to live on the physical world alongside humans, the kwamis decided to help humanity by letting humans utilize their energy and powers through the Miraculous they were bonded with, which included Stompp and the Ox Miraculous.
At some point in time, all of the knowledge about the Miraculouses and their powers was written down in code in a book called the Grimoire, with very few people knowing how to decipher the code. Miracle Boxes were also created at an unknown time to store the dormant Miraculouses. To protect and distribute Miraculouses, the Order of the Guardians was formed and existed for many years. Throughout its existence, guardians trained younger generations to keep a watchful eye over the Miraculouses and the Grimoire, which were placed in the guardians' temple.
Many Ox holders throughout history used Stompp's power for good, like Niú in China, who started the legacy.

title: Ox Miraculous
text:
Ox Miraculous - History
172 years ago, after an disastrous event where a young Wang Fu used the Peacock Miraculous to create a sentimonster and his negative emotions and imaturity led to the creature rampaging through the temple and eating and destroying everything in its path, Fu was entrusted with the Chinese Miracle Box (Which included the Butterfly Miraculous) by a monk and was told to run away from the mess. However, on the mountain range outside the temple, in order to escape from the the monster, Fu jumped over a fissure on the ground - accidently opening the Box and spilling all of its contents on the snow. Due to his distress, Fu didnt notice he accidently left both the Peacock and the Butterfly on the mountain, alongisde the Grimoire, until it was too late and he was too far away to come back. Somewhere along the line, the Peacock got dangerously damaged, to the point of being improper for use - but, as it turns out, no one knew of this fact until it was too late.

title: Ox Miraculous
text:
Ox Miraculous - History
On a previous trip overseas with the Agrestes, Nathalie found the Butterfly and Peacock Miraculouses and gave the jewels to Gabriel. In "Representation", it was revealed that neither the Agrestes nor the Graham de Vanily couples could bear children on their own, so Émilie and Colt used the Peacock Miraculous to create Adrien and Félix respectively, but in doing so, they grew sick over time and were eventually left in a condition where they fell into an eternal slumber due to using the Peacock Miraculous in its damaged state.

title: Ox Miraculous
text:
Ox Miraculous - History
Desperate to fix his mistake, Gabriel Agreste began using the Butterfly Miraculous for evil to obtain the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses in order to gain access to their absolute power, becoming the supervillain Hawk Moth, later Shadow Moth (when unified with a now fixed Peacock Miraculous), and finally Monarch. This decision proved one of the most significant for the history of the series, as Gabriel began utilizing Nooroo's power to akumatize the civilians of Paris, France, trying to get one of them to draw out the current holders of the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses, unintenionally helping start off Marinette's and Adrien's journeys as Ladybug and Cat Noir, and later, the rest of the Miraculers.
One of the members of the Miraculers is Ivan Bruel, who was chosen by Ladybug in "Penalteam" to wield the Ox Miraculous, becoming the hero Minotaurox. Ivan, from that point on, became a member of the team, helping Ladybug and Cat Noir during "particularly difficult missions". From "Penalteam" to "Strikeback", Ivan was a temporary holder, meaning he would only receive the Miraculous from Ladybug when he was needed for the mission, and had to give it back after the crisis was solved.

title: Ox Miraculous
text:
Ox Miraculous - History
Félix, after finding out about his true origins as a sentihuman and learning that the Peacock Miraculous could erase his and his cousin's lifes if it feel into the wrong hands, orchestrated a plan to capture all of the Miraculouses of the Chinese Box from Ladybug and traded all of them (besides the Ladybug and the Cat) for the Peacock, which included the Ox Miraculous, succeeding in "Strikeback". When Gabriel unified it with the Butterfly and other miraculouses, he became Monarch.

title: Ox Miraculous
text:
Ox Miraculous - History
In "Destruction", Gabriel used a laser machine to melt down the Miraculous into a pile of dust, and then reforged it into a special Alliance ring for transferring Stompp's power of Determination to any akumatized villain who wore a regular Alliance ring. In "Re-creation", Marinette Dupain-Cheng manages to recover all of the Miraculous that were previously stolen. In "Miraculous London", Lila stole all of the Miraculous under Marinette's care in an alternate timeline, which included the Ox Miraculous, in order to render her truly powerless and to fuse the Ladybug and the Cat to gain her wish without her interference, but her plan was ultimately thwarted by the combined efforts of Chronobug and Bunnyx, and the event was erased from the timeline.

title: Ox Miraculous
text:
Ox Miraculous - History
After the events of "Miraculous London", Marinette, having realized both instances of all of the Miraculouses being stolen happened because all of them were kept in the same place, and with the idea that centralized power is inherently flawed, and that distributing it among members of a society is a far superior idea, restored and upgraded the Ox Miraculous by redesigning its original design and adding the Miraculous Call: a call feature that grants the holder the ability to summon other superheroes who possess a Miraculous from the Chinese Miracle Box in order to receive aid on their missions. This new feature is particularly useful, as the new holder of the Butterfly Miraculous, Chrysalis, is even more fearsome than her predecessor. After the alterations, the Ox Miraculous was given back to Ivan permanently - putting Minotaurox back on the map.

title: Ox Miraculous
text:
Ox Miraculous - Trivia
The Ox Miraculous is stored in a drawer of the Miraculous box above the Mouse Miraculous' drawer.
This could refer to the relationship between Ivan and Mylène.
Ox symbolize stability, strength, stubbornness, wealth, and sacrifice.
In the animatic of the theme song, a Miraculous with an ox-like appearance appears on the top level of the Chinese Miracle Box, and it appears as a ring.
The Ox Miraculous being a nose ring and Stompp's appearance is a relation to oxen wearing nose rings to be used as draft or driving animals.
In the storyboard for "Miracle Queen" and in "Re-creation" the Ox Miraculous is referred to as the "Buffalo Miraculous", even though buffaloes are a different species, and the fact that a Buffalo Miraculous appears in the Native American Miracle Box.
This is the smallest of the known miraculouses.

title: Painting of Émilie Agreste
text:
Painting of Émilie Agreste - Intro
The  is a stylized portrait of Émilie Agreste that her husband, Gabriel kept in his atelier. The portrait is placed in front of a safe in which Gabriel kept personal things such as a picture of Émilie, the Miraculous spellbook, the Peacock Miraculous, a paper note, and a guide about Tibet.
The portrait also hides a secret mechanism that once allowed access to his secret lair for when he was Monarch, formerly Hawk Moth and Shadow Moth, and to a crypt where Émilie Agreste was located and where Gabriel went to get more butterflies for his akumatizations.
After Gabriel's defeat and death, Bug Noire destroyed the lift mechanism leading to the Crypt and Gabriel's lair, while the painting remained in the abandoned atelier.

title: Painting of Émilie Agreste
text:
Painting of Émilie Agreste - Appearance
The painting depicts Émilie as Gustav Klimt's Adele Bloch-Bauer. She wears a jeweled necklace and gold dress. The painting's background, Émilie's dress, and her jewelry are all painted with glittering gold and silver leaf on canvas. The portrait is longer than it is tall, unlike Klimt's which is square, and it is framed in matching gold.

title: Painting of Émilie Agreste
text:
Painting of Émilie Agreste - Trivia
The portrait resembles Gustav Klimt's Portrait of Adele Bloch-Bauer I, commonly known as The Woman in Gold.
Furthermore, the painting foreshadowed Émilie's infertility, as Bloch-Bauer had two miscarriages and her only child died in infancy.

text:
Optigami - Intro
"" is a Season 4 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 13th written and produced episode of Season 4. It is also the 91st written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Optigami
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Optigami - Synopsis
Now that he knows the identities of some of Ladybug’s allies, Shadow Moth comes up with a plan to exploit that flaw. For guaranteed success, he brings his most fearsome akumatized villain back. As for Marinette, she and her friends have been invited to a party where Adrien will be awarded a prize by Audrey Bourgeois’ fashion magazine. But what should have been a party turns into a nightmare when Audrey becomes Style Queen again, and Adrien and Marinette get trapped together… unable to transform into Ladybug and Cat Noir!
Disney+
Style Queen is back... but is there a hero to stop her?
Netflix
Shadow Moth throws a fashion event as part of an evil scheme. When he unleashes a villain, Ladybug and Cat Noir struggle to come to the rescue.

title: Optigami
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Optigami - Plot
The episode starts with Gabriel and Nathalie on her bed. Nathalie reminds Gabriel that they found out the identities of some Miraculous holders during the events of "Miracle Queen". Nathalie says that she created a sentimonster called "Optigami" after this day and that it followed all the Miraculous holders but never found out anything important. She says that sometimes Ladybug entrusts people with a Miraculous, but she has private rules that prevent anyone from revealing her secret identity. Nathalie mentions that even Optigami failed to follow her and that it is now useless but Gabriel disagrees saying that Optigami will be very helpful to reveal the identity of Ladybug. Then he points to the security vulnerability when Ladybug is retrieving the Miraculous. Then, Nathalie asks on how to gather all the Miraculous holders, which he calls Audrey who is upset with an employee. Gabriel tells her to have the ceremony to be won by his son in her introduction, which she promises that it won't be disappointed to him.
In Marinette's room, Alya explains about the invitation that Marinette received to the kwamis who asked why Marinette had been standing there looking at the invitation.

title: Optigami
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:

text:
Optigami - Plot Developments
This is the eleventh time where Adrien is a minor character in the permanent timeline following "Crocoduel", "Guiltrip", "Sole Crusher", "Furious Fu", "Mr. Pigeon 72", "Gang of Secrets", "Truth", "Cat Blanc", "Silencer" and "Style Queen".
Marinette chooses Alya as her successor in case something happens to her the same way Master Fu chose Marinette back in "Backwarder".
Since Marinette was going to tell Alya everything it's likely she finds out about Chloé's betrayal (if she didn't know before this), and possibly the identity of the other temporary Miraculous holders.
This episode included the most sentimonsters out of all other episodes, with Sentialec, Sentinino, and Optigami. With Adrien and Kagami being officially confirmed as a sentimonster in "Representation" and "Yaksi Gozen", this episode now features five sentimonsters.
This excludes "Feast" which shows several past sentimonsters in the Miraculous spellbook.
This is the third episode that features a post-credit scene, following "Miracle Queen" and "Gabriel Agreste".
Gabriel and Nathalie are aware that Alya has a "special status" since Ladybug became the guardian and decide "it's time for [them] to take an interest in her".

title: Optigami
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Optigami - Plot Developments
Due to the incident in "Miracle Queen" as Ladybug and Cat Noir, Marinette and Adrien are aware that Shadow Moth has been using the information he gained against them let alone spying on them.
Despite Chloé's betrayal and Shadow Moth's knowledge, Ladybug continued to give Miraculouses to their allies. Which is understandable because with the severity of Shadow Moth's attacks and there being no time to pick new charges as Ladybug realized that problem back in "Catalyst".
Meaning this shows that Ladybug trusts the other Miraculous holders except Chloé to use the Miraculouses she choose for them, as seen that she had Carapace, Pegasus and Ryuko help her out on other missions.
And possibly since most of their allies didn't break the rules of their free will, Ladybug likely felt sympathy for the others.
This is the seventh time where a Miraculous is destroyed. Within the current timeline, this is the sixth time a Miraculous is destroyed, following the Rabbit Miraculous and Cat Miraculous in "Timebreaker", Bee Miraculous in "Queen Wasp", the Butterfly Miraculous in "Miraculous Shanghai" and the Ladybug Miraculous in "Cat Blanc".
Kaalki uses her powers the most in the episode.

text:
Optigami - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in Germany on Disney Channel.
This is the fourth time Audrey gets akumatized into Style Queen, following "Style Queen", "Mayura" and an off-screen akumatization, as seen in "Mr. Pigeon 72". Including her akumatization into Heart Hunter, it's her fifth akumatization overall.
This is the seventh episode to be named after a Sentimonster, the others being "Reflekdoll", "Félix", "Ladybug", "Gabriel Agreste", "Mega Leech", and "Guiltrip".
This is the third time the titular Sentimonster isn't related to an akumatized villain after "Ladybug," and "Gabriel Agreste".
The thumbnail of the official trailer features Style Queen next to Optigami, making it the fifth one to have some other character other than the titular one on it, following "Ikari Gozen", "Félix", "Ladybug", and "Mega Leech".
This also makes Style Queen the sixth character to appear in more than one thumbnail, following Mayura, Lady Wifi, Princess Fragrance, Reflekta, and Malediktator, as she appears in the one for "Style Queen".

title: Optigami
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Optigami - Trivia
It's confirmed that Nathalie and Gabriel know the identities of all of Ladybug and Cat Noir's allies, following the events of "Miracle Queen", including that Nino is Carapace. Although, in Nathalie's screen, Chloé is shown to be Queen Bee, even though she was removed from the superhero team.
It's either likely Gabriel and Nathalie thinks Chloé would still use the Bee Miraculous or they don't know that Chloé's position as Queen Bee was permanently revoked but still had Style Queen eliminate her just in case despite Shadow Moth seeing Vesperia in "Queen Banana".
Ironically when Style Queen eliminated Chloé, she also hit Zoé, the new Bee Miraculous holder.
The clips of Nino, Kagami and Max receiving their Miraculouses, as captured by Optigami, appear to be from "Mega Leech".
If Optigami was spying on them in that said episode, Gabriel and Nathalie probably would have known about Zoé being the new Bee Miraculous holder, but since she wasn't seen on Nathalie's tablet, it is safe to say they don't know about her.

title: Optigami
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Optigami - Trivia
Since the sentimonster has been active ever since "Miracle Queen",  and what's taken what's above into account it's likely that Gabriel and Nathalie don't know about Su-Han's existence as a guardian too, or about Polymouse, Pigella or Purple Tigress's true identities.
The text on the Adrien poster right before Optigami hides in displays lorem ipsum, a common filler text.
The concept art of Lady Bee had accidentally been released by Lindalee Rose in early 2021, but Thomas Astruc claimed it was old and discarded.
It's possible that the concept was reintroduced sometime later, or that it was deliberately denounced to keep its eventual appearance a surprise.
He also mentioned that the concept and final designs weren't the same, which is also true.
Alya and Nino's video game has the same sound effects as Donkey Kong (1981).

Its contact appears as a blank red profile picture on Marinette and Alya's phones.
The fact that they can use a phone shows they have adjusted to modern technology since "Truth".

According to Sass, horses and rabbits have a common ancestor. Technically all life on Earth has a common ancestor, but both horses and rabbits also belong to the group Boreoeutheria.
This is one of the several times where the summoning sequences for Ladybug's and Cat Noir's powers aren't seen.
This episode shows that Unification can also be ended by speaking a kwami's detransformation phrase.
This episode features the final appearance of Mayura albeit in a flashback.
Errors
In the English dub, Chloé's voice in the "Miracle Queen" flashback has a different tone than in the actual episode.
All of Audrey's Style Queen Magazine posters incorrectly spell "Magazine" as "Magasine".
During the scene when Shadow Moth sends an akuma, one of the toilet doors’ handle is facing the left side, instead of the right side like all the other doors do.
When Kim walks to the elevators in the lobby, the blonde part of his hair is missing.

title: Optigami
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Optigami - Trivia
When Alya texts Marinette to help get her out of the elevator, the camera on her cellphone is missing.
When Alya grabs the Fox Miraculous, its black instead of its deactivated form.
Despite Rena Rouge using her power in Marinette's room, her necklace never flashed like how it started flashing immediately after she used her power in "Sapotis".
All 5 bars were still present even when she returned the Miraculous.
We can also assume that the fight was obviously longer than 5 minutes and yet she didn't de-transform.
Despite Kim heading to the award ceremony by taking the stairs instead of riding on the elevator with his friends, he didn't make it there in time until much later after Shadow Moth akumatized Audrey into Style Queen, but he can be seen in the audience sitting next to Luka while Sentialec is humiliating Audrey on live TV.
Although kwamis cannot be seen or heard through technology, Marinette could still hear the kwamis through her cellphone.
When Ladybug fuses the Ladybug and Bee Miraculouses, the animation of her fusing (not the background) is reused from "Miracle Queen". As a result, the Dragon Miraculous erroneously appears on her neck.

title: Optigami
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Optigami - Trivia
In addition, the special effect for when the bee icon appears is the same as the dragon icon's special effect, also reused from "Miracle Queen".
When Chloé comes out from hiding, Zoé's head can't be seen next to her, despite the latter appearing in the next shot.
When Nathalie is directing Optigami towards the elevator, she could see Optigami through her tablet, despite the fact that she can only see things happening through its perspective.
When Lady Bee used Venom, she did not require her spinning top to activate it.
When Ladybug de-akumatized Style Queen, the Bee Miraculous vanishes and later reappears after she finished.
It later disappears again once Ladybug, Rena Rouge, and Senticarapace go on the roof. It's unknown if she took it off off-screen beforehand.
Before Ladybug secretly places the Magical Charm on Audrey's hat, the Bee Miraculous is back in its charged mode.
When Max got eliminated by Style Queen, his icon doesn't turn red on Nathalie's device like the others.
Max and the people with him appear in the wrong room after the Miraculous Ladybug is used.

title: Optigami
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Optigami - Trivia
Throughout the whole episode, the Peacock Miraculous on Shadow Moth's chest is in its activated form, instead of charged.
Despite Max being taken before Luka, when Luka is taken Nathalie's tablet shows Max is still active, even though Shadow Moth then says "Only three left".
When Marinette entrusts the Fox Miraculous to Alya, permanently, it is in its charged mode, despite Trixx not being inside it.
When Pollen enters the Bee Miraculous, the two stones in the Miraculous are yellow instead of black.
When Alya transformed in Marinette's room, it shows an old transformation with different eyes than her current costume.
Senticarapace says "Shell off" when removing the Shell-ter around Lady Bee, which is the detransformation command for the Turtle Miraculous. In "Ephemeral", its revealed that the actual deactivation command for Shell-ter is "Unshield".
In the Italian Dub, in the scene where Nino is seen by Optigami, Nathalie doesn’t say anything.
Lila's second mother is seen in her casual outfit in the award ceremony, but in later scenes when she's trying to get out of the building, she's in her black outfit.

title: Optigami
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Optigami - Trivia
As Ladybug starts spinning her Yo-yo to de-evilize the akuma, it starts closing in the last frames before the reused sequence starts.
In the opening scene of Optigami spying on the off-duty Miraculers, Max is seen playing chess against Markov. In this scene, the chessboard is incorrectly positioned as the bottom right square should be white for both sides. This leads to the kings being set up on the d-file and the queens being set up on the e-file when they are supposed to be swapped.
