title: Optigami/Transcript
text:
Optigami/Transcript - Intro
[ Theme Song ]
Nathalie: This is what we learned thanks to the akumatization of Chloé Bourgeois as Miracle Queen.
(Optigami flies nearby as Nathalie shows Gabriel the true identities of Rena Rouge, Queen Bee, Ryuko, King Monkey, Viperion, Pegasus and Carapace on her screen.)
Gabriel: Yes. I remember.
Miracle Queen: People of Paris, listen to Miracle Queen's first order! From now on, no one will have to keep his identity a secret. All the Miraculous wearers, come to me!
(Under the control of Miracle Queen, Alya, Nino, Max, Luka, Kagami and Kim walk towards Miracle Queen.)
Hawk Moth: (excitedly) Yes! Yes!!! No more hiding!
Nathalie: Since then, (Optigami files and lands on Nathalie's finger) I created Optigami.
Mayura: My beautiful amok, bring my creation to life! (puts the amok in her tablet. She concentrates her power and creates the sentimonster Optigami, which flies onto her finger) Optigami, I am Mayura. (Optigami opens its eyes, then flies out) Be my eyes and discover all of Ladybug's secrets.
Nathalie: Under my control, Optigami followed each of the Miraculous holders. Alas, they're just ordinary teenagers-

title: Optigami/Transcript
text:
Optigami/Transcript - Intro
Nathalie: (continued) –who spend their time between school and extracurricular activities.
Nathalie: (continued) True, Ladybug sometimes trusts them with a Miraculous.
Nathalie: (continued) But she's established rules that prevent anyone from discovering her secret identity: she never shows her face, always takes back the Miraculous, and makes sure no one ever follows her.
Nathalie: (continued) Even Optigami couldn't stay on her tail.
Nathalie: We will learn nothing more with the Sentimonster.
Gabriel: On the contrary, I believe that it will help us finally discover who is behind Ladybug's mask. There's a flaw when the holder gives their miraculous back. (Pointing at the video of Nino giving his Miraculous back to Ladybug) There. Imagine if Optigami was hiding in the Miraculous Ladybug took back it would lead us straight to her home, unknowingly.
Nathalie: Brilliant. But how do you plan to do that?
Gabriel: I need an event where all the holders will be sure to come, and a super-villain who will force Ladybug to assign a Miraculous if she wants to defeat it. And I know just the right person for it.

title: Optigami/Transcript
text:
Optigami/Transcript - Intro
Audrey: Are you serious?! Where is the glitter I asked for? You're useless, utterly useless. (her phone rings) Shoo, shoo!
(Audrey picks up her phone after hearing it ringing.)
Gabriel: Audrey, once again this idea was formidable.
Audrey: Utterly formidable, you mean! ... What was the idea again?
Gabriel: This new award by your magazine, the Fashion Icon of the Month, and I was thinking, what better way to launch the award than by electing my son?
Audrey: (interested) I'll take care of the invitations right now.
Alya: (To the kwamis) Basically, everyone's invited to this party, where Adrien's gonna receive the Fashion Icon award from Style Queen magazine!
(We see that Marinette is standing, looking at the invitation dreamily.)
Alya: That's why she's been paralyzed for ten minutes.
Roaar: Roar! Since everyone's invited, can we come too?
Kwamis: Yeah!
Marinette: Wait a sec. Sorry, but you know the rule. (holds hand up) No holder, no wander. (folds arms)
Trixx: In that case, I can come since I've got a holder.
Marinette: Technically no, I hold on to her Miraculous.
Trixx: Well then, just give it to her permanently.

title: Optigami/Transcript
text:
Optigami/Transcript - Intro
Alya: Trixx isn't wrong, Marinette. Now that I know you're Ladybug, I can help you.
Marinette: No, that'd be too risky. You know the rule, no Miraculous out of my sight, no flight.
Alya: You're the guardian, your call. (holds up phone with picture of Adrien) Besides, it's time to go see Adrien at the Fashion Icon.
(Marinette looks at Alya and turns around, blushes and looks at the invitation)
Marinette: Adrien!
(Marinette, Adrien, Alya, Nino, Luka, Kagami, Max and Kim are seen walking towards the entrance, where a large poster of Adrien is shown. They walk to an elevator)
Nino and Alya: (whilst playing Super Penguino) Yeah! (they perform their "secret handshake") Pew pew! Pew pew! (laughs)
Kim: I bet I can get there before the elevator does! Max, time me.
Max: Ready.. GO!
(Kim sprints off toward the staircase.)
Alya: (whispering to Marinette) Elevators are perfect for getting close to your secret crush! (pushes Marinette towards the elevator, where Adrien is)
Marinette: What? No! (uncomfortable, she pushes her hands forwards on the wall, and pushes against it while Alya tries to push her in) What if we accidentally... touch?!

title: Optigami/Transcript
text:
Optigami/Transcript - Intro
(In the elevator, Kagami and Max look on negatively while Adrien and Luka merely smile at Marinette. The elevator eventually closes, leaving Marinette, Alya and Nino the only ones behind)
Marinette: Let's... not rush things, 'kay?
(Audrey Bourgeois stands with Adrien Agreste on the stage, as well as a presenter and Chloé Bourgeois)
Nino and Alya: Yeah! (they do their 'secret handshake' again) Pew pew! Pew pew! (they laugh; Marinette smiles at them)
Audrey: Urgh! If you don't start filming this instant, you're fired!
Unnamed presenter: But we have to wait for Alec, he's the MC!
Audrey: Ridiculous! Utterly ridiculous!
(Optigami is seen flying into an Adrien poster, watching)
(Nathalie taps a control panel, which is broadcasting the fashion show)
Nathalie: Optigami is in place sir.
Shadow Moth: Ladybug has no idea that her defeat will be captured on film. Icing on the cake.
(Shadow Moth gets his hand fan out, while Alec plays a game on his phone in a stall.)
Alec: Yeah! Come on!
Shadow Moth: (holds an feather, evilizes it into an amok, and puts it into his cane. He holds a hand out and creates a Sentimonster version of Alec)

title: Optigami/Transcript
text:
Optigami/Transcript - Intro
Alec: (walking out of his stall, he is flabbergasted at seeing Sentialec) Hey! What's that?
Shadow Moth: Sentialec, you're up.
Sentialec: At your command, Shadow Moth.
(As Sentialec walks out of the restroom, the real Alec sits on the floor cowardly.)
(Sentialec kicks the door open and dances on. The audience applaud him.)
Audrey: It's about time.
Unnamed presenter: Roll!
Sentialec: You won't be disappointed!
Shadow Moth: (speaking through Sentialec) You'll see. It was worth the wait.
Sentialec: (shown on TV) Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the outdated headquarters of Style Queen magazine, that's almost as outdated as Audrey Bourgeois herself!
Sentialec: Well, well, has the Queen suddenly lost her voice?
Shadow Moth: (continuing) What a shame. She could have told you that this whole award ceremony is rigged.
Sentialec: (to Adrien) Sorry, my boy. (looks smugly at Audrey)
Audrey: (shoves Adrien off the stage) That's false! Utterly false! (to the audience) Don't listen to him. (back to Sentialec) You! How dare you?! You're-
Sentialec: (interrupting Audrey and finishing her sentence) Fired! Haha! Too late! You already ridiculed yourself already.

title: Optigami/Transcript
text:
Optigami/Transcript - Intro
(The audience continue to laugh cruelly. Audrey looks down, miserable and in tears.)
(Shadow moth releases an akuma)
Shadow Moth: Fly away, my little akuma, and evilize this wonderfully vile queen once again.
(Sentialec looks at the akuma and steps away. The akuma enters the flower pin on Audrey's hat)
Shadow Moth: (from bathroom) Style Queen, I am Shadow Moth. This MC has lost all sense of style and class.
Audrey: (interrupts) Spare me the boring speech, Shadow Moth, give me back my powers and I'll give you the two trinkets you're so obsessed with!
Shadow Moth: (from bathroom) Immediately, my queen.
(A purple ether engulfs Audrey, replacing her with Style Queen. The audience run away. Marinette looks at Alya determinedly and Alya nods.)
Alya: (whispers to Nino) We gotta be ready in case Ladybug needs us. Come on. (Nino and Alya go one way while Marinette goes the opposite way.)
Sentialec: (mockingly) Glitter? Really? For a style queen, you sure a fashion victim. (runs away laughing)
Style Queen: 'You're' the only victim around here!

title: Optigami/Transcript
text:
Optigami/Transcript - Intro
(she fires at Sentialec, but he jumps over a couch, and the beam turns the couch into a pile of glitter. Sentialec runs away laughing. She then aims at Chloé and Adrien, but then her arm is torn off when Kagami throws a chair at her.)
Kagami: Go, Adrien! Run!
Adrien: Kagami, NO!
Style Queen: (her arm returns) Since you want to play the hero, you'll be the first to get fired! (blasts her staff at Kagami, turning her into a pile of glitter. Adrien and Chloé run away.)
Nathalie: Kagami Tsurugi, Holder of the Miraculous of the Dragon, neutralized.
Shadow Moth: We must find the others before Ladybug shows up.
Adrien: Plagg, cl-
(Marinette runs inside the lift too, ready to transform into Ladybug. Plagg quickly hides.)
Marinette: Tik- (noticing Adrien, she panics) -ki!! Tik! Tik! Tik! Tik! Tok! Tik! It's time to get out of here!
Adrien: Uh, yeah! I was about to go and get some help. (press a button on the elevator)
Marinette: How gorgeous of you- I mean, how brave of you!
(The elevator door closes)
Marinette: Ladybug will show up.
Adrien: Yes, and Cat Noir.
(Both look away from each other, worried.)
'
Style Queen: Alec...

title: Optigami/Transcript
text:
Optigami/Transcript - Intro
Chloe: (appears from behind a table, giving her the location of Sentialec) This way, mom! I saw him!
Style Queen: I saw you laugh when that MC ridiculed me. (fires from her cane) You're fired, haha!
(Chloe grabs Zoé to use her as a human shield but they both get turned into glitter)
Nathalie: Chloe Bourgeois, holder of the Miraculous of the Bee, neutralized. Optigami, go find the others.
Max: This is the safest way, run, run, go, go!
(Optigami flies into a fire extinguisher)
Nathalie: Max Kanté, holder of the Miraculous of the Horse, located.
Shadow Moth: It seems like some know-it-alls are trying to get out of here, my dear queen.
Style Queen: No one can escape my unrivalled style! Rah!
(Golden swirls surround her and expand.)
Style Queen: (appears) No underdressed slob gets out of here without a makeover! (activates the power from her staff to turn the victims into glitter.)
(Both Adrien and Marinette touch the elevator button at the same time)
Adrien and Marinette: (simultaneously) Sorry.
Marinette: The elevator doesn't work.
(Adrien and Marinette pull on the elevator doors, trying to open it, but they end up falling)
Adrien: It's too hard.

title: Optigami/Transcript
text:
Optigami/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: I'm sure Cat Noir will come along to save us.
Adrien: Yeah, or Ladybug.
(Marinette turns her back to Adrien and types and sends a message on her phone to Alya)
Marinette: (voiceover) I'm stuck in the elevator! (Alya sends a message back)
Alya: (voiceover) With Adrien, LOL?
(Embarrassed, Marinette looks at Adrien, who smiles at her reassuringly. She sends another message to Alya.)
Marinette: (voiceover) Yeah!
(Alya grimaces, and types a message back, while Nino receives a message from Adrien)
Adrien: (voiceover) I'm stuck in an elevator with Marinette.
Nino: (smiles, and turns to Alya) This is so cool! Marinette and Adrien are stuck together.
Alya: (nods and laughs awkwardly) Yeah, that's awesome, and not at all a problem! (starts texting back to Marinette)
Alya: (voiceover) How are you gonna do what you need to do?
Marinette: (voiceover) I have a plan, but I need some time alone.
Alya: (puts her phone away, turns to Nino) I need to find a way to let Ladybug know that we're here, in case she's looking for us.
Nino: I'll go with you!
Alya: Err... n-n-n-n-no! We should split up! If Style Queen gets to me first at least you'll be able to do something.

title: Optigami/Transcript
text:
Optigami/Transcript - Intro
Nino: I won't let that happen, believe me.
Alya: Okay... but first I gotta make a pitstop, if you know what I mean. Wait here, (kisses Nino on the cheek) I'll be right back. (she gets up and runs away)
Shadow Moth: I release you from your existence, Sentialec. (with the snap of his fingers, Sentialec dissolves)
(The real Alec is in complete shock and disbelief. He rises from the corner he's been huddling in and bolts out of the restroom)
Alec: Supervillan? Ha, super-moron! Right? (gets turned into golden dust by Style Queen)
Style Queen: Right!
Shadow Moth: (to Style Queen, through telepathic connection) Some still mock you in the air ducts.
Style Queen: Urgh! (teleports inside a nearby air duct)
Luka: (reassures a terrified Wayhem) Hold on, it's going to be okay. (As they continue to crawl, they are taken by surprise by a golden light rushing towards them; they get turned into golden dust by Style Queen. Optigami flies out of the walls and away.)
Nathalie: Luka Couffaine, holder of the Miraculous of Snake, neutralized.
Shadow Moth: Only three left.
Longg: Ha-ha! (stops when he hears the phone next to him ringing)
(The rest of the Kwamis stop what they are currently doing)

title: Optigami/Transcript
text:
Optigami/Transcript - Intro
Longg: It's the guardian's emergency cell!
Kwamis: Hello?!
Marinette: Aaahh! (taken by surprise by the Kwamis' loud speaking, she drops her phone)
Adrien: Who is it?
Marinette: (quickly picks up her phoen, scrambling) Uh- I'm... I'm, uh calling... I'm calling the fire department! Hello! Fire department? We're trapped in an elevator in the Montparnasse Tower.
Longg: Got it! We're taking off!
Marinette: Uh no, no! Don't fly here because... um... helicopters are bad for the environment! Maybe... maybe come on horseback instead.
Marinette: You got that fire department on horseback?
Longg: Horse, she means you Kaalki!
Kaalki: I am not a horse; I am a noble steed! I was the companion to the most glorious heroes! She might be talking about Fluff.
Sass: Of course, in prehistoric times horses and rabbits had one common ancestor.
Fluff: Let's go back to prehistoric times!
Marinette: No no, not prehistoric times! (looks at Adrien, smiling at him)
(Adrien looks shocked, when he sees eyes through the elevator, then grabs Marinette)
Adrien: Shh!
(Marinette looks at the eyes, then disconnects from her phone communication with the kwamis)

title: Optigami/Transcript
text:
Optigami/Transcript - Intro
Barkk: Hello? Hello? Hello? She's in trouble for sure, what are we gonna do?
Wayzz: We stay calm, she'll call back.
(Marinette and Adrien tried to not make sound after seeing that they are being watched)
Style Queen: Ha ha!
(Marinette looks concerned since she needs to transform but can't since she is trapped and Adrien also concerned on him transforming to Cat Noir. Plagg shakes his head.)
Adrien: Argh, I...
Marinette: I...
Marinette and Adrien: ...have to tell you something.
Nathalie: It's only your son, he's safe with one of his classmates. She's not on our list.
Shadow Moth: There's no one in that elevator, Style Queen.
(The eyes from the elevator disappear.)
Adrien: Phew, what were you gonna tell me?
Marinette: Uh, nothing, you?
Adrien: Just I was wondering what that eye thing was.
Marinette: I don't know but we better lay low, I'll text Alya and ask if she can call for help. (texts Alya)
(Style Queen walks through the hallway)
Kim: (opens the door and is tired) So, here first, huh?
Style Queen: Everyone's a loser today! (zaps Kim as he is turn into golden glitter)
Nathalie: Kim Nguyen, holder of the Miraculous of the Monkey, neutralized.

title: Optigami/Transcript
text:
Optigami/Transcript - Intro
Shadow Moth: That leaves us Alya Césaire and Nino Lahiffe, the fox and the turtle. (talks through telepathic connection to Style Queen) Style Queen, only two left.
(walks through the hallway to find others)
(Alya is seen looking carefully down the stairs, then receives a text from Marinette)
Marinette: Call this number!
(Alya looks at her phone seeing that Marinette send her a number, she calls the number)
Alya: Hello?
Trixx: I knew the guardian should have let me go to the party!
Alya: Trixx?
(Alya receives a call from Nino. She declines Nino's call)
Alya: (voiceover) Hey there, it's Alya, if you want to stay connected, leave a message!
(Nino seems worried about her, so he go out of the building without being seeing by Style Queen)
Nathalie: Nino Lahiffe, located. Alone.
Shadow Moth: Style Queen, you're up.
(Nino looks around to see if the villain is there, when he walks further, he is turned into golden glitter. Style Queen smiles, after she turned one of the two targets into glitter.)
Shadow Moth: I know the perfect bait to lure our last target out of her hiding place.
(holds an amok, evilizes it, and puts it into his Cane. He holds a hand out and makes a Sentimonster of Nino)

title: Optigami/Transcript
text:
Optigami/Transcript - Intro
Shadow Moth: Sentinino, I am Shadow Moth. You will help me find Alya Césaire.
(Alya walking down the stairs, then stops when she hears Nino calling her name)
Sentinino: (shouting) Alya? Alya?
(Alya still standing after Nino is calling her name)
(Voyage suddenly appears)
Kaalki: Come on, saddle up!
Sentinino: (background voiceover) Alya? Alya? Alya?
(Alya runs through the voyage, as she enters the room it closes)
Alya: Um, Kaalki, when a kwami uses their power without their holder, doesn't it usually set off some kind of catastrophe?
Kaalki: (gasps in disbelief) I never set off catastrophes! Only exceptional events.
<poem>
(Alya receives a text from Marinette.)
Marinette: (voiceover) Don't forget to take the Bee Miraculous, Alya. It's essential to the plan.
Alya: I know girl, don't worry!
(Alya unlocks the sewing box to get the Fox Miraculous)
Alya: Time to shine, guys!
Trixx and Pollen: Yeah! (Pollen goes into the Miraculous)
<center> [Transformation Sequence]  Alya: Trixx, let's pounce! (Alya transforms into Rena Rouge) </center>

title: Optigami/Transcript
text:
Optigami/Transcript - Intro
Rena Rouge: Mirage! (an illusion of Ladybug is created) And voila! A cool little Ladybug illusion to keep Style Queen busy while I'll… (Rena Rouge looks at the Turtle Miraculous container on the Miracle Box and takes the Miraculous)
Longg: Did the guardian ask you to do that?
Rena Rouge: Just a precaution.
Kaalki: Voyage! (Rena Rouge, Kaalki, and the Ladybug illusion run through the Voyage as it closes)
</poem>
(Rena Rouge checks if the coast is clear and she and Kaalki run one way while the Ladybug illusion runs the other way. Rena is running when she hears Sentinino calling for Alya and runs to him.)
Sentinino: (shouting) Alya? Alya? Alya? Alya? Alya?
(Optigami hides in the wall to spy on them)
Rena Rouge: Shh, shh! Style Queen might hear you.
Natalie: Alya Césaire located sir, but she's already transformed into Rena Rouge and she's with a kwami.
Shadow Moth: What?!
Rena Rouge: Here, your Miraculous.
Shadow Moth through Sentinino: Why are you the one giving it to me?
Rena Rouge: Ladybug gave me a mission while she's dealing with Style Queen. Transform yourself and go help her, I'll meet up later.

title: Optigami/Transcript
text:
Optigami/Transcript - Intro
Nathalie: The only person Ladybug entrusted to distribute a miraculous in the past was Cat Noir.
Shadow Moth: Seems Alya Césaire is not just any holder, be that as it may our plan has not been compromised. Wayzz…
Sentinino: …Shell On! (Sentinino transforms into Senticarapace)
Natalie: Optigami, merge with the Miraculous.
(Optigami hides within the Turtle Miraculous and Senticarapace runs down the hall to where Style Queen is)
(Senticarapace watches as Style Queen fights the Ladybug illusion)
Shadow Moth through Senticarapace: Today, I promise you a great victory Ladybug, but what you don't know is that thanks to Optigami, your victory will also be mine!
(Adrien and Marinette are standing against each side of the elevator and Rena Rouge comes in through a Voyage portal)
Rena Rouge: Everything's fine. Ladybug sent me to get you out of the tower and to shelter before I head out to help her fight Style Queen. Kaalki!
Kaalki: Voyage!
Rena Rouge: You first.
(Rena drags Adrien through the portal. The portal closes)
Tikki: Wow Marinette, that was very well played!
Marinette: Thanks. Tikki, spots on!
(Shows outside of elevator as Marinette transforms)

title: Optigami/Transcript
text:
Optigami/Transcript - Intro
Rena Rouge: Stay here, I'll come back for you as soon as we defeated the villain. (enters the portal and it disappears)
Adrien: It's not going to be easy to get back into that tower.
Plagg: Then let's go home.
Adrien: Not just yet. Plagg, claws out! (transforms behind a roof chimney)
(Rena Rouge teleports back to the elevator and hi-fives Ladybug)
Ladybug: Good job girls!
Rena Rouge: That was some mission, right, Kaalki?
Kaalki: True, we did act with some mastery.
Ladybug: Just so I know, how many times did you use you power?
Kaalki: (nervous) Uhh, a certain amount of times...?
Ladybug: I don't even want to imagine the catastrophes those teleportations may have caused...!
(Shows Kaalki's teleportations brought the Startrain under the sea, the TVi Studio into a volcano, and the Grand Palais and some vehicles on the moon and in orbit around Earth.)
Ladybug: (Puts on the Bee Miraculous) There's no time to lose!
[Transformation Sequence]
Ladybug: Tikki, Pollen, Unify! (She is then transformed into Lady Bee)
(Lady Bee and Rena Rouge watch as Style Queen fights the Ladybug illusion behind some tables)
Lady Bee: Amazing job Rena.

title: Optigami/Transcript
text:
Optigami/Transcript - Intro
(Lady Bee spots Senticarapace sneaking around, unaware that he's a Sentimonster)
Lady Bee: Carapace?
Rena Rouge: There's never too many of us to help, right?
Lady Bee: Mmm, you're right. Carapace will be useful to us.
(Lady Bee and Rena hide behind a table so she could summon her Lucky Charm and she gets a small mirror)
Lady Bee: (whispering) Lucky Charm.
(She looks around but doesn't see anything she could do with her mirror)
Lady Bee: Weird, I think I can beat Style Queen without my Lucky Charm. Well, the important thing is to beat her no matter how. Call back your illusion.
(Lady Bee runs off while Style Queen is still fighting the Ladybug illusion)
Style Queen: So, you want to play hide and seek Ladybug?
Rena Rouge: Reality.
(The Ladybug illusion vanishes as Style Queen blasts the table she was hiding behind)
Style Queen: (groans in annoyance)
(Lady Bee sneaks up behind Senticarapace which surprises him)
Lady Bee: Carapace, I need you to protect me.
Senticarapace: Got it!
Shadow Moth: I'll follow your lead. (laughs evilly) Don't worry, I won't say anything to Style Queen, Ladybug. I'll protect you because nothing should prevent you from winning today!

title: Optigami/Transcript
text:
Optigami/Transcript - Intro
(Lady Bee summons Venom and prepares to ambush Style Queen)
Lady Bee: Venom!
(Style Queen attempts to blast Lady Bee into dust but is stopped by Senticarapace's Shell-ter.)
Senticarapace: Shell-ter!
Style Queen: What?
(Style Queen keeps blasting at Lady Bee, but Senticarapace drops the shield.)
Senticarapace: Shell off!
(Lady Bee uses her Venom and immobilizes Style Queen.)
Lady Bee: Buzz off!
(Lady Bee transforms into Ladybug and breaks Style Queen's rose that contains the Akuma.)
Ladybug: (opens her yo-yo to capture the akuma) No more evil doing for you little akuma! Time to de-evilize! (captures akuma and purifies it) Gotcha! Bye bye, little butterfly.
(Style Queen turns back into Audrey.)
Audrey: Ladybug?
Cat Noir: Cataclysm!
(The building turns back to normal before Cataclysm can be used and Cat Noir opens the door.)
(Before Audrey walks away Ladybug puts a Magical Charm in her hat while she's not looking)
Audrey: Ridiculous, utterly ridiculous!
(Cat Noir comes from behind everyone and is shocked to see them there)
Cat Noir: Ladybug, Rena Rouge, Carapace? How did you get in?
Kaalki: Hello, Cat Noir.

title: Optigami/Transcript
text:
Optigami/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: Sorry, Cat Noir, I would've come to get you if I knew your true identity.
Cat Noir: Like I always say milady, “to know me is to love me”.
Ladybug: On second thought. (laughs quietly) Rena Rouge, Carapace. (they all run to the top of the tower while Cat Noir stays behind) Stay here Cat Noir, I'll be back.
Rena Rouge: It was so easy to beat the villain this time.
Shadow Moth through Senticarapace: It's because she had good partners.
Ladybug, Rena Rouge and Senticarapace: Pound It!
Rena Rouge: Let's rest.
Senticarapace: Shell off.
(They detransform and hand over their Miraculouses to Ladybug)
Ladybug: I don't understand. (Optigami's eyes open on the Turtle Miraculous without anyone noticing) It's been so easy.
(Nathalie hears Ladybug's conversation through Optigami on her screen)
Ladybug: (voiceover on Nathalie's screen) I didn't even get to use my Lucky Charm.
Ladybug: Normally it's always been the key element to defeat the villain.
Shadow Moth: Our trap has just snapped shut, Ladybug!
Ladybug: I guess it was only here to help repair everything. (looks confused when she sees her compact mirror)

title: Optigami/Transcript
text:
Optigami/Transcript - Intro
(She notices Nino acting confused of his handshake with Alya. Sentinino gives Alya a simple hi-five)
(Ladybug remembers their special hi-five in a flashback)
Ladybug: (looks at both of them with curious look) We're gonna have to be a lot more careful now. Shadow Moth knows the identities of some of the people I have given a miraculous and apparently he's decided to use this information. (looks at Sentinino) Isn't that right, Shadow Moth?
(Alya becomes shocked, and Sentinino panicks as he got exposed)
Ladybug: I'm sorry Alya, you better move away from him. This isn't Nino, it's a Sentimonster.
Alya: Huh? (gasps)
Nathalie: That's impossible! (in shock after Ladybug figures them setting a trap)
Shadow Moth: How did she figure it out?! (in anger that Ladybug figures out his trap)
(Alya walks away from the sentimonster, she falls down in shock)
(Ladybug uses her yo-yo, to go the area where Cat Noir is)
Ladybug: (runs to Cat Noir who is eating a cookie) Cataclysm this for me, will you?
Cat Noir: (shocked when Ladybug shows up and what she saying) But it's a miraculous!
Ladybug: Trust me.
(Cat Noir trusts her and uses his Cataclysm to destroy the Miraculous)

title: Optigami/Transcript
text:
Optigami/Transcript - Intro
(Optigami flies out from the Miraculous after it's destroyed)
Nathalie: Ah! (in pain after the miraculous is destroyed, cutting communication with Optigami)
Shadow Moth: (groans in anger) One day, I'll get you Ladybug! I release you from your existence. (release Sentinino from existence)
(Sentinino is released from his existence.)
(Optigami is also released from his existence.)
Ladybug: Miraculous Ladybug! (repairs everything)
Cat Noir: How did you figure out there was a sentimonster in that miraculous, m'lady?
Ladybug: Thanks to my lucky charm, kitty cat, it always shows me the right way, except this time, I'd gotten the villain wrong.
(Cat Noir understands what Ladybug is saying to him)
Alya: Shadow Moth almost unmasked you because of me. I should have never taken the Turtle Miraculous.
Marinette: It's true, you did make a mistake, and that's why I'm gonna have to make a difficult decision. The most important thing is to learn from our mistakes. And today, I learned that I need an ally who can replace me in case something happens to me one day. (hands Alya the Fox Miraculous) From now on, you will keep the Miraculous of the Fox with you, and I'm gonna tell you everything I know.

title: Optigami/Transcript
text:
Optigami/Transcript - Intro
(Alya smiles. She and Marinette hug. The kwamis watch them as they continue to hug.)
Trixx: See, I'm always right, even when I'm wrong!
Gabriel: We don't know our enemies well enough Nathalie. Alya Césaire seems to have a special status in the organization Ladybug has set up since she became guardian. It's time for us to take an interest in her.
(Nathalie agrees and smiles.)

title: Optigami (sentimonster)
text:
Optigami (sentimonster) - Intro
Optigami was the titular main antagonist of the episode "Optigami". It was an origami butterfly-like sentimonster that functioned as a spy camera created specifically by Mayura, to find out the civilian identities of Ladybug and Cat Noir.
Following right after the events of "Miracle Queen", Mayura created Optigami so she could spy on Ladybug, Cat Noir and other Miraculous holders.

title: Optigami (sentimonster)
text:
Optigami (sentimonster) - Appearance
Optigami was an origami butterfly-like sentimonster, with similar colors to Shadow Moth's outfit. It had two eyes at an angle on its upper wings, with tiny black dots as its pupils.

title: Optigami (sentimonster)
text:
Optigami (sentimonster) - Abilities
Optigami had the ability to merge with and hide inside of any object, with it not being visible. It could broadcast its vision as a live video on Mayura's tablet like a security camera. After Optigami unmerged with the object, the live video was sent to her tablet as a video that could be rewatched. Because of its magical nature, Optigami was able to allow the tablet that contained its amok to show images and videos of kwamis. It was also able to fly due to its butterfly form.

title: Optigami (sentimonster)
text:
Optigami (sentimonster) - History
After the events of "Miracle Queen", Mayura created Optigami to spy on Ladybug and her part-time sidekicks from that moment onwards so as to figure out Ladybug's identity.
In "Optigami", Nathalie told Gabriel about her findings about the Miraculous heroes in both their superhero and civilian forms, but she never managed to find out Ladybug's identity or anything else that might be a point of interest. Nathalie began to think Optigami is useless, but Gabriel believed it could help to discover Ladybug's true identity, if it could possess a Miraculous.
Gabriel arranged a fashion event, intent on creating a powerful supervillain, believing that the best opportunity for Optigami to possess a Miraculous was when it was handed back to Ladybug.
Shadow Moth created a Sentimonster to anger Audrey so that he could akumatize her into Style Queen. While the heroes were distracted fighting her, Optigami waits as Rena Rouge mistakenly gave the Turtle Miraculous to Sentinino, believing that he was the real Nino Lahiffe. Once Rena Rouge runs off, Optigami possessed the Turtle Miraculous.

title: Optigami (sentimonster)
text:
Optigami (sentimonster) - History
After Style Queen was defeated and Ladybug takes Rena Rouge and Sentipace up to the roof to take back their Miraculouses, Ladybug, using her Lucky Charm, was able to realize that Nino had an unusual reaction to the handshake Alya offered him despite their usual ones. This made Ladybug realize that Nino was actually a sentimonster created by Shadow Moth and, putting together the villain's plan, she had Cat Noir use his Cataclysm on the Turtle Miraculous, releasing Optigami out of it. After being exposed and its purpose no longer necessary, Shadow Moth released it from existence along with Sentinino.

title: Optigami (sentimonster)
text:
Optigami (sentimonster) - Trivia
Optigami's name came from "optic", meaning eye, referring to its purpose of spying, and "origami", the Japanese art of paper folding, referring to its folded paper-like body.
Optigami was the second Sentimonster active while a person other than its creator wielded the Peacock Miraculous, the first being the Dormant Sentimonster created by Wang Fu.
Interestingly, both sentimonsters were created from their creator's emotions.
Optigami was the first sentimonster partly technological, as it could record and broadcast videos.
Not only that, but, because of being magical, it allowed the technology to which it was connected to capture the image of Kwamis and, in this way, overcome their nature to not be perceived by human technology.
This changes in "Hack-San", whose titular sentimonster was a living thumb drive containing a computer virus.
It looked similar to an Akuma since its original shape is a butterfly.
Optigami's purpose was similar to that of Mayura during Season 3: spying on Ladybug and the rest of The Miraculers, trying to take hold of Miraculouses, and finding the location of the Chinese Miracle Box and its current guardian.

title: Optigami (sentimonster)
text:
Optigami (sentimonster) - Trivia
Optigami was the fourth sentimonster to be based on an animal, following a Butterfly Sentimonster, Banana Boom-Boom and Mega Leech.
It was the fourth sentimonster to be destroyed by Shadow Moth, following Gabriel Agreste, Sentialec and Sentinino.

title: Oriental Pearl Tower
text:
Oriental Pearl Tower - Intro
The  is a well-known TV tower located in Shanghai.

title: Oriental Pearl Tower
text:
Oriental Pearl Tower - Appearance
The Oriental Pearl Tower features 11 spheres, big and small. The two largest spheres are along the length of the tower linked by three columns. The entire tower is supported by three enormous columns that start underground.

title: Oriental Pearl Tower
text:
Oriental Pearl Tower - Trivia
During Miraculous Shanghai, the Tower is destroyed by a laser from Yan Luo Shi, before being repaired by Miraculous Ladybug.
The ground floor of the tower hosts the Shanghai History Museum, which uses models and wax statues to describe the history of the city in a playful way.
The first sphere hosts a roller coaster, which, with an augmented reality headset, allows you to be transported between the skyscrapers of the Lujiazui district.

title: Paint Brush
text:
Paint Brush - Intro
The  is the tool of the Goat Miraculous.
The current owner of the paint brush is Nathaniel Kurtzberg, who uses it as the superhero Caprikid.
Previously, it was used by Gabriel Agreste when he used the Goat Miraculous with the other Miraculouses in his possession to become Monarch.

title: Paint Brush
text:
Paint Brush - Appearance
When used by Caprikid, the paint brush is large with white bristles, and the handle's upper section is black while lower part is white. A single black strip is located near the end the white and the handle's tip is black. The crimp is silver and the ferrule is golden with a circular, grey metal piece at the end. The ferrule has a white indention of circle sprouting a line, which has two lines branching out and curve down towards the ends. It is retractable, with only the ferrule remaining, and when it's not in use, Caprikid usually has it attached to his lower back.
From season 6 onwards, the paint brush is more metallic and the bristles are grey that fade to black at the tip. The handle, crimp, and ferrule are sliver. The handle has a black section on both the upper and lower parts, with a white V-shape marking with the upper part. The ferrule is more conical and its indention remains, but the circle resembles a metal relief and lines indentions are engraving. The handle's tip has an ornamental three-layer circle pyramid with a flat bottom.
When it was used by Monarch, the paint brush changed color from white and black to purple.

title: Paint Brush
text:
Paint Brush - Abilities
Like the other Miraculous tools, the paint brush is nearly unbreakable and can be used to deflect attacks. When used offensively; the paint brush can bind, cut, jab, or bludgeon opponents like a staff or spear.
Its main purpose is to activate Genesis: The Goat Miraculous Holder raises the paint brush and the bristles are charged with white magical energy. Then they spin and wave it, painting on thin air, bringing the desired object into existence.

title: Paint Brush
text:
Paint Brush - Trivia
The weapon being a paint brush perfectly matches Nathaniel as a holder as he is known for his artistry.
The paint brush is the third Miraculous weapon that can create an object following Ladybug's yo-yo and King Monkey's ruyi jingu bang.
The paint brush shares some similarities to Cat Noir's staff:
Both are retractable and are kept on their lower backs.
They can be used as sharp weapons or bludgeoning.
Both can be spun fast to deflect attacks.
The paint brush is based on the Magic Brush from Super Mario Franchise, such as Super Mario Sunshine, which is used by Bowser Jr.
The Inkbrush and Octobrush from Splatoon are very similar to the Magic Paint brush.

title: Orikko/History
text:
Orikko/History - Intro
Orikko is the Kwami connected to the Rooster Miraculous, where he is currently with Marc Anciel to transform into Rooster Bold.

title: Orikko/History
text:
Orikko/History - Before [[season 1]]
When the concept of Pretension came into existence, Orikko came into existence. Before the Miraculous jewels were created, Orikko and the other Kwamis traveled all over the universe unable to interact with humans. Then, thousands of years ago, a mage created the Miraculouses. When his Miraculous was not being worn, Orikko was dormant in the Rooster Miraculous, which was stored inside the Miracle Box.
At some point, Orikko and his owners learned that they can't copy or replicate other kwamis powers, cannot give a power in form of a wish, and cannot give powers that harm the kwamis quantum magic.

title: Orikko/History
text:
Orikko/History - Season 1
During Season 1, Orikko was dormant in the Rooster Miraculous.

title: Orikko/History
text:
Orikko/History - [[Season 2]]
During season 2, Orikko was dormant in the Rooster Miraculous.
In "Sandboy", Orikko was celebrating Nooroo's birthday in the Miracle Box with the other kwamis and was excited when Tikki and Plagg arrived. They marveled at the gift Tikki brought as they thought it was a paintbrush. When it came the time to find Nooroo, Orikko got into position in an effort to contact him, but they contacted his wielder instead. Upon hearing his voice, the kwami shuddered at the thought of being his slave and prevented himself from being discovered when they all cut off the connection. They realized if they contacted Nooroo's wielder, rather than Nooroo, then someone must have been akumatized and that Tikki and Plagg's wielders would be in danger.

title: Orikko/History
text:
Orikko/History - [[Season 3]]
During season 3, Orikko was dormant in the Rooster Miraculous.
In "Kwamibuster", he was activated along with his kwami brothers and sisters to help Multimouse enact her plan to rescue Tikki and Plagg. During the confrontation, Orikko was one of the few kwamis captured but this was actually part of the plan and was set free with the help of Multinoir. After Kwamibuster's defeat, Orikko and the others cheered for Marinette as their plan was successful and was returned to Miracle Box.
In "Miracle Queen", he was activated alongside Stompp, Roaar, Ziggy, Daizzi, Barkk, Mullo, and Fluff, by Queen Bee with the intent to use them against Ladybug and Cat Noir. After being commanded to transform her, they collectively withheld their transformation phrases due to her rude behavior. Upon hearing Master Fu renounce his title, he and the others protest but Master Fu does so anyway, resulting in the Miracle Box changing shape and form. After failing to escape, Queen Bee throws off their respective Miraculouses, and they alongside their kwamis are returned to the Miracle Box by Ladybug.

title: Orikko/History
text:
Orikko/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Truth", Orikko was accidentally released from the Miracle Box when Marinette tried to figure out how the box works and wanted to release the kwamis as she felt they were trapped. When released, Orikko eagerly and disrespectfully explored Marinette's room without her permission. During a video call, Orikko and the others gathered around her new guardian's computer in amazement wondering why her friends were imprisoned. When Marinette leaves for her date with Luka, Orikko and his fellow kwamis hid inside the Miracle Box. After the titular villain's defeat, Orikko and the others saw that Marinette was sad about breaking up with Luka to the point of tears, he didn't know exactly how to help but joined with his fellow kwamis in giving their new guardian a group hug.

title: Orikko/History
text:
Orikko/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Gang of Secrets", Orikko was seen talking with some of his fellow kwamis until their guardian arrives home. Later, Orikko and the others hear Marinette voice her distress about being condemned to a life of secrets and lies forever because of her alter ego. When they hear someone coming, the kwamis hide in the Miracle Box and after the Gang of Secrets had been defeated, Orikko and the others look on as Marinette unveils her secret to Alya.
In "Mr. Pigeon 72", Orikko was seen with the other kwamis helping to clean up Marinette's room.

title: Orikko/History
text:
Orikko/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Furious Fu", hearing that Master Fu was returning, Orikko along with his fellow kwamis expressed dear desire to see him despite Marinette trying to keep them hidden for their safety and when her new guardian voiced concerns about leaving the Miracle Box unguarded. Orikko realized that if someone stayed to guard the box, the others could go. However, when they cheated their way out so all of them can go, they were stopped by Marinette as she reaffirmed that she was the new guardian who made the decisions of who can and cannot go. With no choice, they used the "puppy dog eyes" on her and Marinette reluctantly agreed. However, Orikko and his fellow kwamis had a hard time keeping quiet while in Marinette's bag but heard that Master Fu is doing well and become a great painter.
But returning home, Orikko realized that Su-Han had returned to reclaim the box as he was the previous guardian before Master Fu's incident. With Su-Han's strict orders, Orikko and his fellow kwamis sadly returned to the box. After seeing Ladybug's valiant actions against the titular villain, Su-Han realized that Master Fu's choice wasn't so bad allowing Orikko and their fellow kwamis to stay with Marinette.

title: Orikko/History
text:
Orikko/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Sole Crusher", Orikko and a few other kwamis helped Marinette figure out why Zoé acted differently.
In "Queen Banana", Orikko asked Marinette if she'll be famous after making the movie.
In "Optigami", Orikko looked at Marinette while she was paralyzed staring at the ticket to the Fashion Icon of the Month, because it had a picture of Adrien on it.
In "Hack-San", Orikko and the kwamis were aware that Marinette was leaving for a trip to London, but heard their guardian making an excuse to stay. Not wanting to leave Paris unguarded and when Orikko heard that Marinette pretend to break her leg. Orikko was shocked but was informed by Longg about that trick never working especially if parents want to go on vacation.

title: Orikko/History
text:
Orikko/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Dearest Family", after Tikki ate the pieces of galette Marinette brought for them, the kwamis quickly realized what she did. Orikko huddled together with the others when they realized the danger Tikki's hunger for candy can represent, despite the kwami of Creation's refusal at that. When Tikki and Marinette returned, the kwamis flew around in a panic. Shortly after he watched Marinette, realize that Sass warning was real and transforms to stop Tikki only to be affected by her hunger, which scared him.
Hearing a commotion downstairs, Orikko and the others were commanded to hide. After Ladybug saved her family, Orikko and the kwamis see her return with pieces of galette for them. Despite that they were still nervous regarding Tikki, until Marinette ensured them that Tikki will control herself and the kwamis ate the pieces of galette happily.
In "Kuro Neko", Orikko and the other Kwamis tried to comfort Marinette after Cat Noir gave up on his Miraculous and was surprised to learn that she intended to replace him with someone who doesn't love her.

title: Orikko/History
text:
Orikko/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Penalteam", Orikko introduces himself to Marc, who used Orikko and his Miraculous to transform into Rooster Bold and help Ladybug, alongside many other heroes, to defeat Penalteam.
In "Risk", Orikko and the other Kwamis watched Marinette search for different ways to sabotage Adrien and Lila's journey, unaware that she was under the influence of Risk's superpowers.
In "Strikeback", Orikko and his Miraculous were given to Marc to become Rooster Bold and helped Ladybug, Cat Noir and the rest of the heroes to defeat Strikeback. Later, after Flairmidable betrayed Ladybug by stealing her yo-yo, Orikko's Miraculous, along with all the others, was given to Gabriel Agreste in exchange for the Peacock Miraculous.

title: Orikko/History
text:
Orikko/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Evolution", Orikko is present with the other kwamis when Gabriel makes his declaration as Monarch informing the citizens of Paris that he has stolen the other Miraculouses and will be using their powers to get the Miraculous of Ladybug and Cat Noir. When Monarch decides to use the Rabbit Miraculous to re-write history so that Émilie Agreste and Nathalie Sancoeur never get sick from using the damaged Peacock Miraculous, Orikko and the others are forced into his staff while he executes his plan. When in the Burrow, Orikko and the others momentarily break free and beg Ladybug to save them but are forced back into the staff.
Orikko and the others later re-appear when Monarch traveled to the time Ladybug and Cat Noir had been affected by Reverser's powers but the use of too many powers at once were starting to take their toll. Sass explained that the kwamis need food to keep their strength up or it will have dire consequences. They are quickly fed before Monarch forces them back in the staff. Orikko is last seen when he and the others watch Gabriel wallow in his defeat.

title: Orikko/History
text:
Orikko/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Multiplication", Orikko and the Kwamis back away from Gabriel in fear when he declares he will use their powers for his benefit.
In "Destruction", Gabriel tries to force Orikko to grant him the power to travel through time. Orikko explains that he cannot grant a power that belongs to another kwami. Gabriel then demands the power to track down the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses, but Orikko tells him that this is a wish instead of a power and he cannot make it happen. At Gabriel's demand for the power to learn Ladybug and Cat Noir's true identities, Orikko says that he can't do this as it would disturb the magic of the kwamis protecting those identities.
Gabriel becomes angered and offends Orikko by calling him useless. He then tries to make the kwamis reveal Ladybug's true identity, but they are unable to since Ladybug never renounced them, and the magic spell prevents them from saying her name. Down to his last option, Gabriel has the kwamis direct him toward Ladybug's address and they follow when he travels to the bakery where they tell him Ladybug designed a scavenger hunt to help them find her if they ever got lost.

title: Orikko/History
text:
Orikko/History - [[Season 5]]
When Ladybug and Cat Noir appear to have Monarch cornered, Orikko and the kwamis hurry to her side thinking all is well until Monarch uses Voyage to teleport away, and they are forced to follow. Later, when Marinette is explaining the plan to Alya, Orikko and the Kwamis are taught what to do and say if they were ever asked to tell who Ladybug is or where she lives.
At the end of the episode, all of the Miraculous are broken down by lasers and re-shaped into Alliance Rings.

title: Orikko/History
text:
Orikko/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Deflagration", Gabriel tells the kwamis that they will soon witness a great change and that their abilities will be used to make it happen. Like his fellow kwamis, Orikko was incredibly shocked and worried when Gabriel announced he knows the identities of the new holders of the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses. When Monarch began detailing a plan to catch Alya and Zoe, he mentions how he catch the two by surprise by using Orikko's power of Sublimation to be invisible. This power allowed multiple copies of Monarch to sneak into the school and follow Alya and Zoe when Chloe allowed herself to become akumatized. Because he was successful in being unnoticed, he used Pollen's Venom to paralyze Alya, Tikki, Zoe, and Plagg.
In "Pretension", Orikko's powers are one of those forcibly given to Matagi Gozen who grants herself the enhanced sense of smell to track down Felix to get the Peacock Miraculous. The enhanced sense allows the copies of Matagi Gozen to track Felix and Cat Noir, but a problem arises when Felix spreads his scent through pigeons to trick her. Unfortunately, she is able to continue tracking Cat Noir and corner the group in the sewers.

title: Orikko/History
text:
Orikko/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Revolution", Orikko's powers are used by Chloe's robots when she makes herself Queen Mayor. With Orikko's powers, many of the robots become invisible to be used by Chloe under Monarch's command. Because of this, Chloe is able to use the robots to go unnoticed to put anyone she wants in detention for any reason she wants.
In "Re-creation", Ladybug has gotten all of the Miraculous back and turned them back to their original jewels. But because she fears another potential incident of the Miraculous being stolen, she decides to leave each one with their chosen wielders. The Rooster Miraculous and Orikko are now permanently under Marc's care and the two are shown happily reuniting before Rooster Bold joins the others with Ladybug and Cat Noir.

title: Orikko/History
text:
Orikko/History - [[Season 6]]
In "The Ruler", Orikko is used by Marc to transform into Rooster Bold and reveal his identity to Nathaniel, who had revealed himself as Caprikid.

title: Palais de Chaillot
text:
Palais de Chaillot - Intro
is a monument located at the Trocadéro, in the 16th arrondissement of Paris. It is known for its esplanade overlooking the Eiffel Tower.

title: Palais de Chaillot
text:
Palais de Chaillot - Description
Built in 1937 for the International Exhibition "Arts et Techniques dans la Vie moderne", the Palais de Chaillot consists of two neoclassical pavilions with curved wings. These two pavilions are separated by a central void that forms the Parvis des droits de l'homme.
The entire building is characterized by an abundant statuary by, among others, the artists Paul Belmondo, Léon-Ernest Drivier and Marcel Gimond. Charles Hairon created some of the exterior bas-reliefs and Gilbert Poillerat the entrance gates. The two pavilions are topped by monumental groups sculpted by Raymond Delamarre and Carlo Sarrabezolles. The roofs of the palace are flat and form accessible terraces.
From the Parvis des droits de l'homme, two large symmetrical staircases lead to the Trocadéro fountain, the central part of the Jardins du Trocadéro. These two staircases frame a building located directly under the forecourt. The latter has rectangular bay windows and follows the height of the building.
The exceptional setting of the place, in particular the view of the Eiffel Tower, makes it one of the most popular places for tourists in Paris.

title: Palais de Chaillot
text:
Palais de Chaillot - Activities
Musée de l'Homme
Inaugurated in 1938 and occupying part of the right wing of the Palais Chaillot, it is a national museum. Its mission is to present the human race in its anthropological, historical and cultural diversity.
Part of the National Museum of Natural History (MNHN), this museum presents prehistoric collections (700,000 pieces), ethnobiological (100,000), anthropological (30,000) and ethnological (6,000, transferred to the Musée du Quai Branly).
In particular, there are original fossils of Cro-Magnon Man and La Chapelle-aux-Saints Man, the main skeleton of Neanderthal Man.
National Navy Museum
Occupying in the Passy wing of the Palace since 1943, this museum exhibits a collection of 30,000 objects and works of art. This collection is composed in particular of "Views of the Ports of France" by Joseph Vernet, the stern of the extraordinary galley La Réale and Napoleon's imperial canoe until 2018.
Cité de l'architecture et du patrimoine
It is a public industrial and commercial establishment that has existed since 2007. This city, the largest architecture center in the world, was born from the merger of three establishments that form three departments of the city:

title: Palais de Chaillot
text:
Palais de Chaillot - Activities
Musée national des Monuments Français: there are casts of monuments, copies of murals and stained glass windows and architectural models of French monuments.
École de Chaillot: higher education institution that offers training to obtain the Diploma of specialization and deepening (DSA), mention "architecture and heritage".
Institut français d'architecture (IFA): organization created in 1981 to ensure the promotion of contemporary French architecture and to preserve the architects' archives.
There is also a library of contemporary architecture.
Théâtre national de Chaillot
Inaugurated in 1937, the Théâtre national de Chaillot is one of the five French national theaters. Renovated between 1972 and 1975, this theater has three halls, the Jean-Vilar hall with 1,250 seats, the Gémier hall with 420 seats and finally the Maurice-Béjart studio with 80 seats for smaller shows.
It is located under the Parvis des droits de l'homme.

title: Palais de Chaillot
text:
Palais de Chaillot - Trivia
The Palais de Chaillot has been classified as a Historical Monument since 1980 (apart from the theater).
In its history, the Palais de Chaillot has hosted several museums and organizations in the past:
French Film Library.
United Nations General Assembly, UN (September-December 1948 and November 1951 - February 1952).
North Atlantic Treaty Organization, NATO (1952-1959).
On December 10, 1948, during its 3rd General Assembly at the Palais de Chaillot, the UN adopted the Universal Declaration of Human Rights.
This event is commemorated by a plaque.
This event gave its name to the Parvis des droits de l'homme.

title: Otis Césaire/History
text:
Otis Césaire/History - Intro
Otis Césaire is a zookeeper at Ménagerie du Jardin des Plantes. He is also the husband of Marlena Césaire and the father of Alya, Ella, Etta and Nora Césaire.

title: Otis Césaire/History
text:
Otis Césaire/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Animan", while feeding meat to a new panther at Ménagerie du Jardin des Plantes, Lê Chiến Kim and Max Kanté arrive. Max then tells Kim how fast the panther can go, as Otis listens. Unimpressed, Kim replies that could easily beat her. Otis grows aggravated by this comment and tells Kim not to bother the animal. Kim continues to taunt both the zookeeper and the panther by boasting about winning the County Athletics Tournament.
Max then points out that it would be much more likely for the panther to eat Kim than to race him, Otis agrees with him but Kim ignores the comment. Once again, Otis tells Kim to stop bothering the animal, but he remains persistent in mocking the "poor tomcat" and her "cranky nanny" as he and Max walk away.
Hawk Moth senses Otis's annoyance with the overly competitive Kim and sends an akuma into his bracelet. Hawk Moth offers the zookeeper a chance to put Kim in his place. Once Otis agrees, he is transformed into Animan, an animal shapeshifting supervillain who sets out after the boy. Animan releases the entire menagerie and, in the form of a panther, corners Kim and Max. He tauntingly tells them that he will give them a head start in their race.

title: Otis Césaire/History
text:
Otis Césaire/History - [[Season 1]]
Kim and Max then are seen running for their lives from the zoo animals, led by Animan. Ladybug and Cat Noir then arrive and find Kim, cornered by Animan. They distract the panther long enough for Kim to flee, and Ladybug incapacitates him by tying him up in her yo-yo, but before they can take his bracelet. Then animals he freed come to his aid, forcing the heroes to retreat and with Animan escaping.
At atop of a birdge, Animan manages to once again corner Kim. The heroes then arrive, with Ladybug again tying Animan up in her yo-yo, but he simply turns himself into a bald eagle and flies off towards Kim. He manages to track him down in Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie. He then transforms into a ladybug and flies to where the heroes had previously placed Kim's sweatband. Ladybug traps him in a tissue box, but he changes back into a panther and chases the heroes into an empty bus with the doors locked.

title: Otis Césaire/History
text:
Otis Césaire/History - [[Season 1]]
Animan then fights the heroes in th bus as he changes into a variety of animals, gradually getting slower each time. Ladybug figures out that the transformations must be tiring him out and Cat Noir activates his Cataclysm to make the bus go haywire. The doors are wide enough to give the heroes a chance to escape but not a tired Animan.
At first, it seems that he has successfully been worn out, but just as they are about to take the bracelet from the sleeping panther, he transforms into a Tyrannosaurus Rex. Ladybug use her Lucky Charm summoning a car jack and then Cat Noir uses his cat-like agility to climb onto Animan and distract him while she uses her yo-yo to tie him up for good. With Animan defeated, Ladybug is confused as to why the Lucky Charm would provide her with something they did not need.

title: Otis Césaire/History
text:
Otis Césaire/History - [[Season 1]]
However, when Cat Noir goes over to retrieve the bracelet, he just narrowly avoids being chopped in half by Animan's massive teeth. Understanding at once, Ladybug charges at Animan and he apparently swallow her whole. Cat Noir prepares to attack but is relieved when he sees Ladybug, safe and sound, having used the car jack to open the dinosaur's mouth, retrieving the bracelet, and releasing the akuma. Animan then transforms back into Otis. Wondering what had happened to him, Ladybug tells Otis that everything's okay and that he should get back to the zoo and check on his animals.

title: Otis Césaire/History
text:
Otis Césaire/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Prime Queen", Otis is seen on the couch watching Side by Side with his wife Marlena Césaire and his twin daughters Ella and Etta Césaire. Later, Otis is seen still on the couch with his family when the titular villain comes on all television sets in Paris and announces her plans to force Ladybug and Cat Noir to admit their love for one another.
In "Befana", Otis is seen walking in the background of Ménagerie du Jardin des Plantes. He then attends Marinette Dupain-Cheng's surprise 14th birthday party at the Place des Vosges. Later at night when Nino Lahiffe was playing music, Otis is seen having a good time.
In "Anansi", Otis and Marlena had previously let their daughter Alya Césaire go with her friends to the World Cup fireworks show and watch from Ferris wheel at the Place de la Concorde.
In "Catalyst", Otis became one of the victims akumatized by Scarlet Moth, being transformed back into a scarlet version of Animan. He was then instructed by Scarlet Moth to head to the Eiffel Tower where he is. At the Eiffel Tower, Animan (in Tyrannosaurus Rex form) watched as Scarlet Moth arrived and made a statement to the Ladybug and Cat Noir.

title: Otis Césaire/History
text:
Otis Césaire/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Mayura", Animan (still in Tyrannosaurus Rex form) was first seen at the Eiffel Tower, chanting Scarlet Moth's name. He then watched as the French Miraculous superhero team battled the Scarlet Army. Later after Ladybug and Cat Noir managed to escape, Scarlet Moth ordered Animan to track them down and he transformed into a panther.
Animan then lead several members of the Scarlet Army into the sewers. He then jumped into the sewer waters and transformed into a giant catfish. Animan then swam towards Aquabug while Syren swam towards Aqua Noir. After battling it out, Aquabug broke Animan's pin while Aqua Noir broke Syren's bracelet, releasing the akumas. Animan and Syren then transformed back into Otis and Ondine.
The two civilians have trouble breathing underwater until Aquabug and Aqua Noir give them their yo-yo and staff to use as a breathing device. As they head back up, Frozer uses his powers to turn some of Paris into ice, causing the sewer waters to freeze and them to turn to a different. Fortunately, Otis with the others escape just in time. After Ladybug and Cat Noir transform into their normal superhero forms, they let Otis and Ondine go and they run to safety.

title: Otis Césaire/History
text:
Otis Césaire/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Santa Claws", Otis was celebrating Christmas with his family when Nathalie Sancoeur called Alya asking if she had seen Adrien Agreste. Otis then went out looking for Adrien with Alya in their bicycles. He then returned to the Césaire apartment and soon Ladybug and Cat Noir came flying through the window.
Otis then watched as Ladybug summoned her Lucky Charm and as his family directed her to the supplies she needed to defeat the titular villain. Once the villain was defeated and Adrien was found Otis along with his family and friends joined everyone at Agreste Mansion for Christmas dinner.

title: Otis Césaire/History
text:

In "Animaestro", Otis and his family were watching as Ladybug and Cat Noir fought the titular villain on TV. Ladybug tells everyone watching to close their eyes so their available to defeat the villain, which Otis and his whole family do. After Ladybug smashes TV camera with her yo-yo, Otis and his family look confused at their blank screens.
In "Miracle Queen", Otis was enjoying dinner with his family and Alya's boyfriend Nino. Then he along with everyone else was stung by the titular villain's hornets, which brainwash their victims. He was later freed by Ladybug's Miraculous Ladybug after she defeated the villain, along with everyone else.

text:

In "Sentibubbler", Otis is first seen in Marinette's nightmare. In the nightmare, Otis is seen having a meal with his family, Nino, and Marinette. Marinette tells Alya that Trixx is a secret, but Alya asks why Trixx has to be a secret and then calls her Ladybug, causing Marinette to panic as Otis and everyone else look at her. After Marinette tries to explain she is not Ladybug but Nino says that everyone knows, Chloé Bourgeois suddenly appears sitting in between Otis and Marlena.
Otis then listened as Chloé said that Marinette insists that your identity must be a secret or you won't receive a miraculous and that she would be a better Ladybug, calling her a ridiculous guardian. Otis then continued to watch as Shadow Moth arrived at the balcony, thanking Alya for revealing Marinette's identity to him and allowing him to get the Chinese Miracle Box.

title: Otis Césaire/History
text:
Otis Césaire/History - [[Season 4]]
Otis continued to watch as Marinette then tries to transform but Tikki doesn't transform her and Cat Blanc appears saying that they can be together since there are no more secrets. Marinette begins to panic saying it is a nightmare and Shadow Moth says that he will stop once she gives him her miraculous, with Otis and everyone else starting to walk towards her as she wakes up from the nightmare.
After Alya loses Hannibal the tarantula, Otis goes looking for him all over the apartment with his the whole family and Nino. After Marinette arrives, Otis says that the animal seems to be capable of passing through walls, giving her the wrong idea as thought he was talking about Trixx. In Marlena's pan, Hannibal climbs the spoons which frightens Marinette, causing her to rush to Alya and scream because she is afraid of it. Marlena says to the rest of the family to stop looking for it, because Marinette found Hannibal, as the family sighs in relief.

title: Otis Césaire/History
text:
Otis Césaire/History - [[Season 4]]
Otis says that its legs are healed since it can walk now, and saying that tomorrow it's going back to the zoo. Nino then comes out of the bathroom noticing Marinette in her pajamas and questions her, with Otis and everyone else looking at her. Alya asks her if she was looking for something specific, with Marinette tells her nothing specific now that she's seen that they found the tarantula and that she is so relieved it wasn't something else that you'd lost.
Alya tells her that she knows what she's talking about and that when someone trusts her with a "thing" she don't lose it, Otis and Marlena seem confused about what they're saying and give each other a look. Then Marinette then brings Alya to her room to talk privately, Nino gets left out and jumps in fear after seeing Otis with Hannibal in his terrarium.

title: Otis Césaire/History
text:
Otis Césaire/History - [[Season 4]]
Otis then gets captured by the titular villain in a bubble, along with everyone else except Alya. In the sky, Otis was then seen on the news as he had been floating over five minutes by that time. Later, the sentimonster attempts Otis and everyone else into space. Then after Pegabug gets the coffee cup from Shadow Moth with the sentimonster's amok, she commands him to release Otis and everyone else trapped in bubbles.
The sentimonster, an with optimistic accent, obeys her and gets the bubbles down. Everything's fine until Shadow Moth reveals that he created the sentimonster and he can make it disappear. To make matters worse, Shadow Moth destroys the sentimonster, killing him as he disappears. As a result of his death, his powers are gone too, which culminates with bubbles popping causing Otis and everyone else start to fall. Pegabug uses her yo-yo to make a net that catches Otis and his family.

title: Otis Césaire/History
text:

After Pegabug divides Kaalki becoming Ladybug again, she brings the family to the ground. She uses the pot that she got from her Lucky Charm to bring Hannibal to them and asks Otis to look after it. Ladybug then goes back to the apartment to get the terrarium for the tarantula and soon arrives at the alleyway again and uses the pot to place Hannibal in the terrarium. She uses her Miraculous Ladybug to fix everything, bringing everyone back to the apartment. Otis and the rest of his family then hug Alya. Soon, they all then have dinner.

text:

In "Illusion", Otis attends the parent-teacher conference for Miss Bustier's class. There he is seen sitting with Sabine Cheng as Miss Bustier started with the conference.
In "Collusion", Otis is seen with Marlena, Nora, Ella and Etta on their couch watching the news of Chloé becoming Mayor of Paris as she states that power must return to the people and declares that all Miraculous holders, such as Monarch, Ladybug, and Cat Noir are outlawed.

In "Grendiaper", at his night shift, he finds a Tram driver at the zoo and upon Ladybug, Cat Noir and Rena Rouge's arrival, he explained to the heroes that he found him there and listening to the Tram driver worryingly believing that he was going to be attacked by a panther, Otis reassured him that the zoo's glass windows are unbreakable and thus safe.

title: Palace of Westminster
text:
Palace of Westminster - Intro
The , also known as Houses of Parliament, is a building in the City of Westminster, in London. It is the seat of the Parliament of the United Kingdom, the House of Commons and the House of Lords.

title: Palace of Westminster
text:
Palace of Westminster - Description
Rebuilt between 1840 and 1876 on the north bank of the Thames, the Palace of Westminster is a 112,476 m2 building in Gothic Revival style designed by the architect Charles Barry. The Anstone stone, replaced by Clipsham, gives the building its particular colour.
Along the Thames, the west facade of the Palace reaches 270 metres in length. This facade is two-storey, two pavilions with two square towers at the ends, while two other square towers allow the facade to be divided into three parts.
The Palace of Westminster has many towers. The largest and square one is the Victoria Tower. Named in honour of Queen Victoria, this tower is located in the southwest corner of the palace and is 98.5 metres high. In the centre of the palace, the Central Tower rises to 91 metres. This is octagonal and has a vestibule from which a spire culminates. The most famous is the Elizabeth Tower which, at 96.3 metres, houses the famous Westminster clock and the Big Ben bell, while being the symbol of London. Other much smaller towers were erected at various corners of the palace.
There are many gardens and landscaped areas around the palace.

title: Palace of Westminster
text:
Palace of Westminster - Description
The Palace of Westminster is the seat of the British Parliament. When it meets, a Union Jack is raised on top of Big Ben while its dials light up. When the British Sovereign is present in Parliament, the Union Jack erected at the top of the Victoria Tower is replaced by the Royal Standard of the United Kingdom.

title: Palace of Westminster
text:
Palace of Westminster - Trivia
The Palace of Westminster has been a Grade I listed building since 5 February 1970.
The Palace of Westminster has been a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1987 under the title "Palace of Westminster, Westminster Abbey and St. Marguerite's Church".
