title: Palacio de Bellas Artes
text:
Palacio de Bellas Artes - Intro
The  is a cultural building located in the Historic Center of Mexico City, Mexico. Hosting a variety of performances and two museums, it is considered one of the major arts venues in Mexico.

title: Palacio de Bellas Artes
text:
Palacio de Bellas Artes - Description
Built from 1910 to 1934 according to plans by Adamo Boari, the Palace of Fine Arts is an Art Nouveau building located in the heart of Mexico City 's Historic Center , right next to Almeda Central.
The palace is a two-story building, 53 meters high, constructed of Italian marble. Its façade is inspired by the Neoclassical style, featuring numerous columns and statues by Leonardo Bistolfi, including "Harmony," beneath the vaulted arch of the first and second floors. It has a crystal dome surmounted by statuary depicting the Muses with Apollo.
Four statues representing Pegasus stand in the forecourt of the Palace.
As an opera house and performance venue, the Palace has a capacity of 1,936 seats.

title: Palacio de Bellas Artes
text:
Palacio de Bellas Artes - Activities
Museum of the Palace of Fine Arts
This organization is responsible for the building's permanent murals and other artwork, as well as organizing temporary exhibitions. These exhibitions cover a wide range of media and feature Mexican and international artists, with a focus on both classical and contemporary artists.
National Museum of Architecture
Occupying the top floor of the building, covered by the glass and iron roof, it contains exhibits of renowned Mexican architects, including models, drawings and photographs of major works.

title: Palacio de Bellas Artes
text:
Palacio de Bellas Artes - Trivia
The Palacio de Bellas Artes has been a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1987.
The Palacio de Bellas Artes has the peculiarity of sinking little by little into its foundations, like other buildings in the Historic Center of Mexico City.

title: Peacock Miraculous
text:
Peacock Miraculous - Intro
The  is a brooch that, whenever Duusu inhabits it, transforms the wearer into a peacock-themed superhuman with the power of Emotion.
To activate the brooch, the user must speak the transformation phrase: "Spread My Feathers". To deactivate the brooch, the user must speak the detransformation phrase: "Fold My Feathers".
The brooch is currently owned by Félix Fathom who uses it to transform into Argos.
It was previously owned by Gabriel Agreste who used it to transform into Shadow Moth by combining it with the Butterfly Miraculous. It was also previously owned by Nathalie Sancoeur, who used it to transform into Mayura, who used it for evil purposes. Prior to that, it was used by Émilie Agreste, who fell into an infinite sleep.

title: Peacock Miraculous
text:
Peacock Miraculous - Appearance
In its charged mode, the brooch changes from seven or nine feather segments to five. Its main color is pale, light grayish blue-violet, while the crystals on the top of each segment are red or pink, depending on the episode. The lower part of the Miraculous also changes from the body of a peacock into a single teardrop. As seen in "Ladybug", "Truth", and "Evolution", the actual damage to the Peacock Miraculous itself includes visible cracks on the back of the Miraculous, which were later fixed. If a minor is using the Miraculous, the brooch starts running out of power, emitting a beeping sound, and the crystals begin to disappear one at a time, indicating the remaining time (one crystal is equivalent to one minute). Félix (or another Peacock Miraculous holder) has left.
In its activated mode, the crystals on top turn black.
In its camouflage mode, the brooch changes color and form depending on whose possession it's in:

title: Peacock Miraculous
text:
Peacock Miraculous - Appearance
In the possession of Félix Fathom, the brooch looks like a peacock with an orange raindrop-shaped gem and dull gold triangle at the bottom center and with five dull gold tail feathers coming out from it with arrow-like geometrical patterns. It has an orange pearl-like gem topping each tail feather segment.
When it was worn by Gabriel Agreste, the brooch was gold and shaped like a peacock. It had seven tail feathers and on each of them they had red-purple rubies.
When it was worn by Nathalie Sancoeur, the brooch had the appearance of a peacock with the shape of a peacock's body and head at the bottom center and with nine light sea-green tail feathers protruding from it. It had a teal pearl-like gem on each tail feather segment and a blue gem at the base, which served as the peacock's body.

title: Peacock Miraculous
text:
Peacock Miraculous - Abilities
The Peacock Miraculous can transform its wielder into a peacock-themed superhero, granting its wielder incredible powers of speed, endurance, agility, stamina, and strength. It also makes the user nearly invulnerable. It's special weapon is a hand fan. This weapon can be used as an offensive weapon and a means of communication with other Miraculous owners, as seen in "Miraculer".
The Peacock Miraculous' superpower is Amokization, which allows the user to manifest a Sentimonster, a living creature manifested from a person's emotions. This is achieved by turning a feather into an amok and sending it to inhabit an object belonging to the recipient. The Sentimonster will obey whoever possesses its amok. Users of this power will often command the amok to create a sentimonster by speaking the phrase "Bring my creation to life".

title: Peacock Miraculous
text:
Peacock Miraculous - Abilities
The wielder of the Peacock Miraculous has the power to get rid of the Sentimonster, revoke the amok, and purify the charged feather. They do this by speaking the phrase "I release you from existence" and snapping their fingers, even if the sentimonster was created by a different wielder. They can also cause the Sentimonster pain, to make it heed the Peacock Miraculous holder.

title: Peacock Miraculous
text:
Peacock Miraculous - History
Five thousand years ago, a mage successfully helped the kwamis to interact with humans by creating magic jewels, which were called Miraculouses. In order to repay the mage, and to live on the physical world alongside humans, the kwamis decided to help humanity by letting humans utilize their energy and powers through the Miraculous they were bonded with, which included Duusu and the Peacock Miraculous.
At some point in time, all of the knowledge about the Miraculouses and their powers was written down in code in a book called the Grimoire, with very few people knowing how to decipher the code. Miracle Boxes were also created at an unknown time to store the dormant Miraculouses. To protect and distribute Miraculouses, the Order of the Guardians was formed and existed for many years. Throughout its existence, guardians trained younger generations to keep a watchful eye over the Miraculouses and the Grimoire, which were placed in the guardians' temple.
Many Peacock holders throughout history used Duusu's power for good, like Kǒngquè in China, who started the legacy.

title: Peacock Miraculous
text:
Peacock Miraculous - History
172 years ago, after an disastrous event where a young Wang Fu used the Peacock Miraculous to create a sentimonster and his negative emotions and imaturity led to the creature rampaging through the temple and eating and destroying everything in its path, Fu was entrusted with the Chinese Miracle Box (Which included the Peacock Miraculous after he put it back inside) by a monk and was told to run away from the mess. However, on the mountain range outside the temple, in order to escape from the the monster, Fu jumped over a fissure on the ground - accidently opening the Box and spilling all of its contents on the snow. Due to his distress, Fu didnt notice he accidently left both the Peacock and the Butterfly on the mountain, alongisde the Grimoire, until it was too late and he was too far away to come back. Somewhere along the line, the Peacock got dangerously damaged, to the point of being improper for use - but, as it turns out, no one knew of this fact until it was too late.

title: Peacock Miraculous
text:
Peacock Miraculous - History
On a previous trip overseas with the Agrestes, Nathalie found the Butterfly and Peacock Miraculouses and gave the jewels to Gabriel. In "Representation", it was revealed that neither the Agrestes nor the Graham de Vanily couples could bear children on their own, so Émilie and Colt used the Peacock Miraculous to create Adrien and Félix respectively, but in doing so, they grew sick over time and were eventually left in a condition where they fell into an eternal slumber due to using the Peacock Miraculous in its damaged state. Tomoe Tsurugi also used it's magic to create her daughter Kagami as she wanted a daughter that was perfect in her eyes, but, unlike the other two, didn't die from it's usage - but ended up losing her eyes, having to replace them with bionic ones.

title: Peacock Miraculous
text:
Peacock Miraculous - History
Desperate to fix his mistake, Gabriel Agreste began using the Butterfly Miraculous for evil to obtain the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses in order to gain access to their absolute power, becoming the supervillain Hawk Moth, later Shadow Moth (when unified with a now fixed Peacock Miraculous) and finally Monarch. This decision proved one of the most significant for the history of the series, as Gabriel began utilizing Nooroo's power to akumatize the civilians of Paris, France, trying to get one of them to draw out the current holders of the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses, unintenionally helping start off Marinette's and Adrien's journeys as Ladybug and Cat Noir, and later, the rest of the Miraculers.

title: Peacock Miraculous
text:
Peacock Miraculous - History
During the events of "Mayura", where Hawk Moth had been trapped by the combined efforts of Ladybug, Cat Noir and their superhero team, Nathalie took a big decision, and decided to use the Peacock Miraculous to become Mayura and save him from the heroes, knowing full well of the consequences of using the damaged Miraculous, which horrified Gabriel. She'd continue to use to assist Gabriel all the way until sometime in-between "Miracle Queen" and "Truth", when she was forced to permanently retire due to becoming too sick to continue being Mayura. The consequences followed her all the way into "Re-creation", as her health gradually became worse until finally dying, although she was revived at the end of the episode by Gabriel's wish.

title: Peacock Miraculous
text:
Peacock Miraculous - History
Gabriel managed to track Fu down in "Heart Hunter", and at the end of "Miracle Queen", Gabriel was able to repair the Miraculous with the aid of the tablet he had stolen from him, which contained a translated version of the spellbook, making it safe to use again. Gabriel then used the now-fixed Peacock to fuse with the Butterfly, becoming Shadow Moth, a far more powerful villain, who combined the powers of Nooroo and Duusu to combat the Miraculers during Season 4.

title: Peacock Miraculous
text:
Peacock Miraculous - History
Félix, after finding out about his true origins as a sentihuman and learning that the Peacock Miraculous could erase his and his cousin's lifes if it falls into the wrong hands, orchestrated a plan to capture all of the Miraculouses of the Chinese Box from Ladybug and traded all of them (except for the Ladybug and the Cat) for the Peacock, succeeding in "Strikeback", taking the brooch with him to London, England. Félix then used the Miraculous to become Argos, initially wanting revenge on his uncle and all of humanity in "Emotion", lashing out due to his traumatic childhood. He, however, eventually came to see the errors of his ways at the end of the episode, abandoning his revenge and deciding to keep the Peacock Miraculous to protect himself, Adrien, and Kagami and help the latter two to get their freedom from their abusive parents, as well as preventing other sentimonsters from being created and abused. He also joined the Miraculers sometime during the end of "Re-creation".

title: Peacock Miraculous
text:
Peacock Miraculous - History
Sometime after the events of "Miraculous London", Marinette upgraded the Peacock Miraculous by adding the Miraculous Call: a call feature that grants the holder the ability to summon other superheroes who possess a Miraculous from the Chinese Miracle Box in order to receive aid on their missions. This new feature is particularly useful, as the new holder of the Butterfly Miraculous, Chrysalis, is even more fearsome than her predecessor.

title: Peacock Miraculous
text:
Peacock Miraculous - Trivia
Peacocks symbolize integrity, vision, and vibrancy.
As noted during an event with the writers, it was "weird" that Plagg didn't recognize it when he and Adrien looked inside the safe in "Volpina".
It has been confirmed that the jewel stored in the safe at that time wasn't the real Peacock Miraculous and is merely a copy created by Gabriel. However, the Peacock Miraculous shown in "Mayura" is clearly the real Miraculous, shown by it being in its charged state, which is activated by having a kwami in its Miraculous.
According to Gabriel Agreste, the Peacock Miraculous was "damaged", which resulted in it causing an adverse effect upon its holder when being used. This is demonstrated by Nathalie's coughing and fatigue as a result of using it.
In "Reflekdoll", the Peacock Miraculous malfunctions between its camouflage and charged state when Nathalie activates it before her transformation.
In "Ladybug", cracks can be seen on the back of the Miraculous.
As seen in "Miracle Queen" and "Truth", the Peacock Miraculous was fixed by Gabriel Agreste using the deciphered spellbook on Master Fu's tablet.
The Peacock and Butterfly Miraculouses have rather similar powers.

title: Peacock Miraculous
text:
Peacock Miraculous - Trivia
Both allows the user to charge small things with magic to infect objects of specific people and telepathic communication with them.
They are also the only two known superpowers which the user does not need to say the superpower's name to activate it.
Interestingly, both Miraculouses take the form of brooches, which may cast light on the fact that they have such similar powers.
However, the Butterfly Miraculous's power of Akumatization cannot be used on the wielder (unless they renounce it), unlike the Peacock.
Unlike Kamikotization/Akumatization, however, Amokization can infect an object that's been destroyed, although it is still possible to damage it further to release the Amok.
Also, unlike the former, the Sentimonster can only be controlled by the one who possesses the object containing the Amok, while the power to control Kamikotized/Akumatized champions belongs to the Butterfly Miraculous owner.
Like the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses, the legacy of the Peacock Miraculous dates back to Ancient China and is over 5000 years old.
Exactly how the Peacock Miraculous was damaged whilst the Butterfly was not is unclear.

title: Peacock Miraculous
text:
Peacock Miraculous - Trivia
It was more than likely damaged while Master Fu was fleeing from the Dormant Sentimonster, as after he used it to create his Sentimonster, he was perfectly fine and still alive to this day, while after Émilie, Colt and Natalie used it, they fell ill.
Also, as shown in "Feast" and "Revelation", there was a chasm filled with lava that Wang tripped over, causing him to lose the Miraculous and the Miraculous spellbook, and later, Gabriel, Émilie and Natalie are found to have dug it up under snow and rock, so the lava may have damaged it.
According to Gabriel in "Nathalie as seen by Gabriel", it was actually Nathalie that found the Peacock and Butterfly Miraculouses.
In "Lies", "Furious Fu", "Guiltrip", and "Optigami", the Peacock Miraculous is depicted in its activated form on Shadow Moth's chest instead of its charged one.
The Miraculous has been used by the most people in one family/household, five, having been used by Émilie Agreste, Colt Fathom, Nathalie Sancoeur, Gabriel Agreste, and Félix Fathom.
Peacocks are known to be emotional support animals, potentially inspiring the concept for the Peacock Miraculous.

title: Peacock Miraculous
text:
Peacock Miraculous - Trivia
The Peacock Miraculous is the first known Miraculous to change its user's skin color.
And to be used by a hero of the Miraculers that was previously used by a supervillain.
From a certain point of view, while the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses might be the most powerful out of all the known jewels, the Peacock Miraculous could be considered the most dangerous at least alongside the Rabbit Miraculous.
For example, if a criminal got their hands on the Peacock Miraculous, they could create Sentimonsters based on people that don't even exist to commit crimes, such as murder, robbing banks, etc. And after the deed is done, all the holder would have to do is recall the Amok. And since it's unlikely the police would know about the existence of the Miraculous, they couldn't do anything about it because there's no greater criminal than criminals that don't exist at all. Even worse, the Peacock holder could create Sentimonsters based on real people to frame them for crimes they didn't even commit.

title: Peacock Miraculous
text:
Peacock Miraculous - Trivia
Worse, in the hands of a terrorist, the Peacock holder could assassinate political figures and subsequently create Sentimonster copies of them, allowing said holder to use them as puppets to take over the world. As Ladybug observed in "Ladybug", the powers of the Peacock are so cruel when misused.
Félix considers the Peacock Miraculous as being part of the Graham de Vanily's legacy, since it was used by his aunt, Émilie, and was the tool that gave life to him and his cousin Adrien (the two descendants of the Graham de Vanily family). That was another reason that led him to get it from Gabriel, as he believes that it can only be used by someone related to the Graham de Vanily.
According to Thomas Astruc, when it comes to the damaged Peacock Miraculous, the backlash of its use affects one organ that is connected to the emotion used to create the sentimonster and that the more it is used, the more and faster that organ deteriorates.
That would explain why Tomoe was able to survive, despite the fact others slowly became sick and died, as it was her eyes that were affected when she created Kagami, allowing her to remove them when her condition got worse.

title: Peacock Miraculous
text:
Peacock Miraculous - Trivia
It's unknown if her condition would have spread if she hadn't removed her eyes.
With this in mind, it's currently unknown for Emilie and Colt which specific organs were infected when they created Adrien and Felix respectively. But we do know which emotions were used: love for Adrien and jealousy for Felix.
In "Lady Chaos", Nathalie mentions that Emilie's heart grew weak several months after Adrien's birth, confirming that Emilie's heart was the organ infected by the broken Miraculous.
All miraculouses are supposed to have separate transformation/detransformation phrases depending on whether they're used for good or evil. However, throughout the show, only one phrase has been used by all Peacock holders, no matter their alignment. It's unknown what is the reason for this.
The Rabbit and Peacock Miraculous were the only miraculouses from the Chinese Miracle Box Cerise was unable to steal in the erased timeline in "Miraculous London", as the former was already with Bunnyx in the Burrow and the latter was with Félix in London.

title: Paris
text:
Paris - Trivia
In real life, the city of Paris is divided into twenty arrondissements. However, as revealed in "Peril in Paris", a chapter book adaptation of "Stormy Weather", the series features Paris having twenty-one arrondissements with the 21st being fictitious.
Paris was chosen as the show's setting to complement the show's romantic comedy undertones, as Paris is known as the "City of Love."
It is considered to be a character by the production department.
Originally, in earlier development, Thomas Astruc considered setting the series in Hong Kong, China, as French animated shows weren't usually allowed to take place in France, but Jeremy Zag supported the series' main location being Paris.
The city is the main focus of the webisode "Marinette in Paris".
The distance between the featured locations is larger in real life than what they appear to be on screen.
Thomas Astruc explained at Comic Con Paris 2016 that season 1 was limited in locations due to the lower budget. However, for season 2, the crew has been able to expand on Paris' locations, adding real and important places like the Arc de Triomphe and Sorbonne.

title: Paris
text:
Paris - Trivia
Paris in season 1 was not meant to be entirely accurate. However, Paris in season 2 is meant to be more geographically grounded.
Throughout season 1, multiple landmarks, such as the Eiffel Tower, change their location, depending on the episode. However, starting from season 2, they've been consistently depicted at the same location.
According to Victory in the third issue of Miraculous Adventures, Ladybug and Cat Noir are the only superheroes in Paris presently.
Although "Miraculous Adventures" aren't canon, it's most likely true in the series as well, as all the people of the city were shocked when Ladybug and Cat Noir first appeared in "Ladybug & Cat Noir".
Ladybug and Cat Noir appear to be relatively unknown by civilians outside Paris:
Prince Ali, from the Kingdom of Achu, asks Ladybug who she is after she defeats Princess Fragrance.
Vincent Asa knows about Ladybug but seems to be a bit unacquainted with her, as he refers to her as "this Ladybug".
Wang Cheng, who resides in China, did not know who they were either, having to ask Hawk Moth who they are when he first sees them.

title: Paris
text:
Paris - Trivia
Markov, Max's AI friend, didn't know who Ladybug and Cat Noir were, and asks Hawk Moth during his akumatization.
Fei Wu, who resides in China, didn't know who Ladybug and Cat Noir were, upon first meeting Ladybug she asked if the heroine was one of the good guys.
Zoé Lee did not know who Ladybug and Cat Noir were until a taxi driver showed and told her about them.
However, there have been examples of outsiders knowing about them, including:
Italian exchange student Lila Rossi appears to be well-acquainted with both Ladybug and Cat Noir, lying about being saved by Ladybug and being friends with her to her new classmates.
Kagami Tsurugi, a Japanese student knew who Ladybug and Cat Noir were, even before meeting them in person.
The same goes for Gina Bianchi, Marinette's paternal grandmother, Audrey Bourgeois, Chloé's mother, and Félix Fathom, Adrien's cousin.
Clara Nightingale, an American singer is a big fan of Ladybug and Cat Noir, and makes a song about them in Paris.
The United Heroez, a group of American superheroes, know about Ladybug and Cat Noir, and Aeon, and Jess, two of their members become friends with Ladybug and Cat Noir.

title: Paris
text:
Paris - Trivia
While the history of Paris is relatively the same in the show's universe to real life, there are a few changes.
Armand D'Argencourt's ancestor Darkblade took over and ruled Paris in medieval times, but he was overthrown by a wealthy Frenchman who used his riches to win the favor of the common folk.
Jeanne d'Arc existed, but unlike her real-life counterpart, she was a Ladybug Miraculous holder.
Gilbert du Motier existed, but unlike his real-life counterpart, he was an Eagle Miraculous holder.
The Muskeeters of the Guard existed, but unlike the real guard, Aramis was the first female of the guard and is a Ladybug Miraculous holder.
Heroes' Day exists but the real world Paris doesn't have a Heroes' Day.
French-American Friendship week exists, but the real world Paris doesn't have a French-American Friendship week.

title: Palais de Tokyo
text:
Palais de Tokyo - Intro
is a building dedicated to modern and contemporary art, located at 13 avenue du Président-Wilson, near the Trocadéro, in the 16th arrondissement of Paris.
As seen in "Wishmaker", the Palais de Tokyo hosted, as part of the Paris Career Expo, the stands of the food professions.

title: Palais de Tokyo
text:
Palais de Tokyo - Description
Exterior
The Palais de Tokyo is a monumental classical and modern building. It consists of large wings perpendicular to the Seine built in marble and with glass roofs. These two wings are connected by a colonnade in the peristyle, which overlooks the Place de Tokyo on the city side, and by the Fountain of the Palais de Tokyo, a rectangular basin, on the Seine side.

title: Palais de Tokyo
text:
Palais de Tokyo - Activities
The two wings of the Palace are dedicated to art and artistic creation.
Musée d'Art Moderne de la Ville de Paris
Inaugurated in 1961 in the eastern wing of the palace, the Musée d'Art Moderne de la Ville de Paris houses the municipal collection of modern and contemporary art of Paris. The first is representative of the artistic movements that have developed in the capital since Fauvism, while the second is open to works from the European art scene.
Contemporary Art Center
Opened in 2002 in the West Wing, the Palais de Tokyo is an interdisciplinary place dedicated to contemporary artistic creation in all its forms: painting, sculpture, design, fashion, video, cinema, literature, dance. Artists can be emerging or established, from France or from all over the world.
Exhibitions are presented, in particular by artists who have created their works there.

title: Palais de Tokyo
text:
Palais de Tokyo - Trivia
The Palais de Tokyo was supposed to appear in both Season 2 and Season 3. It first appeared in the background in the episode "Befana".
However, it did not make its first physical appearance until the Season 4 episode "Wishmaker".
Thanks to its vast esplanade and marble steps, the Palais de Tokyo is the mecca of Parisian skateboarding. It is even considered a mythical place nicknamed the "Dome".
There are actually several works of art. The most notable are:
"La France", by Antoine Bourdelle, a bronze statue in homage to the Appeal of June 18 and the fighters of the Free French;
"Allegory of the Glory of the Arts", bas-reliefs by Alfred Janniot located at the bottom of the staircase.

title: Party Crasher
text:
Party Crasher - Intro
"" is a season 3 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 20th written and produced episode of season 3. It is also the 72nd written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Party Crasher
text:
Party Crasher - Synopsis
Netflix
After Adrien tells his friend Wayhem he's not allowed to have friends over, Wayhem discovers an impromptu party at the Agrestes that makes him jealous.
Disney Channel
A fan of Adrien's gets akumatized into Party Crasher; convinced that his star had made a fool of him, he is determined to get revenge; Ladybug and her teammust cheer him up.
Disney+
Ladybug and her team face Party Crasher, a fan of Adrien's.

title: Party Crasher
text:
Party Crasher - Plot
On a video chat, Adrien tells Wayhem that he can't hang out with him because he has casting and a private fencing lesson. When Wayhem gets upset, Adrien promises to hang out with him soon, as Wayhem is his number one fan. He explains that his father rarely lets him go out and never allows friends over. Wayhem promises to one day change his father's mind so that the two of them can spend time together, but Adrien says that his father doesn't easily change his mind. After hanging up, Plagg suggests that Adrien take advantage of his father being out of town by inviting some friends over. Adrien disagrees since he doesn't want to go behind his father's back and couldn't even if he wanted to, as his bodyguard is keeping an eye on him. Plagg reassures him that it's fine because he has him and an endless supply of cheese.

title: Party Crasher
text:
Party Crasher - Plot
In the Agreste car, Nathalie drives a hologram Gabriel to the airport and fixes it when it flickers. When the real Gabriel calls her, Nathalie assures him that he'll be spending the entire weekend in Tokyo, and no one will suspect that he stayed home. Gabriel then goes down to his repository and speaks to Émilie. He promises that she'll be back soon and to use the power of Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses to reverse their past mistake. Noticing that the white butterflies he grows are hatching out of their cocoons, he begins to harvest them.

title: Party Crasher
text:
Party Crasher - Plot
Outside the Agreste mansion, Nino explains their goal to Ivan, Kim, and Max: to get into the Agreste mansion. The first two obstacles, Gabriel and Nathalie, are heading to Tokyo for Fashion Week. For the third obstacle, Placide I.T., they have something to neutralize him. However, Ivan is concerned over the fact that they had promised the girls that they'd help plant trees, and Max agrees that they'd be disappointed if they don't show up. So Nino gives everyone excuses to tell the girls. Meanwhile, as Marinette helps the girls plant trees by the Seine, she wonders where the boys are. Alya says that Nino was asked at the last minute to DJ his grandma's birthday party. Mylène says that Ivan has a toothache and went to the dentist. Alix says that Nathaniel and Marc lost the pages to their comic book, and Max and Markov are helping them recover it. Rose says that Kim had a mandatory swim meet, though is puzzled as to why he texted her that. Marinette, sensing that something is fishy, makes an excuse to leave and quickly takes off.

title: Party Crasher
text:
Party Crasher - Plot
Nino rings the doorbell and claims that they have a school project to work on. However, the bodyguard doesn't let them in until Nino bribes him with a rare action figure. While entering the mansion, he informs him that two others are also coming. The bodyguard therefore pushes them all out, but Nino bribes him again with another action figure. He also asks him not to let in any of their girlfriends should they come by. They all go upstairs to Adrien's room. Adrien is surprised to see them, and Nino explains that they've come for the school project. Adrien is confused as to what project until he realizes what's really going on. Once the bodyguard leaves, the boys reveal that they'd set up a plan to allow Adrien to be able to spend some time with his friends at his house. Adrien is grateful but knows that his father would never allow such a thing. He almost suggests that they leave, but when he notices them getting upset, he decides that it's alright as long as it isn't too long and his father doesn't find out. The guys therefore begin hanging out and admire Adrien's room.

title: Party Crasher
text:
Party Crasher - Plot
In a subway train, Tikki is perplexed since Marinette had told the girls that she was going to her grandpa's house yet is heading the opposite direction. Marinette explains that was an excuse in order to be able to investigate undisturbed. Tikki is displeased that Marinette lied to her friends, but Marinette claims that she didn't want to upset Mylène as it was her idea to plant trees. She also explains that she is suspicious because all the guys were unavailable with lame excuses, and she is an expert on lame excuses since becoming Ladybug. She decides to call Ivan since he is a bad liar and knows that he'll spill the beans if something is going on. While playing foosball, Ivan receives Marinette's call, but Nino tells him not to answer, knowing that he's not a good liar. He also refuses to let anyone else answer Marinette, even taking away their phones. This confirms to Marinette that the guys are all together, and she is confident that they're at the Agreste mansion since Adrien's father is away.

title: Party Crasher
text:
Party Crasher - Plot
Adrien asks why they cannot answer Marinette, to which Nino explains that he doesn't want to get distracted while hanging with his guys. Adrien believes that Marinette counts as "one of his guys", but Nino tells him that they mustn't keep Marinette from hanging with "her guys", much to Adrien's confusion. Nino then suggests playing some music, so Adrien pulls out a bunch of old records, explaining that they were his mother's. He plays one called Stationation and turns the speaker on max, but it isn't very loud. Therefore, Max and Markov plug into the mansion's electrical power to increase the volume.

title: Party Crasher
text:
Party Crasher - Plot
Outside the Agreste mansion, Marinette sees Nathaniel and Marc enter and is now 100% sure of her theory. She prepares to barge in, but Tikki expresses doubt over her idea. Marinette claims that she has just as much right as the guys to be with Adrien and will pretend to have been just passing by. Tikki calls this another lie, but Marinette says it's a half-truth. Meanwhile in Adrien's room, Nathaniel and Marc are greeted by Ivan while Max takes note of how much power the Agreste mansion runs on. Markov directs it all to the speakers, turning the volume so loud that it sends Marinette and dozens of cars flying. Gabriel, who is in his repository collecting butterflies, notices the power go off and frantically rushes to the elevator to see what's going on. However, it stops working halfway up. He also notices Émilie's capsule lose power and becomes concerned.

title: Party Crasher
text:
Party Crasher - Plot
The loud noise prompts an angry Officer Roger to come by the Agreste mansion. He goes into Adrien's room with the bodyguard and demands to know what is going on. After Nino gives the bodyguard another action figure, he tells Roger that they were working on a school project. Roger sarcastically asks if the topic is eardrum damage, to which Nino replies by saying that it's on foosball, pointing to Nathaniel, Marc, and Ivan as they play with Adrien's foosball table. Roger insists that they're doing it wrong and shows them how to play properly. Thomas and Vincent then show up for the casting. Seeing the party going on in Adrien's room, the two of them take multiple photos of Adrien having fun with his friends. Meanwhile, Marinette attempts to enter the mansion by telling the bodyguard that Adrien had invited her, but he doesn't let her inside.

title: Party Crasher
text:
Party Crasher - Plot
Jagged Stone comes by with his helicopter and enters Adrien's room through the window with Fang. Luka, Jalil, and Fred also come by. Marinette complains about all the guys being allowed in but not her, but the bodyguard still refuses to let her inside. Marinette begins complaining to herself about guys when she gets an idea. She goes to a nearby trash bin and puts on a helmet and blanket. Meanwhile, Mr. D'Argencourt comes by for Adrien's fencing lesson. Mayor Bourgeois asks to hide out at the mansion until his daughter's makeup frenzy passes. André claims to have received a call for an ice cream delivery. Mr. Ramier claims to have lost a pigeon that flew into the mansion's backyard. Chloé comes by looking for her father, but she doesn't enter the mansion. Armand asks if Chloé's father is in the mansion. Inside Adrien's room, Jean Tretiens, Simon Grimault, Mr. Banana, and Denis Damoclès dressed as The Owl join the party. Max and Jean take the liberty of filling the entire room with confetti. Adrien asks if all hangout times are like this. Nino says no, but they should be.
Marinette pretends to be a guy named Marino to be allowed inside the mansion.

title: Party Crasher
text:
Party Crasher - Plot
Once in Adrien's room, she is surprised to see Master Fu there.
Master Fu misrecognizes her and pretends to have no idea who she is talking about until she reveals herself to him.
She asks what he is doing at the mansion since he's supposed to be extra careful in hiding the Miraculouses from Hawk Moth, but Master Fu assures her that the Miraculouses are "cool", pointing to a cooler that he is sitting on.
Meanwhile, Armand notices Adrien's Stationation record and is intrigued since it reminds him of his youth.
André suggests doing the dance, but Captain Hessenpy points out that while they do have a fencer, ice cream man, police officer, janitor and fireman, they are missing one last member: The Mustachio'd Biker.
However, Adrien introduces them to a disguised Marinette, and the six of them begin to perform the dance in front of the party guests.
Master Fu dances on his cooler and compliments Kim's moves.
He nearly falls off, but Kim catches him in time.
Master Fu thanks Kim, noting how good his reflexes are, to which Kim says that helping others should always be a natural reflex.
He then jumps into Adrien's bathtub while Master Fu smiles at him.

title: Party Crasher
text:
Party Crasher - Plot
Gabriel transforms into Hawk Moth in order to break out of the elevator and rushes to Émilie. He realizes that he needs an ally to restore power but detects no negative emotions. Instead, he feels only joy and angrily wonders what's going on in his house. Meanwhile, outside the Agreste mansion, Wayhem rings the doorbell in hopes of joining the party but gets no response since the bodyguard put on earplugs. He tries calling Adrien's cellphone but gets no response. Assuming that Adrien had lied earlier about not being allowed to have friends over, Wayhem begins to cry. Hawk Moth detects Wayhem's negative emotions and sends an akuma after him. It infects the glasses he's holding, and Hawk Moth offers him the power to crash Adrien's party in exchange for Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses. Wayhem agrees and is transformed into Party Crasher. Hawk Moth declares that those who invaded his house would face the most fearsome supervillain ever created.

title: Party Crasher
text:
Party Crasher - Plot
Party Crasher uses his power to break into the Agreste mansion. The bodyguard notices and charges towards him, but Party Crasher is able to predict his movements and captures him in his disco ball hands. Meanwhile, as Adrien's party continues, Marinette's disguise falls off while doing a spin during the Stationation dance. Everyone is shocked as Marinette attempts to put her disguise back on, but it's too late. Suddenly, Party Crasher enters the room and begins capturing people in his disco ball hands while calling out for Adrien. As everyone attempts to flee, Adrien tells Marinette to hide and then does so himself to transform into Cat Noir. Marinette also hides to transform into Ladybug. In the middle of his rampage, Party Crasher captures Markov, therefore restoring power to Gabriel's repository, including Émilie's capsule. Pleased, Hawk Moth goes to his lair.

title: Party Crasher
text:
Party Crasher - Plot
Cat Noir tells Party Crasher that "the party's over" once the heroes show up. However, Party Crasher retorts that all he has to do is touch the heroes in order to get their Miraculouses. While fighting, Cat Noir charges at Party Crasher, but he is able to predict his movements, dodge him, and kick him away. He almost captures him in his disco ball hands, but Ladybug uses her yo-yo to pull him with her on top of a nearby statue. Cat Noir wonders how Party Crasher knew what he was going to do, to which Ladybug says that must be his power. She calls on her Lucky Charm and receives a cassette. Party Crasher fires a beam at the heroes, who both jump away from the attack. Party Crasher predicts Ladybug's movements and is able to capture her. Cat Noir is horrified, but before he heads towards the villain, Master Fu stops him, insisting that he won't pull it off without allies. However, Cat Noir doesn't listen and charges towards Party Crasher, so Master Fu pulls out the Miracle Box inside his cooler. He secretly gives Nino the Turtle Miraculous, Luka the Snake Miraculous, and Max the Horse Miraculous.

title: Party Crasher
text:
Party Crasher - Plot
While fighting Party Crasher, Cat Noir winds up losing his staff to the villain. Fortunately, Pegasus, Viperion, and Carapace show up to assist the hero. Hawk Moth warns Party Crasher to be wary of Viperion's ability to go back in time. Viperion activates Second Chance and Carapace prepares to activate Shell-ter only to be captured by Party Crasher. Viperion therefore rewinds time. The second time, Viperion attempts to save Carapace, but Party Crasher predicts his movements and captures him along with the rest of the heroes. Master Fu witnesses this and concludes that there's only one Miraculous that could save the day but notes that it's so special, looking over at the Agreste mansion.

title: Party Crasher
text:
Party Crasher - Plot
Kim swims in Adrien's bathtub until he notices a small black box float in. He picks it up and opens it, finding the Monkey Miraculous and the kwami, Xuppu. Kim refers to Xuppu as a flying monkey plushie. Xuppu retorts that he's not a plushie and gives Kim a raspberry, calling him nitwit. Kim says that his name's not nitwit and also gives him a raspberry. Master Fu watches as Kim and Xuppu make faces at each other and wonders if he made the right choice after all. Kim puts on the Monkey Miraculous and Xuppu tells him what to say. He transforms into a monkey-themed superhero.
Hawk Moth praises Party Crasher for a job well done, saying that all he has to do is deliver the Miraculous to him.
Party Crasher prepares to do so, but Kim, going by the name King Monkey, intervenes and calls on Uproar.
He receives a banana which he throws at Party Crasher.
Party Crasher is perplexed at first but soon sees that his powers have been temporarily messed up.
As a result, everyone he captured is freed.
While most flee, the heroes prepare to fight him.
Ladybug looks around and figures out what to do with her Lucky Charm.
She tells Carapace to protect them and he forms a shield around them.

title: Party Crasher
text:
Party Crasher - Plot
She then tells Pegasus to teleport to Roland Dupain's house and find something to play the cassette in.
Pegasus does just that and picks up an old radio, apologizing to Roland and promising to return it once Paris is saved, leaving the latter confused.
Ladybug puts the cassette inside the radio and tells everyone to be so unpredictable that Party Crasher can't predict their movements.
The heroes approach Party Crasher using a variety of strange dance moves while Stationation plays on the radio.
This confuses Party Crasher and allows the heroes to easily defeat him.
Cat Noir breaks his glasses with his Cataclysm, and Ladybug captures the akuma and uses Miraculous Ladybug to fix all the damage.
The six heroes then fist bump.

title: Party Crasher
text:
Party Crasher - Plot
In Adrien's room, everyone makes sure to clean up well before Adrien's dad comes back from Tokyo. Adrien apologizes to Wayhem, explaining that he hadn't known his friends would surprise him. Wayhem assures him that what matters is that he had fun and also expresses excitement over getting to clean with his idol. Nino also apologizes to Marinette, admitting that things may have gone differently if he hadn't lied. Marinette admits that she also didn't tell a lot of truths. However, both laugh at the fact that they did the things they did for Adrien, and Marinette suggests going to help the girls plant trees once they're done. As everyone leaves, they are unknowingly watched by Gabriel from his atelier, who then goes down to his repository, promising to one day lead Ladybug and Cat Noir into a dance of doom.

title: Party Crasher
text:
Party Crasher - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in Switzerland on RTS Un.
This episode takes place after the events of "Desperada" and "Startrain".
This episode takes place after the events of "Feast" and "Ikari Gozen", as Master Fu began to move and hide his identity more carefully in the former, and explained the situation better to Marinette in the latter, as she expressed doubt about his actions in the Agreste mansion in this episode.
This episode reveals that Gabriel gets the white butterflies he turns into akumas by farming butterflies from a bush in his repository.
This episode shows Master Fu giving Kim the Monkey Miraculous. This is the second time he handed a Miraculous to a user personally, after "Ladybug & Cat Noir".
Unlike that episode, Master Fu genuinely needed help and was not testing the person he was going to give the Miraculous to.
It's unknown how Master Fu knew the identities of Viperion, Carapace and Pegasus.

title: Party Crasher
text:
Party Crasher - Trivia
Since we see Master Fu give the Miraculouses to Luka, Max and Nino it's likely he was told their identities by Marinette prior to this as it's the job for guardians (in training or full fledged) to know the identity of their chosen in the event if either is captured.
Or similar to "Destruction", at some point prior to this episode Kaalki, Wayzz and Sass likely could've shown Master Fu what their current owners looked like.
It is not made clear in this episode whether Marinette and/or Adrien are made aware of King Monkey's true identity. Master Fu may have simply retrieved the Monkey Miraculous personally.
However, it's possible at least Ladybug is aware of King Monkey's identity, as it is her responsibility to return the Miraculous to Master Fu.
This makes this the third episode in a row, production code-wise, to reveal a new hero.
This episode was released out of order, and revealed new information that had to be known previously:
Max is revealed to be the occasional user of the Horse Miraculous, transforming into Pegasus, a horse-themed superhero with the power of Voyage.

title: Party Crasher
text:
Party Crasher - Trivia
Luka is revealed to be the occasional user of the Snake Miraculous, transforming into Viperion, a snake-themed superhero with the power to go back in time for a Second Chance.
This is the second time Master Fu visits the Agreste mansion after "Syren".
Party Crasher becomes the first akumatized villain to succeed in defeating both Ladybug and Cat Noir. He also defeats Carapace, Viperion, and Pegasus in quick succession.
However, he fails to deliver their Miraculous to Hawk Moth, as King Monkey intervenes.
"Stationation" is a reference to the 1970s band "Village People".
To further the reference, Party Crasher's leitmotif bares a strong resemblance to the intro to "YMCA", Village People's most famous song.
This is the fifth time that both Marinette and Adrien's transformation sequences are absent, following "Mayura", "Weredad", "Kwamibuster" and "Feast".
In the episode's English dub, Marinette's made-up name and way of talking when she tries to sneak into the party is a reference to the popular video game character Mario.
The activation phrase of the Monkey Miraculous is "Xuppu, Showtime!"

title: Party Crasher
text:
Party Crasher - Trivia
Marinette's disguise with the helmet has been used at least once in each season: In "Princess Fragrance", she disguised herself to save Tikki while hiding from the press conference with the prince. In "Gorizilla", she gave Adrien the helmet to hide from his fans who later used it to disguise "Adrien" so that Cat Noir could come out and help. In this episode, this is done so Marinette can get into Adrien's all boys party. Lastly, in "Feast", Marinette disguised herself once again to save Master Fu from the giant hungry beast.
The sound wave explosion with cars blown away and the police car thrown upside down is similar to the season 2 episode "Captain Hardrock" in which Max and Markov are able to expand the volume level. Pretty much the same as playing a rock guitar at full volume.
For a currently unknown reason, Disney Channel US cuts the last scene of the episode.
The action figures the guys give Placide I.T. are of Majestia, the original Knightowl and Sparrow, and Mercury.
A part of this episode appears in an Akuma Alert cut scene in the mobile game Miraculous Ladybug & Cat Noir but mirrored.

title: Party Crasher
text:
Party Crasher - Trivia
It's not exactly clear how Party Crasher was able to capture some of the men present as several of them, such as Marc and Nathaniel, were seen making their way out of the house before Party Crasher left Adrien's room.
Roland breaks the fourth wall in this episode when Pegasus takes his radio, and stares at the camera.
Errors
Gabriel's ring is on his ring finger rather than his middle.
After Max and Luka are seen running away from the Agreste mansion, they are spotted hiding in the opposite direction they had run to.
When Master Fu looks back at the Agreste mansion before he bestows the Monkey Miraculous to Kim, the Turtle Miraculous can be seen on his right wrist despite the fact that he previously gave it to Nino.
When Kim gets out of the water, he takes off his swimming goggles. Later when he opens the Miraculous box, the goggles reappear.
Also when Kim transforms into King Monkey, his swimming goggles disappear.
The Monkey Miraculous doesn't turn into Kim's camouflaged form, instead staying in its activated one.
When Pegasus dodges Party Crasher in one scene, his sunglasses disappear.

title: Party Crasher
text:
Party Crasher - Trivia
Immediately before Party Crasher reverts back to Wayhem, he is wearing his glasses, despite them being destroyed earlier.
After Roger rang the Agreste mansion doorbell, he doesn't have his whistle around his neck despite the fact that it appears two scenes later.
When Chloe is seen looking for her father at the doorbell, her sunglasses are a little distorted.
The fireman refers to the fencer on the Stationation cover as a butler.
Luka and Wayhem aren't seen leaving the Agreste mansion even though they are shown helping everyone clean Adrien's room.
Marc is also not seen cleaning the room, even though he and Nathaniel came together.
When King Monkey brings everyone back, Pegasus' glasses are clear.
When Carapace uses his Shell-ter Pegasus' glasses have three dots on them even though he hasn't used his power yet.
When Party Crasher captures Ladybug, Théo can be seen in two different tiles.
When Gabriel talks to Émilie, his voice is deep like Hawk Moth's, instead of being like his civilian voice.
When Ladybug opens her yo-yo to catch the akuma, she does not say the phrase "No more evildoing for you, little akuma".

title: Party Crasher
text:
Party Crasher - Trivia
During the close up of the disco ball holding everyone captured, certain people have moved to a different spot and are in a different stance.
When Party Crasher enters the manor, Placide is seen charging at him with his right hand, but then is seen raising it again when the villain anticipates his moves.

title: Party Crasher/Transcript
text:
Party Crasher/Transcript - Intro
[ Theme Song ]
Adrien: I'm really sorry, Wayhem, but I've got a casting this afternoon and then a private fencing lesson. (notices Wayhem tearing up) But we will hang out soon. You're my number one fan after all. (Wayhem dries his tears) My father never lets me hang out. I never have friends over, either.
Wayhem: Seriously? You never have friends over? (Adrien shake his head) That's harsh. One of these days, I'm gonna come over and change your dad's mind and we'll have a rocking good time. For real!
Adrien: My father doesn't change his mind very easily, but I appreciate the thought. Okay, gotta go finish my homework before the shoot. See you, Wayhem.
Wayhem: Bye, Adrien. (hangs up)
Plagg: Why don't you make the most of your father being out of town? Have some friends over and live it up a little.
Adrien: You know my father has very high expectations of me. I can't go behind his back like that. Besides, even if I wanted to live it up a little, my bodyguard's keeping an eye on me and making sure I stay in line.
Plagg: That's okay, you've got me. And our endless supply of cheese. That'll make anyone happy.
Gabriel: (on speaker) Is everything going to plan, Nathalie?

title: Party Crasher/Transcript
text:
Party Crasher/Transcript - Intro
Nathalie: Yes. On route to the airport, sir. You will officially be spending the entire weekend in Tokyo. No one will ever suspect that you stayed home.
Gabriel: Perfect. (hangs up and then presses the buttons on his painting, leading down to his repository) Émilie, we miss you so much. But you'll be back with us very soon. Thanks to my akumas, it's only a matter of time before I take control of their Miraculous. Merging them will grant me absolute power to reshape reality, and finally reverse our past mistake. (notices white butterflies emerging from their cocoons) They're ready. Nooroo, time to harvest. (collects the butterflies)
Nino: Okay, remember our objective. To penetrate the impenetrable fortress, aka Adrien's pad. Our main obstacle, Adrien's old man, is headed for Tokyo's fashion week along with Obstacle #2. As for Obstacle #3, we have our own secret weapon to neutralize him. (Max taps his bookbag) Operation Adrien begins now!
Ivan: Uh... now now?
Nino: Yeah, now now! What now?
Ivan: Uh, now now is when I promised Mylène I'd go help her plant some trees down by the river.
Kim: Wait a sec! The street thing's today?

title: Party Crasher/Transcript
text:
Party Crasher/Transcript - Intro
Max: Yes, and the probability of the girls being terribly disappointed if we don't participate is 100%.
Nino:  Which is why I already came up with official excuses for each of you. (hand everyone a piece of paper) Like you, Kim, have a swimming lesson.
Kim: Great! I always have my trunks on me.
Nino: Dude, you don't actually have a swimming lesson. That's just your excuse.
Ivan: But isn't that lying?
Nino: Sorry, but Max is right. The girls can't know about this. So, is this mission still on? For Adrien? (the guys look over their excuses) Guys?
(The boys all nod in agreement and begin texting the girls)
Marinette: (places a tree down) Hey, weren't the boys supposed to be here?
Alya: Nino was asked at the last minute to DJ his grandma's birthday party.
Mylène: Ivan suddenly got a toothache and rushed over to the dentist.
Alix: Nathaniel crashed his computer and lost all the pages of the comic book he and Marc are doing. Max and Markov are helping them fix it.
Rose: Kim had to go to the pool for a mandatory swim lesson, though I'm not entirely sure why he texted me that.

title: Party Crasher/Transcript
text:
Party Crasher/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (senses something is wrong, gasps) Oh! Uh... speaking of excuses, I- I- forgot that I was supposed to help my... grandpa bake a cake for one of his mouse's birthday today. Sorry, Mylène. Catch you later, girls! (takes off)
Alya: Did I miss something, or is it bad excuses world championship today?
Nino: Hello. We’re here to see Adrien. We got to work on a school project together. (The camera unceremoniously goes back in. Nino chuckles mischievously, and rings the doorbell again. The camera returns.) Word is, you’re one of the biggest superhero figure collectors in the world. Is it true your collection is only missing a few pieces? Including this incredibly rare Majestia Millennium Edition? (Max shows the bodyguard the action figure)
Bodyguard: (grunts in surprise) Mhuh?(opens the mailbox)
Nino: (puts the figure inside) Here ya go! (The bodyguard opens the gate for them.)
Boys: Yeah! (high five and head towards the mansion)
Bodyguard: (inquisitively) Hmm? Hmm? (nods at Nino and grunts affirmatively) Hmm.

title: Party Crasher/Transcript
text:
Party Crasher/Transcript - Intro
Nino: (entering the mansion) By the way, two more of Adrien’s buddies are gonna show up later and help with the project-! Whoa! (Adrien’s bodyguard shoves then back outside, Nino stops the door from closing with his foot.) Vintage Knightowl, 65th Anniversary Edition. (shows the action figure)
Bodyguard: (grunts excitedly, and lets them back in)
Nino: But if Marinette, Juleka, Rose, Alya, Alix, or Mylène come knocking at the door, don’t let them in. 'Kay?
Bodyguard: Hmph! (He grunts indignantly, opening the door threateningly, then chuckles with satisfaction as he gets a Sparrow action figure)
Max: (to Nino) He sure strikes a hard bargain. (The Bodyguard leads them upstairs)
Adrien: What are you guys doing here?
Nino: We’re here for the school project.
Adrien: Project? What project?
Nino: You know. The project. (winks)
Adrien: Oh, that project! (Adrien’s bodyguard leaves)
Boys: Surprise project! (gather around Adrien)
Nino: You’ve never had any hang out time at your place, right?
Ivan: We get to have it whenever we want.
Max: So we’ve come up with a plan to right this injustice.

title: Party Crasher/Transcript
text:
Party Crasher/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: That’s really cool of you all. But my father would never allow this. It’d be best if you... (notices the guys’ disappointment) Uh, but hey! As long as it’s not for very long and he never, ever finds out about it...
Boys: Hang out time! (look around Adrien’s room)
Kim: (heads inside Adrien’s bathroom) A jet stream bathtub! So glad I came prepared!
Ivan: (slides down Adrien’s pole and plays with his foosball table) Dude, I’ve always wanted one of these in my room!
Max: Is there any game you don’t have?
Nino: Man, you’ve got the coolest stuff!
Adrien: You ain’t seen nothing yet. (throws a basketball into his basketball hoop and his piano emerges from the ground)
Boys: Awesome!
Tikki: Marinette, this isn’t the way to the bakery.
Marinette: No, Tikki, I just said that so I could lead my investigation undisturbed.
Tikki: You lied to your friends...?

title: Party Crasher/Transcript
text:
Party Crasher/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: I didn’t want to upset Mylène. It was her idea to plant the trees this afternoon. But something totally fishy’s going on. All the boys are unavailable with really lame excuses, and trust me, I know a lame excuse when I hear them. I’ve turned into an expert at them since I became... you-know-who. (winks) I know, I’m gonna call Ivan. He can’t lie to save his life. If there’s something secret going on, he’ll definitely blab.
Nino: (commentates on the game foosball between Adrien and Ivan) Zitune to Platino, who dribbles and passes to Kili and the Kaki. Goal!
Adrien: Yes! (he and Nino fist bump)
Ivan: (hears his phone ring) It’s Marinette!
Nino: (takes the phone away) Don’t pick up! You can’t lie to save your life. If she finds out we’re here, you can say goodbye to guy time. (notices Adrien's phone ringing and snatches it)
Max: It’s Marine– (Nino takes away his phone along with Kim’s)
Marinette: Proves my point. They’re all together. And I may have an idea of where they could be. (checks phone) Adrien’s dad left town for Tokyo’s fashion week. While the cat’s away, the mice will play.
Adrien: Why can’t we just answer Marinette?

title: Party Crasher/Transcript
text:
Party Crasher/Transcript - Intro
Nino: Because… you don’t want to get distracted from your only chance to hang out with your guys.
Adrien: But isn’t Marinette... one of my guys?
Nino: Yes... but no. Right now, she’s with her guys, so we aren’t going to go and disturb her and her guys. Otherwise we wouldn’t be the good guys. Get it?
Adrien: This whole guy thing’s super complicated.
Nino: Okay... music! (Adrien opens one of his drawers) Woah! These can’t be your awesome old records.
Adrien: They were my mother's.
(Nino pulls out the record titled Stationation, blows off the dust, puts in into a record player, and turns the volume up on Adrien's computer; music plays from Adrien's speakers)
Nino: Uh, wait a sec. Is this as loud as it gets? Hey, Max and Markov! Can you do something to turn it up?
Max: (gets on Adrien’s computer) Affirmative!
Markov: I just need to hook to the home’s electrical panel. (plugs himself to Adrien’s computer)
Marinette: I knew it!
Tikki: Are you sure this is a good idea?
Marinette: All the guys are together at Adrien’s place, so why can’t I be there too? I’ll just pretend I was passing by and, uh...
Tikki: Yet another lie?
Marinette: Just a half truth.

title: Party Crasher/Transcript
text:
Party Crasher/Transcript - Intro
Ivan: Hey, guys! (hugs Nathaniel and Marc)
Max: (to Adrien) Woah! Your house has an insane power supply, Adrien. It could compete with a nuclear power station.
Adrien: My father always has to own the biggest and the best.
Nino: Cool! Give me the biggest and the best. (Max redirects all the power to the speakers, increasing the volume so much that it knocks away Marinette, who was about to ring the doorbell, and several cars)
Gabriel: The system is down? (sees Émilie's capsule lose power) Émilie!
Adrien: (covering his ears) You sure it's not too loud?
Nino: Are you kidding? This is the way it's supposed to be for guy time!
Roger: Hmm. It's about time.
Marinette: (notices the gate opening) This is my chance! (the gate closes before she can enter)
Roger: (blows his whistle, the music stops) What's all this racket about? (Max gives the bodyguard a Mercury action figure and he leaves)
Max: Uh...
Adrien: Sorry, officer. We're just doing...
Nino: ...a school project! We're working on a school project!
Roger: What's the topic? Eardrum damage?
Nino: No, it's, uh, on foosball. (points to the foosball table)

title: Party Crasher/Transcript
text:
Party Crasher/Transcript - Intro
Roger: Seriously? (approaches the foosball table) You're doing it all wrong! Let me show you how it's done. (plays foosball) Caset! To Baliage! Goal!
Boys: Woah!
Vincent: It's for the casting.
Vincent: Ma, che bella fiesta! The perfect setting for the photoshoot! (Thomas and Vincent take several photos with the boys as they party)
Marinette: Uh, I'm one of Adrien's buddies from school and he... personally invited me to his party? (the gate doesn't open and Marinette sighs)
Jagged: (through a megaphone) Hey, Adrien! I'm digging the tunes! (jumps through the window with Fang) Rock 'n Roll!
Marinette: (indignant) Why are all the guys allowed in and I'm not? (angrily walks away) Guys! Guys? Guys! Of course! (runs to a nearby trash bin and grabs a helmet and other materials)
Mr. D'Argencourt: Tell your young master his fencing instructor awaits, wretch.
Mayor Bourgeois: (with makeup on his face) Can I rest here for a few hours? Until my daughter's makeup frenzy has passed?
André: Bonjour! I received a call for a ice cream delivery!
Mr. Ramier: I'm sorry, I've lost a pigeon. I think I saw it fly into your backyard.
Chloé: Daddykins! I'm not finished with you! Daddy!

title: Party Crasher/Transcript
text:
Party Crasher/Transcript - Intro
Armand: (wearing makeup) Miss Bourgeois sent me here to looking for her Daddykins. Would he be here by any chance?
Roger: Janel! Thanks for bringing your leaf blower!
Simon: Who loves magic?
Mr. Banana: Stay peachy!
Denis Damoclès: (wearing a Knightowl costume) Hoo-hoo!
(Max dumps a bucket of confetti in front of Janel's leaf blower, causing it to fly everywhere)
Mr. Banana: (swings from the ceiling) Stay peachy!
Adrien: Is hang out time always like this?
Nino: No, but it should be.
Marinette: (in a fake accent) Hi there! It's a-me: Marino! Your neighbor! I heard there was a party going on here, a guy's-only, so I'd like to come-a too, because, uh, I'm a guy. Heh! In fact, it's hard for me to walk with all these guy muscles of mine. Hehe! (The gate opens. She cheers in her normal voice) Aha! (goes back to her fake accent) I mean, hoo hoo! (walks inside and into Adrien's room)
Marinette: Master Fu?
Master Fu: (not recognizing Marinette) Who, me? No, not at all. I'm DJ Wong! Ooh, ooh! Wiki, wiki, waa!
Marinette: (leans towards him and takes off her glasses) Master, it's me: Marinette.

title: Party Crasher/Transcript
text:

Marinette: What are you doing here? Aren't you supposed to be extra careful? (winks) You know, keeping the Miraculous hidden so Hawk Moth won't find them?

we love to go to the holiday camp,

we are looking forward to the dance of the champ. ♫

title: Party Crasher/Transcript
text:

Master Fu: Thank you, young man. Your natural reflexes are quite good.

Gabriel: Nooroo, dark wings rise! (transforms into Hawk Moth, breaks elevator glass, and rushes to Émilie)
Hawk Moth: I need someone to restore power from the outside. (searches for negative emotions) I don't feel any negative emotion. There's only... joy. What's going on in my house!?

Adrien's voicemail: This is Adrien's voicemail. Leave a message.
Wayhem: (takes off his glasses) Not only are you allowed to have friends over, but apparently a huge party is no big deal, either. Why did you lie to me, Adrien? (starts crying)
Hawk Moth: I can feel a negative emotion. At last, an unexpected powerful wave of disappointment. (creates akuma) Fly away, my little akuma. And evilize him!
Hawk Moth: (from the repository) Party Crasher, I am Hawk Moth. So you weren't invited? Well I'm giving you the power to crash that party, and end it for good!

title: Party Crasher/Transcript
text:

Wayhem: Let's get this party started, Hawk Moth. (transforms into Party Crasher)

Party Crasher: (absorbs the Agreste gate into his disco ball hand and runs to the mansion) Adrien!
Party Crasher: Your body language is like second nature to me. I can read your dance steps and see all your moves in advance. (absorbs the bodyguard)

text:

title: Passion
text:
Passion - Intro
"" is a season 5 episode of the series Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. Based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 7th written and produced episode of season 5. It is also the 111th written and produced episode of the series overall.

title: Passion
text:
Passion - Synopsis
As Marinette tries to convince herself that she loves Cat Noir to try and forget about Adrien, Adrien, who has given up on being in love with Ladybug, tries to find a way to declare his feelings to Marinette. As everything turns upside down in their lives, Ladybug and Cat Noir exchange their Miraculous to escape a ruthless villain. But the return of Mister Bug is about to make things even more confusing in Lady Noire's heart.
Disney+
Lady Noire and Mister Bug are back!
Netflix
Ladybug turns her attention to Cat Noir while Adrien chases Marinette. Nathalie's promise to Emilie conflicts with her love for Gabriel.

title: Passion
text:
Passion - Plot
Marinette, in her bedroom, tries to convince Alya that she is in love with Cat Noir and explains that her love for Adrien cost her the Miraculouses, but Cat Noir is her partner who is always there for her and also loves her. Alya points out that he's in love with Ladybug, but Marinette says those are the same thing. Alya says that she falls in love with someone else once Adrien falls for her, but Marinette says those two things are not related and leaves for school early and in her pajamas.
Adrien wakes up saying Marinette dreamily, repeatedly. Plagg, annoyed asks if he forgot all about Ladybug.  Adrien says Ladybug doesn't want him, and she has the right to choose and enters his kitchen where his father is cooking pancakes. Gabriel asks Adrien if he would like bananas on his pancakes. Adrien complies.

title: Passion
text:
Passion - Plot
Nathalie hears Adrien's alarm ringing, and enters his room, warning that he will be late. When he is not there, she turns off the alarm, and runs to the kitchen, where she finds Adrien and his father eating breakfast. She informs Gabriel that Adrien prefers his pancakes plain. Adrien says it's okay, but Nathalie tells him not to force himself for his father. Gabriel and Nathalie stare at each other aggressively for a moment. Then they both get alarms and send Adrien to school. Adrien says he forgot to pack his bag and runs off.
Suddenly, Nathalie pins Gabriel to the table, telling him she came to hunt for magical artifacts for Émilie and him. Nathalie then explains how she was his bodyguard, friend and more and now it is all over. She also states he did what he did out of love for Émilie, but now he is only doing it out of madness and she's only here to protect Adrien from him. Gabriel states what he is doing is to make Adrien happy but Nathalie states the only thing Adrien needs to be happy is his father.

title: Passion
text:
Passion - Plot
Nathalie tells Gabriel that he must accept that he will never get Émilie back out of her coma and that even Émilie accepted her fate. He refuses to believe that. Nathalie says to stop kidding and tells him about the recordings Émilie left for them that they both saw. He tells her that he couldn't bear it and about why he made Nathalie destroy Émilie's recordings. Gabriel says it is too late and shows his left arm that was cataclysmed by Cat Noir to her. Gabriel tells Nathalie that if she doesn't help him take Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses and help bring Émilie back, he won't be able to save himself and Nathalie and Adrien will have no one.

title: Passion
text:
Passion - Plot
Adrien talks to Plagg about how his father and Nathalie are getting alone and asks for his opinion about giving a ring to Marinette. Adrien then suggests a poem but Plagg doesn't like his idea. Meanwhile, in Nathalie's room, Nathalie, says what is happening cannot be happening. She takes her phone out from the safe and watches a video Émilie recorded. In the video, Émilie is counting on Nathalie and says her husband is stubborn and won't stop hunting after the Miraculouses and that Adrien needs them both. Nathalie promises Émilie that she will get the Ladybug and the Cat Miraculouses before Gabriel does.
Suddenly, Adrien knocks on the door and asks Nathalie how he should express his love for Marinette. Nathalie tells Adrien about her past and tells him that when she liked Gabriel, she had found out that he had feelings for Émilie. She then tells him that love was complicated. But all of a sudden she starts coughing. Adrien becomes worried and asks her if what happened to his mother will also happen to Nathalie, to which she answers no. Nathalie tells to Adrien to head off to school.

title: Passion
text:
Passion - Plot
In the Crypt, Gabriel is talking to Émilie, saying how he doesn't know how to proceed alone. Nathalie arrives and tells him he is not alone and reminds him about a promise she made about how she would get him magical items he would need, but failed in getting Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses. Nathalie states it is now time for her to fulfil her promise. Gabriel tells Nathalie that she had risked too much. She asks Gabriel to akumatize her.
In front of the school, Adrien tells Marinette that he is not fine and she tells him that being there is enough for someone who is sick. Plagg talks to Tikki about their holders being in love with each other and reassures him at everything is fine. The megakuma sent by Monarch infects a mannequin that has a hunting suit on it. Monarch akumatizes Nathalie and transfers the essence of the Goat Miraculous, as Caprikid's Genesis, to her. Nathalie gets akumatized into Safari. She then draws a chest full of hunting equipment so that she cannot miss her prey and allows her to know where Ladybug and Cat Noir are. Monarch tells Safari that she cannot use more than six powers simultaneously and tells him she will not the same mistake he did.

title: Passion
text:
Passion - Plot
Safari then casts an illusion of Timetagger reappearing. Excited to meet Cat Noir again, Marinette is told by Tikki to focus on defeating Timetagger instead. Marinette transforms into Ladybug. Soon, she and Cat Noir show up and Safari uses a gadget to locate them. Safari creates a Venom Bolt. Ladybug and Cat Noir start to chase after the Timetagger illusion before it disappears. Ladybug is struck by the bolt and Cat Noir uses his powers on a bot, only to see that there are four more bolts after him. Cat Noir realizes that Safari is Nathalie and promises to set her free.

title: Passion
text:
Passion - Plot
After escaping the bolts in the sewers, Cat Noir detransforms back into Adrien and the bolts leave him alone. Adrien realizes that the bolts were only after Ladybug and him but not Mister Bug and Lady Noire. With Plagg's help, Adrien gets the Ladybug Miraculous without discovering her secret identity. Adrien explains his plan to Marinette but suddenly Adrien asks Marinette about combining the two and making a wish to fix the errors of the world. Marinette tells him that the balance between creation and destruction must always be maintained, she is relieved when Adrien decides to trade their Miraculouses instead. Mister Bug and Lady Noire find out that their plan worked.

title: Passion
text:
Passion - Plot
After destroying all of Safari's belongings except her suit, Mister Bug and Lady Noire realize that the megakuma is not on her. Mister Bug uses his Lucky Charm and receives a bottle of perfume. After seeing an advertisement for a bottle of the perfume made by the Agreste brand, Mister Bug realizes that the akumatized object must be at the Agreste mansion. While he goes to Nathalie's room, Lady Noire continues to fight Safari. After destroying the mannequin that has the megakuma in it, Mister Bug purifies the megakuma and repairs all of the damage that occurred when Safari was fighting Mister Bug and Lady Noire. Safari is deakumatized back into Nathalie. Terribly weakened after her akumatization, she staggers... Mister Bug immediately catches her. Assisted by Lady Noire, he helps her sit down on the bed. Gabriel rushes in, asking what has happened. He kneels down next to Nathalie, showing his concern... and taking the opportunity to take a close look at Mister Bug, Lady Noire and their Miraculous

title: Passion
text:
Passion - Plot
Mister Bug (Adrien behind the mask) is absolutely furious at seeing Nathalie in this state. He is indignant against Monarch who used a sick woman for his projects and exclaims that he will pay for his actions. Lady Noire shoots the determined Mister Bug an admiring glance. Gabriel and Nathalie look at him too, but because he's talking about Gabriel.
After giving back their regular Miraculouses, Marinette explains what happened to Alya in her room and tells her about her feelings for Mister Bug/Cat Noir. In her room, Nathalie is thinking about Émilie and Adrien enters and apologizes, thinking he has caused her akumatization. Adrien tells Nathalie he will always be there for her and Nathalie asks him to tell her about Marinette and what it was Adrien wanted to know as the episode ends.
