title: Passion
text:
Passion - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in France on TFOU.
The episode shares its name with the concept of the Goat Miraculous.
It's revealed that the Goat Miraculous can create multiple objects by drawing a container full of them.
However, this could be due to Nathalie being akumatized, Monarch modifying the Miraculouses, or Nathalie being an adult.
The weapons Safari creates appear to be magical, which seemingly contradicts what Caprikid said in "Penalteam".
However, since Safari's power allows her to never miss a target and the projectiles used by her are charged with other Miraculous superpowers, it appears that the objects created by Genesis can use magic coming from an external source.
And also it seems like Safari actually didn't get the powers of the real miraculouses directly, but the powers she used, for example Mirage and Venom is actually provided by Monarch's akuma.
Besides the power, the episode, as well as others, also shows the character's own feelings of passion, both romantic and affective:

title: Passion
text:
Passion - Trivia
Adrien is struggling to find a way to declare his love for Marinette. He is also worried about Nathalie's health and that what happened to his mother will happen to her too.
Marinette is seen flirting with Cat Noir, the same way he used to do with her as Ladybug. She discovers that what she couldn't say to Adrien, she can say to Cat Noir easily.
André's passion of ice cream making and romance couples.
Nathalie is the one to come up with the plan to take Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous because of her motherly love for Adrien, determined to use the Ultimate Miraculous Absolute Power herself so that he won't be alone.
This is the third time someone else besides Monarch that wanted the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses for themselves following "Robostus" and "Ephemeral".
The Goat Miraculous represents that passion can be a powerful thing but have a dark side as well as teach people not to be so stubborn and that lessening or changing them is okay:
Through the current Goat Miraculous holder, Nathaniel, he is super passionate about his art, as well as his crush for Marinette at the time, that it led to distractions and his akumatization in "The Evillustrator".

title: Passion
text:
Passion - Trivia
And prior to becoming Caprikid in "Penalteam", he was passionate and stubborn about not participating in a casual game of soccer.
In "Rogercop" and "Kwamibuster", Plagg's passion and obsession with cheese caused two akumatizations.
In "Dearest Family", where Tikki's passion for sweets caused her to disobey the rules and use her powers selfishly.
How Marinette's passion and obsession over Adrien caused problems for herself and others in "Gamer", "Volpina", "Santa Claws", "Desperada" and other episodes.
Cat Noir's passion over Ladybug leading to trouble in "Copycat" and other episodes.
Like how in "Collusion", Émilie knew that her husband's passion and desire to save her would lead him into trouble.
As Cat Noir, Adrien found Ladybug's stubbornness irresistible in "Volpina".
André who gave up his passion for film making for politics.
Like "Perfection" and "Adoration", this episode and others also have correlations to the goat or at least the term "scapegoat".
When it came to his plans to restore his family Gabriel used what he felt towards them as his emotional scapegoat while his akumatized victims were his physical scapegoat as the heroes kept beating them but not him.

title: Passion
text:
Passion - Trivia
He and Lila used Chloé as their scapegoat to continue their own plans in "Revolution".
Gabriel also saw the heroes to blame for his problems as they constantly stopped him from realizing his wish but they had no idea what wish he wanted nor he wouldn't admit his own mistakes.
As Lady Noire, Marinette asked Mister Bug about going to movie which is about the same thing he asked her in "Timetagger" and "Gang of Secrets".
This is the fourth appearance of Adrien's pajamas following "Kuro Neko", "Risk" and "Multiplication".
It's revealed that Nathalie used to be a treasure hunter of magical artifacts and that is the reason why she came to the Agreste household.
It's also implied that Gabriel and Émilie were explorers too.
Plagg says that Marinette and Adrien falling in love and revealing their identities will be the end of the world. Tikki says it wouldn't happen, but that is exactly what happened in "Cat Blanc" and "Ephemeral".

title: Passion
text:
Passion - Trivia
It's revealed that Gabriel has been tracking the Ladybug and Cat Miraculous before Émilie fell victim to the final collateral effect of the damaged Peacock Miraculous. However, seeing how obsessive her husband was getting, Émilie expressed the desire of him stopping and left recordings of herself expressing that same desire. According to Gabriel, he ordered Nathalie to erase all those recordings, but it's shown that she still has them, including one directed to her where Émilie asks her to take care of Adrien.
This is third time Nathalie gets akumatized following "Catalyst" and "Ladybug". However, this time she gets akumatized into a new form called Safari.
Safari is the fourth villain to request powers from Hawk Moth/Shadow Moth/Monarch directly, after Chameleon, Queen Banana and Style Queen in "Optigami".
This is also the first time the heroes face an akumatized Nathalie directly.
This is the second time a villain gets their powers not immediately after Hawk Moth/Monarch's speech, but instead by touching a newly akumatized object, after "Reverser".

title: Passion
text:
Passion - Trivia
This is the first time that an akumatized villain gets more than one Miraculous superpower. Using the power of the Goat Miraculous, Safari created a set of projectiles charged with the powers of five other Miraculous (Fox, Bee, Pig, Dragon and Tiger).
According to Monarch, he can only give up to six Miraculous superpowers at a time.
Interestingly, the main holders of all five Miraculouses (Rena Rouge, Vesperia, Pigella, Ryuko, and Purple Tigress, respectively) are girls.
It's revealed that Ivan and Mylène don't wear Alliance rings, making them the third and fourth members of Miss Bustier's class to do so.
This is the second time Adrien thinks of using the Absolute Power (in the current timeline), wanting to use it to save Nathalie from her illness. But he ends up giving that idea up after Marinette explains to him that using it would create disastrous consequences, as the illness would not be healed, but only transferred to another person.

title: Passion
text:
Passion - Trivia
The first time was back in "Miraculous Paris", where he thought about using it to bring his mother back but being reminded of how the wish worked and refusing to let another family suffer and remembering his love for others he changed it just to find out it will be the same in the end the problem won't be fixed just moved.
Even though Adrien doesn't know it yet, Marinette in "Robostus" asked Master Fu the exact same thing about using the Absolute Power to end conflicts and cease other miseries. Marinette's reply to Adrien is identical to what she was told by Fu.
Including alternative timelines, this is the second time he thinks in using the Absolute Power, with the first one being in "Cat Blanc", where he, akumatized into the titular villain, sought to take Ladybug's Miraculous so he could fix the damages he had caused with his power.
Adrien was thinking the same as his father using the jewels to heal someone they cared about of their condition but unlike Gabriel, Adrien cared about the consequences of using such power.
This is also the first time where Adrien held both his and Ladybug's Miraculouses at the same time.

title: Passion
text:
Passion - Trivia
With the examples Marinette mentioned taken into account, the ironic fact is that they already have all that even without the wish.
This is the first time a Lucky Charm is summoned when its summoner already knows the answer to defeat the villain. Mister Bug knew who Safari was and where to find her akumatized object. However, in order to preserve his secret identity, he summoned the Lucky Charm hoping it would give him the excuse he needed to go after the akumatized object without revealing his connection to the akumatized villain.
Mister Bug mentions previous Lucky Charms that included a radiator, a whistle, and a playing card. The first one was seen in "Riposte", but the other two were never shown on-screen.
Those two lucky charms he mentioned were also the akumatized objects of Rogercop and Simon Says from the episodes of the same names.
This is tenth time a Lucky Charm object resembled an akumatized victim's object, in this case, a perfume bottle in "Princess Fragrance".
Lady Noire's vision is seen for the first time. Instead of coloring on objects with certain patterns, the objects she focuses on are encircled with green and black circles.

title: Passion
text:
Passion - Trivia
Mister Bug's De-Evilize sequence has been reanimated compared to the one used in "Reflekdoll". Because in that episode, Mister Bug was carrying his Lucky Charm mirror on his back when he was capturing the Akuma and Amok.

title: Panic at the Park
text:
Panic at the Park - Synopsis
Between heroic missions, Ladybug and Cat Noir take a break at the amusement park. Cat Noir takes the opportunity to win Ladybug's heart with a teddy bear. Unfortunately, Stormy Weather has other plans, turning what should be a simple mission into a challenging one!

title: Panic at the Park
text:
Panic at the Park - Trivia
The webisode was created for a Miraculous Chibi playset.
This webisode, along with "The Cake Race", are the first to be released as part of the Miraculous Chibi revival run.
This marks the first appearance of Stormy Weather as well as an akumatized villain in the chibi series.
The carnies who give Cat Noir a damaged teddy bear prize each share the same character design as Marinette, Chloé, and Adrien. For example, the sleeves of the second carnie's jacket are yellow which is identical to Chloé's. However, to keep up with the illusion that the animators didn't reuse one of the three aforementioned characters for a carnie, their faces are obscured and only their arms are shown.
Because the web series takes place in a separate universe, the akumatized villains are revealed to be mild inconveniences since neither Ladybug nor Cat Noir battle Stormy Weather here.
On December 2, 2023, an alternative version of the webisode was released.

title: Panic at the Park
text:
Panic at the Park - Trivia
There's an extra scene added in the alternative version that features Stormy Weather fantasizing about wanting to break apart Ladybug and Cat Noir's relationship via a thought bubble. As a result, this scene gives viewers context on why the akumatized villain wanted to sabotage Cat Noir from winning a teddy bear for Ladybug and it didn't come off as her playing a prank on him which was depicted in the original version.
However, this scene isn't seen in the episode animatic.
Interestingly, this webisode has three different endings. After Cat Noir crashed the rollercoaster onto the Ferris wheel and landed on the ground, the three different endings represent which character "won" in the webisode.
In Stormy Weather's ending: Cat Noir loses his temper and is about to destroy his teddy bear before he sees Ladybug walking towards him. He quickly calms down and is about to give Ladybug the damaged teddy bear before its head falls off. This ending shows Cat Noir's carnival prize plan fails and Stormy Weather wins, albeit the latter doesn't appear in this ending.

title: Panic at the Park
text:
Panic at the Park - Trivia
In Cat Noir's ending: Cat Noir successfully gives the teddy bear to Ladybug despite how damaged it is. This ending shows Stormy Weather's sabotage plan fails and Cat Noir wins.
In Ladybug's ending: Ladybug already managed to win a teddy bear on her own, albeit off-screen. Thus, this ending shows both Stormy Weather and Cat Noir's respective plans fail.
The storyboarder, Esther Brustlein, uploaded an animatic of this webisode that featured Ladybug's ending on ArtStation. However, an animated version of it hasn't been officially released yet.
Both Cat Noir's and Ladybug's endings have Ladybug standing in front of a carnival mirror display. However, Stormy Weather didn't appear in either endings.
It's unknown how Ladybug won a teddy bear in her ending since neither the animatic nor final versions show her playing any carnival games.
Despite the webisode replacing Stormy Weather's ending with Cat Noir's ending, the original version can still be viewed from a compilation video.
Errors
Throughout the webisode, Ladybug's earrings are in camouflaged mode.
In the title card, Ladybug's yo-yo is around the right side of her waist instead of her left side.

Despite Ladybug and Cat Noir being at the amusement park, they and Stormy Weather are the only characters there. There aren't any other fairgoers around. Only two carnies are shown by their arms when they hand Cat Noir a damaged teddy bear prize whenever he wins a game, but there aren't any other carnies shown beside them.
Throughout the scenes when Cat Noir is trying to win the tin can ball toss game, the sign for the hook-a-duck features a duck outline instead of an image of a rubber duck wearing a pirate hat.
Despite the tin can ball toss booth being on fire courtesy of Stormy Weather, the booth somehow rapidly recovers itself when Cat Noir is about to slam his staff on the lever of the high striker.
Before the puck on the high striker is about to hit the bell on the top of the tower, the "winner" board above the teddy bear is missing. This error also appears when the teddy bear is about to fall from the high striker after Cat Noir wins.

title: Parvis des droits de l'homme
text:
Parvis des droits de l'homme - Intro
The , or Esplanade du Trocadéro, is a public space located in the Place du Trocadéro-et-du-11-Novembre, in the 16th arrondissement of Paris.

title: Parvis des droits de l'homme
text:
Parvis des droits de l'homme - Appearance
Named in 1985 on the initiative of François Mitterrand, this square separates the two wings of the Palais de Chaillot of which it is part. It is accessible from the Place du Trocadéro-et-du-11-Novembre and dominates the Jardins du Trocadéro.
It is made of beige marble slabs, other slabs of different colors forming square patterns. On the left and right sides of the square of Place du Trocadéro, there are eight golden statues, four on each side.
Continuing there are several stairs that lead to another lower part of the square. In this area there are some benches, but also access to the Jardins du Trocadéro and the stairs leading to the Trocadéro Fountain.
Below the square are the premises of the Théâtre national Chaillot, in a performance hall.
The square is famous for its view of the Eiffel Tower. Many tourists and locals come here to take photos.

title: Parvis des droits de l'homme
text:
Parvis des droits de l'homme - Trivia
The square was named in honor of the adoption of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights by the United Nations during its 3rd General Assembly on 10 December 1948.
This event is commemorated by a plaque.

Paris has three civilian airports in the real world: Charles de Gaulle, Orly and Le Bourget.
Since the first is the largest and busiest, it's probably the inspiration for this one.
The third is a limited-use civil airport, and therefore would be used by the the Agrestes' and Bourgeois' private jets, although only a single airport is used for all flights in the show.
The airline Avion seems to be a parody of Air France.
In "Revolution", Marinette goes to the airport to search for Adrien, who is about to leave for London, and it is there that the two kiss for the first time, before being forcibly separated.

title: Parvis Notre-Dame - Place Jean-Paul II
text:
Parvis Notre-Dame - Place Jean-Paul II - Intro
The  is a square in the 4th arrondissement of Paris and the square of the Notre-Dame de Paris.

title: Parvis Notre-Dame - Place Jean-Paul II
text:
Parvis Notre-Dame - Place Jean-Paul II - Description
Created in the 12th century, the Parvis Notre-Dame is a square 135 meters long and 100 meters wide with a surface area of ​​1,200 m2. Rectangular in shape, this square has a long esplanade of cut stone decorated with a bed of roses and offering an exceptional view of the western facade of the Notre-Dame de Paris.
It is bordered to the south by the Seine and the beginning of Square Jean XXIII, by the rue de la Cité to the west, by the Hotel Dieu to the north and by the Notre-Dame Cathedral. A lane of traffic runs along the square from Rue de la Cité and past the Hôtel Dieu, although it is framed by several rows of trees.
As seen in "Ikari Gozen", there is also a juice bar.

title: Parvis Notre-Dame - Place Jean-Paul II
text:
Parvis Notre-Dame - Place Jean-Paul II - Trivia
The Parvis Notre-Dame is a zero Kilometre point on the roads of France.
The Parvis Notre-Dame was renamed Parvis Notre-Dame - Place Jean-Paul II in 2006, in homage to Pope John Paul II.
The archaeological crypt of the Île de la Cité is accessible from the square.
In the series, the Parvis Notre-Dame has been important several times:
In "Sandboy", it is in the Parvis Notre-Dame where part of the fight between Ladybug and Cat Noir against the eponymous villain took place
In "Weredad", Gigantitan caused extensive damage in the Parvis Notre-Dame.
In "Ikari Gozen", Marinette and Kagami enjoyed a juice at a café in Parvis Notre-Dame and later took a photo to commemorate the event.
This photo later appeared on Adrien's computer in "Heart Hunter" and on Marinette's bulletin board hanging in her room starting "Truth".
In "Crocoduel", it is in the Parvis Notre-Dame where the preparation for the final attack of Ladybug, Cat Noir and Purple Tigress against Guitar Villain and Captain Hardrock took place.
In "Multiplication", although it did not physically appear, the Parvis Notre-Dame was traversed by numerous copies of Ikari Gozen who were attempting to reach Ladybug to take her Miraculous.

title: Pariser Platz
text:
Pariser Platz - Intro
is a square located in the very center of Berlin, in the Mitte district.

title: Pariser Platz
text:
Pariser Platz - Description
Developed in 1734. and named Place de Paris in 1814, this square is a large public space of 15,000 square meters and is a major center of Berlin.
A very popular tourist destination, Pariser Platz is known worldwide as the symbol of Berlin. It also houses many important buildings, such as the French and American embassies, the Academy of Arts, and the Hotel Aldon, all of which were rebuilt following German reunification in 1990.

title: Pariser Platz
text:
Pariser Platz - Trivia
Parizer Platz was named in 1814 in homage to the occupation of Paris following the overthrow of Napoleon I by the Sixth Coalition.
Apart from the Brandenburg Gate, all the buildings on the square were rebuilt during the German reunification of 1990.
During the final years of World War II, the buildings around the square were destroyed by air raids and artillery fire.

title: Penny Rolling
text:
Penny Rolling - Intro
is a recurring character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She is Jagged Stone's former agent.
In "Troublemaker", due to the pressure put on her by Jagged Stone, Alec Cataldi, Bob Roth and Marinette Dupain-Cheng from filming a TV show, Penny was akumatized by Hawk Moth into Troublemaker, an intangible punk rock-themed supervillain.
In "Migration", it's revealed that Penny and Jagged are dating. After Jagged gives up his fame as a rock star to be with his children and decides to take care of Luka when the latter decides to leave Paris to protect Ladybug and Cat Noir's secret identities from Monarch, Penny decides to accompany them.
In "Re-creation", after having joined up with Su-Han and the Order of the Guardians, Penny returns to Paris to help out in the fight against the Miraculized, along with Jagged, Luka, and Fang.

title: Penny Rolling
text:
Penny Rolling - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Penny is a slender dark-skinned woman with pixie-cut purple hair, strong fuchsia lipstick and light brown eyes.
Civilian Attire
She wears a black jacket with a silver buckle and zipper over a white t-shirt with a V-neck, black pants, and black shoes. She also wears a silver necklace with a green skull pendant, one sphere-shaped earring on her right ear, and wristbands: a red band on her left wrist, and black and pink bands on her right wrist.
As Troublemaker

title: Penny Rolling
text:
Penny Rolling - Appearance
Troublemaker had light sapphire bluish gray skin, brilliant cerise eyes, vivid orchid colored-eyelashes and matching eyebrows, and her hair was spiked upward like a mohawk with light gray tips. The areas around her eyes were black, and her lips were painted with moderate cerise lipstick. A dark purple choker with silver spikes was around her neck, and she wore a dark purple vest with ripped sleeves and edges. Underneath, she had a black sleeveless skin-tight suit with rectangular wedged shoes and pink sections with jagged white outlines on the sides of her legs and hips. On her arms were black and pink cuffs with white edges. There was a logo of a silver skull over four diagonal pink spikes on the chest of her bodysuit.

title: Penny Rolling
text:
Penny Rolling - Personality
Penny is a very professional, helpful and hardworking person who is also kind, thoughtful and supportive. She helps to solve problems, usually disagreements between two sides, by looking over everything carefully and trying to find a middle point or compromise that satisfies everyone. She gives encouragement to Marinette Dupain-Cheng, finds amusement in a misunderstanding that André Bourgeois has relating to her, and she puts on a good face with dealing with business partners, acquaintances, and teenagers. While usually nice, Penny takes on a serious, curt, or confrontational demeanor depending on the situation, like when she sternly demands to Vincent Asa that he stops bothering and taking photos of Jagged Stone in "Pixelator".
Despite her immense patience, especially regarding Jagged and his many demands and whims, Penny sometimes can get exasperated whenever Jagged starts to neglect his work. However, despite that, she still loves him very much.

title: Penny Rolling
text:
Penny Rolling - Personality
As Troublemaker, Penny was mischievous, conniving and sneaky. She was also a bit of a showboat, making a great deal out of achieving one earring from Ladybug. She was also short-tempered, angry with losing Ladybug's earring quickly after achieving it, and with Ladybug's plan to stop her.

title: Penny Rolling
text:
Penny Rolling - Abilities
As a Civilian
Penny is skilled in business communication, cooperating professionally and strategically with the people she works for. She represents Jagged Stone by finding ways to fulfill his desires, but she also knows how to deal with the interactions between Jagged and his manager Bob Roth.
In "Re-creation", after spending sometime with the Order of the Guardians, she learned Mirakung Fu, by Grand Master Su-Han.
As Troublemaker
Troublemaker could switch between being intangible and tangible again by clicking her pen, and while intangible would pass through the floor after a short while. However, she couldn't touch or hold objects or people while intangible, nor make them intangible with her expect for her pen.

title: Penny Rolling
text:
Penny Rolling - Relationships
Romance
Jagged Stone
Penny has a strong dedication to Jagged Stone as his agent. While aware of his eccentricities and stubbornness, she patiently works with him and helps to get him what he needs. She also understands his desire to be authentic to himself and his interests, but she makes sure to think about the business side of issues when he isn't as willing to think about it.
In "Troublemaker", Penny shows that she has romantic feelings for Jagged as she wants to make him happy and considers him as an "awesome" person. When akumatized, she kicks him and is determined to cause trouble for him despite his pleas. However, after being deakumatized, Penny is surprised when Jagged expressed his relief of her being back to normal and hugs her, to which Penny warmly returns.
In "Migration", it's revealed that Penny and Jagged are dating. While pursuing Jagged so he could come record a new album for Bob, Penny ends up venting to Luka how much his father can drive her crazy with his childish behavior, but that, nevertheless, she still loves him. When Jagged decides to cancel his contract with Bob and go with Luka away from Paris, Penny supports him and goes along with them.
Friends/Allies

title: Penny Rolling
text:
Penny Rolling - Relationships
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/Ladybug
When Marinette gives Penny the pair of shades she made for Jagged to give to him for her, Penny takes them and closes the door before Marinette can thank her. However, Penny treats Marinette better with more friendliness in subsequent meetings, smiling politely when giving Marinette a ticket to Jagged Stone's concert. In "Guitar Villain", she encourages Marinette to do her best when she is designing a cover for Jagged's album and Marinette's final design pleases her.
In "Troublemaker", Penny apologizes to Marinette after accidentally getting the cameraman into her bedroom, thus showing on live television her pictures of Adrien and quickly tries to get everyone from her room.
Regarding Ladybug, while akumatized Troublemaker is determined to steal her Miraculous and takes sadistic pleasure when suceeding in stealing one of her earrings, however Ladybug manages to trick her into grabbing her earrings covered with glue, allowing Cat Noir to deakumatize her.

title: Penny Rolling
text:
Penny Rolling - Relationships
When deakumatized, Penny listened to Ladybug praising on her always being helpful towards others, but advised Penny to take care of herself as well and after asking Penny how she felt, Penny told her she felt well and thanked Ladybug.
Luka Couffaine
After Jagged started to pass time with his children, so did Penny. When going in pursue of Jagged so he could record a new album for Bob, Penny ends up venting all her frustrations regarding Jagged's many flaws, all while confessing that she still loves him nevertheless, with Luka being able to reassure her. When Jagged decides to cancel his contract with Bob and go with Luka away from Paris, Penny supports him and goes along with them and help Luka with his studies.
Status unknown
Vincent Asa

title: Penny Rolling
text:
Penny Rolling - Relationships
Penny finds Vincent and his obsession with Jagged Stone greatly annoying and troublesome. In "Pixelator", when Vincent is caught trying to take photos of Jagged at Le Grand Paris, without any hint of remorse, she angrily makes him get out of the hotel's lobby and threatens to break his camera if she ever finds him around Jagged again. While not recognizing the titular villain being Vincent, Penny appears annoyed when he knocks on the door to Jagged Stone's suite, suspiciously asking who he is before he pixelates her.
Enemies
Bob Roth
Penny is more respectful to Bob than Jagged is, but she does her best to remind him of the artistic side of issues, including Jagged's style and decisions. She starts the discussion on asking Marinette to design Jagged Stone's album cover in "Guitar Villain", pointing out the design will be modern and it will be created by someone in Jagged's target audience in order to get Bob to comply. It's because of her intervention and professionalism that she keeps Bob and Jagged working together at Bob Roth Records, despite the two men not getting along well with each other.

title: Penny Rolling
text:
Penny Rolling - Etymology
Penny's last name (Rolling) and Jagged's last name (Stone) are a reference to the rock band The Rolling Stones.
Her first name Penny is a reference to The Beatles song, "Penny Lane".
In the French version, Penny's villain name is L'Insaisissable, which literally translates to the Elusive.

title: Penny Rolling
text:
Penny Rolling - Trivia
In "Pixelator", André Bourgeois confuses her name with Jagged Stone's pet crocodile, which causes Penny to be genuinely amused by his mix-up.
Troublemaker was the first villain who was able to take off one of Ladybug's earrings.
Troublemaker was originally supposed to reappeared in the two part special event "Heroes' Day", according to early concept art.
In "Gamer 2.0", Troublemaker returns as a playable akumatized villain as part of the Gamer 2.0's powers.
Following Marinette, she is the second known member of the Guardians to be a woman.
In "Miraculous: Rise of the Sphinx", after André Bourgeois unjustly cancels one of Jagged's concerts due to the noise that was being made, she gets akumatized by Hawk Moth into Soundwave, a punk-rock themed villain who's able to use soundwaves as weapons and create massive instruments.

title: Pig Miraculous
text:
Pig Miraculous - Intro
The  is a pearl anklet that, whenever Daizzi inhabits it, transforms the wearer into a pig-themed superhero with the power of Jubilation.
To activate the pearl anklet, the user must speak the transformation phrase: "Rejoice". To deactivate the pearl anklet, the user must speak the detransformation phrase, which is currently unknown.
The pearl anklet is currently owned by Rose Lavillant, who uses it to transform into Pigella. It was previously stored in the Chinese Miracle Box and only lent out to her when the situation required it. But, as of "Re-creation", she now posseses the Miraculous permanently.

title: Pig Miraculous
text:
Pig Miraculous - Appearance
In general, the Pig Miraculous is a pearl anklet consisting of a chain with small beads. In charged mode, when Daizzi inhabits it, has a light magenta chain with light pink beads and five light pink bell shaped pearls hanging from it on one side. Each of the five pearls has a small wire twirled around it that resembles a pig's curly tail. The pearls also have a small sphere of light inside of them. If a minor is using the miraculous, the pearl anklet starts running out of power, they make a beeping sound, and the lights inside the pearls start to go dark one at a time as an indication of how much time (one sphere of light is equivalent to one minute) Rose (or another Pig Miraculous holder) has left.
In Season 6 onwards, the chain is now completely smooth and pink, it wraps around a light pink pearl with five pale pink stars.
In its activated mode, the pearls are dark purple.
In its camouflage mode, the pearl anklet changes color and form depending on whose possession it's in:

title: Pig Miraculous
text:
Pig Miraculous - Appearance
In the possession of Rose Lavillant, the form and the pink and white color scheme of the pearl anklet remained the same, the only difference is that the five pearls disappeared, making it resemble its activated form.
When it was worn by Gabriel Agreste, the pearl anklet turned into a silver band and loses the pearls.
When it was worn by Chloé Bourgeois, the pearl anklet turned silver with small gold pearls.
When it was worn by Marinette Dupain-Cheng, the pearl anklet turned silver with small red pearls.
In it's reforged ring form, it was a thick band with a circular surface, similar to the Cat Miraculous, inside of it was the symbol of the Pig Miraculous which glowed pink. It used to sit on the little finger of Gabriel's right hand.

title: Pig Miraculous
text:
Pig Miraculous - Abilities
The Pig Miraculous has the ability to transform its wielder into a pig-themed superhero, granting its wielder incredible superhuman powers of speed, endurance, agility, stamina and strength. It also makes the user nearly invulnerable.

title: Pig Miraculous
text:
Pig Miraculous - Abilities
Its special weapon is an unbreakable Tambourine which can be also be utilized as both a weapon, a communicator, and an object that can be used to breathe underwater. Its special superpower, is named Gift, which gives the user the ability to conjure a gift box that the user can open to reveal the target's deepest wish in order to obtain their goal, like defeating a villain. When the gift box is summoned, it has the appearance of a small, light pink box with a pink ribbon-shaped like a pig's ears on top of it. Once the user removes the ribbon, the box will open, revealing an orb of light which can show the user's target their deepest wish. As long as the superpower isn't used by a minor, the wielder can remain transformed indefinitely. However, as soon as the superpower is used, the wielder loses power and the transformation wears off in about approximately five minutes. The pearl anklet also has the ability to give the wielder the costume they truly desire.

title: Pig Miraculous
text:
Pig Miraculous - History
Five thousand years ago, a mage successfully helped the kwamis to interact with humans by creating magic jewels, which were called Miraculouses. In order to repay the mage, and to live on the physical world alongside humans, the kwamis decided to help humanity by letting humans utilize their energy and powers through the Miraculous they were bonded with, which included Daizzi and the Pig Miraculous.
At some point in time, all of the knowledge about the Miraculouses and their powers was written down in code in a book called the Grimoire, with very few people knowing how to decipher the code. Miracle Boxes were also created at an unknown time to store the dormant Miraculouses. To protect and distribute Miraculouses, the Order of the Guardians was formed and existed for many years. Throughout its existence, guardians trained younger generations to keep a watchful eye over the Miraculouses and the Grimoire, which were placed in the guardians' temple.
Many Pig holders throughout history used Daizzi's power for good, like Zhū in China, who started the legacy.

title: Pig Miraculous
text:
Pig Miraculous - History
172 years ago, after an disastrous event where a young Wang Fu used the Peacock Miraculous to create a sentimonster and his negative emotions and imaturity led to the creature rampaging through the temple and eating and destroying everything in its path, Fu was entrusted with the Chinese Miracle Box (Which included the Pig Miraculous) by a monk and was told to run away from the mess. However, on the mountain range outside the temple, in order to escape from the the monster, Fu jumped over a fissure on the ground - accidently opening the Box and spilling all of its contents on the snow. Due to his distress, Fu didnt notice he accidently left both the Peacock and the Butterfly on the mountain, alongisde the Grimoire, until it was too late and he was too far away to come back. Somewhere along the line, the Peacock got dangerously damaged, to the point of being improper for use - but, as it turns out, no one knew of this fact until it was too late.

title: Pig Miraculous
text:
Pig Miraculous - History
On a previous trip overseas with the Agrestes, Nathalie found the Butterfly and Peacock Miraculouses and gave the jewels to Gabriel. In "Representation", it was revealed that neither the Agrestes nor the Graham de Vanily couples could bear children on their own, so Émilie and Colt used the Peacock Miraculous to create Adrien and Félix respectively, but in doing so, they grew sick over time and were eventually left in a condition where they fell into an eternal slumber due to using the Peacock Miraculous in its damaged state.

title: Pig Miraculous
text:
Pig Miraculous - History
Desperate to fix his mistake, Gabriel Agreste began using the Butterfly Miraculous for evil to obtain the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses in order to gain access to their absolute power, becoming the supervillain Hawk Moth, later Shadow Moth (when unified with a now fixed Peacock Miraculous), and finally Monarch. This decision proved one of the most significant for the history of the series, as Gabriel began utilizing Nooroo's power to akumatize the civilians of Paris, France, trying to get one of them to draw out the current holders of the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses, unintenionally helping start off Marinette's and Adrien's journeys as Ladybug and Cat Noir, and later, the rest of the Miraculers.
One of the members of the Miraculers is Rose Lavillant, who was chosen by Ladybug in "Guiltrip" to wield the Pig Miraculous, becoming the heroine Pigella. Rose, from that point on, became a member of the team, helping Ladybug and Cat Noir during "particularly difficult missions". From "Guiltrip" to "Strikeback", Rose was a temporary holder, meaning she would only receive the Miraculous from Ladybug when she was needed for the mission, and had to give it back after the crisis was solved.

title: Pig Miraculous
text:
Pig Miraculous - History
Félix, after finding out about his true origins as a sentihuman and learning that the Peacock Miraculous could erase his and his cousin's lifes if it feel into the wrong hands, orchestrated a plan to capture all of the Miraculouses of the Chinese Box from Ladybug and traded all of them (besides the Ladybug and the Cat) for the Peacock, which included the Pig Miraculous, succeeding in "Strikeback".
In "Destruction", Gabriel used a laser machine to melt down the Miraculous into a pile of dust, and then reforged it into a special Alliance ring for transferring Daizzi's power of Jubilation to any akumatized villain who wore a regular Alliance ring. In "Re-creation", Marinette Dupain-Cheng manages to recover all of the Miraculous that were previously stolen. In "Miraculous London", Lila stole all of the Miraculous under Marinette's care in an alternate timeline, which included the Pig Miraculous, in order to render her truly powerless and to fuse the Ladybug and the Cat to gain her wish without her interference, but her plan was ultimately thwarted by the combined efforts of Chronobug and Bunnyx, and the event was erased from the timeline.

title: Pig Miraculous
text:
Pig Miraculous - History
After the events of "Miraculous London", Marinette, having realized both instances of all of the Miraculouses being stolen happened because all of them were kept in the same place, and with the idea that centralized power is inherently flawed, and that distributing it among members of a society is a far superior idea, restored and upgraded the Pig Miraculous by redesigning its original design and adding the Miraculous Call: a call feature that grants the holder the ability to summon other superheroes who possess a Miraculous from the Chinese Miracle Box in order to receive aid on their missions. This new feature is particularly useful, as the new holder of the Butterfly Miraculous, Chrysalis, is even more fearsome than her predecessor. After the alterations, the Pig Miraculous was given back to Rose permanently - putting Pigella back on the map.

title: Pig Miraculous
text:
Pig Miraculous - Trivia
Pigs symbolize sincerity, generosity, and prosperity.
The Pig Miraculous being a pearl anklet is likely a reference to the phrase "pearls before swine".
The Pig Miraculous being worn on the ankle, its ability to grant gifts that represent one's greatest desire, and Pigella's name all allude to the classic fairy tale Cinderella (known in French as Cendrillon).

title: Philippe
text:
Philippe - Intro
is a recurring character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He is a figure skating trainer who first appears in season 2. In the French version, he is voiced by and based on the real-life figure skater Philippe Candeloro.
In "Frozer", after failing to get anyone to register for his ice skating lessons and facing the loss of his ice rink, he was akumatized by Hawk Moth into Frozer, an ice-skating supervillain.

title: Philippe
text:
Philippe - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Philippe is of average adult height, with long brown hair and brown eyes.
Civilian Attire
Philippe wears a white workout jacket with a silver zipper and blue accents along the inside of the collar and forearms, paired with white sweatpants. He also wears black ice skates and a black necklace with a silver, circle-shaped pendant. Additionally, he has a dangling earring in his right ear.
As Frozer
As Frozer, his skin was a deep azure that gradually faded into lighter blue and then white on his head, hands, and feet. His hair was slicked back, and his feet became oversized ice skates colored light blue and white. He also bore a light cerulean-gray snowflake symbol on his chest. His sclera and nose were light purple, while his irises were a brilliant opal color.

title: Philippe
text:
Philippe - Personality
Philippe is a passionate ice skater who views his ice rink as his livelihood and is highly enthusiastic about promoting his lessons.
He can be persuasive when he wants something, such as when he attempts to convince Santa Claus to make Christmas come early. Philippe is also helpful at times, notably when he holds off Christmaster's army so that Ladybug, Cat Noir, and Santa can escape.
As Frozer, he was determined to turn Paris into a city of ice and seize Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous for Hawk Moth. He was extremely confident and proud of his skating abilities, which ultimately led to his defeat.

title: Philippe
text:
Philippe - Abilities
As a Civilian
Philippe is highly skilled at ice skating.
As Frozer
As Frozer, he could freeze entire cities using his ice skates. He also possessed the ability to launch icicles from his ice skates while airborne.

title: Philippe
text:
Philippe - Relationships
Friends/Allies
Adrien Agreste/Cat Noir
Philippe tried to suggest Adrien take skating lessons. Unable to bear much, he still ended up advertising these lessons to his fans, thus attracting many potential students to Philippe and thus saving the ice rink from closing.
Philippe greatly appreciates Cat Noir and helps the hero on several occasions.
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/Ladybug/Ladyice
Philippe tried to suggest Marinette take figure skating lessons, but she refused due to the many responsibilities that her role as a superheroine entails.
Philippe appreciates Ladybug very much and helps the superheroine on several occasions. She also agrees to take part in her backup plan in case Monarch gets the Miraculouses and the latter tries to find her.
Acquaintances
André Bourgeois
Phillipe disagrees with the mayor of Paris about the usefulness and future of the skating rink where he gives skating lessons. Despite everything, she seems to have respect for him.
Kagami Tsurugi
In "Frozer", Philippe tries to convince Kagami to join his skating class, but she refuses, saying that ice skating is just for fun.
Luka Couffaine

title: Philippe
text:
Philippe - Relationships
In "Frozer", Philippe tries to convince Luka to join his skating class, but he refuses, saying that music already fills his life.

title: Philippe
text:
Philippe - Trivia
His villain form is similar to the Mega Man 11 Robot Master Tundra Man:
Both are skilled figure skaters who combine ice skating techniques with ice-based powers to attack their opponents.
However, Frozer is human, while Tundra Man is a robot.
He was first revealed on August 31, 2017, in a teaser released by TFOU.
His villain form was later revealed on October 16, 2017, through an animated storyboard released by Thomas Astruc.
A scarlet version of Frozer reappeared in the two-part special event "Heroes' Day".
His daughters share their names with the real-life daughters of Philippe Candeloro.

title: Penalteam
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Penalteam - Intro
"" is a Season 4 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 24th written and produced episode of Season 4. It is also the 102nd written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Penalteam
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Penalteam - Synopsis
Miss Bustier has organized a soccer game to introduce her students to the values of sport and the pleasure to play together. Marinette, who loves soccer, does her best to save the game, even though Chloe is determined to do everything to ruin the happy moment. Indeed, Chloe hates soccer. But when faced with an unfazed Marinette who includes her in the game against her will, Chloe’s anger reaches an all-time high. And she only hopes for one thing now… being akumatized so she can get revenge.
Disney+
Ladybug and her superheroes face Penalteam.
Netflix
During a school soccer game, Chloé gets cloned into a team of supervillains. To defeat them, Marinette assembles a lineup of her own.

title: Penalteam
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Penalteam - Plot
The episode begins at Parc des Princes, with Kim and Marinette as the team captains, choosing their teammates from Miss Bustier's class for a game of soccer. Kim chooses Max to help him discover the best player to help win the match. Max's robot, Markov, points out Alya, but she was unfortunately already chosen by Marinette. Markov continues to help Kim, but Marinette says it’s cheating. Chloé tries to leave the game, saying that it is obvious who the winner will be but is stopped by Ms. Bustier, who says that nobody will be leaving and nobody will be cheating. Mr. Didier, points out that whoever loses and wins is not important but instead, enjoying the game and playing together. Mr. Didier asks the class if there are any ways of making the teams more fair.
Alix suggests boys versus girls, an idea Kim immediately shoots down as he believes the boys' team will lose once more. Alya shoots down Rose's idea of selection based on alphabetical order of names of everyone's teddy bears as she and Chloé are the only people in the class with teddy bears; something Chloe tried to deny she still owns. Marinette's suggestion of drawing for it is cheered and agreed on by the class.

title: Penalteam
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Penalteam - Plot
Meanwhile, Marc is dragging Nathaniel to where the class is as the artist asks Marc what is the point of playing soccer when he isn't interested in the sport and fears hurting his hand. While Marc tries to tell him the wonders of soccer, Nathaniel isn't convinced and asks Marc to come up for an excuse as to why he won't be there. Marc tells Ms. Bustier and Mr. Didier an excuse as when Mr. Didier asks if he wishes to play. After impressing the class with some kicks with a soccer ball, Marinette hands Marc a bib and the game starts.
Chloé is the goalkeeper of the yellow team but she is more interested in taking selfies and forbids Sabrina to play soccer just when she is about to kick the ball in her goal. Marinette comes over to her and advises her not to listen to Chloé's orders and that she can play if she likes doing it. Chloé rushes over and tells Marinette that Sabrina only enjoys doing Chloé's bidding.

title: Penalteam
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Penalteam - Plot
Mylène uses this opportunity to kick the ball out of Sabrina's reach while she is distracted. Mylène passes the ball to Ivan, who is afraid that he will hurt someone if he kicks it too hard. Rose comes out of nowhere and takes the ball from him and kicks it towards Marc, who kicks it past Kim and Nino. Marinette is about to kick the ball and is shocked when she notices Adrien in front of her and blushes. Nervous, she smiles awkwardly and kicks the ball to him. Nino asks Adrien to pass the ball to him as Adrien throws him the ball as Mr. Didier blows his whistle. He comes over and tells Adrien that only the goalie may touch the ball with their hands. Adrien apologizes and admit he is not very familiar with the rules of soccer.

title: Penalteam
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Penalteam - Plot
The game resumes as Alya passes the ball to Marinette who kicks it in Chloé's goal while she is on her phone. Chloé refuses to touch the soccer ball, saying that she could catch something from it. Sabrina offers to take Chloé's position, but Alya points out she is not on her team and Nino also says that it is a losing battle. Ms. Bustier stops Chloé from going back home as it is during school hours. Chloé points to Lila who is on the benches and pretending to be injured and asks why she isn't allowed to join her. Chloé tries poorly to be injured as Marinette makes a suggestion as to how to keep the soccer games fair and engaging to the players. Chloé rejects Sabrina's idea of her father, the mayor of Paris, to close the class, saying that she is waiting for a warrior who has much more power than him.

title: Penalteam
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Penalteam - Plot
Shadow Moth, in his lair, finds Chloé's emotions and feelings as well as he knew that Ladybug's magical charm has put her on the sidelines and sends a megakuma to her for a rematch after creating one. The megakuma kicks off to break Chloé's magical charm and enters her sunglasses. Chloé is akumatized into Penalty after Shadow Moth convinces her to accept the powers he is offering her as Sabrina runs away in fear. A huge dome is covering Paris as Penalty's clones are created. A timer appears as Ms. Bustier tries to reason with Chloé, but is hit by a red card from Chloé and is in a bubble high above the ground. Alya is sent to another bubble as well.
The game between Penalteam, Penalty and her team of clones, versus the students starts as one of the Penalteam kick the ball into the goal and Ms. Bustier's and Alya's bubble shrink in size. Alix and Mr. Didier are imprisoned in bubbles as well when they call Penalty out for fouls and the students run off and hide. Marinette hides behind a chair in the stadium to transform into Ladybug. The bubbles shrink as Penalteam shoots goals. Mr. Didier, with a microphone in front of him, is the commentator of the game.

title: Penalteam
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Penalteam - Plot
Marinette transforms into Ladybug as Adrien transforms into Cat Noir in a bathroom stall. Ladybug and Cat Noir appear on the field. Penalteam puts her sunglasses in a separate bubble so that it cannot be destroyed. Cat Noir tells Ladybug that he has no clue how to play soccer but is asked to be the goalie while she finds help. Ladybug runs off and gives the French Miraculous superhero team their respective Miraculouses. She also gives the Dog Miraculous to Sabrina, the Rooster Miraculous to Marc, the Goat to Nathaniel, and the Ox Miraculous to Ivan.

title: Penalteam
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Penalteam - Plot
Meanwhile, the field and the goal are destroyed as Cat Noir is repeatedly being hit by Penalteam's soccer ball and is hurt. Ladybug returns with her team and recruits four new superheroes with her, Miss Hound, Rooster Bold, Caprikid, and Minotaurox. The game starts once more as Viperion is sent to one of the bubbles as the Penalteam clones passes to each other and he is touched by the cleats. The bubbles shrink as the field increases in size as the goals are further apart from each other. Purple Tigress uses her power, Clout, and creates a crater in the ground as two Penalteam clones are lying in it. Penalteam takes the ball from Ladybug as they trap Ryuko in a bubble of her own as well. The ball flies in the air as Cat Noir accidentally sends the ball into Penalteam's goal. Carapace kicks the ball as Penalteam repeatedly wins as more of her team members are in bubbles and it is halftime.

title: Penalteam
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Penalteam - Plot
Exhausted and about to transform back, the heroes that have used their powers are ordered to transform back and recharge their kwamis and to gather back when done. Ladybug apologizes and admits all of the heroes are needed. The game starts as the superheroes score points through teamwork and Rooster Bold's natural talent and it is soon a tie. Minotaurox activates his power as Penalteam's power has no effect on him and the Miraculous team wins. However, Penalty is not going to admit defeat so easily and makes things harder for them. The goals are moved further from each other as Penalteam cheats the time to last indefinitely. Cat Noir is hit by red cards when he claims this is unfair and is in his own bubble in the sky with the risk of detransforming in a few minutes due to having used his powers.
Ladybug uses her Lucky Charm and receives an easel.
She devises a plan to make Penalteam reject her megakuma.
Caprikid employs his power, Genesis, to create a wand.
He pretends to have given the team the ability to use their powers indefinitely without the risk of transforming back.
Penalteam remarks that this is cheating while Miss Hound uses her ball, touching the soccer ball with it.

title: Penalteam
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Penalteam - Plot
The ball is teleported to Miss Hound's feet, and she kicks it to Rooster Bold, who uses Sublimation to ensure he scores a goal every time he kicks the ball.
Just before a Penalteam clone can kick the ball, Vesperia immobilizes her using Venom and kicks it away to Rooster Bold, who shoots another goal.
Pegasus then teleports the ball to the goal using Voyage.
King Monkey disrupts Penalteam's powers with Uproar by throwing a yellow rubber duck at a Penalty member.
As a result, the rest of the Penalties' cleats turn into rubber ducks, the goals transform into bathtubs, and the yellow balls capturing the players turn into bubbles as the clones argue among themselves.
Frustrated, Penalty grabs the akumatized sunglasses and smashes them on the ground.
The megakuma flies out, and Ladybug captures it, reverting it back to a normal butterfly.
She throws the easel into the air, which repairs all the damage caused during the akumatization, and everyone transforms back to normal.

title: Penalteam
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Penalteam - Plot
Marinette tells Mr. Didier that Chloé should not have to play if that is what she wants. Now down a player, Nathaniel volunteers to play. Marc hands Nathaniel a bib and Sabrina pleads for Chloé to let her play as Chloé sits on the bench with Lila. Lila believes that they have a lot in common as they both hate the same person as Chloé smiles evilly in agreement as the episode ends.

title: Penalteam
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Penalteam - Plot developments
It's revealed that Marc is proficient at soccer and that Sabrina likes soccer.
As of this episode, every Miraculous of the Chinese Miracle Box has a designated holder.
This episode is the first time where an akumatized villain de-akumatizes themself by breaking their own akumatized object.
This is also the first time Chloé rejects Shadow Moth after siding with him in "Miracle Queen".
This is also the third time an akumatized villain is willing to get de-akumatized after "Christmaster" and "Guiltrip". However, unlike Christmaster who willingly gave his object to Ladybug and Cat Noir, and Reflekta who didn't resist having her object destroyed, Penalteam destroys her object herself.

title: Penalteam
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Penalteam - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in Brazil on Gloob.
This is the eighth time Chloé gets akumatized, following "Antibug", "Queen Wasp", "Mayura", "Miracle Queen", "Queen Banana" and two off-screen akumatizations into Antibug that were revealed in "Mr. Pigeon 72".
Due to these constant akumatizations, Shadow Moth now calls Chloé his "favorite victim".
However, unlike her previous akumatizations, Chloé is akumatized into a new villain, Penalty.
This is the third time Chloé is willingly akumatized, following "Miracle Queen" and "Queen Banana".
This is the second episode where a Megakuma is created to destroy a Magical Charm following "Dearest Family".
The word "Penalty" in the title has two meanings: a punishment for breaking the law and, in sports, a penalty kick awarded when a team commits a foul. The episode specifically uses the sports meaning, as it is centered on a class soccer match.
Four new heroes chronologically make their debuts in a single episode, the most of any episode so far.
The previous record holder was "Stormy Weather", which introduced three Miraculous holders.
This excludes "Party Crasher" which was released out of order, revealing three new heroes.

title: Penalteam
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Penalteam - Trivia
Sabrina, Marc, Nathaniel, Ivan are the third, fourth, fifth and sixth new Miraculous holders accompanied by several Miraculous holders besides Ladybug and Cat Noir, following Kim in "Party Crasher" and Mylène in "Mega Leech".
Sabrina, Marc and Nathaniel are the fifth, sixth and seventh Miraculous holders who at first attempted to reject their Miraculouses but ended accepting them.
The others were Marinette in "Origins", Zoé in "Queen Banana", Mylène in "Mega Leech" and Juleka in "Crocoduel". But unlike Sabrina, Marc, and Nathaniel, they were not frightened by their respective Kwamis.
This is the third time where multiple characters received their Miraculous for the first time following "Origins", and "Desperada"
This is the second time an akumatized villain uses their shoes as a weapon after "Sole Crusher".
Until "Re-creation", this episode held the greatest number of Miraculous holder allies recruited by Ladybug coming to a total of 13, only missing Rena Rouge/Rena Furtive and Bunnyx from the Miracle Box.

title: Penalteam
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Penalteam - Trivia
This episode comes in second place for having the greatest number of Miraculouses activated, coming at a total of 17, surpassing "Miracle Queen" at 11, "Kuro Neko" at 12, and "Ephemeral" at 13, and behind "Re-creation" at the maximum 19.
This marks the sixth time a character based on a real person, in this case a French sports journalist Didier Roustan, is introduced but is not akumatized, following Sarah (named Josiane in the French dub and based on the French actress Josiane Balasko), Jean-Pierre Monlataing (based on Thomas Astruc's former teacher), Véronique (based on the manager of Musée Grévin Véronique Berecz), Wu Shifu (based on the Chinese actor Donnie Yen) and Anne-Jeanne Théoxanne du Bocquale (based on Ranita Gobrait, a young Polynesian champion).
This also means that the concept and Miraculous superpowers of each of the kwamis from the Miracle Box is revealed.
This is the second time a new Miraculous is revealed without revealing its transformation phrase, following "Stormy Weather".

title: Penalteam
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Penalteam - Trivia
After purifying the Akuma, Ladybug doesn't give Chloé a new Magical Charm like in "Dearest Family". Most likely, it's because Chloé would just reject it again like in "Queen Banana", as she had to be given that Magical Charm under false pretenses.
This is the fourth episode to introduce a new akumatized villain, but the episode is not named after them, following "Antibug", "Mayura" and "Ephemeral".
Although, unlike the aforementioned episodes, who are named after another villain, this episode introduces only one new villain and is named after the team of clones.
Unlike Lady Wifi in "Gang of Secrets" and Rocketear and Qilin in their eponymous episodes, Penalteam doesn't immediately detransform upon breaking her connection to Shadow Moth, instead retrieving and breaking her akumatized glasses first. This is the first time this happens.
This is the second episode of Season 4 not to have a dotted pattern on its end card, the first being "Rocketear".
Despite Team Miraculous scoring several goals, only Rooster Bold, Minotaurox and Pegasus are seen scoring one.

title: Penalteam
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Penalteam - Trivia
This is the second time a temporary holder transforms back then re-transforms in the same battle, following Vesperia in "Queen Banana".
When Didier Roustan is introducing the heroes, he names the holders in the same order that Ladybug had given them their Miraculouses with the exception of Vesperia and Viperion, whose places are switched.
This is the first time someone willingly calls out to be akumatized. In this case, Chloé waits for Shadow Moth so he can akumatize her.
In the storyboard of the episode, Caprikid wasn't seen posing next to Miss Hound and Polymouse after the Miraculous team regrouped and changed their strategy.
Not counting unifying, Miss Hound and Caprikid are the third and fourth Miraculous heroes that appear in a single episode of a season, following Aspik in "Desperada" and Multimouse in "Kwamibuster".
This is the last season 4 episode to feature Pegasus.
This is the first and last season 4 episode to feature Miss Hound and Caprikid, until Ladybug and Cat Noir get their Miraculous back.
Errors
When Ladybug throws the easel, her drawings vanish.
Her legs also glitch for a moment.

title: Penalteam

Adrien doesn't know how to play soccer, even though he shouted "GOOOAL" in "Furious Fu".
When Rooster Bold scores the first goal, Penalteam's eyes are purple instead of red.
In some scenes, Ladybug's right eye is smaller than her left one.
In one scene, Miss Hound's Ball is missing.
Polymouse doesn't reappear with the other holders after feeding Mullo, and only reappears when Didier comments about their team line-up.
When the heroes fist-bump and say "Pound it" after their victory, King Monkey is missing.
When Chloé says she doesn't want to play and walks past Nino, Nino's other pupil is not located in the same spot as his other eye.
When Miss Hound introduces herself, she has two balls: one on her collar and one in her hand.
When Caprikid explains that he doesn't have the power to make the wand magic, his Miraculous is in activated mode.
The episode is incorrectly referred to as "Penal Team" on Disney+.
In some scenes, Marinette is missing her soccer shirt.
At the end of the episode, Mylène's jacket is much darker than usual.
When Rooster Bold introduces himself, his Miraculous is in camouflage mode.

text:

title: Penalteam/Transcript
text:

Ladybug: You're an excellent player, Rooster Bold. That's why I chose you. That's why I chose all of you! Let's play together, and bring all of our individual strengths together onto the field!
(They come together and do a group fist bump)

Didier Roustan: Ladybug's team is back onto the field with a 4-3-3 formation and a toughly new spirit!

title: Penalteam/Transcript
text:

(Carapace is in goal with the ball, Vesperia and Purple Tigress set up in defense near him, Pegasus and King Monkey stand up on top of the Louvre, Miss Hound, Caprikid and Polymouse stand up on the Louvre Palace, Ladybug is positioned ontop of the Obélisque de Louxor, Rooster Bold, Cat Noir and Minotaurox stand on top of the clear area of the Louvre Palace. text:

title: Penalteam/Transcript
text:

title: Penalteam/Transcript
text:

(The heroes line up in front of Ladybug)
Ladybug: Lucky Charm!

The only way to end this is if Chloé rejects the Akuma herself. We'll have 5 minutes to make the Penalteam despise playing soccer so much, that she'll quit the game.

text:

text:

text:

title: Perfection
text:
Perfection - Intro
"" is a season 5 episode of the series Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. Based on the series's production order specifically, "" is the 12th written and produced episode of season 5. It is also the 115th written and produced episode of the series overall.

title: Perfection
text:
Perfection - Synopsis
What would Marinette do without her friends? The whole gang has decided to do everything to help her finally get closer to Adrien. This time, anything goes. But Marinette knows how to be surprising, again and again! Especially when no one's told her anything, and no one knows that she also has come up with a unique plan to try and tell Adrien how she feels. They're all in to find out that it's better to tell things clearly to your friends if you don't want to cause a misunderstanding… that could lead to someone being akumatized!
Disney+
Ladybug and Cat Noir face an elusive villain.
Netflix
Her friends' plan to force Marinette to confess her feelings to Adrien gets out of hand and leaves Kagami hurt and vulnerable to Monarch's influence.

title: Perfection
text:
Perfection - Plot
Ladybug and Cat Noir try to pull a large boat out of the Seine using their yo-yo and staff.
In the midst of this, Ladybug asks Cat Noir if he is in love.
Cat Noir says he is.
Ladybug then asks if his crush loves Cat Noir.
He says he believes she does.
Ladybug expresses her happiness for his situation.
The two superheroes pull the large boat out of the Seine.
Ladybug and Cat Noir skydive from the Eiffel Tower.
Cat Noir asks Ladybug the same question.
Ladybug replies with a similar answer.
She grabs bird call from the giant human construct climbing the Eiffel Tower and throws the bird call to Cat Noir who catches and Cataclysms it, releasing the megakuma.
Ladybug captures the megakuma and heroes land safely, catching Mr.
Pigeon as he is deakumatized, Ladybug releases the purified megakuma, and Cat Noir catches Mr.
Ramier.
Ladybug throws her Lucky Charm using her Miraculous Ladybug.
At the Jardins du Trocadéro, Cat Noir expresses his happiness at both his and Ladybug's situations.
They pound it and Cat Noir leaves.
In her partner's absence, Ladybug's face droops.

title: Perfection
text:
Perfection - Plot
Marinette, now at her house, tells Alya about her ease of conversation with Cat Noir and difficulty of conversation with Adrien.
Marinette gets a call from Kagami, she declines due to her perceived lack of progress with Adrien.
Marinette is called by Kagami again, she hangs up again reasoning she'll call her back when she talks to Adrien which she believes she is incapable of pulling that feat off and she will either never call Kagami back or only when she's elderly and erased from Kagami's mind.
Marinette questions if she is a bad friend to Kagami.
Alya, who finally is able to get a word in edgewise, assures her best friend she is capable of confessing her feelings to her love with help from her friends.
At François Dupont's art room, Nathaniel and Marc have Marinette and Adrien set up under the guise of helping them with their story.
Adrien asks Marinette to hold his hand, she attempts to do so but her nerves get the better of her and she destroys part of the set.
Nathaniel and Marc move onto their next plan.
At Philippe's ice rink, Philippe tries to help but he sends Adrien and Marinette crashing into the walls of his rink.
Nathaniel and Marc move onto another plan.

title: Perfection
text:
Perfection - Plot
At François Dupont, Miss Bustier's class participates in an empathetic listening activity.
The objective is to sit on a mat opposite a partner, take their hands, and express your feelings for them.
Marinette tries to sit opposite Adrien, but Chloé stops her and takes her place.
Alya defends her friend's spot, but Chloé refuses to budge.
That is until Lila drags her away to the mat opposite hers, discussing aloud that Marinette should be allowed to sit where she pleases while whispering to Chloé her intentions to make their common enemy's life miserable.
A pleased Chloé proclaims Lila her new best friend, much to the chagrin of Sabrina.
Marinette manages to send a mat toward Alya and bowl rolling away.
Nathaniel flips his sketchpad to the next page for the next plan, but the page is empty.

title: Perfection
text:
Perfection - Plot
In her room, Marinette practices confessing to Adrien by attempting to confess to her mannequin with a picture of Adrien pinned to its head. She can't finish her sentence properly, so she takes off the picture. She confesses flawlessly. She reattaches the picture of Adrien and tries again, but she can't do it. Marinette gets a call from Kagami; she declines as she worries Kagami will be disappointed in her lack of a confession. Marinette keeps trying to confess with Tikki cheering her on. After what's most likely been hours and the day nearing sunset, Marinette is red in the face, still struggling to express her feelings. Kagami calls again, prompting Tikki to suggest Marinette answer her friend as she may be able to help. Marinette then comes up with her “ingenious” solution: a picture of a cow. To finish her confession, she will use the picture of a cow to prompt herself to say “moo” to finish her confession. She picks up her phone to inform Kagami about her plan, but an alarm on her phone goes off for a Kitty Section concert she's attending. Marinette rushes out of her room to get there.

title: Perfection
text:
Perfection - Plot
At the Couffaine's houseboat Liberty, Adrien tells Luka about the love song he wrote for Marinette. Luka commends his song and suggests Kitty Section play it. Rose exclaims Adrien wrote a love song to everyone on Liberty, they all decide to play their part in making their friend serenading his feelings to Marinette a reality. Kagami approaches Liberty in Tatsu, reading a piece of paper. She folds it in half as Tatsu informs her she arrived at her destination. Kagami walks onto the boat in the middle of her friend's plans. Several of them suggest she help out. Alya tells Kagami of Adrien's upcoming love song performance. She expresses relief she will see Marinette and her approval of Adrien's progress. Alya uses her Alliance to call Marinette who shows up nearly immediately and dashes toward the Liberty, spouting off her supposed readiness. She gets caught off guard by Kagami's presence. Kagami attempts to ask Marinette a question, but she runs off saying she has to do something. Adrien welcomes Kagami, she once again expresses her pride in Adrien for his intentions to declare his love.

title: Perfection
text:
Perfection - Plot
Inside Liberty, Marinette practices her declaration of love to Adrien with a picture of the former and a picture of a cow. She happily runs back up to the deck just in time for Kitty Section's performance of Adrien's love song with Max, Nino, and Zoé on backup vocals. As the song comes to a close, a pink spotlight shines on Marinette. She tries to finally confess to Adrien, but she panics and runs to get her pictures. Kagami tries to go after her friend, but Alya tells her that she'll handle it, being her best friend and goes after her. Kagami takes out her piece of paper and checks a box on it. Marinette explains her original plan to Alya, who consoles her. The conversation then shifts to her life as Ladybug. Alya tries to tell her to stop with her excuses, but Marinette warns her Kagami is behind her. Alya tells Kagami they have to deal with something before they come back out. Kagami leaves and checks off the final box on her paper. Alya tells Marinette her alter ego isn't blockcading her love life, Marinette deflects this. She transforms into Ladybug and swings out a porthole, Alya watches her friend leave in concern.

title: Perfection
text:
Perfection - Plot
Kagami downtrodden speaks to Lila through her Alliance about the friendship test Lila gave Kagami.
A test that supposedly says if a friend is really a friend.
Marinette just so happened to check all the boxes.
Lila expresses her disapproval of Marinette's supposed ignoring of Kagami's efforts to get closer to Marinette.
Lila states she believes she deserves a better friend and she'd be honored to be Kagami's friend.
Kagami shoots her offer down, believing her imperfection makes her only worthy of solitude, she ends the call and deletes Marinette and Lila's contact information.
Lila grins wickedly, scheming to cut all Marinette's ties, leaving her all alone.
Ladybug realizes Alya was right, she only transformed to avoid Adrien.
She questions her reasoning for doing so.
Kagami runs off Liberty in tears.
Adrien notices her sorrow and runs after her.
Kagami stops at her car.
Tatsu asks her where she'd like to go.
She looks at Lila's friendship test, drops it and runs off sobbing.
Monarch seizes the opportunity to send a megakuma after Kagami, infecting her ring.
Monarch dubs her Ryukomori and transfers her the power of the Ryuko's Dragon Miraculous.

title: Perfection
text:
Perfection - Plot
She transforms into a giant humanoid cloud with the inability to see or hear people.
Adrien, who followed her, transforms into Cat Noir and pursues her.
Ladybug overhears Ryukomori's thunderous footsteps and follows her.
Ryukomori sits on the streets of Paris with her feet in the Canal Saint-Martin and reflects on the day she and Marinette forged their friendship.
She feared disappointment, yet she now feels at peace.
Meanwhile, the police have surrounded the oblivious Ryukomori.
Ladybug and Cat Noir overlook the situation.
Cat Noir hands Ladybug Lila's friendship test to read.
Ladybug realizes while trying to shield her civilian self from hurting, she hurt her friend in the process.
The hero duo leaps into action to save Kagami, but their strike attempt goes right through Ryukomori, landing them in the Seine.
Ladybug and Cat Noir try to talk to her atop Paris city hall via megaphone, Ryukomori walks right through city hall and the heroes.
Ryukomori stops at the Jardin des Tuileries and reminisces about all the times she trained with her mother.
Clara Contard, in a helicopter, reports on the situation with Ryukomri.

title: Perfection
text:
Perfection - Plot
She gets close enough that Ryukomori tries to shoo her off with her hand, cluing Ladybug and Cat Noir to her awareness of objects.
Clara doesn't leave, so Ryukomori shocks her with her lightning power, sending the helicopter hurtling to the ground.
With the disruption to her serenity and tranquility gone from her presence, Ryukomori leaves.
Cat helps Clara and the cameraman down from the crashed helicopter with his staff.
Ladybug formulates a plan to communicate with Ryukomori.
Cat Noir directs Ladybug in setting up cars in the shape of kanji.
They translate to “talk” (話).
Two cars are thrown through Ryukomori to get her attention.
She reads the kanji, but doesn't want to talk, wishing for silence.
In her anger, summoning a blustering wind which blows the heroes away.
Monarch tells Ryukmomori if she wants peace, she needs to defeat Ladybug and Cat Noir.
She spots the cars they broke flung at them by her winds and attacks them with lightning.
They narrowly dodge electrocution.
Ladybug summons her Lucky Charm, which gives her a box of variously colored ironing beads.
She comes up with a plan and sends Cat Noir to gather the materials needed to execute it.

title: Perfection
text:
Perfection - Plot
Cat Noir shows up at the Wang's art shop and orders a bunch of supplies from Socqueline.
Ladybug creates a picture of Kagami with the ironing beads she intends to have a bunch of people replicate on a larger scale.
Though she only has Nathaniel, Marc, Ivan, Max, Markov, and Alya present with her.
Markov offers a solution, he'll contact the group's friends and their friend's friends, and so on and so forth.
Socqueline and Cat Noir arrive with the necessary supplies in a pickup truck.
Ryukomori arrives at François Dupont and flashes back to her fencing match with Adrien.
She laments her disappointment that she could be anyone's friend and her feelings of freedom from suffering.
Cat Noir flies in front of her with a helicopter, infuriating her.
She follows him to the Stade des Princes to find Ladybug has gathered many people, just for her sake.
This touches Ryukomori.
Monarch tries to persuade her they're trying to trick her, but she's not buying what he's selling.
Ryukomori rejects the power Monarch gave her, transforming her back into Kagami and releasing the megakuma.
She starts free falling, the hero duo act quickly.

title: Perfection
text:
Perfection - Plot
Cat Noir grabs Ladybug and extends his staff, launching them into the air to catch their friend.
Kagami congratulates Ladybug on the applause and cheers and thanks Ladybug.
She tells Kagami the applause and cheering is for her, commending Kagami on single-handedly rejecting Monarch's power.
Ladybug throws her Lucky Charm in the air, activating her Miraculous Ladybug.
It fixes the damage caused by the battle.
Ladybug opens her yo-yo and pulls out a magical charm which she gives to Kagami as a symbol of her and everyone else's friendship.

title: Perfection
text:
Perfection - Plot
Later, Marinette gives Kagami a keychain with a picture of them in it and tells her when in doubt, to use it to comfort her. She accepts and asks her to pick up her phone next time. Both girls share their feeling of inadequacy: Kagami with how to act around friends and Marinette with Adrien. Marinette hugs Kagami to thank her for helping her come to this revelation and declares Kagami her best friend. Kagami asks about Alya. Marinette replies she can have more than one best friend. Alya adds her contact to Kagami's Alliance, as does Nino, Rose, Juleka, Luka, Kim, Mylène, Ivan, and Max, who wave and cheer for her. This makes Kagami happy. On her way home, she asks her Alliance to call Lila. Kagami decides to take Lila's offer to be her best friend. Lila replies she thinks of Kagami not as a friend but as a sister to her. Marinette drops off Alya, most likely at her apartment on her moped. Marinette confides in Alya about her being right about using her alter ego as an excuse why she struggles with Adrien. Alya tells her they'll figure it out together.

title: Perfection
text:
Perfection - Plot Development
Besides the power of the Dragon Miraculous, the concept of Perfection was exemplified, with people dwelling on their need to be perfect in order to not disappoint and help others and express themselves:
Marinette's inability to tell Adrien she loves him caused her to avoid Kagami as much as she can, as she couldn't bare to face her as long she didn't confess her love for Adrien, fearing to disappoint her.
Adrien writes a song for Marinette to confess his love for her and asks Kitty Section to help him so the song is as perfect as possible for her.
Marinette's friends try to come up with the perfect plan so Marinette can confess her love for Adrien.
Kagami's limited contact with others made her believe that she had to achieve perfection so she'd be good enough for someone else. And, after being tricked by Lila to think Marinette didn't consider her a friend, comes to the conclusion that, if she can't be her friend, no one else can, so she focuses on being the perfect girl she was pressured to be by isolating herself from everyone else.
