title: Peacock Miraculous/Re-Verse
text:
Peacock Miraculous/Re-Verse - Intro
The Peacock Miraculous is a brooch that, whenever Duusu inhabits it, transforms the wearer into a peacock-themed superhero with the power of Emotion.
The transformation and detransformation phrases are unknown.
The brooch is currently owned by Gabriel Agreste. He stole it after joining The Supreme and to make his wish come true, thus making his wife the holder of this miraculous. However, after she died from an unknown reason, Gabriel starts guarding the Miraculous in an unknown place.

title: Peacock Miraculous/Re-Verse
text:
Peacock Miraculous/Re-Verse - Appearance
In its charged mode the brooch changes from seven or nine feather segments to five. Its main color is pale, light grayish blue-violet, while the crystals on the top of each segment are red or pink, depending on the episode. The lower part of the Miraculous also changes from the body of a peacock into a single teardrop.

title: Peacock Miraculous/Re-Verse
text:
Peacock Miraculous/Re-Verse - Abilities
The Peacock Miraculous grants its wielder superhuman characteristics of speed, endurance, and strength.
Its special weapon is a hand fan. This weapon can be used as an offensive weapon and a means of communication with other Miraculous owners, as seen in "Miraculer".
The Peacock Miraculous' superpower is Amokization, which allows the user to manifest a Sentimonster, a living creature manifested from a person's emotions. This is achieved by turning a feather into an amok and sending it to inhabit an object belonging to the recipient. The Sentimonster will obey whoever possesses its amok. The wielder of the Peacock Miraculous has the power to revoke the amok, destroying the Sentimonster and purifying the charged feather. Users of this power will often command the amok to create a sentimonster by speaking the phrase "Bring my creation to life".

title: Peacock Miraculous/Re-Verse
text:
Peacock Miraculous/Re-Verse - Abilities
The wielder can also form a telepathic connection between themselves and their target and can see and hear through both the target and the Sentimonster. However, this connection only exists between the original creator and amok, as they possess no link between Amokitized people and Sentimonsters created by other wielders. They can also sense where an amok is, even when the Miraculous isn’t in use. In the case of a Sentimonster being dormant, the wielder can awaken the dormant creature. By concentrating the wielder can sense the feeling and emotions of a Sentimonster.
The wielder can also use the power on themselves, namely by charging an amok and placing it in an object the wielder possesses. They can then create a Sentimonster that is completely loyal to them, so long as they possess the amok.
The wielder can get rid of a sentimonster by snapping their fingers or speaking the phrase "I release you from existence", even if the sentimonster was created by a different wielder. They can also cause the Sentimonster pain, to make it heed the Peacock Miraculous holder.

title: Peacock Miraculous/Re-Verse
text:
Peacock Miraculous/Re-Verse - Trivia
Despite the fact Gabriel did manage to steal the Peacock Miraculous, together with his Butterfly Miraculous, it's unknown if he still possesses it, as Shadybug and Claw Noir only mentioned that their mission was to retrieve the Butterfly Miraculous, not mentioning the Peacock Miraculous at all.
It's possible that the reason why they didn't mention it was because the Butterfly Miraculous was their priority (due to being Betterfly's main Miraculous).
It's also possible that the Peacock Miraculous had already been recovered, which also explained why Gabriel was not using it as well or didn't have any of his allies use it.
However, maybe the reason for Gabriel not using the Peacock Miraculous was because he didn't want to misuse of its power again, risk to have the Supreme recover it and/or endanger another with the responsibility of using a Miraculous knowing full well the Supreme would do anything to get it back.

title: Petit Palais
text:
Petit Palais - Intro
The  it is a building built in 1900 which houses the Museum of Fine Arts of the City of Paris. It is located in the 8th arrondissement of Paris, opposite the Grand Palais and close to the Champs-Élysées.

title: Petit Palais
text:
Petit Palais - Description
Built by the architect Charles Girault in 1900 for the Universal Exhibition, the Petit Palais is built around a semicircular garden.
Facing the Grand Palais, the façade of the Petit Palais is 125 meters long. This is centered by a monumental portico surmounted by a dome. Scrolled Ionic columns and many sculptures adorn the facade.
The Petit Palais also has glass roofs, domes, which allow its interiors to be naturally lit.

section: Museum of Fine Arts of the City of Paris
text:
Petit Palais - Museum of Fine Arts of the City of Paris
Since 1902, the Petit Palais has housed the museum. It has a permanent collection of fine art from antiquity to the end of the 19th century, as well as paintings, sculptures and various works of art.
The museum regularly hosts temporary exhibitions.

title: Petit Palais
text:
Petit Palais - Trivia
The Petit Palais has been classified as a Historic Monument since 1975.
In the series, only the exterior of the Petit Palais appears.
In "Stormy Weather", the outside of the building was decorated with a poster of the Grand KIDZ+ competition's winner for new Miss Weather, Mireille Caquet.

title: Perrine Psiquat
text:
Perrine Psiquat - Intro
is a minor character in Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug and Cat Noir, first introduced in season 6. She is the psychiatrist at the Collège Françoise Dupont.
In "Wreckless Driver", after Aglaé, feeling overwhelmed by her anxiety, told Perrine that she was useless for not being able to cure her fears in just one session, she was akumatized by Chrysalis into Wreckless Driver, a psychotherapist/driver-themed supervillain with the power to extract other people's fears with the gadgets of her racing car. She also received a Magical Charm from Ladybug that prevented her from being akumatized again.

title: Perrine Psiquat
text:
Perrine Psiquat - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Perrine is a woman of medium height with fair skin. She has coily-kinky caramel-brown hair and chestnut-brown eyes.
Civilian Attire
She wears an open pink jacket over a white polo shirt. She also wears beige-grey pants, a black belt with a gold buckle, and a pair of brown sandals. She wears a pair of round blue glasses with white polka dots and colored lenses, a pair of gold flower-shaped earrings, and several bracelets on her left wrist, in addition to a wedding ring.
As Wreckless Driver
Wreckless Driver was a blue-skinned woman with slicked-back blue hair (though it remained frizzly) to match her lips, rose pink sclerae, and bright blue eyes. She wore a large teal racing helmet with darker polka dots on the border, and a white slit at the jaw from the side trim. She also had a very transparent, large visor that covered almost her entire face, leaving only the lower half exposed, with a rose ombre near the end.

title: Perrine Psiquat
text:
Perrine Psiquat - Appearance
She wore a costume with white armor featuring a high collar, torso and waist armor, and wide shoulder pads, with a large red Ψ (Psi) symbol on her torso. She also wore a white belt with a large round buckle and a red inner part with the same blue Ψ symbol. The shoulders were bulbous in shape, layered beneath white shoulder pauldrons with a teal upper half while the rest of the arms were white. The waist armor had red trim.

title: Perrine Psiquat
text:
Perrine Psiquat - Personality
Dr. Psiquat is particularly kind and attentive, devoted to helping others with their problems, and always understanding and supportive. She also has a great passion for vehicles, as well as for the world of driving and piloting, often using driving metaphors to explain her work and how she guides her patients through their therapeutic process.
As Wreckless Driver, she became much more energetic and determined in her mission to help others — no longer content to simply accompany them through their healing process, but instead seeking to cure them directly of their fears, even if it meant erasing fear entirely from her victims.

title: Perrine Psiquat
text:
Perrine Psiquat - Abilities
As a Civilian
She is a skilled psychiatrist, as most of her patients give her lots of praise.
She can write everything her patients say and help them one step at a time so they will overcome their problems
As Wreckless Driver
She can identify and extract peoples' fears with her car by pulling them with a plunger attached to said car where the victim will have their fears extracted one at a time while on a lounge chair, causing them to act careless without them and get ejected from the car with a parachute.
Her car also seems to have underwater travel capabilities, as demonstrated with Aqua Noir.

title: Perrine Psiquat
text:
Perrine Psiquat - Relationships
Acquaintances
Max Kanté
Max is one of the doctor's patients, whom he usually sees every Thursday at 6:15 p.m. due to him being on the autism spectrum, which makes it difficult for him to understand a world designed for neurotypical people. Things like delays, misplaced objects, or new places often unsettle him, and she helps him manage them. Max holds her in very high regard, even recommending her to his friends when he concludes that his issues should be addressed by a psychiatrist rather than a psychologist.
During Aglaé's therapeutic session for her insect phobia, Max helped this woman because he is Aglaé's friend and part of the group that had recommended she see a psychiatrist. The exercise involved Max, along with Aglaé's other friends (Marinette, Mylène, Alya, Juleka, and Adrien), forming a circle around Aglaé to help her enter the Mariposario —one of the places that triggers her phobia due to the butterflies— and staying there as long as she felt capable of handling it.
Mylène Haprèle

title: Perrine Psiquat
text:
Perrine Psiquat - Relationships
Mylène is one of this woman's patients, whom she usually sees due to her phobia of the dark, germs, and mice. These sessions have helped her overcome them enough that she no longer gets easily scared when facing them. Mylène holds her in high regard and often recommends her to friends when she believes they need a psychiatrist to address their problems.
During Aglaé's therapeutic session for her insect phobia, Mylène helped this woman because she is Aglaé's friend and part of the group that had recommended she see a psychiatrist. The exercise involved Mylène, along with Aglaé's other friends (Marinette, Max, Alya, Juleka, and Adrien), forming a circle around Aglaé to help her enter the Mariposario —one of the places that triggers her phobia due to butterflies— and staying there as long as she felt capable of handling it.
Adrien Agreste
Adrien is one of her patients, who she currently helps with issues about his father.

title: Perrine Psiquat
text:
Perrine Psiquat - Etymology
The first word of her akumatized villain name, Wreckless, is a portmanteau of "wreck", which is to damage something, and "reckless", which is to be careless about risks.

title: Perrine Psiquat
text:
Perrine Psiquat - Trivia
Judging by the ring on her left ring finger, Perrine is married.
She is shown as being a therapist to many of the school's students, helping them face any problem they may have:
She has been helping Max regarding his struggles with autism.
She has been helping Mylène with her many phobias.
She has been helping Juleka with her inability to talk with others.
She has helped Alya with some family issues.
She is currently helping Aglaé with her bug phobia, along with her anxiety towards akumatization and anything related to it.
She is currently helping Adrien with his feelings about his father.
In her akumatized form, her powers were similar to the "no fear gas" made by the Scarecrow in the episode "Never Fear" from The New Batman Adventures.
Her powers were also similar to Risk's, as they both caused people to lose their fears and act careless.

title: Pili
text:
Pili - Intro
is a secondary character in Miraculous World: Tokyo - Stellar Force and the animated spin-off series Miraculous Stellar Force. He is a student at Kano Academy, a superhero, and member of the Stellar Force. He is the current bearer of the Aries Fragment, which allows him to become Aries and one of the guardians who possess a fragment of the Stellar Matrix.

title: Pili
text:
Pili - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Pili has fair skin, brown eyes, and black hair. His bangs are brushed back and dyed brilliant scarlet. He has two horn-like protuberance-esque locks that stick out of his bangs. His thick eyebrows have an upper cut at the sides.
Civilian Attire
Pili wears a red long-sleeved top with white diagonal upper lines, black zipline and pockets, trim, sleeves, collar, and red cuffs, red pants with square-cut black diamonds on the knees, and red mechanical boots with black tongues, soles, and straps.
As Aries
Aries wears a jumpsuit shared with his teammates: a black jumpsuit with rectangular-detailed white elbow trim, abdomen, thigh trim, and shins. On his chest is a black four-point star. His lower arms (except his fingers), torso, shoulders, inner thighs, sides of his knees, and feet are all red with black fingers and rectangular soles. His helmet is black with a red chin, silver components covering his ears, followed by red angular rectangles on top and black tips, and red horn-like protuberances at the front over the top of his visor, resembling the ones from his bangs. On his left wrist is his red and black watch, the Aries Sprite.

title: Pili
text:
Pili - Personality
Pili is bold, confident, energetic, yet competitive and a bit of a showoff. This is evident when he competed against Leo at the worst time to do so during a fight against a Kaijū.

title: Pili
text:
Pili - Abilities
As a Civilian
Pili is an expert in an unknown kind of sport thanks to attending Kano Academy.
As Aries
Aries has enhanced physical abilities, such as speed, combat, agility and strength. He is especially excellent at hand-to-hand combat. With the help of the Aries Sprite, he can summon his weapons, the Aries Laser. This could suggest he is proficient in marksmanship with hand weapons.

title: Pili

title: Pili
text:
Pili - Etymology
The name Pili has two different origins:
In Hawaiian origin, it means "to join", "to adhere", or "to cling". It can also be a short form of the name "Pele", who is a Hawaiian volcano goddess.
This is quite fitting with Pili's theme color being red, and his zodiac is a fire sign.
In Swahili origin, it means "second-born".
It can also be a shortened form of the name "Philip" from Western culture, meaning "lover of horses".

title: Pili
text:
Pili - Trivia
Pili was the one who, after many failed attempts, managed to come up with the team's name, "Stellar Force".
Pili has several traits associated with the Aries sign:
Pili is bold, confident and energetic, traits normally associated to the Aries sign, as well as competitive.
His horn-like protuberance-esque locks present in both civilian and hero form could resemble the horns of a ram.
This makes sense as the Aries constellation is depicted as a ram.
His theme color is red, which is a color the Aries zodiac can represent since it's often associated with warm colors due to being a fire sign.

title: Placide I.T.
text:
Placide I.T. - Intro
, commonly nicknamed the Gorilla, is a recurring character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He is Adrien Agreste's bodyguard and chauffeur.
In "Gorizilla", after Placide failed to get Adrien back when he snuck out to watch a movie he didn't think his father would let him watch and got harshly insulted when Gabriel left him a voicemail, he was akumatized by Hawk Moth into Gorizilla, a giant gorilla-like supervillain.
In "Representation", it was revealed that he used to work for Colt Fathom, but his employment was traded to Gabriel Agreste in exchange for being lent the Peacock Miraculous to create a child for himself.

title: Placide I.T.
text:
Placide I.T. - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Placide is a large, tall, and middle-aged man with black hair that has light gray sideburns on the sides of his head and dark blue eyes. He has a somewhat primate-like face representing a gorilla. Unlike the other people, he does not have eyebrows but does have large jaws and a straight nose.
From Season 6 onwards, his gray sideburns became darker.
Civilian attire
He wears a dark grayish Persian blue dress suit with a pale, light grayish blue turtleneck sweater underneath. He also sports dark sapphire blue dress shoes.
From Season 6 onwards, his suit becomes dark blue and his shoes are now black.
As Gorizilla
Gorizilla was a giant blue gorilla with his chest being a lighter shade of blue and his face being surrounded by thick black lines. He had light gold sclera with moderate amaranth irises with two upper canines that stuck out of his mouth. He only wore dark blue, tattered pants.

title: Placide I.T.
text:
Placide I.T. - Personality
Placide is a serious, grim, and stoic, but mostly calm man who, unlike most characters, does not speak or express any emotions. He takes his job very seriously and is quite protective of Adrien, threatening Simon Grimault when the latter just wanted to shake hands with Adrien. His suspicious nature also thrives outside of his job as he glanced at Marinette from a distance because she was talking back to her purse, where Tikki was, in "Guitar Villain". He isn't afraid to stand up to what he considers dangerous to himself or others, like Simon Says and Darkblade, but he becomes fearful in particular cases when he is endangered, such as in "Santa Claws", when the titular villain covered him in tarantulas. While not openly genial, Placide obeyed his boss Gabriel and Nathalie. He followed through on requests on others, such as delivering Marinette's Christmas gift to Adrien in "Santa Claws".

title: Placide I.T.
text:
Placide I.T. - Personality
Underneath Placide's intimidating exterior, he is shown to be gentle and kind as he briefly played with action figure dolls and secretly allowed Adrien's friends into the Agreste mansion in "Party Crasher". He can also be easily moved as seen in "Reflekdoll", when he sees the girls sincerely beg him to allow Adrien to have fun with them. He also sincerely cares for Adrien to the extent that the mere sight of the boy was enough to completely banish all of the negative emotions that were about to get him akumatized, showing that he doesn't consider his devotion to protecting Adrien a merely paid job. When Marinette is forced to break up with Adrien in "Cat Blanc", he doesn't let Adrien go but seeing his supplication and tears, he allowed Adrien to go after her.

title: Placide I.T.
text:
Placide I.T. - Personality
As of season 5 onwards, Placide showed himself to be very supportive and kind to Adrien for his relationship with Marinette. He was willing to do anything to make them feel happy and even tried to protect them after they were attacked by Riposte Prime. In "Revolution", Placide was very sad to see Adrien devastated that he would leave Paris and upon seeing Marinette rushing to the airplane on her scooter, Placide unbuckles Adrien and silently signals him to see his girlfriend one last time and smiled, showing his selfless side. When a disgusted and presumably jealous Gabriel furiously orders Placide and the airport technician to separate Adrien and Marinette, Placide had no choice but to comply his orders, albeit begrudgingly. When Adrien starts crying, devastated that he lost the love of his life, Placide was not above crying to see someone so sad and reluctantly buckled Adrien. He is also shown in "Werepapas" where he was tearing up when Adrien ultimately decided to remain in Paris with Natalie, showing his caring side again.

title: Placide I.T.
text:
Placide I.T. - Personality
As Gorizilla, he was more aggressively relentless in finding Adrien and keeping him safe. He was more than willing to attack bystanders who got in his way and cause mayhem to find him. However, he was also careless and oblivious as he didn't realize keeping Adrien with him he was unknowingly almost getting him hurt when attacking Ladybug, and had a hard time getting her Miraculous as he got both her and Adrien in his hands.

title: Placide I.T.
text:
Placide I.T. - Abilities
As a civilian
Placide is a very strong man as he can use his height and build to intimidate others if necessary. When Simon Says hypnotizes him to act like a gorilla, he is powerful enough to attack and restraint Cat Noir.
As Gorizilla
Gorizilla possessed extraordinary strength and an acute sense of smell, as well as a strong jump. Because of his enhanced senses and physical abilities, he was an excellent tracker, being able to follow Adrien just about anywhere after getting his scent from his bracelet. However, if his sense of smell was overpowered by a stronger scent, like Wayhem's bottle of Adrien: The Fragrance, he lost the ability to sniff out whoever he was trying to track.

title: Placide I.T.
text:
Placide I.T. - Relationships
Work environment
Adrien Agreste
As his bodyguard, Placide is very protective of Adrien, leaving his side only when forced to, like when he is chased off by spiders summoned by Santa Claws. In general, he seems to be very fond of Adrien, showing signs of genuine care towards him. In "Gigantitan", when he is about to be akumatized from his frustration with parking the limousine, the mere sight of Adrien being safe is enough to calm him down and repel the akuma. He is also willing to put himself between Adrien and dangerous threats like Simon Says and Gigantitan without hesitation, further showing his protective instincts towards the boy.

title: Placide I.T.
text:
Placide I.T. - Relationships
In "Protection", he is shown to support Marinette and Adrien's relationship, where he secretly helps them set a date at the Agreste mansion, and when they both are attacked Riposte Prime, he defends them both from the supervillain, allowing them to escape. In "Revolution", when he and Adrien hear Marinette calling to him on the plane, he allows Adrien to go see Marinette. A furious, disgusted, and presumably jealous Gabriel ordered Placide to separate the couple and he pulled Adrien apart from Marinette with a genuinely sorry look on his face look as the two shared their first kiss. Back on the plane, a tearful Placide is visibly sad to see Adrien lose the love of his life and has tears in his eyes.
In "Miraculous London", upon learning of Gabriel's death, Placide became sad at seeing Adrien heartbroken for losing his father.

title: Placide I.T.
text:
Placide I.T. - Relationships
In "Climatiqueen", after Adrien and Marinette's relationship became public, he is shown to be protective of them. Whenever someone who tries to intrude on their private life, he sprays the reporters away with a garden hose attached with a portable water tank as shown when they tried to interview Marinette who was visiting Adrien, and later he sprayed Vincent Asa when Vincent was stalking them.
Gabriel Agreste
Placide did his best to follow Gabriel's orders of protecting Adrien, though in situations when Gabriel got angry at him for some reason, he can get nervous or frustrated.
Unlike Nathalie, Placide seems to be unaware of his boss' supervillain identity as Hawk Moth.
Unlike Gabriel, he supports Adrien's relationship with Marinette, and on occasion, he disobeyed Gabriel's orders to prevent Adrien and Marinette from becoming a couple. On Gabriel's orders, he was forced to break up Adrien and Marinette's first kiss.
In "Miraculous London", Placide becomes shocked and saddened when learning from Bug Noire about Gabriel's death while defeating Monarch, not only for Gabriel but also for Adrien.
Nathalie Sancoeur

title: Placide I.T.
text:
Placide I.T. - Relationships
Nathalie and Placide have a healthy professional relationship while working for Gabriel and they are both shown to be equally scared of him in "Gorizilla".
In "Miraculous London", he learns from Bug Noire that Nathalie was supposedly gravely injured by Monarch and that Gabriel used the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses to heal her in exchange of his own life.
In "Werepapas", Placide also shows concerns for Nathalie as shown when Lord Graham de Vanily disagrees with Adrien about Nathalie being a mother figure and that she should have no legal right for Adrien's welfare as she is just an employee. He is also shown to tear up when Adrien chose to stay with Nathalie.
Colt Fathom
Though a play in  "Representation", Placide I.T. was Colt's best man before his employment was traded to Gabriel Agreste in exchange for being lent the Peacock Miraculous to create a child for himself.
Amélie Graham de Vanily
Not much is known about his relationship with Lady Amélie other than he used to work for her husband until his services were traded to Gabriel. In "Re-creation", he serves her and Nathalie drinks at the pool party being held at the Agreste mansion.

Placide was neutral towards Marinette as he tries to not let her interfere with Gabriel's orders in "Reflekdoll" and the alternate timeline in "Cat Blanc", before giving in during both cases. title: Placide I.T.
text:
Placide I.T. - Trivia
Thomas Astruc and the crew call him "the Gorilla".
As revealed in "Adrien's Double Life", Adrien calls him "the Gorilla" because he has a large build and he doesn't talk at all.
In "Simon Says", the title character hypnotizes Placide to think he is a gorilla.
In the French version of "The Puppeteer", Plagg also refers to him as "The Gorilla", while he simply refers to him as Adrien's bodyguard in the English version.
In some languages (including French), "Gorilla" is a slang word used to describe a particularly muscular bodyguard.
In "The Bubbler", Placide can be spotted in the sky to the right of Tom Dupain and Sabine Cheng when they are trapped in bubbles.
He really likes Christmas.
In "Stormy Weather", Placide is helping out Vincent by holding up a reflector during Adrien's photo shoot in the park.
Although the car he usually drives appears in "Kung Food", he himself does not.
An image showing part of Placide's akumatized form was teased in a sneak peek collage at the Miraculous San Diego Comic-Con 2017 panel.
The akuma in "Gigantitan" was intended to akumatize Placide, but it ended up akumatizing August instead.

title: Placide I.T.
text:
Placide I.T. - Trivia
The name of his akumatized form, Gorizilla, is a pun on his nickname and Godzilla. Coincidently, both have Gorilla in their names, representing their strength and power.
In the Korean version of "Gorizilla", his name is simply Gorilla.
A scarlet version of Gorizilla reappeared in the two-part special event "Heroes' Day".
In "Oblivio", he is listed as "G." in Adrien's cellphone, though this is likely short for "Gorilla".
Gorizilla reappeared in "Gamer 2.0" because of Gamer 2.0's powers.
In "Miraculous New York", it is revealed that he is afraid of flying.
In "Miraculous Paris", when Gabriel goes through his contacts, Placide is the only contact to not be labelled with a name.
Ezra Weisz stated in an interview with Lindalee Rose that he believes the bodyguard's name would be either "Maurice" or "Michel".
However, in the Miraculous Secrets card game, his name is revealed to be Placide I.T.
When pronounced in French, "Placide I.T." sounds like placidité, which means "placidity" or "peacefulness". This is a reference to how he does not speak.

title: Place des Vosges
text:
Place des Vosges - Intro
The , originally Place Royale, is the oldest planned square (public park) in Paris. It is located across the street from Marinette's home.

title: Place des Vosges
text:
Place des Vosges - Appearance
The park's ground is mainly yellow-brown dirt with yellow-green grass. The park is surrounded by tall metal fences. There are many trees with green leaves, providing plenty of shade. There are green benches and lamp posts scattered throughout the park. In the center of the park is a fountain. A carousel is somewhere towards the center of the park.

title: Place des Vosges
text:
Place des Vosges - Trivia
A statue of Ladybug and Cat Noir, designed by Théo Barbot, is revealed and added to the park in "Copycat".
However, it is not seen in later episodes.
In "Dark Cupid", there is a mailbox on the outside of the park fence across the street from Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie.
The fences have TV screens in "Reflekta".
In "Re-creation", thanks to Caline and Tomoe, a statue of Gabriel was erected here, in honor of his memory for presumably helping to defeat the Monarch.
However, in "Lady Chaos", it is revealed that Adrien destroyed the statue as Cat Noir using the Cataclysm.

title: Pixelator
text:
Pixelator - Intro
"" is a season 1 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. According to the series' production/written order, it is the 7th episode of season 1, as well as the 7th episode of the series, overall.

title: Pixelator
text:
Pixelator - Synopsis
Rejected by a rock star, an angry fan becomes Pixelator, who traps Parisians in his camera's memory until Cat Noir and Ladybug halt his photo spree.
Disney+
Ladybug and Cat Noir face Pixelator, alias Vincent Asa.

title: Pixelator
text:
Pixelator - Plot
Miss Bustier talks to her students about how they will be able to try some of the jobs in Le Grand Paris. As André Bourgeois looks through this list of jobs for people, Miss Bustier finds that Marinette and Alya aren't on the list. Alya whispers to Marinette that she thinks who knows who helped the mayor pick out the jobs while staring at Chloé. Marinette is upset that Chloé gets to spend the whole day with Adrien and declares that today will be the worst day ever. Chloé then calls out for her father and gives him a sheet with the jobs for Alya and Marinette. Alya ends up having to sort trash in the principle dumpster.

title: Pixelator
text:
Pixelator - Plot
Before Mr. Bourgeois gets the chance to tell Marinette her job, Jagged Stone bursts in with his assistant, Penny Rolling, and his pet crocodile, Fang, asking for a luxury suite room. At first, Mr. Bourgeois doesn't want to let Jagged inside, but after Chloé tells her dad who he is, André welcomes him into his hotel. Meanwhile, a fan of Jagged sneaks into the hotel and hides behind a desk. The fan, revealed to be Vincent Asa, tries to sneak a few photos of Jagged but is caught by Fang. Vincent asks Jagged for a few photos since they are friends, but Jagged tells Vincent they aren't friends. Penny scolds him and throws him out of the hotel, warning him to stay away from Jagged and threatening to take away his camera if he ever comes near him again.
Vincent becomes frustrated by this, and as a result, he is akumatized into Pixelator by Hawk Moth.

title: Pixelator
text:
Pixelator - Plot
After this, Mr. Bourgeois tells Marinette that she is the gopher. Alya wonders what that is, and Marinette guesses that it's as bad as trash duty. In Jagged Stone's room, Penny tells André and Marinette that Jagged wants a pair of red, white, and blue sunglasses with Eiffel Towers on them. André tells Marinette to get the special glasses for Jagged since she is the gopher, which he explains is someone who finds anything a guest asks for.
Marinette runs out of Le Grand Paris to the Eiffel Tower and buys a pair of sunglasses. Tikki tells Marinette that the glasses she bought aren't even close to what Jagged Stone wants and she should just do the job right the first time. Before Marinette can reply, a lady passing by with her child sees Tikki inside of Marinette's bag and freaks out. As a cover, Tikki meows, pretending to be a cat.

title: Pixelator
text:
Pixelator - Plot
Marinette gives Jagged the glasses, but he doesn't like them. Marinette tries to explain that she couldn't find the glasses he requested, but Jagged doesn't care and kicks her out, demanding her to find the glasses he wants. Marinette sighs, upset that she now has to spend more time away from Adrien. Tikki reminds Marinette of her earlier advice, and Marinette decides to take it this time. She gets an idea to make the glasses herself and rushes back to her place.
Pixelator walks up to the hotel and tricks Kim and the doorman into letting him take their photo, only to pixelate them instead. Pixelator then enters the hotel and Chloé attempts to kick him out, stating that her father only allows the biggest celebrities to stay in his hotel, such as herself, however, Pixelator then asks to photograph her, which she allows. Adrien, realizing that Pixelator has been akumatized, attempts to push Chloé out of the way, only to be pixelated and transported into a photo with Chloé. In the photo, Adrien tries to find a way out, while Chloé tries to manipulate their time alone to "bond" with him.

title: Pixelator
text:
Pixelator - Plot
When Marinette gets back to the hotel, she notes that Adrien and Chloé are missing, although Tikki reminds her that she has more important things to do. Marinette tries to give Jagged Stone the glasses, but he is busy washing Fang, so Penny takes care of it. As Marinette walks out, Pixelator walks in and pixelates Penny. Marinette notices this, and transforms into Ladybug. Just before Jagged Stone is pixelated, Ladybug saves him, but she gets her right arm pixelated in the process. Ladybug carries Jagged Stone out of the hotel to Mr. Damoclès' office. She tells Jagged Stone to stay in the office while she goes to capture Pixelator's akuma.
In the photo, Chloé tries to yell for her dad, while Adrien tries to get away from Chloé in order to transform. He starts to run but is interrupted by Chloé, who screams and clings to him while pointing to a newly-pixelated Fang.
As Ladybug is inspecting Vincent Asa's room, she finds a bunch of photos on the wall that have all of Pixelator's victims inside.

title: Pixelator
text:
Pixelator - Plot
Pixelator captures multiple Parisians into photos. Nadja Chamack asks Pixelator a few questions. Jagged Stone, who is watching, decides to go to Pixelator and give him what he wants. Ladybug eventually shows up, although, with her right hand gone, she finds it hard to fight and use her yo-yo. She then slips and is cornered against a car by Pixelator. She makes a deal with him about him freeing half the people, in exchange for a private photo shoot with Jagged Stone. He agrees, even though Hawk Moth warns him not to.
After he frees half the people, Adrien and Chloé are sent back to the lobby of the hotel. Adrien runs off and transforms into Cat Noir. As he sneaks up on Pixelator, Ladybug tries to tell him where the akuma is by stalling. But, just when he was going to take off Pixelator's glasses a civilian yells out Cat Noir's name and alerts Pixelator. Adrien then gets sent back into the pixel world, and Ladybug gets her right leg pixelated. Jagged Stone appears and agrees for Pixelator to take his photo. He can't seem to find the right pose until he gets just the right one. Just as he is about to take the photo, Ladybug uses Lucky Charm, giving her a powder compact.

title: Pixelator
text:
Pixelator - Plot
Cat Noir uses Cataclysm to break the photos and free everyone else, including himself. He gets back to the real world, and he helps Ladybug with her Lucky Charm by using his staff to hit the mirror like a baseball bat in front of Pixelator, just as he takes the photo. The photo beam bounces off of the mirror and shoots Pixelator, causing everything except his camera to disappear. And Hawk Moth warns the heroes that the next time, he assures them there won't be a photo finish as he won't stop until he will destroy them.
Before breaking the item with the akuma inside, she uses Miraculous Ladybug to get her limbs back, then she breaks the item the akuma was inhabiting and captures it. Pixelator turns back into Vincent Asa.
Later, at Le Grand Paris, Ms. Bustier thanks Mr. Bourgeois for the enterprise day. As she is finishing thanking him, Jagged Stone's assistant gives Marinette, Alya, Adrien, and Nino tickets to Jagged Stone's concert. Chloé is unhappy upon not receiving one.
At the concert. Adrien states that it is his first time at a concert and that it's awesome. Marinette agrees, and Jagged Stone dedicates a song on the piano to Ladybug.

text:
Pixelator - Trivia
At his concert, Jagged Stone plays the episode ending soundtrack on his piano (not to be confused with the ending credit soundtrack).
Allusions
The scene where Pixelator knocks at Alec's door is a homage to the first Terminator movie.
The painting that can be seen above Jagged Stone's bed at Le Grand Paris is "Four Seasons" by Alphonse Mucha.
Errors
The Nickelodeon description incorrectly refers to Jagged Stone as a pop star instead of a rock star.
After André sends Jagged Stone off on the elevator, and Miss Bustier, behind him with Marinette and Alya, is reminding him about assigning a job for Marinette. Alya's right eye blinks while her left eye stays open.
The right lift door cuts the crocodile's left foot.
August's mother's gasp when she sees Tikki is not dubbed over in the English dub, being taken directly from the French dub.
When Pixelator is about to take a photo of Kim and unnamed doorman, Kim doesn't have eyebrows.
When Ladybug escapes from the Le Grand Paris hotel with Jagged Stone, her yo-yo is completely white and not colored.

title: Pixelator
text:
Pixelator - Trivia
A poster can be seen on the wall in Vincent Asa's room that is similar to the "Metal Lourd" magazine with both Marinette and Jagged Stone on it from "Guitar Villain". But this event takes place before the latter episode.
During the scene when Chloé, Adrien, and Ladybug talk to each other, Chloé is suddenly wearing her purse even though she wasn't wearing it when she and Adrien got pixelated.
When Ladybug hides behind the car, her arm is not pixelated.
When Jagged Stone and Ladybug escape from the hotel, Ladybug holds Jagged Stone with her pixelated arm, but it doesn’t go through. So Jagged flies up instead of being on the ground.
In Ladybug and Pixelator's first encounter for a few seconds all of the sound effects and the music are silenced.
The synopsis of this episode on the Gloob app calls the main character "Billy", who is a fan of actor "Jean Haprèle" (possibly Fred Haprèle). This could be either is a misnaming or a reference to a previous version of the script.
The Lucky Charm sequence does not show her arm and leg pixelated appropriately.
Ladybug is shown unable to use her pixelated arms, but she carries Jagged with it a few seconds later.

title: Pixelator/Transcript
text:
Pixelator/Transcript - Intro
[ Theme Song ]
Caline: Thanks to the generosity of Mr. Bourgeois, we're able to have our work experience field trip today at the Grand Paris luxury hotel. Each of you will get hands-on experience with one of the many jobs here at the hotel. (Sees Alix and Ivan having a pillow fight) (sighs) You'll be graded on your effort, which will affect whether you pass or fail the class. (Sabrina and the worker giggle)
Ms. Bustier: Do you have Marinette and Alya on your list, Mr. Bourgeois?
Mr. Bourgeois: It doesn't look like it.
Alya: (whispers to Marinette) I bet I know who helped Daddy make the assignment.
Marinette: Of course, she gets to spent her entire day with Adrien... Ugh! This is gonna be the worst day ever! (groans)
Mr. Bourgeois: It must be an oversight.
Chloé: Daddy! (Gives him an assignment)
Mr. Bourgeois: Thank you, sweetie. Oh yes! Alya, you're going to be... sorting trash at the main dumpster.
(Alya gasps)
Mr. Bourgeois: And, Marinette will be...
(The door opens. Jagged Stone, Fang, and Penny Rolling appear.)
Chloé: Wow!
Marinette: Hey! That's...
Mr. Bourgeois: Excuse me, but this is a luxury hotel, not a zoo (Fang growls at him)

title: Pixelator/Transcript
text:
Pixelator/Transcript - Intro
Chloé: Daddy! (whispers to him) That's Jagged Stone, the rockstar. He's sold millions of albums, he's very famous and is very, very rich.
Mr. Bourgeois: Mr. Stone, welcome to the Grand Paris Hotel! I am Mayor Bourgeois and the owner of this luxury establishment, in fact, the most luxurious in all of Paris. How might we serve you?
Jagged Stone: How'd you think? I didn't just come here to admire your lobby.
Penny Rolling: Jagged would like to check into your most luxurious suite.
Jagged Stone: And Fang better get a real bathtub, not a tiny water hole like the one in that hotel across the street.
Mr. Bourgeois: We have everything you need, Ms. Fang. Even a state-of-the-art entertainment center! (Penny chuckles)
Jagged Stone: Fang's me crocodile. (points at Fang)
Mr. Bourgeois: Mr. Stone, we have everything you require for your... (mutters) Fang. Would he, um... enjoy a bubble bath?
(Penny chuckles again)
Jagged Stone: Crocodiles don't like bubble baths. It dries their scales out!

title: Pixelator/Transcript
text:
Pixelator/Transcript - Intro
(Vincent Asa quietly enters the hotel, Fang sees him and follows him. Marinette and Alya see him. As Vincent takes some photos, he notices Fang, making yelp in surprise and comes out of his hiding spot. Jagged and Penny are both looking annoyed.)
Jagged Stone: (sighs) Oh, no. Not him again.
Vincent: Remember me, Mr. Stone? Vincent Asa! Just one photo to show everyone in the world that we're best buds! Come on, please! I'm your biggest fan!
Jagged Stone: I know, you've been to my last 36 shows. But we are not friends.
Vincent: There! Look into the lens! (Vincent gets closer to Jagged (looking uncomfortable) to take his picture, but gets interrupted by Penny, who takes his camera)
Penny: Didn't you hear Mr. Stone? You still haven't got it, have you? (gets Vincent out of the hotel) No photos!
(Penny throws Vincent's camera and he grabs it in time)
Penny: Good reflexes. Now don't let me see you near Mr. Stone again. Or next time, you won't get your camera back.
(Penny goes back in the hotel as Vincent seethes with anger)

title: Pixelator/Transcript
text:
Pixelator/Transcript - Intro
Hawk Moth: I sense brewing anger and frustration. Perfect fodder for my evil little akumas. It won't be long now. (turns a butterfly into an akuma) Fly away, my little akuma, and evilize him!
Hawk Moth: Pixelator, I am Hawk Moth. I'm giving you the power to capture your hero's smile, forever. But in return, you'll need to do some capturing for me as well.
Vincent: Yes, Hawk Moth. (turns into Pixelator)
Ms. Bustier: Mr. Bourgeois, you haven't told Marinette what job she'll be doing.
Mr. Bourgeois: (checks the list) Ah, yes. Of course, Marinette. Gopher. I've got a job for you already, Marinette.
Alya: Gopher? What's that?
Marinette: I'm guessing it's about as bad as trash duty.
Penny: Mr. Stone is going to need a new pair of shades for tonight's gig. Red, white and blue with two large Eiffel Towers on them. Can you get that for him?
Mr. Bourgeois: Of course we can! Marinette here is our gopher. She'll take care of that for you.
Marinette: Huh?
Mr. Bourgeois: A gopher is an employee who goes for anything a customer needs. Anything at all. So go ahead. Goph!
Marinette: These should do the trick. Now I can get back to the hotel and hang with Adrien! Ugh... And Chloé.

title: Pixelator/Transcript
text:
Pixelator/Transcript - Intro
Tikki: You know these aren't even close to what Mr. Stone wants.
Marinette: What do you mean, Tikki? There's some red and white on it, and two little Eiffel Towers.
Tikki: Just saying, it's better in a long run to do it right the first time.
''(A woman and her daughter spot Tikki.)
Tikki: Meow.
Jagged Stone: Where are the Eiffel Towers?
Marinette: Um... here.
Jagged Stone: This is a joke, right? What are you doing, trying to ruin my career?
Marinette: But, Mr. Stone, the glasses you want don't exist!
Jagged Stone: Do I look like I care? Just get me those sunglasses!
Marinette: Great. I'm gonna have to spend even more time away from Adrien!
Tikki: That's what I've been trying to tell you! Just do it right the first time.
Marinette: Yeah... You're right, Tikki. I get it now.
Tikki: Those sunglasses exist somewhere... Get creative!
Marinette: ...Of course! (Runs to the exit)
Chloé: Failed as a gopher already? Not surprised. Don't let the door hit you on the way out!
(Marinette exits the hotel. Pixelator goes into the hotel.)
Worker: Excuse me sir, can I help you?

title: Pixelator/Transcript
text:
Pixelator/Transcript - Intro
Pixelator: Look into the lens... (Kim and the worker smiled, and made V's in their hands as they do so. Pixelator zaps them and digitizes them) Photo finished.
Chloé: Oh, look what the cat dragged in. Let me handle this, Adrien. Watch and learn. (Goes to where Pixelator is) Excuse me... Excuse me! You can't be a guest at this hotel! My father only allows the most important celebrities. Like me.
(Adrien is mad at Chloé because she said that)
Pixelator: Well then, I am Pixelator. Your number one fan.
Chloé: Moi? Oh, my, you're flattering me. Keep going.
Pixelator: A photo of you, sweet miss...
Chloé: Chloé, of course.
Adrien: Look out, Chloé!
Pixelator: Look into the lens, miss!
(Adrien pushes Chloé, but the two get zapped by Pixelator and appear in white endless room)
Adrien: What the...
Chloé: What just happened?
Adrien: I think we've been like... digitized or something.
Chloé: What do you mean, digitized?
Adrien: I don't really know, but I don't think it's a good thing.
Chloé: Well, I can fix this. Leave it to me. (calls Mr. Bourgeois with her phone) Daddy?... Daddy??... DADDY?!
Marinette: Where did I put them... Oh! (gets an old pair of shades) Voila!
Tikki: But they're pink.

title: Pixelator/Transcript
text:
Pixelator/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: They won't be when I'm done with them. This is either gonna be the most amazing pair or the ugliest pair of shades in shades history. Ms. Bustier is grading me on effort, right?
Tikki: Don't worry, I'm sure Jagged Stone will love them!
(Marinette takes the lens out of the shades)
Tikki: Or hate them.
(Meanwhile, Adrien and Chloé are still stuck in a blank space)
Chloé: Ugh! I still can't get through to Daddy! How can there be no cell reception here? Ridiculous!
Adrien: It just goes on forever. No doors, no walls, no nothing...
Chloé: You mean we're stuck here? Just... (getting soft) just the two of us?
Adrien: Uh, no. There's gotta be a way out somewhere. (Sees Chloé hugging him) I hope...
Marinette: Adrien? Chloé? Ughh! I bet those two have gone off together somewhere fun! Hmph! And now I'm here all alone without Adrien...
Tikki: Marinette, snap out of it, let's just focus on getting Mr. Stone's glasses for now, okay?
Pixelator: Jagged Stone?
Alec: What?
Pixelator: (opens the door) Look into the lens!
Penny: I'll get them to Mr. Stone.
Marinette: Can't you deliver them to him now?
Penny: He's... resting.

title: Pixelator/Transcript
text:
Pixelator/Transcript - Intro
Jagged Stone: Now who likes having his belly scratched? Daddy's little Fang!
Marinette: Okay, no problem. Just trying to do the job right the second time.
Penny: Got it.
Marinette: Thank you...
(Pixelator knocks the door)
Marinette: I hope Mr. Stone likes them.
Tikki: Hard work always pays off.
Penny: Who are you?
Pixelator: Look into the lens! (zaps her)
Marinette: (Sees Pixelator, and goes into the elevator) Time to transform!
[ Transformation Sequence ]Marinette: Tikki, spots on! Ah! (Marinette transforms into Ladybug)
Pixelator: Hey there! Time for your photoshoot!
Jagged Stone: How did you get in here? I don't know about any photos. Fang, attack! (Fang rolls over)
Pixelator: See you later, alligator. (Zaps Fang)
Jagged Stone: What? Fang? Fang! Who are you?
Pixelator: I am Pixelator, your biggest fan, Mr. Stone. Can I call you Jagged?
Jagged Stone: No!
Pixelator: I want to immortalize you, Jagged! I'll be your one and only fan! You will belong to me for eternity! Now, look into the lens.
(Pixelator is about to zap him, but Ladybug saves him)
Pixelator: So, you're Ladybug. I've heard such pathetic things about you. Look into the lens!

title: Pixelator/Transcript
text:
Pixelator/Transcript - Intro
(Pixelator zaps Ladybug, but she dodges. Ladybug grabs a flower vase with her yo-yo, and throws it at Pixelator, but he dodges them. Jagged Stone hides under a table. Pixelator keeps zapping Ladybug. Her right arm gets zapped and digitized. She manages to get Jagged Stone out of the hotel)
Pixelator: Ugh! Where did they go?!
Hawk Moth: If you want Jagged, you must find Ladybug.
Pixelator: I don't have time to deal with this Ladybug!
Hawk Moth: Yes, you do. Plenty of time! (Starts controlling Pixelator)
Pixelator: Okay, okay! Tell me what to do.
Hawk Moth: I demand an excellent photograph of Ladybug with her Miraculous. I want those powers! So listen very carefully.
Jagged Stone: I can't stay here. I'm performing tonight.
Ladybug: Don't worry, you'll get to do your gig. You'll even get to wear some awesome shades!
Jagged Stone: Uh?
Ladybug: (giggles) Look. While I'm catching this guy, Pixelator, I need you to stay put where no one would think to look for you.
Denis Damoclès: Hm. Ladybug, is this safe? This is a school.
Ladybug: Yes! Pixelator would never imagine his idol would actually want a day out at school.
Denis Damoclès: Hmm?
Ladybug: I mean, isn't school awesome?

title: Pixelator/Transcript
text:
Pixelator/Transcript - Intro
Jagged Stone: This is ridiculous. I don't have time for this. First, I get practically hijacked by this crazed fan, and then, I'm attacked by some super weirdo, then...
Ladybug: Wait. What do you know about this crazed fan?
Jagged Stone: He's come to every one of my shows this year. He's also sent me stacks of letters, gone through my trash, he even followed my mother to her weekly bingo night!
Ladybug: How creepy.
Jagged Stone: Uh, not really, it's just a bunch of elderly ladies getting together having fun.
Ladybug: (Uses her yo-yo as a phone to find Vincent’s number. She finds it difficult, her arm being digitized. So she types with her nose and chin) Vincent... Asa. (The phone finds him) Got his address.
Jagged Stone: You're not gonna leave me here, are you?
Denis Damoclès: Hmm?
Jagged Stone: I mean, isn't school awesome?
Chloé: Daddy! Daddy!
Adrien: Plagg, I gotta find some way to transform.
Plagg: Come on, what's the rush?
(Adrien looks at him angrily)
Plagg: Fine. If you insist, at least find me some cheese.
Adrien: (goes back to Chloé) I'm gonna see if there's a way out down there. Don't go anywhere. Could be dangerous.
Chloé: Dangerous?
Adrien: You're not scared, are you?

title: Pixelator/Transcript
text:
Pixelator/Transcript - Intro
Chloé: Scared, moi? As if! No way!
(Adrien chuckles and runs to find a way out by leaving Chloé behind. Suddenly, she screams and jumps on his head; she points at a newly pixelated Fang. Adrien is also scared by the alligator)
Hawk Moth: Ah, the Champs-Élysées. Perfect. May the photoshoot begin.
(Pixelator starts zapping people until he sees someone snapping pictures of him)
Pixelator: Amateur. (zaps him)
Ladybug: Oh, this isn't creepy at all. (Suddenly, she stops and sees photos of people who look familiar) What? (She sees Chloé and Adrien; the former screams in terror)
Adrien: Ladybug?
Ladybug: What are you two doing in there?
Chloé: Ladybug! Remember me? Your biggest fan? Please, please get us out of here. It's terrible in here! (Chloe is holding Adrien's arm while he sighs and chuckles a little) I mean, it's only terrible when you're not around.
Théo: Over here, Ladybug!
Mireille: Help... Ladybug... help!
Ladybug: What happened to you?
Théo: It's terrible, this man, he... took a photo of us and we ended up trapped in here!
Mireille: While we were just innocently strolling the Champs-Élysées!
Ladybug: I sure hope Cat Noir's there already! (leaves)

title: Pixelator/Transcript
text:
Pixelator/Transcript - Intro
Nadja: (nervously) Excuse me, sir. Sir? Care for an interview with the reporter who spreads the villains' voice? (Pixelator smiles deviously)
Pixelator: I will continue my photoshoot until Jagged Stone turns up here in the flesh! Where are you, Jagged? Your biggest fan awaits you! All I want is one photo! Otherwise, soon, the people of Paris will be nothing but memories. (zaps Nadja and the cameraman and laughs evilly as he zaps the cameraman, too.)
Denis Damoclès: This is terrible!
Jagged Stone: I've got to do what Pixelator says!
Denis Damoclès: Surely, you can't be serious! It's dangerous out there!
Jagged Stone: (chuckles) Who cares about danger? Jagged Stone can turn down a television appearance! Just imagine what it would do for my career!
Ladybug: Got an itchy trigger finger, eh? (The police and other civilians cheer)
Pixelator: I was expecting you, Ladybug.
(Starts zapping her, but she dodges. She hides under a car, but Pixelator finds her)
Pixelator: Look into the lens!
(Pixelator still zaps her, but she dodges. She runs away from the zaps. She sees a lamppost, and she tries to grab it with her yo-yo, but she falls. Pixelator has her cornered)

title: Pixelator/Transcript
text:
Pixelator/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: I-I have a proposition to make! If you free those innocent people, I'll organize a photoshoot with Jagged Stone!
Hawk Moth: (from his lair) No! Don't listen to her! She's trying to trick you!
Pixelator: Why should I believe you, Ladybug?
Ladybug: Because you have no choice. I'm the only one who knows where Jagged is.
Pixelator: How about I free half of them now and the other half after the photoshoot. Deal?
Ladybug: 'Kay. It's a deal. (to herself) Yeah, right.
(Pixelator starts freeing people, including Adrien and Chloé, who end up in the Hotel. Nino is reading his Math book, and he sees them and nearly falls over on his seat)
Nino: Wow. Dudes! You scared me!
Adrien: (sees the TV) Fill in for me, will you Nino?
Nino: What do you think I've been doing this whole time?!
(Fang appears in a room. Sabrina sees him and squeals and faints in fear)
Plagg: If you want my opinion, I think someone's been akumatized.
Adrien: I think you're right. But where's the akuma?
[Transformation Sequence]Adrien: Plagg, claws out! (Adrien transforms into Cat Noir)
Pixelator: I've kept my part of the deal, Ladybug, now bring me Jagged Stone!

title: Pixelator/Transcript
text:
Pixelator/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: (spots Cat Noir) Pixelator, I know your akuma's inside your glasses!
Pixelator: Stop wasting time!(Cat Noir is about to take his glasses off, but a civilian spots him.)
Civilian: Yeah, go Cat Noir!
(Pixelator sees Cat Noir and fights him. Pixelator throws him off)
Ladybug: Thanks for dropping in.
Cat Noir: Not very handy, I see.
Pixelator: What about our deal?
Hawk Moth: I told you she would betray you. Capture them already! I want their Miraculous!!
(Pixelator starts zapping them, but they dodge the zaps)
Ladybug: Together!
(Ladybug attacks Pixelator with her yo-yo, but fails. Cat Noir is about to fight him with his staff, but Pixelator zaps him)
Cat Noir: (in the white space) Ahh! Oh, not again...
Pixelator: When the cat's away, the mice will play. Ready to become immortalized?
Ladybug: Can't wait to live it up.
(Ladybug dodges Pixelator's zaps. But she trips and falls. Then she jumps into a purple car and does a high jump, but falls because one of the villain's shot zapped her right leg too. Pixelator approaches her.)
Pixelator: Look into the lens!
Jagged Stone: Hey there, Pixelator! I've heard you wanted my photo!
Pixelator: Jagged! It's about time you showed up.

title: Pixelator/Transcript
text:
Pixelator/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: Get out of here, Mr. Stone! (tries to follow him, but falls)
Jagged Stone: It's me you wanted all this time, right? Well, here I am, in the flesh.
Pixelator: Look into the lens...
Jagged Stone: Wait, wrong side. This isn't my best angle. No, no, wait. The lighting's all wrong. Does my nose look shorter this way? Oh, I know, this is better.
Pixelator: Ugh... Hurry up already!
Ladybug: (activates her power up sequence) Lucky Charm! (a powder compact appears) A powder compact?
Jagged Stone: There, I think I'm ready.
Pixelator: No more moving! Look into the lens!
Ladybug: Don't do it, Mr. Stone!
Cat Noir: (activates his power up sequence) Cataclysm! (uses his Cataclysm to make a crack in the white space, freeing the people trapped in the photos) Yes!
Pixelator: Come on, open your eyes.
(Ladybug sees Cat Noir, uses her Lucky Vision and Cat Noir, his staff and the powder compact glows)
Ladybug: Batter up! (throws the compact)
(Cat Noir hits the compact with his staff, and it reflects Pixelator's beam, zapping him and leaving the akumatized object behind.)
Pixelator: (in the white space) What? How did...? Huh?

title: Pixelator/Transcript
text:
Pixelator/Transcript - Intro
Hawk Moth: (from his lair) Next time, I assure you it won't be a photo finish. I won't stop, Ladybug! I'll destroy you!
Ladybug: Miraculous Ladybug! (throws the Lucky Charm into the air, turning everything back to normal. She crushes Pixelator's visor, freeing the akuma) No more evil doing for you, little akuma. Time to de-evilize! (catches the akuma with her yo-yo) Gotcha! (releases a purified butterfly) Bye bye, little butterfly.
(Pixelator is brought back and turned back into Vincent)
Vincent: Huh? What happened? Where am I?
Ladybug & Cat Noir: Pound it!
Ms. Bustier: Thank you very much for this work experience day, Mr. Bourgeois. I'm sure we'll all remember it for a long time to come.
Mr. Bourgeois: So will I. Oh, wait, I almost forgot. Jagged Stone's giving a concert tonight, so, I'm giving tickets to the students who demonstrated the greatest effort today.
(Penny gives tickets to Marinette, Alya, Adrien and Nino, but passes by Chloé)
Chloé: (furious) Ridiculous! Utterly ridiculous!
Jagged Stone: Good evening, Paris! (everyone cheers and makes loud noises)
Adrien: (to Marinette) It's my first live concert, ever! It's amazing!
Marinette: (grins) Yeah, amazing!

title: Pixelator/Transcript
text:
Pixelator/Transcript - Intro
Jagged Stone: I'd like to dedicate this song to the girl who saved my life. This one's for you, Ladybug.
(Jagged Stone plays the song that's dedicated to Ladybug which makes Marinette surprised)

title: Piáo Chóng
text:
Piáo Chóng - Intro
was a Miraculous holder who is featured in the Grimoire for the Ladybug Miraculous. When Tikki inhabited the Ladybug Miraculous, she transformed into a ladybug-themed superhero.

title: Piáo Chóng
text:
Piáo Chóng - Appearance
Physical appearance
As depicted in the Miraculous spellbook, she had long dark blueish-black hair, putting most of it back into a raised bun with fair white skin.
As Piáo Chóng
Piáo Chóng wore a long tied red bandana with eyes holes and black spots over her upper face, a black-spotted and red tunic with short, dark gray-edged sleeves, and black-spotted and red trousers that ended a little below her knees. Additionally, she wore dark gray wristbands and shoes.
As shown in her aquatic upgrade, she had her hair inside her circular hat with a ladybug pattern. She wore her usual superhero suit, but gained black flippers attached on her feet.

title: Piáo Chóng
text:
Piáo Chóng - Personality
Not much is known about her except from Alix during her travels that Piáo Chóng is very wise.

title: Piáo Chóng
text:
Piáo Chóng - Abilities
As Piáo Chóng
If this past Ladybug had the same powers of the current Ladybug, she had enhanced physical abilities and the superpowers Lucky Charm and Miraculous Piáo Chóng. She also used the yo-yo, as seen in the book illustration.
In Aqua Form
Piáo Chóng had access to aqua powers such as the ability to breathe underwater and enhanced swimming capabilities due to the flippers on her feet, as seen in the aqua power up illustrated in the spellbook.

title: Piáo Chóng
text:
Piáo Chóng - Trivia
Piáo chóng (瓢蟲) means "ladybug" in Chinese.
Before her name was revealed, she was referred to as Jiĕ Jie or Jiĕjie (姐姐, elder sister), Feri González's nickname for her.
She is the earliest known Ladybug Miraculous holder.
She is the first known person of Chinese origin to wield the Ladybug Miraculous, preceding her successor Marinette Dupain-Cheng.

title: Place de la Concorde
text:
Place de la Concorde - Intro
is one of the major public squares in Paris, France. Measuring 8.64 hectares (21.3 acres) in area, it is the largest square in the French capital. It is located in the city's eighth arrondissement, at the eastern end of the Champs-Élysées. It was the site of many notable public executions of royalty during the French Revolution.

title: Place de la Concorde
text:
Place de la Concorde - Description
The Place de la Concorde is a monumental octagonal square that connects the Champs-Élysées to the northwest, the Jardin des Tuileries to the southeast, the Church of the Madeleine to the north from the rue Royale, and the Pont de la Concorde to the south leading to the Palais Bourbon, the building that houses the French National Assembly.
Also around the square are notable buildings, such as the Hôtel de la Marine, the Hôtel de Crillon or the Hôtel de Coislin.
The entrances to the Champs-Élysées and the Tuileries each feature groups of statues, the originals of which can be seen at the Louvre Museum: La Renown Riding Pegasus and Mercury riding Pegasus at the Tuileries, and the "Horses of Marly" on the Champs-Élysées side.

title: Place de la Concorde
text:
Place de la Concorde - Description
The square itself is composed of several medians, on which we find at each corner of the octagon of the square a statue representing a city of France: Brest and Rouen at the northwest corner; Lille and Strasbourg at the northeast corner; Lyon and Marseille at the southeast corner; Bordeaux and Nantes at the southwest corner. There are also many lampposts built on pedestals and consisting of a first decorated facade, on each side, two prows of boats surmounted by lights, a second fluted facade, and finally a mixed capital with four masks surmounted by a lighthouse-like cover.
Finally, the central plot is composed of fountains at both ends, the "Fountain of the Seas" on the south side and the "Fountain of the Rivers" on the north side, but above all the famous Obélisque de Louxor.
Depending on the time of year, the Roue de Paris also settles in the square.

title: Place de la Concorde
text:
Place de la Concorde - Trivia
Over the course of its history, the square has had several names:
Place Louis XV (from 1763 to 1792; from 1814 to 1826; from 1828 to 1830).
Place de la Révolution (from 1792 to 1795).
Place de la Concorde (from 1795 to 1814; from 1830 to the present).
Place Louis XVI (from 1826 to 1828).
Place de la Charte (in 1830).
During the French Revolution and the Terror, many personalities were guillotined there. We can mention in particular:
Louis XVI, King of France and Navarre, King of the French, January 21, 1793.

title: Place de la Sorbonne
text:
Place de la Sorbonne - Intro
is a square created in 1639 and located in the Sorbonne district in the 5th arrondissement of Paris. It owes its name to the Sorbonne.

title: Place de la Sorbonne
text:
Place de la Sorbonne - Description
The Place de la Sorbonne is a square seventy-two meters long and thirty-five meters wide. There are many trees offering plenty of shade and pond fountains in its eastern part, all of which provide a place of tranquility for visitors.
The square is surrounded by many buildings. We can notice in particular that these are restaurants or bookstores. There is also Le Sorbonne, a cinema very popular with Parisians.
In this square there is also the "Monument to Auguste Compte", a statuary group sculpted by Jean-Antoine Injalbert and inaugurated in 1902. This monument features a bust of Auguste Compte (1798 - 1857), famous French philosopher, which dominates two allegories . To her left we find "The Virgin Carrying the Child", based on the character of Chlothilde de Vaux. This standing woman is holding a baby in her arms. On the right we find "The Worker", an allegory of the proletariat called to learn. She is represented by a seated young man.
This square also allows an unobstructed view of the Sorbonne, the university that gave it its name, particularly on its dome of the Sainte Ursule Chapel.

title: Place de la Sorbonne
text:
Place de la Sorbonne - Trivia
Throughout its history, the square has had several names:
Rue Neuve-de-Richelieu (from 1639 to the Revolution)
Place Chalier (during the Revolution)
Petite rue Chalier

title: Place du Châtelet
text:
Place du Châtelet - Intro
is one of the public squares in Paris, France. It contains the Fontaine du Palmier, the Théâtre du Châtelet and the Théâtre de la Ville.

title: Place du Châtelet
text:
Place du Châtelet - Description
The Place du Châtelet is a rectangular square about sixty meters wide, located in the heart of Paris. To the north is the intersection of Avenue Victoria with Boulevard de Sébastopol and Rue de Saint Denis. To the south is the intersection of the Quai de Gesvres and the Quai de la Mégisserie, overlooking the Pont au Change.
The square has a rounded square central traffic divider on which there are many trees, benches and a Morris column. To the east there is a bus stop, while to the north there is access to the Châtelet metro station. The Fontaine du Palmier is right in the center of the square.
The Place du Châtelet is surrounded by many buildings. To the west is the Théâtre du Châtelet, to the east is the Le Grand Paris hotel and to the north is the Agreste mansion.

title: Place du Châtelet
text:
Place du Châtelet - Trivia
In the series, the hotel Le Grand Paris is located on the site of the Théâtre de la Ville.
Also in the series, the Agreste mansion is located on the site of the Haussmannian building that houses the Chamber of Notaries of Paris.

title: Place Charles de Gaulle
text:
Place Charles de Gaulle - Intro
, originally called Place de l'Étoile, is one of the largest squares in Paris, so called since 1970 when it was renamed in honor of the French general and president Charles de Gaulle.

title: Place Charles de Gaulle
text:
Place Charles de Gaulle - Description
Built in 1670, the square has a diameter of 241 meters for a surface area of 4.55 hectares. Divided between the 8th, 16th and 17th arrondissements of Paris, twelve large avenues of the capital emerge from it, including the famous Avenue des Champs-Élysées. These twelve avenues form six main axes, including the avenue des Champs-Élysées and avenue de la Grande-Armée, forming part of the Historical axis of Paris (Defense - Louvre Palace).
The square is best known for its central reserve on which the famous Arc de Triomphe was erected. The square itself has a pavement composed entirely of gray cobblestones, thus forming a roundabout in the Arc de Triomphe is the center.
Each end between two avenues is formed by a wooded island. There are sometimes Morris columns, bus stops, but also mouths of the Charles-de-Gaulle Étoiles station of the metro.

title: Place Charles de Gaulle
text:
Place Charles de Gaulle - Trivia
Until 1970 the name of the square was Place l'Etoile.
This name referred to the configuration of the square and the avenues that converged on it, thus forming a sort of star around the square.
Charles de Gaulle (1890-1970) was an important man in the history of France. Leader of the Free French during the Second World War, President of France and founder of the Fifth Republic.
The square was renamed in memory of him after his death on 9 November 1970 in Colombey-les-Deux-Églises.

title: Place de Varsovie
text:
Place de Varsovie - Description
Named in 1928 in homage to the capital of Poland, the Place de Varsovie is a square for car and pedestrian traffic 120 meters long and 90 meters wide.
It is located at the crossroads of the Avenue de New-York, the Avenue des Nations unies and the Pont d'Iéna. It borders the Jardins du Trocadéro and the Fontaine du Trocadéro. There are traffic signs, traffic lights, street lights and a bus stop.

title: Place du Trocadéro-et-du-11-Novembre
text:
Place du Trocadéro-et-du-11-Novembre - Intro
The , or simply Place du Trocadéro, is a square in the 16th arrondissement of Paris.

title: Place du Trocadéro-et-du-11-Novembre
text:
Place du Trocadéro-et-du-11-Novembre - Description
Built in 1869, the Place du Trocadéro is a semicircular square with a length of 164 meters. It is located at the crossroads of avenue du Président-Wilson, avenue Kléber, avenue Raymond-Poincaré, avenue d'Eylau, avenue Georges-Mandel and avenue Paul-Doumer.
It has a central embankment adorned with trees and benches, a Morris column, but above all an equestrian statute facing the Eiffel Tower.
This square opens onto the Parvis des droits de l'homme of the Palais de Chaillot. It is in particular from this square that we find the entrances to the cultural places of the Palace. Near the Palais de Chaillot, you can see an entrance to the metro of the Trocadéro station.

title: Place du Trocadéro-et-du-11-Novembre
text:
Place du Trocadéro-et-du-11-Novembre - Trivia
Throughout its history the square has had various names:
Place du Roi-de-Rome (1869-1877)
Place du Trocadero (1877-1978)
The square was named in homage to the Battle of the Trocadero, consecrating the victory of a French expeditionary force over the Spanish liberal revolutionaries in Cadiz in Spain.
In 1978, by municipal decree of 18 October 1978, it took the name of "Place du Trocadéro-et-du-11-Novembre".
November 11th corresponds to the commemoration of November 11th 1918, the date of the armistice of the First World War.
In reality, the equestrian statue is an equestrian statue of Ferdinand Foch, located in perfect symmetry with another statue of Marshal Foch located in front of the École militaire, from the south-east side of the Champ de Mars.

title: Place du Carrousel
text:
Place du Carrousel - Intro
is a square in Paris located near the Louvre Palace.

title: Place du Carrousel
text:
Place du Carrousel - Description
Dug in 1662, the Place du Carrousel is a square located in the 1st arrondissement of Paris. It is bordered to the north and south by the Denon and Richelieu wings of the Louvre Palace, to the east by the Cour Napoléon and the Louvre Pyramid, and to the west by the Arc de Triomphe du Carrousel and its garden which opens onto the Jardin des Tuileries and the historic axis of Paris.
The square itself consists of two wide lanes separated by several embankments, the main one forming a circle bordered by perfectly pruned square-shaped bushes. At the center of this platform is a large square window which is the base of the inverted pyramid inside the Carrousel du Louvre.
The Place du Carrousel has several street lamps and bus stops.

title: Place du Carrousel
text:
Place du Carrousel - Trivia
The square owes its name to the reason for its creation, namely the holding of a joust, an equestrian show during which the knights perform tricks, and to music.
During the revolutionary period, the square was renamed Place de la Fraternité.
In the series, the Place du Carrousel is important on several occasions:

In "The Mime", Ladybug briefly faced the eponymous villain there in the square.
It is in the square in particular that Ladybug saved the occupants of the Agreste car, with a long exchange of glances with Adrien.
In "Timetagger", the fight between Ladybug, Cat Noir and Bunnyx against the eponymous villain from the future took place there.

title: Place Raoul-Dautry
text:
Place Raoul-Dautry - Description
Place Raoul-Dautry is a square in the 15th arrondissement of Paris created in 1965 during the reconstruction of the Gare Montparnasse. It is located at the intersection of Boulevard Vaugirard and Avenue du Maine, and Rue du Départ and Rue de l'Arrivée lead there.
Covering Avenue du Maine, this square is located between the Gare Montparnasse and the Tour Montparnasse for which it serves as a square. It has several flowerbeds planted with grass and various trees, as well as a large exposed esplanade between the two buildings.
On the Boulevard Vaugirard side, the square has several bus stops to allow passengers to get off there.

Raoul Dautry (1880-1951) was a French engineer, public company manager and politician.

is a square located in the 10th arrondissement of Paris.

title: Place Napoléon-III
text:
Place Napoléon-III - Description
Dug in 1845, Place Napoléon-III is located at the intersection of Rue de Dunkerque, Rue de Compiègne, Boulevard de Dénain, and then Rue de Saint-Ouen. Forming the forecourt of the Gare du Nord, the square has two lanes of traffic with parking spaces and is separated by a central reservation planted with potted trees.
Right in front of the Gare du Nord entrance, there is a small roundabout with a large circular grille that hides the Métro's ventilation system.
The forecourt itself resembles a fairly wide sidewalk, home to several bus stops. At the end of Boulevard de Dénain, there are two metro entrances.

title: Place Napoléon-III

The square has been named since January 9, 1987, in honor of Napoleon III, former French head of state, first President of the French Republic and then Emperor of the French.

Place de Roubaix (1845-1987)
Place de Napoléon (from 1987 to the present).
