title: Plagg (webisode)/Transcript
text:
Plagg (webisode)/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: Hi guys! It's me, Adrien. And that's my kwami, Plagg. My life hasn't been the same since I met him.
When Mom disappeared, Father changed. He wouldn't leave the house. I didn't have many friends, except Chloé. (Gabriel activates the defense system) Then all of a sudden, I wasn't allowed to go to her place, or anywhere else without my bodyguard.
Gabriel: Everything you need is right here, where I can keep an eye on you. I will not have you outside in that dangerous world.
Adrien: And then, Plagg showed up.
Plagg: I'm Plagg, nice to meet you.
Adrien: And thanks to him, I became Cat Noir.
Plagg: Claws out, that's how you transform.
Adrien: Got it!
[Transformation Sequence]Adrien: Plagg, claws out! (Adrien transforms into Cat Noir)
Adrien: Cat Noir can go wherever he wants, whenever he wants.
Cat Noir: Can I hitch a ride?
Adrien: And he gets to fight supervillains with the strong, the incredible, the miraculous, Ladybug.
Ladybug: Not a chance kitty.

title: Plagg (webisode)/Transcript
text:
Plagg (webisode)/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: Plagg goes everywhere with me. School, fencing classes, photoshoots. We can't be separated for long, in case I need to transform. And that's the problem, you see, Plagg is kind of a special kwami. He's out of control, arrogant-
Adrien: ...way! you're like the Genie in the Lamp!
Plagg: I met him once. So he grants wishes, big deal! I'm way more personable.
Adrien: He even pretended that he caused the extinction of the dinosaurs! And most importantly, he's completely obsessed with cheese! The smellier the better, if you ask Plagg. His guilty pleasure is camembert, he'd do anything for camembert. Also, he's super lazy. Every time we have to go on a mission, it's the same. It's the only time I get to be myself, meet Ladybug, and save Paris with her! But Plagg always comes up with an excuse not to move a muscle.
Adrien: We got to transform now, Plagg.
Plagg: I thought I was going to be a spectator, not a performer.
Adrien: If I listened to him, we'd spent our days eating camembert and watching TV. But in spite of his flaws, I'm glad to have him in my life. Plagg is always here when things get tough.
Plagg: You okay?

title: Plagg (webisode)/Transcript
text:
Plagg (webisode)/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: He's the only one I can tell about my double life or talk to about Ladybug.
Plagg: How can you possibly be in love with Ladybug? You don't even know who she really is!
Adrien: He loves teasing me about it. Deep down, I know he's right. Ladybug and I must keep our identities secret, it's part of being a superhero. But a boy can dream, right? Anyway, I don't know why  was chosen to become Cat Noir, or why Plagg came to me. But I can't picture my life without him anymore. He's allowing me to live my life to the fullest, all nine of them!
Plagg: Come on, let's have a little fun while your father's away!
Adrien: Alright, I'm going to try to find a nice piece of camembert for him. I think his birthday is coming soon. I wonder what a kwami's birthday looks like. Don't worry, I'll tell you all about it. See you later!

title: Pollen/History
text:
Pollen/History - Intro
Pollen is the kwami connected to the Bee Miraculous. Formerly, she allowed Chloé Bourgeois to transform into Queen Bee. Currently, she lets Zoé Lee transform into Vesperia.

title: Pollen/History
text:
Pollen/History - Before [[season 1]]
When the concept of Action came into existence, Pollen came into existence. Before the Miraculous jewels were created, Pollen and the other kwamis traveled all over the universe unable to interact with humans. Then, thousands of years ago, a mage created the Miraculouses. Pollen started out with Mìfēng in China. When her Miraculous was not being worn, Pollen was dormant in the Bee Miraculous, which was stored inside the Miracle Box.

title: Pollen/History
text:
Pollen/History - Season 1
During season 1, Pollen was dormant in the Bee Miraculous.

title: Pollen/History
text:
Pollen/History - [[Season 2]]
During season 2, Pollen was dormant in the Bee Miraculous.
In "Style Queen", Pollen was still dormant inside the Bee Miraculous and was intended to be given to Alya Césaire by Ladybug. But before she and her Miraculous could be activated, Ladybug was attacked by Style Queen, causing her to drop it. As the Miraculous Ladybugs did not return the Bee Miraculous to Ladybug, Pollen was found by Chloé Bourgeois and once activated, she greeted her wielder.
In "Queen Wasp", Chloé, in an attempt to impress her mother, activated the Bee Miraculous in front of everyone and commanded Pollen to transform her into Queen Bee. After being exposed as an irresponsible hero and humiliated by her own mother, Queen Bee is akumatized, with the Akuma possessing the Bee Miraculous while Pollen was still charging it. After the akuma was taken out by Cat Noir's Cataclysm, the Bee Miraculous was momentarily destroyed but then restored by Ladybug's Miraculous Ladybug with Pollen dormant inside. Chloé then returned the Bee Miraculous to Ladybug.

title: Pollen/History
text:
Pollen/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Malediktator", Pollen was delighted to meet Chloé again and helped her transform into Queen Bee. With Ladybug, Cat Noir, and her Venom power, the trio was able to stop the villain. After Malediktator's defeat, Pollen went dormant inside the Bee Miraculous once again and was returned to Ladybug and then to Master Fu.
In "Sandboy", Pollen was celebrating Nooroo's birthday inside the Miracle Box with the other kwamis and was excited when Tikki and Plagg arrived. She formally greeted Tikki and Plagg and marveled at the gift Tikki brought and played with the other kwamis. When the time came to contact Nooroo, Pollen got into position with the other kwamis but they ended up contacting his wielder instead. Upon hearing Hawk Moth's voice, she shuddered at the thought of being his slave and to prevent their location from being discovered by him, all the kwamis cut off the connection. However, she and the other kwamis realized that if they contacted Nooroo's wielder, then someone must have been akumatized and that Tikki's and Plagg's wielders were in danger.

title: Pollen/History
text:
Pollen/History - [[Season 2]]
During "Catalyst", when Scarlet Moth unleashed an army of akumatized villains on the city, Pollen and her Miraculous were retrieved by Ladybug and given to Cat Noir, who passed it onto Chloé to transform into Queen Bee.

title: Pollen/History
text:
Pollen/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Miraculer", Pollen was briefly activated to transform Chloé into Queen Bee in order to stop Mayura.
In "Kwamibuster", she was activated along with her kwami brothers and sisters to help Multimouse enact her plan of rescuing Tikki and Plagg. During the confrontation, Pollen was one of the few kwamis captured but was actually part of the plan, as she unveiled another Multimouse and was set free with the help of Multinoire. After Kwamibuster's defeat, Pollen and others cheered for Marinette as their plan was a success and was returned to the Miracle Box.
In "Heart Hunter", upon meeting Chloé again, Pollen was shocked that she was siding with Hawk Moth and tried convincing her not to do this but silenced by her wielder and transformed her into Queen Bee.
In "Miracle Queen", after Chloé was deakumatized as the titular villain and upon having the Bee Miraculous taken off her and Chloé detransformed. Then, she heard her former wielder say that she will no longer be a fan of Ladybug's and rant on about wanting to leave for New York as well as watching her running away. Afterwards, Pollen and her Miraculous were returned to the Miracle Box.

title: Pollen/History
text:
Pollen/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Truth", Pollen was accidentally released from the Miracle Box when Marinette tried to figure it, she explored Marinette's room. During a video call, Pollen and her siblings surrounded her computer in amazement. When Marinette left for her date with Luka, she and her siblings hid with the Miracle Box, but they heard the titular villain broke into Marinette's room. After the titular villain's defeat, Pollen and the others saw that Marinette was sad about breaking up with Luka to the point of tears, she didn't know exactly how to help but joined with her siblings in giving their new guardian a group hug.
In "Gang of Secrets", she was seen talking with some of her siblings until Marinette arrives home. Later, she and the others hear Marinette voiced her distress about being condemned to a life of secrets and lies forever because of her alter ego. When they hear someone coming, the kwamis hide in the Miracle Box and after the Gang of Secrets had been defeated, Pollen and the others look on as Marinette unveils her secret to Alya.

title: Pollen/History
text:
Pollen/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Furious Fu", hearing that Master Fu was returning to Paris, Pollen along with her siblings expressed dear desire to see him despite Marinette trying to keep them hidden for their safety and when Marinette voiced concerns about leaving the Miracle Box unguarded. Pollen realized if someone stayed to guard the box, the others could go but when they cheated their way out so all of them can go, they were stopped by Marinette with no choice they used the "puppy dog eyes" on her and Marinette reluctantly agreed. However, Pollen and her siblings had a hard time keeping quiet while in Marinette's bag but heard that Master Fu is doing well and become a great painter.
But returning home, she realized that Su-Han had returned to reclaim the box as he was the previous guardian before Master Fu's incident and with Su-Han's strictness, she and her siblings sadly returned to the box. After seeing Ladybug's valiant actions against the titular villain, Su-Han realized that Master Fu's choice wasn't so bad, allowing Pollen and her siblings to stay with Marinette.

title: Pollen/History
text:
Pollen/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Queen Banana", when Zoé Lee accepted the Bee Miraculous, Pollen greeted and helped her transform into Vesperia. With Venom, they were able to paralyze Banana Boom-Boom and deakumatized Chloé former owner. Afterwards, Pollen and Zoé detransformed and her Miraculous was then returned to Ladybug.
In "Mega Leech", Pollen was seen sleeping on the shelf above Marinette's bed along with Stompp and Wayzz. Then, when Malediktator returned but was aided by the titular sentimonster, she was one of the few kwamis sent out to stop it.
In "Optigami", she saw Alya coming into Marinette's room through Kaalki's portal and was informed that her and Trixx's powers were needed for Ladybug's plan. Then, she fused her powers with Tikki's turning Ladybug into Lady Bee and defeated the titular villain. After defeating both of Shadow Moth's plans, Pollen heard her guardian give Alya the permission to keep Trixx.
In "Sentibubbler", along with her siblings, Pollen is woken up after Marinette had a nightmare leading to her starting to doubt in her choice of giving Alya the Fox Miraculous.

title: Pollen/History
text:
Pollen/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Hack-San", after Tom went back downstairs, Pollen came out of hiding aware that Marinette was leaving with her family for London for the weekend and when she heard a commotion downstairs about Marinette spraining her ankle in an attempt to stay home as her guardian couldn't leave the city unguarded but was informed by Longg that it won't work when the parents of superheroes want to go on vacation.
In "Wishmaker", hearing Marinette mention of careers, Pollen curiously asked what one was and after Marinette's explanation, she and the other kwamis voiced ideas on what she could do in life until Sass silenced them asking Marinette himself what she wanted to do; then saw her leave for the career expo.
In "Simpleman", Pollen felt very dizzy when Manon, Ella and Etta shook the sewing box.

title: Pollen/History
text:
Pollen/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Dearest Family", after Tikki ate the pieces of galette, Marinette brought for them, the kwamis quickly realized what she did. Pollen huddled together with the others when they realized the danger Tikki's hunger for candy represented, despite the kwami of Creation's refusal at that. When Tikki and Marinette left, the kwamis flew around in a panic. Shortly after, she watched Marinette realize that Sass warning was real and transformed to stop Tikki only to be affected by her hunger, which scared her.
Hearing a commotion downstairs, Pollen and the others were commanded to hide. After Ladybug saved her family, Pollen and the kwamis see her return with pieces of galette for them. Despite that they were still nervous regarding Tikki, until Marinette ensured them that Tikki will control herself and the kwamis ate the pieces of galette happily.

title: Pollen/History
text:
Pollen/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Ephemeral", during the fight against Moolak, Pollen and her Miraculous were given to Zoé and transformed into Vesperia to paralyze the villain. After the battle, Pollen and her jewel were returned to Ladybug. Later, they briefly met Sass owner Luka when he came into Marinette's room, but their introductions were cut short when Luka explains he received a message from Ladybug showing the Lucky Charm and allowing Sass to use his power to go back to the last marked time.
Soon Pollen discovered why as she and everyone noticed the Absolute Power being activated meaning Shadow Moth obtained the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses and started his wish. After Sass explained to Luka the consequences of it, the latter hurried the former to use his power, which he does causing them to forget their encounter with Luka.
In "Kuro Neko", during the fight against Gigantitan, Pollen and her Miraculous were given to Zoé to become Vesperia again. Later, Pollen and the other kwamis tried to comfort Marinette after Cat Noir gave up on his Miraculous and was surprised to learn that she intended to replace him with someone who doesn't love her.

title: Pollen/History
text:
Pollen/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Penalteam", Pollen and her Miraculous were used again by Zoé to become Vesperia and help Ladybug, along with many other heroes to defeat Penalteam.
In "Risk", Pollen and the other kwamis watched Marinette search for different ways to sabotage Adrien and Lila's journey, unaware that he was under the influence of Risk's superpowers.
In "Strikeback", Pollen and her Miraculous were given to Zoé to become Vesperia and helped Ladybug, Cat Noir and the rest of the heroes to defeat Strikeback. Later, after Flairmidable betrayed Ladybug by stealing her yo-yo, her Miraculous, along with all the others, was given to Gabriel Agreste in exchange for the Peacock Miraculous.

title: Pollen/History
text:
Pollen/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Evolution", Pollen and her fellow kwami siblings are captured by Gabriel and figure out his reasons for wanting to claim Ladybug and Cat Noirs Miraculous. Later she fuses her powers with Nooroo’s, Fluff’s, Trixx’s and Wayzz’s to help Monarch paralyze future Bunnyx to take her Miraculous.
In "Multiplication", after Monarch detransforms into Gabriel, he threatens Pollen and her siblings by telling them that he will use their powers to get Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses.
In "Destruction", she along with her kwami siblings are forced by Gabriel to reveal their guardian's identity. Because Pollen and the other kwamis were never renounced by Ladybug, they were not able to speak her true name. With this realization, Gabriel forces them to tell him where Ladybug lives but they instead give clues since they don't know what an address is. She then fuses her powers with Nooroo’s, Kaalki’s and Wayzz’s to help Gabriel prepare for his confrontation with Ladybug. After the battle, Gabriel uses a machine laser to melt down Pollen's Miraculous and then reforges it so that way he can transfer Pollen’s power of Action to any akumatized villain he wants or to himself through the Kwami cage.

text:

title: Pocket dimensions
text:
Pocket dimensions - Intro
are different worlds from the same universe that are located within different planes of existence. There are several instances where characters physically go to another plane to fix unfortunate events; the dimension with the unrepaired event then becomes an pocket dimension.
Currently known methods that grant interdimensional travel capabilities that also create alternate dimensions are the usage of a time-related Miraculouses, or akumatized or amokization powers connected to a plane.

title: Pocket dimensions
text:
Pocket dimensions - Superpowers
Burrow
The power of of the Rabbit Miraculous, Burrow, is used to travel through time.
Bringing someone from the Past to the future
In "Evolution", due to Monarch's, Ladybug's, and Rabbit Noir's many time hops, the trio ended up in 1940's France at night, but not a normal one. It's the night Master Fu left Paris to escape from the Nazis. Aware that Monarch tagged the Rabbit Miraculous with the ball, the duo asked Master Fu for the Past Dog Miraculous. By bringing 1940's Barkk into the future, she became aware of some of her fellow kwamis' future owners.
Akumatization
The power of of the Butterfly Miraculous, Akumatization, is used to transform an ordinary person into a superhuman with special superpowers that correspond to that person's nature or circumstances. This can include powers related to dimensions and dimensional travel.
Pixelator

title: Pocket dimensions
text:
Pocket dimensions - Superpowers
Pixelator could take pictures with the camera over his right eye, which he could see through. When he hit the capture button, a light blue ray of pixels shot out. If it hit a person or an animal, the pixels surrounded them. The pixels reformed the victims in a white world inside of a photograph, the photographs themselves appearing on Pixelator's wall in his room, where they could move and be seen moving from the real world.
Kwamibuster
While Kwamibuster didn't have any superpowers, she wielded a vacuum-like gun attached to a canister on her back. Any kwami hit by the beam from her vacuum would be sucked in and trapped in the canister, unable to phase through. It would even work on a kwami that was inside a Miraculous.
Amokization
The power of of the Peacock Miraculous, Amokization, is used to conjure a living being with special superpowers that correspond to that person's nature or circumstances. This can include powers related to dimensions and dimensional travel.
Feast
In "Feast", whatever the Dormant Sentimonster ate would be trapped in a pocket dimension within its stomach for all eternity.
Guiltrip

title: Pocket dimensions
text:
Pocket dimensions - Superpowers
In "Guiltrip", Guiltrip could create a strong vacuum vortex from its mouth that sucked nearby people and objects into a magenta pocket dimension inside its body.

title: Pocket dimensions
text:
Pocket dimensions - Other Objects
Aside from the pocket dimensions that are accessible through superpowers, there have been a few objects that house pocket dimensions or other universes through divine or magical means.
Miracle Boxes
Miracle Boxes are magical boxes that house the Miraculouses which are either not in use or are missing. It is also the home for the kwamis. According to Tikki in "Truth", the boxes contain a whole entire universe where kwamis gather, but they also have various things collected throughout the millenniums, either to keep their inactive siblings entertained or cherished mementos from their past owners. However, there is one downside once the kwamis are in their magical world: they are mostly cut off from the outside world unless the inside kwamis connect with an outside kwami during the outside kwami's cycle, as seen in "Sandboy".
Miraculous Tools

title: Pocket dimensions
text:
Pocket dimensions - Other Objects
There are a few tools like Ladybug's yo-yo that house bigger objects than itself and even kwamis as seen in various episodes. In "Yaksi Gozen", any object stored inside Ladybug's yo-yo is transformed into a quantic state that prevents anyone from reaching it unless through the yo-yo which only exists when Ladybug is transformed. This may suggest that the tool has a special pocket dimension inside, but what the yo-yo looks like from the inside is unknown.

title: Pocket dimensions
text:
Pocket dimensions - Trivia
Only those Miraculous with special powers, such as the Cat or Peacock, are the ones that can fully vanquish a world.
The total amount of worlds existing in the current universe is 5, excluding all the times in the past the Rabbit Miraculous was used.
In "Pixelator", the titular villain takes pictures with the camera over his right eye, which he sees through. When he hits the image capture button, a light blue ray of pixels shoots out. If it hits a person or animal, the pixels surround them. The pixels reform the victims in a white world inside of a photograph, the photographs themselves appearing on Pixelator's wall in his room, where they can move and be seen moving from the real world.
In "Sandboy", within the Miracle Box, there is just a pocket dimension where the Kwamis can gather.
In "Feast", whatever the Dormant Sentimonster eats will be trapped in a pocket dimension within its stomach for all eternity.
In "Cat Blanc", Bunnyx takes Ladybug to the future to try to find out what caused Cat Noir to be akumatized and to prevent it from happening by going back to the past, after find the reason for his akumatization.

Pocket dimensions - Trivia

title: Police robots
text:
Police robots - Intro
were service robots created by Tsurugi Industries. Tomoe Tsurugi and Gabriel Agreste tried to sell them to Mayor Bourgeois and the City of Paris, although the latter refused and resigned from his position. They later managed to give them to his daughter, who used them as part of her coup d'état.
The robots were secretly able to hold the essences of the Miraculouses which Monarch had turned into rings (similarly to the Alliance rings), and after Chloé had come to power, Monarch made an alliance with her, akumatizing her and transferring the powers of the Bee, Turtle, Ox, Rooster and Horse Miraculouses. After Queen Mayor was defeated and de-akumatized, Cat Noir destroyed them with his Cataclysm.

title: Police robots
text:
Police robots - Appearance
Normal
The robots were blue rectangular cuboids around a meter tall. They had the logo of Tsurugi Industries on the top and on the sides. There were projectile launchers on one of the sides, which retracted when not in use.
Akumatized
After Chloé's akumatizion, they just turned golden.
Cataclysmed
When they were cataclysmed by Cat Noir, they were much more flat and were a blackish color.

title: Police robots
text:
Police robots - Abilities
Normal
They were fast and capable of knocking a grown adult away and could launch projectiles at whatever the person who controlled them wanted them to as well as nets to trap people. They also possessed the same transferring mechanism like the Alliance rings, which enabled them to utilize Miraculous powers when their essence was transferred to them by Monarch. They were also stealthy, being able to sneak up, immobilize and teleport them away with no-one noticing their presence.
Akumatized
When Chloé was akumatized into Queen Mayor, the police robots received the powers of Venom, Voyage, Shell-ter, Resistance and Sublimation. title: Plagg/Movie
text:
Plagg/Movie - Intro
Plagg is one of the two deuteragonists (alongside Tikki) of "Ladybug & Cat Noir: The Movie". He is the kwami of Destruction who is connected to the Cat Miraculous. With his power, Plagg's wearer can use the ring to transform into a cat-themed superhero.
Plagg and his Miraculous are currently active and owned by Adrien Agreste, who uses it to transform into the superhero Cat Noir.

title: Plagg/Movie
text:
Plagg/Movie - Appearance
Plagg's movie version appearance is nearly identical to his TV version except he can  transform into an actual black cat with green eyes. Also, unlike his canon counterpart, he has fingers and toes.

title: Plagg/Movie
text:
Plagg/Movie - Personality
Plagg seems to possess a slightly different personality than the one from the original series. Despite still not taking his responsibilities as serious as he should, being lazy and having a cheese addiction, Plagg possesses a much gruffer attitude, causing his nature as the kwami of destruction to be even more evident. This can be seen in his interaction with Adrien, as he treats him more like a kid (and even referring to him as such) and not being afraid of burping and/or farting in front of others.
Despite that, he is not completely indifferent to his holder's needs, as he had warned Adrien about falling in love with other heroes like Ladybug, feeling bad for him when he was rejected by her, and he gave him his space to deal with rejection, only taking him out of it when Paris was in critical peril.
Regarding his cheese addiction, he also prefers to eat smelly cheese from the garbage, instead of a fresh variety of it, what reflects on his constant flatulence.

title: Plagg/Movie
text:
Plagg/Movie - Abilities
Plagg can fly and levitate. Because of being constantly eating stinky cheese from the garbage, Plagg is always releasing a terrible stink from his belches and farts.
Plagg is connected to the Cat Miraculous, and can transform his Miraculous's wielder into a black cat-themed superhero or supervillain and grant them the power of destruction, which requires the wielder. Much like Tikki, Plagg can either force a transformation or de-transformation his holder at will (possibly if his holder doesn't give any orders against it). Plagg is also able to control his jewel, being able to levitate it while being inside it, as seen when he and Tikki set out to seek their holders once Master Fu opened the Miracle Box.
He is also able of shapeshifting, being capable of taking the form of an actual black cat with green eyes.
Despite not have been showed just yet, it's possible that, just like his counterpart from the original series, he is capable of using his own powers of destruction, but doing it in a scale that he can't control.

title: Plagg/Movie
text:
Plagg/Movie - Relationships
Tikki
Similar to the original series, Tikki and Plagg, according to the comments done by Master Fu when he decides to put their jewels in circulation because of the rise of Hawk Moth, seem to possess a rather complicated relationship. They seem to be always arguing with one another, as Master Fu had warned them he would only open the Miracle Box for them to get out if they behaved and didn't fight. However, because the two kwamis are not seen interacting with one another, it's unknown if their complicated relationship is similar to the one in the original series.
Adrien Agreste
Plagg works with Adrien to help him become Cat Noir, but he doesn't show great amounts of dedication towards him most of the time, even if he was the one to choose the boy to be his holder. In their interactions, Plagg is often seen as being a bit rude and condecending with Adrien (as seen when he calls him "kid") and not worrying in burping and/or farting or eat cheese taken from the garbage in front of him.

title: Plagg/Movie
text:
Plagg/Movie - Relationships
However, despite that, Plagg does show some concern to Adrien, as he had warned the boy to not fall in love with a hero he works with and gave him space to deal with his emotions over his broken heart, only interrupting him so he would transform to deal with an attack caused by a self-akumatized Hawk Moth.

title: Plagg/Movie
text:
Plagg/Movie - Trivia
Plagg's animal form bears a striking resemblance to a black sphinx cat.
It also resembles the black cat from the theme song.

text:

"" (also called "Plastic: The Story So far" and "Plastic, The Story So Far") is a short film of the series, Miraculous Action Shorts and the first module of the Plastic Changemaker Educational Pack.

title: Plastic - The Story So Far

Learn why Plastic was created, its benefits and how its overproduction is causing an environmental crisis.

This is the first time Marinette is absent in any way in a piece of Miraculous media.
The didactic module consists of three 50-minute-long lessons:
The history of plastic: Why it was created and its benefits
The cycle of use of plastic: From human use to waterways and landfill

This module aims for students to:
Understand the benefits of plastic, why it was made or used and evaluate its usefulness.
Analyze the path of plastic from human use to the ocean or environment.
Evaluate the impact of plastic on humans, animals, and the environment.

title: Pont Notre-Dame
text:
Pont Notre-Dame - Intro
is an arch bridge located in the 4th arrondissement of Paris that crosses the main branch of the Seine and connects the Île de la Cité from the Quai de Corse to the Rive Droite, at the height of the Quai de Gesvres, near the Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie and the Le Café du Coin.

title: Pont Notre-Dame
text:
Pont Notre-Dame - Description
Pont Notre-Dame, dating back to 1919 and incorporating elements of bridges built in 1512 and 1853, is an arch bridge 105 meters long and 20 meters wide. Its main span is 59.9 meters.
Since season 6, since the election of Caline Bustier as mayor of Paris, a tram line has crossed the bridge, with its own dedicated track and landscaped features.

title: Pont Notre-Dame
text:
Pont Notre-Dame - Trivia
Notre Dame is on the other side of the bridge, opposite the bakery.
Pont de l'Archevêché is parallel to the bridge on the right side of Notre-Dame.
In "Daddycop", Roger is akumatized along with his police car by Chrysalis into Daddycop.

title: Pont des Arts
text:
Pont des Arts - Intro
The  or Passerelle des Arts is a pedestrian bridge in Paris which crosses the River Seine. It links the Institut de France and the central square (cour carrée) of the Louvre Palace, which had been termed the "Palais des Arts" under the First French Empire.
From 2008 to 2015, tourists would, as a romantic gesture, attach a padlock (love lock) with their first names written or engraved on them to the railing or the grate on the side of the bridge, then throw the key into the Seine below, so that piece of their love could always stay in Paris.

title: Pont des Arts
text:
Pont des Arts - Trivia
In 2015, the locks on the bridge were removed due to safety concerns from the extra weight on the bridge. Season 1 was probably made before this date, as the locks are still visible.
The locks were replaced by plexiglass panels featuring various illustrations. The plexiglass is designed in a way that makes it impossible for tourists to place locks on the fence.

title: Principal's office
text:
Principal's office - Intro
The  is the office of the principal of Collège Françoise Dupont.

title: Principal's office
text:
Principal's office - Appearance
The Principal's office is a square room with a door as an entrance at the front and a large set of windows at the back. A small wooden table is situated to the right of the entrance. The side walls are filled with books, and two old maps of Paris are hung on each in the center. The remaining wall space is taken up by pictures of owls. A wooden desk with a large chair behind it, and two smaller ones in front, is the centerpiece of the room, sitting on a red and white carpet. The desk has a computer and a small lamp on it.
Hidden Compartment
In "The Dark Owl", it was revealed that the wall map of Paris that was to Mr. Damoclès' right when he sat at his desk conceals a large secret compartment behind it, contained his superhero "Owl" costume, a few Owl-related weapons, a small figurine of the comic booked hero character "Knight Owl" (who is of nearly identical design to the real-in-universe New York City-based superhero Knightowl), and several old Knight Owl-related comic books displayed on the wall, included Justice Comics #27, the character's first appearance.

title: Principal's office
text:
Principal's office - Trivia
Mr. Damoclès was adamant that visitors always knock before entering his office.
The office has been involved with multiple different akumatized villain attacks.
In "Lady Wifi", Lady Wifi enters the office and forces Mr. Damoclès to confess to unjustly suspending her civilian self.
In "Pixelator", Ladybug takes Jagged Stone to the office as a place for him to hide from the title character.
The office door is broken down by the titular character in "Rogercop", and by Stoneheart in "Ladybug & Cat Noir".
In "Robostus", after he is trapped in Mr. Damoclès' desk, Markov is akumatized inside of it, and, from there, unleashes a green wave that grants technology sentience before breaking out.
In "The Dark Owl", Mr. Damoclès is akumatized inside the office, which also serves as the hideout for his computer, which was his akumatized object.
In "Multiplication", Ikari Gozen was lured into the office to defeat her and to destroy her bokken.
Vincent uses the office while he takes class photos in "Reflekta".
The Justice Comics #27 comic book cover seen inside Mr. Damoclès' secret compartment in "The Dark Owl" is a reworking of Detective Comics #27, in which Batman first appeared.

Pont de l'Archevêché - Intro
The  is a bridge which crosses the Seine in Paris, France.

title: Pont de l'Archevêché
text:
Pont de l'Archevêché - Description
The Pont de l'Archevêché has three arches on the Seine with an opening from 15 to 17 meters.
The easternmost bridge of the Île de la Cité, connects it to the 5° arrondissement from behind the Notre-Dame de Paris on which it offers an exceptional view.

title: Pont de l'Archevêché
text:
Pont de l'Archevêché - Trivia
In series, the Pont de l'Archevêché's appearance differs from reality because its railings look like they are made of stone, while in the real world they are made of metal:
Because of this aspect, the bridge has been confused with the Pont Marie, connecting the l'Île Saint-Louis with the 4th arrondissement of Paris at the height of the Hôtel de Ville.
This aspect appears to be the default appearance for several Paris bridges in the series, including those that connect Île de la Cité with the rest of Paris.

title: Princess Fragrance
text:
Princess Fragrance - Intro
"" is a season 1 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. According to the series' production/written order, it is the 4th episode of season 1, as well as the 4th episode of the series, overall.

title: Princess Fragrance
text:
Princess Fragrance - Synopsis
Marinette can't transform into Ladybug when classmate Rose is akumatized into a villain whose perfume lets her control Cat Noir and a visiting prince.
Disney+
Ladybug and Cat Noir face Princess Fragrance, alias Rose.

title: Princess Fragrance
text:
Princess Fragrance - Plot
The episode begins with the TVi news report about Ladybug and Cat Noir, who have saved Paris once again by defeating a kid named Jean Duparc, who was akumatized into the Magician of Misfortune and wanted to make the Eiffel Tower disappear in a puff of smoke. After Ladybug transforms back into her civilian form, Marinette notices that Tikki is sick. Tikki asks her if she could take her to a doctor, but Marinette thinks that it isn't a good idea to find a doctor for a kwami. Tikki claims that she knows a healer that can help her, but Marinette is afraid that he might get suspicious. Marinette then remembers that she's late for school, so she tells Tikki that she'll take her to the healer once class is over.

title: Princess Fragrance
text:
Princess Fragrance - Plot
At Science classroom, Rose watches a news report on her phone about Prince Ali, crowned prince of the Achu Kingdom, who is having an official visit to Paris to organize a toy drive for the kids in the city's hospital. Smitten, Rose decides to write him a letter to show how much she loves and respects him. Marinette arrives to class just when Rose is about to write the letter. Rose sprays her letter with her perfume, and is noticed by the professor; annoyed that Rose didn't pay attention in class, Ms. Mendeleiev makes her go to Principal's office. Once Rose is gone, Ms. Mendeleiev demonstrates to the class how Rose's perfume is flammable.
When class is over, Adrien finally shows up outside of school. Alya suggests that maybe Marinette should give him her notes so he can be up to date on what they're working on in class. However, Marinette remembers the promise she made to Tikki, so she tries to think of an excuse. Alya, though, doesn't believe her and forces her to walk up to Adrien. But Marinette does so, she trips on a backpack, causing her to launch Tikki into the air while Adrien manages to catch Marinette before she falls.

title: Princess Fragrance
text:
Princess Fragrance - Plot
When he and Nino leave, Marinette opens her purse to see if Tikki is still in there. When she notices that Tikki is missing, she gasps and starts to look around to see where Tikki is. Next to her, Sabrina and Chloé are on their way to the latter's limousine when they stumble upon Tikki on the ground. Chloé mistakes her for a toy and decides to give "it" to Prince Ali during his visit to Le Grand Paris later that day. Before Chloé steps inside the limo, Rose arrives to ask her if she could deliver her letter to the prince. However, she makes fun of her and her letter and tears it to pieces. While the heartbroken Rose tries to gather the pieces of her letter, Marinette notices Tikki in Chloé's hand. Panicked, Marinette tries to tell Chloé that the "toy" actually belongs to her, but Chloé refuses to give "it" back, and the limo drives away from the school.

title: Princess Fragrance
text:
Princess Fragrance - Plot
Rose is sad and heartbroken and begins to cry since she no longer has a letter for Prince Ali. Rose goes to sit on a bench under the Seine and writes him another letter which is splashed by her tears. Hawk Moth senses her sadness and pain and sends an akuma to control her, Rose takes her perfume bottle and then the akuma lands on it, Hawk Moth offers to give her the power so that no one can resist her with her perfume, Rose becomes happy and accepts the deal and Hawk Moth akumatizes her, transforming her into Princess Fragrance.

title: Princess Fragrance
text:
Princess Fragrance - Plot
Outside of the Le Grand Paris, Marinette tries to get past the hotel doorman so she could enter the hotel to get Tikki back, claiming that she is Chloé's friend. He doesn't let her in, though, due to the fact that Chloé doesn't have any friends. As Marinette walks away, she finds a motorcycle helmet, cape, and an old pizza box in the trash. Pretending to be a pizza delivery girl, she manages to get past the doorman and into the hotel. Taking the elevator to the floor of the Imperial suite, Marinette spots Chloé holding Tikki near the second elevator of the floor. When the elevator doors open and Chloé steps in, Marinette quickly runs to tell her about the "toy" she's holding. But Chloé, disgusted by the prospect of having pizza, rapidly pushes one of the buttons when she sees her, so the doors close. So Marinette has to run up the stairwell to follow her upstairs.

title: Princess Fragrance
text:
Princess Fragrance - Plot
While that is happening, Princess Fragrance arrives at the hotel. She asks the doorman if she can come in to see the prince. But after he refuses, Princess Fragrance brings out her perfume gun and sprays him. The pink spray brainwashes the doorman into serving her, allowing Princess Fragrance to get inside the hotel to see "her" prince.
Meanwhile, the TVi news report is currently broadcasting Prince Ali being greeted by the Mayor of Paris on the top floor of the Le Grand Paris. The Mayor explains to the prince that he has organized some fireworks on the Seine in front of the hotel when he arrives and that it'll be launched from a boat. Then, Chloé arrives, and the Mayor introduces her to the prince. After a handshake, Chloé gives him the "toy" she found earlier outside of school. While the paparazzi are taking photos of Prince Ali, Marinette sneaks behind them and spies on them. The prince puts Tikki into his front jacket pocket. While Nadja Chamack is interviewing the prince, no one notices Princess Fragrance coming out from the service elevator. She uses her perfume gun and fires a green spray onto Chloé, releasing a disgusting smell.

title: Princess Fragrance
text:
Princess Fragrance - Plot
While Prince Ali, his chaperone, the Mayor, and Nadja's backs are turned to Chloé, they hear a blast. They turn and see the mind-controlled paparazzi bowing down to Princess Fragrance. The akumatized villain introduces herself to the prince and says that he'll belong to her once she sprays him from her perfume gun. Now without Tikki to transform into Ladybug, Marinette has to save both Prince Ali and Tikki from the akumatized villain. She activates a button from a synthesizer to launch the confetti to prevent Princess Fragrance from shooting the Prince. Adrien is surprised when he watches the live broadcast of the fiasco in his room. He tells Plagg that the prince is in danger, and he then transforms into Cat Noir.

title: Princess Fragrance
text:
Princess Fragrance - Plot
Marinette follows Prince Ali, his chaperone, the Mayor, and Chloé when they escape into the stairwell to run from Princess Fragrance. They hide inside a hotel room, in which the Mayor claims that they'll be safe from her by the reinforced door. After Chloé feels annoyed about both Prince Ali and his chaperone being disgusted by her smell, she noticed that Princess Fragrance had sprayed perfume under the doorway. Luckily, Marinette vacuums the spray before it brainwashes the prince. But Princess Fragrance points her gun downwards and continually shoots perfume to propels herself, and she lands on the vacuum cord, unplugging it. But before she sprays Marinette, the Mayor gets out of the room and runs off, along with Prince Ali, his chaperone, and Chloé. Princess Fragrance then spins around to spray her perfume around herself to create a fog.

title: Princess Fragrance
text:
Princess Fragrance - Plot
Fortunately, Marinette escapes by the brainwashed waiter, but the Mayor doesn't escape from the fog. He gets caught in the fog after he opens the stairwell door for the prince, his chaperone, and Chloé. Once Marinette gets into the kitchen, she peeks through the door and sees that the Mayor has been brainwashed too. Princess Fragrance arrives by elevator and is about to spray Prince Ali, but Cat Noir barges in just in time. After a quick battle between Cat Noir and Princess Fragrance, Cat Noir helps the prince, his chaperone, and Chloé evacuate by sliding down his staff outside the hotel. Once they get inside Prince Ali's chaperone's car, they drive away. Princess Fragrance uses her perfume gun like a rocket to follow the car, Marinette follows them.

title: Princess Fragrance
text:
Princess Fragrance - Plot
After opening the windows to get rid of the smell from Chloé, Princess Fragrance arrives on top of the car roof. But before the chaperone can close all the windows, she sprays everyone in the car. After riding a scooter to follow the car, Marinette rushes over to see if Tikki is inside. Luckily, Tikki had escaped from Prince Ali's pocket and onto the car's floor. Marinette apologizes to Tikki for not taking her to the healer and runs off to find him. After a visit to Fu's massage shop, Tikki informs Marinette about where Princess Fragrance and the others are. So, Marinette transforms into Ladybug and goes to the Pont des Arts.

title: Princess Fragrance
text:
Princess Fragrance - Plot
At the Pont des Arts, Princess Fragrance is thrilled to wed the mind-controlled Prince Ali. But before she can place a love lock on the bridge, Ladybug uses her yo-yo to knock it into the river. Under Hawk Moth's command, Princess Fragrance sends her mind-controlled servants, including Cat Noir, to retrieve Ladybug's earrings; she also takes Prince Ali away from the fight. On the Le Grand Paris roof, Princess Fragrance decides to make Paris their kingdom for them to rule and starts spraying the sky. When Ladybug realizes that everyone in Paris, including her, is going to become Princess Fragrance's slaves, she remembers something from her chemistry class earlier: Ms. Mendeleiev's warning about the flammability of Rose's perfume; and she happens to see the boat the Mayor mentioned earlier that's full of fireworks.

title: Princess Fragrance
text:
Princess Fragrance - Plot
By tricking Cat Noir into using his staff to push her into the river, Ladybug lands on top of the boat. She pulls the staff to launch him onto the boat with her. Cat Noir uses his Cataclysm to stop Ladybug from escaping. He's about to strike her, but she trips him, and he ends up using it on the fireworks control panel, releasing the fireworks into the sky. After pulling Cat Noir's tail and dropping him into the river, Ladybug uses her yo-yo to escape from the boat.

title: Princess Fragrance
text:
Princess Fragrance - Plot
The fireworks explode into Princess Fragrance's fog of perfume, causing it to vanish into thin air. Upset that her plan failed, Princess Fragrance suggests that she and the Prince should run away from Paris. But Ladybug interrupts her, making the akumatized villain burst into anger and decide to destroy her for ruining her dream. Ladybug uses Lucky Charm, and a balloon appears. She grabs a straw and puts the balloon through it. Before Princess Fragrance can spray her, Ladybug tosses the straw with the balloon in the mouth of the perfume gun; causing the balloon to inflate. Ladybug then uses her yo-yo to grab the perfume gun and breaks it, revealing the akuma. She catches the akuma and purifies it. Ladybug then tosses the balloon and cleanses the city, returning everything, including Rose, back to normal.

title: Princess Fragrance
text:
Princess Fragrance - Plot
After Rose detransforms, she is delighted to see Prince Ali in front of her. Ladybug decides to leave the Prince alone with his biggest fan. Rose confesses to Prince Ali that he's one of the kindest people she ever met. But then Chloé arrives, interrupting them and shoving Rose out of the way, declaring that she is happy that the Prince is alright. Prince Ali rejects Chloé's offer for starting where they left off before the villain's attack because he has to go to the kids hospital with his new friend, Rose. Chloé is left infuriated as he growls and screams very angrily as she watches them leave, while Rose and Prince Ali go to watch the fireworks at the Pont des Arts.

title: Princess Fragrance
text:
Princess Fragrance - Plot Developments
When separated from their owners one of the ways kwamis defend themselves is by using their small size and cuteness to look like toys or plushies. As seen with Tikki, when she was separated from Marinette.
This episode along with "Rogercop" and "Lady Wifi", starts to explain the dangers of improper miraculous transformation from the kwami aspect.
This is the first and only time a kwami gets sick.
When Master Fu was healing Tikki, he said "reading energies", and since kwamis are cosmic beings that implies for a Miraculous holder to transform safely, a kwamis' cosmic energy must flow freely and connect with their owner.
It also reveals that kwamis can still transform their holders, despite being sick. However, it's advised that a holder shouldn't transform if their kwamis cosmic energy is disrupted, then if they do transform it will cause severe or harmful effects which is revealed in later seasons.
If it's true, then it means that not only does the holder have to be strong enough to hold the transformation, the kwami must be too.

title: Princess Fragrance
text:
Princess Fragrance - Plot Developments
Yet, it's also strange that Tikki despite being a cosmic being, she was struck with the "kwami flu", it could be that when Tikki and her siblings obtained their physical forms nor crossed over to the mortal realm they were also bound to the weaknesses or rules that came with it, which also includes being sick.

title: Princess Fragrance
text:
Princess Fragrance - Trivia
This episode first premiered in Canada on Télé-Québec.
This episode was the twenty-second to air in France and twenty-fifth to air on Télé-Québec.
Unlike the rest of the first season episodes, this episode first premiered on Nicktoons instead of Nickelodeon. The episode officially premiered on Nickelodeon on October 29, 2016.
In the Brazilian version of this episode, the people that Princess Fragrance control do not sing, but instead speak normally.
On December 8, 2016, this episode was uploaded in its entirety to the official Miraculous Ladybug YouTube channel.
However, the video is restricted to certain geographic regions, including the United States.
This episode has many first:
The appearance of Master Fu, albeit he appears for the first time chronologically in "Origins".
An akumatized villain is mentioned, but not seen in action, with Nadja explaining in a news report how Jean Duparc was akumatized into the Magician of Misfortune and wanted to make the Eiffel Tower disappear. With this it is the first time an akumatized villain is fought offscreen.
Where Ladybug and Cat Noir don't work together to fight a villain.

title: Princess Fragrance
text:
Princess Fragrance - Trivia
The word "kwami" is mentioned in the episode, making it the first, of two season 1 episodes in which it is so, the other being "Ladybug & Cat Noir".
Where a character sings outside of a performance or recording.
It is revealed that Chloé hates pizza.
References
This is one of the six episodes of Season 1 in which Ladybug and Cat Noir don't do their signature "Pound it!", the other five being "Animan", "The Pharaoh", "Timebreaker", "Kung Food" and "Stoneheart".
This is also one of the four episodes of season 1 in which Hawk Moth doesn't hold his end monologue after being defeated. The other three being "Copycat", "Simon Says" and "Antibug".
This was one of the few times Hawkmoth could have seized Cat Noir's miraculous by simply getting Princess Fragrance to order him to do so after he was hit by her perfume.
Cat Noir falls under Princess Fragrance's control. This happens again to him with the titular villain of "Dark Cupid".
He also attempts to use Cataclysm on Ladybug, which also happens in the aforementioned episode.
Allusions
"Princess Fragrance" is also the name of a character in the Chinese novel The Book and the Sword.

title: Princess Fragrance
text:

The kwamis going "stuffed" alludes to "Doc McStuffins" and "Toy Story".
Marinette refusing to transform when Tikki and her magic was weak, is one of the classic warnings for a person to never rely on magic that is raw or haywire.

title: Princess Fragrance/Transcript
text:
Princess Fragrance/Transcript - Intro
[ Theme Song ]
Nadja: (in a news report) Welcome. Ladybug and Cat Noir have saved Paris once again. Jean Duparc was akumatized into the very menacing Magician of Misfortune, threatening to make the Eiffel Tower vanish in a puff of smoke.
Tikki: (sneezes)
Marinette: Tikki, you don't look well.
Tikki: I need you to take me to a doctor.
Marinette: But where am I gonna find a doctor for kwamis?
Tikki: I know a healer. I'll tell you where to go.
Marinette: But what will I tell him? You're a secret, he'll get all suspicious and ask me questions— (gasps) And I know someone else who is gonna ask a lot of questions: my teacher! About why I'm late again! Tikki, can I take you to the healer right after school? (Tikki nods and sneezes) Thank you.
Olga Mendeleiev: Combustion is a high-temperature exothermic redox chemical reaction between a fuel and an oxidant. Usually atmospheric oxygen...
Nadja: (news report on Rose's cellphone) Today, Prince Ali, heir to the throne of the kingdom of Achu will do the honors during his official Parisian visit by hosting a toy fundraiser for the sick children at the Paris City Children's Hospital.

title: Princess Fragrance/Transcript
text:
Princess Fragrance/Transcript - Intro
Rose: (Rose wipes her eyes as Juleka hands her tissues) He's just so gorgeous and with a heart of gold. (blows her nose) Oh! You know what? I'm gonna write him a letter professing my complete adoration and utmost respect.
(Marinette stumbles into the classroom and then trips and falls in front of the teacher's desk.)
Marinette: Waaa!
Ms. Mendeleiev: Ah, Marinette. What excuse do you have for us this time? Accidentally locked yourself in the bathroom again?
Marinette: Uh, no! Of course not. I had to, uh, take my dog... to the vet! Because he... ate an entire wool sweater. Uh, it must've smelled like th— (Ms. Mendeleiev smells the scent immediately when Rose sprays perfume on her letter)
Ms. Mendeleiev: Thank you, Rose. But I don't think our classroom needs extra refreshing. (walks towards Rose)
Chloé: Uh, I thought someone packed a tuna fish sandwich, but it turns out that it's Rose's perfume. (laughs)
Alya: (to Marinette) Ate a sweater?
Ms. Mendeleiev: (confiscates Rose's perfume) Furthermore, using your smartphone during school hours is strictly forbidden. (confiscates Rose's cellphone and hands free) Take the rest of your things and go to the principal's office.

title: Princess Fragrance/Transcript
text:
Princess Fragrance/Transcript - Intro
Rose: Oh... (takes her things and starts to walk away)
Ms. Mendeleiev: (at the front of the class) Watch what happens when you play about with flammable substances in a chemistry lab. (spritzes some perfume inside a glass container with an open bottom and puts it upright, trapping the air inside. Then she pushes a button and a small flame comes out of a tube creating a small explosion)
Students: (gasp)
Ms. Mendeleiev: Just to make sure you all remember that, I'll be quizzing you tomorrow on lab safety. Again!
Nino: Dude.
Alya: You two really are made for each other. Neither one of you can make it to school on time. Since he missed chemistry class, it would be sweet if some lady could lend him her notes so he could get up to speed.
Marinette: (giggles) You're right. Oh, you mean for me to give him my notes! (looks to her purse, where Tikki is) No, I can't. I-I—
Alya: Girl, your fake excuses don't work on me.
Tikki: (sneezes)
Alya: Huh?
Marinette: Achoo! I think I'm getting sick.
Alya: Then don't breathe on him. (points to Adrien. Marinette starts to walk over to him)
Tikki: (sneezes) I'm not feeling too good.

title: Princess Fragrance/Transcript
text:
Princess Fragrance/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Don't worry, Tikki. It'll just take a sec— (trips over someone's bag and Tikki accidentally flies out of her bag. Marinette lands on Adrien)
Marinette and Tikki: Aaaah!
Adrien: Woah! You okay? Nothing broken?
Marinette: Uh, yeah, uh, I'm fine. (Adrien and Nino leave. Then Marinette realizes Tikki isn't in her purse anymore) Hah! AAH!
Tikki: (weakly) Marinette... (Chloé and Sabrina walk over and Tikki pretends to be a plush doll)
Chloé: Sabrina, what's Prince Ali doing today again?
Sabrina: A toy drive at the Children's Hospital.
Chloé: (sees Tikki and picks her up) Hm, what kind of stuffed animal is this? Who left this here? (gasps) The Prince will never have seen one like this before, and when he lays eyes on me, Prince Ali will forget all about those sick kids. (laughs)
Rose: D-did I hear you say Prince Ali?
Chloé: Not to you.
Sabrina: Prince Ali's staying at Chloé's dad's hotel.
Chloé: The only hotel fit for a Prince, and I'm going to be the first to meet him. Isn't he lucky?
Rose: Oh, please could you give him a special letter for me?
Chloé: No prob.
Rose: Oh, that is so amazingly sweet of you to do that for me.

title: Princess Fragrance/Transcript
text:
Princess Fragrance/Transcript - Intro
Chloé: (laughs) You thought I was serious? You think I wanna get anywhere near this fish funk? (laughs and rips the letter)
Rose: (gasps and then cries. Chloé gets into her limo and leaves Rose crying on the ground.)
Marinette: Tikki? (Marinette hears Chloé laugh and sees her holding Tikki as her limo is pulling away) Chloé, wait up!
Chloé: Huh?
Marinette: That's my... my...
Chloé: Not anymore. Finders keepers. (laughs)
Marinette: (to herself) Tikki...
Rose: (sobs as she begins writing another letter)
Hawk Moth: Ooh, now there's a broken-hearted princess if ever I saw one. Every rose has its thorns. (laughs and turns a butterfly into an akuma) Fly away my little akuma and evilize her.
(The akuma flies over to where Rose is and enters into her perfume bottle)
Hawk Moth: Princess Fragrance, I am Hawk Moth. Your perfume is now your secret weapon. No one will be able to resist it, especially Prince Ali. All I want from you in exchange are Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous.
Rose: ♫ I'm coming, my prince! ♫
Marinette: Hello! I'm in Chloé Bourgeois class and I really have to see her.
Doorman: Are you a friend of hers?

title: Princess Fragrance/Transcript
text:
Princess Fragrance/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: A friend of Chloé's? Ha, you must be kidding! (gasps) I mean— we're in the same class, that's all.
Doorman: If you're not a friend then I can't.
Marinette: Yes! I'm a f-f-friend of Chloé's. We're BFFs!
Doorman: Aha! Chloé doesn't have any friends!
Marinette: Does that mean you're not letting me in?
Doorman: No!
(Marinette leaves defeated but then she sees a pile of trash with a motorcycle helmet, a pink cape and a pizza box.)
Marinette: (disguised) Hey! Got a pizza for Chloé Bourgeois.
Doorman: Hmm, it's usually sushi. (moves aside) Top floor, imperial suite.
Marinette: (giggles) Yes, yes, yes, yes, yes!
(Marinette, still disguised, goes up the elevator and arrives at Chloé's floor. Chloé is waiting for another elevator.)
Chloé: "Here's a gift for the sick children, Prince. Oh, it's nothing, really, stop flattering me. Ahahahahahaha." No. "Ahahahahaha." There, that's better. (Chloé gets into the elevator and Marinette sees her as the doors are about to close)
Marinette: Chloé, wait! (starts to run to her)
Chloé: Pizza? Eugh, don't get that peasant food anywhere near me. (pushes the close button)

title: Princess Fragrance/Transcript
text:
Princess Fragrance/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Wait! It has truffles and caviar on it! (the doors close before she gets there) For a spoiled brat just like you! (runs on the stairs)
(Outside, Princess Fragrance approaches the doorman.)
Princess Fragrance: I've come to see Prince Ali.
Doorman: Ugh, what is going on today? Do you have an appointment with the Prince?
Princess Fragrance: No need, I'm his princess!
Doorman: And I'm a monkey's uncle. Listen kid I—
Princess Fragrance: That's no way to speak to a princess. (she shoots perfume at him from her perfume gun)
Doorman: ♫ At your service, Princess Fragrance. ♫
Princess Fragrance: Thousand times better. (walks in) Now, where's my wonderful prince charming? We can't keep him waiting.
(Cut to Prince Ali's press conference inside Le Grand Paris in the dining hall.)
André: In honor of your presence here in Paris, your highness, I've taken it upon myself to organize a lavish fireworks display on the Seine river. They will be displayed from this barge.
Prince Ali: (gasps) Thank you, or how do we say in your language? Totally awesome!

title: Princess Fragrance/Transcript
text:
Princess Fragrance/Transcript - Intro
Prince Ali's chaperone: We shall have to see if it fits in with the Prince's busy schedule. We have very little time for festivities. His highness has many responsibilities.
Chloé: (clears her throat)
André Bourgeois: Ah! Prince Ali, allow me to introduce you to my own princess, Chloé.
Chloé: Hm, Prince, I brought you a special stuffed toy for the sick children. (gives Tikki to him)
Prince Ali: Whoa! I've never seen one like this before. This is so very kind of you.
Chloé: Ahahahahaha, you're flattering me. It is so kind of me though, isn't it?
Prince Ali: (slightly confused) Why, yes. I said just that. You did not hear me?
(Chloé laughs nervously and her eye twitches. The press continues to take pictures. Marinette sneaks in through the back. The Prince puts Tikki in his shirt pocket and Chloé takes a picture with him.)
Nadja: Nadja Chamack. Don't be bemused, it's just the news! Prince Ali, do you have anything to say about your official Parisian visit?
(An elevator bell rings and Princess Fragrance appears further away from the crowd.)
Prince Ali: I'm very happy to be here. (Princess Fragrance fires her perfume gun at Chloé)

title: Princess Fragrance/Transcript
text:
Princess Fragrance/Transcript - Intro
Nadja: Prince Ali, where is... that-that smell coming from?! Like rotten fish?! (Nadja, Prince Ali, and André stare at Chloé)
Chloé: What? That's not me! (sniffs herself) It-it is me! Ew! (perfume sprays behind the paparazzi. Everyone look at them)
Paparazzi: (turns around and bowed down while singing) ♫ At your service, Princess Fragrance. ♫
Prince Ali: Who-who are you?
Princess Fragrance: I'm Princess Fragrance and I've come just for you! In just a spritz, you'll be mine, Prince Ali!
Marinette: This is bad! (activates a button from a synthesizer to launch the confetti)
Adrien: What or who is that? Plagg? Plagg, let's go! There's trouble in Paris! (he looks in his trash can where Plagg is eating his Camembert and Adrien is annoyed)
Plagg: I'm still chewing!
[ Transformation Sequence ]Adrien: Plagg, claws out! (Adrien transforms into Cat Noir)
André Bourgeois: Quickly, Prince! This way! (Marinette follows them and Princess Fragrance down the stairs. Cuts to them hiding in a room) We'll be safe in here. It's a reinforced door.
Prince Ali's chaperone: So much chaos! How is anyone supposed to stick to a schedule around here? (both she and Prince Ali steps away from Chloé)

title: Princess Fragrance/Transcript
text:
Princess Fragrance/Transcript - Intro
Chloé: (points under the doorway) What is that?
André Bourgeois: (sees the perfume fog) Get back! (outside the room, Princess Fragrance is spraying the perfume under the doorway while Prince Ali, his chaperone, André and Chloé are backing away inside the room)
Princess Fragrance: ♫ My prince, my prince, smell the fragrance of my eternal love! ♫ (gasps)
(Everyone look down and notices that the fog is being sucked away. Princess Fragrance turns and sees Marinette using a vacuum cleaner.)
Princess Fragrance: Seriously, who are you?! (uses her perfume gun like a rocket to launches herself and landed on the vacuum cord, plugging it off) Looks like you're powerless now, superhero! (points her gun at Marinette)
André Bourgeois: (opens the door to take a peek) Oh no, there are two of them now! Run!
(Everyone gets out of the room and runs off.)
Princess Fragrance: (sprays her perfume around herself to create a fog) You can't escape my perfume! ♫ La la la la la la! ♫
(André opens a stairwell door and lets everyone go in first, but he is brainwashed by the fog before he gets inside. Marinette escapes the fog by using a service elevator.)
Princess Fragrance: Get them.

title: Princess Fragrance/Transcript
text:
Princess Fragrance/Transcript - Intro
André Bourgeois: ♫ At your service, Princess Fragrance. ♫
(Meanwhile, Marinette made it to the hotel kitchen. She peeks out from the door and sees Prince Ali, his chaperone, and Chloé back in the dining hall.)
Chloé: (to Armand while pointing at André) He's under the spell! Shut the door!
Prince Ali's chaperone: But it's your father!
Chloé: Who cares? Shut it now!
(Jean uses a broom and pushes André out of the way and shuts the door. Everyone notices the perfume fog from the inside of the nearby elevator, and they all, except Jean, run off.)
Armand: ♫ At your service, Princess Fragrance! ♫
Princess Fragrance: (walks toward Prince Ali, his chaperone, and Chloé) Come into my arms, my sweet prince!
Cat Noir: (sitting on the windowsill) Pee-ew! Can we get a little fresh air in here? (leaps in front of Princess Fragrance and takes out his staff)
Princess Fragrance: No one will take my prince away! (fires at Cat Noir)
(Cat Noir uses his staff to knock out the perfume spray. He then extendes his staff, picking up Princess Fragrance and throws her in the kitchen.)
Marinette: Uh oh! (leaps out of the way)

title: Princess Fragrance/Transcript
text:
Princess Fragrance/Transcript - Intro
(Cat Noir extendes his staff from the window to the outside of the Le Grand Paris like a pole. A Parisian screams in surprise once the end of the staff hit the ground.)
Cat Noir: Emergency evacuation, everybody down!
Prince Ali's chaperone: It's much too dangerous for the prince.
(Cat Noir notices three mixing bowls on the cart nearby.)
Cat Noir: You're right. (taps on the bowls) Safety first! (puts one of the bowl on Prince Ali's head like a helmet, while Prince Ali smiles)
(Cat Noir slides down the staff first. Followed by Chloé, Prince Ali, and his chaperone; the chaperone also wears a mixing bowl on her head. Once everyone is outside, Princess Fragrance looks out the window and sees them get inside the chaperone's car and drive away.)
Princess Fragrance: My prince! (she launches herself with her perfume gun and follows the car)
Marinette: (looks out the window) Tikki, please be okay.
Cat Noir: Can we open the windows? This fish smell is even too much for a cat.
(The chaperone opens all the car windows. Both Prince Ali and Cat Noir gasp for air.)
Tikki: (sneezes) (Prince Ali looks into his jacket pocket towards the noise)

title: Princess Fragrance/Transcript
text:
Princess Fragrance/Transcript - Intro
Prince Ali's chaperone: We have precisely nine minutes to get to the hospital. The prince is on a very strict schedule.
Cat Noir: What? No way we can go to the hospital now! We have to get Prince Ali out of Paris, ASAP!
(Everyone hears a thud and looks up.)
Princess Fragrance: My prince! Fancy seeing you here, what a stroke of luck!
Cat Noir: (to the chaperone) The windows!
(Prince Ali's chaperone tries to close all the car windows, but Princess Fragrance stops the sunroof.)
Princess Fragrance: My prince, I'll take you to the Pont des Arts, and there, we'll seal our love!
(Princess Fragrance then sprays everyone in the car. But Tikki escapes out of Prince Ali's pocket and lands on the car floor)
Hawk Moth: (from his lair) Cat Noir is down! It won't be long before Ladybug shows up too and meets her doom! (laughs)
Marinette: (gasps) Oh no! Where's Tikki? (runs to Prince Ali's chaperone's car, ignoring the accident around her. She took off her motorcycle helmet while running) Tikki? Tikki? (looks inside the car before noticing Tikki on the floor, then gasps) Tikki, I was so worried!
Tikki: (opens her eyes) Marinette...

title: Princess Fragrance/Transcript
text:
Princess Fragrance/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (picks up Tikki) You're much worse than I thought! We need to get you help!
Tikki: We don't have time. You need to transform. I'll be okay... (coughs)
Marinette: No, Tikki. I'm not making the same mistake twice! We've gotta get you to the healer now!
(Wang Fu is hitting a gong while Marinette stares at Tikki, feeling worried.)
Marinette: Is she gonna be okay?
Wang Fu: "One who is burning with impatience can never eat hot porridge."
Marinette: (confused) Um, what has this got to do with eating?
Wang Fu: Silence please. Reading energies. (places both his hands in front of Tikki) What type of cat did you say?
Marinette: Cat? Um, right. Rare hairless flying species from Kingdom of Achu. I was allowed to have one, because I won a zoo tap-dancing contest when I was in... the Kingdom of Achu. (laughs nervously)
(Wang Fu stares at Marinette)
Wang Fu: Mm-hmm. Unusual. (picks up his gong)
Marinette: Yes, yes, very.
(Wang Fu bangs the gong for the last time.)
Wang Fu: We are finished. (puts the gong down) Your cat's health has been restored.
(Marinette looks down at Tikki. To her delight, Tikki opens her eyes, feeling much better. Tikki flies into Marinette's hands.)

title: Princess Fragrance/Transcript
text:
Princess Fragrance/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Thank you, thank you so much! You're a real magician, sir! (about to walk out the door, but stops) How did you do that?
Wang Fu: Ancient Chinese secret. (Marinette closes the shop's door. Wang smiles) Just like yours.
Marinette: Tikki, I'm so, so sorry. You were so sick and, well, I don't know what I do without you.
Tikki: You wouldn't be Ladybug for one! (giggles)
Marinette: (laughs)  I know, but I mean. Tikki, you're more than just my kwami to me.
Tikki: I know. (Both Marinette and Tikki giggle while Tikki hugs Marinette's cheek) Oh, the Pont des Arts bridge! That's where they're headed! I overheard it in the car. Hurry, there's no time to lose!
[ Transformation Sequence ]Marinette: Tikki, spots on! Hah! (Marinette transforms into Ladybug)
(Princess Fragrance is marching toward Prince Ali, while held by André Bourgeois like a bride; Prince Ali is with his chaperone, Cat Noir and Chloé.)

title: Princess Fragrance/Transcript
text:
Princess Fragrance/Transcript - Intro
Princess Fragrance: (stops in front of Prince Ali and holds both of her hands to his) I can't wait for us to be together. ♫ Forever! ♫ Servants, love padlock, please. (Cat Noir opens a box to reveal a padlock with Princess Fragrance's perfume coming off of it) This will lock our love forever, my prince!
Prince Ali: ♫ At your service, Princess Fragrance! ♫
(A yo-yo appears and knocks the padlock out of Princess Fragrance's hands, into the Seine river.)
Princess Fragrance: My padlock! (gasps)
Ladybug: (from a lamp post near them) Not so fast, my royal pains in the neck!
Princess Fragrance: (fires her gun at Ladybug. Once it hits her, she slides down on the bridge. Princess Fragrance grins evilly, before it revealed that Ladybug has a clothespin on her nose)
Hawk Moth: (from his lair) Use Cat Noir to get Ladybug's Miraculous!
Princess Fragrance: Servants, attack! And take her earrings!

title: Princess Fragrance/Transcript
text:
Princess Fragrance/Transcript - Intro
(Ladybug starts to fight with Prince Ali's chaperone, André, Chloé, and Cat Noir. While she's distracted, Princess Fragrance grabs Prince Ali's wrist and sprays her perfume down taking him away with her. After knocking out the chaperone, André, and Chloé. Ladybug leaps away from Cat Noir before being hit by him.)
Ladybug: Snap out of it, Cat Noir! It's me, Ladybug!
Cat Noir: ♫ Give me your Miraculous! ♫
(Ladybug sighs and she continues to fight him. Meanwhile back at the Le Grand Paris, Princess Fragrance and Prince Ali are at the rooftop pool.)
Princess Fragrance: Who needs a padlock to secure our love when I can put everyone under my spell and make Paris our kingdom! (starts spraying the sky, forming a giant cloud of perfume)
Ladybug: Uh oh, I better do something before this whole thing blows up in my face. (gasps) Ah ha!
Ms. Mendeleiev: (flashback) What happens when you play about with flammable substances in a chemistry lab.

title: Princess Fragrance/Transcript
text:
Princess Fragrance/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: (sees the boat full of fireworks that André mentioned to Prince Ali earlier. She tosses her yo-yo around the lamp post behind her) Can't hit me! (Cat Noir continues to try hitting Ladybug) Miss! (giggles) (Cat Noir extends his staff, picking up Ladybug) Yeah!
(Once Ladybug lands on the boat, she pulls back the staff, lifting Cat Noir and making him land on the boat too.)
Ladybug: Nice of you to drop in.
Cat Noir: ♫ Give me your Miraculous! ♫
[ Superpower Sequence ]Cat Noir: ♫ Cataclysm! ♫
(Cat Noir runs toward Ladybug and he is about to use Cataclysm on her. But Ladybug trips him, making him to use it on the fireworks control panel instead, thus launching the fireworks into the sky. Ladybug grabs Cat Noir's tail and pulls him into the Seine river. She uses her yo-yo to go to the Le Grand Paris rooftop.)
<poem>
Princess Fragrance: This city is not for us. Too many people want to bother us. Let's go far away from here, my prince! Very far!
Ladybug: (above them) Leaving so soon? But the party just got started!
Princess Fragrance: (angry) You! You are ruining everything! So now I'll ruin you!
[ Superpower Sequence ]Ladybug: Lucky Charm! (a balloon appears)

title: Princess Fragrance/Transcript
text:
Princess Fragrance/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: A balloon? What am I supposed to do with this?
(Ladybug uses her Lucky Vision, and a fireworks tube and Princess Fragrance's perfume appear. She leaps down and picks up the tube, avoiding Princess Fragrance's perfume bullet.)
Princess Fragrance: You can't escape, Ladybug! It's over!
(Ladybug places the balloon inside the tube to form a makeshift dart. She tosses it, corking Princess Fragrance's perfume gun and contain the perfume in the balloon. She use her yo-yo to grab the gun and breaks it, releasing the akuma.)
Ladybug: No more evil-doing for you, little akuma. Time to de-evilize! (captures the akuma) Gotcha! (releases the purified butterfly) Bye bye, little butterfly.
<center>[ Superpower Sequence ]Ladybug: Miraculous Ladybug! (throws the Lucky Charm into the air and it turns everything back to normal)</center>
(At the Seine riverbank, Cat Noir is licking himself dry before turning back to normal.)
Cat Noir: What am I doing in here? And where's Ladybug?
(At the Pont des Arts, André Bourgeois and Prince Ali's chaperone are back to normal.)

title: Princess Fragrance/Transcript
text:
Princess Fragrance/Transcript - Intro
Prince Ali's chaperone: Ah, the schedule is a complete disaster! We are going to be late for everything! Where's the prince? Wait a minute, where am I?
(Back at the Le Grand Paris rooftop, both Prince Ali is back to normal and Princess Fragrance turns back into Rose at the same time and they don't remember what happened to them.)
Rose: Huh?
Prince Ali: How did I get here?
Rose: (stands up) Prince Ali? (rushes toward him and starts admiring him. She grabs his left arm by cuddling him while she giggles)
Prince Ali: (sees Ladybug) And who are you?
Ladybug: (giggles) Never mind, I'll leave you to chat with your number one fan. Bug out! (leaves and she gives Prince Ali and Rose some privacy)
Rose: Know how you always helping sick children around the world? And I just wanted you to know that you're the most kindhearted person I ever met!
Prince Ali: Really?
Chloé: (appears) Prince Ali! You're safe! (shoves Rose out the way) Aren't you glad I'm safe too? So, shall we continue where we left off?
Prince Ali: Oh, no thank you. I have a special event at the hospital for children with Miss Rose.
Rose: (gasps with excitement)

title: Princess Fragrance/Transcript
text:
Princess Fragrance/Transcript - Intro
Prince Ali: Let us go quickly before my chaperone locates me. (he and Rose leave. Together they go to the hospital)
Rose: (giggles) Bye, Chloé!
(Chloé growls and screams very angrily as she watches them leave.)
</poem>
