title: Protection
text:
Protection - Plot Development
Both Gabriel and Tomoe learn that their respective children are no longer dating each other and that Adrien is in love with Marinette and Kagami is helping them to be together. This causes Gabriel to be determined (and pressured by Tomoe) to separate Adrien from Marinette and have him to be Kagami's boyfriend again.
Ironically, Gabriel is unaware that he is partially responsible for his son being in love with Marinette. Despite Adrien starting to have feelings for her back in "The Puppeteer 2", he only started to see Marinette with new eyes in "Multiplication", when he, followed her advice back in "Risk", was able to tell his father he didn't want to be a model anymore, what caused him to realize how special she was and changed his life for the better. The only reason Marinette gave Adrien that advice was because both were under the influence of Risk's power, what led him to vent his frustrations to her.

title: Protection
text:
Protection - Plot Development
He unknowingly did this long before his son's and Marinette's feelings got this far. Due to him and Émilie using the Peacock Miraculous recklessly prior to the series and it resulting in her slumber, his father shutting him out but keeping him in making Adrien feel unloved. Which pushed his son's desire to leave the mansion and have friends. Starting his dark path as Hawk Moth back in "Origins", he set the stage for the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses to be released unaware that he is partially responsible for them ending up as heroes and leading them to develop feelings for each other.
By preventing him from doing his duties as Cat Noir in "Ephemeral", Gabriel is also partially responsible for them ending up together because of his decision he unintentionally put fear in Su-Han which caused him to force Marinette to discover her partner's identity then later reveals her.
This episode reveals that Lila and Adrien are no longer friends meaning that they officially stopped becoming one somewhere between "Transmission" and this episode.

title: Protection
text:
Protection - Trivia
The episode shares its name with the concept of the Turtle Miraculous.
This episode along with "Miraculer", reveals a new fact about the Shell-ter:
It seems that when the user (regardless of being a minor or not) activates Shell-ter more than once, they would only be able to materialize and maintain one barrier at a time.
The concept of Protection can be seen with people protecting something/someone throughout the episode:
Gabriel tried to protect the agreement he has with Tomoe by trying to separate Adrien and Marinette so the former can be with Kagami instead.
Nathalie managed to protect Adrien's freedom to love whoever he wants by telling him that he is free to love whoever he wants and not let anyone tell him otherwise.
Motivated by Lila's lies and manipulation, Kagami, as Riposte Prime, tries to protect Adrien from Marinette by encasing her inside a barrier.
Similar to "Backwarder" and "The Puppeteer 2", Adrien used the same defense move to protect Marinette from Riposte Prime as well as how equally he is protective towards Ladybug as his alterego.

title: Protection
text:
Protection - Trivia
Placide I.T. stood guard for Adrien and Marinette as they snuck up to the backyard to have their picnic and then went in their defense when Riposte Prime attacked them.
From here, since Kagami was aware of Marinette's identity as Ladybug in "Perfection", despite being akumatized in both occasions she never relayed the information to Monarch likely because she didn't believe it or couldn't prove it so deep down she didn't want to put one of her closest friends or the world in danger based upon lie. Knowing that the feelings Adrien has for Marinette is very real and had she put his lover in any danger she knew he be devastated, so like Nathalie, Kagami kept it secret to protect her friends, their happiness and world.
The concept of protection was applied in other episodes:
In "Befana", Alya and her friends tried to protect Marinette from the titular villain.
In "Anansi", Nora was very protective towards Alya.
Tom in "Weredad" was willing to defend his bakery and his daughter's heart as the titular villain.
Both Master Fu and Marinette shared a protective desire towards the Miraculouses.

title: Protection
text:
Protection - Trivia
Marinette has worked hard to protect her secret identity as Ladybug in order to protect the ones she loves, regardless of whom she may have to lie to, such as her own family, or the people she deeply cares for, such as Luka in "Truth", her friend group in "Gang of Secrets", Cat Noir in multiple instances in other episodes of season 4, and other examples.
The Turtle Miraculous represents protection and its many forms:
Through Nino as the current Turtle Miraculous holder Carapace, he uses his powers to shield anyone from harm.
Like how Ladybug, Cat Noir and their team protect everyone even those who have harmed them.
Cat Noir's protective nature towards loved ones in combat against akumatized villains.
By not telling the people about the absolute power of their miraculouses the heroes were protecting the people from themselves.
The magic spell placed on the kwamis acts as a way to protect their guardians and holders.
Such as with Kagami, due to pressure placed on her by her mother to be perfect, she put up protective walls around her true feelings, holding them back until she couldn't anymore, causing the protection walls to crumble.

title: Protection
text:
Protection - Trivia
Lila formed a protective barrier through her lies and manipulation to cover up her true identity from everyone except Marinette/Ladybug and Adrien/Cat Noir, as shown in "Volpina", Heroes' Day", "Chameleon", "Oni-Chan", "Perfection" and "Revelation". But once she was exposed of her true self in "Confrontation", she lost it.
Gabriel trying to protect Adrien from truth because he was afraid to lose him, but what he didn't know is that he has actually risked losing him on multiple occasions by putting him through multiple detrimental, near-death or actual death situations, such as in "Timebreaker", "Style Queen", "Miraculous Shanghai", "Miraculer", Cat Blanc", "Lies", "Rocketear", "Strikeback" and "Intuition".
To the point where even Nino mentioned in "Miraculous New York", because of Gabriel's protective nature towards Adrien, he was described as a "baby bird afraid to come out of his shell" or more likely Gabriel wouldn't let him out making him feel trapped.

title: Protection
text:
Protection - Trivia
Ladybug putting up more protective walls between her and Cat Noir in season 4, due to the intense pressure of being the guardian, combined with Shadow Moth's relentless hunting and wanting to protect him from being akumatized thanks to the Cat Blanc incident, she struggled to control everything, which led to her loss of the Miraculouses to Monarch.
Likely she also wanted to protect Cat Noir from himself aware of his protective yet caring nature she knew of his habit of leaping before he looked if she told him about everything she probably wouldn't be able to resist breaking down crying or venting in anger in front of him. Unable to bear her pain knowing that Monarch and others were responsible for it, he would do something hasty likely resulting in his akumatization, losing his Miraculous to Monarch or both.
Ladybug had also entrusted her teammates with the responsibility of protecting their respective Miraculous.
Gabriel's belief in himself and the power he had or desired represented his protective walls showing how little he believed, listened or trusted others to help with his problems.

title: Protection
text:
Protection - Trivia
As well as with Chloé in "Miraculer" and Luka in "Migration", because both the heroes and Luka knew due to their situation that Monarch would take advantage of the duo's desire to protect eventually lead to disaster.
Like in "Volpina", "Derision" and other episodes of how protection can be one sided or involve something like parasitic relationship.
Despite Tom and Nora's desire to protect was well intended, they went the wrong way about it, by turning the ones they cared about into prisoners which was usually presented as emotional protection for those who put them there.
In "Miraculous Paris", where the automatic detransformation of a minor miraculous holder protects the wearer expending too much vital energy.
Like how Gabriel and Nathalie came to each other's rescue in "Mayura" and "Ladybug", their form of protection led to further madness.
In "Conformation", due to his condition Adrien knew he was a threat with his ring and removed it so he could protect everyone from himself but still give them a fighting chance.
The Turtle also reminds us despite being comfortable in our shells we need to venture out of them and sometimes slow is the way to go and other times it's not.

title: Protection
text:
Protection - Trivia
Such as when Ladybug and Cat Noir swapped Miraculouses in "Reflekdoll" and "Passion".
In "Santa Claws", Gabriel realized he can't keep Adrien from the world or the people that are in it.
Where Ladybug had to do slow and careful planning in "Backwarder".
Through various episodes where Adrien had to learn to slow down in his love romances.
This is the seventh time Kagami gets akumatized following "Riposte", "Catalyst", "Mayura", "Oni-Chan", "Lies" and "Perfection". This time, however, she gets akumatized into Riposte Prime, a new variation of Riposte.
This is the third time Kagami's akumatization is caused by Lila's manipulations following "Oni-Chan" and "Perfection" (even fourth time if we count Kagami's first scarlet akumatization from "Heroes' Day" being caused by Volpina's illusion).
Nathaniel and Marc's plan contains references to "Mr. Pigeon 72" and "Gabriel Agreste".
At the end of their comic, Marinette and Adrien are shown with two sons and a daughter. It is possible these are Louis, Emma, and Hugo from "Stormy Weather".
It's revealed that, similar to Adrien and Marinette, Gabriel and Émilie come from different social classes.

title: Protection
text:
Protection - Trivia
Having in consideration that Émilie comes from an English aristocratic family, the Graham de Vanily, Gabriel originally belonged to a lower social class. This is further supported by what Audrey Bourgeois said in "Queen Wasp" about she being the reason why he became a famous fashion designer.
Adrien prepares a picnic for Marinette in the Agreste backyard, which is exactly what Gabriel did to his love Émilie as seen in "Evolution".
Coincidentally, Adrien asks Marinette the same as question as his father asked his wife, and both Marinette and Émilie answer with a simple "Yes".
It is hinted that Lila knows Gabriel is Monarch and is actively helping him claim victims. She tells Gabriel that Kagami's emotional instability regarding her conflictive feelings towards Adrien and Marinette would make a perfect target to Monarch once she gave her the little push, possibly being her way to manipulate Gabriel to akumatize Kagami.
There have been hints in previous episodes that suggested Lila knew about Gabriel's identity as the holder of the Butterfly Miraculous:

title: Protection
text:
Protection - Trivia
In "Ladybug", Lila makes a devious smile that suggested she figured out the real intent of Gabriel of having her discredit Marinette before everyone.
In "Strikeback", Lila is seen smiling as she noticed Nathalie coughing while talking on the phone, possibly knowing she was talking with Gabriel about his latest plan.
This is later confirmed in the post-end card scene of "Emotion".
This is the second time Lila tries to turn Kagami against Marinette, with the first one happening in "Perfection". This time, she tries to make Kagami believe that Marinette is a liar and manipulator that pretends to be clumsy and awkward to win over her friends sympathy so they can do whatever she wants.
Both attempts of Lila to break Marinette and Kagami's friendship resulted on the latter's akumatization, with the second being done on purpose.
Ironically, the way Lila described Marinette to Kagami is precisely the way she (Lila) is, as she is the one that lies and manipulates the others to get what she wants, all while pretending to be nice.

title: Protection
text:
Protection - Trivia
This is the sixth time Monarch's reason to akumatize someone doesn't have as a main purpose getting Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous or with that in mind, as Kagami's akumatization into Riposte Prime was meant to separate Adrien and Marinette or at least prepare the ground for their separation.
Following "The Collector" (where his main purpose was to prevent Ladybug and Cat Noir from figuring out his civilian identity), "Gorizilla" (where his main purpose was to track Adrien down), "Oni-Chan" (where her main purpose was to keep Lila away from Adrien), "Félix" (where his main purpose was to drive Félix and Amélie away from Paris) and "Gabriel Agreste" (where his main purpose is to force Félix to give back the ring he stole from him).
Kagami is the third person to know that Lila is a liar following Marinette and Adrien.
However, unlike the two of them who became very wary of her, she remains to be friends with her, still believing on Lila's desire to be her friend because she cares about her.
This is the first time where both Marinette and Adrien are seen in their pajamas.
Riposte Prime is a reference to the Optimus Prime from the Transformers franchise.

title: Protection
text:
Protection - Trivia
This is the fifth time Ladybug and Cat Noir land on top of each other following "Stormy Weather", "Sandboy", "Timetagger" and "Miraculous New York" but unlike the other times it was done in their civilian forms.
There are some differences from the original "Riposte":
Riposte Prime's sword wasn't merged with her hand.
Adrien's willing to fight her this time.
Her akumatization was set up.
This is the fourth episode where a Magical Charm gets destroyed following "Dearest Family", "Penalteam" and "Elation".
Kagami is also the first member of the French Miraculous superhero team to receive a second Magical Charm (and one with a different design).
Like Chloé in "Queen Banana" and Bob Roth in "Migration", Kagami too rejected the Magical Charm at first but unlike Chloé who did it out of hatred and anger, she did it cause the first Magical Charm given to her in "Perfection" had failed her and she didn't think it could help her with her problems. But with the help of her friends she accepted the Charm.
Similarities are seen between Kagami in this episode and "Perfection" and Chloé from "Miraculer" and "Miracle Queen":

title: Protection
text:
Protection - Trivia
Both cherished the bonds they had with the main female protagonist: for Chloé, it was Ladybug and for Kagami it was Marinette.
Both had their friendship with Marinette/Ladybug weakened by Lila that left them both vulnerable to akumatization.
Both rejected their Akumas but Chloé did it before the Akuma transformed her in "Miraculer" while Kagami did after she was akumatized in "Perfection".
Unlike Chloé in "Miracle Queen", Kagami and Marinette were able to make up and admit what they did wrong.
This is the thirteenth episode that features a post-credit scene, following "Miracle Queen", "Gabriel Agreste", "Optigami", "Sentibubbler", "Dearest Family", "Multiplication", "Jubilation", "Illusion", "Transmission", "Perfection", "Derision" and "Intuition".
This is the fifth not to feature Gabriel Agreste, following "Multiplication", "Jubilation", "Derision" and "Intuition".
Cat Noir recalls Kagami's adventures as Ryuko referring to "Ikari Gozen" and other episodes.
Adrien described Marinette to Kagami the same way he did when they first met in "Riposte".
Similar to Nino in "Rocketear", Gabriel saw what he wanted to see but didn't hear what needed to hear.

title: Protection
text:
Protection - Trivia
Even though, Kagami and Marinette didn't know it yet they both did the same thing to each other under their love trials.
As both were jealous towards the other and hurt towards themselves through their love for the same person Adrien.
In their bids to fix their egos or broken hearts they ended up hurting those around them.
The way Adrien brought video games to a picnic with Marinette is similar to the Monster Buster Club episode "The End of Everything Part 1", in which both characters have video games to their love interest.
When Nathaniel talks to Marinette, he says "We kinda thought you could just use a little kick in the a-" This is one of the few times profanity is used in the show (although cut off).
This is the eighth time where a Lucky Charm object breaks (excluding the broken plate in "Troublemaker") followed by "Robostus", "Weredad", "Miraculer", "Psycomedian", "Hack-San", "Miraculous Paris" and "Derision".
This is the first time where an akumatized villain breaks a Lucky Charm object.
This is one of the several times Cat Noir used Cataclysm to destroy the same object this time again it was Shell-ter shield which was in "Evolution" and "Reunion".

title: Protection
text: Protection - Trivia This is the second episode of Season 5 in which Kaalki is absent, following "Derision". The screen where Marinette and Adrien play video games is a hologram with an identical display to that of the Alliance rings. This is likely another feature of the Alliance. This is further proven, when Socqueline mentions in "Jubilation" that Alliance has also games. Errors When Marinette runs away the flower on Zoé's shirt is missing. When Monarch absorbs Wayzz's power, the cage is silver instead of blue. Kitty Section and Nathaniel's cabin comes after Adrien and Marinette's, however, at the end of the ride, they are already seen waiting for Adrien and Marinette at the bottom. When Gabriel bursts into Nathalie's room after seeing Adrien and Marinette together, one of her eyes is green, the other's blue. de:Schutz es:Protección fr:Protection (épisode) it:Protezione pl:Ochrona pt-br:Proteção (episódio) ru:Защита (эпизод)

title: Protection/Transcript
text:
Protection/Transcript - Intro
[ Theme Song ]
Lila: Here. (gives Kagami her water bottle) You need to hydrate more, you know?
Kagami: (grabs the water bottle) Thanks.
(Upon opening the bottle and drinking from it, Kagami's phone vibrates an alert.)
Kagami: It's time. I'm sorry. (grabs her bag) I have to go to meet the others.
Lila: You don't need to apologize. It's not your fault that Marinette hates me for no reason. Just go. (Kagami nods and stands up from the bench) I admire you so much, you know? I don't know how you do it. (giggles) I, too, was in love with the boy once. When he didn't want to see me anymore, I was in pain for so long I couldn't get him out of my head. But you managed to turn your love for Adrien into a friendship. You even helped Marinette get closer to him. If it hadn't been for your big heart, none of what's happening today would be happening today. You're so perfect, Kagami. I'm proud to have you as my best friend.
Kagami: (gasps) "Best friend"? Really?
Lila: (nods) Mhm.
(Kagami walks away with a smile.)
Marc: Alright! That's it! You both finally know you're in love with each other. Under normal circumstances, that would've been a done deal long ago!

title: Protection/Transcript
text:
Protection/Transcript - Intro
(On the other side, Nathaniel's group takes care of Marinette.)
Nathaniel: ...but since you two lovebirds are the most awkwar— I mean, the shyest kids on earth, Marc and I thought you could use a kick in the ahh— a little help!
(Marinette opens the manga created by Marc and Nathaniel as the illustrated montage begins.)
Marc: Our plan is to help you live out a magical moment that will make you want to kiss each other, without needing to say a word! So, we've reserved a pod on the Ferris wheel just for the two of you!
Nathaniel: The place will be magical!
Marc: Your pod is programmed to stop at the exact moment the sun sets over the city.
Nathaniel: The view will be magical!
Marc: There, pigeons trained by Mr. Ramier will release rose petals to rain all around you.
Nathaniel: The moment will be magical!
(Their illustrated montage cuts out.)
Adrien: But I'm allergic to pigeons!
Marc: There's no risk since you'll be in a pod! A pod streaming Kitty Section's romantic music LIVE!
Nathaniel: Even the sound will be magical!
Marc: It'll finally be kissy-time!
Nathaniel: MAAAAGIC!!
Marc: A camera will allow us to make sure that everything's going according to plan.

title: Protection/Transcript
text:
Protection/Transcript - Intro
Nathaniel: The magic of the kiss!
Marc: And that way, you'll have a photo of your first kiss! And from there…
Marc and Nathaniel: …Tada! Perfect love for life!
Marinette: (closes the manga) But… I can’t kiss him! I mean, of course I want to kiss him! But I haven't even been able to tell him that I love him yet! Can't I just hold his hand for starters…
Nathaniel: But that's just it! If you kiss, you won't have to tell him anything! Kissing is a miracle cure for all your problems!
Marc: A kiss can wake a princess and bring her back to life!
Nino: (reaches up to Adrien’s shoulder, who stands unamused) It makes the birds sing and (twirls behind Adrien) the squirrels dance!
Marc: So you two just turn off your brains, follow the comic book, kiss each other, and that's it: end of the show, everything is magically sorted out!
Nathaniel: Hence the name: "magic kiss"!
Marinette: (unamused) I'm not so sure. What are you basing that on?
Marc: Just about every fairy tale, shoujou manga and Hollywood romantic comedy ever!
Adrien: (surprised) Oh? And it works in real life too? Who knew!
Marinette: (to Nathaniel) But what if I need to get out?

title: Protection/Transcript
text:
Protection/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: (to Marc, rubbing the back of his neck) What if… Marinette wants to leave? I wouldn't want her to feel cornered or pressured into anything…
Marc: But that's the whole idea of the magic kiss! You can't escape it. you can't escape destiny!
Marinette (sighs) I don't know... Can't we just wait for things to happen in their own time?
Kagami: If you're waiting for Adrien to do something, then you can be certain nothing will happen.
Rose: (v.o., from the speaker) One, two, three!♪ Don’t need to skyrocket ♪♪ Don’t need no deep pockets ♪♪ Be a prince and princess if you need tenderness— ♪
(Nino disrupts the music sequence by going wild but off-key over the electric guitar.)
Nathaniel: (annoyed) Stop— STOP! Nino, have you never touched a guitar before??
Nino: Uh, no, dude. This is my very first time!
Nathaniel: (v.o., from the speaker) Well, then why did you replace Luka??
Nino: Well, it didn't look so hard when he was playing it!
Marc: (from the other cabin) It's no big deal. It's okay. Stay focused!
Alya: (from the other cabin) You can do this!
(Down the ferris wheel, Mr. Ramier uses his pigeon call to let his pigeons fly according to plan.)
Marc: Kiss in nine, eight, seven...

title: Protection/Transcript
text:
Protection/Transcript - Intro
Adrien and Marinette: (bummed out) Can we get off now?
Kitty Section and Nathaniel: NO!
Marc: Three, two, one...
(The ferris wheel stops with Adrien and Marinette's cabin at the peak, leaving them frustrated. Both sides of the gang continue to watch the two, crestfallen. As all of them got off their cabins[error 1], Adrien and Marinette join them at the bottom of the ferris wheel, all of them dissatisfied as the plan failed.)
Marc: That's okay. We'll find something else.
Marinette: Don't bother. It's not you, it's me. I don't have the magic in me!
(Marinette runs away, leaving Adrien in distraught with the gang.)
Gabriel: More tea?
Tomoe: Don't change the subject, Gabriel-san. Why are you so anxious to move up the date of the Diamonds' Ball?
Gabriel: Oh, it's just a... scheduling issue.
Tomoe: Your lies show an unexpectable lack of respect!
Gabriel: I'm not lying!
Tomoe: (grabs Gabriel's left cataclysmed arm, making him grunt in pain) Your heart beats louder than a Taiko Drum! Why do you want to move up the date?
Gabriel: (painfully breaking free from Tomoe's hold) Because I don't have much time left. (slightly rolls up his sleeve to show his cataclysmed arm)

title: Protection/Transcript
text:
Protection/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: I've always seen Marinette acting funny in my presence. I thought that was just the way she was. I thought it was sweet. I thought it was just her charm. But now that I know it's because she loves me and she freaks out about telling me, I feel bad. Because it means that this whole time she's been uncomfortable around me, and I haven't done anything to help her.
Kagami: But you didn't know.
Adrien: It doesn't take away from her suffering. I just wish she could feel more at ease when she's with me. Otherwise, one day, it'll be too late and she'll give up.
Kagami: What can I do to help, Adrien?
Adrien: Thanks, but it's not up to you or anyone else to help. I'm the one who's gotta do something.
(Tomoe takes a peek at the kitchen to eavesdrop on Adrien and Kagami.)
Adrien: I know everyone wants to see us happy together but it's putting a lot of pressure on us. With or without kissing, With or without kissing, the important thing is that we feel good when we're together, right? I'd do anything to make that happen! (rubs the back of his head)
Kagami: Looks like your doubts are finally gone.
Adrien: Yes, Kagami. I'm ready.
Tomoe: (to Gabriel) Made for each other. Just as planned.

title: Protection/Transcript
text:
Protection/Transcript - Intro
Gabriel: Perfection calls for perfection.
Kagami: (to Adrien) What are you doing?
Adrien: (typing on his phone) I'm going to prepare a special picnic, for just the two of us, no friends around, no outside pressure. And I'm inviting Marinette right now. Hopefully she can be herself, (Tomoe and Gabriel gasp in shock in the unexpected turn of events.) and finally open her heart and soul to me, free of her fears.
Kagami: You've changed, Adrien.
Adrien: Thanks to you, Kagami.
Kagami: Marinette is a very lucky girl.
Tikki: A message from Adrien!
Marinette: Oh, no! It was just a matter of time— after last night, he's finally figured out how pathetic I really am, and he's calling it quits!
Tikki: Marinette, you have to take things as they are, not the way you think they're going to be. Read the message!
Marinette: (sits up on her bed timidly and grabs her phone to view the message) Oh!
Tikki: So, what does it say?

title: Protection/Transcript
text:
Protection/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: He's inviting me over to his home! Just the two of us! (crawls out and gets off of her bed, then walks round and round to contemplate) What should I wear? How should I greet him? Should I kiss him on the cheek or shake his hand? What if there are awkward silences that need to be filled?? (continues to spin around in place) Oh, I'm never gonna have time to prepare any talking points! (plops on her chaise lounge)
Tikki: (with her arms crossed) Marinette...
Marinette: You're right, Tikki. No more complicated plans! I have to take things as they are! I'm not going to plan anything! In fact, I'm not even going to change my clothes!
Tikki: But Marinette, you're wearing your pajamas!
Marinette: (stops for a while to check on herself) Well, precisely! If he really loves me, he'll love me in my pajamas too!
Tomoe: All of our plans are falling apart! You were supposed to control your son, Gabriel!
Gabriel: And you, your daughter!
Tomoe: My daughter's so perfect she doesn't need me to control her! (points her bokken at Gabriel)
Gabriel: (pushes away Tomoe's bokken with his finger) Well, it appears she does.

title: Protection/Transcript
text:
Protection/Transcript - Intro
Tomoe: It's not my child who's falling for someone completely wrong for her!
Gabriel: But she seems to be the one encouraging him!
Tomoe: Take control of your son, and she'll have nothing left to encourage. Organize the dance as soon as possible. Don't fail in capturing Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous. It is imperative that this situation be resolved before you... leave!
Tomoe: Kagami, we're going. (walks out the kitchen as Kagami follows behind her)
Gabriel: (to Adrien) I didn't know that you and Kagami weren't seeing each other anymore. You were such a... perfect couple. It's a shame.
Adrien: Kagami's perfect, but... not perfect for me.
Gabriel: You underestimate yourself. You and Kagami are... of the same design.
Adrien: I just feel better with Marinette.
Gabriel: You're clinging to Marinette because her mediocrity allows you to shine with less effort. But you're better than that.
Adrien: There's no one better than Marinette, Dad! If only you knew her! She's generous, funny, creative, brave! Mom told me about how you met. You too came from two different worlds, but that didn't stop you from loving each other! Why shouldn't it be the same for Marinette and me?

title: Protection/Transcript
text:
Protection/Transcript - Intro
Gabriel: (starts fidgeting with his ring from behind) Adrien, I'm your father. I know what's best for you better than you do. That is why I'm forbidding you to have any relationship with Marinette Dupain-Cheng.
(Adrien frowns at his remark.)
Kagami: I know I've disappointed you, Mother. But much to my regret, love cannot be controlled.
Tomoe: Don't try to convince me that you don't love him anymore.
Kagami: He loves Marinette, and Marinette is my friend. Some knots can't be undone.
Tomoe: When the knot cannot be undone, the samurai cuts right through it.
(Kagami looks down, frustrated.)
Plagg: You're not going to let your father tell you what to do, are you?
Adrien: What do you want me to do, Plagg? He's my father... (proceeds to send his message to Marinette)
Marinette: (brings out her phone from her pouch) "I'm sorry. You can't come. I can't talk to you."
Tikki: Are you gonna be okay?
Marinette: It's probably because his father wouldn't allow it again. That's okay, we'll see each other some other time. Nothing to worry about at all. You have to take things as they are, don't you?
(She begins to walk back to her home as Tikki giggles at her remark.)

title: Protection/Transcript
text:
Protection/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: (sighs heavily) Father forbids to have any relationship with Marinette. But how am I supposed to do that when we're in the same class?
(Nathalie is taken aback after knowing what his father told him to do. Thinking of ways to make him happy, she looks at the ring that Gabriel entrusted to her and clenches her fists.)
Nathalie: Adrien, listen to me. When it comes to your love life, you’re free to decide whatever you want to do. Don’t let anyone else tell you how to act. Not now, not ever.
Adrien: You're right, Nathalie. I don't know what came over me. (brings out his phone again, opening it to message Marinette once more)
Marinette: (checks on her phone and gasps) He's available again! See? He’s acting completely random— he’s perfect for me! And you're right: it doesn't change a thing whether I worry or not! So why worry? Come on, let's go.
Tikki: Since we're back home, why don't you get changed before we leave again?

title: Protection/Transcript
text:
Protection/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: No way, Tikki! What if it breaks the magic of the moment? You start putting on socks and the next thing you know, you're making foolish plans all over again. I've decided that I'll be in my pajamas, so pajamas, it is! (goes down the stairs and Tikki follows her)
Adrien: (after grabbing the wicker basket from Gorilla) Thank you.
(Gorilla goes in the other direction to check if anyone saw them sneaking. Just before Adrien could open the door, he notices Marinette wearing her pajamas, which caused Marinette to become quite embarrassed.)
Adrien: I, uh, forgot something.  (gives Marinette the basket) Don't go anywhere. (He runs to the door, leaving Marinette in the kitchen, puzzled. He comes back a few seconds later, changed in his pajamas as well...) It's better this way. (...to which Marinette smiles.)
Marinette: (leaning on the stone fence) Wow!
(The two of them sit on the picnic blanket. Marinette wonders what the picnic basket is for.)
Marinette: Adrien, what's in there?
Adrien: Take a look! (opens the basket revealing two game controllers, a game console and a whole lot of video games)
Marinette: (wide-eyed) Wooooow!
Adrien: Ah, maybe you would rather watch a movie...?

title: Protection/Transcript
text:
Protection/Transcript - Intro
(Marinette suddenly throws one of the game controllers at him with a smug smile.)
Marinette: You're kidding, right?
Gabriel: (upon realization) Nathalie...!
(He barges into Nathalie's room to confront her.)
Gabriel: ...you gave Adrien a counter-order?!
Nathalie: The power you have over Adrien doesn't mean you could go that far!
(Gabriel gazes upon the ring he entrusted to Nathalie.)
Gabriel: You... were right, Nathalie. (forcibly smiles but shifts to a scowl as he walks out the room)
Kagami: My mother would like me to get closer to Adrien, and I think I've fallen in love with him again. But... I don't want to cause them any hurt. They're my friends, and they're obviously meant to be together. I feel so weak for being a victim of my own feelings...
Lila: (suddenly hugs Kagami) It must be so hard! But just know that I'll always be here for you. (sneaks in to send a message through her Alliance behind Kagami) Oh! I'm sorry, someone's trying to call me. I'll be right back. (She walks to hide behind a tree and her Alliance rings.) Mr. Agreste, I was just about to call you.

title: Protection/Transcript
text:
Protection/Transcript - Intro
Gabriel: (on call) You were supposed to keep an eye out on my son, most importantly, protecting him from toxic people like this Marinette Dupain-Cheng!
Lila: Things are already in motion, sir. I believe you know Kagami Tsurugi? (looks at Kagami over her shoulder) This young lady needs to be perfect so badly that she sees any emotion she might be feeling as weakness. And it's devastating every time. So much so that she's already fallen prey to Monarch more than once!
Gabriel: (gasps) What does this have to do with me??
Lila: Kagami is in love with your son. This whole story with Marinette and Adrien is breaking her heart. Monarch will probably turn her into a supervillain soon. If Marinette and Adrien learn that their love was hurting their friend, it would poison their relationship in the end. What a sad situation, don't you think?
Gabriel: (on-call) All that's left to do is... wait, then?
Lila: Exactly. Just wait. (sneers)
(Lila returns to Kagami who is seen melancholically holding the little handmade picture frame that Marinette gave her with their picture together as a symbol of their friendship.)

title: Protection/Transcript
text:
Protection/Transcript - Intro
Lila: I'm sorry, that was my mother. She couldn't remember where she put her— (sees Kagami looking at Marinette's gift to her) Oh...! I wish I didn't have to tell you this, but I can't stand to see you suffer like this anymore! You can't attach so much importance to your friendship with Marinette! She doesn't feel the same way. (Kagami gasps in disbelief.) I know this because I've been through such similar pain myself.
Kagami: (suspicious) What are you talking about...?? Marinette isn't like that! She's the nicest girl I know! She's always trying to help others!
Lila: That's what she got me to believe, too, at first... until I finally opened my eyes. If you look closely, it's not Marinette helping everyone else; it's everyone helping Marinette. (Kagami gasps once again, starting to feel betrayed.) She pretends to be weak in order to take advantage of all of you! As a result, you all feel like you have to help her! Poor Adrien... Since you two are no longer a couple, he's got no one to protect him. He, too, has fallen into her clutches without realizing it.

title: Protection/Transcript
text:
Protection/Transcript - Intro
(Scene flashbacks to when Kagami was with Adrien in the kitchen back in his home, and so she starts to become manipulated by Lila's lies.)
Lila: Don't you think it's weird that Marinette only ever stutters, faceplants, acts all uncomfortable in front of Adrien? That's because from the beginning, she's set her eyes on him. With people as perfect as you and Adrien, things are bound to work. You're the ones who should be together. You're the ones who belong together.
(With Lila successfully spurting every single misinformation to brainwash Kagami, Kagami feels betrayal.)
Kagami: There's no way... I... I need to talk to Marinette...!
Lila: Don’t waste your time. Manipulators like her always manage to lie their way out of trouble. And of course, Adrien would stand up for her. Toxic people like that are dangerous, and you just need to get as far away from them as possible, as soon as you can. I know it's terrible, but there's nothing else we can do...
(Kagami seethes with anger.)
Monarch: Lila Rossi was right. Kagami's emotions are powerful! Luckily, I have just the recipe to reconcile her! (creates a megakuma)

title: Protection/Transcript
text:
Protection/Transcript - Intro
Lila: No, you mustn't let yourself get so upset. Not you. You're too... (sneers upon noticing the megakuma) perfect.
(The megakuma effortlessly breaks the barrier created by the magical charm and enters the handmade picture frame that Kagami's holding.)
Monarch: Riposte Prime, I am Monarch. To help you take revenge, I am giving you back your powers! But this time, to help you cut through the veil of lies, I am also giving you an extra weapon... Wayzz, (Wayzz's pod hovers toward Monarch...) your power is now mine! (...and absorbs his power.) Transfer! (transmits the power of Protection to Kagami's Alliance ring) I am entrusting you with the essence of the Miraculous of Protection. What good is a sword without a shield?
Kagami: It's time to unmask Marinette Dupain-Cheng! (succumbs to the akumatization and transforms into Riposte Prime)
Marinette: What do you see in that one? (points at one of the clouds)
Adrien: A horse! (He points at one of the clouds, too.) How about that one?

title: Protection/Transcript
text:
Protection/Transcript - Intro
(In Marinette's point of view, the cloud that Adrien pointed out shows in the shape of both of them kissing, which makes her cheeks flush. In a few seconds, she timidly moves her hand to touch Adrien's. To his surprise, he blushes at the touch and smiles, proceeding to completely grab hold of Marinette's hand. They continue to gaze at the clouds, hands never letting go of each other.  Meanwhile, Gabriel goes back to the atelier and spies between Adrien and Marinette by the window, unyielding. Back in the courtyard, Adrien and Marinette turn to look at each other.)
Adrien: Are you sure you're ready?
Marinette: Yes.
(The two now face each other, forehead to forehead, preparing for a kiss. Gabriel, by his office window, hisses in anger upon seeing them, but grins upon seeing his akumatized villain arrive off-screen.)
Adrien: I've never admired the clouds in my pajamas with anyone before....is it always this amazing?
Marinette: Adrien, I...
Riposte Prime: How convenient! (Marinette and Adrien see her standing on top of the courtyard walls) All that awkwardness, all that hesitation that made you so charming... The moment you get what you want, they disappear?

title: Protection/Transcript
text:
Protection/Transcript - Intro
Adrien and Marinette: Kagami???
Riposte Prime: No, I am Riposte Prime!! (leaps down to attack them with her sword as Marinette and Adrien are able to evade it) Adrien! Move away from that liar right now!
Adrien: Kagami, we've talked about this! Marinette's finally less afraid now!
(Gabriel watches everything that's happening from his window and walks away shortly.)
Riposte Prime: You pathetic, naïve fool! You were too weak to take the initiative when it came to loving me, but now you're ready and willing! Would you have gone this far if it weren't for her little act??
(Gorilla ambushes Riposte Prime from behind only to get touched by her sword and imprisoned inside an indestructible sphere.)
Riposte Prime: Another chump who tried to protect Marinette and is now paying the price!
(Riposte Prime gets a glimpse Adrien running to take Marinette inside the mansion and keep her safe.)
Adrien: (points at the bathroom) Hide there, I'll get help!
Riposte Prime: (breaks in the room through the window) Too late!
Marinette: Kagami, what's happened to you?? There has to be some misunderstanding. If I hurt you without realizing it, tell me! I'll do anything to make it up to you!

title: Protection/Transcript
text:
Protection/Transcript - Intro
Riposte Prime: You're good. You almost had me fooled again! (strikes to attack Marinette, only to be blocked by Adrien with his saber)
Adrien: Run, Marinette!
(Marinette exits the room. Adrien and Riposte Prime begins parrying with their sabers until she disarms and corners him.)
Riposte Prime: (pointing her sword at Adrien) Stay here, my sweet Adrien. I'm going to take care of Marinette and stop her from hurting everyone else around her! (touches Adrien with her sword and confines him inside the indestructible sphere, freeing Gorilla in the courtyard) And then, we can finally be happy again. You and me.
Adrien: No!!
(Riposte Prime jumps out of the window and begins her hunt for Marinette.)
Riposte Prime: You really are a great actress!
Marinette: Kagami, listen!
Riposte Prime: Never again! (touches Marinette with her sword and captures her in a sphere, setting Adrien free in his room)
Adrien: We gotta bring Kagami to her senses! Plagg. claws out! (transforms into Cat Noir)
(Back at the Place du Châtelet, Riposte Prime taps the sphere with her sword, securing Marinette inside.)
Riposte Prime: In here, your little puppy eyes won't fool anyone anymore!

title: Protection/Transcript
text:
Protection/Transcript - Intro
Tikki: (to Marinette) Turn into Ladybug! Maybe your Lucky Charm will help you get out of this prison!
Marinette: Then, everyone will know that Marinette is Ladybug! I'm stuck!
Cat Noir: Kagami!
(Riposte Prime and Marinette turn to look at Cat Noir.)
Marinette: (gasps) Cat Noir!
Cat Noir: Kagami, we've been on the same side before. You used the Miraculous of the Dragon as Ryuko. Trust me... put the sword down.
Riposte Prime: Don't try to manipulate me! (begins parrying with Cat Noir)
Marinette: Oh, kitty, I know you can't hear me, but do what you usually do: cataclysm before you think and it'll be perfect! Please, please, please, pretty-please!
(Riposte Prime and Cat Noir continue on their parry until he bounces over her and reaches the sphere where Marinette is kept captive.)
Cat Noir: Cataclysm!! (disintegrates the sphere, setting Marinette free)
Marinette: Thank you, Cat Noir! Oh! I was so scared!
Cat Noir: Get to safety!
Riposte Prime: (enraged) NO!!
(Cat Noir and Riposte Prime continue their sword parry as Marinette takes this an advantage to hide and transform under a bridge.)
Marinette: Tikki, spots on!
(She transforms into Ladybug)
[Superpower Sequence]
Ladybug: Lucky Charm!

title: Protection/Transcript
text:
Protection/Transcript - Intro
(receives a bottle of olive oil)
Ladybug: Olive oil?
(Back at the Place du Châtelet, Ladybug wraps her yo-yo around Riposte Prime's arm, stopping her to strike another blow.)
Ladybug: Hi, kitty cat!
Cat Noir M'lady! Just in time!
(Riposte Prime pulls Ladybug down from the statue.)
Riposte Prime: There's no honor in defending a liar!
Cat Noir: We already saved that girl before. She can't be what you say she is!
Ladybug: Cat Noir is right. You're mistaken!
Riposte Prime: You can't pretend to know someone you just crossed paths with! I know her better than you do!
(Ladybug uses her vision to come up with a plan in de-akumatizing Riposte Prime, as she looks at the bottle of olive oil she's holding, at Cat Noir and Riposte Prime's saber.)
Ladybug: How about a well-oiled baseball game?
(She throws the bottle of olive oil at Riposte Prime, causing her to slice it in half and spilling the olive oil on herself.)
Cat Noir: Hey! She ruined our fun!
(Now in an advantage, Cat Noir rushes at Riposte Prime to continue the battle and hooks the saber off her hand as it is coated in oil. He tosses this in the air for Ladybug to break it and free the megakuma.)

title: Protection/Transcript
text:
Protection/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: No more evil-doing for you, megakuma! (opens her yo-yo) Time to de-evilize! (captures and purifies the megakuma) Gotcha! (opens her yo-yo to free the purified butterfly) Bye-bye, little butterfly!
[Superpower Sequence]
Ladybug: Miraculous Ladybug!
(tosses the bottle of olive oil in the air and clears all the damages caused by Riposte Prime)
(As the magical ladybugs reorganize everything, Riposte Prime reverts back to Kagami. Ladybug opens her yo-yo once again to give Kagami a brand new magical charm.)
Ladybug: Kagami. Take this magical cha—
Kagami: (lets go of Ladybug's hand) It won't solve my problems.
(Ladybug frowns and looks at the charm on her hand.)
Ladybug: Uh— Cat Noir! I— I... have an urgent appointment. Thanks! Bug out! (gives Cat Noir the magical charm and swings away)
Cat Noir: Well, uh, bye then! (reaches to give Kagami the magical charm but still refuses to accept it, making him frown as well)
Marinette: Kagami! (runs towards them) Kagami!!
(Kagami scoffs at Marinette, to her shock.)
Cat Noir: Uh, well... I'll leave you to it, then. (gives the charm to Marinette and vaults away)
Marinette: What happened to you, Kagami?

title: Protection/Transcript
text:
Protection/Transcript - Intro
Kagami: Please forgive me, Marinette. Even though you lied to and manipulated me, that did not give me the right to attack you like I did.
Marinette: Huh? Why do you think I would do that all of a sudden? I thought we were friends?
Kagami: Lila... opened my eyes.
Marinette: (gasps) Lila... (her face shifts into disbelief) Look, I don't know what she told you, but...
Kagami: She warned me that you'd always manipulate your way out with lies.
Adrien: Then, maybe you'll listen to me. Marinette's not a liar nor a manipulator. (walks towards them) She's brave, generous. She listens to others. Unlike Lila, her actions prove it every day. And that's why I love her. I'm sure deep down, you can feel it, too.
(Kagami begins to cry. Adrien and Marinette take her in for an embrace.)
Kagami: I'm sorry. I let my emotions get the better of me again and cloud my judgment. I'm so weak. Please forgive me.
Marinette: Don't try to push your emotions away. Look them in the eye. Acknowledge them. Figure out what they're trying to tell you, (places the magical charm in Kagami's hand) and turn them into energy to move forward. That's real strength. Love yourself the way you are...

title: Protection/Transcript
text:
Protection/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: ...Just like we love you the way you are.
(Kagami turns to look at them again and sinks to her knees, breaking down in tears.)
Kagami: I love you both! (Marinette and Adrien take her in for another embrace.) I truly wish you two being in love wasn't so painful to me, but it is.
Marinette: We're sorry.
Kagami: (sobbing) It's not your fault...
Adrien: Want to try again?
Marinette: I... I'm going to head home. You're not mad, right?
Adrien: I understand. It's alright. You have all the time in the world.
(Marinette stands up from the blanket and makes her way out of the mansion, to which Gabriel grins as his plan to separate her and Adrien worked yet again.)
Gabriel: The worm is in the fruit. It's only a matter of time until their relationship becomes spoiled.
Lila: (on-call) Why don't you find another partner for your son so you can control him better?
Gabriel: I'll think about it. (ends the call and looks ahead considerately)
Lila: Oh, Kagami! I was so scared for you! All because of that horrible Mari--

title: Protection/Transcript
text:
Protection/Transcript - Intro
Kagami: Quiet. I'm going to try to tell you how I feel as best I can. I don't know why you think these things about Marinette. I think you're wrong about her. I love Marinette. But I love you, too. I'll still be your friend if your friendship is genuine. But you won't use me against her. I am NOT a puppet.
Lila: Of course, I'm being genuine with you. I'm sorry if I ever led you to believe that I was trying to turn you against Marinette. That was never my intention. I just wanted to share my feelings with an open heart... with my best friend! (gives Kagami a hug, to which Kagami smiles, not knowing her true intentions)

The Pont de Grenelle-Cadets de Saumur, formerly known as  is a bridge which crosses the Seine and passes through the Île aux Cygnes in Paris, France. Starting from season 6, the Pont de Grenelle has been replaced by the Pont de Bir-Hakeim.

title: Portcullis House
text:
Portcullis House - Intro
The  is an office building for members of the Parliament of the United Kingdom located in the city of Westminster in London.

title: Portcullis House
text:
Portcullis House - Description
Built in 2001, Portcullis House is a five-storey Gothic Revival building with grey accents reminiscent of the architectural style of the Palace of Westminster. Situated on the banks of the Thames and right next to Elisabeth Tower, Portcullis House has rows of tall chimneys that are very distinctive.
Portcullis House is an office building for MPs serving in both houses of the Parliament of the United Kingdom. Each floor is unofficially assigned to a political party. There are various conference and meeting rooms named after British political figures. There are also some food shops reserved for MPs and their guests.
Directly opposite Big Ben is one of the entrances to Westminster tube station.

title: Portcullis House
text:
Portcullis House - Trivia
For security reasons, Portcullis House is the main access point to Parliament.
This access is via an underground passage.

title: Pont de Bir-Hakeim
text:
Pont de Bir-Hakeim - Intro
The  is a road and rail bridge that crosses the Seine and connects the 15th arrondissement to the 16th arrondissement with access upstream from the Île aux Cygnes.

title: Pont de Bir-Hakeim
text:
Pont de Bir-Hakeim - Description
Built in 1905 according to designs by Louis Biette by the Daydé & Pillé company, the Pont de Bir-Hakeim is a 237-meter-long and 24.7-meter-wide steel bridge spanning the Seine. Built as a cantilever, the bridge is supported by steel brackets set in masonry piers built over the Seine, as well as by a masonry arch over the Île aux Cygnes (Swan Island. At the niche level, cast iron statues by Gustave Michel representing sailors and blacksmiths stand.
The bridge has a first level intended for car, pedestrian, and bicycle traffic. This level slopes slightly from the left bank to the right bank and has a staircase providing access to the Île aux Cygnes (Swan Island. At the tip of the island is "Renaissance France," an equestrian statue by Holger Wederkinch donated in 1930 by the Danish community of Paris.

title: Pont de Bir-Hakeim
text:
Pont de Bir-Hakeim - Description
The second level is a 12-meter-wide steel viaduct composed of two rows of slender colonnades 6.90 meters high above a central pedestrian and bicycle island. Supported in the center by a masonry arch at the level of the Île aux Cygnes, it carries two lanes of traffic for the elevated subway. The central arch is decorated with four bas-relief allegories: "Science" and "Work" by Jules Coutan upstream, and "Electricity" and "Commerce" by Jean-Antoine Injalbert downstream.
This bridge is particularly popular for its view of the Eiffel Tower.

title: Pont de Bir-Hakeim
text:
Pont de Bir-Hakeim - Trivia
Before season 6, the Pont de Bir-Hakeim had only appeared in the movie.
In the series, starting with season 6, its location has been swapped with the Pont de Grenelle.

title: Pont de Bir-Hakeim/Movie
text:
Pont de Bir-Hakeim/Movie - Trivia
The Pont de Bir-Hakeim has been classified as a historical monument since July 10, 1986.
Until June 18, 1949, the bridge was called the Passy Bridge.
The bridge was named the Pont de Bir-Hakeim by Charles de Gaulle on June 18, 1949, in commemoration of the Battle of Bir-Hakeim, a strategic victory of the Free French against the Third Reich and the Kingdom of Italy in Libya in 1942, during World War II.

title: Potters Fields Park
text:
Potters Fields Park - Intro
is a bascule bridge in London that crosses the River Thames and connects the boroughs of Southwark and Tower Hamlets. It is one of the main symbols and tourist attractions of the English capital.

title: Potters Fields Park
text:
Potters Fields Park - Description
Located on the south bank of the Thames, at the end of The Queen's Walk, Potters Fields Park is a 3.5-acre park in the London Borough of Southwark.
Built in the heart of the city, the park is divided into four main meadows. It features brightly colored trees, peaceful paths, and colorful gardens with over 50 plant species, such as echinacea and wild peonies in summer, and deep purple buttercups and thorny rhizomes in winter.
Its location offers panoramic views of Tower Bridge, the Tower of London, and the City skyline, making it a popular destination for both Londoners and tourists.
Numerous events take place here regularly, such as food festivals and performances.

title: Potters Fields Park
text:
Potters Fields Park - Trivia
As seen in "Climatiqueen" and "Daddycop", Chloé shoots some of the videos she posts on Zoo for her community near the Tower Bridge.
Since the park is rentable for events, it's likely that Audrey rented it so Chloé could shoot her videos there.

title: Prem
text:
Prem - Intro
is a minor character in Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir, first introduced in season 6. He is a student at Collège Françoise Dupont.
In "Vampigami", when Prem felt guilty for hurting Rose and Juleka's feelings after he invited the former to a special movie event, he was akumatized by Chrysalis into Count Vampigami, a vampire-themed supervillain with the ability to transform people into lookalikes of himself with a bat origami. He also received a Magical Charm from Ladybug that prevented him from being akumatized again.

title: Prem
text:
Prem - Appearance
Physical appearance
He's an Indian teenager with a slim build and dark brown skin. He has an oval face with slightly defined cheeks; large, round, dark brown eyes; thick, dark, well-defined eyebrows; and a straight, medium-sized nose well proportioned to his face. His mouth is wide, with medium to full lips, and when he smiles, he reveals white teeth with a diastema between his upper central incisors. His medium-sized, rounded, slightly protruding ears are visible thanks to his haircut. He wears his hair short and wavy, the same color as his eyebrows, but currently dyed pastel pink, with intentionally messy strands pointing in different directions.
Civilian attire
He wears a V-necked yellow T-shirt with a red heart on the chest and three smaller hearts in a lighter shade of red, knee-length shorts with a gradient, going from peach to white as it goes down, and white tennis shoes. He also wears oval-shaped, white-rimmed sunglasses, which are resting on his head, as well as a silver necklace with two smaller silver beads and a big, blue bead in the center, and a blue and yellow beaded bracelet on his right wrist.
As Count Vampigami

title: Prem
text:
Prem - Appearance
He had light lavender skin, dark plum sclerae, eyebrows, and lips, and icy green eyes. His hair turned brilliant cerise and was styled in a way that resembled that of a traditional vampire hairstyle: open, curly bangs, and outward-pointing hair. His forelocks curled inward. He also had fanged teeth.
He wore a brilliant cerise full bodysuit. He had a jagged, pleated, ruffly collar with pastel pink and dark plum trim, resembling a bat's wings to accent the trim and segments at the sides of his body (except the arms) and the pant legs, which were flared out. The body segments had pointed parts towards the navel. His hands were a glittery dark plum to match his torso-length cape, which was jagged to also resemble bat wings and attached to his arms. On the chest was a black angular bat brooch and a two-point protrusion with a cerise outside and glittery dark plum interior.
His bindi turned light cerise and droplet-shaped. He also wore angular shades with a cerise-to-dark-plum gradient, accented by pastel pink glitter.

title: Prem
text:
Prem - Personality
Prem is a very cheerful and affectionate person who loves music and dancing as much as literature and horror films, especially vampire movies. He is also incredibly respectful toward others, often referring to them as "prince" or "princess" when speaking to them, even formally, if those people have treated them poorly. He also thanks others for things that might seem insignificant, such as lending them a book, serving their food, or even bringing joy to people through their romantic relationship.
Like his friend Rose, he tends to see the good in everything, even in those who do evil for fun. This makes him gullible at times, such as in "Vampigami" when he believed Nelson, who gave him tickets to his favorite show as an alleged act of redemption for his bad actions, or when he fell for Chrysalis' lies claiming she wanted to help people.

title: Prem
text:
Prem - Personality
He hates causing trouble among others. He feels guilty about being the source of negative emotions for his loved ones and is willing to do anything to make it up to them, such as when he gave up the last tickets to his favorite show so Juleka could go see it with Rose. His aversion to conflict goes so far that he believes that, if he were akumatized, he would only bring more unhappiness to those they care about.
As Count Vampigami, he was much more aggressive with his advances, and his main goal was to bring joy to Juleka and Rose, whose relationship was in trouble because Juleka was unable to express how she felt about Prem's closeness to Rose. For this reason, he did not mind enchanting people and turning them into copies of themselves to bring the cinema to them. He also did not care about forcing one of the girls to watch his show, even if she did not want to, nor about attacking anyone who tried to stop him, such as Cat Noir, who stood between him and Rose.

title: Prem
text:
Prem - Abilities
As Civilian
Being from India, Prem has language skills that allow him to speak both Hindi and French, albeit in a formal manner. He is also skilled not only in singing but in dancing and origami, with his favorite talent being creating origami bats that resemble the vampires from his favorite show.
As Count Vampigami
Count Vampigami had the ability to create origami bats, which he could throw at civilians to transform them into look-alikes, similar to Reflekta's powers. The clones created by Vampigami behave in ways similar to him. However, unlike Reflekta's clones, Vampigami's clones are not exact replicas; they do not possess the original's bindi, glasses, ruffle collar, or wings.
When Vampigami claps his hands together, origami bats appear in the hands of the clones. By signalling with two fingers from both hands, he could command the clones to shoot the origami bats at individuals, transforming them into clones who are then under his control.

title: Quantic Universe
text:
Quantic Universe - Intro
The  is the name of the universe where the story of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir takes place.

title: Quantic Universe
text:
Quantic Universe - Summary
According to Thomas Astruc, "[The Quantic Universe] is the extended universe in which live Ladybug and Cat Noir. Ladybug is to the Quantic Universe as to what Spider-Man is to the Marvel-verse, or Batman to the DC-verse. Quantic Universe is filled [with] super-heroes in all countries, alien races, magic... Ladybug is just a tiny part of it. Hopefully, if the series is successful, [the crew] will be able to explore it." He also explained in an interview that while Ladybug, Cat Noir, and their relationship is the main focus of the Miraculous Ladybug series, the crew wants to keep expanding the universe, adding new characters and looking deeper into all of the Miraculouses stored in the Miracle Box. For a while, Miraculous holders were the only known type of superheroes. However, Thomas Astruc has confirmed that other superheroes with abilities unrelated to Miraculouses are in existence within the Quantic Universe. This was first confirmed in-universe in the "Miraculous New York" special, in which both superheroes without superpowers (such as Knightowl, Sparrow, and Victory), as well as superheroes with superpowers not given by Miraculouses (like Majestia and Doorman), exist.

title: Quantic Universe
text:
Quantic Universe - Summary
The Quantic Universe has explored the concept of Alternative timelines and there are also Alternate Universes that are a completely different reality from the Quantic Universe.

title: Quantic Universe
text:
Quantic Universe - History
At the beginning of the universe, the first kwami, Tikki, came into existence. After her, other kwamis were formed throughout the early days of the universe whenever new ideas or emotions were born, such as beauty and love. They weren't able to be detected by humanity until a mage created the Miraculouses. Because of the Miraculouses, not only could kwamis can now interact with humans, they could also transform them into super-powered beings.
To protect the Miraculouses, the Order of the Guardians was formed, watching over and distributing the Miraculouses. Many Miraculous holders existed around the world at different times, including in ancient civilizations, the Middle Ages, and modern periods. Despite existing for many years, sometime in the 19th century, a mistake made by a young member in training named Wang Fu resulted in the Order of the Guardians falling apart, their temple getting destroyed, and the Butterfly Miraculous, Peacock Miraculous, and Miraculous spellbook being lost. Fu escaped, and he kept the Miracle Box with its remaining Miraculouses.

title: Quantic Universe
text:
Quantic Universe - History
In the present day, many superheroes exist around the world. Majestia and Knightowl were well-known and popular, even having comic books based on them. An American superhero, Victory, is the President of the USA. All known American superheroes are part of a team of heroes called the United Heroez.
Meanwhile, in recent years there wasn't any kind of superhero in France. However, Gabriel Agreste found the Butterfly Miraculous and became Hawk Moth. With his superpower, he created other supervillains in order to bring out the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses, take them away from their holders, and use them together to wish for a secret desire. Living in Paris at the time, Fu planned to fight back and stop Hawk Moth from making his wish come true, thereby circumventing its horrible consequences. After realizing he couldn't do it alone, Fu gave the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses respectively to Parisian teenagers Marinette Dupain-Cheng and Adrien Agreste.
As the danger in Paris grew, so did Ladybug and Cat Noir, figuring out the powers of their jewels, growing in allies and not only that they also gained clues to figuring out Hawk Moth's secret dream.

title: Quantic Universe
text:
Quantic Universe - History
In the future, The Miraculers return as adults as Paris is under the threat of a new Hawk Moth.

title: Quantic Universe
text:
Quantic Universe - Geography
Paris, France is the primary location seen in the universe so far in the TV series. In "Startrain", Ladybug, Cat Noir, and Pegasus defeated Startrain and captured her akuma in the Big Ben Clock Tower in London. Other countries have been mentioned or referenced, including China, Egypt, Greece, Italy, the Patagonia region (in Argentina and Chile), the United Kingdom, and its capital London, and Japan. The Miraculous World TV movies take place in different locations throughout the world, including New York City, Shanghai, London, Tokyo, Rio de Janeiro and Dakar.
Achu, the kingdom where Prince Ali and his chaperone live, is a fictional country that exists in the universe. However, it is unknown where in the world Achu is.

title: Quantic Universe
text:
Quantic Universe - Trivia
As of 2023, the Quantic Universe is the only known universe from the multiverse to have an official name given by the production crew. However, it's unknown what's the universe's designation.
Real people from history, such as Jeanne d'Arc and Tomoe Gozen, and mythological figures, such as Heracles and Cernunnos, exist in this universe as Miraculous holders. Whether their histories and legends are the same or they have been modified has yet to be seen.
It is possible that a version of Melodie, Kid Mime, and Gavroche from Quantic Kids, a superhero team that Ladybug and Cat Noir were a part of in an unused concept, exist in this world.
Sparrow, another member of the unused team, is confirmed to exist in the universe as a superhero and a member of the United Heroez in "Miraculous New York".
However, this version is a girl and the daughter of Knightowl, who is also a woman. At the end of the special, she starts using the Eagle Miraculous, and becomes another hero, Eagle.

title: Quantic Universe
text:
Quantic Universe - Trivia
Mercury, who was also a member of the team, is another member of the United Heroez and appeared in "Miraculous New York". However, the current Mercury is an adult, opposite to the original one who was supposed to be a teenager.
Previously, according to Astruc, it was also possible that Félix Agreste, the first version of Cat Noir before Adrien, still existed in some way there. However, Astruc later stated that Félix will never appear.
However, a different version of Félix starts appearing in the show from the season 3 episode "Félix". That Félix is Adrien's maternal cousin, and is a villain turned superhero.
Not only that the first of Cat Noir Félix Agreste, was also used in the in universe anime movies created by Thomas Astruc in "Animaestro" and sequel in "Rocketeer".
The in-universe comic books featuring the United Heroez are published by the company Quantic Comics, which is a reference to the Quantic Universe.
If he isn't able to explore the Miraculous universe, Thomas has another universe he's creating.
Even though the Quantic Universe has some similarities to the history of the real world Universe there are some differences:

title: Quantic Universe
text:
Quantic Universe - Trivia
In Egyptian history, King Tut ruled Egypt 5000 years ago but in the real world it was King Menes.
King Tut's real-world counterpart ruled 3,300 years ago.
He was married to Princess Nefertiti but in reality he was married to Ankhesenamun.
Also Nefertiti is depicted in reality as a queen.
However, according to Thomas Astruc, the names in the English dub aren't supposed to match their real-world counterparts, while the ones in the French dub are the correct ones.
In Mexican history, La Mariquita took part in the War of Independence as a Miraculous holder in the Quantic Universe. However, she has no real-world counterpart.
In Chinese history, the Miraculous spellbook was the first book created.  In real life, the first printed book in China wasn't until 868 AD.
Multiple disastrous events such as the leaning of the tower of Pisa and the extinction of the non-avian dinosaurs in the real world were caused by natural disasters, faulty construction, and many other reasons. In addition, Atlantis is confirmed to have existed in the Quantic Universe despite it being fictional in real life.

title: Quantic Universe
text:
Quantic Universe - Trivia
In the Quantic Universe all that destruction was done by Plagg when he used his powers in the past without his owners.
Several real-world fictional creatures, such as genies, dragons, and mages, exist in the Quantic Universe.
It's true in the real world people can live up to 100 years old and over. But in the Quantic Universe, people can live close to about 200 years or more as in the case of Master Fu and his lifestyle or in the case of the other guardians who were trapped in a place where time doesn't exist.
The concept of chocolate mousse was created by Tikki instead of humans.
The legend of the Loch Ness Monster was created by Trixx. In real life, no one really knows how the legend started in Scotland.
In French history, the real Jeanne was burned by the stake while her Quantic counterpart managed to escape it and went to live with her love Grimalkin after they renounced their Miraculous.
The Musketeers of the Guard also exist in this universe. But unlike the real world, the Quantic Universe included a woman which is Aramis who was a real person. Her real world's fictional counterpart, though, is a male.
The concept of parallel universes and means to travel them also exist.

title: Quantic Kids
text:
Quantic Kids - Intro
The  was an old, unused concept of Ladybug and Cat Noir (Félix) being members of a superhero team, as requested by a producer. It failed to help sell the concept of Ladybug to broadcasters, which resulted in Ladybug and Cat Noir remaining as a duo.
Sparrow exists in the Quantic Universe with Ladybug and Cat Noir, as seen in "The Dark Owl". Mercury also exists in it as seen in "Miraculous New York". However, the fate of the other characters that made up the rest of the team is unknown. They may still exist in the Quantic Universe, but they may have been discarded in the same manner as Félix, with some of their attributes being incorporated into other characters.

title: Quantic Kids
text:
Quantic Kids - Members
Early development members
Marinette Cheng/Ladybug — a teenage girl with the secret identity of a ladybug-themed superhero. She has the power of good luck.
Félix Agreste/Cat Noir — a teenage boy with the secret identity of a black cat-themed superhero. He has the power of bad luck. It wasn't until sometime after the concept was scrapped that the crew replaced Félix with Adrien.
Melodie — a female superhero who wields a flute.
Mercury — a male superhero who appears to have super speed.
Sparrow — a sparrow-themed superhero who appears to use darts. In later development, producers replaced him with Kid Mime.
Members added in later development
Gavroche — a male superhero.
Kid Mime  — a male superhero with miming abilities. Producers replaced Sparrow with him.

title: Quantic Kids
text:
Quantic Kids - Trivia
According to The Art of Miraculous, there were plans for each member of the Quantic Kids to have a kwami who would give them their superpowers so that "various stories could be told". Because the artbook only featured Melodie, Sparrow, Gavroche, and Kid Mime, it's unknown if Mercury was also planned to have a kwami who would give him his super speed.
The idea of a Quantic Kids member having a kwami is eventually reused for Sparrow whose existence in the Quantic Universe is revealed in "Miraculous New York". However, Sparrow changes her super identity to Eagle after she rescued Liiri the eagle kwami from Miraclonizer near the end of the TV movie.
Mercury is the only member of the Quantic Kids who isn't featured in The Art of Miraculous.
Despite the Quantic Kids were planned to have a kwami who gives them their superpowers, the Miraculouses did not exist in this concept. The idea for them came to be after it was discarded.

title: Quantic Kids
text:
Quantic Kids - Trivia
Even though Marinette and Félix both have Tikki and Plagg, the respective jewelry their kwamis are bound to aren't technically Miraculouses. According to the artbook, Tikki and Plagg were originally going to be trapped in their respective jewelry by another kwami named Null.
Sparrow was originally a member of the superhero team, but producers replaced him with Kid Mime later on because "Mime was such [a] great character that they didn't want to keep him as [an] adult baddie only."
On Twitter, Thomas Astruc posted that he hopes he will be able to bring these characters back in comics someday.
He also mentioned that he doesn't believe that the Quantic Kids concept would've been as successful as the final version of Miraculous.
Sparrow exists in the universe, making an appearance in "Miraculous New York". However, the current Sparrow is a girl and gives up her identity at the end of the TV movie. It's currently unknown whether the Quantic Kids Sparrow was supposed to be a boy or a girl.
Mercury was confirmed to exist in "Miraculous New York", although he is an adult, instead of a teenager.

In the first version of the Super Lady Luck slot game, images of Melodie, Kid Mime, and Mercury appeared. In the latest version before the game's removal on Isoftbet, different images of Melodie and Kid Mime were shown, but Mercury no longer appeared.

Melodie's civilian design has elements that were used in Chloé Bourgeois' earlier designs.
The design of Gavroche is similar to Nino Lahiffe's appearances as a civilian, and to Carapace as a superhero.
