text:
Repetition - Intro
"" is the third webisode of the series, Miraculous: Tales from Paris.

title: Repetition
text:
Repetition - Synopsis
Marinette struggles with finding the confidence to ask Adrien out. So, Tikki is to the rescue to help her out!

title: Repetition
text:
Repetition - Plot
In her bedroom, Marinette flips through her phone displaying pictures of Adrien. Upon seeing one, Tikki says that she likes it, and Marinette agrees. Marinette then explains that she lacks the ability to talk to Adrien, and Tikki proposes they practice together.
They begin practising. Tikki asks that she repeat after her and then models a possible request for Adrien - asking if he would like to see a movie together. Marinette repeats it fine. Both are pleased with the success, however, when Marinette declares she's ready to speak to Adrien, Tikki disagrees. She grabs the cellphone and displays a picture of Adrien. This time, Marinette trips over her words. This disappoints Marinette, but Tikki reassures her. They both agree to practice again the following day.
Suddenly, Marinette's mother knocks on her door, curious as to why she was speaking. Marinette quickly explains she was on the phone with Alya, but Alya pops up though Marinette's trap door and exposes the lie. Alya suggests that Marinette was speaking with her posters of Adrien, and Marinette wearily agrees, causing Tikki to giggle.

title: Reflekdoll
text:
Reflekdoll - Intro
"" is a season 3 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 5th written and produced episode of season 3. It is also the 57th written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Reflekdoll
text:
Reflekdoll - Synopsis
Ladybug and Cat Noir each get the others' Miraculous when they must take on Juleka, who has become Reflekta again and now has a sentimonster.
Disney+
Ladybug faces Juleka and her sentimonster, Reflektdoll.

title: Reflekdoll
text:
Reflekdoll - Plot
After defeating another supervillain, Cat Noir tells Ladybug that she's the superhero who captures akumas while he's just charming and cunning. Ladybug points out that the prank he'd pulled earlier almost made her Lucky Charm fail, causing Cat Noir to tell her that Master Fu gave her the Ladybug Miraculous instead of him because she's got no sense of humor. However, when Ladybug shows signs of irritation, Cat Noir says that she has many other great qualities, and he's just in charge of the humor department. He bids her farewell and calls her "Bugaboo" before leaving. Ladybug yells at him to not call her Bugaboo, but he's already left, much to her annoyance.
At the Couffaine houseboat, Juleka wants to be a model for Marinette, but she is unsure as to whether or not Marinette will pick her. Luka encourages her to go for it, commenting on how pretty she is and that she must follow her dreams. He clips her bangs back and kisses her cheek.

title: Reflekdoll
text:
Reflekdoll - Plot
Later at school, since Ms. Mendeleiev is not coming to school today, school ends an hour early. Alya suggests that the girls use the extra time to model Marinette's designs for her upcoming website and asks for a volunteer. Juleka steps up, and the girls are surprised to see her bangs clipped back, commenting on how well it suits her. They agree to let her be the model. Alya suggests to Marinette that she ask Adrien to help since he has experience with fashion shoots. Marinette is reluctant, but Alya approaches him anyways and asks. Adrien wants to but says that he must get home, or his father will be upset. However, Alya reminds him that, technically, he doesn't have to be home for another hour since school ended early. Therefore, Adrien agrees, and Marinette faints.

title: Reflekdoll
text:
Reflekdoll - Plot
In Marinette's room, the girls and Adrien get Juleka ready. However, once they're done, Juleka begins to feel nervous and breathes heavily. Noticing how nervous Juleka is, Marinette decides to take her place. This gives Alya the idea to have both Marinette and Adrien model Marinette's designs since they work for girls and guys. Alya asks Adrien if he's up for it, and he agrees. Alya drags Marinette and Adrien behind separate folding screens to change. The two discover that in order to wear the jewelry that comes with the clothes, they must take their Miraculouses off. Though both their kwamis are against this, they insist that it'll be fine since it won't be for long, and their kwamis will hold onto their respective Miraculouses. Once they're all dressed, the girls admire how nice the two look in their clothes. However, Alya notices that Marinette is overheating, so she decides to take the shoot outside. While the girls head out, Juleka decides that she'd rather stay behind than go with them. Rose offers to stay with her, but Juleka insists that she go. Once they all leave, Juleka laments to herself about how she always ruins everything.

title: Reflekdoll
text:
Reflekdoll - Plot
Hawk Moth senses Juleka's negative emotions. He tells Nathalie that he needs Mayura to give the negative emotion a boost. After Nathalie transforms into Mayura, Hawk Moth sends an akuma after Juleka while Mayura sends an amok after her.
In the Agreste's car, Adrien thanks his bodyguard for picking him and his friends up. When the bodyguard glares at him, Adrien reminds him that there is still a little time before school's officially over and that he's helping his friends out. The girls all say "please" in unison, and the bodyguard relents and drives off.

title: Reflekdoll
text:
Reflekdoll - Plot
The akuma enters Juleka's right lace glove while the amok enters her barrette. Hawk Moth offers to turn Juleka back into Reflekta, and Mayura offers her a sentimonster named Reflekdoll that will help her all in exchange for Ladybug's and Cat Noir's Miraculouses. Juleka agrees and is transformed into Reflekta with a giant Reflekdoll under her command. She uses the doll to turn multiple people into copies of herself and heads to Trocadéro where the girls and Adrien are doing the shoot. She turns each of them into her copies. Rose attempts to apologize to Juleka, but Reflekta merely tries to turn her into a mirror image of herself. Marinette and Adrien hide to transform into their superhero selves but discover that they can't due to their Miraculouses being in the Agreste's car. In the car, Plagg comments to Tikki on how they can enjoy a snack while their owners are busy with the photoshoot, though Tikki is disgusted by the Camembert Plagg's eating.

title: Reflekdoll
text:
Reflekdoll - Plot
While Reflekta turns more people into her mirror images, Marinette and Adrien run to the car to retrieve their Miraculouses. Reflekta spots Marinette and confronts her about stealing her limelight as she was supposed to be the shoot's star. Marinette tells her that she'd said she didn't want to, but Reflekta claims that she didn't let her explain and turns Marinette into her mirror image, stating that Marinette will likely understand her better now that she's in Reflekta's shoes. Adrien attempts to open the trunk of the car, but Reflekdoll grabs it and throws it before turning Adrien into a copy of Reflekta. Tikki wonders how they're going to find their owners when everyone looks the same. Plagg suggests that they look for the Miraculouses first. He finds his quickly and tells Tikki to stay focused before taking off.

title: Reflekdoll
text:
Reflekdoll - Plot
Reflekta looks for Rose, wanting to turn her into her replica so that the two of them can be like twin sisters. Meanwhile, Plagg looks for Adrien but instead finds Marinette. Since there isn't a lot of time, Marinette decides to use Cat Noir's Miraculous herself and transforms into Lady Noire. Meanwhile, Tikki finds the Ladybug Miraculous, but seeing that Marinette is using the Cat Miraculous, she looks for Adrien. After finding him, she explains the mix-up and introduces herself. Adrien puts on the earrings and transforms into Mister Bug.

title: Reflekdoll
text:
Reflekdoll - Plot
With their Miraculouses swapped, Lady Noire and Mister Bug fight Reflekta and Reflekdoll, though they have some trouble adjusting to their new powers. Hawk Moth and Mayura take note of this and encourage Reflekta to take advantage of it. Mister Bug points out that Reflekta's akuma is likely where it was before. Lady Noire agrees but says that they'd need to check that and also points out that they don't know where the amok is. Mister Bug believes that if he had a mirror, he could reflect Reflekta's beams back at her. However, Lady Noire reminds him that the Lucky Charm doesn't just give its users what they want; they have to figure out how to use it. Mister Bug decides to test that and calls on it. He receives a mirror, though Lady Noire insists that it's beginners' luck. However, Mister Bug quickly discovers that the mirror he got with his Lucky Charm is useless because reflecting Reflekta's beams back at her does nothing. So Lady Noire calls on her Cataclysm and uses it on the sentimonster. However, instead of destroying it, it merely causes it to go berserk. Mayura asks Hawk Moth if she should recall the amok, but Hawk Moth says no as he believes chaos is a valuable ally.

title: Reflekdoll
text:
Reflekdoll - Plot
Lady Noire and Mister Bug save Reflekta from the berserk Reflekdoll.
Reflekta tries to turn them into copies of herself, but Mister Bug breaks the object containing her akuma and captures it before she can do so.
Reflekta is turned back into Juleka.
However, as Reflekdoll is still on a rampage, Juleka is turned into a Reflekta copy.
Mister Bug offers to fix everything, but Lady Noire points out that they should stop Reflekdoll first.
Mister Bug admits that being Ladybug isn't easy and he can't do anything without her.
Lady Noire points out that Reflekta had been controlling the doll from inside and suggests going in to find the amok.
Mister Bug wonders how they can do that without getting hit by its beam.
Lady Noire suggests that they figure out how to use the Lucky Charm mirror first.
Through analysis, Lady Noire concludes that in order to get inside Reflekdoll, they must enter through an access panel behind the doll's head that can only be opened with a coin...or something big and round like a coin (aka the mirror).
Once inside, the two realize that the amok is inside the hair clip and break it.

title: Reflekdoll
text:
Reflekdoll - Plot
Mister Bug purifies the amok and then uses Miraculous Mister Bug to fix all the damage.
Hawk Moth is angered by another failure, but Mayura points out that there are two of them now and promises that they'll succeed in the end. The two detransform and Duusu calls what happened awesome, but when Nathalie falls to the floor coughing, she takes back her comment and asks Nathalie if she's alright. Gabriel tells Duusu that she's fine but needs peace and quiet.
Lady Noire and Mister Bug head in separate directions and detransform. After feeding the kwamis, they each deliver the Miraculouses back to their corrected owners. Marinette and Adrien then join the girls at Trocadéro. Marinette apologizes to Juleka for stealing her spotlight and allows her to be the model again. Alya asks Adrien if he still has some time. His bodyguard is initially reluctant, but after Adrien insists that it's important and the girls all say "please", he relents. The shoot continues as the end card appears.

title: Reflekdoll
text:
Reflekdoll - Plot Developments
According to Feri González, "Reflekdoll" takes place before the episode, "Miraculer".
This is evidenced by Lady Noire saying that the Sentimonster was created by "the owner of the Peacock Miraculous", rather than referring to her as Mayura.
Interestingly, she calls Mayura by the name in the German dub. As, Disney Channel Germany was one of the few broadcasters to air "Miraculer" after "Reflekdoll".
This episode marks Duusu's first-ever appearance in the series.
The transformation phrase for Mayura is shown to be, "Duusu, Spread my feathers!", while the detransformation phrase is, "Duusu, Fall my feathers!"
This is Marinette's first time using the Cat Miraculous and Cataclysm and Adrien's first time using the Ladybug Miraculous, Lucky Charm, and Miraculous Mister Bug.
As of this episode, this marks the second time the Ladybug Miraculous has been used by a man following Micazoyolin and the first time the Cat Miraculous has been used by a woman.
It's also a homage to a deleted inktober drawing of a female Cat Miraculous holder but it's unknown if she was used as a base to create Marinette as Lady Noire.

title: Reflekdoll
text:
Reflekdoll - Plot Developments
It is revealed that the spell placed upon the kwamis not only prevents them from saying their owner's name to other kwamis also but other Miraculous holders and possibly other civilians.
When Marinette was found by Plagg, it's likely she saw the bubbles coming out of his mouth however it's unknown after the encounter if Tikki or Master Fu had told the heroes of the magic spell that was put on the kwamis.
And yet, the spell blocks them from saying their owner's civilian names but not from saying any version of their hero name.
After Tikki was separated from Marinette and in trying to find her, she said her name out loud when the spell should've activated but since Tikki wasn't around anyone when she said it meaning that kwamis have to be in close proximity of someone for the spell to active as seen with Plagg in "Sandboy".
If the holder removes his/her jewel without relinquishing the kwami, the Miraculous will enter its charged mode when held by the kwami. If the roaming kwami becomes separated, the jewel enters its camouflaged mode.
This is the first time Cataclysm is used on a Sentimonster.

title: Reflekdoll
text:
Reflekdoll - Plot Developments
Similar to when used against a Miraculous holder, they, too, have resistance to it, which instead causes them to go berserk.
Since sentimonsters count as living beings this is the first time that power is used on a living being.

title: Reflekdoll
text:
Reflekdoll - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in UK & Ireland on Disney Channel.
According to Thomas Astruc, the point of the episode is to show how big of a burden Ladybug has, compared to Cat Noir.
This episode is the first of many to:
Have someone akumatized and amokized at the same time, with Juleka transforming back into Reflekta, and her controlling the Sentimonster Reflekdoll.
Involving both an akuma and an amok being captured at the same time.
Where Plagg is seen in Marinette's room.
Where someone ends up inside a sentimonster following "Feast", "Mega Leech" and "Guiltrip".
When Hawk Moth and Mayura both talk to one singular person, being Juleka, also where a different light mask is used to communicate, to combine Hawk Moth and Mayura's masks.
It is also the only appearance of that mask before Season 4, being Shadow Moth's main akumatization mask.
Not counting unifying, this is the first time where were we see a character appear as a Miraculous holder for a single episode following Aspik in "Desperada", Multimouse in "Kwamibuster", and Scarabella in "Hack-San".
This is the first episode to be named after a sentimonster.

title: Reflekdoll
text:
Reflekdoll - Trivia
This is also the third time an episode is not named after an akumatized supervillain, following "Ladybug & Cat Noir" and "Mayura".
As of with the theory of Adrien being a sentimonster being proven in "Representation", this is actually the second episode to be named after a sentimonster with "Ladybug & Cat Noir" being first.
This episode is Ladybug and Cat Noir's second encounter with a Sentimonster after "Mayura".
This is the second time Juleka gets akumatized into Reflekta following the episode of the same name.
However, this time, her villain identity doesn't determine the title of the episode. Instead, the title is derived from her sentimonster.
This is the second time Adrien gets zapped by Reflekta after "Reflekta", while this is Marinette's first time being transformed by a villain.
It is revealed that Juleka has dreams of being a model.
Adrien revealed as Mister Bug that he always wanted to try using Ladybug's powers.
In "New Powers", Marinette reveals that out of all the powers she has tried so far using Cat Noir's powers was her favorite.
This is the second time where Cat Noir as Mister Bug gets hit in the head by his staff following "Animaestro".

title: Reflekdoll
text:
Reflekdoll - Trivia
This is the third time Tikki and Plagg interact with each other onscreen, following "The Dark Owl" and "Sandboy", the second time Marinette and Plagg interact with each other onscreen following "Style Queen" and the first time Adrien and Tikki interact with each other onscreen.
This is the third time Marinette is separated from her Miraculous following "Ladybug & Cat Noir" and "Miraculous Shanghai".
This is the fourth time Marinette and Tikki end up separated which previously occurred in "Princess Fragrance", "Sandboy" and "Miraculous Shanghai".
This is the third time Adrien and Plagg end up separated which previously occurred "Style Queen" and "Sandboy".
This is also the third time Adrien is separated from his Miraculous following "Lady Wifi" and "The Dark Owl". Unlike "Lady Wifi", he willingly removed his ring.
Similar to "Stormy Weather", despite their jewels being switched, Adrien and Marinette did the right thing by removing them, if they were struck while wearing them then, they wouldn't have been able to transform into their alter egos let alone stop Reflekta and Reflekdoll.

title: Reflekdoll
text:
Reflekdoll - Trivia
More likely this action would have aroused Hawk Moth's suspicions or confusion of the heroes' absence like in "Sandboy".
Mister Bug carried his Lucky Charm on his back similar to Carapace and his shield.
As Mister Bug, Cat Noir tried to aim Reflekta's beam back at her but it didn't work because he forgot as a Reflekta copy himself in the original episode he wasn't affected either.
This also the fourth episode where Ladybug and Cat Noir use their powers twice following "The Dark Owl", "Mayura" and "Miraculous Shanghai".
This is the fourth time where Ladybug's Lucky Charm is an object that appeared in a previous episode. This time, it's the mirror that previously appeared in "Pixelator".
Unlike the others the second time the powers were used it was done by the opposite holder.
Errors
When Adrien changes his clothes in Marinette's room, the reflection in the mirror shows him with impossibly long hair.
In the English dub, Reflekta calls the girls' event a "video" and Plagg calls in a "film", even though it was a normal photoshoot with still pictures.
When Adrien attempts to transform into Cat Noir, his shirt sleeve clips through his arm.

title: Reflekdoll/Transcript
text:
Reflekdoll/Transcript - Intro
[ Theme Song ]
Cat Noir I don't call the shots, m'lady. You're the superhero who captures the evil akumas — I'm just the cunning, ultra-charming Cat Noir.
Ladybug: Right, you have it easy.
Cat Noir: Easy? That's 'cause I make it look easy.
Ladybug: As cunning as you might be, that little prank you pulled earlier almost made my Lucky Charm fail!
Cat Noir: D'you know why Master Fu gave you the Ladybug Miraculous instead of me?
Ladybug: Because it requires someone with a sense of responsibility?
Cat Noir: No, because you don't have a sense of humor.
Ladybug: Pfft, whatever. (Cat Noir tries to kiss her hand) Ah! (She pulls away)
Cat Noir: Uh... Look, it's no big deal! You have so many other great qualities! I'm just in charge of the humor department. (His ring starts beeping)
Ladybug: You'd better get going before you lose your clown costume.
Cat Noir: Miss you already, Bugaboo.
Ladybug: Don't call me—!
Cat Noir: (leaving) See? I was right! (Ladybug groans)
Luka: Don't you wanna be a model anymore?
Juleka: Yeah, but... no one's ever going to pick me.
Luka: (strums his guitar) Have you tried talking to Marinette about your idea?
Juleka: I don't want to bother her with that.

title: Reflekdoll/Transcript
text:
Reflekdoll/Transcript - Intro
Luka: (goes to her) You're really pretty, Jule. I'm sure Marinette would love to have you as her model. (clips Juleka's bangs back) You gotta follow your dreams in life. Don't let 'em pass you by. You were made for this. (kisses her cheek) Go for it.
Marinette: Since Olga Mendeleiev wasn't in today, what should we do now that we're out an hour early?
Alya: We should use this extra time to make that video for Marinette's soon-to-be website!
Rose, Alix, & Mylène: Yeah, good idea!
Alya: Remember I asked you guys to think about modeling Marinette's designs? Well, any takers?
Juleka: (walks up, her bangs clipped back) I... I'd like to do it. (They gasp.)
Marinette: Juleka?
Mylène: I've never seen the top half of your face before!
Rose: It really suits you!
Juleka: (mumbling) Well, it's just a barrette. I mean I just, uh...
Alya: We've got our model! (They cheer and pull Juleka to the front of the school, but Alya holds Marinette back.)
Marinette: Aah!
Alya: Hey! We're gonna need a technical directer. Someone who knows his way around fashion shoots...? (She points Marinette's face toward Adrien, who's walking with Nino.)

title: Reflekdoll/Transcript
text:
Reflekdoll/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Don't even think about it! If he's right there in my house, in my room, I'll be a complete mess! (whimpers)
Alya: No, you won't! You'll be in your element. It's the perfect opportunity for you guys to get close!
Marinette: No, I— (Alya runs off) Alya, no! (groans)
Alya: (to Adrien) I was wondering if you could help us out with a fashion shoot.
Adrien: I'd love to Alya, but I have to get home or else my father...
Alya: I know, but you were supposed to be in Olga Mendeleiev's class today, and since she's not here, you technically don't have to be home for another, entire hour. Your dad won't know any different!
Nino: She's got a point, dude.
Adrien: Oh! Okay then.
Marinette: Ah, no...! (falls over)
Alya: (videotaping them on her phone, whispers to Marinette) Psst! This is totally your chance to ask him to the movies! (Marinette squeaks)
Adrien: Alix, could you shine the light a bit more on Juleka's shoulders, please? I want her to stand out. (Alix does so, and chuckles triumphantly) Does that work for you, Marinette?
Marinette: Huh? Uh, sure! You're perfect— I mean, it's perfect!
Adrien: (takes the hair clip from her) This one! It'll compliment the suit really well.

title: Reflekdoll/Transcript
text:
Reflekdoll/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: I thought the same thing, Madrien, ah—! (shouts) Adrien! (chuckles nervously)
Alya: How about a little smile for the camera, Juleka?
Juleka: (mumbles rapidly) Uh, I don't think this is such a good idea, you guys, I...
Marinette: Is something wrong?
Juleka: (quietly) I'm just not feeling that—
Marinette: You know, it was really cool of you to agree to be my model, (Juleka breathes heavily) but I can tell you're not feeling that comfortable about it at all.
Alya: Decide fast, because we have less than an hour before Adrien has to leave.
Adrien: That's okay, maybe we can do it again some other day, if my father lets me.
Marinette: (to Juleka) Would you prefer if someone stand in for you? (Juleka's heavy breaths come out like whimpers) This is something I should do myself, after all. These are my designs, and—
Alya: Of course! Awesome idea, Marinette! The coolest thing about your designs is that they work just as well with guys, as with girls. A guy? A girl? Same suits? What do you think Adrien, are you in?
Adrien: If it helps.

title: Reflekdoll/Transcript
text:
Reflekdoll/Transcript - Intro
Alya: See? This is gonna be awesome! Give Marinette your suit, Juleka— and Marinette, grab another suit for Adrien! (Juleka groans. The girls set up folding screens for them to change. Alya hands Adrien some jewelry.) Here are your accessories, created by the one and only Marinette Dupain-Cheng! (whispers to Marinette) Just bought you some extra time to ask him out! You're welcome.
Marinette: I— I... (She gets dressed, replacing her earrings with her own designs)
Tikki: Don't do that, Marinette!
Marinette: It won't be for long, Tikki. Besides, you'll hold onto them for me. (places the earrings inside her purse, with Tikki)
Plagg: (sees Adrien about to replace his ring with Marinette's) I hope you're kidding!
Adrien: It won't be for long, Plagg. Besides, you'll be nearby. (places the ring with Plagg in his bag.)
Rose: (seeing Marinette and Adrien) Oh!
Mylène: Wow!
Rose: You look so beautiful!
Alix: It's uber perfect!
Alya: Looks like we're ready!
Mylène: Are you okay, Marinette?
Marinette: Yeah, he's too hot— I mean! I'm overheating in here, aren't you?

title: Reflekdoll/Transcript
text:
Reflekdoll/Transcript - Intro
Alya: Okay! Change of plans, we're gonna take the shoot outside! (Rose, Mylène, and Alix cheer. The next few lines overlap as Mylène and Alix run out.)
Rose: I love the outside!
Adrien: (getting pulled out by Mylène) Heeey!
Alix: C'mon, let's go! (Marinette sighs)
Alya: A new environment, it'll be easier to breathe outside— You can do it. (leaves)
Rose: (gasps) What's the matter, Juleka?
Juleka: I... I'd rather not come.
Marinette: Wha...? Why not?
Juleka: Nothing! I...
Rose: I'll stay with you.
Juleka: No, don't worry. Please go. Just tired, and need to study, and...
Marinette: Are you sure?
Alya: (from downstairs) Girls! We've only got thirty minutes left!
Marinette: (to Juleka) Okay, then. Make yourself at home.
Rose: See you in a bit. Mwah! (kisses her cheek, giggles as she waves goodbye)
Juleka: (sighs, takes the barrette out of her bangs) I was so lame. I ruined everything. As usual.
Hawk Moth: Yet again, my young prey fails to be the center of attention. (A butterfly lands in his hand) Nathalie, I need Mayura to give this negative emotion a new dimension. (Nathalie puts on the glitching Peacock Miraculous.)

title: Reflekdoll/Transcript
text:
Reflekdoll/Transcript - Intro
[Transformation Sequence]Nathalie: Duusu, spread my feathers! (turns into Mayura)
Hawk Moth: (evilizes the butterfly into an akuma) Fly away, little akuma, and evilize her!
Mayura: (takes a feather from her fan, evillizes it into an amok, and blows it away) Fly away, beautiful amok, and enhance and hone that frustration!
Alya: To the Eiffel Tower, please!
Adrien: Thanks for coming to fetch us.
The Gorilla: (grunts disapprovingly)
Adrien: We've got a little time before school's officially over! (lowers his voice) Doing this to help my friends out.
The girls: Please!
The Gorilla: (harrumphs in resignation, and drives them to the Eiffel Tower)
(The akuma and amok flutter into Marinette's bedroom. The akuma is absorbed into Juleka's bracelet, while the amok is absorbed by her barrette. She growls.)
Hawkmoth: (to Juleka) Reflekta, I am Hawk Moth. I'm giving you the power to make people look just like you again, so that everyone will notice you.
Mayura: Reflekta, I am Mayura. To help you succeed you'll be assisted by Reflekdoll. She'll be entirely under your control.
Hawk Moth: And in return, of course, you must get hold of Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous.

title: Reflekdoll/Transcript
text:
Reflekdoll/Transcript - Intro
Juleka: Hawk Moth, Mayura, you can count on me. I will succeed this time. (Her body is engulfed in purple, and Marinette's room is blown up as a gigantic figure engulfed in blue forms.)
Citizen 1: Ah!
Citizen 2: What is it?
Citizen 3: What's that?
Citizen 4: Ah!
(The blue clouds surrounding the figure disappear, revealing Reflekdoll. Inside the doll, the purple disappears, revealing Reflekta.)
Reflekta: Heh, heh, heh! Hah! (jabs a huge barrette into the floor, Reflekdoll wakes up.) Yah! Hah! (She turns the barrette like a pirate's helm; controlling Reflekdoll and turning Tom, Sabine, and everyone else around her into copies of herself.)
Alix & Adrien: (hearing Reflekdoll's thundering footsteps) Huh? (They all look up, see Reflekdoll, and run away screaming)
Reflekta: (all her words are projected loudly through Reflekdoll) Believe, my friends, you're the very people I've been looking for! I've got something special for your video! (tries zapping Marinette and Adrien, but they dodge and hide) I'm gonna show you what it feels like to be me! (she zaps Mylène and Alix, who turn into copies of her)
Rose: I'm sorry, Juleka! I should've stayed with you!

title: Reflekdoll/Transcript
text:
Reflekdoll/Transcript - Intro
Reflekta: Juleka's no more! I am Reflekta! Everyone always forgets about Juleka, anyway. (tries to zap her, but she jumps away in time)
Marinette: Tikki, spots on! (touches her earrings) Tikki! Oh no!
Adrien: Plagg, claws out! Uh— (looks at his ring) Plagg?
Plagg: (lounging in the trunk of The Gorilla's car) This is our lucky day, Sugarcube. A miracle in the making! (pulls a camembert slice out of thin air) Now we can enjoy a nice, aged snack while we wait for them to finish their little film. (throws the whole slice in his mouth)
Tikki: Eww.
(Citizens scream, and the Gorilla grunts, as Reflekdoll zaps them all into Reflektas. Adrien and Marinette dash across the Trocadéro and hide behind the Gorilla's car.)
Adrien: Hide in the car!
Marinette: What about you?
Adrien: I'll uh...
Reflekta: (within Reflekdoll) Marinette! You stole my limelight. I was supposed to be the star of the film!
Marinette: But, you told me you didn't want to be!
Reflekta: You didn't let me explain! (zaps her into a Reflekta) Perhaps you'll understand me better now that you're in my shoes! (Reflekdoll lifts the car, and tosses it aside.) Nobody can escape me! (zaps Adrien into a Reflekta)

title: Reflekdoll/Transcript
text:
Reflekdoll/Transcript - Intro
Tikki & Plagg: (In the car, screaming as it rolls. It lands and they fall out of it, groaning.)
Tikki: (seeing Reflekdoll turning everyone into Reflektas) Oh no, this is terrible, Plagg! How're we gonna be able to find our owners? Everybody looks exactly the same!
Plagg: We have to find their Miraculouses, first! (They begin searching.)
Tikki: Paris is doomed without Ladybug and Cat Noir!
Plagg: Got it! (holds up the Cat Miraculous, laughing triumphantly) Stay focused, Sugarcube, everything will be all right! (flies off)
Reflekta: (jumping around in Reflekdoll) Rose!! Where are you, my BFF!? Come to me, we'll be like twin sisters forever and ever! (Rose whimpers as she runs away) There you are!
Plagg: (Floating over the screaming citizens) Cat Noir? Cat Noir! Cat Noir? (one of the Reflekta's stops and looks at him)
Marinette: Plagg?
Plagg: Eh! You're not— (belches green bubbles)
Marinette: What are you doing here? Has Cat Noir lost his Miraculous? Have you seen Tikki?
Plagg: It's a long story, Marinette. Uh—
Marinette: (snatches the ring and puts it on) Whatever, there's no time!

title: Reflekdoll/Transcript
text:
Reflekdoll/Transcript - Intro
[Transformation Sequence]Marinette: Plagg, claws out! (Marinette turns into Lady Noire, the female version of Cat Noir.)
Tikki: (at the car, she finds the Miraculous) Yes! (hears footsteps) Ah!
Adrien: Plagg? Plagg!
Lady Noire: (attacking Reflekdoll) Ahh!
Adrien: Oh?
Tikki: Oh... (sees Reflekdoll from afar) Marinette! (flies back)
Adrien: Plaaagg? Plagg!
Tikki: You are Cat Noir, correct?
Adrien: (nods) Mmhmm. And that over there is... Ladybug?
Tikki: There's been a little mix up with the Miraculous. I'm Tikki, pleased to meet you!
Adrien: (takes the Miraculous) Hm! Well...!
[Transformation Sequence]Adrien: Tikki, spots on! (Adrien turns into Mister Bug, the male version of Ladybug.)
Lady Noire: Ah! Ah! Ah!
Mister Bug: Well, M'Lady Noire, it looks like you're playing the easy part today!
Lady Noire: Not so sure about that! (blocks Reflekdoll's attack with her staff) Looks like we'll be taking on two opponents with each other's power!
Lady Noire & Mister Bug: (dodge Reflekdoll's laser) Ah!
Lady Noire: Stay focused, Mister Bug. Use the yo-yo as a shield!
Mister Bug:  (smacks himself with the yo-yo) Oww!
Lady Noire: ''(facepalms)
Hawk Moth: They've swapped their Miraculouses!

title: Reflekdoll/Transcript
text:
Reflekdoll/Transcript - Intro
Mayura: And they're struggling with their new powers.
Hawk Moth: Make the most of it, Reflekta, their Miraculouses are within your reach!
Reflekta: Yes, Hawk Moth!
Mister Bug: Just my luck, I'm gonna have to capture two akumas instead of one!
Lady Noire: No! One akuma, and one amok! (Reflekdoll attacks, Lady Noire tackles Mister Bug to save him.)
Mister Bug: Ahh!
Lady Noire: Reflekta has been reakumatized by Hawk Moth, but that giant doll of hers is a sentimonster, created by the owner of the Peacock Miraculous! (attacks Reflekdoll) Hah!
Mister Bug: (attacks Reflekdoll) Hah!  Okay, so we have to find Reflekta's akumatized object, and the baby monster's amok! (They block another laser beam.)
Lady Noire: Can you manage, or should we switch back?
Mister Bug: C'mon, I'm totally capable of doin' it. I just need to use my Lucky—!
Lady Noire: (grabs his arm) No, wait!
Mister Bug: Why'd you do that?
Lady Noire: Because it's too early. You don't know enough about your opponent yet!
Mister Bug: (tackles her) Watch out!
Lady Noire: Ah!
Mister Bug: It's Reflekta controlling a giant doll! (pulls her away from a laser)

title: Reflekdoll/Transcript
text:
Reflekdoll/Transcript - Intro
Lady Noire: (They run past Reflekdoll.) But you don't know where the akuma and amok are hiding!
Mister Bug: The akuma's probably in the same place as the first time we fought her— in her bracelet! (They bound up the Eiffel Tower.)
Lady Noire: Maybe! We're gonna have to check that.
Mister Bug: If I could just get my hands on a mirror, I'd be able to reflect her own beam back at her! (They land on the first floor of the Eiffel Tower.)
Lady Noire: That's not how it works! (They dodge a laser. Reflekta growls with frustration.) The Lucky Charm doesn't just give you what you want.
Mister Bug: We'll see about that. Watch and learn! Lucky Charm! (a mirror appears) A mirror!
Lady Noire: (gasps) Beginner's luck!
Mister Bug: You're just jealous of my mastery, that's all.
Lady Noire: Hmph! (They hear a loud bong and rush over to see Reflekdoll climbing the side of the Eiffel tower. Reflekta holds onto its face, and shoots at them with her bracelet. Mister Bug reflects Reflekta's own beam back at her, and she's knocked down into Reflekdoll. She growls as she makes Reflekdoll charge a large beam at them. They jump back.)
Lady Noire: (sarcastically) Very effective, Mister Bug!

title: Reflekdoll/Transcript
text:
Reflekdoll/Transcript - Intro
Mister Bug: But, I thought...
Lady Noire: May I remind you that the Lucky Charm doesn't just give you an object to defeat the villain with? You actually have to figure out exactly how to use it to win the battle! Using your head! (She bonks his head with her staff. Reflekdoll reaches them.) Now that you've used up your Lucky Charm— (blocks a beam) you've only got a few minutes left— uh! (blocks another beam) Before you transform back, Bugaboy!
Mister Bug: Why don't you try helping me instead of making fun of me!? (They dodge a beam.)
Lady Noire: Apparently, Bugaboy doesn't have a sense of humor.
Mister Bug: (jumping up the Eiffel Tower) Sounds like you're wearing the clown costume now!
Lady Noire: (twirling her staff) You bet! I'm the cunning, funny, and ultra-charming Lady Noire! Watch and learn. Cataclysm! (She cataclysms Reflekdoll's face.)
Reflekta: (As they fall) Whoaah! (Reflekdoll starts bugging out.) What's happening?
Lady Noire: You think that's normal?

title: Reflekdoll/Transcript
text:
Reflekdoll/Transcript - Intro
Mister Bug: Dunno, I've never cataclysmed a sentimonster before. (Reflekdoll throws them off, going berserk.) It's as if the Cataclysm was like a bee sting on a bull! It riled it up without actually wounding it! (They dodge a beam.)
Lady Noire: We don't have much time left before we transform back!
Mister Bug: And we still don't know where the amok's hidden.
Reflekta: (tumbling around inside the sentimonster) No, Reflekdoll! Stop! She-Cat Noir!? Bug Boy!? Help me!
Lady Noire: So, you like playing with dolls? (jumps away)
Mister Bug: Hey! You stole my line! (jumps after her)
Mayura: Should I retrieve the amok?
Hawk Moth: No, definitely not. Chaos can prove a good ally.
Lady Noire: Hah! (throws her stick to keep Reflekdoll's eye open.)
Reflekta: (Mister Bug pulls her out with his yo-yo) Whoa! (They get away from Reflekdoll, and she turns on them.) These costumes look ridiculous on you, I'm going to redo your wardrobe!
Mister Bug: You could at least show a bit of gratitude! (breaks her bracelet, the akuma flies out) Besides, I think we look pretty good in these costumes.
Lady Noire: Don't forget to capture the akuma.

title: Reflekdoll/Transcript
text:
Reflekdoll/Transcript - Intro
Mister Bug: I've always wanted to do this! (opens his yo-yo) Playtime's over little akuma. Time to de-evillize! (captures the akuma) Gotcha! (releases a white butterfly) Bye-bye, little butterfly. (Juleka turns back into herself, but a stray beam from Reflekdoll immediately changes her into another Reflekta copy.) Oh well, whatever. I'll just fix everything back up, anyway. Mira—!
Lady Noire: (grabs his arm) You might wanna stop Reflekdoll from destroying anything else before we go around repairing everything. (charges toward it) Haaah!
Mister Bug: (looks around, trying to figure out how to use his Lucky Charm) Okay, I admit it. It's not easy being a super Ladybug.
Lady Noire: (keeping Reflekdoll occupied) And I admit that I like wearing your costume. It's a lot lighter on the shoulders. (They hide behind a chimney)
Mister Bug: I'll never be able to do this without you, m'lady.
Lady Noire: Reflekta was controlling the doll from inside its eye. We're gonna have to get inside there and find the object containing the amok!
Mister Bug: But... how can we do that without getting hit by its beam?

title: Reflekdoll/Transcript
text:
Reflekdoll/Transcript - Intro
Lady Noire: Why don't we just figure out how to use this mirror? You're a simple, straightforward guy...
Mister Bug: Thanks for the 'simple' part.
Lady Noire: While I always tend to come up with convoluted plans.
Mister Bug: Not to say, surreal.
Lady Noire: Of course! Simple and straightforward! (peers over at Reflekdoll) That access panel on the back of its head, that's how we're gonna get in. And all we need is a...
Mister Bug: A screwdriver!
Lady Noire: Or a coin! (points at the mirror)
Mister Bug: That's right! Or something big and round like a coin!
Lady Noire: Mmhmm. (She trips Reflekdoll, and Mister Bug ties it up with his yo-yo.)
Mister Bug: I would've just asked for a huge coin if I'd known.
Lady Noire: Sure, but you can never know in advance. (Mister Bug opens the panel with the mirror.) The stick shift is a hair clip!
Mister Bug: You're the best, m'lady! (Lady Noire breaks the helm with her stick, releasing the amok.) Time to de-evillize! (captures the amok) Gotcha! (releases a white feather) Bye-bye, little feather. (throws up his Lucky Charm) Miraculous Mister Bug! (The citizens cheer as the magical ladybugs turn everyone back to normal.)

title: Reflekdoll/Transcript
text:
Reflekdoll/Transcript - Intro
Lady Noire & Mister Bug: (fist bump) Pound it!
Hawk Moth: (clenching his fist) We failed yet again!
Mayura: (clasping his hand) But there are two of us now. We're much stronger, and we will win in the end. Duusu, fall my feathers. (detransforms)
Hawk Moth: Nooroo, dark wings fall. (He detransforms. The window closes)
Duusu: Yahoo!
Nooroo: Ah!
Duusu: That was awesome! Huh? (Nathalie coughs, then collapses. Gabriel holds her.) No, it wasn't awesome at all. (sobs) Are you okay, Ms. Nathalie?
Gabriel: Everything's fine. She's just... tired.
Duusu: Yahoooo!
Gabriel: Nathalie needs peace and quiet. Duusu, let her rest.
Duusu: Yes, of course. Sorry.
Mister Bug: Honestly, I understand why you never have any time to make jokes, m'lady.
Lady Noire: We both have our roles, huh Bugaboy? (They jump into separate alleyways.)
Mister Bug: Spots off! (He detransforms. Tikki lands in his hands, and he gives her a bite of camembert. He begins taking off the earrings, which appear flat and silver.)
Adrien: See you again, soon, Tikki.
Tikki: Goodbye, Adrien! (takes the miraculous, which turn round and polka-dotted when she grabs them, and flies away)

title: Reflekdoll (sentimonster)
text:
Reflekdoll (sentimonster) - Intro
Reflekdoll was the titular main antagonist of the episode "Reflekdoll".
She was a baby doll-like sentimonster manifested by Mayura for Reflekta from her frustration and misery over her not being able to allow herself to be in the spotlight in the episode of the same name. She temporarily went berserk because of Lady Noire's Cataclysm, but was defeated by Mister Bug's de-evilization process.

title: Reflekdoll (sentimonster)
text:
Reflekdoll (sentimonster) - Appearance
Physical appearance
Reflekdoll's appearance was just like Reflekta's but in baby doll proportions. She resembled a baby doll made of circular interlocked pieces. The head was pale pink with two dark salmon circles on the cheeks and lips. The "hair" was hot pink with cylindrical, semicircle-tipped protrusions, and there was a white compass-like design on the forehead with a pink border and a red circle in the middle. Her skirt and blouse were both hot pink with rose-colored jagged lines bordered by white. The torso was metallic gray. The arms and legs were both pale pink. There were purple stripes on the legs just above the hot pink shoes.

title: Reflekdoll (sentimonster)
text:

Reflekdoll could shoot giant beams from her mouth which turned people into copies of Reflekta, much like Reflekta's own ability.

text:
Reflekdoll (sentimonster) - Trivia
This was the first sentimonster to be created for Reflekta, with the second one being Guiltrip from the episode with the same name.

title: Renlings
text:
Renlings - Intro
are major characters of Miraculous World: Shanghai – The Legend of Ladydragon. They are divine, sprite-like beings who embody human values. They grant the wielder of the Prodigious the ability to transform into the animals they represent, provided the wielder embodies the corresponding values.
They are cousins of the kwamis, other spirit-like beings who embody abstract concepts.

title: Renlings
text:
Renlings - Appearance
In general, the Renlings are about the same size as the kwamis. They have large heads, big eyes, tails of varying lengths, and animal-like bodies, unlike the kwamis' more humanoid appearance. They are primarily bright red with black swirl patterns, while some also have orange undersides. Although the concept art depicts them with lime green hair, their final designs feature golden yellow hair. They also have purple mouths.

title: Renlings
text:
Renlings - Abilities
Renlings are immortal divine beings capable of levitation. They are visible only to the Renren, the wielder of the Prodigious, and remain invisible to everyone else. Unlike their cousins, the kwamis, who grant a variety of superpowers, Renlings allow the Renren to transform into the animal each of them represents, as long as the wielder embodies that animal's corresponding value.

title: Renlings
text:
Renlings - Etymology
"Renling" is a play on the Chinese term rèn lǐng (认领/認領), meaning "to claim", "adopt", or "accept", combined with the English diminutive suffix "-ling", making the name roughly mean "little people".

title: Renlings
text:
Renlings - Trivia
The renlings share their color scheme with Ladydragon.
In early concept art, Ladydragon also had golden hair, matching the renlings' final designs.
The five colors featured in the concept art (green, red, orange, black, and white) correspond to the five elements of Wu Xing: wood, fire, earth, water, and metal.
The renlings have been described as the "cousins" of the kwamis.
The renlings appear to correspond to animals commonly featured in Southern Chinese martial arts. The traditional Five Animals are the tiger, crane, leopard, snake, and dragon, while alternate systems replace the leopard and dragon with the monkey and mantis. Other martial arts styles also feature animals such as the eagle and bear.
According to Jeremy Zag, Ladybug and Cat Noir would eventually meet the Renlings' owner, who he described as "very special".
This was later revealed to be Ladydragon.
Like the kwamis, the renlings are bound to a magical object. However, whereas each kwami is linked to its own Miraculous, all renlings are connected to the same object: the Prodigious.
Unlike kwamis, who can be seen by anyone under normal circumstances, renlings are visible only to the Renren.

title: Renlings
text:
Renlings - Trivia
Since kwamis are connected to parallel universes, it is possible that renlings are as well.
Ma Ma, Hu Hu, She She, Hou Hou, and Long Long are based on the same animals as Kaalki, Roaar, Sass, Xuppu, and Longg from the Chinese Miracle Box.
Ying Ying and Xiong Xiong are based on the same animals as Liiri and the Bear kwami from the Native American Miracle Box, respectively.
Tang Tang is the only renling based on an animal that is not known to have a corresponding kwami.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Intro
"" is a Season 5 episode of the series Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. Based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 26th written and produced episode of Season 5. It is also the 130th written and produced episode of the series overall.
This episode is also the second and final part of two-part Season 5 finale, "The Final Day", serving as both the final episode of the season, and the ending of the first saga of Miraculous – the Agreste family arc.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Synopsis
Monarch's ultimate plan is in motion. Nothing seems able to stop him now. Especially considering that, while the world descends into chaos, the supervillain has just trapped Ladybug in person…
Disney+
Ladybug faces Monarch.
Netflix
With Cat Noir immobilized and an army of Miraculized drones in pursuit of Lady Bug, Monarch grows even closer to accomplishing his sinister goal.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Plot
The episode starts off with "Cerise Bianca" watching Alec Cataldi's reality TV show: "Live Your Childhood Dream", on her smartphone at the Parisian Catacombs. However, Alec begins to suffer from a nightmare involving his dad shaving off all of his hair, something that Alec begs him stressfully not to do. She then switches over to Nadja Chamack, who immediately reports about the emergence of the Miraculized villains, and how they are now spreading across the globe, looking for Ladybug and Cat Noir, still under the false accusations of kidnapping Adrien Agreste and Kagami Tsurugi, with one of them interrupting Nadja to declare their undeterred sentience. Soon, Cerise puts down her phone and puts on a new disguise; consisting of blue contact lenses, a black bob cut wig, some glasses, a pink shirt, some blue jeans, and a black jacket. Bringing Tomoe Tsurugi's laptop with her as well, Cerise puts on a sinister smile as she gets on 'her' bicycle and rides off towards whereabouts unknown...
Meanwhile, in the Agreste's kitchen of the Agreste mansion, Bug Noire and Monarch begin their battle, with the former commenting on: "Whatever happens, it's the end this time!".

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Plot
Utilizing the power of "Venom" to paralyze his foe, Monarch, and Bug Noire, lunge at each other, with the two clashing their respective weapons against the other's (for Bug Noire, her Staff and Yo-yo, and for Monarch, his Cane).
With the former's secret identity now outed out to her arch-enemy, following "Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)", the latter wastes no time in lightly chiding himself over not figuring out, anytime sooner, that Marinette was Ladybug, because he nearly could've during the times where he nearly akumatized her in "Chameleon", "Zombizou", "Cat Blanc", "Ladybug", "Elation", and "Derision", to which the former responds with: "Just nearly though.", but the latter retorts this with: "Only because of your outrageous luck!", as the former pins his cane to the floor with her staff before smacking him in the chin with it, stumbling the supervillain backwards a bit.
Summoning up her "Lucky Charm" in the form of a grand piano, Bug Noire backflips and allows the grand piano to fall on Monarch, and then, the young superheroine sends the distracted adult supervillain flying through the mansion, out of the kitchen, and into a nearby wall, with her staff.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Plot
After obtaining her "adult" powers, alongside with Adrien/Cat Noir during the events of "Revolution", Marinette/Ladybug/Bug Noire now has the means to summon up her "Lucky Charm" and her "Cataclysm" as many times as she chooses to.
Summoning up another "Lucky Charm" in the form of a pair of handcuffs, she declares that: "Luck is something you make.
(...) And victory is something you take!", as she charges at Monarch to continue their fight.
Around the Liberty, as civilians turn into the Miraculized, Ivan fights off his friends while the Resistance try to restrain him. Rose tackles him down, allowing Nino to grab Ivan's ring and destroy it. Ivan returns to normal and panics over his nightmare of Mylène leaving him before she and the others calm him down with a hug.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Plot
Meanwhile, at the Thousand Delights restaurant in Shanghai, Wang Cheng fights some of the Miraculized, while Fei is in the bathroom panicking as the Renlings, and Mei Shi, reassure her that she is worthy of the Prodigious, indicating that Fei was suffering her own nightmare triggered by Nightormentor when he spread his nightmare dust in the prequel to this episode. Wang then has a nightmare of his restaurant being a fast food place. Fei notices this and transforms into Lady Monkey and takes the rings off the people and turns them back to normal.
In Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, the Order of the Guardians, including Su-Han, Penny, Jagged Stone, and Luka are fighting off more Miraculized and Su-Han has a nightmare of him not understanding the modern society. Luka reassures him not to let the nightmares get to him, just before present Bunnyx tells Luka that their Mira Kung-Fu will be more helpful in Paris, so the others and Fang rush into the Burrow to use as a shortcut to get to Paris quickly.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Plot
In New York City in the United States, even more Miraculized are attacking, using Sublimation to fly, but the United Heroez, such as Hot Dog Dan, Majestia, Knightowl, Eagle and Uncanny Valley, are able to fight them off. Majestia flies through to steal and crush the rings, and blows away some of the Miraculized, before she has a nightmare that she will never be able to solve all the world's problems. Knightowl reassures her that anyone can do it at her level. Eagle tells the superheroines to keep going, and if they figure out a solution, the heroes will win. Uncanny Valley analyzes the quantum imprints of the Alliance rings and discovers they carry some Miraculous powers, deducing that something has occurred in Paris, and that's the source of what created the Miraculized in the first place.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Plot
Back at the Agreste mansion, Bug Noire cuffs Monarch, stating that she'll take back all the Miraculouses, freeing the Kwamis and everything else he stole from her, but Monarch continuously uses Shell-ter to protect the rings and Venom to paralyze her. Though eventually, Bug Noire successfully cataclysms the shield and takes the Turtle Miraculous, but worries when Wayzz doesn't come out of it. Monarch, coughing up black ash, another sign of his Cataclysm injury reaching its fatal stages, reveals that the Kwamis are trapped in his lair, claiming that he re-invented their magic, and intends to reconfigure the whole world upon acquiring the Ultimate Miraculous Absolute Power. He then tries to attack her from above using Voyage, but Bug Noire dodges, and summons a Lucky Charm baker's pan to knock back Monarch.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Plot
A Miraculized Denis Damoclès is looking for Ladybug and Cat Noir, but Nino and Alya, disguised as boxes, land a surprised attack on their formal principal and free him from Monarch's grasp. Damoclès says he had a nightmare of Monarch becoming the mayor of Paris and the Resistance gave up the fight. Nino and Alya assure him that the Resistance will never give up, and dressed as The Owl, Damocles joins them in fighting the Miraculized with the other freed civilians. Elsewhere, a Miraculized Nora uses Clout to split the TVi Tower in half, and the United Heroez, having just arrived thanks to Doorman providing a shortcut to Paris from NYC, free her. Uncanny Valley and Majestia repair the building that Nora damaged, while Majestia, under suggestion of her surrogate daughter, agrees to search for Ladybug and Cat Noir, while Eagle, Uncanny, Knightowl, and the others go to help the Resistance.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Plot
Back at the mansion, Monarch uses Venom and Voyage against Bug Noire, but the latter quickly evades his surprise attack and sends him flying once again. Tying him up with her Yo-yo, she repeats a phrase that he once told her, "life is like fashion and that people only have the illusion of choice", and reveals she knows his real name as Gabriel Agreste, leaving Monarch shocked at how she knows his identity. Unbeknownst to him, Félix told Marinette the truth of his true identity. Bug Noire claims its luck, and attempts to use Cataclysm on the Butterfly Miraculous, but he uses Resistance to nullify it. Bug Noire then suffers from a nightmare due to Monarch's earlier actions as Nightormentor, struggling to remain focused. Smirking and taunting her over having fallen victim to his master plan as well, before Monarch can paralyze her with Venom, Bug Noire uses Cataclysm on the ground, sending them both into the Crypt.
The Resistance evades a Miraculized mob in the subway but eventually gets cornered.
Just when things seem dire, Fang swoops in and clears the way with his tail.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Plot
Su-Han, Jagged, Penny, and Luka arrive through Bunnyx's Burrow and use their Mira Kung-Fu to fight off the Miraculized attackers.
Juleka reunites with her brother and asks how he learned to fight.
Luka replies that it’s a long story, and Su-Han adds that the reunion will have to wait.
Suddenly, Jagged is paralyzed by three Miraculized, and Penny is struck by Clout.
The United Heroez arrive to help, and Doorman safely escorts the freed citizens to a secure location.
Knightowl fights the Miraculized one-on-one with her bare hands, as Su-Han is amazed, then he asks Knightowl how she is able to resist the nightmares, to which Knightowl responds that she is the nightmare.
Just then, storm clouds begin to circulate the square with a silhouette of a dragon seen as the lightning cracked, signaling the entrance of Fei as Ladydragon, striking bolts of lightning at the Miraculized to free even more citizens.
However, just as the heroes manage to liberate the Parisians, more Miraculized suddenly teleport in to attack them, using Voyage to warp in from all over the planet, not just from the city.
Alya anxiously asks where Ladybug is.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Plot
In the Crypt, Monarch commands Bug Noire to surrender her Miraculouses so he can make his wish, revealing Émilie's coffin as he explains his goal to awaken his wife and heal his Cataclysm injury, while Adrien and Kagami become his new world's eternal icons. A shocked and infuriated Bug Noire calls Monarch insane as he does not care how many lives he has to take away to reawaken Émilie and cure the fatal injury that Cat Noir inflicted on him. Despite Bug Noire calling him out on his insanity, Monarch madly retorts that he doesn't care. He's crossed the point of no return and he's come too far and given up too much to turn back now.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Plot
Meanwhile, Zoé and Nathaniel try to protect a paralyzed Marc from more Miraculized. Knightowl manages to save them, but gets attacked by one of the Miraculized with Clout, sending her flying into the Roue de Paris. Then, many Miraculized teleport to and paralyze Ladydragon with Venom, causing her to fall to the ground, whilst Luka suffers from a nightmare as more Miraculized close in on him. Meanwhile, as Bug Noire and Monarch fight, they argue over Adrien, his whole life, coping with the loss of his mother, and how long Gabriel has constantly isolated him from the real world to the point of using him as an excuse to justify his madness. Simultaneously, Majestia returns to regroup with the other heroes and looks down at Eagle, Uncanny, Nino, and Alya despairingly, revealing that she couldn't find Ladybug or Cat Noir, so they are on their own, despite the odds looking extremely grim. Alya tries to call Marinette, but it keeps going to voice mail. Outside the mansion, Cerise uses Tsurugi's laptop to hack into the mansion security and enters, witnessing the fight in the basement.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Plot
As Monarch insists on wanting Adrien to be happy, Bug Noire summons another Lucky Charm in the form of tube of glue while devising a plan to force Monarch on the defensive.
By gluing a boomerang to her yo-yo and launching it at Émilie's coffin, she forces Monarch into a dilemma: Continue fighting her to get the Ladybug and Black Cat Miraculous, or protect his wife before her coffin is damaged.
Horrified at the thought of the coffin being damaged and losing his wife, Monarch teleports to grab it, but it gets stuck to his hand, allowing Bug Noire to steal half of his Miraculous Alliance rings with her yo-yo; she then uses Cataclysm to send the elevator plummeting down, forcing Monarch to hold it using his cane, since he could not use Shell-ter or Resistance anymore after being disarmed of their rings.
Bug Noire then throws her staff at the Butterfly Miraculous, knocking it off Gabriel, who screams in horror as he reverts back, thus finally putting an end to Hawk Moth/Shadow Moth/Monarch and his reign of terror for good as the Miraculous falls into the water.
Gabriel makes an attempt to grab it, only to be stopped by Bug Noire.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Plot
As Gabriel commands Nooroo to retrieve the brooch, Bug Noire pulls him towards her with her yo-yo, claiming that Nooroo will only obey the next Butterfly Miraculous holder that she will choose personally and Nooroo no longer belongs to him as, since Bug Noire is Guardian of the Miracle Box, she has officially renounced his claim on the Butterfly Miraculous.
Enraged and desperate, Gabriel attempts to use Venom, but Bug Noire blocks it while intending to render Gabriel powerless by Cataclysming the Miraculous Alliance Rings, thus freeing the Kwamis with their Miraculous destroyed, and restore the chaos before sending Plagg back to his owner, declaring "Checkmate" to Gabriel and it is over, he has lost, once and for all. But remembering that Gabriel and Nathalie only have a little time left to live, Bug Noire has the former watch Émilie's video message of wanting the best for Adrien.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Plot
This causes Gabriel to break down in shame and guilt, admitting her slumber destroyed him while mentioning his only happy memory of Émilie's smile was the day Adrien was born, but he comprehended the circumstances of Adrien's birth when Émilie became ill, and now, he's ruined everything: Adrien's life, the world and its people, all in his mad obsession to have back the life taken away from him because his wife used a Miraculous when it was damaged, and now, with his own body close to disintegrating to ash from his Cataclysm necrosis, it's too late to make amends. Bug Noire states that Adrien has learned to live through that tragedy, explaining to Gabriel that using the Miraculouses' power has a price that wouldn't solve anything. She assures Gabriel that they can find another solution together, reverting back to Marinette. Tikki and Plagg warn Marinette not to trust Gabriel, just as he uses Venom on her while her guard is down.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Plot
Taking the Ladybug and Cat Miraculous, Gabriel tells Marinette that he already found another solution, and then puts them on himself and commands Tikki and Plagg to reveal their true forms before unifying them to summon Gimmi, the Kwami of Reality. Gabriel removes his remaining rings and frees Marinette from her paralysis as he tells Gimmi he wants to make a wish, to their annoyance at another summoner wanting to complain about the current universe and wanting to change it. With Marinette unable to interfere as she begs Gabriel not to proceed, as a promise he asks her not to reveal the truth to Adrien of his villainous acts and instead to remind his son of the times he tried to be a good father. After Gabriel tells them to read his heart to know his wish and then read his soul to know what he intends to sacrifice, Gimmi grants his wish. Gabriel discards the Miraculouses and the wedding rings while embracing Émilie as the two appear to vanish before Gimmi carries out their duty with the Ultimate Miraculous Absolute Power. Marinette covers her eyes and braces herself for the end as the resulting explosion destroys the entire universe in a bright light as it is re-created.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Plot
One month later, Adrien is awakened from his nap by a kiss from Marinette.
The Resistance, Sabrina, Su-Han, Jagged, Penny, Luka, Kagami and Félix are all having a pool party at the Agreste mansion, which is covered in beautiful greenery during a sunny day.
Placide offers Amélie and Nathalie (who is alive and well) a drink, and a news broadcast begins as Alec, on his new programme "Nouveau Monde", has a new exclusive interview with Caline Bustier, who is the new elected mayoress of Paris, and her newborn daughter Harmonie.
Mayoress Bustier says that Paris will be eco-friendly under her "Eco Rule".
She then unveils a statue of Gabriel Agreste, which was created by melting and re-forging the Alliance rings to ensure their destruction, for who is said to have sacrificed himself to save Paris from Monarch, while Tomoe will be taking over the Agreste brand to "continue his legacy".
The Mayoress also plans to open a new high school, that will allow its students to learn any subject at any time.
After everyone leaves, Marinette asks Adrien if he is not going to wear his parents' rings, which Ladybug gave him while honoring Gabriel's final request.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Plot
Adrien admits not knowing if he will be like his father, but Marinette tells him to be himself as they embrace and kiss.
A few weeks later in August, Nadja reports on the news, stating that summer break will end and the next school year will begin very soon. Meanwhile, in Marinette's room, she is working on creating the mini miracle boxes with the recovered Miraculous spellbook while Alya and Su-Han watch over her. The Kwamis are happy to have all their respective Miraculous back to normal, although Marinette wasn't able to find Nooroo and the Butterfly Miraculous, which does concern the Grandmaster and Alya. However, she declares that whatever happens, they will be prepared to face any future threats, especially if Nooroo and the Butterfly Miraculous fell into the hands of evil again.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Plot
Marinette recalls her mistake of keeping all the Miraculouses in one place during Season 4 and, considering that she lost all of them when her yo-yo was stolen by Flairmidable and Monarch at the end of "Strikeback", decides to entrust the current members of French Miraculous superhero team with their respective Miraculous and Kwami on a permanent basis, as "in order to ensure power is only used for the greater good, it needs to be shared". Ladybug meets up with Cat Noir on a rooftop as they are quickly joined by the restored team, and the new addition of Argos, as they jump off into another adventure.
Later, Mr. Damoclès sets up his new office as the high school principal when he receives a call from an anonymous source inquiring of attending the school and Damoclès agrees to see the new student later. Cerise Bianca, contacting the principal from the Parisian Catacombs, closes her computer and puts the Butterfly Miraculous on while looking forward to meeting Marinette again in the next school year. She is caught off guard when a flash of lightning suddenly appears behind her as the scene cuts to black, ending Season 5 on a cliffhanger and leaving her fate unknown.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
