title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Plot Development
As of this episode, in regards to the Miraculous holders:
After Marinette returns the Miraculouses back to their original forms, the temporary members of the French Miraculous superhero team that were recruited since season 2 have all received their Miraculous permanently. Marinette was also able to secure back the Grimoire.
Due to Monarch no longer posing as a threat, Alya returns to her identity as Rena Rouge and no longer needs to make her presence secret to the team as Rena Furtive. Nino, Kim, Max, and Kagami are also able to use their Miraculous, even though Ladybug still trusted them despite Gabriel knowing who they were, especially Luka, who is able to return home, along with Jagged and Penny. Additionally, Alix is able to finally return to the present, keeping the Rabbit Miraculous permanently.
Argos has also joined the team, totaling the member count to 18. The only Miraculous not present is the Butterfly, which is acquired by Cerise.
In this episode, Cerise acquired the Butterfly Miraculous, setting her up as the main antagonist in Season 6.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Plot Development
As of this episode, every former member of Miss Bustier's class has received a Miraculous, following Marinette and Adrien in "Origins", Alya in "Sapotis", Chloé in "Style Queen", Nino in "Anansi", Max in "Startrain", Kim in "Party Crasher", Mylène in "Mega Leech", Rose in "Guiltrip", Juleka in "Crocoduel", Sabrina, Nathaniel and Ivan in "Penalteam", and Alix in "Evolution".
Cerise is also the second member of Miss Bustier's class to use a Miraculous for evil following Chloé in "The Battle of the Miraculous".
As well as more about and the fate of the kwamis:
It's revealed that they have giant, humanoid forms that can be revealed by saying "[kwami], reveal yourself!"
Tikki's humanoid form was revealed in "Dearest Family", but only as a silhouette.
Tikki and Plagg's true forms were clearly revealed in "Miraculous Paris", by Alternate Marinette when she commanded alternate Tikki and Plagg to reveal themselves, but failed by commanding to combine.
Tikki and Plagg can also combine to form Gimmi, the kwami of Reality.
When Gimmi is summoned, impenetrable barrier materializes around the summoner and the symbol of Order of the Guardians appears under the summoner.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Plot Development
When Gimmi disappears and separated back to Tikki and Plagg, they remember what the user's wish was as in "Miraculous London".
This is the first episode in which the Kwamis have been in Marinette's care since the season 4 finale and they are all reunited with their true owners.
More information about the Miraculous superpowers is revealed while other facts are unknown:
It is revealed that a Ladybug Miraculous holder with access to the jewel's full power can create as many Lucky Charms they want as long as they undo the current one, when an adult Ladybug Miraculous holder user summons a second Lucky Charm when one is still active, the energy of the first one will be recycled into the second.as well as can dismiss their Lucky Charm object from existence without calling on the Miraculous Ladybug (superpower).
Another effect of Venom is revealed: if someone gets stung whilst flying, they immediately stop levitating and fall to the ground.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Plot Development
It is revealed that despite being a sentimonster, Adrien was born and grew up like a normal boy. That is because, when he was manifested through the use of Amokization, he became a growing fetus inside his mother's womb, leading to him being born and growing like any other human being.
It is revealed that Liberation can also nullify limitations that the target didn't put on themselves or are innate to them, and that were put in them through other means, even magical ones. Seen by Eagle is that even minor can affect multiple targets with their feathers with this in mind it could be that Eagle already had the mental maturity to access her adult powers or like the Rabbit may have another limitation.
As of "Style Queen", the kwamis can use their powers in their spiritual and standard forms but it's unknown if they can use them in their true forms or what said versions would like.
This is the final episode of the Agreste family arc, which is the ending of the first story arcs of the Miraculous saga, which began all the way back with the very first episode of the show, "Stormy Weather", in the production order.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Plot Development
However, "Ladybug & Cat Noir" and "Stoneheart" make up the first and second episodes, and are to be set entirely before the events of "Stormy Weather" as the third episode, which is a prequel to the other episodes the series in chronological order.
This episode is followed by "Action" in production, though that episode takes place after "Confrontation" and before "Collusion" in the chronological order.
The two Miraculous World specials released between seasons 5 and 6 are also part of the Agreste saga, with "Miraculous Paris" taking place during the events of "Multiplication" and "Destruction", and "Miraculous London" taking place during the events of "Re-creation".
As of this episode and "Shadow Moth's Final Attack", some of the uncertainties discussed in "Timetagger" are partially revealed.
Gabriel was successful in using the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses to make his wish come true, but he surrendered all the other jewels and sacrificed himself to make it happen, thus defeating Hawk Moth/Shadow Moth/Monarch. This means that, by going in chronological order, this episode marks Gabriel's final physical appearance in the show.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Plot Development
This is also Émilie's final physical appearance, but both she and Gabriel continue to appear in flashbacks during Season 6.
This also clarifies on what the titular villain in "Timetagger" was referring to. And in the scene featuring Gabriel and Nathalie, in a way, both of them were right, as while Gabriel is no longer present in the world, Nathalie's prediction of him getting the absolute power was indeed correct.
As of this episode, Gabriel Agreste achieved the goal of acquiring the Miraculous of the Ladybug and the Cat within the permanent timeline, but he makes a wish to heal Nathalie instead.
With him finally being defeated and deceased, Cerise Bianca becomes the new holder of the Butterfly Miraculous as the new Hawk Moth.
The Butterfly Miraculous was lost to both Hawk Moth and the heroes, falling into the hands of another evil individual, Cerise Bianca.
The fate of the Peacock Miraculous and Duusu is answered with Félix as his new owner who joins Ladybug's team.
The Miraculous spellbook was recovered by the heroes.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Plot Development
Ladybug finally learns about the ultimate toll of using the Miraculouses when damaged from Nathalie in the former episode, but it's unknown if she told Cat Noir and the others or was informed of the real cure for the affliction.
It's unknown how different the reality created by Gabriel's wish differs from the previous one. However, having in consideration how Nathalie was brought back by Gabriel and how Marinette still remembers the events before the use of the absolute power in "Miraculous London", it's possible that the only difference is the one thing that Gabriel wished for and the price he had to take. However, it's possible to see how the world changed in consequence of that wish:
Everyone knows that Ladybug defeated Monarch and recovered all the Miraculous (except for the Butterfly), however, they don't know (and possibly will never know) who Monarch was, including Adrien/Cat Noir. That is because Marinette decided to honor Gabriel's wish of his son not knowing the villain he was.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Plot Development
The only ones know who Monarch was are the ones that had previous knowledge of it: Nathalie, Tomoe Tsurugi, Félix, Lila, the kwamis of the Chinese Miracle Box, Kagami and Marinette. That also includes Amélie if Félix ever told her.
It's most likely that Marinette told Master Su-Han and Alya about Monarch's identity, as she is seen telling them how she was not able to find the Butterfly Miraculous after the battle.
Considering that in "Miraculous London", Alya learned a half-truth from Marinette, it's impossible to say for sure if she found out the truth later which she does in "Revelator" until her memory was erased.
Plagg, and by extension Tikki, are likely honoring Gabriel's wish of not telling Adrien for his sake, considering they, mostly the former, were shocked upon finding out Gabriel's identity and the reason he wanted to use their Miraculous, even if he wanted to tell him while also bypassing the curse that prevents revealing another holder's identity.
Though it is unconfirmed, Plagg was likely informed of Adrien being a sentimonster, and if so, it would make sense for Plagg that Adrien has never able to stand up to his father.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Plot Development
Everyone is led to believe that Monarch had hacked the Alliance system and that Gabriel helped Ladybug defeat him at the cost of his own life. Because of that, Gabriel is regarded as a hero and all the Alliance rings (at the least the ones from Paris) are melted and fused together to create a statue of Gabriel.
Caline Bustier becomes the new mayor of Paris all while becoming a mother to a baby girl called Harmonie. As soon she became mayor, Miss Bustier started planning and implementing major changes to turn Paris into a much eco-friendly place and also a place where children will have more freedom to decide what they want to do later on.
Regarding the changes she made/planned in light of environment are: suspended gardens at the rooftops, the implementation of self-sufficient energy production/consumption, the cleanse of the Seine river, effort to reduce CO2 emission by creating eco-friendly public transportation all over the city (like electric trams and airships).

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Plot Development
Regarding the changes she made/planned towards the children's future, she, along with the others, planned a special school that focused less on grades and more on teaching students on their own pace and help them find who they want to be later in life, while also incentivizing them to socialize with other children of a variety of ages and having many activities.
The worldwide catastrophe caused by Monarch had caused people to become more aware of the impact they have on the planet.
Gabriel's absence as the villain has created a void to be filled by a new evil possibly even more dangerous than him, with that one being none other than Cerise Bianca who was revealed as having the Butterfly Miraculous and is preparing her return with a new identity and enrolling on the same school as Marinette.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Trivia
This is the ninth season 5 episode that is not named after the concept of a Miraculous. However, the name is similar to the name of the power of the Ladybug Miraculous. The title being spelled as "Re-creation" implies this, as the word without a hyphen means "exercise".
The concept of re-creation is applied in some instances:
Gabriel summoned the Ultimate Miraculous Absolute Power to have his wish granted, what causes the world to be destroyed and then re-created based on that wish.
After Miss Bustier becomes the mayor of Paris, she starts to remold the entire city to become a much more eco-friendly place, creating suspended gardens, reducing the CO2 emission by implanting a system of airship taxis to replace cars, cleaning the Seine, etc.
All the Alliance rings (at least the ones in Paris) had been melted and remodeled into a statue of Gabriel Agreste.
Marinette is able to recover all the stolen Miraculous and reforge them back into their original forms.
With the return of the Miraculous to her ownership, Marinette, as Ladybug, is able to recover her entire team, with Argos also joining as the Peacock Miraculous holder.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Trivia
Monarch remade the Miraculouses so only he, the akumatized, and the Miraculized can use them, therefore remaking their magic.
This episode holds the records for having the most Miraculous characters in a single episode, with a total of 74. It was previously held by "Mayura" with 54 and having the most number of times Ladybug has summoned her Lucky Charm during a single transformation, with a total of four.
This is the third time Cataclysm has been used six times in a single episode, following "Miraculer" and "Revolution".
Tied with "Revolution", this episode takes the record for the most uses of Cataclysm by a Miraculous holder, with a total of six times, tying it with "Miraculer" and "Revolution" for the most uses in a single episode being second to "Cat Blanc".
This is also the fifth time Cataclysm has been used by a heroine form of Marinette.
Cerise is the only human/character who hasn't been affected by the nightmare dust of Nightormentor due to her hiding out in La Plage.
Like in the previous episode, "Conformation," each character's nightmare instigated by Nightormentor is revealed:
Alec's nightmare involves his father cutting his hair.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Trivia
Wang's nightmare is that his restaurant will transform into a fast-food outlet.
Su-Han's nightmare centers around his inability to understand modern society.
Majestia's nightmare reflects her powerlessness to solve all of the world's problems.
Mr. Damoclès' nightmare is that Monarch becomes the president of France.
Fei's nightmare involves her feeling unworthy to wield the Prodigious.
With the appearances of characters from "Miraculous New York" and "Miraculous Shanghai", this can be considered the first crossover episode of the main series.
The reason "Jubilation" isn't counted as the first is because those characters only appeared in Ladybug and Cat Noir's dream while under the effects of Gift. But if the episode does count, then that makes "Re-creation" to be the second crossover episode.
As of their dream in said episode, both of them came true as to where they retrieve the Miraculouses and the team while Ladybug and Cat Noir are in a relationship.
It's revealed that sometime after Luka, Jagged, and Penny left Paris in "Migration", they began training Mira-kung fu with Su-Han in Brazil.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Trivia
Following Master Fu and Marinette, Luka is the third person to become a Guardian and Miraculous holder.
Jagged is the first known member of the guardians to have a pet.
Following Marinette, Penny is the second known member of the Guardians to be a woman.
It's revealed that ever since the events of "Miraculous New York", Knightowl dons a new costume that shows off her feminine side.
The mini Miraculous boxes have returned, ever since they were last seen in "Party Crasher".
The box was also Ladybug's Lucky Charm in "Mayura" and "Evolution".
When Marinette was making the boxes, it looked like they were made out of stone-like material or wood.
This also marks the second time in the series Armand D'Argencourt has lost a Paris mayoral election, following "Darkblade".
This episode marks the third time Adrien and Marinette kiss each other in their civilian form and the second time they kiss as a couple. Overall, this is technically (in the permanent timeline), the fifth time they kiss.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Trivia
Counting the alternate timeline in "Cat Blanc", where Adrien discovers Ladybug's identity and declares his feelings to Marinette and the dream Ladybug and Cat Noir had in "Jubilation", where they defeat Monarch and retrieve all the Miraculouses, and later both get married and form a family with children of their own, they have kissed eight times.
This is the first time one or both of the main heroes are seen in the crypt in the permanent timeline.
The state of the Chinese Miracle Box differs as from the season 4 finale; the empty box represents fear and danger, but now it represents freedom, trust and understanding.
In the event, if the Miracle Box, along with any remaining jewels, gets stolen after said holders had been chosen, they act as similar to another safety precaution preventing someone who is selfish or evil from getting them all therefore keeping hope alive.
This is the last time in season 5 the Miraculous power-ups were used.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Trivia
When Tikki and Plagg revealed their true forms, their wings showed a great resemblance to the jet pack wings Ladybug and Cat Noir gained when in Space Mode, but it's unknown if the model for the jet packs gave inspiration for re-creating the kwamis true forms or the other way around.
Marinette mentions to Alya and Su-Han that she transformed into Aquabug to look for the Butterfly Miraculous in the crypt, marking the eighth time aqua power is used.
However, this is the second time a special power-up has been used off-screen, following "Stormy Weather 2".
This is also the first time a known person has swam in the crypt's water, it is later revealed in "Miraculous London" that Cerise swam in the water before Marinette.
Cerise's laptop has the AZERTY keyboard layout, similarly to the heroes' phones on their tools.
This is the third time Marinette was affected by Venom following "Passion" and "Revolution".
This is the seventh episode of seasons 4 and 5 not to have a polka-dotted pattern on its end card.
For an unknown reason, there are two versions of the episode, the current version and the first version:

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Trivia
When Monarch gets slammed onto the floor by Bug Noire, the background music immediately cuts off.
When Bug Noire hits Monarch with her baking pan Lucky Charm, there is no extra sound effect for it.
The background music during Bug Noire and Monarch's battle in the Crypt whilst the Resistance, the United Heroez, Ladydragon and the Guardians fight the Miraculized, and Cerise entering the Agreste mansion is slightly different.
Plagg's true form lacks the green electricity around him.
Most of the effects are less notable upon Gimmi's appearance and Gabriel making his wish.
Gimmi says "So be it." instead of "So be I."
The way the wave of energy from the wish absorbs the universe and how it is shown differs.
The background music when Cerise video chats with Mr. Damoclès is also different.
This is the second episode where Gabriel cries.
Coincidentally, like season 4, he does it in a two-part finale. In season 4, he does it in "Risk", but in this season, he does it in part 2.
This is the fourth time Ladybug is seen dual wielding following.
It's possible that Cerise was attacked by The Supreme from "Miraculous Paris".

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Trivia
Every miraculous tool appears in some way in the episode, except the Ox's Mallet.
During the sequence of the former team members receiving the Miraculouses permanently, the four who weren't in Miss Bustier's class (Luka, Kagami, Zoé and Marc) are the first to be shown, and they're in the order they initially received them.
Alongside the premiere on TFOU, TF1 released a writers' commentary of the two parter, revealing new information:
Bug Noire and Monarch fighting handcuffed is a reference to kung fu movies.
Marinette is the one who defeats Gabriel, not Bug Noire, showing that in the end, it is not violence or strength that wins, but people talking to each other and opening up about their feelings. It is when people are not subject to their emotions, but instead try to understand them to think better and take the right decisions.
The fact that Gabriel removed all the "weapons" shows that Gabriel has surrendered to Marinette and she has won.
Not being able to live without her, Gabriel decided to sacrifice himself to be with Émilie and save Nathalie.
Despite Adrien and Marinette's cuteness, some lies remain, and the butterflies around them fly ominously.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Trivia
Marinette making the Miraculouses unique jewelry by hand, while Gabriel had turned them into identical rings with machinery, is an allegory about craftsmanship and industrial production.
The updated Miraculouses would be shown in Season 6 and adapted to every person.
References
During the beginning of their fight, Monarch references how many times he was close to akumatizing Marinette/Ladybug, but never fully succeeded, in which all these attempts have occurred in "Zombizou", "Mayura", "Chameleon", "Ladybug", "Elation", and "Derision".
Monarch, back when he was Hawk Moth, tried to akumatize Marinette in "Cat Blanc", but those events took place during an alternative timeline.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Trivia
He also said that he couldn't do it because of her outrageous good luck, when actually, she described it as "Luck is something you make", meaning that the Ladybug Miraculous doesn't actually bless the user with good luck, but teaches the user to use their creativity, ingenuity, adaptability and more to make their own luck. In a way, Monarch was right, as Ladybug was blessed with luck but in a different way as she was more fortunate when it came to others as she always had friends and family to lookout and support her, while Gabriel pushed everyone away.
This finale can be seen as a combination of all of the previous four season finales, due to the similarities and references shared in some way.
With "Volpina", both finales set up Lila/Cerise as a major antagonist in the future for the show.
With "Mayura", both finales involve huge events that Ladybug and her allies participate in, and fighting against Gabriel and the multitude of villains he created in an attempt to accumulate the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Trivia
With "Miracle Queen", both finales focusing on the main antagonist, Gabriel and Chloé, using their respective Miraculous for evil purposes, gain control over many citizens, exploit the other Miraculouses and their powers for themselves, and losing their Miraculouses in the end, with Ladybug reclaiming back the jewels and offering the villains a chance of redemption. Both villains also fight against a dual unfication of Ladybug, Bug Noire against Monarch and Dragon Bug (alongside Snake Noir) against Miracle Queen.
With parallels and references from "Strikeback", Ladybug and Cat Noir went from having a team of Miraculous holders to losing all but theirs to Monarch. Here, the roles are reversed, with Monarch having claimed every Miraculous, including the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses, to surrendering them all to Ladybug and thus, restoring her team of Miraculous superheroes back.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Trivia
The end card of this episode is similar to the end card in "Mayura"; it has a rainbow (or colorful in general) background in triangular sections, with the heroes that appeared in the episode jumping out in a direction triumphantly. Also she tried to persuade Gabriel to change his ways in said episode, but ended up falling into a trap where Gabriel actually succeeds in having both the Ladybug and Cat Miraculous; however, unlike before, he changed his mind when using the wish by sacrificing his own life.
The move Bug Noire did with Cat Noir's staff is similar to the move Nino did in his fight against Anansi in the "aforementioned episode".
The fact that Cat Noir, in this episode, has missed the battle, and only Ladybug has recovered the Miraculous, is contradicted by what he said in the final scene of the "Strikeback".
This is the first season finale where the Miraculous Ladybug superpower is not used on-screen.
This is the second season finale to feature a post-credit scene following "Miracle Queen".
This is the first not to feature Gabriel Agreste.
This episode begins directly after the events of "Conformation".

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Trivia
"Conformation" and "Re-creation" join "Origins", "Volpina" and "The Collector", "Queen's Battle", "Heroes' Day", "The Battle of the Miraculous", "Truth" and "Lies", "Shadow Moth's Final Attack", "Evolution", along with "Multiplication" and "Destruction", "The Kwamis' Choice", "Collusion", "Revolution" and "Representation" as episodes that take place during the same day.
If the specials "Miraculous Paris" and "Miraculous London" are counted, then that doubles.
Through Gabriel this episode also has a correlation to both sentimonsters in "Strikeback" and "Emotion", all three were destroyed through an act of acceptance and mercy in the end.
Strikeback was destroyed by being thrown into the sun because the team exhausted all the options they had so it was a last resort.
Red Moon was destroyed by Felix, when he fully understood the weight of being a true miraculous holder.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Trivia
Gabriel through his betrayal, upon hearing Ladybug's choice to help him, he knew that despite earning the heroine's forgiveness it wouldn't be the same for everyone else including his family and Nathalie. Nor no matter how much forgiveness Gabriel earned, it wouldn't lower the laws he broke nor the chaos he created upon exposure, he'd be stripped of any and all power, alone in prison if it wasn't for his cataclysm injury through all that he accepted that both Marinette and Adrien were the victors.
Gabriel ranting on in madness about his fantasy resembles what Felix did back in "Emotion".
Both used Adrien or at least what they felt towards him as a motive for their madness.
Both foolishly thought Adrien was going to be thankful for what they did but both were proven wrong, Felix by Adrien physically, Gabriel by Ladybug.
Allusions
The universe being destroyed and rebuilt is similar to Luma's sacrifice in the ending of "Super Mario Galaxy".
Bug Noire's lucky charm piano falling on Monarch is a reference to an old classic cartoon gag.
The ending was also an allusion to "Elena of Avalor" and "Avatar: The Last Airbender" and their finales as well as from "Brave".

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Trivia
From the "Avatar: The Last Airbender":
Like the Fire Lord, Gabriel too lied to everyone but his lie timewise was a lot shorter than the former.
Both families started their destruction and had the power to stop but didn't.
Both misused the hope they put into those who followed them for the Fire Lord: his soldiers and for Gabriel as Hawk Moth: his akumatized victims.
In addition, both misused something causing nothing but trouble for everyone else. For the Firelord, it was his firebending while for Gabriel it was the Miraculouses. In the end, both had lost their gifts, Ozai had his bending taken away unlike him, while Gabriel lost the Butterfly, through finally accepting what happened and he surrendered the other jewels.
Zuko knew about the destruction and damage his family had caused, but it took until mid-season 3 of his series to finally fix it, whereas Adrien didn't know what his father was doing, and without knowing it as Cat Noir he stood against him. This goes for Félix as well.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Trivia
Both Ladybug and Aang were given their destinies too soon as both were suppose to be older but the tradition was broken as a result of a crisis or emergency for Aang: his world was on the verge of war; for Ladybug: there was no time to find adult holders.
Had important information about their enemies kept from them but they didn't have much time left, plus they weren't ready yet.
Because of their statuses, they were given problems no child should ever be forced to think about nor to fix.
Both Zuko and Gabriel obsessively hunted Aang and the Miraculers respectively in the hope (or at least false hope) that everything would go back to normal, but there was no guarantee.
They both finally got what they wanted but it came at a cost, the former finally caught Aang in the first season finale of his series but they both nearly frozen to death if not for Aang's friends finding them; the latter if he had made his first wish, where he'd be led to his defeat anyway.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Trivia
Both fathers dressed up their sons into being something they wanted but not what their sons wanted, and both sons wanted their father's love and approval. Both sons realized through their dads' actions that this would never happen.
On top of that, Ozai had no love in his heart, while Gabriel had love at first but it slowly withered away into revenge, hatred and fear.
Both were responsible for the states of their worlds: like the Fire Nation, Adrien's parents (especially his father and cousin) were directly responsible for everything, similar to Aang; Master Fu left the world without the Miraculous holders nor guardians protection.
And once the Miraculous holders nor Aang had returned both the latter and Master Fu tried to make a difference: where Aang saved the North Water Tribe and Master Fu, where he refused to let the people of Paris suffer the same fate as the Order of the Guardians.
Both the transitions were hard on Master Fu and Aang when they were chosen for their destinies.

text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Trivia
This also alludes to the reason both Adrien and Félix were not there to stop Monarch, the same way why Iroh wouldn't stop his brother. On the notion, that if Adrien had found out about everything sooner, or if everything about his family was exposed, history would see it as more fear and destruction.
When it came to the most critical moment both Aang and Marinette appealed to give their enemies mercy, but unlike her, Aang sensed that Ozai would betray and attack him.
From "Elena of Avalor":
Esteban and Félix both betrayed a cousin that trusted and believed in them, Adrien and Elena respectively.
Gabriel and Esteban both went through great lengths to get what they wanted to make their own lives better but they sought power that wasn't theirs or tried to steal it. For Esteban, this power was the crown of Avalor that was Elena's. For Gabriel, he stole the Miraculouses from the Miraculers.
They sought what they stole to get what they wanted: Esteban wanted the crown just so people would listen to him and Gabriel wanted the Miraculous so his family could be whole again.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Trivia
Despite them being able to get what they want, it would come at a terrible price at the cost of them becoming villains loved by no one. Everyone in Avalor knew of Esteban's treachery but for Gabriel it would be a matter of time before Paris or the world found out if he had made the wish.
They both refused to listen, Esteban was mentioned by Cahu, that he always trusted those who were pretending to listen, while Gabriel refused to listen or trust those who knew and did better than him.
From "Brave":
Similar to Mor'du, both were scarred by the past, the former was eldest prince of his kingdom and felt betrayed when his birthright was going to be shared between him and his brothers while Gabriel, born with no ties to high society received ridicule from both his parents and brother-in-laws when pursuing a relationship with Emilie.
Wishing assert dominance/independence both cut ties with their families, Mor'du cutting the stone sculpture of his family and Gabriel aiding in no contact with his parents.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)

text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Trivia
This also comes from the spell breaker "Fate be changed, look inside mend the bond the torn by pride". As they both tried to change their fates for selfish reasons-Mor'du because of his greed and Gabriel through desperation, obession, greed and fear.
But unlike Mor'du, Gabriel tried to change fate nor his own twice, when he and Emilie tried to have children but couldn't naturally, they used the Peacock Miraculous to create Adrien but due to impatience as well as the jewel was used while broken leading to her condition.
Near the old king's as well as Emilie's end, both their decrees were heeded by the family members all but one, like Mor'du; Gabriel refused to accept that she was gone.
Similar to the brothers, Gabriel also went to war against the Miraculers as Hawk Moth and his alteregos but mostly went into a bitter stalemate.
Both sides refuse to give in, Gabriel and Mor'du- turned into monsters, the prince into a black bear physically and the former was turned into an emotional monster leading to them both laying waste to their homes.
In the end, both were laid to rest by the protaganist accepting that they were wrong with their actions and reuntied with their loved ones.

From "The Dragon Prince":
Similar to what Viren did with the Dragon King and his allies by undoing all the work they did just to imprison Aaravos, Gabriel did the same with Emilie by not respecting her wishes, warning, nor wisdom, he undid the meaning of her sacrifice setting himself up for a situation that's impossible.
As well as Aaravos, both had motives that started out as love but along the way it got twisted and turned into revenge and both sought to use what their fallen loved ones admired or sacrificed themselves for: Leola loved everything and everyone about their world and her own father used the same to destroy it, while Émilie accepted her fate out of love not just for her family but everyone as she wanted a family so much that she couldn't live with herself if another was destroyed which was what Gabriel was trying do to get her back.
All together this series deals with the same thing: Someone who's joy that didn't last long, then falling into grief and despair, taking revenge on others to fix their problems nor to make their suffering easier just to see that they get the opposite of what they wanted.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Trivia
It is revealed in "Miraculous London" that Marinette had discovered that someone had acquired the Butterfly Miraculous, yet when talking to Alya and Su-Han, she appears to not know what happened to it and even tried to look for it in the crypt's water as Aquabug.
It is possible she lied to Alya and Su-Han about searching for it in order to protect her story, or that she searched half-heartedly, knowing it wouldn't be there.
It is also possible that Marinette only went to search for the Butterfly Miraculous after securing the kwamis and making sure Adrien and Kagami were okay, while also wanting to tell Adrien the "truth" before he learned from someone else.
On top of that, with so much chaos and destruction around except for her, Marinette and Gabriel probably thought no one else was crazy enough to come inside the mansion.
Taking the consideration of time travel and placement of events into account as well as Marinette's actions as Bug Noire and Aquabug, the latter is more likely.
This inconsistency could also be due to the timespan of both specials suggesting there was a script rewrite.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)

text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Trivia
When consoling Gabriel, Bug Noire states "Spots and claws away", even though the phrase for de-transforming while using multiple Miraculouses is "Reverse morphosis".
It's possible that this may be a special incantation used for the Ladybug/Cat pair of Miraculouses.
In order to keep the identity of Monarch safe, Ladybug's claim that Gabriel gave his life to defeat Monarch is inconsistent with the rules of her Miraculous Ladybug, as all damage and presumed death is negated and reversed. Therefore, the logic would be scrutinized very quickly, especially by Adrien.
However, it's possible that she said that Gabriel sacrificed himself after Ladybug used her power to restore everything or that Gabriel's sacrifice was beyond her power to repair, something that is believable as even Miraculous Ladybug has its own limitations, such as in "Miracle Queen", when the Miraculous Ladybug couldn't restore Master Fu's memory. In "Miraculous New York", the possibility of Ladybug not being able to restore Aeon had she not been an android is brought up.

text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2) - Trivia
Perhaps the very effects of the Ultimate Miraculous Absolute Power cannot be nullified by the Miraculous Ladybug. This is implied in "Miraculous London".
Implying that the restoration power can be set by the Ladybug holder's intentions and/or knowledge.
Also knowing that Nathalie and Gabriel were at the end of their ropes and Ladybug saying her power restoration couldn't heal either of them, not only did she not know about after effects of their conditions soon enough but both shared no connection to what was happening now.
When Cerise puts on the Butterfly Miraculous at the end of the episode, Nooroo doesn't appear. It's possible that the electrical field could be caused by him, it's currently unknown whether or not that is the case.
Also, when Cerise put on the Miraculous, for some reason it was shown at its activated mode instead of a camouflaged one. It is possible that at the time this episode was produced and finished, a camouflaged mode did not exist for her with this Miraculous.
When Gabriel wears the Ladybug and Black Cat Miraculouses, they do not go into camouflage mode, and instead remain in activated mode.
In the end card, Bunnyx's Miraculous is outside of her pocket.

When Bug Noire takes off one of the rings out of Monarch's right ring finger, she has the Turtle Miraculous ring, but she should have had the Rooster Miraculous ring instead as she grabbed the ring which was closer to the fingertip.
When Monarch, after coughing dust, tells Bug Noire that he reconfigured the Miraculous, the top part of the Butterfly Miraculous phases through his chest.

Monarch was shown to be physically affected by the Lucky Charms even though he was using Resistance, meaning that they should've dissolved when they made contact with him as seen in "Revolution".
It is very possible that Tikki was already aware that Monarch would use Resistance during her battle against Bug Noire and decided to give her Lucky Charms that are not magic and that only disappear after she discards them of their existence with their own power instead of also disappearing with their de-transforming.
It may also be possible that since Marinette was in a unification with the powers of Creation and Destruction, she could have used the energy of Tikki and Plagg's powers to make objects not disintegrate with any kind of magic.
Or Monarch didn't activate Resistance until Bug Noire used the Cataclysm on him directly.
Bug Noire incorrectly states that Resistance is the "power of the Buffalo", when it is in fact the power of the Ox Miraculous.
After Marinette transforms into Bug Noire, the Miraculized don't teleport to Gabriel's mansion and participate in the battle. They could have found out her place using their quantum imprint detectors.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
[ Theme Song ]
Alec: (from the broadcast) And now, we're going to love one another! Starting with everyone loving themselves! Because how are you going to love other people if you don't love yourself? Welcome to "Live Your Childhood Dream"! Today, we're helping Odile, 46, fulfill her childhood dream! Why don't you tell us about it, Odile?
(The scene switches to Cerise, who is seen watching the broadcast on her phone.)
Odile: (from the broadcast) Ever since I was a child, I've been dreaming of meeting every single human being on Earth. But traveling around the world has always seemed impossible to me.
Alec: (from the broadcast) Well, it shouldn't! The team and I discussed it, and we're—
(Suddenly, a headache strikes Alec, causing him to groan loudly in pain. Cerise watches through her phone with amusement.)
Alec: And we're— (grimaces)
Odile: (from the broadcast) Alec, are you alright??
Alec: (from the broadcast, on his knees, grimacing in pain) No, Dad! Please don't shave my head!!
(The broadcast is interrupted with a breaking news.)

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Nadja Chamack: (from the broadcast) Don't be bemused, here's some breaking news! Supervillains are emerging all across the globe! They call themselves "Miraculized" and apparently are after Ladybug and Cat Noir, who are thought to have kidnapped teenage celebrities Kagami Tsurugi and Adrien Agreste!
Miraculized victim: (from the broadcast, flipping the camera towards him) Ladybug! Cat Noir! We'll find you, wherever you are, and we'll free Kagami and Adrien!!
(After turning off her phone, Cerise puts it down on the table and starts to put on another of her disguises. She then takes the Tsurugi briefcase that she stole from Mrs. Tsurugi in "Revolution". She rides a bike and heads off.)
Monarch: I should've known! (smirks)
(The two rivals prepare for battle as Monarch brings out his cane and Bug Noire spins her yo-yo for protection.)
Bug Noire: Whatever happens, it's the end this time!!
(The battle begins. Monarch charges in with Venom and is about to hit Bug Noire with his cane and Bug Noire blocks it with her staff. The two rivals continue to exchange hits with their weapons.)
Monarch: To think of the number of times I nearly akumatized you!!
Bug Noire: Just "nearly" though!

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Monarch: Only because of your outrageous luck!!
(Bug Noire pins Monarch's cane on the ground, causing the tiles to crack upon its impact. Bug Noire plants her staff on the ground, extending it to hit Monarch on his chin, sending him staggering to other side of the kitchen.)
Bug Noire: Speaking of which... Lucky Charm! (summons a grand piano and flips backward, with the piano crashing down on Monarch) Luck is something you make!
(She extends her staff, pushing Monarch through the walls to the mansion's foyer.)
Bug Noire: Lucky Charm!! (summons a pair of handcuffs and attaches one side of it to her wrist) And victory is something you take! (charges towards Monarch)
Miraculized Ivan: I must find Kagami and Adrien!
Alya: We've got to get this ring off!!
(Rose charges in as the Resistance members pile up on in each other. Finally pinning down the Miraculized Ivan on the ground, they seize the opportunity to remove the Alliance ring from his finger and Nino breaks it with his heel, relieving Ivan from being Miraculized, though he is still suffering from Nightormentor's nightmare dust.)
Ivan: NO!! Mylène!! Don't leave me alone!!
Mylène: Don't be scared. I'm right here, teddy bear.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
(Mylène, along with the other members of the Resistance, huddles in Ivan for a group hug.)
Miraculized victim: Where are Ladybug and Cat Noir?!
(Wang holds out a frying pan and hits the Miraculized. But then, more Voyage portals open and more of the Miraculized appear behind him. He hits one of the pans on the counter and catches the ladle that it sent midair.)
Miraculized victims: Where are Ladybug and Cat Noir?! Bring us back Kagami and Adrien!!
(Wang continues to fend of the Miraculized in his restaurant.)
Wang: No one goes in without a reservation!! (hits more Miraculized victims with his frying pan)
Bastille: Not on the menu! Not on the menu! Not on the menu!
(In the restaurant's restroom, Fei is also seen suffering from the effects of Nightormentor's nightmare dust. Her headaches make her collapse on the floor. The Renlings, and Mei Shi appear to her aid.)
Long Long: It was just a nightmare, Fei. It wasn't real!
Mei Shi: Of course you're worthy of the Prodigious!
Fei: I'm worthy of the Prodigious! I'm worthy of the Prodigious!
Wang: No, no! I don't want my restaurant to turn into a fast food outlet!

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
(She gasps as she sees and hears Wang getting cornered by the Miraculized as he succumbs to his own nightmare from Nightormentor's nightmare dust.)
Fei: Uncle Wang! Hou!
(She transforms into Lady Monkey and charges into the kitchen to help Wang fend of the Miraculized. Shortly after their Alliances have been removed, the victims turn back to their normal selves. Lady Monkey looks at the Alliance rings that she took from the victims in her hand.)
Su-Han: It's time for you to prove that you remember everything I've taught you! (kicks off a few of the Miraculized as he falls on his knees once his headaches hit him that are caused by Nightormentor) What's the point of this?! I don't understand this world anymore!
(Luka enters in to save Su-Han.)
Luka: (while fighting off the Miraculized) Master, don't let these nightmares overcome you!

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:

(Making their escape, Jagged Stone whistles to Fang to come with them inside the Burrow. The portal closes quickly before the Miraculized can chase after them.)
Hot Dog Dan: Sabotage! My magic hot dogs!!
Female Miraculized victim: Ladybug! Cat Noir! Where are you hiding?! Whatever it takes—
(A beam of red swoops in towards the Miraculized who are standing on top of the fallen hot dog stand and they revert back to their normal selves, assuming that the red beam has removed their Alliance rings. It does the same to other New Yorkers who are then transformed back into civilians. The red beam then appears to be Majestia, who crushes the Alliance rings with her bare hands.)
Male Miraculized victim: Ladybug! Cat Noir! Where are you?!
(More of the Miraculized appear behind Majestia and she fends every single one of them.)
Majestia: What's with this obsession over the French kids?! (blows away the Miraculized, but stops as her headaches come in) Even with every one of my powers, I'll never be able to solve all the world's problems!
(A Miraculized victim flies down to her with Venom, but is pushed away by Knightowl, who swings in just in time.)

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Knightowl: If anyone could do as much as you do at their own level...
Majestia: Thanks, honey!
(The two heroes fly away. The scene switches to Eagle and Uncanny Valley, who are also seen fighting off the Miraculized.)
Eagle: Keep going! There has to be a reason this is all happening. And once we've figured it out, we'll have won!
Uncanny Valley: I've analyzed these villains. They carry the quantum imprint of some Miraculous powers. (shoots the Miraculized victims flying towards her at their Alliance rings and brings them to safety) Something must have occurred in Paris! (scans the broken Alliance rings in her hand)
Bug Noire: I will take back all of the Miraculous! One by one, if I have to!
(Aims to grab the rings from Monarch)

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Monarch: (shoves Bug Noire away) Shell-ter! (forms another shield) Who's the fool here: he, who has fifteen Miraculous, or she, who recklessly jumped into the Monarch's den, making a mistake of wearing the two Miraculous that I covet?!
(Bug Noire dodges his attack, causing his hands to get stuck in the wall.)

(Monarch is about to land another blow on Bug Noire, but Bug Noire successfully evades it once again.)
Bug Noire: Cataclysm!!
(She successfully destroys the shield and takes one of Monarch's rings. Monarch attempts to catch her but he was too slow to do so.)

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Bug Noire: Things would be so easy if you could defeat me with a snap of your fingers, wouldn't they? (wears the ring with the power of the Turtle Miraculous in hopes that it will give her the power of Protection, but fails) Wayzz?! What have you done to the Miraculous?! Where are the Kwamis?!

There are people who are content with following the rules, and people who bend the world to their wishes! You played Guardian of the Miraculous, I reinvented their magic! And once I've taken yours from you, I'll reconfigure the whole universe, too, as I proclaim my wish!!
(Monarch escapes to the portal underneath him, causing Bug Noire to quickly shift her head side to side. The villain then appears right above Bug Noire, in which she quickly evades once again.)
Bug Noire: Lucky Charm!! (summons a baker's peel) Reconfigure this!! (hits Monarch with the baker's peel, sending him flying through a wall to the atelier)
Miraculized Mr. Damoclès: Ladybug? Cat Noir? Where are you?
(Two boxes appear just behind him, where Alya and Nino are hiding.)

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Nino: You sure that's him, Comrade Beurre Maître d'Hôtel?
Alya: Positive, Comrade Ketchup!
(The two jump out the boxes, holding the flag of France, to capture the Miraculized Mr. Damoclès and to remove his Alliance ring, reverting him back to his normal self.)

(The three of them run out to the streets.)

(cracks her knuckles and jumps in the sky.) Clout! (She swings her punch with the power of the Tiger Miraculous and cracks the Montparnasse Tower in half)
(The United Heroez come in the scene.)
Doorman: Paris, 15th arrondissement.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Eagle: I free you from your nightmares! (throws a magic feather towards the Miraculized victim, with Knightowl throwing her boomerang to break her Alliance ring, reverting the Miraculized victim, who turns out to be Nora Césaire.)
Nora: What happened?
(The United Heroez come to her aid. Majestia flies to the center of the crack and pushes the two halves of the tower back together. Uncanny Valley then seals it with her head laser.)
Uncanny Valley: Mom, search the city as fast as you can. We need to locate Ladybug and Cat Noir!
Majestia: Okay, I'll be back in a flash! (zooms away)
Bug Noire: Life is like fashion. People only have the illusion of choice, as you say yourself... don't you, Gabriel Agreste?!
(Monarch seems to be in shock in hearing his true identity from Bug Noire.)
Monarch: How did you know?!
Bug Noire: Luck. I hear it's one of my superpowers. The other one being the... Cataclysm!
(Bug Noire pulls Monarch towards her with her yo-yo and seizes the opportunity to use her Cataclysm on the Butterfly Miraculous, but she has been outsmarted — as Monarch has already activated the power of invulnerability on himself.)

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Bug Noire: (gasps) No! The power of the Buffalo! (her headache strikes) No! No— NO! NO!! (falls down to her knees)
Monarch: Too bad you're not invulnerable to your nightmares! And too bad I'm invulnerable to your luck!!
Bug Noire: (while using her Lucky Vision) Resistance, Voyage, Venom — (gasps) my true nightmare... is YOU!! And it stops right here!! Cataclysm!!! (breaks the ground as both of them fall down in the hole)
Miraculized: There they are! Hey!! Get 'em!!
Alya: Uh-oh!
(As the Resistance continue to flee from the Miraculized in the subway, they are still found cornered by these goons arriving at Place de la Concorde.)
Nino: Dude, there's a whole lotta them!!
(The Miraculized victims from the subway charge from behind them until Fang comes in to action alongside Luka, Jagged, Penny and Su-Han, who burst out from the Burrow.)
Su-Han: Storm of Justice! The warrior brings forth the sudden shower of redeeming slaps!
(The Order of the Guardians aids the Resistance to fight off the Miraculized. On the other side of the subway entrance, Luka fights off more of the victims, pushing them down the stairs. The Couffaine twins reunite as well.)
Juleka: Luka...?

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Luka: Twinsie! (runs to embrace Juleka)
Juleka: But how did you...? (imitates their fighting manners)
Luka: That's a long story.
(A portal appears right above the siblings, with a Miraculized victim bursting out to ambush them. Luckily, Su-Han appears right away to kick it off.)
Su-Han: Your reunion will have to wait!
(Su-Han continues to fight off more of the Miraculized. Luka is about to take Juleka to safety when Jagged is thrown right to the pavement.)
Jagged Stone: Rock and roll! (gets cornered by the Miraculized and gets paralyzed by them)
Luka: Dad!!
(On the other side, Penny is also knocked down by the Miraculized and gets thrown at Alya and Nino, causing them to fall together on the ground. Suddenly, some of the Miraculized behind them are reverted back to their normal selves, which means another group has come to their rescue...)
Alya: The United Heroez!
(Uncanny Valley flies in while holding Eagle and while shooting to destroy the Miraculized victims' Alliance rings, turning them back to civilians. Doorman opens a portal on a bus.)
Doorman: In here! Quick!
(Meanwhile, Knightowl, with her bare hands, fights the Miraculized one-on-one. Su-Han seems to be amazed.)

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Su-Han: How do you resist the nightmares?
Knightowl: (removes the Alliance ring from one of the Miraculized victim) I AM the nightmare. (crushes the Alliance rings in her hand whilst reverting back the pile of victims to civilians)
(Just then, storm clouds begin to circulate the square with a silhouette of a dragon seen as the lightning cracked, signaling the entrance of...)
Alya: Ladydragon!
(Ladydragon roars and shoots lightning bolts with her mouth, destroying every single Alliance ring in sight. Just as they were about to triumph, more portals appear and more of the Miraculized begin to surround them.)
Male Miraculized victim: Give us back Kagami and Adrien! They're Ladybug and Cat Noir's accomplices! Stop them!!
Alya: (to herself) Ladybug, what are you doing?!
Monarch: ENOUGH!!
(Upon hearing the villain's voice, Bug Noire begins to search for her yo-yo, which was lost during the fall.)
Monarch: Give me your Miraculous so I can make my wish!!
Bug Noire: (while searching for her yo-yo) Never! No wish is worth the price of the world will have to pay (finds her yo-yo within the debris) in order to satisfy YOUR desires!!

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
(Bug Noire makes a grab of her yo-yo, but Monarch hits her to the other side with his cane, her back hitting the protected pod.)
Monarch: Are you sure that no wish is worth that price, Marinette?!
(The pod opens, to Bug Noire's shock, as she sees the unconscious Émilie Agreste lying inside it.)
Bug Noire: No... This is impossible!
Monarch: I want my wife, Adrien's mother, to come back to us!! Once our family is reunited, Kagami and Adrien will become the eternal icons of this world! And we will be here to witness their absolute triumph!!
Bug Noire: Your... wife? Come... back...? Kagami and Adrien... eternal icons?! How many lives are you going to ruin in the name of your crazy dreams??!!
Monarch: As many as it takes!
(The two rivals scream out their battle cries as they rush in towards each other, commencing another parring.)
Monarch: In order to bring Émilie back, someone else will have to disappear! In order to heal the wound that Cat Noir inflicted on me, (pins Bug Noire on the steel bridge) someone else will have to be wounded!!
Bug Noire: (swings away) Someone else? But who?!

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
(During Bug Noire and Monarch's banter, the scene switches to the Place de la Concorde square, where the Miraculized continue to wreak havoc amongst the Resistance, the United Heroez, the Order of the Guardians, and Ladydragon. One of the Miraculized, using Clout, punches Knightowl, causing her to fly into the Ferris wheel, which dismantles.)
Monarch: Anyone! No one matters except us! How about you, Marinette? Wouldn't you give your life for your sweet Adrien's happiness?!
Bug Noire: Do you really think that's what he'd want?!
(Back at Place de la Concorde, Ladydragon is surrounded by the Miraculized, with Venom at the ready to paralyze her, in which she was, causing her to fall to the ground.)
Bug Noire: To discover that his father has turned into a supervillain, willing to make innocent people pay the price of his madness?!
(Luka grimaces with his headaches as he drops down on his knees whilst being surrounded by the Miraculized.)
Monarch: Adrien would do the same thing!!
Bug Noire: Never!

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
(Majestia returns from her search of Ladybug and Cat Noir, yet shakes her head to tell them that she found neither of them, meaning things are becoming very grim. Alya looks at her phone, her contacts full of her missed calls to Marinette.)
Bug Noire: Unlike you, Adrien has made his peace with it. He's not living in the past! He has a whole life ahead of him!
(Meanwhile, from the outside of the mansion, Cerise disables every security that guards the mansion.)
Bug Noire: You'd know this if you ever took an interest in him. But in reality, Adrien means NOTHING to you anymore! You've locked him in your house — LOCKED him in your Alliance rings!
(The gate opens before Cerise as she waltzes inside the courtyard, to the mansion's interior, before the huge hole created by Bug Noire's Cataclysm.)
Bug Noire: Locked him into a life that allows you to hide behind him in order to justify YOUR madness! Lucky Charm!! (summons a tube of glue)
Monarch: All I want is for him to be happy! (traps Bug Noire into a portal where it will lead to fall straight onto Monarch)

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
(During her fall, Bug Noire uses her Lucky Vision to spot the boomerang by the foot of Émilie's pod, then Émilie's pod, then the crypt's elevator. Nearing the ground, she pushes Monarch away and quickly grabs the boomerang.)
Monarch: Get back here, you coward!!
(Right after applying glue to the boomerang, Bug Noire swings out from behind the pod and makes a run towards the elevator. She hurls her yo-yo with the boomerang attached to it towards Émilie's pod, causing Monarch to choose over a dilemma: to chase after Ladybug or to prevent the boomerang from damaging Émilie's pod.)
Monarch: NO!
(The villain quickly teleports right beside the pod to keep the boomerang from hitting the pod, which is all according to Bug Noire's plan. She slides down the rubble in the middle of the bridge and quickly uses her power to destroy the crypt's elevator.)
Bug Noire: Cataclysm!

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
(The elevator tube cracks and starts to fall down. Bug Noire pulls her yo-yo towards her, and with the glue sticking on Monarch's hand, Bug Noire uses this to her advantage by swooping off all of the rings from Monarch's hand, making it stick on the glue that she applied to the boomerang. She catches the boomerang as the elevator falls towards Monarch's direction and Émilie's pod. Monarch tries his best to prevent the elevator tube from crushing him and the pod, and while Monarch's hands are full, Bug Noire uses this once again as an advantage to unpin the Butterfly Miraculous from him by throwing her staff at Monarch's chest, in which she is successful in doing so. This causes Monarch to de-transform back to Gabriel.)
Gabriel: NOOOO!!
(The Butterfly Miraculous falls off the edge of the platform. Gabriel makes an attempt to grab it only to be stopped by Bug Noire, as she ties her yo-yo on his ankle. And by this, the platform is shaken, causing the Butterfly Miraculous to fall in the water below.)
Gabriel: Nooroo, bring me back the brooch— (grunts)

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Bug Noire: (as she pulls Gabriel towards her) I'm still the Guardian, and the Guardian just took the Miraculous of the Butterfly back from you! Its power is no longer yours! Nooroo will only obey the next person who uses the brooch — someone that I'LL be choosing!!
Gabriel: Veno— (aims his fist towards Bug Noire, but is blocked by her bare hand)
Bug Noire: I can just say the word and the rings will be destroyed. You'll be powerless. The Kwamis will be free. Thanks to my magic ladybugs, I'll repair the chaos YOU created. Then, I'll send Plagg out to give the Black Cat Miraculous back to its holder, and everything will be back to normal. Checkmate. (she glares at Gabriel, making it clear she is dead serious with her threat and it is over. He's lost, once and for all. However, she then sighs and kneels down) Except you will only have a few hours left to live. So does Nathalie, a victim of your madness. And Adrien will be miserable. This is the sad truth. My power won't be able to remedy it. If you meant what you said earlier, then we both want the same thing: we want Adrien to be happy, and that was also your wife's greatest wish.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
(Gabriel's face softens as his anger and lust begin to recede. Bug Noire brings out the phone that Nathalie handed out to her and plays Emilie's video recording.)
Émilie: (from the video recording) Don't be sad, Nathalie. You know that I had agreed to it, that Gabriel never forced me to do anything. But he should never try to bring me back. No one should have their life stolen from them because of the mistake that we made. You must continue to be happy, even though I'm no longer here. As long as there's love, it is possible. Adrien will be well-surrounded. He'll have you, Nathalie, and he'll have his father if Gabriel agrees to give up on his madness... and on me. (Gabriel breaks down.) Adrien... will have all the love he needs to be happy.
Bug Noire: And that's what happened. Adrien has learned to live, and built his own happiness while cherishing the memory of his mother. She would be proud of him.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Gabriel: (whilst his shaky hands reach for the paused image of Émilie on the phone) I... just can't live without her. (sobs) I loved her so much. When she left me, the world shut down around me. I still remember her smile the day Adrien was born. When I placed him in her arms, for so long, we've been thinking that we would never be able to have a child. Adrien was our little miracle. (voice breaks) Everything was so... perfect, until Émilie became ill. She is— She was right. Adrien was not alone. He had Nathalie and me. I've ruined everything. Nathalie's about to disappear, (the tip of his index finger shatters) and so am I. Adrien will have no one left.
Bug Noire: I'm sure we can figure out a solution... if we work together. You... and me.
(With a fully-regained hope, Gabriel smiles.)
Gabriel: Of course! What if you made the wish? You always come up with impossible solutions. You would be able to come up with the perfect wish that would repair everything!
(But with sadness in her eyes, Bug Noire replies:)

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Bug Noire: There's no such thing as a perfect wish. Every time the power is used for personal gain, it causes disasters. Power of any nature should only be used for the greater good. But we can think and work out a solution on our own human scale, even though it won't be as perfect as we want it to be.
(Gabriel's expression changes as Bug Noire speaks, seeming to realize that the wish can't really be perfect. Finally, Gabriel nods in agreement, as well as Bug Noire. She lets go of her hand on Gabriel's.)
Bug Noire: Spots and claws away.
(She de-transforms back to Marinette and stands up whilst reaching her hand out to Gabriel, alarming Tikki and Plagg.)
Tikki: This is impossible!
Plagg: Marinette, don't trust him!
(Marinette was wrong in trusting him...)
Gabriel: (grabs Marinette's hand...) Venom! (...and paralyzes her)
(He takes her earrings off and puts them on his own earlobes.)
Gabriel: I already have my solution, Marinette. (puts on the Cat Miraculous as Tikki and Plagg huddle in on each other in fear) Tikki, Plagg, reveal yourselves!
(As they can't disobey their holder, Tikki and Plagg transform into their true, celestial forms.)

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Plagg: I am Plagg, the Kwami of Destruction. I am everything that is and no longer will be!
Tikki: I am Tikki, the Kwami of Creation. I am everything that isn't yet and is yet to be.
Gabriel: Gimmi, reveal yourself!
(Tikki and Plagg hold hands and embrace each other, transforming into the supreme Kwami, Gimmi.)
Gimmi: I am Gimmi, the Kwami of Reality. I am everything that was, is, and will be.
(Gabriel takes off all his rings one by one, starting off with the ring with the power of the Bee Miraculous, relieving Marinette from her paralysis. Marinette gasps as she sees the Supreme Kwami right behind her.)
Marinette: Gabriel! NO!!
(She attempts to step inside the force field, but it deflects her, sending her flying on her back. Gabriel has finally taken off all his rings and places them on the ground.)
Gimmi: (peeks behind Gabriel) Hi, little human! How are things going for you? Say, what year is it, huh?
Gabriel: I want to make a wish.
Gimmi: Here we are. Yet another complainer. You humans only ever summon me to complain, never to rejoice.
Gabriel: There is only one thing I wish to change.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Gimmi: Fine. What do you want? Eternal life? Wealth? You want garden peas to turn red? I'm warning you, though: to each wish, it's sacrifice because the universe is balance. For example, if you wish for garden peas to be red, then strawberries will have to turn green.
Marinette: NO! (slams her fist against the force field) Don't do this!!
Gabriel: (turns around to Marinette) Marinette, make sure that Adrien never knows about the villain that I was, (puts down the twin rings on the ground) but instead, that he remembers the times I tried to be a good father. (turns back to Gimmi)
Gimmi: What do you wish for?
Gabriel: Read my heart.
Gimmi: What do you sacrifice?
Gabriel: Read my soul.
Gimmi: So be it.
(A bright pink light shines upon them. Émilie levitates from her pod as Gabriel floats with her in midair, reuniting with her. The Ladybug and Cat Miraculous fall off from him and he embraces Émilie in his arms as both of them disappear in the light... whilst the whole universe is engulfed in the bright pink light, rewriting reality. Marinette can only shield her eyes and avert her gaze as she braces for the end of her universe as she knows it before being engulfed in the light.)

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Penny: Everyone, quick! It's starting!
Alec: (from the broadcast) Hello, folks, and welcome to Nouveau Monde! Mayor Caline Bustier, it's an honor! It's only been a few weeks since you became the new Mayor of Paris, and you've already completely transformed your city. What's your superpower? And hello to Harmonie, as well! (coos) Hewwo, little baby!
Caline: (from the broadcast, while carrying Harmonie in her sash) Hello, Alec! Hello, everyone! And thank you, but my only superpower is you. It was the revolution by the people of Paris that forced the Bourgeois out of power, and it was in partnership with all our citizens that we adapted what we're calling the "Eco Rule". It consists of very simple principles: don't take more from the Earth than what it can give us, distribute its riches equitably and don't pollute more than it can recycle. We've reorganized everything to remove the need from cars, wrappers, and it's been working great! Here is just one example: all the Alliance rings that were hijacked by Monarch have been recycled to design the statue in honor of the great Gabriel Agreste.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
(Said statue is seen to be unveiled from a white cloth at the Place des Vosges in front of a large crowd.)
Tomoe: (from the broadcast, at a podium in front of the statue) Beyond the visionary entrepreneur and the genius creator, it's the hero who we celebrate today. And tomorrow, it's his legacy that I continue to carry on.
Alec: (from the broadcast) Why don't you tell us about this new school you've imagined?
Caline: (from the broadcast) Oh, it isn't my school, but... the result of a collaborative effort. In this new school, there will be no classes or struggling to get good grades. Children of all ages will be able to intermix and freely access all kinds of activities. They'll be able to try their hands at everything, learn at their own pace, and help each other until they've figured out what they want to do later in life. The school will be their second home. Children are our future. If we want it to be right, we must help each child to shine.
(Everyone in the mansion's garden cheer in joy.)
Marinette: You're not wearing it?

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: (while fidgeting with the rings) When Ladybug gave it to me, she told me how my father helped her to defeat Monarch, at the cost of his life. I don't know if I'll ever manage to be like him.
Marinette: (holds Adrien's hands) You don't need to be like him. Just be yourself. (wears the twin rings on his left ring finger as Adrien blushes) Adrien, you're the only one who can decide what you make of your life.
Adrien: You always find the right words, Marinette. When I'm with you, I feel so... free!
(As Marinette smiles and her cheeks produces a tint of red, the two of them say in unison:)
Adrien and Marinette: I love you!
(The couple share a laughter together. They stare at each other, eye-to-eye, for a brief  moment, and as Adrien intertwines his hands with Marinette, the two of them share a heartfelt kiss — a kiss which they have been longing for to have ever since the day their hearts became as one.)
Nadja: With only a few days left before school starts again, let's take a look back on a summer that transformed the world. Professor du Boucquale explains to us how.

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Professor du Boucquale: We all remember the worldwide nightmare epidemic followed by the victory of Ladybug over Monarch,
(In her room, Marinette is seen to be doing a redesign of the Mouse Miraculous as well as the rest she has retrieved back from Monarch while Alya and Grand Master Su-Han are watching her in awe, as well as the Kwamis.)
Professor du Boucquale: and how the swarm of magic ladybugs swarmed the planet to repair everything and free us. This even raised global awareness. We humans have accomplished incredible things throughout history. But still, we often fall victim to our emotions, because no one teaches us how to understand or deal with them.
(Marinette opens an empty box, where the Butterfly Miraculous should be placed.)
Professor du Boucquale: If we don't listen to what our fears, sadness, or anger are trying to tell us—
(Alya turns off the monitor.)
Su-Han: Still no trace of the Miraculous of the Butterfly?

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (puts down the empty box on her table) After the wish, all I could find was the double wedding ring, along with the Miraculous that Monarch had turned into rings and Cat Noir's and mine. I transformed into Aquabug and searched the basement but nothing. Even after repairing everything, it's as if the brooch had... disappeared! But whatever happens, we'll be ready.
(A montage follows where each of the Miraculous are back to their respective holders.)
Marinette: (v.o.) When Monarch seized my yo-yo, he suddenly gained access to all Miraculous at once. This can never happen again, which is why I'll remain the Guardian, but only to support and help my fellow heroes. From now on, each holder will be responsible for the Miraculous and their Kwami. To be sure that power is used for the greater good, it needs to be shared.
(By the Eiffel Tower, the Miraculous team, including Bunnyx and Argos, are gathered together. Ladybug waits for them as Cat Noir joins her side shortly.)
Cat Noir: Glad to see you again, m'Lady!
(Ladybug smiles at him as the other heroes jump in behind them. After a pan across all of them, ready and raring to go, all of them spring into action.)

title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Unknown caller: Mr. Damoclès? Hello! My family and I just moved to Paris. Is it still possible to register at your new school for the upcoming year?
Mr. Damoclès: Of course! I'll see you at the start of the school year.
(The scene switches to La Plage, where Cerise, who is taking on a brand new identity, hangs up from the call. It is revealed that the Butterfly Miraculous is now in Cerise's hands as she attaches the brooch on her blouse.)
Cerise: I look forward to seeing you again, Marinette Dupain-Cheng. (An unknown force appears right behind Cerise as her things begin to float mid-air.) Huh? Hmm? (She turns around, wide-eyed and terrified, as the screen cuts to black.)

title: Red Moon
text:
Red Moon - Intro
was the secondary antagonist of the episode "Emotion". It was a full moon-like sentimonster manifested by Argos' feelings of hatred towards Gabriel Agreste and his treatment of Adrien Agreste, with Red Moon having been created to "free" Adrien from his father's control. Argos would later recall it's amok after he was initially unable to bring back Marinette Dupain-Cheng from Red Moon's effects, making it seem as if he had lost control of the sentimonster.

title: Red Moon
text:
Red Moon - Appearance
True to it's name, Red Moon looked like a full moon, but was entirely red in color, resembling a blood moon during a lunar eclipse.

title: Red Moon
text:
Red Moon - Abilities
Red Moon was capable of changing its size, capable of becoming as small as an orb/marble and as big as an actual moon.
Everyone under its light became subjected to Argos' influence. Once he snapped his fingers, Argos could make anyone disappear or reappear as he wished.
However, when Argos wanted to make someone reappear, he needed to have a clear image of that person, as he was unable to bring Marinette back when he believed that he had made her disappear accidentally, despite the fact he made her disappear when she was Ladybug, as he didn't know they were the same person.
If someone was wearing a Miraculous, then it would also disappear along with the Kwami.
A way to escape Red Moon (besides getting Argos' sympathy and/or mercy) was to be sheltered from its light. As long as the light was not bathing (even if inside of its range), the individuals would be safe.

title: Red Moon
text:
Red Moon - Trivia
The Red Moon was the first Sentimonster to be used directly against Gabriel Agreste.
The Red Moon was the second non-humanoid sentimonster in the show to be referred to by a gendered pronoun, following Reflekdoll.
In the cases of Reflekdoll and the Ladybug Sentimonster, this was because they were modeled after females (Reflekta and Ladybug, respectively), while the Red Moon wasn't, instead being modeled after a full moon. However, the Red Moon was still referred to by her creator as she/her.
