title: Raymond
text:
Raymond - Intro
Raymond is a supporting character of "Ladybug & Cat Noir: The Movie". He is a ticket seller who works at the Tuileries Funfair.
After his lover refused his marriage proposal and reveals that she's in love with someone else, Raymond was akumatized by Hawk Moth into the Gargoyle, a stone creature supervillain.

title: Raymond
text:
Raymond - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Raymond is a short, fair-skinned man with a fairly large overweight. He has neck-length neat combed brown hair slicked back, black eyes, and a protruding nose. He also sports a small parted mustache and a goatee.
Civilian Attire
During his marriage proposal, he wore a white suit with a red rose, a long-sleeved blue shirt, and a red bow tie.
As the Gargoyle
Gargoyle appeared as a statue found in Paris. He had wings and clawed limbs.

title: Raymond
text:
Raymond - Personality
Raymond is a particularly romantic person. For his marriage proposal to his lover, he didn't hesitate to put the means to make this moment unique. Following the rejection of his better half, he is very emotional and particularly reluctant to love.
As the Gargoyle, he was nothing but a monster filled with rage and destruction.

title: Raymond

As the Gargoyle
Having wings, he was able to fly long distances in addition to having great strength for his size.

title: Reduce, Reuse, Recycle
text:
Reduce, Reuse, Recycle - Intro
"" (also called "Plastic the 3Rs: Reduce, Reuse, Recycle") is a short film of the series, Miraculous Action Shorts and the second module of the Plastic Changemaker Educational Pack.

title: Reduce, Reuse, Recycle
text:
Reduce, Reuse, Recycle - Synopsis
Explore plastic items in your everyday lives and make informed choices about what you buy, use and consume.

title: Reduce, Reuse, Recycle
text:
Reduce, Reuse, Recycle - Trivia
This is the second time Marinette is absent in any way in a piece of Miraculous media, following "Plastic - The Story So Far".
Adrien's the only character to appear throughout the whole short, being the only piece of media with a single character.
The didactic module consists of two 50-minute-long lessons.
This module aims for students to:
Identify hidden plastics in everyday items and estimate the number of years that they take to decompose.
Explain and distinguish between the 3Rs: Reduce, Reuse, Recycle and then sort items by material.
Identify better alternatives in their lives to reduce, reuse and recycle everyday items.
Create a house pledge (set of guidelines to follow).

title: Re-Verse
text:
Re-Verse - Intro
The  is the name of a different reality from the Quantic Universe where the story of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir takes place.

title: Re-Verse
text:
Re-Verse - Summary
In this universe, Marinette Dupain-Cheng and Adrien Agreste are supervillains: Shadybug and Claw Noir (now known as superheroes Ladybug and Furry Paw for their redemption), while Gabriel Agreste is a superhero: Betterfly.

title: Re-Verse
text:
Re-Verse - History
At some point, a being known as The Supreme becomes the ruler of the world in this universe. He controls all the Miraculouses, which are a complete secret from the public and entrusts them to powerful individuals, all of whom have sworn loyalty to him. It's implied that the Supreme had used the Absolute Power of the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses to enslave the world, while also sealing it to prevent another besides him from using it.
Gabriel Agreste was one of the Supreme's followers, but he stole two of the Miraculous to make his wish come true, but he misused them and as a result, he hurt the ones he loves. To redeem himself, he became the superhero Betterfly, he led a resistance movement against the Supreme and his followers. Between his allies in the resistance are two teenagers, Alya Césaire and Nino Lahiffe, and also an AI called Maxkov.

title: Re-Verse
text:
Re-Verse - History
To counter Betterfly's resistance, the Supreme entrusted the Ladybug and Cat Miraculous to two vulnerable teenagers, Marinette Dupain-Cheng and Adrien Agreste, respectively, so they could go and retrieve the Butterfly Miraculous (and possibly the Peacock Miraculous as well). Marinette Dupain-Cheng was a girl, the daughter of bakers, who was constantly tormented by Chloé Bourgeois. The Supreme gave her the Ladybug Miraculous, promising her that no one else would be able to hurt her. She then became Shadybug. Adrien Agreste is the son of the famous fashion designer Gabriel Agreste, the man who is also Betterfly, and who had recently lost his mother, with the Supreme preying on his grief to sway him to his side. He then became Claw Noir.

title: Re-Verse
text:
Re-Verse - History
When giving the two teenagers those Miraculouses, he didn't tell them about the Absolute Power their Miraculous could achieve together or about the dangers of using their Miraculous for evil while still young. Because of this, Shadybug and Claw Noir's bodies started to deteriorate, with them getting marks similar to the ones caused by Cataclysm, leading them to hide them with either pieces of clothes or make-up. To keep them on their mission to retrieve the Butterfly Miraculous from Betterfly, the Supreme promised to spare them from their fate if they completed the mission.
Cornering Betterfly on his lair, the superhero decided to turn to outside help, tracking a universe where the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses are used for good and kamikotizing Alya Césaire into Ubiquity to reach it. When he managed to cross over to that universe, so did Shadybug and Claw Noir. However, Shadybug and Claw Noir eventually decided to become allies of Betterfly. When both of them return to their universe, they adopted new identities as Ladybug and Furry Paw respectively and joining Betterfly in the fight against the Supreme.

title: Re-Verse
text:
Re-Verse - Geography
Just like the Quantic Universe, Paris, France is the primary location seen in the Re-Verse. The Dupain-Cheng bakery, the Agreste mansion, and the Gabriel brand all exist in this universe.

title: Re-Verse
text:
Re-Verse - Trivia
During production, the crew named the universe "Re-Verse" to distinguish itself from the Quantic Universe.
"Re-Verse" became this universe's official moniker when Playmate Toys released dolls based on three of its inhabitants.
The Playmate Toys doll line nicknamed the inhabitants with a "Re" prefix to distinguish them from their Quantic Universe counterparts. For example, Alya is nicknamed "Re-Alya".
According to Thomas Astruc, the universe will be seen again in the future. One possibility is a comic book.
This universe is actually one of the billions of other parallel universes that exist alongside the Quantic Universe, and the kwamis exist in all of these universes simultaneously.
The Kwamis usually don't bother bringing this up with their holders because there isn't enough time in the human lifespan to explain even the tiniest bit about it, and instead choose to focus on the time they have together.
This universe mirrors the Quantic Universe, both in reverse and in similarity, as while there are some opposing traits, those differences mirror the ones of the Quantic Universe.

title: Re-Verse
text:
Re-Verse - Trivia
In the Re-Verse, Marinette Dupain-Cheng, Adrien Agreste, and Gabriel Agreste are still the holders of the Ladybug, Cat, and Butterfly Miraculouses respectively. However, while the former two began as supervillains (as opposed to their counterparts who begin as heroes), the latter is a superhero (opposing his counterpart who is a villain).
Both Marinettes of the two universes were bullied and tormented by Chloé Bourgeois. However, while the Quantic Universe's Marinette was able to stand up to her (thanks to both Alya and the fact she became Ladybug), the Re-Verse's Marinette was unable to make friends to help her deal with Chloé's intense bullying, eventually leading her to become the supervillain Shadybug.
Both Adriens of the two universes lost their mother. However, while the Quantic Universe's Adrien was able to move on and find other sources of love to fill the void, the Re-Verse's Adrien held on to that loss and, because of it, was unable to make any friends and resented his father for being able to move on. This made him an easy target to the Supreme who manipulated him to become Claw Noir.

title: Re-Verse
text:
Re-Verse - Trivia
Both Gabriels are successful fashion designers and both lost their wives. However, while the Quantic Universe's Gabriel was unable to move on and became a supervillain to bring her back, the Re-Verse's Gabriel was able to move on and became a superhero to fight the Supreme.
Both Gabriels were able to steal Miraculouses from the ones that were guarding them in their respective universe. The Quantic Universe's Gabriel stole all the Miraculouses Ladybug was guarding (except for hers, Cat Noir's, and Argos'), planning to use them to get the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses. Meanwhile, the Re-Verse's Gabriel stole two Miraculous (the Butterfly and the Peacock) from the Supreme, hoping to use them to achieve his dream, but eventually using the Butterfly one to fight the Supreme.
Just like in the Quantic Universe, there's a resistance fighting against the evil of its respective universe. In both of them, Alya Césaire and Nino Lahiffe are members.

title: Re-Verse
text:
Re-Verse - Trivia
Based on Betterfly's comment that "no one believes in heroes", he was the only hero to exist in the Re-Verse before Ladybug and Furry Paw switched sides. Everyone lost hope and "is afraid of the Supreme", believing that no one can stop him since he rules the world. This would imply that the United Heroez and the Stellar Force didn't exist in this reality.
It's unknown if the Prodigious exist in this reality. In the Quantic Universe, it was created as a prototype for the Miraculouses before it was later abandoned. Whether or not the Supreme has his hands on the Prodigious, it's likely Ladydragon doesn’t exist in this reality.

title: Raymond Pugnant
text:
Raymond Pugnant - Intro
Raymond "Ray" Pugnant is the secondary antagonist of season 6 in Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He is a student at Collège Françoise Dupont and Nelson de Glusset's and Loïc Stompet's friend.
In "Heartfixer", after failing to separate Marinette and Adrien several times, Ray was voluntarily akumatized, alongside Loïc and Nelson, by Chrysalis into Couplewreckers, a trio of supervillains capable of copying the appearance of any person which they photographed.

title: Raymond Pugnant
text:
Raymond Pugnant - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Ray is a tall, fair-skinned American teenage boy with a narrow face and sharp chin, along with shoulder-length wavy light blond hair and cyan colored eyes.
Civilian Attire
Ray wears a royal blue blazer with gold lining and a emblem on the upper left corner over a button down shirt,  salmon  pants with a brown belt and a gold buckle, blue socks, and brown loafers with gold buckles. He also wears a gold signet ring on his left hand and bracelet on his left wrist.
As a Couplewrecker

title: Raymond Pugnant
text:
Raymond Pugnant - Appearance
He wore a dark purple, skin-tight suit showing his physique with a light pink broken heart emblem on his chest, along with hot pink boots and gloves. The boots extended up to his knees, while the gloves reached his elbows. He also wore hot pink briefs over the suit. His hair turned lighter as well. The tops of the boots and gloves formed a heart shape, and his belt featured the same broken heart emblem as his chest. His skin was light purple, and his eyes turned cerise. He wore an inward pointing mask that extended past his cheekbones, leaving the mouth and the rest of his head exposed with a gradient in the middle — hot pink on top and purple on the bottom. He wore a hot pink cape with a folded collar. He no longer wore his sunglasses.

title: Raymond Pugnant
text:
Raymond Pugnant - Personality
Ray is a cruel, manipulative, and arrogant young man whose behavior reflects a consistent pattern of bullying and harassment. He is sly and calculating, able to hide his true nature behind a façade of calm and control. Ray takes pleasure in exerting power over others. Alongside his friends Nelson and Loïc, he targets couples simply for fun, as seen in their attempt to break up Kim and Ondine. Even when their plan fails, Ray remains unfazed, reassuring a nervous Loïc that there will be plenty more opportunities to cause trouble.
Ray is particularly hostile toward Zoé. He insults, intimidates, constantly blackmails, and exposes her and her past actions in New York. Much like Chloé Bourgeois, Ray weaponizes other people's reputations and behaves with complete impunity, knowing he can manipulate situations to his advantage. His father supports him unconditionally and is even proud of his behavior, which strengthens Ray's sense of untouchability and encourages him to ignore consequences, even going so far as to mock the police without fear.

title: Raymond Pugnant
text:
Raymond Pugnant - Personality
Ray also shows a complete lack of empathy and consideration. He and his friends deliberately left Sublime Varlette behind, refusing to let her enter an elevator because she uses a wheelchair.

title: Raymond Pugnant
text:
Raymond Pugnant - Abilities
As a Civilian
While not as convincing as his friend Nelson, Ray can utilize his wealth and connections as a bargaining chip to obtain whatever he wants, like how he got Kim flippers to convince him to stop talking to Ondine, or how he called up his father to bail him and his friends out of trouble at school.
As a Couplewrecker
Whichever image on the phone he clicked on became the person he transformed into, taking on their appearance, voice, and sometimes even mannerisms. He also seemed to posses a certain amount of superhuman agility that persisted when transformed, as he and his companions talked atop the terrarium cupula, a place the majority of regular people wouldn't be able to access with no help, as well as some degree of speed.

title: Raymond Pugnant
text:
Raymond Pugnant - History
Before Season 4
Ray lived in New York City, where he was one of Zoé's fake friends. Because of this, he knows things about her that her new friends, including Marinette, do not know, and which Zoé does not want them to find out.
Before Season 6
At some point after Monarch's defeat and death, he moved to Paris, enrolled in Collège Françoise Dupont, and learned that Zoé now has a different life and is trying to hide her past, which Ray intends to take advantage of. In that time, he also became friends with Nelson and Loïc.
On the day of Aglaé's return to school, Ray and his friends met her and learned of her fear of butterflies, and decided to take advantage of it. They left her in the butterfly garden alone, cruelly laughing at her as she panicked. Later, after Aglaé was akumatized into Lady Butterfly from the incident, she sought revenge on the bullies and trapped them in cocoons. They were later freed by Ladybug's magical ladybugs.
Season 6

title: Raymond Pugnant
text:
Raymond Pugnant - History
In "Climatiqueen", he entered a contest held by Chloé Bourgeois on the social networking site Zoo as he is shown on second place. He ultimately loses to Aurore Beauréal, who had been akumatized into the titular villain. After her akumatization, he is also visible in the collège's courtyard during her attack.
In the post end card scene of "Daddycop", Ray makes a surprise appearance to Zoé by mocking her with a smug expression, much to her dismay. He asks if she is worried about her new friends finding out about her old life while showing a video of her on his phone. But she angrily snatches his phone and deletes the video. Ray then reminds her that anything that is related to Zoé will never be forgotten, especially she herself will never forget who she was back in New York. Soon after, Ray walks away while laughing arrogantly, leaving Zoé all alone.

title: Raymond Pugnant
text:
Raymond Pugnant - History
In "Sleeping Syren", Ray and his friends, Nelson and Loïc, planned to split up Kim and Ondine as part of their wicked scheme. Ray tried to make Kim not to talk to girls after he bribed him with swimming flippers. But Ray's plans fell apart when Kim accidentally spoke to Ondine and returned the flippers to Ray. Loïc later tried to confront Kim but failed to convince him not to talk to Ondine. After Nelson told Kim about the "consequences" of kissing, Ray and the others watched behind one of the lockers as Kim and Ondine interacted at the locker room. When Kim lost an arm-wrestling match to Ondine, she attempted to kiss him, but he quickly rejected her, unintentionally hurting her feelings.
Later, in the middle of the night, after their failed attempt on Kim and Ondine, Ray reassured an angry Loïc about the other couples they can wreck with. Just as Loïc vowed to try again with another couple, they were confronted by a hooded figure with glowing yellow eyes who warned them that they won't get another chance to ruin a relationship before jumping down toward them.

title: Raymond Pugnant
text:
Raymond Pugnant - History
In "Vampigami", Ray and his friends decided to prank Prem when they took the paper vampire bat he made for Rose, which ended up in a bucket of water.
Although Prem's friends tried to defend him, Ray was unwilling to back down until Nelson saw the perfect opportunity to use Prem to ruin Rose and Juleka's relationship.
So, in front of everyone, he pretended to be genuinely sorry and make amends, which left Ray and Loïc perplexed.
Nelson's plan involved Ray getting two tickets for Prem, and then Nelson telling him to go to the movie with Rose.
When Prem publicly gives Rose a ticket and asks her to come with him, Ray, Loïc, and Nelson watch as Juleka becomes jealous of Rose's relationship with Prem, indicating the plan was working.
However, the plan ultimately backfired, as Prem, Juleka, and Rose were having a normal conversation after Ladybug, Cat Noir, Purple Tigress, and Pigella defeated Count Vampigami.
Prem said he didn't mean to interfere with their relationship, and the three of them ended up going to see a movie together, as Marinette had given Juleka her ticket.

title: Raymond Pugnant
text:
Raymond Pugnant - History
Roy, Loïc, and Nelson witnessed this, but then apparently switched their attention to destroying Marinette and Adrien's relationship.
In "Wreckless Driver", Ray, Loïc and Nelson overhear Marinette and her friends talking to Aglaé about seeing a psychiatrist about her fear of butterflies. Ray then said that he would never go to one, as it sounds "lame." Alya snapped back, saying that it could help someone as "senseless and mean" as them, and the three of them just angrily glare at her; the rest of the group ignore them and focus on helping Aglaé.
In "Heartfixer", he, Loic and Nelson akumatized on purpose into Couplewreckers.

title: Raymond Pugnant
text:
Raymond Pugnant - Relationships
Family
Mr. Pugnant
Ray and his father have a positive relationship and he is aware that his son bullies others, but he doesn't think it's bad, and instead encourages it, as it makes him a leader in his opinion.
Friends/Allies
Loïc Stompet and Nelson de Glusset
Ray is friends with Nelson and Loïc, and they are known to cause trouble around and outside school grounds. Ray gets along with them very well and vice versa, with Ray being the leader in the group's hierarchy. Being from a rich family, Ray uses his money and connections to benefit himself and his friends, especially by bailing them out of trouble.
Chrysalis
Like the rest of the Parisians, Raymond is aware that after the fall of Monarch, he was succeeded by an unknown individual who continues to akumatize people. Ray is unaware that Chrysalis is actually Cerise Bianca, who attends the same college as him, so it's possible they may have crossed paths but had no significant interactions. But it is still implied that Cerise has seen Ray and his friends and considers them incompetent.

title: Raymond Pugnant
text:
Raymond Pugnant - Relationships
In "Wreckless Driver", it is revealed that it was because of Ray and his friends, Loïc and Nelson, that Chrysalis chose Aglaé as her first victim, leading to her akumatization into Lady Butterfly, who imprisoned her tormentors in cocoons until they were freed by Miraculous Ladybug.
In "Vampigami", Ray and his friends also evoked negative emotions in Prem, which Chrysalis sensed and akumatized him into the titular villain.

title: Raymond Pugnant
text:
Raymond Pugnant - Relationships
In "Heartfixer", Ray, Loïc, and Nelson were frustrated because they couldn't break Adrien and Marinette's love because it was too strong. Alone in the library, they tried to focus on their anger, which Chrysalis sensed because their desires aligned to some degree, which she could exploit. Ray and his friends were akumatized in Couplewreckers, allowing them to convince the others that Marinette was cheating on Adrien with Nino. The akumatization wore off, and the Ultrakuma left Nelson's phone, a recording of which confirmed their plan's success thanks to Chrysalis. Seeing the Ultrakuma flying somewhere, they realized it was about to akumatize Marinette. In the end, Ray, his friends, and Chrysalis still screwed up because Adrien realized that the whole thing was a setup by the akumatized trio and his love saved Marinette and they didn't break up, much to the disappointment of Ray, Loic, and Nelson.
Enemies
Zoé Lee/Fury

title: Raymond Pugnant
text:
Raymond Pugnant - Relationships
Ray communed with Zoé for a long time when they lived in New York and was also one of her fake friends who bullied her. This affected Zoé so much that when she came to Paris, she also pretended to be a mean person, but Marinette and her friends were able to convince her that they could have a real friendship, which calmed her down and she seemed to be able to let go of the situation with Ray. However, at some point after Monarch's defeat and death, Ray recently moved to Paris as well. He's become aware that Zoé now has new, genuine friends and plans to show everyone what she was like before.
In "Vampigami", when Ray, Loïc, and Nelson took Prem's paper vampire bat, Zoé was one of the few people who stood up for him. However, when Zoé tries to stand up to them, Ray blackmails her to stand down by threatening to show her friends the video of her when she was in New York. He first did that at the end of "Daddycop".

title: Raymond Pugnant
text:
Raymond Pugnant - Relationships
In "Sleeping Syren", when Ray, Loïc, and Nelson were discussing their failure to break up Kim and Ondine, Ray reassured that they would succeed next time, as there were still many couples to break up, to which Fury, who had suddenly appeared before them, said that there would be no next time and attacked them, to make them pay for trying to break Ondine and Kim's relationship.
In "Grendiaper", after Ray, Nelson and Loïc were on an unauthorized motorboat on the Seine and disrespected Roger Raincomprix's orders to stop, Fury utilized her Venom and super speed to paralyze the trio and strap them to a moving roller coaster train in the amusement park, in order to teach them a lesson.
Aglaé
In "Vampigami", when Ray, Loïc, and Nelson took Prem's paper vampire bat, Aglaé was one of the few people who stood up for him. However, the trio was too arrogant to apologize. When Nelson admitted they had gone too far, Aglaé suggested that they should make amends to Prem.

title: Raymond Pugnant
text:
Raymond Pugnant - Relationships
In "Wreckless Driver", it is revealed that on their first day of school, Ray, Loïc, and Nelson decided to make fun of Aglaé because of her fear of butterflies. They pretended to be kind to her, but then locked her in the butterfly enclosure. This caused Chrysalis to sense her negative emotions and akumatize her into Lady Butterfly. While Ray and his friends tried to escape, the akumatized villain sealed them in cocoons, and they were ultimately rescued by Ladybug.
Marinette Dupain-Cheng
Because Ray is openly a bully, he and Marinette have a hostile relationship with each other.
In "Vampigami", Ray, Loïc, and Nelson see Marinette and Adrien kissing and very much in love and think that the more couples there are, the more fun it is to break them up, which hints that they are showing interest in targeting Marinette and Adrien's couple as well.
In "Grendiaper", Ray prevents Zoé from preventing Loïc and Nelson from pranking Marinette by changing her letter to Adrien, which was rude to him. However, they were unable to separate them because Marinette was sincere when she said she didn't write it, and Adrien believed her.
Sabrina Raincomprix/Miss Hound

title: Raymond Pugnant
text:
Raymond Pugnant - Relationships
In "Grendiaper," Ray needed a textbook that he didn't have, so Loïc takes Sabrina's from her for him.
When Fury kidnaps the trio and puts them on a fast roller coaster, which scares them, Miss Hound saves them using Fetch and they run away in terror.
Nino Lahiffe
In "Grendiaper", when Ray threw a crumpled piece of paper directly onto the ground, Nino demanded that he clean it up, but Ray refused, because in his opinion, he was creating work for the cleaners.
Sublime Varlette
In "Vampigami", Ray, Loïc and Nelson took away the paper vampire bat that Prem made, and this happened in front of his friends, among whom was Sublime, she told the trio that they should be ashamed of themselves, but Ray just laughed, calling it pathetic.
In "Grendiaper", Ray, Loïc, and Nelson entered the elevator before Sublime and made fun of her for it, which angered Marinette, but Sublime calmly said that they should "take a walk", and also mentioned that she doesn't pay attention to such moments.
Roger Raincomprix

title: Raymond Pugnant
text:
Raymond Pugnant - Relationships
In "Grendiaper", Ray, Loïc, and Nelson were riding on the river at night, but Officer Roger tried to stop them because they weren't old enough to drive, to which Nelson lies that Loïc just turned eighteen because he was the one driving it, and then adds shampoo to the water to make Roger foamy, which makes the gang laugh.

title: Raymond Pugnant
text:
Raymond Pugnant - Etymology
The given name "Raymond" comes from the Germanic elements "ragin" (counsel) + "mund" (protector), meaning "wise protector".
The surname "Pugnant" is based on the word "Pungent", which describes a sharply strong smell or taste.
When spoken aloud as "Ray Pugnant", it resembles the word "repugnant", which alludes perfectly to his horrible personality.

title: Raymond Pugnant
text:
Raymond Pugnant - Trivia
In season 6, Ray, along with Loïc Stompet and Nelson de Glusset, replaced Chloé Bourgeois, Sabrina Raincomprix, and Lila Rossi as the troublemaking trio of the Collège Françoise Dupont.
Ray is Chloé's equivalent, comparable to her in several aspects.
Both bullied a girl in the past (Zoé for Ray and Marinette for Chloé), used cockroach as a means of torment; have blonde hair and blue eyes, wears sunglasses as fashion item, a dislike for Zoé, and an arrogant personality.
However, while Chloé always abused her position and got others into trouble to benefit herself, Ray simply seems to enjoy being a bully and tormenting others.
Both have used their parent's help in order to get out of being punished at school or in public.
However, while André is shown to be reluctant and hesitant to defend her when Chloé did abusive things, Ray's father actually praises him for his actions and is happy to get him out of trouble, thinking it might make him a leader.
Ray, Loïc, Nelson, Jean Duparc, Marc Anciel, Aglaé, Prem and Marinette Dupain-Cheng are the only known students of the Collège Françoise Dupont to have only been akumatized once.

title: Raúl Bruel
text:
Raúl Bruel - Intro
is a minor antagonist in Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug and Cat Noir. He is the father of Ivan Bruel, a security guard at the Louvre, and a former criminal known as El Toro.
In "El Toro De Piedra", after his son refused to commit a heist at the Louvre, Raúl was akumatized by Chrysalis into El Toro de Piedra, a bull-themed supervillain who had the power of transforming everyone into stone bulls.

title: Raúl Bruel
text:
Raúl Bruel - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Raúl is a light skinned middle-aged Spaniard with a muscular build. He has short medium-brown hair combed back, with two tufts of hair that resemble the horns of a bull, a full beard, and blue eyes. He also has numerous scars all over his body and a lot of hair on his chest.
Civilian Attire
Raúl wears a black T-shirt with a gold bull symbol on the front, along with camo green pants and black boots with lighter soles. He also has black bracelets with spikes on each wrist and a silver earring on his right ear.
As El Toro de Piedra
El Toro de Piedra's appearance turned jet black and stone-like, decorated with gold veins. However, his hairstyle appeared sharper, solid, and straighter, his bangs pulled back. At the back was a thin, long ponytail held by a gold clip. His eyes glew a very pale blue, and he had long, charcoal gray horns with gold veins and ombre near the tip, held by gold pieces.

title: Raúl Bruel
text:
Raúl Bruel - Appearance
He wore a black matador coat with ripped sleeves, gold trim, swirly accents, jagged collar, and black high-waisted trousers matching the coat's details, mainly being made of angular lines connecting to semicircles with points down to the legs. Suspended from four black leather straps with gold studs was a gold zloty ornament in the shape of an inverted bull's nose ring on his chest. His bracelets were retained, but with gold spikes and trim, accenting the large shoulder pads. He carried a three-piece black whip.

title: Raúl Bruel
text:
Raúl Bruel - Personality
Raúl is a man who is particularly obsessed with theft and who has great confidence in his own strength. He has strong principles of manhood and does not accept anyone who opposes him or refuses to follow his orders.
However, he seems to be a person for whom family is of great importance, although he would like his family to follow him in his misdeeds, despite their disapproval.

title: Raúl Bruel
text:
Raúl Bruel - Abilities
As a Civilian
Raúl is a particularly powerful man and believes he is capable of breaking down the gates of the Louvre Museum to steal the Mona Lisa. He is also capable of being very meticulous in crime, capable of developing a plan.
As El Toro de Piedra
As El Toro de Piedra, his natural strength was increased tenfold. He was able to transform anyone he touched with his whip into a stone bull, joining his herd to sow destruction in Paris.

title: Raúl Bruel
text:
Raúl Bruel - Relationships
Family
Ivan Bruel/Minotaurox
In "El Toro De Piedra", Raúl treats his son harshly and wants him to listen to him when he talks about his plan to kidnap the Mona Lisa. His plans were to make his son his accomplice and successor. This makes it clear that because of his criminal life, Raúl was not involved in the upbringing of his son. Ivan, on the other hand, is very afraid that he will become the same, and being a villain is in his blood. When he resigns and leaves his father a letter of explanation, he becomes enraged. He recognizes his son as a weakling because he is sensitive and has a kind heart.
His conversation with Minotaurox suggests that Raúl actually treated his son the way his father treated him, and projected his own weakness onto Ivan – the inability to rebel. The superhero convinces him that the fact that Ivan challenged Raúl is paradoxically evidence of his strength and courage. He forces him to rethink his behavior, and the man sees his mistake and promises to try to become a better father.

title: Raúl Bruel
text:
Raúl Bruel - History
Before season 1
Raul is a supervillain named El Toro, who apparently was involved in the theft of valuables, but was caught and exiled to prison.
Season 6
In the opening stinger of "El Toro De Piedra", Raúl talks to his son, Ivan, at the police station about a plot to steal the Mona Lisa from the Louvre after it is returned after restoration. Ivan must put on an old El Toro costume and distract attention so that Raúl can steal the painting while everyone's attention is distracted. When Raúl has to return to his cell because his visit time has expired, he indicates the time when he will need to come and leaves the meeting with his son.

title: Raúl Bruel
text:
Raúl Bruel - History
On the same day, Raúl waits in the Louvre for his accomplice, dressed as a security guard. The museum staff, led by Alim Kubdel, came at the time previously mentioned by Raul to replace the painting during the renovation. He is looking forward to his son's arrival. The painting is taken out with Kubdel's team, and Raul calls Ivan, but to no avail. Enraged, the man goes to the toilet to the planned place of delivery of the stolen painting. Instead of a bag, he finds only a letter addressed to him. Ivan writes that he is not like his father and does not want to be a villain anymore, and that he is disappointed with his father for not giving him the opportunity to rehabilitate himself. This is the last time he asks his father to think about his choice and just be a good example to him.

title: Raúl Bruel
text:
Raúl Bruel - History
Raúl gets angry and aims to tear up the letter, but the ultrakuma possesses him and Chrysalis enters his mind, touching and apologizing for the intrusion. He gets scared and angry, pushing the silhouette away, but the holder of Butterfly Miraculous changes her approach and begins to humiliate him, accusing him of how good his son is, and stating that it was he who failed in parenting. Chrysalis warns about the Miraculouses. They make a deal, after which Raúl  turns into the villain El Toro de Piedra. He turns the letter into a whip, with which he turns people into obedient bulls after he leaves the wall in the Louvre. Along the way, he turns more and more civilians into bulls.
El Toro de Piedra violently attacks his son, who is sitting on the banks of the Seine, unsuccessfully. Frightened, Ivan runs away from the bull company, but stops and asks if he has read his letter. Surprised, Raul objects that yes, and declares that Ivan's grandmother is to blame for everything. He calls his son a calf, shooting a beam of energy into the ground and aiming at his son, but he escapes into the sewers.

title: Raúl Bruel
text:
Raúl Bruel - History
In the evening of the same day, El Toro de Piedra continues to attack Paris. He notices Cat Noir and shoots him with a whip, causing a crash and knocking him into the street. He almost hits him, but his shot is blocked by the Minotaurox, who uses his superpower to absorb the attack. Ladybug joins the battle, and the three heroes attack the villain together. Minotaurox catches the bull, which El Toro de Piedra grabs by the horns, further blocking the attacks. Ladybug and Cat Noir knock him down, after which Minotaurox hits the sheet with a mallet and Raúl transforms back.
Minotaurox sends a letter from himself to Raúl, who objects that his son is weak and useless, to which his son, who is under the mask, objects that putting himself in his father's place means being stronger than him. Officer Roger plans to arrest him, to which the heroes say that he is just a victim of the ultrakuma and does not deserve to be punished. Minataurox tells Raúl be a good father, and Raul is ashamed to understand.

title: Raúl Bruel
text:
Raúl Bruel - Trivia
His akumatized form as El Toro de Piedra makes allusion to the running of the bulls (also known as Encierro), an event part of Spanish tradition where a small group of bulls are let loose on sectioned-off streets in a town, with the most famous one being that on the Spanish city of Pamplona.
The fact El Toro de Piedra could turn people into bulls made of stone makes reference to his son's akumatized form, Stoneheart.
He has some similarities with El Macho, from Despicable Me 2:
Both are Spanish-speakers, very robust, as well they have a moustache.
Both had sons, but opposite personalities: Antonio is arrogant and charming, while Ivan is kind but intimidating.
Both are talented criminals and seek to be invincible, however, unlike El Macho, Raúl was able to redeem himself.
Raúl's relationship with Ivan mirrors the relationship between Big Daddy and Johnny from the movie Sing!:
Both Raúl and Big Daddy were criminals who wanted their children to follow on their footsteps.
Both Ivan and Johnny didn't want to become like their fathers and ended up bailing on their respective heists.

title: Raúl Bruel
text:
Raúl Bruel - Trivia
Due to their respective sons bailing on them, both Raúl and Big Daddy ended up suffering the consequences, with the former being akumatized, while the latter was arrested.
This had caused both fathers to get disappointed with their respective sons.
Both parents ended up making amends in some way with their respective sons.
It is unknown if Raúl received a magical charm after he was de-akumatized.
He's the first known akumatized villain who actually managed to scare Chrysalis during their akumatization, to the point that she briefly lost her blended voices and for a moment spoke with her real voice.

title: Riposte
text:
Riposte - Synopsis
Netflix
A fencing opponent who loses a duel against Adrien gets akumatized and goes after him for a rematch while only Ladybug is around to protect him.
Disney Channel
A mysterious masked fencer gets akumatized into Riposte.
Disney+
Ladybug and Cat Noir face Riposte, the masked fencer.

title: Riposte
text:
Riposte - Plot
Marinette has hopes of joining Armand D'Argencourt's fencing school. Although Marinette's worried and nervous, Tikki assures her that she will do a good job. Marinette then clumsily knocks down several helmets, although ends up finding one her size. On the fencing court, D'Argencourt assigns the new recruits to fence with the old ones in order to find out who is capable of filling the only open spot. Marinette is paired with Adrien, who helps teach her some techniques. Adrien also explains that in fencing, who touches their opponent first isn't necessarily the one who gets the point.

title: Riposte
text:
Riposte - Plot
A new fencer then arrives and demands to be enrolled in the class. D'Argencourt tells the new student that only the best can join his school, and the challenger claims to have been the best everywhere they had gone. D'Argencourt tells the student that, in order to be accepted, they must beat one of the other students, and the fencer immediately ask who the best fencer in the class is. The other students single out Adrien. As he and the new student take their stances, Marinette laments about the latter going to get the position on the fencing team due to "that guy's" obvious skill, although another student tells her that the new challenger must beat Adrien first.
Adrien and the new student duel, however, D'Argencourt calls abstention, being unable to decide who the winner is.
The new student then suggests that he and Adrien "do it the old-fashioned way", in order to have more freedom with their movements, which Adrien agrees to.
Marinette asks how they will be able to tell who hits first, and one of the other students tells her that they must watch very carefully.

title: Riposte
text:
Riposte - Plot
Adrien and the new student duel, taking their battle up a set of stairs as the rest of the class follows them, while Marinette goes up another set of stairs due to being unable to see the fight.
Adrien continues to ascend up the stairs, and the fencing class follows suit, trampling D'Argencourt.
The duel is taken to the library, where Adrien and the new student knock a book cart down the stairs, scaring away the class and running over D'Argencourt, leaving Marinette as the only person watching the fight.
When the final blows are struck, the new student and an injured D'Argencourt turn to Marinette and ask who hit first, and she uncertainly guesses that it was Adrien.
With that, D'Argencourt declares Adrien the winner and the new student, disappointed in their failure, shakes hands with Adrien and walks out of the building, jabbing their saber into the ground.
Sensing the student's anger and disappointment, Hawk Moth sends an akuma after them.

title: Riposte
text:
Riposte - Plot
Believing that the new student struck first, Adrien runs outside to offer them a rematch. Adrien confronts the student outside their car, who then removes their helmet, revealing themself to be a girl. Adrien offers her the rematch, however, the students declines, claiming that there are no second chances in her family, and leaves. Adrien then enters his car and tells his bodyguard to follow the student. As this happens, Marinette sees the akuma and transforms into Ladybug in order to capture it.
In the car, the student leaves a message for her mother in which she regretfully states that she lost and will not be joining D'Argencourt's school. She then looks at her ring, which the akuma then settles inside. Hawk Moth then offers her the chance to be the best fencer once again in exchange for the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses, transforming her into Riposte. Riposte then slices through the roof of her car and jumps into the air.

title: Riposte
text:
Riposte - Plot
Meanwhile, Adrien researches the new student on his phone while Plagg watches, and finds out that she is the only child of a prestigious fencing family; her mother and grandfather both being world champions. Riposte then falls out of the sky and cleaves Adrien's car in half. Riposte tells Adrien that she accepts his offer of a rematch, although he refuses to fight her in her current form. Before she can attack, Hawk Moth stops Riposte and tells her that she must take Ladybug and Cat Miraculous first. Riposte agrees and decides to wait for Ladybug and Cat Noir to show up. On cue, Ladybug arrives and uses her yo-yo to grab Riposte's sword, however, she is surprised to find it's fused with her hand. Riposte attacks Ladybug with a flurry of sword strikes, which Ladybug blocks, and Adrien tosses Ladybug the student's discarded sabre. Even with the sabre, Ladybug finds herself outmatched by Riposte, who knocks her to the ground and attempts to strike her. Adrien saves Ladybug before Riposte's hit can land, although sprains his left ankle in the process.

title: Riposte
text:
Riposte - Plot
Ladybug and Adrien then swing themselves to a rooftop and hide behind a chimney. Ladybug states that it will be hard to both fight Riposte and guard Adrien, and calls Cat Noir, who does not respond, Adrien suggests that he could be busy. Riposte destroys the chimney, and they attempt to talk things out with her, although she states that the damage has already been done and attacks. Ladybug fights Riposte and buries her in a pile of rubble while Adrien limps away and hides. He attempts to transform, however, Ladybug interrupts him and takes them to find a safe hiding place. As this happens, Riposte frees herself.

title: Riposte
text:
Riposte - Plot
Ladybug takes Adrien to the Louvre, and after getting the citizens to peacefully escort themselves away from the area, she hides him inside a sarcophagus. Riposte soon catches up to them, breaks into the Louvre and demands Ladybug tell her where Adrien is. She refuses, and the two begin to fight. Adrien uses his time alone to transform into Cat Noir, however, he finds that his ankle is still injured. Riposte attempts to strike Ladybug, only for Cat Noir to block her sword with his staff. They manage to corner Riposte, however, she knocks Cat Noir back (unintentionally hurting his sprained ankle), and forces Ladybug out of the room, which she then seals off using the security system. Riposte chases after her while Cat Noir uses his Cataclysm to destroy the bars.

title: Riposte
text:
Riposte - Plot
Upon entering the Egyptian exhibit, Riposte realizes that Adrien is inside the sarcophagus and destroys it. To the surprise of both Ladybug and Riposte, he isn't inside the sarcophagus. Ladybug seals off the room as Cat Noir enters and the two continue to fight with Riposte. Ladybug then uses her Lucky Charm, receiving a radiator, and realizes that the akuma is inside Riposte's sword. Using her Lucky Vision, Ladybug spots Cat Noir's belt, Riposte's sword, and the radiator, and comes up with a plan. She and Cat Noir tie the belt to Riposte's sword as she sticks it through the radiator, and use the force of the object to break the sword apart. She purifies the akuma and tosses the radiator in the air, turning everything back to normal. Cat Noir then claims to need to see the veterinarian and runs off to detransform as Ladybug walks Kagami out of the room.

title: Riposte
text:
Riposte - Plot
Ladybug wonders where Adrien could have gone, and he reappears from behind a statue. But realizes that she is about to detransform and tells him to give the fencer her sword back. As Ladybug leaves, Adrien secretly blows her a kiss. Outside, Adrien catches the fencer, who apologizes as he does. He tries to return the saber, although the fencer tells him to keep it, as she had lost. Adrien remarks that she should have won, and that Marinette flusters easily, but that she's kind and means well. The fencer asks if Adrien likes Marinette, and he states that she is a very good friend (to the disappointment of Marinette, who is secretly watching). Adrien finally introduces himself, and the fencer introduces herself as Kagami. Kagami's driver arrives to pick her up, and Kagami enters her car, telling Adrien to get ready for the decisive match, which he replies he can't wait for. Adrien walks into his vehicle, while Marinette laments on how she isn't satisfied with Adrien only seeing her as a friend. Tikki states that Marinette will have time to work on her fencing skills, and the two have a pretend fencing match before the end card appears.

title: Riposte
text:
Riposte - Plot Developments
A protocol for akumatized villains for the citizens of Paris is shown, the Louvre running an announcement and instructions for people in the area to evacuate.
This is the first time Hawk Moth akumatizes a sentimonster. This proves that a sentimonster can be akumatized just like a normal human.
It's seen that if holders get hurt before they transform, they will still be hurt afterwards, as seen with Adrien and this is the first time it's done so in the series followed by "Miraculer".
It appears that the Lucky Charm may be indestructible as Riposte's sword went through the radiator multiple times and it didn't break or similar to the carjack in "Animan" the object was highly durable. The only possible thing that could destroy a Lucky Charm would be Cataclysm, as seen in "Weredad".
However, it appears that not all of them are as the frame of the harp broke upon contact with Cat Noir's staff in "Robostus", the glued-together broken plate broke when it hit the wall in "Troublemaker", or the pillow when Ladybug ripped it in two in "Miraculer".

title: Riposte
text:
Riposte - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in France on TFOU.
Thomas Astruc first revealed the episode on Twitter by posting a screenshot of Ladybug and Adrien on a rooftop.
This episode was originally planned to be aired on November 2, 2017, in France, but it was moved ahead to November 1.
This is the first episode where Alya does not make an appearance.
Marinette notices an akuma before it approaches and akumatizes a villain.
The previous time a character noticed an akuma prior to it akumatizing someone is Aurore Beauréal in "Stormy Weather".
Hawk Moth shows concern during one of his plans towards his akumatized victim when Riposte is going after Adrien, which he has previously done in "Simon Says" upon realizing that Simon Says is going after Gabriel Agreste.
Though Adrien transforms into Cat Noir onscreen, there is no transformation sequence because he is inside the sarcophagus.
Kagami being mistaken for a boy until she removes her helmet is not in the French version.
Adrien doesn't wear his regular clothes in the episode.
The first time was in "Copycat" when he was framed for the burglary and the second time was "The Pharaoh".

title: Riposte
text:
Riposte - Trivia
This is the second time Ladybug is seen dual wielding following "The Puppeteer" and interestingly her using both a sword and yo-yo are the same weapons as her predecessors Jeanne d'Arc and La Coccinelle.
Allusions
While there are multiple disciplines in fencing, the precise type of fencing is electric epee fencing since the epee is the only type of discipline that can score on any part of the body.
The kanji in the design on Kagami's ring is "女", meaning "woman", with a sabre stuck in the middle.
Errors
Because her design is a common background model, there are several instances where August's mother can be seen at different places at once. For example, she can be seen as one of the students at Armand D'Argencourt's fencing class as well being spotted outside the Louvre Museum speaking to another civilian.
Also, inside the Louvre Pyramid, two duplicates of the same background model of the woman can be seen together inside the museum during the voice announcement.

title: Riposte
text:
Riposte - Trivia
During her match with Adrien, Kagami performed several moves illegal in fencing such as shoving him off the mat (a corps-a-corps) and into a pillar (a dangerous, violent or vindictive action), crossing her feet and turning her back to him, which should have all gotten her penalized.
Also, the bout should have ended the moment they left the strip.
Placide I.T.'s car and another car in the background disappear when Ladybug is fighting with Riposte.
The Mona Lisa is not in its display location during the fight with Riposte.
Just before Kagami was changed back to normal, her sabre appears to be not broken despite it being broken off by Ladybug.
When Cat Noir detransforms, the flash of light formed is not aligned with the cat statue, being offset to the left.
When Kagami is escorted by Ladybug, she wears her glove on her right hand, despite not having it when she was akumatized and when she was changed back to normal.
When Adrien is talking to Kagami before she gets into her car, she is wearing a glove on her right hand. Seconds later though it's gone so Adrien can see the ring on her finger. Even though she took said glove off and threw it into the car before taking her helmet off.

text:
Riposte - Trivia
When Marinette is fencing Adrien, her jacket is black, not her usual grey.
In the Brazilian Portuguese credits, Kagami's name is misspelled as "Kioto".
This was corrected in later versions.

title: Riposte/Transcript
text:
Riposte/Transcript - Intro
[ Theme Song ]
Tikki: This fencing gear really does suit you, Marinette.
Marinette: Thank you, Tikki! Let's hope wielding a saber is a lot easier than finding a helmet that fits. (The helmet slips and Marinette makes a disgruntled noise.)
Tikki: (giggles)

Tikki: You've been reviewing the fencing rules all weekend, it's going to be great!
Marinette: You're right. I'm going to make quite an impression on Adrien! (She slams the helmet down on the table, upsetting the others laid out. Marinette scrambles to catch them before they fall off, catching one on her foot.) Ah, here we go! This one should fit perfectly!
Armand: I am the fencing master, Mr. D'Argencourt. As I'm sure you're aware, we have only one open spot on the team this year. (Armand stops and faces the challengers.) So, in order to select the best possible candidate, I will observe the beginners performing a number of attacks on the experienced students.
Marinette: (looks around) Where's Adrien?

title: Riposte/Transcript
text:
Riposte/Transcript - Intro
Armand: (Gestures with his arm to his students.) Get into position.
(Marinette is still looking around for Adrien when one of the students approaches her.)
Adrien: Seems like you're looking for someone?
Marinette: Yeah, I thought Adrien was here. You know, a boy this tall (she gestures to about Adrien's height then puts her hand to her cheek.), blond, nice, super handsome?
Adrien: (lifts up his helmet to reveal his face.) Thanks for the compliments!
(Marinette yelps in surprise.)
Adrien: I didn't know you were into fencing, Marinette.
Marinette: A-Adrien! Nice to fencing, I'm totally into you! Uhh, I mean, nice to see you! Yeah, I'm totally into fencing.
Adrien: (Chuckles gently and smiles.)
(Marinette giggles and blushes.)
Armand: Get into position!
Marinette: (She awkwardly puts her helmet on, glances at Adrien, and holds her saber upright).
Adrien: Bend your knees, then stretch your left foot back, turned outwards. (Marinette does so.) Perfect! (He moves to her side, putting his arm around her to have her lean forward, using his other hand to guide hers so her saber is pointing out.) Now, put your saber forward, like this.
Marinette: (Blushes and giggles again.)

title: Riposte/Transcript
text:
Riposte/Transcript - Intro
Armand: Greet each other! (He crosses his saber arm over his chest and then snaps it out to his side in the traditional fencing greeting.)
(Adrien, then Marinette, greet each other.)
Armand: En garde! Prêt, allez!
(The students begin fencing while D'Argencourt watches. Adrien is ready, but Marinette is standing quite still.)
Adrien: (He straightens up and pushes up his helmet) Go on, Marinette. You're supposed to touch me.
Marinette: (giggling) Touch you?! Yeah...
(Adrien smiles and puts his helmet back down before lunging at Marinette. She dodges, striking back.)
Armand: Attaque! Touche. Point! (He indicates Marinette) Continue!
Marinette: (she pushes up her helmet.) Thanks!
Adrien: (He also pushes his helmet up.) All I did was lunge. You've got good reflexes! (He puts his helmet down again and readies himself again) En garde!
Marinette: (She puts her helmet back down and likewise gets into position.)
Adrien: Prêt, allez!
(Adrien and Marinette quickly fence, Marinette blocking Adrien before getting him in the chest.)
Adrien: Attack, parry, riposte, counterattack. The point goes to you, Marinette.
Marinette: (Once more pushes her helmet up.) I don't get it. You hit me first.

title: Riposte/Transcript
text:
Riposte/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: (He also pushes his helmet up.) With saber fencing, the attacker doesn't necessarily win the point even though he touched his opponent first. You took the initiative, so we say that you had priority. I can only parry or riposte, so I lose.
Marinette: But everything's happening so fast, I mean, how can you know who won the point?
Adrien: We don't always know for sure. That's why you can also abstain. Shall we continue? (He lowers his helmet.)
(Marinette nods, then lowers her helmet and gets ready to fence, but before she can move, a shout interrupts the fencing try-outs. A figure in red fencing gear stands on the scoring box, carrying a red saber.)
Kagami: Hey, you! Are you Mr. D'Argencourt, the fencing master? I wanna join your team.
Armand: Only the best are admitted here, you knave.
Kagami: And I was, everywhere I went.
Armand: Part le fer! This whippersnapper has nerve! All right! I may consider your admission, shall you defeat one of my students.
Kagami: (Kagami strides forward to the silent students.) Which one of you is the best combatant?!
(All of the students shuffle around, looking at each other and sidling away from Adrien, who yet again lifts up his helmet.)

title: Riposte/Transcript
text:
Riposte/Transcript - Intro
Armand: Adrien, please give our visitor a lesson in chivalry.
Adrien: (smirks and lowers his helmet.) I shall, Master.
(Adrien and Kagami face off, now attached to the scoring box and standing beside it. Adrien touches his saber to Kagami's shoulder, and she touches him with hers to test the box. Kagami and Adrien bow and walk apart. Adrien bends his saber blade while Kagami swings hers around. It is obvious she is very skilled.)
Marinette: (Gasps and looks down at the ground.) Great. There goes any chance I had of making the team. This guy's obviously better than everyone.
Student to Marinette's left: It's not over yet, he still has to beat Adrien.
Armand: Prêt... allez!
(Adrien and Kagami lunge at each other and both point buzzers go off at the same time.)
Armand: Simultané! Par un toucher!

Marinette: I could have sworn Adrien touched him first...
Student to Marinette's left: Not sure. Anyway, you never question the referee's decision.
Armand: En garde! Prêt... allez!
(Again, Kagami and Adrien lunge at each other, lighting up both sides of the points box.)
Armand:  Uhh... Abstention!
Marinette: What's happening?

title: Riposte/Transcript
text:
Riposte/Transcript - Intro
Student to Marinette's left: Mr D'Argencourt isn't sure who won, so he's chosen to abstain. This is a tight bout.
Armand: En garde!
Kagami: Wait. I request that we do it the old-fashioned way. We'll be much more at ease without the machine.
Armand: Adrien?
Adrien: Fine with me. (He unplugs his body cord.)
(Kagami unplugs her body cord as well, backflips, and shows off her skill with her saber more.)
Marinette: (to the student on her right.) But how will we know who touched the other one first?
Student on Marinette's right: By watching very closely.
Armand: En garde... Prêt... allez!
(Adrien and Kagami lunge each other a third time, sabers clashing. Adrien hits a post dodging her and the fight makes its way upstairs. Kagami jumps ahead up to the second level)
Marinette: (amazed) Is this what fencing's all about?!
Armand: (excited) Part le fer! This IS what fencing's all about!
(Armand and the remaining students go to the base of the stairs. Marinette can't see over the other students, so she heads over to the other set of stairs. Meanwhile, Adrien is pinned between Kagami and the railing of the stairs.)
Kagami: Is that all you can do?

title: Riposte/Transcript
text:
Riposte/Transcript - Intro
(Adrien uses his saber to force Kagami off him and goes further upstairs, Kagami following him. Marinette meanwhile has gotten up the first flight of stairs, while her classmates and Armand are still at the base of the other stairs.)

(Kagami and Adrien are still fencing furiously, bursting into the Library when Adrien knocks Kagami inside. They begin making a mess of the library, sending a book cart out into the hallway that nearly hits Marinette.)

(In the library, Kagami and Adrien are still fencing, with only Marinette to watch. Kagami and Adrien move back from each other.)

(She and Adrien once more lunge at each other, blades clashing until both sabers seemingly touch the other at the same time. Kagami steps aside and turns to Marinette.)
Kagami: Who got the first hit?! Who?!
Marinette: Uhhh, I...!

title: Riposte/Transcript
text:
Riposte/Transcript - Intro
Armand: (He appears on the floor as he crawls up the stairs.) Who touched first? Tell us now!
Marinette: I don't know! I think... (She looks between Kagami and Adrien. Nervous and uncertain, Marinette can't decide who won but makes a choice under pressure.)... It was... Adrien?
Armand: (Suddenly springs to his feet.) Ah-ha, wonderful! This victory is an honor to D'Argencourt Academy!
Kagami: (She sighs in defeat, then walks up to Adrien, offering her hand for a shake, which Adrien takes. Kagami calmly walks out of the room.)

Marinette: Uh, um... Well, I'm not entirely sure. I mean, it looked like it was you, but it went so fast.

(Adrien looks put-out by this and goes after Kagami, who is in the middle of leaving the school. She stabs her saber into the ground and leaves it, striding out of the school.)

title: Riposte/Transcript
text:
Riposte/Transcript - Intro
Hawk Moth: A champion whose victory has been stolen... Crushing defeat is the ideal steel with which to form a blade of revenge. (turns a butterfly into an akuma)  Fly away, my little akuma, towards this spite and petulance, and evilize that fencer! (The akuma flies out of his window into Paris.)
Adrien: I'm going to offer him a decisive match. (He goes running after Kagami, grabbing her saber from the ground as he goes. Kagami is about to get into her car when Adrien catches up to her) Hey! Wait! Your saber!
(Kagami throws her glove into the car and removes her helmet, turning to look at Adrien expectantly. As she does so, Marinette runs up to the school entrance.)
Adrien: (Momentarily stunned by her appearance.) Let's do a... decisive match? (As he speaks, he notices Kagami's ring.)
Kagami: What's the point? You won. There's no such thing as a second chance in my family. Goodbye. (She gets into her car, which drives off.)
Adrien: H-Hey! What's your name?!
Tikki: You might have a chance on the fencing team after all!
Adrien: (He gets into his car where the Gorilla is waiting and points) Follow that car!
(Marinette watches the car drive off and sees the akuma flying past)

title: Riposte/Transcript
text:
Riposte/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (horrified gasp.) An akuma! (she runs after it, ducking into the metro station to transform.) Better capture it before it turns someone into a villain!
Tikki: At your service, Marinette!
Marinette: Quick! Adrien is in danger!
[Transformation Sequence]
Marinette: Tikki, spots on! Ha!
(Marinette transforms into Ladybug.)
(Ladybug uses her yo-yo to get out of the Métro quickly.)
Tomoe: (Voicemail) I'm not available at the moment. Leave a message. (Beep!)
Kagami: Mother, you thought I was good enough, but... I lost. I won't be joining the D'Argencourt Academy.
(She hangs up and sits back in her seat. The akuma flies into her ring.)
Hawk Moth: Riposte! I am Hawk Moth. I'm giving you a second chance to prove that you are the best fencer of all, but in return, you must bring me Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous.
Kagami: On my honor, Hawk Moth, I shall be victorious! (She transforms into Ripsote, slicing open a new sun roof into her car and leaving.)
(Adrien is skimming through logos on his phone, stopping when he sees the one on Kagami's ring.)

title: Riposte/Transcript
text:
Riposte/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: She's the only daughter belonging to a family of prestigious fencers. Her mother and grandfather were both world champions. I've read about them before! She and her mother just moved to Paris! How incredible!
(Riposte comes spinning out of the sky, cutting Adrien's car in half, launching Adrien out of his seat. She stands atop the back half of the car.)
Riposte: I'm taking you up on your offer of a decisive match!

Riposte: Fight!

(Riposte strikes at Adrien and Ladybug, cutting a poster display apart.)

title: Riposte/Transcript
text:

Riposte: Give me a moment, Adrien. I must finish her off, first! But don't worry- I haven't forgotten about you! I won't be long.

She lunges at them, but Ladybug carries them away. She picks up Adrien once landed and sets him down out of sight behind the chimneys.)

title: Riposte/Transcript
text:

(He thinks for a minute and he shrugs his shoulders. Riposte slices up their hiding spot.)

title: Riposte/Transcript

text:

title: Riposte/Transcript

Miraculous Ladybug!(The Miraculous Ladybug ladybugs repair all the damage done and Riposte turns back into Kagami.)Kagami: What happened?

title: Roaar
text:
Roaar - Intro
is a supporting character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She is the Kwami of Elation who is connected to the Tiger Miraculous. With her power, Roaar's wearer can use the panjas bracelet to transform into a tiger-themed superhero.
Roaar and her Miraculous are currently owned by Juleka Couffaine, who uses it to transform into the superheroine Purple Tigress.

title: Roaar
text:
Roaar - Appearance
Roaar is 10 centimeters (or 4 inches) tall and dark magenta, the bottom of her face and her belly being a lighter shade, with light orange eyes with round, black pupils and two pointed white teeth. She also has round black tiger-like ears, three vertical black stripes on the top of her head, and a whisker on each cheek. Lastly, she has a long tail with a round black tip and two black stripes below the tip.
From season 6 onwards, she has additional sideburns and black tips on her limbs. Her black pupils are now slit-shaped and her tail is sightly thicker.

title: Roaar
text:
Roaar - Personality
True to her concept, Roaar possesses a very intense personality, being fierce and confident, but also loud and expressive. She prefers her Miraculous to be wielded by a holder who is not afraid to raise their voice. If she encounters a holder that can't speak up properly, then she pushes them to do it, sometimes being a little pushy.
Still, she doesn't like for her holder to be rude, when being commanded by those who are demanding or impolite, Roaar will refuse help and criticize them on their recklessness, such as she did with Chloé.
Like all the other Kwamis, she too has a deep sense of responsibility on how her powers should be used.
Roaar is also notably curious about human items, such as art supplies and technology.

title: Roaar
text:
Roaar - Abilities
Roaar can fly, levitate, and phase through solid objects. She can also carry objects that are larger and/or heavier than herself.
As a Kwami, Roaar is able to transform the holder of the Tiger Miraculous into a tiger-themed superhero. The wearer of the Tiger Miraculous gains the power to use Clout, a superpower that allows the user to gather a tremendous amount of energy into their fist and unleash a very powerful punch.
However, Roaar's version of the power is unknown but stronger and will cause a catastrophe if used. It is certain the effects will be just like Plagg's cataclysm, creating a huge wave of destruction and destroying everything in its radius.

title: Roaar
text:
Roaar - Relationships
Friends/Allies
Juleka Couffaine/Purple Tigress
Roaar helped Juleka become more confident and vocal when they were paired together. Although seeing Juleka was incredibly shy, Roaar knew she had the potential to become more assertive and helped her do so which led to Juleka loudly scolding her parents for always fighting. When they were reunited after Marinette restored the jewels, Roaar is seen joyfully reuniting with Juleka.
Despite Roarr mostly being a positive influence on her, she can also sometimes encourage Juleka's more aggressive and negative tendencies, such as in "Vampigami", when she told her to stop Rose and Prem from going to the movies, prompting Juleka to become more enraged by punching the pillow to vent on her anger.
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/Ladybug
Roaar greatly enjoyed the new sense of freedom Marinette allowed the Kwamis to have when she became the new Guardian. She was also helpful when Marinette was working on projects and showed concern when Marinette was going through emotional stress.
Tikki
The two Kwamis are seen to get along well.
Sass

title: Roaar
text:
Roaar - Relationships
Like many of the other Kwamis, Roaar sees Sass as a leader and often looks to him for guidance during moments of uncertainty.
Since Roaar and Sass' holders, Juleka and Luka are siblings, the two Kwamis now live together on the Liberty when Luka isn't in Brazil.
Wang Fu
Wang Fu was Roaar's Guardian for many years before he passed on his role to Marinette. Roaar, like the rest of the Kwamis, was devasted he had to give up his memories once he passed on the box, and deeply missed him, jumping on the chance to see him again in "Furious Fu" when the opportunity arose.
Su-Han
As the Celestial Guardian, Roaar shows him great respect and obedience to his orders even if they are ones she does not like or agree with.
Enemies
Gabriel Agreste/Monarch
Like her fellow Kwamis, Roaar did not enjoy her powers being used for evil means but was often prevented from standing up to Gabriel. However, she was the Kwami who stood up to him the most, saying he always says he's going to win but always loses in "Deflagration" and asking him if he doesn't knows stealing energy from others is wrong in "Pretension".
Chloé Bourgeois/Queen Bee

title: Roaar
text:
Roaar - Relationships
When Chloé had tried to force the Kwamis to give her their powers, Roaar was one of those who vocally denied her demand because of Chloé's rude behavior and not knowing their names or commands.

title: Roaar
text:
Roaar - Trivia
In the English Dub, the concept of the Tiger Miraculous has been stated to be Elation. However, in the French Dub the tiger's concept is Exaltation.
Roaar was first revealed from a second season trailer on August 31, 2017.
Tigers represent power, energy, and protection, among other things.
Her name is a pun on "Roar".
The tiger is the third animal of the Chinese zodiac.
She is the second Kwami based off of a feline, following Plagg, who's based off a cat.
In the English dub, Roaar was originally given a masculine voice which was first heard in "Sandboy". However, as of "Miracle Queen", the tiger Kwami now speaks in a feminine voice.
Roaar's Brazilian Portuguese and Russian voices, much like the English one, are masculine. However, unlike in the English dub, the Brazilian Portuguese and Russian dubs kept the masculine voice through out the series.

title: Reverser
text:
Reverser - Intro
"" is a season 2 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 20th written and produced episode of season 2. It is also the 46th written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Reverser
text:
Reverser - Synopsis
Angry over his perception that Marinette and Nathaniel humiliated him, fellow student Marc becomes Reverser, who is determined to get revenge.
Disney+
Ladybug and Cat Noir face Marc, now Reverser.

title: Reverser
text:
Reverser - Plot
As the bell rings, Marinette pauses to speak to a student, Marc Anciel, who is hiding under the stairs with his notebook, writing a new installment of "Diary of Ladybug". Marinette encourages him to come to the art room and meet everyone there.
Later, Marinette, Nathaniel, and their art teacher discuss finding a creative author to help Nathaniel write scripts for his illustrated comics. Marinette spots Marc hanging out outside the classroom door, calls him in, and introduces him to everyone. They briefly discuss having Marc and Nathaniel work together, but Marc doesn't believe he has it in him. He awkwardly flees the room, inadvertently dropping his "Diary of Ladybug" in the process. Marinette finds it and decides to read it in the girls restroom. She finds it to be "...not exactly the truth... but definitely a fun read!"

title: Reverser
text:
Reverser - Plot
After she returns it to Marc, she encourages him to team up with Nathaniel, but Marc is not confident in his abilities and fears rejection. They decide to give it to Nathaniel without telling him who wrote it. While the two of them are spying on Nathaniel to see his reaction, Adrien shows up behind them, saying that it's "...a bit rude to spy on people" before winking at Marinette, but she nervously says that they were working on a surprise for him for his birthday. Understanding he says that's nice of her and offers his help before leaving. Marc comments that Marinette, just like himself, is shy, to Marinette's chagrin.
In the art room, Marinette gives Nathaniel the story, but he had been deceived by the title and believes that Ladybug wrote the diary herself. Marinette tells Nathaniel he can meet the writer out by the fountain after school. When Nathaniel shows up, he starts blushing bright red expecting Ladybug, but is shocked to find Marc instead. He believes that Marinette and Marc teamed up to play a joke on him and angrily rips up Marc's stories, rejecting Marc's suggestion of writing a comic book together.

title: Reverser
text:
Reverser - Plot
From his lair, Hawk Moth senses Marc's devastation and sends an akuma after him. The akuma possessed Marc's notebook and Hawk Moth greets him as Reverser, telling Marc that he is giving him the power to invert anyone as long as he helps in return. He agrees and gets akumatized. Marinette, who watched the whole thing from her balcony, runs down to Reverser to tell him her true intentions, but he gets angry and tries to make everyone hate Marinette, who dodges his paper airplane and runs off to transform into her superhero alter ego. Ladybug then confronts Reverser, only to be carried throughout Paris on her yo-yo string. She flies past Adrien in his car, who is stuck in traffic jam. He claims that he left his fencing gloves behind and leaves to get them and then jumps out to transform.

title: Reverser
text:
Reverser - Plot
Ladybug and Cat Noir are both hit by Reverser's superpowers - Ladybug is hit while protecting a citizen, and Cat Noir is caught off guard by Ladybug, causing him to be hit as well. She becomes extremely clumsy and Cat Noir becomes scared of everything around him causing them to fall into the river. With the heroes weakened, Hawk Moth commands Reverser to find them. But seeing the heroes as harmless, he leaves to find and reverse Marinette and Nathaniel.

title: Reverser
text:
Reverser - Plot
Meanwhile, Nathaniel arrives at the museum to speak to Alix and Reverser arrives at the school art classroom demanding to know where Marinette and Nathaniel are. At the same time, Cat Noir and Ladybug pull themselves to shore despite their condition. Knowing that the villain is looking for Nathaniel, Ladybug has an idea of where to find him. Cat Noir, who is still under the effects of Reverser's superpower, doesn't want to fight until Ladybug encourages him, but they realize they're not going to get very far. After taking a cab to the school, they find that Reverser has already reversed the personalities of the art class students and teacher. By looking at one of the Nathaniel's drawings, the heroes find out that he's at the Louvre Museum.

title: Reverser
text:
Reverser - Plot
Reverser asks Chloé and Sabrina where Nathaniel and Marinette are, but when they refuse to answer, he reverses them, causing Chloé to tend to Sabrina instead of the other way around. Reverser then throws a paper airplane at Mayor Bourgeois during his announcement of relocating trash to space dumpsters in an effort to make Paris the cleanest city despite the idea bring heavily protested against. As a result, the mayor then brings the space dumpsters back to Paris. In the museum, Alix talks to Nathaniel about making up with Marc, knowing that Marinette is not the type of person who embarrasses others, to which Nathaniel believes he jumped the gun too quickly. Ladybug and Cat Noir enter the museum and they hear Reverser's ultimatum through Ladybug's yo-yo, where he demands the heroes hand over Marinette and Nathaniel as well their Miraculous to him. The heroes ask for Nathaniel's help to defeat Reverser, and Cat Noir asks about Marinette. Ladybug replies that there is no time and that Reverser will have to settle with Nathaniel. Alix wants to help them as well, but they refused, deeming it too dangerous, but after being reminded of their reversed conditions they accept her help.

title: Reverser
text:
Reverser - Plot
They arrive at the Eiffel Tower and see the space dumpsters entering the atmosphere, threatening to cover the city in trash. Cat Noir quivers in fear until Ladybug reminds him that, despite their condition, they're still a team. She summons her Lucky Charm and receives a bundle of bamboo rolls. Using a traffic cone as a makeshift megaphone, Ladybug offers Cat Noir to Reverser in exchange for reversing the mayor, but the villain wants Cat Noir and Nathaniel to which the heroine agrees. When they deliver Nathaniel and Cat Noir, Reverser tells them this better not be a trick, but Ladybug replies that they couldn't pull a trick with their reversed states. Cat Noir jumps off while riding a kite made from his blanket and the bamboo sticks from Ladybug's lucky charm. With Alix steering the kite, he blindly uses his Cataclysm to destroy Reverser's paper hoverboard and Ladybug successfully reverses the actions of Reverser and de-evilizes the akuma.

title: Reverser
text:
Reverser - Plot
With everything back to normal, Cat Noir saves Marc from falling, Ladybug has him and Nathaniel make up while Hawk Moth vows revenge. The next day, Nathaniel and Marc make a comic book about Reverser and they dedicate it to Marinette, saying she'd make a great hero "if she wasn't such a klutz". Marinette laughs along with her friends, and the ending card appears.
