title: Reunion
text:
Reunion - Intro
"" is a season 5 episode of the series Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. Based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 8th written and produced episode of season 5. It is also the 112th written and produced episode of the series overall.

title: Reunion
text:
Reunion - Synopsis
While visiting the Louvre museum, Marinette makes a double discovery. First, she realizes that her friend Alix, whom she's entrusted with the Rabbit Miraculous, has found a way to communicate with her loved ones without setting foot in the present. Second, Marinette learns that she herself can use her kwagatama to communicate with the Memories of the former Miraculous holders. Will this help her escape the trap that Monarch has set for her?
Disney+
Ladybug discovers the secrets of her kwagatama.
Netflix
Ladybug makes contact with someone from the distant past to help her escape the Louvre after Jalil traps her as revenge for sending his sister away.

title: Reunion
text:
Reunion - Plot
Alim Kubdel is supervising the insertion of antiques into his museum when Marinette, invited to the museum, is asking Alya why she can't be in love with Cat Noir, and wonders if other Ladybugs have been in love with other Black Cats. She asks Tikki and she suggest Jeanne d'Arc, and how she fell in love with a Black Cat holder. Tikki says that there was no Monarch for them and that for more information she would have to ask Jeanne d'Arc herself using her Kwagatama. Alya keeps watch to make sure no-one comes. Marinette starts the meeting by touching her Kwagatama to the base of the painting of Jeanne d'Arc. Marinette stumbles back and accidentally knocks down a painting. In the back is an ancient hidden letter. The letter is from Alix.

title: Reunion
text:
Reunion - Plot
Meanwhile, Adrien asks for permission to accept an invitation from Mr Kubdel, inviting him to the museum and is given permission. At the museum, Mr Kubdel reads letters written by Alix and shows the students who were invited photos of Bunnyx in her past adventures. During the excursion, Jalil Kubdel declares that Ladybug has kidnapped his sister and uses his Alliance ring to show posts that prove his theory. His father says that he's spending too much time on the internet. Jalil leaves angrily. Alim says that he had trouble dealing with his sister's loss.
Marinette and Alya go back to where they were when they found the hidden letter. Marinette uses her kwagatama and manages to get in contact with Jeanne d'Arc. After Tikki explains Marinette's situation and why she was summoned, Jeanne d'Arc gets angry at Marinette, demanding that she ends the reunion.
Meanwhile, Jalil listens to the comments people have posted about Ladybug and thanks, to one by Lila, he is convinced Monarch is good while Ladybug and Cat Noir are the villains. He hopes Monarch will akumatize him and promises him he will get the Miraculouses of Ladybug and Cat Noir.

title: Reunion
text:
Reunion - Plot
Meanwhile in his lair, Monarch senses Jalil's plead and strong emotions. He creates a megakuma and absorbs Kaalki into his ring. He then uses the power of Voyage to teleport the megakuma to Jalil. Monarch says he will get back the Rabbit Miraculous and make up for his mistakes to Émilie and Nathalie. The megakuma goes into the binder that Jalil carries with him. Jalil gets akumatized into Pharaoh. Monarch than transfers the essence of the Turtle Miraculous by absorbing Wayzz and giving him the power of protection, as Carapace's Shell-ter, to Pharaoh. He uses it on the Book of Truth, a book capable of telling him the truth from the lies to protect it.

title: Reunion
text:
Reunion - Plot
The Book of Truth transforms the museum into a giant pyramid traps the people inside. Meanwhile, Jeanne d'Arc is still telling Marinette to end the reunion. Adrien is out of the museum and transforms into Cat Noir and inside the museum, Marinette transforms into Ladybug. Ladybug is surprised when she still sees Jeanne d'Arc because the former did not end the reunion. Mr Kubdel is imprisoned in a page of the Book of Truth due to him incorrectly answering a question. Cat Noir manages to enter the museum and freeing some of the people due to him answering the question the Book of Truth correctly.
Ladybug answers one of the questions the Book of Truth asks her. When Jeanne d'Arc sees Cat Noir, she is surprised as to how weak he is and wonders how Ladybug could be in love with him. When the Book asks Ladybug and Cat Noir a question from the future, they realize only Bunnyx can answer it due to her time-travelling powers. Ladybug uses her Lucky Charm and receives a pen. She thinks and realizes how to answer the book's question.

title: Reunion
text:
Reunion - Plot
She takes a museum booklet and writes to Bunnyx what is happening in the present and puts the booklet behind the painting. In the future, Alix finds the booklet and reads the instructions Ladybug wrote her. She transforms into Bunnyx and uses her power, Burrow to travel to July 14, 200 years from when the letter was written. She notices there is a thunderstorm and draws a symbol of it on the booklet. Bunnyx travels to the moment when Mr Kubdel was inserting the new antique and hides it under the cat statue Ladybug told it to hide it under.
Meanwhile, in the present, Ladybug finds the booklet under the cat statue and sees Bunnyx's drawing of the answer and uses it to answer the question asked by the Book of Truth. Ladybug and Cat Noir finally meet face-to-face with Pharaoh. Cat Noir uses his power and cataclysms the shield that protects the book only for Pharaoh to use his power on the book again. Ladybug convinces Pharaoh to ask his book to see if Alix really did want to help Ladybug. After seeing that Ladybug was right the entire time, he realizes that Monarch lied to him and rejects the megakuma.

title: Reunion
text:
Reunion - Plot
After purifying the megakuma and fixing the damage with her Lucky Charm, Pharaoh is deakumatized back into Jalil. After seeing the message left by Bunnyx, Jeanne d'Arc is proud of Ladybug. Monarch detransforms into Gabriel and apologizes to Nathalie for failing to get the Miraculous of the Rabbit. Jeanne d'Arc tells her story of her love life to Marinette. Jeanne d'Arc was known as The Scarlet Fate and fell in love with a Cat Miraculous holder called The Dark Grimalkin after they fought each other. They both wanted to be in love with each other and displeased the kings and The Scarlet Fate and The Dark Grimalkin both gave up their Miraculouses.
After ending the reunion, Marinette learns that romance between the Ladybug holder and the holder of the Miraculous of the Cat can happen but the ending can be unpredictable. At the Agreste mansion, as Adrien is lying on his bed, Plagg makes him his very own kwagatama as the episode ends.

title: Reunion
text:
Reunion - Plot developments
Following "Determination", Passion and later, "Elation", this episode continues the reverse love square of the French Duo.
This episode reveals the Kwagatamas' special power:
It's revealed that many artifacts in the Louvre possesses a seal of the Order of the Guardians such as the Ladybug statue.
When it comes into contact with a symbol of the Order of the Guardians from an artifact in the Louvre Museum such as the Ladybug statue, and the holder says "Reunion" they can summon their kwami's previous owners who first appear in a ring of ethereal portraits of the past Miraculous holders will appear all around the current holder. When the current holder selects the portrait of the previous holder they want said holder will appear in the form of a ghost or spirit.
Only the current Miraculous holder and the kwami will be able to see and hear the spirit, and the same rule applies to the ethereal portrait as anyone else would just see regular empty air.
This is similar to how only the Renren can see the Renlings, as seen in "Miraculous Shanghai".
The summoned spirit is also not able to interact with the physical world.

title: Reunion
text:
Reunion - Plot developments
Jeanne says, "I keep forgetting", implying that she was summoned before.
According to Jeanne, a Miraculous holder with a kwagatama can only talk with the previous holders that have the same Miraculous as they do.
In other words, for Marinette to talk to the other Rabbit holders, she would need Fluff's kwagatama.
The summoned spirit only retains their memories as a Miraculous holder, not including what happened to them after they renounced their Miraculouses.
But since Tikki said they "can't" know what happened to their real selves it's implied something bad will happen if they do.
Interestingly when Tikki explained more about the kwagatama, she was able to say Joan's civilian and hero name at the same time with spell taking no effect meaning that when a kwami's owner dies they likely can speak their owner's name freely.
The spirit will remain with the current holder until or unless they say "End of Reunion".

title: Reunion
text:
Reunion - Plot developments
Marinette is the only one of her holder legacy to be a Miraculous holder and guardian, but if the Ladybug Statue in the Louvre Museum can only retain the memories of the past Ladybugs as Miraculous holders through the use of the kwagatama. It's unknown if that will work for Marinette if or when she relinquishes her title as guardian.
More Miraculous holders are revealed in this episode:
A painting reveals a former Rabbit Miraculous female holder. It is based on Ghirlandaio's "Portrait of a Lady with a Rabbit".
There was an English Cat Miraculous holder called Dark Grimalkin.
In the photo of Alix with the Three Musketeers, one of them was a woman and it's been confirmed one of Ladybug's predecessors was apart of the guard but it's unknown if that is what La Coccinelle looked like in civilian form or not.
More about Jeanne d'Arc is revealed in this episode:
She was chosen as a Ladybug Miraculous holder (using the name Scarlet Fate) to fight against a Cat Miraculous holder called Dark Grimalkin, who served England during the Hundred Years War.
She and Dark Grimalkin were manipulated by their own monarchs to fight each other, even if that meant the suffering of the people.

title: Reunion
text:
Reunion - Plot developments
The two of them fell in love and ended up living that love in secret, but they were caught and sentenced to die for treason, with Jeanne being sentenced to die by fire at the stake.
Unlike her real life counterpart, Jeanne d'Arc actually managed to escape the stake and she and Dark Grimalkin abdicated their Miraculous to live in peace together. It's unknown if they lived happily after that.
She and Grimalkin were the first Ladybug and Cat Noir pair to be on opposite sides of the conflict, pursue each other romantically and be together.
As shown in the season 5 finale "Re-creation", this episode foreshadows the main timeline Paris' future: A more modern, more green city. Both in the time period Alix is in when she finds Ladybug message, as well as the far future she travels to as part of her mission, Paris is way, way more ecological compared to its' present day counterpart. A change that we now know started with Ms. Bustier's mayoracy.

title: Reunion
text:
Reunion - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in France on TFOU.
This is the first season 5 episode that is not named after the concept of a Miraculous.
That is, however, the very power of the kwagatama.
There are many reunions in the episode:
Alix was able to reunite with her family and friends by sending them letters and messages placed on the exhibitions of the museum.
Alim Kubdel gathered Alix's friends so he can share with them the letter he had just received.
Marinette was able to make a reunion with one of the past holders of her Miraculous, with that holder being Jeanne d'Arc.
It's revealed there is a forum where all the haters of Ladybug gather to insult her and Cat Noir, with Chloé belonging to that same forum.
There were also other reunions in other episodes:
Along with various episodes of Ladybug and Cat Noir reuniting families and friends after akuma battles such as in "The Puppeteer", "Gigantitan" and "Weredad".
How Marinette reunited her father and grandfather in "Bakerix".
In "Furious Fu", where the kwamis, Marinette/Ladybug and Cat Noir reunited with Wang Fu, then again in "Evolution" as well as Master Fu and Su-Han reunited.

title: Reunion
text:

The various times Ladybug and Cat Noir were reunited following "Miraculous Shanghai", "Miraculous New York", "Hack-San", "Kuro Neko" and "Strikeback".
Such as Ladybug and Cat Noir being reunited with their kwamis and miraculouses (separately and together) following "Reflekdoll", "Feast", "Hack-San", "Kuro Neko", "Passion", "The Kwamis' Choice" and more.

This episode introduces a new usage of the Pharaoh's power: Maat, the goddess of truth, allows him to transfer his power to a living book that will ask trivia questions and imprison those who answer incorrectly.
This episode introduces a new background theme for the Cataclysm sequence.

title: Reunion
text:

References

title: Reunion
text:

This is similar to how in "Passion", the Paint Brush appeared only when Safari used Genesis.
In the English dub, Ladybug's "Time to de-evilize" line, and Jalil's line seconds later, "I'm sorry I doubted you, Ladybug", are slightly sped up.
Similarly, Monarch's monologue line when he sends out a megakuma "And finally, I will make up for my mistakes" is cut off in between.
Jalil has his akumatized self's voice after he was de-akumatized.
When the Pharaoh rejects the megakuma, it doesn't purify itself, even though that occurs in all other episodes when a megakuma is rejected.

title: Revelation/Transcript
text:
Revelation/Transcript - Intro
[ Theme Song ]
Lila: Sorry, Mother. I can't put in you in video. We're in the savanna. The connection's just too unstable. I gotta go! I have to free a baby rhino from a poacher's snare. I'll call you at seven P.M., Paris time. Love you!
Mrs. Bianca: (on the phone) Oh, you're so wonderful, sweetie. Love you too!
(Lila hangs up the phone as her other "mother" enters the room. She begins talking to her in sign language.)
Lila's third mother: (in sign language) "Who were you talking to, angel?"
Lila: (while doing hand signs) Oh, I was talking to my agent, Mom. I was telling him I'm going to miss you while we're shooting the movie in Mexico.
Lila's third mother: (in sign language) "Oh, you're already going so far back when we just met."
Lila: (while doing hand signs) Yes, I know. We've just reunited, Mom. But I'll be back soon.
Alliance Lila: Lila, painting class starts in fifteen minutes.
Alliance Lila: Your taxi will be arriving in three minutes, Quentin.
Kid: Alliance, can you please call Mommy?
Alliance Lila: The next screening is at 11:30AM.
(Lila walks past Mr. Ramier.)
Alliance Lila: The Place des Vosges square is 0.2 miles away, Mr. Ramier.

title: Revelation/Transcript
text:
Revelation/Transcript - Intro
(Lila flips her hair and stops walking besides another Parisian with her Alliance.)
Parisian: Please, Alliance. When will the next bus be here?
Alliance Lila: Three minutes.
Lila: Phew. I won't miss my flight to New York.
Parisian: (gasps) The real Alliance! Can we take a selfie?
Lila: (nods) Of course!
(Lila and the Parisian take a photo together. A bus stops in front of them. The Parisian boards the bus as the door opens.)
Parisian: (to Lila) Thanks!
Bus driver: Please, Alliance. Show me the road construction ahead.
Alliance Lila: Construction reported in 800 meters on Rue du Quai.
Lila: Oh, where has my brain gone — I forgot my wallet!
Bus driver: Oh! Alliance... in person?! Come on, get on! Today, you ride for free!
Lila: Aww!
(Once seated, she tells her fellow passengers one of her "made-up" stories.)
Lila: Of course, being coached by an Olympic gold medalist would've been awesome! But I had to turn it down. Pro-tennis wouldn't have left time for my charity work.
(Lila gets off the bus, arriving in front of the school. She spots a penny on the pavement and picks it up.)

title: Revelation/Transcript
text:
Revelation/Transcript - Intro
Lila: There are days like this when everything just goes so well. (puts the penny inside her purse and starts to walk again)
Sabine: It's wonderful how fast you adapt, Lila. You've only been here for a few weeks but it's like you've always been part of the class!
Lila: The credit goes to you, Sabine. It's such a shame that your daughter Marinette won't bother to take advantage of all that you have to teach!
Sabine: Marinette already has so much on her plate...
Alliance Lila: Warning: your Alliance will restart to install an update. This will only take a moment.
Alliance Kagami and Adrien: Update complete. Welcome!
Alliance Kagami: We are Kagami and Adrien.
Alliance Adrien: From now on, we will be the ones making your daily life easier.
Alliance Kagami and Adrien: Because together, we're always stronger!
(Every person in the class turns to look at Lila, who is enraged by the current Alliance update. She takes a deep breath and coyly comes up with another story about her sudden disappearance of her avatar on the Alliance.)

title: Revelation/Transcript
text:
Revelation/Transcript - Intro
Lila: Oh, right! The update! I actually wanted to tell you today. Taking this class has been an eye-opener for me. I'm tired of the fame and all my superficial connections to people in the world. I suggested this avatar change. This way, I'll be able to fully dedicate myself to my passion for my painting, among real friends! Thank you, Sabine! (embraces Sabine) You're like a mother to me.
(Sabine hugs her back. The class gives a round of applause for Lila's speech.)
Nathalie: There's someone for you at the gate. (closes the door)
(Gabriel presses the intercom button on his monitor. It appears that Lila was the one looking for him, who is now seen standing in front of the mansion gate.)
Lila: You could've warned me! I don't believe this replacement was in our agreement. As the face of the Gabriel brand—

title: Revelation/Transcript
text:
Revelation/Transcript - Intro
Gabriel: You were only the face of my brand in exchange for a mission — to monitor my son's relationships and keep him away from bad company. You failed. My son got close to this Marinette Dupain-Cheng who's been nothing but a terrible influence on him. But you did give me one excellent idea — to create a new media-friendly pairing for my son, which is why Kagami Tsurugi will be the new female face of the Gabriel brand. (opens his Alliance) Perfection itself! All that remains to do is perpetuate this façade until it becomes truth in everyone's eyes. Absolutely everyone. And until jealousy eats away at Marinette Dupain-Cheng...
Lila: But... What's to become of me??
Gabriel: You just remain what you are. Nothing.
(The intercom camera retracts back in the wall. Lila, filled with betrayal, becomes livid.)
Gabriel: Hmm... such intense hate! It's tempting. But entrusting a power to someone who hates me so much wouldn't be a good idea.
Lila: You wouldn't get rid of me that easily, Monarch. (walks away)
Student 1: There they are!
Student 2: So cool!
Student 3: These two are so cute!
Student 4: They look so great together!
Student 5: Wow!

title: Revelation/Transcript
text:
Revelation/Transcript - Intro
Student 2: Did you see that? You can put them in matching outfits!
Student 6: I ship them so much, I gotta write a fanfic about them!
(Adrien and Marinette sit by the stairs.)
Marinette: Did you know about that update?
Adrien: No...
(Settling down, the two of them are greeted by their classmates who are also shocked about the news.)
Rose: Hey, Adrien? Doesn't your father know that you and Kagami broke up? And that now, you're about to live the most romantic love story ever with Marinette?
Adrien: Yeah. He knows.
Rose: But then... what he's doing, presenting these avatars as a couple, is a lie?
Adrien: Doesn't matter. These avatars are just images, Rose. They're not really us.
Marinette: His father can always try to force his truth on us, but we know ours. And so does Kagami.
(Adrien and Marinette look at each other for a brief moment, stand up and walk up the stairs together, hand-in-hand. Lila is shown to be eavesdropping in their conversation behind a door.)
Ms. Bustier: (upon giving the paper back to Mylène) Excellent work, Mylène! (walks to Chloé and Sabrina's table) Now, however... these two papers I had a small issue with, as they both bear Sabrina's name.

title: Revelation/Transcript
text:
Revelation/Transcript - Intro
Chloé: WHAT??? (scowls at Sabrina)
Sabrina: I'm sorry, Chloé! It's just that I haven't slept for several nights preparing all your cheat sheets for the end-of-the-year exams!
Ms. Bustier: (gasps) Sabrina, are you saying that you did Chloé's homework?
Chloé: You don't seriously expect me to do my own homework?!
Ms. Bustier: But... your handwriting is on this paper!
Chloé: Of course, she didn't imitate my handwriting. You'd know that I didn't write it.
Ms. Bustier: How long has this been going on?
Chloé: Oh, since we learned to write— I mean, since Sabrina did. Hmph!
(Ms. Bustier becomes wide-eyed.)
Ms. Bustier: Alright. Sabrina, I'm going to give you your real grade. Just don't do it again. You mustn't exhaust yourself in Chloé's service. You need your energy for yourself, too! (Sabrina nods.) As for you, Chloé, it's been so long since you've done any original work that you must've fallen way behind. You're going to need a lot of help!

title: Revelation/Transcript
text:
Revelation/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: That's unfair, Ms. Bustier! Everybody knows that Chloé's been cheating — taking advantage of Sabrina and not making any efforts compared to the others... for years! And the only consequence is that she's going to get help?? Of course, we need to support students who have problems, but not when they're the problem!
Ms. Bustier: At school, Chloé is like everyone else, Marinette. Her falling behind will be punishment enough.
Chloé: Woah! First of all, I am NOT like everyone else. I am rich, which means I don't need to learn because I'll never have to work. So you can just keep your "support" and your "falling behind", thank you.
Marinette: There! You see?! You're too nice to her!
Lila: Oh, Chloé... you're having problems at school and you haven't told me, your friend about it?
Chloé: (scoffs) School is pointless! It's just a daycare center so that parents of “anyone else's” can go to work!
(Lila covertly sends Chloé a message through her phone.)
Lila: Marinette, as class representative, I guess you've already discussed Chloé's difficulties with the teachers, haven't you?

title: Revelation/Transcript
text:
Revelation/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Huh? Why would I have? She doesn't have difficulties! Only privileges! And if you need proof to see how the teachers will let her get away with anything!
Chloé: As they should! Otherwise, my father, the Mayor of Paris, would kick them out of school for good!
(Chloé's Alliance flashes briefly as she receives the message from Lila. Lila continues her act of being compassionate.)
Lila: Oh, Marinette, I understand why you're being defensive...
Chloé: (reading Lila's message to herself) "Let me handle it. I've got this."?
Lila: Because of your wonderful romance with Adrien, you no longer have time for your duties as class representative, and that makes you feel bad. Oh, if you want, I could replace you! This way, you'll be able to think exclusively about yourself without feeling guilty for betraying the trust of those who elected you.
Marinette: Huh— What??? But t-t-that's out of the question!!
Lila: (stands up) It so happens that I just quit as face of Gabriel brand in order to have more time for my friends. If everyone agrees, I'm willing to give the attention that's obviously lacking to Chloé's and everyone else's issues.

title: Revelation/Transcript
text:
Revelation/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: If you wanted to be class rep, you should've run in the election!
Lila: Oh! That's right. I wasn't here on that day. Hmm... When you think about it, it wasn't exactly democratic to hold the elections in my absence. What do you think, Ms. Bustier?
Ms. Bustier: (confused) Uh... Sorry, I was lost in thought. Despite her haughty behavior, I always thought Chloé was a gifted student. So, this new discovery today has taken me by surprise. I'll think about your proposal during lunch, Lila.
Marinette: It's Lila! No matter (slams her food tray on the table) what she's doing, she's always up to something!!
Alya: Marinette, you know we'll always believe you. But every time you've accused Lila, there's been no evidence. And at worst, it was just a misunderstanding. (Nino nods in agreement.) You disliked her from day one because you thought she was after Adrien — fine. But it's over now! You know Adrien only has eyes for you! You don't need to be jealous anymore.
(Marinette scowls.)
Adrien: I should've said something sooner, but Marinette's right. Lila's a pathological liar and a talented one at that. She always manages to lie her way out of trouble.

title: Revelation/Transcript
text:
Revelation/Transcript - Intro
(Alya and Nino coo at Adrien's defense.)
Nino: Aww! Look how he'd say anything for his sweetheart! They sound like a real little couple now.
Alya: That's super sweet of you, Adrien! But you don't have to defend Marinette, you know?
(Adrien only had his brows furrowed, seeing that their friends don't seem to believe him, too. Marinette squeezes his hand under the table.)
Marinette: (whispers to Adrien) You were right. We can't talk about it openly. Lila is too good a liar. They'll never believe us. (to Alya and Nino) You have to admit that holding a new class rep at the end of the school year makes no sense.
Alya: Duh! Then it'd be no big deal to let Lila try and see if she can get somewhere with Chloe.
Marinette: "Get somewhere with Chloé"??
Alya: Alright, fine. I'll admit that there's very little chance that Chloé will ever change. But if Lila can rid the world of such a huge dose of walking wickedness, it's worth a try, right?
(Marinette, being so done with Alya's reasoning, stands up the table with her tray. Alya follows her from behind. Marinette places her tray on the tray rack.)
Alya: (whispers) You know, even Ladybug accepts help from Scarabella every once in a while.

title: Revelation/Transcript
text:
Revelation/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: With one small difference: I trust you entirely; I don't trust Lila at all!
Alya: Marinette, Lila is a nice girl. Maybe you should give her a chance to prove it to you.
(On another table, Lila, Chloé and Sabrina spy on Alya and Marinette from afar. Lila then gives Chloé an offer.)
Lila: Don't you want to exterminate Marinette for good, like the vermin that she is, (crushes a peanut) and make her lose everything?
Chloé: Of course, I do!!
Lila: Then, no matter what happens, from now on, do as I say. And in the end, your wish will come true.
(Chloé nods immediately to Lila's offer. Sabrina, sitting in between them, begins to cower in fear with Chloé and Lila's conspiracy.)
Ms. Bustier: School, in addition to its educational mission, must be a place of equality and justice. If Lila feels cheated for not being able to participate in the last elections, then we would all grow by acceding to her request. Which is why, even though school is nearly over, I propose that we take a new vote. I'm inviting those who wish to run to come to the board.
(Marinette scowls at Ms. Bustier's decision as she glares at Lila who walks down the classroom aisle, making her way to the front.)

title: Revelation/Transcript
text:
Revelation/Transcript - Intro
Lila: My dear classmates, I am convinced that even the worst person can change if you reach out to them. And to prove it to you, (points at Chloé) Chloé, will you be my deputy?
(The whole class gasp collectively. Chloé, being forced to follow along, stands up from her seat and walks to Lila's side.)
Nino: Wow... is Chloé actually going to be a mere deputy??
Alya: That is SO not Chloé!
Rose: Does this mean it's already working?
Mylène: Can Lila actually get her to change?
Marinette: (slams her fists on her table) This is so crazy! It's all lies!!
Lila: Poor Marinette... couldn't succeed because she was too busy with her love life, as well as being reminded of her disdain for Chloé. But you know me. You know all about my humanitarian work. I'm used to going into conflict zones. I can do this. There are two weeks left... What do you have to lose? Help me, help Chloé change. Vote for me!
Ms. Bustier: Thank you, Lila.
(Lila and Chloé go back to their seats as Marinette shoots daggers at them. Marinette and Alya proceed to the front for their presentation.)

title: Revelation/Transcript
text:
Revelation/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: My dear friends, of course, you should always do everything in your power to help people. And we all hoped that Chloé would become a better person. Ladybug reached out to her. Ms. Bustier reached out to her. So did Adrien and so did I. You all reached out to her. This proves how big your hearts are. And yet, Chloé remained the same. Why? Because as far as she's concerned, having a big heart is a weakness to be exploited. Chloé already believes she's better than all of us. (Chloé nods in agreement.) So... don't be fooled. I, for one, am done wasting my energy in vain. As class representative, I'd much rather help all of you because you deserve it a thousand times more.
Ms. Bustier: Alright, everybody, write down the name of the person you want to vote for on a piece of paper, and...
(Just as Marinette and Alya return to their seats, Lila interrupts Ms. Bustier and puts up another act.)
Lila: I'm sorry. I'm going to withdraw my candidacy. Marinette convinced me. She's right to call me an idiot and to say that what I'm trying to do is pointless...
Marinette: I didn't call her an idiot?!

title: Revelation/Transcript
text:
Revelation/Transcript - Intro
Lila: (while sobbing) It's just that... I'm having a really bad day. (wipes her tears) The truth is, I didn't quit. Gabriel Agreste fired me. I loved helping people so much, being their personal assistant on their Alliances, and now I feel completely useless. So... when I saw Chloé, I was convinced that this could be a new way for me to make myself be useful, to feel like I, too, might belong somewhere... even though, wherever I go, there's always someone rejecting me. But if Marinette is right, and there is no more hope for Chloé, then there is no hope for me either! (runs towards the door and exits the classroom, crying)
Alya: (whispers) I think you went a little bit too far. You shouldn't have called her an "idiot".
Marinette: (annoyed) I did not call her an idiot!!
Ms. Bustier: Marinette, go see if she's okay.
Marinette: But this is all probably just an act, too!
Ms. Bustier: You are still class representative, and you have to support all the students, even those who are not your friends.

title: Revelation/Transcript
text:
Revelation/Transcript - Intro
(Marinette, without any choice, groans in anger and follows Lila outside the classroom. Meanwhile, in a locker room, Lila places her phone in one of the lockers. She then proceeds to a cubicle in the girls' bathroom.)
Lila: Come on, Monarch. Feel my hatred! (growls)
Monarch: A hatred such as this I rarely felt! Far too powerful for me to ignore! (pauses in realization) Lila Rossi? Hmm... No, this anger doesn't seem to be directed at me anymore. (corrupts a butterfly and transforms it into a Megakuma) Kaalki, (her pod flies towards Monarch) your power is now mine! (absorbs her power) Voyage, my Megakuma, and feed on the power of her despair!
Monarch: (from his lair) Lila Rossi, I am Monarch. Could it be that you need my help again?
Lila: Marinette! It's always Marinette! All my failures are linked to her! Gabriel Agreste dismissed me because of her, and it's the same story at school! All I want now is a chance to get revenge on her!

title: Revelation/Transcript
text:
Revelation/Transcript - Intro
Monarch: (from his lair) With pleasure! The enemies of my friends are my enemies. Hoaxer, you have an innate talent for lying to people. Sure, a few people still escape your power. But thanks to the one I’m about to give you, all your lies, no matter how absurd, will irresistibly be taken as the truth. Trixx, (Trixx's pod flies towards Monarch...) your power is now mine! (...and absorbs his power) Transfer! (taps on his ring and transmits the power of the Fox Miraculous to Lila's Alliance) And because a fake picture is worth a thousand lies, I am transferring to you the essence of the Miraculous of Illusion. It will give you the power to illustrate your words. Anyone who sees your images will be convinced immediately.
Lila: I will use my powers to make Marinette Dupain-Cheng's life a nightmare. Trust me, Monarch.
(Just as Lila transforms into Hoaxer, Marinette enters the girls' bathroom witnessing her transformation. Monarch takes off his Alliance in his lair. Lila, now Hoaxer, opens the door to reveal herself to Marinette.)

title: Revelation/Transcript
text:
Revelation/Transcript - Intro
Hoaxer: Don't worry, Marinette. I'm not going to do anything to you directly. (corners her on the wall) Your friends will take care of it all once I've revealed to them who you really are!
Hoaxer: (on the Alliance screen) Update complete. Welcome! I am Hoaxer, your new source of information.
(Everyone who makes eye contact with Hoaxer on their Alliance gets brainwashed by Hoaxer's influence, turning their eyes red, starting with Ms. Bustier.)
Marinette: We're going to have to find a solution for this "Lila problem"! Tikki, spots on! (transforms into Ladybug)
Hoaxer: Revelation! You want to know why Marinette is always absent and doesn't fulfill her duties as class representative? (a footage of Marinette running to an alley is shown on the Alliance screens)
Marinette: (from the transmission) Another perfect opportunity to akumatize that stupid Lila! (transforms into Monarch)
Hoaxer: Because Monarch is really her! Save Paris, my followers! Catch Marinette!
(Nino gives in to the influence of Hoaxer.)
Nino: Marinette is Monarch!
Alya: Let's save Paris!!

title: Revelation/Transcript
text:
Revelation/Transcript - Intro
(Every student in the classroom stands up from their seats, except for Adrien, Ivan and Mylène who are the only students who are not under Hoaxer's influence.)
Kim: Let's find her!
Rose: Quick!
Mylène: (to Ivan) What's the matter with them?
Ivan: They all wear Alliance rings; we don't!
Mylene: Everyone, don't — it's a trap!
Adrien: (blocking the classroom's exit) Wait— That doesn't make any sense! If Marinette were Monarch, she wouldn't have akumatized Lila to reveal the truth!
Alya: Exactly! She did it on purpose so we wouldn't think it's her! (pushes Adrien on the floor as the whole class walk out the classroom)
(The students' hunt for Marinette begins, with Rose, Juleka, Sabrina and Kim barging in the locker room. Ladybug, currently on top of one of the lockers, witnesses every single bit of the chaos. She uses her yo-yo to swing away to the rooftops. Back at the classroom corridor, Ivan helps Adrien up.)
Ivan: Come on, Adrien! (pulls Adrien up)
Adrien: I have to find Marinette before they do!
Mylène: We'll help you!
Adrien: Oh... Okay. You guys check the nurse's office, I'll check the library!

title: Revelation/Transcript
text:
Revelation/Transcript - Intro
(The three of them run in two different directions as per Adrien's command. With Ivan and Mylène out of sight, Adrien re-enters the classroom.)
Plagg: Marinette as Monarch? It'd be like the most delicious tomette turning into disgusting cheese in a can!
Adrien: We can't reason with them. Lila hypnotized them through their Alliances. They'll believe everything! Plagg, claws out! (transforms into Cat Noir)
Marinette: (from the transmission) Another perfect opportunity to akumatize that stupid Lila! (transforms into Monarch)
(The Parisians disperse in search of Marinette. Ladybug, now perched on a rooftop, becomes briefly helpless upon seeing every citizen brainwashed by Hoaxer's illusion. At the school's entrance, the students rush out to search for Marinette as well.)
Alya: I know where to find Marinette for sure, sooner or later! (glances at the bakery)
(At the rooftops, Cat Noir arrives on the scene.)
Cat Noir: We have to find Marinette Dupain-Cheng, m'Lady. And quick, before they all swoop down on her!
Ladybug: The safest and fastest way would be is to defeat Hoaxer!
Cat Noir: But how can we capture her? She's everywhere and nowhere at the same time!

title: Revelation/Transcript
text:
Revelation/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: Let's capture someone with an Alliance and take the ring to study how it works!
(On another rooftop, Roger looks for Marinette inside a trash bin.)
Roger: Marinette Dupain-Cheng?
(Ladybug wraps her yo-yo around him, lifting him out of the trash bin. Cat Noir quickly removes the Alliance ring from his finger and relieves him from Hoaxer's influence.)
Roger: Ladybug? Cat Noir? What happened?
Cat Noir: You were used by an akumatized supervillain. (Ladybug lowers him down.) But don't worry, we'll fix it!
Ladybug: So, you just need to remove the ring to escape Hoaxer's influence.
Cat Noir: Good to know, but... we're not supposed to take everyone's rings off, are we?
Ladybug: (takes the Alliance ring from Cat Noir's hand) We need to get Hoaxer to come out of her ring and reveal herself. (examines the Alliance ring) But how?
(Meanwhile on the streets, a few Parisians continue for the hunt for Marinette.)

title: Revelation/Transcript
text:
Revelation/Transcript - Intro
Hoaxer: (from the Alliance transmission) Stop everything, dear followers! I can feel that one of you has removed their ring, or rather, Ladybug and Cat Noir have attacked them and stolen it! Revelation! Ladybug and Cat Noir come from the planet Saturn and fart bubbles that destroy the ozone layer! They're hiding on a roof near City Hall! Save the planet, my followers! Catch them and bring me back their Miraculous!
Parisian 1: Catch Ladybug and Cat Noir!
Parisian 2: But cover your noses first!
Monarch: (from his lair) Your guardian will have a difficult time escaping all of these revelations! (laughs maniacally)
(Back in the city, the Parisians begin climbing and enclosing the building where Ladybug and Cat Noir are.)
Cat Noir: Revelation, m'Lady! Hoaxer's connected to all the Alliance rings!
Ladybug: That's how she located us! (gives the ring back to Roger) DO NOT put it back on. Under any circumstances!
(Ladybug and Cat Noir flee from the Parisians who are about to swarm in on them on the rooftops. As the two heroes manage to hide behind a building, Ladybug activates her superpower.)
[Superpower Sequence]
Ladybug: Lucky Charm!
(receives a sewing machine)

title: Revelation/Transcript
text:
Revelation/Transcript - Intro
(Ladybug and Cat Noir look at each other, confused.)
Ladybug: I have an idea, but we need some very special items. I'll go grab them. In the meantime, you create a diversion.
Cat Noir: No problem! I'm great at diverting new audiences.
(Ladybug swings away and Cat Noir goes to the ground to distract the other civilians.)
Cat Noir: Paw-don me! I got info on Ladybug and her kitty cat! (runs away as the civilians chase after him)
Ladybug: According to the Lucky Charm, the solution is supposed to be here. But what is it?
(She uses her Lucky Vision, only to find nothing. Alya sneaks behind her and tackles her from behind.)
Alya: I'm gonna have a bomb scoop for Hoaxer!
(Ladybug throws Alya on the chaise lounge and wraps her yo-yo around her, and also finding out how to use her Lucky Charm, as her Lucky Vision highlights Alya. She quickly runs to Alya and removes her takes off her Alliance, relieving her of Hoaxer's influence.)
Alya: What's going o—
(Ladybug hushes her, carries her in her arms and swings out of her room. They arrive on the rooftop safely.)
Ladybug: Spots off!
(She de-transforms into Marinette and immediately removes her earrings, to Alya's surprise.)

title: Revelation/Transcript
text:
Revelation/Transcript - Intro
Alya: Hey— What are you doing??
Marinette: I need Scarabella to set a trap for Hoaxer!
(She gives her earrings to Alya, along with Tikki in her hands. Alya nods in agreement.)
Cat Noir: Let go of me!
(Hoaxer steps out in one of the Alliances.)
Monarch: (from his lair) Well done, Hoaxer! Cat Noir's Miraculous is a good start!
(Hoaxer grins.)
Hoaxer: Revelation! (Nathalie's eyes turn red, brainwashing her.) Gabriel Agreste is an alien who hid his flying saucer under the pyramid of the Louvre. He must have other secrets hidden inside his house. Without ever letting him see you, you will use your smartphone, NOT your Alliance, to deliver them to me. And then, you will erase any trace of that transmission. Save the world, dear follower. Reveal Gabriel Agreste's secrets to me!
(Nathalie pushes her monitor and walks towards the secret vault behind her framed photo with Gabriel and Emilie. She opens it to grab the phone inside and begins taking a picture of every content inside the vault.)
Cat Noir: It's you and me now, Hoaxer!
Hoaxer: (teleports in front of Cat Noir) Does this look like a tète-à-tète to you, pussy cat?

title: Revelation/Transcript
text:
Revelation/Transcript - Intro
Monarch: (from his lair) Ladybug shouldn't be long now and all the Miraculous will be mine!
Marinette: (standing on top of a car) Lila! I'm the one you want! Here I am!
Cat Noir: No! What are you doing?!
Cat Noir: (reads the message to himself) "Cat Noir, it's okay. She's going to help us trick Hoaxer."
Scarabella: (continues to type the message to Cat Noir from behind a chimney) I'm hiding. As soon as I catch her with my yo-yo, get ready to Cataclysm her ring. (closes her bug phone)
Marinette: You're right, Lila. I never liked you. I always thought you were a liar. But this has gone too far. I never wanted you to get akumatized. This has nothing to do with the people of Paris, or Ladybug and Cat Noir. You don't need to make everyone suffer because of me. If you want to talk, I'm ready to listen. (goes down from the cartop) Just you and me.
Cat Noir: Wow... I love that girl!
Hoaxer: You're right, Marinette. I should've had the courage to do that without resorting to superpowers given to me by a supervillain. I was desperate! But the fact that you're giving me another chance gives me hope!

title: Revelation/Transcript
text:
Revelation/Transcript - Intro
(Marinette looks surprised at her sudden change of heart. Hoaxer then rejects the Megakuma, de-akumatizing herself.)
Monarch: (from his lair) No!!
(Lila is seen grinning while crouching on the floor after de-akumatizing herself. Scarabella looks at the purified butterfly flying away.)
Scarabella: Miraculous Scarabella! (tosses the sewing machine in the air and relieves all the civilians from Hoaxer's influence, as well as reverting all the damages caused by the villain)
Cat Noir: (sitting on the lamppost; to himself) Pound it, m'Lady!
Marinette: (looks up to the rooftops;to herself) Pound it, Alya!
(Scarabella flees.)
Monarch: Dark wings, fall.
(He de-transforms into Gabriel.)
Gabriel: Marinette Dupain-Cheng, it's always Marinette Dupain-Cheng! You will pay for this!!
Adrien: I'm sorry, Marinette. I was wrong. I shouldn't have told you to act against Lila. If you give the slightest opportunity to people like her, they'll grasp at it and cause disasters in no time. And now, you're the one who looks like a bad person.

title: Revelation/Transcript
text:
Revelation/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (reaches out to hold his hand beside her) You thought you were doing the right thing. Just like with Chloe. That's another reason why I love you, Adrien. You always want to see the good in other people. But sometimes, the good we think we see in some people is just a reflection of our own, and we end up being fooled by our own kindness. (They squeeze each other's hands.) But we'll find a way to expose Lila eventually.
Ms. Bustier: Here is the result of the vote: unanimously elected, Lila and Chloé!
Lila: Thank you for giving me a chance, and in second chances, like me!
(Chloé lets out a forced smile. The whole class applaud the two of them.)
Alya: (to Marinette, nudging her on her arm) I told you she was a nice girl. She rejected her Megakuma. That's proof enough, right? I'm glad you decided to trust her.
Marinette: No. I decided to let her have her way so I can finally prove to you all who she really is.
(Alya looks at her with worry in her eyes.)
Lila: Your secrets are mine, and soon I'll have your Miraculous, Monarch. (closes the locker door)
es:Revelación/Transcripción
pl:Sensacja/Transkrypt

title: Revolution/Transcript
text:
Revolution/Transcript - Intro
[ Theme Song ]
Chloé: Starting today, super-offenders Monarch, Ladybug and Cat Noir are outlawed.
Nadja: But... will this last long?
Chloé: Of course.
Cerise: (through Chloé's earpiece) No, of course not!
Chloé: Uh— of course not. We'll be holding a "decromatic" election. A "decratomic"— I will speak later in a meeting!
Chloé: (from the broadcast) In the meantime, my new robots will be upholding Chloé's law in Paris.
(Upon closing her Bugphone, the Tsurugi robots that are under Chloé's control are seen roaming around the streets of Paris)
Cat Noir: Shall we go?
Ladybug: We can't do that.
Cat Noir: Of course, we can! We have to! We can't let Chloé make up the rules.
Ladybug: If she were akumatized, it'd be easy. Find the object, break it, de-evilize her.
Cat Noir: But there is no object, and we can't attack someone who isn't akumatized, or we'd look like the supervillains.
Ladybug: Surely someone will handle the situation.
Cat Noir: You're right. Adults, an authority figure.
Ladybug: And we carry on playing our role: fighting Monarch.
''(Ladybug and Cat Noir both hold out their fists and bump it with each other and flee)
Ladybug: (off-screen) Spots off!

title: Revolution/Transcript
text:
Revolution/Transcript - Intro
(After de-transforming into Marinette, she feeds Tikki with a macaron in her room. She then opens her monitor to watch the news. Several Parisians are being interviewed from the broadcast)
Young Woman: Finally, someone young, like us, representing us!
Ticket Inspector: Superheroes are useless anyway. They've never been able to stop Monarch. And who knows? Maybe it's because they've been on his side the whole time!
Woman 1: A teenager at City Hall? That's absurd! She'd do a better job in cleaning her room!
Plagg: Come on, be brave! Holding on to bad news can be like cheese. If you wait too long, it gets stinkier. (eats a piece of camembert)
Adrien: But I'm hoping I'll find a way to convince my father not to send me to London.
Plagg: Marinette is the most amazing girl in the whole universe. You love her and you trust her, don't you?
Adrien: Yes.
Plagg: Then ask her for help. Maybe she'll find the solution you're talking about.
(Adrien's phone rings, showing a call coming from Marinette)
Plagg: It's a sign!
Adrien: You're right! Now's the right time! (answers the call) Marinette, I—
Marinette: (on-call) Have you watched the news?
Adrien: Huh? (grabs the remote and turns on his TV)

title: Revolution/Transcript
text:
Revolution/Transcript - Intro
Man 1: (from the broadcast) She can't be worse than her father.
Man 2: (from the broadcast) Besides, it won't be for long anyway. She said there'll be a "decromatic" election.
Adrien: Don't worry, Marinette. This won't last long. Someone's bound to do something. I need to tell you—
Marinette: (on-call) Yes, you're right. We gotta do something. But what? I'm going to call everyone. We'll figure out that something together. Whoever comes up with an idea first calls the other one back. (hangs up)
(Adrien lets out a frustrated sigh)
Adrien: It'll be the right time another time.
Tomoe: Is Ms. Chloé satisfied with the police robots we provided to City Hall?
Chloé: Yes, very! They're a lot of fun! (commands a robot to bump into Armand, taking the glasses of juice on a tray on his hand) You're fired, Jean-Raoul! These robots are much more competent than you. (grabs a glass of juice from the same tray)
Gabriel: It hasn't been a day since you replaced your father and everything is already resolved. Ladybug, Cat Noir, Monarch, all the super-offenders, as you call them, have disappeared.
Chloé: Yes, well... it's not like it was difficult.

title: Revolution/Transcript
text:
Revolution/Transcript - Intro
(The camera zooms in on Chloé's Alliance, which is seen with a red light blinking)
Gabriel: (from the recording) It hasn't been a day since you replaced (Cerise zooms in to Chloé's briefcase in the recording) your father and everything is already resolved. Ladybug, Cat Noir, Monarch...
Cerise: (through her earpiece) You were great.
Chloé: Of course, I'm great. That's why I'm the new Mayor of Paris.
(Two employees who are seen painting the walls gold are seen behind Chloé. One of them seems to think that Chloé is talking to them)
Employee 1: Did you say something, Ms. Mayor?
Chloé: Why on earth would I want to talk to you? Get lost! You're fired!
(A police robot zooms towards the employee and pushes him out with force)
Monarch: Alliance, please call Ms. Tsurugi. (dials in and reaches Tomoe) Chloé Bourgeois is going to make a mess of everything.
Tomoe: (on-call) Ladybug and Cat Noir won't be left with any choice but to step in.
Monarch: And thinking that (absorbs Pollen's power) they're dealing with just a teenager, they won't dare to use their superpowers.
(Continuing to lay out their diabolical plan, Monarch continues to absorb powers from a few more Kwamis)

title: Revolution/Transcript
text:
Revolution/Transcript - Intro
Tomoe: (on-call) Whereas we won't hesitate to use ours!
Monarch: And we will easily seize their Miraculous! (absorbs Kaalki's powers) Voyage! (steps inside the portal and transports himself in the Mayor's office in City Hall)
Chloé: Oh! You're under arrest, Monarch! (commands the police robots to surround Monarch) Give me your Miraculous!
(Tomoe, from an unknown place, commands the police robots from her very own briefcase, making the police robots "stand down")
Monarch: (puts his hands in the air) It's alright. I'm only here to form an alliance with you, dear Chloé.
Chloé: I'll never form an alliance with a super-offender again. I'm the greatest!
Cerise: (from Chloé's earpiece) Accept his alliance.
Chloé: Ugh, okay, whatever. What's this alliance thing about?
Monarch: No more superpowers for anyone else but you.
Chloé: So, you'll give me your Miraculous?
Monarch: Hmm, if I give you my Miraculous, you'd become a supervillain, yet, you yourself have banned superpowers. How would you look then?
Chloé: (nods) Hm, that's true.

title: Revolution/Transcript
text:
Revolution/Transcript - Intro
Monarch: But I can do much better: I'll keep my Miraculous and put their powers at your service without anyone knowing. This way, you'll have all the powers you want without looking like you do. And you can finally rid us of Ladybug and Cat Noir.
Chloé: (intrigued) I'll be the villain, but I'll look like the hero.
Monarch: Exactly! (unleashes a Megakuma from his cane, letting it fly into Chloé's sash, akumatizing her) Queen Mayor, I'm giving you and your robotic elite guard absolute power.
(Chloé transforms into somewhat her same appearance, but only to have her clothes change as well as the police robots turning from blue into gold.)
Monarch: (while respectively tapping on the corresponding rings...) I'm transferring the powers of Protection, Migration, Determination and Action, as well as the power of Pretension, (...and transmitting them into the police robots) which will allow them to become invincible from now on!
Queen Mayor: And they'll still do everything I want?
Monarch: Absolutely everything!
Tomoe: (from an unknown place) For as long as we need her.
Monarch: (bows) Voyage! (exits through the portal)
Adrien: Today's the day, Plagg. I'm going to tell Marinette everything.

title: Revolution/Transcript
text:
Revolution/Transcript - Intro
(He walks towards the school with newfound determination. Upon arriving in the school courtyard, he is greeted with rally boards parched at the center)
Adrien: Woah...
Nino: This was an idea from Marinette, Alya and Mylène. Those girls got skills, dude!
(Marinette walks towards the boys, with Adrien already having his enamored eyes on her.)
Adrien: That's for sure, Nino.
Marinette: We're not letting Chloé call the shots!
(A limousine and a news truck park outside the school. The limousine door opens and we see Queen Mayor stepping out of the car, sporting her incognito akumatized identity)
Queen Mayor: (while walking into the school alongside reporters) Thanks to me, who rid you of those super-duds, Paris is going to become super-fab again! You'll get to do whatever you want to do and say whatever you want to say.
(Chloé is then greeted by the Resistance, who are chanting:)
Students: Reinstate Miss Bustier the Great! Reinstate Miss Bustier the Great! What do we say? What do we say?
Queen Mayor: What is this?
Zoé: Since we're free to say whatever we want to say, Chloé, we're refusing to go back to class until Miss Bustier and Mr. Damoclès are reinstated as our teacher and principal.

title: Revolution/Transcript
text:
Revolution/Transcript - Intro
Queen Mayor: Ugh— Do you really think I care?!
Cerise: (from Chloé's earpiece) Whoa, whoa! The camera! Don't forget about the camera, Chloé!
Queen Mayor: Oh, sorry! (drags the cameraman with her and points the camera at Zoé) It seems like this girl, who's pretending to be my sister, and her libertarian friends, who'd rather protest than study, intend to take the school hostage in order to force me to reinstate an evil teacher and a principal who thinks he's a superhero.
Mr. Damoclès: (poses) Hoo-hoo! (hides) Uh— oops.
Sabrina: We're not taking the school hostage.
Marinette: We're just protesting!
Chloé: They're not respecting decromancy— detromacy— (groans) You know what I mean!
Ivan: Yeah, we know what democracy is, but you obviously don't!
Mylène: Which is why you better hold the elections ASAP!
Queen Mayor: These two are threatening me also? Ooh, that's not exactly demaquatic of them! People who threaten the Mayor go straight to detention, you know.
Miss Bustier: Chloé, you need to come to your senses.

title: Revolution/Transcript
text:
Revolution/Transcript - Intro
Queen Mayor: (walks up to Bustier) But I never lost my senses, and I'll prove it to you. I remember that you're still fired! (towards the reporters) Uh, I mean, I did what had to be done to protect the children from your negative influence. (walks towards Adrien and Marinette, whom she notices that are hand-in-hand) Ah, Dupain-Cheng... my turn to tell you a secret.
Cerise: (from Queen Mayor's earpiece) No! Not now, Chloé!
Queen Mayor: Uh, I've changed my mind. I'll tell you later. Revenge is a pastry best served cold. Right, baker girl? (walks past Marinette, deliberately bumping into her shoulder)
Mrs. Mendeleiev: The ancestors of the Bourgeois were the ones who discovered the gold that made all the great achievements of this world possible.
(Outside the classroom, Marinette notices two placards placed on the floor which were being held by Ivan and Mylène earlier)
Marinette: Where did Mylène and Ivan go?
Cat Noir: Are we still doing nothing?
Ladybug: Well, it's ugly, but Monarch had nothing to do with it.
Adrien: Today's the day. I'm going to tell Marinette everything.
Marinette: Adrien! Your father knows the Bourgeois family well. You could ask him to do something to stop Chloé.

title: Revolution/Transcript
text:
Revolution/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: Talking to my father won't solve anything. Because right now...
Marinette: Is something wrong with him?
Adrien: Well, my father is—
Queen Mayor: (from a helicopter, holding a megaphone) Hey, you, ice cream man! Did you pay the permit fee to sell your ice cream?!
André: I don't need a permit to sell love in Paris!
Queen Mayor: Well, now you do! Otherwise, you'll end up in detention!
(Queen Mayor's helicopter flies away. Andre gives his last ice cream to Adrien and Marinette)
André: Savor it. It might be my last cone.
Marinette: (grabs the ice cream from Andre) No way, Andre! No one can keep you from bringing everyone so much happiness.
(Adrien walks to Nino, who is currently calling Alya)
Adrien: You okay, Nino?
Nino: Yeah, dude. It's just that Alya was supposed to meet us, but she's not answering her phone.
(Adrien and Marinette have their eyes furrowed)
Marinette: (putting her helmet on a counter nearby) Where are my parents?!
Queen Mayor: (while chewing on her chouquettes) In detention! They wanted to make me pay for the chouquettes.
Marinette: Detention? What are you talking about? Dad? Mom?

title: Revolution/Transcript
text:
Revolution/Transcript - Intro
Queen Mayor: Oh, you miss them already? Why don't you go join them... in detention?!
(An elite police robot appears behind Marinette and immobilizes her with Venom, then teleports her in "detention", as how Queen Mayor puts it. Queen Mayor throws in her last piece of chouquette in her mouth)
Marinette's voicemail: It's Marinette! Leave a message. Beep!
Plagg: You two are definitely having a hard time communicating lately.
Adrien: She must be home. It'd be better to tell her in person anyway.
Adrien: Is anyone here? (gasps upon seeing Marinette's helmet on the counter) Marinette?
(Going back outside, he sees Andre's ice cream cart gets pushed by the air and bouncing on a gutter, stopping it from moving. Perplexed, he scowls at this sight as a leaflet of Chloé floats towards him and gapes.)
Adrien: Chloé!
Adrien: What have you done?!

title: Revolution/Transcript
text:
Revolution/Transcript - Intro
Queen Mayor: Adri-nothing! It took you long enough! Oh, I know what you're going to say. (mocks Adrien) "Meanie Chloé, I hope you didn't do anything to the baker girl!" Oh, I'm so terrified I'll get punished! (blinks innocently and cackles) Kidding! I couldn't care less, and there's nothing Adri-traitor can do! Otherwise, I'll tell Dupain-Cheng that he's been lying to her, that he didn't tell her he was going to London to obey his daddy like a nice little puppet!
(Adrien is left jawdropped)
Queen Mayor: That's right! I know everything. But it can remain our secret, you know. You just have to do whatever I want, and to start with, I want you to be my Deputy Mayor!
Adrien: You're out of your mind, Chloé.
Queen Mayor: I can have anything I want. Even you. Unless you'd rather I told the truth to the baker girl.
Adrien: You know what? I'm going to tell Marinette myself.
Queen Mayor: You want to join her? You should thank me 'cause I'm about to grant your wish!
(A police robot appears behind Adrien and immobilizes him, the same way it did with Marinette at the bakery)
Queen Mayor: Detention for the traitor!
(Adrien is sucked into the portal and gets teleported away.)

title: Revolution/Transcript
text:
Revolution/Transcript - Intro
Queen Mayor: (from the red screens) Ridiculous! You'll always be ridiculous!
(An elite police robot escorts a group of Parisians that are held hostage, including former Mayor André Bourgeois)
Robot: Detention. You're in detention. Find a corner to sit in and you can get out.
Queen Mayor: (from the screens, now white) I will always be there for you; you can count on me.
André: But there is no corner here! We're walking and walking and going in circles!
Queen Mayor: (from the screen, now red again) Ridiculous! You'll always be ridiculous!
Adrien: How did Chloé pull this off? (runs around) Marinette? Marinette!
Queen Mayor: (from the screens, white again) I will always be there for you; you can count on me.
(The scene cuts to Marinette walking alongside Alya.)
Adrien: (off-screen) Marinette!
Marinette: (hears Adrien at last) Adrien? Adrien!
Queen Mayor: (from the screens; red) Ridiculous! You'll always be ridiculous!
(They keep searching for each other by calling their names out loud. Seeing that there's no use from yelling out to find the source of their voices, Marinette comes up with a plan after noticing two roaming elite police robots coming their way.)

title: Revolution/Transcript
text:
Revolution/Transcript - Intro
Queen Mayor: (from the screens; white) I will always be there for you; you can count on me.
Marinette: (to Alya) Let's pretend like we're trying to destroy those screens.
(Marinette proceeds to a nearby the screen and attempts to break it off the wall. Adrien does the same as well from his respective place by kicking a screen to let it fall)
Queen Mayor: (from the screens; red) Ridiculous! You'll always be ridiculous!
Plagg: Put my mind at ease. You haven't forgotten that I can give you superpowers, have you?
Adrien: No, but I need a diversion so I can use them. (continues to kick the screen)
(The elite police robots start shooting rubber balls at Marinette and Adrien after noticing their attempt on destroying the screens. On Adrien's side, the screen already falls off, giving him the chance to hide behind it and transform)
Queen Mayor: (from the screens, white) I will always be there for you; you can count on me.
Adrien: (voice only) Plagg, claws out! (transforms into Cat Noir)
Cat Noir: Cataclysm! (uses his power to break through the floor, creating a hole that leads him down the sewers)
Queen Mayor: (from the screens; red) Ridiculous! You'll always be ridiculous!

title: Revolution/Transcript
text:
Revolution/Transcript - Intro
(Back at detention, André, alongside Agent Roger, found the hole that Cat Noir created)
André: We found a way out! (enters the hole, alongside Roger and more people to come)
Queen Mayor: (from the screens; white) I will always be there for you; you can count on me.
(On the other side, Alya is on the lookout as Marinette transforms behind her broken screen)
Queen Mayor: (from the screens; red) Ridiculous! You'll always be ridiculous!
Marinette: (voice only) Tikki, spots on! (transforms into Ladybug)
(Ladybug swings out to the roofs from what is revealed to be Stade des Princes, where Queen Mayor set her "detention" — a maze built in an endless loop)
Queen Mayor: (from the screens, white) I will always be there for you; you can count on me.
Queen Mayor: Everyone will agree that within a few days, I've made Paris better than it was before. Utterly better! So, if there were an election today, who would feel justified in running against me?

title: Revolution/Transcript
text:
Revolution/Transcript - Intro
(The camera pans to Audrey, watching her daughter with pride, with Queen Mayor's supporters, who are dressed up as Chloé, behind her; Gabriel and Tomoe, with their plans finally coming into place; and the students of Françoise Dupont, who are watching her with disgust on their faces)
Queen Mayor: No one!
(Ladybug and Cat Noir arrive on the scene from a nearby rooftop)
Cat Noir: Now we step in, right?
Ladybug: Yes, we step in! But she won't take us by surprise this time.
[Superpower Sequence]
Ladybug: Lucky Charm!
(receives a pair of underwear)
(Ladybug looks at her Lucky Charm with embarrassed wide eyes.)
Cat Noir: A mira-kini? My power can't compete with your creativity, m'Lady. Cataclysm!
(With their powers activated, the two heroes jump in to put a stop to Queen Mayor.)
Queen Mayor: So, we all agree. There's no need to hold an election.
Ladybug: No, we disagree!
(The crowd cheers upon seeing Ladybug and Cat Noir, who standing on top of the Louvre)
Queen Mayor: You see? I was right all along.
(In the shadows, Cerise is seen to be coaching Chloé behind the scenes through their earpieces)
Cerise: They have no respect for democracy.

title: Revolution/Transcript
text:
Revolution/Transcript - Intro
Queen Mayor: They have no respect for detromacy! And— and— and— and then they use their superpowers to steal my power!
Gabriel: (whispering to Tomoe) Now is the moment of truth, Tsurugi-san.
Ladybug: The only power that has value, Chloé, is the power that we use for the common good of the people, and you (points to her) only use your power for yourself.
Cat Noir: (raises his hand) Who wants an election to get rid of a dictator?
(The majority of the crowd, and the Resistance raises their hands, agreeing with Cat Noir, which worries Queen Mayor)
Ladybug: It's time we teach you how to say the word correctly, Chloé. De-mo-cra-cy!
(The two heroes slide down the Louvre pyramid and leap into action, only to get encapsulated by two shields created by the power of the Turtle Miraculous, causing them to fall onto the stage. Losing hold of the Lucky Charm, it fades away as it touches the shield, to Ladybug's shock)
Ladybug: (gasps) Cat Noir! The Lucky Charm has disintegrated!
Cat Noir: Let me try! (attempts to break the shield with his powers, only to fail) My Cataclysm isn't working either!

title: Revolution/Transcript
text:
Revolution/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: It's as if the power of Protection had been mixed with the power of invulnerability to create these prisons!
Cat Noir: Miraculous powers?
Ladybug: Monarch!
Queen Mayor: So, who's got all the powers now? I do! I said no one could have superpowers because they're all just for me! (cackles and activates more elite police robots, pointing them at the crowd and at the two heroes)
Gabriel: (to Tomoe) Stand ready to regain control of the robots. Ladybug and Cat Noir are about to transform back. (Tomoe opens her briefcase.) I will take care of de-akumatizing Chloé, then the Miraculous will finally be ours!
(Tomoe subtly smirks)
Queen Mayor: I won! I'm the greatest! There's nothing you can do now because I'm akumatized!
(Ladybug gasps)
Cat Noir: It twists my whiskers to say so, m'Lady, but I don't think she's wrong. We are kinda stuck here.
Ladybug: We've been waiting for someone to do something from the start but... we were wrong, Cat Noir. It's not up to someone to do something, it's up to everyone! Everyone has to act!
(Both their Miraculous start to trill, initiating the countdown of their de-transformation)
Alya: (gasps; turns to Nino and Zoé) They're going to transform back!

title: Revolution/Transcript
text:
Revolution/Transcript - Intro
(Their costumes begin to fade quickly. Cat Noir immediately covers his hand, as well as Ladybug)
Ladybug: No! Not now! Not yet!
(With heavy grunts, the two heroes try their best to slow down their de-transformation. But Ladybug does it harder, as her de-transformation seems to be indeed slowing down)
Cat Noir: M'Lady, your de-transformation is slowing down!
Ladybug: (opens her eyes and realizes Cat Noir's words are true) You can resist, too! We need more time!
(Cat Noir attempts to slow down his de-transformation as per Ladybug)
Ladybug: (towards the crowd of Parisians) We only have a few seconds left until we transform back! We won't be able to be superheroes again. You're going to have to keep fighting without us. You can do it because you've already been doing it this whole time... by supporting us. Some did it by being Miraculous holders anonymously by our side! You all did it— by not giving in to fear! Despite Monarch's constant threats, if anyone can do something, it's all of you! It's always been you!
Mylène: She's right! We have to do something!
Max: But we're not superheroes!
Kim: We'll see about that!
Mr. Damoclès: (dressed up as Knightowl) Time for the Owl! Hoo-hoo!

title: Revolution/Transcript
text:
Revolution/Transcript - Intro
Nino: You're right! Comrades of the Resistance, it's time to come out of the shadows!
(Each member of the Resistance shout out their respective codenames)
(The two heroes continue to make efforts to stop their de-transformation. Unfortunately, their efforts seem to be failing as their costumes fade ceaselessly)
Cat Noir: It was an immense pleasure knowing you, Ladybug. Well, not knowing you really because it looks like I'm going to get to know you soon. (grunts) Shoot! I'm completely botching my last superhero lines, m'Lady. Cracking jokes was all I was ever good for.
Ladybug: You were perfect, Kitty Cat.
(Cat Noir holds out his bare fist, as well as Ladybug, and they perform their last "pound it" against their prisons before they completely de-transform in front of the crowd. But shortly after...)
Kim: Super Underpants!
(...the Resistance make their move by making an ambush on stage, surrounding a shocked Queen Mayor. This brings a smile to Ladybug and Cat Noir's faces. The crowd then pushes down the control barriers holding them back and a fracas ensues. This doesn't seem to go according to Gabriel and Tomoe's plan, after all.)
Tomoe: What is going on here— AH! No!

title: Revolution/Transcript
text:
Revolution/Transcript - Intro
(A person bumps into Tomoe's back, causing the briefcase to nudge from her hands. But realizing there was no use continuing with their plan on double-crossing Chloé, Gabriel and Tomoe run off from the crowd. Next to them, Audrey screams, running off in her own direction)
Gabriel: Come!
(Cerise is still seen hiding behind a wall, waiting for the perfect time to execute her own schemes. Back on the stage, the Parisians fight off the police robots and cornering Queen Mayor as well)
Queen Mayor: Attack them! Put them in detention!
(Some people get encapsulated, but some fight back against the robots by pointing one of them at the other robots)
Ladybug: Cat Noir, we have to do like them! We have to keep fighting!
Cat Noir: They're not giving up, and we're not giving up!
Ladybug: We won't de-transform back! Ever again!
Cat Noir: Never again!
(And with their efforts finally paying off, as Ladybug and Cat Noir regain both their powers back and transform back into their superhero identities, as well as fully charging their Miraculous)
Gabriel: How are they doing this?! Why aren't they transforming back, Nooroo?!
Nooroo: You don't transform back either.

title: Revolution/Transcript
text:
Revolution/Transcript - Intro
Gabriel: I am an adult! Not transforming back is a power belonging to grown-ups!
Nooroo: I guess they must have grown up, Master.
Gabriel: No! (he and Tomoe run off)
(Back on the stage...)
Queen Mayor: (to one of the robots that got encapsulated) You're ridiculous! Utterly ridiculous! (notices the crowd forming a circle around her) Ah!
Miss Bustier: (waltzes towards her) It's time for this to stop, Chloé!
Ladybug: (to the teacher) The Megakuma must be in her sash!
Miss Bustier: No more evil-doing for you! (takes Queen Mayor's sash and rips it in half, releasing the Megakuma and powering down the robots, as well as breaking the Shell-ters that trapped Ladybug, Cat Noir, and everyone else)
Cat Noir: (as he breaks the police robots one by one) Cataclysm! Cataclysm! Cataclysm! Cataclysm!
Ladybug: (opens her yo-yo) Time to de-evilize! (captures the Megakuma) Gotcha! (opens her yo-yo once more to release the purified butterfly) Bye-bye, little butterfly!

title: Revolution/Transcript
text:
Revolution/Transcript - Intro
(Queen Mayor de-transforms back into Chloé. On her knees, she looks up in defeat, and sees all those who once had hope that she would change for the better look down at her furiously, fed up with her antics for the very last time. Ladybug takes a deep breath, a little hesitation on her face hinting whether she should give her a Magical Charm, and proceeds to open her yo-yo shortly after to do so, only to be stopped by André)
André: Leave it to me. It is time I corrected my own errors. (drags Chloé away with him)
Chloé: Let me go! I haven't lost yet! I still have my robots!
(And finally now being the perfect time, Cerise grabs hold of Tomoe's briefcase, now gaining control over the police robots. Back at the Louvre, fireworks are set off into the night sky — a celebration for their successful revolution against Chloé's dictatorship)
Nino: Yes! We're finally free from Chloé the Brat!
Alya: Paris needs to find itself a new mayor.
Kim: Ooh! But how are we going to do that?
Miss Bustier: Well, we'll just put democracy in motion. The citizens are going to hold an election.
Mylène: That's a great idea! I'm sure that the people of Paris would love to have a mayor like you!

title: Revolution/Transcript
text:
Revolution/Transcript - Intro
Miss Bustier: (gasps) But I can't. I'm just a teacher!
Marinette: No, she's right! You'd be amazing!
Nino: We'll help you with your campaign, Comrade— I mean, Miss Bustier!
(Miss Bustier smiles at her students gleefully.)
Rose: Oh! This calls for a celebration!
Zoé: Perfect timing! The end of the school year dance is tonight!
Marinette: I have to go home and change. I'll meet you back on the Eiffel Tower!
(Upon Marinette's departure, Adrien's smile fades, realizing that he hasn't told Marinette that he'll leave for London on the same night)
Adrien: (towards his friends, with a forced smile) Same with me. See you later!
Audrey: Because of you, we've lost face! You've ruined our name and our reputation! You had all the powers in your hands and you foolishly lost them! Bourgeois do not raise losers. You think you're going to London on vacation? Dream on! I'm going to take control of your life again, starting with your education.

title: Revolution/Transcript
text:
Revolution/Transcript - Intro
(Unable to stand another word, Chloé unbuckles her seatbelt and runs to the back of the plane, sitting alone in red light. She opens her Alliance and scrolls through her list of contacts, and stops to look at her contact photo of Sabrina, and her expression softens as she becomes lost in thought. However, said expression hardens once more, as she starts to scroll again and stops on Marinette, now sporting a devious smirk)
Gabriel: Go pack your bags. The plane to London leaves in an hour.
Adrien: Dad, tonight's the end-of-the-school-year dance—
Gabriel: Adrien, I am your father, and I refuse to hear another word!
(Adrien runs off hopelessly. In his room, he packs his things on the verge of crying)
Plagg: Your powers have evolved. Do you realize what this means? You've grown up! You're stronger now!
Adrien: I wish it were true, Plagg. I'll try to believe it is anyway... for you... and for Marinette.
(Adrien goes down the stairs with his luggage and stops by a despaired Nathalie)
Nathalie: You cannot disobey your father, but don't let anyone stop you from loving who you want.

title: Revolution/Transcript
text:
Revolution/Transcript - Intro
(Adrien has nothing else to reply but to sigh in frustration. He walks outside the mansion, and doors shut with a loud thud)
Adrien: Father, please, I know what I want. Let me live my life here in Paris with Marinette and my friends.
Gabriel: You must go through with this life like an Agreste. That's what your mother would have wanted.
(Adrien revolts with tears, shedding in his eyes)
Adrien: No! I'm sure that Mom would have just wanted me to be happy!
(Gabriel doesn't respond. The car stops for a moment and Adrien forcefully attempts to open the car door. But to no avail, the door is completely locked, sending Adrien to tears. The car continues to move again. Now with nothing else to do, Adrien brings out his phone to call Marinette and tell her everything once and for all. Marinette answers the call after a few seconds)
Marinette: (on the video call) Adrien!
Adrien: (voice breaking; in tears) Marinette, I should've told you sooner, but... up until the last minute, I thought I'd find a solution. I tried everything, I swear.
Marinette: (on the video call) Adrien, what's... what's going on?

title: Revolution/Transcript
text:
Revolution/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: I have to leave Paris. (his voice breaks) I'm not worthy of your love. I feel terrible for hurting you.
Adrien: (on-call) I'm sorry.
(With Adrien hanging up, Marinette drops to her knees and begins to cry. A tear drops on the lucky charm on her hand — the very same lucky charm Adrien has given her)
Marinette: (crying) I made you a promise, Adrien, remember? Well, I'm going to keep it! I'll never abandon you! (runs off, with Tikki flying behind her)
Tomoe: (on-call) We have sold enough Alliances. Everywhere in the world, people are now at our mercy.
Gabriel: Once Kagami and Adrien are safe in London...
(Inside the plane, the Gorilla buckles Adrien's seatbelt. He seems to feel bad while doing so, with nothing else to do against bringing back Adrien's freedom to be with the love of his life)
Gabriel: ...we will launch "Operation: Perfect Alliance".
(But then...)
Marinette: (off-screen) Adrien!
(Both Adrien and his bodyguard gasp at the sight of Marinette chasing him to the plane on her scooter while also being tailed by an airport technician)
Airport technician: Stop! You're not allowed to be here!
Marinette: Adrien!

title: Revolution/Transcript
text:
Revolution/Transcript - Intro
(In the plane, the Gorilla quickly unbuckles Adrien's seatbelt and gestures to him to go see Marinette for the very last time. Adrien then quickly runs out of the plane, with Marinette also quickly mounting down her scooter to run towards Adrien. They meet on the plane's stairs, grab each other by the arms and pull each other to share a bittersweet kiss — one where neither of them wants to let go of each other, that nothing will come between them. But alas...)
Gabriel: (to the airport technician, stepping out the car) You! Separate them!

title: Revolution/Transcript
text:
Revolution/Transcript - Intro
(The airport technician does as he is told, pulling Marinette away from Adrien. The Gorilla does the same, pulling Adrien away from Marinette. They never wanted to break the kiss, but as the Gorilla and the airport technician continued to pull them apart, they couldn't do anything but let each other go. The thought of being inseparable becomes nothing after they lose hold of each other as the Gorilla and the airport technician successfully pull them apart. The plane's door closes shut, leaving a crying Adrien on the plane seat. The Gorilla sympathizes with him and gives him the lucky charm that Marinette gave him. He clutches it tightly in his hands as he sobs. The plane departs, leaving Marinette alone in the runway with a broken heart)
Marinette: (Irritated) Watch it, Chloé. I'm not in the mood.
Chloé: (on the plane) Good! Remember the secret I wanted to tell you? Well, guess what? Adrien's moving to London! None of you will ever see him again, and you will suffer! You're ridiculous! Utterly—

title: Revolution/Transcript
text:
Revolution/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Be quiet, Chloé. I already know your little secret. I know because Adrien told me. I also know that he loves me, and there's nothing you can do about it. Nothing! You've lost any and ALL power over us. You're the one who's ridiculous, Chloé. Utterly ridiculous. Enjoy your trip. (hangs up)
(With all her bullying backfiring at her, Chloé starts to burst into tears, crying that she has truly lost everything while inside their private plane)
es:Revolución/Transcripción

title: Representation/Transcript
text:
Representation/Transcript - Intro
[ Theme Song ]
News anchor: (from the broadcast) God save the Queen! Now that their former mayor has resigned, Parisians are holding a new election and — surprise, they have a candidate who might actually go the distance. Her name is Miss Bustier and she's a French teacher. Like all candidates before her, she will be running against Mr. Armand D'Argencourt. So, good luck to them and Vive la France! But the big news today is the London arrival of the Royal Couple of Fashion: Adrien Agreste and his perfect love, Kagami Tsurugi, heiress to the Tsurugi Industries. Did the capital of love eat too many frogs that let its famous sweethearts go overseas? Let's see some pictures!
(The camera zooms out and slowly shows that Adrien is watching the broadcast.)
