Adrien: (from the broadcast) Kagami is the greatest love of my life. You only love once — the first time, and it's forever.
(He seems to disapprove at his own statement.)
Adrien: How did I get into this mess?

title: Representation/Transcript
text:
Representation/Transcript - Intro
Plagg: (while smudging his foot on the plastic covering an English cheese) By letting your father decide your future and selling your life story through a fake narrative, as usual! (Adrien deeply sighs.) Forgive me, I was a bit harsh.
(In another room, Kagami is also seen watching the news broadcast and sees herself saying:)
Kagami: (from the broadcast) Ever since I became the muse of the Agreste brand, and Adrien and I fell in love, my life has been nothing but perfect!
(She revolts to it as well)
Kagami: (growls) Lies!
(She was about to throw the remote control towards the television when someone knocks at the window — Argos. Kagami smiles at this sight. Argos, on the other hand, breathes on the glass window and draws a heart, to Kagami's amusement. She runs towards the window and joins Argos to escape. In the other room, Adrien comes up with a plan.)
Adrien: (walks to the glass window) I can never seem to go against my father. But I won't give up my love for Marinette! I could go see her as often as I want... as Astrocat!
Plagg: And how will you explain this incredible ability of yours — making the London-Paris trip so often?!

title: Representation/Transcript
text:
Representation/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: I'll just have to tell her that I'm Cat Noir! (opens the window and runs out)
Plagg: WHAT?! You can't! What about—
Adrien: Plagg, claws out!
Plagg: ...your secret identit— (screams as he gets sucked inside his ring)
(As Adrien transforms into Cat Noir, he jumps out the hotel balcony and transforms himself into Astrocat to fly back to Paris.)
Cat Noir: Power up!
Tikki: (worried) Marinette, are you sure you want to go...?
Marinette: We fought so hard for a happy ending, Tikki. (wipes her tears) We have to go to this dance, if only for my friends' sake.
Tikki: You're so brave... Is there anything I can do?
Marinette: Do you know a surefire trick to keep from crying?
Tikki: If I did, I'd use it on myself.
(After a few reassurances from Tikki, Marinette steps inside the elevator. Going up, she tries her best to hold back her tears)
Marinette: (breathes deeply) I won't cry. I won't cry. (fans her face with both her hands as she holds back her tears) I won't cry. With a little luck, no one will even notice me.
(Stepping out the elevator, a spotlight opens, directing at her)

title: Representation/Transcript
text:
Representation/Transcript - Intro
Nino: (off-screen) Let's give it up for the girl who organized this awesome night with Zoé, make some noise for Marinette!
(The other students in the venue start to cheer upon Marinette's entrance. As the party continues on, Argos and Kagami arrive on the tower as well)
Argos: What if it's not actually her?
Kagami: I couldn't believe it either at first.
Marinette: I'm petrified at the thought of doing something careless again and losing my Miraculous because I won't be focused on my mission!
(End of flashback.)
Kagami: But that's the only possible explanation.
(On the venue grounds, Marinette meets up with her classmates.)
Argos: (off-screen) Do you think she can be trusted?
Kagami: She's my friend. We don't have a choice. (holds hands with Argos) My mother and Gabriel Agreste will never allow us to love each other freely. Only Ladybug can help us.
(As Argos smiles, the two of them share a kiss before Argos jumps below to de-transform.)
Argos: Fold my feathers.
(He de-transforms to Félix whilst disguising himself as Adrien. He walks casually into the party, where Miss Bustier gives Marinette a bouquet of flowers.)
Miss Bustier: Thank you, Marinette! Without you...

title: Representation/Transcript
text:
Representation/Transcript - Intro
(As Miss Bustier continues to thank her, Marinette sees "Adrien" at a distance.)
Miss Bustier: I never would've had the courage to run for Mayor!
Marinette: Oh! You're welcome, Miss Bustier! We've always been an inspiration to you— I-I mean, the opposite! (bumps on Ivan)
Ivan: She took up our ecological proposals in her program! (gives Marinette a tight hug)
Mylène: (gives Marinette a small piece of log with a ribbon) Thanks to you, if Miss Bustier is elected, there will be more trees, less cars — the planet will breathe!
Marinette: (walks away backwards from Ivan and Mylène) I'm happy that the planet gets to breathe. But right now, I'm the one who can't breathe! (runs) Adrien!
(Marinette hurriedly runs through the crowd, bumping into numerous people along the way.)
Mylène: Are you sure you're okay, Marinette?
Kim: You don't look too good right now!
Marinette: (skittishly) Me? Not looking too good? What are you talking about? I'm here, totally here! I've got a bouquet, a crown, a log, and I'm dancing! Woohoo! Oh wow, speaking of which, why don't I go try out that trampoline? Hop-hop! See ya!
(She continues to run after "Adrien", but this time, she bumps into Zoé.)

title: Representation/Transcript
text:
Representation/Transcript - Intro
Zoe: Oh, Marinette! We did it! Did you see this? The dance is incredible!
Marinette: Yes, yeah! Totally, Zoé! I'll be right back.
(Marinette continues to run before being running into Marc and Nathaniel mid-affection.)
Marc: (startled) Marinette?
Marinette: Oh, sorry! Did you see him? Adrien... he was right there!
Nathaniel: Adrien? But—
Marc: Marinette, are you crying?
Marinette: Who, me? (hides her face behind the bouquet she's holding) Of course not! Adrien!
(She runs over to where she sees "Adrien" walk by. She slumps down against the railing of the Eiffel Tower before attempting to call Adrien.)
Marinette: (dejected) There's no way... (sits on the floor and attempts to contact Adrien)
Adrien's voicemail: Hello! You've reached Adrien's voicemail, leave a message!
(Ironically, fireworks blast behind Marinette whilst her crestfallen mood.)
Alya: Marinette, stop. You're just hurting yourself. You know he's in London.
Marinette: What if he's come home? What if he disobeyed his father to come... (voice breaks) and find me?
Nino: London isn't that far! We'll find a way to go and visit him.
Alya: You have the right to be sad, Marinette. This is anything but the ending we expected.

title: Representation/Transcript
text:
Representation/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Oh! I just remembered! (stands up) I forgot a giant cookie that I made for the party! So, I'm going to go get it! I'll be right back!
(Marinette runs away along the Eiffel Tower's loggia.)
Alya: That was the worst lie she's ever fed me.
Gabriel: (furious) How could they disappear?
Tomoe: (on-call) That your son should disobey you, Gabriel, that does not surprise me. But my own daughter? Akumatize me!
Gabriel: No! (hangs up) I'll take care of this.
Emilie: (from the video) All I want is for Adrien to be free.
Gabriel: Nathalie, Adrien is no longer in London. Where is he?
﻿Nathalie: I don't know where he's gone. But the farther away he is from you, the better.
Gabriel: I was wrong to entrust my son to you. You are unworthy of upholding the legacy of the Agrestes. I am his father and I'm the only one my son will obey.
﻿Nathalie: He's bound to escape you someday.
Gabriel: Marinette Dupain-Cheng. Well, I'm sure he went to find her.
Monarch: (empowers a butterfly and transforms it into a Megakuma) I'm going to need your help to find my son, dear Megakuma. ﻿Kaalki, (her pod flies towards Monarch) your power is now mine! (absorbs her power) Dark wings fall.

title: Representation/Transcript
text:
Representation/Transcript - Intro
(He de-transforms into Gabriel and takes out a pen)
Gabriel: My son, ﻿if you no longer respect your father's authority, ﻿then get ready to face that of Nightormentor!
(The megakuma flies into the pen and Gabriel transforms into Nightormentor)
Nightormentor: I guess all I have to do to find you is to find her... Marinette.
Marinette: Adrien! (sees "Adrien going down the stairs a little bit farther from her) Adrien? Adrien! Adrien! (continues to rush down the stairs) Wait!
(The perfect timing — as soon as Marinette goes to chase after "Adrien" down the road, Astrocat arrives on the Eiffel Tower.)
Astrocat: Power down! (reverts himself back to Cat Noir)
(On the venue grounds...)
Mylène: Poor Marinette... She looks so sad.
Alya: Hey, guys! (runs towards the others with Nino and pants) She's gone.
(The gang collectively gasps in shock, as well as Cat Noir who is quickly saddened with the news whilst perched on one of the tower's beams.)
Cat Noir: Marinette...
Ivan: You can't blame her for not being in a party mood.
Nino: And Adrien? He's our buddy. W-Why didn't he tell us anything? We would have helped him. His father can't have that much control over his life.

title: Representation/Transcript
text:
Representation/Transcript - Intro
(A sudden burst of pink dust showers over them and reveals Nightormentor.)
Nightormentor: Where is Marinette Dupain-Cheng?! Where is my son, Adrien?
Cat Noir: Dad...?
Alya: Mr. Agreste?
Nightormentor: No, I am Nightormentor! And if you don't want me to awaken your worst nightmares, you'd better answer my questions. My son is with your friend, isn't he? You're protecting them!
Nino: Dude, your son is in London!
Mylène: You sent him there yourself!
Rose: And you shouldn't be so proud of what you're doing to your own son!
(Cat Noir jumps in the scene.)
Cat Noir: Need a little parental counseling?
Nightormentor: I take counsel from no one! You, little kitty, like my son, could use a demonstration on how to obey your superior!
Cat Noir: Seems to me that it's the father who's in need of a little demonstration right now.
(The battle ensues — Nightormentor begins firing bolts of pink dust at Cat Noir, but the feline superhero evades every single one of his attacks)
Kim: Yeah! Get him, Cat Noir!
(Upon dodging one of the bolts pink dust, one of them hits Rose and awakens her greatest nightmare)
Rose: (as she collapses on her knees) No! NO! NOOO!

title: Representation/Transcript
text:
Representation/Transcript - Intro
(And her greatest nightmare is awakened — a rainbow unicorn dying. Juleka runs towards Rose to her rescue.)
Juleka: What did you do to her?
Nightormentor: (while evading Cat Noir's every blow) Her worst nightmare is awakening! But I can rid her of it if you answer my simple question: Where are Adrien and Marinette?
Juleka: Never!
(With no other choice, Nightormentor shoots pink dust at Juleka and awakens her nightmare — Jagged Stone yelling at her and breaking her bass guitar.)
Rose: Marinette is not here!
Nightormentor: I will free you from your nightmares once I've found my son and your friend!
Cat Noir: You really can't be trusted. What kind of father are you? (charges in)
Nightormentor: Voyage! (escapes through a portal)
Cat Noir: No!
Max: There's a 98.9% chance that he went to Marinette Dupain-Cheng's!
Ivan: Go, Cat Noir! Teach him a lesson!
Cat Noir: That akumatized villain's son and his girlfriend are lucky to have friends like you. (vaults away)
(Alya continues to contact Marinette on her Alliance)
Marinette's voicemail: It's Marinette. Leave a message. Beep.
(Alya closes her Alliance)
Nino: Maybe the Resistance should get involved.
Alya: You're right, Comrade Ketchup.

title: Representation/Transcript
text:
Representation/Transcript - Intro
Nightormentor: Hmm. Voyage.
(As Nightormentor enters another portal, Cat Noir is already seen perched on another rooftop, preparing an ambush. He opens his cat phone to contact Ladybug)
Cat Noir: M'Lady, if you're looking for me, I'm at the Dupain-Cheng bakery with an akumatized villain. (closes his cat phone) It's time you learn to let your son live his own life, Father.
Marinette: Sorry!
(She never stopped running to go after what she thinks to be Adrien, as if she's being hallucinated by her own emotions — of her longing to see the love of her life. She stops in front of the school and notices the door slightly open. Figuring out that "Adrien" might have entered the school, she follows quickly inside. She wanders for a while and sees another door open on the floor above. She runs up and enters the art classroom, only to find no one inside. But rather, she sees a sketch of herself and Adrien on a piece of paper on the floor, and breaks down.)
Marinette: Adrien! (sobs as she hugs the piece of paper)
Duusu: It's so sad!
Félix: The reason we're doing this, Duusu, is because we're hoping for a happy ending.
Duusu: (flies around them, ecstatic) Then, it's wonderful!

title: Representation/Transcript
text:
Representation/Transcript - Intro
Félix: (to Kagami) Are you ready? (Kagami nods) Duusu, spread my feathers!
(As he transforms into Argos, he plucks a feather from his fan and creates an amok, blowing it towards Kagami's ring.)
Argos: Oh, Amok, let our thirst for truth take shape! (He creates a sentimonster in the form of a projector) ﻿I am giving you life so that you can help us bring the truth to light.
Cat Noir: That's enough! Leave these school kids alone!
Nightormentor: Learn your lesson, Cat Noir, and don't put your nose where it doesn't belong! (starts to shoot pink dust at Cat Noir)
Cat Noir: (while continuously evading every pink dust shot at him) ﻿On the contrary, ﻿I think you need someone to give you a few parenting lessons! It doesn't seem to be your strong suit!
Nightormentor: Silence! (throws Cat Noir over Marinette's sewing table)
(Landing on the table, a photo of Marinette with him as Adrien falls on his face, making him a little distracted as he stares at it for a while. Nightormentor then makes his escape.)
Nightormentor: Voyage!
(Cat Noir quickly lunges on his feet and goes after Nightormentor before the portal closes.)
﻿Marinette: Adrien? ﻿Kagami?
﻿Kagami: (puts on mask) ﻿﻿﻿﻿Shh.

title: Representation/Transcript
text:
Representation/Transcript - Intro
Félix: ﻿﻿﻿(puts on mask) ﻿Shh.
(The projector starts narrowing down on both of them, and projects a hairstyle onto Kagami's mask, and a crown on Félix's. The backdrop switches to an English castle, and Félix starts narrating)
Félix: ﻿Once upon a time, in a faraway kingdom, ﻿a queen and a king were expecting a child.
(Kagami acts as a pregnant Milly Graham de Vanily, and Félix, as Emil Graham de Vanily, leans to the implied bump)
Félix: (as Emil Graham de Vanily) Oh, my queen. ﻿How I look forward to seeing our child. ﻿Thanks to him, our lineage will continue and our family will reign over the kingdom ﻿for eons to come.
(A cradle for the first child lights up on the left...)
Félix: But the queen did not give birth to one child...
(...as well as for the second child on the right)
Félix: but to two little girls.
Félix: (as Emil Graham de Vanily) ﻿Oh, my queen. ﻿Which one should we entrust our kingdom to?
(The twin rings were attached to baby Emilie's necklace)
Félix: Because she had been born seven seconds earlier, the king and queen decided to entrust the fate of the kingdom to the firstborn.
Nightormentor: Adrien...!

title: Representation/Transcript
text:
Representation/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: I'm guessing he's avoiding you. You don't seem like a nice father!
Nightormentor: Very well. ﻿I'll do away with you first! (throws a punch at Cat Noir, sending him flying) ﻿And I'll take your Miraculous and give it to Monarch! (shoots pink dust at Cat Noir once more)
Cat Noir: (evades the pink dust) ﻿How about you start leaving your son and the girl he loves alone instead?!
Nightormentor: Voyage!
(He creates a portal underneath him, making another escape, in which Cat Noir misses his attack, sending him on the ground)
Cat Noir: ﻿Coward.
Félix: ﻿The king and queen's twins grew up, each day as different in heart as they were similar in body.
(Kagami, as Emilie, prances around a backdrop of a forest.)
Félix: The firstborn, curious and brazen, despised life at court and escaped at every opportunity.
(While Félix, as Amélie, sits in front of a bookshelf backdrop, reading books.)
Félix: ﻿The younger daughter, well-behaved and respectful, ﻿did everything she could to please her parents, and stayed quietly in the castle.
(The scene switches to Félix holding Kagami, acting as the de Vanily couple, under a spotlight.)

title: Representation/Transcript
text:
Representation/Transcript - Intro
Félix: (as Emil Graham de Vanily) ﻿Oh, my queen. ﻿Did we entrust our legacy to the right princess?
Kagami: ﻿(as Milly Graham de Vanily) She will fall in line, eventually.
(Marinette places down the drawing and immerses herself to watch the duo's reenactment.)
Félix: ﻿Confident that she would settle down as she matured...
(Kagami hops around a moving backdrop, somewhat depicting Emilie's travel to Paris.)
﻿Félix: ...the king and queen allowed the curious princess to leave ﻿to study beyond the sea in another kingdom.
(Félix dresses up as Gabriel Agreste, and they both stand before a backdrop of the Eiffel Tower.)
Félix: ﻿There, she immediately found true love in a humble tailor.
(Commence kiss. Marinette realizes who the peculiar tailor is.)
Marinette: (gasps) ﻿It can't be...
(Félix, as Gabriel, draws in the air, reenacting Gabriel making his own designs.)
Félix: ﻿﻿The tailor was making clothes so magnificent ﻿that they revealed the beauty of the soul of anyone who wore them.
(Félix as Gabriel, and Kagami as Emilie, are being playful on the bed.)

title: Representation/Transcript
text:
Representation/Transcript - Intro
Félix: ﻿﻿Although it made her parents furious, the curious princess gave up her rank, ﻿her wealth and her kingdom to live a bohemian life with the tailor.
(Kagami, as Emilie, removes the family ring from her finger and divides it into two, putting the other half on Félix as Gabriel.)
Kagami: (as Emilie) ﻿Oh, my humble husband. ﻿We only require a child for our happiness to be complete.
(The two of them share a kiss. The scene switches to Kagami acting as Amélie.)
Félix: Meanwhile, the good princess, to please her parents, ﻿resigned herself to marry a wealthy, though heartless, lord of war.
(Félix as Colt waves his hat over his head, while Kagami as Amélie looks down sadly)
Félix: ﻿The king, the queen, and the lord all dreamed of the same thing: a child for the good princess, an heir for the kingdom.
Nightormentor: ﻿Adrien! ﻿Adrien!
Cat Noir: ﻿I don't think I'd like having a father like you! (attacks Nightormentor with his staff)
Nightormentor: ﻿If I were your father, I would start by teaching you some manners!

title: Representation/Transcript
text:
Representation/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: (after kicking Nightormentor) ﻿And if I were your son, ﻿I'd tell you you can't always make decisions for people — that to have a child is to help them blossom, ﻿to grow, to find themselves and to be free! (lands a final blow on Nightormentor and tackles him on the ground, stepping on his arm to make sure he will not get away once more)

title: Representation/Transcript
text:

Félix: ﻿﻿Eventually, with deep sorrow, ﻿the curious princess resigned herself to returning to court ﻿in order to benefit, like her sister, from the best remedies.

Félix: ﻿﻿(as Gabriel) ﻿Maybe it's a miracle.

title: Representation/Transcript
text:

﻿Félix: ﻿﻿﻿Then, the miraculous boy met a girl like him. (him and Kagami take off their masks) ﻿They fell in love.

﻿Félix: ﻿﻿﻿But this time, it's the tailor who is trying to stop them.

title: Revelator
text:
Revelator - Intro
"" is a season 6 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 11th written and produced episode of Season 6. It is also the 142nd written and produced episode of the series overall.

title: Revelator
text:
Revelator - Synopsis
Marinette and Adrien are now the most famous couple in Paris. As such, they catch the attention of an unscrupulous influencer who will do anything to generate buzz...
Gloob
Marinette and Adrien, the most famous couple in Paris, attract the attention of an unscrupulous influencer who will do anything for repercussion... even destroy the love between them.
TVGuide
An influencer turns his attention to Marinette and Adrien since they're the most famous couple in Paris, and when Marinette tries to teach the influencer a lesson about his smear campaign, he winds up akumatized into an upgraded villain of Pixelator.
Disney+
Ladybug and her team face an unscrupulous influencer.

title: Revelator
text:
Revelator - Plot
The prologue is a flashback that takes place in the underground subway, where Ladybug and Cat Noir train their allies into gaining their adult powers, such as never transforming back after using their special powers once, with the exception of Bunnyx. Once they all finally succeed, they do a group "pound it". Cat Noir suggests that it would be cool if they had a group name. While many of the heroes suggest many different names, Ladybug comes up with "The Miraculers". Everyone agrees with the name and cheers.
In the present, Marinette and Alya are at the beach, joined by Nino and Adrien as they get ice cream from their favorite ice cream vendor in Andre. However, some other beachgoers offer their sympathies and condolences to Adrien over the death of his father, making it clear they still respect and honor his sacrifice. While Alya, Marinette, Nino, and Adrien enjoy themselves, Alya shows Marinette videos on the Ladyblog of the Miraculers helping out around Paris as part of their new duties when not fighting victims of the new Hawk Moth.

title: Revelator
text:
Revelator - Plot
However, later, the Dupain-Cheng Bakery is shown to have been vandalized with graffiti depicting Marinette in a negative light, and people are calling Tom and Sabine to diss Marinette, much to her parents' ire.
When Marinette returns home, they close up the bakery and show her the propaganda about her being spewed by Vincent Asa as Vincent Secret on his blog, putting down Marinette, as well as Ladybug, and praising Gabriel for his heroism in sacrificing himself to end Monarch's threat for good; but with Adrien no longer being a fashion icon of London, England due to his father's death, he got replaced by Chloé Bourgeois.
Watching the videos, Marinette admits to Tikki that this only makes her feel worse because of the lie she had to spread about Gabriel so that Adrien wouldn't know he was Monarch.
This leads to where later, Marinette wants to speak to Vincent about his false info after discussing it with Adrien and Alya after Adrien saw the footage himself.
Tom offers to come with her, and when they meet up with Vincent, Adrien had a similar idea as he brought Placide with him.

title: Revelator
text:
Revelator - Plot
Vincent offers to clear up the misunderstanding by having Marinette and Adrien be on his podcast, but while he is interviewing them while Placide and Tom stand nearby and are ready to confront him for trouble, it seems the interview goes off without a hitch.
Later that night, Vincent begins editing the footage with malicious intent in mind.
The next day, when Adrien and Marinette go to the movies, other guests continues to scorn and show Vincent's latest blog video regarding his edited footage from the podcast towards Adrien and Marinette, forcing them to leave to escape from the scorn. After Marinette shows Alya the edited video, she decides to expose the truth of Vincent deceiving everyone. Transforming into Rena Rouge and using her Mirage to disguise herself as an avid fan of Vincent, Alya/Rena goes to speak with Vincent and ask him about his videos including how he does it. While Vincent is explaining everything at Alya/Rena, a hidden Lucky Charm camera is recording everything as Ladybug watches through her yo-yo secretly. Back at Marinette's room, with their evidence proving Vincent was fooling everyone secured, Alya uploads it into the Ladyblog.

title: Revelator
text:
Revelator - Plot
Eventually, Vincent is ordering his coffee at the café from Maya's father, when Nadja appears on the news to broadcast Alya's Ladyblog about her footage that exposes Vincent for the liar he really is, much to his shock.
As a result, Vincent, horrified, watches his subscribers plummet as Maya's father takes his coffee away angrily with Phong and everyone at the café glaring at him in disapproval and contempt for his deceit against Marinette and Adrien.
As Vincent panics and runs out of the café over his ruined reputation in distress, one of Chrysalis' Ultrakumas infects his cellphone, where Chrysalis contacts him, offering him the power to get back at them for ruining his reputation.
Realizing he'd be a fool for refusing Chrysalis' offer, Vincent accepts the power and then requests to be transformed into "Revelator".
As Vincent is Akumatized, the customers at the café panic and flee in terror upon witnessing it.

title: Revelator
text:
Revelator - Plot
Revelator targets Maya's father as his first victim after pushing Phong away from harm, revealing his deepest secret to be picking his nose and eating it, disgusting Maya before taking the crystal containing the secret, uploading it into his camera eye and broadcasting it all over Paris.

title: Revelator
text:
Revelator - Plot
When Alya and Marinette discover this video themselves when it appears on their cellphones, realizing they've got to stop Revelator, they transform into Rena Rouge and Ladybug to go confront him. During the fight, Revelator manages to hit Ladybug with his laser, causing her to cough up a crystal containing her deepest secret. Before Revelator can get it, Cat Noir arrives to help, but he too is zapped and coughs up a crystal containing his deepest secret, but destroys it with Cataclysm after witnessing his secret to be him reverting back to Adrien, causing him to realize he would still see the secret before destroying it, so he can't risk using his Cataclysm. Ladybug uses her Lucky Charm and ends up getting an eraser. Nevertheless, Rena uses her Mirage to conceal Ladybug's crystal by summoning illusionary replicas to confuse Revelator before he can grab the authentic one. As Revelator tries to find the authentic crystal in his frustration, Rena managed to recover it first. Despite Ladybug's pleads not to look into the crystal, Rena does so, convinced she'll only find out that it reveals Marinette is Ladybug, which she already knows anyway.

title: Revelator
text:
Revelator - Plot
Instead, Rena witnesses the earlier conversation between Marinette and Tikki regarding her admitting that Gabriel was Monarch and that she couldn't bring herself to tell Adrien the truth.
Upon hearing and witnessing the secret in the crystal, Rena is utterly shocked and in disbelief at this revelation.
Cat Noir fears that Rena knows Ladybug's secret identity, but is under the belief that Ladybug can fix it with her Miraculous Ladybug.
Ladybug hopes so as Rena turns to glare at her with an absolute anger, causing Ladybug to recoil anxiously.
However, when Revelator attacks again, Ladybug has Cat Noir distract him while she speaks to Rena.
Before Ladybug can take back her crystal, Rena holds it away from her, disappointed that Ladybug broke her trust after they agreed not to keep anymore secrets from each other.
Using her Mirage to create illusionary copies of herself and Ladybug to help Cat Noir and distract Revelator, Rena takes Ladybug to a rooftop to speak with her in private, asking if Cat Noir knows about Gabriel being Monarch the whole time.
Ladybug replies "no" as she doesn't know who Cat Noir is under the mask, and is worried he'll tell Adrien about it.

title: Revelator
text:
Revelator - Plot
When Rena asked why Ladybug would lie to Adrien, Ladybug admits the truth is too harsh to tell him.
This sets off Rena as she tells Ladybug that neither Ladybug or Rena gets to decide what Adrien should or shouldn't know.
Truth is vital to one's personal growth, and now that Rena knows of Monarch's true identity, she has to do the worst thing she can do as a journalist: Lie, and that's something she hates with a passion.
Ladybug feels extremely remorseful, as this is why she didn't want to tell Rena, knowing she would be furious with her if she found out the secret.
Back with Revelator, he manages to overpower Cat Noir before dispersing the illusionary Ladybug and Rena.
As Revelator advances towards Cat Noir, furious at being tricked, Ladybug ties him up with her yo-yo before Rena tackles and pins him to the ground, disarming him of his Akumatized object before throwing it at Ladybug to destroy, freeing the Ultrakuma for her to purify.
After Vincent returns to normal, Ladybug looks at her Lucky Charm object as Cat Noir thinks using her Miraculous Ladybug would undo Rena learning Ladybug's secret.

title: Revelator
text:
Revelator - Plot
A scornful Rena agrees, mentioning to Ladybug with something she said to her about secrets earlier.
Thus, Ladybug uses her Miraculous Ladybug to repair all the damage, but when she looks at Rena, Rena is still scowling as she admits the Miraculous Ladybug didn't work.
Rena also admits that the secret she knows is one that she can't keep hidden, even if she wanted to.
When Cat Noir asks Ladybug why the Miraculous Ladybug didn't work, she explains that nothing is broken.
The Miraculous Ladybug only repairs what has been broken, but with the secret Rena knows, they have to destroy it in order to restore things to normal.
When Cat Noir feels uneasy about that statement, Rena assures him that it is one's personal decision that decides which secrets can and can't be known, and that is repairing things in this scenario.
Thus, Ladybug encourages Cat Noir to use his powers to erase the secret from Rena's mind.
While Cat Noir doubts himself, she reminds him of how there is always room to evolve your Miraculous powers and grow stronger.

title: Revelator
text:
Revelator - Plot
Trusting Ladybug, Cat Noir summons his Cataclysm, and is able to unlock his Miraculous Cat Noir, which works like Miraculous Ladybug, but instead swirls around Rena, who closes her eyes and accepts what is about to happen, and erases what she learned from Ladybug's crystal from her memories.
After it is all over, whereas Cat Noir and Ladybug wonder if it worked or not, Rena turns around and asks them in puzzlement, "Did what work?", which they realize the Miraculous Cat Noir worked and Ladybug's secret that Rena learned has been erased from her memories and remains solely with Ladybug.
Although Rena is still confused afterwards, Ladybug grants Vincent a Magical Charm and is encouraged by the three Miraculers to only reveal secrets if the person's life is in danger.
Back at the beach, Alya notices that Marinette feels down in the dumps, but after a pep talk, Marinette cheers up, before Adrien and Nino call them out to join them in the water, and the two Best Friends Forever do just that.

title: Revelator
text:
Revelator - Plot
Later, back home, Alya looks at a photo of herself and Marinette, wondering why Marinette would ever think she would be angry with her. When Trixx inquires further, Alya admits that Marinette must be bearing a secret that burdens her so much, she can't tell anyone about it, and promises to help her deal with it in any way she can.

title: Revelator
text:
Revelator - Plot Developments
The French Miraculous superhero team officially adopted the name "Miraculers" for their team.
Ladybug and Cat Noir are revealed to have taught their allies how to unlock their adult powers in order to use their powers as much as they want and remain transformed.
The reason for Alix Kubdel's absence from the episode's training is not only because she was protecting the timeline with the Rabbit Miraculous, but also because it was not necessary for her to unlock her adult powers when her own Miraculous had already been revealed in "Evolution" to have had adult powers from the beginning.
Argos is not seen during training at any point, but is later seen with the other heroes during the creation of the team name. However, there is a box in the second row, next to Viperion's, whose user isn't visible, which could belong to Argos.
It is clear that the superheroes of Ladybug's team managed to upgrade their superhero costumes sometime after they regained their Miraculous in "Re-creation", with the exception of Miss Hound, as she is seen with her previous costume. The upgrade of her costume happened in "Daddycop".

title: Revelator
text:
Revelator - Plot Developments
Despite the opening scene happening before "The Illustrhater" (due to the heroes unlocking their adult powers) and "Daddycop" (as Sabrina used the group's new name), the episode itself happens after them (or at least after the latter), as Miss Hound is shown in her upgraded costume in one of the photos on Alya's video about the Miraculers on the Ladyblog.
It is possible, but not yet confirmed, that Adrien/Cat Noir now knows the secret identities of all the team members, as he was in front of them when they tried to slow down their de-transformation.
However, considering that some like Kim and Zoé went quickly into hiding when they couldn't hold on the detransformation (despite the fact they had dividers to prevent the others from knowing their identities), it's possible that Cat Noir still only knows the identities of some of them.
Vincent is revealed to have become an influencer under the name "Vincent Secret" after the fall of Monarch, dedicating to twist the truth by using rhetorical questions, half-truths and putting answers out of context. He posts his contents at the Bee Community on the Zoo.
It is revealed that Sabine Cheng is part of the Ladybug Community on the Zoo.

title: Revelator
text:
Revelator - Plot Developments
Cat Noir unlocks a new function of his Cataclysm, allowing him to turn it into Miraculous Cat Noir, a destructive version of Miraculous Ladybug, allowing him to destroy anything "created" by supervillains (that is any causal effect originated from their actions), like memories of secrets revealed by their powers.
Two of the kwamis' favorite foods were revealed: Wayzz likes cookies and Mullo likes cheese, just like Plagg.

title: Revelator
text:
Revelator - Trivia
This is the second time Vincent has been akumatized, following "Pixelator". However, unlike his previous akumatization, Vincent is not akumatized into Pixelator, but rather into a new villain, Revelator.
He now holds the record for the longest time between two akumatizations, not counting his transformation into Pixelator as result of the titular villain's powers in "Gamer 2.0".
According to Vincent, Chloé has replaced Adrien as a new fashion icon after Gabriel's death and the boy's retirement as a new model while she is in London.
Given this reveal, her Season 6 outfit may be part of a fashion line inspired by her time as Queen Bee.
Her new status as fashion icon may be due to her mother, who is a fashion critic and had decided to take full control over her life after the events in "Revolution".
The episode reveals some of the characters' secrets:
Maya's father eats boogers after picking his nose.
A worker's baldness with his toupée being blown off.
Cat Noir's secret identity as Adrien.
Marinette telling Tikki that she can't tell Adrien the truth about Gabriel's secret identity as Monarch.

title: Revelator
text:
Revelator - Trivia
Furthermore, since Tikki was by Marinette's side in her secret, Marinette's secret identity as Ladybug would also be revealed. This could mean that, in the case of people with multiple secrets, Revelator's powers show a moment in time that reveals all of them at once.
Alya learns the truth about Marinette lying about Monarch's identity being Gabriel Agreste in order to protect Adrien. This angered Alya, not only because Marinette lied to her, but also because she is keeping that secret from Adrien and preventing him from growing as a person, while also forcing her to lie about it as well, something that she hates.
However, after hearing Ladybug's side on why she hasn't told Adrien the truth yet, Cat Noir's Miraculous Cat Noir erased Alya's memory of the truth about Gabriel after realizing that not all secrets are meant to be shared.
This episode also gives insight if anyone (especially one of the Miraculers) finds out about Gabriel's identity as Monarch.
Both girls had valid points in their arguments:

title: Revelator
text:
Revelator - Trivia
Marinette was wise in some way to wait to tell Adrien the truth. If he was told the truth about Gabriel at the worst time, then it could push him to an akumatization, under the effects of which he might let out the secret, which would definitely cause people to turn on not only Adrien, but also the Miraculers as a whole (since Ladybug lied), which in turn might hinder their mission to stop Chrysalis by losing the support of Paris.
Furthermore, because Adrien is actually Cat Noir, Marinette, without knowing it, actually prevented a disaster leading to the repeat of "Cat Blanc" and "Ephemeral", much like he did in "Conformation".
While memories can be erased by Miraculous Cat Noir, this power cannot be used if Adrien is akumatized.
It's also a recall to "Miraculous London", to where Marinette wanted to wait until the Butterfly Miraculous was in the Miracle Box, so she going to tell Adrien the whole truth.

title: Revelator
text:
Revelator - Trivia
In the long run, Alya was right in that Marinette stunted Adrien's growth by not telling him the truth. While there is no good way to reveal this harsh truth, further hiding and lying about it would cause the emotional and mental blow to be more severe and most likely would cause Adrien to lose trust in the people around him if/when he learns said people he was close with/related to knew of this but decided to keep it from him. Marinette also seemingly forgot that Chrysalis already knows the truth from the events in "Miraculous London".
Marinette was also aware that the Butterfly Miraculous would be used for evil years into the future, which she knew from the events in "Timetagger".
Also, because Adrien is Cat Noir, if/when he finds out the truth, the emotional breakdown caused might cause him to get akumatized, thus Marinette both prevented but also might have caused a turn of events that lead to a "Cat Blanc scenario".

title: Revelator
text:
Revelator - Trivia
This time, if/when Adrien learns everything his akumatization could also be out of guilt for what happened to those close to him or for what they did: his mother's demise, his dad going obsessively crazy to fix everything while using him and his mother as his motivation and his death too, Nathalie and Felix for helping his dad making the problems worse; and for all the danger and damage everyone were put through because of him.
Worst of all, Adrien could end up being mad at himself for this because he let all of it slip under his nose.
This also applies to hiding Adrien's own nature as a Sentibeing, in addition to him risking his own existence and autonomy if he loses the rings or they get into the possession of Chrysalis or other ill-intentioned individuals.
Before forgetting about the secret, Alya, despite being angry, still encouraged Marinette to tell Adrien the truth, showing that she has hope her best friend will find the best way to reveal it.
Despite forgetting Marinette's secret, Alya notices that her best friend is still burdened and is determined to help her.

title: Revelator
text:
Revelator - Trivia
As of this episode, except for Monarch's identity it also implies that Marinette told Alya everything she hid as Ladybug possibly including the Cat Blanc incident.
As a callback to "Lady Wifi", at the episode's end, Alya suspected Adrien of being Cat Noir, she had no idea how right she was and had she figured it out any sooner then combining it with what she knew or at least until her memory was erased. Then, Alya would with a dilemma between going against her code or she and everyone else would be living the "Cat Blanc" incident possibly learning another harsh lesson about being a hero: sometimes what you hold and value doesn't always apply to very situation or person.
A new audio effect and multiple visual effects have been added for when Ladybug opens her yo-yo.
During Vincent's videos, images from "Strikeback", "Representation" and "Miraculous London" were re-done with the new models.
Pictures of Marinette and Adrien from "Climatiqueen" and "Daddycop" also appear.
In addition, posters of Adrien created by the Gabriel brand are redone in the style of the new animation.
This is the first episode where Fire Captain Hessenpy is seen without his helmet, revealing his blonde hair.

title: Revelator
text:
Revelator - Trivia
The instrumental which plays during Bug Noire and Gabriel's heart-to-heart in "Re-creation" is heard twice: between the Miraculous Ladybug and the Miraculous Cat Noir, and during Marinette and Alya's conversation at the beach at the end of the episode.
Starting from this episode, Miss Hound's glitching arm at the end of the theme song has been fixed.
Vincent's false claim to a disguised Rena Rouge about Marinette's plan to become the "wealthiest most powerful girl on earth so she can manipulate absolutely everyone on the planet" and "manipulating Adrien is the start" ironically describes Lila's previous intention. Through the previous seasons one through five, she manipulated her way into Adrien's home that lead her to be an ally to Gabriel, via, an ally to Hawk Moth/Monarch, but after being betrayed and cut off by him, Lila manipulates his distaste for Marinette, got rid of Gabriel's allies, and manages to steal the Butterfly Miraculous.
References
This episode also shares some correlations with "Cat Blanc":
Both episodes, the topic of Marinette and Adrien now being a couple is brought up in the episode and acknowledged by famous Paris media.

title: Revelator
text:
Revelator - Trivia
Both involve the same Lucky Charm object: an eraser.
Both episodes, have one or more heroes learn Hawk Moth's/Monarch's identity, only for the knowledge to be erased from their minds.
Cat Noir's new ability parallels Cat Blanc's Mega Cataclysm ability, with a similar appearance when activated and the ability to cause mass destruction (with more control in Cat Noir's case).
Both Alya and Marinette were told critical pieces of information but they weren't given the whole story.
Marinette becomes haunted by the outcome of both episodes, even if they ended up being erased, with her becoming traumatized by Cat Blanc in a way that caused her to start to exclude Cat Noir from missions in fear of him being akumatized and with her becoming afraid of losing Alya's friendship because of her secret about Monarch's real identity.
Revelator's power is activated by saying "Revelation", similar to Hoaxer in the episode of same name.
Coincidentally, Revelator was akumatized by the person who was Hoaxer. While Hoaxer's "revelations" were no more than lies and illusions created with the power of the Fox Miraculous, Revelator's powers truly reveal hidden secrets.

title: Revelator
text:

Both villains caused Alya to become furious at Marinette; while Hoaxer caused Alya to be angry because of mind control, Alya's anger in this episode was genuine and resulted from Revelator's actions, not his powers.
The plot of both episodes has the villains make Marinette look like a bad person; Hoaxer mind controls everyone through her illusions to make everyone believe Marinette was Monarch, but Vincent, way before he became Revelator, uses information to make Marinette look bad by twisting the truth and words that are taken out of context.

title: Riginarazione
text:
Riginarazione - Intro
"" is a Season 6 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 19th written and produced episode of Season 6. It is also the 150th written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Riginarazione
text:
Riginarazione - Synopsis
TFOU
As her grandparents' 75th birthday approaches, Marinette learns news that will turn her life and her family's upside down. What will she discover? Will this unexpected revelation truly change her life forever?
Disney Channel
As her grandparents' 75th birthdays approach, Marinette learns news that will turn hers and her family's lives upside down.
Disney+
Marinette receives life-changing news.

title: Riginarazione
text:
Riginarazione - Plot
As the episode opens, Marinette is with her grandmother Gina making food, when Gina receives an alert indicating Roland is in trouble. Worried, she tries to excuse herself and lie to Marinette that she's going to a concert for the elderly, and successfully convinces her. Gina rushes over to Roland's and bursts in, only to find that he appears to be fine and wants her to turn off his TV, once again complaining that he wants it done the old-fashioned way rather than the modern way. Gina is initially incensed by Roland's behavior, but then he gets serious and confesses he has little time left to live, as he sold the house as part of his preparations for his impending death. Gina is horrified, but contains her emotions to try and convince Roland it is time to tell his granddaughter the truth. Roland is hesitant, but agrees to tell Marinette that his time is running out.

title: Riginarazione
text:
Riginarazione - Plot
Marinette has finished soccer jerseys customized with her family's names on each of them, but as she's about to head out, Roland does call Marinette, and she agrees to go see him after being convinced by Gina, Sabine, and Tom to go see him, but after she leaves, they exchange worried looks with each other. At her grandfather's, Roland tries to cover up his impending death to Marinette by stalling with excuses, but he finally tells her that his time is running out. His doctor said his heart is failing him, and he wants to ensure he departs this world with no regrets. Marinette is devastated. She flees Roland's house, transforms into Ladybug, swings across Paris with tears streaming from her eyes, before landing on one roof and powering down, collapsing to her hands and knees as she continues to sob over losing her paternal grandfather. Tikki tries to reassure her things will be alright and they can find a solution, but realizing that not even Gimmi and the Ultimate Miraculous Absolute Power can fix this, Marinette continues to cry in total heartbreak over losing her grandfather, calling it unfair.

title: Riginarazione
text:
Riginarazione - Plot
Later, when Marinette is with Adrien in his room playing some football, the thought of losing her grandfather continues to weigh heavily on her heart, showing how much it is weighing on her with playing aggressively until Adrien comforts her over her impending loss. Adrien consoles and reassures her, before they join the rest of the family for the birthday celebration, taking some final photos of Roland before his time comes. However, as Gina reminisces on her life with Roland, Tom's birth, Marinette's birth, and other memories, when she and Roland blow out the candles, Roland almost blacks out, and Marinette, her parents, and Adrien take Roland to bed. Alone, Gina is so upset and heartbroken, that Chrysalis is able to send an Ultrakuma to her cookie box to transform her into Riginarazione, the more powerful version of Befana. When Tom, Marinette, Sabine, Adrien, and Roland discover this, Riginarazione de-ages Roland back into his younger self, de-ages Tom back into a baby, and then escapes with Roland. Marinette has Adrien stay with her parents while she goes after her grandparents, transforming into Ladybug in an alleyway before going after them.

title: Riginarazione
text:
Riginarazione - Plot
When Ladybug catches up to Roland and Riginarazione at a DJ party hosted by XY, not only does Riginarazione age XY into an elderly adult that looks like his father Bob Roth, but she manages to do the same to Ladybug, aging her into adulthood with a pixie cut hairstyle, before burying her under aged-up collapsed debris to buy herself time to escape with Roland.

title: Riginarazione
text:
Riginarazione - Plot
Back at Roland's, Sabine pardons Adrien to go check on things outside, allowing him to become Cat Noir to go lend Ladybug a hand. Unfortunately, as he regroups with Ladybug and sees what Riginarazione did to her, as they try to help everyone affected, Riginarazione manages to de-age Cat Noir into a baby. With him helpless, Chrysalis instructs the villain to take his ring but with adult Ladybug's warning, he saves himself by activating his powers but ends up stuck in the subway having to saved by his partner. When the pair resurfaces, they discover Riginarazione gone, and baby Noir taking one of her earrings causing Ladybug to briefly detransform until she reclaimed it but to see her little kitty gone quickly spotting him trying to eat a cookie, then another but couldn't because of his powers. And yet, Ladybug using her Lucky Vision, to see that they weren't random but Roland left them a trail to follow. Meanwhile, Riginarazione and Roland are at a clothes shop where the villainess wanted to change his wardrobe, buying time and still leaving a trail he agrees while the duo arrive on the scene.

title: Riginarazione
text:
Riginarazione - Plot
Aware of the situation, Ladybug summons her power receiving a baby carrier as her Lucky Charm loading Cat Noir up, she confronts the villainess, snaring Riginarazione's wrist with her yo-yo, despite her pleas, and those of Roland, Riginarazione refuses to give up.
Thus, as a game of tug of war began, Riginarazione continued to blast the heroine with her age-up shots, soon turning Ladybug into an elderly version of herself, and threatening to go all the way with potentially killing her and turning her into nothing but bones, but Ladybug gets close enough for Cat Noir to Cataclysm the ammo jar of Riginarazione's weapon due to the unstable usage of a Miraculous' power as a baby and thus freeing the Ultrakuma, leaving Riginarazione disappointed as she realizes she is defeated.
The elderly Ladybug then captures and purifies the Ultrakuma, As Roland reassures Gina that he has no regrets on how he lived his life and that she shouldn't have any regrets either, Ladybug hands Cat Noir over to Gina and Roland so she can perform her Miraculous Ladybug, restoring herself, Cat Noir, Roland, Tom, and everyone and everything else affected back to normal.

title: Riginarazione
text:
Riginarazione - Plot
Back to her teenage self, she then gives Gina a Magical Charm and words of wisdom, before sharing a "Pound It!" with Cat Noir and the two take their leave, with Ladybug remaining behind long enough to say goodbye to her grandfather before departing herself.
In her lair in La Plage, Cerise warns Ladybug that it is only a matter of time before she defeats and unmasks her as Cerise's time is coming.

title: Riginarazione
text:
Riginarazione - Plot
Sometime later, Roland's house is seen having been completely emptied of its furniture and other possessions following his selling of it and his off-screen passing. Gina, having taken in Roland's three mice, stares at the sunset before taking her leave on her motorcycle. At the Dupain-Cheng Bakery, Tom and Sabine resume their business with also trying to continue Roland's legacy, and in her room, Marinette continues to work on her fashions before looking at her grandfather's yeast container and the new background for her computer's desktop of her, Roland, and Gina at his last birthday party. At his home, Adrien listens to Roland's record player until the music ends when the needle reaches the middle of the record. It is clear that, while Roland may be gone now, his memory lives on in his family.

title: Riginarazione
text:
Riginarazione - Plot developments
More about Marinette's grandparents, Roland and Gina, is revealed:
Roland is revealed to have been facing a deteriorating health condition and, eventually, he passes away offscreen at the end of the episode.
Roland becomes the second character to permanently die during the events of the show, the first being Gabriel Agreste.
Coincidentally, their sons, Tom and Adrien (as Cat Noir), were de-aged into babies by Riginarazione.
Gina, Tom and Sabine knew about this, with Roland contacting Gina through her digital watch regarding his health problems.
The adults tried to shield Marinette from this to keep her from worrying, but Roland was eventually forced by the circumstances to tell her.
Before his passing, Roland sold his house, entrusted his family yeast to Marinette and his pet mice, Charlotte, Marie-Louise, and Marguerite, (all of which first appeared in "Bakerix"), to Gina. In addition, either Roland or the Dupain-Chengs gifted Adrien his pickup, which he listens to in his room.

title: Riginarazione
text:
Riginarazione - Plot developments
Roland and Gina are revealed to have been together ever since they were twenty years old and had celebrated together their birthdays (even if they were born on different days), with the number on the cake being the combination of their respective age.
They stopped this ritual during the time Roland isolated himself in his house for twenty years until the family reconnected for Tom's 40th birthday in "Bakerix".
Since the latter episode implies that the split occurred around the time Tom and Sabine got married, which was twenty-one years ago according to "Timebreaker" and "The Dark Castle", the last birthday Roland and Gina celebrated together was probably their 54th.
Since he was de-aged into a baby by Riginarazione while transformed, Adrien/Cat Noir has the distinction of being the first and only baby Miraculous holder.
It's revealed that, as opposed to a teenager who can use their power only once before detransforming, a baby Miraculous holder is incapable of controlling their own power, with it leaking without them even activating it.

title: Riginarazione
text:
Riginarazione - Plot developments
The enhanced abilities the holder is granted are also still intact, as Cat Noir fell some five metres below underground into the Métro without suffering any injury.
Like Adrien in "Heartfixer", Marinette is learning the same thing the pain of losing a loved one.

title: Riginarazione
text:
Riginarazione - Trivia
This is the first Season 6 episode to have neither an end card, nor a scene after it.
"Lady Chaos" would later also not have a proper end card, but the final shot of Marinette's blank piece of paper serves as one, and the ladybug transition appears between it and the final scene.
The entire cold open before the intro is silent with no background music to convey the serious tone to the plot of the episode.
Ladybug's design after becoming an adult resembles Thomas Astruc's concept art of an adult Ladybug from 2017.
Unlike with her other victims, Chrysalis gives an additional statement before closing her palm, wishing Riginarazione a happy birthday after the latter chooses her name.
Since Riginarazione's aging blasts seem to turn the victim into a future version of themselves (as demonstrated by Ladybug's changing hairstyles), rather than just aging them, this seemingly confirms that Marinette and XY will live until old age.
Interestingly, the aged XY looks very similar to his father Bob Roth.
This is the second time where Marinette and Adrien are seen as a babies following "Wishmaker", though they are only depicted in 2D drawings in the latter episode.

title: Riginarazione
text:
Riginarazione - Trivia
Unlike "Wishmaker" and Marinette's case in this episode, Adrien is seen as a baby in the present and while transformed as Cat Noir.
As of this episode, Sabine is the only member of Marinette's family who hasn't celebrated a birthday yet on-screen.
The episode's title and akumatized villain's name is a portmanteau of 'Gina', Marinette's paternal grandmother and 'Rigenerazione' an Italian word meaning regeneration which aligns with the akumatized villain's power to transform anyone (and anything) into a five year older or younger version of themselves.
Gina's current-day model has been updated from "Werepapas": she has more wrinkles and her hair is a lighter shade of grey.
According to the storyboard, the civilian Ladybug swings by after Roland tells her the truth is called Saladin Martine.
References
Adrien successfully consoling Marinette over her grandfather's fate most likely comes from his own tragic experiences of losing both of his parents: Émilie before the start of the series and Gabriel in "Re-creation".
It also mirrors Marinette trying to console Adrien over losing his father in "Miraculous London", first attempting as Bug Noire, before later doing it as herself.

title: Riginarazione
text:
Riginarazione - Trivia
Marinette crying over her grandfather's fate also most likely reminded her of what happened to Gabriel.
Even though both did things of their own choices, what happened to Roland was natural, so Marinette couldn't stop it even if she wanted to, for Gabriel there was something Marinette could do, but he wouldn't let her.
Sabine manages to dodge Riginarazione's blasts using her martial arts skills, which she first displayed briefly in "Troublemaker" and "Qilin", the latter episode revealing that she practices qigong.
Ladybug carrying baby Cat Noir into battle references what they did with their imaginary kids in their shared dream in "Jubilation".
This is the third time someone managed to briefly steal one of Ladybug's earrings, causing her to gradually detransform, after "Troublemaker" and "The Dark Owl".
Unlike previous times where an akumatized villain stole one of Ladybug's earrings to bring them to Hawk Moth, this time Baby Cat Noir took it because he thought it was pretty and his de-aged brain did not realize what he did.
At the end of the episode, Gina is also seen wearing her T-shirt with the prism design from the first saga instead of the plain black T-shirt from Season 6.

title: Riginarazione
text:
Riginarazione - Trivia
This episode is similar to "Bakerix" and "Simpleman". Roland's previous akumatized forms revolved with him wanting things to be back in the old and simple days. The titular's villain in this episode is similar to this plot only she wanted Roland to have more time to enjoy together instead of living out his life at home.
The episode is also similar to "Backwarder". Both akumatized villains' powers revolve around time, and want more time to be together with their loved ones. Backwarder wanted to make up for lost time with Wang Fu, and Riginarazione wanted Roland to have a second chance by restoring his youth.
Ironically, Roland's akumatized forms wanted things back to the way it was, Gina got akumatized because of Roland's traditional views and she wanted him to have a second chance to have more time together.
Allusions
Ironically when Marinette was crying over her grandfather's fate, she said there was nothing that could be done to stop it. Yet when Gina was akumatized she had the power to do so but it was wrong. Alluding to how to real people feel and act to the death of their loved ones.
