[ Theme Song ]
(video contains images of the Miraculers helping civilians such as King Monkey saving a cat, Carapce and Rena Rouge trapping dinosaurs, Ryuko helping firefighters and Miss Hound handing out a football to kids)
Alya: Now these heroes who call themselves the Miraculers help us out even when the problem is not caused by an akumatized villain. Thank you Miraculers and remember for more superheroic news, stay connected.
Marinette: This is amazing Alya!
Alya: Yeah but anyone can do that. I wanna put some real journalism out there. Tell people how hard it is to be a superhero. How hard we had to train in order to evolve, to stop transforming back. I want to explain how you enhanced our miraculous when you redesigned the jewels. (sighs) But all I get to do is tell a fraction of what I know.
Marinette: People might figure out you're a superhero if you didn't.
Alya: I know, but you know me. I'd love to be able to tell the truth, the whole truth.

title: Revelator/Transcript
text:
Revelator/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Do you wish I hadn't given you that miraculous?
Alya: Are you kidding? I love being a superhero. I would've been so mad at you if you hadn't picked me.
Marinette: You never would've found out.
Alya: Impossible. I'm a lie detector in the flesh.
(Alya and Marinette laugh)
(Nino pays André as Nino and Adrien get ice cream)
Nino: Thanks André.
André: With pleasure kiddo.
First Boy: Adrien Agreste, my condolences.
Adrien: Thank you.
Second Boy: Your father was a great man.
Adrien: Thank you.
Third Boy: I hope we'll see you on the big screen one day.
Adrien: Thank you, but I don't want to be an actor. (sad) Not an actor or a model, or famous.
Nino: You okay buddy?
Adrien: Yes. Yeah. People are nice but sometimes I just wish I had a simple life where everyone didn't stare at me or everyone didn't know every single thing going on in my life.
(Nino and Adrien approach Marinette and Alya)
Nino and Adrien: Hey girls! (extend ice-cream towards them but it melts and falls down. Adrien looks at the ice-cream, sad)
Marinette: You see, these cones are just like me. They immediately start melting when they are around you (Adrien smiles and they both kiss)

title: Revelator/Transcript
text:
Revelator/Transcript - Intro
Girl: You can have mine. Come on, it'd be my pleasure. You two are so cute, Adrien Agreste and Marinette Dupain-Cheng. I love you two!
Marinette: Uh, thank you?
Girl: (leans towards Marinette and Marinette leans towards Adrien) No, thank you for existing. (Adrien and Marinette are confused. Nino puts his together as though he is filming them)
Alya: Scoop. Marinette and Adrien, the most famous couple in Paris.
Nino: Marinette and Adrien, (Alya pretends to hold out a mic) the couple that melts everyone's hearts.
All: (Laughs)
Male voice: (on the phone) Is it true that your daughter, is dating Adrien Agreste?
Sabine: Sir! How dare you talk about my daughter this way?
Tom: Hand me the phone Sabine. (takes the phone) I'm warning you, say one word about my daughter and...
Marinette: Dad, Mom, what's going on?
(Tom keeps the phone down quickly and hides his bread peel.)
Tom: Uhh, nothing at all. Everything's fine sweetheart.
Marinette: (suspicious) Mom, I heard you telling someone not to talk about me. What were they saying?
Sabine: I'd...rather not repeat it.
Marinette: Who was it?
Tom: I- don't know what these people want. But I will find them and I'll...

title: Revelator/Transcript
text:
Revelator/Transcript - Intro
Sabine: Tom, you don't know where they are, much less who they are.
Marinette: I don't understand. Why won't you tell me what's going on?
(Tom and Sabine look at each other)
Tom: I'll close the shop. (pulls down the shutter)
Sabine: You're bound to see it anyway, we might as well watch these videos together so we can talk about it afterwards.

title: Revelator/Transcript
text:
Revelator/Transcript - Intro
Vincent Asa: (in the video) Wondering what happened to Adrien Agreste? Son of the famous fashion designer who saved Paris? I know. because no truth can be kept from Vincent Secret. This is what Adrien used to be, (shows pictures of his photos as a model) a good- looking, rich and famous boy with a good-looking, rich and famous girlfriend (shows picture of Adrien and Kagami), a good-looking, rich and famous father. (shows picture of Gabriel Agreste). But now that his hero of a father is no longer here to set a good example for him, Adrien has become Adri-nothing! (shows picture of Chloé Bourgeois as a fashion icon) replaced by Chloé Bourgeois in the hearts of fashion lovers. The former celebrity teen is under the influence of an apprentice designer. (shows picture of Marinette and Adrien, drawing horns and making Marinette look evil) If you like Vincent Secret, remember to hit the like button and subscribe. And thank you to my sponsor,  Tsurugi electric city cars.
(Marinette replays the video)
Vincent: This is what Adrien used to be, Adrien has become Adri-nothing. Under the influence of apprentice designer. (replays) Apprentice designer. (replays again) Apprentice designer.

title: Revelator/Transcript
text:
Revelator/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: He's lying!
Alya: (on the monitor) And it looks like he's not done. He just posted another new one.
(Marinette clicks on it)
Vincent: Wondering who Marinette Dupain-Cheng is? I know because no truth can be kept form Vincent Secret. Marinette Dupain-Cheng is the futureless daughter of bakers who is lucky enough to end up in the same classroom as famous model Adrien Agreste. Following the disappearance of Adrien's father, Marinette Dupain-Cheng took advantage of the boys distress, bewitching him in order to control his future life. Is she really after love? Or the fashion empire that Adrien Agreste inherited? Will the Agreste empire survive the baker daughters attack? If you like this, remember to hit the like button and subscribe. Thank you to my sponsor, Vanita Watches.
(Adrien watches Vincent Secret on his laptop)
Plagg: No way! I can't believe I had Marinette all wrong.
Adrien: Come on Plagg, how do you believe this bunch of nonsense?

title: Revelator/Transcript
text:
Revelator/Transcript - Intro
Plagg: You're right. It'll be like camembert suddenly tasting like croissants. It makes no sense indeed. (gasps and closes Adrien's laptop) I've never seen anything as dangerous as this video, and this is coming from the  kwami of destruction.
(Adrien's phone rings, group call involving Alya and Marinette. He answers)
Adrien: Did you see Vincent Secret's video?
(Marinette nods)
Alya: Vincent Secret, more like Vincent lies.
Adrien: I'm sorry for causing you so much trouble Marinette.
Marinette: It's not your fault. There has to be some misunderstanding. We should just meet with this Vincent Secret guy and explain that we genuinely love each other. And he'll realise that he made a huge mistake, that whatever information he got is fake and everything will be back to normal.
Adrien: You're probably right.
Alya: You two are so naive. This dude's obviously doing it on purpose.
Marinette: That's impossible Alya. Why would he try to hurt us? We didn't do anything to him.
Adrien: We don't even know him.
Alya: He's not trying to hurt you. He doesn't care if he does. All he wants is to create buzz for his channel.
Marinette: No one can be this mean. We'll go talk to him.
(Tom spits out water)

title: Revelator/Transcript
text:
Revelator/Transcript - Intro
Tom: What?
Marinette: I sent him a message and he agreed to meet with me.
Sabine: Alone?
Marinette: No. Adrien is coming with me. Besides, you're the ones who taught me to talk through my problems. Aren't you?
Sabine: We have good reason not to trust this Vincent Secret character and he's an adult. You and Adrien are children. You can't meet with him on your own.
Tom: I'm coming with you and I'm bringing my bread peel.
(Marinette smiles and nods)
Vincent: Wondering what's the point of superheroes Ladybug and Cat Noir?
Tikki: Marinette? (Tikki goes to Marinette who is watching a video on her phone)
Vincent: I know, because no truth can be kept from Vincent Secret. For a year, supervillain Monarch spread terror in Paris. And for a year, Ladybug and Cat Noir tried to stop him. Did they succeed?
Marinette: If I hadn't lied to Adrien and Alya and everyone, he couldn't have made this video.
Tikki: Whether you lied or not, this Vincent Secret would have made up some other fake stories to gossip about.
Ladybug: (from the events of Miraculous London, At The Edge of Time: footage) But thanks to the heroic sacrifice, we are finally free from Monarch.

title: Revelator/Transcript
text:
Revelator/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: I couldn't tell Adrien the truth. He would have been completely ruined if he found out that Monarch was his own father.
Tikki: Marinette, your mom is right. There's no point in watching these videos.
Vincent: That's right, Ladybug wasn't the one who defeated supervillain Monarch. It was all thanks to famous fashion designer, Gabriel Agreste. And without any superpowers either, except his ability to design super sneakers.
(Marinette's phone battery runs low and she gasps)
Marinette: What time is it?
Tikki: Almost 9.
Marinette: Oh no, Tikki! These videos made me completely lose track of time! (rushes to leave her room)
(Adrien and Marinette sit on a table opposite Vincent and Tom and  Adrien's bodyguard stand behind them.)
Marinette: So now complete strangers are calling my parents' bakery to say bad things about me.
Vincent: It's just innocent little phone pranks. Probably kids having fun. I don't see how any of this connects to Vincent Secret.
Tom: Of course it's all connected, with all the horrible things you claim in your videos.
Vincent: I said horrible things? Really?
Tom: You sure did, when you called Marinette the futureless daughter of bakers for one.

title: Revelator/Transcript
text:
Revelator/Transcript - Intro
Vincent: I don't see anything mean here. You're still a teenager, aren't you? Don't tell me you already know what you want to do later.
Marinette: Of course I do. I want to design clothes, or jewels or furniture but also...
Vincent: See? You don't know exactly.
Adrien: You also said that Marinette had bewitched me.
Vincent: It just means that you're under her spell. Is that not true? You two seem very much in love, aren't you?
Adrien: Uh, we are but-
(Adrien is interrupted by Tom who furiously slams the bread peel on the table)
Tom: (outraged) What about when you asked, 'Will the Agreste empire survive the bakers daughters attack?' Are you going to tell me that's not mean?
Vincent: I'm not stating anything. I'm just asking questions. I stimulate people's intellect. Are you going to blame me or that? If they start imagining bad things, it's not my fault.
Tom: Is this what you mean by imagining? (shows a photo of the graffiti on the patisserie on his phone)
Vincent: Listen. I don't want any misunderstandings. I seek the truth without filters. How about you express yourself directly to the audience? Eye to eye.
(Marinette and Adrien look at each other)

title: Revelator/Transcript
text:
Revelator/Transcript - Intro
Vincent: You wanted to set the record straight, didn't you?
(Marinette and Adrien both nod)
(Camera flashes in Marinette's eye and she flinches. Adrien looks at her and smiles. She returns his smile)
Vincent: So tell me, how did you two really meet?
Marinette: At first I thought, 'I hate this guy' because I assumed he was best friends with Chloé, the girl who bullied me at school.
(Vincent makes a smug expression)
Adrien: And I didn't understand why she didn't like me.
Marinette: I thought Adrien had stuck gum to my seat but he was actually trying to peel off Chloé's gum.
Adrien: But things got better.
Marinette: Thanks to the umbrella.
Vincent: An umbrella?
Adrien: The day we met, it was raining.
Marinette: I was waiting for the rain to stop.
Adrien: And I had an umbrella.
Marinette: I didn't want his umbrella.
Adrien: I didn't know how to get her to understand that I wasn't who she thought I was.
Marinette: He told me that he...he never had friends.
Adrien: This was my very first time going to school. It was all so...new.
(Marinette places her hand on Adrien's)
Marinette: And you handed me the umbrella.
Adrien: You took it.
Marinette: And I fell in love.

title: Revelator/Transcript
text:
Revelator/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: And the umbrella closed over your head.
(Adrien and Marinette start laughing)
Vincent: That's when you two became...a couple?
Marinette: Oh! No. No.
Adrien: I thought I had made a new friend.
Marinette: And I thought there was no way he'd ever fall in love with a girl like me.
Vincent: A girl like you? What do you mean by that?
Marinette: I was clumsy, always stammering, tripping over stuff. He never knew, what I was going to do. I don't know. How could you ever fall in love with me?
Adrien: It's because you're so... unique.
(Both hold hands, look into each others eyes and kiss)
Vincent: (claps) There! This is love. True love. Pure love. You two are so cute, people are going to love it.
(Adrien and Marinette look into the camera and look at each other and smile)
(Vincent typing and editing his video)
Vincent: Add a little video filter. And boom. Perfect. People are going to love hating the baker girl.
(Adrien and Marinette  walk inside and stand in a line)
Girl: How can you still be with her after what she said about you?
(Adrien and Marinette look at each other, confused)
Adrien: What are you talking about?
Girl: Well, she did say that she hates you.

title: Revelator/Transcript
text:
Revelator/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: I never said such a thing.
(shows them a video)
Vincent: (in video) How do you really feel about Adrien?
Marinette: (in video) I hate this guy.
Girl: So are you saying that's not you?
Marinette: It is me but...
Girl: So you actually did say such a thing.
Adrien: This has to be taken out of context.
Girl: You really need to stop making excuses for her Adrien. It's obvious she's manipulating you.
Marinette: I'm not.
Adrien: Come on, let's go.
Girl: It's so sad that you two stay together when you don't love each other.
(Adrien and Marinette leave the building)
Vincent: (on video) Want to know why Adrien Agreste and Marinette Dupain-Cheng are together? I know because no truth can be kept from Vincent Secret. I interviewed Marinette Dupain-Cheng for you and she revealed all her secrets to me. We already knew she was after the Agreste empire. But what we didn't know is about how she really felt for Adrien. And here's her answer.
Marinette (on video) I hate this guy.
Vincent: (on video) I think that's pretty clear don't you? She also explained how she deviously managed to bewitch him.
Marinette: (on video) He never knew what I was going to do.

title: Revelator/Transcript
text:
Revelator/Transcript - Intro
Vincent: (on video) And she exploited poor Adrien's weaknesses.
Marinette: (on video) He never had friends.
Vincent: (on video) Good thing Vincent is here to restore the truth and come to poor Adrien's aid. If you like this remember to...
(Marinette pauses the video)
Alya: I totally warned you. He's not a true journalist. Journalists investigate. They cross reference the evidence and report on facts. He is an influencer. By definition he isn't there to inform people. His goal is to influence them.
Marinette: So, there's nothing we could do against this liar?
Alya: There is one thing that can crush these lies. The truth. And the evidence to go with it. Trixx, let's pounce. (transforms into Rena Rouge) Mirage!
(Alya transforms into her disguised form)
Rena Rouge: It's my turn to make Vincent Secret talk.
Marinette: But you can't use your power like that! (Marinette touches the illusion making it disappear)
Rena Rouge: Ladybug said that unless it's an akumatized villain. We can help out!
Marinette: If that's what Ladybug said...
Rena Rouge: Mirage!
(Alya once again transforms into her disguised form)

title: Revelator/Transcript
text:
Revelator/Transcript - Intro
Nadja Chamack: (on the TV screen) Don't bemused, it's just the news! With the spread of false information...(voice fades out)
Rena Rouge (Disguised form): Woah! You're Vincent Secret! I'm a huge fan of your work!!
Vincent: (Starting to walk away) That's nice thank you-
Rena Rouge (Disguised form): Please wait!
(Vincent stops)
Rena Rouge (Disguised form): I want to be an influencer too. Could you give me some...tips?
Vincent: I am not an influencer. I am a journalist and also in a rush, but...I could give you an autograph, I suppose.
Rena Rouge (Disguised form): Woah, thanks! Wait, I have a pen in my bag.(She starts to look through her bag.) I can't believe you get people to open up to you. As soon as I ask a question, people beat around the bush or evade answering…(She pulls out the pen.) You're so talented; it's your natural charisma, isn't it?
Vincent: It plays a part of course but that's not the only thing. Ok, so you want a tip right? (Rena nods) When a journalist asks a question they should already know the answer they wanna get. It's called the angle of attack, well I go even further...

title: Revelator/Transcript
text:
Revelator/Transcript - Intro
(Camera pans to Lucky Charm spying device hidden in plain sight. Ladybug watches the conversation on her yoyo from the roof of the cafe)
Vincent: I don't even need to ask the question.
Rena Rouge (Disguised form): Oh, You're so good!! but take the story about Adrien Agreste and Marinette Dupain-Cheng for example. How did you get the info?
Vincent: What info?
Rena Rouge (Disguised form): That she only loves him for his own self interest.
Vincent: (Laughs mockingly)..Ok, you do need advice. (He gestures for Rena to follow.)
(Vincent and Rena sit down at a cafe table)
Vincent: You'll never succeed that way.
Rena Rouge (Disguised form): What do you mean "that way"?
Vincent: Let me give you an example and you'll see. If I tell you that two teens are in love and super cute together, do you find the info interesting?
Rena Rouge (Disguised form): Uhh...not really.
Vincent: Exactly! You don't care. Zero drama means zero clicks. Now listen carefully, here's some more info. Marinette Dupain-Cheng manipulating Adrien Agreste is just the start, what she really wants is to become the wealthiest most powerful girl on earth so she can manipulate absolutely everyone on the planet!

title: Revelator/Transcript
text:
Revelator/Transcript - Intro
Rena Rouge (Disguised form): (Stands up) Woah! No way!
Vincent: Of course no way! but if the story sticks you get clicks.
Rena Rouge (Disguised form): Wow! (She sits back down) You're such a good storyteller I can almost believe it.
Vincent: The only truth is that people are stupid, all they want are exciting stories to make up for their boring lives whether they're true or not.
Rena Rouge (Disguised form): Wow! (giggles) Okay!
(Alya and Marinette are watching footage of Vincent at the computer)
Vincent: (in video) ...make up for their boring lives whether they're true or not.
Alya: Well I say the truth makes for a great story.
Marinette: Mm-hmm.
(Alya downloads the video)
Nadja Chamack: Who really is famous influencer Vincent Secret? A promising young journalist just unveiled the truth.
Alya: (On screen) Vincent Secret reveals a lot of secrets in his videos, but he's never told you how he manages to know so many of these secrets. Good thing Alya's here to inform you.
(Screen shows a recording of Vincent sitting at a cafe table)

title: Revelator/Transcript
text:
Revelator/Transcript - Intro
Vincent: (in the video) The only truth is that people are stupid. All they want are exciting stories to make up for their boring lives, whether they're true or not.
Vincent: (shocked) But... how'd she do it?
(He checks his phone and sees that his fans are unfollowing him with his subscriber charts plummets downward immediately)
Vincent: No, no! Not my followers!
Maya's dad: (Takes the coffee cup from Vincent angrily, with Phong glaring at Vincent with a contemptuous expression) We don't like liars here.
(Everyone looks at Vincent with a disapproved expression.)
(Vincent runs out in distress after seeing everybody's disapproving looks. An Ultrakuma approaches him and enters his phone)
(Chrysalis appears on Vincent's phone)
Chrysalis: Hello. Forgive my intrusion, but your emotion was so strong it called out to me. It sounded like a reputation crumbling to bits.
(Chrysalis now appears behind Vincent)

title: Revelator/Transcript
text:
Revelator/Transcript - Intro
Chrysalis: Like the humiliation of witnessing your deepest secret revealed to the entire world. Do you know what would be fitting? Since people like secrets so much, how would you like to regain the admiration you were robbed of by being able to access everyone's true secrets? I can give you that power. Only if you agree, of course.
(As she speaks, more and more silhouettes of Chrysalis keep appearing around Vincent)
Vincent: I'd be stupid to say no.
Chrysalis: And what should I call you?
Vincent: (stands up) Revelator!
(Chrysalis closes her palm)
(The blue orb rolls up to Maya, who she picks it up seeing her father eat his own boogers inside)
Maya: Dad! You eat your boogers?!
(Maya throws the orb away, Revelator picks it up and puts it inside his akumatized object)
Revelator: Now everyone will know your dad does what he forbids you to do. Revelation!
(A blue wave sends out of Revelator's gadget broadcasting Maya's father's secret to all of the phones in the city)
Revelator: From now on no one will have any secrets from anyone!
Revelator: The Paris Café owner eats his boogers! Anyone wanna frequent his establishment now?

title: Revelator/Transcript
text:
Revelator/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: This is why the best kept secrets are the ones you never share.
Alya: The truth always finds a way, Marinette. Trixx, Let's Pounce!
Marinette: Tikki, Spots On!
Rena Rouge: We'll de-evilize him and make him understand that he needs to stop lying!
(They both jump out of Marinette's bed window)
Revelator: Do you know where I can find Alya Cesaire?
Man: Ah! No, I don't know her.
Revelator: Let's find out if you're lying or not!
(Revelator shoots him with his beam, the man spits out an orb. Revelator grabs it and looks into the orb. It reveals the man wearing a toupee. A voice rings out from the rooftops)
Rena Rouge: Wanna know our secret, Revelator?
Ladybug: We're about to de-akumatize you then you'll stop lying for success!
Revelator: (puts the orb into his gadget) How about I uncover your secrets instead?!
(Ladybug and Rena Rouge dodge Revelator's lasers as they jump down and run down the street towards him. The three spar for a bit till Revelator jumps behind Ladybug, hitting her with his beam. Ladybug spits out an orb. They wrestle for the orb)
Revelator: Scoop of the century is mine! Ladybug's secret identity!

title: Revelator/Transcript
text:
Revelator/Transcript - Intro
(Ladybug hits the orb with her yoyo sending it to Rena Rouge)
Rena Rouge: (Redirects the orb with her flute back to Ladybug) I have a scoop too: In your dreams!
(Cat Noir drops into the battle almost hitting Revelator with his staff. He tries to run to the orb, but Cat Noir sends him into the wall)
Cat Noir: (He runs to the orb) Cataclysm!
Ladybug: Don't touch the ball!
Cat Noir: If I destroy it, your secret will be safe, m'lady.
Ladybug: I'll take care of it. Lucky Charm!
(An eraser drops into her hand. Revelator shoots Cat Noir while he's distracted. Cat Noir spits out an orb)
Chrysalis: Great job, Revelator. We're about to find out the two ultimate secrets: Ladybug and Cat Noir's identities.
(Revelator pounces onto Cat Noir trying to grab the orb. Cat Noir throws him off, grabbing the orb first. It is Cataclysmed, however, Cat Noir still sees the secret)
Cat Noir: You were right, m'lady. It's not safe. My power still let me see the secrets.
(Ladybug, Cat Noir, and Revelator run to Ladybug's orb. Rena Rouge stands off to the side)
Rena Rouge: Mirage!

title: Revelator/Transcript
text:
Revelator/Transcript - Intro
(The Mirage creates multiple versions of the orb, confusing Revelator. He tries shooting the fake orbs trying to find the real one. Rena runs to the real orb, lifting it up with her flute and tosses it to her hand. She looks into it)
Ladybug: No! Rena!
(The orb reveals Marinette's earlier talk with Tikki in her room)
Marinette: I couldn't tell Adrien the truth. He would have been completely ruined if he found out that Monarch was his own father.
(Rena Rouge looks at the orb, completely stunned, only able to gasp in utter shock and disbelief at what she had seen)
Cat Noir: Uh-oh...she just discovered your secret identity, huh? But that's okay, your Miraculous Ladybug will erase everything right, m'lady?
Ladybug: I hope so...
(Rena turns to look at Ladybug. Her face registers absolute anger in her stare. Ladybug looks shocked)
(Revelator runs to Rena, sparring with her)
Ladybug: Cover us, Cat Noir!
(Rena jumps back from the spar, letting Cat Noir continue. Ladybug tries to grab the orb. Rena holds it in her hand firmly)
Rena Rouge: I thought we were no longer keeping secrets from each other. (A Tram passes by, concealing them) Mirage!

title: Revelator/Transcript
text:
Revelator/Transcript - Intro
(The Mirage creates a fake Ladybug and Rena. Rena grabs Ladybug and jumps away. The tram passes and the illusions go and assist in the fight)
Rena Rouge: Does Cat Noir know that Gabriel Agreste was Monarch?
Ladybug: I don't know who Cat Noir is beneath the mask. What if he knows Adrien and tells him the truth?
Rena Rouge: But why lie to Adrien?! (shoves the orb back at Ladybug)
Ladybug: Because the truth is too harsh.
Rena Rouge: You don't get to decide what Adrien should or shouldn't know. Neither do I. Truth is essential for someone's personal growth, and now that I know I'm gonna have to lie! And you know I don't. like. Lying!
Ladybug: That's why I didn't want to tell you...
Revelator: Illusions! You two are just fake superheroes!
(Ladybug's yoyo wraps around Revelator as Rena Rouge pounces onto him wrestling him to the ground)
Rena Rouge: This is what being lied to feels like, Revelator!
Cat Noir: You lied to me, too?
(Rena Rouge takes Revelator's gadget and tosses it to Ladybug)
Ladybug: Only so we could take Revelator by surprise.
(Ladybug breaks the gadget)

title: Revelator/Transcript
text:
Revelator/Transcript - Intro
[Purification Sequence]Ladybug: No more evil doing for you, Ultrakuma. (spins yo-yo around) Time to de-evilize! (captures Ultrakuma; yo-yo closes) Gotcha! (releases butterfly) Bye bye, little butterfly.
(Revelator is de-akumatized. Vincent looks at his broken cellphone with a horrified whimper. Ladybug looks sadly at her Lucky Charm)
Cat Noir: Maybe it was meant to erase the secret Rena Rouge found out?
Rena Rouge: (looks at Ladybug with disappointment) That'd be nice. Aren't you the one saying the best kept secrets are the ones you never share?
[Superpower Sequences]Ladybug: Miraculous Ladybug!(She throws the eraser into the air, and ladybugs shoot out from it, reverting the damage done by Revelator. Vincent's cellphone is also fixed, much to his joy as he hugs it in relief. Ladybug then looks at Rena, still scowling in disappointment at her.)
Rena Rouge: It didn't work.
Cat Noir: You still know who Ladybug is?
Rena Rouge: Some secrets are heavier than others and I am afraid I won't be able to keep this one.
Cat Noir: How come it didn't work, m'lady??
Ladybug: Nothing's broken...Secrets are not physical damage.
(Rena glares angrily at Ladybug as she says the latter part)

title: Revelator/Transcript
text:
Revelator/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: Ladybug's power can fix things, not destroy them.
Ladybug: (Gets an idea and looks at Cat Noir) This time to repair things we have to destroy them...
Cat Noir: But isn't that wrong?
Rena Rouge: No. Because it's meant to give people the ability to choose whether to share their secret or not. (She looks at Ladybug) And that's repairing things.
(Ladybug walks up to Cat Noir, taking his hand and putting it up to his chest)
Ladybug: You are a good person, kitty. Trust yourself.
Cat Noir: But how do I do it?
Ladybug: Remember: There's always room to evolve.
[Superpower Sequences]Cat Noir: Cataclysm (He focuses his energy on the cataclysm lifting it to the sky, it slowly increases in size)Cat Noir: Miraculous Cat Noir! (He throws the ball into the air it explodes into destructive energy, the energy swirls around until it goes right into Rena Rouge erasing her memory of the secret)
Cat Noir: Did it work?
Rena Rouge: (Turns around) Did what work?
(Ladybug sighs with relief, Cat Noir smiles with excitement)
Ladybug: Well done, Cat Noir.
Rena Rouge: Did I miss something?
Ladybug: Only a part of it.

title: Revelator/Transcript
text:
Revelator/Transcript - Intro
(Ladybug pulls a magical charm from her yo-yo; black and white to match Vincent's color scheme. It glimmers. Ladybug takes Vincent's hand to give him the magical charm.)
Ladybug: People should be free to have secrets and share them with whomever they want whenever they want if they want to.
Vincent: And what am I supposed to do? Huh? Secrets are my thing.
Rena Rouge: Try telling the truth for a change. (Ladybug's face saddens)
Cat Noir: And stop telling lies about people's private lives.
Ladybug: The only time it's ok to reveal people's secrets is when someone is in danger.
Cerise: I too have secrets. Everyone has secrets. So do you. You, too, have lied Ladybug...
Alya: You know you can tell me if something's wrong.
Marinette: I know. Everything's fine.
Alya: May I remind you that I am a personal lie detector and it's flashing red.
Marinette: I know you can't stand secrets and lies Alya but I don't want you to hate me..

title: Revelator/Transcript
text:
Revelator/Transcript - Intro
Alya: Me? Hate you? I hope you are kidding. There's one truth I know about you; you have a big heart and whatever you do you do it for people's own good. Sure you may  make mistakes sometimes we all do, but you always put them right. So don't think of it as a lie or a secret just something that's hard to tell.
Nino: You coming in the water or what?
(Alya stands up prompting Marinette to do the same.)
Alya: Whenever you're ready to take the plunge I'll be there for you.
(Marinette grips onto Alya's hand, they both run to the water.)
Alya: Why would I hate you, Marinette?
Trixx: Right? You'd never.
Alya: Her burden is probably too heavy, Trixx. I have to figure out how to help her.
es:Revelador/Transcripción

title: Riginarazione/Transcript
text:
Riginarazione/Transcript - Intro
Gina: (sips) Mm! You're a great cook, Caramia. Now you know how to make braciola!
Marinette: Thanks, Grandma, and we can make one for Grandpa's birthday.
(Gina's watch rings, showing a broken heart with a lightning symbol in the middle. Gina is shocked.)
Marinette: Is something wrong?
Gina: No, no. Everything's fine, Marinetta. I forgot that I have to go to um... a concert.
Marinette: In the middle of the day?
Gina: Yes, it's a concert for uhm... the elderly. But we'll see each other next week anyway. Your grandma still has a lot to teach you. (kisses Marinette on her cheek) Ciao!
(Gina rushes out the room, down the stairs, and on her motorcycle. She drives as fast as she can to arrive at Roland's house. She runs in through the gate, tossing her helmet to the side, rushing inside.)
Gina: Roland, are you okay??
Roland: Hi, Gina.
Gina: But— You're alright?
Roland: Of course!
Gina: Then, why'd you make me rush over here?
Roland: So you can change the channel.
Gina: But you have a remote for that!
Roland: Yes, but I don't like these modern thingamibobs. Back in the day, that's not how it was done! You get up and press the TV!
Gina: And you made me come so I'd do just that?!

title: Riginarazione/Transcript
text:
Riginarazione/Transcript - Intro
Roland: Of course! Now the game's over.
Gina: (annoyed) Are you kidding me?! (pants angrily)
Roland: (smirks) Yes.
Gina: (sighs) I don't believe you. (crouches beside Roland) You're too much.
Roland: Actually, there's another reason why I wanted to see you.
Gina: What is it?
Roland: (sighs) This is it.
(Gina gasps as she realizes Roland has little time left. She covers her mouth to suppress her emotions.)
Roland: I sold the house, Gina. (grabs the key on the table beside him) The game is over. (hands over the key to Gina)
Gina: Can we still celebrate our 75th birthdays here?
Roland: Yes, but... then I'll have to leave the field.
Gina: Don't you think it's time you told Marinette?
Roland: No way! Back in the day, that's not how it was done!
Gina: Well, times have changed. That's how it's done now.
(She hands over the telephone to Roland, who looks at the yeast container on the table beside him. Roland grabs the yeast container and takes a good look at it before making his decision.)
Roland: I'll talk to her. (puts down the phone Gina's holding)
[ Theme Song ]

title: Riginarazione/Transcript
text:
Riginarazione/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: I just finished these soccer jerseys. They look pretty good, right? I also made one for Grandpa Roland as a gift for his birthday.
Adrien: They look amazing, Marinette. Well done!
Marinette: Now all we got to do is learn how to play.
Adrien: Speaking of, I'm waiting for you. (shows his foosball table to the camera)
(Marinette and Adrien give each other air kisses over the screen. Tikki emerges from Marinette's purse.)
Tikki: You're into soccer now, Marinette?
Marinette: If Adrien is, then, yes. (takes off her jersey)
(Tikki giggles. Scene changes to the living room. Marinette goes downstairs to join Gina, Tom and Sabine, who are decorating Gina and Roland's birthday cake, which is seen to have the number "150".)
Marinette: Hey, everyone! I'm going out. (notices the cake) But Grandpa and Grandma aren't a hundred and fifty!
Gina: When your grandfather and I were still married, we'd always celebrate our birthdays together, even though we weren't born on the same day. And now that we're friends again, thanks to you, we're reviving the tradition. Seventy-five years plus seventy-five years make one hundred fifty years! (puts two cookies in her can of cookies)

title: Riginarazione/Transcript
text:
Riginarazione/Transcript - Intro
(Marinette's phone rings and she sees Roland calling.)
Marinette: (answers her phone) Grandpa, how are you? What— Right now? But, uh, I'm about to go on a date with Adrien. And besides, I'll see you tonight at your birthday party. Are you sure? Can't we do it another day?
Gina: (grabbing Marinette's phone) Your granddaughter will be there in ten. (hangs up and tosses the phone back to Marinette)
Marinette: But Grandma, I didn't say yes!
Tom: For your grandfather to use a phone, it means he probably has something very important to tell you.
Marinette: Alright. I'll drop by quickly, and then, I'm off to Adrien's. (opens the door) See ya!
(Marinette leaves the room. Tom, Sabine, and Gina look at each other, worried.)
Marinette: I'm just making a detour to my Grandpa's and I'll be on my way.
Adrien: (on the phone) No problem, Marinette. Take all the time you need.
(As she hangs up, she runs inside the house.)
Marinette: Hi, Grandpa! I'm here! What did you want to tell me?
Roland: Um...So, yes... well, I... (clears his throat and strokes his yeast container) I wanted to tell you that, uhm... that...
Marinette: That...?

title: Riginarazione/Transcript
text:
Riginarazione/Transcript - Intro
Roland: That today is the perfect day to... teach you how to make Parisian Croûte!
Marinette: Parisian Croûte? What's that?
Roland: Uhh...
Marinette: (Typing on her phone) There's nothing about it online.
Roland: (Puts his hand on Marinette's phone to keep her away from it) Yes, of course. That's because it used to be called the "Lutetian Croûte"! It was the greatest creation of our indomitable ancestor...
Roland and Marinette: Loafamix the Gaul!
Roland: Today, I'm the only one left who knows how to make it.
Marinette: You didn't teach it to Dad?
Roland: Uh, he didn't like it.
Marinette: And, uhm, how long does it take to make?
Roland: As long as it takes.
Marinette: Okay, then, we'll really have to do this another day. Adrien's waiting for me. (about to leave the room)
Roland: No, no, no. It's now or never.
(Marinette groans. She then proceeds to mix dough in the kitchen.)
Marinette: Okay, Grandpa. I'm done!
Roland: No! I-I mean, not yet. You should, uh, you should add... fish sauce!
Marinette: Fish sauce...? Are you sure?

title: Riginarazione/Transcript
text:
Riginarazione/Transcript - Intro
Roland: Of course, I'm sure! In ancient times, they used garum, a.k.a. fermented fish. But things change, and now we use fish sauce. (pauses) That's right, things change, like... like... like this Minitel, for example.
Marinette: (while mixing) You mean that plastic cube?
Roland: That cube was the Internet's ancestor. It would give you access to train schedules, weather forecasts, sports scores... It even featured games and discussion forums. Those days are gone. Now, everything's in your phones. That's how it is. One day, old things make way for new things. And that's fine. Do you understand?
Marinette: Uh, yeah, yeah! So, can I put this in the oven now? 'Cause I really have to go. (shows Roland the mixture)
Roland: No, no, no! Your dough is... too thin. You need to add more flour.
(Marinette groans and goes back to the kitchen again.)
Roland: And you see, well, that Minitel... maybe one day, you'll remember it. And you'll want to see it again, but it will be gone. And when that day comes, you shouldn't be sad, okay?
Marinette: Yeah, yeah! I promise, Grandpa! I promise you that I won't feel sad about the Minitel. Really. It looks okay now, doesn't it? (shows the mixture again)

title: Riginarazione/Transcript
text:
Riginarazione/Transcript - Intro
Roland: Almost. It just needs... thyme! Thyme's essential to the recipe.
(Once again, Marinette groans. She walks back to the kitchen with two heavy feet.)
Roland: You see that Minitel has lived a good Minitel's life. It's told the forecast to its users as much as it could. It's had many connections. And now that its system is down, we can put it back in its box with no regrets.
Marinette: Ah! I think I get it now. You want us to fix your Mini-thing over here. Is that it? I know you don't like to throw away old things.
Roland: No, no! What I'm trying to say is... sometimes, old things are just glad to have had their day and to have met Marinettes.
Marinette: Ooookay...? Uhm, so, Grandpa, thanks for your stories about the Mini-thing but... I think we're done now, right?
Roland: Hmm? Right... (takes another look at his yeast container)
Marinette: Great! I'm off, then. You keep an eye on it. Thank you! See you tonight! (takes off her apron)
Roland: Marinette, wait!
Marinette: I'm out of time, Grandpa. We'll talk tonight. (opens the door to leave)
Roland: (clutches on his yeast container) There's no such thing as Parisian Croûte.

title: Riginarazione/Transcript
text:
Riginarazione/Transcript - Intro
(Marinette stops walking upon hearing Roland's words. She goes back and talks to him.)
Marinette: Then, what did we just cook?
Roland: I was just trying to find the words to tell you, but I failed.
Marinette: Is something wrong, Grandpa?
Roland: Come sit next to me. (Marinette sits next to him.) Marinette, soon, I'll have to leave this place.
Marinette: But, this house is your whole life! Why would you want to leave it?
(Roland simply and fondly smiles at Marinette, and even though words weren't conveyed, she realizes that his time is almost up in this world. Marinette gasps, on the verge of crying.)
Roland: The doctors told me that my heart is too weak. I've been through a lot in this house, you know? But now, I'm worn out. I don't have enough strength for all those stairs, to keep those rooms clean. I'm tired, cupcake. I have to leave.
Marinette: No! That's... that's not possible!
Roland: I've had a wonderful, full life here. I'm ready.
Marinette: But— But I'm not! I barely had any time to enjoy this house with you.

title: Riginarazione/Transcript
text:
Riginarazione/Transcript - Intro
Roland: That's why I wanted us to spend time together. I wanted to give you this. (hands over the yeast container to Marinette) It contains my yeast — the secret ingredient that's been giving its wonderful taste to our family's bread for generations. It's time for you to inherit it.
Marinette: (stands up, tears shedding in her eyes) I don't want it! It's yours! It's your yeast, and I'm staying here with you!
Roland: But this is how it's done.
Marinette: Well, I don't want to do it like this! I don't want things to change!! (runs off)
Roland: Marinette, wait!
(Marinette rushes her way out, in tears. She can't accept that her Grandpa has little time left. She can't accept that her Grandpa will soon no longer not be with them anymore. She then runs to an empty alley.)
Marinette: (crying) Tikki, spots on!
(She transforms into Ladybug and swings up on the roofs. She swings as hard and as fast as she could, while a person named Saladin Martine watches her. Her tears fly off with the wind as she cries in denial that her dear Grandpa will soon depart. She arrives at another rooftop and lands on her knees as she de-transforms.)
Ladybug: (crying) Spots off!

title: Riginarazione/Transcript
text:
Riginarazione/Transcript - Intro
Tikki: Don't cry, Marinette. I'm sure we can come up with a solution.
Marinette: (crying) No magic power can fix this, Tikki. This is so unfair!
Marinette: Ten-zero!
Adrien: You already know how to play, don't you?
Marinette: Not at all! Must be beginner's luck. I know it doesn't seem fair but that's life! Come on! How about another game?! An even less fair one! (puts the ball in the foosball machine as she aggressively spins the rod) There! Just like I said: zero fairness!! Come on, let's keep going!
Adrien: Marinette, did something happen with your Grandpa earlier?
Marinette: Of course not. Things are just fine with my Grandpa. Life is perfect! Super perfect! It's not cruel at all!!
(Adrien places his hand on Marinette's on the rod she's holding, halting her from playing the game.)
Adrien: You don't have to tell me what's wrong if you don't want to.
(He pulls her in for a hug, in which Marinette bursts into tears. Adrien goes out for a quick moment only to come back with a warm drink and gives it to Marinette.)
Marinette: (sobbing, tucked in a futon with tissues next to her) Sorry. It feels good to tell you but it's making me cry, too.

title: Riginarazione/Transcript
text:
Riginarazione/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: That's okay. (places his hand on her knees) You can cry as much as you need. Tears allow sadness to flow out little by little.
Marinette: (sobbing) Really? You... You think?
Adrien: Of course. Letting go of the sadness allows room in your heart to enjoy all the good memories you've shared with your Grandpa in that house.
Marinette: Like... Parisian Croûte?
Adrien: Like what?
Marinette: (sniffles) It's an absurd recipe he made me cook to try to get his point across, but it turns out, the dish doesn't even exist.
Adrien: It does now, Marinette. You made it with your grandfather, which means now Parisian Croûte does exist. It's a memory of the time you've shared with him before he goes. (scooches in closer to Marinette and puts his arm around her) How was it, by the way? The croûte?
Marinette: I don't know. (sniffles) I left before I could try it.
Adrien: That's a shame, don't you think?
Marinette: Would you come and try it with me? (smiles)
Adrien: Oh, that's delicious!
Gina: Si, è delizioso!
Tom: Mm-mm! How'd you do it, Dad?
Roland: How did we do it? Marinette cooked it.
Marinette: So, Grandpa, does it taste better than Loafamix the Gaul's version?

title: Riginarazione/Transcript
text:
Riginarazione/Transcript - Intro
Roland: (laughs) You bet it does! I'll teach you too if you want, or rather better even, Marinette will teach you!
(Tom laughs)
Marinette: Okay, but on one condition: next time, we're using real garum.
Roland: Yes!
Roland and Marinette: That's how it's done!

title: Riginarazione/Transcript
text:
Riginarazione/Transcript - Intro
(Everyone shares a hearty laughter. Scene shows a montage of photographs. First, Roland holding his Marinette-tailored jersey. Next, Gina holding up her jersey, printed with her name and a number "75" on it. Then, Adrien takes a picture of Gina, Roland, and Marinette. Food on the table are seen next, and then it shows the whole family eating together. Gina looks around, first at Sabine and Marinette. She gets a blast to the past, as she sees little Marinette with a younger Sabine playing together. Then, she looks to her left and sees a young version of Roland feeding baby Tom, who's sitting in a highchair. She hopes all of it would last forever. Adrien then turns on the record player and invites Marinette to dance with him. Seeing the two dance together, Gina starts reminiscing again, this time, back in the days where she and Roland danced together like them too. She smiles at the memory. Tom is then seen bringing the birthday cake over, with the "150" candle all lit up. Gina reminisces again, when Roland brings over a birthday cake with a "40" candle" on it. Gina tears up at the memory.)
Tom, Sabine, Adrien, and Marinette: ♫ Happy birthday to you! ♫

title: Riginarazione/Transcript
text:
Riginarazione/Transcript - Intro
(Tom puts the birthday cake on the table. Gina and Roland blow the candles together. But as Roland blows the candle, his vision starts to blur, darkens, and he falls toward the cake. Tom comes to the rescue and catches him before he falls.)
Tom: Dad!
(Gina gasps and stands up.)
Roland: It's nothing. I just blew a little too hard on the candle.
Sabine: Are you sure you're okay, Roland?
(Gina starts to panic at the situation.)
Roland: Yes, yes. I just think it's time for me to... (groans)
Marinette: You okay, Grandma?
Gina: Sì, sì, va bene. I guess I blew too hard on the candle, too.
(Tom carries Roland, bridal-carry style, upstairs. Adrien, Marinette, and Sabine follow them. Gina is left behind.)
Roland: What are you doing? That's not how it's done! I'm okay, seriously. Put me down now!
(Gina grabs her can of cookies and sits down, letting herself cry. Just then, an Ultrakuma flies in the window and infests the can.)
Chrysalis:  Good evening. Forgive my intrusion, but I sensed a fear so strong that it called out to me.
Gina:  Me? Afraid? Nonsense. You're wrong!

title: Riginarazione/Transcript
text:
Riginarazione/Transcript - Intro
Chrysalis: Of course, that's what you think. You thought you were ready, but in reality, you wish you could go back to the delightful time when everything seemed like it would never end.
Gina: If only that was possible...
Chrysalis: (puts her hands on Gina's shoulders) It is possible if you want it. Let me give you this gift.
Gina: Really?
Chrysalis: Of course. What should I call you?
Gina: Riginarazione!
Chrysalis: Happy birthday, Riginarazione.
(Chrysalis' silhouette closes her hand, engulfing Gina.)
Roland: No, I don't need someone to get me a glass of water. That's not how it's done.
Sabine: Roland, be reasonable.
Marinette: Grandpa, wait!
Roland: Leave me alone! I can still walk to the— (sees Riginarazione) Oh! What are you doing in my house?!
Riginarazione: I'm here to make you twenty again!
Roland: Gina?!
Tom: Mom?!
Marinette: Grandma??
Adrien: Signora Gina?!
Riginarazione: I'm no longer Signora Gina, or "Mom", or "Grandma". I am... Riginarazione! (fires her gun at Roland who turns several decades younger)
Young Roland: What have you done to me?
Riginarazione: I've given you your youth back!
Young Roland: But why?
Riginarazione: So you can have another chance!

title: Riginarazione/Transcript
text:
Riginarazione/Transcript - Intro
Sabine: Gina, please be reasonable!
Tom: Let's all talk it out together.
Riginarazione: No. Let's start over together!
(As Sabine dodges Riginarazione's pink bolts, Tom gets hit instead and transforms him into baby Tom, who cries. Sabine cradles him to pacify him. Riginarazione picks up 20-year-old Roland.)
Young Roland: Hey!
Riginarazione: Now you get to do everything you never had the time for!
Marinette: (to Adrien) Can you stay with my parents? I'm going to follow Grandma and Grandpa to find out where they're going.
Adrien: Okay. But be careful, Marinette!
(Marinette rushes off. Riginarazione mounts her motorcycle with Roland.)
Riginarazione: Where do you want to go? We have all night! (revs up her motorcycle)
Young Roland: I don't know. I've never stayed up so late. (Riginarazione rides away with him, flying through the air.) AAAHH!
Riginarazione: Oh, you're a youngster again. Now's not the time to act like a little old man!
Young Roland: This isn't about age. I have to get up early to make bread! Take me back home!
Riginarazione: First, we take a walk. (throttles her motorcycle in the air.)
Young Roland: That's not how you take a walk!! (flies away with Riginarazione)

title: Riginarazione/Transcript
text:
Riginarazione/Transcript - Intro
(Marinette runs to an empty alley.)
Tikki: Looks like there's no time to waste, Marinette!
Marinette: Tell me about it. Tikki, spots on! (transforms into Ladybug and swings away)
(Riginarazione continues to ride along with Young Roland. They fly over the train tracks and then fly to a party in a boat in the Seine.)
Riginarazione: You've never went out dancing. Come on! You're going to love it! (runs as she drags Young Roland along)
Young Roland: No, no, no. I don't even know the song!
Riginarazione: Let me handle this. (taps XY on his shoulder)
XY: Huh?
Riginarazione: Hey, DJ Guy, play "The Ballad of Blue Birds". It was a hit back in our time. (giggles)
XY: That's not a song of our time. It's for old people.
Riginarazione: You don't say "old", you say "signore"! (fires green bolts at XY, turning him old and making him look and sound just like his father)
(The people at the boat run away in fear.)
Young Roland: Gina, that's not how it's done!
Old XY: (removes his sunglasses) Give me a minute. I'm not as young as I used to be.
Riginarazione: Come on, let's dance! (selects La Ballade des Oiseaux Bleus in the playlist)
Young Roland: But I never liked dancing!

title: Riginarazione/Transcript
text:
Riginarazione/Transcript - Intro
(As the music plays, Riginarazione pulls Young Roland to the dance floor. They dance like there's no tomorrow. Just then, Ladybug hurls her yo-yo and wraps it around Riginarazione's wrist.)
Ladybug: Leave him alone, Grandma! I-I mean, Ma'am!
Riginarazione: I'm no "Grandma". I'm Riginarazione, and I still have all the time in the world! (fires green bolts at Ladybug)
(As Ladybug evades Riginarazione's green bolts, it hits the beams, which make them look aged — rusty. Ladybug uses her yo-yo as a shield to deflect the green bolts. She jumps onto a rusty beam, losing her balance, falls off and gets hit by Riginarazione's green bolt, making her older, with a new hairstyle, as she gets up and looks at her new body)
Adult Ladybug: No...! What's happening to me?
Riginarazione: If you keep wasting your time trying to stop me, Ladybug, you'll eventually run out.
(The villain maniacally laughs and continues to fire green bolts at Adult Ladybug. Riginarazione fires a green bolt at the concrete foot bridge, which breaks on its own, and Adult Ladybug falls off. Young Roland, who is hiding behind a barrel, is dragged off by Riginarazione once again.)

title: Riginarazione/Transcript
text:
Riginarazione/Transcript - Intro
Riginarazione: The party goes on, Roland. (puts him on the motorcycle) We have our whole lives! (flies off)
(Adult Ladybug emerges from the rubble.)
Adrien: Good thing Mister Roland never throws anything away.
Sabine: This should do while Ladybug and Cat Noir put things in order.
Adrien: Mrs. Dupain-Cheng, do you mind if I go out to see if Marinette needs help?
Sabine: Of course not, Adrien. That's nice of you.
(Baby Tom cooes. Adrien runs outside to transform.)
Plagg: Finally, it was starting to feel like time was dragging.
Adrien: You know what they say: "Patience is a virtue." Plagg, claws out! (transforms into Cat Noir and tosses himself up the roofs)
Cat Noir: Woo-hoo-hoo!
(Meanwhile, Riginarazione and Young Roland continue to fly above the rooftops of Paris. The two of them arrive at Café Crème, which scares patrons away.)
Riginarazione: Now's your chance to try all the dishes you never tasted!
Young Roland: But I don't like going out to eat. I always preferred making my own meals, (picks up a bowl of biscuits) and my own cookies.
Riginarazione: Bring me one of everything on the menu!
Café owner: You're too late, Ma'am. Kitchens closed.

title: Riginarazione/Transcript
text:
Riginarazione/Transcript - Intro
Riginarazione: You're too late, and I have no time to lose! (fires green bolts at the owner, making him old and frail)
Old Café owner: (frailly) What's happening to me?
Riginarazione: If you don't want to lose another five years, you better re-open the kitchen!
(Adult Ladybug grabs the owner with her yo-yo, putting him in a safe place.)
Riginarazione: (growls) If you don't stop, you'll give yourself gray hair, Ladybug!
(As Riginarazione fires green bolts at Adult Ladybug, the superheroine swiftly evades the villain's attacks. One of the lampposts where Ladybug's yo-yo is anchored gets hit by the green bolt, and so it becomes rusty and crumbles into pieces. This makes Adult Ladybug lose her balance. She crawls away to escape Riginarazione's attacks. Cat Noir joins in the scene.)
Cat Noir: Woah, M'Lady! Looks like you're the grown-up in the room!
Adult Ladybug: Yes, and if we want to enjoy our youth, we better find the villain's akumatized object fast!

title: Riginarazione/Transcript
text:
Riginarazione/Transcript - Intro
(The heroes escape Riginarazione, but one of the green bolts hit a bus's tire, which flattens it, causing the bus to lose control. Cat Noir sees a pedestrian with a stroller, where the bus is heading at. He extends his staff to prevent the bus from hitting the pedestrian. Then, Cat Noir gets hit by a bunch of Riginarazione's pink bolts, eventually making the feline superhero... a baby.)
Baby Cat Noir: Meow~ (cooes)
Chrysalis: Now's your chance! Seize his Miraculous!
(Riginarazione flies to Baby Cat Noir.)
Adult Ladybug: Cat Noir, look out!
Baby Cat Noir: Cat-cwysm! (touches the concrete, breaking it and falls in the subway)
Adult Ladybug: Come on! (jumps into the hole that Baby Cat Noir fell in and saves him before the train arrives) What am I going to do with you, huh?
(Riginarazione escapes once again. Young Roland looks back at them, holding the bowl of biscuits. Adult Ladybug goes back up the surface with Baby Noir.)
Adult Ladybug: And we've lost track of Riginarazione!
(Baby Noir spots Adult Ladybug's earring and takes it off of her ear, causing Ladybug to begin detransforming.)

title: Riginarazione/Transcript
text:
Riginarazione/Transcript - Intro
Adult Ladybug: Hey! Not so fast, Kitty Cat. (quickly puts her earring back on and stops her detransformation) That was close.
(Just as looks back, Baby Noir has disappeared from her sight.)
Adult Ladybug: Cat Noir?!
Baby Cat Noir: Ookie! (grabs the cookie but it gets destroyed by his Cataclysm, he then cries, then spots another cookie.) Ah! Ookie! (crawls to it and grabs it but it gets destroyed too when he touches it, and he throws a tantrum again)
Adult Ladybug: (picks up Baby Noir) You're not supposed to eat food off the ground, Kitty! Oh! (spots the pieces of biscuits on the pavement through her lucky vision) Woah! Well-spotted, Kitty Cat! Looks like Roland has left us a trail!
(At a clothing store, Riginarazione browses some clothes.)
Riginarazione: Come, Roland! You never took the time to dress properly. Let's change that!
Young Roland: Why not! Okay, yes! (nervously chuckles)

title: Riginarazione/Transcript
text:
Riginarazione/Transcript - Intro
Adult Ladybug: (lands on the corner of a roof) If I come any closer, Riginarazione will fire at me like she did the last time. We're going to need a little help. Lucky Charm! (gets a baby carrier) I'm not going to take you to fight with me, am I? (With her lucky vision, she spots Riginarazione's gun, and Baby Noir's Cataclysm.) Want more cookies, Kitty? (secures the baby carrier on her body with Baby Noir in it as he's babbling) If you give me a good Cataclysm, you're in for a treat! (swings to Riginarazione) Time to lay down your arms, Riginarazione!
Riginarazione: (tosses the clothes aside) Never!
(As Riginarazione once again fires green bolts at Adult Ladybug, the superheroine wraps her yo-yo around her gun. While she fires, she pulls herself closer to the villain.)
Riginarazione: Don't come any closer, Ladybug. You're not going to stop this young man from enjoying life!
Young Roland: But I don't want any of this! Not dancing or eating at restaurants or buying new clothes. These shorts are enough for me! When they wear out, I just change the buttons and that's it.
Adult Ladybug: Listen to him and reject the Ultrakuma!
Riginarazione: Never!

title: Riginarazione/Transcript
text:
Riginarazione/Transcript - Intro
(Adult Ladybug continuously gets hit by the green bolts, making her older and older, until she turns into an old lady.)
Riginarazione: Not so clever now, Grannybug!
Baby Cat Noir: Ookie!
(As Grannybug and Baby Noir get closer to Riginarazione, Baby Noir reaches for the guns container with the candies and finally destroys the weapon, ejecting the Ultrakuma.)
Grannybug: No more evil-doing for you, Ultrakuma. Time to de-evilize! (catches the Ultrakuma) Gotcha! (opens her yo-yo) Bye-bye, little butterfly!
(Riginarazione turns back into Gina.)
Gina: (falls on her knees) What happened?
Young Roland: I think you got afraid that I didn't live my life to the fullest.
Gina: I wish you could've had so much more time.
Young Roland: You have nothing to worry about. I've spent my life inside my bakery by choice, and it made me very happy. We have a great son, and he and Sabine have given us a great granddaughter. I have no regrets. That's how I wanted to do it. (offers his hand for Gina to take as he pulls her up to stand) You shouldn't have regrets either.
(Gina and Young Roland share a heartfelt embrace. Grannybug looks at them with endearing eyes.)

title: Riginarazione/Transcript
text:
Riginarazione/Transcript - Intro
Grannybug: Excuse me. Could you hold this for me, please? (Gina holds Baby Noir.) Miraculous Ladybug! (throws the baby carrier in the air and restores all the damage caused by the villain, restoring herself back to her younger, teenage self alongside Cat Noir being restored to his teenage self, while Roland is restored to his older age. Elsewhere, Tom is restored to his adult form, to Sabine's surprise, and all the other objects or people affected are returned to normal as well. Upon being returned to her younger self, Ladybug smiles with relief at having her youth and restored strength back.)
Cat Noir: (while being in Gina's arms) Ga-ga! (Gina looks surprised.) Just kidding.
(Ladybug brings out a magical charm and gives it to Gina.)
Ladybug: Let this magical charm help you to remember to have no regrets.
Ladybug and Cat Noir: Pound it!
(As Cat Noir jumps away, Ladybug goes to hide behind a wall. Gina walks Roland back home, and Ladybug takes one last glance at her Grandpa.)
Ladybug: Goodbye. (swings away)
Cerise: You think you can control the course of events, Ladybug. But my time will come, too. I promise you.

title: Rigger
text:
Rigger - Intro
is a secondary antagonist of "Miraculous Tokyo" and its spin-off anime series "Miraculous Stellar Force". He is a creature created by Moddler, who aids him in his quest to obtain the Stellar Matrix fragments.

title: Rigger
text:
Rigger - Appearance
Rigger is a creature nearly 13 feet tall, its body composed of various rocks and stones. The upper half of its body, including its head and torso, is made of Lava 'a'a (or Cheire), largely solidified with a black crust, although traces of lava remain. Its head is conical, reminiscent of volcanic cones and craters, with a slit extending toward one of its eyes. It has two eyes with yellow sclera and red pupils, reflecting the different colors of lava and magma. It has two arms: the left one made of purple stone and the right one of a particularly solid brown rock. The lower half, from its hips to its feet, is composed of various pieces of gray rock arranged in an irregular pattern.

title: Rigger
text:
Rigger - Personality
Rigger appears to have inherited the evil of its creator, taking perverse pleasure in transforming humans into kaijū and serving its creator.

title: Rigger
text:
Rigger - Abilities
Rigger appears to possess incredible strength and is capable of jumping very far. When Moddler equipped him with transformation modules, he was able to transform humans into kaijū, or fish into minions.

title: Roger Raincomprix
text:
Roger Raincomprix - Intro
Lieutenant  (also known as Agent Roger or, formerly, Officer Roger) is a recurring character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He is a policeman and Sabrina Raincomprix's father.
In "Rogercop", when he was fired by André Bourgeois for refusing to arrest Marinette Dupain-Cheng for stealing Chloé Bourgeois's bracelet without evidence, which would be in violation of the law, he was akumatized by Hawk Moth and became Rogercop, a robotic police supervillain.
In "Kuro Neko", Roger was reakumatized into Rogercop by Shadow Moth for unknown reasons.
In "Daddycop", after being called by Sabrina to pick her up and hearing her say no one wanted to be her friend, he is akumatized by Chrysalis into Daddycop, an upgraded version of his previous akumatization as Rogercop. He also received a Magical Charm from Ladybug that prevented him from being akumatized again.

title: Roger Raincomprix
text:
Roger Raincomprix - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Roger is at a medium height and a bit overweight. He has pale skin, short orange hair on the back and sides (but has gone bald on the top as revealed in "Startrain") and eyebrows, vivid spring green eyes, and a large nose.
Civilian Attire
His police cap is dark blue and has the word "police" written in all uppercase white letters. He wears a blue polo shirt with a badge with the flag of France on his right arm. His shirt has three buttons, and beneath them are light blue lines. On his right wrist, he wears a wristwatch and on his left wrist, he wears a medical bracelet. He also wears dark blue pants with a black belt, a baton attached to the belt, and black work boots. His silver police whistle dangles from his neck, like a necklace.
As Rogercop

title: Roger Raincomprix
text:
Roger Raincomprix - Appearance
Rogercop was taller and more muscular, and he wore a dark blue armored jumpsuit. His chest, hands, the underside of his upper arms, behind, back of his legs, and hips were black. The police whistle was still around his neck. Also, he had light blue lines around where his blasters were on the back up his forearms, around the black on his chest, and around the bottom of his feet. His skin was quite pale, and a hollow light blue triangle pointing downwards was at the center of his chest. His helmet included a light blue line above a light blue shield in front of his eyes. His left shoulder and right shoulder had a blinking red light and blue light, respectively.
As Daddycop

title: Roger Raincomprix
text:
Roger Raincomprix - Appearance
Daddycop's appearance was an upgrade of his original form. In this form, his helmet was more cylindrical in shape. It lost the line above it in favor of a silver spot and his shield became black and almost butterfly-shaped, completely blocking his eyes. The area around his mouth was more square-like in shape. The neck piece was slightly modified in shape. The chest piece was now completely dark blue with two white lights, resembling those on a police car. His shoulder pauldrons were bigger. The wrist armor had more padding and blue accents, ditching the original lining. His leg armor was also more intricate in structure, with less details on the waist. He floated on his police car, which was modified to match his appearance.

title: Roger Raincomprix
text:
Roger Raincomprix - Personality
Roger is a dedicated police officer who firmly believes in the principle that everyone is innocent until proven guilty. In "Rogercop", he disobeys Mr. Bourgeois's orders to arrest Marinette without sufficient evidence, as he believes that would violate the law; this decision results in his temporary suspension. Roger is known for being strict, as demonstrated when he throws Xavier Ramier out of the Trocadéro in "Mr. Pigeon" for his habit of feeding the pigeons. He also takes pride in the police's ability to handle situations without outside help, telling Ladybug in "Copycat" that her assistance is unnecessary. However, he can be excessive in dealing with lawbreakers. In both "Gigantitan" and "Gorizilla", he piled numerous tickets to Placide. for seemingly minor offenses, even asserting that he tickets Anarka Couffaine in "Captain Hardrock" for reasons such as "bad behavior", claiming that it made him use too many tickets, which disrupts his sleep and makes him seasick. Despite his strictness and pride in his duties, when not focused on work, Roger is friendly, loving towards his daughter, and kind to others.

title: Roger Raincomprix
text:
Roger Raincomprix - Personality
Roger loves his daughter very much, but his love can sometimes lead him to be overly protective. When he notices that she is feeling sad, he goes to great lengths to help her, even if his actions prevent her from processing her emotions independently. After being de-akumatized from his persona as Daddycop, Ladybug reassured him that Sabrina is very capable of handling her own struggles, thanks in part to having him as a father.
As Rogercop, he became a merciless, emotionless, law-abiding figure who forced civilians to comply with what he believed were the rules. He sought order and obedience and was not tolerant of anyone questioning his authority. His desire for revenge also fueled him, particularly regarding his anger towards André for firing him.
As Daddycop, he became determined to help Sabrina make as many friends as possible. However, this obsession made him unaware that Sabrina doesn’t want to be forced into friendships; she desires to be loved for who she truly is.

title: Roger Raincomprix
text:
Roger Raincomprix - Abilities
As Rogercop
Rogercop had blasters on his forearms that shot handcuffs, one of them red and the other blue. When they attached to people, he could command them and blow his whistle to make them do whatever he wanted, whether for a short period of time or continuously. The blasters could also fire tracking devices, which allowed Rogercop to easily locate anyone or anything they attached to, like André Bourgeois' limousine. He was also able to attach his shoes to moving surfaces. Another ability of the blasters was shooting a laser beam, allowing him to break down doors.
His car, having gotten an upgrade when he was akumatized, was able to fly. It also had an autopilot option so that he could do other tasks without having to drive.
As Daddycop
Similar to Rogercop, Daddycop has a flying car and blasters on his forearms. Anyone hit by his blasters will become infatuated with his daughter Sabrina and will chase her down so they can love her the way he does. The pupils of people affected by their lasers turn bright pale pink.

title: Roger Raincomprix
text:
Roger Raincomprix - Relationships
Family
Sabrina Raincomprix/Miss Hound
Sabrina is his daughter, whom he loves a lot. In "Santa Claws", he reassures her that they'll find her friend, the missing Adrien Agreste. His love for his daughter shows that he listens to Sabrina and thereby loses negative emotions in "Startrain". In "Mega Leech", when he received a call from Miss Bustier, Roger Raincomprix was quick to inquire about his daughter's wellbeing.
He likely knew that Sabrina and Chloé were friends but Sabrina didn't tell him that she took part in Chloé's bullying of several other students especially Marinette. Probably also because Sabrina knew what her father would say or do if he knew telling Sabrina to end her friendship with Chloé immediately or confront Chloé's father about her behavior likely risking his job in the process.

title: Roger Raincomprix
text:
Roger Raincomprix - Relationships
In "Daddycop", it is shown that Roger also shows great care for Sabrina. He would become worried with his daughter, thinking that maybe she was struggling to make new friends, something that Sabrina tried to hide by pretending she had a new group of friends. After a distraught Sabrina called him to pick her up and told him no one would become friends with her, his worry and overprotectiveness over her wellbeing causes Roger to be akumatized into Daddycop, who proceeds to force everyone to be Sabrina's friend.
When it comes to Miss Hound, despite not knowing she is his daughter, Roger seems to appreciate her, as seen in "Daddycop".
Friends/Allies
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/Ladybug
In the few instances Roger has interacted with Marinette, he treats her respectfully while still acting professionally. He silently and suspiciously stares at her when she retrieves a pigeon feather at the Trocadéro in "Mr. Pigeon", but he smiles at her after she leaves. Also, he defies André's orders to search Marinette for Chloé's bracelet in "Rogercop", as he firmly believes in not breaking the law and jumping to conclusions without solid evidence.

title: Roger Raincomprix
text:
Roger Raincomprix - Relationships
With Ladybug, Roger appreciates her and Cat Noir's work as long as they don't cause any trouble for the public or the police. In "Stoneheart", he accuses Ladybug of failing with Stoneheart previously and commands for her and Cat Noir to stay out of the police's way. The police officer and superhero also disagree about Cat Noir's innocence in "Copycat". Although stubborn at times with Ladybug, he knows that she truly cares about protecting Paris. In particular situations, he openly wants her and Cat Noir to save him and others, like when he and other police officers get captured by the titular villain in "Mr. Pigeon". Also, he sometimes shows pure gratitude towards her and her heroics, including when she destroys Hawk Moth's akuma projection in "Stoneheart" and when her Miraculous Ladybug returns the Mona Lisa in "Copycat".
In "Frightningale", he apparently admires Ladybug enough that he auditions for the role of Ladybug in Clara Nightingale's music video, though he doesn't get the part.

title: Roger Raincomprix
text:
Roger Raincomprix - Relationships
As Rogercop, he sees Ladybug and Cat Noir as being no longer needed to protect Paris. It takes a little time before he starts thinking of them as lawbreakers, as once he replaces André as the head power of Paris, he declares Ladybug and Cat Noir as fugitives.
Adrien Agreste/Cat Noir
Roger doesn't know Adrien personally, however because he knows that Sabrina sees him as a friend, he determinedly searches for him with her in "Santa Claws".
Rogercop feels the same about Cat Noir as he does with Ladybug, liking their heroics while not being troublesome to Parisians and the police. When Copycat impersonates Cat Noir and steals the Mona Lisa in the episode of the same name, Roger firmly believes that Cat Noir is the culprit, leading the superhero into a trap, but after the real culprit was deakumatized he started to be nice to Cat Noir again as seen in later episodes.
André Bourgeois

title: Roger Raincomprix
text:
Roger Raincomprix - Relationships
Roger respects and served André during his time as mayor, but he didn't agree with André's impulsive orders that go against the law. Despite André commanding him to search Marinette, even stressing his authority as mayor, Roger stands his ground on not disobeying the law. While being Rogercop, he goes after André and blackmails him with his daughter so André will give Rogercop authority over Paris. After he is returned to normal, Roger gets promoted by André for finding Chloé's bracelet, and Roger thanks him, saying he is proud to be on the police force.
It's currently unknown how their relationship are after André stept down as mayor.

title: Roger Raincomprix
text:
Roger Raincomprix - Etymology
Rogercop is a reference to the titular character of the sci-fi movie RoboCop.
As with most of the characters in the show, Roger's names is a wordplay in French. In this case, Roger Raincomprix sounds like Roh j'ai rien compris, meaning "Er, I didn't get it".
His name might also be a reference to "roger", used by policemen and military in radio communications to indicate that a message has been received and understood.

title: Roger Raincomprix
text:
Roger Raincomprix - Trivia
Roger becomes Rogercop a second time, when the Puppeteer turning him back by using a doll of his villain form in the episode of the same name.
In "Sandboy", it's revealed that his greatest fear is getting persued by the law himself.
A scarlet version of Rogercop reappeared in the two-part special event "Heroes' Day".
In "Gamer 2.0", Rogercop returns as a playable akumatized villain as part of the Gamer 2.0's powers.
A statue of Rogercop appears in the Musée Grévin in "The Puppeteer 2".
Although having only one akumatized form throughout the series, Roger comes in third place for having been akumatized the most number of times alongside Kagami, Juleka and Lila and behind Xavier and Chloé, having become Rogercop a total of 7 times: "Rogercop", "Catalyst", "Mayura", "Kuro Neko" and three other off-screen akumatizations as showcased in "Mr. Pigeon 72".
He is similar to Bad Cop from The Lego Movie. Both are police officers who are antagonists with laser guns as their main weapon. They also both have flying police cars and have "cop" in their name.
