text:
Rocketear - Trivia
It is revealed that Adrien doesn't actually know the identities of Rena Rouge and Carapace, however because of Nino who unwillingly revealed them, he now knows their identities too.
Like in "Sentibubbler", Cat Noir's anger began to grow when he found out it was Ladybug who picked them and they already knew each other identities.
It could stem from the jealousy he feels, because while Rena and Carapace are together as a couple, he and Ladybug can't be together until Hawk Moth is defeated.
Ironically, unknown to them, he and Ladybug had already discovered the other's identity and were a couple, in "Oblivio", "Cat Blanc" and "Ephemeral", but due to their circumstances, they couldn't stay that way.
With him now knowing the identities of his friends what happened in "Sentibubbler", should've made more sense to Adrien now as Ladybug wasn't fonding Rena over him as an act of favoritism but she was the one in the most danger.
When Nino mentions Ladybug giving him and Alya their Miraculouses together, he's referring to "Catalyst", however he failed to mention that the reason why the heroine unveiled the identities was because she was in a hurry.

title: Rocketear
categories: Episodes where Marinette is a minor character
text:
Rocketear - Trivia
Let alone that Alya figured out Nino's identity on her own while he was unaware until that episode.
Nino is the second person to reject Shadow Moth's control and returns back to normal on his own, following Alya in "Gang of Secrets".
This excludes Chloé and Félix as they hadn't transformed into a villain.
Unlike how it happened with Alya, who had to fight to release herself, the reason why he rejected Shadow Moth's powers was because he no longer needed them.
This is the first time that Ladybug or Cat Noir does not destroy the akumatized object, but instead the akumatized person deakumatizes on their own while under the influence of Shadow Moth.
Even though Alya deakumatized while under the control of Shadow Moth in "Gang of Secrets", she didn't carry the akumatized object.
This is the second time Adrien transforms with a sad expression, following "Santa Claws", and the sixth time he transforms on-screen in Season 4, following "Lies", "Psycomedian", "Gabriel Agreste", "Mega Leech" and "Sentibubbler".
Interestingly, the transformation sequence is new, rather than being recycled from "Santa Claws".

title: Roland's residence
text:
Roland's residence - Intro
is the house which used to belong to Roland Dupain.
Prior to his estrangement from the rest of his family, his wife Gina and son Tom also used to live there. In "Riginarazione", he decides to sell the house after realizing that he will soon pass away.

title: Roland's residence
text:
Roland's residence - Appearance
Exterior
Roland's residence is an old building. It is made of light brick and has no finished facade. The only decorations are red and white bricks arranged in a horizontal line between the ground floor and the first floor, under the roof and on the sides of the building and red stripes and arches at the windows. The lower part of the building is finished with stones of various sizes. The windows are always covered with old shutters, which are made of wood and painted green. A staircase with several steps leads to Roland's residence, which leads to a dark brown wooden door with a colorful glass mosaic. The fur coat is white, and just above it is a semicircle. The front door is covered by a canopy made of dark metal and glass or transparent plate. Lamps were hung on both sides. The roof is red, and on top of it there is a windscreen with the image of a rooster. The whole property gives the impression of being neglected and not renovated for many years, despite the visible damage caused over time.

title: Roland's residence
text:
Roland's residence - Appearance
In front of Roland's residence there is also a small courtyard where he keeps old things. On the right side among other things, a rusty and unusable car. On the conceptual drawings on the other side a wooden bench, an old garden gnome, a box, a tire and other things. The whole yard is enclosed by a green fence with a stone wall at the bottom and a green gate to which a golden bell is attached. On the right side there is also a pipe that performs a function similar to an intercom. On the left side of the fence hung a green letterbox. Since Roland is reluctant to talk to people and does not receive correspondence, both the mailbox and the basket located in the yard are constantly overflowing.
Hallway
The hallway is narrow and long, as it runs along the entire length of the building.
The floors in the room are made of wood of several colors, laid in geometric patterns, patterned carpets are laid right at the entrance door and next to the stairs.
The walls were lined with cream wallpaper with rich brown and green patterns, and the lower part of the wall was decorated with dark brown wood.
Various paintings and portraits related to baking hang on the walls.

title: Roland's residence
text:
Roland's residence - Appearance
Two long chandeliers with six lampshades hung on the ceiling.
To the right of the entrance, previously a pipe seen in the courtyard, and a patterned vase in which umbrellas are stored, and on the other side there is a hanger for the top covering.
On the ground floor there are three pairs of brown doors: the first on the left is double and glazed, leading to the living room, and the other is decorated with a light brown rectangle in the middle (the staircase on the left leads to the kitchen, and on the right–to an unfamiliar room).
At the end of the hallway a staircase made of dark wood covered with a patterned carpet.
They have handrails made of wood, with a white base at the bottom.
Roland also keeps bread baskets and a shovel for the oven in the corridor.
Living room

title: Roland's residence
text:
Roland's residence - Appearance
In the living room the wooden floor, the same as in the hallway. The walls are also similar to those that can be seen at the front door, that is, cream wallpaper with a brown-green floral pattern. Above, above the door level, there is a cream wallpaper with slightly darker patterns, decorated with horizontal stripes in brown. On the ceiling hung a chandelier with six orange-colored blocks. The windows in the living room are always covered with a purple and red curtain, so that the sunlight does not get inside.

title: Roland's residence
text:
Roland's residence - Appearance
To the right of the entrance, just by the door, there is a narrow wooden rack with six shelves, on which Roland keeps books and various kinds of Bibelot, while at the very top there is a golden cup. Next to it there is a wooden sofa with red upholstery, which is decorated with two red pillows, and a little further a small wooden table, on which there is an old telephone and a decorative lamp. Opposite the sofa there is a wooden table with a glass top, and a little further-a wooden shelf, on which there is an old TV and a small monitor with a keyboard, as well as books or newspapers located on the lower shelf (in the later section there is also a turntable). Under the table is a colorful carpet. In front of the entrance was built a brick fireplace with decorative building in white or cream color. In this place the man also keeps several things, namely books and a white vase with flowers.  By the fireplace hung decorative plates fixed on a string. A little further away is a wooden, richly decorated chest of drawers, where Roland keeps an old radio, an alarm clock, a white vase and family photos.

title: Roland's residence
text:
Roland's residence - Appearance
To the right of the entrance, opposite the chest of drawers, space has also been landscaped. There's an old wooden pendulum clock right next to the door. Next to it, however, is a large wooden chest of drawers with three shelves above. This is where the man keeps all his trophies, probably related to the production of bread. At the chest of drawers also hung on a string decorative plates. In addition, the room is decorated with three paintings, a portrait and still life, which by their theme refer to the production of bread or these breads represent. In the further part of the room there are wooden sliding doors leading to the kitchen, which, when opened, visually enlarge the living room.
Kitchen
On the walls in the kitchen laid crenic wallpaper with vertical stripes in two shades of brown.
Under the ceiling, the wallpaper is cream with a slightly darker plant motif, while at the bottom-cream with a brown pattern, separated by a white strip at the top and bottom.
The floor is tiled with brown tiles.
As in the living room, the window is covered with a red curtain, so that sunlight does not enter.

title: Roland's residence
text:
Roland's residence - Appearance
To the left of the entrance (from the side of the living room) there is a white refrigerator, where Roland hangs various kinds of cards with notes, and then there is a door leading to the corridor.
On the opposite side, the space was arranged quite differently: there a small rib radiator in white, bread baskets lying on the floor, two shelves for bread suspended one above the other and a third shelf, suspended above, where a toy car, a white vase with flowers and containers with kitchen accessories were placed.
Three pots hang from the edge of the shelf.
This wall is decorated with two paintings: a portrait of a woman with bread and still life.
On this side, a brick oven designed for baking bread was also built into the wall, on which two shelves made of wood were hung side by side, where kitchen accessories are stored.
Opposite the entrance there are two wooden cabinets, each of which has three drawers with a light handle and a light brown countertop.
On the right there is a third cabinet with a light door, but it was intended for the sink.
Above the sink hung another cabinet with doors in greenish color; on these cabinets the bucket.

title: Roland's residence
text:
Roland's residence - Appearance
In addition, above the sink hang two small wooden shelves: simple and more decorative; on the right side, near the furnace mounted three shelves for storing bread, while above the window hung seven decorative plates.

title: Roland's residence
text:
Roland's residence - Trivia
The house's house number is 29.
The car in the yard is a Citroën 2CV, commonly called deux chevaux ("two horses"), one of the most famous cars in French automobile history.
Two of Roland's three akumatizations (in "Bakerix" and "Simpleman") took place at his home.
In "Riginarazione", Gina was also akumatized into the titular villain here.

title: Rocketear/Transcript
text:
Rocketear/Transcript - Intro
[ Theme Song ]
Carapace: Hey, do you think T-Rexes eat a lot?
Cat Noir: Well, we're about to find out unless Ladybug gets back real soon!
(Ladybug shows up, and she is with Anne-Jeanne Théoxanne du Bocquale)
Ladybug: Yeah, it's all good! We found the dino call!
Anne-Jeanne: (chuckles) It rolled under my cyclotron.
(One of the dinosaurs breaks Carapace's protective shield. Anne-Jeanne blows through her call and relieves the dinosaurs.)
Anne-Jeanne: Oh, yes! (rubs one of the T-Rex's belly) Who's a good little T-Rex? You are! Coochie-coochie-coochie-coochie-coo!!
(Ladybug notices Carapace is sad.)
Ladybug: Everything okay, Carapace?
Carapace: Oh, yeah! Yeah, yeah.
Carapace, Ladybug and Cat Noir: Pound it!
Ladybug: (To Anne-Jeanne) Good luck with your good little T-rexes, Mrs. du Bocquale!
(Ladybug, Carapace and Cat Noir leap away.)
Anne-Jeanne: Bye! (waves her hand)
(Dinosaur distracts Annie-Jeanne)
Anne-Jeanne: Maybe it wasn't the best idea to bring you dinosaurs back to life. What am I gonna do with you guys now? You're gonna eat my entire food budget.
(Bob Roth appears in a helicopter with a speaker.)

title: Rocketear/Transcript
text:
Rocketear/Transcript - Intro
Bob Roth: I'll buy them from you! I'll put them on an island and turn it into a theme park! I'll be rich! (laughs)
Cat Noir: Catch you later!
(Rena Furtive witnesses they are going back safely.)
Carapace: Shell off! (detransforms)
(Nino Lahiffe hands over the Turtle Miraculous back to Ladybug.)
Ladybug: Thanks! (notices Nino is still upset.) Something's wrong, isn't it?
Nino: Well, uh..., well, why wasn't Alya- I mean, Rena Rouge, here today?
Ladybug: Oh, uh... because we needed you and... only you, and you've rocked it! Way to go!
Nino: I did?
Ladybug: Mm-hmm. (about to leave) Bug out! (leaves)
(Nino still feels upset and sadly leaves.)
Ladybug: We weren't followed? No sign of Shadow Moth's traps?
Rena Furtive: Nothing to report.
Ladybug: Perfect! Spots off! (de-transforms into Marinette)
Rena Furtive: (simultaneously) Let's rest! (de-transforms into Alya)
Marinette: (about to climb up the ladder she came through, but pauses) Alya, I wanted to ask you something.
Alya: Ah, you noticed! It's crazy how my costume automatically adapted to my new role. And it gave me the idea for my new name - Rena Furtive!

title: Rocketear/Transcript
text:
Rocketear/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Cool, yes, but secret. We agreed that officially the Miraculous of the Fox doesn't have a holder anymore. Alya, you did tell Nino that you would never be Rena Rouge again, right?
Alya: Well, it's just...
Marinette: Alya! Everyone has to believe that you can never use a Miraculous again. That way, you can be our spy without anyone suspecting.
Alya: (interrupts) And cover you with my power of illusion if Shadow Moth has you followed or if he ever shows himself, I can follow him. I know, I know. (gets upset)
Marinette: For the plan to work, no one can know about it. And no one means no one. Even Nino has to believe that you'll never be Rena Rouge again!
Alya: Or... Rena Furtive?
Marinette: Or Rena Furtive!
(Alya groans.)
Alya: (upset) I just don't know if I can lie to Nino like that we share everything and...
Marinette: It's too late to turn back now. Tell yourself that it's not really lying. It's more-
Alya: (interrupts) It's more like you don't lie to your boyfriend. If Nino ever finds out, he'll never trust me again.
Marinette: I had to keep the truth from my best friend for a very long time, so I know how you feel.

title: Rocketear/Transcript
text:
Rocketear/Transcript - Intro
Tom: Girls! (appears a rainbow background) How about an Ultimate Mecha Strike 23 Tournament!
Marinette: Woah! Sorry, but, uh, we're doing homework, Dad! (shoves him away and closes the trapdoor)
Tom: (opens the trapdoor) Again?! Your teacher sure gives you loads of homework!
Marinette: (closes the trapdoor again and turns around to Alya) And see, I still have to lie to my family. It's been months since I hung out with my dad but... we don't have a choice. We've got to protect our superhero secrets.
Alya: (sighs) Fine, I'll tell him.
Alya: (stutters) I-I, um...
Nino: (lies on Alya's lap while reading a book) Somebody wants to play Super Penguino!
Alya: There's something we gotta talk about first.
Nino: (sits) What?
Alya: (stutters) Uh, I, uh..., (groans) I can't do this, it's too hard.
Nino: (worried) You're starting to worry me.
Alya: If I do this, it might change so much between us.
Nino: (stands up) Oh, no! Don't say it anything but that!
Alya: Anything but what?
Nino: You don't love me anymore!
Alya: What? No! Of course, I do!
Nino: What is it, then?

title: Rocketear/Transcript
text:
Rocketear/Transcript - Intro
Alya: (holds his hands) Nino, it's about our superhero secrets. Ladybug and I had a chat and... Okay. I'm no longer Rena Rouge and I never will be. Ladybug won't give me a Miraculous ever again, she thinks it's become too dangerous.
Nino: That all makes sense. It was so weird you're not being there with us last time. Well, it's a super bummer for sure but if Ladybug thinks it's better for you, (hugs her) why are you so scared to tell me? You know we can share everything and nothing will ever change that.
Alya: Yeah, we can share everything.
(Alya hugs him back.)
Marinette: (whispers to her ear) You did the right thing. It's safer to protect our secrets.
Alya: Yeah, it's probably better that way. (smiles)
(Nino smiles back at her.)
Marinette: It's gonna be time for our (air quotes) evening walk soon if you know what I mean.
Alya: And while the bug is out patrolling with the kitty, the sly fox will cover them in case the mean old moth sets up- (gasps) Oh, I've been meaning to show you something. I took a few selfies with my new costume. There are tons of details I'm sure you missed. Check this out! (shows her new costume on her phone) Right by the neckline, isn't it way cool?

title: Rocketear/Transcript
text:
Rocketear/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (upset) Alya...
Alya: I think I like it better than the old one. Oh, what if I did a survey on the Ladyblog and let people vote on their favorite?
Marinette: (sighs) Alya, Rena Furtive means Rena Invisible. No one can ever see these.
Alya: Oh, right. I forgot. (sighs) Bummer, it's getting really hard to find a new material for the Ladyblog. (Marinette pats her head.) I guess I still have that raw footage of Cat Noir stunts depending on how well I edit it. (deletes the photo)
Marinette: (happy) Yes, that's an awesome idea. (hugs Alya) Come on, let's go.
(They walk down the steps. The scene rewinds to Nino's perspective where Adrien leaves and Nino waves goodbye, then turns around at Marinette and Alya having a conversation. Marinette pats her head.)
Nino: (startled) Oh!
(Marinette and Alya walk down the steps while Nino half-smiled.)
Nino: Hey! Since we got out early today, what do you say we catch a movie?
Alya: Uh, I'm... not so sure.
Marinette: (whispers to her ear) Go on! You have time, we'll meet up later.
Alya: (approaches Nino) So, what's playing in the movies? (grabs his arm aggressively and runs off)
Nino: (while running) Alya! Slow down!

title: Rocketear/Transcript
text:
Rocketear/Transcript - Intro
(Marinette admiringly smiles at them.)
Trailer: After Ladybug & Cat Noir...
Ladybug (in the trailer): (voiceover) Oh, Cat Noir, come back!
Cat Noir (in the trailer): (voiceover) I'll always love you, Ladybug!
Trailer: (voiceover) Ladybug & Cat Noir 2: The Arrival of Rena Rouge.
Nino: (annoyed) What about Carapace? Has everyone forgotten about Carapace?! (startled up to what Rena Rouge has said)
Rena Rouge (in the trailer): Cat Noir, forget about Ladybug. You and I, we are made for each other.
Nino: What?! Rena Rouge will love Cat Noir? This is totally ridiculous!
Alya: Hey, Nino. It's a cartoon, a made-up story! It's just made to entertain people.
Nino: Well, I, for one, am not entertained!
Ladybug (in the trailer): (voiceover) She's right, Cat Noir. You and Rena Rouge should be so much better together!
(Alya has gone upset on her phone while Nino notices her, then, she turns off her phone quickly and smiles to him, then, Nino smiles back.)
Nino: Mademoiselle. (welcoming Alya outside the cinema) Should I take you home? Or..
(Nino notices Alya once again checking her phone constantly)

title: Rocketear/Transcript
text:
Rocketear/Transcript - Intro
Nino: That thing you were showing to Marinette on your phone earlier seemed really cool. What was it? Can I see?
Alya: Oh- A thing? What thing? It was nothing. Besides, I'm just running out of battery. (laughs nervously)
(André rings his ice-cream bell. Nino and Alya notices.)
Nino: Hey, look! André's over there! How about some ice cream?
(Alya smilingly shakes her head)
Andrè: Alya and Nino, my favorite lovebirds! What shall I serve you today?(Alya sees Ladybug who is calling her by gesturing.)
Alya: Uh, nothing for me, thanks! I just remembered that I have homework to do and I'm not really hungry, anyway. You can have my half. See you later! (Alya leaves Nino and kissed him on his cheek.)
Nino: Thanks, André, but I guess we'll have to wait till next time.
(Nino notices Cat Noir leaping majestically on the roofs. Nino suddenly gets distracted by three kids who are role-playing Cat Noir, Ladybug & Rena Rouge near him.)
Kid 1: Come on, Cat Noir is in love with Ladybug, not Rena Rouge!
Kid 2: I don't care! I'm Cat Noir and all the girls love me!
(Nino sadly looks down and leaves.)

title: Rocketear/Transcript
text:
Rocketear/Transcript - Intro
Alya: There's a lot of talk about Ladybug, but hardly any about Cat Noir, and he's really an amazing superhero! Brave, funny, handsome; coming right up a montage of some of the most impressive stunts of a superhero who's every bit as magnificent as Prince Char-meow-ing. Stay connected!
(Nino gets angry and calls Adrien.)
Nino: I knew it! She's in love with someone else!
Adrien: You guys spend every minute together. I'm sure you're just imagining things. Who else do you think she'd be in love with, anyway?
Nino: (angrily) Cat Noir!
Adrien: (laughs) Yeah, right. How about Jagged Stone's crocodile while you're at it?
Nino: (angrily) Did you see the video?
Adrien: Come on, that's just some video from the Ladyblog, not proof.
Nino: (angrily) I'll find proof, then you'll see that I was right! (Nino disconnects the call)</poem>
Adrien: (to Plagg, worried) There's no way!
Plagg: Oh, there's a way. Yes way! My natural charisma has probably just rubbed off on you.
Adrien: You think I played the charming kitty cat one too many times and unintentionally made her fall in love with me? I have to be sure! Plagg, claws out! (transforms into Cat Noir and jumps out of his window)

title: Rocketear/Transcript
text:
Rocketear/Transcript - Intro
Nino: Who would want a tormented turtle for a companion? No one could resist a kitten! (blows bubbles) This one just ripped my heart out, like a tragic sax solo and a love song. There I was, with my old buddies again: the city, the night, the solitude, the rain, pouring down, (his phone starts to ring) not like the tears that were stuck in my throat. (puts on a fake mustache) It was time to end all the lies and secrets. I'd always wanted to have a mustache anyway.
(Alya unveils the curtain, revealing Cat Noir.)
Alya: Cat Noir!?
(Alya opens the window and goes to talk to him, whereas Nino who is hiding, watches and records everything via his phone.)
Alya: What's going on? Is something wrong?
Cat Noir: No, no! Everything's fine! It's just that I saw you posted a new video about me. I'm super flattered, really, but it made me wonder: you've been following Ladybug and me from the very start. You take photos and videos, and we even saved you a couple times. What I mean is, we're starting to know each other pretty well and... it's made me notice a couple of small things. I hope I'm just under the illusion that there's something but uh...

title: Rocketear/Transcript
text:
Rocketear/Transcript - Intro
Alya: Illusion...? What illusion? What small things?
Cat Noir:  It's kind of hard to explain, but I wanted to make sure that in all this time you've spent admiring me, you haven't built up some kind of uh... feelings for me. I mean, I get it, "Hey, I am the Cat's Meow."
Alya: Huh, what feelings for you?
Cat Noir: Well.. you know.. (makes a heart on his hand)
(Nino zooms in his video as Alya laughs from the balcony.)
Alya: (laughs) Are you insane?! I already have a boyfriend! And FYI, with him it's not just, (makes a small heart on her hand) it's more like (makes a big heart with her arms)
Cat Noir: (laughs) Sorry, that was so silly of me.
(Cat Noir and Alya hug each other. Nino gets taken aback by the gesture and puts down his phone. He then returns on recording them.)
Alya: Sorry, Cat Noir, but my Nino is a thousand times more irresistible than you. (scratches his chin)
(Nino from a distance watches and starts to cry after seeing them "flirting" with each other.)
Alya: Besides, I don't really know your real identity, and I could never fall for someone I didn't really know.
(Nino, in tears, runs off crying.)
Adrien: Oh, hey, Nino! I gotta tell you something.

title: Rocketear/Transcript
text:
Rocketear/Transcript - Intro
Nino: (angrily) No! I gotta tell you something!
Adrien Huh?
<poem>
Nino: (sets up a chair for Adrien.) Sit down!(After offering Adrien to sit, Nino sits and puts his legs on the table.)Adrien: Uh... when did you set all this up?
Nino: I'm the one asking questions! Remember what I told you yesterday? I got proof now. What do you say to this?! (shows Adrien the video he recorded of Cat Noir and Alya on her balcony)Adrien: (shocked) Uh- (turns the radio volume down) Come on, that doesn't make any sense. You're wrong, that's not at all what happened!
Nino: How do you know? You were there? You're in on it too?!
Adrien: No, no. Of course, not! But it's impossible! I'm sure this is just a misunderstanding. Alya and Cat Noir have nothing in common. They barely know each other! Alya is just a superhero fan she's been filming Ladybug and Cat Noir, that's all!
Nino: They know each other well enough!
Adrien: But no one knows Ladybug and Cat Noir's secret identities. Can you imagine Alya falling in love with someone she doesn't really know? The girl who wants to be a reporter who always wants to know the truth, no matter what? Who wants to share everything with the boy she loves?

title: Rocketear/Transcript
text:
Rocketear/Transcript - Intro
Nino: (turns the radio volume back on) They actually know each other much better than you think!
Adrien: You can't assume that from this video.(Nino comes closer to Adrien, and tries to explain that he is right)
Nino: Listen, here's what you don't know! I'm not talking about the video, dude. I'm talking about something I shouldn't be telling you. A mind-blowing secret. Alya is a superhero. She's Rena Rouge!
Adrien: What?!
Nino: Shh! (puts his finger on Adrien's lips) I know what you're about to say: "That's nonsense and how would Nino know that anyway?" I know because... I'm a superhero too. I'm Carapace!
Adrien: Huh? You're... Carapace? But... the two of you know?! You know each other's secret identities?!
Nino: Of course, Alya and I have never kept anything from each other. Until now, though that Cat Noir's business!
Adrien: Wait a sec, I don't understand! I thought that secret identities had to be protected at all costs. If it were true, you'd never just tell me like that. Ladybug would never agree to that!
Nino: Are you kidding? Ladybug is the one who gave us both our Miraculous at the same time.
Adrien: (betrayed) No, that's impossible!

title: Rocketear/Transcript
text:
Rocketear/Transcript - Intro
Nino: What are you trying to say? That I'm lying or something!?
Adrien: No, no. What I meant was- Okay, you're Carapace, she's Rena Rouge and Ladybug's okay with this. But it still isn't like Alya or Cat Noir to be... (rolls his hands) you know...?
Nino: You don't know what Cat Noir really is but I do! I'm part of the team! I see how he acts in real life. Sure, as soon as Ladybug shows up, he throws himself at her feet with roses and big declarations, (smooches) but he gets blown off every time, because Ladybug thinks he's obnoxious, and she's right! And then whenever Rena Rouge shows up, it's like, (scratches Adrien's chin) "Why, hello there, pretty lady, you look so fine! You smell so good!" So yeah, it's easy to figure out that the first mission I missed- I mean, Carapace missed, he made his move and, BAM! This is what happened. Now, (sits down slowly) I'm all alone. I've lost the love of my life. (angrily) If I could, I'd sew his sweet talking mouth shut with his own whiskers! (a tear drops on the screen of his phone)

title: Rocketear/Transcript
text:
Rocketear/Transcript - Intro
Shadow Moth: A spurned boyfriend who wants vengeance on his rival. Now that's a strong emotion. (creates an akuma) Fly, my little akuma and help this young man destroy his enemy! My enemy! (the akuma flies out flies out the window)
<poem>
Adrien: There's got to be an explanation, Nino. We'll work it all out! (gasps as the akuma enters Nino's glasses.)
Shadow Moth: (from his lair) Rocketear, I am Shadow Moth. Cat Noir has ripped your heart out and left you in a weeping state of sorrow. So, I'm giving your tears the power to destroy everything! All I ask for in return are-
Nino: (interrupts) I know what you want, Shadow Moth. Don't worry, the only thing left to them will be their Miraculous. (transforms into Rocketear)
Adrien: Nino, you have to fight off this-
Rocketear: (throws Adrien) You're not my enemy, Adrien. Cat Noir is! (jumps onto the upper hall and starts to walk away)
Plagg: I know what you're about to do but I would advise you not to, considering what your pal's got in store for Cat Noir.
Adrien: I can't leave Nino like that!
<center> [Transformation Sequence]  Adrien: (unhappy) Plagg, claws out!  </center>
</poem>

title: Rocketear/Transcript
text:
Rocketear/Transcript - Intro
Alya: And that's why he showed up in the middle of the night, because of this video I post on the Ladyblog. He thought I was in love with him.(laughs)
Marinette: (facepalms) Oh, that Cat Noir.
(A rumbling is heard outside. They looked at the window and saw Rocketear and Cat Noir fighting on the streets.)
Rocketear: (voiceover) Cat Noir! You stole my Alya from me! I'm going to steal your life from you! (He shoots tears at Cat Noir but is able to dodge from it and instead, it explodes on a car. He tries to shoot more tears at Cat Noir.)
Cat Noir: I didn't steal anyone! (lands on a lamppost) Alya still loves you!
Rocketear: LIAR! I have proof! (continues to shoots tears)
Marinette: Oh no, this can't be happening! (goes behind an art desk along with Alya)
Alya: Oh, Nino, no!
Marinette: (softly) We have to stop them before they hurt each other. Come on, follow me!
(The girls sneak away whilst the others continue to watch the battle by the window.)
Marinette: Okay, we can transform in peace in here. (They notice Nino's secret office and walks towards it. Marinette also notices the video on Nino's phone.) Alya, don't tell me you... (shows the video to Alya)

title: Rocketear/Transcript
text:
Rocketear/Transcript - Intro
Alya: Of course, not! It's a misunderstanding. If you could hear what we were saying, there's no way Nino would believe that I'm in love with Cat Noir.
Marinette: Okay, fine. Let's not waste time. (Tikki and Trixx pops out.) Tikki!
Alya: (simultaneously) Trixx!
Marinette: Spots on! (transforms into Ladybug)
Alya: (simultaneously) Let's pounce! (transforms into Rena Furtive)
Ladybug: Lucky Charm! (receives a projector) A video projector? What am I supposed to do with this? (lights it up)
Rena Furtive: Do like Nino and make up imaginary movies in your head?
Ladybug: (using her Lucky Vision, she looks around and sees Rena Furtive's flute, the video from Nino's phone, and the projector.) (to Rena Furtive) You said that if Nino could have heard what you were saying, there'd be no misunderstanding?
Rena Furtive: Absolutely!
Ladybug: How well do you remember what you guys said on the balcony?
Rena Furtive: Every. Word.
Ladybug: Do you think you could make... a sound illusion?
Rena Furtive: Totally.
(Ladybug smirks.)
Cat Noir: I don't wanna fight you!
Rocketear: Silence! (Rocketear continues to shoot more tears.)
Cat Noir: (dodges the tears) Let me explain!

title: Rocketear/Transcript
text:
Rocketear/Transcript - Intro
Rocketear: (tries to knock him down) I don't wanna hear your lies!
(Cat Noir throws Rocketear away from him.)
Cat Noir: You wanted proof? Here's proof. (shortens his staff and tosses it away)
Rocketear: That doesn't prove a thing! (He shoots tears at him, making him thrown onto a van and knocks him down one more time.)
Cat Noir: (weakly) See? I don't wanna hurt you. Can we talk now?
Shadow Moth: (from his lair) Shut him up for good! But before you do, seize his Miraculous!
Rocketear: (about to shoot a tear to him) It's over, Cat Noir!
Cat Noir: (weakly) Don't do this.
(A yoyo grabs Rocketear's wrist, misdirecting the tear and is shot on one of the buildings' roofs.)
Ladybug: Nino, stop! (shows the projector) Look, my Lucky Charm gave me a super-advanced projector that will allow you to hear the sound of the video that you shot. (Rocketear hesitates for a moment. Meanwhile, Rena Furtive is hiding behind a wall on the rooftops, waiting for her cue to activate her power.) I don't know what Cat Noir said to your girlfriend either, but I trust him.
Rena Furtive: (whispers) Mirage!

title: Rocketear/Transcript
text:
Rocketear/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: Now, look and listen carefully. (shows a bigger screen of the video from the projector) (looks at her)
Rena Furtive: (uses her Mirage to create a sound for her and Cat Noir's conversation on the video) Well, you know...
Cat Noir: (from the video) (repeats) Well, you know... (Alya laughs)
(The video made Rocketear furious but stops for a while.)
Alya: (from the video) Are you insane? I already have a boyfriend! And FYI, with him,...
Alya and Rena Furtive: It's not just... it's more like... (gestures a bigger heart)
Cat Noir and Rena Furtive: (laughs) Sorry, that was so silly of me. (hugs each other)
Alya and Rena Furtive: Yeah, sorry, Cat Noir, but my Nino is a thousand times more irresistible than you. Besides, I don't know your real identity and I could never fall for someone I didn't really know.
(Rocketear realizes the whole thing happened. In the meantime, Rena Furtive runs and hides behind a car to detransform.)
Rena Furtive: Let's rest! (detransforms into Alya)
Alya: Nino! (goes to Rocketear and hugs him)
Rocketear: I can't believe I ever doubted you.
Alya: I can't believe I ever chose to do anything over spending time with you.

title: Rocketear/Transcript
text:
Rocketear/Transcript - Intro
Rocketear: I'm so sorry. (Alya removes his glasses and wipes away Rocketear's tear)
Alya: I was so scared for you. (hugs him and Rocketear hugs her back)
Rocketear: Shadow Moth! You can have your lame powers back! (resigns)
Shadow Moth: (from his lair) Oh! (he frowned)
(Rocketear turns back into Nino causing it to release the akuma.)
Ladybug: No more evil-doing for you, little akuma! Time to de-evilize! (captures the akuma) Gotcha! (releases the butterfly) Bye-bye, little butterfly! Miraculous Ladybug! (throws the projector and returns all the cars safe, fixes the damaged rooftop, and the dented car where Cat Noir was throwned onto)
Shadow Moth: Love and secrets don't mix, Ladybug, and I'm sure you have many secrets, too. (laughs) (window closes)
Ladybug: (takes his hand) Nino, take this magical charm. Always carry it with you. That way, Shadow Moth can't get to you, anymore.
Nino: I won't need to use it, Ladybug. (holds Alya's hands) I'll never let Shadow Moth use my love to manipulate me again. (to Cat Noir) I guess I was wrong about you, my dude. I'm sorry. (tips his cap)
Cat Noir: Everyone has doubts now and then, (looks down) even me...
Ladybug: Is everything okay, Cat Noir?

title: Rocketear/Transcript
text:
Rocketear/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: Yeah, yeah. (prepare his fist) Pound it!
Ladybug: (fistbumps) Pound it!
(Cat Noir and Ladybug runs away, whereas Cat Noir is still upset, thinking about the secrets Nino had blurted out to him earlier at the boiler room.)
Adrien: I still can't believe Ladybug entrusted Alya and Nino with those Miraculous.
Plagg: (while eating camembert) Of course she did. She's the Guardian.
Adrien: But they're a couple and they know each other's secret identities.
Plagg: So...? (eats the camembert)
Adrien: So, why does she make it a rule that we can't know each other's identities but it's okay for them?
Plagg: She's the Guardian, the Grandmaster Cheese Ripener, and you and I are just cheese on the platter. She decides what's on the menu.
Marinette: I'm really sorry. I didn't mean to cause trouble between you and Nino.
Alya: (at her balcony while on the call) Don't worry, I've got this. Do you trust me?
Marinette: I trust you.
Alya: Nino?
Nino: Hmm?
Alya: There's something I have to tell you.
Nino: Again? You sure you don't wanna just play Super Penguino instead?
Alya: (sighs) I'm still Rena Rouge. (Nino gasps.) But now I'm in hiding and that's why Ladybug asked me not to tell anyone.

title: Rocketear/Transcript
text:
Rocketear/Transcript - Intro
Nino: (goes to her) But why are you telling me if no one's supposed to know? Is Ladybug cool with this?
Alya: I can't hide it from you, because I love you, Nino, and we share everything.
(They hug each other.)

title: Roaar/History
text:
Roaar/History - Intro
Roaar is the kwami connected to the Tiger Miraculous. Currently, she lets Juleka Couffaine transform into Purple Tigress.

title: Roaar/History
text:
Roaar/History - Before [[season 1]]
When the concept of Elation came into existence, Roaar came into existence. Before the Miraculous jewels were created, Roaar and the other kwamis traveled all over the universe unable to interact with humans. Then, thousands of years ago, a mage created the Miraculouses. When her Miraculous was not being worn, Roaar was dormant in the Tiger Miraculous, which was stored inside the Miracle Box.

title: Roaar/History
text:
Roaar/History - Season 1
During season 1, Roaar was dormant in the Tiger Miraculous.

title: Roaar/History
text:
Roaar/History - [[Season 2]]
During season 2, Roaar was dormant in the Tiger Miraculous.
In "Sandboy", Roaar was celebrating Nooroo's birthday in the Miraculous Box with the other kwamis and was excited when Tikki and Plagg arrived. She marveled at the gift Tikki brought as she thought it was a paintbrush and draws a line with the marker to show the other kwamis. When the time came to find Nooroo, Roaar got into position but in an effort to contact him, they contacted his wielder instead. Upon hearing his voice, she shuddered at the thought of being his slave and prevented herself from being discovered when they all cut off the connection. She realized if they contacted Nooroo's wielder rather than Nooroo, then someone must have been akumatized and that Tikki and Plagg's wielders would be in danger.

title: Roaar/History
text:
Roaar/History - [[Season 3]]
During season 3, Roaar was dormant in the Tiger Miraculous.
In "Kwamibuster", she was activated along with her kwami brothers and sisters to help Multimouse enact her plan to rescue Tikki and Plagg. During the confrontation, Roaar was one of the few kwamis captured, but was set free with the help of Multinoire. After Kwamibuster's defeat, Roaar and the others cheered for Marinette as their plan was a success and was returned to Miracle Box.
In "Miracle Queen", she was activated alongside Stompp, Ziggy, Daizzi, Barkk, Mullo, Orikko and Fluff by Queen Bee with the intent to use them and their Miraculouses against Ladybug and Cat Noir. After being commanded to transform her, Roaar criticized her for not knowing the necessary transformation phrases and then promptly withheld her transformation phrase with the other kwamis. Upon hearing Master Fu announce that he will give up his title as "Guardian of the Miracle Box", she and the other kwamis attempt to persuade him not to do it. After failing to escape, Queen Bee throws off her Miraculous in frustration. Afterwards, Roaar and her Miraculous were returned to the Miracle Box by Ladybug.

title: Roaar/History
text:
Roaar/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Truth", Roaar was accidentally released from the Miracle Box when Marinette tried to figure it out, she explored Marinette's room. During a video call, Roaar and the others gathered around the new guardian's computer in amazement wondering why her friends were imprisoned. When Marinette leaves for her date with Luka, Roaar and her fellow kwamis hid with the Miracle Box. After the titular villain's defeat, Roaar and the others saw that Marinette was sad about breaking up with Luka to the point of tears, she didn't know exactly how to help but joined with the others in giving their new guardian a group hug.
In "Lies", Roaar was seen in Marinette's room.
In "Gang of Secrets", Roaar was seen talking with some of the kwamis until Marinette arrived home. Later, she and the others hear Marinette voicing her distress about being condemned to a life of secrets and lies forever because of her alter ego. When they hear someone coming, the kwamis hide in the Miracle Box and after the Gang of Secrets had been defeated, Roaar and the others look on as Marinette unveiled her secret to Alya.

title: Roaar/History
text:
Roaar/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Mr. Pigeon 72", Roaar is seen playing with one of Marinette's design hats along with Barkk until the other kwamis decided to join in on the fun. Afterwards, they put it back and take cover when Marinette's potion making attempts cause an explosion making a mess of her room, soon Roaar helps in cleaning up.
In "Furious Fu", hearing that Master Fu was returning, Roaar along with her fellow kwamis expressed dear desire to see him despite Marinette trying to keep them hidden for their safety and when their Marinette voiced concerns about leaving the Miracle Box unguarded. Roaar realized if someone stayed to guard the box, the others could go but when they cheated their way out so all of them can go, they were stopped by Marinette with no choice they used the "puppy dog eyes" on her and Marinette reluctantly agreed. However, Roaar and the kwamis had a hard time keeping quiet while in Marinette's bag but heard that Master Fu is doing well and become a great painter.

title: Roaar/History
text:
Roaar/History - [[Season 4]]
But returning home, Roaar realized that Su-Han had returned to reclaim the box as he was the previous guardian before Master Fu's incident and with Su-Han's strictness, she and the kwamis sadly returned to the box. After seeing Ladybug's valiant actions against the titular villain, Su-Han realized that Master Fu's choice wasn't so bad allowing Roaar and the other kwamis to stay with Marinette.
In "Crocoduel", Roaar and her Miraculous were lent to and activated by Juleka Couffaine. Letting out a roar, she accidentally scared her new owner, but nonetheless was ready for action. Upon hearing Juleka weakly accept Ladybug's usual promise, Roaar encouraged her to speak up, until she got pushed back into a wall. Impressed, she believed they'll get along just fine. Then, Roaar and Juleka transform into the superheroine Purple Tigress and defeat Captain Hardrock and Guitar Villain by using Clout. After Juleka's task was completed, she gave the Miraculous back to Ladybug, who, in turn, sent Roaar and the panjas bracelet back to her own residence.

title: Roaar/History
text:
Roaar/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Optigami," Roaar grew excited when she heard that everyone was invited to the upcoming fashion event, thinking that she and the kwamis would get to go as well. However, Marinette immediately denied this, reminding them of the rule that states that they cannot go anywhere unless their Miraculous is with an owner.
In "Sentibubbler", Roaar was visible in Marinette's room after she had a nightmare of Shadow Moth getting the Miracle Box and when she checked if the Miracle Box was there.
In "Wishmaker", when Marinette explained what a career was, Roaar and the other kwamis voiced ideas on what she could do in life until Sass silenced them asking Marinette himself what she wanted to do; then saw her leave for the career expo.
In "Simpleman", she was in the sewing box with some of her siblings but when the Cesaire twins and Manon got a hold of the box and started shaking it, Roaar and the kwamis got very dizzy.

title: Roaar/History
text:
Roaar/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Dearest Family", after Tikki ate the pieces of galette, Marinette brought for them, the kwamis quickly realized what she did. Roaar huddled together with the others when they realized the danger Tikki's hunger for candy can represent, despite the kwami of Creation refusal at that. When Tikki and Marinette left, the kwamis flew around in a panic. Shortly after she watched Marinette, realize that Sass warning was real and transforms to stop Tikki only to be affected by Tikki's hunger, which scared her. Hearing a commotion downstairs, Roaar and the others were commanded to hide. After Ladybug saved her family, Roaar and the kwamis see her return with pieces of galette for them. Despite that they were still nervous regarding Tikki, until Marinette ensured them that Tikki will control herself and the kwamis ate the pieces of galette happily.

title: Roaar/History
text:
Roaar/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Ephemeral", during the fight against Moolak, Roaar and her miraculous were given to Juleka and transformed into Purple Tigress. After the battle, Roaar and her jewel were returned to Ladybug. Later, they briefly met Sass owner Luka when he came into Marinette's room, but their introductions were cut short; when Luka received a message from Ladybug allowing Sass use his power to go back to the last marked time.
Soon Roaar discovered why as she and everyone noticed the Absolute Power being activated meaning Shadow Moth obtained the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses and started his wish. Sass explained to Luka the consequences of it and the latter hurried the former to use his power, which he does, causing the kwamis encounter with Luka to be erased.
In "Kuro Neko", during the fight against Rogercop, Roaar and her Miraculous were given to Juleka to become Purple Tigress again. Later, Roaar and the other kwamis tried to comfort Marinette after Cat Noir gave up on his Miraculous and was surprised to learn that she intended to replace him with someone who doesn't love her.

title: Roaar/History
text:
Roaar/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Penalteam", Roaar and her Miraculous were used again by Juleka to become Purple Tigress and help Ladybug, along with many other heroes to defeat Penalteam.
In "Risk", Roaar and her Miraculous were briefly given back to Juleka. Later, Roaar and the other kwamis watched Marinette search for different ways to sabotage Adrien and Lila's journey, unaware that she was under the influence of Risk's superpowers.
In "Strikeback", Roaar and her Miraculous were given to Juleka to become Purple Tigress and helped Ladybug, Cat Noir and the rest of the heroes to defeat Strikeback. Later, after Flairmidable betrayed Ladybug by stealing her yo-yo, her Miraculous, along with all the others, was given to Gabriel Agreste in exchange for the Peacock Miraculous.

title: Roaar/History
text:
Roaar/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Evolution",
In "Multiplication",
In "Destruction",
In "Elation",
In "Confrontation",
In "Re-creation", after Bug Noire defeated Monarch, she restored the Miraculouses to their normal state, making Roaar and the other kwamis happy and returning them to their holders. Roaar was seen ecstatic as she reunited with Juleka.

title: Roaar/History
text:
Roaar/History - [[Season 6]]
In "Vampigami", Roaar told Juleka that she could not let Rose and Prem be alone together at The Vampire Horrific Musical Show. After seeing Juleka's video call with her brother, Luka, Roaar cheered Juleka on as Juleka punched a pillow to vent her frustration.

title: Roland Dupain
text:
Roland Dupain - Intro
was a recurring character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He was the ex-husband of Gina Bianchi, the father of Tom Dupain, and the paternal grandfather of Marinette Dupain-Cheng.
In "Bakerix", when Roland refused to eat Marinette's bread after finding out she was his granddaughter, he was akumatized by Hawk Moth and became Bakerix, a Gaulic bread-themed supervillain.
In "Simpleman", after becoming overwhelmed with the complexity of the modern world, Roland was akumatized by Shadow Moth into Simpleman, a supervillain with the power to simplify people's minds, causing them to find simple solutions to complicated problems/situations. He also received a Magical Charm from Ladybug that prevented him from being reakumatized.
In "Dearest Family", when Roland, Tom, Sabine and Gina started arguing about what they each thought was best for Marinette, they were reakumatized by Shadow Moth into Bakerix, Weredad, Qilin and Befana respectively and formed the villainous group Dearest Family, who competed with each other to prove that they knew what was best for Marinette. He also received a new Magical Charm from Ladybug after his first one was destroyed.

title: Roland Dupain
text:
Roland Dupain - Intro
In "Riginarazione", it was revealed that Roland's health had been deteriorating and that the entire family hid it from Marinette until the former was near his end and told her the truth. Not long after the celebration of his 75th birthday, Roland passed away off-screen, leading to his house being sold, Gina getting custody of his pet mice and Marinette and her parents receiving his family's yeast as an inheritance.

title: Roland Dupain
text:
Roland Dupain - Appearance
Physical appearance
Roland was a short man with a large build. He had grey hair, a balding head, bushy grey eyebrows and green eyes.
Civilian attire
Roland wore a brilliant cerulean and white striped shirt with five white buttons, light arctic blue shorts, thick black glasses and brown-soled dark blue dress shoes.
As Bakerix
Bakerix looked like a Gaul made out of different varieties of bread and his eyes resembled chocolate chips. He had a Gaul helmet with two croissants on top almost resembling horns similar to Viking helmets, and a belt made out of slices of bread and pretzels.
As Simpleman
Simpleman looked like Roland Dupain with pale, light grayish violet skin. He wore a red white and blue mask on his face, right brilliant amaranth eye and left brilliant azure eye, a red and blue cape, red gloves, white sleeveless jumpsuit with a letter S logo on it and he was armed with a red, blue and white baker's peel for combat.

title: Roland Dupain
text:
Roland Dupain - Personality
Roland was a highly traditional man who enjoyed doing things the old-fashioned way. He was very proud of his Gallic heritage and fond of reminiscing over the old days; though, in turn, he was not fond of modern technology or anything he considered non-traditional, being quick to point out when something is not being done the way he thought it should be done. His fixation with sticking to tradition extended to the point where he isolated himself from the rest of the modern world and even cut ties with his son Tom over him and his wife changing his bread recipe with rice flour. Because of his attachment to the old-fashioned way, Roland had a great difficulty to understand the complexity of the modern world.
Marinette described him as grumpy and very stubborn but knew it was a facade because he was afraid of change in "Family".

title: Roland Dupain
text:
Roland Dupain - Personality
However, despite this, he could be nice and polite towards others, showing kindness to his flour delivery man and later his granddaughter Marinette when she pretended to be a flour delivery intern named Germaine to get into his house, and allowed her to have a baking contest with him. Later Roland revealed that he had yeast that has been in his family for over 2,000 years. Regardless of his aversion to non-traditional things, he was willing to rely on them under certain circumstances, allowing Cat Noir to rush him back home when he feared his bread or granddaughter could be in danger. Furthermore, after realizing that his son's way of baking bread is just as good as his own, he quickly became more accepting of going against tradition and decided to reconnect with his family afterwards.
According to Gina, Roland was overprotective of his son Tom, which in turn, resulted in him becoming overprotective of his daughter Marinette.
As Bakerix, he was obsessed with making Paris the way it was when he was young, destroying anything that he considered modern.

title: Roland Dupain
text:
Roland Dupain - Personality
During his second akumatization as Bakerix, he was determined to raise Marinette with the rules and discipline he believed she needed. Because of this, Bakerix got very competitive with the rest of her akumatized family, fighting with them to prevent them from imposing their way of raising Marinette or trying to beat them into getting Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses. He also berated Ladybug for stealing Galettes and eating them as they are meant to be eaten as a family.
As Simpleman, he retained most of his normal personality. He wanted everything to get simple and get rid of any complicated situation/problem. Despite this, he appeared to not have any malicious trait, as he didn't use his powers on Manon, Ella, Etta or Chris, only deciding to do it when they started to help the heroes defeat him.

title: Roland Dupain
text:
Roland Dupain - Abilities
As a civilian
Like his family, Roland was an excellent baker.
As Bakerix
Bakerix wielded an elixir that, when he drank it, enabled him to grow bigger and stronger for a short period of time.
As Simpleman
Simpleman wielded a staff that, when struck on the ground, released a wave of energy. This wave caused anyone caught within it to automatically find simple solutions to their problems, even if these solutions were not the best or could be harmful in the long run. The more someone was affected by his power, the simpler their thinking became, leading them to behave more like children and even speak like them. Even Shadow Moth, the holder of the Butterfly Miraculous, was not immune to Simpleman's influence. He found himself unwilling to take Simpleman's powers away, despite Simpleman's reckless use of them, because he wanted him to obtain the Miraculouses.
However, due to the simplicity of his powers, Simpleman’s own akumatization, unlike other akumatized villains, didn't grant him any additional abilities. He still suffered from back pain and lacked any enhanced physical abilities.

title: Roland Dupain
text:
Roland Dupain - History
Prior to season 1
In Paris, Roland was born to unknown parents in 1941 during the same year as Gina Bianchi but they didn't meet until two decades later in 1961 to which they became a couple. From then on, they started the tradition of combining their birthday numbers until 1976 and they had a son to whom they named Tom Dupain. As Tom was growing up, Roland introduced him to the art of baking where Tom learned his father's recipes.

title: Roland Dupain
text:
Roland Dupain - Relationships
Family
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/Ladybug
When Roland first met Marinette, he believed her to be a flour supplier. At first, he was reluctant to her person and got annoyed when the girl asked him questions. Although he was surprised by her great knowledge, he tried to flush her out. Upset by Marinette's intrusiveness, he wanted to throw her out of the house, but it did not work out for him. He accepts her challenge to make the best bread. After spending time with her, he told her the story of his family sourdough. Hearing a familiar melody, he recognized her as Tom's daughter, but quickly rejected this thought, claiming that the girl was lying and threw her out of the kitchen, not wanting to listen to her translations. After returning to normal, he began to worry about the girl, although he did not want to reveal it. He confessed to Marinette that he had took a liking to her and, at her urging, visited his son for the first time in 20 years.

title: Roland Dupain
text:
Roland Dupain - Relationships
After reconnecting with his family, Roland was able to forge a deep bond with his granddaughter, even if, just like Tom, he would become somewhat overprotective of her, as seen in "Dearest Family", where, after Gina appearing with a motorcycle as a gift to Marinette, Roland expressed his opinion that Marinette needed discipline and be treated accordingly to the age she had. After being de-akumatized, along with his family, he came to realize that Marinette should also express her opinion when it comes to matters that concern her.
Just like the rest of his family, Roland was also very supportive of Marinette's relationship with Adrien.
His love and appreciation for Marinette was what eventually led him to hide from her his deteriorating health. However, as his end came near, he had no other choice but to tell her. When that moment came, he kept on trying to delay while trying to find the right words. After doing so, he expressed how he loved his granddaughter by entrusting her with the yeast that had been passed down in his family through generations.
Tom Dupain

title: Roland Dupain
text:
Roland Dupain - Relationships
Roland was convinced that Tom betrayed him by adding rice to the bread and not sticking to the traditional and tried and tested recipes. Since that point, he had not spoken to his son for over two decades and did not want to forgive him, even going as far as not attending Tom's and Sabine's wedding - even if he kept a flipped down photo of their wedding day in his house. He hated his son's pastries, even though he had never tried them. When Marinette showed him how new recipes can taste just as good as the traditional ones, he decided to visit Tom and make peace with him.
Afterwards, they forgave each other and were shown to be in touch, even teaming up to bake pastries and galettes together in "Dearest Family".
Sabine Cheng
While much information isn't available, their relationship was virtually nonexistent before the events of "Bakerix", as by that point Roland had renounced his and Tom's relationship. However, it is known Roland did not attend Tom's and Sabine's wedding, had not been in contact with her for two decades, as well as have only met her daughter Marinette when the girl was around 14 years old.

title: Roland Dupain
text:
Roland Dupain - Relationships
After the events of "Bakerix", they seemed to have a nice, pleasant relationship with one another, participating in various family reunions and events together.
Romances
Gina Bianchi
Gina is Roland's ex-wife. While the exact reason why they separated is unknown, it's implied that it was due to the feud that Roland had with their son.
Friends/Allies
Charlotte, Marie-Louise, and Marguerite
They are Roland's pet mice who often helped him during his baking by fetching him the ingredients he needed.
Cat Noir

Roland first met them in "Simpleman", when Marinette asked him to babysit them while she helped Adrien, and Roland offered the teach the kids on how to make a potato launcher and to play darts, but Marinette rejected those ideas as she considered them dangerous and instead left them with her laptop playing a movie of Ladybug and Cat Noir.

title: Roland Dupain
text:
Roland Dupain - Relationships
When the kids watched the movie, Roland had a difficult time understanding the movie and instead tried to get the children to watch a VHS from a 45 soccer cup but not knowing on how to use the computer, he ended up turning the movie off, upsetting the children, who ran across his house, stressing him and leading to his akumatizaton, albeit he soon reassured the scared children they weren't the problem but the complexity of the outside world and decided to use his powers on everyone else (minus the children) to show them that simplicity is better.
Soon they walked across the city watching the simplified citizens and Simpleman stopped to buy them some ice cream and protected the kids from being hit by flying pizza boxes.
However, upon seeing the kids stopping the simplified Ladybug ant Cat Noir from handing over their Miraculouses, Simpleman apologized but decided to simplify the kids as well, albeit he was stopped by the heroes who managed to deakumatize him.
There the kids apologized to him and they went to watch the Ladybug movie, which they enjoyed.

title: Roland Dupain
text:
Roland Dupain - Etymology
Bakerix might be inspired by Asterix who is the main protagonist from the french comic series by Rene Goscinny and Albert Uderzo.

title: Roland Dupain
text:
Roland Dupain - Trivia
In "Bakerix", Roland is the third akumatized character to be related to Marinette, after Wang Cheng in "Kung Food", and Gina Bianchi in "Befana".
Roland was revealed during a Miraculous panel at Ludicomix on April 21, 2018. And according to Thomas Astruc, the story of this character will have some elements of his family's story.
During a Q & A on January 15 2019, Jeremy Zag confirmed we would see Marinette's grandfather and more of her family members.
In "Gamer 2.0", Bakerix returned as a playable akumatized villain as part of the Gamer 2.0's powers.
In "Simpleman", he became the first and only akumatized person to reject the name a Butterfly Miraculous holder gave him initially, specifically, he rejected the name because it was too complicated. Before settling with the titular name, Shadow Moth tried to call him Unravelder and Doctor Obsolete.
He will probably stay the only person to have done this, as starting in season 6, everyone who gets akumatized gets to pick their supervillain name.
Roland was the first in his family to receive a Magical Charm.

title: Roland Dupain
text:
Roland Dupain - Trivia
Roland, alongside Sabine, were the first people to receive more than one Magical Charm, as Shadow Moth managed to destroy both of their previous ones in "Dearest Family".
He was also the first person to have two Magical Charms with different designs, later being followed by Kagami and Tomoe Tsurugi in Season 5.
As of "Riginarazione", Roland is the second person to die permanently during the events of the series, after Gabriel Agreste. He's also Marinette's only relative who is known to be definitely deceased, albeit it is possible Sabine's parents have passed away.

title: Roger's police car
text:
Roger's police car - Intro
is a police car owned by Roger Raincomprix.
In "Rogercop", after being fired by the Mayor Bourgeois for refusing to search Marinette's bag for the bracelet of his daughter, Roger was akumatized by Hawk Moth into Rogercop, transforming his car together with him.
In "Daddycop", When Roger got akumatized by Chrysalis into Daddycop, his car transforms with him once again.

title: Roger's police car
text:
Roger's police car - Appearance
Normal
External
The car looks like a small, slightly rounded white city car. It has a blue "Police" lettering on the cap. The doors each have a large rectangular blue line with a white "Police" lettering and another thinner red line parallel to the previous one. It also has a large front windshield and a single blue headlight on the roof. At the rear, the vehicle has a storage compartment.
Internal
The interior of the car is quite simple. There are two seats in the front and one in the back. There is also a radio to listen to and answer calls from his police station. At roof level there are various controls for the vehicle's light and headlight.
Akumatized (Rogercop)
Under the effects of Roger's akumatization in Rogercop, the vehicle had transformed into an all-blue coupe car with a blue line running from the front of the bumper to the center of the rear doors. Its hood was very extended and it had a more voluminous bumper. There was also a silver police symbol. The car had a double blue-white-red flashing light on the roof and a spoiler on the trunk.

title: Roger's police car
text:
Roger's police car - Appearance
The interior had also changed radically, going from a simple vehicle to a truly cutting-edge car. The steering wheel had turned white, and a large touch screen replaced the car radio.
Akumatized (Daddycop)
TBA

title: Roger's police car
text:
Roger's police car - Abilities
Akumatized
Under the effects of Roger's akumatization in Rogercop, the vehicle had become capable of reaching very high speeds. Furthermore, it could fly smoothly and find the location of a target.

title: Roger's police car

Roger's police car - Trivia
This is the first vehicle in the series to be akumatized at the same time as its owner/driver.
Its registration is: 654 W 974.
Roger's police car is so far the largest akumatized object.

title: Robin Hood

title: Robin Hood
