title: Rose Lavillant
text:
Rose Lavillant - Intro
Rose Lavillant is a major character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She is a student at the Collège Françoise Dupont and a former student of Miss Bustier's class, before she became mayor of Paris. She is currently in a relationship with Juleka Couffaine.
In "Princess Fragrance", after Chloé Bourgeois teased Rose and tore up her letter to Prince Ali, she was akumatized by Hawk Moth and became Princess Fragrance, a perfume-shooting supervillain.
In "Félix", after being fooled by the titular character into thinking that Adrien didn't appreciate his friends' kind videos, Rose was reakumatized into Princess Fragrance yet again alongside Reflekta and Lady Wifi. The three formed the Punishers Trio, a group of akumatized supervillains who wanted to get revenge on the disguised Félix, who later convinced Hawk Moth to let him help them, as he was after some jewelry too.

title: Rose Lavillant
text:
Rose Lavillant - Intro
In "Gang of Secrets", after Marinette kept hiding secrets from her friends, Rose was reakumatized by Shadow Moth into Princess Fragrance alongside Lady Wifi, Reflekta, Timebreaker and Horrificator. These five supervillains formed the Gang of Secrets, a group of supervillains who wanted to reveal Marinette's secrets.
In "Guiltrip", after Juleka was reakumatized into Reflekta and the students are captured by her titular sentimonster, Rose received the Pig Miraculous from Ladybug. When the Miraculous is inhabited by Daizzi, Rose becomes Pigella, a pig-themed superhero with the power of Jubilation who helps Ladybug and Cat Noir during "particularly difficult missions" in the fourth season. It is also revealed she got sick when she was younger, and the sickness can reappear at any second. The exact illness is unrevealed.
After the events of "Strikeback", Rose was temporarily unable to become Pigella after Monarch managed to steal the Pig Miraculous along with the others contained in the Chinese Miracle Box from Ladybug's yo-yo.

title: Rose Lavillant
text:
Rose Lavillant - Intro
In "Re-creation", after Ladybug recovered the stolen Miraculous and reforged them following Monarch's defeat, Rose was given back the Pig Miraculous permanently and reunited with Daizzi.
In "Revelator", it's shown that, after getting her Miraculous back, Rose, along with the other secondary heroes of Ladybug's team, was trained to unlock her adult powers, no longer detransforming after using her power.

title: Rose Lavillant
text:
Rose Lavillant - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Rose is a fair-skinned slender teenage girl of petite stature. From season one through five, her hair is a buttermilk blonde pixie cut with bangs that slightly cover her eyes to the right and a tiny cowlick on top. In regards to her face, she has thin eyebrows, round vivid sapphire blue eyes, eyeliner and light brilliant magenta lipstick.
Originally, as shown in "Reflekta", she had straighter and shoulder-length hair when she was younger.
From Season 6 onwards, she is revealed to be completely bald and now wears a shorter wig and a headscarf as an accessory. She has glittery fuchsia eyeshadow, decorated with white sparkles and pink hearts at the bottom, and dark coral lipstick. She now wears a rainbow nail polish.
Civilian Attire
In the first five seasons, Rose wore a crotch-length light magenta dress with light pink cup sleeves. The dress had pink and vivid magenta stripes on the front, a pale pink wing design on the back, and a dark magenta wearable rope belt tied around her waist. She also wore a pink mini skirt with light pink lacy hemlines, white capri pants, two pink bracelets around her right wrist, and light pink gladiator sandals with thin brown soles.

title: Rose Lavillant
text:
Rose Lavillant - Appearance
On occasion until "Re-creation", she wore her Miraculous as an anklet on her left ankle, as the form and the pink and white color scheme of the pearl anklet remained the same, the only difference is that the five pearls disappeared to resemble its activated form.
From Season 6 onwards, she wears a cropped fuchsia cardigan jacket with small puffy sleeves that have a light pink stripe in the middle like her collar, the collar itself being open and dark pink, small gray buttons, a pink and vivid magenta striped shirt like her movie counterpart and a fuchsia silk waist belt with a white chibi cat side buckle that resembles Kitty Section, which is mainly fuchsia with light pink insides on the ears and mouth up to the center of the head and big slanted black eyes with shiny irises and cyan sclerae and horn, a two-layered fuchsia-to-vivid pink gradient layered skirt with pale pink leggings, white tube socks with two fuchsia stripes on top and pink loafers with lighter soles.

title: Rose Lavillant
text:
Rose Lavillant - Appearance
She accessorizes with a bead necklace around her neck, mainly consisting of fuchsia, light pink, violet, and orange beads, as well as a cyan star-shaped bead on the right. On the middle finger on her left hand, she wears a pink ring.
Her Miraculous is also worn around her right ankle, seemingly composed of rainbow-colored beads.
As Pigella
In Seasons 4-5, Pigella wore a sparkly vivid pink jumpsuit. It was swan-necked with a white neck and upper chest, bordered by a magenta collar and lining above the neck that had a matching-colored button with a lighter-colored swirl on top on the chest. The forearms had thin magenta outlines around them. The front of the torso was white and slanted downwards with magenta lining on either side. Her arms were also white with a matching-colored stripe on top, accented by the three thicker stripes around her leggings, going down to her white socks that had light pink soles featuring downward-pointing toes, and the stripes on each limb ending in a light pink swirl.

title: Rose Lavillant
text:
Rose Lavillant - Appearance
She had a three-layered light brilliant fuchsia skirt around her waist with a solid, rounded fuchsia belt wrapped around the top of it with an open front, and small fuchsia dots above. Her hair grew longer and was tied in two swirled pigtails, possibly resembling pig ears. Her bangs were straighter, curved, and swept aside with a small downward thick strand on the top of her head. Her mask was white at the top and light pink at the bottom with a magenta line in the middle.
Her Miraculous, an anklet, was worn around her left ankle. It turned into a light magenta chain with light pink beads and five light pink bell shaped pearls hanging from it on one side. Each of the five pearls had a small wire twirled around it that resembles a pig's curly tail. The pearls also had a small sphere of light inside of them. She also had her Tambourine.

title: Rose Lavillant
text:
Rose Lavillant - Appearance
From Season 6 onwards, her appearance changes significantly. Her bangs are more flat and swept to the right. Her hair is a lot shorter, replacing her pigtails with fuchsia pig ears and a lighter gradient at the tip, as well as swirled designs on top. She has thin swirly forelocks. The top of her jumpsuit is mostly the same, but it is more pearl pink in color; in addition, she now wears a sparkly magenta leotard, ditching the lining on her collar for transparent pearl pink small puffy sleeves. Her arms are mostly magenta with two pearl pink stripes on top, with her hands being dark violet. Her skirt is now transparent, shorter, two-layered, and pearl pink, with the middle part being missing and a dark pink bow adorning the back with two swirly ribbons sticking out of each side of her waist, resembling a pig's tail. Her leggings are pearl pink with thick, big magenta swirls at the top, and three more equally thick stripes below. Her feet and at the back of them turn black, likely resembling a pig's hooves. Her mask turns magenta with a pink blotch over her left eye, mimicking the ones sometimes found on pigs' eyes.

title: Rose Lavillant
text:
Rose Lavillant - Appearance
Her Tambourine also has slight changes, mainly the zills turning silver. Her Miraculous is also now worn on the right ankle, changing significantly in design. It's no longer a string of beads, but a dark fuchsia string with a single pink pendant on top, which has light fuchsia lining and a swirl at the bottom, and five pale pink stars in the center.
As Princess Fragrance
Princess Fragrance's skin was a moderate green, and her eyes were vivid blue-violet with brilliant fuchsia sclerae.
Her hair was a luminous vivid magenta with very light raspberry colored-edges on her sharper, pointier bangs. It was long and tied back into a rosebud-like bun, (hence her name) and detailed with black horizontal lines and black leaves around the bottom half. A black tube came out of the top of the bun and hung down to the back of her knees, and the end of her hair was tied with a black band. Some black paint was around her upper face and over her eyes with a swirl below her left eye, like a mask. She also had luminous vivid cerise-colored lipstick.

title: Rose Lavillant
text:
Rose Lavillant - Appearance
Her outfit was a black turtlenecked skin-tight suit that covered her arms and legs. Narrow cerise lines went down her dark mulberry puffed sleeves and puffed shorts, the shorts having bands around the bottom with cerise borders, and there was a cerise rose design on her chest. Her high heel shoes were connected to her suit, and they were also black, with cerise cone-shaped heels and pointed cerise tips to her toes. Her blaster was a dark purple tear-shaped bottle with pink horizontal lines, and the end was clear, rounded, light pink glass surrounded by dark gray leaf-like edges where it attached to the bottle. Through the bottle and out of the end of the glass was a small, dark gray pipe, which was where the perfume shot out. The handle and the trigger were thin, curled dark gray metal wire, and over one part of the handle near the back, there was a round, dark purple piece with indented lines spiraling around it.

title: Rose Lavillant
text:
Rose Lavillant - Personality
Rose is a sweet, innocent, outgoing, cheerful, generous, and sometimes a little silly girl who radiates positivity wherever she goes. With an sociable and jovial attitude, her kindness allows her to make friends easily by being very affectionate and friendly to everyone she meets. She enjoys going out and spending time with her friends, being particularly close to several of her schoolmates. True to how Marinette Dupain-Cheng described her in the webisode of the same name, Rose is expressive about the things and people she likes. She adores things that can be considered cute or childish, such as fairy tales, mythical creatures (especially unicorns) and plush toys, demonstrating her weakness for all things cute. She shares her girlfriend's passion for music, being the lead singer and songwriter for their band, Kitty Section. Rose likes romance and love, being one of her classmates who is most eager for Marinette and Adrien Agreste to become a couple, seeing Marinette's borderline-stalkerish schemes due to her obsession with Adrien as romantic. She is also a fan of film and theater, sharing with Prem her fanaticism for vampire movies.

title: Rose Lavillant
text:
Rose Lavillant - Personality
Rose's cheerful and optimistic disposition, as revealed in "Guiltrip", is due to the fact that she has a recurring illness that could come back at any time, and having a positive outlook is how she asserts some control over her life. Knowing this and admiring Rose's positive outlook on life and her courage in always wanting to help others, Ladybug chose her as the holder of the Pig Miraculous, and Rose happily accepted becoming a superheroine. Rose has come to terms with her illness and, unwilling to be treated differently, becomes uncomfortable when Juleka reveals her condition to their classmates. However, she understands her girlfriend and friends' concern for her well-being, grateful to have them by her side and proclaiming her love for them all.

title: Rose Lavillant
text:
Rose Lavillant - Personality
Due to her naive, kind-hearted nature, Rose's kindness can sometimes negatively affect her emotionally and put her in danger. In "Princess Fragrance", Rose asks Chloé Bourgeois, of all people, to deliver a letter to Prince Ali, who is staying at the Le Grand Paris, only for Chloé to destroy it in front of her to mock her, which ultimately results in Rose being akumatized by Hawk Moth. In "Timebreaker", she tries to help the titular villain after he falls and pretends to be hurt, only for the villain to mock her and steal her energy to increase her own power. In "Zombizou", she leaves safety to save Chloé from the titular villain's minions, which, although it saves the latter, results in Rose becoming infected.

title: Rose Lavillant
text:
Rose Lavillant - Personality
Rose is welcoming and encouraging, motivating her friends to be themselves and feel more comfortable doing what they are passionate about. She cares for everyone around her, often showing much gratitude, and tends to see the good in everything, even in those who do evil for fun. However, even she has her limits, especially when her loved ones are attacked. Although in "Derision" it's revealed that Rose initially tried to justify Chloé's despicable behavior because her mother abandoned her as a child, upon realizing that this doesn't excuse her bad actions, she eventually shares her classmates' disgust for Chloé. In "Daddycop", Rose still bears a grudge against Sabrina Raincomprix for the misdeeds she did to her friends in the past, such as indirectly causing Juleka's akumatization in "Reflekta", but she joins the other girls in forgiving her when Sabrina offers a sincere apology for her actions as Chloé's friend.

title: Rose Lavillant
text:
Rose Lavillant - Personality
Despite being sweet and somewhat docile, this doesn't make Rose vulnerable or fearful, demonstrating great courage. When she sees others in trouble, Rose doesn't hesitate to defend those in need, whether they are her friends or not, something that is noticed by both her friends and some akumatized villains. She is willing to take attacks from villains targeting her friends, taking an attack from the Gold Record to protect Luka Couffaine in "Migration", which prevented him from spilling Ladybug and Cat Noir's secret identities to Gold Record and by extension, Monarch. She doesn't hesitate to confront villains to help others, as shown in "Deflagration", where she and Juleka weaponize a tied-up Sole Destroyer against Monarch Bug, essentially forcing him to deakumatize her (and creating enough of a distraction for Adrien to be able to steal back the Ladybug earrings from him).

title: Rose Lavillant
text:
Rose Lavillant - Personality
As Pigella, she retains her normal personality, remaining the cheerful and happy girl she is, using her powers to spread happiness and counter the negativity brought by akumatized villains. Like a pig, she is curious and playful, being very cooperative when working with her teammates on missions and prioritizing the well-being of others over fighting villains. Pigella is also intelligent and stealthy, as shown when Ladybug gives Juleka a magical charm; she sneaks away to detransform in order to comfort Juleka and return the Pig Miraculous to Ladybug, without anyone noticing.

title: Rose Lavillant
text:
Rose Lavillant - Personality
As Princess Fragrance, she was obsessed with Prince Ali and would stop at nothing to accomplish her goal to make him hers. She wanted to live her own fairy tale by having people to treat her like royalty and tries to make Paris her own kingdom with a giant cloud of perfume. Because of this, she liked to sing and made everyone under her control sing like a musical, becoming enraged at anyone who stood in the way of her fantasy by taking Prince Ali away from her or would not follow her. She was also vengeful, making Chloé smell like rotten fish in retaliation for Chloé claiming her perfume smelled of such and for destroying her love letter to Prince Ali.
When akumatized a second time as Princess Fragrance in "Félix", she, along with Lady Wifi and Reflekta, wanted revenge on Adrien for sending an ungrateful message. However, after learning it was his cousin Félix Fathom, the Punisher Trio aimed their anger at him for making Adrien look like a monster. She would also "punish" anyone who got in their way, such as hypnotizing Lê Chiến Kim and Max Kanté.

title: Rose Lavillant
text:
Rose Lavillant - Personality
When akumatized a third time as Princess Fragrance in "Gang of Secrets", she, along with Lady Wifi, Reflekta, Timebreaker, and Horrificator, wanted to expose Marinette's secrets in hopes of saving her and to be friends again by forcing her to give them up by hypnotizing her with her perfume. Princess Fragrance and the Gang of Secrets had no qualms putting bystanders in danger to find Marinette, such as hypnotizing them to find Marinette. Her desire to persevere their friendship was so intense that she, Reflekta, Horrificator, and Timebreaker chased after an illusion of Marinette instead of stealing Cat Noir's ring.

title: Rose Lavillant
text:
Rose Lavillant - Abilities
As a Civilian
Rose has a talent for songwriting and proves to be an very good singer, writing lyrics in the art room and being the lead vocalist of her band Kitty Section.
Because of her positivity, Rose possesses a great deal of willpower against powers like the ones of the sentimonster Guiltrip, that is able to engulf its victims in their own guilt. She can also cheer up those around her, making them happy when they are feeling sad or desperate. She attempts to do this in "Reflekta" and "Reflekdoll".
Rose also possesses surprising strength for her size, impressing her classmates. In "Zombizou", she was able to sprint while carrying Chloé Bourgeois, although just barely. In "Guiltrip", she accidentally knocked the whole class over when they were all leaning against a door and eavesdropping.
As seen in "Sole Crusher", Rose does have experience with hair styling as he was able to dye Zoé Lee's hair and as implied in "Confrontation", she said that when she grows up, she wanted to be a hair stylist.
As Pigella

title: Rose Lavillant
text:
Rose Lavillant - Abilities
Pigella has enhanced capabilities such as speed, agility, and strength, and she is almost invulnerable to physical damage. These abilities allow her to react to and quickly evade enemy attacks, as well as jump and leap several times her height. Her tool is a tambourine, which is able to reflect energy reaching towards it such as beams and projectiles.
Pigella's special superpower, Gift, allows her to conjure a magical gift box. When the box is opened, it reveals an image of the targeted person's deepest wish. Initially, using her power would depower her and cause her to detransform after 5 minutes, however, in "Revelator", it is shown that Pigella has learned to control her adult powers, allowing her to not detransform back and use Gift as much as she wishes.
As Princess Fragrance
As Princess Fragrance, Rose's perfume bottle became a gun that could spray different scents, each with its own abilities. The barrel of the gun changed color to signify which one was being used. There were different types of scents seen:
The pink spray brainwashed anyone into serving her. Those affected would do whatever she says and speak only in song.

title: Rose Lavillant
text:
Rose Lavillant - Abilities
The green spray made whoever it hit give off a horrendous, rotten fish-like stench.
The yellow and orange spray had currently unknown powers.
If she pointed the gun downwards and continually shot perfume, it propelled her into and through the sky, allowing her to fly long distances.

title: Rose Lavillant
text:
Rose Lavillant - Etymology
In the Latin American dub, Rose's name is Rosa and Rosita.
Rose's surname is a modification of the surname "Laville", meaning "the city".
Her full name is a reference to the song "La Vie en rose" ("Life in pink") by French singer Édith Piaf.
Her surname also sounds similar to Cendrillon, the French name of the classical fairy tale Cinderella.
In an Instagram post sharing early concept art for Pigella, Thomas Astruc revealed that the heroine was originally called Porcinella.
Despite most dubs opted to use "Pigella" as Rose's superhero name, the European Portuguese dub decided to use her original superhero name.

title: Rose Lavillant
text:
Rose Lavillant - Trivia
Miraculous Holder and Akumatized Villain
On May 17, 2017, the writers revealed that Princess Fragrance will reappear in season 3.
Since then, it was confirmed that a scarlet version of Princess Fragrance would appear in the two-part special event "Heroes' Day".
However, due to the fact that the Heroes' Day two-parter was originally announced as a Season 3 episode but has since been confirmed as the finale of season 2, the writers may have simply been referring to her appearance in this two-parter.
Eventually, Princess Fragrance did return in season 3, appearing in "Félix", where she teamed up with Lady Wifi and Reflekta to make the Punishers Trio; in "Ladybug", where she appears briefly in her scarlet form; in "Gamer 2.0" for Gamer's powers; and as a statue in the Musée Grévin in "The Puppeteer 2".
In the openings of Seasons 2 and 4, Rose has pig stickers on her face, foreshadowing that she would become the owner of the Pig Miraculous.
She is the second Miraculous user to wear a skirt in her costume, following Mayura.

title: Rose Lavillant
text:
Rose Lavillant - Trivia
Following Alya Césaire, Nino Lahiffe, Chloé Bourgeois, Nathalie Sancoeur, Luka Couffaine, Max Kanté, Kagami Tsurugi, Alix Kubdel, Lê Chiến Kim, Adrien Agreste, Wang Fu, Zoé Lee and Mylène Haprèle, Rose is the fourteenth person to become a Miraculous holder and akumatized villain, excluding Gabriel Agreste, who akumatized himself.
Although having only one akumatized form throughout the series, Rose comes in fourth place, alongside Alya, Jagged and Philippe, for being akumatized the most times behind Mr. Ramier, Chloé, Kagami, Juleka, Lila and Roger, having become Princess Fragrance 6 times ("Princess Fragrance", "Catalyst", "Mayura", "Félix", "Ladybug", and "Gang of Secrets").
In both "Félix" and "Gang of Secrets", she is akumatized alongside Lady Wifi, and Reflekta in a group.
It should be noted that in "Ladybug" due to Nathalie's sickness, she and the other villains only got transformed, and didn't use their powers to fight Ladybug and Cat Noir.
Rose is the third person to use a Miraculous while under an illness, following Nathalie Sancoeur and Émilie Agreste.
However, Rose's illness is natural, and Émilie's and Nathalie's are caused from using the damaged Peacock Miraculous.

title: Rose Lavillant
text:
Rose Lavillant - Trivia
She is the first and only member of the French Miraculous superhero to use a Miraculous while under an illness.
In Season 6, Pigella has the Pig Miraculous symbol both on her back and on the badge on her chest, thus making her the only hero to have their respective Miraculous symbol twice.
However, Rooster Bold also has two identical buttons with the Rooster's symbol on his lapel.
Miscellaneous
During the derby hat competition in "Mr. Pigeon", Rose and Juleka are standing next to a derby hat with gears attached to it, suggesting one or both of them made the hat.
An earlier concept design for Rose includes her hair being slightly longer and curlier and her shoes having flowers on them.
In the past class photo seen in "Reflekta", Rose has longer, roughly shoulder-length hair.
In "Princess Fragrance", "The Evillustrator", "Antibug", "Reflekta", and "Pixelator", it is shown that she is left-handed. but the most of the recent episodes she is shown as right-handed.  This is either a continuity error or Rose is ambidextrous.
In her webisode, "Rose", it is revealed that she is the lead singer and the songwriter of Kitty Section.

title: Rose Lavillant
text:
Rose Lavillant - Trivia
In the same webisode, it's also revealed she has a grandmother, though unnamed for the time being.
Rose is the only student in Miss Bustier's class whose family has not yet been revealed in canon.
It's revealed in "Guiltrip" that Rose has an unknown illness that causes her to have headaches and feel weak ever since she was a little child. She has only told Juleka about it, as she feared her other friends would treat her differently because of it, which does end up happening for a short while.
In "Vampigami" suggests that Rose has cancer, as it is revealed that she wears a wig and is bald underneath due to her illness, implying that she has been receiving chemotherapy.
Rose mentions she's the second character other than Chloé to have a teddy bear.
In sixth grade, Rose had an imaginary friend named Unicorn Lilly.
In "Confrontation", it is implied that Rose wants to be an animal hairstylist when she grows up.

title: Sabine Cheng
text:
Sabine Cheng - Intro
, born 郑夏冰/Cheng Xia Bing (or Xia Bing Cheng in western order), and often referred to as Sabine Dupain-Cheng, is a recurring character in Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She is a highly upheld merchant and the co-owner of Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie. She is the wife of Tom Dupain and the loving mother of Marinette Dupain-Cheng.
In "Ladybug", after believing Marinette to be a liar and a thief, she was nearly akumatized by Scarlet Moth into Verity Queen. However, her akumatization was interrupted because of Nathalie Sancoeur's illness and was never fully completed.
In "Qilin", after being racially profiled and wrongfully arrested for supposedly not paying for a bus ticket, and the police not listening to her attempts to explain, she got akumatized by Shadow Moth into Qilin, a Chinese mythical beast-themed supervillain with wind-based powers. She also received a Magical Charm from Ladybug that prevented her from being reakumatized.

title: Sabine Cheng
text:
Sabine Cheng - Intro
In "Dearest Family", when Sabine, Tom, Roland and Gina started arguing about what each one thought was best for Marinette, they were reakumatized by Shadow Moth into Qilin, Weredad, Bakerix and Befana respectively, and formed the villainous group Dearest Family, who competed with each other to prove that they knew what was best for Marinette. She also received a new magical charm from Ladybug after her first one got destroyed.
In "Secret Protocol", Sabine celebrates her birthday as her uncle, Wang Cheng, makes a surprise visit. Later, Fei calls her, revealing that Wang has been in Shanghai the entire time. This leaves her to question who was in the guest room, causing her, Tom, and Marinette to become frightened. At the end of the episode, Marinette reveals that she is Ladybug by transforming in front of Sabine and Tom.

title: Sabine Cheng
text:
Sabine Cheng - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Sabine is a short Chinese-French woman with light skin, short black hair with blue reflections in a bob style, whitish-pink lips, and gray eyes.
From Season 6 onwards, her eyes are now dark gray, and her hair has turned jet-black with swept bangs on her forehead and salmon-pink lips.
Civilian Attire
She wears a white Cheongsam with a red, black and gold plant design, periwinkle pants and black and white dress shoes. She wears a silver band on her ring finger.
From Season 6 onwards, Sabine is wearing a white traditional dress with black trim and frog-button closures. The dress has a red floral design on the front, and the sleeves have black cuffs. Additionally, her wedding ring is now golden.
As Qilin

title: Sabine Cheng
text:
Sabine Cheng - Appearance
Qilin had orange skin and blank eyes without any pupils or irises. She wore a Chinese armor with a jade green chain mail covered by a dark green chest and abdominal plates with golden edges, a skirt armor with jade green chain mail, red and dark green shoulder plates with golden edges and red spiral-shaped ornaments at her waist with a long brushy dark green tail with brilliant green tips. She also wore dark green pants with red coloring at her thighs with golden poleyns and her feet were hoofed. Protecting her head, she had a golden helmet that is shaped after the head of the mythical creature Qilin, having blank eyes just like her, a red mustache with two long whiskers, a long golden horn that branched itself into four tips, and a dark green mane with green tips.

title: Sabine Cheng
text:
Sabine Cheng - Personality
Sabine is a gentle, kind, and loving woman to her family and the people around her. However, she is a good responsible parent who will discuss issues with her daughter at the worst. Sometimes, Sabine is a bit nosy and over-involved, usually when it comes to Marinette with her crushes. She still keeps to her boundaries though, and she wants the best for everyone.
For the bakery, Sabine is warm and professional, often treating others respectfully. With great concern and compassion toward others, she helps those in need with selflessness, from people she doesn't know well like Lê Chiến Kim in "Animan" to people she knows personally like Marinette and Adrien Agreste.
In "Weredad", she isn't as hasty as Tom when he believed Marinette was in "love" with Cat Noir aware that the hero didn't return her feelings. In "Family", Marinette describes her as calm, gentle and, never panics but tough and, always finds the solution to every problem being described as Marinette's everyday hero.

title: Sabine Cheng
text:
Sabine Cheng - Personality
In "Qilin", Sabine is shown to be deeply in touch with the traditions and superstitions of her Chinese roots, making Feng Shui to keep negative energies away, practicing Tai Chi and teaching chinese painting. She is cool, calm, very organized and thinks ahead, even predicting her daughter's accidents even before they happened and being always prepared for them.
However, Sabine is not without a temper, which only is shown when she is facing a terrible injustice, as she faced when she was caught in the bus without a ticket. But, despite facing all this injustice, she still did not harm anyone. Together with her strong will, she is shown to not easily give in to Shadow Moth's influence.

title: Sabine Cheng
text:
Sabine Cheng - Personality
As Qilin, her personality remained the same, but her dislike for injustice was even stronger, attacking all those who she knew to perform it, however, without harming them. Her dislike, with a little push from Shadow Moth, even extended to those who protect the injustice perpetrators, like Ladybug and Cat Noir, thinking that protecting those who practice injustice is the same thing. However, she was a firm believer of honesty and she always kept her part of an agreement, as long as others did the same. When Ladybug proved to her she was telling the truth about wanting to free her from her cuffs, Qilin decided to stop her rampage and let Ladybug take off the cuffs, without attacking her, ignoring Shadow Moth's orders and breaking free from his akumatization.

title: Sabine Cheng
text:
Sabine Cheng - Personality
In "Dearest Family", during her second akumatization as Qilin, she was shown to be very protective of her daughter's rights, having a great trust on her sense of judgment and believing she just needed her by her side. Because of this, Qilin got very competitive with the rest of her akumatized family, fighting with them to prevent them from imposing their way of raising Marinette or trying to beat them into getting Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses.

title: Rooster Miraculous
text:
Rooster Miraculous - Intro
The  is a thumb ring that, whenever Orikko inhabits it, transforms the wearer into a rooster-themed superhero with the power of  Pretension.
To activate the thumb ring, the user must speak the transformation phrase: "Sunrise". To deactivate the thumb ring, the user must speak the detransformation phrase, which is currently unknown.
The thumb ring is currently owned by Marc Anciel, who uses it to transform into Rooster Bold. It was previously stored in the Chinese Miracle Box and only lent out to him when the situation required it.  But, as of "Re-creation", he now posseses the Miraculous permanently.

title: Rooster Miraculous
text:
Rooster Miraculous - Appearance
In general, the Rooster Miraculous is composed of two rings that are connected by a chain. In its charged mode, when Orikko inhabits it, each ring is golden, covering the entire thumb with the ring on top having a point that resembles a rooster's spur or talon. The Miraculous gains five orange segments, two on the upper ring and three on the lower ring. If a minor is using the Miraculous, the thumb ring starts running out of power, indicated by the segments making a beeping sound, and start discoloring one at a time as an indication of how much time (one segment is equivalent to one minute) Marc (or another Rooster Miraculous holder) has left.
In Season 6 onwards, the five orange segments now change to three thick red segments and the claw tip is now thinner and sharper.
In its activated mode, the five segments are black.
In its camouflage mode, the thumb ring changes color and form depending on whose possession it's in:
In the possession of Marc Anciel, the tip is gone and it is silvery gray with two links connected by a chain.
In Season 6 onwards, the ring has one link and turns gold with black lines forming the spine from the fountain pen.

title: Rooster Miraculous
text:
Rooster Miraculous - Appearance
When it was worn by Gabriel Agreste, it was silver.
When it was worn by Chloé Bourgeois, it was golden and composed of four rings, two per phalanx, with a honeycomb pattern connecting the rings to the chain.
When it was worn by Marinette Dupain-Cheng, it was grayish with two hearts connecting the links to the chain.
In it's reforged ring form, it was a thick band with a circular surface, similar to the Cat Miraculous, inside of it was the symbol of the Rooster Miraculous which glowed maize. It used to sit on the intermediate phalange of Gabriel's right ring finger.

title: Rooster Miraculous
text:
Rooster Miraculous - Abilities
The Rooster Miraculous has the ability to transform its wielder into a rooster-themed superhero, granting its wielder incredible powers of speed, endurance, agility, stamina and strength.
Its special weapon is an unbreakable fountain pen, which can be utilized as both a weapon, a communicator, and an object that can be used to breathe underwater. Its special superpower is called Sublimation, which allows the user to gain any ability they desire in order to obtain their goal, like defeating a villain. As long as the superpower isn't used, the wielder can remain transformed indefinitely. However, as soon as the superpower is used by a minor, the wielder loses power and the transformation wears off in approximately five minutes. The thumb ring also has the ability to give the wielder the costume they truly desire.

title: Rooster Miraculous
text:
Rooster Miraculous - History
Five thousand years ago, a mage successfully helped the kwamis to interact with humans by creating magic jewels, which were called Miraculouses. In order to repay the mage, and to live on the physical world alongside humans, the kwamis decided to help humanity by letting humans utilize their energy and powers through the Miraculous they were bonded with, which included Orikko and the Rooster Miraculous.
At some point in time, all of the knowledge about the Miraculouses and their powers was written down in code in a book called the Grimoire, with very few people knowing how to decipher the code. Miracle Boxes were also created at an unknown time to store the dormant Miraculouses. To protect and distribute Miraculouses, the Order of the Guardians was formed and existed for many years. Throughout its existence, guardians trained younger generations to keep a watchful eye over the Miraculouses and the Grimoire, which were placed in the guardians' temple.
Many Rooster holders throughout history used Orikko's power for good, like Gōngjī in China, who started the legacy.

title: Rooster Miraculous
text:
Rooster Miraculous - History
172 years ago, after an disastrous event where a young Wang Fu used the Peacock Miraculous to create a sentimonster and his negative emotions and imaturity led to the creature rampaging through the temple and eating and destroying everything in its path, Fu was entrusted with the Chinese Miracle Box (Which included the Rooster Miraculous) by a monk and was told to run away from the mess. However, on the mountain range outside the temple, in order to escape from the the monster, Fu jumped over a fissure on the ground - accidently opening the Box and spilling all of its contents on the snow. Due to his distress, Fu didnt notice he accidently left both the Peacock and the Butterfly on the mountain, alongisde the Grimoire, until it was too late and he was too far away to come back. Somewhere along the line, the Peacock got dangerously damaged, to the point of being improper for use - but, as it turns out, no one knew of this fact until it was too late.

title: Rooster Miraculous
text:
Rooster Miraculous - History
On a previous trip overseas with the Agrestes, Nathalie found the Butterfly and Peacock Miraculouses and gave the jewels to Gabriel. In "Representation", it was revealed that neither the Agrestes nor the Graham de Vanily couples could bear children on their own, so Émilie and Colt used the Peacock Miraculous to create Adrien and Félix respectively, but in doing so, they grew sick over time and were eventually left in a condition where they fell into an eternal slumber due to using the Peacock Miraculous in its damaged state.

title: Rooster Miraculous
text:
Rooster Miraculous - History
Desperate to fix his mistake, Gabriel Agreste began using the Butterfly Miraculous for evil to obtain the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses in order to gain access to their absolute power, becoming the supervillain Hawk Moth, later Shadow Moth (when unified with a now fixed Peacock Miraculous), and finally Monarch. This decision proved one of the most significant for the history of the series, as Gabriel began utilizing Nooroo's power to akumatize the civilians of Paris, France, trying to get one of them to draw out the current holders of the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses, unintenionally helping start off Marinette's and Adrien's journeys as Ladybug and Cat Noir, and later, the rest of the Miraculers.
One of the members of the Miraculers is Marc Anciel, who was chosen by Ladybug in "Penalteam" to wield the Rooster Miraculous, becoming the hero Rooster Bold. Marc, from that point on, became a member of the team, helping Ladybug and Cat Noir during "particularly difficult missions". From "Penalteam" to "Strikeback", Marc was a temporary holder, meaning he would only receive the Miraculous from Ladybug when he was needed for the mission, and had to give it back after the crisis was solved.

title: Rooster Miraculous
text:
Rooster Miraculous - History
Félix, after finding out about his true origins as a sentihuman and learning that the Peacock Miraculous could erase his and his cousin's lifes if it feel into the wrong hands, orchestrated a plan to capture all of the Miraculouses of the Chinese Box from Ladybug and traded all of them (besides the Ladybug and the Cat) for the Peacock, which included the Rooster Miraculous, succeeding in "Strikeback". When Gabriel unified it with the Butterfly and other miraculouses, he became Monarch.

title: Rooster Miraculous
text:
Rooster Miraculous - History
In "Destruction", Gabriel used a laser machine to melt down the Miraculous into a pile of dust, and then reforged it into a special alliance ring for transferring Orikko's power of Pretension to any Akumatized villain who wore a regular Alliance ring. In "Re-creation", Marinette Dupain-Cheng manages to recover all of the Miraculous that were previously stolen. In "Miraculous London", Lila stole all of the Miraculous under Marinette's care in an alternate timeline, which included the Rooster Miraculous, in order to render her truly powerless and to fuse the Ladybug and the Cat to gain her wish without her interference, but her plan was ultimately thwarted by the combined efforts of Chronobug and Bunnyx, and the event was erased from the timeline.

title: Rooster Miraculous
text:
Rooster Miraculous - History
After the events of "Miraculous London", Marinette, having realized both instances of all of the Miraculouses being stolen happened because all of them were kept in the same place, and with the idea that centralized power is inherently flawed, and that distributing it among members of a society is a far superior idea, restored and upgraded the Rooster Miraculous by redesigning its original design and adding the Miraculous Call: a call feature that grants the holder the ability to summon other superheroes who possess a Miraculous from the Chinese Miracle Box in order to receive aid on their missions. This new feature is particularly useful, as the new holder of the Butterfly Miraculous, Chrysalis, is even more fearsome than her predecessor. After the alterations, the Rooster Miraculous was given back to Marc permanently - putting Rooster Bold back on the map.

title: Rooster Miraculous
text:
Rooster Miraculous - Trivia
Roosters symbolize pride, honesty, watchfulness, and flamboyance.
The Gallic rooster is the unofficial national symbol of France as a nation. Its association with France dates back to the Middle Ages due to the coincidental homonyms of the Latin words Gallus (inhabitants of Gaul) and gallus ("rooster"). The French onomatopoeia for its crowing, "cocorico" (equivalent to the English "cock-a-doodle-do") is sometimes used as an expression of national pride.
In the animatic of the theme song, a Miraculous with a rooster-like appearance appears on the top level of the Miracle Box.
This is the third Miraculous to be based off of a ring following the Cat and Ox Miraculouses.
The form of the Rooster Miraculous is a reference to the spurs that roosters are known to have and are their fiercest weapons in the defense of their hens or to fight with other roosters.

title: Rose Lavillant/History
text:
Rose Lavillant/History - Intro
Rose Lavillant is a teenage girl in Miss Bustier's class. In the episode "Guiltrip" it is said that she had an illness as a child.

title: Rose Lavillant/History
text:
Rose Lavillant/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Ladybug & Cat Noir", Rose sits in Miss Bustier's class until it's time for gym. Once gym class was over, she was getting ready to leave the field until Stoneheart arrived, causing her to run away in fear.
In "Stoneheart", Rose is one of the many people who crowd Ivan after his previous akumatization. During attendance, Rose is just as shocked as everyone else when they find that Ivan was reakumatized. Rose is then seen in the library with the rest of her class watching the news when Hawk Moth announces himself and demands that Ladybug and Cat Noir surrender their Miraculouses. She appears scared, but when Ladybug refuses and vows to protect the citizens of Paris, Rose happily cheers. The next day, Rose witness Marinette stand up to Chloé and is amused.

title: Rose Lavillant/History
text:
Rose Lavillant/History - [[Season 1]]
In "The Bubbler", Rose was one of the many people Bubbler forced to attend a surprise birthday party for Adrien. She was seen dancing and when asked by Adrien if she's having fun, she gave him a thumbs up but made it quite obvious that she was miserable. When Ladybug and Cat Noir show up, Rose and the other party goers cheer them on but angered Bubbler, causing him to trap her and the others in floating bubbles. However, after Bubbler's defeat, Rose was saved.
In "Mr. Pigeon", during Gabriel Agreste's fashion contest, Rose is seen standing beside Juleka with a gear-inspired derby hat.
In "Timebreaker", Rose cheers on Alix when she competes against Kim in a race. When Alix is akumatized into Timebreaker, the villain takes advantage of Rose's kindness and tricks her into touching her, therefore allowing Timebreaker to steal her energy and causing Rose to fade from existence. However, Rose is brought back after Ladybug and Cat Noir defeat Timebreaker.

title: Rose Lavillant/History
text:
Rose Lavillant/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Dark Cupid", when Miss Bustier talks to her class about the fairy tale Sleeping Beauty, Rose expresses her belief that only love can conquer hate. When battling Dark Cupid, Ladybug remembers what Rose said and is able to use that to help her return Cat Noir to normal after he's infected by the villain.
In "Horrificator", Rose helps her classmates make a short film. She is shown to be mainly in charge of providing snacks. When the class realizes that Kim and Max are missing and something unusual is happening, she offers everyone fruity snacks as they run out of the classroom. Rose sticks with Ladybug, Cat Noir, and the rest of her class as they are pursued by Horrificator. Little by little, Rose's classmates are captured by the monster, though Rose herself manages to avoid this. She helps Ladybug and Cat Noir defeat Horrificator by performing Smelly Wolf.

title: Rose Lavillant/History
text:
Rose Lavillant/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Darkblade", Rose considers running for class representative but drops the idea when Chloé threatens to kick her out of the scrapbooking club. She is delighted when Marinette decides to run against her, stating that she spoke from the heart, and requests that she add pink comfortable chairs into the classrooms when she wins. However, when Chloé invited everyone to City Hall to get autographs from Jagged Stone, she, along with her other classmates, went until Darkblade surrounded the place. Rose asked Chloé what a class representative would do, but Chloé told her to wait for an answer tomorrow despite Rose insisting that they can't wait that long. Therefore, Marinette was the one who told everyone what they should do, with Rose being told to come with her. Rose, along with the rest of her class, was briefly turned into a knight by Darkblade, but Ladybug and Cat Noir soon defeated the villain and everyone else returned to normal. The next day, she and everyone else in the class voted Marinette as their class representative.

title: Rose Lavillant/History
text:
Rose Lavillant/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Princess Fragrance", Rose listened to an announcement on her phone about Prince Ali's visit to Paris to help the children's hospital and expressed her adoration him. When Rose wrote a letter to him and sprayed it with perfume, Ms. Mendeleiev got irritated and sent her to the principal. After school, Rose overhears that Prince Ali will be staying at Le Grand Paris hotel and asks Chloé to deliver her letter to him, though Chloé laughs in her face and rips the letter to shreds, breaking Rose's heart and causing her to become akumatized into Princess Fragrance.
She went to Le Grand Paris hotel and requested that she see Prince Ali, claiming to be his princess.
When the doorman refused to let her in, she sprayed him with her perfume, turning him into her loyal subject.
She goes up to the room where Prince Ali is and, after spraying Chloé to make her smell bad, she chases the prince and attempts to spray him with her perfume multiple times until Cat Noir arrives.
Though Cat Noir, the prince, his chaperone, and Chloé managed to escape the villain in Prince Ali's car, she caught up to them and sprayed them all.

title: Rose Lavillant/History
text:
Rose Lavillant/History - [[Season 1]]
She took them to the Pont des Arts bridge and prepared to seal her love to Prince Ali with a padlock.
Ladybug knocked the padlock out of her hands before she could do so.
Enraged, Princess Fragrance orders her servants to attack Ladybug while she takes off with Prince Ali.
She attempts to use her perfume to turn Paris into a kingdom for her and the prince, though Ladybug manages to stop the effects of her perfume using fireworks before this can happen.
Princess Fragrance decides that she and Prince Ali should just leave Paris, but Ladybug intervenes and eventually defeats her.
Once deakumatized, Rose was excited to see Prince Ali and tells him that she finds him to be the most kindhearted person.
Happy, he invites her to help him at the children's hospital, to which Rose accepts.

title: Rose Lavillant/History
text:
Rose Lavillant/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Gamer", Rose along with the rest of her classmates watch as Max and Adrien compete to be finalists in a video game contest. She is surprised when Marinette asks to try out but is even more surprised when she easily defeats Max. She feels bad for him losing his spot, knowing how badly he wanted to compete. Eventually at the actual tournament, Rose was cheering for Max and Marinette as they prepared to enter the competition.
In "Pixelator", Rose was seen baking in Le Grand Paris' kitchen alongside Nino, Max, and Juleka.

title: Rose Lavillant/History
text:
Rose Lavillant/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Reflekta", when Juleka expresses disappointment over the fact that she isn't going to appear in the class photo, Rose tells her that she isn't jinxed and has a feeling in her heart that everything will be okay. However, thanks to Chloé, Juleka winds up locked in the bathroom and misses the class photo. Rose eventually frees her and explains what happened, causing Juleka to run off crying. When she told Marinette and Alya that Juleka might be jinxed after all, Marinette got an idea and told Rose that if the class photo disappeared, another one would have to be taken. Rose finds this to be genius but wonders why the class photo would disappear, to which Marinette simply tells her to find Juleka while she takes care of everything else.
When her best friend was akumatized she was changed into a Reflekta copy. With Cat Noir's encouragement, Rose and the others stopped Reflekta from taking Ladybug's earrings. After Reflekta's defeat, Rose gathers with her other classmates to take class photos in the park, all while expressing relief that Juleka's class photo curse is over.

title: Rose Lavillant/History
text:
Rose Lavillant/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Volpina", Rose expresses fascination upon hearing that Lila knows Prince Ali and once rode in his private jet.

title: Rose Lavillant/History
text:
Rose Lavillant/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Santa Claws", Rose and Juleka go to the Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie to pick up a Christmas log. When Marinette wishes them a Merry Christmas, Rose and Juleka wish her a Merry Christmas, too. Then, upon hearing that Adrien has gone missing, Rose is one of the many people who goes searching for him. Once she learns that he's home safe, Rose, along with Adrien's other friends, goes to the Agreste mansion to check on him and is invited inside for a Christmas feast.
In "The Collector", Rose finds out that Adrien's father has forbidden him from coming back to school and was just as disappointed as the rest of her classmates. However, when Adrien comes back the next day, she was delighted.

title: Rose Lavillant/History
text:
Rose Lavillant/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Despair Bear" during Tom Dupain's cooking lesson, Rose points out that he was making macarons, not croissants. When Chloé secretly called the fire department, Mr. Damocles punished the whole school, with Rose being forced to mop the floors. While doing so, she was rudely told by Chloé to go sweep somewhere else, causing her to cry. Later, she helps Marinette by modeling some hats she designed and also takes a liking to the jewels she's made. She then receives a text from Chloé inviting her to a party and finds this to be nice of her. She attends the party and thanks Chloé for the invite with two kisses on the cheek. She appears to have fun until Despair Bear crashes the party. After Despair Bear's defeat, Tom is invited to finish his cooking lesson, and Rose winds up baking some pink macarons. However, when Chloé insults them, she can't help but faint.

title: Rose Lavillant/History
text:
Rose Lavillant/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Befana", Rose helped plan and attends Marinette's 14th birthday party. When Befana attacks Marinette, she meekly tells her not to, calling Marinette the nicest person in the world. Though Befana gets annoyed that Rose spoke without permission, she admires her willingness to stand up for her friend. Therefore, Rose is turned into a fairy servant. Once Ladybug and Cat Noir defeat Befana, Rose was returned to normal and continued celebrating Marinette's birthday.
In "Robostus", Rose along with almost everyone in her class is amazed by Max's robot Markov.

title: Rose Lavillant/History
text:
Rose Lavillant/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Gigantitan", Rose along with Juleka, Mylène, and Alix were brought to Marinette's house by Marinette and Alya. When Alya tells them that Marinette has a crush on someone, the girls reveal that they know it's Adrien as she doesn't hide it very well. When Marinette asks if Adrien knows, Rose assures her that boys don't pick up on things like that. As part of Marinette's and Alya's plan to set Marinette up on a romantic date with Adrien, Rose is given the code name "Tulip" and put in charge of signaling the rickshaw driver. She asks why her code name isn't "Rose" instead of Juleka, to which Marinette and Alya tell her that since "Rose" is her real name, it wouldn't be much of a code name if she were called that. Despite seeing a potential problem, Rose agreed to go along. However, during the actual setup, Rose expressed confusion due to the girls calling Juleka "Rose" and mistakenly believed that they were talking to her. As a result, she signals the rickshaw driver too soon, and the entire plan was foiled.

title: Rose Lavillant/History
text:
Rose Lavillant/History - [[Season 2]]
When baby August was akumatized into Gigantitan, Rose ran to safety and embraced the girls, though she realized that Marinette was missing and asked where "Lotus" was. When the others were confused, she clarified that she meant Marinette. They go looking for her, only to be chased by Gigantitan. Later, when Gigantitan was about to put Ladybug in his mouth, Rose and the other girls helped her by distracting the baby, causing him to drop her. After Gigantitan's defeat, Rose and the other girls are delighted to see Marinette. When they spot Adrien, the girls suggest that they try their plan again, though Marinette reveals that she's decided not to do the complicated plan. Rose watched her talking to Adrien from afar with the others, comparing the scene to a romantic movie. She was somewhat irritated when Marinette failed to ask Adrien to a rickshaw ride but was delighted when Adrien offered to take her home in his car, though she finds herself shocked when Marinette turns the offer down. Once Adrien was gone, Rose told Marinette that at least she managed to get a third of a sentence out and joins the girls on a rickshaw ride home.

title: Rose Lavillant/History
text:
Rose Lavillant/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Gorizilla", she, Juleka, Mylène, and Alya wait outside the swimming pool entrance for Marinette. The girls see multiple pictures online of her with Adrien and are fascinated, with Rose commenting on how cute they are together. Eventually, the girls contact Marinette and, after asking for the details, reveal that they are still waiting for her at the pool.
In "Captain Hardrock", Rose helps set up the Couffaine houseboat for Kitty Section's concert at the music festival. She expresses excitement over her very first concert and later alerts Anarka that everything is set, though Luka is missing. When the band's volume is deemed too loud by Officer Roger and Anarka is akumatized into Captain Hardrock as a result, Rose is chained up against Juleka and thrown underground, though she is later freed by Ladybug. After Captain Hardrock's defeat, Kitty Section performs their concert, with Rose singing vocals.

title: Rose Lavillant/History
text:
Rose Lavillant/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Frightningale", Rose went with the other girls to audition as extras in Clara Nightingale's video. When Marinette was offered the role of Ladybug after she helps Clara up when she trips, Rose was happy for her and says that she deserves it. But when Marinette turns down the offer to be with her friends, Rose embraces her in a hug along with the other girls. She was surprised when Chloé came to audition for the Ladybug role, but she laughed when Marinette told the girls that Chloé didn't stand a chance of being chosen. However, when Chloé gets the part and Marinette changes her mind as a result, Rose cheers her friend on. When Alya takes multiple pictures of Marinette and Adrien together, Rose expresses fascination at how much the two look like the real Ladybug and Cat Noir. She was disappointed when Chloé caused the music video to be canceled and when Clara is akumatized into Frightningale. Rose runs away to safety. The next day, Rose watches Clara's completed music video and says that the new version is so much better.
In "Syren", Rose was seen at the movies with her friends. When the theater winds up flooding, Rose rushes up to the roof for safety.

title: Rose Lavillant/History
text:
Rose Lavillant/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Zombizou", Rose reveals that for Miss Bustier's birthday, she has made her a scrapbook inspired by the exercise they do every morning where they say a kind word to one of their classmates. Rose was just as disappointed as the rest of her class when she learned that Chloé didn't get Miss Bustier a gift but was really upset when Chloé ruined Marinette's gift. When Miss Bustier is akumatized into Zombizou, Rose, along with the rest of her classmates, run away to safety. She hid inside one of the lockers in the locker room until Ladybug showed up and led the group to the top of the school's roof. When Zombizou's zombies begin to approach, Rose alerts everyone. She is one of the people that Cat Noir helps slide down to the safety of a nearby bus. When Chloé slides down too fast and is surrounded by zombies, Rose rushes outside and helps her. However, she is unknowingly kissed on the leg and soon turns into a kissing zombie who infects Juleka and Alix as well, forcing Ladybug and Cat Noir to leave the three on the bus. Once returned to normal, Rose embraces Juleka and Alix in a hug.

title: Rose Lavillant/History
text:
Rose Lavillant/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Frozer", when Marinette tells the girls at the Couffaine houseboat about Adrien's date with Kagami, the girls all suggest ways she can get out of it, with Rose suggesting that Marinette claim she got lost on the way over. However, she is shocked when Marinette says that she doesn't want to cancel as Adrien is her friend and needs her. Rose expresses her belief that the two love each other, but when Marinette says that she thinks there's nothing between them and that she and Adrien are better off friends, Rose disagrees and quickly gets into an argument with the other girls.
In "Style Queen (Queen's Battle - Part 1)", Rose is seen in the front row seat of Gabriel Agreste's fashion show and is horrified when Style Queen shows up and turns Adrien into a glitter statue.
In "Queen Wasp (Queen's Battle - Part 2)", Rose is seen watching Gabriel Agreste's fashion show.
In "Reverser", while writing and listening to song lyrics, Rose happily greets Marc when he comes to Art Club. Later, Rose is horrified when Reverser shows up. He reverses her so that she hates writing music.

title: Rose Lavillant/History
text:

In "Malediktator", Rose along with the rest of her classmates laugh at Chloé's Queen Bee presentation. Later, when she heard that Chloé was leaving Paris, she was as ecstatic as everyone else and happily celebrates. However, Malediktator soon crashed the party and made it so that Rose (and other students and staff) destroys the school. After Malediktator's defeat, Rose attends the party honoring Queen Bee.

title: Rose Lavillant/History
text:
Rose Lavillant/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part 1)", like most of her classmates, Rose believes Lila when she tells everyone on a video chat that she is in the Kingdom of Achu and will be meeting up with Prince Ali to show him an idea she thought of. When Max asks Lila what her idea is, Rose says that she's sure it's amazing. After Lila's video chat ends, Rose listens as Mr. Damocles shows up and starts talking to the class about Ladybug's and Cat Noir's heroism. When Marinette says that for her good deed she will organize a tasting with lots of treats, Rose becomes excited. However, she later learns that Ladybug was akumatized and destroyed Cat Noir with his Cataclysm (unaware that it was Volpina's illusion) and shows Adrien and Marinette the news about it. Then, a whole bunch of scarlet akumas appear in the school, and Rose winds up reakumatized into Princess Fragrance, who then heads to the Eiffel Tower where Scarlet Moth is.

title: Rose Lavillant/History
text:
Rose Lavillant/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)", Princess Fragrance begins praising Scarlet Moth until he signals for her and his other akumatized villains to stop. She battles the heroes but is quickly deakumatized and caught by Queen Bee. When Dark Cupid infects her with his arrows, Rose's emotions become negative, and she is reakumatized. After Scarlet Moth is reverted into Hawk Moth, Rose is once again deakumatized. Later, she attends a picnic for Marinette with Miss Bustier's class.

title: Rose Lavillant/History
text:
Rose Lavillant/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Chameleon" when Lila returns to school, Rose, along with the rest of Miss Bustier's class, happily greets her. She believes Lila's lie about having tinnitus and needing a front row seat. She moves to accommodate her and expresses disapproval when Marinette shows reluctance in changing her seat. Later during lunch, Rose believes Lila when she claims to have a sprained wrist, so she helps in getting her lunch for her. When Marinette throws a napkin at Lila and Lila catches it with her "sprained wrist", Rose is as shocked as everyone else, though she believes Lila when she says that she had wanted to catch the napkin before it hit Max's eye. After the defeat of Chameleon, Rose and the rest of her class continue to listen as Lila lies about being friends with Ladybug. Shortly after she returns to class, Lila claims that her tinnitus is gone and she no longer needs a front row seat. Therefore, the class, including Rose, begins to return to their normal seats.

title: Rose Lavillant/History
text:
Rose Lavillant/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Backwarder", Rose and the other girls are called by Marinette to an emergency meeting. While the others are tired as it is early in the morning, Rose is full of energy. When Marinette informs the girls that Adrien is going to the royal wedding in England with Kagami and asks for suggestions on how to stop a potential romantic weekend, Rose suggests that Marinette dress up as a famous British star to sneak into Buckingham Palace and lure Adrien away from Kagami. Alix quickly points out that Adrien would likely get upset when he finds out who she really is and Marinette would be arrested. The next day at school, the girls all ask Marinette how everything went with Adrien. When Marinette reveals that she gave Adrien a letter, she cheers for her and is super excited when Adrien shows up and gives Marinette a gift. Upon learning that it's constipation capsules, while the other girls are confused, Rose calls it a beautiful display of pure love.

title: Rose Lavillant/History
text:
Rose Lavillant/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Gamer 2.0", Rose was asked by Max if she would try his new game but politely refused because she and Kitty Section were heading to Marinette's house. She and several others were captured by Gamer 2.0. After Ladybug and Cat Noir defeated Gamer, Rose and everyone were set free.
In "Silencer", Rose and the rest of the members of Kitty Section hear an announcement from Bob Roth claiming to be looking for new talent. Rose is just as happy as the others, viewing it as the perfect chance to promote the band. When they work on their video, Rose does the singing. After the video is completed and sent to Bob, Rose joins the band in a group hug. Later, after another band rehearsal, Rose is upset to learn that XY has stolen their ideas. She goes with the rest of the band to confront XY and Bob. When they are prevented from entering by two security guards, Rose helps distract the guards by pretending to be chased, alongside Juleka, by an akumatized Ivan, allowing Luka and Marinette to sneak in. After Ladybug and Cat Noir trick Bob into admitting his plagiarism on live TV, Rose and Kitty Section are able to perform on TV.

title: Rose Lavillant/History
text:

In "Oblivio" after Alya and Nino explain that they were akumatized because they were embarrassed at getting caught playing the game Super Penguino, Rose assures the two that it's okay as she and Juleka often play Super Penguino together.
In "Party Crasher", she was planting trees by the Seine with her friends until she got a message on her phone saying that the boys can't make it.
In "Ikari Gozen", Rose competed in the Friendship Day game with her friends and won the prize of hanging out with Adrien along with Alya, Juleka and Mylene.

title: Rose Lavillant/History
text:
Rose Lavillant/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Reflekdoll" due to Mrs. Mendeleiev being absent, Rose and her friends were let out an hour early. With some free time, they were asked by Alya if any of them were interested in being Marinette's model for her website, and Rose was shocked when Juleka offered. As the preparations began at Marinette's house, she saw that Juleka was having a nervous breakdown and was alright with Marinette taking over. After trying to comfort Juleka, she left to the photo shoot. She was soon horrified when Juleka was akumatized into Reflekta again as well as piloting a Reflektdoll sentimonster. Upon hearing hear akumatized friend looking for her, Rose came out of hiding attempting to apologize but was turned in a Reflekta copy.
Thanks to Mister Bug and Lady Noir, she and everyone else were returned to normal. She reunited with Juleka, and when Marinette returned, she saw Marinette gave Juleka back her role. After convincing Adrien's bodyguard to let Adrien stay a little longer, they finish the shoot.

title: Rose Lavillant/History
text:
Rose Lavillant/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Desperada", Rose was hanging with friends on the Couffaine houseboat until she and everyone were surprised that Kagami and Adrien came. Soon everyone went up to the deck to see what was going on, and she was surprised that Jagged Stone was there. Anarka and Jagged had a history together. She heard Anarka turn down Jagged's offer because he had a habit of firing his guitarist. Soon Jagged's guitarist, Vivica, arrived, akumatized as Desperada, and Rose, along with everyone else except Luka, Marinette and Adrien, ended up captured until she and everyone were set free by the heroes.
In "Ladybug", Rose was getting ready for the Mock Exams in Miss Bustier's class. She was surprised that Marinette was accused of stealing the answers. Like her other classmates, she knew that Marinette would never cheat or steal, being sad that it ended with her friend being expelled from school. It led to Rose almost being akumatized again.

title: Rose Lavillant/History
text:
Rose Lavillant/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Startrain", Rose was getting ready for her class field trip to see Big Ben in London and sat next to Juleka during the train ride. During the ride, they were directed to Marinette and Adrien who were sleeping peacefully by Mylene, which she found awesome. However, their class field trip took a surprise trip to space when Max's mom was akumatized into the titular villain. Then, following Marinette's lead in trying to takeover the train, Rose and everyone became excited that Ladybug and Cat Noir were on board, and to ensure their safety, they were led to the back of the train by Miss Bustier. After the heroes defeated Startrain, they were all lead back to earth.
In "Félix", she was with her friends at the Couffaine houseboat aware that this was the anniversary of Adrien's mother going missing, Rose agreed with Marinette's idea that everyone should send a video message making a video package.  However, after hearing Felix disguised as Adrien leave a nasty message. Rose and everyone were hurt and confused and doubted their friendship with him to the point of her, Alya and Juleka being akumatized into their villain alter egos again.

title: Rose Lavillant/History
text:
Rose Lavillant/History - [[Season 3]]
Despite some interference from Ladybug, Princess Fragrance and her friends left to find him. Upon entering Adrien's room, they were surprised to find two of him, realizing they had been tricked. Wanting the one that sent the nasty message, they almost attacked Adrien until Nathalie rushed to his defense. They made quick work of her and were directed to Felix by Hawk Moth. Fighting Ladybug and Cat Noir on the roof of the Le Grand Paris Hotel, the villainous trio had them in a three way crossfire and heard that Felix had his own demands. Through Hawk Moth they said they'd work something out. They were eventually deakumatized.
She was with Juleka and Luka until they, along with their friends, received a video from the real Adrien, who explained what happened and received a thanks from him.

title: Rose Lavillant/History
text:
Rose Lavillant/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Cat Blanc", while waiting for Marinette to return, Rose made a bet with Alix on the outcome of her friend's effort, putting her unicorn plushie on the line. She saw that Marinette returned because of her rejection. She gave her plush to Alix, having confidently told Marinette that they would stop hanging out with her with her until she delivered the gift and cheered her friend on as she left. In an alternate future, Rose and her friends cheered for Marinette as she delivered her gift but was more surprised when Adrien appeared. When the two admitted their feelings for each other, everyone cheered on with joy. However, due to certain "secrets" being unveiled leading to Cat Noir's akumatization, she and everyone on the planet were destroyed. Thanks to Ladybug changing the past, so did the future. After Marinette went back, Rose heard that she couldn't deliver the gift because Adrien wasn't home but hugged her for the effort.
In "Miracle Queen", after Hawk Moth's and Miracle Queen's defeat, Rose was at the Seine with her friends.

title: Ruyi Jingu Bang
text:
Ruyi Jingu Bang - Intro
The  is the tool of the Monkey Miraculous.
The current owner of the Ruyi Jingu Bang is Lê Chiến Kim, who uses it as the superhero King Monkey.

title: Ruyi Jingu Bang
text:
Ruyi Jingu Bang - Appearance
The Monkey Miraculous tool is a staff used by King Monkey. It is half his height and is dark brown with golden tips on either side. There are little sections in it. When not in use, he typically holds the staff in his hand or he keeps it on his back.
From Season 6 onwards, the staff is longer and has a smooth surface with a light brown handle in the middle and thick golden ornamentals on each side.

title: Ruyi Jingu Bang
text:
Ruyi Jingu Bang - Abilities
The staff can be be used offensively, as it can be thrown or used as a bat. It is strong enough to support King Monkey's entire weight, and it is required for King Monkey to use his superpower Uproar.
As seen in "Risk", the Ruyi Jingu Bang can be used as a method of transportation by extending the length.

title: Ruyi Jingu Bang
text:
Ruyi Jingu Bang - Trivia
It's the fourth Miraculous tool to be revealed to be able to be used as a method of transportation, following the Ladybug Miraculous' yo-yo, the Cat Miraculous' staff, and the Bee Miraculous' spinning top.
This Miraculous tool is the first of all to have a specific name, rather than a name given by its physical attributes.
The Ruyi Jingu Bang takes its name from the legendary staff wielded by Sun Wukong, who in the Quantic Universe is a former wielder of the Monkey Miraculous.
According to Chinese legend, the Ruyi Jingu Bang can follow the commands of its owner, shrinking, growing, or multiplying itself.
It is also extremely heavy, weighing 7,960 kg.

title: Rythm
text:
Rythm - Intro
is a minor character in season 4 of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She is a young girl who owns a black cat whom she tried to spend her savings on.
In "Kuro Neko", Shadow Moth manifested a sentimonster resembling a maneki-neko when Rythm became upset over losing her pet cat.

title: Rythm
text:
Rythm - Appearance
Physical appearance
Rythm is a short young girl. She has dark skin, as well as brown hair with red, green, and black beads and she has brown eyes, the former of which is hidden under a hoodie.
Civilian attire
Rythm wears a pair of black footed pajamas, with cat ears and feet resembling a cat's paws. She has a couple strands of her hair braided with beads, some with a red-and-black bead pattern and some with a green-and-black pattern.

title: Rythm
text:
Rythm - Personality
Rythm is a very kind and caring girl, but her exact personality is unknown. She was collecting money in a piggy bank to buy a toy for her cat, which shows that she loves the pet and cares about it. She was sad when her cat went missing, which made her a victim of Shadow Moth, however, her mood immediately improved when she saw her feline friend again.

title: Rythm
text:
Rythm - History
In "Kuro Neko", Rythm was buying toys for her cat, until the pet ran away, which left the girl sad and amokizated by Shadow Moth with amok hiding her piggy bank and her inside the creature. Later, her voice was heard when Kuro Neko broke as a result of a wayward Cataclysm, and the girl lost control of him. After luring Kuro Neko to the Stade des Princesses and with parachute full of grass Rythm was spat out. Being found by Ladybug, Rythm was asked the heroine to have her piggy bank, but she refused explaining everything but realized nothing could replace her pet to where she heard Ladybug sympathized about missing her own kitty.
Then was convinced by Ladybug to destroy her piggy bank to stop the cat's naughtiness and to which she did. After Sentimonster disappears, Cat Walker brings the girl her lost cat, after which they have fun playing at the stadium. Later, she and her pet were led home by Ladybug.

title: Rythm
text:
Rythm - Trivia
The character is based on a girl named Rythm, who was invited by ZAG in June 2019 as part of a collaboration with the Make-A-Wish Foundation to make her wish. She created a concept of herself with an akumatized version.
On October 14, 2021, Wilfried Pain confirmed she'll appear in the show but with a different look. She later appeared as Shadow Moth's victim in "Kuro Neko".
She's the third character to be unwillingly amokized without being akumatized, following Hawk Moth in "Mayura" and August in "Miraculer".
She is the first character to willingly destroy their own amokized object.

title: Sabine's cellphone
text:
Sabine's cellphone - Intro
is a smartphone owned by Sabine Cheng. Her phone number is +33690250.
In "Hack-San", Sabine gets hypnotized by Robostus after the phone received a message from him. The akumatized villain ordered her to "give [Robostus] what [Sabine] hold most valuable", which Sabine used her phone to trap Marinette.

title: Sabine's cellphone
text:
Sabine's cellphone - Appearance
In the first five seasons, Sabine's cellphone was black with white edges. It had three white-grey cameras on the top, one camera on the bottom, and another on the back of the phone. In "Miraculous Paris", the cover was a light blue with teal spots, with what looks like stylised flower branches drawn on it.
Starting from season 6, Sabine's cellphone has a white cover. On the top side of the screen, it has a small round camera, and on the back, in the top left, it has four round cameras arranged in a square.

title: Sabine's cellphone
text:
Sabine's cellphone - Trivia
As seen in "Oblivio", Sabine's phone number is +33690250.
The cellphone's design was changed from "Qilin" to "Miraculous Paris", adding a drawing depicting two blossoming cherry branches.
In "Miraculous Paris", due to her phone being destroyed by Monarch in "Destruction", Alya uses Sabine's cellphone to take a video of Shadybug and Claw Noir joining forces with Monarch in Marinette's room. She later returns it to her discretely without her noticing it was gone. The phone's design also changed, with the back of it featuring two cherry blossom branches.
Sabine saved on her mobile phone the phone numbers of: Marinette, Tom, Gina, Roland, Wang Cheng, Alya, Nadja, Lila, Roger, André, Denis and Caline.
Errors
In "Oni-Chan", after Sabine is teleported into Roger's police car, her cellphone cover is pink and not light blue.

title: Roue de Paris/Movie
text:
Roue de Paris/Movie - Intro
The Roue de Paris is a Ferris wheel installed in the Jardin des Tuileries, in the 1st arrondissement of Paris. It is the main attraction of the Luna Park des Tuileries.

title: Roue de Paris/Movie
text:
Roue de Paris/Movie - Description
The Roue de Paris is 70 meters high and its structure is white. It has many cabins to allow people to admire the surroundings, offering a panoramic view of Paris.
Installed inside the Luna Park des Tuileries, it is one of the most popular rides among visitors.

title: Roue de Paris/Movie
text:
Roue de Paris/Movie - Trivia
Since summer 2019, the Luna Park des Tuileries has been home to the Roue de Paris which was previously installed on the Place de la Concorde.
This change is due in particular to legal issues between the Paris City Hall and the owner of the Roue de Paris, who is also one of the organizers of the Tuileries Luna Park.
In "Ladybug & Cat Noir: The Movie", the Roue de Paris was attacked by the Magician and the Mime. Unhooked, it traveled through the streets of Paris, before ending its journey at the Cour Napoléon, near the Louvre Pyramid.
Chloé and Sabrina were inside a cabin during the attack.

title: Ryo
text:
Ryo - Intro
is a minor character in Miraculous World: Tokyo - Stellar Force and the animated spin-off series Miraculous Stellar Force. He is a student at Kano Academy, a superhero, and member of the Stellar Force. He is the current bearer of the Aquarius Fragment, which allows him to become Aquarius and one of the guardians who possess a fragment of the Stellar Matrix.

title: Ryo
text:
Ryo - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Ryo is a teenage boy of short-to-average height and slender build. He is dark-skinned with a somewhat feminine appearance, and he has dark brown eyes. He has shoulder-length chocolate-brown hair styled in a wide straight-cut, with a thick strand on top and a shaved scalp beneath. His  forelocks are spiky near the ends. On the bridge of his nose is a dark crimson crease of face paint.
Civilian Attire
Ryo wears a lime, loose, slightly unbuttoned dress shirt, a long dark green robe, loose dull olive pants, a black obi with long brilliant chartreuse and white strings tying into a knot at the near left with the ends hanging loose, and black sandals with thin white diagonal straps down to the toe, foot, and sides. Ryo accessorizes with a thin black collar necklace, orange binds on his forelocks, and a brilliant chartreuse feather earring on the left ear with a smaller white one next to it.
As Aquarius

title: Ryo
text:
