Aquarius wears a jumpsuit shared with his teammates: a black jumpsuit with rectangular-detailed white elbow trim, abdomen, thigh trim, and shins. On his chest is a black four-point star. His lower arms (except his fingers), torso, shoulders, inner thighs, sides of her knees, and feet are all green with black fingers and rectangular soles. His helmet is black with a green chin, silver components covering his ears, followed by green angular rectangles on top with black tips, and green feather pieces below the left ear, resembling his earring. On his left wrist is a green and black watch, the Aquarius Sprite.

title: Ryo
text:
Ryo - Etymology
Ryo is based on the Japanese name Ryō (りょう, リョウ), which is a unisex Japanese given name. It is sometimes romanized as Ryou, Ryoh, or Ryo. It is mostly written in the following kanji: 涼, meaning "cool, refreshing", 良, meaning "good, virtuous", or 龍/竜, meaning "dragon".

title: Ryo
text:
Ryo - Trivia
Ryo could have several traits associated with the Aquarius sign:
His theme color is green, which is a color the Aquarius sign can represent.
Ryo's name has one of the meanings "cool, refreshing".
Given that the Aquarius constellation is depicted as a water bearer, and water can be associated with this definition quite well, it's fitting for Ryo to represent this zodiac.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix - Intro
is a supporting character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She is a student at the Collège Françoise Dupont and a former student of Miss Bustier's class (before the latter became mayor of Paris) and Chloé Bourgeois' former "all-purpose girl".
In "Antibug", after a furious Chloé ignored her and pretended that she was invisible, Sabrina was akumatized by Hawk Moth and became Vanisher, an invisible supervillain.
In "Miraculer", after Chloé told her that they would never play their game of superheroes again, Sabrina was akumatized by Hawk Moth into Miraculer, a supervillain that stole powers from superheroes.
In "Penalteam", Sabrina received the Dog Miraculous from Ladybug. When the Miraculous is inhabited by Barkk, Sabrina becomes Miss Hound (Traquemoiselle in the French version), a dog-themed superhero with the power of Adoration who helps Ladybug and Cat Noir during "particularly difficult missions" in the fourth season and beyond.
After the events of "Strikeback", Sabrina was temporarily unable to become Miss Hound after Monarch managed to steal the Dog Miraculous along with all the others contained in the Chinese Miracle Box from Ladybug's Yo-yo.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix - Intro
In "Adoration", in order to keep her friendship with Chloé after refusing to help her and Lila with their plan to falsely incriminate Marinette of stealing, Sabrina was re-akumatized by Monarch into Vanisher and received the Dog Miraculous superpower through her Alliance ring. She also received a Magical Charm from Ladybug in order to prevent her from being re-akumatized.
In "Confrontation", after having enough and being forced by Chloé and Lila to forge the study options form of their class, Sabrina revolted against them and teamed up with Marinette to expose them and, as a result, she ended her "friendship" with Chloé for good.
In "Re-creation", after Ladybug recovered the stolen Miraculous and reforged them following Monarch's defeat, Sabrina was given back the Dog Miraculous permanently and reunited with Barkk.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix - Intro
In "Daddycop", due to feeling extremely sad and believing that she didn't deserve to have friends for what she did to everyone as Chloé's minion after being neglected by everyone (except for Zoé), and having her feelings accidentally hurt by Marinette, Sabrina was almost akumatized by Chrysalis, but she quickly rejected the Ultrakuma. After her father got akumatized into Daddycop, Sabrina tried to renounce her Miraculous as she felt unworthy of having friends, but Ladybug was able to convince her otherwise. With her new resolve and upgrade, she helped de-akumatize her father with Ladybug, Cat Noir and Pegasus.
Thanks to Zoé, Marinette decides to accept Sabrina's proposal to be part of the girls group, after the latter had apologized for not always being nice to them, since Chloé was the one who forced her to hurt others and promises to become a better person. As part of their friends' group, Sabrina changed her look entirely to show people her new and permanent self.
In "Revelator", it's shown that, after getting her Miraculous back, Sabrina, along with the other heroes of Ladybug's team, was trained to unlock her adult powers, no longer detransforming after using her power.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Sabrina is a short fair-skinned slender teenage girl. In the first five seasons, she had middle parted neck-length strawberry blonde hair that was styled in a bob. She has strong cyan eyes, and light pink lipstick.
From season 6 onwards, Sabrina has a new hairstyle: her hair is in chin-length with messy bangs. Her lipstick is no longer light pink and her hair is copper red.
Civilian Attire
In the first five seasons and "Daddycop", Sabrina wore a white headband and glasses with a grayish-brown tortoise rim. She wore a purple, deep purple, and teal argyle vest, and underneath that was a white long-sleeved dress shirt with a very deep purple ribbon tied to the collar. She had light blue shorts with a brown belt and a silver square buckle, black leggings with a dark teal argyle pattern, light arctic blue socks, and black hidden wedged white sneakers with black laces. On occasion until "Daddycop", she wore her Miraculous as a metallic orange necklace.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix - Appearance
From "Daddycop" onwards, Sabrina dons a new outfit that is slightly similar to her original one: her argyle vest now has a V-neckline, her undershirt sleeves are at 3/4 length, and her shorts and leggings are replaced with cyan jeans that flare out at the ends. Her sneakers' wedges turn wavy in lining with a point on top in the middle, with arctic blue bows on top of the black tongues. Her glasses are replaced with white-rimmed ones at the top, and she no longer wears her headband. Her chest ribbon also faces more downwards. She also now wears her Miraculous as an orange brooch with bronze lining.
As Miss Hound

title: Sabrina Raincomprix
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix - Appearance
In seasons 4-5, "Daddycop" and a flashback in "Revelator", Miss Hound wore an moderate orange outfit with a short tail with a black tip and a thin black stripe below it, a white heart on the front outlined in black, a black neck and shoulders with an orange stripe between the end, with the hands being white at the back and black on the palms, and the suit ending on large shorts. She had black pants that were white starting at the knees, with a black stripe at the top of the white area. She had her tool, a ball, hanging on her black turtleneck (in the same way as Cat Noir's bell). Over her eyes, she had a mask that was moderate orange on the bottom and white at the top with a black line outlining the top half and border. Over her head, she wore an moderate orange beret with a black brim and two moderate orange appendices that looked like dog ears. Her hair appeared the same, but a little more wider. Her Miraculous, a collar necklace, turns black with an open end. The tips of the edges are shaped like gray dog heads, with two rounded light brown bead-like objects next to each one, worn around her neck.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix - Appearance
From season 6 onwards, she kept her appearance from before, but after the events that transpire in "Daddycop", Miss Hound's costume undergoes some changes. Her suit with shorts now has a sleeveless top with black lining and bottom bordering over it designed like the part it is over, being moderate orange with a white heart on the front without the black outline around the white, with it being now at the end of the top and across the front. Her armpits, the bottom of her arms, and the inside of the palm turn white. Her shoulders lose the stripe. Her fingers are black on the back and her legs lost their black stripe at the top of the white, getting instead a pair of black buttons each on white straps on the sides of her thighs, accented by the ones on the top of her wrists. The top of her lower arms remain moderate orange up to the wrist. Her beret changes as well, getting a moderate orange peak brim and becoming white on the sides and the dog-ear-like appendices now being black. Her mask has more moderate orange around her eyes, white on the center and above and it has black eyebrow-like marks.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix - Appearance
On her beret, she has the symbol of the Dog Miraculous as a black button with the symbol being moderate orange and more intricate on the top right side. Her hair also alters, turning longer and curling to her shoulders with the middle parted bangs retained, only for a small thin lock to hang over her right eyebrow, and a faint orange gradation at the bottom. Her Miraculous also alters in design, styled as a metallic brown necklace and the tips of the edges become round.
As Vanisher
While being entirely invisible, Vanisher still wore her regular outfit and glasses, along with her brooch and a bag.
In "Adoration", she gained various shades of violet and purple hues which could only by seen by the people who she willingly wanted to reveal herself to, but she was still transparent.
As Miraculer

title: Sabrina Raincomprix
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix - Appearance
As Miraculer, she had very pale pink skin, light scarlet lipstick, and long and neatly combed vivid cerise hair that was pointed at the top. Miraculer had long eyelashes, and her eyes were bluish-black with vivid rose-colored sclera. She also wore a black mask with a vivid rose border, the bottom tips being swirled. Her lower arms were vivid rose, which contrasted to black, with a vivid rose outline and split tip. She wore a black sleeveless jumpsuit that covered her neck, torso, and halfway down above her ankle gloves, except her upper arms and lower legs with a vivid rose outline around her V-necked collar, armholes, and lower legs. On her chest was a magenta-pink hexagon with a black question mark on the center. The Miraculous logos appeared on her suit as polka dots when acquiring Miraculous powers. Along with them, she also wore a pair of black dress shoes with a downward pointing vivid rose outline around the top and matching-colored soles.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix - Personality
Sabrina was initially depicted as a meek, mousy, and very loyal girl to Chloé Bourgeois, who always tried to impress her and get on her good side by helping her, to the point of service. Despite being constantly bossed around and bullied by Chloé, she could be surprisingly unpleasant and conniving herself, as shown by her stealing Marinette's derby hat design for Chloé in "Mr. Pigeon" and eagerly helping Chloé get Alya Césaire suspended in "Lady Wifi". Sabrina feels very guilty if she makes a mistake and had a warped sense of how friendship works, believing that she must completely submit herself to helping a friend, such as by doing their homework and packing their things. This was seen in "The Evillustrator" when she temporarily committed to a stronger friendship with Marinette Dupain-Cheng and offered to complete the whole group project herself. However, Sabrina expressed joy at her liberation from Chloé's control, suggesting that she was actually unhappy in her situation. But seeing quickly she latched onto Marinette proved that she wasn't ready to stand on her own yet.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix - Personality
However, outside of Chloé's presence and assistance, Sabrina is nice and grateful for anyone's geniality, compassion, and generosity, getting along well with some schoolmates like Marinette and Adrien Agreste, or with people she's just met like Delmar. She has no problem giving praise when it's due seen in "Darkblade" after hearing Marinette's speech, and in "Mayura" when she cheered for Marinette as she admitted her feelings towards Adrien. She cares about the well-being of others and is willing to help those in need, joining others to search for Adrien when he disappears at Christmas in "Santa Claws" and accepting the Dog Miraculous to save Chloé from akumatization in "Penalteam".
Sabrina also seems to have a childish side to her as well, happily engaging in role-playing games about Ladybug and Cat Noir with Chloé and becoming distressed when the idea is rejected.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix - Personality
Despite being loyal to Chloé and her desire not to lose her friendship, Sabrina does have her limits when it came to what she was willing to do for her, something that stemmed from the fact that her father, Roger Raincomprix, is a police officer. In "Darkblade", she sneaks into Marinette's room for incriminating evidence to derail the latter's campaign for class rep, but decides not to reveal Marinette's crush on Adrien, and in "Deflagration", she also looks incredibly uncomfortable when Chloé tries to humiliate Marinette by trying to ridicule her dream of being Adrien's girlfriend. In "Adoration", like her father, Sabrina is a firm believer of the law and refuses to break it by any means. That fact is the major source of tension in the relationship of the two girls, leading to Chloé threatening Sabrina to stop being her friend or have her father fire hers, if the latter refuses to do what she tells her to do, forcing Sabrina to obey her.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix - Personality
However, that ultimately changed in "Confrontation", when Chloé and Lila Rossi forced Sabrina to forge the forms of their classmates' study options in order to ruin their futures and lie about Marinette (whose form would be the only one not to be forged) forcing her to do this in order to destroy her social life and turn everyone against her, Sabrina finally decided that enough is enough. When the moment came for Sabrina to tell the class Marinette forced her to forge the forms, she refused to do it and threatened Chloé and Lila to expose them. This ended up being a ruse Sabrina came up with alongside Marinette to trick Chloé and Lila into confessing what they had done to their classmates and teachers.
Meaning like Ladybug and Cat Noir, she is moral bound and had to make peace with the past if she wanted to move on. The reason she rejected the ultrakuma so quickly was because of her extreme loyalty and how she understood why everyone was wary of her and didn't want to use the ultrakuma's power to make everyone be friends with her. She also proves that she's nothing like Chloé.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix - Personality
After Chloé left Paris and with the start of the new school year, Sabrina struggled with making new friends due to being haunted by the long time consequences of being Chloé's helper and taking too long to find the courage to stand up to her. Despite being able to let go any vestige of Chloé's influence on her with Barkk's motivation, she still found herself getting isolated and left out, both because of the other student's uncertainty of her due to her being Chloé's accomplice in bullying everyone in school and her own insecurity about it that led her to think no one would ever want to be her friend. This caused great sadness after a misunderstanding caused Marinette to accidentally break Sabrina's heart. However, with Zoé Lee's support and an motivational speech from Ladybug, Sabrina formally apologized to everyone for all the bad things she did under Chloé's influence and genuinely gains their friendship in return. Marinette also apologizes to her for hurting her feelings and also tells her that she was very brave finding the courage to stand up to Chloé and separated herself from her.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix - Personality
Despite freeing herself from her influence and making new friends that actually care for her, Sabrina still on occasion finds herself feeling insecure about what Chloé thinks of her. This was shown in "Grendiaper", when Sabrina gets sad over Chloé's posts on Zoo making fun of her new looks. Fortunately, her friends' support and positive posts about her allowed her to regain her confidence and chase away the feelings of insecurity she was feeling.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix - Personality
As shown in "Queen of The Dreadzone", even after all of these events, Sabrina still held onto a spark of hope deep within herself that Chloé would still change and become a better person one day. This belief was exploited by Lila, who secretly forged an apology letter from Chloé and sent it to Sabrina, reigniting her faith in her former friend's reformation - possibly aiming for an akumatization after Sabrina's presumed meltdown after yet another humiliation by Chloé. However, after seeing Chloé's rambutious hysterics and realizing the letter had been forged, Sabrina finally saw how things truly were: Chloé simply hadn't changed and held no intentions of changing nor apologizing for her behavior. This realization was what truly set Sabrina free for good - she thanked a confused Chloé and, after the latter's akumatization into the eponymous villain, she threw the brooch Chloé had given her in the trash, and finally moved on from her former "best friend".

title: Sabrina Raincomprix
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix - Personality
As Miss Hound, she is more independent and assertive, capable of making her own decisions within the bounds of her moral compass. Like a dog, she is playful and daring, enjoying working with her teammates on missions. Similar to her civilian self, she is also very much helpful with anyone, using her powers to bring things that are out of reach, like a cat stuck in a tree, or move heavy objects to far away locations, as she teleported Marinette's broken electric scooter to a repair shop.
As Vanisher, she was malicious, confident, and vengeful. She messed with Chloé and humiliated her in any way possible. When she returned as Vanisher, instead of messing and trying to humiliate Chloé, Sabrina threw away her beliefs to help Chloé in a desperate bid to save their friendship to the point where she treasured it to great obsession and blind loyalty.
As Miraculer, she wanted to make Chloé continue wanting to play with her and had no qualms about stealing superpowers in order to make sure that happened, often through using her wits. However, she was also childish as she constantly mimicked and taunted Ladybug, as well as gullible when she easily fell for Rena Rouge's illusion.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix - Abilities
As a Civilian
Sabrina is a smart and hardworking girl as she is able to finish both her homework and Chloé Bourgeois's homework on time. She knows the rules of her school — noting that theft by a student results in one week of suspension.
Furthermore, Sabrina can be very sneaky, as she trapped Juleka Couffaine in a bathroom stall with a chair (preventing her from joining the school photo) without the adults' awareness in "Reflekta" and secretly taking a picture of Marinette's derby hat design in "Mr. Pigeon". Sabrina is able to approach people and spy on them from afar without being noticed.
In "Sole Crusher", Sabrina is very fast and has a lot of stamina, she was able to carry her bags, Chloé's bags, and keep up with the limo. In "Penalteam", she's good at soccer, and in "Re-creation", she plays with Marc Anciel.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix - Abilities
In "Revelation", it was revealed that she can perfectly forge other people's handwritings, as she has been forging Chloé's handwriting ever since they learn how to write. "Confrontation" reveals that Sabrina is an adequate actor, as she was able to successfully lead Chloé and Lila Rossi into the trap that she and Marinette had planned to reveal the two other girls' true natures.
As Miss Hound
Miss Hound has enhanced capabilities such as speed, agility, and strength, and she is almost invulnerable to physical damage. These abilities allow her to react to and evade akumatized villains attacks, as well as jump and leap several times her height and length. Her tool is a ball, which she can use to deflect akumatized villains attacks and as a communication device, with her being able to call upon any superhero of her team. She can also use it to activate her power, Fetch, that allows her to recover all and any object or anyone her ball has touched after activation.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix - Abilities
She is not usually involved in fights as she does not possess a tool that can be used as a weapon. Her role in the team is to use Fetch to capture important objects to help neutralize the situation, such as akumatized objects or weapons (especially if the object in question is unattainable by normal means), giving Miss Hound far more of a furtive, utilitarian nature as opposed to a more physically imposing heroine.
Initially, using her power would depower her and cause her to detransform after 5 minutes, however, in "Revelator", it is shown that Miss Hound has learned to control her adult powers, allowing her to not detransform back and use Fetch as much as she wishes.
As Vanisher
Vanisher was entirely invisible, not even casting a shadow and she was only partially visible if something covered her, such as glitter. Additionally, she was skilled in combat, holding up well against Ladybug and Cat Noir in a fight. She could also throw objects from her bag as projectiles, which are invisible as well.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix - Abilities
In "Adoration", she could make herself slightly visible before becoming completely invisible again and, due to the power of the Dog Miraculous, she could use her akumatized whistle to mark multiple objects and send them to her to be used as weapons.
As Miraculer
By touching a Miraculous holder with her tonfa, she could steal their special superpowers from them and use them as her own. She was able to use more than one power at once, such as infusing a Lucky Charm weapon with the destructive energy of the Cataclysm. She also had the ability to grant others the superpowers she has stolen without losing them herself.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix - Etymology
As with most of the characters in the show, Sabrina's last name is a wordplay in French. In this case, Sabrina Raincomprix sounds like (Sabri...) n'a rien compris, meaning "(Sabrina) didn't get it" (most likely referring to her situation).
Rien compris also means, "misunderstood", which is usually written in French as, mal compris.
In the Irish dub, her name is changed to Siobhán, which means "God is gracious".
The names of her superhero alter-ego has meaning to it:
Traquemoiselle comes from a combination of the words Moiselle meaning "Miss" and Traque coming from the word Traquer meaning "Stalking" or "Tracker" in French, so the name means "Miss Tracker" in English.
In the English version her superhero name is Miss Hound, named after the word "hound", a name used for tracking dogs. Thus, the etymology behind the name is kept.
In the European Portuguese dub, her superhero name is "Miss Dog".

title: Sabrina Raincomprix
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix - Trivia
Revealed by the Staff
In earlier concept designs for Sabrina, she had full bangs with the rest of her hair worn up in a bun, her dress shirt's sleeves were shorter, and her sweater vest and sock pattern were shades of green.
In "Robostus", Sabrina's hair has dark green highlights. According to Astruc, it's an error.
At Mangafest in Spain, Thomas Astruc said that Chloé and Sabrina's relationship would improve notably in the future.
When asked why Sabrina allows Chloé to treat her this badly, Thomas Astruc stated that "Everything in its own time", implying that it'll be explained in the future.
Originally, Sabrina and Chloé were supposed to be in a trio with Alix Kubdel, which was a reference to the main trio (Sam, Clover, and Alex) in Totally Spies!.
Miraculous Holder and Akumatized Villains
Sabrina is the first person not to have their first akumatization as an episode name.
This happens in "Antibug", where Sabrina is akumatized into Vanisher for half the episode. However, the episode does not get named after her akumatized form.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix - Trivia
Unlike other akumatized villains, Sabrina's first akumatization form, Vanisher, does not appear to get a different outfit upon being infected, only becoming invisible.
A scarlet version of Vanisher reappeared in the two-part special event "Heroes' Day".
In "Gamer 2.0", Vanisher returns as a playable akumatized villain as part of the Gamer 2.0's powers.
As of "Penalteam", following Alya Césaire, Nino Lahiffe, Chloé Bourgeois, Nathalie Sancoeur, Luka Couffaine, Max Kanté, Kagami Tsurugi, Alix Kubdel, Lê Chiến Kim, Adrien Agreste, Wang Fu, Zoé Lee, Mylène Haprèle, Rose Lavillant, and Juleka Couffaine, Sabrina Raincomprix is the sixteenth person to become a Miraculous holder and akumatized villain, excluding Gabriel Agreste, who akumatized himself, Marinette Dupain-Cheng, who almost got akumatized, and Félix Fathom, who resisted the akuma.
Sabrina is one of four members of The Miraculers to have a single parent shown on-screen which was followed by Alix with Alim Kubdel, later for and Max with Claudie Kanté.
Sabrina, alongside Zoé Lee, Juleka Couffaine, Nino Lahiffe, Kagami Tsurugi, and Lê Chiến Kim, are the only current members of the Miraculers to whom Ladybug gave a Magical Charm.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix - Trivia
In "Adoration", she became the third member of the Miraculers to receive the power of their primary wielded Miraculous through their Alliance ring, following Kagami Tsurugi in "Perfection" and Lê Chiến Kim in "Derision".
In "Daddycop", Sabrina is the first person and Miraculer to reject an Ultrakuma.
Miscellaneous
In past class photos, Sabrina's hair was the same, but her clothes were different; a dark green sweater with a light green diamond pattern with a light green headband, black leggings with green diamond patterns along with light green socks; green shoes, and the same dark grey ribbon on her sweater.
As seen in "Miraculer", she is ticklish.
Sometimes, Sabrina changes hair color between episodes, switching from orange to red. It's most likely an oversight.
Sabrina is currently the only character to have more than two voice actors/actresses in the English dub, having three: Marieve Herington voices her in Season 1 and "Despair Bear", Cassandra Lee Morris voices her in Season 2 (starting from "Zombizou"), Season 3, and "Miraculous New York", and Lauren Landa voices her from Season 4 onwards.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix - Trivia
Excluding honorary members, Sabrina, along with Nathaniel, Zoé, and Marc, are the only members of the Resistance whose code names are unknown.
In "Confrontation", Sabrina reveals that she wants to be a nurse, due to her love of helping others.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix/History
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix/History - Intro
Sabrina Raincomprix is a teenage girl and daughter of policeman Roger Raincomprix. She was friends with Chloé Bourgeois.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix/History
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix/History - Before Season 1
Sabrina Raincomprix, born in 2001 from the relationship between Roger Raincomprix, a police officer, and a woman, showed soccer skills from an early age, becoming a talented player. During her childhood, she was best friends with Cléo, but at the beginning of elementary school, she broke off that friendship to form a new one with Chloé. From then on, she assumed the role of Chloé's personal assistant, doing everything she could to please her, even forging her handwriting to complete her homework.
Sabrina later entered Collège Françoise Dupont with Chloé, collaborating with her in bullying Marinette from the beginning, to the point that she feared attending the school. In her third year, she shared classes with Chloé, Marinette, Kim, Nathaniel, Max, Rose, Juleka, and Jean. The class was led by Caline, and Sabrina acted as assistant to the class president, Chloé, but did all of her work.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix/History
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix/History - Before Season 1
Toward the end of the school year, Sabrina, following Chloé's orders, set two traps for Marinette. In the first, she placed cockroaches in her locker and a bucket of water behind the bathroom door, causing Marinette to fall as she escaped. In the second, she placed a tube of green paint on her seat in the science classroom, staining Marinette's favorite jeans. While trying to tease Marinette to Chloé after this latest prank, Sabrina made a comment that Chloé didn't find funny, causing her to shush her in contempt, much to Sabrina's dismay.
Later, during break, Sabrina eavesdropped on Marinette's conversation with Socqueline and warned Chloé that Marinette was in love with Kim and had invited him to the swimming pool. Chloé convinced Kim to play a cruel prank on Marinette in the pool, and Sabrina accompanied her to record the incident. The prank, involving spiders, caused Marinette to fall from the diving board into the pool.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix/History
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix/History - Before Season 1
When the lifeguard discovered what had happened, Sabrina and Chloé ran away laughing, satisfied with the success of their plan. However, as Chloé bragged about how she was going to ruin Marinette's life, Socqueline appeared, kicked Sabrina's cellphone that Chloé was holding and destroyed it, ending their moment of glory.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix/History
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix/History - Season 1
In "Ladybug & Cat Noir", Sabrina accompanied Chloé into Literature classroom. They walked over to Marinette Dupain-Cheng and kicked her out of her seat, choosing to sit there this year because Adrien Agreste would be sitting in front of them. She was sent to the library and wasn't seen for the rest of the day due to Stoneheart.
In "Stoneheart", she joined Chloé when she made fun of Ivan. She placed Chloé's gum on Marinette's seat per Chloé's request. She was present when Stoneheart burst through Literature classroom and took Mylène Haprèle and Chloé. She watched Hawk Moth's announcement from the library and cheered as Ladybug made her announcement. The next day she was forced back to her old seat in front of Alix and Mylène.
In "The Bubbler", Chloé ordered her to get a present for Adrien after Chloé forgot his birthday. She was taken to Agreste mansion by Bubbler along with other students but was bubbled after chanting for Ladybug. The gift Chloé ordered her to buy didn't arrive for Adrien's birthday.
In "Mr. Pigeon", Chloé had Sabrina steal Marinette's derby hat design at the Trocadéro to win a fashion design competition. She stood at the hat podium with Chloé.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix/History
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix/History - Season 1
In "Timebreaker", she watched the race between Kim and Alix with the rest of her class. She was hit by Timebreaker and disappeared alongside Chloé in both the alternate reality and the new one. She was revived by the Miraculous Ladybug.
In "Copycat", Sabrina was seen in the front desks of Mrs. Bustier's classroom.
In "Lady Wifi", during the end of Mrs. Bustier's class Sabrina like all the others find that Marinette is still and heads home from school. The next day she walks with Chloé to school and sees Alya sneaking into her best friends locker and followed Chloé and Alya to Principal Damocles office where she reminded him of the rules which resulted in Alya getting suspended for a week. She returns to the classroom and the lesson resumes until Lady Wifi attacks and she runs home.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix/History
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix/History - Season 1

Sabrina explained that she has always done "her best friend" homework ever since they were kids. When she sees Marinette standing up to Chloé she hugged her telling her she was amazing and becomes her new best friend. Sometime later, she went to Marinette's house and that she did her geography homework for her and she thanks her. However, Sabrina heard Marinette say she wouldn't be able to do the project she accused her as being the same as Chloé and walks away then she rekindled her friendship with Chloé.
In "Rogercop", during Career Day at school Sabrina came with her father and the day goes well until Chloé's bracelet went missing. Then, was accused by Marinette for stealing it but Sabrina said she only held it and gave it back right away. But when Rogercop came bursting in she was the only one that recognized him as her father and after Rogercop was defeated Sabrina embraced her father as he got his job back.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix/History
text:

He signed it, walking away annoyed. Then they, spot Marinette, making rude jokes about why she is searching the trash can. She was seen again with Chloé, only this time showing the poster around to girls, making them burst crying. Later, Ladybug shows up telling Sabrina and Chloé to run away because Dark Cupid was chasing them. Soon afterwards, Dark Cupid finds Sabrina and shoots one of his arrows at her, causing her to hold a grudge against her best friend. After Dark Cupid is defeated by the superheroes, Chloé finds Sabrina scribbling eyebrows, a mustache, and a beard on Adrien's poster, much to both of their surprise.

In "Derision",
In "Intuition",
In "Adoration", she witnesses Chloé furiously watching Marinette step on the stairs. Chloé then rushes into her room angrily and Sabrina follows her while they both spy and eavesdrop on Marinette.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix/History
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix/History - [[Season 5]]
In Chloé's bathroom, Chloé is upset, and complains that punching bags should be punched, not bags that punch back. Lila then reveals that has a plan to get rid of Marinette since she is the source of the problem, the one person who sets a bad example for Chloé's half-sister, and states that the plan will only work if it involves both Chloé and Sabrina. Sabrina, however, disapproves of their plan, fearing that her dad would be furious with her. Chloé warns her she will be demoted from underling to punching bag, and tells her to get lost. When Sabrina is about to leave, Chloé shows her a whistle and throws it at her to find another friend who is half good as her, leading to Sabrina running off crying.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix/History
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix/History - [[Season 5]]
Because of her sadness she is led to be akumatized by Monarch and becomes Vanisher again, gifted with the power of the Dog Miraculous. She went back to Chloé and promises to help her by framing Marinette if the two stay as friends. Vanisher goes into Zoé's room to spy on the two of them discussing the dress Marinette made. Vanisher follows them around Paris by using the whistle to touch the items with the power of Fetch in a plan to frame Marinette and lead everyone to believe that she'd stolen the items from them.
At the Eiffel Tower, she and Chloé's plans are in motion. She summons the items she touches with the whistle and places them in Marinette's bag.
As Chloé tells everybody that Marinette stole their possessions, Vanisher is spotted by Marinette.
In "Revelation", in class Caline saw the two papers with Sabrina's name because she did Chloé's homework and she hasn't slept for several nights since she'd been prepping the cheat-sheets for the end of the year exam. Caline tells her to give her a real grade and advises Sabrina to not do it again, saying that she mustn't exhaust herself in Chloé's services as she needs energy for herself.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix/History
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix/History - [[Season 5]]
At the cafeteria, she listens to Chloé and Lila as they come up with a plan to exterminate Marinette like a bug and make her lose everything. Lila tells Chloé to do everything she says and her wish will come true in the end, which causes Sabrina to be even more worried and uneased about their plan.
In "Confrontation", Chloé and Lila force Sabrina into doing something that goes against everything she stands for with believing in the law by having her forge the the student career forms for all their classmates in Caline Bustier's class.
When Sabrina tries to refuse, they force her into doing it.
However, knowing this is going over the line, and the straw that broke the camel's back, Sabrina secretly calls Marinette to warn her of the plot.
Thus, when Marinette is confronted over her being the one to have Sabrina forge the forms, Sabrina rounds on Chloé and Lila and tells the truth, threatening to have her father arrest them before running off in tears.
This was part of the trap she had concocted with Marinette to finally expose Lila for the liar that she was.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix/History
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix/History - [[Season 5]]
When Lila and Chloé corner Sabrina in the temporary restroom, Lila loses her normal, calm, tranquil fury attitude, and flat out tells Sabrina that no matter what she tells the class, she'll simply concoct another lie for them to believe, and even find some way to have Lt.
Raincomprix arrest his own daughter just to continue her plans.
It is at that point, smirking with triumph, Sabrina reveals the temporary restroom to be a trap, and Lila just exposed true self to the whole class, including Ms.
Bustier and Principal Damocles.
Now finally knowing the truth about Lila, and Marinette had been right about her all along, Ms.
Bustier and the class apologize to Marinette for having been deceived for so long by Lila, and an enraged Damocles expels Lila and Chloé on the spot.
However, Chloé calls her dad, and Sabrina is among those trying to encourage Damocles to not give up when Mayor Bourgeois threatens to fire him if he doesn't let the forged forms be processed and overrules Chloé and Lila's expulsion.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix/History
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix/History - [[Season 5]]
Their encouragement allows Damocles' Magical Charm to activate and purify a Megakuma that Monarch tried to infect him with, and thanks to their support, Damocles resigns rather than be fired, letting the kids resubmit their career forms in his last act before quitting.
Sabrina and the other kids wish him well as he leaves the school, finally free of being forced to defy his morals because of Chloé's social status.
In "Collusion", she angrily stares at her ex "best friend" and walks away as she decides to sit with Nathaniel, who exchanges a smile with her as he openly accepts her as his new seatmate.
In "Revolution", Sabrina learns of her father's termination of employment when Chloé, as Interim Mayoress, replaces the Paris Police Department with robots developed by Tsurugi Industries, putting Roger and many of his lawmen out of work. However, later, with Ladybug and Cat Noir's encouragement, Sabrina and the rest of the Resistance lead the citizens of Paris to rise up in revolt against Chloé, leading to her defeat.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix/History
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)", fast forward one month later, and it seems that, whatever happened with the wish, Sabrina and everyone else are alright as they enjoy a pool party at the Agreste Mansion before watching an interview of the new Mayoress, Caline Bustier, announcing her plans to make Paris more eco-friendly. Sabrina is later reunited with Barkk and the Dog Miraculous, becoming Miss Hound permanently.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix/History
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix/History - [[Season 6]]
In "The Illustrahater",
In "Daddycop", Sabrina was sadly watching a video of her former "friend" Chloe ranting about how much her life is better in London and looking for a new "lackey", cruelly mocking her but with Barkk's support, Sabrina threw away everything that involved her relationship with Chloe preparing to start over.
However, she found it tougher than she though.
She felt so miserable after breaking up her ship" with Chloé due to Chloé being her only friend.
Sabrina feared that Marinette and the other girls won't accept her because of her actions when serving as Chloé's lackey.
Encouraged by Zoe during lunchtime, Sabrina attempts to attend Marinette's monthly girls movie night when Zoe asks Marinette, and Marinette appears to agree to it, causing Sabrina to hug Marinette later under the surmise she agreed to invite her.
However, when Sabrina arrives at Marinette's later, Marinette sadly admits that she was waiting for Adrien, not Sabrina, breaking Sabrina's heart.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix/History
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix/History - [[Season 6]]
As Sabrina calls her father to come get her, believing she doesn't belong anywhere in Paris now as she has no friends for support anymore, Chrysalis attempts to akumatize her, but Sabrina, quickly and forcefully, rejects the Ultrakuma, forcing Chrysalis to change targets to her father, Akumatizing Lt.
Raincomprix into Daddycop.
When he appears to confront Alya, Zoe, Juleka, Mylene, Rose, and Kagami for rejecting Sabrina, realizing what's happened, Sabrina pleads to her father, but he won't listen, blasting and entrancing the girls into chasing after Sabrina to love her, and soon doing it to more Parisians until a whole mob is after Sabrina.
Luckily, she's rescued by Ladybug, but as Cat Noir then distracts Daddycop as Astrocat, Ladybug asks for Sabrina's help as Miss Hound, but Sabrina intends to return the Dog Miraculous to her, feeling unworthy of it and being part of The Miraculers due to her own guilt for her actions against Marinette and the others while Chloé's lackey.
Ladybug encourages her to look inside herself at the Sabrina she wants to become and not be held back by her past self and the sins she committed then.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix/History
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix/History - [[Season 6]]
Thanks to Ladybug's advice, Sabrina not only wills the Dog Miraculous into a new form in its disguised state, but even creates a new costume for herself as Miss Hound.
Working with Ladybug, Cat Noir, and Pegasus, Miss Hound is able to help de-Akumatize Daddycop back into Lt.
Raincomprix.
Later, at Marinette's, Sabrina formally apologizes to the other girls for her past mistakes, and thanks to her heartfelt apology, they forgive and accept her into their group with a group hug.
As a result, freed of her burdens and able to make a fresh start, Sabrina appears at school sporting a new look that many of her classmates react positively to.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix/History
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix/History - [[Season 6]]
In "Sleeping Syren", Sabrina is summoned by Ladybug with the rest of The Miraculers to aid her and Cat Noir against the forces of an akumatized Ondine. When Miss Hound and the others show up, Miss Hound points out that Minotaurox is not with them, worried he might have fallen victim to the Sleeping Syren's water knights and was turned into a toad by them, but Ladybug assures her if it did happen, de-akumatizing Ondine and using Miraculous Ladybug will save him. Under Ladybug's instructions, Miss Hound joined Rena Rouge, Purple Tigress, Rooster Bold, Polymouse, Pegasus, and Vesperia with saving civilians and taking them to the Eiffel Tower, where Carapace erects a Shell-ter to protect them, while Caprikid and Pigella provide towels for them. After Ladybug, Cat Noir, and King Monkey are able to de-akumatize Ondine, they and Ryuko rejoin Miss Hound and the others to share a "Pound it!" fist-bump for a job well-done on their teamwork.
In "El Toro De Piedra", Sabrina joins several of her classmates from Caline Bustier's former class to thank their former teacher, now the current Mayor of Paris, for everything she did for them as their teacher.
In "The Dark Castle",

title: Sabrina Raincomprix/History
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix/History - [[Season 6]]
In "Revelator", Sabrina is seen in her original Miss Hound outfit in a flashback as she joins most of the team in attempting to unlock their adult Miraculous powers and bypassing the five-minute failsafe that would automatically have them power down after using their Miraculous' special ability for the first time. Despite some difficulty, Miss Hound successfully unlocks her adult Miraculous powers through sheer heroic willpower alongside the others, and Ladybug declares the team's new name to be "The Miraculers", which Miss Hound and everyone else agree with wholeheartedly.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix/History
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix/History - [[Season 6]]
In "Grendiaper", Sabrina sees a video from Chloe denouncing her new look, calling it "Ridiculous. Utterly ridiculous." Marinette and the others rush to Sabrina's aid with posting their own videos supporting Sabrina's new look to tell Chloe off. Later, Sabrina has her textbook taken by Ray and his flunkies in Loic and Nelson, so Zoe offers to share hers with Sabrina. Later, as the two of them head home on the tram, they watch a young boy named Sam torment a mother and her newborn baby by blasting music, causing the baby to cry, and taking a selfie of his cruel act, much to their anger, before escorting the mother to another seat away from Sam so she won't be bothered by him. Sabrina later gets off the tram to head home.
That night, Sabrina becomes Miss Hound when chaos erupts as, unknown to her, Zoe, as Fury, takes justice into her own hands as a vigilante and punishes everyone who had been disrespectful and a bully.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix/History
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix/History - [[Season 6]]
Miss Hound contacts Ladybug through the Miraculous Call to warn her of the trouble, before rescuing Ray, Loic, and Nelson from the roller coaster at the amusement park with Fetch, after which they run off in fright, while the amusement park owner voices how he doesn't know how it happened as the park was closed at the time.
Then the Miraculers see Grendiaper storming through the city looking for Fury.
At one point, Miss Hound recognizes the cellphone on Grendiaper's chest.
After recovering it, and finding it is not the akumatized object when they destroy it and no Ultrakuma emerges, once Ladybug repairs it with Miraculous Ladybug, looking at the videos posted on Zoo, Miss Hound recognizes Sam from earlier on the tram, and see how he was akumatized in the first place when Fury humiliated him in retaliation for tormenting his baby sister.
Thanks to the Miraculers' teamwork after calling in Vesperia for additional support, Sam is de-akumatized, and given a harsh scolding by Cat Noir for his behavior so he promises to behave himself better.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix/History
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix/History - [[Season 6]]
However, there is still discussion about Fury and whether or not they are the new Butterfly Miraculous holder, or a new ally to said holder, before Miss Hound returns home with their mission complete.

text:
Sabrina (webisode)/Transcript - Intro
Marinette (narrating): Dear diary, it's a disaster! The art teacher has organized a drum workshop and used straws to determine the groups. Guess who I got paired up with..
Sabrina!
Remember the last time she and I had to work together? It was for a science presentation.
Olga Mendeleiev: and then Sabrina, Chloé and Marinette.
Marinette(narrating): And Satan, well is an understatement.
Marinette: In the library today and finally work on the project with you.
Sabrina: Too late, Chloé and I are doing the project together.
Marinette: You mean you're doing the project?
Sabrina: Well of course! After all she's been through!
Marinette(narrating): It's like Sabrina can only get along with Chloé.
Chloé: Well, well Marinette looking for something to eat?
Sabrina: Maybe she's looking for some better clothes.
(Chloé and Sabrina laugh)
Marinette(narrating): To Sabrina things are clear.
Sabrina: Yeah, we've been doing this ever since grade school when I started doing Chloé's homework, and we've been BFFs ever since.
Marinette(narrating): But clearly...
..the feelings are not mutual.
Chloé: Uh, why do I bother?
Chloé: Seriously, what are you good for?

title: Sabrina (webisode)/Transcript
text:
Sabrina (webisode)/Transcript - Intro
Marinette(narrating): Sabrina is a complete mystery.
She's the best student in class, behind Adrien obviously.
How can someone so smart possibly be friends with a brat like Chloé?
Chloé: Look, don't touch.
Marinette(narrating): Maybe it's because Chloé always promises her gifts?
Chloé: ..and perhaps I could lend it to you.
Sabrina: ..a really adorable hat. That would look fantastic on me.
Marinette(narrating): Yet, Sabrina can be very moral about other things.
Sabrina: Uh Chloé, Alya's looking in your locker.
Marinette(narrating): Maybe it's because of her dad, he a police officer you know. A true advocate of order and morals.
Roger: ..and I firmly believe that every citizen is innocent until proven guilty.
Marinette(narrating): I've tried to open Sabrina's eyes to the way Chloé treats her.
Marinette: Sabrina, Chloé's totally taking advantage of you. You don't have to do what she says, that's not how a real best friend acts.
Marinette(narrating): and to no effect.
Sabrina: I'm Chloé's BFF.
Marinette(narrating): And who knows, maybe Chloé's genuinely nice to Sabrina when no one's around.
Chloé: ...and put it on your sweater, it'll make it less horrible.
Sabrina: Oh, thank you Chloé.

title: Sabrina (webisode)/Transcript
text:
Sabrina (webisode)/Transcript - Intro
Marinette(narrating): But if you ask me, the only reasonable explanation
...is that they share a secret that keeps their friendship together.
Chloé: Not only am I Sabrina's best friend, I'm her only friend. So she better do what I say cause without me she has nothing.
Marinette(narrating): Sabrina even knows things about Chloé that the rest of the world doesn't know yet.
Chloé: Yeah well, you don't have to tell them my life story either.
Marinette: I'll tell you if I learn anything, my dear diary. I have to go, the drama workshop is about begin. Goodbye for now.

title: Sabine Cheng/History
text:
Sabine Cheng/History - Before Season 1
Sabine was born Xia Bing Cheng to Mei and Yan Cheng and is the sister of Shu Yin Cheng. She lived with her family in Shanghai, China, but was raised by her Wang Cheng. paternal uncle, her father's brother, for unknown reasons. Because of her sister, she had a bit of a rough childhood.
At some point in time Sabine moved from China to France, changed her name, and met Tom Dupain and soon one day she went Andre's ice cream stand with him where Tom asked for her hand in marriage, which she accepted. As of April 1995, they were married and in 2001, Sabine became a mother to a baby girl they named Marinette.

title: Sabine Cheng/History
text:
Sabine Cheng/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Ladybug & Cat Noir", she woke Marinette up telling her to get ready for school and when her daughter was downhearted about being in the same class as Chloe with her being surprised that was the fourth time in a row. Sabine encouraged Marinette to remain hopeful. After Marinette came home after school  upon hearing a ruckus in her daughter's room she when to check on her but didn't see her there. Sometime later, she and Tom heard from the news that new heroes are in Paris but became horrified when some innocent people became frozen Stonehearts.
In "Stoneheart", Sabine was watching Hawk Moth's announcement on television with Tom in worry but rejoiced when Ladybug stood up against him.

title: Sabine Cheng/History
text:
Sabine Cheng/History - [[Season 1]]
In "The Bubbler", while drinking tea she saw Marinette come downstairs and was about to leave but before that Sabine reminded her daughter to clean her room after school. But when Marinette tried to opt out of it, she retorted to doing it and possibly looked through her daughter's private stuff if she did. Nervously Marinette agreed and she wished her daughter a good day at school. Then, sometime later, she heard Marinette talking to herself but heard her say that she's happy to get back to school. However, she along with Tom and all the adults in Paris were bubbled by the Bubbler and sent skywards after Ladybug and Cat Noir defeated the bubble villain she and Tom were brought back down to earth.

title: Sabine Cheng/History
text:
Sabine Cheng/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Timebreaker", Sabine was getting for her 20th wedding anniversary with Tom at the Le Grand Paris Hotel. But soon their date was interrupted when Tom received a call from Nadja saying that Maarinette wasn't there. In an alternate reality, Sabine saw that Tom was called by Nadja but this time Marinette was at the bakery in time and was relieved. They returned home having enjoyed their anniversary despite having a close call. Sabine told Marinette for next time to wait in the bakery for customers instead of her room when her daughter agrees remembering that they have only one daughter and they're counting on her before they embrace.
In "Lady Wifi", when Marinette returned home Sabine told her that Alya dropped off her bag seeing her daughter exhausted. She suggested that she get some exercise for her growing brain. Later, she was watching Lady Wifi's broadcast with Tom but also with worry as the villain tried to unveil Ladybug's identity.
In "Rogercop", Sabine was helping Marinette and Tom get ready for Career Day at Marinette's school and wished them luck.

title: Sabine Cheng/History
text:
Sabine Cheng/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Darkblade", Sabine was working in the bakery until Sabrina comes in saying that she was looking for her textbook that Marinette borrowed. Since she was busy with customers, she directed her Marinette's room.
In "The Mime", Sabine invited Mylene and father to Marinette's room so Mr. Harpele could pick up a hat Marinette was repairing in time so Mr. Harpele could make it to his performance in time.
In "Animan", she and Tom were working in the bakery until an exhausted Kim came in asking for help. Sabine became awestruck when Ladybug (unable to recognize that it's her daughter) and Cat Noir arrived and heard from the news that animals were running wild all over Paris. Then, was instructed by the heroes to keep all the windows and doors locked as well as being thanked by the heroine for their help.

title: Sabine Cheng/History
text:
Sabine Cheng/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Simon Says", she along with Tom were talking to Marinette about her recent absences but when her daughter couldn't come up with an answer. Sadly, they had no choice until her absences came to an end they grounded her. When they saw that Marinette's absences had finally ended the couple allowed her to watch Nino's performance at the studio but heard that Marinette was going to a nap in her bedroom.
In "Guitar Villain", when Bob Ruth appeared at the bakery asking Marinette to design Jagged Stone's new album cover Sabine and Tom were ecstatic.
In "Gamer", she heard that Marinette won a spot in a gaming competition and then heard that Adrien was her partner for the event. Then, upon hearing
Adrien's arrival; Sabine was aware that her daughter was fond of him but while Marinette and Adrien were practicing, she and Tom constantly checked on the two offering them snacks.
In "The Puppeteer", she sees Manon leaving with her mother Nadja.

title: Sabine Cheng/History
text:
Sabine Cheng/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Santa Claws", Sabine was enjoying Christmas with her family until they received a called from Nathalie that Adrien was missing and left to search for him. Before leaving Sabine asked if Marinette was coming accepting her daughter's choice to stay behind and listen in for further calls. After awhile she heard that Adrien was found and joined him at the Agreste Mansion for dinner.
In "Befana", she was getting for Marinette's birthday by helping Tom bake her cake, however her daughter's sudden arrival caused it to be ruined (Tom accidentally dumped it in the trash) causing them to make another one. Then, the family got a surprise visit from Gina Dupain; Tom's mother upon seeing that she believes that Marinette was still a little girl and sees the two leave to do the things we normally would. However, upon hearing them return Sabine told Tom to find the cake, but was saddened to see that Gina believed that Tom was right about Marinette and suggested that he to talk to her. Seeing that Tom dumped the cake again she'd help him bake another after they were done they'd bring his mother with them to the party.

title: Sabine Cheng/History
text:
Sabine Cheng/History - [[Season 2]]
Once the third cake was done, she and Tom was horrified when Gina was akumatized then turned him into a coal statue but Sabine was turned into Befana's minion and fought against the heroes. After Befana was defeated she was returned to normal and enjoyed her daughter's birthday party.
In "Glaciator", Sabine was enjoying dinner with her family and was getting ready for dessert but when Marinette mentioned going to Andre's ice cream stand with her friends. Sabine remembered that's when Tom proposed her and asked Marinette who the lucky guy was but laughed in amusement when their daughter left.

title: Sabine Cheng/History
text:
Sabine Cheng/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Troublemaker", Sabine and her family agreed to have Jagged Stone host his new tv show at their bakery and asked Penny what it was like to work for a rock star. During the show's intermission she and Tom had found that their daughter's room was shown on live tv, just before the show continued Sabine gave her husband a stern look agreeing with him that they should stop because they had their privacy invaded. But soon things went from bad to worse when strange things were happening in the bakery, first Sabine felt someone touch her in a mortifying way that she fiercely demanded an apology, then more strange things began to happen. To their surprise it was the akumatized villain Troublemarker that did it but upon seeing Ladybug release her restoration powers they all rejoiced and was relieved that Marinette was okay. The next, Sabine wished her daughter to have a good day at school.

title: Sabine Cheng/History
text:
Sabine Cheng/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Style Queen", Sabine and her family attend Fashion Week Show to show support for Marinette who had her own hat design being shown off by Adrien during the show. But the event was interrupted by Style Queen soon she and Tom managed to escape to safety but went looking for Marinette. Upon finding her after Style Queen's defeat she and Tom were happy to be reunited with her and took her back to the show.

title: Sabine Cheng/History
text:
Sabine Cheng/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Queen Wasp", Sabine and Tom continued watching the Fashion Show however, she along with everyone else became shocked that Gabriel Agreste appeared. Then, after the show they both saw that Audrey became so impressed Marinette's design so much so that her daughter had the opportunity to go to New York. Surprised she told Marinette that they'd support her no matter what she chose however, at seeing Chloe disregarded by her mother, Sabine along with everyone else were shocked that Chloe transformed into Queen Bee in an attempt to be a hero. Afterwards, the Dupain-Cheng family took a subway train home and was still surprised that Marinette got the opportunity to go to New York. And Tom liked the ideas of having so many business opportunities in New York but she reminded her husband that he hated flying.

title: Sabine Cheng/History
text:
Sabine Cheng/History - [[Season 2]]
However, soon they were all put on a "speeding train" in Chloe's attempt to "be a hero", then she and Tom moved to the front of the train in attempt to stop it. Then, soon Sabine was met by Ladybug but saw she had no luck at stopping the train by the controls either. However, thanks to the heroes they were able to safely stop the train with the vehicle under control Sabine and Tom went home. After Marinette turned down Audrey's offer they all played a round of video games in their living room.
In "Malediktator", Sabine was working with Tom in the bakery until Malediktator came in demanding to know where Marinette was. Soon the couple was struck with the villain's demands to leave Paris forever, and after they were packed they raced to the airport until Ladybug's Miraculous superpower returned her to normal as well as confused to why they had their suitcases.

title: Sabine Cheng/History
text:
Sabine Cheng/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Catalyst", Sabine was getting ready for Heroes Day's with her husband Tom by making a big desert of the heroes for the event, she was approached by Marinette who admitted that she made a horrible mistake about her deed. And yet, along with her husband agreed that their daughter should be more honest with her mistake. Soon, through the news they watched Hawk Moth commenced his biggest plan yet and felt great joy to know that Ladybug and Cat Noir were still out their fighting for them.
In "Mayura", they continued to watch the news, understanding that the heroes needed help Sabine and Tom joined the rebellion to stop Hawk Moth.

title: Sabine Cheng/History
text:
Sabine Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Animaestro", Sabine, Tom and Marinette were helping to cater the event of Ladybug and Cat Noir movie and when the titular villain attacked the event they both hid.
In "Bakerix", Sabine was on the phone with Roland trying to convince him to come to Tom's birthday but was saddened when he refused. Then, was asked by Marinette of why her grandfather hasn't left the house in twenty years she quickly replies that it's complicated suggesting that she ask her father. Afterwards, Sabine along with Gina and Tom were surprised that Marinette brought Roland and the whole family enjoyed Tom's birthday.
In "Gamer 2.0", Sabine understood the responsibilities Marinette had to do and got locked into a gaming match with Tom agreeing to a bet that the loser does the laundry. Afterwards they were in the bakery until Marinette came in and apologized that she didn't have enough time to play games as much as she use to but was informed that Max did. Needing to test a new game he invented with a ton of bugs to find really excited Sabine and Tom rushed to the living room and eagerly played Max's new game.
In "Weredad",

title: Sabine Cheng/History
text:
Sabine Cheng/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Oni-Chan" Sabine noticed a Lila panicked coming into the bakery asking for help but was surprised by the horn on her head. But she received Oni-Chan's strange message and was transported to her location inside Officer Roger's police car and she was instructed by Ladybug to stay put.

title: Sacred Cave
text:
Sacred Cave - Intro
The  is a secret cave in Shanghai, China that is now currently being protected by Fei Wu. It was originally protected by Wu Shifu.
Inside of the cave is a vault, which previously contained a powerful and dangerous magical jewel, the Prodigious. The vault could only be opened using the special bracelet key and only once every fifteen years during the magical eclipse.
In "Miraculous Shanghai", after Mei Shi is akumatized into YanLuoShi, he destroyed the cave, but it was repaired by Ladybug's Miraculous Ladybug superpower.

title: Sacred Cave
text:
Sacred Cave - Appearance
The Sacred Cave is a black cave with a secret hidden brick-wall shaped as a circle that when opened has a mould to store the Prodigious and when done so, it opens a secret safe which has Mei Shi guarding inside. The door in the back of the cave leads to the backyard where Wu Shifu and Fei train together. Above this door is a glowing Light source which has the shape as a mirror or circular object. The cave also has statues in it, examples of such is a Dragon, Bear, Mantis, Horse, Tiger, Eagle, Snake and Monkey. The cave also possesses numerous glowing crystals, so far all the seen crystal colors are:
Green
Light Blue
Pink
Purple

title: Sacred Cave
text:
Sacred Cave - Trivia
According to the Timeline, Miraculous Shanghai is set either in late 2015, or early 2016. Since the magical eclipse that allows for the the vault in the Sacred Cave to be accessible only happens once every 15 years, the last time was either in late 2000, or early 2001.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix/Movie
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix/Movie - Intro
Sabrina Raincomprix is a supporting character of "Ladybug & Cat Noir: The Movie". She is a student at Collège Françoise Dupont and Chloe Bourgeois' "all-purpose girl".

title: Sabrina Raincomprix/Movie
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix/Movie - Appearance
Physical appearance
Sabrina is fair-skinned, slender girl with shoulder-length ginger hair and green eyes.
Civilian attire
She wears a purple and green-blue argyle vest with a white long-sleeved dress shirt underneath. She has light blue shorts with a brown belt, black leggings with a dark blue argyle pattern, light blue socks, and white shoes with black toe caps and laces. Sabrina also dons glasses with a grey-brown pattern and a  creamy white headband.

title: Sabrina Raincomprix/Movie
text:
Sabrina Raincomprix/Movie - Relationships
Chloé Bourgeois
Much like in the original series, Sabrina serves as Chloé's "all-purpose girl," and though she is a valuable asset to Chloé, Chloé often bosses her around and treats her as inferior rather than as a true friend. When Sabrina makes a mistake or behaves in a way that Chloé considers incompetent, Chloé reprimands her harshly.
However, unlike the original series, the relationship between Chloé and Sabrina appears to be more of a realistically toxic friendship rather than a master-servant dynamic. Chloé frequently employs emotional blackmail to manipulate Sabrina into doing what she wants, rather than simply giving her orders. Chloé makes Sabrina feel selfish and like a bad friend for not wanting to comply with her demands or for not always following her lead. Despite this, Chloé does show that she cares for Sabrina, as evidenced by her helping up on her feet after Hawk Moth's attack.

Additionally, if Sabrina hadn't rejected Chrysalis's akumatization, the whistle would have become the first item to be akumatized by both Gabriel and Lila.
