title: Santa Claws
text:
Santa Claws - Intro
"" is a Christmas themed season 2 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. According to the series' production/written order, it is the 26th and final episode of season 2, as well as the 52nd episode of the series, overall.

title: Santa Claws
text:
Santa Claws - Synopsis
Because of Ladybug, a Santa Claus gets akumatized by Hawk Moth. Now Santa Claws, he is determined to make this Christmas Eve the worst in Paris' history. Will Ladybug and Cat Noir manage to save Christmas?
Netflix
Parisian teen Marinette transforms into superhero Ladybug to find her secret crush Adrien when he runs away from home at Christmas.
Disney+
Ladybug and Cat Noir face Santa Claws, an akumatized Santa.

title: Santa Claws
text:
Santa Claws - Plot
The episode begins on a snowy night with Marinette, Alya, and Manon walking into the bakery. Alya drops a coin in a collection box held by cardboard cutouts of Ladybug and Cat Noir. When she does, Marinette takes off her coat and begins singing.
She grabs a Christmas log cake from her mother, almost dropping it when giving it to Alya. Alya taps her on the forehead and wishes her a Merry Christmas. Tom and Sabine wave as she leaves. Alix and her father come in next, followed by Rose and Juleka, Nadja (who takes Manon), Nino, and Sabrina, each of them leaving with a Christmas log. When Chloé and her father enter the bakery, Marinette freezes in the middle of her song. Sabine reminds her that it's Christmas, and Marinette begrudgingly gives Chloé the Christmas log. She has to shout "Merry Christmas, Chloé!" at her before Chloé takes it. André also reminds Chloé to wish Marinette a Merry Christmas, which she shouts back to Marinette before leaning in and reminding her that she hates her guts.

title: Santa Claws
text:
Santa Claws - Plot
After Chloé and André leave, Placide I.T. enters and drops a coin in the collection box. Marinette runs upstairs when she realizes who he is, asking him to wait a minute. She tears her room apart, searching for Adrien's gift. Tikki finds it on her desk and gives it to Marinette before she can make even more of a mess. She runs back downstairs and outside, following the bodyguard. Fumbling over her words, she asks him to take the present to Adrien and to wish him a Merry Christmas for her. He takes it and drives off. Marinette looks off into the sky, thinking of Adrien.
At the Agreste mansion, Adrien and Nathalie are decorating the Christmas tree in the foyer when the bodyguard walks in. Adrien wants his father, Gabriel, to decorate the tree with them, but he doesn't come, upsetting Adrien. The bodyguard hands Adrien Marinette's present as he sadly walks up to his room.

title: Santa Claws
text:
Santa Claws - Plot
Gabriel is in his atelier, staring at Émilie Agreste's portrait. Nathalie enters the room and asks him to spend time with his son, reminding him that not only is it his first Christmas without Émilie, but it's also Adrien's too. Gabriel agrees to spend Christmas with Adrien and tells Nathalie that he needs a little more time. She leaves him looking at the portrait. He closes his eyes with a sigh, feeling remorseful for treating his son.

title: Santa Claws
text:
Santa Claws - Plot
Adrien is in his room and is angry at his father. He decides that he hates Christmas. Dropping the present, and in frustrated rage, he transforms into Cat Noir and leaves the room through a window. Using his staff to soften his landings, Cat Noir jumps over Paris' snowy rooftops, singing about being a pitiful cat in the night. He watches the Dupain-Chengs eat dinner through one of their windows before moving on to the Bourgeois family. He ends up outside the Hôtel de Ville and runs at the Christmas tree outside the building. He summons his Cataclysm, prepared to destroy the largest symbol of Christmas in the city out of anger and hatred, but before he does, an image of his mother flashes before his eyes and he stops. He realizes that he can't kill something he loved. Instead, he runs to a nearby Gabriel advertisement (displaying himself) and destroys it. He walks away and detransforms in the snow.

title: Santa Claws
text:
Santa Claws - Plot
Plagg flops on his back in the snow, singing about how tired and hungry he is. Adrien frets because he doesn't have any cheese on him. Instead, Adrien opens Marinette's present, which he had with him, hoping it can help. Inside is a Christmas hat. Adrien puts Plagg on the hat and opens the card Marinette left him. He smiles, appreciating her gift. He puts the card in his back pocket. Bells ring in the distance, signaling Christmas Day. Adrien wishes Plagg a "Merry Christmas", not realizing the card fell out. Plagg wishes him a "Merry Christmas" back.
At the Agreste mansion, Gabriel holds a present in his hands and walks up to Adrien's room. He calls out for Adrien first but begins panicking when he sees Adrien's window is open and Adrien is missing. Nathalie and the bodyguard rush in. Gabriel shouts furiously at them to find Adrien immediately.

title: Santa Claws
text:
Santa Claws - Plot
The bodyguard begins the search and leaves in his car. Nathalie makes phone calls to the police and Adrien's classmates. Nino, while eating a potato, says that Adrien isn't at his house. Alya answers the call while at her apartment and is surprised to hear that Adrien isn't home. Kim has no clue where Adrien is and thinks he may have been kidnapped. Max doesn't know where Adrien is, either. Roger and Sabrina search for Adrien in Roger's patrol car. Sabine and Tom set aside their presents and go out to look for Adrien, while Marinette says she doesn't feel good and goes upstairs to transform into Ladybug. She leaves from her balcony.

title: Santa Claws
text:
Santa Claws - Plot
Adrien, meanwhile, is wandering around Paris, alone and cold. He comes across a Santa Claus and two naughty children who are being rude to Santa. The kids knock Santa over with snowballs. Adrien helps him up and scolds the kids for being mean. Their father tells them to apologize. Adrien hands Santa back his hat, receiving a blanket and hot chocolate in return. Adrien asks Santa if he has any Camembert, which Santa gives him from his sandwich. Adrien discreetly feeds it to Plagg, who is hiding in the fuzz at the end of Adrien's hat. Santa and Adrien drink the hot chocolate in Santa's sleigh, Adrien telling Santa about his family problems. Santa convinces Adrien to return home to his father and even gives him a free ride back. Before they leave, Adrien gives Santa the hat he received from Marinette as Santa's hat was soggy from the snow.

title: Santa Claws
text:
Santa Claws - Plot
Ladybug arrives in the Hôtel de Ville square and sees the damage from Cat Noir's Cataclysm and her letter to Adrien. She assumes that Cat Noir must be trying to protect Adrien from an akumatized supervillain. She sings about Adrien being the boy that she secretly loves. She follows Adrien's footprints, wondering who could've been akumatized on Christmas Eve.

title: Santa Claws
text:
Santa Claws - Plot
Santa is driving the sleigh and waving to the people who pass by. No one sees Adrien because he leaned away from them unknowingly and the pink blanket disguised him slightly. Adrien and Santa talk about where Santa will spend his Christmas as they go back to Adrien's house. Since he will be alone and since there needs to be more Christmas cheer in the Agreste mansion, Adrien decides to invite Santa over for dinner. Outside the gates of the Agreste mansion, Adrien rings the doorbell, his father answering. Gabriel notices the Santa and angrily tells him to leave, assuming he had something to do with Adrien's disappearance and now wants money. Adrien tries to calm down his father, trying to convince him that he's wrong, but Ladybug arrives on the scene and calls Santa an akumatized villain. Adrien tries to tell Ladybug that Santa isn't a supervillain, but she refuses to listen, and chases after him, who runs away in his sleigh. Before leaving, Ladybug tells Adrien to go home, because he is safe now. Adrien moves to transform again, but Nathalie and the bodyguard call out to him and bring him inside, dismaying and infuriating Adrien.

title: Santa Claws
text:
Santa Claws - Plot
Ladybug catches Santa, pulling him out of the sleigh and into the snow. Santa then yells at Ladybug about her hurting him. Hawk Moth, in his lair, senses Santa's anger and sends out an akuma to corrupt him
Back in the mansion, Adrien is leaving to his room, before he expresses his hatred and disdain towards his father to Nathalie and the bodyguard. Nathalie assures Adrien that his father came to see him early, but he panicked after Adrien's disappearance. The bodyguard sends Adrien back to his room, with Nathalie asking Adrien to stay at home this time.
Meanwhile, Santa angrily explains that he is not a supervillain and accuses Ladybug of reading too many comic books. Ladybug apologizes and tries to help him up, but Santa just wants her to leave, as he's had enough of kids tonight. Ladybug leaves, feeling sad, while Santa trudges back to his sleigh, muttering about people no longer respecting the spirit of Christmas. The akuma then lands in his hat. Hawk Moth claims to have been good all year and that as a present, Santa should get him the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses, to which Santa agrees, turning him into Santa Claws.

title: Santa Claws
text:
Santa Claws - Plot
Santa Claws approaches Ladybug, singing a song about how he is Santa Claws and how he will give everyone a horrible Christmas. He throws a present at Ladybug and it explodes, releasing several bats. Ladybug chases after him.
Adrien is in his room, upset and playing video games, with his bodyguard, Placide I.T., behind him. Santa Claws phases through Adrien's window, sings his song, and drops a present in Adrien's room. Placide protects Adrien before the present explodes on him. Tarantulas crawl out of the present and onto Placide, causing him to flee while he tries to get the spiders off his legs. Santa Claws promises not to hurt Adrien, since he feels like he owes him since he gave him a gift and because Adrien has been nice to him. He leaves, promising to avenge both Adrien and himself. When Placide runs away, Adrien transforms into Cat Noir.
Santa Claws bursts through the windows of the Le Grand Paris Hotel, sings his song and dances, and throws a present on Chloé, covering her in cockroaches, much to her disgust and dismay. The akumatized reindeer also eat some of her presents.

title: Santa Claws
text:
Santa Claws - Plot
Ladybug finds Santa Claws again after he leaves Le Grand Paris and chases him across Paris. When Cat Noir joins up with her, she questions him about Adrien and what happened earlier in the night. Cat Noir avoids the question and they both jump and land on Santa Claws' sleigh. Santa Claws throws a present at Cat Noir, knocking him off the sleigh. Ladybug jumps off after him, throwing her yo-yo around one of the sleigh's skis and grabbing Cat Noir with her hand. They dangle and run over Paris' rooftops before Ladybug flings Cat Noir back on the sleigh.
Cat Noir fights Santa Claws, baton to sword. Ladybug flings herself onto one of the reindeer, trying to stop it. This causes Santa Claws to fall over the back of the sleigh. Cat Noir grabs him by his wrist, but Santa Claws uses that to his advantage by climbing back on the sleigh and flinging Cat Noir off it again. Ladybug jumps off the sleigh after Cat Noir again, throwing the yo-yo around a lamppost. They swing wildly through the city and land in Alya's living room, Cat Noir on top of Ladybug. Alya asks for a scoop for the Ladyblog, but Ladybug says it's not what it looks like.

title: Santa Claws
text:
Santa Claws - Plot
Cat Noir moves to leave, but Ladybug grabs his tail and stops him. She then uses her Lucky Charm and summons a large box. Ladybug looks around the Césaire apartment for packing tape, scissors, and office supplies, pulling open drawers and cabinets to find them. Alya helps Ladybug find trash bags and packing tape. Marlena gives Ladybug scissors, sticky notes, and a pencil. Ella holds up crayons while Etta holds up a notepad. Ladybug writes on the sticky note and tells Cat Noir to go to the Dupain-Cheng bakery to get some items. She cuts down the Césaire's curtain and wraps the things they gave her up in it, leaving slightly after Cat Noir.

title: Santa Claws
text:
Santa Claws - Plot
Cat Noir signals Santa Claws from the Eiffel Tower. A black present dangles off of it from Cat Noir's baton. Santa Claws conjures up a large mace, preparing to destroy it, but the present turns, revealing his face. Cat Noir sings about surrendering to Santa Claws and that the present is their gift to him. Hawk Moth yells at Santa Claws to get away from the present since it's obviously a trap, but Santa Claws is so surprised to even be receiving a present that he ignores Hawk Moth. As Cat Noir finishes his song, Ladybug is nowhere to be seen: the Ladybug in the background is the cutout from the Dupain-Cheng bakery, but Santa Claws doesn't notice it.

title: Santa Claws
text:
Santa Claws - Plot
When Santa Claws grabs the box, the wind blows against him and knocks over the Ladybug cutout. Ladybug jumps out of the box, shouting, "Merry Christmas!" and wraps her yo-yo around Santa Claws and the sleigh. Cat Noir runs up and over his baton, Cataclysm in hand, and grabs Santa Claws' hat, turning it black. He throws it to Ladybug, who blows on it to make it dissolve and release the akuma. Ladybug catches the akuma and throws the box in the air, using Miraculous Ladybug. The ladybugs return Paris to normal and put Santa Claus back on the ground safely. They do not, however, fix Adrien's hat. When the hat was dissolved, the pieces came together to form the akuma.
In his lair, Hawk Moth decides to let Ladybug and Cat Noir have a Merry Christmas, but he swears that next Christmas, he'll have the best presents.
Cat Noir returns to his home and meets his father in his atelier. Gabriel tells Adrien that he cannot accept him disappearing, too, as he couldn't bear to lose him. The doorbell then rings. Nathalie picks up the phone on her desk and presses a button, telling Adrien he has a visitor.

title: Santa Claws
text:
Santa Claws - Plot
Gabriel and Adrien stand in the foyer while Nathalie opens the doors. Adrien, in fact, does not have one visitor; he has several. Marlena, Rose, Mr. Kubdel, Juleka, Alix, Nino, Otis Césaire, Alya, Santa Claus, Marinette, André, Tom, Sabine, Sabrina, Roger, Chloé, Max, Kim, and the Césaire twins are all outside the Agreste mansion doors to see Adrien. Gabriel invites them in when Adrien asks if it is okay. The episode ends with everyone at the dinner table, wishing each other a merry Christmas. Adrien turns to the portrait of his family behind him, saying, "Merry Christmas, Mom."

title: Santa Claws
text:
Santa Claws - Plot Developments
According to Wilfried Pain, this episode happens somewhere in season 1 and before season 2.
As of May 11, 2018, "Santa Claws" was announced as a season 2 episode, therefore, it is considered to be a part of that season, despite the story of this episode taking place during season 1's timeline.
However, it is revealed that the events of the specials take place before the events of "Volpina" in the chronological order.
The episode reveals that Émilie Agreste disappeared some time in the last year.
The episode was originally going to also reveal why Hawk Moth has a picture of her. However, this issue was not addressed.
Because Adrien received the Cat Miraculous at the beginning of the series in September, it can be confirmed that the heroes and Hawk Moth have been around for at least 3 months or a little bit over 3 1/2 months.

title: Santa Claws
text:
Santa Claws - Plot Developments
But as the series progressed Émilie missing for that long was false because Nathalie said, "This is Adrien's first Christmas without her." Meaning that she was around as of Christmas 2014, but somewhere between January 2015 to Origins, Émilie used the Peacock Miraculous 14 years ago resulting in her endless sleep. Which is about 8 months meaning she would've been "missing" for more than half to a year.
This episode reveals that Cat Noir's baton can bend and curve when extended.

title: Santa Claws
text:
Santa Claws - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in France on TFOU.
This episode is famously advertised as a Christmas special episode due to its Christmas theme and songs.
The episode was originally advertised as a 40 minute special, called "Ladybug in Christmas" when concept art of it was first published by Jeremy Zag. Later concept art listed the name as "A Special Christmas".
The episode was shown in theaters during its Korean premiere in February 2017.
The special was originally announced to be 40 minutes long. However, it was finally released as a standard episode with 21 running minutes.
Ezra Weisz explained in a Periscope that the shortened length was due to deadlines.
The English dub cast started recording their lines for the special on November 16, 2016, which is exactly one month and four days before its official release on Netflix on December 20, 2016.
As revealed by Ezra Weisz on two Periscope live streams, he voiced the father who scolded his two naughty children for insulting Santa Claus and made them apologize to him.
In one of the two aforementioned Periscope live streams, Ezra revealed that the two naughty children were both voiced by Stephanie Sheh.

title: Santa Claws
text:
Santa Claws - Trivia
It was stated that the powers of the Turtle Miraculous would be revealed in this episode. However, the Turtle Miraculous was not featured in the episode's final release.
Even though his sister and father are in the episode, Jalil Kubdel does not appear.
Nathaniel, Ivan, and Mylène (and, therefore her father) don't appear in any way in the episode, despite the rest of the class appearing.
When Chloé and Marinette are shouting "Merry Christmas" at each other, their hair moves backwards from the strength of their voices and the screen even shakes.
For the first time, Adrien is visibly unhappy while he transforms into Cat Noir.
Marinette is also visibly unhappy when she transforms into Ladybug, similar to her transformation in "The Bubbler".
This is the only time they both are visibly unhappy while transforming.
This is also the first time Adrien irrationally uses his powers as Cat Noir out of anger and as seen in several episodes in doing so it leads to trouble.
Cat Noir's transformation music in this episode is changed slightly with a rock-n-roll edge to it.
Hawk Moth's lair is lit in blue instead of purple, due to it being at night.

title: Santa Claws
text:
Santa Claws - Trivia
Possibly because of this lighting, the initial appearance of the akuma is also darker, without the white streaks. However, in later shots, the white streaks are present again.
In the French version, when Ladybug leaves the Césaire apartment, she says, "Ho ho ho," which is absent in the English version.
The French equivalent to the nickname Alya gives Ladybug (Lady-Claus) is "Coccinoël".
This is a combination of the French words for ladybug ("coccinelle") and Christmas ("Noël").
On the Eiffel Tower is a Christmas light display of Santa Claus.
It snows in the end credit sequence.
The end credit sequence also has a holiday-themed instrumental of the theme song, adding remixes of both "We Wish You a Merry Christmas" and "Jingle Bells" in the background as well. A lyricized version of the track with vocals by Kalina & Kiana Campion was later released on the Miraculous Ladybug Christmas Album.
The full episode was uploaded to the official YouTube channel. However it was later set to private.
References
This is the third time a character sings outside of a performance or recording, following "Princess Fragrance" and "Befana".

title: Santa Claws
text:
Santa Claws - Trivia
This is the first time where Ladybug's Lucky Charm is an object from a previous episode following the box in "The Mime".
This is the fifth time where Cataclysm is used twice following "Copycat", "Simon Says", "The Dark Owl" and "Mayura".
When Cataclysm is summoned the first time, the animation sequence is not shown, akin to in "Copycat".
Allusions
Adrien's actions as Cat Noir similar to Muge's in "A Whisker Away" and Gus' from "Jingle Jangle: A Christmas Journey".
As both, Adrien and Muge left feeling unloved and unwanted causing both to runaway in their cat forms but soon realized they were always surrounded by those they loved.
Similar to Gus, if Adrien was more patient with his father then, Santa's akumatization wouldn't have happened.
Errors
During the song "Marinette & the Bakery," the words on the right inside window are flipped to where they can be read inside the bakery instead of being backward (to be read from the outside).
When Placide I.T. leaves with his Christmas log, the window is missing the words and the bakery's logo.
Based on the characters' mouth movements, the last word in "Marinette & the Bakery" was animated to be "you" instead of "all."

title: Santa Claws
text:

When Cat Noir detransforms in the snow-covered plaza, he says his usual "Claws out" instead of the proper deactivation "Claws in".
When Plagg is on the snow, one of his whiskers clips through the snow and doesn't leave an imprint.
When Santa Claus gives Adrien a piece of Camembert, his sandwich appears to have sliced Camembert, but the piece he gives Adrien is a triangular cut piece.
One of the cockroaches on Chloé disappears into her clothes.
Ladybug's eye color changes from dark blue to turquoise.
Immediately after Santa Claws leaves Chloé's house, when Ladybug lands on the roof her hand and feet are not properly touching the roof, as they are positioned to appear to be touching something, but are not actually touching anything. Her right foot is repositioned when she stands up, but her left foot remains unchanged.
Before Adrien transforms into Cat Noir before "Cat in the Night" Marinette's gift can be seen on his side, but when he transforms the gift disappears and in Cat in the Night it reappears again in his belt/tail then after Cat in the Night the gift disappears until Adrien opens the gift.
In Cat in the Night, Cat Noir's foot marks don't appear in the snow.

title: Santa Claus
text:
Santa Claus - Intro
is a minor character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He is an immortal man who delivers presents on Christmas.
In "Santa Claws", when Ladybug upset Santa by wrongly accusing him of being a supervillain, he was akumatized by Hawk Moth and became Santa Claws, a Christmas-themed supervillain.

title: Santa Claus
text:
Santa Claus - Appearance
Physical appearance
Santa is tall and overweight with balding white hair, a large, thick white beard, and blue eyes.
Civilian attire
On top of his head, he wears a red Santa hat with white trim around the bottom edge and tip of the hat. He wears a large red Santa suit with white trim on the end of the sleeves, top of the hood, lining, and bottom. Where the sleeves end, a large, black, fingerless gloves reach down to his knuckles. He also wears a thick black belt with a golden buckle around his waist, red pants with white trim on the cuffs, and black boots.
As Santa Claws

title: Santa Claus
text:
Santa Claus - Appearance
Santa Claws's skin was moderate malachite green, his eyes were light brilliant amaranth with amber sclerae with a same shade, his beard included many pointed tips, and he had long fingernails and sharp, jagged triangular teeth. He wore a black mask over the top of his face and Adrien's Christmas hat. While the red part of the suit was the same, the bottom edge was jagged, and his gloves included silver spots and a silver jagged line below the fingers, along with red edges on the finger holes. His belt was black with silver spots and a silver Christmas tree-shaped buckle, and on his back was a red bag with a white trim on the top edge. His pants were still red with thicker white trim on the cuffs, and his boots were black with red toe caps and silver hidden wedges. He also had a black sled with red patches on the side and back and rockets on the back that blasted green fire, two black and red reindeer being connected to it.

title: Santa Claus
text:
Santa Claus - Personality
Santa is warm, kind, and generous. He enjoys giving to others and helping them out, and he gives useful wisdom to those who need it, like Adrien. However, if he is disrespected or falsely accused of something, he becomes grouchy and upset, along with sometimes not easily forgiving the culprits.
As seen in "Christmaster", he is also very stern and strict towards tradition, refusing to give out gifts to kids early as such, and highly appreciates those who respect them, such as Ladybug.
As Santa Claws, he was menacing, bitter, and cruel. He got revenge on those who he disliked or who harmed him with terrifying gifts, and he enjoyed singing songs to proclaim his evil gifts. Despite his villainous nature, Santa Claws held nothing against Adrien, wanting to avenge both Adrien and himself, and he liked getting gifts and praise for being a frightening villain.

title: Santa Claus
text:
Santa Claus - Abilities
As a civilian
Santa Claus knows how to reign two horses to use a sled.
As Santa Claws
Santa Claws could fly with the help of his akumatized reindeer and sleigh with handles like a motorcycle. The sleigh was also able to become intangible to pass through walls and windows. From the sack on his back, he conjured wrapped presents that exploded with green smoke, sometimes also containing terrifying creatures like bats, tarantulas, and cockroaches. His magically created presents could also contain weapons that he could wield, like a sword and a mace.

title: Santa Claus
text:
Santa Claus - Etymology
His French villain name is Pire Noël, which literally translates to "Worst Christmas".
It's also a pun on Santa's name in France, Père Noël, which translates to "Father Christmas", one of the names for Santa Claus.
His Spanish villain name is Santa Atroz, which literally translates to "Atrocious Santa".

title: Santa Claus
text:
Santa Claus - Trivia
Both his existence and appearance were revealed at San Diego Comic-Con 2016.
His appearance was shown in a preview, while his character was first spoken about by Thomas Astruc.
Thomas calls him Bad Santa.
According to Wilfried Pain, the Santa Claus who appears in "Santa Claws" is the same character who appears in "Christmaster".
Santa Claus' animal companions, his horses, become akumatized with him, which also happens with Jagged Stone's crocodile Fang in "Guitar Villain", "Catalyst" and "Crocoduel".
Unlike with other akumatized villains, his supervillain name is based on his actual name, but with the letter "W" replacing the letter "U".
In "Gamer 2.0", Santa Claws returns as a playable akumatized villain as part of the Gamer 2.0's powers.

title: Sass
text:
Sass - Intro
is a supporting character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He is the Kwami of Intuition who is connected to the Snake Miraculous. With his power, Sass' wearer can use the Ouroboros bracelet to transform into a snake-themed superhero.
Sass and his Miraculous are currently owned by Luka Couffaine, who uses it to transform into the superhero Viperion.

title: Sass
text:
Sass - Appearance
Sass is 10 centimeters (or 4 inches) tall and is light sea green, and has a broad, triangular head, resembling a cobra. His eyes are vivid green with narrow black pupils and light apple green sclerae, his mouth has two pointed fangs, and he has a sea green forked tongue. Additionally, he has a long tail, and from the top of his head and down his back to the tip of his tail, he has a very deep sea green diamond line pattern.
From Season 6 onwards, his appearance remains the same, except that his sclerae are now yellow, he has a visible nose and eyelashes, and there are two white dots above his eyes.

title: Sass
text:
Sass - Personality
Sass is the de facto leader of the Kwamis in the Miracle Box, given his wise, insightful and charming demeanor. Because of his status as the Kwami of Intuition, his fellow kwamis value his sagacious wisdom and look to him for guidance when necessary, like when he told Tikki and Plagg to get Wayzz when they were not managing to contact Nooroo during the latter's cycle. With the eminent danger of a famished Tikki looking for galettes to eat and using her power like she has done in the past, he allowed Wayzz and Barkk to leave and watch over her. Another demonstration of his leadership is how he has the courage to try to dissuade Gabriel from having his wish granted and explain to him the drawbacks of fusing too many Miraculous. The other Kwamis also tend to hide behind him when they get scared by their new villainous owner.
Like Longg, he has a bit of a formal side happily greeting his owners. Due to the unique ability of his powers, Sass has high expectations of those he is partnered with. As Master Fu described his jewel, Sass is also wise in carefully choosing what time he needed to go back too like his holders he was able to resist temptation.

title: Sass
text:
Sass - Personality
And yet, in rare incidents Sass will beg for things he truly desires seen in "Furious Fu", as he did the puppy dog eyes along with his fellow Kwamis expressing their desire to see Master Fu. Due to his calm demeanor, he rarely gets scared as seen in "Simpleman" when Manon tries to open Marinette's sewing box.

title: Sass
text:
Sass - Abilities
General Skills
As Sass' holders remember every revised timeline, it's likely he does too, possibly meaning that he has a photographic memory or is capable of recalling the past in detail with great accuracy.
As a Kwami
Sass can fly, levitate, and phase through solid objects. He can also carry objects that are larger and/or heavier than himself.
As a Kwami, Sass is able to transform the holder of the Snake Miraculous into a snake-themed superhero, with the power to go back in time with Second Chance.
Unlike his holders, Sass, when he uses Second Chance, can go back to any previously marked time, no matter how much time has passed. However, doing so causes different moments in time to randomly overlap with each other, causing objects, animals or people from the past to reappear at the present.
It also disrupts objects and devices that use or measure the passage of time in order to function properly.

title: Sass
text:
Sass - Relationships
Friends
Tikki & Plagg
Sass treats Tikki and Plagg as equals and considers them of being high virtue, given that he assumed they both got permission from their owners and from the Great Guardian of the Miraculous to participate in the ceremony inside the Miracle Box.
Sass cares about Tikki and Plagg as he was willing to help Marinette rescue them in "Kwamibuster" from the titular villain.
In "Miracle Queen", Sass fuses his power with Plagg's after having it removed from his owner, who was under the titular villain's control to help Cat Noir become Snake Noir. Later the episode, when Tikki's owner becomes the new Guardian, he and his fellow kwamis move in with her.
Upon concerning about Tikki going on hunger rampage again in "Dearest Family", he advised Wayzz and Barkk to watch over her.
In "Ephemeral", upon seeing Tikki's and Plagg's combined power being used Sass knew that his fellow kwamis were caught by Shadow Moth. From his Guardian's Lucky Charm, he got her permission to use his power and in doing so their capture was undone.
Adrien Agreste/Cat Noir

title: Sass
text:
Sass - Relationships
Sass appears to have a friendly relationship with Adrien, though he has likely left a poor impression on Sass after failing to make good use of Second Chance 25,913 times as Aspik.
In "Miracle Queen", after Sass' Miraculous was taken from a mind controlled Luka, he was fed some cheese by Cat Noir before unifying his power with the Cat Miraculous to become Snake Noir. It's likely that Sass' impression on Adrien started to change, as he was more focused on saving his friends, and that he only used Second Chance twice.
Luka Couffaine/Viperion
Sass appears to get along well with Luka. He likely thinks highly of Luka after comparing him to his recent temporary owner, Adrien, who proved to be a failure with the Snake Miraculous. In "Party Crasher", Luka and Sass continued to work together. In "Miracle Queen", he was likely worried after seeing Luka put on the Miraculous to be used against his friends.
In "Wishmaker", Sass becomes delighted to see Luka again when Ladybug needed his help.
In "Strikeback" Luka is shocked to discover that Sass is now Monarch's prisoner.

title: Sass
text:
Sass - Relationships
In "Ephemeral", when Shadow Moth is able to get the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses and is about to grant his wish, Sass explains to Luka the consequences of using the Absolute Power, before Luka telling him to use his power to go back in time and prevent that from happening.
In "Re-creation", after being held hostage for months and being treated like a slave by Monarch, Sass was happily reunited with Luka, and they hugged each other, with Luka now being Sass' holder permanently now.
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/Ladybug/Multimouse
Even though his Miraculous wasn't activated, Sass helped Marinette as Multimouse enact her plan to rescue Tikki and Plagg by having her ride in his mouth. After Kwamibuster's defeat, he praised Marinette as her plan was a success.
After "Miracle Queen", Sass respects Marinette as his new Guardian.
In "Dearest Family", aware of what was going on with Tikki, Sass tried to warn her.
In "Ephemeral", upon sensing time anomalies happening everywhere Sass detransformed to explain to Ladybug that he got permission from her Lucky Charm to use his power.
In "Strikeback", he and the Kwamis were taken from Marinette by Monarch.

title: Sass
text:
Sass - Relationships
In "Evolution", he was amongst the Kwamis who begged Marinette to free them from Monarch.
In "Destruction", he and the Kwamis were briefing reunited with her when Ladybug captured Monarch, but was taken from her again when he managed to escape.
In "Deflagration", when he and the Kwamis learned that Monarch had found out who the holders of the Miraculous were, they were horrified, thinking that he found out who Ladybug and Cat Noir were. Even after they found that he meant Scarabella and Kitty Noire, they were still concerned about them.
In "Miraculous London", he and the Kwamis were freed from Monarch by Ladybug and Natalie, and upon hearing that she was giving the Kwamis to their holders permanently, he and the Kwamis hugged her one more time and told her they loved her.
Enemies
Gabriel Agreste/Monarch
In seasons 1-4, Sass did not know Hawk Moth's identity, but he knew that Nooroo was under his command and like all the other Kwamis he wanted to free him.
In "Miracle Queen", after Hawk Moth discovered Master Fu and stole the Miracle Box, Sass was at his disposal, but was handed over to a mind-controlled Luka, allowing Ladybug and Cat Noir to free him.

title: Sass
text:
Sass - Relationships
However in "Strikeback", because Flairmidable betrayed Ladybug and stole her yo-yo, Sass' Miraculous and all the others were stolen by Gabriel, leaving Sass under his service.
In "Evolution", upon discovering Gabriel's intentions, Sass tries to convince him that what he is trying to do is very risky, but Gabriel does not listen and silences his mouth. Later when Monarch was suffering the consequences of using many miraculous at the same time, Sass warned him that they needed food and that if he continued he would only hurt himself more. Later, after Monarch loses Fluff, Sass and the other kwamis witness Gabriel being abandoned by Nathalie and retreat in fear.

title: Sass
text:
Sass - Relationships
In "Destruction", Gabriel tries to force Orikko to give him the power to travel through time, but Sass, Orikko and Xuppu explain to him that that is not possible and when Gabriel calls them useless, Orikko is offended and Sass and the other kwamis call Gabriel evil which causes Gabriel to seal their mouths. Afterwards, Sass and the other kwamis are forced to take Monarch to his guardian's house, but they end up taking him into a trap prepared by Ladybug to rescue Sass and his companions, but she fails. After Gabriel melts Sass' miraculous and turns it into an Alliance ring to use his power without fusing it with the Butterfly Miraculous, and imprisoning Sass in a cage.
Later Monarch began using Second Chance to give his akumatized villains more chances to win, but it didn't work and ended up accelerating the effects of the Cataclysm on Gabriel.
In "Deflagration", Sass and the other Kwamis are surprised that Gabriel has discovered the identities of Tikki and Plagg's new owners, but they could do nothing but watch Gabriel carry out his plan to capture Tikki and Plagg, but then they see him return defeated to his lair.

title: Sass
text:
Sass - Relationships
In "Intuition", Gabriel makes one last attempt to use Sass' power in a plan to separate Ladybug and Cat Noir to get their miraculouses but it ended up becoming a no-win situation and he made so many attempts that the effects of the Cataclysm accelerated even more. Later Monarch is forced to stop using Second Chance and has no ally he can trust with the power because he considers it risky to give it to an akumatized villain.
Because he no longer has any use for Gabriel, Sass can only watch from his cage as Monarch increasingly loses his sanity and makes desperate plans.
In "The Final Day", he witnesses how Gabriel and Tomoe Tsurugi start the Perfect Alliance operation and then Gabriel transfers the power of Sass and the other caged kwamis to the Miraculized, then during his guardian's battle against Monarch, Bug Noire manages to snatch all the rings of Monarch's right hand including the Snake Miraculous. After the wish Sass and his companions were freed from Monarch forever.

title: Sass
text:
Sass - Trivia
Sass was first revealed from a second season trailer on August 31, 2017.
Snakes are symbols of rebirth, patience, intuition, and healing, among other things.
The snake is the sixth animal of the Chinese zodiac.
In the terms of episodes production codes (followed roughly in chronological order) Sass is the first known Kwami of the Chinese zodiac to be activated and used.
Sass appears to be the leader of the Kwamis inside the Miracle Box.
Due to his hood and the black diamond pattern on his back, Sass appears to be based on both cobras and eastern or western diamond-backed rattlesnakes.
The word "sass" means "impudence, cheek", and is similar to the sound a snake makes.
According to an official book of ambiguous canon, Sass' concept is Intuition.
This is later confirmed by Wilfried Pain in an interview.
In "Desperada", Sass' Miraculous is temporarily entrusted to Adrien Agreste, who uses it to turn into Aspik. Shortly after, Ladybug then gives Sass' Miraculous to Luka Couffaine turning him into Viperion, after Adrien fails to properly use the snake's power.
In "Miracle Queen", Cat Noir temporarily wears and unifies Sass' Miraculous with his own to become Snake Noir.

title: Sass
text:
Sass - Trivia
Sass is the fifth Kwami to use his power without a holder on screen, in "Ephemeral", following Plagg in "Style Queen", "Catalyst" and "Deflagration", Trixx in "Gang of Secrets", Kaalki in "Sole Crusher" and "Optigami", and Tikki in "Dearest Family" and "Deflagration".

title: Sapotis
text:
Sapotis - Intro
"" is a season 2 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 12th written and produced episode of season 2. It is also the 38th written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Sapotis
text:
Sapotis - Synopsis
Netflix
During a sleepover with Marinette, Alya punishes her twin sisters, Etta and Ella, who get akumatized into monsters that multiply when they eat.
KidsClick
Alya's little sisters get akumatized into small, out-of-control monsters named Sapotis who wreak havoc in Paris. Epic babysitting session ahead for Ladybug and Cat Noir!
Disney+
Ladybug faces small, out–of–control monsters named Sapotis.

title: Sapotis
text:
Sapotis - Plot
Marinette is at the Césaire apartment for a sleepover with Alya who is on the phone with her mother, assuring her that they are getting Alya's younger twin sisters, Ella and Etta, to bed.
Meanwhile, the rambunctious twins are pretending to be the "Sapotis", making Alya chase them around. Then, Alya tells them to go to bed and picks them up with both her arms. She puts her sisters to bed in their room, but they are reluctant to sleep because they want to stay up like Marinette and Alya and watch the movie with them.
Alya asks the girls how they expect to go to the amusement park tomorrow if they stay up late, using Marinette as a demonstration of the sisters being tired and falling asleep at the amusement park. Ella and Etta finally give in, and Alya allows them to wear their hats while they sleep as long as they stay in bed. She leaves the room and shuts off the light.
Back in the kitchen, Marinette compliments Alya's ability to control her sisters. She then asks what the Sapotis are, and Alya explains that they are mischief-causing creatures from Creole Mythology.

title: Sapotis
text:
Sapotis - Plot
Alya then excitedly shares her newest findings on Ladybug with Marinette. She explains that Ladybug has existed since the time of the pharaohs, although the one they know couldn't possibly be five thousand years old. So, Alya decided to investigate by analyzing audio recordings of Ladybug. She found that Ladybug's voice frequency matches that of a girl their own age.
Marinette is anxious to find a way to stop Alya from trying to find more clues to Ladybug's identity. At that moment, she notices that the orange juice they were going to drink is gone and points it out to Alya. Discovering that her younger twin sisters had sneakily drunk the juice, Alya cleans the girls up and puts them back to bed as they playfully insist, "It's not us, it's the Sapotis!"
In the continued discussion of Ladybug, Marinette points out that it's important to Ladybug that her identity must be kept a secret, as exposure would endanger her friends and loved ones.

title: Sapotis
text:
Sapotis - Plot
Meanwhile, the twins repeatedly get out of bed, annoying Alya more and more. Finally, Alya loses her temper for her younger sisters' behavior, so she angrily scolds them for disobeying her, takes away their hats, and tells them that they won't be going to the amusement park the next day. She leaves them, and the twins start crying.
Hawk Moth, sensing their sadness, sends an Akuma to them. The akuma flies out of Hawk Moth's lair and straight to Ella's and Etta's bedroom in the Césaire apartment. It infects the hat that Ella and Etta are fighting over, and Hawk Moth tells them that he'll give them the power to do whatever they want if in return they'll get Cat Noir's and Ladybug's Miraculouses. Ella and Etta both agree, and they are transformed into the Sapotis.

title: Sapotis
text:
Sapotis - Plot
Hearing a noise from her sisters' room, Alya becomes furious that the girls disobeyed her yet again, but she is shocked when she sees that they have become akumatized monsters. They break out of their room and cause a ruckus throughout the apartment. Marinette begins to think that Alya might have been a little too harsh on them, but Alya responds that this is not the normal result of being strict. During the little monsters' rampage, Marinette observes them multiplying when they eat.
Several of them escape the apartment through an open window. Alya tells Marinette to keep her eye on the ones still inside while she takes care of those that got out. When Alya leaves, Marinette transforms into Ladybug.
The ever-multiplying Sapotis continue to cause havoc in the city, such as recklessly driving a car with Penny Rolling and Jagged Stone inside. One Sapoti goes inside a garbage can, and when the garbage is dumped, it causes lots of other Sapotis to keep on multiplying. More problems are then created in Paris.

title: Sapotis
text:
Sapotis - Plot
Nadja Chamack tries to report on the creatures but gets tackled by two of them, leaving one of them to take over the broadcast. Seeing the commotion from his television, Adrien knows that he has to do something and calls on Plagg. He joins Adrien after locking up his cheese supply to make his precious food secure from the devilish monsters, just in case they manage to break into their house. Then, Adrien transforms into Cat Noir.
In the midst of the Sapotis' rampage, Cat Noir and Ladybug find one of them playing with a traffic light, and they cause it to get tangled in the wires. Then, Ladybug destroys its hat, making it disappear.
Cat Noir asks how she knew to go for the hat, and she says that it was through trial and error. He points out that no akuma was released, and Ladybug explains that it's because it was just a clone. She also says that they'll have to catch them all in order to find the very first pairs of sapoti that Hawk Moth had akumatized or the original pair.

title: Sapotis
text:
Sapotis - Plot
Cat Noir manages to trip a bicycle with three sapotis riding on it, sending them flying into the air, and Ladybug destroys their hats. Ladybug and Cat Noir defeat multiple Sapotis, but they have no luck finding the right ones, as it would take forever.
When Ladybug and Cat Noir are at the pier, the Sapotis bounce on André the ice cream maker and steal his ice cream cart so that they could eat more and more ice cream, multiplying more and more of the mischievous monsters. Cat Noir and Ladybug come to them, and Cat Noir says that things will get into serious damage.
Hawk Moth instructs the Sapotis to take their Miraculouses. Despite their best efforts, the heroes come to realize that they are going to be outnumbered soon. As a last resort, Ladybug summons her Lucky Charm and receives a teapot.
It strikes her as familiar, but she can't figure out how to use it. When Cat Noir reminds Ladybug that his kung fu is insufficient to fight off the Sapotis, Ladybug realizes the purpose of the object and tells her partner that she has to go. In shock, Cat Noir protests, but Ladybug tells him to trust her before heading off.

title: Sapotis
text:
Sapotis - Plot
Marinette, de-transformed, arrives at Master Fu's massage shop. Upon seeing her, Wayzz tells her that it's dangerous to come here, but Master Fu says that they should give her a chance to speak.
Marinette explains to Master Fu that her Lucky Charm sent her to him. Master Fu understands and recounts how he has already talked to her about all the Miraculouses and their powers but points out that hers and Cat Noir's are the most powerful and mysterious ones. The Lucky Charm that she created told her to come to Master Fu, telling her that she and Cat Noir need help.
As he goes to the Miracle Box in the phonograph, Master Fu becomes hesitant about the use of another Miraculous, but Marinette reminds him that she and Cat Noir have always been very careful when using their powers.
Reassured, Master Fu sets the Miracle Box down between them and opens it up, revealing many Miraculouses inside of it. He tells Marinette to choose a Miraculous for a trusted ally to help them but also reminds her that their powers are supposed to be used for good and must not fall into the wrong hands.

title: Sapotis
text:
Sapotis - Plot
He also says that when the mission is over, she must return the Miraculous to him, reasoning that until they discover all the secrets of the Miraculouses, it's too dangerous to leave any more out in the open. Marinette chooses the Fox Miraculous and confidently states that she knows the perfect person for the job.
At the park, Alya tries to reason with some of the Sapotis but to no avail. Then Ladybug arrives and destroys them. Alya expresses her need to help her sisters, so Ladybug asks Alya if she'd like to help her and Cat Noir, to which she enthusiastically agrees.
In her excitement, Alya is eager to tell Marinette and reaches for her phone to call her, but the superheroine stops her and says that this must stay a secret from her friends and the Ladyblog. Alya understands and puts her phone away.
Ladybug then presents her with the Fox Miraculous and makes Alya promise she'll use its powers for good and return it once the mission is over. Alya agrees and opens the Miraculous box. She is at first startled by Trixx, who introduces himself as her kwami; but she quickly becomes fascinated by him and figures out that he will give her magical superpowers.

title: Sapotis
text:
Sapotis - Plot
Trixx is impressed by his new wielder's observational skills. Alya becomes even more excited and frantically asks Ladybug a bunch of questions that could uncover her identity until Ladybug reminds her to focus. She apologizes and puts the necklace on.
Trixx tells her that her activation phrase for her to transform is "Trixx, let's pounce!", and after saying it, Alya transforms into a fox-themed superheroine, named Rena Rouge. She finds her new outfit amazing but comments on the fact that she looks like Lila's akumatized form. Ladybug explains that Alya is a superhero version, and both of them take off, with Alya happily following behind her.
Meanwhile, Cat Noir is overwhelmed by the numerous Sapotis clones. Seeing him surrounded, Hawk Moth orders the Sapotis to take his Miraculous. They pile up on him and almost grab his ring, but before they can, Ladybug saves him. She and her new ally fight off the other Sapotis clones nearby.
Amazed at seeing the new superhero, Cat Noir comments that he thought that he was Ladybug's only superhero friend. Ladybug introduces their new member of the superhero team, but stumbles on what name they will call her by.

title: Sapotis
text:
Sapotis - Plot
She introduces herself as Rena Rouge. Cat Noir playfully jokes around with her and welcomes her to the team with a kiss on the hand, jovially offering her superhero advice if she needs it. When Rena Rouge coyly asks Cat Noir for Ladybug's phone number, he says that he has a feeling that working with her is going to be a lot of fun, causing Ladybug to laugh.
Hawk Moth is surprised that there is a new superhero but comments that he had suspicions about there being other Miraculouses in Paris; meaning that there are more heroes to save France than just Ladybug and Cat Noir. He remains unfazed, however, and orders the Sapotis to band together and defeat the trio or else he'll take away their powers.
Seeing that there are too many around them to fight, the three superheroes retreat. Ladybug uses her Lucky Charm once again and receives a unicycle. She quickly comes up with a plan and gathers a bunch of items while fighting off the Sapotis.

title: Sapotis
text:
Sapotis - Plot
Cat Noir extends his metal staff so that he, Ladybug, and Rena Rouge can get from the building that they are on to another building while Ladybug and Rena Rouge are carrying the items. They quickly get across to the other side of the building and leave the Sapotis on the previous building, even though two of them attempted to get across with the superhero team.
Rena Rouge is very curious about how the items will help but Ladybug says to just trust her. Then Ladybug lures the Sapotis into a confined alleyway by telling them of an amusement park called Sapotis-Land. When Cat Noir sees them coming, he tells Rena Rouge to use her illusion powers.
Although she's a little nervous, he instructs her to concentrate on the illusion she wants to make. Then, she blows on her flute, summoning her superpower, Mirage, and creating an illusion of an amusement park for the Sapotis.

title: Sapotis
text:
Sapotis - Plot
The Fox Miraculous then beeps, and Rena Rouge realizes that she'll de-transform soon because she used her superpowers. Cat Noir playfully assures her that he'll keep her identity a secret, but she retorts by saying a superhero never reveals their identity. He praises her for learning quickly, and she teasingly counters by quoting his words from earlier, "If you need any superhero tips, you know where to come."
As Ladybug continues to call the Sapotis, Hawk Moth senses the deception and tells them that it's a trap, but they ignore him. Signaling Cat Noir, Ladybug tells him to start phase two. After he wedges the prepared object into the narrow alleyway, Ladybug uses her yo-yo to set it spinning. It scoops all the hats off the Sapotis as they run underneath it and hurls the hats into a garbage bin, while Rena Rouge and Cat Noir hold the bin and catch every single one of them.

title: Sapotis
text:
Sapotis - Plot
Once every hat has been captured, Cat Noir uses his Cataclysm to destroy the garbage bin, which is the container for all of the Sapotis' hats. Ladybug leaps up to where Rena Rouge and Cat Noir are standing on the top of the building and kicks the disintegrated garbage bin. All of the clones disappear, and Ella and Etta are de-akumatized.
Ladybug captures the akuma with her yo-yo, purifying and releasing it. She throws her lucky charm, which is a unicycle and yells, "Miraculous Ladybug!" to reverse the damage the Sapotis did. All the buses and cars are back to their normal places, repaired.
Cat Noir tells Rena Rouge he looks forward to working with her again before she leaves with Ladybug to de-transform. As they depart, Ladybug asks Cat Noir if he can take the twin girls home. He tries to ask them where they live, but the twins ecstatically jump on top of him. Hawk Moth says that although he was defeated, he now knows that there are other Miraculouses in Paris and maybe even a guardian.

title: Sapotis
text:
Sapotis - Plot
After Alya de-transforms, she is overjoyed about her first adventure as a superheroine. Ladybug thanks her for the help and puts her hand out for the Miraculous, but Alya is hesitant to return it. She says she wants to keep it so that she can continue helping Ladybug and Cat Noir and even states that they'd make a great team. Ladybug reminds Alya of her promise, but seeing that her transformation is almost up, she goes inside a nearby building, telling Alya that she trusts her.
When Ladybug is gone, Trixx agrees with Alya that she makes a great superheroine, citing her best qualities including, above all, trustworthiness — the push Alya needs to make the right choice. Inside the building, Marinette detransforms and at first believes that Alya won't return the Miraculous, which saddens her. Then the door opens, and Alya places the Fox Miraculous inside. This satisfies Marinette, and she returns the jewel to Master Fu, who praises her for making the right choice.

title: Sapotis
text:
Sapotis - Plot
Back at her home, Alya hears a knock at her door and sees Marinette, who tells Alya that she tried calling her but didn't answer. Alya almost tells Marinette about her time as Rena Rouge but quickly remembers her promise to Ladybug. She instead says that her phone battery died. When Alya remarks that everything turned out well thanks to Ladybug and Cat Noir, Marinette mentions hearing a rumor that a third hero also helped out, and Alya begs her for details.

title: Sapotis
text:
Sapotis - Plot Developments
When Marinette and Tikki first met, she told the kwami that Alya would make a better hero than her meaning that possibly without knowing it Marinette was aware of Alya's potential as a hero.
So Alya debuts as Rena Rouge debuts in this episode, although she gives her Miraculous back to Ladybug after defeating the Sapotis.
That the transformation phrase for the Fox Miraculous is Let's Pounce and power is Mirage.
When Alya transformed for the first time her glasses were gone being replaced by her mask and just like Gabriel in "The Collector", it's been revealed that the Miraculous transformations can completely fix physical impairments temporarily.
Unlike previous situations, Ladybug's Lucky Charm (the teapot) doesn't give her a clue on how to defeat an akumatized villain, but instead, it prompts her to get help from her guardian Wang Fu as a chance to recruit new allies to join her team.
It is revealed that more than one person can be akumatized at the same time if they are both holding onto the object the akuma enters.
This episode takes place after "The Pharaoh", "Volpina" and "The Collector".

title: Sapotis
text:
Sapotis - Plot Developments
Alya mentions the ancient Egyptian Ladybug and the time of the pharaohs, referencing the events of "The Pharaoh".
She also mentions remembering when Lila was akumatized referencing the events of "Volpina".
Also she should've suspected that Lila was lying as Cat Noir said thinking "he was Ladybug's only superhero friend" and being aware that superheroes can't be open with civilians on a personal level to avoid arousing suspicion of their identities.
And yet, due to Alya not knowing that Marinette and Ladybug were the same person at the time in her perspective she believed what Lila said was the truth.

title: Sapotis
text:
Sapotis - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in France on TFOU.
Marinette's alternate pajamas were first shown on a special poster by SAMG Animation for the show's second anniversary.
In the French version of the episode, Wilfried Pain voices some of the Sapotis.
This is the second episode to have two characters in its title, the first being "Ladybug & Cat Noir".
Cat Noir destroys an akumatized object with his Cataclysm for the second time, following "Santa Claws".
Just like Santa Claus's hat, the twins' amusement park hats don't get repaired or fixed.
When Alya transforms into Rena Rouge, her body is slimmer than her regular body.
In the English dub, the moment when Alya opens her apartment gate and gasps is recycled from the French dub.
Additionally, although the majority of the sound effects that the Sapotis make are modified in the English dub, quite a few of sound effects are also reused from the French dub.
Alya was the first of the Miraculers to get a Miraculous at night being followed by Eagle in "Miraculous New York" and Alix in "Evolution".
This episode takes place entirely at night.

title: Sapotis
text:
Sapotis - Trivia
This is the last episode to have its international premiere on TFOU until "Mr. Pigeon 72", more than two and a half years later.
References
A DVD cover that Marinette shows Alya is for a Ladybug anime, and it includes an image of Ladybug from the Ladybug PV.
The design on Alya's pajama top is a reference to one of her favorite superhero, Majestia.
The alternate version of Ladybug's transformation sequence is when Marinette transforms in her pajamas rather than in her everyday attire is shown again, following "Gorizilla".
This is also the second time Marinette wears her pajamas throughout the whole episode.
This is the third time Tikki doesn't have a speaking role.
As well as that Hawk Moth turns a child into a villain, following "The Puppeteer" and "Gigantitan".
Allusions
The name "Sapotis" is from a real Créole fable about troublemaking jester monsters.
Besides the main seven Miraculouses, the Miraculous jewel box is revealed to hold twelve other Miraculouses, corresponding to animals of the Chinese zodiac.

title: Sapotis
text:
Sapotis - Trivia
After realizing how to capture the Sapotis' akuma, Cat Noir says "So you mean we gotta catch them all", which is a reference to the motto of the Pokémon franchise "Gotta catch 'em all".
The Pokémon reference is also present in the French version, with Cat Noir saying "Attrapez-les tous."
The behavior and method of multiplying is reminiscent to that of the Gremlins from the movie franchise Gremlins.
Gremlins multiply by getting wet with water while the Sapotis multiply by eating food.
Ladybug, Cat Noir, and Rena Rouge make a pact that is similar to the PJ Masks' pact, only their balled up fingers are facing up and not facing down.
Errors
When Marinette heads over to Alya's apartment balcony, she is wearing her purse despite not wearing it beforehand. However, in the next shot, before she transforms into Ladybug, her purse is gone again.
Both of Marinette's ponytails freeze for a whole frame during her transformation, but when the camera zooms into her earring, they start to move again.
Also, her regular transformation head is edited over the newer sequence starting from when she flips her hair, which creates some odd visual cuts.

title: Sapotis
text:
Sapotis - Trivia
She also has an additional pair of side-burns as a result.
After Rena Rouge uses her Mirage power, her necklace's top section turns black. However, in the shot after the three-way fist-bump, it's orange again.
When Rena Rouge transforms, Trixx does not go inside her necklace, but when she detransforms, Trixx comes out.
Also in her transformation when Rena Rouge does her first spin before her pose, the point at her upper legs behind the tail is missing, though during her second spin the point is back.
During Alya's transformation, her arm also randomly appears in the background and then disappears after a few shots.
Ladybug called out her Lucky Charm first, and then after, Rena Rouge her Mirage. However, during the end of the episode, it's Rena's Miraculous that runs out of time first and transforms back.
When the akuma is flying out of Hawk Moth's lair, the Eiffel Tower is shown in the background.
This episode is mistakenly titled "The Sapotis" on Netflix.
Throughout the episode, Rena Rouge doesn't have black eyelids and eyeliner. This is corrected in all later episodes.
