title: Sarah/History
text:
Sarah/History - Intro
Sarah is Chris' and Fred Haprèle's manager as the play director for The Mime's Extraordinary Adventures.

title: Sarah/History
text:
Sarah/History - [[Season 1]]
In "The Mime", Sarah directs the play called The Mime's Extraordinary Adventures, starring Fred Haprèle, that is being performed at the Eiffel Tower. She, the cast, and the crew are all waiting on Fred at the bus stop. Sarah angrily calls Fred and screams at him for his tardiness, with Fred saying he was picking up his hat and that he will be there soon. After they hang up, Fred's understudy Chris comes up to Sarah and asks her what was Fred's excuse this time. She then tells him what Fred to her, with Chris saying he was very convincing actor.
Sarah defends Fred by pointing that he is a great actor, but mentions how he is always making excuses for why is he late. Chris then tells that she is making the show suffer by letting Fred get away with it. He does this by reminding her of Fred's various excuses, such as why falls asleep in the middle of rehearsal, why he leaves early, or why he is missing parts of his costume. Sarah then angrily reminds Chris that he is only his understudy, telling him to be ready to take Fred's place in case something happens.

title: Sarah/History
text:
Sarah/History - [[Season 1]]
A few minutes later, Sarah is still waiting outside for Fred, with Chris insisting that they need to leave now to make it in time for dress rehearsal. She tells him that he is right and gives him Fred's place. Chris tells Sarah that he won't let her down and the bus leaves. Soon, Fred starts calling Sarah, with Chris telling her that he wouldn't give him the time of day if he was her. She then hesitantly answers the phone and Fred tells her that he was waiting for them at the Louvre. Sarah tells him that she has had enough of his excuses and informs him of his replacement. She then angrily throws her phone onto her seat.
Later, Sarah is startled when Ladybug and Cat Noir land on the roof of the bus. The heroes then start fighting the titular villain who is soon knocked off the bus. However, Ladybug grabs on to him, smashing him onto the window of the bus and scaring everyone on it. Within moments, Ladybug enters the bus and Sarah questions her on what's happening. After the heroine explains, Sarah quickly realizes that the villain is actually an akumatized Fred.

title: Sarah/History
text:
Sarah/History - [[Season 1]]
Outside, the villain throws an arrow at one of the bus' wheels, making it go out of control and Sarah to fall to the floor. Cat Noir then stops the bus with his staff just in time before it crashes. Ladybug tells everyone on the bus to stay inside and not to panic, before she was stopped from leaving by Chris. He tells her that the villain is after them because he took his role. Sarah confused, explains that he lost it. Chris then tells her that there is something he has to tell her. Before he does, everyone's attention turns to Cat Noir and the villain fighting.
Moments later, when Ladybug does her Lucky Charm, she takes Sarah's glasses. The heroine then makes a projector out of the box, using the glasses as a magnifying glass, a The Mime's Extraordinary Adventures poster, and a car's light. The villain sees the poster projection and gets angry. He mimics a sword and cuts the "poster" in half. But that's before he realizes that he had sliced the Eiffel Tower in half instead, scaring everyone. Sarah then watched while others ran as the villain sees it falling and mimics a shield to stop it, saving everyone's lives.

title: Sarah/History
text:
Sarah/History - [[Season 1]]
After Fred turns back to normal and Ladybug does her Miraculous Ladybug, Sarah apologizes to Fred for not believing him earlier. She is then pressed by Chris who also apologized as he was so desperate to perform that he lied to Fred about where they were meeting up at. With Fred having forgiven them, they all pressed to get ready for the play. Later, once The Mime's Extraordinary Adventures starts, Sarah is seen applauding from a sound booth.

title: Sarah/History
text:
Sarah/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Heart Hunter", Sarah attends Mayor André and Audrey Bourgeois' 20th wedding anniversary inside Le Grand Paris. There she witnesses the couple be akumatized into the titular villains.

title: Sarah/History
text:
Sarah/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Lies", Sarah made model Adrien Agreste perform on stage with a pencil in his mouth, reciting the  tongue twister called How Much Wood Would A Woodchuck Chuck. After he did this, she told him that he was not bad, telling him to do it again. However, this time Sarah asked him to do it with a bit more "orange", making Adrien giggle.
In "Hack-San", after Robostus sends out a signal to all Parisians with a message sent through their phones, Sarah is hypothesized offscreen. She is then sent by Robostus to the Musée Grévin, positioning herself where her statue used to be. There after Scarabella and Cat Noir arrive, Sarah unfreezes from his position. She then pulls out her phone and moves towards the heroes.
Sarah is commanded to seize the Ladybug and the Cat Miraculous, along with the other high-profile hypothesized individuals. She then watched as Scarabella and Cat Noir delivered themselves to Robostus. Later, Sarah is freed from Robostus' control by Scarabella's Miraculous Scarabella.

title: Sadnansi
text:
Sadnansi - Intro
"" is a season 6 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 23rd written and produced episode of season 6. It is also the 154th written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Sadnansi
text:
Sadnansi - Synopsis
Marinette is convinced Nora and her coworker, Twig, have feelings for each other but are too afraid to confess, risking their chance at love.
Disney+
Marinette plays matchmaker.

title: Sadnansi
text:
Sadnansi - Plot
As the episode opens, Ladybug stands over the torn-up remains of the drawing of Gabriel that she had been working on. Opening her yo-yo and taking out the letter to Adrien from Gabriel, she then powers down and tells Tikki that she is going to tell Adrien the truth, knowing that she'll be there to support him during his grief. She then grabs her helmet, heads to the Agreste mansion on her electric scooter, is let in by Nathalie and Placide, and enters Adrien's room to tell him everything.

title: Sadnansi
text:
Sadnansi - Plot
At the school cafeteria from earlier that same day, Nora and her new crush, Twig, serve Marinette, Adrien, Nino, and Alya lunch, but it is clear that Nora is refusing to acknowledge that she and Twig are a couple. Because should your ex, Kouki was very toxic with her, after sitting down, the four discuss things about Nora and Twig, and then attempt to help them out. However, it is during their attempt that Alya and Nora admit that they are half-sisters as Otis is not Nora's biological father. Then, Twig admits that he is going to miss Nora while she is in Shanghai, undergoing training with Marinette's great uncle Wang Cheng at the Thousand Delights restaurant, while Nora says something that Twig figures out is a fib, but after the kids leave, it is clear that Twig and Nora are still having trouble admitting their affection for each other as they return to work in the cafeteria's kitchen.

title: Sadnansi
text:
Sadnansi - Plot
In art class, Adrien asks Marinette about the portrait of Gabriel he asked her to work on, but she lies saying she was busy with other interests, which draws Alya's attention. When Alya asks her about it in the restroom later, Marinette tries to explain things to her, but admits she can't tell Adrien the truth. Alya suspects it is her secret identity as Ladybug, but Marinette admits that the lie she can't tell Adrien is really hurting her deep inside. Despite Alya's supportive advice, Marinette just can't bring herself to tell him the truth.
Alya comforts her as she cries.

title: Sadnansi
text:
Sadnansi - Plot
Back home, Marinette tries to tear up the portrait of Gabriel she was working on, but hesitates. Even with Tikki's support, Marinette keeps remembering Gabriel's last request and struggles with it. When she finally finishes a good sketch of Gabriel smiling, her guilt causes her to hallucinate as Gabriel urges her to continue lying instead of telling Adrien the truth, but Marinette struggles to do it, trying to tell the hallucination that she wants to tell Adrien the truth and have an honest relationship with him. When Tikki snaps her out of it, Marinette, after seeing her tears dripping on the portrait of Gabriel, now with a sad expression on his face, finally rips up her sketch of Gabriel in a fit of anger, deciding it is not time to tell Adrien the truth yet. However, she hears a crash outside, and sees that Nora has been akumatized again as the supervillain, Sadnansi, and is attacking people with her webbing, turning them into minions to further infect others with webbing as well. Suspecting this was the result of earlier with Twig, Marinette is encouraged by Tikki to transform and stop Sadnansi. Agreeing, Marinette tells Tikki "Spots On!" and transforms into Ladybug.

title: Sadnansi
text:
Sadnansi - Plot
At the Eiffel Tower, Sadnansi tries to pull it down, but Carapace arrives to catch it with Shell-ter so Ladybug can set it upright again. Sadnansi then tries to attack Ladybug, but she summons a Lucky Charm of an umbrella to block her webbing. When one nearly hits Ladybug when she lets her guard down, Cat Noir arrives to help her, and soon Rena Rouge arrives as well. While Cat Noir and Carapace keep Sadnansi busy, Rena and Ladybug speak privately about things before being reminded by the fight when Carapace protects them from more of Sadnansi's attacks.

title: Sadnansi
text:
Sadnansi - Plot
As the Miraculers regroup upon being attacked by all the affected citizens, after Ladybug uses another Lucky Charm of a bathtub to protect Cat Noir from the webbing, she later summons a third one of a boxing glove. Thanks to her Lucky Vision, she sees that Sadnansi is keeping her lowest left hand's fist clenched, indicating the akumatized object is being held there and they need to get her to drop it somehow. While Cat Noir and Carapace serve as a distraction, Ladybug and Rena go to the top of the Eiffel Tower after securing Twig, who was among the affected being under Sadnansi's control, and Rena uses her Mirage to summon an illusion of Twig that she threatens to drop off the Eiffel Tower. Sadnansi calls her bluff, and Rena lets the fake Twig go while summoning several more copies to confuse Sadnansi. Falling for it out of love for Twig, Sadnansi tries to save him, but in the process, has to let go of her carved rose to use all her arms. As a result, by the time she discovers the ruse when the illusions disperse, she is too late to prevent Cat Noir from destroying the object with Cataclysm, freeing the ultrakuma for Ladybug to catch and purify.

title: Sadnansi
text:
Sadnansi - Plot
Afterwards, Ladybug uses her Miraculous Ladybug to restore everyone to normal, and when Nora explains what happened, Twig admits his guilt in her akumatization, as a flashback reveals what happened in the moments before Nora was turned into Sadnansi, where she was so upset and heartbroken, it allowed the ultrakuma to infect the carved rose, and Twig could do nothing to stop it before Nora was turned into Sadnansi and made him one of her first minions. After Nora and Twig make amends, Ladybug gives Nora a Magical Charm, before turning back to Cat Noir, Carapace, and Rena Rouge, who notice Ladybug crying. She assures them she's fine before sharing a "Pound It!" fist-bump with them, before heading home.

title: Sadnansi
text:
Sadnansi - Plot
When Ladybug returns home, the scenes from the beginning of the episode play out again as Marinette powers down after retrieving Gabriel's letter to Adrien from her yo-yo, and with Tikki asking her what she'll do, Marinette decides to tell Adrien the truth now, and be there to support him in his grief. When she arrives at the mansion and is let in by Nathalie and Placide, she then reaches Adrien's room and attempts to tell him the truth, however, she sees Froggy on the bed, and once more can't bring herself to do it, instead saying with tears in her eyes that she loves Adrien and he gives her a reassuring hug.
In the stinger, Alya, as Rena Rouge, uses her Mirage to re-create the final battle between Bug Noire and Monarch regarding Gabriel's heroic sacrifice to end Monarch's threat, but keeps finding flaws in the way that Ladybug told the public about how Gabriel sacrificed himself to stop Monarch for good. However, she vows to keep trying until she figures out what really happened when Marinette faced down their first arch-enemy while Alya and The Resistance were dealing with the Miraculized army.

title: Sadnansi
text:
Sadnansi - Plot Developments
More about Alya and her family is revealed in this episode.
Nora and Alya share the same biological mother, but have different biological fathers. This means Otis is Nora's stepfather and that Alya, Ella and Etta are her half-sisters.
Nora is estranged with her biological father and considers Otis her real father. Since she has his last name, it is reasonable to assume that Otis adopted her to make her his legal child.
Alya learned about the fact she and Nora are half-sisters later in life, being more upset over the fact that someone else decided what was best for her rather than the truth itself.
It's likely that this was the complicated family issue that she mentioned in "Wreckless Driver".
This may also be the reason Alya wants to be a reporter to discover the truth and her dislike for (unnecessary) lies, seen in "Revelator" and the previous episode.
Nora is revealed to be very sensitive when it comes to love after she broke up from a past relationship with Kouki (previously seen in "Transmission"), with that preventing her from expressing her feelings to her co-worker, Twig, who is also in love with her.

title: Sadnansi
text:
Sadnansi - Plot Developments
It is revealed that Nora will be soon be heading to Shanghai and staying for a year to learn "Cook Fu" with Wang Cheng, Marinette's maternal great-uncle.
Marinette continues to be plagued by her lie regarding Gabriel Agreste's identity as Monarch to protect Adrien. She lied to him and the world at large in "Miraculous London" per Gabriel's request at the end of "Re-creation" and was plagued by this lie for the whole season, especially in episodes like "El Toro De Piedra", "Mister Agreste", "Revelator", "Heartfixer" and the previous episode, "Lady Chaos". By know Marinette got so emotionally overhelmed that she started to have hallucinations with Gabriel and tries to tell Adrien the truth about Gabriel in order to have a proper, honest relationship with Adrien, but she ends up losing her courage.
Adrien asks her if she started working on the portrait of the "good father" version of Gabriel, which he asked her to do to illustrate the image of the good man that Adrien came to believe Gabriel was; she tries to make a portrait, but ends having an emotional breakdown and hallucinations when trying to make Gabriel like harsh, cruel or sinister man he was.

title: Sadnansi
text:
Sadnansi - Plot Developments
Adrien asked Marinette to draw a portrait of the "good" Gabriel after Adrien's opinion of him changed for the better from the documentary he, Nino and Marinette did in the previous episode, "Lady Chaos". Unknown to Adrien (and Nino), the documentary was secretly sabotaged by Marinette so Adrien wouldn't become even more suspicious about the difference between the "hero" Gabriel and the man Adrien knew and come closer to finding out the truth.
Much like in "Mister Agreste" and "Heartfixer", Marinette wanted to tell Adrien the truth by giving him the letter Gabriel wrote and left for him in "El Toro De Piedra", and which she hid inside her yo-yo at the end of "Heartfixer". She took out the letter, but much like in the other episodes, didn't go through with it. While in "Mister Agreste," Nathalie stopped her by saying that it's too late to tell Adrien the truth, this time Marinette doesn't do it because, like in "Heartfixer", she was still not ready for Adrien to know the truth.

title: Sadnansi
text:
Sadnansi - Plot Developments
Marinette went back on her decision to reveal the truth to Adrien at the last moment because she saw the Papa Corn frog plushie she and Adrien found among his things in "El Toro De Piedra". which represents earlier times when Gabriel was more affectionate towards Adrien.
Marinette's guilt and hallucinating could be a result of how she starts to see that there are similarities between her and Gabriel, both superficial ones like both of them coming from a middle-class, culinary backround, having talent in fashion and falling in love with a person from a higher social class (Émilie for Gabriel and Adrien for Marinette), but also more profound similarities like them both doing everything they can to make the person they love the most happy (Gabriel continuing to take Émilie on trips to find the Peacock Miraculous so they could have a child and Marinette lying to Adrien so he could move on and be happy).
The guilt and hallucinations are also present because she feels stuck in a situation that's impossible, yet on the other hand it wasn't her responsibility to bare.

title: Sadnansi
text:
Sadnansi - Plot Developments
Alya realizes the secret Marinette is keeping from her, which she deduced and started researching at the end of "Revelator", has something to do with the final battle with Monarch (which happened in "Re-creation"), where Gabriel allegedly sacrificed himself to defeat him. In order to help her friend, she, as Rena Rouge, begins using her powers to simulate possibilities and find out what truly happened.
The wall in Adrien's bedroom is shown fully painted white. In all previous episodes, it was partially painted yellow and blue.

title: Sadnansi
text:
Sadnansi - Trivia
This is the second episode of season 6 in which Chrysalis doesn't appear in any way, after "The Chained Titans".
In Rena Rouge's mirages of the final battle with Monarch, there are several differences in Bug Noire's design:
The small green spots on her forearms are missing.
The red ribbons holding her braids have a different design.
Instead of being green with black paw prints, her soles are black with green paw prints.
The differences might be a result of Alya's imagination of what Bug Noire looks like based on Marinette's descriptions.
References
Nora's powers of mind-controlling people as Sadnansi are similar to those of Chloé Bourgeois as Miracle Queen in the eponymous episode, even down to the yellow eyes.
One of the Lucky Charms that Ladybug summons is a boxing glove, which was also the lucky charm object in the original "Anansi".
Her object being something she needed to always keep in her clenched fist is similar to Ivan Bruel while akumatized as Stoneheart in "Ladybug & Cat Noir" and "Stoneheart".
Like Stoneheart in the eponymous episode, Sadnansi was also defeated near the Eiffel Tower.

title: Sadnansi
text:
Sadnansi - Trivia
Rena Rouge having an illusion of Twig atop the Eiffel Tower, references Lila doing the same in "Volpina".
Marinette admitting to Alya, that she was right about keeping the truth, is a callback to "Revelator".
Her hallucinating while talking to a picture of Gabriel resembles the movie version of his reflection talking to him.
During the debate with herself, Marinette opted to break up with Adrien, if she couldn't have an honest relationship with him, the same she did with Luka in "Truth".
This episode holds a reference to "Re-creation", as Marinette pointed out they were both right as they wanted Adrien to be happy but they had different ways about it. As well as similar with Felix in "Strikeback", it didn't justify the way he went about it, as he endangered the lives of many others just to have his family back together. When all Gabriel really needed to do was appeal to the Miraculers and the guardians.
Errors
At one point while Marinette's drawing the portrait, a part of her hair passes through her forehead.
There are multiple errors in Rena Rouge's second mirage of the final battle:
Marinette has her leggings from her season 6 design.

title: Sadnansi
text:
Sadnansi - Trivia
Cat Miraculous is shown on Bug Noire's left index finger instead of the right ring finger.
The Bug Noire illusion has both of her hands on her head, but when Monarch pulled the Cat Miraculous off her finger, that hand was not touching her head. In the next shot, both of her hands are on her head again.
In the shot when the Bug Noire illusion detransformed into Marinette, the Cat Miraculous illusion was in the silver camouflage mode, but in the next shot facing Monarch, the Cat Miraculous illusion was black again.
When Ladybug swings her yo-yo towards the Eiffel Tower, the string goes through a metal bar.
When Rena Rouge uses her power for the second time in the post-credit scene, the Fox Miraculous sparkles for a few frames.
Rena Rouge's mirage of Twig was on her left side when trying to bait Sadnansi, but after Rena snaps her fingers for the illusion to fall, the next shot shows the illusion falling on her right side, and it is too far from its falling position.

title: Sadnansi/Transcript
text:
Sadnansi/Transcript - Intro
Tikki: What are you going to do, Marinette?
Marinette: I don't have a choice, Tikki. (wiping her tears) This letter from Gabriel holds the whole truth. If I want a relationship with Adrien that's built on authentic love and true honesty, I must give it to him. He must know the truth that his father was a supervillain who put the entire world in danger, (Illustration of Hawk Moth appears behind her.) and discover the causes of the illness that afflicted his mother (The illustration is now of Émilie Agreste surrounded by peacock feathers and a baby Adrien on top of a peacock feather.). That truth will make him suffer horribly, but I'll be there to comfort him and never lie to him ever again.
Tikki: How will you explain that Ladybug kept this from the entire world?
Marinette: I don't know, Tikki. Ladybug will figure it out, but I, Marinette, can't continue a relationship where I lie to the person I love most every day. If I can't tell Adrien the truth, then I'll have to break up with him.

title: Sadnansi/Transcript
text:
Sadnansi/Transcript - Intro
(She grabs her helmet and goes down from her room. She rides her mini scooter and arrives at the Agreste mansion. She presses the doorbell and Adrien's bodyguard opens the door for her. Nathalie watches Marinette as she enters the mansion with the same sad, anxious emotion on her face. She knocks on the door to Adrien's room, where Adrien is seen reading a book while holding his frog toy.)
Adrien: Come in! (Marinette enters the room.) Marinette?
Marinette: Adrien, I have something important to tell you.
(Scene fades to black.)
[ Theme Song ]
Nora: So, lovebirds, what will you be having this morning?
Marinette: Today's special?
Nora: You got it! Twig, four specials, please!
(A montage of Twig and Nora preparing their meals is shown, using cook fu to cut up fruit and put them on sticks before adding granola onto them.)
Nora: Açaí and seasonal fruit skewers, topped with crunchy granola!
Marinette: (gasps) You two are the best!
Nora: (performs a victory handshake with Twig, cracking the bones in his hand in the process) Nice job, Twig!
Twig: (bashfully) Well, I didn't do much.
Nino: You really make an awesome couple!

title: Sadnansi/Transcript
text:
Sadnansi/Transcript - Intro
(Nora immediately glares at Nino, as she was negatively taken aback by his remark.)
Nora: Who you callin' a couple, Cappie??
Nino: AH— No, I meant, you really make an awesome duo!
(He nervously chuckles and walks toward the table where Adrien, Marinette, and Alya are. Meanwhile, Twig places the hand that Nora held against his cheek.)
Nino: Okay, so we can all agree that something's going on between those two, right?
Alya: Totally agree, except my sister doesn't want to hear a peep about love. I mean, her ex, Kouki, was such a toxic dude.
Marinette: Sure, but Twig is super sweet and kind. Just look at the way she gazes at your sister!
(Scene briefly shows Twig lovingly gazing at Nora who is preparing meals for other students.)
Alya: I'm sure she likes him, too. They're always together even outside of work. He supports her in everything she does. He has endless admiration for her, and— and, most notable, my independent sister actually tolerates his presence. But... Nora will never say she's in love. I don't think she's even aware of her own feelings.

title: Sadnansi/Transcript
text:
Sadnansi/Transcript - Intro
(While Alya explains, the background shows shots of Twig supporting Nora while she's boxing, them canoeing together, and them at the movies together.)
Marinette: But she should be told! Love is what gives flavor to life's every meal! What's the point of making these fruity-licious skewers if you're going to eat them without love? What's the point of cook fu if you're not sharing the passion?!
Adrien: A cook-what?
Alya: Cook fu, a martial art that combines kung fu and cooking. It's all Nora could think about. She's actually going to Shanghai soon to get serious training.
Marinette: She'll be staying at my uncle Wang's for the year. (gasps in realization) She can't leave for a year without talking to Twig first!
Nino: But... has Twig told her about the way he feels?
Alya: Uh, I don't think so, no. He's way too shy.
Marinette: Oh! Maybe he just needs a hand! Nora can't say love but maybe she'll hear it!
Alya: Yeah, but it's too late already. Nora's leaving in a couple of days.
Marinette: It's never too late to express your love! Nino, give me your cap.
Nino: (confused) You want her to talk to my cap...?
Marinette: Kinda...?

title: Sadnansi/Transcript
text:
Sadnansi/Transcript - Intro
(Marinette sets her food tray aside and places Nino's cap before she rips a piece of paper into four pieces and draws something on them.)
Adrien: Are you going to tell us what you're up to or is it a surprise?
Marinette: I'm doing what they'll regret not having done if we do nothing.
(Some of the papers show a drawing of a mouth and an ear. Marinette takes a piece of paper and folds it into smaller pieces and puts them in Nino's cap. Time passes and the students are out of the cafeteria. Nora and Twig are seen cleaning. The Core Four tests out Marinette's plan. Nino gets the "mouth" while Adrien gets the "ear". Nora merely scoffs at their game. As Marinette notices that Nora noticed them, she commences the game.)
Marinette: Go ahead, begin! You tell Adrien something about you.
Nino: Like... that I'm Carapace?
(Adrien, Alya, and Marinette shush him.)
Alya: No! Something that everyone can hear.
Nino: (looks at Nora and realizes) Oh, right! I know! Cotton candy gives me the heebie-jeebies.
Adrien: Uhh, I'm kinda lost.
Marinette: You have the paper with the "ear" so you guess if it's a fib or not.
Adrien: (turns to look at Nino) A fib?
Nino: Wrong.
(Adrien is surprised.)

title: Sadnansi/Transcript
text:
Sadnansi/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: You sure you get the rules? Are you really scared of cotton candy, Nino?
Alya: Yep, he thinks it looks... deceptive.
Nino: (to Alya) You know me so well I can't hide anything from you.
Marinette: How can cotton candy look "deceptive"?
Adrien: It doesn't even have a face!
Nino: Precisely!
Nora: What are you flyweights still doing here? Don't you have class?
Marinette: (while collecting the pieces of paper) We have a free period so we're playing "Fib or No Fib" to get to know each other better. Want to play? (hands over the cap to Nora)
Nora: No way. Sounds like the cringiest game ever. (walks away)
Marinette: No, no, no, wait! It's, uh, traditional game in Shanghai! My Uncle Wang taught it to me. (Nora turns to look back) When you're there, you can be sure he'll want to play it with you.
Nora: Okay, you win, Baguette. (sits with them)
Marinette: But it requires an even number of players. Twig, will you play with us?
Twig: Oh! Uh, but I'm not done cleaning.
Nora: Don't sweat it, Twig. We'll finish up later. Besides, Baguette won't leave us alone 'til we play.

title: Sadnansi/Transcript
text:
Sadnansi/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (chuckles and adds two additional sheets of paper in Nino's cap) It's a great game, you'll see. (distributes the paper while everyone gets one paper each) So, first, everyone pulls a piece of paper from the cap. Alya, you got the "mouth", so you have to tell something about yourself to the person who got the "ear", a.k.a. me! (laughs) And I guess whether it's true or not. Good luck, girl, because you've already told me everything about your life. (smiles cockily)
(Scene pans to a deadpan Nora. Alya scoffs cockily as well.)
Alya: Ready? Nora's father is not my father.
Marinette: (laughs) Too easy. Fib!
Nora: Wrong, Baguette. My father is not her father, which is lucky for her. But her father is like a father to me, which is lucky for me.
(Nora winks at Alya, who winks back at her. Marinette is shocked.)
Alya: Technically, Nora is my half-sister. I never mentioned it because she's just my sister to me, that's all. But now's the perfect time because it means I won!
Marinette: (chuckles, confused) Yeah, right... Okay, fine. One point for you, and now we know each other even better! How amazing is this game! Let's play another round!

title: Sadnansi/Transcript
text:
Sadnansi/Transcript - Intro
(She distributes the paper around one more time. Seeing that Alya got the "ear", Marinette picks it up from her and hands it to Nora instead since...)
Marinette: The rules say that in the second round, you must hand over your paper twice on your right.
Nora: (sarcastically) Awesome game. Not convoluted at all. (turns to Twig) Alright, Twig, I'm listening.
(Scene focuses on Twig's paper, which shows that he picked up a "mouth".)
Marinette: Come on. If there's something you want to tell Nora, something you wanted to get off your chest for a while—something you'd regret never having told her if she were to leave—now is the time! Go on! This is a turning point in your life, Twig!
(Scene shows Twig getting really nervous... and finally gaining confidence.)
Twig: I really like you, Nora. I'm devastated you're leaving. But I'm very happy you're embarking on this adventure in Shanghai.
Nora: (shocked, almost speechless) Fib...?
Twig: Wrong.
(Nora's eyes widen. She really couldn't believe what she just heard.)
Marinette: Additional rule! If you get it wrong, you have to swap papers! (switches Nora and Twig's papers) Nora, it's your turn to tell something to Twig. Now, go, go, go!!

title: Sadnansi/Transcript
text:
Sadnansi/Transcript - Intro
Nora: I— I... You and me...? (looks away from Twig) Never in a million years!
(The kids all look shocked.)
Twig: (dejected but smiles and moves closer to Nora) Fib.
Nora: (turns her head at Twig) Correct.
(Alya, Marinette, Adrien and Nino smile at the situation.)
Marinette: Right! (picks up Nora and Twig's papers) Well, we'll leave you to it 'cause, you know, we have classes and all to learn lots of stuff that'll help us in our lives to come. So, anyway, bye! (exits the room with Nino, Alya, and Adrien, pushing them out with her)
(With Nora and Twig left in the room, they move closer to each other, seemingly about to share a kiss, but then pull away in the last minute, shy. Their eyes meet once again.)
Nora: (annoyingly) What?
Twig: Wha— What?
Nora: You're gawking at me, like all weird— like a raw fish!
Twig: Oh! Sorry... (looks away and smiles)
Nora: (shakes her head) Well, uh, anyway, uhm... the oven shelf isn't going to remove the grease by itself—
(Nora and Twig stand up and bump into each other's heads. They are both growing a lot more awkward with each other.)
Twig: Go ahead—
Nora: No, no, no! You go.
(The two of them walk back to the kitchen.)

title: Sadnansi/Transcript
text:
Sadnansi/Transcript - Intro
Alya: (in a scary voice, holding up a sketch of a cotton candy on a canvas) Nino, I'm a nice cotton candy!
Nino: Well, that one isn't scary.
(Alya and Nino share a laugh. Scene shows Marinette, who is also busy sketching. Adrien moves closer to check in on Marinette's drawing, which is a sketch of Alya and Nino from her point of view.)
Adrien: It's beautiful, Marinette!
Marinette: Thanks! (continues sketching)
Adrien: By the way, did you get a chance to work on my drawing?
Marinette: "Your" drawing? What drawing?
Adrien: You know, my father's portrait?
Marinette: Oh— Right! That drawing...
Adrien: It's so wonderful that the person I love the most can re-create the image of the secret hero my father really was! I can't wait to see the drawing!
Marinette: (gets all giddy and smiles nervously) Sure, me too! I can't wait! But I haven't had time yet 'cause I had... badminton practice... yesterday.
Adrien: Really? You didn't tell me you've taken up badminton.
Marinette: Oh, it was just a... trial practice, but it was awesome! Super fun...

title: Sadnansi/Transcript
text:
Sadnansi/Transcript - Intro
(Alya turns to look at Marinette, really getting suspicious of her excuses. Marinette sees that she got busted so she stops talking and continues drawing.)
Adrien: Maybe you'll have time tonight.
Marinette: No, no tonight... I'm giving figure skating a try.
(Alya is getting worried about the excuses.)
Adrien: You are?
Marinette: But I'll get on it, as soon as I have a free moment.
Adrien: Thank you, Marinette.
Alya: So, how was badminton yesterday?
(Marinette doesn't utter a word.)
Alya: Marinette, you and I spent last evening playing Ultimate Mecha Strike. Why are you feeding your boyfriend all this baloney?
Marinette: Because... I can't draw the portrait of his father that he asked me to.
Alya: Then, why don't you just tell him that?
Marinette: I'm scared he'll take it the wrong way, and I don't want to disappoint him.
Alya: Five minutes ago, you made up some silly game to stand for truth and love at all costs, and now, because you're afraid of disappointing Adrien, you totally lie to him? Whoa, girl, what's up with that?? You want to be practicing gymnastics instead of badminton because you're doing a mega split right now!

title: Sadnansi/Transcript
text:
Sadnansi/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: It's... more complicated than that. (reopens the faucet)
Alya: Okay, then explain away. I love complicated stuff.
Marinette: Yeah, well, it's easy for you to say. You and Nino tell each other everything. I just can't do that with Adrien.
Alya: I know it's a heavy burden to have to hide you're Ladybug from everyone, and especially from Adrien, but I don't see what this has to do with the whole portrait thing.
Marinette: (sighs) That's because it's not the point.
Alya: Huh? Then, what is it? I can't think of anything more complicated than having to hide your secret identity.
(The faucet turns off by itself.)
Marinette: I think our hands are pretty clean now. (walks to the hand dryer) Could we just forget about this whole convo, please?
Alya: Marinette, I'm your friend. I'm here if you need help. You know that, right?
Marinette: Even if I did share the secret with you, it wouldn't change anything. I'd still have to lie to Adrien! I just have to learn to live with it. There will always be this wall... between him and me. (tears stream down her cheeks)

title: Sadnansi/Transcript
text:
Sadnansi/Transcript - Intro
Alya: (eyebrows furrow with worry) For years, it was kept from me that Nora and I didn't have the same dad. When I found out, the only thing that really hurt wasn't the truth, but the fact that someone else had decided for me what was good for me, what I should or shouldn't know.
Marinette: I really wish I could tell him. Every day, it's on my lips but... I can't!
Alya: Marinette, I don't know what lie you've gotten yourself stuck in, but the truth always comes out in the end. So, what would you rather have happen: you being honest with Adrien, or him... eventually finding out on his own and realizing you betrayed him on top of lying?
Marinette: (wipes her tears) You're right. You always are. It's just... (bursts into tears and runs to Alya) It's so hard! (sobs)
Marinette: Adrien only wants this portrait so much because I've done everything to make him see his father as a good person—a hero. I suppose I could wait a few more days before I finally tell him the truth, and make the boy I love very, very sad, don't you think?
Tikki: (while holding her small cup of tea) I don't know, Marinette. What are you hoping to achieve by giving him this drawing?

title: Sadnansi/Transcript
text:
Sadnansi/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: One last image of the father he made peace with... (reveals more images of Gabriel on her desk under her notepad) before I ruin it forever.
(She begins to sketch Gabriel's face on the canvas. First, with a serious face, but she isn't satisfied with it, and so she erases it.)
Marinette: (sighs) No.
(She sketches another one again, this time, with Gabriel looking like he's smirking. She still isn't satisfied yet, like she's being mocked by her own sketch of Gabriel.)
Marinette: What do you want from me??
(She erases her drawing and sketches again. This time, Gabriel looks sad, frowning.)

title: Sadnansi/Transcript
text:
Sadnansi/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Don't look at me like that! (The same cycle happens.) "Marinette, make sure that Adrien never knows about the villain that I was, but instead that he remembers the times I tried to be a good father." Well, mission accomplished! (draws Gabriel with a serious expression) Adrien now believes that you were a hero in spite of all of the harm you caused. But soon, I'll reveal the truth! (mockingly, as Gabriel) "No, don't do it, Marinette. I'm begging you! You're going to cause so much pain to the person you love the most." (as herself, talking to her Gabriel portrait) Yes, I know! But because of you, I can't have a simple... loving... relationship! Even gone, you keep hurting us! (draws Gabriel with a stern expression) I can't give you these eyes. Adrien wants to forget about that man, the cruel father that you were, the father who only opened his mouth to criticize, humiliate, control. "Adrien, you're fencing. Adrien, your piano. Adrien, go live in London on your own, away from all your friends and the girl you love!"
(Finally, Marinette draws Gabriel with a calm expression.)
Marinette: There. This is the father that Adrien wants to see. But has he ever even... existed?

title: Sadnansi/Transcript
text:
Sadnansi/Transcript - Intro
Gabriel: (as the sketch in the portrait) Of course, he existed.
Marinette: AH! (jumps from her chair)
Gabriel: (as the sketch in the portrait) I was the man in tears over not having a child with the woman he loved. The father who traveled the world looking for the Peacock Miraculous. (The hallucination shows Gabriel and young Adrien at the bedside where an ill Emilie is lying.) The father who was crushed when the mother of his beloved son became ill. (The hallucination shows Monarch carrying an unconscious Émilie in his arms.) I was the father who became Hawk Moth in order to save the woman he loved and give back Adrien the mother he deserved. You and I are the same, Marinette. You said it yourself on the final day we faced each other. (Marinette starts walking backward and bumps into a mirror, seeing a reflection of Gabriel in it.) We both want the same thing. (The Gabriel reflection shows a picture frame containing a photo of her and Adrien.) We want Adrien to be happy.
Marinette: No, no! I'm not like you! I don't want to lie to him anymore!

title: Sadnansi/Transcript
text:
Sadnansi/Transcript - Intro
Gabriel: (in the mirror, his voice coming out of a reflection of Marinette) Yes, a lie's a heavy burden to keep secret, but that truth will only become one if you talk. I was willing to do anything to ensure my son's happiness. If you truly love him, you'll find the strength to lie.
Marinette: Be quiet!!! Adrien deserves sincere and honest love. (drops to her knees and cries) I love Adrien! I love him so much!
Tikki: Marinette! Marinette!!
(Back to reality, Marinette's tears drop on her Gabriel portrait. Marinette then immediately and angrily tears the canvas into two... and to even smaller pieces and throws them on the floor. Just then, a sound of vehicles crashing into one another is heard outside their house, much to Marinette's alert. Marinette looks out the window and sees Parisians escaping a bus.)
Sadnansi: Don't worry, Sadnansi will set you all free! Love is like poison to the heart!!
(She lands on the concrete and sees a scared couple. She spits two drops of her venom and hits the couple, making them hate each other. Those two people wreak havoc on other Parisians, spitting venom on them, too. The army continues to multiply...)

title: Sadnansi/Transcript
text:
Sadnansi/Transcript - Intro
Sadnansi: Soon, no one will love anyone anymore! And nobody will suffer ever again!!!
Marinette: Sadnansi?
Tikki: Did Nora get akumatized again?
Marinette: (gasps) Shoot. I guess she wasn't ready to find out that Twig likes her. What if Adrien isn't ready either? What if he doesn't want to hear the truth??
(A loud bang stops her rambling.)
Tikki: Marinette, don't you think we should go?
Marinette: Yes, of course. Tikki, spots on! (transforms into Ladybug)
Sadnansi: Since Paris is the City of Love, let's destroy Paris!
(She pulls on her web to bring the tower down. Just right before the Eiffel Tower crashes down, Carapace arrives at the scene.)
Carapace: Shell-ter!
(He throws a shield above the buildings to keep the tower from crashing. Ladybug arrives at the scene as well. With her yo-yo, she pulls the Eiffel Tower up back in its place.)
Ladybug: Love isn't destroyed so easily, Sadnansi!
Sadnansi: What do you know about love, Beetle?! (spits venom at Ladybug)
Ladybug: Lucky Charm! (gets an umbrella and blocks the venom) Love is the most beautiful thing in the world!
Sadnansi: Really? You think it's so simple?? Love is a burden. Let me show you how easy life is without it!!

title: Sadnansi/Transcript
text:
Sadnansi/Transcript - Intro
(Ladybug completely freezes up from that sentiment, and Sadnansi takes the opportunity to spit venom at her. But before the venom lands on her, Cat Noir saves her by using his...)
Cat Noir: Cataclysm!! (catches and destroys the venom) Mind your heart, m'lady!
Sadnansi: Mr. Whiskers, come face me if you dare!
Cat Noir: I'm always down for stretching my paws! (runs toward Sadnansi)
(Rena Rouge arrives and lands beside Ladybug.)
Rena Rouge: Everything okay?
Ladybug: Yes, only— what if Sadnansi's right? It's probably easier to do what's right when you're not burdened by love.
Rena Rouge: Huh? Are you seriously willing to give up on love?
Ladybug: I don't want to give up on it. But if I stopped loving you-know-who, maybe I'd have the courage to do what's best for him.
Rena Rouge: Don't you think that maybe love shows us the way?
(Before they even see it, drops of venom are headed their way.)
Carapace: Shell-ter! (shields Rena and Ladybug) What are you doing?? (shows him and Cat Noir fighting Sadnansi from afar)
Rena Rouge: We're coming! Thanks, Carapace! (to Ladybug) Come on, girl. Get a grip!
Ladybug: (sighs) Thanks.

title: Sadnansi/Transcript
text:
Sadnansi/Transcript - Intro
(Rena Rouge and Ladybug join the battle. Meanwhile, Cat Noir is about to hit his Staff on Sadnansi, along with Carapace with his Shield, but they fail as she punches them and sends them flying away from her. Sadnansi fires venom again, at Cat Noir this time, but is saved by Ladybug using a lucky charm bathtub as protection over him.)
Ladybug: Lucky Charm! Missed by a whisker, Kitty Cat.
Cat Noir: Thanks for the helping paw, m'lady!
(Sadnansi continues to fire venom at Ladybug. Ladybug hurls her yo-yo at the villain but is blocked. Carapace plans to hit but misses. Rena Rouge jumps in to attack but fails as well. The heroes continue to battle Sadnansi but then begin to be cornered by people affected by Sadnansi's venom. Carapace continues to take hits from Sadnansi, using his shield to protect himself. Victims are coming from behind Carapace as well. They are continuously cornered now into a smaller space as the victims continue to spit venom at them.)
Ladybug: It's time for us to rise!
(The four heroes escape to the top of the Eiffel Tower.)
Rena Rouge: (through Ladybug's comms) We've got to find the akumatized item and quick before love disappears from Paris for good!

title: Sadnansi/Transcript
text:
Sadnansi/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: Trouble is that a six-armed supervillain is keeping us out of reach.
Carapace: Six-armed and a martial arts champion!
(Sadnansi crawls up the Eiffel Tower.)
Ladybug: (through Cat Noir's comms) We have more than six arms between the four of us.
Cat Noir: We don't have as many allies as she does.
(Victims of Sadnansi step out the Eiffel Tower's elevator.)
Ladybug: Maybe, but we have the...
[Superpower Sequence]
Ladybug: Lucky Charm!
(A boxing glove appears.)
Ladybug: A boxing glove?
(Using her vision, Ladybug sees that one of Sadnansi's hands is closed. Realizing this, she swings away before Sadnansi gets to her.)
Ladybug: She's keeping a fist closed. The akumatized object must be inside!
Rena Rouge: Let's find a way to make her unclench it.
(Ladybug continues to evade Sadnansi's rain of venom. The other heroes continue to distract Sadnansi. Carapace throws his shield and cuts off Sadnansi's web, causing her to fall down and crash onto the ground.)
Sadnansi: No more messing around! (whistles to call out her victims to gather around them) It's the final round!!
(The heroes are once again cornered.)
Cat Noir: Friends, have I ever told you that I love you?

title: Sadnansi/Transcript
text:
Sadnansi/Transcript - Intro
Carapace: You were always too sentimental, Cat Noir.
Ladybug: No way! (sees a venom-induced Twig amongst the crowd) You can never be too sentimental. Love shows us the way. (to Rena Rouge) You're right, as always. (to Carapace and Cat Noir) We need you guys to create a diversion.
(The boys agree and flee.)
Carapace: Shell-ter!
(Puts a shield around himself and Cat Noir as they run into the crowd.)
(The girls go the other way. Ladybug hurls her yo-yo and wraps it around Twig. She and Rena Rouge rush up the tower to bait Sadnansi.)
Rena Rouge: Mirage! (creates an illusion—a clone of Twig, she and the illusion walk to the railing) Hey, Spider! What would you do if the man you supposedly don't love was about to fall from a great height?
Sadnansi: A superhero would never allow that. She'd never put an innocent person in danger. I know what your power is. This is an illusion! You're bluffing!!

title: Sadnansi/Transcript
text:
Sadnansi/Transcript - Intro
Rena Rouge: Are you sure? Maybe I'm like you and I love no one! (snaps her fingers behind the illusion and the illusion of Twig falls down) So, who do you think is bluffing? (Twig's illusion turns into multiple copies of Twig illusions, which successfully baits Sadnansi into thinking she's only just used her power.)
Sadnansi: (lunges and jumps to catch the "Twigs") Twig!!
(Finally, her closed fist opens, and the akumatized object falls out from her hand. As the "Twigs" come into contact with her hands, the illusions disappear. Sadnansi realizes it too late, and so she falls back down to the ground.)
Cat Noir: Dinner is served. Cataclysm! (picks up the akumatized carved rose, sending the Ultrakuma out of the object. Ladybug gets back down to the ground with Twig in one of her arms.)
[Superpower Sequence]
Ladybug: No more evildoing for you, Ultrakuma! (opens her yo-yo) Time to de-evilize! (catches the Ultrakuma) Gotcha! (re-opens her yo-yo to release the purified butterfly) Bye-bye, little butterfly!
(As the Ultrakuma is purified, Sadnansi transforms back to her normal self, Nora.)
[Superpower Sequence]
Ladybug: Miraculous Ladybug!

title: Sadnansi/Transcript
text:
Sadnansi/Transcript - Intro
(She throws the boxing glove in the air and reverts all the damage caused by the villain.)
Ladybug: (seeing the small rose trinket in Nora's hand) It looks so pretty. Did you carve it?
Nora: No. (looks up at Twig) It was a gift.
Twig: This whole thing was my fault. I'm sorry.
Twig: Is something wrong? (attempts to comfort Nora)
Nora: 'Course not, it's the onions! And you, too, messing with my head. You couldn't keep your lovey-dovey feelings to yourself. Things were perfectly fine before, back when we didn't tell each other anything. Now it's going to be the biggest headache ever!
Twig: But didn't it make you feel good to tell the things we told each other?
Nora: Feel good?? Before we talked, I was sad about leaving because I was going to miss you and your face, but I thought of cook fu and it passed! But now that I know we like each other, what do I do? If I go to Shanghai, I'll think of you the whole time and it's going to hurt like crazy! But if I stay, I'll regret not going to Shanghai every time I see you. You're a pain, Twig, and these onions are a pain, too!!
Twig: Those aren't onions, Nora. They're carrots.
Nora: (upset) Watch it, Twig.

title: Sadnansi/Transcript
text:
Sadnansi/Transcript - Intro
Twig: (takes Nora's hand to give her the rose trinket) I'm sorry.
(Nora only becomes more emotional upon receiving the gift. An Ultrakuma is then seen flying towards Nora and inhabiting the rose trinket.)
Twig: And then Nora transformed into Sadnansi. I shouldn't have told you how I felt.
Nora: Don't sweat it, Twig. The truth is I would've hurt in Shanghai without you. I just didn't want to see it, is all.
Twig: Maybe... we can call each other when you're there?
Nora: Yeah. Totally! And you can even come and visit me? (clears her throat) I mean, if you have nothing else to do.
Twig: (takes Nora's hand) I'd love to come visit you.
Nora: (hugs Twig) I'm going to miss you!
Twig: You'll come back eventually.
(Ladybug walks to Nora and gives her a Magical Charm.)
Ladybug: This Magical Charm will remind you that some truths are hard to hear but must be told. Your love had the courage to be sincere. Good job to both of you.
(She turns around. A tear is seen falling down her cheek.)
Cat Noir: You okay, m'lady?
(Ladybug nods and wipes her tears.)
The Miraculers: Pound it!
(Ladybug swings away, still feeling emotional.)

title: Sadnansi/Transcript
text:
Sadnansi/Transcript - Intro
(She opens her yo-yo and pulls out the letter from Gabriel to Adrien. Ladybug detransforms into Marinette.)
Tikki: What are you going to do, Marinette?
Marinette: I don't have a choice, Tikki. (wiping her tears) This letter from Gabriel holds the whole truth. If I want a relationship with Adrien that's built on authentic love and true honesty, I must give it to him. He must know the truth that his father was a supervillain who put the entire world in danger and discover the causes of the illness that afflicted his mother. That truth will make him suffer horribly, but I'll be there to comfort him and never lie to him ever again.
(Nathalie watches Marinette as she enters the mansion with the same sad, anxious emotion on her face. She knocks on the door to Adrien's room, where Adrien is seen reading a book while holding his frog toy.)
Adrien: Come in! (Marinette enters the room.) Marinette?
Marinette: Adrien, I have something important to tell you.

title: Sadnansi/Transcript
text:
Sadnansi/Transcript - Intro
(Adrien stands up from his bed and walks to Marinette. As he approaches her, Marinette can't help but notice the frog toy on Adrien's bed, which makes her feel a wave of hesitation once again. As Adrien stands before Marinette, she bursts into tears once more.)
Marinette: I love you, Adrien, I love you so much.
(Yet another truth untold. Adrien holds Marinette in his arms and embraces her, in which Marinette is quite hesitant to return but embraces Adrien anyway.)
Rena Rouge: (groans) That's not it. If Bug Noire's there, it means Monarch can't be wearing the Ladybug earrings. Marinette can't draw the portrait of Gabriel Agreste because her secret has something to do with Adrien's dad. (makes the illusion disappear) If I want to help her, I have to figure out what she's keeping to herself first. Mirage! (creates another simulation of Bug Noire and Monarch's battle) And with a secret that heavy, it's got to be connected to the day he died.

title: Sadnansi/Transcript
text:
Sadnansi/Transcript - Intro
(In the simulation, Monarch succeeds in taking the ladybug and black cat Miraculous from Bug Noire. Gabriel attempts to stop Monarch by surprise attacking him from behind, but Monarch turns around and kicks him away. Rena Rouge makes the illusion disappear and tries again one more time.)
Rena Rouge: Mirage! (creates another simulation) I'll find out sooner or later.

title: Sam
text:
Sam - Intro
is a minor character from Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir, introduced in season 6.
In "Grendiaper", after being humiliated by Fury for intentionally making babies cry, Sam was akumatized by Chrysalis into Grendiaper, a supervillain who controlled a giant baby-themed robot equipped with rattle-like missiles, supersonic screams, and laser eyes. He later received a Magical Charm from Ladybug that prevented him from being akumatized again.

title: Sam
text:
Sam - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Sam is a slender boy with short, deep blue straight hair, dark brown eyes, and full pink lips.
Civilian Attire
Sam wears a red hoodie with green flame patterns on the sleeves, loose gray cargo shorts, and sneakers featuring blue, yellow, and white details. Underneath, he wears a red T-shirt.
As Grendiaper
Grendiaper wore a black suit with hexagonal padding. It featured red armor plating on the chest and a gold frame in the middle, yellow shoulder pads resembling pacifiers, and two gold ring-shaped bracelets on each wrist. He had a white diaper-like piece around his waist that was not as prominent as that he was put in in his civilian outfit. He wore a red helmet with a yellow upper half resembling a pacifier, black transparent visors, and gold ear pieces. He also possessed a lolipop turret.

title: Sam
text:
Sam - Appearance
He controlled a large mech, which was mainly black in color. Its inner chest was red with gold trim, with red shoulder pauldrons and yellow, orange, green, and blue rings covering the forearm below. The abdomen of it was yellow with a diaper structure. It also had red armor around its wrists and palms, the wrists featuring round appendages. The head was framed by a sharpened deep blue section, pointing to the middle of its face with yellow spikes at the sides, a big red and yellow pacifier as its mouth, a red triangular section on top of its head with a forked piece above, and a large yellow ring jutting out with a blue piece in the middle to further resemble a pacifier. Its eyes were angular in shape and emitted a brilliant pastel yellow light.

title: Sam
text:
Sam - Personality
Sam is jealous of his youngest sister due to her taking away all the attention from him, which fuels his dislike of babies and tendency toward mischief, including making babies cry on purpose and cutting off his baby sister's diapers. His public humiliation by Fury traumatized him, intensifying his aggressive and immature tendencies. After his de-akumatization, he showed no gratitude towards the heroes and was not interested in changing his behavior. Fortunately, Cat Noir lectures him into promising to behave better, even if that might not happen because of his trauma.
As Grendiaper, his behavior was more immature and childlike than usual, indicating emotional distress or regression, thus causing him to act like a baby. He was determined to find the vigilante who humiliated him.

title: Sam
text:
Sam - Abilities
As a Civilian
As a civilian, Sam could irritate babies with loud music and tamper with his sister's diapers.
As Grendiaper
As Grendiaper, he could control a giant baby-themed robot, launch rattle-like missiles, emit destructive supersonic screams, and fire laser beams from its eyes. He could also use his phone as if it was a projector. His robot is implied to be powerful enough to damage Miraculouses, proven when Chrysalis warned him to be careful not to damage them before he would seize them.

title: Sam
text:
Sam - Relationships
Family
Father & Mother
This couple are Sam’s parents, whom he resents because, since the birth of his sisters—especially Sofia, the youngest—he feels that they only care about the babies and have forgotten about him. Because of this, he often takes out his anger by damaging the things they buy, such as Sofia’s diapers.
Maya
Maya is Sam’s younger sister. Since their sister Sofia was born, their relationship has become tense, as Sam has grown increasingly cruel, believing his family has neglected him because of the baby. As a result, he often has angry outbursts, like when he yelled at Maya for asking if he had seen Sofia’s diapers that their mother was looking for. Because of this behavior, Maya thinks her brother is acting more like a whiny baby than their sister.
Sofia

title: Sam
text:
Sam - Relationships
Sofia is Sam’s youngest sister. Since she was born, Sam has hated her because he believes his family only cares about babies and has neglected him because of that. As a result, he often takes out his anger by breaking her things, such as her diapers, claiming she should use the toilet. His hatred toward her has grown into a general dislike for babies, to the point where he enjoys bothering them in the streets just to make them cry.
Acquaintances
Zoé Lee/Vesperia/Fury
Sam first met Zoé in "Grendiaper", where she scolded him for intentionally waking a nearby baby up with loud music. He ignores her as she and Sabrina lead the mother and her baby to another seat.
Unbeknownst to him, Zoé was also the superhero Vesperia, who after becoming the vigilante Fury, decided to teach Sam a lesson by paralyzing him and dressing him up as a baby to publicly humiliate him, leading to his akumatization. He was determined to find Fury to get back at her for his humiliation.
After being deakumatized, he was told off by Vesperia, who agreed with Fury's actions, but she backed down when Ladybug and Cat Noir firmly told him he should stop his bullying ways.
The Miraculers
TBA

title: Sam
text:
Sam - Etymology
The name Sam is Hebrew origin deriving from the name may "Samuel" meaning "name of God" or "God has heard". It can also derived from "Samson" meaning "sun" or "like the sun".
Since his sister shares her name with Autodesk Maya, the engine which was used to animate the first five seasons of the series, it's possible his name is a reference to SAMG Animation, the Korean animation studio which worked on the first five seasons.

title: Sam
text:
Sam - Trivia
Sam is the second member of his family to be akumatized, after his younger sister Maya.
However, this can only be said production-wise, as "Grendiaper" chronologically takes place before "The Illustrhater".
Sam's akumatized form, Grendiaper, references the 1975 mecha anime UFO Robot Grendizer, also known as the third entry of the Mazinger Z series.
The same way his sister Maya shares her name with the engine previously used to animate the show (Autodesk Maya), Sam could have been named after SAMG Animation, the main animation studio of the first saga.

title: Saint Basil's Cathedral
text:
Saint Basil's Cathedral - Intro
(Собор Василия Блаженного), or Cathedral of the Intercession of the Mother of Jesus on the Moat (Собор Покрова Пресвятой Богородицы, что на Рву), is an Eastern Orthodox cathedral located on the Red Square in Moscow, and is one of the most popular cultural symbols of Russia.

title: Saint Basil's Cathedral
text:
Saint Basil's Cathedral - Description
Built in 1561, St. Basil's Cathedral is located southwest of Red Square, east of the Spasskaya, Tsarskaya and Nabatnaya towers of the Moscow Kremlin wall. It stands 65 meters tall.
The cathedral is adorned with nine main domes and another on the bell tower, each distinguished by its shape, ornamentation, and vibrant colors. The building itself is primarily constructed of red brick, often left exposed.
The square main church is surmounted by an octagon that tapers towards the top and is crowned by a gilded dome. Four medium-sized octagonal towers surround the main church, oriented towards the four cardinal points. The four smaller towers are square and interspersed between the medium-sized towers, giving the building an eight-pointed star shape.
The cathedral consists of nine chapels (Saint Basil, Holy Trinity, Three Patriarchs, Alexander Svirsky, Cyprian and Justina, Saint Nikola Velikoretsky, Varlaam Khutynsky, Saint Gregory of Armenia, and Palm Sunday) surrounding the main and central church of the Intercession of the Most Holy Mother of God.

title: Saint Basil's Cathedral
text:
Saint Basil's Cathedral - Description
A little further away, an eleventh chapel, Saint John the Blessed, is located beneath the bell tower and the belfry. This one houses the relics of Saint John.

title: Saint Basil's Cathedral
text:
Saint Basil's Cathedral - Trivia
St. Basil's Cathedral has been a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1990. under the title "The Kremlin and Red Square, Moscow".

title: Science classroom
text:
Science classroom - Intro
The  is a lab classroom at Collège Françoise Dupont where Olga Mendeleiev teaches math and science.

title: Science classroom
text:
Science classroom - Appearance
Classroom
The floor is green and white checkerboard patterned. There are ten wooden workbenches with gray counter tops with a lip in front. Each bench has two black rolling stools. The far left of each bench has a white sink with a metal spout, and below each sink are two white drawers.
The walls are composed of small white tiles and large off-white bricks. At the very bottom of the walls, there are about six inches of exposed gray stone. The next three feet are tiled with white squares. The rest is made of off-white stones with molded panels in the center: a row of medium rectangles, and above that, a large rectangle spanning the wall's width. At the very top of each wall is a row of small rectangles with scalloped bottoms. The ceiling is stone with beams that make a grid (also known as coffered).
Front

title: Science classroom
text:
Science classroom - Appearance
At the front of the classroom is a green sliding chalkboard with a light brown wood border. The chalkboard always seems to have complicated (if not nonsensical) writing on it. To the right of the chalkboard is a dark oak door. Ms. Mendeleiev has a light oak desk with a sink identical to the students' on its far left. Normally, during school hours, various scientific tools sit on top. The whole desk is elevated on a platform, and there is also a trashcan on the floor next to the desk.
Sides
The wall on the left (when facing front) has a window with black grilles that shows the nearby stairs outside the room. Next to that window is a light oak door (the exit/entrance to the classroom) with a metal handle. There is a large window above this door. To the left of that door are more windows along the wall, showing out into the central courtyard. These windows also have black grilles. Just below the window sill are the white tiles mentioned earlier. The wall to the right of the chalkboard has large windows showing Paris. These windows have vertical brown grilles.
Back

title: Science classroom
text:
Science classroom - Appearance
The back wall has a dark oak door on the right, just before it meets with the left wall. This wall has the same design as the others, but has a periodic table of elements framed in black on the top left. The center of the wall has an assortment of sticky notes pasted to it.

title: Science classroom
text:
Science classroom - Trivia
The dark oak door to the right of the chalkboard is shown to also be an entrance/exit in "Princess Fragrance", with Marinette entering through it and Rose seen heading toward it to leave the room, as well as Nathaniel likewise heading toward it in "The Evillustrator".
In the center of the chalkboard, behind where Ms. Mendeleiev usually stands, it says SAYLOVE with "LOVE" circled.

title: Sasuke Sarutobi
text:
Sasuke Sarutobi - Intro
(猿飛佐助) was a ninja who appears in kōdan narrative art and fictional writings. He was also a past Miraculous holder, wielding the Monkey Miraculous and transforming into a monkey-themed superhero when Xuppu inhabited it.

title: Sasuke Sarutobi
text:
Sasuke Sarutobi - Abilities
If this past Monkey Miraculous holder had the same powers as the current Monkey Miraculous holder (Kim), he had enhanced abilities and the superpower Uproar, and the Ruyi Jingu Bang as a tool.

title: Sasuke Sarutobi
text:
Sasuke Sarutobi - Trivia
When asked if Sasuke Sarutobi was a former Monkey Miraculous holder, Thomas Astruc responded, "Most certainly."
Sasuke is a generic given name for a ninja, while his family name, Sarutobi, means "monkey jump" in Japanese.

title: Scarybug
text:
Scarybug - Intro
"" is the seventh episode of the Miraculous Chibi short series. It  premiered on October 26, 2018, on the official Miraculous Chibi YouTube channel.

title: Scarybug
text:
Scarybug - Synopsis
It's Halloween in Paris, and Cat Noir is determined to scare Ladybug. But the superheroine has not said her last word!

title: Scarybug
text:
Scarybug - Trivia
This is the first Halloween-themed animated media for the franchise.
The scene when Ladybug jumps down from the Eiffel Tower and leaps from rooftop to rooftop is a recycled animation from "Rooftop Dinner" and "The Chase".
The Eiffel Tower is shown to be decorated for Halloween.
The French title for this episode is "Ladybouh" (a pun on the words "ladybug" and "boo").

title: Season 7
text:
Season 7 - Intro
The seventh season of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir is in production. It will consist of 26 episodes and is set to premiere on November 14, 2026, via Disney Channel in various European and Middle Eastern countries.

title: Season 7
text:
Season 7 - Overview
First synopsis
In the first episodes of season 7, Marinette's personal life is turned upside down: she discovers new allies she can rely on and talk to more openly than ever before. Unfortunately for her, she also learns that some people around her aren't who they seem and could betray her at the first opportunity. Meanwhile her relationship with Adrien takes a new turn: no longer able to keep secrets from him, Marinette makes the difficult decision to reveal the unthinkable to her lifelong love…
Second synopsis
New heroes. New powers. New enemies.
The Miraculous universe will never be the same again. Faced with the greatest threats ever seen, Ladybug and Cat Noir will have to push beyond their limits to protect the world.

title: Season 6
text:
Season 6 - Intro
The sixth season of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir consists of 26 episodes. It premiered on January 24, 2025, via Gloob in Brazil, and ended on August 8, 2026 via Disney Channel in the USA. This is the first season of the second story arc, after the Agreste family arc which ended in Season 5.

title: Season 6
text:
Season 6 - Overview
After Hawk Moth's disappearance, a new cycle begins.
Ladybug and Cat Noir must face a new enemy – mysterious, worrying, elusive, and yet close to them. Very close, but they have no idea.
Marinette and Adrien too have never been so close to each other, but that does not necessarily make their everyday life a bed of roses, for they keep secrets from each other. The biggest secret being that they still do not know that they are Ladybug and Cat Noir.
In a new and exemplary green Paris, in the heart of a new and revolutionary school, our heroes are about to experience a school year full of emotions and revelations.

title: Season 6
text:
Season 6 - Trivia
For this season, the writing team of the previous four seasons (Thomas Astruc, Mélanie Duval, Frédéric/que Engel Lenoir, and Sébastien Thibaudeau) wrote the narrative arcs, while the scripts were written by Astruc, Thibaudeau, and usually one new writer. According to the ISAN registry:
Caroline Torelli wrote "The Illustrhater", "El Toro De Piedra", "Revelator", "Noe", "The Dirtifiers", "Sadnansi", and "Nemesis".
Pierre Doublier wrote "Daddycop", "Vampigami", "Mister Agreste", "The Ruler", "Heartfixer", "Queen of the Dreadzone" and "Secret Protocol".
Camélia Acef wrote "Sleeping Syren", "Wreckless Driver", "The Dirtifiers" and "Nemesis".
Manuel Meyre wrote "The Dark Castle", "A Fairy Good Night", "The Chained Titans" and "Secret Protocol".
Chloé Paye wrote "Grendiaper", "The Dirtifiers", "Riginarazione", "Lady Chaos" and "Nemesis".
Jean-Rémi Perrin, who had written an episode in both seasons 2 and 3, wrote "Sublimation".
Wilfried Pain, who had written an episode in both seasons 2 and 3, wrote "Yaksi Gozen".
No one co-wrote with Astruc and Thibaudeau for "Climatiqueen" and "Werepapas".

title: Season 6
text:
Season 6 - Trivia
This season and onwards are animated with Epic's Unreal Engine instead of Autodesk Maya. As a result, the crew is also no longer outsourcing the animation to other studios like SAMG Animation in South Korea or Assemblage Entertainment in India. The episodes are now animated in-house in France.
According to Thomas Astruc, it's necessary because the original assets from Season 1 to Season 5 don't work anymore with newer versions of Maya.
This season took the longest to premiere compared to all previous seasons, with more than eighteen months passing between the first and last episodes' international premieres. According to Thomas Astruc, there were technical issues related to the switch to Unreal Engine which slowed down the production, but they were solved over time.
Due to the long production period, there are noticeable differences in the animation assets seen in the episodes, something which almost never occurred in the previous seasons. These differences include:
Slight changes in some colors and textures in characters' models, such as Nathalie's glasses, King Monkey's mask and Trixx's tail.

title: Season 6
text:
Season 6 - Trivia
Additional special effects or impact frames in power sequences, primarily in Ladybug's Lucky Charm, De-evilize and Magical Charm sequences.
Changes in decorations and other background details, usually in Marinette's room, namely the photo wall and the elements of her secret protocol.
Starting from this season, cold openings are used instead of the theme song playing immediately at the beginning of the episode.
Furthermore, every episode has a post-end card scene, except "Riginarazione".
The end credits also feature all of The Miraculers, unlike the end credits of the previous five seasons.
This is the first season that does not have a two-part special.
According to Thomas Astruc, all episodes are standalone one-parters.
This is the first season in which Cat Noir's Cataclysm sequence is entirely absent.
In the USA, this was the first season to premiere on Disney XD alongside Disney Channel.
