title: Sass/History
text:
Sass/History - Intro
Sass is the kwami connected to the Snake Miraculous, where he is currently with Luka Couffaine to transform into Viperion and temporarily Adrien Agreste into Aspik. Sass is the kwami connected to the Snake Miraculous.

title: Sass/History
text:
Sass/History - Before [[season 1]]
After the universe was created 13.8 billion years ago and the idea of creation came into existence along with Tikki, not long after she came, so did the concept of Intuition came into existence, so did Sass and at first unknown to him along with the first universe many others were created. After more concepts and ideas were brought into the universe, Sass was given her kwami siblings then through some unknown events the kwamis discovered the existence of the billions of parallel universes and due to their concepts being so abstract they came across different versions of themselves as well as discovered that they lived simultaneously in all of them sharing a mind link gaining the knowledge and memories of each other. And yet, they made it their pact that due to them living for so long unless in an emergency or crisis they chose not to bring up complexity of parallel universes to their owners knowing that they wouldn't have enough time to explain the smallest bit about it so they all agreed to stick with the basics of living in their own universes with them. But still used the memories and knowledge of their massive experiences to guide them and their owners through.

title: Sass/History
text:
Sass/History - Before [[season 1]]
Regardless for countless eons they traveled throughout the universe until they made their way to Earth. However, they discovered two things: one, they couldn't be seen by any living beings and two when Fluff and the others discovered their powers their lack of control resulted in disaster usually with Sass pulling various people and things across time to the point he traveled too. Until one day, in ancient China, they met a mage who crafted his Miraculous, allowing him to maintain a physical appearance. But before their jewels and physical form were obtained Sass and his kwami family began to grow when the Prodigious was created giving them their cousins the Renlings, however an unknown incident caused the jewel and their renling cousins to sealed yet guarded by Mei Shi and the Renren guardians. For over 5,000 years, Fluff helped people transform into superheroes in order to save the world.

title: Sass/History
text:
Sass/History - Before [[season 1]]
She and many of her siblings started in China where her first owner became She and through her as well as other civilians, Sass and his siblings began discovering the basics of their powers. During one of their many adventures, Sass and his owners made another interesting discovery their powers can altered to include elemental abilities through Miraculous Potions but were never allowed to know the contents as well as witness the creation of the Miraculous spellbook but couldn't read it. In their earlier adventures, Sass and the kwamis began to treasure the bonds they had with their owners creating the tradition of the kwagatama. At a point in time after their jewels were created, the guardians also made a special magical box the Mother Miracle Box to house inactive miraculous and siblings once inside they discovered that a whole another universe exist and made it their home where they could cherish mementos of their adventures and owners. At some point, Sass was chosen to be the de facto leader of the inactive kwamis in the box.

title: Sass/History
text:
Sass/History - Before [[season 1]]
Furthermore, the kwamis desires had been fulfilled wishing to help people throughout the world however just like humans, Sass and the others also discovered that not all of them were worthy of their powers causing destruction making it their job along with their owners to rescue their captured siblings. However as time moved on, they found out that unlike them humans weren't immortal or when the crisis had been dealt with Sass and his siblings had to say goodbye to their first owners. But to their surprise their owners of the past weren't completely gone, seeing that their wisdom and insight as miraculous holders could benefit future generations the kwamis and guardians worked together by combining the kwagatamas, great magic and artifacts they established something amazing a magical reunion despite knowing the beings they were talking to weren't exactly like their past owners the kwamis were happy to be reunited nonetheless.
Sometime after She's death or retirement, then for the next 5000 years, Sass has helped by people throughout the world become Miraculous holders to protect it.

title: Sass/History
text:
Sass/History - Before [[season 1]]
Sometime before or after Trixx's departure to Germany and after the first mechanical clock was invented in 1270-1300, Sass was with an unknown owner at the time and they discovered when Sass uses Second Chance without his owners it makes other mechanical time keeping devices go haywire.
When his Miraculous was not being worn, Sass was dormant in the Snake Miraculous, which was stored inside the Chinese Miracle Box.
But he and his siblings next owners would have to wait for the next 172 years some time after Tikki returned from Vietnam and was placed back in the Mother Miracle Box, as a teenager Master Fu was inducted into the guardians and yet wasn't happy with his life as a guardian so much so that during one of his training sessions, young Fu used the Peacock Miraculous to create a simple little companion to get him food however his anger snuck into the creation of his creature destroying the Order. With the creature nearly impossible to stop, Sass and his siblings were given to Master Fu and escaped but lost Nooroo and Dusuu hiding in places unknown.

title: Sass/History
text:
Sass/History - Season 1
During Season 1, Sass was dormant in the Snake Miraculous.

title: Sass/History
text:
Sass/History - [[Season 2]]
During season 2, Sass was dormant in the Snake Miraculous.

title: Sass/History
text:
Sass/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Sandboy", Sass was celebrating Nooroo's birthday in the Miraculous Box with the others kwamis and was excited when Tikki and Plagg arrived. As the other kwamis marveled at the gift Tikki brought, he expressed his thanks to Tikki's and Plagg's owners for letting them attend. He noticed Tikki trying to say her owner's name but understood what she meant and that they received the guardian's permission and played with the other kwamis. When the time came to find Nooroo, Sass commanded the kwamis into position but they realized they did not have enough kwamis singing to make the connection. He pointed out that they were missing Duusu and seeing this as their only opportunity to find Nooroo, he told Plagg to get Wayzz, who was standing guard in case Fu woke up. Wayzz's presence allowed them to make contact with Nooro but they contacted Hawk Moth instead. Upon hearing his voice, he shuddered at the thought of being his slave and prevented themselves from being discovered when they all cut off the connection. They realized if they contacted Hawk Moth, rather than Nooroo, then someone must have been akumatized, and Tikki's and Plagg's wielders were in danger.

title: Sass/History
text:
Sass/History - [[Season 3]]
During season 3, Sass was dormant in the Snake Miraculous.
In "Desperada", Sass came out of the Snake Miraculous when it was temporarily given to Adrien by Ladybug. Sass then helped Adrien transform into Aspik, but his power were used in several failed attempts to save Ladybug and defeat Desperada. After numerous failures, Aspik immediately detransformed, with Sass landing in Adrien's hands exhausted, and returned to the Snake Miraculous to Ladybug, who then gave it to Luka instead. After Sass introduced himself and told Luka how to transform, they both transformed into Viperion and used Second Chance to devise a plan and help Ladybug and Cat Noir in defeating Desperada. After that, Sass was dormant in the Snake Miraculous again and returned to Ladybug, then to Master Fu.
In "Kwamibuster", he was activated along with his kwami brothers and sisters to help Multimouse enact her plan of rescuing Tikki and Plagg. During the confrontation, Sass was one of the few kwamis captured but was set free with the help of Multinoir. After Kwamibuster's defeat, Sass and others cheered for Marinette as their plan was a success and was returned to Miracle Box.

title: Sass/History
text:
Sass/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Miracle Queen", he was activated by a brainwashed Luka, transforming for him into Viperion and his powers was used against the heroes until Dragon Bug and Cat Noir managed to retrieve his Miraculous. After eating a wedge of cheese to recharge, he fused his powers with Plagg's to transform Cat Noir into Snake Noir. With the power of Second Chance and Cataclysm, they were able to stop Miracle Queen and save their allies. Afterwards, he defused and after Ladybug retrieved the Miracle Box, he returned to his Miraculous.

title: Sass/History
text:
Sass/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Truth", Sass was accidentally released from the Miracle Box when Marinette tried to figure it out in his eagerness explored Marinette's room. During a video call on his new guardian's computer, Sass and the others surrounded the screen in amazement. When Marinette leaves for her date with Luka he and his siblings hid with the Miracle Box. After the titular villain's defeat, Sass and the others saw that Marinette was sad about breaking up with Luka to the point of tears. He didn't know exactly how to help but joined with his siblings in giving their new guardian a group hug to comfort her.
In "Gang of Secrets", Sass was seen talking with the other kwamis until their guardian arrives home. Later, hears Marinette voiced her distress about being condemned to a life of secrets and lies forever because of her alter ego. When they hear someone coming the kwamis hide in the Miracle Box and after the Gang of Secrets had been defeated, he and the others look on as Marinette unveils her secret to Alya.
In "Mr. Pigeon 72", Sass was seen talking to Fluff in Marinette's room.

title: Sass/History
text:
Sass/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Furious Fu", hearing that Master Fu was returning for a visit, Sass and the other kwamis expressed dear desire to see him despite Marinette trying to keep them hidden for their safety. When his new guardian voiced concerns about leaving the Miracle Box unguarded, Sass realized that if someone stayed to guard the box then the others could go but when they cheated their way out so all of them could go, they were stopped by Marinette. With no choice, they used the "pup dog eyes" on her and Marinette reluctantly agreed. However, Sass and his siblings had a hard time keeping quiet while in Marinette's bag but heard that Master Fu is doing well and became a great painter.
But when returning home, Sass realized that Su-Han had returned to reclaim the box as he was the previous guardian before Master Fu's incident and with Su-Han's strictness he disappointingly returned to the box. After seeing Ladybug's valiant actions against the titular villain, Su-Han realized that Master Fu's choice wasn't so bad and allowed Sass and the others to stay with Marinette.

title: Sass/History
text:
Sass/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Sole Crusher", Sass came out of the Miracle Box to see that his guardian had been captured by the titular villain. He heard Tikki give Kaalki the confirmation to use her powers to find Cat Noir and tell him about the situation.
In "Queen Banana", Sass was helping as Marinette put the finishing touches on a pair of costumes she was working on for a movie project with her class.
In "Optigami", like the other kwamis, Sass was used to manipulate technology and heard a call from Marinette saying they need Kaalki's help. But upon hearing Kaalki's comment about needing Fluff's help, he adds that his siblings animal forms have a common ancestor and yet hearing the call end he and others believed she call again.
In "Sentibubbler", Sass and the others were woken when Marinette was worried about a nightmare she had about Alya betraying her. Like the others, Sass believed that Alya was a good choice but had concerns about Trixx and his mischief. But upon hearing Xuppu mention about Trixx causing the myth of Lochness monster, he sees his guardian rush off to check on Alya and Trixx.

title: Sass/History
text:
Sass/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Wishmaker", when Marinette explained what a career was, the other kwamis voiced ideas on what she could do in life until Sass silenced them to ask Marinette himself what she wanted to do; then saw her leave for the career expo. After Alec was akumatized into the titular villain, Sass was happily reunited with Luka and transformed into Viperion. With the power of Second Chance, Alec was deakumatized. Then, he returned the Snake Miraculous to Ladybug.
In "Simpleman", Sass was worried when Manon was getting close the Miracle Box and felt very dizzy when Manon, Ella and Etta shook the sewing box.

title: Sass/History
text:
Sass/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Dearest Family", after Tikki ate the pieces of galette Marinette brought for them, the kwamis quickly realized what she did. Then, Sass warned Marinette of the danger Tikki's hunger for candy can represent, despite the kwami of Creation's refusal at that. However, when Marinette doesn't listen to Sass' warning, he ordered Wayzz and Barkk to leave the room and watch over Tikki. Shortly, Marinette realized that his warning was real and transforms to stop Tikki only to be affected by his sibling's hunger, which scared him. Hearing a commotion downstairs, Sass and the others were commanded to hide.
After Ladybug saved her family, he and the kwamis see her return with pieces of galette for them. Despite that they were still nervous regarding Tikki, Marinette ensured them that Tikki will control herself and the kwamis eat the pieces of galette happily.

title: Sass/History
text:
Sass/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Ephemeral", during the fight against Moolak, Sass and his miraculous were given to Luka and transformed into Viperion. After the battle, Ladybug was forced by Su-Han to discover Cat Noir's identity so Viperion was recruited to help, by having him know Cat Noir's identity and then use Second Chance to make her forget everything. When Ladybug decided to cancel her plan, they detransformed, as time ran out. Later, Sass heard Luka come into Marinette's room, but their introductions were cut short; when his owner received a message from Ladybug allowing Sass use his power to go back to the last marked time.
Soon Sass discovered why as he and everyone noticed the Absolute Power being activated meaning Shadow Moth obtained the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses and started his wish. He explained to Luka the consequences of it and the latter hurried the former to use his power, which he does. After his power caused time anomalies to appear Viperion detransformed and Sass explained that he saw an image of Ladybug's Lucky Charm telling him to do so. When time was reset, Sass and his Miraculous were returned to Ladybug.

title: Sass/History
text:
Sass/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Kuro Neko", Sass and the other Kwamis tried to comfort Marinette after Cat Noir gave up on his Miraculous and was surprised to learn that she intended to replace him with someone who doesn't love her.
In "Penalteam", Sass and his Miraculous were used again by Luka to become Viperion and help Ladybug, along with many other heroes, to defeat Penalteam.
In "Risk", Sass and his Miraculous were briefly given back to Luka. Later, Sass and the other Kwamis watched Marinette search for different ways to sabotage Adrien and Lila's journey, unaware that she was under the influence of Risk's superpowers.
In "Strikeback", after Flairmidable betrayed Ladybug by stealing her yo-yo, his Miraculous, along with all the others, was given to Gabriel Agreste in exchange for the Peacock Miraculous.

title: Sass/History
text:
Sass/History - [[Season 5]]
In “Evolution”, Sass was seen with all the Kwamis under Gabriel's possession inside the repository. They all shake in fear from their new holder, while he comments to his wife about his greatest victory in obtaining almost all the Miraculouses from the Chinese Miracle Box and how he is going to use them to finally get Ladybug and Cat Noir’s Miraculous in order to wish her back. Upon hearing this, Sass quickly objected and begged Gabriel to reconsider the consequences that would result in someone else taking Émilie’s place if he used the Absolute Power. But Gabriel ignored his warning by sealing his mouth. Then, Gabriel told him and the other Kwamis that they will obey him from now on. After transforming into his new supervillain form, Monarch, by fusing the Butterfly and Rabbit Miraculous together, Gabriel forced them all to go inside his cane while he entered the Burrow.

title: Sass/History
text:
Sass/History - [[Season 5]]
When Monarch was confronted by Ladybug, Cat Noir, and Bunnyx, he opens his cane, taking all the Kwamis out. Sass cried out for Ladybug's help. Thanks to the powers of the Miraculouses, Monarch escaped the heroes and lands in the time when Reverser was akumatized. After being hit by multiple electric charges, he ordered the Kwamis to tell him what’s going on. Sass told him that if the Kwamis aren’t fed their powers become weak. Monarch reminded them that he’s their master. Sass warned him that if he were to destroy the Kwamis that power him, he would be destroying himself too. Left with no choice, Monarch detransforms and returns to the present to find Nathalie on the train, just as his past self hangs up on her. Sass and all the Kwamis are seen around Gabriel who has become very weak from using multiple powers, and he orders Nathalie to feed the Kwamis, referring to them as useless creatures. Sass along with Kwamis are fed pieces of bread, and when Gabriel prepares to travel again in time, he goes back to the cane with his brethren.

title: Sass/History
text:
Sass/History - [[Season 5]]
After Gabriel lost the Rabbit Miraculous and returned to the present, the Kwamis watched as he regrets his actions to his wife. Just as Gabriel dropped the phone after Nathalie refused to help him any longer, the Kwamis back away scared.
In "Deflagration", he was shocked when he heard Gabriel had discovered the identities of the new holders.
In "Intuition", he was revealed to be used by Monarch when Second Chance and Sass were used when he got the code from Tomoe Tsurugi as well as try to get Astrocat and Cosmobug's Miraculouses several times.
In "Re-creation", his Miraculous was turned back into its original form and Sass was reunited with Luka.

title: School infirmary
text:
School infirmary - Intro
The  is the room intended for the reception of sick or injured students and for the provision of certain treatments within the Collège Françoise Dupont.

title: School infirmary
text:
School infirmary - Appearance
The infirmary is medium-sized and includes a library that allows the nurse to store the medical records of students. In front of the bookcase is the nurse's desk, from which she receives pupils as part of her duties. To the right of the desk is a sink with a soap dispenser. At the bottom of the infirmary there are two beds that allow students to rest when they are sick or injured; these same beds are covered with paper to prevent the transmission of germs.

title: School infirmary
text:
School infirmary - Trivia
The full interior of this room first appeared in "Climatiqueen".
Part of it was visible, but only one wall, in "Guiltrip".
The infirmary has been important at several points in the series:
In "Horrificator", Chloé and Sabrina went there to get a nurse's outfit for their class' film.
In "Guiltrip", Marinette accompanied Rose when she had a headache.
In "Intuition", Adrien accompanied Marinette, who pretended to be sick so she could transform into Ladybug and go rescue Claudie from her space jet.
In "Climatiqueen", Adrien and Marinette took Aglaé there.

School terraces - Intro
The school terraces are the terraces located on the roof of the Collège Françoise Dupont.

title: School terraces
text:
School terraces - Description
The terraces appeared following the architectural renovation of the Collège Françoise Dupont. Each symmetrically occupies a wing of the building and provides access to different areas, such as the art classroom, the cafeteria, the library at the front, and the dome at the back.
Gardens
The first terrace features a hanging garden. It features numerous species of flowers and trees, such as cherry trees, and is equipped with benches that allow students to enjoy a quiet space with a fantastic view of Paris. This terrace is used notably by Gine during her poetry class.
The second terrace is a teaching space dedicated to the vegetable garden, with numerous tomato plants. This area is used primarily by the gardening teacher for her gardening class.

The  is the amphitheater of the Collège Françoise Dupont.

title: School amphitheater
text:
School amphitheater - Appearance
The amphitheater is a large room at the Collège Françoise Dupont with white walls and wood paneling, and a gray-beige floor with a subtle brown texture.
The student area consists of tiers with three rows of benches and large solid wood tables arranged in a semicircle.
The room features a fairly high wooden platform with a solid wood desk, two lamps positioned symmetrically at the corners, and a black office chair. Behind the desk is a large screen with a soundbar running the length of the lower section, framed in wood. A small wrought iron railing runs along one side.
The room is accessed through two doors flanking the platform.
As seen in "A Fairy Good Night", the amphitheater hosts lectures and scientific conferences.

The  is the building dedicated to the practice of indoor sports of the renovated Collège Françoise Dupont, as well as of the fencing academy of Armand D'Argencourt.

title: School gym
text:
School gym - Appearance
The gymnasium is located at the rear of the building, in an annex connected by a glass-roofed corridor. The entrance is through a three-panel door with a wheelchair ramp in the center.
The gymnasium has an iron structure clad in red brick. It has a wide, smooth wooden floor, ideal for indoor sports. On the school side, there are two white bleachers with seven rows of seats, accessible via a short staircase. Below the bleachers, a door can be seen, presumably leading to the locker rooms. However, the two bleachers are distinct: the one on the right has a purple panel that also serves as a table for personal belongings, creating a dedicated space for students with reduced mobility.
On the other side, a glass-roofed window with an iron frame allows natural light into the room and offers views of northern Paris.

title: Seine
text:
Seine - Intro
The  is a 776-kilometer (482 mi) long river and an important commercial waterway within the Paris Basin in the north of France.

title: Seine
text:
Seine - Description
In Paris, the Seine is almost 13 kilometers long. Its width varies between 30 meters and 200 meters, and its depth also varies between 3.40 meters and 5.70 meters.
The river divides the city into two areas, called the Right Bank (northern part) and the Left Bank (southern part).
Entering Paris from the southeast between the 12th and 13th arrondissements, it takes a northwest direction until reaching the historic center of Paris. Here the Seine splits into two arms to form two islands, Île Saint-Louis and Île de la Cité.
Further on, at Place de la Concorde, the river heads west. Just before the Champ de Mars and the Trocadéro, the Seine begins to follow a south-southwest direction.
It is divided one last time in two by an artificial island, Île aux Cygnes, before leaving the capital between the 16th and 15th arrondissements.
All along its course, the Seine is surrounded by quays where Parisians like to walk and sit, as well as parks and gardens to enjoy the calm of the river on sunny days.
Since the Seine is a navigable river, there are also ports where many ships can dock, including the famous tourist boats or private barges, such as the Liberty.

title: Seine
text:
Seine - Trivia
The banks of the Seine in Paris have been classified as a World Heritage Site by UNESCO under the title "Rives de Seine" since 1991.
Les Sources de la Seine, located at Source-Seine (21), belong to the municipality of Paris.
There are Gallo-Roman remains classified as a historical monument since 1945.
The entire archaeological and landscape site was registered as a Historical Monument in 2016, then classified in 2020.
The Seine flows from east to west. The northern side of the river is called Rive droite, while the southern side is called Rive gauche, in relation to someone facing downstream.
The 21st arrondissement, the neighborhood of Paris where the protagonists live, which does not exist in real life, is near the Seine.
In "Sandboy", Hawk Moth stated that he heard the kwamis somewhere on the right bank of the Seine, which means that the Master Fu's house is located there.
In the series, the Seine has been important at various points:

title: Sentimonster
text:
Sentimonster - Intro
A  is a living creation/being born from a person's emotions through Amokization, the superpower of the Peacock Miraculous, which involves turning a white feather into an Amok. They can take on a vast variety of forms and sometimes have special powers.

title: Sentimonster
text:
Sentimonster - Creation
Whenever a person or people feel strong emotion(s), positive and/or negative, the Peacock Miraculous holder takes one of the feathers from their hand fan and charges it with magical energy, transforming the feather into an amok. The Peacock owner then sends the Amok away to reach the person or people with the strong emotions.
Once the Amok reaches the recipient, it inhabits an object belonging to them, after which, a telepathic connection is established between the recipient(s) and the Peacock Miraculous holder allowing them to communicate through a peacock-shaped light mask that appears in front of their faces. The wearer of the Peacock Miraculous will then have the ability to manifest a Sentimonster from the recipient's emotions via a magical dark-blue ether that appears next to the amok recipient. The Peacock Miraculous holder will also be able to remotely communicate with the recipient and the Sentimonster with telepathy similar to how Rena Rouge and Volpina can communicate through their illusions.

title: Sentimonster
text:
Sentimonster - Creation
It is revealed in "Representation", that there is more than one way for the Sentimonster to manifest; when Adrien Agreste and his cousin Félix Fathom were manifested, it was as growing fetuses inside their respective mothers' womb.
Human sentimonsters can even create their own sentimonsters from their own emotions by using the Peacock Miraculous, as Felix was able to create Red Moon while using a copy of Adrien's ring as the amokized object in "Emotion".
The Peacock Miraculous holder can also create sentimonsters from their own emotions. Whilst multiple Sentimonsters can exist, only one can be created per user. In order for a new Sentimonster to be created by the same user, the current one must be dispelled.
In "Representation", It is revealed that the amok can remain inside the Amokized object even after the Peacock Miraculous holder who used it and/or the recipient of said amok have died/passed away, the Sentimonster that is created will continue to exist and live as well. Not just that, but is showed that an amokized object can contain more than one amok, as seen how Argos used Kagami's ring (which already contained an amok) to bring Once Upon a Time to life.

title: Sentimonster
text:
Sentimonster - Nature
The Sentimonster has an appearance and abilities that correspond to the recipient and the emotion they felt, the same emotion that the Sentimonster was manifested from, and they can come in a very wide variety of shapes and sizes; including animals, anthropomorphic objects, humans, and much more. They can be very large, towering over buildings, or very small, able to fit in the palm of ones hand. Sometimes, a Sentimonster will possess special superpowers that go beyond its anatomy and brute strength. Depending on the complexity of its creation, Sentimonsters can range from basic sentience to fully sapient beings capable of complex thought. A Sentimonster can also possesses personality traits that relate to its physical form. For example, Kuro Neko, a Sentimonster in the likeness of a cat, likes to eat grass to help it cough up its hair balls, the same as a real cat does.

title: Sentimonster
text:
Sentimonster - Nature
According to Thomas Astruc, "Sentimonster" is not a species, it is a "status" one may have. The nature of the manifested emotion ultimately depends on what it is made to be. If a Sentimonster is made to be human, then it is just as real and human as anyone else. Sentimonsters are not even necessarily living beings, it all depends on how they were conceived during the creation process.
A Sentimonster will obey the order of whoever is in possession of their Amokized object, even if that person is an opponent of the Peacock Miraculous holder and/or the person whose emotions the Sentimonster was manifested from. If a Sentimonster gets ahold of their Amokized object, then they will be able to think and act on their own free will, as seen in "Ladybug", "Pretension",  "Representation", and "Re-creation".
As seen in "Truth", "Sentibubbler" and "Kuro Neko", a Sentimonster can receive commands from the Peacock Miraculous holder and/or the person who possesses their Amok, even if they are out of earshot.

title: Sentimonster
text:
Sentimonster - Nature
Due to an Amok being connected to a Sentimonster's life force, if an Amokized object suffers a minor damage, the Sentimonster it controls can suffer pain as well, as seen in "Representation", when Colt cracked his Amokized ring, thus causing Félix to collapse.
As stated by Nathalie in "Feast", the Peacock Miraculous holder can only control the Sentimonsters if they possess the Amokized object. However, they would still be able to release another Peacock Miraculous holder's Sentimonster from existence, which could be used as leverage to make the Sentimonster compliant.

title: Sentimonster
text:
Sentimonster - Nature
Sentimonsters are also highly durable, if not outright indestructible, even with the Cataclysm, the power of the Cat Miraculous capable of feats up to galactic or universal destruction, being unable to outright destroy a Sentimonster. If Cataclysm is used on a Sentimonster, it will cause cracks to appear and spread all over its body. This damaged state can deeply effect the Sentimonster in question, breaking the link between the sentimonster and its Amok holder, causing it to go berserk, like a bee sting on a bull. However, this was not the case when Cat Noir was hit by Cataclysm in "Miraculer", instead he reacted with pain and agony like a regular human Miraculous holder. It could be a result of his miraculous suit protecting him, or his physical nature as a human-sentimonster. It may also be due to the fact that it was done via akumatization and not the real Cat Miraculous. It's unknown what would happen if the Cataclysm were used on a sentimonster more than once or to a stronger extent.

title: Sentimonster
text:
Sentimonster - Nature
Sentimonsters can also lack certain abilities, such as being good at soccer. Similar to humans, humanoid sentimonsters need to or can be taught these skills. But sometimes even if humanoid one despite being based on a human, isn't taught a certain skill or if not all the skills and abilities their human counterpart has or the creator doesn't know all the skills or behavior patterns the real person has then another can tell the difference between the original person and the humanoid sentimonster, Such as in "Ladybug", as the two Ladybugs used their powers Cat Noir saw the original was given a fork and the sentimonster was given a large blaster commenting the one beside him was the real one as he remembered that Ladybug's power never gave her a weapon as a Lucky Charm, or in "Gabriel Agreste", when Shadow Moth created Sentigabriel, Félix tore his pants which the real Gabriel doesn't have after releasing him from existence, or in "Optigami", When Shadow Moth created Sentinino, he didn't know the secret handshake the original Nino and Alya shared.
Human sentimonsters can also naturally develop allergies, as Adrien possesses an allergy to feathers.

title: Sentimonster
text:
Sentimonster - Nature
If a sentimonster is meant to have a human aspect, then it can have any human emotion, like for example, Adrien, in "Glaciator 2", who went into a deep sadness after being scolded by Ladybug for being a couple, and seeing all these billboards around town with pictures of Ladybug and Cat Noir kissing.
Although sentimonsters are meant to have control of themselves, sometimes they can not have notion of what freedom really is. Félix himself wanted to get rid of all the humanity, except for Adrien, Marinette and Kagami, for believing that all the humanity is oppresive, where in fact in most cases, they want the best for people they care/protect.
Also, as revealed in "Adoration", when Adrien was trying to kiss Marinette and his father disallowed him, he immediately didn't kiss her and went inside his home, while Gabriel twists his ring to control him.
If a sentimonster is under the control of a Butterfly Miraculous wielder and tries to resist akumatization/kamikotization, it will not succeed, as shown in "Ephemeral", when Adrien tried to resist his akumatization, but was thwarted due to Shadow Moth rotating his ring finger.

title: Sentimonster
text:
Sentimonster - Nature
If a human-made sentimonster knows about their true nature and others are active, or, in some cases, they see another sentimonster suffering, being imprisoned, or released from existence, then they will develop some kinship for them like true siblings, as Flairmidable expressed grief for the Strikebacks after Pegabug teleported them to the Sun, and when he, as Argos, regretfully released the Red Moon from of existence. That said, in other cases, they may react in shock, horror, fear, or denial, and may question their own existence as a person, possibly even believing that the memories or feelings they experienced aren't real.
Human sentimonsters can also be miraculous holders, such as Adrien, who uses the Cat Miraculous to become Cat Noir.

title: Sentimonster
text:
Sentimonster - Defeat
In order to defeat a sentimonster, one must break/destroy the object containing the amok. Once the amokized object is broken/destroyed, the Amok will be released, and the Sentimonster will disappear into nothingness.
After the object is broken, the owner of the Ladybug Miraculous uses the yo-yo to capture the Amok. The Yo-yo will then "purify" the Amok and turn it back into a feather. It is currently unknown what will happen if the amok was allowed to fly away without being purified.
In "Yaksi Gozen", it is revealed that if an amokized object gets damaged, it makes the sentimonster seriously ill.
If a Sentimonster's amok is duplicated somehow, as was the case with Mega Leech, all of the Amoks must be released, captured, and purified before the Sentimonster can disappear.
The Peacock Miraculous wearer can revoke the amok themselves, thus destroying/releasing the Sentimonster from existence and purifying the Amok without needing the Ladybug Yo-yo. To do this, the Peacock user must simply snap their fingers. The sentimonster(s) will also feel pain during this process, as seen in "Feast" and "Ladybug".

title: Sentimonster
text:
Sentimonster - Defeat
However, as seen in "Miraculous Shanghai" and "Gamer 2.0", if a Sentimonster is killed through other means, such as the power of another Miraculous and are on the side of good, they can still be brought back to life with the Miraculous Ladybug, but only if their amoks are still inside their respective objects.
In "Representation", it's revealed that the Peacock Miraculous holder can hold more than one amok in the same object, as Argos placed an amok in Kagami's ring which already held her amok. It's also shown that the holder can revoke one amok from that object if they wish.
In "Werepapas", it is revealed that, if a broken amokized object is fixed before the amok is released from it, then it's possible to prevent that from happening, in this way preventing the sentimonster from disappearing, as shown when Ladybug broke the Twin Rings containing Adrien's amok so she could free the ultrakuma and being quick to restore everything before the amok could get out, in this way, preventing Adrien from disappearing.

title: Sentimonster
text:
Sentimonster - Trivia
The name sentimonster is a portmanteau of "sentiment", a synonym for feelings, and "monster", hinting towards the fact that sentimonsters are monsters formed from emotions.
If they are used for good, they can be called sentibeings or sentis.
This power is somewhat similar to Kamikotization, as both involve embuing an item with magic and communicating telepathically with a person.
Unlike Kamikotization, however, Amokization can embue an object that's been destroyed, although it is still possible to damage it further to release the amok.
Also, unlike Kamikotization, the sentimonster can only be controlled by the one who possesses the object containing the amok, while the power to control Kamikotized champions belongs to the Butterfly Miraculous owner.
Just like the Butterfly Miraculous owner can create heroes as well as villains, the Peacock Miraculous holder can create good and evil Sentimonsters.

title: Sentimonster
text:
Sentimonster - Trivia
Just like Kamikotized heroes and Akumatized villains can turn against the Butterfly Miraculous owner, Sentimonsters can turn against the Peacock Miraculous holder or the one that was controlling them, as long they gain possession of the object containing their amok and both can inflict pain.
Just like how the Butterfly Miraculous is able to sense the emotions and contact with the Kamikotized Heroes and Akumatized Villains, the Peacock Miraculous holder can feel the sentimonster(s) presence when they're close or harmed, they can also contact them.
Sentimonsters are living emotions manifested in physical form and have feelings, so they can also be Akumatized, as seen in "Feast", "Cat Blanc", "Gabriel Agreste" and "Ephemeral". As such, Amokization can fuse itself with Akumatization to create a hybrid mask.
They can be created by a combination of emotions and not just one.
While multiple sentimonsters can exist at a given time, a holder is only able to create one at a time.
For example, Mayura was able to create singular Sentimonsters while Adrien Agreste, Kagami Tsurugi, Félix Fathom and the Dormant Sentimonster are active.

title: Sentimonster
text:
Sentimonster - Trivia
This is further proven in "Optigami" and "Representation", as Shadow Moth was able to create Sentialec and Sentinino even while Optigami was active, as Optigami was created by Mayura rather than Shadow Moth, and when Argos was able to create Once Upon a Time even while he, Kagami Tsurugi and Adrien Agreste are already active.
Not only that, Colt Fathom was able to create his son while Adrien Agreste and Kagami Tsurugi were already active.
An ancient Chinese Peacock Miraculous holder was shown in an illustration surrounded by multiple sentimonsters, though it is unclear if this was an actual example of multiple sentimonsters being created by the same user or if it could also be an example of the types that can be created.
Although, the same way Gabriel found a way to make himself create multiple akumas by creating an akumatized villain that enhances his powers, that previous holder could have created a sentimonster that allowed her to produce multiple amoks.
Even though users of the Peacock Miraculous can make humanoid sentimonsters that look and sound like the real humans they are based on, they can only copy their memories and mannerisms the Miraculous holder knew of.

Adrien is the only known sentibeing to have outlived the recipient(s) of his amok.

title: Sentinino
text:
Sentinino - Intro
was one of the two secondary antagonists (alongside Sentialec) of the episode "Optigami". He was a sentimonster in the likeness of Nino Lahiffe manifested by Shadow Moth from his own emotions of ambition in the midst of his latest grand plan to defeat the Miraculous heroes.
In "Optigami", Sentinino received the Turtle Miraculous from Rena Rouge and became Senticarapace, a turtle-themed Miraculous holder who dissimulated as a superhero. However, when having no more use to Shadow Moth (after Ladybug realized that "Nino" didn't do the secret handshake with Alya Césaire previously planned out, fathoming Ladybug to realize he was a sentimonster), he removed Sentinino's amok.

title: Sentinino
text:
Sentinino - Appearance
Physical appearance
Sentinino was an uncanny doppelgänger of Nino. He was a tall slender teenager, with short dark brown hair, tan skin, and moderate orange eyes. He wore a plain red cap, used black-rimmed glasses, and had a pair of dark gray, blue, and orange headphones hung around his neck. He wore a vivid azure t-shirt with an eye design on the front (a design involving a black pupil, white sclera, a dark gray upper eyelid with lashes, and a light blue lower lid). Around his moderate azure jeans was a brown belt, and while most of it was hidden by his shirt, one tip stuck out a little bit below the hem. Additionally, he wore lime green, pink, red, blue, and yellow wristbands around his right wrist, and red and white high collar shoes with a white knight design on the tongues.
As Senticarapace

title: Sentinino
text:
Sentinino - Appearance
Senticarapace was the exact same as Carapace. He had a deep green jumpsuit with a hood over his head, the suit itself made with tiny hexagonal patterns resembling those on the Turtle Miraculous. The hoodie had a silver semicircle on the front, curved red-eye designs on the sides with black and golden details, and two small light green ovals below the bottom of the hood's opening. Over his eyes, Senticarapace wore black goggles with yellow-green lenses, and underneath the suit, he had a black collar. On his suit, he had six hexagon-shaped light green circles on his chest, and he had dark gray hexagon-shaped protective pads on his shoulders, elbows, hips, and knees. The Turtle Miraculous bracelet was on his right wrist. Also, Senticarapace wore deep green boots with an indent between his big toe and other toes, dark gray outsoles, and two indents on two sides of each boot. On his back, he carried a shield that was dark green on one side and light green on the other.

title: Sentinino
text:
Sentinino - Personality
Because Sentinino was created based on the real Nino, he was supposed to have a similar behavior as him. However, because he didn't have his memories, there were some faults on the behavior of the sentimonster that caused him to deviate from his original, like not being aware of the special high-five the real Nino has with his girlfriend, Alya, which helped Ladybug see through Shadow Moth's deception.

title: Sentinino
text:
Sentinino - Abilities
As Sentinino
Sentinino had the exact abilties as Nino. He was a skilled DJ and also knowledgeable in film tropes and film crew.
As Senticarapace
Senticarapace had the exact same abilties as Carapace, such as speed, agility, and strength, and he was almost invulnerable to physical damage. He possessed a shield as a weapon that could easily be thrown and used to fight.
His special power, Shell-ter, was executed through his shield, and allowed him to create a giant green shell-like spherical barrier/force field to protect himself and his 'allies'.

title: Sentinino
text:
Sentinino - Trivia
He was the third known sentimonster to use a Miraculous, following Adrien Agreste and Kagami Tsurugi.
He was the second sentimonster to be based on the French Miraculous superhero team, the other being the Ladybug sentimonster.
He was the fourth sentimonster that is based on a human, following Ladybug, Gabriel Agreste, and Sentialec, and thus also the fourth sentimonster that could be viewed as a person.
Sentinino was the second sentimonster to wear glasses after Gabriel Agreste. This could mean that his glasses were affecting his vision, or they were just for looks to be an exact carbon copy of Nino Lahiffe.
He was the third sentimonster to be destroyed by Shadow Moth, following Gabriel Agreste and Sentialec.

She hugs Rena Rouge and tells her that she should have never doubted the idea of leaving the Fox Miraculous with her.
She then swings away and Rena Rouge de-transforms.
Ladybug arrives at the alleyway again and uses the pot to place the tarantula in the terrarium.
She uses her Miraculous Ladybug to fix everything.
Everyone is brought back to the apartment and hugs Alya. Ladybug quickly heads back to Alya's room in the apartment and de-transforms. She runs out of Alya's room and hugs Alya again. Marinette and Alya go back to Alya's bedroom, and Alya tells Marinette that she made the illusion of Ladybug say that she will never get her miraculous ever again so he will never try to get her Miraculous again. Marinette is very happy that the nightmare is over. She fist-bumps with Alya, saying "Pound it!" as the end card appears.

title: Sentibubbler (sentimonster)
text:
Sentibubbler (sentimonster) - Intro
Sentibubbler was the titular main antagonist of the episode "Sentibubbler". He was a humanoid bubble-themed sentimonster created by Shadow Moth from his own emotions of confidence in the midst of his latest plan of capturing Ladybug by taking Nino and Alya's family hostage in his titular episode. His Amok was revoked by Shadow Moth shortly after he sided with Ladybug when she stole the amokized object in order to free Alya's family.

title: Sentibubbler (sentimonster)
text:
Sentibubbler (sentimonster) - Appearance
Sentibubbler was a perfect uncanny, carbon copy of Bubbler. He had light brilliant arctic blue skin, dark amaranth eyes, and black circles around his eyes, along with a black spot above his left eye and a black spot below his right eye. He wore a luminous vivid red, arctic blue, and yellow elbow-length sleeved tunic with many parts of the suit being rounded like attached bubbles.
Around his head, he had a red hood-like thing that featured a red antenna on top with a red sphere. Also, he wore black boots, black elbow-length gloves with brilliant amaranth knuckles, and black pants. On his chest, he had an eye-like black and white circle with two dark gray tubes attached. The tubes connected to Sentibubbler's red, yellow, and blue bubble container, where he put his bubble wand when he wasn't using it. The bubble wand had a blue handle and a yellow head with a long, oval hole.

title: Sentibubbler (sentimonster)
text:
Sentibubbler (sentimonster) - Personality
When controlled by Shadow Moth, Sentibubbler acted as the villain's eyes and ears, delivering his instructions word-for-word. However, he also possessed a unique personality, one that was serious and willing to enforce Shadow Moth's will; this contrasted to the original Bubbler's laid-back and often disobedient attitude.
When controlled by Pegabug, Sentibubbler was more happy and eager to comply with her commands and returned the people he was holding hostage.

title: Sentibubbler (sentimonster)
text:
Sentibubbler (sentimonster) - Abilities
Sentibubbler had the exact same abilities as The Bubbler. His bubble wand weapon could create giant impenetrable bubbles with various powers and colors.
Purple bubbles could be used to chase and capture people, turning green. Additionally, Sentibubbler could use them to project his face and give a message, and he could stand on them to levitate. He could turn these bubbles yellow, making them soundproof.
Red bubbles were his offensive attack: he could throw them at his enemies, causing a fiery explosion on impact. Additionally, Sentibubbler could turn existing red bubbles into swarming green ones that attached to people and morphed into a giant green bubble. This was used to catch both Ladybug and Cat Noir in one go.
He was unable to levitate in mid-air without standing on a bubble, but he could jump very high and fly from one place to another leaving a trail of purple bubbles.
His bubbles couldn't be penetrated by limbs or by Ladybug's yo-yo. However, the shields Ladybug and Cat Noir create by rotating their weapons did offer some protection. Additionally, the bubbles could be blown away by air currents and be burst by Cataclysm and the Miraculous Ladybug.

title: Sentibubbler (sentimonster)
text:
Sentibubbler (sentimonster) - Abilities
His bubbles were rigid and transparent, allowing anyone outside them to see and hear what's happening inside. However, he could also apply an orange protective shield that soundproofed the bubbles so outsiders could not hear their prisoners.

Sentibubbler was the first sentimonster to be controlled by Ladybug (who was at that time the hybrid superhero Pegabug).
Sentibubbler was the second sentimonster to side with Ladybug, the first being Ladybug Sentimonster.

Alya: Trust me, and trust yourself! You were right to give me a Mirac- (gets annoyed by the continuous phone ringing) Ugh, seriously? Hello?? Why isn't anybody getting that? (storms out of the room)
(Alya looks outside her room only to find out that there is already nobody there. The phone continues to ring.)
Alya: Hey! Where'd you guys all go? Is this some kind of joke? (picks up the phone) Hello?
Shadow Moth: (on the phone) Rena Rouge, I am Shadow Moth.
(Alya hears Marinette screaming from behind, she turns around to find Marinette already caught by one of the bubbles.)
Alya: Marinette! (shocked, she turns to look at dining table, where the supervillain who appears to be the Bubbler is standing.)
(Marinette's bubble starts to float outside.)
Marinette: Alya!
Alya: (runs to the balcony, chasing after Marinette's bubble) Marinette, no!
Marinette: Alya! Be careful! (her bubble continues to float away)
(Alya turns angrily to look at the Bubbler in their living room.)

title: Sentibubbler/Transcript
text:
Sentibubbler/Transcript - Intro
Alya: Nino! Seriously? Don't tell me you got akumatized into Bubbler again just 'cause I didn't let you in my room!
Shadow Moth: (speaks through the "Bubbler") I'm not Nino, I'm the Sentibubbler.
Sentibubbler: Nino is with your family, all prisoners!
(Alya runs back to the balcony to see her whole family, Marinette, Nino, including their tarantula, imprisoned in Sentibubbler's bubbles up in the sky.)
Nino: (sees the tarantula floating towards him and tries to move away from it) Hey, you! Keep those hairy legs away from me, okay?
Nora: (sitting calmly inside her bubble) Don't panic, the Beetle and Mr. Whiskers will save us!
(Back at Alya's home, she looks back at Sentibubbler, signaling her to pick up the phone and winks at her. Alya picks up the phone eventually.)
Shadow Moth: (on the phone) You've probably realized by now (scene changes at the rooftop where he is standing) that you'll have to obey me if you want to see your loved ones again.
(scene changes back to Alya's home)
Alya: What do you want, Shadow Moth?
Shadow Moth: (on the phone) I want you to betray Ladybug!
Marinette: This is worse than a nightmare! Tikki, I can't transform or everyone will see me!

title: Sentibubbler/Transcript
text:
Sentibubbler/Transcript - Intro
Tikki: Alya will figure something out. That's why you left her a Miraculous!
Marinette: (grabs her phone from her purse) I have to tell her that the villain is probably a sentimonster! (starts typing on her phone) Rena Rouge has to warn Cat Noir that he must not cataclysm him, or the sentimonster will get out of control and our bubbles could pop out!
(Alya's phone vibrates from her pocket. She grabs it and sees a message from Marinette but one of Sentibubbler's bubbles eventually takes Alya's phone away.)
Alya: No!
Shadow Moth: (on the phone) The only people you'll be able to communicate with now, Alya Césaire, are me and my sentimonster!
Marinette: (nervously tapping her phone) Why isn't she answering? (sees Alya's phone float across her) Oh no.
Tikki: Trust Alya, Marinette. She's never let you down before!
Marinette: You're right! Besides, I'm sure Cat Noir will show up soon!
<poem>
Nadja Chamack: (on TV) These bubbles are floating for over five minutes now, and still no superhero in sight. Isn't that right, Clara?
Plagg: (sniffs on the camembert on the table) Aww, this cheese isn't runny enough yet.

title: Sentibubbler/Transcript
text:
Sentibubbler/Transcript - Intro
Clara Contard: (on TV) Yes, Nadja, and no villain either. In fact, these bubbles are identical to the ones created by the Bubbler. Yet, in one of them, there's Nino Lahiffe, the student who was originally akumatized as the Bubbler.
Nadja: (on TV) Keep your distance, Clara. Don't take any risks until Ladybug and Cat Noir get there.
Adrien: (worried) Nino! Marinette! (stands up) Plagg?
Plagg: (smiling) Well, good! By the time we're back, maybe this cheese will become edible!
<center> [Transformation Sequence]  Adrien: Plagg, claws out!  </center>
</poem>
(Alya is still on the phone talking to Shadow Moth.)
Shadow Moth: Listen carefully. Ladybug will be here any minute. And since it's your family and friends, Ladybug will ask you to help her, and hand you the Miraculous of the fox. Once she's given you the Miraculous, the Sentibubbler will be hiding nearby and capture Ladybug!
Alya: Cat Noir will come to save her!

title: Sentibubbler/Transcript
text:
Sentibubbler/Transcript - Intro
Shadow Moth: No. He won't even know she's been captured. Because thanks to your Miraculous, you'll transform into Rena Rouge and create an illusion of Ladybug and Rena Rouge to distract Cat Noir. Thinking he's joined his fellow heroes, he won't notice the Sentibubbler until it's too late, and you'll give me your Miraculous! It is then and only then when the three Miraculous are finally in my possession! That, the Sentibubbler will release your loved ones. If you try anything to warn Ladybug or Cat Noir, I'll order the Sentibubbler to send the bubbles into space, too far for any superhero to ever save them!
(Alya looks up to the sky where her family, Nino and Marinette's bubbles are at.)
Shadow Moth: If I were you, I would do anything I could to ensure Ladybug showed up very shortly!
Alya: (puts down the phone while looking up in the sky) Got to gain some time!
Marinette: Phew, Alya's still free! She'll be able to save us.
Tikki: (from Marinette's purse) You see? You were right to give her the Miraculous!
Marinette: Thanks, Tikki.
Alya: (from their balcony) Ladybug! Please come save us!
Marinette: (suspicious) What's she doing?
Alya: (waving her hands) Ladybug! Please come save us!

title: Sentibubbler/Transcript
text:
Sentibubbler/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Ugh, I'm just gonna have to transform in front of everyone and later use the Miraculous of the Rabbit to go back in time! Ah, no! Time travel is never a good idea! But if I don't transform, I won't have access to any of the Miraculous. Oh! Except mine! (looks at Tikki inside her purse) You could take it to another holder!
Tikki: The earrings can't go through the bubble, Marinette!
Marinette: Then, Cat Noir is our last hope.
Cat Noir: No villain in sight. Watch out, m'lady. I get the feeling someone's trying to play cat and ladybug with us. I'm waiting for you! (puts down his cat phone)
Alya: (continues to wave her hands) Yoo-hoo! Ladybug! (looks on her fanny pack where Trixx is peeking out) (softly) Get ready, Trixx. We have to figure out a way to free Marinette, or else we're all serious goners!
(She looks behind and uses her vision, pointing at the Sentibubbler, the fruit bowl, and her bedroom door.)
Alya: Hey, Sentibubbler? I have to go to the bathroom.
Shadow Moth: (annoyed) Not now!
Sentibubbler: (annoyed) Not now!
Alya: (stomps her feet) Seriously, it cannot wait. Must be the stress. Plus, it sure will look weird if Ladybug finds me like this.

title: Sentibubbler/Transcript
text:
Sentibubbler/Transcript - Intro
Shadow Moth: (sighs) Just remember that if you try anything...
Sentibubbler: I'll send those bubbles right into space!
Alya: I can't try anything without a Miraculous, anyway. I just need to go to the bath- Woah!(Alya trips and the table falls down. She hides behind the table.)
Alya: (whispers) Trixx, let's pounce! (transforms into Rena Rouge and grabs her flute to quickly create an illusion of herself as Alya)
Rena Rouge: (whispers)'' Mirage!
Shadow Moth: Sentibubbler, what is she doing?
Sentibubbler: Ah, I can't see!
("Alya" appears from the table, holding a bowl above her head and places it on their kitchen counter. Rena Rouge makes her move to stay hidden from the Sentibubbler and Shadow Moth. "Alya" continues to walk to the bathroom as the Sentibubbler keeps an eye on her.)
Sentibubbler: You got thirty seconds!
("Alya" enters the bathroom. Rena Rouge grabs a bunch of grapes on the floor and sneaks behind the Sentibubbler as he begins to count.)
Sentibubbler: One, two, three...
Rena Rouge: (softly) Reality! (Her illusion of Alya disappears without the Sentibubbler's knowledge.)
Sentibubbler: (from outside Alya's room) Five!

title: Sentibubbler/Transcript
text:
Sentibubbler/Transcript - Intro
Rena Rouge: Let's rest! (detransforms into civilian form and catches Trixx on her hands)
(She hands over the bunch of grapes to Trixx as he pulls out a piece and bites on it.)
Trixx: You got a plan?
Alya: Uh-huh. Shadow Moth and the Sentibubbler don't know I have my Miraculous with me. I'm going to use it to make them believe everything is going according to their plan.
Trixx: (chewing on his piece of grape) You're going to create an illusion of Ladybug?
Alya: Yep. But first, I have to make sure that Cat Noir doesn't come to mess up my plan. Trixx, let's pounce! (transforms once again into Rena Rouge)(She opens her fox phone and calls Cat Noir.)''
Cat Noir: (answers his cat phone) Rena? Are you with Ladybug?
Rena Rouge: (from Alya's room) Yes. She... asked me to call you and say we got a plan.
Cat Noir: Perfect! What should I do?
Rena Rouge: Oh! Uh- I- It's actually a two-person plan.
Cat Noir: What do you mean a "two-person plan"? You mean she and you? What about me?
Rena Rouge: Well, that's just it. In this plan, you have to stay right where you are. A-and wait for instructions.
Cat Noir: Hm. I need to hear it from her. Put her on the phone, please.

title: Sentibubbler/Transcript
text:
Sentibubbler/Transcript - Intro
Rena Rouge: Well, I- Uh- I can't. She's super busy right now. And, uh, if you happen to see the Bubbler, whatever you do, don't cataclysm him! It's actually a sentimonster.
Cat Noir: What?
Rena Rouge: I gotta go! I-I mean, we will keep you posted. (hangs up) Mirage!
(She brings back the illusion of herself as Alya, together with an illusion of Ladybug on the rooftops.)
Cat Noir: (enraged) A two-person plan?! There's only one two-person plan, and that's Ladybug and me! (smashes the wall behind him with his stick) The Miraculous Ladybug will fix everything as usual. Hm? (He sees "Ladybug" jumping over the rooftops alone.) Where's Rena Rouge? (becomes suspicious and frustrated) "Stay where I am," I can't just sit here and do nothing! (goes to follow "Ladybug")
Marinette: (sees the illusion of Ladybug down below) Rena Rouge has gone into action, Tikki! I knew Alya could handle it! (she then sees Cat Noir follow "Ladybug" from behind) Cat Noir! No!
Tikki: What's wrong?

title: Sentibubbler/Transcript
text:
Sentibubbler/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: If Cat Noir comes into contact with Rena Rouge's illusion anyway, it'll disappear! I've got to warn Cat Noir! (attempts to push her bubble forward) Or Shadow Moth will figure out Alya's plan! (continues to push her bubble forward)
Shadow Moth: (sees "Ladybug") There she is! (as the Sentibubbler) Hurry up, Ladybug's coming!
Sentibubbler: (to "Alya") Hurry up, Ladybug's coming!
Alya: (exits the bathroom) See? I didn't make trouble.
Sentibubbler: Don't forget what will happen to your loved ones if you don't stick to the plan. (hides in a room behind him)
Alya: I hear you loud and clear. (walks to the balcony)
(Sentibubbler takes a peek at "Alya" from the room.)
Shadow Moth: Sentibubbler, wait until Ladybug has given the Miraculous to Rena Rouge before you capture her.
Marinette: Cat Noir! Cat Noir!!
Cat Noir: (sees Marinette inside a bubble above him) Marinette Dupain-Cheng?
Marinette: You have to stay where you are!
Cat Noir: (angrily) Oh, come on! What is with everyone telling me to stay where I am?
Marinette: Rena Rouge created an illusion of Ladybug to fool the Bubbler who's really a sentimonster! If you go there, you might screw up the whole plan!

title: Sentibubbler/Transcript
text:
Sentibubbler/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: (suspicious) And you know this... how?
Marinette: (nervously) Uh- Oh, well... i-it's because I-I have a really good view of the whole thing since the very beginning. You might even say I have front row seats here! (lays down smugly inside her bubble)
(Cat Noir sighs in defeat and leans on his stick.)
Rena Rouge: (as "Ladybug") What's going on? (as "Alya") The Bubbler has captured my family, my friends!
Ladybug (illusion): What's going on?
Alya (illusion): The Bubbler has captured my family, my friends!
Ladybug (illusion): Hmm, but not you?
Alya (illusion): I don't know. He was already gone when I got here.
Ladybug (illusion): That's strange. It would have made more sense if he threatened your family in order to force you to betray me.
Alya (illusion): I'd never betray you, Ladybug.
Ladybug (illusion): Shadow Moth attacked your family because he found out that you're a superhero. Unfortunately, I won't be able to give you the Miraculous of the Fox ever again.
("Alya" gasps.)
(scene changes to Shadow Moth, shocked that his plan begins to fail)
Shadow Moth: No!! This isn't the plan!
Sentibubbler: (takes out his bubble sword) Shall I capture Ladybug?

title: Sentibubbler/Transcript
text:
Sentibubbler/Transcript - Intro
Shadow Moth: Wait! Just a moment!
Rena Rouge: (as "Alya") I was proud to fight by your side, Ladybug. (as "Ladybug") Don't worry...
Ladybug (illusion): ...I'll find another holder and give him a different, but very powerful Miraculous! We'll save your loved ones!
Rena Rouge: (as "Alya") Thank you, Ladybug!
("Ladybug" swings away.)
Shadow Moth: I'm looking forward on getting my hands on this new and very powerful Miraculous, as well! Let's follow her!
(Rena Rouge peeks at a door and closes it as the Sentibubbler passes by. She opens it again and sees the Sentibubbler jump out the balcony.)
Cat Noir: If the sentimonster touches the illusion, it'll disappear! He'll know it's a trap! I gotta stop him!
Marinette: Great idea!
Cat Noir: (extends his stick and sits on it, levelling it to Marinette's bubble) Don't worry, the real Ladybug will get here and together we'll save you!
Marinette: (watches Cat Noir jump away) We already are, Kitty Cat. We already are.
(Sentibubbler chases after the illusion of Ladybug, who's then cut short by Cat Noir.)
Cat Noir: So, now you're a superhero stalker, Bubbler?

title: Sentibubbler/Transcript
text:
Sentibubbler/Transcript - Intro
(Sentibubbler throws a bubble at Cat Noir and dodges it. He jumps toward Sentibubbler then blocks it with his bubble sword. They continue to fight over the rooftops. Shadow Moth spectates their battle.)
Shadow Moth: No! That alley cat is going to ruin my plan! (sees "Ladybug" from afar) Ladybug cannot escape me! Not today! (He begins to chase after "Ladybug")
(Marinette pushes her bubble higher and sees Shadow Moth chasing after the illusion of Ladybug.)
Marinette: Shadow Moth?
Tikki: The real one?(Marinette pushes her bubble further.)''
("Alya" enters inside her bedroom with Rena Rouge.)
Rena Rouge: Reality!
(The illusions of Alya in her room and Ladybug running in an alley disappears, much to Shadow Moth's disappointment.)
Shadow Moth: NO!! (punches the alley wall in fit of rage) You can't hide for long, Ladybug!!
Rena Rouge: (in her room) Let's rest! (detransforms back to her civilian form)''
(The Sentibubbler starts to throw more bubbles at Cat Noir, but is able to block them with his stick.)
Shadow Moth: (from behind a wall on the rooftops) All is not lost, yet.(The Sentibubbler caught Cat Noir off-guard. Shadow Moth ambushes Cat Noir from behind.)

title: Sentibubbler/Transcript
text:
Sentibubbler/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Cat Noir, watch out!
(Shadow Moth hits Cat Noir and gets caught in one of Sentibubbler's bubbles.)
Marinette: Sorry.
Cat Noir: You'll need more than this to capture this cat! Cataclysm! (He uses his power to pop the bubble, but unfortunately he gets caught once again. He laughs nervously once beside Marinette.)
Shadow Moth and Sentibubbler: It's over for you, Cat Noir!
Cat Noir: Nothing's over! You haven't defeated Ladybug, yet!
Marinette: (to Tikki) Or Rena Rouge!
(Tikki winks at Marinette.)
Alya: From this point on, Trixx, Rena Rouge can never be seen in the light of day. Shadow Moth's gotta believe that no one's using the Miraculous of the Fox!
Trixx: Now that's sly. Very sly!
Alya: Trixx, let's pounce! (she transforms once again into Rena Rouge)
Rena Rouge: (sends Marinette a message) Marinette, get ready. It's time for the real Ladybug to show up!
grabs her flute to create another illusion) Mirage!
(Rena Rouge created an illusion of Marinette, full of despair inside her bubble.)
Tikki: What's happening?
Marinette: Alya has created the illusion of an identical bubble containing an illusion of me and it completely overlaps us! (disappears)

title: Sentibubbler/Transcript
text:
Sentibubbler/Transcript - Intro
(Scene focuses on hopeless Marinette and Cat Noir trapped inside the bubbles.)
Marinette: (off-camera) Nobody can see us from the outside now!
Tikki: (off-camera) It's brilliant!
Marinette: (softly) Tikki, spots on! (transforms into Ladybug)
(Ladybug sees Cat Noir float towards Sentibubbler.)
Cat Noir: Ladybug will never fall into your trap!
Shadow Moth: (hiding in an alley) Shut him up!
(Sentibubbler silences Cat Noir's bubble.)
Cat Noir: No one will silence me, Shadow Moth! (becomes inaudible)
Shadow Moth: Now, I will have the pleasure of capturing Ladybug!
Ladybug: (inside her bubble) (softly) Lucky Charm! (She uses her power and gets a polka-dotted pot. She uses her Lucky vision and looks at the coffee cup Shadow Moth is holding, Sentibubbler, and the tarantula that is trapped inside the bubble.) That cup's gotta be the object that allows him to control the sentimonster!
(Ladybug opens her yo-yo and grabs the Horse Miraculous. She wears the glasses as Kaalki emerges from it.)
Ladybug: Tikki, Kaalki, Unify! (She transforms into Pegabug.)''
Sentibubbler: Show yourself, Ladybug! It's over for you and Cat Noir!
Sentibubbler and Shadow Moth: If you don't surrender...

title: Sentibubbler/Transcript
text:
Sentibubbler/Transcript - Intro
Sentibubbler: ...I'll send all these prisoners into space! Three, two, one! Too late!! (Sentibubbler brings the bubbles high up into the sky as it head toward outer space.)
Ella and Etta: Help, Ladybug!!!
Sentibubbler: Hurry up! The bubbles are rising! Tick-tock, Ladybug!
(Cat Noir's ring begins to beep.)
Cat Noir: (very worried) It's now or never for your awesome two-person plan, m'lady!
(Pegabug spots Shadow Moth, the Peacock and the Butterfly Miraculous, and his coffee cup.)
Pegabug: I won't be able to seize everything at once! First, the object that controls the sentimonster. Voyage! (She opens up a portal that opens up behind Shadow Moth, ambushing him and grabbing his coffee cup.)
Shadow Moth: Ladybug?!
[Post-Transformation Sequence]Pegabug: No, Pegabug! (strikes a pose)
(Shadow Moth tries to catch Pegabug, but she was able to jump on a lamppost whilst holding the coffee cup that controls Sentibubbler.)
Pegabug: Sentibubbler! Bring the bubbles down and free the prisoners!
Sentibubbler: At your command! (sends down the bubbles safely to the ground)

title: Sentibubbler/Transcript
text:
Sentibubbler/Transcript - Intro
Shadow Moth: You're forgetting something, Pegabug! I created him! Sentibubbler, I release you from existence! (snaps his fingers and Sentibubbler disappears)
Pegabug: No!
(The amok from the coffee cup appears and purifies itself as it floats in the air. The bubbles that hold Alya's family and Nino captive pops which send them falling to the ground.)
Rena Rouge: (inside her room) Reality! (The illusion of Marinette's bubble vanishes.)
(Cat Noir catches Nino and Pegabug lassoes her yo-yo to create a net to catch the Césaires safely.)
Pegabug: Kaalki, dismount! (Kaalki comes out from her glasses and transforms back to Ladybug. She brought down everybody back to the ground gently, including their tarantula as she traps it with her pot.)
Ladybug: Gotcha! (She hands it over to Otis.) Can you hold on to this for me, please?
(Otis grabs the pot with the tarantula on it.)
Ladybug: (to Cat Noir) Where did Shadow Moth go?
(Both look up on the roof, seeing Shadow Moth escape.)
Cat Noir: I think he felt the wind start to change.
Ladybug: This could've been the end of Shadow Moth. (looks down)

title: Sentibubbler/Transcript
text:
Sentibubbler/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: (his ring starts to beep again) You know, I really thought today was the end of Cat Noir. But you guys really had it under control.
(Ladybug smiles.)
Ladybug and Cat Noir: Pound it!
(Cat Noir jumps away. Ladybug approaches the Césaires.)
Ladybug: I guess you'll need a little something. I'll come back in a minute.
Ladybug: (hugs Rena Rouge) You rocked, Rena Rouge!
Rena Rouge: See? When someone trusts me with a "thing," I don't lose it.
Ladybug: (takes the terrarium from Rena Rouge) I never should've second-guessed letting you hold on to the Miraculous. (swings back to where the Césaires are)
Rena Rouge: Let's rest! (de-transforms)
(Ladybug gives Otis the terrarium and gently placed the tarantula inside. They all look at it with awe.)
Ladybug: Miraculous Ladybug! (She throws the pot up high as the wall that Cat Noir smashed earlier is fixed back to normal, organized the mess inside the Césaire residence and brought back the Césaires, along with Nino, safely back home. She swings inside Alya's room.) Spots off! (de-transforms)
(Marinette peeks at the door and runs to Alya and reunites with her.)
Nino: (in the background) I'm not really afraid of spiders.

title: Sentibubbler/Transcript
text:
Sentibubbler/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: You actually have Ladybug say that she would never ever give you the Miraculous of the Fox again?
Alya: Uh-huh.
Marinette: So, he'll never try to steal it from you again! Nightmare over!
Alya: Pretty sly, don't you think?
Marinette: Sly as a fox! You're a true superhero!
Alya: You aren't so bad either, Pegabug.
Alya and Marinette: Pound it!
Gabriel: (infuriated) Ladybug never makes a mistake! (cracks the tablet's screen and sits on the bed where Nathalie is lying)
Nathalie: Don't give up. Everyone makes mistakes, and one day, she'll make one, too. And when that day comes, (holds Gabriel's hand) your wish will come true.

title: Sewers
text:
Sewers - Intro
The sewers are the underground pipelines intended to collect the sewage and wastewater of the city of Paris.

title: Sewers
text:
Sewers - Description
The sewers are accessed through numerous manholes located throughout Paris. They provide access to various types of subsurface through wall-mounted ladders. The sewer tunnels are located under the Parisian boulevards and range in width from five to six meters. There are two alleys called banquettes that surround a more or less wide culvert filled with water. The walls are covered with piper through which drinking water, compressed air and Seine water pass.
The sewers of Paris are built with a slight slope to deliver wastewater to internal and external drains, which deliver water to sewage treatment plants located outside the capital. In the series, there is a large drop and sewage pool under the Trocadéro, to regulate the flow of water to avoid flooding, and a cloakroom for sewage works, which has lockers and a bench in the center. The sewers are also connected to the wind turbine in front of the Gare du Nord.

title: Sewers
text:
Sewers - Trivia
Ladybug, Cat Noir and their allies often use the sewers to hide and avoid detection.
The sewers has been involved in multiple events:
In "Catalyst", Ladybug de-evilized Vanisher.
In "Mayura", Ladybug and Cat Noir took refuge in the sewers to escape from the Scarlet Army.
In "Silencer", Bob Roth hid in the sewers to escape from the titular villain.
In "Desperada", Ladybug gave the Snake Miraculous to Adrien to transform into Aspik, and later to Luka into Viperion.
In "Ladybug", Nathalie created the titular sentimonster.
In "Mega Leech", Ladybug gave the Mouse Miraculous to Mylène to transform into Polymouse.
In "Ephemeral", Ladybug and Viperion discussed their plan to uncover Chat Noir's secret identity.
In "Evolution", Monarch travelled back to the past and tried to see Ladybug and Cat Noir detransform in "Mayura", but he was stopped by Ladybug and Rabbit Noir.
In "Illusion", Ladybug ant Cat Noir were trapped there by the Collector illusion and Cat Noir was immobilized by an invisible mini Monarch, but Ladybug managed to escape the trap and "deakumatize" Gabriel Agreste.

title: Sewers
text:
Sewers - Trivia
In "Passion", Cat Noir took refuge in the sewers with a paralyzed Ladybug before lbeing forced to detransform. Later, Ladybug and Cat Noir exchanged their Miraculouses, becoming Lady Noire and Mister Bug once again.
In "El Toro De Piedra", Ivan hid from his akumatized father and was later comforted to continue being Minotaurox by Ladybug.
In "Vampigami", Marinette hid to transform into Ladybug after discovering someone had planted cameras in the cinema restroom to expose her secret identity.
She also calls on Purple Tigress and Pigella to help fight the akumatised villain.
