text:
Secret Protocol - Intro
"" is a season 6 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 25th written and produced episode of season 6. It is also the 156th written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Secret Protocol
text:
Secret Protocol - Synopsis
Marinette is organizing a surprise for Sabine's birthday. But it's her who will live a day full of surprises… not all of them pleasant.
Disney Channel
Marinette plans a surprise for Sabine's birthday, but she is the one who is in for a day of nonstop surprises.
Disney+
Marinette is in for a day of nonstop surprises.

title: Secret Protocol
text:
Secret Protocol - Plot
An image of City Hall is shown before the camera shows the Miraculers under City Hall in their meetup area. Ladybug tells them that the biggest secret for anyone to keep is their identity, after which she sends them a list of 2,782 protocols they have to follow. Everyone reads through them, with a few looking surprised and others looking annoyed. Ryuko asks if such a long list is necessary, and Ladybug responds that "you can never be too careful".
Marinette wakes up and grabs a snow globe from under her pillow, where her Ladybug earrings are stored. She then opens a wooden chamber where Tikki is staying. Marinette puts her snow globe near a window, shifts a book slightly, and sets an alert if anyone enters her room.

title: Secret Protocol
text:
Secret Protocol - Plot
Marinette heads to the main bakery where she sees Tom up early and is surprised. She then tells Tom she is going to bake a sponge cake for Sabine's birthday. Tom tells her that it is hard, but Marinette tells him it should be a super cake for Sabine. She starts putting the cake in the oven, then prepares a breakfast for Sabine. She tells Tom about a surprise pizza party for lunch. Alya, Adrien, and Nino call, and they say that the surprise lunch party is ready, while Marinette tells them, to their surprise, that the breakfast is ready. She hears Sabine and tells them that she will call them back. Sabine sees the surprise and thanks Marinette.
Suddenly, they hear the doorbell ring. As they open the door, they are surprised by "Uncle Wang."

title: Secret Protocol
text:
Secret Protocol - Plot
Uncle Wang wishes Sabine a happy birthday as Marinette realises that was the reason why he didn't call. Sabine then says to Marinette to not act surprised (she thought she had set it up), although this was not true. Marinette then proceeds to ask Uncle Wang why he didn't tell her. He responds with 'I wanted it to be a surprise for everyone', to which Sabine says: mission accomplished, and asks Marinette to get Uncle Wang set up in the guest room while she makes some tea.
As they are walking to the guest room, Marinette asks how long he will be staying. Uncle Wang says only until tomorrow morning, as he has to work at the restaurant. Marinette then whispers to him about the surprise pizza party they had planned for Sabine. Uncle Wang says, 'That's lovely,' and 'it won't be the only surprise,' as he too had a gift for her. Marinette then hears her phone alarm go off, and Marinette lets Uncle Wang know that she needs to take the sponge cake out of the oven. He then says to her, 'I'm going to freshen up while you do that'. Marinette then leaves.

title: Secret Protocol
text:
Secret Protocol - Plot
However, as Marinette is about to take the sponge cake out of the oven, her phone alarm goes off, alerting her that someone is in her room. Horrified, she excuses herself to return to her room, but finds that her snow globe music box was knocked onto the floor and the window was open; no one was there. She closes the window and fixes her bed before coming back downstairs, but finds that the cake was burned in the meantime. Tom assures her they will make a new one as they still have time, and closes the bakery to do that.

title: Secret Protocol
text:
Secret Protocol - Plot
Later, Wang presents Marinette with some earrings that he says are from Grandma Fen, but sensing trouble, Marinette pardons herself to go get a gift for Wang. In her room, she decides to implement one of her secret protocols with Tikki. When she returns, she presents a new hat to Wang, while she takes off what appears to be the Ladybug Miraculous and puts on Fen's earrings, making Wang very happy. They then leave to go to the picnic that the other Miraculers are setting up for Sabine, but Wang asks to return to the house as he forgot Sabine's gift. Tom gives him the keys, and he heads back, but after missing two ferry boats, the Dupain-Chengs are getting worried, before Wang suddenly cuts his way out of the house, akumatized as Kung Food again. Unknown to anyone, this is being watched from another rooftop by Alya, transformed into Renabug.

title: Secret Protocol
text:
Secret Protocol - Plot
It turns out, Marinette's secret protocol implementation was contacting Alya, warning her of what was about to happen, and Alya prepares for it as Marinette sends Tikki and the Ladybug Miraculous to Alya, despite Tikki's attempts to protest. Once meeting up with Alya and Trixx, Tikki hands the Ladybug Miraculous to Alya, who transforms with Tikki into Scarabella. Using the Miraculous Call to contact Cat Noir, Polymouse, Carapace, and Minotaurox for aid, Scarabella then unifies Tikki and Trixx to become Renabug, a fusion of Scarabella and Rena Rouge.

title: Secret Protocol
text:
Secret Protocol - Plot
Back in the present, as Kung Food accuses Marinette of stealing his gift to Sabine, he takes her hostage. Renabug summons an illusion of Ladybug with Mirage, and cleverly makes it appear that Ladybug is legit, as even the other Miraculers refer to her as if she were real, while Renabug stays out of sight to avoid blowing the deception. However, seeing Marinette in danger, Cat Noir becomes enraged and tries to save her himself, nearly ruining the plan. However, while Polymouse returns to the bakery to find Wang's gift, Minotaurox frees Carapace, and Cat Noir soon manages to free Marinette from Kung Food, also managing to stop a potential strike on the Ladybug illusion that would have dispelled her and exposed the ruse, before he is restrained by Carapace and Minotaurox with Shell-ter and Resistance. Polymouse then arrives with Sabine's gift, having found where it was hidden, and a remorseful Kung Food apologises before willingly breaking his akumatization and returning to normal. Renabug and her Ladybug illusion then use Miraculous Ladybug to repair all the damage.

title: Secret Protocol
text:
Secret Protocol - Plot
Marinette returns home, where Renabug arrives and divides back into Rena Rouge, returning Tikki and the Ladybug Miraculous to Marinette, and believing she was right to take those precautions. She tells her they'll see her at the picnic later before taking her leave. Marinette then collapses in exhaustion, thinking she is getting too paranoid over things, though Tikki reassures her it is fine since she's got a lot of secrets and responsibilities to deal with at the moment.
Some time later, Marinette has changed into a beautiful qipao dress as she and her parents prepare to head to the picnic, until they get a phone call from Fei Wu, revealing that Wang was still with her at the Thousand Delights restaurant in Shanghai.
This causes the Dupain-Chengs to become terrified, wondering how Wang is still with Fei when he was just with them in Paris.
Sensing trouble and scared out of her wits, Marinette quietly puts the Ladybug Miraculous back on in place of Grandma Fen's earrings, and tells her parents to stay there while she checks out the guest bedroom, leaving them hugging each other in fear.

title: Secret Protocol
text:
Secret Protocol - Plot
Despite her own fear and trepidation as she reaches for the door handle, when she opens the door and looks in, the room is empty, and there is no sign of "Wang" anywhere, leaving Marinette aghast.
As Tom and Sabine join her and become paranoid over what's going on, seeing the fear on her parents' faces, Marinette takes Sabine's cellphone, ends the call from Wang and Fei, and tells her parents that "they" have something they must tell them.
Confused, Sabine asks who "we" is, and Marinette, with great reluctance, decides to make one of the most life-changing and difficult decisions she's ever had to make in her life.
She calls out Tikki, revealing the Kwami of Creation to her parents before saying her transformation command and transforming into Ladybug right in front of them, leaving Tom and Sabine in shock that their daughter was really Paris' superheroine all along...

title: Secret Protocol
text:
Secret Protocol - Plot Developments
In order to counteract Chrysalis' attempts to discover her secret identity (and possibly all the other Miraculers'), Marinette develops safety protocols for herself and teammates to help them keep their identities hidden. In total, she has developed 2,782 safety protocols for the team.
Ladybug's secret protocols and her response that one "can never be too cautious" are probably a consequence of her experiences with the new Butterfly holder in "Miraculous London", "Vampigami" and "Queen of the Dreadzone".
Some of Marinette's safety protocols include:
Secret Protocol #78: Vigilance in regards to one's secret identity in case of guests, especially surprise guests.
Secret Protocol #842: In case of a secret identity being in danger, set a trap to fool the Butterfly Holder and/or their Akumatized villain.
Marinette has also made several safety protocols for herself as the Guardian and leader of the Miraculers; these include:
She sleeps with fake earrings, while keeping her miraculous inside a snow globe that is rigged to only open with her fingerprint that she keeps under her pillow while sleeping. Once she wakes up, she takes the real ones and keeps the fake ones in her pocket.

title: Secret Protocol
text:
Secret Protocol - Plot Developments
Tikki now sleeps in a special hidden compartment.
She has an alarm connected to her phone that causes a lullaby to play on the latter whenever someone grabs the snowglobe or senses loud sounds or voices, alerting her to any undesirable presence at her room.
She has key points on her room (her bed cover, a book and her snowglobe) in precise positions that allow her to know if anyone has been searching her room.
In case her secret identity is threatened, Marinette sends Tikki with her Miraculous to Alya while using the fake ones. As Scarabella, Alya summons the necessary heroes (so the heroes know it's sent from the Ladybug Miraculous) if an akumatized villain or Chrysalis appears and then unifies the Ladybug and Fox Miraculous to become Renabug so that she can use Mirage to create an illusion of Ladybug, while also being able to use Lucky Charm and Miraculous Renabug.
Kim is revealed to not know he can clean his own room, as his parents do it for him.
Marinette throws a surprise Pizza party for her mother's birthday, which is organized with Adrien, Alya and Nino's help.

title: Secret Protocol
text:
Secret Protocol - Plot Developments
Adrien is the only one seen wearing an apron, indicating he's the one who mainly prepares the pizzas to be backed, again showcasing his culinary skills from "Climatiqueen", "Vampigami" and "Yaksi Gozen".
Uncle Wang is revealed to call Sabine on her birthday every year, but accidentally calls early because he always forgets the time difference. This time, however, he remembered, probably because he met Cerise during her stay in Shanghai.
Cerise/Chrysalis either akumatizes herself into or somehow manifests a copy of Wang that is also able to turn into Kung Food, Wang's akumatized alter-ego, to spy on Marinette to find out if she is Ladybug (and steal her earrings if so). This explains why she went to Shanghai in the previous episode to meet Wang, so she learned personal details and his general mannerisms.
It's revealed that Marinette's great-grandmother, Wang and Yan's mother, was called Fen.

title: Secret Protocol
text:
Secret Protocol - Plot Developments
Marinette realizes that Chrysalis suspects of her being Ladybug and is really close to discovering her. However, after seeing how they were able to infiltrate her home and even allow her to drop her guard, Marinette, realizing her secret is putting her parents in direct danger, reveals to them that she is Ladybug.
This makes Tom and Sabine the eighth and ninth people to know this in the current timeline (not counting the Kwamis).
They are also the second and third people that Marinette has told willingly, rather than being found out, following Alya.

title: Secret Protocol
text:
Secret Protocol - Trivia
This is the second episode of the series that, excluding Season 5 episodes and their unique naming scheme, is not named after a featured antagonist, after "Ladybug & Cat Noir".
As of this episode, all members of Marinette's family who have been seen have celebrated their birthday on-screen.
As of "Nemesis", Chrysalis is confirmed to have the ability to shapeshift, which would have allowed her to disguise herself as Wang Cheng. It is currently unknown where she gained that power or how it precisely operates.
It is possible she akumatized herself twice, using one akuma to shapeshift into Wang Cheng and another to give herself Kung Food's powers. Although, the holder of the Butterfly Miraculous can only energize one akuma/kamiko at a time, she may have been able to evolve her powers in order to produce multiple ultrakumas.
It's unclear what the symbolism of the pizza box created by the Lucky Charm was, as Renabug neither used it in the fight, nor was inspired by it how to defeat the villain.
It's possible, however, that the box might be related to the pizza picnic Marinette, Adrien, Alya and Nino were organizing for Sabine, which Marinette informed "Wang" about.

title: Secret Protocol
text:
Secret Protocol - Trivia
This marks the second time that someone other than Marinette, Adrien, or Gabriel is shown to perform unification, following Alix in "Evolution". Alya unified the Ladybug Miraculous with the Fox while she was Scarabella.
On April 8, Bing Yin, Wang's French VA, posted a behind-the-scenes image which seems to be from the scene between Marinette and "Wang" at the bakery. However, there is no shot in the episode which matches the image, and "Wang" doesn't wear his bag during that scene.
References
Marinette's 2,782 secret protocols demonstrate her excessive thoroughness in her instructions, previously shown by the 675 pro-tips about being Ladybug which she sent Alya in "Hack-San".
This is the second time a fake copy of the Ladybug Miraculous is seen, following "The Dark Owl".
Marinette had previously expressed a desire to introduce Tikki to her parents in the Miraculous Secrets webisode "Tikki".
Tikki's tea set, first seen in "Climatiqueen", is among the decorations in her sleeping hideout.
Secret compartments were also seen in "Heartfixer", where Marinette hides her many diaries.

title: Secret Protocol
text:
Secret Protocol - Trivia
The baby monitor, book and snow globe were visible in the backgrounds of many episodes throughout the season, including "The Dark Castle", "Noe", "A Fairy Good Night", "Riginarazione", "Heartfixer", "Lady Chaos" and "Sadnansi".
Cat Noir furiously attacks Kung Food because he captured Marinette, similarly to his anger towards Scarabella when they first met in "Hack-San", the Darker Owl in "Jubilation" and Dark Humor in "Derision".
The cold open is similar to the one in "Revelator", where the camera shows the Hôtel de Ville before panning down to the ghost metro station to show Ladybug guiding the Miraculers' training to be superheroes.
But when Marinette was used as the hostage as Renabug, Alya should've paid more attention to Cat Noir and the fury he unleashed on "Kung Food", she should've found it strange why he was fighting like that. Unknown to them both, Cat Noir pulled "a red flag", by showing his fury to the shapeshifting Chrysalis, similar to "Elation", he exposed his feelings towards Marinette in front the villain.

title: Seine/Movie
text:
Seine/Movie - Intro
The Seine is a 776-kilometer (482 mi) long river and an important commercial waterway within the Paris Basin in the north of France.

title: Seine/Movie
text:
Seine/Movie - Description
In Paris, the Seine is almost 13 kilometers long. Its width varies between 30 meters and 200 meters, and its depth also varies between 3.40 meters and 5.70 meters.
The river divides the city into two areas, called the Right Bank (northern part) and the Left Bank (southern part).
Entering Paris from the southeast between the 12th and 13th arrondissements, it takes a northwest direction until reaching the historic center of Paris. Here the Seine splits into two arms to form two islands, Île Saint-Louis and Île de la Cité.
Further on, at Place de la Concorde, the river heads west. Just before the Champ de Mars and the Trocadéro, the Seine begins to follow a south-southwest direction.
It is divided one last time in two by an artificial island, Île aux Cygnes, before leaving the capital between the 16th and 15th arrondissements.
All along its course, the Seine is surrounded by quays where Parisians like to walk and sit, as well as parks and gardens to enjoy the calm of the river on sunny days.

title: Seine/Movie
text:
Seine/Movie - Trivia
The banks of the Seine in Paris have been classified as a World Heritage Site by UNESCO under the title "Rives de Seine" since 1991.
Les Sources de la Seine, located at Source-Seine (21), belong to the municipality of Paris.
There are Gallo-Roman remains classified as a historical monument since 1945.
The entire archaeological and landscape site was registered as a Historical Monument in 2016, then classified in 2020.
The Seine flows from east to west. The northern side of the river is called Rive droite, while the southern side is called Rive gauche, in relation to someone facing downstream.

title: Secret Protocol/Transcript
text:
Secret Protocol/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: Being a superhero means first and foremost being able to keep a secret, the ultimate secret being your identity, and you've already figured out it's not that easy.
King Monkey: Yeah, so true. You got to even be careful when your parents clean your room.
Polymouse: You're old enough to clean your own room, King Monkey.
King Monkey: I am?
(Polymouse, Minotaurox, and Carapace laugh at his reaction.)
Ladybug: Anyway, we've got to be prepared and ready to act in any and all situations. Even the most unexpected, which is why I've come up with a few safety protocols! (She presses a button on her yo-yo to send a message to the rest of the Miraculers, who take out their weapons to scroll through a long holographic message, looking shocked at the number of protocols.)
Cat Noir: Uh, m'lady, how many protocols are there?
Ladybug: 2,782.
Pegasus: For real?!
Minotaurox: I've never read anything so long!
Ryuko: Isn't this a bit...extreme, Ladybug?
Ladybug: You can never be too cautious.
[ Theme Song ]

title: Secret Protocol/Transcript
text:
Secret Protocol/Transcript - Intro
(Marinette sits up on her bed, yawns, and removes her fake earrings. She then takes a snow globe playing music out from under her pillow, scans her finger on a fingerprint scanner at the bottom of the snow globe, then twists the top off to reveal her real earrings. She twists the top back on then opens a wooden panel next to her bed to reveal a tiny room for Tikki.)
Marinette: It's time!
Tikki: (yawns and closes the wooden panel) Good morning, Marinette. Did you sleep well?
Marinette: Very well, thanks Tikki! How about you?
Tikki: I could use more sleep, but your mom's birthday only comes once a year!
Marinette: (yawns) Luckily.
(She changes into her normal clothes behind a changing wall and puts her fake earrings into her pocket. She then activates her baby monitor which is connected to her phone.)
Marinette: Test. One, two, one, two.
(An alarm goes off on her phone which she switches off. She then puts her phone in her purse which Tikki also hides in, tilts a book on her desk to the side a little bit, and puts the snow globe in front of her window.)
Marinette: Safety protocol #1 in place.
Marinette: How do you get up so early every day, dad?

title: Secret Protocol/Transcript
text:
Secret Protocol/Transcript - Intro
Tom: It's the baker's superpower, sweetie! Here, I've already prepped all the ingredients you'll need for the fraisier cake. I have to say, you haven't picked the easiest cake to bake.
Marinette: Mom deserves the best cake in the world! (Gasps) Shoot! I forgot something! I'll be right back!
(Marinette runs back upstairs, creating a lot of weird noises that makes Tom look slightly worried. She then runs back down now wearing her purse and awkwardly giggling.)
Tom: Do you really need your purse to bake?
Marinette: I... like having it on me, it gives me...inspiration!
(Tom shrugs and chuckles.)
(Time skip to a while after Marinettes finished mixing the ingredients. She puts the cake into the oven.)
Marinette: I'll get moms breakfast ready while it bakes.
Tom: Here's my small contribution. (He hands her a box with two croissants shaped like a heart in it.)
Marinette: Awwww!
Adrien: (Through Marinette's phone) We're almost done with the pizzas. What about you, did you manage to get everything done?
Marinette: Yup! The cakes in the oven and breakfast is ready-!

title: Secret Protocol/Transcript
text:
Secret Protocol/Transcript - Intro
Marinette's phone shows her on a video call with Adrien, where him, Alya, and Nino are making a bunch of small pizzas at the Agreste mansion's kitchen.)
Alya: Are you saying she's getting a surprise breakfast on top of our surprise pizza party?
Nino: It's the day of nonstop surprises!
Marinette: (hears a door roll open) She's coming! Gotta go! See you later at the Champ de Mars!
Sabine: (Walks in carrying the laundry basket and gasps) Wow!
Marinette: Ta-da! Happy birthday, mom!
Sabine: (Kisses her daughter's cheek) Thank you, sweetie. (yawns)
Marinette: I bet you Uncle Wang phoned you in the middle of the night to wish you a happy birthday as usual.
Sabine: Actually, he didn't. He usually does forget that daytime in Shanghai means nighttime here but not this time.
(The doorbell suddenly rings. Sabine goes to answer the door.)
Wang: Suprise!
Sabine and Marinette: Uncle Wang?!
Wang: Happy birthday, Xia Bing!
Sabine: Oh, thank you! I'm so happy to see you!
(Wang hugs Sabine and kisses Marinettes cheeks.)
Marinette: That's why you didn't call mom last night, you were on a plane! (Wang winks at her)
Sabine: Don't act so surprised, I'm sure you were in on it.

title: Secret Protocol/Transcript
text:
Secret Protocol/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: I wasn't! Why didn't you tell me you were coming?
Wang: I wanted it to be a surprise for everyone.
Sabine: Well, mission accomplished. Marinette, go get your uncle settled in the guest room. I'll make you some tea.
(Sabine leaves while Marinette and Wang head to the guest room).
Marinette: How long will you be staying with us?
Wang: I'm leaving tomorrow morning. I can't be away from the restaurant for too long.
Marinette: But can't Fei manage on her own now?
Wang: She can, but I have my habits and it's not easy to break habits.
Marinette: Well, anyway, it's great that your here for mom. (Whispers in his ear) We're throwing a surprise pizza party for her at lunchtime.
Wang: That sounds lovely, Marinette, and it won't be the only surprise. (Takes a gift box out of his bag) I have a very special gift for Xia Bing of great sentimental value. It will touch your mother deep in her heart.
Marinette: Ooh la la! I can't wait to see it! (her phone suddenly rings.) The sponge cake is ready. I got to take it out of the oven. Another surprise for mom!
Wang: Wonderful. I'm going to freshen up while you do that, it'll feel good after such a long journey.

title: Secret Protocol/Transcript
text:
Secret Protocol/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Everything you need is in the bathroom cabinet. See ya!
(Back in the kitchen, Marinette puts on her oven mitts while Tom bakes more croissants.)
Marinette: Can you believe it? Coming all the way from Shanghai just for one day!
Tom: Uncle Wang is so kind. He's more like a father to your mom, you know.
Marinette: Yes, he's even brought her- (When she opens the oven, her baby monitor alarm starts ringing from her phone. Looking horrified, she closes the oven, takes off her mitts, and checks the alarm on her phone.) What could- (She starts running to the stairs)
Tom: Marinette!
Marinette: I left something in my room!
Tom: Again?
Marinette: Someone's been in my room!
Tikki: Maybe it was just your mom!
Marinette: Or a supervillain! Safety protocol #1! Hide Tikki!
Marinette: Did you go in my room, mom?
Sabine: Uh, no. Why?
Marinette: No reason!
Sabine: Is everything okay, Marinette?
Marinette: Uh, yeah, yeah. I just forgot to make my bed. And I also left the window open.
(Marinette looks out the window before shutting it and then looks at her book. She turns the sound from the snow globe off and puts it back in front of the window. She then completely makes her bed.)

title: Secret Protocol/Transcript
text:
Secret Protocol/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: There. The room looks much better with a made-up bed.
Marinette: Uncle Wang didn't drink his tea?
Sabine: No, I think he's still in his room.
(Marinette runs over to the guest room door and puts her ear to it, hearing Uncle Wang sing in Mandarin inside the room.)
Marinette: (sighs in relief) It must've been a draft. Yeah, it was just a draft.
Tikki: Of course, Marinette! You're probably getting worried over nothing.
Marinette: Maybe, but that's what we have to do whenever we have guests. Especially unexpected surprise ones, as per the rules of safety protocol #78.
Marinette: Ugh! No!
Tom: Is everything okay, Marinette?
Marinette: I'm okay but the sponge cake...not so much. Aghh, I ruined everything!
Tom': Don't worry cupcake, we still have time to bake another one. I'll close the shop. (He closes the window blinds of the bakery.)
(Time skip to later in the bakery, a new cake has been made, and Tom puts a strawberry on top of it.)
Tom: And voila!
Marinette: Just in time for the party! You're the best baker and the best dad! (Kisses his cheek)
Tom: Get ready, I'll go get your mom. (He opens the doors to the stairs to see Wang standing there.) Oh! Uncle Wang you scared me!

title: Secret Protocol/Transcript
text:
Secret Protocol/Transcript - Intro
(Marinette looks suspiciously at her great-uncle.)
Wang: Hello Tom. How's everything?
Tom: Good. It's just going to be such a wonderful day filled with great surprises thanks to you! I'll go take care of Sabine, you both wait for us here.
(Tom goes upstairs while Wang comes in to talk to Marinette, who's just put the cake in a box.)
Wang: You look worried. What's wrong?
Marinette: Nothing it's just that...uh...mom can't see the cake! It's a surprise!
Wang: I too have a surprise for...you, Marinette.
Marinette: A surprise for me?
Wang: I was cleaning and found this in an old chest that belonged to Grandma Fen.
(He puts a small jewelry box on the counter. Marinette opens it to find golden ladybug earrings.)
Marinette: Oh...uh...(awkward giggle) ladybug earrings...they're- they're gold!
Wang: I hope you like them as much as she did. Don't you like them?
Marinette: Uh...
Wang: Maybe you don't like ladybugs.
Marinette: Yes. Yes, of course I do!
Wang: Then go on, try them on!
Marinette: What, like, now?
Wang: Why wait? I'm sure they'll look great on you.
Marinette: Uh, okay, I'll put them on sure.
(Wang smiles and chuckles.)
Marinette: But first I have a gift to give you too!

title: Secret Protocol/Transcript
text:
Secret Protocol/Transcript - Intro
Wang: That's very kind of you, Marinette, but you don't have too.
Marinette: Oh, but I insist! That's me, whenever someone offers me a gift, I always offer something in return. It's a matter of principle!
Tom: But before we go, I have to blindfold you!
Sabine: Another surprise? Oh, you're all spoiling me today!
(Marinette barges in and starts running up the stairs to her room.)
Marinette: He thinks he can trick me, but he doesn't know just how cautious I am! There's a safety protocol for everything!
Tikki: What are you talking about?
Marinette: Something's off with Uncle Wang, he's acting...weird. The new Butterfly Miraculous holder must've akumatized him in order to gain control of him.
Tikki: If he's been akumatized where's his costume? What are his powers? And how could he know that you're Ladybug?
Marinette: (Gasps) You're right! He's not akumatized! It's worse than that, he is the new Butterfly Miraculous holder!
Tikki: What!?
Marinette: It's obvious! He's giving me earrings to force me to take off my miraculous so he can seize it!
Tikki: Or it's just a gift from your uncle who loves you very much!

title: Secret Protocol/Transcript
text:
Secret Protocol/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Earrings shaped like ladybugs, surprise, surprise! And now it all makes sense. The music box didn't fall because of a draft, it was him! He was snooping in my room looking for my miraculous!
Tikki: Your vigilance is starting to look like paranoia, don't you think?
Marinette: Me!? Paranoid? We'll see about that! Safety protocol 842, I'm going to set a counter trap for him in order to dodge his trap while pretending that I didn't figure out that he was trying to trap me!
Marinette: There! For you.
Wang: (unwraps the gift to see a cap that looks like a chef's hat) A cap!
Marinette: It's shaped like a chef's hat for my favorite chef, that way you can wear it outside and in the kitchen!
Wang: And I'll always look stylish. Thank you very much, Marinette. Your turn now. (Holds the earrings out to her.)
Marinette: Yes, my turn. (Takes off her earrings)
Wang: I can hold them for you if you want.
Marinette: ...No need! Thank you. (She puts on the golden ladybug earrings.)
Wang: Perfect! Ladybugs look beautiful on you.
Marinette: Thanks Uncle Wang. (She starts taking off the earrings)

title: Secret Protocol/Transcript
text:
Secret Protocol/Transcript - Intro
Wang: (Gasps) You're already taking them off? That's a shame. When you have them on you remind me of Grandma Fen. I miss her so much.
Marinette: (Sees Wang's sad look) Oh, okay. I'll keep them on. (She puts the golden earring back on and puts the old ones in her purse.)
Wang: Hm. You couldn't make me happier.
Tom: (Leading a blindfolded Sabine out of the bakery) Let's go! Is everyone ready?
Sabine: Where to?
Tom: You'll never guess!
(Wang and Marinette also follow them out.)
Sabine: Am I hearing the Seine? Oh! We're taking a river taxi!
Tom: We can't keep any secrets from you, my love, but the surprise isn't over just yet!
Wang: Shoot! My surprise for Xia Bing, I left it in my room!
Marinette: It's okay. We'll wait for you here.
Wang: Tom.
Tom: Yeah?
Wang: I forgot something inside. Can I borrow the keys to the building?
(Tom hands him the keys and Wang leaves to go back to the bakery, Marinette eyeing him suspiciously. Marinette looks back at the bakery, a random rooftop, and checks the alarm on her phone while other people go onto the river taxis.)
Tom: That's the second boat we're missing. He's been gone for a while now.

title: Secret Protocol/Transcript
text:
Secret Protocol/Transcript - Intro
Sabine: Marinette, maybe you should go and find out if Uncle Wang needs help.
(Suddenly, they hear the sound of a sword slashing and the ground starts to shake. They look back at the bakery and see that Kung Food has slashed a part of the building off with his pizza sword. The villain jumps down to the seine and puts his sword back in his bag, replacing it with sausage nunchucks that has a durian at the end of it.)
Kung Food: Marinette!
(Marinette looks at the random rooftop again, where we discover Renabug watching the situation through her flute.)
Renabug: An akumatized villain did show up to attack Marinette. She was totally right to initiate the secret protocol!
Marinette: I'm going to set a counter trap for him in order to dodge his trap while pretending that I didn't figure out that he was trying to trap me!
(She takes out her phone and calls Alya, who's setting up the picnic at the Champ de Mars park with Adrien and Nino.)
Alya: Don't tell me, you're late. Again.
Marinette: Yes, but for a good reason this time. Initiating secret protocol.
(Alya looks shocked for a second before Marinette ends the call to take off her earrings and give them to Tikki.)

title: Secret Protocol/Transcript
text:
Secret Protocol/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Take these to Alya.
Tikki: Marinette, you didn't even make sure that-
Marinette: There's no time to argue Tikki, do it!
(Tikki gasps, taking the earrings and flying out the window. Marinette takes the fake copies of the earrings out of her pocket and puts them on.)
Alya: Tikki, spots on! (Transforms into Scarabella. She then opens the Miraculous Call system on her yo-yo and clicks on the icons of the black cat, turtle, mouse, and ox.)
Trixx: This should make for a beautiful family reunion!
Scarabella: You bet it will.
[Transformation Sequence]
Scarabella: Tikki, Trixx, unify! (transforms into Renabug)
Renabug: If he seizes Marinettes earrings it means he suspects her of being Ladybug.
Kung Food: Grrr, Marinette! Where is the surprise gift for Xia Bing?
Sabine: Uncle Wang!?
Kung Food: Uncle Wang came specially from Shanghai to give you a very precious gift, but it's gone because Marinette stole it! So now Kung Food will get the gift back! (He wraps his nunchucks around Marinette)
Marinette: That's nonsense! I didn't steal anything! Ahhhhh! (Kung Food pulls her over to him, making her drop and ruin the cake.)

title: Secret Protocol/Transcript
text:
Secret Protocol/Transcript - Intro
Kung Food: The gift was gone from my bag, and you were the only one who knew it was there!
Tom: Let go of my daughter now!
Kung Food: No one will stop Kung Food from getting his gift back! Take that! (He takes bread dough out of his bag and throws it at Tom; the dough grows over him making him stuck.) Ha ha! A baker caught up in bread dough, what a tasty irony! (To Marinette) So, where did you hide it? (He opens her purse and takes out the fake earring copies) No gift in here. Only the cheap jewelry that you like better than Grandma Fen's precious earrings! You don't deserve my present; I'm taking it back!
(Renabug watches him take the precious earrings off of Marinette, putting both sets of earrings in his bag.)
Renabug: Okay, he has the earrings. Either he brings them to the new Butterfly Miraculous holder, or he is the new Butterfly Miraculous holder. (She plays her flute) Mirage! (She creates an illusion of Ladybug who jumps down near the battle.)
"Ladybug": Kung Food, you shouldn't steal family jewels!
Renabug: Lucky Charm!
"Ladybug": Lucky Charm!
(At the same time that Renabug gets a pizza box as her lucky charm object, she makes her Ladybug illusion get a pizza box as well.)

title: Secret Protocol/Transcript
text:
Secret Protocol/Transcript - Intro
Renabug: A pizza box? What am I supposed to-? Never mind. I'll figure it out later.
(Cat Noir and Carapace join "Ladybug".)
Cat Noir: Hey, m'lady. What's on the menu today?
"Ladybug": An akumatized chef with a side of angry!
Cat Noir: Yum! (Gasps as he sees Kung Food holding Marinette.)
"Ladybug": Carapace, trap Kung Food inside a shield. And you, Cat Noir-
Cat Noir: I set Marinette Dupain-Cheng free!
"Ladybug": No, wait!
(Cat Noir jumps down, angrily crawling on all fours towards the villain.)
Renabug: Ugh, cats always do their own thing.
Carapace: Shell-ter!
(Before the shield materializes around him, Kung Food jumps back and throws bread dough at Cat Noir, leaving him stuck.)
Renabug: That's what happens when you don't listen.
(Kung Food then throws bread dough at Carapace.)
Carapace: Shell-ter! (The bread dough grows to cover his entire shield) Unshield! (The shield drops but Carapace is still stuck in the bread dough) Ladybug I'm stuck! Help!
"Ladybug": I wish I could Carapace, but-
Kung Food: Ladybug!!
"Ladybug": I have an emergency! Sorry!
(The illusion jumps away before Kung Food can touch it, leaving the villain to follow it.)

title: Secret Protocol/Transcript
text:
Secret Protocol/Transcript - Intro
Renabug: Sorry, my turtle-kins, but if my illusion touches anything, it'll disappear!
(Kung Food, still holding Marinette, chases the Ladybug illusion on the rooftops while throwing bread dough at it. Renabug runs on the opposite side of the rooftops, watching the battle.)
Renabug: If Kung Food thought he had the Miraculous, he'd know that this is an illusion and not the real Ladybug!
Cat Noir: Cataclysm! (His power destroys the dough prison around him and sets him free. He immediately flings himself back to the battle using his staff.) Hold on, Marinette!
(Kung Food throws chip projectiles and pineapple bombs at the Ladybug illusion, but the illusion dodges every weapon and is eventually joined by Minotaurox and Polymouse)
Minotaurox: Hey, Ladybug!
Polymouse: What's the plan?
"Ladybug": Minotaurox-
Renabug: (Speaking through her illusion) you set Carapace free!
"Ladybug": He's trapped near the riverbanks, okay?
Minotaurox: On it, Ladybug!
"Ladybug": Polymouse, you go search the Dupain-Cheng house for Kung Food's gift.
Polymouse: Got it!
Marinette: Uncle Wang, I'm sure we can find the gift calm down! Let's go home and look for it together.

title: Secret Protocol/Transcript
text:
Secret Protocol/Transcript - Intro
Kung Food: Later! Right now, I have to bring Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous to the person who gave me my powers!
Renabug: He'd never say that if he knew that Marinette's earrings were Ladybug's earrings. What if he's just poor Uncle Wang who got akumatized because of the whole missing gift thing?
(Kung Food jumps up and gets closer to the Ladybug illusion, about to hit her with his nunchucks which scares Renabug and Marinette as one hit would make the illusion disappear and reveal their plan.)
Cat Noir: Marinette! (Jumps at Kung Food and blocks his nunchucks with his staff) Let go of her or you'll regret it!
Kung Food: (Takes his pizza sword out of his bag) I only need one hand to get rid of you for good, scrawny cat! And to seize your precious ring!
Cat Noir: We'll see about that!
Polymouse: Multitude!
(All of the tiny Polymouse clones jump inside the house, checking every area of the guest room and bakery until one clone eventually finds the gift inside a wooden box in the guest room.)
Polymouse: (Through earpiece) Ladybug, we found the gift.
Cat Noir: So, big chef, what's cooking now!?

title: Secret Protocol/Transcript
text:
Secret Protocol/Transcript - Intro
(They continue to fight with Kung Food hitting Cat Noir's staff away. Cat Noir continues to dodge the pizza sword slashes and pineapple bombs, eventually grabbing his staff back and extending it to hit Kung Food in the shoulder holding Marinette, making him drop her as the hero catches her.)
Cat Noir: Phew!
(Kung Food's pizza sword is knocked away but he throws more pineapple bombs at Minotaurox and Carapace.)
Minotaurox: Resistance!
(The pineapple bombs that directly hit Minotaurox disappear, not exploding and having no effect on him. Carapace throws his shield at the villain as Minotaurox tries to hit him with his mallet. Kung Food blocks the attacks with a durian weapon until  Minotaurox grabs one of his wrists, and Carapace puts a shield around his other hand.)
Carapace: Shell-ter!
(Cat Noir with Marinette, the Ladybug illusion, and Polymouse holding the gift all jump back down to the battle.)
Polymouse: No one stole Kung Food's gift; it was in the wardrobe!
Marinette: See uncle? You just put it in another spot.

title: Secret Protocol/Transcript
text:
Secret Protocol/Transcript - Intro
Kung Food: Huh? (Gasps) I remember now. (He drops his durian weapon.) I hid it there so Xia Bing wouldn't see if she came into the room! My dear Marinette, my memory plays dirty tricks on me! Please forgive me the old man I'm becoming for accusing you like this. What a disgrace! (The butterfly mask appears over his face, and he breaks out of it, the Ultrakuma flying out of his hat and turning back into a white butterfly, turning Kung Food back into Wang.)
Renabug: (Hiding on a nearby rooftop, watching the scene) His rejection of the akuma means he just fell victim to his negative emotions, nothing more. Marinette was wrong. Miraculous Renabug!
"Ladybug": Miraculous Ladybug!
(The magic ladybugs repair all the damage caused by Kung Food, freeing Tom and fixing the Dupain-Cheng home and Sabine's cake.)
The Miraculers: Pound it!
Wang: I'm truly sorry, Xia Bing, I've ruined your birthday.
Sabine: Don't worry Uncle Wang, the day isn't over yet.
Tom: We'll have the picnic at snack time; it's no big deal!
Wang: Marinette, I'm sorry I pushed you to wear Grandma Fen's earrings. (He puts the earrings back into Marinette's hands.)

title: Secret Protocol/Transcript
text:
Secret Protocol/Transcript - Intro
Sabine: (Gasps) These belonged to Grandma Fen? They're so beautiful!
Marinette: I really do love them, but special earrings deserve a special outfit I'll go change so I can wear them!
Wang: You're filling my heart with happiness, Marinette. I'm going to lie down while you get ready, I need too after all the emotions of today.
(Wang enters the guest room, while Marinette and her parents go back into the main area.)
Renabug: Divide! (Transforms back into Rena Rouge and gives the earrings back to Marinette) Turns out he wasn't the Butterfly Miraculous holder after all but just your Uncle Wang.
Tikki: There was no need to get so worried!
Marinette: Yes, I read the situation all wrong. Uncle Wang wasn't acting weird; he was probably just tired after a long trip. The ladybug earrings were just a coincidence, and the music box fell because of a draft. (Sighs) Sorry I initiated the secret protocol over this.
Rena Rouge: You can never be too cautious like you always say. Even though maybe you were a bit too cautious on this one. See you later at the picnic! (Leaves the room)

title: Secret Protocol/Transcript
text:
Secret Protocol/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: I'm sorry, Tikki. I didn't take your advice, and I even snapped at you. (She drops down to lay on the rug) I don't know what's up with me. I have so many secrets to protect and it's making me completely paranoid.
Tikki: Don't worry, Marinette. This is only because you have so many responsibilities, don't think about it anymore! Just go and enjoy your mom's birthday!
Marinette: I'm so lucky to have you in my life.
(Marinette and Tikki cuddle.)
Marinette: (off-screen) I'm ready to go! (She goes down the stairs wearing her qipao and twirls around to showcase her new outfit.)
Tom: Oh... You look beautiful, sweetie!
Sabine: The qipao looks so lovely on you!
(Marinette chuckles at their compliment. Sabine's phone rings.)
Sabine: Oh, it's Fei! I hope everything's okay with the restaurant in Shanghai. (answers the call)
Fei: Hello, Sabine!
Sabine: Hello, Fei! Do you need to speak with Uncle Wang?
Fei: (on the phone) Why would I want to speak to him? He's right here with me.
Fei and Wang: (on the phone) Happy birthday, Xia Bing!
(A mortified Marinette gasps and steps back with her eyes wide open, realizing her family is not with the real Uncle Wang.)

title: Secret Protocol/Transcript
text:
Secret Protocol/Transcript - Intro
Wang: (on the phone) I remember the time difference this time!
Tom: So Fei is in Paris now, too?
Sabine: I don't understand. Where are you?
Wang: (on the phone) In Shanghai, of course!
(Just as the conversation between her parents, Wang, and Fei continue, Marinette starts to tremble. She grabs her Miraculous inside her purse, briskly and cautiously taking off the earrings that the former "Wang" gave to her and replaces them with her Miraculous.)
Sabine: How is this possible? Uncle Wang, you're right here with us.
Wang: (on the phone) I so wish I were, but you know how hard it is for me to get away from the restaurant.
Sabine: If Uncle Wang is in China, then... (looks at Tom with a terrified glare) who's in the guest room?
Marinette: (anxiously) Mom, Dad, don't go anywhere.
(Marinette, now on high alert, goes to check on the guest room if the "Wang" with them earlier is still there. Tom and Sabine embrace each other in terror. Marinette reaches for the door knob with her hands trembling, holds back for a moment and finally opens the door, only to find an empty room. She walks in with the fear of the unknown. Her parents follow behind her.)

title: Secret Protocol/Transcript
text:
Secret Protocol/Transcript - Intro
Sabine: Where is Uncle Wang? (enters the room with Tom)
Tom: He was here five minutes ago!
Sabine: I don't understand. Who was in our home earlier?
Wang: (on the phone) Hello? I'm right here on the phone.
(As fear continues to consume the Dupain-Cheng family, Marinette has no choice but to do the most nerve-wracking and difficult decision of her life.)
Wang: Xia Bing, can you hear me?
Marinette: (grabs Sabine's phone and hangs up) Mom, Dad, we have something to tell you.
Sabine: What do you mean "we"?
Marinette: (pauses) Tikki, show yourself! (Tikki emerges and floats next to Marinette) Spots on!(And just like that, Marinette transforms into Ladybug right in front of her parents.)''

title: Sensō-ji
text:
Sensō-ji - Intro
(浅草寺, Sensō-ji ), officially Kinryū-zan Sensō-ji (金龍山浅草寺, Kinryū-zan Sensō-ji ), is a Buddhist temple located in Tokyo's Asakusa district. Dedicated to the bodhisattva goddess Kannon, it is the oldest temple in the Japanese capital and the most visited religious complex in the world.

title: Sensō-ji
text:
Sensō-ji - Description
Built in 645, Sensō-ji is the oldest temple in Tokyo. It dedicated to the bodhisattva goddess Kannon, it has several hectares of sanctuary, with several temples and gardens dedicated to the goddess or the founders of the temple, all in a particularly urbanized area of ​​Tokyo.
It was completely destroyed during American bombings in World War II, the temple was rebuilt identically between the 1950s and 1960s, sometimes with changes in materials.
It is a highly spiritual, but also tourist and commercial, place in Tokyo. Numerous festivals (masturi) take place there, attracting nearly 30 million visitors a year.
Kaminarimon
The Kaminarimon (雷門, "Thunder Gate") is the outer gate of the Sensō-ji temple complex. It is 11.7 meters high, 11.4 meters wide, and covers an area of ​​69.3 square meters.
Inside the Kaminarimon are four statues. In front of the gate are the statues of the Shinto deities Fūjin and Raijin. Fūjin, literally "god of wind," is located on the east side of the gate, while Raijin, literally "god of thunder," is located on the west side. Two other statues are located behind the gate: the Buddhist deity Tenryū on the east side and the goddess Kinryū on the west side.

title: Sensō-ji
text:
Sensō-ji - Description
At the center of the Kaminarimon, beneath the gate, hangs a giant red chōchin, 4 meters tall, 3.4 meters in circumference, and weighing 670 kilograms. The front of the lantern bears the gate's name, "Kaminarimon" (雷門). The gate's official name, "Furaijinmon" (風雷神門), is painted in black on the back. A carved wooden dragon adorns the base of the lantern.
The characters Kinryū-zan (金龍山) on the tablet above the lantern refer to the official name of Sensō-ji.
Nakamise-dōri
Nakamise-dōri (仲見世通り) is a wide, 250-meter-long pedestrian shopping street located between the Kaminarimon and Hōzōmon gates. The street is lined on both sides with around 90 small shops, boutiques, and stalls, all housed under low green-tiled roofs. The shopfronts are often decorated with red lanterns or traditional curtains (noren). Along this street, souvenir stalls stand alongside those selling traditional items, sweets, and typical Japanese fast food.
Hōzōmon
The Hōzōmon (宝蔵門, "Treasure Gate") is the inner gate of the Sensō-ji temple complex. It is a two-tiered gate (nijūmon), 22.7 meters high, 21 meters wide, and 8 meters deep.

title: Sensō-ji
text:
Sensō-ji - Description
It houses two identical statues located on either side of the southern facade of the gate. These 5.45-meter-tall statues represent Niō, the Buddha's protective deity.
The gate also features three large lanterns. The largest and most prominent lantern is a red chōchin suspended in the center of the gate opening. Standing 3.75 meters tall, with a diameter of 2.7 meters and a weight of 400 kg, the lantern bears the name of the town of Kobunachō (小舟町). On either side of the chōchin (main hall) hang two copper tōrō (spirits), each 2.75 meters tall and weighing approximately 1,000 kg.
On the north (rear) side of the Hōzōmon are the waraji, two straw sandals 4.5 m long, 1.5 m wide and weighing 400 kg each.
The upper floor of the Hōzōmon houses many of Sensō-ji's treasures.
Sensō-ji Hondō

title: Sensō-ji
text:
Sensō-ji - Description
Declared a National Treasure, the Hondō (本堂) is the main hall of the Sensō-ji complex. Standing 35 meters tall, it is built in traditional Japanese style, with a broad tiled roof supported by imposing pillars. The style is characterized by elegant simplicity and powerful lines. The roof is particularly noteworthy. It is broad and slightly curved, with the decorative fish-shaped motif at each end, typical of Japanese Buddhist temples.
The large incense bowl, called Jokoro, stands in front of the main hall of Sensō-ji Temple. Worshippers and visitors gather there to inhale the sacred smoke, a symbol of purification.
The main entrance is via a staircase above which hangs a lantern with the inscription "Tōkyō-to", a gift from the local fishing community.
The interior of the building is entirely dedicated to the worship of the goddess Kannon.
Pagoda

title: Sensō-ji
text:
Sensō-ji - Description
The five-story pagoda, erected in 942, stands proudly behind the main hall of Sensō-ji Temple. Inspired by Chinese Buddhist structures, it symbolizes the five elements (earth, water, fire, wind, and space). It is painted in bright colors (often vermilion, black, and white), contrasting with the much more sober hondo to its right. Each tier has wide, curved eaves. At 53 meters tall, it dominates the entire Sensō-ji complex.

title: Sensō-ji
text:
Sensō-ji - Trivia
Sensō-ji is important during events of "Miraculous Tokyo":
It is in this temple that the Hoshimatsuri festivities take place
It is the place where the confrontation between the Stellar Force, aided by Ladybug and Ryuko, and the fish Kaijū begins.
The fight against the fish Kaijū seems to be a nod to the link between the temple and fishermen, the latter being greatly important in the history of the temple.

title: Simon Grimault
text:
Simon Grimault - Intro
is a minor character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He is a hypnotist.
In "Simon Says", after Gabriel Agreste got him disqualified from The Challenge by refusing to accept his challenge, he was akumatized by Hawk Moth and became Simon Says, a supervillain who could hypnotize anyone.

title: Simon Grimault
text:
Simon Grimault - Appearance
Physical appearance
Simon is tall, having very wavy brown hair and dark cornflower bluish gray eyes.
Civilian attire
He wears a high-turtleneck collared white dress shirt underneath a dark gray vest with black buttons, along with a black bow around the collar. On top, he wears a dress jacket that's very pale fuchsia with vivid cerise circles with red swirled lines inside as a pattern, along with a black collar, black cuffs, and coattails. He also wears dark black slacks and black shoes.
As Simon Says

title: Simon Grimault
text:
Simon Grimault - Appearance
Simon Says was bald, his eyes were deep blue-violet, and his skin was purplish white. He wore a vivid green top hat with the bottom of the bill being black and a purple ribbon around the crown. A black mask was over his eyes, and the area close to the eyes was colored indigo. He wore a skin tight turtlenecked, butterfly sleeved jumpsuit below the head with a light gray collar and front, with a large black bow pattern on the front below the collar. The left side of the top of the suit was vivid green with a brilliant purple left glove and a sleeve edge, and the right side and bottom of the suit were brilliant purple with a vivid green right glove, vivid green sleeve edge, a vivid green left leg that started in the middle of the upper leg, and a vivid green right leg that started below the knee.

title: Simon Grimault
text:
Simon Grimault - Personality
Simon is soft-spoken, nice, and nervous. He likes his work, but he doesn't lie about his skills. However, he is upset if he feels wronged, bothered that he is kicked off The Challenge despite it being Gabriel's fault that he failed his task.
As Simon Says, he was outspoken, eccentric, commanding, and overconfident. He thought fast and used his cards wisely to get people to do what he wanted them to. He was persistent in succeeding to get revenge on Gabriel and get Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses for Hawk Moth.

title: Simon Grimault
text:
Simon Grimault - Abilities
As a civilian
Simon is a skilled hypnotist and magician, using cards to hypnotize people.
As Simon Says
Simon Says used his cards to control people and make them do his bidding. When he drew a card, he said "Simon Says", and then made a command. A black and white silhouette picture relating to the command appeared on the card. For example, when he made Alec Cataldi act like a duck with one of his cards, an image of a duck appeared on the card. Simon Says then throws the card at the person, and it faded into their body, causing the person to do whatever he commanded them to do. He could give a person more than one command, like making Placide I.T. act like a gorilla with one card and then making him attack Cat Noir with a second one, or he could make multiple cards with the same command at once, like using a handful of cards to transform a group of people into mindless followers. Cards could also affect objects, as Simon Says created a card that broke Ladybug's yo-yo. He wes also able to throw his cards like knives with incredible accuracy. It didn't matter if the target couldn't hear him; as long as he gave a command, the person was controlled.

title: Simon Grimault

Simon Grimault - Etymology
His villain name is based on the game "Simon Says", where a player is Simon and orders people to do something, but the other players must obey only if the orders start with "Simon says...".
In the French version, his name is Jacques Grimault, which is a reference to the French version of "Simon Says" called "Jacques à dit".
His villain name in the French version is Jackady.

Elements of Simon Grimault's design, such as his face, hair, etc, bear resemblance to famous illusionist and escape artist Harry Houdini.
His akumatized form's outfit is similar to the Jester from Marvel Comics. Both outfits are half green and half purple.
A statue of Simon Says appears in the Musée Grévin in "The Puppeteer 2".
The color scheme of Simon Says is similar to The Riddler from Batman's Rogue gallery.
He is one of four characters who were akumatized villains in the first three seasons who did not appear in any way in seasons 4 and 5, the others being Vincent Asa, Unnamed boy and Vivica.

title: Simon Says
text:
Simon Says - Intro
"" is a season 1 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. According the series' production/written order, it is the 10th episode of season 1, as well as the 10th episode of the series, overall.

title: Simon Says
text:
Simon Says - Synopsis
A hypnotist akumatizes into Simon Says, a villain who can make anyone obey him with his deck of cards, and seeks revenge on Adrien's father.
Disney+
Ladybug and Cat Noir face Simon Says, alias Simon Grimault.

title: Simon Says
text:
Simon Says - Plot
The episode begins with a live broadcast of a KIDZ+ competition show called The Challenge at the TVi Studio. Nino is the next candidate, his challenge is to make the mayor, André Bourgeois, dance.
At the bakery, Marinette learns that she is being grounded by her parents because of how often she is absent from school, including classes like PE and Social Studies. Marinette tries to explain to her parents that Nino is counting on her to support him during The Challenge, but her father says that, as long as her unjustified absences continue, she will stay at home.
So Marinette accepts her punishment and walks up to her room. Tikki tells Marinette that it's not her parents' fault since they don't know that she's missing class to save the world. Marinette finds it unfair, and Tikki agrees, but she reminds her that if Nino wins, she can go see him at the show next week. Marinette turns on her computer and watches Nino try to complete his challenge.
Hawk Moth, in his lair, finds the concept of The Challenge to be interesting, as the TV show has the potential to cause negative emotions.

title: Simon Says
text:
Simon Says - Plot
Marinette tells Alya about her parents grounding her, and Alya agrees with them, much to Marinette's surprise. Alya tells Marinette that she's always showing up late and mysteriously disappearing, and claims that she'd almost suspect her of living a double life. Marinette jokingly tells Alya to give her a break.
Nino is successful in making the mayor dance, while Adrien watches him in support, and Alec calls up the next contestant, a hypnotist named Simon Grimault. Alec tells Simon that his challenge is to hypnotize Gabriel Agreste and to make him come to the studio. But when Gabriel refuses to participate, Simon is automatically disqualified. Hawk Moth senses Simon's frustration over not even getting the chance to perform, so he sends a akuma after him.
The akuma possesses Simon's deck of hypnotic cards, and Hawk Moth offers Simon powers that'll make him a powerful hypnotist, and so he is akumatized into Simon Says. Using his cards, he hypnotizes Alec and Placide I.T., who both become his servants.

title: Simon Says
text:
Simon Says - Plot
Marinette is still watching the show and sees these events unfold. Despite mentioning Tikki that she is still grounded, Tikki says that she has got no choice but to transform into Ladybug. Tikki then instructs Marinette to put her pillow under her sheet so her parents would think she is sleeping. Marinette transforms into Ladybug and heads for the studio.
At the studio, Adrien transforms into Cat Noir. Simon Says announces that since Gabriel turned down his challenge, he would make him pay by having him entertain the viewers in the TV studio by midnight, much to Cat Noir's shock. Hawk Moth hears Simon Says' announcement and says to himself that, although it's risky, this has given him an idea.
Cat Noir then jumps on top of Simon Says and demands that he give him his cards. Simon Says sends Placide I.T. to fight Cat Noir. While the two are fighting, Simon Says uses his powers to enslave people in the building and sends them to find Gabriel Agreste. Ladybug arrives at the studio and finds Nino hiding in the recording room. Nino explains that Adrien is somewhere in the studio, so they both start searching for him.

title: Simon Says
text:
Simon Says - Plot
After throwing his bodyguard into an elevator, Cat Noir uses his Cataclysm on the elevator's control panel, causing it to drop down the shaft. Cat Noir then meets Ladybug and Nino, and they conclude that Simon Says is going after Gabriel. Cat Noir tells them they have to get to the Agreste mansion before Simon Says can, but he realizes that he is about to detransform. Ladybug tells Cat Noir that she will look for Nino’s friend, but Cat Noir tells her to forget it since he has probably been hypnotized. Nino tells Cat Noir that Adrien is his buddy, so Cat Noir agrees to let them look for him and he tells them to meet him at Gabriel Agreste's mansion later on. After Cat Noir runs off and detransforms, he meets up with Ladybug and Nino, and they all head for the mansion.
At the mansion, Gabriel refuses to listen when Adrien tries to warn him about Simon Says and sends Adrien and Nino to Adrien's room with Nathalie. Gabriel then apologizes to Ladybug about Adrien's behavior, stating that he is just like his mother. When Ladybug tries to warn Gabriel about how dangerous Simon Says is, he replies by saying that he trusts her to protect him.

title: Simon Says
text:
Simon Says - Plot
Once Adrien gets to his room with Nino, he tells Nino that he needs to take a shower. While in the bathroom, he transforms into Cat Noir. Meanwhile, Ladybug is admiring Gabriel's pictures of Adrien and agrees with Gabriel when he says that Adrien is perfect. Gabriel takes a strange interest in Ladybug's earrings and reaches out to take a closer look at them, but before he can, Ladybug gets a call from Cat Noir, who tells her that Simon Says is coming.
Cat Noir meets Ladybug and Gabriel in Gabriel's office and warns them that Simon Says and his army have arrived, and tells Gabriel to activate the mansion's defense system. After doing so, Gabriel asks Cat Noir how he knows so much about the system, to which Cat Noir replies that in a house like his, there's bound to be one. Meanwhile, the servants of Simon Says begin to break through the mansion's defenses.

title: Simon Says
text:
Simon Says - Plot
Ladybug and Nathalie go to Adrien’s room make sure he and Nino are all right. Cat Noir tells Gabriel to hide in the atrium as it is not safe where he is now, but Gabriel refuses to listen to Cat Noir, saying that no one, not even a superhero, tells him what to do. Cat Noir gets angry and tells Gabriel that he's in danger like everyone else and to just do what he tells him, much to Gabriel's surprise. He tells the superhero that he reminds him of someone. After Cat Noir leaves, Gabriel faces a portrait of his wife.
Simon Says is delighted since his army is getting closer to breaking into the mansion. However, Hawk Moth strangely tells Simon Says that he doesn't think what he is doing is such a good idea and to not forget their deal. Simon Says assures Hawk Moth that he'll defeat Ladybug and Cat Noir.

title: Simon Says
text:
Simon Says - Plot
Ladybug warns Nino about what's happening, and he and Nathalie leave Adrien's room while Ladybug calls for Adrien to get out of the shower. Cat Noir climbs in the bathroom window and hears Ladybug calling for Adrien. Quickly, he detransforms while turning on the shower. Ladybug opens the shower door and tells Adrien that they need to go, and freaks out when she realizes Adrien may not have his clothes on. Adrien says that he needs to get dressed and then they can go.
As Ladybug waits for Adrien to come out of the bathroom, she notices the person on the wallpaper of Adrien's computer. When he leaves the bathroom, Adrien reveals to Ladybug that the person is his mother on her seventeenth birthday. Both simultaneously tell each other, "she's got your eyes." Suddenly, hypnotized servants of Simon Says break into the room. Ladybug pushes Adrien back into his bathroom to keep him safe. In the bathroom, Plagg teases Adrien, stating that Ladybug actually does love him, but only as Adrien. Adrien ignores Plagg's teasing and transforms into Cat Noir again.

title: Simon Says
text:
Simon Says - Plot
The servants of Simon Says break into the mansion and capture Gabriel. Simon Says brings Gabriel back to the TVi Studio, where he hypnotizes him to think he is a butterfly. By the time Ladybug and Cat Noir reach to the outside of the recording room of the studio, Ladybug assumes that the akuma is inside one of the cards.
As they break in, Ladybug uses Lucky Charm, which gives her a normal yo-yo. Ladybug tries to attack Simon Says with her magical yo-yo, but Simon Says uses a card to make it useless. Cat Noir attacks Simon Says while Ladybug rapidly rips up the villain's cards to look for the akuma.

title: Simon Says
text:
Simon Says - Plot
Simon Says then hypnotizes Gabriel to think he is a plane, sending him to jump off the studio roof. Cat Noir attempts to run after him, but Ladybug determines that the best course of action would be to defeat Simon Says as quickly as possible, rather than going to try to save Gabriel. Ladybug then uses her normal yo-yo to knock Simon Says' pack of cards out of his hands. Cat Noir uses Cataclysm to destroy the pack of cards and tosses the pack to Ladybug, who breaks it and reveals the akuma. She then tosses her Lucky Charm yo-yo and cleanses the city, returning everything except Simon back to normal. She then captures and purifies the akuma, returning Simon back to normal. Afterward, Ladybug and Cat Noir go to the roof and check on Gabriel. When Cat Noir and Gabriel shake hands, the latter looks closely at Cat Noir's ring before he and Ladybug leave.

title: Simon Says
text:
Simon Says - Plot
Back at the Agreste mansion, Adrien is sadly looking at pictures of his mother when Gabriel suddenly walks into his room and gives him a hug, much to Adrien’s surprise and pleasure. Then, Gabriel notices Adrien's ring and asks about it, having never noticed it before. Adrien avoids the question by asking his father if that's the only thing he's never noticed about him, and Gabriel tells Adrien he's glad everything worked out for the best before leaving the room.
At the bakery, Tom and Sabine tell Marinette that because she has had a perfect week of attendance at school, she can go and meet Nino for the second round of The Challenge. Marinette decides that she would rather stay at home and watch The Challenge with her parents. However, when she hears that Nino wants Ladybug and Cat Noir to be there for the challenge, she makes an excuse and leaves for the studio.

title: Simon Says
text:
Simon Says - Plot Developments
This is the first episode in which Ladybug's yo-yo breaks.
This episode also reveals that the Miraculous tools aren't completely indestructible and the only ways it can break is by other forms of Miraculous magic or by a Miraculous holder's enhanced strength.
This is one of several episodes to unveil a weakness to the Miraculous superpowers: if a holder uses their tools to summon their powers but they become separated from them or the weapons become damaged then they can't use their powers.
With Ladybug's Lucky Charm being another yo-yo it's implied that Tikki was aware of Simon Says powers and it being said object was precaution just in case if her original yo-yo was damaged also implying that this has happened in the past with other Miraculous holders.
And the first time where an object appears based on a similar incident or memory.
This is the first time Adrien meets Marinette as her alter ego, Ladybug.
In this episode, Gabriel (Hawk Moth) begins to suspect that Cat Noir is his son after seeing Adrien's ring in the first time which is followed in "Gorizilla".

title: Simon Says
text:
Simon Says - Plot Developments
When Adrien confronted his father as Cat Noir, about him being in danger the same as everyone else, it foreshadows him in "Shadow Moth's Last Attack", learning the same thing about freedom.

title: Simon Says
text:
Simon Says - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in Canada on Télé-Québec.
This episode was the twenty-third to air in France and on Télé-Québec.
In the Russian, Ukrainian and Slovene versions, the episode and title villain are called "Hypnotist".
The animation of Ladybug swinging to the TVi building is the same as in the theme song.
The photo of Émilie Agreste that Adrien uses as his computer background is an edited photo of voice actress Tara Strong.
Interestingly, like several other episodes Hawk Moth had no idea how close he was to winning if Simon Says had struck Ladybug's yo-yo before she summoned her Lucky Charm.
Although only partly, this is the first time Cataclysm is used to destroy an akumatized object.
As it is not activated on the ground, the activating sequence is also cut.
This is also the only time Cataclysm is used to destroy an akumatized object in season 1.
This is also the first time Cat Noir destroys an akumatized object in the entire series.
This is the first and only episode in Season 1 where an akumatized object is made out of many pieces coming together to make one big object.

title: Simon Says
text:
Simon Says - Trivia
This episode spans the longest amount of time for any episode of Season 1, as Nino's second appearance on the game show is stated to be a week later.
References
The cat Ladybug saves is similar to the cat that knocks Alya's phone into the trash can in "The Mime".
The card Simon Says uses to immobilize the Gorilla has the same symbol Lady Wifi uses to immobilize her opponents.
Like in "Pixelator", Ladybug uses the Miraculous Ladybug before capturing the akuma.
This episode doesn't have a particular end card following "Stormy Weather".
The Agreste Mansion is revealed to have a security system, following the Louvre Museum in "Copycat".
Marinette has brief flashback of saving a falling helicopter. Since no akumatizezd villain is seen, it's possible the helicopter was about to crash from an unrelated cause and also it could be a reference from "Lady Wifi", where she was seen hanging from a helicopter.
This is one of the four episodes of season 1 in which Hawk Moth doesn't hold his end monologue after being defeated. The other three being "Princess Fragrance", "Copycat" and "Antibug".
Allusions

title: Simon Says
text:
Simon Says - Trivia
The titular villain in this episode and powers are based on the popular children's game "Simon Says".
In the French version, the episode is called "Jackady".
In French, Simon's name is Jacques Grimault because the phrase "Jacques à dit" is the French version of the phrase "Simon Says".
The Challenge is a reference to the real The Challengers game show in 1990's.
Which also alludes to various other "Challengers" franchises, places and vehicles.
Errors
In the English dub, when Adrien and Ladybug are complimenting each other, they say "She's got your eyes" even though Marinette/Ladybug has blue eyes. In the original French version, they instead compliment their smiles. Thomas Astruc confirmed that it was a translation error.
The Gorilla takes and throws Cat Noir's staff away from him when they fight, but another one is attached to his back until he picks up and reattached the first one.
Ladybug's yo-yo is duplicated when she picks it up in order to talk with Cat Noir.
When Ladybug, Adrien and Nino first see Gabriel, his hair is brown. It’s normal white in the next shot.
Even though Gabriel leaves the door open when he enters Adrien's room, it is closed again before he leaves.

title: Simon Says

When Gabriel sees Ladybug for the first time, he greets "Good evening", but it's still bright outside as seen a few frames earlier.
When Adrien and Ladybug are flustered by complimenting each other in unison, Adrien's blush suddenly vanishes just before the camera cuts away.
When Ladybug and Cat Noir kick open a door to fight Simon, Gabriel doesn't appear, but, in the next scene he appears.
While Clara Contard's (one of the background civilians) head and body are tanned, her arms are fair.

title: Simon Says/Transcript
text:
Simon Says/Transcript - Intro
[ Theme Song ]
Alec: Welcome back to everyone's #1 live game show: The Challenge! Let's give it up for our awesome contestant, Nino!
(Nino enters the stage)
Alec: So Nino, you're a student and a DJ. That's pretty awesome! Check out the decks we got for you!
Marinette: Grounded? For what?!
Tom: Let's jog your memory, Marinette. Monday morning, absent from P.E...
(Shows a flashback of Ladybug saving a helicopter.)
Marinette: I was in study hall.
Tom: Friday evening, absent from study hall.
(Shows a flashback of Ladybug saving a kitten from a tree)
Marinette: I was at P.E.!
Tom: You're never where you're supposed to be, Marinette! The only way we can keep track of you is by keeping you here, grounded.
Marinette: But I was invited... Nino is my friend, he was counting on me.
Alec: So, the challenge our viewers have chosen for you is... To get the mayor of Paris, André Bourgeois, to dance! Thank you for agreeing to play with us today, sir. What are Nino's chances tonight?
André: (On the screen) Zero. I despise dancing. The last time I set foot on a dance floor, Madonna was in kindergarten.

title: Simon Says/Transcript
text:
Simon Says/Transcript - Intro
Tom: I know Nino's your friend. But until your unexcused absences come to an end, that's the way it's going to be.
Marinette: Awesome. (She goes to her room, sad. Sits in her chair and groans.)
Tikki: Can you blame them? How are they supposed to know that you're missing class to save the world?
Marinette:  I guess being grounded comes with the territory of being a top secret superhero. Doesn't seem fair though.
Tikki: It's not. But hey, if Nino wins, you're not grounded next week. You can go see him at the show!
Marinette: Yeah, but Adrien was there today! (turns on the computer, and Nino can be seen DJing.)
Hawk Moth: The Challenge... what an interesting concept. A TV show with such potential for negative emotion. Oh, the destructive mayhem we could cause...
Marinette: Seriously? How can you say that, Alya?
Alya: Sorry, but I kinda get your dad, Marinette. You're never where you say you'll be. Showing up late, splitting mysteriously and all. I'd almost suspect you were leading... (narrows eyes) a double life.
Marinette: (shocked) Gimme a break! You're being ridiculous.

title: Simon Says/Transcript
text:
Simon Says/Transcript - Intro
(Simon Grimault arrives and tries to shake Adrien's hand, but Placide I.T. shields Adrien and stands protectively in front of him.)
Adrien: (shocked) No! It's okay!
Alec: Victory! Challenge conquered by Nino. You moved your head to the beat, Mayor Bourgeois! That counts as dancing!
André Bourgeois: (On the screen) What?! That's not true! My neck was... itching, that's all.
Alec: Relieving an itch to the beat counts as dancing, too! Nino, congratulations. You'll return in one week to meet your next challenge! And now, for our next contestant, welcome Simon Grimault!
Adrien: (To Nino, who comes back from the stage) Awesome, dude!
Alec: Mr. Grimault, you are a hypnotist. You use cards to hypnotize people to get what you want from them!
Simon: Well, yes, I'm a hypnotist. But, uh, I don't use my skills to get anything.
Alec: So, your challenge today, Simon, is to use your talents to bring a very elusive celebrity to this very TV set! Give it up for the king of fashion, Gabriel Agreste!
Gabriel: What is this show? I was told this was an interview.
Nino: Dude, your dad!
Alec: Do your thing, Grimault, let's see if you can bring Mr. Agreste here with your hypnotic persuasion!

title: Simon Says/Transcript
text:
Simon Says/Transcript - Intro

title: Shield
text:
Shield - Intro
The  is the tool of the Turtle Miraculous.
The current owner of the shield is Nino Lahiffe, who uses it as the superhero Carapace.
Previously, it was used by Gabriel Agreste when he used the Turtle Miraculous with the other Miraculouses in his possession to become Monarch. And also, it was formerly used by Master Fu when he used the Turtle Miraculous to become Jade Turtle.

title: Shield
text:
Shield - Appearance
The shield changes color depending on whose possession it's in:
When it is used by Carapace, the shield is large, round and flat. The outer side of the shield is dark green, while the inner side is light green with jagged lines running from the edge to the center of it.
In Season 6 and onwards the shield's green color becomes brighter and the central hexagon is bigger.
When Carapace was akumatized into Shell Shock, the shield kept the same appearance, but instead was red.
When it was used by Jade Turtle, the shield had a conical shape, when not in use, it was used as a hat, and the colors have been inverted with the light green being inside and outside the shield.
When it was used by Monarch, the shield changed color from green to purple.

title: Shield
text:
Shield - Abilities
The shield is shown to be extremely durable, able to withstand multiple direct hits from Anansi with seemingly no damage. It can even handle lightning, Pharaoh's punches, and Riposte's sword, as seen in "Mayura".
The Turtle Miraculous' superpower, Shell-ter, involves the shield, with the user holding up the shield to generate a force field which is a nearly indestructible barrier to defend the user and others. Alternatively, the power can be "shot" towards a target, as first seen in "Optigami".
As shown in "The Illustrhater", the shield can also be used as a skateboard for transportation.
As show in "Lady Chaos" the shield can be also be used as communicator and can access the Miraculous Call to signal the other heroes. It also has a flat diamond-shaped camera.

title: Shield
text:
Shield - Trivia
The hand shield was first revealed when concept art of Carapace carrying the tool on his back was shown in a press release video on August 31, 2017.
It's befitting that the tool of the Turtle Miraculous is a shield because a tortoise and/or turtle's shell is one of the toughest defenses in nature.
It's the first tool to be worn as a superhero outfit accessory, followed by the Mouse Miraculous' skip rope, the Tiger Miraculous' bolas, and the Rooster Miraculous' fountain pen.
Normally, when not in use, the shield can be carried on the Turtle Miraculous holder's back. Jade Turtle, however, wears the shield on his head similar to an Asian conical hat, an homage to his Chinese heritage.
