title: Sleeping Syren
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Sleeping Syren - Intro
"" is a season 6 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 6th written and produced episode of season 6. It is also the 137th written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Sleeping Syren
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Sleeping Syren - Synopsis
When Ondine worries that she still hasn't had a first kiss with Kim and wonders about his true feelings, Marinette decides to help her… in her own way!
TF1
Ondine is worried that she still hasn't had a first kiss with Kim and wonders about the boy's romantic feelings. Having become a self-proclaimed specialist in first kisses and declarations of love, Marinette decides to help her friend...in his own way! A new opportunity for Marinette to learn that not all couples work the same way.
Disney+
An inconsolable villain floods Paris with her tears.

title: Sleeping Syren
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Sleeping Syren - Plot
As Ondine waits on the steps of the school, she decides to apply her new lip balm before spotting Kim approaching with his two fathers. After he splits from them to join Ondine, she tries to give him a kiss with her new lip balm, but he pulls the old "Got your nose" prank on her and runs into the school. Taking it in stride, she goes after him. Unknown to either of them, Zoé's ex-classmate Ray, and his two new buddies, Loïc and Nelson, plan on splitting the two up as they follow after them to begin their wicked plan.
At lunch, Ondine is sitting with Diane, Marinette, Alya, Juleka, Rose, Kagami, Mylène, and Zoé.
Marinette asks Alya why she is chatting with Nino again, especially since they will be seeing each other in less than an hour.
Alya explains that she knows that, but Nino just told her what he had for breakfast, and now he’s saying he’s about to brush his teeth and go to the bathroom before he leaves.
Marinette is surprised to learn that they really share everything, and Alya reminds her that Nino is her boyfriend and also her best friend, so they keep almost zero secrets from each other.

title: Sleeping Syren
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Sleeping Syren - Plot
Startled, Marinette looks around and asks the other girls if they tell their boyfriends or girlfriends everything too.
Mylène replies that she tells Ivan everything, although he is a bit more reserved, as she doesn’t know much about his family yet.
However, she believes she will learn more about him in time.
Juleka says she and Rose just really understand each other.
Kagami chimes in, saying that Juleka and Rose are lucky since Félix is on the other side of the sea, making communication challenging.
Rose asks Kagami how she manages it, which prompts Kagami to imagine her, and Félix as Argos and Ryuko using their space power-up to kiss in the sky.
She quickly covers up her thoughts with video calls.
Turning to Ondine, she then asks about her and Kim.
Ondine admits that she has been trying to get a kiss from Kim, but he seems oblivious to her intentions due to his personality.
The girls suggest ideas to help Ondine, and she ultimately agrees to write a poem for Kim to see if that will prompt him to kiss her.
Meanwhile, Ray, Loïc, and Nelson decide who will get the first chance to break up Ondine and Kim, and Ray is chosen for the first attempt.

title: Sleeping Syren
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Sleeping Syren - Plot
He tries to bribe Kim with a new pair of swimming flippers, but with the condition that Kim can't speak to any girls, including Ondine, or he will have to return them.
This approach works at first, but when Ondine reads her poem to Kim while the girls watch in secret, he can’t help but laugh at some of the words.
Realizing that he has broken the terms of his deal with Ray, Kim goes to return the flippers, leaving Ondine heartbroken due to his ignorance of her feelings and her attempt to express them through the poem—despite Marinette and the other girls trying to cheer her up.
Kagami then suggests an old Japanese tradition with biscuit sticks that would have one person start on one end, their match on the other, and they would eat the stick until meeting in the middle and kissing.
They use the sticks to lure Kim to Ondine, but when it comes time to do the tradition, Kim, again being ignorant and oblivious, takes the stick completely when he thinks Ondine wasn't going to finish it herself, further angering her.

title: Sleeping Syren
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Sleeping Syren - Plot
Meanwhile, Loïc tries his luck getting Kim to break up with Ondine before Marinette and the girls tried the biscuit stick ploy, but despite his direct, brute-force strategy, Kim is unable to be swayed, so it falls to Nelson to finish what Ray and Loïc started.
Nelson confronts Kim at one point, and warns him of the threat of germs and diseases if he were to kiss Ondine, even mentioning it could send them into anaphylactic shock from an allergic reaction and turn Kim into looking like a toad due to getting warts on him just like one.
This does the trick as Kim becomes fearful and hesitant to kiss Ondine.
As a result, when Ondine decides, with a little encouragement from Marinette, to arm wrestle Kim, she easily beats him, but when she tries to kiss him, he freaks out and panics as he remembers what Nelson said and tries to explain it to Ondine.
This is the last straw for her.
Upset, heartbroken, and furious with Kim, she declares their relationship over, calling him despicable as she storms off to the restroom to cry.

title: Sleeping Syren
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Sleeping Syren - Plot
After witnessing the incident, Marinette and Alya decide to talk to Ondine. However, before they can reach her, one of Chrysalis' Ultrakumas gets to Ondine first and infects her lip balm. In Ondine's mind, while she is wearing her swimsuit, Chrysalis speaks to her and offers her the chance to get back at Kim for breaking her heart. Feeling she has nothing to lose, Ondine accepts the offer and asks to be called the "Sleeping Syren". Chrysalis grants her wish, and as Ondine is akumatized—similar to when she became Syren due to Monarch's influence as Hawk Moth—her tears begin to overflow from the restroom, which catches the attention of Marinette and Alya. Soon, the tears start to flood all of Paris. Thinking quickly, Marinette and Alya evacuate their classmates and the other Miraculers to the rooftops for safety. Once they are alone, Marinette speaks to Tikki and decides to revoke the Monkey Miraculous from Kim next time she sees him, before transforming into Ladybug to rendezvous with Cat Noir to work out their plan.

title: Sleeping Syren
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Sleeping Syren - Plot
Meanwhile, Ondine, now akumatized as the Sleeping Syren in the flood waters, does up her lips with her lip balm, before lying down and going to sleep, triggering a water mural of herself as a mermaid to tell her story, before sending her water knights to turn the innocent people of Paris into toads if they prove cowardly, just like with what Kim said to break her heart. Understanding this, and seeing Ladybug and Cat Noir, unable to warn them that they are walking into a trap, Kim sets off from the others to try and help, despite concern from Xuppu if he is doing the right thing. Elsewhere, Ladybug realizes that they are going to need the whole team to combat the Sleeping Syren's water forces, but as she brings out the Miraculous Call, she specifically excludes Kim, AKA King Monkey, when she sends out the call for help, still convinced she has to revoke the Monkey Miraculous from him for his behavior against Ondine. Kim later sees the rest of the team dashing across the rooftops to help, and wonders why Ladybug didn't contact him for assistance.

title: Sleeping Syren
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Sleeping Syren - Plot
When the Miraculers arrive to meet up with Ladybug and Cat Noir, Miss Hound notices that Minotaurox is not alongside them, worried he might have fallen victim to Sleeping Syren's forces and was turned into a toad, but Ladybug assures them he'll be fine once they de-akumatize Ondine and reverse the damage with Miraculous Ladybug. Carapace also mentions King Monkey is not there either, but Ladybug assures them they don't need his help for this mission. Ladybug assigns Ryuko to help her and Cat Noir with getting to Sleeping Syren, while the rest of the team rescue as many of the Parisians as they can and take them to the Eiffel Tower for protection. Thanks to the efforts of the Miraculers, as Rena Rouge, Purple Tigress, Vesperia, Polymouse, Miss Hound, Pegasus, and Rooster Bold rescue civilians and take them to the tower, Carapace creates a Shell-ter to protect them there, and Caprikid and Pigella pass out towels to the civvies.
Meanwhile, Ladybug and Cat Noir power up into Aquabug and Aqua Noir, and joined by Ryuko using the Water Dragon power, they head for Sleeping Syren's location.

title: Sleeping Syren
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Sleeping Syren - Plot
However, as Ryuko keeps the guards busy, things take a turn for the worse when they spot Kim swimming down to help them.
Distracted, Ryuko is jabbed by one of the water knights and turned into a toad herself, but the Dragon Miraculous survives, and Aquabug unifies it with the Ladybug Miraculous to become Aqua Dragonbug.
She then rescues Kim and takes him back up onto a rooftop to confront him for what just happened, reverting to just Dragonbug once out of the water.
Kim explains everything to Dragonbug, regarding Ondine and what Nelson had told him and how he had to dive in since she didn't call on him.
Dragonbug chastises him and tells him that he needs to stop being so gullible and believing everything he hears without thinking for a second.
Realizing she's right and that Nelson tricked him into saying terrible things to Ondine, Kim is horrified, fearing Ondine will never forgive him and love him again.
However, once she understands the truth of what led to Ondine's akumatization, Dragonbug assures Kim that if he explains everything to Ondine and apologizes, along with explaining how he feels about her, she'll forgive him.

title: Sleeping Syren
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Sleeping Syren - Plot
When he agrees, impressed since she remembered how her former master Wang Fu trusted Kim, Dragonbug permits him to keep the Monkey Miraculous and allows him to assist in saving Ondine.
Grateful, he transforms with Xuppu into King Monkey, and using his Uproar, he is able to remove the flood waters around Paris and clear the way to the Sleeping Syren.
Unfortunately, there was one last obstacle in the form of a water dragon guarding Sleeping Syren.
When Dragonbug summoned a Lucky Charm that turned into a bag of cement, she realized how it could help them.
She had Cat Noir pour the bag over the water dragon, causing the cement to mix with the water, forming concrete.
She then used her Wind Dragon power to harden it, effectively immobilizing the creature.
Once the dragon was taken care of, they turned their attention to de-akumatizing Ondine.
Thanks to his keen sense of smell, King Monkey recognized the banana-flavored scent from the lip balm and was able to locate the lip balm tube.
However, when Dragonbug broke it, no Ultrakuma emerged.
Still detecting the scent, King Monkey deduced that the Ultrakuma was hidden in Ondine's lip balm on her lips.

title: Sleeping Syren
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Sleeping Syren - Plot
Using his Uproar ability, he summoned a pencil and used it to erase the lip balm from Sleeping Syren's lips, transforming it into a snorkel.
Cat Noir then used his Cataclysm power on the snorkel to release the Ultrakuma, allowing Dragonbug to catch and purify it.
Afterward, she used her Miraculous Dragonbug to repair all the damage around Paris, restoring Ryuko and the other victims to normal.
As Ondine awoke, Dragonbug gifted her a Magical Charm along with some words of wisdom.
The three Miraculers then regrouped with the restored Ryuko and returned to join the others.
They shared a celebratory "Pound it!" fist-bump, to celebrate their teamwork and success.
However, in her lair at La Plage, Cerise refuses to admit defeat and plans to make sure she gets it right next time.

title: Sleeping Syren
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Sleeping Syren - Plot
As a result, the next day, Kim apologizes to Ondine for hurting her feelings and Ondine also apologizes for making such a big deal over a kiss. Ondine tells Kim that he doesn't have to kiss her right now if he doesn't want to and says he can do it when he's ready. Kim finally musters the courage to kiss her, and realizes it wasn't so bad as the two kiss some more mundane ones. Marinette and the other girls were slightly disgusted by this and decide to give them some privacy. Later, Marinette offers the biscuit sticks to Adrien, and they are able to successfully pull off a kiss by eating their respective ends of the stick before meeting in the middle.
However, that night, Ray, Nelson, and Loïc felt frustrated as their efforts had backfired, as Loïc is stomping on a soda can on the stairs. Ray says that there are still plenty of couples to wreck. However, a dark figure with glowing yellow eyes appeared, standing on a lamppost. As the dark figure tells the trio that there won't be a next time they attempt to ruin another relationship, the dark figure jumped down toward them with unclear intentions...

title: Sleeping Syren
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Sleeping Syren - Plot Developments
Kim's parents make their first appearance, confirming that he in fact has two fathers: Vadim Ature, who appears to be an athlete much like his son, and Lê Minh Cường, who appears to be a physician.
This also explains why he has two last names, as he got them from both his parents.
One of Kim's parents calls Ondine "little mermaid", which is a reference to the episode Syren where Hawk Moth calls her that too.
It would appear Ray has his own group with two boys, Loïc and Nelson, and they appear to be very interested in causing havoc to his fellow students, especially couples, seen how dedicated they were in causing Ondine and Kim to break up.
This parallels the trio in Season 5 consisting of Chloé Bourgeois, Sabrina Raincomprix and Lila Rossi/Cerise Bianca. Ray is the equivalent of Chloé, while Loïc is the equivalent of Sabrina (until Sabrina breaks off her "friendship" with Chloé), and Nelson being the equivalent of Lila/Cerise.
In the post-credits scene, Ray, Loïc and Nelson are approached by Fury, a cloaked figure with a feminine voice.
Interestingly, Fury is the superhero identity of Andy Baker, one of the main protagonists of Ghostforce, another ZAG Heroez show.

title: Sleeping Syren
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Sleeping Syren - Plot Developments
Their personality types can be reflected on the way each one of them tried to manipulate Kim to break up with Ondine: Ray tried to bribe Kim with brand new flippers if he stopped talking with girls, showing his way to use his wealth to get what he wants; Loïc tried to force Kim to stop talking with Ondine, showing a more aggressive approach; Nelson took advantage of Kim's naive nature and manipulated him to think something bad would happen if he and Ondine ever kissed, showing a more cunning demeanor.
It is implied that Ladybug has provided her fellow Miraculers with the same potions that enable them to power up. This is evident as Kagami and Félix are revealed to have been meeting each other halfway between Paris and London while in their space power-up forms.
It is also revealed that Félix is aware of Kagami's secret identity as Ryuko, making them the second couple to reveal their hero identities to each other, after Alya and Nino in "Catalyst" followed by Marc and Nathaniel later in "The Ruler".

title: Sleeping Syren
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Sleeping Syren - Trivia
Mylène references the time Ivan wrote a poem to her back in "Stoneheart".
Mylène mentions not knowing a lot about Ivan's family, a topic that is later explored in "El Toro De Piedra".
Marinette planned in taking Kim's Monkey Miraculous after he ended up causing Ondine's akumatization, but she ended up forgiving Kim, after she realizes that Nelson took advantage of Kim's naivety to break his relationship with Ondine, allowing him to keep his Miraculous.
It marks the first time Marinette wanted to take back a Miraculous for a reason unrelated to the holder's usage of their Miraculous.
This is the first time an akumatized villain under Chrysalis has been shown to be in different clothing in their mind while communicating with her, as Ondine is seen wearing her swimsuit.
In "El Toro De Piedra", Raúl would also be seen in his El Toro outfit during the akumatization and in his bodyguard uniform prior to it, but he has the former after being de-akumatized.
This is the first time Aqua Noir has received a transformation sequence.

title: Sleeping Syren
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Sleeping Syren - Trivia
King Monkey's transformation sequence is reanimated in the new artstyle. Much like in "Party Crasher", Kim still starts off wearing his swimming gear rather than his civilian outfit.
Ladybug becomes Dragonbug for the second time, following "Miracle Queen". By unifying with the Dragon Miraculous, while in her aqua form, she becomes Aqua Dragonbug.
This is the first unification to be done in Season 6.
This is also the second unification where the user also uses a power-up, following Cosmobugnoire (Bug Noire with the space power-up) in "Miraculous London". However, it is the first time the holder performs a unification while using a power-up.
Cat Noir calls Ladybug "Bugaboo" for the first time since "Crocoduel" in Season 4.
References
Kim uses a trash bin and a traffic sign to move through Syren's flood, like how Marinette did in "Syren".
Marinette remembered her saddest event of seeing Adrien flying away to London in "Revolution".
Ondine's new akumatized villain identity Sleeping Syren is also refers to what the titular villain in "Style Queen", called Adrien.
Allusions
This episode references many elements from fairytales:

title: Sleeping Syren
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Sleeping Syren - Trivia
Sleeping Syren's supervillain name and design is a clear reference, respectively, to The Sleeping Beauty, where the princess is placed on an eternal slumber until a prince would come to awake her with a kiss, and to The Little Mermaid, where the main character is a mermaid princess that falls in love with a human prince.
There are also references to Disney's The Princess and the Frog, with Kim believing he would turn into a frog if he kissed Ondine and with Sleeping Syren's water knights turning people into frogs.
The dragon, such as the one guarding Sleeping Syren, is an iconic obstacle in many fairytales.
This may also reference Disney's Sleeping Beauty where the main villain, Maleficent, transforms into a dragon in the final battle.
It could also be a reference to Dreamworks' Shrek, where Princess Fiona was trapped in a tower watched over by a giant dragon.
Dragonbug makes a call out to many fairytales where the prince kisses the princess' lips without her consent.
This is something of a contradiction to the events of "Dark Cupid", when Ladybug kissed Cat Noir to free him from the hate spell.

title: Sleeping Syren
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Sleeping Syren - Trivia
If technically, the reason Ondine was akumatized in the first place was because she wanted a kiss from Kim, so in a way, permission was given.
Kagami talking about couples sharing a "sweetheart cookie" references to Pocky Game, a Japanese party game where two people share a single Pocky stick, each nibbling from opposite ends simultaneously, aiming to reach the center.
Errors
When the Miraculers fist-bump and say "Pound it" after their victory, Pegasus and Carapace are missing.
In the scene right before, Polymouse's soles are gray instead of pink.
When Miss Hound expresses concern because Minotaurox is not present, the Horse Miraculous symbol on Pegasus' zipper is missing.
When Ladybug jumps away from the school, the shot changes right before the Ladybug transition appears.
This was fixed in later airings of the episode.
At the start of the de-evilization sequence, Ladybug's yo-yo isn't shining when it first drops down.
Aqua Noir's tail fin is sometimes missing and the fins on his feet also sometimes lose their light and color.
Right before Aquabug, Aqua Noir and Ryuko jump into the water, Aquabug's right pigtail clips through her shoulder.

title: Sleeping Syren
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Sleeping Syren - Trivia
When Dragonbug first activates Wind Dragon, the scales from the Aqua power-up sequence are still present, but she isn't in her Aqua form anymore.
In some shots the fountain pen holster on Rooster Bold's costume is miscolored gray, alongside the feather.
When the heroes are shown jumping to save citizens, Purple Tigress' and Polymouse's miraculous are colored pure white.

title: Shirel Kurtzberg
text:
Shirel Kurtzberg - Intro
is a minor character in Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug and Cat Noir. She is the wife of Aton Kurtzberg and the mother of Nathaniel Kurtzberg.
In "The Ruler", after learning that her son is the illustrator of the comic he and Marc created and he disobeyed her, she was akumatized by Chrysalis into the Ruler, a knight-themed supervillain who had the power to make people obey the commands of the one holding her sword when branded by it. She also received a Magical Charm from Ladybug that prevents her from being akumatized again.

title: Shirel Kurtzberg
text:
Shirel Kurtzberg - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Shirel is a tall fair-skinned middle-aged woman with long red-orange hair with straight bangs and tied in a low bun and hazel colored eyes. She has brown stylized eyebrows and wears dark red lipstick.
Civilian Attire
Shirel wears a black long blazer jacket over a red shirt, black pants, and black boots. In addition, she wears a red-and-sliver triangular scale through her bun and two-tone red glasses. Other accessories includes silver earrings shaped like right-angle triangle rulers, a tennis necklace, a silver pin in a design likely representing skyscrapers, and a silver bracelet on her left arm.
As Ruler

title: Shirel Kurtzberg
text:
Shirel Kurtzberg - Appearance
Ruler appeared as a Templar knight cladded in gray armor. Her helmet, covering her head, was the same gray color, featuring a horizontal opening at eye level that emitted a golden light, complemented by a red ponytail at the nape of her neck. Surrounding her neck was a wide metal band. She wore gray metal shoulder pads with folds and elongated triangular tips. Openings on her elbows and thighs also emitted a golden light. Her black belt, adorned with a silver metal buckle, secured a white toga. At the center of the toga was her symbol—a ruler, a square, and a protractor—rendered in red and black, which overlaid a vertical red band running down the center of the garment. She completed her look with boots that had silver heels.
On her left arm, she carried a shield, while in the same hand, she wielded her weapon—a spear with an elongated triangular blade capable of cutting like a sword (resembling a triangular scale). At the end of the spear was her stamp, which allowed her to charm people.
Under her helmet, she kept her civilian hairstyle but with olive skin, purple eyes, and darker sclerae.

title: Shirel Kurtzberg
text:
Shirel Kurtzberg - Personality
Shirel was initially presented as a strict authoritarian mother who expressed demeanor to her son, Nathaniel, with her expectations that aligned to her standards. She saw the value in Nathaniel and Marc's comics as meaningless due to seeing it as the only kind of art as trash, blaming her husband, Aton, for exposing him to comics. When her authority was questioned, as evident with Marinette, she became furious and took drastic measures to force her son to obey, such as threatening him from seeing Marc ever again, or pulling him away from Marinette after Nathaniel rebelled and Marinette stood up for Nathaniel. However, after Ladybug tells Shirel that Nathaniel should make his own decisions, she understood that he poured effort into his passion in comics and accepted him and Marc for who they are after reading their masterpiece. She reconciles with Nathaniel by apologizing to him and telling him that she loves him.
As Ruler, her personality was an exaggerated version of her strictness and perfectionism. Like other villains, she disliked people or heroes who prevented her from achieving her goal, such as Ladybug, Cat Noir and Caprikid.

title: Shirel Kurtzberg
text:
Shirel Kurtzberg - Abilities
As a Civilian
Shirel is a successful and famous architect, so she is very skilled in building designing.
As Ruler
Ruler possessed a suit of armor that protected her from any damage, along with a shield, and she was a skilled swordswoman.
Her power relied on her sword, which had a tip shaped like a stamp. Whenever she stamped someone with it, that person fell under her control, and their pupils contracted. The response from her victims resembled that of a robot. However, this control did not depend on the person wielding the sword; it was the sword itself that granted power over those marked with the stamp. This meant that even Ruler was vulnerable to her own ability. For example, Caprikid managed to stamp her sword against herself, commanding her to remove her earrings and release the ultrakuma.

title: Shirel Kurtzberg
text:
Shirel Kurtzberg - History
In the opening stinger of "The Ruler", Shirel is in her work corner at home finishing her work with the blueprint of a building, following the conversation between her husband and son. She is surprised when Aton expresses his sympathy for his son and Marc's comic strip and gives him nudging looks. Next, she finishes her work and puts a stamp with her name in a red frame with three rectangles.

title: Shirel Kurtzberg
text:
Shirel Kurtzberg - History
After a day off from school, Nathaniel and Marс are discussing new sketches for their comic book in Nathaniel's room before Shirel knocks on the door and appears in front of them. She asks why they are not at school yet and suddenly notices her son hiding comics on the table, as she begins to get angry by this. Marc defends Nathaniel and says that they were working on schoolwork, which convinces her as she tells them to hurry up or they'll be late for school. On the evening of the same day, when Nathaniel comes home from school, Shirel finds herself in the living room with Aton, holding in her hands the script of their comic book, which was left in Nathaniel's room. She says that there is nothing sincere in this story and while Marc can imagine whatever he wants, Nathaniel mustn't waste his time on comics. She points out that there are a lot of noble arts, such as architecture, industrial design, scenography and his phase of comic books are over. Shirel goes as far as to threaten Nathaniel by saying that if he rebels against her, he'll never see Marc again. She shreds the script and leaves the living room, leaving Nathaniel crying by her harsh words.

title: Shirel Kurtzberg
text:
Shirel Kurtzberg - History
The next school day, Nathaniel gets sick and she picks him up from Gine Jinet, promising to take him to the doctor. They are about to leave when Marinette stops them and begins to prove to Shirel that Nathaniel's comics are a masterpiece and tries to change her mind, saying that her son's talent could change people's minds, pointing out the ending of "Sun-Heart and Rain-Piercer". Shirel realizes that her son has disobeyed her after he gives her a death stare, taking him by the wrist and dragging him out of school, after which the ultrakuma penetrates her earrings. In Shirel's mind, Chrysalis apologizes for the intrusion and gives her the opportunity to fix everything in order to bring her son in line with her vision of the world. Shirel shows a desire and accepts the stranger's deal, becoming the Ruler's villainess and turning into a knight-like villain.
Marc jumps on Ruler's back, forcing her to let go of Nathaniel, after which she throws him onto a bench, accusing him of convincing her son to create comics, after which she pokes him with a ruler and ordering him to leave therefore forgetting about his boyfriend's existence.

title: Shirel Kurtzberg
text:
Shirel Kurtzberg - History
Her son almost becomes the next victim, but Ladybug manages to appear and tie her yo-yo so that Nathaniel can escape and turn into Caprikid, after which she stumbles into a trap and does not have time to run after her son.
After the appearance of Caprikid, Ruler runs away and reflects attacks with markers and pencils, until the appearance of Cat Noir, who tries to use Cataclysm on her, but Ruler closes with a shield and she manages to subdue him, asking him to get Ladybug's earrings.
Later, she fights Caprikid, asking for her son's return before Ladybug takes him away.
Even later, thanks to Cat Noir, Ladybug falls under Ruler and they both find themselves under the influence of Ruler.
But before she can pick up their Miraculouses, Caprikid appears and pokes her with his own ruler, asking her to break her earrings.
After that, Shirel is successfully deakumatized and receives a Magical Charm from Ladybug, who tells her that children must follow their own path, not one that's forced upon them.

title: Shirel Kurtzberg
text:
Shirel Kurtzberg - History
In the evening of the same day, Shirel reads the comic book again and realizes that her son has put his whole heart into creating the comic and remembering Ladybug's earlier words, reconciles with Nathaniel by apologizing to him and telling him that she loves him. Shirel, along with Aton, hugs Nathaniel and allows Marc to join them.

title: Shirel Kurtzberg
text:
Shirel Kurtzberg - Relationships
Family
Nathaniel Kurtzberg/Caprikid
She treats her son strictly. Knowing that he is plastically gifted, she expects him to practice what she believes to be real art. She is not interested in the fact that Nathaniel is passionate about comics, and illustrating such stories gives him joy, and she does not want to understand that such an art form can also carry with it some value. Shirel does everything possible to dissuade the guy from working with Marc and is convinced that she is doing this for his benefit and the future. When she finds out that Nathaniel illustrated the latest comic after he gives her a death stare, she becomes furious. Following her deakumatization, her relationship with Nathaniel improves as she reconciles with him. She now understands him better, as she takes Ladybug's advice that Nathaniel should make his own decisions.

title: Shirel Kurtzberg
text:
Shirel Kurtzberg - Relationships
As Ruler, she strives to ensure that her son and Marc no longer meet, and wants to force her son to comply and choose another field of art. Later, when Ladybug told her to let her son make his own decisions, she apologized and accepted Nathaniel's choice. As Caprikid, regardless of if she is a civilian or villain, she is unaware of his true identity as Nathaniel.
Aton Kurtzberg
Aton is Shirel's husband. He is the exact opposite of his wife, and his gentleness makes a man dominate and obey her when she imposes her point of view on him and Nathaniel. They have different methods of education and visions of art. Shirel believes that only what is on display in museums has value, while Aton takes on other forms. After expressing disapproval to Nathaniel's comic, she told Aton off for exposing him to comics. At the end, they express a better judgment of Nathaniel and Marc's comic.
Acquaintances
Chrysalis

title: Shirel Kurtzberg
text:
Shirel Kurtzberg - Relationships
While she is unaware of Chrysalis' true identity, Chrysalis empathized Shirel's fury due to her son rebelling against her, offering her a deal that she can grant her the power to force people to obey her commands. When she accepted the offer, she allowed Shirel to choose her villain's name.
Marc Anciel
Shirel disliked Marc, threatening Nathaniel that she would forbid him from seeing Marc if he disobeyed. As Ruler, she blamed Marc for influencing Nathaniel to write comics, using her power to manipulate Marc into walking away from Nathaniel, which infuriates Nathaniel. However, after seeing the errors of her ways, she accepted Marc.

title: Shirel Kurtzberg
text:
Shirel Kurtzberg - Etymology
"Shirel" is a Hebrew name meaning "song of god".
"La Redresseuse" in a French meaning "feeder" or "rectifier".

title: Shirel Kurtzberg
text:
Shirel Kurtzberg - Trivia
The relationship between Shirel and Nathaniel mirrors the one between Gabriel and Adrien or the one between Tomoe and Kagami. Shirel, just like Gabriel and Tomoe did, tried to control the future of her son. Despite still supporting his artistic inclination, she disapproved his focus on illustration, instead on other more serious forms of art, going as far as forbidding Nathaniel from cooperating with Marc in their comics.
Unlike Gabriel and Tomoe, she comes to see the error of her ways and manages to make amends with Nathaniel, something that improved their relationship greatly.
Ruler's overall design appeared to be inspired by the Knights Templar, a religious order of knights who were most well-known for their role in the Crusades.

title: Shibuya 106
text:
Shibuya 106 - Intro
(渋谷106) is a chain shopping center located in the Shibuya district of Tokyo, Japan. It is based on the real-life Shibuya 109 center.

title: Shibuya 106
text:
Shibuya 106 - Description
Located at the intersection of Tokyu-Honten-Dori and Dogen-zaka and near the famous Shibuya Crossing, Shibuya 106 is a shopping center specializing in fashion with teenage girls and young women as its target audiences.
Built in 1979 according to plans by Minoru Takeyama, Sibuya 106 is a postmodernist building. It is recognizable by its cylindrical tower clad in aluminum, giving it a sleek appearance, with the enormous "106" sign in red at its summit. The rest of the building forms a Y shape to follow the two streets, also clad in the same material.
This is an important meeting place for Japanese youth.

title: Shibuya 106
text:
Shibuya 106 - Trivia
"109" is a registered trademark in Japan. Due to this, the number has to be changed in a lot of fictional media, such as anime and video games.

title: Shibuya Station
text:
Shibuya Station - Intro
(渋谷駅, Shibuya-eki, Shibuya Station) is a railway station located in the Shibuya district of Tokyo. It is a major station that is served by lines operated by JR East, Tokyo Metro, Tōkyū and Keiō.

title: Shibuya Station
text:
Shibuya Station - Description
In operation since 1885, Shibuya Station is located in the heart of the Shibuya district. Its Hachiko exit, on the square of the same name, is famous for being situated on Shibuya Crossing, an iconic Tokyo landmark and a major meeting place for Japanese people.
It contains three distinct train stations, as well as shopping centers belonging to transport companies.
JR East Station
Shibuya Station, JR East, occupies the eastern part of the station complex. Located next to a local police station, its Hachiko Exit opens directly onto the square of the same name and its statue of the dog Hachiko. The exit features windows tinted a subtle blue with a cloudy effect, as well as large advertising screens covering a significant portion of the facade.
It allows travelers to use three JR East lines: the Yamanote Line, the Saikyo Line, and the Shonan-Shinjuku Line.
Tokyo Department Store
The Tokyu Department Store is an eleven-story shopping mall overlooking Hachiko Square. Its west wing is recognizable by the white upper part of its facade. This building also houses the terminus of the Tokyo Metro's Ginza Line, the oldest subway line in Japan and Asia.
Shibuya Mark City East

title: Shibuya Station
text:
Shibuya Station - Description
Shibuya Mark City East is a 99.67-meter-tall building and the westernmost building in the Shibuya Station complex. It is a 25-story steel-reinforced concrete building comprising a large shopping mall and housing Keio Shibuya Station and the Inokashira Line.
Tokyo Metro/Tokyu
Shibuya Station also has an underground subway station serving the Tokyu Subway (Toyoko and Den-en-toshi lines) and the Tokyo Metro (Hanzomon and Fukutoshin lines).
With several subway entrances located at various points around Shibuya Crossing, the main entrance, Gate A8, is located in Hachiko Square, a few meters from JR East Station. It consists of a small building with advertising panels and information about the various subway lines. There are also stairs and escalators.

title: Shibuya Station
text:
Shibuya Station - Trivia
Shibuya Station is the second busiest train station in the world and in Japan in terms of passengers, surpassed only by Shinjuku Station.
In "Miraculous Tokyo", the station is destroyed in the Stellar Force's fight against the Mecha Kaijū with their Stellar Cannon.

title: Spinning Top
text:
Spinning Top - Intro
The  is the tool of the Bee Miraculous.
The current owner of the spinning top is Zoé Lee, who uses it as the superhero Vesperia.
Previously, it was used by Gabriel Agreste when he unified the Bee Miraculous with the other Miraculous to become Monarch. And also, it was formerly used by Chloé Bourgeois when she used the Bee Miraculous to become Queen Bee and temporarily by Marinette Dupain-Cheng when she unified the Bee and the Ladybug Miraculouses to become Lady Bee.

title: Spinning Top
text:
Spinning Top - Appearance
The spinning top changes color depending on whose possession it's in:
When it is used by Vesperia, the colors of the spinning top are reversed, but with a warmer color of yellow, thus resembling a wasp's stinger. It has a yellow pull string with a yellow ring for her finger. When not in use, Vesperia wears it around her hips.
In Season 6 and onwards, the stripes run crosswise with the spinning top and they have triangles on the bottom of each stripe aimed down, on both sides of the spinning top
When it was used by Queen Bee and Lady Bee, the spinning top was shaped like a teardrop with the point aimed down, resembling a bee's stinger. It was primarily yellow, but had a black dot on the round end, and was wrapped in several diagonally slanted black stripes. It had a black pull string that wrapped around the wielder's finger.
When Queen Bee was akumatized into Queen Wasp and Miracle Queen, the colors of the spinning top were inverted.
When she was akumatized into scarlet version of Queen Wasp, the spinning top kept the same appearance, but instead was red.

title: Spinning Top
text:
Spinning Top - Appearance
When it was used by Monarch, the spinning top had the same color combination as when used by Vesperia, but the color was changed from yellow to purple.

title: Spinning Top
text:
Spinning Top - Abilities
The wielder can use the top to attack or protect; when thrown, it can be used as a projectile and when spun in a circle very quickly it lights up and creates a yellow shield able to deflect or withstand strong attacks. The spinning top is also used for travel in one of two ways: the holder can either swing with it, like a Ladybug holder with the Yo-yo (seen in "Wreckless Driver"), or they can thrown it on the ground and then be pulled around by it (seen in "Queen Wasp"). The length of the string of the top could be controlled by the wielder's willpower, has unlimited length and is indestructible.
The Bee Miraculous' superpower, Venom, involves the top by holding it, with the user hitting the target with the point of the top, immobilizing them.
The spinning top can also be used as a communicator, splitting into two pieces in a manner similar to a candlestick phone.

title: Spinning Top
text:
Spinning Top - Trivia
The spinning top is specifically a trompo, a type of top with a string attached to it.
The weapon was revealed in a storyboard video of Queen Bee using it, which Jeremy Zag posted on Instagram.
It is the second Miraculous tool introduced to be based off of a toy, after the Ladybug Miraculous' yo-yo, and before the Mouse Miraculous' skip rope and the Dog Miraculous' ball.
It's the third Miraculous tool to be revealed to be able to be used for communication, following the Ladybug Miraculous' yo-yo, and the Cat Miraculous' staff.
It's the third Miraculous tool to be revealed to be able to be used as a method of transportation, following the Ladybug Miraculous' yo-yo, and the Cat Miraculous' staff.
The spinning top is the first Miraculous tool to be an akumatized object.
When it's not worn, the string is black, but when wrapped around Queen Bee's and Vesperia's waists, the string is yellow like their costumes. It's unknown whether that's part of the magic, or just a design choice.
The spinning top is the last tool that Gabriel Agreste used before making the wish that would sacrifice himself to save Nathalie and join his wife in the afterlife.

title: Snake Miraculous
text:
Snake Miraculous - Intro
The  is an Ouroboros Bracelet that, whenever Sass inhabits it, transforms the wearer into a snake-themed superhero with the power of Intuition.
To activate the Ouroboros bracelet, the user must speak the transformation phrase: "Scales Slither". To deactivate the Ouroboros bracelet, the user must speak the detransformation phrase: "Scales Rest".
The bracelet is currently owned by Luka Couffaine, who uses it to transform into Viperion. It was previously stored in the Chinese Miracle Box and only lent out to him when the situation required it. But, as of "Re-creation", he now posseses the Miraculous permanently.

title: Snake Miraculous
text:
Snake Miraculous - Appearance
In general, the Snake Miraculous is an Ouroboros bracelet. In charged mode, when Sass inhabits it, it is sea green and features a snake that can be slid back to reveal a yellow forked tongue, divided into five parts. If a minor is using the miraculous, the bracelet starts running out of power, it makes a ticking sound, then the snake figurehead starts to slide in place, when the 5 parts of the snake tongue start to turn grey, (one part is equivalent to one minute) Luka (or another Snake Miraculous holder) has left.
In Season 6 onwards, the bracelet is now shaped like an open hoop. Its structure is a shiny mint green, with a smooth, metallic finish. The snake's head is now shaped like a teardrop, and the rest of the band represents the animal's body, curving to join together at the back. To activate it, one must slide the head of the snake through one side of the bracelet, instead around the bracelet itself (like in the previous form).
When Ladybug fused the miraculous with the Ladybug Miraculous, the bracelet changed color to copper pink.
In its activated mode, the tongue turns grey.
In its camouflage mode, the bracelet changes color and form depending on who possesses it:

title: Snake Miraculous
text:
Snake Miraculous - Appearance
In the possession of Luka Couffaine, it is silver, with ridges.
When it was worn by Gabriel Agreste, it appeared as a silver band with an indent in the front.
When it was worn by Marinette Dupain-Cheng, it became a little thinner than Luka's and was rose gold with an open end, as well as vaguely snake-shaped.
When it was worn by Adrien Agreste, it was similarly silver to Luka's camouflage mode, but it was completely smooth.
In its reforged ring form, it was a thick band with a circular surface, similar to the Cat Miraculous, bearing the symbol of the Snake Miraculous which glowed turquoise. It used to sit on the intermediate phalanx of Gabriel's right middle finger.

title: Snake Miraculous
text:
Snake Miraculous - Abilities
The Snake Miraculous has the ability to transform its wielder into a snake-themed superhero, granting its wielder incredible superhuman powers of speed, endurance, agility, stamina and strength. It also makes the user nearly invulnerable to damage. It's special weapon is an unbreakable Lyre which can be also be utilized as both a weapon, a communicator, and an object that can be used to breathe underwater.

title: Snake Miraculous
text:
Snake Miraculous - Abilities
Its special superpower is Second Chance, which gives the user the ability to mark a savepoint in time by sliding the snake on the Miraculous and rewind the timeline back to that exact marked point in order to obtain their goal, like defeating a villain. The timeframe of the temporal loop created by Second Chance is exactly 5 minutes after the safepoint was created - while in the active loop, the user can rewind back to the safepoint as much as they deem necessary. Only one Second Chance temporal loop can be marked per given time. The user's memory remains perfectly untouched, allowing them to correct anything that may have happened before going back in time. However, those around a Snake Miraculous holder can only see the final reality that is created with Second Chance due to the effects of the temporal loop, as time is constantly being rewritten - these indviduals do not retain any memories of the erased timelines, regardless of how subtle or dramatic the changes were.

title: Snake Miraculous
text:
Snake Miraculous - Abilities
As long as the superpower isn't used by a minor, the wielder can remain transformed indefinitely. However, as soon as the time limit is up, the underage wielder loses power and the transformation wears off in about approximately five minutes. If the superpower is used by an adult, the wielder can use the superpower indefinitely. The Ouroboros bracelet also has the ability to give the wielder the costume they truly desire.

title: Snake Miraculous
text:
Snake Miraculous - History
Five thousand years ago, a mage successfully helped the kwamis to interact with humans by creating magic jewels, which were called Miraculouses. In order to repay the mage, and to live on the physical world alongside humans, the kwamis decided to help humanity by letting humans utilize their energy and powers through the Miraculous they were bonded with, which included Sass and the Snake Miraculous.
At some point in time, all of the knowledge about the Miraculouses and their powers was written down in code in a book called the Grimoire, with very few people knowing how to decipher the code. Miracle Boxes were also created at an unknown time to store the dormant Miraculouses. To protect and distribute Miraculouses, the Order of the Guardians was formed and existed for many years. Throughout its existence, guardians trained younger generations to keep a watchful eye over the Miraculouses and the Grimoire, which were placed in the guardians' temple.
Many Snake holders throughout history used Sass's power for good, like Shè in China, who started the legacy.

title: Snake Miraculous
text:
Snake Miraculous - History
172 years ago, after an disastrous event where a young Wang Fu used the Peacock Miraculous to create a sentimonster and his negative emotions and imaturity led to the creature rampaging through the temple and eating and destroying everything in its path, Fu was entrusted with the Chinese Miracle Box (which included the Snake Miraculous) by a monk and was told to run away from the mess. However, on the mountain range outside the temple, in order to escape from the the monster, Fu jumped over a fissure on the ground - accidently opening the Box and spilling all of its contents on the snow. Due to his distress, Fu didnt notice he accidently left both the Peacock and the Butterfly on the mountain, alongisde the Grimoire, until it was too late and he was too far away to come back. Somewhere along the line, the Peacock got dangerously damaged, to the point of being improper for use - but, as it turns out, no one knew of this fact until it was too late.

title: Snake Miraculous
text:
Snake Miraculous - History
On a previous trip overseas with the Agrestes, Nathalie found the Butterfly and Peacock Miraculouses and gave the jewels to Gabriel. In "Representation", it was revealed that neither the Agrestes nor the Graham de Vanily couples could bear children on their own, so Émilie and Colt used the Peacock Miraculous to create Adrien and Félix respectively, but in doing so, they grew sick over time and were eventually left in a condition where they fell into an eternal slumber due to using the Peacock Miraculous in its damaged state.

title: Snake Miraculous
text:
Snake Miraculous - History
Desperate to fix his mistake, Gabriel Agreste began using the Butterfly Miraculous for evil to obtain the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses in order to gain access to their absolute power, becoming the supervillain Hawk Moth, later Shadow Moth (when unified with a now fixed Peacock Miraculous), and finally Monarch. This decision proved one of the most significant for the history of the series, as Gabriel began utilizing Nooroo's power to akumatize the civilians of Paris, France, trying to get one of them to draw out the current holders of the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses, unintenionally helping start off Marinette's and Adrien's journeys as Ladybug and Cat Noir, and later, the rest of the Miraculers.
In "Desperada", Adrien was Ladybug's initial choice, using the Miraculous to become the hero Aspik. However, Adrien's love for Ladybug blinded him to the mission at hand, causing him to fail constantly at using Second Chance correctly - after many failed attempts, Adrien reliquinshed the Miraculous and gave it back to Ladybug. However, Adrien would use it again in "Miracle Queen" by fusing the Cat Miraculous with it in order to become Snake Noir - this time, he managed to succed.

title: Snake Miraculous
text:
Snake Miraculous - History
Later on in the episode, Adrien suggested Luka Couffaine to be the next Snake holder. Ladybug agreed, and he used the Snake Miraculous to become the hero Viperion. Luka, from that point on, became a member of the team, helping Ladybug and Cat Noir during "particularly difficult missions". From "Desperada" to "Strikeback", Luka was a temporary holder, meaning he would only receive the Miraculous from Ladybug when he was needed for the mission, and had to give it back after the crisis was solved.
Félix, after finding out about his true origins as a sentihuman and learning that the Peacock Miraculous could erase his and his cousin's lifes if it feel into the wrong hands, orchestrated a plan to capture all of the Miraculouses of the Chinese Box from Ladybug and traded all of them (besides the Ladybug and the Cat) for the Peacock, which included the Snake Miraculous, succeeding in "Strikeback". When Gabriel unified it with the Butterfly and other miraculouses, he became Monarch.

title: Snake Miraculous
text:
Snake Miraculous - History
In "Destruction", Gabriel used a laser machine to melt down the Miraculous into a pile of dust, and then reforged it into a special Alliance ring for transferring Sass's power of Intuition to any akumatized villain who wore a regular Alliance ring. However, differently from all of the other Miraculous he also turned into rings, he chose not lend out its power, as giving the power of Second Chance to someone else could prove disastrous. As of "Intuition", he could not use the power himself anymore because it was expediting the spread of his Cataclysm injury - because of this, he effectively renounced the Snake Miraculous, even if he still wore it and was its de facto owner.
In "Re-creation", Marinette Dupain-Cheng manages to recover all of the Miraculous that were previously stolen. In "Miraculous London", Lila stole all of the Miraculous under Marinette's care in an alternate timeline, which included the Snake Miraculous, in order to render her truly powerless and to fuse the Ladybug and the Cat to gain her wish without her interference, but her plan was ultimately thwarted by the combined efforts of Chronobug and Bunnyx, and the event was erased from the timeline.

title: Snake Miraculous
text:
Snake Miraculous - History
After the events of "Miraculous London", Marinette, having realized both instances of all of the Miraculouses being stolen happened because all of them were kept in the same place, and with the idea that centralized power is inherently flawed, and that distributing it among members of a society is a far superior idea, restored and upgraded the Snake Miraculous by redesigning its original design and adding the Miraculous Call: a call feature that grants the holder the ability to summon other superheroes who possess a Miraculous from the Chinese Miracle Box in order to receive aid on their missions. This new feature is particularly useful, as the new holder of the Butterfly Miraculous, Chrysalis, is even more fearsome than her predecessor. After the alterations, the Snake Miraculous was given back to Luka permanently - putting Viperion back on the map.

title: Snake Miraculous
text:
Snake Miraculous - History
In-between the events of "Miraculous London" and "Climatiqueen", Luka, who still harbored feelings for Marinette, realized he couldn't keep on seeing Marinette and Adrien together, fearing his longing for her could've ended up turning into resentment and ruining his friendship with both of them, as well as being scared of possibly being targeted by Chrysalis, as he knows both of Ladybug's and Cat Noir's secret identities, decided on a whim to move to Brazil with his father, taking the Snake Miraculous with him to Rio de Janeiro.
In "Mister Agreste", after having a nervous breakdown because of the lie she told everyone, Marinette decided to fly to Brasil to meet Luka and then asked for his Miraculous and temporarily fused the Ladybug and Snake to become Viperbug, using Second Chance to vent to Luka about the truth without permanent consequences - she gave the Miraculous back to him and decided not to tell him in the permanent timeline, after being scared of his intense reaction in the alternate timeline.

title: Snake Miraculous
text:
Snake Miraculous - Trivia
Snakes symbolize rebirth, patience, intuition, healing, and being of a sinister nature.
The snake is modeled after an Ouroboros, a symbol of a snake biting or eating its own tail. It is a symbol of self-reflexivity, cyclical, and eternal return.
The Snake Miraculous shares similar abilities with the Rabbit Miraculous, as both can be used to manipulate time.
Both can be used as many times as the user wants or needs, though the latter has no time limit on its ability.
Unlike the Rabbit Miraculous, the Snake Miraculous is only capable of going backwards in time for a few seconds or minutes. The Rabbit Miraculous is capable of manipulating time freely.
While the Snake Miraculous allows its user to go back to change events, the Rabbit Miraculous allows its user to go back to participate in them, while not necessarily changing the future the user came from.
While the Snake Miraculous user is not affected by the time changes, the Rabbit Miraculous user may suffer from them, as shown in "Cat Blanc".

title: Snake Miraculous
text:
Snake Miraculous - Trivia
While Snake Miraculous users can tell their allies what's going to happen in the immediate future, Rabbit Miraculous user cannot do so or need to do or say as little as possible to prevent altering the future.
According to Dragon Bug, the Snake Miraculous is one of the most dangerous Miraculouses if used for evil, only second to the Rabbit Miraculous.
This is the second Miraculous that is a bracelet, following the Turtle and and being followed by the Tiger.
The Snake Miraculous also shares similarities with the Tiger and Cat Miraculous.
All are directly used to activate their respective powers, rather than the user's tool.
All are worn on the users' hands.
All are based off ferocious but calm and intelligent creatures.
Another coincidence is that the primary holders of the Snake and the Tiger are twin brother and sister.
As of "Mister Agreste", this is the second Miraculous that has been used in a unification by both Ladybug and Cat Noir, as they used it to become Viperbug in "Mister Agreste" and Snake Noir in "Miracle Queen", respectively. The first was the Rabbit Miraculous.
Curiously, both have time-related powers.

title: Solitude
text:
Solitude - Intro
is a French film by Graham Films. It was directed and produced by André Bourgeois and starred Émilie Agreste. According to Adrien, the film is very rare, and Gabriel is the only person to own a DVD of the film.

title: Solitude
text:
Solitude - Description
The film is in black and white. The opening sequence includes Émilie's character walking along a bank of the Seine river with an umbrella.

title: Solitude
text:
Solitude - Trivia
The logo of the film's production studio, "Graham Films", is two linked rings, a possible reference to the Graham de Vanily Twin Rings.
The producer's name, "A. Bourgeois", suggests a familial relation to Chloé Bourgeois.
In "Sole Crusher", it is revealed that André Bourgeois was the one who produced the film. Émilie Agreste both wrote the film and starred in it.
In "Gorizilla", Adrien, believing his father won't let him watch the film, sneaks out of the mansion to see it in the Le Sorbonne.
Later, Adrien with Gabriel watch the film together in his room.

title: Snowflake
text:
Snowflake - Intro
is a minor character of Miraculous World: New York - United Heroez. She is an ice-themed superhero and member of United Heroez, a team of superheroes, that protects the United States of America.

title: Snowflake
text:
Snowflake - Appearance
As Snowflake
Snowflake's skin tone is white and the eye makeup and lipstick are blue. The eyes of the protagonist are presumably white with blue snowflake-like pupils. She has a blue snowflake on her forehead. The snow-white hair is cut at shoulder length, with a significant part combed to the right side, while the fringe - at the level of the cheekbones.
The superheroine is dressed in a white costume with blue reflections that covers her entire body. There are many white and blue snowflakes on the outfit. There is also a large snowflake tiara on the back of her head. She is accompanied by snowfall that appears around her body.

title: Snowflake
text:
Snowflake - Personality
Snowflake's personality is not exactly known. In "Miraculous New York", she is brave and courageous. She is not afraid to stand up to fight the enemy to protect people. She is also loyal to other heroes. Given that she started playing around with her powers after being hit by Liberation, she is presumably normally very responsible and serious.

title: Snowflake
text:
Snowflake - Abilities
Snowflake can fly and has the power to control snow and ice. She can make ice sculptures with her icy breath.

title: Snowflake
text:
Snowflake - History
Miraculous New York
Snowflake is seen on the news with the other members of the United Heroez, where President Camilla Hombee/Victory makes a statement about the hunt for Techno-Pirate and postpones the French-American Friendship Week celebration ceremony. Later in Times Square, Snowflake re-materializes on a rooftop where she meets with Majestia, Knightowl, Hurricane, and Victory. She is then told by Majestia to wait until she lands to make a move.
After Majestia lands, Snowflake and the other superheroes surround Techno-Pirate, now Miraclonizer, who uses the Eagle Miraculous's power of Liberation to free all the superheroes from their ethical constraints, with Snowflake's being to use her powers when needed. Snowflake then began to use her powers to create ice all over the street and went ice skating on it.

title: Snowflake
text:
Snowflake - History
Later, Snowflake shoots blasts of ice at Sparrow but she dodges them and then kicks Snowflake in return. She is then seen looking for Sparrow, along with the other superheroes. Once she is freed from the effects of Miraclonizer's use of Liberation by Eagle, she attends the French American Friendship celebration ceremony. There Snowflake used with her icy breath to make an ice statue of Ladybug, Cat Noir, Uncanny Valley, and Eagle. She then celebrated them as she flew in the air.

title: Snowflake
text:
Snowflake - Trivia
She has similar abilities to Killer Frost and Ice from the DC Comics and Iceman from Marvel Comics.
According to Thomas Astruc, he created her so the term "Snowflake" can't be used as an insult. This is another example of his support of many social justice movements, whose members have been called "Snowflakes" by people who disagree with them, because according to them, they are over-sensitive, like snowflakes.

title: Sole Crusher
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Sole Crusher - Intro
"" is a season 4 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 7th written and produced episode of season 4. It is also the 85th written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Sole Crusher
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Sole Crusher - Synopsis
Marinette meets Zoé. They instantly hit it off, but Marinette didn't know that Zoé is Chloé's half-sister! Chloé forces Zoé to be mean to Marinette to earn her place in the Bourgeois family. Indeed, to Chloé, there are two types of people in life: those who crush others, and those who get crushed. Zoé hesitates between Marinette and Chloé and gets akumatized into Sole Crusher, a giant golden supervillain who look just like Chloé who absorbs people with her shoes. Ladybug and Cat Noir won't let her walk over them if they want to stop her!
Disney+
Ladybug and Cat Noir face off against Sole Crusher.
Netflix
Zoé tries to impress her snobby half-sister, Chloé, but the pressure to fit in transforms her into the gigantic Sole-Crusher who only Ladybug can stop.

title: Sole Crusher
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Sole Crusher - Plot
The episode starts with a taxi driver giving Zoé a tour of Paris.
They pass by multiple landmarks such as the Eiffel Tower, Jardins du Trocadéro and the Louvre.
During the tour, Zoé sees the Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie, and asks the taxi driver to stop, saying that she always wanted to eat Parisian croissants.
Inside the bakery, Zoé asks Sabine Cheng for some croissants and receives them quickly.
Marinette then walks in with a box of apples and accidently bumps into Zoé.
Marinette apologizes and Zoé says it's ok.
Zoé helps Marinette up, and Marinette begins to explain how clumsy she is.
Zoé laughs, and helps Marinette place the apples back in the box.
Marinette asks if Zoé needs anything, but she says she is okay.
Marinette, however, asks her mom for a dozen extra croissants in apology, but then pauses since she doesn't know the other's name.
Zoé tells her name to Marinette, and Marinette says she is Miss Walking-Disaster.
She asks Zoé where she's from since her accent is "really pretty".
Zoé tells Marinette that she is from New York, and she came to live with her family that lives in Paris.
Marinette notices Zoé's sneakers and asks if she drew on them herself.

title: Sole Crusher
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Sole Crusher - Plot
Zoé says that on them she wrote everything she'd been told that was nice.
Marinette points out there's only one thing, and Zoé answers saying that she only had one friend.
Marinette tells Zoé that she and her friends are going to put on a show in the Liberty that night in the Seine.
Before going, Marinette writes her number on the box Zoé ordered, while Zoé writes downs hers on Marinette's hand.

title: Sole Crusher
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Sole Crusher - Plot
A while after, Zoé arrives at the Le Grand Paris hotel and gives the croissants to the taxi driver telling them to share it with their kids, they ask about if she wants to keep some for her family, and she says no, they prefer sour to sweets. The taxi driver thanks Zoé and tells her to enjoy her journey, as Zoé looks at Marinette's number, storing the box in her purse. At the entrance, Armand greets her, and takes her inside to see her mother, Audrey Bourgeois. Zoé tries to put on a mean façade in order to match her mother's demeanor, saying her flight was terrible when asked if it was horrific because she looked the part. Zoé talks of someone in economy class having disgustingly smelly cologne and the flight attendants' refusal to open the window. Audrey questions her not getting a private jet from her forgetful father then says he's "too busy for anyone as usual". Zoé's told it's fine she wants to come with them in Paris but asked about what exactly was wrong with her boarding school. Zoé blames her want to move on the existence of roaches in her locker and that on the establishment.
At Audrey's order, Zoé is taken to meet Chloé, her half-sister.

title: Sole Crusher
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Sole Crusher - Plot
Chloé looks her up and down, telling her that she measures up to the family standards so far due to her blonde hair and blue eyes and makes an at least physically acceptable sister.
She shows disgust at Zoé's phone and sneakers and introduces diamond ones saying that, in life, there are winners and losers, and winners have their "perfect little feet" in said shoes, while losers get crushed under the souls.
Chloé asks her if she wants the shoes and Zoé reaches out, but Chloé takes moves them away.
Chloé says if Zoé wants to be a winner and part of the family, she's going to have to earn her place.
Chloé says she'll mentor Zoé and that if she proves worthy as a sister, she might maybe get to borrow the diamond shoes.
Zoé continues to act mean so as to appease Chloé.
Rule #1 is that her father only exists to give her whatever she wants whenever she wants.
Calling up her father -who appears in seconds- Chloé demands he have something painted pink before she goes to school and then cuts off his protest by closing the door.
Chloé says if she becomes her sister Zoé can use her father (Mayor André Bourgeois) since her birth one isn't there.

title: Sole Crusher
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Sole Crusher - Plot
Rule #2 is the existence of a minion in your possession and when asked for hers Zoé says she left them in New York.
Chloé calls that a "fatal mistake" saying "you never go anywhere without your minion" and walks over to her closet stating, "don't confuse a minion for a pet" and that she'll teach her that later.
Chloé says "a minion is someone who does everything for you" then opens her closet doors and berates Sabrina about not having finished some math homework yet.
Sabrina apologizes saying it's because of the darkness.
At school, after making Sabrina run next to the car the whole way, shoving her bag on a boy, she thought good enough, and forgetting Zoé's name, Chloé introduces Zoé to the student body, demanding that they treat her with respect. Alya, Rose, Juleka, and Alix immediately think the new girl is bad news, like a second Chloé, but Marinette puts their anger to rest by saying not to judge quickly. She tries to talk to Zoé and ask about the macaroons. When Chloé gets angered over the fact that they seem to know each other, Zoé claims she had 'good taste' and threw the macaroons away. Disheartened, Marinette leaves, and Zoé gains admiration from her sister and Sabrina.

title: Sole Crusher
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Sole Crusher - Plot
Zoé is eventually settled into Ms. Mendeleiev's class after threatening to call her stepfather. In art class, the girls discuss ways to get Zoé away from her sister's toxic influence, with Rose asking if they could adopt her. Marinette says she'll make the first move. On the way home, Chloé finally allows Zoé to have the diamond heels she promised.
At home, Marinette ponders why Zoé was so mean earlier; Daizzi suggests it was because she was hungry. Confident that Zoé's true self was the one in the morning, Marinette texts her; Tikki says that as long as she acts with good intent, nothing bad will happen. Back at the hotel, Chloé searches for the shoes while Zoé receives the text, saying they can talk in private and that she's still invited to the party that evening. Zoé writes back that she'll explain everything later. Chloé notices this and is infuriated, telling Zoé that she either walks over others or she walks on her and that Zoé should be proud to be in the family. Zoé, acting mean once more, says she plans to humiliate Marinette by throwing the macaroons in the river. Buying this, Chloé begins writing down other ways to ruin Marinette's life while Zoé steps onto the balcony.

title: Sole Crusher
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Sole Crusher - Plot
Looking out onto the city, Zoé contemplates throwing the shoes away, but relents. She is noticed by André, who asks if she's okay. He tells her that he used to be a filmmaker but was pushed into politics by his family. Zoé explains that, back home, she liked acting, but ended up acting so much she tried to please everyone and concealed her true self. André shows her his "dream depository" where he keeps his movie scripts and supplies away from Audrey and Chloé so that they would accept him and says he can make room for her things. Saddened and remembering Chloé's harsh words, Zoé ends up putting her sneakers in. Meanwhile, Shadow Moth detects Zoé's sadness and lack of acceptance, sending out an akuma following her.
As Zoé puts on the diamond shoes, the akuma infects her old sneakers. Shadow Moth christens her Sole Crusher, offering her the power to get revenge on Chloé. Zoé accepts and transforms as André runs to hide. Now Sole Crusher, she uses her powers to absorb Armand and the hotel residents into her shoes, making her grow to a gigantic size.

title: Sole Crusher
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Sole Crusher - Plot
When she comes for Chloé, the latter runs away, eventually stopping at the bakery and causing Tom and Sabine to get absorbed. She breaks into Marinette's room and barricades the door, but Sole Crusher simply tears the roof open. Chloé pushes Marinette into the villain's grasp, but Sole Crusher simply holds her in her hand instead of absorbing her (due to her earlier kindness towards her) and continues chasing Chloé across the city. Tikki instructs Kaalki to teleport to Plagg and send for Cat Noir, before leaving to be with Marinette. Though hesitant at first, Kaalki opens Voyage into Adrien's room, but it has the side effect of sucking Plagg's camembert and Adrien's globe into space and Adrien's foosball table into a gorilla exhibit at the zoo. Adrien is caught up and transforms.
Sole Crusher continues her rampage as Chloé gets near the Liberty, where Kitty Section is setting up.
Chloé tells her half-sister that if she really wants to be like her, then she should crush the "losers" instead of her despite Sole Crusher's reluctance, and threatens to send her back to New York if she doesn't, and tells her that she may be bigger, but she is still just a "ridiculous copy of her".

title: Sole Crusher
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Sole Crusher - Plot
However, before Sole Crusher could do anything, Marinette intervenes, telling Sole Crusher that Chloe's words are untrue and that she doesn't need to crush anyone.
Marinette explains to Sole Crusher that the "winner and loser" concept doesn't exist, meaning neither winners or losers exist, that everyone are just themselves, are different in their own way, and has unique differences and other individualities as Cat Noir shows up, unintentionally interrupting Marinette in the process, and he makes a pun about someone "getting off on the wrong foot", which annoys Sole Crusher.
Marinette interrupts him back, stating that she isn't finished, much to Cat Noir's confusion.
Marinette continues, telling Sole Crusher that no one will judge her the way her old classmates in New York did and that she can be herself.
She assures Sole Crusher that she will always have someone like her to help her when she trips or falls and that she will always be there for her.
Sole Crusher is deeply touched by Marinette's words, but Shadow Moth contacts her, threatening to remove her powers and put her on the "losers" side.

title: Sole Crusher
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Sole Crusher - Plot
Sole Crusher listens to her master and continues, saying that no one will boss her around again.
Cat Noir trips Sole Crusher with his staff, causing Sole Crusher to fall and Marinette to be freed.
She runs into a safe spot and reunites with Tikki.
She then transforms into Ladybug.

title: Sole Crusher
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Sole Crusher - Plot
The heroes fight Sole Crusher, but their battle ends up causing mass destruction. Ladybug summons her Lucky Charm, receiving a shoehorn. She takes this as a hint that the akuma is in one of Sole Crusher's shoes. Cat Noir Cataclysms her right heel and Ladybug breaks the left one with her yo-yo; this makes Sole Crusher loses her balance, but no akuma comes out of either one. Chloé yells at her sister for causing harm to her priceless shoes and tells her to go back to her old sneakers. As Sole Crusher finally absorbs Chloé, the heroes realize the akuma's true hiding spot and race to the hotel to search Chloé's room. They didn't find one, but André comes out of hiding and says he knows the sneakers' location. As they reach the depository, Sole Crusher arrives, now bigger than the building itself, and winds up for a punch. Ladybug uses the shoehorn to quickly open the bin and rip up the infected shoe. She purifies the akuma, repairs the damage with Miraculous Ladybug, and gives the freed Zoé a Magical Charm. Thankful, Zoé says the heroes are truly miraculous as they leave. Vengeful, Shadow Moth tells Ladybug that he will crush her one day.

title: Sole Crusher
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Sole Crusher - Plot
In the evening, Zoé is welcomed aboard the Liberty with the macaroons as Chloé and Audrey watch from the Hotel balcony. Zoé apologizes for the mess she caused, saying she only wanted to impress her family and be accepted. Back home, people bullied her and called her a loser, but she vows to be different. Ivan takes the first step and warmly hugs her, with Mylène saying that they can be her new family. Chloé is outraged as they all eat the macarons and party into the night.
When Zoé returns to the hotel, she returns the diamond shoes and Chloé demands André to let Zoé leave Paris. André says that the paperwork will take a while, so Zoé will have to stay with them for a couple of months. Chloé wants her in the basement, but André takes her to another room instead. Away from Audrey and Chloé, Zoé thanks him and tells him not to give up on his dreams.
In bed, Marinette receives a text from Zoé, thanking her and the others for being by her side. A montage shows Zoé meeting more of Marinette's friends and allowing Rose and Juleka to dye a strand of her hair pink, finally giving her the freedom of being her own person.

Sole Crusher - Plot Developments
It's revealed that Audrey had an affair with a man back in New York, and they had a daughter together; Zoé.
It's revealed that Mayor Bourgeois had the dream to become a movie director and that he was the one to produce and direct the movie Solitude, which Émilie Agreste starred in.
This finally reveals "A. Bourgeois", as seen in the film's credits, is André, which he later confirms in "Queen Banana".
It's revealed that Sabrina does Chloé's homework in Chloé's wardrobe in the dark. As she says that her eyes are getting used to the dark, it's implied that she has been doing Chloé's homework in the wardrobe for quite some time.
According to Feri González, this episode features Zoé's first appearance and chronologically takes place before "Queen Banana".
It's also seen in the end scene card where it's Chloé next to a neon purple butterfly foreshadowing her akumatization.
The neon drawings at the end card foreshadow major events involving Zoé:
The purple butterfly near Chloé foreshadows the events of "Queen Banana", where Zoé becomes the new holder of the Bee Miraculous.
The green cat foreshadows the events of "Transmission", where she becomes the temporary holder of the Cat Miraculous.

This time, the unrestrained version of Kaalki's powers is revealed when she uses Voyage: her portals can suck nearby objects and teleport them to random locations, including space.
Kaalki is the fifth Kwami to know that Adrien is Cat Noir following Plagg, Wayzz, Tikki and possibly Sass (who must have heard Aspik's confession to Ladybug during one of the time loops).
Despite being aware that Plagg has an owner up until this episode Kaalki didn't know what Cat Noir looked like in civilian form mostly she used her powers while thinking about Plagg and his location.
Meaning that Kaalki and her owners can not only use their powers in the terms of where they are thinking about but also who they're thinking about.

When Shadow Moth states when he contacts the titular villain after Marinette tries to reason with Sole Crusher, that he can sense her "weakening", implying the Butterfly Miraculous holder can monitor the emotional well-being and resolve of their transformed champions even while they are in action. This proves Shadow Moth can constantly read his villains resolve even while they are mid-rampage. This also confirms the holder can continuously read the champion's emotional state, psychological resolve, and vulnerability to purification from afar.
However, despite having this deep emotional awareness, the Butterfly Miraculous holder's sensing is strictly internal and lacks visual data. Because the sensing is strictly an internal, magical tether, the Butterfly Miraculous holder sees and hears only what the villain directly perceives.

It is likely that no other translation of this episode uses a literal translation of the full title used by the English translation, since the sole/soul pun that the English title employs does not work in any of those other languages.
This is the first time Chloé has ever been in Marinette's room.

He's also seen sitting in the same row as Aurore, possibly being a reference to both of their names being based on natural phenomena.

(holding the booklet to his chest) We end up burying out feelings deep, here. (puts the booklet back in the cellar) And here. (turns to Zoé) If you want, I can make some space for you.

(Zoé looks down at her shoes sadly. Then a resigned look. She puts the shoes in the cellar. She looks down, hurt, as the cellar door closes.)

title: Sole Crusher/Transcript
text:

text:

Which is why I left New York in the first place. At the boarding school, I was playing a part; being someone else, hoping they'd accept me. But finally, I just couldn't anymore. That's when everyone turned against me, and one day, I found roaches in my locker. They all said I was a loser. Maybe they were right. I get that I'm different, and...
