title: Socqueline Wang
text:
Socqueline Wang - Intro
is a minor character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She is a student at Lycée Claude Monet and a former schoolmate of Marinette Dupain-Cheng. She sometimes helps out at her family's arts and crafts supply shop.

title: Socqueline Wang
text:
Socqueline Wang - Appearance
Physical Appearance
She looks similar to Marinette Dupain-Cheng, with longer hair and ponytails. Like Marinette, she is half Chinese, half French, and has blue eyes and a light skin-tone.
Civilian Attire
She has black square-shaped glasses and wears a black sweater and a red-black plaid shirt, bright pink jeans and red sport shoes with white laces.
In the flashback in "Derision", it is shown that last school year, when she was in the 9th grade, she wore a dark blue shirt and white sweater and black jeans with the same sport shoes.

title: Socqueline Wang
text:
Socqueline Wang - Personality
Socqueline is an energetic teenage girl. She is a fan of Adrien Agreste, and is even ecstatic when she learns that Marinette is in the same class as him. She is also a fan of Ladybug, as she dresses up as her and pretends to be her, unaware that she puts herself in grave danger. Her greatest desire is to help Ladybug and Cat Noir. She is not fond of her former schoolmate Chloé Bourgeois, and would always defend Marinette whenever she bullied her.
In fact, it's showed in "Derision" that Socqueline was basically the only person at school who was not afraid of standing up against Chloé, who, in turn, was intimidated by a girl older than her precisely because she didn't fear her. Just like Adrien learned, she too looked beyond knowing that force, intimidation nor status can only go so far.

title: Socqueline Wang
text:
Socqueline Wang - Abilities
Socqueline is a very talented gymnast, being a champion in the Grand Prix Gymnastics three years in a row. She also practices taekwondo. Socqueline is also very clever as she was able to hide her Ladybug identity from Marinette very skillfully. While not as good as Lila, she is adequate at acting or deceiving people.

title: Socqueline Wang
text:
Socqueline Wang - Relationships
Friends/Allies
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/Ladybug
Denis Damoclès
Mr. Damoclès and Socqueline seem to have a rather good relationship as seen in "Jubilation", even after the latter no longer studies at the former's school. This is shown when she helps him while pretending to be Ladybug whenever he ends up in trouble while performing his good deeds as The Owl. Inclusive, Mr. Damoclès is shown to buy supplies (like materials to do his owl mask) from her family's shop. Socqueline also seems to be encouraging towards Mr. Damoclès' superhero work, even if sometimes her encouragement may cause the opposite effect at the wrong time (like when Mr. Damoclès was feeling down about being The Owl).
During one of Marinette's flashbacks in "Derision", it was shown that, despite having a good relationship with her former principal, Socqueline was suspended by Mr. Damoclès for the rest of the school year (causing her to miss the end-of-the-year party and graduation) for something that happened outside the school out of fear of what Chloé's father, the mayor, could do. Despite that, Socqueline didn't hold a grudge on him and they continued to be on good terms with one another.

title: Socqueline Wang
text:
Socqueline Wang - Relationships
When confronted by Darker Owl, Socqueline did everything she could to help deakumatize him like tricking to reveal where his megakuma was so she could record the information for Ladybug.
Adrien Agreste/Cat Noir
Socqueline is a great admirer of Adrien, including having him as an Avatar on her Alliance ring. After learning that Marinette studies at the same class as him, she wishes she had got hold off an year just to be able to at least study at the same school as him.
Just as she is an admirer of him, she is also one of Cat Noir, admiring his work and Ladybug's greatly. Because of her admiration for them and her eagerness to help, Socqueline would many times dress up as Ladybug and perform many good deeds. After becoming a target and a hostage for Darker Owl, she is saved by Cat Noir. Despite promising Ladybug to never put herself in unnecessary danger, Socqueline would always help the heroes in their plans, like she did in "Transmission" and "Perfection".
Sabine Cheng
It is implied in a flashback in "Derision", that Socqueline forged a friendship with Marinette's mother by honoring Sabine's promise of wanting Socqueline to protect Marinette from Chloé's constant bullying.
Enemies

title: Socqueline Wang
text:
Socqueline Wang - Relationships
Chloé Bourgeois
Unlike most of the students and teachers at school during the previous school year, Socqueline was not afraid of the rich girl and would always stand up to her whenever she caught her bullying Marinette. In fact, she was the only person Chloé wouldn't mess with precisely because the former was not afraid of her. But just because Socqueline wasn't afraid of Chloé, it didn't meant that she was not out of her reach. Such as after preventing Chloé from publishing a video of Marinette falling for one of Kim's cruel pranks by breaking the phone where the video was, the mayor's daughter was able to manipulate Principal Damoclès into suspending her for the rest of the remaining school year, even if he didn't actually had the power to punish Socqueline for something she did outside of the school.
While Socqueline didn't appear in "Revolution", it is likely that she was thrown into the Chloé inhumane detention center and was freed by Ladybug and Cat Noir. It is also likely that she protested against Chloé being mayor off-screen.
Sabrina Raincomprix

title: Socqueline Wang
text:
Socqueline Wang - Relationships
Just as Socqueline dislikes Chloé, she is also shown to dislike Sabrina very much due to supporting Chloé's evil actions against Marinette. It's possible that she knows that Sabrina was being used by Chloé and doesn't see her as a great rival compared to Chloé. Sabrina overhears Socqueline and Marinette's conversation regarding Marinette's feelings for Kim and tells Chloé this to manipulate Kim into playing a prank on her. Just like Chloé, Socqueline also gives Sabrina a tense look when she breaks Chloé's phone. It's unknown how their relationship is after this.
Lê Chiến Kim
Socqueline is shown to have a dislike for Kim for him to be too much clueless about his annoying behavior, warning Marinette to be careful with him when trying to express her feelings for him. Her concern for Marinette regarding Kim is what drove her to follow her to the pool. After Marinette has her heart broken because of Kim's cruel prank, Socqueline is the one to have Kim go away before going to console Marinette. It's unknown how their relationship is after this, but she likely dislikes him even more for what he did to Marinette.

title: Socqueline Wang
text:
Socqueline Wang - Etymology
Socqueline's name is a portmanteau of the French word socque and the name Jacqueline.
Socque means "clog", referring to a type of shoe made entirely of wood. Clogs are traditionally protective footwear for agricultural workers, and are negatively associated with the cheap footwear of the working class, though are considered fashionable by some cultures.
Jacqueline is the feminine form of Jacques, the French version of the name Jack, which ultimately stems from the Hebrew name Jacob. The name is thought to come from one of several roots that mean "supplanter" (one who replaces), "to follow/to be behind", or from the word for "heel" (which may also refer to her name's "clog" meaning).
In the Brazilian Portuguese dub, her name loses the portmanteau, being just Jacqueline.

title: Socqueline Wang
text:
Socqueline Wang - Trivia
Her character appears to be based on the Ladybug PV version of Marinette, just as Félix Fathom is based on the PV version of Adrien.
Socqueline is one year older than Marinette, having graduated from the Collège Françoise Dupont. Evidence of that is how she wished of failing a grade just to be in Marinette's class with Adrien.
In "Derision", it's revealed she was suspended from school two weeks before the end of the school year and her graduation because of Chloé who she was trying to protect Marinette from.
It's also implied that Socqueline is the reason why Marinette styles her hair with pigtails, as she was her protector against Chloé and hoped to get as much confidence as she has to stand up to the rich girl.
Socqueline is the third character to have their first/last name called "Wang", following Master Fu and Wang Cheng.
Out of these three characters, she is the only female, minor, and one whose last name is Wang instead of their first one.
Socqueline is the first person, who was not involved in their creation, to be seen owning an Alliance ring.

title: Socqueline Wang
text:
Socqueline Wang - Trivia
Socqueline, Mireille Caquet, Diane and Sublime Varlette are the only known students of Collège Françoise Dupont not to have been akumatized in any way.

title: Snapping My Fingers
text:
Snapping My Fingers - Trivia
In "Deflagration", the song was not dubbed into English, and was retained from the original French version.
According to Wilfried Pain it's because the French version is the international version and it should remain in French in all the series' dubs; for example, this also occurs in the European Spanish and European Portuguese dubs of the episode.
However, it is not known why the song has been dubbed in the Brazilian Portuguese and Catalan dubbings of the episode.
Interestingly enough however, the show's dubs did dub the complete version of the song that is sung by Argos in "Emotion", such as the English version and internation dubbings.
Argos's line of "All's not gold, that glitters" could be a reference to his late father Colt Fathom and his uncle as well.

title: Socqueline Wang/History
text:
Socqueline Wang/History - Intro
Socqueline Wang is a student at Lycée Claude Monet and a former schoolmate of Marinette Dupain-Cheng. She sometimes helps out at her family's arts and crafts supply shop.

title: Socqueline Wang/History
text:
Socqueline Wang/History - Before [[Season 1]]
Socqueline lives with her parents in the Helsinki Tower, 13th arrondissement, Les Olympiades, Paris, France. Her parents owned an arts and crafts supply shop at Les Olympiades, which she sometimes helps at.
Socqueline attended Collège Françoise Dupont for four years previously, where she constanly protected her friend Marinette Dupain-Cheng from being bullied by Chloé Bourgeois after making a promise to Sabine Cheng, Marinette's mother.

title: Socqueline Wang/History
text:
Socqueline Wang/History - Before [[Season 1]]
As shown in Marinette's flashbacks in "Derision", when Socqueline was in her last of days of her ninth grade year, she saw Chloé Bourgeois threatening Marinette Dupain-Cheng. Socqueline then steps in to shoo Chloé away from Marinette. She then tells Marinette that she needs to stand up to Chloé on her own, as she won't be around next year to protect her. Marinette remarks the teacher's fear of Chloé and shifts her attention to Lê Chiến Kim. Socqueline's in disbelief that her friend could have a crush on Kim, asking her what she sees in him. Marinette believes she likes him for his kindness. Socqueline thinks she's confusing kindness for foolishness. Marinette decides to invite Kim to go to the swimming pool with her, with Socqueline hoping that she is careful about this decision.
Socqueline and Marinette get on a bus headed for the pool. Socqueline asks Marinette her intentions. Marinette shares her plans: if all goes well and there's a moment that's right, she intends to confess her feelings to Kim. Marinette says goodbye to Socqueline and leaves for the pool. Socqueline stops the bus to be nearby, just in case her friend needs her.

title: Socqueline Wang/History
text:
Socqueline Wang/History - Before [[Season 1]]
Turns out, that Chloé manipulated Kim into doing a prank to Marinette so she could humiliate her on social media by recording the entire thing and posting it on the internet, with Socqueline, who had followed Marinette, seeing everything. Then a livid Socqueline angrily destroys Chloé's phone with the recording on it out of outrage before Chloé can post it online. Kim, not understanding what he did, goes to Marinette, expecting her to find his prank funny, with Socqueline shooing him away being furious about what he and Chloé did and disgusted by their shamelessness, retorting he should be ashamed of himself. Kim dismisses her, believing it was just a joke. Marinette is traumatized from this experience and tells Socqueline about her changed her outlook on love.

title: Socqueline Wang/History
text:
Socqueline Wang/History - Before [[Season 1]]
The next day at school, Chloé tries to get Socqueline suspended from school out of spite for breaking her phone, preventing her from having new fuel for tormenting Marinette. She argues Socqueline attacked her. The principal of their school, Denis Damoclès, tells Chloé due to it happening off school property, he can't do anything. Chloé threatens Mr. Damoclès with her dad, the mayor. Mr. Damoclès suspends Socqueline for the rest of the school year. Socqueline tries to protest, but Chloé has the principal wrapped around her finger. Marinette catches Socqueline before she leaves, remorseful things ended up this way. Socqueline tells her to keep fighting and doing the right thing. With that, she leaves.
Since then, Socqueline has become a tenth grader and now attends Claude Monet High School. Socqueline is has also been the winner of the Grand Prix Gymnastics, three years in a row before the events of "Jubilation".

title: Socqueline Wang/History
text:
Socqueline Wang/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Jubilation", Socqueline cosplaying as Ladybug, sees The Owl about to fall off a build board. Socqueline then saves him, but they're spotted by Marinette (the real Ladybug), whom is able to identify her. But Socqueline denies it, saying she is just a superhero and runs away.
At Les Olympiades, Marinette visits the art shop and both greet each other, and Socqueline asks Marinette about her school life. Marinette replies that everything is fine and continues talking to her. Marinette indirectly asks Socqueline about her Ladybug activities, but she manages to dodge them. When Socqueline asks her the purpose of her visit, Marinette replies she wants some paint. Socqueline enquires about the paint stock with the help of the Alliance ring, and Marinette expresses her amazement at seeing an Alliance ring first time in person.

title: Socqueline Wang/History
text:
Socqueline Wang/History - [[Season 5]]
Socqueline explains every feature of it and gives it to Marinette to try. Socqueline says that it is like a dream to have Adrien Agreste for herself. Marinette replies it's weird since there is hardly any difference between this Adrien and the real Adrien. Socqueline expresses her surprise and asks if Marinette have met Adrien. Marinette replies that she is just his classmate. She proceeds to explain about Adrien, how she helped him to confront his father about modelling and how they become closer. When Socqueline suggests that Adrien and Marinette are together, Marinette denies it by saying they are only friends, just like Socqueline, who only helps her mother, to which Socqueline gets nervous.

title: Socqueline Wang/History
text:
Socqueline Wang/History - [[Season 5]]
At this point, Mr. Damoclès interrupts them while searching for a mask. Marinette tells Socqueline that, like Mr. Damoclès is just a principal. She further says that nobody should try to be a superhero if they haven't any superpowers. Socqueline replies it could be a relief to Ladybug to have help. But Marinette denies it by saying that it is dangerous and that if they put themselves at risk, it would be riskier for Ladybug to save them. Mr. Damoclès thinks Marinette is jealous of superheroes, which angers Marinette, and she exclaims that everyone should be happy with their normal life and not try to be a superhero. This statement subtly offends Mr. Damoclès and seeing her outburst, Socqueline tells her that she will help Mr. Damoclès to find his mask, and they can continue their discussion afterwards.

title: Socqueline Wang/History
text:
Socqueline Wang/History - [[Season 5]]
Socqueline then tries to help Mr. Damoclès to buy a new mask, but he is still upset about what Marinette said. He says what if he is doing more harm than help. Socqueline tries to cheer him up, but Mr. Damoclès says it is all pointless now. As he leaves, she gives a mask to him as a gift for being the principal of Françoise Dupont High School. He leaves the store as Marinette rushes back in and Marinette explains to Socqueline that she forgot to lock her scooter. Socqueline laughs at it and asks her to return the Alliance ring.
As Marinette gives it to her, it suddenly activates and congratulates Marinette on covering a hundred and thirty kilometers in fifteen minutes, to Socqueline's surprise and confusion. She then asks what she did to her ring. Marinette panics and says that she must have screwed up the controls. Socqueline believes it and proceeds to reset the settings. After Socqueline resets her Alliance ring, Marinette tries to leave, but Socqueline stops her and gives her the paint.

title: Socqueline Wang/History
text:
Socqueline Wang/History - [[Season 5]]
Later after Marinette exits, Mr. Damoclès, now the Darker Owl, barges into the art shop and demands the Ladybug Miraculous from Socqueline since he believes her to be the real Ladybug. On seeing him, Socqueline quickly turns on her Alliance ring and records the part where she says that the Megakuma is in his mask. After that, she drops it and pushes it under a shelf. As Darker Owl chases her, she constantly denies that she is not Ladybug. Darker Owl then uses Gift on Socqueline to immobilize her. The Gift shows her an illusion of Ladybug and Cat Noir, who thank her for help. Darker Owl snatches her earring while she's trapped in the illusion. But he sees that the earrings are not the Ladybug Miraculous and realize that she is not the real Ladybug. Regardless, Monarch decides that she is still helpful to them.

title: Socqueline Wang/History
text:
Socqueline Wang/History - [[Season 5]]
Socqueline is then seen tied up in the air upside down as struggled to break free. Ladybug and Cat Noir then arrived and the Darker Owl presses his remote control, which releases Socqueline from her captivity. Due to this, she begins to fall head first to the ground, much to Ladybug's panic. She yells at Cat Noir, and he jumps to save Socqueline. Cat Noir saves Socqueline and tells her to hide, which she does.
Later after the Darker Owl is defeated, Socqueline apologizes to Ladybug for impersonating her. Ladybug forgives her by saying that she should help her without putting herself in danger and tells her that she's amazing and doesn't need superpowers to be it. Both of them then share a hug.
In "Transmission", Socqueline gives Kitty Noire and some fire fighters a lot of paint from the art shop to help defeat Kikou.
In "Perfection", Cat Noir shows up at the art shop and orders a bunch of supplies from Socqueline, to her surprise. Socqueline and Cat Noir then go to Liberty and arrive with the necessary supplies in a pickup truck, with Socqueline waving as she sees all her friends.

title: Soraya Khan
text:
Soraya Khan - Intro
Miss  is a minor character in Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She is the chaperone of Prince Ali, who is responsible for organizing his schedule and keeping him safe from potential danger.

title: Soraya Khan
text:
Soraya Khan - Appearance
Physical appearance
Soraya is tall and light-skinned, with brown hair and brown eyes.
Civilian attire
She wears a light pink draped turban, a light pink dress jacket and dress pants with a diamond pattern, and a white shirt underneath the jacket. She also wears a golden bangle bracelet on each wrist, golden earrings with dangling triangles, and a golden necklace with triangles on the front. The belt around her pants is golden with a golden belt buckle, and she has white high-heel shoes.

title: Soraya Khan
text:
Soraya Khan - Personality
Soraya worries about the prince's safety and his duties, so she is determined to keep him on track. She is extremely dedicated to her job, to the point that even when the prince is being targeted by Princess Fragrance, she is still trying to get him to the hospital for him to be there on time, even though Cat Noir tells her that Prince Ali's safety is the priority and not the hospital.

title: Soraya Khan
text:
Soraya Khan - Abilities
As a chaperone to the prince, Soraya is the person who over sees his busy schedule and sees to it that nothing happens to the heir to the throne of the Kingdom of Achu.

title: Soraya Khan
text:
Soraya Khan - Relationships
Friends/Allies
Prince Ali
Soraya is almost always seen with the prince, making sure that he stays safe and keeps on schedule. She also worries about his safety when they ran out of the hotel window in "Princess Fragrance".

title: Soraya Khan
text:
Soraya Khan - History
In "Princess Fragrance", Soraya was sent by the kingdom of Achu to chaperone Prince Ali on a trip to Paris, where he was hosting a toy fundraiser for the sick children at a hospital. She and his Royal Highness go to Le Grand Paris, where they are greeted by Mayor André Bourgeois. He explains to Prince Ali that he has organized a lavish fireworks display on the Seine in front of the hotel, for his presence here in Paris, that it'll be launched from a boat. Soraya tells him that they'll have to see if it fits with Prince Ali's busy schedule, making his Royal Highness sad.
She continued to watch as André introduce his Royal Highness to his daughter Chloé Bourgeois. Prince Ali then started to get interviewed by Nadja Chamack when soon they were forced to stop thanks to a disgusting smell appearing out of nowhere. Soraya and everyone, turn their backs to Chloé, who was the one carrying the smell. They all then hear a blast.

title: Soraya Khan
text:
Soraya Khan - History
They turn and see the mind-controlled paparazzi bowing down for the titular villain. She then introduces herself and says that Prince Ali will belong to her once she sprays him from her perfume gun. Out of nowhere, a mysterious person activated a button from a synthesizer to launch the confetti to prevent the villain from shooting his Royal Highness. Soraya then takes Prince Ali and they both escaped through the stairwell with André and Chloé.
They all hide inside a hotel room, in which André claims that they'll be safe from her by the reinforced door. Soraya wonders how anyone is supposed to stick a schedule with all this chaos. She and Prince Ali then move away from Chloé because of her smell. To her annoyance, Chloé soon notices that the villain had started spraying her perfume under the doorway. Everyone then back away from the door and to a corner in the room as the perfume got closer.

title: Soraya Khan
text:
Soraya Khan - History
Luckily, the mysterious person from earlier vacuums the spray before it brainwashes anyone. They all then manage to escape to the stairwell again. However, the villain still ends up brainwashing André with her perfume. The three survivors go back to where they were earlier, with Chloé telling Armand to shut the door on the brainwashed André. Despite Soraya trying to get her to have mercy on her father, but Chloé didn't care. The villain suddenly arrives by elevator and was soon confronted by Cat Noir.
After a brief fight between the hero and the villain, Cat Noir tried to evacuate everyone by sliding down his staff outside the hotel. Soraya objects to this as it is too dangerous for Prince Ali. But he then gives the three civilians mixing bowls to protect their heads. After everyone evacuated, they got inside Soraya's car and drove away. After opening the windows to get rid of the smell from Chloé, Soraya tried to keep up his Royal Highness' very strict schedule and attempts to drive them to the hospital, with Cat Noir arguing with the idea. The villain then arrives on top of the car roof and, before Soraya can close all the windows, she sprays everyone in the car.

title: Soraya Khan
text:
Soraya Khan - History
Now a brainwashed Soraya then goes to the Pont des Arts with the villain and her other victims. Her enthraller tries to put a padlock of her and Prince Ali's love on the bridge, but it was knocked into the water by Ladybug with her yo-yo. Soraya and her other victims tried to attack the heroine and take the Ladybug Miraculous from her after the perfume spray failed.
A fight then breaks out, with Soraya being knocked down to the floor with André by Ladybug, who uses her yo-yo to do so. Later, after the villain was defeated and Ladybug does her Miraculous Ladybug, Soraya was freed from being brainwashed. She was still at the Pont des Arts when this happened and started complaining about how everything was now a disaster since they were so off schedule. Soraya then wondered where his Royal Highness was before wondering where she was.

title: Soraya Khan
text:
Soraya Khan - History
In "Style Queen" and "Queen Wasp", Soraya chaperones Prince Ali to the fashion show of Gabriel Agreste. There she is seen sitting on the front row, next to Prince Ali and Aurore Beauréal. She is later seen when the fashion show was interrupted by the first titular villain and in a recording of that on the news. She was also present when Gabriel arrives and hugs his son, Adrien Agreste.
In "Heart Hunter", Soraya chaperones Prince Ali to Mayor André and Audrey Bourgeois' 20th wedding anniversary inside Le Grand Paris. There she witnesses the couple be akumatized into the titular villains.
In "Emotion", Soraya chaperones Prince Ali to the Diamonds' Dance. They are both first seen walking the red carpet outside of the Grand Palais, where the Diamonds' Dance is being held. When Soraya gets to the entrance, she puts up her mask to let the guards scan it to get in. Given that she made it in, Soraya presumably witnessed Félix Fathom transforming into Argos, being one of the few people who know his secret identity.

title: Soraya Khan
text:
Soraya Khan - Trivia
According to Thomas Astruc, her turban is the closest he could get to showing a hijab.
As a guest at the Diamonds' Dance in "Emotion", she is one of the people who know the secret identity of Argos.

title: Sorbonne
text:
Sorbonne - Intro
The  is a building in the Latin Quarter of Paris located in the 5th arrondissement. It previously housed the University of Paris and now serves as the seat of the rectorate of the Paris Academy while hosting part of the activities of various Parisian universities.

title: Sorbonne
text:
Sorbonne - Description
On the Place de la Sorbonne side, the Sorbonne stands out for its elegant proportions and the dome of the Sorbonne Chapel. Following the Baroque line, this chapel has a façade with two orders of superimposed columns delimited on the floor by two volutes. It is decorated with four niches, each with a statue: St Thomas Aquinas, Pierre Lombard, Jacques-Bénigne Bossuet and Jean Gerson. In the center of the façade, two muses hold up a clock surmounted by the coat of arms of Cardinal Richelieu.
Further north, in Rue de la Sorbonne, there is a Haussmann-style wing which houses, among other things, the Sorbonne Library.

title: Sorbonne
text:
Sorbonne - Trivia

Master Fu presents himself to Adrien for the first time on dome of the Sorbonne Chapel.
Not visible in the series, the Sorbonne has a forty meter tower on its east wing which houses the Sorbonne Observatory.
In "Syren", when Kim and later Alya and Marinette rush to the cinema, the statue of Auguste Comte is visible in the background.

title: Sophie/History
text:
Sophie/History - Intro
Sophie (called Sarah in "Gabriel Agreste") is a maid and waitress at Le Grand Paris and the restaurant on the Eiffel Tower.

title: Sophie/History
text:
Sophie/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Pixelator", while Caline Bustier is speaking, Sophie teaches Sabrina Raincomprix how to make a bed as the latter's class is having a work experience field trip at Le Grand Paris. After finishing the bed, everyone notices Ivan Bruel and Alix Kubdel having a pillow fight. Miss Bustier then tells them that they would be graded on their efforts, which would determine if they pass or fail. As the two students start to pick up after themselves, Sophie and Sabrina giggle.
In "Timebreaker", Sophie is seen waiting tables in the restaurant inside Le Grand Paris.
In "Guitar Villain", Sophie is seen existing an elevator as Marinette Dupain-Cheng enters at Le Grand Paris.
In "Kung Food", Sophie is seen standing outside of Le Grand Paris with Armand as Alec Cataldi is talking to the camera. She is later seen in the lobby when a cameraman is running to get out of the building, before the titular villain pours indestructible caramel over the entire building, trapping everyone inside.

title: Sophie/History
text:
Sophie/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Despair Bear", Sophie is seen serving drinks to Max Kanté and Lê Chiến Kim at Le Grand Paris for Chloé Bourgeois' party.
In "Robostus", Sophie was in the kitchen of the restaurant inside Le Grand Paris when the titular villain brings numerous mechanical devices in there to life and they start to revolt against humans, causing Sophie to run away in despair.
In "Queen Wasp", Sophie was one of the many people who were paralyzed in the Le Grand Paris' lobby by the titular villain's army of paralytic wasps.
In "Malediktator", Sophie and Armand pack Chloé and Audrey Bourgeois' bags when they decide to move to New York and leave Mayor André Bourgeois behind in Paris. Soon, up on the roof of Le Grand Paris, Sophie, Armand, and the building's doorman wave as Chloé and Audrey leave for the airport on a helicopter. They all then leave as André falls to his knees.
In "Santa Claws", on Christmas Eve, Sophie and Armand serve Chloé and André their Christmas dinner in the restaurant inside Le Grand Paris. Later on, Sophie watches as Chloé is about to open up her many present. However, soon the titular villain arrives and she falls down to floor thanks to the impact.

title: Sophie/History
text:
Sophie/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Chameleon", while working as a waitress at the Eiffel Tower, where a selection of seafood is being served, Sophie jumps down for cover as the titular villain, in the body of Cat Noir, is tricked by Ladybug into using Cataclysm on the ground below them, which caused them to fall. Sophie then watched from a corner as Ladybug grabbed an oyster and puts it in front of Chameleon's mouth, causing her to take on its form and the real Cat Noir to show up.
Soon, Ladybug gives Sophie the villain and her Lucky Charm, which was the T-shirt, and she opens the oyster with the oyster shucker, revealing a black pearl inside it. Sophie then watched as Ladybug broke the pearl, purified the akuma, and returned everything to normal with her Miraculous Ladybug. She also witnessed the villain transforming back into Lila Rossi.
In "Heart Hunter", Sophie is seen preparing the tables for André and Audrey's 20th wedding anniversary on the rooftop of Le Grand Paris.

title: Sophie/History
text:
Sophie/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Gabriel Agreste", outside of the Agreste mansion, Sophie is angrily waiting for Armand to arrive. Soon, another waiter comes along, introducing themselves as Marino, saying that Armand was sick and that he was taking over for him. Sophie then introduced herself and explained that they have to be "invisible" and the only contact that need to make with Gabriel Agreste is to take their fingerprints at the entrance.
Sophie tells him that their only here for food prep in the kitchen and overseeing the children. She hands a small box to Marino and she takes a heavy box. However, Marino puts the small box down and takes the heavy box from Sophie, saying "I've got the muscles." Sophie then enters the mansion and gets her fingers scanned.

title: Sophie/History
text:
Sophie/History - [[Season 4]]
Soon, Sophie comes out of the kitchen to find Marino watching the children. Despite Marino saying that he can take care of watching the children because he's always been good with kids, Sophie angrily tells him to stay in the kitchen. They both then go into the kitchen, only for Marino to quickly make a mess. Sophie tells him the he can be in charge of the children instead. After awhile, Marino comes back to the kitchen and puts a cardboard box on his head, to Sophie's confusion.
Later, after Collector arrives and causes a commotion, Sophie comes out of the kitchen, holding a broom to defend herself, with Placide I.T. She then teams up with him and Kagami Tsurugi to attack the villain. A fight between them and Collector then breaks out, with the villain ending up capturing them all on his tablet. After Collector is eventually defeated, Sophie and the others are freed by Ladybug's Miraculous Ladybug.
In "Optigami", Sophie and Armand are seen serving food to the guest at Tour Montparnasse for the Fashion Icon Award from Style Queen.

title: Sophie/History
text:
Sophie/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Adoration", Zoé Lee says hello to Sophie when she enters Le Grand Paris with Marinette. Sophie was a adjusting a plant on a table in the lobby. When she sees Zoé, she also says hello to her and asks her how she's doing.

title: Sleeping Syren/Transcript
text:
Sleeping Syren/Transcript - Intro
Vadim: That's a new record, buddy. Well done.
Cường: Let me check your blood pressure before you go, little fish. Hello, little mermaid.
Ondine: Hello, Minh Cường. Hello, Vadim.

(Kim's dads leave. Kim then starts sniffing the air, smelling banana from Ondine's lip balm.)

Ondine: It's my flavored lip balm. I picked it because I know how much you love bananas. (Kim leans into her. Ondine thinks he's going to kiss her and starts leaning in too, but Kim pretends to twist her nose instead and starts running off.)Kim: I've got your nose! If you want it back, you'll have to catch me first!
Ondine: You better run fast! (Ondine starts chasing Kim into the school as they're both laughing. Meanwhile, on a nearby bench, Ray, Nelson and Loïc are watching them.)''
Nelson: Hm. How about those two?
Loïc: Yeah, totally.
Ray: Let's do this.
[ Theme Song ]
Marinette: Don't tell me you're chatting with Nino again. You're seeing each other in less than an hour.
Alya: I know, but he told me what he had for breakfast and now he's saying that he's about to brush his teeth and go to the bathroom before he takes off.

title: Sleeping Syren/Transcript
text:
Sleeping Syren/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Whoa, you two really tell each other everything.
Alya: Of course. Nino's my boyfriend and my best friend. We keep zero secrets from each other.
(Marinette starts looking around, startled.)
Alya: I mean, almost zero secrets. You got to keep a little mystery, right?
Marinette: (sigh of relief) Girls, do you tell your boyfriends or girlfriends everything, too?
Mylène: I tell Ivan everything, though he's a little more reserved. Like, I don't know a lot about his family, but it'll come. I know my teddy bear.
Marinette: What about you girls?
Juleka: I... I feel like we just really understand each other.
Rose: Me too.
Kagami: You're lucky. My boyfriend's on the other side of the sea, which makes communication challenging.
Rose: How do you do it then?
Kagami: Uh...
(An illustration of Argos and Ryuko using the space power-up to kiss in the sky appears.)
Kagami: ...video calls. (turns to Ondine) What about you and Kim, how are things?
Ondine: Well, we, um...laugh a lot.
Marinette: Awesome! It's so nice-
Ondine: Actually, I'm kind of worried about something. Truth is, we still haven't...kissed.
All of the girls: For real!?

title: Sleeping Syren/Transcript
text:
Sleeping Syren/Transcript - Intro
Ondine: And it's not just about kissing. He's never held my hand or told me that he loved me. Sometimes I wonder if we're even together.
Marinette: You know, some couples struggle with that kind of stuff. Things were like that for a while between me and Adrien.
Diane: Does Kim know that you want to kiss? Maybe you need to ask him.
Ondine: That's not romantic at all! In fairy tales, the princess doesn't have to tell the prince that she wants him to kiss her.
Alya: But fairy tales are just stories. Don't freak out too much about it. If he's the right dude, it'll happen when the time is right.
(Ondine looks down sadly.)
Marinette: You're right, Alya. Things happen when the time is right. And if it doesn't, then your BFFs can get involved! It's simple, we'll help Ondine create the perfect moment for the first kiss. In my case, for example, Adrien was about to leave for London forever. So, I grabbed my scooter and rushed to the airport where I stopped him just before take-off. Right then and there, we kissed for the first time. You could do the same thing!
Ondine: It won't work for me anyway. I'm not planning on leaving.
Kagami: And we don't have a plane.

title: Sleeping Syren/Transcript
text:
Sleeping Syren/Transcript - Intro
Rose: And I don't think Kim owns a scooter.
Marinette: Fine, it might not be the best of plans. Has one of you had a more... simple first kiss?
Mylène: Ivan wrote a poem for me. It was super romantic.
Marinette: Perfect! That's a great idea; you could write him a poem! What do you think Ondine?
Ondine: It's a great idea! Thanks for your help, girls.
(Unbeknownst to all the girls, Loïc is sitting at the table behind them and recording their conversation through an old fashion cell phone.)Ondine: (through the recording.) Thanks for your help, girls.
Ray: So, who's going to break them up first?
All three boys: Rock, paper...
Nelson and Loïc: Scissors!
Ray: (brings his hand down after them.) Rock. (flips his hand) Ha! I go first.
Female student: I really loved your solo. You must have worked so hard on it.
(Ray sits down next to Kim and opens a box containing swimming flippers.)
Kim: Woah! Those are so cool!
Ray: You can have them if you want.
Kim: For real?! Awesome! Thanks. (tries to take the flippers, but Ray moves them away from him)
Ray: But in exchange you have to stop talking to girls.
Kim: Really? Why?
Ray: You don't need to know.
Kim: Oh, okay. That's too funny.

title: Sleeping Syren/Transcript
text:
Sleeping Syren/Transcript - Intro
''(Ray smirks while he watches Kim.)
Ondine: Your new shoes are, um...very unique!
Kim: Yeah! (Quickly covers his mouth.)
(Ondine looks confused for a second, but Kim giggles and she shrugs and takes his hand leading him outside.)
Ondine: I want to read you something.
Ondine: (takes a breath.) Once upon a time, a Sleeping Syren dreamt of meeting her true love, a kind and gentle boy, not a tyrant, who would love her beyond and above. The Syren feared she'd never meet him, for she thought she wasn't pretty enough.
(The girls are watching the scene hiding behind a bush.)
Ondine: She was tall, too tall, with broad limbs and spots on her face that made it look rough.
(Kim covers his mouth, trying to hold from laughing.)
Marinette: He's making a strange face, don't you think? I guess it must be all the emotions.
Ondine: Even in the worst of times, they would have fun. The Syren had found her merman. What a bliss.
(The trio of bullies are also shown watching the scene from a bush.)
Ray: This is going to work, I'm sure of it.
Ondine: And when her prince finally graces her with a kiss, she will be the happiest princess in the ocean.

title: Sleeping Syren/Transcript
text:
Sleeping Syren/Transcript - Intro
Kim: (Bursts out laughing.) Hahaha! That's such a funny story!
Marinette: Wait, is he making fun of her? That's so rude!
(Ray also laughs.)
Ondine: It's not a story, it's a poem! And it's meant to be romantic, not funny.
Kim: It's hilarious, though. There are even words that sound the same, and- (quickly covers his mouth.) Oh no, dang! I just lost my flippers. Oh man... (walks away in dismay)
(While Ondine stays on the bench sobbing, Kim takes his flippers off and goes to give them back to Ray.)
Kim: I lost the challenge. But it's impossible not to talk to Ondine, she's really funny!
(After Kim returns to the flippers to Ray, Ray and his friends watch him go.)
Ray: (frowns) If I can't do this, you two don't stand a chance.
Loïc: (scoffs) We'll see about that...
(All of the girls are comforting Ondine. Mylène is sitting with Ondine.)
Ondine: Did you see him laughing?
Mylène: That wasn't very nice.
Rose: Especially considering how beautiful your poem was.
Ondine: The truth is that he doesn't love me, plain and simple. That's why he won't kiss me!
Marinette: That's not true. We just have to find the right scenario for you and Kim. We'll try something else.

title: Sleeping Syren/Transcript
text:
Sleeping Syren/Transcript - Intro
Kagami: In Japan, we use biscuit sticks. It's the sweetheart's cookie. You're supposed to share it. (Visuals of chibi versions of her and Félix illustrate her words.) You bite opposite ends of the same stick and nibble until your lips touch.
Marinette: Okay, let's give it a try!
Kim: Hi Loïc!
Loïc: Your girlfriend.
Kim: Ondine?
Loïc: Right. Don't touch her anymore. Don't talk to her anymore. Don't even look at her anymore.
Kim: Huh? Why?
Loïc: Because I'm telling you and when I tell you to do something you just do it!
Kim: Okay, but then what do I do when I'm with her?
Loïc: You're no longer with her.
Kim: Yes, I am.
Loïc: No, you're not.
Kim: Yes, I am.
Loïc: No, you're not.
Kim: Yes, I am.
Loïc: (angry) I'm telling you you're not!!
Kim: And I'm telling you I am.
Loïc: (defeated) He's just too good...
Nelson: It's your plan that was bad.
Kim: Delicious! Another one? And another?
Kim: Ondine? What are you doing here?
(Some of the girls are hiding and watching the scene, including Marinette who plays a piano tune from her phone that comes out of speakers in the classroom. Kim sits down at the table across from Ondine.)
Kim: Oh, did you find some too? They're so yummy.

title: Sleeping Syren/Transcript
text:
Sleeping Syren/Transcript - Intro
(Ondine puts the biscuit stick in her mouth and leans in. Kim looks confused for a second but then leans in too and bites the biscuit stick out of her mouth, eating it.)
Ondine: What are you doing?
Kim: You didn't look like you were going to finish it, so I ate it.
Ondine: You never get anything right! Why won't you kiss me?
Kim: (gulps) But... what for?
Ondine: I love you Kim, but sometimes I can't help but wonder why!
(Ondine storms out of the room, with the rest of the girls and Kim looking sad. Nelson is watching the scene from the window.)
Nelson: You're so right, you know?
Kim: What do you mean I'm right?
Nelson: Not to kiss her. It's disgusting. Did you know that kissing increases your heart rate and that the exchange of saliva can transfer hundreds of different bacteria strains?
Kim: Really?
Nelson: But the real problem is when the girl is a swimmer, then it becomes seriously dangerous. You can turn into a toad.
Kim: Huh? No way. That only happens in fairy tales.
Nelson: In every fairy tale there's an element of truth, you know. Take her for example.
Kim: Ondine?

title: Sleeping Syren/Transcript
text:
Sleeping Syren/Transcript - Intro
Nelson: All of her swimming causes the presence of specific bacteria in her mouth, and if you kiss her and catch her bacteria, warts will grow on your back like with toads. And on top of that, if the girl is taller than you, then you must never kiss her. Both your lives would be at stake. It would cause an anaphylactic shock!
Kim: What?
Nelson: Swelling, choking, boom! On the floor. Both of you.
Kim: That sounds horrible.
Nelson: (walks away) Absolute horror indeed.
(Ondine is crying on the bench, still with all the girls around her.)
Ondine: I give up. He's not into it. I'm not going to force him.
Diane: You're right, it's probably best to throw in the towel.
Mylène: Maybe he's not worthy of your feelings.
Marinette: (stands up) No towels will be thrown in! We just haven't figured out the right approach to make him understand yet. But I'm sure we can rise to the challenge!
Ondine: Huh? Of course, a challenge! (hugs Marinette.) Great idea, Marinette! Thank you!
(Ondine drops Marinette and runs away. Marinette slowly gets up with her messy hair.)
Marinette: (confused) Uh... what was my idea exactly?
Ondine: Come on, arm wrestling! Loser has to do a dare.
Kim: What... now?

title: Sleeping Syren/Transcript
text:
Sleeping Syren/Transcript - Intro
Ondine: So, you're not up for it?
Kim: Of course I'm for it.
(Ondine quickly overpowers Kim, winning the arm-wrestling match and breaking the table.)
Ondine: Now for the dare, you must give me a kiss.
(Ondine takes the lip balm out of her bag and applies it while some of the girls are watching through the doorway.)
Kim: Couldn't we just do... best of three?
Ondine: Huh? Don't you love me? Is this why you won't kiss me? You can tell me, you know.
Kim: No, it's just because that it's disgusting because of all the swimming bacteria. I'm sorry, but I don't want to turn into a toad.
Ondine: What are you talking about?!
Kim: Your bacteria causes warts.
Ondine: If that's a joke because you don't feel ready it's really not funny.
Kim: Of course it's not funny, it's horrible!
Ondine: I'm warning you. If you don't stop this nonsense right now and kiss me...
Kim: I can't. Besides, you're taller than me. I really can't kiss you it's a matter of life or death!
Ondine: You're despicable! (runs away crying)
Marinette: Those are horrible things to say to her!
Alya: Yeah, I don't know what's gotten into him.
(An Ultrakuma flies in and enters her lip balm.)

title: Sleeping Syren/Transcript
text:
Sleeping Syren/Transcript - Intro
Chrysalis: Hello, forgive my intrusion but I heard your heart breaking so loudly that I thought you might need a good fairy to help you finally live out your miraculous fairy tale. This would require you finding the right prince charming, but all the toads in the kingdom are likely to come knocking on your heart's door. So, would you like me to make sure that only the most valiant prince is worthy of your first kiss?
Ondine: Yes, I would.
Chrysalis: Very well, and what should I call you?
Ondine: Sleeping Syren.
(Chrysalis closes her palm.)
(Marinette and Alya are walking towards the bathroom.)
Marinette: I'll go get Ondine.
(Marinette is about to open the door but sees the water coming out from the bottom. She quickly takes Alya's arm, and they both run away as water continues to flood through the school. Everyone notices the flood and starts running.)
Marinette: Can you go with them? I'll see what's happening.
Alya: Don't panic, friends! Let's get to the roof, this way!
(The students run up to the roof while the water continues to flood through all of Paris.)
Tikki: Do you think Ondine got akumatized?

title: Sleeping Syren/Transcript
text:
Sleeping Syren/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: It's possible. She looked so sad because of Kim... I made a mistake entrusting the Miraculous of the Monkey to someone like him. I'll be taking it back. But first, Tikki, spots on! (transforms into Ladybug and runs out of the room.)
(Sleeping Syren sits down and applies her lip balm to her lips turning them golden. She then falls asleep.)
Voice: The Sleeping Syren has had her heart broken. She fell asleep from sorrow. Who will dare to dive into the ocean of her tears and wake her up with a kiss? Kim: Ladybug, Cat Noir, watch out! It's a trap!
(As they don't hear him and leave, Kim looks into the water and sees a trash bin and road sign floating in the water. He jumps into the garbage. Max notices Kim doing so)
Max: Kim! What are you doing?
Kim: I have to go warn them not to kiss Ondine!
(Water guards start coming out of the water.)
Water Guard: Aye, show courage! For the happiness of the Syren!
Paris Citizen: I- I left my flippers at home!
Water Guard: Those who refuse to go will be turned into toads!

title: Sleeping Syren/Transcript
text:
Sleeping Syren/Transcript - Intro
(The water guards start touching the citizens with their tridents, turning them into toads. Meanwhile, Kim is using the road sign to travel through the water in the trash bin.)
Xuppu: Why don't you just transform into King Monkey and go help Ladybug and Cat Noir?
Kim: When someone's been akumatized I've got to wait for Ladybug to call me.
(Ladybug and Cat Noir are on a random rooftop. Ladybug has opened the Miraculous Call system and is staring at the monkey symbol.)
Cat Noir: You're not sure which swimsuit to wear, m'lady?
Ladybug: No, I'm good, I've made my choice. (swipes the monkey symbol away and calls all of the Miraculers present) We're going to need reinforcements.
(While Kim is still paddling through the water with the road sign, he sees the rest of the Miraculers running on the rooftops to join Ladybug and Cat Noir.)
Ladybug: While you get people to safety, Cat Noir and I will take care of the akumatized villain. Ryuko, you're coming with us. We're going to need your water power.
Miss Hound: Minotaurox is missing. Do you think he's been turned into a toad?
Ladybug: Don't worry, if he has, we'll see him again once we've deakumatized the Syren.

title: Sleeping Syren/Transcript
text:
Sleeping Syren/Transcript - Intro
Carapace: What about King Monkey?
Ladybug: We don't need him. Let's go!
Pegasus: Voyage! (goes through his portal.)
(All of the summoned heroes, except Ryuko, all leave.)
[Superpower Sequence]Ryuko: Water Dragon! (transforms into a water version of herself)
[Transformation sequence]Ladybug: (eats a green magicaroon) Power Up! (transforms into Aquabug)
[Transformation sequence]Cat Noir: (eats a green magic cheese) Power Up! (transforms into Aquanoir)
(Aquabug, Aquanoir, and Ryuko all jump into the water while Kim is still paddling through.)
Kim: Why did Ladybug call on everyone but me? Never mind, I have to warn them about the dangerous kiss, Xuppu, to protect them and to protect Ondine! (He closes the lid of the trash bin then comes out wearing his swimsuit and snorkel, jumping into the water.)
(The Water guards continue threatening the civilians of Paris who are taken to safety through Pegasus' portals.)Carapace: Shell-ter!

title: Sleeping Syren/Transcript
text:
Sleeping Syren/Transcript - Intro
(Carapace creates a protective force field around the Eiffel Tower, meanwhile Caprikid and Pigella are passing towels out.)(Vesperia throws her Spinning Top which gets rid of some water guards. Rena Rouge, Purple Tigress, Rooster Bold, Miss Hound, and Polymouse also use their powers to fight the guards and save civilians.)Water Guard: Halt! Only a knight who can defeat us will be worthy of waking the Syren.
Aquabug: You're up, Ryuko.
(Ryuko fights the water guard with her Sword. Before Aquabug and Aquanoir can get inside the building, they're distracted by Kim swimming down and being chased by another water guard, making a lot of muffled noises. This also distracts Ryuko who gets hit with the guard's trident and turning into a toad.)
Aquanoir: Looks like our plan just sunk! (starts fighting the guards.)
Aquabug: I'll deal with this, just give me a minute.
Aquanoir: Come on, go with the flow!
(Aquabug finds the Dragon Miraculous near the newly transformed toad and puts it on.)
[Transformation sequence.]Aquabug: Tikki, Longg, unify! (transforms into AquaDragonbug)

title: Sleeping Syren/Transcript
text:
Sleeping Syren/Transcript - Intro
(AquaDragonbug immediately turns into a stream of water and pushes Kim to safety on a rooftop. She then reverts back to Dragonbug.)
Dragonbug: Are you out of your mind putting yourself in danger like that?!
Kim: Ondine's the one in danger.
Dragonbug: What?
Kim: If she gets kissed it'll cause an anaphylactic shock, and everyone will get sick!
Dragonbug: What on earth are you talking about?
Kim: It's science. Because Ondine is too tall and she's a swimmer you can't kiss her. Nelson explained it to me, and since you didn't call me, I couldn't tell you. That's why I had to dive in.
Dragonbug: (unamused sigh) You need to stop being so gullible, Kim.
Kim: Gullible?
Dragonbug: Yes. Gullible, naive, someone who believes everything he's told without thinking for a second!
Kim: Hold on, that's not true? But then...that means I said horrible things to Ondine! She'll never love me again!
Dragonbug: She will if you explain everything and apologize and tell her how you feel about her.
Kim: Okay!
Dragonbug: Huh. Maybe your power can help us. You can transform.
[Transformation sequence]Kim: Xuppu, showtime! (transforms into King Monkey)

title: Sleeping Syren/Transcript
text:
Sleeping Syren/Transcript - Intro
King Monkey: Uproar! (laughs and gets a tea bag that he throws into the flood, turning all the water into soap bubbles.)
Dragonbug: Perfect.
[Superpower sequence]Dragonbug: Wind Dragon! (transforms into a gust of wind and clears out all the bubbles.)(Dragonbug uses her Yo-yo to zip a guard away, letting Cat Noir know that she and King Monkey are behind him.)
King Monkey: Uproar! (Throws a stapler at a water guard which transforms it into a giant mug with a monkey on it.)
Cat Noir: Cataclysm! (Busts open the door which lets him, Dragonbug, and King Monkey run into the building.)
(King Monkey starts to run towards Sleeping Syren but trips and falls from a loud footstep.)
Water Dragon: Only a knight who can defeat me will be worthy of waking the Syren.
Cat Noir: Hey, am I the only one getting tired of these watered-down fairy tales?
(The Water Dragon starts shooting big streams of water at the heroes.)
Dragonbug: Don't worry kitty cat, King Monkey will liven things up!
King Monkey: Uproar! (Gets a trumpet that he throws at another stream of water coming towards him, turning the stream into confetti that piles around him. However, the Dragon still manages to smack him into a wall.)

title: Sleeping Syren/Transcript
text:
Sleeping Syren/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: We're going to need your magic wand, m'lady!
Dragonbug: Lucky Charm! (gets a bag of cement.) Perfect, cement!
Cat Noir: Are you planning on building a wall, bugaboo?
Dragonbug: You know what happens when you mix cement with water? Lend me a paw, kitty cat!
(She throws the cement bag above the dragon, letting Cat Noir use his power to destroy the bag open and let the cement out.)
Dragonbug: Wind Dragon! (She transforms into a gust of wind and flies all around the dragon, the mix of cement and water transforming it into stone.) Now we just need to deakumatize the Syren.
Cat Noir: Is someone supposed to kiss her like in fairy tales?
Dragonbug: You don't kiss someone without their permission. We'll just break the akumatized item.
King Monkey: If we can find it. (he starts sniffing the air.) Do I smell banana? (he continues to sniff around Sleeping Syren until he finds the bottle of lip balm on her chest, giving it to Dragonbug.)
Dragonbug: Well spotted, King Monkey. (breaks the bottle.) No akuma.
(Cat Noir gasps and King Monkey continues sniffing around, stopping at Sleeping Syren's lips.)

title: Sleeping Syren/Transcript
text:
Sleeping Syren/Transcript - Intro
King Monkey: Uproar. (gets a pencil and uses the eraser on Sleeping Syren's lips, transforming the lip balm into a snorkel.)
Cat Noir: Cataclysm.
(With the snorkel destroyed, the ultrakuma is set free and Sleeping Syren transforms back into Ondine.)
Dragonbug: No more evil doing for you, ultrakuma! (She opens up her yoyo.) Time to de-evilize! (She catches the ultrakuma.) Gotcha! Bye bye, little butterfly! (She releases the butterfly.) Miraculous Dragonbug!
(The magic ladybugs turn all the toads back into humans and reverts the damage caused by the villain.)
Ondine: What happened?
Dragonbug: While you were akumatized, a boy named Kim took huge risks to come and save you.
Ondine: Really?
(King Monkey smiles.)
Dragonbug: (Pulls a magical charm out of her yo-yo.) This magical charm will help you remember that, when in doubt, it's best to try talking it out before taking action. The Miraculers: Pound it! Cerise: I refuse to admit defeat. I'll get it right next time. Diane: Maybe I should carry a swimsuit everywhere I go from now on. You never know the weather.

title: Sleeping Syren/Transcript
text:
Sleeping Syren/Transcript - Intro
Kim: (Walks up to Ondine.) I'm sorry I hurt your feelings, Ondine. I shouldn't have believed Nelson without checking the facts. I apologize.
Ondine: I'm sorry I made such a fuss about a kiss. I guess I just wanted to feel like you really care about me.
Kim: I care about you a lot.
Ondine: Forget about fairy tales, if you don't want to kiss me now, you can take all the time you need.
Kim: Okay... but how long?
Ondine: A minute, a month, a year, however you want. Or never. As long as we love one another.
Kim: Hmm... okay then. One... two... three! (he leans in and gives her a peck.) Hey, that was kind of nice! (kisses her cheek.)
(Kim and Ondine start kissing a lot, making the rest of the girls feel slightly awkward and disgusted as they leave the cafeteria. Marinette and Adrien head out to the balcony.)
Marinette: I learned a new game today.
Adrien: You did? What is it?
(Marinette takes a box of biscuit sticks out of her purse, making Adrien gasp.)
Marinette: Want one?
Adrien: Yes, thank you.

title: Sleeping Syren/Transcript

It's a wintery day in Paris and Ladybug enjoys it by finishing a snowman. Until she gets hit by an incoming snowball turning around to see a laughing Cat Noir. So she decides to join in the fun and throw a ball back but amping up the pressure he kicked a tree getting more snowballs until one of them hits her snowman. As the fight gets bigger the two hit each other with more and bigger balls leaving her snowman further wrecked. Furious and ready to end this, Ladybug huffs off while Cat Noir was getting ready to throw more snowballs, he sees Ladybug prepare a giant snowball terrified Cat Noir tried to outrun it. Reaching the bottom of the hill, he catapulted it into the air with his staff up into the sky. But seeing it come back down and land on her snowman she tried save it to no avail. After coming out of the snow pile, Ladybug was devastated that her snowman was completely destroyed. Then, rejoined by her remorseful partner they rebuild another snowman and once done they leave the park until they both get hit by snowballs terrified thinking it came from the snowman.

title: Sparrow (Actionverse)
text:
Sparrow (Actionverse) - Intro
Sparrow is a superhero in the United States of America and a member of the American superhero team with his partner Knightowl.

title: Sparrow (Actionverse)
text:
Sparrow (Actionverse) - Appearance
Physical appearance
Sparrow is at medium height.
As Sparrow
Sparrow has a dark gray mask covering his face, with the top of the mask being dark brown. Over his mask, he wears goggles with gray straps and circular red lenses. He also wears a brown hooded jacket. The hood is worn over his head, and it's designed after the head of a sparrow, having a dark gray beak, white markings on its forehead and the sides, and an eye with a dark brown pupil. Underneath his jacket, he has a white suit, and over it, he has dark gray buckles around his torso. On his upper left leg, there is a dark brown bag with pockets, and he wears gray gloves.

title: Sparrow (Actionverse)
text:
Sparrow (Actionverse) - Personality
Sparrow is witty and supportive. Some instances make him exasperated when others are confused, but he supplies any information they need.

title: Sparrow (Actionverse)
text:
Sparrow (Actionverse) - Abilities
Sparrow is physically fit, having enough stamina and skill to keep up with Ladybug and Cat Noir while they're running and to jump from edge to edge down a huge crack in in the ground.

title: Sparrow (Actionverse)
text:
Sparrow (Actionverse) - History
Miraculous Adventures
In the end of "Silurus", Sparrow and Knightowl meet Cat Noir on the roof of a building in New York after Doorman uses his powers to open a passage between the New York and Paris. Cat Noir walks to the edge of the roof and joins the other heroes as they admire the view of the city destroyed by the villain names as the Trash Krakken. However, Ladybug and Cat Noir running off to detransform, thus surprising their new allies before parting ways over the rooftops.

title: Sparrow (Actionverse)
text:
Sparrow (Actionverse) - History
Later in "The Big Leagues", Ladybug and Cat Noir return to Majestia, Knightowl, Sparrow, Uncanny Valley, and Doorman fifteen minutes after they originally left. After Camilla Hombee arrives by helicopter and reveals herself to be Victory, Sparrow explains to the Parisian superheroes that the President revealed her identity to boost her chances in the election. When Knightowl starts mocking Cat Noir, saying he's only important in puns, Sparrow tries to cheer him up, understanding how he feels. Soon, Knightowl and Sparrow are running after the heroes across the rooftops. Knightowl tries to stop Ladybug's plan, thinking it's reckless, and then they jump into the crevice and come face to face with the villain.

title: Sparrow (Actionverse)
text:
Sparrow (Actionverse) - History
In "Battle for New York", Sparrow joins Ladybug's rebellion, not wanting New York to be destroyed. The young superheroes ask Knightowl to help them carry out their plan, and he finally agrees. Together, they attack the Trash Krakken, trying to pull the plush octopus out of its body. When Ladybug falls, Sparrow tries to block a tentacle flying toward her with his fist. The hero gets sucked into the tentacle, and its sticky texture prevents him from escaping. Cat Noir uses his Cataclysm on the Trash Krakken, freeing Sparrow and the other heroes from captivity. After de-evilize the black substance with Mr. Squad using Ladybug's yo-yo, Knightowl slings the unconscious Sparrow over his shoulder. After defeating the Trash Krakken, the American heroes, still on the same rooftop, thanked Ladybug and Cat Noir for their help, did the "Pound It", and said goodbye to them.

title: Sparrow (Actionverse)
text:
Sparrow (Actionverse) - Relationships
Friends/Allies
Knightowl
Sparrow and Knightowl are partners, but Sparrow is seen as a sidekick by Knightowl, which he doesn't appreciate much. It is unknown if he is aware of Knightowl's true identity.
Acquaintances
Ladybug and Cat Noir
Sparrow gets along okay with Ladybug and Cat Noir, liking their ideas and teasing them. In one case, he facepalms at them when they are confused by President Camilla Hombee revealing her secret identity. He relates to an unknown degree to their frustration with the way others see them as well. When Knightowl insults Cat Noir, Sparrow tries to cheer him up by pointing he is viewed the same way by Knightowl, but unlike Cat Noir, he "doesn't have a cute partner". Later, when Knightowl dismisses Ladybug's plan to stop the Trash Krakken, Sparrow sticks up for her and points out that her plan is far less destructive and more sensible than Knightowl's.

title: Sparrow (Actionverse)
text:
Sparrow (Actionverse) - Trivia
Although Cat Noir refers to him as "Birdy", this was later revealed to be either an error or a nickname.

title: Staff
text:
Staff - Intro
The , also called the Stick or Baton, is the tool of the Cat Miraculous.
The current owner of the Staff is Adrien Agreste, who uses it as the superhero Cat Noir.
In "Miraculous Paris", to escape from Shadybug and Claw Noir, Betterfly sends a kamiko into the Staff, causing it to become the kamikotized object of Celesticat.

title: Staff
text:
Staff - Appearance
When owned by Cat Noir, the Staff is shiny dark gray with a glowing green paw print near its upper end. It is retractable, and when it is not in use, Cat Noir usually has it attached to his lower back. Lady Noire has the same design, but she keeps it attached on her hip.
From Season 6 and onwards, the cat paw on Cat Noir's Staff has a similar design to Claw Noir's Staff.
As Cat Blanc, the Staff was the same color as the rest of his costume which was pure white.
With Celesticat, the Staff develops a shiny blue sheen.
With Kitty Noire, the Staff adopted a black color with a purple sheen and with glowing green accents and paw print.
With Bug Noire, the Staff appeared similar to with Cat Noir, but the paw and other parts that glow green instead were colored red due to being unified with the Ladybug Miraculous.

title: Staff
text:
Staff - Abilities
The Staff, like Ladybug's yo-yo string, is nearly unbreakable shown in "The Mime" and "Glaciator" as the staff is able to stop the weight of a bus (over 10,000 kg) with ease or more all the way to speeding train and ferris wheel which was heavier. It can be extended to unlimited length. Cat Noir can split it in half or changes its length to use it as a staff, sword, bridge, javelin, or vaulting pole. On occasion, to stop something from moving or slowing down, his staff can also work as a blockade seen various episodes. When spun around at high speed, it can generate a gray-colored shield to deflect attacks, be used as a helicopter to allow Cat Noir to safely land from great heights, or move to a different location. In "Anansi", it's revealed that Cat Noir was able to extend the staff to said great lengths by pressing parts of the paw print meaning unlike Ladybug's yo-yo the length of the staff isn't connected to his willpower. Like the other miraculous tools it can be used by other people.

title: Staff
text:
Staff - Abilities
When the paw print button at the upper end of the staff is pressed, it slides open to reveal a screen. With this, Cat Noir can use the staff as a telescope, a tracker, a map, a phone, or an x-ray. He can also use it as a communicator to contact Ladybug or as a normal cellular phone. In "Animan", when not used as a phone the staff has a storage compartment for tracers allowing Cat Noir to track anyone he tags anywhere. In "The Dark Owl", "Gamer 2.0", "Queen Banana", "Glaciator 2" and "Pretension", like Ladybug's yo-yo, it's revealed the staff also has an ear communicator.
In and out of "Aqua Mode", the staff can also work as a breathing apparatus for those who can't breathe underwater, such as Cat Noir himself in "Reverser" and "Queen Wasp", and Ondine in "Mayura". In "Miracle Queen", it can also be used as a periscope when under water.

title: Staff
text:
Staff - Abilities
Due to the staff's ability to split apart, Cat Noir can use one section for his phone and the rest for fighting, as seen in "Oni-Chan". In "Weredad", it is shown that it can be split into at least four pieces. As seen in "Sentibubbler", the staff can be swung like a club and its force is enough to break a chimney. Despite the staff being thick and strong in "The Pharaoh", "Guitar Villain", "Santa Claws" and "Weredad", it's revealed to be bendable.
Seen in "Mayura" and "Optigami", the staff can be held while the holder has Cataclysm activated without being affected from it.
As seen in "Glaciator 2", "Qilin" and "Ephemeral", the staff can be used as an umbrella, which Cat Noir uses to shelter from the rain or to deflect objects thrown by akumatized villains.

title: Staff
text:
Staff - Abilities
From Season 6 onwards, to better fight the akumatized villains sent by the holder of the Butterfly Miraculous, Ladybug added a function to Cat Noir's staff that allows him to call on any of his fellow Miraculous Heroes (including Ladybug) by picking one of their sigils from his staff. After he clicks on the sigil, it sends an empathic signal to the designated hero which tells them that Cat Noir needs their help and where to find him.

title: Staff
text:
Staff - Trivia
Ladybug has used the staff against Cat Noir during the times when he is under the control of supervillains.
On occasion, Cat Noir has a habit of resting his staff across his shoulders.
Sometimes, Cat Noir's staff can being used as well as still be on his back, in some episodes it was seen as an error and other times it was the staff's ability to split apart.
Instances of the staff being split apart are seen in "Lady Wifi", "The Evillustrator", "Horrificator", "Dark Cupid", "Chameleon", "Animaestro", "Timetagger" "Cat Blanc", "Miraculous New York" and "Pretension".
In the Miraculous spellbook, a drawing of the staff is colored black.
Copycat has a staff identical to Cat Noir's staff in "Copycat". However, he uses Cat Noir's Staff to call Ladybug instead of his own.
In "Oblivio", Adrien's cellphone has multiple pictures of Ladybug, which he could've taken with his staff while transformed and when Ladybug wasn't looking, so the pictures could've transferred from his cat phone to his regular one.

title: Staff

Cat Noir's Staff originally started as a crutch for Adrien as he was supposed to be disabled however, the producers and broadcasters didn't trust the writers to write him well, so the idea was scrapped.
In "Elation", it is revealed that Cat Noir's staff can extend to at least hundreds of meters, as it's shown to extend above the clouds, which usually form at least 300 meters above the ground.

title: Stade des Princesses
text:
Stade des Princesses - Intro
The  (literally "Stadium of the Princesses" or "Princesses' Stadium" in English) is an all-seater soccer stadium located in the center of Paris, France. It's based on the real-life Parc des Princes stadium.

title: Stade des Princesses
text:
Stade des Princesses - Appearance
Exterior
The Stade des Princesses has an elliptical shape and is supported by cantilevered porticoes of different sizes, which give the building its particular character. The enclosure and the roof are grey. In the evening, yellow lights illuminate the stadium.
Interior
The enclosure consists of a lawn on which the markings and equipment necessary for playing football have been installed. Since the arrival of Caline at the Town Hall in Paris, a large athletics track has been built in the stadium.
The stadium is distinguished by its two tiers of stands, the one closest to the pitch with red seats and the other with blue seats, all three before a redesign of the seats with an exclusive blue color.
Advertisements have been installed everywhere, both around the pitch and between the two tiers of stands.
Locker rooms

title: Stade des Princesses
text:
Stade des Princesses - Appearance
The locker rooms in the stadium are large, with a grey and blue tile floor, with the stadium logo in the center of the room. There are large brown lockers with blue jerseys and doors, with a small blue armchair under each. There is a section where the lockers are closer together, and this section has large blue benches. In front of this area is another section with a blue bench, a tall horizontal shelf, and a coat rack.
Each locker room has a bathroom. This room has a wall divided into two parts: the upper one is smooth and white, and the lower one is made of small blue tiles. There are three cabins, one of which is for disabled people, and four sinks, each with a round mirror.

title: Stade des Princesses
text:
Stade des Princesses - Trivia
Its name is mentioned in the French dub of "Gamer" and can be seen on a billboard in the same episode, as well as the floor of the dressing rooms in "Sublimation".
Advertisements at the stadium feature the ZAG logo spelled backwards ("GAZ"). Interestingly, the real-life logo is used in "Gamer".
Other signs advertise TVi, a telephone company, "Baskets" (with a logo resembling that of the band Kiss), and "Eau" (French for "water", with a logo resembling Evian).
Starting from season 6, some signs also advertise Tsurugi Industries and "Jus de Fruit" (French for "fruit juice").
In "Gamer", the stadium is the location of the Ultimate Mecha Strike III tournament.
As seen in "Ladybug & Cat Noir", Armand D'Argencourt sometimes escorts students here for outdoor physical education class.
In "Penalteam", Caline organized a soccer course in the stadium supervised by Didier Roustan.
The stadium has been involved in several attacks by Akumatized villains:
In "Ladybug and Cat Noir", it was in the stadium that Ladybug and Cat Noir revealed themselves to the Parisians and fought for the first time against Stoneheart.

title: Stade des Princesses
text:
Stade des Princesses - Trivia
In "Gamer", it was in the stadium that Ladybug and Cat faced the Mecha of the eponymous villain.
In "Robostus", it was inside the stadium that the heroes managed to defeat the eponymous villain.
In "Gamer 2.0", the stadium became the fighting arena for the game created by the eponymous villain.
In "Furious Fu", the entire fight between Ladybug, Cat Noir, Su-Han and the eponymous villain took place in the stadium.
In "Kuro Neko", it was on the stadium's lawn that Ladybug managed to defeat the eponymous sentimonster and save Rythm.
In "Penalteam", Chloé was akumatized into Penalty in the stadium, and with her clones she organized a soccer match with unfair rules, before taking the whole of Paris as their playing field.
In "Sublimation", Caroline was akumatized into Sublimation and began her confrontation with Ladybug, before chasing after Bob.
