is a minor character of Miraculous World: New York - United Heroez. They are a bee-themed superhero and member of United Heroez, a team of superheroes, that protects the United States of America.

title: Sting

Sting's personality is not exactly known. In "Miraculous New York", they are brave and courageous. They are not afraid to stand up to fight the enemy to protect people. Miraculous New York

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)
text:
Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2) - Intro
"" is a Season 4 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 26th and last written and produced episode of Season 4, thus making it the season's finale. It is also the 104th written and produced episode of the series, overall.
This episode is also the second and final part of the two-part Season 4 finale, "Shadow Moth's Final Attack".

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)
text:
Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2) - Synopsis
Unaware that they are under the influences of a powerful villain, Ladybug and Cat Noir are determined to get back to their lives as quickly as possible. They think everything is under control, but Shadow Moth is preparing himself for his first big victory. What will Ladybug and Cat Noir do to stop him?
Disney Channel
Shadow Moth's trap closes in on Ladybug and Cat Noir, threatening to turn their fate upside down.
Disney+
Shadow Moth's trap closes in on Ladybug and Cat Noir.
Netflix
Ladybug and Cat Noir argue over the secrets between them. Marinette risks everything to save Adrien - unaware that Félix has assumed his identity.

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)
text:
Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2) - Plot
The episode follows the events of "Risk": Adrien finds Félix's revealer lens but hears Strikeback attacking the city and transforms into Cat Noir on the run. Meanwhile, on the roof of the Gare du Nord, Marinette Dupain-Cheng decides to transform into Pegabug and catch up to Adrien but is interrupted by the sentimonster. She decides to postpone the rescue and runs to fight it as Ladybug.
Meanwhile, aboard the train, Nathalie attempts to cheer up who she thinks is Adrien, and Lila expresses her hope of becoming close friends with Adrien. Félix agrees with them and leaves to the bathroom. He takes out the fake Peacock Miraculous and Nathalie's tablet and is frustrated to discover that the Miraculous did not work. Upon breaking it, to his fury, he discovers that it's a fake.

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)
text:
Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2) - Plot
Back in Paris, Ladybug and Cat Noir agree to hurry up and defeat the villain as soon as possible. As they prepare to fight Strikeback, Risk makes the Parisians approach the villain and put themselves in danger, thus distracting the heroes. Affected by Risk, Cat Noir tries to use his Cataclysm, and Ladybug accidentally causes destruction when releasing the sentimonster from her yo-yo. The heroes argue, Cat Noir calling out Ladybug for never taking any risks nor taking the time to explain anything to him, as they dodge the sentimonster's fearsome punches. Cat Noir then claims that he doesn't need Ladybug to protect him, and that they'd never get akumatized, and she remembers the events of "Cat Blanc", then tells him that he doesn't know what he's talking about, to which Cat Noir chastises her for not telling him anything. Just then, Rena Furtive warns Ladybug just in time to avoid another punch, and, under Risk's influence, she thanks her out loud, revealing the fact that Rena was around to Cat Noir. The heroes continue rescuing the reckless Parisians.
Ladybug rounds up the team, which splits up in order to fight Strikeback and protect the civilians at the same time.

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)
text:
Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2) - Plot
Vesperia, Purple Tigress and Polymouse soon discover that their powers, instead of affecting the villain, are only cloned by it.
Ladybug orders the team to avoid using their powers, and they all gather at the city hall, Ladybug carrying Risk, whom she believes to be a regular child.
Strikeback throws the Roue de Paris at the heroes.
Ryuko protects the team by sending the wheel towards the Tour Montparnasse, and Carapace shell-ters Rena, making everyone, including Shadow Moth, aware of her activity.
Disappointed for going behind her back and telling Nino, Ladybug promises to address this later.
Risk taunts Ladybug and continues singing, and Cat Noir decides to carry him away.
Rena Furtive notices that all the heroes and civilians have a frog mark on their necks as Risk launches Cat Noir, who realizes that they are dealing with an akumatized villain.
Ladybug orders him to de-transform and brings part of the team to neutralize Risk while the rest limit the damage.
Risk admits that he hid the akumatized object after they destroy all his belongings.
Meanwhile, Cat Noir, influenced by Risk, decides to fight Strikeback and uses his Cataclysm, which is soon absorbed by the sentimonster.

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)
text:
Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2) - Plot
Ladybug, using her Lucky Charm yet doubting herself, decides to travel to the past and retrieve the akumatized object with the help of an ally who she believes hasn't been affected: Adrien.
Unifying the Ladybug, Horse and Rabbit Miraculouses to become Pennybug, she travels to the train via Voyage and bumps into Félix. She makes sure he doesn't have a mark on his neck and gives him the Dog Miraculous, encouraging him. Félix notices that she can access all the Miraculous from her yo-yo. He transforms and receives instructions, casually holding Pennybug's hand and yo-yo. The two enter a Burrow and return to the point when Froggy was akumatized, touch his stuffed toy with the ball and return to the present. Pennybug divides Fluff and Kaalki to become Ladybug again while the team struggles to keep up with Strike Back. He uses his power, and Ladybug destroys the toy and reverts the damage, bringing Cat Noir back to his senses. Cat Noir overhears Ladybug praising the new hero, Flairmidable. Ladybug and Flairmidable leave to the sewers to recharge their kwamis, and Félix insists on fighting alongside her and promises to stand up to his "father", inspired by her.

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)
text:
Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2) - Plot
The heroes regroup, and Ladybug is excited to have Cat Noir and Flairmidable, holders of the Cat and Dog Miraculous, meet. She uses her Lucky Charm and asks Rooster Bold to clone the glasses she gets. Meanwhile, Flairmidable discreetly touches her yo-yo with his ball. Ladybug explains her plan of isolating the sentimonsters and teleporting them away, and Flairmidable shows concern. The heroes run towards the villain, but Flairmidable stays where he was and observes as Carapace uses Shell-ter around the Strikeback clones and they are teleported to the sun by Pegabug. He sympathizes with them and leaves just as Ladybug uses her Miraculous Ladybugs. Shadow Moth is frustrated by the fact that she has not made any major mistakes and goes back to his home. Ladybug and Rena Furtive meet up, and the latter de-transforms. Alya apologizes to her for telling Nino, but Ladybug understands and relates. Alya tells Ladybug not to trust her with the Fox Miraculous again due to the riskiness and Shadow Moth knowing, and with her reluctant approval, renounces Trixx and tells Ladybug to retrieve the rest of the Miraculouses before she transforms back.

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)
text:
Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2) - Plot
After taking back the Miraculouses, Ladybug goes to the sewers but can't find Adrien. Meanwhile, Flairmidable awaits Gabriel's return, who calls Nathalie to cancel the trip to London, and interrupts him, revealing his identity and causing Gabriel to drop the phone. On the train, Nathalie tries to reach out to him and explain that Adrien is missing but starts coughing uncontrollably. Lila smirks. Ladybug makes it to Adrien's room and asks him to return the Dog Miraculous. After she explains, Adrien tells her that she gave the Miraculous to his cousin Félix causing her to gasp in shock for the biggest mistake of her life. Just under them, Flairmidable demands the real Peacock Miraculous, threatening to otherwise reveal the painting's secret code to Adrien and promising to hand over the stolen ring and Ladybug's yo-yo, containing almost every Miraculous of her allies. Gabriel hesitates and reluctantly agrees, renouncing Duusu.

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)
text:
Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2) - Plot
Flairmidable uses his power, and Ladybug's yo-yo disappears when touched by the ball and appears in Flairmidable's hand. Gabriel maniacally reaches out all the Miraculouses. Ladybug has a panic attack, realizing that she lost all the Miraculous. Adrien advises her to focus and allows her to de-transform in the bathroom to recover the yo-yo. Freaked out and doubting herself she ultimately agrees and cries in the bathroom as Tikki eats, pleading for there to be at least some Miraculouses left. A floor below, Flairmidable de-transforms and renounces Barkk, leaving his uncle with the magical jewels. Marinette transforms into Ladybug but, much to her despair, finds the yo-yo to be empty. Adrien, overhearing this, opens the door, but Ladybug is already gone.

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)
text:
Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2) - Plot
At nightfall with rain, on the rooftops of the Jardins du Trocadéro, Ladybug cries over the loss of the Miraculouses for the darkest hour of France. Suddenly, an illusion of the message transmission appears inside with Shell-ter to protect his akumas in case Ladybug purifies them again. Hawk Moth with all the Miraculouses, now known as Monarch, threatens all the Parisians, promising to attack them more than ever, and that he will not stop until he gets Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses. As Monarch explains further his plans of the Endgame, we see the reactions of all of Ladybug and Cat Noir's allies in the sidelines: Luka, Kagami, Alya, Nino, Juleka, Rose, Ivan, Mylene, Su-Han, Zoé and, ironically, her half-sister Chloé watch in shock, horror and slight anger. Ladybug believes that all is lost, but Cat Noir comes, letting her know she still has him. Guilt-ridden, she apologizes to him for all the times she neglected him. He reaches a helping hand and promises that they will retrieve the Miraculouses, one by one, until the very last and promise that this will never happen again. The people of Paris cheer for the heroes, who prepare to face the villain.

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)
text:
Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2) - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in Brazil on Gloob.
The scene of Ladybug giving the temporary heroes their Miraculouses is re-animated from the "Miraculous holders" scene in the Season 2 and 3 intro.
Alongside the previous and the next three episodes, it forms a pentalogy called "The Rise of Monarch".
"Shadow Moth's Final Attack" is the second two parter which each episodes' international premiere happens in two different nations after "Origins".
This episode's world premiere date (March 10) and English premiere date (March 12) is the closest to its Disney+ premiere date (March 16). Usually, after the last episode of a hiatus premieres on Disney, it takes 1-2 months for it to go on Disney+, but this time it only took 4 days for it to come on the platform and the season ended in the same month it started in March.
The phrase "Strike Back" means to retaliate or counterattack. This is likely a reference to the sentimonster's power to copy the powers of Miraculous holders and 'strike them' back with it.
In the French dub, the episode is called Réplique, which means to reply, retort, or object, as well as to replicate.

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)
text:
Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2) - Trivia
With this episode, season 4 is the first season in which every Miraculous from the Chinese Miracle Box has been activated.
This also makes it the first season where all of those Miraculouses' superpowers were used.
This is the first second part of a two-parter where the beginning scenes overlap with the ending of the first part.
Clara Contard has a slightly deeper voice in this episode.
This is the second time Gabriel sends out a message through which the Akumas speaks his message, after "Stoneheart".
This is the first time the streets of Paris are shown as crowded.
Flairmidable's transformation music is a high pitched version of Polymouse's transformation music.
References
This is the eleventh and last episode to be named after a Sentimonster, the others being "Reflekdoll", "Félix", "Ladybug", "Gabriel Agreste", "Mega Leech", "Guiltrip", "Optigami", "Sentibubbler", "Hack-San" and "Kuro Neko".
This is the second episode where a character fuses three Miraculouses together, with Marinette unifying the Ladybug, Horse and Rabbit Miraculous, after "Ephemeral" with Gabriel unifying the Butterfly, Peacock and Cat Miraculous.

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)
text:
Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2) - Trivia
This is also the first time a hero unifies three Miraculouses, and the first time the Rabbit Miraculous is used by a non-adult user and in the current timeline.
André Bourgeois mentions that "the magic of cinema" is "more exciting than power or money", which means he is starting to relive his dreams that he first mentioned in "Sole Crusher".
This is the second time that a villain from a previous episode is deakumatized but not in their debut episode, following "Heart Hunter".
Félix had the same reaction as his uncle in "The Dark Owl", where both characters were fooled by fake jewelry.
This episode has the most people to renounce their Miraculous in an episode: Alya renounced the Fox Miraculous, Gabriel renounced the Peacock Miraculous, and Félix renounced the Dog Miraculous.
This is the sixth episode to not have a proper endcard, after "Stormy Weather", "Ladybug & Cat Noir", "Volpina", "Style Queen", and "Risk".
Like "Miracle Queen", this episode also has many ironic and similar factors to other people and episodes as well.
As mentioned in "Félix", by Amelie that both boys did the same trick when they were young, however, their trick ended up dealing a lot more harm than good.

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)
text:
Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2) - Trivia
Both Adrien and Marinette did actions that were selfish and it cost them something dearly. Like with Marinette's actions in "Miracle Queen" cost Master Fu's memories, both their actions led them to losing the other Miraculouses.
Aside from that, Chloé's actions still haunt Marinette, as the reason why she didn't give the Miraculouses to the others (on a permanent basis) was because of her fear of what Shadow Moth would've done to them similar to what he did to Alya in "Sentibubbler".
In "Horrificator", as Hawk Moth, Gabriel mentioned that Ladybug didn't scare him but he was scared of consequences and yet was still in denial about them and was also responsible for placing that fear in Ladybug.
If Ladybug had given the jewels to the others (the identities of the holders Hawk Moth didn't know albeit temporarily), or tried to get the Dog Miraculous first, then she and Cat Noir would have only lost half of the Miraculouses to Shadow Moth. Either way, Ladybug was guaranteed to have lost at least some of the Miraculouses the moment she decided to give "Adrien" (unaware at the time that he was Félix) the Dog Miraculous, including the latter, to Shadow Moth.

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)
text:
Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2) - Trivia
However, thanks to Betterfly in "Miraculous Paris", and "Re-creation", Marinette decided to give the Miraculouses to her teammates on a permanent basis, inspired to share out the jewels to ensure power is used for the greater good, as well as to prevent the same mistake from happening twice.
Félix criticized Chloé for being selfish in "Félix", but he proved to be more selfish than her.
As of "Representation", it was explained why Félix took the actions he did, as he wanted to guarantee on getting the Peacock Miraculous to secure his own existence, but that didn't justify the way he went about it, as he endangered the lives of many others by giving almost every Miraculous to Gabriel.
He also should've taken it as a matter of perspective as he knew that Adrien was a sentimonster, but his cousin didn't know, from Adrien's perspective Felix didn't give him his freedom but took it away and hurt others just to get it like Gabriel and his father.
Like in "Miracle Queen", Cat Noir embraced Ladybug for her doubt and guilt, although this time, it was done in the episode's end.

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)
text:
Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2) - Trivia
When Cat Noir attempted to use Cataclysm but Ladybug stopped him, he criticized her about not taking any risks like knowing their identities or that he would never be akumatized is another callback to "Ephemeral" and "Kuro Neko".
Through his and Ladybug's perspectives, what she said did hold some truth, as throughout all of Hawk Moth/Shadow Moth's akumatized villains, they were the only ones never akumatized and fought against each other in the permanent timeline, even though he was close to akumatizating them, as shown in "Zombizou", "Mayura", "Chameleon", "Ladybug" and "Glaciator 2".
Because of the erased timelines, Cat Noir himself was never aware nor informed of his akumatizations.
Adrien also seemed to have forgotten his time as Cat Walker, and Ladybug hesitating at first believing the sentimonster was him akumatized should've made him realize that is what she was scared of.
Hearing that Sass used his powers and aware of when a kwami does so disastrous results happen like Ladybug, Cat Noir too should've been aware that something did and more or less they could've arrived at the same answer.

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)
text:
Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2) - Trivia
And that maybe she didn't tell Cat Noir the consequences of knowing each others identities or she did and he forgot.
In a few other episodes like "Ephemeral", Marinette was right, Adrien is going to need saving from his father unknown to her, their friends and especially him that he is in the grandest of danger.
Marinette beating herself up over the way she treated Cat Noir mirrors "Kuro Neko" where she did just that but this time she finally realizes the way she was neglecting him was similar to Gabriel.
Cat Noir offering his hand to a distraught Ladybug is also what he did for her as Cat Walker in "Kuro Neko".
Also like in "Kuro Neko" and other episodes, one small choice can either prevent or cause something big to happen both good and bad.
Cat Noir also forgot about the consequences of using his power on someone else if he dares to aim wrong calling back "Miraculer", "Miraculous New York" and "Simpleman".
Félix used Adrien's predicament to further his own agenda similar to his uncle.

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)
text:
Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2) - Trivia
When Gabriel believed he wasn't worthy of Emilie's love he was wrong he was worthy but instead he panicked giving into fear and desperation if he had surrendered for his family and admitted he needed help then maybe none of this would've happened.
Alya giving up her Miraculous is a stark contrast to Chloé in "Miracle Queen", as she surrendered hers for her loved ones, while Chloé couldn't let go.
Ladybug giving Félix the Dog Miraculous is similar to how she gave Adrien the Snake Miraculous in "Desperada". Likewise, this happened due to her troubled heart and feelings for him, as when she traveled to the train to give Adrien the Dog Miraculous, she didn't know she gave it to Félix. While Adrien realizes the mistake, he relinquishes the Snake Miraculous but Félix kept the Dog Miraculous to use for his own agenda.
Both times with "Heart Hunter", Ladybug's feelings for Adrien lead her to make a mistake that allowed Hawk Moth to obtain victory.
Ladybug had the same pressure from "Gang of Secrets", in which both situations evolve with the problems they can't face, but her friends comforted her.

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)
text:
Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2) - Trivia
More or less, Ladybug and Cat Noir were both in the same boat as both have enemies, but they don't completely understand their enemy's actions.
For Ladybug, she knew that Hawk Moth wanted their powers to make a wish but she didn't know what wish he wants.
For Cat Noir, it's Félix as his cousin betrayed his partner by stealing the jewels but didn't understand why he did it.
They both learn the reason for Felix's actions in "Emotion".
Similar to how Gabriel acted as a personality foil for Fei in "Miraculous Shanghai", he and his wife did for their son and Marinette:
As the duo have the same problem following the walk in a mile in each other's shoe tactic, as shown in "Reflekdoll".
The Agreste couple recklessly used the broken Peacock Miraculous without the watchful eye of a guardian or a Ladybug Miraculous holder to fix the damage. By giving into their own desires like Adrien they both unintentionally put others in danger: the people of Paris.
By refusing to stop they both lost or temporarily lost the thing that mattered the most for Gabriel: his wife, and for Marinette: Adrien.

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)
text:
Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2) - Trivia
Both were consumed by fear and an extreme desire to control everything as they continued their endeavors: Gabriel feared of Adrien, let alone anyone else discovering the truth. While Ladybug was desperately trying to stop her archenemy, she feared his deceptive and sneaky nature and what he would do.
In doing so, they rejected or ignored the proper help they needed; Ladybug with Cat Noir, and Gabriel with the Guardians.
Both became obsessive as: Gabriel tried to get the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses to wake Emilie up and as: the duo gave in to their desires (Ladybug and her love for Adrien and Adrien with his freedom).
Unlike Gabriel, the French duo cared about consequences of their actions following in "Multiplication".
This episode also draws parallels between Marinette and Fei from "Miraculous Shanghai":
As both were chosen to be the heirs of their predecessor's legacy.
They tried to do everything they could to uphold it but went the wrong way about it.
Both were found by the ones they hurt or pushed away, Fei was found by Marinette and as Ladybug she was found by Cat Noir.
Both berated themselves for their actions towards them but were forgiven.

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)
text:
Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2) - Trivia
Neither were completely to blame for what happened as Cash was consumed by endless greed and Gabriel was desperate and fearful.
Even without Risk and Strikeback, Gabriel didn't know he already won because he played on the heroes deepest desires. Furthermore, it didn't matter what sentimonster or villain he needed to create because it would add up to one thing: Getting Adrien to leave which set both his son and Ladybug off. In a way, Froggy didn't need to be akumatized at all which is similar to "Reflekta".
Marinette acted similar to Nino in "Rocketear", as both thought they were going to lose someone they cared about.
This episode also has correlations to "Cat Blanc":
For starters, everyone was at fault for what happened
However, unlike the first time, Gabriel started the chain of events, not Marinette.
Both of Gabriel's plans were devastating leading to results that were disastrous.
Unlike Master Fu, Su-Han was distracted by the technological advances the world's been through since he and the Order were freed, by letting his fear get the better of him and lack of help, he failed to watch over Ladybug and Cat Noir properly.

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)
text:
Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2) - Trivia
Félix, like his uncle, is responsible for putting Paris in a death trap.
Like Adrien, if the kwamis had been more attentive and observant, then the holders would've noticed Risk's akumatization sooner.
Similar to his father and before that, Adrien was making a promise he couldn't keep no more than Marinette could about him or her being akumatized because he also didn't know that it nearly did happen to her in "Ladybug".
As shown in "The Last Day", where he couldn't be with Ladybug during the final battle but he did keep his promise just not the way he expected too.
Ladybug as Marinette would later be akumatized in "Heartfixer" into the titular villain.
Just as Ladybug was trying to protect Cat Noir from akumatization, he also tried to do the same for her but they went in different ways about it, as Ladybug wanted to keep Cat Noir away while he wanted to draw her in.

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)
text:
Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2) - Trivia
However, Cat Noir saying that he doesn't need protection is a callback to the over-protection he gets from his father as Adrien, but when living the life of a hero or with a team, a person only has themselves and their teammates to defend them. Just as Cat Noir, said it's him and Ladybug against the world meaning until the other holders were recruited, they only had each other.
This is the seventeenth time, where Cat Noir attempted to use his powers on someone else following "Dark Cupid", "Princess Fragrance", "Despair Bear", "Troublemaker", "Malediktator", "Miraculous Shanghai", "Miraculer", "Cat Blanc", "Ladybug", "Miraculous New York", "Furious Fu", "Sole Crusher", "Queen Banana", "Guiltrip", "Hack-San" and "Simpleman" but the fourteenth time of his own free will.
In "Félix", Ladybug knows Adrien wouldn't behave in such a pushy manner and wasn't fooled by Félix's act, but now she was completely fooled by him. It's likely Félix had to perfectly act like how Adrien does, especially around Ladybug, while not showing his own traits.
This is the eighteenth time where a previous Lucky Charm appeared in another episode.

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)
text:
Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2) - Trivia
However, the ticket in this episode is different from the one that appeared in "Ikari Gozen".
This is the twenty-fifth time in which Lucky Charm is summoned twice in a single episode following "The Bubbler", "Antibug", "Sapotis", "The Dark Owl", "Syren", "Style Queen", "Anansi", "Malediktator", "Mayura", "Miraculous Shanghai", "Reflekdoll", "Weredad", "Miraculer", "Oblivio", "Desperada", "Ikari Gozen", "Timetagger", "Heart Hunter", "Psycomedian", "Glaciator 2", "Hack-San", "Dearest Family", "Ephemeral" and "Kuro Neko".
This is the eighth time where Ladybug's Lucky Charm resembles an akumatized villain's object from before it got akumatized following the glasses from "Gamer", "Antibug", "Gamer 2.0" and "Rocketear"
This is also marks one of the few times a Miraculous holder's identity is revealed to another that is not Ladybug or Cat Noir. Flairmidable revealed himself as Félix to Gabriel to make an exchange for the Peacock Miraculous. When Ladybug told Adrien about giving him the Dog Miraculous at the train, Adrien realized, and by the extension Cat Noir, that Flairmidable is his cousin.

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)
text:
Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2) - Trivia
Like with the Snake and Bee Miraculous, the Dog Miraculous was given to another instead of the previous holder. In this case, Ladybug gave it to Félix who was pretending to be Adrien at that time instead of giving it to Sabrina.
Sabrina and Félix getting the Dog Miraculous mirrors Chloé and Zoé with the Bee Miraculous. Chloé obtained the Bee Miraculous and wanted to do good for the first time, but got addicted to her own powers and got expelled from the team, while Zoé got the Miraculous and she performed good deeds. Sabrina got the Dog Miraculous to do good by defeating Penalteam while Félix got the Miraculous and while he helped Ladybug find Risk's akumatized object he then defects and makes a deal with Gabriel.
Likewise, Chloé and Félix sided with Gabriel for their own actions. Chloé agreed to get Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous as Miracle Queen and the Miracle Box, while Félix got Ladybug's yo-yo for Gabriel to have almost every Miraculous.
While Chloé only sided with Hawk Moth for her own selfish desires to gain power, with Félix, as mentioned above, only sought out a way to get the Peacock Miraculous by any means necessary.

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)
text:
Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2) - Trivia
In "Risk", Alya warns Marinette not to risk messing with someone's life, and at the train station, Marinette declared she is ready to risk everything to bring Adrien back; this came back as an omen when Ladybug unknowingly handed the Dog Miraculous to Félix. Had she known that Adrien and Félix switched places, or if Adrien had told his friends he was still in Paris, then she wouldn't have lost almost every Miraculous since she was doing this to help Adrien, not knowing he was home the entire time.
Likewise, Rena Furtive deduces that everyone in Paris had the mark of Risk. Given Adrien was asleep during the time Risk marked everyone in Paris, Ladybug would have at least realized it was Félix pretending to be Adrien given Félix was out of Paris.
Tikki also tried to point out in the previous episode how Adrien is Marinette's weakness and how there are complications when she used Ladybug to try to solve her personal problems.

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)
text:
Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2) - Trivia
Adrien received an omen too back from "Simon Says", He desperately wanted his own freedom as a civilian but didn't have the courage to fight for it and relied on someone else who tricked him. As compared to being Cat Noir, he had the freedom he dreamed of and someone to share it with, but he failed to realize it came with a price: everyone else including his partner losing their freedom and even more when Felix stole the jewels.
When Monarch sends his message, Chloé is seen looking worried, despite the fact she's been his ally ever since "Miracle Queen".
Upon seeing Monarch make his announcement, Ladybug and Cat Noir are aware that he doesn't have the Peacock Miraculous but are unaware that Félix has it until "Multiplication".
Not counting unifying, this is the ninth time a character(s) appears as a Miraculous holder for a single episode, following Mister Bug and Lady Noire in "Reflekdoll", Aspik in "Desperada", Multimouse in "Kwamibuster", Scarabella in "Hack-San", Cat Walker in "Kuro Neko" and Caprikid and Miss Hound in "Penalteam".

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)
text:
Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2) - Trivia
This marks the eighth time a miraculous has its ownership transferred in the show following "Anansi", "Reflekdoll", "Desperada", "Kwamibuster", "Queen Banana", "Mega Leech" and "Penalteam". But unlike the others "Anansi", dealt with a holder who couldn't use it.
Allusions
The summoning sequence of the evolved message transmitter resembles the eye of ender from Minecraft if paused.
Pennybug's hair style is a Japanese hair style called usagi buns. "Usagi" means "rabbit" in Japanese, and is the name of the protagonist of Sailor Moon, who popularized the hairstyle. Considering that Miraculous Ladybug is partially made by the same company who made the Sailor Moon anime, it's a high possibility as well.
The smirking running gag returns, but with Lila smirking at someone other than Marinette (Nathalie possibly).
Errors
When Adrien picks up Félix's revealer lens his face doesn't reflect on it like in the same scene in "Risk".

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)
text:
Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2) - Trivia
When Ladybug's yo-yo disappears after she detransforms, trying to prevent Gabriel from getting all the miraculouses, Ladybug's yo-yo only disappears from Gabriel once Ladybug transforms into her hero identity again, instead of disappearing once she detransforms, unlike how it happened in "Mayura", where Hawk Moth's cane disappeared once Hawk Moth detransforms.
When Ladybug is retransformed, her yo-yo doesn't turn to dust like Hawk Moth's cane in "Mayura", instead just disappearing.
However, this might be related to the fact that the cane was already cataclysmed prior to disappearing.
Also, when she retransforms, her lower legs are transformed before the transformation magic reaches them.
The reason why the yoyo remained despite Marinette detransforming could've also been due to added affect of Fetch.
Despite Félix reading the translated version of the Grimoire, the text on the tablet remains under the ancient language.
When Ladybug divides Fluff and Kaalki, both of the kwamis are missing.
Rena Furtive zooms her flute on King Monkey and Carapace landing on a roof, even though Ladybug didn't call on the former. This is because the scene was reused from "Risk".

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)
text:

When Rena Furtive informed Ladybug about the "Froggy kid" (Risk), just after Ladybug had gathered the team, the shot of Ladybug, Carapace, and Purple Tigress is mirrored. Due to this, the tips of Ladybug's bangs end on the right side of her forehead instead of the left, and the Tiger Miraculous is on Purple Tigress' left hand instead of her right.

Ryuko's sword is yellow instead of red in multiple scenes.
This error was also present in "Mega Leech".
When Pennybug creates a portal to enter the present timeline, Froggy's parents are nowhere to be seen as they enter through.
Throughout scenes with Pennybug and Flairmidable, the Rabbit Miraculous is shown to be nowhere on her, even though she did apply it before fusing into Pennybug. However, it is possible she put the the Rabbit Miraculous in her left or right pocket.
Pennybug creates two burrows in this episode. Yet in the next episode, she suddenly no longer understands how a teenage Miraculous holder such as Rabbit Noir is able to use the superpower more than once.

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)
text:
Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2) - Trivia
When Froggy is seen being akumatized in the past, his expression is different from the one he had prior to his Akumatization in "Risk".
Although, it's possible it was still the same expression just seen from a different angle.
In the same scene, Froggy's mother has a line, but she didn't have one in the previous episode.
Throughout the whole episode, the spinning top has switched colors making the black counterparts yellow and the yellow counterparts black and Vesperia's braid is longer by a centimeter.

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)
text:
Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2) - Trivia
Before Ladybug is about to introduce Flairmidable to her teammates, Vesperia's fingertips are yellow. And when Ladybug introduces Flairmidable to the team, Vesperia’s antennae are yellow instead of black, Minotaurox has Rooster Bold's weapon and the mark of Risk still on his neck, and Ryuko's body isn't complete.

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)
text:

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
[ Theme Song ]
Adrien: Father?
(His Risk mark activates, and Adrien spots something gleaming on the floor... the monocle Félix used to scan the whole room. The environment shakes, and Adrien is shocked and turns around. He runs to the window and notices Strikeback wandering outside.)
Adrien: I'll have to talk to my father later! (runs off)
Adrien: Plagg, claws out! (transforms into Cat Noir and leaps away)
Ladybug: (moans sadly) Spots off. (de-transforms into Marinette)
Marinette: (crestfallen) It's all over, Tikki.
Tikki: He'll be back, Marinette. He's just going on a voyage!
Marinette: (her Risk mark activates) Of course, Voyage! Ladybug may have failed, but Pegabug will bring him back! And together we'll go talk to his father!
Tikki: You wanna use the Miraculous of the horse and teleport yourself, just for that?
Marinette: I'm ready to risk everything to not lose Adrien! Tikki, spots on! (transforms into Ladybug)
(Ladybug opens her yo-yo to take the Horse Miraculous and wears it upon obtaining it.)
Ladybug: Tikki, Kaalki, unify—
(The heavy stomps of Strikeback disrupt her, and she takes off the glasses.)

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: Okay, I guess I'll have to deal with this small problem first, but I'll be back to save you soon, Adrien!
Nathalie: (holds Félix's hand) Try to make the most out of this trip, Adrien. You're about to discover the world, and then you'll return to all of your friends and your father with fantastic memories to share with them.
Félix: You're right, Nathalie. You have to seize the opportunity when it presents itself to you.
Lila: And we'll end up being the best friends in the world, since we're going to see it all together.
Félix: I hope so with all my heart. Please excuse me for a moment.
(Nathalie steps out for a while as Félix walks away from them with a secret intent. In the lavatory, he equips the Peacock Miraculous and finds the Grimoire's written instructions as pictured in Nathalie's tablet.)
Félix: Ah, here we go. "Attach the brooch." Okay, that's done. "The kwami comes out of the jewel." (he grows suspicious upon seeing no kwami in sight) "Say the magic words, 'Duusu, spread my feathers'." Duusu, spread my feathers!

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)/Transcript
text:

(With no transformation occurring, Félix realizes that there is something suspicious about the jewel. He clenches the "Peacock Miraculous" in his fist, and it breaks into minuscule pieces, slamming his fist after.)
Félix: It's a fake!
Cat Noir: Okay, m'lady. Let's wrap this one up quickly. I've got... a full schedule.
Ladybug: Fine by me, kitty cat. I've got some urgent stuff to attend, too. (both heroes leap up)
Shadow Moth: My dear akumatized friend, sing as much as you can. We must ensure that Ladybug and Cat Noir will take countless risks today.
Risk: ♪ I'm Froggy, here I come. I'm not afraid of anyone. ♪
Parisian 1: Hey, if we wait a bit, we should see Ladybug and Cat Noir!
Parisian 2: I'm gonna get so many likes for this!

Parisian 2: Check that out!
(Ladybug and Cat Noir arrive. Ladybug throws her yo-yo to create a net, stopping the Roue de Paris from dealing more damage.)
Parisian 2: I gotta get a video!
(As the ferris wheel stops, it leans towards the buildings beside it.)
Ladybug: What's wrong with you? It's dangerous to stay here, shoo!
(The Parisians, although evidently furious, leave, following Ladybug's orders.)

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: Hey, little buddy old pal! Over here!
(Strikeback punches towards Cat Noir a few times, destroying the surroundings. A few debris fall near Risk, who Ladybug catches and reels back along with his toy wheel.)
Ladybug: Don't stay here, otherwise you risk getting hit by the bad guy! (leaps off)
Risk: (continues cycling) ♪ I'm Froggy, here I come. I'm not afraid of anyone. ♪
(Cat Noir approaches Strikeback, and upon hearing Risk's song, a risk takes effect.)
Cat Noir: Come on, no time to waste! Cata—
Ladybug: (holds his arm) What are you doing? (throws her yo-yo to catch Strikeback)
Cat Noir I'll use my power, you get the akuma, and bam. We can both go back to what we were doing. (extends his staff)
Ladybug: Who knows what your power would do directly on an akumatized person? And if it's a sentimonster, a cataclysm would send it out of control!
(Ladybug reels in Strikeback and immediately lets go, making Strikeback trip from the recoil. Strikeback hits a few buildings from the fall.)
Cat Noir: Well, brilliant. That's control? What's the difference with what I was saying?
Ladybug: No way, it's too risky.

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: (groans) That's the problem with you. You never want to take any risks.
Ladybug: Of course, I do! I take risks all the time!
Cat Noir: Oh yeah? Would you risk knowing who I really am behind my mask?
Ladybug: You know very well that—
(As soon as they notice a shadow, they look above to see Strikeback punching towards them. Cat Noir grabs Ladybug and jumps off, both landing on the pavements.)
Cat Noir: Our identities have to remain secret, I know. (gets up) So why do you know the identities of the other holders? So why not me?
Ladybug: I already told you, if I knew who you were, Shadow Moth would only need to akumatize me to get to you. I'm doing this to protect you.
(Ladybug notices a giant foot about to stomp on them and grabs Cat Noir to swing out to another rooftop. Cat Noir gets up.)
Cat Noir: I don't need you to protect me. We'll never get akumatized!
(His akumatized form, Cat Blanc, flashes back through Ladybug's mind.)
Ladybug: You don't know what you're talking about.
Cat Noir: Maybe because you never talk to me about anything!
Rena Furtive: (to Ladybug, on-call) Ladybug, watch out!

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)/Transcript
text:

(Ladybug looks up to find Strikeback about to crush them. They both jump out, and Ladybug takes a risk.)

(Cat Noir squints in annoyance.)

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
(Strikeback hits the helicopter, sending it flying uncontrollably and about to crash on the streets. Luckily, the helicopter gets saved by Cat Noir's staff. Ladybug and Cat Noir stand beside Risk without any prior knowledge that they are already standing beside the akumatized victim.)

Shadow Moth (to Risk) Keep it up! Taking risks always pays off in the end!
Risk: (continues cycling) ♪ I'm Froggy, here I come. I'm not afraid of anyone. ♪

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)/Transcript

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Rena Furtive: (on-call) You, Cat Noir, the others, all the people of Paris... we've all got that mark!(Cat Noir is seen flying and gets knocked to the rooftop's edge, which makes Ladybug see the frog mark on his nape, shocking her. Ladybug turns to see Risk standing on another rooftop.)Risk: ♪ When Froggy's near, there's nothing to fear. Risk is my name and you're all so— ♪
Cat Noir: Blind! We were blind. We're not just dealing with a sentimonster. There's also an akumatized villain!
Ladybug: That's why we're being so careless. It's him that's making us taking all these risks!(Risk sticks his tongue out and teases the heroes.)''
Shadow Moth: (laughs maniacally) Now that Ladybug knows they've all been hit, she will doubt everything! And above all, herself!
Ladybug: Cat Noir, you need to de-transform!
Cat Noir: What??
Ladybug: Until I've de-akumatized him, I can't leave you with your cataclysm. It's too risky! Minotaurox, Purple Tigress, Polymouse, with me! We'll never be able to beat the sentimonsters until we defeat Risk! Everyone else, try to limit the damages.
Risk: (while running off) ♪ I'm Froggy, here I come. I'm not afraid of anyone. ♪

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
(The heroes agree with the plan as they all leap away to the rooftops. Ladybug, Purple Tigress, Minotaurox and Polymouse chase after Risk as the other heroes prevent Risk from creating more casualties in the city. Cat Noir is left on the rooftops per Ladybug's order, leaving him shocked and frustrated.)
Cat Noir: But I can help... (The frog mark takes effect as he takes the risk of fighting the sentimonsters, not following Ladybug's orders.)(The four heroes taking care of Risk continue to chase after him. Purple Tigress manages to grapple Risk as Ladybug takes his nunchucks and breaks it, with no akuma freed from it. Ladybug proceeds to break everything that Risk owns only to find no akuma flying away.)Ladybug: Nothing! No akuma!
Risk: I tricked you! You'll never find my akuma 'cause my object's hidden from you!(Ladybug gasps in shock and turns her head to the three sentimonsters wreaking havoc to the city.)''
Ladybug: Okay, let's split up! Keep looking!
Cat Noir: Cataclysm!
(Strikeback unfortunately touches his ring and mimics his power.)
Cat Noir: No!
Strikeback: Strikeback!
(The sentimonster activates the cataclysm and destroys the Tour Montparnasse.)

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: Cat Noir! No, I told him! This is a nightmare... (gasps) Unless...
[Superpower sequence]Ladybug: Lucky Charm!(She gets a ticket.)
Ladybug: A ticket for the Jardin des Plantes? It's from yesterday... (gasps) I know! I've gotta put an end to this madness ASAP! (leaps off)
Ladybug: Okay! I need someone who hasn't been hit.
(Ladybug flashes back to what she sees as Adrien's departure, and her vision zooms in on his nape.)
Félix (flashback): Farewell, Ladybug.
Ladybug: (gasps) Adrien! But I've been hit by Risk! Maybe my idea's way too risky, or is it a risk not to take this risk? Am I doing this for the love of risk, or the risk of love? (groans)
(Ladybug opens her yo-yo and reaches for the Rabbit Miraculous and Horse Miraculous. She wears the two Miraculouses.)
Ladybug: No. It's Adrien, and he doesn't have the mark. It's a good idea! Tikki, Fluff, Kaalki, unify! (transforms into Pennybug)
Pennybug: Voyage!
(A portal opens, sending her to the Startrain.)
Félix: Who are you?
Pennybug: Oh! It's me, Ladybug. Or rather, Ladybug with a few extra powers. Pennybug! Wait!
(Pennybug checks Félix's neck immediately, still under the impression that he is Adrien.)

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
Pennybug: (sighs) You're alright. Adrien, I need your help. (retrieves the Dog Miraculous) I have to find an object.
Félix: Y... Your yo-yo gives you direct access to all the Miraculous?
Pennybug: The ones in my Miracle Box, yes. It's a magic shortcut.
Félix: Wow!
Pennybug: Adrien Agreste, here is the Miraculous of the Dog, which will grant you the power to locate and fetch whatever your ball has touched. You will use it for the greater good, then you will return it to me.... Can I trust you?
(Félix looks at the Miraculous intensely.)
Pennybug: If you're doubting yourself, then trying is the only way you can gain the confidence you need.
(Félix nods and wears the Miraculous, and Barkk appears.)
Barkk: Hi, I'm Barkk! The kwami of adoration! I'm so happy to have a new holder, you and I can play ball! All you have to say is, "Barkk, on the hunt"!
Félix: With pleasure. Barkk, on the hunt!
Barkk: Whoo!

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)/Transcript
text:
Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)/Transcript - Intro
<center>[Transformation sequence](Félix transforms into Flairmidable)</center>Pennybug: Thanks to your superpower, you can locate any object that you've touched before.Flairmidable: Oh! Uh... (touches her yo-yo) Like this?Pennybug: No! With the ball. A light touch will be enough.Flairmidable: Okay, I get it. What about the object I'm supposed to find? Where is it?Pennybug''': In the past. Burrow!(Pennybug enters the portal and Flairmidable follows.)''

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)/Transcript
text:

The other heroes are on the pavements; they are exhausted, injured, or unconscious as they look at Strikeback in fear. On the rooftops, Cat Noir continues to take risks as he lures Strikeback to his direction.)

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)/Transcript
text:

title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)/Transcript

title: Strikeback (sentimonster)
text:
Strikeback (sentimonster) - Intro
Strikeback (Réplique in the French version) was the final antagonist of Season 4 of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir, serving as the final antagonist of the episode "Risk", and the titular central antagonist of the episode "Strikeback".
It was a knight/golem-themed Sentimonster manifested by Shadow Moth from his emotions of determination/ambition in order to wreak havoc on Paris.

title: Strikeback (sentimonster)
text:
Strikeback (sentimonster) - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Strikeback had a black-armored body with spikes on its torso, arms, and angles. It had a blank chrome-like face. It was incredibly tall, almost taller than the Eiffel Tower.

title: Strikeback (sentimonster)
text:
Strikeback (sentimonster) - Personality
Strikeback is considered to be an emotionless being who sought out destruction and chaos among Paris. Its main duty, like most villains, was to get the Miraculouses of Ladybug and Cat Noir.

title: Strikeback (sentimonster)
text:
Strikeback (sentimonster) - Abilities
Strikeback was immune to any superpower used against it directly. Once a superpower was used against it, Strikeback could copy and summon the power as many times as it wanted. To do so, all it needed was to say its name "Strikeback".
Powers that it copied:
Venom: Strikeback could turn its hand into a bee stinger and immobilize its opponents by stinging them.
Clout: Strikeback could charge up its fist with energy and unleash a very powerful punch.
Multitude: Strikeback could shrink and duplicate into smaller copies of itself.
Cataclysm: Strikeback could fuse its hands with dark destructive energy and could destroy anything or anyone with one touch.
It also bore the power of super strength, easily being able to crush things with its body and lift heavy things, such as the Roue de Paris.

title: Strikeback (sentimonster)
text:
Strikeback (sentimonster) - Trivia
Strikeback bore a strong resemblance to the Destroyer from the Marvel franchise. Its body shape was also reminiscent of the Laputa Robots from the 1986 anime film Castle in the Sky.
It's also possible it was based on Sachiel from anime series Neon Genesis Evangelion.
This was the fifth Sentimonster to have its Amok within Shadow Moth's cane, following the Butterfly Sentimonster from "Mayura" and "Miracle Queen", Sentinino and Sentialec in "Optigami" and Hack-San in the episode with the same name.
It was the first Sentimonster that didn't go berserk when touching Cataclysm, given its ability to copy any power it was used on it directly or touching any superpower.
This could have been one of the most powerful Sentimonsters, the second being the Ladybug Sentimonster.
Its ability to copy powers was similar to Miraculer. However, her ability allowed her to steal Miraculous' powers and use them while Strikeback could copy powers after they were used on it directly or touching it.
After copying someone's power, it spoke "Strikeback" to use them, much like how a Miraculous wearer says a phrase to use their superpower.

title: Strikeback (sentimonster)
text:
Strikeback (sentimonster) - Trivia
It was also one of the known Sentimonsters to say its own name on its own, similar to a Pokémon saying their name.
Due to the circumstances, Strikeback was the only Sentimonster to be defeated without its amok ever being released, as the Miraculers didn't know where the amok was hidden, nor where Shadow Moth was.
Given that the Dormant Sentimonster, was in suspended animation after falling into lava, it is likely Strikeback and its clones experienced a similar fate after being teleported to the sun.
Although, unless he couldn't because the amok was out of bounds, just like with out-of-bounds akumas, it is possible that Strikeback's amok was revoked off screen, as he would first have to release it from existence before he could make a new Sentimonster.
This is further supported by the fact that when he or Mayura didn't need a sentimonster either of them previously created anymore they revoked the amok, which due to Strikeback getting sent to the sun he probably had no use for him anymore and revoked his amok.
Strikeback and its clones' fate mirrors the demise of Jubileus the Creator in Bayonetta, as both monstrosities were sent to the sun.

title: Strikeback (sentimonster)
text:
Strikeback (sentimonster) - Trivia
However, unlike Strikeback and its clones, who were sent to the sun by Pennybug with their fates left unknown, Jubileus' soul was burned to nothingness after being punched by Queen Sheba.
Strikeback greatly resemble Giganto from Sonic Frontiers.
Both are enormous gray, silver, black humanoid robots with big powerful bodies.
Coincidentally, Adrien's voice actor: Bryce Papenbrook, voices Silver the Hedgehog, Gabriel's voice actor: Keith Silverstein, voices Vector the Crocodile, Emilie's voice actor: Colleen O'Shanughnessey, voiced Miles Tails Prowler and Charmy Bee.
Strikeback's French name (Réplique) means "Replica". This is likely a reference to his power copying ability.
