title: Su-Han/History
text:
Su-Han/History - Intro
Grand Master Su-Han is a celestial guardian of the Miraculous.

title: Su-Han/History
text:
Su-Han/History - Before season 4
He was the one who trained Wang Fu to be a guardian. He called him "Whiny Chicken Leg" because he did not do his training properly like watching the Miracle Box without eating for 24 hours and doing 1,000 finger pushups. One day he trained Fu to watch the Miracle Box without eating for 24 hours. Fu used the Peacock Miraculous to create a Sentimonster as a companion to fetch him some rice balls, but due to Fu's anger towards the Miraculous mixed with his hunger, the Sentimonster ate Su-Han, the monks, and the Miracle Boxes and they became trapped inside it, leaving Fu as the last guardian.
However, 175 years and a half later, in "Feast", Su-Han, the other guardians and their temple were restored by Ladybug, after she and Cat Noir managed to defeat the titular Sentimonster. And off-screen and guided by his staff, Su-Han traveled on foot from Tibet to Paris to retrieve the Chinese Miracle Box.

title: Su-Han/History
text:
Su-Han/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Furious Fu", after arriving in Paris, Su-Han is first seen spying on Marinette at the Gare du Nord in a trashcan and at the Seine on a scooter. He later confronts Marinette in her room as he holds the Chinese Miracle Box and Barkk. He explains that he found her with the Guardians' staff which holds a compass that tracks the Miracle Boxes. He proceeds to tell Marinette that she is not a true guardian based on the appearance of the Miracle Box, as well as calls Master Fu "Whiny Chicken Leg" and insults him. As Marinette tries to defend Master Fu, Su-Han realizes that a few of the kwami's are missing, which Marinette tells him that Master Fu had lost the Butterfly Miraculous and the Peacock Miraculous but not the Cat Miraculous since she knows that Plagg has a holder. Su-Han is upset by this and reads 3 precepts that he believes Marinette and Master Fu have broken and thinks which is why they were not up for the role of being a guardian. He then orders Marinette to take him to Cat Noir.

title: Su-Han/History
text:
Su-Han/History - [[Season 4]]
Once Su-Han sees that Cat-Noir is another teenager, he becomes frustrated, introduces himself as the celestial guardian of the Mother Box and orders them to hand over their Miraculouses then tells them that he would hand them over to adults to take care of Shadow Moth, however the heroes were reluctant to do so, especially after he asked Ladybug to renounce her guardianship of the Miracle Box, which would erase her memories of the Miraculouses, and Cat Noir refused to give his Miraculous and which led to a fight between the heroes and Su-Han, which the latter having the upper hand with his Mirakung fu, but Ladybug managed to distract him with a recording in her yo-yo, enabling them to regain the Miracle Box and his tracking staff, much to his anger, which was sensed by Shadow Moth.

title: Su-Han/History
text:
Su-Han/History - [[Season 4]]
Su-Han quickly found Fu with his wife Marianne and tried to steal the former's tracking cane, which made Fu angry, but were cut short when Su-Han noticed an akuma and with a special technique repelled it away, but it akumatized Fu instead, which made Su-Han flee the scene and tracked Ladybug and Cat Noir into a soccer field, and soon were interrupted by Furious Fu who wanted to retrieve his cane and to make Su-Han apologize to him.
And after watching his former student power, Su-Han became scared and hide while criticzing Ladybug and Cat Noir their way of fighting the villain, and when asked to help them, Su-Han replied that Mirakung Fu was created to fight against rogue Miraculous holders, not villains created by their powers, and when Ladybug asked if he expected them to fix his mistake, Su-Han became ashamed and decided to fight Furious Fu, only to be defeated and frozen in place by his former student.
However after Ladybug deakumatized Fu, Su-Han apologetically returned Fu's cane to him, claiming he mistook him for someone who was gone, and Fu accepted his apology and the two bowed in respect.

title: Su-Han/History
text:
Su-Han/History - [[Season 4]]
Later in Marinette's house, Su-Han told her that including Marianne, a civilian in the fight was against the Order's rules but commented on following her instincts and that while her methods were unusual, they did prove to be effective and decided to trust the Miracle Box in her hands stating he will be watching her from afar and shall take the Miracle Box back if she fails, to which Marinette agreed. And Su-Han stated he will spend his time on Paris learning about the modern world and Marinette gave him a pair of modern shoes to replace his torn shoes.

title: Su-Han/History
text:
Su-Han/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Ephemeral", when Luka is about to give the Snake Miraculous to Ladybug, Grandmaster Su-Han appears and grabs Luka's hand to stop him from giving the Miraculous. Grandmaster Su-Han gets angry at Ladybug for giving out nine Miraculous, although she needed only Cat Noir and his cataclysm to defeat the supervillain. Ladybug protests that he was unreachable, but Su-Han counters her by saying that, what if he uses the power of Miraculous for his own good, like Shadow Moth. Ladybug asks what she should do about it, to which Su-Han replies that she should know his identity to control him. Ladybug protests that she can't do it in case Shadow Moth captures any of them. Su-Han says that he doesn't care about it and if she does not do it, he will take back the Cat Miraculous and appoint a new Cat Noir. Ladybug thinks of an idea and asks Su-Han if it is fine if he directly knows the identity of Cat Noir. To this, Grandmaster Su-Han agrees and reminds Ladybug that if she fails in that task, the Cat Miraculous will be taken away and Ladybug agrees to it. Then, Grandmaster Su-Han hops away out of the sewers.

title: Su-Han/History
text:
Su-Han/History - [[Season 4]]
Despite learning Cat Noir's identity from Ladybug, the two later get their memories erased thanks to Sass due to the catastrophes they ended up generating during the events of said episode.
In Marinette's balcony, Cosmobug detransforms into Ladybug and sees that Grandmaster Su-Han is already present and he asks if she knows the identity of Cat Noir. When Ladybug replies with no, Grandmaster Su-Han begins to berate her, but Ladybug stops him by saying that she doesn't want to know it and doesn't need to know because she is a good Guardian and says that Grandmaster Su-Han's judgment is only based on his fears instead of their actions. Grandmaster Su-Han admits that he is afraid and says that Ladybug is a guardian like no other that he had seen in his time of 100 years being a Guardian. After that, Ladybug and Grandmaster Su-Han do the "Pound It".
In "Strikeback", he saw Monarch with the other Miraculous he has stolen from Ladybug.

title: Su-Han/History
text:
Su-Han/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Multiplication", just after Monarch announced having almost all Chinese Zodiac Miraculouses in his hands, Su-Han angrily confronted Ladybug and Cat Noir for this and pointed to the former that she failed in her role as a Guardian and states his worries about Monarch using the Rabbit Miraculous to change the course of time, but the heroes quickly told him that Monarch has already tried that, and reassured him that they managed to retrieve the Rabbit Miraculous and it was currently safe in the hands of a trusted holder and that they had a lead to find the other Chinese Zodiac Miraculouses and asked for his help instead of scolding them, which ashamed Su-Han and kneeling down, he apologized to the heroes for getting distracted by the modern world instead of guiding Ladybug in her guardian role but Ladybug forgave him, reassuring him that everyone makes mistakes and asked him to help them, to which Su-Han agreed and leaped back to the Guardian’s temple to bring back reinforcements to help the duo stop Monarch.

title: Su-Han/History
text:
Su-Han/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Re-creation", it was revealed that Su-Han somehow met and trained Luka Couffaine, his father Jagged Stone and Penny Rolling in Mirakung Fu, which proved to be useful when they were attacked in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil by Monarch's Miraculized army, and despite being affected by Nighttormentor's nightmare dust, which showed him his nightmare of being unable to understand the modern world, he was encouraged by Luka to not let the nightmares overcome him and the four were surprised by the appearance of Bunnyx, who told them that Ladybug and Cat Noir needed their help in Paris and sent them there through her Burrow, where Su-Han and his students fought the army and cut short the reunion between Luka and his sister Juleka to focus in the battle. Then Su-Han became impressed when Knightowl managed to resist the nightmares. Soon he shielded himself when the Miraculized managed to Venom Lady Dragon en masse and sent her down.

title: Su-Han/History
text:
Su-Han/History - [[Season 5]]
After Gabriel Agreste recreated the universe by making his wish, Su-Han was later seen Adrien's pool party, dancing at Jagged and Luka's music. Later in Marinette's room, alongside Alya, he watched Marinette restore all the stolen Miraculouses back into their original forms (as Monarch previously turned them into rings) by using the Miraculous Spellbook, and also listened to her telling that after the wish, despite searching in the repository as Aquabug, she was unable to find the Butterfly Miraculous, but that they would be ready to face whatever happens with it, and in order to prevent all Miraculouses from being stolen by a villain again, Marinette decided to entrust them to their temporary holders in a permanent basis.
pt-br:Su-Han/História

title: Stompp/History
text:
Stompp/History - Intro
Stompp is the kwami connected to the Ox Miraculous, where he is currently with Gabriel Agreste since his Miraculous was stolen from Ladybug. Formerly, he allowed Ivan Bruel to transform into Minotaurox.

title: Stompp/History
text:
Stompp/History - Before [[season 1]]
When the concept of Determination came into existence, Stompp came into existence. Before the Miraculous jewels were created, Stompp and the other kwamis traveled all over the universe unable to interact with humans. Then, thousands of years ago, a mage created the Miraculouses. When his Miraculous was not being worn, Stompp was dormant in the Ox Miraculous, which was stored inside the Miracle Box.

title: Stompp/History
text:
Stompp/History - Season 1
As of season 1, Stompp has lain dormant in the Ox Miraculous.

title: Stompp/History
text:
Stompp/History - Season 2
As of season 2, Stompp has lain dormant in the Ox Miraculous.
In "Sandboy", Stompp, along with the other dormant kwamis in the Miracle Box, were celebrating Nooroo's birthday, commemorating his 3,500th cycle. Stompp and his fellow kwami friends were excited when Tikki and Plagg arrived. He marveled at the gift Tikki brought, thinking it was a paintbrush, and played with the other kwamis. When it came the time to find Nooroo, Stompp and the other kwamis got into position and vocalised a tune to strengthen ther connection in order to reach Nooroo. However, they inadvertently contacted his wielder instead. Seeing this as their chance to find Nooroo, Stompp encouraged the other kwamis to keep singing as a chance to find out where Hawk Moth was hiding. Upon hearing his voice, the kwamis shuddered at the thought of being his slave and prevented themselves from being discovered, in which they all cut off the connection. They realized if they contacted Nooroo's wielder, rather than Nooroo, then someone must have been akumatized and that Tikki and Plagg's wielders would be in danger.

title: Stompp/History
text:
Stompp/History - [[Season 3]]
During Season 3, Stompp was dormant in the Ox Miraculous.
In "Kwamibuster", he was activated along with the other kwamis to help Multimouse enact her plan of rescuing Tikki and Plagg. He was one of the few kwamis that ended up captured by Kwamibuster but with the help of Multinoire, Stompp was eventually set free. After Kwamibuster's defeat, Stompp and the others cheered for Marinette as their plan was a success and was returned to Miracle Box.
In "Miracle Queen", he was activated alongside Roaar, Ziggy, Daizzi, Barkk, Mullo, Orikko and Fluff by Queen Bee with the intent to use them against Ladybug and Cat Noir. After being commanded to transform her, Stompp judges that Queen Bee doesn't even know the kwamis names, and they collectively withhold their transformation phrases. Upon hearing Master Fu give his title up, he and the others protest but Master Fu does so anyway, resulting in the Miracle Box changing shape and form. After failing to escape, Queen Bee throws off their respective Miraculouses, and they, alongside their kwamis, are returned to the Miracle Box by Ladybug.

title: Stompp/History
text:
Stompp/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Truth", Stompp was accidentally released from the Miracle Box when Marinette tried to figure it out, he plays with Marinette's computer keyboard with Xuppu. During a video call on Marinette's computer, Stompp and his fellow kwamis surrounded the screen in amazement. When Marinette leaves for her date with Luka, he and the kwamis hid with the Miracle Box, but they heard the titular villain broke into Marinette's room, Ziggy panicked at the thought of being discovered by Shadow Moth again but were saved by Ladybug. After the titular villain's defeat, Stompp and the others saw that Marinette was sad about breaking up with Luka to the point of tears, Stompp didn't know exactly how to help but joined with the other kwamis in giving their new guardian a group hug.

title: Stompp/History
text:
Stompp/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Gang of Secrets", he was seen talking with some of his fellow kwamis until Marinette arrives home. Later, he and the others hear Marinette voiced her distress about being condemned to a life of secrets and lies forever because of her alter ego. When they hear someone coming, the kwamis hide in the Miracle Box and after the Gang of Secrets had been defeated. Stompp and the others look on as Marinette unveils her secret to Alya.
In "Furious Fu", hearing that Master Fu was returning, Stompp along with the other kwamis expressed dear desire to see him despite Marinette trying to keep them hidden for their safety and when Marinette voiced concerns about leaving the Miracle Box unguarded. Stompp realized if someone stayed to guard the box, the others could go but when they cheated their way out so all of them can go, they were stopped by Marinette with no choice they used the "puppy dog eyes" on her and Marinette reluctantly agreed. However, Stompp and his fellow kwamis had a hard time keeping quiet while in Marinette's bag but heard that Master Fu is doing well and become a great painter.

title: Stompp/History
text:
Stompp/History - [[Season 4]]
But returning home, Stompp realized that Su-Han had returned to reclaim the box as he was the previous guardian before Master Fu's incident and with Su-Han's strictness, he and the other kwamis sadly returned to the box. After seeing Ladybug's valiant actions against the titular villain, Su-Han realized that Master Fu's choice wasn't so bad allowing Stompp and his fellow kwamis to stay with Marinette.
In "Mega Leech", Stompp was sleeping with Pollen and Wayzz in the shelf above Marinette's bed.
In "Optigami", Stompp heard from Alya that the reason why Marinette was happy was because she received an invite to Audrey's event while in the Miracle Box; he and the others received a call from Marinette about her needing Kaalki's help in code. Noticing that the call ended, they believe she call again.
In "Sentibubbler", Stompp and his siblings were woken up when Marinette had a nightmare about Alya betraying her to Shadow Moth, Wayzz like the others were agreed that Alya was the correct choice as a Miraculous holder but was worried about Trixx due to his mischievous behavior.

title: Stompp/History
text:
Stompp/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Simpleman", Stompp like the other kwamis were hiding while Marinette was babysitting Manon and her friends upon hearing her offer to play hide and seek, he along with Xuppu and Kaalki knowing it's a bad idea shook their heads no.
In "Dearest Family", after Tikki ate the pieces of galette, Marinette brought for them, the kwamis quickly realized what she did. Stompp huddled together with the others when they realized the danger Tikki's hunger for candy can represent, despite the kwami of Creation refusal at that. When Tikki and Marinette left, the kwamis flew around in a panic. Shortly after he watched Marinette, realize that Sass warning was real and transforms to stop Tikki only to be affected by Tikki's hunger, which scared him.
Hearing a commotion downstairs, Stompp and the others were commanded to hide. After Ladybug saved her family, Stompp and the kwamis see her return with pieces of galette for them. Despite that they were still nervous regarding Tikki, until Marinette ensured them that Tikki will control herself and the kwamis ate the pieces of galette happily.

title: Stompp/History
text:
Stompp/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Kuro Neko", Stompp and the other kwamis tried to comfort Marinette after Cat Noir gave up on his Miraculous and was surprised to learn that she intended to replace him with someone who doesn't love her.
In "Penalteam", Stompp introduces himself to Ivan, who used Stompp and his Miraculous to transform into Minotaurox and help Ladybug, alongside many other heroes to defeat Penalteam.
In "Risk", Stompp and the other kwamis watched Marinette search for different ways to sabotage Adrien and Lila's journey, unaware that she was under the influence of Risk's superpowers.
In "Strikeback", Stompp and his Miraculous were given to Ivan to become Minotaurox and helped Ladybug, Cat Noir and the rest of the heroes to defeat Strikeback. Later, after Flairmidable betrayed Ladybug by stealing her yo-yo, his Miraculous, along with all the others, was given to Gabriel Agreste in exchange for the Peacock Miraculous.

title: Stompp/History
text:
Stompp/History - [[Season 5]]
During season 5, Stompp was trapped in the cage created by Monarch and located in his lair.
In "Evolution", Stompp was seen with all of Gabriel's kwamis inside the basement of his mansion. Everyone trembled in fear of their new wielder, as he discussed with his wife his greatest victory in obtaining almost all the Miraculouses from the Miracle Box and how he would use them to finally obtain Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses and wish for her to return. Afterward, Gabriel told her and the other kwamis that they would obey him from now on. After transforming into his new supervillain form, Monarch, merging the Butterfly Miraculous with the Rabbit Miraculous together, Gabriel forced them all into his cane while he used the power of time travel to enter the Burrow.

title: Stompp/History
text:
Stompp/History - [[Season 5]]
When Monarch was confronted by Ladybug, Chat Noir, and Bunnyx, he opened his cane, releasing all the kwamis, and Stompp begged Ladybug for help. Later, thanks to the powers of the Miraculouses, Monarch escaped the heroes and found himself in the period where Reverser had been akumatized. After being hit by multiple electric shocks, Monarch, left with no other choice, transformed back and returned to the present to find Nathalie Sancoeur on the Startrain, just as his past self reattached them to Nathalie's cell phone. Stompp and all the kwamis were seen surrounding Gabriel, who had become very weak due to using multiple Miraculouses, and had ordered Nathalie to feed the kwamis, calling them useless creatures. Stompp and the other kwamis were later fed pieces of bread.
After Gabriel lost the Rabbit Miraculous and returned to the present, the kwamis witnessed him regretting his actions towards his wife. Just as Gabriel dropped cellphone after Nathalie refused to help him further, the kwamis fled in fear.
In "Multiplication", after Monarch transformed back, he threatened Stompp and the other kwamis, telling them he would use their powers to retrieve Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses.

title: Stompp/History
text:
Stompp/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Destruction", Stompp and the other kwamis were forced by Gabriel to reveal their guardian's identity. Since Ladybug had never given up on them, they were unable to pronounce her true name. With this knowledge, Gabriel forced them to tell him where Ladybug lived, but they instead gave him clues since they didn't know what an address was. After the battle, Gabriel used a mechanical laser to destroy Stompp's Miraculous and then reforged it so he could transfer its power to any akumatized villain he wished or to himself through his specially created cage.
In "Jubilation", while trapped in his cage, Stompp witnessed Gabriel send a megakuma through the Horse Miraculous's portal to akumatize Denis into Darker Owl. He later witnessed him take Daizzi's power and transfer it to Darker Owl.
In "Illusion", Stompp witnessed Monarch take the powers of Trixx, Pollen, Mullo, and Orikko to carry out his plan to divert the Resistance suspicions about him and the Alliance rings.
In "Determination", while trapped in his cage, Stompp witnessed Gabriel send a megakuma through the Horse Miraculous's portal to akumatize Véronique into Manipula. Her power was later transferred to Manipula.

title: Stompp/History
text:
Stompp/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Passion", although he didn't physically appear, Stompp witnessed Gabriel send a megakuma through the Horse Miraculous's portal to akumatize Nathalie into Safari. He later witnessed him take Ziggy's power and transfer it to Safari.
In "Reunion", while trapped in his cage, Stompp witnessed Gabriel send a megakuma through the Horse Miraculous's portal to akumatize Jalil into Pharaoh. He later witnessed him take Wayzz's power and transfer it to Pharaoh.
In "Elation", although he didn't physically appear, Stompp witnessed Gabriel send a megakuma through the Horse Miraculous's portal to akumatize André into Glaciator. He later witnessed him take Roaar's power and transfer it to Glaciator.
In "Transmission", although he didn't physically appear, Stompp witnessed Gabriel send a megakuma through the Horse Miraculous's portal to akumatize his son. His power was later transferred to Kikou.
In "Deflagration", Stompp was shocked when Gabriel revealed to him and the other kwamis that he knew the secret identities of Scarabella and Kitty Noire. Later, his power was used by Gabriel to carry out his plan to steal the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses from Alya and Zoé.

title: Stompp/History
text:
Stompp/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Perfection", although he didn't physically appear, Stompp witnessed Gabriel send a megakuma through the Horse Miraculous's portal to akumatize Kagami into Ryukomori. He later witnessed him take Longg's power and transfer it to Ryukomori.
In "Migration", while trapped in his cage, Stompp witnessed Gabriel send a megakuma through the Horse Miraculous's portal to akumatize Luka. He later witnessed him transfer Kaalki's power to Gold Record.
In "Derision", while trapped in his cage, Stompp witnessed Gabriel send a megakuma through the Horse Miraculous's portal to akumatize Kim into Dark Humor. He later witnessed him take Xuppu's power and transfer it to Dark Humor.
In "Intuition", while trapped in his cage, Stompp saw Gabriel pass out on the floor, unaware that he had used Sass's Second Chance multiple times.
In "Protection", while trapped in his cage, Stompp saw Gabriel send a megakuma through the Horse Miraculous's portal to akumatize Kagami into Riposte Prime. He later saw him take Wayzz's power and transfer it to Riposte Prime.

title: Stompp/History
text:
Stompp/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Adoration", while trapped in his cage, Stompp saw Gabriel send a megakuma through the Horse Miraculous's portal to akumatize Sabrina into Vanisher. He later saw him take Barkk's power and transfer it to Vanisher.
In "Pretension", Gabriel attempted to use the power of Pollen and his fellow kwamis to cure Cat Noir's Cataclysm using a machine created by Tomoe's industries. He was also seen sending a megakuma through the Horse Miraculous's portal to akumatize Tomoe into Matagi Iozen. Later, he was seen taking the powers of Pollen, Orikko, Mullo, Kaalki, and Roaar and transferring them to Matagi Gozen.
In "Revelation", while trapped in his cage, Stompp saw Gabriel hesitate to akumatize Lila, but after realizing that the anger wasn't directed at him, Stompp watched as Gabriel sent a megakuma through the Horse Miraculous's portal to akumatize Lila into Hoaxer. He later watched as Gabriel took Trixx's power and transferred it to Hoaxer.

title: Stompp/History
text:
Stompp/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Confrontation", while trapped in his cage, Stompp witnessed Gabriel send a megakuma through the Horse Miraculous's portal to akumatize Juleka into Reflekta. He later witnessed him take Rooar's power and transfer it to Reflekta. He also witnessed him send a megakuma to akumatize Denis, but saw him complain that the megakuma was taking too long to break his Magical Charm. Later, he witnessed him transform back, remove his glove, and reveal his cataclysmic hand, stating that he had been defeated by a group of children and that, with or without Magical Charms, he wasn't finished yet.
In "Action", while trapped in his cage, Stompp witnessed Gabriel transform into Monarch and send a megakuma through the Horse Miraculous's portal to akumatize Bertrand into Plastic King. He later saw him take Pollen's power and transfer it to King of Plastic.

title: Stompp/History
text:
Stompp/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Collusion", while trapped in his cage, Stompp witnessed Gabriel send a megakuma through the Horse Miraculous's portal to akumatize Caline into Miss Sans-Culotte. He watched Gabriel transform back as his Alliance ring reminded him that he had a meeting with Tomoe and André in ten minutes. Some time later, he saw him send another megakuma to akumatize Caline into Miss Sans-Culotte. He then witnessed him take Daizzi's power and transfer it to Miss Sans-Culotte.
In "Revolution", while trapped in his cage, Stompp witnessed Gabriel call Tomoe with his Alliance ring and tell her that Chloé was causing chaos and that Ladybug and Cat Noir would have no choice but to intervene. Gabriel then used his power to transfer it to Queen Mayor's police robots.
In "Representation", while trapped in his cage, Stompp witnessed Gabriel create a megakuma to akumatize into Nightormentor and find his son.

title: Stompp/History
text:
Stompp/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Conformation", while trapped in his cage, Stompp witnessed him speak to Tomoe and begin the Operation: Perfect Alliance. He also saw him reakumatized into Nightormentor and transfer Mullo, Orikko, and Kaalki's powers to himself. She also saw Gabriel watching the cameras in Adrien's room at the Tsurugi Labs in London. She saw Tomoe and Gabriel's plan unfold. She later heard the alarm sound in Gabriel's lair, and he went to check on her, then returned to his evil plans. Finally, she saw Gabriel transform to chase Ladybug, then take his power to confront Ladybug in her mansion.
In "Re-creation", Stompp and the other Kwamis were saved from Monarch's clutches by Ladybug, and his Miraculous returned to its original form. He was later reunited with Ivan.

title: Stompp/History
text:
Stompp/History - [[Miraculous World]]
In "Miraculous Paris", when Gabriel began removing the Miraculouses and placing them on the table, all the kwamis, including Stompp, huddled together in fear. Later, Stompp witnessed him send a megakuma to akumatize Shadybug and Claw Noir. He also witnessed him granting himself the power of traveling between universes with Subimation and failing several times.
In "Miraculous London", when Bug Noire arrived to rescue the kwamis from the cage with Nathalie, Pollen was happy when she saw her and hugged her when she freed her. Later, when Marinette began repairing the Miraculous and explained that they would stay with their carriers, Pollen hugged her along with the other kwamis.

In "El Toro De Piedra",

title: Sun Wukong
text:
Sun Wukong - Intro
(孫悟空 [Traditional Chinese] / 孙悟空 [Simplified Chinese] Wukong Sun western order.), also known as the Monkey King, is a mythological figure from legends in China. He was a past Miraculous holder, wielding the Monkey Miraculous and transforming into a monkey-themed superhero when Xuppu inhabited it.

title: Sun Wukong
text:
Sun Wukong - Abilities
If this past Monkey Miraculous holder had the same powers as the current Monkey (Kim), he had enhanced abilities and the superpower Uproar, and the Ruyi Jingu Bang as a tool.

title: Sun Wukong
text:
Sun Wukong - History
In "Miraculous Shanghai", an action figure of Sun Wukong was being sold in Shanghai, China alongside other superheroes.

title: Sun Wukong
text:
Sun Wukong - Trivia
When asked if Sun Wukong was a former Monkey Miraculous holder, Thomas Astruc responded, "Most certainly".
However, it is unknown if Zhu Bajie, a character from the same story, was a Pig Miraculous holder.
hóu wáng (猴王) means "monkey king" in Chinese.
Sun (孫) means "monkey" (in this context), Wu (悟) means "awakened, and Kong (空) means "space".
In Chinese Mythology, Sun Wukong obtained his supernatural powers through Taoist practices. However, it seems that this Sun Wukong had gotten his powers from the Monkey Miraculous.
He is the second person of Chinese origins to wield the Monkey Miraculous, succeeding Hóu Zi.

title: Syren
text:
Syren - Intro
"" is a season 2 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. According to the series' production order, it is the 14th episode of season 2, as well as the 40th episode of the series, overall.

title: Syren
text:
Syren - Synopsis
When her crush, Kim, goes on a movie date with someone else, talented swimmer Ondine gets akumatized into Syren, who tries to submerge Paris.
Disney+
Ladybug and Cat Noir face Syren in a flooded Paris.

title: Syren
text:
Syren - Plot
Nadja Chamack reports on several escaped zoo animals rampaging across Paris, while Ladybug, Cat Noir, and their new friend Rena Rouge try to recapture them. Meanwhile, Ondine and Kim are at the swimming pool. Kim wonders what it's like to be a superhero, such as the powers, the secrets and the costumes a superhero would be wearing. Ondine takes out a note and puts it in the capsule of her bracelet. She then turns to Kim and asks if he wants to know her secret, before throwing the bracelet in the water.
Kim dives in, retrieves the bracelet, and reads the note inside, which says that Ondine has a huge crush on a boy who has no idea about it. Oblivious, Kim says that the boy is clueless. He then puts his own note in her bracelet and throws it in the water for Ondine. She reads the note that says Kim can stick his big toe in his ear. Ondine decides to state outright who she's crushing on in her next note. Just as Kim is about to open the note, his watch alerts him that he's going to be late for the movies. Kim tells Ondine that he asked Chloé to go to the movie with him, and dashes off. Ondine is left on the poolside, lamenting on how Kim was the one she had a crush on.

title: Syren
text:
Syren - Plot
Hawk Moth's lair opens up as Hawk Moth senses Ondine's sadness. He remarks on how many times the Little Mermaid has tried to tell "her prince" how she feels, only to be dismissed, before he creates an akuma and sends it to akumatize her.
Meanwhile, Cat Noir is being chased by a pair of black panthers, and he jokingly asks them if they would really eat one of their cousins. Rena Rouge then uses her Mirage power to create a series of steak illusions. The panthers fall for the mirages, and are drawn into and trapped in the back of a van. Cat Noir prepares to fist-bump Ladybug and Rena Rouge, but they have to leave because Rena Rouge is about to transform back. Upset, Cat Noir asks why Ladybug is allowed to know who Rena Rouge really is when he isn't. Ladybug explains that she must return her Miraculous. Cat Noir asks if his role is to be left in the dark about Ladybug's secrets, and Ladybug says she will talk to "him" about it. Cat Noir asks who "him" is, but Ladybug says that must wait until the time is right, and leaves with Rena Rouge. Frustrated, Cat Noir declares that he hates secrets.

title: Syren
text:
Syren - Plot
Rena Rouge soon detransforms back into Alya, and hands her Miraculous back to Ladybug. Alya offers to team up with Ladybug again, before her phone alerts her that she's late to the movies, and she runs off. Ladybug turns back into Marinette and begins running in the opposite direction from Alya. Tikki advises her to take Alya's route in order to get to the movie, but Marinette opts to miss the trailers again. Overhead, the akuma flies into the swimming pool and attaches itself to Ondine's bracelet. Hawk Moth offers Ondine the power to turn Paris into an underwater kingdom for her and her prince in exchange for the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses. Ondine accepts the deal and turns into Syren, whose tears then fall into the pool, making it start to overflow.

title: Syren
text:
Syren - Plot
Kim runs up to the cinema, where Max and Markov are waiting for him. Kim asks if Chloé came, but Max jokingly asks if he really thought she would come see Mecha Monkey vs. Cyber Sharks 3. Alya runs up to the two boys and asks if Marinette is late too, which Max confirms. Alya stands outside to wait for Marinette, while Max, Kim and Markov enter the theater, Max promising to save seats for the girls. Meanwhile, water floods out of the swimming pool building.

title: Syren
text:
Syren - Plot
Marinette returns the Fox Miraculous to Master Fu at his massage shop, and Master Fu asks what's troubling her. As they enter the next room, Fu prohibits Tikki and Wayzz from following, as kwamis aren't allowed to know the recipes that can modify their powers, in case they are captured like Nooroo. In the next room, Marinette explains that Cat Noir is asking more questions and is tired of being left in the dark, but Fu insists that they must wait for the right time to tell him the truth, comparing it to putting noodles in boiling water. He then shows that he is unlocking the recipes to give her and Cat Noir new powers; however, he is unable to figure out what ingredient the "Tear of Joy" is. Thinking the Tear could be honeydew, Fu adds it to his brew, and believes he has unlocked underwater powers. As this happens, people beside the Seine run away as it begins to overflow.

title: Syren
text:
Syren - Plot
At the Agreste mansion, Adrien is in his room, playing with Cat Noir and Ladybug action figures. Adrien expresses his frustration with Ladybug not trusting him through the figures. Adrien turns to Plagg and asks if he knows what Ladybug is hiding from him, but Plagg refuses to tell. Adrien then begins offering to order Plagg different types of cheese if he tells the truth.
Back at the massage shop, Fu feeds the potion to Wayzz, who believes it to be the right one. Excited, Fu tries to invoke a transformation in Wayzz, but nothing happens, and Wayzz suggests adding a little more salt. Marinette gets a call from Alya, and rushes off to the cinema, leaving Fu and Wayzz.

title: Syren
text:
Syren - Plot
Marinette arrives at the cinema and enters with Alya, unaware of the water running through the streets behind them. Rose, Nino and Juleka wave Alya and Marinette down, and they shuffle into their seats. As the movie starts, Marinette notices people running away in fear, and realizes that the cinema is flooding with water. Outside the cinema, water rushes through the streets and floods them. Back in Adrien's room, Adrien is still trying to bribe Plagg when he notices that the room is filling with water. He transforms into Cat Noir.
Marinette runs up to the roof of the building where the others are looking to see that all of Paris has been flooded. Markov claims that his circuits are sensitive to water. Unconcerned, Kim jumps in the water and says he can teach Markov how to swim. A fin swims towards Kim, and Syren jumps from the water, and takes him under. While her friends try to look for Kim, Marinette gets into the water in a recycling bin and paddles away using a shovel, claiming she is going to get help. Cynically, Alix asks if this means they're saved.

title: Syren
text:
Syren - Plot
Underwater, Syren grasps Kim and creates an air bubble for him to breathe in. Marinette transforms and searches for Kim underwater. Ladybug soon spots him with Syren, who is showing Kim around the submerged Paris, much to his amazement. Ladybug latches onto Kim with her yo-yo, but Syren tries to pull him back. Hawk Moth boasts that every new environment brings a new set of rules, and Ladybug can't win because she can't breathe underwater. Cat Noir is then seen leaping across the rooftops above the water, when he sees Ladybug flying through the air, having been knocked out of the water by Syren. Cat Noir saves Ladybug, and asks if there's a chance she can get them a submarine. Ladybug uses her Lucky Charm, and receives a pot. Realizing the pot indicates Master Fu, Ladybug says she has to leave. Cat Noir is frustrated at Ladybug not telling him where she's going, despite them being a team, but Ladybug insists it isn't easy for her, either. She then zips away, while Cat Noir is left behind, further frustrated.

title: Syren
text:
Syren - Plot
Ladybug detransforms and finds Master Fu on the roof of his building. Marinette tells Fu that she and Cat Noir can't beat Syren underwater, which he knows, although he can't find the right blend that could give them underwater powers, believing he has failed them. Marinette suggests using a real tear of joy in the recipe, and tells Master Fu a series of jokes, making him shed a tear in laughter. Marinette takes the tear and drops it into the pot, which releases a burst of green energy. Excited, Fu says Marinette has found the final ingredient. Fu immediately feeds the potion to Tikki, who, on Marinette's command, powers up into Aqua Tikki. Marinette then transforms into a new version of Ladybug with aquatic powers. Before leaving, Ladybug turns to Fu and tells him its time to "put the noodles in the boiling water", which he agrees to.

title: Syren
text:
Syren - Plot
Meanwhile, fed up with waiting, Cat Noir transforms back into Adrien and threatens to quit being Cat Noir if Plagg doesn't tell him what Ladybug has been hiding. Plagg says that Adrien mustn't do that, but Adrien insists no one will know or care if he does. Plagg says he would care, although Adrien dismisses this as being because there will be no one to give him Camembert. Plagg states that he's sure there will be another Cat Noir to feed him cheese, but they won't be Adrien. Adrien cheers up because of this, just before Master Fu, addressing him as Cat Noir, appears beside him. Adrien recalls how he had helped Master Fu on the first day of school, and Fu hands him a vial of the aqua-power potion, telling him he must help Ladybug. Plagg moans about how he hates transforming.
Inside the submerged swimming pool facility, Kim, inside a giant bubble, remarks that he loves what Syren has done to the place.
She says that the pool is where she had tried to pour her heart out to Kim many times, and, after seeing her bracelet, he realizes Syren is actually Ondine.
Syren says that she can turn Kim into a merman with a kiss, so they can rule their underwater kingdom together forever.

title: Syren
text:
Syren - Plot
Before this happens, Kim asks if that means he'll never get to see Mecha Monkey vs.
Cyber Sharks 3, confusing Syren.
Ladybug swims in and tells Kim he will get to see the movie, and Cat Noir joins her.
Hawk Moth confirms his suspicions of the Miraculouses possessing hidden powers, and tells Syren to take them before Ladybug and Cat Noir steal Kim away from her.
The heroes begin to fight Syren using their new abilities.
Kim tells Ladybug how cool their new outfits are, and she asks what got his friend so worked up.
Kim explains that he and Ondine were playing a game of Secrets in which she tried to tell him that he was the boy she liked, but he didn't realize it at the time.
Realizing the bracelet must be where the akuma is hidden, Ladybug uses her Aqua Lucky Charm and summons a car key.

title: Syren
text:
Syren - Plot
Ladybug gives Kim her yo-yo to breathe through, and he escapes with her while Syren and Cat Noir are fighting. Outraged, Syren pursues them and demands that Ladybug tell her where Kim is, unaware he is on a nearby roof above them. Syren chases after Ladybug through several floating cars, only to be trapped inside one by Cat Noir when he strikes the car with his staff, setting off its airbag, and pinning her inside. Ladybug locks Syren inside the car with the key, and Cat Noir fishes the car out of the water using her yo-yo string and his staff. Ladybug unlocks the car and breaks the bracelet, releasing the akuma, which she then purifies. She throws the key in the air, returning the city to normal and de-akumatizing Syren into Ondine. Cat Noir thanks Ladybug for keeping her promise, and the two of them fist-bump.

title: Syren
text:
Syren - Plot
At the massage shop, Fu gives Marinette seven augmented-power blends in different vials, which he tells her to keep with her at all times. Marinette thinks this is not very practical, and Fu says that only the ingredients matter, and that she can put them in anything, which gives her an idea. Marinette bakes some macarons at her house, but when Tom tries to eat one, she says she'll taste them first. Since Marinette made the macarons Tom assumes that they would taste great if eaten.  In Marinette's room, Tikki says she loves the idea of the magical macarons as Marinette places them in boxes. Meanwhile, at the pool, Kim hands Ondine a bracelet, asking if she wants to play a game of Secrets. Ondine opens the bracelet and reads the note, which asks her if she wants to go to the movies.

title: Syren
text:
Syren - Plot
At the Agreste mansion, Gabriel and Nathalie are inside Gabriel's atelier when they hear the doorbell. Gabriel uses a camera to see who is there, and finds Master Fu. Fu, using the name Mr. Chan, claims to be a substitute for Adrien's Chinese tutor. Adrien is practicing his Chinese when Nathalie brings Fu into his room, much to his confusion. Plagg introduces Adrien to Master Fu as the last Guardian of the Miraculous.
Gabriel enters his lair and interrogates Nooroo about how Ladybug and Cat Noir obtained their new powers, as well as how he might acquire them. Nooroo informs him that kwamis do not know the recipes for the powers. Gabriel deduces that the recipes must be contained within the Miraculous spellbook and inquires if Nooroo is able to read it. Nooroo explains that only a Guardian can read the recipes and admits that he knows nothing more. Determined, Gabriel declares that he will find the Guardian, no matter where he is. Meanwhile, Fu hands Adrien a box of cheeses infused with the various potions. Plagg once again complains that he hates transforming just before the end card appears.

title: Syren
text:
Syren - Plot Developments
Following "Sapotis", Rena Rouge does return to assist Ladybug and Cat Noir during difficult missions; however, she still has to give back the Fox Miraculous afterward.
According to Master Fu, when a kwami consume a Miraculous potion, the holder gains elemental abilities debuting the underwater power-ups, with indications of six other types. Marinette hints at the blue one having "icy" properties, a foreshadowing to "Frozer".
In the beginning of the episode, Kim mentions that he wants to be a hero, which comes true when he is chosen to wear the Monkey Miraculous becoming King Monkey by Master Fu in "Party Crasher".
Since Wayzz remembers using the aqua potion with a previous Miraculous holder at some point in the past it's unknown if it was his first owner or not.
Interestingly, his comment about the potion perhaps needing more salt is an indication that the last ingredient was a tear, since tears are salty.

title: Syren
text:
Syren - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in Spain on Disney Channel.
This episode was first revealed in a TV guide from the UK.
Originally it was supposed to air on April 21, 2018, in the UK, but didn't due to a sudden change of schedule. It was later rescheduled for May 12, 2018.
This episode marks the second time Adrien meets Master Fu. Adrien learns of Fu's identity as the Guardian of the Miraculouses and the one who gave Adrien's Miraculous to him.
When Master Fu first addresses him as Cat Noir, a flashback scene from "Ladybug and Cat Noir" is shown.
This is the first episode that features a Lucky Charm item without the ladybug pattern.
This episode also has Syren as the second villain who refers to their love for their prince, which was also seen in "Princess Fragrance".
In the end card of the episode, Ladybug's face in the French dub is different than the face in all other versions of the episode.
In the French dub, the transformation music for Ladybug's in aqua transformation doesn't change.

title: Syren
text:
Syren - Trivia
When Aquabug uses her Lucky Charm, it's referred to as "Aqua Lucky Charm". However, in future episodes, such as "Frozer" and "Gang of Secrets", the powers are referred to without the name of the power-up used.
References
The scene where Hawk Moth talks to Syren while explaining his powers given to her is reused from the episode "Pixelator", however with just a minor addition of the Ladybug and Cat Miraculous icons implemented. The mismatch between the audio and the visual animation is noticeable when watching Hawk Moth's lip movements.
This episode features the first time Adrien considers quitting being Cat Noir following "Stoneheart" when Marinette wanted to quit being Ladybug.
This is the third episode in which Cat Noir doesn't invoke his Cataclysm, following "Darkblade" and "The Mime".
This episode reveals that the zoo has another panther since the one in "Animan" and "The Puppeteer".
Ondine, like Kim in "Dark Cupid", was akumatized because the person she liked didn't reciprocate her feelings for them at first.
Allusions
The episode title, Syren, is derived from the word "Siren".

title: Syren
text:
Syren - Trivia
When Hawk Moth says "Poor little mermaid", it is a reference to the Disney movie franchise, "The Little Mermaid".
According to Adrien, Fourme de Montbrison cheese is the oldest in the world but Conciato Romano is actually oldest.
Errors
Just before Rena Rouge transforms back, her skin tone is lighter than it's supposed to be.
When Kim first arrives at the movies, he's wearing his swimming cap without the goggles, but the goggles appear on the cap in the shot where he pulls the cap off.
Outside the movie theater, the sign on the front that says Le Sorbonne is absent when Max points at the movie poster.
The Bee Miraculous is shown differently from how it's supposed to be as shown in "Sapotis".
Because the scene where Tikki enters the Ladybug Miraculous is reused from the regular transformation sequence, she is seen in her normal form instead of her aquatic form.
When Marinette extends her arm during the transformation sequence, her regular pigtails can be seen under her aqua form's pigtails.
La Trappe d'Échourgnac has a brown rind, not an orange one as Adrien claims.
When Ladybug has her aquatic outfit, a few of the spots on her suit are missing in some shots.

title: Syren
text:

When Cat Noir first arrives in his aquatic form, and when he positions himself right next to Ladybug, the scales and spots on Ladybug's mask are missing.
This error happens again when Ladybug is using her Miraculous Ladybug power.
When Cat Noir's making a fish face at Syren, the ring on his finger is green instead of black.
When Ladybug opens her yo-yo to capture the akuma, she is wearing her normal outfit for that shot instead of her aquatic outfit.
The light inside the yo-yo also disappears for a brief moment.
Similarly, in the shot where Ladybug and Cat Noir fist-bump, Cat Noir is in his regular outfit instead of his aquatic one.
When Marinette finishes making the mini macaroons, her earrings are miscolored white.
When Gabriel is talking to Nooroo in Hawk Moth's lair, the room is devoid of butterflies.
Syren's eyelashes are missing when she shows her bracelet to Kim, after which they reappear.
During the Aqua Lucky Charm, when the ladybugs spiral out of Ladybug's yo-yo, they aren't lined up correctly with the Yo-yo.
In one shot Syren is shown to have feet.

When Ladybug de-evilizes the akuma, her earrings disappear and the background is a bit darker than usual, as well as the yo-yo string in some shots.
Ladybug's earrings also disappear in her aqua outfit for the rest of the transformation sequence.
When Ladybug captures the akuma and bring it back out of her yoyo as a normal butterfly, the light in her yoyo is missing.
Plagg is shown to like the stench of Adrien's sock despite hating the smell of his shoe in the Season 1 episode, "Horrificator".
Adrien had dolls of Ladybug and Chat Noir, he plays with them, he puts them down and then in the next shot they are missing.

title: Syren/Transcript
text:
Syren/Transcript - Intro
[ Theme song ]
Nadja: (news report) Nadja Chamack, live above Paris. Escaped animals are invading the city! But Ladybug, Cat Noir and their new friend, Rena Rouge, are already on the spot.
Lifeguard: I'm sure they'll get the animals back in the zoo super fast.
Kim: Right, sir. They are the best! (groans) I wish I could be a superhero. The powers. The secrets. The costume. That would be awesome, right?
Ondine: (laughs) Yeah, sure.
Kim: How can I become one? You think there's some kind of superhero school, or something? Or maybe more like some super secret training facility?
(Ondine puts a piece of paper in her swimming bracelet.)
Ondine: You wanna know my secret?
Kim: Yeah, totally! I love this game. (Ondine throws her swimming bracelet into the pool. Kim dives in to fetch it, then reads its paper) "I have a serious crush on this boy, but he has no idea." (Ondine blushes. Kim laughs.) That boy's clueless. (gets out of the pool) Okay, now it's my turn.
(Kim throws the swimming bracelet into the pool. Ondine dives in after it.)
Ondine: (reads paper) "I can stick my big toe inside my ear"...?
(Kim demonstrates. Ondine laughs. Kim gives her the notebook and pen with his feet.)

title: Syren/Transcript
text:
Syren/Transcript - Intro
Ondine: (to herself) Let's stop beating about the bush.
(Ondine notes something down and throws the bracelet into the pool. Kim dives in, retrieves it, and starts to unfold the paper, but then his watch alarm goes off.)
Kim: Ah! The movie! I totally forgot! (gets out of the pool)
Ondine: But we haven't finished yet!
Kim: I've really gotta split. I asked Chloé to come, remember? The girl I told you about in my class? Next time, I promise!
(Kim leaves. Ondine reaches out toward him, then picks up the paper and opens it, revealing a heart with Kim's name on it, and "Je t'aime" written below, with more hearts.)
Ondine: (sadly, to herself) The boy I'm crushing on is...you.
Hawk Moth: Poor Little Mermaid. How many times have you tried to tell your Prince how you feel? And how many times has he dismissed you? (charges an akuma with dark energy) Fly away, my little akuma, and evilize her!
(The akuma flies into Paris.)
Cat Noir: Come on, guys, you wouldn't eat one of your cousins, would ya?
(Rena Rouge jumps along roofs to a vantage point above the street.)
Rena Rouge: (plays flute) Mirage! (throws energy ball)(Large cuts of meat appear on the street in front of the panthers.)

title: Syren/Transcript
text:
Syren/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: How about some tasty chops, instead? (leaps away with his staff)
(One of the panthers steps on a piece of meat, causing it to disappear. It and the other panther step on more of them, following a trail of vanishing meat until it leads them into the back of a van. Ladybug shuts the van doors, trapping the panthers inside. Civilians cheer Ladybug, Cat Noir and Rena Rouge standing on the edge of a roof.)
Cat Noir: (holds up fist) Pound i— (looks back at Ladybug and Rena Rouge running away) Hey, where're you going?
Ladybug: Rena's about to transform back.
Cat Noir: So you're allowed to know her true identity, but I'm not?
Ladybug: Because I have to get her Miraculous back.
Cat Noir: So what's my role, then? The guy who's always left in the dark? What else are you hiding from me?
Rena Rouge: (Miraculous flashes and she points at it) We really gotta jam.
Ladybug: (still to Cat Noir) Okay, I'll talk to him about it.
Cat Noir: Him? Who's him?
Ladybug: Uh...when the time is right, Cat Noir, I promise. (departs with Rena Rouge)
Cat Noir: (to himself) I hate secrets.

title: Syren/Transcript
text:
Syren/Transcript - Intro
(Rena Rouge and Ladybug jump down to the ground behind a building. Rena Rouge detransforms and Alya hands Ladybug the Fox Miraculous in its box.)
Alya: We can do this again whenever you want, Lady— (phone rings) Oh! The movie! (runs off, waving back) Later!
Ladybug: Spots off. (detransforms and runs in a different direction)
Tikki: Uh, if you want to get to that movie on time too, you better go the way Alya went.
Marinette: Sorry, Tikki; we'll just have to miss the trailers again.
(The akuma enters the swimming bracelet of the tearful Ondine.)
Hawk Moth: Syren, I am Hawk Moth. I'm giving you the power to turn Paris into your own underwater kingdom, for you and your prince. In return, you must bring me Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous.
Ondine: May they all sink under my sorrow.
(She transforms into Syren, and stands up. Her tears now falling into the pool trigger the water to rise up and overflow the pool.)
Max: (to Kim) You're 3 minutes and 37 seconds late; everybody's already inside.
Kim: Is Chloé here?
Max: (laughs) Chloé watching Mecha Monkey vs. Cyber Shark 3? I think your swimming cap's on too tight, Kim.
(Kim takes off his swimming cap, and hands it to Max.)

title: Syren/Transcript
text:
Syren/Transcript - Intro
Alya: (runs up, panting) Ah, let me guess — (takes two tickets from Max) Marinette hasn't arrived yet?
Max: True to form. We'll save you both a seat. (follows Kim into the theater along with his robot friend, Markov.)
Alya: (to herself) Marinette, Marinette, Marinette.
(Back outside the swimming pool, people scream and run when water spills out under the doors.)
Master Fu: Perfect. Now come and tell me what's bothering you, Marinette.
Marinette: Huh? How do you...?
Master Fu: (laughs and turns to Wayzz and Tikki) Hold on. You both stay here.
Wayzz and Tikki: Oh, Master, please!
Master Fu: Kwamis must never know the recipe that can modify their powers. Ever!
Marinette: Modify their powers?
Master Fu: Imagine what would happen if one of you were captured by a villain, just like Hawk Moth's kwami, Nooroo.
Wayzz and Tikki: (scared) Ohh! (both fly away and into the shop's mattress)
Master Fu: So, what's on your mind, Marinette?
Marinette: Master Fu, Cat Noir is asking more and more questions. He's tired of being left in the dark.
Master Fu: Tell me, Marinette; do you put the noodles in the water before the water boils?
Marinette: Uh, no.

title: Syren/Transcript
text:
Syren/Transcript - Intro
Master Fu: Exactly. That's because there's a right time for everything. (pours some tea and hands a cup to Marinette)
Marinette: Uh, what are you cooking exactly?
Master Fu: When fed with a specific blend of ingredients, the kwamis can grant special power. Each power's specific mix is listed here, encoded in the Grimoire. I've deciphered most of the ingredients; for example, to trigger aquatic powers you need a branch from the dragon king's garden — that's seaweed; then secret kept in a shell — that's an oyster pearl. But the last one still puzzles me: a tear of joy. I can't figure it out, and it's required for almost every blend. Oh! Maybe it could be some dancing ant honeydew. (puts drops from a bottle into his potion with an eyedropper, producing a small blast) I think I may have finally got the right mix. (Marinette smiles.)
(Civilians scream and run away as the river starts to overflow.)
Adrien: (imitating Ladybug) Hey, Cat Noir, do you trust me? (as himself) Sure, Ladybug; do you trust me, too? (as Ladybug) Are you kidding? I will never trust you! Ha ha ha ha! (normally, to Plagg) You must know what Ladybug's hiding from me, Plagg.

title: Syren/Transcript
text:
Syren/Transcript - Intro
Plagg: I'm just a kwami, Adrien, and we kwamis have a right to remain silent.
Adrien: Pity. (gets out his phone) Just when I was about to order you some very tasty cheese. Have you ever sampled La Trappe d'Échourgnac? It says here it tastes like walnuts.
Plagg: (swallows some Camembert, crosses his arms and turns away) I can't be swayed, sorry!
(Plagg starts shaking, trying to resist the temptation)
Adrien: Did you know about the Fourme de Montbrison? Apparently, it's the oldest cheese in the world.
Plagg: (nervously) You don't say...!
(Adrien begins swaying his phone in a circular motion; Plagg follows)
Adrien: Yes... and do you know why its rind is orange? Because they age it on special boards of spruce wood.
Plagg: (snaps out of his trance and flies into the bathroom) There's only one thing in this world that smells as good as cheese!
(Plagg sniffs heavily from one of Adrien's dirty socks in a laundry basket. Suddenly, Adrien appears and talks to Plagg into the bathroom while he sniffs the socks.)
Adrien: Which one do you prefer, the Tomme de Bouche, or the Saintignon? (Plagg screams.)
(Wayzz drinks some of the power blend.)

title: Syren/Transcript
text:
Syren/Transcript - Intro
Wayzz: Mmmm, there's a slight flavor to it. Yes, I remember it being a lot like this.
Master Fu: Ha! I knew it.
[Transformation Sequence]Master Fu: (raises his Turtle Bracelet hand)  Wayzz, power up!
(Wayzz stiffens momentarily, then relaxes again, unchanged.)
Wayzz: A little more salt, maybe?
Master Fu: Oh, failed again.
(Marinette's phone rings.)
Marinette: Hey Alya...yeah, what's up? The movie? Oh, uh, of course I didn't forget. I'm almost there. (runs out the door) Sorry, Master. Good luck finding the secret ingredient.
(Master Fu sighs disappointedly.)
Marinette: (runs up, panting) Coming! Sorry, I was—
Alya: No time to explain. Come on!
(She and Marinette run inside the theater. Floodwater approaches the theater.)
Rose: (waving from her seat) Hi!
Nino: Hey!
Marinette: (shuffling into her seat) Sorry...sorry...sorry.
(Movie starts to play. People in the frontmost row get up and run out, followed by people in rows succeedingly further back doing the same.)
Marinette: What's going on?

title: Syren/Transcript
text:
Syren/Transcript - Intro
(Water rushes under the seats where Marinette is sitting. She, Alya, Nino, Max, Kim, and others in that row lift their feet onto their seats. Out in the streets, people scream as flooding water rages. Water also rushes into the theater.)
Alya: Okay, who left the faucet running?
Marinette: The stairs! Quick!
Fleeing girl: Hurry up!
Marinette: (on the stairs) Everyone, up on the roof!
(People run upstairs toward the roof; water floods the stairway right behind them.)
Plagg: (continuously, flying around inside Adrien's sock, trying to drown out Adrien while he follows Plagg around the room)
Adrien: Tome de Quraish with truffles; raw milk Camembert, aged on vine leaves marinated in Emmental juice.
(Adrien stops when he sees water flooding the floor of his room.)
Plagg: Looks like your whole cheese strategy will have to tread water.
Adrien: (tersely) Don't worry, this isn't over.
[ Transformation Sequence ]Adrien: Plagg, claws out! (Adrien transforms into Cat Noir.)
Markov: (Marinette gasps.) My circuits are sensitive to water.

title: Syren/Transcript
text:
Syren/Transcript - Intro
Kim: Wha, ho, ho, ho! Ha, ha! (runs and dives off the roof into the water) Come on, guys! I can teach you to swim in two seconds flat, Markov. You just put your arms like this, then you push your legs, and it's kind of like being a frog, you see. In fact, it helps to think as a frog, too, you know—
(A fin is seen approaching in the water. Syren leaps out, and dives back in, pushing Kim underwater with her.)
Max: (frantically) Kim!!
(Marinette quietly slips away from the others.)
Alya: (runs to the edge of the roof and looks out) Where is he? Can you see him? (sees Marinette paddling away from the theater in a trash bin) Marinette, what are you doing?!
Marinette: Um, I'm gonna go get help! (tips the bin, falling into the water, and grabs hold of the bin) I'm fine!
Alix: (deadpan sarcasm) Okay so...I guess we're saved, then?
(Underwater, Syren speaks to Kim.)
Syren: Kim! I found you at last. (blows an air bubble, and places it over Kim's head so he can breathe)
(On the water surface, Marinette has paddled out of sight of the others.)
Marinette: Okay, we're alone.
[Transformation Sequence] Marinette: Tikki, spots on! Ha! (Marinette transforms into Ladybug.)

title: Syren/Transcript
text:
Syren/Transcript - Intro
(Ladybug dives into the water and swims around. She is nearly swallowed by a giant catfish, but dodges it, and then surfaces. She takes a deep breath and goes back underwater. She spots Syren pulling Kim along with her.)
Kim: Huh! This is amazing! I can breathe underwater, just like a fish.
Syren: I knew you'd love it, and I've got lots of other surprises for you, you'll see—
(Ladybug grabs Kim with her yo-yo, and pulls him back away from Syren.)
Kim: Hey!
Syren: My prince!
(She swims after Kim, grabs him, and pulls back him and Ladybug, who grabs hold of a window railing to stop them as she runs low on air.)
Hawk Moth: (from his lair) With every new environment comes a new set of rules, Ladybug, you won't be able to win this time. Ladybugs can't breathe underwater. Syren, are you going to let Ladybug steal your prince away from you?
Syren: Never!
(Cat Noir is leaping between roofs with his staff, until he sees Ladybug come flying out of the water, screaming.)
Cat Noir: Ladybug? (leaps up, catches her, and lands with her on a roof) You didn't tell me you were going swimming today.
Ladybug: I wasn't planning on it; ladybugs aren't exactly cut out for deep-sea diving, you know.

title: Syren/Transcript
text:
Syren/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: Cats aren't exactly crazy about water either, you know. Is there any chance you can get us a submarine? (winks at Ladybug)
Ladybug: (responding to his hint) Pawssibly, kitty cat. Lucky Charm! (A potion bowl appears)
Cat Noir: Huh. Well, we can always use it to scoop up the water. It'll just take a long time.
Ladybug: (gasps as she realizes the significance of the bowl) I'll be right back! (starts to run off, but Cat Noir grabs her wrist)
Cat Noir: Wait! Where're you going?
Ladybug: (hesitantly) I can't.
Cat Noir: (disappointedly) Say anything. Yeah, I know. But we are a team, aren't we? (turns away from Ladybug) I'm tired of all these secrets.
Ladybug: I'm sorry. It's not exactly easy for me either, trust me. (she leaps away while Cat Noir turns to see her leaving him)
(Cat Noir sits down on the roof to wait for Ladybug to return.)
Ladybug: (swings in and lands out of sight) Spots off! (detransforms, hidden, before looking around for Master Fu)
Marinette: Master Fu? Master?
(Master Fu has his potion-mixing setup on the roof.)
Master Fu: This way.
Marinette: Cat Noir and I can't defeat the mermaid underwater.

title: Syren/Transcript
text:
Syren/Transcript - Intro
Master Fu: (studying the Grimoire on his tablet) I know, and unfortunately I haven't found the correct blend that could help you both out. (sadly) I've failed you.
Marinette: No way! We are gonna find that last ingredient! (points to Grimoire image on the tablet)
(Tikki and Wayzz gasp and turn their backs, fearfully remembering Fu's earlier warning.)
Master Fu: The Tear of Joy? I've tried everything: water from the Laughing Fountain, melted snow from the Mountain of Jubilation, drops of pure chocolate extract!
Marinette: But have you tried a real tear of joy?
Master Fu: What?!
Marinette: Come on, tell me a really, really funny joke!
Master Fu: Do you think this is really the time to have fun?
Marinette: Okay, why do you go to bed at night?
Master Fu: (confused) I don't know, uh...
Marinette: Because the bed won't come to you! (Fu chuckles) What goes up, but doesn't move? Stairs! (Fu laughs) What does a snail say when it's riding on a turtle's back? (throws her arms up) "Wooohooo!!"
(Fu laughs heartily, until a tear comes to his eye. Marinette wipes the tear onto her finger, and carries it over and drops it in the potion bowl. The potion flashes brightly, producing a skyward blast.)

title: Syren/Transcript
text:
Syren/Transcript - Intro
Master Fu: I think you have just found the magic ingredient, Marinette!
(Fu gives Tikki a drink from a spoonful of the potion.)
Tikki: Mmm! Yummy!
[Transformation Sequence]
Marinette: Tikki, power up! (Tikki's forehead spot glows, and she spins into a flash as she becomes...)
Tikki: Aqua-Tikki! (now has fins and a tailfin instead of arms and legs)
Marinette: Aqua-Tikki, spots on! Yeah!
(Marinette transforms into Aquabug, with scaly costume, large blue ponytails with purple ribbons, finny arms and feet, and a "beltbuckle" device.)
(Ladybug admires her new costume design momentarily, and starts to walk away, but stops, pauses, and turns to Fu.)
Aquabug: Master Fu, I think it's time you put those noodles into the boiling water.
Master Fu: You're right, Ladybug. I'll take care of it.
(Ladybug leaps away.)
Cat Noir: This is so dumb! (stands up) Claws in. (detransforms)
Plagg: (groans) What's taking her so long? (Adrien holds up his hands to Plagg, and starts to pull off his ring a little bit) Whoa, easy! W-What are you doing?!
Adrien: (grimly) If you don't tell me what Ladybug is hiding from me, I'm done!
Plagg: You can't do that!

title: Syren/Transcript
text:
Syren/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: (bitterly) Why not? No one'll know if I quit. No one'll care!
Plagg: I will!
Adrien: Why? (cynically) Because you won't have anyone to give you Camembert?
Plagg: Oh, I'm sure there'll be another Cat Noir to give me cheese... (pauses, and turns to Adrien) ...but he won't be you. (Adrien's expression softens)
Master Fu: (suddenly appears next to Adrien) Hello, Cat Noir. (Adrien turns and gasps in shock)
Nathalie: Adrien, please reconsider! You know what your father wants!
Adrien: This is what I wanna do!
(Adrien hears a distressed groan, and spots Master Fu over near the street corner, on hands and knees, his cane lying nearby, the old man struggling feebly to get up. Adrien runs over, hands Fu his cane, and helps him to stand up.)
Master Fu: Thank you, young man.
Adrien: (gaping at Master Fu, shocked) You! You're the man who—
Master Fu: (holds up a vial of bright green potion) I'll explain everything, I promise. But right now, you must go and help Ladybug! (He gives the vial to Adrien and he takes it)
Plagg: (groaning) Oh, no! I hate transforming.
Kim: (chuckles) I love what you've done with the pool! It's awesome!

title: Syren/Transcript
text:
Syren/Transcript - Intro
Syren: This is the pool where the old me tried to pour her heart out to you so many times.
Kim: But, uh...I've never seen a Syren at the pool. (Syren holds up her wrist with her swimming bracelet for Kim to see. Kim stares at it for a moment until he recognizes it, and gasps) Ondine?!
Syren: I'm your Syren now. And you could be my merman. (puts her hands into Kim's air bubble, drawing closer to him) It only needs a kiss, and you'll become just like me!
Kim: You mean I could swim as fast as you?
Syren: (takes Kim's face in her hands, and starts to pull his face toward hers) Yes, Kim! You'll be my Prince, and we'll rule this underwater city together, forever!
Kim: (has puckered his lips for a kiss, until a thought occurs to him) Wait! Does this mean I never get to see Mecha Monkeys vs. Cyber Sharks 3?
Syren: (surprised; taken aback) What?!
Aquabug: (floating at the far end of the room) Oh, yes you will; don't worry! In fact, you'll probably make it to the next showing! (Syren is angry.)
Aqua Noir: (swimming into the room, with green-finned arms, feet and "tail" on his costume) The three of us can go together. (assuming a position next to Ladybug) I'll even share my popcorn.

title: Syren/Transcript
text:
Syren/Transcript - Intro
(Aquabug and Aqua Noir strike fighting poses facing Syren.)
Hawk Moth: (from his lair) I knew those Miraculous had hidden powers! Syren! There's too many fish in this sea. Take their Miraculous before they take your merman away in their net!
(Syren lunges toward Aqua Noir, and shoves him back against an upper-floor railing. Aquabug pulls Syren back with her yo-yo, but then Syren pulls Aquabug around in the water instead, until she's close to Kim's bubble. Her yo-yo gets disengaged, and Aqua Noir continues the fight with Syren, as Aquabug looks on.)
Kim: Your new outfits are so cool!
Aqua Ladybug: Oh, um, thanks! But tell me, what happened to your friend that got her so worked up?
Kim: We were playing a game of secrets, and I think she was trying to tell me that I'm the boy she likes. But, I was a doofus and didn't realize.
Aquabug: Game of secrets? What kind?
Kim: It's a game Ondine invented. (making explanatory gestures) You write down a secret and put it inside the bracelet's capsule. It's awesome! You wanna know my secret?

title: Syren/Transcript
text:
Syren/Transcript - Intro
Aquabug: (ignoring Kim's question, and noticing Syren's bracelet) That's where the akuma must be! Aqua Lucky Charm! (a car key appears) Car keys? I guess we should hit the road, then. (gives her yo-yo, opened up, to Kim) Here. You can breathe through this.
(Kim puts the yo-yo over his nose and mouth and gives Ladybug a thumbs up.)
Syren: (angry at seeing Kim being taken out of the building by Aquabug) Kim! (swims toward the exit)
Aqua Noir: Hey! We're not done yet! (swims after Syren)
Syren: (spotting Ladybug) Ladybug! What have you done to my prince?!
Aquabug: (Kim is seen above water, hiding behind the chimney of a nearby building.) I think he took someone else to the ball.
Syren: I won't let you steal him from me! Kim is mine! (chases after Aquabug)
Aquabug: (using her ear-communicator) Cat Noir! Are you all right?
Aqua Noir: (likewise) Yeah, Bugaboo. Like a fish in water.
Aquabug: Great! Now, be ready to strike! (swims along until she swims through a car with its doors open on both sides, Syren following until she enters the same car) Cat Noir! Now!

title: Syren/Transcript
text:
Syren/Transcript - Intro
(Aqua Cat Noir strikes the car's hood with his staff, triggering the car's airbag, which pins Syren inside. Aquabug and Aqua Noir close the car doors on either side, and Aquabug uses the key signal to lock them. She then ties the loop-end of her yo-yo around the car's trailer hitch, and she and Cat Noir swim to the surface.)
(Aquabug and Aqua Noir leap out of the water, and land on a roof. Aquabug wraps her yo-yo around Aqua Noir's staff, which he then extends, and pulls on like a fishing rod.)
Aqua Noir: Looks like I got a nibble! (pulls the car Syren is trapped in out of the water, and lets it impact on the roof; then looks in the car window) How cool! I always wanted a goldfish! (imitates a goldfish breathing with his mouth and flapping his hands on the sides of his head)
(Aquabug unlocks the car with a key signal. Its door pops open, spilling out water. Ladybug reaches inside, takes Syren's bracelet, and cracks it in her hands, releasing the akuma.)
Aquabug : No more evil-doing for you, little akuma. Time to de-evilize! (captures the akuma and purifies it) Gotcha! Bye bye, little butterfly. (throws the car key in the air) Miraculous Ladybug!

title: Syren/Transcript
text:
Syren/Transcript - Intro
(The Miraculous wave removes all the floodwater from Paris, leaving it dry. Syren transforms back into Ondine, in her swimsuit.)
Aqua Noir: Thank you for keeping your promise, M'Lady.
Aquabug : (raises her fist) We are a team, aren't we?
Aquabug & Aqua Noir: (fist-bumping) Pound it!
(Master Fu is holding a rack with seven vials containing potions of different colors. He shows Marinette a paper with matching colored circles and written descriptions of each.)
Master Fu: Each blend corresponds to a new power.
Marinette: (takes the paper and scans it) Oh wow! That's a lot of powers!
Master Fu: (gives Marinette the rack of vials) You should keep these vials with you at all times, just in case.
Marinette: (apprehensively) Well...that's not very practical.
Master Fu: Only the ingredients matter. They could be contained in anything.
Marinette: Then...I may just have an idea!
(Marinette lifts a tray from the oven holding 21 mini-macarons, 3 each of the 7 potion colors, arranged in rows by color.)
Tom: My little girl's mini-'macaroons' are ready. Mmm! They look so good! (reaches up to take one)
Marinette: (pulls tray away) Uh, actually, I'll taste them first and see if they are good.

title: Syren/Transcript
text:
Syren/Transcript - Intro
Tom: My daughter baked them! They're bound to be great!
Tikki: Mmm! Magical 'macaroons'! I love your idea, Marinette!
Marinette: (putting a red one into a box with other colors) One 'magic-aroon', one transformation.
Tikki: The blue one looks yummy!
Marinette: You'll see. (in a hushed tone) I'm told it's icy. (winks at Tikki)
(Ondine swims up to the edge of the pool where Kim is waiting for her.)
Kim: Wanna play a game of secrets? (holds a swimming bracelet out to Ondine)
Ondine: (chuckles, and gets out the bracelet's note) "Wanna go to the movies with me?"
(Kim and Ondine smile at each other.)
(The refractor pops out of the wall at the front entrance.)
Gabriel: (heard through the speaker, speaking tersely) Who is it?!
Master Fu: (unseen through the "eye") Over here! (The "eye" view shifts left) Lower. (The "eye" view shifts back to the right, and down, revealing Fu) Hello, I'm Mr. Chan. Adrien's Chinese tutor could not come today. I'll be replacing him.
Gabriel: (viewing the stranger with general suspicion) Hmmm.
Translator app: "What time is it?" Xiànzài jí diǎn le? [现在几点了?]
Adrien: "Xiànzài jí diǎn le?"
(Master Fu enters along with Nathalie.)

title: Syren/Transcript
text:
Syren/Transcript - Intro
Master Fu: Shí jī dào le. [时机到了] It's the right time.
Nathalie: Adrien, here's Mr. Chan. He'll be your substitute teacher for today. (leaves the room)
Master Fu: Hello, Adrien. I think you and I should have a little talk.
(Plagg flies out of Adrien's clothing and goes over to Master Fu.)
Plagg: Adrien, meet Master Fu, the last Guardian of the Miraculous.
Gabriel: (Holding book with strange symbol) Nooroo! How can I obtain more powers?
Nooroo: What do you mean, Master?
Gabriel: Don't treat me like an idiot! Ladybug and Cat Noir have new powers. How did they do it?
Nooroo: We kwamis do not know the recipes.
Gabriel: It's inside this Grimoire, isn't it? Can't you read it?
Nooroo: Only Guardians can. I don't know anything, I swear!
Gabriel: Well then, I will have to find this Guardian of the Miraculous, wherever he is.
(Master Fu takes out a round box from his bag and hands it to Adrien. Plagg gets excited, believing that inside could be Camembert as Adrien opens it, revealing seven wedges of cheese in the colors of the power potions.)
Plagg: (groaning in frustration) Oh, no! I hate transforming.

title: Swimming pool
text:
Swimming pool - Intro
The swimming pool is an indoor pool located somewhere in Paris.

title: Swimming pool
text:
Swimming pool - Appearance
Exterior
The exterior of the pool has two sets of double doors framed by a symmetrical, tiled pattern of pink fan flowers and dark blue curved shapes on a light blue background. The shape forms an arch over the two doors.
The roof of the swimming pool is a glass roof in a gabled shape.
Interior
The swimming pool has three levels. The levels have potted plants positioned in various places. Above the top level there is a stained glass window of a setting sun.
The top two levels are in a courtyard style with the middle of the floor 'cut out' so people can view the pool from upper levels. The floors have numbered lockers on the walls and have a black railing facing the pool. Each level also has a diving board protruding out.
The bottom level has the swimming pool in the center. The floor is tiled with small square tiles, which are various shades of light blue and aqua, and has a white grout.
The walls have the same blue tiles lining the bottom. Above them the walls are painted yellow on the bottom half and pale blue on the top half with a stripe of painted blue waves separating the two halves. One wall has a dark blue box and instructions to a waterslide (in French).

title: Swimming pool
text:
Swimming pool - Appearance
The pillars go from the floor of the ceiling of the first floor. They are made of white bricks with black grout, separated in the middle by a painted large yellow seashell with a blue background. The bottom is lined with the same blue wave pattern as the walls.
The side of some of the pillars facing the pool have an orange and yellow life ring while others don't. Some of the pillars also have a first aid kit.
There are white chairs along the sides of the pool throughout the level. There is also a movable slide. Next to one of the pillars, there is a bucket with some pool noodles sticking out. One side of the pool has two vending machines. Next to the machines there is a pool wheel.

title: Swimming pool
text:
Swimming pool - Trivia
The swimming pool has spaces for squash and fitness practices.
Its exterior is inspired by the building of the Pontoise Swimming Pool, located in the 5th arrondissement of Paris.
The swimming pool has been involved in several attacks/incidents:
In "Syren", the titular villain was akumatized there, thereby flooding it; she fought the heroes there later.
In "Gang of Secrets", thanks to Ladybug's plan, the akumatized object was destroyed at the pool.
In "Mr. Pigeon 72", most of the episode takes place:
Xavier Ramier akumatized into Mr. Pigeon for the 72nd time and attacks people in the pool.
It is in the pool that Ladybug improves her powers and creates the first Magical Charm - small pendants that can protect people from akumatization.
In "Derision", this is where Marinette and Adrien's first date takes place, which turns into a fiasco due to the trauma that Marinette experienced in this place the year before.
Due to the panic attack that this causes her, Monarch tries to akumatize her into Panic, but she manages to break free.

title: Swimming pool
text:
Swimming pool - Trivia
During the flashback, we find out that Marinette had a date with Kim, but he ruined it on Chloé's advice by arranging a cruel joke towards Marinette, and Chloé and Sabrina filmed it.
Lê Chiến Kim is akumatized by Monarch into Dark Humor, a new version of Dark Cupid, and is given the power of the Monkey Miraculous through his Alliance ring.
