title: Sword
text:
Sword - Intro
The  is the tool of the Dragon Miraculous.
The current owner of the sword is Kagami Tsurugi, who uses it as the superhero Ryuko.
Previously, it was used by Gabriel Agreste when he used the Dragon Miraculous with the other Miraculouses in his possession to become Monarch. It was also used by Marinette Dupain-Cheng who unified the Ladybug Miraculous with the Dragon Miraculous to become Dragon Bug.

title: Sword
text:
Sword - Appearance
The Sword changes color depending on whose possession it is in:
When it was used by Ryuko and Dragonbug, the sword has a red blade, a black spiraled hilt, and a golden cross-guard with pointed tips. At the center on the side at the cross-guard is a circle screen including three swirling icons: a cloud, a water drop, and a lightning bolt. Any of the icons can be filled in with color or colored outlines.
In Season 6 and onwards, when used by Ryuko and Dragonbug, the sword blade is sharper and the handle lacks the pointed tips.
When it was used by Monarch, the sword's handle turned purple while the blade turned silver.
The blade seemingly changes color in accordance with the icons on the cross-guard: yellow for the lightning bolt, grey for the cloud, and blue for the water drop.
When the sword is not in use, it is attached to the holder's back.

title: Sword
text:
Sword - Abilities
The sword, like the rest of the Miraculous tools, is nearly unbreakable and can be used to deflect attacks. The sword is also sharp enough to cut through the solid steel of a car with ease. As seen in "Kuro Neko", the sword can also be used for communication via a detachable earpiece communicator.
Although not yet seen, it has at least been proven with the yoyo in "Miracle Queen", the sword blade changes color depending upon which element gets used may suggest that the dragon miraculous holder can channel the three different elements through the sword using it to create all kinds of attacks.

title: Sword
text:
Sword - Trivia
The Sword first appeared in concept art of Dragon Bug at the 2018 Comic Con Experience panel on December 6, 2018.
The Dragon Miraculous is the second Miraculous to have a bladed weapon as its tool, the first being the Butterfly Miraculous' Cane, and followed by the Cat Miraculous' Staff.

title: Super Penguino
text:
Super Penguino - Intro
is a popular platform game app in the series. The game is playing as a penguin who travels through different territories to catch more coins.

title: Super Penguino
text:
Super Penguino - How to play
While the game wasn't fully shown being played, the screen shows the player controlling the character as it jumps on icy platforms above water and collects coins.
The screen has timer and life counters on the upper left corner, and score and coin counters are on the upper right corner. The bottom has a direction pad and presumably a jump button.
Despite appearing as a single player game, it is said to be played by pairs, with one controlling the character's movements, and the other player controlling the jumps. Alya insinuates to Marinette that the game would be better when played with "the right partner".

text:
Super Penguino - Trivia
Super Penguino is used throughout "Oblivio" as a euphemism for romantic relationships with many of the canon couples admitting to playing it, including Alya and Nino and Ivan and Mylène. As well as this, other couples who are heavily implied to be involved also play it, such as Marc and Nathaniel and Rose and Juleka.
Interestingly, Chloé and Sabrina are said to play the game as well.
The game is a reference to Super Mario.

title: Sublimation (episode)
text:
Sublimation (episode) - Intro
"Sublimation" is a season 6 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "Sublimation" is the 3rd written and produced episode of Season 6. It is also the 134th written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Sublimation (episode)
text:
Sublimation (episode) - Synopsis
Adrien makes a new friend whom Marinette is determined to befriend too; but Marinette has no clue how to become friends with someone who doesn't need to be helped.
TV Guide
Marinette wants to befriend Adrien's new pal, but she does not know how to befriend someone who doesn't need to be helped.
Disney+
Ladybug and Cat Noir face a perfectionist.

title: Sublimation (episode)
text:
Sublimation (episode) - Plot
The episode begins with a close-up view of Adrien and Sublime running on a path next to a river. Marinette spies on them from her balcony. Alya attempts to figure out why to no avail. Marinette then pulls down a board with information on Sublime, including many facts about her. She explains how she should become friends with Sublime, then skims over the board's details. Marinette finishes by boldly claiming they run every day supposedly without speaking. She breaks down melodramatically into Alya's arms, whom tries to reassure her to just talk with Sublime to befriend her. It doesn't work, since Marinette retaliates, emphasizing that she only has one chance to make a first impression, even confidently declaring a short speech that she can and will measure up. Alya finally gives up on trying to stop Marinette's mess-making and exits the room. Tikki catches up to Alya and stops her, asking if she won't stop Marinette from making a ruin of things. Alya calms her down, saying that when Marinette's made up her mind it's difficult to call her out that she's wrong. Trixx even backs Alya up. Regardless, Alya requests Tikki to watch over Marinette before leaving.

title: Sublimation (episode)
text:
Sublimation (episode) - Plot
Séverin, Sublime's father, drops her off at school, where Marinette follows her. Sublime goes to her locker, where she drops her books. Marinette sees the opportunity to help her, but Sublime instead uses the books as a stepping stool to feed her birds. Marinette attempts to sneak away, but in the process of doing so hits herself on a pole nearby. Sublime looks in that direction, but no one is nowhere to be found. She then is about to eat sushi, but does not have any chopsticks. Marinette runs to the cafeteria to get chopsticks, but Sublime uses her hairpins as her own chopsticks, defeating Marinette again. Finally, Sublime plays the harp for her animals, but one of the strings breaks. Marinette rushes to the art room to get string, but to her defeat, Sublime has used a piece of her hair as a replacement for the string.

title: Sublimation (episode)
text:
Sublimation (episode) - Plot
Sublime and Adrien enter Greek class together. She is on a call with her father. After it ends, she informs Adrien of her early trial and requests him to pick up her homework assignments for her. She notices Marinette hiding behind a plant, following her again puts forward if she could be his girlfriend by any chance, whom confirms of the fitting description. Meanwhile, Marinette concludes several unlikely truths. Tikki excuses it, but Marinette continues. Sublime asks why Marinette followed her around all morning, and Adrien tells her she might just wants to be friend with her and get to know her more. Sublime comments that it's unique, suggesting to arrange something so they can all meet. Adrien notes this while she departs. Marinette panics, thinking she's been caught, retreats. In spite of this, yet again, she spies on Sublime as she leaves the school. Marinette, being Marinette, misunderstands everything she is seeing. Tikki calls her out to no avail. As the car departs, Marinette runs after the vehicle, wailing an apology at the top of her voice.

title: Sublimation (episode)
text:
Sublimation (episode) - Plot
The car arrives at the entrance of Stade des Princesses. Her mother, Caroline, is waiting for her. Séverin gets out and opens the door for his daughter. Sublime gets out and carries her bag but is unable to lift it. Séverin helps carry the bag, and they walk towards Caroline. However, she scolds him for his good deed and urges to let their daughter manage on her own. Séverin persists, but she insists him to stop helping Sublime whenever she's faced with a challenge. Sublime, feeling shameful, grabs her bag and walks into the stadium with her parents tailing behind. Marinette pulls up on her scooter.
In the locker rooms, Sublime changes into her running trainers and running protheses, the left one sporting her father's signature. Marinette is revealed to be waiting outside and on the verge of going in, but Tikki thwarts the situation, reminding her they don't even know why they're here. Regardless, Marinette bursts inside to find nobody.

title: Sublimation (episode)
text:
Sublimation (episode) - Plot
A man slides into the spectators seats', overlooking the trial. On the tracks, Caroline confidently explains one of Sublime's achievements to Bob Roth so she can secure a sponsor for her daughter. Bob becomes even more unimpressed once he finds out that the gold medal Sublime had won was merely junk. He dismisses Caroline firmly and walks away with a piece of cake. Séverin tries to comfort the equally disappointed Caroline, but she isn't giving up without a fight. She follows Bob and tries to persuade him by assuring the medal at the world championship will be a 100% pure gold medal. She succeeds, but Bob sets a term that if he does sponsor Sublime and she wins, he gets to keep the medal as in "advanced payment". Séverin whispers his disapproval of the way Bob operates to Caroline, however, she snaps. She points out their daughter won't be able to enter the world championships without a sponsor and if he wants Sublime to keep failing like her father. She happily accepts the offer. Nonetheless, Bob slows her down, not offering anything yet, since he would like to see Sublime in action on the tracks first.

title: Sublimation (episode)
text:
Sublimation (episode) - Plot
Marinette explores the locker rooms, investigating for any clues for Sublime's whereabouts while staying on high alert.
She eventually discovers Sublime's casual prostheses and is convinced an akumatized villain disintegrated her.
Luckily, Tikki stops her just in time.
After that, Marinette decides to check the bathrooms.
Marinette quickly dives for another one as she hears Sublime exits hers.
Sublime whimpers because of the fear of the amount of pressure buried into her shoulders.
However, she takes a deep breath to calm down and gives herself motivational mantras to help overcome her fear and succeed.
Meanwhile, Marinette, from her stall, is frightened, thinking Sublime is giving those mantras to her because of hatred.
After the girl is off, Marinette avidly overthinks, even thinking Sublime is in love with Adrien.
Outside, Sublime forgets her water bottle and comes back to fetch it.
Marinette, on the other hand, panics, thinking she's coming back to overcome her.
She spots a janitor's trolley and kicks it over.

title: Sublimation (episode)
text:
Sublimation (episode) - Plot
As Sublime enters the locker rooms, she sees Marinette taking on the identity of an "akumatized" villain; Soapinator, talking and laughing in an evil manner hysterically while mopping the floor.
Sublime sighs and assures Marinette she will happily have a chat with her after her trial, and urges her to not move nor follow her later on.
Following Sublime's departure, Marinette believes that since Sublime didn't fall for her disguise, she will become Ladybug instead to convince her that she was actually akumatized for real.
She then transforms, much to Tikki's dismay.

title: Sublimation (episode)
text:
Sublimation (episode) - Plot
On the tracks, Séverin notices her daughter partially hyperventilating before the trial begins. Face etched with concern, he makes up an excuse to come up and be there for her daughter. He tells her that if she finds the situation too difficult, she has every right to give up. He adds that he will always love her, and it's ok to be afraid and not succeed all the time. However, Caroline has followed them. Turning him down, she advises her daughter to not listen to Séverin. She contradicts Séverin's advice, telling Sublime that fear is always ready to leap out and stop her from winning, she needs to overcome it and turn into a strength that will make her soar. She emphasizes heavily on each word she says to her Sublime daughter.
With the starting pistol's BANG!
and newfound determination, Sublime begins running triumphantly.
She puts in all her efforts, going as fast as she can go.
Out of nowhere, Ladybug comes in, searching for Soapinator.

title: Sublimation (episode)
text:
Sublimation (episode) - Plot
Seeing this, Sublime attempts to slow down, however, back when she was fetching her water bottle, she had stepped on the cleaning solution Soapinator used to clean the floor to further support her act, causing her prostheses to become a tad slippery.
She accidentally slips, breaking her prostheses.
It was a tragedy.
Disheveled yet nonchalant, with her Father by her side, Sublime explains to Ladybug of what she knew of Marinette and her peculiar behavior.
She ends on a bitter note, while Séverin is also worried they lost months of work.
Ladybug gasps in horror as she realizes her mistake.
Meanwhile, Caroline, instead of checking up on her daughter to see if she is ok, runs back to Bob Roth and tries to keep their deal in place.
But Bob angrily rejects the ordeal and leaves the stadium.
An Ultrakuma descends and materializes with Sublime's medal.
Chrysalis contacts Caroline and pretends to understand her anger of the lack of a sublime world, and offers her the power to make anyone a better version of themselves.
After Caroline agrees, she asks to be akumatized into a villain named Sublimation.
Chrysalis grants her desire and akumatizes her.

title: Sublimation (episode)
text:
Sublimation (episode) - Plot
Sublimation confronts the agents hiding behind the audience's seats in cowardice, declaring she can help them surpass their fear so they can carry on with the trial. The villain blasts them one by one, and they all turn aplomb. Ladybug intent to protect Sublime and Séverin. Her words enrage Sublimation, who points out Ladybug's boldness since she was also the one who destroyed her daughter's trial. Ladybug continues engaging with Sublimation, even admitting of the unfortunate misunderstanding and adamant to set things right. Sublimation then latches on to her opponent's yo-yo and spins her several times, flinging her outside of the stadium. Séverin cries out how she's scaring everyone, but instead, Sublimation zaps a projectile at her ex-husband and turns him under her power's influence. After that, she jumps away, wanting to secure her daughter's sponsor once and for all.

title: Sublimation (episode)
text:
Sublimation (episode) - Plot
While she does catch up to Bob entering his car and is about to blast him, Ladybug stops her with the yo-yo. The car drives away, and Sublimation roars if superheroes shatter people's dreams. She manages to open a weak spot in the form of hesitancy and pull Ladybug towards her only to fling her away, then launching into the skies, showing super-agility. Realizing she can't fight alone, she contacts Adrien via the summoning system through her yo-yo. Detecting the summon, Adrien hastily retrieves Sublime's homework from the Greek Teacher and has Plagg transform him into Cat Noir once he has a safe place to do so.
Back with Sublimation, she manages to stop Bob's car and even remove it's sunroof.
Luckily, Cat Noir flings one of Sublimation's projectiles away from Bob's direction, marking his entry in battle.
As they both flee onto the Parisian rooftops and Ladybug joins them, they have a debate on if she is truly a supervillain, since she only has power to make people better.
An argument with Bob follows, and Cat Noir hides him, on Ladybug's command, in a trash dump.
Ladybug, meanwhile, engages with Sublimation, only for Chrysalis to contact her mid-fight.

title: Sublimation (episode)
text:
Sublimation (episode) - Plot
Chrysalis tells her that Ladybug and Cat Noir can't bear anyone better than them, so she should seize their miraculous.
Caroline agrees, however Cat Noir has came back, and they continue to fight.
Ladybug manages to tuck onto the medal, but using Cat Noir's extended staff, Sublimation sends him and Ladybug crashing to the ground.
Ladybug then summons her Lucky Charm to obtain a makeup mirror.
They begin confronting each other while on the run.
Sublimation reminds Ladybug of the accident with her daughter.
She believes there is a better version of her opponents and tries to make them give in.
Cat Noir assures Ladybug everyone makes mistakes, and he can't see how there can be a better version of her, and that she is powerless against Sublimation.
Ladybug comes to a realization and stops in her tracks, Cat Noir following suit, and Sublimation blasts her projectiles at them, overjoyed and believing they are now Sublime.
Shockingly, the projectiles on them wear off, proving they are already the best versions of themselves.
They both dive back into battle.
But as Chrysalis sends a swarm of Antikumas through Sublimation at that moment, successfully hitting Cat Noir.

title: Sublimation (episode)
text:
Sublimation (episode) - Plot
As a result, he loses his powers.
Ladybug dives behind a wall.
After spotting a weak spot, she goes for the akumatized medal, dodging the many Antikumas along the way, and destroys it.
Ladybug captures the Ultrakuma and purifies it.
As they observe a confused Caroline, Cat Noir reminds Ladybug to use her Miraculous Ladybug to repair the damage caused by the akumatized villain.
While Sublimation was indeed akumatized, she realizes something as she looks into her reflection on the Lucky Charm makeup mirror.
She was the villain.
It was her from the very beginning.

title: Sublimation (episode)
text:
Sublimation (episode) - Plot
Back at the stadium, after they all arrive at the stadium, Ladybug sincerely apologizes to Sublime. She is now able to use her Miraculous Ladybug, repairing the broken medal and Sublime's prostheses. Afterwards, she grants a Magical Charm to Caroline to protect her from the new butterfly miraculous holder. She and Cat Noir give their good-lucks for the trial and eventually leave. The trial proceeds to run successfully, the agents even commenting Sublime's performance was the best of the year. Bob congratulates them for his approval of the deal, but being the trash person he is, he tasks Caroline and Séverin to figure out how to add shoes to their daughter's prostheses, or any sneakers will be ceased to sell. This upsets them both, but Sublime believes there must be other sponsors, so they can reject this one. Bob storms away with his nose in the air.

title: Sublimation (episode)
text:
Sublimation (episode) - Plot
Upon entering the locker rooms, Sublime discovers Marinette waiting for her. Not spying or under a disguise, just Marinette as herself. She apologizes, confessing her doubt that she wasn't good enough. Surprisingly for her, Sublime accepts the apology, knowing what it's like to put pressure on yourself. As they sit down, a conversation emerges. Amongst it, Marinette gets the disavowal Sublime and Adrien talk while they're running, but they talk outside of that. Sublime kindly accepts Marinette as her new friend, even cracking a joke. The girls laugh to the heartwarming moment.
In the post-end card scene, sometime later, it is revealed Sublime has indeed secured a sponsor, but under the name of Tsurugi Industries. After the Varlettes have thanked Tomoe Tsurugi and left the residence, Tomoe looks at the view of the horizon, all the while a smirk creeps onto her face, possibly planning or thinking of something sinister.

title: Sublimation (episode)
text:
Sublimation (episode) - Plot Developments
More is revealed about the upgraded Collège Françoise Dupont:
The school now has classes for students from 10th grade forward, as Marinette and her friends are still shown going there despite the fact they have already graduated in "Revolution".
This is most likely from one of the reformations Mayor Bustier had said she would do.
The school now possesses a green area where animals are living there like swans, chickens, fishes, and sheep.
Anarka Couffaine is the new music teacher.
Marlena appears to work as a cook at the cafeteria, but it is unclear whether she was hired there and left her job as head chef at the restaurant at Le Grand Paris or if she volunteers like Sabine does with her Chinese painting classes in the art classroom.
Since Denis was reinstated as principal, as revealed by Caline in Alec's broadcast in "Re-creation", it is unknown whether Olga has been reinstated as the science and math teacher at the school.

title: Sublimation (episode)
text:
Sublimation (episode) - Plot Developments
It's revealed that the upgrade behind Chrysalis' ultrakumas is the ability of allowing her to shoot antikumas from the butterfly light mask of her akumatized villains, which are butterfly-shaped energy beams that are capable of severing the transmission of powers between Miraculous and holder, rendering the latter temporarily powerless.
The reason behind this upgrade is most likely to allow Chrysalis to fight Ladybug and her entire team on an equal ground.
This mirrors Shadow Moth/Monarch's megakumas that were stronger versions capable of breaking through the magical charm's protection.
It's revealed that Ladybug can use her yo-yo to call upon her teammates even though they aren't transformed. Once she selects the symbol of the ally she wants to summon, the selected ally is able to sense her call through their Miraculous even while not transformed.
The kwami is also able to sense the call, as Plagg complained about Adrien needing to transform despite Adrien not saying anything.

title: Sublimation (episode)
text:
Sublimation (episode) - Plot Developments
Sublimation's power is nullified if her targets are already the best versions of themselves, as shown when she hit Ladybug and Cat Noir. This demonstrated that they truly are the best versions of themselves without any flaws.

title: Sublimation (episode)
text:
Sublimation (episode) - Trivia
This episode shares its name with Sublimation, the superpower of the Rooster Miraculous.
"Sublimation" can also come from "sublime", which means "extremely good, very great, awesome, majestic". This is referenced by Sublime's mother basing her villain name and ability to make people better (in her opinion) and forcing her daughter to be a champion no matter what happens.
The episode takes place chronologically before "The Illustrhater", due to Caroline mentioning having been akumatized in the latter.
Nevertheless, this episode takes place after "Climatiqueen", since Adrien discovered his passion for running and met Sublime in that episode.
Notably, this episode shows that Marinette's overthinking can lead to disastrous consequences in any situation, as the liquid soap she spread as "Soapinator" caused Sublime's prosthetics to become slippery, which lead to her falling and breaking them when she as Ladybug accidentally got in Sublime's way. Furthermore, Ladybug's mirror Lucky Charm and even Ladybug herself identified her as "the villain" in this instance.

title: Sublimation (episode)
text:
Sublimation (episode) - Trivia
Similar to "Miraculous Paris", the mirror lucky charm object once again served as a revelation, reminding Marinette about acceptance and that she didn't need a complex plan to be friends with Sublime but treat her as a normal person.
This is also a callback to "Guiltrip", where aside from Adrien, everyone else including Marinette treated Rose differently after knowing about her condition.
Because the Lucky Charm deemed Marinette/Ladybug the real villain of that fight and not the akumatized villain, the Miraculous Ladybug was able to not only fix the damages caused by Sublimation, but also fix Sublime's prosthetics that Ladybug accidentally destroyed.
Similar to "The Dark Owl", this is the second time where the heroes created a situation where it led to an unintentional akumatization.
When Marinette talks about the world championship, an image of Tokyo can be seen on her board. This could imply that the championship will take place in Tokyo, which is interesting, as Tomoe Tsurugi becomes Sublime's sponsor at the end of the episode.
References

title: Sublimation (episode)
text:
Sublimation (episode) - Trivia
A page from Marinette's sketch pad first seen in "Pretension" featuring Juleka, Rose and Nino appeared on the drawing table in Marinette's room.
Unfinished animation of multiple scenes from this episode were heavily featured in early promotional material for season 6, notably in a trailer shown at the 2024 Annecy International Animation Film Festival. Naturally, there are many differences between the trailer and final episode versions of several scenes:
The first scene, in which Marinette spies on Adrien and Sublime, happens during the day and not at sunrise.
When Sublimation addresses the referees from the top of the stadium, there is an additional logo on her right.
The backgrounds in most of the scenes are less detailed than the ones in the final version.
On Marinette's graph in Sublime's information, there is a photo of Adrien at an amusement park similar to the Luna Park des Tuileries that appeared in Ladybug & Cat Noir: The Movie, indicating that the festival also takes place in the series.
The piece Sublime plays on the harp bears resemblance to the song "Abel's theme" from the 1988 movie  Saint Seiya: Legend of Crimson Youth.

title: Sublime Varlette
text:
Sublime Varlette - Intro
is a minor character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She is a Belgian girl with prosthetic legs, para-athlete, and a friend and training partner of Adrien Agreste. She is the daughter of Séverin Varlette and Caroline.

title: Sublime Varlette
text:
Sublime Varlette - Appearance
Physical appearance
Sublime is a fair-skinned Belgian teenage girl of average height, with long, creamy champagne-blonde hair with light brown highlights some of which she braids, and gradient gray-blue eyes.
Civilian attire
She wears a cropped light blue denim jacket over a green dress that barely reaches her femoral prosthesis and a pair of gray-brown ankle boots.

title: Sublime Varlette
text:
Sublime Varlette - Personality
Sublime is a very kind and compassionate person who is able to get along with anyone. In "Sublimation", her gracious heart towards animals is showcased as she tends to a couple of birds nesting over her locker and plays a harp for the animals living in the green area of the school. She is very patient and understanding, seen in how she was able to make no mind of Marinette's antics after Adrien ensured her she was just trying to find a way to befriend her; or not getting upset with her mother for pushing her too far, knowing she only has her best interests in mind; even when Ladybug accidentally caused her prosthesis to break, she didn’t get upset with the superhero.

title: Sublime Varlette
text:
Sublime Varlette - Personality
Because of her mother, who always motivated her to face her problems and overcome any obstacle, Sublime has become very sufficient, accomplished and capable of finding creative solutions to any obstacle that comes her way. However, due to the immense pressure her mother places on her, Sublime tends to feel anxious whenever she has to face a big challenge; she doubts herself and has small anxiety attacks. To counter this, she tells herself in the mirror motivational mantras. Her father is also the one to encourage her to do her best whenever she feels anxious, with his support being the one thing that allows her to regain her focus.

title: Sublime Varlette
text:
Sublime Varlette - Abilities
As a civilian
Sublime is an accomplished para-athlete, as she has won the gold medal on the 100 and 400 meters and is a candidate to win the upcoming World Championship. Because she is an accomplished runner, she has great control over her breathing, allowing her to run not only fast, but also for a long time and during the cold and the rain without getting too tired.
Sublime also excels in music, being capable of playing both the harp and the transverse flute.
She is also capable of speaking five languages.

title: Sublime Varlette
text:
Sublime Varlette - History
Season 6
At the end of "Climatiqueen", when Adrien decided to go for a run around Paris, discovering a new activity, Sublime decided to join him. She asked why he was running, and he replied that it felt right. She then told him that there was no need to run in circles and invited him along to show him the right places.
In "Sublimation",
In "Daddycop", she was mentioned in the background by Mylène at school cafeteria where the girls are discussing their Girl's Night Plan.
In "El Toro De Piedra", she attended the concert at Collège Françoise Dupont in honor of Mayor Caline Bustier.
In "Vampigami", she was at the cafeteria table with her friends when Raymond Pugnant, Nelson and Loïc were making fun of Prem, saying the trio should be ashamed of themselves.
In "The Dark Castle", she appears as one of the guests at Alix's 16th birthday party.
In "Wreckless Driver", she appears in Aglaé's flashback from the first day of school.
In "Grendiaper", when Ray, Loïc and Nelson cut her in line to get in the elevator, she lightheartedly told the angry Marinette and Zoé that the three needed to take a walk, saying she doesn't give them attention.

title: Sublime Varlette
text:
Sublime Varlette - Relationships
Family
Séverin Varlette
Séverin is Sublime's father and the one she lives with. In contrast with her mother, Séverin is a very loving and doting father to Sublime, while also being very supportive of her dreams, as he was the one to develop the running prosthetics she uses. But he is also the first to try to help Sublime whenever she faces a problem or an obstacle, something that causes a lot of friction with his ex-wife. Because of this, he is quick to perceive when Sublime is being overwhelmed by anxiety and is able to help her regain her calm and focus.
Caroline
Caroline is Sublime's mother. In contrast with her father, Caroline does her best to make Sublime the best version she can be. Because of this, instead of offering to help her whenever she faces a problem or obstacle, she motivates her to overcome them herself. Even though it allowed Sublime to become the independent and resourceful girl she is; it also made her develop a great deal of anxiety whenever she has to prove herself on big challenges, due to her mother's great expectations for her. Despite this, Sublime is very understanding of her mother, knowing she only has her best interests in mind.
Friends/Allies

title: Sublime Varlette
text:
Sublime Varlette - Relationships
Adrien Agreste/Cat Noir
Sublime first met Adrien in "Climatiqueen", when she spotted him running in circles, and offered to show him some other places for them to go together. Since then, they have started running in unison. Despite the fact that they never talk while running together so they could control their breathing, the two of them would talk before and after, with Adrien talking about his girlfriend Marinette to Sublime. After Sublime started noticing Marinette following her, she brought this up to Adrien, who put her mind at ease by telling her that Marinette was only trying to find a way to become friends with her. Sublime took this to heart, despite the fact Marinette later on pretended to be akumatized before her, and later on, she cleared all possible misunderstandings with Marinette and the two became friends.

title: Sublime Varlette
text:
Sublime Varlette - Relationships
Sublime's first interaction with Marinette was odd, as she noticed her following and watching her. That behavior confused her at first, but Adrien reassured her Marinette was just nervous about being friends with her. Their next encounter was when Marinette pretended to be akumatized when she panicked over the thought of Sublime confronting her over their possible mutual attraction towards Adrien. Despite finding Marinette's behavior stranger than before, Sublime paid her no mind, telling her they would talk later. After her mother's de-akumatization and refusing Bob Roth's sponsorship, Sublime met with Marinette again at the locker room, where the latter apologized for her behavior and expressed her nervousness in becoming her friend. The two girls were able to clear all the misunderstandings between them and befriend one another.

title: Sublime Varlette
text:
Sublime Varlette - Relationships
Her first encounter with Marinette's superhero-self happened when the latter tried to make her fake akumatization believable by appearing on the running track looking for an akumatized villain. However, this caused Sublime to lose control over her prosthetics and fall, breaking them in the process. Despite the fact that Ladybug caused months of work on developing those prosthetics to be all for nothing, Sublime didn't blame the superhero, as she saw that as nothing but an accident caused by a misunderstanding and knew the prosthetics could be rebuilt. She later was thankful to Ladybug for de-akumatizing her mother and also fixing her prosthetics.
Mylène Haprèle
Sublime and Myléne seem to be good friends, as Mylène briefly considered inviting her to the girlfriends' movie night during the events of "Daddycop".
Enemies
Bob Roth

title: Sublime Varlette
text:
Sublime Varlette - Relationships
Caroline invited Bob to watch Sublime's tracking trial for her sponsorship. But when Ladybug unintentionally ruined Sublime's trial and accidentally destroyed her prosthetic legs, Bob refused to become Sublime's sponsor, causing Caroline to be akumatized by Chrysalis. After Ladybug de-evilized Caroline and fixed everything, Sublime is given another chance to retake the trial. Bob becomes amazed by Sublime's perfomance, however, he makes an unacceptable condition by having Sublime's prosthetic legs to be covered with tennis shoes in order to promote them. Sublime nonetheless advises her parents to search for other sponsors, and they agree with her, as they wanted a relationship with a sponsor who could respect those who have disabilities. Bob, who got rejected, then angrily storms off.
Raymond Pugnant, Loïc Stompet and Nelson de Glusset
In "Vampigami", Sublime was among with her friends when Ray and his friends took away the paper vampire bat that Prem made, and she told the trio that they should be ashamed of themselves.

title: Sublime Varlette
text:
Sublime Varlette - Etymology
The name Sublime comes from the Latin word sublimis, meaning "high" or "elevated." It describes something so great or beautiful. In philosophy and art, it represents a powerful or overwhelming feeling of admiration. As her name suggests, Sublime symbolizes excellence and beauty.

title: Sublime Varlette
text:
Sublime Varlette - Trivia
On February 9, 2024, Thomas Astruc mentioned in a reply on Twitter that after Tomoe Tsurugi and Lila's third mother, two more disabled characters would debut in season 6, and that they would be designed in cooperation with relevant people; Sublime is one of them.
Sublime is the fifth character who has a physical disability, after Tomoe Tsurugi, Lila's third mother, Odile and Gine Jinet.
Marinette states that Sublime is able to speak five languages. Considering Sublime is Belgian and also taking the British and Japanese flags in Marinette's vision board, the five languages Sublime speaks are most likely: French, German, Dutch (these three being Belgium's official languages), English and Japanese.
The way Marinette befriended Sublime mirrors almost exactly the way she befriended Kagami. Both Kagami and Sublime are very accomplished girls with very demanding mothers, whose first encounters with Marinette were very awkward. Not just that, but Marinette also developed an inferiority complex regarding their friendship, seeing both girls as being too perfect to be her friends.

title: Sublime Varlette
text:
Sublime Varlette - Trivia
The difference between the beginning of her friendship with Kagami and her friendship with Sublime is that Marinette used to be jealous of Kagami's friendship with Adrien, while Marinette never got jealous of Sublime, but instead just wanted to make the best possible impression with her due to her being friends with Adrien.
Despite having prosthetics, Sublime is seen mostly using a wheelchair to move around. That's because, due to having prosthetics to both her legs, Sublime uses much more energy to walk with them than a normal person does, so, and being her a parathlete, she uses the wheelchair to conserve her strength.
Sublime, Mireille Caquet, Socqueline Wang and Diane are the only known students of Collège Françoise Dupont not to have been akumatized in any way.
Although Adrien Agreste has never been akumatized in a permanent timeline, he has been akumatized twice in two alternate timelines.

(Ladybug stops running, and Cat Noir follows, shocked.)
Cat Noir: M'Lady, what are you-
(Ladybug faces Sublimation.)
Sublimation: Are you becoming reasonable, Ladybug? Be better!
(She throws her medal at Ladybug,)
Sublimation: You are now sublimed! (To Cat Noir) Be better!
(He is hit with the medal as well. The background fades to purple.)
Chrysalis: Don't forget about their Miraculous.
(Ladybug breaks out of the effects of Sublimation's power.)
Cat Noir: Wow, I told you M'Lady!
(He breaks out as well.)
Ladybug: You, too, are the best version of yourself, Kitty Cat.
Cat Noir: (Smugly) I know.
Ladybug: And the most modest.

title: Sublimation (episode)/Transcript
text:
Sublimation (episode)/Transcript - Intro
(They go back over to where Sublimation is to fight her. The background fades to purple again.)
Chrysalis: It's not over!
(Cerise's silhouette is shown blowing an antikuma, and several of them shoot out of Sublimation's eyes, shocking her. One hits Cat Noir, causing him to hit a wall and fade to gray. Ladybug jumps for cover.)
Cat Noir: (Gasps) I lost my powers!
Sublimation: Oh, what are these?!
Ladybug: Antikumas!
(She runs towards Sublimation, who is panicking, and grabs her medal.)
Sublimation: NOOO!
(Ladybug breaks the medal with her yo-yo, unleashing the ultrakuma. She then opens up her yo-yo.)
Ladybug: No more evil-doing for you, ultrakuma. Time to de-evilize! (She catches the ultrakuma) Gotcha! (She sets it free) Bye bye, little butterfly!
(Sublimation turns back into Caroline.)
Caroline: Oh! What happened?
Cat Noir: (After Ladybug hesitates) And now you toss the lucky charm into the air and repair the damages caused by the akumatized villain.
Ladybug: But Sublimation hasn't caused any damage.
(She picks up the pieces of the medal.)
Ladybug: She was indeed akumatized, but...
(She opens the hand mirror and gasps.)

title: Sublimation (episode)/Transcript
text:
Sublimation (episode)/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: But she wasn't the villain the lucky charm was pointing at. It was me, from the very beginning!Ladybug: I sincerely apologize, Sublime. If I hadn't shown up, you would've finished your race. Your prostheses would still be intact, and your mom would never have been akumatized. Miraculous Ladybug!
(She tosses the hand mirror into the air, and Sublime's medal and prostheses are fixed, with her father being reverted to normal. Sublime and Séverin hug, and Ladybug pulls out a Magical Charm, handing it to Caroline along with the medal.)

(They leave the stadium. The suspicious figure who was writing in their book leaves. Later, Sublime is seen redoing her trial, making it to the end.)
Workers: Wow! Best performance of the year!
Bob: Congrats! Your daughter is gonna make me a lot of money. (He looks down at her protheses) However, you'll have to figure out a way to add shoes to these, or we won't have any sneakers to sell.
Séverin: You can't wear shoes with the blades!

title: Sublimation (episode)/Transcript
text:

Séverin: Our daughter is right. We want a relationship with a sponsor based on respect.
Caroline: Well said, Séverin.

(The Varlettes all smile.)Marinette: I'm sorry, Sublime. I should've just come talked to you, but I was afraid I wasn't good enough. I hope you'll forgive me.

title: Sydney Opera House
text:
Sydney Opera House - Intro
The  is one of the most famous buildings of the 20th century and a center for the performance of the arts, particularly opera, in Sydney and around the world.

title: Sydney Opera House
text:
Sydney Opera House - Description
Built in 1973 on the shores of Sydney Harbour by Jørn Utzon, the Sydney Opera House is one of the symbols of Sydney and Australia in the world.
The building covers 1.8 hectares of land and measures 183 meters long and 120 meters wide at its widest point. It is supported by 588 concrete pillars poured up to 25 meters below sea level. The highest point of the roof is 67 meters above sea level.
It presents itself as an impressionistic architectural structure with a series of overlapping "shells" (or sails). These shells are made of reinforced concrete panels, each formed from a quarter of a single sphere with a diameter of 75 meters. They are supported by curved concrete ribs composed of welded lattice elements, installed one after the other.
Although they appear white, these "shells" are actually composed of 1,056,006 matte beige or glossy white tiles.
The Sydney Opera House has a capacity of 5,738 spectators spread across six venues: the Concert Hall, known for housing the world's largest organ (2,679); the Joan Sutherland Theatre (1,507); the Drama Theatre (544); the Playhouse (398); The Studio (400); and the Utzon Hall (210).

title: Sydney Opera House
text:

The forecourt of the Opera House has many steps and hosts many community events and large open-air shows.

title: Sydney Opera House

title: Sumida River
text:
Sumida River - Intro
The  (隅田川, Sumida-gawa) is a 23.5-kilometer river in Japan that flows through Tokyo and empties into the Tokyo Bay.

title: Sumida River
text:
Sumida River - Description
In Tokyo, the Sumida River is a tributary of the Ara-gawa River, whose historical course it forms. Once past the Iwabuchi Dam, its waters are joined by those of the Shingashi River. From there, it meanders in a southeast direction, forming a natural border between the Kita and Adashi wards, and then between the Arakawa and Adashi wards.
Upon reaching Shiori Park, the Sumida changes direction, this time heading south-southwest. It then passes between the wards of Taito to the west and Sumida to the east, near the Tokyo Skytree which borders a tributary of the river, the Kitajukken River.
After several kilometers, surrounded by skyscrapers and receiving water from various western tributaries and canals, the Sumida River widens considerably just after the Etai Bridge. The river then encounters its first island and forms its delta at the Place de Paris.
Finally, the Sumida-gawa ends up flowing into the Tokyo Bay at various points.

title: Sumida River
text:
Sumida River - Trivia
The Sumida gave its name to a famous Noh play by Kanze Motomasa, The Sumida River.

TVi Tower - Intro
The  is a building where TVi, KIDZ+ and TV 5 are recorded.

title: TVi Tower
text:
TVi Tower - Appearance
The TVi studio is a very large cylindrical skyscraper, whose walls consist almost entirely of large windows, with very thin white framing. The top of the building is round, with many air-conditioning units, vents, etc. The top also has three billboards, which often depict an important event going on in the building.
Entrance
The outside entrance wall is made up almost entirely of large glass windows with grey framing. The entrance doors have a red carpet leading up to them. On the left side is a poster of Nadja Chamack, standing in front of a purple and blue background. Below her is the TVi logo, white letters spelling TVi in front of a blue and red background. Just above the logo, in white letters, it has her name shown. On the right side is a poster of Alec Cataldi, seen in front of a blurred background, depicting blue bubbles. Below him is the TVi logo, and above the poster has his name in white letters above the logo. At the top of the outside entrance wall is the TVi logo in front of a transitioning purple to blue background.
Lobby

title: TVi Tower
text:
TVi Tower - Appearance
The lobby's walls are white, until about five feet from the ground, when they turn into a dark oak covering. These walls are also mostly covered by one of two different pieces. One is a large very light blue background, with light baby blue inkblots on them. The other is a large blue fabric framed in black, which only occur on top of the inkblot wall coverings.
Upon entering the lobby, the receptionist's desk is directly ahead. In front of the desk is a large semicircle of oak wood, purely for aesthetic purposes. In front of, and slightly above the desk is two sets of three cylindrical lights: yellow, pink, and grey. These lights are hanging from the ceiling by thin metal strands, bringing them to about three feet above an average person's head. The receptionist's desk is black, with dark blue lights on the bottom of the outward overhang. On either side of the desk is four grey entrances, presumably to the rest of the studio. Each one has a black screen on it that has a blue arrow pointing upwards.

title: TVi Tower
text:
TVi Tower - Appearance
Behind each entrance is a glass barrier, which slides open. Behind the desk is an inward curving semicircle wall, with a glass bridge across the inside of that semicircle. Also behind the desk is two metal elevators, with digital displays above them, showing which floor the elevator is on. To the far right of the desk is a seating area with three baby blue faux fabric love seats surrounding a small wooden table with metal legs. Just above this seating area is two black monitors. Even farther right is an alcove with three TV screens, a painting, and a small white box. Just in front of the alcove is a wooden platform with many cameras attached to steel girders above it.
To the left is a partial wooden wall, with three porthole-style windows, each framed with a white metal. Directly next to this partial wall is a white sink, about waist high, with a metal faucet. Beyond this is another seating area with seven love seats/couches arranged in a circle. Next to these is three grey vending machines.
Hallways

title: TVi Tower
text:
TVi Tower - Appearance
The hallways have white floors, and a few feet before the white reaches the wall, it turns into blue, edged in grey. The walls have a singular blue line on them, the line being edged in white. Most doors in the hallways are grey, with a blue door frame. The ceiling has square white vents along it, with an occasional round white light.
Shooting Studio
The shooting studio's doors are orange with grey handles, and the door frame is blue. On either side of the doors is a television screen showing how the current show being broadcasted looks to the viewers. Above the doors is an orange "On Air" sign, with a grey edge. The stage in the studio has a light blue "green screen" background. The filming cameras surrounding the stage are mounted on tracks, so they may give different angles of the stage.

title: TVi Tower
text:
TVi Tower - Appearance
Near the stage is also numerous lights, props, other cameras, and cases. Four of the lights hanging from above the stage can extend or retract. Above the entrance to the room is a white concrete and glass viewing balcony supported by two steel rods. The grilles for the windows on the balcony are grey. On either side of the stage is a set of two orange doors. The walls are mainly grey concrete from the floor to about ten feet up, and then the walls become horizontal black and white steel beams.

title: The Bubbler
text:
The Bubbler - Intro
"" is a season 1 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. According to the series' production/written order, it is the 9th episode of season 1, as well as the 9th episode of the series, overall.

title: The Bubbler
text:
The Bubbler - Synopsis
Adrien's best friend, Nino, is akumatized into the Bubbler, a villain who traps adults in bubbles and sends them floating away into the atmosphere.
Disney+
Ladybug faces Adrien's friend, Nino, now The Bubbler.

title: The Bubbler
text:
The Bubbler - Plot
Marinette Dupain-Cheng and Tikki are asleep in Marinette's room when Marinette's cellphone alarm begins ringing. Cheerfully, Marinette remembers that it's Adrien Agreste's birthday, practicing saying "Happy Birthday" to her crush and tripping over herself. Then, she looks at photos of Adrien on her computer while saying "Happy Birthday". Marinette even accidentally says "Happy Birthday" to her mom, Sabine Cheng, as she leaves the house.
At the Agreste mansion, Plagg gives Adrien a piece of cheese as a birthday present, but since it stinks and is a "filthy piece of Camembert," Adrien dislikes it. Happily, Plagg eats it instead. While he eats breakfast, Nathalie Sancoeur gives Adrien his schedule for the day. When Adrien asks if his father, Gabriel Agreste, agreed to let him have a birthday party, Nathalie responds that Adrien's father decided against it and wishes a saddened Adrien a happy birthday before leaving.

title: The Bubbler
text:
The Bubbler - Plot
At the beginning of lunch break at school, Nino Lahiffe and Adrien are chatting on the front steps. Nino is blowing bubbles while talking to Adrien. Nino is surprised that Mr. Agreste won't throw Adrien a birthday party and decides to speak to Mr. Agreste during the lunch break. Meanwhile, Marinette and Alya Césaire hide behind a banister. Alya is encouraging Marinette to give Adrien the gift that Marinette made, and Marinette is trying to build up courage for the task. Marinette stands up, looks at Adrien, and immediately returns to hiding, her emotions overwhelming her. Alya pushes Marinette out from behind the banister, and she stumbles in front of the boys. The boys immediately cease speaking, staring at her.

title: The Bubbler
text:
The Bubbler - Plot
Chloé Bourgeois, while speaking to Sabrina Raincomprix, realizes that she forgot to get Adrien a birthday present. Extremely nervous, Marinette stutters and babbles, trying to say that she has a gift for Adrien, but before she can spit it out, Chloé shoves her aside. Chloé walks up to Adrien, lies about getting him a present that failed to be there on time by blaming it on the delivery company, and leaves, telling Sabrina to find him a present right away. Adrien leaves soon after that for a photo shoot, much to Marinette's and Alya's disappointment. Then, Nino walks away to the Agreste mansion to talk to Mr. Agreste.
Alya and Marinette stand in front of the gates of the Agreste mansion. Marinette tries to pry open the mailbox but can't. Alya suggests ringing the doorbell, and while Marinette is protesting, a camera immediately pops out of the wall focusing on Marinette. Stuttering, Marinette explains that she has a gift for Adrien. The mailbox opens and swiftly closes after the present is placed inside, dismissing Marinette. Marinette does a little dance, hoping Adrien enjoys the gift. Alya then asks if Marinette signed it, and Marinette freezes, realizing that she forgot to.

title: The Bubbler
text:
The Bubbler - Plot
Nathalie, who is sitting at her desk in Gabriel's atelier, sighs, putting the present on the corner of her desk. When Gabriel calls her to ask who was at the gate, Nathalie explains it was one of Adrien's friends who came with a gift. This answer leads to Gabriel questioning why Nathalie has not yet given Adrien a gift from him. After Gabriel hangs up, Nathalie frets over not getting Adrien a gift before spotting Marinette's gift. She sees it and is relieved, deciding to claim it as a gift from Gabriel. Nino then rings the doorbell.

title: The Bubbler
text:
The Bubbler - Plot
Nino and Nathalie wait inside the Agreste mansion's foyer. Gabriel stands at the top of one set of stairs, assuming that Nino is there for Adrien. Nino says otherwise, stating that he is there to speak with Mr. Agreste. He attempts to persuade Gabriel into giving Adrien a birthday party, but his speech is littered with colloquialisms such as "dude," giving Gabriel a poor impression of him. Gabriel tells Nino to drop the subject, but Nino does not. Adrien walks in, hearing the tail end of Nino's speech. Gabriel declares that a birthday party will not be happening and banishes Nino from the residence, telling Nino that he is a bad influence on Adrien. Nino leaves angrily, and Adrien tries to apologize for his father's strictness. Nino doesn't believe it to be fair and says that Adrien's father is harsh and uncool.

title: The Bubbler
text:
The Bubbler - Plot
Nino sits on a bench at the Place des Vosges next to Marinette's house, blowing bubbles to calm down after how he has been treated. He spots a boy crying and being dragged away from the park by his father because the boy still has chores to do and can no longer play. Nino grumbles over it, frustrated with parents and says that, "parents ruin all the fun". Hawk Moth, in his lair, senses Nino's frustration and sends an akuma to him. The akuma lands on Nino's bubble wand. Nino agrees to take powers to get revenge on the adults and in turn take Ladybug's and Cat Noir's Miraculouses for Hawk Moth. He then turns into the supervillain, Bubbler.
Bubbler flies across Paris, with a trail of purple bubbles flying from his bubble wand. These bubbles catch the adults, turning green when they have captured someone. They then rise in the air, going off into space.

title: The Bubbler
text:
The Bubbler - Plot
Meanwhile, Marinette is eating lunch with her mother. She daydreams about Adrien's reaction to her present while her mother opens a window. Right before Marinette's eyes, a bubble scoops up her mother. Marinette spots her father, Tom Dupain, in the sky next to her mom, too far for her to reach, among many other adults trapped in bubbles. Tikki pops up next to her, and both of them agree that they need to fix this immediately. Marinette then transforms into Ladybug.
Ladybug runs outside the bakery to find two children crying next to an older boy watching the adults in the sky. The bubbles act as projection screens, displaying Bubbler's face as he conveys his message about parents keeping their kids from having fun and how they can have fun now. Ladybug consoles the children, promising to bring back their parents, and swings away to the rooftops with her yo-yo.

title: The Bubbler
text:
The Bubbler - Plot
Adrien, eating alone, leaves the dining hall of the Agreste mansion, intending to go back to school. As he leaves, he finds a surprise in the courtyard: all of his classmates from school have set up a surprise birthday party for him. Adrien immediately realizes that Nino was akumatized and runs back inside, trying to figure out what to do. Plagg wrongfully convinces Adrien that he should party first - it's not like he'll get another chance to do so.
Ladybug, on the other hand, spots fireworks bursting over the Agreste mansion. Both Adrien and Ladybug realize that the kids at the party are not dancing for fun; they're dancing to keep from being sent into the sky. Chloé asks Bubbler who is currently acting as the party's DJ to switch the music over to a slow song since it would be Adrien's first slow dance. The Bubbler first disagrees, but when Chloè pleads, he agrees, as he wants Adrien to enjoy himself. The other children begrudgingly partner up, and Chloé takes Adrien for herself.

title: The Bubbler
text:
The Bubbler - Plot
Adrien doesn't want to dance with Chloé. He leans away from her, especially when she tries to kiss him. Ladybug, jealous and angry, calls out "Lucky Charm!" and a vinyl record appears. Ladybug looks around and figures out that she has to throw it to the side of the building. Ladybug bounces the record against the side of a building, and the record ricochets to the DJ booth, changing the song. Ladybug's earrings beep, so Ladybug then jumps over the side of the building, transforming back into Marinette.
Tikki scolds Marinette for wasting power out of jealousy. Marinette apologizes before hiding Tikki in her purse and entering the courtyard. She takes three cookies, giving them to Tikki to recharge her energy. Before she can change back into Ladybug, Alya arrives. She leads Marinette through the Agreste mansion to Nathalie's office. The present from earlier is there, and Marinette takes the time to sign it. Tikki worries about the time Marinette's taking and for good reason; Bubbler spots Ivan Bruel not dancing and decides to place him in a bubble for not complying.

title: The Bubbler
text:
The Bubbler - Plot
Marinette transforms back into Ladybug and stands on the wall of the Agreste mansion's gate. Ladybug interrupts the party by throwing her yo-yo at the power cord for the speakers and DJ booth. Ladybug and Bubbler begin to fight, causing the children to hide behind the banisters in front of the Agreste mansion. Adrien runs inside, scolding himself for not taking out Bubbler. Plagg ignores him, dancing. Adrien transforms into Cat Noir.
Ladybug continues with her attack while Cat Noir joins in, the two deflecting bubbles left and right while the children watch in awe. Then Bubbler snaps his fingers, and the bubbles swirl around Ladybug and Cat Noir, trapping them in one massive bubble. The only way they can escape is by giving up their Miraculouses, something that neither one of them will do. Ladybug tries to convince Bubbler that children need their parents, and Cat Noir agrees, although he is slightly hesitant.

title: The Bubbler
text:
The Bubbler - Plot
Enraged, Bubbler tosses the heroes into the air, angering Hawk Moth because he wanted the Bubbler to take the Miraculouses. Above the Eiffel Tower, Ladybug suggests that Cat Noir uses his Cataclysm. Cat Noir complains that she should have said that earlier, before they were in the sky. He summons it and breaks the bubble. Ladybug grabs his arm as he throws his staff into the Eiffel Tower. Ladybug hooks her yo-yo around it, the two swinging to the ground safely. Ladybug tosses Cat Noir's staff to him, and they race back to the Agreste mansion.
Ladybug and Cat Noir return posthaste, the children cheering for Ladybug. Ladybug remarks that the kids don't like the Bubbler's party. Before anything can be done, Bubbler captures all of the children, sending them off to their parents. He then flies off, the battle going to the Eiffel Tower. With only one pad left, Cat Noir reminds Ladybug to hurry, and she summons her second Lucky Charm. She receives a large wrench. Bubbler hurls bubbles at Cat Noir, exploding upon impact with the Tower.

title: The Bubbler
text:
The Bubbler - Plot
Examining the area around her, Ladybug spots an HVAC and takes it apart. She sends a pipe with air spewing out of it to Cat Noir, who uses it to deflect the bubbles. Bubbler raises his bubble wand, about to take another swing, when Ladybug catches it with her yo-yo and wrenches it out of his grasp. Breaking it in two, she captures the akuma and cleanses the city, bringing back the parents and children from the bubbles and returning Nino back to normal.
Defeated, Hawk Moth vows to capture and crush Ladybug as his window closes.
Afterward at the Agreste mansion, Nathalie is typing on her computer when Gabriel calls and asks if Adrien liked his gift. Nathalie says that she will check. Hanging up, Nathalie takes the present, removes the note Marinette signed, and hands the gift to Adrien, who is eating dinner, saying that his father gave him the gift. Adrien is extremely surprised by the gift and asks Nathalie to thank his father before he even opens it. Nathalie agrees, walking away.

title: The Bubbler
text:
The Bubbler - Plot
The next day at school, Chloé is yelling at Sabrina over the tardiness of Adrien's gift (it hasn't been delivered yet and won't be for another week due to all the adults being bubbled the day before). Adrien steps out of a limousine, a new blue scarf around his neck. Marinette is silent, exuberant that Adrien is wearing her gift. Alya mentions the scarf, and Adrien explains it is a gift from his father. He then explains that though his father banished Nino from the house, he will not stop hanging out with him. When Alya asks Marinette why she didn't tell him that she was the one that gave him the scarf, she says that she'd rather ensure Adrien's happiness over hers, not spoiling the moment. Alya then hugs Marinette, and they all enter the school, ending the episode.

title: The Bubbler
text:
The Bubbler - Plot Developments
This episode provides an early hint towards Hawk Moth's identity: although Nathalie and Placide are both seen captured by Bubbler's bubbles, Gabriel is not.
Not to mention how Gabriel should've been the main target, given how his stubborn and rude behavior towards Nino caused him to get Akumatized.
If the original production order is followed this is the first episode to follow a birthday.
Adrien turns 14 years old this episode.

title: The Bubbler
text:
The Bubbler - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in Korea.
It was the second episode of the show's run in France and Korea.
This is first time and the only Season 1 episode in which Marinette's sad transformation is seen as well as
It's also the only time it uses the old transformation background.
On the post-it that Marinette puts on Adrien's gift, it says "Bises", which is French for "Kisses", in the closure of a letter. It is the equivalent of the English word, "Love."
Whenever Gabriel calls Nathalie, the background is reused from the dining room, with the same striped wallpaper, chairs and golden painting frames.
References
In the background of the first scene set in front of the school, several buses with Mireille and Aurore on the side can be seen. These are advertisements for the KIDZ+ weather girl competition from "Stormy Weather".
This episode shares a few similarities with "Stormy Weather":
Both of them are the only ones which have the title on the title card in the top left corner, instead of the bottom left like every other episode.
Ladybug and Cat Noir's transformations in both episodes have different, less detailed backgrounds than the ones in all other episodes.

title: The Bubbler
text:
The Bubbler - Trivia
Ladybug references to the righting ability of a cat in both episodes.
These similarities most likely are related to the fact that they're the first two episodes to have been aired internationally.
Allusions
The scene with Marinette and the camera outside Agreste mansion is a reference to Return of the Jedi from the Star Wars franchise.
The slow-dance melody has a distinct auditory resemblance to the guitar solo in "I Won't Hold You Back" by Toto.
Errors
On the title card, the writers of this episode are given as "Thomas Astruc et Sébastien Thibaudeau"; et (meaning "and") left untranslated from French.
When Marinette panics over giving Adrien her gift, Alya's hair clips through her head.
When Marinette first transforms into Ladybug, she doesn't have her purse, but when she de-transforms, she has it.
Max Kanté is not wearing glasses.
Thomas Astruc noted it as an animation mistake.
In one scene, Rose has darker hair.
When Nino is akumatized, he doesn't have either a red or purple shadow on his face unlike other akumatized villains.
When Hawk Moth tells the Bubbler to get the Miraculouses, the paw print on the Cat Miraculous is upside down.

title: The Bubbler
text:
The Bubbler - Trivia
When Ladybug runs out of the bakery, the door is open but in next shot after the Bubbler has said his speech, it's closed.
During the slow dance right before Ladybug arrives, Rose Lavillant's hair appears brown.
Despite Ladybug saying "Spots Off" which would detransform her right away, the last spot on the earring runs out anyway.
When Ladybug's powers run out and she detransforms to her civilian identity after using Lucky Charm to stop Chloé from kissing Adrien while dancing, she still has her Ladybug ribbons on.
The gates leading outside the Agreste mansion appear open in some scenes and closed in the next.
When Cat Noir first enters the scene, his staff clips through Ladybug twice.
Towards the end when Ladybug and Cat Noir are falling next to the Eiffel Tower, Ladybug's yo-yo ties around Cat Noir's staff, and the yo-yo string falls. But in the next slide, it is tied around Ladybug's finger.
The Cat Miraculous is on Cat Noir's middle finger when he uses Cataclysm and when he looks at it under the Eiffel Tower.
The paw print on the Cat Miraculous is also upside down when it is beeping while Cat Noir looks at it.

title: The Bubbler

When the kids are watching Ladybug and Cat Noir fight Bubbler at the Agreste mansion, some students are on one side of the balcony, but in the next shot of them, they're all on the same side.
When Ladybug breaks the bubble wand, it ends up reformed and on the Bubbler's back before he returns to normal.
Ladybug and Cat Noir detransform quicker than normal.
When Marinette is at the Agreste Mansion, her eyelashes are missing for a moment.
