Kid: But, Daddy, please! (A father takes his son by the hand.)
Kid's Father: No, it's not playtime. You've got your chores to do. (Kid complains.)
Nino: (angrily) Ugh. Adults ruin everything all the time.
Hawk Moth: Desperate to help his friend, but feeling powerless. How frustrating! It won't be long before frustration turns to anger! (turns a butterfly into an akuma.) Fly away, my little akuma, and evilize him. (The akuma flies out into Paris.)
(The akuma flies into Nino's bubble wand.)
Hawk Moth: (from his lair) Hawk Moth is my name and Bubbler is now yours. I will help you with these horrid adults and all you have to do in return is help me get something from Ladybug and Cat Noir.

title: The Bubbler/Transcript
text:
The Bubbler/Transcript - Intro
Nino: Yes, Hawk Moth. (turns into Bubbler)
(Cut to a rooftop, where the Bubbler flies in and crouches.)
Bubbler: No more adults means total freedom! This is SOOO sweet! Off the hook! (takes out his bubble sword and flies over Paris, leaving a trail of purple bubbles behind him.)
(The bubbles start capturing adults, then turning green and flying away while citizens scream.)
Woman: Help!
Man: Look out!
Children: (crying)
Hawk Moth: (from his lair) Perfect.
Marinette: (to herself) Adrien must have gotten his gift by now. (her mom opens the window.)
Sabine: What's that you said?
Marinette: (looks surprised) Um, I can't wait to get back to school this afternoon, hehe.
(Her mother chuckles and then a purple bubble flies in through the window and captures her. Marinette looks scared. Sabine starts screaming.)
Marinette: Mom! MOM! (she sees her father also in another bubble.) Dad? Dad!
Tikki: Your parents! Hawk Moth must've released another akuma.
Marinette: I've got to find his newest villain ASAP.
[ Transformation Sequence ]Marinette: Tikki, spots on! (looks unhappy; Marinette transforms into Ladybug.)
(Cut to The Bubbler on a rooftop.)
Bubbler: And now, party time! (kids cry.)

title: The Bubbler/Transcript
text:
The Bubbler/Transcript - Intro
(Ladybug runs out of the bakery. Purple bubbles appear in the sky, broadcasting a message from the Bubbler.)
Bubbler: Today is your lucky day, little dudes. The adults have taken the day off, so make the most of it. No chores, no homework, no more nagging, just fun, fun, fun, fun. This is The Bubbler's gift to you.
Ladybug: (to the kids) Don't worry, your parents will come back. I'll see to it. (to the teenager) You take care of them in the meantime. (runs off)
Kids and Teen: (cheering) Yay! Go, Ladybug!
(Adrien finishes his meal and gets up.)
Adrien: (sarcastic) Wow. That was a birthday lunch break to remember. Yay! (He walks into the foyer and stops.) Nathalie? Father? (shrugs sadly, then walks outside to a crowd of his classmates cheering.)
Teenagers: Yay! Woo! Happy birthday!
Bubbler: (standing on top of a bubble) Hey, hey, hey, birthday boy. Guess what? Daddy's gone. While the cat's away, the mice will play. (Adrien looks at the Bubbler with a strange expression until he realizes who he is.)
Adrien: Nino?!
Bubbler: The Bubbler's brought all yo homies together for one single-sole purpose, to ce-le-brate!
Teenagers: YEAH!
(The Bubbler jumps down from the bubble into a DJ booth.)

title: The Bubbler/Transcript
text:
The Bubbler/Transcript - Intro
Bubbler: Let's get this party started!
(Everyone cheers. The Bubbler plays party music, and people start to dance. Adrien looks surprised and runs back into his house.)
Bubbler: Come on, everybody, I brought you here to party! (Pan over the teens dancing, but looking sad.) So dance or else you'll join the adults up in the sky! Hahahahahahahaha! (fireworks are shot.)
Hawk Moth: (from his lair) It won't be long before Ladybug and Cat Noir show up to meet their doom! Mwahahahahahahaha!
Plagg: What's your problem? Relax! You're getting the party you've always wanted.
Adrien: But Nino's been akumatized! I've gotta help him!
Plagg: You may never get this chance again! C'mon, let's have a little fun while your father's away! Then we'll save Nino, trap his akuma, and all will be good. (Adrien turns and looks sad.)
Adrien: Okay, you're right. This might be the first day in my life that I actually get to do what I want for once.
Ladybug: (to herself) It's you and me, Bubbler.
(Cut to the Agreste Mansion. Everyone is dancing and Adrien is enjoying himself.)
Adrien: Yeah! (walks over to a sad-looking Rose) Hey, nice party, I guess, since it's my first one.

title: The Bubbler/Transcript
text:
The Bubbler/Transcript - Intro
(Rose smiles and gives him two thumbs up, then keeps dancing and looking sad. Adrien turns around and sees everyone dancing but with a grim expression.)
(nearby Chloé is motioning Sabrina to do something near the DJ booth.)
Sabrina: (frightened) I'm requesting a slow dance.
Bubbler: It's a bit early for that, isn't it?
Chloé: Ugh. (shoves Sabrina down and puts on an innocent face.) It's for Adrien. His first slow dance. Mm? (makes a sweet face)
Bubbler: OH! You know it, girl. (he changes the music to a slow dance. People pair up and keep dancing and looking sad. Chloé walks up to Adrien.)
Adrien: Is it me, or does everyone seem a bit weird?
Chloé: Forget about them, let's go dance! C'mon!
(Cut to the balcony. Ladybug watches the Bubbler going to change a record and at Chloé and Adrien dancing. Chloé tries to kiss him, but Adrien looks uncomfortable. Ladybug looks aghast.)
Ladybug: There is no way this is happening. Lucky Charm! (The Lucky Charm superpower gives her a record.) A record?

title: The Bubbler/Transcript
text:
The Bubbler/Transcript - Intro
(Ladybug uses her Lucky Vision, it shows her the empty record spot in the DJ mixer, the volume modifier and a ledge on the Agreste Mansion building. Ladybug chuckles, then throws the record. It hits the ledge, bounces over to the DJ booth, hits the volume all the way up, lands on the empty spot and begins to play dance music again. Everyone breaks their pairs and keeps dancing. Adrien moves away from Chloé. The Bubbler realizes that the music changed.)
Bubbler: Dude! Who just hijacked my mix?
Ladybug: Yours truly. (her earring beeps.) Better bug out quick before I change back to normal. (jumps out of the balcony to the outside of Agreste Mansion.) Spots off.
(She changes back to normal. Tikki comes out of the earrings and lands on her hands.)
Tikki: Marinette!
Marinette: It was an emergency.
Tikki: Yeah, if by emergency, you mean jealousy. You know what happens once you use your Lucky Charm. You only have minutes before-–
Marinette: I turn back, I know. But I figured, The Bubbler, he's not going anywhere, we have time to get you some food to get your energy back up. Then, we'll get right back out there, I promise.

title: The Bubbler/Transcript
text:
The Bubbler/Transcript - Intro
(She puts Tikki in her purse, enters the party and starts looking around. She heads to the food table, grabs some cookies, and puts them in her purse for Tikki.)
Marinette: I've got to find a place where I can transform, fast.
Alya: Where have you been, girl? I was so scared something had happened to you.
Marinette: Me too! (they hug)
Alya: I'm sure Ladybug and Cat Noir will show up in a minute to save us all. They never failed us. Meanwhile, come with me, I've got something for you.
Marinette: Uh, there's something I've got to do first.
Alya: It's about Adrien.
Marinette: Okay.
Tikki: (urgent) Marinette, The Bubbler.
Marinette: Okay, okay, in a sec.
(she runs after Alya. Cut to Nathalie Sancoeur's office. Alya and Marinette sneak in. They see Marinette's gift on Nathalie's desk.)
Alya: Look! Now you can sign your gift. (Marinette gasps)
Marinette: Ah, yes!
(Cut back outside. Ivan is not dancing, and the Bubbler confronts him.)
Bubbler: Hey, you. Why aren't you having fun?
Ivan: None of your business.
Bubbler: Then I'm going to make it my business. (He chuckles and takes out his bubble sword.)
(Cut back to Nathalie's office. Marinette is signing a post-it.)

title: The Bubbler/Transcript
text:
The Bubbler/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: "Love, Marinette". There. (She sticks it to the present and gives the present a kiss.)
Tikki: Right, we're good. Spots on, Marinette.
Marinette: I can't do it now, Alya's here.
Alya: What'd you say?
Marinette: Go ahead! I'll meet you in the yard.
(Alya leaves and Marinette lets out a sigh of relief. Behind her, Ivan can be seen in a green bubble through the window)
Marinette: No! You were right, Tikki, I never should've waited this long.
(Cut back to outside. Adrien is on top of the DJ booth and has a mike)
Adrien: Hey, Paris, how you doing?
(He raises the mike in excitement, but the people don't respond. The Bubbler, behind Adrien, threatens everyone with his bubble sword, and they cheer. Adrien jumps out and Ladybug can be seen on the roof.)
Adrien: Ladybug?
(Ladybug throws her yo-yo. It hits the power strip and unplugs everything. Ladybug retracts her yo-yo.)
Ladybug: Sorry, Bubbler, but the party is over.
Bubbler: Why you gotta be like that?
Ladybug: You made all the adults disappear, that's why! And now you're imprisoning anyone who isn't having fun. (Adrien runs into his house.)

title: The Bubbler/Transcript
text:
The Bubbler/Transcript - Intro
Bubbler: You will not bust up my party! (He takes out his bubble sword and casts two bubbles at her, which she deflects. The crowd scatters. Cut to Adrien in his room.)
Adrien: I think I've been a complete idiot.
[Transformation Sequence]
Adrien: Plagg, claws out! (Adrien transforms into Cat Noir)
(Cut to Ladybug and The Bubbler fighting. Ladybug throws her yo-yo at one of his bubbles, but it just bounces back toward her. Cat Noir enters and hits the yo-yo with his staff, and the yo-yo goes up in the air)
Cat Noir: Looks like I made it just in time.
Ladybug: I had it under control, (the yo-yo falls on Cat Noir’s head), but thanks.
Hawk Moth: (from his lair) Get the Miraculouses. I want those powers, NOW!
(The Bubbler throws a stream of small red bubbles to Ladybug and Cat Noir, and they fight them. The Bubbler snaps his fingers, and the bubbles turn green and start circling around them, some sticking to them until they are both captured in one big bubble. Ladybug struggles against the bubble as the Bubbler laughs.)
Bubbler: Give me your Miraculouses before you run out of air.
Ladybug: Dream on, Bubbler.
Bubbler: Total party poopers, just like adults.
Ladybug: Kids need adults.

title: The Bubbler/Transcript
text:
The Bubbler/Transcript - Intro
Bubbler: False! Kids need freedom, fun, let loose and live it up. Adults are controlling and bossy.
Ladybug: But adults keep children safe and protected. They care for their kids, they love them!
Cat Noir: (to himself) Most adults do anyhow.  (Cat Noir is talking about his civilian self's father, Gabriel) (to Bubbler) You must bring the adults back!
Bubbler: Nope, never. Know what, since you care about these adults so much, why don't you go float with them for a while? (he runs at them and kicks the bubble high up into the sky. Ladybug and Cat Noir scream and the teenagers gasp.)
Hawk Moth: (from his lair) What do you think you're doing Bubbler?! You're supposed to seize their Miraculouses!
Ladybug: Use your Cataclysm!
Cat Noir: Couldn't you have said that five hundred feet ago?
Ladybug: We can't stay stuck in this bubble together forever. (Cat Noir smirks, Ladybug facepalms)
Cat Noir: Cataclysm! (touches the bubble and it bursts. They start falling)
Ladybug: Should we see if you land on your feet this time?
Cat Noir: No, thanks!
Ladybug: Your stick, there! (points to the Eiffel Tower)

title: The Bubbler/Transcript
text:
The Bubbler/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: Got it! (throws his staff so hard it gets stuck in the Eiffel Tower. Ladybug takes his hand.)
Ladybug: Hang on! (she throws her yo-yo. It catches around the Cat Noir's staff, and they swing and land safely.)
Cat Noir: Good thing cats aren't afraid of heights.
Ladybug: We've got to get to his bubble sword, that's got to be where the akuma is. (Cat Noir's ring beeps.)
Cat Noir: We Better hurry.
Bubbler: Where is everybody? Get out here and party!
Ladybug: Sorry to burst your bubble.
Alya: (from the crowd) Ladybug! (All the teens start to cheer her on.)
Ladybug: No one wants to party with you anymore, Bubbler.
Bubbler: What's wrong with all you guys!? Why you gotta be such haters!? (he grunts, takes out his bubble sword and captures all the teens in bubbles.)
Ladybug and Cat Noir: NOOO!
Bubbler: Outer space is the next stop for your precious peeps, and they're never coming back!
(The Bubbler jumps from roof to roof and Ladybug and Cat Noir pursue him. The Bubbler flies to the Eiffel Tower. Ladybug and Cat Noir start climbing it while he throws explosive bubbles at them. Cat Noir's ring beeps again. His icon shows that he is very close to switching back.)

title: The Bubbler/Transcript
text:
The Bubbler/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: I'm gonna switch back soon, hurry.
Ladybug: Lucky Charm! (The Lucky Charm superpower gives her a big wrench)
Cat Noir: Your... plumbing skill is gonna help us out? (Ladybug shrugs and The Bubbler throws more explosive bubbles at Cat Noir. He dodges them, ending up atop a beam.)
Cat Noir: Could use a little work! Is that all you got?
Ladybug: (her Lucky Vision shows her a vent, a vent pipe, the screw connecting them, and the wrench) Got it! (she runs towards the pipe while Cat Noir is still dodging bubbles. She loosens the screw and the pipe comes off. It goes up to where Cat Noir is standing.) Cat Noir, cover me! (Cat Noir takes the pipe)
Cat Noir: Go on! (The Bubbler throws more bubbles at him, but the air flowing from the pipe deflects them. The Bubbler raises his bubble sword once again, but Ladybug throws her yo-yo and snatches the sword, bringing it to her. She breaks the sword in half with her knees. The akuma flies out of the sword.)

title: The Bubbler/Transcript
text:
The Bubbler/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: Get out of there, you nasty bug. No more evil doing for you, little akuma. (opens her yo-yo) Time to de-evilize! (captures the akuma and closes the yo-yo) Gotcha! (opens the yo-yo again and releases purified butterfly.) Bye-bye, little butterfly. Miraculous Ladybug! (throws the wrench up in the sky, and the magical ladybugs' cleansing light returns every adult to safety. The Bubbler turns back to Nino.)
Nino: Who? Dude.
Ladybug and Cat Noir: Pound it!
Hawk Moth: You can't run forever Ladybug and when I catch you, I will crush you! I will DESTROY YOU BOTH!
(The lair window closes)
Gabriel: (on the intercom) Nathalie? Did my son like his gift?
Nathalie: Actually, I was going to check right away sir.
Gabriel: Good. (disconnects)
Nathalie: (she despairs, looks around, and takes Marinette's gift. She sighs, and crumples and throws Marinette's post-it note in the garbage. She goes to the dining room where Adrien is eating.) A birthday present, from your father.
Adrien: Thank you. I mean, please say thank you to my father for me. (Nathalie nods. Adrien looks happily at the gift.)
Chloé: (screaming at Sabrina) What do you mean not for a week?!

title: The Bubbler/Transcript
text:
The Bubbler/Transcript - Intro
Sabrina: (scared) There were no adults yesterday to deliver it.
Chloé: So what? Ridiculous, utterly ridiculous! (she storms inside, followed by Sabrina.)
Alya: (to Marinette) Ha ha! Serves Chloé right.
Adrien: Hey girls! (he gets out of the limousine, wearing a scarf)
Marinette: (to Alya) Hey, that's my scarf! He's wearing my scarf.
Adrien: (to Nino) Hey, dude.
Alya: Yo, nice scarf, Adrien. Off the chain.
Adrien: Yeah, can you believe my dad got this for me? (Marinette looks surprised) it's so awesome. He's been giving me the same lame pen for three years in a row.
Nino: Wow, I guess anyone can change. Adults can be cool when you least expect it.
Adrien: Speaking of adults, I know my father said you were a bad influence, but--
Nino: We're good, Adrien, don't sweat it. We're buds. Always and forever.
Alya: (to Marinette) You gotta tell him you were the one who knitted the scarf.
Marinette: But he seems so happy about his dad. I don't want to spoil it for him.
Alya: Aw, Marinette. (they hug.) You're amazing, girl. You know that, right? And someday Adrien will figure it out too. Promise.
(The bell rings and everyone walks in.)

title: The Chase
text:
The Chase - Intro
"" is the third episode of the Miraculous Chibi short series. It premiered on August 31, 2018, on the official Miraculous Chibi YouTube channel.

title: The Chase
text:
The Chase - Synopsis
Cat Noir decides to ask Ladybug to the movies. But if he wants the superheroine to go with him, he'll need to catch the tickets first, as they just slipped out of his hand and are now flying away in the Paris sky…

title: The Chase
text:
The Chase - Plot
While Ladybug releases a purified akuma after de-evilizing it and Hawk Moth now defeated, Cat Noir jumps out of a garbage bin he fell into.
Ladybug bursts out laughing upon noticing a banana peel in his hair, which he throws away in disgust, then winks at him and leaves.
Cat Noir pulls out a pair of movie tickets, imagining him and Ladybug watching a movie together, and holds them up triumphantly before the Paris skyline.
Later, Ladybug is seen running across the rooftops of Paris, before stopping to admire a picture of Adrien on a sidewalk column.
Cat Noir comes up behind her, startling her into punching him and making the tickets fly out of his hand.
Pausing to flirt with her for a moment, he runs off after the tickets, leaving her to continue admiring the poster of Adrien.
Cat Noir attempts to catch the tickets by leaping off several rooftops, but the wind blows them away each time.
Ladybug notices Cat Noir's activity and investigates, but Cat Noir gestures in reassurance before making one last attempt to catch the tickets, pinning them down with his staff before handing them to Ladybug and collapsing on a rooftop.

title: The Chase
text:
The Chase - Plot
Unfortunately, upon receiving the tickets, Ladybug finds that the staff has punched holes in them, making them useless.
She discards the tickets and leaves, while Cat Noir lies passed out on the rooftop.

title: The Chase

The chibi design of the purified akuma is noticeably different from that of the main series.
Errors
After Cat Noir throws a banana peel off his head, Ladybug disappears in one frame.

title: The Cake Race
text:
The Cake Race - Intro
"" is the ninth episode of Miraculous Chibi.

title: The Cake Race
text:
The Cake Race - Synopsis
It's Adrien's birthday! Marinette puts her heart and soul into making a beautiful cake for her secret love, Adrien. But that was without predicting Chloé's arrival with the same splendid cake. A frantic race then begins, leaving us all wondering: Who will be able to deliver the cake to Adrien first?

title: The Cake Race
text:
The Cake Race - Characters
Marinette Dupain-Cheng
Adrien Agreste
Chloé Bourgeois
Tikki (animatic only)
Civilians (alternative version only)

title: The Cake Race
text:
The Cake Race - Trivia
The webisode was created for a Miraculous Chibi playset.
This is the first physical appearance of both Marinette and Adrien in their civilian identities and not their superhero identities. However, Adrien did appear in pictures during the original run of the chibi series.
This is the first appearance of Chloé in the chibi series. Before the release of this webisode as well as the chibi series being revived, a concept art of her was first shown at San Diego Comic-Con 2017.
The interior of the bakery is reused from Miraculous: Tales from Paris. Angie Nasca, the character designer, also worked on that web series.
Both a variant of Mr. Cuddly and the Bee Miraculous make cameo appearances in this webisode.
Chloé can be seen blowing a bubble from her bubblegum before the helicopter is about to land near her. This is a reference to her Quantic Universe counterpart where in both "Stoneheart (Origins - Part 2)" and "Animaestro", Chloé chewed on a piece of gum and blew a bubble before she was about to conduct a scheme that involves sticking her gum onto a chair.

title: The Cake Race
text:
The Cake Race - Trivia
Even though the webisode contains cartoonish gags, it's surprising that neither of the cakes that Chloé and Marinette were carrying got damaged on their way to the Agreste mansion until the end of the webisode.
On November 23, 2023, Esther Brustlein, one of the two storyboard artists, uploaded an animatic of this webisode on ArtStation.
The animatic revealed that Tikki was originally going to appear in this webisode. She was going to make a brief cameo appearance watching Marinette add the finishing touches to the cake, but that scene was cut for unknown reasons.
There was going to be a scene where Marinette looked at the picture of the cake on her phone. The animatic revealed that the name of the cake Marinette wanted to give to Adrien is called "Gâteau d'Amour", which means "Love Cake" in French.
While it wasn't specifically stated, it's implied Chloé ordered her cake instead of baking one herself unlike Marinette did in the animatic.
Originally, the scene where Marinette fantasizes herself giving Adrien the cake and getting kissed by him in return isn't included in the animatic.

title: The Cake Race
text:
The Cake Race - Trivia
Chloé was originally going to blow a bubble from her gum before she noticed Marinette was about to bring an identical cake to Adrien.
In the animatic, Chloé was going to throw her sunglasses, Mr. Cuddly, a lipstick tube, a comb, and a hair roller at Marinette. But in the final version, she only threw Mr. Cuddly and a round hairbrush.
The Bee Miraculous was originally not going to appear in this webisode.
There's an entire scene that is changed for the final version.
In the animatic, Marinette was going to catch one of Chloé's hair comb and throw it back to her. The hair comb was going to slice through one of the strawberries on Chloé's cake and cause it to land on top of her hair.
In the final version, Marinette noticed a water pipeline outside of a store ahead of Chloé. So, she took out the Bee Miraculous from her purse and threw it at the pipeline, causing water to leak onto Chloé's hair.
On December 2, 2023, an alternative version of this episode was released.
Although there isn't any alternate ending like "Panic at the Park", the alternative version features minor changes to the background.

title: The Cake Race
text:
The Cake Race - Trivia
In the original version, the streets of Paris seem empty except for a few cars when Marinette presses multiple pedestrian call buttons to slow down Chloé's limousine.
In the alternative version, more cars, background characters, and pigeons are added to make the city more populated to the viewers. Even though the background characters didn't move at all, the cars can be seen moving around the streets and the pigeons are seen flying in the background.
Despite the changes made for the alternative version, the original version can still be viewed from a compilation video.
This is the second time in the franchise of celebrating Adrien's birthday after The Bubbler from the first season of the original series.
Errors
Note: The following errors didn't get fixed in the alternative version.
In some scenes, the floral design on Marinette's shirt is on the right instead of on the left:
This is also seen on the title card.
When she screams after noticing Chloé carrying an identical cake.
Before she vandalized a car wash sign to trick Chloé into thinking it was a hair salon.
When she is running down the hill and angrily glaring at Chloé in her limousine.

title: The Cake Race
text:
The Cake Race - Trivia
During the scene when she presses a pedestrian call button.
After she drew a helicopter landing area on the street near Chloé.
Marinette's purse is missing from the title card.
When Marinette vandalized the car wash window, her purse wasn't layered around her arm. And before she does the vandalization, her purse is on her right arm instead of her left arm.
When Marinette notices Chloé carrying an identical cake after leaving the bakery, she's standing on the crosswalk. But when she screams in horror, she's suddenly standing on a sidewalk across from the bakery.

title: The Chained Titans
text:
The Chained Titans - Intro
"" is a season 6 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 21st written and produced episode of season 6. It is also the 152nd written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: The Chained Titans
text:
The Chained Titans - Synopsis
TF1+
Nino suggests to Alya to replace Carapace and Rena Rouge in order to protect Marinette and Adrien. But the arrival of two supervillains complicates everything: how can Marinette and Adrien be both their friends' replacements and Ladybug and Cat Noir at the same time?
Gloob
Worried that Marinette and Adrien's relationship might be on bad terms, Nino suggests making them assistants to Carapace and Rena Rouge, without knowing their secret identities.
Disney Channel
Afraid that Marinette and Adrien's relationship is failing, Nino suggests making them Carapace and Rena Rouge's deputies, unaware that they are already Ladybug and Cat Noir.
Disney+
Marinette and Adrien are made an offer.

title: The Chained Titans
text:
The Chained Titans - Plot
The episode starts with a flashback in Nino's apartment, where both of his parents, Nordine Lahiffe and a pregnant Vita Lahiffe, are discussing their plans after receiving a generous amount of money in a jar from their wedding. Vita places the jar in the corner of their kitchen, saying that they'll plan later. It then transitions into the current time, where the jar remains untouched.

title: The Chained Titans
text:
The Chained Titans - Plot
Ladybug, Cat Noir, Rena Rouge, and Carapace detransform on their respective bedrooms after defeating an Akumatized villain. Marinette falls down from the stairs and lands on a laundry basket, and Sabine Cheng, while doing yoga, asks her about her night. Sabine looks at Marinette and both laugh at the circumstance. Nathalie bakes Adrien madeleines. During breakfast, Ella and Etta Césaire scream their favorite hero is Rena Rouge, while Alya Césaire sips coffee grinning. In contrast with the three's routine, Nino Lahiffe plays music from his headphones to distract himself from his parents' arguing about what they plan to do with the money from the jar. Chris Lahiffe offers Nino his strawberry-spread toast, to which Nino declines because of his distaste towards strawberry. Their father eats his toast instead. The episode skips to Nordine waving goodbye to his sons, exiting a bus. Chris tells Nino that he doesn't like when his parents argue, he responds by saying that they have a hard time agreeing.

title: The Chained Titans
text:
The Chained Titans - Plot
At school, Nino blows bubbles sadly, telling Wayzz he doesn't think there's anything they can do about his situation. He is then greeted by 'the love of his life', who he easily recognises. After a kiss, they both go to the cafeteria and ask for hot chocolate, but Nora insists on strawberry smoothies. Despite not liking strawberry, Nino agrees and pretends to like it. Marinette and Adrien soon arrive, thinking about names of their future hamster and having a light discussion over it despite Nino's interventions. Being worried due to what happened with his parents, he takes Alya aside and expresses anxiety about the possibility of them soon arguing about things much worse, and then divorcing. Alya immediately clocks something is wrong. But instead of talking about his home problems, Nino suggests they become superheroes so their ties are strengthened - just like him as Carapace and Alya as Rena Rouge - and then, they won't break up. Alya is conflicted, but Nino has already called Ladybug.
Marinette gets the signal and leaves Adrien behind to transform into Ladybug and head to the two on the school roof, now in their superhero personas.

title: The Chained Titans
text:
The Chained Titans - Plot
Carapace expresses the idea of having stand-ins for the Turtle and Fox miraculouses to Ladybug in case they ever need it.
At first, Ladybug agrees, but only under the condition that she knows who they are, but soon starts panicking when she's told who Nino's intended stand-ins are, instantly disagreeing and making up excuses.
Carapace doesn't notices, and calls Marinette's situations 'Marinette moments', defending them and calling them brave people and amazing friends.
Ladybug eventually agrees, much to the dismay of an angry Rena Rouge.
Nino is ecstatic about this after he and his partner transform back downstairs, calling them family.
Alya realizes this is about his parents, but Nino doesn't want to talk about it.
He rushes off to get Adrien, while Alya talks with Marinette.
The latter was so moved by the compliments about her and her boyfriend, but knows she can say no.
Alya, having changed her mind, convinces Marinette to say yes anyways to cheer him up and make them feel united.
They'll do a practice run - then never mention it again.
She tells Adrien the same thing over the phone, who pretends to be worried about being a superhero, but agrees.
Plagg finds this amusing.

title: The Chained Titans
text:
The Chained Titans - Plot
Nino soon rushes in the room and gives Adrien the offer.
He pretends to be shocked.
Rena Rouge and Carapace take Adrien and Marinette to the ghost metro station, where its revealed Mayoress Bustier allowed them to use it and remodeled it so it can be used as the Miraculers's secret training base.
The two detransform and introduce the kwamis.
Then, they hand over their miraculouses and watch Adrien and Marinette turn into Trionyx and Renardette.
She "learns" how to do Mirage, despite not knowing how to play the flute.
While she doesn't get the label on the jar of pickles at first, the second try is successful.
Trionyx also manages to cast Shellter around the mirage.
Now comes the best part - running on the buildings.
Renardette and Trionyx enjoy being superheroes together.
Nino is happy for them.
The two heroes' time is cut short as they come across two gigantic stone statues; revealing that Chrysalis has akumatized Nino's parents for frustration of fighting over the jar and wanting a divorce due to their hatred.
On instinct, they rush towards it, as Alya and Nino worry for them.

title: The Chained Titans
text:
The Chained Titans - Plot
Renardette realizes the two are trying to walk away from each other, but cannot due to the chains shackling them to a jar.
While they cannot step into action without Ladybug's approval, they do protect people from the attacks.
They both detransform separately and hand the miraculouses to their kwamis, properly transforming into Ladybug and Cat Noir.
The classic duo meet up, and target the jar.
Cat Noir cataclysms it, and the entirety of the structures, including the chains and the titans themselves, break.
However, they reemerge and regrow immediately after, once again trying to walk away from each other.
Ladybug's lucky charm gives them a large anchor.
Alya and Nino find Trixx and Wayzz, learning their stand-ins are safe.
Nino sees the villain's jar and realizes who they are - his parents.
With Alya's approval, he transforms into Carapace and lets the two heroes know.
Information in mind, Ladybug realizes they need to anchor the two in place.
All three are involved in the plan - Cat Noir cataclysms the ground to knock the male titan down, Ladybug uses the anchor to send the female titan down, and Carapace shell-ters the jar.

title: The Chained Titans
text:
The Chained Titans - Plot
Which means the two titans can't go anywhere and try to free themselves.
Now they wait - much to Cat Noir's confusion, but Carapace realizes and soon, so do they - only they can escape their chains.
The couple look each other in the eyes, and walk to their centre, helping one another unshackle from what's binding them together.
And then, they part.
Carapace then lifts his shield, and Cat Noir cataclysms the jar, finding a much smaller jar inside, the true akumatized object.
The Lahiffes are caught by the boys as Ladybug breaks the akumatized object and purifies the situation.
Magical charms are given, as Ladybug gives the two advice, and Carapace solemnly hands their jar back.
Vita and Nordine finally decide to talk properly.

title: The Chained Titans
text:
The Chained Titans - Plot
Back to their strawberry smoothies, Nino finally confesses that he doesn't like strawberry, but Alya doesn't mind, as long as they have no secrets. Adrien and Marinette come back, being told the news of Nino's parents starting the divorce process. Despite Adrien's worry, Nino and Chris aren't sad about it, as things have been calmer, and they can finally go on holiday. At the notion of being stand-ins again, Marinette and Adrien reject it, being happy to be their civilian selves. And Alya and Nino are happy to be a couple.
In the post end card scene, looking at the Eiffel Tower together at sunset, Ladybug suggests that Cat Noir gets a stand-in for himself. But Cat Noir doesn't want to give the superhero responsibility to anyone. His partner doesn't force him to carry it out, and the two go into silence as the episode fades out.

title: The Chained Titans
text:
The Chained Titans - Plot developments
More about Nino's family is revealed in this episode:
His and Chris' parents, Nordine and Vita Lahiffe (which were revealed in this episode), started out as an affectionate couple, but their relationship soured due to them not being able to find consensus about different things, especially what to do with the money jar they got as a wedding present. By the end of the episode, they amicably decide to split up.
Due to the atmosphere in the house being negative and hostile despite their parents being loving and affectionate to them, both Nino and Chris are content with their parents' divorce since it got rid of the hostility in their house.
His parents' constant fights have impacted Nino deeply:
Nino developed defense mechanisms to help him cope with his family's unstability, like listening to music on his headphones to muffle his parents' fights and blow bubbles to distract himself from his problems.

title: The Chained Titans
text:
The Chained Titans - Plot developments
He developed a belief that different opinions in relationships in general can cause the latter to break apart, which he projects onto his own relationship with Alya: he automatically agrees with her and tries everything she likes, despite him not having the same preferences, like trying strawberry smoothies despite not liking strawberries. By the end of the episode, he learned to be upfront about his tastes to Alya, with both knowing they need truth and open communication in their relationship, not the exact same preferences.
Alya herself is revealed to have met Nino's parents and is already aware of their constant fighting.
Nino also briefly came to fear Marinette and Adrien's disagreement on their hamster's name might in turn destroy their relationship.
Nino and Chris' poor eyesight is revealed to have been inherited from their mother, Vita.
As both Nordine and Vita were akumatized by Chrysalis, all known Lahiffe family members were akumatized as of this episode (not counting Nino's grandparents mentioned near the end of the episode).

title: The Chained Titans
text:
The Chained Titans - Plot developments
Marinette and Adrien are revealed to want to get a hamster, echoing Marinette's desire for a pet hamster as she fantasized about a potential future relationship with Adrien in several episodes from previous seasons.
This also echoes Cat Noir's desire for a pet hamster in his fantasy of a potential relationship with Ladybug in "Frozer" (unaware that she and Marinette are the same person).
The two are shown trying to come into an agreement over the name they may give to their hypothetical hamster, seemingly not able to come to a consensus.
This is a reference to the running gag of Marinette always being cut off when she is about to say the hamster's name during her fantasies about Adrien.
Nino's worry over Marinette and Adrien's relationship causes him to convince Alya that the two of them temporarily lend the Turtle and Fox Miraculouses to Adrien and Marinette so they could become their stand-ins and share this secret and become closer, and in turn so that all four become closer. To assuage Nino's fears, Alya, Marinette and Adrien agree.
Adrien uses the Turtle Miraculous and becomes Trionyx.

title: The Chained Titans
text:
The Chained Titans - Plot developments
Out of all Miraculouses Adrien has used over the seasons, the Turtle is the only that Marinette hasn't used, but she briefly wore it as an Alliance ring in "Re-creation".
Marinette use the Fox Miraculous and becomes Renardette.
This marks the second time Marinette has used the Fox Miraculous and the first time she uses it by itself after previously unifying it with the Mouse Miraculous to become Multifox in "Kwamibuster".
Nino's decision echoes his disappointment in "The Illustrhater" that Adrien and Marinette can't share the secret of the Miraculouses like he and Alya can (not knowing they are Ladybug and Cat Noir).
Due to their main secret identities, Adrien and Marinette permanently retire as Trionyx and Renardette, though they tell Nino it is because they don't feel cut out to be heroes.
As Carapace discussed his choice with Ladybug, it is revealed she came to trust the other holders so much that she lets them have stand-ins in case they are unable to transform, as long she knows who they are so she can locate them in case of trouble. However, she never made that clear to the other holders.

title: The Chained Titans
text:
The Chained Titans - Plot developments
At the end of the episode, Ladybug proposes to Cat Noir that he should get a stand-in in case of emergency, like she did with Scarabella in "Hack-San", "Transmission", and "Deflagration" (and secretly in "Revelation"). However, he refuses because he doesn't want to expose someone else to the burdens of the superhero life. Though visibly unhappy, Ladybug respects his choice.
Cat Noir's refusal might also be because his closest friends, Nino and Alya, are already full-time holders while his girlfriend Marinette already told him she doesn't feel cut out to be a hero (with Adrien unaware that she lied like him).
In addition, he might also have refused because he can send Plagg with the Cat Miraculous either to Kitty Noire, who was chosen by Plagg as a holder and who was Scarabella's brief partner in "Transmission" and "Deflagration"; or to Ladybug herself so she can become Bug Noire again like in "Conformation" and "Re-creation".
These may also be the reasons why Ladybug was not more insistent, along with also possibly thinking of Cat Walker, with whom she briefly worked in "Kuro Neko" (unaware that he was actually Cat Noir with a new identity).

title: The Chained Titans
text:
The Chained Titans - Plot developments
Ladybug's unhappy response might be due to guilt because she brought every close friend she had into the superhero life across the seasons, in addition to leaving Alya the burden of both the Ladybug holder and guardianship, as well as finding a new Fox holder, if something happens to her (as established in "The Illustrhater").
The Métro station where Nino and Alya take Adrien and Marinette to is the same one seen in the cold open of "Revelator" where the secondary heroes were training to gain their adult powers. Nino reveals it's named the "Miracle Station" and that it is an abandoned metro station purposely remodeled by Mayor Bustier for use by the Miraculers.
It is revealed that the Fox holder doesn't need to know how to play the flute to activate Mirage; they simply need to move their fingers and it will do the rest.
However, it is confirmed that the wielder needs to concentrate on what they want to manifest, or the illusion will be incomplete.
Alya and Nino's advice for Renardette to focus on what she wants to manifest is the advice Cat Noir gave Alya/Rena herself during her debut as a superhero in "Sapotis".

title: The Chained Titans
text:
The Chained Titans - Trivia
This is the first episode of Season 6 in which Chrysalis doesn't appear in any way.
Marinette and Adrien's temporary Miraculouses and identities correspond to aspects of their personalities. Adrien, as Cat Noir, protects Ladybug from attacks, even occasionally sacrificing himself, fitting for the Turtle's power of Protection; Marinette, as Ladybug and the Guardian, keeps all the secrets and is known to have told a great lie regarding Gabriel Agreste/Monarch, fitting for the Fox's power of Illusion.
Recognizing the risks of Ladybug and Cat Noir being needed while Marinette and Adrien had the Fox and Turtle Miraculouses, Marinette and Plagg come with theoretical unification names: Lady Rouge (Ladybug/Fox unification) for Marinette (coined by herself) and Carapaw (Cat/Turtle unification) for Adrien (coined by Plagg).
Marinette's alleged lack of knowledge in wielding the flute and incomplete illusion despite her experience with them as Multifox in "Kwamibuster" are ways to maintain her cover as a novice holder to Adrien and Nino.

title: The Chained Titans
text:
The Chained Titans - Trivia
Due to the giant anchor Lucky Charm being larger and heavier than many others before, Ladybug needed to use her yoyo to throw it in the air to activate her Miraculous Ladybug.
Previous giant Lucky Charm objects usually had smaller parts or were broken during the fight, allowing Ladybug to easily throw them.
References
This is the third time Sabine is seen practicing qigong, after "Qilin" and "Conformation".
This is the third episode where Sabine puts a laundry basket at the stairs to prevent Marinette from hurting herself when tripping down the stairs, after "Qilin" and "A Fairy Good Night".
In production order, this is the fourth episode where multiple magical charms are given, following "Crocoduel", "Dearest Family", and "The Dirtifiers".
This episode's plot is similar to "Crocoduel" in multiple ways:
The parents of one of the Miraculers (Juleka/Purple Tigress and Nino/Carapace) get akumatized via the object that once represented their love (Jagged and Anarka's Croco Duo record disk and Nordine and Vita's wedding jar) because they argued about it.
The said Miraculer aided Ladybug and Cat Noir to fight the akumatized villains.

title: The Chained Titans
text:
The Chained Titans - Trivia
They also had a transformation sequence in the episodes.
The Miraculers' first attempt to break the akumatized object was unsuccessful until they figured out what they should do first before they can successfully break it to release the akuma/ultrakuma.
When the villains were de-akumatized, they were falling from a great height until the heroes saved them.
Due to having more than one akumatized villain at the same time from the akumatizations, Ladybug created and gave out more than one magical charm to them after purifying the akuma/ultrakuma and the villains got de-akumatized.
A normally-sized anchor appeared as the Lucky Charm object in the second issue of Miraculous Adventures.
Allusions
The akumatized villains bear significant resemblance to Zeus and Hera whose constant arguments are in the center of many Ancient Greek myths.
The Titans were also giant deities in Greek mythology who were banished by Zeus to Tartarus, where they were imprisoned.
Errors
When the Chained Titans' jar is first seen, it is far from the Eiffel Tower. However, throughout the rest of the fight, the latter is shown to be much closer to the jar.

title: The Chained Titans
text:
The Chained Titans - Trivia
As the Chained Titans are regrowing with the jar, the Nordine Titan is facing the Eiffel Tower, but as he walks away again, his chain shows that he's walking in a completely different direction from it.
Later, when Carapace uses Shell-ter on the jar, the Nordine Titan's chain is facing the Eiffel Tower. It is seen in the same area once the Titans unchain each other.
When both chains fell to the ground, their ends landed on grass. Later, the Nordine Titan's chain was seen on the ground below the Eiffel Tower and the Vita Titan's was also touching the pavement.
If the Nordine Titan's chain fell on the Eiffel Tower, it should have landed on top of it instead of below it.
When the Miraculous Ladybug goes over the shards of the giant jar, the chains are nowhere to be seen.
The first time Cat Noir cataclysms the Chained Titans' jar, it was falling with the chains connected to it, but when the jar hits the ground, the chains are not seen, they are not attached to the jar, and there are no broken pieces of the chains seen falling from the sky, unlike what happened to the Vita Titan when the Cataclysm was spreading to her chain.

title: The Chained Titans
text:
The Chained Titans - Trivia
The second time Cat Noir cataclysms the Chained Titans' jar, the color changes to black when it gets destroyed. But when Ladybug and Carapace leap to the remnants of the jar's base, it is in its marble color instead. Then, when all three land on it, the color is dark again.
In the English dub, Cat Noir mispronounces "ultrakuma" as "ultra akuma" twice.
He also mispronounces it once in "Yaksi Gozen".
When Ladybug looks at Carapace's location, the zoomed-out map depicts him as being near the Grand Palais.
When Carapace uses Shell-ter on the Chained Titans' jar, both sides have two and a half loops of the chains inside the shield. But when Ladybug and Cat Noir regroup with Carapace, both sides have at least five loops of the chains inside the shield.
When Carapace removes the shield from the jar, the chains are dark grey and are semi-reflective. But when Cat Noir cataclysms the jar after that, the chains are light grey and look matte.
In the first shot, the chains go through some of the shards from the first giant jar that was destroyed earlier.
In both of those shots, some of the buildings are modeled differently.

title: The Chained Titans
text:
The Chained Titans - Trivia
When Carapace tells Ladybug and Cat Noir about his parents arguing about the jar, an additional chimney appears left of Carapace, which is missing in all scenes before and after.
Furthermore, the buildings in the background change between shots.
Before Marinette and Adrien transform, the Fox Miraculous is in its activated mode, while the Turtle is in charged mode, instead of having camouflaged modes.
On Disney+, the thumbnail for the episode is from the Miraculous Chibi episode "Drawn in the Stars".

Nordine: What's the point, then? It's a honeymoon. Can you imagine buying your apartment and living there without me?
(Vita stares at him angrily for a moment before calling her client back.)
Vita: I'm back, Mrs. Muskaan. Sure, we can take a look... (Her voice becomes faded.)
(Nordine stares angrily before getting up and taking Chris's piece of toast before exiting.)
Nordine: Have a good day, kiddos! See you tonight.
Chris and Nino: See you tonight, Dad!
(The train begins to move.)
Chris: I don't like it when Dad and Mom don't love each other.
Nino: (takes off headphones) Sure they do. They just have a hard time agreeing on stuff.
Wayzz: There must be something we can do to help your parents get along better, right?
Nino: I don't think so, Wayzz. Unless you're the kwami of love.
(Alya comes behind Nino and places her hands on his eyes while Wayzz and Trixx meet up.)
Alya: Guess who?
Nino: The love of my life?
(Alya laughs while Trixx and Wayzz spin in circles together.)
Alya: How do you get it right every morning?

title: The Chained Titans/Transcript
text:
The Chained Titans/Transcript - Intro
Nino: Maybe 'cause of your voice, your perfume, the softness of your fingers, or the fact that this is our secret place.
(Alya laughs again and the two kiss.)
Alya: Two hot chocolates, please!
Nora: Wait, I've got something better today! Twig and I harvested strawberries from the vegetable garden! We can make some epic smoothies with these; you're gonna love them!
Alya: Strawberry smoothies? Awesome! One of my favorite fruits!
(Nora tosses the strawberries into the blender and Twig pours in milk.)
Alya: (to Nino) What about you?
Nino: Uh, yeah! Same! I love strawberry! We really love the same things, don't we?
(Alya smiles at him. The scene cuts to Alya setting an empty glass down while Nino hesitantly drinks his. Both of them have milk mustaches.)
Alya: Delicious!
Nino: Blegh! Right? Strawberry tastes so good!
(Alya wipes Nino's mouth while Marinette and Adrien come in.)
Marinette: Van Gogh?
Adrien: Eh. How about Mozart?
Nino: What's up?
Marinette: We're figuring out the name of our future hamster. Mmm, Boléro!
Adrien: Mmm, Hummel?
Nino: You could just have a bunch of hamsters! Then you don't have to choose just one name; you can keep them all!

title: The Chained Titans/Transcript
text:
The Chained Titans/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: For starters, we just want one name. Uh, Gustav?
Adrien: A little too Eiffel Tower-y.
Marinette: I don't think so!
Nino: You can't argue over this!
Marinette: We're not arguing! We're discussing.
Adrien: And we'll agree on something eventually. Flounder!
Marinette: Or, um, John Smith!
Adrien: Are you sure?
Nino: (whispers to Alya) Hey, we've got to talk. It's urgent. (to Adrien and Marinette) Uh, see you guys later! (takes Alya away)
Adrien: Julien?
Marinette: Jeremy?
Nino: Did you see Adrien and Marinette? Things are going badly between them!
Alya: Huh? No, they're not.
Nino: Believe me. First you're not sure about your hamsters' names, next you can't agree on whether to take a trip or buy a house, and eventually, you just—you...
Alya: You what?
Nino: Get divorced!
Alya: (surprised) Are we still talking about Marinette and Adrien?
(Nino looks away before looking at Alya's necklace.)
Nino: I know what they need!
Alya: Us to let them manage on their own and not meddle in their business?
Nino: They need to become superheroes!
Alya: What?!

title: The Chained Titans/Transcript
text:
The Chained Titans/Transcript - Intro
Nino: They'd share a mission, a secret—it'd totally strengthen their ties! They'd be like us: super united, totally open with each other, and sharing everything! And like us, they'd never break up!
Alya: O...K... but Ladybug's already handed out every Miraculous.
Nino: Sure, but we can make them our stand-ins!
Alya: Uh, I dunno. We should probably talk to...
Nino: (presses his Miraculous, calling Ladybug) Ladybug!
Alya: No! I meant we should talk to Marinette and Adrien!
Nino: Oops... too late.
(Alya facepalms.)
Adrien: Sine or Cosine?
Marinette: I'd just keep thinking about how bad I am at math.
(Marinette receives the signal from Nino.)
Marinette: Got to go!
Adrien: That's a strange name.
Marinette: No, I actually have to go.
Adrien: Ah.
Marinette: See you in class! (kisses Adrien)
Marinette: It's weird that Nino called me.
Tikki: Maybe he spotted an akumatized villain.
Marinette: We were together just a minute ago. If there was a villain, I'd have seen him too. Tikki, spots on! (transforms)
(Ladybug uses her yo-yo's map and sees Carapace and Rena Rouge are still at the school.)
Ladybug: And he's with Alya. That's strange.
Ladybug: Hey, you. What's up?

title: The Chained Titans/Transcript
text:
The Chained Titans/Transcript - Intro
Rena Rouge: Carapace has a (clears throat) bad (clears throat) idea to run by you.
Carapace: Rena and I thought—
Rena Rouge: You thought!
Carapace: Yeah, well, same thing. Anyway, we'd like to have stand-ins.
Ladybug: Uh, sure? Of course! These are your Miraculous, so you're free to entrust other people with them. I just need to know who in case there's a problem and I need to locate them.
Carapace: Don't worry. For the two we have in mind, there'll be no problem! For the Turtle Miraculous, Adrien Agreste!
(Ladybug starts looking shocked.)
Carapace: He's my best bud.
Ladybug: O...K?
Carapace: And for Alya's Miraculous, Marinette Dupain-Cheng!
(Ladybug is even more shocked and laughs nervously.)
Ladybug: Yes... I see. Um...
Rena Rouge: So, (clears throat) Ladybug, as Guardian and a very, very clever and very, very wise person, can you tell us what you think?
Ladybug: Uh, this is a bad idea.
Rena Rouge: Mhm.
Carapace: But why?
Ladybug: Well, uh, because I've met them before and they seem like the very busy kind. And, and, and who's to say they'd be willing to? Or able to?

title: The Chained Titans/Transcript
text:
The Chained Titans/Transcript - Intro
Carapace: Oh, I see! You're saying that because like many people who don't know them, you think Adrien's just a pretty boy who always gets everything he wants without lifting a finger and Marinette's a walking disaster always getting bogged down in Marinette moments!
Ladybug: "Marinette moments"?
Carapace: But Marinette and Adrien are not like that at all! They're brave, tenacious, always willing to take the time to help other people! Two hearts of gold. They're more than friends—they're role models!
Ladybug: Uh, well when you put it like that...
(Rena Rouge shakes her head at Ladybug.)
Ladybug: It does sound like a good idea.
(Rena Rouge glares at Ladybug.)
Carapace: Yeah, awesome! Come on, Rena, let's go tell 'em the good news!
(Carapace and Rena Rouge leave, and then Ladybug facepalms.)
Rena Rouge: Let's rest! (detransforms)
Carapace: Shell off! (detransforms) I'm so stoked! Marinette and Adrien will be even more bonded, and all four of us will be more than buddies—we'll be a real family! A family who loves each other and doesn't argue and will never split up!
Alya: Nino, I feel like you're not telling me the whole story. This is really about your parents, isn't it?

title: The Chained Titans/Transcript
text:
The Chained Titans/Transcript - Intro
Nino: Nah, don't worry!
Alya: Did they get into another fight?
Nino: Psh, you know them.
Alya: Was it more serious than normal?
Nino: No... I don't know, it's no use talking about it. Alright, I'll get Adrien, you get Marinette!
(He heads downstairs while Alya gives him a concerned look.)
Marinette: I swear I was going to say no, but those compliments about Adrien and me were just so moving! But that's OK. Ladybug might've said "yes," but Marinette can still say "no."
Alya: No. You have to say "yes."
Marinette: Huh? I thought I was supposed to say "no"!
Alya: Well, not anymore. This has become way too important for Nino.
Marinette: Uh, care to elaborate?
Alya: Nino's parents... they argue a lot, these days more than usual, so I think he needs to feel like the four of us are more united than ever.
Marinette: Oh, poor Nino. But I'm already Ladybug! I can't become Rena Rouge's stand-in! (gasps) What if you're not available one day and we both need Ladybug and Rena Rouge at the same time?! I'd have to turn into Lady Rouge, and I would betray my secret identity! (gasps; calmer) Am I having a Marinette moment?
Alya: Mhm.
Marinette: Is that really what you guys call it?

title: The Chained Titans/Transcript
text:
The Chained Titans/Transcript - Intro
Alya: Mhm. Don't worry though. We'll never need stand-ins. We'll just give you a run-down, you agree, do a quick test run, leap once or twice between buildings, then boom, we never mention it again! It's just to make Nino feel better.
Marinette: OK. For Nino.
Alya: (gets out her phone) I'll tell Adrien.
Adrien: I'm kinda scared of being a superhero, but if it's just this one time and it helps Nino feel better, then OK. Thanks for the heads up, Alya. (hangs up)
Plagg: (teasingly) "I'm kinda scared of being a superhero!" Winner for the best actor. Bravo! What are you gonna do though if you ever need to be both Cat Noir and the holder of the Turtle Miraculous? Being Carapaw would put your secret identity in jeopardy!
Adrien: There's no chance of that ever happening, Plagg. Besides, if Nino needs this.
(Adrien changes out of his fencing gear and begins to leave the locker room when Nino runs in.)
Nino: Hey dude! I was looking for you! (whispering) How would you like to become a superhero?
Adrien: What in the...
Carapace: Welcome to Miracle Station!
(Marinette and Adrien exclaim as an obstacle course is revealed to them.)

title: The Chained Titans/Transcript
text:
The Chained Titans/Transcript - Intro
Carapace: The mayor of Paris secretly remodeled this ghost metro station just for us Miraculers.
Rena Rouge: Let's rest! (detransforms)
Carapace: Shell off! (detransforms and gestures to Wayzz) This is the secret to our powers: kwamis! Meet Wayzz!
(Wayzz flies up to Adrien.)
Wayzz: Hello, Adrien!
Adrien: Uh, hello?
Alya: And Trixx!
(Trixx flies up towards Marinette.)
Trixx: Hello, Marinette Dupain-Cheng!
Marinette: (laughs nervously) Hello!
(Nino hands his Miraculous over to Adrien, and it changes its camouflage form.)
Nino: In order to transform, just say "Wayzz, shell on!"
Adrien: (nervously) Uh, Wayzz, shell on?
(Adrien transforms and pretends to be surprised. Alya then hooks her Miraculous on Marinette.)
Alya: In order to transform, you say "Trixx, let's pounce!"
Marinette: Trixx, let's pounce.
(Marinette transforms and looks at her costume.)
Renardette: Woah, amazing, I look like a renardette!
Alya: Awesome name, Renardette! Your flute allows you to create illusions. All you have to do is say "mirage."
Renardette: But I can't play the flute!

title: The Chained Titans/Transcript
text:
The Chained Titans/Transcript - Intro
Alya: It doesn't matter. Just blow into it and move your fingers—it works on its own. The main thing is you gotta clearly visualize in your mind what you want to create. So come on, conjure up... uh, a jar of pickles!
Renardette: OK... (plays into the flute) Mirage!
(She flings the energy ball created by the flute to the side, forming an illusion of a jar of pickles.)
Trionyx: Well done, Marinette. It looks just like the real thing!
Alya: Uh... no, it doesn't.
Nino: Uh-uh. There's no label on the jar.
Alya: If it's not realistic enough, people will know that something's off, and your illusion will be challenged in no time.
Renardette: Oh! OK, I really need to get detailed.
Alya: Say "reality" to erase everything, then try again.
Renardette: Reality! (plays into the flute) Mirage!
(The pickles disappear and reappear, now with a label.)
Alya: Oh, perfect, Renardette!
Nino: (to Trionyx) You're up next, dude! Have you thought of a name?
Trionyx: Uh, how about Trionyx? It's the genus of turtle. Would that be OK?
Nino: That's awesome! Now you're gonna activate a shield to protect the jar of pickles! All you've got to do is visualize it and say "shell-ter!"
Trionyx: Shell-ter!

title: The Chained Titans/Transcript
text:
The Chained Titans/Transcript - Intro
(A beam shoots out of Trionyx's shield and forms a force field around the pickle illusion.)
Nino: Great job, guys! You've got this! And now, time for the best part.
(Renardette and Trionyx look at each other puzzled.)
Renardette: Wow!
Trionyx: (laughs) It feels like flying—it's incredible!
Renardette: This is being superheroes together!
(The camera pans down to Nino and Alya on the ground.)
Nino: See, I told you it'd be awesome. It'll unite them more than ever, like us!
(Renardette and Trionyx continue jumping around, and then spin each other around.)
Renardette: This is magical, Trionyx. I wish this moment—
Trionyx: Would last forever, Renardette!
(They lean in to kiss each other, but are interrupted by the ground shaking. They look up to see The Chained Titans walking away from each other; and it reveals that Chrysalis has akumatized Nino's parents out of frustration from fighting over the jar and wanting a divorce due to their hatred. Renardette and Trionyx look at each other hesitantly before leaping towards them. The camera then pans back down to Alya.)
Alya: Uh, that wasn't part of the training!

title: The Chained Titans/Transcript
text:
The Chained Titans/Transcript - Intro
Nino: We've got to figure out a way to help Marinette and Adrien!(They run towards The Chained Titans, who are shown to be connected together by chains connected to their wedding jar. The female titan falls down after pulling away too hard. Renardette and Trionyx continue running towards the titans, who are both up again.)Trionyx: They look like akumatized villains! What do we do?
Renardette: We're not supposed to step in until Ladybug calls us, are we?(The male titan falls down along with the jar, causing earthquakes around Paris. Several people exclaim while Renardette and Trionyx look in horror.)Trionyx: We can still protect people, right?
Renardette: Yes, of course!

title: The Chained Titans/Transcript
text:
The Chained Titans/Transcript - Intro
Trionyx: Alright then, shell-ter!(A shield forms around a car and a group of people on the ground right before rubble hits them. The civilians look up in relief. Renardette then gasps, noticing the male titan getting up and causing the female titan and the jar to fall back down again, causing the top of a building to start to collapse where a group of kids are scootering towards. She jumps close by.)Renardette: (plays the flute) Mirage!(An illusion of a wall stops the kids, who then turn and go the other way.)Renardette: Reality!(The illusion disappears, revealing Renardette standing on the pile of rubble. She then heads into the sewers.)Tikki: (flies in) You make a great Renardette, but Ladybug needs to step in!
Renardette: Yup, and quick. Let's rest! (detransforms) Trixx, bring the Miraculous back to Alya and tell her that Marinette is fine.
Trixx: (takes the Miraculous)'' Right away, Guardian!
Marinette: Tikki, spots on!
Trionyx: Shell off! (detransforms) Take this to Nino, Wayzz. Please tell him that I'm OK.
Wayzz: (takes the Miraculous) Sure thing!
Plagg: I love discovering new cheeses, but I always come back to my favorite. How about you, Adrien?

title: The Chained Titans/Transcript
text:
The Chained Titans/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: Couldn't have said it better! Plagg, claws out! (transforms and jumps away)
Cat Noir: A mission last night, another today—we've become inseparable, M'Lady!
Ladybug: So have they by the looks of it.
(The Chained Titans continue trying to walk in opposite directions.)
Ladybug: How about you go give them a helping paw?
Cat Noir: Check if the Ultrakuma is in that jar? I'd love to!
(He uses his staff to launch himself up to the jar.)
Cat Noir: Cataclysm!
(The jar, chains, and titans all turn black and crumble. Cat Noir jumps back to where Ladybug is.)
Cat Noir: No Ultrakuma?
Ladybug: No akumatized villains?
(Within the remnants of the jar there is now a smaller version of The Chained Titans, who then grow to their original scale and continue walking away from each other, their chains still stopping them.)
Cat Noir: This is what I call an unexpected chain of events!
Ladybug: Lucky Charm!
(A giant anchor appears, which Ladybug narrowly dodges as it crashes into the ground.)
Cat Noir: Feeling like rocking the boat, M'Lady?
Nino: Wayzz, Trixx, where are Marinette and Adrien?
(The kwamis hand them their Miraculouses, which they put on.)
Wayzz: They're both fine! Don't worry.

title: The Chained Titans/Transcript
text:
The Chained Titans/Transcript - Intro
(Trixx giggles. A shadow then covers the four of them, and they look up to see the giant jar.)
Nino: That jar... It looks like... (gasps) my parents' wedding jar!
Alya: Go tell Ladybug.
(She and Nino kiss.)
[Transformation sequence.]Nino: Wayzz, shell on! (transforms into Carapace)
Carapace: I'll be back soon! (jumps away)
Carapace: Ladybug, Cat Noir, I know the akumatized villains. They're my parents.
(Ladybug and Cat Noir both exclaim.)
Carapace: The jar is their wedding present. They've been arguing forever over what to do with it. Never could agree on anything.
Ladybug: I get it. Since each one wants to go their own way, we're gonna force them to stay right here!
Carapace: How are we going to do that?
Ladybug: By anchoring them!
Cat Noir: Strong idea, m'lady!
Ladybug: Stay close to the jar; we'll need your shield. Cat Noir and I will throw them off balance!
Cat Noir: I love to throw wrenches in supervillains' gears!
(They all head in separate directions, with Ladybug wrapping her yo-yo around the anchor.)
Cat Noir: Cataclysm!

title: The Chained Titans/Transcript
text:
The Chained Titans/Transcript - Intro
(He causes damage to the streets. Ladybug then flings the anchor into the air. The damaged street causes the male titan to fall down while the anchor latches onto the female titan, causing her to fall as well.)
Ladybug: (over earpiece) Carapace, you're up!
Carapace: Shell-ter!
(A shield is formed around the jar. The Chained Titans get back up, but then realize they're anchored to the ground. They both try yanking their chains. Ladybug and Cat Noir meet back up with Carapace.)
Cat Noir: What now?
Ladybug: We wait.
Cat Noir: Huh? But this could last forever!
Carapace: Ladybug is right. They're the only ones who can escape their chains.
(Ladybug smiles at him. The male titan keeps yanking before trying to detach the chain off his back. The female titan does the same, but neither of them can reach. They then look at each other for a moment before walking over to each other.)
Carapace: They figured it out.
(The Chained Titans come up to each other, and then the female titan turns around so the male titan can undo her chain. She does the same for him. They then walk away from each other.)
Carapace: Unshield!
(The shield disappears, and Cat Noir jumps onto the jar again.)

title: The Chained Titans/Transcript
text:
The Chained Titans/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: Cataclysm!
(The jar breaks and Ladybug and Carapace jump over. The three of them then head to the small jar in the center of the broken jar.)
Ladybug: Get ready to catch them!
(Carapace and Cat Noir nod and leave while Ladybug breaks the jar with her yo-yo, causing The Chained Titans to turn back into Nino's parents. Carapace and Cat Noir catch them before they fall to the ground.)
Ladybug: No more evildoing for you, ultrakuma! (She opens up her yo-yo.) Time to de-evilize! (She catches the ultrakuma.) Gotcha! Bye-bye, little butterfly! (She releases the butterfly and then hooks her yo-yo onto the anchor before launching it in the air.) Miraculous Ladybug!
(The damaged streets and buildings are all fixed. Carapace and Cat Noir then bring the Lahiffes to where Ladybug is.)
Vita: What happened?
Nordine: I don't remember anything!
Ladybug: You got akumatized into two supervillains who seemed to want to go in opposite directions. These Magical Charms will help you to talk to each other without anger and agree on a direction together.
(The Lahiffes take the charms and then look at each other. Carapace walks over sadly, holding their wedding jar.)
Vita: You're right, Ladybug.

title: The Chained Titans/Transcript
text:
The Chained Titans/Transcript - Intro
Nordine: (takes the jar with Vita) It's time for us to have a calm conversation.
Miraculers: Pound it!
(The three of them jump away.)
Alya: That strawberry smoothie is just incredible! (looks at Nino's full glass) Aren't you gonna drink it?
Nino: The truth is, I've been meaning to tell you... I don't like strawberry! I'm sorry! I know it's one of your favorite fruits!
Alya: It's OK, Nino. We don't have to love the same things to love each other, as long as we tell each other everything.
Nino: As long as we tell each other everything.
(Marinette and Adrien join them at the table.)
Marinette: Hey, lovebirds!
Adrien: How are things at home?
Nino: Well, my parents have decided to split up.
Adrien: Oh no, I'm sorry.
Nino: The weird thing is, I'm kinda fine, actually, and so is my little bro! Things have been a lot calmer at home since they made the decision. We're gonna go on holiday for the first time ever! Two-week road trip with my dad in his convertible, and two weeks with my mom at my grandparents'!
(Alya gives Nino a hug. Then they both make mischievous faces towards Marinette and Adrien.)

title: The Chained Titans/Transcript
text:
The Chained Titans/Transcript - Intro
Nino: So, what about you two? Happy to be our stand-ins? Even though your first time was quite...
Adrien: Terrifying is what I'd call it. You know, I'm not sure I'm cut out to be a superhero.
Marinette: Neither am I. (holds Adrien's hand) Would you be OK with us remaining just Adrien and Marinette?
Nino: Honestly, you two are a really great fit for each other.
(The three of them laugh together.)
Nino: (to Alya) So are we, don't you think?
(The two of them kiss.)
Ladybug: You know, I was thinking today, maybe you should find a stand-in for yourself. Just in case, if you can't be Cat Noir for some reason like I've done with Scarabella!
Cat Noir: Being a superhero is amazing, but it can also be a heavy burden to bear. I wouldn't want to impose that on anyone.
Ladybug: (somewhat upset) It's your call, Kitty Cat.
