title: The Collector/Transcript
text:
The Collector/Transcript - Intro
[ Theme Song ]
Wayzz: Master, are you okay?
Master Fu: She's here!
(Marinette knocks on the door and Wayzz flies off and hides inside the phonograph.)
Master Fu: Hello, Ladybug!
Tikki: I know you never wanted me to bring her here again but... you must see what she's discovered. Show him, Marinette.
Marinette: I've been here; I've met you before. You're the healer that cured Tikki when she was sick! (Marinette has flashbacks of her meeting Master Fu.) Soo... I'm guessing you're not really a vet?
Master Fu: Not really. That was your first day of school, that wasn't a chance meeting either. (Master Fu has flashbacks of Marinette helping him.) Marinette, you're always ready to help others. I knew that day, that very moment, that you'd make a fantastic Ladybug!
Marinette: But, who are you?
(Master Fu stands up and guides Marinette to the phonograph and uses the code which unlocks access to the Miracle Box.)
Tikki: Master Fu is the last known member of the Order of the Guardians!
Wayzz: (Wayzz gets out of the phonograph and starts talking to Marinette.) Guardians of the Miraculous! I'm Wayzz, Master Fu's kwami. It's a pleasure to meet you, Marinette.
Marinette: Uhh, you too! (chuckles)

title: The Collector/Transcript
text:
The Collector/Transcript - Intro
Master Fu: We guardians are responsible for protecting and distributing the Miraculous, for the good of all humanity. We are chosen in childhood and trained for many years, specially for this mission. When we were much, much younger, we... (sighs) I made a mistake. The guardians' temple was destroyed, all because of me! Two of the Miraculous were lost that day. The Butterfly and the Peacock. Also gone forever was the ancient spellbook!
Marinette: But all it has are drawings of old superheroes and a bunch of strange symbols.
Master Fu: Not strange to a Guardian. Back in the days, I was never given the opportunity to even have a look at it, but I've been taught enough to be able to partially decipher the code.
(Marinette looks at Tikki, then hands the Miraculous book to Master Fu.)
Master Fu: These pages contain various spells capable of giving Ladybug and Cat Noir special abilities we haven't known about, until now! Obviously, this book is invaluable.
Gabriel: Why did you take the book?

title: The Collector/Transcript
text:
The Collector/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: I... I just wanted to know what you were hiding behind that portrait that was so important. You.. you never told me about those things. I was intending to give it back to you, I swear! But then... I lost it.
Gabriel: How can I possibly trust you again, Adrien?
Adrien: Sorry... I'll get you another copy.
Gabriel: It's one of a kind! The book's the source of my inspiration.
Adrien: I didn't know that. I hardly know anything about you, Father.
Gabriel: You won't be returning to school. You'll be home-schooled again...with Nathalie.
(Adrien is disappointed. Nathalie looks at Adrien and Gabriel leaves the room.)
Master Fu: I've always believed that whoever possessed this spellbook must also have the Peacock and the Butterfly Miraculous.
Marinette: Wait a sec, you mean whoever owned the spellbook could be Hawk Moth?
Master Fu: How did you discover this book, Marinette?
Marinette: (Marinette has a flashback of Adrien with the Miraculous book.) I... uh... I found it, lying on a bench in a park close to... close to the school.
Master Fu: You didn't see who it belonged to, then?
Marinette: No. No, I...didn't.
(Tikki looks at Marinette in a bewildered manner.)

title: The Collector/Transcript
text:
The Collector/Transcript - Intro
Master Fu: What a shame. For a moment, I thought we were about to discover the identity of Hawk Moth. We would've had a chance to defeat him.
Marinette: Uh... I could investigate if you want.
(Master Fu closes the book.)
Master Fu: But you must be very careful, Marinette. If you succeed, you may well find yourself face to face with Hawk Moth.
Marinette: I'll be very careful, I promise.
(Marinette stands up and leaves the shop along with Tikki.)
(Marinette is panting.)
Tikki: (pops out from Marinette's purse.) Why did you lie to Master Fu?!
Marinette: I couldn't tell him that Adrien was the one who had the book. Adrien can't be Hawk Moth! (gasps) But what if he is? (runs to a nearby Gabriel advertisement pole, right next to the school. She then imagines that Adrien is Hawk Moth.) Th-That would mean that I'm crazy in love with a supervillain! I can't be crazy in love with a supervillain... I... I'd have to fight him and...
Tikki: Calm down Marinette, I'm sure there's an explanation.
Marinette: I need to get to the bottom of this.
Tikki: Do you know where to find Adrien?
Marinette: I know that boy's schedule by heart.
Tikki: Let's go.
(Marinette runs towards the school.)

title: The Collector/Transcript
text:
The Collector/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: I don't see him. Something's up. Adrien never misses his fencing lessons.
Chloé: Oh no! (Marinette runs over to the sound of Chloé's voice)
(Marinette arrives at the classroom, only to see her classmates crowded around Chloé, who's holding her phone and crying while Sabrina attempts to comfort her.)
Chloé: This is a terrible tragedy! (crying)
Marinette: What's up with her?
Chloé: Adrien's never coming back to school! Ever! Oh.. (continues crying)
Kim: His dad grounded him!
Max: For life.
Marinette: What? Why?
Nino: Something about losing this major important book that belongs to his dad.
Marinette: His dad? Ha! Phew!
(Everyone stares at Marinette.)
Chloé: (irately) "Phew"?!
Marinette: (initially sheepish) "Phew". Cause I... I was scared it was super serious. I mean, yeah, sure, it really is serious but it's not like he's sick or anything, you know. Surely we can fix this, right? We won't just stand by and let this happen! Ha! (then runs off and leaves the classroom)
Marinette: So it wasn't Adrien's book. It was his father's! Adrien isn't Hawk Moth! (sighs in relief) I knew it! Adrien doesn't have an evil bone in his body.

title: The Collector/Transcript
text:
The Collector/Transcript - Intro
Tikki: Except, according to Nino, Adrien did take the book without his father's permission.
Marinette: Well, he must've had a good reason to do it.
Tikki: You realize, based on Master Fu's theory, Adrien's father could be Hawk Moth.
Marinette: No way! It couldn't be! Hmm... An eccentric artist who never leaves his home. Mysterious, very intelligent, but cold, even with his own son. This is a very strong lead, Tikki!
Tikki: Please be careful, Marinette!
Marinette: I will.
[Transformation Sequence]
Marinette: Tikki, spots on! Ha! (Marinette transforms into Ladybug.)
Cat Noir: (voicemail) Has the cat got your tongue? Leave a message!
Ladybug: Cat Noir, I think I know who Hawk Moth is! Get your whiskers over here fast!
Nathalie: What will you do without the book?
(Gabriel opens a blank notebook then closes it before handing it to Nathalie.)
Gabriel: You know where this goes.

title: The Collector/Transcript
text:
The Collector/Transcript - Intro
(Gabriel storms around while Nathalie walks toward the painting. Gabriel grabs a picture of Adrien off the wall and throws it on the floor, followed by a second picture of Adrien. He walks over to a small shelf in a cupboard, briefly looking at a drawing Adrien made when he was younger before throwing that as well. He proceeds to smash other objects.)
Plagg: Look on the bright side. Your father could've found out about me! It's a good thing we kwamis can never be filmed or photographed. Ah, those photographers have no idea what they're missing!
Adrien: I've gotta find that book, or I'll never be allowed to return to school.
Plagg: Return to school?! Are you crazy?! No more homework, no more alarm clocks! We should be celebrating! Hey, I know! (flies off, only to return carrying a huge jar of Camembert) I named this piece El Plaggo. It's been maturing for nine hundred and ninety-nine days!
(Adrien hears objects being broken to pieces and runs out of his room with his bodyguard following close behind.)
Adrien: What was that?!
(Adrien and his bodyguard run downstairs, only to be greeted by Nathalie guarding the door to Gabriel's atelier.)
Nathalie: Your father is very busy.

title: The Collector/Transcript
text:
The Collector/Transcript - Intro
(Gabriel has been continuing to smash things to pieces inside his atelier in displeasure. He throws a mannequin on the floor, breaking it in two. He then breaks another mannequin before heading over to something else. No more breaking is heard.)
Nathalie: Shouldn't Adrien be practicing his piano right now?
(Placide I.T. nods and looks briefly at Adrien before escorting him upstairs. Nathalie watches silently as Adrien looks back sadly.)
Hawk Moth: I feel...the wrath of a father betrayed by his son. What perfect prey for my akuma! (A butterfly flies into his open palm and he then transforms it into an akuma.) Stay close, my little akuma!
(The akuma flies towards the window, but then stops and hovers at the opening.)
Hawk Moth: Dark wings, fall! (detransforms, and Nooroo comes out of the Miraculous, facing the all-too-familiar man)
Nooroo: Uh, why is the akuma still here?
(The view faces the man, who takes off his tie, revealing the Butterfly Miraculous under it, and showing that Hawk Moth is Gabriel Agreste.)
Gabriel: I must become someone else to lead them astray.
Nooroo: I don't understand, Master.

title: The Collector/Transcript
text:
The Collector/Transcript - Intro
Gabriel: Nooroo, I renounce you... (takes off the Butterfly Miraculous, causing Nooroo to get sucked into it; then puts the Miraculous into a small box) ...temporarily. (A spotlight shines on his empty replacement notebook. Gabriel walks over and grabs it. He then opens it) Come to me, my little akuma, and evilize me!
(The akuma flies into Gabriel's notebook, transforming him.)
The Collector: I am now...the Collector! My book of inspiration has been taken from me, so I shall build a new one! And perhaps pick up a Miraculous or two while I'm at it! (laughs evilly)
Adrien: My father's angry because of me; he won't forgive me until I find that book.
Plagg: May I remind you that you're actually grounded?
Adrien: Adrien is, but Cat Noir isn't.
[Transformation Sequence]
Adrien: Plagg, claws out!
Plagg: Oh my!
(Adrien transforms into Cat Noir.)
(Cat Noir receives a notification from his staff and opens up a message he's received from Ladybug.)
Ladybug: (from recorded message) Cat Noir, I think I know who Hawk Moth is. Get your whiskers over here, fast!
Cat Noir: Wow! I guess the Spellbook will have to wait a bit longer.
(Cat Noir extends his staff and vaults off, leaving his room.)

title: The Collector/Transcript
text:
The Collector/Transcript - Intro
The Collector: Nathalie! You'll be the first of my many inspirations to come.
Nathalie: Mr. Agreste?
The Collector: You will call me...the Collector.
(The Collector swings his book at Nathalie and traps her inside his notebook; then does the same to Placide I.T. a moment later, before going up to Adrien's room and knocking on the door)
The Collector: Adrien...I have a great collection I want to show you.
(The Collector kicks open the door to Adrien's room and enters. When he sees that the piano music he heard had been coming from a CD player perched on the piano, he angrily swipes up the CD player, and growls.)
August's mother: Cheese!
(As the Louvre pyramid gets trapped inside the Collector's notebook, people start screaming and run away with fear. Inside the Louvre, the Collector traps the portrait of the Mona Lisa, and, outside again, Jagged Stone along with Fang.)
Nadja: Don't be bemused, it's just the news. I'm Nadja Chama—
The Collector: (swipes Nadja into his notebook) Since the book that used to fill my life is gone, I'm going to use your life to fill up this new one! [Camera gets warped and sucked by the notebook, which causes the program to shift to static]

title: The Collector/Transcript
text:
The Collector/Transcript - Intro
Mayor Bourgeois: People of Paris—
(Lieutenant Roger and the other pedestrians gasp after the mayor gets trapped inside the villain's notebook.)
(The Collector throws his notebook across the Eiffel Tower, trapping it inside his notebook book with the notebook returning to him like a boomerang)
The Collector: Nothing can inspire me more than imprisoning Ladybug and Cat Noir in these pages forever.
Ladybug: (grunts and slides open her yo-yo to contact Cat Noir) Cat Noir, what did you do? (suddenly sees Cat Noir arriving) Cat Noir, did you get my messages?
Cat Noir: Yeah, and I can't wait to know more, M'Lady-tective. So, who's the suspect?
Ladybug: Gabriel Agreste. (Cat Noir gasps and almost trips after hearing the suspect's name)  You know, the fashion designer?
Cat Noir: You got proof?
Ladybug: (stammers, as it is mostly secret) I can't tell you.
Cat Noir: So, I'm supposed to just... accept that?
Ladybug: You must trust me on this. But it all makes sense. Gabriel Agreste is a secretive man and he never leaves his house. And get this. (shows Cat Noir images of Gabriel's fashion design logos on her yo-yo screen) Check out his brand's logo.

title: The Collector/Transcript
text:
The Collector/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: (stunned) A butterfly? (has flashbacks of the butterfly patterns on furniture inside his house, and sighs after thinking about it)
Ladybug: You okay, Cat Noir?
Cat Noir: (with grim determination) It's time to get the bottom of this.
(Cat Noir and Ladybug leave the school to go and investigate.)
The Collector:  (behind a statue) My plan is working perfectly!
Ladybug: (shocked) Whoa, what happened here? Looks like somebody had a little tantrum.
(Cat Noir sees his painting of him and his family that was thrown on the floor by his father. Cat Noir sighs with heartache.)
Ladybug: Are you sure you're okay?
Cat Noir: Yeah. Yeah, let's keep going.
Ladybug: (gasps) He's got a son! Let's go check his room; make sure nothing's happened to him.
(Ladybug and Cat Noir run towards the front hall until they see the Collector at the top of the main stairs.)
Cat Noir: Where's Gabriel Agreste?
The Collector: There is no more Gabriel Agreste. There is only...the Collector!

title: The Collector/Transcript
text:
The Collector/Transcript - Intro
(He throws his notebook towards Ladybug, trying to trap her inside of it; but she manages to dodge the hit, which leads the notebook to trap the Mansion entrance door instead. The notebook heads back the way it came, towards Ladybug and Cat Noir. Ladybug knocks Cat Noir to the floor before the notebook manages to touch them.)
The Collector: You won't be able to escape!
(The Collector's notebook continues chasing Ladybug and Cat Noir around the room as they both vault away from it using their yo-yo and staff. They then come to the large dining room.)
Ladybug: (to Cat Noir) Wait!
(Cat Noir throws his staff towards the Collector, only to have it trapped inside his notebook, which causes the superheroes to gasp.)
The Collector: Nice piece, wouldn't you agree?
(Cat Noir throws a chair at the Collector, which gets trapped inside his notebook as well. Ladybug and Cat Noir continue running away back into the main hall. The Collector erases the trapped chair inside his notebook.)
Ladybug:  The akuma's gotta be in that book!
Cat Noir: Yeah, but if we touch it, we'll disappear!

title: The Collector/Transcript
text:
The Collector/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: Lucky Charm! (A set of pedals appears) A pedal? (Ladybug tries her Lucky Vision to figure out what to do with the pedal, but sees nothing.) I have no idea what to do with this. We need to stall him.
The Collector: (uses his notebook to make the staircase disappear) Ladybug and Cat Noir, you shall be the masterpieces in my new book of inspiration.
(The fight continues with Ladybug and Cat Noir trying to avoid getting touched with the Collector's notebook. The Collector grunts when he vigorously tries to touch Cat Noir with his book but fails. Ladybug then attaches her yo-yo onto his arm, making his notebook released from his hand, which gives him the opportunity to touch Ladybug but that doesn't work either. Cat Noir kicks the notebook away from his hand, but the Collector kicks Cat Noir and tries to reach for his notebook. Ladybug uses her yo-yo and attaches it to the Collector's leg, pinning him on to the floor. However, the Collector manages to grab his notebook and traps Ladybug's yo-yo inside. Ladybug shrieks as the loss of the yo-yo string throws her off-balance.)
The Collector: My collection's growing!
Ladybug: No!

title: The Collector/Transcript
text:
The Collector/Transcript - Intro
(Ladybug, Cat Noir and the Collector are grunting as they are fighting. As the Collector continues chasing Ladybug and Cat Noir, they jump up to the second floor.)
Cat Noir: So that must mean...Gabriel Agreste can't possibly be Hawk Moth, since he's been akumatized!
Ladybug: You call Agreste turning into the Collector good news?!
(The superheroes are still running away from the Collector.)
(The superheroes barricade the door entrance using the furniture in Adrien's room to prevent the Collector from entering.)
Ladybug: Gabriel Agreste's son isn't at home?
Cat Noir: Maybe the Collector's already captured him.
Ladybug: (gasps in shock) You think he'd take it out on his own son?
Cat Noir: Uh...
The Collector: You cannot escape from me. (laughs after making the objects blocking his way disappear)
Ladybug: What if he has no pages left in his book? (uses her Lucky Vision again, seeing certain objects, and figures out a plan)
(After the Collector manages to free himself from the barricaded entrance, he chases Ladybug and Cat Noir around the room. Ladybug hides behind the TV out of the Collector's sight.)

title: The Collector/Transcript
text:
The Collector/Transcript - Intro
The Collector: But before I immortalize you, allow me to seize your Miraculous for Hawk Moth.
Ladybug: Cat Noir, I need ammunition!
(The Collector traps the TV and chases Ladybug.)
Cat Noir: You need what?
Ladybug: We're gonna complete his collection!
Cat Noir: Very smart M'Lady, quite ingenious.
Ladybug: Less talking, more doing!
(Ladybug detaches Cat Noir's tail from his suit and leaps next to the Foosball table while Cat Noir continues fighting the Collector by his library, until the Collector is thrown onto the rock-climbing wall.)
Cat Noir: Cataclysm!
(Cat Noir uses the cataclysm on the bookshelf, with CDs dropping down. Ladybug then attaches the pedal along with Cat Noir's tail to the Foosball table to create a makeshift device)
Ladybug: Ready, Cat Noir?
Cat Noir: I'm always ready for you, M'Lady!
(Ladybug uses the makeshift device to fire numerous CDs dropped down by Cat Noir towards the Collector as he approaches Ladybug, capturing the CDs, thus neutralizing the pages inside his notebook.)
Ladybug: Come on! Come on!
Cat Noir: No more ammo!

title: The Collector/Transcript
text:
The Collector/Transcript - Intro
(As the Collector closes in on Ladybug, he traps the Foosball table itself inside his notebook, and then touches Ladybug; but the pages of his notebook are filled up.)
The Collector: Huh? It's already full!
(The Collector is about to remove one of the CDs from his notebook, but Ladybug kicks the notebook out of his hand, with Cat Noir catching it and then throwing it to Ladybug)
The Collector: My book! No!
Ladybug: (rips the book into two pieces and the akuma flies out) Miraculous Ladybug!
(throws the Lucky Charm into the air and turns everything back to normal, including returning Cat Noir's baton and he kisses it and Ladybug's yo-yo to them)
Ladybug: No more evildoing for you, little akuma. Time to de-evilize! (catches the akuma with her yo-yo) Gotcha! (releases the akuma, turning it back into a normal butterfly) Bye bye, little butterfly. (The Collector turns back to Gabriel.)
Ladybug: Pound...Uh. (Ladybug sees Cat Noir heading towards Gabriel.)
Cat Noir: Are you okay, Faaa...sir?
Gabriel: Cat Noir, Ladybug, what happened to me?
Cat Noir: You were akumatized by Hawk Moth. But don't worry, it's over now!

title: The Collector/Transcript
text:
The Collector/Transcript - Intro
Gabriel: Thank you, thank you, both of you! (gasps upon realizing that his son is nowhere to be seen) Adrien...where is my son?
Cat Noir: He...must be hiding?
Ladybug: Cat Noir is right, otherwise your son would have reappeared right here.
Gabriel: Nothing must happen to him. He's too precious to me. (puts his hands on the shoulders of Cat Noir, who gazes at him, smiling)
Ladybug: (notices the spots on her earring are about to wear off and warns Cat Noir) We're about to transform back. Goodbye, Mr. Agreste.
Cat Noir: Don't worry yourself, sir. I'm sure your son is safe and sound.
(Ladybug and Cat Noir vault off, assured that everything is fine with Gabriel. Gabriel smiles evilly to himself.)
Gabriel: See you very soon!
Marinette: So, since Gabriel Agreste was akumatized, he can't possibly be Hawk Moth, right?
Master Fu: That's very probable, but...how did you find out that Gabriel Agreste was the owner of the Spellbook?

title: The Collector/Transcript
text:
The Collector/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: At first, I was thinking the book belonged to Gabriel Agreste's son, Adrien, 'cause I saw him with it at school — well before it was stolen by a girl and before Tikki got it back; and I'd only just met you so I...I didn't know if I could tell you that, so yeah.
Master Fu: You were afraid in case the one you love turned out to be Hawk Moth.
Marinette: (stammers) Wha... Uh, no, uh, how did you know that? I mean, I don't love him at all. (chuckles nervously as Master Fu giggles) Oh, all right, yes, Adrien is amazing. I couldn't stand the thought of him being a supervillain.
Master Fu: You know, Marinette, if we want to be stronger than Hawk Moth, we have to trust each other.
Marinette: I know; but now, Adrien will never be able to come back to school because I can never give him that book back. I'll never ever see him again! (falls over on the floor, whimpering)
Master Fu: There isn't a single problem that can't be solved, Marinette. (starts taking pictures of the contents of the Miraculous Spellbook using his phone) These modern inventions really are quite incredible. Hmm.

title: The Collector/Transcript
text:
The Collector/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: So, when Adrien put the book down and walked away, I wanted to take a peek. You see, I thought it was a portfolio with lots of pictures of him 'cause he's so cute. Uh, but you already knew that. (giggles) Anyway, um, when he came back, I was scared he'd see me staring at his book so I hid it in my backpack and I know it was a dumb thing to do. I'm really, really sorry.
Gabriel: I see. So, you're one of his admirers?
Marinette: Admirers? Yeah. That's the word. (gives the Miraculous book back to Gabriel, who passes it to Nathalie) You won't say anything to him, will you? (Gabriel shakes his head for "no") Are you going to let Adrien come back to school?
Gabriel: Well, considering he didn't actually lose my book as it was borrowed by you, yes I will.
Marinette: (chuckles) Thank you. (Nathalie guides Marinette out the door) Hmm, can I ask you a question? (Gabriel nods) I flipped through the book and it looked really awesome. Those illustrations of legendary heroes are super...inspiring. Where did you get it?
Gabriel: I found it while I was on a trip overseas with my wife. I've never seen another copy of it.

title: The Collector/Transcript
text:
The Collector/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Well then, you're very lucky to own it. (waves and leaves)
Tikki: It was really brave what you just did for Adrien.
Marinette: Thanks, Tikki. All that really matters is for Adrien to be allowed out of the house again. (slowly walks away from the Agreste mansion)
Gabriel: I'm sorry I became so furious over a book.
Adrien: I shouldn't have taken it without your permission.
Gabriel: That book...was the very last gift your mother gave to me before...before she disappeared. All I have left of her is this book...and you. But I know I can't keep the book or you locked up in this house forever.
Adrien: Does that mean you'll let me go back to school, then?
Gabriel: Hm. (nods his head)

title: The Dark Owl
text:
The Dark Owl - Intro
"" is a season 2 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 13th written and produced episode of season 2. It is also the 39th written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: The Dark Owl
text:
The Dark Owl - Synopsis
Netflix
After school principal Damoclès is akumatized into Dark Owl, he traps Ladybug and Cat Noir in a warehouse and tries to uncover their true identities.
KidsClick
The school principal Mr. Damoclès gets akumatized into Dark Owl. Armed with high-tech gadgets, he wants to get revenge on Ladybug and Cat Noir, who've humiliated him. To stop him, our heroes will have to ruffle his feathers!
Disney+
Ladybug faces Principal Damoclès, now the Dark Owl.

title: The Dark Owl
text:
The Dark Owl - Plot
At the end of the school day, Mr. Damoclès hurriedly rushes Marinette, Alya, Nino, and Adrien out of the school before closing the doors behind them. Denis Damoclès then tip-toes into his office, making sure nobody is watching him, and boots up his computer program, Albert. He attempts to get Albert to open up the secret compartment behind his painting with a secret code; however, after several failed attempts, Damoclès is forced to open it manually, revealing several framed Knightowl comics, a Knightowl figurine, a grappling hook, a boomerang and a custom-made Knightowl costume. Donning the (somewhat ill-fitting) suit, Denis Damoclès takes up the identity of The Owl and heads out to patrol Paris.

title: The Dark Owl
text:
The Dark Owl - Plot
Outside, Mr. Damoclès attempts to help a mother and son rescue their cat from a tree, although all his attempts to do so fail, until Cat Noir and Ladybug arrive to save him and the cat from falling. Ladybug and Cat Noir mention that this is the fifth time they've had to save Owl from himself and advise him to not attempt to be a superhero and endanger himself. TVi reporters arrive on the scene and Clara Contard interviews The Owl. The Owl claims that he will try to do better next time, being oblivious to Ladybug's and Cat Noir's real point, before running off, not realizing that the camera was following him the entire time, leaving Ladybug and Cat Noir to deal with the press. Both Ladybug and Cat Noir advise the children of Paris to not act like The Owl and try to be superheroes like him, as it is dangerous. At the end of her broadcast, Nadja Chamack asks the question of who The Owl's real identity is.

title: The Dark Owl
text:
The Dark Owl - Plot
That evening, Ladybug and Cat Noir discuss Denis Damoclès's superhero antics on a rooftop and decide to create a plan to make him feel like a real hero for at least one day so that his dream will be fulfilled and he'll stop acting like a superhero. Through the night, Marinette creates fake copies of her earrings, Cat Noir's ring, and a fake supervillain costume made out of cardboard.

title: The Dark Owl
text:
The Dark Owl - Plot
The next day after school ends and Denis Damoclès yet again takes up his Owl persona, Ladybug and Cat Noir go to Alya's house, and they tell her about their plan. Alya agrees to pretend to be a villain, named "Cardboard Girl", who is holding them hostage. Alya calls Denis Damoclès and "reveals" that she has captured Ladybug and Cat Noir and that he is the only one who can save them. At the park, Cardboard Girl is taking Ladybug and Cat Noir's fake Miraculouses. Ladybug and Cat Noir then pretend to be in danger but act relieved when The Owl arrives. Owl fires his grappling hook at Cardboard Girl, only for it to end up snagging onto a moving garbage truck, which drags him into a fence. Ladybug apologizes for what happened and slips up by revealing The Owl's identity of Denis Damoclès while people are snapping pictures of him. The Owl runs off crying, with Ladybug, Cat Noir and Alya left hoping that nobody has heard about what has happened.

title: The Dark Owl
text:
The Dark Owl - Plot
Back in his office, Denis Damoclès is on the internet, where the news has revealed his identity to Paris and Alec Cataldi is mocking him. Meanwhile, Hawk Moth senses Denis Damoclès's sadness and sends an akuma after him. The akuma enters Damoclès's computer, and Hawk Moth offers Denis Damoclès real powers and weapons in exchange for Ladybug's and Cat Noir's Miraculouses. Denis Damoclès accepts Hawk Moth's offer and is transformed into The Dark Owl.

title: The Dark Owl
text:
The Dark Owl - Plot
Later that evening, Marinette is sewing in her room while Tikki watches Clara Nightingale's music video on her computer. Dark Owl then hijacks the television broadcasts throughout Paris, to the disbelief and horror of Marinette and Tikki, as well as Adrien and Plagg. Dark Owl announces that he has kidnapped a multitude of zoo animals, locked them in a bus dangling off the Eiffel Tower, and, with the press of a button, can drop them all on a helpless kitten; and if anyone tries to save them, liquid nitrogen bombs will freeze and shatter the tower's structure, destroying them anyway. Dark Owl then demands that Ladybug and Cat Noir hand over their Miraculouses to him, also telling them to follow his Owl-Signal to find him before ending the transmission. Marinette and Adrien then immediately transform into their respective superhero identities. At the same time, Dark Owl gets Albert to activate the Owl-Signal.
Ladybug and Cat Noir meet on a rooftop, coming up with a plan of letting Cat Noir distract Dark Owl while Ladybug sneaks up on him from behind.

title: The Dark Owl
text:
The Dark Owl - Plot
At the Stade des Princesses, Cat Noir, as per the plan, distracts Dark Owl by talking while Ladybug scouts the villain from the back, guessing that the akuma must be in one of his weapons on his belt.
Ladybug attacks Dark Owl and manages to knock his detonator to Cat Noir, only to be flung away onto her partner by Dark Owl's hook line.
Dark Owl tells the heroes that they have one last chance to surrender their Miraculouses, but they still refuse.
Dark Owl ensnares the two using his grappling hook, and they are forced to roll away as Dark Owl attempts to pounce on them.
Cat Noir uses his Cataclysm on the ropes to escape, and Ladybug uses her Lucky Charm soon afterward, receiving a fountain pen.
Ladybug and Cat Noir incapacitate Dark Owl long enough for them to get a hold of the detonator on top of a shipping crate, only to find that the countdown will not stop.
Dark Owl then has Albert open a trapdoor on the crate, dropping the two inside the crate and trapping them there; he reveals that the animals, bus and bombs were nothing but holograms.

title: The Dark Owl
text:
The Dark Owl - Plot
At that moment, the crate begins to fill up with whipped cream, which Dark Owl claims will drown the two heroes if they refuse to give up their Miraculouses. Ladybug spots the camera lens at the top of the crate, Cat Noir's ring, and the pen. She then squirts the pen ink over the lens so that Dark Owl can't watch them, although the latter is unfazed by this. Cat Noir is unable to break down the crate's walls, and deems their situation hopeless; however, Ladybug instead decides to give up and hand over their Miraculouses, telling Cat Noir that they must close their eyes when they detransform.

title: The Dark Owl
text:
The Dark Owl - Plot
Both Tikki and Plagg see each others' Miraculous wielders, which shocks Plagg, but they don't say anything. Marinette is about to take Adrien's ring but, remembering she still has the fake Miraculous she had made, gives those to Dark Owl, who in turn sends them to Hawk Moth. Feeling triumphant for a moment, Hawk Moth discovers the Miraculouses are fake, but by then, both kwamis have been able to recharge. The two heroes once again transform, and Cat Noir destroys the crate. Dark Owl wonders how they did it, but Ladybug merely tells him that they would never give him their Miraculouses and claims to have had a Plan A, B, C, and all the alphabet to Z.

title: The Dark Owl
text:
The Dark Owl - Plot
Dark Owl fires his boomerangs at them while the heroes are still trying to figure out where the akuma is. Telling Cat Noir to cover her, Ladybug uses her Lucky Charm and receives a Knightowl comic book. Upon reading it, she figures out that since the "real" Knightowl has a partner, so must Dark Owl. Just as Cat Noir manages to restrain him, she realizes the akuma is back at the school and goes to Principal Damoclès's office to try to destroy the akumatized computer, but Dark Owl gets there, too. She kicks the rolled-up comic book to the Knightowl figurine that's on the secret compartment, but the villain is able to remove one of her earrings, almost detransforming Ladybug. Then the falling figurine triggers a chain reaction that knocks over the monitor, releasing the akuma, and Ladybug retrieves her earring and purifies the akuma. Hawk Moth is once again defeated but vows to get revenge. Afterward, Ladybug and Cat Noir see that Denis Damoclès has become a superhero on a smaller scale by doing good deeds and has genuinely earned people's admiration.

title: The Dark Owl
text:
The Dark Owl - Plot
Now that Cat Noir and Ladybug have more free time, Cat Noir asks her if she'll go to the movies with him. She politely turns down his offer, saying that she made a promise to hang out with someone else and that he'll see her soon, as she swings away, leaving Cat Noir smiling wistfully. At Alya's house, Marinette is playing a video game with Alya. As Alya explains her latest adventure with Ladybug and Cat Noir, Marinette wins the game. Startled, Alya says it was unfair because she wasn't looking and tickles Marinette, leaving the two of them laughing. Tikki quietly laughs before the end card appears.

title: The Dark Owl
text:
The Dark Owl - Plot Developments
Following "Animan", it shows that the Miraculous tools also adapt to the era, their holder lives in such as Ladybug's yo-yo and Cat Noir's baton having a camera and both having communication earpiece sets.
Following "Lady Wifi", Adrien removes his Miraculous but unlike before he does so willingly with the intent of giving it away, yet Plagg didn't disappear. This could be because he gave up the Miraculous reluctantly but did not want to lose it. Meaning a kwami will only disappear if said owner renounces their jewel intentionally and fully.
Plagg and Tikki interact together onscreen for the first time and find out who the others' Miraculous holder is revealing that Adrien was right.
This episode starts the exploration of Miraculouses that function as multiple pieces starting with Ladybug's:
This is first instance where an akumatized villain manages to take a Miraculous, although it was only one of her earrings.
The instance confirms that she needs both earrings to maintain her transformation.
While her suit slowly disappears, her yo-yo remains.

title: The Dark Owl
text:
The Dark Owl - Plot Developments
Through Kamikotization it reveals that an akumatized villain does not need to be in constant possession of the akumatized item to retain his or her powers.
Hawk Moth's desire is hinted at, as he wishes to change a certain event from the past.
As of "Evolution", we learned that the event he wanted to rewrite, Emilie's coma by fixing the Peacock Miraculous in the past.

title: The Dark Owl
text:
The Dark Owl - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in Spain on Disney Channel.
In the French version, the episode is called "Le Hibou Noir", which literally translates to "The Black Owl."
Jun Violet, co-director for the episode, makes a cameo in it as the face of the akumatized version of Albert, Denis Damoclès' computer program assistant.
This episode was first revealed in a promotional poster for Season 2 released by TFOU on October 16, 2017.
It was first announced it would be released on November 26, 2017, in France, but it was later confirmed to not be planned for that date anymore, "Gigantitan" airing instead.
Plagg recharges after eating a macaron instead of his regular Camembert.
This is the second episode where Tikki and Plagg don't have any speaking roles.
This episode reveals that Marinette is ticklish.
Ladybug and Cat Noir detransform in front of each other for the first time, although they keep their eyes closed while doing so to avoid discovering each others' identities.
This is the first episode where the summoning sequence for Cataclysm isn't seen, despite the ability being used twice.
Clara Nightingale makes a cameo appearance in a music video on Marinette's computer.

title: The Dark Owl
text:
The Dark Owl - Trivia
Alya's bedroom debuts in this episode.
Within her room, there are action figures of Ladybug and Cat Noir that are holding hands.
When the closeup of the Knightowl comic book is shown, Knightowl and his butler are seen saying "Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing" and "Elit, sed do eiusmod", from the Latin Lorem ipsum graphic design placeholder text.
References
The picture Nadja Chamack shows of Denis Damoclès is Miss Bustier's class photo that was taken in "Reflekta".
At the stadium, one of the signs reads "GAZ" which is the Zag Logo backwards.
Allusions
Nearly the entire episode is a homage to the 1960s Batman series. Similarly, Dark Owl's ruse is similar to the Joker's plan in The Dark Knight.
The Justice Comics #27 cover seen behind Denis Damoclès's secret panel is a reworking of Detective Comics #27, in which Batman first appeared, and the cover of the Lucky Charm comic Ladybug obtains, Knight Owl #1, is based on Batman #1.
On the back of the Knightowl comic book, there's an advertisement which is similar to the real-life 1960s vintage comic books.

title: The Dark Owl
text:
The Dark Owl - Trivia
An animation error occurs when Ladybug leaves the Stade des Princesses where the back cover of the comic book changes to a "Got Mint?" ad. The "Got Mint?" ad is an obvious reference to the real-life Got Milk? advertising campaign.
After emerging from the crate Ladybug says, "A superhero never reveals their secrets", referencing to the famous rule of magicians, "A magician never reveals their secrets".
Errors
When Clara Contard pans the camera to Ladybug and Cat Noir after Denis Damoclès runs off, the microphone she's holding disappears for one frame.
When Denis Damoclès picks up his phone, his arm and the phone didn't have any shadow reflection.
When he rolls on his table, his body doesn't have any shadow reflection either.
When Denis Damoclès gets up after he was pulled into a trashcan by a garbage truck trying to save Ladybug and Cat Noir, his head disappears for a few frames and only his mask's ears are visible.
One of the civilians who starts filming Mr. Damoclès is holding a switched-off cellphone.
When Alec is declaring Denis Damoclès as the "Biggest Loser", he puts his arms up and skin is visible near the neck of his shirt.

title: The Dark Owl
text:
The Dark Owl - Trivia
When Dark Owl is being akumatized, his keyboard and mouse are shown to have wires, but in every other scene, they are wireless.
When Dark Owl is threatening the Eiffel Tower, his description contradicts the fact that, whether the temperature scale is Fahrenheit or Celsius, there is no such temperature as "minus 700 degrees", because the lowest possible temperature is what's called "absolute zero", which is not as low as –700 in either scale, only being -273.15ºC (-459.67ºF).
However, he later states that his related threats were holograms, so his temperature threat was likewise made up.
In one shot, the kitten had green eyes and in the second shot, before the hologram disappeared, the kitten had blue eyes.
When Cat Noir uses Cataclysm to destroy the ropes tying him and Ladybug together, his ring is on his left hand instead of his right.
The detonator that Ladybug is holding disappears for a few shots but then reappears when she and Cat Noir are in the crate.
After The Dark Owl shows Ladybug and Cat Noir that the kitten and the bus were holograms and they both are shocked, Cat Noir's left eye glitches weirdly.
In the same shot, Cat Noir's face looks stretched.

title: The Dark Owl
text:
The Dark Owl - Trivia
The whipped cream was rising at a rate that would've at least reached their shoulders or above by the time it stopped and drained; however, it remained at only their waists the whole time.
The fake Cat and Ladybug Miraculouses switch places in Hawk Moth's hand.
In the Tikki and Plagg flashback, the macaron is whole in Marinette's hand, but is suddenly broken in half when held by Tikki. It's broken in such a way that in real life, it wouldn't have held together.
On the back of the Knightowl comic book, there's an advertisement for various objects that are similar to the real-life 1960s vintage comic books. However, when Ladybug leaves to get to Collège Françoise Dupont, the back of the comic book changes to a "Got Mint?" advertisement.
When Ladybug triggers the chain reaction in Denis Damoclès's office, the item that started it was the Knightowl action figure which falls off the secret compartment and lands on two books. However, when the lamp knocks Denis Damoclès's computer monitor off the table, the action figure is back on the secret compartment.
When Dark Owl releases Ladybug and jumps to catch Albert, Ladybug is shown with her full suit and mask before retrieving her earring.

title: The Dark Owl
text:
The Dark Owl - Trivia
Clara Contard incorrectly uses the model of Lila's first mother, which was confirmed to be an animation error.
When Marinette and Alya leave the school for the second time, the end of Marinette's line (when she says "tomorrow") is cut off.

title: The Crypt
text:
The Crypt - Intro
was a garden located somewhere beneath the Agreste mansion. It was in this place that Gabriel Agreste kept his wife's body in a coffin.
As of "Re-creation", Marinette and Gabriel clashed in the crypt. After reducing the crypt to rubble, Gabriel lost his Miraculous, but later paralyzed Marinette, gaining both Ladybug and Black Cat Miraculouses, thereby achieving his goal of uniting Tikki and Plagg to reveal Gimmi to make his wish to revive Nathalie Sancoeur.
In "Miraculous London", the cryogenic pod, bridge, and elevator to the crypt were destroyed by Bug Noire's Cataclysm so Adrien doesn't find out that his father was Monarch.

title: The Crypt
text:
The Crypt - Appearance
It was a large room with an arched ceiling, barely lit by lights along the side walls and what appears to be a beam of sunlight from a skylight. The bottom's fully covered with water. A catwalk extends the length of the room down the middle. The other end starts at the back where the elevator in the glass tube is. The far end of the room appears to have a tree growing from the floor below, and the main wall at that end features a design identical to the "butterfly window" in Gabriel's lair. Like that window, it can also be uncovered to let in light.
At the end of the catwalk is a circular platform covered in greenery; grass covers the floor, bushes and flora decorate the platform, and what appear to be trees snake across as well as underneath the platform. A green glow emanates from underneath the platform where Émilie Agreste was previously held in a glass-covered cryogenic pod, which required an "insane power supply". As seen in "Party Crasher", white butterflies were bred from the tree growing around Émilie's pod.
As revealed in "Queen Wasp", Gabriel previously accessed this room via the same secret passage from his atelier that he uses to get to his lair.

title: The Crypt
text:
The Crypt - Trivia
On August 26, 2018, Feri González teased that the location would make another appearance "very soon" after "Gorizilla". This turned out to occur in "Style Queen" and "Queen Wasp".
In "Party Crasher", it was revealed that the Agreste mansion has the energy equivalent of a nuclear power plant, so it can be assumed that Émilie's coffin used a lot of energy to keep her body in good condition.
It could also be assumed that the pipes visible under the hanging garden were power outlets.
Also in "Party Crasher", it was revealed that in the basement Gabriel and Nathalie grew butterflies that were then used for future akumatizations.
In "Cat Blanc", Ladybug and Cat Noir fought a decisive battle in this place, and Hawk Moth showed Émilie's coffin to his son. This shocked him deeply, which resulted in the defeat of the two superheroes. But these events were erased thanks to Ladybug, with the help of the Bunnyx from the future.

title: The Crypt
text:
The Crypt - Trivia
A similar situation also happened in "Ephemeral": Adrien, discovering his father's secret, was akumatized, which would have led to the victory of Shadow Moth who became Shadow Noir with her son's Miraculous. However, these events were erased thanks to Sass' Second Chance.
However, these two similar scenes were set in a hypothetical future.

title: The Illustrhater
text:
The Illustrhater - Intro
"" is a season 6 episode of the series Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. Based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 2nd written and produced episode of season 6. It is also the 133rd written and produced episode of the series overall.

title: The Illustrhater
text:
The Illustrhater - Synopsis
Disney Channel
Ladybug and her team face a villain full of imagination.
Gloob
While Marinette struggles with her controlling instincts, Ladybug and her team face a villain full of imagination.
Disney+
Ladybug and her team face an imaginative villain.

title: The Illustrhater
text:
The Illustrhater - Plot
In her lair, Cerise is seen writing in a book. In her lair lie multiple stacks of books, hundreds in total, while Nooroo is paralyzed on the table, forced to watch.
In Marinette's room, Alya recaps the events of Gabriel Agreste's time as Hawk Moth, Shadow Moth, and Monarch, including facts such as that he was an adult male. Marinette, visibly shaken, adds that he wanted one wish, on the way akumatizing 212 people, and panics that she handed out all of the Miraculous to their separate holders, which she believes could be dangerous due to the possibility of one of the holders being akumatized. Alya reassures her that that is very unlikely to happen as they now know how to deal with their emotions better. As the sun rises, Marinette remembers her and Alya's movie date with Adrien and Nino respectively, but Alya, exhausted from staying up all night, suggests cancelling. Marinette, worried about the prospect of messing up with Adrien encourages her to come, and doesn't give it up.

title: The Illustrhater
text:
The Illustrhater - Plot
Later, at a tram stop, the date has not been cancelled, and Alya and Nino handshake. Marinette tries to imitate them, but accidentally pokes Adrien. The four get onto the tram, and Alya and Marinette make faces at each other and copy each other's motions. Suddenly, the tram comes to a stop; there's a crack in the road. Alya and Nino transform into Rena Rouge and Carapace, both using their respective powers to get the tram back on track and to make sure traffic stops and goes at the right time. A few civilians congratulate and compliment these heroics.
In an alley, Carapace and Rena Rouge transform back, making a plan to leave Marinette and Adrien alone, which would also make time for them to investigate more about the new Butterfly Miraculous holder. Marinette frantically texts Alya upon noticing her and Nino's absences, but Alya brushes it off. Marinette is visibly nervous that she has to be alone with Adrien, which Adrien starts to notice at a point, but tries not to worry about it.

title: The Illustrhater
text:
The Illustrhater - Plot
Adrien and Marinette wait in a line to enter Le Sorbonne to watch a movie, but Marinette looks around, noticing couples showing affection to each other in various ways. Marinette tries to imitate all of these, but ends up accidentally holding a stranger's hand. Adrien points out Ryuko's appearance, which Marinette uses as an escape to transform into Ladybug. Ryuko jumps down to a building on fire, but when she is about to use her Rain Dragon, Ladybug interrupts and uses her Lucky Charm to summon a hose to put out the fire. Later, Ladybug de-transforms back into Marinette and sneaks up to Adrien. Adrien asks where she went; she makes up that she went to get drinks, but there were none. Marinette sees the Café Crème and takes Adrien over to it.

title: The Illustrhater
text:
The Illustrhater - Plot
Meanwhile, Alya and Nino are interviewing multiple people that have been akumatized by the new Butterfly Miraculous holder, both times getting no new information. Alya feels discouraged, but Nino reassures her that they'll get somewhere. At the café, Marinette orders pistachio shrimp cookies like a nearby couple is having. A young girl, Maya walks to the table to show Marinette her drawing, which Marinette acknowledges, redirecting her to the other table. Maya shows the other table her drawing, but the woman there shoos her away. Marinette sees the woman at another table rub her leg against her partner's leg, so she tries to copy them, but accidentally kicks Adrien. Adrien mentions seeing Miss Hound, so Marinette runs away once again.

title: The Illustrhater
text:
The Illustrhater - Plot
Miss Hound travels to Mrs. Michelle's location, where her cat is stuck in a tree. Miss Hound is about to use Fetch to get the cat down, but Ladybug interrupts and uses her yo-yo to get the cat down. Miss Hound finishes her word, instead teleporting the cat to herself. Ladybug commends Miss Hound for her interrupted work, then notices Polymouse. Adrien, still waiting for Marinette, is approached by Phong, who asks where Marinette went. Adrien responds that she tends to come and go, and Phong awkwardly leaves him be. Adrien decides to join the superheroes and makes sure to pay for his meal. However, his payment is swept away by the wind.
Cat Noir joins Polymouse watching her superhero work being completed by Ladybug, although Polymouse was perfectly capable of completing the task herself. Ladybug gets a ball from under a truck, and then jumps up onto a rooftop. Cat Noir checks on her, finding her erratic behavior suspicious and pointing out that she has a team for a reason. Ladybug tries to excuse this by saying that her role as Guardian of the Miraculous requires her to check up on the team members in case of anything going wrong.

title: The Illustrhater
text:
The Illustrhater - Plot
In the café, Maya attempts to show Phong her drawing, but her father dismisses her efforts. Feeling hurt, she goes to the bathroom to cry. There, an Ultrakuma slips in after her. In Maya's mind, the new Butterfly Miraculous holder, Chrysalis, begins to speak to her. However, instead of introducing herself or revealing Maya's villain name, like Hawk Moth, she approaches the situation differently. She pretends to empathize with Maya's feelings about people not appreciating her drawings. Through this connection, she persuades Maya to become an akumatized villain known as The Illustrhater.
Alya and Nino are discussing the fact that they still haven't found anything, when the Illustrhater flies past. Rena Rouge and Carapace are hesitant to transform as it would technically be against the rules, but transform anyway. Civilians get stuck in a tram due to the Illustrhater's drawings, so Rena Rouge and Carapace help them out of the tram and get them to safety. Rena Rouge frantically calls Ladybug, who is helping take out the trash with Cat Noir. She explains that someone has been akumatized and urges Ladybug to be there as soon as possible.

title: The Illustrhater
text:
The Illustrhater - Plot
The four superheroes attempt to approach the Illustrhater, who continues to make drawings that they dodge. Eventually, they hide in a house, where they come up with a plan to trap the Illustrhater, including Carapace's Shell-ter and a Lucky Charm, which is an empty art supply box (Carapace goes to get art supplies for the plan to work). They attempt to carry the plan out, but when Ladybug wraps her yo-yo around Carapace's Shell-ter, the Illustrhater draws a door, foiling the plan. Instead, they try to talk to the Illustrhater to trick her into giving up her akumatized object. They also try to figure out information about Chrysalis, including her gender or her name. Chrysalis tells the Illustrhater not to say anything about her, or she'll stop Maya from drawing.

title: The Illustrhater
text:
The Illustrhater - Plot
The superheroes notice the Illustrhater avoiding their questions, and tell her that there are multiple voices, which the Illustrhater still tries to deny. Eventually, she grows annoyed with the constant questions, and yells at them to stop bothering her. Just then, Carapace comes with the now filled art supply box, and Ladybug offers her art supplies to the Illustrhater. Chrysalis tries to warn her that this is a trap, but when Rena Rouge summons a Mirage, she ignores that warning and hands over her akumatized object. Ladybug knocks the akumatized object out of the Illustrhater's hands, and Cat Noir Cataclysms it, transforming the Illustrhater back into Maya. After Ladybug does her Miraculous Ladybug, she asks Maya if she remembers anything about her akumatization. Maya only remembers everything leading up to the akumatization, but nothing following. Ladybug gives Maya a magical charm, and reminds her that she can resist the voices. The superheroes look through Maya's sketchbook, and compliment her drawings. Ladybug sees one of her, and after asking Maya if it's supposed to be her, Maya decides that she can keep it as a reward for saving her.

title: The Illustrhater
text:
The Illustrhater - Plot
In Marinette's room, Alya is disappointed about not having any information regarding the new holder of the Butterfly Miraculous. However, Marinette reminds her that they do know a few things: the new holder is changing their voice, they won't reveal their identity to their victims, and they want to keep their true intentions hidden. She also reflects on her own erratic behavior from earlier and realizes that she can rely on her team after all. Tikki gives Alya a Kwagatama and officially makes her Marinette's deputy, which is meant to be used in case something happens to Marinette. Alya responds that she hopes she will never have to use it, as that would mean something has happened to Marinette. They share a hug, supporting each other in this challenging time.

title: The Illustrhater
text:
The Illustrhater - Plot
At the theater, Marinette and Adrien are sitting together. Adrien wonders if Marinette no longer wants to be his girlfriend, but she reassures him that she is also afraid of being in a serious relationship. Adrien admits that this is new for him as well, but expresses confidence that they can navigate it together. They hold hands, and soon Marinette falls asleep with her head resting on Adrien's shoulder. Adrien relaxes into the moment, resting his head on Marinette's shoulder as he closes his eyes.
At the café, Cerise/Chrysalis, writes in her notebook. Only her hands and legs are visible, highlighting that she was the first person to reject Maya's drawings earlier. She closes the notebook and walks away, blending in like any ordinary civilian. In a voiceover, Cerise declares that she is both everywhere and nowhere, like a chameleon. She insists that the heroes will never learn anything about her, about us, or about them; they won't get anywhere.

title: The Illustrhater
text:
The Illustrhater - Plot Developments
It is shown that Ladybug allows all of her superhero friends to use their Miraculous to help people on their own as long as it is not to fight against an akumatized villain.
It is also revealed that some of Ladybug's superhero friends have already unlocked their ability to use their powers infinitely as well, as shown when Carapace used his twice in a short period of time. In "Revelator", it is revealed all heroes unlocked their adult powers under Ladybug and Cat Noir's guidance.
Nooroo now has black wings and Cerise paralyzes him whenever she writes down her secrets in one of her notebooks. It is unknown if Nooroo is redesigned or this is a result of his strict treatment by Chrysalis.
It is revealed that Chrysalis can make sure that her akumatized villains do not share details about her with any member of the French Miraculous superhero team by threatening to remove their powers. This is to further leave the Miraculous team in the dark about her true goal, which is indeed to take the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses to make a wish, as shown in "Miraculous London".

title: The Illustrhater
text:
The Illustrhater - Plot Developments
It is shown that she can partially eject an ultrakuma from the object it was placed in, to further scare her victims into submission.
It is revealed that two people were akumatized by Chrysalis before Maya: Caline Bustier and Caroline (who is akumatized in "Sublimation").
This means that "Sublimation" takes place before this episode, despite their production codes. The previous episode, "Climatiqueen", takes place chronologically before "Sublimation", since in that episode Adrien discovers his love for running and meets Sublime for the first time.
Furthermore, Miss Hound has her new suit, which she gains in "Daddycop", placing the episode before this one.
Tikki gives a Kwagatama to Alya by Marinette's request, so that Alya is able to access the latter's memories as Guardian in case anything happens to her. As such, Marinette officially makes Alya her successor, which she stated she would do in "Optigami".
Through this situation, it is revealed that Miraculous holders can not only get a kwagatama from the kwami they're assigned too, but they can get one from any kwami whether it is by permission from the Guardian or as long as they spend enough time together.

title: The Illustrhater
text:
The Illustrhater - Plot Developments
It's unknown if Kwamis that are held captive like Nooroo and used without their own consent or the Guardian's permission can create a kwagatama if ordered by their wielder.
Since Tikki gave a kwagatama to Marinette in "Befana" and stated she gave one to all her previous wielders in the same episode, this makes Adrien the only one not to have received one from her not counting Gabriel due to him briefly using of her and the Ladybug Miraculous in "Deflagration" and without transforming "Re-creation").
Marinette naming Alya, her official successor not only inheriting the Miracle Box but the Ladybug mantle, meaning she and Trixx may have to separate one day but according to adult Bunnyx in "Timetagger", Marinette is still Ladybug in her time there could be a few reasons for this:
It could be that Marinette didn't renounce the box yet.
Something must have happened to Alya and Marinette had to choose someone else.
Marinette did surrender the box erasing her memory and giving the mantle to Alya as so but similar to "Kwami's Choice", caused her to resume as Ladybug.

title: The Illustrhater
text:
The Illustrhater - Plot Developments
In the future, Marinette and the Order found a way to alter transference spell of Miracle Box allowing Marinette to keep her memories as Ladybug thereby allowing her and Alya to keep their mantles as Ladybug and Rena Rouge.
Carapace's shield is revealed to be able to be used as a skateboard and Polymouse's skip rope is revealed to be able to be used to swing between buildings (like Ladybug's yo-yo).
Him using his shield as a skateboard parallels his movie counterpart having the same skills.
It's revealed that Fetch can be used on living beings.

title: The Illustrhater
text:
The Illustrhater - Trivia
Not counting trailers, this is the first released piece of Miraculous media that doesn't include the old animation style at all.
Besides the new animation, the 2D animation used for calls, messages, long range communications and imagination sequences was replaced by the one used for Miraculous Chibi.
A part of Bunnyx's transformation sequence music is used after Rena Rouge and Carapace rescue the citizens on the tram.
It's revealed that the café known as "Le Café" in the previous seasons is now called "Café Crème".
Cerise was shown to have been spying on Marinette and Adrien at that café, though her intentions remain unclear.
Not counting flashbacks, this is the second episode that shows fire, after "Elation".
This is the first time since "Risk" that a child is akumatized.
According to Marinette, during Gabriel's time as the Butterfly Miraculous holder, he was able to akumatize 212 people, including the akumatizations in the "New York" and "Shanghai" specials. However, he only individually akumatized 76 people on-screen, including himself, implying that 136 others were akumatized off-screen.

title: The Illustrhater
text:
The Illustrhater - Trivia
By counting re-akumatizations, including the additional off-screen ones recorded by Marinette in "Mr. Pigeon 72", and by not counting akumatizations that happened in alternative timelines (such as Cat Blanc and Ephemeral, in their eponymous episodes; and Bugfighter in "Intuition"), akumatizations that Marinette is unaware off (such as Gabriel's self-akumatizations in "Dearest Family" and "Conformation", and Nathalie's akumatizations into Catalyst in the eponymous episode and "Ladybug"), that would make around 270 akumatizations (271 if Marinette counts Cat Blanc).
It is possible that even Marinette lost track of how many people were akumatized or re-akumatized.
References
This is the first time Marinette and Adrien go to the movies as a real couple.
In both "Ephemeral" and "Jubilation", Marinette and Adrien were both present in the movies as a real couple, but these situations are excluded due to the fact that they take place in realities that do not exist in the real permanent timeline.
Overall, this is the second time in the permanent timeline, along with "Miraculous New York", that Ladybug has summoned three Lucky Charms.

title: The Illustrhater
text:
The Illustrhater - Trivia
She had also summoned three throughout alternate timelines in "Ephemeral" and "Elation".
What Marinette said about being afraid of messing up everything leading to her controlling impulses refers to how she was behaving in Seasons 1-4 towards Adrien due to her obsession with him and in the later season in general due to the new burden of guardianship.
Cat Noir recognizes Ladybug's erratic behavior (most likely from "Gang of Secrets") but only tries to make small talk with and watch over her until she calms down, knowing she won't or can't give a straight answer if he directly asks her what's wrong.
But this time, it is not only about her love life; now it's about her worrying for the whole team, referencing Marinette's worry for Alya back in "Sentibubbler".
In Alya's room, multiple photos in the old animation style can be seen in the background.
The images are from the end cards of "Lady Wifi" and "Animan", and the characters' Instagram accounts.
Errors
During the sequence when Alya comforts Marinette, the chain of the Fox Miraculous phases through her body.
When Ryuko jumps from the sky, her hair is seemingly invisible and can't be distinguished from the black smoke behind her.

Or it could be possible that she can use more than only one word as long as it conveys the same meaning or intention.
At the same time, when Rena undoes her illusion while saving the tram it's completely black.

title: The Dark Castle
text:
The Dark Castle - Intro
"" is a season 6 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 10th written and produced episode of season 6. It is also the 141th written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: The Dark Castle
text:
The Dark Castle - Synopsis
Disney Channel
To allow Alix to celebrate her birthday with her friends and family, Marinette gets the Rabbit Miraculous back and becomes the Keeper of Time for a few hours.
Disney+
Ladybug and Cat Noir face a villain of a new kind.

title: The Dark Castle
text:
The Dark Castle - Plot
At school, Marinette and Adrien finish getting their lunch when they notice Alix's older brother, Jalil, looking over photos of Alix on his cellphone with a forlorn expression. When they ask him what's wrong, he explains that Alix's birthday is coming up. When Prem, confused, asks who Alix is, the friends explain that Alix is the holder of the Rabbit Miraculous and the guardian of the timeline. She has to stay in the Burrow to prevent the current wielder of the Butterfly Miraculous from obtaining the Rabbit Miraculous and disrupting the timeline. If that were to happen, characters like Ladybug would never exist. Alix must remain as Bunnyx until Ladybug and Cat Noir can recover the Butterfly Miraculous, at which point she will be able to come home. Jalil is heartbroken over Alix's duty to the timeline, which keeps her from returning home for her birthday. However, Marinette assures him they will find a way to wish her a "Happy Birthday." From the Burrow, Bunnyx looks on and mentions how much she misses her friends. She then receives a Miraculous Call from Ladybug, asking for her help.

title: The Dark Castle
text:
The Dark Castle - Plot
Later at the Louvre, Alix's father Alim is getting ready to film a Happy Birthday video to post on the Zoo app for Alix, with help from Marinette, Adrien, Alya, and Nino. Their recording is interrupted by Armand D'Argencourt, who demands that the glass pyramid be removed from the museum's courtyard because of its historical connection to the former French monarchy. When Alim tells him they can discuss the matter later, Armand storms off, insisting the issue is not finished.

title: The Dark Castle
text:
The Dark Castle - Plot
With Armand gone, Alim resumes filming the birthday message, wishing Alix a Happy Birthday while the Miraculers and classmates join in. The video ends with Jalil adding his own birthday wishes for his younger sister. However, after Marinette reviews the video back in her room, she feels it still isn't enough. Talking with Tikki, she becomes unsure of what else she can do—until she is suddenly visited by a future version of herself, who is using both the Ladybug and Rabbit Miraculous together as "Bunnybug." Bunnybug instructs her past self to organize a party with Alya, while the present Marinette temporarily takes over the Rabbit Miraculous so Alix can fully enjoy her celebration. After the two Marinettes share a "Pound It!" fist bump, Bunnybug departs, and Marinette immediately begins preparing the plan her future self suggested.
Tikki seems unsure of the plan, but nevertheless, agrees to it.
Marinette calls Alya to set up the party, before having Tikki transform her into Ladybug, and contact Bunnyx over the Miraculous Call.
When Bunnyx answers, Ladybug says she needs her help, and when Bunnyx opens a Burrow portal, Ladybug leaps in and explains her plan.

title: The Dark Castle
text:
The Dark Castle - Plot
Although initially unsure, Bunnyx accepts, powers down, and before handing the Rabbit Miraculous to Ladybug, warns her to uphold Bunnyx's duties to NOT interfere with the timeline.
Assuring Alix she has this, Ladybug takes the Rabbit Miraculous, unifies Tikki and Fluff, and becomes Bunnybug.
Providing a time window to the party, Bunnybug lets Alix out, and Alix happily reunites with Alim, Jalil, and all of the other classmates, excluding Marinette, to enjoy her birthday party.
When Adrien notices Marinette is not there, Bunnybug secretly texts a cover story to Alya using the cellphone in her yo-yo so Alya can say she is homesick and couldn't join them.
When Adrien offers to check on Marinette later to see if she's okay, touched, Bunnybug sticks her lips out of a Burrow portal to kiss him, but recoils at the last second upon realizing she almost violated her duties to Alix as the temporary guardian of time and has to stick to it.
As Bunnybug watches Alix's birthday party unfold, things begin to go wrong one after another.

title: The Dark Castle
text:
The Dark Castle - Plot
The first problem happens when a soccer ball accidentally launches a piece of flan through the air, splattering Jalil's clothes and forcing him to leave the party early to change. Not wanting the party to be ruined, Bunnybug rewinds time and rotates the plate just enough so the soccer ball causes no damage. The second incident occurs when a pigeon chooses the worst possible moment to relieve itself—right over Alix's birthday cake. Bunnybug rewinds again and uses a Burrow portal to redirect the bird's droppings safely into the Burrow, barely avoiding getting hit herself. The final disaster strikes as Nathaniel and Marc are carefully carrying the cake to Alix while everyone sings "Happy Birthday". One of them slips on a bowl of pudding left on the grass, sending the cake flying straight onto Jalil, who is understandably upset, while everyone else is shocked and concerned. Bunnybug rewinds once more and shifts the bowl slightly out of the way, causing the scene to proceed without incident. She even wiggles her fingers back and forth in time as the others sing the last line of "Happy Birthday".

title: The Dark Castle
text:
The Dark Castle - Plot
However, when you tamper with time, time tends to fight back. Bunnybug's repeated interventions create an unintended chain reaction of events that eventually spirals into a global catastrophe; an apocalypse that destroys the world and ruins Alix's party far worse than before. Horrified, Bunnybug immediately rewinds again and decides to let the original events happen exactly as they were meant to and puts the pudding back where it originally was. Ironically, that turns out to be the right decision. Alix happily reveals that when they were younger, she used to love splattering food onto Jalil's clothes, which makes everyone burst into laughter, including Jalil himself.

title: The Dark Castle
text:
The Dark Castle - Plot
After that, Bunnybug decides things should be okay now, but then notices something ominous with the Louvre as it now looks like some sort of dark castle fortress instead of the museum it should be. Realizing something is wrong, and it wasn't her that caused it, as D'Argencourt must have been akumatized by the new Butterfly Miraculous holder in frustration, tantrum and anger of being banned from the museum and corrupted the Louvre in some way, after some indecision, Bunnybug decides to contact her future self to serve as the temporary keeper of the Rabbit Miraculous so she can face the akumatized villain as Ladybug. When she does contact her future self, the future Marinette is aware of what's going on, and gladly takes over custody of the Rabbit Miraculous as Bunnynette while Ladybug goes to deal with the akumatized villain.

title: The Dark Castle
text:
The Dark Castle - Plot
Once at the Louvre, Ladybug contacts Cat Noir on the Miraculous Call, and upon getting it, Adrien excuses himself from Alix's party to go transform and help her. As they enter the museum, they first deal with the knights that are dismantling the pyramid that was in the courtyard, before hearing the voice of the akumatized villain, apparently Armand, taunting them. Inside, they are nearly crushed when the entire building begins to move, and upon getting back outside, are shocked to find the whole museum having come to life as Armand's akumatized villain identity, Dark Castle.
As Ladybug and Cat Noir attempt to fight it, they soon figure out that the flag/banner flying from the top of Dark Castle's head/turret is the akumatized object.
However, as Dark Castle rotates his 'limbs', turning them into an obstacle course for the Miraculous duo, every time they get close to the flag, he quickly furls it up, retracts it, and deploys it elsewhere on his body in a sadistic game of cat-and-mouse to keep them from breaking it and freeing the Ultrakuma.

title: The Dark Castle
text:
The Dark Castle - Plot
Finally, Ladybug summons her Lucky Charm, consisting of sandwich wrapped in aluminum foil, which gives her the idea to use her yo-yo to essentially tie up and immobilize Dark Castle, rendering him unable to move, and when she pulls the string taut, it slices Dark Castle to pieces, also snapping the flag from its flagpole, thus destroying Dark Castle, and freeing the Ultrakuma for her to catch and purify, before Armand is restored to normal, and Ladybug uses the Miraculous Ladybug to repair all the damage, restoring the Louvre back to its normal appearance.
When Armand discovers this, he is still incredulous about the pyramid, until Ladybug reminds him of the Great Pyramids of Giza in Egypt that were used by the Egyptian pharaohs when they were in power.
Realizing the symbolism, Armand finally understands why it was added, and gives up his vendetta against it.
Ladybug gifts him a Magical Charm and some added wisdom, and Armand thanks her before taking his leave, while Ladybug and Cat Noir share a "Pound It!" fist-bump before parting ways so Adrien can return to Alix's party, and Marinette to reclaim the Rabbit Miraculous from her future self as Bunnynette.

title: The Dark Castle
text:
The Dark Castle - Plot
After she takes back Fluff and the Rabbit Miraculous from her future self, she lets her return to her bedroom to get some rest.
Meanwhile, at La Plage, Cerise is writing in her journal about how Marinette wasn't present for Alix's birthday party.
She feels the need to check again and again.
Ladybug transforms into Bunnybug to provide Alix with a Burrow portal so she can return from her party.
Once she reverts back to Marinette, she asks Alix how the party went.
Alix replies that it was awesome and even brought back a slice of cake for Marinette, who eagerly gobbles it up in one bite.
Since Alix had such a great time at her party with her friends, family, and fellow Miraculers, Marinette offers to take the Rabbit Miraculous herself so Alix can come home to Paris.
However, Alix agrees only on the condition that Marinette gives her the Ladybug Miraculous in exchange.
When Marinette refuses, explaining that she is Ladybug, Alix points out that she is the reason why Alix is Bunnyx.
Recognizing Alix's reasoning, Marinette decides to return the Rabbit Miraculous to her.
Alix has Fluff transform her back into Bunnyx and creates a way home for Marinette.

title: The Dark Castle
text:
The Dark Castle - Plot
Alix thanks her for everything she did that day.
When Marinette returns home, she finds the voicemail Adrien left her, thanks to the cover story she sent to Alya to explain her absence.
She replies with a message for him before heading inside to see her parents, who ask her how the party went, especially Alix's birthday cake that Tom baked personally.
After speaking with her parents, Marinette heads to bed. Just as she lies down, she starts to count down the seconds until Bunnybug contacts her for help to temporarily become Bunnynette. Within moments of entering the Burrow to assist, she quickly emerges and prepares for sleep. Before closing her eyes, she shares a "Pound It!" fist-bump with Bunnybug. Soon after, she receives a new voicemail from Adrien, wishing her well and letting her know he'll see her in the morning. This leaves Marinette smiling warmly as she looks at Adrien's picture on her wall, feeling that their relationship is still as strong as ever.
