title: The Dark Castle
text:
The Dark Castle - Plot Developments
This episode revolves around Alix's sixteenth birthday, revealing that one exact year has passed between "Timebreaker" and "The Dark Castle".
Yet at the same time, Alix wasn't gone for that long since she likely got her Miraculous near the school year's end which for Paris is between April-June and with her birthday between September-December, so Alix would've been roughly gone for half a year.
Jalil is shown to be part of the Collège Françoise Dupont, but it is unknown if he is a student (as the school is opened to all kinds of students, possibly even those in the university) or part of the staff (be it teacher, assistant, or other).
If it is the latter, that would make him the sixth confirmed relative of one member of the Miraculers to work at the school, following Fred Haprèle, Sabine Cheng, Anarka Couffaine, Marlena Césaire and Nora Césaire.
It is shown that, in order for Alix to spend time with her family and friends, she needs to lend her Miraculous to another so that both the Rabbit Miraculous and timeline are not left unattended, especially with Chrysalis being a threat.

title: The Dark Castle
text:
The Dark Castle - Plot Developments
It is shown that Cerise is suspicious of Marinette after noticing the latter was not in Alix's birthday party, but she also expresses that she needs to confirm her theory many times before reaching a conclusion, meaning that, for the time being, it is only a vague suspicion.
It is unknown of how Cerise became aware of Marinette's absence in Alix's birthday party, as the fight against The Dark Castle happened at the other side of the city.
The only other way it could be possible is that Cerise de-transformed herself and went to stake out Alix's party in disguise.
It is shown that the Miraculous Call can even reach the Burrow, contacting Bunnyx at the precise moment it is send to her.
It's unknown how the Miraculous Call would be able to reach Bunnyx and whether she was not in the Burrow, but rather on another time period, either past or future.
The fact Alix is capable of receiving the Miraculous Call in real time may suggest that the Burrow is capable of adapting to its user's own present, possibly to allow them to just hop in to it without any kind of time displacement.

title: The Dark Castle
text:
The Dark Castle - Plot Developments
This episode really showcases the danger of messing up time, as one of Bunnybug's interference with events caused a succession of major disasters that quickly spread around the entire world, forcing her to correct her mistake and stop interfering.
Which may also explain why Bunnyx despite knowing of Gabriel's actions and reasons, she didn't do the same thing he did in "Evolution", because she saw no point in doing it and possibly would've led to so many time disturbances that she or even Monarch would be forced to put everything back to how it was before.
When the Rabbit Miraculous holder changes the events of time themselves if/when said changes lead to disaster they have to remember every change that they made, so they can undo do it, the watch must not only to those that aren't tempted to mess with time but have a good memory too.
Marinette faking that she is sick likely foreshadows her having an actual cold in "The Ruler".

title: The Dark Castle
text:
The Dark Castle - Trivia
The episode's end card was revealed in an interview with Thomas Astruc and Nathanaël Bronn for Serieously FR released on October 5, 2025.
Due to having a lot of time travel in this episode, we get some reused scenes:
Future Bunnybug first appearing to give present Marinette the idea of taking Alix's place so she can spend her birthday with family and friends, which is then reused when present Bunnybug has to give that idea to her past self.
Present Bunnybug went to fetch her future self (who had already lived the events of that day) so she could stand in for her as the Rabbit Miraculous holder while the former goes face the Dark Castle as Ladybug, which is then reused after present Marinette (after defeating the villain and giving the Rabbit Miraculous back to Alix) is contacted by her past self as Bunnybug.
Marinette unifies the Ladybug and Rabbit Miraculous, becoming Bunnybug, so she can take Alix's place, while she goes enjoying her birthday with her family and friends.
Later on, Bunnybug gives the Rabbit Miraculous to her future self, who becomes Bunnynette, so that she can go fight The Dark Castle.

title: The Dark Castle
text:
The Dark Castle - Trivia
This is the second time Ladybug unifies her Miraculous with another that had already been unified by Cat Noir, following the Snake Miraculous.
In "Evolution", Cat Noir unified the Rabbit Miraculous, becoming Rabbit Noir.
Interestingly, both the Rabbit and Snake Miraculouses have time-related superpowers.
This is also Marinette's second time using the Rabbit Miraculous since "Strikeback", but this time she only uses it with the Ladybug Miraculous and then by itself.
Even if it was a joke on Alix's part, when she asked Marinette for the Ladybug Miraculous and the same refusal even after having borrowed the Rabbit Miraculous is a parallel to when Luka asked Marinette for the Ladybug Miraculous in "Mister Agreste" and the same refusal even after having borrowed the Snake Miraculous.
It's revealed that Armand D'Argencourt is a count, therefore part of the French nobility.
This would make his obsession towards the times of French monarchy (especially the time his ancestor governed Paris) more understandable, as French nobility lost all of its power and privileges after the French Revolution.

title: The Dark Castle
text:
The Dark Castle - Trivia
It's also shown that Armand has a habit of calling Alim Kubdel or meet him at the Louvre to make ridiculous demands, such as dismantling the Louvre pyramid or burning the Liberty leading the people painting from Eugène Delacroix, with the intention of returning the Louvre palace back to what it was before becoming a museum, to the point Alim threatened him to forbid him from entering the Louvre ever again.
This is the first time in Season 6 the titular villain's akumatization isn't seen. Chrysalis doesn't appear physically throughout the whole episode.
At the end of the episode, the clock on Marinette's cellphone is clearly shown: at 11:15 pm she comes home, at 11:35 she goes to bed and is taken to the Burrow by her past self, and she returns from the Burrow at 11:40. It's possible those times are meant to have some symbolism, as in all other episodes, there isn't an analogue (or digital) clock on her phone's lock screen.
One of the photos next to Marinette's bed is revealed to be of Master Fu and Marianne.
References
Armand's akumatization into The Dark Castle shows some similarities with his previous akumatization into Darkblade.

title: The Dark Castle
text:
The Dark Castle - Trivia
Both akumatizations wanted to bring Paris back to its past, with Darkblade wanting to "dethrone" Mayor Bourgeois and turn Paris into his image and the Dark Castle wanted to restore the Louvre Palace back to being the home of the French monarchs, while also wanting to restore the monarchy.
Both akumatizations controlled an army of black armored knights, but while Darkblade was able to turn people into knights, the Dark Castle simply controlled the armors existing in the Louvre.
To detransform from Bunnybug into her civilian form, Marinette says "Spots and lops away". Since she used "Spots and claws away" to detransform from Bug Noire in "Re-creation", this would imply that every pair of Miraculouses has a special detransformation phrase instead of the usual "Reverse morphosis".
This is the fifth time where two Ladybugs are seen at the same time following "Timebreaker", "Sandboy", "Cat Blanc" and "Miraculous Paris".
"The Dark Castle" follows the pattern of "Timebreaker" and "Cat Blanc", where it was done by time travel.
Allusions
When Marinette says "The day of glory has arrived!", it is a reference to the French national anthem "La Marseillaise"

categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
The Dirtifiers - Intro
"" is a season 6 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 18th written and produced episode of season 6. It is also the 149th written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: The Dirtifiers
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
The Dirtifiers - Synopsis
After a sleepover full of surprises, Marinette and her friends wonder what's happening to Kagami. She isolates herself from the group before disappearing, becoming unreachable. The friends set out to find her but are quickly interrupted by the arrival of supervillains. Will Ladybug manage to defeat the Dirtifiers and find Kagami?
Gloob
Marinette and her friends begin to wonder what's wrong with Kagami. With her disappearance from the group, the girls decide to go looking for her.
Disney Channel
Ladybug and her team face the Dirtifiers.

title: The Dirtifiers
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
The Dirtifiers - Plot
In a flashback that shows how young Tomoe Tsurugi used the Peacock Miraculous to "give birth" to Kagami as a sentimonster, and how Tomoe lost her original vision in the process.
In the present, Kagami is with Marinette and the other girls for one of their usual movie nights at Marinette's, and after Tom and Sabine drop off food for the girls, they are able to enjoy the movie Kagami brought for them, only to be interrupted by Tom and Sabine again, who then change into their pajamas to join the girls for the movie, but it appears that Kagami is thinking of something else.
Alya is then called by her mom to reveal they just confirmed the gender for her new little sibling, and she's getting a new sister.
As everyone celebrates, Kagami steps away to watch the movie alone, visibly troubled.
Marinette notices and asks if she is okay, but Kagami makes it clear she is not.
Kagami returns home to Tsurugi Tower, leaves food for her mother, and goes to change for fencing practice.

title: The Dirtifiers
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
The Dirtifiers - Plot
Marinette calls again, but it becomes evident that Kagami still harbors deep-seated resentment toward Tomoe—particularly over having been created as a sentimonster, a fact that reminds Marinette of her own origins with having been born as a normal human to Tom and Sabine.
After abruptly hanging up on her friend, Kagami explodes in anger.
Longg tries to calm her down, but, questioning why she was even created, she storms into her mother's room to confront her.
The two end up dueling with wooden katanas until Kagami disarms Tomoe.
Even after hearing her mother's explanations, Kagami insists she will always be viewed as a trophy rather than a daughter; she returns furiously to her room—narrowly missing another call from Marinette—before allowing Longg to transform her into Ryuko.
Back at the Dupain-Cheng Bakery, while the other girls are getting picnic supplies, Marinette startles them as she wants to help Kagami in some way. After some discussion, they all agree to get Kagami and take her to their picnic.

title: The Dirtifiers
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
The Dirtifiers - Plot
At the Cesaire house, the twins are having fun, before deciding to help Marlena out with painting the nursery for their new little sister. Over at Tsurugi Tower, the girls are having trouble getting past Tatsu to get inside, so they decide to split up to find Kagami. Zoé goes to the cinema to watch movies; Juleka goes to Marc's parents' bookstore, where she buys manga; Rose goes to the school gym; and Marinette goes to the park, where she trains with her mother. Ducking into an alleyway, Marinette has Tikki transform her into Ladybug and contact Ryuko with the Miraculous Call, but Ryuko, now as a cloud hovering over the city, refuses to speak to her for the moment.
At the Cesaire house, when the twins show what they did to their mom, Marlena is very disappointed and cross with them for the mess they've made of the apartment, and locks them in the bathroom until they clean themselves up, slamming the door, and leaving the twins upset at thinking their mom hates them, allowing Chrysalis to Akumatize them into The Dirtifiers.

title: The Dirtifiers
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
The Dirtifiers - Plot
When the twins begin their rampage, Juleka sees them, and after protecting Mr. Anciel, whom she was talking to when the attack began, ducks into a hiding spot, and telling Roaar they need to warn Ladybug, she has Roaar transform her into Purple Tigress to contact Ladybug, who as Cosmobug, is going up to speak to Ryuko. As Ryuko voices her frustrations to her, at one point engulfing Cosmobug as she becomes a thunderstorm to vent her pent-up fury and jealousy of how Ladybug has loving parents compared to how cold and distant Tomoe is, realizing her poor choice of words, Cosmobug offers her support and apologies. However, she gets word from Purple Tigress of the Dirtifiers and their rampage, and tells Ryuko to join them when she's ready, before heading back down to investigate.
Joined by most of the female members of the Miraculers along with Cat Noir, Ladybug confronts the The Dirtifiers, but they are able to outmaneuver the Miraculers, using their ink they spread to teleport around the city to escape the Miraculers.

title: The Dirtifiers
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
The Dirtifiers - Plot
This leads to where as the Miraculers are trying to find them, the Dirtifiers ambush Purple Tigress, allowing Chrysalis to hit her with an Antikuma through them, cutting her off from her Miraculous powers.
Purple Tigress warns Ladybug she's out of action, and Ladybug tells her to power down, recharge her Kwami to regain access to her powers, and rejoin them as soon as she can.
Polymouse is the next to be affected, causing her clones to re-merge with her as she's cut off from her powers, and warns Ladybug she's down too.
When Cat Noir and Ladybug then see The Dirtifiers heading for the Eiffel Tower, they realize that Rena Rouge is nearby, and let her know.
After the Dirtifiers cover the Eiffel Tower in their ink, Rena uses her Mirage to make it look like the Eiffel Tower became clean again, angering the Dirtifiers as they try to dispel the illusion, only to then be ambushed by Ladybug and Cat Noir, but they manage to escape, attack Rena, and then ambush her for Chrysalis to hit her with an Antikuma as well, much to Rena's chagrin as she contacts Ladybug to let her know she's out of commission too.

title: The Dirtifiers
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
The Dirtifiers - Plot
Thankfully, Ryuko arrives to lend a hand, startling Ladybug and Cat Noir with her arrival via Lightning Dragon, and begins using her Water Dragon to clean up the city.
When the Dirtifiers are then surrounded by Cat Noir and the female Miraculers, with Rena, Polymouse, and Purple Tigress having recharged and regained their powers, they still attempt to escape by using their ink to teleport away.
Ladybug summons a Lucky Charm umbrella, and encourages Ryuko to use her powers to summon a storm to clean up all of Paris, so the Dirtifiers can't use their ink to teleport away and either escape or ambush them again.

title: The Dirtifiers
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
The Dirtifiers - Plot
Although hesitant, encouraged by the other girls and Cat Noir's support, Ryuko begins focusing her powers, and summons her Storm Dragon, unleashing a massive thunderstorm across Paris that undoes all of the Dirtifiers' messes, much to their anger and frustration, and resulting in the twins being attacked by Cat Noir and the female Miraculers, leading to Purple Tigress knocking them off-balance with Clout, Vesperia to hit them with Venom to paralyze them before they could attempt any counterattack, leaving them with shocked looks on their immobilized faces, and Cat Noir using his Cataclysm to destroy their akumatized object, freeing the Ultrakuma for Ladybug to capture and purify.
After Ryuko then dispels her storm and returns to normal, Ladybug uses her Miraculous Ladybug to clean up the city.
Restored to normal, the twins are taken home by Ladybug, where Marlena voices how worried she was over their disappearance and apologizes for losing her temper at them because of the mess they made.
As Alya, having powered down from Rena Rouge, arrives home, Ladybug gives the twins Magical Charms before taking her leave.

title: The Dirtifiers
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
The Dirtifiers - Plot
She then meets up with Ryuko and shares a hug with her, reminding her that your friends can be your family.
With that advice for Ryuko, she returns to Tsurugi Industries, where Tomoe voices how she's impressed by Ryuko's efforts with the storm, and decides she is ready to move on to the next step as Tomoe summons steel katanas for them to spar with, but Ryuko ignores taking up hers to engage Tomoe with and returns to her room.
Later, at Alya's home, after help painting the new room for Alya's new sister, Marinette, Alya, and Kagami speak alone on the balcony over recent events. In the meantime, back at Tomoe's, Chrysalis appears before her, and while not at all disappointed by her latest defeat, powering back down into Cerise, she summons the steel katanas again, and takes Kagami's, apparently wishing to spar with Tomoe herself as her image is reflected in Tomoe's sunglasses to end the episode.

title: The Dirtifiers
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
The Dirtifiers - Plot developments
More about Kagami's family is revealed:
The cold open shows a young Tomoe Tsurugi (with her original eyes) donning the Peacock Miraculous to use its power on her womb to magically conceive Kagami, whom she is seen holding as a baby shortly after physically giving birth to. Kagami was implied to be a Sentimonster in "Perfection", "Emotion", "Pretension", "Representation", and fully confirmed to be one in "Yaksi Gozen", with her amokized object being her family crest ring, in which Tomoe is seen putting her amok in.
The flashback explicitly depicts the creation process via the Peacock Miraculous.
This is the first time the series has visually confirmed the use of the Peacock Miraculous to "birth" a human through an amok.
The specific incantation used during the creation ("Mirror's reflection, Diamond made into a girl, Dragon above men") was done by Tomoe to allow her to focus the emotion she wanted to use to create her daughter. The incantation's syllable structure makes it a haiku.
Strangely, in the French dub of the episode, the second and third lines are switched, thus distorting the haiku structure.

title: The Dirtifiers
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
The Dirtifiers - Plot developments
Despite pretending to accept Kagami's independency and relationship with Félix at the end of "Yaksi Gozen", Tomoe is revealed to usually be cold and distant towards Kagami, much like Gabriel was to Adrien, to the point Kagami even wonders if Tomoe loves her and what emotion Tomoe felt/used when creating her. Unfortunately, Tomoe seems to think of Kagami only as a warrior apprentice, trophy and/or continuation of her own ego and legacy.
The lack of open love and affection between them caused Kagami to feel weird/uncomfortable when around moments of affection between families.
Tomoe even imposed an "allowance of social interactions" each weekend, restricting Kagami to see only a limited number of friends each weekend.
When Kagami wants/requests something, Tomoe always feels she needs to prove her worthiness by sparring with swords to get that thing. This was briefly seen in Kagami's flashback in "Miraculous Tokyo".

title: The Dirtifiers
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
The Dirtifiers - Plot developments
At the end of the episode, Tomoe was impressed by Kagami's new level of using the power of the Dragon Miraculous and, through a haiku, wants to switch to real metal swords ("Wood turns to metal") during their sparring sessions to advance her swordsmanship training ("Undefeatable dragon"), but Kagami rejects her ("Soft heart under scales").
By the end of the episode, encouraged by Marinette, Kagami learned to see her friends/teammates as family. As a result, Kagami learns to accept herself and completely reject her mother's warrior-like attempt at parenting, even refusing to spar with her anymore and disobeying Tomoe's "allowance of social interactions".
Kagami literally becoming a giant storm not only symbolizes her growth, but is also a nod to how Tomoe wanted Kagami to become the perfect warrior (by using the metaphor of a storm's "perfection") in "Ikari Gozen", which is why Tomoe expressed "pride" in Kagami's evolution in this episode.
In the post-endcard scene, Cerise openly refers to Kagami as her sister (in addition to Tomoe as her mother in "Yaksi Gozen"), further implying she may be somehow related to the Tsurugi family.

title: The Dirtifiers
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
The Dirtifiers - Plot developments
Cerise is revealed, or at least implied, to be proficient in swordsmanship, as she proposed Tomoe spar with her in the post-endcard scene.
This might be Cerise's way of getting close to Tomoe, as she briefly mentioned to Ella and Etta Césaire that she knew how hard it is "having a mother who doesn't love you."
If Cerise is indeed Tomoe's child, then that means she went through the exact same thing that Kagami went through in this episode.
Alya's mother, Marlena Césaire, is revealed to be pregnant with her fifth child, with the Césaire family finding out in this episode that the baby is a girl.
It's revealed that the new emblem signal function of Miraculous tools also works as a communication link, as Ryuko was able to respond to Ladybug via her emblem on Ladybug's yo-yo.
Marc's father, first seen in "The Ruler" very briefly, is revealed to own a bookstore and be acquainted with some of his son's friends, like Kagami (who is a regular client) and Juleka.

title: The Dirtifiers
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
The Dirtifiers - Plot developments
The Miraculers seem to become even more independent from Ladybug, as they transformed to warn her of the akumatized villains and confront them until she arrives. Later, Polymouse, Purple Tigress, Vesperia and Cat Noir perfectly synchronized their powers to contain and depower the Dirtifiers without Ladybug guiding them or making a plan beforehand (even if she was the one to come up with the plan to prevent the two villains from continuing to evade them).
Through the Dirtifiers, Chrysalis was able to hit Purple Tigress, Polymouse and Rena Rouge with Antikumas, making this the first episode in season 6 where a member of the Miraculers, other than Cat Noir, is hit with an Antikuma and the first time multiple people are hit in a single episode.
It's revealed that the Antikuma doesn't turn the affected hero's costume a paler shade as a visual effect of depowerment but that it makes it monochromatic.
On the other hand, if the holder's hair is colored, fully or partially, by the transformation, it will become a paler shade of the respective color.

title: The Dirtifiers
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
The Dirtifiers - Plot developments
As seen with Polymouse, if the Mouse holder is hit while already divided, the clones will all be affected and be forcefully fused back into a single being.
This also implies that, if a Miraculous holder with a power that can remain active after being summoned, the holder will not only lose their powers, but their active power will also be undone.

title: The Dirtifiers
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
The Dirtifiers - Trivia
In production order, this is the first episode where Chrysalis akumatizes two people at the same time.
Tomoe creates Kagami on a Rhodochrosite geode. The gem represents cleansing from past wounds.
When Tomoe places the amok in the ring, she wears it on her left ring finger, indicating that, at the time, she was either married or engaged.
In "Yaksi Gozen", Tomoe mentions to have been disappointed by men her entire life; perhaps the man she was in love with was one of them.
In the English audio description, Chrysalis is said to detransform into "an identical Kagami" during the end scene. Due to the explicit wording, it's unlikely that the line is a simple error. It's possible that the original episode script or storyboard featured Cerise impersonating Kagami with her shapeshifting powers, symbolizing that she's "replacing" the latter as Tomoe's daughter.
References
Part of Tomoe's incantation for the Peacock Miraculous, "Diamond made into a girl" is a nod to Kagami's statement on how the rich kids' parents saw their children (like Kagami, Adrien, Chloé) as diamonds, since they named their ball the Diamond's Dance in "Emotion".

title: The Dirtifiers
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
The Dirtifiers - Trivia
This contrasts Cerise's status, who despite being Tomoe's daughter, is not considered a precious stone, according to Kagami in the aforementioned episode.
The girls' movie night at the beginning is most likely meant to be the one from the end of "Daddycop".
In that episode, it's mentioned that they have the movie nights once a month and at a different person's home each time, thus months would pass between two sleepovers held at Marinette's.
Kagami's CD case in both episodes has the same design.
The girls sit on and around the chaise lounge in the same formation in both episodes. Most of their drinks and snacks are also in the same locations.
Marinette is seen clenching the heart-shaped cushion for her and Adrien's 100th kiss.
Tom and Sabine's interruptions of Marinette's sleepover are similar to their interruptions of Marinette and Adrien's gaming training session in "Gamer".
Unlike that time, when she wanted to spend alone time with Adrien, this time Marinette welcomes her parents to join them in watching the movie (provided they change into their pajamas).

title: The Dirtifiers
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
The Dirtifiers - Trivia
"Mr. Cube" uses the same model as the valet robots in "Emotion" and the Tsurugi police robots seen in "Collusion" and "Revolution".
Several of the places the girls think Kagami may be are nods to activities and passions of hers from previous seasons:
Rose looks for Kagami in the gymnasium of Collège Françoise Dupont, thinking she was at her fencing class. Kagami is known for her talent in fencing and is known to frequently train there in several episodes.
Juleka goes to look for her at Marc's father's book store, where she is a regular client. Kagami was revealed to be a manga fan in "Glaciator 2".
Zoé goes to look for her at the Le Sorbonne. Kagami secretly met Felix there in "Pretension".
Marinette suggests the Jardin des Tuileries, stating that Kagami and her mother train there sometimes, which has been seen in many episodes since "Oni-Chan".
Ryuko contemplating alone in the sky as a cloud is similar to what she did while akumatized as Ryukomori in "Perfection".

title: The Dirtifiers
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
The Dirtifiers - Trivia
Cat Noir and Ladybug using his staff to get to a higher point and locate the Dirtifiers is reminiscent of them doing the same thing to find the Mime in the eponymous episode and André in "Elation" (tough Ladybug was Marinette at the time).
Ladybug being perched on Cat Noir's leg while he was crouched on his staff is the exact position they were in when looking for the titular villain in "The Mime". Unlike in that episode, this time Ladybug doesn't complain when using this move.
Rena Rouge seemingly summons her flute from her back directly to her hand. Hawk Moth was previously seen being able summon his cane in "Cat Blanc".
This is the second time Lila refers to Kagami as her sister, following "Perfection", though this time she literally means it, rather than saying she thinks of her as a sister.
Ella and Etta's wall drawing of their family features Hannibal, the tarantula Otis brought from the Ménagerie du Jardin des Plantes in "Sentibubbler".
Juleka suggests kidnapping Kagami, referencing her line in "Backwarder".
In production order, this is the third episode where multiple Magical Charms are given, after "Crocoduel" and "Dearest Family".
Allusions

title: The Dirtifiers
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
The Dirtifiers - Trivia
The Dirtifiers' designs, ability to shoot ink and travel through it are all nods to the Inklings and Octolings from the Nintendo video game franchise Splatoon.
Errors
When Marlena takes Ella and Etta to the bathroom, the door of the nursery is seen closed, even though it was opened in the previous shot.
When the heroes surround the Dirtifiers, there is a second tambourine floating next to Pigella.
Her eyes are also closed.
Rena Rouge also seems to have 2 flutes.
As Marlena walks towards the nursery room, there is blue paint on the floor even though Etta had said earlier that they're out of that color.
When Ladybug and Cat Noir stand under the umbrella, they seem to be on the pavement, but after Polymouse multiplies, both Ladybug and Cat Noir are standing on the road.
While Chrysalis speaks with Tomoe, her cane is missing.
When all the heroes look at Ella and Etta after they have been defeated, Vesperia's hand clips through her spinning top.
As Chrysalis detransforms, her Miraculous is missing.
It is possible that it is hidden beneath her jacket, as seen in "Re-creation".

title: The Dirtifiers

text:
The Dirtifiers - Trivia
During the balcony scene at the end, the plant pot on Kagami's left is placed on the frame, but when the perspective changes to Kagami's face, the plant pot is placed on the outside of the frame.
When Cerise walks to the other side of Tomoe's office to pick up the metal sword there, she is on the left side, but the reflection on Tomoe's sunglasses do not show the mirrored view, which shows Cerise on the left side instead of the right side in the reflection.
Assuming the movie night is the same one from "Daddycop", Sabrina is seen with her new haircut and glasses, despite her makeover occurring after the sleepover.
Also, when the girls are in their pajamas during "Daddycop", Juleka, Rose, and Mylène are not wearing their makeup. But during this episode, they are wearing their makeup while wearing their pajamas.
After Kagami disarms Tomoe, the former is standing more than halfway across the transparent bridge in Tomoe's office. But when Kagami asks her mother if she loves her, Kagami is standing much closer to the end of the bridge that is close to the office door.

title: The Dirtifiers

This also makes Kagami and Tomoe stand farther from each other than in previous shots, even though Tomoe only took a few steps and Kagami did not walk back to the other side of the bridge before asking her mother one last question.

title: The Illustrhater/Transcript
text:
The Illustrhater/Transcript - Intro
Cerise: (writing in a book) First this.. then this. Then a bit of this. Then a bit more of this. Then..  (Nooroo looks at her while he's still paralyzed)
Alya: (explaining, holding ruler) So, we have a former holder who went by Hawk Moth, then Shadow Moth and finally, Monarch. And we know that he was defeated and that a new holder claimed his Miraculous, and what we know about the new holder is...
Marinette: Nothing! We know nothing! It's even worse than before!
Alya: (yawning briefly) Is that so bad? I mean, we didn't know a lot about Monarch either, but he still got busted.
Marinette: That's not true! We know lots of things about Monarch! He was an adult male, he akumatized 212 people in total, 99.8 percent of them in Paris. His goal was to seize Cat Noir's and my Miraculous so he'd be granted one wish. Now we have a supervillain we know zilch about, who akumatizes whomever, whenever, and who knows why! This is a disaster!
Alya: (smiling) Except, this time, you've got a whole super team on your side.

title: The Illustrhater/Transcript
text:
The Illustrhater/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Ah! No, no, no, no, no, no, no, no! This is a double disaster! I gave out every Miraculous. What if one of the holders gets akumatized by this new supervillain? They could lose their Miraculous! I've put the world in DANGER!
Alya: (sits beside her) We've all been akumatized before. We know how it works, and we learned how to deal better with our emotions. (winks) Trust me, we'll be able to resist if this villain attacks us, whoever they are.
Marinette: (groans) You're right. (sits back up and hugs Alya) I'm lucky to have such good people and friends around me. (grunts, gasps) Adrien and Nino will be here soon! We've gotta get ready for the movies! (tries to pull her up) Hurry!
Alya: Oh darn, it completely went out of my head. (yawns) Forget about it. I'm beat. (takes out her phone) I'm gonna let Nino know.
Marinette: (stops her) NO! Don't cancel. I need you, please, please, please!
Alya: (stands up) Marinette, you and Adrien a legit couple for real now. You don't need us to go to the movies with you.

title: The Illustrhater/Transcript
text:
The Illustrhater/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Easy for you to say. You and Nino are so perfect together, but... (sighs) Adrien and I... Things are brand new for us as a couple, and Adrien is so perfect too. I don't wanna mess things up. So! I need to watch you guys, so I can figure out how to act perfectly around my perfect boyfriend.
Alya: Are you telling me you're afraid of spending time alone, with your boyfriend?
Marinette: Yep.
Alya: Marinette, can I be frank?
Marinette: (pushes her) Nope.
[ Theme Song ]
Alya: Hello, pretty boy.
Nino: Hello, pretty girl.
(Marinette walks behind Alya and Nino, who do a special handshake, lock their fingers together and share a kiss. Marinette tries to copy them, but fails, and accidentally pokes Adrien.)
Marinette: (looks back at Adrien) Oh! Sorry! (giggles)
Adrien: Hello, Marinette.
(They all get on the bus. Alya and Nino, who are sitting next to each other both wear Nino's headphones on the opposite side. Marinette tries to copy, but instead bangs with Adrien's head.)
Adrien: (looks at her) Are you okay?
Marinette: (smiling) Yes- yeah, I'm good, hehe. You, are you good?
Adrien: (smiling) I am, thanks.

title: The Illustrhater/Transcript
text:
The Illustrhater/Transcript - Intro
(Alya looks at her, and Marinette tries not to break when looking at her. They both start making facial expressions, then blowing a raspberry. They then both make their two hands, put behind their boyfriends, making them look like bunnies.)
Nino: Looks like we're a couple of bunnies.
(They all laugh, before the bus stops, which makes them jump around and fall. The bus driver sees that everything's down.)
Bus Driver: (tries to press everything) Everything's down.
(The citizens look confused.)
Bus Driver: (PA) Dear passengers, there's a crack in the road. The wheels are stuck. Everyone, please stay calm.
(Marinette checks the windows, and the bridge starts to break. Parisians start to worry and want to get out.)
Alya: (whispering to Nino) Ladybug was clear. Unless it's an akumatized villain, we can transform and help out ourselves.
(They both stand up.)
Alya: (whispering) We're on it.
(Marinette looks shocked.)
Marinette: What?! No, you're not!
Adrien: Marinette, they have to. They're superheroes.
Marinette: (looking back) Yeah, yeah, I know, (glares at Alya, a little angry) but, careful, okay?
Alya: Don't worry girl, everything is gonna be alright.
Adrien: We have you covered.

title: The Illustrhater/Transcript
text:
The Illustrhater/Transcript - Intro
(Alya and Nino walk to the back of the train, and Marinette and Adrien cover them as they transform.)
Alya:  (whispers) Trixx, let's pounce.
Nino: (whispers) Wayzz, shell on.
(They both transform into Rena Rouge and Carapace, and Carapace uses his strength to open the door. They nod at Marinette and Adrien before getting out.)
[Superpower Sequences]Carapace: Shell-ter! (His superpower lifts the boulders and the bus back on the bridge.)Rena Rouge: Mirage! (creates an illusion of traffic cones, a tent, and barriers to surround the area, stopping the cars from passing through)
Female civilian: It's Rena Rouge and Carapace.
Rena Rouge: This way. Head over to the secure area please.
Marinette: Those two share everything, even as superheroes.
Adrien: (holds Marinette's hands) We don't need to be superheroes to be a super couple.
(Marinette smiles and both of them go to the "secure area". Rena Rouge and Carapace are moving the bus)
Adrien: Even with superpowers, this must be hard.
Carapace: Unshield! (shield disappears)
Rena Rouge: Vanish! (illusions disappear)
Marinette: Rena Rouge thought of everything.
(Roger and his workmates arrive at the site.)

title: The Illustrhater/Transcript
text:
The Illustrhater/Transcript - Intro
Roger: Huge thanks to you two. Paris is lucky to have you.
Carapace: At your service, officer.
Carapace and Rena Rouge: Pound it!
Rena Rouge: See you next time.
(Rena Rouge and Carapace leaves.)
Boy Civilian: Superheroes are awesome, mom.
Rena Rouge: Let's rest.
Carapace: Shell off.
(Alya and Nino transform back.)
Nino: Man, it's so awesome we can be Carapace and Rena Rouge together. Too bad Adrien and Marinette can't share a bond so strong like this.
Alya: They have things they could share, they just have to get more comfortable about sharing them...
(Alya gets an idea and gasps.)
Alya: What if we let them enjoy their date, just the two of them?
Nino: You're right! Their relationship is brand new, they've gotta give it a chance!
Alya: And I can use the time to investigate the mysterious new holder of the Butterfly Miraculous. We still don't know anything about them.
Nino: Oooh, cool! Way cool! We can even be a duel of reporters! You and me! What do you think?
(Alya leans in Nino's face and kisses him on his lips.)
Alya: I think that sounds awesome.
Marinette (texting): Where are you guys? Why haven't you come back yet?
(Alya texts back.)

title: The Illustrhater/Transcript
text:
The Illustrhater/Transcript - Intro
Alya (texting): We've got something to take care of. Have fun without us!
(Marinette gasps)
Alya (texting): It's for your own good, you'll see. Love you!
Adrien: Is everything alright?
Marinette: Gaahh!!
(Marinette gets startled, and in response throws her phone up into the air.)
Marinette: Yeah! Ha-ha-ha! So, looks like we're spending the rest of the day, alone... (awkardly) just the two of us.
Adrien: Oh, okay. That's good, isn't it?
Marinette: Yeah, that's good. Very good. (teeth gritted, increasingly nervous) Very, very, very good. Really perfect.
(The bus approaches behind Marinette. When it arrives, she turns and walks onto the bus.)
Boy civilian: (I heard great things about the movie.)
(Marinette groans, not knowing what to do. She looks around, and sees various couples holding each other in various ways, which she tries to copy. She sighs as she gets tired of it, but finally sees a couple holding hands, gasping excitedly. She slowly brings her hand to what she thinks is Adrien's hand, but looks back; she's holding someone else's hand by accident.)
Marinette: (gets embarrassed) AHH!! Oh, excuse me. I'm so sorry.
(She awkwardly walks up to Adrien with her face in her purse.)

title: The Illustrhater/Transcript
text:
The Illustrhater/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: (gets concerned) You okay? (Marinette groans; Adrien notices Ryuko running on a building) Whoa, Ryuko! She's probably gonna use her rain powers to put out a fire. We're so lucky to have all these superheroes in Paris. Don't you think, Marinette?
(Adrien looks around; Marinette is gone.)
Adrien: Hm, Marinette?
Marinette: Tikki, spots--
Tikki: Marinette, I don't understand. You have everything you always wanted. Adrien is your boyfriend!
(Adrien calls Marinette through her phone, but she ignores it.)
Tikki: You have a team that can take care of any issue in Paris, which gives you more time to be with Adrien. So why do you wanna turn into Ladybug right now?
Marinette: Because I'm... the guardian, and the guardian transforms into Ladybug. Tikki, spots on!
(She transforms into Ladybug.)
[Superpower Sequences]Ryuko: Rain Dragon--!Ladybug: Lucky Charm! (summons a firefighter hose)
Ryuko: Oh, well, look at that. I was going to make it rain to put the fire...
Ladybug: Don't worry, I'm on it!
Ryuko: Be my guest.
(Ryuko gestures her sword to her left; Ladybug pants as she runs in that direction with the hose.)

title: The Illustrhater/Transcript
text:
The Illustrhater/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: Marinette! I bought the tickets! But, the movie's almost over. Where were you?
Marinette: (glancing around nervously) I... I went for... drinks! B-But they were out of them. Drinks. But that's okay, let's just... (notices a cafe, and drags Adrien along) Let's get a drink at that cafe!
Adrien: Whooaaa!
Alya: Ms. Mayor, you were one of the first people to get akumatized by the new holder of the Butterfly Miraculous.
Mayor Bustier: I was.
Nino: Do you have any memories of the experience?
Mayor Bustier: I remember how I felt prior to the akumatization, yes. I was extremely worried about our baby, and that's when I heard a voice.
Alya: Did it belong to a man or a woman?
Mayor Bustier: It wasn't clear, like several voices blending together.
Alya & Nino: (gasp, look at each other with concern)
Marinette: (glances at a few tables: a customer, Maya, & a pair of lovers; she squeals)
Phong: Hello. What will it be?
Adrien: Uh...
Marinette: Two hot chocolates and some cookies, please. Like that couple is having over there.
Nino: When that voice contacted you, by any chance, did it say its name?

title: The Illustrhater/Transcript
text:
The Illustrhater/Transcript - Intro
Caroline: I remember nothing that followed the akumatization. Only the moment I came to. Ladybug and Cat Noir were there, and it was all over.
Alya & Nino: Mm?/Mm. (Nino and Alya look at each other with concern, again)
Phong: Pistacho shrimp cookies, like the lady and gentleman are having over there.
(Marinette taps her hands on the table rapidly as Phong serves their order.)
Adrien: That's an... original combination.
Marinette: Right? Original, just like us!
(Marinette looks at another couple giggling at each other; one customer slowly feeds a cookie to her partner. Marinette tries to copy this, when Maya pops up to show Marinette her drawing of Carapace and Rena Rouge.)
Maya: Look! Look what I drew!
Marinette: Yeah, yeah! That's very pretty! Uh, why don't you show it to the next table instead?
(Maya runs to the next table, holding her drawing up.)
Maya: (giggles) Look what I drew!

title: The Illustrhater/Transcript
text:
The Illustrhater/Transcript - Intro
(A female hand shoos her away; Maya walks back disappointed. The woman at the table giggles with her partner, which Marinette stares at. Under their table, the woman is rubbing her foot on the man's leg affectionately. Marinette's face lights up as she tries to copy them. Her foot goes under the central leg of the table, but she accidentally kicks Adrien. Adrien grunts, and she gasps in a startle. Adrien rubs the area where he was kicked to ease the pain.)
Marinette: Sorry, sorry, sorry! I didn't mean to do that. I wanted to... not do that, at least, uh. I'm sorry.
Adrien: Don't worry about it. But, are you sure everything's alright?
Marinette: Why wouldn't it be? We're here together, doing it on our own. It's amazing!
(Marinette nervously slurps her hot chocolate; Adrien looks to his right, where he notices Miss Hound on top of a moving bus.)
Adrien: Oh, look, Marinette! It's Miss Hound!
(Marinette has disappeared again. Adrien stands up and looks around.)
Adrien: Uh, Marinette?
(Marinette rushes into the bathroom.)
Marinette: Tikki, spots--
(Someone knocks on the door. Marinette opens the door; Maya is outside.)
Marinette: (gasps) What is it?

title: The Illustrhater/Transcript
text:
The Illustrhater/Transcript - Intro
Maya: Wanna see another pretty drawing?
Marinette: Sorry, I don't have time. Later, okay?
(Marinette hurriedly closes the door. Maya sighs sadly and turns around. Marinette sighs.)
Marinette: Tikki, spots on!
(Marinette transforms.)
(Miss Hound jumps from the train, where Mrs. Michelle is standing in distress.)
Mrs. Michelle: My cat! My cat!!
Miss Hound: Don't worry, Mrs. Michelle!
(Miss Hound throws her ball up to a tree, where Mrs. Michelle's cat is stuck, meowing loudly. The cat touches the ball.)
Miss Hound: You're up, kitty!
(Miss Hound catches the ball.)
[Superpower Sequence]Miss Hound: Now, Fe--!
(Suddenly, Ladybug's yo-yo wraps around the cat, retracting to Ladybug.)
Miss Hound: ...etch.
(The cat reappears in Miss Hound's hands.)
Ladybug: Awesome job, Miss Hound.
Miss Hound: Yeah, well, I didn't have time to do muc--
Ladybug: Oh! Polymouse!
(Ladybug leaves.)
Miss Hound: ...much.
(Phong places a receipt on the table.)
Phong: Did your girlfriend leave?
Adrien: Oh, no. Uh, I mean, she'll be back. She's like that. She comes and goes.
Phong: O...kay.
(Phong walks into the café. Adrien sighs and lays back, opening his eyes to see Polymouse and Ladybug running on the rooftops.)

title: The Illustrhater/Transcript
text:
The Illustrhater/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: Huh?
(Adrien smiles, but is unsure. Finally, he decides to join the superheroes, making sure to pay for the meal by leaving a 20-euro note on top of the receipt. The note falls off of the table due to the wind.)
Cat Noir: Did she call you?
Two boy civilians: Woah!
Polymouse: No. I thought I would multiply and shrink and sneak under the car, but I didn't have a chance.
(Ladybug has wrapped her yo-yo around the car, and is slowly lifting it up. She throws the ball that was under the car at Polymouse.)
Ladybug: There you go.
Polymouse: Thanks?
Ladybug: Always there for you, Polymouse. Don't you forget it! Bug out!
(Ladybug leaves with her yo-yo again. Cat Noir looks at her suspicious. Ladybug lands on a nearby rooftop, looking around the city. Cat Noir pops up to her using his staff.)
Cat Noir: Uh, m'lady? Are you bored or something?
Ladybug: No! Of course not! Why would you ask that?
Cat Noir: You could've let Polymouse handle this on her own, don't ya think? Aren't you the one who said as long as it's not someone akumatized, do whatever you want?

title: The Illustrhater/Transcript
text:
The Illustrhater/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: But it's always nice to have some help. Where were you, by the way? I haven't seen you all day when I haven't stopped for a minute.
Cat Noir: Hold on, hold on. I thought you handed out all the Miraculous precisely so you wouldn't have to take care of everything and everyone, and get some private time?
Ladybug: Yeah, well, I have no choice. What if something, ANYTHING happened? They could get hurt, or akumatized! No. As long as we're in the dark about the new holder of the Butterfly Miraculous, there's no way I'm leaving the others on their own. (gasps) There!
(Ladybug points elsewhere and rushes in that direction. Cat Noir grunts.)
(Phong picks up the empty receipt and walks inside.)
Maya: Phong! Phong! Look what I drew!
(Phong ignores Maya, making her even sadder. He hands the receipt cup to Maya's father, the owner who is behind the counter; he facepalms. Maya walks up to her father's leg, trying to get his attention.)
Maya's father: Never lose sight of customers.
Maya: Dad! Look what I drew!
Maya's father: Maya, can't you see that I'm busy? Customers are like children: we take care of 'em and we watch them.
(Maya walks away, now crying.)

title: The Illustrhater/Transcript
text:
The Illustrhater/Transcript - Intro
(Maya is sitting on the toilet, crying with her face in her sketchbook. An akuma approaches her, and enters her sketchbook.)
(Maya is sadly drawing in her sketchbook. Chrysalis appears.)
Chrysalis: Hello, Maya. Forgive my intrusion, but, I seem to feel a huge disappointment. No one's interested in your drawings when they're so pretty! Do you feel ignored? Like no one sees you?
Maya: Yes. It's no fair!
Chrysalis: I think I know what would be fitting. For no one to be able to ignore your drawings anymore. I can give you this power. Only if you agree, of course.
Maya: Yes! (stands up)
Chrysalis: And what should I call you?
Maya: The Illustrhater!
(Chrysalis closes her palm.)
(Maya transforms into The Illustrhater, and opens her new sketchbook. She doodles in it, drawing a door and ripping the page out. The door comes to life.)
(The Illustrhater comes through the door.)
The Illustrhater: Look! Look what I drew!
(She takes a page out of her sketchbook; a car-like vehicle appears.)
The Illustrhater: Look at my pretty drawings!
(She flies away laughing.)
Alya: We already knew that victims forgot everything after they got akumatized. We haven't learned anything new.

title: The Illustrhater/Transcript
text:
The Illustrhater/Transcript - Intro
Nino: This is a seriously tough investigation, but if there's one journalist who can handle it... (puts hand on Alya's leg) it's you.
(Alya turns around to face Nino, when the Illustrhater is heard giggling and seen flying past.)
The Illustrhater: Look at my pretty drawings!
(Alya and Nino get up to see the source of the noise.)
Alya: What was that?
The Illustrhater: Look what I drew!
(The Illustrhater takes a page out of her sketchbook, spawning a giant snail. The snail moves towards a moving train, colliding with it. Civilians scream.)
Nino: Shall we go?
Alya: If it's an akumatized villain, we've gotta wait to be called.
Nino: Shouldn't we at least get those passengers to safety?
(Alya texts Marinette.)
Alya: (texting) Marinette, I know you're busy with Adrien, but we have an emergency!
(Alya sends the text.)
Alya: Let's pretend it wouldn't break any rules.
(Alya and Nino go inside to transform.)
[Superpower Sequence]Carapace: Shell-ter!(shield opens bus doors, civilians exclaim)
Rena Rouge: We're going to turn into road safety pros!

title: The Illustrhater/Transcript
text:
The Illustrhater/Transcript - Intro
(Two passengers jump out of the bus, Rena Rouge and Carapace ensuring their safety. The ground shakes; the Illustrhater has summoned a giant ball that bounces towards the bus.)
Carapace: Shell-ter!
(The ball bounces off of the shield. In the sky, the Illustrhater takes at least three more pages out of the sketchbook, which summon multiple flowers.)
Carapace: Where's Ladybug?
Cat Noir: So, how are things with you? Life? Love? Everything?
Ladybug: Oh! All good! Especially the looove department.
(Ladybug empties a garbage can into the garbage truck and takes it back. The truck moves forward as Ladybug talks.)
Ladybug: Things are super duper awesome with me and my boyfriend. Everything feels simple and natural, and I perfectly know how it works when you're a couple. I'm not afraid at all of disappointing him or doing ANYTHING wrong! How about you and your girlfriend?
Cat Noir: Well, I guess we're fine, too?
(Ladybug gets a notification from Rena Rouge.)
Rena Rouge: Are you transformed?
Ladybug: Well, yeah.
Rena Rouge: Then WHERE ARE YOU?! I'm with Carapace and there's an akumatized villain in town!
Ladybug: Uh, we've been... super busy, but we're on our way.

title: The Illustrhater/Transcript
text:
The Illustrhater/Transcript - Intro
(Ladybug and Cat Noir run to deal with the akumatized villain.)
(Rena Rouge dodges The Illustrhater's projectiles as Carapace skates on his shield next to her, both reaching Ladybug and Cat Noir.)
Cat Noir: Now that's an animated drawing!
Carapace: Happy to see you, my dudes.
(The Illustrhater notices the heroes.)
The Illustrhater: It's Ladybug! Hi, Ladybug! Look what I drew!
(She drops a comic-like explosion that fades to reveal her animated style of a gigantic Ladybug.)
Ladybug: We have to find her akumatized object ASAP!
[Superpower Sequence]Ladybug: Lucky Charm!(summons a megaphone; catches it)
(The other heroes carefully step away from the Ladybug drawing as it almost steps on them.)
Carapace: I bet the Ultrakuma's in the sketchbook!
Cat Noir: I bet it's in the pen!
Ladybug: (running on the drawing pole, with megaphone) Thank you for you drawing, but it'd be better if they stayed on the page. Don't you think?
The Illustrhater: You don't like my drawings, do you!?
Ladybug: (stutter) On the contrary, I love them. Could I see your sketchbook?
The Illustrhater: (keeping it in arms) Hmph. No! MINE!!

title: The Illustrhater/Transcript
text:
The Illustrhater/Transcript - Intro
(The Illustrhater draws a yo-yo, throwing a barrage of them at the team while they run to hide in one of the drawn houses.)
Rena Rouge: Wherever the akumatized object is, we'll have to be sly; this kid won't let go of her precious art supplies easily.
(Ladybug thinks for a second to explain her plan; a visual of it is illustrated in the background.)
Ladybug: Carapace, trap her in a shield to prevent her from fleeing. I'll wrap my yo-yo around it, then you'll make the shield disappear. She'll find herself tied up, and all you'll have to do is take her notebook and pencil to destroy them.
Rena Rouge, Cat Noir & Carapace: Got it!
(Carapace, Rena Rouge, Cat Noir and Ladybug jump out of the house and start running towards the villain, each wielding their respective tools.)
Carapace: Shell-ter!
(Carapace's Shell-ter confines the Illustrhater, as planned.)
The Illustrhater: Hey, let me out!
(Ladybug shoots the yo-yo up to continue her plan, while the Illustrhater draws a door and brings it to life. Just as the yo-yo wraps around the Shell-ter...)
(...The Illustrhater comes through the door, again.)
The Illustrhater: It's not nice to lock me up.

title: The Illustrhater/Transcript
text:
The Illustrhater/Transcript - Intro
(She draws a cloud on her sketchbook and takes the page out; the cloud comes to life.)
The Illustrhater: I just want to show my pretty drawings!
(She summons multiple objects at once; including a star, a muffin, a pencil, and two rockets.)
[Superpower Sequences]Cat Noir: Cataclysm! (destroys rocket)Carapace: Shell-ter! (deflects muffin)Ladybug: Lucky Charm! (summons art supplies)
Cat Noir: A box for art supplies? (jumps; flies away on rocket)
Ladybug: Exactly what I needed.
(Ladybug opens the box; all of the spaces are empty.)
Ladybug: Or not.
Carapace: I can go get things to fill it with.
Rena Rouge: What if... (object hits ground) ...we use this time and try to find out more about the new Butterfly villain... (deflects object with flute) ...BEFORE the Illustrhater is de-akumatized and forgets everything?
Ladybug: (closes art supply box) Brilliant idea. (gives art supplies to Carapace, he and Ladybug jump out of frame)
(Rena Rouge and Cat Noir run on building rooftops as the Illustrhater flies at the same pace making drawings.)
Rena Rouge: Say, these are really pretty drawings! Does the person who gave you your powers like them?

title: The Illustrhater/Transcript
text:
The Illustrhater/Transcript - Intro

title: The Kingdom
text:
The Kingdom - Intro
is an overarching antagonistic syndicate in Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. They are a group of people who seek to find the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses in order to make their perfect world for their families and for their own personal desires.

title: The Kingdom
text:
The Kingdom - History
The timeline of this secret organization's existence is unknown, but it is clear that Gabriel Agreste, known among his fellow members as "The Diamond", was part of it. The entire council was aware that he was Monarch and shared his objective of obtaining the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses to use their combined powers to create a "perfect world".
In a flashback in "Yaksi Gozen", it's shown that Gabriel reached out to Tomoe when he was struggling to defeat Ladybug and Cat Noir, asking for her help, enticing her with the possibility of using the Ladybug and Cat Miraculous for themselves, despite Tomoe warning him about the risk of the two being possibly considered traitors to the organization if they happened to find out about it.
In "Re-creation", Bug Noire convinced Gabriel to think of his son's future before he would've perished due to Cat Noir's Cataclysm. He decided to sacrifice himself by using the Ultimate Miraculous Absolute Power, and therefore left his mission.

title: The Kingdom
text:
The Kingdom - History
Some time later in "El Toro De Piedra", the council summoned Nathalie, Gabriel's "Shadow", to explain what had happened. When the group asked Nathalie for details about Gabriel's final moments, she claimed she had been unconscious during Monarch's final battle. Although technically true, as she was brought back to life by Gabriel's wish, this was a ruse to protect Marinette and her identity as Ladybug from the organization, leading the council members to believe she did not know what had transpired. Tomoe Tsurugi, who uses the alias "The Machine", then stepped forward and offered to take over Gabriel's mission, with Nathalie as her "Shadow". The other members approved this arrangement. As the council members logged out, one of them, known as "The Stomach", spoke to Nathalie, reminding her of his own plans for the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses, and asking if she understood his orders. Nathalie replied affirmatively, revealing that the council member was her father.
In "Yaksi Gozen", the council members welcome their new "Diamond", the one that succeeded Gabriel as "The King of Luxury".

title: The Kingdom
text:
The Kingdom - History
In "Noe", the Kingdom decided to take action after witnessing the impact that Mayoress Bustier was having on Paris, which they disapproved of. Noé Luxus, a young and successful luxury businessman, attempts to purchase the Gabriel brand from Adrien. He also greenlights a script that claims to be based on real events, aiming to discredit Ladybug and Cat Noir by portraying them as supervillains and allies of Monarch. Noé becomes a stockholder at TVi, which enables him to fire Nadja Chamack after she attempts to reveal the truth about the script and spreads rumors that Mayoress Caline Bustier manipulated the elections. He also volunteers to run for the position of Mayor. When The Mime attacks and forces the nature of the defamatory script to be revealed, Noé manages to escape any repercussions by claiming that he was also deceived by the script's author. Ultimately, it is revealed that the entire scheme was designed to promote him as the new "King of Luxury". By the end of the episode, it is revealed that Noe is the son of Audrey Bourgeois, making him the half-brother of Chloé Bourgeois and Zoé Lee.

title: The Kingdom
text:
The Kingdom - System
Currently, not much is known about how the organization operates. It appears to be led by a council of twelve members, although there are only eleven members remaining after Gabriel's death.
In "Yaksi Gozen", the group regained its twelfth member after Noé Luxus took Gabriel's position as "The Diamond".
Each member is represented by a unique symbol and has a code name. Some of these council members have assistants, known as "Shadows", who act as their enforcers. If a council member leaves the organization, whether due to expulsion or death, another member can claim their "Shadow".
In "Yaksi Gozen", it is implied that the use of the Ladybug and Cat Miraculous is meant for the collective's common interests, and that hoarding their use may be considered as treason in the organization, as Tomoe feared of being considered a traitor for helping Gabriel in getting the Miraculous only for the two of them.

title: The Kingdom
text:
The Kingdom - Trivia
The Kingdom mirrors the one led by The Supreme in the Re-Verse.
Both had the Gabriel Agreste of their respective world as member, with the one from the Quantic Universe sacrificing his life to save Nathalie and ensure his son's future and the one from the Re-Verse betraying The Supreme after obtaining the Butterfly and Peacock Miraculouses.
Both search to use the power of the Miraculous so they can make what they perceive to be a "perfect world".
While The Supreme's organization had already the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses at their disposal (with only the former being allowed to use their Absolute Power), the Kingdom of the Quantic Universe is looking to obtain them from Ladybug and Cat Noir.
Interestingly, at the moment, both organizations are after those two Miraculous, after Shadybug and Claw Noir deserted The Supreme and sided with Betterfly as Ladybug and Furry Paw.
The meeting of the Kingdom with Nathalie resembles the meeting of SEELE with Gendo and Fuyutsuki from Neon Genesis Evangelion.

title: The Kingdom
text:
The Kingdom - Trivia
Despite the fact that the existence of the Kingdom is still unknown to both Ladybug and the Miraculers, the former became cautious about one of his members, Noé Luxus, after he caused a lot of chaos and problems for her friends and even drove one person to be akumatized.
While Gabriel and Nathalie's hunt for the miraculous was known since "The Collector," several other members of The Kingdom were foreshadowed throughout the show:
Tomoe and Audrey's involvement was foreshadowed in "Feast," when the two of them were watching Guardians' temple being restored.
Camilo Pista's involvement was foreshadowed in "Miraculous Paris," when he first appeared in the contact list in Gabriel's cellphone.
This may also imply that Frank Masson and Francis Kasenti, the other unknown contact numbers appearing in Gabriel's contact list, may be involved in The Perfect World Project.
