(Jalil walks away while Alim is talking on the phone.)
Alim: No, Mr. D'Argencourt, we're not burning the painting of the Liberty leading the people.
(Alix looks sad.)Bunnybug: Oh no, Jalil's leaving already? That's so sad...but maybe...something can be done about this.
(She rewinds the portal back to when the soccer ball is about to hit the plate of cheesecake, reaching her hand out of a burrow portal to turn the plate over just a little bit.)
Bunnybug: Turning a plate a little to the left or to the right isn't really changing the timeline.
(She lets the events play out again, this time the ball misses the plate of food and lands near where Jalil is. A little boy comes to get it.)

title: The Dark Castle/Transcript
text:
The Dark Castle/Transcript - Intro
Little boy: Sorry about that.
Bunnybug: There! Crisis avoided. Alya, Nino, and Ivan: Woahhhh!
Ivan: That looks delicious!
(A pigeon sat up in a tree then poops on the cake.)
Alya, Nino, and Ivan: ewwwwww! Bunnybug: Gross! Ugh, I can't let that happen. (She starts rewinding the actions of the despicable bird.) This won't throw the universe off balance.
Alya, Nino, and Ivan: Woahhhh!
Ivan: That looks delicious!
(This time, Bunnybug catches the pigeon poop through a burrow portal. It gets splattered on the wall of the burrow while the pigeon flies away.)
Bunnybug: Bye bye, little pigeon! Alya: Psst! Time for cake.
(Everyone gets up to gather around near the cake.)Bunnybug: (Gasps) The moment we're all waiting for! Everyone: Happy birthday to you, happy birthday to you, happy birthday dear Alix-
(Screams of shock as Nathaniel steps into a bowl of chocolate pudding and accidently launches the cake forward. Most of the cake lands on Jalil, covering his letter in frosting too.)
Jalil: This was supposed to be perfect.
Bunnybug: Don't sweat it! Bunnybug is here to help you step by step.
(She rewinds the scene.) Alya: Psst! Time for cake.
(Everyone gets up to gather around near the cake.)

title: The Dark Castle/Transcript
text:
The Dark Castle/Transcript - Intro
(Nathaniel and Marc are carrying the cake, walking towards Alix who has everyone else gathered behind her. This time, Bunnybug reaches out of a burrow portal and moves the bowl of chocolate pudding to the side.)
Everyone: Happy birthday to you, happy birthday to you, happy birthday dear Alix, happy birthday to you!
(This time, Nathaniel and Marc get the cake to Alix with no complications.)
Bunnybug: Playing with the timeline is not so risky after all! (The pigeon flies in to stand on the bowl of pudding, scaring the rabbit who runs off into the street while a man is riding the bike. The man loses balance trying to avoid the rabbit and accidentally drives in front of a bus, which drives onto a boat and launches a long rod that hits a helicopter. The helicopter comes crashing down near the Eiffel Tower, causing an explosion that makes the Eiffel Tower fall, hitting a blimp that also crashes down. We then fade out into space to see the Earth, where multiple explosions are now covering Europe, and soon the rest of the world too.)  Bunnybug: Okay! I'm not touching anything anymore, for real.Everyone: Happy birthday dear Alix-

title: The Dark Castle/Transcript
text:
The Dark Castle/Transcript - Intro
(Screams of shock as Nathaniel steps into a bowl of chocolate pudding and accidently launches the cake forward. Most of the cake lands on Jalil, covering his letter in frosting too.)
Jalil: This was supposed to be perfect.  Bunnybug: (Sighs) Sorry Alix, your party is ruined. Alix: Is this for me?
(Alix takes the letter and opens it, seeing a photo of her as a baby throwing food on a younger Jalil.)
Alix: Thanks, Jalil! That's such a cool photo!
Jalil: I look at it when I miss you.
Alix: Things have changed, but we still love each other a lot. (She hugs him.) Don't we, big bro?
(He hugs her back and Alim smiles at his children. He then gets another call on his phone and walks to the side to answer it.)
Alim: No, no, no, no, Mr. D'Argencourt! Now stop harassing me OR I'LL HAVE YOU BANNED FROM THE LOUVRE!!
(Alix looks at the photo again, comparing it to Jalil who's currently covered in cake.)
Alix: Looks like things haven't changed that much.
(Everyone at the party laughs, with Jalil looking slightly embarrassed.)Bunnybug: Okay...looks like things are fine...huh?

title: The Dark Castle/Transcript
text:
The Dark Castle/Transcript - Intro
(She sees an flag of darkness in the distance and zooms in on it, zooming out to show a dark Louvre and knights in front of a broken version of the glass pyramid; and it reveals that the butterfly holder has akumatized D'Argencourt for his frustration and anger.)
Bunnybug: Uh...uhhhh...I didn't do anything this time! No, not like this. This looks more like a Ladybug situation; she must be the one to fix this. Except I'm not Ladybug, I'm Bunnybug! And as holder of the Rabbit Miraculous I must not intervene or leave the burrow. It'd be too dangerous, but I can't just let an akumatized villain roam free in Paris...that's too dangerous too! Ugh, what should I do?! (Gasps) I know! I can go if I leave the Rabbit Miraculous with someone else like I did with Bunnyx!
(Visuals illustrate her point, showing a chibi Bunnybug throwing the Rabbit Miraculous at a chibi Alix, who transforms into Bunnyx while she becomes Ladybug again.)
Bunnybug: I just have to find someone I trust one hundred percent...like myself! Tonight's Marinette will be perfect!

title: The Dark Castle/Transcript
text:
The Dark Castle/Transcript - Intro
(She scrolls through another portal that shows Future Marinette laying in bed at night.) Future Marinette: Don't tell me, you need me to guard the Rabbit Miraculous.
Bunnybug: How did you know?
Future Marinette: Well, I am you from the future.
Bunnybug: Of course! That makes sense.
Bunnybug: Divide!
(She transforms back into Ladybug and holds out the Rabbit Miraculous to her future self.)
Ladybug: Marinette Dupain-Cheng, here is the mira-
Future Marinette: Don't worry, I know the drill. Fluff, clockwise.
(Future Marinette transforms into Bunnynette and scrolls through a burrow portal to a rooftop near the Louvre.)
Bunnynette: Good luck, this villain's gonna be a toughie.
Ladybug: Oh? Do you have any tips to make this... easier?
Bunnynette: Unfortunately, I'm not allowed to-
Ladybug: Interfere with the timeline, I know. (Groans)
(Ladybug goes through the portal.)
Bunnynette: I know you'll be alright. (Ladybug opens the Miraculous Call system on her yo-yo and clicks on Cat Noir's icon.)Adrien: You can't stay like that, Jalil. I'll go get something to clean you up.
(Adrien runs off to hide behind the carousel.)
Adrien: Sorry Plagg, picnic's over.

title: The Dark Castle/Transcript
text:
The Dark Castle/Transcript - Intro
Plagg: There wasn't a single piece of cheese anyway. Picnic might as well not even have started.
Adrien: Plagg, claws out!
(He transforms into Cat Noir and uses his staff to launch himself away from the park.) Cat Noir: M'lady.
(They both start running towards the Louvre, watching the knights destroy the glass pyramid.)
Cat Noir: You think they're trying to get in for free?
Ladybug: I doubt they're fans of art.
Cat Noir: They don't look like fans of ours either.
(Some of the knights run up to attack them with their swords while the heroes dodge or block with their own weapons.)
Ladybug: It's nice of you to join us but we'll take the unguided tour!
Cat Noir: Cata-
Ladybug: Careful, kitty! You could hurt the akumatized villain if they turn out to be one of them!
Cat Noir: You're right, m'lady.
(Cat Noir opens the helmet of one of the knights, seeing no one inside.)
Cat Noir: Huh? No one! May I?
Ladybug: Sure, kitty.
Cat Noir: Cataclysm! (He destroys the moving armor completely) There's no ultrakuma in this one!
Ladybug: (Knocks a knight's head off with her yo-yo.) No one in here either!

title: The Dark Castle/Transcript
text:
The Dark Castle/Transcript - Intro
(Cat Noir also knocks a knight's head off with his stick and then cataclysms the rest of the armor. The heroes keep fighting and destroying the knights.)
Cat Noir: Come on, where's the akumatized villain?
Dark Castle: Hahahaha! You'll never find me!
Ladybug: Sounds like it's coming from inside. Ladybug: Whoever you are just what are you trying to achieve?
Dark Castle: Doing history justice. The Louvre must become a fortress protecting Paris again, like Phillip the second of France had wanted.
Ladybug: You should brush up on your history! You're forgetting that the French revolutionaries fought to turn this castle into a museum so people could have access to art!
Dark Castle: Decadent art that tarnishes the values of monarchy!
Cat Noir: More like art that upholds the values of democracy!
Dark Castle: There is nothing you can do to stop the return of monarchy!
(Ladybug's vision highlights the museum's crown gallery.)
Ladybug: The crown gallery!
Cat Noir: You're right. If the villain thinks he's a monarch, he might be in there.
(The heroes fight off more knights that are blocking the crown gallery.)
Dark Castle: Don't try to stop the monarchy, it's above you!

title: The Dark Castle/Transcript
text:
The Dark Castle/Transcript - Intro
(The heroes make their way into the crown gallery and realize there's no one inside, the throne is empty.)
Cat Noir: Why try to keep us from getting in if the room's empty?
Dark Castle: Since you enjoy the museum so much, how about becoming exhibits yourselves for eternity?
(The chandeliers and columns in the room start to fall down.)
Ladybug: It's a trap!
(A column falls over, right above and about to hit Ladybug and Cat Noir.)
Ladybug: Lucky Charm!
(She creates a shield that holds the column up for a second to allow Cat Noir to push them out of the way. A big chunk of debris then starts falling which Cat Noir destroys.)
Cat Noir: Cataclysm!
Ladybug: Come on, we've got to get out of here!
(The heroes run to the exit as the room starts spinning while continuing to crumble in on itself.)(The Louvre then starts moving and shifting into a giant humanoid state, revealing the entire building to actually be the villain the Dark Castle.)
Cat Noir: Okay, so he isn't hiding in the castle...
Ladybug: He is the castle!
Dark Castle: I am the Dark Castle, and your magic will be no match for my power! The noble stone that founded history!

title: The Dark Castle/Transcript
text:
The Dark Castle/Transcript - Intro
(The Dark Castle starts walking around as Ladybug and Cat Noir begin to run after it.)
Cat Noir: M'lady, we could use some backup, don't you think?
(Ladybug remembers the rest of the Miraculers are having fun at Alix's party.)
Ladybug: No need for backup. We can do this on our own, kitty.
(The Dark Castle launches a 'fist' at them, allowing the heroes to climb up onto him.)
Cat Noir: Your optimism never ceases to amaze me, m'lady!
Chrysalis: (voice) You'll never get Ladybug and Cat Noir to rally behind your noble cause, Dark Castle. They deserve the fate reserved for traitors and rebels. But first, remember to seize their miraculous.
(Another part of the giant castle pushes Ladybug away, but she hangs off another part of him and jumps back up to wrap the yo-yo around his 'head.)
Ladybug: Missed me! Can't get rid of a ladybug that easy.
(She misses and starts falling but wraps her yo-yo around another part of the villain. Cat Noir then attempts to run up to the top but loses his balance once the Dark Castle starts launching objects and artifacts out of himself. He jumps in and ends up in a flipped over hallway.)
Cat Noir: The museums closing. Please proceed to the nearest exit!

title: The Dark Castle/Transcript
text:
The Dark Castle/Transcript - Intro
(He cataclysms through a bunch of walls, causing the Dark Castle to shake violently until he comes out through the other side and runs up to the top.)
Cat Noir: Cataclysm!
(He attempts to destroy the flag at the top, but it disappears Cat Noir's night vision then spots the flag near the bottom of the walking castle.)
Cat Noir: M'lady, I think I found the akumatized object.
Dark Castle: You'll never reduce the monarchy to ashes.
(Ladybug and Cat Noir run over to the flag but it disappears and ends up on the other side of the villain again.)
Ladybug: There!
Dark Castle: Tallyho!
(Quick montage of the heroes running onto the moving parts of the villain to get to the flag, but each time they're about to grab it the flag disappears and ends up somewhere else.)
Cat Noir: (slightly out of breath) How are we supposed to know where it'll reappear next?
Ladybug: We can't without a great stroke of luck.
[Superpower Sequence]Ladybug: Lucky Charm!(She gets a sausage with netting around it.)
Cat Noir: Are you suggesting a picnic, m'lady?
Ladybug: No, I have another plan. A tied-up one.

title: The Dark Castle/Transcript
text:
The Dark Castle/Transcript - Intro
(The heroes dodge more artifacts that start shooting out of the Dark Castle, with Ladybug swinging around and tying the giant villain up with her yo-yo.)
Dark Castle: You think you can start a revolution with a puny bit of string you peasant?!
(Cat Noir hits the villain in the 'head' with his staff repeatedly which causes the villain to crush his own 'head' with his 'fist'.)
Ladybug: The day of glory has arrived!
(With the villain all tied up with her yo-yo, Ladybug pulls on the string completely breaking the huge castle into pieces. This also cuts the pole of the flag, releasing the ultrakuma. Ladybug and Cat Noir make their way down as the Dark Castle completely crumbles.)
Ladybug: No more evil doing for you, ultrakuma! (She opens up her yoyo.) Time to de-evilize! (She catches the ultrakuma.) Gotcha! Bye bye, little butterfly! (She releases the butterfly.)
(The Dark Castle turns back into Armand.)
Ladybug: Miraculous Ladybug!
Armand: Again, with this vile pyramid?! It's defacing this noble building that was once home to the French sovereigns!
Ladybug: Mr. D'Argencourt, weren't the pyramids the last homes of the sovereigns of Egypt?
Armand: Uh...they were, indeed...you're right.

title: The Dark Castle/Transcript
text:
The Dark Castle/Transcript - Intro
(Ladybug pulls a Magical Charm out of her yo-yo and gives it to him.)
Ladybug: This jewel will remind you that we shouldn't rewrite past history, for it helps us to make the right decisions in shaping our future.
Armand: Thank you, Ladybug...You know, this pyramid isn't so ugly after all.
Ladybug and Cat Noir: Pound it!
(Ladybug goes to a rooftop near the Louvre and contacts her future self on her earpiece.)
Ladybug: Bunnynette, I'm done!
(She heads inside a burrow portal that opens in front of her.)Bunnynette: Counterclockwise
(She turns back into Future Marinette and hands the Rabbit Miraculous back to Ladybug.)
Future Marinette: Good job, Ladybug.
Ladybug: Thanks, Marinette. Fluff, Tikki, unify!
(She transforms back into Bunnybug and manipulates a Burrow portal to show Marinette's bed.)
Future Marinette: (yawns) At last, I can go to bed.
Bunnybug: Thanks for your help.
Future Marinette: If you want something done, do it yourself.
(She jumps back into her bed through the portal.) Cerise: She wasn't there. It goes to show... but I need to check again to make sure. Again, and again, and again.
Alix: So, how was your afternoon in the burrow, not too boring?

title: The Dark Castle/Transcript
text:
The Dark Castle/Transcript - Intro
(Bunnybug spots the bird poop from earlier and quickly kicks it away so Alix can't see it.)
Bunnybug: No! haha, not for a minute haha! Spots and lops away! (transforms back into Marinette)
Alix: You didn't miss the whole thing, I brough you back some cake!
(Marinette takes the cake and scarfs it down before looking sad again.)
Marinette: Sorry about your surprise. It could've been better if-
Alix: Are you kidding? It was uber awesome! The best birthday of my whole life! Thank you, Marinette, for real.
Marinette: No, thank you for everything you do. Your mission is such a hard one. I can't make you do this anymore, Alix, becoming Bunnyx again, living away from your friends... just because I couldn't secure the Butterfly Miraculous. This isn't fair. It's my mistake, not yours.
Alix: Okay, you can keep the Rabbit Miraculous, but in exchange you give me the Ladybug.
Marinette: Huh? But I'm Ladybug!
Alix: And I am Bunnyx.
Marinette: And the best one there is. (gives her the Rabbit Miraculous back) Happy birthday, Bunnyx.
Alix: Fluff, clockwise. (transforms into Bunnyx.) (Marinette gets an alert on her phone and opens it up to hear a recorded message from Adrien.)

title: The Dark Castle/Transcript
text:
The Dark Castle/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: (recording) Alya told me that you were sick. I hope it's not too serious. When you wake up, let me know if you need anything and I'll come right over.
Marinette: (happy squeal) Thanks Adrien, I just woke up, and I think I'm still a bit contagious. But um, I super appreciate your message and I'm sure that thanks to you, I'll feel one hundred percent tomorrow morning.
(Marinette finally enters her home and we hear a conversation between her and her dad offscreen.)
Tom: So how did the picnic go, sweetheart?
Marinette: It went great, dad. And the cake was delicious. Tom: So how did the picnic go, sweetheart?
Marinette: It went great, dad. And the cake was delicious.
(Marinette enters her room. We then cut to her flopping onto her bed in her pajamas.)
Marinette: (sighs) What a day.
(She checks her phone to see the time.)
Marinette: Three...two...one...and...
(A burrow portal opens in front of her.)
Marinette: Don't tell me, you need me to guard the Rabbit Miraculous.
Bunnybug: How did you know?
Marinette: Well, I am you from the future.
Bunnybug: Of course! Makes sense.
(Bunnybug lifts Marinette into the portal, but almost immediately afterwards another burrow portal opens up.)

title: The Dark Castle/Transcript
text:
The Dark Castle/Transcript - Intro
Bunnybug: Thanks for your help.
Marinette: If you want something done, do it yourself.
(She jumps back into her bed through the portal.)
Marinette and Bunnybug: Pound it!
(Bunnybug leaves and Marinette gets an alert on her phone again, seeing a new message from Adrien.)
Adrien: (recording) See you tomorrow morning, Marinette. I love you.
Marinette: I love you, Adrien. See you tomorrow morning.
(Marinette stares happily at the framed photo of Adrien on the wall next to her bed.)
es:El Castillo Sombrío/Transcripción

title: The Dirtifiers/Transcript
text:
The Dirtifiers/Transcript - Intro
Tomoe: Duusu, spread my feathers!
(She transforms and lies on a large geode. She then pulls a feather from her hand fan.)
Peacock Tomoe: Mirror's reflection / Diamond made into a girl / Dragon above men.
(She turns the feather into an amok and places it into her ring. She then creates a senti in her womb.)
Nurse: What are you going to name her?
Tomoe: Kagami.
[ Theme Song ]
Kagami: It's the story of a samurai's wife who was betrayed. She managed to escape with a child and now must protect them from the henchmen of the awful lord. It's thrilling!
Tom: Whoa, it does sound thrilling!
(The camera pans to show Tom and Sabine peeking in from the trapdoor. Tom is holding pastries.)
Tom: Oh, uh, pretend we're not here!
(Tom sets the pastries down.)
Rose: Whoa, are those the same ones as last time?
Sabine: Nope, this one you haven't had yet! You know how Tom is.
Tom: Well, of course! My daughter is my muse! Nothing's too good for her sleepovers!
Marinette: Thanks, Dad. (kisses him on the cheek)
Tom: You're welcome, Cupcake.
Sabine: What about me?
(They both kiss on her cheeks and then laugh.)
Kagami: Ahem. Can we start the movie now?

title: The Dirtifiers/Transcript
text:
The Dirtifiers/Transcript - Intro
(The scene cuts to them engrossed in the movie. Tom and Sabine are shown to be peering in again.)
Marinette: Hey, this is a sleepover! You can't be here!
(Kagami pauses the movie.)
Tom: Sorry, you're right. We're adults.
Marinette: (laughs) That's not the problem. It's just that you're supposed to be wearing PJs!
Tom: Oh! In that case.
Sabine: Sorry for the interruption.
(Kagami continues the film, and Tom and Sabine now wear PJs. They laugh at a line in the film.)
Kagami: Are your parents always like this?
Marinette: Sure. We never miss a chance to spend time together.
Tom: We just love our Cupcake so much!
Marinette: You okay, Kagami?
Kagami: Yes, yes, I'm just trying to focus on the movie.
(Alya gets a phone call and walks to a corner.)
Alya: Mom?
Marlena: Okay, we just got the results. We're having a baby girl!
(Alya screams in excitement, surprising the others.)
Alya: Yay!
Ella and Etta: We wanna paint too!
Marlena: Stay out of the room, girls! You'll get everything dirty! (to Alya on the phone) Gotta go, Sweetie! Love you!
Marinette: What's up?
(Kagami once again pauses the movie.)
Alya: I can tell you now. I'm gonna have another baby sister!

title: The Dirtifiers/Transcript
text:
The Dirtifiers/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: What?! Your mom's pregnant?!
Rose: Oh, that's wonderful!
Kagami: Don't you already have sisters?
Alya: Yep! And now we're gonna be a family of seven! The more the merrier—that's how we do it! Things are gonna be even more fun around the house!
Rose: We've gotta celebrate!
(The group parties with confetti falling from the ceiling. Kagami sits on top of Marinette's bed and continues watching the movie with headphones in. Marinette climbs up.)
Marinette: Is something wrong?
Kagami: No, nothing. I just wanna watch the end of the movie.
Marinette: (dejected) Okay...
(Marinette leaves her be, and Kagami watches the movie upset.)
Bot: Password?
Kagami: ただいま。 (Translation: I'm home.)
(The elevator door opens and she enters. She then makes her way to her mom's door.)
Kagami: Mother, I'm home. Did you have breakfast yet?
(The door buzzes and flashes red, and Kagami leaves the bag behind as she takes the elevator to her room. Once there, another bot lifts up her bag to her.)
Bot: Fencing class in ten minutes.
(She picks up the bag before Marinette gives her a call. She answers.)
Marinette: Hey, Kagami! You seemed a little sad last night.
Kagami: No, I had a lot of fun.

title: The Dirtifiers/Transcript
text:
The Dirtifiers/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: I get it. That's 'cause you wanted to show us your movie but we kept stopping it, right? But I promise, we'll have another sleepover where we watch it all the way through with no interruption! We can even watch it twice, if you want! I'll talk to my parents.
Kagami: That's not necessary, Marinette. It was a perfect sleepover. Your parents are very kind, and it's great that I get to share moments with them and you girls. Alya is so excited about her baby sister. It's normal to celebrate—it's very good, even! Everyone is happy.
Marinette: Even you?
Kagami: You know how things are here at home, so when I see you all so joyous to be with your families, it feels strange. I've never had that with my mother.
Marinette: I... I'm sure she loves you, in her own way.
Kagami: You know my secret. You know I'm not like you, and my mother isn't like any other parents either.
Marinette: Well, how 'bout meeting up with us girls again today? Come and join our picnic!
Kagami: I can't. I've already reached my allowance of social interactions for the weekend.
Marinette: Your what?

title: The Dirtifiers/Transcript
text:
The Dirtifiers/Transcript - Intro
Kagami: I'm only allowed to see a certain number of friends each weekend. My mother wants me to focus on more serious matters. Anyway, thank you for your concern, but I'll manage on my own, like always. You girls have fun.
Marinette: Kagami—
(Kagami hangs up on her.)
Bot: Warning: leave now for fencing class, or risk tardiness.
(Kagami sits for a second before angrily getting up and smacking her bag to the ground and kicking the bot over.)
Longg: Anger is like a fire that burns in the hearts of those battling unanswered questions.
Kagami: I know, Longg. But why have a child if you're just going to leave them all alone?
Longg: If your mother used the Peacock Miraculous to give birth to you, it means she really wanted to have a child.
Kagami: That magic jewel can turn an emotion into a living being, so what was her emotion when she created me?
Longg: I... don't have an answer to that question.
(Kagami storms out of her room, leaving her phone behind, which receives another call from Marinette. She then barges into her mother's room.)
Kagami: Mother, why am I here?
Tomoe: I could ask you the same thing. You should be at fencing class by now.

title: The Dirtifiers/Transcript
text:
The Dirtifiers/Transcript - Intro
Kagami: You never spend time with me, you never show me affection. I feel like it doesn't matter to you if I'm here or not, so why did you make me?
Tomoe: Why do you ask?
Kagami: I can see how different things are for my friends. Why aren't we a family like everyone else?
Tomoe: Why would you want to be like everyone else?
Kagami: Stop answering my questions with more questions!
Tomoe: If you want answers, you must prove yourself worthy of them.
(She touches the end of her cane, which makes two swords rise up from the ground. Kagami takes one.)
Kagami: I want to know what was in your heart when you used the Peacock Miraculous to bring me to life!
Tomoe: I made you to be better than other people!
(They begin sword fighting.)
Kagami: That's not an emotion!
Tomoe: My greatest joys revolve around you: your fighting abilities, the pride watching you surpass children your age in every way!
Kagami: You made me so you would be admired. I'm just a tool to satisfy your ego!
(Kagami knocks the sword out of Tomoe's hand and makes Tomoe lose her balance.)
Tomoe: And when you accept this, you're fulfilling your mission perfectly. Mirror's reflection / Diamond made into a girl / Dragon above men.

title: The Dirtifiers/Transcript
text:
The Dirtifiers/Transcript - Intro
Kagami: I didn't ask for a haiku; I want an answer!
Tomoe: This is my answer.
Kagami: Do you love me?
Tomoe: I... love it when you make me proud.
Kagami: I wish I could've been your daughter, but all I'll ever be to you is a trophy!
(She throws her sword to the ground and runs away to her room upset.)
Kagami: (to Longg) I'll never be loved like my friends! Longg, bring the storm! (transforms into Ryuko)
Marlena: Girls, I'm feeling tired. I'm going to take a quick nap. Try not to make too much noise, okay?
(She lies down on the couch.)
Ella: (to Etta) Mommy is tired. Let's help her finish the work!
(They peek into the nursery.)
Ella and Etta: Mommy's going to be so proud of us!
Marinette: No, she shouldn't be all alone!
Alya: You okay, girl?
Marinette: I am, but Kagami isn't! I don't know how to help her, and if there's one thing that really bugs me, it's not knowing how to help someone!
Rose: What's wrong with Kagami?
Marinette: Last night, she saw how caring my parents are and how Alya's family is so loving and kind to each other! And then she came home to her mother...
Sabrina: But what can we do?
(Marinette thinks for a moment.)
Marinette: We'll do what friends do!

title: The Dirtifiers/Transcript
text:
The Dirtifiers/Transcript - Intro
Juleka: Kidnap her?
Marinette: (surprised) Uh, of course not, Juleka! Although... let's go get her and take her to the picnic with us!
Girls: Awesome!
Etta: We're out of blue!
Ella: That's okay! We can use some orange!
Etta: Oh, and some green!
Ella: It's hard. The colors are all so pretty!
Etta: That's okay! Let's just use them all!
Ella: Yeah!
(They giggle and drive their stroller full of paints and brushes into the nursery.)
Marinette: Hello?
(The bot appears again.)
Bot: Hello. How can I help you?
Rose: (whispering) I think the cube just spoke.
Sabrina: Why are we whispering?
Bot: Sorry, I'm having trouble understanding your request.
Marinette: Hello, uh, Mr. Cube. Um, is Kagami home, please?
Bot: Do you have an appointment?
Marinette: No, but she's our friend!
Bot: I don't understand your answer. Please rephrase it.
Alya: (impatiently) Could you just tell us where to find Kagami?
Bot: I'm sorry—I'm not authorized to provide such information. Would you like to make an appointment?
Mylène: No, we just wanna talk to her!
Bot: If you wish to talk to Ms. Tsurugi, you need to make an appointment. Would you like to make an appointment?
Zoé: No, we wouldn't!
Juleka: Or maybe we would?

title: The Dirtifiers/Transcript
text:
The Dirtifiers/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: You're right. We would like to make an appointment, please!
Bot: Please indicate your availability.
Marinette: We're available now!
Bot: I'm sorry. Ms. Tsurugi is currently away at a meeting. Please adjust your request.
(Marinette makes a dismayed face, and the girls end up back at the front of the building.)
Marinette: Where could Kagami be? We should split up and look for her!
Rose: I can go to the gymnasium. Maybe she's already at fencing class!
Alya: I'm coming with you—I'll search the other rooms at school.
Juleka: Or she's at Marc's parents' bookstore. She's always buying mangas there.
Zoé: I can see if she's at the movie theatre.
Sabrina: I'll check the Place des Vosges!
Mylène: And I'll stay right here in case she comes home!
Marinette: Perfect! I'll go check the Tuileries. She practices there with her mother sometimes! First one who finds her tells the others!
(They all nod and split up. Marinette runs into an alleyway.)
Tikki: Aren't you going to the Tuileries, Marinette?
Marinette: I've got a better idea. Kagami isn't answering, but I'm sure she'll pick up if I call Ryuko. Tikki, spots on!

title: The Dirtifiers/Transcript
text:
The Dirtifiers/Transcript - Intro
(She transforms into Ladybug and then uses her Miraculous Call system to summon Ryuko.)
Ryuko: Do you need my help with an akumatized villain?
Ladybug: No, I just wanted to talk to you.
Ryuko: I am not coming back down.
(She disconnects.)
Ladybug: "Coming back down?"
(She looks up and smiles.)
Ella and Etta: Mommy, Mommy!
Ella: Mommy, come see this!
Etta: It looks so good—you'll see!
(The twins giggle as Marlena gets up to see a trail of paint leading to the nursery.)
Ella: We finished painting Little Sissy's room!
Etta: So you could get plenty of rest!
(Marlena looks into the room horrified as she finds it splattered with paint all over.)
Ella and Etta: Surprise!
Marlena: I don't believe this! (inhales) You two really are walking disasters! (brings them into the bathroom) You got the entire apartment dirty! Go wash up in the bathroom and don't come out until I'm done cleaning everything up!
(She slams the door. The twins pull themselves up to the sink and start using the soap on each other.)
Etta: (sadly) Mommy's really, really angry!
Ella: We caused a dirty disaster!
(An ultrakuma flies in and goes into the soap bottle they're both touching.)

title: The Dirtifiers/Transcript
text:
The Dirtifiers/Transcript - Intro
Chrysalis: Hello, Etta. Hello, Ella. Forgive my intrusion, but I've sensed a great sadness in you. What's wrong?
Etta: (sniffles) It's Mommy. She doesn't love us anymore!
Ella: (sniffles) Because we made everything dirty!
Chrysalis: I understand why that would make you sad. It's hard having a mom who doesn't love you. Do you know what would be fitting? For you two to have the power to make all of Paris dirty.
Ella: But if we do that...
Etta: Mommy will get even more angrier!
Chrysalis: Oh, not at all! Right now, your mom thinks what you did is dirty, when in truth, it is beautiful! If everything everywhere is dirty, then your little sister's room won't look so dirty anymore, and your mom will stop being angry.
Etta: And she'll love us again?
Chrysalis: Exactly. Do you want that power?
(They look at each other before celebrating!)
Ella and Etta: Yay!
Chrysalis: And what should I call you?
Ella and Etta: The Dirtifiers!
(Chrysalis closes her palm.)
Mr. Anciel: I'm sorry, no, Kagami hasn't been here today. Oh, what is that?
(Juleka turns around to see the Dirtifiers spewing ink around and giggling.)
Dirtifiers: We're gonna dirtify all of Paris!

title: The Dirtifiers/Transcript
text:
The Dirtifiers/Transcript - Intro
(They jump and spin around, causing a large amount of ink to be spewed.)
Juleka: (pushes Mr. Anciel away) Look out, Mr. Anciel!
Dirtifiers: Mommy's gonna love our pretty paintings! Dirt-portation!
(They jump into a blotch of ink and disappear. Juleka scowls before hiding. Roaar pops up.)
Juleka: Roaar, we've gotta warn Ladybug. Stripes on! (transforms into Purple Tigress)
Cosmobug: Why are you here?
Ryuko: Everything feels lighter up here. No one's missing me down below anyway.
Cosmobug: Of course we are! We're all looking for you!
Ryuko: Don't bother. You're looking for Kagami Tsurugi, and I no longer want to be her.
Cosmobug: How can you say that? Kagami Tsurugi is loyal, sincere, brave, always there for her friends—she's one of the best people I know!
(Ryuko briefly turns into a storm cloud.)
Ryuko: "The best?" That's all that matters to my mother, too.
Cosmobug: Not everyone can have a perfect family.
(Ryuko turns back into a storm cloud and enlarges, creating a whirlwind around Cosmobug.)
Ryuko: Easy for you to say! Your parents are wonderful. You talk to each other—play and laugh together! They'd do anything for you! They even give you...

title: The Dirtifiers/Transcript
text:
The Dirtifiers/Transcript - Intro
(Lightning crackles and Ryuko turns back into a smaller, regular cloud.)
Ryuko: ...hugs.
(Cosmobug gives Ryuko a hug on the back.)
Cosmobug: Forgive me. You're right—I am lucky! But friends are like a second family, a family you get to choose, and your friends are waiting for you down there! They can't wait to see Kagami Tsurugi again.
(Cosmobug gets a message from Purple Tigress.)
Cosmobug: I have to go. There's been an akumatization. Join us when you feel ready.
(She flies down.)
Ladybug: Hey, Dirtyflyers, you shouldn't dirty the pretty city of Paris!
(Cat Noir hops down nearby.)
Cat Noir: I think their name's "Dirt Fires," M'lady.
(Purple Tigress and Pigella drop nearby.)
Purple Tigress: No, it's "Dirty Fires."
(Miss Hound and Vesperia are shown to have joined near Ladybug.)
Miss Hound: Don't you mean "Dirt Fliers?"
Ladybug: You know what? Let's just call 'em "Grubby."
Dirtifiers: You're the ones about to get grubby!
(They do another jump-spin attack, causing all the Miraculers to dodge them. They then teleport through the ink again.)
Cat Noir: They're gone. It's a dirt-saster!
Ladybug: Don't panic, Kitty Cat!
(She takes an earpiece out of her yo-yo.)

title: The Dirtifiers/Transcript
text:
The Dirtifiers/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: We'll canvas the city and find them! Girls, spread out!
(They all split up.)
Cat Noir: What about me? Should I stay here and let the mice play?
Ladybug: Of course not. You're coming with me, Kitty Cat!
Chrysalis: (telepathically) Don't move!
(She blows an antikuma which hits Purple Tigress right as she falls down.)
Dirtifiers: No one will stop us from dirtifying all of Paris!
(They teleport through the ink again.)
Purple Tigress: (to earpiece) I got hit by an antikuma!
Ladybug: Purple Tigress, go hide and recharge your kwami to get your powers back!
Ladybug: (over earpiece) The rest of you, watch out! The villains could come out of anywhere!
(The Dirtifiers run towards the bridge, laughing and spewing ink while a Polymouse clone on another rooftop spots the villains.)
Dirtifier (Etta): No more Canal Saint-Martin. From now on, it's Canal Saint-Dirt!
Polymouse: (to earpiece) We've got the villains in sight. It's time to clean up this mess!
(She jumps down, traps the Dirtifiers with her skip rope, and uses Multitude to shrink down into 6 copies and trap them with even more ropes.)
Dirtifiers: You'll never catch us!

title: The Dirtifiers/Transcript
text:
The Dirtifiers/Transcript - Intro
(They do another jump-spin, which knocks the Polymouse clones over. They then teleport through the wall to behind one of the Polymouse clones. Another antikuma is shot, hitting the clone and causing Polymouse to form back into just one. The Dirtifiers then teleport away again.)
Polymouse: (to earpiece) They got me too, and now they're gone!
Ladybug: Cat Noir, use your staff so we can spot them!
Cat Noir: Brilliant, M'lady!
(He lifts himself and Ladybug up with the staff, and Ladybug spots a trail of ink forming near the Eiffel Tower.)
Ladybug: Over there!
Cat Noir: They're heading to the Eiffel Tower!
Ladybug: That's where Rena Rouge is!
The Dirtifers: There! The whole city is dirty now! So pretty!
(Rena Rouge watches from above.)
Ladybug: (over earpiece) Try and hold them back, Rena Rouge! We're coming!
Rena Rouge: I'll play a little something for them. (plays her flute) Mirage!
(She creates an illusion that makes the Eiffel Tower look clean again.)
Dirtifiers: Hey! What's that dirty trick!
(They jump up and shoot the tower again, removing the illusion.)
Dirtifiers: That's so much better!
(Rena Rouge creates another illusion of the Eiffel Tower being clean.)

title: The Dirtifiers/Transcript
text:
The Dirtifiers/Transcript - Intro
Dirtifiers: No! Our pretty splotches!
(They get under the Eiffel Tower and shoot it again. Ladybug and Cat Noir become visible on the tower once the illusion disappears. The heroes jump down and ambush them.)
Ladybug and Cat Noir: Surprise!
(The Dirtifiers jump back and start spewing ink again. Ladybug and Cat Noir try attacking them, but they dodge before teleporting. They end up closer to where Rena Rouge is, shoot near her, and then jump through the ink they shot, giving Chrysalis the chance to send out another antikuma which hits Rena Rouge. The Dirtifiers then run away giggling.)
Rena Rouge: Oh, come on! (to earpiece) I'm out of the game, too.
Ladybug: The larger their painted area, the easier it is to escape from us. We'll never succeed like this!
(Ryuko appears behind Ladybug through a bolt of lightning, causing Ladybug's pigtails to swing upwards in startled fright before she and Cat Noir turn around in shock to see who just made the impressive entrance.)
Ladybug: Ryuko!
Ryuko: It's time for Paris to get a makeover! Water Dragon!

title: The Dirtifiers/Transcript
text:
The Dirtifiers/Transcript - Intro
(Ryuko turns into a huge swirl of water, cleaning the Eiffel Tower. The water then bursts off, cleaning the surrounding area. The Dirtifiers drop near the Eiffel Tower again.)
Dirtifier (Ella): Hey, everything's clean!
Dirtifier (Etta): Who's the cleaners?
(The Miraculers drop down and surround them. They shoot below them and teleport away.)
Cat Noir: Ugh, they keep slipping through our fingers!
Ladybug: We're gonna need a Lucky Charm!
(She creates an umbrella.)
Ladybug: Looks like it's time for a big change in weather, Ryuko!
Cat Noir: Yep! A really massive storm to clean all of Paris at once!
Ryuko: I've never conjured a storm that big.
Ladybug: But I'm sure you can!
Cat Noir: We're with you!
(The Miraculers surround Ryuko reassuringly. The elements surround Ryuko as she attempts to create the storm.)
Miss Hound: Have faith in yourself!
Ladybug: You can do this!
(Ryuko rises off the ground.)
Ryuko: Storm Dragon!
(A massive storm covers all of Paris, erasing all the ink. Cat Noir hides under Ladybug's umbrella, causing her to give him an annoyed look. The Dirtifiers try to create more ink, but the rain quickly washes it away.)
Dirtifiers: Oh no!

title: The Dirtifiers/Transcript
text:
The Dirtifiers/Transcript - Intro
Dirtifier (Etta): If Paris is clean again!
Dirtifier (Ella): Mommy won't love us anymore!
(Ladybug and Cat Noir drop near them.)
Ladybug: Huh? Why would their mom stop loving them?
(Cat Noir shrugs. The girls try to ink Ladybug, who shields herself with the umbrella, and run away.)
Polymouse: Multitude!
(Several Polymouse clones fall out of the sky and chase the Dirtifiers back towards Ladybug and Cat Noir.)
Purple Tigress: Clout!
(She drops out of the sky and creates a large crater, stopping the Dirtifiers from moving any further. They then try to spin into the air.)
Vesperia: Venom!
Cat Noir: Cataclysm!
(Vesperia hits and immobilizes them, leaving the Dirtifiers with shocked looks on their paralyzed faces now that they couldn't move an inch, while Cat Noir lands on and destroys their ink canister, causing the ultrakuma to fly out.)
Ladybug: No more evildoing for you, ultrakuma! (She opens up her yo-yo.) Time to de-evilize! (She catches the ultrakuma.) Gotcha! Bye-bye, little butterfly! (She releases the butterfly.)
(Ryuko turns back into a regular cloud, and she and Ladybug smile at each other.)
Ladybug: Miraculous Ladybug!

title: The Dirtifiers/Transcript
text:
The Dirtifiers/Transcript - Intro
(She tosses the umbrella in the air, fixing the crater and drying the ground. The Dirtifiers revert back to Ella and Etta, who open their eyes and gasp at the sight of the Miraculers, who are smiling at them.)
Miraculers: Pound it!
Marlena: I've been looking for you everywhere! I was so scared!
Etta: So you still love us?
Marlena: Huh?! Of course I love you, girls!
Ella and Etta: Even when we cause dirty disasters?
Marlena: (chuckles) Well, it would be better if you didn't cause any, but I'll never stop loving you!
(The three hug and Alya walks in. Ladybug then hands the twins Magical Charms.)
Ladybug: These Magical Charms will help you remember what your mom just told you.
Ella and Etta: Thanks, Ladybug!
(Ladybug swings out of the apartment, where Ryuko is hiding nearby.)
Ryuko: Ladybug, wait!
(She gives Ladybug a hug.)
Tomoe: I saw the storm you created. My teaching is bearing fruit. You're becoming the warrior I've hoped for. We can finally move on to the next step in your training.
(She presses the button on her cane again, summoning the swords once again, only this time, they are made of metal instead of wood.)
Tomoe: Wood turns to metal / Undefeatable dragon...

title: The Dirtifiers/Transcript
text:
The Dirtifiers/Transcript - Intro
(Ryuko ignores her and walks by, surprising Tomoe.)
Ryuko: ...Soft heart under scales.
Marinette: I guess you've reached your allowance of social interactions in just one night, right?
Alya: Huh? What are you two talking about?
Kagami: Nothing. Besides, there'll never be a limit again, and it's much better like this.
Chrysalis: Good evening.
Tomoe: After the defeat Kagami inflicted upon you, you should've stayed holed up in your lair.
Chrysalis: After the humiliation my sister inflicted upon you, you must be getting bored without anyone left to train.
(She snaps her fingers and detransforms. She then presses the end of Tomoe's staff, summoning the swords once again, and she grabs one while Tomoe looks up.)

title: The Gherkin
text:
The Gherkin - Intro
, officially 30 St Mary Axe, is a commercial skyscraper located in London's main financial district, the City.

title: The Gherkin
text:
The Gherkin - Description
Opened in 2004, The Gherkin is a 180-meter-high, 41-story neo-futuristic tower with small, triangular, bluish windows. Located in the City of London, its oblong shape with a rounded top is reminiscent of a gherkin, hence its name.

title: The Gherkin
text:
The Gherkin - Trivia
The Gherkin has had several names since its construction, including 30 St Mary Axe and the Swiss Re Building.
At the foot of 30 St Mary Axe lies the tomb of a Roman-era adolescent girl. This tomb was discovered during the construction of the tower and was preserved at the Museum of London until 2007.

title: The Four Columns
text:
The Four Columns - Intro
are a work by Josep Puig i Cadafalch built on the hill of Montjuic, just above the Magic Fountain of Montjuic in Barcelona, Spain.

title: The Four Columns
text:
The Four Columns - Description
Initially built in 1919 and rebuilt in 2010, the Four Columns are columns with Ionic capitals 20 meters high and 2.5 meters in diameter.
Enthroned on Montjuïc hill and overlooking the famous Magic Fountain of Montjuïc which occupies their original location, The Four Columns represent the four stripes of the Catalan flag and symbolize the perseverance, conviction and steadfastness of the Catalan language, culture and national identity.

title: The Four Columns
text:
The Four Columns - Trivia
The Four Columns is classified as Public Art in Barcelona.
Initially built as a symbol of Catalanism and for the 1929. Universal Exhibition, the Four Columns were destroyed in 1928. under the dictatorship of Primo de Rivera.

title: The First Secrets/Transcript
text:
The First Secrets/Transcript - Intro
Narrator: Some events are known to all. Others are known to only one person, me. For only I know every secret.
[Intro]
Narrator: In the beginning, Marinette Dupain-Cheng was just a normal girl.
Narrator: But then on her first day back at school in 9th grade, her life changed dramatically. First, because she made a new friend.
Alya: Girl, you just need more confidence!
Marinette: (grabs a macaron from the box and gives half to Alya) Marinette.
Alya: Alya.
Narrator: But what changed Marinette's life the most was being chosen to become Ladybug.
Tikki: Trust yourself, Marinette. Just say "Spots on".
[ Transformation Sequence ]Marinette: Spots on? (the earrings activate) Whoa! What is happening?! (Marinette transforms into Ladybug for the first time)
Narrator: Finally, Marinette's heart started beating in a new way as she discovered a feeling previously unknown to her. Love. True love.
Adrien: I've never been to school before. I've never had friends. It's all sort of new to me. (He hands her his umbrella, and they share brief eye contact through the exchange.)
Adrien: See you tomorrow. (walks down the stairs)
(Marinette drops her bag.)

title: The First Secrets/Transcript
text:
The First Secrets/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Uh-huh! See you to... mo... tomo..  Haha! Whoa, why am I stammering?
Tikki: Hey! I think I might have an idea! (flies onto Marinette's cheek)
Plagg: (peeks out of Adrien's shirt and looks at him) First day of school and we already have two lovebirds.
Adrien: Pfft. Whatever, she's just a friend. Oh, a friend... (smiles and blushes then he enters the car and goes home)
Narrator: What Marinette didn't know, for it was a secret, was that on that same day,
Narrator: ...the new classmate she had just fallen in love with also received a Miraculous, that of the Black Cat.
Cat Noir: (while tightrope walking over his staff) I'm starting to get the hang of this. (sees Ladybug falling onto him. They both fall and get hung by the yo-yo which is attached to Cat Noir's staff)
Cat Noir: Well, hey there. Nice of you to drop in.
Ladybug: Oh, I'm sorry, I didn't do it on purpose.
Cat Noir: I bet you're the partner my kwami told me about. I'm... Cat Noir. Yeah, Cat Noir. And you?
Ladybug: I'm Ma... err... Mar... uhh... (pulls the yo-yo and it hits Cat Noir's head) Madly Clumsy. I'm so clumsy.
Cat Noir: No sweat, clumsy girl.
Narrator: As they met each other for the first time,

title: The First Secrets/Transcript
text:
The First Secrets/Transcript - Intro
Narrator: ...Cat Noir became instantly infatuated with Ladybug.
Adrien: Her name's Ladybug.
Plagg: Eww, wee. What is this?
Adrien: Seriously? My personal chef made all this!
Narrator: What he didn't know, for it was a secret, too, was that under the superhero's mask was Marinette, which led to comical situations.
Cat Noir: I know that Ladybug is not in love with me, but I can't help telling her how I feel. I wish I could fall in love with someone else, but I can't. She's just so incredible! I'm so afraid I'm not the good person I thought I was, and now I've gone too far, and she hates me.
Marinette: (smiles) She doesn't hate you.
Narrator: Of course, since Marinette had fallen for Adrien, Ladybug couldn't be in love with Cat Noir.

title: The Pharaoh
text:
The Pharaoh - Intro
"" is a season 1 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 15th written and produced episode of season 1. It is also the 15th written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: The Pharaoh
text:
The Pharaoh - Synopsis
When a villain with the power of the Egyptian gods wants to sacrifice Alya, Ladybug and Cat Noir must fight an army of mummies to rescue her.
Disney+
Ladybug and Cat Noir face Alix's brother, now Pharaoh.

title: The Pharaoh
text:
The Pharaoh - Plot
Marinette is watching Alya's new blog update. Alya is tracking Ladybug when she passes by, hanging onto a helicopter, dropping her history textbook in the process. Alya picks it up, identifying it as a 10th-grade history textbook, thus announcing her belief that Ladybug's secret identity may be that of a student.
Marinette panics since Alya will know something's up if she asks to borrow her history textbook. Tikki tells her that what's done is done; that she can only keep looking ahead; and that, if she wants to keep her identity secret, she needs to get the book back from Alya. Tikki then types on Marinette's computer and brings up a web page about an exhibit at the Louvre on the Pharaoh Tutankhamun. Tikki urges Marinette to invite Alya to the museum and to have her to bring the book with her. Marinette is skeptical, not understanding what King Tut has to do with Ladybug, but Tikki promises that the trip will be worth it.

title: The Pharaoh
text:
The Pharaoh - Plot
Marinette ends up telling Alya that she found something about Ladybug at the King Tut exhibit, so they go to the Louvre. Alya excitedly talks about how close she is to finding out Ladybug's identity, as their school is the only one that uses this particular history textbook, and there are only 43 girls in their grade, excluding herself. Marinette tries to exclude herself from the suspects list, but Alya points out that Marinette had to borrow her textbook yesterday. Panicked, Marinette makes the excuse that she'd forgotten her own book at home and that Alya knows how she always loses or forgets things. Alya just laughs and says she was teasing. Marinette will be off the suspects list when she brings her book to school.

title: The Pharaoh
text:
The Pharaoh - Plot
As the girls reach the King Tut exhibit, a young man shoves past them and drops a bunch of papers and a pendant, which, thankfully, hasn't broken. He introduces himself as Jalil Kubdel, their classmate Alix's older brother, before running off to greet his father, Mr. Alim Kubdel. Shrugging at his odd behavior, Alya turns back to Marinette and asks why she brought her here and what this has to do with Ladybug. Marinette tries to stall, and Tikki points her over to a papyrus scroll on the wall in the corner. Unfortunately, the scroll is covered in hieroglyphics without a translation. Marinette tries to find something that's relevant to Ladybug before Alya loses interest.
In his room, Adrien is on the Ladyblog, watching the video of Alya finding the history book. He, too, wonders if Ladybug goes to his school. Plagg doesn't understand why humans crush on each other instead of cheese. Adrien replies that girls smell better than cheese, much to Plagg's annoyance.

title: The Pharaoh
text:
The Pharaoh - Plot
Meanwhile, Jalil and Mr. Kubdel join Marinette and Alya in front of the scroll as Jalil explains the images on the scroll. He identifies a man holding a scepter as Pharaoh Tutankhamun I and the woman next to him as Princess Nefertiti with one hundred mummies surrounding them. The Princess died before the Pharaoh did and became the Sun God, Ra's wife in the afterlife. Mr. Kubdel remarks that he already knows all this since he organized this exhibit. Jalil then claims to have deciphered the hieroglyphs, theorizing that the images on the scroll depict a resurrection ceremony in which the pharaoh tried to bring his princess back from the afterlife and that the scroll contains a spell to bring people back from the dead.

title: The Pharaoh
text:
The Pharaoh - Plot
Marinette remarks that, like Alya, Jalil is prone to jumping to conclusions. Likewise, Mr. Kubdel is unconvinced and cautions Jalil that anything written in the scroll is a legend and cannot be interpreted so literally. Jalil insists that he is right and suggests proving his theory by using the pharaoh's scepter on display nearby and reading a spell from the scroll. Having lost his patience, Mr. Kubdel yells at Jalil for treating the scepter like a toy instead of a priceless historical artifact. He leaves, telling Jalil to stop with his wild theories and start focusing on the real world. In his lair, Hawk Moth senses Jalil's dejection and sends an akuma his way.
While Marinette stalls, Alya grows bored and takes the book out of her bag. Before she can open it, Marinette jumps in and puts the book away, insisting that she's found something about Ladybug. Outside the museum, the akuma finds Jalil and lands on the pendant around his neck, transforming him into Pharaoh and giving him the ability to harness the powers of the Ancient Egyptian gods.

title: The Pharaoh
text:
The Pharaoh - Plot
Transforming into Thoth, Pharaoh creates bubbles and traps several museum visitors and security guards inside them, slowing down their perceptions of time. Alya and Marinette duck behind some displays, the history textbook falling out of Alya's hands in the process. Alya begins livestreaming everything with her cellphone while Marinette sneaks off and transforms into Ladybug. Back home, Adrien is watching Alya's feed and transforms into Cat Noir when he sees Pharaoh stealing the scroll and scepter.
Ladybug dives into the Egyptian exhibit room as the museum's security doors come down, trapping her, Pharaoh, and Alya. She tries to fight Pharaoh, but he grabs her yo-yo and swings her into a wall. He then transforms into Sekhmet and uses his enhanced strength to pull apart the bars of the security door. Cat Noir arrives, but Pharaoh easily defeats him by throwing him into a sarcophagus. He then notices Alya hiding behind a display and kidnaps her, taking the scroll and scepter and pulling the bars back in place behind him.

title: The Pharaoh
text:
The Pharaoh - Plot
Ladybug and Cat Noir escape the room by using Cataclysm on the bars, and Cat Noir goes to recharge his Miraculous. Ladybug uses her yo-yo to access the Ladyblog, where Alya has been livestreaming her abduction. Outside the museum, Pharaoh uses Anubis' powers and transforms all the bystanders into mummies. At Alya's questioning, he explains that he needs one hundred mummies and a sacrifice (a soul pure of heart) to resurrect his Princess. He reveals that he plans to exchange the Princess's soul for Alya's (because she looks like the person being sacrificed in the pictures on the papyrus scroll) to appease the Sun God, Ra.
Hearing this, Ladybug runs to rescue Alya but accidentally gets trapped in one of the time-warping bubbles. Cat Noir returns and pops the bubble, and they run to the roof to witness the resurrection ceremony in the courtyard. Alya, still being held hostage, notices a figure in a spotted dress on the scroll who seems to be swinging a yo-yo. When she questions Pharaoh, he explains that the goddess on the scroll is Ladybug, who had thwarted the original Pharaoh's resurrection ceremony 5,000 years ago.

title: The Pharaoh
text:
The Pharaoh - Plot
Pharaoh recites the spell and a beam of energy shoots up from the Louvre Pyramid, opening a portal in the sky. The mummies grab Alya and begin carrying her toward the pyramid, but Cat Noir distracts them while Ladybug swings in on her yo-yo and carries Alya to safety on a nearby rooftop. With Alya's help, Ladybug realizes that the akuma must be in the pendant. However, Pharaoh transforms into Horus and flies up and captures Alya again, dropping her onto the beam on top of the pyramid to be transported into the portal.

title: The Pharaoh
text:
The Pharaoh - Plot
The mummies attack Cat Noir, but he and Ladybug trap them in a bus. Ladybug then ties her yo-yo around Pharaoh and manages to grab the pendant from around his neck when he's flying. It falls to the ground, but he retrieves it before she or Cat Noir can. Just as Alya is about to disappear into the portal, Ladybug uses Lucky Charm, and a Ladybug costume falls out. She spots the pair of earrings that come with the costume. She then bargains with Pharaoh, offering herself as a sacrifice in Alya's place, with the reasoning that Pharaoh can finally have his revenge on Ladybug for stopping him the first time 5,000 years ago. Pharaoh agrees and releases Alya, placing Ladybug on the beam to the portal.
Pharaoh holds out his hand for Ladybug to give him her Miraculous, but she grabs his pendant and throws the toy earrings from the Ladybug costume to the ground, telling him to go fetch. When he is distracted by the decoy, Ladybug destroys the pendant and catches the akuma. After that, she purifies the akuma, and with the help of her Lucky Charm, Ladybug then returns everything back to normal. After that, Pharaoh transforms back into Jalil.

title: The Pharaoh
text:
The Pharaoh - Plot
Ladybug returns Alya's phone to her, and Alya asks her how old she is. To throw Alya off Marinette's trail, Ladybug replies that she's definitely "much older than a high school student." Cat Noir asks Alya if she wants to know how old he is. She replies that she will know "in a sec", referring to him detransforming. Cat Noir looks at his ring and runs off while Alya giggles.
When Alya wanders back into the museum to the King Tut exhibit, Marinette makes the excuse that she was turned into a mummy. Alya is happy to have learned that Ladybug is 5,000 years old, but she's confused because the history book in her bag has disappeared. As Alya searches for the book, Marinette keeps walking and giggles to herself.

title: The Pharaoh
text:
The Pharaoh - Plot
Later that night, Tikki explains that she is actually much older than 5,000 years. There has always been a Ladybug superhero, and Tikki is the kwami who has watched over every Ladybug since the beginning. Marinette wonders if the other Ladybugs were as klutzy as herself. Tikki replies that every Ladybug is different, but Marinette is surprising, unpredictable, endearing, talented, a quick learner, and the cutest Ladybug. The episode ends with Tikki telling Marinette to get some sleep because she has a history test tomorrow. Marinette quips that at least her test is about ancient Egypt.

title: The Pharaoh
text:
The Pharaoh - Trivia
Internationally, this episode premiered in Korea.
This episode was the third to air in France and the seventh to air in Korea.
The date of the video and Alya's live stream on the Ladyblog suggests this episode takes place on May 21.
With the inclusion of the Ladyblog video, this episode takes place over the course of two days. However, it could be anywhere from three days to a week long because Marinette did not have her textbook the previous day and had to borrow from Alya and because the Ladyblog video was filmed "last week".
In the English dub of this episode, Alya says on her blog that she is in the 10th grade.
In the French dub of this episode, Alya says it is a troisième-year textbook, which is equivalent to Year 10 in the UK and Grade 9 in the US.
Alya threw this textbook behind her when Pharaoh showed up so that she could film for the Ladyblog.
In the French version, Marinette had written her name in her history book before she dropped it.
In the Korean dub of the episode, Pharaoh seeks to revive Queen Ankhesenamun, who, according to the episode, died before King Tutankhamen. Historically, Ankhesenamun was King Tut's only wife, and she died later in life than her husband.

title: The Pharaoh
text:
The Pharaoh - Trivia
In the English version, Ankhesenamun is called "Princess Nefertiti", after another Egyptian Queen with a much easier to pronounce name.
Nefertiti was King Tut's father's (King Akhenaten's) first wife. She is not related to King Tut and died about a year after Tut became Pharaoh.
In the French version, the Pharaoh is Akhenaten and the Egyptian Queen is Nefertiti. This rendition of names is considered the canonically accurate version.
Which is actually incorrect because the real King Tut ruled Egypt 3,300 years ago.
The pharaoh that ruled Egypt 5,000 years ago was actually King Menes.
This episode also takes considerable liberties with Egyptian mythology. In the myths, Thoth was the god of writing and knowledge, not the god of time. Sekhmet was the goddess of war but is portrayed as a goddess of destruction. Horus was the god of kingship and ruled the sky, but there are no major legends about him with wings. His mother, Isis, goddess of magic, was the only Egyptian deity with wings.
When Pharaoh is about to perform the spell to offer Alya to Ra, the sun god, the mummies stand around them in an ankh, an Egyptian hieroglyph which reads as "life."

title: The Pharaoh
text:
The Pharaoh - Trivia
In the English dub of this episode when the Lucky Charm equips Ladybug with a costume version of her superhero suit, Cat Noir asks, "That's our last hope?", but in the Korean version, he quips, "You want me to wear that?"
This is one of Carrie Keranen's favorite episodes, along with "Lady Wifi".
The second time Cat Noir uses Cataclysm in this episode is unknown as he is on his last toe pad at the episode's end so this is the first time where Cat Noir uses his powers on an obscured object. As well as him using Cataclysm twice this season following "Copycat" and "Simon Says".
After Alya tells Ladybug where the akuma is after Ladybug rescues her, she turns her head to the camera and says "I pay attention!", breaking the fourth wall.
On the background of the Egyptian gallery, the sign says "Pharaons". There's nothing wrong since this is how the French spells it. The English translation is simply "Pharaohs". Anyway, it's natural to show that they're in France and not in a place involving English.
It's unknown how Tikki knew about knowledge of one of her former owners being in the museum varying in three different ways:

title: The Pharaoh
text:
The Pharaoh - Trivia
Tikki must have studied and/or read Marinette's textbook before she lost it prior to this episode.
They were in the museum before this episode and Tikki saw the scroll there.
Due to Tikki being drawn in the scroll that means she was there when it was created 5000 years ago in Egypt and she remembered it.
This is the first time where a current Miraculous holder has to deal with a specific problem from a previous holder.
References
The Tutankhamun exhibition that appears in this episode was previously advertised by some banners in "Copycat".
This is the first time where Cat Noir uses his powers to destroy a previous object: the Louvre Museum bars seen in "Copycat".
Marinette can't read hieroglyphics at all, which is similar to "Kung Food" in which her Mandarin gets all jumbled up. In short, her knowledge of languages is moot at this point.
This is one of the six episodes of Season 1 in which Ladybug and Cat Noir don't do their signature "Pound it!", the other five being "Princess Fragrance", "Timebreaker", "Animan", "Stoneheart" and "Kung Food".
Allusions
Marinette's role in this episode is similar to Yugi Moto in of the "Yu-Gi-Oh" franchise:

title: The Pharaoh
text:
The Pharaoh - Trivia
As both had ancient predecessors that come from Egypt and were tasked with saving their world from a great evil.
Once that evil was defeated both worlds entered in an era of peace but the predecessors knew that someday it would return and their successors would be picked to help them finish what they started.
She and Yugi were both infused with the power of ancient magical items and had to protect the power of their items from those who wanted them for themselves.
The beings that gave them their power or in turn shared it couldn't fully interact with living world.
Errors
The school bag that Alya normally uses is light blue, but in this episode, she uses a yellow school bag that has the same design as Nino's.
Her school bag is also white for a single shot
When Alya moves to film Ladybug freeing Cat Noir from the sarcophagus, she takes her bag off. In the next scene, the strap is on her shoulder. It's missing again when Pharaoh picks her up.
When Cat Noir looks at his Miraculous after using Cataclysm, the ring is on his left hand.
When Alya was picked up by the mummies, she dropped her phone on the ground. Then she has it again.

title: The Pharaoh

When Ladybug dragged Cat Noir away from the mummies, his baton was long and in his hand. When she let him go, his baton was small and on his back.
The pendant's chain grows and shrinks in length throughout much of the episode.
The bus where Ladybug and Cat Noir lock most of the mummies has an advertisement with Mireille and Aurore on the side. This is for the KIDZ+ weather girl competition from the episode "Stormy Weather" and is not supposed to be there.
When Ladybug leaves Alya after defeating Pharaoh, Cat Noir‘s right hand is placed on top on his left hand, but it’s on his shoulder in the next shot.

Alya says that in a second she can figure out Cat Noir's age but there are still roughly 2-3 paws still left before he transforms back.
The papyrus' layout changes position when Pharaoh is describing the spell to Alya, showing everything to be opposite from its original position.

title: The Mime
text:
The Mime - Intro
"" is a season 1 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 19th written and produced episode of season 1. It is also the 19th written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: The Mime
text:
The Mime - Synopsis
When Mylène's father loses a part in a play to his scheming understudy, he akumatizes into the Mime, a villain whose pantomimes become real.
Disney+
Ladybug and Cat Noir face Mylène's father, now the Mime.

title: The Mime
text:
The Mime - Plot
The episode begins with Ladybug rushing home before the last dot on her earrings disappears, and she transforms back into Marinette. By the time she lands on her balcony, she detransforms. As Marinette and Tikki walk into her room, Tikki comments that what Ladybug did for Alya earlier was very cool. They pause when they hear Sabine's voice from downstairs, telling Marinette that Alya has arrived.
Back on Marinette's roof, Alya explains what happened earlier, showing the video of Ladybug saving a child and giving a brief interview for the Ladyblog over the other reporters. Alya is very happy that Ladybug knows about her blog. In the background, Marinette's pigeon imitates Alya's movements. She then leaves to get her laptop. When Tikki asks to see the video on Alya's phone, the phone slips out of Marinette's hand, Marinette presses buttons while trying to catch it and accidentally deletes the video. Marinette freaks out over how Alya is going to kill her when she finds out. Tikki tries to reassure her that Alya wouldn't kill her best friend, but that doesn't prevent Marinette from imagining what despicable things would happen if she tells Alya.

title: The Mime
text:
The Mime - Plot
Alya pops up to the roof, telling Marinette that she has visitors. They return to Marinette's room, finding Sabine, Mylène, and Fred Haprèle, Mylène's father. Mylène explains that her dad is getting his first major performance in The Mime's Extraordinary Adventures at the Eiffel Tower. The Haprèles came to pick up Fred's hat, which Marinette was fixing. She added a small pocket inside, per Fred's request. As a form of thanks, he mimes taking the hat out of a box, Marinette playing along. Fred puts a photo of his daughter in the pocket just as Sarah, his manager, calls and tells him that he needs to be on the bus for the show immediately. Fred then leaves the bakery.
Meanwhile, Chris and Sarah are about to board the bus for the show. Sarah tells Chris that he needs to be ready to take Fred's place in case something happens, unaware that Chris has a plan to sabotage Fred.

title: The Mime
text:
The Mime - Plot
At the bakery, Mylène is about to leave when Alya's phone rings. Marinette has Alya's phone in the purse, trying to find a way to fix her problem. After checking her phone and realizing it's her mother, Alya asks Mylène if she wants to watch the video she recorded earlier, but Marinette quickly reminds them about Fred's premiere. Alya suggests that she'll show Mylène the video on the way, so Marinette sneakily snatches her phone out of Alya's purse when they leave.
Meanwhile, Fred gets a call from Chris that there's a "last-minute location change". The bus actually picks them up in 10 minutes, in front of the Louvre, so he leaves.
In Marinette's room, Marinette decides to transform into Ladybug and film herself doing the exact same thing at the exact same place, planning to then return Alya's phone without the latter realizing it was even gone.

title: The Mime
text:
The Mime - Plot
While that happens, Chris tells Sarah that they have to get to the Eiffel Tower for dress rehearsal since Fred didn't show up. The play director explains that Chris will be taking Fred's place that night, much to the latter's pleasure. Fred arrives at the Museum and seems confused to where the bus is. He calls Sarah, and she angrily informs him that since he didn't show up, Chris will be the lead instead. Fred feels upset that he's been tricked and his daughter will be disappointed in him. Hawk Moth senses Fred's sadness as a tragedy and sends an akuma to hand him the role of a lifetime.
Back at the Louvre, Ladybug is trying to redo Alya's video, but a cat knocks the phone into the trash, much to Ladybug's disgust. Nearby, the akuma possesses Fred's photo of Mylène. Hawk Moth then offers Fred the chance to destroy the premiere performance and have his revenge on Chris, resulting in him being akumatized into the Mime. Mime first cuts the posters for the show with his invisible sword, before he mimics a golf club to knock off a police car. Ladybug notices this and tries to calm him down, but Mime fires invisible arrows towards her instead.

title: The Mime
text:
The Mime - Plot
A couple miles away, Adrien is in his car with Nathalie and Placide I.T.. Suddenly, the Gorilla sees Ladybug and hits the brakes. They knew that a supervillain is attacking them, so Adrien, Nathalie, and the Gorilla run off to hide. Adrien then turns into Cat Noir to help Ladybug.
Meanwhile, Mime still throws arrows at Ladybug. Then he takes out an invisible bazooka. Ladybug avoids it. Mime later mimics a whip and uses it to grab Ladybug. He's about to get her Miraculous, but Cat Noir arrives just in time to stop him. After he traps both Cat Noir and Ladybug in an invisible cage, Ladybug sees Mime mime a car and rides away. She realizes that if he started another pantomime, the previous one would evaporate. So both Ladybug and Cat Noir follow Mime and his invisible car.

title: The Mime
text:
The Mime - Plot
Once they land on top of the roof, Mime escapes and mimes an invisible motorcycle. As he drove away, Cat Noir uses his staff to carry himself and Ladybug to find the bus for the theater troupe. As soon as they landed on the roof of the bus, Ladybug uses her yo-yo to make a net so she can stop Mime. He dodges the net and jumps on the bus. While Cat Noir and Mime are sword/staff fighting, Ladybug tries to grab Mime's hat to get the akuma. However, he notices and attacks her, and Cat Noir knocks Mime off the bus. Ladybug grabs Mime's hand. But before Mime can grab her earrings, Cat Noir grabs Ladybug and pulls her up.
Mime attacks her, but he falls off the car. He mimics a chainsaw to saw the ceiling of the car and tells the driver to drive faster. Ladybug knew that she has to get the passengers to safety. So while Cat Noir covers for her, Ladybug warns everyone in the bus about the attack and that Mime seems to be after Chris. Outside, Mime throws an arrow at one of the bus' wheels, making it go out of control, but Cat Noir stops the bus just in time before it crashes. Chris feels guilty about what he has done and tells Sarah the truth about what he did to Fred.

title: The Mime
text:
The Mime - Plot
Outside, Cat Noir is about to lose the fight with Mime. He is about to take the ring from Cat Noir, but Ladybug ties his hand with her yo-yo. Mime then mimics a bomb and throws it at Ladybug and Cat Noir. So Ladybug uses Lucky Charm, and a shoe box appears. Using her lucky vision while Cat Noir and Mime continue to fight, Ladybug makes a projector out of the box, Sarah's glasses as a magnifying glass, a Mime poster, and a car's light. Mime sees the poster projection and gets angry. He mimics a sword and cuts the "poster" in half. But that's before he realizes that he had sliced the Eiffel Tower in half instead. He sees it's falling and mimics a shield to stop it. Ladybug knew that her plan has worked.
Once Cat Noir uses his staff to get Mime's hat, Ladybug grabs it and looks for the picture of Mylène. She tears the photo in half, revealing the akuma. Ladybug catches the akuma and purifies it. She then tosses the shoe box and cleanses the city, returning everything, including Fred, back to normal. Chris apologizes to Fred for tricking him earlier, and Fred forgives him.

title: The Mime
text:
The Mime - Plot
Ladybug transforms back into Marinette, runs back to the Louvre, and grabs Alya's phone out of the trashcan. She then goes to the Eiffel Tower for The Mime show. After taking a seat next to her friend, Adrien joins them, much to Marinette's delight.
Once the show is over, Marinette finally confesses to Alya about what happened to her phone and the video. She apologizes for deleting the video and tries to fix it for her, and she forgives her because it turns out that Alya had uploaded the video on the Ladyblog before she showed it to Marinette.
After the two best friends hug, Marinette said to her that there's a surprise inside the theater. When Alya goes inside, she meets Ladybug and starts interviewing and recording her for her blog.
After the interview, Marinette quickly transforms back to herself and stands outside. When asked if she would see the interview video, Alya playfully teases her to not accidentally delete it until she uploads it to the blog.

title: The Mime
text:
The Mime - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in Korea.
This episode was scheduled to premiere in English on March 6, 2016 on Nickelodeon USA, but it was cancelled and premiered two months later on Nicktoons.
In the Korean and English version, the pigeon's name is "Jack". It is different in almost every version.
In the Korean version, Fred's show is called, "Mime, the Fantastic Adventure".
Juleka and Rose make a cameo, appearing in the background of the fight under the Eiffel Tower.
Mime appeared previously in the "Ladybug PV".
In order to animate Mime's miming, the animators would animate him with the objects but make the objects invisible.
On the front and back of the tour bus, the license plate number is Zag-100-UG, a reference to Jeremy Zag and Univergroup (the original name for ZAG Entertainment).
Both the Univergroup logo and ZAG logo can be seen on The Mime's Extraordinary Adventures advertisement poster.
According to the poster of Fred's mime show, this episode seems to happen on April 16th.

title: The Mime
text:
The Mime - Trivia
If one looked carefully at the pigeon in the background (the one Marinette nicknamed Jacques later) while Alya was fawning over Ladybug knowing about the Ladyblog, it was shown mimicking Alya when she was singing "awesome".
References
Cat Noir does not use Cataclysm in this episode following "Darkblade".
This is the third time where the heroes appeal to reason with an akumatized villain following "Rogercop" and "Stormy Weather".
Allusions
Hawk Moth calls the position Fred was in a tragedy, which is a reference to one of the two main genres of plays (the other being comedy).
A tragedy similar to the episode is William Shakespeare's "Macbeth" as Chris was similar to Macbeth due to the fact he stole a role from someone.
In several releases for this episode, Fred's and Chris' miming is called "pantomiming." Pantomime is actually a form of British theatre that takes place around Christmas and involves throwing candy at audiences. Miming — while it can be comedic — is very different; miming does not involve using the voice or using props.
Errors

title: The Mime
text:
The Mime - Trivia
After detransforming at the beginning of the episode, Marinette can be briefly seen wearing her purse. However, the very next shot has the purse disappeared.
There are problems in Marinette's room with the reflection of the mannequin with a hat.
At the first shot, it doesn't have a rack in the mirror.
At the next shot, it disappears completely from the mirror.
When Chris is talking to Fred on the phone, the contact picture on Chris's phone is Chris himself instead of Fred.
After Alya and Mylène leave Marinette's house, they walk by the Agreste mansion, but there is no wall to be seen behind the house. Adrien's room is usually within the walled-in backyard.
This error is however not specific of this episode. Actually, the backyard isn't present in season 1 at all.
After transforming, a recycled shot from "Timebreaker" is seen which shows Ladybug erroneously holding the banner when she leaves the bakery.
Animations are missing completely for a second, while Ladybug talks about the weak spot of Mime.
When Cat Noir uses his staff to carry himself and Ladybug high into the sky to locate Mime, a second staff can clearly be seen on his back.

Also, when Ladybug's arm is around Cat Noir, her breasts seem to be missing.
After Ladybug and Cat Noir falls down from the invisible car, one of Ladybug's pigtails becomes transparent before she and Cat Noir stand back up.
Some background characters appear in multiple places at once during the battle under the Eiffel Tower.
There's a metal fence in between the two street lamps which Cat Noir uses to stop the bus with his staff, but in the shot where he uses it, the fence disappears.
When Hawk Moth contacts Fred, Fred's butterfly-shaped light mask is bigger than Hawk Moth's, but when he agrees to become Mime in the next scene, the light mask is smaller than Hawk Moth's.
During the deakumatization, Mime flashes briefly, before returning to normal.
