As for Cat Noir, still amazed with Ladybug, he found it impossible to choose someone else to the point where he feared disappointing her and in turn lead to her hating him which she proves otherwise. Seeing Glaciator return, they meet once again and noticing Cat Noir keeping to his promise, she praised him for his efforts. Afterwards, resuming the practice session, Cat Noir heard Marinette speak from the heart, finding it beautiful and wished her luck in her endeavors. As for Adrien, he followed Marinette's advice and decided to keep his photographs of Ladybug, believing that if he showed his true self, she'll fall for him.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
In "Hack-San", Alya learns what it's like to be Ladybug for the weekend when Marinette gives her the Ladybug Miraculous while she was in London. Under the alias Scarabella, she had a hard time adjusting, starting with Cat Noir believing she was an akumatized villain or a sentimonster that harmed his partner until she convinced him otherwise. Then, the duo realized that Markov was akumatized into Robostus again with a swarm of minions after them as Scarabella fell for obvious traps. While inside the Wax Museum, Cat Noir figured out that due to the trust between Scarabella and Ladybug, he believed they were friends but soon they were surrounded. Then, Alya realized that she was no Ladybug but was encouraged by Cat Noir to find her own way and she did, leading to Robostus' defeat. Reuniting with his Ladybug, she apologized for her actions but despite the hero's understanding, Cat Noir explained his greatest fear, since he doesn't know her identity, he was afraid he'd lose Ladybug forever until she assured him she'd always be by his side.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
In "Rocketear", with Alya's new status of working behind the scenes she adopted a new persona Rena Furtive. But because of her new role she had a hard time staying hidden especially from her boyfriend. Things became crazy when Nino doubts his relationship with Alya when he believed she was in "love" with Cat Noir leading him to tell Adrien; unknowingly telling Cat Noir his and Alya's identities as Carapace and Rena Rouge. Hurt Nino saw revenge against the hero as the titular villain until Rena and Ladybug showed him what really happened the night he found them. Remorseful Nino relinquished his powers and made up with Cat Noir. To avoid further misunderstandings, Alya told Nino that she was helping Ladybug; however, Adrien was shocked that Ladybug allowed Rena Rouge and Carapace to know their respective identities but not them.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
In "Wishmaker", Ladybug and Cat Noir were hit by Wishmaker, causing Shadow Moth and Viperion to know their secret identities. Due to Viperion's Second Chance, Shadow Moth's memories of them were erased. However, when returning the Snake Miraculous, Ladybug thanked Luka and made sure that he too didn't know her and Cat Noir's secret identities. He lied to her, saying that he didn't know since Wishmaker never hit the two heroes and decided to keep the new knowledge to himself.
In "Dearest Family", double trouble happens during Galette Day, when Tikki's monstrous appetite returns making it difficult for Marinette to control her.
Upon transforming, she fell under her kwami's influence, devouring every galette in sight.
Soon, things get worse when Marinette's whole family is reakumatized despite her giving them Magical Charms.
Needing Tikki, she finds that her kwami's hunger had gotten so ravenous that she used powers to create a giant galette in the sky but was thankfully destroyed by Astro Cat.
Before Tikki could make another, she admitted to Marinette that she was ashamed of her flaws and believed Marinette would fear her until she was told otherwise.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
Calming down, they met up with Cat Noir and knowing the situation, they went to Marinette's house upon finding that the group's akuma was inside the galette.
They realized that Shadow Moth had created a Megakuma to overpower Ladybug's magical charms.
Despite that, she gave her family a set of new ones, believing they could still be useful.
Meanwhile, Gabriel's desire for the miraculouses had grown darker where he wishes to use them to destroy this reality and create a new one where he and his beloved would never be separated again.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
In "Ephemeral", under Su-Han's watchful eye, he was furious that Ladybug called on so many allies to defeat one villain which was due to Cat Noir's absence. Consumed by fear, Su-Han believed the hero was like Shadow Moth until Ladybug told him otherwise. Refusing to let the powers of the Black Cat be on the loose with a stranger, the heroine was forced by the guardian to discover her partner's identity or else he'd be replaced. With Viperion's help, she planned to meet with Cat Noir at the Eiffel Tower. He apologized for his absence and after hearing his partner's reasoning of knowing their identities, he revealed to Ladybug that he is Adrien. At first, she laughed but upon discovering it was true she was so shocked that she abandoned the plan and relayed the information to Su-Han herself.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
Afterwards, Marinette found it difficult to accept that Adrien and Cat Noir are the same until she gained advice from Luka. Starting to see her partner in a new light, she finally had the courage to reveal herself to Adrien. They started dating but because they weren't careful, Adrien discovered the horrible truth about his parents once again. This time, he was akumatized by Shadow Moth and surrendered his ring, letting his father turn into Shadow Noir. With his son's help, Shadow Noir obtained the Ladybug Miraculous, unified them and gained the absolute power.
Fortunately, with one chance to fix everything through the power of her Lucky Charm, Ladybug summoned Luka to call for Sass and use Second Chance. Rewinding time back to the night that caused it all, Ladybug and Cat Noir noticed time anomalies happening everywhere. Aware that this was Sass' doing, the kwami explained his actions, being told he received a message from her Lucky Charm telling him to use his power. Once Paris' time was right, Marinette confronted Su-Han about his actions being consumed by fear and the guardian admitted she was right as well as her being different than any other guardian.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
"Kuro Neko" is parallel to "Hack-San", with Cat Noir leaving Ladybug, believing that she doesn't need him anymore. After claiming his ring, Marinette gets earful from Plagg about how badly she has been treating her partner. With no choice, Marinette hastily tried to pick a new owner for Plagg to no avail. Seeing that their owners belonged together and needed to talk, Plagg, with the help of Tikki, playfully tricked Marinette into returning the ring to his owner. Reuniting with Adrien, the kwami saw that his owner was still depressed, refusing the ring if things didn't change. So under Plagg's guidance, he changed himself into the prestigious Cat Walker.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
However, despite returning to Ladybug in a "new mask" they weren't doing so well. Due to leaving things on a sour note with her ex-partner and trying not to repeat the same mistakes, the heroine acted hesitant and remorseful and hearing how Ladybug felt about his former alter-ego, Adrien understood his own feelings and actions. After many failed attempts to subdue the sentimonster, the duo came to the conclusion that they needed to separate, this time Cat Walker handles exclusion with maturity leading to the creature's defeat. Returning home, Plagg explained to Adrien that his plan worked better than ever giving his owner much needed clarity but is happy to be reunited. Returning to Ladybug in his original persona, Cat Noir apologized for his actions and is tenderly reminded that he is irreplaceable.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
In "Penalteam", after Chloé gets akumatized once again into Penalty, she creates a team of clones she calls Penalteam. When challenged to play, Ladybug summons everyone (expect Bunnyx and Rena Rouge/Furtive who are trapped inside a bubble leaving only the Rabbit Miraculous unused) including four new holders; Miss Hound, Minotaurox, Rooster Bold and Caprikid with the powers of Adoration (Fetch), Determination (Resistance), Pretension (Sublimation), and Passion (Genesis). Despite the team putting up a good fight, their numbers dwindle. Regrouping, Ladybug realizes that she isn't doing well as team captain. So, she learns that being part of a team means working together to win and plans a new strategy to defeat Penalty by involving everyone. The Miraculous team manages to tie the game but with Penalty constantly changing the rules and capturing Cat Noir after using Cataclysm, the team had to act fast. They use Penalty's desire for cheating against her to end the game, with Chloé releasing the Megakuma herself and returning to normal.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
In "Risk", feeling that he is out of time, Gabriel concocted a devastating plan believing that Ladybug's caution is the reason for Team Miraculous' constant victories.
He turned them into the opposite, having everyone become reckless through Risk.
Aware of the many things that could go wrong, Gabriel wanted to send Adrien away under the disguise of a several month trip to promote his company along with Lila.
Unknowingly, he set the duo off just like him to be consumed by their own desires (his son's desire for freedom and Marinette's love for Adrien.) As for their alter egos, despite them still working together, Cat Noir was still angry that Ladybug didn't trust him enough out of fear to help with her guardian duties but was still happy that he was her favorite.
And yet, the one risk Ladybug, Adrien nor Shadow Moth didn't count on was Félix's arrival in Paris and when Adrien agreed to switch places with him it put the nail in the coffin.
Félix used the opportunity to discover what his uncle was hiding.
Going inside his safe, he discovered what he believed to be true; that his uncle is Shadow Moth.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
He took the pair of fake jewels for himself and finds out that his aunt's portrait has one more secret.
Activating the hidden the passageway, he shockingly discovers that his aunt is still alive.
With Adrien out of the way, Shadow Moth creates his deadliest sentimonster ever, Strikeback, and lets it loose in the city.
In "Strikeback", during the scuffle against Strikeback, problems keep arising when Cat Noir lashes out at Ladybug for not trusting him with anything. She angrily admitted that she was trying to protect him from being akumatized which he retorted back that it would never happen. More-so, from Rena, the team learned that Risk had marked them and that's what's been causing everyone to act risky. Needing to find someone who wasn't under Risk's power, Ladybug pulls off a triple fusion into Pennybug. Still obsessing over Adrien, she goes to "him" and entrusts "him" with the Dog Miraculous, turning into Flairaimable. Going back in time, they found Risk's akumatized object and return to the present to find the city in a wreck by Strikeback. Seeing no choice left, the team banishes the sentimonster to sun.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
However, it ends in the heroes defeat when Ladybug returns asking for the Dog Miraculous from Adrien but he points out that she didn't give the jewel to him and her yo-yo disappears. The French Duo learned the hard way what happens when they give into one's desires selfishly, desperately or recklessly by accidentally giving the jewel to Félix. He had used its power to steal Ladybug's yo-yo, and worst of all, traded all the Miraculous in the Chinese Miracle Box to his uncle, rendering the whole team inactive except for Ladybug and Cat Noir. Finally having a victory, Shadow Moth decided to make his announcement public to all of Paris and Ladybug looks on as well feeling broken and defeated until Cat Noir appears. Shocked to find him, she battered herself about her behavior towards him, for not trusting and lying to him, believing she didn't deserve a partner like him. Instead of abandoning her, he assures her that as long as they are still free, they'll get the Miraculouses back, one by one if necessary. And looking below, seeing that the duo still has the people's support and with Cat Noir by her side, Ladybug rises up once more knowing the war has just begun.
|-|Season 5=

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
In "Evolution", the kwamis finally discover who Shadow Moth is and his actions despite that Gabriel merges the Miraculouses, turning into Monarch.
Upon running into later versions of themselves and Monarch, future Bunnyx arrives and Ladybug and Cat Noir easily discover that he couldn't wait to use the other Miraculous.
First, was the Rabbit Miraculous, the most powerful and dangerous Miraculous as their arch-enemy wanted to use it to steal the duo's jewels in the Past which could change events in the Present.
They follow Monarch and stopped him from changing the events in "Lady Wifi", but Monarch immobilized Future Bunnyx.
To follow him through time and not wanting to make the same mistake Ladybug allows Cat Noir use Future Bunnyx's Miraculous becoming Rabbit Noir.
Through multiple time jumps through “Ripsote”, “Catalyst” and “Animan” the Heroes along with Monarch ending up in 1940's France in “Backwarder”, the duo saw Monarch suffer the consequences when he unified 7 miraculouses at once but knowing they can't track him forever calling upon her Lucky Charm and seeing Master Fu they knew the help of another holder was needed.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
Since preying on younger heroes didn't work Gabriel decided to rewrite the past by giving information on how to fix the Peacock Miraculous to his past self to prevent his wife from falling into an endless sleep in the present.
Later Ladybug and Rabbit Noir reunite with their former master asking for the past Dog Miraculous.
Knowing that the time is now, they return to the present to get Alix, but receiving a jewel she didn't expect; Ladybug explained that they needed her help in recovering the Rabbit Miraculous from Monarch and was more surprised that her father knew of her destiny.
Then upon entering the Burrow as Canigirl, she then tagged the Present Rabbit Miraculous with the ball.
And playing on Monarch's weakness they managed to retrieve both Rabbit Miraculous.
To ensure the Rabbit miraculous' safety, Ladybug allows Alix to keep it, Allowing her to become Bunnyx, but have remain in burrow until Monarch is defeated.
Present Bunnyx returns the past Dog Miraculous to Master Fu in 1940s to make sure that the past isn't changed in the present.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
Meanwhile, Monarch is stuck in the past of "Heroes' Day", but makes a plan that he'll defeat Ladybug and Cat Noir by reliving the events in the past, ultimately changing the future, but Adult Bunnyx arrives and takes him back to the present, Ladybug and Cat Noir were about to recover the other Miraculouses but Monarch escapes using wind dragon leaving her distraught but was comforted by Cat Noir to take solace in the victory they have today of recovering the Rabbit Miraculous.
Unknown to them, thanks their trick the heroes caused Mayura to finally split her ties with Gabriel because he chose his own desires over everyone else long enough.
In "Multiplication", Ladybug told Cat Noir that Flairmidable isn't Adrien, but rather his cousin: Félix, when she gave him the Dog Miraculous which lead him of stealing the Chinese Zodiac Miraculous to Monarch.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
They decided to head to London to hunt him down, but Su-Han came to scold Ladybug and Cat Noir for the Chinese Zodiac Miraculouses being in Monarch's hands, the Kwamis capture, and Fluff's power of Time Travel which could lead to unnatural consequences, but was informed that Fluff and the Rabbit miraculous were already recovered from Monarch by the heroes back in their previous adventure and given to an exceptional holder, before Su-Han could scold them anymore, Ladybug and Cat Noir scolded him back about the progress they made and finding a clue that will lead them straight to Monarch.
Much more about him doing nothing to help them since he arrived.
Su-Han bowed in shame as he sorrowfully admitted they were right, and that he failed to watch and protect them properly due to distractions of the modern world.
But he was forgiven, and following Ladybug and Cat Noir's advice to help set things right, Su-Han left to go back to the Guardian's temple to bring back reinforcements to help the duo stop Monarch, recover the Chinese Zodiac Miraculouses and rescue the Kwamis.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
Ladybug and Cat Noir heads to London to confront Félix at home, but Amélie told them he wasn't home, unbeknownst to them, she actually lied to keep Félix safe.
Back in Paris, the heroes laminated about their actions with Ladybug putting a stop to her love obsession permanently and Cat Noir realizing he should fight for what he desires himself instead of relying on others to do it for him. They waited for Monarch to appear so they can reclaim the Chinese Zodiac Miraculouses but no had intel. A few days later, they're waiting came to an end when Ikari Gozen appeared, despite their best efforts to fight her she was too quick more so Ladybug and Cat Noir were shocked that Ikari Gozen used the power of Multitude to clone herself making Ladybug believe that Monarch must have given her the Mouse Miraculous. Despite deakumatizing Tomoe, they became shocked that Monarch somehow gave her Multitude without giving her the actual Miraculous. Leaving Ladybug and Cat Noir ashamed that they couldn't recovered Mullo and the Mouse Miraculous, but she gave Tomoe a magical charm before leaving.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
Unbeknownst to them, Tomoe became an ally of Monarch and her akumatization was set up as they developed technological rings called Alliance that would allow Monarch to transfer and give the Miraculous superpowers to his akumatized villains without giving them the actual Miraculouses. After the success of the experiment, Tomoe and Gabriel make the rings go public.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
Then, "Destruction", gives a flip side to "Multiplication", before Gabriel melted the Chinese Zodiac Miraculouses and reforged them into rings this as well as "Evolution" shows how little he knows about the kwamis or understands their powers. Worst of all, he forced them to reveal the their guardian's location, arriving at Marinette's house where the kwamis explain that she devised her location into a treasure hunt. Following the clues Monarch ends up at the Wax Museum only to discover that Ladybug planned it in advance to trap him, despite the heroes small reunion with the kwamis. Monarch didn't get away scot free either, as he forced Cat Noir to do the one thing he never would: use Cataclysm on someone, with their enemy being their first victim and with no way to cure him, the damage was permanent. After Marinette explained everything to Alya, she was praised by her best friend for coming up with the greatest plan ever and showing self control as well as holding onto hope that the kwamis will be freed.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
The heroes begin to discover the dark side of jewels, as they fight to save the kwamis first learning that the powers of the Pig can be just as cruel as the Butterfly and Peacock Miraculouses in "Jubilation". As the Dark Owl returns with the power of Gift, the heroes discover their greatest desires, only to have them be ripped away and something even more disturbing that Monarch was using the alliance rings to hunt them down.
Even though the rest of the inactive members lost their powers, they still want to help their leaders in "Illusion", Nino saw to set up the Resistance, but unknown to him like Alya in "Optigami" and in "The Collector", still proves as heroes they have a lot to learn, as Nino's impulviseness made him unintentionally take on Monarch too soon. As the heroes were fooled once again into believing that Gabriel wasn't the mastermind and the real purpose of the alliance rings are unknown to them, they let their own enemy into their midst.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
Emotions run high and all over the place for many in various episodes, starting with "Determination". First, Adrien begins to develop feelings for Marinette but for her, in the terms of love, she really is confused distinguishing what is real and what is fake, so they return to the Wax Museum with Luka and Kagami as moral support, and soon they were left alone to sort things out. With Marinette partially admitting to Adrien that when she is in love, everything falls apart. Things go from bad to worse when Chloé's grudge, jealously and denial of the past caused Veronique's akumatization into Manipula, as their hero alter egos, Ladybug and Cat Noir are still traumatized by past events. With the loss of the inactive teammates, the heroine saw her partner in a new light regardless. After Veronique is deakumatized, the duo reaffirms the return of the other heroes. Meanwhile, they become aware that they are falling into a reversed love square.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
In "Passion", it's not only the heroes love square that was reversed after Gabriel's failure in "Evolution"; Nathalie's relationship becomes strained only being with him to protect Adrien. Knowing that her condition was reminding him of his mother, Adrien was upset that there was nothing he could do for her. Then, he sought out advice from Marinette, being reminded that even in some situations if you can't do something for someone physically, being there emotionally is good enough. Desperate to obtain the Miraculous so Adrien wouldn't be alone, Nathalie was akumatized into the powerful hunter Safari, and when Ladybug becomes distracted she's the villainess' first target. After losing the magic bolts, the duo realizes they are only after Ladybug and Cat Noir, but not their civilian selves, leading to the return of Mister Bug and Lady Noire. With having both Miraculouses after unfreezing his partner, Cat Noir asks Ladybug about using their combined power to free their world from miseries, only to hear her recite the words of their former master about the powers consequences.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
After Safari's deakumatization and the jewels were returned, Marinette realized that she was more comfortable around Cat Noir, but Alya begins to suspect that she is using her feelings of love towards him to hide from Adrien, and remembering what Marinette said earlier, Adrien talks to Nathalie about always being there for her and tells her about the girl he loves.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
Wondering if a love relationship between the Ladybug and Cat Miraculous holders is possible in "Reunion", Marinette learns the true power of the kwagatama: allowing current holders to talk to their predecessors. So she summons Jeanne d'Arc known as Scarlet Fate but they had a rough start, as the spirit refused to answer her question. It wasn't only Ladybug that had questions or a desire for their love ones, as Jalil desperately missed his sister and through the lies of social media and Monarch, he was akumatized into Pharoah again, but this time armed with the Goddess of Truth's power to unveil Ladybug's true motive. Then the fight turned into a battle of brains throughout the Lourve Museum. Upon reaching Pharoah in the main chamber, realizing they couldn't reach his book and knowing all he wanted was answers, Ladybug convinced him to seek them. When Jalil discovered that he'd been lied too, he broke his connection with Monarch, receiving the duo's praise in thinking for himself.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
Receiving praise from Jeanne, Marinette was finally told of her predecessor's love story of how she met her Black Cat Dark Grimalkin on opposite sides of the Hundreds Years War. They constantly fought until the holders discovered that they were deceived by their kings' greed for power. Refusing to take anymore lives, Jeanne and Grimalkin laid down their weapons, wishing to live peacefully together, but were branded as traitors in their kings' eyes. Despite escaping their fates, realizing that there was only one way they could be together was by surrendering their powers, and then they disappeared but the answer was bittersweet, as the reunion allows current holders to talk their predecessors with only their memories as holders, leaving Marinette to wonder if she and her Cat Noir will have to do the same as them. Just Ladybug like with Tikki, Cat Noir is gifted his own Kwagatama by Plagg and Alix by Fluff.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
In "Elation", soon both Marinette and Cat Noir are lovesick for each other but the moment is ruined for them when they head to André's ice cream only for the hero to learn of Marinette's crush on his alterego. However it made the moment akward between them with both admitting that their love pursuits brought the worse in them but when Marinette mentioned that Cat Noir still had his fans he believed they wouldn't stick around if they knew who he really was. But Marinette said she would and they share a kiss however realizing that their relationship is wrong Cat Noir decide to end it which left the girl very distraught at her constant failures in love. Which don't go unnoticed by Shadow Moth when he attempted to akumatize to her and worse she nearly gives in until Cat Noir makes her anger vanish with a kiss making it more akward but the experience finally made her realize a relatioship with a hero wouldn't work.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
Determined to see Ladybug and Cat Noir together, André is akumatized into Glaciator for the fifth time but added with the power of Clout causing major damage in his path. Then during said rampage, Glaciator convinced that their miraculouses are in the way if they surrender them they could be together and yet when they ask each other about their feelings the heroes both agree that it's complicated but remain friends. Once André is deakumatized and Marinette is returned home, she and Cat Noir apologize to each other for the misunderstanding Marinette wonders if she'll ever solve the mysteries of love while Adrien discovered that her feelings towards him dimished he remained hopeful he would gain it back however Cat Noir and Marinette's love bout still didn't go unnoticed by Monarch as he hopes to find a way to make use of it in the end.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
In "Transmission", believing that she was a failure in everything especially love a very despressed Marinette was held up in her room. And yet, with Adrien's feelings being true and real for her, he goes to confess his love but she rejects him leaving him depressed as well; not going unnoticed by their kwamis, Tikki and Plagg did the most daring thing ever with caring yet heavy hearts they set Marinette and Adrien free so they could be together. With Monarch still on the loose the kwamis of Creation and Destruction set out to find to new owners leading to the return of Scarabella and a new heroine Kitty Noire. With Ladybug and Cat Noir free, renewed with hope and not to waste the chance their friends gave them, Adrien returns to Marinette's home and this time they accept each other feelings starting their path to becoming a couple. However through the alliances rings Monarch finds the identities of the kwamis new charges and begins the hunt.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
In "Deflagration", Plagg had chosen Zoé to become his new charge being the second female to wield the Cat Miraculous however he was quick to discover that she and Chloé are sisters and how similar she is to Adrien advising her to be more confident.
Believing that he has the advantage, Monarch begins to prey on Scarabella and Kitty Noire meanwhile Adrien and Marinette begin to work on their relationship gaining everyone's support except for Chloé.
Making his move, Monarch sets his trap and easily obtains the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses but his overconfidence cost him dearly as he didn't expect the kwamis to use their powers in self-defense.
First, Tikki summoned a lucky charm to call for their owners and then Plagg's daring sacrifice using his cataclysm to destroy his Miraculous returning to his former form.
Once again repeating what happened before in their self-defense the kwamis powers caused a continous wave of creation and destruction, knowing that Tikki and Plagg were danger, Ladybug in disguise mounts a daring rescue at first convincing Monarch Bug to return her earrings so the damage can be fixed but aware he wouldn't agree she tricked him with a fake lucky charm.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
During their scuffle she was backed into a corner and yet was saved by the Resistance together with their help she managed not only to retrieve her Miraculous, but Cat Noir's and discover that Monarch reforged the Chinese Zodiac Miraculoues into rings.
With the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses out of Monarch's hands the kwamis were baffled how their enemy found them so easily unaware that they had the same answer back in "Jubilation. Regardless Tikki and Plagg decide to look for new charges but were halted by Marinette who had come to a realization for the duo resume their mantles. But before that Plagg wished to say goodbye to a remorseful Zoé who believed she was a failure until the kwami told her otherwise reminding her to be brave and call her own shots in life. Redonning their mantles, Ladybug and Cat Noir found out what pair had truly worked and was willing to put their love relationship under wraps until Monarch is defeated while admiring the view they also thanked their kwamis and the Resistance for the bravery they showed in the hands of their enemy.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
The three-way triangle between Kagami, Marinette and Adrien becomes even crazier in "Perfection". While Adrien tries to find ways to express his love to Marinette, Kagami learns more about the trials of friendship, finding it strange that Marinette kept avoiding her so much that she followed Lila's advice on doing a friendship test with her. Disappointed with the results she falls into loneliness, believing she can't have any friends and drowned herself in searching for perfection in her akumatized form Ryukomiri. But through the heroes and their friends, Kagami's reminded that she isn't alone and surrounded by loved ones touched; she breaks free of Monarch's hold and was given a Magical Charm as a sign of her friendships. Afterwards, the two girls discover that they are bound by the same thing striving for perfection to be good enough for someone else.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
In "Migration", so many depend on Luka for his wise advice to their problems from family to friends and similar to his ally Bunnyx as the Snake Miraculous holder Viperion, he too as become the keeper of secrets. Matched by his sage advice is his love for music but trouble comes when the greedy Bob Roth wants to make money off of the young musician's talent so much that Luka and the others were tricked into signing his contract of a solo career that Luka was nearly akumatized again. But this time knowing of Ladybug and Cat Noir's identities and his strong desire to protect them he fought it off smashing his belovent guitar in the process but not before the mastermind became aware that the young snake has the knowledge he seeks. And the hunt for him wasn't over yet now the duo had to protect Luka from an akumatized Bob armed with the power of Voyage by using him as bait the heroes deakumatized Bob. However Ladybug, Cat Noir and everyone discovered what Monarch had suspected was true Luka really did know the heroes identities because of that knowledge he decides to leave Paris with Jagged to further protect them.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
Luka's sage advice for Marinette and Adrien from before comes to fruition when they have their first official date in "Derision".
Going to the pool, but seeing her having panic attacks, Adrien learned what Marinette's life was like before he came to her school from Kim. Meanwhile, Marinette becomes Monarch's target; by re-examing her past, it's revealed that she was constantly bullied by Chloé and suffered from her pranks needing Socqueline to watch over her. And that Adrien wasn't her first crush back then she had one on Kim, but thanks to not keeping her guard up towards him, she suffered her first heartbreak leading to her journey of cautioness. By fully understanding her past, her actions now and making peace with it, she rejected the megakuma, but for Adrien after Kim finished the story, he was very angry at him and Chloé as they were the ones responsible for Marinette's trauma, Kim gets akumatized into Dark Humor, an upgraded version of Dark Cupid, but with the power of Uproar.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
During the battle against him, Ladybug found it strange about Cat Noir's aggression (unaware that he was avenging her alterego) even nearly attempting to Cataclysm him, but was stopped by the heroine, but by fighting a mean prank with one of her own, Kim was deakumatized.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
Back at the pool, Kim expresses remorse for the actions he committed as Dark Humor, and yet, Ondine replies he still does bad actions as himself. Despite trying to defend himself, pleading ignorance, she retorts that just because he didn’t know, doesn’t mean the pain he caused Marinette was any less real. Kim realizes Ondine is right and vows to change. He apologizes to Marinette for his actions, to which she accepts. Ondine rejoices at her love’s growth. Outside the pool, Marinette shared with Adrien why she gets so nervous around him: she’s afraid of getting hurt again like she was by Chloé’s manipulation of Kim. Adrien shares with her that he’s scared too: of doing something wrong, hurting her, someone else hurting her, and scared of losing her. But he believes that together, they will help each other, no matter what. He reaches his hand out for Marinette to grab, she holds it, but lets go and apologies, as she’s not ready for that yet. Adrien tells her they have time and they go their separate ways for now.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
Later that day, Adrien goes to Chloé’s place to confront her for her heinous deeds and demands that she apologize to Marinette for everything, being sure she'll earn forgiveness. But Chloé couldn't care less about the harm she caused by doing what she did and goes on about how she views people like Marinette as doormats who exist to suffer for her amusement. Sabrina reluctantly continues to paint her nails, despite being equally disgusted by her "best friend's" remarks. Adrien is disgusted and angered by what she did to Marinette and Socqueline, as well as her egoistical selfishness, despite the multiple chances everyone including him gave her to become a better person. Finally realizing that people like Chloé will never change their ways, Adrien ends their friendship for good. As he leaves, she hypocritically calls him a traitor behind his back.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
In "Intuition", Monarch found out the hard way that even with the Miraculouses he stole the French Duo remained undefeated. Especially when it came to the power of Snake Miraculous and Second Chance by using it selfishly it caused Gabriel more harm than good by having him relive constant failure and his Catacylsm injury to spread shortening what time he had left. Alone on a rooftop, Ladybug and Cat Noir pondered that it was strange that Monarch didn't use the power but happy that he didn't forgetting that the effects of Second Chance erases everyone's memories except user's but even with their memories gone their adaptability and unpredictably guided them through.
Then in "Protection", due to Kagami's background and her mother's restrictions, she becomes conflicted as Marinette and Adrien come closer; still having feelings for him but still wanting to keep Marinette's friendship.
However, due to her unable to express herself properly leading to her instability, being taken advantage of by Lila convincing Kagami that Marinette is a manipulator, which led to her akumatization into Riposte Prime wanting vengeance against her "former" friend.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
She tells Adrien that Marinette is a liar and tries to hunt Marinette down, trapping her in a Shell-ter, Cat Noir tries to convince Riposte Prime but fails but he free Marinette allowing her to transform into Ladybug and come up with a plan.
After succeeding, Kagami is deakumatized, and apologized for her actions and behavior towards Marinette.
Upon explaining that Lila told her about Marinette's "true colors", she and Adrien explained to Kagami that she was deceived by Lila and hearing Adrien describe Marinette on the first day they met and his true feelings towards her.
Kagami broke down in tears, knowing that they were both right, and experienced another trial that showing her true feelings and trying to understand them isn't a sign of weakness but strength, leading to her finally expressing the sorrow she felt being embraced by friends despite being happy for them.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
Afterwards, Marinette and Adrien return to the Agreste mansion and they reflect over what happened leaving them both upset, but Gabriel was contended to know that their relationship was falling apart and so was Lila. Kagami goes to confront Lila, speaking her mind about even though she didn't get why Lila said those things about Marinette but doesn't believe it, and yet wants them both to be her friends under the conditions that their friendship is genuine, and she isn't used against Marinette, to which Lila begrudgingly complies too.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
In "Adoration", Chloé orders Sabrina to steal for her and Lila comes up with a plan to expel Marinette from school, but due to Sabrina refusing to take part in this as it goes against everything she stands for regarding her father's work, Chloé demoted her to her subordinate instead of a friend, leaving her very sad and vulnerable for another akumatization, into Vanisher again wanting to serve and help Chloé and Lila with their plans so as not to lose Chloé's friendship. Shortly after her deakumatization, she is scolded by Chloé, but later realizes thanks to her Magical Charm that Ladybug had given her that she could choose the right side between good and evil. Furthermore, after Zoé confesses her feelings to Marinette it inspires her to follow her own advice and also to finally say them to Adrien for the first time. Much more so Sabrina began to see that Marinette was right about Lila.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
During "Emotion", despite Marinette and Adrien's happiness at finally becoming a couple, they still have trouble, as Gabriel continued to drive a wedge between them, as he didn't approve of Marinette being so close to his son. Things go from bad to worse when it was time for Gabriel's Diamond Dance celebration for the richest people in Paris, Marinette crashes the event, but to only admit that she was proud of "Adrien" and that he didn't have to be secretive with her, and intended to leave. But "Adrien" danced with her instead, and saw how much she didn't fit in, however she wasn't the only one to crash the party, Félix did so too and to Ladybug, Adrien and Kagami's horror, he was acting no different than those before him, being called Argos. Wanting the Peacock as well as the duo's Miraculouses to wish for a world that was free from oppressors, however Ladybug didn't approve of his methods. As the fight continued the heroine gained a better understanding of him, then received no Lucky Charm and hearing the rogue holder claim victory, she also understood why realizing what he needs, she calmly admitted defeat and he made her disappear.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
Walking through Paris' streets empty, coming across Kagami and bringing back Adrien, Argos sadly discovered that like the heroine they didn't approve of his actions either. With their views of freedom being totally different, as Adrien and Kagami couldn't be free not without their loved ones, and wanting to prove he wasn't completely cruel, Argos brought them to where he hid Marinette, only to find her gone. Then, he found out the hard way why Miraculouses can't just be given to anybody, as he tried to bring her back but couldn't. In fear, he believed she was gone forever, as well as feeling what everyone in Paris endured since his family used the jewels, Félix was scolded harshly by his cousin and Kagami about his lack of control, and demanded that he brings everyone to which Félix does. Afterwards, he flees the scene in shame of his actions and griefully destroys his sentimonster. After the whole escapade, understanding the situation now Felix began to do what his family should've done long ago.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
In "Pretension", knowing that Gabriel didn't approve of Marinette and Adrien's relationship, she opted to talk with him but despite not being well received she still refused to abdonded Adrien. When Félix returns to Paris, he took Kagami away from her mother only to tell Kagami that he is reformed as well as wanted to talk to and had an interest in her. While protecting her from an akumatized Tomoe and the heroes, he vowed to never use his powers again and if he had to, only create sentimonsters with pure intentions and good reasons. After he and Kagami were found by the French Duo, she explained Felix's intentions to them, but soon they were cornered by the titular villain and aware that Duusu was the only other kwami besides the duo's and Fluff were freed they let Felix escape with his miraculous and by the villainess' defeat Ladybug and Cat Noir hoped they didn't make a mistake in trusting him.
But to Adrien's shock he heard that his father was sending him to London by the school year's end and didn't have the heart to tell Marinette but hoped he could figure out something before then meanwhile Kagami and Felix begin their relationship.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
In "Revelation", Marinette, Adrien and Lila collide again, when her and Chloe vie for Marinette's position as class president and from Lila's trickery he learns the difference between those who do mean harm and who don't when it leads to Lila's akumatization and revenge against his girlfriend. After defeating Hoaxer, Adrien apologized to Marinette for giving her terrible advice but she replied his kind heart what she loved about him and nonetheless promised they would expose her with the first step being letting Lila and Chloe take her position as class president. Unknown everyone even Gabriel that Lila also stole his secrets and began to plot her revenge against him.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
In "Confrontation", Sabrina finally had enough of Lila and Chloé's cruelty. Lila and Chloé are eventually exposed for their vile actions thanks to Marinette and Sabrina. However, Denis Damoclès was unable to expel them due to the former using André against him, almost leading to his akumatization. But, the Resistance and Cat Noir all work together to motivate him not to give up, which leads to his Magical Charm to evolve into a shield and purify the megakuma. Cat Noir explains what happened with the megakuma to Ladybug. Miss Bustier confronts Chloé about what she done, afterwards, Chloé gets a call from Lila (who reveals her true identity as Cerise) to be ready for next time.
In "Collusion", however those that rise or in power continue to tighten their grip as Chloé continues being a negative influence in school, getting Miss Bustier fired and nearly akumatizated by Monarch but she calms down before it's finished.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
Meanwhile, he and Tomoe Tsurugi have a meeting with the mayor about the new security, unknowingly that it was a part of their plan to capture Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses, leaving Andre hesitant until Chloé comes in to criticize him as well as declaring that she would do a better job as mayor.
Glumly, Andre lamented finally realizing that a life of power isn't what he wanted and even tried to convince Gabriel to give it up and seek their old lives but unknowingly Andre's actions about the past was recorded, doctrinated and posted by Gabriel for everyone to see.
Finally leading to Caline Bustier's akumatization as Miss Sans-Culotte, while fighting Ladybug receives a crown making the heroes realize it was time for Andre's term as mayor to end and made their way to City Hall.
Yet, Andre upon seeing the video, he reunonces his friendship with Gabriel, then along with Zoé, the hero duo convince Miss Sans-Culotte to use reason instead of force.
As they guard her, she confronts Andre telling him to step down as Mayor of Paris in the name of the people, to which he agrees, reinstates Miss Bustier's position, and fires himself, thus allowing her to break free of her akumatization.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
However due to not reading her object correctly Ladybug realized it was also for Chloé.
Barging in taking her father's position and nearly capturing them despite their escape Chloé, alongside Cerise, declares that miraculous holders are outlawed.
In "Revolution", Ladybug and Cat Noir fall into a trap set up by Chloé, akumatized into Queen Mayor, by being imprisoned in Shell-ter barriers mixed with Resistance.
Doomed of transforming back and having their secret identities exposed, they manage to slow down their transform and encourage the Parisians and the Resistance to keep on fighting and standing up to Monarch's threats.
This motivates everyone to revolt against Queen Mayor and her robots, and allows for Ladybug and Cat Noir to unlock their adult powers, now being able to use their powers indefinitely without transforming back.
With Chloé deakumatized and having lost all power, she is exiled to London with her mother.
However, Gabriel commands Adrien to pack up for London leaving Adrien depressed, he tries to tell his father that he´s happy in Paris with Marinette and his friends.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
But his father didn´t listen so he angrily tries to run away but fails, he soon calls Marinette about the truth leaving them both upset.
But Marinette goes to see Adrien one more time and they share a kiss goodbye.
Marinette drives to the party and gets a call from Chloé that Adrien is leaving Paris but Marinette told her that she already knows and she could never break their love.
Marinette also tells Chloé that she is now utterly ridiculous, and has lost all the power over the Parisians, especially her before she hangs up, leaving Chloé crying.
Meanwhile, Cerise hacked into the Tsurugi laptop to layout her plan.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
In "Representation", the group worries about Marinette not being okay after being forcibly separated from Adrien and wonders why he never told them about his departure to London; meanwhile determined to protect his relationship with Marinette, Adrien sought to do the one he could: tell her his identity. So as Cat Noir, he flew back home just to find out he just missed her, unknown to him that his cousin already beat him there. Felix who witnessed and was told everything especially (Marinette's idenity as Ladybug through Kagami), knowing what he needed do disguised as Adrien, he led Marinette away to the school where they tell her the history of the Graham de Vanily, Agreste, and Fathom families, Monarch's true identity, and why he had to betray her so that everyone can have a happy ending.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
Meanwhile, as Adrien fought Gabriel, as Nightormentor, he was hit with magic dust and mentally experienced his worst nightmare, unknown to him, it was the same as his partner from "Cat Blanc", him akumatized and in a destroyed world with Ladybug perishing in his arms devastated he nearly surrendered his ring to prevent his nightmare from coming too past. But thanks to the Resistance, Cat Noir was given the hope to finish him, even capturing the Akuma for Ladybug. Meanwhile, so close, yet so far; with a door separating them, Adrien was still suffering from his nightmare and realizes he can't tell Marinette his identity, thus returns to London, missing her again as she is left with a note about what happened the previous night for her to perform her Miraculous Ladybug. Adrien and Kagami are locked up in white rooms by their parents to prevent another escape.

text:

In "The Illustrhater", now with Hawk Moth's defeat and with the team reformed each one possessing their respective Miraculous full-time, it is revealed that Ladybug had allowed all of them to patrol Paris and use their powers to perform rescues on their own. title: The Miraculers
text:

The team tries to convince Illustrhater to tell them more about the Butterfly Miraculous holder, but she is always convinced by the latter to not say anything. title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
In "Daddycop", after feeling herself unworthy of being part of Ladybug's team due to thinking she was a bad person after everything she had done in the past as Chloé's accomplice, Sabrina tried to renounce her miraculous and give it back to Ladybug. However, the latter was able to reassure her that she was a good person and motivated her to visualize the person she had become and showcase that change to everyone. This led Sabrina to upgrade her costume as Miss Hound.
In "Sleeping Syren", after Kim is tricked by Nelson to refuse a kiss from Ondine and unintentionally hurt her feelings, leading to her akumatization into the titular villain, Marinette considers taking the Monkey Miraculous from him, even refusing to call him to help, despite the fact his power would allow the team to defeat the Sleeping Syren much easier. However, after witnessing Kim putting himself in harms way to save Ondine and realizing he was taken advantage of, she reconsiders and allows him to keep his Miraculous and help them as King Monkey. At the end of the episode, Zoé attacks Ray and his friends while disguised as Fury.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
In "El Toro De Piedra", due to the problems he was having in his relationship with his father, especially cause of his fear of becoming like him that was worsened by his guilty over his akumatization, Ivan tried to renounce his Miraculous, but Ladybug managed to convince him otherwise, telling him that, by rejecting violence, he managed to separate himself from his father. Together with Cat Noir, they managed to defeat the titular villain. However, it hadn't been only Ivan that was having father issues. As for Adrien, despite him wanting to remember the good about his parents, Marinette found the last will of Gabriel, informing Nathalie about the letter. Upon reading it, both were shocked and horrified to discover that Gabriel wanted Adrien to take up his mantle, but knowing of the dangers it would pose to both Marinette's and Adrien's lives, Nathalie opted to destroy the letter. However, Marinette decided to keep it intact until the day Adrien was ready to handle the truth.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
And yet, what the Miraculers didn't know was that Gabriel and Nathalie had been hiding one more secret: as the Order of the Guardians hide from prying eyes, so does another as the two adults were/are apart of The Kingdom, who like him want Ladybug's and Cat Noir's jewels to create a "perfect world".
In "Mister Agreste", after Monarch's defeat and Chrysalis' rise, it wasn't Bunnyx only who continued to stay away so did Luka as he decided to return to Brazil for fear of being akumatized due to not only knowing his leader's identities but also his lingering love for Marinette of one day turning the joy of watching her and Adrien together into jealousy confessing this to her as Viperion before rewinding time and lied to her about having a girlfriend back in Brazil, even going as far as asking his friend Irupé to pretend to be so.
But back in Paris, the wounds were still fresh for the French duo: Ladybug feeling the pressure of her lie about Gabriel Agreste being Monarch, and Adrien: feeling down about unanswered questions about his dad they both got to vent in different ways.
For Marinette, as Cosmobug, she flew to Brazil seeking Luka's advice after revealing the truth as Viperbug.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
Despite being shocked by the revelation, he doesn't react negatively towards Marinette, but asks to borrow her Miraculous, believing he can fix everything due to knowing things she doesn't.
However, his reaction causes Viperbug to use Second Chance to rewind time, causing Luka to forget everything, then wished him luck with Irupé.
Back in Paris, during the fight against the titular villain, Cat Noir lose his Miraculous and detransform, but not before he called Ladybug as the but the heroine almost loses her earrings.
However, thanks to Adrien's intervention, he finally vented out all of the bad things his father did to him leading to Mister's Agreste's defeat, and the Cat Miraculous is returned to the hero while Ladybug commended Adrien for his bravery.
But despite being able to vent he still felt bugged by unaswered questions while Marinette saw there was no turning back now.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
Surprisingly it wasn't only the Miraculers who were embued with magic jewels, in seeing Ladybug coming to talk to Luka, Irupé (revealed to possess a magical jewel with her kwami-like partner, Maino'li) becomes suspicious of his relationship with Ladybug and considers the possibility of him having a Miraculous.
In "Revelator", it is revealed that, shortly after the holders received their Miraculous permanently, Ladybug and Cat Noir taught more of their allies how to unlock their adult superpowers, while also officially naming their team The Miraculers.
However, when it comes to reporting news, sometimes telling the truth can be as hurtful as telling a lie, especially when involving Alya during the fight against the titular villain.
As Rena Rouge, she discovers Ladybug's greatest secret: Monarch's real identity.
This causes a great deal of strain on her friendship with Ladybug, as not only was that secret preventing Adrien from growing as a person, but also forcing her (Rena Rouge) to keep that secret from him.
She didn't consider the horrible consequences of what would happen if Adrien or anyone found out.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - History
Because Rena Rouge discovered that the secret, despite it being caused by the supervillain, was not physical damage, it couldn't be undone by the Miraculous Ladybug, because it only fixed physical damage.
However, Cat Noir, thinking the secret Rena Rouge uncovered was Ladybug's identity, was able to unlock a new function of his Cataclysm, allowing him to turn it into a new power called Miraculous Cat Noir, a destructive version of Miraculous Ladybug that destroys anything "created" by the akumatized villain, like secrets revealed through their powers.
Through this, Rena Rouge forgot about it, but now knows deep down that her best friend is burdened by something.
Regardless, she is determined to help her.
From "Wreckless Driver", Marinette discovered despite having magic, superpowers nor all the influence in the world it takes more to solve the world's problems especially when involving people personally never forgetting that some problems can be fixed on a human scale.
In "Yaksi Gozen", afraid of having their rings destroyed or stolen, Kagami and Félix have been trying to find a way to safely hide them.

title: The Miraculers
text:

It is then then came up with the idea of having them stored in Ladybug's magic yo-yo, as it's a place where no one can reach unless they access it through the yo-yo, which only exists whenever Ladybug is transformed.
Before Ladybug can safely put the rings inside her yo-yo, they are interrupted by Adrien and Marinette's parents, causing the girl to drop the rings and hastely detransform.
During the confusion, Félix ends up with Kagami's ring, while Adrien gets Félix's, but Yaksi Gozen (Tomoe Tsurugi akumatized) appears to put in practice Chrysalis plan to take control over Félix and use him as a spy.

After the combined efforts of Ladybug, Cat Noir and Ryuko immobilizes Yaksi Gozen, Chrysalis drops the plan and manages to escape from the akumatized villain's body without anyone knowing and opted to at least keep the final part of the plan, where Tomoe forces her away out of the akumatization and (fakely) apologizes to Kagami to regain some of her trust.
After that, Félix and Kagami decide to keep their rings.

title: The Miraculers
text:

In "The Ruler", after the titular villain is defeated and he manages to fix his relationship with his mother, Nathaniel has a talk with Marc, where both express that power or not, they will always be there to protect each other. But when the latter expresses his worry about Nathaniel protecting him from a supervillain, due to him not being a superhero. This caused Nathaniel to reluctantly reveal his identity as Caprikid to Marc who, in turn, revealed he was Rooster Bold.
