title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - "[[Miraculous Shanghai]]"
Ladybug and Cat Noir's heroic world expands when Shanghai needs protecting from Hawk Moth too, as it holds a secret magical object that is about old as the Miraculouses themselves: the Prodigious. Due to unknown events, its power was deemed too dangerous and sealed away. Just like the Miraculouses that were protected by the Order of the Guardians, this jewel was protected by the Renren Guardians, those who were taught ancient human values. However, as time went on, most had forgotten them, leaving a man named Wu Shifu as the sole guardian until one day when he heard the cries of a baby girl. Happy to have an heir, Wu Shifu named her Fei and taught her of his legacy, making her the next guardian. However, their days weren't always full of happiness as a greedy man, named Cash, used dirty tactics to get them off the land which ended in the school's destruction, her adoptive father's disappearance, and most importantly, the Sacred Cave Key being stolen, leaving Fei alone.
As for the French duo, Spring Break is here, but Marinette, upon realizing that Adrien is in Shanghai, followed him while wanting to visit her granduncle, Wang Cheng, to celebrate his 60th birthday.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - "[[Miraculous Shanghai]]"
Upon visiting him, she learns more about her family and wishes to explore the city.
However, just as she started to, her things get stolen, and with a language barrier, she was lost and alone in the city.
Meanwhile, Adrien goes off to explore, reacquaints with Wang Cheng, and is surprised that Marinette is also in Shanghai.
Noticing that she was gone for too long, he transformed into Cat Noir to find her.
While wandering the streets, Marinette gets cornered by people she believed was going to hurt her trying to escape, she runs into Fei.
Relieved that someone can understand her, she explains to her "new friend" her situation and the importance of her things sympathizing, Fei helps her look for them.
At the time aware that the city was so big, Cat Noir contacts Ladybug to help in his efforts.
After that, the girls manage to find the earrings, but Cash wanted a lot of money in return.
However, Fei easily swaps them for fake ones which resulted in trouble, but they gained help in unexpected places.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - "[[Miraculous Shanghai]]"
Briefly losing Cash's goons, Marinette was brought to Fei's home where she explained her own hardships, but just before she could explain the real reason for her friend's "misfortune", Cash beat her to it telling her truth of her earrings getting stolen, leaving Marinette devastated because Fei was desperate for information about her father.
During their discussion, Fei discovered that Cash was the one responsible for what happened to her father and refused to let him touch her friend.
Unknown to them all, Hawk Moth was there aware of Cash's greed, he akumatized him.
Marinette, not completely sure of Fei's intentions but refusing to leave her at an akumatized villain's mercy, transforms into Ladybug.
Happy that Cat Noir was already in Shanghai, she explained the situation.
Helping Fei, Ladybug discovered that Hawk Moth attempted to steal the Prodigious.
Despite not knowing what it is, she couldn't let her enemy have it.
Refusing to let the heroine fight alone, Fei uses the jewel's power, becoming the new Renren guided by the Renlings.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - "[[Miraculous Shanghai]]"
During the fight, she was observed by the guardian, Mei Shi, matching almost all the values except the dragon because she was clouded by vengeful thoughts.
With Cat Noir's timely arrival, the trio deakumatizes Cash, but Hawk Moth refuses to admit defeat and turns his akuma to Mei Shi, changing the guardian into one of his most dangerous villains yet that even he couldn't stop.
Heartbroken and distraught by her actions, Fei believed she wasn't worthy of the Prodigious and left the French Duo.
With no choice, Cat Noir decided to use his powers on him, but it left the hero eradicated and Ladybug distraught.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - "[[Miraculous Shanghai]]"
Finding Fei below her, Marinette accepts her forgiveness, but Fei wasn't so sure she deserves it as she turned away from her father's teachings, aware he wouldn't do this but turn it into something good. With that in mind, she finally understands what Mei Shi meant. With that insight, Fei finally accessed the power of the dragon, using it to save Marinette, and by helping Ladybug dive into the belly of the beast, the duo managed to calm the guardian and save the city. With her anger gone, Mei Shi found Fei worthy of the Prodigious but one test remained: facing Cash. Again, she reprimanded him because of his uncontrollable greed, she has no family and was left homeless but chose to let justice take its course by taking cash to the police, reclaiming the Sacred Cave Key. The group was surprised to discover that Mei Shi had another purpose: watching over the Renren. With Marinette safe and sound, they all celebrate Wang Cheng's birthday. It turns out the group of boys weren't trying to hurt her but return her necklace, whom she graciously thanks and accepts Fei as a friend and ally.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - "[[Miraculous New York]]"
It's French-American Friendship Week, a week when students from both countries come together. The heroes come together too, causing them to learn from each other on both sides of the mask. Marinette is trying to give up her romantic pursuit of Adrien and work on being his friend. Not wanting him to be alone, she convinced Gabriel to let him come to New York with them. Adrien was eternally grateful towards her, describing her as "the girl willing to take a chance". However, as their trip continued, Marinette's romantic feelings continued to grow to the point of her trying to convince a disheartened Adrien to stay in New York, admitting that she loved him.
As their alter egos, the bond between Ladybug and Cat Noir continues to grow, and they begin to use new powers, like the Space form.
The ultimate test of trust between them began as she trusted Cat Noir to watch over Paris while she was gone.
Not wanting to disappoint her or lose her trust, Cat Noir hid the truth from her and was in New York too (although Marinette unknowingly took her partner with her).

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - "[[Miraculous New York]]"
Along the way, they meet Majestia, Knightowl, Sparrow, and Uncanny Valley and discover that the American heroes are different from them.
Unlike the Miraculous heroes, who were more secretive and independent, American ones were more open and protective of the younger heroes.
As the four young heroes came together during a fight against Technolizer, Ladybug was angry at Cat Noir that he left Paris unguarded to the point she expressed her disappointment in him.
A terrible mistake led to them learning a big lesson: with great power comes great responsibility and the consequences if said power is used recklessly.
The terrible mistake was Cat Noir accidentally destroying Uncanny Valley with his Cataclysm.
Despite Ladybug fixing her and the city, the duo was harshly scolded by Knightowl, warning them that if the conditions had been different, then the outcome would have been worse.
Then, things escalated when Ladybug and Cat Noir had discovered the state Paris was in.
Aware that the damage had been there for too long and with the villain gone, Ladybug couldn't use her powers to fix anything.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - "[[Miraculous New York]]"
Cat Noir felt unworthy of his powers and renounced his ring, leaving Ladybug alone and heartbroken because she had become so close to him, believing that she couldn't be herself without him. Meanwhile, the American heroes learned for the younger generation of heroes to grow, one needs to take chances and make their own way as Jessica, aka Sparrow, fiercely wanted her independence and admired the Miraculous duo for it. However, it caused her and Aeon, aka Uncanny Valley, to be disobedient towards their superiors and were temporarily grounded from the team. But, they soon discover that Hawk Moth was responsible for everything that's happening in New York, and by using the Eagle Miraculous along with Techno-Pirate turning into Miraclonizer, they both misused Liiri's powers to cause the adult heroes to run wild.
Understanding that they would need their help, Uncanny left to find the french duo; due to her being a robot she figured out the heroes' identities.
She tried to convince Cat Noir to return to New York, but it wasn't until he heard his partner's message that he did so, returning to a grateful Ladybug.
As they hugged, he apologized for his mistake of not being honest with her.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - "[[Miraculous New York]]"
Together with Sparrow and Uncanny, along with some creative thinking, they managed to retrieve the Eagle Miraculous from the titular villain, and with Sparrow, now known as Eagle, returned the adult heroes to normal, defeated Miraclonizer, and saved the city.
With the mission over, Jessica tried to return the Miraculous, but Ladybug allowed her to keep it, knowing she would use it well.
Being reunited with their mothers, Jess expected a scolding but received praise from Knightowl and Majestia about proving their mettle, turning from fledglings to full-grown eagles.
They also thanked Ladybug and Cat Noir for inspiring their daughters, understanding that the French duo was secretive about their identities, Uncanny saw it necessary to erase their identity data from her memory but not before Ladybug thanked her for bringing them back together.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - "[[Miraculous New York]]"
Meanwhile, Hawk Moth didn't see this escapade as a defeat but relished in the fact that there were other lost Miraculouses and that he'd find them all no matter how long it took. Back in Paris, people were working hard to clean up the damage. They missed their local heroes, but they didn't take it too hard because they heard of the duo's adventure in New York. Ladybug and Cat Noir were thanked by the American heroes with an ice statue of the four young heroes to honor their bravery and courage. With their trip nearing the end, Marinette would have another day to sort out her feelings and, along with her friends, gave Adrien one final surprise making him smile.
Then, sometime after Ladybug and Cat Noir had returned home, Eagle and Uncanny during a nightly patrol were approached by an unnamed guardian who demanded the Eagle Miraculous. Eagle proposed a better idea: convincing the guardian to stay in New York and create a new generation of heroes.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - "[[Miraculous Paris]]"
After their plan failed the French Duo started to lose hope they would defeat Monarch but just as someone loses hope others are seeking it.
As the Miraculous world expands again this time they learn that Miraculouses and wearers exist across the multiverse when a mysterious Butterfly holder named Betterfly appears seeking their aid but they realize he didn't come alone as a mysterious pair of villains named Shadybug and Claw Noir chased after him.
But seeing how much the dark duo's powers differ from theirs, Ladybug and Cat Noir learn why because of the security system that protects them but their dark counterparts broke it by using their jewels for evil thereby hurting themselves.
After their battle drew a draw, the Duo and Betterfly hide in the sewers where they hear him crying in joy at how beautiful their world is compared to his which is a nightmare ruled by an entity named the Supreme and that he controls the Miraculouses under a corrupt system.
To which Betterfly used to be apart of until one day he learned the hard way that with great power comes great responsibility.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - "[[Miraculous Paris]]"
With that he intended to use his power the right way for good and set up the Resistance but the Supreme retaliated with holders of his own to hunt him down.
During the conversation Ladybug and Cat Noir discovered that Shadybug and Claw Noir were also the duo's dark counterparts.
.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - "[[Miraculous Paris]]"
Returning to the surface, from Alya the hero trio learned that the dark duo team up with Monarch as per part of the plan Ladybug used the alternate Butterfly Miraculous to unify into Ladyfly and pretended to fall for Monarch's scheme so they could deal with their counterparts personally. By talking with them Ladybug and Cat Noir discovered how dark their lives would be if they were consumed by despair and anger, as well as encouraged the dark duo to believe in themselves to seek better lives. With that insight in mind, Shadybug and Claw Noir used it to change their costumes, heal their affliction, were renamed Ladybug and Furry Paw and join the resistance. However their joy was short lived when Monarch still refused to give up since couldn't have the Miraculous of his world, he tried to steal them from across the multiverse but the heroes managed to stop him. With the other worlds safe; both pairs thank each other for giving something they both needed - the hope to keep fighting.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - "[[Miraculous London]]"
Here we're given an insider's look on what happened after Gabriel's wish once it was done Marinette retrieved all the remaining jewels including her own and the twin rings.
Being briefly reunited with Tikki and Plagg, she discovered that Gabriel sacrificed himself to be with Emilie at the price of healing Nathalie.
However Marinette felt no joy as she believed her greatest nightmare had come true until Nathalie told her otherwise regardless upon entering Monarch's lair, Bug Noir finally managed to rescue the kwamis as well as discovered where Adrien and Kagami were hiding.
Then, needing to figure out what to do, Marinette flew to London to tell Adrien the half truth about Gabriel until the Butterfly Miraculous was found.
After reuniting with Kagami and Adrien, breaking the news to the world and returning home with the kwamis, Marinette mulled over if she did the right thing but the kwamis had no idea how to answer nonetheless Tikki told her owner to rest for the long night ahead and she was right.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - "[[Miraculous London]]"
Not long after they were all asleep Marinette was woken up by startling scene all the kwamis including Tikki were stolen again, much worse that someone had activated the wish causing the world's destruction.
Which led to a reunion with Bunnyx, who informed Marinette of the situation needing her Miraculous, they retrieved Tikki from her first adventure making her aware of her holder's potential among other things.
As Chronobug, by reviewing the past the duo discovered to their horror that someone else found the Butterfly Miraculous first becoming the new "Hawk Moth", and used it to spy on Past Bug Noir's actions knowing everything she did including her identity revealing how the jewels were stolen.
Despite Chronobug's best, the mystery holder always escaped making Chronobug realizes that she had to stop her enemy knowing the information with a little rewriting the new Butterfly holder was thrown off the trail and the timeline was restored.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - "[[Miraculous London]]"
Before returning things to normal, Chronobug asked the Bunnyxes for advice if she did the right thing with Adrien but they retorted that telling the truth nor a lie will always yield to different results but the most important thing is how someone owns up to them.
Knowing how Ladybug always saved the day, current Bunnyx retorted that it always saved not by a lucky charm but by the heroine's mind and instincts knowing she'll find a way out of her predictament too.
With everything restored both Nooroo and Marinette expressed great joy and to ensure that the jewels were never stolen all at once again she allowed the remaining kwamis to stay with their owners full time restoring her team.
Although, Ladybug was happy to reunite with Cat Noir it was bittersweet as they both shared the guilt with what did and didn't happen with Monarch regardless they promised to get the Butterfly Miraculous back from the new holder.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - "[[Miraculous Tokyo]]"
It was summer vacation and the Miraculers had their jewels returned but before then Ladybug was called away by Ryuko to come to the latter's home country of Tokyo.
Once there, Marinette discovered what Kagami's life was like before she came to Paris seeing that it was no different than Adrien's before he came to school.
Then, hearing a call to action, the duo transformed into Ladybug and Ryuko, to see that just as Paris has akumatized victims and New York has supervillains, Tokyo has it's own danger Kaijū monsters created by the mysterious Moddler.
Arriving at the scene, the duo come across the new budding team: the Stellar Force, but seeing them in action, Ryuko informed Ladybug that the reason they were here was to lead them, which the latter refused because it wasn't their place.
Or so they though, further watching the Stellar Force about to destroy the taxi kaiju, eying her lucky charm, recgonizing the taxi from before the French Duo tried to stop them but it was too late and the kaiju was destroyed.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - "[[Miraculous Tokyo]]"
Finally moving, Ladybug called the Stellar Force out  informing them that they destroyed an innoncent person reviving the kaiju and following Capricorn's markings and the french heroine's instructions the budding team saw that Ladybug was right.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - [[Miraculous Adventures]]
At an unknown time after the events of "The Collector", in the second issue, Wang Fu explained the origins of the kwamis and the Miraculouses to Marinette.
Later that day, she and Cat Noir were summoned to New York City through a portal by Doorman.
As detailed in the third issue, various superheroes requested their help in fighting a huge threat, the Trash Krakken.
While reluctant about their leader, Victory's, plan, which involved catastrophic destruction followed by the Miraculous Ladybug fixing all of the damage, Ladybug and Cat Noir agreed to help.
However, theorizing that a stuffed animal, called Mr.
Squid, could be related to the monster, Ladybug decided to directly face the monster against orders, Cat Noir loyally following her.
Knightowl, Sparrow, and Majestia, with persuasion, were willing to temporarily try the plan to snatch Mr.
Squid from the Trash Krakken's body in the fourth issue.
While Sparrow was caught in the Trash Krakken's body, Ladybug, Cat Noir, and Knightowl successfully took the toy.
The Trash Krakken reverted back into a human man, and the toy was purified with Ladybug's yo-yo.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - [[Miraculous Adventures]]
With New York City saved, the duo and the other superheroes confirmed their alliance, and the duo returned to Paris through another portal.
</tabber>

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - System
Original Duo
Whenever they realize a villain is attacking: Marinette and Adrien, with the help of their respective kwamis, use their Miraculouses to transform into their superhero personas: Ladybug and Cat Noir. Both have enhanced physical abilities: such as strength, agility, and near invulnerability. They also each have a special weapon: Ladybug's Yo-yo and Cat Noir's Staff. Both with a unique superpower: Ladybug able to create a helpful object with her Lucky Charm and Cat Noir being able to destroy anything he touches with his Cataclysm.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - System
While both are selfless and determined heroes in their own rights, they have unique knowledge and skills outside of their powers and tools. Ladybug is exceptionally tenacious, creative, kind, and skillful at thinking up plans, able to figure out how to use her Lucky Charm to benefit her situation, usually with various items around her in conjunction with the Lucky Charm to help Ladybug achieve her goal, making her a resourceful and powerful leader. For his part, Cat Noir is a daring warrior, he speaks various languages, he's wise, funny, compassionate in times of despair, along with having calm observations, keen cleverness, and passionate reactions during serious situations, he's one of the greatest partners any hero could ever have.
Ladybug is the only hero able to purify akumas and undo damage caused during the mission, but outside of occasions where Ladybug or Cat Noir have to battle villains on their own, they usually work best as a team by utilizing their strengths together.
After Wang Fu translates some of the spellbook, Ladybug and Cat Noir gain new superpowers related to particular situations, like floods, extreme cold, and space modes.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - System
As of "Revolution", Ladybug and Cat Noir have grown as precocious heroes with evolved powers. They no longer de-transform after they used their powers once, they can use their powers multiple times, and stronger than they were before.
New Superheroes
But sometimes, Ladybug and Cat Noir are unable to handle the crisis on their own and need help from the power of another miraculous. When they need more support and assistance, they've built a team of allies with transcendent potential to aid them:
Rena Rouge, who proves to have remarkable resourcefulness and cunning, becomes the first member of the team to know Ladybug's secret identity, and ready to help her anytime she is unable to fulfill her superhero duties.
As Rena Furtive, she acted as the team's secret protector against Shadow Moth's traps, using her illusions to prevent the latter from following any teammate or to follow him in case he appears.
Carapace, who proves to have unyielding combat skills, exceptional courage, and genuine determination to protect those who are unable protect themselves.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - System
Queen Bee (formerly), who isn't impressed by people in power and despite her obnoxious personality she had proven that she could be a very good teammate.
Viperion, who is wise beyond his years, gives his teammates another chance, able to perceive the best way to defeat relentless villains, all while preventing himself, and his teammates from repeating any mistake that may compromise the mission or their identities. He becomes the only member (except for Bunnyx) to know both Ladybug's and Cat Noir's identities.
Pegasus, whose mind is advanced, quick, and astute alongside his power (Voyage); helps the heroes expect the unexpected.
Ryuko, who controls the elements of storm (wind, water, and lightning), alongside a high sense of honor, lavish empathy, and proper discipline in any situation; makes her an undefeatable warrior.
King Monkey, who is confident, caring, and cunning to outsmart any villain. He is also the only hero (besides Ladybug and Cat Noir) to be chosen directly by Master Fu.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - System
In order to save the other Miraculouses and prevent Hawk Moth from extracting valuable information from him, Master Fu renounced his position as Guardian and Miraculous holder and officially made Ladybug the new Guardian, at the expense, however, of his own memories of everything concerning the Miraculouses, including the secret identities of the heroes being erased.
Later, because of Chloé's despicable actions, Ladybug seized the Bee Miraculous from her and definitively banished her from the team. After becoming a Guardian, Ladybug kept increasing her superhero team.
Vesperia, Queen Bee's replacement as the Bee Miraculous holder, who possesses a much more heroic demeanor than her predecessor.
Polymouse, whose great ideas and her power to divide and conquer, can deal with any problem.
Pigella, who knows how to spread her optimism, gift it to others, and sees light in the darkness.
Purple Tigress, whose inner confidence, allied to her power (Clout), can put an end to any conflict or defeat any maniacal foe(s).
Miss Hound, who is loyal, intuitive, and bold, can retrieve anything her ball touches beforehand.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - System
Rooster Bold, who can combine his creative mind  and passionate demeanor to his ability to give himself any superpower he wants.
Caprikid, who has impressive teamwork but strong instinct and imagination, allowing him to create any object he desires.
Minotaurox, who is a gentle giant but fearsome when needed, who resists any enemy attack.
After Félix, in exchange for the Peacock Miraculous, stole Ladybug's yo-yo and gave it Shadow Moth to have access to the Chinese Zodiac Miraculouses, stealing them, the latter became Monarch. Soon after Monarch's debut, the heroes manage to recover Fluff and the Rabbit Miraculous, allowing Alix to become:
Bunnyx, who understands that there's a time for everything and oversees the timeline to make sure no one endangers it.
In "Re-creation", as Gabriel was making his wish, he relinquished his remaining Miraculouses to Ladybug and she reforged the jewels to their original forms. Then, they were returned to all of the inactive members making them like herself and Cat Noir full time members along with their newest addition to the team:

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - System
Argos, who has the power to manifest emotions of himself, or others into a physical form to create living beings and treats them as equals; not tools.
Against Chrysalis
With the fall of Monarch, the reformation of the team (with each member becoming a permanent holder) and the rise of a new Butterfly Miraculous holder, Ladybug and Cat Noir taught their fellow heroes how to unlock their adult powers. This allows her teammates to use their powers to help other people freely across the city. However, when it comes to face akumatized villains, they must not face them unless she calls them, so that the right heroes and powers can be used all while keeping the Miraculous safe.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - System
In order to face the new holder of the Butterfly Miraculous, Marinette developed a new upgrade on the Miraculous she integrated in them when she reforged them back to their original forms, while adding it to the ones that were not turned into rings by Monarch. She was able to develop a direct line of contact between the Miraculous that allows her to call for any hero of her team when in need of their help by selecting their symbol on her yo-yo. Once she selects the hero, her yo-yo sends a signal that the hero in question is able to sense, knowing exactly where the signal is coming from. In "Daddycop", it is shown that Ladybug implemented the same system on the other Miraculous, allowing the other holders to either call for her whenever an akumatized villain appears when they are transformed or to request the help of another hero when they need it or on Ladybug's behalf.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - System
Due to the danger Chrysalis represents, including to the timeline (as she already tried to use time travel to discover Ladybug's identity and her wish involves reconfiguring the world in ways that will change the timeline altogether), Alix is forced to remain away from the present in order to both protect the Rabbit Miraculous and watch over the timeline and ensure nothing disturbs it.
As seen in "Mister Agreste", Luka, in order to prevent himself from being akumatized and reveal the identities of both Ladybug and Cat Noir to Chrysalis (and to not sour Marinette and Adrien's relationship), decided to return to Brazil.
However, as seen in the cold open of "Revelator", before Luka returned to Brazil, Ladybug and Cat Noir trained their allies in obtaining their adult powers.
In "The Chained Titans", it revealed that Mayor Caline Bustier secretly gave the team an abandoned Métro station, which the Miraculers dubbed as the "Miracle Station", and remodeled it so that they can use it as personal hideout and base.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - System
In "Secret Protocol", it is shown that the danger of the new holder of the Butterfly Miraculous forced Ladybug to create many secret protocols for her and her teammates to better protect their Miraculous and their secret identities. Despite most of them being common to all of the Miraculers, a few secret protocols are specific for a particular Miraculer, like Alya having a secret protocol where she unifies the Fox Miraculous with Marinette's Ladybug Miraculous to become Renabug, whenever the latter's identity is in danger. However, in "Nemesis", after the revelation that the new holder of the Butterfly can shapeshift and take any appearance, including one of the Miraculers, Ladybug sees the urgency to create a secret protocol to counter that.
The Future

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - System
According to Bunnyx in "Timetagger", 10 years later the Miraculers especially the duo, will continue to fight against akumatized villains, who are controlled by a new Butterfly Miraculous holder. To combat this a superhero team was assembled with Bunnyx as one of its members and Ladybug's future self as team leader with Cat Noir by her side. Aside from them it's unknown who else is active in the team at the time then on, from "Miraculous London", the timeline will still be safeguarded by an elderly Bunnyx.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Secret Identities
The two main members of the team, Ladybug and Cat Noir, aka Marinette Dupain-Cheng and Adrien Agreste, agreed from the outset to keep their respective civilian identities secret, even from each other, since if one of them were to discover the other's secret identity, they should give up their own Miraculous to avoid endangering their partner.
The danger of the two knowing each other's identities is further explored in "Cat Blanc" and "Ephemeral", seen to what would happen if any of them would discover the other's identity. In both cases, the two would end up dating each other and that would lead to Gabriel discovering his son's identity as Cat Noir, leading to the latter being akumatized and cause the end of the world.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Secret Identities
Even the temporary Miraculous heroes they call for help try to respect this rule, and within the team, Ladybug, who is usually the one who recruits new heroes, knows all their civilian identities. Instead, while Cat Noir unquestionably knows the civilian identities of Viperion, Pegasus, Ryuko, Bunnyx, Pigella, Rena Rouge, Carapace and Argos, and even though several important pieces of information have been revealed to him after having officially met Master Wang Fu, he doesn't know the secret identities of King Monkey, Vesperia, Polymouse, Purple Tigress, Miss Hound, Caprikid, Rooster Bold and Minotaurox, since Ladybug prefers that there are as few people as possible to know their civilian identities, and therefore, whenever possible, she tends to leave Cat Noir in the dark about such information, much to his chagrin.
Exceptions
However, there have been a few exceptions:

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Secret Identities
Since "Queen Wasp", Queen Bee, aka Chloé Bourgeois, is the only hero whose civilian identity is in the public domain, having transformed in front of the cameras to show everyone (but specifically her mother) her value. Despite the recklessness of her actions, Ladybug, who was in a desperate moment and despite understandable doubts, chose to give her a second chance, and since then Queen Bee has helped the team for some important missions, only to be suspended by Ladybug due to her public civilian identity.
In "Catalyst", Rena Rouge and Carapace, aka Alya Césaire and Nino Lahiffe, get to know each others' secret identities. While at first Alya had suspicions about Nino, the latter had no suspicion about the former. During Heroes' Day, Ladybug, who was in an emergency situation and didn't have time to separate the couple, was forced to ask both temporary heroes on the spot for help, revealing to each other the other's secret identity. Since then, she has made the two heroes swear not to reveal each others' civilian identities to anyone.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Secret Identities
In "Oblivio", both Ladybug and Cat Noir discovered each other's civilian identities after getting struck by Oblivio's powers which led to them becoming a couple until the magic ladybugs restored their memories.
In "Desperada", after a failed attempt to woo Ladybug with the Snake Miraculous, Adrien suggests that Luka Couffaine wields it. Since nobody besides Wang was aware that Cat Noir and Adrien are the same person, from Ladybug and Luka's points of view, Adrien is just another temporary Miraculous holder, but who is aware that Luka is the new holder of the Snake Miraculous.
In "Startrain", when Ladybug chose to give the Horse Miraculous to Max Kanté, besides her and Cat Noir, even Markov, Max's robot, was present at that time. As revealed in "Miraculous New York", robots are immune to the magical nature of the Miraculouses which hides the identity of the holders, although Markov can't recognize Miraculous holders' identities because he's not as advanced as Uncanny.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Secret Identities
In "Ikari Gozen", Hawk Moth learned that Kagami Tsurugi is Ryuko after she was able to free herself from her akumatized mother's prison. Because of that, Ladybug told her she may not give her back the Miraculous as it may put Kagami's loved ones in danger. Despite that, in "Heart Hunter", Ladybug asked again for her help to secretly prevent her from dating Adrien at that time.
Despite losing her memories after being deakumatized, Tomoe Tsurugi is later on informed by Gabriel about her daughter being Ryuko. This is later confirmed in "Yaksi Gozen", where Kagami, due to knowing her mother was Gabriel's accomplice, is aware her mother knows her superhero identity and doesn't hide Longg and is not afraid of transforming before her.
In "Timetagger", Ladybug and Cat Noir met a Rabbit Miraculous holder from the future, Bunnyx, aka Alix Kubdel as an adult. Being a time traveler and a connoisseur of many key moments in the course of history, Bunnyx knows the secret identities of the two heroes, although she cannot reveal neither this nor other information in order to protect the time continuum.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Secret Identities
Outside the team, Master Wang Fu used to know the secret identities of all the Miraculous heroes of the team, as he was the Guardian of the Miraculouses, and the chooser of some of its members (Ladybug, Cat Noir and King Monkey). This changed when he abdicated his title as Guardian and lost his memories related to the Miraculous.
The situation regarding Ladybug's allies' anonymity, however, changed drastically in "Miracle Queen"; the titular villain, aka Chloé, who allied herself with Hawk Moth and Mayura, took mind control of all of Paris and commanded all the Miraculous holders to come to her, allowing Hawk Moth, Mayura and Chloé to learn the secret identities of Rena Rouge, Pegasus, Viperion, King Monkey, Carapace and Ryuko (Ladybug and Cat Noir escaped being affected by her powers, while Alix Kubdel, future Rabbit Miraculous holder, has not used yet her Miraculous in the present).

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Secret Identities
An unusual case was that which occurred in "Miraculous New York": Uncanny Valley, being a very advanced robot, was immune to the magical nature of Ladybug and Cat Noir's suits that made their civilian identities unrecognizable from human observers allowing her to find them in civilian form. After defeating an akumatized Techno-Pirate and understanding the French Duo's need for secrecy after their encounter, she deleted the knowledge from her memory to protect them, making herself in the dark again. Later on, in the end scene of Miraculous Tokyo, Uncanny Valley again knows that Adrien is Cat Noir.
Also, despite their enemies being privy to the secret identities of many of the temporary members of the team, Ladybug has decided to keep calling them back for help, due to the increasingly difficult battles, and there were further exceptions regarding secret identities, as well as new management changes within the team:

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Secret Identities
In "Gang of Secrets" due to pressures of being the new Guardian, being unable to confess her feelings to Adrien, and breaking up with Luka, Marinette revealed her superhero persona to Alya for comfort, making the latter the first person, post-Master Fu's amnesia, to know Ladybug's true identity. Furthermore, in "Optigami", due to the increasing risks caused by Shadow Moth's constant attacks, Marinette definitively gave the Fox Miraculous to Alya, thus making her a full-time holder like Ladybug and Cat Noir.
In "Furious Fu", the celestial guardian Su-Han learned that Marinette is, not only the new Guardian, but also the current Ladybug Miraculous holder, much to his chagrin, as this broke several rules of the Order. However, after seeing how Marinette's unorthodox methods work, Su-Han decided that she is a good fit for her role, while continuing to keep an eye on her.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Secret Identities
In "Sentibubbler", Rena Rouge was able to make Shadow Moth (as well as heroes such as Cat Noir and Carapace) believe, thanks to her illusions, that Ladybug will never give her the Fox Miraculous again, so as not to endanger her and her loved ones. In reality, Alya will still continue to use the Fox Miraculous, but with a new secret identity, Rena Furtive, helping her teammates in the shadows, with only Ladybug aware of Alya's new superhero persona. However, in "Rocketear", to avoid further misunderstandings with Nino, Alya decided to reveal to him her new secret identity.
In "Rocketear", having misunderstood the relationship between Alya and Cat Noir as romantic, in a burst of emotion and to make Adrien to believe him, Nino revealed to him his own and Alya's secret identities, thus unknowingly making Cat Noir aware, for the first time, of Rena Rouge and Carapace's civilian identities.  Alya and Ladybug were unaware that Adrien (aka Cat Noir) was privy to such information until "Illusion".

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Secret Identities
In "Wishmaker", while fighting the titular villain, both Ladybug and Cat Noir have fallen victim to his powers, which caused their civilian identities to be revealed to both Viperion and Shadow Moth. However, thanks to Viperion's special power, Second Chance, he was able to revert both situations, preventing the main villain from uncovering such important information; but because he still retains the knowledge of the erased timelines, Luka is still privy to Marinette and Adrien's secret identities, unbeknownst to the two main heroes.
In regard to Ladybug's situation, she only replaced Chloé and not the others because Chloé was the only one to break the secret identity rule so she gave the others a second chance as, with Hawk Moth becoming stronger, more deadly ever and for the same reason why Marinette in "Catalyst" opted to not call new allies (at least with the ones she already chose), she needed those who already have experience with the jewels.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Secret Identities
In "Ephemeral", it was shown more insight about the rules regarding the secret identities: according to Ladybug, the reason why all the other Miraculous heroes don't know who she and Cat Noir really are, is to protect them from Shadow Moth, so that he leaves them alone, since he knows their civilian identities and could threaten and blackmail them (as he tried to do with Alya in "Sentibubbler"). However, in an emergency situation, Ladybug allowed Viperion (unaware that he is already aware of the civilian identities of the two heroes) to know Cat Noir's identity, but not both; in that way, at least one of them is still out of danger. Regarding instead Ladybug and Cat Noir themselves, if at least one of them knew the other's civilian identity, and he or she get akumatized, Shadow Moth would make them betray their partner, and would get a hold of both of them (as happened in the aforementioned episode, and it was only thanks to Sass's Second Chance this timeline was erased).

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Secret Identities
After Monarch had stolen the other Miraculouses through Félix, he devised a deadly plan by creating the Alliance Rings, which would transmit information back to him if anyone achieved the physical standards of a Miraculous holder allowing him to discover said holder's identities as long as they wear it. Unfortunately to him, both Marinette and Adrien, for their own reasons, refused to wear the rings, in this way rendering this tactic pointless.
However, when Marinette and Adrien gave up their Miraculous in "Transmission", Gabriel used this tactic to discover Alya and Zoé's identities as Scarabella and Kitty Noire, causing Ladybug and Cat Noir to resume their mantles.
And even though Monarch was still not privy to the identities of the heroes, there were occasions where the knowledge still got out, directly or indirectly:
In "Multiplication", with Ladybug's permission, Alim revealed to his daughter's classmates and teachers her secret identity as Bunnyx, the Rabbit Miraculous' holder.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Secret Identities
In "Perfection", Kagami accidentally eavesdrops a conversation between Marinette and Alya where the former vents about being afraid of losing her Miraculous. Due to have heard only a part of the conversation and being herself in a stressful state at that moment, Kagami was not able to immediately realize the truth and took some time to process the information and realize Marinette was Ladybug, something that happened between "Protection" and "Representation". Since she overheard Marinette talking to Alya about her secret identity, she also found out that Alya is Ladybug's confidant.
In "Migration", while trying to re-akumatize Luka into Silencer, Monarch was able to realize that the boy knew Ladybug and Cat Noir's identities. After failing to force him to tell the truth, Monarch didn't waste time to send a villain after him. With the danger of becoming Monarch's main target and not wanting Ladybug and Cat Noir to neglect their duties to the city just to protect him, Luka decides to leave Paris with his father, Jagged Stone, and Penny.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Secret Identities
In "Representation", it's revealed that, after solidifying their relationship as a couple, Kagami told Félix that Marinette was Ladybug and Félix told Kagami that Gabriel was Monarch. Realizing they would need her help in order to be together, the two of them then put together a play for Marinette, helped by the sentimonster Once Upon a Time, so, in that way, they could not only tell Félix's side of the story, but also reveal to her who her greatest enemy really is.
In "Conformation", after entering the Agreste mansion to talk with Nathalie about Adrien, Marinette has the confirmation that Gabriel is Monarch after seeing him de-transform. Not just that, but she also learns that Nathalie was Mayura after the latter admits that her illness was caused by the use of the damaged Peacock Miraculous. After she is cornered and forced to de-transform, Marinette is found by Monarch who is able to discover her identity.
In "Re-creation", it is shown that Grand Master Su-Han is aware of Alya's role as Marinette's confidant and, most likely, as the holder of the Fox Miraculous.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Secret Identities
In "Miraculous London", after being healed from her illness, Nathalie goes to the Crypt after the wish is made, expecting to find Gabriel, only to find Marinette with Tikki and Plagg, in this way discovering she has been Ladybug all along.
In "Miraculous Tokyo", in order to protect her grandmother and Shinobu from the hord of small kaiju, Kagami is forced to transform into Ryuko in front of them and the Stellar Force so she could use her powers. Despite not all members of Stellar Force were not present at that moment, that information was passed to them. It's unknown if Stellar Force was able to deduce Marinette was Ladybug for the fact Ryuko is part of her team and Marinette was in Tokyo together with Kagami.
In "Mister Agreste", in Luka's case; usually when a Miraculous holder has their identity exposed to anyone, even a villain, they have to surrender their jewel so it doesn't get stolen, but depending on how their identity comes out, they not only run the risk of exposing themselves to one enemy but to any and all future enemies. Thereby same as Alix, Luka had to stay out of Chrysalis' reach for the sake of what he knew until her defeat.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Secret Identities
In "Revelator", there was a great danger of the identities of Ladybug, Cat Noir and Rena Rouge due to the titular villain's power. Because Rena Rouge hold Ladybug's secret, Cat Noir assumed she knew the latter's identity, but actually she learned Gabriel's secret identity as Monarch, putting her at odds with Ladybug due to the consequences of hiding that information, especially from Adrien. Thankfully with Cat Noir's new power, the secret was erased from Rena's mind and yet made Marinette remember like Gabriel she can't keep the secret forever.
In "Yaksi Gozen", due to being Tomoe's ally, Chrysalis knows that Kagami is Ryuko, Félix is Argos and that the two are sentimonsters with their amoks located on their rings. It's also possible that she also knows the identities of Rena Rouge, Carapace, Viperion, Pegasus and King Monkey and that Adrien is a sentimonster as well.
In "The Ruler", in order to make Marc not worry too much about him protecting him, even from supervillains, Nathaniel reveals his identity as Caprikid to him. This leads Marc to also reveal his superhero identity as Rooster Bold to him as well.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Secret Identities
In "Secret Protocol", after realizing her secret identity had put her parents in direct danger after the holder of the Butterfly Miraculous managed to infiltrate her home and allow her to drop her guard, Marinette decides to tell them the truth about being Ladybug.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Members
In chronological order of when they were recruited:
Original Members
After the group was founded by Master Fu, Ladybug and Cat Noir became the very first members of the hero team.
Currently, with the threat imposed by Chrysalis, Ladybug and Cat Noir are the only heroes of the team allowed to fight akumatized villains when they first appear, the former because she is the leader and the only one capable of purifying the akumas and fix the damages and the latter because of his powers complementing Ladybug's.
HeroNameMiraculousKwamiConceptSuperpowerCivilianLadybugCreationLucky CharmCat NoirDestructionCataclysm
Active Members
List of Miraculous holders who are currently active thanks to Marinette leaving their Miraculouses with them permanently. Originally, their Miraculouses were kept in the Chinese Miracle Box and only handed out when their powers were needed. After Gabriel Agreste got ahold of Ladybug's Yo-yo, he gained direct access to the Miracle Box and stole all the Miraculouses stored inside of it. After all the Miraculouses were retrieved, Ladybug decided to give them back to their holders to keep, to ensure that all the Miraculouses couldn't be stolen all at once again.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Members
To minimize the risk of their Miraculouses being stolen, as a rule, they are not to go into action against any Akumatized villains unless Ladybug and Cat Noir call them in. However, if no Akumatized villains are present, then they are free to do as they please.

Temporary members

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Members
Certain members of the  only used another miraculous once, making that hero persona a temporary member that is unlikely to return. A few of them are even just variations of their identity with their current Miraculous.
