title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Allies
Superheroes
United Heroez — a team of American superheroes, operating in mainly New York City which debuted in the "Miraculous New York" special.
Majestia — she first met Ladybug and Cat Noir after the battle against Techlonizer. While grateful for Ladybug fixing the damage from the fight, she was heartbroken due the the condition of her 'daughter', and sided with Knightowl regarding them using their Miraculouses while in the city. After defeating Techlonizer, she, along with Knightowl, recognized the French heroes as their equals and admit that times are changing and they should as well.
Doorman — he acts as a support during the battle against Techlonizer, guiding the civilians away to safety. His powers were later used by Ladybug and Cat Noir to reach Miraclonizer and free the rest of the United Heroez from the villain's spell.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Allies
Knightowl — she is initially judgmental and critical towards Ladybug and Cat Noir, but after seeing their work, grows to respect their heroism. Due to the damages and their reckless behavior during the battle against Techlonizer, she demands Ladybug and Cat Noir hand over their Miraculouses. After the United Heroez were released from Miraclonizer's spell, she helped detain Techlonizer long enough for Cat Noir to break his akumatized cuffs.
Sparrow/Eagle — Sparrow gets along very well with Ladybug and Cat Noir. She is inspired by the French teens to try and fight Techlonizer without the adults. She is later granted the Eagle Miraculous, showing the trust Ladybug has in her, and starts going by the name "Eagle".
Liiri — the kwami of Freedom. Liiri was retrieved from Miraclonizer and helped Jessica Keynes transform into Eagle.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Allies
Uncanny Valley — she is an AI robot created by Majestia with whom she has a mother/daughter relationship and is close friends with Sparrow. She has a key role in reuniting the heroes during the climactic battle against Miraclonizer and has proven herself to be a trusting ally by protecting Ladybug and Cat Noir's secret identities to the point where Marinette trusted her with delivering the Cat Miraculous to Cat Noir.
Camilla Hombee/Victory — the President of the United States of America and a superheroine, who doesn't hide her secret identity.
Fei Wu/Ladydragon — The holder and Guardian of the Prodigious and a superhero in Shanghai.
Renlings — The Kwamis' "cousins", inhabiting the Prodigious, they give Ladydragon her powers. They are only visible to Fei.
Mei Shi — A spirit and the protector of the Prodigious. He accompanies Fei and teaches her about her abilities.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Allies
Betterfly - A superhero from an alternative universe who is the holder of the Butterfly Miraculous. At his home universe, he uses his power to fight against the tyrany of the Supreme, all while fighting two supervillains who wield both the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses, Shadybug and Claw Noir, sent by the latter to recover the two Miraculous he had stolen. He finds a way to come to Ladybug's universe to ask for her help and Cat Noir's to fight against those two supervillains.
Ladybug (alternative) - A Ladybug Miraculous superhero from an alternative universe who used to be a supervillain called Shadybug. While fighting her counterpart, she was inspired by the latter to become a better person, giving up her evil ways and joining Betterfly in the fight against the Supreme.
Furry Paw - A Cat Miraculous superhero from an alternative universe who used to be a supervillain called Claw Noir. While fighting his counterpart, he was inspired by the latter to become a better person, giving up his evil ways and joining Betterfly in the fight against the Supreme.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Allies
Stellar Force - A team of Japanese superheroes in Tokyo who draw their powers from the Stellar Matrix, each one possessing a piece of it based on the Western Zodiac constellations. They are Kagami's friends from when she used to live in Tokyo. They received helped from Ladybug and Ryuko when they were still starting their career as superheroes, which allowed them to become a much more cohesive team.
Civilians
Miss Bustier's class — Students taught by Miss Bustier in the same class as Marinette and Adrien at Collège Françoise Dupont. Some of the students have helped the heroes in a few instances, like singing "Smelly Wolf" to defeat the titular villain of "Horrificator" and joining up with Cat Noir to save Ladybug and fight the titular villain of "Reflekta". Some even faced against a villain head on to show their support, like the majority of the girls against the titular villain in "Gigantitan" or when Max Kanté turned against his then akumatized friend Markov. When Ladybug and Cat Noir were unable to fight the titular villain of "Reverser", Alix Kubdel and Nathaniel Kurtzberg assisted them in defeating him. Almost all students of the class are members of Ladybug's superhero team.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Allies
Caline Bustier: A former teacher at Collège Françoise Dupont and current mayor of Paris who used to teach Marinette and her friends. During the events of "Revolution", she helped the duo by breaking Queen Mayor's akumatized object.
Alya Césaire — A teenage girl and the creator of Ladyblog, often following akuma incidents across the city throughout the series. Being a huge fan of Ladybug and Cat Noir, she helps the heroes whenever they need, like help defeat Stoneheart in "Ladybug & Cat Noir". One of her greatest dreams is to someday find out their secret identities. This eventually becomes a reality when, in "Gang of Secrets", Marinette tells her she is Ladybug. In "Optigami", Marinette gives Alya the Fox Miraculous permanently, with her becoming a hero in the shadoes that ensured the safety of every mission. After having to give up the Miraculous after being exposed to Shadow Moth and the latter steal all the Miraculous in the Miracle Box, Alya returned to help Marinette as herself, being her emotional support and confident.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Allies
Nino Lahiffe — A teenager who, in "Anansi", is determined to fight against Anansi to free Alya, and when he sees that Ladybug needs help, he offers his. Ladybug gives him the Staff of Cat Noir, and he fights against Anansi to prevent her from taking the Cat Miraculous.
Nadja Chamack and Alec Cataldi — Employees at TVi and KIDZ+, the former being a news reporter and the latter usually being a television show host. Ladybug and Cat Noir contact them if they need to inform them of danger, like when Ladybug calls them to warn them about Guitar Villain's quest to get revenge on XY in "Guitar Villain".
Markov — A sentient robot created by Max. He helped the team to open the highly technological gates of Startrain in order to capture the villain in the episode of the same name.
Wayhem — A fan of Adrien. When Adrien was targeted by titular villain of "Gorizilla", Wayhem stood in his way multiple times and, unknowingly, allowed Adrien to become Cat Noir without revealing his identity, which also resulted in Hawk Moth to deviate his suspicions on his son.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Allies
Paris Rebellion — A large group of civilians gathered to fight Scarlet Moth and his akumatized army during "Mayura". The group assistance varied from building a road block to fighting the villains directly. They consist, among others, of Nora Césaire, Marlena Césaire, Anarka Couffaine, Luka Couffaine, Gina Bianchi, Manon Chamack, Marc Anciel, Tom Dupain, Sabine Cheng, and August's mother.
Tom Dupain and Sabine Cheng — The owners of Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie and Marinette's parents. They believe that the heroes will protect them from harm, for example allowing them and Kim to hide from Animan in their bakery during the episode of the same name. In "Secret Protocol", after realizing the danger her parents were after the new holder of the Butterfly Miraculous infiltrated their home, Marinette tells them she is Ladybug. Despite the shock and still being worried, the two of them fully support Marinette's superhero activities.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Allies
Philippe — An ice skating competitor and teacher at Paris's ice rink. As a former akumatized villain, he was a foe for the superheroes, but while in control, he is their enthusiastic supporter, providing them a safe place to hide Santa Claus when he was pursued by Christmaster and fighting against the villain toy army during "Christmaster".
Santa Claus — A manifestation of the folklore figure, brought to life by the magic of Christmaster, in the episode of the same name, and targeted by the villain for his toys. Unwilling to break his holiday rules, he sought the help and protection of the superheroes and helped them fight their toy counterparts.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Allies
Su-Han — A monk from the Order of the Guardians and Wang Fu's master. He came to Paris to retrieve the Chinese Miracle Box, but after seeing the team in action, he decided to stay and assist them. However in "Multiplication" instead of helping he was distracted and criticized the heroes for the Kwamis capture but upon being scolded back he accepted that he was blame too and to make up for it Su-Han left for the temple to find help. In "Re-creation", it's revealed that he has been training Luka, Jagged Stone and Penny Rolling in mirakung fu and they went back to Paris to help fighting the Miraculizeds.
Manon Chamack, Chris Lahiffe, and Ella and Etta Césaire — Four kids Marinette often babysit, with the last three being siblings to Nino and Alya respectively. During "Simpleman", when the heroes and the majority of Paris were under the effect of the titular villain, the four help Ladybug and Cat Noir figure out how to use the Lucky Charm and defeat the villain.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Allies
The Resistance — After Monarch managed to get all the Miraculous in the Miracle Box except for Ladybug and Cat Noir's, Nino decided to help the heroes despite not being Carapace anymore, and so he founded the Resistance. All members of the Resistence have codenames named after sauces. Their first mission was to discover how Monarch is giving Miraculous superpowers to his akumatized villains by recording an akumatization caused by them, but, because they chose Gabriel Agreste, who is Monarch himself, who was aware of their plan thanks to Lila Rossi, the supervillain was able to give them false information to deviate their attention from the Alliance rings. After that, they came to help heroes in dire situations, like help Ladybug against Monarch, saving her and recovering her Miraculous in "Deflagration"; they also saved Cat Noir from Nightormentor and helped him defeat him and capture his akuma in "Representation"; they also fought against the Miraculizeds, during "The Final Day".

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Allies
Nino Lahiffe: known as Comrade Ketchup, is the founder and leader of the Resistance. He was the mind behind the group's first plan to figure out how Monarch was giving Miraculous superpowers to his akumatized villains, ending up collecting misleading information because he chose Gabriel Agreste (Monarch himself) as a test subject and the latest was warned by Lila about the plan.
Adrien Agreste: known as Comrade Mayo, is the second member of the Resistance. He participated on the group's first plan, being the one to record his father's "akumatization", without realizing it was just an illusion created by Monarch to mislead them. Secretly, he is Cat Noir. After giving up his Miraculous during the "Kwamis' Choice" two-parter special, he helped the Resistance in subduing Sole Destroyer and recover the Ladybug Miraculous from Monarch.
Alya Césaire: known as Comrade Beurre Maître d'Hôtel, is the third member of the Resistance. She particpated on the group's first plan (despite having big reservations about it).
Marinette Dupain-Cheng: known as Comrade Bechamel, is the fourth member of the Resistance. She participated on the group's first plan. Secretly, she is Ladybug.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Allies
Gabriel Agreste: known as Comrade Tartar Sauce, an honorary member. However, unknown to Nino and the rest of the Resistance, Gabriel is Monarch himself, the very enemy they are trying to defeat.
Max Kanté: known as Comrade Bearnaise.
Lê Chiến Kim: known as Comrade Burgundy.
Rose Lavillant: known as Comrade Cocktail.
Juleka Couffaine: known as Comrade Grand Veneur.
Ivan Bruel: known as Comrade Aioli.
Mylène Haprèle: known as Comrade Gribiche.
Lila Rossi: known as Comrade Sweet and Sour. Unknown to the rest of the Resistance, she is a spy for Gabriel Agreste (and by extension to Monarch), so he gets to know exactly what the group is planning by infiltrating their inner circle. She leaves the group after her true nature is exposed by Marinette and Sabrina.
Nathaniel Kurtzberg
Zoé Lee
Denis Damoclès
Marc Anciel
Sabrina Raincomprix

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Allies
Nathalie Sancoeur — The former ally of Gabriel Agreste. After perceiving the madness in her employer's obsession towards the Miraculous, she starts to slightly undermind him the best way she could when it came to Adrien's life, while trying to dissuate him to stop being a villain, and officially turned against him when the latter initiated his ultimate plan, failing to do so due to the advanced state of her sickness caused by the use of the damaged Peacock Miraculous. Before succumbing to it, she warned Ladybug she needed to detransform in order to dodge the Miraculized's attacks, giving her the time she needed to obtain the Cat Miraculous and unify it with her own. Later on, she learns Ladybug's secret identity and the two together become accomplices in the lie that covers Gabriel's real identity as Monarch for Adrien's sake. Despite Nathalie is part of the Kingdom seeking the Ladybug and Cat Miraculous, she hides Ladybug's secret identity from its council.
Kwamis

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Allies
Aside from the kwamis of the superheroes, and Nooroo and Duusu who are captured by Hawk Moth, the kwamis in the Miracle Box are trying to help the team and save Nooroo, as shown in "Sandboy". The same team-up happened at Marinette's side to save Tikki and Plagg in Kwamibuster. As of the "The Battle of the Miraculous", Marinette became the new guardian of the Chinese Miracle Box, and the kwamis are in her care. Until "Strikeback", she lost them through betrayal and trickery to Monarch but vows to rescues them. But as of "Evolution", the duo and both Bunnyx-es managed to rescue Fluff. In "Destruction", the kwamis were almost freed if Monarch hadn't forced Cat Noir to cataclysm and escape taking the kwamis with him. After Ladybug recovered all the kwamis from Monarch (except for Nooroo) in order to prevent the same thing from happening again, she gave each kwami to a permanent holder. Through Argos, Duusu also joins the team.
Former Allies

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Allies
Master Wang Fu/Jade Turtle — The former Turtle Miraculous holder and the Great Guardian of the Miraculouses. He founds the duo team when he realizes he can't defeat Hawk Moth on his own. Tikki officially introduces him to Marinette when she takes the Miraculous spellbook to him in Volpina, helping the team through information about their powers and whereabouts of their enemies. In "Heart Hunter", Hawk Moth and Mayura locate his whereabouts. He transforms into Jade Turtle to fight them but ends up being captured by them. In "Miracle Queen", Master Fu relinquishes his role as Guardian to Marinette, causing him to lose all of his memories about the Miraculouses. Through the many time hops in "Evolution", Ladybug and Rabbit Noir seek their former master's help in retrieving the current Fluff from Monarch.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Allies
Chloé Bourgeois — The teenage daughter of Parisian Mayor André Bourgeois. She usually gets saved by the heroes because of the multiple akumatizations she causes, but she has helped them on occasion, such as informing them about Vanisher's akumatized object in "Antibug" and assisting Ladybug in stopping the titular villain of "Despair Bear". After the events of "The Battle of the Miraculous", she is no longer a fan of Ladybug.
Ladybug Sentimonster - In "Ladybug", she initially worked with Mayura to trap Cat Noir and briefly fought against the duo until her real counterpart set her free. Grateful, she agreed to help them retrieve the Peacock Miraculous, but Mayura destroyed her.
Sentibubbler - In "Sentibubbler", he initially worked with Shadow Moth by taking Alya's family hostage to capture Ladybug and Cat Noir until Pegabug got a hold of Sentibubbler's Amoktized coffee cup, Sentibubbler sides with Pegabug and agrees to free Alya's family, but Shadow Moth destroyed him.
Temporary Allies

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Allies
Volpina — An akumatized villain who tricked Ladybug and Cat Noir into thinking she was the real Fox Miraculous holder and a superhero. With the use of her illusions, she made it look like she saved Paris from a meteorite and requested their help in stopping Hawk Moth, who appeared to be teleporting across Paris's rooftops. Cat Noir accepts her warmly, but Ladybug is suspicious and jealous of her. Once Volpina revealed herself to be an enemy, Ladybug and Cat Noir turned against her to revert her back into Lila.
Sentinino/Senticarapace - A Sentimonster of Nino Lahiffe, originally created to lure Alya Césaire into a trap, but when he was trusted with the Turtle Miraculous, he was used in an attempt to place surveillance on Ladybug to learn her identity. He helped Ladybee and Rena Rouge defeat Style Queen, before he was asked to give the Turtle Miraculous back, and having the ruse reveled by Ladybug, causing both the sentimonsters to be defeated.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Allies
Félix Fathom/Flairmidable - Adrien's cousin who poses as him when Ladybug gave him the Dog Miraculous. He helped the hero defeat Risk, but during the the fight against Strikeback, he used his power on Ladybug's Yo-yo, stole the Dog Miraculous, and traded Gabriel Agreste all the Miraculouses from the Miracle Box (sans the Ladybug and Cat) and his ring in exchange for the Peacock Miraculous.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Enemies
Supervillains/Vigilantes
Hawk Moth/Shadow Moth/Monarch — A mysterious supervillain and the Butterfly Miraculous holder bent on acquiring the Ladybug Miraculous and Cat Miraculous, with the aid of his akumatized villains, in order to get absolute power to make his dearest wish come true. While having mutual suspicions about each other, the team rarely meets him in person. After repairing the damaged Peacock Miraculous, he unified it with the Butterfly Miraculous to become Shadow Moth. After Flairmidable traded all of the Miraculouses from the Miracle Box for the Peacock Miraculous, Hawk Moth renames himself to become Monarch. In "Re-creation", he succeeds in getting the Ladybug & Cat Miraculouses, but chooses to save his assistant Nathalie and join his wife in the afterlife. In "El Toro de Piedra", it's revealed that he used to be part of the council of a secret organization, known as The Diamond, wanting to obtain the Ladybug and Cat Miraculous.
Nooroo — Nooroo is not willingly an enemy but is forced to help transform Gabriel into Hawk Moth. Nooroo is the kwami of Transmission.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Enemies
Akumatized villains — Ordinary civilians who are transformed into supervillains by Hawk Moth's akumas when they have negative emotions. With different desires and different powers, each villain does whatever they desire and pays Hawk Moth back by working to retrieve Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses, with the exception of Robustus who betrayed him by wanting a reality-bending wish for himself. Some villains have personal goals related to the team, including Copycat, Antibug, Volpina, and Prime Queen. After the villains' defeats, though, the team doesn't hold anything against the victims, even calming them down from the stress of being a victim.
Mayura — Hawk Moth's ally, who physically encountered the team in "Miraculer" for first time. Her actions not only prevented them from bringing Hawk Moth to justice, but caused some of the team's most powerful opponents. She later on retires as a supervillain after her used of the damaged Miraculous caused her to become too weak to hold a transformation and Hawk Moth manages to fix it to use it along his own Miraculous and become Shadow Moth.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Enemies
Duusu — Duusu is not willingly an enemy but was forced to help transform Nathalie Sancoeur into Mayura, Gabriel Agreste into Shadow Moth, now Félix into Argos. Duusu is the kwami of Emotion.
Sentimonsters — Living beings/Monstrous creatures manifested from people's emotions by Mayura's, Shadow Moth's, now Argos' amoks. With different powers, each sentimonster is created/born and is under the command of the one who holds the object containing their amok, usually helping Shadow Moth, Mayura, and the akumatized villains to fight the superheroes, Currently, they're in league with Argos for his own intentions. While most Sentimonsters are beings with no sentient behavior, some are in fact sentient beings that can be free if they get ahold of the Amokized object, although the Peacock Miraculous Holders are able to release them from existence.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Enemies
Félix Fathom/Argos - Despite not being exactly a super-villain (as his actions, despite villainous, were made with good intentions), he is sort of an enemy to Ladybug and her team since he is the one who stole Ladybug's yoyo with Fetch and gave it to Gabriel, allowing him to get the Chinese Zodiac Miraculous in the Miracle Box, in exchange for the Peacock Miraculous. Using it to transform into Argos, he intended to seize Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses for personal use. After backing off on his plan, in "Pretension" onwards, he changed his ways as in "Representation", Argos created Once Upon a Time to show Ladybug the truth about his and Adrien's origins, his betrayal in "Strikeback", and Monarch's true identity, in “Re-Creation”, he joins the French Miraculous superhero team.
Red Moon - A sentimonster created by Argos himself using his feelings of anger and hate. Argos created it so he cound have the power to make anyone under its light disappear and/or reappear by snapping his fingers. After seeing the error of his ways and realizing how dangerous the sentimonster's power was, having created it just to satisfy his need for vengeance, Argos released it from existence in tears.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Enemies
Shadybug - A supervillain from the Re-Verse who is the holder of the Ladybug Miraculous. At her home universe, she uses her power to fight against Betterfly, the holder of the Butterfly Miraculous, along with Claw Noir (the holder of the Cat Miraculous), in order to obtain his Miraculous and return it to the Supreme.
Claw Noir - A supervillain from the Re-Verse who is the holder of the Cat Miraculous. At his home universe, he use his power to fight against Betterfly, the holder of the Butterfly Miraculous, along with Shadybug (the holder of the Ladybug Miraculous), in order to obtain his Miraculous and return it to the Supreme.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Enemies
Chrysalis - Monarch's successor as the new holder of the Butterfly Miraculous and enemy of Ladybug and Cat Noir and their team. On her first move as the new holder, she tried to find Ladybug's identity by going back in time and then with that information steal the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses from her. However, her plan was thwarted by the joined forces of Chronobug and Bunnyx. Now, she resumes Hawk Moth's work of akumatizing people to get the Miraculous, however, without revealing any hint about her identity, being it her gender, age or even her villain name. Not even her akumatized villains know anything, as she masks both her appearance and voice when talking to them. The only person to know her identity is Tomoe Tsurugi, who is revealed as being an ally of her, even before Gabriel's defeat.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Enemies
Fury — A mysterious vigilante that carries out punishments towards people that abuse innocent people, using her power to immobilize others and then her super-speed to put them at dangerous/humiliating situations. Despite her targeting bullies and other bad people, she is considered an enemy by the Miraculers due to her actions having nothing to do with justice, especially after she caused one of her targets to get akumatized. They are uncertain if she is the current Butterfly Miraculous holder, but, unknown to them, she is one of their own.
Civilians

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Enemies
Lila Rossi/Cerise Bianca — A teenage girl, originally from Italy. She despises Ladybug after she exposed her lies to people she tried to impress. After she is de-akumatized from being Volpina, Lila refuses to accept Ladybug's apology and declares that they will never be friends. She later willingly allows Hawk Moth to akumatize her in order to get her revenge and indirectly helps him to get many people akumatized through her actions in her class. After being rejected by Gabriel (and by extension Monarch), Lila becomes determined to also get revenge on him as well. She is forced to drop her Lila Rossi identity after she is exposed by Marinette and Sabrina, revealing her lying nature to everyone, and, under her other identity, Cerise Bianca, she works in the shadows, manipulating Chloé Bourgeois to better inact her vengence on both Marinette, Ladybug and Monarch. Despite she failed to get her vengence on Marinette and Ladybug, she was able to get hold on the Butterfly Miraculous after Gabriel lost it and become its current holder.
Chloé Bourgeois - A French teenage girl and a former admirer and ally of Ladybug.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Enemies
After Ladybug refused to give her the Bee Miraculous multiple times, Chloé betrays her and joins Hawk Moth, who gives her the Bee Miraculous, along with the Miracle Box, he had taken from Wang Fu, all while akumatizing her into Miracle Queen.
When deakumatized, Chloé tries to use all the other Miraculouses, but her lack of knowledge prevents her from doing so.
As Ladybug becomes the new Guardian of the Miracle Box, she is able to recovers all of them from Chloé, who then declares to Ladybug that she's no longer her fan.
Their relationship continues to sour in “Determination”, where Chloé still blames Ladybug for losing the jewels, believing none of that would ever happened if she was still Queen Bee.
In "Collusion", with the help of Cerise ("Lila"), through Gabriel's manipulation, and after her father resigns as mayor, she took over his position becoming the interim mayor of Paris, effectively banning the heroes as outlaws.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Enemies
To where it ends in "Revolution", after allying herself with Monarch getting akumatized into Queen Mayor, receiving control over an army of Miraculous superpowered robots which she used to slowly remove all the obstacles to her permanent election and set a trap for Ladybug and Cat Noir with Shell-ters empowered with Resistance, leaving them powerless forcing them to detransform into their civilian forms with of all of Paris watching.
But what she didn't count on was Ladybug giving a speech to rally everyone, thanking them for their support and encouraging them to remain resilient in the fight against Monarch as well as empower everyone to stand up to her.
The crowd's decision to turn against Queen Mayor inspired the two duo not to give up, leading them to receiving their adult powers.
With the help of the Resistance, the heroes were free and then Ladybug purifies the Megakuma.
From her former idol, Chloé was going to receive a new Magical Charm, but is stopped by André Bourgeois, who promises to correct his own errors.
She later goes to London with her mother.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Enemies
The Kingdom - A covert council of twelve powerful individuals seeking the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses to create what they perceive as a "Perfect World." Due to Gabriel Agreste being part of it, known to his fellow members as "The Diamond", everyone in the council knew he was Monarch. Following the fall of Monarch, the organization remains active, operating from the shadows. Each member is identified by a symbol and has a codename. One known figure, Nathalie Sancoeur ("Shadow"), previously served as the shadow of Gabriel and now serves as the shadow of another council member called "The Machine", who also knows Ladybug's identity, but doesn't discloses that fact with the council. This organization is still unknown to the current Miraculous holders. After Gabriel's death, they welcomed a new member to become the new "The Diamond".
Camilo Pista/The Wheat - A member of the council of The Kingdom, being also Nathalie's father.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Enemies
Tomoe Tsurugi/The Machine - Kagami's mother, a tech business CEO and world champion in fencing. She made and alliance with Gabriel which was first believed to be a business deal, but she was later revealed to be aware of his secret motives and was a major part in his plan by creating and distributing the Alliance rings. She is also part of the council of After Gabriel's sacrifice, she took over his mission to get Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses. She is also an ally to Chrysalis, although it's unknown if the rest of the organization is aware of this.
Audrey Bourgeois - Mother of Noé Luxus, Chloé Bourgeois and Zoé Lee, head of the fashion magazine Style Queen and ex-wife to the previous mayor of Paris, André Bourgeois. She is part of the council of the Kingdom. Her codename is currently unknown.
Noé Luxus/The Diamond - Audrey Bourgeois' son and head of Luxus Corp., being a businessman from the luxury industry that holds a film production company, is a shareholder of TVi and wants to buy the Gabriel brand from Adrien Agreste. He is Gabriel's successor as the new Diamond in the council of The Kingdom.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Trivia
In early development, Ladybug and Cat Noir were going to be in a team with other types of superheroes called the Quantic Kids. However, the concept was scrapped, and Ladybug and Cat Noir were kept as a duo.
However, Ladybug and Cat Noir work with the canon version of a character from the Quantic Kids, Sparrow, alongside other heroes in Miraculous Adventures
The Ladybug Miraculous and Cat Miraculous are the most powerful Miraculouses while being opposites of each other, the former having the power of creation and the latter having the power of destruction. They also compliment each other though, forming something much more powerful.
In the "Ladybug & Cat Noir: The Movie", it was revealed that the greatest power between the two was love.
According to Victory, Ladybug and Cat Noir are the first superheroes that Paris has had in a long time.
Various people have done things to show recognition and appreciation towards Ladybug and Cat Noir:
A statue of Ladybug and Cat Noir, designed by Théo Barbot, is placed in the Place des Vosges and revealed in a ceremony in "Copycat".
Nathaniel draws a comic book in his sketchbook about Ladybug in "The Evillustrator".

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Trivia
In "Pixelator" at his concert, Jagged Stone dedicates a song to Ladybug, noting her as the girl who saved his life.
In "Lady Wifi" and "Antibug", Chloé cosplays as Ladybug with Sabrina as Cat Noir.
Life-sized cardboard stand-ups of Ladybug and Cat Noir are used with a donation box in the Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie in "Santa Claws".
In "Prime Queen", Nadja notes on Face to Face that many people believe that Ladybug and Cat Noir are a romantic couple. In a later episode of Nadja's series, Alya clarifies for everyone that they aren't together "yet".
Denis Damoclès is inspired by Ladybug, Cat Noir, and Knightowl to become a superhero himself, The Owl, in "The Dark Owl".
Alya keeps action figures of Ladybug and Cat Noir in her room, as shown in "The Dark Owl".
Clara Nightingale is inspired by Ladybug and Cat Noir to make her hit song, "Miraculous", in "Frightningale".
Adrien also keeps a pair of Ladybug and Cat Noir action figures in "Syren".
In "Reverser", Marc writes stories about Ladybug.
During the season 2 finale "Heroes' Day", the people of Paris include parade floats of the heroes.
In "Miraculous Shanghai", figurines of Ladybug and Cat Noir could be seen.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Trivia
In "Animaestro", Thomas Astruc creates a movie about Ladybug and Cat Noir.
In "Gamer 2.0", Manon has Ladybug and Cat Noir toy dolls, and Max Kanté creates a video game called Miraculous All Star Brawl using the Akumatized Villains.
In "The Puppeteer 2", the Musée Grévin wax museum has wax statues of Ladybug and Cat Noir.
In "Miraculous New York", the adult heroes dedicate an ice statue of them along with Uncanny Valley and Eagle.
In "Gabriel Agreste", Marc and Nathaniel were working on a love arc for their story of Ladybug and Cat Noir.
In "Rocketear", a sequel to Thomas' moving is in the making.
In "Simpleman", Manon and her friends have Ladybug, Cat Noir and Rena Rouge themed backpacks.
In "Determination", statues of the whole team were made.
In "Passion", statues of Ladybug and Cat Noir are seen outside of the movie theater.
Ladybug in "Chameleon" and Queen Bee in "Miraculer" were the first two team members to resist being akumatized.
Unlike Chloé, Marinette drove the akuma off before it affected an object of hers while Chloé did it after.
As of "Gang of Secrets", Alya is the first member of the team to resist Shadow Moth's akumatization while akumatized.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Trivia
In "Rocketear", Nino is the second member of the team to resist Shadow Moth's akumatization while akumatized.
Cat Noir holds the record for being affected by an akumatized villain the most with a total of twenty-four times.
Meanwhile, Ladybug holds the record where her powers had been used against her the least amount of times, with a total of six.
As of "Heartfixer" Adrien is the only member of the Miraculers that hasn't been akumatized yet (both completely or partially) in the permanent timeline.
He is the first person to only be akumatized in an alternate reality.
According to Thomas's tweet on "Cat Blanc", he also broke the record for the longest time a person has been akumatized with it being over the course of a few months.
As of "Heartfixer", Félix is the only member of the team who hasn't been shown in their akumatized form. If including alternate and erased timelines, Félix is only member of the Miraculers who hasn't officially been akumatized.
In "Guiltrip", Rose is the only team member to use a Miraculous while under an illness.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Trivia
Out of all the team members, Ladybug, Cat Noir, Carapace, King Monkey, and Ryuko are the only heroes related to their Miraculous predecessors origin wise.
Cat Noir, Argos, Ryuko, Vesperia, Queen Bee, Viperion and Purple Tigress are the only members of the team as well as in history who are/were biologically related to another Miraculous holder.
Cat Noir and Argos are maternal cousins and related to Hawk Moth/Shadow Moth/Monarch, Emilie Agreste and Colt Fathom.
Hawk Moth/Shadow Moth/Monarch is the father of Cat Noir, and the maternal uncle of Argos.
Emilie Agreste is the mother of Cat Noir, and the maternal aunt of Argos.
Colt Fathom is the father of Argos, and the maternal uncle of Cat Noir.
Tomoe Tsurugi is the mother of Ryuko. Ryuko is also the sister of Chrysalis.
Vesperia and Queen Bee are maternal half-sisters.
Viperion and Purple Tigress are twins.
Ryuko, Vesperia and Argos are the only members who aren't native to France, though Vesperia is part-French (due to her mother) and the family that Argos's mother comes from has a dual nationality of Britain and France.
Ryuko is the second member to have her identity revealed to Hawk Moth following Chloé.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Trivia
As of "The Ruler", Pigella is the only heroine not to have any member of her family appear onscreen.
Cat Noir, Lady Noire, Aspik, Viperion, Ryuko, Polymouse, Purple Tigress, Cat Walker, Rooster Bold, Kitty Noire and Argos are the only heroes whose eyes change upon transforming.
King Monkey (as of Season 6), Rooster Bold and Argos are the only heroes whose skin color changes color upon transformation.
Alix and Juleka were the only heroes to receive a Miraculous/become a Miraculous holder on their birthdays.
Ladybug, Ryuko, Argos and Bunnyx are the only Miraculers members whose families know their secret identities.
As of "Miracle Queen", Hawk Moth, Mayura, and Chloé learn the identities of all of Ladybug and Cat Noir's allies except for Vesperia, Pigella, Purple Tigress, Polymouse, Miss Hound, Rooster Bold, Caprikid and Minotaurox.
Chloé was akumatized, so it is unknown if she remembers their identities.
Also, as of this episode and "Revelator", Cat Noir knows the identities of all his teammates except for Ladybug, Scarabella, and partially knowing Sparrow's identity as Eagle.
This leaves Ladybug and Cat Noir/Aspik as the only team members whose identities are unknown to Hawk Moth.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Trivia
Due to Alix not receiving the Rabbit Miraculous until "Evolution", she is the only member of the team that didn't transform as her current self.
Because of her future alter egos, she is technically the oldest member of the team.
She set the record for the longest time a Miraculous holder can be transformed for a total of 5,000 years, because of being trapped in stone by Timetagger.
But as of the current timeline she is the third, with Luka being the oldest of the team, with Juleka being a few seconds/minutes younger than Luka and Alix being a few months younger than both of them.
Due to the time based powers of the Snake and Rabbit Miraculouses, Viperion and Bunnyx were the only members of the team that could use their powers multiple times before detransforming until "Revolution", when Ladybug and Cat Noir unlocked their adult powers.
Max is the only member of the team that doesn't give himself a superhero name. Instead, Max was called Pegasus by Ladybug,
Pegasus is the only member of the Miraculers that doesn't wear a mask when he transforms, considering that the Horse Miraculous takes the form of glasses (science-styled goggles starting from Season 6).

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Trivia
King Monkey and Argos are the only other hero who wasn't chosen by Ladybug.
Third and Fourth if counting Chloé and Luka as Ladybug intended not to give Chloé the Bee Miraculous but to Alya in "Style Queen" and Luka who was given the Snake Miraculous under Adrien's suggestion.
So far, Ladybug and Cat Noir are the only members of the team to use power-up potions and fusion forms which is succeed by Alix in "Evolution", fuses the Dog and Rabbit Miraculous teams.
In "Sleeping Syren" and "Miraculous Tokyo", it is revealed that Ladybug and Cat Noir gave power-ups to the other Miraculers, as Ryuko and Argos are shown to be using them.
According to Su-Han in "Furious Fu", the miraculouses were never meant to be used by children or teenagers, making Rooster Bold and Vesperia (and by extension, Ladybug, Cat Noir and the rest of The Miraculers) the youngest owners in Miraculous history.
As seen in "Optigami", similar to Rena Rouge, the rest of the team has been given their Miraculous back after the events of "Miracle Queen".

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Trivia
However, in order to protect her family, Rena Rouge stops fighting Shadow Moth at the front lines to start acting in the shadows to better protect her team from any traps from the villain or to follow him in case he appears in person at the battle.
Purple Tigress has the longest superhero name of the Miraculers while Ryuko and Argos are tied with the shortest superhero name of the Miraculers.
Cat Noir, Rena Rouge/Rena Furtive, Lady Noire, Pegasus and Rooster Bold are the only heroes whose hair grows longer upon transformation.
To go along with this, Queen Bee, Rena Rouge/Rena Furtive, Viperion, Pegasus, King Monkey, Vesperia, Polymouse, Lady Bee, Purple Tigress, Pegabug, Scarabella, Cat Walker and Rooster Bold are the only heroes whose hair changes color upon transformation.
Carapace, Ladybug, Cat Noir, Viperion, Ryuko, Vesperia, Polymouse, Scarabella, Flairmidable, Canigirl and Kitty Noire are the only heroes (even temporarily) to have Miraculous predecessors that are alive.
As of "Deflagration", Ladybug and Cat Noir are tied with the most successors: four.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Trivia
From "Strikeback" to "Re-creation", all members of the team were temporarily inactive, except for Ladybug and Cat Noir, as Hawk Moth managed to obtain all the Miraculous in the Chinese Miracle Box.
In "Evolution", the Rabbit Miraculous was retrieved back and given to present Alix, who remained inside the Burrow until Monarch was defeated.
The former members formed the Resistance to support the heroes.
When Ladybug needs help from another Miraculous, she chooses someone whose important person or place to them (family member, best friend, love interest, etc.) is in danger.
Alya was given the Fox Miraculous to become Rena Rouge when her little sisters, Etta and Ella, were akumatized.
Nino was given the Turtle Miraculous to become Carapace when Alya, his girlfriend, was captured by Anansi.
Chloé was given the Bee Miraculous to become Queen Bee when her father, Mayor Bourgeois, was akumatized.
Luka was given the Snake Miraculous to become Vipereon when Desperada attacked his friends and family.
Max was given the Horse Miraculous to become Pegasus when his mother, Claudie Kanté, was akumatized.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Trivia
Kagami was given the Dragon Miraculous to become Ryuko when her mother, Tomoe Tsurugi, was akumatized.
Zoé was given the Bee Miraculous to become Vesperia when her half-sister, Chloé, was akumatized and amokized.
Mylène was given the Mouse Miraculous to become Polymouse to stop Malediktator from destroying the park, a place she really loves and goes to often.
Rose was given the Pig Miraculous to become Pigella when her love interest, Juleka Couffaine, was akumatized and amokized.
Juleka was given the Tiger Miraculous to become Purple Tigress when her parents, Anarka Couffaine and Jagged Stone, were akumatized.
Sabrina, Marc, Nathaniel, and Ivan were given the Dog, Rooster, Goat, and Ox Miraculouses to become Miss Hound, Rooster Bold, Caprikid, and Minotaurox respectively when Chloé Bourgeois was akumatized once more and attacked their friends.
The exceptions to this rule are when Kim became King Monkey, as it was Master Fu and not Ladybug who gave him the Monkey Miraculous; and Alix becoming Bunnyx, in "Evolution", it's revealed that she was exception to the rule as she didn't get her jewel not only to protect her friends but the jewel itself.

title: The Miraculers
text:
The Miraculers - Trivia
Except Ladybug, Cat Noir and Argos, all of the other team members began as akumatized victims before they became heroes.
Scarabella made the most appearances out of all the temporary holders being followed by Lady Noire, Mister Bug and Kitty Noire.
It's implied in "Revelation" that Scarabella had made a few more off-screen appearances, as Alya said that sometimes her Ladybug superhero persona helps Ladybug. That, as showed by the episode, comes from the necessity of Marinette sometimes needing to be in two places at the same time, both as Ladybug and herself, or when she is unable to participate in the battles.
Marinette, Adrien, Félix, Mylène, Ivan, Alix and Luka, are the only heroes who don't wear Alliance rings.
Kagami, Félix, Alix and Luka are the only members who weren't part of the Resistance.
There are at least three sentimonsters on the team who are Adrien, Kagami and Félix.

title: The Puppeteer 2
text:
The Puppeteer 2 - Intro
"" is a season 3 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 21st written and produced episode of season 3. It is also the 73rd written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: The Puppeteer 2
text:
The Puppeteer 2 - Synopsis
Marinette tries to arrange some alone time with Adrien at the wax museum, but she's supposed to be babysitting Manon, who becomes Puppeteer again.
Disney Channel
Manon becomes The Puppeteer again; she is determined to have fun like never before in a unique playground: the Grēvin wax museum; Ladybug and Cat Noir cannot stand still if they want to stop her.
Disney+
Ladybug faces the Puppeteer again... at the Grévin wax museum!

title: The Puppeteer 2
text:
The Puppeteer 2 - Plot
Adrien practices his piano with Plagg until Nathalie comes in and tells him that it’s time to go to the Musée Grévin. Adrien asks if he can invite a friend, to which Nathalie agrees. He calls Nino and asks him to come. Nino agrees, but since he’s spending the day with Alya, he asks if he can bring her, too. Adrien asks Nathalie if two friends would be alright. Nathalie approves, but then Alya calls Marinette and asks her to come. Marinette wants to, but she can’t since she’s babysitting Manon. Therefore, Adrien asks to bring four friends (or rather, three and a half), and Nathalie tells him that she’ll see what she can do.

title: The Puppeteer 2
text:
The Puppeteer 2 - Plot
While in the Agreste car, Alya and Nino discuss their plan to leave Marinette alone with Adrien. Manon overhears and loudly asks why they want to leave Marinette alone. Adrien says that it’s because Alya and Nino are boyfriend and girlfriend and want to be alone for a while. Manon says that she always thought he and Marinette were boyfriend and girlfriend as Marinette has several photos of Adrien in her room. Adrien says that’s because Marinette is a fan of fashion, but Manon reveals that several hearts are drawn on them. Marinette denies that they’re hearts, claiming that they’re upside down spades. Marinette then covers Manon’s ears and scolds Alya for telling Nino about her feelings for Adrien, though Alya denies doing that. Manon asks what they’re talking about, to which all three say nothing.

title: The Puppeteer 2
text:
The Puppeteer 2 - Plot
The five friends arrive at Museum Grévin and are met by Véronique, who thanks Adrien for coming as one of the arms on his statue went missing. Manon is ecstatic at the thought of being in a museum after hours. She spots Jagged Stone and asks for an autograph, but he doesn’t reply. Manon almost gets upset until Veronique reveals that it’s only a wax statue. Manon is amazed at how real it looks.
While receiving a tour of the museum, Nino talks to Adrien about why they all came. However, as Alya had previously told him to deny everything Adrien asks, he unintentionally makes it sound like Marinette is mad at Adrien for some reason. Meanwhile, Marinette asks Alya why she told Nino everything. Alya denies that to be true and instead tells Marinette that she fixed everything up so that she can be alone with Adrien and finally confess her feelings. However, Marinette is too nervous to do such a thing, though Alya insists that today is the day. They all then enter the elevator leading to the museum's workshop.

title: The Puppeteer 2
text:
The Puppeteer 2 - Plot
Véronique shows everyone where the statues are made along with where the wax comes from. Adrien is then told by Théo to put his arm into a device that’ll create a duplicate out of wax and to not release it until the timer goes off. After Véronique leaves, Manon begins looking around and is surprised to find a wax statue of Nino, only to quickly discover that it’s the real one. Manon then asks Marinette to play with her, but Marinette says that they came to keep Adrien company, much to her disappointment. Alya and Nino decide to go with Manon and leave Marinette with Adrien. Marinette begs them not to, unintentionally upsetting Adrien. He asks Marinette if she’s mad at him. Marinette denies this, but her constant rambling makes Adrien believe that she’s lying. After she leaves to use the restroom, Plagg teases Adrien with an unfinished statue about how complicated girls are. Adrien tells Plagg to put the statue down before he Cataclysms it and wonders if he did something to mess up his friendship with Marinette. As the time to make his wax arm is completed, he decides to do something to repair his friendship and follows Marinette.

title: The Puppeteer 2
text:
The Puppeteer 2 - Plot
While chasing Manon, Alya and Nino come across statues of former akumatized villains, themselves included. Alya doesn’t like seeing herself as an akumatized villain, commenting on how unsettling it is. Nino tells her not to think of the statues as villains but rather people saved by Ladybug and Cat Noir. The two then playfully tease each other, and Nino chases Alya. Manon becomes upset that the two forgot about her and stares at a statue of Puppeteer, even grabbing her wand. Hawk Moth senses Manon’s sadness and sends an akuma after her. It enters the wand, and Hawk Moth offers her the power to play with the statues in exchange for Ladybug and Cat Noir’s Miraculouses. Manon agrees and is transformed into Puppeteer.

title: The Puppeteer 2
text:
The Puppeteer 2 - Plot
In the girls' bathroom, Marinette expresses her anger at not being able to tell Adrien how she feels. Tikki suggests that she roleplay and pretend to be a character who isn’t afraid of anything, to which Marinette agrees. Meanwhile in the elevator, Plagg asks Adrien why he cares about making friends, to which Adrien says that Marinette is important to him and wants to make her feel good when she’s around him. He decides to pull a little prank on her. When he sees Marinette, he pretends to be a wax statue. Marinette openly admires the “statue” and how much it looks like Adrien to the point where Adrien starts to feel uncomfortable. When Marinette leans in for a kiss, Adrien backs away and Marinette is shocked. Adrien apologizes for scaring her, stating that he only wanted to prank her, but Marinette claims that it wasn’t funny. Adrien asks her to forgive him, believing that he still doesn’t know how to be a good friend.

title: The Puppeteer 2
text:
The Puppeteer 2 - Plot
Alya looks for Nino and finds him in the Heroes Room. She sneaks up behind him and tickles him but is surprised when he doesn't react at all. She realizes that the statue of Lady Wifi has come to life and paused him. She attempts to run away, but the statue of the Bubbler blocks her path. She is then paused by Lady Wifi and trapped in a bubble by the Bubbler. Puppeteer then appears and brings more wax statues to life.
Adrien asks Marinette if she meant the stuff she said when he pretended to be a statue.
Marinette denies it and claims that she’d known it was Adrien, so she said that stuff as a joke.
The two are then suddenly shocked to see a living Hawk Moth statue which attacks the two.
Adrien uses the parasol on Aurore’s statue to fight him and tells Marinette to get some help.
However, Puppeteer goes on the speaker and says that no one will be leaving as she wants to play with them.
Marinette and Adrien realize that Manon was akumatized, so Marinette runs into an elevator and transforms into Ladybug.
Meanwhile, Adrien continues to fight the Hawk Moth statue until Ladybug saves him.

title: The Puppeteer 2
text:
The Puppeteer 2 - Plot
She tells him to go hide while she deals with the statue, so Adrien heads into an elevator and transforms into Cat Noir, who joins Ladybug.
He’s delighted to see that she caught Hawk Moth with her yo-yo until Ladybug reveals that it’s only a statue.
The two deduce that Puppeteer must be in the Heroes Room and head there.
After a close call with the Lady Wifi and the Bubbler statues, Ladybug spots Puppeteer and throws her yo-yo at her until she realizes that Puppeteer is only a statue.
She notices that the Puppeteer statue is missing its wand, and Cat Noir figures that’s where the akuma must be.
Suddenly, the wax statues come to life, and Ladybug and Cat Noir fight them.
While doing so, Cat Noir compliments Ladybug, leading Ladybug to ask him how he’s so easily able to tell his feelings.
Cat Noir says that it’s because he believes that it’s important to say such things.
Then, after noticing parts of unfinished statues heading down the stairs, Ladybug figures that Puppeteer must be in the workshop and heads there.
Cat Noir almost follows her, but he gets pinned down by a bunch of the statues, something Ladybug doesn’t see.

title: The Puppeteer 2
text:
The Puppeteer 2 - Plot
She unknowingly heads to the workshop with a Cat Noir wax statue.
Once reaching the workshop door, she calls on her Lucky Charm and receives a cardboard tube.
Unsure what to do with it, Ladybug bursts into the workshop.
Puppeteer mocks Ladybug, stating that while she has tons of friends, Ladybug has no one to play with her. Ladybug points out Cat Noir, but when Puppeteer tells him to attack Ladybug, he does so. Ladybug is confused until she realizes that he isn’t the real one. Meanwhile, Cat Noir manages to defeat the wax statues and is surprised when Ladybug attempts to kiss him afterwards. However, he realizes that she’s a wax statue and Cataclysms her before heading to the workshop.
Ladybug continues to fight the wax statues.
Though she struggles, she does manage to use her yo-yo to knock Puppeteer’s wand out of her hand.
She and Puppeteer both rush to grab it, but because Puppeteer has assistance from her statues, she gets a hold of it first.
She tells the statues to take Ladybug’s Miraculous while she enters the wax room.

title: The Puppeteer 2
text:
The Puppeteer 2 - Plot
The statues manage to overpower Ladybug and pin her to the ground, but before they can take her Miraculous, Cat Noir comes to the rescue and defeats all the statues.
Ladybug thanks Cat Noir and, after he asks about it, figures out what to do with her Lucky Charm.
As part of her plan, she and Cat Noir go into the wax room, and Cat Noir pretends to be a statue that caught Ladybug.
Puppeteer orders Cat Noir to take Ladybug’s Miraculous but is surprised when nothing happens.
Hawk Moth asks Puppeteer what’s wrong, to which Puppeteer claims that her wand stopped working.
Ladybug shows Puppeteer a counterfeit wand she made with her Lucky Charm and says that she switched her wand with a fake.
She threatens to break it, but Puppeteer reveals that she tied up some of the workers at the Museum Grévin and threatens to drop them into hot wax if Ladybug doesn’t return the wand.
Ladybug complies and gives it to her.
Puppeteer notices Cat Noir’s ring flashing and realizes that she’s been tricked, but by then it’s too late.
Ladybug knocks the real wand out of her hand and breaks it, releasing the akuma.
She then purifies it and uses Miraculous Ladybug to return everything to normal.

title: The Puppeteer 2
text:
The Puppeteer 2 - Plot
Hawk Moth swears that one day, he’ll be pulling the strings.
Véronique shows the finished Adrien statue to Adrien, Marinette, Nino, and Alya. Marinette notices Manon is missing and jokingly suggests that they check behind “the weird statue” of her. Manon, pretending to be a statue, startles the four friends, but ultimately they all have a laugh about it. Later, Alya and Nino are dropped off home first and then Manon. After Marinette brings Manon to her mother, Adrien opens the car door for her.

title: The Puppeteer 2
text:
The Puppeteer 2 - Plot
Once Marinette gets inside the Agreste car, she and Adrien simultaneously apologize to one another. Marinette apologizes for kissing his statue, claiming that she didn’t know it was actually him. However, Adrien insists that it was his fault, stating that he thought she was mad at him and that’s why he did the prank. Marinette says that she’s not mad at him and apologizes for making him think that. The two agree to remain friends and not to pull any more pranks. Adrien comments on how the girl he loves says that he’s no good at pranks, unintentionally saddening Marinette, who is upset to learn that Adrien loves another girl. Once she arrives home, she laments about the situation to Tikki, who points out that life is full of surprises. Marinette agrees, stating that kiss would’ve been a silly first kiss anyways before the end card appears.

title: The Puppeteer 2
text:
The Puppeteer 2 - Plot Developments
Marinette learns that Adrien loves some other girl, but she doesn't know who it is, unaware that it's her alter ego, meaning that he is in love with her.
As revealed by Plagg, another ability of a kwami is it that they can possess or inhabit objects.
Despite the akumatized villains being statues this is the first time where a civilian actually sees what they look like as their akumatized alter ego.
Upon Alya seeing hers and showing remorse could imply that she was told of her actions as Lady Wifi and possibly what could happened if she wasn't stopped prior to this episode.
This episode is after the events of "Feast", as Plagg and Adrien were doing a piano duo for first time in the aforementioned episode.
As of this episode, Nino, Alya, Chloé, Juleka, Mylène, Rose, and Alix know that Marinette has a crush on Adrien, with Chloé finding out in "Animaestro". Luka may also have inferred that she likes him in "Frozer", but it hasn't been confirmed as of now.

title: The Puppeteer 2
text:
The Puppeteer 2 - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in Switzerland on RTS Un.
This is the second time, Manon is akumatized into Puppeteer, following the former episode with the same name.
This is the third time Puppeteer appears after "The Puppeteer" and "Gamer 2.0".
Adrien is revealed to be proficient in pretending to be a statue.
SAMG Animation was not originally meant to handle this episode. However, due to ZAG wanting DQ Entertainment International Limited to perfect their technique and work with a wider range of visuals, ended up reassigning this episode to SAMG and "Cat Blanc" to DQ.
References
This is the third time Marinette and Adrien kiss, though it was unintentional.
She mentions having her first kiss with Adrien being silly, when actually in "Dark Cupid", she was completely unaware that she already had her first kiss with Adrien who is Cat Noir. It also happens again in "Oblivio", but their memories were erased.
Alya's promise to keep Marinette's crush on Adrien a secret, telling Nino about it, and getting upset with him when he slipped up, was first seen at the end of "Animan".
Marinette stating reasons why she's not ready to confess to Adrien is also reused from "Animan".

title: The Puppeteer 2
text:
The Puppeteer 2 - Trivia
In the same episode, Adrien tells Nino that Marinette will never fall in love with a statue, whereas in this episode, Marinette says that she was in love with Adrien's statue.
Adrien's knowledge about his photos in Marinette's room and believing it is due to her love of fashion was shown in "Troublemaker".
This episode also references back to what Alya said about Nino being a terrible liar in "Stormy Weather 2".
This is the sixth time that both Marinette's and Adrien's transformation sequences are absent, following "Mayura", "Weredad", "Kwamibuster", "Feast" and "Party Crasher".
Every villain first seen and fought by Ladybug and Cat Noir in Season 1 appears as a statue, with the exception of Copycat, Animan, Horrificator, Stoneheart, Pharaoh and Vanisher.
However, a mummy that accompanies Pharaoh does appear as a wax statue alongside the villains.
Adrien defended Marinette from the Hawk Moth statue the same way he did with Ladybug as his alter ego in "Backwarder".
Unlike the original "The Puppeteer", Cat Noir doesn't end up being controlled by Puppeteer, only a wax figure of him is, and he only pretends to be as a part of Ladybug's plan.
Allusions

title: The Puppeteer 2
text:
The Puppeteer 2 - Trivia
The statue pose Adrien takes is similar to Michelangelo's statue of David.
The hat of Franco-Belgian comic character Spirou is seen hanging on the shelf where Marinette knocks the bucket of wax eyeballs.
Errors
When everyone enters the workshop, the head statue of Thomas Astruc is not present, however when Théo and Nino are talking, it is present.
When Nino and Adrien walk through the museum, a statue of Sarah appears and disappears behind Nino.
After Ladybug saves Adrien from the wax statue of Hawk Moth, his hair is slightly off model.
When Ladybug throws the fake wand into the air, it returns to being a red stick with black spots.
The Antibug statue's yo-yo is miscolored.
In the workshop, Manon says "Let's go and play hide and seek and statues in the museum!". This is grammatically incorrect.
However, this is a typical speech pattern for children.
It's possible she meant to say she wanted to play the two children's games, "hide-and-seek" and "statues", instead of incorrectly saying that she wanted to play "hide-and-seek" with the statues.

title: The Puppeteer 2
text:
The Puppeteer 2 - Trivia
Even though Adrien took the wax Aurore Beauréal's parasol to fight the wax figure of Hawk Moth, the statue of Aurore is seen to still have the parasol.
Clara Nightingale's statue is not in the first scene where Ladybug fights the Puppeteer in the workshop. It suddenly appears after the scene where Cat Noir leaves the Heroes' Room.
After Cat Noir saves Ladybug in the workshop from the statues, the front part of his belt disappears for a short amount of time.
When Ladybug cuts the Hawk Moth statue in pieces, the Butterfly Miraculous is missing from its chest.

title: The Puppeteer 2/Transcript
text:

[ Theme Song ]
Plagg: Whoa! (hides in the piano)
Nathalie: (walks in) Ready to go, Adrien?

Nino: Sure thing, dude. I'll be right there— (sees Alya glaring at him) Uh, eh, actually, Alya and I are hanging together today. (Alya points at herself, then at Adrien) Wait! Do you think Alya could come too?

Nathalie: (nods) Hmm.
Alya: Hey, wait! (pulls out phone)
Marinette: Hey, girl.

Marinette: Ah! Wha! But! Nuh—!
Alya: There's no saying no. We're coming to get you now. You don't have a choice, girl!
Nino: (to Adrien) Do you think Marinette could come too? That way you two guys could—
Alya: Shhh!
Nino: Uh, you could... stare at the statues together! Marinette loves the... she loves statues! Which is perfect since the wax museum is, uh, full of them! (chuckles nervously, Alya facepalms)
Adrien: Can we make that... three?

title: The Puppeteer 2/Transcript
text:
The Puppeteer 2/Transcript - Intro
Nathalie: (rolls her eyes, but nods) Mhmm.
Manon: But Marinette! (holds up a drawing of herself) What about my superhero costume? (pouts) Hmph, everyone always forgets about me.
Marinette: Sorry, guys. I'm looking after Manon this afternoon. Go ahead without me.
Adrien: Would four work? Actually, more like three and a half.
Nathalie: I'll see what I can do.
Alya: (whispering to Nino) You leave Adrien alone, and then, I'll leave Marinette alone...
Manon: Hey! Why are you leaving Marinette all alone? Don't you like her?
Marinette: Huh, what're you guys talking about?
Nino: Nothing! It's got nothing to do with us leaving you and Adrien alo... (Alya elbows him) Uh...! To... look at the statues as, uh, just friends, of course. (laughs nervously, Marinette gasps)
Adrien: Don't worry, Manon. It's just that Alya and Nino are boyfriend and girlfriend, and they probably wanna spend some time alone together. Without us. (Marinette sighs with relief.)
Manon: Really? But I thought you and Marinette were boyfriend and girlfriend. (Marinette squeaks) She has lots of photos of you all over her bedroom.
Adrien: (laughs) That's because she loves fashion and I'm a fashion model.

title: The Puppeteer 2/Transcript
text:
The Puppeteer 2/Transcript - Intro
Manon: But then why are there so many hearts drawn on them?
Marinette: (laughs nervously) Those aren't heart! Those are, uh, upside-down spades! I was just coming up with some new, uh, patterns, for my fabric designs. (covers Manon's ears and leans towards Alya with clenched teeth) You told me you wouldn't tell Nino!
Alya: I haven't told him. Right, Nino? I didn't tell you anything. (elbows him)
Nino: She didn't tell me. And besides, I told her I won't tell.
Marinette: So you didn't tell anyone what Alya didn't tell you. Or did you?
Manon: What are you guys talking about?
Marinette, Nino, & Alya: Nothing.
Adrien: Hi, Véronique.
Véronique: Thanks for coming on such short notice, Adrien. I'm sorry, but a piece of your statue went missing yet again! (takes Adrien and his friends inside the museum) Just goes to show how popular you are.
Manon: Look Marinette, we get to go in, even though it's closed! It's like we're princesses. (Marinette is staring at Adrien, not listening) Hey! Did you hear me?
Alya: (to Nino) Be careful this time, right? Marinette's the only one that's gotta spill the beans to Adrien— not us! So no matter what Adrien asks you, just deny. Okay? (Nino nods)

title: The Puppeteer 2/Transcript
text:
The Puppeteer 2/Transcript - Intro
Manon: (runs ahead to the museum's lobby) Ahaha, wheee! (spots a statue of Jagged Stone standing on top of a statue of Fang, gasps) Mr. Jagged! Can you give me an 'autygraph,' please? (Jagged statue does nothing) Why isn't anyone paying attention to me today!?
Véronique: (laughs) That's because this isn't the real Jagged Stone. It's a wax statue of him. The Grévin Wax Museum is the kingdom of illusions!
Manon: Woah! But he looks for reals! (makes silly at faces the statue, then runs off again)
Véronique: (leads them further into the museum) The museum opened in 1882. We have about 200 wax statues on exhibition at any one time. We bring new celebrities in on a regular basis, the most recent one being Adrien!
Adrien: (to Nino) So if I've got this right, you and Alya wanna spend some alone time together, yeah?
Flashback Alya: So no matter what Adrien asks you, just deny.
Nino: Not at all! That's not why we came here at all.
Adrien: Oh! Well, then it's real nice of you guys to come here just to keep me company.
Nino: That's not why we came here at all, either!
Adrien: Really? So why did you want to come here then? Did it have something to do with Marinette?

title: The Puppeteer 2/Transcript
text:
The Puppeteer 2/Transcript - Intro
Nino: Uh, no! You've got it all wrong, dude. (Alya gives him two thumbs up) Not with Marinette, or with you, and even less with you and Marinette alone by yourselves! (Alya signals for Nino to zip his lips)
Adrien: I'm confused. Marinette wants to be alone with me?  (They enter a room full of statues of Parisian Celebrities, including: Sarah, Philippe, Clara Nightingale, Alec Cataldi, XY, Bob Roth, Jagged Stone, Aurore Beauréal, André Bourgeois, Audrey Bourgeois, Nadja Chamack, Mireille Caquet, and Prince Ali. In another section of the room are the statues of Adrien and Gabriel Agreste.)
Nino: (looks at Alya for help, and she gestures for him to keep going.) Marinette alone with you? Uh, no way, dude! You couldn't be further from the truth. It's the exact opposite, actually.
Adrien: Marinette doesn't want to be with me? (looks at Marinette sadly)
Marinette: Ah! Manon, come here! (runs off)
Adrien: Does she hate me?
Nino: No, no! Dude, she likes you a lot! I mean, no! I mean, yes? I mean... barely! She barely likes you a lot, so there you have it.

title: The Puppeteer 2/Transcript
text:
The Puppeteer 2/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: You sure? I'd be really bummed if I knew Marinette didn't like me. (Nino sighs and the group enters the elevator. Alya glares at Nino, who smiles nervously.)
Véronique: The museum opened in 1882. We have about 200 wax statues...
Marinette: Why did you tell Nino everything? You promised you wouldn't.
Alya: I didn't, I swear! Besides, even if I had told him everything, he would still be clueless. Ugh! Who cares anyway? I've set everything up with Nino, who doesn't know a thing, so you can finally pour your heart out to Adrien, girl!
Marinette: Wait, what?
Alya: We'll take off, leaving you two solo. Then you can spill your beans.
Marinette: Ah! Ahh! (Alya gives Nino two thumbs up)
Nino: (from a distance to Adrien) Not with Marinette, or with you, and even less with you and Marinette alone by yourselves! (Alya facepalms and signals for Nino to zip it)
Marinette: No! Not like that! I'm so not ready. I'd have to practice first, and wash my hair, and I'm not even wearing my lucky socks. (They walk into the room full of Parisian Celebrities.)
Alya: It's up to you, girl. But I'm just telling you: today's the day.

title: The Puppeteer 2/Transcript
text:
The Puppeteer 2/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (notices Adrien looking at her and gasps) Manon, come here! (takes off)
Manon: (points at statue of Nadja Chamack) Look, Marinette! My mommy's a famous person too.
Marinette: Yeah. Yeah, right. Okay. (takes Manon back to the group and they go into the elevator. Both Marinette and Adrien look disheartened.)
Véronique: Welcome to the workshop! This is where our sculptors create and repair all of our statues. (takes the group an adjacent room) And this is where we store our wax. It comes straight from our very own beehives up on the roof of the museum. (They go back to the main part of the workshop, where Théo is waiting.)
Théo: So I heard we have to do your hand again. Right, Véronique?
Veronique: (nods) Mmhmm.
Nino: (looking at a statue of Thomas Astruc's head) The beard's really well done.
Théo: It's genuine yak hair. (puts Adrien's arm inside a device and pours wax into it)
Véronique: (gets a phone alert) Okay, we have to leave you for a while, if you don't mind.
Théo: (places a timer next to Adrien) It'll ding when it's over. We'll be back as soon as possible.
Adrien: Take your time. (Véronique and Théo leave.)

title: The Puppeteer 2/Transcript
text:
The Puppeteer 2/Transcript - Intro
Manon: (looks at a row of statues, that Nino poses next to) Oh! I didn't know Nino was a famous person, too!
Nino: Boo!
Manon: (screams, then laughs) My turn! My turn! I wanna play statues, too! Marinette! (grabs her hand)  C'mon! Let's go and play hide and seek and statues in the museum!
Marinette: We can't, Manon. We came here to keep Adrien company. (Manon sighs. Alya winks at Nino, who nods.)
Alya: We'll play with you. Marinette, you take good care of Adrien. He must not get bored a single second!

Adrien: Are you mad at me, Marinette?
Marinette:  (knocks over a bucket of fake eye balls, picks them up) No! Of course not. Why would you say that?
Adrien: Because, Nino told me...
Marinette: I have no idea what Nino told you, but whatever he said, it's totally not true.

title: The Puppeteer 2/Transcript
text:
The Puppeteer 2/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Of course I like you... Well, like, uh, like! But, not like that! (chuckles nervously) What I mean is, you're not exactly a 'good friend,' you know?
Adrien: (saddened) Uh, okay... (Marinette groans) But then, if I'm not a good friend, what am I to you?
Marinette: You're... (struggles to get the words out) Toilets! I— I really gotta go to the toilet now. Eee! (runs out)
Adrien: See you later.
Plagg: (In wax head, making it float, speaking in a ghost-like voice) Oooh, Aadrieeen! What is it with the girrrls?? At least you don't have these kinds of troubles with cheeeese!
Adrien: (smiling) Stop pranking, Plagg. Put that head back down before you cataclysm it. (Plagg does so, then floats back over to him, laughing mischievously)

Adrien: (releases his hand, stands up) I gotta make it up to her. (heads out)
Alya: (in another room, playfully) Manon, where are you hiding!? (She and Nino walk in, and see the statues)

title: The Puppeteer 2/Transcript
text:
The Puppeteer 2/Transcript - Intro
Nino: Wow! (Manon poses beside Ladybug and Cat Noir to hide. Alya gazes at a wax statue of Lady Wifi, standing next to a statue of The Bubbler.) Excuse me, lady, what exactly is your superpower, making me fall super in love?
Alya: I don't need a super power for that. (pensively) I know that we're not really ourselves when we're akumatized, but it's... weird to see ourselves like that, as supervillians.
Nino: It's because you don't look at them properly. These aren't supervillains, these are all the people Ladybug and Cat Noir have saved.
Alya: You're right. (hugs him, he tickles her) Hey! What're you doing?
Nino: Oooh! I've been akumatized, now I'm Tickle Man!
Alya: (laughs) No, not the tickles! (runs away) Help! Ladybug, Cat Noir! (They run out, laughing)
Nino: (as they leave) I'm gonna tickle!
Manon: Come on, what about me!? Why doesn't anyone wanna play with me? (steps off the podium, sees a statue of The Puppeteer. She gasps, then giggles and grabs the statue's wand.)

title: The Puppeteer 2/Transcript
text:
The Puppeteer 2/Transcript - Intro
Hawk Moth: A little girl who feels all alone. Children cannot be disregarded. Well, she can count on me to give her my full attention. (A butterfly lands in his hand, he evillizes it) Fly away, my little akuma, and prey on her despair! (The akuma flies out).
Hawk Moth: (through his telepathic connection) Puppeteer, glad to see you again. So, no one wants to play with you, huh? I'm giving you the power to play with them!

title: The Puppeteer 2/Transcript
text:
The Puppeteer 2/Transcript - Intro
Plagg: Like, giving her cheese? (They exit, and go into the statue room full of Parisian Celebrities.)

title: The Puppeteer 2/Transcript
text:

title: The Puppeteer 2/Transcript
text:

title: The Puppeteer 2/Transcript
text:
