title: Thorn
text:
Thorn - Intro
is a minor character of Miraculous World: New York - United Heroez. He is a plant-themed superhero and member of United Heroez, a team of superheroes, that protects the United States of America.

title: Thorn
text:
Thorn - Appearance
Physical appearance
Thorn is a well-built man with yellow eyes. His skin is green in color with pink spots. His green-pink-yellow "hair" resembles thorns or flexible appendages.
As a superhero, Thorn is dressed in a green one-piece suit with pink decorations that may resemble creepers. On the suit's chest there is an oval sign with the symbol of creepers, surrounded by a green eight-pointed star with yellow edges. There are green, pink and yellow spikes around the arms and legs.

title: Thorn
text:
Thorn - Personality
Thorn's personality is not exactly known. In "Miraculous New York", he is brave and courageous. He is not afraid to stand up to fight the enemy to protect people. He is also loyal to other heroes. Given that he started playing around with his powers after being hit by Liberation, he is presumably normally very responsible and serious.

title: Thorn
text:
Thorn - Abilities
Thorn has the ability to create plant life, even from a surface that would normally be unable to support plant life, such as pavement. Thorn also has the ability to make the plant life rapidly grow to a gigantic size.

title: Thorn
text:
Thorn - History
Miraculous New York
Thorn is seen on the news with the other members of the United Heroez, where President Camilla Hombee/Victory makes a statement about the hunt for Techno-Pirate and postpones the French-American Friendship Week celebration ceremony. Later in Times Square, Thorn and the other superheroes surround Techno-Pirate, now Miraclonizer, who uses the Eagle Miraculous's power of Liberation to free all the superheroes from their ethical constraints, with Thorn's being to grow plants for the good of the health, not for the sake of rapidness.
Thorn then started using his powers to make plants grow all around, covering everything in plants. He is later seen chasing Sparrow, along with the other superheroes. Once he is freed from the effects of Miraclonizer's use of Liberation by Eagle, he attends the French American Friendship Week celebration ceremony. There Thorn watched as Snowflake made an ice statue of Ladybug, Cat Noir, Uncanny Valley, and Eagle as he celebrated them while on a huge rose created by him with Mercury.

title: Thorn
text:
Thorn - Trivia
He has similar abilities to Poison Ivy and Pixie Girl.

title: Thousand Delights restaurant
text:
Thousand Delights restaurant - Intro
The  is a famous Chinese restaurant in Shanghai, China owned by the famous and highly skilled chef, Wang Cheng. As stated by Cash, the restaurant is very successful.

title: Thousand Delights restaurant
text:
Thousand Delights restaurant - Appearance
Exterior
The building where the restaurant is located is made of red, gray and yellow bricks, slightly stretched and located next to a small round fountain. The restaurant is located on the ground floor. To his right are three large Moderna windows and a bay window on the left. Its entrance door is made of opaque glass and is located under a sign written in gold script. Part of the upper floors with yellow brick seems to be an apartment for Wang Cheng.
Interior
After passing through the front door, visitors enter a small corridor that precedes the door in the shape of a red moon, and then into the restaurant itself. The part accessible to customers has white walls and a red ceiling. The floor consists of both brown parquet and checkered tiles. There is a piano nearby. Customers get access to a counter with stools. Upon entering, there is a photo gallery of Wang Cheng's relatives. The restaurant has a separate room with a large brown round table with a raised grey turntable with white floral motifs, large white and red chairs and a TV.

The kitchen area is located just behind the counter, has a floor with slightly rounded blue-and-white hexagons and small red tiles. The kitchen countertop is equipped with a variety of electric stoves, several hoods, storage shelves, a clock and an electric panel.

title: The Supreme
text:
The Supreme - Intro
is the unseen overarching antagonist of Miraculous World: Paris, Tales of Shadybug and Claw Noir, Miraculous World: Tokyo, Stellar Force, and Miraculous World: Rio de Janeiro, as well as the overarching antagonist of Miraculous Stellar Force. He is an enigmatic entity who rules the world in the Re-Verse.
He gave Shadybug and Claw Noir their Miraculouses and Moddler his powers to use for evil. His origins and ultimate ambition are currently unknown.

title: The Supreme
text:
The Supreme - Appearance
Nothing is known about his appearance, but what can be said is his symbol looks similar to the Order of the Guardians and the Butterfly Miraculous.

title: The Supreme
text:
The Supreme - Personality
Not much is known about the Supreme except for what Betterfly, Shadybug, and Claw Noir have described: the entity gives Miraculouses only to those who are powerful or to those who have experienced the most pain. He never informed them that using their powers for evil would slowly destroy them, nor did he reveal the possibility of granting a wish by combining the powers of the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses. This behavior shows that he is manipulative and secretive.
Shadybug told Claw Noir that once she succeeded in retrieving the Butterfly Miraculous, she would be the one the Supreme spared. This implies that he isn't afraid to threaten or kill those who betray him, regardless of their previous loyalty, tricking them with empty promises of saving them from their afflictions.
The Supreme has demonstrated carefulness by blocking Plagg and Tikki from communicating with their owners or summoning Gimmi. This precaution prevents anyone from discovering the Ultimate Miraculous Absolute Power and attempting to use it to alter his reality.

title: The Supreme
text:
The Supreme - Personality
Similar to Monarch, the Supreme views the Kwamis as slaves meant to do only his bidding. However, his actions are more extreme; he placed a magical seal on Tikki and Plagg's mouths that rendered them unable to speak and caused them pain if anyone tried to summon Gimmi.

title: The Supreme
text:
The Supreme - Abilities
Currently, it is unknown who or what The Supreme is, but he appears to be an entity of immense and extraordinary power. He was able to cast a magical seal on Tikki and Plagg's mouths that prevented them from speaking and from merging into Gimmi, even in alternate universes.

title: The Supreme
text:
The Supreme - Relationships
Friends/Allies
Moddler
Moddler and The Supreme made a pact: The Supreme would give him the ability to get his hands on the Stellar Matrix and the Sprites, in exchange for his release by Moddler.
Enemies
Gabriel Agreste (Re-Verse)/Betterfly
It's known that in the past, the Supreme trusted Gabriel the Butterfly Miraculous to help him to perpetuate his power in their world, however Gabriel took advantage of this to steal both the Butterfly and Peacock Miraculouses for his own goals, which as consequence caused Émilie's death, much to Gabriel's grief.
Since that day, Gabriel decided to use the Butterfly Miraculous to fight against the Supreme and bring hope in Paris and created a Resistance to free their world. This decision angered the Supreme, who sent Shadybug and Claw Noir (who unknown to Gabriel was his son) to hunt down Betterfly and retrieve the Butterfly Miraculous. This was what made Betterfly to travel across worlds to find outside help to defeat him and also tried to convince Shadybug and Claw Noir to join the Resistance, as the Supreme was manipulating them and also was slowly destroying them by making them to use their powers for evil.

title: The Supreme
text:
The Supreme - Relationships
After visiting the Quantic Universe's Paris and a reformed Shadybug and Claw Noir joined Betterfly's team, the latter got renewed hope to defeat The Supreme and having a better world.
Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Re-Verse)/Shadybug/Ladybug
It's known that the Supreme took advantage of alternate Marinette's anger and sadness from being alone and bullied by Chloé Bourgeois to recruit her to his side promising that no one would hurt her again and she agreed, which led the Supreme to entrust her with the Ladybug Miraculous thus becoming a supervillain and relentlessly chasing Betterfly to retrieve his Miraculous and be spared by the Supreme.
However, unknown to Marinette, the Supreme neglected to tell her that using her powers for evil would slowly destroy her. That is the reason for the black veins that appeared on her neck.
While fighting Betterfly, she briefly considered his pleas that the Supreme was manipulating her but kept trying to steal his Miraculous.

title: The Supreme
text:
The Supreme - Relationships
In Marinette's room, Shadybug was shocked to learn that the Supreme hid from her and Claw Noir the Ultimate Miraculous Absolute Power, and immediately tried to use it to switch lives with her good counterpart, only to find to her shock and horror that the Supreme blocked their kwamis to prevent anyone else than him from changing reality, which resulted in the wish failing and her affliction worsening and soon Shadybug broke down in tears realizing the Supreme tricked her and she and Claw Noir would be soon destroyed.
After reforming and healing herself and Claw Noir with her Miraculous Shadybug, she decided to become a superhero and despite her worries about the Supreme's reaction to her and Claw Noir's defection, she willingly joined Betterfly's team to defeat the Supreme and free their universe.
Adrien Agreste (Re-Verse)/Claw Noir/Furry Paw
It's known that the Supreme took advantage of Adrien's sadness over losing his mother to recruit him to his side by entrusting him the Cat Miraculous to get back the Butterfly Miraculous, which was stolen by Betterfly (unknown to Adrien, that he was actually his father).

title: The Supreme
text:
The Supreme - Relationships
However, unknown to Adrien, the Supreme refrained to tell him that using his powers for evil would slowly destroy him.
And when fighting Betterfly, Claw Noir refused to listen to his pleas that the Supreme was manipulating him and only abused his powers. But soon, he began to realize Betterfly was right as he and Shadybug discovered that the Supreme also hid from them that fusing their Miraculouses would grant them one wish, and much to his shock and fear, when alternate Marinette tried to make a wish, they learned the Supreme blocked the kwamis to do so, to prevent anything other than him to alter reality.
After reforming, Claw Noir (now Furry Paw) joined Betterfly's team to defeat the Supreme and free their universe.
Stellar Force
TBA

title: The Supreme
text:
The Supreme - Trivia
His name is a reference to the French hip hop band Suprême NTM.
The Supreme had placed a seal on Tikki and Plagg to prevent anyone else, besides himself, from using the Absolute Power. This may indicate that The Supreme may have already used the Absolute Power in his universe or knew of it beforehand and, possibly, that's the reason why he managed to dominate the world and get almost all Miraculous.
According to Shadybug, up until her and Claw Noir's defection, the only two Miraculous that weren't in his possession was the Butterfly and Peacock Miraculous, which were stolen by Betterfly.
According to the Betterfly intro, Emilie, Gabriel's wife, used to be the holder of the Peacock Miraculous. It's unknown if she was chosen by him, the same way he chose Gabriel.
The Supreme's taking advantage of alternate Marinette and Adrien's negative emotions to get them to join him and retrieve the Butterfly Miraculous from alternate Gabriel, is similar to Monarch preying on people's negative emotions to turn them into supervillains to follow his goals of stealing the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses from the Quantic Universe.

title: The Supreme
text:
The Supreme - Trivia
The Supreme's symbol resembles a crossed out version of the symbol of the Order of the Guardians from the main universe.
Also both of them distribute the Miraculouses to people selected, however the Supreme does it to preserve his evil rule in the Re-Verse, while the Order of the Guardians distribute them for the greater good.
According to an interview with Thomas Astruc and Sébastien Thibaudeau, The Supreme was teased and will likely be used in the future, his story is already written but they don't know when he will appear.
It was later confirmed that he will be involved as one of the main antagonists of Miraculous Stellar Force.
However, it is unknown whether this is the same person, his version from the Quantic Universe, or a completely different person who just happened to take his name.
But on the other hand, if this is his version from the Quantic Universe and he made a pact with the Moddler for his freedom, that means he is bound by an unknown force that prevents from doing damage in this universe as opposed to the Re-Verse and he seeks the stellar matrix for his freedom.

title: The Ruler/Transcript
text:
The Ruler/Transcript - Intro
Nathaniel: ...So?
Aton: I love it. It's great but it could use some more...
Shirel: Seriousness? (She uses a ruler to straighten the lines on her drawing.)
(The camera cuts to Nathaniel's sad face.)
Aton: (attempting to defend Nathaniel) Darling, comics is an art as respectful as any other. (turns back to look at the comic) No. No, it lacks... sentiment, there!
Nathaniel: But the relationship between Rain-Piercer and Sun-Heart is pretty deep, isn't it?
(Nathaniel smiles and Shirel looks at him, displeased.)
Aton: No, I'm talking about real sentiment. For example in the next issue the two knights could fall in love with Deep Darkness.
Nathaniel: But she's the villain, Dad.
Aton: (exchanges looks with Shirel) Sure, but this way they fight each other so she could chose the bravest one of them. (drops the comic on the table)
Nathaniel: You think?
Aton: Of course! That's what people wants to see. Go tell your buddy Marc what I suggested. I can't wait to read the next issue.
(The camera points at Shirel looking at her work and finishing with her signature stamp. Nathaniel grabs the comic while looking at it with an uncertain expression.)
Marc: (slightly nervous)...So?

title: The Ruler/Transcript
text:
The Ruler/Transcript - Intro
Mrs. Anciel: This is the best script you've written to date! Sincere, moving.
Mr. Anciel: Especially the final scene when they take off their helmets to reveal each other's true faces. It's beautiful, Marc.
Mrs. Anciel: It's like you! It is you. It's obvious you wrote from the heart.
Mr. Anciel: We're so proud of you.
Mrs. Anciel: And we can't wait to see how Nathaniel draws this story.
(Mr. and Mrs. Anciel warmly hug Marc with a smile on their faces. Marc look at the script with a smile too.)[ Theme Song ]
Marinette: It's awful, Tikki. (she blows her nose again, making Tikki fly and stamp against a drawer) My nose itches won't stop running.
(Tikki peels off the drawer and flies toward Marinette.)
Marinette: What if Adrien sees me like this? He'll think I'm disgusting.
Tikki: Of course not, Marinette. Adrien loves you just the way you are.
(Marinette blows her nose again and sends Tikki flying.)
Marinette: ACHOO!!! I can't go to school like this.
Sabine: (off-screen) Marinette, you're going to be late!
(Marinette lies down on the floor in despair.)
Everyone: Wow!
Adrien: It's really incredible. Don't you think, Marinette?

title: The Ruler/Transcript
text:
The Ruler/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (covers her nose with her finger.) Yeah, right! You're so talented, Diane.
Diane: I just accidentally dropped the paint can and the spill made a portrait of Jagged Stone.
Alya: Super amazing.
(Marinette runs to hide before she sneezes while the camera pans to Marc and Nathaniel reading the script.)
Marc: So?
Nathaniel: This is really incredible but-
(The camera shakes at Marinette blowing her nose. Everyone flinches at the sudden loud noise.)
Max: Probably a jet plane. (adjusts his glasses)
Marc: But what?
Nathaniel: It's the reveal scene, when they show each other's true faces. I'm just not sure that's what people want to see...
Marc: (he grabs Nathaniel's arm with reassurance.) But if you draw from the heart, people will feel it.
Nathaniel: You sure? Because everyone is going to read that comic: our teachers, our friends... our parents.
Marc: My parents read it and loved it. They even cried!
Marinette: Someone cried?
Marc: In a good way. Don't worry, Marinette. We were just talking about the storyline of our next issue.
Marinette: What?! You already wrote the next story for Sun-Heart and Rain-Piercer?!

title: The Ruler/Transcript
text:
The Ruler/Transcript - Intro
(Everyone in the art classroom rushes to the table enthusiastically when they hear Marinette's announcement.)
Alya: For real?!
Rose: The latest issue was so awesome!
Adrien: We all can't wait to find out what happens next!
(Marinette wants to grab the script but Nathaniel keeps it away from her.)
Marinette: Can we read it? (quickly pulls away) No! Wait! I don't want to spoil the pleasure for myself. I'd rather wait until Nath has drawn it.
Marc: Well, actually Nath isn't a hundred percent sure everyone will like it. Maybe you can tell us what you think?
Marinette: (snatches the script from Nathaniel's hands) If you insist!
(The class start reading the script. Marc and Nathaniel looks at them expectantly.)
Marc: So?
Marinette: I love it!
Rose: The sentiment is so beautiful!
Adrien: It's as if everything Sun-Heart and Rain-Piercer confronted lead them to this final revelation.
Marc: You see?
Nathaniel: I know it's a good story. It's just...
Marc: You don't like it, do you?
Nathaniel: Of course I like it!
Marc: Are you sure? I don't want you to do it just to make me happy. Sun-Heart and Rain-Piercer is our story. Mine and yours.
Mylene: It's more than that. It's our story, all of us.

title: The Ruler/Transcript
text:
The Ruler/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Mylene is right. And you're the only person who can illustrate it.
(Marinette gives the script back to Nathaniel and he smiles.)
Nathaniel: Alright, I'll draw it.
(Everyone cheers and runs to hug Nathaniel. Marc looks at him from afar with a smile.)
(Snot falls from Marinette's nose and she quickly covers it.)
Adrien: Uh, are you okay?
Marinette: Yep! I'm great!
Adrien: Why are you pinching your nose?
Marinette: It's just uh- something smells awful, don't you think?
(Adrien sniffs at the air in confusion.)
Adrien: No, I can't smell anything.
(The bell rings)
Marinette: I got to go! Have a good nose- I mean, a good night!
Marc: It's okay if you change your mind, you know? I won't be mad. It won't change anything between us.
(Nathaniel smiles but looks back at the script before reluctantly giving it back to Marc. They exchange smiles before Nathaniel turns around and walks away. Marc looks at the script before frowning in disappointment and walking away too.)
(Nathaniel stops walking, turning around to chase Marc.)
Nathaniel: Marc! Wait! (he grabs the script from Marc's hands.)
(Nathaniel and Marc smile at each other before they hug.)

title: The Ruler/Transcript
text:
The Ruler/Transcript - Intro
Nathaniel: Something wrong, Ziggy? Are you sad about something?
Ziggy: No, I'm crying because it's beautiful. The final scene is so well written. I understand why you're scared; would a drawing ever be as powerful as this text?
Nathaniel: You're right, Ziggy. It's going to be a challenge, but I'll give it a try, and you tell me what you think.
(The visuals show what Nathaniel is drawing as we hear Marc's voice narrating the story.)
Marc: At last, the Deep Darkness was defeated, and the nine kingdoms were finally safe. Sun-Heart and Rain-Piercer's quest was coming to an end. It was time for them to say goodbye forever. But Sun-Heart couldn't bring himself to leave! He was starting to remove his helmet when Rain-Piercer warned him. If Sun-Heart showed his face, then the Great Rain would never let him wield the magical powers of the Secret Armor again! But Sun-Heart didn't care. He'd rather lose his powers then his partner who had been at his side through this entire journey. Rain-Piercer reciprocated, removing his helmet with passion, renouncing the powers of the Great Sun.
(The scene cuts back to Nathaniel, looking unsure.)
Ziggy: What is it?
Nathaniel: Something's wrong.

title: The Ruler/Transcript
text:
The Ruler/Transcript - Intro
Ziggy: Is it too beautiful for you to draw it?
Nathaniel: (he grabs the script.) No, that's not it, it's the ending. It can't end like this. They can't lose their powers, it's not fair.
(Nathaniel starts glaring at the ceiling to think. His face then lights up in new-found inspiration and starts drawing again.)
(Cut to a later scene - Marc is now in Nathaniel's room looking at the drawings.)
Marc: You changed the ending?
Nathaniel: You don't like it?
Marc: It's so obvious! How did I not think of it?
Nathaniel: I just followed my heart. Like you did when you wrote it.
Marc: It's the best thing we've ever made together.
(Marc and Nathaniel look at each other. Shirel suddenly knocks and opens the door, entering the room. Nathaniel quickly hides the pages under his folder.)
Shirel: You boys still haven't left for school? (she notices the drawings.) What's that? Your comic book stuff again? That's why you stayed in your room this whole weekend, isn't it? We're going to need to talk about this. All this nonsense is starting to become a huge distraction!
Marc: (stand up from the chair and defends Nathaniel) No ma'am. It's schoolwork. We have a group assignment due.

title: The Ruler/Transcript
text:
The Ruler/Transcript - Intro
Shirel: You do? Well, then I'm glad to see you two getting serious. Now, hurry up. You're going to be late for school.
(Shirel leaves the room. Marc turns around to talk to Nathaniel.)
Marc: I don't think your mom will ever like comics. Maybe we should keep this issue to ourselves. I don't want you to get in trouble because of what we do.
Nathaniel: No. You were right when you said this is the best thing you and I have ever made. Everyone's got to see it. Let's print it! (Nathaniel puts the pages in his folder.)
Marc: You sure? Are you ready to let everyone see it?
Nathaniel: Yes. What we've done is genuine. And when my mom reads it, she'll see how beautiful our story is. (he holds Marc's hand.) Beautiful and important to us.
(Nathaniel and Marc exchange smiles. Nathaniel pulls Marc playfully out of the room, leaving the script on the desk.)
Adrien: Uh, are you still smelling something awful?
Marinette: Um, yeah! Aren't you? (she pinches her nose and pretends to fan the smell away from her) Ugh, it's disgusting like some old cheese running in a dirty sock. Oh, look! The proofs are done!
(Adrien sniffs his jacket.)

title: The Ruler/Transcript
text:
The Ruler/Transcript - Intro
Marc: Wow! (him and Nathaniel grab the color proofs from the printer.)
Nathaniel: The color settings are perfect!
Jean: So, we can start the final printing.
(Marc and Nathaniel nod at each other. Nathaniel stands up to throw the proofs in the trash can.)
Marinette: Hey! Why are you throwing them away?!
Nathaniel: They're just proofs, Marinette. We only needed them to adjust the print settings.
Marinette: No! (she moves the trash can away.) They're too good. Can I keep them? I'll put them in my room!
(Nathaniel gives the proofs to Marinette.)
Nathaniel: If it makes you happy.
Marinette: Could you both sign them?
(Nathaniel and Marc sign the paper. Jean puts the already printed comics on the table.)
Jean: This time we'll distribute your comic everywhere.
(Everyone cheers at the announcement.)
Adrien: Plagg, did you secretly bring camembert to school? You know how stinky it is.
Plagg: Me? How can you accuse me of such a thing?
(Adrien cross his arms, glaring at Plagg.)
Plagg: Oh, alright. It might have happened before in the past but not this time!
Adrien: So... do I smell like camembert?
Plagg: I wish you did...
(Adrien angrily stares at Plagg for his petty remark)

title: The Ruler/Transcript
text:
The Ruler/Transcript - Intro
Shirel: Care to explain? (she holds the script in her hand.)
(Nathaniel gasps in shock.)
Shirel: Were you planning on drawing this?!
Nathaniel: No...
Shirel: Did your friend write this story?!
Nathaniel: Yes. That's what you wanted, isn't it? Genuine sentiment?
Shirel: There's nothing genuine in there! (she glares at Aton.) See what encouraging him to read comics leads to?!
Nathaniel: Is this about the final reveal scene?
Shirel: Your friend is free to imagine whatever he wants. But you mustn't waste your talent on it! There are a lot of noble arts: architecture, industrial design, scenography! You can do anything you want except this! This comic book phase of yours is over. And if you ever disobey me, I'll have no choice but to forbid you from seeing Marc again!
(Shirel grabs the script from the coffee table and puts it in the shredder. Nathaniel starts to cry.)
Shirel: I'm doing this for your future! (she leaves the room.)
Aton: (remorsefully) I told you that's not what people want to see... (he leaves the room too.)
(Nathaniel steps backwards into the hall, back against the wall as he cries while covering his face. He then starts running out of the apartment.)
Nathaniel: Wait!

title: The Ruler/Transcript
text:
The Ruler/Transcript - Intro
Fred: Nathaniel? What are you doing here?
Nathaniel: I left something inside! I'll only be a minute!
Ziggy: What are you going to do?!
Nathaniel: No one can see this. It was a mistake.
Ziggy: (gasps) I thought you were happy with the results.
Nathaniel: I was wrong. Ziggy, bleat it! (transforms into Caprikid)
Caprikid: Genesis! (uses his power to draw and create an industrial shredder, destroying all of the comic books with it. He then remembers the color proofs he gave to Marinette.)
Caprikid: (gasps) Marinette!
Marinette: But why would you want to destroy them?!
Nathaniel: I'm done with comic books.
Marinette: No, Nath! Comic books are- Hold on! (she turns around to blow her nose. The camera shakes again.)
Nathaniel: So- you were the jet plane?
Marinette: The jet plane? Ugh, anyway- Please, don't tell Adrien. I was saying that comic books are so you.
Nathaniel: You're only saying that because that's all I've ever done. But if I do something else, I can become someone else.
Marinette: But that's not how it works.
Nathaniel: Marinette, please respect my choice.

title: The Ruler/Transcript
text:
The Ruler/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Okay, I'll respect it. But you might regret that choice tomorrow or the day after tomorrow, or in a few weeks! You might one day and that day you'll be sad that you destroyed all the pages, don't you think? Let me keep them safe, just in case. I promise I won't show them to anyone.
(Nathaniel looks at her and nods. Marinette quickly runs to hug him.)
Marinette: What are you going to tell Marc?
(Nathaniel's face becomes sadder.)
Marc: You can't be serious.
Nathaniel: I'm sorry...
Marc: Nath, I know you. Even if you stop, you'll keep drawing comics in your head!
Nathaniel: I won't. Besides, that's my problem. This way at least- you and I can still be friends.
Marc: (he grabs Nathaniel's hands) My friend draws from the heart. He doesn't give up on his passion. My friend doesn't hide who he really is.
Nathaniel: (reluctantly) I'm sure you'll find another illustrator...
(Marc flinches to catch Nathaniel as he runs away but can only look at him sadly.)
Marinette: Huh? Tomato plants cry when you cut them? (Her nose starts running and she runs away into the greenhouse, blowing her nose and causing the camera to shake again.)
Max: Another jet plane?
Marinette: Marc?

title: The Ruler/Transcript
text:
The Ruler/Transcript - Intro
(She walks over to him.)
Marinette: Are you crying because of Nath? (hands him a tissue) I'm sure he'll change his mind when he's ready.
Marc: (wipes his eyes) For that to happen, he'd need to change parents too...
Marinette: (Looks out the window and sees Nathaniel and his mom in the courtyard) Or his parents are the ones who need to change!
Ms. Jinet: He seemed really unwell. I thought it best to call you.
Shirel: You did the right thing. We'll go see the doctor, thank you.
(Ms. Jinet is taken away by her helper as Marinette runs into the courtyard)
Marinette: Nath, wait! Since you quit illustrating comics, you won't be drawing the ending to Sun-Heart and Rain-Piercer! So, I wanted to ask you would you mind if I, did it?
Shirel: Of course he doesn't mind!
Nathaniel: But... do you know how to illustrate comics?
Marinette: Uh, sure! It'll never be as good as it would if you'd done it though.
Shirel: Nathaniel has decided to focus on more serious art. He doesn't have time for this nonsense anymore!
Marinette: Nonsense?! His and Marc's comic book is a masterpiece!
Shirel: Let's not get carried away. If comics were a real art form they'd be exhibited at the Louvre.

title: The Ruler/Transcript
text:
The Ruler/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Maybe your son's talent could change people's minds.
Shirel: Enough! Comics have no future. They're just basic graffiti with meaningless stories.
(As Shirel speaks, several students on the rooftop watch the confrontation. Marc, who is also watching the confrontation, has a dejected expression on his face)
Marinette: You wouldn't say that if you'd had a chance to read the ending of Sun-Heart and Rain-Piercer!
Shirel: Well, we'll never know since he never drew it, right?
(She looks at Nathaniel, who's looking down)
Shirel: Nathaniel?
(He gives her an angry and defiant stare)
Shirel: You did! You drew that rubbish when I had forbidden you to do it! (Nathaniel continues to stare angrily at her as Marc runs down the stairs) I won't let you ruin your future. We'll get you straightened out, believe you me! (She grabs Nathaniel's wrists and starts dragging him out of school)
Nathaniel: Let go of me!
Marc: What's going on?!
Marinette: I wanted to make things better, but I think I just did the complete opposite!
(Marc runs off to follow Nathaniel while Marinette sees an Ultrakuma go into one of Shirel's earrings)
(Shirel is sitting and drawing in a purple space)

title: The Ruler/Transcript
text:
The Ruler/Transcript - Intro
Chrysalis: (appears next to her victim) Hello. Forgive my intrusion. I heard the fear of a mother whose son is going off the rails. (takes the ruler out of Shirel's hair) Do you wish to set things straight again? Being able to convert your son to match your vision of the world, along with anyone who tried to steer him in the wrong direction? I can give you that power, only if you agree of course.
Shirel: (Stands up) For his own good, I do!
Chrysalis: And what should I call you?
Shirel: The Ruler!
(Chrysalis closes her palm)
(Marinette rushes off and goes into a random room inside. She shuts the door)
Tikki: Nathaniel's mom looked really, really angry!
Marinette: Time to talk some sense into her. Tikki, spots- achoo! (her nose starts running) Tikki, spots on... (transforms into Ladybug)
(Back in the courtyard, Ruler raises her weapon while Nathaniel struggles to break free from her hold)
Ruler: You'll never make comic books again!
(Marc jumps onto Ruler's back, making her let go of Nathaniel)
Marc: Let him go! He's done nothing wrong!

title: The Ruler/Transcript
text:
The Ruler/Transcript - Intro
Ruler: (Spins around, throwing Marc, who hits a bench) You... you're the one who convinced him to make comic books! You'll never get near my son again! (she puts a stamp on Marc with her ruler)
Nathaniel: (gasps) Marc!! (The Ruler grabs his wrist again)
Marc: (wide-eyed and with a robotic voice) Don't get near me. I don't know you.
Nathaniel: No!
Marc: (walks away) (robotic voice) Don't get near me. I don't know you. Don't get near me. I don't know you.
Ruler: You're next. (lets go of him) You'll finally obey your mother!
Nathaniel: Taking it out on me is one thing. But him... you shouldn't have done that.
(Ladybug appears, wrapping her Yo-yo around The Ruler's weapon)
Ladybug: Nathaniel Kurtzberg, if you want to help me get somewhere safe!
(Nathaniel nods and starts running into the school. The Ruler tries following him, but Ladybug makes her trip with her yo-yo before jumping in front of her)
Ziggy: Are we really about to confront your mother?!
Nathaniel: Yes, I'm ready. I'm done hiding.
[Transformation Sequence]
Nathaniel: Ziggy, bleat it! (transforms into Caprikid)
Ruler: Get out of my way! I need to find my son!

title: The Ruler/Transcript
text:
The Ruler/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: Think for a second what you're doing! Don't you want your son to be happy?
Ruler: I'm doing this for his own good, so that he doesn't suffer in the future.
Caprikid: He's already suffering now because of your actions! Genesis! (He draws and creates a bag full of markers, putting the bag on and throwing markers at The Ruler)
(The Ruler blocks the markers with her shield and starts to run away)
Caprikid: Ladybug, the ultrakuma's in her earrings, under her helmet!
Ladybug: Got it, Caprikid!
(Caprikid runs out of markers to throw, while Ladybug's sneak attack from the side is blocked by the villain)
Caprikid: Genesis! (He draws and creates a giant pencil. He then throws the pencil at The Ruler, but it gets cut in half by her sword)
Ladybug: We have to destroy all her gear piece by piece.
Cat Noir: Luckily for you m'lady, that's my specialty. A-meow-zing aren't I?! (He jumps down and starts fighting The Ruler) Cataclysm!
(Cat Noir's power destroys The Ruler's shield but she's quickly able to stamp him and put him under her control)
Ladybug and Caprikid: No!
Chrysalis (voice): Ask him to get Ladybug's magic earrings.
Ruler: Cat Noir bring me the ladybug's jewels!

title: The Ruler/Transcript
text:
The Ruler/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: (robotic voice) Must cataclysm Ladybug! Must cataclysm Ladybug! (He starts chasing after her)
Ladybug: I liked it better when you were making puns, kitty cat!
Cat Noir: (robotic voice) Must cataclysm Ladybug!
(Ladybug swings onto the school's roof to hide from him)
Cat Noir: (robotic voice) Must cataclysm Ladybug! Must cataclysm Ladybug!
(Ladybug's nose starts running again, she holds in her sneeze to not give herself away)
Cat Noir: (robotic voice) Must cataclysm Ladybug! (runs away) Must cataclysm Ladybug!
[Superpower Sequence]
Ladybug: Lucky Charm! (She gets a rope.)
(Her vision eyes the rope, The Ruler's weapon, and Caprikid who's currently fighting the villain using an art palette as a shield)
Ruler: I want my son!!
Caprikid: Your son doesn't belong to you!
Ruler: You don't get it! I'm trying to protect him!
Caprikid: You're not protecting him, you're deciding for him! (he draws a line with his Paint Brush to create a giant rubber to use as a shield)
Ruler: I'm his mother!
Caprikid: Mothers want their children to be happy, but you're making him unhappy!
Ruler: (cuts through the rubber with her weapon) It's not your son so be silent!

title: The Ruler/Transcript
text:
The Ruler/Transcript - Intro
(Ladybug slides in, grabs Caprikid, and swings away to a different area)
Ladybug: We'll turn her weapon against her to force her to remove her helmet. Can you draw something for me to catch her?
Caprikid: Mm-hmm! Genesis! (he draws and creates a carabiner. Ladybug hands him the rope.)
Ladybug: I'll go first to create a diversion.
(Ladybug goes back to the front of the school, jumping in front of The Ruler while Caprikid hides on the roof. Cat Noir then appears behind a bush and extends his Staff to push Ladybug into The Ruler's weapon. She gets a stamp as she screams)
Chrysalis (voice): Now Ruler, demand Ladybug and Cat Noir hand over their miraculous.
Ruler: Time to bring them back on the straight and narrow!
(Caprikid uses the rope attached to the carabiner to latch onto The Ruler's weapon, jumping onto her armor)
Caprikid: Now it's your turn to show your true face, Ruler! (He jumps off and takes the weapon away from her, using it himself to put a stamp on her) Ruler, take off your helmet and break your earrings.
Ruler: At your command. (she takes her helmet off and grabs onto her earrings)
Chrysalis (voice): No, don't do it!

title: The Ruler/Transcript
text:
The Ruler/Transcript - Intro
(The Ruler throws her earrings on the floor and crushes them under her foot, releasing the Ultrakuma and turning her back into Shirel)
Caprikid: Ladybug, toss the lucky charm into the air and say Miraculous Ladybug!
[Superpower Sequence]
Ladybug (robotic voice): Miraculous Ladybug! (She throws the rope into the air, and ladybugs shoot out of it, reversing the damage done by The Ruler, including the control put on her, Cat Noir, and Marc.)
Ladybug: No more evil doing for you, ultrakuma! (She opens up her yoyo.) Time to de-evilize! (She catches the ultrakuma.) Gotcha! Bye bye, little butterfly! (She releases the butterfly)
Shirel: What happened?!
Ladybug: Children must follow their own path, not a path that is planned for them. (She creates and gives a Magical Charm to Shirel) This magical charm will help you remember that.
Ladybug, Cat Noir, and Caprikid: Pound it!
Adrien: Marinette, good news. You won't be bothered by the bad smell again!
Marinette: (pinches her nose) Woah-! What happened to you? Did somebody pour an entire bottle of perfume on you?!
Adrien: Three bottles to be exact!
Marinette: Three bottles!? But why did you do that?

title: The Ruler/Transcript
text:
The Ruler/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: You've been avoiding me for several days now because it seems I smell like cheese, so...
Marinette: No, Adrien, you don't smell like cheese it's just...
Adrien: What? You know you can tell me anything, don't you?
Marinette: The truth is...(holding in her sneeze) I can't blow my nose in front of you!
Adrien: Huh? Why not?
Marinette: Because I'm very loud!
Adrien: I don't care about that! You blow your nose anytime you need too.
Marinette: You'll still love me, right?
Adrien: Of course!
(Marinette blows her nose, shaking the screen again as it sends Adrien back against the balcony rails and messes up his hair)
Marinette: Aah! Are you okay? Do- do you still love me?!
Adrien: (speaking loudly) What did you say?
Marinette: Oh no! I'm so ashamed!
Adrien: (laughs) I'm teasing you. I love you just the way you are Marinette Dupain-Cheng, so please don't try to be someone else, especially someone with a quieter nose.
(Marinette puts the snot back up in her nose, causing both her and Adrien to laugh)
Cerise: (unsure) Nathaniel Kurtzberg... what's your true face?

title: The Ruler/Transcript
text:
The Ruler/Transcript - Intro
Aton: (puts the comic book on the table) Woah... there are some really strong sentiments here alright, and I wouldn't change a thing.
(Nathaniel and Marc smile, but then frown again as they look at Shirel)
Shirel: (Looks at the comic book, Ladybug's magical charm, and both boys in front of her) Now I finally see it. You've really poured your heart into it. I'm sorry, and I love you.
(Nathaniel goes up and hugs his parents. Aton pats the seat next to him and Marc joins them)
Marc: I never thought making a comic would have such an impact on real life. We were attacked for it.
Nathaniel: When we were just talking about love.
(Marc moves closer to Nathaniel as both boys start leaning on each other)
Marc: Do you think Deep Darkness will come back?
Nathaniel: That or something else. The great hate hasn't been defeated. There will always be someone to summon it.
Marc: At least thanks to your new ending, Rain-Piercer and Sun-Heart will still have their powers.
Nathaniel: They can continue the fight!
Marc: Kind of like us! Except, we don't have powers, obviously...
Nathaniel: Power or no power, I'll always be there to protect you. (caresses Marc's cheek)

title: The Ruler/Transcript
text:
The Ruler/Transcript - Intro
Marc: (warmly takes his hand) Same here. But promise me you'll never put yourself in danger for me. You're not a superhero.
(Moved by Marc's concern, Nathaniel thinks about his words and stares at him with a "I can't believe what I'm about to do" look)
Nathaniel: (reluctantly) Ziggy, bleat it.
(Marc gasps silently as he covers his mouth in shock at Nathaniel's transformation as he and Caprikid silently stare at each other)
Caprikid: (flustered) Well I uh- say something...
(Touched by this revelation, Marc laughs a little as he removes his hands from his mouth)
Marc: Orikko, Sunrise.
(As Marc transforms into Rooster Bold off-screen, we end on Caprikid's excited smile.)
es:Estricta/Transcripción

title: The Vampire Horrific Musical Show
text:
The Vampire Horrific Musical Show - Intro
, also called The Vampire Musical Horrific Show, is an immersive horror musical film with a cult following. To commemorate its golden 50th anniversary, a special screening was held at Le Sorbonne in Paris.

title: The Vampire Horrific Musical Show
text:
The Vampire Horrific Musical Show - Description
The film features vampire-themed horror with touches of romance and bat imagery, presented in an immersive style that encourages audience participation.

title: The Vampire Horrific Musical Show
text:
The Vampire Horrific Musical Show - Viewers
Marinette Dupain-Cheng (pre-movie only)
Adrien Agreste
Johnny Grassette (many times)
Gabrielle Grassette (many times)
Nathalie Sancoeur (when she was younger)
Rose Lavillant
Prem
Juleka Couffaine
Cerise Bianca (unknown identity; pre-movie only)

title: The Vampire Horrific Musical Show
text:
The Vampire Horrific Musical Show - Trivia
The film is also a musical, and is most likely based on The Rocky Horror Picture Show.
Like Rocky Horror, the movie is a musical; has gained a cult following; screenings of the movie encourage wearing costumes and audience engagement; and the plot includes rainy scenes and a romance between the two protagonists. Additionally, at the time of Vampigami's release, Rocky Horror was celebrating the 50th anniversary of its release, just like the movie in the episode.
It may also be inspired by Dracula, the Musical or Dance of the Vampires.
André Bourgeois presents the beginning of the film himself, promising the viewers a longer, unseen version with 30 extra minutes.
The movie has garnered a cult following. Johnny, Gabrielle, Prem and Rose are shown to be enthusiastic fans of the movie. Rose calls it her favorite movie.
The show has immersive elements where the viewers participate:
Viewers use squirt guns to mimic rain during rainy scenes.
This is also common in screenings of Rocky Horror.
They throw paper planes when bats are flying.
They kiss as the two heroes declare their love for each other. Adrien's paternal grandparents shared their first kiss this way.

title: The Vampire Horrific Musical Show
text:
The Vampire Horrific Musical Show - Trivia
When the vampire places his hands on a character's shoulders, viewers grab the shoulders of the person in front of them.
Viewers may wear costumes and makeup. Whilst the school students, Adrien's grandparents, Cerise and a few others wore makeup, some only showed up in costumes.
A famous dialogue from the show is imitated twice:
[Character 1]: "Those are lovely fangs you got!"
[Character 2]: "Bite me tender!"
Tickets for the show sold out in one minute, according to Rose.
Ray, however, gets two tickets for Nelson's scheme to break up Rose and Juleka, reflecting how ticket scalpers buy en masse and resell at high prices.
It is revealed that Nathalie had seen the film when she was younger. She did not disclose this information to Adrien or Marinette.
Marinette is scared to watch the movie because she dislikes horror movies, but is hesitant to admit it because she fears Adrien will not love her anymore if they don't share the same interests. She eventually comes to her senses in the end and gives Juleka her ticket instead.
This is Adrien's first horror movie.
It is also likely the first movie he sees with his newly befriended grandparents.

title: The Vampire Horrific Musical Show
text:
The Vampire Horrific Musical Show - Trivia
Count Vampigami interrupts the movie presentation with his akumatization. The movie later continues after he is defeated.
It is unclear if Cerise goes to see the movie out of genuine interest or purely because of her plan to unmask Ladybug.
If it is the latter, then it suggests that she is indeed hiding in plain sight within Marinette's friend group, or has a spy feeding her information.

title: The Theater
text:
The Theater - Intro
"" is the twenty-third episode of Miraculous Chibi.

title: The Theater

title: Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie
text:
Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie - Intro
The  (or Dupain-Cheng bakery) is a bakery owned by Tom Dupain and Sabine Cheng, located on 12 Rue Gotlib in the 21st arrondissement of Paris, France.

title: Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie
text:
Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie - Appearance
Entrance
The entrance to the bakery features white walls with white rectangles slightly outset from the walls, outlined in gold. The windows are tinted dark black with capital letters in gold. Six of the windows (appearing in pairs) have a golden design, each depicting a peel, grains of wheat, and a croissant as the logo. In the center of two of these pairs is an arch window, outlined in white. Above each arch is a small rectangular clear window. The door is styled similarly to the outside walls, with the same black window, gold lettering, and white outline. Above the windows and door is a white overlap with ridges, gold lettering, and a black background.
Bakery

title: Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie
text:
Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie - Appearance
Upon entering the bakery, to the left is a collection of glass display cabinets, showcasing many of Tom Dupain's treats. On top of the cabinets are small displays of baked bread, ready to sell. The floors are ornately styled, with repeating designs of lilies and fleur-de-lis. The walls are wood near the entrance and brick farther back. To the right are more displays, and further along is the register, with peels hanging from the ceiling above and a cast-iron oven in the background. Also in the back are various sacks of flour and a door leading to a rear exit (the residential street entrance) with stairs to Dupain-Cheng residence.
In "Troublemaker", it is shown that the bakery has a security system which activates metal covers that close downward to seal all the bakery windows and its main entrance.

title: Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie
text:
Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie - Trivia
The bakery is based on a real bakery called the Boulangerie Boris du Moulin de la Galette.
This bakery is now addressed as Boris Lumé Boulangerie and it's found in the 18th arrondissements.
Marinette designed the bakery's logo.
The words "boulangerie patisserie" are translated into English as "bakery confectionery". In France, a boulangerie is a shop that specializes in selling bread, while a patisserie is a shop that specializes in selling pastries. Therefore, this bakery sells both bread and pastries. It sells cakes as well.
In "Rogercop", Tom states that the bakery opens every day at seven o'clock in the morning.
The street address for the bakery is a reference to French comic writer and artist Marcel Gotlib.
The bakery is said to be located in the 21st arrondissement of Paris. However, Paris has only 20 arrondissements; the 21st is fictitious.
There is also a framed copy of the goldfish tapestry hanging in Master Fu's massage shop.
According to Marinette, she helps her father with taste testing his new recipes and loves asking her friends to help.

title: Timebreaker
text:
Timebreaker - Intro
"" is a season 1 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 16th written and produced episode of season 1. It is also the 16th written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Timebreaker
text:
Timebreaker - Synopsis
When anger over a broken watch turns Alix into a time-traveling villain, it's up to Ladybug to return to the past and thwart her plans.
Disney+
Ladybug and Cat Noir face Alix, now Timebreaker.

title: Timebreaker
text:
Timebreaker - Plot
Marinette runs down her house's stairs to her mother, Sabine, who adjusts a flower in her hair, preparing for her 20th wedding anniversary dinner later that evening. Tom calls Marinette downstairs into the bakery, where Marinette reminds her father to take off his apron before he leaves. Marinette is left in charge of the bakery for the night. Her only expectation is to give an Eiffel Tower cake to Nadja Chamack when she arrives in 30 minutes.
At the restaurant, Tom spots one of Marinette's classmates, Alix, with her father, Mr. Alim Kubdel. The Kubdels are celebrating Alix's 15th birthday. As a gift, Mr. Kubdel gives Alix a watch which has been passed down in their family for generations. It looks like a normal pocket watch, but in reality, it is a holographic watch, the only one of its kind. When Alix insists that she wants the watch over a new pair of skates, her father complies and gives her the watch. Alix's phone rings; it's her friends. She promised she'd meet up with them, but only after she had lunch with her father. Mr. Kubdel lets Alix leave the restaurant early.

title: Timebreaker
text:
Timebreaker - Plot
Meanwhile, Marinette is in her room, working on homework, while Tikki floats above her, giving encouragement. Marinette reveals that Tikki is actually making Marinette lose focus when her phone rings. It's Alya, reminding Marinette about Alix's and Kim's race. Marinette needs to be there, especially since she made a banner for the race. Tikki reminds Marinette about Nadja, which makes Marinette scream. With only five minutes to get to the Trocadéro, Marinette sets a timer for when Nadja will arrive and transforms into Ladybug and swings her way to the starting line.
Marinette detransforms, running with the banner to her friends. Opening it, she receives compliments from everyone on how well it is made. Kim points out that they made the wrong choice to cheer for Alix since she's not even there yet. Alix rolls up on a pair of in-line skates, smirking. Max separates the them apart, explaining the rules. Both of them, Alix on skates, Kim on foot, will go 500 feet around the Trocadéro square twice. The first one back to the starting line is the winner. If Kim wins, then he gets Alix's skates. If Alix wins, then Kim isn't allowed to make any more dares for the rest of the school year.

title: Timebreaker
text:
Timebreaker - Plot
Alix and Kim get ready, standing at the start line. Just as Max is about to yell, "Start," Alix makes him stop, causing Kim to fall forward on his face. Alix hands her watch to Alya, who is filming the event. Before the race begins, Alya hands it to Marinette so that she can hold her phone with both hands. Marinette, who is holding the banner with one hand, tries to give it back to Alya. However, because Nino is holding the other side of the banner and is cheering very roughly, Marinette loses hold of the watch. Adrien catches it before it falls to the ground. Chloé then takes the watch out of Adrien's hand. Adrien tries to get it back, claiming it belongs to Alix, but Chloé doesn't care. Marinette tries to make Chloé give it back. Instead, Chloé opens the watch, dropping it in surprise when it lights up. The watch rolls on the track and is destroyed underneath Alix's rollerblades as Alix finishes in first place.

title: Timebreaker
text:
Timebreaker - Plot
Alix cheers for only a moment before she notices her watch, turning her anger onto Alya, who tries to explain how the watch changed hands, but Alix doesn't want to listen. Alya, Marinette, and Adrien try to apologize (Chloé blames everyone else), but Alix says they're all the same. She skates off, crying. Marinette chases after her, trying to fix things.
Hawk Moth, in his lair, senses Alix's anger and sends an akuma to her.
Meanwhile, Nadja is at the bakery, impatiently waiting outside. Finding no one there, Nadja calls Tom, who is about to eat. He tells her Marinette is supposed to be home and he hangs up, calling Marinette. Meanwhile, Marinette is trying to talk to Alix, who is still very upset. She skates away angrily as Marinette receives a call from her father. While she's distracted, an akuma flies to Alix's rollerblades, possessing her and turning her into the skating, time-traveling supervillain, Timebreaker.
Tom tells Marinette that Nadja is in front of the bakery, waiting for her order. Marinette hangs up, on her way to retrieve the order until she spots Timebreaker skating past her.

title: Timebreaker
text:
Timebreaker - Plot
Timebreaker races back toward the students, who scatter on Adrien's command. She tags Kim, making him freeze mid-run before he fades away. The bar on her right rollerblade fills up by two. Marinette confronts Timebreaker, confused about how she managed to make Kim fade, trying to convince her to stop. Timebreaker explains that she stole Kim's existence and she tries to steal Marinette's, skating towards her, arm outstretched.
Marinette dives out of the way, throwing the banner in Timebreaker's face when Timebreaker comes after her again. Timebreaker trips up the stairs, losing sight of Marinette. Marinette, hidden behind the wall of the stairs, transforms into the superhero Ladybug. Throwing her yo-yo, Ladybug knocks Timebreaker off her feet. Timebreaker spots Rose and reaches out her hand, feigning injury. Rose, being the sweet girl she is, takes Timebreaker's hand, freezing in place and giving Timebreaker an extra minute.
Seeing Ladybug struggle, Adrien, hidden behind a tree, transforms into Cat Noir.

title: Timebreaker
text:
Timebreaker - Plot
Mylène Haprèle is running away from Timebreaker, but she slips and falls, allowing Timebreaker to steal her energy, making her total time 1 minute and 30 seconds. Ladybug and Cat Noir appear to stop her. She skates towards Cat Noir, but he jumps over her. Skidding to a stop, Timebreaker sees Alya, recording for the Ladyblog on her cellphone, and skates towards her. Alya runs, but is caught, shocking Ladybug. Chloé and Sabrina were already caught.
Ladybug explains Timebreaker's power as Timebreaker finds Ivan, who tries to hide behind a tree. Ladybug and Cat Noir need to catch the akuma before everyone disappears. Throwing her yo-yo, Ladybug catches Timebreaker's arm, saving Ivan. Timebreaker laughs, pulling the arm with the yo-yo and successfully dragging Ladybug forward. Hawk Moth tells Timebreaker that it's time to get Ladybug's Miraculous.

title: Timebreaker
text:
Timebreaker - Plot
Reaching out her arm, Timebreaker moves to take the Miraculous, but Cat Noir takes the touch on himself, protecting her. Now with his energy, Timebreaker gains 6 minutes to go into the past. Hawk Moth tells her to steal Cat Noir's Miraculous before he disappears. Ladybug tells her to see if she can try; she is extremely angry. Ladybug and Timebreaker fight, Ladybug knocking Timebreaker to the floor. Hawk Moth is angered, but Timebreaker has a solution: she skates away. Ladybug throws her yo-yo to stop her, but she finds herself being dragged by Timebreaker.
Ladybug and Timebreaker travel to the past, to the moment where Alix and Kim finished their first lap. Timebreaker spots the watch in Chloé's hands and jumps down to the students. Ladybug tells Chloé to drop the watch, but this causes it to break again (this time by falling and not being run over). Enter Hawk Moth, amused over the fact that there are two akumas out. Blaming Ladybug, Alix is akumatized once more, resulting in two Timebreakers.

title: Timebreaker
text:
Timebreaker - Plot
Marinette sees Ladybug from a moment later, surprised. While Ladybug from the future and Tikki try to explain what happened, the two Timebreakers meet and Cat Noir appears. Marinette runs off to the bakery to give Nadja her cake. Ladybug tells Cat Noir that she will explain everything later. The two heroes approach the two Timebreakers. Hawk Moth orders them to get the Miraculouses. Ladybug and Cat Noir fight the two Timebreakers. The Timebreakers need more speed to go back farther in time and they start stealing energy from people.
Meanwhile, Nadja, in front of the bakery, sees Marinette, who gives Nadja her cake. When the bakery is empty, Marinette transforms into Ladybug and runs back to the future Ladybug. Meanwhile, future Ladybug and Cat Noir chase the two Timebreakers. The Timebreakers turn to go after them, but present Ladybug stops them. Cat Noir clasps his hands and grins, amazed to see two Ladybugs. Finding themselves outnumbered, the Timebreakers decide to go back to the time when the heroes weren't around. The two Ladybugs use Lucky Charm, a traffic cone and a bicycle lock appearing.

title: Timebreaker
text:
Timebreaker - Plot
Cat Noir buys them some time by using his Cataclysm to break a low-relief. The two Timebreakers can't get past it, so they turn around and see one Ladybug. As they are about to steal her energy, Ladybug ties their skates with the bicycle lock. The other Ladybug uses the traffic cone and a sign to make a ramp. The two Timebreakers go up the ramp, tossing them into the air. The Ladybugs catch them with their yo-yos by the ankles, and the Timebreakers fall to the ground, their akumatized skated removed.
The Ladybugs break their skates, releasing the akumas and purifying them. Both use Miraculous Ladybug and return the world and the timeline to normal. The people return, the watch is fixed, the two Ladybugs merge, and the Timebreakers turn back into a single Alix. Ladybug hands the watch back to her, Alix says she should have been more responsible with it, taking Ladybug's words of responsibility to heart.
Cat Noir approaches Ladybug, but she swings away. Cat Noir holds out hope that Ladybug will fall for him. Hawk Moth swears the heroes that one day, past, present, or future, they will eventually lose to him and he will become invincible.

title: Timebreaker
text:
Timebreaker - Plot
Back at the bakery, Marinette's parents return from their dinner. She asks them how their wedding anniversary went. Her father says it was great, but they almost had to leave early. Marinette apologizes for making Nadja wait. Her mother tells her "to watch the shop properly, instead of listening to music in her room next time". Marinette and her parents share a big hug, ending the episode.

title: Timebreaker
text:
Timebreaker - Plot Developments
It is unknown if Alix won the race or not since it's unknown which history was kept when the two realities merged. In the second reality, Alix never crossed the finish line and Kim wasn't anywhere to be seen.
So it's most likely that a new history was made when the two realities merged. In the first one, due to Kim calling for a rematch, it's likely Alix won the first race, but when her future self went back in time, she didn't tell her past self much of anything unlike Ladybug did with hers.
In the second reality, Alix never crossed the finish line, and since Kim wasn't anywhere to be seen due to Future Ladybug telling them to run, the race was called off, meaning no one won.
This is the first time a Miraculous breaks by other means.
With Alix's watch being (unknown at the time) the camouflaged version of the Rabbit Miraculous and Cat Noir's ring disappearing after being touch by Timebreaker this is the first and second time a Miraculous jewel is destroyed and repaired followed by the Bee Miraculous in "Queen Wasp", the Butterfly Miraculous in "Miraculous Shanghai" and the Turtle Miraculous in "Optigami".

title: Timebreaker
text:
Timebreaker - Plot Developments
As well as the first Miraculous of the Chinese Zodiac section of the Miracle Box to be seen.
Even though the Rabbit Miraculous was activated, Fluff herself didn't come out which is understandable because her character wasn't created yet. And yet, for the in universe reason itself is unknown. However, it could be that due to the Rabbit Miraculous' nature or to Fluff already being merged with Bunnyx and sealed in stone slumber is why she didn't come out despite her owner having her jewel.
As her akumatized alter-ego, Alix used a variation of Burrow foreshadowing her future self using the Rabbit Miraculous as the holder Bunnyx.
By extension and with the knowledge of "Destruction", taken into account Hawk Moth copied a version of the powers of a Miraculous he didn't know about yet.
This is the first episode where a character dies, though it is later reversed.
Timebreaker is the first and so far only akumatized villain in Season 1 to cause the temporary death of more than one character, the second is YanLuoShi and the third is Cat Blanc in an erased timeline.
However, unlike Cat Blanc, Cat Noir was killed by both YanLuoShi and Timebreaker.

title: Timebreaker
text:
Timebreaker - Plot Developments
Timebreaker caused the temporary demise of Chloé, Sabrina, Alya, Mylène, Cat Noir, Kim, Rose, and 4 other people.
Since Plagg was transformed into Cat Noir, this converts to the first time a kwami reverts back to its spirit form, following Pollen in "Queen Wasp".
In "Wreckless Driver", it's revealed that Aglaé was one of the people that got their time stolen by Timebreaker, though it happened to her off-screen.
The same episode also revealed what happens after someone fades away completely, as she describes it to Dr. Psiquat.
Cat Noir's hope that Ladybug would one day finally fall in love with him and that it was just a matter of time, is exactly what comes true in "Determination".

title: Timebreaker
text:
Timebreaker - Trivia
This episode's world premiere was in Korea.
It was the fifth episode to air in France and the fourth episode to air in Korea.
This is the first time an akumatized villain transformed before verbally accepting Hawk Moth's deal.
In the French, Italian, Catalan and European Portuguese versions, the episode and title villain are called "Chronogirl".
In the Korean version of this episode, if Alix wins the race, Kim has to be her servant until they graduate from Collège Françoise Dupont.
This is the first time Ladybug uses Lucky Charm twice.
But unlike the other following times, this is the first time the two Lucky Charms were summoned at the same time with there being two Ladybugs.
This is the second episode where Plagg has another non-speaking role following "The Evillustrator".
This is the first time we see Ladybug and Marinette, as well as two Ladybugs, at the same time.
As Cat Noir was disappearing, Hawk Moth instructed Timebreaker to take his ring before he was gone, but unknown to him the villainess also took Plagg's energy too. If she had gotten the ring, then it wouldn't have done no good anyway:

title: Timebreaker
text:
Timebreaker - Trivia
Since she took the life energy of a kwami without them to power the Miraculouses, they become no more than ordinary jewels.
There was no guarantee, if Timebreaker was capable of giving the energy she stole from her victims back.
Hawk Moth didn't realize if the Miraculouses are destroyed by any means, the kwamis revert back to their spirit forms until the jewel is fixed as a result of Ladybug's powers, what leads to the jewel's destruction is averted or when another can be made, which he didn't know until "Deflagration".
However, the knowledge of how the jewels were made wasn't revealed or proven to be in the Miraculous spellbook yet.
On top of that, since Gabriel knew using a damaged jewel was a bad idea, he should've exercised caution to Timebreaker when he told her to get them.
References
This is one of the six episodes of Season 1 in which Ladybug and Cat Noir don't do their signature "Pound it!", the other five being "Princess Fragrance", "The Pharaoh", "Kung Food", "Animan" and "Stoneheart". However, the two Ladybugs from the two timelines do their own "Pound it!".
Allusions
The name "Timebreaker" may be a pun on "tie breaker".

text:
