In "Catalyst", after dealing with a late night akumatized villain, Tikki and Marinette detransformed. She tucked Marinette in and wished her a goodnight before falling asleep herself but instantly woke up and was informed it was Heroes' Day. Sometime later Tikki helped Marinette bake the macarons she promised for her Heroes Day good deed but when Marinette suggested using her powers. Tikki gently reminded her that her powers as Ladybug weren't meant for personal gain, however after shortly arriving at the school. The two notice the school being attacked by a swarm of red akumas and transformed after dealing with Vanisher they detransformed and went to Master Fu's shop. Once again when Marinette was offered to choose an ally seeing the seriousness of the situation Tikki suggested using all the jewels but seeing that there was little time she saw her wielder take only the Fox, Bee and Turtle Miraculouses. Afterwards, they transformed into Ladybug and met up with Cat Noir and their allies.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Mayura", despite the team putting up a good fight and after summoning a lucky charm Ladybug and Cat Noir lost their allies as well as they were about to detransform back. But thanks to Cat Noir using Cataclysm on the ground below them the duo escaped, afterwards Tikki was given a macaroon by Marinette and heard her express doubt on how to beat Hawk Moth. After receiving encouragement from Cat Noir, being found by the army Tikki and Marinette retransformed into their Aqua Mode. This time with the Paris rebellion's help the duo managed to corner Hawk Moth and deakumatize everyone. But their archenemy managed to escape thanks to Mayura despite that the team managed to save the city and they both returned to Master Fu's shop and returned the Fox, Turtle and Bee Miraculouses.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - "[[Miraculous Shanghai]]"
Tikki went with Marinette to Shanghai to follow Adrien and during their vacation she revealed that her species can speak a multitude of languages which was a necessary as their owners were always a mystery. Unbestowed, she was kidnapped by Fei who in turn tried to sell her for information from Cash while in his shop Tikki pretended to be a doll then was placed in a claw machine a while later she saw Marinette come into Cash's shop and heard the conversation between Cash and Fei and tried to warn her owner but was assured she'd get her out. Seeing Fei's quick handywork Tikki made her move and followed the girls out of the shop reuniting with Marinette. Soon after the pair were chased by Cash's goon and they attempted to fight them off but were interupted by Fei and brought to her home, where she explained her own hardships, however the truth of her owner's misfortune was explained by Cash, but seeing Fei come to Marinette's defense she started to feel unsure about Fei.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - "[[Miraculous Shanghai]]"
Then trouble added on when an akuma appeared fleeing to transform knowing of Fei's actions Tikki asked Marinette, if Fei was being sincere despite that they transformed into Ladybug to fight against Hawk Moth and King Cash. With Ladydragon and Cat Noir's help the trio manage to corner him but the fight wasn't over when Hawk Moth akumatized the Prodigious' guardian Mei Shi aware that both heroes used their powers Tikki and Marinette detransformed for a recharge and once charged up despite the trio's best efforts they lost Cat Noir. By helping Fei understand the dragon's value the duo were able to calm Mei Shi and restored the city to normal.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Chameleon", after hearing what Lila planned to do to Marinette if she exposed her lies. Tikki told Marinette not to let Lila get to her trying to console her, then she warned her of an incoming akuma. Encouraging Marinette, she told her that Hawk Moth's power only works when people don't see another way out of them and reminds Marinette that she always finds a way. After the akuma flies away Tikki and Marinette transform into Ladybug to catch before it akumatizes someone. However, the akuma infects Lila turning her into Chameleon, and despite her shape shifting Ladybug and Cat Noir deakumatize her.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Animaestro", Tikki was watching the new movie trailer with Marinette about her superhero alter ego. When Tikki asked her if she was going to the premier she was happy with her wielder's decision not to go for seeking stardom but when Tikki heard that Adrien was going to be there and Marinette change her mind she just laughed. After Marinette was done talking with her parents Tikki saw her take out a special macaron. Which she found strange because Marinette's parents already made so many and heard that Marinette this one for Adrien. She was surprised that's the reason why Marinette made a special macaron every Sunday saving them for special occasions. Then, the pair went off to the movie showing, in the midst seeing Adrien and Kagami being so close Tikki was shocked that Marinette went along with Chloé in an effort to stop them from being together. But when the plan turns into a fiasco leading to Thomas Astruc being akumatized into Animaaestro, Tikki praised her for deciding of not listening to Chloé and transformed into Ladybug.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - [[Season 3]]
With Cat Noir's help and a head camera the pair discovered the villain's weakness with everyone's help they were able to stop Animaestro and enjoyed the movie premier.
In "Bakerix", Tikki was watching the unveiling of the new Startrain on the news from Marinette's computer. And she was curious on how the train was going to get to the U.K. when Marinette spoke of the train using a tunnel under the English Channel. At first, she thought it was made by a superhero but was told it was made by people with machines and was amazed by how many things people have invented since her last owner.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - [[Season 3]]
Tikki called the sweater Marinette was making for her father Tom's 40th birthday beautiful but when Marinette had trouble figuring out what to get for him, Tikki wasn't worry as she always comes up with something perfect. Noticing the look on her wielder's face Tikki knew she had the idea of having getting Marinette's grandfather and father to make up after finding the address they leave for Roland's bakery. Arriving there, Tikki was surprised that Marinette was giving up so easily but she finally got in posing as a flour delivery girl. And yet, Tikki thought it wasn't the best idea for Marinette pose has someone else unaware how her grandfather would react. However, when Roland discovered Marinette was his granddaughter, he felt betrayed and was akumatized into Bakerix.
Then Tikki and Marinette transformed into Ladybug and along with Cat Noir they followed Bakerix to the Startrain. By using a ketchup bottle and other ingredients to make a non traditional sandwich as a lure and trapping him in a wind turbine, the duo was able to save Marinette's grandfather and have him make up with Tom.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Backwarder", soon after Alya and the others leave Tikki and Marinette approached by Wayzz telling them that Master Fu needs help. But remembered the last time Fu called them for help it was about his lost house keys with that Tikki thought it was time that he learned to text and write a note. Upon making it to the Master's shop, she saw the guardian lying in bed after the doctor leaves, she was that Master Fu chose Marinette to be new guardian aware he won't live forever. Also in picking up his medications, Tikki and Marinette find out that Master Fu has a sweetheart for someone else.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - [[Season 3]]
However with three letters and little time Tikki advised Marinette to choose but to have enough time for everything they transformed into Ladybug. Arriving at the train station they detranformed after Marinette dropped off the "letter" for Adrien, Tikki praised her for taking the plunge. However, due to an accidental letter mix-up Master Fu's friend Marianne Lenoir was akumatized into Backwarder and she and Marinette transformed into Ladybug. Using a pipe and have Cat Noir struck with the villainess' powers they were able to destroy the brooch and save Ms. Lenoir. After giving her the correct letter Tikki and Marinette watched Master Fu and Marianne talking and wondered why he wouldn't express his love to her and when Marinette said the time wasn't right. Then, she asked about her doing the same thing with Adrien that's when Marinette answered she'll have to find out if she's still alive tomorrow and Tikki goes with her to school the next day.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Gamer 2.0", Tikki was helping Marinette with a multitude of things to do but when she saw Marinette drawing on one of the band shirts she finished Tikki advised her to take a break, but her wielder refused with everything being due tomorrow. Then, the next day Tikki continued to help to Marinette until they were interrupted by a broadcast from Gamer who wanted to play with that she realized Marnette was going to get that break after all and transformed into Ladybug. Meeting up with Cat Noir, Gamer invited them in but aware that it might be a trap the duo remained in contact. After playing a series of rounds with akumatized villain avatars the heroes managed to beat them all but for them to defeat Gamer they had to fight each other. Having no other choice but refusing to fight Ladybug, the kitty sacrificed himself by elimination. During the final fight along with a few accessories including Cat Noir's ring and a bag of flour Ladybug defeated Gamer and freed everyone. Returning home, Marinette asked Tikki if the things she was working on could wait and she agreed leaving to join her parents and Max in playing his new game.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Weredad", after dealing with Gigatitan again Tikki became disappointed with Marinette for lying about her feelings towards Cat Noir after Marinette's father was going to set up a breakfast between them. While waiting for the hero the next day Tikki asked Marinette what she will do if he does show up and yet she was reminded that he was in love with Ladybug. However, the kwami ruled out the possibility of Cat Noir actually being in with Marinette for real because of Ladybug's several rejections. Soon she saw Cat Noir coming and told Marinette not to doubt the hero's love of macrons.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - [[Season 3]]
Then, Tikki listened to Marinette rambling on about what to do and asked for her help but gave her wielder a dissatisfied look. After the date Tikki was informed that Cat Noir was still in love with Ladybug and yet Marinette's convincing act in front of her parents led to Tom's akumatization. Even worse she and Marinette ended up separated making her way out she discovered her wielder was trapped high up in a prison maze of thorn vines. Despite hearing Marinette due to the prison being magical, it prevented Tikki from finding her. When Marinette plucked the akumatized rose from its pedestal the thorn maze started to fall from the sky. Upon being reunited Tikki and Marinette finally transformed and by making a hang glider from a sailboat they were able to save Tom and Cat Noir.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Silencer", after Luka was akumatized into Silencer because Bob Roth stole everything from the Kitty Section band and threatened Marinette. Tikki heard of Luka's confession to her wielder, in the bathroom she began to suspect that those were his true feelings. Nonetheless, she and Marinette transformed into Ladybug but the first confrontation led to the heroine being muted by the villain. With Cat Noir's help and a fake Lucky Charm the duo tricked Silencer into activating the real one; with a vacuum cleaner and Cat Noir destroying Silencer's helmet with Cataclysm they deakumatized Luka. As well as got Bob to admit his actions on live television. After Bob tried to save face by letting the band perform but before they do Luka admitted the same love confession to Marinette when he was akumatized. When he finished Tikki admitted it was the most beautiful love confession she has heard in her whole life.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Oni-Chan", as Marinette chased after Lila and Adrien to the Agreste mansion, Tikki tried to tell her to be more trustful towards Adrien as like them he knew the truth about Lila. When she heard Lila denying the possibility of humiliating Marinette and her wanting to transform out of retaliation, Tikki halted her from doing so. Shortly after Lila's photo for attention caused Kagami's akumatization, she allowed Marinette to transform into Ladybug. However catching Oni-Chan was tricky with her constantly teleporting everywhere Lila was. That's when Ladybug found out that Lila's horn acted as a beacon and after being tied by the heroine's own Lucky Charm a hose Ladybug decided to use it to an advantage. By bringing Lila close and answering the villain's call they switched places and in doing so Ladybug and Cat Noir stopped Oni-Chan and saved Lila.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Miraculer", after dealing with Destroyer and Marinette's conversation, Tikki advised Marinette to talk to Chloé as Ladybug knowing she will only listen to her alter ego. But talking to Chloé was going to be a lot harder when Sabrina was akumatized into Miraculer. With the whole team on deck they were able to stop Miraculer, keep the Bee Miraculous safe and have Chloé come to an understanding. The next day, when Marinette voiced concerns hoping she didn't hurt Chloé's feelings too bad. Tikki comforted her by saying it was the right thing to do by protecting Chloé they were protecting themselves and everyone else which was the duty of being a heroine.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Oblivio", when Alya and Nino were akumatized into Oblivio during their field trip to the Montparnasse Tower, Tikki and Marinette transformed into Ladybug. However, their first fight with them resulted in Ladybug using her Lucky Charm and losing her memory.  Upon detransforming Tikki didn't know who or what she was except for being very hungry and picked up by an amnesiac Marinette. Seeing that the elevator was collapsing she helped Marinette and Adrien by opening the door. Escaping the villain while in the bathroom she was given a macaron by Marinette but their safe spot didn't last long and they escaped through the vent to another part of the building.
Despite being amnesiac, she tried to convince Plagg to help their amnesic wielders but he refused, fed up Tikki called him selfish and a total coward and watched Plagg fly off telling the pair they shouldn't wait for him to come back with help. After avoiding the titular villain again and through watching a video, the trio learned what happened to them earlier. Due to Marinette's previous actions before getting hit and during a phone call with Master Fu, Tikki discovered her name and that she was a kwami.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - [[Season 3]]
Seeing Oblivio's giant bubble, the two retransformed into Ladybug and soon with an amnesiac Cat Noir's help they stopped the villain and restored their memories. When Tikki saw Marinette freaking out about kissing Cat Noir and wondering how that happened, she replied who knows believing Marinette still has things to learn about him.
In "Party Crasher", hearing Marinette's excuse she was surprised that they were taking the wrong way to the bakery and Marinette said it was a ploy to work undercover. When Party Crasher crashed Adrien's party; Tikki and Marinette transformed into Ladybug. However, she along with Marinette end up being caught by the villain until they were freed by a new ally King Monkey. Along with their allies they were able to defeat Party Crasher and save Wayhem.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Christmaster", after watching Nino take his little brother Chris home, Tikki asked Marinette why she lied about being Santa's helper. Marinette said that she didn't want him to know about the gifts and hopefully that Chris would learn patience too. Then afterwards, Tikki helped Marinette make her next gift for Adrien until they both fell asleep. And yet, was surprised to see that it was snowing outside and that there was an army of toys everywhere, hearing Marinette believe it was a dream. Tikki pulled her hair telling her it wasn't and transformed into Ladybug along with Cat Noir the duo fought against Christmaster's army of toys. By making a deal with the young villain's ultimate gift on the line, Ladybug willfully gets the akumatized object and returned everything to normal. When Marinette had to babysit Chris again Tikki pushed her to be honest and was proud of her for doing so.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - [[Season 3]]
In "The Puppeteer 2", when Marinette grew uncomfortable about being with Adrien during their trip to the wax museum, Tikki advised her to be cool and calm like her alter ego. However, that would have to wait when Manon was reakumatized into Puppeteer but this time being able to control the wax figurines and yet the two transformed. By making a forgery of the villain's wand the duo was able to deakumatize Manon. Returning home, when Tikki heard that Adrien had a crush on another girl but aware of his identity she advised Marinette not to give up on Adrien yet.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Stormy Weather 2", after hearing Marinette possibly agreeing with Chloé about not changing Tikki thought otherwise believing that she had changed a lot since the beginning of the school year. Reminding Marinette of all the times she spent with Adrien albeit some of them were awkward but in the end she admits that Adrien had become a true friend. When Marinette admits about her ability to talk to him except about her feelings Tikki accepted that it was better nothing. Soon when Stormy Weather was on the loose again she and Marinette transformed into Ladybug. Even with Stormy Weather's increased power the duo still managed to defeat her. Afterwards, Tikki encouraged Marinette to drop off the notes for Adrien and when she did Tikki was happy to see an improved Marinette.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Timetagger", Tikki was at the park with Marinette along with Alya as they were watching Ella, Etta and Chris. Soon after they noticed that Mr. Ramier was akumatized again for the 24th time and after hearing Marinette's latest excuse about macron flavor tasting, Tikki commented that it wasn't her best one. Regardless the two transform into Ladybug and make quick work of Mr. Pigeon but soon afterwards they had to deal with another villain from the future Timetagger. However, they were short on time recharging in lavatory when Marinette expressed doubt on how to defeat Timetagger, Tikki comforted her saying that every problem has a solution and retransformed. Just as a villain came from the future so did some future help of their own, with the help of the future Miraculous holder Bunnyx; Alix's future self and their future alter egos the group defeated Timetagger. But Tikki and Marinette had to transform again to defeat Mr. Pigeon again.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Ikari Gozen", as Marinette participated in the Friendship Day Games, Tikki praised her for figuring out the first clue but when she heard Marinette shriek she asked if there was a supervillain. But when Marinette saw Kagami as her new friend Tikki didn't see it as a problem and yet her wielder wanted to back out however, she advised her to give Kagami a chance as she won't be able to play if Marinette doesn't go back. After hearing Marinette's idea to sabotage their Tikki advised her against it but was pushed back into her purse.
During the event after Marinette and Kagami swapped their phones, Tikki told her not to look in Kagami's phone but upon seeing it. They discovered that it had no other contacts except for her mother's and Kagami was using app on how to make friends. Seeing her wielder make a huge mistake Tikki asked if all humans snoop into other human's belongings. After Kagami had been kidnapped by her akumatized mother and Marinette realized she was wrong about her; Tikki knew she would find a way to fix things and they transformed. Afterwards, with Cat Noir, by giving Kagami the Dragon Miraculous and with her help as Ryuko the trio was able to save Kagami's mother.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Reflekdoll", Tikki advised Marinette not to take off her Miraculous for the photoshoot. However, Marinette ignored her warning, but was given the Miraculous for safe keeping. After Juleka is re-akumatized, Tikki was with Plagg inside the car, and was unaware of the situation at first. Shortly after, they become aware and Tikki expressed worry about not finding their owners but was told to find their miraculous first. When Plagg finds the ring she was assured that everything would be fine. After she found the earrings Tikki started looking for Marinette but saw that she had Cat Noir's ring. Coming across Reflekta clone looking for Plagg and quickly figured out that the clone was Plagg's owner explaining that there was mix up and introduces herself.
He took the earrings and transformed himself into Mister Bug. Once Reflekta was defeated and Reflekdoll destroyed, Adrien gave the miraculous back to Tikki who returns to Marinette, happy to be reunited.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Desperada", after Desperada attacked them on the houseboat when Marinette asked why she gave Adrien the guitar, Tikki replied that it was her troubled heart and transformed. After escaping Desperada with Luka and Adrien and summoning her lucky charm receiving a gong they detransform and leave for Master Fu's shop. Tikki then, saw Marinette take the Snake Miraculous and retransform but due to Adrien not focusing about the task at hand as Aspik the two have been captured over 29000 times until Adrien returned the Snake Miraculous and with the help of their ally Viperion and Cat Noir destroying the villain's vantage point the trio was able to stop Desperada and save everyone.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Ladybug", after Marinette nearly gets akumatized by Hawk Moth because Lila's deception got her expelled from school. In her room, Tikki warned her of what could've happened if it was finished, refusing to let Hawk Moth or Lila get away with this she heard that Marinette was going to prove her innocence. Agreeing Tikki advised her to talk Alya noticing that she resisted being akumatized due to still believing in Marinette. While working at the bakery they noticed from the news Mayura fighting Ladybug but knowing it was one of Mayura's traps Tikki and Marinette transformed into Ladybug and went to save Cat Noir. After explaining to the hero that the Ladybug imposter was actually a sentimonster, using a fork Ladybug gained control of the creature but instead of destroying her she asked for her help.
But before the trio could get the Peacock Miraculous, the Ladybug sentimonster was destroyed and soon the duo fought against Hawk Moth until their fight ended in a stalemate. And yet both sides valued their partners more knowing they could get their enemies Miraculous another day.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Startrain", after a late night fight; Tikki and Marinette returned the Fox Miraculous to Master Fu. She reminded her of the upcoming field trip to see Big Ben in London and Master Fu gave them a way to go by taking the Horse Miraculous with them in case of emergency. However, their peaceful field trip was ruined when an akuma unknowingly snuck aboard the Startrain and akumatized Max's mother into the titular villain. With having to capture the akuma and teleport everyone back to earth at the same time the duo called upon their newest allies Pegasus using his powers of teleportation and Markov. The group battled their way through the train and made their way back to earth.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Feast", Tikki and Marinette went to Master Fu's under the worry that Alya figured out the secret of the Order of the Guardians. But she and the others were surprised that Master Fu was afraid of a statue to which he explained was a dormant sentimonster he created long ago out of his hunger and anger. So much so that the guardians and the temple were destroyed with him being the soul survivor. Realizing what Hawk Moth would do Tikki was returned to her Miraculous and placed back in the Miracle Box. But thanks to Marinette showing her bravery in the face of danger Tikki was reunited with her owner and they transformed into Ladybug. Armed with a metal detector the heroes dove into the belly of the beast they were able to destroy the sentimonster and restored the Order of the Guardians.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Kwamibuster", during their wielder's class, Tikki knew where Plagg was going and tried to stop him telling her kwami brother that he should've found it strange that this cheese kept appearing out of nowhere. Upon seeing Ms. Mendeleiev's attempt to capture them, she tried to flee with Plagg reminding him that's the reason why he should've listen to her afterwards she returned to Marinette. Upon seeing her wielder writing in her diary, Tikki believed that Marinette didn't want to her read her secrets but she retorts that they have no secrets between them. As soon as Marinette falls asleep Tikki meets Plagg to discuss what happened earlier telling him of her concerns but was assured nothing would go wrong.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - [[Season 3]]
However, she received a slight scalding from Marinette at school the next day about keeping secrets and Tikki didn't want to bother her wielder with Kwami foolishness. Upon hearing Marinette figure out that Plagg was there too, she tried to calm her nerves but upon seeing her owner still disappointed Tikki apologized. And yet, Marinette didn't take it too hard as Tikki was trying to protect her completely aware of what would happen if their identities got out. Seeing that their little adventure caused Ms. Mendeleiev's akumatization, the two transform into Ladybug but after being struck by Kwamibuster, Tikki was separated from Marinette. Then, saw Plagg trying to get out but told him to save his energy and when he opted to Cataclysm she told him it was a bad idea as he couldn't control it. Tikki was asked if she had a plan retorted she didn't but trusted that her owner did have a plan.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - [[Season 3]]
Seeing more of her kwami siblings being captured at first she believed they were doomed but seeing her wielder as (Multimouse) she proclaimed her as the best then fused her powers with Mullo becoming "Multibug". After setting the other kwamis free, Kwamibuster was defeated, the identities of the heroes were safe and the jewels were returned. Afterwards, Tikki apologized saying if Marinette had to give up being Ladybug because of her, then she wouldn't forgive her. And yet, she was comforted by her wielder understanding that everyone makes mistakes and was a true friend Marinette could rely on.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Cat Blanc", hearing the conversation among Marinette's friends Tikki asked her if she was really going to do this. But upon being denied entry into the mansion and hearing her wielder want to transform, Tikki once again warned Marinette that her powers must not be used for personal gain. However, she agreed under the notion of being quick but by taking too long as Ladybug and being spotted by Adrien. A serious mistake was caused leading to the duo being retrieved by Bunnyx and brought to an alternate future where everything and everyone including themselves in Paris was destroyed. Then after defeating an akumatized Cat Noir and by fixing a mistake in the past, Ladybug saved him and changed the future.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Félix", when it was Marinette's turn to say something for Adrien's video care package, Tikki was asked for advice on what to say in situations like this. However, she didn't exactly know what to say because her kind was immortal and don't have any parents but told Marinette to speak from the heart. Afterwards, when Marinette was having second thoughts, Tikki halted her wielder from deleting the video believing that her message could turn Adrien's sad day into a happy one. However, due to their message being returned with a nasty one caused some of Marinette's friends to be akumatized into the Punisher Trio, Tikki and Marinette transformed Ladybug. After being informed by Cat Noir that the imposter was Adrien's cousin Félix and setting off a chain reaction with a can of whipped cream the duo was able to save him.
In "Heart Hunter", after dealing with Heart Hunter and Marinette on her way to return the Dragon Miraculous, Tikki saw that the place that they met Master Fu as been ransacked. Despite that she tried to assure Marinette that he was fine, unaware that he had been captured.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Miracle Queen", upon seeing a swarm of hornets coming after them, to escape Tikki activated her Aqua powers and they retransformed into Aquabug. Reuniting with Aqua Noir, the duo discovered that Chloé was akumatized again into Miracle Queen but to make matters worse, all their allies and Master Fu were captured and Hawk Moth was in possession of the Miracle Box. Through the powers of fusion as Snake Noir and Dragon Bug, they were able to save their allies, stop Hawk Moth, Mayura and reclaim the Miracle Box.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - "[[Miraculous New York]]"
After Mr. Ramier got akumatized into Mr. Pigeon for the 50th time, Tikki and Marinette transformed into Cosmo Bug to stop afterwards they detransformed and upon noticing Marinette taking photo of Adrien's advertisement she informed her that she thought she gave up romantic pursuit of her friend and Marinette retorted it was for research purposes. While hearing that Marinette and her class were going to New York for French American Friendship Week, Tikki wondered how her wielder was going to protect the city while she was gone, but was assured everything was taken care off, by having Cat Noir stay in Paris and warn her of trouble. However double trouble came when Hawk Moth was in New York too and akumatized Techno Pirate into Technolizer, despite the young heroes defeating him it led to Uncanny Valley's temporary demise.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - "[[Miraculous New York]]"
While in the sewers with no heroes in Paris their home was wrecked by Mayura's sentimonster with no chance of repairs. Detransforming both Tikki and Marinette hear a gulity Cat Noir renounce his role and ring leaving the pair alone in the sewers. After resurfacing she was joined by Plagg in Marinette's bag until they were approached by a repaired Uncanny Valley asking for Ladybug's help despite her owner trying to dissuade the robotic heroine the kwamis were shocked that their masking powers didn't work against machines allowing Uncanny to find her. After hearing Marinette's speech about needing her partner, they accepted Uncanny's help in retrieving Cat Noir meanwhile they retransformed into Ladybug and helped Sparrow do damage control in the city. When the young heroes reunited they worked together to retrieve Eagle Miraculous and with their newest ally Eagle returned the adult heroes to normal, with their help deakumatized Techno Pirate and saved New York. With the Eagle Miraculous in trustworthy hands the French Duo returned to Paris.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Truth", Tikki was trying on hats while telling Marinette about the Miracle Box when her holder asked if it's she ever gets lonely while in there she retorts that there is a whole magically universe inside the box. When her holder discovered accidently how to open the box they both were surprised that her siblings got out and when Marinette asks how it happened Tikki answered that the box was in her likeness full of surprises and chased after Mullo when she stole her hat. Upon answering a video call Tikki explained to Marinette that kwamis can't be filmed or photographed. Soon due to constant calls of needing Ladybug and Marinette's refusal to share her secrets it led to Luka's akumatization. Even with a hanicap Ladybug and Cat Noir manage to a deakumatize Luka, knowing how hurt her owner was about the breakup Tikki and her siblings gave Marinette a group hug.
In "Lies", however the night wasn't over for them yet when the same problem with lies when Kagami was akumatized into the titular villain paralyzing everyone lied but thanks to the help of Jagged's crocodile and a drone the heroes managed to deakumatized her.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Gang of Secrets", Tikki stayed transformed by an overstressed Marinette until after being convinced by Trixx to do so which the kwami sensed that she was doing better than her owner. Despite talking to Marinette, the kwami was hastily transformed again until Marinette's friends came in and they sadly leave Tikki came out of hiding to console her. Things got worse when Marinette's friends were akumatized into the Gang of Secrets but after freeing Lady Wifi and with Rena's help, Marinette's girlfriends were freed. After the girls, made up, Tikki heard Marinette tell Alya everything including her identity as the two girl embraced Tikki and her siblings officially meet Alya.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Mr. Pigeon 72", Tikki and Marinette were still transformed as Ladybug, while her owner was working on one of the power potions and how to find a way to limit Shadow Moth's supply of akumatized victims. When it was time for a break they detransformed and Tikki was fed a piece of crossiant while in her owner's purse and left for the pool. However, in trying to get Kagami and Adrien back together it resulted in Mr. Ramier's 72th akumatization into Mr. Pigeon but this time armed with the power of turning people into pigeons including Cat Noir. Hiding inside the changing room Tikki and Marinette transform into Ladybug and couldn't risk leaving but with a hand drill, Plagg's and Rena's help Ladybug was deakumatized Mr. Ramier, even further with Rena's insight Ladybug enhanced her powers creating the first magical charm and after everyone else left the pair head home.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Psycomedian", Tikki attended the show of Harry Clown with Marinette until the comedian was akumatized into the titular villain. Soon enough she and Marinette transform into Ladybug however by guessing the wrong object the heroine was struck by the villain becoming very angry. But when their transformation ended Marinette's condition transferred to Tikki making her very angry as well. Then, by following Cat Noir's lead the duo deakumatized Harry and returning to the show she convinced her owner to be herself.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Furious Fu", upon hearing that Master Fu was returning for a visit despite being greatly excited Tikki and Marinette had a hard time convincing her other siblings to stay put until they allowed them to come too. But after returning home from a picnic with their former master they all were shocked by the arrival of Su-Han where Tikki explained to Marinette that he was the celestial and head of the Order of the Guardians returning to reclaim the Miraculous, kwamis and Miracle Box. Sadly, Tikki and Marinette transform into Ladybug to inform Cat Noir of the situation but upon meeting and receiving encouragement from the feline hero they defied the head guardian and escaped him. However they soon discovered that Su-Han's grudge against Wang Fu akumatized him into the titular villain but after seeing the French Duo in action the celestial guardian let go of his grudge and allowed Tikki and her siblings stay with Marinette.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Sole Crusher", hearing Marinette voice concerns about her new friend Zoé's behavior at school, Tikki suggested that she talk to her with honesty. Then, sometime later she and the other kwamis watched Marinette working on another project until hearing a commotion outside and Chloé coming up through the door causing the kwamis to hide but seeing her owner captured Tikki commanded Kaalki to use her powers and find Cat Noir while she followed after Marinette. Once Marinette was freed they transformed into Ladybug, by finding the right pair of shoes they deakumatized Zoé.
In "Queen Banana", Tikki was at the cinema with Marinette and her classmates until Chloé's anger akumatized her into the titular villain. Upon receiving a motorbike with a repair kit inside via Lucky Charm, Ladybug put their plan into action but realized that something was still missing but upon hearing Zoé the heroine discovered that they needed her help and along with Vesperia and playing on Queen Banana's ego Chloé was deakumatized.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Mega Leech", Tikki was sleeping with Marinette until they were awakened by the construction noise going on outside and see both Ivan and Mylène protesting but being taking away by Roger as well as Marinette asking to transform to help team. She advised not too as the police deal with normal civil problems then they left for school. But when the stress of the protesters increased causing Mayor Bourgeious' akumatization into Malediktator again but this time aided with a sentimonster creating Malediktator clones. By transforming into Ladybug and with the help of many including a new hero named Polymouse the villain and sentimonster were beaten.
In "Crocoduel", Tikki heard Alya convince Marinette come to Juleka and Luka's birthday party on their houseboat but the party was put on hold when Anarka's and Jagged's arguing over who broke up their family caused a double akumatization. With the help of the team's newest member Purple Tigress and a high sky battle the hero trio were able to deakumatized Juleka's and Luka's parents.
In "Optigami",

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Sentibubbler", Tikki was sleeping on Marinette until she was flunged off by her owner having nightmares about leaving the Fox Miraculous with Alya. Like her siblings she agreed that Alya was worthy of being a Miraculous holder but was worried about Trixx and his mischief leading Marinette to panic even more when Xuppu brought up Trixx causing a past incident leading Tikki to follow her panicked owner to Alya's house. However a bit after they got there the pair end up trapped in Sentibubbler's bubbles and held for ransom like Alya's family but Tikki expressed trust in Alya and encouraged Marinette to do the same. As things went on needing Ladybug, Marinette suggested that Tikki look for a new owner but the kwami informed her that the earrings couldn't come with her. However seeing an illusion of Ladybug they were aware that Rena's plan was in action but had to warn Cat Noir afterwards they saw Shadow Moth in person after luring the villain away. Soon Cat Noir gets captured too then being covered with an illusion Tikki, Kaalki and Marinette transform into Pegabug and along with the hero saved Alya's loved ones.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Glaciator 2", Tikki and Marinette transformed into Ladybug to deal with Glaciator again and some time later after hearing Kagami mentioning Marinette praticing her love affairs with a partner she suggested to do it until Marinette politely refused the offer. Noticing Cat Noir nearby she found it strange to see him, and seeing her owner getting the idea of using him as a partner Tikki went into hiding. But the pratice session was halted when André was akumatized again after being led to safety Tikki was shocked about André's condition thinking that her owner gave him the magical charm earlier however Marinette realized she didn't so  they transformed into Ladybug once more. With the help of a sports car and Cat Noir using a Cataclysm on a turbine cover the duo saved André.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Hack-San", when Tikki heard that Marinette and her family were leaving for London for the weekend the kwami encouraged her not to abdonded her family but not wanting a repeat of what happened in New York. Tikki and her miraculous were lent to Alya with the kwami of creation having total confidence in her owner's best friend despite Trixx's objections. Then came the chance for Alya to be Ladybug when Markov was akumatized into Robostus again so they transformed into Scarabella however they forgot about minor detail a suspicious and angry Cat Noir but after calming him down and a quick recharge, the pair had a rocky start at working together. But then by embracing their true selves the duo were able to deakumatize Markov and save everyone and after Marinette returned from her weekend trip, Tikki returned to her.
In "Rocketear",

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Wishmaker", Tikki and Marinette transformed to deal with the latest akumatized victim of Shadow Moth, but realizing that Wishmaker could expose Ladybug's secret identity, they call on Luka and Sass to become Viperion to use Second Chance to reset events should that happen. When it does, Viperion does use Second Chance to prevent it, and after a second time to prevent Cat Noir from being exposed as Adrien and Plagg, they are able to defeat and de-akumatize Wishmaker.
In "Simpleman",

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Qilin", during the middle of the night Tikki and Marinette transformed to deal with saving Paris from a rancid chocolate factory explosion then returned home. Then, the pair transformed for a second time dealing with Lollipop Boy sentimonster. While having a day out with Sabine, Tikki admired her for her calmness and organization skills however an accidential mishap happened causing Sabine's akumatization and then transformed into Ladybug for a third time. Arriving on the scene, they discovered that the titular villain can be reasoned with despite the chaos, police brutality and her lucky charm being a ray gun the heroes fight with dioplamcy enough that Sabine deakumatizes herself and with the akuma purified they reunited with Sabine.

In "Conformation", Tikki and Marinette find themselves caught up in Monarch's endgame of Operation: Perfect Alliance. With Marinette plagued by nightmares from Monarch as Nightormentor, Tikki and Marinette agree to speak to Gabriel about Adrien and having him come back to Paris. After she explains everything to Ladybug and pleads with her to stop Gabriel, she falls unconscious and unresponsive. When the Miraculized then attack her, Ladybug is forced to hide and power down back into Tikki and Marinette, forcing the Miraculized to retreat after losing Ladybug's scent. When Plagg finds them, they barely have a chance to rest before Monarch finds all three of them, but Marinette has Tikki and Plagg unify with her to become Bug Noire to face her arch-enemy in their final clash.

Despite his best efforts trying to paralyze her with Venom and ambush her with Voyage, Monarch can't beat Bug Noire as she uses Lucky Charm and Cataclysm repeatedly against him, before finally outsmarting him and disarming him of the Butterfly Miraculous for good.
When Bug Noire then offers to help Gabriel find a way to make amends for having ruined Adrien's life and that of the world in his mad obsession to revive Emilie, she powers down back into Marinette, Tikki, and Plagg.
However, despite warnings about trusting Gabriel from Tikki and Plagg, Marinette is paralyzed with Venom, allowing Gabriel to secure Tikki and Plagg, commanding them to assume their revealed forms, and then fuse into Gimmi, the Kwami of Reality, so he can make a wish with the Ultimate Miraculous Absolute Power.
Although Gimmi warns him of the universal balance that must be maintained, and every wish must have its sacrifice, Gabriel simply tells Gimmi to look in his heart and soul for what he wishes for and what he wants to sacrifice in return.
Surprised by his choices, Gimmi nevertheless grants it.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - [[Season 5]]
Later, Tikki is safely back in Marinette's possession as she sends the other Kwamis back to their holders on a permanent basis, thus reuniting the French Miraculous Superhero Team for whatever the future holds for them.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - "[[Miraculous London]]"
After granting Gabriel's wish as Gimmi, Tikki and Plagg de-fuse and return to their normal Kwami forms.
When Marinette asks what Gabriel wished for, Tikki and Plagg somberly reveal that he gave up his life to revive Nathalie as penance for his actions.
When Nathalie alerts them to her arrival, Marinette has Tikki and Plagg turn her into Bug Noire again, but Nathalie reveals that she is not here to fight and surrenders.
She takes Bug Noire to the Kwami cage and releases the other Kwamis back into her custody, before Bug Noire uses her Miraculous Ladybug to undo the effects of Operation: Perfect Alliance.
After then traveling to London to free Adrien and Kagami and break the bad news to Adrien of his father's death, Bug Noire returns to Paris and sees to the destruction of The Crypt so Gabriel's crimes remain buried, before then going before the public and press as Ladybug to spin her lie that Gabriel died sacrificing himself to end Monarch's threat forever.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - "[[Miraculous London]]"
After she returns home that night, no sooner after Marinette falls asleep, Lila slips into her room akumatized as Spectral Looter and steals all of the Miraculous and Kwamis, including Tikki and Plagg, allowing her to summon Gimmi and make a wish.
Marinette is rescued by Bunnyx before the wish affects her, and using a past version of Tikki and the Ladybug Miraculous.
Marinette, as Chronobug, is able to prevent Lila from discovering her secret identity, thus preventing her from coming after the Miraculous and making her wish, saving the timeline and the universe.
Afterwards, to avoid something like this or with Felix as Flairmidable happening again, Marinette keeps Tikki with her while sending Plagg back to Cat Noir and the other Kwamis back to their holders on a permanent basis.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - "[[Miraculous Tokyo]]"
Tikki travels with Marinette, Kagami, and Longg to Tokyo under the surmise of helping the Stellar Force, but Marinette speaks privately to Tikki over how she believes Kagami has an ulterior motive for returning to her former hometown.
Tikki helps Marinette understand the Japanese language by popping into her head, allowing her to speak fluent Japanese and translate it as well.
When the Stellar Force face down a Kaiju attacking Tokyo, Tikki turns Marinette into Ladybug to try and help them.
After showing the Stellar Force that the Kaiju was a transformed taxi cab and its driver who was trapped inside and transformed with it, Ladybug departs to return to Kagami's grandmother's house.
That night, figuring out Kagami's ulterior motive for coming to Tokyo, Marinette has Tikki help her write a message to Kagami's former friends, using Kagami's cellphone while she's still asleep.
The next day, when they attend the festival being held in town, Marinette is able to go with Miki to find Kazuno, and witnesses them transform into their Steller Force identities of Leo and Capricorn when Tokyo is besieged by more Kaiju.

title: Tikki/History
text:
Tikki/History - "[[Miraculous Tokyo]]"
Having Tikki transform her into Ladybug again, Marinette goes to help, but is sent flying with Ryuko and Capricorn and separated from the others.
Figuring things out, Ladybug tells Ryuko to make amends with Capricorn while she tries to help the Stellar Force.
Using her Miraculous Ladybug, Ladybug is able to restore many of the victims to normal, but grows fatigued from it.
Luckily, Ryuko and Capricorn return, with Capricorn now having his self-confidence restored, and after summoning a battle mech Lucky Charm to join the Stellar Force in their battle mech, Ladybug is able to help defeat and restore the Kaiju to normal, before the Stellar Force use their own version of Ladybug's power of Creation to repair all the damage to the city from the Kaiju.
After the festival, Marinette, Tikki, Longg, and Kagami return to Paris.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Intro
This page covers the sequence of events in the universe of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir in the form of a timeline.
Most of the episodes of Season 1 have no direct correlation and almost never make references to each other, meaning there is no order needed apart from season premieres and finales. The episodes of Seasons 2 and 3 are mostly self-contained, though some episodes make references to previous episodes, necessitating a more specific order of events. Seasons 4 and 5 follow a serialized style, with almost every episode directly following either the previous episode or an earlier episode. Season 6 returns to a somewhat episodic format similar to Seasons 2 and 3, though it heavily references events from earlier seasons. This timeline organizes episodes based on their production codes, which almost always align with the chronology, unless there is some in-episode reference to the events of a later episode, and what appear to be continuity errors are noted.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
Eons Ago
About 13 billion years ago: The Big Bang brought the universe into existence, giving birth to Kwamis: sentient creatures who embody a single concept each. Tikki, the first kwami and character in the series, who embodies the concept of creation, was born shortly after The Big Bang.
With the creation of new concepts over the next several millennia, new kwamis embodying those concepts were born.
After that, several other parallel universes were created as well. The kwamis discovered that they live simultaneously in each one, gaining the knowledge and memories of all their counterparts from the other universes. Due to their long lifespans, many of them don't tell their owners about it unless in case of a serious emergency or crisis.
Unknown: A long time ago before the kwamis had their 'standard' forms, they had another form where they were humanoid giants.
Unknown: The kwamis continued their journey through the cosmos until they found their way to Earth. They discovered that they couldn't be seen by mortal creatures.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
Bunnyx is sent by Timetagger to the Cretaceous Era about 145-66 million years ago, where she fights a T. Rex named Denver, but she returns to the present almost instantly.
After retrieving the Rabbit Miraculous in "Evolution", present-day Bunnyx visited Brazil during the Cretaceous period, where she encountered the Vespersaurus paranaensis, a theropod.
About 66 million years ago: Plagg used Cataclysm for an unknown reason, which resulted in the extinction of the non-avian dinosaurs.
Unknown: Sometime after that, the kwamis discovered that they have limited control of their Miraculous powers when they use them without a holder. In addition to the intended use, inadvertent disasters related to their powers occur. For example:
When Tikki uses Lucky Charm, she creates many items.
When Plagg uses Cataclysm, mass destruction spreads from where the power is used.
When Trixx uses Mirage, he creates several illusions.
When Sass uses Second Chance, he brings various items and people from various points in time into the time he travelled to.
When Kaalki uses Voyage, she creates another Voyage portal which teleports something to a random location.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
About 13 million to 5 million years ago: The kwamis saw the first of humanity. Sadly, the kwamis couldn't be seen by humans, just like other creatures. Yet, they silently observed humans and over the years yearned to live with and help them.
Human values were introduced to the universe, creating renlings, the personifications of said values.
Sometime in the Late Pliocene through Middle Pleistocene, about 3.5 million to 700,000 years ago: The concept of transmission was introduced to the universe, thus a kwami embodying that concept, Nooroo, was born.
Bunnyx is sent by Timetagger to the Ice Age about 100,000 years ago, but she returns to the present almost instantly.
Before Common Era (B.C.E)
Unknown: The Prodigious, the Prodigious Box and Sacred Cave Key were made by an unknown person and served as a prototype for the Miraculouses.
The Renlings discovered that they can only be seen by the Renren and the person who wears the Prodigious.
That they can transform their holder into animals as long as that person shows the value the Renling represents.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
Unknown: Jīngrén de used the power of the Prodigious for unknown reasons, which had disastrous consequences. Judged to be too powerful to control, the Prodigious was sealed away in the Sacred Cave to be guarded by Mei Shi.
Unknown: Thousands of years ago, the Miraculouses were made along with the Miraculous tools by an unnamed mage in Ancient China. Through the creation of the jewels, the Kwamis gained their 'standard' forms. The Chinese Miracle Box was made, containing the Miraculouses.
Over time the Chinese Miracle Box, also called the Mother Box, was used to store dormant Miraculouses when they weren't needed.
After the Mother Miracle Box was created and the kwamis ended their tenures with their first owners they discovered a whole other miniature world is in said box and for the next thousands of years the kwamis collected various items from all around the world and throughout history as not only a reminder of their owners but adventures and to keep their inactive siblings entertained.
When the inactive kwamis are housed in the magical world the guardians discovered they have no way to communicate with them.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
Some time afterwards, the Native American Miracle Box and other Miracle Boxes were made for the same purpose as the first Miracle Box.
Unknown: The Order of the Guardians were established and set up a temple in the Himalayan Mountain Range in Tibet.
The Guardians learned that when the position of Guardian of a Miracle Box is passed on to someone else, the former Guardian loses their memory to protect the identities of their chosen Miraculous holders. To pass on this role, the Guardian must willingly state that they renounce ownership of the Box and name the person they wish to give the role to. This is similar to transferring ownership of a Miraculous.
The Guardians discovered the Miraculous potions, along with their ability to grant powered-up forms when consumed.
The ingredients of Miraculous potions can be contained inside a food item and be consumed by either a Kwami (before the holder's transformation) or the transformed Miraculous holder.

title: Timeline
text:

Unknown: In Ancient China during an unknown crisis, Piáo Chóng becomes the first Ladybug Miraculous holder. During her time as said holder, she had activated her aqua powers for an unknown mission and received a kwagatama from Tikki as symbol of friendship between them.

The Bee Miraculous, Butterfly Miraculous, Turtle Miraculous, Dragon Miraculous, Fox Miraculous, Peacock Miraculous, Horse Miraculous, Snake Miraculous and many more were used by several Chinese citizens. The kwamis discovered their powers are more manageable when used with a holder:
Tikki discovered with Piáo Chóng that instead of creating many objects, the user only gets one.
Plagg discovered with Hēi Māo that his destruction is limited.
Longg discovered with Lóng:
The power of Wind Dragon makes the holder "as elusive as the wind" - they are transformed into a large cloud of air and can generate and control strong winds.
The power of Water Dragon makes the holder "as powerful as the flood" - they are transformed into water, and can create and manipulate floods of water.

title: Timeline
text:

Kaalki discovered with Mǎ that she doesn't create random voyage portals.
Sass discovered with Shé that he had better control over his leaps through time, and that the holder remembers every timeline where Second Chance was in use but time was reverted. This means that they are the keeper of any possible secrets from a revised timeline, while others around them can only see the final reality.
With every revised timeline, everyone's progress is undone including the user's leading to them to choosing their words and actions carefully but also be flexibly their plans.
While active with owners, the kwamis discovered that they must stay close to them in case of danger or trouble.
When transformed they can't directly talk with their owners but they do have a level of awareness.
Upon their first owners, the kwamis discovered they can understand them, enabling them to speak Chinese.

title: Timeline
text:

Not only that they began to sure up other defenses like knowing how to repel akumas implying that guardians were akumatized in the past before.

title: Timeline
text:

text:
