title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
France, 1431: Jeanne d'Arc, a French warrior in the Hundred Years' War, became the Ladybug Miraculous holder, Scarlet Fate, to fight against the English serving Dark Grimalkin. However they were manipulated by their respective monarchs into fighting each other, even if that meant the suffering of the people, but the compassion she and Dark Grimalkin had for the innocent lives who their ruthless rulers made miserable put an end to their fighting and caused the two superheroes to fall in love. They lived together in secret until they were caught and sentenced to die for treason, with Jeanne being sentenced to die by fire at the stake, but she managed to escape. Then, she and Dark Grimalkin abdicated their Miraculous to live in peace together.
In her time as the Ladybug Miraculous holder, Jeanne d'Arc was on a quest to slay a dragon for unknown reasons, received a kwagatama from Tikki and sometime after her death Jeanne's spirit memory was summoned by at least one of her successors for advice on at least one occasion.
Europe, late 15th century: an unknown knight became the holder of the Cat Miraculous.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
Between the 15th and 21st century, Plagg used Cataclysm for an unknown reason, resulting in the extinction of dragons.
Namibia, 16th century: an OmuHimba girl became the Ladybug Miraculous holder known as Mudekudeku.
Europe, 16th century: An unknown woman became the Ancient European Rabbit Miraculous holder.
Florence, Italy, 1517: While protecting the Rabbit Miraculous, present-day Bunnyx used Burrow to travel back in time to meet Leonardo da Vinci when he was finishing the Mona Lisa. She met Lisa del Giocondo, the woman who posed for the Mona Lisa, but she promised Leonardo to keep Lisa's identity a secret.
Korea, Imjin War, 1592-1598: an unknown Korean woman became the Ladybug Miraculous holder known as Mudangbeolle and a Korean army general, Yi Sun-sin, obtained an unknown Miraculous, using it until his death in 1598.
France, 1622: King Louis XIII created a group of guards dedicated to protecting him and the royal family called the musketeers among them was Charles D'Artagnan and the Three Musketeers including a French Musketeer girl that became the Ladybug Miraculous holder as La Coccinelle.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
While protecting the Rabbit Miraculous, present-day Bunnyx used Burrow to travel back in time to meet them. There, she learned that one of the Musketeers, Aramis, was actually a woman and the holder of the Ladybug.
Europe, the 17th century: An unknown kwami was active and collected a rocking horse which was stored in the Miracle Box.
Unknown - Ancient History
An unknown person became the Butterfly Miraculous holder.
An unknown person became the Ladybug Miraculous holder.
Plagg met the Genie in the Lamp.
Throughout history, many more Miraculouses were lost all over the world; some were from the guardian or Miraculous holders or forgotten about.
At some point, Orikko and his past owners discovered that:
The Rooster Miraculous owner can charge the tip of the Fountain Pen with magical gold-orange energy, then writing out the intended power on the palm of their hand, then they have to touch their hand to their chest with the hand they wrote on, causing a ripple of gold-orange energy to spread across their torso, then gaining the intended ability.
Sublimation can't copy or duplicate other kwamis' Miraculous superpowers.
Sublimation can't grant a superpower that is a wish.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
Sublimation can't use a power that interferes with another kwamis' magic.
Any power chosen by Sublimation is not automatically infallible. And the user's opponent can trick the power's workings, such as enhanced sense of smell, if its trail is hidden or passed on to someone else. If the wielder chooses to turn invisible but is covered in sticky substances, turning invisible does no good.
The holder can grant a condition that the chosen power can be used multiple times.
If the power the user gives themselves involves bestowing a new property onto something, then the power itself will manifest as a gold-orange glow on their hands, which they can bestow on the target by touching it, at which point the glow will vanish.
If the user exists as multiple but separate (but still one and the same) beings, then one can give themself a power with Sublimation and it can be used by the other being.
If the user also has the superpower of the Mouse Miraculous, Multitude, then only one of them will need to activate Sublimation and all of the user's clones will have the chosen power granted to them as well.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
Sublimation cannot restore the memories of a guardian whose memories of the Miraculouses were erased after passing on the Miracle Box, due to the nature of the spell used to erase a former guardian's memories, being related to the Miracle Box itself, therefore connected to the power of the kwamis.
At some point, Kaalki and her other owners discovered:
If the location of where the holder wishes to teleport has no space, then they can not go through the portal.
Also, the power of Voyage can be used for attacking by allowing the user to appear from anywhere they can fight and attack from anywhere. Then, once that's done enough times, the opponent will be totally exhausted.
Give off a sound that can make the opponent aware of the user's location.
The user can also choose the size of the portal they open, it can be big enough to transport entire monuments or buildings, or small enough to transport small things quietly or serve as a window to spy on others.
The portal does not necessarily have to be a vertical like a doorway, it can be horizontal if the user chooses.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
In this case, the user can teleport by falling or jumping down into the portal, or it can be used against enemies as a pitfall, forcibly teleporting them to a place that puts them in a disadvantageous situation.
Voyage can also be used for defense, the user can open a portal to teleport the incoming attack, and/or the charging attacker away, effectively making the portal a shield.
It takes a moment for the portal to close completely, meaning that after the user teleports away, the users opponent would have a brief opportunity to jump through the portal after them before it closes.
At some point, Wayzz and his owners discovered that:
The force field is strong, but not completely impenetrable.
The power of the Shell-ter's shield can be broken by another form of miraculous magic.
If the user of Shell-ter also has the Ox Miraculous superpower, Resistance, then the two powers can be combined to make the barrier impervious to superpowers, effectively making it truly impenetrable.
Assuming the user can use Shell-ter more than once, they would only be able to materialize and maintain one barrier at a time.
The barrier can be bypassed by the power of the Horse Miraculous, Voyage.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
The barrier is transparent, however, the view can be obscured if the barrier is covered with something, such as ink.
The Turtle Miraculous owner can dematerialize the barrier by speaking the cancellation phrase: "Unshield".
The barrier is also portable; it can move and follow anyone it's surrounding, as well fall to the ground when they do.
This also means that if the barrier is only protecting a single body part, then the barrier will follow the user the same way a normal piece of armor would when it's being worn.
The force field is incredibly strong and durable, enough that it can endure a massive, incredibly heavy structure.
Its size and shape can vary as the user wishes; in terms of its size, it has so far been seen to range from being small enough to protect only a single body part.
Shell-ter doesn't have to be perfect a sphere or a dome, it can be in the shape of a long spheroid.
At some point, Longg and her owners discovered:
The user cannot only turn into the elements but control them too.
However, these powers cannot be used to infiltrate a place that is air tight.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
Since the user has three different powers to choose from, they may end up choosing the wrong power by mistake if they don't know what their allies are planning.
At some point, Stompp and his owners discovered:
That even though that the power of Resistance can protect the user from another miraculous holder's power but not indirect damage.
That if someone who's currently under the effects of Resistance puts on or holds an object after they activated the power, the object in question will be unprotected.
Doesn't protect the user's body from something that doesn't count as an attack or at least the weakness of another power.
When the user is hit with a superpower and Resistance cancels it out, that same blue glow will briefly reappear in a ripple pattern on whatever part of the users body was struck.
While the user of Resistance cannot be effected by superpowers, they can be restrained, even if the restraint in question is a magic one.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
The power of Resistance protects the user and nothing else; while the user's own body is made impervious to superpowers, their surroundings aren't protected. Even if the user is a buffer between the power and the ground, if the power is on a large enough scale, it will still inflict damage on the user's surroundings.
Resistance cannot protect the user from their memories of the previous timeline from being erased when the Snake Miraculous' power, Second Chance is used.
At some point, Daizzi and his other owners discovered:
Depending on how the Gift is used, it can cause the enemy to live out an illusionistic dream, ending up in misery or sadness.
The gift box can be thrown, so the user does not actually have to be right in front of the target when activating the power.
When the box is opened, it reveals an image of the deepest wish in the target's heart. This wish is seen through a floating ball of light about the size of a shot put ball.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
Gift is meant to grant happiness and joy to the target, so it can be used to cheer someone up just as easily as it can pacify an enemy. Since this power enhances happiness and positivity, it is also capable of driving off forces that feed off negative emotions.
The power can be used on more than one person at a time, as long as those people are standing very close together. When it hits multiple people at once, their deepest wishes are combined into one joint dream.
A victim under the effect of this power can be awoken from their trance by a disturbance in their real-world surroundings, such as the ringing of an alarm clock. The disturbance in question would repeatedly appear in the dream in various, but consistent forms, causing the victim to realize that they are in a dream, allowing the victim to choose to wake up.
Gift can also be used to show someone a specific happy dream of the users choosing.
Gift can also force its target to live a hallucinatory dream of their greatest desire, instead of merely showing them a vision of it.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
Being trapped in the dream dulls the senses, making the victim not realize that they got trapped in the Gift and causing them to believe everything they experience, no matter how obviously absurd.
Additionally, time is compressed within the dreamscape; in the span of a few seconds of real world time.
The user of Gift can look into the orb without getting mesmerized and see the victim's desire.
At some point, Trixx and her owners discovered:
That their illusions won't be accurate if the user isn't focused or doesn't know what their illusion is suppose to look like.
The power is as limited as the knowledge the user has of the thing the illusion appears to be. Furthermore, the user must also have enough knowledge about the traits and mannerisms of the animals, things or people they cast with their illusions, otherwise someone with greater knowledge might get suspicious of the inaccuracies, being able to tell what's real and what's fake.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
They mostly revolve around sight and sound, so if someone or something has an acute sense of smell, they might be able to tell an illusion apart from the real one and the illusions aren't solid, with the exception of the illusions interacting with each other, so if someone touches the illusion, it will vanish.
The user can hear and see through their illusions, even from far distances.
Not only can the owner of the Fox Miraculous make visual illusions of people or objects, but also "sound illusions".
Illusions of people are able to speak, even having the same voice as the real person.
They can only act as the cast wants, meaning they don't automatically react the same way real people do.
Though the illusion disappears if touched, if it is made up of multiple separate entities, multiple illusory clones of the user for example, touching one of the entities would cause only that one to disappear. The rest of the illusion would continue to exist and function.
At some point Pollen and her owners discovered:
That Venom can be used on creatures or victims that the possess the ability of intangibility such as akumatized victims or kwamis.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
It's equally effective if a victim is stung on their bare skin or clothing such as a Miraculous users magical super suit.
Someone under the effects aren't only stiff, but they are also unable to see, hear, or think.
Adult Bee Miraculous holder can release the victims from the paralysis by snapping their fingers.
If the victim is one of a set of clones, then only one of the clones will be effected by this power, the one who actually gets stung. All of the other's will go unaffected.
The user has to get in close to their target in order to sting them, this means that the user would have to get past enemies' defenses and avoid their opponents attacks' before they can use Venom on them.
The Venom shot can also be destroyed and nullified by the Cataclysm.
If Venom is used on a being that has the ability to fly, then the victim will stop flying and will start landing.
At some point, Barkk and her owners discovered:
If the ball touches a Miraculous tool, the connection between them will be broken when the user of that tool de-transforms and the tool disappears.
Adult holders of the Dog Miraculous can mark with the ball as many objects as they want, and can retrieve in the order they want.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
The Ball is clearly visible when Fetch is used to retrieve something, making it difficult to use the power discretely.
The object does not necessarily appear in the users hands. It can be transported to whatever part of their body they deem appropriate, such as it appearing under the users foot.
The power of Fetch not only retrieves the object itself, but also whatever is inside the object.
The ball can only fly so fast, so the marked object could move or be moved faster than the ball can chase after it.
The user can mark multiple objects with a single touch, if the object the user touches is part of the greater whole; for example, for a stack of doilies, the user would only need to touch the one on top in order to mark the whole stack, or for a collection of paper flowers, the user would only need to touch one of the flower in order to mark them all.
Fetch can be used in unison with the Rabbit Miraculous superpower, Burrow. The user can go back to the past to touch the object with the ball, then when the user returns to the present, the connection between the ball and the marked object remains and the user is able to use the power to retrieve that object.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
The power is also capable of retrieving living beings as well.
At some point, Ziggy and her past owners discovered that:
Genesis can't create magical objects.
The objects produced through Genesis can be destroyed or disintegrated by Cataclysm.
Even though it can't produce objects that are themselves magical, it can produce objects that can utilize external magic, such as a crossbow that can shoot magic arrows that never miss their target.
The object can be made to appear anywhere the user desires, whether they want it to appear right next to them or even all the way in outer space.
Genesis can also be used to produce multiple objects in one usage, if those objects are all part of the same object.
At some point, Tikki and her owners discovered:
Akumatized/kamikotized objects can break before the person holding it was akumatized/kamikotized. If the object is broken in that condition, the object must be restored to a whole piece then broken again.
If the holder releases the akuma/kamiko, but does not purify it, the akuma/kamiko will escape and multiply. Also, if the akuma copies touch any civilian, those people will turn into frozen copies of the akumatized/kamikotized victim.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
The original akuma/kamiko will return to the Butterfly Miraculous holder's cane, and once their previous champion has strong emotions enough to get akumatized/kamikotized again, he will become in the possession of the frozen copies, and those will return to life, serving as an army.
That they don't always need a Lucky Charm to solve their problems.
Sometimes the lucky charm can be used as a revelation than a solution.
Any Ladybug Miraculous holder can use a Lucky Charm object to repair the damage done by any other form of Miraculous magic even if they're not the object's summoner.
The object doesn't have to be completely intact for the Miraculous Ladybug superpower to work.
If the Snake and Ladybug Miraculous holders are enemies and the Snake holder doesn't wait until the Ladybug's powers used up, the Lucky Charm will just adapt and change according to the situation. But if they're allies, then the Lucky Charm object will stay fixed as long as said ally finds a way for the object to be used for its intended use.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
Not only can it be used to defeat the Ladybug Miraculous holder's enemies but also help them and their allies out of a jam, remind them to seek help.Warn the holder of danger or can be used to solve more than one problem.
If they lose the Lucky Charm, then the damage can't repair the damage.
When a Ladybug Miraculous holder becomes an adult, they can summon as many Lucky Charm objects they need or want as well as dispell them by turning them into different objects.
The same object can be used in different situations or later on in the future.
That the magic ladybugs can:
Healing those who were hurt.
Fixing broken items whose destruction is what caused the crisis in the first place.
Undoing the effects of what the villain has done.
Any damage caused by the heroes themselves.
Returning displaced people to where they are supposed to be.
Returning displaced celestial bodies back to their proper orbit.
Undoing the effects of the strain young holders have suffered if they've used their Miraculouses for evil.
It is even capable of repairing anomalies in the space-time continuum, such as by combining past and future selves back into a single being.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
The magic ladybugs don't work under certain conditions:
If there is no Ladybug Miraculous holder present during the crisis.
If the lucky charm is a fake object.
Cannot retrieve lost Miraculouses, but they can fix them if they have been damaged during recent crisis.
Cannot restore a Sentimonster whose Amok has been released.
However, if the Sentimonster itself was destroyed, but their amok is still intact and inside their Amokized object, then the Sentimonster can be brought back with the magic ladybugs.
Cannot revert anything on a mental and/or emotional state, unless the change in mind and/or emotion was directly caused by the crisis, such as it being done by an akumatized villain's powers.
Cannot restore a former guardian's memories when they pass their role due to the Guardian's code.
Cannot restore memories from a timeline that was undone by the power of Second Chance.
They can't heal those that were damaged by the jewels alone unless they were attacked directly by jewel's powers.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
It has been implied that they cannot revive deceased people but they can revive people that were on the receiving end of lethal attacks during the recent crisis. This includes anything that would cause them to be erased from existence.
Cannot fix anything that's broken before an akumatized or amokized champion shows up, unless the object breaking is what caused them to show up as seen in "Timebreaker".
At some point, Nooroo and his past owners discovered:
If the Butterfly Miraculous is used for good, the butterflies will become kamikos, and the power will be called Kamikotization.
But if is used for evil, the butterflies will become akumas, and the power will be called akumatization.
That their akumatized/kamikotized champions can rebel against their masters, can have a strong enough will to break free of a holder's control ,and as well as enough power to kill their masters.
The link will be broken if the champion is knockout or unconscious.
Even before the person becomes akumatized/kamikotized, they can reject the offer by breaking the object, or even the contact link.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
The maximum contact distance between an akumatized/kamikotized and their master is 150 miles. If the mileage exceeds this amount, the holder will not be able to make contact with his champion, and in addition his akuma/kamiko.
Depending on the champion, additional objects not infected by the akuma/kamiko can become their weapons.
The holder can akumatize/kamikotize not just one person, but a group. However, the akuma/kamiko must infect a specific object that is under the command of such a group.
The holder can reuse an akuma/kamiko from another champion without having to create another one.
Even though the Miraculous holder is telepathically linked to any akumatized/kamikotized champion or victim, regardless of where or when they're from, it can be hard for the holder to find them if they don't know what their champions look like unakumatized/unkamikotized.
If someone overcomes their negative emotions before being infected, the Akuma will ignore the intended target and go for the closest source of negative emotions, with or without the user's consent. This will continue as long as the Akuma manages to infect an object.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
The victim's body must be strong enough to hold the transformation. If not, the transformation will drop and the champion will lose their powers.
The Butterfly Miraculous owner can also choose to akumatize/kamikotize themself, though they would first have to de-transform after empowering the akuma/kamiko.
An Akuma/Kamiko can inhabit multiple objects at once, as long as they are all basically pieces of a whole; a stack of pamphlets for example.
In this case, if one of the objects is broken, only a fragment of the Akuma/Kamiko will be released in the form of a dark mist.
All the objects need to broken to release the Akuma/Kamiko completely.
If two Butterfly Miraculous holders have the same power then they can equally akumatized or kamikotized a target to one up the other.
Unlike with akumatized villains, kamikotized heroes are given a feeling of hope by the holder, which allows them to accept the power and convinced to do good with it, either by saving people or fighting villains.
At some point, Duusu and his other owners discovered that:
Sentimonsters when being hit from Cataclysm can go berserk.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
But even though the link with the object is broken, the sentimonster can still be destroyed, either by the Peacock Miraculous holder releasing the amok or by breaking the amokized object.
Notably, when used on a human sentimonster, instead of going berserk, they will react in pain and agony like a normal human, or lessen the damage if they are using something to protect them such as a magic super suit.
A Sentimonster can also be formed to give powers related to themselves and to the holder of their amok.
Even if a holder did not create them, they can bring dormant sentimonsters back to life, or even be released from existence by their amoks.
Sentimonsters only obey whoever has the object with the amok.
If a sentimonster's amok is duplicated somehow, all of the Amoks must be released, captured, and purified before the Sentimonster can disappear.
The emotions that embody sentimonsters can fail if the powers aren't chosen by the condition of the recipient.
An Amok can inhabit multiple objects, if those objects are pieces of a whole, and separated, the pieces will not have any negative consequences on the Sentimonster.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
Each person is given equal control of the creature giving it either partial freedom or a counter order if one of the holder's of the pieces is unconscious or not.
But it results in all pieces needing to be united for the sentimonster to be destroyed and if one piece is destroyed but the other isn't then the sentimonster will survive.
They can also be created inside of another person with seemingly no ill effects.
If the object containing the Amok is broken, the Amok will be released and the Sentimonster will disappear into nothingness.
However, minor damages don't release the amok and the sentimonster will not erased from existence, but they will faint until the amokized object is fixed.
If the process happens in reverse the sentimonster can be restored by the Ladybug restoration power.
An amok can remain in the object even after the Peacock Miraculous holder who used it and/or the recipient of said amok have died/passed away, and therefore the resulting Sentimonster will continue to exist as well.
Sentimonsters are not even necessarily living beings, it all depends on how they were conceived during the creation process.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
A human Sentimonster can even be a Miraculous holder; they can even use the Peacock Miraculous to create their own Sentimonsters.
If a broken amokized object is fixed before the amok is released from it, then it's possible to prevent that from happening, in this way preventing the sentimonster from disappearing.
The longer an amok is inside an object, the longer it will take for it to be released, if it is not intended by the one that breaks the object.
At some point during the past, Mullo and her other owners discovered:
All the clones are mentally linked, so they would know what each clone made even would do if they are separated.
The user can choose to shrink only a couple of inches (or a couple meters, depending on the size of the user) and make clones of themselves that are only slightly smaller than their normal height, however, this can only happen with a small number of clones.
The size of the clones is inversely proportional to the number, the more clones there are, the smaller the user and the clones become.
Any item the user is in possession of at the time of the powers activation will also be shrunken and duplicated along with them.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
The user's and the Clones' small size makes them unsuitable for physical battle, so they must outsmart their opponents in a fight.
At some point, Plagg and his owners discovered:
That the powers of Cataclysm won't work on liquids, gases, against Resistance or if their hands are bound.
Becomes more dangerous if used for evil.
Destroy miraculouses returning kwamis to their natural state breaking their connection to the mortal world.
If anyone gets hit with a cataclysm but not healed by its counterpart it will cause a magical necrosis that will spread over time on their body, eventually killing them.
The exact effect of Cataclysm depends on what it's used on:
Fragile solid materials like minerals would break and fall apart.
Metals would corrode and crumble.
Organic materials like wood, plastic or cloth would be charred and crumble into ashes.
Technology will go haywire or malfunction.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
A sentimonster would not be destroyed, but would go berserk, similar to a bee sting on a bull causing the link between them and their amokized object or a transformed Peacock Miraculous user would be severed, making them uncontrollable but even though the link with the object is broken, the sentimonster can still be destroyed, either by the Peacock Miraculous holder releasing the amok or by breaking the amokized object.
Notably, when used on a human sentimonster, instead of going berserk, they will react in pain and agony like a normal human, or lessen the damage if they are using something to protect them such as a magic super suit.
Once the power is activated, it cannot be deactivated until it is used on something if used by a minor but for an adult holder they can expand it's range giving it more power, to the point where they can completely deactivate it and use it multiple times.
On occasion they also discovered that Cataclysm can also cause natural disasters such as volcanic eruptions.
At some point, Fluff and her owners discovered:

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
Due to the severity of the Rabbit Miraculous powers they are only allowed to use the watch as a last resort when all the other Miraculouses fail or in extreme emergencies.
Can use Burrow as many times as they wish without de-transforming, independently of being adults or minors but if a minor de-transforms, they suffer from a temporary temporal anomalies.
Even though anyone can pass through the Burrow, only the Rabbit holders can change the destination of the portals, open them and can send others through time without bringing themselves along.
Learned that the pocket dimension is at the center of all the time flow and is shared by all the Rabbit Miraculous holders, regardless of what point in time they're from.
If the user's mind isn't focused then the destinations of the portals are going to be totally at random or the burrow dimension itself will choose where and when the traveler(s) need to go.
The portal into the pocket dimension does not necessarily have to be a vertical like a doorway, it can be horizontal like a hole or tilted diagonally if the user chooses.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
In this case, the user will enter the pocket dimension from a window that is at the same angle as the portal they came through.
The pocket dimension is shown to have no physical up or down, meaning that anyone inside it can walk anywhere and in any direction without needing a ground to support them, including vertically through the air, although, this does not prevent someone from falling all the way through if it benefits them.
Another portal into the Burrow can be opened, even before the first portal closes.
The circular portal windows inside Burrow just show blurry colors until someone actually interacts with them; then they show a clear image of a point in time, even voices and sounds can be heard from inside the Burrow.
Each portal can be made to "fast-forward", "pause" or "rewind" by swiping one's hand across it like a touchscreen.
While anyone can interact with the portals like this, only the Rabbit Miraculous users can open them.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
The "fast-forwarding" and "rewinding" features does not simply show the previous events that happen in a certain location, but rather follows one's expectations, allowing the user to track a target through time as well as observe their personal history.
The portals to the future change accordingly with the events that happen in the past and/or present, meaning, if a change happens in one of them, the future is rewritten progressively.
If the two Rabbit Miraculous holders are fighting against each other, then they would both have equal control over the Burrow and would be able to use it to one-up each other.
At some point, Sass and his owners discovered:
They must never use it when sick or hurt as it will speed up their conditions.
If used by an enemy of the Ladybug or Cat Miraculous holders, then it must be used after the Ladybug and Cat superpowers are used.
If not, the Lucky Charm will continue to adapt and change itself to fit the situation but if the power is used by an ally, then the object will stay fixed as long as said ally finds a way for the object to be used for its intended use.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
The power can be triggered by anyone not just the user, but the same thing still happens as everyone else would forget while the Snake Miraculous holder would remember.
Can't be used in situations that are simply unwinnable, even with infinite chances.
An adult holder, who is able to use the power multiple times without de-transforming, is capable of overwriting the marked moment with a new one, achieved with the same action used to mark the initial moment.
If the user is intercepted, trapped, or otherwise put in a disadvantageous position before they have a chance to mark a moment, then they would be unable to go back to before they were in that bad situation, thereby making it so there is no point in using the power.
If someone knows about Second Chance, they can think ahead of the user.
At some point, Xuppu and his owners discovered:
That if the power of Uproar is used on a Miraculous holder, the victim can cancel out the effect's by de-transforming and transforming back again.
It only affects superpowers not enhanced abilities.
If the victim is one of a set of clones, then all the clones will be affected by this power if one of them gets hit by the toy.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
If the ability being disrupted takes the form of a power within one's own body, then it will go haywire.
If the ability takes the form of an external object or entity, then it will be transformed into something ridiculous.
If the victim has more than one superpower, then Uproar can be used to disrupt multiple of the victims powers at once.
The Ox Miraculous' Resistance can cancel out the effect of Uproar.
At some point, Liiri and his owners discovered:
Liberation can nullify limitations that the target didn't put on themselves or are innate to them, and that were put in them through other means, even magical ones.
Once the Eagle Miraculous owner frees someone of their metaphysical restrictions, the recipients remain free even if the Eagle Miraculous is stolen and used by someone else.
The user must be careful in choosing the binds they wish to break, or else the person being freed may go out of control, following their every whim without any concern for the consequences.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
While Liberation can embolden people, it cannot increase or enhance their abilities, nor can it give them any additional abilities. It can only give people the courage to utilize the potential that they already have.
Someone who has been freed of their restrictions can be very predictable and can therefore be tricked and taken advantage of.
At some point, Roaar and her owners discovered:
That Clout has the most potential for collateral damage.
It's impact generates a loud boom and a giant cloud of thick purple smoke, making it very easy for an enemy to locate the user.
Regardless of the users size and strength, it appears that Clout has a set amount of power.
Objects sent flying by the super punch are not unstoppable, they can be diverted by the power of Wind Dragon and blocked by the power of Shell-ter.
The actual impact of Clout carries tremendous blunt force and is powerful enough to generate a very wide and strong shock wave capable of demolishing buildings and/or leaving a large crater in its aftermath.
Even a Miraculous holder, whose magic super suit make them nearly invulnerable, can barely handle a hit from Clout.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
The super punch can also be used to send the target, even a very large and heavy one, flying a very far distance at high speeds, allowing the user to send their opponent flying away or send a projectile toward them at high speeds.
Resistance can cancel out the effect of Clout.
In the unique circumstances that the power is duplicated, then it can be turned against itself, resulting in massive super-explosion when the punches collide, thus incapacitating the users.
At some point, unknown people were chosen by the guardians to be Miraculous holders in Australia, India, Maldives, Tibet, Norway and numerous other places around the world.
At some point, the Miraculous holders discovered that:
They can they set other rules that their kwami cannot disobey, such as set limits for how far away from them they are allowed to go, and not being able to speak, making the kwami completely mute.
Sometimes they don't only look like the animals their miraculouses are based on but they may also develop the behavior patterns of the animals their based on.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
If Miraculouses are removed without intentionally verbally renouncing them, the kwami is not pulled back into their Miraculous. The kwami will only disappear if the owner wants to get rid of the Miraculous or the jewel is forced off and has been reclaimed by the guardian.
While the appearance of the Miraculouses in charged mode are always the same, camouflaged mode is different for each user, changing color and even shape to match wearers sense of style.
A person only stops being a Miraculous holder if they actually renounce the Miraculous. Even if a Miraculous is stolen, the previous owner or guardian is still a kwami's holder just as much as the new holder who stole their Miraculous.
There were few wielders that were aware of the unconstrained version of their kwami's powers but only used them in emergencies.
If a kwami has an object stuck on them when their owner transformed, it damages the holder's powers, leading to disastrous results.
The Miraculouses' unification ability started to be used.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
A Miraculous holder figured out how to change the appearance of their Miraculous suit by focusing on specific parts of their personality, also can change their suits if they need to play a specific role. Plagg or Trixx were either at the discovery of this property of the Miraculouses' transformation abilities or was informed of it through someone who was. They can also change their suits to show growth, resolve and age.
Sometime ago, an unknown Miraculous holder fused too many Miraculouses together, resulting in said holder suffering electrical shocks and losing their mind.
If kwamis are overexerted from excessive use of their powers and they don't refuel with food nor rest, then their powers will become weak overtime and cause a severe hindrance to them and their Miraculouses' holder when powering their transformation, possibly making the kwami lose their physical form, leaving them unable to communicate with organic life.
Through unknown circumstances, there were incidents where the Miraculouses were damaged, destroyed and caused severe harm to their owners.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
Such as one use of a damaged Peacock Miraculous results in the user having 15 years left to live symptoms also include: fatigue, coughing, dizzy spells, then over time the person will be immobile unless they use walk supports but after that they will be completely bedridden with their conditions getting worse, soon bags develop under their eyes, skin will go pale, and hair will start graying. Then the final toll the user will be put in an endless sleep and overusing a damaged Miraculous will result in the effects spreading faster shortening the user's time to a year.
Another sign that a holder can tell that if their Miraculous is damaged is if the jewel glitches between it's changing modes.
To deal with this problem, the guardians obtained the knowledge on how to repair them.
The quantum masking from the kwami's magic is made to confuse humans minds but it doesn't always work while masking their scent.
The Miraculous holders also discovered that some parts of their suits can be removed while transformed like belts or weapons while the others can't like the masks.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
Sometimes through mishaps and accidents the holders discovered that they can end up stuck in their holders forms or when they do de-transform sometimes it can be transferred to the kwamis.
They discovered that it's very unwise to transform with a kwami that's in a hunger food crazy sometimes even influencing them to chow down on whatever the kwami has a hunger for.
That the Miraculous transformations can modify or temporarily completely fix those with impairments such as bad eyesight.
Due to some unknown incident the guardians strictly put the Miraculouses under the use of adults.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
At some point, it was uncovered by the miraculous holders that using the special superpowers uses vital energy from both the Kwami, and holder. It's one thing for an adult holder, but for an underage holder, who is less physically and mentally capable of handling the strain, there is a security system in place that limits them to only using their special power once and causes them to de-transform before it becomes dangerous. However, using the Miraculous for evil overrides the limiter, allowing an underage holder to use them to their full potential. But due to them being unable to handle the strain; dark veins of corruption will gradually spread across their body, and they will inevitably be destroyed.
At some point during the past, the miraculous holders used post office pigeons to communicate with other holders that were far from them.
Then aside from their Miraculous superpowers the kwamis discovered they had other abilities and things about themselves:
Despite their godlike status the kwamis discovered that they can get sick and would need to be healed by guardian.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
At some point, the kwamis discovered that because of their appearances and small size, they can disguise themselves as dolls or toys when separated from their owners or discovered by someone.
When gathered in the Miracle Box on a certain day once every several centuries kwamis either active or inactive can communicate with kwamis that are missing on their cycles by singing.
The kwamis discovered in their standard forms even thought they can go intangible it doesn't pass on to objects even the Miraculouses their connected too.
They created their own version of Eeny, Meany, Miney, Moe.
When some of them gained their physical forms they discovered they're partially color blinded.
The kwamis discovered if the Miraculous they're connected too are destroyed, then they go back to the way they were before the jewels were made cut off from the physical plane of existence.
At some point the kwamis of the Mother Box appointed Sass their defacto leader.
When the Miraculous a kwami is connected to is damaged, it's harmful to them too but to a lesser extent resulting possibly in sporadic or a change in a kwami's behavior or as Duusu described it "having a mind filled with chaos".

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Ancient History
In rare incidents not all kwamis know the identity of the guardian that has ownership of the Miracle Box their Miraculous came from if they are separated.
Interestingly outside of an owner verbally renouncing their jewels the spell has no effect when a kwami's owner (or at least a previous owner) dies they can speak their owner's name freely.
Sometimes, depending on certain situations, emergencies or a great deal of time, kwamis would often return to the home cities, towns, countries of their previous owners, but come under the ownership of new holders.
If they become separated from their chosen owners kwamis can work with temporary ones until their original owners can be found.
If the task of being a wielder is too great for them or least if the holder doesn't meet the kwamis expectations they can convince their owners to surrender their jewels without saying the renounce command and begin their search for new owners under their own judgement if a guardian doesn't or can't intervene or has their permission.

title: Timeline
text:

18th century

France, 1757: Gilbert du Motier was born.
North America, sometime after 1776: After Lieutenant General Gilbert du Motier found the Eagle Miraculous, he used it during the Battle of Yorktown to help George Washington win the battle and the war of the American Revolution and before Gilbert returned to France, he gave George his saber and the Eagle Miraculous as a sign of friendship between the two countries.
19th century
After 1804: The Eagle Miraculous ended up the New York City Museum.
Sometime in the 1800's-1820's: Marinette's great-great-great-grandfather designed clothes for Beijing opera performances.
Sometime in the late 1800's to 21st century: Plagg came across dairy free and canned cheese and hated it so much it became his greatest fear.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Recent History
Near the end of the Mexican colonial period: Mexican girl known as La Mariquita became the Ladybug Miraculous holder and fought in the Mexican War of Independence between 1810 to 1821.
Sometime before 1826: Ziggy's last point of activity before Nathaniel became Caprikid was before the creation of photography.
When photographs, cameras and sound recordings were invented, the kwamis learned that they cannot be seen in pictures or heard on recordings.
1829: Wang Fu is born.
Vietnam, 1821-1830: a Vietnamese girl became the Ladybug Miraculous holder known as Bọ rùa.
Sometime between 1834-1841: When Fu was a child, he was chosen to become a Guardian.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Recent History
1843: Fu, while hungry in the midst of his guardian training, used the Peacock Miraculous to create a sentimonster to bring him food. However, the ravenous sentimonster destroyed the Guardians' temple and devoured everything in it such as the monks and all the Miraculouses except for the Miraculouses inside the Chinese Miracle Box and the Grimoire a monk had managed to save and give it to Fu, telling him to run. During his escape, the Butterfly Miraculous, Peacock Miraculous, and Grimoire were lost in the nearby mountains. This made Fu the last living member of the Order of the Guardians.
Sometime in 1868: An unknown kwami collected a typewriter and stored inside the Chinese Miracle Box.
Somewhere in the 1870s: An unknown kwami collected a high wheel bicycle as a souvenir placed it inside the Chinese Miracle Box.
Sometime before 1886: Kaalki's last point of activity before Max became Pegasus was before the creation of the car.
1877-1940: Master Fu obtained a phonograph to hide the Chinese Miracle Box.
1880's: The first generation of Knightowl and Sparrow came to the world in New York City.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Recent History
1889 or after: An unknown kwami collected and stored a jukebox inside the Chinese Miracle Box.
20th Century
1903, while protecting the Rabbit Miraculous, present-day Bunnyx used Burrow to travel back in time to meet Orville and Wilber Wright when they created the first airplane.
After the Wright Brothers created the first airplane, present-day Bunnyx intended to visit Santos Dumont, the one who disputes with the Wright brothers for the title as the inventor of the airplane.
1930's: Through unknown means while in Scotland, Trixx got out of the Miracle Box used Mirage for fun to create the Loch Ness Monster.
Before World War II: Wang Fu arrived in Paris and met Marianne. Both became close friends, leading to Fu telling her of his responsibility as the Guardian of the Chinese Miracle Box. They soon developed feelings for each other.
France, 1940: During the Battle of France, Nazi soldiers searched for the Chinese Miracle Box. Fu fled to England to protect the Miracle Box.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Recent History
Monarch came from his present to these events with Ladybug and Rabbit Noir pursuing him to get the Miraculouses he stole back. When Fu was escaping to England, he was stopped by and met Ladybug and Rabbit Noir, who he would give the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses respectively about 75 years later. The hero duo asked Fu to borrow a Miraculous to get back the Rabbit Miraculous Monarch stole, to which Fu agreed. Ladybug and Rabbit Noir then returned to their present with the Miraculous they chose, the Dog Miraculous, and lent it to Alix. After the Rabbit Miraculous is taken back from Monarch, a young Bunnyx comes back to return the Dog Miraculous back to Fu as Ladybug and Rabbit Noir promised. She takes a picture with the young Fu and goes back through her Burrow to begin her journey through time to keep the Rabbit Miraculous out of Monarch's hands.
1950: The kwamis discovered aside from being unable to be filmed nor photographed, they can't be seen nor heard by robots or AI and yet their quantum masking doesn't work on them.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Recent History
Late 1960s to Early 1970s: Emil Graham de Vanily, the Duke of Westchester, and his wife, Milly Graham de Vanily, become parents to twins, Émilie and Amélie Graham de Vanily.
A baby boy named known as Gabi Grassette was born to Gabrielle and Johnny Grassette in Lille, France.
1974 or after: An unknown kwami collected a Rubik cube and stored it in the Miracle Box.
1975: Tom was born to Gina and Roland Dupain.
1979: An unknown kwami collected a walkman and stored it in the Miracle Box.
Sometime before 1995: Xia Bing Cheng was born in China, then moved to Paris and changed her name to Sabine. She later met and fell in love with Tom Dupain. He eventually proposed to her with a ring hidden in a scoop of vanilla ice cream while at André's ice cream cart with her nearly swallowing the ring.
Sometime before 1988: Tikki's last point of activity before Marinette became Ladybug was before the construction of the Channel Tunnel.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Recent History
Late 1980s or Early 1990s: Emil and Milly worried about Émilie's defiant nature, wondering if they trusted their legacy to the right twin, thus sending her to Paris, where she fell in love with a modest tailor named Gabi Grassette, thus renouncing her noble rank as an aristocrat to be with him, much to her parents' anger and dismay.
Unknown: Gabriel and Émilie were married.
Emil and Milly forced their daughter to marry an American billionaire named Colt Fathom.
After the marriages of both couples, they were missing one thing: a child so they could have a family of their own. However, both sisters discovered they were infertile and for years, they tried with no results and despite Émilie returning home to her parents and having the best treatment, it still wasn't enough.
After their marriage, but before Adrien was born, his parents become in possession of the Graham de Vanily Mansion in Paris, that would be later known as the Agreste mansion.
Unknown: Thomas Astruc starts attending Collège Françoise Dupont.
1995: Tom and Sabine were married.
1996: André and Audrey Bourgeois were married.
Unknown: Gabrielle and Johnny Grassette owned a French Fry shop called Friterie Grassette.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Recent History
Unknown: Gabriel and Émilie became closer friends with the Bourgeois.
In 1997, André was elected the mayor of Paris for the time; he was re-elected for 3 subsequent terms.
Before the Couffaine twins were born, Jagged Stone and Anarka Couffaine started performing together and sometime later got married.
Unknown: The film Solitude by Graham Films is directed and produced by André Bourgeois and written and starred in by Émilie.
Unknown: Caline Bustier starts attending Collège Françoise Dupont and was a student in Mr. Damoclès' class.
During an April Fools, as a student in Mr. Damoclès' class, she pinned a fish on his back as a joke.
Unknown: Alec used to have big afro-styled hair, but was mocked about his style by other children. And ever since that, he started to mock people as much as he was mocked.
Unknown: Tomoe Tsurugi gave birth to Cerise Bianca, the result of a past relationship in which she ended up being disappointed.
As a result, Cerise may have been separated from her biological mother, keeping the secret about her motherhood a secret only between the two of them.
21st Century
2000: Luka and Juleka Couffaine were born.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Recent History
Sometime in their infancy, Jagged Stone left his family because he felt like he wouldn't be a good father.
Alix Kubdel was born.
1999-2001: Wu Shifu found a baby girl on the doorstep of his martial arts school. He adopted her and named her Fei.
2000-2001: While on an overseas trip, Émilie found and gave the Grimoire to her husband, Gabriel. Nathalie assisted them in finding the Butterfly and the Peacock Miraculouses.
2000: Tomoe Tsurugi used the Peacock Miraculous to impregnate herself and give birth to a baby sentimonster girl she named Kagami Tsurugi.
Sometime between 2001-2002: Due to complications with pregnancy, Émilie used the Peacock Miraculous to have a baby sentimonster boy she and Gabriel named Adrien Agreste.
At some point, Colt heard about Émilie's pregnancy, making him jealous, as he wanted to have a child too, because Amélie also had problems with getting pregnant. Gabriel offers Colt the Peacock Miraculous, not accepting it at first, as he hated magic. But since there was no other solution, he reluctantly borrowed the Peacock Miraculous and used it to have a baby sentimonster boy they named Félix Fathom.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Recent History
Sometime between January-June or Fall 2001:  Tom and Sabine became parents to a baby girl they named Marinette Dupain-Cheng.
Various times between 2000-2004: Aglaé, Marc Anciel, Aurore Beauréal, Ivan Bruel, Chloé Bourgeois, Mireille Caquet, Alya Césaire, Nelson de Glusset, Diane, Mylène Haprèle, Max Kanté, Nathaniel Kurtzberg, Nino Lahiffe, Rose Lavillant, Lê Chiến Kim, Ondine, Prem, Raymond Pugnant, Sabrina Raincomprix, Loïc Stompet, and Sublime Varlette are born to their respective families.
Early 2000's: Audrey left her family to move to New York.
Sometime between 2002-2004: Audrey had a daughter named Zoé Lee.
Early 2000's-2015: Alya attended one or more unknown schools for an unknown amount of school years until she was transferred to Collège Françoise Dupont for unknown reasons.
2012-2015: Marinette attended Collège Françoise Dupont for three school years, all while sharing classes with Chloé Bourgeois.
2014-2015: Marinette used to suffer heavy bullying from Chloé and Sabrina, with their tricks leading to her getting late in every first school hour, making her get detention on every Saturday.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Recent History
Marinette soon develops a crush on Kim and plans to spend a time alone with him at the pool, but Sabrina overhears the conversation and goes ahead to tell Chloé, in which she tells Kim that Marinette only called him because she wants to confess her love with him. Kim was puzzled, and Chloé takes the advantage to tell him for making a prank that would make Marinette shocked.
During the same day, when Marinette and Kim went swimming together in the pool, she took the opportunity to declare herself to him, but Kim anticipated it before she could speak and handed her a box of jewelry. However, there were no jewels inside, but a large amount of spiders that scared Marinette and thus caused her to fall into the pool in terror. Socqueline saw everything, and slashed at Chloé breaking Sabrina's cellphone as she held it.
Chloé told Denis Damoclès about what happened on the club's doorstep, but he said it took place in an environment outside the school. Not making it easy, Chloé threatened to call her father, thus Damoclès having no other option but to suspend Socqueline for 2 weeks, even though the school year is already over. So Socqueline was banned from the school prom.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Recent History
Marinette starts wearing pigtails after Socqueline graduated from Collége Françoise Dupont as a form of thanks for inducing courage against Chloé and as a byword for true friendship.
Before September 1, 2015: The damaged Peacock Miraculous deteriorated Émilie's health, with dizzy spells being a symptom. Eventually, she fell into a coma. Gabriel preserved her in a glass coffin in a secret area below their mansion, with the reason for her disappearance unknown to almost everyone except for his assistant, Nathalie Sancoeur.
Due to the Peacock Miraculous' damaged state making it dangerous to use, Gabriel hid it away in his safe and prohibited Nathalie from using it.
Colt had a similar fate to Émilie, having his health deteriorate overtime, eventually dying from his usage of the damaged Peacock Miraculous.
Before his death, Colt, convinced by using magic to create a child as a price to pay, began to see Félix as a monster and, to be the reason for his illness, began to abuse him, giving absurd and horrible orders, and mistreating him non-stop. And anything Félix acquired a passion for, it became a reason for him to destroy that thing and start having a nervous breakdown.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Recent History
At some point during it, the ring containing Félix's amok has been damaged for some reason, leading Félix to faint and only waking up after the ring was repaired.
After his death, Félix began to use the ring that belonged to his father, thus having freedom and possession of his Amok.
Either April 4, 2015, September 28, 2015, or March 23, 2016: The Sacred Cave Key was stolen from Fei before the next lunar eclipse.
Wu Shifu was murdered by Cash and his martial arts school was burned down.
The Supreme entrusted Gabriel Agreste the Butterfly Miraculous, and became a supervillain with an unknown identity. However, seeing that his actions hurt anyone he loves, he decided to get revenge on The Supreme and stole the Peacock Miraculous, giving it to his wife.
As a result, Émilie had her life taken away for unknown reasons, leaving Gabriel and Adrien in an endless mourn.
After this disaster, Gabriel redeemed himself and reinvented his hero persona, becoming Paris' new main hero: Betterfly.
Unknown - Recent History
Fu spent a great amount of time looking for the Grimoire.
After leaving Marianne, Fu spent an unknown amount of time in England before returning to Paris.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Recent History
Wayzz became Fu's kwami for an unknown amount of years.
New York's superheroes created a team of superheroes called the United Heroez.
Rose developed an illness that can affect her again at any time.
Mylène's mother leaves her family.
Nino was given headphones from his favorite DJ after a concert he went to and starts carrying them with him.
Before Sabrina became friends with Chloé, she used to be friends with Cléo.

An unknown girl takes on the identity of Cerise Bianca for unknown reasons.

Alya received various Chinese treatments from Fu.

Kagami has drawn a manga about her childhood in Japan, but she hasn't dared to publish it yet.
Marinette once dreamed of tailoring a hat for the Eiffel Tower to protect it from snow, and after that, she wanted to be a fashion designer ever since.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Recent History
Marinette made her chaise lounge out of some salvaged parts.
Zoé became best friends with Jessica Keynes.
André used to sell his ice creams at locations where famous French films were shot.
Alec shaved his head and becomes bald to avoid mockery.
Trixx used Mirage, which resulted in a event that had dangerous consequences.
The Supreme entrusted the Ladybug Miraculous to an teenager called Marinette Dupain-Cheng and the Cat Miraculous to Adrien Agreste, so they can be supervillains in a goal to retrieve the Butterfly Miraculous from Betterfly.
Marinette became Shadybug and Adrien became Claw Noir.
The Kingdom was formed to hunt down the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses, and Gabriel, Nathalie, Tomoe and Camilo Pista became part of it under specific alias.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Note: Each season occurs after the preceding one, which means some events and dates that are stated in some episodes cannot have occurred at that stated moment, with the series being subject to a sliding timescale; such continuity errors will be marked.
The Agreste Family Saga
|-|Season 1=
Events of Season 1
This season has no set order of progression; any episode can be watched in any order besides for premieres and finales. For the sake of simplicity, this section is organized by production code, except when the events of an episode are referred to in another episode, indicating the former must occur before the latter.
The Origins Story ("Ladybug & Cat Noir" and "Stoneheart")
On the first day of the 2015-2016 school year, September 1, 2015, Gabriel uses the Butterfly Miraculous to become Hawk Moth, with the goal of obtaining the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses.
Alya transfers to Collège Françoise Dupont and becomes friends with Marinette.
Ivan is teased by Kim for being unable to confess his feelings for Mylène and is sent to the principal's office for threatening to punch him by Miss Bustier, causing Ivan to be akumatized into Stoneheart.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Marinette and Adrien receive their Miraculouses from Fu and meet their kwamis, Marinette is given the Ladybug Miraculous with Tikki, becoming Ladybug, and Adrien is given Cat Miraculous with Plagg, becoming Cat Noir.
Ladybug and Cat Noir defeat Stoneheart, who becomes Ivan again, but Ladybug has forgotten to capture and purify the akuma, allowing it to multiply. The copies turn various Parisians into copies of Stoneheart.
Marinette feels discouraged to be Ladybug, which prompts her to renounce her Miraculous and put it away in her drawer, after she does, she goes down to her living room/kitchen to talk to her parents, but Marinette from the future with a yellow vest on comes out of the Burrow and takes the Miraculous, then she goes back into it. Later, right before current Marinette is done talking to her parents, Future Marinette puts the Miraculous back into the drawer after making Tikki confident that she's the right Ladybug holder, and she comes back up into her room, retrieves the box of magical earrings, and has the idea to give them to Alya.
Alya creates the Ladyblog, a blog dedicated to the exploits of the Miraculous holders.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Adrien starts attending Collège Françoise Dupont and becomes friends with Nino.
Ivan is re-akumatized into Stoneheart.
Cat Noir develops a crush on Ladybug after she stands up against Hawk Moth's threat.
Marinette, after becoming Ladybug, gains the confidence and courage to stand up to Chloé, and tells her that she and the rest of her class will no longer be manipulated by her hostility.
Marinette develops a crush on Adrien after he kindly gives her his umbrella on their way home from school.
"Stormy Weather"
Marinette babysits Nadja Chamack's daughter, Manon Chamack.
Alya comes over and helps Marinette, being great with kids thanks to babysitting her little sisters.
Alya informs Marinette that Adrien is doing a photo shoot in the park and the girls go to the park.
The photographer decides that Adrien needs a female partner. He offers the job to Alya, but she insists that Marinette should be the one to partner with Adrien.
Mireille Caquet wins the KIDZ+ weather girl competition against Aurore Beauréal, who, upset about loss, is akumatized into Stormy Weather.
Alya and Manon get trapped on the merry-go-round by an enclosing wall of ice.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
The photographer decides to use Manon as Adrien's partner in the photo shoot.
"Lady Wifi"
Alya sees Chloé pull a red and black yo-yo out of her locker and this leads her to believe Chloé is Ladybug, so she sets out to prove it.
After Alya tries searching her locker for proof, Chloé gets Alya suspended from school, causing the latter to be akumatized into Lady Wifi.
Monarch comes through his Burrow to take the trapped Ladybug's Miraculous, but Adult Bunnyx went back to before that happened and Future Ladybug's yo-yo pulled him back into the Burrow before he could've caused some serious damage.
Lady Wifi almost reveals Ladybug's secret identity.
"The Evillustrator"
Nathaniel celebrates his birthday.
Marinette tries to befriend Sabrina.
Nathaniel is sent to the principal's office for drawing in class and is mocked by Chloé for his drawings and his crush on Marinette, causing him to be akumatized into The Evillustrator.
"Princess Fragrance"
Prince Ali visits Paris.
Rose's letter to Prince Ali is torn in half by Chloé, causing Rose to be akumatized into Princess Fragrance.
Tikki gets sick and is separated from Marinette.
Marinette meets Fu, but just thinks that he's a healer.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
"Mr. Pigeon"
Xavier Ramier is kicked out of the Trocadéro for feeding the pigeons, causing him to be akumatized into Mr. Pigeon for the first time.
On May 18, Collège Françoise Dupont hosted a derby hat design competition judged by Gabriel which Marinette wins, introducing the world famous fashion designer to the budding fashion designer.
"Pixelator"
Jagged Stone comes to Paris and visits the Le Grand Paris hotel.
Vincent Asa is refused a photo with Jagged Stone and kicked out of Le Grand Paris, causing him to be akumatized into Pixelator.
Marinette creates a pair of Eiffel Tower sunglasses for Jagged Stone, impressing the rockstar.
Jagged Stone dedicates a song for Ladybug during his concert, as an honor for saving him from the titular akumatized supervillain.
Jagged Stone, Penny Rolling, and Fang begin their residence at Le Grand Paris hotel.
"Copycat"
A sculpture of Ladybug and Cat Noir was made by Théo Barbot.
After Cat Noir lies about his relationship with Ladybug, making Théo think that the two superheroes are in love, the sculptor is akumatized into Copycat.
"The Bubbler"
Adrien turns 14.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Gabriel coldly shuts down Nino's request for a birthday party for Adrien and dubs his son's best friend a bad influence, causing him to be akumatized into The Bubbler.
Ladybug and Cat Noir get trapped in one of The Bubbler's bubbles and Cat Noir used his Cataclysm to release them, but they end up falling from the sky along with Monarch, Future Ladybug, and Rabbit Noir. Monarch kicks Rabbit Noir away from him and goes through his Burrow. Future Ladybug and Rabbit Noir follow him.
Adrien receives a scarf from Marinette, but thinks it's from his father.
"Simon Says"
Simon Grimault is akumatized into Simon Says.
Gabriel begins to suspect that Cat Noir is Adrien after noticing his son's ring for the first time.
"Timebreaker"
Tom creates a Eiffel Tower-shaped cake ordered by Nadja.
Tom and Sabine celebrate their twentieth wedding anniversary at Le Grand Paris.
Alix turns fifteen and is gifted a family heirloom, a pocket watch.
Alix accidentally skates over her pocket watch, causing her to be akumatized into Timebreaker.
Several people, including Cat Noir, fade away from the timeline due to Timebreaker's theft of their energy.
Timebreaker goes back in time with Ladybug hitching a ride.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
"Rogercop"
It's Career Day at Collège Françoise Dupont.
André Bourgeois fires Officer Roger Raincomprix for refusing to search Marinette's belongings for Chloé's bracelet without proof, causing him to be akumatized into Rogercop.
"Dark Cupid"
On Valentine's Day, Marinette and Adrien write a love letter to their respective crushes.
Chloé harshly rejects the romantic feelings of Kim, causing him to be akumatized into Dark Cupid.
Ladybug kisses Cat Noir to break Dark Cupid's spell.
"Animan"
Nino had a crush on Marinette.
Alya's father, Otis, is akumatized into Animan.
Alya and Nino are put in a zoo exhibit cage by Ladybug to keep them out of danger. During their time alone together, Alya and Nino find out they have many things in common, fall in love, and share a kiss. During the kiss, Monarch falls through his Burrow, with Future Ladybug and Rabbit Noir following close behind.
"Darkblade"
Armand D'Argencourt loses Paris' mayoral election to André Bourgeois, causing him to get akumatized into Darkblade.
Marinette becomes class representative.
"Gamer"

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
May 18th through May 21st, Collège Françoise Dupont participates in a game tournament, which Max loses his spot in to Marinette, causing him to get akumatized into Gamer.
"The Pharaoh"
On May 21, Alix's big brother, Jalil Kubdel, is akumatized into an akumatized supervillain based off Tutankhamun I: The Pharaoh.
Marinette learns about the history of past Ladybugs.
"Horrificator"
Miss Bustier's class creates a film for contest at Collège Françoise Dupont. Mylène is cast as one of the lead actors, but is unable to get over her fears, causing her to get akumatized into Horrificator.
"The Puppeteer"
Marinette makes a set of dolls based on Ladybug, Cat Noir, Lady Wifi, The Evillustrator, and Rogercop.
Nadja refuses to let Manon borrow Marinette's dolls and takes away the Lady Wifi doll Marinette gave to her daughter, causing Manon to be akumatized into The Puppeteer.
The Puppeteer transforms Alya, Nathaniel, and Roger into their akumatized identities and controls Cat Noir with the dolls.
"The Mime"
On April 28th, a theater troupe is getting ready for a performance.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
A member of the theater troupe, Fred Haprèle, has his part stolen by his understudy, Chris, causing him to be akumatized into The Mime.
Alya interviewed Ladybug for the Ladyblog.
"Guitar Villain"
Marinette designs the cover for Jagged Stone's next album on the recommendation of the rockstar himself, remembering the Eiffel Tower glasses she created for him.
XY smack talks Jagged Stone and his music, causing him to be akumatized into Guitar Villain and his pet crocodile, Fang, is akumatized into a dragon.
"Reflekta"
Today is class picture day.
Chloé gets Sabrina trap Juleka in a girls' bathroom stall, making the shy girl miss the class photo and be akumatized into Reflekta.
"Antibug"
Sabrina made Chloé angry by calling the latter out as the former's true self, unaware Chloé was trying to pass herself off as the real Ladybug to Nadja and Jagged Stone during an interview. When Sabrina came by the next day, her best friend pretended she was invisible, causing her to be akumatized into Vanisher.
Chloé is pushed aside when she tries to help her idols, Ladybug and Cat Noir, causing her to be akumatized into Antibug.
"Kung Food"
Le Grand Paris hotel hosts a cooking competition.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Marinette's granduncle, Wang Cheng, visits Paris.
After Chloé sabotages his soup, Wang Cheng is akumatized into Kung Food.
"Santa Claws"
Adrien spends his first Christmas without his mother, and runs away from home.
A man costumed as Santa Claus is akumatized into Santa Claws.
"Volpina"
Adrien stole the Miraculous spellbook from Gabriel's safe.
Cerise Bianca transfers to Collège Françoise Dupont as a foreign exchange student named Lila Rossi.
On May 21st, Alya interviewed Lila for the Ladyblog.
Lila stole the book from Adrien, and then Marinette took the book.
Lila is akumatized into Volpina.
Marinette officially meets Wang Fu as the Guardian of the Miraculous.
|-|Season 2=
Events of Season 2
This season is more interconnected than the previous one, with many episodes referencing events of other episodes that occur later in the production line. The order of production codes mostly align with the chronological order, so this section is organized by them, except when the events of an episode are referred to in another episode, ensuring it must happen before the latter episode.
"The Collector"

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Wang Fu and Marinette believe that the owner of the Miraculous book is Hawk Moth, but that suspicion leads to either Adrien or his father, Gabriel.
Gabriel akumatized himself into The Collector.
After taking snapshots of the book, Marinette returns the book to Gabriel and Adrien is allowed back into school.
Lila starts being absent from school due to supposedly travelling around the world.
"Prime Queen"
Ladybug and Cat Noir appear on the show Face to Face.
Nadja is akumatized into Prime Queen.
"Glaciator"
Nino and Alya are officially a couple.
André is akumatized into Glaciator.
Marinette learns of Cat Noir's genuine feelings for Ladybug. She mentions the previous time they met in "The Evillustrator".
Cat Noir learns that Ladybug considers him a close friend, but remains hopeful of her love for him.
Cat Noir also learns that Ladybug is in love with someone else, but is unaware that it's his real identity.
"Despair Bear"
Adrien threatens to end his friendship with Chloé unless she acts nicer to people.
Chloé hosts a party.
Hawk Moth tries to re-akumatize Mylène and Kim, but he fails, thanks to the intervention of Armand reminding Chloé to be nicer.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Armand is akumatized into Despair Bear.
"Troublemaker"
Jagged Stone guest stars at Marinette's bakery.
Adrien discovers photos of him in Marinette's room while watching the broadcast.
Penny Rolling is akumatized into Troublemaker.
Troublemaker almost had Ladybug's Miraculous.
"Gigantitan"
Marinette and Alya officially inform Juleka, Rose, Mylène, and Alix that Marinette is in love with Adrien. Of course they all knew the whole time.
The girls come up with a plan to get Marinette and Adrien on a date; While Adrien is doing a photo shoot, Juleka will plant a fake No-parking sign next to Adrien's car and Mylène will find a police officer and point out that the car is parked illegally. After the police officer makes Placide I.T. move the car, Alya will inform the others when Adrien is done with his photo shoot. When he finds that the car is missing (he won't be able to call his bodyguard since he always leaves his phone in the car during photo shoots), Marinette will then move in. Rose will then send in a rickshaw, which will give Adrien and Marinette a ride to André's ice cream cart. As they eat ice cream, Alix will skate by and shower them with rose petals.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
The actual execution of the plan goes sideways in several different ways.
After Placide I.T. gets frustrated by Officer Roger, Hawk Moth tries to akumatize him, but his negative emotions disappear after he finds Adrien still safe.
The akuma goes after August instead and Hawk Moth akumatizes him into Gigantitan.
"Riposte"
This episode introduces Kagami Tsurugi, a recurring character.
Kagami tries to enroll in Mr. D'Argencourt's fencing school, but thinks she lost to Adrien and is denied.
After misunderstanding that she loses the fencing battle against Adrien, Kagami is akumatized into Riposte.
Monarch tries to jump scare Cat Noir while he is watching the battle between Ladybug and Riposte in the Louvre, but Rabbit Noir's umbrella trips him over. Monarch didn't give up, so he uses Burrow to go forward to "Heroes' Day" and Future Ladybug and Rabbit Noir go along with him.
Kagami becomes friends with Adrien and is willing to get to know Marinette.
Adrien and Kagami decide to have a rematch in the future.
"Gorizilla"
Gabriel suspects that Adrien is Cat Noir.
Placide I.T. is akumatized into Gorizilla.
Adrien goes to the movies with Marinette.
"Robostus"

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Max's robot, Markov, is akumatized into Robustus, and rebels against Hawk Moth.
Wang Fu explains to Marinette that if one would use both the Ladybug and Cat Miraculous, they would get the ultimate power, one that shapes reality, further commenting that it would allow them to make a wish, but warns that the universe must maintain balance and that every action would carry a reaction.
"Sapotis"
Alya's little sisters, Ella and Etta, are akumatized into Sapotis.
Alya temporarily received and activated the Fox Miraculous, becoming Rena Rouge.
Hawk Moth is aware that there is a Guardian of the Miraculous in Paris.
"The Dark Owl"
Principal Damoclès tries to become a superhero.
Principal Damoclès is akumatized into a dark version of Knightowl.
Tikki and Plagg learn the identities of their wielder's partner.
"Syren"
Ladybug, Cat Noir, and Rena Rouge save Paris from escaped zoo animals.
Ondine is akumatized into Syren and floods Paris.
Marinette and Wang Fu decode the recipes to unlock more powers for the kwamis.
Ladybug and Cat Noir unlock their Aqua power-ups.
Adrien officially meets Wang Fu and Wayzz.
"Zombizou"
Miss Bustier's birthday is celebrated at Collège Françoise Dupont.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Marinette is targeted for akumatization.
Miss Bustier is akumatized instead into Zombizou.
"Captain Hardrock"
This episode introduces Luka Couffaine, a recurring character.
Marinette becomes friends with Juleka's twin brother, Luka.
Juleka's mother, Anarka, and her ship are akumatized into Captain Hardrock.
Queen's Battle ("Style Queen" and "Queen Wasp")
Audrey Bourgeois is akumatized into Style Queen, Hawk Moth's masterpiece.
Style Queen turns Adrien into a gold glitter statue, leaving him unable to transform and help Ladybug.
Ladybug gets the Bee Miraculous and intends to give it to Alya temporarily, but Style Queen intercepts them.
Alya gets turned into a statue.
Ladybug drops and loses the Bee Miraculous.
Marinette officially meets Cat Noir's kwami, Plagg.
Plagg arrives and uses Cataclysm on the Eiffel Tower and causes an explosion.
Ladybug defeats Style Queen which causes Gabriel to almost give up his Miraculous.
Chloé finds the Bee Miraculous and uses it to become Queen Bee.
Queen Bee creates a fake emergency to save people in an attempt to impress her mother.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Gabriel gives himself another chance and akumatizes Chloé while still transforming, causing her to become the first Akumatized Miraculous holder, Queen Wasp.
Ladybug and Cat Noir defeat Queen Wasp and retrieve the Bee Miraculous from her.
"Befana"
Marinette turns 14.
Marinette's grandmother, Gina, visits the family and is akumatized into Befana.
Adrien gifts Marinette a bracelet as a birthday present as an accolade for giving him hers previously from "Gamer".
Marinette is given a kwagatama by Tikki.
"Reverser"
This episode introduces Marc Anciel, a recurring character.
Marinette attends an Art Club.
Marc is akumatized into Reverser.
Monarch ends up on the top of a back trunk of a taxi Ladybug and Cat Noir were riding in. The taxi driver sees Monarch, freaks out, and drives crazily to Ladybug and Cat Noir's destination. Cat Noir acknowledges that the taxi driver drives like a maniac, thinking the titular villain infected the poor driver with their powers.
Nathaniel and Marc start making comic books together.
André creates a space garbage program to remove garbage from Paris, but later decides to scrap it.
"Frightningale"

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
