Clara writes a song called Miraculous and hires Marinette and Adrien to play Ladybug and Cat Noir, causing them to nearly reveal their identities.
Clara is akumatized into Frightningale.
Marc, Luka, and Ondine appear in end video after befriending the students of Miss Bustier's class.
"Frozer"
Cat Noir and Marinette feel hopeless about their love targets, asking Kagami and Luka for advice.
Philippe is akumatized into Frozer and freezes all of Paris.
Ladybug and Cat Noir unlock their Ice power-ups.
"Anansi"
Alya's big sister, Nora, is akumatized into Anansi.
Nino is given the Turtle Miraculous for the first time to transform into Carapace.
"Malediktator"
Chloé threatens to leave Paris.
André Bourgeois is akumatized into Malediktator.
Ladybug realizes how much Chloé wants to be accepted and lends her the Bee Miraculous again.
Chloé is officially lent the Bee Miraculous to transform into Queen Bee.
Alya mentions Rena Rouge and Carapace as previous heroes.
"Sandboy"
Nooroo turns 3,500 cycles.
An unnamed boy is akumatized into Sandboy.
Hawk Moth knows the existence of the other kwamis and plans to enslave them all.
Heroes' Day ("Catalyst" and "Mayura")

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
It's the anniversary of heroic activities.
Gabriel implements his biggest plan yet.
Gabriel as Hawk Moth re-akumatizes Lila into Volpina, who uses Mirage to create an illusion of an akumatized Ladybug fighting Cat Noir. The former turns the latter's Cataclysm against him, turning him into black dust. The akumatized Ladybug seizes Cat Noir's Miraculous, claiming Hawk Moth has won, devastating the citizens of Paris.
Hawk Moth akumatizes Nathalie into Catalyst, who transforms him into the powered-up Scarlet Moth.
With all the negative emotions he needs, Scarlet Moth uses his new powers to make a flock of scarlet akumas and rain them down over Paris. The scarlet akumas transform numerous civilians into scarlet versions their previous akumatized forms to make an army of scarlet akumatized supervillains.
Ladybug and Cat Noir recruit Alya, Nino and Chloé, to become Rena Rouge, Carapace, and Queen Bee respectivly to help them stop Scarlet Moth and his army of scarlet akumatized supervillains.
With no time for Ladybug to come up with an excuse to recruit them seprately, she gives Alya and Nino the Miraculouses they used previously together, learning each other's secret identities.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Hawk Moth makes a public appearance for the first time.
Rena Rouge, Carapace, and Queen Bee are akumatized into Rena Rage, Shell Shock, and Queen Wasp.
Monarch almost finds out Ladybug and Cat Noir's secret identities when they were de-transforming in the sewer but Future Ladybug and Rabbit Noir stopped him just in time by sending all three of them back to "The Bubbler".

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Ladybug uses her Lucky Charm, a hexagonal box like the one she got on Heroes' Day during "Mayura" to set a trap for Monarch in the Burrow to coax him into going to that time. Future Ladybug, Rabbit Noir, and Canigirl go through the Burrow, with Ladybug and Rabbit Noir positioning themselves as if they plan to attack Scarlet Moth while Canigirl hides. Monarch falls into their trap, going through the Burrow to try and stop them, when Canigirl comes out of hiding and uses Fetch to take the Rabbit Miraculous from him, then fusing the Rabbit Miraculous with Dog Miraculous to become Bunny Dog. Monarch tries to get the Rabbit Miraculous back with Fetch, but Bunny Dog uses Burrow to escape before Monarch's ball can get to the Rabbit Miraculous. Future Ladybug and Rabbit Noir go back into the Burrow to revive Adult Bunnyx with Miraculous Ladybug, trapping Monarch in the past. Monarch thinks of a new plan, he'll use his knowledge of the future to help him seize Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses, getting the ultimate revenge on his nemeses, but Adult Bunnyx comes through her Burrow and sends him forward to the present day of "Evolution", foiling his plans.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Ladybug and Cat Noir fought and defeated Scarlet Moth, freeing Paris from the scarlet akumatized supervillains.
Nathalie uses the Peacock Miraculous and becomes Mayura.
Hawk Moth's cane gets amokized, creating the Butterfly Sentimonster. This allows Hawk Moth to escape and informs Ladybug and Cat Noir that Hawk Moth has the Peacock Miraculous holder helping him.
Marinette kisses Adrien on the cheek.
|-|Season 3=
Events of Season 3
This season is more interconnected than the previous one, with many episodes referencing previous ones. The production codes order fully align with the chronological order, so this section is organized by them.
"Chameleon"
This episode marks Lila's official reintroduction to the series, after errors in Season 2.
Lila returns to school and Marinette is almost akumatized, but she resists it; however, Lila literally akumatized herself into Chameleon.
Lila and Marinette begin a rivalry against each other for Adrien.
Miraculous World: Shanghai – The Legend of Ladydragon
It's Marinette's granduncle Cheng's 60th birthday.
Both Marinette and Adrien go to Shanghai, China.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
During her trip to Shanghai, Marinette gets her Miraculous, kwagatama, and purse with her phone and Tikki in it stolen by Fei, causing her to become lost in the city.
Marinette meets Fei.
When Marinette discovers from Cash that Fei was the one that stole her stuff in exchange for information about her adopted father, she became devastated doubting if they were friends.
Hawk Moth akumatizes Cash into King Cash.
Hawk Moth uses the Sacred Cave Key to obtain the Prodigious, but loses it.
Fei obtains the Prodigious back, becoming the next Renren, and she masters all the powers, except for the Dragon.
Hawk Moth akumatizes Mei Shi into YanLuoShi, but rebels and eradicated him.
During the fight, Fei becomes devastated that her actions caused all this, feeling unworthy of using the Prodigius and flees.
In the same period, Alix was in the shadows hiding and was watching the full battle.
Cat Noir tried to stop YanLuoShi with his powers, but was eradicated, leaving Ladybug heartbroken at the loss of her partner.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Marinette reunites with Fei, forgiving her for her actions, and, understanding the difference between justice and revenge, Fei unlocks the power of the dragon, using it to save Marinette.
Fei finally lets go of her revenge against Cash and has him face justice in prison.
Fei reclaims the Sacred Cave Key and meets Mei Shi again.
Ladybug and Cat Noir unlock their Space power-ups.
During this period, Bunnyx travelled in time and met Fei in person, also learning her true identity as a Prodigious holder.
"Animaestro"
A premiere is being held for the animated movie about Ladybug and Cat Noir.
Ladybug and Cat Noir were invited to the premiere, but they refused. Marinette became she felt she had a responsibility to being a superhero, and Adrien because he would already be there in his civilian form, having voiced Cat Noir for the movie.
Marinette regrets her choice when she learns that Adrien would be there.
This episode introduces Thomas Astruc, a recurring character throughout the season.
He served as director for the movie.
Every Sunday, Marinette makes a single passion fruit macaron (Adrien's favorite) in anticipation of the right time to present it to her crush.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Marinette offers to help her parents serve macarons at the premiere party.
Marinette and Chloé conspire to make Kagami look bad in front of Adrien.
Chloé's plan was to smash a bunch of macarons and cover all but one of the chairs with crumbs, then get Kagami to step on a piece of chewing gum. Kagami would have to sit to take it off, and once she found the one seat with no crumbs, Chloé would use cooking string (it was supposed to be rope, but Marinette couldn't find any) that had been tied to the chair to pull it out of the way, and in its place pull in a chair with a slice of chocolate cake on it, right as Kagami was sitting down.
Thomas Astruc, after a day full of people not recognizing him and belittling his contribution as director (as well as eating Marinette's special macaron which triggered his allergies), is akumatized into Animaestro.
Chloé discovers that Marinette has a crush on Adrien. Though she decides to ignore it, believing Marinette to be her lesser anyway.
Thomas gives Marinette his ticket, since he's seen the movie already and he's elated that she recognizes him.
Marinette gets to sit next to Adrien during the movie.
"Bakerix"
Tom turns 40.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Marinette meets her grandfather, Roland, and he is akumatized into Bakerix.
The Startrain is unveiled.
"Backwarder"
The Agrestes and the Tsurugis are going to London for the weekend to attend a royal wedding.
Marinette fears that Adrien will fall in love with Kagami during that time.
Master Fu isn't feeling well and is worried that the end is near, though his doctor doesn't think it's a big deal.
The doctor gives Marinette (who she assumes to be Fu's granddaughter) a prescription to take to the local pharmacy.
Fu gives Marinette a letter to give to his long lost love, Marianne Lenoir.
Marinette writes a letter confessing her feelings to Adrien, intending to give it to him at the train station before he leaves.
Marinette mixes up the letters; she gave the prescription to Adrien, Fu's letter to the pharmacy, and her own letter to Marianne.
Due to the letter mix-up, Marianne believes Fu gave up on their love and gets akumatized into Backwarder.
Hawk Moth learns from her that the Guardian is named Master Fu, though he is unaware that he goes by the alias, Mr. Chan.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Marianne leaves Paris, knowing it’s not safe for her now that Hawk Moth knows she knows the Guardian. Though she and Fu promise to reunite once the villain has been defeated.
When Adrien returns, he gives Marinette the medicine that she was supposed to get for Fu.
"Reflekdoll"
Juleka is re-akumatized into Reflekta and gets amokized, creating Reflekdoll.
Marinette and Adrien's Miraculouses are swapped, leading to them becoming Lady Noire and Mister Bug.
According to Feri González, this episode takes place before "Miraculer".
"Weredad"
August is akumatized into Gigantitan again.
Marinette tells Cat Noir that she loves him to throw him off his suspicions of her being Ladybug, but she finds out that Cat Noir suspected her of being a fan of his and remain friends.
Tom Dupain is akumatized into Weredad.
"Silencer"
This episode establishes the band, Kitty Section.
Luka is akumatized into Silencer.
Marinette discovers that Luka has a crush on her.
"Oni-Chan"
Kagami is akumatized into Oni-Chan.
Adrien discovers that Kagami has a crush on him.
As Cat Noir, he discovers that Lila's friendship with Ladybug is a lie.
Gabriel and Lila become allies.
"Miraculer"

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Hawk Moth once again tries to akumatize Chloé, but she manages to reject the akumatization. Hawk Moth quickly changes targets to Sabrina, akumatizing her into Miraculer.
Ladybug and Cat Noir recruit Rena Rouge and Carapace, the temporary team members meet Mayura for the first time, while Ladybug and Cat Noir come across her again, she and Hawk Moth try to convince Chloé to join them, though she refuses.
Hawk Moth and Mayura almost manage to take the Bee Miraculous, but Ladybug manages to retrieve it.
Chloé's adventures as Queen Bee come to an end for her and her loved ones' safety, making Chloé's trust in Ladybug begin to falter.
"Oblivio"
Alya and Nino are akumatized into Oblivio.
Cat Noir and Ladybug lose their memories and discover each other's alter egos.
Marinette and Adrien briefly become a couple until Miraculous Ladybug restores their previous memories and erases their amnesic memories.
After their memories are restored, Marinette is shocked to learn she kissed Cat Noir and Adrien remains hopeful Ladybug will fall in love with him again.
Hawk Moth assumes the heroes are in love.
"Desperada"
Vivica is akumatized into Desperada.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Adrien is temporarily given the Snake Miraculous to transform into Aspik; however, he recants it after failing 25,913 times.
Luka is given the Snake Miraculous for the first time to turn into Viperion.
Luka and Juleka learn that Jagged and their mother used to perform together.
"Christmaster"
Nino's little brother, Chris, is akumatized into Christmaster.
"Startrain"
Hawk Moth attempt akumatizes Sabrina's father, but the akuma stowed away on the Startrain, and akumatizes Max's mother, Claudie, into Startrain.
Max is given the Horse Miraculous for the first time to transform into Pegasus.
"Kwamibuster"
After Olga Mendeleiev fails at catching Tikki and Plagg and tries proving their existence to the world, she is akumatized into Kwamibuster.
Marinette temporarily receives the Mouse Miraculous becoming the holder Multimouse; Marinette unifies the Mouse and Fox, Mouse and Cat, and Mouse and Ladybug Miraculouses to become Multifox, Multinoir, and Multibug.
Hawk Moth learns of all the different Miraculouses and kwamis.
"Feast"
Master Fu's mistake is finally revealed when Hawk Moth and Mayura obtain his old sentimonster.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Master Fu briefly takes Marinette and Adrien's Miraculouses, but returns them.
He reveals his identity to Hawk Moth as the Guardian of the Miraculous.
After Feast is defeated, the Order of the Guardians is restored.
Knowing that his shop is no longer safe, Master Fu moves elsewhere, but stays in Paris and begins to train Marinette to be the next guardian.
"Gamer 2.0"
Max is re-akumatized, but as Gamer 2.0.
Max creates Miraculous All-Star Brawl.
"Stormy Weather 2"
Aurore is re-akumatized into Stormy Weather.
"Ikari Gozen"
Marinette is paired up with Kagami, and, despite them losing the contest, they become friends.
Kagami's mother, Tomoe, is akumatized into Ikari Gozen.
Kagami is given the Dragon Miraculous for the first time to transform into Ryuko.
"Timetagger"
This episode introduces Bunnyx, a recurring character throughout the season.
Mr. Ramier was re-akumatized into Mr. Pigeon for the 24th time.
Chris, akumatized as Timetagger in the future, travels back to the past to obtain Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses.
Ladybug, Cat Noir, and Alix rescue Bunnyx her statis in an old Egyptian artifact.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Mr. Ramier was re-akumatized into Mr. Pigeon for the 25th time. After being de-akumatized, Cat Noir advises him about connecting to another animal, implying that Ramier becomes Mr. Rat in the future.
"Party Crasher"
Nino and his friends throw an all-boys party for Adrien.
Wayhem is akumatized into Party Crasher.
Max is given the Horse Miraculous to become the Miraculous holder, Pegasus.
Luka is given the Snake Miraculous to become the Miraculous holder, Viperion.
Master Wang Fu, an attendant at the party, leaves the Monkey Miraculous to Kim after he saves him from falling.
Kim is given the Monkey Miraculous for the first time to transform into King Monkey.
"The Puppeteer 2"
Manon is re-akumatized into Puppeteer.
Marinette finds out Adrien has a crush on another girl, unaware that it's her other identity.
"Cat Blanc"
It's Adrien's 5th names day.
Ladybug meets Bunnyx again and is brought into an alternate future, where Paris is destroyed.
From her Burrow, Bunnyx knew the identities of Ladybug, Cat Noir, and Hawk Moth.
Cat Noir is akumatized into Cat Blanc (in an alternate future).

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Marinette transforms into Ladybug to deliver a gift to Adrien, but it leads to him discovering her identity.
Afterwards, Marinette and Adrien briefly become a couple.
Due to Gabriel's sabotage, Marinette broke up with Adrien, leaving her vulnerable to being akumatized, but was saved by Adrien and discovered his identity as Cat Noir, along with Nathalie and his father.
Ladybug and Cat Noir discover that Hawk Moth is Adrien's father, Gabriel.
Returning back to her own time, Marinette erases her name from the gift preventing the events of Cat Blanc from happening.
"Félix"
Amélie and Félix arrive in Paris.
It's been one year since Émilie fell into her coma.
Alya, Juleka, and Rose are re-akumatized into Lady Wifi, Reflekta, and Princess Fragrance, forming The Punishers Trio.
"Ladybug"
Lila pulls a stunt that leads Marinette to be expelled from school which almost caused her and everyone around her to be akumatized, but Catalyst's health from using the damaged Peacock Miraculous causes him to cancel his transformation, de-akumatizing everyone.
Ladybug and Cat Noir discover more abilities of the Peacock Miraculous.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Nathalie's use of the damaged Peacock Miraculous causes her to become sick.
She steals it from Gabriel and uses it to become Mayura again and create a Ladybug sentimonster.
After Ladybug gives her sentimonster counterpart her amokized object and the freedom to make her own choices with it, Ladybug asks for Sentimonster Ladybug's help defeating Hawk Moth and Mayura, but her former master destroys her creation shortly after.
Gabriel begins planning to find the Guardian of the Miraculouses.
Knowing that Lila was behind everything with Marinette, Adrien convinced her to make things right and her next lie, allowing Marinette to come back to school.
The Battle of the Miraculous ("Heart Hunter" and "Miracle Queen")
André Bourgeois and Audrey are akumatized into Heart Hunter.
Chloé betrays Ladybug and Cat Noir, and is akumatized into Miracle Queen.
Master Fu transforms into Jade Turtle to face Hawk Moth and Mayura.
Hawk Moth is amokized again, creating the Butterfly Sentimonster again.
Hawk Moth learns the true identities of Rena Rouge, Carapace, Viperion, Pegasus and King Monkey.
Ladybug unifies the Ladybug and Dragon Miraculouses to become Dragon Bug.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Cat Noir unifies the Cat and Snake Miraculouses to become Snake Noir.
Master Fu gives up his role as Guardian of the Miracle Box and passes the role to Ladybug.
Chloé gets the Bee Miraculous taken away from her permanently and is banished from the French Miraculous superhero team for good.
Mayura steals Master Fu's tablet, allowing Gabriel to fix the Peacock Miraculous and gain more information about the Miraculouses and their powers.
Mayura creates Optigami to spy on Ladybug and Cat Noir.
Cat Noir starts carrying a silly message on his bell written "42 half-wit" for a future trap for Hawk Moth, if that happens.
Miraculous World: New York – United Heroez
Xavier Ramier is akumatized into Mr. Pigeon for the 51st time.
Miss Bustier is revealed to be pregnant.
Miss Bustier's class, Denis Damoclès and Olga Mendeleiev travel to New York City for French-American Friendship week.
Gabriel secretly travels to New York in search of the Eagle Miraculous.
Mike Rochip is akumatized into Techlonizer, and later receives the Eagle Miraculous and becomes Miraclonizer.
Ladybug and Cat Noir meet the United Heroez.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Mayura creates the Robostus sentimonster in Paris, but Ladybug and Cat Noir aren't able to repair the damage caused by it because the sentimonster disappears before Ladybug can create another Lucky Charm to use Miraculous Ladybug.
Jessica recovers the Eagle Miraculous from Miraclonizer and transforms into Eagle.
Hawk Moth begins his search for other lost Miraculouses in the world.
A monk arrives in New York with the Native American Miracle Box to retrieve the Eagle Miraculous, but is convinced by Eagle to stay and make a new generation of Miraculous superheroes together instead.
|-|Season 4=
Events of Season 4
This season is serialized, with many episodes referencing previous ones. The production codes order fully align with the chronological order, so this section is organized by them.
"Truth" and "Lies"
Hawk Moth fixes the Peacock Miraculous and unifies it with the Butterfly Miraculous to become Shadow Moth.
Luka is akumatized into Truth and amokized, creating Lighteye.
Prince Ali travels to Paris for his birthday.
Luka and Juleka learn that their father is Jagged Stone.
Marinette and Luka stop dating each other, due to Marinette being away to protect the Miracle Box and Paris.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Kagami is akumatized into Lies.
Adrien and Kagami stop dating each other, due to Adrien always being away to protect Paris and lying all the time.
"Gang of Secrets"
Alya, Juleka, Rose, Mylène, and Alix are re-akumatized into Lady Wifi, Reflekta, Princess Fragrance, Horrificator, and Timebreaker, joining together to be the Gang of Secrets.
Trixx uses Mirage to lead the Gang of Secrets away from Marinette, but causes multiple huge illusions around Paris.
Alya breaks free from Shadow Moth's control, receives the Fox Miraculous to become Rena Rouge again, and learns that Marinette is Ladybug.
"Mr. Pigeon 72"
Xavier Ramier is akumatized into Mr. Pigeon for the seventy second time.
Ladybug learns how to make Magical Charms, giving one to Mr. Ramier.
Marinette tries to get Adrien and Kagami back together, but Kagami admits that Marinette and Adrien are perfect for each other.
"Psycomedian"
Marinette tries to impress Adrien with comedy with Harry Clown's help, but learns that she makes him laugh on her own.
Bob Roth destroys Harry's movie idea, making the latter get akumatized into Psycomedian.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Ladybug becomes extremely angry under Psycomedian's influence, leaving Cat Noir to take the lead.
Ladybug creates a Magical Charm and gives it to Harry.
"Furious Fu"
Su-Han arrives in Paris to retrieve the Chinese Miracle Box, but allows Marinette to keep it for the time being.
Wang Fu and Marianne travel to Paris to visit and Fu is akumatized into Furious Fu.
Ladybug creates a Magical Charm and gives it to Fu.
"Sole Crusher"
Zoé arrives and stays in Paris and is akumatized into Sole Crusher.
Kaalki uses Voyage to inform Cat Noir about Ladybug's situation, causing things to fly out Voyage portals to faraway places.
Zoé as Sole Crusher learns the concept of "winner and loser" doesn't exist, and Marinette tells Zoé, while she was Sole Crusher, that she'll will always be there for her while attempting to reason with her.
Ladybug creates a Magical Charm and gives it to Zoé.
Zoé develops a crush on Marinette after their first met at the bakery.
"Queen Banana"
Miss Bustier's class makes a movie with Zoé.
Chloé ends her friendship with Adrien.
Chloé is akumatized into Queen Banana and amokized, creating Banana Boom-Boom.
Zoé is lent the Bee Miraculous, becoming Vesperia.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Ladybug creates a Magical Charm for Chloé, intially rejecting it before Zoé tricks her half-sister into wearing it.
André finally stands up to Chloé.
"Gabriel Agreste"
Gabriel hosts a dinner party to get his ring Félix stole from him back, but lets him keep it.
Chloé records Marinette and her friends coming up with a plan to reveal Marinette's feelings to Adrien and tries to ruin Marinette's chances, but fails when Bob deletes her video.
Shadow Moth amokizes himself, creating a sentimonster copy of himself in attempt to trick his nephew into believing Gabriel and Shadow Moth are two sperate people.
Félix deduces that Gabriel is Shadow Moth.
Félix is akumatized, but resists and rejects the akuma, marking the Gabriel sentimonster, who is akumatized into The Collector.
Ladybug creates a Magical Charm for Gabriel giving it to the sentimonster, believing he's the real Gabriel.
Shadow Moth destroys the sentimonster, and learns about the Magical Charms and the pontential of the Miraculouses.
Félix notices Gabriel is not marked, reaffirming his deduction of Gabriel and Shadow Moth being one and the same.
Gabriel leaves fake Butterfly and Peacock Miraculouses in his safe for Félix to find.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
"Mega Leech"
André Bourgeois plans "Project Oxygen" to clean the air with man-made filters, but then later decides to plant more trees instead.
André Bourgeois is re-akumatized into Malediktator, and his emotions create Mega Leech.
Mylène is lent the Mouse Miraculous, becoming Polymouse.
While Polymouse fights Malediktator's clones, Ladybug and Cat Noir lend Nino, Zoé, Kagami, and Max Miraculouses to defeat Mega Leech.
Ladybug creates a Magical Charm for André Bourgeois and gives it to him.
"Guiltrip"
Miss Bustier's class learn that Rose has an illness since she was young.
Juleka is re-akumatized into Reflekta, and amokized, creating Guiltrip.
Rose is lent the Pig Miraculous, becoming Pigella.
Ladybug creates a Magical Charm for Juleka and gives it to her.
"Crocoduel"
It's Luka and Juleka's birthday, and Luka and Marinette decide to stay friends.
All of their friends learn that Jagged Stone is Luka and Juleka's father.
Jagged Stone and Anarka Couffaine are re-akumatized into Guitar Villain and Captain Hardrock, becoming Crocoduel, but they fight more against each other than with each other.
Juleka is lent the Tiger Miraculous, becoming Purple Tigress.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Ladybug creates Magical Charms and gives them to both Jagged and Anarka.
Jagged and Anarka finally reconcile after years of hatred towards each other.
"Optigami"
Shadow Moth amokizes himself, creating Sentialec, leading Audrey to be re-akumatized into Style Queen.
Shadow Moth amokizes himself again, creating Sentinino, who receives the Turtle Miraculous, becoming Senticarapace, and is destroyed shortly after he returns it.
Kaalki uses Voyage multiple times to help Rena Rouge and Ladybug, causing multiple large structures and items to fly to space and other places.
Ladybug unifies the Ladybug and Bee Miraculouses to become Lady Bee.
Ladybug creates a Magical Charm for Audrey, but puts it on her hat secretly.
Marinette permanently gives Alya the Fox Miraculous.
Gabriel and Nathalie learn that Ladybug and Alya have a close relationship.
"Sentibubbler"
Marinette had a nightmare to which she was worried about giving the Fox Miraculous to Alya and goes to her house to retrieve it.
Shadow Moth amokizes himself, creating Sentibubbler, and is destroyed when Ladybug gets ahold of the amokized object.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Shadow Moth tries to get Rena Rouge to betray Ladybug and Cat Noir, but she uses Mirage to make Shadow Moth think that Ladybug will never let Alya use the Fox Miraculous again, forcing Rena Rouge to work in secret.
Ladybug unifies the Ladybug and Horse Miraculouses to become Pegabug.
"Glaciator 2"
Ladybug and Cat Noir are named couple of the year.
Cat Noir decides not to flirt as much with Ladybug.
André is re-akumatized into Glaciator. Ladybug forgot to give him a Magical Charm and he is transformed into Glaciator again later.
Ladybug creates a Magical Charm and gives it to André.
"Hack-San"
Shadow Moth amokizes himself to create Hack-San, and he uses Hack-San to re-akumatize Markov into Robustus.
Before leaving for London, Marinette temporarily gives Alya the Ladybug Miraculous, which she uses to transform into Scarabella.
Cat Noir learns that Ladybug told someone her true identity, but doesn't know who.
"Rocketear"
Anne-Jeanne Théoxanne du Bocquale brings dinosaurs back to life.
Rena Rouge gains a new suit now that she works in secret, becoming Rena Furtive.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Nino believes that Cat Noir and Alya are a couple, and, after seeing them meeting at night, it leads to him being akumatized into Rocketear.
Nino tells Adrien (and unknowingly Cat Noir) that he's Carapace and Alya's Rena Rouge.
After learning that it was a misunderstanding, Nino breaks free from Shadow Moth's control.
Ladybug creates a Magical Charm and gives it to Nino.
"Wishmaker"
Alec is akumatized into Wishmaker.
Viperion learns the true identities of Ladybug and Cat Noir, but keeps it to himself.
Ladybug creates a Magical Charm and gives it to Alec.
"Simpleman"
Alya and Nino bring their siblings to Marinette, who was also babysitting Manon.
Roland Dupain is akumatized into Simpleman.
Ladybug creates a Magical Charm and gives it to Roland.
Marinette decides to stop creating complicated plans to tell her feelings to Adrien.
"Qilin"
Sabine is racially profiled and wrongfully arrested for not having a bus ticket, even though she gave the tickets to Marinette.
After being arrested, Sabine is akumatized into Qilin.
After Ladybug gives Qilin the keys to her handcuffs, Sabine breaks free from Shadow Moth's control.
Ladybug creates a Magical Charm and gives it to Sabine.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Marinette pays the fines at the end.
"Dearest Family"
Gabriel figures out how to evolve his powers in order to create a "Megakuma", a stronger type of Akuma that can break through the Magical Charms' protection. He uses this to break Sabine and Roland's Magical Charms.
Tom and Roland work together for the first time to make a dessert, a galette des rois for Three Kings Day, that perfectly combines tradition and modernity.
After an argument about how Marinette should be raised, Tom, Sabine, Roland, and Gina are all re-akumatized into Weredad, Qilin, Bakerix, and Befana.
The deliciousness of Tom and Roland's galette drives Tikki mad with hunger and she uses Lucky Charm to create a gigantic galette in space.
Ladybug creates four Magical Charms and gives them to Tom, Sabine, Roland, and Gina.
"Ephemeral"
Bob is akumatized into Moolak, leading to Ladybug getting the entire French Miraculous superhero team (except for Cat Noir) together to defeat him.
Upset that only Cat Noir was needed, Su-Han forces Ladybug and Viperion to find out Cat Noir's identity.
Viperion activates Second Chance, but after Ladybug learns Cat Noir's true identity, he never uses it.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Later, Ladybug reveals her true identity to Cat Noir, and they start dating.
Flash-foward to 100 weeks since Émilie fell into her coma.
Gabriel learns that Adrien is Cat Noir, and reveals to Adrien the truth about his mother and him being Shadow Moth.
Adrien ends up getting akumatized into Ephemeral, and gives his Miraculous to Shadow Moth, unifying all 3 to become Shadow Noir.
Shadow Noir gets Ladybug's Miraculous, and begins to use the Ultimate Power.
Sass uses Second Chance, erasing all events from when Ladybug learned Cat Noir's identity, but messes up the space-time continuum.
After everything is fixed, Su-Han accepts that Ladybug doesn't need to know Cat Noir's identity.
"Kuro Neko"
August gets re-akumatized into Gigantitan, leading to Ladybug getting help from Carapace, Vesperia, Pegasus and Pigella.
Officer Roger gets re-akumatized into Rogercop, leading to Ladybug getting help from Ryuko, King Monkey, Polymouse and Purple Tigress.
After several times of not being called upon and feeling that Ladybug doesn't want or need him anymore, Adrien gives up his Miraculous.
Nathalie has robotic leg braces that help her walk.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Plagg returns the Cat Miraculous to Adrien and helps him reinvent his hero persona with a new costume and a more gallant and refined personality, becoming Cat Walker.
Rythm is amokized, creating Kuro Neko.
After realizing that Cat Walker won't be able to help win, Adrien leaves the fight.
Adrien returns to his old hero persona, once again becoming Cat Noir, and Ladybug tells Cat Noir that he is irreplaceable.
"Penalteam"
Didier Roustan referees Miss Bustier's class in soccer.
Chloé is akumatized into Penalty, and then clones herself into Penalteam.
To face off against Penalteam, Ladybug and Cat Noir gather their entire team of superheroes, except for Rena Furtive.
Sabrina is lent the Dog Miraculous, becoming Miss Hound.
Marc is lent the Rooster Miraculous, becoming Rooster Bold.
Nathaniel is lent the Goat Miraculous, becoming Caprikid.
Ivan is lent the Ox Miraculous, becoming Minotaurox.
After being continually being scored on by the Miraculous holders, Chloé angrily breaks her akumatized object, freeing her from Shadow Moth's influence.
Lila and Chloé agree to work together against Marinette and Ladybug.
Shadow Moth's Final Attack ("Risk" and "Strikeback")

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Froggy is akumatized into Risk.
Risk infects everyone in Paris with his mark, causing them take risks.
Gabriel announces his plans to have Adrien and Lila tour around the world for a photo shoot for a perfume ad.
Félix comes to Paris and trades places with Adrien.
Gabriel entrusts Nathalie with his wife’s ring and with Adrien, in case anything happens to him.
Félix finds the fake Miraculouses in Gabriel’s safe and discovers the underground repository where his Aunt Émilie is being kept.
Shadow Moth amokizes himself, creating Strikeback.
Shadow Moth and the Miraculous team discover that Alya is still using the Fox Miraculous.
Ladybug unifies with the Horse and Rabbit Miraculouses, becoming Pennybug.
Félix, who Pennybug thinks is Adrien, receives the Dog Miraculous, becoming Flairmidable.
Pennybug and Flairmidable travel back in time to the moment that Froggy was akumatized into Risk and hit his akumatized object with the Ball.
After traveling back to the present, Flairmidable uses Fetch to retrieve Risk's akumatized object.
Ladybug transforms into Pegabug and uses Voyage to teleport Strikeback into the sun.
Alya returns the Fox Miraculous to Ladybug.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Félix makes a deal with Gabriel, in exchange for the Peacock Miraculous, Félix will return the ring he previously stole from Gabriel and use the Dog's power to take Ladybug's Yo-yo.
Gabriel accepts the deal and uses the Yo-yo to steal the Miraculouses of the Turtle, Fox, Bee, Mouse, Ox, Tiger, Rabbit, Dragon, Snake, Horse, Goat, Monkey, Rooster, and Pig, in addition to Félix giving him the Dog Miraculous as a bonus.
Gabriel Agreste unifies the Butterfly, Fox, and Turtle Miraculouses to become Monarch.
Shadow Moth, now known as Monarch, makes an announcement to the city that Ladybug has failed and he has all of the Miraculouses which makes Su-Han upset.
Monarch uses Mirage to make illusions of the Miraculous symbols and Shell-ter to protect the illusions and akumas.
The people of Paris cheer in support of Ladybug.
|-|Season 5=
Events of Season 5

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
This season is serialized, with many episodes referencing previous ones. The production codes order fully align with the chronological order, so this section is organized by them. This is with the exception of "Action", since despite being the final episode of the season in production order, its chronological placement was confirmed by international broadcasters like Disney Channel EMEA.
"Evolution"
Gabriel wears the Butterfly, Turtle, Fox, Bee, Mouse, Ox, Tiger, Rabbit, Dragon, Snake, Horse, Goat, Monkey, Rooster, Dog, and Pig Miraculous, taking a new form.
Monarch unifies the Butterfly and Rabbit Miraculous and travels to the past, intending to get the drop on Ladybug and Cat Noir when they were at their weakest.
Future Monarch, Future Ladybug, and Rabbit Noir are seen chasing each other on top of the roof Ladybug and Cat Noir were last seen on in "Strikeback". Ladybug and Cat Noir get confused.
Bunnyx arrives and helps Ladybug and Cat Noir to stop Monarch from changing the past, but Monarch immobilizes her with Venom.
To prevent Monarch from taking Bunnyx's Miraculous, Cat Noir unifies the Black Cat and Rabbit Miraculous, becoming Rabbit Noir.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
After chasing Monarch across time and ending up in The Battle of France in 1940, Ladybug and Rabbit Noir find a young Wang Fu and borrow the past Dog Miraculous.
Present Alix Kubdel receives the Dog Miraculous, becoming Canigirl.
To trap Monarch, Ladybug leaves her Lucky Charm to lure him to the Battle of the Scarlet Army.
Monarch uses Burrow to travel back to before Émilie fell ill from using the damaged Peacock Miraculous so as to give his younger self the instructions to fix the Peacock Miraculous and prevent her from ever getting sick in the first place, but seeing Ladybug's Lucky Charm, he goes to the Battle of the Scarlet Army instead.
Trapping Monarch, Canigirl takes Monarch's Rabbit Miraculous, unifies it with the Dog Miraculous, and escapes into the Burrow before Monarch can use Fetch to get it back.
Cat Noir returns the Rabbit Miraculous to adult Bunnyx, and Ladybug allows present Alix to keep the Rabbit Miraculous, who uses it to transform into teenage Bunnyx, and returns the past Dog Miraculous to young Wang Fu.
To prevent the risk of Monarch reclaiming the Rabbit Miraculous, Alix does not return to the present and instead goes on a long journey across time.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Enraged that Gabriel chose to get Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses over fixing the Peacock Miraculous to heal her and Émilie, Nathalie breaks off ties with Gabriel and stops helping him.
"Multiplication", "Destruction" and Miraculous World: Paris - Tales of Shadybug and Claw Noir
Su-Han, now upset that Ladybug had failed to protect the Miraculous, forces her and Cat Noir to give up their Miraculouses, but ultimately apologizes to them for not being more attentive in 4 months since he arrived in Paris. He leaves to return to the Guardians' temple in Tibet to fetch reinforcements for the fight against Monarch.
Cosmobug and Astro Cat use the space potion power-up to fly to London to find Félix, but his mother, Amélie, tells them she has not seen him.
In reality, Amélie was protecting Félix, who was home the whole time.
Gabriel tries to force the Kwamis to tell him Ladybug's home address.
Marinette reveals that after she became the Guardian, she created a fake treasure hunt under the guise of helping the Kwamis find their way home if they ever got lost. In reality, it was actually a trap for the villain who stole the Miraculous.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
The Kwamis have to tell the truth, so Marinette took advantage of the Kwamis method of finding their way home, following the smell of baked goods, by making it the first clue. As a bonus, she would be alerted to Monarch trying to find her home by none other than Monarch himself.
After Monarch left, Ladybug went to the final stop on the treasure hunt, the statues of her and and Cat Noir at the Grévin Wax Museum to set up her trap.
Ladybug had previously told Cat Noir to follow the Ice Rinks online blog, so he would be alerted if Monarch ever showed up there, and when that happened, he should go to the wax museum immediately. She also told Cat Noir to keep a small piece of paper with the word "halfwit" written on it in his bell in preparation of that day.
This treasure hunt trap would allow any Kwamis who had been captured to be reclaimed and return home, so the Kwamis were telling the truth about why Ladybug created the treasure hunt.
Monarch allows himself to get Cataclysmed so that he can escape the trap, resulting in a dark mark on his arm. He took Ladybug's Lucky Charm when he Voyaged away, so she was not able to do anything to heal him.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
An alternate version of Gabriel Agreste from an Alternate Universe, Betterfly, Kamikotizes the alternate version of Alya, giving her the power to open a portal to another universe and get help from Ladybug and Cat Noir to defeat their evil counterparts, Shadybug and Claw Noir.
Shadybug and Claw Noir force alternate Alya to reopen the portal and follow Betterfly through.
Tikki explains the basics of the Multiverse to Marinette and about why Shadybug and Claw Noir can use their powers continuously.
Betterfly explains to Ladybug and Cat Noir about how his world is ruled by The Supreme, who controls all the Miraculouses, which are a secret to the whole world except for a few chosen holders.
Shadybug and Claw Noir return to Marinette's room, reasoning that as the place where the portal opened in the first place, it might provide some kind of clue.
Shadybug reads through Marinette's diary and is driven to tears.
Shadybug, having learned about the wish from the diary, sneak attacks Claw Noir and takes his Miraculous. She tries to make a wish herself, but Tikki and Plagg are unable to combine into Gimmi.
Shadybug and Claw Noir discover each other's secret identities in the process.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Shadybug and Claw Noir are approached by Monarch, who offers them a team up so they can all get the Miraculouses they want.
Monarch's plan is to use the Fox Miraculous to create gigantic illusions of Shadybug and Claw Noir, tricking Ladybug and Cat Noir into splitting up. Monarch would then use the Horse Miraculous to teleport Shadybug and Claw Noir to their respective counterparts. While the heroes were distracted by their evil doppelgängers, Monarch would use the Mouse Miraculous to go after both of them, the Rooster to turn invisible, and finally use the Bee's power to paralyze them.
What the villains didn't know was that Alya was in the room and heard their whole plan.
After Alya tells Ladybug, Cat Noir, and Betterfly about what the villains are planning, Ladybug comes up with a plan of her own.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
First, they take advantage of the limited range of the Butterfly Miraculous, and once they are far enough away, Betterfly Kamikotizes Alya to open the portal between universes again, then Betterfly lends his Miraculous to Ladybug. Ladybug Kamikotizes alternate Gabriel and gives him the power to bestow a gift of protection onto the heroes so Monarch can't paralyze them. To make sure Monarch can't sense their plan and take away his powers, they use Alya's portal to hide his Kamiko object in the other universe.
With the plan foiled, Monarch decides to cut his losses and returns home.
Ladybug and Cat Noir have their final confrontation with their evil counterparts.
Monarch attempts to use the Rooster Miraculous to travel to other universes to try and steal the Miraculouses from other versions of Ladybug and Cat Noir.
Alya senses the disturbance and Marinette allows herself to be Kamikotized, synchronizing with all her alternate selves who deal with Monarch in each universe he travels to.
Monarch vows to destroy every Ladybug and Cat Noir in every universe but sighs in defeat as it is worthless and designs his new outfit.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Betterfly, along with the redeemed and renamed Ladybug and Paw Noir, return home.
Adrien finally tells his father that he does not want to model anymore, which Gabriel agrees to.
Gabriel has Adrien's image scanned into a computer so that the computer rendering can handle the modeling from then on.
Alim Kubdel, with permission from Ladybug, tells Miss Bustier's class about his daughter being entrusted with the Rabbit Miraculous and how she will be away until Monarch is defeated.
More than six weeks pass without Monarch making any moves.
During that time, Gabriel melts down the Miraculouses to create his personal set of Alliance rings that he calls the "new Miraculouses" and becomes final form Monarch.
Tomoe is re-akumatized into Ikari Gozen and is able to use Multitude without having the Mouse Miraculous on her.
At some point, Gabriel revealed to Tomoe that he is Monarch and they became partners. Together, they developed the Alliance rings, which allow Monarch to bestow the superpowers of the Miraculouses to his akumatized villains without him having to give them the actual Miraculous.
The attack by Ikari Gozen was actually to test the prototype Alliance ring.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Ladybug creates a Magical Charm and gives it to Tomoe.
Gabriel and Tomoe mass produce the Alliance rings under the guise of them being smart devices and they are very popular, to the point where everyone stops using their smartphones.
Félix puts on the Peacock Miraculous for the first time and meets Duusu.
"Jubilation"
Marinette's former schoolmate, Socqueline, has been going out dressed as Ladybug doing heroic deeds.
Marinette goes to the art supply shop owned by Socqueline's family under the guise of buying supplies for her mother's painting class so that she can talk to Socqueline and convince her not to go out heroing anymore for fear that she might get mistaken for the real Ladybug.
Socqueline lets Marinette try on her Alliance Ring and Marinette accidentally wears it while she goes out as Ladybug to stop a flock of dinosaur-pigeon hybrids that escaped from a science lab.
This results in Monarch believing that Socqueline is Ladybug, as he was alerted that the wearer of Socqueline's ring demonstrated superhuman capabilities on the rings' fitness tracker.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Denis Damoclès broke his owl mask and gets discouraged from heroics when he goes to buy a new one. As a result, he is akumatized into Darker Owl.
Monarch uses the Alliance Rings to give Darker Owl the superpower of the Pig Miraculous, Gift.
Darker Owl uses Gift on Ladybug and Cat Noir.
In the Gift, both Ladybug and Cat Noir's dreams were combined into one: Ladybug and Cat Noir defeat Monarch and retrieve it in the Miracle Box (Ladybug's dream). They later get married and have kids (Cat Noir's dream).
Ladybug creates a Magical Charm and gives it to Denis.
"Illusion"
Nino starts a resistance group made up of the inactive Miraculous holders in hopes that they will be able to help Ladybug and Cat Noir from behind the scenes.
Gabriel comes to a parent-teacher conference and the resistance group plans to get him angry so he'll get akumatized and they can see how Monarch is giving his villains Miraculous superpowers.
However, Gabriel receives a warning from Lila on his way in.
When Gabriel gets home, he uses the power of the Fox Miraculous, Mirage, to create an illusion of himself getting akumatized.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Adrien records the akumatization on his phone and Nino analyzes the footage in super slow motion, discovering a magic bolt of lightning that he believes Monarch uses to give and take back the Miraculouses.
"Determination"
Véronique has a meeting with Mayor Bourgeois about opening a new superhero exhibit at the Grévin Wax Museum to give hope to the people of Paris, but the Mayor claims that reminding people about the other heroes being inactive will cause akumatizations (in reality, his daughter, Chloé, still bitter about no longer being Queen Bee, demands that the exhibit be shut down).
The Mayor rejects the proposal for the new exhibit and even threatens to shut down the whole museum on false charges of health code violations if they try to open it anyway. As a result, Véronique is akumatized into Manipula.
Monarch uses the Alliance Rings to give Manipula the superpower of the Ox Miraculous, Resistance.
Ladybug creates a Magical Charm and gives it to Véronique.
Adrien comes to the realization that he has fallen in love with Marinette.
Marinette come to the realization that she has fallen in love with Cat Noir.
"Passion"

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Nathalie tells Gabriel that his goal is unachievable, but Gabriel shows her his Cataclysmed flesh, revealing that quitting is no longer an option, or else Adrien will end up all alone.
Nathalie allows Gabriel to akumatize her into Safari so that she can get the Miraculouses before he can, fearing what he could do with the wish.
Monarch uses the Alliance Rings to give Safari the superpower of the Goat Miraculous, Genesis.
To bypass Safari's tracking abilities, Ladybug and Cat Nor swap Miraculouses to become Mister Bug and Lady Noire.
"Reunion"
Marinette found a letter behind a painting in the Louvre that Alix wrote to her father about her time travel adventures.
Marinette uses her kwagatama to summon the ghost of a past Ladybug Miraculous holder, Jeanne d'Arc, in hopes of getting relationship advice.
Jalil, upset about his sister leaving and fooled by online posts about Ladybug and Cat Noir being the real bad guys, is re-akumatized into Pharaoh.
Monarch uses the Alliance Rings to give Pharaoh the superpower of the Turtle Miraculous, Shell-ter.
Plagg gives Adrien a kwagatama.
"Elation"

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Cat Noir takes Marinette for André's Ice Cream, but André refuses to serve them, believing that they aren't each other's rightful soulmates.
In the process, Cat Noir finds out about Marinette having been in love with his civilian alter ego, Adrien.
Marinette is almost akumatized into Unmasker, but is interrupted by a kiss from Cat Noir.
André is re-akumatized into Glaciator.
Monarch uses the Alliance Rings to give Glaciator the superpower of the Tiger Miraculous, Clout.
The Kwamis' Choice ("Transmission" and "Deflagration")
It has been 286 days (9 months and 12 days) since Adrien first came to school and Ladybug and Cat Noir first began their mission. Adrien stops being friends with Lila (off-screen).
Marinette falls into despair over her failures in love and as a Guardian. She stays home from school because of it.
Adrien brings Marinette the schoolwork that she missed.
While there, Marinette confesses her feelings for Adrien, but claims that she no longer feels that way about him, causing him to fall into despair as well.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Plagg and Tikki feel awful about what the mission is doing to their holders and decide to take away their Miraculouses so that Marinette and Adrien can finally be free and happy.
Tikki chooses Alya to be her new holder, who uses the Ladybug Miraculous to transform into Scarabella.
Plagg chooses Zoé to be his new holder, who uses the Cat Miraculous to transform into Kitty Noire.
Kouki is akumatized into Kikou.
Monarch uses the Alliance Rings to give Kikou the superpowers of the Tiger, Turtle, Mouse, Ox, and Horse Miraculouses, Clout, Shell-ter, Multitude, Resistance, and Voyage.
Gabriel's own Alliance ring detects two people whose fitness trackers registered superhuman capabilities.
Chloé is akumatized into Sole Destroyer.
Monarch steals the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses.
Tikki and Plagg use their superpowers to try to thwart Monarch.
Tikki releases her Lucky Charm out to the world so fortune can do the rest, while Plagg Cataclysms his own Miraculous, preventing Monarch from having both.
Tikki and Plagg's superpowers cause a city-wide calamity of creation and destruction.
Monarch unifies the Butterfly Miraculous and the Ladybug Miraculous, becoming Monarch Bug.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
The Resistance squares off against Monarch Bug and helps Ladybug to get her Miraculous back, allowing her to use the Miraculous Ladybug power to stop the calamity and bring back the Cat Miraculous to Cat Noir.
The heroes see that Monarch reforged the stolen Miraculouses into rings.
"Perfection"
Marinette tries numerous times with help from all her friends to try and confess her feelings for Adrien, only for it to go horribly wrong every time.
Marinette feels embarrassed about her inability to talk to Adrien and cannot bring herself to face Kagami after all she did to try to get them together.
Adrien writes a song to confess his feelings to Marinette and plays it with Kitty Section.
Marinette vents to Alya about the complications of her life, not realizing that Kagami overheard everything and discovered her secret identity as Ladybug.
Lila convinces Kagami to take a friendship quiz to see if Marinette is actually her friend and she fails. This causes her to get akumatized into Ryukomori.
Monarch uses the Alliance Rings to give Ryukomori the superpower of the Dragon Miraculous, Wind Dragon, Water Dragon, and Lightning Dragon.
"Migration"

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Bob learns about Luka being the son of Jagged Stone.
Bob tricks Kitty Section into signing a contract that actually ruins their musical dreams so that he can replace Jagged with Luka.
Luka nearly gets akumatized into Silencer and Monarch discovers that he knows Ladybug and Cat Noir's true identities.
Bob is akumatized into Gold Record.
Monarch uses the Alliance Rings to give Gold Record the superpower of the Horse Miraculous, Voyage.
To protect Ladybug and Cat Noir's secret identities, Luka leaves Paris with Jagged and Penny.
"Derision"
Marinette has her first proper date with Adrien at the public pool, but trauma caused by Chloé's bullying the previous school year causes her to have a series of panic attacks.
Marinette is almost akumatized into Panic.
Kim recounts the story of a prank he pulled on Marinette the previous year at Chloé's recommendation and is reprimanded for his actions.
Kim is akumatized into Dark Humor.
Monarch uses the Alliance Rings to give Dark Humor the superpower of the Monkey Miraculous, Uproar.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Adrien visits Chloé and insists that she apologize to Marinette for all her past wrongdoings, only to finally end his friendship with her permanently when she refuses and now Chloé sees Adrien as a traitor.
"Intuition"
Monarch has been using the power of Second Chance to help his akumatized supervillains, but the heroes always ended up getting the best of him.
Since Second Chance rewinds time for the rest of the world, but the user still remembers everything, Gabriel's Cataclysm injury continued to spread as if time was still flowing normally, basically expediting his condition and shortening what time he has left.
Due to the spread of the Cataclysm injury, his heart has begun beating irregularly, and he begins to suffer from strong chest pain.
Tomoe's tech company creates a new one-man space jet with an A.I. assistant based on Markov's program, A.D.A..
Monarch convinced Tomoe to give him the password for A.D.A.'s system, allowing him to put his plan into action.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
After shutting down A.D.A.'s sensors so she would no longer be able to detect her pilot, Claudie Kanté, she believed that she was a failure and wanted to disappear into space, even though in reality, Claudie was safely in the cockpit. Monarch then used the power of Genesis to create a giant meteor hurtling towards earth. He then used the power of Mirage to announce to the city about A.D.A. and the meteor, convincing Cosmobug and Astro Cat to split up so they would not be able to help each other. He akumatized A.D.A. into Bugfighter to capture Cosmobug, and after Astro Cat used up his Cataclysm on the meteor, Monarch trapped him in Shell-ter, teleported to him with Voyage, and immobilized him with Venom.
Monarch used the power of Second Chance multiple times to try and make this plan successful, but it was ultimately a failure every time. This failure greatly affected his health and left him with very little time.
As of these events, Monarch can never use the power of Second Chance again.
"Protection"
The inactive members of the French Miraculous superhero team set up a romantic moment for Marinette and Adrien, but they do not feel comfortable and let the moment go to waste.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Gabriel reveals his Cataclysm injury to Tomoe.
Lila tells Kagami that Adrien is no longer friends with her.
Adrien wants to invite Marinette over for a picnic. Gabriel disapproves, but Nathalie gives permission.
Lila deceives Kagami into believing that Marinette is a liar who manipulates people and she is akumatized into Riposte Prime.
Monarch uses the Alliance Rings to give Riposte Prime the superpower of the Turtle Miraculous, Shell-ter.
"Adoration"
Marinette and Zoé are elected by their respective grades to plan the End-of-the-School-Year dance, which is two weeks away.
Sabrina is re-akumatized into Vanisher.
Monarch uses the Alliance Rings to give Vanisher the superpower of the Dog Miraculous, Fetch.
Chloé, Lila and Vanisher try to frame Marinette for a series of thefts.
Zoé confesses to Marinette that she is in love with her.
Marinette finally tells Adrien that she is in love with him.
"Emotion"
Gabriel hosts an annual invitation only event known as the Diamonds Dance, a ball where the richest and most important people in Paris show off their greatest treasures: their heirs and heiresses.
Gabriel tells Adrien not to tell Marinette about the event.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Félix returns to Paris and uses the Peacock Miraculous to create Red Moon.
Félix uses Red Moon to make Adrien disappear and takes his place to gain entrance to the Diamonds Dance.
Marinette crashes the party using the invitation that Zoé didn't want so she can tell Adrien that he didn't have to keep secrets from her.
Félix uses Red Moon to make everyone at the Diamonds Dance disappear, intending to get rid of everyone who tries to be controlling of others, eventually making nearly everyone in Paris disappear.
He brings everyone back and destroys the Sentimonster after seeing that Marinette has disappeared and he is unable to bring her back, thinking the power he has created for himself is too dangerous and cannot be controlled.
Amélie is revealed to know that her son is the Peacock Miraculous holder.
Gabriel will never let Adrien see Marinette again.
Lila reveals that she knows Gabriel is Monarch.
"Pretension"
Gabriel attempts to use the essence of all the kwamis to heal his Cataclysm injury, but it fails.
Marinette comes over to the Agreste mansion and has a talk with Gabriel.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Félix has been following and spying on Kagami and due to his inability to be social, Argos kidnaps her out of her car in an effort to be alone with her and get to know her better.
Tomoe puts on multiple Alliance rings and calls on Monarch to akumatize her to save Kagami.
Monarch akumatizes her into Matagi Gozen and uses the Alliance Rings to give her the superpowers of the Rooster, Bee, Mouse, Horse, and Tiger Miraculouses, Sublimation, Venom, Multitude, Voyage, and Clout.
Félix admits that he does not like using the Peacock superpower, he feels it's wrong to create living beings only to use them, control them, and destroy them after.
Tomoe takes back the Tsurugi family ring from Kagami, but Félix swapped it out with a fake and gave the real ring back to Kagami when they meet up later.
"Revelation"
There are two weeks left until the end of the school year.
It is revealed that Lila has multiple families and identities.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Gabriel replaces Lila with Kagami as the female template for the Alliance Rings AI and displays Adrien and Kagami as a couple. He believes that if the whole world believes the lie that Adrien and Kagami are together, then it will be just the same as if it were actually the truth.
Because Sabrina was working so hard for Chloé, she hadn't gotten enough sleep. This caused her to make a mistake on a test paper, leading to Ms. Bustier finding out that Sabrina has been doing all of Chloé's school work their whole lives.
Lila tricks the class into re-holding the class representative elections and she runs with Chloé as her deputy, her platform being that even the most terrible people can change, though the whole thing is actually a long game scheme to ruin Marinette's life once for all.
Lila fakes an emotional breakdown during the campaign speeches and allows herself to be akumatized into Hoaxer.
Monarch uses the Alliance Rings to give Hoaxer the superpower of the Fox Miraculous, Mirage.
Hoaxer creates an illusion of Marinette transforming into Monach to turn all people in Paris (including her family and friends) against her.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
While controlling Nathalie, the latter reveals all of Gabriel's secrets by taking pictures of photos and documents from his past, how he finds the Peacock Miraculous, his contracts with Tomoe, the images of the Miraculous spellbook, the secret code on Émilie's painting to the lair, Émilie herself in the comatose state, and one of the Graham de Vanily Twin Rings on her finger. After that, she sends all the pictures to Lila, who learns all about Gabriel's archives.
Marinette frees Alya from Hoaxer's influence and gives her the Ladybug Miraculous.
When Marinette confronts Hoaxer directly, she pretends to have a moment of emotional growth and rejects the akuma, as was her plan from the beginning. Then, Scarabella uses the magic ladybugs to repair all the damage.
Lila and Chloé are elected the new class representatives by unanimous vote. Marinette allows Lila to have her way for now so she can ultimately expose who she truly is.
"Confrontation"
The students at Collège Françoise Dupont are submitting their career aspiration forms to the school so the teachers can review them and determine if they have the grades necessary to pursue their chosen career path.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Chloé and Lila have Sabrina use her skills with duplicating handwriting to forge fake forms for the teachers to review and put their classmates on paths that don't match their ambitions. They intend to blame Marinette so everyone would hate her. Lila decides to use Sabrina to dismantle Adrien's relationship on Marinette.
Sabrina has serious misgivings about this plan and finally decides that enough is enough. She calls Marinette days ahead of time, and she comes up with a plan of her own to expose who Lila really is once and for all.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Marinette puts up an "Out of Order" sign on the girls restroom and Principal Damoclès sets up a temporary restroom in the courtyard. Marinette replaces the mirror in the temporary bathroom with one-way glass and sets up a hidden microphone. Once the class tries to figure out what happened with the forms, Sabrina confesses to being the one who faked them, but instead of blaming Marinette, she told the truth about Chloé and Lila being responsible. Sabrina claims she has proof and runs to the temporary bathroom, followed by Lila and Chloé. Believing that nobody is listening, Lila reveals herself to be an unapologetic merciless liar. Sabrina reveals the see-through mirror and shows them that Marinette brought the entire school to witness Lila's confession in person.
After the fake forms set her up to repeat the year, Juleka is akumatized into Reflekta.
Monarch uses the Alliance Rings to give Reflekta the superpower of the Tiger Miraculous, Clout.
After Chloé and Lila fall into Marinette's trap, Chloé calls her father to get them out of trouble. The Mayor also insists that the students cannot resubmit their career forms.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Principal Damoclès feels that he has failed his students and nearly gets akumatized; however, thanks to the encouragement of the students, they discover a hidden power of Ladybug's Magical Charms and the Megakuma is warded away.
Inspired, Principal Damoclès finally stands up to Mayor Bourgeois and gives the students new forms to fill out, though at the cost of his job.
As Principal Damoclès leaves his office, he is given the heroes farewell.
Lila discards her "Lila Rossi" identity by throwing her wig in a trash can, and returns to her original identity, Cerise Bianca. While she's doing this, she calls Chloé, telling her to be ready for what comes next.
Cerise returns to her other school, Collège Paul Bert.
"Action"
It's June and Paris is experiencing a heatwave.
The Gabriel brand has partnered with a plastic company to produce disposable hand fans, available in vending machines put up by city hall.
The inactive members of the French Miraculous superhero team try to clean the Seine of plastic pollution (which has recently become much worse due to the fans) by converting the Liberty into an ecological water treatment plant, but the machine cannot keep up with so much plastic.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
The kids take advantage of Adrien being the face of the hand fan ad to get a meeting with the CEO of the plastic company, Bertrand King, who disregards their concerns in favor of his profits.
The kids try to talk convince Mayor Bourgeois and Gabriel, but their concerns are disregarded.
Marinette asks Nadja Chamack to spread awareness of plastic pollution on the news, but she cannot because Bertrand's plastic ads are the studio's biggest money maker.
When all else fails, the kids and their friends from around the world hijack a news broadcast to spread an anti-pollution message.
People everywhere start to disapprove of plastic products and Gabriel and Mayor Bourgeois leave Bertrand out to dry.
Bertrand is akumatized into King of Plastic.
Monarch uses the Alliance rings to give King of Plastic the superpower of the Bee Miraculous, Venom.
After the battle leaves Bertrand in a pile of plastic garbage, he admits that plastic pollution is a problem and finances the effort to clean the river.
"Collusion"
Olga Mendeleiev has since become the new principal at Collège Françoise Dupont.
Cerise is feeding Chloé instructions from afar via an earpiece.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Chloé has Ms. Bustier fired/dismissed from her job.
Monarch attempts to akumatize her into Miss Sans-Culotte, but she rejects his offer.
Gabriel and Tomoe have a meeting with Mayor Bourgeois about commissioning police robots, but the Mayor refuses.
Chloé barges into the meeting at Cerise's behest and puts an idea in Gabriel's head.
Mayor Bourgeois confesses to Gabriel that he is deeply unhappy with how his life turned out and resolves that it might not be too late to start over.
However, Gabriel secretly records the conversation and then edits it to make the Mayor look like a tyrant, as Cerise is watching both of them.
Gabriel sends the video to Miss Bustier and is, this time, able to successfully akumatize her into Miss Sans-Culotte.
Monarch uses the Alliance Rings to give Miss Sans-Culotte the Pig Miraculous power of Jubilation.
Miss Sans-Culotte goes on the news and shares the video with all of Paris.
Ladybug and Cat Noir convince Miss Sans-Culotte that she should attempt to reason with the Mayor before resorting to violence.
After seeing the video and realizing that Gabriel betrayed their friendship, Mayor Bourgeois got the push he needed to set his life back on track.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
When Miss Sans-Culotte arrived in his office, he hired her back to her old job and resigned from his position as Mayor.
While all this was happening, Chloé secretly made a deal with Gabriel for the power that her father was bound to lose after these events.
Chloé is armed with an army of police robots and has declared herself the "interim" Mayor in her father's stead. Her first order of business is to declare all Miraculous holders, including Ladybug, Cat Noir, and Monarch, as outlaws.
"Revolution"
Ladybug and Cat Noir decide not to deal with Chloé's bid for power, because while she is definitely a villain, she is not an akumatized supervillain. They decide to let the system handle her.
Chloé allows Monarch to akumatize her into Queen Mayor, and though she has no superpowers herself, she also didn't look like a costumed villain, making it impossible for anyone to tell that she was akumatized. This also allows Monarch to give her the powers of Sublimation, Venom, Voyage, Shell-ter, and Resistance, all of which were transferred to her police robots.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
The police robots patrol the city while using Sublimation to make themselves invisible. If someone was caught breaking the rules, or if Chloé simply felt like it, the robots would immobilize that person with Venom and use Voyage to teleport them to Chloé inhumane detention facility.
As Chloé is hosting a big campaign rally, Ladybug and Cat Noir finally decide to act, but are captured by the robots with Shell-ter, and their powers cannot get them out because the barriers are combined with Resistance.
Just as they are about to de-transform back, Ladybug and Cat Noir have a major epiphany about what it truly means to be a hero, resulting in them "growing up" and allowing them to use their superpowers without timing out.
Chloé is defeated, stripped of all power, is left with nothing and no one, and hits rock-bottom. As a result, she is taken to London, United Kingdom, by her mother.
Cerise steals Tomoe's personal laptop for unknown reasons.
Caline Bustier is nominated to become a candidate in the upcoming mayoral election.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Tomoe confirms to Gabriel that enough Alliance rings have been sold worldwide for them to commence their final plan, and they intend to begin as soon as Adrien and Kagami are safe in London.
Adrien leaves for London, but not before he and Marinette share their first kiss.
Chloé calls Marinette, attempting to bully her one last time, but the latter tells Chloé the hard truth that Adrien loves her, getting justice for all the people she harmed and has no power over Paris anymore and Chloé is left in tears over her fate.
"Representation"
Adrien transforms into Astro Cat and flies back to Paris for Marinette.
Argos comes for Kagami and they return to Paris together.
The "end of the school year" dance is held on the Eiffel Tower.
Félix disguises himself as Adrien to lure Marinette away from the party and leads her to the art classroom.
Argos uses the Peacock Miraculous to manifest his and Kagami's yearning for the truth into Once Upon a Time.
They put on a theatrical performance for Marinette to tell her the story of how their life situation came to be.
After finding out that Adrien and Kagami were gone, Gabriel akumatizes himself into Nightormentor to look for them.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Cat Noir and the inactive heroes Resistance group defeat Nightormentor, but since Ladybug never used her power to repair everything, the effects of Nightormentor's powers remain active.
Adrien and Kagami return to London and their parents lock them in safe rooms to make sure they can't escape again.
The Final Day ("Conformation" and "Re-creation") and Miraculous World: London - At the Edge of Time
Gabriel and Nathalie only have a few hours left to live.
Gabriel wrote a letter for Adrien to continue his legacy as a Miraculous-hunter in case he is already dead, and wanted to him to revive him and Emilie with the wish.
Gabriel and Tomoe commence their final plan, Operation: Perfect Alliance, in order to turn the entirety of the human population into Miraculous-powered villains.
Gabriel re-akumatizes himself into Nightormentor and takes on the powers of the Mouse, Horse, and Rooster Miraculouses.
He uses Multitude to make many of himself, then they all use Voyage to go all over the world and Sublimation to fly.
The numerous Nightormentors use their powers from high in the air to infect everyone in the world with stressful hallucinations.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
The next day, Gabriel uses the Alliance rings to get everyone hooked on a new tranquility app that can cure them of their nightmare visions, and once as many people as possible are reliant on it, he broadcasts a simulation to all the Alliance rings, in which digitally recreated images of Ladybug and Cat Noir kidnap the digitally recreated images of Adrien and Kagami, thus disabling the tranquility app and causing everyone's nightmares to return.
Then, he uses the Alliance rings to broadcast an offer to all people the chance to save Adrien and Kagami and get the tranquility app running again.
Those who accept are transformed into Miraculous-powered villains.
Additionally, thanks to the Magical Charm that Ladybug gave them, and Gabriel's Cataclysm injury, Gabriel and Tomoe were able to give the Miraculized villains the quantum imprint of Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses, allowing them to track them down as long as the Miraculouses are being used.
Adrien, believing that he is in no condition to wield the power of destruction with his head full of nightmares, sends Plagg back to Paris with the Cat Miraculous.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Nathalie tried to stop Gabriel from carrying out his plan, but he takes her down easily.
Marinette sees Monarch de-transform while he is putting Nathalie back in bed after her attempt to stop him and she learns his true identity, and from Nathalie the horrible side effects of using a damaged Miraculous.
Marinette de-transforms to hide from the Miraculized villains as they are looking for and tracking Ladybug, not Marinette.
Plagg locates Ladybug by following the villains and meets up with her.
After finding out that she is actually in his house, Monarch absorbs the powers of the Ox, Horse, Bee, and Turtle Miraculouses and goes to confront Ladybug in person and learns her true identity.
Marinette unifies the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses to become Bug Noire and has her final battle with Monarch.
During their fight, Bug Noire knocks the Butterfly Miraculous off of him, meaning that she, the Guardian, technically stripped him of the Miraculous, so he is not the holder of the Butterfly Miraculous anymore. But the Miraculous mysterious disappear.
Ladydragon and the United Heroez arrive in Paris to help stop the worldwide disaster.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Marinette de-transforms and tries to give Gabriel a chance to do the right thing, but he paralyzes her with Venom and takes both the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses for himself.
Gabriel summons Gimmi and makes his wish to heal Nathalie at the cost of his own life.
After the wish is made, Bug Noire destroys Gabriel's lair, the Kwami cages, and The Crypt, and retrieves all the stolen Miraculouses that had been turned into rings.
Ladybug files to London and tells Adrien, Kagami, and the public a half truth to protect Adrien's feelings: that Gabriel and Tomoe were forced to help Monarch under threat of their children being harmed, and that she was badly hurt in her final battle with Monarch and Gabriel used the wish to heal her and Nathalie at the cost of his own life and Monarch's.
During the final battle, Cerise Bianca finds and stole the Butterfly Miraculous under the cover of chaos and used it to transform herself into Timestalker, a villain with the power to teleport through time. She used this power to find out Ladybug's true identity, and wrote the information down in a notebook so she wouldn't forget after being deakumatized.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Cerise akumatizes herself into Spectral Looter, a villain with the powers of a ghost. She snuck in to Marinette's bedroom and stole all the Miraculouses.
Cerise makes a wish that destroys the flow of time, and Bunnyx from her Burrow sees the future windows fade black.
Bunnyx grabs Marinette to help her solve the situation.
The time-destroying wish made it so Bunnyx couldn't go to the future anymore, but she could still travel to the past.
Marinette's earrings had been stolen, so she borrows the Ladybug Miraculous from her past self, from the time she temporarily renounced them after the first battle with Stoneheart.
Marinette wills herself to have an alternate costume so Bunnyx can tell the difference between past and future selves, becoming Chronobug.
Chronobug couldn't stop Spectral Looter, so she instead decided to go back and prevent the ghost villain from learning her identity.
They find Timestalker and Chronobug uses observations to deduce that this person is working alone and is therefore the new Butterfly Miraculous holder.
Chronobug and Timestalker begin a game of cat and mouse across time.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Marinette manages to take Timestalker's notebook to erase her name and write in "Gabriel Agreste" without Timestalker realizing until it's too late.
Cerise read the notebook and went mad because she thought she wrote it. She then ultimately gives up, returning the timeline to normal.
One month later:
Gabriel is honored as a hero for his sacrifice and the Alliance rings are melted down to make a statue of him.
Tomoe became the new owner of the Gabriel brand.
The Kingdom calls Nathalie and Tomoe Tsurugi for their Operation: Perfect World.
Tomoe continues Gabriel's legacy as a villain and was entrusted by the members of the council to retrieve the Miraculouses.
After the council ends, Camilo Pista commands Nathalie to give the Miraculouses for him, as they are father and daughter.
Caline Bustier has been elected Mayoress of Paris and she starts to remake the entire city into a more eco-friendly place, creating suspended gardens, reducing the CO2 emission by implanting a system of airship taxis to replace cars, and cleaning the Seine. She has also given birth to her daughter, Harmonie.
Marinette gives Adrien the Graham de Vanily Twin Rings containing his amok, giving him his freedom.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
A few weeks later, just days before the start of the new school year, Marinette returns the Miraculouses back to their original forms, with a few new features of her own, and decides to give them back to their holders permanently to prevent another situation where the Miraculouses could be stolen all at once again.
Cerise, now known as Chrysalis, swears vengeance on Ladybug and declares that their war has only just begun and enrolls under an unknown identity at Mr. Damoclès' brand new school where Marinette and her friends will be attending.
Some strange lightning-like presence appears behind Cerise, leaving her fate unknown.
