Events of Season 6
This season is less interconnected than the previous ones, with many episodes referencing events of other episodes that occur later in the production line. The order of production codes mostly align with the chronological order, so this section is organized by them, except when the events of an episode are referred to in another episode, ensuring it must happen before the latter episode.
"Miraculous Tokyo" - first, second and third flashbacks
It's Kagami's 14th birthday.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
After Kagami uses a bow and arrow to make the ring not touch the ground, Tomoe lets her go to school.
Kagami meets Miki, Kazuno, and a few other people.
Kazuno offers to be Kagami's friend forever.
Kazuno and Kagami played Stellar Dance at an arcade.
Kagami fell in love with Kazuno, but he was already in love with Miki.
"Yaksi Gozen" - first flashback
Gabriel recruits Tomoe to defeat Ladybug and Cat Noir.
"Miraculous Tokyo" - fourth flashback (before "Riposte")
Kagami tells Kazuno that her mother is moving her to Paris and runs away in tears.
"Mister Agreste" - first flashback (after "Migration")
Luka goes to Brazil because he fears that Monarch will akumatize him and reveal the identities of Ladybug and Cat Noir.
Adrien confirms that Luka knows his identity as Cat Noir.
"Yaksi Gozen" - second flashback (during "The Final Day")
Gabriel double-crosses Tomoe Tsurugi before his battle with Bug Noire.
Tomoe worries about Kagami and calls Cerise to go to his mansion.
"Mister Agreste" - second flashback (after "Miraculous London")

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Luka goes back to Brazil because he fears that Chrysalis will akumatize him because he still loves Marinette; however, he lies to her, affirming that he's going back to Brazil because he met an amazing girl there.
In an erased timeline, he confesses his feelings to Marinette, but because her reaction wasn't the one that he expected, Luka went back in time to try again.
"Lady Chaos" - flashback
Adrien, as Cat Noir, destroys the Statue of Gabriel Agreste at the Place des Vosges.
Miraculous World: Tokyo - Stellar Force
Adrien visits New York for a few days.
Adrien and Marinette recreate their dance from Chloé's party and the New York party.
Kagami alerts Marinette that Tokyo needs Ladybug.
Kagami and Marinette travel to Tokyo by taking Tomoe's private jet.
Tikki helps Marinette understand and speak the Japanese language by popping herself into her head.
Kagami is still in the group chat of a newly-formed superhero team as they forgot to remove her.
Marinette finds out that Kagami used to had friends.
A Tokyo taxi driver takes Kagami and Marinette to her grandmother's place.
Marinette meets Nozomi and Shinobu, Kagami's grandmothers.
The latter scares Marinette, who freaked out.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Moddler tells the Tokyo taxi driver that he's upgrading it.
Ladybug and Ryuko help the Tokyo team defeat the kaiju.
Capricorn noticed strange marking on the kaiju. Ladybug gives him her Lucky Charm to him to show the team the spots.
Kagami exposes herself as Ryuko to her friends and grandmothers.
Miki and Kazuno reveal their identities as Leo and Capricorn to Marinette.
Kagami and Kazuno reconcile.
The superhero team is now called Stellar Force.
The Stellar Force performs their own version of Miraculous Ladybug called Miraculous Steller Force.
Cat Noir and The United Heroez face off against a hand-like villain.
"Vampigami" - flashback
TBA
"Revelator" - flashback
Ladybug and Cat Noir help all their Parisian hero-friends mature psychologically and unlock their adult powers.
The Parisian Superhero Team decides that their name will be "The Miraculers".
"Grendiaper" - flashback
The Miraculers civilian alter-egos reunite on the first day back at school.
Kim brings Zoé to go meet someone who also came from New York just like her, only for that person to be her archenemy Ray.
"Wreckless Driver" - flashback
Aglaé comes back to school after Ladybug claimed she had defeated Hawk Moth.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Aglaé is locked in the Butterfly Greenhouse by three mean bullies. This leads to Chrysalis making her first public attack, as she akumatizes Aglaé into Lady Butterfly, a butterfly-themed supervillain.
"Daddycop"
Sabrina is struggling with the loss of Chloé. In spite of everything, she was still Sabrina's only friend.
Marinette is planning a special romantic dinner for her 100th kiss with Adrien, including a fireworks display. She is determined for it to happen that evening specifically due to the occurrence of an astrological event said to represent good luck.
Marinette is so focused on the romantic evening, she forgets that it's the night of her monthly movie night sleepover with the girls.
Sabrina feels like she doesn't have a place in the friend group, so Zoé invites her to the sleepover.
Marinette tries to combine the movie night and romantic evening, but Adrien doesn't go for it and insists that she spend the night with the girls.
Zoé tries to convince the girls to let Sabrina come to the sleepover, but they're not thrilled with the idea.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Marinette, still hopeful that Adrien will change his mind, asks the girls to let him come, but due to a misunderstanding, they think she's talking about Sabrina.
Marinette is very disappointed when Sabrina shows up at her house instead of Adrien.
The new Butterfly Miraculous holder tries to akumatize Sabrina, but she resists it.
Roger is akumatized into Daddycop.
Sabrina tries to give back the Dog Miraculous, feeling like her past crimes as Chloé's minion are an inescapable stain on her character, but is reassured by some encouraging words from Ladybug.
To represent her decision to change and be better, Miss Hound changes her costume and the camouflaged mode of her Miraculous.
Ladybug creates a Magical Charm and gives it to Roger.
Sabrina kicks off the new phase of her life by giving herself a new look.
Marinette shares her 100th kiss with Adrien in a casual setting after realizing she doesn't need the stars to align for them to be in love.
Zoé is confronted by an old bully from her old school in New York.
"The Dirtifiers"
TBA
"Revelator"
Vincent Asa has become an influencer who uses lies to spread disinformation and attacks Marinette and Adrien's relationship on social media.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Marinette and Adrien decide to have an interview with him, with Tom and Placide tagging along to protect them. Despite their attempt to clear things up, Vincent still manipulates and worsens the narrative.
Alya and Marinette plan to expose all the methods that Vincent uses for deceiving viewers.
Rena Rouge, using Mirage, disguises herself as a trendy-looking influencer to lure Vincent into their trap by claiming that she wants tips on how to become a famous influencer like him.
Successfully, Alya manages to expose Vincent, who loses his followers and respect.
Enraged with his exposal, Vincent is akumatized by Chrysalis into Revelator.
Ladybug gets hit by Revelator's powers and her secret of knowing that Gabriel Agreste was Monarch is revealed to Rena Rouge.
This angers the latter, as she realizes that Marinette has lied to not only Paris, but the entire world.
Cat Noir upgrades his powers and learns to use the Miraculous Cat Noir, successfully erasing what Rena Rouge had learned about Gabriel Agreste being Monarch.
Alya realizes that Marinette is carrying a big burden and aims to support her, but Trixx does not tell her what it is.
"Climatiqueen"

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Marinette tries to help Adrien find his passion.
Aurore Beaureal enters Chloé's social media competition, in which whoever gains the most followers will get whatever they want.
In Aurore's case, she wants a signed copy of the book Weather From Space, written by Max's mom, Claudie Kanté.
Despite her efforts, mainly by uploading shady posts about Marinette and Adrien's relationship, she fails when time is almost up. She is akumatized by Chrysalis into Climatiqueen, using her powers to become more popular.
After being de-akumatized by Ladybug, Cat Noir and Pegasus, she is encouraged to be true to herself and talk about her passions about weather phenomena.
Ladybug gives Aurore a Magical Charm.
At the end of the episode, Adrien discovers his passion for running through Sublime Varlette.
"Sublimation"
Marinette has been spying on Adrien and his new running partner, Sublime, a champion Paralympic with multiple admirable qualities.
Marinette looks for a chance to be of help to Sublime so they can become friends, but Sublime is very resourceful, so Marinette never gets the chance she's looking for.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Sublime has a running demonstration for Bob Roth, in hopes of getting a sponsorship so she can qualify for the next level of her athletic career.
Marinette pretends to be an akumatized villain so Sublime will not recognize her and to really sell the act, she transforms into Ladybug.
Ladybug's sudden appearance causes Sublime to stumble during her run and break her prosthetic running legs.
Sublime's mother, Caroline, is akumatized into Sublimation.
Ladybug creates a Magical Charm and gives it to Caroline.
Sublime and her family realize that Bob Roth is terrible and decide to find a different sponsor, Tomoe Tsurugi.
"Werepapas"
Adrien's paternal grandparents from the north come to visit Adrien on the same day that his maternal grandparents come to visit from London.
Marinette wishes to be there to support Adrien, but the lunch is family only, so she goes undercover as a member of the house staff.
Adrien's maternal grandfather, Emil, wants Adrien to come live with them in London and return the Graham de Vanily Twin rings. He also wants Adrien's other grandparents to sign a contract stating they will never again try to have contact with him.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Emil and Adrien's paternal grandfather, Johnny, get into a screaming match over who will have custody of their grandson.
This upsets Adrien's maternal grandmother, Milly, who gets akumatized into Ringmaster, traps Adrien in a giant golden trophy, and forces the two men to fight as the werewolf boxing duo Werepapas.
Ladybug, at great risk, is forced to break the rings to release the ultrakuma, using then the Miraculous Ladybug to fix them. Peculiarly, the apparent amok contained within the rings does not get released.
Ladybug creates a Magical Charm and gives it to Milly.
Both sets of grandparents consent to let Adrien remain in Paris with Nathalie, who has been like a mother to him since he lost his parents.
"The Dark Castle"
Alix's birthday is coming up, but she can't celebrate with her loved ones because she has to guard the Rabbit Miraculous and can't return to the present as long as the evil Butterfly Miraculous holder is still a threat.
Alix's friends and family decide to make a birthday video for her.
Marinette feels that the video isn't good enough and wishes for a better idea.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Marinette, as Bunnybug, emerges from the Burrow and gives herself the idea to take possession of the Rabbit Miraculous for the day so Alix can enjoy her birthday with everyone.
A few little things start to go wrong with the party, so Bunnybug tries to go back in time to fix them, but it sets off a chain of events that destroy the world. Bunnybug decides to set things back to the original timeline.
Armand D'Argencourt has been petitioning to remove the glass pyramid in front of the Louvre on the grounds that it defiles the buildings history.
As a result of his petition being ignored, he is akumatized by Chrysalis into The Dark Castle.
Bunnybug brings in her future self from later that same evening to watch over the Rabbit Miraculous while she takes care of the villain.
After defeating Dark Castle, Ladybug returns to the Burrow and sends her future self back to bed.
Alix returns to the Burrow, but Ladybug isn't sure she wants to burden Alix with the immense responsibility all over again.
Alix assures her that she's ready, willing and able and becomes Bunnyx once more.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Fed up with all the injustice being cause in Paris, Zoé accidentally transforms into Fury, a vigilante-themed superheroine with the power of super speed in addition with the power of paralysis.
Fury punishes those who do wrong things:
She punishes Bob Roth (who insulted his barber) by leaving him at the peak of the Eiffel Tower.
She punishes three thugs (who cornered a pizza delivery guy) by forcing them to watch a musical at the cinema.
She punishes Raymond, Loïc, and Nelson (who were illegally driving a boat) by taking them to a roller coaster.
She punishes a tram driver (who ignored Max’s plea to drop him off) by leaving him in an animal exhibit.
Maya's older brother, Sam, was publicly humiliated by Fury, which leads to his akumatization into Grendiaper, a diaper-themed supervillain.
"The Ruler"
Nathaniel and Marc start to develop a love story comic book called "Sun-Heart & Rain-Piercer" and show it to their respective parents.
However, despite Marc's parents' approval of the comics and his relationship with Nathaniel, the former's parents do not show interest, with his father partially approving, and his mother completely disapproving.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Marinette develops a cold and is ashamed of Adrien thinking she is disgusting.
She then tries to hide it at school, but her nose blow is so heavy that everyone surrounding her gets jumpscared.
Shirel suspects Nathaniel and Marc's story, but the former reassures her that it is only homework.
She eventually discovers the script, shreds it in front of her son, and forbids him from seeing Marc ever again.
Nathaniel cries and rushes off to school, where he transforms into Caprikid and uses Genesis to create a shredder, destroying the prints of the comic.
The next day, Marinette stands up to Shirel about Marc's story being a masterpiece, but she does not care and forces Nathaniel to leave school.
Enraged with her son's disobedience, she gets akumatized by Chrysalis into The Ruler, and hits Cat Noir with her brainwashing powers.
After Ladybug also gets hit, Caprikid manages to get hold of the akumatized object and hits the villain, commanding her to give up her ultrakuma.
Ladybug creates a Magical Charm and gives it to Shirel.
After her deakumatization, Shirel apologizes to Nathaniel and starts to support his drawings and his relationship with Marc.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Marinette realizes that Adrien will still love her, even if she has a runny nose, and they laugh together.
Chrysalis is aware that Nathaniel has a secret side.
After all the damage, Marc assures to Nathaniel that he must not put himself in danger to prove their love, as they don't have superpowers.
However, Nathaniel decides to take off the masks, and reveals himself as Caprikid to Marc.
Marc, in turn, reveals his identity as Rooster Bold to Nathaniel, making them both learn of each other's superhero alter-egos.
"Sleeping Syren"
The girls try to come up with a plan to help Ondine get her first kiss from Kim.
Mylène suggests she write him a poem, but he finds it more funny than romantic.
Kagami suggests uses a Japanese snack stick, where each person eats one end and they meet in the middle. Kim doesn't get it and eats the whole stick himself.
Ray, Loïc, and Nelson conspire to break up Kim and Ondine.
Ray offers Kim a new pair of swim flippers if Kim doesn’t talk to girls anymore, but Kim "fails the challenge" and returns the flippers.
Loïc tries to command Kim that he and Ondine are broken up, but Kim is too dumb to get it.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Nelson tricks Kim into thinking that there are horrible medical consequences for kissing a girl if they are a swimmer and also happen to be taller than you.
Ondine finally figures out a way to get Kim to kiss her: Arm wrestling, loser has to do a dare.
Ondine wins at arm wrestling, but Kim doesn't want to kiss her because of the lies he was told by Nelson.
Ondine, heartbroken and furious, is akumatized by Chrysalis into Sleeping Syren.
Kim goes after Ladybug to warn her about the dangers of kissing tall swimmer girls.
This causes Ladybug to realize exactly what happened.
Kim apologizes to Ondine the next day and they finally share their first kiss.
That night, Ray, Loïc and Nelson are discussing their next cruel prank, when they are suddenly jump by a mysterious dark hooded figure.
"El Toro De Piedra"
Raúl Bruel, formerly known as the villain "El Toro", becomes a part of Mayor Bustier's "New Chances" project and starts working as a security guard in Louvre.
Raúl plans a larceny of the Mona Lisa frame and commands Ivan to join in, but the latter refuses, becoming deeply sad and conflicted.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Marinette finds a letter from Gabriel Agreste addressed to Adrien when the former was already dying from the Cataclysm mark after the Alliance rings were developed.
She opens the letter before Adrien finds it, and is horrified of what Gabriel proposed to him.
She shows the letter to Nathalie, who wants to destroy it, but Marinette holds onto it.
Kitty Section prepares a performance in the Agreste Mansion yard at sunset, which is dedicated to Mayor Bustier and the other Françoise Dupont teachers.
Ivan has an anxiety crisis and heads off to the Louvre, but again refuses to aid his father.
Enraged with this, Raúl gets akumatized by Chrysalis into El Toro De Piedra.
Luka video calls the band all the way from Brazil to help them perform, but the call keeps disconnecting.
Ivan almost renounces his Miraculous after being pressured by his father, but gets encouraged by Ladybug and gives up the renouncement.
Juleka finally gets over her shyness and performs an emotional song at the concert.
After Raúl is deakumatized, Minotaurox, Ladybug and Cat Noir encourage him not to be a thief and instead be a good father, which he accepts.
"Mister Agreste"

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Marinette is having a hard time dealing with the guilt she feels due to the lie she told the world that Gabriel Agreste was a hero who sacrificed himself to help her stop Monarch. She is stressed out and having nightmares.
Adrien and Nathalie, with Marinette accompanying them, go to City Hall to meet with the Mayoress about erecting a new statue of Gabriel Agreste after the old one was damaged.
Marinette talks to Nathalie about telling Adrien the truth, but Nathalie insists that they have to stick to their story.
Adrien cannot reconcile the idea that his cold and distant father was the same man who sacrificed himself to defeat Monarch and ultimately rejected the proposal of constructing a new statue.
Marinette turns into Cosmobug and flies to Brazil to meet Luka. She borrows the Snake Miraculous from him and confesses everything about Gabriel.
Luka asks to borrow her Miraculous, insisting that he can help, but Marinette used the Snake's power to turn back time and take back everything she said.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
After hearing that the new statue was rejected, the statue builder, Théo Barbot, a Gabriel Agreste super fan, believes Adrien to be an unworthy son for not wanting to display his father's glory, and is in turn akumatized by Chrysalis into Mister Agreste.
Adrien uses Ladybug's Lucky Charm, a megaphone, to say all the things he's always wanted to say to his father, and the revelation that his idol wasn't as great as he believed caused the villain to fall apart.
"The Illustrhater"
Marinette and Alya stay up all night trying to compare notes regarding the new Butterfly Miraculous holder, but they know literally nothing about this unknown person, not even their gender.
Marinette and Alya go on a double date with Adrien and Nino.
Their tram gets caught on a crumbling bridge, so Alya and Nino transform into Rena Rouge and Carapace.
Alya and Nino decide to go their separate ways from Marinette and Adrien. This gives them a chance to interview the previously akumatized victims of the new Butterfly holder in hopes of gleaning some helpful information about their identity. It also gives Marinette and Adrien a chance to be alone together, which Alya believes Marinette is in desperate need of.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Marinette tries to be the perfect girlfriend by imitating various other random couples she sees on the streets.
Marinette transforms into Ladybug and joins the other heroes on minor errands to avoid potential awkwardness with Adrien.
Maya, the young daughter of the owner of the cafe where Marinette and Adrien stop to eat, wants to show people her drawings, but no one will give her the time of day. As a result, she is akumatized into Illustrhater.
During the fight, the heroes try to question Illustrhater about her new friend who gave her those superpowers, but the heroes were unable to gain any information about the new Butterfly Miraculous holder, except that they are doing everything they can to keep their identity a total secret.
Ladybug creates a Magical Charm and gives it to Maya.
Marinette officially makes Alya her deputy guardian and entrusts her to carry on the duties of the guardian if anything happens to her. She also has Tikki make a new Ladybug Kwagatama for Alya so she can access Marinette's memories.
"Wreckless Driver"
The Miraculers stop a runaway train, but Aglaé is scared of Ladybug.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
The next day at school, Aglaé confesses that she has a crippling fear of bugs since she was akumatized. At first, it was just butterflies, but it eventually spiraled into all bugs, and even things that are bug themed.
Her friends recommend she see Dr. Psiquat, a therapist who has helped many of them in the past.
Aglaé threw a fit when she found out how long it might take for her to be cured of her fear.
Dr. Psiquat is akumatized by Chrysalis into Wreckless Driver.
Ladybug creates a Magical Charm and gives it to Dr. Psiquat.
Aglaé takes a healthy first step to getting over her fear with her friends by her side.
Adrien goes to Dr. Psiquat to talk about his father.
"Yaksi Gozen"
Marinette has a special surprise for Adrien, who wants to return the favor, but it doesn't go great.
Kagami and her mother get into a heated argument.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Current History
Tomoe is visited by Cerise Bianca, who transformed into Chrysalis and offers Tomoe a solution to her problem with her daughter. Cerise's plan is to akumatize Tomoe into Yaksi Gozen, capture Félix so Chrysalis can ambush him and take his ring, then control him as a spy and give Tomoe control over Kagami's boyfriend. After replacing Félix's ring with a fake, Tomoe would pretend to reject the Ultrakuma transform back, and have a heart to heart with Kagami. The heroes would be none the wiser. Tomoe agrees to the plan.
Félix and Kagami go to Marinette; they want her to keep their rings inside her yo-yo, that way they will only exist in a state of pure quantum probability and be safe.
As Marinette is about to take the rings, Adrien comes over, the rings get lost, and Félix and Kagami end up with each other's rings.
With the plan ruined by the swap, Chrysalis cuts her losses and makes her escape.
A successor for Gabriel Agreste in the Kingdom is decided upon.

title: Timeline
text:
Timeline - Future
2025: Bunnyx returns to the future from the events of "Timetagger" to inform future Ladybug and Cat Noir that she failed to take down Timetagger, only to be told she did not fail and that it is all part of Ladybug's plan.
After Timetagger is defeated by the present Ladybug and Cat Noir, Bunnyx returns to retrieve him and take him back to their future time.
Alix, at an unknown point in the future, reads the note that Ladybug left for her in "Reunion".
Alix time travels to July 14, 2216: 200 years from when the events of "Reunion" took place to get the answer to the question posed by Pharaoh's all-knowing book.
2070: Alix will continue as Bunnyx watching over the timeline into her elderly years.
At some point in the future, there are at least seven Interstellar Wars.
During the events of "Timetagger", Bunnyx is sent to the Seventh Interstellar War in the year 24000, but returns to the present almost instantly.

title: Tikki (webisode)
categories: Episodes where Adrien is a minor character
text:
Tikki (webisode) - Trivia
The webisode contains clips from "Pixelator", "Timebreaker", "Volpina", "Copycat", "Ladybug & Cat Noir", "The Pharaoh", "Befana", "Princess Fragrance", "Mr. Pigeon", "The Mime", and "Gamer".
As with several other webisodes, the clips of Marinette writing in her diary are from "Gamer".
When Marinette mentioned that Tikki rubbed shoulders with the Kings of France she alluded to her time with Jeanne d'Arc as the kwami's former owner was friends with King Charles VII.
The webisode could take place after "Pixelator", as Tikki acts like a cat when discovered by someone in the episode, even though Marinette mentions Kwamis have weird habits as a clip of "Befana" is shown, she doesn't directly mentions the Kwagatama made in the episode.
When the webisode, and "Master Fu" were released, their title cards were different from the rest, being similar to the thumbnails of the videos released on the official Miraculous Ladybug YouTube Channel. They were later updated, when they were released by various Disney Channels and on Disney+.
An extract from this webisode was read by Shadybug from Marinette's diary in "Miraculous Paris".

title: Tikki (webisode)/Transcript
text:
Tikki (webisode)/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Do you realize? She was born at the same time as the universe. She's rubbed shoulders with dinosaurs, cave men, the kings of France, it's just amazing. Yes, meeting a kwami for the first time came off as a bit of a shock...
Tikki: Everything's okay, don't be scared.
Marinette: Ahh, bug-mouse talks!
...even when you know them well truth is...
Tikki: Miraculous birthday Marinette!
Marinette: ...the habits of a kwami can be pretty strange.
Anyway, Tikki quickly became my friend, she always looks on the bright side and restores my confidence when I feel like all is lost.
Tikki: Unpredictable and endearing and very talented you learn fast.
Marinette: She has an eye for detail that often inspires me...
Tikki: What a unique character he was like a human bird all he needed was a feather jacket to complete the look.
Marinette: A feather jacket hmmm, nice thinking Tikki.
...she even helps me when I'm designing something new.
I wish I could introduce her to my parents,...
...or to Alya.
I'm sure they'd love her, but I can't.
Being a superhero means having to keep secrets, even from your loved ones. Good thing I can tell you everything my dear diary. Goodbye for now.

title: Timetagger
text:
Timetagger - Intro
"" is a season 3 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 19th written and produced episode of season 3. It is also the 71st written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Timetagger
text:
Timetagger - Synopsis
Ladybug and Cat Noir are trapped between two time travelers from the future, one of whom has been sent by Hawk Moth to steal their Miraculous.
Disney Channel
Ladybug and Cat Noir face Timetagger, a supervillain who has come from the future to seize their miraculous; the future of Paris lies in their hands.
Disney+
Ladybug faces a supervillain from the future.

title: Timetagger
text:
Timetagger - Plot
At the park, Alya and Marinette are playing a mobile rap game where Alya succeeds and Marinette doesn't. Bored playing a "game for babies", Chris asks the two girls if he could play the rap game with them which they do not allow as it's a game for "big kids". Suddenly, Cat Noir is seen fighting Mr. Pigeon, much to Marinette's dismay. Marinette excuses herself from Alya's company saying that she has to help her father taste his new recipe. Alya offers to help, but Marinette declines, telling Alya that her father's a shy one when it comes to new recipes, and goes behind a pillar to transform. Tikki says her reason this time is not the best one that she has given to which Marinette replies saying that soon, she'll run out of excuses to use.
At the Louvre, Cat Noir is seen confronting Mr. Pigeon people nonchalantly witnessing the event. Ladybug and Cat Noir then half-heartedly call upon their powers and easily beat Mr. Pigeon, releasing the Akuma. Mr. Ramier apologizes for the trouble that he caused them yet again, offering them ice cream as a thank you for what they had done.

title: Timetagger
text:
Timetagger - Plot
Hawk Moth, frustrated, rambles about the many times he has failed to use Mr. Ramier to take Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses. Turning back, he suddenly feels a strong surge of power, one he has never felt before. Back at the superhero duo's location, a portal suddenly appears behind them with a seemingly akumatized man coming out of it. The man raps about how he's going to defeat the duo by shooting a beam at them which will send them back into the past, revealing himself to be a villain named Timetagger. He then shoots Mr. Ramier causing him to go back in time. Suddenly, a giant statue commemorating Mr. Ramier, who appears to have become a knight in the past, appears behind Ladybug and Cat Noir.

title: Timetagger
text:
Timetagger - Plot
The adversary then goes to other various spots shooting beams on the ground causing some graffiti to appear acting as a marker or site to which he can teleport whenever needed. The duo's Miraculouses then beep, leaving them with only one minute left to beat the villain. They frantically charge at him. He easily dodges them by teleporting to said sites that he made earlier. Hawk Moth is amazed by the villain's fighting style, to which the villain responds telling him about the future Butterfly Miraculous holder's plan to send him back in time to retrieve the Miraculouses and give them to him. Hawk Moth is astonished by this and praises his future self. The two heroes then go run to the Louvre to detransform. They go into the lavatories right before detransforming.

title: Timetagger
text:
Timetagger - Plot
In the female lavatory, Marinette feeds Tikki to restore her strength and gets worried about how they may not be able to beat the villain. As he is from the future, it means that even their stronger future selves couldn't beat him. Tikki reassures her, stating that there is always a solution to a problem. Marinette then transforms back into Ladybug. In the male lavatory, Plagg talks about how, despite them being in peril, on the bright side, Adrien still gets to be with Ladybug in the future. Adrien responds saying that to experience that future, they must win against Timetagger now. He then transforms back into his superhero self.

title: Timetagger
text:
Timetagger - Plot
Out in the hallway, the two superheroes run back to the villain's location when suddenly, Alix bumps into them. Alix marvels at them and at how the message she received was actually real. Confused, Ladybug questions her about said message. Alix takes out her watch which has been passed down in her family for generations, stating that it has never chimed until today, explaining that it contains a message for Ladybug. She opens the watch, and the hologram appears. An audio message is then played, congratulating the superhero duo for finding it and telling them to "dig deep into the past" to which Cat Noir jokingly asks Alix if her watch came with a shovel so they can do the "digging", much to her annoyance. Ladybug then comes up with what the message may mean, asking Alix about the oldest exhibit in the museum. Alix answers telling her about the Egyptian Collection where some items date back to thousands of years ago, as said by her father. They then rush towards the Ancient Egyptian section.

title: Timetagger
text:
Timetagger - Plot
At the Egyptian exhibit, Ladybug knocks on all of the items to test their hollowness. Stopping at one that sounds hollow, she orders Cat Noir to use his Cataclysm on it. The cataclysm reveals a sleeping person in a superhero costume inside. The sleeping person wakes up. She is revealed to be the person who sent the message through Alix's watch. Realizing that Ladybug and Cat Noir have solved her riddle, she congratulates them. She then says that she has something very important to do. They all go to the lavatory.

title: Timetagger
text:
Timetagger - Plot
The person introduces herself from inside the bathroom revealing herself to be a superhero from the future named Bunnyx, who is part of a team formed by the Ladybug and Cat Noir of the future. She then continues, stating that she is called upon only when every superhero, including the two famous heroes she is talking to, have failed. Cat Noir, baffled, asks her about how she must've failed too, since he and Ladybug were the ones who freed her from the ancient artifact, to which she responds stating that technically that's true but it will be his fault as sometime in the future, one of his Cataclysms damages her Miraculous. She says that this is how Timetagger will be able to send her back into the past to Ancient Egypt.

title: Timetagger
text:
Timetagger - Plot
Ladybug asks her about how they'll be able to defeat the villain without the Rabbit Miraculous. The superheroine then asks Alix if she has "the watch" which she explains is their watch. Alix hesitantly gives it to her. Suddenly, the watch changes form and is revealed to have been the Rabbit Miraculous all along revealing the heroine's identity as Alix but from the future. Bewildered by this, Ladybug asks her how is she in possession of a Miraculous when she has never given Alix a Miraculous before. Future Alix reassures her that she will give it to her once the time has come. This excites present Alix.

title: Timetagger
text:
Timetagger - Plot
Wondering why she doesn't use her powers that often as it's obviously very powerful, Cat Noir asks her what the rationale is behind her doing so. She responds, saying that messing with time can lead to serious consequences and may only be used when no other option is available. Suddenly, Cat Noir's Miraculous starts beeping prompting him to go back into the lavatory to detransform. Still confused, Ladybug talks about how she, Bunnyx, must know how to defeat Timetagger as she is from the future and that her younger self, as said earlier, saw all the events take place. Unfortunately, due to her long sleep in the ancient artifact, she barely remembers anything from the past that she had experienced. However, she states that the way she'll be able to logically defeat Timetagger is by sending him back to the future where he can be beaten by heroes his own size. Bunnyx recalls one memory of her younger self being there and figures that she must play an important role.

title: Timetagger
text:
Timetagger - Plot
Back in the main hall of the Louvre, the group realizes that many people from the present have been sent back in time as many ancient artifacts are changing due to the Timetagger's interference with time. This causes Ladybug to conclude that since her future self wasn't able to stop Timetagger, she must be a not as powerful a superheroine in the future. Bunnyx, stunned at what Ladybug said, reassures her telling her that in the future, she is a stunning leader and has defeated the likes of many villains, including one particular weirdly named villain, called Monsieur Rat. Interested in his future love life, Cat Noir asks Bunnyx about his relationship with Ladybug in the future, much to Ladybug's annoyance. Bunnyx explains their relationship in a way they don't understand.

title: Timetagger
text:
Timetagger - Plot
Outside the Louvre, Timetagger has already prepared for their upcoming fight making many marks for him to use against them. Bunnyx tells Ladybug and Cat Noir to stand back and let her handle the situation. She tells Alix to stay by an ice cream vendor which is all according to her plan. She then starts fighting Timetagger exchanging blows with him and also starts using her special ability: Burrow. Noticing how Bunnyx is able to stay transformed even after using her special ability, Cat Noir questions how she's able to do that. Ladybug says it's because she's a grown-up, making Cat Noir excited to become one himself.

title: Timetagger
text:
Timetagger - Plot
Not proud of himself just watching the fight take place, Cat Noir lunges in with his Cataclysm, almost hitting Bunnyx's Miraculous making her become mad at him. Timetagger then appears right beside her attempting to attack her. Bunnyx quickly forces him into a portal of hers using her umbrella. Thinking she has won, she exchanges goodbyes with the two heroes when suddenly she feels a sense of déjà vu. Timetagger appears again behind her and shoots a beam at her sending her back to the ice age. Having had enough with all that has happened, Timetagger demands Ladybug and Cat Noir hand over their Miraculouses. Bunnyx appears again through a portal, now freezing cold, and tries to attack Timetagger. He easily dodges and shoots her again. This process is repeated as Timetagger keeps shooting at her whenever she comes back.

title: Timetagger
text:
Timetagger - Plot
Seeing how Bunnyx is losing, Ladybug considers actually helping her rather than following her plan. Alix stops her from doing so as she believes her future self will be able to defeat Timetagger. Fatigued from fighting non-stop, Bunnyx admits defeat and apologizes to Ladybug for her inability to beat the adversary. Because of this, Ladybug thinks of a plan and summons her Lucky Charm only to receive a notebook. Timetagger laughs at this and jokes about it.

title: Timetagger
text:
Timetagger - Plot
Acting in defeat, Ladybug sketches a landscape of her surroundings on the notebook she received and marks a certain spot on it. Slowly, she walks towards Bunnyx and hands it over to her, telling her not to worry as she is the leader of their team in the future. Bunnyx reluctantly accepts the paper and heads back to the future where she meets Ladybug and Cat Noir and apologizes to them for not being able to defeat Timetagger. Just like her younger self, Ladybug reassures Bunnyx, telling her that every problem has a solution and takes the sheet of paper from her hand. Back in the present, Ladybug and Cat Noir walk to Timetagger holding hands preparing to give him their Miraculouses. Hawk Moth, thinking that he's won, is satisfied that the miraculouses are finally in his hands. Timetagger, however, corrects him stating that he never said the future Hawk Moth was him. Hawk Moth is horrified by this.

title: Timetagger
text:
Timetagger - Plot
Timetagger walks over to the two heroes. As he's preparing to take off Ladybug's earrings, a blue portal suddenly appears and future Ladybug's and Cat Noir's weapons come out, disabling Timetagger. This enables the duo in the present to take his akumatized weapon and de-evilise it. After de-evilising, Timetagger's identity is revealed to be Chris from the future, shocking Ladybug. Future Ladybug tells present Ladybug not to worry as they will always find a solution. Alix then asks the future Ladybug when will she get the Rabbit Miraculous, and her elder self answers, "As soon as you start acting as cool as me, Mini-me". Cat Noir asks why nobody tells him how great he is, to which Ladybug answers saying he already knows how great he is, referring to him as "Kitty Noir". This puts a smile on his face. They share a "pound it" with Alix who is excited to know that she'll be a superheroine in the future. At the Agreste mansion, Gabriel is upset and hurt at the thought of failing. Gabriel thinks that if he is not a future Hawk Moth, then it means it was his fall. Nathalie tries to comfort him saying the future is not set in stone.

title: Timetagger
text:
Timetagger - Plot
Ladybug and Cat Noir continue to fight, battling Mr. Pigeon again. Amidst the fight, Ladybug goes into an alleyway and calls Alya, apologizing yet again for not being able to come babysit her younger siblings. Alya says it's okay as she got someone else to take care of them. Relieved by this, Ladybug wishes her a good time with Nino at the movies. The babysitter is then revealed to be Lila who lies to Chris telling him that she's the creator of a game he plays. Chris is amazed by this.

title: Timetagger
text:
Timetagger - Plot
On the Pont des Arts, Mr. Ramier treats Ladybug and Cat Noir to some ice cream as an apology again for having them fight him. Cat Noir advises him to get closer with some other type of animal as pigeons have it hard in Paris, with which he agrees. As they are about to detransform soon, the two heroes say their goodbyes to Mr. Ramier and walk away. As they are walking away, Cat Noir talks about all the crazy things Bunnyx had told them about the future with one particularly weird villain name: Monsieur Rat. It may even be possible that Ladybug will agree to go to the movies with him, he says. As Cat Noir keeps rambling about the future, Mr. Ramier is seen playing with a rat before the end card appears.

title: Timetagger
text:
Timetagger - Plot Developments
It is revealed that the transformation phrase for the Rabbit Miraculous is "Fluff, Clockwise", the de-transformation phrase is "Fluff, Counterclockwise", and the special power is "Burrow".
The French Duo meet 25-year-old Alix, from ten years into the future after freeing her from stone.
That ever since "Timebreaker", Alix's watch is actually the future Rabbit Miraculous.
More is revealed about the Miraculouses and their superpowers:
As revealed by future Alix, Cat Noir will be responsible, 10 years later, for the present Rabbit Miraculous (the one in the Miracle Box) being damaged. However, compared to how he destroyed the Bee Miraculous in "Queen Wasp", how the Rabbit Miraculous ended up in its state is likely the result of two possible outcomes:
The jewel didn't receive a full Cataclysm resulting in an accident or his future self was able limit the damage of his powers hinting that when some holders get older they can have further control of them. Done by Claw Noir/Furry Paw in "Miraculous Paris", likely confirms that the second option happened to be true.

title: Timetagger
text:
Timetagger - Plot Developments
When Bunnyx is freed from stone, she didn't de-transform until after her miraculous is fully repaired, hinting that she and the future heroes are likely aware of the consequences using a damaged Miraculous likely learning about this from Émilie's condition, and which Marinette could possibly be aware about from the former as of "Re-creation".
Interestingly, since Bunnyx is seen exiting the bathroom in her suit and not de-transforming until after her jewel was repaired that implies that miraculous holders can remove their suits while transformed.
If a holder's Miraculous is broken, minorly damaged, or malfunctions after they transform (while the jewel is being worn), and they still can de-transform but it's advised that they shouldn't until their jewel is fixed. However, both Chloé's and Nathalie's cases were different:
For Chloé as Queen Bee, the Bee Miraculous was completely destroyed and fell off forcing her de-transform.
For Nathalie as Mayura, she was able to transform and de-transform despite the Peacock Miraculous being damaged which means it could have been broken to a different extent. This hints that the jewel was damaged after it had been used and removed.

title: Timetagger
text:
Timetagger - Plot Developments
Despite both jewels being broken, future Alix appeared healthy while Nathalie got sick. This could be a result of the Peacock Miraculous being constantly used while the Rabbit Miraculous was in stone slumber with the heroine thus making it inactive.
When working with adult holders since kwamis "feed" off their wielder's energy it likely hints with the Peacock Miraculous being constantly used in it's broken state Duusu took more energy than he needed to sustain himself leading to Nathalie's condition as well as Émilie's. But with Bunnyx who was transformed and yet was in stone slumber with her Miraculous thus making it inactive, Fluff had less energy to feed off of having her owner be more healthy.
From Tikki's warning about this in "Miraculous Paris", it isn't only the kwamis that "feed" off their wielder's energy but the Miraculous too especially when broken.
Bunnyx says that she is not in danger of de-transformation (even if the time limit has been reached), which makes it clear that adults Ladybug, Cat Noir and the other members of the Miraculers will get rid of this problem in the future. This happens in "Revolution" and "Revelator".

title: Timetagger
text:
Timetagger - Plot Developments
Upon seeing the mastery of Bunnyx's powers, Cat Noir said he couldn't wait to grow up. According to Thomas Astruc, the age when someone becomes an adult is different depending on the person. It's also implied that legal adulthood doesn't have anything to do with the powers. Instead, it's most likely related to the age the person physically and mentally becomes an adult.
Despite Bunnyx being an adult, just staying transformed takes a toll on kwamis if held for long periods of time.
And as of "Re-creation", it is confirmed that the current members of the Miraculers currently get to keep their Miraculouses on a permanent basis.
Mylene having a nightmare about Trees being uprooted by Extraterrestrials in "Conformation" is likely possible The Aklipt invaders are coming in later seasons.
It is revealed that Ladybug and Cat Noir had already fought against Mr. Pigeon 23 times. They defeat him twice in this episode.
It is hinted that in the future, he'll start going by the Akumatized name of Monsieur Rat.

title: Timetagger
text:
Timetagger - Plot Developments
By the episode's end, Cat Noir encourages Xavier Ramier to get a new pet in the future. After he and Ladybug leave, a rat comes up to him and they both mentioned of Monsieur Rat. This means Monsieur Rat is most likely Xavier Ramier in the future, but as a different akumatization than just Mr Pigeon over and over again.
This episode begins the prophecy of Gabriel's downfall as Hawk Moth, which wouldn't begin until "Destruction", where he gets Cataclysmed.
This episode gives a glimpse of what happens 10 years later:
That Ladybug and Cat Noir will continue to have their team of superheroes, with Alix continuing her role as Bunnyx but aside from her it's unknown who else will be apart of the Miraculers by then.
It is revealed that Marinette and Adrien are still Ladybug and Cat Noir in the future, but Gabriel Agreste has been succeeded by someone else as Hawk Moth, which is eventually confirmed by Lila Rossi/Cerise Bianca by the end of "Re-creation" after his death to bring Nathalie back and reunite with Émilie in the afterlife/other world.
However it's unknown if Lila/Cerise is still the Butterfly Miraculous holder in 25-year-old Bunnyx's time or if this future holder is someone else.

title: Timetagger
text:
Timetagger - Plot Developments
And yet, as of "El Toro De Piedra", it was revealed that both Gabriel and Nathalie were/are apart of a secret organization that like Gabriel, they too wanted the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses to create a "perfect world", but since the time difference is 9 years and Bunnyx's power allows her to see any point in time it's likely she and her team know about the organization too.
From "The Illustrhater", Marinette named Alya, her official successor not only inheriting the Miracle Box but the Ladybug mantle, meaning she and Trixx may have to separate one day but according to Bunnyx, Marinette is still Ladybug when they are adults there could be a few reasons for this:
It could be that Marinette didn't renounce the box yet.
Something must have happened to Alya and Marinette had to choose someone else.
Marinette did surrender the box erasing her memory and giving the mantle to Alya as so but similar to "Kwami's Choice", caused her to resume as Ladybug.
In the future Marinette and the Order found a way to alter transference spell of Miracle Box allowing Marinette to keep her memories as Ladybug thereby allowing her and Alya to keep their mantles as Ladybug and Rena Rouge.

title: Timetagger
text:
Timetagger - Plot Developments
When Сat Noir asks the future Alix about his future relationship with the adult Ladybug, Bunnyx awkwardly gestures with her hands in a semicircle hinting at a few possible outcomes of the future:
Adrien and Marinette will still be unaware of each other's secret identities and will continue to suffer from "unrequited" love for each other. But now as of Season 5 and 6 so far the pair aren't victims of "unrequited" love but are unaware of each other's secret identities.
They will be involved in a new love triangle (square).
It could be that Adrien found out about everything and is going to spend the next 10 years repairing his relationship with Ladybug.
Since Bunnyx mentions of the heroes defeating Majestia's sister Ignoblia, it likely hints that Ladybug and Cat Noir will meet up with the United Heroez again at some point in the future.

title: Timetagger
text:
Timetagger - Plot Developments
Since Bunnyx was sent 5000 years into the past she met Khepri, who was living in Ancient Egypt and possibly the guardian of that time foreshadowing that the team will know about the Order of the Guardians at some point. And one of the adventures current Alix is going on after the Rabbit Miraculous is retrieved in "Evolution" and so that means both Bunnyxs were at the same place at the same time.
When Ladybug said to Bunnyx, "You gotta know how all this ends", due to her being from the future Ladybug was probably hoping that she knew how to defeat not only Timetagger but Hawk Moth too however, when Bunnyx said, "I was stuck in stone for so long I barely remember". That means not even she completely remembered Hawk Moth was defeated until she looked into the Burrow again.
But interestingly, this does reveal what will happen to current Alix/Bunnyx time-wise, everything that she learned from "Timetagger" to now, she'll forget when the titular villain appears in her time as an adult a decade later.

title: Timetagger
text:
Timetagger - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in Switzerland on RTS Un.
In the credits of the Latin American dub, it is revealed that Bunnyx comes from 30 years into the future, seen as they credited Xøchitl Ugarte as "45 years old Alix".
However, this has been confirmed to be a mistake, as Bunnyx’s age is not known.
Furthermore, in "Miraculous London", 70-year-old Bunnyx calls her younger selves 15-year-old Alix and 25-year-old Alix, respectively.
This is the second time (as far as we know) that Chris Lahiffe is akumatized following "Christmaster".
However, unlike his previous akumatization, Chris doesn't get akumatized into Christmaster, but instead into a new villain: Timetagger. This makes sense because at the end of the episode, Lila tells Chris as a kid that she made the game. However, she didn't make it and Chris finds out that she was lying as an adult, so he gets akumatized and wants to go back in time.
Timetagger is also the first akumatized villain to appear that has not been akumatized by Gabriel Agreste but by a future Butterfly Miraculous holder.
This is the second time Hawk Moth feels a powerful negative emotion from the future, the first one being "Timebreaker".

title: Timetagger
text:
Timetagger - Trivia
When the episode originally aired on RTS, the background of the scene in the future was blue and yellow. However, every release following that one, including the ones on TFOU, Netflix, Disney Channel, and Disney+, have an orange background.
This marks the first time Nathalie calls Gabriel by name.
The dates that Timetagger sent Bunnyx to were -100,000 (the Ice Age), -66,000,000 (The Cretaceous period), 24,000 (7th Interstellar War), 79 (Pompei), and he was going to send her the Big Bang, but then Ladybug intervened.
References
This is the third episode which involves a time-related villain, the first two being "Timebreaker" and "Backwarder".
This is the tenth episode that involve the heroes fighting more than one akumatized villain.
Timetagger's akumatization are not shown, making this the eighth time this happens, after Magician of Misfortune in "Princess Fragrance", Vanisher in "Antibug", the Unnamed boy in "Sandboy", August akumatization in "Weredad", Alya and Nino's akumatization in "Oblivio", Vivica in "Desperada" and the current Chris in "Christmaster".
This is one of the many episodes where the heroes use their powers multiple times.

title: Timetagger
text:
Timetagger - Trivia
This is the third time Ladybug and Cat Noir land on top of each other following "Stormy Weather" and "Sandboy".
This is third time the akumatized object's regular form isn't seen, following "Sandboy" and "Desperada".
Cat Noir uses his power three times. The same later happens in "Dearest Family", and the record's broken in "Revolution", when he uses it six times.
Interestingly, when Hawk Moth said, "That he didn't want to wait until Ladybug and Cat Noir became adults to get their jewels", assuming he was going to fight the heroes for the next decade. In a sense it was true, time-wise for as long as the show has been around he has done so.
Allusions
It is possible that this episode hints at the famous tale, "Alice in Wonderland" by Lewis Carroll, where there is a white rabbit with a pocket watch that worries about being late. Also, there is no proper time in Wonderland.
What happened to Adult Bunnyx is a classic predestination time loop paradox.
Errors
Hawk Moth said the full de-transformation phrase ("Nooroo, dark wings fall!") after the battle with Mr. Pigeon and did not detransform.
In the French dub, however, he only says "Nooro, detrans-", before he stops.

title: Timetagger
text:
Timetagger - Trivia
While Bunnyx is using Burrow, she disappears for a few frames and then reappears afterwards.
When Marinette puts her hand on Chris's shoulder, her hand is hovering over his shoulder.
Even though it's briefly seen, the Lucky Charm Ladybug summoned against Mr. Pigeon wasn't red with black spots. However, it may have been like that on purpose, like the car keys in "Syren" and the movie ticket in "Ikari Gozen".
In one scene when Cat Noir starts running out of power, his Miraculous turns blue instead of the normal green.
When Bunnyx goes to say goodbye to the duo, the graffiti marks left by Timetagger are still present on the ground.
When Bunnyx thought her plan worked, the umbrella can be seen in her hand. When she remembered something from her memories being different, the umbrella was seen on her back. When Timetagger sent Bunnyx to the past, the umbrella was in her hand again.
Timetagger's hair is miscolored purple when Cat Noir is about to Cataclysm him.
The Rabbit Miraculous can briefly be seen in its charged mode despite Bunnyx being detransformed.
The white glow is not present in the inside of Ladybug's Yo-yo when releasing the purified butterfly.

Timetagger shouldn't have existed because by the time that they were considered adults, everything would’ve been destroyed.
