text:
Timetagger/Transcript - Intro
Alya: (rapping)Alya's on the line, I rise and shineWhen I pick up the mic like this game is mineFake MC's can't catch my flow'Cause I whip up the beat with each word I throw! (Alya hands Marinette her phone.)
Marinette: (rapping) Eh– The name's Marinette, I bake chouquettes, I love drawing and… sewing blankets? Uh… (giggles)
Alya: C'mon, c'mon!
Marinette: Uhhhh…
App: (Laughs) Fifty words?! You flow so low, you need a shovel to dig it!
(Both Alya and Marinette laugh, Chris walks up to them and sits down.)
Marinette: Shoot, I'm so bad at this game.
Chris: Hmph.
Alya: What's up? You don't want to play with my sisters anymore?
Chris: I'm not a baby anymore, can I play Freestyle Clash II with you?
Marinette: C'mon Chris, it's a game for big kids! You know that.
Chris: Ugh, that's what you always say!
(Marinette spots pigeons formed as a bomb in the sky)
Marinette: Uh, again?! Alya, can you handle these three on your own? I uh, I just remembered I promised my dad I would try out his new macaron recipe.
Alya: Mmm, sounds yummy! Maybe we could all come over and try it out with you if that's okay?

title: Timetagger/Transcript
text:
Timetagger/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Oh yeah, I mean no! (laughs) Dad's always super shy whenever he tried out a new recipe like, "Oh, what if it doesn't taste good?" (laughs) Okay, catch you later best BFF in the world!
(Marinette runs away and facepalms herself. She hides behind a pillar of a nearby building.)
Tikki: That macaron recipe excuse wasn't exactly your best one yet, Marinette.
Marinette: I know but I'm running out of excuses. I've needed so many this week. Tikki, spots on!
Mr. Pigeon: Ladybug, Cat Noir, if you don't give me your Miraculous, this pigeon-iron will crash down on the Louvre pyramid and give all the tourists inside it perfectly flat socks! Pigeons have a right to culture, too. (Pigeon noises)
(Ladybug arrives on the scene.)
Cat Noir: Hey there, m'lady. No need to brief you on this one, right?
Ladybug: (sighs) Nope. Let's just end this fast like the last 23 other times. (bored) Lucky Charm.
(The Lucky Charm animation isn't shown, but Ladybug receives a palm-sized object. It's uncertain what it is or what she uses it for)
Cat Noir: (bored) Cataclysm.

title: Timetagger/Transcript
text:
Timetagger/Transcript - Intro
(The camera turns to a group of bystanders. They have their phones out, recording the fight. The audience can be heard gasping and seen cringing several times. Feathers fly in front of the camera.)
Mr. Pigeon: (off screen) Nooooo!
(A few grunts of victory can be heard from Ladybug and Cat Noir and the bystanders turn to rapidly typing on their phones.)
Ladybug: Bye bye, little butterfly. (Ladybug releases a white butterfly from her yo-yo; Mr. Pigeon is engulfed in purple magic and turns back into Mr. Ramier.)
Mr. Ramier: Huh? Huh? Please don't tell me it happened again.
Ladybug: It's okay, Mr. Ramier, we'll always be here to bring you back to the good side.
Mr. Ramier: Hmm. Can I buy you both ice cream to make up for it?
Cat Noir: (his ring flashes its first warning) Well, since we keep getting better at this, we have a few minutes before we transform.
Ladybug: Hmm, why not?
Mr. Ramier: I'm really sorry, I just can't help it. Whenever something happens to my beloved pigeons it breaks my heart and—
Cat Noir: And Hawk Moth akumatises you again?
Ladybug: There must be some way to make sure this doesn't keep happening.
(Ladybug's earrings and Cat Noir's ring begin to beep rapidly.)

title: Timetagger/Transcript
text:
Timetagger/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: We gotta get going.
Ladybug: Thanks for the ice cream.
Hawk Moth: This man is hopeless. I've akumatised him 24 times and not once has he come close to succeeding. Nooroo, dark wings fall-! Huh–?! What is this? A powerful negative emotion. I've never felt this before. Where could such energy be coming from?
Ladybug and Cat Noir: Pound it. (they're about to leave when a portal opens up behind them)
Timetagger: (rapping)Yo-yo! I'm Timetagger from the future, manI criss-cross time with a spraypaint canLooks like your time's up at last'Cause I'm gonna send you way back to the past (He spraypaints the floor, graffiti appears; he also spraypaints Mr. Ramier, he gets sucked into a green portal. The year '1630' appears. A huge statue appears.)
Cat Noir: (reading the inscription) Lord Ramier Featherbottom, knight of the king? Founder of the order of The Great Pigeon?
(Timetagger proceeds to spraypaint the floor and random inanimate objects as bystanders and tourists run in fear. Among them, is André. Both Ladybug's and Cat Noir's Miraculous beep violently.)
Ladybug: Only one minute left!
Cat Noir: No time to lose. (they run after Timetagger)

title: Timetagger/Transcript
text:
Timetagger/Transcript - Intro
(They jump up, but right as both Cat Noir's staff and Ladybug's yo-yo were about to hit Timetagger, he disappears.)
Timetagger: (rapping)Ladybug and Cat Noir, now you're stuckIf you wanna catch me, then, ha, good luck (Both heroes try again, but right as they're about to hit Timetagger, he disappears again and they both faceplant.)
Timetagger: (rapping)All I have to do is go back in timeTo escape with a laugh and a rap and rhyme Ladybug: He's traveling through time!
Cat Noir: Therefore in space.
(Scene transition: Hawk Moth's lair.)
Hawk Moth: I just love his style.
Timetagger: (through the butterfly mask) I'm not surprised you like it, Hawk Moth.
(Scene transition: Louvre.)
Timetagger: (through the butterfly mask) I come from the future. A future where Ladybug and Cat Noir are adults.
(Ladybug and Cat Noir retry twice more, missing both times.)
Timetagger: (through the butterfly mask) It was future Hawk Moth's slick idea to send me into the past. To seize their Miraculous before they've obtained their adult powers.
(Scene transition: Hawk Moth's lair.)

title: Timetagger/Transcript
text:
Timetagger/Transcript - Intro
Hawk Moth: I can only approve of my future decision. And I won't wait for Ladybug and Cat Noir to become adults! I'm counting on you to change the future, Timetagger!
(Scene transition: Louvre. Ladybug and Cat Noir fail again. Timetagger shoots a random civilian into the year 1900.)
Timetagger: If you don't give me your Miraculous, I'll send everyone into the past. (both Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous beep their last warnings)
Cat Noir: Unlike him, I'm afraid we're running out of time.
Ladybug: Then we better try to gain some back.
(They run at Timetagger again, who looks disappointed in them. Instead of falling however, they run into the Louvre.)
Timetagger: Hahaha! Superhero babies need a little rest? Well, take your time. I have eternity ahead of me.
Marinette: (in the women's lavatory; feeding Tikki a macaron) If we can't defeat Timetagger in the future when we're adults, how are we supposed to defeat him now when we're younger and less experienced?
Tikki: There's a time for everything, Marinette. Every problem has a solution.
[Transformation Sequence]Marinette: Tikki, spots on! Yeah! (Marinette transforms into Ladybug)
(In the men's lavatory.)

title: Timetagger/Transcript
text:
Timetagger/Transcript - Intro
Plagg: Look on the bright side, Adrien. In the future, you and Ladybug still know each other.
Adrien: Yeah, but if I want a chance to see that future, we're gonna have to defeat Timetagger today.
[Transformation Sequence]Adrien: Plagg, claws out! (Adrien transforms into Cat Noir)
(Alix falls over and Ladybug and Cat Noir land atop each other again )
Alix: Crazy! So the message was for real.
Ladybug: What message?
Alix: (takes out her watch) This watch has been in my family since forever. It's never chimed, until today! And there was a message for you, Ladybug. (Alix hands Ladybug the watch, Ladybug takes it and opens it; blue mist arises from the watch face, a blue hologram of a woman holding a clock appears)
Watch: (in the robotic voice of a woman) Nice work, Minibug, you're right on time. Now, dig as deep as you can into the past and you will find the rabbit's burrow. (the hologram disappears; Ladybug closes the watch and gives it back)
Ladybug: Dig deep into the past?
Cat Noir: Did you also inherit a shovel to go with your watch, by any chance? (Alix grunts) Uh, shovel, you know? For all this deep digging. (makes air-quotes)

title: Timetagger/Transcript
text:
Timetagger/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: (facepalming; then she suddenly jumps up) Of course! What's the oldest exhibit in the museum?
Alix: The Egyptian collection! My old man says some of it dates back more than five thousand years!
Ladybug: There, it sounds hollow! Do your thing, Kitty.
Cat Noir: Cataclysm! (he cataclysms the statue, which turns black and then to dust; when the dust clears, Bunnyx is standing still)
Bunnyx: (yawns) Minibug, Kitty, I knew you'd solve my riddle. A basic security measure in case the watch is stolen. But now, I need to do something very important.
Bunnyx: My name's Bunnyx. And in the future, I'm a member of Ladybug and Cat Noir's team of superheroes. Well, the Ladybug and Cat Noir you're going to become, because right now, you two are more like Minibug and Kitty Noir. Within the team, I am the hero of the last chance. I'm called upon when everyone else has failed, that includes you two.
Cat Noir: Hey! We just got you out of the stone, didn't we? Which means you must have failed somewhere, too.

title: Timetagger/Transcript
text:
Timetagger/Transcript - Intro
Bunnyx: Yes, well, no. It was actually your fault. Or more precisely, it will be. In the future, one of your cataclysms will accidently damage my Miraculous. (she emerges from the lavatory) That's how Timetagger will be able to send me into ancient Egypt and get me stuck in stone.
Ladybug: Wait, then how are we going to do that without the Rabbit Miraculous?
Bunnyx: (to Alix) Do you have the watch?
Alix: My watch?!
Bunnyx: Yes, my watch. Our watch.
(Alix grunts and reluctantly grabs her watch. Before giving it to Bunnyx, she squints her eyes, but gives her the watch anyway. The second it's in Bunnyx' hand, it drops its disguise.)
Alix: So this was a Miraculous?!
Ladybug: In camouflage mode.
Bunnyx: (to the watch) Fluff, counter-clockwise! (Fluff emerges)
Alix: But you are—
Future Alix: So, mini-me, you get it now? You're me and I'm you. Well, more precisely, I'm you when you grow up.
Alix: Wow! I can't believe how cool I'm gonna be when I'm older!
Ladybug: But wait, it doesn't make sense. I never gave you, I mean her (points to Alix), I mean… I never gave either of you the Miraculous.

title: Timetagger/Transcript
text:
Timetagger/Transcript - Intro
Future Alix: You haven't given it to us, yet, Minibug, because you haven't realised just how awesome I really am. But don't worry, you will, one day.
Alix: I'm gonna get a Miraculous! So cool!
Future Alix: Fluff, snack time! You have to recharge your batteries. (she gets out a carrot; Fluff inhales the carrot)
Fluff: Hmm, was that breakfast, or dinner? What time will it be yesterday? Is it tomorrow already? When it'll be the day after tomorrow, it will have been yesterday again!
Cat Noir: That Miraculous seems so powerful, how come we don't use it more often?
Future Alix: Because traveling through time is very dangerous. Interfering with events can have serious consequences.
Cat Noir: (his ring beeps) Oops, time to feed my Kwami, too! (runs off)
Ladybug: I don't understand. If you're from the future, then you gotta know how this all ends. Your younger self has seen it with her own eyes. Which means you obviously know how to defeat Timetagger.

title: Timetagger/Transcript
text:
Timetagger/Transcript - Intro
Future Alix: Actually, uh… I've spent so much time in stone, I can barely remember. But I think, the logical thing to do, would be to take Timetagger back to the future, so he can be defeated by heroes his own size. (the background shows a simple animation of how this would go down) I'll take care of this.
Alix: Awesome!
Future Alix: One thing I remember for sure is: (shows flashback, where young Alix is waving with a pen in her hand) mini-me has to be there when I defeat Timetagger. If she's still in my memory, she must play a vital role.
Alix: Good! I wasn't planning on sitting on the bench this time!
[Transformation Sequence]Future Alix: Fluff, clockwise! (Future Alix transforms into Bunnyx)
(The foursome is running through the Louvre)
Cat Noir: Uh, guys, you should take a look at this, now.
Ladybug: (a portrait of Jagged Stone with the text 'Musique' can be seen) Timetagger sent Jagged Stone into the past!
Bunnyx: That's Nadja Chamack!
Ladybug: (gasps) André Glacier.
Alix: (le gasp) Mayor Bourgeois?!
Ladybug: He's destroying our present by rewriting the past! Bunnyx, since the future me hasn't been able to stop Timetagger from coming here, they must not be that powerful.

title: Timetagger/Transcript
text:
Timetagger/Transcript - Intro
Bunnyx: Are you kidding?! You're – I mean, you will be an awesome team leader. The greatest superhero ever.
Ladybug: How do you explain Timetagger then?
Bunnyx: I told you earlier. If Cat Noir hadn't cataclysmed my Miraculous, Timetagger wouldn't be here. In the future you've defeated: (the background shows images of all named supervillains) Doctor Sadness; The Eclyptinvaders; Pain and Tears, the twin queens of the Interdimension; and Ignoblia, the evil sister of Majestia, so believe me, you're not going to be intimidated by Timetagger. Oh, and I even forgot Monsieur Rat.
Ladybug: Monsieur Rat?
Bunnyx: You can always count on Ladybug. With her around, every problem has a solution.
Ladybug: How will I ever get to be like that?
Bunnyx: By growing up, Minibug.
Cat Noir: Tell me, Bunnyx, in the future, are Ladybug and I like… (makes a heart with his hands)
Ladybug: Cat!
Bunnyx: Oh, you and her it's always more like… (violently throws her arms around)
(Ladybug giggles.)
Cat Noir: Hey, the future isn't set in stone. (crosses his arms)
Bunnyx: Okay, let's go!
Bunnyx: We've taken too long, he's had enough time to weave a giant time-web around us.

title: Timetagger/Transcript
text:
Timetagger/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: Surrounded by just one guy? Does that mean he can attack from anywhere?
Bunnyx: More like from any time.
(Timetagger appears.)
Timetagger: (rapping)Gimme your MiraculousDon't make me askIt's pretty clear you're not up to the taskWhen I bring them to Hawk Moth's doorLadybug and Cat Noir will be no more (Cat Noir advances and prepares for battle, but Bunnyx holds him back)
Bunnyx: Stay where you are. I'll deal with him and take him back to the future you. It means nothing must happen to you in the meantime. But first... (she picks up Alix and places her next to André's ice cream cart) Stay right there, okay? Then it'll be exactly like it was in my memory. And now... Burrow!
(Bunnyx goes through the portal she created and transports herself next to Timetagger. He teleports out of the way in time.)
Timetagger: Missed me!
(Bunnyx tries again, and Timetagger successfully dodges again. At Bunnyx' next attempt, she gets hit. While flying through the air, she creates a portal and uses her momentum from being hit to hit Timetagger. Timetagger is hit and is flying through the air, he pulls off the same trick. This continues for some time.)

title: Timetagger/Transcript
text:
Timetagger/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: She doesn't need to transform back before she uses her power again?
Ladybug: No, because she's an adult!
Cat Noir: Awesome! I can't wait to grow up.
(In the background, the fight between Bunnyx and Timetagger is still commencing. Cat Noir is getting antsy, he is ready to run towards the fighting duo before Ladybug stops him with her words.)
Ladybug: I don't think we're quite up to the job yet, Cat Noir.
(The fight goes on. Bunnyx throws her umbrella into the air and goes through a portal. When she comes out, sliding, she catches her umbrella and hooks it around Timetagger's ankle, throwing inside another portal. Before he reaches it, however, he teleports)
Timetagger: (rapping)Bunnyx, you're lame, you don't get the gameAnd now you have to start all over again (He hits Bunnyx straight in the face, she flies backwards but gets up quickly and resumes the fighting.)
(Scene transition: Hawk Moth's lair)
Hawk Moth: My victory is close at hand. How brilliant from me to send myself such a powerful ally from the future.
(Scene transition: Louvre, outside.)
Timetagger: Where's your sad gun now, fluffytail?

title: Timetagger/Transcript
text:
Timetagger/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: I can't stand watching them playing cat and mouse like this. Cataclysm!
Ladybug: Cat Noir, no!
(Cat Noir runs at the fighting duo, but Timetagger notices him and teleports out of the way just in time. Instead, Cat Noir stumbles and almost hits Bunnyx' umbrella. She pulls it out of the way and Cat Noir lands on the ground.)
Bunnyx: See?! In the future that's exactly how you damaged my Miraculous! (Timetagger teleports next to Bunnyx, where she just then opened a portal, she opens her umbrella and pushes Timetagger into the portal.) I knew it! I knew you'd do that. Who's the best now, huh?
Hawk Moth: (from his lair) That– That's impossible!
Bunnyx: (bows head)Thanks for you involuntary help, my young friends. Now Bunnyx is going home! (makes rock n' roll symbol with hand)
Ladybug, Cat Noir and Alix: Bye, Bunnyx!
(Bunnyx is walking to the portal, before entering, she halts; the flashback is shown. She then looks back at her younger self, who is show waving without a pen in her hand.)
Bunnyx: Wait a second. This is not the exact right moment.
(Timetagger appears behind Bunnyx and shoots her with his gun. She gets sucked into a green portal and the number -100.000 appears.)

title: Timetagger/Transcript
text:
Timetagger/Transcript - Intro
Timetagger: Enjoy your trip to the ice age, fluffytail! (to Ladybug and Cat Noir, who are preparing themselves for battle) We've wasted enough time! Gimme your Miraculous now!
(Bunnyx emerges from a portal in front of him, shivering; she punches but he dodges.)
Timetagger: So, the ice age wasn't good enough for ya? Back to the cretaceous then!
(She gets hit with his gun again. She gets sucked into the portal with the number -66.000.000; not even 2 seconds later she emerges from a portal, a t-rex sticks its head out of the portal, Bunnyx holds it back.)
Bunnyx: Down, Denver, down!
Timetagger: You wanna keep playing, fluffytail?
Bunnyx: Don't call me fluffytail!
Timetagger: (hits her with his gun again; she gets sucked into a portal with the number 24.000) To the future, Seventh Interstellar War!
Unknown: Disintegrate! Disintegrate!
Ladybug: Maybe we should give her a hand after all.
Alix: You heard her, she's the only one who can solve this time problem. She can do it. Go Bunnyx!
Timetagger: (hits Bunnyx again, the portal has the number 79, which is the year Mount Vesuvius erupted and destroyed Pompeii) The heat is on!

title: Timetagger/Transcript
text:
Timetagger/Transcript - Intro
(Bunnyx emerges from the portal, she's smoking and panting, she tries one more attack, but collapses)
Bunnyx: Sorry, Minibug, I just can't. Looks like this time I don't have a solution after all.
Ladybug: What if today's the day we grow up? Lucky Charm! (receives a notepad) A block of paper?
Timetagger: Hahahaha! What are you gonna do with that? Send a defeat treaty? Now gimme your Miraculous or I get rid of your friend by sending her back to the big bang.
Ladybug: Alright, you win. We'll give you our Miraculous. All I ask is that you give me a little bit of time, to write a letter, to apologize, to my future self.
Cat Noir and Alix: What?!
Cat Noir: No, think of something! You always think of something.
Timetagger: Fair enough, Ladybug, wish granted.
Hawk Moth: (voice) Be careful, it could be a trap.
Timetagger: If she thinks she can trick me, she's wasting her time. Pun intended. Hahaha!
Ladybug: I don't have a pen. Could anyone lend me one, please?
(Alix hands her a pencil and Bunnyx gasps. Ladybug is about to start writing, but her Lucky Vision highlights, in order: the notepad, the pencil, Bunnyx, Timetagger and the graffiti closest to Timetagger. Ladybug starts drawing.)

title: Timetagger/Transcript
text:
Timetagger/Transcript - Intro
Timetagger: Time's up, my moment of victory has arrived.
Ladybug: (sighs) Ugh, I can't find the words. It's pointless anyway. I won't even be Ladybug in the future after we give up our Miraculous. (crumples up a sheet of paper from the notepad)
Bunnyx: Please don't do this, Minibug!
Ladybug: Some problems simply don't have a solution. (she walks up to Bunnyx) Go back to your timestream, Bunnyx, make the most of your remaining time.
Bunnyx: No, I refuse! I—
Ladybug: (whispering) Who's the team leader in the future? (hands her the crumpled paper) Trust me.
Bunnyx: (whispering) Okay, Ladybug. Burrow. (a portal opens, she goes through it)
Ladybug: Come on, Cat Noir. We better give him our Miraculous.
(Cat Noir walks up to Ladybug. Ladybug has her arm extended, and with his right hand still bubbling from his unused cataclysm, he takes hold of her hand with his left. Ladybug winks at Cat Noir, he gasps)
Bunnyx: I'm sorry, Ladybug, I didn't deliver.
Future Ladybug: Not true, Bunnyx. You didn't fail. Every problem has a solution.

title: Timetagger/Transcript
text:
Timetagger/Transcript - Intro
(Future Ladybug takes the crumpled paper present Ladybug wrote from Bunnyx' hand and unfolds it. A drawing of the topdown view of the Louvre can be seen, with a dot-grid array under it. One dot is circled and an arrow is point to it.)
(From Ladybug's perspective, we see the floor full of graffiti. Ladybug stops precisely atop one drawing. Both look at each other disheartened and then look dejectedly at the ground.)
Hawk Moth: (from his lair) The future bird catches the worm. This time, the Miraculous are mine!
Timetagger: You're right on the first count, but not on the second. The Miraculous are not for you.
Hawk Moth: (from his lair) What?!
Timetagger: Hahaha! I said I was sent by the Hawk Moth of the future, but I never said that the Hawk Moth of the future was you!
(Hawk Moth grunts.)
Timetagger: Your earrings are mine, Babybug. (holding out Alix' pencil) And you, Kitty Noir, cataclysm this so I can take your ring safely after I'm finished with her. (Cat Noir takes the pencil with his left hand) Good boy.

title: Timetagger/Transcript
text:
Timetagger/Transcript - Intro
(Ladybug looks supremely smug as Timetagger reaches for her earrings. Then, a burrow-portal opens and out comes a yo-yo. Timetagger is pulled towards it and Future Cat Noir's staff pushes Timetagger's gun off his belt, where it was fastened. Ladybug jumps up to catch the gun.)
Timetagger: No!
Ladybug: Cat Noir!
(She throws the gun at Cat Noir, who catches it in his cataclysm-activated hand; the gun crumbles to ashes and from its remains arises an akuma; she opens her yo-yo)
Ladybug: No more evil-doing for you, little Akuma. Time to de-evilise! (swings it around and catches the Akuma) Gotcha! (releases the now purified Akuma as a white butterfly) Bye bye, little butterfly.
(Timetagger is engulfed in purple magic and turns back into Future Chris)
Chris: Ladybug? And Cat Noir? You're so young! Where am I?
Cat Noir: The question should be more like: when are you?
Bunnyx: (emerges from a portal) C'mon, Chris, let's go home.
Ladybug: (gasps) Chris? (Future Chris goes through the portal)
Future Ladybug: (throws back the note present Ladybug wrote) See girl? We did it. We always will.
Alix: Hey, future Ladybug, when am I gonna get my Miraculous?

title: Timetagger/Transcript
text:
Timetagger/Transcript - Intro
Bunnyx: As soon as you're as cool as I am, mini-me.
(They all wave, with Alix waving with a pen in her hand, as Bunnyx goes through the portal and the portal closes.)
Ladybug: Miraculous Ladybug! (The Miraculous Cure spreads throughout Paris, restoring the statue of Mr. Ramier back to himself, cleaning the square of its graffiti and reverting the posters in the Louvre museum back to how they were.)
Cat Noir: Why doesn't anyone tell me how awesome I am?
Ladybug: Because you already know you're the best, Kitty Noir.
Cat Noir: (laughs; his ring beeps) I think we're gonna have to hurry, Bugaboo.
Alix: Are we gonna see each other again soon?
Ladybug: No doubt about that.
All Three: (they fistbump) Pound it!
Hawk Moth: Nooroo, dark wings fall. (Hawk Moth turns back into Gabriel Agreste)
Nooroo: Master, I—
Gabriel: Quiet, Nooroo.
(Gabriel leaves his lair with the elevator. He goes to sit on a chair in the dining room. Nathalie walks up to him.)
Gabriel: If I'm not Hawk Moth in the future, then that means I failed.
Nathalie: Or that you've succeeded. The future is not set in stone, Gabriel. (she puts an arm around Gabriel; he grunts)
Alya: (begin phonecall) Hey there!

title: Timetagger/Transcript
text:
Timetagger/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: Alya, it's Marinette! I'm sorry I won't be able to look after Chris and your sisters this afternoon. I— I hadn't finished my presentation for Monday, I hope you're not mad at me.
Alya: No, of course not, no biggy. A friend of mine said she'd take care of them, so Nino and I are going to see a movie.
Ladybug: A friend?
Alya: Yeah, don't worry, she'll take care of everything.
Ladybug: Perfect, enjoy your movie then. See you later! (end phonecall)
(Scene transition: Césaire apartment.)
Alya: Okay, we're going.
Nino: Thanks again, Lila. (they leave)
Lila: (to Chris) Do I know how to play Freestyle Clash? Please, I invented Freestyle Clash.
Chris: Wow, for real?
Lila: Of course for real, I never lie.
Chris: You're so cool.
Mr. Ramier: I'm so sorry.
Ladybug: Don't worry. Every problem has a solution. We didn't discover it today, but we will next time.
Cat Noir: The problem with Pigeons in Paris is that they have it too hard here. Maybe you should move to the suburbs, or try to make friends with some other type of animal. A goldfish for example. (Ladybug groans and facepalms)
Mr. Ramier: Another type of animal? That might be a good idea, Cat Noir. I'll think about it.

title: Timetagger/Transcript
text:
Timetagger/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: Okay, we have to get going. Thanks for the ice cream, Mr. Ramier. (they walk off)
Cat Noir: Everything Bunnyx told us seems crazy. All those supervillains with weird names. Like doctor what's-his-name and Monsieur Rat? Monsieur Rat?! (Ladybug giggles) What kind of a codename is that?! Maybe in the future, you might even agree to go see a movie with me. Hey, what if it was in the very near future, say, the next show? I can get a ticket… (their voices fade out)
Mr. Ramier: (feeds pigeons until he sees a rat) Oh, hello! What are you? Hello, cutie. (picks up the rat) You're even cuter than a pigeon.
(The endcard shows Timetagger, Ladybug, Cat Noir, Alix Bunnyx and in the background, Hawk Moth's face)
es:Timetagger/Transcripción

title: Times Square
text:
Times Square - Intro
(formerly known as Longacre Square) is a major commercial intersection, tourist destination, entertainment center, and neighborhood located in the Midtown Manhattan section of New York City, at the junction of Broadway and Seventh Avenue.

title: Times Square
text:
Times Square - Trivia

title: Tikki/Movie
text:
Tikki/Movie - Intro
Tikki is one of the two deuteragonists (alongside Plagg) of "Ladybug & Cat Noir: The Movie". She is the kwami of Creation who is connected to the Ladybug Miraculous. With her power, Tikki's wearer can use the earrings to transform into a ladybug-themed superhero.
Tikki and her Miraculous are currently active and owned by Marinette Dupain-Cheng, who uses it to transform into the superheroine Ladybug.

title: Tikki/Movie
text:
Tikki/Movie - Appearance
Tikki's movie version appearance is nearly identical to her TV version except she has another form allowing her to transform into an actual ladybug. Also, unlike her canon counterpart, she has fingers and toes.

title: Tikki/Movie
text:
Tikki/Movie - Personality
Compared to her counterpart in the original series, Tikki's personality differs in the way that she isn't completely obedient with her guardian's orders, as she flew away from him the second Master Fu opened the box in order to find an holder of her own choosing. She is also very excitable and curious, as she was seen excited about humankind having discovered electricity and how women were now allowed to wear pants. Her attitude also borders a little pushy as she injected herself into Marinette without her owner's permission to transform her.
When she calms down from her hype and curiosity, Tikki can be patient and compelling as she gave Marinette the space to sort out her issues and didn't come to her owner until she was ready.

title: Tikki/Movie
text:
Tikki/Movie - Abilities
Tikki can fly and levitate. She also possesses superhuman strength despite being smaller than Marinette she was able to pull Marinette just by her finger to a mirror effortlessly.
Tikki is connected to the Ladybug Miraculous, and can transform her Miraculous's wielder into a ladybug-themed superhero or supervillain and grant them the power of creation, which requires the wielder to say the following transformation phrase: "Tikki, spots on!". However, Tikki can either force a transformation or de-transformation her holder at will (possibly if her holder doesn't give any orders against it). Tikki is also able to control her jewel, being able to levitate it while being inside it, as seen when she and Plagg set out to seek their holders once Master Fu opened the Miracle Box. But she can also transform into her connected Miraculous and visa versa.
She is also a shapeshifter, being capable of taking the form of a ladybug.
Despite not having been showed just yet, it's possible that, just like her counterpart from the original series, she is capable of using her own powers of creation, but doing it in a scale that she can't control.

title: Tikki/Movie
text:
Tikki/Movie - Relationships
Plagg
Similar to the original series, Tikki and Plagg, according to the comments done by Master Fu when he decides to put their jewels in circulation because of the rise of Hawk Moth, seem to possess a rather complicated relationship. The two of them seem to be always arguing with one another, as Master Fu had warned them he would only open the Miracle Box for them to get out if they behaved and didn't fight. However, because the two kwamis are not seen interacting with one another, it's unknown if their complicated relationship is similar to the one in the original series.
Marinette Dupain-Cheng
Before they met physically upon hearing Master Fu's orders to choose an owner Tikki flew off into the paris streets to do so with her master following behind. After leading Master Fu into traffic but "seeing" Marinette save her master from danger, she landed inside her backpack choosing the girl as her owner, then once Marinette found her way to Master Fu's shop she let her inside first playfully landing on the girl's nose, then leading her to the Ladybug Miraculous obtaining her physical form.

title: Tikki/Movie
text:
Tikki/Movie - Relationships
When the two first met, Tikki got very excited for finally having a new holder to the point of being intrusive with Marinette's personal space and pushy with her when the latter was still very uncertain about wanting to become a superhero to the point Tikki forced a transformation and guided her into a fight with an akumatized villain. However, Tikki, after sometime, was able to empathize with Marinette's uncertainty about becoming a hero, giving her the space she needed to sort out her thoughts and fears. This proved to be the right call, as eventually Marinette was able to overcome her fears in order to protect the ones she loved and decided to embrace her superhero persona.

title: Tikki/Movie
text:
Tikki/Movie - Relationships
After Marinette was able to get the confidence she needed to become Ladybug, she and Tikki soon were able to develop the same type of friendship the two have in the original series, with the kwami being very supportive of her holder's dreams and even helping her to get closer to Adrien. Not just that, as they were separated when Hawk Moth was able to get her Miraculous they reached for each other and even after the earrings were taken, Tikki was the one to inspire Marinette to be a hero, even without her superhero mask. After Gabriel's evil has been quelled Tikki happily returned to Marinette.

title: Tikki/Movie

When Tikki appeared in front of Marinette, she was excited about humankind having discovered electricity and how women were now allowed to wear pants. This could suggest that she had owners prior to those times.
Taking into consideration of what she said it could be that Tikki had an owner before 600 BC due to electricity being first discovered back then or at least before 1700's when people started to use it for power.
For the women wearing pants she was likely referring to before the 1950's because it didn't become popular until then.
Upon Tikki covering her ears and saying, "I forgot how loud this part could be" also suggest that before Marinette, she at least one or a few other owners who screamed at the sight of her or it happened to one of her siblings being warned that some people will freak out at the sight of them.
For Tikki to know Marinette's name despite not being told it, could be that she saw it either sown into her backpack or learned it from the items that were in her bag.

title: Tokyo Tower
text:
Tokyo Tower - Intro
The  (東京タワー, Tōkyō tawā) is a 332.6-meter steel tower located in Minato Ward, Tokyo. Built in 1958 by Tachū Naitō as a symbol of Japan's reconstruction after World War II, its concept was inspired by the Eiffel Tower in Paris.

title: Tokyo Tower
text:
Tokyo Tower - Description
Tokyo Tower is a white and orange international communications and observation tower. Inspired by the Eiffel Tower in Paris, it stands 332.6 meters tall. Its base rests on an 80-meter square. Between its pillars is a four-story gray and black building, Foot Town, a shopping mall with a gallery and tourist attractions, including an aquarium.
The main observatory is 145 meters high and is the first duplex floor of the tower. It is accessed by elevators located in the tower's three pillars, or by a 600-step staircase.
There are observation tables, souvenir shops, a Shinto shrine, and a small concert hall.
The special observatory is 250 meters high and is the top floor of the tower. It consists of a circular glass gallery that offers a panoramic view of Tokyo and, on clear days, Mount Fuji.
Just above the top floor, there is the digital television transmission system, and therefore its antenna.

title: Tokyo Tower
text:
Tokyo Tower - Trivia
The Tokyo Tower has been a National Cultural Heritage Site of Japan since 2013.
It belongs to The Tokyo Tower consortium, which includes Toei Company.
Toei Animation, an animated film and series production studio, is involved in the production of the "Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir" series.
Starting in 2021, it also sells the Miraculous manga.
An amusement park based on the "One Piece" anime is located on the top three floors of Foot Town.
Although Tokyo Tower is taller than the Eiffel Tower (2 meters with antenna), the top floor of the Parisian tower is taller than that of its little sister in Tokyo.

title: Tokyo Skytree
text:
Tokyo Skytree - Intro
The  (東京スカイツリー; Tōkyō Sukaitsurī) is a broadcasting and observation tower located in Sumida, Tokyo. At 634 meters high, it is the tallest building in Tokyo and the third tallest in the world.

title: Tokyo Skytree
text:
Tokyo Skytree - Description
Built in 2012, the Tokyo Skytree is a 634-meter-tall steel tower with a neo-futuristic style that blends with the traditional beauty of Japan.
It has three legs, reminiscent of a tripod, for maximum stability and earthquake resistance. Its cylindrical metal structure offers panoramic views of Tokyo from two observatories, one at 350 meters and the other at 450 meters.
It is a bluish white color called "SkyTree White," inspired by the traditional Japanese color aijiro. At night, it is illuminated by LED lamps that alternate between Iki blue and Miyabi purple. It can also light up in other colors, including the white and red of the Japanese flag.

title: Tokyo Skytree
text:
Tokyo Skytree - Trivia
The fifth and sixth floors of Tokyo Skytree house the Sumida Aquarium, known for its use of artificial seawater.

title: Tom Dupain
text:
Tom Dupain - Intro
is a recurring character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He is the husband of Sabine Cheng and the father of Marinette Dupain-Cheng. He and his wife are the owners of the Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie.
In "Weredad", when Cat Noir confessed that he was not in love with Marinette and Tom believed he broke her heart, he was akumatized by Hawk Moth into Weredad, a werewolf-themed supervillain with chlorokinesis.
In "Dearest Family", when Tom, Sabine, Roland and Gina started arguing about what each one thought is best for Marinette, they are reakumatized by Shadow Moth into Weredad, Qilin, Bakerix, and Befana respectively and formed the villainous group Dearest Family, who competed with each other to prove that they knew what was best for Marinette. He also received a Magical Charm from Ladybug to prevent him from being reakumatized.

title: Tom Dupain
text:
Tom Dupain - Intro
In "Secret Protocol", Tom celebrates his wife Sabine's birthday with his daughter, Marinette, as his uncle-in-law, Wang Cheng, makes a surprise visit. Later, Fei calls them, revealing that Wang has been in Shanghai the entire time. This causes Tom, Sabine, and Marinette to question who was in the guest room and become frightened. At the end of the episode, Marinette reveals that she is Ladybug by transforming in front of Tom and Sabine.

title: Tom Dupain
text:
Tom Dupain - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Tom is a tall man with a large muscular body build. He has short brown hair, green eyes, sideburns and a mustache.
Civilian Attire
Tom wears a light blue shirt with two buttons at the front of the neckline, light brown pants, and dark brown dress shoes. He wears a silver band on his ring finger.
As Weredad
Weredad was entirely brown with a bronze fur mane on his back. There was a dark brown and black mustache-shaped area on his chest. His eyes had light yellow sclerae and black pupils. He also had vines wrapped around his wrists, waist and ankles. His mustache became a large beard, and he only wore light green shorts. He had powerful muscles, paws instead of feet, and a short tail.

title: Tom Dupain
text:
Tom Dupain - Personality
Tom is passionate about his job and loves to share with his daughter. He also likes to play video games with Marinette and seems to be quite confident in his abilities as a gamer, saying his daughter learned from the best. He is protective of his loved ones, even courageously going against the mayor's authority when Chloé Bourgeois tries to convince Roger Raincomprix arrest Marinette in "Rogercop". In this same episode, he tells Marinette that passing the blame onto others is wrong, showing that he does not approve of selfish behavior. He also gets exasperated, frustrated, and disappointed in some cases, but he usually means well and doesn't hold a grudge afterward. While he can be intrusive sometimes, usually related to Marinette's crushes, he knows his boundaries. Caring about the well-being of others, Tom assists and comforts anyone, whether he is familiar with them or not, and he is very friendly and optimistic. In "Family", Marinette describes him as a true romantic and can get carried away at times.

title: Tom Dupain
text:
Tom Dupain - Personality
In "Troublemaker", he is somewhat nervous in front of the camera, very protective when his family's privacy gets invaded. Tom has proven himself to be very brave on occasion seen in "Mayura", when he took part in the Paris Rebellion.
When he was willing to defend the bakery and their home from Gigantitan. But according to Sabine, Tom has a habit of jumping to conclusions or making a big deal out of everything when he quickly assumed that Marinette was in love with Cat Noir or when things don't go well. According to Sabine in "Bakerix", Tom doesn't talk openly about his feelings meaning he can be shy or hesitant about them.

title: Tom Dupain
text:
Tom Dupain - Personality
As Weredad, he was overprotective and became antagonistic when he assumed that someone was going to harm or threaten his daughter. He seemed to have a hatred towards Cat Noir for breaking Marinette's heart and found him unworthy of his daughter's love. Without a second thought, Weredad was stubborn, even never listening to Cat Noir and told him that one day, a prince worthy of her will climb up the vine, confront him, and pluck the magic rose to free Marinette. Additionally, he started to act like Gabriel Agreste in regards to his son, as Weredad thought his daughter would be safe from harm without considering the possibility about how miserable and hurt she would feel.
During his second akumatization as Weredad, he remained overprotective with Marinette, wanting to protect his daughter from anything that could harm her. Even his wife and parents, and their opinions of how to raise Marinette, came in conflict with his own. Because of this, Weredad got very competitive with the rest of his akumatized family, fighting with them to prevent them from imposing their way of raising Marinette or trying to beat them into getting Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses.

text:

As a Civilian
A baker, Tom can make multiple delicious foods like pastries and candies. He also knows how to play video games, which is a hobby he enjoys outside of work.
He is really strong as he is able to pick up a three layer cake seen in "Befana" or his wife and Marinette with ease.
As Weredad
His strength increased and he could attack with thorny vines that came from his hand while the main one was used as a trap to prevent anyone from reaching the akumatized object and its prisoner.

title: Tomoe Gozen

title: Tomoe Gozen
text:

title: Tomoe Gozen
text:
Tomoe Gozen - Trivia
She appears in a painting at the beginning of "Ladybug & Cat Noir".
The painting is based on The Great Wave off Kanagawa by Katsushika Hokusai.
She later appears in a painting in "Ikari Gozen".
The painting appears to be based on two paintings by the artist Toyohara Chikanobu made in the 1890s depicting Tomoe Gozen battling Uchida Ieyoshi and Hatakeyama Shigetada, both pertaining to the Battle of Awazu in 1184.
The word gozen (御前) isn't a last name. It is an honorary title primarily given to women but also some men. It roughly translates to "young lady" or "lord."
As of her age, Tomoe Gozen is the oldest of all the female Miraculous holders but follows behind Master Fu as the second oldest of all the Miraculous holders.

title: Tomoe Tsurugi
text:
Tomoe Tsurugi - Intro
(剣 ともえ / Tsurugi Tomoe in Japanese order) is one of the two secondary antagonists (alongside Nathalie Sancoeur) of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She is also a cameo antagonist in Miraculous World: London - At the Edge of Time.
She is a world champion fencer, CEO of Tsurugi Industries and the mother of Cerise Bianca and Kagami Tsurugi who formed an alliance with Gabriel Agreste. She is also secretly a member of The Kingdom, a secret evil organization that is searching for the Ladybug and the Cat Miraculouses. Within the council, she is known as The Machine.
In "Ikari Gozen", after Kagami disobeyed her by choosing to participate in the Friendship Day games, Hawk Moth akumatized Tomoe into Ikari Gozen, a giant centaur samurai supervillain in order to punish her daughter.

title: Tomoe Tsurugi
text:
Tomoe Tsurugi - Intro
In "Multiplication", it is revealed that Tomoe is the CEO of her own tech company called Tsurugi Industries (also known as the Tsurugi technologies) and that she was aware of Gabriel's secret identity as Monarch, and was a willing ally to him. They developed technological rings called Alliance rings that would allow the latter to give the Miraculous superpowers to his akumatized villains without the need to give them the Miraculous themselves. To test the Alliance rings, she let herself be reakumatized into Ikari Gozen, while holding one Alliance ring, she received the Mouse Miraculous superpower to multiply herself and become Ikari Dozen. After the success of the experiment, Tomoe and Gabriel give public access to the Alliance rings. She also received a Magical Charm from Ladybug to prevent her from being re-akumatized.

title: Tomoe Tsurugi
text:
Tomoe Tsurugi - Intro
In "Pretension", after Argos kidnapped Kagami, Tomoe put on five Alliances and asked Gabriel to reakumatize her so she could recover her daughter, seeing that also as a chance to retrieve the Peacock Miraculous. She was akumatized into Matagi Gozen, a new version of her previous akumatized form Ikari Gozen, receiving the superpowers of the Bee Miraculous, Rooster Miraculous, Mouse Miraculous, Horse Miraculous and Tiger Miraculouses through her Alliance rings. She also received a new Magical Charm after her first one got destroyed.
In "Re-creation", with Gabriel's sacrifice, Tomoe took over the Agreste brand in honor of "continuing his legacy", after Ladybug exonerated her by lying to the public she and Gabriel were forced by Monarch to create the Alliance rings, both for Adrien and Kagami's sake.
In "El Toro De Piedra", Tomoe, using her alias The Machine, meets with the council and says she has no explanation provided about the final battle between Gabriel Agreste and Bug Noire. She proceeds to remind the council about the desired success for the Perfect World Project. She is entrusted with carrying on Gabriel Agreste's mission, with Nathalie Sancoeur as her shadow.

title: Tomoe Tsurugi
text:
Tomoe Tsurugi - Intro
In "Vampigami", it's revealed that Tomoe Tsurugi has teamed up with Cerise, and by using Chrysalis's latest akumatized villain to uncover Ladybug and Cat Noir's identities. Following the deakumatization, Cerise now suspects Marinette of being Ladybug, but without definitive proof, there's no way to prove it.
In "Yaksi Gozen", it's revealed that she had allied herself with Cerise before Monarch's defeat. After getting into a big argument with Kagami, Tomoe is convinced by Cerise to let herself akumatized by her into Yaksi Gozen, another new version of Ikari Gozen, as part of Chrysalis' plan to capture Félix and seize his ring to control him against Ladybug and Cat Noir. She is also revealed to have been the one to use the Peacock Miraculous to bring Kagami to life, with her lost sight being a consequence of the use of the damaged Miraculous.

title: Tomoe Tsurugi
text:
Tomoe Tsurugi - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Tomoe is a slender Japanese middle-aged pale-skinned woman of average height with long black hair with blue reflections that is arranged in Chignon style.
In "Yaksi Gozen", when removing her sunglasses, it is revealed Tomoe has cybernetic prosthetic eyes with dark blue pupils due to losing her eyesight after using the Peacock Miraculous.
Civilian Attire
Tomoe wears a red barrette on her hair, a white long-sleeved keikogi with a Cheongsam collar and the Tsurugi family crest on her upper sleeves and on the back below the neck is black, a black band around her waist, flowing deep festive red hakama pants, black sunglasses, and black high heeled dress shoes. She uses a shinai as a support cane for her blindness.
From season 6 onwards, the Tsurugi family crest on her upper sleeves and on the back below the neck is red.
As Ikari Gozen

title: Tomoe Tsurugi
text:
Tomoe Tsurugi - Appearance
As Ikari Gozen, Tomoe had an appearance reminiscent of a classical Greek centaur as her lower body resembled a horse, complete with four legs and four hooves. Unlike the other centaurs, she didn't have a tail. As a living suit of hollow samurai armor, her skin was the same metallic red as the rest of her body with light brilliant amber eyes with almost invisible yellowish white pupils, partially covered with a helmet reminiscent of the one that Riposte beared; albeit with a large horn that looked like Oni-Chan's rather than a winged emblem and bearing the Tsurugi family crest on her chest.
Because the Tsurugi car was transformed along with Tomoe in the akumatization, she appeared to be very mechanical and vehicular, especially in the lower half of her body. Its appearance evoked a high end car, inspired by a Tesla Model S, with tires at the joints, headlights at the front hips, and exhaust ports throughout. Ikari Gozen wielded her akumatized bokken in her right hand. She also had the ability to see as she was able to locate her daughter repeatedly and recognize her as the hero Ryuko.
As Matagi Gozen

title: Tomoe Tsurugi
text:
Tomoe Tsurugi - Appearance
Matagi Gozen had the same appearance as Ikari Gozen, but she was armed with a bow and arrow along with her sword and rode a red and black dog/horse with yellow eyes just like her. She also had two normal legs unlike her previous form.
As Yaksi Gozen
Yaksi Gozen's appearance served as an upgrade to her past forms as Ikari and Matagi Gozen respectively. While she had a similar look to her past forms, her armor was more intricate in structure, featuring minor alterations; she had black markings near the corners of her torso armor, she gained additionally large and open shoulder pauldrons with points, matching the more wide and open helmet, her emblem was upside down and pentagonal in shape, and her helmet horn turned black.
She had a more robotic face with darker, angular cheeks, matching the shape of her eyes. As shown in her resisting her akumatization, her tears were light brilliant amber. She also had a charcoal gray waist area featuring a mouth made of teeth-like fangs. She wielded her bokken as well.
As a Peacock Miraculous holder

title: Tomoe Tsurugi
text:
Tomoe Tsurugi - Appearance
She gained light indigo skin, black sclerae with magenta irises, and light mint eyeshadow. Beneath her eyes were blue teardrops. Her lips turned dark blue and her hair became thicker, styled in locks resembling peacock feathers with pointy tips featuring dark purple markings with cerise dots inside, and translucent slate blue tips. Around her head was a white band with diamond patterns, with mint-to-rose graidented appendages on top of her head.
She wore white fabric wrapped around her chest with an Atzec pattern to it, accented by the triangular buckle on her sash, with white strips of fabric around her exposed legs, attached to white cuffs and a blue gem in the middle. She was barefoot. She had dark blue markings around her arms, and magenta swirls around her stomach, resembling a womb. She also wore the Peacock Miraculous pinned to the fabric around her chest.

title: Tomoe Tsurugi
text:
Tomoe Tsurugi - Personality
Tomoe seems to be a very strict and kept woman who is very aware of her environment. She can be wise and informative towards others as well, advising the less open-minded Gabriel Agreste to not give into fear in "Backwarder". However, she is also quite cold and holds a great deal of cynnicism towards love and friendship, even seeing that as Gabriel's fatal flaw, as his own desperate obsession in bringing back his wife has been the root of many of their strives in reaching their objective, something she is not affraid of telling him, as seen in "Pretension".
In "Yaksi Gozen", it's revealed that Tomoe's cynicism towards love and friendship is the result of many disappointments she suffered in the past, especially with the opposite gender. That was the one thing that held her back in allying herself to Gabriel to defeat Ladybug and Cat Noir when he called for her help, only doing so at the prospect of regaining her sight back and her daughter getting a "prince charming" as perfect as she was.

title: Tomoe Tsurugi
text:
Tomoe Tsurugi - Personality
As a mother, Tomoe is very strict and demanding with her daughter Kagami, always holding her to very high standards and pushing her to her limits in order to turn her into a strong and disciplined person. Both to protect Kagami from disappointment and due to her past grievances, Tomoe was very controlling towards her daughter's friendships, only allowing her to be friends to those she approved of. To prevent Kagami from seeking friendships, she would always tell her forming bonds with another can end sour or disappointing. However, after noticing Kagami's determination in seeking friendships, she allowed her to do so, possibly expecting she would learn this way how disappointing friendships could be, allowing her daughter to be friends with Marinette to this end.

title: Tomoe Tsurugi
text:
Tomoe Tsurugi - Personality
Tomoe has a pretentious and sanctimonious attitude about Kagami being under her control, saying she has the ideal behavior and is too perfect for her to control. This comes from the way Tomoe educated Kagami, passing the latter's entire life to teach her respect and discipline in a way that would cause her daughter to obey her without the need of using her amok to do so. She would also pressure Kagami into not only being perfect but to suppress her emotions, chastising her for allowing even a inch of emotion to come from her. She doesn't take it lightly when Gabriel tells her she doesn't have her daughter under her control, but, despite her self-righteous belief, Tomoe is willing to force Kagami into obedience and even wanted Gabriel akumatize her when Kagami escaped from London in "Representation". However, thanks to Félix, who switched Kagami's amokized ring for a fake one, that was prevented.

title: Tomoe Tsurugi
text:
Tomoe Tsurugi - Personality
In "Yaksi Gozen", Tomoe's desire to control her daughter's life again drove her to try to regain the latter's ring by force after knowing she would meet with Félix, the one that disrupted the hold she had on Kagami's life, which resulted in a tempestous argument with her that forced the latter to use her powers as Ryuko to defend herself. That also motivated her to accept Cerise/Chrysalis' proposal for a plan that would both give her back some of the control she once had over Kagami, but would also allow her to spy on the Miraculers, targeting Félix instead.
Despite being a stringent parent towards Kagami, Tomoe is showed to care for her daughter, even if on her own way. This is seen how she refuses to allow her daughter to be harmed, especially through her silver family ring, as seen in "Perfection", when Gabriel sent a megakuma to Kagami's ring, putting her in danger of being destroyed if Ladybug had come to break the akumatized ring and free the amok before it could be repaired with her powers.

title: Tomoe Tsurugi
text:
Tomoe Tsurugi - Personality
Tomoe also doesn't want Kagami to go through the same pain she endured, as the all point of her helping Gabriel in his quest to have Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses (besides regaining her sight) was for her daughter to be paired up with someone that was as perfect as her, but also easy to control, with Adrien being the ideal choice. However there was a flaw just like Chloé, Tomoe was so wrapped up in the past that she didn't or not wanted to see the differences between her and Kagami.
Where she failed to realize had she gone through with the plan, Tomoe would be acting no different than Gabriel in the case of "pulling the strings". By using Félix like that, she'd be making things dangerous for her daughter thereby her friends just to make a point, Tomoe would only be proving that she is dangerous not what she said extending to Tomoe that she also lost her daughter's forgiveness.

title: Tomoe Tsurugi
text:
Tomoe Tsurugi - Personality
Tomoe is also showed possessing a great deal of disgust and hatred towards the Peacock Miraculous itself, due to the fact she had to give up on her eyes in order to create Kagami with its magic. This hatred towards the jewel is so much that she initially refused to help Gabriel fix it in order for Nathalie to help him as Mayura without any danger (even with him suggesting to use the wish to restore Tomoe's eyes), only accepting after realizing she could use this to ensure her daughter would be paired up with a "prince charming" worthy of her that could also be controled. The hatred towards the Peacock Miraculous is also extended to their holders, as they have the power to undo any sentimonster.

title: Tomoe Tsurugi
text:
Tomoe Tsurugi - Personality
As Ikari Gozen, Tomoe became much more violent and ten times more strict and furious as she regularly performed large sword strokes without care for collateral damage and knocking aside several cars. Her aggression was so that she showed no hesitation to anything, even combating her own daughter, attempting to stomp her several times under her hooves. She believed she was well within her rights as a mother to act out and punish her child as she deemed fit for disobeying her. She was also rather confident and prideful, declaring herself "as elusive as the wind, as powerful as the flood, as swift as lightning".
In "Multiplication", her akumatization this time was voluntary but she still remained with her altered personality so as not to bring suspicion to her enemies. Her personal goal along with Monarch's was to test the Alliances rings but from the heroes' point of view, she had an opposite goal from Bakerix which was to destroy everything that was considered old.

title: Tomoe Tsurugi
text:
Tomoe Tsurugi - Personality
As Matagi Gozen, due to being voluntarily akumatized, her personality remained the same as her civilian form and her personality as Ikari Gozen. She also had multiple objectives, which were to take the Ladybug, Cat and Peacock Miraculous from their respective owners, take revenge on Argos for kidnapping her daughter and also recover her at all costs, even needing to hurt her with the Venom shots.
As Yaksi Gozen, she lets herself be perceived as wanting to keep Félix away from Kagami, even extending that to Adrien, despite the fact he only sees the latter as a friend. However, that is nothing but a façade to hide the true plan of getting control over Félix through his amokized ring and use him to spy on the Miraculers, all while earn Kagami's forgiveness after pretending to finally understand her feelings and fight off and reject the ultrakuma. Despite the main objective to seize control over Félix failed, she managed to salvage the last part of plan.

title: Tomoe Tsurugi
text:
Tomoe Tsurugi - Abilities
As a Civilian
Tomoe is a very skilled champion in fencing and kendo, surpassing her prodigious daughter's prowess. She has heightened senses and is able to sense the mood of those near her even though she is blind. Although blind, Tomoe easily navigates her environment with the help of her other senses, gadgets such as a smart phone, her bokken as a cane and the assistance of her Tesla-inspired self-driving car named Tatsu. As the CEO of her own technology company, she is well-versed at running and leading a business, doing partnerships, and creating a wide range of electronical products.
As Ikari Gozen
As Ikari Gozen, Tomoe possessed a gigantic size and immense strength. She was capable of easily knocking aside heavy objects, such as cars, and creating large stomping vibrations with her hooves. Despite her size, she remained nimble and dexterous, able to gallop like a horse or donkey, leap great distances, and wield her sword with one hand. In her akumatized form, she also demonstrated sharp vision. In other words, Ikari Gozen was incredibly strong, fast and agile.

title: Tomoe Tsurugi
text:
Tomoe Tsurugi - Abilities
Since her akumatization was fused with her car, Tatsu, she also had the ability to swallow victims whole and, being made of metal, could place them into her armor unharmed. The inside of her armor was similar to that of her car, albeit larger. She could control the seatbelts with her willpower alone, trapping her victims. However, a noticeable weakness of this is water, which would build up inside her and seep through her armor, also forcing her to release any prisoners inside.
In "Multiplication", she gained the power of the Mouse Miraculous, known as Multitude, through her Alliance ring. This allowed her to create multiple copies of herself all a smaller size and with a hive mind.
As Matagi Gozen

title: Tomoe Tsurugi
text:
Tomoe Tsurugi - Abilities
As Matagi Gozen, Tomoe retained the same abilities as Ikari Gozen except that she got the powers of Sublimation, Venom, Multitude, Voyage, and Clout. Matagi Gozen also had a bow and arrow rather than a bokken. She could fire powerful arrows with different effects depending on which Miraculous powers she had. She could combine them with Venom to paralyze her victims in place, or Clout to give them an extra powerful punch. She could also create portals using Voyage to go anywhere she wished to in the world, or even in space! She also retained the power of Multitude. Alongside this, she had the power of Sublimation, which allowed her to choose a super ability of her own, as long as it did not copy that of a Miraculous. She used this power to grant herself (or rather the enormous canine steed she rode) the ability of supernatural smell, which allowed her to locate anyone. However, the flaw in her power is that she could be thrown off the scent if the target's clothing or otherwise was spread out.
As Yaksi Gozen

title: Tomoe Tsurugi
text:
Tomoe Tsurugi - Abilities
Yaksi Gozen, like her Ikari Gozen and Matagi Gozen forms, is characterized by her gigantic size and immense strength. She wields a Bokken, a wooden sword with which she can effortlessly cut through thick objects, such as cars and the walls of houses. Yaksi Gozen has the ability to shoot a yellow beam from her mouth that freezes her targets, allowing her to then open her stomach and imprison them inside. Inside, she has a cage that resembles a dark room. Similar to Venom, those affected by her beam become unable to see, hear, speak, or think, as was the case with Félix, who couldn't perceive Chrysalis even though she was standing right in front of him.
As a Peacock Miraculous holder
The Peacock Miraculous granted her enhanced physical abilities, a hand fan as her tool, and Amokization as her superpower, allowing her to manifest emotions of herself or others into physical form to create sentimonsters. After amokizing her ring to create her daughter, the use of the damaged Miraculous caused her eyes to start to deteriorate, eventually, causing her the need to remove them and replace them with mechanical prosthetics in hopes of regaining some of her vision.

title: Tomoe Tsurugi
text:
Tomoe Tsurugi - Etymology
Tomoe's name is a reference to Tomoe Gozen and her surname Gozen for her akumatized identity has reference to Tomoe Gozen's last name as well.
Furthermore, as seen in "Ikari Gozen", Tomoe seems to admire Gozen, complimenting her perserverance skills.
Tomoe's surname Tsurugi means "sword, blade, saber, bayonet, sting, clock hand" (剣).
Tsurugi is a type of Japanese sword.
The Kusanagi-no-Tsurugi is a legendary sword that represents the virtue of valor. It is one of the three Imperial Regalia of Japan, along with the Yata no Kagami, a mirror that represents wisdom and the Yasakani-no-Magatama, a sacred jewel that represents benevolence.
Matagi Gozen is an altercation of Tomoe's first akumatized villain name. The Matagi (マタギ) are traditional winter hunters of northern Japan, explaining why Matagi Gozen wields a bow. Northern Japan is also famously known for their Akita dogs, which is Matagi Gozen's steed's face design is based off of.
Yaksi Gozen's name comes from the Yaksha, nature spirits in Buddhist mythology.

title: Tomoe Tsurugi
text:
Tomoe Tsurugi - Trivia
It is revealed by Feri González that Tomoe is indeed blind as she is shown using a kendo sword as a walking stick and black sunglasses.
This is due to her having sustained eye damage from using the Peacock Miraculous. As revealed in "Yaksi Gozen", Tomoe had replaced her eyes with prostetics that appear to give her some form of limited vision.
However, when she was akumatized into Ikari Gozen, being akumatized fixed Tomoe's eyesight, returning her ability to see. However, her blindness returned when she was deakumatized.
It is revealed that Kagami Tsurugi has a grandfather, but it is unknown if he is Tomoe's father or father-in-law.
It is also unknown whether she raised Kagami alone.
The episode "Yaksi Gozen" reveals that Tomoe has had many disappointments from the men in her life, suggesting that she indeed had Kagami by herself or that the one that would be the latter's father abandoned them.
Tomoe is the first akumatized villain to be given by Monarch access to a Miraculous superpower through the Alliance rings.
Tomoe is the third person shown to know of Gabriel's supervillain identity, following Nathalie Sancoeur and Félix Fathom.

title: Tomoe Tsurugi
text:
Tomoe Tsurugi - Trivia
Tomoe is the fifth person to voluntarily get akumatized following Gabriel Agreste, Nathalie Sancoeur, Lila Rossi and Chloé Bourgeois.
Since it was revealed in "Multiplication", that Tomoe knows who Monarch is, she was already aware of his secret identity in "Ikari Gozen" and gotten herself voluntarily akumatized in that episode. It was shown in "Animaestro" that Gabriel and Tomoe had been working on "Operation: Perfect Alliance" for quite some time, which supports the previous statement.
If so, Tomoe might also retain her memory of Kagami's secret identity as Ryuko and pretended not to remember after being deakumatized, or Gabriel told her.
Gabriel might have told Tomoe the secret identities of Rena Rouge, Carapace, King Monkey, Pegasus, Bunnyx and Viperion, following the events of the Season 5 premiere, "Evolution".
In "Perfection", it is revealed that Gabriel tried to take away Tomoe's dream in the past, causing him to be in debt to her.
Considering the fact Tomoe lost her sight after using the Peacock Miraculous, maybe she blames Gabriel for that, possibly either due to him being the reason why it was damaged or for not warning her about the dangers of using it.

title: Tomoe Tsurugi
text:
Tomoe Tsurugi - Trivia
Matagi Gozen is the second akumatized villain to receive multiple Miraculous powers through the Alliance rings, following Kiku, not counting Safari, who was able to get other powers with the help of Genesis.
Tomoe's role as Gabriel's accomplice to steal the Miraculouses could be foreshadowed in the episode "Feast" where after the restoration of the Order of the Guardians' temple, Tomoe is seen among the people listening closely to the news announcement.
After Marinette offers her some ice cream in "Lady Chaos", it is revealed that she is lactose intolerant.
In "Yaksi Gozen", it's revealed she used the Peacock Miraculous to give life to Kagami, the same way Émilie and Colt did to create Adrien and Félix respectivelly.
However, unlike them, she managed to survive, as the emotion she used to create Kagami caused her eyes to be affected by the backlash, unlike the other two who most likely had vital organs affected. When they started to deteriorate, Tomoe had them removed to avoid any complications.

title: Tom Dupain/History
text:
Tom Dupain/History - Before Season 1
Tom Dupain was born to Roland Dupain, a French man and Gina Bianchi, an Italian woman around 1976. In the 1990s, he met a Chinese woman named Sabine Cheng to whom he proposed his hand in marriage to by hiding the ring in a scoop of vanilla ice cream when he took her to André's ice cream. By 1995, he and Sabine had married, but afterwards, he and his father broke off all communications when he tried to alter a family recipe. In 2001, he became a father to a baby girl whom he and Sabine named Marinette.

title: Tom Dupain/History
text:
Tom Dupain/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Ladybug & Cat Noir", Tom saw Marinette head off to school with a box of macarons. Sometime later, he and Sabine heard from the news that new heroes are in Paris but became horrified when some innocent people became frozen Stonehearts.
In "Stoneheart", after Marinette began to doubt Ladybug's ability Tom tried to encourage her by reminding her the best way to help their new heroes is not being afraid and having faith in them. But when Marinette still doubts herself, Tom replied he'd save her. He was watching Hawk Moth's announcement on television with Sabine in worry but rejoiced when Ladybug stood up against him.
In "The Bubbler", Tom were bubbled along with the other adults in Paris and sent skywards until they were brought back down to earth due the Miraculous Ladybug (superpower).

title: Tom Dupain/History
text:
Tom Dupain/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Timebreaker", Tom was getting for his 20th wedding anniversary with Sabine at the Le Grand Paris Hotel. But soon their date was interrupted when Tom received a call from Nadja saying that Marinette wasn't there. In an alternate timeline, he was called by Nadja but this time Marinette was at the bakery in time and was relieved. They returned home having enjoyed their anniversary despite having a close call. When his daughter agreed not to mess up next time he also remembered that they have only one daughter and they're counting on her before they embrace.
In "Lady Wifi", Tom and Sabine watched their television in anguish when Lady Wifi was about to unveil Ladybug's identity.

title: Tom Dupain/History
text:
Tom Dupain/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Rogercop", Tom and Marinette were getting ready for Career Day at Marinette's school with Sabine's help and wished them luck as they left. At the school, Tom started to describe his job to his daughters classmates referencing "Timebreaker". However, things went sour when Chloé accused Marinette of stealing her bracelet Tom rushed to his daughter's defense believing she wasn't a thief. As the discussion continued he refused to let the mayor get anywhere near his daughter or her bag. Upon hearing Marinette let the situation get out of hand he told her to let the adults handle this but she retorted that she was defending herself. Tom also reminded Marinette in trying to defend herself she accused her friends like Chloé did to her but became surprised when an akumatized villain smashed into the classroom.
In "Dark Cupid", he was minding the bakery and gave Marinette and Alya heart shaped candy apples.

title: Tom Dupain/History
text:
Tom Dupain/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Animan", he and Sabine were working in the bakery until an exhausted Kim came in asking for help. Tom became awestruck when Ladybug (unable to recognize that it's his daughter) and Cat Noir arrived and heard from the news that animals were running wild all over Paris. Then, was instructed by the heroes to keep all the windows and doors locked as well as being thanked by the heroine for their help.
In "Simon Says", he along with Sabine were talking to Marinette about her recent absences but when his daughter couldn't come up with an answer. Sadly, they had no choice until her absences came to an end they grounded her. When they saw that Marinette's absences had finally ended the couple allowed her to watch Nino's performance at the studio but heard that Marinette was going to a nap in her bedroom.
In "Guitar Villain", Tom along with Sabine were surprised that Bob Roth chose Marinette to design Jagged Stone's new album.

title: Tom Dupain/History
text:
Tom Dupain/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Gamer", he heard that Marinette won a spot in a gaming competition and then heard that Adrien was her partner for the event. Then, upon hearing Adrien's arrival; Tom was aware that his daughter was fond of him also admitting that Marinette got all her skills from him while striking a pose. But while Marinette and Adrien were practicing, he and Sabine constantly checked on the two offering them snacks.

title: Tom Dupain/History
text:
Tom Dupain/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Glaciator", Tom was enjoying dinner with her family and was getting Marinette's favorite dessert. When she mentioned going to Andre's ice cream stand with her friends, Tom remembered that had been when he proposed Sabine and asked Marinette who the lucky guy was. He laughed in amusement when their daughter left.
In "Despair Bear", Tom was teaching Marinette and her classmates how to make eclairs and asked his daughter to take the bowl into the kitchen while he continued the lesson. Then, hearing the fire alarm he exited the classroom with the remaining students hoping it was just a fire drill. After Despair Bear's defeat, Tom was brought to the hotel to take part in a macaron contest.

title: Tom Dupain/History
text:
Tom Dupain/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Troublemaker", Tom and his family agreed to have Jagged Stone host his new tv show at their bakery. During the show's intermission, he and Sabine found that their daughter's room was shown on live TV. Just before the show continued, he received a stern look from his wife agreeing with him that they should stop because they had their privacy invaded. Soon things went from bad to worse when strange things started happening in the bakery. To their surprise, it was the akumatized villain Troublemaker that did it, and Tom tried to stop to no avail. Upon seeing Ladybug release her restoration powers they all rejoiced and were relieved that Marinette was okay.

title: Tom Dupain/History
text:
Tom Dupain/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Befana", he was getting ready for Marinette's birthday by helping Sabine bake her cake. However, his daughter's sudden arrival caused him accidentally dump it in the trash, causing them to make another one. Then, the family got a surprise visit from Gina Dupain: Tom's mother. Upon seeing that Gina believed that Marinette was still a little girl, he tried to break it to her gently that Marinette was growing up and watches the two leave. However, upon hearing them return, Tom panicked and dumped the cake in the trash again. He was saddened to see that Gina believed he was right and was given a suggestion by Sabine to talk to her. They agreed that after they were done baking another cake, they'd bring his mother with him to the party. Once the third cake was done, Tom left to get her but was horrified when his mother had been akumatized. He was then turned into a coal statue. After Befana was defeated, Tom was returned to normal and enjoyed his daughter's birthday party.

title: Tom Dupain/History
text:
Tom Dupain/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Syren", Tom was eying Marinette's mini-macrons, believing they looked delicious. He tried to eat one until Marinette moved them away wanting to check to see if they were good. Tom assured her they'd be great since she made them.
In "Style Queen", Tom and his family attended Fashion Week to show support for Marinette who had her own hat design being shown off by Adrien during the show. The event was interrupted by Style Queen. Soon he and Sabine managed to escape to safety but went looking for Marinette. Upon finding her after Style Queen's defeat, he and Sabine took her back to the show.

title: Tom Dupain/History
text:
Tom Dupain/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Queen Wasp", Tom and Sabine continued watching the Fashion Show. However, he, along with everyone else, became shocked that Gabriel Agreste appeared. Then, after the show, they both saw that Audrey became so impressed by Marinette's design that she gave their daughter the opportunity to go to New York. Surprised, Tom agreed with her believing that they'd support Marinette no matter what she chose. However, at seeing Chloe disregarded by her mother, Tom, along with everyone else, was shocked when Chloe transformed into Queen Bee in an attempt to be a hero. However, he didn't think it was great idea. Afterwards, the Dupain-Cheng family took a subway train home and was still surprised that Marinette got the opportunity to go to New York. As Tom liked the idea of having so many business opportunities in New York, she reminded him that he hated flying.

title: Tom Dupain/History
text:
Tom Dupain/History - [[Season 2]]
However, soon they were all on a "speeding train" in Chloe's attempt to "be a hero". Then he and Sabine moved to the front of the train in an attempt to stop it. Soon Tom was met by Ladybug but saw she had no luck at stopping the train by the controls either. However, thanks to the heroes, they were able to safely stop the train with the vehicle under control. Tom and Sabine went home. After Marinette turned down Audrey's offer, they all played a round of video games in their living room.
In "Malediktator", Tom was working with Sabine in the bakery until Malediktator came in demanding to know where Marinette was. Soon the couple was struck with the villain's demands to leave Paris forever, and after they were packed, they raced to the airport until Ladybug's Miraculous superpower returned them to normal. They were also confused to why they had their suitcases.
In "Sandboy", Tom was making bread in the kitchen until he was sprinkled with Sandboy's nightmare sand facing his worst nightmare of bread coming alive.

title: Tom Dupain/History
text:
Tom Dupain/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Catalyst", Tom was getting ready for Heroes Day with his wife, Sabine, by making a big dessert of the heroes for the event.
