title: Tomoe Tsurugi/History
text:
Tomoe Tsurugi/History - Intro
Tomoe Tsurugi is an antagonist who, revealed in season 5, was assisting Gabriel Agreste's quest to steal the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses and CEO of Tsurugi Industries.

title: Tomoe Tsurugi/History
text:
Tomoe Tsurugi/History - Pre-Series
Tomoe was born to Nozomi Tsurugi and an unknown man and raised in Japan. A world fencing champion (along with her father) and the CEO of Tsurugi Industries, she had an alliance with Gabriel Agreste, who was indebted to her when he tried to destroy her greatest dream. She descends from the Tsurugi clan, a clan of female samurai descendants and prominent fencers, and is currently training by her daughter Kagami to be her perfect successor in the family's traditions.
Tomoe raised Kagami in a sheltered life away from the outside world; she had her daughter homeschooled and only allowed her out for fencing competitions. On Kagami's fourteenth birthday, Tomoe was busy working in her office when Kagami came in and asked if she could attend school as her birthday wish. Tomoe said no and to choose something else but Kagami rejected her answer, much to her surprise. Tomoe issued a challenge to Kagami by throwing her amokized ring in the air and not letting it hit the ground. Kagami succeeded in catching with a bow and arrow. Tomoe granted her request and allowed Kagami to attend the Kano Academy in Tokyo, an international school that combines sports and studies.

title: Tomoe Tsurugi/History
text:
Tomoe Tsurugi/History - Pre-Series
It is revealed in "Yaksi Gozen" and "The Dirtifiers", Tomoe used the Peacock Miraculous to create and give birth to Kagami with the emotion of pride through her vision of the perfect daughter.
However, since it was broken at the time, Tomoe not only lost her eyesight and had them replaced with cybernetic prosthetic eyes with dark blue pupils, but developed an intense hatred for it.
It is also revealed in a flashback in the same episode, while Tomoe and Kagami were still living in Japan, Gabriel phoned Tomoe, asking for her help in repairing the Peacock Miraculous, so Nathalie could help him in the fight against Ladybug and Cat Noir and even offered to help get her eyes back with the wish, but refused, as she did not want to touch it ever again, betray The Kingdom, and was even disgusted that Gabriel became a villain.
To prove his loyalty to her as she did not wanted to be betrayed, Gabriel bargained with Tomoe for her help in making their wishes come true: he offered to betrothe Adrien to Kagami.

title: Tomoe Tsurugi/History
text:
Tomoe Tsurugi/History - Pre-Series
Tomoe had a distrust for men as they have disappointed her all her life and she wanted Kagami to have someone as perfect (and obedient) as she is, so she accepted the offer to help in making their wishes come true on the condition that their children meet first before she thought about helping him.
After finishing the call and Kagami got ready for fencing, Tomoe asked her about moving to Paris, much to her surprise.
Tomoe and her daughter moved to Paris prior to the latter's debut episode.

title: Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie van
text:
Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie van - Intro
The  is an electric van of the brand Volkswagen owned by Tom Dupain and Sabine Cheng. They use it for their personal trips and for deliveries of their pastry products.

title: Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie van
text:
Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie van - Appearance
The ID. Buzz of the Dupain-Cheng family is an electric minibus of the brand Volkswagen, 4.9 meters long, 1.9 meters wide and 1.9 meters high.
It has a two-tone white and metallic yellow coloring. It has four doors, two classic front and two sliding rear. On these last two doors is represented in white the logo of the Dupain-Cheng pastry shop. It features numerous side windows, including those corresponding to the darkened rear seats. The roof of the van is equipped with several windows, including a removable one.
The interior of the vehicle is particularly modern and has plenty of seating Moderna, but also a large load capacity. It has a rectangular steering wheel, and the interior is predominantly beige. This van has an electric motor with a power of 150 kW (204 hp) and is electronically limited to a maximum speed of 145 km/h. It is very quiet and low pollution and has a maximum range of 400 kilometers. The van is a Volkswagen ID Buzz van. It has two headlights on the top and the bottom. The van's primary colors are gold and white with the bakery's logo on the sides.

title: Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie van
text:
Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie van - Trivia
The ID. Buzz of the Dupain-Cheng family is one of four vehicles resulting from the collaboration between the production of "Ladybug & Cat Noir: The Movie" and the German automaker Volkswagen.
The other vehicles are: the ID. Vizzion of the Agreste family, the ID. Ladybug and ID. Crozz Cat Noir.
Tom and Sabine's possession of a vehicle is exclusive to "Ladybug & Cat Noir: The Movie".

title: Trixx
text:
Trixx - Intro
is a supporting character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He is the Kwami of Illusion who is connected to the Fox Miraculous. With his power, Trixx's wearer can use the necklace to transform into a fox-themed superhero.
Trixx and his Miraculous are currently owned by Alya Césaire, who uses it to transform into the superheroine Rena Rouge.
In "Kwamibuster", Trixx fused with Mullo (as Multimouse) to become Multifox.
In "The Chained Titans", Trixx and his Miraculous were temporarily used by Marinette Dupain-Cheng to become Renardette.

title: Trixx
text:
Trixx - Appearance
Trixx is a small orange creature that is 10 centimeters (or 4 inches) in height. He has purple eyes, eyelashes on the side of his eyes, and two fox incisors. A small dark brown spot is above each of his eyes, appearing like eyebrows. He has long fox-like ears with white insides and black tips and edges, and he has a thick flexible tail with a white tip. His forearms and lower legs are black, and the front of his body and the area around his mouth is white.
From Season 6 onwards, his tail is larger and has a more realistic fur texture.

title: Trixx
text:
Trixx - Personality
Trixx is friendly, encouraging, wise, and a good judge of character, as he identifies his new wielder's best qualities very easily. He is honest when something impresses him, like Alya quickly figuring out he transforms her with the Fox Miraculous. He is good at giving advice without being rude or blunt, as seen when Nino questions Alya about her decision not to tell him her secret.

title: Trixx
text:
Trixx - Personality
Like Tikki, Trixx is also very understanding of others actions and feelings. Because of that, he can be very manipulative. After the mission is completed in "Sapotis," when he hears that Alya made a promise to return the Miraculous, he is willing to return to the necklace without any resistance, and also understands Alya's burning desire to continue helping her new teammates and that the three of them would make a good team. He uses that to make her do the right thing and give the Fox Miraculous back, by reminding her that Ladybug chose her because she was trustworthy. Another example is when Marinette, while transformed into Aqua Ladybug, feeling depressed with all the pressure due to her role as the new Guardian. When the Kwamis know they need Tikki to help Marinette feel better, Trixx convinced her to detransform by reminding her of how tired Tikki was from sustaining her transformation.
He is also very caring towards others as he was worried about Alya when she was under Miracle Queen's control and didn't like the idea of being used against his friends. As well as for the well being of his new Guardian.

title: Trixx
text:
Trixx - Personality
However, at times Trixx can be sneaky and mischievous as he looks through Marinette's diary as well as having created an illusion of the Loch Ness monster a long time ago. In fact, this mischievous side of him causes the other Kwamis to find him not very reliable/responsible, with Wayzz saying that, even if Alya is trustworthy, Trixx can't help but cause trouble whenever he is free to do it. Also, like Alya, Trixx is a bit of a scatterbrain, something that is evident when he uses his power; despite him making an illusion of Marinette, his powers also affected the Eiffel Tower despite being nowhere near it.

title: Trixx
text:
Trixx - Personality
Trixx is also shown to be a little possessive of his holders, as it is shown regarding his current holder, Alya. After the Kwamis get out of the Miracle Box when Marinette frees them, they all meet Marinette's friends through the computer, Daizzi hoped to have Alya as his holder, causing Trixx quickly to reply she was already his. As he also doesn't like to share Alya with another Kwami, even if it is necessary to keep Paris safe. This was shown in "Hack-San", where Trixx didn't like the idea of Alya using the Ladybug Miraculous instead of his, even trying to take advantage of Alya's insecurity regarding her living up to Marinette's expectations to not have her use the latter's Miraculous.

title: Trixx
text:
Trixx - Abilities
Trixx is able to fly, levitate, phase through solid objects and carry objects that are larger and/or heavier than him.
As a kwami, Trixx gives the wearer the power of illusion and transforms them into a fox-themed superhero by entering the Fox Miraculous. Whenever an underage wearer uses Mirage, Trixx begins losing power and eventually detransforms in about 5 minutes. Then Trixx has to recharge by eating.
Without the restraints of an owner, Trixx can create illusions of anything he desires. Similar to Plagg, however, he is unable to properly control and channel it as his powers affect a wide area such as when he made the Eiffel Tower move unnaturally and unpredictably.
According to Trixx, his illusion powers in raw form could be strong enough to actually become real and affect the world around them.

title: Trixx
text:
Trixx - Trivia
Trixx's name was revealed on October 7, 2016 during the Miraculous Ladybug panel at the New York Comic-Con.
His first appearance was revealed by the Miraculous fan "Kenya Danino" on August 5, 2016. She revealed the design on a clock she made that showcased all seven known kwamis.
It was later confirmed that the design she had shared was, in fact, the real appearance of the character.
After Trixx's name was revealed, along with some concept art, at New York Comic Con 2016 Kenya posted a piece of concept art of him by Nathanaël Bronn.
With Trixx being the kwami of illusions and having a fox-based appearance, he shares a resemblance to Kitsunes from Japanese folklore which is also the Japanese word for "fox".
Trixx's name is based on the word "tricks" because in some folklore foxes are known for their cunning and trickery.
Unlike all the other known Kwamis, during Alya's transformation sequence, Trixx is not shown entering his Miraculous during his wielder's transformation. Instead, a ball of light flashes when the Miraculous is activated.
The same would later happen with Fluff in teenage Bunnyx's transformation sequence in "Evolution".

title: Trixx
text:
Trixx - Trivia
Trixx's sclerae are sometimes white, other times purple, depending on the episode.
Trixx's appearance and powers are a reference to how real foxes use their cunning and trickery to avoid predators and catch prey.
Like Plagg, Trixx has used his power twice (at least), even though it was used once in "Gang of Secrets".
Trixx is the ninth Kwami to be used for evil, though briefly, following Nooroo, Duusu, Plagg (in an alternative timeline in "Cat Blanc" and "Ephemeral"), Pollen (briefly in "Miracle Queen"), Liiri (briefly in "Miraculous New York"), Wayzz (briefly in "Optigami" and later in "Strikeback"), Tikki (in an alternative timeline in "Ephemeral") and Barkk (briefly in "Strikeback"). Trixx and his Miraculous were used for evil in "Strikeback" by Monarch, who used them, with the Butterfly and Turtle Miraculous, for his Message Transmission.
In "The Illustrhater", following Alya's nomination as the official successor of Marinette, in the case the latter is forced to renounce her role as Guardian and Alya inherits the Ladybug Miraculous, Trixx will have a new holder so that his power can continue to be used to fight against the akumatized villains.

title: Troublemaker
text:
Troublemaker - Intro
"" is a season 2 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 5th written and produced episode of season 2. It is also the 31st written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Troublemaker
text:
Troublemaker - Synopsis
Netflix
A rock star is scheduled to visit the bakery owned by Marinette's parents, but his overwhelmed personal assistant is akumatized by Hawk Moth.
Disney Channel
Jagged Stone's assistant Penny gets akumatized into Troublemaker.
Disney+
Ladybug and Cat Noir face Troublemaker, alias Penny Rolling.

title: Troublemaker
text:
Troublemaker - Plot
At the Le Grand Paris Hotel, Penny is checking off things off her list she has already done. When she opens the door, she starts talking to the Armand, who came to agree with some of Penny's questions about Jagged. But their conversation is interrupted by Penny's phone after a while, Bob Roth enters the room, who says he has found a great way to promote Jagged's new album because he'll become a reality-show star. Penny continues on the phone, this time coming back inside the room. In the background, Fang runs out of the door with the ball, remaining unnoticed. Penny stops talking on the phone and approaches to Jagged, who asks her if she remembers to order macarons for Fang.

title: Troublemaker
text:
Troublemaker - Plot
After a while, there is a knock at the door, which causes Penny to leave Jagged Stone and Bob, who are starting to talk about the performance on the TV. André Bourgeois stood at the door one hand holding Fang’s leash, saying that Fang can't run freely around the hotel, then hands back the crocodile. The phone rings again and Penny answers it, she was telling someone about an airplane trip for Jagged. At the same time, she apologizes to the mayor and goes to Jagged, who throws the ball at Bob, because he didn't like the idea of performing in the "Rocko Wants a Wife" program. Again there is a knock on the door and the telephone rings. Jean is standing in the doorway again, asking Penny, who answers him at the same time holding the phone to her ear. She closes the door and goes to Jagged and Bob again, who are arguing with each other. Penny decides to tell Jagged about her idea to resolve the conflict. Jagged consents to its implementation. He thanks Penny and gives her a kiss on the cheek.

title: Troublemaker
text:
Troublemaker - Plot
Outside the bakery Tom and Sabine gathered a crowd of Jagged's fans. Inside, the recording of the "Fill My Shoes" live program with Jagged and Tom begins. Sabine, after giving Bob a croissant, starts talking to Marinette to make sure that the organization of a television program in a bakery is a good idea. Marinette responds that it is good for the bakery, and her dad will become a celebrity. Sabine states that Tom looks quite nervous. In the same time, Tikki is watching the show in Marinette's room. After a while, Tom instructs Jagged how to roll the dough. Penny is very nervous about the whole situation, and Marinette points out on it. The girl asks if everything is all right, and Penny replies that the idea of the show was hers, and Jagged trusted her and she just hoped that everything would be fine. At the time, Alec asks Jagged what it's like to be in the baker's shoes today.

title: Troublemaker
text:
Troublemaker - Plot
Jagged says enthusiastically that he's great and begins to pretend to play the guitar made of various pastries. After a moment, Sabine asks Penny how it is to work with a star like Jagged. Penny is very flattering talking about Jagged, but right after that, it improves, speaking that more neutrally. The whole show is watched by Adrien in his room together with Plagg. He asks what is interesting in watching that, and Adrien says the program takes place at Marinette's. In the bakery, Jagged and Tom are singing together, where Jagged also proposes Marinette to join. When Adrien notices her on TV, begins to very smile. Jagged starts telling the audience how talented Marinette is, mentioning the cover she made for his album, being just a student at school making Alec impressed by the girl's skills. After a moment, he asks Tom what he'll be preparing today. Tom says he'll make chocolate croissants. He also asks Marinette to hand him a sack of flour. Marinette, wanting to take a sack, accidentally makes the flour spill on Jagged's head. This makes him start laughing and pretending to be a ghost.

title: Troublemaker
text:
Troublemaker - Plot
Alec announces a break and Marinette seizes the opportunity to apologize to Jagged, but he tells her that nothing is wrong. Penny asks Marinette, where is the bathroom and after hearing "upstairs", she goes there with Jagged. In the meantime, Tom and Marinette decide to clean up the flour.
While looking for the bathroom, Jagged and Penny wind up in Marinette's room. Curious, Jagged begins looking around while Penny attempts to clean the flour off him. Meanwhile back in the bakery, Bob comments on how well the ratings of the show are when the camera crew informs them that they'll be back on the air soon. Alec wonders where Jagged is, to which Marinette tells him the bathroom upstairs. Alec, Bob, and the camera crew head up there.

title: Troublemaker
text:
Troublemaker - Plot
Jagged continues to look around Marinette's room while Penny tries to clean the flour off him. The camera crew suddenly arrives and the show continues just as Jagged is admiring Marinette's multiple photos of Adrien. He comments on them and says that Marinette clearly has a crush on Adrien. Adrien is surprised while Plagg refers to Marinette as another secret admirer. Marinette also sees this and, horrified, runs upstairs to her room. On the way, Tikki tells her to calm down as it is not a big deal, but Marinette says that it is because she told the whole school, including Adrien, to watch the show and if Adrien sees all those photos, he'll figure out that she has a crush on him. Tikki asks Marinette if that's what she wants, to which Marinette says no, at least not that way.

title: Troublemaker
text:
Troublemaker - Plot
Marinette bursts into her room and demands to know why everyone is in there, to which Penny frantically apologizes, saying that she couldn't find the bathroom. Jagged offers to sign Marinette's poster of him, but Marinette says that she just wants everyone to leave and tells Penny to do something. Penny begins to shove Bob out but accidentally steps on the cable, cutting everyone off the air. Penny prepares to replug the cable, but Marinette tells her to get everyone out first. However, Alec tells her to give him the cable as they are live. Jagged also begins sneezing and asks Penny if the flour on him is organic as he is allergic to non-organic flour. Alec once again tells Penny to give him the cable while Bob yells at her that they don't have a picture. Everyone shouting at her at once causes Penny to become so stressed that she eventually yells at everyone and shoves them all out. Bob asks what they're going to do now, to which Penny angrily says that she'll meet them downstairs in five minutes before slamming the door.

title: Troublemaker
text:
Troublemaker - Plot
Hawk Moth senses Penny's stress and sends an akuma after her, which infects her pen. Hawk Moth tells her that from now on, instead of solving people's problems, she'll create them. Penny agrees and is transformed into Troublemaker. Meanwhile back in Marinette's room, Marinette repeatedly comments on the whole situation being a disaster. Tikki tries to assure Marinette that it'll be okay but points out that the show is live, which only makes Marinette freak out more.
Alec begins the countdown to restart the show; however, Tom and Sabine say that they'd rather not continue.
Bob is baffled at to why, to which Sabine explains that they aren't comfortable with the cameras going everywhere and invading their privacy, pointing out how Marinette is upset now because of their show.
Bob refuses to allow this, commenting on how the show's ratings are sky high.
Suddenly, Troublemaker sneaks behind Sabine and tickles her back with her fingers.
Sabine doesn't see her and quickly assumes that it was Bob who did it, demanding that he apologize.
Troublemaker then hits Bob's bottom with a guitar and throws it into Tom's hands before she can see seen, causing Bob to think Tom hit him.

title: Troublemaker
text:
Troublemaker - Plot
Marinette sees all the commotion through her computer screen and is perplexed.
Troublemaker also puts a bag of flour over Jagged's head and pushes Alec towards him.
She then turns on the bakery's self-defense system, causing Bob question if the bakery is haunted.
Troublemaker then shows up and, putting her arm around Jagged, says hello to him.
Jagged fearfully backs away from her and calls out for Penny, but Troublemaker says that Penny is no longer around to solve problems and from now on, she'll be creating them.
The fans of Jagged Stone who are outside the bakery run away in fear while Tikki comments on how Penny's efforts to please everyone caused her to become akumatized.
Marinette agrees that filming the show in the bakery was a bad idea and transforms into Ladybug.
Adrien also sees Troublemaker on his TV and tells Plagg that he's got to transform.
Plagg asks him to bring him some baked goods while he's at the bakery.
Adrien jokingly calls Plagg a floating stomach before transforming into Cat Noir.

title: Troublemaker
text:
Troublemaker - Plot
Troublemaker continues to cause trouble at the bakery while Nadja Chamack reports on a new supervillain in Dupain-Cheng bakery. Cat Noir then shows up and promises to take care of everything before attempting to break in. Troublemaker hears this and goes outside. Cat Noir prepares to use Cataclysm on the bakery door but is stopped by Troublemaker, who says that no one will be rescued today before throwing him against a news van. Ladybug grabs Cat Noir's leg with her yo-yo and pulls him on top of Marinette's balcony.

title: Troublemaker
text:
Troublemaker - Plot
As Troublemaker begins to make a mess of Marinette's room, Ladybug and Cat Noir sneak behind her, though Cat Noir gets momentarily distracted by the photos of Adrien on the walls until Ladybug tells him that they can take a tour later. Troublemaker spots them and throws several sewing needles at them, but Cat Noit blocks this attack with Marinette's mattress. Seeing more photos of Adrien underneath, Ladybug pushes the mattress back down before Cat Noir spots them, causing him to fall forwards. As they battle Troublemaker, they discover that whenever she clicks her pen, she can make her entire body intangible. Troublemaker uses this ability to sneak behind Ladybug and almost manages to grab her earrings, but Cat Noir uses his staff to prevent that from happening. Troublemaker drops her pen, which Ladybug realizes is where the akuma is. She and Cat Noir attempt to grab it, but Troublemaker reaches it first and uses it to slip away. Cat Noir wonders how they are going to defeat a villain they cannot touch. Ladybug points out that Troublemaker's strength is also her weakness, as she must become touchable in order to steal their Miraculouses.
The heroes go downstairs.

title: Troublemaker
text:
Troublemaker - Plot
Ladybug warns Cat Noir to be careful as Troublemaker is probably hiding nearby and also reminds him that she must become touchable if she wants to take their Miraculouses.
Troublemaker suddenly arrives and attacks the duo.
She nearly grabs Cat Noir's Miraculous but is stopped by Ladybug, who she then attacks instead.
She manages to pin her down and take an earring, proclaiming that she's already lost half the battle.
Ladybug slowly begins to detransform as Hawk Moth praises Troublemaker.
Seeing this, Cat Noir calls on his Cataclysm and then charges towards Troublemaker, who makes herself untouchable.
However, she winds up dropping Ladybug's Miraculous as a result.
Ladybug grabs the earring and puts it back on before she can fully detransform.
Cat Noir comments on the close call, stating that's not how he dreamed that they'd share their secret identities.
Ladybug says that'll have to wait until Troublemaker and Hawk Moth are both defeated.
She then calls on her Lucky Charm and receives a broken plate.
However, she doesn't see what to do with it.
Cat Noir believes that losing an earring weakened Ladybug's power, but Ladybug refuses to believe this and looks around for clues.

title: Troublemaker
text:
Troublemaker - Plot
She spots a tube of super glue and quickly forms a plan.
The duo head back to Marinette's room.
Ladybug pretends to be scared and tells Cat Noir that Troublemaker can come from anywhere to grab her Miraculous.
However, the duo don't see her, so Cat Noir decides to check the roof even though Ladybug begs him not to, stating that she only has a plate to defend herself with.
Troublemaker then shows up and attacks Ladybug, who throws the plate against the wall before Troublemaker pins her down.
She prepares to grab her Miraculous but soon finds that they are super-glued to her ears and that she's now stuck.
Cat Noir then comes back and grabs Troublemaker's pen with his Cataclysm, destroying it and freeing the akuma, turning Troublemaker back into Penny.
Ladybug captures the akuma and uses Miraculous Ladybug to fix the damage.
Penny is confused as to what just happened and asks where Jagged is.
However, Ladybug tells her that she's always worrying about others and should worry about herself for once, asking how she's feeling.
Penny tells Ladybug that she's fine.
Seeing that her transformation is almost up, Ladybug heads up to the balcony and Cat Noir follows behind her.

title: Troublemaker
text:
Troublemaker - Plot
Before taking off, Ladybug jokingly tells Cat Noir that he won't be finding out her secret identity today.
Cat Noir says that he already knows who she is, which worries her for a moment before he calls her the girl of his dreams.
Ladybug laughs at his silliness and fist-bumps with him.
The duo then take off, though Ladybug comes back a second later and detransforms.
Marinette heads back to the bakery and hugs her parents, who are relieved to see her safe. Marinette assures them that she'd just locked herself in the bathroom. Penny then arrives and awkwardly greets everyone, who are all happy to see her. Jagged even hugs Penny out of relief that she's back.

title: Troublemaker
text:
Troublemaker - Plot
The next day, as Marinette heads to school, she tells Tikki that she'll never let her parents shoot a TV show at her house again and decides to lay on the low for a while until everyone forgets about it. She avoids all of her classmates and sneaks into the locker room, where she then puts her backpack inside her locker and sighs with relief that no one saw her. However, the moment she slams her locker shut, she spots Adrien waiting for her from behind, much to her horror. Panicked, she tries to explain that the reason she has so many photos of him is because she is a mere fan. Though Adrien doesn't exactly buy it, he goes along with the explanation and even invites Marinette to his next photoshoot. He also tells her that he's glad to have her as one of his fans before leaving. Marinette expresses her joy over getting an invite to Adrien's photoshoot, to which Tikki also jokingly adds that Marinette managed to let out some normal sentences. Marinette insists that's not funny. Tikki agrees and the two laugh before the end card appears.

title: Troublemaker
text:
Troublemaker - Plot Developments
In this episode, it is revealed that Penny has a crush on Jagged Stone.
This episode also reveals that Jagged Stone is allergic to non-organic flour, which causes him to sneeze.
This is the first time Ladybug's Lucky Charm object is a broken object.
Upon seeing it, Cat Noir suggested that when Ladybug lost an earring it weakened her powers but it's unknown if that is completely true.
Plus his suggestion could also be from his memory as up until this episode Cat Noir never saw Ladybug conjure a broken lucky charm object.
Following "The Dark Owl", this episode starts the exploration for Miraculouses that function as multiple pieces but since then no other facts or progress has been made yet.

title: Troublemaker
text:
Troublemaker - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in Spain on Disney Channel.
This episode was originally supposed to air on May 27th, 2018 in Portugal after "Reverser", but didn't due to a sudden change of schedule.
In the French version, the episode is called "L'Insaisissable".
Some of the English cast read through a part of this episode at a panel at San Diego Comic-Con 2017.
The script for this episode was later changed when the episode officially premiered in Spain.
This episode shares a lot of seconds:
Where Alya doesn't have a speaking role despite being present following"The Collector".
That Adrien went to check on Marinette after she was attacked by an akumatized villain since "Evillustrator".
That doesn't have a new character from Season 2, following "The Collector".
A supervillian de-transformed back into their previous civilian identity before Ladybug captures the released akuma and restoring everything back.
Where one of Ladybug's earrings is taken by force, following "The Dark Owl".
The third time where a Miraculous is seen being forced off following "Lady Wifi" and "The Dark Owl".
References

title: Troublemaker
text:
Troublemaker - Trivia
This episode also reveals that Tom and Sabine's bakery has a high-security defense system.
This is the fifth time that a high-security defense system is shown being set into action, following the Louvre's from "Copycat", "The Pharaoh" and "Riposte", and the Agreste mansion's from "Simon Says".
Some of the pictures of Adrien on Marinette's wall have been previously seen in the episodes "Santa Claws", "Mr. Pigeon", "Gamer", "Gorizilla", "Pixelator", "Copycat", "Stormy Weather" and "The Bubbler". Her wall also has the class pictures from "Reflekta".
The album cover Marinette designs for Jagged Stone in "Guitar Villain" is referenced.
In the SDCC cast read-through, the shades that Marinette makes for Jagged in "Pixelator" were also referenced.
Adrien discovers by watching Fill My Shoes that Marinette has many pictures of him in her room. The previous time Adrien had seen her room in "Gamer", where Marinette had hidden them beforehand.
This is the fourth time Cat Noir uses his Cataclysm to destroy an akumatized object.

title: Troublemaker
text:
Troublemaker - Trivia
As Adrien offered Marinette to go to one of his photoshoots, it may be implied that this episode is before "Style Queen". However, since the fashion show in "Style Queen" may be the same one as the one mentioned in the design contest in "Mr. Pigeon" where Adrien would model the winning design, he is probably thinking of a different photoshoot.
This is the fourth time, Cat Noir attempted to use his powers on someone else but unlike "Dark Cupid", "Princess Fragrance", and "Despair Bear" it was of his own will for the first time. Seeing Ladybug in her current situation and aware of rules of secret identities he used it to protect her identity from being seen by Troublemaker and by extension Hawk Moth.
Meaning that the heroes are likely aware that Hawk Moth can see through the eyes of his minions.
If Cat Noir's Cataclysm had connected, similar to the protective abilities of a Miraculous transformation, Troublemaker would've been severely injured but still alive.

title: Troublemaker
text:
Troublemaker - Trivia
If the direction of where Cat Noir aimed his Cataclysm is observed closer if Troublemaker hadn't gone intangible most likely his power would've hit the side of her head similar to what almost happened to Ladybug in "Despair Bear".
This is third time where an akumatized object resembles Ladybug's Lucky Charm object from a previous episode the pen in "The Dark Owl". Following the cameras and mirrors in "Pixelator" and "Reflekta".

Rocker Wants a Wife is a parody of a reality TV show Farmer Wants a Wife.

title: Trixx/History
text:
Trixx/History - Intro
Trixx is the kwami connected to the Fox Miraculous, where he is currently with Alya Césaire to transform into Rena Rouge after Ladybug managed to recover all the miraculouses from Gabriel Agreste.

title: Trixx/History
text:
Trixx/History - Before [[Season 1]]
When the concept of Illusion came into existence, Trixx came into existence. Before the Miraculous jewels were created, Trixx and the other kwamis traveled all over the universe unable to interact with humans. Then, thousands of years ago, a mage created the Miraculouses. Trixx started out with the Húlí in China and later in Germany. When his Miraculous was not being worn, Trixx was dormant in the Fox Miraculous, which was stored inside the Miracle Box.
At some point in the past, Trixx used his power, creating the Loch Ness Monster.

title: Trixx/History
text:
Trixx/History - Season 1
During Season 1, Trixx was dormant in the Fox Miraculous.

title: Trixx/History
text:
Trixx/History - [[Season 2]]
During season 2, Trixx was dormant in the Fox Miraculous.
In "Sapotis," Trixx came out of the Fox Miraculous when it was temporarily given to Alya by Ladybug. He was impressed by her wielder's observations and transformed Alya into Rena Rouge. With help from his Miraculous power of illusion, Ladybug, Cat Noir, and Rena Rouge defeated the Sapotis and returned Alya's sisters to normal. With the mission over, when he noticed that Alya was hesitant to return the Fox Miraculous, he agreed that they made a great team but also reminded Alya of her heroic qualities, including trustworthiness. Alya gave back the Fox Miraculous to Ladybug with Trixx dormant in it again, and Marinette returned it to Master Fu.
In "Syren", Trixx transformed Alya into Rena Rouge and assisted Ladybug and Cat Noir with catching a pair of runaway panthers. Afterwards, Trixx returned to the Fox Miraculous and it was returned to Master Fu yet again.

title: Trixx/History
text:
Trixx/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Sandboy", Trixx was celebrating Nooroo's birthday in the Miraculous Box with the others kwamis and was excited when Tikki and Plagg arrived. The kwami marveled at the gift Tikki brought and thought it was a paintbrush and played with the other kwamis. When the time came to find Nooroo, he and the others got into position but in an effort to contact him they contacted his wielder instead. Hearing his voice made him shutter at the thought of being his slave and to prevent being discovered, they all cut off the connection. But realized if they contacted Nooroo's wielder then someone must have been akumatized and the danger Tikki's and Plagg's wielders are in.
During "Catalyst", when Scarlet Moth unleashed an army of akumatized villains on the city, Trixx and his Miraculous were retrieved by Ladybug which was then given to Alya. Upon briefly meeting Nino, Trixx informed him that superheroes must keep their identities a secret before Alya transforming into Rena Rouge.

title: Trixx/History
text:
Trixx/History - [[Season 3]]
During season 3, Trixx was dormant in the Fox Miraculous.
In "Miraculer", Trixx was once again given to Alya by Ladybug to help her and Cat Noir fight Destroyer. Once the villain was defeated, he was returned to Master Fu. Trixx's Miraculous was subsequently loaned out again when Sabrina was akumatized into Miraculer and Mayura entered the fray. With the whole team, they were able to defeat Miraculer and stop Mayura from taking the Bee Miraculous. Afterwards, Trixx was returned to Master Fu again.
In "Kwamibuster", he was activated along with his kwami brothers and sisters to help Multimouse enact her plan of rescuing Tikki and Plagg. By fusing his powers with a Multimouse clone they became Multifox. During the confrontation, Trixx was one of the few kwamis to avoid capture. After Kwamibuster's defeat and ending the illusion, Trixx and others cheered for Marinette as their plan was a success and was returned to Miracle Box.

title: Trixx/History
text:
Trixx/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Miracle Queen", Trixx was activated by a possessed Alya transforming her into Rena Rouge and his powers were used against the heroes until they managed to deakumatize the titular villain. After Hawk Moth and Mayura fled and the role of guardian was passed to Ladybug, Trixx and his Miraculous were retrieved and placed in the Miracle Box.

title: Trixx/History
text:
Trixx/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Truth", Trixx was accidentally released from the Miracle Box when Marinette tried to figure it out, he was reading Marinette's diary until she hid it away. During a video call on Marinette's computer, he was fascinated more so that he got to see Alya again and hearing Daizzi express his desire to have Alya as an owner. Trixx says she's already taken and when Marinette leaves for her with Luka, he and the other kwamis hid with the Miracle Box, but they heard the titular villain break into Marinette's room but were saved by Ladybug.
After the titular villain's defeat, Trixx and the others saw that Marinette was sad about breaking up with Luka to the point of tears, he didn't know exactly how to help but joined with the other kwamis in giving their new guardian a group hug.
In "Lies", Trixx was seen in Marinette's room.

title: Trixx/History
text:
Trixx/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Gang of Secrets", Trixx was seen talking with some of his fellow kwamis until Marinette arrives home. Later, seeing that there was something wrong with Marinette, he decided to intervene by suggesting that she talk to her friends and convinced her to detransform so Tikki could have a break. He and the others hear Marinette voiced her distress about being condemned to a life of secrets and lies forever because of her alter ego when they hear someone coming, the kwamis hide in the Miracle Box. After hearing Marinette push her friends away resulting them being turned into the titular villains, with no choice Trixx used his powers of Mirage to protect them, before Ladybug left to confront them, she voiced concerns about the after effects and yet Trixx eased her worry. However, when Barkk and Wayzz looked unconvinced, he told them there wasn't much damage when his powers were used hoping that Ladybug will be able to reverse it.

title: Trixx/History
text:
Trixx/History - [[Season 4]]
When Alya broke free from Shadow Moth's akumatization, Trixx was happy to see her once more transforming into Rena Rouge using another illusion of Marinette to lure Timebreaker into a trap. After the Gang of Secrets had been defeated, Trixx was returned to his Miraculous later, he and the others look on as Marinette unveils her secret to Alya.
In "Mr. Pigeon 72", seeing Marinette work so tirelessly to the point of frustration, Trixx asks Alya for help.
In "Furious Fu", hearing that Master Fu was returning, Trixx along with his fellow kwamis expressed dear desire to see him despite Marinette trying to keep them hidden for their safety and when Marinette voiced concerns about leaving the Miracle Box unguarded. Trixx realized if someone stayed to guard the box, the others could go but when they cheated their way out so all of them can go, they were stopped by Marinette, with no choice they used the "puppy dog eyes" on her and Marinette reluctantly agreed. However Trixx and the other kwamis had a hard time keeping quiet while in Marinette's bag but heard that Master Fu is doing well and become a great painter.

title: Trixx/History
text:
Trixx/History - [[Season 4]]
But returning home, Trixx realized that Su-Han had returned to reclaim the box as he was the previous guardian before Master Fu's incident and with Su-Han's strictness, he and his fellow kwamis sadly returned to the box. After seeing Ladybug's valiant actions against the titular villain, Su-Han realized that Master Fu's choice wasn't so bad allowing Trixx and his fellow kwamis to stay with Marinette.
In "Sole Crusher", he heard Marinette voice concern about Zoe's earlier behavior.
In "Queen Banana", Trixx watched with Fluff as Marinette was adding the finishing on her costumes for a class movie project.
In "Crocoduel", Trixx was in Marinette's room, as Alya tried to convince Marinette to come to the Couffaine's birthday party and make up with Luka.

title: Trixx/History
text:
Trixx/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Optigami", seeing Marinette with a stunned face, Alya explained that Marinette was excited because she got an invite to Audrey's fashion event; the same one Adrien was going to receive an award. Soon the other kwamis were excited to go too but was reminded by Marinette, no owner, no leaving, aware that Alya was his owner, Trixx thought he could go and even agreed with Alya about becoming a permanent holder but Marinette was hesitant from doing so.

title: Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1)
text:
Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1) - Intro
"" is a season 5 episode of the series Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. Based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 10th written and produced episode of season 5. It is also the 114th written and produced episode of the series overall.

title: Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1)
text:
Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1) - Synopsis
It's the same thing every time. Be it as Marinette and Adrien or as Ladybug and Cat Noir, our heroes' secret identities always prevent them from having a romance. Tikki and Plagg are sorry to see their holders so sad to have to give up on their feelings. So, the kwamis make a drastic choice that will change many things in Paris…
Disney+
The kwamis make a choice that will transform Paris.
Netflix
Seeing their holders despondent over their impossible love, the Kwamis make a radical decision. Now Marinette and Adrien must confront a huge change.

title: Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1)
text:
Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1) - Plot
Marinette lies on her bed in her room; her windows are covered with curtains, making the room almost completely dark, and her photos of Adrien are in the trash. Sabine enters her daughter's room attempting to get her to go to school. As it turns out, Marinette, depressed about her love life, doesn't feel like going. When Sabine leaves, Tikki tells Marinette she can't stay in her room forever. Marinette tries to give Tikki her Miraculous, which Tikki refuses. Marinette laments about her perceived failed romances. Tikki tries to cheer her up to no avail.
Adrien goes to Marinette's house to give her her homework, and also tries to cheer her up, worrying Plagg that they might fall in love and reveal their identities. Meanwhile, Miss Bustier's class is having a party over Adrien and Marinette being inevitable, or so they think. Zoé is skeptical. During this, Alya constantly receives calls from her sister Nora which she declines to answer. Meanwhile, a dejected Marinette rejects Adrien's help. Adrien leaves Marinette's room; now, both of them are depressed.

title: Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1)
text:
Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1) - Plot
Monarch senses Adrien's sadness and attempts to akumatize him. However, he hesitates, realizing that Adrien doesn't have an Alliance. Tikki and Plagg can't bear to see their holders in so much pain, so they decide to re-assign their Miraculous and bid their holders goodbye.
Back at Françoise Dupont, due to Zoé's concern, Nino calls Adrien, who is now at home in his room, crying in the darkness. Adrien asks Nathalie to pick up his phone for him; Nathalie tells Nino that Adrien doesn't feel like talking, making everyone sad. Gabriel then comes to Adrien's room, to which Nathalie warns him not to take advantage of Adrien's misfortune. Gabriel does not heed this warning and gives Adrien an Alliance, which Adrien takes off immediately after his father leaves. Tikki and Plagg take their Miraculouses, freeing Marinette and Adrien of their despair. Monarch attempts to akumatize Adrien, but Adrien feels better as he realizes he can go back over to Marinette's house and make amends. Marinette also realizes her newfound freedom and takes her photos of Adrien out of the trash. Monarch swiftly finds another target - one who has not one, but five Alliances.

title: Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1)
text:
Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1) - Plot
Adrien runs over to Marinette's house and find her putting her picture's of Adrien back up.
Marinette apologizes for her dower demeanor toward Adrien.
Marinette tries to tell Adrien she loves him, but struggles to do so.
Adrien comes up with an idea to help: he gets her to raise her right hand for "yes" and her left hand for "no".
Marinette answers Adrien's questions regarding her feelings for him, and he gives Marinette her homework.
Back at Françoise Dupont, most of Miss Bustier's class and Marc try to formulate a plan to save Marinette and Adrien's love, which is interrupted by Alya getting another call from Nora, which she answers.
Nora tells Alya she humiliated fellow kickboxer Kouki to his friends and humiliated him on social media, and that she needed advice on how to handle the situation.
Meanwhile, Tikki and Plagg are also at the school to select their new holders.
When Tikki chooses Alya, Plagg is going to choose Nino, but when he finds out Nino is in love with Alya, he aborts, figuring the same situation with their previous holders would occur.
Zoé speaks up, suggesting they should talk to Adrien and Marinette before they make a plan, and leaves for Marinette's house.

title: Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1)
text:
Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1) - Plot
This prompts Plagg to choose her as his Miraculous' holder.
The akumatized Kouki, Kikou, now has Voyage, Clout, Shell-ter, and Resistance, and attacks Paris.
The nearby Marinette and Adrien, hearing the destruction go up to Marinette's balcony, realize it's not their responsibility to protect Paris anymore, so they wait for the threat to be over.
Kikou, now at Les Olympiades, continues his destruction of Paris.
Alya, now Scarabella once again, and Zoé, now the heroine Kitty Noire, appear on scene; they have no time to introduce themselves, as they need to fight Kouki.
Kitty Noire tries to Cataclysm Kikou's Shell-ter, but Kikou's Resistance prevents his Shell-ter from being broken.
Monarch transfers Kikou his fifth and final Miraculous power: Multitude.
Kikou uses it to multiply into three slightly smaller clones of himself.
Scarabella summons her Lucky Charm and receives a towel.
Scarabella explains her plan to Kitty Noire, who runs off to execute her part, while Scarabella distracts Kikou and dodges his attacks.
Kitty Noire gathers fire fighters, their truck, and buckets of blue paint from Socqueline's family's art shop.

title: Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1)
text:
Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1) - Plot
The firefighters fill their truck with blue paint and give Kitty Noire the hose.
She fills the Lucky Charm towel tied to her staff with the paint, dumping it on an unsuspecting Kikou, blinding him.
He drops his Shell-ter, giving Scarabella the opening she needs to break his headgear with her yo-yo.
Scarabella captures and purifies Kikou's Megakuma, reverting him back to Kouki.
Nora appears on the scene and argues with Kouki.
Scarabella advises the two to keep their emotions in check while communicating, to which they agree to.
Scarbella summons her Miraculous Scarabella and repairs the damage.
Now rest assured that the new holders of their Miraculouses can handle future akumatizations just fine, Adrien and Marinette exchange smiles as the damage is repaired.
Monarch's Alliance informs him of superhuman activity on two Alliances: Alya's and Zoé's. He smiles with a wicked grin and laughs, ready to attack the new Miraculous holders.

title: Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1)
text:
Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1) - Plot developments
This is the first episode where Marinette doesn't transform into Ladybug, with the superhero only appearing on flashback. This is also the first episode where neither Ladybug nor Cat Noir appear in present time, being it together or by themselves. It's also so far the only episode not to feature an appearance from either Ladybug or Cat Noir.
This episode also marks the third time Adrien does not transform into Cat Noir, following "Style Queen", "Mr. Pigeon 72", and the preceding "Emotion" and "Conformation".
After hearing that Marinette was not picking up her friends' call after missing classes, Chloé comments how that reminded her of the time Marinette asked her for permission to come to school. This is a reference to how she used to be a doormat to Chloé's bullying behavior towards her before getting the Ladybug Miraculous and becoming Ladybug.
This is the first and only time when the destination of Monarch's Voyage portals is seen.
Kikou is the second character to get akumatized for the first time in season 5 following Véronique in "Determination".

title: Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1)
text:
Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1) - Plot developments
His akumatization is not shown, making this the nineteenth time this happens, after Magician of Misfortune in "Princess Fragrance", Vanisher in "Antibug", the Unnamed boy in "Sandboy", August akumatization in "Weredad", Alya and Nino's akumatization in "Oblivio", Vivica in "Desperada", the current Chris in "Christmaster", the teeenage Chris in "Timetagger", Mr. Pigeon akumatization in "Truth" and "Lies", the two akumatizations of André in "Glaciator 2", Moolak, Syren and The Mime's akumatizations in "Ephemeral", Gigantitan and Rogercop's akumatizations in "Kuro Neko", and Tomoe's akumatization in "Multiplication".
As of Plagg, picking Zoé to be his new wielder, she becomes the second female to wield the Cat Miraculous, following Lady Noire.
With her being called Kitty Noire, Zoé unknowingly named herself after Cat Noir's nickname, being called that by Bunnyx in "Timetagger".
However, Zoé's name is spelled with an "e" because the adjective is feminine.
Similar to Marinette being the first female overall to wield the Cat Miraculous, Zoé became the first known American female Cat Miraculous holder.

title: Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1)
text:
Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1) - Plot developments
Adrien was shown to have knowledge about Scarabella to Marinette before she gave her formal introduction in the following episode. This should have been a mistake on his part, since the only ones who knew her were Marinette herself, Cat Noir, Gabriel/Shadow Moth and Markov, so this way Marinette could have discovered that Cat Noir was Adrien.
Yet, at the same time it's likely not a mistake, because Alya had to be the Ladybug Miraculous holder for one weekend and it's doubtful that Shadow Moth would just give up after Markov unable to resist fresh meat, and thanks to that, news probably got around that Scarabella will be the temporary Ladybug until Marinette came back and knowing how Marinette is she was probably up to date about Paris' whereabouts.
This is the episode where Adrien ended his friendship with Lila but this all happened off-screen. She told Kagami about this in "Protection". And as of "Confrontation", she now decides to dismantle/breakup his relationship with Marinette as revenge.
This episode also marks the third time Adrien does not transform into Cat Noir, following "Style Queen", "Mr. Pigeon 72", and the preceding "Emotion" and "Conformation".

title: Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1)
text:
Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1) - Trivia
Originally, this episode was named "Passation".
The episode shares its name with the concept of the Butterfly Miraculous.
This episode explores a little bit more Monarch's new powers to transmit the powers of the other Miraculous. It's shown that an Alliance ring can only hold one power at the time and that the more rings one person has, the more powers Monarch is able to transmit.
The concept of transmission was applied in this episode besides through the superpower of Akumatization:
Tikki and Plagg take their respective Miraculous from Marinette and Adrien and redistribute them to other new holders: Alya Césaire and Zoé Lee respectively.
Monarch transmitted his megakuma from him to Kouki.
This is the first time Monarch is able to transmit more than one Miraculous power to an akumatized villain's Alliance without any other support, like Genesis.
The ability of Gabriel's Alliance ring to force the other rings to transmit information about their respective owners allowed him to discover the identities of Scarabella and Kitty Noire.
The concept of transmission was also applied in other episodes:

title: Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1)
text:
Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1) - Trivia
The Butterfly Miraculous represents that change and growth are intertwined, how people feel about changes and what they do about it, come in different sizes and how they can bring hope but also disaster if not careful.
Gabriel Agreste as the current and deceased Butterfly Miraculous holder, Hawk Moth then Monarch tried to use the power of the miraculouses to change his fate but tried to force it too much as well couldn't accept changes he didn't want or had no control over.
With Émilie's death, Gabriel and Adrien were both affected but Adrien changed his life for the better while he wouldn't.
If Gabriel had made the choice to ask for help and work hard to build everything back up then things would've changed for the better or what Betterfly had mentioned in "Miraculous Paris".
Like Chloé, he refused to change out of fear that going forward he wouldn't be able to control anything once the people or Adrien knew the truth or backwards knowing that he wouldn't have his family.
Gabriel saw the Ultimate power as his hope to return everything back to normal or get him what he wanted but he also twisted the hope people had for their dreams and desires by akumatizing victims into villains.

title: Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1)
text:

Like how when someone start out with things when they're young so they can grow with the maturity to handle it as they grow Hawk Moth in "Evolution".
Mentioned by Roland in "Simpleman" and Marinette in "Family" and "Gang of Secrets" how they were fearful of change.
Chloé who refused to change out of fear of losing her privileges but for her father and sister by ridding themselves of status and power they changed themselves for the better. Despite that there were many that gave Chloé chances in the hope she'd change but were let down.
Like Shadybug and Claw Noir as they were afraid to change worried that there would be nothing for them if they went back except pain, suffering and no love.
As well as the Supreme twisting the hope Shadybug and Claw Noir had for themselves nor their desires and the alternate heroes new suits symbolizes the growth and change for their new lives and hope they have for their world.
As Ladybug, Cat Noir and their team were the hope for Paris' freedom but when Félix stole the jewels, he diminished the hope the heroes had for it.
Betterfly was looking for the heroes to help him return hope to his world while he returned it renewing the duo's confidence.

title: Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1)
text:
Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1) - Trivia
When Cat Noir slowly began to realize he couldn't have Ladybug's love he didn't want the other thing she gave him to change their companionship and went to great lengths to keep or get it.
According to Max, it has been 286 days, or a bit over nine months and 12 days, since Adrien started school and when Ladybug and Cat Noir began their first adventure.
If so, and since French school years begins on early September, then that would put the current date somewhere between the middle and the end of June.
As well as Bunnyx beginning her adventures through time, most likely she would've been gone for a few weeks.
And this causes many inconsistencies about the timeline, because in season 1 there was Christmas and Valentine's Day, in season 3 there was the summer holiday and in season 4 there was the King's Day, which was January 6th. So it is impossible that it has only been 9 months. It has been at least one and half years.
The reason for that inconsistency has to do with the fact that season 1 served as a way to test the viability of the series, so the timeline was scrambled as a result, a consequence that remained in the subsequent seasons.

title: Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1)
text:
Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1) - Trivia
Similar to Jeanne d'Arc and Dark Grimalkin, Marinette and Adrien abdicated their jewels in the name of love but unlike their predecessors and Alya in "Strikeback" who did it by their own choosing their kwamis did it for them.
Zoé is the sixth member of the French Miraculous superhero team to use another Miraculous. The first is Marinette with the Mouse, Fox, Cat, Dragon, Bee, Horse and Rabbit Miraculouses, the second is Adrien with the Ladybug, Snake and Rabbit Miraculouses, the third one is Master Fu with the Turtle and Peacock Miraculouses, the fourth one is Alya with the Ladybug Miraculous and the fifth one is Alix with the Dog Miraculous.
This is the eighth episode where someone who isn't Ladybug or Cat Noir breaks an object, following Rhythm in "Kuro Neko", Jagged Stone, Anarka, and Purple Tigress in "Crocoduel", Polymouse in "Mega Leech", Marianne Lenoir in "Furious Fu", Fang in "Lies" and Queen Bee, Rena Rouge and Carapace in "Mayura".
This is the third time Gabriel is seen listening for targets, after "Risk" and "Jubilation".

title: Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1)
text:
Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1) - Trivia
This is the ninth episode that features a post-credit scene, following "Miracle Queen", "Gabriel Agreste", "Optigami", "Sentibubbler", "Dearest Family", "Multiplication", "Jubilation" and "Illusion".
This is the twenty-fifth time where a Lucky Charm is an object that appeared in a previous episode. This time, it's the parachute that previously appeared in "Stoneheart" and "Kuro Neko".
But unlike the other times this one was not summoned by Ladybug but Scarabella, making this the second time a temporary Ladybug holder summoned an object that Ladybug created previously following Mister Bug creating a mirror in "Reflekdoll".
The scene of them giving their jewels back is parallel to when they first get them in "Ladybug and Cat Noir".
Like in "Glaciator 2", Monarch tries to akumatize Adrien only to stop upon realizing who he is. However, unlike before, Gabriel convinces his son to wear an Alliance Ring before he proceeds to akumatize him.
Unlike the last time, Gabriel did this because he was desperate enough to akumatize his own son, where he didn't saw benefit to do it, especially since he doesn't know Adrien is Cat Noir.

title: Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1)
text:
Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1) - Trivia
Plagg actually made the right choice to take back the Cat Miraculous, since if Adrien kept it Gabriel would have come very close to having his Miraculous, and had Adrien would still akumatized without it, it would have been pointless for Gabriel.
Errors
In the English dub, Max says that 286 days is nine months and twelve days, and in the Brazilian Portuguese dub, he says it's nine months and sixteen days. However, 286 days is actually nine months and thirteen days.
Scarabella's right pinky finger bent when she activated the yo-yo to purify the Megakuma.
When Monarch's face mask appears on Kikou's face, it is grey instead of blue.
Monarch uses Voyage to see Kouki's anger more clearly but when the Megakuma leaves, the other side of the portal is not visible.
When Kikou hits the buildings at Les Olympiades with Clout, they're already destroyed, even before Clout had touched them.
Alya's hands are not touching the water while washing them.
When Monarch touches Mullo's cage to take her power, she turns into a blue light beam instead of a pink one.

title: Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1)/Transcript
text:
Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1)/Transcript - Intro
[ Theme Song ]
Sabine: Marinette, you’re going to be really late!
Marinette: (groans from her bed) I don’t wanna go to school, Mom. I’m not feeling well.
(Sabine frowns at Marinette’s response and goes downstairs.)
Tom: So?
Sabine: She just needs some time. Why don’t you go bake her some chouquettes? I’m sure she would like that.
(Back in Marinette’s bedroom, Marinette is still seen on her bed under her blanket.)
Tikki: You can’t stay in your room forever.
(Marinette groans in reply.)
Tikki: What will you do if an akumatized villain shows up?
Marinette: (takes off her blanket off her face annoyingly and removes her earring) Just give my Miraculous to whoever you want, Tikki! (Tikki pushes Marinette’s hand with her earring back to her) They can never be as bad as I was. Nothing ever works out for me. Adrien? Never even started. Luka? Couldn’t work out. Cat Noir? Didn’t even get off the ground. I’m so pathetic!
Tikki: Of course not! You’re an amazing Ladybug!
(A montage of Ladybug fighting off akumatized villains like Sapotis, Party Crasher and Puppeteer is seen.)

title: Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1)/Transcript
text:
Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1)/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: But I am just a normal girl with a normal life. But there’s something about me that no one knows yet. I’m pathetic! (hides under her blanket)
Tikki: You’re overreacting, Marinette!
Marinette: (a tad furious) Really? Then, how come I lost the Miraculous I was entrusted with all because of love?? Love only ever causes problems. I’ll never fall in love again! Love is weak! And I can’t be sad about it; otherwise, I might get akumatized! (buries her head in her arms)
(Alya is seen calling Marinette’s phone.)
Tikki: It’s Alya, your best friend! She was a superhero once. She’ll know how to make you feel better!
Marinette: If I talk to her, she’ll catch my weakness. (hides under her blanket again)
(Marinette’s phone rings again, but this time, Adrien is the one calling her. Tikki cannot do anything but frown.)
Marinette’s voicemail: (feebly) Leave a message after the beep. Beeeeeep.
Adrien: She’s not picking up.
Chloé: Hah! That reminds me of the good old times when Dupain-Cheng had to ask for my permission to show up at school! (she and Sabrina share a mocking laugh)
Ms. Bustier: Alya, would you mind taking this homework to Marinette, please?

title: Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1)/Transcript
text:
Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1)/Transcript - Intro
Alya: Yes, Ms. Bustier, um— (Nino clears his throat) I… uh… can’t. Uh, busy. But maybe Adrien…?
(Alya and Nino grins at Adrien.)
Ms. Bustier: Adrien, would you mind taking this homework to Marinette, please?
Adrien: Yes, of course. (takes the folder from Ms. Bustier)
(Alya and Nino bump their fists together.)
Adrien: I’m sure Cat Noir’s the reason Marinette’s feeling bad.
Plagg: Uhh, you do know that you’re Cat Noir, right?
Adrien: I do, but Marinette doesn’t. She has no idea.
Plagg: Well, that’s what happens when superheroes flirt. Poor Marinette fell in love with Cat Noir and got her heart broken.
Adrien:  Yeah, that was terrible of me.
Plagg: It was.
(Adrien stops walking as he arrives in front of the bakery, smiling.)
Adrien: I have to do everything I can to cheer her up. Hide, Plagg!
Sabine: (off-screen) Someone here to see you, sweetheart.
Marinette: Tell Alya I’m contagious. She’ll catch my weakness.
Adrien: (off-screen) I caught it a while ago, Marinette, so I’m safe.
(Upon hearing Adrien’s voice, Marinette immediately gets up from her bed in shock.)
Marinette: Adrien?
(Sabine and Adrien are seen standing by her room’s trapdoor, smiling up at her.)

title: Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1)/Transcript
text:
Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1)/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: You should be at school.
Adrien: So should you, Marinette. Can I come in?
Marinette: Okay. (lies back on her bed)
(Sabine and Adrien nod to each other, leaving Marinette in his care and heads downstairs, closing the trap door. Adrien puts down his bag and sits on Marinette’s swivel chair.)
Adrien: Looks like you’re not doing too great. Can I help you?
Marinette: (groans) No one can help me because no one will ever truly know me.
(As Adrien and Marinette continue to converse, Tikki hollers at Plagg to fly towards her and hide behind the trash bin.)
Adrien: You know, not a lot of people know who I really am either. What people know of me is just an advertising image. But you and me? We could be different. If you wanted to, we could… really get to know each other.
Plagg: (to Tikki) No, they can’t really get to know each other! What’s he up to?
Marinette: I can’t let anyone love me... and I never will! Even if he were nice, sweet and generous, and handsome, and brave— even if he were you! (sits up on her bed and cries)
Adrien: I’m sure I can understand if you would… just explain things to me.
Plagg: (to Tikki) Oh, we have to step in!

title: Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1)/Transcript
text:
Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1)/Transcript - Intro
Tikki: We can’t! They can’t know that they’re Ladybug and Cat Noir.
Marinette: No one can understand what I’m going through!
Adrien: (stands up from the swivel chair) Marinette, you can tell me anything. Before anything else, I will always be your friend!

title: Tram
text:
Tram - Intro
The tram is a public transport system in the city of Paris. New lines have been opened by Mayor Caline Bustier.

title: Tram
text:
Tram - Appearance
Tram
The carriages of the Paris tram have different shades of green and a yellow line at the bottom, as well as a blue "M" logo reminiscent of the Métro, as well as a transparent roof that allows you to look at the sky. At the back there is an open platform, or rear balcony, surrounded by a golden railing that allows you to enjoy the open air, like on historic or tourist trams.
The interior of the carriages is very bright and the large windows offer an excellent view of the outside and even the sky. The interior itself is painted white and the seats, whether retractable or not, are yellow. There are also yellow handrails with round blue validation terminals. There are automatic doors on each side, allowing users to enter or exit from the right or left, depending on the type of station.
The interior is particularly large and features numerous control levers and buttons, as well as various speed and camera control screens, and a microphone to allow the driver to speak to passengers.
Stations and platforms

title: Tram
text:
Tram - Appearance
Paris tram stops are equipped with surface stations, on lateral or central platforms, with green-painted iron shelters and transparent glass roofs with rounded edges. Each shelter is equipped with several maps of the Paris tram lines and possible connections to the buses and the Métro, as well as two wooden benches and a white terminal for purchasing tickets. The name of the stop is indicated by four blue signs with stylised white capital letters.
The tramway generally runs on its own, independent site, which cannot be crossed by any other means of transport. Depending on the area, the streets may be planted with vegetation. Outside the dedicated lanes, the tramway runs on special tracks with rails inserted into the roadway or on the platform, especially at intersections with the normal lanes.
In addition, the absence of overhead lines indicates that the City of Paris has chosen to use a ground power system to provide the electricity needed to operate the trams.

title: Tram
text:
Tram - Trivia
In real-life Paris, only two tram lines run entirely within the city walls: lines 3a (Pont du Garigliano - Porte de Vincennes) and 3b (Porte de Vincennes - Porte Dauphine).
In "Sublimation", the tram lines were seen under construction.
In "The Illustrhater", the passage of the tram caused part of the Pont au Change to collapse. Fortunately, Rena Rouge and Carapace were able to intervene quickly and save all the passengers.
In reality, the Pont au Change is not designed to support the passage of a tram, especially due to the weight of the train and the vibrations caused by its passage.
This accident could reveal a lack of previous studies, as well as a lack of reinforcement of the bridge.

title: Tower Bridge
text:
Tower Bridge - Intro
The  is a bascule bridge in London that crosses the River Thames and connects the boroughs of Southwark and Tower Hamlets. It is one of the main symbols and tourist attractions of the English capital.

title: Tower Bridge
text:
Tower Bridge - Description
Built to a design by architect Horace Jones and inaugurated on June 30, 1894, the Tower Bridge is a 244-meter-long (800-foot) bridge. This highly sophisticated bascule bridge is in the Neo-Gothic style. It has two large, 65-meter-high metal-framed towers clad in Cornish granite and Isle of Portland stone, a rigid suspension system, a forecourt that opens to accommodate taller ships, and two parallel pedestrian bridges at the top.
Between the twin towers, the bridge can be raised to allow the passage of ships sailing on the Thames.
Located between the boroughs of Southwark and Tower Hamlets, Tower Bridge is one of London's most iconic landmarks. It is located near the Tower of London, from which it takes its name.
At night, the bridge is illuminated by numerous lights, including the multi-colored walkway.

title: Tower Bridge
text:
Tower Bridge - Trivia
During the London 2012 Summer Olympics, the Tower Bridge displayed the Olympic rings, as did the Eiffel Tower during the Paris 2024 Summer Olympics.
As seen in "Climatiqueen" and "Daddycop", Chloé shoots some of the videos she posts on Zoo for her community near the Tower Bridge.

title: Tower of London
text:
Tower of London - Intro
The  is a historic fortress located on the north bank of the River Thames, near the famous Tower Bridge, in London. The Crown Jewels are kept there and on public display.

title: Tower of London
text:
Tower of London - Trivia
The Tower of London has been a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1988.
The Fortress has had many uses throughout its history such as prison, armory, treasury, menagerie, royal mint and public archives.
During "Backwarder", Alix frightens Marinette by saying that she risks being locked up there.
In "Hack-San", the Dupain-Cheng family visited the Tower with Shu Yin Cheng and Marinette and Tom tried to get her imprisoned there.

title: Turtle Miraculous
text:
Turtle Miraculous - Intro
The  is a bracelet that, whenever Wayzz inhabits it, transforms the wearer into a turtle-themed superhero with the power of Protection.
To activate the bracelet, the user must speak the transformation phrase: "Shell On". To deactivate the bracelet, the user must speak the detransformation phrase: "Shell Off".
The bracelet is currently owned by Nino Lahiffe, who uses it to transform into Carapace. It was previously stored in the Chinese Miracle Box and only lent out to him when the situation required it. But, as of "Re-creation", he now posseses the Miraculous permanently.
It was previously used by Wang Fu, who used it to transform into Jade Turtle.

title: Turtle Miraculous
text:
Turtle Miraculous - Appearance
In general, the Turtle Miraculous is a bracelet that appears to have triangular carvings and shaped like a turtle, with a black string tied through holes in the turtle's head and tail to make a loop. In charged mode, when Wayzz inhabits it, the gem is dark green with five pale green triangular carvings on its shell, along with carvings on the edges of the shell. The underside of the bracelet is dark green with a pale green hexagon-shaped center. If a minor is using the miraculous, the bracelet starts running out of power, and it makes a beeping sound, and the pale green triangular carvings start turning dark green (one part is equivalent to one minute) that Nino (or another Turtle Miraculous holder) has left.
In Season 6 onwards, the turtle is jade, and the pale green hexagon-shaped center becomes a white hexagon with green lines forming the turtle's shell.
In its activated mode, it is completely black with pale green etches of where the carvings are supposed to be.
In Season 6 onwards, the jade turtle is absent.
In its camouflage mode, the bracelet changes color and form depending on whose possession it's in:

title: Turtle Miraculous
text:
Turtle Miraculous - Appearance
In the possession of Nino Lahiffe, it is fully pale green and the triangular carvings have black outlines.
In Season 6 onwards, it changes to a bracelet with a symmetrical design with geometric patterns: a central orange-yellow circle, flanked by green shapes resembling leaves or arrows on a black background with white edges.
When it was worn by Gabriel Agreste, it was a piece with triangular carvings and shaped like a turtle attached to a silver band with an indent in the front.
When it was worn Master Fu, it was completely green and had six triangular engravings.
As an akumatized object, it takes on a reddish color.
In its reforged ring form, it was a thick band with a circular surface, similar to the Cat Miraculous, inside of it was the symbol of the Turtle Miraculous which glowed green. It used to sit on the ring finger of Gabriel's right hand.

title: Turtle Miraculous
text:
Turtle Miraculous - Abilities
The Turtle Miraculous has the ability to transform its wielder into a turtle-themed superhero, granting its wielder incredible superhuman powers of speed, endurance, agility, stamina, and strength. It also makes the user nearly invulnerable.
Its special weapon is an unbreakable Shield, which can also be utilized as both a weapon, a communicator, and an object that can be used to breathe underwater. Its special superpower is named Shell-ter, which gives the user the ability to generate a massive, spherical green force field in order to obtain their goal, like defeating a villain. As long as the superpower isn't used by a minor, the wielder can remain transformed indefinitely. However, as soon as the superpower is used, the wielder loses power and the transformation wears off in about approximately five minutes. The bracelet also has the ability to give the wielder the costume they truly desire.
