title: Two parters
text:
Two parters - Intro
are specials composed of two back-to-back episodes which feature important and impactful story arcs. The episodes within two parters belong to a specific season, and because they are tightly connected, the first part always ends in a cliffhanger. The second part is always a direct continuation of the first one.
__TOC__
Note: To see additional information of each individual episode such as their trivia, transcripts, galleries, airdates, and credits, please visit their individual pages. This page is only a summarization of each 2-parter.

title: Two parters
text:
Two parters - The Origins Story
Information
Season: 1
Episodes: 2
Episode 22, "Ladybug & Cat Noir (Origins - Part 1)"
Episode 23, "Stoneheart (Origins - Part 2)"
Focus: The first ever introduction of Marinette and Adrien, meeting Master Fu, entrusting them both with Miraculouses, and Hawk Moth akumatizing Parisians.
Summarized TFOU Synopsis
TBA
Notes
Both episodes were the 22nd and 23rd episodes to be written and produced in season 1.
However, storyline-wise, they are chronologically the first and second episodes of season 1 and the series, overall. Both episodes introduce the new school year, Marinette and Adrien's first ever time meeting each other and becoming Ladybug and Cat Noir respectfully, as well as Hawk Moth's first time akumatizing Parisians and becoming the heroes' sworn enemy.
Despite them being the first two episodes chronologically, Thomas Astruc wants them to be watched after the series, as he thinks that it's more interesting that way.

title: Two parters
text:
Two parters - The Origins Story
In earlier versions of both episodes, there were many more errors as compared to the final release. These errors include certain objects glowing (the Butterfly Miraculous) or being transparent (Cat Noir's ring). This is due to the show's staff still working on the episodes whilst they were still in production. These errors have since been corrected in subsequent releases of the episodes.

title: Two parters
text:
Two parters - Queen's Battle
Information
Season: 2
Episodes:
Episode 18, "Style Queen (Queen's Battle - Part 1)"
Episode 19, "Queen Wasp (Queen's Battle - Part 2)"
Focus: Both episodes focus on Marinette and her derby hat design being featured in a fashion show and inspected by the fashion icon, Audrey Bourgeois. They also focus on Chloé finding and using the Bee Miraculous to impress and seek validation from her mother, as well as Gabriel becoming desperate over his failed akumatizations.
Summarized TFOU Synopsis
It's Fashion Week and all of Paris has a rendezvous at Gabriel Agreste's fashion show, during which Adrien will wear a hat created by Marinette. For the occasion, Audrey Bourgeois, Chloé's mom and the international queen of fashion, is passing through the capital. But, manipulated by Gabriel/Hawk Moth, Audrey gets akumatized and becomes Style Queen, the most chic villain of all!
Armed with her scepter, she transforms people into statues of glitter and plans to do everything in her power to prevent Gabriel's show from taking place, starting by attacking Adrien.

title: Two parters
text:
Two parters - Queen's Battle
Without the support of Cat Noir, Ladybug is getting ready to call on a new superhero to help her, but she loses the Miraculous she wants to entrust to them...
Will Ladybug manage to stop Style Queen and recover the Miraculous before it falls into the wrong hands?
Notes
The French version of this 2-parter is called "Le Combat des Reines" which means "The Queen's Fight".
According to Feri González, the possible reasons for Malediktator not being part of the 2-parter is that it is slightly self-contained and can be watched "some time" independently after "Style Queen" and "Queen Wasp" whereas the other 2 are back-to-back and must be watched together. However, she still stressed the importance of watching "Malediktator" after "Style Queen" and "Queen Wasp." The reason for this is that this episode continues the Bourgeois family's storyline with Audrey Bourgois now playing an important role in Chloé's life, as well as Ladybug giving Chloé a chance to use the Bee Miraculous responsibly this time.
Thomas Astruc also advised fans to first watch the 2-parter ("Style Queen" & "Queen Wasp"), and then "Malediktator", otherwise their experience would be ruined.

title: Two parters
text:
Two parters - Heroes' Day
Information
Season: 2
Episodes:
Episode 24, "Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part 1)"
Episode 25, "Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part 2)"
Focus: Both episodes of this 2-parter focus on Marinette struggling to do a special deed for her class. Gabriel and Nathalie manifest their grand plan of deceiving Paris into thinking that Ladybug has become evil and she has defeated Cat Noir, thus, using their pain to their advantage of akumatizing multiple villains simultaneously. This results in Ladybug recruiting Rena Rouge, Carapace and Queen Bee to help them fight Scarlet Moth and his army.
Summarised TFOU Synopsis
It's Heroes' Day in Paris and everyone must prepare a good action for others. Bogged by her activities as Ladybug, Marinette did not have time to prepare hers. For fear of disappointing her friends by announcing that she has not prepared anything, Marinette lies to them and finds herself quickly overcome by her own lie.
Her nightmare is just beginning...
Hawk Moth has akumatized his assistant Nathalie into Catalyst, a supervillain that will allow him to put into action the plan he's been concocting for a long time, that will finally make it possible to defeat Ladybug and Cat Noir.
Notes

title: Two parters
text:
Two parters - Heroes' Day
Despite appearing in the promotional posters, Troublemaker, Reflekta, The Collector, Befana, Dark Owl, and Anansi do not appear in the special's episodes.
Not counting Antibug, The Bubbler, Lady Wifi, and The Collector, the only previously-known akumatized villains who don't appear in either of the special's episodes are Mr. Pigeon, Copycat, Evillustrator, Magician of Misfortune, Simon Says, Pixelator, Kung Food, Reflekta, The Puppeteer, Santa Claws, Befana, Robostus, Dark Owl, Sapotis, Captain Hardrock, Troublemaker, Zombizou, Reverser, Anansi, and Sandboy.
Xavier Ramier, Théo Barbot, Jean Duparc, Simon Grimault, Vincent Asa, Wang Cheng, Santa Claus, Markov, and the boy who was akumatized into Sandboy are the only characters among them who don't appear in any form.

title: Two parters
text:
Two parters - The Battle of the Miraculous
Information
Season: 3
Episodes:
Episode 25, "Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 1)"
Episode 26, "Miracle Queen (The Battle of the Miraculous - Part 2)"
Focus: Both episodes focus on Marinette learning to accept Kagami and Adrien being romantically involved, Master Fu's identity being compromised by Hawk Moth, as well as struggling with the stress of having many responsibilities.
Summarized TFOU Synopsis
Marinette helps Adrien and Kagami escape a ceremony organized by the Bourgeois couple for their 20 years of marriage. The 3 friends have fun until Marinette, seeing Adrien and Kagami together, decides to leave them alone, sacrificing her feelings for the one she's always loved.
But during this time, the Bourgeois anniversary turns sour and the couple gets akumatized.
Now Heart Hunter, a floating head with two faces constantly fighting each other, they devour all love in Paris.
Overpowered by this powerful villain, Ladybug seeks the help of Master Fu. But still upset about her love sacrifice, she makes a mistake that will prove disastrous...
Notes

id: Two parters::The Battle of the Miraculous::1
title: Two parters
text:
Two parters - The Battle of the Miraculous
Both episodes feature narration for the first time. Marinette narrating in the beginning and end of each episode. "Miracle Queen" reveals said narration to be a letter written by Wang Fu to Marinette in the case he had to relinquish his role as a guardian to her and lose his memory.
This is the first and currently only two parter finale that Lila Rossi/Cerise Bianca doesn't appear in.

title: Two parters
text:
Two parters - Shadow Moth's Final Attack
Information
Season: 4
Episodes:
Episode 25, "Risk (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 1)"
Episode 26, "Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)"
Focus: Gabriel Agreste obtaining most Miraculouses from the Chinese Miracle Box, and giving away the Peacock Miraculous to Félix Fathom.
Summarized TFOU Synopsis
Having understood that her cautiousness is the reason why Ladybug is always triumphing, Shadow Moth prepares a diabolic plan which consists of creating a supervillain able to make his victims take all sorts of risks. When Marinette finds out that Adrien is leaving Paris for a few weeks with Lila, the new figure of the Agreste brand, she’s ready to do anything to prevent him from doing so; but to what point? Would she reveal her secret identity for the sake of love? And would Adrien take the risk of finally confronting his father?

title: Two parters
text:
Two parters - The Kwamis' Choice
Information
Season: 5
Episodes:
Episode 10, "Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1)"
Episode 11, "Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)"
Focus: Both episodes focus on Tikki and Plagg finding new holders so that Adrien and Marinette can live their love story, but ultimately, the mission is theirs to complete, but they don't have to do it alone.
Summarized TFOU Synopsis
Every time, it's the same thing. Whether it's Marinette and Adrien or Ladybug and Cat Noir, they can never have a love story because of their secret identities...
Tikki and Plagg are sad to see their carriers so sad to be forced to give up their feelings. The Kwamis will then make a radical choice that will change many things in Paris... They will free Ladybug and Cat Noir from their superhero missions and entrust their miraculous to new carriers! Will they be up to the task of fighting Monarch? Will Marinette and Adrien take the opportunity to declare their love at last?

title: Two parters
text:
Two parters - The Final Day
Information
Season: 5
Episodes:
Episode 25, "Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)"
Episode 26, "Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)"
Focus: Gabriel being on his last legs and launching his largest scale, most ruthless plan yet.
Summarized TFOU Synopsis
While Marinette is desperate to hear from Adrien who has gone to London, Monarch places the last pieces of his machiavellian plan on his chessboard of evil. He has nothing more to lose because it is necessarily the final day for him. Indeed, the Cataclysm inflicted on him by Cat Noir makes him lose his last strength. But he does not admit defeat and intends to fulfill his wish: to bring back his beloved Émilie, by obtaining the Miraculouses of the Ladybug and the Black Cat. For this, he has set up a global and radical plan, which will almost put the population of the whole world on the heels of our superheroes and their Miraculouses! In great difficulty, will they manage to escape Monarch's ruthless scheme?
Notes
In the promotional poster, the Miraculized are colored silver grey. In "Conformation" and "Re-creation", however, the Miraculized are colored rose gold and white.

title: Two parters
text:
Two parters - The Final Day
This is the first two parter where Adrien is a minor character.

title: Tsurugi Industries
text:
Tsurugi Industries - Trivia
The brand was known to be in partnership with Gabriel.
The Agrestes' cars and private jet are from Tsurugi.
Gabriel Agreste and Nathalie Sancoeur own tablets and cellphone scramblers from Tsurugi.
In "Mega Leech", they co-funded Project Oxygen.
Due to her deteriorating health, Nathalie used technical leg braces to walk, which were made by Tsurugi.
In "Multiplication" and "Destruction", they created the Alliance rings together.
The machinery Gabriel used to create the Miraculous Alliance rings was also from Tsurugi.
In "Intuition", it's mentioned that Gabriel designed the interior of the space-plane.
As seen in a flashback in "Werepapas", Émilie Agreste, when affected by her illness, used an automated wheelchair made by Tsurugi to move around.
The logo of the brand is a mitsudomoe, also known as a tomoe, which might be a reference to Tomoe Tsurugi's name.
The power emblem of the Dragon Miraculous, which is usually used by Ryuko, is also a mitsudomoe.
In "Miraculous Shanghai", a Tsurugi store in Shanghai is seen, along with a Gabriel store on the opposite side.

was a Miraculous holder who is featured in the Grimoire for the Rabbit Miraculous. When Fluff inhabited the Rabbit Miraculous, they transformed into a rabbit-themed superhero.

They would also had enhanced skills, such as speed, strength, and - most prominently - agility.

title: Tsurugi laptops
text:
Tsurugi laptops - Intro
The  are laptops from Tsurugi Industries, formerly owned by Tomoe Tsurugi.

title: Tsurugi laptops
text:
Tsurugi laptops - Appearance
The Tsurugi laptops look like real-life laptops with metal handles which make them look more like briefcases. It's keyboard consists of 22 keys (14 perfect rectangles, 4 right angled pentagons, 2 right angled trapezoids, 2 pentagons with 1 inner round edge) and an orb in the center bottom, which is used as a mouse. It possess no glass screen. Above the keyboard is a hologram projector which creates a holographic screen. The outer panel of the laptop's has the logo of the Tsurugi Industries upside down within a shield symbol within a triangle with round vertices symbol engraved. The laptops have been shown in three different colour variations.
The prototype version is gray coloured with the handler, keyboard and logo black coloured. The version owned by Chloé is gold coloured with the handler, keyboard and logo black coloured and unlike the other versions it also has two bails, which can be tied to a strap. Tomoe's version is red coloured with the handler and logo dark red coloured and the keyboard black coloured.

title: Tsurugi laptops
text:
Tsurugi laptops - Abilities
The primary function of these laptops was to control the Police robots designed by the same company. The holographic screen displayed the controls and showed the footage of the robots' cameras. In "Re-creation", it's revealed that the laptops can control other technological systems besides the Police robots, such as the security system in the Agreste mansion.

title: Tsurugi laptops
text:
Tsurugi laptops - Trivia
In "Revolution", Cerise manages to steal Tomoe's laptop and in "Re-creation", Cerise (under a new identity), uses it to hack into the Agreste mansion's security system to be able to enter and steal the Butterfly Miraculous.
However, in "Yaksi Gozen", it's revealed that Tomoe sent an unknown female accomplice to the Agreste mansion to spy on Gabriel back in "Re-creation", with said accomplice hinted to be Lila, so it's possible that Tomoe helped her to hack the mansion's systems to better infiltrate to the mansion.

title: Tsurugi space jet
text:
Tsurugi space jet - Intro
is a space plane created by Tsurugi Industries that possesses an artificial intelligence, A.D.A., which is capable of controlling the entire spacecraft. In "Intuition", it was tested by Claudie Kanté in a real real situation.
In "Intuition", after being manipulated by Monarch into believing that she had lost her pilot, and after Cosmobug tried to convince her to return to Earth, A.D.A. was akumatized by Monarch into Bugfighter, also transforming the ship along with her.

title: Tsurugi space jet
text:
Tsurugi space jet - Appearance
Normal
The Tsurugi space jet is a triangular, relatively flat black and white spacecraft. It has two rear thrusters that allow it to move at high speed through the atmosphere and space.
It has a single passenger cabin with a green seat designed by Gabriel Agreste. This cabin is filled with sensors that allow A.D.A. to collect and analyze the emotional and physical state of Claudie Kanté. There is a large triangular screen used to communicate with A.D.A., but also the device commands.
Akumatized
Under the effect of A.D.A.'s akumatization in Bugfighter, the spaceship had transformed into a particularly large Mecha with a white tubular head and the rest of its body was blue and purple.

title: Tsurugi space jet
text:
Tsurugi space jet - Abilities
Normal
The Tsurugi space jet appears to be a prototype space plane with the ability to fly like an airplane in Earth's atmosphere and hover like a spaceship in space.
In space it is capable of well exceeding 10,000 km/h, reaching hypersonic speeds, even high ones. It is also capable of resisting atmospheric reentry velocity.
Akumatized
Under the effect of A.D.A.'s akumatization in Bugfighter, the spaceship was capable of performing very precise robotic actions, notably becoming capable of capturing Cosmobug, or analyzing various elements with external sensors. It could also fire very powerful lasers that were capable of destroying objects that were normally indestructible, such as Cosmobug's yo-yo.

title: Tsurugi space jet
text:
Tsurugi space jet - Trivia
The Tsurugi space jet is the ninth object, after Roger's police car in "Rogercop", Gina's motorcycle in "Befana" and "Dearest Family", Anarka's boat in "Captain Hardrock" and "Crocoduel", Santa Claus's sleigh in "Santa Claws", the train in "Startrain" and Tomoe's car in "Ikari Gozen", "Multiplication" and "Pretension", Chloé's limousine in "Queen Banana" and Froggy's bicycle in "Risk", which has been akumized together with its owner.
The security code for this space plane is "K1s3k1_n0_Sh1n_J1d41".
In rōmaji, this gives "Kiseki no Shin Jidai", which can be translated as "A New Age of Miracles" in English.
According to Marinette and Nadja, this is the most sophisticated space plane ever seen.

title: Tsurugi Labs
text:
Tsurugi Labs - Intro
The  are tech laboratories owned by Tsurugi Industries located in Paris, London, and possibly other locations in the world.

title: Tsurugi Labs
text:
Tsurugi Labs - Appearance
Paris laboratory
3D scanning room
It is a square room with all-white walls with horizontal and vertical metal pillars that allow for the installation of various projectors and measuring devices. The center of the room has a raised stage above which a robot scanner is installed on the ceiling.
On one side is a computer monitoring area with several screens and seating.
Supercomputer room
The room is black and has a slight red glow. There is a supercomputer there with a hologram screen.
"Connection" room
TBA
London laboratory
Exterior
The laboratory is located in a building with several dozen floors and is built of red bricks. The roof has a white floor covered with various pipes, fittings and ventilation systems. The raised parts each have an antenna, one for telephony. Towards the stairwell accessing the building there is a red first aid kit with transparent glass. Finally, a white door gives access to a descending staircase.
Furthermore, the roof offers an exceptional panorama of the City of London.
Interior
Corridors

title: Tsurugi Labs
text:
Tsurugi Labs - Appearance
The London laboratory has an interior entirely in white squares giving the impression of total sanitization. The corridors are wide and without any decoration, without windows, lit only by artificial lights.
One of its corridors gives access to two padded bedrooms side by side.
Rooms
The rooms of the laboratory have entirely white walls padded with large squares that can also serve as a television and a higher space on the ground that serves as an improvised bed.
In addition, the rooms are equipped with a video surveillance camera, which monitors the person staying there.

title: Tsurugi Labs
text:
Tsurugi Labs - Trivia
In "Multiplication", Adrien and Lila went there to be scanned in order to create the two avatars for the Alliance rings.
Tomoe wanted to move this lab to a brand new technopole that would be built on the site of the Parc des Buttes-Chaumont, in the 19th arrondissement of Paris, but this plan was rejected by Mayor Bourgeois.
Tomoe's supercomputer resembles Betterfly's parallel universe detector in his lair.

text:

is a private jet built by the Tsurugi Industries and owned by Tomoe Tsurugi. Its unique feature is complete autonomy thanks to Tatsu.

Exterior
The Tsurugi's private jet is white with a red stripe along the side windows, and red stripes also appear on the leading edge flaps, elevators and engines. The logo of Tsurugi Industries is printed small on the sides and large on the drift.
Interior
The interior of the jet is especially luxurious. It features a large cabin with a pale pink floor. Inside, there are two rows of e sedili wide seats with white cushions, one row with single seats and the other with two-seater seats, each with a large wooden coffee table. title: Tsurugi car
text:
Tsurugi car - Intro
The  is a car created by the Tsurugi Industries that belongs to Tomoe Tsurugi. It has the unique feature of being completely autonomous via Tatsu.
In "Ikari Gozen", after Kagami disobeyed her by choosing to participate in the Friendship Day games, Tomoe was akumatized by Hawk Moth into Ikari Gozen, transforming her car along with her.
In "Multiplication", to test the functioning of the Alliance rings, Tomoe was reakumized by Monarch into Ikari Gozen, once again transforming her car along with her.
In "Pretension", after Argos had kidnapped Kagami and asked Gabriel to akumatize her also seeing it as an opportunity to recover the Peacock Miraculous, Tomoe was akumatized from Monarch into Matagi Gozen, transforming her car into a steed she could ride.

title: Tsurugi car
text:
Tsurugi car - Appearance
Normal
Tatsu is a red car with black wheels. Its windows are darkened.
Inside, the main parts of the car are red, such as the seats, steering wheel, dashboard and much more. The back of the seats has devices similar to a miniature television. The steering wheel is on the left side of the car.
Akumatized
Ikari Gozen
Under the effects of Tomoe's akumization into Ikari Gozen, the car had merged with Tomoe and become part of the villain.
Matagi Gozen
Under the effects of Tomoe's akumatization into Matagi Gozen, the car had transformed into a red and black steed.

title: Tsurugi car
text:
Tsurugi car - Abilities
Normal
Tatsu can record and recognize voices. In this case, the only recorded voices that Tatsu can recognize are Tomoe, Kagami and Cerise Bianca.
Akumatized
Ikari Gozen
Under the effects of Tomoe's akumization into Ikari Gozen, the car had become part of the villain but seemed to have a mind of its own. When a person or object was swallowed by Ikari Gozen, he was thrown onto one of the car seats and immediately secured with belts, preventing his escape.
When Cat Noir had attempted to summon his Cataclysm, the car had grabbed his wrist and prevented him from using it, meaning the car could detect sudden movements.
Matagi Gozen
Under the effects of Tomoe's akumatization into Matagi Gozen, the car, transformed into a steed, followed all of Matagi Gozen's orders. Furthermore, it seemed that he could use the Miraculous superpowers that Monarch had transferred to the supervillain, as he was able to smell Félix/Argos and Cat Noir after Matagi Gozen used the superpower of the Rooster Miraculous.

text:

According to Kagami Tsurugi, the Dorayaki sold by her grandmother are the best in Tokyo.

title: Tsurugi apartment in Tokyo
text:
Tsurugi apartment in Tokyo - Intro
The Tsurugi apartment was the residence of Tomoe Tsurugi and her daughter Kagami in Tokyo, Japan.

title: Tsurugi apartment in Tokyo
text:
Tsurugi apartment in Tokyo - Appearance
Located on a high floor of a prestigious building in the Ginza district, this apartment is exceptionally spacious. The main room is particularly large, featuring a true Japanese-style indoor garden with a reflecting pool spanned by a transparent walkway. Around the pool, there is a marble floor, itself bordered by a section of parquet flooring.
In this room, there is a giant bonsai tree, as well as a wooden desk supported by two legs, one modern and the other set directly into the stone. There is also a bokken stand, and a bow rack on the wall.
The room has an unobstructed view of Tokyo Tower.

title: Tsurugi apartment in Tokyo

Tsurugi apartment in Tokyo - Trivia

Both apartments also have a view of the Eiffel Tower and Tokyo Tower, respectively.

title: Twig
text:
Twig - Intro
is a minor character in Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He is a school cafeteria worker who serves students in the cafeteria of Collège Françoise Dupont with Nora Césaire.

title: Twig
text:
Twig - Appearance
Physical appearance
Twig is a tall man with a very slim, almost twig-like build and fair, freckled skin. He has long, curly blond hair brushed back and green eyes.
Civilian attire
He wears a dark green military-style jacket with a floral "peace and love" symbol embroidered on the back, along with a lighter green tunic featuring Tatreez patterns. He also wears brown cargo pants and a pair of reinforced combat boots. He accessorizes with round glasses, a necklace, and a silver earring on his right ear.
When working, his outfit also includes a pair of gloves, a hairnet, and a blue apron with the Collège Françoise Dupont logo.

title: Twig
text:
Twig - Personality
Twig is a calm, kind, and sensitive young man. He enjoys cooking as well as martial arts. He is also very supportive of Nora, acting as her coach during her fights and accompanying her in her activities, which has made him one of the few people Nora feels comfortable being around.

title: Twig
text:
Twig - Abilities
As a cafeteria worker, Twig is able to serve students portions appropriate for their age. He also helps prepare meals, reheats them, and takes care of cleaning the cafeteria.
He also practices "Cook-fu", a martial art that combines cooking with kung fu.

title: Twig
text:
Twig - Relationships
Romances
Nora Césaire
Twig worked with Nora in the school cafeteria, serving students. He also spent a lot of time with her, accompanying her to sports practices and matches. Twig was in love with Nora, but at first, due to his shyness, he was hesitant to confess his feelings. Even though Nora is much stronger than him and can squeeze his hand tightly, Twig appreciates it and loves her touch.
Despite this, he was always there for her and supported her in everything. As a result of a game provoked by Marinette, he and Nora confessed their feelings, but Nora, fearing the pain of separation, was akumatized into Sadnansi. After the intervention of superheroes, Nora and Twig decided they could maintain a long-distance relationship and wait for a reunion, and they officially became a couple.

title: Twig
text:
Twig - History
Season 6
In "Daddycop", he is seen serving students alongside Nora Césaire before Marinette barges into the Cafeteria.

title: Twig
text:
Twig - Etymology
"Twig" is an English name derived from the Old English twigge or twigga, meaning "small branch" or "shoot". It is associated with nature, growth, and delicacy.
In the French dub, he's called "Brindille", which is the French word for "twig".

title: Unnamed fisherman
text:
Unnamed fisherman - Intro
The fisherman is a man who likes to fish at the Seine.
In the Miraculous Adventures story "Trash Krakken Part 1", after having a lousy day of fishing, he gets akumatized by Hawk Moth into Silurus, a water and catfish-controlling supervillain.

title: Unnamed fisherman
text:
Unnamed fisherman - Appearance
Physical appearance
The fisherman is a tall man with tan skin. He has light brown hair and yellowish black eyes.
Civilian attire
The fisherman wears a light gold fishing hat, a plain white shirt, and green pants. He also wears a light gold vest with four pockets on the chest, dark green pants that are tucked below his brown boots which go below his knees.
As Silurus
He has luminous vivid chartreuse green skin, and his eyes are brilliant yellow. His suit is brilliant opal around the torso with three luminous vivid chartreuse green spots and strong blue in the forearms and legs from his waist to his feet. The suit covers the top half of his face with a strong blue mask, and two catfish-like whiskers protrude from his cheekbones. At the top of his head, the suit has a luminous vivid chartreuse green crest, and it has a fin on the back as well.

title: Unnamed fisherman
text:
Unnamed fisherman - Personality
As a civilian
The fisherman is fine overall, but he can lose his patience when dealing with disappointing situations, upset about being unable to catch any fish and getting splashed because of a beach ball.
As Silurus
As Silurus, he is vengeful, proud, and furious. He strongly believes that the Seine is only meant for fishing, not for other leisure activities like swimming. Angry about the civilians ruining his fishing by scaring off the fish, he lashes back at them with catfish and his fishing rod, even willing to drown his foes. Silurus also has little patience for those ruining his schemes, getting enraged at Cat Noir for trying to get rid of his catfish.

title: Unnamed fisherman
text:
Unnamed fisherman - Abilities
As a civilian
The fisherman is skilled at fishing.
As Silurus
Silurus can control the water and catfish. He holds himself high above the river and travels around with a waterspout. With voice commands and gestures, he controls the catfish to go out in any direction and/or attack anyone he desires. Also, Silurus is able to create catfishes comprised out of water for crashing into opponents. However, a strong enough blow, like from Ladybug's yo-yo or Cat Noir's Cataclysm, can destroy his waterspout or water-formed catfishes, His fishing rod is his tool for hitting targets, like humans and objects, or hooking them to pull them towards him or yank them into the water. The rod is able to hook onto his water-formed catfishes as well.

title: Unnamed fisherman
text:
Unnamed fisherman - Trivia
Silurus' name is taken from Silurus, the genus of catfishes that are native to Europe and Asia.
Silurus' abilities are similar to Mr. Pigeon in that they both have the power to control a particular animal species.
However, unlike Mr. Pigeon, Silurus can control water as well.

title: Unnamed boy
text:
Unnamed boy - Intro
This  is a minor character in Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He is a young child who lives in Paris.
In "Sandboy", after having a nightmare due to watching a scary movie alone by himself, he was akumatized by Hawk Moth into Sandboy, a nightmare-themed supervillain.

title: Unnamed boy
text:
Unnamed boy - Appearance
Physical Appearance
The boy has messy black hair with deep sapphire blue reflections and dark indigoish gray eyes. He has fairly light skin, and his height is average for a child. He has black eye shade around his eyes.
Civilian Attire
He wears teal-and-white one-piece pyjamas with Knightowl's logo in the center of it. He also wears socks with orange and white stripes.
As Sandboy
Sandboy was a Sandman-like guy and has black eyeliner around his eyes. He had sapphire blue skin with white spots that resembled stars, brilliant gold eyebrows, and eyeliner. He had purple hair with curled tips and an upward position with a glowing dotted line on each part, making the hair look like octopus tentacles. His eyes were brilliant blue-violet with oval pupils and very pale violet sclerae. Over each eye, there was a yellow line. He wore a dark purple bodysuit with a large collar, the inner lining of which being yellow, and a nearly white glowing symbol on the chest. The villain also had lower arms which were thick with glowing dotted lines going down them. He also appeared to be riding a dark purple item with very pale yellow pointed tips that had resemblance to a pillow.

title: Unnamed boy
text:
Unnamed boy - Personality
The boy is a happy boy. He is very energetic. He can be easily scared when something scares him, like in "Sandboy" when he watched a scary movie on TV and had a nightmare (which caused him to get akumatized). He was also very excitable when Ladybug offered to take him home.
As Sandboy, he was more confident and demanding, but at the same time as he was focused on Ladybug, he left himself wide open.

title: Unnamed boy
text:
Unnamed boy - Abilities
As Sandboy
As Sandboy, he could cause the nightmares/bad dreams of others to be brought to reality by using multicolored sand that came from his pillow cloud, which he used as transportation. The sand was capable of going right through buildings to reach victims. He could also shoot the sand at his opponents from the cloud, and it would still have the same effects. He was also able to get around very quickly and spread his sand to all of Paris using his pillow. He could shoot beams of sand out of his pillow, and when a person was hit by them, the same effect occurred.

title: Unnamed boy
text:
Unnamed boy - History
Season 2
In "Sandboy", after watching a scary movie on TV and going to bed, falling asleep, the boy had a really bad nightmare. Hawk Moth senses the boy's fear and sends an akuma into his room, scaring him once he wakes up. The akuma then goes into his pillow and once he accepts Hawk Moth's terms in exchange for powers, the boy is transformed into Sandboy, a nightmare-themed supervillain.
Sandboy then flies into the night sky with his pillow, which he uses to spread his multicolored sand all over the city of Paris while chatting "The Sandboy just checked in! Now nightmares can begin!". This causes the nightmares/bad dreams of anyone the sand touches to come to life, effecting people such as Marinette Dupain-Cheng, Tom Dupain, Adrien Agreste, Jean Tretiens, Roger Raincomprix, Wang Fu, and Fire Captain Hessenpy.
Later, Hawk Moth communicates with Sandboy and tells him that he felt the presence of kwamis somewhere in the right bank of the Seine, ordering him to find and capture them. Soon, Sandboy spots Plagg, the kwami of Cat Noir, and tells Hawk Moth who tells him to follow him. Sandboy then starts flying after Plagg and shooting him with beams of sand.

title: Unnamed boy
text:
Unnamed boy - History
He follows the kwami into the train station, where Sandboy narrowly avoids getting hit by a train and loses track of Plagg. Hawk Moth then angrily tell him that he failed, warning Sandboy that Ladybug and Cat Noir will arrive soon and reminding him that he wants their Miraculouses. After this, Sandboy angrily flies out of the train station and into the night sky.
Later, while spreading his multicolored sand all over the city again, Sandboy is attacked by Ladybug and Cat Noir, dodging their attacks. He then starts shooting them with beams of sand, hitting Ladybug right before she can finish her Lucky Charm, making her lose her powers. Sandboy tries to take her Miraculous, but Ladybug is saved by Cat Noir. Flying over Cat Noir with his pillow spreading his multicolored sand, Sandboy makes his greatest fear come true, an evil Ladybug who wants nothing but to destroy him.

title: Unnamed boy
text:
Unnamed boy - History
The evil Ladybug then calls on her Lucky Charm and receives a sword, to which she starts attacking Cat Noir with. Sandboy soon moves in from the other side to attack both heroes. However, Cat Noir grabs Ladybug by her waist and plants his staff in the ground, to fly upwards and avoid the incoming attacks. Sandboy then crashes into the evil Ladybug, landing on the ground.
After getting up, Sandboy goes up to the rooftop where the two heroes are at and threatens them into giving him their Miraculous but fails. He then watched as Ladybug and Cat Noir tricked the evil Ladybug into hitting her sword against a building rail edge, breaking a piece off her sword. They use this to cut open Sandboy's pillow, making him fall, to be catched by Cat Noir, and releasing the akuma.
Sandboy then gets deakumatized after Ladybug does her Miraculous Ladybug. Soon, the heroes walk over to the boy and ask him what happened. He then explained how and why he got akumatized, making Ladybug realize that Hawk Moth fed off of the negative emotions of a nightmare. Cat Noir also expresses his belief that kids shouldn't be allowed to watch whatever they want on TV. Ladybug then took the boy back to his parents.

title: Unnamed boy
text:
Unnamed boy - History
Season 3
In "Gamer 2.0", the boy was one of the many former akumatized villains that the titular villain zapped into his video game dimension. Sandboy (played by the titular villain) fights Gigantitan (played by Ladybug) and is easily defeated. After the villain is defeated by Ladybug and Cat Noir, the boy and the others are freed by Ladybug's Miraculous Ladybug.
In "Stormy Weather 2", he appeared in a flashback when Ladybug recalled fighting alongside Cat Noir against the akumatized villains.

title: Unnamed boy
text:
Unnamed boy - Etymology
His supervillain name is based off the Sandman, a mythical character in Western and Northern European folklore who puts people to sleep and brings good dreams by sprinkling magical sand onto people as they sleep.
However, his powers operate parallel to the Sandman's, as he brings nightmares to life as opposed to creating dreams.
In the Latin American Spanish dub, his akumatized form is called Dormilón, which translates to Sleepy.
In the Brazilian Portuguese dub, his akumatized form is called Sonhador, which translates to Dreamer.
In the Russian dub, his akumatized form is called Seyatel, which translates to Sower.

title: Unnamed boy
text:
Unnamed boy - Trivia
Sandboy was first revealed in a promotional video for Season 2 from TFOU.
He reports to seeing Hawk Moth while being akumatized, calling him a "weird man".
As a result, he is aware that he is being akumatized, in a similar fashion to Caline Bustier in "Zombizou".
So far in the series, he is the first villain to see a Kwami while akumatized and know what it is.
He is also the second character in the franchise to be akumatized who does not have a given name, with the first being the fisherman from issue 2 of Miraculous Adventures.
In "Gamer 2.0", Sandboy returns as a playable akumatized villain as part of the Gamer 2.0's powers.
Sandboy has the distinction of being the only akumatized villain that has made more appearances than its civilian counterpart.
The boy is also seen wearing the logo of The Owl (Mr. Damoclès).
He is one of four characters who were akumatized villains in the first three seasons who did not appear in any way in seasons 4 and 5, the others being Vincent Asa, Simon Grimault and Vivica.

title: Unnamed black substance
text:
Unnamed black substance - Intro
The black substance is a unknown substance capable of transforming a person into a monster. Its origins are unknown.

title: Unnamed black substance
text:
Unnamed black substance - Appearance
The substance is black, and looks similar to glittery tar.

title: Unnamed black substance
text:
Unnamed black substance - Abilities
The substance can get stuck on an object. If a person comes into contact with the substance covering an object, the substance begins to move, and it transforms the person into a monster. For example, a New York civilian who touches Mr. Squid, a stuffed animal covered with the substance, changes into a monster known as the Trash Krakken.
The transformed victim gains powers, like the Trash Krakken being able to dig and absorb anything that it touches, but it also makes the victim lose their mind and become monstrous and aggressive.
When the substance-covered object is taken away from the victim, the victim can temporarily revert back to normal. However, their eyes glow purple and they will transform again unless the substance is removed from the object. Ladybug's yo-yo can completely purify the covered object and get rid of the substance. Afterwards, the person doesn't remember anything from their time being transformed.

title: Unnamed black substance
text:
Unnamed black substance - Trivia
The substance appears to work in similar fashion to akumas, which the holder of the Butterfly Miraculous creates to infect objects and transform people into superheroes or supervillains.
Because of the cancellation of Miraculous Adventures, it's unknown what's the origin of the substance and why it caused Kenya's father to transform into the Trash Krakken.

text:

title: United Heroez
text:
United Heroez - Intro
The  is a team of American superheroes based in New York City, who protect people from evil.

title: United Heroez
text:
United Heroez - History
The earliest known hero pair is Knightowl and Sparrow, with the original pair dating back to the 1880's. They made a valiant effort in protecting those who lived in the United States and had done so for the next 134 years, with each Sparrow becoming the next Knightowl and choosing a Sparrow of their own. When it came to the fourth generation of Knightowl and Sparrow, a young woman named Barbara Keynes became the next Sparrow with an unknown man becoming the Knightowl. After several years, she took the mantle of the Knightowl herself, and overtime other heroes, including Majestia, came to North America, but just as the heroes came, so did the villains.
Understanding that they couldn't defeat so many villains on their own, the heroes decided to team up and protect New York together. To further protect the people, one of the heroes, known as Victory, became the President of the United States and had stashes of military weapons hidden all over New York City. Then, at a some point, Knightowl and Majestia took it upon themselves to train the newest additions of the team, their own daughters Jessica Keynes as the fifth Sparrow and Aeon as Uncanny Valley.

title: United Heroez
text:
United Heroez - History
When supervillain Mike Rochip, aka Techno-Pirate, attacked a plane traveling to New York from Paris, Majestia, Sparrow, Knightowl, and Uncanny Valley arrived and stopped him while saving the plane.
The next day, the French and American students visit a museum, covertly observed by Uncanny and Sparrow in their civilian identities of Aeon and Jess. Meanwhile, French supervillain Hawk Moth akumatizes Techno-Pirate as he is being taken to prison, and sends the newly-dubbed Techlonizer to steal the Marquis de Lafayette's sword.
Uncanny, Sparrow, Ladybug, and Cat Noir attempt to subdue Techlonizer. Sparrow tries to call for backup, but Techlonizer damages her communicator. Sparrow doesn't care for long, though, seeing this as a chance for her and Uncanny to prove themselves. Meanwhile, Hawk Moth's true plan has been a success: While the heroes were busy fighting Techlonizer, he was able to walk in and steal the Eagle Miraculous unopposed.

title: United Heroez
text:
United Heroez - History
The heroes manage to get the upper hand, but Cat Noir accidentally destroys Uncanny with an errant Cataclysm. Ladybug uses her magic Ladybugs to revive her, but an angered Knightowl suspends Sparrow for disobeying protocol and demands the French heroes surrender their Miraculouses, causing the two to flee into the sewers.
Later, Techno Pirate, now re-akumatized, and with the Eagle Miraculous as well, is cornered by the United Heroez, but uses the Eagle's power of Liberation to free them from their ethical constraints, causing them to go berserk.
Uncanny, able to see through other people's identities, goes to recruit Ladybug and Cat Noir while Sparrow tries to contain the crisis. Uncanny finds and recruits Marinette, then goes to return the Cat Miraculous to Adrien. At first, Adrien is hesitant, but Uncanny plays back a recording of Marinette saying that she can't be Ladybug without him. Adrien becomes Cat Noir again and flies back to New York with Uncanny but notes that he had to get back before the plane lands.

title: United Heroez
text:
United Heroez - History
Once Cat Noir and Uncanny rendezvous with Ladybug and Sparrow, they come up with a plan to manipulate Doorman into helping them infiltrate the Statue of Liberty, where Miraclonizer is waiting to launch a missile on Hawk Moth's order if Ladybug and Cat Noir don't surrender.
They manage to get the Eagle Miraculous, and Sparrow, now Eagle, uses the power of the Eagle Miraculous to dispel the effects of Miraclonizer's use of Liberation. The villain manages to fire the missile, but it is stopped and destroyed by Majestia.
The four young heroes defeat and deakumatize Techno Pirate and restore everything to normal. Ladybug tells Eagle to keep the Eagle Miraculous, knowing that it's in good hands. Majestia and Knightowl congratulate their protégés and admit that they should give them more freedom to grow.
In "Re-creation", the United Heroez battled against the Miraculized who believed Ladybug and Cat Noir kidnapped Adrien Agreste and Kagami Tsurugi.

title: United Heroez
text:
United Heroez - Trivia
The United Heroez bear a strong resemblance to the Justice League from the DC franchise and the Avengers from the Marvel franchise.
Many of the Heroes bear strong similarities to characters from the aforementioned franchises.
Majestia is similar to Superman and Wonder Woman from DC.
Knightowl is similar to Batman from DC.
Knightowl is also similar to Nite Owl from Watchmen.
Eagle, back when she served as Knightowl's sidekick, Sparrow, is similar to Batman's sidekick, Robin.
Uncanny Valley is similar to Cyborg from DC and Vision from Marvel.
Victory is similar to Captain America from Marvel.
Snowflake is similar to both Killer Frost and Ice from DC.
Hurricane is similar to Storm from Marvel.
Mercury is similar to Flash from DC and Quicksilver from Marvel.
Thorn is similar to Poison Ivy from DC.
Sting is similar to Bumblebee from DC and Wasp from Marvel.
However, Red, Blue and Yellow Agents differ from them, mainly because they were inspired by Totally Spies.
The United Heroez is the second superhero team to be showed in the series, after The Miraculers.
Unlike Ladybug's team, most of United Heroez's members are adults that don't possess Miraculouses.

title: United Heroez
text:
United Heroez - Trivia
According to Thomas Astruc, the bracelets that transform the heroes are advanced technology created by Majestia.
Multiple members make minor appearances outside of "Miraculous New York":
Majestia is pictured in a comic in "Ladybug & Cat Noir", is one of Animaestro's forms in "Animaestro", is mentioned in relation to her evil sister Ignoblia by Bunnyx in "Timetagger", appears as a toy in "Party Crasher" and "Miraculous Shanghai", and can be seen on a poster in Alya's room in multiple episodes.
Uncanny Valley appears as a toy in "Miraculous Shanghai".
Knightowl appears in comics in "The Dark Owl" and "Truth", as toys in "Gamer 2.0", "Party Crasher" and "Simpleman", and can be seen on posters inside and outside the Le Sorbonne in multiple episodes.
Sparrow appears in a comic in "The Dark Owl", and as toys in "Party Crasher" and "Miraculous Shanghai".
Mercury appears as toys in "Party Crasher" and "Simpleman".
In "Risk" it's revealed that there is a film franchise about them, and Marinette and Alya see one of the films in the cinema.

title: Vampigami
text:
Vampigami - Intro
"" is a season 6 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 8th written and produced episode of season 6. It is also the 139th written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Vampigami
text:
Vampigami - Synopsis
TF1+
Fearing he'd stop loving her if she didn't go to the movies with him, Marinette forces herself to go with Adrien to a special showing of a horror film. Marinette's worst phobia. Chills, anxiety, and terror guaranteed! Boo!
Disney Channel
Afraid Adrien won't love her anymore if she doesn't go to the movies with him, Marinette agrees to attend the screening of a horror movie with him. Marinette's worst fear!
Disney+
Ladybug faces a villain... along with her own fears!

title: Vampigami
text:
Vampigami - Plot
As the episode opens, Rose is at the beauty salon getting fitted for her new wig due to being bald as a result of either her illness or undergoing treatment for it. She's joined by Juleka, and thanks her for all her support and being by her side through all her tribulations. They share a hug to show how strong their relationship is.
After the theme song, Marinette arrives at the Agreste mansion to have breakfast with him, despite a still half-asleep Nathalie trying to argue that it is way too early, but then Placide I.T.
arrives with a letter from Adrien's paternal grandparents, Johnny and Gabrielle Grassette, inviting Adrien and Marinette to watch a vampire horror movie that is celebrating its 50th anniversary at Le Sorbonne.
Marinette shows indications that she's scared silly of horror movies, but fearing for her relationship with Adrien, she agrees, but later speaks in private with Alya, Trixx, and Tikki about how screwed she is now.

title: Vampigami
text:
Vampigami - Plot
Alya and the Kwamis try to convince Marinette to be honest with Adrien, but during lunch later, Marinette completely forgets Alya's advice, though she tries to convince Marinette to give her ticket to allow Rose and Juleka to go to the movie instead.
It is then that Prem shows up and does a quick musical number with the students, but when he tries to show off his origami to Rose, Ray and his two buddies arrive to cause trouble, resulting in Prem's origami bird ending up in the janitor's bucket and ruined.
Needless to say, Marinette, Sublime, and the others are furious with Ray, Loïc, and Nelson, and when Zoé tried to intervene, Ray again uses his blackmail to get her to back off.
However, when Nelson notices Juleka feeling left out when Prem seems to be spending a lot of time with Rose, he gets a wicked idea, then convinces Ray and Loïc to back off.
Adrien and Aglaé then tell the Bully trio that they should apologize and repay Prem for what they did.
When they confront him later for apparently turning traitor, he reveals it was a ruse as he has a plan to further drive a wedge between Juleka and Rose.

title: Vampigami
text:
Vampigami - Plot
Acquiring two tickets to the vampire film, Nelson gives them to Prem, with one to be given to the girl he wants to take to the movie with him, inspiring Prem to take Rose to the movie.

title: Vampigami
text:
Vampigami - Plot
At the gardening class, Prem shows the tickets to Rose and invites her, and she accepts, but Juleka feels even more hurt, but tries not to show it to the others. Rose, however, is worried for Juleka, and when Prem offers his ticket to her, Juleka says it is okay. Watching from a distance, Nelson is pleased to see his plan is working. Later, back at Adrien's house, Marinette has her makeup done by Juleka, but when she asks Adrien if she can use the bathroom to look at it, Adrien's appearance, alongside that of Rose, Prem, and the Grassettes, sends her into a panic, and upon seeing her own reflection in the mirror, she is terrified. Nevertheless, she tries to be brave and goes with the others to the movie. As for Juleka, she heads back to the Liberty, where despite attempts by Roaar to cheer her up, Juleka calls her brother and voices her fear and worry over how he's halfway across the world now in Brazil and she can't talk to him for support when she needs it, especially now with fearing losing Rose. Luka senses a problem, but before he can try to encourage Juleka, she hangs up, grabs a pillow, and starts punching it in frustration, as Roaar cheers her on.

title: Vampigami
text:
Vampigami - Plot
At Le Sorbonne, Andre gets ready to start the film, despite Marinette's anxiety over it, but when Rose gets a call from Luka regarding his concern for Juleka, Rose decides to leave to go check on her. Marinette decides to join her, and confesses to Adrien that she's still scared of horror movies, but didn't want to tell Adrien out of concern for their relationship. Luckily, Adrien understands and wants Marinette to be honest with him as he won't think ill of her if she tells him the truth. Seeing he understands, Marinette kisses him before going after Rose. Unknown to anyone, someone locks the front doors, then checks their cellphone that is connected to a hidden camera in the ladies' restroom. As Prem realizes he's horrible for driving a wedge between Rose and Juleka, the figure, revealed to be Cerise, sends an Ultrakuma to akumatize him. While she speaks to him in his mind, Rose arrives to find the front doors padlocked. In the meantime, Chrysalis convinces Prem to become Count Vampigami, and he begins turning the movie guests into his loyal clones to try and mend things between Rose and Juleka, including the Grassettes.

title: Vampigami
text:
Vampigami - Plot
Marinette ducks into the restroom to transform, but Tikki spots the hidden camera and warns Marinette that she's being watched and can't transform or she'll blow her secret identity as Ladybug. In the meantime, Adrien slips out the back door and transforms into Cat Noir to Cataclysm the door to let the civilians out and protect Rose from Vampigami and his clones. With the main entrance now open, Marinette slips out with the other civilians, but it appears she's being followed, but Marinette escapes into the sewers before she's seen, has Tikki transform her into Ladybug, and then contacts Purple Tigress and Pigella for help.

title: Vampigami
text:
Vampigami - Plot
After they arrive to assist, during the fight, one of the Vampigami clones, possibly Cerise, prepares an Antikuma, but is interrupted when Purple Tigress uses her Clout to send Count Vampigami flying, allowing Ladybug to snare him with her yo-yo, and Pigella to subdue him with Gift, allowing Ladybug to take his Akumatized object and break it to free the Ultrakuma for her to capture and purify, before using her Miraculous Ladybug to restore everyone to normal. She then gives Prem a Magical Charm and some words of wisdom that he takes to heart, before sharing a "Pound It" fist-bump with Cat Noir, Purple Tigress, and Pigella. After Purple Tigress and Pigella leave, Ladybug takes Cat Noir aside and warns him of how the new Butterfly Miraculous holder is attempting to discover their secret identities and they need to be extra vigilant now. Cat Noir assures Ladybug that she can count on him.

title: Vampigami
text:
Vampigami - Plot
Later, Prem offers his ticket to Juleka in apology and allow her to watch the movie with Rose, but after some discussion between them, Marinette arrives with Adrien and offers her ticket so Juleka, Rose, and Prem can watch the movie with Adrien and his grandparents instead. With that done, while Juleka, Rose, Prem, and Adrien go with Johnny and Gabrielle to watch the film, Marinette smiles after them, before looking at a poster for the movie sends her into a full-on freak out and running home in fear.
Unknown to her, Cerise watches her flee, before speaking to Tomoe Tsurugi via a video chat, convinced that Marinette is Ladybug. However, Tomoe is skeptical without more evidence, and suggests Cerise seek out other ways to prove it before hanging up. With nothing else to go on, Cerise hops into the Tsurugi car and commands Tatsu to take her home, which it does as it drives off.

title: Vampigami
text:
Vampigami - Plot Developments
Rose is revealed to be bald, possibly related to the disease she has had since a young age that was revealed in "Guiltrip", and to have been wearing a wig.
It is unknown if she had always been wearing a wig, or if she had just started recently.
The fact she is bald implies that she is receiving a treatment which has a side effect of causing hair to fall out, like chemotherapy. This would further indicate that the disease she is or was battling is some kind of cancer, or leukemia.
However, it should be noted that hair loss isn't a side effect exclusive to cancer or its treatment, and multiple diseases, conditions, medications, treatments, or even aggravated emotional stress can cause hair loss. Therefore, this is not confirmation that Rose has or has had cancer.
Adrien making breakfast for Marinette and himself is another showcase of his culinary skills, which he seemed to have picked up some time before "Climatiqueen". This culinary prowess is passed down in the family since his father showed this skill in episodes like "Illusion", "Intuition" and "Pretension" and his paternal grandparents showed theirs in "Werepapas".

title: Vampigami
text:
Vampigami - Plot Developments
Nathalie implies that Marinette regularly comes for breakfast alongside Adrien at the Agreste mansion.
When Adrien and Marinette talk on the phone with his grandparents, they are seen in their French fry restaurant, which they were stated to own in "Werepapas". Gabriel also worked there in his youth, as shown in his file in "Revelation".
Johnny and Gabrielle Grassette, Adrien's paternal grandparents and Gabriel's parents, buy tickets for him and Marinette to come watch the Vampire Musical Horrific Show on its golden 50th anniversary, which Adrien does at the end. His grandparents expressed their desire to know/spend time with Adrien when they first met in "Werepapas".
The movie is presented directly by André Bourgeois. In the cold open of "Grendiaper", he was shown to have become the new owner of the movie theater and lived in the same building alongside Zoé Lee since at least the beginning of the new school year.
Marinette ultimately doesn't stay to watch the movie, partially because she dislikes horror movies. Marinette's dislike for horror movies was first mentioned by herself in "Gorizilla".

title: Vampigami
text:
Vampigami - Plot Developments
Nathalie is also a fan of the Vampire Musical Horrific Show, though she keeps this to herself.
Alya tries to convince Marinette to be honest to Adrien about her dislike of horror movies. She previously gave relationship advice to Marinette in "The Illustrhater" and previously advised Marinette to be forward with her feelings towards Adrien and helped her stage possible dates in the first 5 seasons.
Prem, a character shown in the background of some episodes like "Daddycop", "Sleeping Syren" and "El Toro De Piedra", is fully introduced and shown to have befriended Marinette, Adrien and their other friends.
Loïc Stompet, Raymond Pugnant, and Nelson de Glusset try to cause strife in Rose and Juleka's relationship. They were previously shown trying to damage Kim and Ondine's relationship back in "Sleeping Syren", in which they also tried to break them up. This episode, chronologically, happened before that.
When Zoé tries to stand up to them, Ray blackmails her to stand down by threatening to show her friends the video with a bad thing she did in while in New York. He first did that at the end of "Daddycop".

title: Vampigami
text:
Vampigami - Plot Developments
Juleka is shown to be affected by Luka's distance since he is not personally there to comfort her in times of need. One of those times was in "Reflekdoll".
Among her many disguises, seen in "Re-creation" and briefly in "The Illustrhater", "Sublimation" and "Sleeping Syren", Cerise is also seen to work at the movie theater.
Cerise sent an already-powered ultrakuma and to akumatize Prem without the need to transform. This was seen when Gabriel akumatized himself in "The Collector", "Dearest Family" (briefly), "Representation" and "Conformation" and in "Startrain", where the titular villain was akumatized without Hawk Moth, proving that the Butterfly Miraculous only needs to transform in order to produce a kamiko/akuma.
It's revealed that not only can Butterfly Miraculous holders still sense emotions when detransformed, but that they are able to establish a connection with their targets, since Cerise telepathically spoke with Prem before akumatizing him.
Due to this and the similarly-powered Peacock Miraculous holders being able to sense amoks even when detransformed, it's possible that Butterfly holders are also able to sense Kamikos/Akumas when detransformed.

title: Vampigami
text:
Vampigami - Plot Developments
Also, despite being transformed, Chrysalis was able to prevent herself from getting brainwashed and still use her powers as a clone, as she was about to shoot an antikuma at Cat Noir.
Count Vampigami's power is very similar to that of Reflekta's, as both are capable of turning people into copies of themselves.
Count Vampigami's power seem to take after Reflekta's powers from "Confrontation", where both turn people into themselves by throwing an object and their copies act like them.
Cerise starts to suspect Marinette is Ladybug after watching her hiding in a restroom during an akumatized villain attack, but since the latter was warned by Tikki about the existence of a camera at the restroom and didn't transform, she doesn't have definitive proof of that. Even Tomoe pointed out if Marinette was Ladybug, she would've immediately transformed once she hid in the restroom. This was foreshadowed at the end of "Re-creation", when she said to herself that she awaited to meet Marinette again.
Cerise did learn Marinette's identity during the events of "Miraculous London". but the knowledge was erased from her mind and she was stopped from finding out again by Chronobug and Bunnyx.

title: Vampigami
text:
Vampigami - Plot Developments
Marinette/Ladybug stated she already had a feeling abut the new Butterfly holder's intentions, which was confirmed in this episode. This feeling may be due to the events of "Miraculous London".
It is revealed that Cerise is an accomplice of Tomoe Tsurugi and that their main objective is not to retrieve Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses with the akumatizations, but, rather, discover their identities. The akumatized villains are treated by Cerise as more of distractions rather than actual competent henchmen, and their main purpose is to allow Cerise to examine and observe the heroes.
Cerise previously took Tomoe's laptop after she dropped it in "Revolution" to enter the Agreste mansion during "Re-creation" to steal the Butterfly Miraculous.
At the end, she is shown to travel in a limousine similar to Tomoe's car, which also has the Tatsu AI.

title: Vampigami
text:
Vampigami - Trivia
When the episode was aired in Russia, Rose and Juleka's relationship was censored. Rather than Juleka being jealous of Prem due to his closeness and similarities to Rose, she is jealous of Rose and has a crush on Prem.
Allusions
Prem refers to Marinette and Adrien as "Adri(e)nette", which is commonly used as their ship name in fan spaces.
The Vampire Musical Horrific Show is a cult horror musical film with a tradition of people dressing up for its showings and doing and reciting formulaic things throughout the movie, a clear reference to the 1975 film The Rocky Horror Picture Show, a movie adaptation of the 1973 musical The Rocky Horror Show, both of which have gained a cult following in the LGBTQ community.
Prem's akumatization design is based on Count Dracula, the titular character and villain of Bram Stoker's 1897 novel of the same name, which has inspired many vampire movies, as well as Tim Curry's potrayal of Frank-N-Furter, one of the main characters of The Rocky Horror Picture Show.
Count Vampigami's dance moves reference Michael Jackson's moves for Thriller.
Errors
When Juleka calls Luka, her hair in her profile picture is missing the purple streaks.

text:
United Heroez bracelets - Intro
The  are bracelets created by Majestia that allow members of the United Heroez to transform into their superhero identities.

title: United Heroez bracelets
text:
United Heroez bracelets - Appearance
The United Heroez bracelet is a thin gold bracelet with a heptagonal plate depicting a golden shield with the United Heroez symbol, red and white heptagonal bands, a blue background, and a white star button.

title: United Heroez bracelets
text:
United Heroez bracelets - Abilities
Extremely discreet and derived from alien technology, the bracelets allow the wearer to transform into their superhero identities in the blink of an eye. Simply press the United Heroez symbol and be enveloped in the costume.

title: United Heroez bracelets
text:
United Heroez bracelets - Trivia
These bracelets may be inspired by the "Dragon Ball" manga, its sequels, and the animated series.
In fact, several characters use high-tech devices, in this case a watch, to transform into superheroes, such as Son Gohan in Great Saiyaman (Intergalactic Warrior).

Marinette: (Lifts her head, throwing the pamphlet away) Oh, no, nonsense. I love it when my heart jumps out of my chest. Horror movies are the best! (Smiles awkwardly).
(Having finished the call, Rose puts her phone in her purse with a frown and stands up from her seat.)
Prem: (Looking at her) Where are you going, Princess Rose?
Rose: Juleka's not okay and it's my fault. She's always there for me, and tonight I'm not there for her. I didn't realize she'd be so sad if I went to this movie without her.
(Rose runs towards the exit.)
Marinette: I'll go with Rose!
Adrien: No, you stay. I'll go.
Marinette: (Stands up) No, no, no. This is an important moment for you and your grandparents.
Adrien: You're going to miss the movie.
Marinette: It's okay, I already hate it anyway.
Adrien: But-!
Marinette: Adrien, you were right all along. I still don't like horror movies, but I was afraid not coming with you would drive us away from each other, that you'd be disappointed in me, that you'd love me less.

title: Vampigami/Transcript
text:
Vampigami/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: Marinette, the only thing that could disappoint me is if you feel you can't be honest with me and you force yourself to do something you don't want to just to please me.
(Hearing this, Marinette smiles, and the two kiss. Marinette then leaves to look for Rose.)
Prem: Ugh, the blame falls upon me, (Sees Rose leave the theater) I'm the one who caused such distress between Rose and Juleka. I did something horrific! (Puts a hand on his head) I'm horrific! I'm horrific!
(The mysterious figure pulls a box out from her jacket and opens it. There is an Ultrakuma inside, which begins to fly toward Prem and enters into the paper bat he is holding.)
Chrysalis: Hello, forgive my intrusion, but I sensed a great deal of guilt.
Prem: (Turns his back on her) Get out of my head evil super villain! I've done enough harm as it is today. If I listen to you, I'll make someone else broken hearted.
Chrysalis: (Appears at his side again) You're wrong about my intentions, dear Prem. People think I'm an evil person like the former Hawk Moth, (She appears crouching in front of him) when really, I only want to help my fellow humans.
Prem: (looks at her) Why should I believe you?

title: Vampigami/Transcript
text:
Vampigami/Transcript - Intro
Chrysalis: (Appears standing up) Because I'm offering you the power of your choosing and (Walks away) I'm not asking for anything in return. (Appears behind Prem again) Not even Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous.
(While they're talking, the scene changes to Rose, she tries to open the cinema's exit door, but it's locked with a padlock) What more do you need to believe I'm acting selflessly?
Prem: You're not tricking me?
(Rose kneels in front of the door, then the view returns to Prem's mind.)
Chrysalis: Of course not. Just tell me what should I call you and see for yourself.
Prem: Fine... then call me Count Vampigami!
(Chrysalis closes her palm over him.)
André: Huh? Ahh! (Runs away).
Count Vampigami: (On the stage) If Princess Rose and Juleka can't come to the movie... The movie will come to the princesses!
(Marinette hears a muffled scream coming from the movie theatre, she turns around and sees several people running out of the theatre, screaming.)
Woman: Move! I think we should get out of here.
(Seeing this, Marinette goes into the bathroom to transform.)
Count Vampigami: I'm not Prem. I'm Count Vampigami.

title: Vampigami/Transcript
text:
Vampigami/Transcript - Intro
(Count Vampigami picks up two origami bats and throws them at the audience, then he applauds, turning the origami bats white.)
(The origami bats fly toward Adrien, but he manages to dodge them by throwing himself to the ground. However, they hit two people behind him instead, and when they’re struck, they turn into slightly different copies of Count Vampigami.)
(Count Vampigami applauds again, and the copies get their own origami bats, which they try to throw at Adrien. Seeing this, Adrien shudders, quickly gets up and runs away.)
Woman: What's happening!?
(Adrien dodges the bats thrown at him, but they hit more civilians instead, turning them too into copies.)
(Tikki comes out of her hiding place and looks around the bathroom. She notices an opening in the ceiling with a camera inside thanks to the bathroom's mirror.)
Tikki: (Gasp)
Marinette: Tik-!
Tikki: (Interrupts her) Be quiet Marinette! Don't say a word! And whatever you do, do not transform. There's a video camera above. (Marinette straightens up) Unlike kwamis, you can be filmed and recorded, so just act like you're afraid of the akumatized villain and you've come here to hide.

title: Vampigami/Transcript
text:
Vampigami/Transcript - Intro
(The mysterious figure is currently watching the live feed from the bathroom camera on their phone, Tikki doesn't appear on it.)

Marinette: Ah!

Adrien: Plagg, Claws out!

Cat Noir: Cataclysm!

Count Vampigami: Princess Rose, stay, stay! Count Vampigami and his friends will go get Juleka just for you.
(Rose turns to look at Count Vampigami, scared.)
Cat Noir: (Appears in front of Rose to protect her) If leaving that girl alone is beyond your skills, (He imitates Count Vampigami's dance) then you're the worst vampire friend there is.

title: Vampigami/Transcript
text:
Vampigami/Transcript - Intro
Count Vampigami: (Still dancing) I'm not in the mood for jokes fuzz bucket! Step aside (Applauds, giving all his copies origami bats) or get ready to express regret!

(Cat Noir uses his staff to send Ladybug a message, and jumps away avoiding the bats that were thrown at him.)
(From someone's perspective, this figure is following Marinette as she rushes out of the cinema. But when they leave the cinema, Marinette turns on the corner and the figure loses sight of her.)

title: Vampigami/Transcript
text:
Vampigami/Transcript - Intro

Tikki: It could be a trap from the new holder of the Butterfly Miraculous.
Marinette: I don't know, but we're going to have to be extra careful. Tikki, Spots On! (Transforms into Ladybug and notices her Yo-yo ringing.)

(Ladybug opens the Miraculous Call system and selects the Miraculous of the Tiger and Pig.)

(An origami bat nearly hits Cat Noir from behind. When he turns around, he discovers that three copies of Count Vampigami have cornered him on the ceiling and throw at him with more origami bats.)
Ladybug: (Appears and blocks all the origami bats with her Yo-yo) For now, I'll be the one joining him! Keep away from the kitty, vampires.
Cat Noir: Ah, M'Lady! So glad to see you!

title: Vampigami/Transcript
text:

Ladybug: (Laughs nervously) Yeah, same, I'm super glad. I love scary vampires! (Laughs nervously again).
(The Count Vampigami copies rush toward them, so Ladybug and Cat Noir flee from the building and land on the ground in front of the street where the original Count Vampigami is.)
Cat Noir: And these ones sing too. Vampigami over there, (View of the Count Vampigami parade on the street in front of them) he's the one running the show.
Ladybug: He doesn't look terrifying at all! (Nervous laugh).
Cat Noir: (Hears teeth chattering beside him) Is that noise coming from you?
Ladybug: (Stops trembling) Me?! No! What noise? Oh, right! It's my fingers! (Snaps her fingers to the beat of Count Vampigami's music) I can't help it. Whenever I hear music, I have to snap my fingers! (laughs nervously).
(Count Vampigami claps his hands, and his copies receive more origami bats, which, at Count Vampigami’s signal, launch toward Ladybug and Cat Noir. They block the bats using their weapons.)
Cat Noir: This music does make you want to sing and clap your hands.
Ladybug: Vampigami, on the other hand, must be stopped from clapping his hands.

title: Vampigami/Transcript
text:
Vampigami/Transcript - Intro
(As she says this, Count Vampigami claps his hands again, giving his copies more origami bats.)
Cat Noir: Well spotted, M'Lady. (Avoding the origami bats) When he claps his hands, his zombie dancers get new battle origamis.
(Pigella and Purple Tigress arrive to the battle landing behind Ladybug and Cat Noir.)

Cat Noir: Pigella, Purple Tigress, you're right on time for the vampire dance.

Ladybug: Cat Noir, get the party started with your cataclysms, I've got you covered. (Runs foward) Lucky Charm!

(From the perspective of one of the copies behind the original Count Vampigami, the copy positions itself as if to launch an Antikuma at Cat Noir, who is jumping over Count Vampigami copies.)

title: Vampigami/Transcript
text:
Vampigami/Transcript - Intro
(The scene shifts to Ladybug swinging with her yo-yo and Purple Tigress running across the rooftops, flanking Count Vampigami.)
Ladybug: Purple Tigress, you're up!
Purple Tigress: Gladly. (Jumps towards the Count Vampigamis) Clout!
(The Count Vampigami copy was about to fire an Antikuma at Cat Noir, but before she could do so, she noticed Purple Tigress lunging towards her with Clout.)
Vampigami copy: Huh?
(Clout sends all the Count Vampigamis flying into the air, and Ladybug uses her yo-yo to tie up the original Count Vampigami and hurls it toward Pigella.)

Ladybug: Pigella, you're next!

Pigella: Gift!

Count Vampigami: Urgh... Hmm?

(Ladybug lands in front of him and uses her yo-yo to snatch the origami bats from him, which she then tears apart. The Ultrakuma comes flying out of them.)

title: Vampigami/Transcript
text:
Vampigami/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: No more evil doing for you, Ultrakuma. (She opens her yo-yo) Time to de-evilize! (She snatch the Ultrakuma in the air) Gotcha! (Let's the now white butterfly go) Bye bye, little butterfly. Miraculous Ladybug!
(The bowling ball transforms into a swarm of ladybugs that repair all the damage caused by the fight and return everyone back to normal.)
Prem: Hmm? Ladybug, what did I do?
(Ladybug takes a Magical Charm out of her yo-yo and gives it to Prem.)
Ladybug: This magical charm will help you remember that you can dance on your own or with another person, (They both stand up) or even in a group, (The rest of the team lands behind her) but that some people may just not want to dance and that's okay too.
(Prem smiles and nods.)
The Miraculers: Pound it!
(Pigella and Purple Tigress leave, and Cat Noir was about to leave too, but is stopped by Ladybug grabbing his belt.)
Cat Noir: Hm?(Ladybug looks around with suspicion, then approaches Cat Noir to whisper in his ear.)''

title: Vampigami/Transcript
text:
Vampigami/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: Cat Noir, the new holder of the Miraculous is not trying to defeat us by using their akumatized villians to fight us. They want to defeat us by figuring out who we really are. They're spying on us, I already had a feeling but it was confirmed today. We've got to stay alert.

Prem: I'm sorry Princess Juleka, I never wanted to form rain clouds in the blue sky of your relationship with Princess Rose or upset you. If this is going to bring you sadness, I'd rather not see the movie with Princess Rose. (Stands up, still offering Juleka the ticket) You go with her.
