Adrien: Plagg, no!

title: Volpina/Transcript
text:
Volpina/Transcript - Intro
Plagg: (muffled) My, my, what have we got here? A book on Tibet, an old flyer from a hotel, a load of junk, come on, where's the good stuff? (knocks the book Gabriel was looking at into Adrien's arms) I've seen this book somewhere before. But who cares? I'm famished! I need Camembert!
Adrien: Why is my dad keeping this locked in a safe? (stares at a page with a picture of an ancient Chinese Hawk Moth) Hawk Moth? What's this monster doing in a book about superheroes?
Plagg: Cheese! Didn't you hear me?
(Adrien gasps after hearing approaching footsteps, and hides the book in his school bag and closes the picture just as Nathalie and Placide I.T. enter the room.)
Nathalie: Adrien? You're going to be late.
(Placide I.T. grunts.)
Adrien: I was...looking for my homework. Silly me. (chuckles nervously)
Rose: Can you believe Lila knows Prince Ali? She even flew in his private jet with him!
Chloé: Why did Jagged Stone write a song about Lila when he could've written it about me?
Nino: Lila knows all of the Hollywood directors. She promised she'd mention me to Steven Basielberg himself!
Marinette: (rushes back to Alya's side) Lila?

title: Volpina/Transcript
text:
Volpina/Transcript - Intro
Alya: Yeah, she just started at our school! (points to Lila, who's on the second floor of the school with Adrien) She even gave me an exclusive interview for the Ladyblog, 'cause Ladybug saved her life once! Watch! (shows Marinette the video of Lila on her blog)
Marinette: Who is this girl and what is she doing next to the love of my life?!
Alya: Lila's got the most incredible life, and now she's going here. She's totally awesome!
Marinette: (daydreaming) What?! Don't say that! This is super bad, what if Adrien totally falls for her?! I've never flown in a private jet; nobody's ever written a song about me; and I don't know a single person in Hollywood! Adrien will forget I even exist! (Lila guides Adrien along by the hand)
Marinette: (gasping) Where are they going? Alya, we've got to stop them!
Alya: You need to chill out, Marinette. My Ladyblog has the highest number of hits ever after that Lila interview! (walks away)
Marinette: What's going on? I mean has this Lila girl hypnotized everyone or something?
Tikki: You wouldn't be a little jealous, Marinette?
Marinette: Huh! Me, jealous? No way! (runs after Lila and Adrien)
Marinette: Where is she?

title: Volpina/Transcript
text:
Volpina/Transcript - Intro
(Adrien takes the book from his dad's safe out of his bag, and Tikki gasps and leaves Marinette's purse.)
Tikki: Marinette, Adrien's book! I need to get a closer look at it.
Marinette: Why are you so concerned about his book? Hide, Tikki!
(Tikki flies over to a bookcase right next to Adrien.)
Lila: Now we can get going on our history homework. It's so much more fun doing it together, don't you think? (notices Adrien's book and grabs it from under the other book he was using to hide it) What's that?
Adrien: Uh nothing! Just stories about superheroes.
Lila: (puts her hand on top of Adrien's) I love superheroes!
Marinette: (gasps from behind the bookcase) It's already too late! (bumps into a book cart, pushing it by accident. Tikki watches Lila as she flips through the book turning to the page on Ladybug)
Lila: Ladybug!
Adrien: (sighing) She's amazing.
Lila: A girl doesn't need to wear a costume to be amazing, you know. (scoots her seat closer to Adrien)
Adrien: Uh, I don't know—I mean, I—
Lila: So you've got a little soft spot for the bug, huh?
Adrien: Me? Oh, no! Not at all!
(The book cart moves closer to them, but is unnoticed.)

title: Volpina/Transcript
text:
Volpina/Transcript - Intro
Lila: You know I actually happen to be very close friends with Ladybug.
(Adrien and Marinette both gasp.)
Adrien: Really?!
Lila: We can chat about it if you want. Not here though. Why don't we meet at the park after school and I'll tell you everything.
(Marinette accidentally slams the cart into the wall, causing Adrien and Lila to stand up in surprise. Marinette has hidden under their table.)
Adrien: (gets an alert from his phone) I gotta go! I've got a lesson in 58 seconds. (Lila causes Adrien to drop his bag on the floor)
Lila: So, the park? (pushes the superhero book on the floor away from Adrien's bag with her foot)
Adrien: Uh sure! (runs out)
Lila: (picks up the book) A vixen superheroine? Hmm, interesting... (leaves the library)
Tikki: Marinette!
Marinette: I know. I gotta talk to Adrien before he meets up with Lila in the park. He needs to know that she's a total thief.
Tikki: No! You can't say anything to Adrien yet. I need a chance to check out the book first. If it's the one I think it is we have to get our hands on it!
Marinette: I don't get it? Exactly why would we need it?
Tikki: I'll explain to you once I know for sure. Please, we mustn't let Lila out of our sight!

title: Volpina/Transcript
text:
Volpina/Transcript - Intro
Lila: (in the video) Ladybug and me, we're like this! (crosses her fingers together)
Marinette: Liar!
Tikki: There! She's coming out!
(Lila exits a jewelry store.)
Tikki: We're too far away.
(Marinette uses the zoom on her phone to get a closer look at Lila, who is putting on a necklace with a fox tail charm. Lila pulls out the book, but then quickly hides it when Adrien approaches)
Lila: Oh hi!
Marinette: (sees Adrien) Oh no! He's already here!
Adrien: Hey! (Lila throws the book in the trash behind her)
Marinette: She dumped the book in the trash bin! What a brat!
Tikki: I'll get it–
Marinette: No Tikki!
Tikki: I have to get that book! You take care of Adrien. (flies to the trash canister)
Marinette: Tikki! (runs after her hiding behind the trash canister)
(Tikki struggles to get the book out of the trash.)
Adrien: So you do know Ladybug, for real?
Tikki: (carrying the book) This is the book Marinette! (Marinette grabs the book)
Lila: Not only did Ladybug save my life, we've become very close friends because we have something very special in common- it's what I wanted to tell you about. I'm the descendant of a vixen superheroine myself, Volpina.
Adrien: Volpina?

title: Volpina/Transcript
text:
Volpina/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Volpina?
Adrien: Wait a minute! I think I read about her in my book.
Lila: (stopping him from grabbing the book) Of course she's in your book. She's one of the most important superheroes. More powerful and more celebrated than Ladybug. (Marinette is angered by the comment) Between you and me Ladybug doesn't even make the top ten. (Marinette bites down on the book) My grandma gave me this necklace.
Tikki: Wow she's good. Really good (Marinette runs just out of the park)
Marinette: You've got your book. I can't lose Adrien. Time to transform!
[Transformation Sequence]
Marinette: Tikki, spots on! Yeah! (Marinette transforms into Ladybug.)
Adrien: (holding Lila's necklace) Are you telling me this is a Miraculous?! (Ladybug lands in front of them)

title: Volpina/Transcript
text:
Volpina/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: (sarcastically) Well hey Lila! How's it going? Long time no see. I saw your interview on the Ladyblog, awesome job. (puts her foot on the bench between Lila and Adrien, and leans closer to Lila) Oh sure! I remember our instant connection when I saved your life and we've been really good friends ever since! Practically BFF's! Uh actually, when did I save your life again, Lila? I don't recall. Oh yes! Of course, now I remember. Never! And we're not friends either! (to Adrien) Miss Show-Off here was trying to impress you and everyone around her.
Adrien: (to Lila, who is crying) So I guess you aren't the descendant of a superhero either?
Ladybug: She's more like a super liar.
Lila: How dare you?!
Adrien: Wait! Lila! (Lila runs away) Hey, what was that all about? Uh, I mean, weren't you kinda harsh with her?
Ladybug: I...I don't put up with lies, especially when they're about me. (yo-yos away)
Adrien: (confused) What is with you, Ladybug?
Ladybug: I may have gone a bit overboard there, but at least I'm not dealing with her anymore. (grasps her yo-yo and leaves)
Lila: My chances with Adrien, gone! I hate you, Ladybug! (throws her bag at the poster)

title: Volpina/Transcript
text:
Volpina/Transcript - Intro
Hawk Moth: (his window opens) Ah...jealousy, deceit, and the desire to be a superhero. This young lady is my perfect prey. (turns butterfly into akuma) Fly, my evil little one, and akumatize her!
(The akuma lands on Lila's fox tail necklace.)
Hawk Moth:  (from his lair) Volpina, I am Hawk Moth. I'm giving you the power of illusion, from now on, your lies will come to life. Gain Ladybug and Cat Noir's trust and convince them you're a real superhero, then betray them and bring me their Miraculous.
Lila: It would be my pleasure, Hawk Moth. (transforms into Volpina and uses her new power to change the poster of Ladybug into one of Volpina and Adrien)
[Transformation Sequence]
Adrien: Plagg, claws out! (Adrien transforms into Cat Noir.)
Ladybug: Code Red!
(Ladybug yo-yos towards the meteor, but is surprised by Volpina, who flies under the meteor and catches it before it hits the Louvre pyramid. She hurls it back into the sky, where it vanishes as it hits a pigeon. Volpina flies down onto a building, but is revealed to be an illusion when the real Volpina swats her away. Volpina then addresses the Parisians below.)

title: Volpina/Transcript
text:
Volpina/Transcript - Intro
Volpina: I am Volpina, the only superhero Paris needs! (Citizens chant her name)
Ladybug: (standing on a nearby roof) Volpina?
Cat Noir: (lands next to Ladybug) Looks like we have a new partner.
Ladybug: Don't you think it's weird, this superhero just appearing out of nowhere.
Cat Noir: Well, at least she got the job done. If she hadn't been here—
Ladybug: (defensively) I could have easily stopped that meteorite myself.
Cat Noir: Hey! Relax! I'm just saying she seems seriously awesome. (Volpina lands in front of them)
Volpina: Hey guys! Glad you dropped in, I need a hand. Come on!
(Volpina flies off with Ladybug and Cat Noir following behind her. They all land on a nearby roof.)
Cat Noir: I can't believe it! It's Hawk Moth in the flesh! (Hawk Moth's figure is on a roof across from them)
Ladybug: He never shows up! Something big is going on. Really big!
Volpina: We can take him down, but it's gonna take all three of us. We better make the most of our individual talents.
Cat Noir: You can count on us.
Volpina: Very nice to meet you by the way Cat Noir! Cool outfit.
Cat Noir: (Scratching the back of his head) Why thanks! You too, Volpina. (Ladybug gags)

title: Volpina/Transcript
text:
Volpina/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: First the meteorite, now Hawk Moth appearing both on the same day. Don't you think that's a little bit unusual?
Volpina: Why would you say that?
Ladybug: (annoyed) I was asking Cat Noir.
Cat Noir: I'm finding you unusual today, My Lady. Everything okay?
Ladybug: I'm fine, just fine. (to Volpina) Say Volpina, what's your Miraculous?
Volpina: My necklace.
Ladybug: What power does it give you?
Volpina: The power of flight and super strength. (Hawk Moth disappears) He's getting away! (they all chase after him until he stops again) Ladybug, go to his left, Cat Noir, you take the right and I'll come from behind.
Ladybug: No! I...I take the right, Cat Noir goes from behind and you... take the left.
Volpina: (laughing) Fine. Makes no difference to me.
Ladybug: Good. (Volpina flies off)
Cat Noir: Can you chill out a little? She's one of us. (Cat Noir jumps off. Ladybug scoffs before heading towards Hawk Moth)
Volpina: (Watches Cat Noir running on rooftops) He's running right into my trap. (Meanwhile, Cat Noir thinks he has Hawk Moth, but he has vanished again)
Cat Noir: Where did he go? (Hawk Moth appears on a different roof) I'll take him!

title: Volpina/Transcript
text:
Volpina/Transcript - Intro
(Cat Noir continues to chase after the vanishing Hawk Moth. Back to Volpina who goes after Ladybug)
Volpina: Good! Now for the other one.
Ladybug: Where did he go?
(Her foot catches in one of Volpina's traps and when she tries to move, bombs aim at her. Volpina appears.)
Volpina: I wouldn't move an inch if I were you. (Ladybug gasps) Don't worry Ladybug, I don't wanna be your friend. At least now you won't be able to say we don't know each other. (laughs)
Ladybug: Lila?
Volpina: You will call me Volpina!
Ladybug: You're not a superhero. You're another one of Hawk Moth's akumatized victims!
Volpina: Everyone thinks I'm a superhero, including Cat Noir. So you won't be able to call me a liar anymore 'cause everyone will think you're the liar. (Hawk Moth speaks to Volpina)
Hawk Moth: Take Ladybug's Miraculous. Her earrings, now!
Volpina: (To Ladybug) Before I get rid of you, you are going to give me your Miraculous.
Ladybug: Never!
Volpina: Do you really think you've got a choice, Ladybug? You'll give me your Miraculous or the building goes down! (points to a nearby building)

title: Volpina/Transcript
text:
Volpina/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: You wouldn't do that! (Volpina blows into her flute and sends the building down) Stop! (reaches for her earrings)
(The crumbling building hits a pigeon and then vanishes, showing that it was never falling)
Ladybug: It's an illusion! Just like the meteorite! Just like Hawk Moth! That's your power Volpina, isn't it?! Illusion, lies. Of course!
(Ladybug throws her yo-yo at all the bombs and Volpina and everything vanishes)
Ladybug: (She phones Cat Noir) Is Volpina with you, Cat Noir?
Cat Noir: (Through phone) No! And I can't find Hawk Moth either.
Ladybug: Forget it. He was never there in the first place.
Cat Noir: What do you mean? But we saw him.
Ladybug: (On Cat Noir's staff) That's Volpina's power. She creates illusions. The Hawk Moth we saw wasn't real.
Cat Noir: What are you trying to say?
Ladybug: She's not a real superhero. She was akumatized by Hawk Moth!
Cat Noir: I don't get it? Why did he do it?
Ladybug: I think it's partly my fault. I ruined her chances with a guy she likes.
Cat Noir: Lila?
Ladybug: I'm sure she's going to his house. I'll send you the address. Meet me there!
Cat Noir: You got it! (He hangs up) I think I know the way already.

title: Volpina/Transcript
text:
Volpina/Transcript - Intro
Plagg: Wouldn't Cat Noir be more useful in this situation?
Adrien: If Volpina's got a thing for me, I can make her see sense without Cat Noir. Maybe then she'll listen.
Plagg: You really think you can take down Volpina without your super powers? Without me?
Adrien: (sees Volpina) Hide Plagg, she's coming! (Plagg goes in his jacket)
Volpina: Adrien!
Adrien: Hey! Who are you?
Volpina: Do you remember this necklace? I didn't know how to tell you the truth, but at least this way you can see for yourself that I'm not lying. I am a superhero.
Adrien: Lila!
Volpina: You can call me Volpina. I'm sorry about the scene in the park earlier today. Ladybug's jealous because she's not as powerful as me.
Ladybug: (hanging outside of Adrien's window) You'll see Ladybug isn't just a figment of your imagination, Volpina. (Ladybug calls Cat Noir, but he doesn't answer)
Ladybug: What is he doing? No time to hang around and wait any longer. (Ladybug swings into Adrien's room)
Volpina: See what I mean! She's jealous of me, of you, of us, but this time you aren't going to ruin our date Ladybug.

title: Volpina/Transcript
text:
Volpina/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: Mm excuse me, but it wasn't really quite a date, per say. (Volpina turns to him angrily) I mean- what I meant was it could've become one right? No need to get bent out of shape!
Ladybug: (to Adrien) Excuse us, but I need to have a chat with super liar. (to Volpina) You! Stop thinking your illusions are reality!
(Adrien runs into the bathroom, and shuts the door.)
Plagg: So, was I right or was I right?
Adrien: Come on Plagg, Claws Out!
(Meanwhile Ladybug and Volpina are fighting in Adrien's room.)
Cat Noir: (has landed in the open window) Sorry I'm late. I had some trouble... (jumps into the room) ...finding the place.
(Volpina uses her flute to make a bunch of other Volpinas to hide in. Ladybug swats them away.)
Cat Noir: Illusions!
(At that moment, Volpina is seen outside, leaping away with a captive "Adrien".)
Ladybug: Cat Noir! She's taken "Adrien"!
Cat Noir: That's an illusion, too!
Ladybug: How are you so sure?
Cat Noir: Uh...my..um...feline sixth sense. It's legendary! Oh...
(Ladybug goes over to the bathroom and finds it empty.)
Ladybug: Really? You don't say! "Adrien"'s gone! (leaps out the window)
Cat Noir: I'm not even gonna try to get out of this.

title: Volpina/Transcript
text:
Volpina/Transcript - Intro
(Volpina laughs evilly as Cat Noir and Ladybug climb up the tower.)
Volpina: Give me your Miraculous now or I will!
Ladybug: I thought you loved him!
Volpina: Not as much as seeing you two defeated! (to "Adrien") No hard feelings, right?
Cat Noir: You're bluffing. It's another illusion.
Volpina: You wanna bet on that? (releases one finger at a time on her grip on "Adrien")
Ladybug: (screams) NO!! (reaches for her earrings)
Cat Noir: Don't do it, Ladybug! (throws his baton at Volpina and "Adrien")
Ladybug: No!
(The illusion of Adrien vanishes, and Volpina along with it.)
Ladybug: (spots the real Volpina) There she is!
(They all climb to the top of the tower and Volpina plays her flute to create more illusions of herself.)
Ladybug: Lucky Charm! (A chocolate popsicle appears) Huh? (she opens it and the bright inner wrapper makes her squint) I've got an idea to take down Volpina!
Cat Noir: With a chocolate popsicle?
Ladybug: Trust me. Get ready.
Cat Noir: Cataclysm!
(Ladybug uses the shiny wrapper to blind the real Volpina, and Cat Noir uses Cataclysm to make a cage around her with the tower's metal.)

title: Volpina/Transcript
text:
Volpina/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: Trapped! Like a fox! (grabs Volpina's necklace) Your days are over, akuma! (breaks the necklace, releasing the akuma) Time to de-evilize! (captures the akuma in her yo-yo) Gotcha! (releases the white butterfly) Bye, bye little butterfly. (throws the ice cream in the air) Miraculous Ladybug! (The Miraculous wave puts everything back to normal, including Lila) Lila?
Lila: Ladybug?
Ladybug: I... totally overreacted and... never should've spoken to you like that. I'm sorry.
Lila: Forget it, Ladybug; you were right. We'll never be friends. (picks up her necklace and walks away)
Cat Noir: Ouch...
Hawk Moth: She's still angry. You're not done with Volpina yet, Ladybug. You haven't seen the last of her.
Ladybug: There's one problem we still have to solve. Where's Adrien?
Cat Noir: Uh...everything's been put back to normal, right? So he must be safely back at home.
Ladybug: I should check to make sure!
Cat Noir: Uh... No, don't worry about it! I'll go! You're about to change back. (Ladybug's earrings beep)
Ladybug: So are you. (Cat Noir's ring beeps) No arguing. I'll take care of it. (jumps off the tower)

title: Volpina/Transcript
text:
Volpina/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: Ugh! That stubbornness... It's so...so... (fondly) ...irresistible. (leaps off to follow Ladybug)
(Ladybug walks, then runs, over to the bathroom door.)
Ladybug: Adrien? (Cat Noir is in a panic) Are you there? (slides open the bathroom door) Can I come in? (Cat Noir turns on the shower)
Ladybug: (hears the shower, quickly slides the door shut again, and jumps back) This is...Ladybug. Is everything okay?
Cat Noir: Uh...yeah, yeah. I had to grab a shower after all this excitement. (leans with his ear up to the door)
Ladybug: Uh....oh...yeah...sure. I'm sorry. I'll be off then, huh.
Cat Noir: Thank you!
(They both lean their heads against either side of the door, mirroring each other. Ladybug yo-yos out through the window. Cat Noir opens the door and walks out, sadly staring out the window.)
Marinette: (to Tikki) This book could've been my connection to Adrien without my Ladybug mask for once, but I get that I'm not gonna be returning it to him.
Tikki: I'm really sorry Marinette, but its information is invaluable.
Marinette: Information? But it's all written in code.
Tikki: I know someone who's been looking for this for a long time. He knows how to decipher the codes.

title: Volpina/Transcript
text:
Volpina/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: So what exactly is so special about this book?
Tikki: It contains all the secrets of the Miraculous powers. It's sacred and extremely dangerous in the wrong hands. He needs it back.
Marinette: I don't get it, Tikki. Just tell me what's going on. Please, who is he?
Tikki: The Great Guardian. And I think the time has come for you to finally meet him.
Adrien: Did you take my father's book, Plagg?
Plagg: (mouth stuffed with cheese) Of course not!
Adrien: If he finds out it's missing, I'll have something worse than Hawk Moth to deal with.
(Marinette and Tikki enter the room.)
Master Fu: Hello, Ladybug.
(The door closes behind Marinette on its own.)

title: Vivica
text:
Vivica - Intro
is a minor character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She is a professional guitarist.
In "Desperada", after being temporarily fired by Jagged Stone for eating his cereal and drinking Fang's milk, she was akumatized by Hawk Moth into Desperada, a skeleton/mariachi-themed supervillain.

title: Vivica
text:
Vivica - Appearance
Physical appearance
Vivica is a slender teenage girl of average height. She has light red lipstick, dark brown eyes, thick dark brown eyebrows, and long dark brown hair with bangs that covers a bit of her right eye and face, which is also tied in a low ponytail. She has a mole on her right cheek below her eye and also wears braces.
Civilian attire
In her civilian attire, she wears a reddish brownish black t-shirt with red letters underneath a grayish malachite green jacket hoodie. She also sports blue jeans and knee-length black and white platform soled boots.
As Desperada

title: Vivica
text:
Vivica - Appearance
As Desperada, she looked like a skeleton from Día de los Muertos with light gray skin, violetish black hair that half covered her right eye and face which was also tied into a low ponytail, black eyeshadow, deep blue-violet lipstick, and two black musical notes shaped eyebrows and two more musical notes that were on both sides of her cheeks and hands. Her nose is painted with very dark cornflower blue skin paint, and her eyes had dark purple sclerae, moderate amber irises and small, round black pupils. She wore a black Traje/Mariachi jacket with pointed shoulders and gold bones details on the chuffs, underneath a yellow t-shirt with swan-necked collar and a logo (white circle with black outline and a musical note on the top, and 3 black bones on the right, left and bottom), on her chest and neck. She also wore black pants with gold long bone designs on side of the legs, and gold high heel shoes that were connected to them. She also had black star-shaped guitar case on her back.

title: Vivica
text:
Vivica - Personality
Not much is known about Vivica's real personality. However, if she is anything like her akumatized persona, she has a deep love for music. She also can get very upset when her work is underappreciated, like when Jagged fired her for a very unfair reason, leading to her akumatization. But she is forgiving, as Vivica accepted Jagged's apology and invite to return to her job as his guitarist.
As Desperada, she disliked anyone that tried to replace her such as Adrien Agreste. Even if that one person refused to take her job, the mere fact that person was even considered by Jagged made them a target to her, like Anarka (who was her first victim).
She's shown to be determined and skilled in her pursuit of Ladybug and Aspik. Desperada's one of the most competent villains, able to successfully defeat Ladybug nearly 26,000 times.

title: Vivica
text:
Vivica - Personality
Desperada had a very high respect for musical instruments as a whole, especially stringed instruments, "punishing" those who dared to play them wrongly, like when turned into stickers all the pigeons that were pecking the strings of Luka's guitar. That high respect for stringed instruments could also become her undoing, as Desperada could get easily distracted by anyone who played a stringed instrument near her, such as Viperion who used his lyre strumming to distract her so Ladybug and Cat Noir could disarm her and then quickly subdue her and take her akumatized object.

title: Vivica
text:
Vivica - Abilities
As a civilian
Vivica is a skilled guitarist, even skilled enough to be recognized by the rockstar, Jagged Stone.
Vivica is generally observant and good at hiding, a skill which she could use to make sneak attacks while she was Akumatized.
As Desperada
Desperada could summon a variety of music-based weapons from her guitar case. Any person or object who was hit by these was transformed into a sticker on said case. Her known weapons included:
A trumpet that fired blasts of yellow energy that transformed anyone she hit into yellow dust. She also could use the smoke as smokescreen to distract her enemies.
A medieval-axe-shaped guitar.
A pair of bicycle horns resembling dueling pistols that also fired out yellow energy.
A trombone that resembled a sniper rifle.

title: Vivica
text:
Vivica - Relationships
Friends/Allies
Jagged Stone
Vivica is Jagged Stone's guitarist. However, after she accidentally ate Jagged's cereal and drank Fang's milk, the rock star fired her and searched to replace her, something that leads to her akumatization as Desperada. After she is de-akumatized, Jagged rehired her and the two made peace with one another.
As Desperada, she wants to make Jagged pay for firing her, all while getting rid of anyone he had considered to take her place. She ends up transforming him into a sticker.
Anarka Couffaine
Like Desperada, she catches Anarka in her a guitar case, while Jagged Stone wanted to replace it with her. At the end, Vivica and Anarka can be seen playing the guitar together at the Liberty.

title: Vivica
text:
Vivica - Trivia
Vivica is the first character in the show to have braces.
When akumatized, she referred to herself as Vivica and Desperada on separate occasions. She is the first akumatized villain to refer to both their previous and akumatized identity.
Originally, Desperada's character looked like Deathstroke from DC Comics with a musical twist.
Vivica is based on a real person of the same name. As the winner of a contest at the Miraculous Ladybug panel at Los Angeles Comic Con 2016, Vivica got to help create a future Akumatized character during a visit at Zag Studios in Los Angeles.
The real Vivica said she wanted to be a vet when she grew up, which is what inspired the character Vivica's job and Akumatized form in early development, though it has since changed.
According to the whiteboard seen behind Jeremy Zag during the meeting for creating Vivica, Vivica was originally going to be a fan of Cat Noir and felt like he doesn't get enough attention.
Based on the whiteboard, either Hawk Moth, who "knows Cat very well", might have gotten jealous of Vivica or something else, or Vivica might have become jealous and it led to her akumatization.

title: Vivica
text:
Vivica - Trivia
As of May 17, 2017, Vivica's episode had not been written, and the French crew didn't know about Vivica even being a character. As Season 3 was written completely then, it's possible that that Vivica isn't the same Vivica as the one seen in the show, and that she might appear in the future.
A year later, on June 3, 2018, Thomas Astruc noted that Vivica would still appear, but ideas from her development early on have changed. It's currently unknown whether the real Vivica was involved with the changes, or if they were done by the writing team.
It's possible, however, that only her akumatized form was changed, and all other parts of her character remained the same, as the Vivica seen in the show shares a lot of her physical features with the real Vivica (similar skin tone, similar hair, similar eye color, and both have braces).
She is one of four characters who were akumatized villains in the first three seasons who did not appear in any way in seasons 4 and 5, the others being Vincent Asa, Simon Grimault and an unnamed boy.

title: Véronique
text:
Véronique - Intro
is a minor character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She works at Musée Grévin.
In "Determination", after Mayor Bourgeois forbade Véronique from exposing the wax statues of the inactive superheroes of The Miraculers at the cost of closing the Grévin, she was akumatized by Monarch into Manipula, a wax-themed supervillain with the power to bring a wax statue to life and received the Ox Miraculous superpower of Resistance through her Alliance ring. She also received a Magical Charm from Ladybug to prevent her from being reakumatized.

title: Véronique
text:
Véronique - Appearance
Physical appearance
Véronique has straight brown auburn hair in a bob that is brushed towards the outside with a straight-cut fringe gently divided and moderate vermilion eyes. The tips of her hair are dyed in dark blonde auburn.
Civilian attire
She wears a pair of square-framed glasses with a luminous vivid orange and black stripped tiger pattern, eyeliner, red lipstick, a festive vivid red short-sleeved knee-length dress with a round neckline and a pleated-hem, and festive vivid red dress shoes adorned with white rectangles and lining and strong red soles.
As Manipula

title: Véronique
text:
Véronique - Appearance
She had pale yellow skin and light yellow hair that curled upward into a candle with a wick on top of it. Her eyes were brilliant yellow with vivid orange sclerae, and they were shaded by light yellow sunglasses with triangular lenses with fake melted candle wax droppings. She wore a dark gold blouse with a light gold tie, underneath a vivid gold dress jacket with small oval shaped shoulder pads, white ovals with gold outlines, a light goldish gray collar with brilliant yellow lining, and fake melted wax features on her shoulders and lower arms, and medium sized coattails. She also wore vivid gold dress pants with round legs, and matching medium heeled boots.

title: Véronique
text:
Véronique - Personality
As a civilian
Véronique is very passionate with her work, taking good care of the wax statues in it so people can admire them and have a good time at the museum. It is at her believe that the wax statues of the famous people exposed there can inspire the visitors. This is reflected by how she had an entire room dedicated to Ladybug and Cat Noir along with the statues of akumatized villains that represent the people they have saved.
After Monarch stole all the Miraculous under Ladybug's care, in order to help the heroes, Véronique decided to build an entire exposition about Ladybug and Cat Noir together with their superhero team with the intent of giving hope to the visitors.
As Manipula

title: Véronique
text:
Véronique - Personality
Her sense of heroism was twisted by Monarch who made her believe that it was Ladybug's fault that the Miraculous were lost, the other superheroes were gone and the reason why the mayor forbade her from opening her exposition. As well as causing her to act overconfidence, cocky and gloatful firstly she believed in Monarch's promise he would stop akumatizing people if she delivered him Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous (and thinking she would be able to stop him if he went back on his word, unaware he could just take way her powers), Manipula stopped at nothing to defeat the two heroes, all while getting her revenge on Mayor Bourgeois for forbidding her from exposing her superhero wax statues.
She hastily believed just because she had a team and the heroes didn't, Manipula could easily defeat them, unknown to her that numbers don't always decide who wins and loses.

title: Véronique
text:
Véronique - Abilities
As Manipula
She could place a pamphlet on the forehead of a wax statue, animating the statues and allowing her to control them. The animated statues were able to replicate the powers of the originals, like Rena Rouge's statue being able to use Mirage, Polymouse's being able to use Multitude, Cat Noir's being able to use Cataclysm and Ladybug's being able to use Lucky Charm. Her statues appeared to be able to think on their own, as they, despite following her orders, were able to talk and even play mind games with their opponents, like Cat Noir's wax statue did with Ladybug.
With the addition of her own powers, Manipula got from Monarch the power of the Ox Miraculous, Resistance, that gave her the ability to become invulnerable to the magic of the other Miraculous. She used her power to neutralize the effects of Cat Noir's Cataclysm and, in this way, leave him defenseless and about to detransform. However, despite being invulnerable to the power of the other Miraculous and powers related to them (and possibly to other types), Resistance would not protect her from things like a fallen chandelier.

title: Véronique
text:
Véronique - Abilities
Manipula also seemed to have a very strategic mind, as she had her statues to pursue Ladybug and Cat Noir in pairs and use ambushes, knowing they would need to get their pamphlets in order to release her akuma, all while she would focus on Mayor Bourgeois, having him to choose between letting her have her superhero exposition or having his Hôtel de Ville destroyed. She was also smart enough to not let Minotaurox's statue leave her side, as it was the only statue that was invulnerable to Ladybug and Cat Noir's powers and it could help her deal with them once they tried to stop her.

title: Véronique
text:
Véronique - History
Season 3
In "The Puppeteer 2", Véronique greets Adrien Agreste, Marinette Dupain-Cheng, Nino Lahiffe, Alya Césaire, and Manon Chamack when they arrive at the Musée Grévin. She thanks Adrien for coming as one of the arms on his statue went missing. Manon spots Jagged Stone and asks for an autograph, but he doesn't reply and Manon almost gets upset until Véronique reveals that it's only a wax statue. Véronique then explains that the museum opened in 1882 and that they have about 200 wax statues on exhibition. As she continues, Véronique explains that they bring new celebrities in on a regular basis, with the most recent one being Adrien.

title: Véronique
text:
Véronique - History
Véronique takes the visitors to elevators that lead to the workshop. Their Véronique shows everyone where the statues are made along with where the wax comes from. After Adrien is then told by Théo Barbot to put his arm into a device that'll create a duplicate out of wax and to not release it until the timer goes off, Véronique and Théo are forced to leave. Later, Manon is turned into the titular villain and takes Véronique and Théo hostage as they're seen tied up above the molten wax, until Ladybug and Cat Noir defeat her and Ladybug does her Miraculous Ladybug, which saves them both. Véronique then shows the finished Adrien statue to Adrien, Marinette, Nino, and Alya.
Season 5
In "Destruction", Véronique positions Cat Noir where his statue used to be with help from Ladybug, as it was part of Ladybug's plan to capture Monarch who was looking for her. Véronique pretends to proceed and close the Musée Grévin, but Monarch teleports behind her and orders her to take him to Cat Noir's statue. When they arrive at the statue's place, Véronique leaves him. Later after Ladybug and Cat Noir reveal themselves to Monarch, Véronique locks them in the room that they were in.

title: Véronique
text:
Véronique - History
In "Determination", Véronique sees Adrien, Marinette, Luka Couffaine and Kagami Tsurugi enter the Musée Grévin. She then asked them first if they had an appointment and if there was a problem with his statue. Adrien then replied saying that he was here with his friends just for fun, with Véronique saying that if he needs anything to not hesitate to ask. She then leaves for her appointment with Mayor André Bourgeois.
Véronique meets with Mayor Bourgeois to talk about opening her new hall of superheroes, featuring all the members of The Miraculers. The mayor does not want to open the hall and says it will cause more akumatizations, when in reality it's because of his daughter, Chloé Bourgeois, who ordered him not let her open the hall. She argues that it will cause hope instead. He threatens to close the museum due to hygiene problems, despite not having any.

title: Véronique
text:
Véronique - History
Later on a staircase, Véronique is seen crying because of Mayor Bourgeois' disapproval of her proposal. A tear falls down on her pile of brochures. Monarch senses Veronique's emotions and sends a megakuma to her, with the megakuma flying into her pile of brochures. Véronique then temporarily tries to resist the megakuma, but Monarch akumatizes her in the end and gives her the power of the Ox Miraculous. Véronique is turned to Manipula, a wax-themed supervillain who has the power to bring the wax statues to life and recreate the superheroes using her wax statues.

title: Véronique
text:
Véronique - History
Soon Ladybug and Cat Noir catch up to Manipula and her statues of the superheroes. Manipula announces that she brought the heroes back and Monarch will renounce evil and that the museum can once again celebrate the superheroes. Ladybug and Cat Noir try to persuade her to reject the megakuma and that Monarch is manipulating her. Monarch then convinces her not to trust Ladybug. She blames Ladybug for losing all the Miraculouses, but Cat Noir supports her. Then, the wax heroes were actually an illusion and the wax statues of Rena Rouge and Vesperia surprise attack from behind but, Ladybug and Cat Noir destroy the statues. Manipula runs away and Monarch tells her that he was right that it was Ladybug's fault on losing the Miraculouses. Manipula announces that Paris has a new superhero.

title: Véronique
text:
Véronique - History
She orders the statues of the superheroes to pair up and get Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses. She then enters Hôtel de Ville and orders Mayor Bourgeois to open the hall of superheroes, with Chloé telling her father not to listen to her. The mayor apologizes to Manipula, saying he can't. She tells the statue of Cat Noir to use his Cataclysm. She threatens Mayor Bourgeois by saying that if he doesn't change his mind, the wax statue of Cat Noir will destroy Hôtel de Ville. Meanwhile, the statue of Minotaurox is walking behind her.
Ladybug and Cat Noir then arrive after defeating all the other statues of the superheroes, Manipula points to Minotaurox who is about to hit the mayor and Chloé who are whimpering in fear. Ladybug demands that Mayor Bourgeois and his daughter be free but Manipula says she will not until the mayor opens the hall of superheroes.

title: Véronique
text:
Véronique - History
Ladybug looks around, trying to figure out how to use her Lucky Charm but finds nothing. Cat Noir tries to cataclysm the remaining strips of paper but Manipula grabs his wrist and uses Cat Noir's powers on her. Scared he has harmed another person with his superpower, Manipula reveals she is immune to superpowers due to Monarch giving her the power of Resistance. She throws Cat Noir to the Minotaurox statue and he tries to take his ring. Ladybug tries to rescue Cat Noir but is stopped by Manipula.
She tries to take Ladybug's earrings but the hero realizes how to use her Lucky Charm and says that Manipula is not invincible. She gets crushed under a chandelier and the the brochures are destroyed. Manipula then is transformed back into Véronique. Ladybug then gives her a magical charm and Mayor Bourgeois is convinced by Ladybug to authorize the opening of the hall of superheroes, to Véronique's joy.

title: Véronique
text:
Véronique - Trivia
Her character is based on Véronique Berecz, the manager of Musée Grévin.
Interestingly, Berecz is listed in the credits of Season 4, alongside Franck Dubosc, Didier Roustan, and Philippe Candeloro, despite not making a cameo in any of the episodes.

title: Wang's art shop
text:
Wang's art shop - Intro
Wang's art and crafts supply shop is an activity dedicated to artistic creation located in the Galerie Mercure in the district of Les Olympiades, in the 13th arrondissement of Paris.

title: Wang's art shop
text:
Wang's art shop - Appearance
Externals
The business has a red storefront. Above the display case and the door, there are two black signs, one in traditional Chinese "美術" (Měishù, lit. "Art") and the other in French "ART". A third pink side sign near the door repeats the sign in traditional Chinese.
When the store is closed, it has iron curtains above covering the display case and the door. During opening hours, the shop window, which consists of three rectangular and vertical windows, looks directly into the store with a presentation of some items. There is also a white diamond sticker with a red outline with sinograms, but also a poster for an exhibition, another white and purple sticker, and a regulatory document.
The door is black with a window. On it, there is hung on the inside a reversible sign with an emoticon to indicate the opening or closing to the customer, but also a small poster with the opening hours of the store.
Internals
The interior of the store is quite large and has two parts. The walls are beige and the floor is wooden parquet.

title: Wang's art shop
text:
Wang's art shop - Appearance
In the first part, there are various shelves and wooden displays where articles allowing the realization of works are stored, with some decorations on the walls or a green plant.
It is also in this part that the counter is located.
The other part is smaller and is separated from the previous one by an Asian wooden arch. This one seems to be dedicated to artistic reading since books are stored there in wall shelves. One of its shelves is decorated with a white statuette representing a dragon.

title: Wang's art shop
text:
Wang's art shop - Employees
Mrs. Wang (co-owner)
Socqueline Wang (occasional saleswoman)

title: Wang's art shop
text:
Wang's art shop - Trivia
This shop seems to be where Sabine usually buys supplies for the Chinese painting classes she teaches at the Collège Françoise Dupont every Saturday.
Mr. Damoclès arrived at the store through the path suggested by his Alliance ring.
In "Jubilation", the shop is attacked by Darker Owl, the latter following orders to attack Socqueline, suspected of being Ladybug.

is a smartphone belonging to Vincent Asa, who uses it for his podcast Vincent Secret on Zoo.

text:

Normal
Vincent's cellphone has a gold cover. On the top side of the screen, it has a small round camera, and on the back side, on the top left, it has four round cameras arranged in a square.
Akumatized
Under the effect of Vincent's akumatization into Revelator, the cellphone had become a circular lens with a glowing edge.

title: Vincent's cellphone
text:
Vincent's cellphone - Abilities
Akumatized
Under the effect of Vincent's akumatization into Revelator, the cellphone, which had become a lens, gave Revelator the ability to shoot rays that forced people's secrets out of their mouths in the form of marble-like spheres that exposed that secret to anyone who held them and looked at them. Furthermore, by inserting those secrets into the lens, Revelator was able to transmit them to any video device, such as cell phones, computers, and TVs.

text:

title: Vita Lahiffe
text:
Vita Lahiffe - Intro
is a minor character from Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She is the wife of Nordine Lahiffe (currently in the process of divorce) and the mother of Nino Lahiffe and Chris Lahiffe.
In "The Chained Titans", after another argument with Nordine Lahiffe about their wedding money, she and her husband were akumatized by Chrysalis into the Chained Titans, two colossal supervillains physically linked together who constantly attempted to move away from each other while causing widespread destruction across Paris. She received a Magical Charm from Ladybug that prevents her from being akumatized again.

title: Vita Lahiffe
text:
Vita Lahiffe - Appearance
Physical appearance
Vita is a middle-aged woman of average height with a fuller build and tan skin. She has short auburn hair like her younger son which is styled into a pixie cut and hazel-green eyes.
Civilian attire
She wears a green gandoura with white patterns on the chest and rolled-up sleeves. She also wears pentagon-shaped glasses with a black frame and brown temples, along with dangling earrings and bracelets. Her arms and hands are covered with traditional tattoos.
As a Chained Titan
She became a colossal marble-like titan standing several hundred meters tall. Her physique became slimmer, and she had long hair styled in a classical Greek fashion. She wore a toga and a diadem, and a loop of the chain attached to her back.

title: Vita Lahiffe
text:
Vita Lahiffe - Personality
Vita is a very devoted mother who deeply loves her children and tries to guide them strictly for their own good. She values traditions and simple living, and can be quite uncompromising when something goes against her beliefs. Because of this, she is often short-tempered, especially with Nordine Lahiffe, whose desire for travel and lack of responsibility she cannot tolerate.

title: Vita Lahiffe
text:
Vita Lahiffe - Abilities
As a civilian
Vita owns a practice in an unspecified field and has a loyal clientele, some of whom contact her early in the morning.
As a Chained Titan
As one of the Chained Titans, Vita possessed colossal strength proportional to her immense size, allowing her to unintentionally cause massive destruction across Paris. She was capable of carrying the jar that linked her to the other titan.
Even after being reduced to a smaller size by Cat Noir's Cataclysm, she could grow back to her colossal form.
She could not break free from the chain binding her to the other titan, although she was capable of detaching it.

title: Vita Lahiffe
text:
Vita Lahiffe - Relationships
Family
Nordine Lahiffe
Vita and Nordine were in love for several years and got married while she was pregnant with Nino Lahiffe. However, their relationship deteriorated over time due to their opposing life views. Nordine's desire for adventure conflicted with Vita's preference for simplicity, symbolized by their jar of wedding money.
Their arguments became constant, and after their akumatization and Ladybug's advice, they ultimately decided to divorce on good terms.
Nino Lahiffe
Vita deeply loves Nino and wants the best for him. However, he resented her due to her constant arguments with his father.
Later, he is shown to be sad but relieved when his parents begin an amicable divorce.
Chris Lahiffe
Chris loves his mother and often repeats the advice she gives him. He is also shown to be worried, believing that she no longer loves his father.

title: Vita Lahiffe
text:
Vita Lahiffe - Etymology
The name Vita is of Latin origin, meaning "life".

title: Vita Lahiffe
text:
Vita Lahiffe - Trivia
Vita owns a practice, although her exact profession remains unknown.
Her relationship with Nordine parallels that of Gina Bianchi and Roland Dupain:
Like Nordine, Gina enjoys traveling and spending long periods away from home.
Like Vita, Roland preferred a simpler, more traditional life.

title: Wayzz
text:
Wayzz - Intro
is a major character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He is the Kwami of Protection who is connected to the Turtle Miraculous. With his power, Wayzz's wearer can use the bracelet to transform into a turtle-themed superhero.
Wayzz and his Miraculous are currently owned by Nino Lahiffe, who uses it to transform into the superhero Carapace.
Previously, Wayzz and his Miraculous were used by the Guardian Wang Fu to transform into the superhero Jade Turtle.
In "The Chained Titans", Wayzz and his Miraculous were temporarily used by Adrien Agreste to become Trionyx.

title: Wayzz
text:
Wayzz - Appearance
Wayzz is a small, light green creature that is 10 (or 4 inches) centimeters tall. His appearance includes yellow eyes, green pupils, and an antenna on his head. He also has a slightly darker green turtle shell on his back and a short pointed tail.
In seasons 4-5, he gains eyelashes.
From season 6 onwards, Wayzz gains black pupils on his eyes and a pale cream front.

title: Wayzz
text:
Wayzz - Personality
Wayzz is kind, compassionate, and helpful. He worries when Miraculouses are being used wrong and Master Fu takes risks, but he trusts the wisdom of Master Fu, although concerned for the safety of his partner, the remaining Miraculous, and other Miraculous holders. He has a sense of humor, teasing Marinette that she should have been given the kwami of lateness. He is also playful, happily running on a phonograph before getting stuck under it because of it being faster than him.
Wayzz can also be curious on occasion, seen in "Syren" when he and Tikki beg Master Wang Fu to tell them the secret to modifying their powers, and yet he is very understanding of what the consequences would be if he was captured with that knowledge. For the most part, Wayzz is obedient towards Master Fu, but he doesn't tell him everything at times, seen in "Sandboy" when he doesn't tell Master Fu the importance of tonight (the night of Nooroo's birthday) and apologizes for his mistake.

title: Wayzz
text:
Wayzz - Personality
Wayzz admires those who show acts of bravery as Marinette and Adrien fought against his master's old sentimonster in "Feast" without any powers. He is also encouraging too, as he tried to convince Master Fu to follow his disciples examples and is also aware that not every problem can be solved by running away.
As shown in "Furious Fu", Wayzz can also be impulsive, as he even begs with his siblings through their puppy dog eyes in trying to go with Marinette to see his former master and later on allows himself to get caught by Master Fu.

title: Wayzz
text:
Wayzz - Abilities
Wayzz is able to fly, levitate, carry objects that are heavier than him and phase through solid objects. He can also sense the aura of a Miraculous, like when a Miraculous is being used for dark purposes, sensing that Nooroo and the Butterfly Miraculous are under Hawk Moth's control. He also appears to have a strong connection to other kwamis.
As a Kwami, Wayzz gives the wearer the power of protection and transforms them into a turtle-themed superhero by entering the Turtle Miraculous.
Whenever the wearer uses Shell-ter, Wayzz begins losing power and eventually can't retain the transformation any longer, leaving the bracelet and reverting the wearer back to normal. To transform them again, he first needs to refuel by eating.

title: Wayzz
text:
Wayzz - Etymology
Wayzz's name is based on the word "wise", and is pronounced the same way in the original French dub.
However, in the English and Russian dubs, "Wayzz" is pronounced the same as "ways".

title: Wayzz
text:
Wayzz - Trivia
In "Ladybug & Cat Noir", in the pavilion of the phonograph, Wayzz can be seen sleeping in a matchbox with a picture of the famous Théophile Steinlen poster art of the Parisian establishment, Le Chat Noir hanging on the side.
From his turtle based appearance and green coloring, Wayzz appears to be based off of a green sea turtle.
Mentioned in "Syren", since he remembers tasting the Aqua potion before it means at some point, he used his aqua powers but it's unknown what he looked like in said form.
According to "Feast", Wayzz has the longest record of being active being with Master Fu over the course of several years.
Wayzz was the fifth kwami to have his Miraculous destroyed following Fluff and Plagg in "Timebreaker", Pollen in "Queen Wasp" and Nooroo in "Miraculous Shanghai".
Wayzz is the sixth Kwami to be used for evil, following Nooroo, Duusu, Plagg (in an alternative timeline in "Cat Blanc" and "Ephemeral"), Pollen (briefly in "Miracle Queen") and Liiri (briefly in "Miraculous New York").
Wayzz and his Miraculous were used for evil in "Optigami" by Sentinino and later in "Strikeback" by Monarch, who used them, with the Butterfly and Fox Miraculous, for his Message Transmission.

title: Wayzz
text:
Wayzz - Trivia
Wayzz is depicted with eyelashes in season 4, but keeps appearing without them, alongside Nooroo.

title: Wang Fu/History
text:
Wang Fu/History - Intro
Master Fu is a 186-year-old painter who formerly was a healer and the Great Guardian of the Miraculouses, who guards them when not in use. He gave Marinette Dupain-Cheng and Adrien Agreste their Miraculouses to stop Hawk Moth and his villains' evil-doings. With the Turtle Miraculous, when inhabited by Wayzz, Master Fu was able to transform into the turtle-themed superhero Jade Turtle.

title: Wang Fu/History
text:
Wang Fu/History - Before Season 1
Before coming to Paris prior to 174 years ago, Fu was a young guardian in training at the Temple of the Guardians to be successor to celestial guardian Su-Han, but at the time, he didn't wish to be a Guardian. Eventually he was put to the test, where he was tasked to watch over a Miracle Box for 24 hours without any food. But as time passed, Fu grew hungry which became worse while he guarded the box. Eventually, he decided to use the Peacock Miraculous to create a sentimonster that would go and fetch him some food. Unfortunately, Fu's resentment toward the Guardians and the Miraculous, mingled with his intense hunger, caused the sentimonster to go on a rampage and desire to consume the Miraculous. This resulted in the destruction of the temple and the loss of the book, and both Butterfly and Peacock Miraculouses.

title: Wang Fu/History
text:
Wang Fu/History - Before Season 1
Sometime afterwards, Fu came to Paris and became acquainted with Marianne Lenoir whom he fell in love with. He told Marianne about the Miraculous, the Miracle Box and his duty as the Guardian. However, during Paris' Nazi occupation Fu planned to flee to England to protect the Miracle Box. He and Marianne, who had decided to stay behind and resist, parted ways. But then he Met the Future Ladybug and Cat Noir who then told him that he would meet Ladybug in the future and they would become great friends. This is probably the reason why he chose them in the future and knew they would make a great superhero team.

title: Wang Fu/History
text:
Wang Fu/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Ladybug & Cat Noir", Master Fu was with a client when Wayzz interrupted him, telling him that he could sense the Butterfly Miraculous. Master Fu tried to transform in order to get it back, but due to his age, he could not. Instead, he went to search for two new Miraculous holders.
He stopped by 12 Rue Gotlib street in the 21st arrondissement and crossed the street. A car was barreling down the street, as it had the right of way. Marinette Dupain-Cheng pulled him out of the car's way before she left for school. Seeing her bravery, Master Fu left the Ladybug Miraculous in her room. He then pretended to trip and lose his cane outside near Collège Françoise Dupont. Adrien Agreste helped him up. Seeing Adrien's kindness, he left the Cat Miraculous in his room. He decided that these two would be the best users. He was only wrong once and it wouldn't happen again, or so he hoped referring to himself.
In "Stoneheart", the next day after the Stonehearts were taken care of, Master Fu and Wayzz watched Marinette and Adrien as they left the school. Wayzz approved of them as the next wielders, Master Fu stating that they were made for each other.

title: Wang Fu/History
text:
Wang Fu/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Princess Fragrance", Master Fu was visited by Marinette who brought a sick Tikki to him. In the process of healing the kwami by using a gong and reading energies, he reminds Marinette that she must be patient. He playfully asked her what sort of cat Tikki was, and she told Master Fu Tikki was a rare breed from a far away kingdom. After Tikki was fully healed she asked how he did it and he tells her it was an Ancient Chinese secret.
In "Animan", Master Fu was observing one of the animals at the zoo in the background.
In "Gamer", Master Fu was seen watching Adrien and Marinette while they were in the park behind a lamppost.
In "Antibug", Master Fu was in the lounge area of Le Grand Paris Hotel until Chloe and Sabrina were cosplaying Ladybug and Cat Noir that caught his attention.
In "Volpina", Master Fu is seen in his shop meditating as he sensed Marinette's arrival.

title: Wang Fu/History
text:
Wang Fu/History - [[Season 2]]
In "The Collector", he officially meets Marinette and explained that he chose her to wield the Ladybug Miraculous because of her willingness to help others. From Tikki and Wayzz he also explained that he came from the Order of the Guardians, a group of people whose job it was to distribute the Miraculous for the good of humanity. But when Marinette asks about the book, Master Fu detailed that the Miraculous Book is an instruction manual on all the powers of the Miraculous which he was able to partially translate.  He also pointed out besides the book, Master Fu also lost the Peacock and Butterfly Miraculouses.
He concluded that whoever had the book and the two Miraculouses was believed to be Hawk Moth.  But when Master Fu asked Marinette how she found the book, she lied by saying she found it on a bench. When Marinette decides on who Hawk Moth could be he advises her to be careful, but after her evidence was proven false (unaware that she was right) Master Fu understood why she lied because he knew that Marinette was afraid that the one she loves was Hawk Moth.

title: Wang Fu/History
text:
Wang Fu/History - [[Season 2]]
That's when Master Fu realized that for them to defeat Hawk Moth, they would have to trust each other, to which Marinette agrees. Then to solve her friend's problem, Master Fu took pictures of the spellbook so Marinette could return it to Gabriel Agreste.
In "Robostus", after defeating Robostus, Master Fu was visited by Marinette who had questions about the combined powers of the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses. The guardian explained that whoever uses the Miraculouses' combined powers will obtain the power to alter reality; the ability to make a wish. But he confidentially warned Marinette that since the universe must stay in balance, for every wish a price had to be pay. And, he tells her that she and Cat Noir must never lose their magic jewels.

title: Wang Fu/History
text:
Wang Fu/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Sapotis", sometime ago Master Fu taught Marinette all the secrets of the Miraculouses. Then, he was drinking tea when he heard someone knocking at the door which happens to be Marinette. When she explains that her Lucky Charm told her to come to his shop, he took it as a sign that Marinette's Lucky Charm is telling her the heroes need help. As Master Fu goes to the Miracle Box he hesitated on the idea of letting another Miraculous out but was assured by Marinette that she and Cat Noir were very carefully with their powers. Afterwards, he showed Marinette all the Miraculouses and advises her to choose wisely in picking a trusted ally. He also told her that when the mission was over she must return the chosen Miraculous to him as it was too dangerous to let any of them out for long until they learned all the Miraculous secrets. When Master Fu asked Marinette if she knew of someone, he watched as she took the Fox Miraculous and said yes. Once the mission was over, Master Fu put the Fox Miraculous back in the box and praised Marinette for making the right choice.

title: Wang Fu/History
text:
Wang Fu/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Syren", after Marinette returned the Fox Miraculous Master Fu noticed that something was troubling her and she spoke of hiding secrets from Cat Noir and the guardian says things will be revealed in time. At the time he was cooking up a magical potion for modifying the kwamies' power but forbid Tikki and Wayzz from following them under the warning of what would happen if they were captured with that knowledge. Through reading the spellbook Master Fu almost figured out the recipe for unlocking "Aqua Mode" but lacked the final ingredient. After testing it on Wayzz, he realized the potion didn't work.
After the streets became flooded because of Syren, Master Fu and Wayzz retreated to the roof, along with the ingredients and Miracle Box. After being found by Marinette he expressed sadness over not finding the last ingredient, but Marinette refused to give up. Thinking about using a real tear of joy, Marinette made Master Fu tear up in laughter at her jokes, and when the tear was added to the potion it was a success. At Marinette's request, Master Fu found Adrien on the rooftop and promised to explain everything and gave him the Aqua potion.

title: Wang Fu/History
text:
Wang Fu/History - [[Season 2]]
Afterwards, he gave Marinette a list of the magical potions telling her the ingredients could be contained in anything. He approached the Agreste mansion as Adrien's substitute Chinese instructor officially meeting Adrien as Plagg introduced him as the Guardian of the Miraculous.  He then gave Adrien a box of potion filled Camembert.
In "Anansi", he was approached by Marinette who explained that Cat Noir was about to have his ring taken and Nino couldn't hold off Anansi for long. Refusing to let that happen he instructed her to choose a Miraculous and a trusted ally. When Wang found out that she needed his, he and Wayzz allowed her to use it and after Anansi was defeated Marinette returned the Turtle Miraculous and Wayzz back to him.

title: Wang Fu/History
text:
Wang Fu/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Sandboy", he was reading a book in his shop until he fell asleep, after Sandboy turned Paris into a living nightmare. Wang Fu was woken up by Marinette but covered with nightmare sand causing the guardian to face his nightmare: the pressure and guilt of his past mistake. He instructed Marinette to transform but she couldn't and was informed of Tikki's whereabouts, which was not good because he said that there was no way for them to communicate with the kwamis while they're in their magical world. Driving away the ghosts with a stool he was approached by Wayzz who apologized for not telling him but noticing their predicament Master Fu says they'll talk about it later.
After Sandboy's defeat he was slightly angered by what happened, but understanding that Marinette and the kwamis had good intentions Wang forgave them and said to come to him the next time they need something.

title: Wang Fu/History
text:
Wang Fu/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Style Queen", Master Fu and Wayzz are approached by Plagg who told them what happened to Adrien. Then, after Marinette arrived she tried to explain the same thing but he already knew and told Marinette that her partner lost his ring. When Plagg offered to help, Master Fu said it was out of the question aware of how reckless he was without an owner and tried to remind the kwami of the destruction he had caused previously. Once again he allowed her to pick a Miraculous and trusted ally then watched Marinette take the Bee Miraculous.
In "Queen Wasp", from watching the live feed of the fashion show Master Fu wasn't fazed at all that the Bee Miraculous ended up with Chloé. He assured Wayzz that Marinette would do no such thing and had faith in her that she would fix her mistake. After Queen Wasp was defeated the Bee Miraculous was returned to him.

title: Wang Fu/History
text:
Wang Fu/History - [[Season 2]]
During "Malediktator", Master Fu was doing math with an abacus until Marinette came in and explained that the titular villain had turned her partner into a cat. Shocked he says that she shouldn't have left Cat Noir on his own being at Hawk Moth's mercy, which Marinette agrees but also said the Lucky Charm led her here. Knowing not to disobey the charm he allowed Marinette to choose a Miraculous and an ally, witnessing her take the Bee Miraculous again. Master Fu was cautious after hearing the events of "Queen Wasp", but was assured by Marinette on how to properly use it.
After Malediktator's defeat, Wang Fu knew that Marinette took a big risk with Chloé and was still cautious that she was the right choice. Marinette spoke of how Ladybug made her a better person and that same could be said for Chloé, hearing a noble answer he supported Marinette's choice.

title: Wang Fu/History
text:
Wang Fu/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Catalyst", upon hearing the news Master Wang knew there would be a day when Hawk Moth would discover the unbound limits of his powers. After being approached by Marinette once more he offered her to choose an ally and watched her take the Bee, Fox, and offered his Turtle Miraculous too, wishing the heroes luck to get the Butterfly Miraculous back.
In "Mayura", after Hawk Moth's defeat Fu was given back the three Miraculouses placing the Bee and Fox Miraculouses in the Miracle Box and wearing the Turtle Miraculous again. He thanked Marinette for a job well done.

title: Wang Fu/History
text:
Wang Fu/History - [[Season 3]]
During "Backwarder", aware he won't live forever, Master Fu sent Wayzz to get Marinette and once she arrived. He told her that if anything happens to him she'd have to take care of the Miracle Box and the new guardian. And asked her to deliver a letter to his friend Marianne realizing he waited too long to confess his love and thanked Marinette for accepting the task.
Once Marianne was deakumatized and Fu was feeling better they met at their spot. He apologized to her for waiting so long and from her he learned that Hawk Moth got closer to finding him. Aware that Marianne was in danger too she said it was her turn to hide, with that he wanted to express his love for her but was stopped until she came back. Master Fu expressed hope Ladybug and Cat Noir would defeat Hawk Moth and the two would be together.

title: Wang Fu/History
text:
Wang Fu/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Miraculer", he loaned out the Fox and Turtle Miraculous again when Ladybug and Cat Noir needed in defeating Destroyer and was given back the jewels when the job was finished. Seeing the threat Miraculer posed Wang once again told Marinette of the circumstances but he found out that the whole team was needed he let her take the Bee, Fox and Miraculouses again. However, like Marinette Wang Fu was also aware that Chloé revealed her identity and questioned about her. She was sure that Chloé was up to the task wanting to save her best friend with the whole team they were able to deakumatized Sabrina and stop Mayura from taking Bee Miraculous with the danger over all three were returned to Master Fu.

title: Wang Fu/History
text:
Wang Fu/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Oblivio", Wang received a call by an amnesiac Marinette asking her if something was wrong and was informed that her memory was erased by Oblivio as well as asked if her partner was with her. She said that Adrien was and figured out the that the two discovered their identities but wasn't too worry since the magic ladybugs would fix everything anyway. With Marinette's phone running out of power he quickly asked the duo if their kwamis were with them and was informed that the "red one" was with them. Wang told them of their kwamis names and how to retransform. However, he was told by Adrien that Plagg flew away and that Adrien couldn't transform without him but before he tell the pair more Marinette's phone ran out of power ending the call.

title: Wang Fu/History
text:
Wang Fu/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Party Crasher", Wang attended the all boys party for Adrien at the Agreste mansion. While dancing on top of the cooler hiding the Miracle Box, he nearly falls but is caught by Kim, but soon Party Crasher crashed the party. He with everyone else escape but stayed out of sight but watched Ladybug's and Cat Noir's battle when the heroine was caught Wang held Cat Noir saying he needs help. With that he signed the Snake Miraculous to Luka, the Horse Miraculous to Max and his Miraculous to Nino but seeing them all get captured along with Cat Noir. Wang thought of one Miraculous that could help with it being so special he decided to trust what saw in Kim with the Monkey Miraculous. But seeing Kim and Xuppu bonding through making funny faces he suspected that he made a bad choice and yet seeing him come through in the end with the other heroes in defeating Party Crasher. Wang believed he was the right choice after all and had retrieved all the loaned Miraculouses.

title: Wang Fu/History
text:
Wang Fu/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Desperada", once again he allowed Marinette to pick a Miraculous along with a trusted ally. Upon seeing her take the Snake Miraculous, Wang told her that this Miraculous was very powerful and that it must be used by someone whose wise enough and not tempted to use time manipulation for their own personal gain. He was happy that Marinette knew of the perfect person for the job and after Desperada's defeat the Snake Miraculous was returned to him.
In "Startrain", after Ladybug's and Cat Noir's late night fight, Master Fu has the Fox Miraculous returned to him and thanks Marinette for a job well done. When he heard of Marinette's class field trip from Tikki as well as Marinette's choice not to go under the knowledge of Hawk Moth causing trouble while she's away. Solving the solution he gave Marinette the Horse Miraculous in case if there was a villain in Paris. Agreeing that she and Cat Noir deserved to have some fun.

title: Wang Fu/History
text:
Wang Fu/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Kwamibuster", he was relaxing in his shop until being approached by a panicked Marinette saying that her and Cat Noir's identities were jeopardized and yet Wang reminded her of the consequences. To help her Wang allowed Marinette to pick another Miraculous for herself until she rescued Tikki.
In "Feast", hearing of Alya's latest discovery from Marinette, Wang was aware she'd figure the truth out sooner or later. But he soon became horrified at the sight of a sentimonster that he thought was long gone and explained his mistake. Refusing to let Adrien and Marinette suffer he took their jewels and decided to leave Paris to draw the creature away. In trying to escape and being informed by Wayzz he saw that his disciples will do anything to help him even without their powers and was encouraged to follow their example but put Wayzz in his Miraculous. When Ladybug and Cat Noir were back into a corner and realizing his kwami was right Wang stared down his own sentimonster revealing himself to Hawk Moth but returned the heroes jewels.

title: Wang Fu/History
text:
Wang Fu/History - [[Season 3]]
In trying to find the creature's amok, Wang told Ladybug that his staff was part metal and to hide. While the heroes were in the belly of the beast Wang and Wayzz continued to run until they couldn't anymore believing this was the end, he thanked Wayzz for his service. But seeing Ladybug and Cat Noir defeat the creature he thanked them and seeing that the Order of the Guardians had returned Fu was happy he could return home someday. Seeing Marinette's courage and acknowledging her as a full fledged Ladybug he felt it was time to pass his role of guardianship to her.
But he also realized with Hawk Moth still out there and knew his identity his job wasn't over. With the shop no longer safe Wang decided to move but remain in Paris assuring Marinette that he'd always be there when they needed him.
In "Ikari Gozen", Wang was working at the cinema to hide his identity from Hawk Moth. When Ladybug arrived he knew that she sought out help once more and allowed her to choose a temporary miraculous and an ally. Then, saw her take the Dragon Miraculous and after Ikari Gozen was defeated it was returned.

title: Wang Fu/History
text:
Wang Fu/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Heart Hunter", some time prior he wrote a letter to Marinette about the trials of losses as well as loving life and moving on putting it in his locker at the train station. Afterwards, on a bench in the park Master Fu was looking at a photo Marianne. Then was approached by Marinette as Ladybug and lent her the Dragon Miraculous but soon he was attacked by Hawk Moth and Mayura. Left with no choice, Wang Fu transformed into Jade Turtle. Despite putting up a good fight he used the power of Shell-ter to protect himself but was captured.
In "Miracle Queen", he was still protected by Shell-ter while Miracle Queen took control over all of Paris.
He then was attacked by Hawk Moth's sentimonster to destroy the shield in order for Hawk Moth to find out who Ladybug and Cat Noir were, along with everything he knew about the Order of the Guardians.
When Dragon Bug and Cat Noir arrived, he told them to stay united and fight with each other, not against each other, which they listened to.
But even though Miracle Queen was defeated, his Shell-ter was caving in, and Hawk Moth was winning.

title: Wang Fu/History
text:
Wang Fu/History - [[Season 3]]
With Ladybug doubting herself about not de-transforming when visiting Master Fu, and being the worst Miraculous holder ever, he assured her that she was the best Miraculous holder he ever knew, and will be the best Guardian ever.
He then gave up his memories and passed the Miracle Box over to her just as his Shell-ter was destroyed, leaving Hawk Moth upset and leaving with Mayura.
When he regained consciousness, he couldn't remember who Ladybug and Cat Noir were, even after Ladybug tried to use Miraculous Ladybug to fix it.
Later, he went to the train station with Marinette to meet Marianne, who he instantly knew he loved.
He then thanked Marinette, saying he will never forget her, and left with Marianne for London.

title: Wang Fu/History
text:
Wang Fu/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Furious Fu", he developed a passion for painting, and returned to Paris with Marianne to paint.
At the train station, he saw Marinette, who Marianne said that she saved him from a boat accident where he lost his memory, and he thanked Marinette for that.
At a park, he told Marinette about his life in London, and said that he and Marianne were now married.
He also gave Marinette a painting he said that reminded him of her.
He also saw Wayzz on the ground, but not remembering who he was, thought Wayzz was a toy, and Marinette said it was hers.
Later near a fountain, he was approached by his former master Su-Han, who took Fu's cane, which had a compass in it to lead the Miracle Box, and knocked Fu and Marianne over.
After helping Marianne up, he tried to get his cane back from Su-Han, and became angry enough to be akumatized into Furious Fu.
He then found Su-Han, Ladybug and Cat Noir, and fought them.
He managed to stop Su-Han, take the Miracle Box, and prevent Ladybug and Cat Noir from taking his paintbrush, but Marianne then showed up and destroyed the paintbrush, turning him back into Wang Fu.

title: Wang Fu/History
text:
Wang Fu/History - [[Season 4]]
Ladybug then gave him a Magical Charm, saying it will protect him from future attacks.
He also accepted Su-Han's apology when he returned his cane.
After talking to Marinette about what happened with Ladybug, he went back to London with Marianne.

title: Wang Fu/History
text:
Wang Fu/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Evolution", when Ladybug and Rabbit Noir chase down Monarch across time to retrieve the stolen Miraculouses, they end up in Paris during WWII. The former two find a younger Master Fu, who just parted ways with Marianne to protect the Miracle Box. He is surprised by their appearance and doesn't trust them at first, asking the heroes how they know his name and about their Miraculouses, to which Ladybug reassures him that they'll become friends in the future and that he's haunted by a past mistake but that he will find peace someday. Convinced by this, Fu decides to help them by loaning them the Dog Miraculous and asks them to return it to him when finished to avoid changing the timeline and becomes surprised when Ladybug finishes his speech. A few minutes later, a teenage Bunnyx returns the Dog Miraculous to him after she had used it to retrieve the stolen Rabbit Miraculous from Monarch, and much to Fu's confusion, the superheroine takes a selfie with him.
In "Conformation", Master Fu's stolen tablet is found by Ladybug in Nathalie's room, much to her shock, which allows her to discover Nathalie and Gabriel's secret identities.
