title: Wayhem
text:
Wayhem - Intro
is a minor character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He is a teenager who is a fan of Adrien Agreste.
In "Party Crasher", when Wayhem felt left out for not being allowed to get in the party being held in Adrien's room, he was akumatized by Hawk Moth into Party Crasher, a disco-themed supervillain.

title: Wayhem
text:
Wayhem - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Wayhem stands at a medium height. He has very light tangelo skin, brown eyes, and wavy hair. His hair is sometimes blond, other times light or dark brown, depending on the episode.
Civilian Attire
He dresses very similar to Adrien. He wears a white button-down jacket with an upturned collar and sleeves rolled up above his elbow, which he keeps unbuttoned. On the upper left side of the shirt, there is a green chameleon design. Underneath, he wears a black round V-neck collared t-shirt (which in "Glaciator" has five horizontal stripes around the chest which are colored, from top to bottom, yellow, dark grayish chartreuse green, bright green, deep green, and very pale blue), blue jeans, a brown belt, and red sneakers with white laces and soles.
As Party Crasher

title: Wayhem
text:
Wayhem - Appearance
Party Crasher wore a stereotypical 70's disco dancer's outfit, with an unbuttoned disco ball patterned pointed shouldered jacket, matching pants, and high heel shoes that were connected to his pants. He also had a black V-neck dress t-shirt with a popped collar and a necklace with a smaller silver disco ball bead around his neck. He wore a pair of sunglasses of the same style as the jacket and pants. At the end of each hand, he wielded a disco ball-shaped gauntlet which he used to activate his powers. He had luminous vivid arctic blue skin and orchid afro styled hair with the same shade of skin, alongside a matching thick mustache and pointed eyebrows.

title: Wayhem
text:
Wayhem - Personality
Wayhem is overly enthusiastic, courageous, passionate, and sometimes obnoxious. He often reacts melodramatically to situations, from panicking for Adrien's safety when he falls from a building to gushing in delight when Adrien gives him his email address.
Wayhem dedicates himself to anything that he wants, like Adrien's autograph, although sometimes going too far in his obsessions with his energy and forwardness.  However, when he realizes his mistakes, he feels quite guilty about it. Bold, Wayhem takes on any challenge to protect what he cares about, as seen when he tries to defend Adrien from Gorizilla.
In "Mr. Pigeon 72" and "Illusion", it is revealed that he still has the tendency to run to wherever Adrien is, as in the case of the former he went to the public pool and in the latter episode he went to the school cafeteria which were both places where Adrien was at during those times.

title: Wayhem
text:
Wayhem - Personality
As Party Crasher, he was vengeful towards Adrien about not inviting him to his party. He was quite cruel, trapping anybody who was invited to the party. He was also understandably confident in his ability to predict one's movement, deeming their "body language second nature" to him, but leaning on overconfidence. When King Monkey threw an object at him, he wasn't aware that it would distort his powers.

title: Wayhem
text:
Wayhem - Abilities
As a Civilian
Wayhem shows quick thinking by spraying Gorizilla with perfume to undermine his enhanced sense of smell.
As Party Crasher
Party Crasher had a large selection of disco-themed powers. Primarily, he could trap people and objects inside the tiny mirrors of his disco ball gauntlets whenever he touched them, causing them to disappear and appear frozen on the mirror. It is not known whether this ability was voluntary or not, as everything touched by the gauntlets disappears, even if Party Crasher did not mean to touch it. The people or objects trapped inside the gauntlets appeared to be frozen in time to an extent, as they were not seen moving or emoting in any way until they are released, which could be accomplished by breaking the gauntlets. Party Crasher displayed the ability to shoot a sparkling beam of refracted light from his gauntlets, which had the same effect as touching something with the gauntlets. There were no stated limitations on the mirror beams but given that Party Crasher only used them occasionally, it can be inferred that there was some period of cool down before he could use it again.

title: Wayhem
text:
Wayhem - Abilities
Furthermore, Party Crasher could predict the future movements of his opponents', visualizing the area as a disco-tiled floor with his opponents movements projected as static silhouettes on each tile. This ability could be used against multiple people at once, although the user was liable to be overwhelmed by unpredictable movement.

title: Wayhem
text:
Wayhem - Relationships
Adrien Agreste
Wayhem is a huge fan of Adrien, dressing like him and admiring him. When he meets Adrien in "Gorizilla", he is very ecstatic and chases Adrien around town with other fans. However, his admiration of Adrien leads him to confront Gorizilla with a bottle of perfume, and he willingly pretends to be Adrien to confuse Gorizilla and — unknowingly — help Adrien run off to transform into Cat Noir. Although giddy around Adrien, he apologizes for posting an image of Adrien that caught people's attention. Excitedly, Wayhem accepts Adrien's friendship while promising not to endanger his obscurity in public again.
In "Party Crasher", it is shown that the two chat online often, with Adrien confiding that his father never lets him go out or have friends over. He later learns of Adrien’s party and believes that he'd lied to him, causing his akumatization. However, once deakumatized, Wayhem accepts Adrien's apology and explanation that he hadn't known his friends would surprise him, even expresses excitement over getting to clean his room with him.
Alya Césaire

title: Wayhem
text:
Wayhem - Relationships
Not much is known about Alya and Wayhem's relationship, but they seem to be good friends, as they were paired up for the friendship game in "Ikari Gozen". Wayhem and Alya won the game together as they were good partners and worked together with ease.

title: Wayhem
text:
Wayhem - Trivia
His name is a play on the word "mayhem", and in fact his over-enthusiasm did cause some mayhem to Adrien.
In the Italian version of "Gorizilla", he is named Farìd, which is a play on the expression fa ridere which means "he's funny". Although, possibly because of an oversight, in his second appearance in "Party Crasher", he's called Wayhem as normal.
In "Gorizilla" and "Frozer", on his social media post, his name is spelled as Wayem.
Wayhem's outfit is very similar to Adrien's outfit.
Marinette briefly mistakes Wayhem for Adrien because of the similarity when she is at André's ice cream stand in "Glaciator".
Similarly, in "Multiplication", Ladybug and Cat Noir briefly mistake him for Félix, when looking for him in their Space mode and wave at him.
He was the first akumatized villain to successfully get hold of both Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses. However, he failed to deliver them to Hawk Moth because of King Monkey's intervention.
In "Mega Leech" it's revealed that he has multiple cutouts of Adrien due to his email address not being on the one seen in the episode.
Party Crasher is the only akumatized villain to have facial hair, but not in their civilian form.

title: Wayzz/History
text:
Wayzz/History - Intro
Wayzz is the kwami connected to the Turtle Miraculous, where he is currently with Nino Lahiffe to transform into Carapace.

title: Wayzz/History
text:
Wayzz/History - Before [[Season 1]]
After the universe was created 13.8 billion years ago, the idea of creation came into existence along with Tikki not long after she came, when the concept of Protection came into existence, so did Wayzz and at first unknown to him along with the first universe many others were created. After more concepts and ideas were brought into the universe, Wayzz was given his kwami siblings then through some unknown events the kwamis discovered the existence of the billions of parallel universes and due to their concepts being so abstract they came across different versions of themselves as well as discovered that they lived simultaneously in all of them sharing a mind link gaining the knowledge and memories of each other. And yet, they made it their pact that due to them living for so long unless in an emergency or crisis they chose not to bring up complexity of parallel universes to their owners knowing that they wouldn't have enough time to explain the smallest bit about it so they all agreed to stick with the basics of living in their own universes with them. But still used the memories and knowledge of their massive experiences to guide them and their owners through.

title: Wayzz/History
text:
Wayzz/History - Before [[Season 1]]
Regardless for countless eons they traveled throughout the universe until they made their way to Earth. However, they discovered two things: one, they couldn't be seen by any living beings and two when Wayzz and others discovered their powers their lack of control resulted in disaster. Until one day, in ancient China, they met a mage who crafted their Miraculous, allowing them to maintain a physical appearance. But before their jewels and physical form were obtained he and his kwami family began to grow when the Prodigious was created giving them their cousins the Renlings, however an unknown incident caused the jewel and their renling cousins to sealed yet guarded by Mei Shi and the Renren guardians. For over 5,000 years, Wayzz helped people transform into superheroes in order to save the world.

title: Wayzz/History
text:
Wayzz/History - Before [[Season 1]]
He and many of his siblings started in China where his first owner became Gui and through him as well as other civilians Wayzz and his siblings began discovering the basics of their powers. During one of their many adventures, Wayzz and his owners made another interesting discovery their powers can altered to include elemental abilities and some point during one of his tenures Wayzz used the aqua power up of the Miraculous Potions. But like the rest of the kwamis they were never allowed to know the contents as well as witness the creation of the Miraculous spellbook but couldn't read it. In their earlier adventures Wayzz and the kwamis began to treasure the bonds they had with their owners creating the tradition of the kwagatama. At a point in time after their jewels were created the guardians also made a special magical box the Mother Miracle Box to house inactive miraculous and siblings once inside they discovered that a whole another universe exist and made it their home where they could cherish mementos of their adventures and owners.

title: Wayzz/History
text:
Wayzz/History - Before [[Season 1]]
Furthermore, the kwamis desires had been fulfilled wishing to help people throughout the world however just like humans, Wayzz and the others also discovered that not all of them were worthy of their powers causing destruction making it their job along with their owners to rescue their captured siblings. However as time moved on, they found out that unlike them humans weren't immortal or when the crisis had been dealt with Wayzz and his siblings had to say goodbye to their first owners. But to their surprise their owners of the past weren't completely gone, seeing that their wisdom and insight as miraculous holders could benefit future generations the kwamis and guardians worked together by combining the kwagatamas, great magic and artifacts they established something amazing a magical reunion despite knowing the beings they were talking to weren't exactly like their past owners the kwamis were happy to be reunited nonetheless.
Then for the next 5000 years, Wayzz has helped by people throughout the world become Miraculous holders to protect it. When his Miraculous was not being worn, Wayzz was dormant in the Turtle Miraculous, which was stored inside the Miracle Box.

title: Wayzz/History
text:
Wayzz/History - Before [[Season 1]]
But he and his siblings next owners would have to wait for the next 172 years some time after his sibling Tikki returned from Vietnam and was placed back in the Mother Miracle Box, as a teenager Master Fu was inducted into the guardians and yet wasn't happy with his life as a guardian so much so that during one of his training sessions, young Fu used the Peacock Miraculous to create a simple little companion to get him food however his anger snuck into the creation of his creature. With the creature nearly impossible to stop, Wayzz and his siblings were given to Master Fu and escaped but lost Nooroo and Dusuu hiding in places unknown.
Sometime during WWII between arriving in London but before returning to Paris, Wayzz was activated by Wang Fu and became his companion for up to the next 72 years so the guardian can benefit from his advice and help protect the box.

title: Wayzz/History
text:
Wayzz/History - Season 1
In "Ladybug & Cat Noir", Wayzz is seen sleeping in a matchbox until he senses Nooroo's power being used for evil. He alerts Wang Fu of the disturbance and agrees that they must find Nooroo as soon as possible but disagrees that Wang is up to the task anymore. After Wang delivers the Cat and Ladybug Miraculouses, Wayzz asks his master if the new heroes will be up to the task.
Later, after Stoneheart has been defeated in "Stoneheart", Wayzz watched Marinette and Adrien with Wang nearby, complimenting on his choice of the new heroes.

title: Wayzz/History
text:
Wayzz/History - [[Season 2]]
In "The Collector", Wayzz watched Wang Fu meditating until Marinette arrived with the Miraculous spellbook. The kwami made himself known to her introducing himself and happily played with Tikki as their Miraculous holders talk.
Wayzz shared tea with Tikki on the phonograph in "Robostus" as Marinette and Wang talk about the combined power of the Ladybug Miraculous and Cat Miraculous.
When Wayzz saw Marinette come into Wang Fu's shop in "Sapotis", he told her it's too dangerous for her to come here but Wang calmed him down. After Marinette explained everything he watched with Wang as she takes the Fox Miraculous.

title: Wayzz/History
text:
Wayzz/History - [[Season 2]]
After Marinette returned the Fox Miraculous in "Syren", Wang Fu spoke of modifying the kwamis powers. Wayzz along with Tikki begged him to tell them but the guardian warned the kwamis of what could happened if they were captured with that knowledge. Understanding the two went into hiding, after the potion was complete, Wayzz tested it and yet it didn't work as he said it needed more salt. After Syren caused the streets of Paris to flood, he and Wang retreated to higher ground. When Marinette assured his master that they would find that last ingredient, he and Tikki covered their ears. Upon finding it, Wayzz witnessed that the potion was a success. With Paris no longer under attack by an akumatized villain, Wayzz came to the Agreste Mansion with Wang Fu where they both officially met Adrien.

title: Wayzz/History
text:
Wayzz/History - [[Season 2]]
During "Anansi", Wayzz saw Marinette come into Wang Fu's shop explaining that Nino can't hold off the villain for long and Cat Noir is about to lose his ring. As Wang offered Marinette to pick a temporary miraculous along with an ally, he and Wang Fu were surprised that she picked his and they agreed. Afterwards, Wayzz was introduced to Nino who thought he was a genie and yet clarified he was a kwami and transformed Nino into Carapace. With Ladybug, Cat Noir and Carapace's powers of Shell-ter, the trio were able to stop Anansi and save Alya.
Then, after the Miraculous was returned to Ladybug, Wayzz was returned to Wang Fu.
In "Sandboy", he saw Tikki and Plagg come in and told them not to wake Wang Fu and before they left, Wayzz told them to wish Nooroo a happy birthday from him while he stood guard. In the kwamis attempt to contact Nooroo, they realized they didn't have enough power, Wayzz was sought out by Plagg, at first he refused to go but was convinced this was their only chance and went into the kwami's world. During their attempt to contact Nooroo, they contacted his wielder instead and shuttered at the thought of being Hawk Moth's slave.

title: Wayzz/History
text:
Wayzz/History - [[Season 2]]
To prevent being discovered, they cut off the connected but realized that Hawk Moth akumatized someone and left with Tikki and Plagg to find their owners. He then saw Wang Fu being attacked by his greatest fear and apologized to him when he didn't tell him the whole truth but was told they'd talk about it later. After Sandboy's defeat, Wayzz apologized to his owner about putting the other kwamis and him in danger along with Tikki and Marinette. But was forgiven and informed to talk to him if he needs to ask something.
In "Style Queen", Wayzz and Wang Fu are approached by Plagg who told them of what happened to Adrien. Then, Marinette arrived explaining same thing but they already knew but when Plagg offered to help, Wayzz was aware of how reckless he was without an owner but he watched Marinette take the Bee Miraculous.
In "Queen Wasp", from watching the live feed of the fashion show, Wayzz was shocked to see that Marinette gave the Bee Miraculous to Chloé. But he was assured by Wang Fu that she wouldn't do such thing and had faith in her that she would fix her mistake.

title: Wayzz/History
text:
Wayzz/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Malediktator", he watched Wang Fu do math on an abacus until Marinette explaining what happened to Cat Noir and felt concern for him and yet watched her take the Bee Miraculous again.
In "Catalyst", Wayzz watched Marinette come into the massage shop under a great emergency and went inside the Turtle Miraculous when every hero was needed on deck. Later he meets Nino again doing a secret handshake with him before transforming his wielder into Carapace.
In "Mayura", during the battle against Scarlet Moth, Wayzz was indirectly akumatized while charging the Turtle Miraculous. Until thanks to the people of Paris and the heroes destroying Scarlet Moth's cane, he and Nino were returned to normal. And after Hawk Moth's defeat, Wayzz was dormant in the Turtle Miraculous until it was worn by Wang Fu.

title: Wayzz/History
text:
Wayzz/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Backwarder", Wayzz was sent to Marinette by Wang Fu telling her that he needs help. After hearing what the doctor said, he didn't believe it and asked Marinette to hurry and get the medicine.
In "Miraculer", Wayzz was once again given to Nino by Ladybug to help her and Cat Noir fight Destroyer and once the villain was defeated, he was returned to his master. But was loaned out again when Sabrina was akumatized into Miraculer and when Mayura entered the fray. With the whole team they were able to deakumatized Sabrina and stop Mayura from taking Bee Miraculous, with the danger over, Wayzz was returned to Wang Fu.
In "Desperada", he saw Marinette take the Snake Miraculous.
In "Startrain", Wayzz saw Marinette return the Fox Miraculous and that his master gave her the Horse Miraculous allowing to go on her class field trip.

title: Wayzz/History
text:
Wayzz/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Feast", Wayzz was informed of his Master's past mistake when he created that sentimonster long ago, but the creature fed off his hunger and anger laying waste to everything. Realizing what Hawk Moth would do, Wayzz was instructed to take Marinette's and Adrien's jewel and flee Paris. But when he saw the creature chase after them instead of Marinette; Wang tried to point out that he made the right choice and yet Wayzz retorted that she would've transformed and fought. He was informed by his master that fighting isn't always the answer however, Wayzz saw that running was pointless and that his disciples were fighting back despite being powerless and encouraged his master to follow their example and pushed him to do the right thing.

title: Wayzz/History
text:
Wayzz/History - [[Season 3]]
But Wang, still remorseful, put Wayzz in his Miraculous and after Wang returned the jewels to his disciples, he was released again, happy that he made the right choice. When he saw his master's attempt to transform, Wayzz reminded him he's too old to play hero and when being cornered by his sentimonster, he tells his master that he was happy to be his kwami all these years. But he saw that Ladybug and Cat Noir were successful and that his master was free from his burden of the past; after the heroes take their leave, they return home as well.
In "Kwamibuster", Wayzz was alerted along with Wang Fu that Tikki and Plagg were captured and once again watched Marinette choose another Miraculous but this time for herself. But he was shocked that she took the remaining jewels of his kwami brothers and sisters aware of the danger, and yet saw her activate the Mouse Miraculous becoming Multimouse. Seeing the other kwamis leave to help Marinette, he assured his master that she would succeed. After Kwamibuster's defeat and the kwamis return to the Miracle Box, Wayzz like his master was amazed that Marinette pulled off such a great feat calling her very special.

title: Wayzz/History
text:
Wayzz/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Heart Hunter", after he and Wang Fu were discovered by Hawk Moth and Mayura. He told his master not to transform as he was too old for it but regardless Wayzz and his master transform into the Jade Turtle and activated Shell-ter to protect himself.
In "Miracle Queen", after Wang Fu relinquishes his guardian title to Ladybug, Wayzz and his master detransform. But upon seeing him on the ground, he asks for him to wake up and after Wang regains consciousnesses, he hid behind Ladybug. When he heard that his former master couldn't remember anything, he told the heroes about the code of the guardians. When one guardian passes their role to another their memories about the Miraculous are erased in order to protect the identities of their chosen holders. Afterwards, Wayzz sadly told his former master goodbye and returned to the Miracle Box.

title: Wayzz/History
text:
Wayzz/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Truth", Wayzz was accidentally released from the Miracle Box when Marinette tried to figure it out and was amazed with his fellow kwamis at Marinette's computer. When Marinette leaves for her date with Luka, he and the kwamis hid with the Miracle Box, but they heard the titular villain broke into Marinette's room, when Xuppu offered to use his powers to stop Truth but Wayzz advised against it aware their powers were too strong but were saved by Ladybug. After the titular villain's defeat, he and the others saw that Marinette was sad about breaking up with Luka to the point of tears, he didn't know exactly how to help but joined with the other kwamis in giving their new guardian a group hug.

title: Wayzz/History
text:
Wayzz/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Gang of Secrets", he was seen talking with the others until Marinette arrives home and was upset seeing her so sad they realize they should intervene. Later, he and the others hear Marinette voiced her distress about being condemned to a life of secrets and lies forever because of her alter ego. When they hear someone coming, the kwamis hide in the Miracle Box, but when Lady Wifi appeared, Wayzz and the kwamis resumed hiding seeing Trixx activate his powers, he along with Barkk advised against but realized there was no choice. After Ladybug voiced concerns about Trixx's powers and was relieved, Wayzz wasn't so convinced and after the Gang of Secrets had been defeated, Wayzz and the others look on as Marinette unveils her secret to Alya.
In "Mr. Pigeon 72", Wayzz continued to support Marinette who had trying to decode the grimore commenting that Master Fu had the same problem but was able to figure it out with patience.

title: Wayzz/History
text:
Wayzz/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Furious Fu", hearing that Wang Fu was returning, Wayzz along with his fellow kwamis expressed dear desire to see him despite Marinette trying to keep them hidden for their safety and when Marinette voiced concerns about leaving the Miracle Box unguarded. He realized if someone stayed to guard the box, then the others could go but when they cheated their way out so all of them could go, they were stopped by Marinette with no choice they used the "puppy dog eyes" on her and Marinette reluctantly agreed. However, Wayzz and the others had a hard time keeping quiet while in Marinette's bag and during the visit, Wayzz snuck out, allowed himself to be touched by his former master but was happy that Wang Fu is doing well and became a great painter.
But returning home, Wayzz realized that Su-Han had returned to reclaim the box as he was the previous guardian before Wang Fu's incident and with Su-Han's strictness, they sadly returned to the box. After seeing Ladybug's valiant actions against the titular villain, Su-Han realized that Wang Fu's choice wasn't so bad allowing the kwamis to stay with Marinette.

title: Wayzz/History
text:
Wayzz/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Mega Leech", Wayzz was sleeping with Pollen and Stompp in the shelf above Marinette's bed. Then, he was called upon along with a few of his siblings and their owners to help Ladybug and Cat Noir deal with the titular sentimonster and after the mayor's deakumatization, Wayzz was returned to his guardian.
In "Crocoduel", Wayzz and the others were listening to Alya trying to convince Marinette to come to the Couffaine Twins' birthday party and to also talk to Luka.

title: Wayzz/History
text:
Wayzz/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Optigami", he heard from Alya that the reason why Marinette was happy was because she received an invite to Audrey's event while in the Miracle Box; Wayzz and the others received a call from Marinette about her needing Kaalki's help in code. Noticing that the call ended, they believe she'll call again. Upon receiving another call but this time from Alya, Wayzz and the others see her come through one of Kaalki's portals and her retrieve Ladybug's permission to get the Fox and Bee Miraculouses as a part of her plan to stop Style Queen. Through Alya's impulsiveness, Wayzz and his Miraculous were taken too unknown to Alya that she played into Shadow Moth's trap by giving Wayzz's jewel to a sentimonster doppelganger of her boyfriend. As apart of the plan, the titular sentimonster hid inside the kwami's Miraculous until Ladybug discovered the mastermind's trick, to flush Optigami out; Wayzz's jewel was destroyed by Cat Noir's Cataclysm then repaired by his guardian's powers. After both plans were foiled, he and the kwamis heard Alya's apology for her actions and seeing her sign of growth that Alya and Trixx got the permission to stay together.

title: Wayzz/History
text:
Wayzz/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Sentibubbler", Wayzz and his siblings were woken up when Marinette had a nightmare about Alya betraying her to Shadow Moth, Wayzz like the others were agreed that Alya was the correct choice as a Miraculous holder but was worried about Trixx due to his mischievous.
In "Hack-San", Wayzz and the kwamis were aware that Marinette was leaving for a trip to London, but heard her making an excuse to stay. Not wanting to leave Paris unguarded and when he heard that Marinette pretend to break her leg. Wayzz was shocked but was informed by Longg about that trick never working especially if parents want to go on vacation.
In "Wishmaker", when Marinette explained what a career was, Wayzz and the other kwamis voiced ideas on what she could do in life until Sass silenced them asking Marinette himself what she wanted to do; then saw her leave for the career expo.
In "Simpleman", Wayzz was briefly seen hiding behind Marinette's computer.

title: Wayzz/History
text:
Wayzz/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Dearest Family", after Tikki ate the pieces of galette, Marinette brought for them, the kwamis quickly realized what she did. Wayzz huddled together with the others when they realized the danger Tikki's hunger for candy can represent, despite the kwami of Creation refusal at that. When Tikki and Marinette left, the kwamis flew around in a panic. Wayzz along with Barkk were given permission by Sass to keep an eye on Tikki. Shortly after he watched Marinette, realize that Sass warning was real and transforms to stop Tikki only to be affected by her hunger, which scared him.
Hearing a commotion downstairs, Wayzz and the others were commanded to hide. After Ladybug saved her family, Wayzz and the kwamis see her return with pieces of galette for them. Despite that they were still nervous regarding Tikki, until Marinette ensured them that Tikki will control herself and the kwamis ate the pieces of galette happily.

title: Wayzz/History
text:
Wayzz/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Ephemeral", during the fight against Moolak, Wayzz and his Miraculous were given to Nino and transformed into Carapace to shield Vesperia from the titular villain. After the battle, Wayzz and his jewel were returned to Ladybug. Later, he briefly met Sass owner Luka when he came into Marinette's room, but their introductions were cut short; when Luka received a message from Ladybug allowing Sass use his power to go back to the last marked time.
Soon Wayzz discovered why as he and everyone noticed the Absolute Power being activated meaning Shadow Moth obtained the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses and started his wish. After Sass explained to Luka the consequences of it and the latter hurried the former to use his power, which he does. Causing them to forget their encounter with Luka.
In "Kuro Neko", during the fight against Gigantitan, Wayzz and his Miraculous were given to Nino to become Carapace again. Later, Wayzz and the other kwamis tried to comfort Marinette after Cat Noir gave up on his Miraculous and was surprised to learn that she intended to replace him with someone who doesn't love her.

title: Wayzz/History
text:
Wayzz/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Penalteam", Wayzz and his Miraculous were used again by Nino to become Carapace and help Ladybug, along with many other heroes to defeat Penalteam.
In "Risk", Wayzz and his Miraculous were briefly given back to Nino. Later, Wayzz and the other kwamis watched Marinette search for different ways to sabotage Adrien and Lila's journey, unaware that she was under the influence of Risk's superpowers.
In "Strikeback", Wayzz and his Miraculous were given to Nino to become Carapace and helped Ladybug, Cat Noir and the rest of the heroes to defeat Strikeback. Later, after Flairmidable betrayed Ladybug by stealing her yo-yo, his Miraculous, along with all the others was given to Gabriel Agreste in exchange for the Peacock Miraculous.

title: Wayzz/History
text:
Wayzz/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Evolution", Wayzz and the other kwamis had become enslaved by Gabriel who makes it clear he intends to use them and their abilities to get the last two Miraculouses in order to fulfill his wish. Forced to accompany Monarch as he traveled through time to beat Ladybug and Cat Noir, Wayzz and the kwamis would momentarily break free from the staff to plead for Ladybug to save them. Monarch then forced Wayzz to unify with several of the others to give Monarch his powers long enough to escape Ladybug, Cat Noir, and Bunnyx from trying to get the stolen Miraculouses back.
When they eventually landed in the time when Reverser had affected Ladybug and Cat Noir, the kwamis powers were beginning to overwhelm Monarch and they needed food to keep their strength up. They were able to get food from Nathalie but eventually Monarch lost the Rabbit Miraculous and had been taken to his original point in time. Wayzz watched as Gabriel admits his mistake of falling for Ladybug's trap.
In "Multiplication", Wayzz and the kwamis are shown huddled in fear when Gabriel asserts his ownership of them and their powers.

title: Wayzz/History
text:
Wayzz/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Destruction", he and the others watched as Gabriel tried to force Orikko to give him any power or ability to find out who Ladybug and Cat Noir are in order to get their Miraculouses and joined in calling Gabriel mean when he offended Orikko until they were forced to be silent. Gabriel then ordered the kwamis to reveal Ladybug's true identity, but the magic spell prevented them from speaking her name since she never renounced them.
Finding the only possible loophole, Gabriel forces the kwamis to take him to Ladybug's home with Wayzz one of the kwamis forced to give Gabriel his powers for the task. When arriving in Marinette's room, the kwamis explained that Monarch would have to find clues that would lead him to Ladybug's address. Monarch was eventually cornered by Ladybug and Cat Noir at the wax museum, but just as the kwamis thought they could return to Ladybug, Monarch teleported away and they were made to follow. It was later explained that Wayzz and the others had been taught what to do in case Monarch ever tried to make them reveal her identity or address.
At the end of the episode, all of the stolen Miraculouses are broken down and remade into Alliance Rings.

title: Wayzz/History
text:
Wayzz/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Reunion", Jalil Kubdel was reakumatized into Pharoh and given Wayzz's power of protection to protect the Book of Truth. When Jalil realized he had been fooled by Monarch and all of the social media claiming Alix was forced to leave, he rejected all of the powers given to him.
In "Protection", Wayzz's powers were transferred to Kagami when she was akumatized into Riposte Prime.
In "Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)", Ladybug had regained all of the stolen Miraculouses and restored them to their original jewel forms. But because she feared what would happen if they were taken again, she trusted each jewel to their holder and Wayzz was reunited with Nino.

title: Weredad
text:
Weredad - Intro
"" is a season 3 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 6th written and produced episode of season 3. It is also the 58th written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Weredad
text:
Weredad - Synopsis
Disappointed that Cat Noir doesn't return his daughter's love, Tom becomes Weredad, who locks Marinette in a magic prison to protect her from hurt.
Disney+
Ladybug faces her own father, akumatized into Weredad.

title: Weredad
text:
Weredad - Plot
Late at night, Gigantitan is causing havoc throughout Paris looking for some cake. When he approaches the Dupain-Cheng bakery, Tom comes out and vows to protect his home, though Sabine and Ladybug warn him of the danger. Ladybug tries to restrain Gigantitan with her yo-yo while Cat Noir flirts with her, but the villain flings her into a giant Adrien advertisment. Cat Noir jokingly tells her that his poetry must've at least made her swoon, though Ladybug tells him that's not the case and then calls on her Lucky Charm, receiving a giant plastic donut. Gigantitan grabs the donut and puts it in his mouth, though upon realizing that it isn't food, he throws it away and it smashes through Marinette's room. Worried, Tom rushes to check on Marinette while Ladybug and Cat Noir defeat Gigantitan and turn him back into baby August. Tom is horrified to find that Marinette is not in her room and alerts Sabine.

title: Weredad
text:
Weredad - Plot
Meanwhile, Ladybug picks up August's pacifier and kisses him, causing Cat Noir to remark that he's jealous. Ladybug gives August to him and takes off. Cat Noir notices how sad August looks all of a sudden and at first believes that he misses Ladybug, but soon realizes that he wants his pacifier. Cat Noir takes off after Ladybug but is surprised when he instead finds Marinette. He comments on how Marinette always appears just after Ladybug detransforms. After thinking about it, Cat Noir realizes something. Marinette fears that he suspects that she's Ladybug, so she panics and tells the superhero that she's in love with him, even hugging him tightly. Tom overhears this and is overjoyed, so he invites Cat Noir to have brunch at his house on Sunday. Cat Noir is at first reluctant, but when Tom mentions that he'll make macarons, Cat Noir accepts. Once he leaves, Cat Noir tells August that he'd assumed that Marinette was just a fan and is surprised that she's in love with him. Meanwhile in her room, Marinette is in shock over what just happened. Tikki tells her that she shouldn't have lied about her feelings, but Marinette reminds her that Cat Noir almost found out she was Ladybug.

title: Weredad
text:
Weredad - Plot
Tom is so excited about having Cat Noir over for dinner that he prepares several heart-shaped foods for the occassion. Sabine reminds him that Cat Noir never said that he was in love with Marinette, but Tom believes that he must be since everyone loves Marinette.
Cat Noir goes into Adrien's room and detransforms. Plagg congratulates Adrien on getting himself a girlfriend, but Adrien is surprised that Marinette is in love with Cat Noir, having believed that he wasn't her type. Plagg is excited since Cat Noir dating Marinette means that they can get unlimited amounts of cheese from the Dupain-Cheng bakery, but Adrien reminds Plagg that he's in love with Ladybug. Plagg believes that dating both girls will boost his chance of success and comments to himself on how Ladybug and Marinette are actually the same girl. However, Adrien decides that he must tell Marinette the truth.

title: Weredad
text:
Weredad - Plot
While Tom gets everything ready for the dinner, Marinette looks outside her balcony for Cat Noir. She is convinced that he won't come since he's in love with Ladybug, though Tikki is not entirely sure, believing that the amount of times Ladybug rejected him might have changed his mind. Marinette, however, insists that Cat Noir is too stubborn to change his mind.
At the Agreste mansion, Adrien is eating alone in the dining room. Plagg reminds him that they should already be heading to Marinette's, but Adrien tells him to hide as Nathalie walks in and reminds Adrien that he has 24 minutes to finish eating before his Chinese class. Adrien asks if his father is too busy to eat with him, to which Nathalie tells him when the next scheduled dinner between him and his father is. Sadly, Adrien goes up to eat in his room. Plagg is excited since they can now go to Marinette's, but Adrien reminds him that he's only going there to inform Marinette that he isn't in love with her. Not wanting to break her heart, Adrien decides to bring the pink rose on his dinner tray as a gift for Marinette.

title: Weredad
text:
Weredad - Plot
Marinette doesn't see Cat Noir and is now sure that he's not coming, but before she leaves, Tikki spots Cat Noir heading towards the bakery.
Marinette is in shock at the possibility that Cat Noir fell in love with her and changed his mind about his love for Ladybug.
She decides that she must tell Cat Noir the truth but soon realizes that if she does, Cat Noir will want to know why she lied and may figure out that she's Ladybug.
Marinette relucantly goes downstairs and after hearing the doorbell ring, answers it with Tom's insistance.
Cat Noir greets Marinette, and Tom joyfully lifts and hugs him tight.
Sabine reminds Tom to let Cat Noir breathe, so he apologizes and puts the hero down.
Cat Noir and Marinette then nervously greet each other with kisses on each other's cheek.
Tom takes note of how Cat Noir brought Marinette a pink rose and says that they already know each other well since Marinette adores pink, but Marinette points out that everyone likes pink and Cat Noir reminds him that they don't really know each other all that well.
However, Tom calls this love at first sight and drags the two to the dining table.
He then presents them with some tasty heart-shaped treats.

title: Weredad
text:
Weredad - Plot
While Cat Noir eats, Tom asks him if as a superhero, he finds the situation good, surprising Cat Noir and making him choke on his food.
Marinette tells her father that perhaps dating a superhero is too dangerous, but Tom says that it's okay since Cat Noir won't be a superhero his whole life and after he defeats Hawk Moth, he can work at the bakery with them, envisioning how great it would be. Tom then presents a heart-shaped cake, but Sabine suggets that they let Cat Noir say what he wants to say. Marinette agrees and angrily notes how Cat Noir seems to be the type to change his mind fast. Cat Noir thanks Marinette and her parents for the lovely dinner but reveals that he isn't in love with Marinette -- he loves Ladybug. Tom and Sabine are shocked, and Marinette is happy, but not wanting anyone to know, she pretends to be heartbroken and runs up to her room. Cat Noir apologizes for causing so much trouble, thanks Tom and Sabine for the invitation, and leaves. Tom is furious.

title: Weredad
text:
Weredad - Plot
Hawk Moth senses how upset Tom is about Marinette getting her heart broken and sends an akuma after him. Sabine tries to comfort Tom and assures him that Marinette will find another boy that she loves, but Tom refuses to allow anyone to break his daughter's heart again. Just then, the akuma infects the rose Tom is holding. Hawk Moth offers Tom the power to protect his daughter from a world of heartbreak in return for Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses. Tom agrees and is transformed into Weredad, causing a large beanstalk-like vine to sprout from the bakery and trap Marinette on the very top of it. Cat Noir sees the vine and rushes back to the bakery. Tikki also flies up towards Marinette.
Cat Noir apologizes to Sabine, blaming himself for the situation.
However, Sabine tells him that it's not his fault and her husband just makes too big a deal out of everything.
Cat Noir promises Sabine that he'll bring both her husband and daughter back.
Sabine believes that he should wait for Ladybug, but Cat Noir is confident that she'll show up when he needs her, causing Sabine to realize just how much Cat Noir loves her.

title: Weredad
text:
Weredad - Plot
While Cat Noir climbs the vine in search of Marinette and Tom, Marinette and Tikki look for each other inside the maze of thorny vines Weredad trapped her in.
When Cat Noir reaches the top of the vine, he is confronted by Weredad, who is angry to see him again after all the trouble he caused.
The villain fights Cat Noir, who insists that he'll save Marinette, though Weredad believes that she is safe from heartbreak.
Cat Noir tells Weredad that he didn't mean to hurt Marinette, but Weredad merely says that he's going to hurt him before attacking him, causing the hero to nearly fall off the vine.
Cat Noir attempts to climb up to where Marinette is, but Weredad refuses to allow him to save his daughter.
Cat Noir tells Weredad that his way of protecting Marinette will only make her lonely for the rest of her life.
However, Weredad says that one day, a prince worthy of her will climb up the vine, confront him, and pluck the magic rose to free Marinette.
Marinette and Tikki continue to search for one another but have no luck.
Tikki realizes that the thorn maze is magical and prevents them from finding one another.

title: Weredad
text:
Weredad - Plot
Marinette spots the akumatized rose in the middle of the maze and heads towards it, though there are several obstacles that she must pass first.
Meanwhile, Cat Noir continues to battle Weredad but the villain overpowers him.
Hawk Moth orders Weredad to grab his Miraculous.
Before he does, Marinette reaches the rose and grabs it, releasing the akuma and deakumatizing Tom.
With that, the vine begins to fall apart and Cat Noir, Tom, and Marinette all begin to fall.
Tikki approaches Marinette, who transforms into Ladybug.
She captures the akuma and purifies it.
Cat Noir then spots Ladybug and calls out to her.
Ladybug assures him that she's coming, but Cat Noir tells him to save Marinette as she's in danger.
Ladybug assures Cat Noir that Marinette is safe, which pleases Cat Noir and causes him to comment on how one can't help but fall in love with her.
However, he takes it back after noticing that Tom is still upset with him.
Ladybug calls on her Lucky Charm and receives a sailboat.
Once the three of them are in it, Cat Noir uses Cataclysm on the sailboat's hull.
Then, Ladybug and Cat Noir quickly turn it into a glider for the three of them to land safely.

title: Weredad
text:
Weredad - Plot
Once on the ground, Sabine and Tom run towards each other and hug.
Ladybug then uses Miraculous Ladybug to fix all the damage.
Tom, Sabine, and Cat Noir then all run upstairs to check on Marinette, even though Ladybug tries to tell them that she's safe.
Quickly she rushes to her bedroom and detransforms before they arrive.
Tom is happy to see his daughter safe and hugs her, noting how sad she had been because of Cat Noir. Noticing how angry her father is getting, Marinette tells him to calm down and then tells Cat Noir that Ladybug is lucky to have someone like him love her and says that they can still be friends. Cat Noir is relieved that Marinette isn't heartbroken and hugs her, calling her an amazing girl even though she isn't his number one fan. Marinette is surprised that Cat Noir thought she was his number one fan, which Cat Noir tells her is what he'd assumed when he saw her on the balcony. Sabine tells Tom that Marinette can handle her own heartbreaks and Tom forgives Cat Noir, though he does ask him if he's sure he doesn't want to work in the bakery with him, much to Marinette's annoyance.

title: Weredad
text:
Weredad - Plot Developments
After the battle with Gigantitan, the Miraculous Ladybug is used without the summoned Lucky Charm for the first time.
This could mean that Ladybug broke a piece of the charm off unseen to use the superpower or maybe the two powers aren't completely linked together and the power isn't only activated by using the lucky charm but also by some other means.
The Miraculous Ladybug (superpower) doesn't only fix the damage done by a villain, those affected by said villain's powers or Cat Noir's Cataclysm but it also has the power to heal those who are hurt as the magic ladybugs healed Cat Noir's injuries from his battle with Weredad.
According to Adrien this was the first time when a girl admits she's in love with him.
Since Marinette is unaware that Adrien is Cat Noir, she actually confessed her feelings to her crush without realizing it.

title: Weredad
text:
Weredad - Plot Developments
However when Tikki reprimanded Marinette for lying about her feelings towards Cat Noir, from her perspective ever since "The Dark Owl", she and Plagg had known each other's owner's identities, so she should have been happy for Marinette doing so. But she could have said what she said to keep up that she knew or it could that she was sad about Marinette tricking her dad about being in love with the hero.

title: Weredad
text:
Weredad - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in Switzerland on RTS Play.
This episode was first revealed during a script reading by Brazilian Portuguese voice actors Fabrício Vila Verde (Cat Noir's voice actor) and Jéssica Vieira (Ladybug's voice actress) as well as fragments of this episode being released at CCXP 2018 on 8 December 2018 (at 4:30 PM).
Weredad started to act like Gabriel Agreste, both as himself and as Hawk Moth in regards to his son, as Weredad wanted to protect his daughter from being sad and keeping her locked up in a thorn prison without giving any thought he was would make her miserable from doing it, like Gabriel on how he barely lets his son out of the house and thinks it would be better if he is kept at home.
This is the first time Ladybug purifies the akuma before calling on her Lucky Charm.
This is the second time where Marinette's transformation sequence is not shown following "Mayura" .
Additionally, this episode is the second time after "Mayura" where no transformation sequences are shown at all.
The akuma catch scene has been reused from "Mayura" with a blue background.

title: Weredad
text:
Weredad - Trivia
This is the first time Ladybug summons a Lucky Charm in midair and downwards, instead of the usual direction, which is up.
This is the first time Cat Noir uses his Cataclysm on a Lucky Charm object and yet the second time where a Lucky Charm object breaks (excluding the broken plate in "Troublemaker") before "Robostus" and followed by "Miraculer", "Psycomedian" and "Hack-San".
As well as summoning a Lucky Charm after a villain's defeat.
Usually Ladybug always catches her Lucky Charm object but this is first time where it catches her.
This is also the second time Cat Noir uses Cataclysm on an object that was obscured following "The Pharaoh".
Plagg's metaphor involving cooking pots references his knowledge of Marinette being Ladybug since "The Dark Owl". Also, when he says this, he breaks the fourth wall.
This is the first time Marinette defeats an Akumatized villain without transforming into Ladybug.
References
August is akumatized for the third time: first in "Gigantitan" and again in the "Heroes' Day" special.

title: Weredad
text:
Weredad - Trivia
His akumatization are not shown, making this the fourth time this happens, after Magician of Misfortune in "Princess Fragrance", Vanisher in "Antibug" and the Unnamed boy in "Sandboy"
This is the fourth episode where a relative of the Dupain-Cheng family is akumatized, following "Bakerix", "Kung Food" and "Befana". In this case, it is Tom Dupain.
Cat Noir gave Marinette a rose like he did in "Glaciator".
Unlike in "Glaciator", the rose is pink; red roses are seen as a symbol of love (in line with Cat Noir's feelings about Ladybug), while pink roses are seen as a symbol of friendship (in line with Cat Noir's feelings about Marinette).
This is the fifth time Marinette and Tikki end up separated which previously occurred in "Princess Fragrance", "Sandboy", "Miraculous Shanghai" and "Reflekdoll".
This is the fourth time the akumatized object was not in the hands of the villain following "The Dark Owl", "Captain Hardrock", and "Style Queen".
Although, in "Style Queen", the object started in Style Queen's hands but then she put it in Adrien's mouth, whom she had previously turned into a glitter statue.

title: Weredad
text:
Weredad - Trivia
This is the fourth episode Alya Césaire doesn't appear in. However, she was briefly mentioned by Cat Noir.
This is the fifth time where Cat Noir and Ladybug deal with two akumatized villains following "Princess Fragrance", "Antibug", "Volpina" and "Queen's Battle".
This also the fifth episode where Ladybug and Cat Noir use their powers twice following "The Dark Owl", "Mayura", "Miraculous Shanghai" and "Reflekdoll".
This is fourth time an akuma is seen by a character before someone becomes akumatized following "Riposte", "Gigantitan".
However, this time Sabine sees the akuma, instead of Marinette or Adrien.
When Adrien calls Marinette "an amazing girl" as Cat Noir is a reference to what Alya said at the end of "The Bubbler".
Similar to "Despair Bear", Cat Noir and Marinette kiss each others cheeks for two reasons: to greet each other and is part of French tradition. Although controversial, there's no sign of either Cat Noir and Marinette showing love to each other.
This is the eighth time where the heroes appeal to reason with an akumatized villain following "Frightningale", "Riposte", "Robostus", "Volpina", "The Mime", "Rogercop" and "Stormy Weather".
Allusions

title: Weredad
text:
Weredad - Trivia
This episode's title is derived from werewolf.
Similarly, the French title, Papa-Garou, comes from loup-garou, the French term for werewolf.
According to Thomas Astruc on Twitter, this episode is a tribute to fairy tales, especially 'Zettai Unmei Mokushiroku' (Absolute Destiny Apocalypse), a song by J.A Seazer.
One of the inspirations might be "Beauty and the Beast", a French fairy tale involving an enchanted rose, a man who is placed under a spell and cursed in the form of a hulking beast or monster as punishment for his selfishness and arrogance, and an imprisoned kind girl.
The rose was also kept precious, just like in the episode.
Other fairy tales possibly used are "Jack and the Beanstalk" with the tall plant reaching the sky, and "Sleeping Beauty" with the thorn maze.
Errors
When Cat Noir is in Marinette's house, his ring is silver instead of black.
When Weredad reveals himself to Cat Noir, the latter's left costume ear disappeared.
When Cat Noir is holding onto a vine in front of Weredad, his ring is blue.
When Marinette took the rose from Cat Noir, it went through her hand.
Marinette's shirt is miscolored gray throughout the whole dinner.

Before Ladybug detransformed, her civilian feet and hands can be seen in the few shots before the detransformation occurred.
When the Akuma is flying out of Hawk Moth's lair, the Eiffel Tower is shown in the background.

text:

text:

text:

text:

text:

(Cat Noir is still chewing)

(Her parents recoil in shock.)

title: Weredad/Transcript
text:
Weredad/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (excitedly) Oh, this is so— (She remembers she's supposed to be heartbroken.) Uh… (She looks at her parents.) So sad! (grabbing Cat Noir, dramatically) Oh, to think I spent all this time following you everywhere to tell you that I loved you Cat Noir! (cries) I am so miserable! (weeps on table) No one will ever love me! (Her father looks sad and concerned) (into her hands) I'll end up all alone with my hamster, (running to the stairs) and its name will be (inhales) Loneliness!!
