Cat Noir: (getting up to leave) Well, uh, I don't want to bother you any longer. I'm really sorry. Thanks for having me anyway. (He exits)
(Tom clenches his fist and growls furiously)
Hawk Moth: Is there a more delicious recipe than a father's heart broken by his child's heartache? (He akumatizes a butterfly) Fly, my dreadful akuma. An evil feast of darkness awaits you. (He laughs)
(The akuma flies away)
Tom: (voice) How can he not love Marinette? (Tom is holding the rose) (in apartment) Everyone loves Marinette!

title: Weredad/Transcript
text:
Weredad/Transcript - Intro
Sabine: (She grabs Tom's hand) One day, Marinette will meet another boy. She'll love him with all her heart, and—
(The akuma enters the apartment. Tom shrugs Sabine's hand away. She gasps.)
Tom: He'll break it, too. Never again! I won't let anyone break my daughter's heart again! (The akuma enters the rose. Sabine gasps in shock that akuma will akumatize her beloved husband. A light halo appears around Tom's face.)
Hawk Moth: (voice) Weredad. (from his lair) I am Hawk Moth. I'm giving you the power to protect your daughter from anything that brings her harm. In return…
Tom: (in apartment) I'll bring you some Cat Noir pâté.
Hawk Moth: (in lair) That, and his and Ladybug's Miraculous, would be perfect.
(Tom and the entire apartment are surrounded by the akumatizing purple and black bubbles. Sabine gasps and backs up.)
Marinette: What is this? Tikki!
Tikki: Marinette!
Cat Noir: I messed up. (He hears an explosion and turns to see the bubbles forming a giant, thorny, stalk-like stem growing from the apartment.) I really messed up! (He runs towards the building) Marinette!
(Tikki emerges from behind the stem. She looks up to the top.)
Tikki: Marinette!
(Cat Noir bursts through the door)

title: Weredad/Transcript
text:
Weredad/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: I'm so sorry, this is all my fault!
Sabine: (She turns) Of course not, Cat Noir. It's Tom. (She puts her hands on his shoulders.)
Cat Noir: Huh?
Sabine: (gesturing) No matter how many times I tell him, he always takes things too far.
Cat Noir: (He clenches his fist) I'll bring your husband back to his senses and get Marinette out of this. I promise.
Sabine: Shouldn't you wait for Ladybug?
Cat Noir: I trust her. She always shows up at the right time.
Sabine: You really love her, huh?
Cat Noir: Yes. (He surrenders his hands) But, um, Marinette's seems like an awesome girl, too, you know. (clenching fist) Don't worry. I’ll save her.
Sabine: I have faith in you, Cat Noir. (She puts her hand on his shoulder) You're a good person. Never apologize for your feelings.
Cat Noir: Thank you, Mrs. Dupain-Cheng. (He jumps on the stalk and climbs up through the ceiling.)
Sabine: Good luck, Cat Noir.
(He climbs through the clouds and stops to look out. He continues upward and lands on a flat platform of vines.)
Cat Noir: Marinette! (He looks to the top and sees a ball of thorny vines.)
Marinette: (panting) (She grunts as she jumps down from a giant vine) Tikki? (She looks around) Tikki?

title: Weredad/Transcript
text:
Weredad/Transcript - Intro
(Outside the thorny ball. Tikki is looking for Marinette.)
Tikki: Marinette! (She flies inside) Marinette!
Marinette: Tikki? (She runs towards Tikki's voice) I'm here!
Tikki: Marinette?
Marinette: (voice) Tikki?
Tikki: Where are you? (She looks around as the room turns)
Cat Noir: Marinette? Mr. Dupain? (He's startled by a giant foot)
(Tom is akumatized into a large brown werewolf-looking creature with green shorts and vines around his wrists, ankles, and waist. The vine around his waist extends like a tail.)
Weredad: How dare you come back after what you've done? (He jumps and attacks Cat Noir, who rolls away, recovers, and spins his staff in his hand.)
Cat Noir: I will always be here to save Marinette. (He deflects Weredad's punch and continues to dodge him.)
Weredad: She's safe from you and all the boys who want to break her heart. (They struggle with the staff. Cat Noir jumps away before Weredad can punch him.)
Cat Noir: I didn't mean to break her heart, sir, I swear.
Weredad: Then I swear that I'm about to crush your bones! (He grabs the vine around his waist and hits Cat Noir. Cat Noir rolls off the edge of the stalk platform but catches himself.)

title: Weredad/Transcript
text:
Weredad/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: Where are you, Ladybug? (He climbs back up) I'm sorry, but— ah! (Weredad picks him up by the back of his neck) I can't let you do this!
Weredad: Why not? (He throws Cat Noir.)
Cat Noir: Ah! (Cat Noir lands and dodges punches from Weredad.)
Cat Noir: Because I have— whoa! — a damsel in distress to rescue! (He tries to climb up the stalk but is pulled down by his belt and spun around by Weredad.)
Weredad: I forbid you to rescue her! You don't deserve to save her. (He slams Cat Noir into the ground) From now on, no one else but I will protect her! (Cat Noir groans as he gets up and holds his arm)
Cat Noir: And are you planning to protect her all her life?
Weredad: Exactly! I’ll keep her safe from sadness, hardship, and anything else that could hurt her!
Cat Noir: You can't protect her from what hurts the most. Do you know what hurts the most?
Weredad: My great big punches? (They lunge towards each other. Cat Noir lands behind him and bends his staff around Weredad to restrain him.)

title: Weredad/Transcript
text:
Weredad/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: No! What hurts the most is solitude. Believe me, I know all about it. Nothing hurts more than isolation. Having to sit alone in front of a cold meal. Is that what you want for your daughter? A lifetime of cold meals in her prison of roses?
(Weredad briefly looks remorseful, but then breaks free from Cat Noir's staff)
Weredad: She will never be alone! (Cat Noir flips away and lands on one knee) Someday, a prince will come. A prince worthy of her, daring enough to face me! Who will brave the many dangers and pick the magic rose for her! He will be worthy of taking her from my guard!
Marinette: Tikki!
Tikki: This is a magic prison, Marinette. It looks like it's trying to keep me from finding you!
Marinette: Ah! (She looks around, lost) There must be a way out of here!
(She sees a beam of yellow light illuminating something. She shields her eyes with her hand and squints. Cat Noir's pink rose is standing in a thorn.) That rose! It's the one Cat Noir gave me!

title: Weredad/Transcript
text:
Weredad/Transcript - Intro
(She runs towards it, but steps on a section of vine that makes a clanging noise. Marinette jumps out of the way of a loose vine. She's activated an obstacle course made of swinging thorny vines.) Okay. (She starts to run through)
Cat Noir: I may not be her prince, but I'm charming enough to free her.
Weredad: I forbid you to do so! (He raises his fist and Cat Noir flinches)
Cat Noir: Ah!
Tikki: Marinette? Marinette?
Marinette: I'm okay! I can do it.
Cat Noir: Not being in love with her, losing my stick, won't keep me from saving her. (Weredad picks him up) I'll never give up. Never! (He punches Weredad's fist weakly. Weredad brings him to the edge of the platform.)
Weredad: You're not worthy of my daughter. (A light halo appears around his face)
Hawk Moth: (from his lair) The Miraculous! Grab his ring!
(On the stalk, Weredad starts to grab Cat Noir's ring)
Marinette: Gotcha! (The rose dissolves into an akuma) Huh? Ah! (She looks around) Uh oh. (The entire vine ball breaks apart and falls out of the sky. Marinette, inside the ball, screams.)
(Outside, Weredad turns back into Tom and falls backwards.)
Tom: What? What's going o— (The stalk collapses)

title: Weredad/Transcript
text:
Weredad/Transcript - Intro
(Tom, Cat Noir and Marinette scream simultaneously while falling; Marinette is clinging to a piece of stalk)
Tikki: Marinette!
Marinette: Tikki! Spots on! (She transforms in a flash of pink and dives towards Cat Noir and Tom.)
Ladybug: Ha! (She extends her arms and legs to slow down. She catches the akuma) Gotcha! Bye bye, little butterfly. (It flies away.)
(Cat Noir turns around and waves his arms)
Cat Noir: M'Lady! Whoa!
Ladybug: I'm coming!
Cat Noir: No, take care of Marinette! She's somewhere around here!
Ladybug: Don't worry, I've already taken her to safety!
Cat Noir: (to himself) She's as wonderful as ever. (He flips around, clasps his hands together on his cheek and raises his foot.) Who wouldn't be in love with Ladybug? (Tom crosses his arms, perturbed. Cat Noir backpedals) Oh, I— she also has some flaws, you know.
(Ladybug catches up with them.)
Ladybug: Not all of us know how to land on our feet. So I guess we're gonna need a little bit of luck! Lucky Charm! (A sailboat appears under them and slows their descent.) Do your thing, Cat Noir! (He nods)
Cat Noir: Cataclysm! (He touches the hull of the boat) Hang on! (The sail lifts them higher)

title: Weredad/Transcript
text:
Weredad/Transcript - Intro
(Ladybug and Cat Noir tie the sail to the mast and boom to make a hang glider. They glide over the city, landing on the street in front of the bakery.)
(Sabine runs out the front door.)
Sabine: Tom!
Tom: Honey! (He runs over and they hug)
Cat Noir: (He extends his fist feebly) Pound it, m'lady. (He collapses in her arms)
Ladybug: Pound it, Cat Noir. (She throws part of the hang glider frame into the air) Miraculous Ladybug!
(The fallen vines disappear, resulting in a woman's foot being freed and a man being able to open his car to hug his son. Cat Noir is healed.)
(Sabine and Tom run into their bakery.)
Tom: Marinette!
Sabine: Marinette!
Tom: Marinette! (Cat Noir follows them)
Cat Noir: Marinette!
Ladybug: Wait! The miraculous ladybugs have repaired everything, so she must be safely back in her room. (She swings up to her balcony)
Tom, Sabine, and Cat Noir: Marinette!
Tom: Marinette! (He hugs her tightly)
Marinette: (strained) Dad, I can't breathe! (He releases her)
Tom: Oh, sorry. I was so scared. You were so heartbroken because of that— (He clenches his fist, looks at Cat Noir, and growls angrily. Cat Noir straightens and giggles nervously.)

title: Weredad/Transcript
text:
Weredad/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Dad, stop! (She lowers his fist and puts her hand on his arm) Cat Noir has every right to be in love with Ladybug. (She walks over to Cat Noir) She's very lucky to have you. And just because you and I aren't in love with each other doesn't mean that we can't be friends.
Cat Noir: Really? (wiping his brow) Phew! I really didn't wanna hurt you, Marinette. (He hugs her) You seem like such an awesome person. (She smiles and chuckles. He releases her.) Even though you’re not a huge fan of mine, like I originally thought when I saw you on the roof.
Marinette: (surprised) What? You just thought I… was a fan of yours?
Cat Noir: Well, yeah, that's what I was about to say when you jumped on me. "Could it be that she's a fan of mine?"
Sabine: You see, Tom? Your daughter is strong and can handle her own disappointments. And even if he's not in love with Marinette, Cat Noir proved himself by saving her today.

title: Weredad/Transcript
text:
Weredad/Transcript - Intro
Tom: (He puts his arm around Cat Noir's shoulder) It's true. Your courage and tenacity match those of the greatest pastry chefs. Are you sure that you don't want to learn the trade? If you bring fresh croissants to Ladybug every day, she'll surely wind up falling in love with you.
Marinette: Dad! (They laugh)

title: Wishmaker
text:
Wishmaker - Intro
"" is a Season 4 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 18th written and produced episode of Season 4. It is also the 96th written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Wishmaker
text:
Wishmaker - Synopsis
It's Careers of Paris weekend, and the students need to think about their future. Marinette realizes that there are so many things that she wants to do… that she doesn't know what she really wants anymore. Adrien doesn't know either… because his father has always decided for him. The two friends meet at Careers of Paris, where Luka provides guidance. But a villain shows up. Wishmaker wants to force people to live their childhood dreams, and targets Ladybug and Cat Noir especially, to make them reveal their secret identities…
Disney+
Ladybug and Cat Noir face Wishmaker.
Netflix
As Marinette and Adrien consider their futures at a career expo, Ladybug and Cat Noir fight a villain who makes people's childhood dreams come alive.

title: Wishmaker
text:
Wishmaker - Plot
Marinette is handing out questionnaires to her classmates, which she received from Miss Bustier, who is telling the class that the papers are about filling their study options when school is finished. Chloé openly admits that when she finishes school, she will be rich, since she already is, and mocks Marinette for being a baker girl, which she believes is plain ridiculous. Miss Bustier tells Chloé that people are defined by their choices and what they decide to do with their lives, and that's why she is asking everyone to start defining themselves. Denis Damoclès elaborates by informing the students that the Paris Expo will be held in various locations across the city. During this, Marinette continues to distribute the papers, and she blushes once she reaches Adrien. Marinette next comes to Alya, who asks her if being a superhero counts as a job. Both laugh as Denis Damoclès tells the students they should never let the context impose on their costumes, they should choose their own. With this said, he quickly runs out of the classroom and returns as The Owl.

title: Wishmaker
text:
Wishmaker - Plot
However, Adrien is watching all this, eventually looks at the career expo papers sadly, and the scene transitions to his room sometime afterward. Plagg asks Adrien if he wants to continue modeling, but Adrien explains that he only does modeling because of his father's wishes, and he never wondered what he wanted to be if independent. Plagg suggests to Adrien that he could continue being Cat Noir as his full-time job, but Adrien worries that with Ladybug constantly choosing new Miraculous holders, she won't need him anymore. Plagg lets Adrien know that he'll always be there for him, and advises that they could open a cheese shop together. Adrien laughs at Plagg's words and warns him that he can't eat cheese if he's trying to sell it. Plagg slightly grunts and wonders if there are jobs to taste cheese, to which Adrien brings up visiting the food trade booths. Ultimately, the two decide to visit the Paris Career Expo.

title: Wishmaker
text:
Wishmaker - Plot
Meanwhile, Marinette is discussing her complicated life with the Kwamis, and tells them that a job is something that "gives meaning to your life". This confuses the Kwamis, as they ponder all the different "jobs" Marinette currently has, such as being the Guardian, crafting, or being in life, until Sass tells them to remain silent. Sass then asks Marinette what the really important thing is that will bring meaning to her life. A bewildered Marinette admits that she doesn't know anymore, and Tikki advises her to go and visit a few booths at the Paris Careers Expo, to which Marinette agrees.
Later at Île aux Cygnes, Alec Cataldi is welcoming his audience to a new show he's recording, entitled "You've Gotta Be Kidding".
Live at the Paris Careers Expo, he plans to introduce people to the most pointless shops and jobs ever.
To start, Alec attempts to humiliate André the ice-cream maker by making fun of the fact that he is constantly moving around Paris, making it hard to find where he is, and the fact that he chooses the ice-cream flavors you eat.
Andrè claims that people come to him to share their love and experience of magical moments, but Alec still claims that it's not a real job.

title: Wishmaker
text:
Wishmaker - Plot
After Andrè offers Alec ice cream flavored with lime for his sourness outside and chocolate cinnamon for his sweet dreams, Alec becomes mortified after receiving the ice cream from André and orders the cameraman to cut the scene.
They both walk away, but Marinette, who was witnessing everything in the crowd nearby, asks Andrè how he got to know that making ice cream was his job.
Andrè tells Marinette about how years ago, he was in a job that didn't make him happy, but every day when he came home from work, he would concoct ice-cream flavors that suited his mood.
He soon realized that if ice cream enchanted his daily life, he wondered if his true calling was to enchant others' lives.
Andrè then offers Marinette ice-cream flavored with strawberry and cherry "for the indecisive lady", and pistachio and pecan for "the clear-sighted young man".
Marinette soon realized that the "young man" Andrè wanted Marinette to share his ice-cream with was Luka, who was standing right behind them.
Marinette quickly informs Andrè that she and Luka aren't dating anymore, and they're just friends.
Andrè assures them they don't need to be in love to share his ice-cream, and they decide to take it.

title: Wishmaker
text:
Wishmaker - Plot
Later, Marinette tells Luka that she was surprised to see him here because she thought he already knew what career he was going to have.
Luka tells Marinette that he's in charge of his school's booth, where he shows people how to make stringed instruments.
The two arrive at Luka's booth, where guitars, electric guitars, and other stringed instruments are displayed as Marinette looks fascinated, and Luka grabs one of the guitars and asks Marinette why she's here if she wants to be a fashion designer.
Marinette confusingly tells Luka that she doesn't know anymore because there are so many careers that interest her in the world of fashion, creation, decoration, and compliments Luka that he's lucky to know what he wants to do.
Luka advises Marinette to listen to her inner voice and shows Marinette the first instrument he made himself, which took two years to complete.
Luka hands over the guitar to an amazed Marinette, but Alec abruptly comes into the scene and mocks Luka by stating that it would be easier to download a guitar-playing app within seconds, which he does and masters playing it, and then deems Luka's job as pointless.

title: Wishmaker
text:
Wishmaker - Plot
Luka grabs the violin and tells Marinette, Alec, and the cameraman to follow him outside to the Île aux Cygnes.
There, Luka closes his eyes whilst feeling the breeze as Alec and his cameraman look at each other in confusion.
The cameraman begins to film Luka, who raises his violin in the air to let the wind produce music for it, and explains that "musical instruments fill the space and space fills the instruments".

title: Wishmaker
text:
Wishmaker - Plot
Alec begins to cry at the seemingly beautiful sight, but then realizes that he's on the air, and once again orders the cameraman to cut the scene. As the frustrated pair storms off, Marinette compliments Luka that he has a gift for finding the right words at the right time. Luka suddenly notices Adrien, who's far from the two, sadly sitting under the tree. Luka alerts Marinette of his presence, and Marinette gets nervous and hides behind Luka. Luka asks if she hasn't told Adrien about her feelings for him, and she says she hasn't. Marinette realizes Adrien looks sad, and together they decide to go over to talk to him. Luka asks Adrien if something is wrong. He responds by saying he went through every stand in the career expo and still doesn't know what to do with his life, and if he doesn't choose his father's will for him.
Luka sits next to Adrien, Marinette looks conflicted about who to sit next to, but ultimately chooses to sit next to Luka.
Luka turns back to Adrien and tells him he's never thought modeling was truly his passion.

title: Wishmaker
text:
Wishmaker - Plot
Adrien says it was easier that way, he thought he would be happy doing what his father wanted of him, like Luka who wants to be a musician like his father and Marinette who's always known that she wanted to pursue a career in the Fashion Department, each of them says that it's actually way more complicated than it seems, they all emerge in surprise and they laugh.
Luka tells them that he doesn't want to be a rock star like his dad, he said that music is his nature and not someone he wants to pursue as his career, what he wants is for other people to feel the music.
Luka says that he wants to be a stringed instrument maker so that other people can feel it.
Adrien smiles.
Marinette tells them that she always wants to try new things, but she can't manage her priorities properly, and she's really mixed up about the careers she wants to try.
Adrien says that his father always arranges everything for him, and when he thinks about what he wants to be, he just can't think straight; his mind is empty.

title: Wishmaker
text:
Wishmaker - Plot
Adrien and Marinette say that the things they would like to try are lost. Luka reminds them that to know who you really are, you simply need to learn to listen to your inner melody. Luka listens to Marinette's inner melody, and he tells her that all the instruments are playing different melodies, and he understands she is completely lost. Everyone laughs. Then Luka tells Marinette that if she listens more closely, the music of her band is really beautiful, and that she just needs some time to understand it. He then listens to Adrien's music and says that it sounds like it's being muffled by someone else playing a sad piano tune, but his true melody is a happy one. Luka then stands up, grabs his violin, and tells Marinette and Adrien that they will eventually find what's in front of them, but they can't hear it clearly, and to just let the melody flow. With that, he begins playing the violin. Marinette and Adrien become mesmerized by the music, and they smile at each other.

title: Wishmaker
text:
Wishmaker - Plot
Meanwhile, at the Île aux Cygnes, Alec continues on his show and is standing in front of a wig booth. He then tries to humiliate the wig seller, unsuccessfully, as the wig seller interjects that a wig is never a disguise, but very revealing. He then takes a wig and puts it on Alec, which causes him to remember a horrible memory from his childhood. He then reveals that he used to have long hair, but everyone made fun of him, so he shaved it all off. He then has a breakdown after realizing he has wasted his life on mocking everyday people, just like the people in his childhood, instead of changing it.
Shadow Moth's lair window then opens, sensing Alec's sadness. He then creates an akuma and sends it after him, entering his microphone. Shadow Moth offers Alec the power to make people live their childhood dreams when he touches them. Alec accepts, saying that from now on, he will only be what he wants to be, and transforms into Wishmaker, and begins targeting people and making their childhood dreams come true, even turning Jagged Stone into a crocodile and a man into Santa.

title: Wishmaker
text:
Wishmaker - Plot
Back in the Île aux Cygnes, Luka continues to play the violin for Marinette and Adrien when, suddenly, Jagged as a crocodile appears, to the teens' shock. They then start running, but they are stopped by a giant robot, causing Adrien to run and hide in a tree and Luka to hide Marinette in a porta-potty, where she secretly transforms into Ladybug. Luka tries to take on the robot, which nearly attacks him, but is saved by Ladybug, who takes him to the expo and thanks her. He then runs back to the portalet to check on Marinette, but she has disappeared. Luka then tries calling her, but Jagged calls for help, drowning in the lake, and Luka rescues him.

title: Wishmaker
text:
Wishmaker - Plot
Robo Tech then faces off with Ladybug, saying that he always wanted to be Roboto Tech. Ladybug then clarifies that they are not living in a video game. Cat Noir then arrives and makes Robo Tech fall and power off, then joins Ladybug, adding that he has mistaken dreams for reality. The two heroes witness Wishmaker targeting and transforming a firefighter, who wanted to be a cowboy and a fireman at the same time. Wishmaker is about to target another person, but is held back by Ladybug's yo-yo. Wishmaker then yells at her, saying that he only wanted to make people happy. Ladybug once again clarifies that he is doing it against their will and without permission. Wishmaker then retorts by saying that he only wants people to live their dreams. Cat Noir, looking skeptical, points behind him and asks him if that is a dream. The one he's pointing to turns out to be someone, as a cucumber, rolling down the road and behind an annoyed Cat Noir.
Wishmaker then twirls his staff, sending Ladybug to the ground beside Cat Noir.
Wishmaker then starts to attack the two heroes, trying to avoid being hit, as that would reveal their secret identities.

title: Wishmaker
text:
Wishmaker - Plot
Ladybug then reveals her childhood dream to be the Knitting Fairy when she was six, and adds that the Knitting Fairy didn't wear a mask.
As she speaks, a jet of light nearly hits her, but she is pulled in time by Cat Noir.
The two then launch themselves to the rooftops.
Ladybug then asks him what his childhood dream was, and Cat Noir looks away sadly.
Ladybug then laughs and says that he's making fun of her, but he's too embarrassed to tell her.
Wishmaker then launches himself in the air and sends two jets of light towards them, which they dodge.
Cat Noir then tells Ladybug that he didn't know what he wanted to be as a kid.
Ladybug then jokes about whether he wants to be a magician or a fireman.
Ladybug then stops and uses her yo-yo to pull Cat Noir away from an incoming Wishmaker.
Wishmaker then keeps hitting them, while Cat Noir objects that he can't remember.
Ladybug then tells him he must've forgotten, and pulls Cat Noir to the other side of the wall, and the two heroes continue running.
Ladybug then adds that if Wishmaker ever hits one of them, they need a second chance, to which Cat Noir suggests Viperion.

title: Wishmaker
text:
Wishmaker - Plot
Ladybug then agrees and urges him to keep fighting while she goes to get Luka.
Ladybug then swings away.
At the Île aux Cygnes, Jagged and Luka are lying down, talking. Luka then says that crocodiles know how to swim, to which Jagged replies that he didn't know how to swim when he was a kid. Ladybug then arrives, and Luka immediately gets up, knowing the situation. Ladybug then excuses Luka from Jagged, saying she needs a word with him, to which Jagged replies with a thumbs-up and rock and roll.
Ladybug and Luka land on a rooftop, and she hands him the Snake Miraculous. Sass appears, and he and Luka greet each other. Ladybug then tells him to use his power now, in case she or Cat Noir gets hit, he has to come back to the exact moment. Luka then agrees and transforms into Viperion and uses his power. Ladybug then reminds him that no one can know about their secret identities. Viperion says she can count on him. Ladybug smiles, and she uses her Lucky Charm, and a dino plushie appears, to her confusion.
Meanwhile, Cat Noir and Wishmaker continue to battle, with the former continuously blocking the latter's attacks.

title: Wishmaker
text:
Wishmaker - Plot
Wishmaker then says that every child has a dream, to which Cat Noir replies that not everyone has.
Wishmaker then tells him that he just needs to get his memory back and that all he needs to do is let him touch him, and his childhood dream will be revealed to him.
Shadow Moth is impressed, telling Wishmaker to make Cat Noir's dreams come true and show him his true face.
Ladybug and Viperion then arrive.
Cat Noir nearly gets hit by Wishmaker, but is pulled in time by Viperion.
Using her Lucky Vision, Ladybug spots Wishmaker, Viperion, and a few people.
Ladybug then asks the people if the dino plushie means anything to them, to which they all shake their heads.
Just then, Wishmaker releases another shooting star, which Viperion deflects, eventually hitting Ladybug, causing her to remember her childhood dream.
She then transforms into Marinette, dressed in a Knitting Fairy costume, and says that she wanted to be the Knitting Fairy in real life.
Viperion is left shocked, as he now knows the reason why Marinette has been keeping secrets from him.
Shadow Moth is also left shocked, then he finally shouts in victory at last.

title: Wishmaker
text:
Wishmaker - Plot
Viperion then uses Second Chance, bringing them back to the moment where Ladybug tells Viperion that no one can know about their secret identities.
She then calls her Lucky Charm, and she receives the dino plushie once more.
Viperion then tells her that he already has the first part of the solution.
Shadow Moth is then impressed with Wishmaker's suggestion to Cat Noir and tells him to make his dreams come true.
Ladybug and Viperion then arrive; the latter tells Cat Noir to duck and runs off with Ladybug towards a man in a red beret.
Wishmaker then releases another shooting star, which hits Cat Noir, causing him to remember his childhood dream.
He then transforms into Adrien and declares that when he was a kid, he always wanted to be what his parents wanted him to be, to the shock of Viperion and especially Shadow Moth, who is left horrified after discovering Cat Noir was his son all along.
The man Ladybug is speaking to then tells her that when he was a kid, he wanted to be in the dino huggie gang.
Ladybug then declares that he is the answer to defeating Wishmaker.

title: Wishmaker
text:
Wishmaker - Plot
However, Viperion then apologizes, saying that this isn't the right time and uses his Second Chance once more, going back to the moment he first activated his power.
Viperion promises her that it wouldn't happen.
Ladybug calls on her lucky charm and receives the plushie, confusing her for the third time.
Viperion then tells her that the plushie is for the man in the red beret and that his childhood dream was to be a dino huggie.
The fight once again commences, and this time Wishmaker releases a shooting star, which Viperion deflects to the man in a red beret.
The man then transforms into the dino huggie and walks toward Wishmaker and hugs him.
Ladybug uses the moment to snatch Wishmaker's staff from him and throws it to Cat Noir, who destroys it with his Cataclysm, releasing the akuma and turning Wishmaker back into Alec, who is still being crazily hugged by the huge dino huggie.
Ladybug then purifies the akuma and restores everything to normal.
She then pulls out a magical charm from her yo-yo and gives it to Alec, who thanks her, and the heroes do their signature "pound it" fist bump.

title: Wishmaker
text:
Wishmaker - Plot
Back at the expo, Alec then tells the heroes that when he was a kid, he wanted people to be happy and decides to help people achieve their dreams through a new TV show. He then asks the heroes what their dreams are when Cat Noir's Miraculous suddenly beeps, and Ladybug apologizes to Alec, telling him that, as they're superheroes, even their dreams have to remain a secret. The three then bid Alec goodbye and left. Alec's cameraman then asks him if it is time to roll, to which Alec laughs. Shadow Moth then rants about how he almost unmasked the two heroes, then says that the day will come when he will find a way to make his dream come true as his lair closes.
In an alley, Luka returns the Snake Miraculous to Ladybug, who thanks him due to their secret identities being preserved. She is about to leave when something crosses her mind, and asks Luka if he doesn't know, to which Luka agrees, saying that luckily Wishmaker never hit either her or Cat Noir. Ladybug smiles, then leaves. Luka then looks sad, considering he lied about not knowing their secret identities.

title: Wishmaker
text:
Wishmaker - Plot
Ladybug then runs back to the portalet and detransforms into Marinette, who catches Tikki in her hands and hides her in her purse. Luka then goes to the portalet, about to open the door, but is opened by Marinette, who thanks him for hiding her inside. Luka then replies that it was nothing, saying that she can always count on him. Adrien then arrives and is relieved to find the two are fine. Luka then agrees, saying it's all thanks to Ladybug and Cat Noir, as Marinette and Adrien look at each other and smile.
Inside Adrien's room, Adrien is looking at a picture of him and his mother, and says that it's okay that he doesn't remember his childhood dream and that it's time to focus on the future and find his inner music, like Luka had said. He then turns to Plagg and asks him what he is doing. Plagg, holding a stethoscope and placing it on top of a quarter-eaten piece of camembert, wonders what a camembert concerto sounds like. Adrien laughs.

title: Wishmaker
text:
Wishmaker - Plot
Meanwhile, in Marinette's room, she is still pondering over her list of careers. She then declares that she will do it all: she'll be Ladybug, design clothes, jewelry, furniture, space rockets, be Luka's best friend, and love Adrien. Fluff then asks her how she's going to do it all at the same time, to which she replies that she doesn't know... yet. But she declares that she will do it all. Marinette then looks at her computer. Alec is revealed to be now hosting a new show titled "Live Your Childhood Dream". The end card then appears.

title: Wishmaker
text:
Wishmaker - Plot Developments
It's revealed that Adrien feels sad about Ladybug prioritizing other Miraculous holders over him.
It's revealed that André used to work at an office before he became an ice cream vendor.
It's revealed that Luka is a maker of stringed instruments at his school.
According to Alec, the reason he was bald is because when he was a kid, he had a big afro. But since everyone made fun of him for it, he shaved it all off.
It's also revealed that this is the main reason why he became a TV host that often mocks others. That is until this episode when he changes and decides to embrace his real dream by helping others make their dreams come true.
The episode reveals some of the characters' childhood dreams:
Marinette's childhood dream is being a knitting fairy.
Adrien's childhood dream is him wanting to be what his parents want him to become.
A toy vendor's childhood dream is being Santa Claus.
Jagged Stone's childhood dream is being a crocodile.
An unknown person's childhood dream is being the Robo Tech Ultimate Destructor.
Fire Captain Hessenpy's childhood dream is being a firefighter and a cowboy at the same time.
Mr. Banana's childhood dream is to be a cucumber.

title: Wishmaker
text:
Wishmaker - Plot Developments
The man wearing a red beret's childhood dream is to be a Dino Huggie.
Luka discovers that Marinette is Ladybug and Adrien is Cat Noir, but hides the fact that he knows from Marinette.

title: Wishmaker
text:
Wishmaker - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in USA on Disney Channel.
Despite Shadow Moth knowing Luka's secret identity, Ladybug still entrusts him with the Snake Miraculous and decided to get his help because she knew her and Cat Noir's secret identities were at risk.
It's the fourth time Miraculous related content was aired in the US before being aired in other countries after "Captain Hardrock", "Ikari Gozen", and "Miraculous New York", later being followed by "Ladybug Saves Christmas", "Qilin", "Risk", and "Daddycop".
Alec Cataldi is the fourth person that gets fully akumatized for the first time in season 4, following Harry Clown, Wang Fu and Zoé Lee.
It's revealed that Adrien feels sad about Ladybug prioritizing other Miraculous holders over him.
The Île aux Cygnes (Swan Island), which first appeared in the second issue of "Miraculous Adventures", first appears in the series in this episode.
As seen in concept art by Marina Tsuzuki, the Dino Huggie man's childhood dream would've also been accompanied by a 2D drawing, although it was scrapped in the final version, for an unknown reason.

title: Wishmaker
text:
Wishmaker - Trivia
Second Chance's activation sequence is shortened in this episode, similar to the activation sequence in "Miracle Queen".
As of this episode, Luka knows the true identities of Ladybug and Cat Noir as well as learns the reason why he and Marinette broke up.
Luka kept this knowledge of Ladybug and Cat Noir's true identities to himself however, instead of telling Ladybug when she asked if he knew.
This makes him the third person, post-Wang Fu's amnesia, to know Ladybug's true identity. Alya finds out in "Gang of Secrets" and Su-Han in "Furious Fu". This also makes him the first person ever to know Cat Noir's true identity.
Unlike Alya, Luka found out Ladybug's true identity instead of her telling him, and as of now, Ladybug herself doesn't know anything about this.
Luka is also the third member of the French Miraculous superhero team to know Ladybug's identity, following Alya in "Gang of Secrets" and before, Bunnyx in "Cat Blanc".
Chronologically, however, Luka is the second member to know Ladybug's identity, as Alya comes before him, and Alix has yet to be told of this in the current timeline.

title: Wishmaker
text:
Wishmaker - Trivia
This marks the second time Shadow Moth finds out Adrien is Cat Noir in a timeline that doesn't exist anymore.
Shadow Moth's reaction to finding out Cat Noir's true identity differs from the episode "Cat Blanc", where he was more happy than shocked, because he knew how he could use this information to his advantage. Here, it resembles his reaction in "Gorizilla" when he suspected Adrien could be Cat Noir. This left him shocked and unhappy.
Shadow Moth finding out Ladybug's identity then forgetting it thanks to Viperion foreshadows him learning it again in "Ephemeral".
This is the second appearance of the "Robo Tech Ultimate Destructor" as seen in "Christmaster".
In this episode, it's revealed that Luka can play the violin, which was originally teased by Wilfried Pain to a fan.
The posters and brochures for the career expo are very similar to those of the real life Paris des métiers qui recrutent career expo held on May 16th, 2019.
Robo Tech Ultimate Destructor is voiced by Jacob Weisz, Ezra Weisz's son, who provides additional background voices in some episodes.

title: Wishmaker
text:
Wishmaker - Trivia
This was the final episode along with "Rocketear" to premiere on Disney Channel in Southeast Asia along with Disney Junior Asia, prior to it's shutdown at the end of September 2021.
Errors
At the beginning of the episode, Ivan sits in front of Nathaniel in class, blocking the latter, but he isn't visible when Marinette talks to Chloé.
When Shadow Moth akumatizes Alec, he tells him that his power will reveal who Ladybug and Cat Noir really are under their childhood dreams, but when Wishmaker tells Cat Noir his childhood dream will be revealed to him by letting Wishmaker touch him, Shadow Moth agreed to the idea like he never thought of it before.
In Adrien's childhood dream, Émilie has blue eyes instead of green eyes and Gabriel has green eyes instead of blue eyes.
Ladybug still has the dino huggie when she uses Miraculous Ladybug, despite the fact that the man with the red beret still had it.
However, it's been seen in many previous episodes that Ladybug can seemingly summon her Lucky Charm from anywhere.
After Luka uses his Second Chance the first time, when Ladybug uses her Lucky Charm and changes to her upgraded form, her shadow remains the one of her normal form.

title: Wishmaker
text:
Wishmaker - Trivia
The same thing happens at the second time Luka uses Second Chance, but with her shadow being the one of her upgraded form while she is on her normal form.
Even though Ladybug uses her Lucky Charm first, Cat Noir's ring is the first to time out.
When Marinette's hiding in the portalet, her feet are not visible from the bottom of the door, despite her standing right in front of it.

title: Wishmaker/Transcript
text:
Wishmaker/Transcript - Intro
[ Theme Song ]
Denis Damoclès: Your class representative, Marinette, is going to be handing you a questionnaire to fill out regarding your study options after school.
(Marinette begins to distribute the questionnaires, starting with Sabrina.)
Chloé: Utterly useless! I already know what I want to be when school is over: rich, because I'm already rich. And the baker girl, well, the baker girl. Oh, just plain ridiculous! Yes, being ridiculous would be right up your alley, Marinette Dupain-Cheng! (Marinette stares angrily at her.)
Ms. Bustier: You know, Chloé, people are defined by their choices and what they decide to do with their lives. That's why I'm asking you to start defining yourselves by deciding what you want to do later on. It's not just about your future careers, (Marinette hands over a questionnaire to Chloé) but also what you want out of your life.
Denis Damoclès: If some of you aren't sure yet about what you want to do, the Paris Career Expo will be held this weekend in various locations throughout the city! You'll meet professionals who would tell you about their careers!

title: Wishmaker/Transcript
text:
Wishmaker/Transcript - Intro
Ms. Bustier: (opens a projected map behind her) The document that Marinette just handed you includes a map of Paris with the locations of each career booth. (Marinette hands a questionnaire to Alya.)
Alya: (whispers to Marinette) How about "superhero"? Does that count as a job? (They both laugh softly.)
Denis Damoclès: I would add that you should never let the context impose your costume on you. You should choose your costume yourself! Speaking of which, I, myself, would be present at the charity stand as... (zooms out of the door and comes back as The Owl while breathing heavily) the Owl! Hoo-hoo! Your daily righter of wrongs!
(Adrien looks sadly on his career booklet.)
Plagg: Don't you wanna continue to model?
Adrien: I don't think so, Plagg. I'm doing it now because my father asks me to, and I realize now I don't know what else I wanna do. I never ask myself that question.
Plagg: What do you think of Cat Noir as a career?
Adrien: Well, since Ladybug keeps giving Miraculous out to other holders, one day she probably won't need me anymore.

title: Wishmaker/Transcript
text:
Wishmaker/Transcript - Intro
Plagg: Don't worry, I will always be here for you. Hey, if you want, we could even open a cheese shop together! Just imagine... "Plagg and Cat Noir's Fromagerie"!
Adrien: You can't eat cheese if you're trying to sell it.
Plagg: Oh, you're right. Good point. What's a job where you get to eat cheese, then?
Adrien: Why don't we start by visiting the food trade booths? (grabs his bag) Come on, Plagg, it's time to think about our future!
Marinette: True, Tikki. My life is complicated. But at least one thing is simple: I know what I wanna do later! No need to go to the Paris Career Expo for that!
Pollen: What's a career, dear Guardian?
Marinette: Oh- Well, it's... your job! Something really important that you do and gives meaning to your life!
Roaar: Oh! So, your job is being the Guardian of the Miraculous!
Mullo: Of course not! It's being a student!
Xuppu: Not at all! It's making presents for Adrien!
Marinette: Well-
Longg: She said "something important", like when she crafted the big doll house to hide the Miracle Box!
Wayzz: Or when she designed the alarm for this room! What a masterpiece!
Marinette: Sure, I love crafting but-

title: Wishmaker/Transcript
text:
Wishmaker/Transcript - Intro
Ziggy: You guys don't get it! What gives meaning to her life is to be in love with Adrien, or Luka, that's her job!
Fluff: Luka's the one with the guitar, right?
Kaalki: Her real career is being Ladybug and carve her name in history by her glorious deeds, of course!
Sass: Silence, kwamis! Let's listen to the guardian. Marinette, what is the real important thing that will bring meaning to your life?
(Marinette becomes indecisive.)
Marinette: (groans) I don't know anymore! I guess I'm not so sure of my real job should be after all!
Tikki: Maybe you should go visit a few booths at the Paris Career Expo!
Marinette: I guess so, Tikki.

title: Wishmaker/Transcript
text:
Wishmaker/Transcript - Intro
Alec: Welcome to "You Gotta Be Kidding"! Today, we're live at the Paris Career Expo where I'm gonna be introducing you to the most pointless jobs ever! And to start off, here's a perfect example: André, the Ice Cream Maker, the ice cream man that is never around! Let me remind you how this goes: André doesn't have a shop, no one knows where he is, it takes forever to find him, and he gets to pick a flavor of your ice cream! You've gotta be kidding, André! (to André) Give me one reason why I should bother to chase after you when I could get my choice of ice cream in any corner supermarket!
(The crowd laughs.)
André: Well, people don't just come for ice cream when they find me. They come to share their love and experience of magical moments! A supermarket cannot do what I do! I am a creator of magical moments!
Alec: "Creator of magical moments?" You've gotta be kidding! That's not a real job!
André: You're right, dear Alec. It's not a job, it's a career!
(The crowd becomes taken aback of what André said, much to Alec's shock. Alec groans.)

title: Wishmaker/Transcript
text:
Wishmaker/Transcript - Intro
André: But you found me today! I have some ice cream just for you: lime for the sourness you show on the outside, and chocolate cinnamon for the sweet dreams that still live inside of you! One day, you too will figure out what you really want to be!
(Alec becomes mortified after receiving the ice cream from André.)
Alec: (to the cameraman) Cut! CUT! (he and the cameraman walk away)
(Marinette walks to André.)
Marinette: André, how did you know that making ice cream would be your job?
André: My dear Marinette, being an ice cream man isn't a job; I used to have a job. Every morning, I would wake up and do something I didn't like doing. The only enjoyable moment for my day was when I would come home and concoct ice cream flavors that suited my mood. Until one day, in the same way that ice cream enchanted my daily life, I wondered if my true calling would be to try and enchant other people's lives, too! That's when the truly successful career is: a blend of flavors of what you can do, what you love to do, and what you can bring to others! (gives Marinette an ice cream) Strawberry and cherry for the indecisive lady, pistachio and pecan for the clear sighted young man.

title: Wishmaker/Transcript
text:
Wishmaker/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Who? What young man?
Luka: Hello, Marinette! (appears behind her)
Marinette: (yelps) Luka! (chuckles nervously) Actually, Luka and I are just, uh-
Luka: Buddies! We're buddies.
André: You don't necessarily have to be in love to enjoy your own scoop of magic. (He hands the ice cream to Luka. Luka then hands it over to Marinette.)
Marinette: Have a good day, André!
Luka: (simultaneously) Have a good day!
(Luka and Marinette walk off while eating their ice cream.)
Marinette: I'm surprised to see you here! I thought you already knew what career you're going to have.
Luka: I do! I'm in charge of my school's booth where I tell people about being a maker of stringed instruments.
(The two arrive at Luka's booth, where guitars, electric guitars, and other stringed instruments are displayed as Marinette looks fascinated. Luka grabs one of the guitars.)
Luka: What about you, Marinette? Why are you here? Aren't you on your way to become a talented fashion designer?
Marinette: I don't know anymore. There's so many careers that interest me in the world of fashion, creation, decoration. You're lucky you already know exactly what you wanna do.

title: Wishmaker/Transcript
text:
Wishmaker/Transcript - Intro
Luka: I just listen to my inner voice. (plays the guitar) This is the first instrument I made myself. (gives Marinette the guitar) It took me two years.
Marinette: Woah!
(Alec suddenly enters the scene.)
Alec: Two whole years to make one guitar when you can download an app in two seconds to your phone? (plays the guitar on the guitar app on his phone) Yet, another pointless job! You've gotta be kidding!
(Luka grabs a violin from his booth and walks away.)
Luka: (to Alec) Follow me.
(Luka closes his eyes whilst feeling the breeze as Alec and his cameraman look at each other in confusion. The cameraman begins to film him. Luka raises his violin up in the air to let the wind produce music for it.)
Luka: Musical instruments fill the space and space fills the instruments. No phone in the world will ever be able to do that.
(Alec starts to tear up and wipes his tears. He then realizes that he's on the air.)
Alec: Cut! CUT!
Cameraman: Again? (groans)
Marinette: (walks to Luka) Woah, you definitely have a gift for finding the right words at the right time!
(Adrien sits near the place where Luka and Marinette are.)
Luka: Adrien!
Marinette: Uh- Well, most of the time.

title: Wishmaker/Transcript
text:
Wishmaker/Transcript - Intro
Luka: No, Adrien! He's behind you, Marinette.
Marinette: (panics) How far away is he? (hides behind Luka) Did he see me already?
Luka: You still haven't told him how you feel about him, right?
Marinette: Umm... well... not- (sees Adrien feeling sad and lonely) Wait, he looks sad!
Luka: One more reason we should go to talk to him!
(Luka takes Marinette's hand and the two walk together to Adrien.)
Luka: Something wrong, Adrien?
Adrien: (sighs) I just made the rounds to every stand at the Paris Career Expo and I still don't know what I wanna do. If I don't figure it out, my father will decide for me once again.
(Luka goes to sit beside Adrien as the boys look at Marinette. She hesitates for a moment but goes to sit beside Luka.)
Luka: (to Adrien) I've always felt that modelling wasn't really your true inner music.
Adrien: I thought things would be simple this way, that I'd be content to do what my father told me to. Like you, Luka, who decided to be a musician like your father. Or like you, Marinette, you've always known you wanted to be a fashion designer. But actually...
Adrien, Luka, and Marinette: It's way more complicated.
(The three look at each other and laugh.)

title: Wishmaker/Transcript
text:
Wishmaker/Transcript - Intro
Luka: I don't wanna be a rock-star like my dad. I make music but that's not my career, it's my nature. What I want though, is for other people to be able to feel that music. That's why I wanted to be a stringed instrument maker; to make instruments so people can create emotions with them.
Marinette: I feel like I always wanted to try new things. But the things I want to do, the things I forget to do, and the things that I just have to do, it's a lot, and I don't know.
Adrien: My father arranges it all for me, but when I think about what I really actually wanna do, nothing! My mind is empty!
Adrien and Marinette: I'm completely lost!

title: Wishmaker/Transcript
text:
Wishmaker/Transcript - Intro
Luka: There's no one way to become Marinette or to become Adrien to find out who you are. You just need to learn how to listen to your inner melody. (leans closer to Marinette) Your inner music, Marinette, at this moment, is a little bit like a brass band where... all the instruments are playing a different tune. I totally get it why you're lost. (The three of them laugh.) But if you listen a bit more closely, the music of your band is really beautiful. You just need some time to understand it. (leans closer to Adrien) Your music, Adrien, sounds like it's being muffled by someone else playing a sad piano tune, but your true melody is a happy one. Pretty rock and roll, actually. (stands up and grabs his violin) You two will eventually find what's already in front of you, but you can't hear it clearly. Just let the melody flow.
(Luka stands from a distance and begins to play his violin. Adrien and Marinette becomes mesmerized as they smile and look at each other. They stand up and go closer to where Luka is playing the violin.)
Alec: Who on earth would want to disguise himself with such a ridiculous fake hairdo? Louis XIV's reign is over. You've gotta be kidding!

title: Wishmaker/Transcript
text:
Wishmaker/Transcript - Intro
Wig Seller: A wig is never a disguise, sir. On the contrary, it is always very revealing. (He grabs a wig and puts it on Alec, then holds a mirror for him. Alec suddenly remembers a memory from his childhood.)
Alec: When I was a kid, I used to have long hair, but everyone made fun of me. That's why I shaved it all off. I've been making the wrong choices my whole life. My TV shows are nothing personal. I make fun of people the way they make fun of me when I was a kid. (starts to tear up) I should've been the person I always wanted to be, (throws the wig off) trying to change the world instead of mocking it! (falls on his knees) I've wasted my life!
Shadow Moth: A man who has made bad choices because of pressure from others. A wasted life full of regrets and bitterness. What a perfect job for my akuma. (creates an akuma in his hand) Go and give that remorseful show host a new career that he won't regret!
(The akuma flies out the window.)

title: Wishmaker/Transcript
text:
Wishmaker/Transcript - Intro
Shadow Moth: (from his lair) Wishmaker, I am Shadow Moth. The world didn't let you realize your childhood dreams? From now on, any person you touch will have no choice but to become who they dreamed of being when they were a child! And when you attack Ladybug and Cat Noir, their masks will fall as their childhood dreams betray them!
Alec: From now on, I'll only be who I wanna be! (stands up) And thanks to me, everyone will finally be able to do what they always wanted! (the purple magic engulfs him and transforms into Wishmaker)
(The other people in the expo runs in fear after seeing Wishmaker transformed. Wishmaker then targets a citizen.)
Wishmaker: Live your childhood dream!
Toy Vendor: When I was a kid, I wanted to be Santa! (transforms into Santa Claus while riding a sleigh) My dream has come true! Merry Christmas, everyone! I can make people happy even if it's not Christmas! (flies off as he drops gift boxes throughout Paris)
(Wishmaker jumps on the roof of Jagged Stone's limousine.)
Jagged Stone: Hey, I love your look! Rock and roll! (Wishmaker shoots him.)
Wishmaker: Live your childhood dream!

title: Wishmaker/Transcript
text:
Wishmaker/Transcript - Intro
(Jagged's childhood dream as shown in the background is him wearing a crocodile costume while chasing after a cat.)
Jagged Stone: Haha! I finally get to live my childhood dream! Awesome! (A beam of light appears in the car, which makes the limo driver run off while screaming.)
Jagged Stone: (as a crocodile) Hey! Hi there, son!
Luka: Dad?
Adrien and Marinette: Jagged Stone?
(A gift box falls beside Jagged. The three of them are in shock.)
Toy Vendor: (as Santa Claus) Merry Christmas, everyone! (continues to drop gift boxes)
(Adrien, Luka, and Marinette start to run.)
Adrien: This is a nightmare, right?
(A giant robot of what appears to be like a Robo Tech Ultimate Destructor appears in front of them.)
Robo Tech Ultimate Destructor: I will turn you into mush!
Luka: (to Adrien) Go hide behind that tree! (runs to the opposite direction with Marinette and hides her inside a portalet) Stay here, Marinette! (closes the portalet door) So, robot, where is this mush you were promising? (runs)
(The Robo Tech Ultimate Destructor starts to fire lasers)
Marinette: (to Tikki) I've got to protect Luka! Quick, Tikki! Spots on! (transforms into Ladybug)

title: Wishmaker/Transcript
text:
Wishmaker/Transcript - Intro
(The Robo Tech Ultimate Destructor continues to fire lasers as Luka runs away from it. He falls on the ground but before the Robo Tech Ultimate Destructor fires its laser at Luka, Ladybug swings in and saves him. She brings Luka inside the expo.)
Ladybug: (puts Luka down) You'll be safe here.
Luka: Thank you, Ladybug!
(Ladybug swings away. Luka runs back to the portalet where Marinette was hiding.)
Luka: Marinette! (calls her on the door but there was no response) Marinette? Huh? (He opens the door only to see nobody inside. He grabs his phone to call her.)
Jagged Stone: (as a crocodile, drowning in the lake) Help me! I don't know how to swim!
Luka: Hold on, Dad! I'm coming! (dives into the lake)
Robo Tech Ultimate Destructor: I always wanted to be Roboto Tech! (fires lasers)
Ladybug: Yeah, but we're not living in a video game!
(Ladybug jumps on another rooftop to wrap her yo-yo around the gigantic robot as Cat Noir arrives and extends his stick to push the robot as it falls.)
Robo Tech Ultimate Destructor: Destroyer of... Dreams! (falls and powers off)
(Cat Noir leaps to the rooftops to join Ladybug.)
Cat Noir: He's mistaken dreams from reality!

title: Wishmaker/Transcript
text:
Wishmaker/Transcript - Intro
Wishmaker: Live your childhood dream! (fires his staff on Captain Hessenpy) Live your childhood dream!
(Captain Hessenpy's dream shows him as a child playing a fire truck with a cowboy riding on it.)
Captain Hessenpy: When I was a child, I wanted to be a fireman and a cowboy! (a flash of light appears and he gets a horse with the colors of a fire truck) Wow! I knew it was possible! Yee-hah! (the horse neighs and gallops)
(Wishmaker prepares to fire once again at a nearby stander, but Ladybug manages to stop him by lassoing her yo-yo around his staff.)
Wishmaker: (Holding tight on his staff) Why are you trying to stop me? I'm making people happy!
Ladybug: Yes, but your doing it against their will without permission!
Wishmaker: I want people to live their dreams!

title: Westminster Bridge
text:
Westminster Bridge - Intro
The  is a road and pedestrian bridge that crosses the Thames and connects the city of Westminster to the borough of Lambeth, in London.

title: Westminster Bridge
text:
Westminster Bridge - Description
Built in 1862 to a design by Thomas Page, Westminster Bridge is a stone and iron bridge 252 metres long and 26 metres wide.
It has seven arches over the Thames, allowing boats to pass. It connects the borough of Lambeth and the city of Westminster, in particular allowing it to connect the London County Hall to the Palace of Westminster and the Big Ben.
The oldest bridge in the central sector of the Thames, its main colour is green, including the iron railings that adorn it. Street lamps illuminate the roadway and the wide pavements of the bridge.

title: Westminster Bridge
text:
Westminster Bridge - Trivia
Westminster Bridge has been a Grade II listed building since 1981.
Westminster Bridge is a popular bridge for tourists, who photograph it for a great backdrop with the Palace of Westminster and Big Ben in particular.

it:Ponte di Westminster

title: Westminster Abbey
text:
Westminster Abbey - Intro
The  is a religious building of Anglican worship and royal burial located in the city of Westminster, in London.

title: Westminster Abbey
text:
Westminster Abbey - Description
Built from the 13th century at the request of Henry III, Westminster Abbey is a Gothic building built in Reigate Stone which gives it its particular color. Built in the shape of a Latin cross, this abbey has for its main part two towers and symmetrical buttresses, a nave and transepts.
The abbey has a cloister and numerous chapels, some of which house the tombs of British monarchs, but also a museum.

title: Westminster Abbey
text:
Westminster Abbey - Trivia
Westminster Abbey has been a Grade I listed building since 1958.
Westminster Abbey has been a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1987 under the title "Palace of Westminster, Westminster Abbey and the Church of St. Marguerite".
Westminster Abbey is an important site of the British Crown;
Since its construction, the abbey has hosted almost every coronation of British monarchs.
Many royal weddings have taken place there, the last of which was the union between Prince William and Kate Middleton in 2011.
Due to the symbolism of the location and the many real-life royal weddings that have taken place there, it is possible that the royal wedding that Gabriel, Adrien, Tomoe and Kagami and their parents attended in "Backwarder" took place there.

title: Werepapas
text:
Werepapas - Intro
"" is a season 6 episode of the series Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. Based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 5th written and produced episode of season 6. It is also the 136th written and produced episode of the series overall.

title: Werepapas
text:
Werepapas - Synopsis
When Adrien gets nervous about meeting his grandparents, Marinette gatecrashes the lunch to support him... unaware that a family war is about to break out.
TV Guide
Realizing that Adrien is about to meet his grandparents for the first time and is completely nervous about it, Marinette decides to crash the meeting to give him her support completely unaware that a big family war is about to break out.
Disney+
Ladybug faces the Werepapas.

title: Werepapas
text:
Werepapas - Plot
In a flashback, a young Adrien is in bed with his mom, Émilie, as she talks to him about her parents, which are his maternal grandparents. When he asks where they are, Émilie says they are very far away. When he asks if he can visit them sometime, Émilie seems hesitant to answer, instead explaining that her parents love things more than her, and that makes them not so good and why they never visit them. When Adrien asks if that is the same with Gabriel, Émilie assures him that Gabriel and Nathalie are traveling the world to find what is needed to heal her of her illness. Once that is done, he'll come back and they can be together again. Adrien hugs his mom after that.

title: Werepapas
text:
Werepapas - Plot
In the present, Adrien is looking at his parents' old bedroom, now with the furniture covered in white sheets and the window blinds lowered, leaving it dark, when Nathalie asks him if everything is alright. Still upset over losing both of his parents, Adrien hugs Nathalie, who is hesitant to return the hug, before telling him lunch is ready. As he is leaving, Nathalie is stopped from following by a phone call. The royal crest from the caller ID startles her, and Adrien takes notice when she answers. After she hangs up, Adrien asks who was that, and Nathalie reveals that his grandparents wish to visit him.
At the Dupain-Cheng Bakery, Marinette is having lunch with Tom, Sabine, Roland, and Gina, but they are all curious as to when they are going to get to meet her new boyfriend in Adrien.
When Tom suggests inviting him over for dinner on Sunday, he, Gina, and Roland begin chanting for Marinette to invite him.
Sabine calms them down and tells Marinette she can invite Adrien if she wants to.

title: Werepapas
text:
Werepapas - Plot
Marinette hesitates as she talks about her future she planned with the wedding, kids, and hamsters, but more chanting from Tom, Gina, and Roland convinces her, and she retreats to her room to call Adrien.
When he answers, Marinette offers the invitation to dinner with her family, but Adrien reveals that he already has plans with his grandparents coming to visit him.
Marinette is excited to hear that, but then Adrien explains that he's never seen his grandparents before.
Émilie told him her parents were mean, and Gabriel remained steadfast silent on saying anything about his parents.
Sensing that Adrien is going to need some emotional and moral support dealing with seeing his grandparents for the first time, Marinette offers to come and help him.
Despite some uncertainty, Adrien accepts, and Marinette asks Nathalie to be put on so she can explain the plan to her.

title: Werepapas
text:
Werepapas - Plot
That Sunday, at the Agreste Mansion, to help blend in, after Nathalie mentioned that Lord Graham wanted only family and waitstaff in the dining room, Marinette has put on her waitress disguise so she'll be able to support Adrien should anything go wrong regarding his grandparents. Nathalie warns Marinette she'll have to be very discreet to avoid blowing her cover, but then mentions that she hopes everything goes well. Noticing her concern, Adrien and Marinette inquire why she's not joining them, and Nathalie reminds them that she's only an employee, not family. Even Marinette's accusations that Nathalie has been like a mother figure to Adrien since Émilie and Gabriel disappeared result in Nathalie admitting that she's not Adrien's mother and could never replace Émilie.

title: Werepapas
text:
Werepapas - Plot
Soon, a gold VTOL aircraft arrives to drop off Émilie's parents and Adrien's maternal grandparents: Lord Emil and Lady Milly Graham de Vanily. Right off the bat, Emil makes it clear to everyone present that the Agreste Mansion was originally Graham de Vanily property before giving it to Émilie and her "dressmaker husband" to live in. His comment with calling Adrien a "half-decent looking child" quickly earns the ire of Marinette as she glares and growls softly at Emil. Soon after, Gabriel's parents and Adrien's paternal grandparents, Johnny and Gabrielle Grassette, arrive on a motorcycle, sporting identical Jagged Stone attire. Emil reasserts his authority in the meeting between the grandparents, but is quickly repulsed, as is Milly, when Johnny reveals his ballotines he brought for the luncheon, which quickly garners the attention of Plagg because of his love of cheese-themed food. As Marinette takes Johnny to the kitchen to cook up his ballotines, Plagg goes after them, much to Adrien's distress as he follows the rest of his grandparents into the dining room before Nathalie closes the doors and stands guard outside with Placide I.T..

title: Werepapas
text:
Werepapas - Plot
Inside, as everyone sits down, Johnny and Marinette emerge from the kitchen, but while Johnny sits next to Gabrielle, Marinette gives a reassuring wink to Adrien that everything's fine, but anxious over Plagg, Adrien interrupts Emil's speech to go look for him.
Sensing trouble, Marinette goes after him to reassure him that everything will be okay and gives him a hug to prove it.
Reassured, Adrien calms down and thanks her before they return to dining room, with Marinette bringing in starters for everyone.
As Emil resumes his monologue, when he explains that Adrien is alone now with Émilie and Gabriel's disappearances, Marinette nearly blows her cover speaking out in Adrien's defense, but quickly realizes her mistake and adopts a British Cockney accent to maintain her disguise.
As Emil resumes, Milly attempts to interject, only for Emil to angrily tell her to mind her own business and keep quiet, before pulling out a contract for the Grassettes to sign.

title: Werepapas
text:
Werepapas - Plot
They are more interested in the Graham de Vanily seal, but when Emil mentions the Graham de Vanily Twin Rings that Adrien currently wears, he pauses when he smells something burning, causing Johnny to sprint to the kitchen to save his ballotines.
Taking advantage of the moment, Marinette, using her Cockney accent, asks Adrien to come with her for a moment.
Sneaking out through the kitchen, Marinette and Adrien go to speak to Nathalie and Placide, as Marinette pleads to Nathalie that Adrien can't go back to London with Lord Emil, but Nathalie reminds her that Emil is Adrien's grandfather and family, and she can't overrule his decision.
Marinette pleads that something has to be done, but when Nathalie is unable to answer, Marinette turns to Adrien for his thoughts on the matter.
Adrien admits that, while he doesn't want to leave Paris, Marinette, or Nathalie, those are his grandparents in the other room.
They're his family.

title: Werepapas
text:
Werepapas - Plot
As Marinette and Adrien return to the dining room as Johnny serves his burnt ballotines to everyone, Marinette tells Adrien to leave everything to her, while Adrien starts to panic when he sees Plagg sneakily eating some of the ballotines off his grandparents' plates without them noticing.
Emil demands that Adrien hand over the twin rings, much to Marinette's shock, and Adrien surrenders them without hesitation.
Before Emil can claim them, he's interrupted by Milly voicing her interest in Johnny's ballotine, forcing him to again tell her to shut up and suffer in silence before turning his attention back to the twin rings, only to see they've disappeared, causing Marinette to gasp in shock, due to her own knowledge of them being where Adrien's Amok is.
As Emil demands to know where the twin rings went, he immediately accuses Johnny of taking them.
Marinette tries to calm the grandfathers down as she starts looking for the twin rings, as does Adrien, but only to subdue Plagg before he blows his cover and exposes himself to the grandparents.

title: Werepapas
text:
Werepapas - Plot
Emil, in the meantime, demands that the Grassettes sign the contract so that, not only will this give Emil full custody of Adrien, but prohibit the Grassettes from ever seeing Adrien again, leaving Marinette horrified upon hearing the ultimatum.
Johnny is livid after hearing this, deciding that Adrien should go with the Grassettes and not the Graham de Vanilies.
As they argue, Nathalie listens from outside with growing sadness, while Placide is barely holding back his own rage as his face narrows in anger.
Milly tries to talk Emil down, but he again bellows at her to mind her own business, causing her to become further upset herself.
Marinette tries to intervene by spilling juice on the contract, ruining it, making it look like she did it by accident, but Emil whips out a spare copy, and even offers to pay the Grassettes off to encourage them to sign it, which only further infuriates Johnny as he tells Emil off, saying that they refused his money 16 years ago when Émilie married Gabriel, and they'll refuse it now.
As Emil and Johnny continue to quarrel, Milly grows more and more upset, beginning to compare Emil and Johnny to two wolves barking at each other to see who is the alpha.

title: Werepapas
text:
Werepapas - Plot
Emil finally confesses to how he doesn't want the Graham de Vanily Family to be related to the Grassettes due to Johnny and Gabrielle running a French fry restaurant.
Hearing the truth come out, Johnny proudly declares that the Grassettes have been in the fried food business longer than the Grahams had a broomstick on their family crest, even saying his ancestors served their food to Parmentier himself.
When Milly again complains about Emil and Johnny barking at each other, Emil snaps and furiously orders her to stop eating the ballotines, finally causing Milly to snap and shout back at Emil to stop yelling at her, causing the twin rings to finally be found.
Milly tries to lay claim to them first, but Emil takes them back, and then gets into a fight with Johnny over them.
In the meantime, Adrien finally reigns in Plagg, while Marinette tries to help with tickling Emil, forcing him to drop the twin rings, but Milly grabs them and flees the dining room, retreating to Gabriel's old study and locking herself inside.

title: Werepapas
text:
Werepapas - Plot
As everyone but Adrien and Plagg gather by the door, and Emil angrily demands Milly to come out, as she tells him off and declares that no one tells her what to do anymore, Marinette watches through the keyhole in horror as one of Chrysalis' Ultrakumas infects the twin rings. She immediately asks for the key, and Nathalie sends Placide to get it. In the meantime, Chrysalis contacts Milly, and offers her power to finally be in charge, but only if she agrees. Milly smiles wickedly.

title: Werepapas
text:
Werepapas - Plot
By the time Placide returns with the key and Marinette tries to unlock the door, Milly smashes the doors off their hinges as she emerges, now Akumatized as Ringmaster. Using her bowtie, she turns Emil and Johnny into werewolves with boxing gloves. When Adrien arrives to investigate, Ringmaster traps him in a giant gold trophy as the prize for the winner of the fight between his grandfathers. After she vanishes with Emil and Johnny, the trophy begins rising into the air where an arena is formed high above the mansion and Paris. As this is happening, Marinette has ordered Nathalie and Placide to get Gabrielle to safety while she goes to get help! And once they are out of sight, Tikki questions to Marinette that grandparents are complicated as she answers that they can be, but they'll be ready to fix it as she is ready to prepare her transformation of Ladybug.
Up on the arena, Ringmaster forces Emil and Johnny to fight against their will, declaring that the winner will be the one to decide Adrien's fate, and if they end up destroying each other, Adrien will be able to decide his own life from then on.

title: Werepapas
text:
Werepapas - Plot
Adrien is helpless to intervene as, if he tries to escape as Cat Noir, he'll blow his secret identity.
When Ladybug does show up, he does become Cat Noir, but only to send her a message to let her know he'll be unable to help her for this fight, then reverts back to Adrien.
With Cat Noir unable to help her, Ladybug tries to plead with Ringmaster to reject the Ultrakuma, but she refuses, and sends Emil and Johnny to attack Ladybug, with both grandfathers apologizing to Ladybug as they attack her against their will, as she summons several Lucky Charms to defend herself with against their attacks.
When her last attempt to plead with Ringmaster is met with defiance, summoning a scarf as her next Lucky Charm, Ladybug decides to give Ringmaster a dose of her own medicine.
Swinging under the ring with her yo-yo, Ladybug catches Ringmaster by surprise, and forces her into becoming a human shield as, with Emil and Johnny still under orders to attack Ladybug, to get to Ladybug, they'd have to attack Ringmaster.

title: Werepapas
text:
Werepapas - Plot
Horrified, Ringmaster tries to call them off, but while she tries to do so, Ladybug removes the twin rings from her finger, before kicking her and the werewolf grandfathers away, tying them up in the scarf, and kicking them off the arena to fall back to the mansion below.
However, as she prepares to break the twin rings to release the Ultrakuma, Ladybug hesitates, fearing that doing so will also release Adrien's Amok and kill him. Finally, she forces herself to break the rings, but only the Ultrakuma emerges. She quickly captures and purifies it, then uses Miraculous Ladybug to fix all the damage, returning Milly, Emil, and Johnny safely to the ground, and restored to normal. This also removes the trophy Adrien was trapped in, revealing him to be alright, much to Ladybug's relief upon seeing he's safe. Afterwards, Ladybug grants Milly a Magical Charm, offering some advice on hoping it will help her make the right decisions, and then retreats to Adrien's room to revert back to Marinette, where Adrien finds her, and both are relieved the other is alright.

title: Werepapas
text:
Werepapas - Plot
Back at the luncheon, Milly returns the twin rings to Adrien, but when he is still uncertain what to decide on, Marinette brings Nathalie in and offers some encouraging words to her. When Nathalie is still hesitant to accept being Adrien's adoptive mother, Gabrielle offers some advice she heard from Jagged Stone, and Adrien also wants her to be his mother figure, as his life is in Paris with her, Marinette, and all his friends. Something that even Placide tears up from hearing in joy. Adrien then also decides to visit his grandparents for the holidays, and they can get to know each other better then, and his grandparents also agree to visit each other as well. Gabrielle, Johnny, and Milly all support it, but Emil is still hesitant, until Milly gets him to confess that he does love the Grassettes' French fries, much to his own sheepish embarrassment.

title: Werepapas
text:
Werepapas - Plot
In another flashback following the end card image, a young Adrien is sitting on the steps of the entrance hall to the mansion when he hears the sound of Gabriel, Nathalie, and Placide returning from one of their excursions. When he eagerly asks his father if he found the medicine for Émilie, Gabriel coldly replies "No" before retreating to his study without another word or glancing at Adrien. Nathalie comforts Adrien, assuring him that once Émilie is healed, Gabriel will stay here with him forever, but it does little to cheer him up. Nevertheless, watching it from above, Émilie, now in a wheelchair, smiles gently before returning to her room and closing the doors.
