title: Werepapas
text:
Werepapas - Plot Developments
More information about Adrien and his family is revealed:
Because of her bad relationship with her parents (mainly her father), Émilie never allowed Adrien to meet them. Meanwhile, Gabriel never mentioned his parents to Adrien.
Due to Émilie's illness for using the damaged Peacock Miraculous, Gabriel and Nathalie would travel a lot around the world searching for the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses, the only jewels with the magic necessary to heal her. Also, because of that, Adrien was mostly homeschooled and kept at home in order to keep her company.
The Agreste mansion used to belong to Émilie's parents, being their house in Paris.
The Graham de Vanily are confirmed to be a family with dual nationality, belonging to both the Kingdom of England and the former Kingdom of France.
That dual nationality is symbolized by the Twin Rings.
Emil Graham de Vanily is also known as the Duke of Westchester Munster.
The crest of the Graham de Vanily family features a wolf.
Around the crest is the family motto, which translated into English says, "Brooms in front of your drawbridge before criticizing your vision".

title: Werepapas
text:
Werepapas - Plot Developments
Much like their son as Gabi Grassette (as seen in a picture in "Revelation"), both Johnny and Gabrielle Grassette are sport rocker/punk clothes. In addition, Johnny states that the Grassettes are into french fry culinary business for generations.
Apparently, Emil Graham de Vanily offered money to the Grassettes 16 years ago, as a way to force them not to have any contact with his family, after Gabriel and Émilie got married.
This could be one of the reasons why Gabriel never mentioned them to Adrien, among others.
Both Émilie and Gabriel's names are revealed to be genderbent versions of their parents' (Émilie's father and Gabriel's mother) names, meaning they were named after them, much like Adrien himself shares two of his names (or a variation of them) with his parents (Gabriel and Emil).
It is also possible that Émilie's name was coined by combining both of her parent's names and that Adrien might have been named after his maternal grandfather in an attempt to please him.

title: Werepapas
text:
Werepapas - Trivia
On April 19, 2024, Thomas Astruc shared that he was working on the storyboard for the episode.
Ladybug's transformation has been fully reanimated with an addition of a hair changing scene during the transformation.
The background during the end of transformation has changed.
When her miraculous is activated, there's a new effect added that looks like ladybug wings opened.
The transformation music of Seasons 1, 2 and 3 has been reused after "Miraculous London", but it's more arranged.
Her hair changing is similar to how it is during her transformation from Ladybug to Cosmobug in "Ephemeral".
This episode's title is similar to "Penalteam", as they are called after a group created by the episode's main villain, and not the villain themselves.
Because Ladybug broke the Graham de Vanily Twin Rings to release the ultrakuma, but no amok got out, this episode started a discussion among the fandom as to whether or not those (or at least one) were the real twin rings.
As shown in the episodes "Feast" and "Ladybug", destroyed sentimonsters do not get repaired by the effect of the Miraculous Ladybug. Meaning that in this episode, Adrien did not evaporate off-screen.

title: Werepapas
text:
Werepapas - Trivia
A  very similar situation is shown to us in the episode "Feast", in that as soon as the Dormant Sentimonster's amokized and akumatized object gets destroyed, it evaporates while the Amok and Akuma fly out at the same time (which does not happen with the Double Rings), Ladybug activates her Miraculous Ladybug restoration effect and the sentimonster does not return, despite being part of the damage caused.
However, it has been showed that slight damages to an amokized object is enough to release an amok, as seen "Reflekdoll" and "Guiltrip" where the amokized object was only damaged slightly and not completely broken, but that was enough to release the amok in them.
In "Representation", it was shown that Colt once damaged the ring containing his son's amok, but the latter didn't disappear, and the ring was then fixed afterwards.
This implies that, possibly depending on the complexity of the sentimonster, the amok may take some time to be released from the amokized object when damaged/broken. This is supported by the fact that any emotionally intelligent sentimonster never had their amokized object broken but rather had their amok removed by a holder of the Peacock Miraculous.

title: Werepapas
text:
Werepapas - Trivia
If so, then, if an amokized object is fixed before the amok is released, it's possible to conserve the sentimonster.
It is later confirmed by Thomas Astruc that there are two factors that may have influenced the delay at the exit of the amok in the Twin Rings.
The first one is the intention, which plays a part in the Miraculous rules. This means that Ladybug's intention to only release the ultrakuma in the rings has caused the latter to get out immediately after she broke the rings. However, because intentions only play a part, it's likely that the amok would have exited as well, if Ladybug hadn't been able to fix the rings, hence why Ladybug's relief after seeing Adrien was fine when he was freed from the trophy.
The second one is the time the amok has been in the object. This means that, the longer an amok is inside an object, the longer it will take for it to be released (if it is not intended by the one that breaks the object).

title: Werepapas
text:
Werepapas - Trivia
In the case of Master Fu's sentimonster, despite it having been around for 172 years, because Cat Noir intended to free its amok and akuma, they immediately came out and also because everything Master Fu's sentimonster have eaten, it was in a kind of magically-suspended state.
Additionally, the Dormant Sentimonster's amoktized object was destroyed by Cat Noir's Cataclysm, a power born from the very concept of destruction while the Twin Rings were merely broken by blunt force.
Ladybug breaking the Twin Rings and then repairing them before the amok can exit and worrying about what it did to Adrien can be a reference to Schrödinger's cat, an experiment of quantum superposition where a hypothetical cat may be considered simultaneously both alive and dead, while it is unobserved in a closed box. After she broke the Twin Rings, Ladybug didn't know if Adrien's existence was affected, despite the fact she fixed the rings before the amok was released up until the moment she saw him alive. This is supported by the fact that Adrien was also in a "box" (trophy).
This episode mirrors "Weredad", sharing with it some aspects, but in reverse:

title: Werepapas
text:
Werepapas - Trivia
In both episodes, a family member of Marinette and Adrien is akumatized, with Tom (Marinette's father) being akumatized into Weredad in the titular episode and Milly (Adrien's maternal grandmother) being akumatized into Ringmaster in this episode.
Both Marinette and Adrien are held hostages by the akumatized villain, forcing the other, in their superhero form, to rescue them.
However, unlike in "Weredad", where Marinette was able to rescue herself and de-akumatize her father, Cat Noir was unable to do anything to help.
In truth, Adrien would have been able to escape if he transformed, though didn't because he risked his identity being discovered (which would be even more problematic due to his nature as a sentimonster). Furthermore, unlike Marinette, he didn't have the luck to be caged with the akumatized object.
Ladybug was also able to make her three adversaries fight each other to win. Cat Noir had no one to pit Weredad against.
Both episodes had werewolves in them, with Tom being a werewolf-themed supervillain in "Weredad", while Emil and Johnny were turned into werewolves by Ringmaster and forced to fight one another.

title: Werepapas
text:
Werepapas - Trivia
Emil and Johnny were turned into werewolves as a reference to the wolf crest of the Graham de Vanily family as well Milly's annoyance at Emil always "barking".
It also bears resemblance to "Dearest Family", where family members argue over what's best for the protagonist.
Nathalie becoming Adrien's legal guardian, something that happened in "Miraculous London", is again addressed, with it now being recognized, not only by Marinette and Adrien, but also by all of his grandparents.
This episode breaks the record in "Re-creation" for the most Lucky Charm objects summoned by Ladybug, with a total of six.
Nathalie claiming she could never replace Adrien's mother mirrors what Gabriel said in "Félix" when Adrien thought he and Nathalie were together.

The picture of Gabriel and Adrien in their black clothes representing their grief over Émilie's death can be seen in the post-credit flashback, despite the fact Gabriel still has brown hair and that Émilie was still yet to fall into her slumber.
In the dining room family portrait, Adrien wears the Cat Miraculous, despite it being from when Émilie was still alive.

categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Wreckless Driver - Intro
"" is a season 6 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 12th written and produced episode of season 6. It is also the 143rd written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Wreckless Driver
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Wreckless Driver - Synopsis
Traumatized by being akumatized, Aglaé has developed a phobia of butterflies and is now afraid to leave the house. Marinette would like to find a magical solution to help her friend, but as she will soon discover, not all problems can be solved with a Miraculous Ladybug!
Gloob
Marinette wants to find a magical solution for her friend's phobia, but not all problems can be solved by Ladybug.
Disney Channel
Marinette wishes she could come up with a magic solution to help a phobic friend, but not all problems can be fixed with a Miraculous Ladybug!
Disney+
Ladybug faces a villain determined to help her.

title: Wreckless Driver
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Wreckless Driver - Plot
Early morning on the beach, Parisians relax, unaware that a huge shadow belongs to an akumatized villain, who is destroying the tracks and continuing across the water. On the train, Aglaé cries for help. Vesperia, using her spinning top, climbs onto the train's roof and uses her powers to stop the speeding train. The car begins to dangle from the tracks, and Aglaé falls through the window, but Ladybug saves her at the last moment. Aglaé begs her to let go, then breaks free and runs away crying. Ladybug is surprised and sad, and Vesperia turns to Ladybug, saying she'll take care of the train and Ladybug will take care of the villain.

title: Wreckless Driver
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Wreckless Driver - Plot
At school, Alya and Marinette are talking about how Aglaé was frightened by Ladybug. Suddenly, Aglaé collapses, so they both rush to help her. Marinette explains that it's just an insect, but Aglaé panickily uses an essential oil spray, and when she spots another one, she sprays herself a few more times. She later confesses that her fear began after her first akumatization. First, she was only afraid of butterflies, and now of all insects. Alya tries to calm her, explaining that Ladybug helps people, but Aglaé still fears being akumatized again. Marinette and Alya escort her to class, assuring her that she's safe there. Marinette feels guilty for not obtaining the Butterfly Miraculous, but Alya reminds her that she's doing her best to repair the damage caused by the new Hawk Moth, and gives her a comforting hug.
Later, Marinette brings food to the table where her friends are sitting.
She notices Aglaé struggling to eat because a fly keeps buzzing over her plate.
In a panic, Aglaé runs away, saying she can't stand it anymore.
Marinette gets up and tells her friends that they need to help Aglaé.

title: Wreckless Driver
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Wreckless Driver - Plot
In the cafeteria, Aglaé confesses that she thought everything was fine, but her fears are getting worse again.
She expresses her desire to never leave the house so she won't have to feel afraid.
Marinette tries to comfort her, promising to find a solution—like making a suit to protect her from insects.
However, Alya suggests a more sensible approach, encouraging Aglaé to gradually face her fears.
Max then suggests seeing a psychiatrist, mentioning that he sees one for his autism spectrum disorder.
However, Aglaé is not on the autism spectrum.
Mylène explains that psychiatrists also treat phobias.
She shares that she used to be afraid of the dark and germs, but seeing a psychiatrist helped her significantly.
In the background, Ray chimes in, stating that he would never go to one, as it sounds "lame".
Alya snapped back, saying that it could help someone as "senseless and mean" as them.
Alya and Max then block Ray and his two friends, emphasizing to Aglaé that she should consider it.
Aglaé is apprehensive about seeing a psychiatrist because she doesn't know what to say, but Alya and Max reassure her that she will be able to share things that she wouldn't tell anyone else.

title: Wreckless Driver
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Wreckless Driver - Plot
Eventually, Aglaé agrees to give it a try.
In the psychiatrist's waiting room, Aglaé thanks her friends for coming with her.
When Dr.
Psiquat arrives, she's surprised that Alya, Max, Juleka, and Mylène are waiting and explains that she can't see everyone at once.
Marinette explains that they're only there to support Aglaé.
Aglaé enters the office with the doctor.
Dr.
Psiquat hands her a small model car and tells her she can sit wherever she wants.
She mentions that she spoke with her father but would like to hear the story from her perspective.
Aglaé recounts that it all started when she was first akumatized.
On the day the school year began, Ladybug announced that she had defeated Monarch, so Aglaé felt she could return to school, although she still stuttered and felt like an alien.
The biology teacher organized a trip to the butterfly greenhouse.
She wanted to participate because she loved butterflies, and akumatization wasn't supposed to happen anymore, but she couldn't.
And then they showed up.
In the waiting room, Alya praised Dr.
Psiquat and mentioned that she used to go to her for family reasons.

title: Wreckless Driver
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Wreckless Driver - Plot
Marinette is surprised that she didn't know about it, and Alya replies that it's in the past.
Adrien wonders if he could talk to the doctor about his father.
Marinette reacts nervously, saying she can talk to her, but Alya explains that talking to the doctor is different.
She compares it to a game where Adrien is chased by ghosts in a maze; Marinette can sometimes help him, but only the doctor can show him the way out.
Adrien becomes thoughtful and says he'd like to try meeting Dr.
Psiquat.
Dr.
Psiquat suggests a break, though Aglaé wants to continue.
Dr.
Psiquat asks her who "they" were.
Aglaé says that Ray, Loïc and Nelson were supposed to help her get into the greenhouse, but they locked the door, leaving her alone.
She couldn't think straight; she saw butterflies, including an Ultrakuma, and heard strange voices.
She claims a new villain has appeared, who stole the Butterfly Miraculous and is much more dangerous than the last one.
He promised her help in ridiculing those who made fun of her, so she accepted his offer.
She doesn't remember what happened next, but there are recordings online.

title: Wreckless Driver
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Wreckless Driver - Plot
She was Lady Butterfly, trapping people in cocoons and attacking Paris until Ladybug and her team stopped her.
Aglaé is afraid of being akumatized again because she constantly feels anxiety.
Dr.
Psiquat asks why she's so afraid.
Aglaé says that it was because of Timebreaker when she made her disappear, she was afraid she wouldn't see her loved ones again.
She shows her a photo, claiming she's in it, even though no one is there.
She explains that after Ladybug fixed everything, she tried to enjoy life until a butterfly landed on her shoulder.
Since then, she's been terrified of butterflies and has stopped leaving the house.
Dr.
Psiquat thanks her and says they'll do the exercises at the next session.
Aglaé angrily gets up, saying she wants to fix it now.
She slams the toy car on the floor and runs out of the office, crying.
She runs into the elevator and goes down.
Marinette and her friends run after Aglaé.

title: Wreckless Driver
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Wreckless Driver - Plot
An Ultrakuma flies into Dr. Psiquat's office and flies into the toy car that Aglaé had previously thrown on the floor. Chrysalis tries to convince Dr. Psiquat that she couldn't help Aglaé. Dr. Psiquat says she won't let anyone toy with her emotions. Chrysalis replies that everyone thinks she's evil, even though she only wants to help others and never meant any harm. She tries to convince her that there's a magical solution to everything, but Dr. Psiquat objects, saying there's no magical method to heal someone. Chrysalis replies that that's exactly what Ladybug does. Finally, she adds that people should find their own solutions, even if they suffer for months or even years. Haunted by that thought, Dr. Psiquat tells her to wait, saying she'd like to try, and then calls herself Wreckless Driver.

title: Wreckless Driver
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Wreckless Driver - Plot
Outside, Marinette and the others try to reason with Aglae, who has announced her intent to go home and lock herself in her room again. Suddenly, Dr. Psiquat, fully akumatized as Wreckless Driver, bursts out of her office in a new car, aiming to capture Aglae and cure her phobia. Aglae, terrified, flees, and several of the Miraculers do the same. Marinette finds a spare bike to duck into an alleyway and transforms into Ladybug, while Adrien also finds an alleyway to duck into so he can become Cat Noir.

title: Wreckless Driver
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Wreckless Driver - Plot
Wreckless Driver quickly catches up to Aglae, captures her, and siphons her fear away, curing her in the process. She then ejects Aglae into the air with a parachute, despite Ladybug's attempt to save her. As a result, Aglae is no longer afraid, even of Ladybug. Despite this, Ladybug uses the Miraculous Call to contact Cat Noir for assistance. He replies that he's already in pursuit but needs to stop to rescue another of Wreckless Driver's cured victims, who is dangerously playing Russian Roulette with traffic due to his newfound lack of fear. Soon, Pegasus and Purple Tigress join Ladybug and Cat Noir, but Wreckless Driver evades Purple Tigress' attempt to stop her with Clout, as well as Pegasus' Voyage portals.

title: Wreckless Driver
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Wreckless Driver - Plot
Fortunately, Polymouse arrives to disorient Wreckless Driver by covering her windshield with mini-clones from Multiplication. This distraction allows Rena Rouge to force Wreckless Driver to navigate an illusionary hedge maze that Rena creates with Mirage. Eventually, they manage to use one of Pegasus' Voyage portals to drop Wreckless Driver into the Seine River. Cat Noir transforms into Aquanoir and goes after her, but he gets captured and has his fear of revealing his secret identity extracted. When Ladybug arrives through Pegasus' Voyage, she uses her Lucky Charm, which turns out to be a sandwich, to prevent Cat Noir from disclosing his identity to her. However, when Wreckless Driver proves too daunting for Ladybug, she sends Polymouse via another Voyage portal to distract her. Earlier, Chrysalis had already used an Antikuma to de-power Cat Noir, and when she attempts to do the same to Ladybug to cut off her access to her Miraculous powers, one of Polymouse's mini-clones blocks the attempt with her skip-rope to protect Ladybug.

title: Wreckless Driver
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Wreckless Driver - Plot
Finally, Ladybug signals Purple Tigress, who uses her Clout to drain the river and then employs another one to destroy Wreckless Driver's vehicle, ensuring that Ladybug, Cat Noir, Wreckless Driver, and Polymouse remain unharmed. As Rena and Pegasus join them, there's no sign of the Ultrakuma. However, Ladybug uses her Lucky Vision to spot Aglae's toy car from her earlier session and realizes that's where the Ultrakuma is. Wreckless Driver tries to recover the toy car first but arrives too late, as Ladybug crushes it underfoot to free the Ultrakuma. She captures and purifies it, then repairs everything with Miraculous Ladybug. Afterward, Ladybug gives Dr. Psiquat a Magical Charm and shares some wisdom regarding her practice. After Psiquat expresses her thanks, the Miraculers celebrate with a "Pound It!" fist bump.

title: Wreckless Driver
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Wreckless Driver - Plot
In her lair in La Plage, Cerise makes it clear Ladybug won't be keeping secrets from her forever. Back at the school, Dr. Psiquat and the others attempt to help Aglae overcome her phobia by escorting her back into the butterfly habitat, but Aglae is only able to stay in there for a short bit before coming back out. Nevertheless, Dr. Psiquat praises her effort, and assures her that, with time and patience, she'll be able to stay in there longer and overcome her phobia completely. Some time later, Marinette and Adrien are back in Psiquat's office as she calls Adrien in to discuss his issues regarding his father, Gabriel.

title: Wreckless Driver
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Wreckless Driver - Plot Developments
More about Aglaé is revealed:
It's revealed that her deep fear of akumatization is an accumulation of untreated trauma that started in "Timebreaker", when the titular villain touched her and made her disappear. The event was so traumatic that Aglaé developed a fear of butterflies and she ended up locking herself in her room.
After Monarch's defeat, Aglaé found courage to return to school, but she felt herself unable to socialize like she used to and her fear of butterflies persisted.
After being locked in the butterfly room by Ray, Loïc and Nelson, she was akumatized by Chrysalis into Lady Butterfly, a butterfly-themed supervillain.
She is most likely one of Chrysalis' first victims.
Her experience as an akumatized victim and the reminder of the recorded footage of it caused Aglaé's fear of akumatization to become even greater and her fear of butterflies to extend to all bugs and anything related to them, including bug-themed superheroes, like Ladybug.
It's revealed that Max is autistic, and is sometimes distressed by situations such as being tardy, losing something, or being in a new environment.

title: Wreckless Driver
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Wreckless Driver - Plot Developments
It's revealed that Collège Françoise Dupont possesses a psychotherapy office and a butterfly garden.
Dr. Psiquat, the school's psychotherapist, is introduced.
She is revealed to have given therapy to some of Marinette's friends:
Max has been seeing her to better deal with distress caused by unpredictable situations, due to being autistic.
Mylène has been seeing her due to her phobias.
Juleka has been seeing her to deal with her inability to speak up.
Alya has received her help regarding some family issues.
Aglaé starts seeing her due to her trauma related to akumatizations and deep fear of bugs (especially butterflies)
Adrien starts seeing her due to his issues regarding his late father, Gabriel Agreste.
All of the secondary superheroes Ladybug calls to help her deal with Wreckless Driver are all patients or former patients of Dr. Psiquat.

title: Wreckless Driver
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Wreckless Driver - Trivia
A picture of Gabriel's new model, wearing his outfit from Seasons 1-4 and his hair being blonde, can be seen on the cover of a magazine in Dr. Psiquat's office.
In France, this episode was released as part of the 36th Mental Health Awareness Week (Semaines d'information sur la santé mentale or SISM in French.)
It was also released on October 10, which is World Mental Health Day.
The episode is a pun of "reckless driver", a driver who operates a vehicle disregarding the safety of their surroundings.
"Wreckless" has a double meaning, aligning the villain's motive of not hurting but helping people and "curing" their victims' sense of danger.
The 2D drawings shown while Aglaé's explaining her story were drawn by French artist Anaïs Flogny, known online as Hakunette.
Though Aglaé's not on the autism spectrum, her English VA Analesa Fisher is actually on the spectrum.
References
This is the third time Cat Noir has been hit by antikumas, after "Sublimation" and "Daddycop".
This is also the second time he got hit when he was using a power-up, after "Daddycop".

title: Wreckless Driver
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Wreckless Driver - Trivia
The same with "Mister Agreste", Cerise as Chrysalis, started to tell her victims that Ladybug and Cat Noir's jewels can grant wishes to convince them to work alongside her which is the opposite of Gabriel as Hawk Moth, who after the "Robostus" incident never told any of his villains the true power the duo's jewels for out of fear they'd betray him and take the power for themselves and use it anyway they wanted without thinking of the consequences which is how Gabriel acted.
Which is also being reckless on their parts because neither fully explained how the duo's wishing power worked which is pretty often a classic warning for people to never wish for something so recklessly.
This is the first time Chrysalis controls a villain's body part as she stopped Wreckless Driver from removing Cat Noir's Miraculous right away before removing his powers with an Antikuma, just like how Hawk Moth did in "The Evillustrator" and "Pixelator".
The cold open scene of Vesperia using Venom on a subway train and her strength to slow it down parallels her predecessor Queen Bee from "Queen Wasp".

title: Wreckless Driver
categories: Episodes where Gabriel is a minor character
text:
Wreckless Driver - Trivia
It's also revealed here that Venom works on anything in motion, whether biotic or abiotic. This was previously seen in "Ephemeral", but it wasn't clear whether Moolak's safe was part of his body or a separate flying object.
Allusions
The way Alya explains to Marinette the difference between professional and interpersonal help is a clear reference to the Pac-Man series.
The rail bridge being partly cut off and Vesperia stopping the train from just falling off the rails is a reference to a scene from Pixar's "The Incredibles", where Mr. Incredible stops a train at the beginning of the film.
Errors
When Wreckless Driver drives away, the road is completely intact even though Purple Tigress just used her power on the road.
When Ladybug tries calling Cat Noir, some of the heroes' emblems are distorted.
In some shots, Wreckless Driver's seatbelt floats over her shoulders and chest.
When Aglaé complains about not getting healed in a day, the shadow on the lounge switches in opacity.
When Ladybug runs on the roof right before she jumps to Aglaé, a part of the building on the right is missing.
In the final scene in the greenhouse, Mylène's sideburns are not fully rendered in some shots.

When Aqua Noir gets sucked into Wreckless Driver's vehicle, the fins on his feet lose their colors and light.

title: Werepapas/Transcript
text:
Werepapas/Transcript - Intro
(Émilie shows some photos in her photo album to little Adrien.)
Adrien: So this mean you have a daddy and a mommy too?
Émilie: Yes and they're your grandpa and grandma.
Adrien: Where are they?
Émilie: Far away.
Adrien: Where is far away? Can we go there?
Émilie: You know, Adrien, being a daddy or a mommy means loving your children more than anything in the world, and there are things that my daddy and my mommy… love more than me. (Adrien looks sad.) Things that sometimes make them… (Wipes tears.) not so good. That's why we never see them.
Adrien: Does that mean that daddy doesn't love me?
Émilie: Why would you say that?
Adrien: Because we never see daddy. He's never here.
Émilie: (Puts her hand on her son's chin.) No, no, it's just that daddy travels a lot. He goes around the world with Nathalie looking for important things. One day, they'll find them and I'll get better, then we'll all stay home. Together.
(The two cuddle.)
[ Theme Song ]

title: Werepapas/Transcript
text:
Werepapas/Transcript - Intro
(Adrien opens the door and looks into his parents' bedroom with a sad look on his face. All the furniture inside the room is covered with white sheets and the blinds on the windows are closed making the room completely dark and empty. Nathalie stands behind him.)
Nathalie: Everything alright, Adrien?
(The boy runs up to her and hugs her, sobbing. She hesitates to put her hands on his shoulders and regains her composure.)
Adrien: (Lets go and backs away.) I'm sorry, Nathalie. (Wipes tears.)
Nathalie: Lunch is ready.
(As Adrien walks downstairs, Nathalie also steps closer to the room. Suddenly, her phone rings. The caller's profile picture is a royal crest. She looks shocked. Adrien stops on the staircase and stares at her answering the call.)
Nathalie: (Answers.) Yes. Yes, sir. Yes. Goodbye. (Hangs up.)
Adrien: Everything alright, Nathalie?
Nathalie: …Your grandparents want to see you.
(Adrien is surprised.)
(The Dupain-Cheng family is sitting at the table to eat lunch.)
Gina: (Places a large pot in the middle of the table with braciola.) Buon appetito!
Roland: (Eats a little.) Mm, that's how braciole's done!
(Marinette also starts eating.)

title: Werepapas/Transcript
text:
Werepapas/Transcript - Intro
Tom: (Moves closer to his daughter.) I, for one, feel like somebody's missing. When do we get to meet him?
Marinette: (Becomes flustered.) But dad, you already know him – you've seen him hundreds of times already.
Gina: (Claps.) Ah, the young model! Handsome as a princess!
Marinette: (Accidentally flings some food off her fork.) Yes, he is very, very, very handsome. (Shakes her head.) But he's more than that and he's not a model anymore, you know.
Tom: (Moves closer again.) Well, we don't know, since you haven't officially introduced him as your boyfriend to us. So I was thinking you could invite him over for lunch on Sunday!
Tom, Gina and Roland: Invite him! Invite him! Invite him! Invite him!
Sabine: Really, all of you, it's her first time being in a relationship. Let her do things at her own pace. (to Marinette) You can invite him if you want to, sweetheart.
Marinette: No, it's too soon. It's not like I've already thought about a wedding, three kids and two hamsters–
Tom, Gina and Roland: Invite him! Invite him!
Marinette: Then… okay! (Takes out her phone and calls Adrien. Runs off upstairs to her bedroom.)

title: Werepapas/Transcript
text:
Werepapas/Transcript - Intro
(Marinette is sitting at her coffee table. Adrien answers her call as he's eating lunch with Nathalie.)
Adrien: (Picks up.) Ah, Marinette.
Marinette: Hello, Adrien. (Marinette's entire family peeks inside through the trapdoor. The girl motions and gestures at her parents and grandparents to hide.) Are you free for lunch on Sunday?
Adrien: I… no, I… already have something planned.
Marinette: Oh… is it something… important?
Adrien: I'm meeting my grandparents.
Marinette: Woah, that's amazing! (Adrien doesn't answer. He looks sad.) What?
Adrien: I'm not sure. I don't know them. I never even met them before.
Marinette: Seriously?
Adrien: My mom's parents… she didn't want us to see them.
Marinette: Huh? But… why not?
Adrien: She said they were mean. As for my father, he never even told me about his parents.
Marinette: Wow…
Adrien: And now, all of a sudden they're determined to see me. I don't know what to do. You know how much I'd love to spend Sunday with you.

title: Werepapas/Transcript
text:
Werepapas/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Me too. But, you know what? Since you can't come to my place, (Stands up.) I'll come to yours! I'm an expert at grandparents. I'm sure they're not that bad. And if they really are mean, then I'll protect you! Because you're family– well, not yet– uh, I mean, almost? (Facepalms.) What do you say?
Adrien: If that's possible, then… I think I'd like you to be there with me, yes.
Marinette: Of course it's possible! You'll see, give me Nathalie.
(Nathalie, Adrien and Marinette set the table in preparation for the family meeting. Marinette is dressed in her waitress outfit.)
Nathalie: I'm really not sure this is a good idea. Lord Graham was very specific about the lunch being a family-only reunion. Only the waitstaff will be allowed inside the dining room.
Marinette: Hence, the uniform. (Spins around.)
Adrien: (whispers to his girlfriend) The shellfish cracker goes to the right of the fish fork.
Marinette: (Swaps the utensils' placement.) Oops. (Giggles awkwardly.)
Nathalie: Lord Graham is a stickler for principles, Marinette, you'll have to be very discreet.
Marinette: I've done this plenty of times helping my parents when they've catered events. I'll be invisible.

title: Werepapas/Transcript
text:
Werepapas/Transcript - Intro
Nathalie: I'm counting on the two of you to let me know how it went.
(The teens react with surprise.)
Adrien: What do you mean? You– you're not having lunch with us?
Nathalie: I'm not part of the family.
Marinette: What?! Does Lord Graham know you're practically Adrien's mom now?
Nathalie: I… could never replace Adrien's mother.
(Adrien looks worried at what Nathalie said.)
(A golden helicopter with two wings lands on the front premise which sucks the water from the front fountain which reveals the same royal crest that was on the call profile. Adrien is waiting outside in front of the door with Nathalie, with Marinette behind them.)
Nathalie: These are your grandparents on your mother's side, Emil and Milly Graham de Vanily.
(The royal couple approaches them)
Nathalie: (Bows) It's an honor to have you.
Emil: You're not having us. May I remind you this estate used to be our pied-à-terre in Paris before we allowed our daughter and her dressmaker husband to live here? (Looks over at Adrien.) Now, at least they produced a half-decent-looking child.
(Marinette glares angrily at Emil for his comments and growls softly)
Adrien: Grandfather. (Nods.) Grandmother. (Nods.)

title: Werepapas/Transcript
text:
Werepapas/Transcript - Intro
(Milly nods back with a gentle, kind expression on her face.)
Emil: "Lord Graham", please.
(The guests are surprised by the sound of a motorcycle behind them. A vehicle arrives.)
Nathalie: And arriving now are your grandparents on your father's side, Johnny and Gabrielle Grassette.
(The Grassettes take off their motorcycle helmets and kiss on the lips. They approach the Graham de Vanilys.)
Gabrielle: Thanks for the invite, your international highnesses! (Extends her hand to Milly)
Milly: Hello. (Tries to shake Gabrielle's hand, but...)
Emil: (Grabs his wife's hand by the wrist before she can greet Gabrielle. Milly drops her hand and lowers her head) I am Lord Emil Graham de Vanily, Duke of Westchestermunster, and this is Lady Milly, my wife.
(Milly quietly, lightly nods)
Johnny: I am Johnny and this is Gabrielle. (She does the "rock on" hand gesture) We're not married, but like a convict of love, I am chained to her forever!
Gabrielle: (Notices Adrien) Oh! Jumpin' Jagged, Adrien! (Walks up to her grandson) I've been waiting for this day for so long! You're even more darling in person!
Milly: (Sniffs the air) What is this intriguing scent?

title: Werepapas/Transcript
text:
Werepapas/Transcript - Intro
Emil: (Sniffs) It's vile! (Pinches his nose)
Johnny: It is my ballotines. (Opens a box of treats with a very strong scent) Delish, no? (Emil and Milly seem disgusted) I made them myself.
(Plagg peeks out from Adrien's shirt, having also smelled the ballontines. Adrien covers him with his hand)
Johnny: I've got to heat these puppies up! (to Nathalie) Where is your cuisine?
(Nathalie points inside. Everybody enters. Marinette tries to take Johnny's box)
Johnny: Save yourself the trouble, mon petit. Just show me the way.
Emil: Enough time wasted with preposterous ceremonials. Our lunch is waiting.
(Everybody else heads to the dining room. Plagg flies out of Adrien's shirt, off into the kitchen. His holder nervously watches him disappear inside. Once everybody has entered, Nathalie shuts the door and stands by it along with the bodyguard.)
(Everyone settles down for the lunch)
Gabrielle: Ooh la la! Fancy-schmantzy!
(Marinette and Johnny exit the kitchen)
Johnny: Voilà, they're in the oven! (Laughs)
(Adrien looks inside the kitchen for any sign of Plagg. Marinette winks at him while passing and he awkwardly smiles back. The door to the kitchen shuts with no sign of the Kwami)

title: Werepapas/Transcript
text:
Werepapas/Transcript - Intro
Emil: (Clears his throat) Dear relatives, (quietly) not by choice, I should say, (louder again) thank you for agreeing to this lunch, which will undoubtedly prove to be decisive in regard to the future of our families. The question that brings us together at this table–
Adrien: (Interrupts and stands up) Sorry! I forgot… something.
Emil: (after a moment of silence, annoyed) By all means. (Gestures for Adrien to go)
Adrien: Thank you! (Runs into the kitchen)
Adrien: (Runs in) (whispers) Plagg? Plagg! (Looks under the table. The door opens, surprising Adrien, making him accidentally slam his head into the table)
Marinette: Adrien?
Adrien: Marinette!
Marinette: (Runs up to him) I know this must be hard, but everything's gonna be okay. (Grabs his hands, then hugs him)
Adrien: You're right, it'll be okay. (Pats her on the back)
(The teens return, Marinette with starters in her hand)
Emil: As I was saying, the question that brings us together today is: who will have custody of Adrien now that he's all alone?
Marinette: But Adrien isn't alone.
(The Graham de Vanilys glare at her)

title: Werepapas/Transcript
text:
Werepapas/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (Realizes her mistake, puts on a British accent) Um, Mister Adrien is not alone in having some appetizers, I suppose. (Hands out plates to the guests)
Adrien: If I may, Lord Graham, I live with Nathalie.
Emil: She's an employee, not family. She has no legal right to care for you, unlike us, (Nathalie hears the comment from outside the room and becomes sad) your mother's parents.
Milly: Emil, dearest, Nathalie has known Adrien for so long that she's practically part of the family now.
Emil: Milly, I'm talking! Keep your useless remarks to yourself! (Milly instantly stops speaking and lowers her head. Emil stands up and takes out a contract, passing it to the Grassettes) As shown on this crest bearing the coat of arms of our family, the Graham de Vanilys have always been astride the Kingdom of England and the lamented Kingdom of France.
Gabrielle: (Points at the crest) Oh, that's funny! The doggy is sweeping the floor! (Traces the text on the crest with her finger) And what does this little poem say?

title: Werepapas/Transcript
text:
Werepapas/Transcript - Intro
Emil: It's a wolf! And the poem is our family motto, but it matters not. This dual nationality is symbolized in (Points at the rings Adrien is wearing on his finger) this twin ring passed from generation to generation to the eldest chi– (Pauses his speech upon smelling smoke in the kitchen) Is something burning?
Johnny: Oh! (Runs off)
Gabrielle: Ah, that's my Johnny – always playing with the fire.
Marinette: (with a British accent) Mister Adrien, could you come with me to the kitchen to check? Thank you very much. (The two follow Johnny)
(Marinette and Adrien run out through the kitchen into the hall)
Marinette: Nathalie, there's no way! Adrien can't go and live there with that Lord!
Nathalie: Marinette, "that Lord" is his grandfather and I have no right–
Marinette: There must be something that can be done.
(Nathalie looks away and doesn't answer)
Marinette: (to Adrien) What do you think about this?
Adrien: I don't wanna leave Paris, Marinette. I don't wanna leave you or Nathalie, but… they're my family.
(Johnny places some of his treats on each guest's plate. They're black and hard on the outside)

title: Werepapas/Transcript
text:
Werepapas/Transcript - Intro
Emil: (sarcastically) Coal. (Touches the food with his fork) A northern specialty, isn't it? So then, you eat it?
Johnny: Bah, that's not coal, that's my ballotine!
Milly: (Intrigued, tries to cut it open with a fork and knife. Under pressure, the ballotine flies off her plate and ricochets off the walls into the kitchen) Oops… (Her face turns red from embarassment)
(Adrien sits down in his seat after returning)
Marinette: (whispers to Adrien) Let me handle this.
Adrien: (whispers) Marinette, no!
(Milly manages to crack a ballotine open)
Emil: Oh, Milly, (Slams his hands down on the table) are you actually going to taste this horror?!
(The Grassettes are upset at his comment)
Milly: It looks like there's still something edible inside. (Starts picking out what's inside with her fork)
Emil: Very well, poison yourself if you want to, but I better not hear a peep out of you. (Adrien notices Plagg sneakily eating one of the ballotines off Emil's plate) Getting back to the matter at hand, Adrien! (The boy turns his attention to his grandfather) Hand me the Grahams' twin ring.

title: Werepapas/Transcript
text:
Werepapas/Transcript - Intro
(Adrien, without protesting, takes the rings off and sets them down on the table. As Emil reaches for them, his wife interrupts him)
Milly: Oh, my! It's incredible!
Emil: I don't believe this! (Slams his hands on the table again, causing the rings to roll away) SILENCE!
Milly: (to the Grassettes) What is it filled with?
Gabrielle: Maroilles.
Johnny: It's a fromage. (Milly lightly giggles) What is it? You're not allergic, I hope! Gabrielle, start the bike! (Adrien discreetly looks around for Plagg) We're taking her to the hospital!
Milly: No, no, it's alright. (Adrien catches Plagg stealing from Johnny's plate) This is just so, so delicious!
Emil: Milly, be a dear and suffer in silence as you're used to doing so well. (Milly's mood worsens) As I was saying, it's time Adrien and the twin ring came back to– (Notices the ring isn't where Adrien set it down anymore. Marinette gasps in shock upon seeing it herself) Adrien, where is the twin ring?!
Adrien: I… I gave it to you, Lord Graham.
Emil: (Looks around the table for the family heirloom. He sets his eyes on Johnny, sitting in front of him) You…
Johnny: What, "you"?
Milly: You're not eating your ballotines, Emil?

title: Werepapas/Transcript
text:
Werepapas/Transcript - Intro
Emil: (Slaps his plate aside) Give me back the ring!
Johnny: Oh, I see, so now you're calling me a thief, huh?!
Marinette: (with a British accent) Hold on, let's not get carried away. (normally, whispering) It has to be here somewhere.
Adrien: (Tries to grab Plagg, who's now stealing from his plate. He fails, but draws the attention of his family) I… I'll look for it too! The twin ring… not here, (Checks under his plate.) not here either… (Goes under the table)
Emil: No one is leaving this room until the twin ring is recovered, (Milly discreetly steals Adrien's plate) and in the meantime, (Hands the Grassettes a pen) you are going to sign this contract that will, one, give me full custody of Adrien and, two, assure me that you will never try to see him again.
(Marinette gasps in shock and horror at hearing this)
Gabrielle: But that's monstrous! Why would you want to keep us from seeing this poor kiddo that we only just met?
Johnny: Listen up, milord, if Adrien should go with someone, that someone is gonna be us, and definitely not a mean monsieur like yourself!
(Outside, Adrien's bodyguard's lip starts quivering with anger. Nathalie is also upset at Emil's proposal)

title: Werepapas/Transcript
text:
Werepapas/Transcript - Intro
Milly: Emil, darling, what do we care about this ring and all these antiquated customs, really?
Emil: Milly, for pity's sake, stay in your place!
Milly: (Cracks open another ballotine) (whispers) Why do you scream all the time?
Marinette: (Glares while holding up a tray of drinks before intentionally tripping with them, pretending it's an accident) Whoopsie! (The drinks spill all over the contract) (with a British accent) Sorry, I'm such a klutz.
Emil: (Pulls out another contract to replace the soaked one, to Marinette's shock) I understand clearly, how much do you want? (pulls out his checkbook)
Johnny: You can keep your money! We didn't want it 16 years ago and we don't want it today either!
(Milly keeps cracking and eating ballotines, her face turning red from suppressed anger.)
Emil: Stop this charade already, you just want to raise the bid. Name your price now and be done with it.
Johnny: I'm not charading, you're charading! You think I don't know what you've been up to this whole time?! Come on, be honest, tell us why you want so badly we should sign your contract!
Milly: (Eats another treat) Woof-woof, it's always about who can growl the loudest.

title: Werepapas/Transcript
text:
Werepapas/Transcript - Intro
Emil: Don't pretend like you don't realize how shameful it'd be if people knew that Adrien's other grandparents were… were… (Gestures at them)
Johnny: Were what?! Come on, say it!
Emil: WERE THE OWNERS OF A FRIED FOOD ESTABLISHMENT!
Johnny: So what? What's the problem? The Grassettes have been in the french fry for more generations than the Grahams have had a broomstick on their crest! (Takes the contract and shapes it into a fry bag) My ancestors served cornets of fries with piggy sauce to Parmentier himself!
Milly: Woof-woof, who cares about any of that?
Emil: Oh, and you, stop busting everyone's ballotines! (Knocks the food out of her hand) It's absolutely revolting!
Milly: (Slams her hands on the table, knocking the tableware over) Emil, STOP BARKING AT ME!
(The two suddenly notice the twin rings among the messy plates and cutlery)
Milly: Ooh! (Picks the rings up) Lucky me!
Emil: (Snatches them from her) Give me that!
Johnny: (Gets on top of the table. Takes the rings from Emil.) That belongs to the kiddo, not you!
Emil: Hands off!

title: Werepapas/Transcript
text:
Werepapas/Transcript - Intro
(Plagg tries to steal from Milly's plate, but Adrien, still under the table, finally manages to catch him. Johnny and Emil wrestle for the rings. Marinette sneaks up behind Lord Graham and starts tickling him. He drops the twin rings, which roll to the other end of the table)
Milly: (Catches the rings) Mine!
(Milly slams the door open, knocking Nathalie and the Gorilla out of the way, and runs off to Gabriel's office laughing. She locks the door)
Emil: Milly, get back in this instant! MILLY! (Tries to open the door) MILLY! MILLY!
Adrien: (Tries to calm his Kwami down) Plagg, get a hold of yourself!
Plagg: I can't! Maroilles' too delicious!
(Everyone except for Adrien has gathered by the door)
Emil: Milly, stop trying to be the center of attention and come out of there at once!
Milly: No! I'm tired of turpid, aristocratic, patriarchal dictators! (An Ultrakuma flies into the room) I have the ring! (Puts it on her finger.) I am the queen! No one tells me what to do! (The Ultrakuma infects the rings.)
Marinette: (Observes the akumatization through the keyhole.) (to Nathalie) The key! Do you have the key?
Nathalie: (to the bodyguard) The key.

title: Werepapas/Transcript
text:
Werepapas/Transcript - Intro
(The man nods without a word and runs off in search of it. Meanwhile, an akumatization mask appears in front of Milly's face, with her gasping)
(Milly is sitting in a purple space, focused on cracking more ballotines.)
Chrysalis: (Appears in front of her victim, also in a sitting position) Hello. Forgive my intrusion. (Puts her hand on Milly's shoulder) You've had enough of people fighting and making decisions for other people, haven't you? I know what would be fitting for you – to finally be in charge. (Kneels next to the woman) I can give you this power. (Milly finally stops cracking treats) Only if you agree, of course. (Milly looks up and smiles)
(The bodyguard comes running back with the key to the room. He passes it to Marinette. Just as she puts it in the keyhole, an akumatized Lady Graham de Vanily rips the doors off their hinges and throws them away.)
Emil: Milly?
Ringmaster: No, I'm Ringmaster, the Lady of the Rings! (Takes off her bowtie) So, you wanted to fight? (Throws it at her husband, who is transformed into a boxer-werewolf.) Well then, fight like wolves! (She does the same to Johnny Grassette.)
Adrien: (Arrives) What's happening?

title: Werepapas/Transcript
text:
Werepapas/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Adrien, don't stay here!
Ringmaster: On the contrary, stay, since this fight is for you! (Throws her bowtie at Adrien. It encloses him inside a giant, golden trophy)
Adrien: Marinette, get somewhere safe!
(Ringmaster makes herself and the two grandfathers disappear. The trophy rises high into the skies above Paris, boosted by a giant staircase)
Marinette: Nathalie, take care of Gabrielle! I'll go get help!
(Nathalie nods. She leads the bodyguard and Miss Grassette into the kitchen, closing the door behind her)
Tikki: Are grandparents always this complicated, Marinette?
Marinette: They can be, but we'll fix this!
[ Transformation sequence ]
Marinette: Tikki, spots on! (The Kwami enters her earrings.) Yeah! (Transforms into Ladybug)
(Once it rises above the clouds, the trophy expands into a full ring)

title: Werepapas/Transcript
text:
Werepapas/Transcript - Intro
Ringmaster: (Appears, with an announcer's microphone in hand) Welcome to the main event! In this corner, Johnny "The Fry" Grassette, (One werewolf appears) the Wonder from the North! And in this corner, Emil "The Duke" Graham, (The other boxer appears) the Terror from Albion. (Jumps on top of a platform above the ring) May the best weregrandpa take Adrien away! (Launches her bowtie into a bell, starting the match) Fight!
(Against their will, Emil and Johnny rush at each other and begin throwing punches.)
Emil: I don't wanna fight!
Johnny: Neither do I! You have a strange way of showing it!
Emil: It's not my doing, it's my body! I've lost control of it!
Johnny: So have I!
Ringmaster: (Sits down.) At last, Adrien is about to find out which of his grandpas is the strongest since that's all that counts apparently. Unless you end up destroying each other, which would finally allow him to decide his own life!
(Adrien tries climbing out of the trophy, to no avail. He watches the fight)
Plagg: Just transform and use your power to destroy the whole thing!
Adrien: But then everyone would know that I'm Cat Noir.

title: Werepapas/Transcript
text:
Werepapas/Transcript - Intro
Plagg: In that case, relax and take this chance to enjoy a ballotine with me. (Pulls out one he stored from the meal and eats it)
Emil: My deepest apologies!
Johnny: Yes, I'm sorry too, oui!
Ringmaster: (seeming bored) Oh, you seemed more combative earlier. (Grants Johnny a huge hammer and Emil a sword with her superpower. Blows from the weapons sometimes cause the boxing ring's tiles to fall out)
Johnny: It wasn't on purpose!
(Ladybug swings up onto the battlefield with her yo-yo. Johnny falls on his back and Emil rushes at him)
Emil: Apologies!
Ladybug: (Trips up Emil just as he's about to strike Johnny) Don't worry, everything will be back to normal soon.
Johnny: Wow! Ladybug!
Johnny and Emil: Save us!
Ringmaster: (Stands up) Oh no, you don't. No tresspassers in the ring!
(Ladybug focuses on the two rings the akumatized woman is wearing, then looks up at the trophy. Ringmaster jumps off her podium to begin attacking the heroine)
Adrien: M'lady's gonna get us out of here, Plagg.
Plagg: Of course, like she always does.
Adrien: But won't she find it weird that Cat Noir doesn't show up? Plagg, claws out! (Transforms)

title: Werepapas/Transcript
text:
Werepapas/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: (voiceover of the message he writes to Ladybug) M'lady, I just saw a platform appear in the sky. I'm on my way, but–
Ladybug: (Dodges Ringmaster's bowties) Violence is never a solution! Why don't you give me whatever's been akumatized and we can have a nice and calm chat about it all together?
Ringmaster: (Chases after Ladybug) Chat about it? All together? You think these two are really interested in chatting? The only thing they like is fighting and being right. They're exactly the same!
Johnny: Hey, you can't just lob this guy and me together!
Emil: Tell yourself! It's not my fault my wife lost her head over your so-called "food"!
Ringmaster: See? They're just proving me right, Ladybug!
Ladybug: (Receives Cat Noir's message. Takes out her yo-yo and reads it) Bla-bla-bla, "I'm on my way, but I'll be a little late"? Ugh, Cat Noir!
(As she runs after Ladybug, the akumatization light mask appears in front of Ringmaster's face again. Time momentarily stops for her)
Chrysalis: (Appears behind the woman) Ladybug doesn't even realize that they're the villains, not you. Get rid of her and seize her Miraculous.
Ringmaster: (Points at the Miraculous holder) Defeat Ladybug!

title: Werepapas/Transcript
text:
Werepapas/Transcript - Intro
(The two "weregrandpas" change their target to Ladybug)
Ladybug: Lucky Charm! (Receives a teapot)
Johnny: I'm sorry, Ladybug!
Emil: Forgive me, Lady-superhero!
(Ladybug creates a couple more Lucky Charms and uses them to fend off the boxers' attacks)
Ringmaster: Having fun with your friends, Ladybug?
Ladybug: Renounce the power that was given to you, I'm begging you!
Ringmaster: Never!
Ladybug: (Gets cornered. She creates another Lucky Charm, a long scarf, is then forced to jump onto Emil's sword, hanging over the platform's edge) Have it your way. (Jumps above the fighters and rushes forward)
Ringmaster: You're barking up the wrong tree, Ladybug!
(The heroine jumps down, tying her yo-yo string around one of the platforms, and swings beneath the boxing ring. As Ringmaster looks around for her enemy, Ladybug appears suddenly and grabs the akumatized villain. She holds her against her back.)
Ladybug: Do you know what the strongest thing in the world is? Family ties.
(Johnny and Emil, still following the command to "defeat Ladybug", charge at her, but attack Ringmaster instead, who Ladybug uses as a human shield.)
Ringmaster: No! No! Stop it, you imbeciles!

title: Werepapas/Transcript
text:
Werepapas/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: (Forces the twin rings off Ringmaster's finger. Kicks her into the two werewolves) Come on, hug each other and make up! (Ties the trio with the scarf. Pushes them off the ledge. Prepares to break the akumatized ring, but hesitates greatly, glancing at the trophy as she thinks she's going to kill Adrien if his Amok comes out. Finally, she does it by force. Only an Ultrakuma flies out) No more evil-doing for you, Ultrakuma. Time to de-evilize! (Catches the possessed butterfly) Gotcha! (Releases a purified one out of the yo-yo.) Bye-bye, little butterfly. Miraculous Ladybug! (Throws her Lucky Charm into the air. It first frees Adrien from his trophy. The boy is fine. Ladybug breathes a sigh of relief)
(Miraculous Ladybug brings everyone back down to the mansion. Emil and Johnny, humans again, hug each other on their knees. Upon realizing what they're doing, they awkwardly get up and pretend to still be mad at each other)
Milly: I think I ate too many ballotines. (Giggles)

title: Werepapas/Transcript
text:
Werepapas/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: (Creates a magical charm. Hands it to Lady Graham de Vanily) I hope this Magical Charm will help you make the right decisions. (Milly holds her charm in one hand and the twin rings in the other) I've gotta go. Bug out! (Runs out through the front door)
Milly: Bye-bye, Ladybug!
Adrien: Where is Marinette? (Runs into the kitchen.) Marinette? (Checks his dad's office) Marinette!
Ladybug: (Sneaks in through the window) Spots off! (Detransforms. Marinette hides behind a couch)
Adrien: (Enters and searches) Marinette? Marinette!
Marinette: (Leaves her hiding spot) Adrien!
Adrien: Marinette!
Marinette and Adrien: (Hug each other) I was so worried about you.
(The family has gathered back at the table)
Milly: (Slips the twin rings off her finger) This ring belongs to Adrien. (Places it on the table) He should decide his own future.
Adrien: (Puts the rings back on) Thank you. But… I don't know what I want.

title: Werepapas/Transcript
text:
Werepapas/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (Walks over to the door. Opens it and drags Nathalie inside) I'm still just a teenager, Nathalie, and I'm only Adrien's girlfriend (Gabrielle, Johnny and Milly smile at her), and I can't decide for him or stop his grandparents from fighting for his custody, but you are an adult and more importantly, you're the one who's been taking care of him since his parents disappeared. If there's one thing I know for sure, it's that to Adrien, you're like a mother now.
(Adrien stands up with a smile)
Nathalie: Adrien is not my son. I have no rights.
Gabrielle: Like Jagged once said, "You is the one who loves him, so you is mom".
Johnny: Did he really say that?
Gabrielle: If he didn't, then he should.
(Adrien walks up to Nathalie)
Nathalie: Is this really what you want?
Adrien: (Hugs Nathalie) My life is here in Paris, with Marinette, my friends and you.
(Finally, Nathalie hugs him back. The Gorilla tears up as he watches them from outside)
Adrien: (to his grandparents) I'll come visit you for the holidays. We'll get to know each other better, if you'd like that of course.
Gabrielle: Of course, we'd love that!
(Johnny winks to express approval)
Emil: Well…

title: Werepapas/Transcript
text:
Werepapas/Transcript - Intro
Milly: (Stands up. Puts a hand on her husband's shoulder) (to Adrien) You're more in need of a mother than of a crest. We'll be delighted to welcome you anytime you want.
Johnny: (to the Graham de Vanilys) You two are welcome to visit us anytime if you want too.
Milly: (Sits back down) Will there be more of your delicious ballotines?
Johnny: There will even be fries – the Grassettes' specialty!
Milly: Then we gladly accept your invitation.
Emil: Honestly, Milly…
Milly: Emil, stop it! Just admit it already, you love french fries!
Gabrielle: Do you? Really?
(Emil, embarrassed, gestures to say "sort of")
(A young, teenage Adrien waits at the bottom of the staircase. He excitedly gets up and runs to the door once he hears a car arrive. The Gorilla opens the door to let in Gabriel and Nathalie, who have returned from an expedition)
Adrien: Father! Did you find the medicine for Mom?
Gabriel: (coldly) No. (Walks into his office without even glancing at his son.)
Adrien: Are you gonna leave again?
(There's no response. The young boy is disappointed. Seeing this, Nathalie kneels next to him.)
Nathalie: Once your mother is healed, your father will stay here with both of you… forever.

title: Werepapas/Transcript
text:

title: Xavier Ramier
text:
Xavier Ramier - Intro
is a recurring character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He is also the opening antagonist of "Miraculous World: New York, United Heroez". He is a man who loves pigeons.
In "Mr. Pigeon", after being kicked out of the Jardins du Trocadéro by Officer Roger for feeding the pigeons, he was akumatized by Hawk Moth and became Mr. Pigeon, a pigeon-controlling supervillain.
In "Timetagger", after pigeons were not able to have the right to experience culture in Paris, he was reakumatized into Mr. Pigeon for the 24th and 25th time. In the same episode, it was revealed by Bunnyx that he would be akumatized into Monsieur Rat, a rat-themed supervillain with unknown powers.
In "Miraculous New York", after he decided that pigeons have it hard in Paris, he is reakumatized into Mr. Pigeon for the 51st time, and tried to take all pigeons to the moon.

title: Xavier Ramier
text:
Xavier Ramier - Intro
In "Mr. Pigeon 72", after his pigeons accidentally ruined Adrien's photoshoot at the swimming pool, causing him to be fired by Bob Roth, Xavier was reakumatized by Shadow Moth into Mr. Pigeon for the 72nd time, but this time, he could turn his victims into villainous pigeons. He also received a Magical Charm from Ladybug that prevented him from being reakumatized.
In "Perfection", he was reakumatized into Mr. Pigeon for at least the 73rd time and bound Paris with chains of pigeons.

title: Xavier Ramier
text:
Xavier Ramier - Appearance
Physical appearance
Xavier is tall and muscular, with short messy caramel-brown hair and strong gold eyes and olive skin. He has very thin lips.
Civilian attire
He wears a gray elegant suit complete with a gray hat, a dark gray waistcoat decorated with a square pattern, a white shirt, a big teal bow tie, dark green vest and brown sandals worn with white socks. He also has a bird call whistle on a string hanging from his neck.
As Mr. Pigeon
Mr. Pigeon was more muscular and fairly white skinned supervillain and wore a full body skin-tight jumpsuit with black forearms, waist and thighs, dark gray belly, light gray chest, shoulder and biceps, and pale, light grayish amaranth shins and head. The suit also had black stripes on his triceps and around his upper hips, along with two lozenge light blue diamonds where his bow tie was. He seemed to still carry a bird call whistle around his neck.

title: Xavier Ramier
text:
Xavier Ramier - Personality
Xavier is a kind and cheerful man who loves to take care of pigeons. He often goes to the park to feed them, even though it is not allowed, because he worries about them not getting fed if he doesn't do it. Also quirky, he walks to a bench as if he is a bird and talks to the pigeons.
He can also be very friendly and caring towards others, most notably with Marianne Lenoir, whom he shows respect to and tries to comfort after she feels that her love has forgotten about her.
In "Timetagger", it's showed that he feels very guilty over the fact he is constantly akumatized by Hawk Moth because of how he can't bear seeing his pigeons being mistreated or discriminated in any way possible. After being deakumatized, he likes to treat Ladybug and Cat Noir to ice cream in order to apologize for being akumatized again. In the same episode, on Cat Noir's advice, he also seemingly develops an affection for rats over pigeons, feeling that the former are even cuter than they are.
In "Mr. Pigeon 72", he finally shows his anger at Bob Roth for blaming him and his best friend Edgar, he was also very grateful that he wouldn't be reakumatized by Shadow Moth after Ladybug gave him a Magical Charm.

title: Xavier Ramier
text:
Xavier Ramier - Personality
As Mr. Pigeon, his love for pigeons was taken to an extreme, his desire being them taking over Paris. He still acted very pigeon-like, cooing and flapping his arms like wings. Proving to also be clever, he planned to trick Ladybug and Cat Noir into thinking that he abandoned the park guards, just to ambush them with his birds. It would be assumed that he, in the future, as Monsieur Rat, would show this same affection to rats.

title: Xavier Ramier
text:
Xavier Ramier - Abilities
As a civilian
Xavier Ramier is excellent at swimming and training pigeons. Even when not akumatized, he can make them fly in formation or retrieve certain items at a blow of his whistle. He is also capable of identifying specific pigeons by name, and can perform CPR on pigeons.
As Mr. Pigeon
Mr. Pigeon's control over pigeons was taken to an extreme. With his bird call, he could not only communicate with them, but also make their flocks form into any shape he wanted, like a plane or throne, or he could gather pigeons around his fists and throw them to attack. If he fell, the pigeons are able to catch him. He could also get them to capture and carry large objects, including a metal cage or other people. His control over them even allowed him to command them to cause diarrhea.
However, the pigeons were entirely obedient to him if there is food around such as bread crumbs.
When reakumatized for the 68th time in the game "Rise of the Sphinx", he turned the pigeons he commanded into pigeon robots.

title: Xavier Ramier
text:
Xavier Ramier - Abilities
When reakumatized for the 72nd time, Mr. Pigeon had the ability to turn people into villainous pigeons. Once he whistled on his bird call, all the existing colors of the pigeons in Paris turned medium gray to very dark gray. Any object and anyone the villainous pigeons touched would be transformed into copies of themselves in a puff of pink smoke. He was able to control and communicate with the villainous pigeons using his pigeon whistle.

title: Xavier Ramier
text:
Xavier Ramier - Relationships
Friends/Allies
Edgar
Edgar is Xavier Ramier's favorite pigeon. In "Mr. Pigeon 72", Xavier consults with him that if he and the others accomplish the ad with Adrien, the mayor will allow all the Pigeons of Paris to roam free. However, Marinette interferes and causes him to almost drown. Xavier, who cares very deeply for him, swims to get him back to land and ditches Bob Roth's ad for Edgar's safety.
Marianne Lenoir
Marianne and Mr. Ramier are good friends. In "Backwarder", it's showed that, because Marianne would come to the same place at the same time to wait for her love, they would meet every day and developed a good friendship as a result, with them sitting on a bench and talking. Mr. Ramier has such respect for Marianne that he even comments that the one she is waiting for doesn't deserve her.

title: Xavier Ramier
text:
Xavier Ramier - Trivia
Mr. Pigeon is one of the first known villains in the world of Ladybug, being one of the only three villains featured in the Ladybug PV with Hawk Moth and Mime.
Unlike most Akumatized victims, Hawk Moth refers to him by his actual name, calling him Mr. Ramier before sending out an akuma.
Surprisingly, even though he has had the most amount of akumatizations, Mr. Pigeon doesn't appear in the "Heroes' Day" special.
Mr. Pigeon appears another time in "Gamer 2.0" from Gamer 2.0's powers.
In "Timetagger", while facing Mr. Pigeon again at the Louvre, Ladybug mentions that he has been Akumatized twenty-three times beforehand. He later appears as Mr. Pigeon again towards the end of the episode.
Cat Noir mentions at the end of the episode that pigeons have it hard in Paris. In real life, it is illegal to feed pigeons in Paris as they are considered pests, which would explain Mr. Ramier's recurring akumatization due to his over-protectiveness for pigeons.

title: Xavier Ramier
text:
Xavier Ramier - Trivia
Though all but his 1st, 24th, 25th, 51st, 52nd, 72nd and 73rd akumatizations took place off-screen, Mr. Ramier has technically been akumatized more than any other character in the series, having been transformed back into Mr. Pigeon 73 times in total.
Additionally, in the same episode, it is implied that Mr. Ramier will be again akumatized into the villain "Monsieur Rat" at some point in the future.
There is a statue of Mr. Pigeon in the Musée Grévin in "The Puppeteer 2".
In "Mr. Pigeon 72", he's the first akumatized villain to receive a Magical Charm, as he has been akumatized 72 times.
Eventually, his Magical Charm (the very first to be created by Ladybug) ends up being destroyed by Monarch's megakuma, as in "Perfection", Mr. Ramier is seen akumatized in Mr. Pigeon again for at least a 73rd time.
In "Miraculous: Rise of the Sphinx", after André Bourgeois launches a new cleaning strategy using robots to try and put and end to the pigeons of Paris, he is reakumatized into Mr. Pigeon for the 68th time, now able to turn the pigeons into his robot pigeon minions in order to take revenge.

title: Yo-yo
text:
Yo-yo - Intro
The  is the tool of the Ladybug Miraculous.
The current owner of the yo-yo is Marinette Dupain-Cheng, who uses it as the superhero Ladybug.

title: Yo-yo
text:
Yo-yo - Appearance
The yo-yo is a red circle with a smooth surface and five black spots in a quincunx pattern, resembling the Ladybug Miraculous in charged mode. Ladybug and Mister Bug usually attaches it around their hips when not in use, Scarabella wears the yo-yo as a belt buckle. The length of the string is unlimited and can be controlled by willpower. The string is black and has a small red hoop to put around the user's finger at its end.
In "Ice Mode", as seen in "Frozer", the yo-yo has a different appearance, having black hexagons over it instead of spots, and there are seven of them instead of five.
When wielded by Ladyfly, Ladybug's yo-yo gained a purple sheen due to being unified with the Butterfly Miraculous.
When wielded by Bug Noire, the yo-yo was black with five green spots in a quincunx pattern due to being unified with the Cat Miraculous.
When wielded by Chronobug, the yo-yo was yellow with five white shiny spots in a quincunx pattern.
From Season 6 and onwards, when wielded by Cosmobug, the yo-yo was red with five white glowing spots in a quincunx pattern.
When wielded by Viperbug, the yo-yo was cerise with brilliant velvet spots in a quincunx pattern.

title: Yo-yo
text:
Yo-yo - Appearance
When wielded by Bunnybug, the yo-yo was blue with white spots and red outlines around the latter in a quincunx pattern.

title: Yo-yo
text:
Yo-yo - Abilities
The yo-yo is extremely versatile, as Ladybug uses it as a weapon, both offensively and defensively, to hit enemies with it like a projectile or tie them up with its string. It works like a grappling hook, which Ladybug can swing from and use to travel far distances. The yo-yo's string never runs out and, as mentioned in "Animan", is unbreakable. Then proven true in "Simon Says" and "Captain Hardrock", as the string can hold the weight of a police car (which is 400 kg) and helicopter (which weighs up to 1300 kg) with ease, even stop speeding buses and trains without breaking.
When swung in a circle very quickly, it lights up and creates a pink shield that can be able to deflect and withstand strong attacks. In "Stormy Weather", Ladybug uses the yo-yo's shield to protect herself and Cat Noir from a bus launched at them by tearing a hole through it. The string of the yo-yo is strong enough to cut through thick metal or concrete, as displayed in "Riposte", "Gigantitan", "Anansi" and "Desperada". It can create safety nets to catch people and even large vehicles like cars or helicopters from falling.

title: Yo-yo
text:
Yo-yo - Abilities
The yo-yo is useful for some of Ladybug's special abilities. Whenever something corrupts or infects an object or animal, like butterflies transformed into akumas with the power of the Butterfly Miraculous, or feathers turned into amoks with the power of the Peacock Miraculous, the yo-yo can capture and purify them back to normal. The yo-yo opens up, showing glowing pink energy, and it closes around the infected animal or object. It opens again with them healed or clean, such as akumas getting purified into ordinary butterflies and or Mr. Squid in the fourth issue of Miraculous Adventures being purified from the unknown black substance. The yo-yo can contain things larger than the weapon itself, and it can hold more than one object at once, from a stuffed animal to a huge swarm of akumas.
In "Yaksi Gozen", it is explained that any object stored inside Ladybug's magical yo-yo is turned into a quantic state that prevents anyone from reaching it unless through the yo-yo, which can only exist when Ladybug is transformed which also may suggest that the tool has a special pocket dimension inside but what the yo-yo looks like from the inside is unknown.

title: Yo-yo
text:
Yo-yo - Abilities
The yo-yo is also used for Lucky Charm: Ladybug throws the yo-yo in the air, and it releases a pink energy that produces an object that Ladybug uses to save the day. However, the Lucky Charm is also Ladybug's weakness because, as it is used in the middle of the summoning process, she can't use the yo-yo to attack or defend until the process is finished, as seen in "Sandboy", the power will be canceled out if the process is interrupted.
One side of the yo-yo can slide open, revealing a screen. With this, Ladybug can use the yo-yo as a tracker, a map, a communicator to contact Cat Noir, or a cellular phone. Additionally, it can access the internet, as seen in "Simon Says" and "Pixelator".
In "The Dark Owl", "Gamer 2.0", "Queen Banana", "Glaciator 2" and "Pretension", it's revealed the yo-yo also has an ear communicator and camera so the holder can communicate with others.
In and out of "Aqua Mode", the yo-yo can also work as a breathing apparatus for those who can't breathe underwater, like Kim in "Syren", Ladybug herself in "Queen Wasp", "Reverser", "Cat Blanc", and "Truth", and Otis in "Mayura".

title: Yo-yo
text:
Yo-yo - Abilities
In "Backwarder", it is revealed that the yo-yo can store or hold other objects like letters, and it also has its own timer. Anything stored in the yo-yo can be transferred to the user's bag or purse if wearing one when they aren't transformed and stay inside the yo-yo when they are. The yo-yo can also purify amoks, as seen in "Miraculer".
Also seen in "Weredad" and "Miraculer", if the holder can't use the Miraculous Ladybug (superpower) as the result of having no Lucky Charm, the power can be activated by using the yo-yo.
While under the power of fusion with the Dragon Miraculous, the yo-yo's shield making ability was expanded when combined with the Water Dragon in "Miracle Queen".
In "Mr. Pigeon 72", the yo-yo gains the ability to create Magical Charms when it purifies an akuma from a defeated akumatized villain.
In "Gang of Secrets", it is revealed that since she became the Guardian of the Miraculous, Ladybug's yo-yo now allows her to quickly access all the Miraculous stored in the Miracle Box. However, as shown in "Strikeback", any other person in possession of the yo-yo can access the Miracle Box and all its contents.

title: Yo-yo
text:
Yo-yo - Abilities
It is revealed in "Kuro Neko" that even when the Ladybug Miraculous holder uses their yo-yo to tie something up, they can still lose their grip on it. Interestingly, in "Miraculous London", if a Ladybug holder ends tied up by the yo-yo and summons a lucky charm the tool will release them.
From season 6 onwards, to better fight the akumatized villains sent by the holder of the Butterfly Miraclous, Ladybug added a function to her yo-yo that allows her to call on any of her Miraculous Heroes (including Cat Noir) by picking one of their sigils from her yo-yo. After she clicks on the sigil, it sends an empathic signal to the designated hero which tells them that Ladybug needs their help and where to find her. This call feature is also available to the other Miraculous Heroes and they can call on each other and Ladybug. However, it is unknown if anyone can contact the person with the Butterfly Miraculous.

title: Yo-yo
text:
Yo-yo - Trivia
In concept art and test animation in the 2014 licensing video, the yo-yo appears to have more abilities, like being able to split in half to become a staff, generating a wing-like shield, and exploding like a bomb. These abilities have not yet been seen in the show.
In "Copycat", one side of the yo-yo can be seen with inverted colors (black with red spots) at times, like when Ladybug is using it as a communicator. Thomas Astruc said that it was a mistake that couldn't be fixed.
When Ladybug is using the yo-yo or capturing the akuma the yo-yo makes a wire like sound effect.
When it's not worn, the string is black, but when wrapped around Ladybug's waist, the string is red like her costume. It's unknown whether that's part of the magic, or just a design choice.
When used by Mister Bug the yo-yo's string is black even when wrapped around his waist, but it is red when wrapped around Scarabella's waist after she transforms. Based on this, it is possible that the red string only appears with female users of the Ladybug Miraculous.

title: Yo-yo
text:

A recurring gag involving the yo-yo has Cat Noir getting hit on the head with it, usually by accident but occasionally on purpose when Ladybug is irritated by one of his comments or to prove a point.
She also does this with her staff as Lady Noir in "Reflekdoll".
The yo-yo is a toy which was invented by the Chinese coincidentally.
It is the first Miraculous tool based off of a toy preceding the Bee Miraculous' spinning top, the Mouse Miraculous' skip rope, and the Dog Miraculous' ball.
The yo-yo is the first Miraculous tool introduced needed for a holder to access their superpower.
Ladybug's yo-yo can purify multiple akumas at a time, as seen in "Stoneheart" and "Mayura".
Hinting that the yo-yo could have infinite space which is one of the laws of Anime physics called the magic satchel, as it can hold or store things bigger than an Akuma like a stuffed toy or a letter.
In "Battle for New York", the yo-yo can also purify or clean other objects that aren't affected by an akuma, like Mr. Squid.
