title: XY
text:
XY - Intro
Xavier-Yves Roth, better known as , is a minor antagonist of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He is a famous pop star and Jagged Stone's biggest rival in the music making business. He is Chloé Bourgeois' favorite singer, as stated in "Guitar Villain". He is the son of Bob Roth.

title: XY
text:
XY - Appearance
Physical appearance
XY is a tall young man with honey-blond hair styled into a sharp quiff  with fair skin, and  cobalt-blue eyes.
Civilian attire
He wears a purple camouflage headband that is tied in the back of his head. His jacket is purple, having white with a thin black line in the middle cuffs, bottom, and collar, and he wears it over a white t-shirt with a low collar. He wears a light purple belt with a golden buckle, pale blue jeans, and gray tennis shoes. He also wears a gold chain necklace with a large gold "XY" symbol hanging from it.
From season 6 onwards, he now wears sunglasses and headphones, and he no longer wears his gold chain. His T-shirt is also more tight-fitting.

title: XY
text:
XY - Personality
XY is arrogant, vain, and rude, believing himself to be the best and looking down at anyone who he believes is less popular than he is. He carelessly insults his rivals in the music industry, and he doesn't take warnings seriously, even when they come from the superheroes Ladybug and Cat Noir. When his life is threatened, though, he freaks out and loses his overconfidence. He is also lazy, as he does not even attempt to do anything original or work-related, believing it is easier to let someone else do all the work before taking all the credit.
He also assumes that his father will get him out of any legal problems he has, which leads him to boast in public about his cheating habits. He is so dependent on his father that he cannot function unless his father tells him what to say or do. Despite his arrogance, he’s sensitive to feeling hurt that his own father called him talentless for not coming up with the original idea.

title: XY
text:
XY - Abilities
He is good at making music that people enjoy, as he has amassed considerable fame. However, this is questionable, considering he planned to have a music engineer and a hologram of himself to play a supposedly live concert.
It is revealed in "Silencer" that he doesn't actually make much of his music but instead he copies it from inspiration.

title: XY
text:
XY - Relationships
Family
Bob Roth
XY and his style are admired by Bob, who attempted to get Jagged to change his style to more closely resemble XY's.
"Silencer" revealed that Bob and XY are father and son. Due to the two being fond of plagiarism to achieve success, they get along very well. This also proves that XY is constantly spoiled by his father, who chooses not to educate his son about morals or ethics in the entertainment business.
In "Illusion", Bob has shown that he is embarrassed of his son when the latter of which was asked about Monarch, it gets worse when Nadja Chamack asked him about how he feels about the situation, ignoring the fact that he keeps ignoring the questions when he brings up XY he is too embarrased to call XY his son.
Enemies
Jagged Stone
XY doesn't like Jagged very much, thinking that he is too "old-fashioned" to perform. However, when he, as Guitar Villain, comes to get revenge on him for insulting him during a TV interview, XY cowardly panics and pleads with him to spare his life.
Unknown status
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/Ladybug

title: XY
text:
XY - Relationships
In "Silencer", when he stole Kitty Section's designs and music, XY was confronted by Marinette and Luka for plagiarism. After Marinette furiously confronted him for stealing Luka's music, he says to her that he was just "inspired" by them, which is obviously not true. He and Bob Roth also rejected Marinette's offer to do the right thing.
In "Guitar Villain", When Ladybug and Cat Noir come to warn XY about Guitar Villain, XY does not take their warning seriously and ignores it until it is too late.
Cat Noir
In "Guitar Villain", When Ladybug and Cat Noir come to warn XY about Guitar Villain, XY does not take their warning seriously and ignores it until it is too late.

title: XY
text:
XY - Trivia
In the Serbian dub, Jagged and XY are voiced by the same voice actor, Mateja Vukašinović.
His name is a reference to the musician Jay Z.
XY is very popular, being at #1 on the sales chart.
Because of this, Bob Roth wants to base the cover of Jagged Stone's upcoming album after XY's album, Number One, and his promotional artwork.
However, when Jagged Stone releases his album Rock Giant, he overthrows XY as #1 in sales.
XY can be seen as a caricature of Justin Bieber in his early career, especially with his purple color scheme, youthful facial features (Jagged refers to him as a "baby"), rude tendencies, and repetitive yet catchy pop tunes.
He is Chloé's favorite musician.
His music mainly consists of beats and techno music rather than consisting of lyrics.
In "Captain Hardrock", he can be seen at the Place de la Concorde and he has been setting his concert there.
In "Silencer", it is revealed that his actual name is Xavier-Yves.

title: Xuppu
text:
Xuppu - Intro
is a supporting character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. He is the Kwami of Derision who is connected to the Monkey Miraculous. With his power, Xuppu's wearer can use the circlet to transform into a monkey-themed superhero.
Xuppu and his Miraculous are currently owned by Lê Chiến Kim, who uses it to transform into the superhero King Monkey.

title: Xuppu
text:
Xuppu - Appearance
Xuppu is 10 centimeters (or 4 inches) tall and is light brown with a yellow mark on his face. He has yellow ears, brown eyes with the irises being black, and a long tail with a bulb-like tip at the end.
From Season 6 onwards, he now has a visible nose and eyelashes and his tail no longer has the bulb-like tip.

title: Xuppu
text:
Xuppu - Personality
Xuppu is pretty energetic and talkative, which can come off as funny sometimes. He is also a bit immature, for example, he does not like being called names, which he retaliates against by calling people names and making faces at them. He also quite enjoys some of the results of his brethren's powers, as he found Trixx's illusion of the Loch Ness monster quite funny.
He is also very cheeky and is not afraid of mocking others, including his own owner. This is shown when Xuppu was not afraid of explaining Orikko's power's limitations to Gabriel as if he was not smart enough to understand a more technical explanation and going as far as explaining other examples to him when he asks rhetorical questions or dodging the actual intent of his question.

title: Xuppu
text:
Xuppu - Abilities
Xuppu can fly, levitate, and phase through solid objects. He can also carry objects that are larger and/or heavier than himself.
As a Kwami, Xuppu is able to transform the holder of the Monkey Miraculous into a monkey-themed superhero.
He gives his wielder the ability to user the superpower Uproar, which allows the holder to summon an item with their weapon to later throw it at the opponent. Once struck, it will cause the target's powers and abilities go temporarily out of control.

title: Xuppu
text:
Xuppu - Relationships
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/Ladybug
Xuppu respects Marinette as a guardian and lived with her and the other kwamis for a time. In "Wishmaker", Xuppu says that Marinette's job is to give gifts to Adrien, implying he's aware of her crush on him. In "Strikeback", Flairmidable steals Ladybug's yo-yo and uses it to transfer all the miraculous and kwamis to Gabriel Agreste, the Monarch. Since then, Xuppu and the other kwamis have been held captive by him and want to return to Marinette as soon as possible. This almost happened in "Destruction", when Ladybug and Cat Noir managed to tie up the Monarch in the museum after luring him into a trap, but he escaped using Voyage. In "Re-Creation", Marinette was able to get her Miraculouses back, including the monkey one, and decided it would be better if they were kept by their former temporary owners, so she gives the Monkey Miraculous to Kim, meaning Xuppu will live with him now.
Lê Chiến Kim/King Monkey
At first, Xuppu looks like he and Kim don't get along (since Xuppu calls Kim a nitwit and Kim calls Xuppu a plushie) as the two make exchange of funny faces but is impressed that Kim is a quick learner.

title: Xuppu
text:
Xuppu - Relationships
In "Ephemeral", "Kuro Neko", "Penalteam", and "Risk", Xuppu meets Kim again when they are needed to help Ladybug fight against Moolak, Rogercop, Penalteam, and an unseen villain, respectively.
As of "Re-creation", he is reunited with Kim following Gabriel's death after Marinette recovered his Miraculous and repaired it back to its original form. He is seen playing with him before joining with Ladybug and Cat Noir on another adventure.
In "Sleeping Syren", when Kim tries to go after Ladybug and Cat Noir to warn them about Ondine's akumatization, Xuppu suggests to Kim that he should transform into King Monkey and go help them, although Kim reminds that he has to wait for Ladybug to call him whenever someone got akumatized.

title: Xuppu
text:
Xuppu - Etymology
Xuppu is the only known Kwami with a name related to one of their holders (Sun Wukong, the Monkey King); his name is based on Xu Sheng, a character that rejects the existence of Sun Wukong before becoming a devotee of his, in the story "The Great Sage, Heaven's Equal" written by Pu Songling.
In the French dub, Xuppu's name is pronounced "Z-uppu"; it is pronounced "Sh-uppu" in the English dub, to match the Chinese pronunciation of X.
In the Brazilian Portuguese dub, Xuppu is called Tuppu.

title: Xuppu
text:
Xuppu - Trivia
Xuppu was first revealed from a second season trailer on August 31, 2017.
Xuppu's name was confirmed in the credits of the Latin American Spanish dub of "Sandboy".
Among many things, monkeys are symbols of honor, instinct, swiftness, and playfulness.
The monkey is the ninth animal of the Chinese zodiac.
Along with Ziggy, he is one of the only known Kwamis named after people.
Xuppu's favorite food being bananas is a reference to the dietary habits of real monkeys.
It is hinted by Wayzz in "Truth", that Xuppu has never used his power without a holder.

title: Wu Shifu
text:
Wu Shifu - Intro
was the posthumous overarching protagonist of Miraculous World: Shanghai - The Legend of Ladydragon. He was the adoptive father of Fei Wu and one of the Guardians of the Sacred Cave and the Prodigious. In a flashback from "Miraculous Shanghai", it is shown that he made Fei the new Guardian and protector of the Sacred Cave.

title: Wu Shifu
text:
Wu Shifu - Appearance
Physical Appearance
He was a tall and slender middle-aged man with black hair and white temples in the end. After Fei becomes a teenager, his hair soon turned gray as he aged to an old man.
Civilian Attire
He wore a white long sleeve changshan shirt, black pants, and a pair of black martial arts slippers.

title: Wu Shifu
text:
Wu Shifu - Personality
He was a kind and honorable man, and was a wise mentor who trained Fei. She said that he really loved her adoptive father for taking her in and raising her well. He did everything possible to protect his school from falling and not lose his students, who were like children to him. He was also a devoted guardian.

title: Wu Shifu
text:
Wu Shifu - Abilities
As a Civilian
According to Fei, like her, Wu his bilingual having a love for the English language as well as speaking Chinese.
With him being a previous Renren guardian and a teacher, Wu was a highly skilled kung fu expert and trained his daughter and others really well.

title: Wu Shifu
text:
Wu Shifu - History
Pre-Series
Wu Shifu was the last one to defend Sacred Cave with Prodigious. He lost hope when his students left, and he had no successor. The students were bribed by Cash, who wanted to buy back the territory of his school. After one of the magical full moons, he heard an abandoned baby in front of the school, whom he named Fei. Shifu spent all his knowledge and experience on the girl, training her as the new keeper of the cave and all magical things. He handed her the bracelet, trusting her completely. He soon disappeared. Fei immortalized his memory by putting up a modest shrine with his photo.
Miraculous World
In "Miraculous Shanghai", Wu Shifu was reminded of Fei and Cash when the topic turns to the girl's missing foster father. Fei also remembers her father during a conversation with Marinette. The girl explains that it was Wu who taught her several foreign languages. She also says that her foster father wanted to open his school to tourists when he lost his students. While at the burned-down school, Fei informs Marinette that Wu has disappeared, and before that, their enemy broke in, intimidated, and eventually also robbed the precious bracelet.

title: Wu Shifu
text:
Wu Shifu - Relationships
Family
Fei Wu
Wu Shifu adopted Fei when she was still a small child. He raised and trained her for many years to be the future keeper of the cave, and when she was ready, he gave her a bracelet. It can be seen from Wu's behavior that he loved his ward very much and took care of her. He wanted to convey to her all the values that guided his life.
Enemies
Cash
Cash has been Shifu's opponent for a long time. It was because of him that the man lost his school, which he cared so much about. Despite Cash's numerous insidious attempts to seize the territory where the kung fu school was located, Wu was adamant in his decision and did not bow to Cash. He lost his life because of him.

title: Wu Shifu
text:
Wu Shifu - Trivia
He is based on the Chinese actor Donnie Yen.
He is the first and only character to be human and then be killed by a human.
His name may be a combination of Sensei Wu and Shifu.

title: Wu Shifu's school
text:
Wu Shifu's school - Intro
is a kung-fu school created and owned by Wu Shifu, as well as being his residence. After being threatened by Cash and his gang who wants the land upon which his school was built, Wu Shifu's students whom were guarding the school quit their duty.
Later, Fei Wu became the successor of the school after Wu Shifu died from failure to protect the school. As Fei was highly vulnerable, Cash used this to his advantage to attack at that time and ended up destroying the school in the process.

title: Wu Shifu's school
text:
Wu Shifu's school - Appearance
The school was presented as a vast traditional Confucian temple, with a wooden framework and structure painted in gold and a green-tiled roof. It consisted of several interconnected pavilions, two rounded towers, and multiple inner courtyards. The temple opened onto an immense tree-lined garden, arranged according to tradition, which provided a wide space for the practice of martial arts on fair-weather days.
This garden included a small hill from which a stream flowed, forming a waterfall that concealed the secret entrance to the Sacred Cave. However, after the fire, the school was largely devastated by the flames: most of the roof and supporting structure burned down, leading to the destruction of the first floor’s walls and flooring, as well as the complete collapse of the temple’s towers. The inner courtyard was left in ruins, buried beneath the remains of the roof and walls that had fallen inward.

title: Wu Shifu's school
text:
Wu Shifu's school - Appearance
Fei Wu managed to set up a small shelter in which to sleep, installing an improvised altar there in memory of his late father. The garden was the only part that seemed to have escaped the fire, although the lack of maintenance caused debris and ashes from the disaster to accumulate in certain areas over time.

title: Wu Shifu's school
text:
Wu Shifu's school - Trivia
Wu Shifu's school may be based off of Yu Garden.
However, Yu Garden still exists till today unlike Wu Shifu's school which was destroyed by Cash.

title: Xuppu/History
text:
Xuppu/History - Intro
Xuppu is the kwami connected to the Monkey Miraculous. Currently, he allows Lê Chiến Kim transform into King Monkey.

title: Xuppu/History
text:
Xuppu/History - Before [[Season 1]]
When the concept of Derision came into existence, Xuppu came into existence. Before the Miraculous jewels were created, Xuppu and the other kwamis traveled all over the universe unable to interact with humans. Then, thousands of years ago, a mage created the Miraculouses. Xuppu started out with Hóu Zi in China, then returned to China thousands of years later and was later in Japan. When his Miraculous was not being worn, Xuppu was dormant in the Monkey Miraculous, which was stored inside the Miracle Box.

title: Xuppu/History
text:
Xuppu/History - Season 1
During Season 1, Xuppu was dormant in the Monkey Miraculous.

title: Xuppu/History
text:
Xuppu/History - [[Season 2]]
During Season 2, Xuppu was dormant in the Monkey Miraculous.
In "Sandboy", Xuppu was celebrating Nooroo's birthday in the Miraculous box with the other kwamis and was excited when Tikki and Plagg arrived. They marveled at the gift Tikki brought as they thought it was a paintbrush, and they drew a line with the marker to the other kwamis. Starting to play the music, Xuppu danced with the others kwamis. When the time came to find Nooroo, they got into position in an effort to contact him, but instead, they contacted his wielder instead. Upon hearing his voice, they shuddered at the thought of being his slave and prevented themselves from being discovered when they all cut off the connection. They realized if they contacted Nooroo's wielder rather than Nooroo, then someone must have been akumatized and that Tikki and Plagg's wielders were in danger.

title: Xuppu/History
text:
Xuppu/History - [[Season 3]]
During Season 3, Xuppu was dormant in the Monkey Miraculous.
In "Kwamibuster", he was activated along with his kwami brothers and sisters to help Multimouse enact her plan of rescuing Tikki and Plagg. During the confrontation, Xuppu was one of the few kwamis captured but was set free with the help of Multinoire. After Kwamibuster's defeat, Xuppu and others cheered for Marinette as their plan was success and was returned to Miracle Box.
In "Party Crasher", Xuppu and his Miraculous are given to Lê Chiến Kim by Master Fu after Ladybug, Cat Noir, Carapace, Viperion and Pegasus had failed against Party Crasher. Upon meeting him, Xuppu was offended when Kim called him a plush toy, sticking his tongue after he introduced himself. The two then engaged in a match of making funny faces at each other. Afterwards, the two transformed into King Monkey and use their power Uproar to make Party Crasher's powers go haywire, allowing them to free the other heroes and defeat the party villain. Xuppu was returned to the Monkey Miraculous which was given back to Master Fu.

title: Xuppu/History
text:
Xuppu/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Miracle Queen", Xuppu was activated by a possessed Kim, transforming him into King Monkey and his powers were used against the heroes until they managed to deakumatize the titular villain. After Hawk Moth and Mayura fled and the role of Guardian was passed to Ladybug, Xuppu and his Miraculous were retrieved and placed in the Miracle Box.

title: Xuppu/History
text:
Xuppu/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Truth", Xuppu was accidentally released from the Miracle Box when Marinette tried to figure it out, he explored Marinette's room. During a video call on his new guardian's computer, Xuppu and the others surrounded the screen in amazement. When Marinette leaves for her date with Luka, he and his fellow kwamis hid with the Miracle Box, but they heard the titular villain broke into Marinette's room, he attempted to use his powers but was stopped by Wayzz being reminded of the dangers. After the titular villain's defeat, Xuppu and the others saw that Marinette was sad about breaking up with Luka to the point of tears, Xuppu didn't know exactly how to help but joined with the other kwamis in giving their new guardian a group hug.
In "Lies", Xuppu was seen with Mullo and come across an apple by Marinette's computer trying to play with it but drop on the keyboard and yet couldn't agree on how to move it and stepped on the keyboard changing the screen.

title: XY/History
text:
XY/History - Intro
Xavier-Yves Roth, better known as XY, is a famous pop star and Jagged Stone's biggest rival in the music making business. His father is the producer Bob Roth.

title: XY/History
text:
XY/History - [[Season 1]]
In "Guitar Villain", after XY takes Jagged Stone place on the sales chart, he becomes #1 on the charts. XY is interviewed by Nadja Chamack on TVi for his accomplishment, there he acts arrogant and foolish, claiming all music is related to technology to program what people expect. XY then completely aggravates Jagged Stone by describing him to Nadja as old, out of date and worthless. He then says one of Jagged's catchphrases and invites him to his concert while making fun of his age.
Later at the TVi Tower, Nadja receives a call from Ladybug while XY is being interviewed by Alec Cataldi. Ladybug tells Nadja that XY is in danger and when Alec is informed of this, he finishes the interview and tells XY about the situation. Alec then takes XY outside the TVi Tower, where Ladybug and Cat Noir arrived. The heroes try to get him to safety, when suddenly the titular villain and his dragon swoop in and take XY to the Eiffel Tower.

title: XY/History
text:
XY/History - [[Season 1]]
At XY's concert, the villain (who is actually an akumatized Jagged Stone) ties-up XY and is about to make him walk the plank on top of the Eiffel Tower. While Ladybug and Cat Noir are climbing up the Tower, he plays his guitar and green energy waves which he calls "Ultimate Solo" start to cause tremendous earthquakes around him causing XY to bounce on the end of the plank. While battled the villain and his dragon, the plank under XY starts to break.
Later after Ladybug uses the hairspray to stiffen the villain's hair preventing him from being able to play his guitar, the plank breaks causing XY to fall. Ladybug then uses her yo-yo to save XY and make him land on top of the guitar, breaking it releasing the akuma. After the villain was de-akumatized back into Jagged, XY's wonders why he was at his concert and called him crazy after he was defended by Ladybug.

title: XY/History
text:
XY/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Captain Hardrock", for the National Music Festival, XY hosted a concert at the Place de la Concorde. While performing at his concert, the titular villain blasts speakers onto the performing area making XY run away.
In "Style Queen" and "Queen Wasp", XY is seen sitting on the front row of the fashion show of Gabriel Agreste, next to his father Bob Roth, who is also his producer, and Lila Rossi. He is later seen when the fashion show was interrupted by the first titular villain and in a recording of that on the news. He was also present when Gabriel arrives and hugs his son, Adrien Agreste.

title: XY/History
text:
XY/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Silencer" XY and his father Bob are greeted at Le Grand Paris hotel by Mayor André Bourgeois, whom says that having a famous DJ and his manager father is an honor. When André leaves, Bob asks his son if he has any new ideas for his upcoming promotion, to which XY says that he never has ideas. He shows him an idea that he copied, but after listening to it for a moment, Bob notices that it sounds the same as the piece he did last year.
XY listens and realizes that his father is right, joking on how he copied himself. Bob says that it's okay as people are too busy to notice and what really matters is the concept. He asks XY for visuals, but when XY reveals that he has none, Bob tells him to use the same method that won him his fame and fortune, which is copying others' ideas. They both then laugh so hard that other guests begin staring at them.

title: XY/History
text:
XY/History - [[Season 3]]
XY and Both decide to copy a band named Kitty Section after the submit a video for a fake contest. They then go live at the TVi Tower, where XY plays Kitty Section's music and wears a cardboard version of the costumes that Marinette Dupain-Cheng designed. Once he's finished, Alec praises XY and asks him where he came up with such an original style, to which XY says that it was all in his head. Alec then asks him where he came up with his idea, which XY claimed that it all came to him in five minutes.
XY then goes to his father as he was being confronted by Marinette and Luka Couffaine from Kitty Section. XY claims that they were merely inspired, but Luka furiously affirms that it's plagiarism, even ripping the mask he's wearing off in anger. Marinette tells Bob and XY that they can still make things right by telling the truth and letting Kitty Section appear on the show, but Bob refuses, stating that if he does that, they'll demand a share of the profits.

title: XY/History
text:
XY/History - [[Season 3]]
Once again, he and XY deny knowing anything about the video. Though Luka is still angry, he tells Marinette that it's not a big deal and prepares to escort her out. However, Marinette refuses to let Bob and XY get away with copying Kitty Section and tells Bob that if he won't tell the truth, she'll do it on live TV.
After Bob threatened Marinette, Luka was akumatized into the titular villain as XY complains that the costumes Marinette designed were hard to copy. In the middle of his rant, the villain grabs XY's face, puts his fingers to his lips, and shushes, causing a purple jellyfish-like creature containing XY's voice to pop out of XY's mouth. The villains then absorbs it in his helmet and XY tries to speak, nothing comes out making him run away.
Later after Ladybug does her Miraculous Ladybug, XY who was tied up is freed and is given back his voice. He then watched as his father yelled at everyone and admitted that copied Kitty Section on live TV, saying that he stole the music and costumes of the band to give him to his talentless son, which made XY sad.

title: XY/History
text:
XY/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Kwamibuster", broadcasting live, Alec announces the jury of the newest segment of Alternative Truth, XY being one of them, along with Mr. Banana and Manon Chamack. He and the other judges then watch as Olga Mendeleiev says that what the viewers are about to witness is proof of the existence of interdimensional creatures (which are actually Kwamis) that like to eat cheese. She shows them a recording she'd made earlier but interdimensional creatures didn't show up on it, to XY's confusion.
Later, Alec announces that it's time for XY and the other judges to decide whether the theories they heard are true or false. Jalil Kubdel hypothesized that Egyptian pyramids are actually alien spaceships that crashed onto Earth, which XY and the other judges decide to be true. Vincent Asa hypothesized that snow is boogers from a giant in the clouds. Manon and XY believe this to be true, but Mr. Banana isn't convinced.

title: XY/History
text:
XY/History - [[Season 3]]
As for Olga's hypotheses, XY and the other judges is convinced to be false. Olga is exasperated and insists that her discovery is true, but everyone believes her video is fake and Alec has her escorted offstage, with XY and everyone else laughing at her. Soon after Olga is akumatized by Hawk Moth into the titular villain and she arrives on stage, with XY still sited with the rest of the judges.
In "Heart Hunter", XY attends Mayor André and Audrey Bourgeois' 20th wedding anniversary inside Le Grand Paris. There he witnesses the couple be akumatized into the titular villains.

title: XY/History
text:
XY/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Lies", XY attends Prince Ali's birthday at Hôtel de Ville, along with his father Bob. Then, the titular villain's orb enters the party and it freezes half of the people at tha party who have lied before, XY and Bob hide behind the presents and as there about to freeze by the villain, Cat Noir arrives and takes the attention of them. Later, XY was frozen offscreen until he was unfrozen by Ladybug's Miraculous Ladybug.
In "Hack-San", after Robostus sends out a signal to all Parisians with a message sent through their phones, XY is hypothesized offscreen. He is then sent by Robostus to the Musée Grévin, positioning himself where his statue used to be. There after Scarabella and Cat Noir arrive, XY unfreezes from his position. He then pulls out his phone and moves towards the heroes. XY is commanded to seize the Ladybug and the Cat Miraculous, along with the other high-profile hypothesized individuals. As he moved in on Cat Noir, he was knocked back by the hero's staff. XY then got back on his feet and watched as Scarabella and Cat Noir delivered themselves to Robostus. Later, XY is freed from Robostus' control by Scarabella's Miraculous Scarabella.

title: XY/History
text:
XY/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Illusion", XY was interviewed at Le Grand Paris for the talk show, Leading Questions, Honest Answers. He was asked about how Ladybug had lost all the Miraculouses to Monarch. Throughout the interview, XY was confused about the name of the supervillain as he has been known as "Hawk Moth" and "Shadow Moth" previously. His father Bob signaled him no various times and then pointed at his head drawing a crown. XY thought that the supervillain calls himself "King" and Bob then wrote "Monarch" on a paper and showed it to him, to his confusion.

title: Yaksi Gozen
text:
Yaksi Gozen - Intro
"" is a season 6 episode of the series Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. Based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 13th written and produced episode of season 6. It is also the 144th written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Yaksi Gozen
text:
Yaksi Gozen - Synopsis
While Adrien wonders how to be as surprising as Marinette, Kagami and Félix wonder how to avoid unpleasant surprises. But a supervillain will upset the plans of the four teenagers.
Disney Channel
While Adrien wonders how to be as full of surprise as Marinette, Kagami and Felix wonder how to avoid unpleasant surprises.
Disney+
Kagami and Félix turn to Ladybug for help.

title: Yaksi Gozen
text:
Yaksi Gozen - Plot
At the beginning of the episode, we see a flashback from the fifth season finale "The Final Day", showing Gabriel moments before his death. We learn that Gabriel wasn't actually working with Tomoe until the end. He cut her off from the system, and Tomoe, fearing for Kagami, made a mysterious phone call to a female accomplice. After hanging up, she cried out in anger at Gabriel's betrayal.
In the present time, Placide purchases Adrien some chouquettes. However, Marinette switches the bag because it's part of a surprise she's prepared for Adrien. Understanding, Placide gives her an understanding wink and grunt before taking his leave. At the Agreste house, Adrien finds small items from Marinette in the chouquettes. These lead him to a dove with a message from her. Adrien records a voicemail thanking Marinette, which delights her greatly. At his house, Adrien also decides to prepare something for Marinette.

title: Yaksi Gozen
text:
Yaksi Gozen - Plot
At the same time, Kagami talks to Félix about their joint plan, which is currently unknown. Adrien knits a t-shirt for Marinette, but it don't turn out as he wants. Despite this, Marinette assures him that she really likes it. At Kagami's house, the situation is much more tense. Kagami argues with Tomoe, then transforms into Ryuko when Tomoe attempts to reclaim the Tsurugi Family Ring from her. Using her Elemental Dragons, she tears the room apart as she tells Tomoe off, reminding her of what Ladybug and Kagami did to keep Tomoe from going to prison for life because of her collaboration with Gabriel/Monarch but Ryuko calms down and pleads with her mother to reconsider and change, as Adrien has already lost both of his parents, and Ryuko doesn't want to lose Tomoe, then transforms into the wind and flies away.
Meanwhile, Adrien has baked a cake for Marinette, but it ends up burned and Plagg tells him that Marinette's parents are the best bakers in Paris and that she could just go to them for a cake but he has another idea.

title: Yaksi Gozen
text:
Yaksi Gozen - Plot
Soon, Adrien is walking down the street embarrassingly with a large beef rib as people are looking at him in confusion and he asks Plagg if he was sure about it and tells him that a beef rib is great for romance but a dog snatches the rib and Adrian is left disappointed.
Meanwhile, back at Tomoe's house, she takes off her glasses, revealing cybernetic prosthetic eyes.
She reminisces about the moment Gabriel asked for her help.
Back in Tokyo, while overlooking Tokyo Tower and the city from her room, Gabriel calls her asking for assistance.
Tomoe is incredulous, calling Gabriel weak for his inability to defeat Ladybug and Cat Noir on his own.
When he requests her help, she is unwilling, especially when he mentions the Peacock Miraculous, which she blames for taking away her eyesight in exchange for Kagami's birth.
She warns him that they could be labeled traitors by "The Kingdom" if they are discovered using the Ultimate Miraculous Absolute Power without consent.
Only when Gabriel offers to pair up Adrien with Kagami, Tomoe does seem placated enough to cooperate.

title: Yaksi Gozen
text:
Yaksi Gozen - Plot
However, her flashback is interrupted by the sudden appearance of Cerise, who transforms into Chrysalis, revealing her true form after previously appearing merely as a silhouette during the akumatizations. She shares her plan with Tomoe: she intends to akumatize her into Yaksi Gozen, a new version of Ikari Gozen. Their plan involves kidnapping Félix, taking his ring, replacing it with a fake one, and controlling him to gain a spy within The Miraculers, ultimately giving Tomoe control over Kagami's boyfriend. Tomoe seems to agree to this plan. Meanwhile at the train station, Kagami greets Félix, who has just arrived in Paris, and they head to meet Marinette together.

title: Yaksi Gozen
text:
Yaksi Gozen - Plot
At home, Marinette has prepared a hanger for Adrien's shirt when she receives a call from Ryuko and Argos. Moments later, the heroes enter her room and remind Marinette of their history. They explain that their amokized rings could be destroyed (which would cause them to cease to exist), damaged (making them seriously ill), or taken by someone (forcing them to serve that person). They revert to their civilian forms when Kagami's mother suddenly calls. Although Kagami doesn't answer, she and Félix explain the options they have devised: burying the rings (which is risky in case of future construction), locking them in a safe at the bank (they could get stolen if a heist happens), sending them to space (where cosmic rays could damage them), and keeping them themselves (risky because they’re superheroes). They finally come up with the idea of hiding the rings in Ladybug's yo-yo, as the magic of her yo-yo would keep them safe. This way, no one could steal or damage the rings because only Ladybug could access them, and when she’s not transformed, no one else can.

title: Yaksi Gozen
text:
Yaksi Gozen - Plot
Marinette is initially unsure, recalling that she had previously kept the other Miraculouses in her yo-yo but lost them to Shadow Moth back in "Shadow Moth's Final Attack." An ashamed Félix reassures her, acknowledging that he was to blame for that incident and reassures her it wasn't her fault. Kagami then states that there will always be a risk no matter what plan they come up with but also tells Marinette that she can find the solution to any problem. Marinette then transforms into Ladybug. However, just as she's about to place the rings in her yo-yo, she is interrupted by Tom, Sabine, and Adrien. Félix and Kagami quickly cover for Marinette as she reverts from Ladybug, but in the confusion, she loses the rings.

title: Yaksi Gozen
text:
Yaksi Gozen - Plot
Tom, Sabine, and Adrien have come to tell Marinette about a surprise Adrien has prepared: beef ribs. Marinette corrects him, saying they are lamb chops. Adrien explains that the butcher was out of beef ribs, and Tom and Sabine take the lamb chops to cook, assuring them that with garlic and rosemary, they will be delicious. Confused as to why Félix and Kagami are here, Adrien asks them. They, along with Marinette, are panicking about the lost rings and want to keep their secret safe from Adrien. They tell him they were there to hide the rings as a romantic gesture that Kagami read about in a manga, also asking Adrien to help find the missing rings.

title: Yaksi Gozen
text:
Yaksi Gozen - Plot
Much to Marinette, Kagami, and Félix's relief, Adrien eventually finds the rings under his foot. However, he decides to show them a magic trick he learned, making the rings disappear, which causes horror among the group. He later pulls Félix's ring from behind Félix's ear and makes Kagami's appear in Félix's hand. Félix yells at Adrien, telling him not to mess with valuables and to give him his ring back. Adrien reassures him that it's just a magic trick and nothing to panic about. Félix calms down, realizing everything is fine, and he lays down, shocking Marinette and Kagami as they realize that Adrien is unknowingly controlling Félix with his ring.
Suddenly, Marinette tells Kagami that Tomoe was calling, and when Kagami answers, Yaksi Gozen appears and kidnaps Félix, where Chrysalis is waiting inside, but it turns out that Félix's ring is in Adrien's possession, and Félix has Kagami's ring. The villain tries to kidnap Adrien, but he escapes, gives Kagami Félix's ring and transforms into Cat Noir.

title: Yaksi Gozen
text:
Yaksi Gozen - Plot
Yaksi Gozen realizes that Kagami now possesses her boyfriend's ring, which allows Marinette time to transform into Ladybug. Meanwhile, Kagami transforms into Ryuko, ensuring the ring's safety. When the villain captures Ryuko, she shifts into water and escapes by jumping into the Seine. Ladybug then uses her Lucky Charm, causing a fire truck to fall on Yaksi Gozen. While Ryuko, in her water form, grows larger and attempts to reason with the villain, Cat Noir uses his Cataclysm ability on her sword, but the Ultrakuma is nowhere to be found. Realizing that their plan won't work, Chrysalis orders Yaksi Gozen to help her escape without being noticed. Yaksi Gozen throws Ryuko aside, pretending to fall, which allows Chrysalis to slip away safely underwater. Later, Tomoe rejects the Ultrakuma, apologizes, and seeks forgiveness. Ryuko agrees, powers down into Kagami, and embraces her mother. Ladybug then uses the Miraculous Ladybug, repairing all the damage caused during the battle. Félix returns to normal and hugs Kagami. They exchange rings, hinting that their relationship will remain the same for now.

title: Yaksi Gozen
text:
Yaksi Gozen - Plot
Cat Noir remarks that it's very romantic, which Ladybug confirms, and everyone gives a fist bump. A hidden Chrysalis watches the scene mysteriously. At Marinette's house, everyone is enjoying dinner. Adrien apologizes for not being as charming as Marinette and adds that what he does for her is just weird, to which Marinette replies that it's weird how he doesn't do things his way. Marinette's dad says that without his lamb chops, they wouldn't be having dinner together now and tells him he's part of the family, and a hidden Plagg tells Tikki that he was right and that a good meal is the key to success.
In the final scene, Tomoe enters a completely white room and sits in a white chair, connecting to a screen in The Kingdom's Lair as the Machine. During the meeting, the council honors Gabriel, the former Diamond, and welcomes the new king of luxury. They declare, "The Diamond is dead! Long live the Diamond!".

title: Yaksi Gozen
text:
Yaksi Gozen - Plot Developments
More about Tomoe's life is revealed:
It's revealed that she had suffered great disappointment from men all her life, which is why she wanted Adrien to be paired with Kagami, as she didn't want her daughter to suffer like she did.
Tomoe's blindness is revealed not to be a birth defect, but rather due to her using the Peacock Miraculous to have Kagami.
Due to Tomoe appearing to be capable of seeing, it's possible those mechanical eyes are able of giving her if not limited vision, possibly working by capturing vibrations.
This is also a reference to her statement at the post-end card scene of "Sublimation".
She was the one to use the Peacock Miraculous to give life to Kagami, with her lost sight being a consequence of that.
The reason why she and Kagami came to Paris is confirmed as being because Gabriel contacted her to require her help to fight Ladybug and Cat Noir, expecting Tomoe to try to fix the Peacock Miraculous so Nathalie could join him in battle against the superheroes.

title: Yaksi Gozen
text:
Yaksi Gozen - Plot Developments
Tomoe initially refused, due to the fact she had to give up on her sight to have Kagami and also for feeling that The Kingdom (the secret organization they both belong to) could consider that as an act of treason, only accepting after Gabriel agreed to have Adrien paired up with Kagami and use the wish to also restore her eyes.
It's revealed that Tomoe and Lila/Cerise have been allies even before Monarch's defeat, with the latter even calling the former as "mother", which suggest some kind of biological or adoptive bond between them.
However Lila/Cerise could be using that term to mock Tomoe and her argument with Kagami.
The fact the two have been in collusion, possibly since the beginning, may explain some things about Lila/Cerise:
Lila trying to become close to Adrien may have been a way for her to also become close to Gabriel.
Lila becoming friends with Kagami may have served to keep a close watch over the latter.
Lila figuring out Gabriel Agreste was Monarch.
Lila/Cerise having multiple identities each with their own mother may have been possible thanks to Tomoe.
Cerise being able to hack into Gabriel's security system may have been facilitated by Tomoe.

title: Yaksi Gozen
text:
Yaksi Gozen - Plot Developments
If it is confirmed that Lila is in fact her daughter (either biological or adopted), then that would mean she is also Kagami's sister.
Tomoe is shown being aware that her daughter is the holder of the Dragon Miraculous, as not only Kagami had transformed in front of her, but also Longg talks to her.
Due to knowing her mother was Monarch's accomplice and that he knew her secret identity, Kagami is also aware her mother knows she is Ryuko, which is why she is capable of transforming in front of her and doesn't hide Longg from her.
Due to Tomoe's alliance with Lila, the latter is also aware of Kagami's identity as Ryuko.
Not just that, but Lila also knows everything Tomoe knows about The Miraculers, including that Félix is Argos and that both Félix and Kagami (and most likely Adrien as well) are sentimonsters and where their respective amok is located.
Kagami and Félix, realizing the danger of carrying their respective rings, have tried to come up with ways to keep them hidden, with the safest option being asking Marinette to keep them safe inside her magical yo-yo.
At the episode's end, they end up giving up on that idea and keep the rings.

title: Yaksi Gozen
text:
Yaksi Gozen - Plot Developments
When Tomoe used the Peacock Miraculous to make Kagami, she should've lost all her vital energy that kept her alive but instead she lost her sight, implying that using a damaged Miraculous has other side effects or Tomoe found another way to stop her vital energy from being drained.
Considering her practical nature, it's possible she either replaced parts of her body affected by the illness with mechanical parts in order to survive or used the Peacock Miraculous to create a Sentimonster that would concentrate the damage on her eyes and then have them removed (akin to the removal of a cancer), in this way preventing her state from worsening.
If the first option is true, then it means it was still possible for Émilie, Colt and Nathalie to save themselves, but considering the circumstances, they didn't: Émilie accepted the price to have Adrien and just enjoy the little time she had with him; Colt became unaware of the backlash caused by the damaged Miraculous until it was too late; and Nathalie kept on using the damaged Peacock Miraculous to help Gabriel, in this way worsening her condition beyond recuperation.

title: Yaksi Gozen
text:
Yaksi Gozen - Plot Developments
Since it's likely a major organ was attacked first, Émilie, Colt and Nathalie all centered their feelings around their hearts when they first used the Peacock Miraculous and if so as well as considering the circumstances back then, it would be costly financial-wise.
But if the second option is true, then it could be that Tomoe created another creature before she made Kagami, if so she had another organ afflicted but it's unknown which one or if she had it removed nor if she's still afflicted.
It was revealed by Thomas Astruc that the damaged Peacock Miraculous affects different organs depending on the emotion used to create the sentimonster and that the more the damaged Miraculous is used, the worse and more damaged that organ becomes. This may suggest that the illness works like a cancer, affecting the first organ and potentially spreading throughout the rest of the body. Since Tomoe's eyes were first to be affected by the backlash of the use of the damaged Miraculous, she was able to remove them when they started to deteriorate and potentially prevent her condition from worsening.

title: Yaksi Gozen
text:
Yaksi Gozen - Plot Developments
There is also something interesting that only happened when she acted with enough time but say if Tomoe had her eyes removed later and if they were still the central organ where the affliction started then it's unknown if the affliction would still continue.
If Tomoe followed the pattern and lost her eyes, then it's likely the emotion she used to create Kagami was satisfaction or at least with it in the terms of perfection but due to her strict lifestyle and horrible past with relationships, it could be that Tomoe's fear or bitterness snuck into her daughter's creation as well. And if so, then Tomoe likely wouldn't be able to bare that happening again so maybe her eyes were taken so she couldn't.
It is explained that any object stored inside Ladybug's magical yo-yo is turned into a quantic state that prevents anyone from reaching it unless through the yo-yo, which can only exist when Ladybug is transformed which also may suggest that the tool has a special pocket dimension inside but what the yo-yo looks like from the inside is unknown.

title: Yaksi Gozen
text:
Yaksi Gozen - Plot Developments
Following "Emotion", "Pretension" and "Representation", Felix continues his redemption arc, upon meeting Marinette and seeing that he still feels guilty of his actions in "Strikeback", it's likely he was told about everything that happened before and after he traded the miraculous to his uncle.

title: Yaksi Gozen
text:
Yaksi Gozen - Trivia
This is the fourth time Tomoe gets akumatized following "Ikari Gozen", "Multiplication", and "Pretension". This time she gets akumatized into Yaksi Gozen, a new variation of Ikari Gozen.
The name of the villain comes from "yaksha", nature spirits in Buddhist mythology, while the honorific "gozen" usually implies female nobility.
In Brazil, this was the first episode to receive the A6 self-rating (not recommended for children under 6 years old), created by the Ministry of Justice and Public Security and self-applied during its broadcast on Gloob.
This episode is the very first in season 6 to fully show Cerise Bianca in both her civilian form and as Chrysalis.
During the flashback sequence, Gabriel addresses Tomoe by her first name for the first time in the series.
Ryuko's transformation is shown using all three elements, starting with water, then lightning and then finishing with wind.
In the version aired on Disney Channel, Ryuko's transformation sequence has an anti-seizure filter, making it darker, which differs from her Water Dragon sequence in "Sleeping Syren". Plus, the dragon-scale details in the background are much less visible compared to the TF1 version.

title: Yaksi Gozen
text:
Yaksi Gozen - Trivia
This is the first time two Miraculous holders use the Miraculous Call at the same time, even more to call the same holder.
Adrien is revealed as having learned magic tricks on online tutorials, even using it on Kagami and Félix's respective rings.
It is ironic that Adrien uses a magic trick on Félix, considering that has always been one of the latter's skills.
Adrien becomes the first person after Colt Fathom to ever control Félix with the latter's amok, even if he did it without realizing.
Tomoe becomes the second person to fight off Chrysalis' ultrakuma, following Sabrina in "Daddycop".
However, unlike Sabrina, who truly resisted Chrysalis, Tomoe broke akumatization with Chrysalis' permission.
Chrysalis opting to not take Kagami's ring when she had the chance is due to the fact the Peacock Miraculous holder is able to sense amoks. If she had taken Kagami's ring and replaced it with a fake, Félix would be able to tell it was a fake for not feeling the amok in it.

title: Yaksi Gozen
text:
Yaksi Gozen - Trivia
At the end of her call with Félix, Kagami tells him that she loves him in Japanese. However, the phrase differs between the dubs: she says daisuki da yo (大好きだよ) in the French version, and aishiteru ne (愛してるね) in the English one.
References
Kagami transforming in front of her mother in a rage is similar to what Chloé did with her mother in "Queen Wasp".
And yet, their rages were fueled by something different: Chloé's was fueled by her jealously ego and desperation for her mom's approval while Kagami's was fueled against her mother's controlling nature and fear of the past.
When Adrien bakes a cake, the corner starts breaking off due to it being burned. This is similar to what happened to Gabriel's finger in "Re-creation" as he was dying from the Cataclysm wound.
Placide purchases Adrien chouquettes, like how his Re-Verse counterpart did in a flashback in "Miraculous Paris".
Allusions
The scroll (or kakemono (掛物)/kakejiku (掛軸)) seen in the Tsurugis' Tokyo apartment features a Japanese proverb, "父の思历 山よりも高く 母の愛ら 海よりも深し", which translates to "A father's goodness is higher than the mountain, a mother's goodness is deeper than the sea." in English.

title: Yaksi Gozen
text:
Yaksi Gozen - Trivia
This implies that Tomoe's father was one of the men she's been disappointed by.
Similar to Laval from the "Legends of Chima", Felix too still felt guilty from how things turned out as he created two Butterfly Miraculous holders; Monarch, when he gave the jewels he stole to his uncle and Chrysalis, when he didn't speak up sooner about what was going on.
Errors
When Kagami transforms into Ryuko during the confrontation with her mother, Longg is not seen entering the Dragon Miraculous.
Also, just before Kagami transforms, the shadows of her suit and mask can be seen on her face and neck.
Kagami has two Miraculouses at the same time during a shot in her transformation sequence: the Dragon Miraculous is simultaneously on her neck and on her neck-collar.
Sometimes Kagami's black shirt clips through her red top.
When Chrysalis tells Yaksi Gozen that Adrien has Félix's ring, the part of her mask under her eyes clips through her skin.
When Kagami, Félix and Marinette look for the rings and Félix is seen from behind, the belt on the back of his vest is grey.

title: Yaksi Gozen
text:
Yaksi Gozen - Trivia
The photo on the blue nightstand in Marinette's room changed to a different one when her parents and Adrien were about to come in and when Félix dropped it while searching for the rings.
When looking for the rings, Félix picks up a table and throws it upward, but it never lands back.
When looking for the rings, the back of Marinette's head and her sideburns go right through the floor when she comes from underneath.
When Kagami's hair changes during her transformation, the Dragon Miraculous glitches partially through her neck.
The Startrain doesn't have its usual color scheme.
In the English dub, Cat Noir mispronounces "Ultrakuma" as "Ultra akuma".
