title: Wreckless Driver/Transcript
text:
Wreckless Driver/Transcript - Intro
(Just then, a candy-looking akumatized villain attacks, breaking part of the train track to get through while people are screaming.)
Man: What is that?!
(On the train, Aglaé is watching this unfold through the glass doors.)
Aglaé: Help!
(Vesperia swings by and lands on top of the train to paralyze it.)
Vesperia: Venom!
(Vesperia lands on the track and grabs onto the train, slowing its movements and bringing it to a stop with only one part of the train hanging off the edge. Aglaé is dragged towards a window leaning off the edge along with her bag and a scooter, and the window pops open causing her to fall while screaming. Ladybug swings by and catches her.)
Aglaé: Don't touch me! Put me down!
Ladybug: Everything's okay! It's over.
Aglaé: Let me go!
(Aglaé quickly runs away from Ladybug while sobbing. Vesperia jumps down to where her fellow hero is.)
Vesperia: I'll shut down the subway. You deal with the villain.
(Both heroes go their separate ways, with Ladybug still looking worried.)
[ Theme Song ]
Alya: She was scared of Ladybug? For real?
Marinette: Yes, I'm telling you! That's strange, right? I didn't do anything to her.

title: Wreckless Driver/Transcript
text:
Wreckless Driver/Transcript - Intro
(They look over at Aglaé who suddenly sees a ladybug around the plants and starts panicking.)
Aglaé: A...a- lady..ladybug!
(Marinette and Alya go over to comfort her, with Marinette holding the ladybug on her own fingers.)
Marinette: It's nothing, Aglaé. It's just a nice little ladybug.
Aglaé: Ahh! It's coming to attack me!
(She takes out a bottle of essential oils and starts spraying it all around her.)
Marinette: Smells good, what is it?
Aglaé: Essential oils! The smell is supposed to repel bugs. Did it go this way? No! That way?! AHH! There's another one!
(Aglaé continues panicking as Marinette and Alya look at each other, worried.)
Aglaé: I've been like this ever since I got akumatized. At first, I was only scared of butterflies because they reminded me of the akuma that hit me.
Marinette: And now you're scared of all bugs?
Aglaé: Bees, flies, ladybugs, I'm even afraid of Ladybug herself!
Alya: But Ladybug isn't scary, she helps people.
Aglaé: I know, but I can't control myself. I'm terrified of getting akumatized again.
(They walk into a classroom.)
Marinette: At least you're safe here. There won't be any bugs in the classroom.
Alya: Meet for lunch?

title: Wreckless Driver/Transcript
text:
Wreckless Driver/Transcript - Intro
(Aglaé nods while Marinette and Alya start walking out of the classroom.)
Marinette: This is all my fault. If I had the Butterfly Miraculous people like Aglaé wouldn't be so traumatized.
Alya: It's not your fault, Marinette. You're already doing your best to free the akumatized people and fix all the damage they cause.
Marinette: Maybe but...magic ladybugs don't fix everything.
(Alya gives her a hug.)
(Aglaé notices a fly coming towards her. She sits still and watches it but then quickly runs away sobbing.)
Aglaé: It's too hard! I can't do this!
Marinette: We can't leave her like this.
Aglaé: I thought I was doing better, but it's actually getting worse. I'll stay home tomorrow and I'm never coming out again if it means I won't be scared anymore!
Marinette: No, don't do that. We can come up with a solution. I could craft you a... let's say an anti-bug protection suit!
Alya: Or we could look for a more rational solution, one that would actually help Aglaé overcome her fear.
Max: When it comes to phobias or fears seeing a specialist is most recommended. I myself see a psychiatrist because I'm on the autism spectrum.
Adrien: The autism spectrum? What's that?

title: Wreckless Driver/Transcript
text:
Wreckless Driver/Transcript - Intro
Max: It means I see things in a different way than you do.
Markov: Neuroatypical brains provide new insight into the world!
Max: The problem is that our environment is designed for neurotypical people. In my case, for example, lateness can be distressing, as well as misplaced things and unfamiliar places. That's why I see Dr. Psiquat every Thursday at 6:15 pm. She helps me overcome my difficulties.
Aglaé: But I'm not on the autism spectrum.
Mylène: It doesn't matter. Dr. Psiquat can also help people with phobias. You're scared of butterflies, and I was scared of the dark, of germs, mice, but I talked to her, and it helped me.
(At a nearby table is Ray, Loïc, and Nelson.)
Ray: That sounds so lame. I'd never go.
Alya: Too bad because it can also help senseless and mean people like you.
(The bullies look mad at that statement.)
Max: Don't listen to toxic people with failed socialization, Aglaé.
Aglaé: But what will I talk to Dr. Psiquat about?
Juleka: Things you don't always want to tell other people.
Adrien: And that helps you feel better?
Max: A lot better.
Aglaé: Ok...I'll give it a try.
(Mylène puts a hand on Aglaé's arm to ease her nerves.)

title: Wreckless Driver/Transcript
text:
Wreckless Driver/Transcript - Intro
Aglaé: Thanks for coming with me, friends.
Dr. Psiquat: Oh my! Alya, Max, Juleka, Mylène, I'm not sure I'll have time to see all of you.
Marinette: Aglaé is your only appointment, Dr. Psiquat. We just came with her.
Dr. Psiquat: Aww, your friends came with you. Quite significant, and very kind of you all. If you're ready Aglaé, you can come with me.
(Everyone makes heart symbols of encouragement towards Aglaé who leaves with Dr. Psiquat.)
Aglaé: What's with all the models?
Dr. Psiquat: Well, life can take many different paths, so many that you can sometimes feel lost. But I'm here to help you find your own path and pick the right vehicle to travel down it with serenity. (hands the miniature car to her) You can have the car if you like it. And you can sit anywhere you want.
(Aglaé sits in a big blue chair. Dr. Psiquat sits across from her with a clipboard in hand.)
Dr. Psiquat: I spoke to your dad on the phone. He told me about some issues you've been having, but I'd like to hear it in your own words. What would you like to talk to me about?
Aglaé: I-I don't know...
Dr. Psiquat: Your dad mentioned a problem with uh...butterflies?
Aglaé: ...It's because of the day I got akumatized.

title: Wreckless Driver/Transcript
text:
Wreckless Driver/Transcript - Intro
(Aglaé voices over the events that happened in the flashback of That Day.)
Aglaé: It was the first day back at school. Ladybug had claimed that she defeated supervillain Hawk Moth so I thought I'd be safe to leave my house again and go back to school. It had been so long that I didn't know how to act around people anymore.
(Aglaé watches some of the other students from afar before Prem taps her on the shoulder and points to her shoes.)
Aglaé: I'd shake, stammer, I felt like I had become an alien. I wanted to be part of the group, but I couldn't do it.
(Prem waves to the other students and runs up to them, greeting them with Namaste before Anne-Jeanne Théoxanne du Bocquale walks up to the group.)
Aglaé: Since it was the first day back at school my science teacher Mrs. du Bocquale had planned a visit to the butterfly house and the lab there.
(The rest of the students enter the butterfly house to watch the butterflies. Aglaé follows behind them but doesn't go inside yet.)
Aglaé: I wanted to go with the group especially because I used to love butterflies and biodiversity as a whole. Besides, I thought that all the akumatizations were over. That I had no reason to be scared anymore.

title: Wreckless Driver/Transcript
text:
Wreckless Driver/Transcript - Intro
(A butterfly flies to the door handle just as Aglaé is about to open the door and get in, scaring her.)
Aglaé: I couldn't do it. And yet I really wanted to follow them, to do like them, to be like them but I just couldn't do it. And... that's when they showed up.
(Dr. Psiquat looks at her sadly.)
Alya: Dr. Psiquat is awesome. It helped a lot to talk to her, you know?
Marinette: Huh? I didn't know you were seeing her too, what for?
(While the girls are chatting, Adrien looks at a bunch of magazines on the table in front of him. He sees one about his father being a hero and quickly covers it up with another magazine.)
Alya: Well, let's just say some kind of complicated family issues.
Marinette: You never told me about that.
Alya: I worked it out a long time ago. I don't even think about it anymore.
Adrien: Do you think I could talk to Dr. Psiquat about... my father?
Marinette: Your father? Why? You can talk to me about him, right?
Adrien: Yes, of course, you're right.
Alya: Talking to Dr. Psiquat's different, Marinette. She's someone from the outside with specific skills to help.
Marinette: I help him! I'm his girlfriend, you know.

title: Wreckless Driver/Transcript
text:
Wreckless Driver/Transcript - Intro
Alya: I know, but that's not the point. How can I put this...okay, let's say we're in a video game.
(A Pac-man style video game is shown on screen, with Adrien being stuck in a maze and Alya voicing over what's happening in the video game.)
Alya: Adrien is trapped in a maze being chased by a ghost. You can face the ghost and temporarily help Adrien, but the ghost will always come back.
(The video game now shows Marinette shooting arrows at the ghost, but it always comes back, and more ghosts start appearing as well.)
Alya: Until Adrien figures out why he can't face the ghost he'll be stuck in the maze. Dr. Psiquat can help him find the exit by guiding him from the outside.
(The video game ends with Dr. Psiquat helping Adrien exit outside the maze through some stairs, making the game disappear.)
Alya: See what I mean?
Adrien: I think... I do. And I'd like to try.
Alya: It doesn't mean you're not helpful, Adrien can talk to both of you. But you'll be there to support Adrien while Dr. Psiquat will heal him.
(Marinette and Adrien smile at each other.)
Dr. Psiquat: We can stop for now if you feel like you need a break.
Aglaé: No. I want to keep going.

title: Wreckless Driver/Transcript
text:
Wreckless Driver/Transcript - Intro
Dr. Psiquat: Alright, you were saying 'that's when they showed up.' Who are...they?
(Aglaé continues to voice over the events that happened  in the flashback.)
Aglaé: They asked me what was wrong. I told them I was scared of butterflies. They said that they would help me, that they'd walk into the greenhouse with me.
(Nelson opens the door to the greenhouse while Ray gestures for her to go inside. Aglaé walks in but Nelson closes the door behind her, making the trio of bullies laugh. Aglaé looks terrified at the butterflies flying around her.)
Aglaé: They closed the door behind me, and I was suddenly all alone. I could've walked back out but I couldn't think straight, I don't know why I- I was completely frozen, and the butterflies were flying towards me and among them there was...
(An Ultrakuma enters her bottle of essential oils.)
Dr. Psiquat: There was an Ultrakuma, is that it?

title: Wreckless Driver/Transcript
text:
Wreckless Driver/Transcript - Intro
Aglaé: Strange voices spoke to me, and I knew right away that there was a new villain in Paris, that someone had gotten their hands on the butterfly miraculous lost by Ladybug and that this someone was even scarier than the one before them. They said that they'd help me show people who make fun of my fears how dangerous butterflies can be. I accepted, and I don't remember anything that happened next, like everyone who's been akumatized. But people told me and there are videos online, so I still have these mental images.
Dr. Psiqutat: What kind of images?
Aglaé: I saw videos of me where I'm barely recognizable.
(Aglaé voices over the events that happen in the flashback.)
Aglaé: I looked like a huge butterfly, and I was attacking the boys who had made fun of me.
(Lady Butterfly shoots beams at Ray, Loïc, and Nelson, who are then trapped in cocoons.)
Aglaé: I was told that I'd call myself Lady Butterfly and that I'd trap people inside cocoons. But I didn't stop at the three boys, from what I heard I went after everyone in Paris.
(Lady Butterfly starts trapping random citizens in cocoons.)
Aglaé: Next, according to witnesses, Ladybug and The Miraculers showed up and saved me.

title: Wreckless Driver/Transcript
text:
Wreckless Driver/Transcript - Intro
(Ladybug, Cat Noir, and Pegasus run up to the villain. Pegasus uses a Voyage portal to teleport the beam back at Lady Butterfly and trap her in a cocoon, dropping her akumatized object. Ladybug then breaks the object with her yo-yo and catches the Ultrakuma.)
Dr. Psiquat: So, the whole story didn't end so badly. Ladybug saved you and everyone was freed.
(Ladybug throws her Lucky Charm object, a butterfly net, into the air to trigger a Miraculous Ladybug. The magic ladybugs repair all the damage caused by Lady Butterfly.)
Aglaé: Yes, but I could get akumatized again. I'm so scared all the time, and I know that makes me even more vulnerable.
Dr. Psiquat: This fear precisely, it's quite significant, why were you so scared of getting akumatized even before it happened to you?
(Aglaé shows her a photo of the Eiffel Tower, with seemingly nothing in front of it.)
Aglaé: Because of Timebreaker.
Dr. Psiquat: What am I supposed to see in this photo?
Aglaé: Me!
Dr. Psiquat: But... you're not in the photo, Aglaé.
Aglaé: I am! She made me disappear!
Dr. Psiquat: And how did you feel about that?
Aglaé: As I was disappearing, I completely lost track of time.

title: Wreckless Driver/Transcript
text:
Wreckless Driver/Transcript - Intro
(Visuals shows a younger Aglaé, frozen and slowly disappearing.)
Aglaé: I- I didn't know if seconds or months were passing. I was scared that soon... I would no longer exist.
(Visuals now show the sky from Aglaé's point of view, also starting to disappear into a white screen.)
Aglaé: That I've never see my friends again, or my family. That I would no longer be able to do any of the things I want to do.
Dr. Psiquat: (Holding out a box of tissues) But that time too Ladybug fixed everything, didn't she?
Aglaé: Yes, and when the magic ladybugs repaired everything, I thought I'd be able to enjoy life again, even more than before.
(Visuals show Ladybug repairing the damage, turning Timebreaker back into Alix and bringing back the disappearing people.)
Aglaé: But a few days later a butterfly landed on me and that's when it all started. I used to love them, but now I was terrified of them.
(Visuals show Aglaé looking scared at a butterfly landing on her, before the rest of the screen fills up with purple butterflies.)
Aglaé: I went home and I shut myself in my room, I was too scared of something bad happening to me.

title: Wreckless Driver/Transcript
text:
Wreckless Driver/Transcript - Intro
(Visuals show Aglaé shutting herself in her room while sobbing. The windows fill up with purple butterflies.)
Dr. Psiquat: Thank you for telling me all this, Aglaé. Now, what we're going to try is to, so to speak, de-evilize you like Ladybug did when you were akumatized. Except she did it for you, I'm going to need you to do it for yourself.
Aglaé: What do you mean?
Dr. Psiquat: Here's what I propose in our next session, we'll do an exercise and-
Aglaé: Hold on. What next session? Won't I be healed today?
Dr. Psiquat: Oh, I'm afraid not. Healing depends on the road ahead and on the vehicle you're traveling in. Try to have patience.
Aglaé: But that's not possible! I can't wait, I can't stay like this!
Dr. Psiquat: It's good to be eager, but-
Aglaé: I was told that if I came here and talked, I would feel better!
Dr. Psiquat: Therapy isn't a magic solution, it requires time. I suggest that when you feel ready, we'll go back to the butterfly house together so we can help you overcome your fears.
(Aglaé starts hyperventilating.)
Dr. Psiquat: Your friends can come help and-
Aglaé: No! I need you to help me right now, you said you would do it like Ladybug!

title: Wreckless Driver/Transcript
text:
Wreckless Driver/Transcript - Intro
Dr. Psiquat: It- what I meant was...
Aglaé: What is the point of coming here and spilling my guts if you won't help me! You're useless!
(She throws the toy car on the ground, breaking it.)
Dr. Psiquat: Now, I understand you're angry but come back, let's talk about it calmly-
Aglaé: No! I've talked enough already and nothing's changed. I'm never coming back!
(Aglaé runs out of the room crying, heading to the elevator. Alya notices something is wrong.)
Marinette: Was that Aglaé?
(The group gasp and quickly run out, Markov flying behind them.)
Alya: She took the elevator!
(The group run down the stairs.)
''(An Ultrakuma flies throw the window and enters the pieces of the toy car.)
Chrysalis: Hello. Forgive my intrusion. I couldn't help but sense some kind of frustration in you. Do you feel guilty that you couldn't help the girl?
Dr. Psiquat: No, get out of my head! You're trying to use my emotions to manipulate me, but I'll never help you hurt people!
Chrysalis: I understand your reaction. There are many misunderstandings about me. Unlike what you'd want to believe I'm trying to help people not hurt them. Wouldn't you desire a magical solution that could heal people for example?

title: Wreckless Driver/Transcript
text:
Wreckless Driver/Transcript - Intro
Dr. Psiquat: There is no such thing as a magical solution!
Chrysalis: And yet that's what Ladybug does, doesn't she? Magically fixing everything with a swing of her yo-yo? Thanks to me you could do the same and put an end to peoples needless suffering.
(A mini Chrysalis appears in the toy car Dr. Psiquat is holding.)
Chrysalis: I can sense your hesitation and perhaps you're right, people should find their paths on their own. Who cares if they suffer for months, sometimes years on end? I'll leave you be.
(Chrysalis walks away from her victim and disappears.)
Dr. Psiquat: No, wait! I... I'll give it a try.
Chrysalis: You will? In that case, what should I call you?
Dr. Psiquat: Wreckless Driver!
(Chrysalis closes her palm.)
(Dr. Psiquat starts transforming into Wreckless Driver.)
Marinette: Aglaé! Aglaé, what happened?
Aglaé: This was never a good idea. I can't be healed. I'm going home and shutting myself away forever, there's nothing that can be done!
Max: The first session is an unexceptional experience in seven out of ten cases, it doesn't mean you should stop.

title: Wreckless Driver/Transcript
text:
Wreckless Driver/Transcript - Intro
(Surprising everyone, Wreckless Driver's car suddenly bursts out of the building and lands on the street. Everyone except Marinette, Adrien, and Aglaé run away.)
Wreckless Driver: Aglaé, come back! I can heal you instantly now just like you wanted.
Aglaé: (Gasps) No, you've been akumatized!
(Aglaé rides on her bike while Wreckless Driver follows her in her car. Marinette quickly puts on a helmet and takes a bike.)
Adrien: What are you doing?
Marinette: I'm going to try to help Aglaé. I'll be super careful, I promise.
(She rides on the bike to hide between buildings.)
Marinette: I think it's best to cut Dr. Psiquat's session short for today. Tikki, spots on! (transforms into Ladybug.)
(Adrien runs into a hiding spot between buildings.)
Plagg: Don't tell me, you want to play Cat Noir and rescue your girlfriend.
Adrien: Precisely! Plagg, claws out! (transforms into Cat Noir.)
(Aglaé is still driving away while being chased by the villain. Wreckless Driver then presses a button that releases a helmet, pulling Aglaé into the car as she screams.)
Wreckless Driver: Hm, quite significant. You do have a phobia of insects, and more specifically these awful butterflies. I'll fix it for you.

title: Wreckless Driver/Transcript
text:
Wreckless Driver/Transcript - Intro
(The helmet transfers Aglaé's phobias into a giant container.)
Wreckless Driver: There. You are now de-evilized and free from all your fears.
(The villain pulls a lever that springs Aglaé's seat up and ejects her from the car.)
Aglaé: Thanks to Wreckless Driver I'm no longer scared of anything. Woohoo!
Ladybug: Uh... okay, still stay here it's safer.
Aglaé: But there's no danger, she healed me. How amazing!
Ladybug: Yeah, well, she still needs to be deakumatized.
Aglaé: (Sighs) If you must. But it's a shame, she's a great superhero too.
(Ladybug opens the Miraculous Call system on her yo-yo and clicks on Cat Noir's icon. The paw print on Cat Noir's staff starts glowing to alert him of the summon while he's running on the rooftops. He opens the staff to send a message to Ladybug.)
Cat Noir: I'm on the akumatized villains track, M'lady. Huh?
(A man is sprung out of Wreckless Driver's car, cheering. Cat Noir catches him as a parachute appears on the man to slow their descent.)
Cat Noir: Two safety measures are always better than one.
Man: No need for safety, Cat Noir. I used to be afraid of cars but not anymore! (He grabs a chair and starts sitting in the middle of the street.)

title: Wreckless Driver/Transcript
text:
Wreckless Driver/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: You can't stay here, sir.
Man: Why not? This is where the sun is.
Cat Noir: True, but it's also where cars are.
Man: That's okay. Drivers have eyes, they'll avoid me.
(A car narrowly swerves out of the way.)
Cat Noir: I'm sorry but I can't let you take this kind of risk.
(Cat Noir folds the chair with the man inside and takes it to a park. He then leaves to join Ladybug, Pegasus, and Purple Tigress on a rooftop.)
Cat Noir: Hey, team!
Pegasus: Voyage!
(He throws portals in front of the speeding car, but Wreckless Driver avoids all of them.)
Purple Tigress: Clout!
(She punches the street sending the car flying but it lands correctly and keeps driving away while the villain laughs. Purple Tigress glares and snarls in frustration as she watches the villain escape. Ladybug then swings in front of the car and throws out her yo-yo, but the car spins and avoids it.)
Wreckless Driver: Are you afraid of me, Ladybug? Hmm, quite significant.
Ladybug: Of course I'm not. We just have to stop you! (She ties her yo-yo to a part of the car and lands on top of it, then hangs on for dear life as Wreckless Driver tries to throw her off with violent swerving.)

title: Wreckless Driver/Transcript
text:
Wreckless Driver/Transcript - Intro
Wreckless Driver: But you're not sure whether it's the right thing to do?
Ladybug: I am. You can't speed up solutions like this without there being some other price to pay. Sometimes meaningful help takes time.
Wreckless Driver: Are you sure?
(Cat Noir lands in front of the car and extends his staff between two buildings, creating an obstacle that should stop the car. Wreckless Driver speeds up and presses a button, making the car spring forward above the staff.)
Cat Noir: She's going to drive us buggy!
Wreckless Driver: That's quite a significant observation. We could go for some group therapy!
(Pegasus appears through another portal while Purple Tigress jumps down, both chasing the villain.)
Ladybug: I'd rather go for a...
[Superpower Sequence ]Ladybug: Lucky Charm!(She gets a sandwich.)
Ladybug: Uh... okay, not sure this will help.
(A bunch of Polymouse's clones appear covering the front window of Wreckless Driver's car, obscuring her view.)
Wreckless Driver: What in the world is all this?!

title: Wreckless Driver/Transcript
text:
Wreckless Driver/Transcript - Intro
(She uses her windshield wiper to get the clones off but sees she's about to crash into the wall of a maze, forcing her to quickly and recklessly drive to avoid hitting the walls, not knowing the maze is a Mirage cast by Rena Rogue who's making parts of the maze appear and disappear by tracing them out with her flute.)
Ladybug: Those are some awesome illusions, Rena!
(Wreckless Driver is still struggling trying to drive around the maze.)
Ladybug: Pegasus, we need your portals.
Pegasus: Voyage!
(Wreckless Driver gets out of the illusion-maze but speeds up into a voyage portal, teleporting her into a river.)
Cat Noir: Looks like it's bathtime. (Eats a Magicamembert) Power up! (Trasnforms into Aquanoir and dives into the water.)
Ladybug: (Through earpiece) The Ultrakuma must be in the car, Kitty Cat.
Aquanoir: Worth a try, M'lady. Cata-
(A helmet comes out of the car and grabs Aquanoir under water, pulling him into the car as he screams.)
Ladybug: Cat Noir? Everything okay?
Wreckless Driver: Let's see what you're afraid of, Cat.
(The cars scanner scans the hero and shows his fear of revealing his secret identity.)

title: Wreckless Driver/Transcript
text:
Wreckless Driver/Transcript - Intro
Wreckless Driver: Oh, of course, revealing your secret identity. Quite significant. Well, time to de-evilize.
(The helmet transfers his phobias into a giant container.)
Wreckless Driver: There. You are now de-evilized and free - (gasps as she's suddenly stopped from pulling the lever) What's going on?
Chrysalis: (voice) It's fine, Wreckless Driver. I'm just helping you.
(Chrysalis blows into her palm and releases an Antikuma out of Wreckless Driver, hitting Aquanoir and depriving him of his powers.)
Chrysalis: (voice) I've deprived him of his powers, he's at your mercy. You can seize his Miraculous now.
Wreckless Driver: That's not significant at all! I told you I only want to do good.
Chrysalis: (voice) Precisely! If we got our hands on the Cat Miraculous, we'd only need the Ladybug one. Then we can make a wish for people to be freed from their fears all across the world.
Wreckless Driver: Hmm, that would be very significant.
Chrysalis: (voice) Wouldn't it?
(Wreckless Driver goes to grab Cat Noir's Miraculous, but before she can, Ladybug comes in through a Voyage portal.)

title: Wreckless Driver/Transcript
text:
Wreckless Driver/Transcript - Intro
Cat Noir: Ah, M'lady, am I glad to see you. This akumatized villain is amazing, thanks to her I no longer am afraid of revealing my secret identity. I can finally tell you-
Ladybug: (stuffs the sandwich in his mouth) No talking with your mouth full, Kitty Cat.
(Ladybug and Wreckless Driver continue battling in the car. When the villain goes back to try and take Cat Noir's Miraculous again, Ladybug calls on another hero through her earpiece.)
Ladybug: Polymouse!
(A Voyage portal opens above Wreckless Driver. A bunch of Polymouse clones fall out of the portal, climbing all over the villain and obscuring her vision.)
Polymouse: Attack!
(Another Voyage portal opens near the steering wheel, and more Polymouse clones come out. The clones begin to tie Wreckless Driver up with their skip ropes. Another Antikuma is released through Wreckless Driver and is about to hit Ladybug, but a mini Polymouse quickly deflects it with her skip rope, saving Ladybug from being cut off from her powers as Cat Noir is. Ladybug unbuckles Cat Noir.)
Ladybug: Whenever you're ready, Purple Tigress!
Purple Tigress: Clout!

title: Wreckless Driver/Transcript
text:
Wreckless Driver/Transcript - Intro
(She punches the river, launching the water and the car up into the air, emptying the river and making the car fall back down into an empty space with rain.)
Purple Tigress: Clout!
(She punches the car, completely destroying it and knocking the villain out. Ladybug, Cat Noir, and Polymouse, who were inside it as well, emerge unharmed and regroup with Rena Rouge, Pegasus, and Purple Tigress.)
Rena Rouge: Why hasn't she transformed back?
Ladybug: I don't see an Ultrakuma which means it wasn't in the car. (Gasps) Maybe it was something inside the car.
(She looks around and spots the miniature toy car. Wreckless Driver wakes up and runs over to try and grab it, but Ladybug quickly crushes the toy under her foot.)
Wreckless Driver: No!
Ladybug: No more evil doing for you, ultrakuma! (She opens up her yoyo.) Time to de-evilize! (She catches the ultrakuma.) Gotcha! Bye bye, little butterfly! (She releases the butterfly, then she takes the sandwich out of Cat Noir's mouth.)
Cat Noir: I'm A-
(Ladybug puts a finger over his mouth to shush him.)
Ladybug: Miraculous Ladybug!

title: Wreckless Driver/Transcript
text:
Wreckless Driver/Transcript - Intro
(All the damage caused by the villain is reversed, and Wreckless Driver turns back into Dr. Psiquat. Ladybug pulls a Magical Charm out of her yo-yo and gives it to her.)
Ladybug: This Magical Charm will help you remember that you should believe in yourself. You're a good therapist, I'm sure you've helped a lot of people. People who've had family problems, phobias, or communication issues. You never needed a magical solution because you already know how to de-evilize people for good, even though it can take a while sometimes.
Dr. Psiquat: Thank you, Ladybug.
The Miraculers: Pound it!
Cerise: You will tell me your secret in the end, Ladybug. And when you do, it won't be the way you think.
Aglaé: I'm sorry, it's my fault you got akumatized.
Dr. Psiquat: No, it's not. I let my own emotions get the better of me. Besides, it's over now.
Aglaé: But I'm still afraid.
Dr. Psiquat: Fear can be a good thing, it teaches us to be cautious and not put ourselves in danger. But in your case, fear of insects has become a phobia that keeps you from enjoying your life. That's why we're here with your friends to help you feel better.
(The group of friends form a circle around Aglaé.)

title: Wreckless Driver/Transcript
text:
Wreckless Driver/Transcript - Intro
Dr. Psiquat: Go as far as you want and stop anytime you want, okay?
Aglaé: Mhmm.
(She takes a deep breath and slowly walks into the greenhouse, her friends still forming a protective circle around her. She looks fondly at the butterflies but still gets scared when one gets near her face, making her breathing heavy.)
Marinette: Do you want to go back out?
Aglaé: Yes.
Dr. Psiquat: That's an excellent start, Aglaé. And now you know no matter how long it takes you won't be alone to travel your path. You've found a wonderful vehicle: friendship.
Adrien: Thanks for coming with me, and for understanding my need to talk to Dr. Psiquat.
Marinette: Of course.
Dr. Psiquat: Adrien Agreste?
(Adrien gives Marinette a kiss and stands up to leave with Dr. Psiquat.)
Dr. Psiquat: So, what do you need to talk about, Adrien?
Adrien: There's something... strange about my father.
es:Psicoconductora/Transcripción

title: Yaksi Gozen/Transcript
text:
Yaksi Gozen/Transcript - Intro
(Tomoe Tsurugi is talking to Monarch while watching the Miraculized victims.)
Monarch: Hah... hah... Ladybug is still here, I can feel it! She must have transformed back! She's vulnerable! Make sure that the others keep looking for Cat Noir, I'm going to give a personal, proper welcome to Ladybug. Stompp, your power is now mine! (Absorbs the Kwami into his Ox Miraculous ring.)
Tomoe: Gabriel-san, don't put yourself at risk for nothing. Just let the plan unfold and we'll-
Monarch: (Scoffs) Let me be, Tsurugi-san! I know what I'm doing. Fortunately, I won't be needing you much longer.
(Tomoe gasps as the screen in front of her completely shuts off.)
Tomoe: Kagami.
(She takes out her phone and calls someone.)
Unknown person: Yes?
Tomoe: Gabriel has cut me off the system. His obsession may cause us to lose everything. Go to his mansion, be my eyes and arms.
(With a yell of anger, Tomoe slams her fist down on the control table in front of her, knocking over her bokken in the process.)
[ Theme Song ]
Sabine: Have a nice day, sir.
Marinette: Wait!
(Marinette runs in with her own bag of chouquettes with a drawing of her on the bag.)

title: Yaksi Gozen/Transcript
text:
Yaksi Gozen/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: Hello! (awkward giggle) Sorry, um, these ones are special. They're for Adrien. (Placide winks and exits the bakery.)''
Sabine: What surprise have you come up with this time, Marinette?
Marinette: I'll tell you but only after I'm sure it's worked.
(Adrien takes a bite out of a chouquette and finds a piece of paper inside, which he unfolds to reveal a drawing of...)
Adrien: A bird house?
(Adrien takes a bite of another chouquette, this time finding a bag of bird seeds inside.)
Adrien: A bag of seeds...
(He takes a bite of another chouquette and finds a bird whistle inside.)
Adrien: And a bird whistle... I've got it!
(He takes out a couple of seeds and blows into the whistle, causing a dove to fly out of the birdhouse and in his hand.)
Adrien: Hello, pretty dove.
(Around the dove's foot is a piece of paper with a heart on it. Adrien takes the paper before the dove flies away and unfolds it to reveal a written message from Marinette.)
Marinette: Have a good day, I love you! Marinette.
Adrien: (Chuckles and takes out his phone to record a message) Thanks for the surprise, Marinette. I love you too.
Adrien: (recording) Thanks for the surprise, Marinette. I love you too.

title: Yaksi Gozen/Transcript
text:
Yaksi Gozen/Transcript - Intro
(Marinette delightfully squeals and spins around in her chair.)
Tikki: You really are the superhero of surprises.
Adrien: Marinette is so wonderful. She always does amazingly creative things for me like this surprise while... the only thing I can do is send her a voice message.
Plagg: No one expects a cheesemaker to be great at sewing too, yet everyone knows that cheesemakers are exceptional beings.
Adrien: Of course! You're right, Plagg.
Plagg: I know.
Kagami: So? What do you think?
Félix: When we talked about finding a hiding place I thought of a lot of spots, but never this.
Kagami: Believe me, it's the safest option. 愛してるね ("I love you" in Japanese. Kagami makes half a heart on the screen-mirror.)
Félix: Love you too. (Completes the heart.)
(Kagami swipes the screen away and leaves the bathroom.)
Tutorial video: Loosen the stitch in the tip of the needle by pulling the working end. You'll need enough stitches to-
Plagg: If I had mentioned mechanics would you have built her a moped?
Adrien: No, Plagg, I chose knitting because Marinette is passionate about fashion design, and I'm sure she won't be expecting this surprise.
Marinette: Mm... Oh, it's a towel! A hand towel?

title: Yaksi Gozen/Transcript
text:
Yaksi Gozen/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: Uhh... No, Marinette, actually it's a... a t-shirt.
Marinette: Oh, right, of course it's a t-shirt! These bigger holes are for arms. This is so surprising, Adrien, that's so nice of you. Thank you.
(Marinette hugs him, but Adrien looks down in sadness.)
Kagami: Mother, I'm going out.
Tomoe: What about your Ikebana class?
Kagami: We've discussed this. I'm no longer wasting time making boring flower arrangements.
Tomoe: You'd rather waste your time with that boy?
Kagami: Félix isn't just a boy.
Longg: They love each other, and love won't wait.
Tomoe: After all I've done for you, after everything I've lost, (slams her bowl down and stands up) How can you put your life in the hands of a monster who could be rid of you with a snap of his fingers?!
Kagami: Félix would never do that! (Walks up to her mother) He's helping me find meaning to my life instead of trying to control it like you always did. The only monster here isn't Félix or me, it's you!

title: Yaksi Gozen/Transcript
text:
Yaksi Gozen/Transcript - Intro
Tomoe: Insolent girl. Whether you like it or not, you are a Tsurugi! (She starts trying to forcefully take the real Kagami's ring and not a fake one this time) You're not worthy of wearing our family ring. You'll earn it back again when you respect our values!
Kagami: Longg, bring the storm! (Transforms into Ryuko)
(Ryuko instantly summons her wind powers to blow her mother away from her and place her on a pillow.)
Ryuko: You're the one who hasn't kept her promise, mother.
Tomoe: I allowed you to go to school!
Ryuko: And I saved you from HUMILIATION!!! (Lightning crackles all around her, breaking apart the room and making pieces float in the air around her.) You were Monarch's accomplice, remember?! If it weren't for me, Ladybug would've brought you to justice! But I promised her that you'd change, and she trusted me! Enough to hide what you and Gabriel Agreste did from the whole world! Enough to leave me the Dragon Miraculous knowing I live under THE SAME ROOF AS YOU!!!!
(Her wind powers emerge and push all the floating objects surrounded by lightning out. Water droplets also appear in the air. She starts calming down and all the floating pieces slowly fall to the floor.)

title: Yaksi Gozen/Transcript
text:
Yaksi Gozen/Transcript - Intro
Ryuko: I should stop loving you for everything you've done. But I can't. Adrien has lost his father forever. (Tomoe's expression softens upon hearing this, now looking concerned and worried, before Ryuko helps her back up into a sitting position) Do you realize how lucky we are to still have each other? Please, don't ruin everything. (Short pause. Tomoe's eyebrows are furrowed in her normal stern expression as she thinks things over.) Wind Dragon.
(Ryuko turns into a gust of wind and flies out of the apartment through the open balcony, leaving Tomoe alone in the destroyed room.)
Adrien: I'm not as creative as Marinette. But this cake is bound to help me measure up.
(Adrien puts his burnt cake on the table with a smile, Plagg has an unsure expression)
Plagg: Do you really want to give a cake to a baker's daughter?
(Adrien realizes Plagg is right and looks down)
Adrien: You're right... why would you want a cake from me when she can have all she wants at home, the best in Paris. But then, what could make her happy?.
Plagg: I have an idea.
Adrien: Hm?
Woman: What is he doing with that large chunk of meat?
(Adrien laughs uncomfortably.)
Adrien: Are you really sure about this?

title: Yaksi Gozen/Transcript
text:
Yaksi Gozen/Transcript - Intro
(Plagg peeks out from Adrien's jacket.)
Plagg: Absolutely, Beef rib is a no brainer when it comes to romance a la France.
Dog: Woof woof!
(A dog appears out of nowhere and steals Adrien's beef rib.)
Adrien: U-Uh?! Hey! (The dog jumps over the park's fence, fleeing with the ribs) I think I'm going to need another idea.
Plagg: Or just another beef rib.
(Tomoe sits in the middle of the room, takes off her glasses, looks down, and pinches her nose in exasperation. Then she lifts her head, takes a deep breath, and opens her eyes, revealing robotic eyes.)
(Tomoe sits at her table. In the corner, Kagami is behind a changing wall changing clothes as her school uniform is being draped over the top of it. Tomoe's cellphone rings, revealing it to be Gabriel calling. Tomoe walks over to the windows to be out of earshot of Kagami before answering.)
Gabriel: Tsurugi-san.
Tomoe: Gabriel-san. I knew you'd call for my help eventually.
Gabriel: Ladybug and Cat Noir are stronger than I anticipated.
Tomoe: Or rather you are too weak.
Gabriel: There are two of them and I'm just one, but with your help I could repair the Peacock Miraculous, then Nathalie could join me.

title: Yaksi Gozen/Transcript
text:
Yaksi Gozen/Transcript - Intro
Tomoe: That's out of the question! I'm never touching that wrenched Miraculous again! The price I paid to have Kagami using its magic was high enough! As for you, I thought losing your wife would have brought you to your senses... Playing supervillains. You're disgracing yourself, Gabriel.
Gabriel: Tomoe, if you help me obtain Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous we'll make the wish together. I'll get my wife back and you'll get your eyes back.
Tomoe: That would mean betraying The Kingdom.
Gabriel: Are you having qualms? I wasn't aware of such weakness in you.
Tomoe: How can I be sure you won't betray me as well?
Gabriel: What proof of my loyalty do you need?
(Tomoe looks over at a dead bonsai tree and scroll with Japanese written on it before replying)
Tomoe: I've been disappointed by men my entire life. I want Kagami to grow up to have a prince charming as perfect as she is: smart, strong, handsome, and obedient.
Gabriel: Someone like my son?

title: Yaksi Gozen/Transcript
text:
Yaksi Gozen/Transcript - Intro
Tomoe: Perhaps. Let's introduce them first. If your lineage proves worthy of uniting with mine, I might consider helping you. (She hangs up before going over to where Kagami emerges from the changing wall, now wearing her fencing outfit. Tomoe dusts some residue off the shoulder before commenting on Kagami's appearance.)
Tomoe: Perfect. (Kagami turns to go behind the changing wall again) Kagami.
Kagami: (pauses) Yes, mother?
Tomoe: How would you like to move to Paris?
Kagami: (surprised) Hmm?
Cerise: (suddenly appears, snapping Tomoe out from the flashback) Hello, mother. Forgive my intrusion, but I've sensed your disappointment so I thought I'd pay you a little visit. Nooroo, dark wings rise. (transforms into the true form of Chrysalis after being a silhouette. In the meantime, Tomoe puts her sunglasses back on after being brought back to reality by Cerise's interruption.)
Chrysalis: Kagami was so perfect, it must be so painful to feel your favorite daughter escape from your grasp... Luckily, I am here.
Tomoe: What do you want, Lila?
Chrysalis: To help you. (Kisses Tomoe's cheek) It must be hard playing the kind mother.

title: Yaksi Gozen/Transcript
text:
Yaksi Gozen/Transcript - Intro
Tomoe: You know as well as I do that I have no choice if I want my freedom.
Chrysalis: Ah... Things would be so much easier if Kagami obeyed you again, wouldn't they?
Tomoe: As long as Kagami bears the ring holding the amok that I used to give birth to her, I can not control her. She will do whatever she wants.
Chrysalis: You might not be able to control her, but you could control the company she keeps. Would you like to hear about the plan I've devised?
Chrysalis: First, I'll Akumatize you. Once you've become a supervillain, you'll capture Félix. I'll be waiting for Félix inside your armor, since Félix too like Kagami is connected to the magic of an amok, the only thing left for me to do would be to seize the object of control... his signet ring.
Chrysalis (in the plan) : From now on, you will be a spy within The Miraculers, you'll give us all the information we need to seize Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous.Félix (in the plan, somberly): At your command.

title: Yaksi Gozen/Transcript
text:
Yaksi Gozen/Transcript - Intro
Chrysalis: Once I've replaced his ring with a forgery, you'll drop me off in a quiet place. Then you'll pretend you've seen the error of your ways, and in a final effort you'll reject the Ultrakuma and apologize to Kagami telling her...
Tomoe (in the plan): I've realized my errors Kagami, and from now on I will let you live your life with Félix.
Chrysalis: Kagami will be happy to be reunited with her boyfriend, except he will no longer be her Félix, but our Félix. You can no longer control your daughter, but you'll be able to control her boyfriend.
Tomoe: How do I know you'll stick to your word this time?
Chrysalis: I'm only doing what's in your best interest.
(Félix and Kagami lock eyes and run to embrace each other. After hugging the moment is broken by Kagami's phone ringing)
Kagami: Ugh... it's my mother again.
Félix: Something wrong?
Kagami: (Kagami ends the call.) Everything's fine now that you're here.
(Kagami grabs Félix's hand and pulls him to run alongside her.)
Félix: Are you sure Marinette will agree?
Kagami: Can you imagine Marinette refusing to help someone?
Félix: Ha ha! Of course, you're right!
(Both chuckle while running side by side)

title: Yaksi Gozen/Transcript
text:
Yaksi Gozen/Transcript - Intro
Tikki: What a strange object Marinette, what is it for?
Marinette: It's a special hanger for Adrien's special T-shirt!
Tikki: This T-shirt would be perfect for someone with 4 arms.
Marinette: It's the thought that counts Tikki. (Marinette receives a call through her earrings from the Dragon and Peacock Miraculous.) Ryuko? Argos?
Tikki: Why do they want to see you?
Marinette: We're about to find out.
(Ryuko and Argos enter Marinette's room through the balcony hatch.)
Ryuko: We need you, Marinette.
Marinette: What's going on?
Ryuko: You know our secret. You know that our mothers carried us like any children, but since they used the Peacock Miraculous, our existences are bound by its magic, which makes us especially vulnerable.
Argos: Whoever has the Peacock Miraculous has the power of life and death over every being created by its magic. Now that I'm the holder, we know for sure no one will use it for evil. No one can destroy us with a snap of their fingers.
Marinette: But then, what's the problem?
Ryuko: Storm subsides.
Argos: Fold my feathers.
(Ryuko and Argos power down back into Kagami and Felix)

title: Yaksi Gozen/Transcript
text:
Yaksi Gozen/Transcript - Intro
(Tikki, Longg, and Duusu happily greet each other and go to the other side of the room to play)
Félix: The problem, Marinette, is our rings. The amok holding the magic of the Peacock Miraculous was deposited into them.
(Visuals show amoks coming out of the Peacock Miraculous and entering Félix and Kagami's rings.)
Kagami: If someone were to seize them, we would have no choice but to obey them.(Visuals show a hand wearing both rings controlling Félix and Kagami like puppets.)
Félix: If they got damaged, we'd become seriously ill.
Kagami: And if they got destroyed, we'd disappear.
Félix: Living with this knowledge is...
Marinette: I get it. You need me to put them somewhere safe, right?
Félix: Yes Marinette, that's right.(Kagami's phone starts ringing but she declines the call.)
Kagami: We've considered everything. Burying them in an isolated place...
Félix: But it's risky in case of future excavations or construction.
Kagami: Locking them in a safe in the bank...
Félix: It could be stolen.
Kagami: Even sending them into space wouldn't be a solution.
Félix: Cosmic radiation could damage them.

title: Yaksi Gozen/Transcript
text:
Yaksi Gozen/Transcript - Intro
Kagami: And since we're also superheroes, we're running the risk of enemies battling us for them.
Marinette: But you are here to see me because you already came out with a solution, haven't you?
Kagami: Yes, magic.
Félix: Your yo-yo's magic.
Dusuu: This is very clever! Good job.
Tikki: Indeed, once immersed in the field of possibilities of Ladybug's yo-yo the rings could return to a quantic state.
Longg: Of course! And the only person in the universe who could access them would be...
Kwamis: Ladybug!
Marinette: Hold on! Hold on! Explain it to me again like I'm 5 years old.
Tikki: It means the rings would be stored in a form of magic puree in your yo-yo.
Marinette: And there'd no risk of turning Kagami and Félix into puree too, right?
Tikki: There'd be absolutely no risk for them since the rings would still exist, but in the form of probabilities.
Marinette: Ooookay....
Kagami: And when you're not Ladybug, it'd be completely inaccessible. No Ladybug, no yo-yo. No yo-yo, no stealing the rings!
Félix: It's a good idea, isn't it?
Marinette: I don't know, for a while I kept all the Miraculous with me in my Yo-yo, but that didn't stop Shadow Moth from stealing them from me.

title: Yaksi Gozen/Transcript
text:
Yaksi Gozen/Transcript - Intro
Félix: (looks away guiltily) That wasn't your fault...
Kagami: (puts a hand on Félix's shoulder) There will always be a risk, but if there's one person who always finds a solution, it's you, Ladybug.
Marinette: Tikki, spots on! (Transforms into Ladybug and pulls out her yo-yo, opening it to place the rings inside)Ladybug: I'm touched by your trust, even though this is great responsibility... You're entrusting me with your lives.
Kagami: You can decline, we don't want to force your hand.
Ladybug: No, it's okay. I want to help you.
Tom: Marinette!(Hearing her father, Ladybug is startled and panics, dropping the rings on the floor)Ladybug: Aaaaah!
Sabine: There's a surprise guest for you! Huh?(She, Tom and Adrien open up the door and are surprised to find Felix and Kagami standing there, unknowingly covering for Marinette as she powers down from Ladybug behind them so her cover is not blown)Adrien: Kagami? Félix? What are you doing here?
Tom: We didn't even see you come in.
Sabine: Where's Marinette?
Marinette: (having transformed back from Ladybug) I'm right here! (Laughs awkwardly)Adrien: Ah! Great! I hope you're ready because I have another surprise for you!
Marinette: Uh, now?

title: Yaksi Gozen/Transcript
text:
Yaksi Gozen/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: TA-DA! A beef rib!
Marinette: That's not a beef rib, those are lamb chops.
Adrien: I know, but the butcher was out of beef ribs.
Marinette: Oookay?
Tom: With some garlic and rosemary these will be delicious! (takes the lamb chops and leaves the room with Sabine)Adrien: (to Félix and Kagami) I still can't figure out why you're here.
Marinette, Kagami and Félix: (panicked)THE RINGS!
Adrien: What rings?
Kagami: (pushes Félix forward) You tell him!
Félix: (awkwardly) You know we have these old family rings, (Adrien nods) and Kagami and I thought these old rings... Uh...
Adrien: You thought that...?
Félix: That we'd ask Marinette to help us hide them.
Adrien: Hide them? But why would you want to hide them?(Kagami takes Félix's place in explaining the situation to Adrien)Kagami: We want to hide them because it's romantic!
Adrien: Romantic?
Kagami: Yes, I read it in a manga. Wanting to give a gift to their future unborn children, the two sweethearts hid cherished objects of theirs together.
Adrien: Oh! and where do they hide them?
Kagami: In... uh... some... puree?

title: Yaksi Gozen/Transcript
text:
Yaksi Gozen/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: And... that's romantic?(Marinette takes Kagami's place)Marinette: No! Not at all! Puree is a terrible idea! So that's why Kagami and Félix came to see me! To come up with a better puree- I mean, a better idea than the one in the manga!
Adrien: Aaah, what's your idea then?
Marinette: I-I'll tell you, but first you've got to help us find the rings because no rings mean no hiding place and no hiding place means no idea.
Adrien:(finds the rings under his shoe) Ahh! They were right there, look!
Marinette, Kagami and Félix: (relieved) THE RINGS!
Adrien: Watch this, Marinette! I might not be the best when it comes to knitting or choosing meat, but I can do this! (Blows into his hand and makes the rings disappear, shocking Marinette, Kagami and Félix) Magic.
Marinette: What have you done!?
Félix: Where are the rings!?
Adrien: I watched a magic tutorial online!(Adrien pulls Félix's ring from behind Félix's ear)Adrien: Not bad, huh?
Kagami: What about my ring!?
Adrien: Félix, open your hand.(Félix does as asked and Kagami's ring appears in his palm) TA-DA!

title: Yaksi Gozen/Transcript
text:
Yaksi Gozen/Transcript - Intro
Félix: (angrily) You're being reckless, Adrien! (Adrien is surprised at Félix's outburst) You don't mess with valuables! Give me my ring back!
Adrien: It's just a magic trick, Félix. No need to panic.
Félix: Huh? (Félix suddenly calms down) You're right, everything's fine.(Félix lies down on Marinette's cushions and closes his eyes.) Why am I worried?(Kagami and Marinette look at Adrien holding Félix's ring in shock. The tension is broken by Marinette's phone ringing)Marinette: It's your mother, Kagami.
Kagami: Ugh! (Kagami angrily grabs the phone) Mother, that's enough! I don't want to talk to you right now!
Tomoe: That's fine, Kagami. I just needed to know where you were.
Kagami: Huh?
Marinette and Adrien: Huh?(The room is suddenly sliced open, revealing Yaksi Gozen standing outside.)Yaksi Gozen: Félix Fathom you're a bad influence! You'll never be anywhere near my daughter again! (shoots a beam to Félix which paralyzes him)Kagami: MOTHER NO! FÉLIX!
Yaksi Gozen: And you'll never transform again either! (Picks up Felix and puts him in her stomach hatch, walking away.)''
Kagami: FÉLIX!

title: Yaksi Gozen/Transcript
text:
Yaksi Gozen/Transcript - Intro
Chrysalis: (looks for Félix's ring) Hm... (Gasp) Urg! (Gasp) Urg! (opens his hand only to finds Kagami's ring). This isn't his object of control, it's Kagami's! (Looks through Yaksi Gozen's eyes and spots Adrien with the ring.) Adrien Agreste has Félix's ring!
Yaksi Gozen: Adrien Agreste you too won't be going anywhere near Kagami ever again!
Adrien: No! No! Ms. Tsurugi, you're mistaken! Kagami is just a friend, I'm in love with Marinette!
Yaksi Gozen: I'm not taking any risks believing in Agreste!
(Marinette quickly opens the trapdoor to block another beam, and to let Adrien and Kagami escape through it.)
Sabine: Aren't you two staying for lunch?
Adrien: Sorry, we have a small emergency.
(Yaksi Gozen slices open the roof of the kitchen)
Yaksi Gozen: Where are Kagami and Adrien!?
Tom: Sabine, I-I don't think there'll be enough cutlets for everyone.
Kagami: Don't move, you'll be safe here.
Adrien: But what about you?
Kagami: I'm going to get my mother away from here.
Adrien: Wouldn't it be safer if I kept it? (Kagami takes Félix's ring and puts it on)
Kagami: I'd rather you didn't.

title: Yaksi Gozen/Transcript
text:
Yaksi Gozen/Transcript - Intro
Adrien: Wow! She treats her boyfriend's ring with so much care! Do you think that's what being romantic looks like? Plagg, claws out! (Transforms into Cat Noir.)
Kagami: Mother, I'm here!
Yaksi Gozen: (Sees the ring on Kagami's hand and contacts Chrysalis.) My daughter has Félix's ring now.[Transformation Sequence ]
Kagami: Longg, bring the storm! (transforms into Ryuko)  (Yaksi Gozen grabs Ryuko in her hand, but Ryuko quickly turns into a stream of water to escape.)
Ryuko: Water dragon!
(Ryuko becomes a water version of her normal self, dodging Yaksi Gozen's attacks and jumping into the water.)

Marinette: Kagami and Félix's lives are in danger! Tikki, spots on! (Transforms into Ladybug behind her changing wall.)
Ladybug: Lucky Charm! (Gets a van that begins to fall on top of Yaksi Gozen, but she slices through it)
Yaksi Gozen: Hya!
Ladybug: Come to your senses. Prove to your daughter that you've changed!
Yaksi Gozen: Not while she's with that boy!
Ryuko: (Uses the water around her to become a bigger version of herself and trap her mother by holding her from the arms.) I'm in love with Félix, mother!

title: Yaksi Gozen/Transcript
text:
Yaksi Gozen/Transcript - Intro
Yaksi Gozen: He's not meant for you! He'll end up hurting you. Like Adrien. Like every other boy!
Ryuko: So that's your choice? You want to keep being a supervillain?
Yaksi Gozen: When you get out of control, I must get you on track! That's a mother's job!
Ryuko: You don't choose my path or select who's worthy of my love!
Yaksi Gozen: I am your mother!
Ryuko: Keep that up and soon, I won't be your daughter!
Cat Noir: Cataclysm! (Destroys the villain's sword) Uh!? Where's her Ultrakuma if it's not in there?

(Yaksi Gozen throws Ryuko over her and into the other side of the water, then pretends to fall over in pain, putting her stomach hatch in the water to allow Chrysalis to escape.)

(Chrysalis has made it to a rooftop where she can comfortably watch the fight from a distance.)
Chrysalis: Now.
Yaksi Gozen: No, get out of my head! You won't fool me again! I don't want your wretched power anymore! This is all because I've been akumatized. I'm sorry, Kagami!
Chrysalis: You're perfect. Larger than life.

title: Yaksi Gozen/Transcript
text:
Yaksi Gozen/Transcript - Intro
(Yaksi Gozen rejects the Ultrakuma and destransforms)
Tomoe: I wouldn't want to lose my one and only daughter for the world. Can you forgive me?
Ryuko: Storm subsides. (Ryuko destransforms)

Ladybug: Miraculous Ladybug!
(The ladybugs repair the damage and unfreeze Félix)

Tom: Lamb cutlets are a great gift idea!

Adrien: I know it's not as romantic as burying rings in puree... I feel like nothing will ever be enough to show Marinette how much I love her.

title: Ziggy
text:
Ziggy - Intro
is a supporting character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She is the kwami of Passion who is connected to the Goat Miraculous. With her power, Ziggy's wearer can use the hair clips to transform into a goat-themed superhero.
Ziggy and her Miraculous are currently owned by Nathaniel Kurtzberg, who uses it to transform into the superhero Caprikid.

title: Ziggy
text:
Ziggy - Appearance
Ziggy is 10 centimeters (or 4 inches) tall and is gray with dark gray horns, arms and legs, and a large dark gray spot around her right eye. She has dark gray eyes, eyelashes, floppy gray goat ears, and a small tail.
From season 6 onwards, she has a visible nose.

title: Ziggy
text:
Ziggy - Personality
Ziggy is kind, helpful, playful, and friendly. True to her concept, she is very sensitive and emotional, easily swayed by her emotions as when she read the transcript Marc wrote she believed that Nathaniel wouldn't be able to draw something equivalent to the emotion in Marc's writing.  Ziggy gets upset when someone asks something from her without saying "please" first and cries when she sees something emotionally touching, like Marc's stories.
Like her fellow kwamis, Ziggy is extremely curious. It's implied that she is one of the youngest or least used of the kwamis, as she wasn't fully aware of her inability to be photographed. Despite being out of the Miracle Box for only a short time, she appears to be a fast learner, as she figured out to take a selfie of her herself with Marinette's phone quickly after being released.
When stressed, Ziggy has a tendency to panic. This is shown when Truth began to ravage Marinette's room, and she immediately assumed the worst and when she worried for Nathaniel when he was forced to confront his mother.
She sometimes speaks with a goat-like bleat in her voice.

title: Ziggy
text:
Ziggy - Abilities
Ziggy can fly, levitate, and phase through solid objects. She can also carry objects that are larger and/or heavier than herself such as Marinette's cellphone and a costume along with Sass without much difficulty.
As a kwami, Ziggy is able to transform the holder of the Goat Miraculous into a goat-themed superhero, giving the wearer the power of Genesis, allowing the user to make anything they draw real objects.

title: Ziggy
text:
Ziggy - Relationships
Friends/Allies
Kaalki
Ziggy and Kaalki are seen dancing together at the party that celebrates Nooroo's birthday in "Sandboy". After they broke their contact with Hawk Moth, Ziggy is seen attending to Kaalki, which shows that two kwamis are possibly close friends, or simply get along with each other. Once Master Fu, handed over his guardianship to Marinette, they move in together.
Orikko
Like the rest of the kwamis, Ziggy gets along well with Orikko as they danced together at the party that celebrates Nooroo's birthday in "Sandboy". Once Master Fu, handed over his guardianship to Marinette, they move in together. Then, soon like the rest of her siblings and her, she knew that Orikko had an owner and in "The Ruler", she officially meets his owner Marc.
Nathaniel Kurtzberg
Ziggy seems to be on good terms with Nathaniel as his kwami, in "Penalteam" as she greets him with respect and kindness and they were happy to be reunited again in "Re-creation".

title: Ziggy
text:
Ziggy - Relationships
In "The Ruler", Ziggy is shown to get along with and support her holder immensely. Ziggy enjoys his creations and motivates him to draw the illustrations for Marc's story as best as he can. She also worries about him when he wants to destroy the printed comics and when Nathaniel needs to transform in order to fight his akumatized mother.
Marinette Dupain-Cheng/Ladybug
At first, Ziggy didn't know anything about Marinette, but was aware that she was Tikki's owner, until they officially meet until "Kwamibuster", when Marinette needed her help in rescuing Tikki and Plagg as well as cheered for her when the plan was success. Once Master Fu, handed over his guardianship to Marinette in "Miracle Queen", she moved in with her along with the rest of her siblings.

title: Ziggy
text:
Ziggy - Relationships
With Marinette's new guardianship, Ziggy along with the rest of her siblings, showed their new guardian's constant care and support. Before their capture, Ziggy and her siblings were taught what to do if any of them were caught by Monarch and when the plan commenced in "Destruction", they were briefly reunited only to have their hoped dashed when Monarch took them away. In "Kwami's Choice, she was aware that Marinette was briefly no longer Tikki's owner but seeing Monarch return empty handed, Ziggy felt joy that her guardian foiled the mastermind's plan.
In "Miraculous London", Ziggy felt joy being reunited with her guardian again and when given the permission to live with their owners permanently, Ziggy and her siblings shared an embrace with Marinette before leaving.
Marc Anciel/Rooster Bold
After moving in with Nathaniel, she was aware that her owner constantly worked with Marc in creating comics finding it impressive at how well they worked together even more so that her owner and Marc are in a relationship, and after defeating the titular villain in "The Ruler", Ziggy officially meets Marc and that he is her brother Orikko's owner.
Enemies

title: Ziggy
text:
Ziggy - Relationships
Gabriel Agreste/Hawk Moth/Shadow Moth/Monarch
During many of their interactions, Ziggy was shown to be nervous and fearful of Gabriel and his intentions. During "Destruction", she was obviously not wanting to do anything to help the villain learn anything that would lead to Ladybug's real identity but she was forced to provide the first clue to find her. Since then, Ziggy feared her powers being used for Monarch's plans and hoped for rescue from Ladybug and that rescue finally came in "Miraculous London",
Chloé Bourgeois/Queen Bee
Ziggy doesn't know Chloe too well but she is aware that the latter was her sister's Pollen temporary owner, but upon meeting her, Ziggy's opinion of her soured seeing that the selfish activated her along with her siblings to enact revenge on her guardian but she along with the other kwamis refused to her help finding her not very nice.

title: Ziggy
text:
Ziggy - Etymology
Ziggy is named after David Bowie's character Ziggy Stardust.
It also bears a resemblance to Ziege, a German word meaning "goat".

title: Ziggy
text:
Ziggy - Trivia
Ziggy was first revealed from a second season trailer on August 31, 2017.
Ziggy's name was confirmed in the credits of the Latin American Spanish dub of "Sandboy".
Goats symbolize faith, peace, sturdiness, dignity, creative energy, revelry, tranquility, aggression, abundance, and aspiration.
The goat is the eighth animal of the Chinese zodiac.
Sometimes, the goat is replaced with a ram or sheep.

title: Zombizou
text:
Zombizou - Intro
"" is a season 2 episode of the series, Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. As based on the series' production order specifically, "" is the 15th written and produced episode of season 2. It is also the 41st written and produced episode of the series, overall.

title: Zombizou
text:
Zombizou - Synopsis
The students give gifts to Miss Bustier on her birthday but the popular teacher is akumatized into Zombizou, a monster armed with evil black lipstick.
Disney+
Ladybug and Cat Noir face Miss Bustier, now Zombizou.

title: Zombizou
text:
Zombizou - Plot
Marinette runs into the school locker rooms where everyone is showing the gifts they made for Miss Bustier's birthday. Mylène got her a braid of hair inspired by the breathing classes that make her less afraid of akumas. Nathaniel made a drawing of her as a superhero since she is always there for her students. Rose made her a scrapbook inspired by the excerise she makes them do where they exchange a nice compliment with their neighbors.
Hearing all those thoughtful gifts makes Marinette fear that her gift is lame, but Alya assures her that there's no pressure. Adrien and some of the other students gather around Marinette to see what she has, and she shows them that she made a cosmetics bag for Miss Bustier with a quote that she'd taught her classmates on the first day of school and added a tube of lip balm inside of it.

title: Zombizou
text:
Zombizou - Plot
Adrien then asks Chloé what she got Miss Bustier, but Chloé doesn't respond, so the whole class is disappointed that she didn't get anything. Sabrina defends her by saying that Chloé just doesn't remember birthdays like her mother. Chloé tells Sabrina that the class doesn't need to hear her life story and even calls Miss Bustier's lessons about love ridiculous. Marinette whispers to Alya that Chloé has no heart, which Chloé overhears and is provoked. When everyone leaves for Olga Mendeleiev's class, Chloé sabotages Marinette's gift by drawing on it with permanent marker.

title: Zombizou
text:
Zombizou - Plot
When it's time for Miss Bustier's class, everyone hands over the gifts they got her. Miss Bustier opens Marinette's first and is surprised by it. Noticing her confused expression, Marinette goes over to Miss Bustier and sees the permanent marker all over the bag. She immediately realizes that it was Chloé's wrongdoing and calls her out on it. The rest of the class is just as displeased. Alya calls Chloé worse than Hawk Moth, and Alix even points out how over half the city was akumatized because of her. Miss Bustier, however, is more forgiving, calling the present wonderful and saying that she'll be able to think of both Marinette and Chloé every time she uses it. Marinette believes that Chloé shouldn't get away with what she did, but Miss Bustier asks to speak to Marinette outside the classroom and puts Alya in charge while the two are gone. Thinking that she is in trouble, Marinette's emotions became negative. Hawk Moth senses Marinette's feelings of injustice and sends an akuma after her.

title: Zombizou
text:
Zombizou - Plot
Marinette tells her teacher that Chloe is the meanest person and Miss Bustier tells Marinette there are much more worst people in Paris and she tells them that is why Marienettes are so import, this makes Marienette's negative emotions fade away before Miss Bustier can akumatized. Then Hawk Moth sends a akuma to evilize Miss Bustier and Marinette tells Miss Bustier to not give up and then Miss Bustier tries to fight the negative emotions and she tells the akuma she won't let it evilize of her students and then the cosmetics bag drop and have positive thoughts and then Marinette runs down the stairs

title: Zombizou
text:
Zombizou - Plot
Zombizou bursts into her classroom and smears lip balm on her lips. She then tells her students that from now on, everyone is going to hug, kiss, and feel the love -- even Chloé. She blows a kiss at her, but Chloé uses Sabrina as a human shield and the kiss touches her forehead instead. Before Zombizou can blow another kiss, Ladybug intervenes and begs Miss Bustier to stop. However, she says that she is no longer Miss Bustier and attacks Ladybug. While the two battle, the rest of the class runs out of the classroom. While running down the stairs, however, Sabrina began to feel sick and soon becomes a kissing zombie who tries to kiss Chloé. Adrien drags Chloé away from Sabrina, who kisses Mylène instead, turning her into a kissing zombie. Adrien realizes that the kisses are contagious and warns everyone not to let themselves get kissed. Ivan holds Sabrina and Mylène back while everyone else escapes.

title: Zombizou
text:
Zombizou - Plot
Ladybug continues to fight Zombizou in Literature classroom until an infected Sabrina, Mylène, and Ivan burst in. Zombizou decides to leave Ladybug in their hands and goes from classroom to classroom looking for Chloé while blowing more kisses at students. Ladybug manages to tie down Sabrina, Mylène, and Ivan and then looks for anyone who hasn't been infected. She eventually finds Miss Bustier's class hiding inside lockers in the locker room. However, Adrien doesn't come out of his locker, and when Ladybug checks on him, she finds that he has been turned into a kissing zombie. More kissing zombies burst into the locker room, so Ladybug takes everyone up on the roof. Once they're gone, it is revealed that Adrien is actually not a kissing zombie and only pretended to be in order to be able to transform into Cat Noir, though Plagg wonders if it was actually a ploy to get a kiss out of Ladybug.
Cat Noir joins everyone on top of the roof where Ladybug shows him a news broadcast of the kissing zombies.
The mayor makes an announcement advising people to stay indoors, but is tackled and infected live on the air by, of all people, Roger the policeman!

title: Zombizou
text:
Zombizou - Plot
Zombizou then infects anchorwoman Nadja and announces that she is coming after Chloé and then Ladybug and Cat Noir.
Angry that another person was akumatized because of her, everyone starts to wonder if they should just give Zombizou what she wants, but Ladybug intervenes by saying that Chloé doesn't deserve to get hit and will be needed as bait to lure Zombizou when the time comes.
Just then, the kissing zombies manage to climb onto the roof, so Ladybug spots a nearby bus and comes up with a plan to lure everyone into safety.
Cat Noir jumps onto the bus roof and uses his staff and belt to make a zipline, bringing the students inside of the bus one at a time.
Unfortunately, they are unable to save everyone, as Max and Kim are infected.
When Chloé ziplines, she goes too fast and misses the bus.
Rose goes out of the bus and saves her, though Chloé complains about her being too slow.
Ladybug brings Rose and Chloé inside of the bus and then Cat Noir drives off, though he's not well experienced with the bus.
Juleka comforts a shaken Rose, who has unknowingly been kissed on the leg.

title: Zombizou
text:
Zombizou - Plot
While Cat Noir drives, he and Ladybug discuss their plan to bring Chloé to the Eiffel Tower in order to draw out Zombizou. They then hear Juleka scream. They turn around to find that she had been kissed by an infected Rose. Rose runs towards the duo, but Alix holds her back, having faith in Ladybug. Chloé complains about people attacking her personal space, which made both Alya and Nino angry. Meanwhile, Zombizou is reminded by Hawk Moth not to forget their deal. Zombizou assures him that no one can escape her kiss and heads to the Eiffel Tower.

title: Zombizou
text:
Zombizou - Plot
Ladybug, Cat Noir, Chloé, Alya, and Nino run inside the Eiffel Tower building and hold the doors back with a vending machine. Alya frantically pushes the elevator buttons, but when the elevator opens, a few kissing zombies pop out and kiss her. Cat Noir heads inside the elevator with Chloé, realizing that there's nothing they can do for her. Alya agrees and tells Ladybug to just go and save them all. Ladybug goes inside the elevator and tells Nino to come with them, but Nino decides to stay with Alya instead. Ladybug is against this but it is too late to stop him. Cat Noir says that it's okay, knowing that Ladybug will fix everything in the end. Nino notes that it isn't the first time he and Alya have been in trouble together before an infected Alya kisses him.

title: Zombizou
text:
Zombizou - Plot
Ladybug and Cat Noir reach the top of the Eiffel Tower. While Cat Noir holds the kissing zombies back, Ladybug hides Chloé inside of Gustave Eiffel's office. Chloé freaks out when she sees someone, but calms down upon realizing that it's just a statue. When Ladybug heads back to Cat Noir, she finds that he has been kissed. Cat Noir assures her that he'll be fine and that she should just save everyone. Though Ladybug doesn't want to, she leaves him behind and goes back inside of Gustave Eiffel's office, where she finds Chloé hiding underneath a table. After Chloé wishes Ladybug good luck, Zombizou appears and demands that Ladybug hand over Chloé and her Miraculous. Ladybug calls on her Lucky Charm and receives makeup remover. While figuring out what to do with it, an infected Cat Noir bursts into the office with his Cataclysm and tries to kiss Ladybug. Ladybug runs from him and grabs the scarf on the statue's neck, putting the makeup remover on it. Cat Noir nearly kisses Ladybug, but Chloé takes her hit instead and tells Ladybug to save them all.

title: Zombizou
text:
Zombizou - Plot
Ladybug goes on top of the Eiffel Tower and is confronted by Zombizou, who demands that she accept her love and hand over her Miraculous. Ladybug refuses and throws her yoyo, which she tied the scarf with makeup remover on, at Zombizou, wiping the lip balm off her face. Before she can reapply, Ladybug grabs the lip balm and releases the akuma before purifying it and using Miraculous Ladybug to return everything to normal. Hawk Moth, noting Ladybug and Cat Noir's relationship, says that if Zombizou is right about love conquering all, his greatest wish will come true for sure.
After Miss Bustier is deakumatized, she feels awful about letting her negative emotions get the better of her, calling herself terrible. Ladybug, however, assures her that it wasn't her fault, saying that Hawk Moth is the one to blame, but Miss Bustier still feels bad about hurting so many innocent people. However, Chloé intervenes, saying that she is the one to blame. She admits that she'd forgotten Miss Bustier's birthday and when she saw that everyone else had a gift, she lost it because she wanted to give her something, too. She also apologizes to her. Miss Bustier accepts the apology and embraces Chloé.

title: Zombizou
text:
Zombizou - Plot
The next day at school, Alya demands that Chloé apologize to the class about what happened the previous day, but Chloé retorts that everyone should thank her for saving them. Alya disagrees, but then Marinette intervenes and thanks Chloé for helping Ladybug and saving Miss Bustier. She also takes back her earlier comment about Chloé being heartless before dragging herself and Alya back to their seats. Alya asks Marinette why she did that, to which Marinette replies by saying that she has realized that Chloé has a heart but doesn't know how to use it, but may learn if they set a positive example. The two then notice Chloé put something on Miss Bustier's desk just before the teacher walks in and greets her students. In the end, it's just a letter with Chloé's name on it.

title: Zombizou
text:
Zombizou - Plot Developments
In "Collusion", it is revealed that the birthday gift from Chloé was a golden bracelet.
As of this episode, Miss Bustier is the final person in the class photo to be akumatized, with the exception of Marinette and Adrien.
Since or before this episode there was recurring theory that fans believed that Miraculous holders couldn't be akumatized because they were protected by their jewels. When, Hawk Moth tries to akumatize Marinette for the first time, this proves said holders, are not "invisible" to his sensing of negative emotions by virtue of them holding Miraculouses; however, it is not resolved whether it would actually be possible to akumatize them. Then, revealed in "Queen Wasp", they can be akumatized.
As of this episode, Adrien is the only character from the class photo who hasn't been an Akuma target.
This episode shows that someone doesn't need to hold the object where the akuma enters to be akumatized. Miss Bustier threw the lip balm at the akuma, which entered it and put her under Hawk Moth's control despite her no longer touching the lip balm at that point.

title: Zombizou
text:
Zombizou - Trivia
Internationally, this episode first premiered in Canada on Family Channel.
This is the second time a victim tries to fend off an akuma before getting infected. This previously occurred in "Stormy Weather", when Aurore tried to fight off the akuma with her umbrella.
Nathaniel is inexplicably absent when the class heads for the locker rooms.
This is the first episode where Cassandra Lee Morris voices Sabrina.
References
Alix stated that almost half the city of Paris got akumatized because of Chloé's tricks:
Alya in "Lady Wifi"
Nathaniel in 'The Evillustrator"
Kim in "Dark Cupid"
Mylène in "Horrificator"
Rose in "Princess Fragrance"
Cheng in "Kung Food"
Juleka in "Reflekta"
Sabrina and herself in "Antibug"
Armand in 'Despair Bear"
Clara Nightingale in "Frightingale".
Just like in other previous episodes, Cat Noir ends up being controlled by a supervillain.
This is one of the few episodes, in which Ladybug saves the world without his help.
One of the gifts on Ms. Bustier's desk in the beginning is a purple flower bouquet like the one Marinette gives her uncle in "Kung Food".
This is third episode to:

title: Zombizou
text:
Zombizou - Trivia
Be from Season 2 that doesn't have a new character following "Troublemaker" and "The Collector".
Where a villain hunts down Chloé, following "Dark Cupid" and "Reflekta".
Where Marinette's role as class representative, established in "Darkblade" and recalled in "Robostus".
Involve where a person in the series to be akumatized on her birthday, this time it's Miss Bustier preceded by Alix in "Timebreaker" and Nathaniel in "The Evillustrator".
Have an akuma seen by one of the heroes before it akumatizes its victim just like in "Riposte" and "Gigantitan".
This is the fourth episode where Tikki doesn't have a speaking role.
Without realizing it Hawk Moth was close to achieving victory for the fourth time following "Lady Wifi", "The Puppeteer" and "The Dark Owl".
This is the fifth episode that involve celebrating a birthday; specifically, in this case, Miss Bustier's birthday. The previous occasions were, "The Bubbler", "Timebreaker", "The Evillustrator", "Befana".
Similar to "Gigantitan," an akuma misses its objective and possesses another victim.

title: Zombizou
text:
Zombizou - Trivia
This occurs when the akuma tries to target Marinette, however, after being consoled by her teacher, Marinette releases her negative emotions and remains positive, thus no longer being a target. However as Miss Bustier notices the akuma and tries to fend it off, Hawk Moth and the akuma both pick up on her emotions, and akumatizes her instead.
Miss Bustier tries to resist being akumatized after she's been struck, making her the first akuma target to do so; however, she still succumbs to it in the end.
Marinette is visibly unhappy when she transforms into Ladybug, something that has occurred in "The Bubbler" and "Santa Claws".
This also occurs in "Anansi" and "Style Queen".
This is the seventh episode where the Cat Noir transformation sequence isn't shown, following "Mr. Pigeon", "Dark Cupid", "Copycat", "Prime Queen", "Despair Bear", "Riposte" and "Gorizilla". In this case, as in "Riposte", a quick green flash is shown emanating from Cat Noir's hiding spot.
Allusions

title: Zombizou
text:
Zombizou - Trivia
Like "Despair Bear" and "Weredad", kissing remains controversial for children. But in this case, instead of following the horror movie cliche in which zombies infect people by biting their body parts, the people who were infected would kiss in a similar fashion. Unlike zombie movies where the infected has to die due to a lack of cure, Ladybug is able to turn everyone back to normal using Miraculous Ladybug.
The episode's title is a portmanteau of the French words zombi and bisou (also written as bizou), which mean "zombie" and "kiss" respectively.
This episode pays homage to zombie horror films and clichés present within them.
It's revealed that Adrien can drive; he apparently learned how by mastering every car and racetrack in Extreme Racing 3 which alludes to the racing video game Extreme G-3.

When everyone is running up the stairs after the infection starts to spread, Rose's leg clips through her skirt for a couple of frames.
