title: Zombizou/Transcript
text:
Zombizou/Transcript - Intro
(Entering from off-screen, Roger jumps at Mayor Bourgeois, kissing his cheek. The mayor falls over, along with his podium and Roger. The footage cuts back to Nadja in the studio. The City Hall feed becomes scrambled.)
Nadja: Mr. Mayor? Mr. Mayor?
(Chloé pushes Cat Noir away, and looks at the newscast.)
Chloé: Daddy?!
(Nadja is trying to wave a Zombizou kiss away with her tablet.)
Nadja: It looks like we're having a slight technical issue.
(The kiss hits Nadja's cheek, and she slumps. Zombizou walks into the shot.)
Zombizou: I took care of your father, Chloé. Show yourself! (Chloé runs away, screaming) Then, Ladybug and Cat Noir? I'm coming for you. Mwah! (kisses the camera lens, leaving a kiss mark on-screen) Unless, of course, my sweethearts get hold of you first; because very soon, the whole city will be hot on your heels! (evil laughter)
(Ladybug ends the feed. The whole class then becomes angry at Chloé as Alix marches sternly towards her, backing her onto the roof's edge.)
Alix: Chloé! Hunh! Always Chloé! You only think about yourself!
Alya: I don't know why we don't just give them what they want.
Nino: Yeah! Good idea!
Chloé: Is it my fault if I'm better than all of you?

title: Zombizou/Transcript
text:
Zombizou/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug: Sorry to disappoint you guys, but Chloé doesn't deserve to get hit any more than you. (Chloé crosses her arms, smirking) And we need her as bait to lure Zombizou when the time is right.
Chloé: (nervously) Uh...thanks?
Rose: (pointing) They're coming!
(Zombified students climb onto the roof.)
Ladybug: We've gotta evacuate! (looks at a bus on the street) Over there! Cat Noir, do you know how to drive?
Cat Noir: You should know the answer to that, M'Lady. I can do anything.
Ladybug: Kitties first, then.
Cat Noir: (leaps into the air, and spins his baton) Woo-hoo!
(Cat Noir lands on top of the bus, somersaulting. He extends his baton back to reach the school's rooftop, and throws his belt to Ladybug. Chloé appears afraid.)
Chloé: Max and Kim, you go first.

title: Zombizou/Transcript
text:
Zombizou/Transcript - Intro
(Max and Kim angrily cross their arms. Ladybug puts Cat Noir's belt around Rose's waist, and then around Cat Noir's baton. Rose slides down the baton with her feet also wrapped around it, shrieking in excitement. Cat Noir catches her, and lowers her into the bus through the roof. He then catches Juleka. Ladybug sends Alya down. Nino takes hold of the baton, but is interrupted by zombified students. Ladybug uses her yo-yo to trap them.)
Ladybug: Hurry up!
(Nino slides down Cat Noir's baton. Zombified students climb onto the roof.)
Student: Kissou-kissou-kissou!
(Max shields Chloé from the oncoming zombies. Chloé backs away. Zombies strike Max. Kim is ready to slide down Cat Noir's baton, but halts when he sees Max being attacked.)
Kim: Max! (Ladybug glances at Max, shocked, then towards Chloé. Kim grabs Chloé.) Come on, Chloé!
(Zombified students let Max go. He turns to reveal that he has been zombified.)
Max: Ki...
Chloé: Play the hero as much as you like, Kim, but you won't be getting a kiss out of me.
Kim: Just go, before I change my mind.

title: Zombizou/Transcript
text:
Zombizou/Transcript - Intro
(Kim sends Chloé down Cat Noir's baton. Kim is attacked by zombified students. Ladybug uses her yo-yo to pull Kim out of their clutches. Ladybug grabs Kim and leaps with him to safety. Chloé continues sliding down Cat Noir's baton, yelping in fear.)
Cat Noir: Slow down, Chloé!
(Chloé slides past Cat Noir, hitting a sign. Zombies try to reach her.)
Chloé: Hello?! Who's gonna come and save me?
(Cat Noir jumps down from the bus, and starts waving his arms.)
Cat Noir: Yoo-hoo! Kissy-kissy-kissy!
(Rose opens the bus doors, leaving the bus.)
Juleka: Rose, no!
Rose: I can't just leave her by herself!
(Rose runs to catch Chloé. Chloé falls down, and holds her shin.)
Chloé: Ow! Great! (to Rose) Now I've twisted my ankle because you weren't fast enough!
(Rose picks Chloé up. Back on the school roof, Ladybug kneels over Kim, who has purple kiss marks on his face.)
Kim: You take care of Chloé. Besides, you'll save all of us, like you always do, right?
Ladybug: Yeah. That's a promise!
(On the street, Rose is carrying Chloé while zombies close in.)
Zombie: Lady wants a kissy...
(A zombie grabs Rose's leg. She screams.)
Juleka: (from inside the bus) Rose!

title: Zombizou/Transcript
text:
Zombizou/Transcript - Intro
(Ladybug rescues Rose and Chloé with her yo-yo. Cat Noir baits the zombies from on top of a van.)
Cat Noir: Na-na-na-na-nah! Kissy-kissy-kissy! (jumps down, then up on top of the bus) Hurry up; we gotta go now. (retrieves his baton)
(Ladybug and Cat Noir look back at Max and Kim. Ladybug angrily looks down. The bus engine is started. The bus proceeds haltingly. Alya and Nino hold on to each other for balance in the lurching bus.)
Ladybug: I thought you said you knew how to drive!
Cat Noir: I've mastered every car and racetrack in Extreme Racing 3, but there are no buses in that game.
(The bus speeds up, outrunning the zombies. In the back of the bus, Juleka comforts Rose. Alix glances at Chloé angrily, then looks away. Chloé looks down.)
Juleka: Are you okay?
Rose: Yeah...just a close call, that's all.
(Rose's leg is shown to have a purple kiss mark.)
Cat Noir: So, what now?
Ladybug: Let's take Chloé to the top of the Eiffel Tower. There'll be less zombies up there, and fewer places for all of Zombizou's disciples to run to.
Cat Noir: Less places for us to hide, too.
Ladybug: But it's the only way if we want Zombizou to turn up in perso—

title: Zombizou/Transcript
text:
Zombizou/Transcript - Intro
(Juleka yells. She covers her mouth, backing away from Rose. Rose turns, revealing that she has been zombified. Chloé runs to the front of the bus, Rose following. Alix stops Rose. Ladybug traps Alix, Rose and Juleka in the back of the bus using her yo-yo.)
Rose: Kissou!
(Rose hugs Alix to plant a kiss.)
Alix: I totally trust you, Ladybug!
Chloé: Ogh! People need to stop invading my personal space!
(Alya and Nino grunt angrily at Chloé.)
Hawk Moth: (from his lair) Don't forget our agreement, Zombizou.
Zombizou: No one can escape my kiss! (reapplies her lip balm, then takes huge leaps towards the Eiffel Tower)
(Cat Noir parks the bus under the Eiffel Tower. He carries Chloé out of the bus.)
Cat Noir: Stay together and follow me!
(Alya and Nino follow Cat Noir. Ladybug pulls back her yo-yo, presses the bus' door button and leaps out, trapping Rose, Alix and Juleka inside. Ladybug runs inside the Eiffel Tower. Nino closes the door behind her.)
Ladybug: (pushing a vending machine towards the door) Nino! The vending machine! Quick! Everybody, inside the elevator!
Alya: (frantically pushing the elevator button) Faster, faster!

title: Zombizou/Transcript
text:
Zombizou/Transcript - Intro
(The elevator doors open. Alya is attacked by zombies that were inside.)
Ladybug: Alya!
(Nino and Ladybug remove zombies from Alya and pin them down. Alya is covered in kiss marks.)
Nino: Oh...no!
Cat Noir: There's nothing we can do for her. (enters the elevator, still carrying Chloé) Come on!
Alya: He's right. (puts her hands on Ladybug's) Just go, and save us all.
Ladybug: (enters the elevator) Nino? (Nino tips his hat at Ladybug as a goodbye. The elevator doors close.) Nino!
(The elevator ascends. Ladybug hits the elevator door with her fist.)
Cat Noir: It doesn't matter that we're the only ones left, Bugaboo, since you'll fix it all in the end anyway.
Chloé: Only the best remain.
(Ladybug glares at Chloé)
Nino: (to Alya) This isn't the first time we've been in trouble together.
(Nino opens his arms. Alya looks up, zombified.)
Alya: Kissou. (hugs Nino)
(Nino hugs Alya back.)
(Elevator doors open.)
Ladybug: Straight ahead. Gustave Eiffel's office! (opens door)
(The heroes and Chloé are swarmed by zombies. Ladybug dodges; Cat Noir has trouble. Cat Noir tosses Chloé just before he is hit by the zombies.)
Cat Noir: Ladybug, catch!

title: Zombizou/Transcript
text:
Zombizou/Transcript - Intro
(Chloé shrieks, and Ladybug catches her, then throws her into Gustave Eiffel's office, locking the door. Chloé looks at a figure of Gustave Eiffel, and screams.)
Chloé: ...Phew.
(Outside, Cat Noir is holding zombies back. He has kiss marks on his face.)
Ladybug: (holding Cat Noir's face) Cat Noir!
Cat Noir: I'll just stay here and chill, M'Lady. If we're going to end up kissing, then I'd rather do it after you save us, okay?
Ladybug: No!
Cat Noir: You're the only one who can fix this for us. No arguing now!
(Ladybug runs. Cat Noir falls down under the weight of the zombies.)
Ladybug: It's down to you and me. (looks around) Chloé? (crouches down to Chloé's hiding spot under a small table)
Chloé: At least I won't get in your way now. Good luck!
(Through a window, Zombizou laughs.)
Zombizou: Hand over Chloé and your Miraculous, Ladybug. Then I might just let you witness the final triumph of love!
Hawk Moth: (from his lair) Victory has never been so close!
Ladybug: Lucky Charm! (a dispenser of make-up remover appears)
Chloé: (stands up) Make-up remover? How are you going to save my life with that?

title: Zombizou/Transcript
text:
Zombizou/Transcript - Intro
(With her Lucky Vision, Ladybug sees the scarf worn on the figure of Gustave Eiffel, when the Vision is interrupted.)
Cat Noir: (heard from outside, above) Cataclysm!
(Cat Noir crashes through the ceiling into the office.)
Ladybug: (happy with hope) Cat Noir!
(Cat Noir raises his head, revealing purple eyes.)
Cat Noir: Kissou. (tries to grab Ladybug)
(Ladybug grabs Gustave Eiffel's model's scarf, as Cat Noir starts chasing her around the room.)
Ladybug: Don't worry, kitty... You'll get your kisses... But first, I have a Lucky Charm I need to use. (applies the make-up remover to the scarf while being chased)
Chloé: (back under the table) I'm sorry!
Ladybug: What?
Chloé: Oh, this is all my fault!
Ladybug: (wrapping the scarf around her yo-yo) Awesome. But...now's not exactly a good time.
(Cat Noir leaps at Ladybug, but Chloé stands up and shields her. Cat Noir clings to Chloé.)
Chloé: Save us all, Ladybug.
(Cat Noir starts kissing Chloé's cheek. Ladybug jumps up through the hole Cat Noir made in the ceiling, to confront Zombizou on the roof.)
Zombizou: You're all alone, Ladybug. Accept my love, and give me your Miraculous!
Ladybug: This is not true love!

title: Zombizou/Transcript
text:
Zombizou/Transcript - Intro
(Ladybug throws her yo-yo with the soaked scarf wrapped around it at Zombizou. On its return, the yo-yo wipes off Zombizou's lip balm. Zombizou tries to send a kiss, but nothing happens. Zombizou takes her lip balm out to reapply it, but Ladybug stops Zombizou with her yo-yo, then kicks the lip balm out of Zombizou's hands. Zombizou falls backwards off of the Eiffel Tower. Ladybug's yo-yo pulls Zombizou back up. Ladybug breaks the stick of balm, and the akuma flies out.)
Ladybug: No more evil-doing for you, little akuma. Time to de-evilize! (captures the akuma and purifies it) Gotcha! Bye bye, little butterfly. Miraculous Ladybug!
(The Miraculous light fixes all of the damage caused. Released from the infuence, Chloé pushes Cat Noir away in disgust. Back on the bus, Rose and Juleka hug, and are joined by Alix. On a park bench, zombified Mylène and Ivan are kissing before the Miraculous wave cures them, after which they kiss again, freely.)
Hawk Moth: Ladybug... Cat Noir! If Zombizou is right...if love does always conquer...then someday, my most cherished wish will come true for sure!
(Hawk Moth's lair window closes.)
(Zombizou detransforms. Miss Bustier gasps.)

title: Zombizou/Transcript
text:
Zombizou/Transcript - Intro
Ladybug & Cat Noir: (fist-bumping) Pound it!
Miss Bustier: Ladybug?! Cat Noir? What on earth—? (gasps) The akuma overtook me, oh no, I...I let my negative emotions get the upper hand, how terrible! ...I'm terrible.
Ladybug: That's not true! It wasn't your fault. Hawk Moth is the one to blame.
Miss Bustier: But I hurt a lot of people...
Chloé: No... I did... I forgot your birthday, once again. And when I saw everyone had prepared a gift for you, I totally lost it. Because I, too, would've liked to offer you something. I'm sorry, Miss Bustier.
Miss Bustier: Thank you, Chloé. Those words are the best possible gift you could ever give me. (hugs Chloé)
(Chloé hugs her back, forgetting herself for a moment.)
Chloé: Huh?... Uh, yeah. Okay then, we're all good.
(Ladybug and Cat Noir leave.)
Cat Noir: Woo-hoo!
Chloé: Me? You want me to apologize to the entire class? Ridiculous! They should be thanking me for saving everybody.
Alya: I happen to have several accounts of what went down, including my own, and they don't exactly match your version.
(Marinette puts an arm on Alya's shoulder.)

title: Zombizou/Transcript
text:
Zombizou/Transcript - Intro
Marinette: (to Chloé) I heard you helped Ladybug and saved Miss Bustier! Awesome! There really is a heart beating in there after all. Sorry I said there wasn't. (pushes Alya away)
Alya: Uh, but—!
Marinette: (giggles softly) And thanks! (walks away)
(Chloé and Sabrina look at her, surprised, then at each other. Chloé shrugs. Marinette and Alya take their seats.)
Alya: Marinette? Girl, are you still Zombizoufied, or what?
Marinette: I've realized Chloé has a heart, too. She just doesn't know how to use it. Hopefully, she'll learn if we continue setting a positive example.
(Chloé quickly puts something on Miss Bustier's desk, behind the computer monitor, then acts nonchalant. Alya gasps as Marinette smiles. Miss Bustier enters. Chloé sits down at her desk.)
Miss Bustier: 'Morning, everyone!
Students: 'Morning, Miss Bustier!
Miss Bustier: Glad to see you all! As usual, we'll start the day by giving a nice compliment to your neighbor.
(The view pans to show Chloé's present.)

title: Zoé's cellphone
text:
Zoé's cellphone - Intro
is a smartphone owned by Zoé Lee. Her phone number is +33612443.

title: Zoé's cellphone
text:
Zoé's cellphone - Appearance
In the first saga, Zoé's cellphone was white with white edges. It had three white-gray cameras on the top, one camera on the bottom, and another on the back of the phone.
From season 6 onwards, Zoé's cellphone has a cover with several hearts drawn on it, one inside the other, in the same colors as the flower on her shirt: light blue, pink, and yellow. On the top side of the screen, it has a small round camera, and on the back, on the top left, it has four round cameras arranged in a square.

title: Zoé's cellphone
text:
Zoé's cellphone - Trivia
As seen in "Sole Crusher", Zoé's phone number is +33612443.
It is unknown if she keeps her phone in her bag.
Zoé and Lila appear to have the same type of smartphone.
Considering, Zoé has only a few friends with one of them being in New York City and Marinette who gave her number to Zoé it is most likely that Zoé has only one or two contacts listed on her phone.
Although she may have other friends such as Juleka, Rose, and Ivan, it has not yet been revealed whether she has their contact numbers or not.

title: Zoé's bag
text:
Zoé's bag - Intro
is a bag owned by Zoé Lee. The bag temporarily held Plagg when she was temporarily in possession of the Cat Miraculous, for when he wasn't to be seen before Zoé renounced the Miraculous in "Deflagration".

title: Zoé's bag
text:
Zoé's bag - Appearance
Zoe's bag is almost like a drawstring bag, it can be used as a purse. It is dark grayish tangelo with lighter tangelo strings. In the middle, it is black and bush-like with two blue triangles on top and bottom. surrounding it, it has a light brilliant crimson rhombus. After that, it has a small blue outline and finally, a thick black outline with white squiggles in the middle. Then it has three faded blue square patterns in each corner. On the top sides of the bag, it has brilliant raspberry-colored strings tied together. On the bottom of the black lozenge diamond, it has a white bead studded on it and three white leather strings attached to the bottom of it.

title: Zoé's bag
text:
Zoé's bag - Trivia
As seen in "Re-creation", Marinette put the mini Miracle Box with the Bee Miraculous in the bag.
Now that Pollen permanently belongs to Zoé, it is possible that she will be hidden in the bag just like Plagg was previously.
As of Season 6, the drawstring bag is replaced by a normal backpack.

title: Ziggy/History
text:
Ziggy/History - Intro
Ziggy is the kwami connected to the Goat Miraculous. Currently, she lets Nathaniel Kurtzberg transform into Caprikid.

title: Ziggy/History
text:
Ziggy/History - Before [[season 1]]
After the universe was created 13.8 billion years ago, the idea of passion came into existence, so did Ziggy come into existence. Once more concepts and ideas were brought into the universe, Ziggy was given her kwami siblings then through some unknown events the kwamis discovered the existence of the billions of parallel universes and due to their concepts being so abstract they came across different verisions of themselves as well as discovered that they lived simultaneously in all of them sharing a mind link gaining the knowledge and memories of each other. And yet, they made it their pact that due to them living for so long unless in an emergency or crisis they chose not to bring up complexity of parallel universes to their owners knowing that they wouldn't have enough time to explain the smallest bit about it so they all agreed to stick with the basics of living in their own universes with them. But still used the memories and knowledge of their massive experiences to guide them and their owners through.

title: Ziggy/History
text:
Ziggy/History - Before [[season 1]]
Regardless for countless eons they traveled throughout the universe until they made their way to Earth. However, they discovered two things: one, they couldn't be seen by any living beings and two when Ziggy and others discovered their powers their lack of control resulted in disaster. Until one day, in ancient China, she met a mage who crafted her Miraculous, allowing her to maintain a physical appearance. But before their jewels and physical form were obtained Ziggy and her kwami family began to grow when the Prodigious was created giving them their cousins the Renlings, however an unknown incident caused the jewel and their renling cousins to sealed yet guarded by Mei Shi and the Renren guardians. For over 5,000 years, Ziggy helped people transform into superheroes in order to save the world.

title: Ziggy/History
text:
Ziggy/History - Before [[season 1]]
She and many of her siblings started in China where her first owner became the Shānyáng and through her as well as other civilians Ziggy and her siblings began discovering the basics of their powers. During one of their many adventures, Ziggy and Shanyang made another interesting discovery their powers can altered to include elemental abilities making the pair the first to use the aqua power up of the Miraculous Potions but were never allowed to know the contents as well as witness the creation of the Miraculous spellbook but couldn't read it. In their earlier adventures Ziggy and the kwamis began to treasure the bonds they had with their owners creating the tradition of the kwagatama. At a point in time after their jewels were created the guardians also made a special magical box the Mother Miracle Box to house inactive miraculous and siblings once inside they discovered that a whole another universe exist and made it their home where they could cherish mementos of their adventures and owners.

title: Ziggy/History
text:
Ziggy/History - Before [[season 1]]
Furthermore, the kwamis desires had been fulfilled wishing to help people throughout the world however just like humans, Ziggy and the others also discovered that not all of them were worthy of their powers causing destruction making it their job along with their owners to rescue their captured siblings. However as time moved on, they found out that unlike them humans weren't immortal or when the crisis had been dealt with Ziggy and her siblings had to say goodbye to their first owners. But to their surprise their owners of the past weren't completely gone, seeing that their wisdom and insight as miraculous holders could benefit future generations the kwamis and guardians worked together by combining the kwagatamas, great magic and artifacts they established something amazing a magical reunion despite knowing the beings they were talking to weren't exactly like their past owners the kwamis were happy to be reunited nonetheless.
Sometime after Shanyang's death or retirement, around 200 years ago before the creation of photography, Ziggy was activated by unknown owner.

title: Ziggy/History
text:
Ziggy/History - Season 1
During season 1, Ziggy was dormant in the Goat Miraculous.

title: Ziggy/History
text:
Ziggy/History - [[Season 2]]
During season 2, Ziggy was dormant in the Goat Miraculous.
In "Sandboy", Ziggy was celebrating Nooroo's birthday in the Miracle Box with the other kwamis and was excited when Tikki and Plagg arrived. She marveled at the gift Tikki brought and thought it was a paintbrush before continuing to play with the other kwamis. When the time came to find Nooroo, Ziggy got into position in an effort to contact him, but they contacted his wielder instead. Upon hearing him, the kwamis shuddered at the thought of being his slave, and to prevent him from discovering their location, they all cut off the connection. They realized if they contacted Nooroo's wielder, then someone must have been akumatized and that Tikki and Plagg's wielders would be in danger.

title: Ziggy/History
text:
Ziggy/History - [[Season 3]]
During season 3, Ziggy was dormant in the Goat Miraculous.
In "Kwamibuster", she was activated along with her kwami brothers and sisters to help Multimouse enact her plan of rescuing Tikki and Plagg. During the confrontation, Ziggy was one of the few kwamis captured but was set free with the help of Multinoire. After Kwamibuster's defeat, she and the others cheered for Marinette as their plan was a success and was returned to Miracle Box.
In "Miracle Queen", she was activated alongside Stompp, Roaar, Daizzi, Barkk, Mullo, Orikko and Fluff by Queen Bee with the intent to use them against Ladybug and Cat Noir. After being commanded to transform her, Ziggy reminds her to say please, and they collectively withheld their transformation phrases. Upon hearing Master Fu renounce his title, she and the others protest but Master Fu does so anyway, resulting in the Miracle Box changing shape and form. After failing to escape, Queen Bee throws off their respective Miraculouses, and they, alongside their kwamis are returned to the Miracle Box by Ladybug.

title: Ziggy/History
text:
Ziggy/History - Season 4
In "Truth", Ziggy was accidentally released from the Miracle Box when Marinette tried to figure it out, she took Marinette's phone and a photo of herself. During a video call, when Marinette was informed that kwamis couldn't be filmed or photographed, Ziggy understood why she didn't appear in the photo. When Marinette leaves for her date with Luka, she and her fellow kwamis hid with the Miracle Box, but they heard the titular villain broke into Marinette's room, Ziggy panicked at the thought of being discovered by Hawk Moth again but were saved by their Ladybug.
After the titular villain's defeat, Ziggy and the others saw that Marinette was sad about breaking up with Luka to the point of tears, she didn't know exactly how to help but joined with the others in giving their new guardian a group hug.
In "Lies", Ziggy was seen flying around with Fluff in Marinette's room.

title: Ziggy/History
text:
Ziggy/History - Season 4
In "Gang of Secrets", She was seen talking with Barkk until Marinette arrives home and was upset seeing her so sad and moves with Barkk to remove Marinette's pictures until Ziggy was halted from doing so. Later, she and the others hear Marinette voiced her distress about being condemned to a life of secrets and lies forever because of her alter ego. When they hear someone coming, the kwamis hide in the Miracle Box and after the Gang of Secrets had been defeated, Ziggy and the others look on as Marinette unveils her secret to Alya.
In "Mr. Pigeon 72", Ziggy along with Daizzi joined her fellow kwamis in playing with one of Marinette's designer hats. Then, afterwards she and the other kwamis helped clean up Marinette's room.

title: Ziggy/History
text:
Ziggy/History - Season 4
In "Furious Fu", hearing that Master Fu was returning, Ziggy along with the other kwamis expressed dear desire to see him despite Marinette trying to keep them hidden for their safety and when Marinette voiced concerns about leaving the Miracle Box unguarded. Ziggy realized if someone stayed to guard the box, the others could go but when they cheated their way out so all of them can go, they were stopped by Marinette with no choice, they used the "puppy dog eyes" on her and Marinette reluctantly agreed. However, Ziggy and her friends had a hard time keeping quiet while in Marinette's bag but heard that Master Fu is doing well and become a great painter.
But returning home, Ziggy realized that Su-Han had returned to reclaim the box as he was the previous guardian before Master Fu's incident and with Su-Han's strictness, she and the other kwamis sadly returned to the box. After seeing Ladybug's valiant actions against the titular villain, Su-Han realized that Master Fu's choice wasn't so bad allowing Ziggy and the other kwamis to stay with Marinette.

title: Ziggy/History
text:
Ziggy/History - Season 4
In "Queen Banana", Ziggy along with Sass was helping Marinette as she was making the finishing touches on costumes for her class movie project.
In "Crocoduel", Ziggy and her siblings were listening to Alya trying to convince Marinette to come to the Couffaine Twins' birthday party and to also talk to Luka.
In "Optigami", hearing that Marinette received an invite to Audrey's event; Ziggy and her fellow kwamis were excited to go but was told by Marinette with no owner they couldn't. Then, later received a called from Marinette needing Kaalki's help but seeing their guardian hang up, they knew she would call again.
In "Sentibubbler", Ziggy along with most of her siblings were woken up when Marinette woke up from having a nightmare leading her guardian doubting about leaving the Fox Miraculous and Trixx with Alya.
In "Hack-San", Ziggy and the kwamis were aware that Marinette was leaving for a trip to London but was trying every excuse she could in order not to go as she didn't want to leave Paris unguarded. When Ziggy hears Marinette claim to have injured her leg, she was genuinely concerned until Longg explained that it was another attempt not to leave.

title: Ziggy/History
text:
Ziggy/History - Season 4
In "Wishmaker", curious about what a career is, after hearing Marinette explain and yet seeing Marinette being indecisive about her future, along with her fellow kwamis, they came up with many suggestions with Ziggy believing it has to be something that gave meaning to Marinette's life, she thinks of her guardian being in love with Adrien, or Luka. Until she and the others were silenced by Sass suggesting they listen to their guardian, Ziggy and the other kwamis see Marinette leave for the Career Expo.
In "Simpleman", Ziggy, alongside Sass, Roaar, Daizzi and Barkk were apprehensive at Manon trying to open the sewing box and finding her, the other kwamis and the Miracle Box. She was shaken up and was about be found by Ella and Etta and Manon, until Marinette intervened, saving them.

title: Ziggy/History
text:
Ziggy/History - Season 4
In "Dearest Family", after Tikki ate the pieces of galette, Marinette brought for them, the kwamis quickly realized what she did. Ziggy huddled together with the others when they realized the danger Tikki's hunger for candy can represent, despite the kwami of Creation refusal at that. When Tikki and Marinette left, the kwamis flew around in a panic. Shortly after she watched Marinette, realize that Sass warning was real and transforms to stop Tikki only to be affected by her hunger, which scared her.
Hearing a commotion downstairs, Ziggy and the others were commanded to hide. After Ladybug saved her family, Ziggy and the kwamis see her return with pieces of galette for them. Despite that they were still nervous regarding Tikki, until Marinette ensured them that Tikki will control herself and the kwamis ate the pieces of galette happily.
In "Kuro Neko", Ziggy and the other kwamis tried to comfort Marinette after Cat Noir gave up on his Miraculous and was surprised to learn that she intended to replace him with someone who doesn't love her.

title: Ziggy/History
text:
Ziggy/History - Season 4
In "Penalteam", Ziggy introduces herself to Nathaniel, who used Ziggy and her Miraculous to transform into Caprikid and help Ladybug, alongside many other heroes to defeat Penalteam.
In "Risk", Ziggy and the other kwamis watched Marinette search for different ways to sabotage Adrien and Lila's journey, unaware that she was under the influence of Risk's superpowers.
In "Strikeback", after Flairmidable betrayed Ladybug by stealing her yo-yo, her Miraculous, along with all the others were given to Gabriel Agreste in exchange for the Peacock Miraculous.

title: Ziggy/History
text:
Ziggy/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Evolution", Ziggy is with the other kwamis as they were now captives of Gabriel/Monarch. They back away in fear at hearing him call them his slaves and how he will use their powers to obtain the miraculous of the Ladybug and Cat to make the wish that will bring his wife back. Though they try to warn him of the dangers this would bring, Gabriel ignores them and forces the kwamis to follow along as he attempts to use Fluff's powers to catch Ladybug and Cat Noir off guard in the past.
When in Bunnyx's burrow, the kwamis were able to momentarily break free from his staff to beg Ladybug to save them. When Monarch traveled to the time when Ladybug and Cat Noir had been affected by Reverser's powers, Monarch begins suffering from using too many powers at once and the kwamis needing food to keep their strength up in order for him to use their abilities. With no other choice, Gabriel had to transport himself and the kwamis to Nathalie to get food. After Alix retrieved the Rabbit Miraculous and Monarch was defeated, the kwamis witnessed Gabriel wallow in his defeat before his wife.
In "Multiplication", the kwamis are once more threatened by Gabriel in that he will use their powers.

title: Ziggy/History
text:
Ziggy/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Destruction", Ziggy watches as Gabriel tried to force Orikko to grant him powers and abilities the kwami could not grant and became upset when Gabriel called Orikko useless. They are then ordered to reveal the identity of their holder. Although they answer Ladybug is their holder, they are under the spell that prevents them from revealing her true identity since she never renounced them.
Finding a loophole, Gabriel forces Ziggy to tell him where Ladybug lives. Tearfully, Ziggy tells him to follow the scent of croissants to find her. Monarch teleports himself and the kwamis to Marinette's bedroom where Ziggy next tells him he now has to ask for the gift left to Marinette by Ladybug as part of a scavenger hunt in case the kwamis were unable to find their way back to her.

title: Ziggy/History
text:
Ziggy/History - [[Season 5]]
At the hall of wax statues, Monarch appears to be cornered by Ladybug and Cat Noir and the kwamis think they will be able to return to her until Monarch forces Cat Noir to hit him with his Cataclysm and teleport away with the kwamis pleading to stay with Ladybug. In a flashback, it is shown that Ziggy and the others don't know what an address is and had been taught by Marinette what to say if Monarch ever tried to learn where she lives.
At the end of the episode, Gabriel destroys all of the magic jewels and reform them into Alliance Rings.
In "Passion", Nathalie forces Monarch to akumatize her. She is transformed into Safari and was given the power of Passion, using the ability to create weapons that can track down and attack Ladybug and Cat Noir.
In "Deflagration", Gabriel plans to use the kwami's abilities to change the world now that there are new holders of the Ladybug and Black Cat Miraculouses. Like the others, she was shocked to hear Gabriel that knew the identities of the new holders and this would be his greatest chance to fulfill his wish.

title: Ziggy/History
text:
Ziggy/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Intuition", Monarch used Ziggy's powers during his latest scheme to catch Ladybug and Cat Noir. Her power of Genesis was used by Monarch to create a large asteroid in space that was on a direct collision course with Earth. Although Cat Noir suspected the asteroid was a distraction, he and Ladybug could not take the chance of the risk it posed and Cat Noir flew into space to destroy it. Fortunately, Monarch was not able to keep using Second Chance due to the damage it was causing his body and he was forced to undo his entire plan by resetting things to before he interfered.
In "Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)", Ladybug gets all of the Miraculous back and returns them to their original shapes. Because she was concerned about the Miraculous being taken again, she gave the chosen holders their magic jewels to keep and Ziggy was seen happily reuniting with Nathaniel.

title: Zoé's first room
text:
Zoé's first room - Appearance
Zoé's room is quite spacious and rectangular in shape. It has three large windows opening onto a balcony and allowing access. The walls of the room are pink and gray, while the ceiling is white with a rectangular pattern composed by two golden lines.
The room has a large double bed with a red blanket over which Zoe has installed a giant photograph of New York, her hometown. On each side of the bed, there is a small gray and golden bedside table with a bedside lamp of the same color placed on it. There is also a large wardrobe on which Zoe has put a large camera and a small camera, and another on the windows side.
Further on, the room has several white armchairs of various sizes surrounding a round transparent coffee table. There is also a laundry room near the front door and other dressers with lamps. There are also black sheet music tripods and camera stands. The gray area of the room undoubtedly delimits the bathroom and convenience of the room, this one being accessible through the door  towards the entrance, also on the gray wall is a poster of Kitty Section. The entire room is illuminated by small round ceiling lights.

title: Yo-yo/Movie
text:
Yo-yo/Movie - Intro
The Yo-yo is the tool of the Ladybug Miraculous.
The current owner of the yo-yo is Marinette Dupain-Cheng, who uses it as the superhero Ladybug.

title: Yo-yo/Movie
text:
Yo-yo/Movie - Appearance
The yo-yo is a red circle with a smooth surface and five black spots in a quincunx pattern, resembling Ladybug's earrings in charged mode. It has a design of shiny golden spirals that surround the spots. Ladybug usually attaches it around her hips when she's not using it. The length of the string is unlimited and can be controlled by willpower. The string is black and has a small red hoop to put around the user's finger at its end.

title: Yo-yo/Movie
text:
Yo-yo/Movie - Abilities
The yo-yo is extremely versatile, as Ladybug uses it as a weapon, both offensively and defensively, to hit enemies with it like a projectile or tie them up with its string. It works like a grappling hook, which Ladybug can swing from and use to travel far distances. The yo-yo's string never runs out and is unbreakable.
When swung in a circle very quickly, it lights up and creates a pink shield that can be able to deflect and withstand strong attacks. At times the Yo-yo can move on its own.
The yo-yo is useful for some of Ladybug's special abilities. Whenever something corrupts or infects an animal, like butterflies transformed into akumas with the power of the Butterfly Miraculous, the yo-yo can capture and purify them back to normal. The yo-yo opens up, showing glowing pink energy, and it closes around the infected animal. It opens again with them healed or clean, such as akumas getting purified into ordinary butterflies.

title: Yo-yo/Movie
text:
Yo-yo/Movie - Trivia
When the user is unsure of themselves or doubtful, the yo-yo will act of it's own accord or at least under Tikki's control.
Unlike the original, every time the yo-yo is spun, it plays the Ladybug Theme song.

title: Zoo
text:
Zoo - Intro
is a multifunctional mobile application and social network.

title: Zoo
text:
Zoo - Description
Zoo has the basic functions of a messaging app, allowing users to send text messages and make regular or video calls. It is also a social network service with the possibility of creating specific profiles, creating communities, and publishing statuses, photos or videos.
Backgrounds
The interface includes a button with the chosen profile type, another for messaging, one for calls and finally one for settings. When a user views an item published by another person, it is displayed with the color and symbol of the profile. Content can be commented, liked, reported or shared.
Its colors and backgrounds are based on the The Miraculers. Depending on the theme chosen by the user, the background will consists of the respective Miraculous' symbol. Additionally, the user's profile will also be visible to others with this background, with a logo that recalls their theme.

title: Zoo
text:
Zoo - Description
As seen in "Climatiqueen", all those themes are refered as communities. Those communities can interact with each other through a "like system" represented by hearts, although it is possible for certain members to block interactions from specific communities, like how Chloé managed to forbid users with Ladybug, Fox, Turtle, Goat and Horse themes from participating in her Bee community's contests. Media channels like TVi also have their own official themes used by their employees.

title: Yu Lu
text:
Yu Lu - Intro
is a secondary character in Miraculous World: Tokyo - Stellar Force and the animated spin-off series Miraculous Stellar Force. She is a student at Kano Academy, a hero and member of the Stellar Force. She is the current bearer of the Cancer Fragment, which allows her to become Cancer and one of the guardians who possess a fragment of the Stellar Matrix.

title: Yu Lu
text:
Yu Lu - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Yu Lu is appears to be a petite chubby Japanese teenager. She has light skin, gentle brilliant pink eyes with a single lash on each side, and shoulder length jet-black hair styled in low braids in the front. She has inward curled forelocks, short bangs with a small piece near the left and a parted middle, and rounded, thick eyebrows.
Civilian Attire
Yu Lu wears a pink cheongsam with lighter trim, wide cuffs, and pastel blue buttons, an ankle-length pastel pink skirt, white socks, and black loafers. She accessorizes with a baby clue cap tilted at right to match the bows holding her pigtails. She wears brilliant fuchsia glasses.
As Cancer

title: Yu Lu
text:
Yu Lu - Appearance
Cancer wears a jumpsuit shared with her teammates: a black jumpsuit with rectangular-detailed white elbow trim, abdomen, thigh trim, and shins. On her chest is a black four-point star. Her lower arms (except her fingers), torso, shoulders, inner thighs, sides of her knees, and feet are all pastel pink with black fingers and rectangular soles. Her helmet is black with a pastel pink chin, silver components covering her ears, and pastel pink pieces resembling her pigtails with the same bows from before and pastel blue bands. On her left wrist is her pastel pink and black watch, the Cancer Sprite.

title: Yu Lu
text:
Yu Lu - Personality
Yu Lu appears to be quite sensitive and easily prone to panicking. This is evident after Marinette texts on Kagami's phone to the group chat, raising concern to Yu Lu because she thought Kagami found out about them being superheroes. Yu Lu values keeping their heroic occupations a secret, suggesting she takes things seriously.

Cancer has enhanced physical abilities, such as speed, combat, agility and strength. With the help of the Cancer Sprite, she can summon her weapon, which is unknown.

title: Yu Lu
text:
Yu Lu - Etymology
The name Yu Lu is of Chinese origin, which combines the words "Yu" (玉, 愉, 雨) meaning "jade", "precious stone", "gem", "pleasant", "delightful" or "rain" respectfully and "Lu" (露, 禄, 陆, 鹿) meaning "dew", "blessing", "happiness", "prosperity", "land", "continent", "mainland" or "deer" respectfully.

However, it can also be associated with the color baby blue, which is quite fitting with how Yu Lu's accessories are that exact color to compliment her outfit.

title: Île aux Cygnes
text:
Île aux Cygnes - Intro
The  is an uninhabited artificial island in the Seine within Paris, France. It is most known for being the location of a replica of the Statue of Liberty.

title: Île aux Cygnes
text:
Île aux Cygnes - Appearance
The downstream tip of Île aux Cygnes is a scaled-down replica of the Statue of Liberty surrounded by palm trees and blue umbrellas with white stripes. Behind, there are white and blue beach cabins. Behind all this, the island is cut by the Pont de Grenelle. Under this bridge there is a large tunnel that allows in particular to install stands. A footbridge provides access to the central part of the island from the Pont de Grenelle.

title: Île aux Cygnes
text:
Île aux Cygnes - Sightings

title: Île aux Cygnes
text:
Île aux Cygnes - Trivia
The island has a small beach, which is where Ladybug and Cat Noir fight Silurus in the second issue of Miraculous Adventures.
The statue on the island is described in the comic as the original model of the Statue of Liberty, used as the prototype for the larger model given to America by France in 1886. However, the model on Île aux Cygnes was in fact created three years later in America as a gift to France. The actual prototype model is located in the Musée des Arts et Métiers in a different part of Paris.
Île aux Cygnes is one of the only locations to appear in "Miraculous Adventures" before an episode of the show.
Île aux Cygnes makes its first appearance in the show in the season 4 episode "Wishmaker".

title: Zoé Lee
text:
Zoé Lee - Intro
is a major character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She is a teenage girl from New York City, a student at Collège Françoise Dupont and a former student of Olga Mendeleiev's class, before Mayor Bustier reformed the school. She is also Noé Luxus' and Chloé Bourgeois' younger half-sister and André Bourgeois' stepdaughter.
In "Sole Crusher", after being tired of hiding her true self in order to please her half-sister, Zoé was akumatized by Shadow Moth into Sole Crusher ("Pirkell" in the French version), a golden supervillain who could absorb people and grow larger by stomping on or kicking them. She also received a Magical Charm from Ladybug that prevented her from being akumatized again.
In "Queen Banana", after Chloé was akumatized into the titular villain, Zoé received the Bee Miraculous from Ladybug. When the Miraculous is inhabited by Pollen, Zoé becomes Vesperia, a bee/wasp-themed superhero with the power of Action who helps Ladybug and Cat Noir during "particularly difficult missions" in the fourth season.

title: Zoé Lee
text:
Zoé Lee - Intro
After the events of "Strikeback", Zoé was temporarily unable to become Vesperia after Monarch managed to steal the Bee Miraculous along with all the others contained in the Chinese Miracle Box from Ladybug's yo-yo.
In "The Kwamis' Choice", in order to allow Adrien Agreste to be free to love Marinette, Plagg took back the Cat Miraculous from him and gave it to Zoé so she could take his place. When Plagg inhabited the Miraculous, Zoé became Kitty Noire ("Blaqueminette" in the French version), a cat-themed superhero with the power of Destruction who became Scarabella's partner when she got the Ladybug Miraculous. After Zoé's secret identity as Kitty Noire was uncovered by Monarch, he formulated a plan to take her Cat Miraculous, forcing her to give the Miraculous back to Cat Noir.
In "Adoration", at the end of the episode, it is revealed that Zoé has been in love with Marinette since their first encounter in "Sole Crusher".
In "Re-creation", after Ladybug recovered the stolen Miraculous and reforged them following Monarch's defeat, Zoé was given back the Bee Miraculous permanently and reunited with Pollen.

title: Zoé Lee
text:
Zoé Lee - Intro
In "Revelator", it's shown that, after getting her Miraculous back, Zoé, along with the other secondary heroes of Ladybug's team, was trained to unlock her adult powers, no longer detransforming after using her power.
In "Grendiaper", after repeatedly witnessing injustices committed by bullies and self-absorbed people, Zoé creates a new Bee Miraculous alter-ego to punish them: Fury, a black wasp-themed vigilante.

title: Zoé Lee
text:
Zoé Lee - Appearance
Physical Appearance
Zoé is a slender teenage girl with straight, wavy mid back-length honey-blonde hair that had a rounded gap at the right where her significantly shorter bangs are, with the ends reaching her shoulders and upper back while she has hot pink dyed strands on the left side from "Sole Crusher" (which was done by Rose Lavillant and Juleka Couffaine) onwards, the right bang being slightly wavy.
Her eyes are a vivid shade of azure and her eyebrows are honey-colored. She has peach skin, coral lips, and a dusting of light freckles over the bridge of her nose and cheeks.
From season 6 onwards, Zoé sports a new hairstyle that is half pinned back and at shoulder-length: she still has her hot pink streak with more of that color on the left side and a turquoise streak dyed on the right side of her bangs. Her bangs are also more framed at the center than at the right, with thinner strands sticking out on either side towards her face. Her hair is now held together by her Bee Miraculous. She also wears faint black eyeshadow.
Civilian Attire

title: Zoé Lee
text:
Zoé Lee - Appearance
In seasons 4-5, Zoé wore a black faux leather jacket with two horizontal silver studs on the collar and at the bottom along with a silver zipper, a white T-shirt with a honeycomb flower-like design on the front, the petals being pink, the center being yellow, and the leaves in the top right and bottom left corners being mint to accent the lining on the shirt, and an orange belt with bronze zigzag patterns and a gray buckle as well as skinny yellow sport jeans that have a small ripped part on the right of her knee that was a pink, lime-green, and blue star design with black outlining to match her sneaker designs.

title: Zoé Lee
text:
Zoé Lee - Appearance
At each side of the pants were two tiny horizontal studs on top. On her feet, her sneakers had white shoelaces, toe caps and soles. The sides of her sneakers were decorated with blue, lime-green and pink heart and star patterns with black outlines. There was a moderate apple green crown and a white dice design on the left side of her right shoe and a white skull on the left side of her left shoe. The midsole of the shoes seemed to be decorated with different drawings that appeared to be drawn with a black permanent marker with a black line across the sole. The right sole had red and black shapes drawn on it, while the left sole had black details including a upper half outline of a cat face on it. The left shoe had a red heart drawn on the toe cap that read "I♡︎U".
At the end of "Sole Crusher", her shoes got more drawings from her new friends. On her left wrist, she also wore a two blue-brown beaded bracelets and a half red-and-yellow patterned white bracelet with black lining on each and a luminous vivid opal-colored beanie on her head.

title: Zoé Lee
text:
Zoé Lee - Appearance
She wore a drawstring bag. It had dark grayish tangelo with lighter tangelo strings. In the middle, it was black and bush-like with two blue triangles on top and bottom. surrounding it, it had a light brilliant crimson rhombus. After that, it had a small blue outline and finally, a thick black outline with white squiggles in the middle. Then it had three faded blue square patterns in each corner. On the top sides of the bag, it had brilliant raspberry-colored strings tied together. On the bottom of the black lozenge diamond, it had a white bead studded on it and three white leather strings attached to the bottom of it.
From season 6 onwards, Zoé has a new but similar outfit: her leather jacket is longer, her sport jeans are replaced with a yellow high waisted pencil skirt with a slight side slit at left to reveal matching-colored shorts, and below are black and gray striped tights. She no longer wears her beanie, and her Miraculous used to hold her hair back is now made of three hexagons with pink lining and light rose segments when they connected together inside, with the antennae pink with round metallic dull pink tips. She no longer wears her drawstring bag.
As Vesperia

title: Zoé Lee
text:
Zoé Lee - Appearance
In seasons 4-5, Vesperia wore a yellow and black swan-necked, bee and wasp hybrid formed superhero jumpsuit, which had a leather texture. The upper part of the suit was black with six large yellow angular stripes on the torso and a smaller ones on the upper arm sections that pointed down to the yellow forearms and hands with black fingers.
She had a yellow zipper at the front with a slider made of a gold V-shaped part with a black diamond piece on top, making it look like she was wearing a jacket. The lower part of the suit was yellow with three horizontal rows of two black angular stripes on the leg. The ankles were black with a triangular cut in the middle. She wore short black boots with a yellow stripe at the collar, tongue and toe cap, as well as angular lining around the sole and a yellow angular mask with thick black lining. Her hair was braided into a ponytail at neck length with a black streak and her bangs were of equal length and turned black.
The Bee Miraculous was located right above of the base of her braid as the shape of a bee on a gold comb, holding two black antenna-like ribbons, similar to Chloé's form as Queen Bee.

title: Zoé Lee
text:
Zoé Lee - Appearance
From season 6 onwards, Vesperia's costume undergoes some changes. Her mask's lower half accents become more triangular and frame the bottom corners. The colors of her suit reverse significantly to resemble an actual wasp. The torso is now a warmer yellow and the stripes are now black except for the bottom row, but the neck and shoulders remain black, the slider included. However, the zipper is also black, with the upper black parts having a downward triangular point to the chest. The upper arms and stripe switch colors, while there are faint linear bumps around the arms to make the upper half of the suit more akin to a jacket. This is complemented below the legs, where they are now black entirely with wide angular zigzagged ends and the top being V-shaped with a yellow stripe on each hip and two more on each leg. The bottom legs are still yellow, but with only two black stripes at the sides, while the boots invert in color entirely.

title: Zoé Lee
text:
Zoé Lee - Appearance
She now has the Bee Miraculous symbol on her back that is black in color with an altered design, having small antennae to look more akin to a bee. Her hairstyle also alters a little, having the bangs become two-layered with more blonde locks beneath the black bangs. There are also small black amounts pulled back at the sides at the back of her head, and her hair ribbons are gone.
As Kitty Noire
As Kitty Noire, Zoé had a hairstyle that somewhat resembled Cat Noir's with a bob-length spikier cut as compared to her civilian form, coupled with full, spiky bangs and with green highlights starting around her temples and ending on the tips of her hair. She had cat-like eyes with yellow sclerae, dark orange irises, and slitted pupils and lips covered in a yellow-green lipstick and black cat ears on top of her head.

title: Zoé Lee
text:
Zoé Lee - Appearance
She wore a black compression shirt topped with a swan-necked cropped black jacket that ended around her mid-chest area with 3/4 length sleeves. The jacket had green zippers around the shoulders and at the edges of the sleeves, and closed with two silver buttons on the front. On her lower body, she wore high-waisted capri pants with the same fabric as her jacket, with a golden button and green front pockets. She also wore green suspenders that went under her jacket and connected to the waistband of her pants, and a long, black ribbon on her lower back that ended around her ankles, simulating a cat's tail. On her feet, she wore green socks and black sneakers with a green sole and stripe on the back, and black cat-paws prints on the undersoles.
Kitty Noire also had black biker gloves on both of her hands, and sharp, black claw-like nails on her fingers. The jacket, the pants, and the gloves had a similar purple sheen to the fabric, and a leather-like texture.
Her Miraculous sat on the ring finger of her right hand, and her weapon, the staff, was now black (as opposed to Cat Noir's and Lady Noire's, which were both silver), and rests retracted on her lower back when not in use.

title: Zoé Lee
text:
Zoé Lee - Appearance
As Sole Crusher
As Sole Crusher, Zoé was a hybrid form of her older half-sister, having her physical look (like face and hairstyle), and her mother's akumatized form as Style Queen.
Her hair, eyes, teeth, skin and clothes (which were the same as Chloé's) were sparkly brilliant amber with encrusted very light cyan-colored jewel diamonds with a large one on her forehead, medium sized ones on top of her eyebrows, and tiny ones on her head. There were five more on the chest that gradually enlarged towards the chest, the rest of the jewel diamonds circling her limbs and waist entirely as well as at the back of her flats. There were also six jewel diamonds on the back of her jacket. Her headdress-like accessory featured multiple lightning-shaped horns, matched by her jacket collar, the back of her shoulders, and flats that had similar ornaments. She also had jewel diamond earrings on her ears.
She wore her half-sister's diamond heels, which also transform with her, became glittering gold with light cyan-colored jewel diamonds embedded in them. The ends had protrusions resembling thorns or lightning bolts.
As Fury

title: Zoé Lee
text:
Zoé Lee - Appearance
Fury wears a black full body jumpsuit. There is lighter padding across her suit, which consists of two thick downward points on her chest, accented by the padding on her shoulders and down her limbs, which give a similar, but not identical look to her outfit as Vesperia. Her feet also have inward points at the back of the sole. There are padded lines running down the sides of her stomach down to the leg.
Fury also has a black hood with lighter padding that wraps around upwardly at the sides and conceals her Miraculous, along with a black mask that covers her entire face with black spikes that resemble the teeth on a wasp. The upper half of it is specifically lighter, with downward padding on top and sides framing her eyes, and a point in the middle of her nose. The lower half is darker and accents this.
On top are black appendages resembling the antennae of a wasp. Her eyes become a light, piercing bright yellow with pitch black pupils. Her stinger appears to be black and rounder in design.

title: Zoé Lee
text:
Zoé Lee - Personality
Zoé is a sweet, helpful, thoughtful, and generous girl. She is quite creative, as seen with her dying her hair and customizing her own shoes. She is also very caring and friendly to anyone that crosses her way, even able to befriend someone she has just met, even if it may be the hardest thing like her half-sister, Chloé Bourgeois. Since Marinette Dupain-Cheng was the first person to be kind to her after her arrival in Paris, Zoé shows great loyalty to Marinette that despite having her own feelings for her, Zoé lets her be with the one she loves and saw her as great friend. Zoé can connect with those who are normally withdrawn and have similar insecurities, like Marc Anciel and Sabrina Raincomprix.

title: Zoé Lee
text:
Zoé Lee - Personality
Her greatest dream is to become an actress as she is very skilled at doing so. However, because she was constantly acting a role, Zoé ended up concealing her true self and, when she was not able to do it anymore, she ended up having no friends back in New York and even become target of bullying to the point she had to move. In "Sole Crusher", after moving to Paris to live with her maternal family, she pretends to be like her mother and older half-sister in order to please and be accepted by them. After being deakumatized, she learned that the way she was acting was wrong and decided to finally stop hiding her true self but not completely. However, despite learning not to let Chloé get in her way in things she likes (like taking her role as the star of Miss Bustier's class movie project), Zoé still avoids any type of conflict with Chloé in order to not give her any excuse to convince her parents, especially Audrey Bourgeois, to send her back to New York. This goes as far as avoiding any place inside the hotel where she is not allowed and where Chloé may be and/or doing any menial task for her, like cleaning all of her shoes, in order to appease her anger.

title: Zoé Lee
text:
Zoé Lee - Personality
Zoé has a protective instinct towards her loved ones and those in need, which leads Ladybug to choose her as the new holder of the Bee Miraculous. In "Optigami", despite her strained relationship with Chloé, she tries to protect her half-sister before Style Queen hit her. In "Deflagration", when Chloé tries to humiliate Marinette by trying to ridicule her dream of being Adrien Agreste's girlfriend, Zoé, moved by her desire to protect Marinette’s happiness, gathers the courage she needed to confront her half-sister and drags her away from the duo so she'll leave them alone. In "Daddycop", when the other girls express their dislike for Sabrina for all the times she and Chloé picked on them, Zoé stands up for her, reminding her friends that if it wasn't for Sabrina, they'd still be suffering from Chloé's relentless bullying.

title: Zoé Lee
text:
Zoé Lee - Personality
Although Zoé tries to appear confident, she is terrified of making mistakes and feels anxious about the idea of ​​others being disappointed in her. In "Queen Banana", Zoé was hesitant in taking the Bee Miraculous knowing how Chloé would react at first, but Ladybug reassures her that unlike Chloé, she'll keep her identity a secret. In "Deflagration," she felt unworthy for having her identity as Kitty Noire revealed to Monarch via the effects of Venom and of the Alliance Ring, causing the latter to be renounced off-screen when actually it wasn't her fault. She is also afraid of her friends to discover her past actions back when she was pretending to be mean back in New York to the point of letting herself falling victim of Ray Pugnant's (her classmate from her previous school and has transferred to her school in Paris) blackmail of revealing her past to her current friends, forcing herself to pass a blind eye to his gang's transgressions.

title: Zoé Lee
text:
Zoé Lee - Personality
Her past as victim of bullying has caused her to develop a strong dislike for bullies, especially when they are unpunished for their actions. In "Grendiaper", witnessing different situations where people got away with harming others, Zoé's frustration and desire to make them pay grew to the point she was unable to contain it, something that manifested when she, when trying to transform into Vesperia, turned into a new superhero identity. When confused about what to do, she seeked advice from Ladybug. However, she felt dissatisfied and secretly carried out vigilante justice under her new superhero identity. After noticing how this work had caused an akumatization and further trouble, Zoé let her vengeful nature subside, especially after watching the people she punished have justice served to them. That wouldn't prevent her from continuing her vigilante work when she thought it was necessary. It is seen in "Sleeping Syren", where she went to punish Ray and his friends after they tried to spilt Kim and Ondine up and were conspiring to do the same to another couple.

title: Zoé Lee
text:
Zoé Lee - Personality
As Vesperia, Zoé is more self-assured and acts in a flashy way, proving to be very clever using her acting skills. Like a bee, she is bold and works in tandem with her teammates. After becoming a vigilante, she embraces her rebellious spirit and her instinct to fight against the injustices she sees around her, believing that people who have done wrong, even if their actions led them to be akumatized, must be held accountable for their deeds, even if that makes her appear to be the villain.
As Kitty Noire, she was shown to be rather competent and skillful when using her powers. She was able to take the right initiative like using her Cataclysm to get access to the villain's akumatized object, failing only because of unexpected events (like the use of Resistance). Kitty Noire was also able to cooperate very well with others, even when she had just met them, as she was able to make great teamwork with Scarabella moments after they had just met each other, with the two of them quickly coming up with a plan together to defeat a villain and execute it perfectly. Similar to Cat Noir, she had a little of a flirtatious side.

title: Zoé Lee
text:
Zoé Lee - Personality
As Fury, she takes on vigilante work, targeting individuals who are abusive toward others. She executes her missions swiftly and efficiently, using Venom and her super-speed to place her targets in humiliating or dangerous situations as a form of punishment. Fury makes an effort to remain discreet, fully aware that if other Miraculers suspect she is a holder of the Butterfly Miraculous, her identity could be revealed by Ladybug—the only person who knows her true identity—who would insist on reclaiming the Bee Miraculous.

title: Zoé Lee
text:
Zoé Lee - Personality
As Sole Crusher, she was much more confident and refused to let others boss her around, However, she was still willing to please Chloé as she initially considered crushing Kitty Section just to be like her but she decided against it. Despite her villainous nature, Sole Crusher still cared for Marinette, as shown when she carried her around in her hand rather than absorbing her because she remembered her kindness when they first met, and was almost willing to stand down when the latter tried to reason with her. She was also shown to not be willing to harm Marinette or her friends when Chloé tried to convince her to attack Kitty Section, and her hesitance and reluctance to do so caused Chloé to threaten her. Even while akumatized, she maintained her calmness and patience as shown when she allowed Marinette to continue explaining reality to her. Even after continuing her rampage, she opted to continue targeting Chloé instead of Marinette's friends.

title: Zoé Lee
text:
Zoé Lee - Abilities
As a Civilian
Zoé is very good at acting, being able to convince others she possesses a much different personality than the one she truly has as she was able to convince her mother and older half-sister she was just like them. In "Queen Banana", a scene from a movie shows her skillfully wielding a toy sword demonstrating that she has good fencing skills. Additionally, since joining the electronics, gardening, cooking, arts, and poetry workshops, she has been steadily developing skills in all of these areas.
As Vesperia/Fury
Vesperia has enhanced capabilities such as speed, agility, and strength, and she is almost invulnerable to physical damage. These abilities allow her to react to and evade akumatized villains attacks, as well as jump and leap several times her height and length. Her tool is a spinning top, which she uses to defend herself against attacks from akumatized villains and as a communication device, with her being able to call upon any superhero of her team.

title: Zoé Lee
text:
Zoé Lee - Abilities
She can also use her spinning top to activate her power, Venom, which allows her to immobilize her opponents by hitting them with it when it's charged with the superpower's energy. This ability makes her an excellent asset to the team, as she can paralyze enemies in order to defuse situations.
Iniatially, using her power would depower her and cause her to detransform after 5 minutes, however, in "Revelator", it is shown that Vesperia has learned to control her adult powers, allowing her to not detransform back and use Venom as much as she wishes.
As Kitty Noire
As Kitty Noire, Zoé had the same abilities as the most recent Cat Miraculous holder, Cat Noir. She had enhanced physical characteristics such as speed, strength and agility. She also used the staff and had the superpower Cataclysm, which allowed her to destroy anything she touched.
As Sole Crusher

title: Zoé Lee
text:
Zoé Lee - Abilities
As Sole Crusher, Zoé could absorb any person she kicked or stomped with her shoes on. The more people she absorbed, the taller and larger she grew, eventually becoming a giant. Her physical strength increases considerably as she grows, allowing her to cause significant damage and overpower her opponents. As a giant, she has high resistance to physical damage and due to her immense size and thick skin, she is highly resistant to any attack, making her nearly indestructible to conventional attacks.
However, because of her size, it was hard for her to move freely in tight spaces or catch those who have speed, she had lower speed than her enemies (Ladybug and Cat Noir). Not only that, her shoes made her easy to tumble and they seriously affect her balance, especially after she gets big, and when the heels were broken, especially by Cataclysm, she had difficulty in moving.

title: Zoé Lee
text:
Zoé Lee - Etymology
The name Zoé means "life" in Greek.
Zoé's surname Lee means "meadow/a meadow, clearing/forest clearing" in Old English or of Korean/Chinese origin.
Lee can be used as a given name or a surname.
The name of Zoé's akumatized form Sole Crusher is a pun and combination of the noun "sole", the bottom part of a shoe and the saying "soul crusher", used to describe someone who is cruel and discouraging.
Sole Crusher's French name, Pirkell is a pun on "Pire qu'elle", meaning "Worse than her", referencing her resembling Chloé Bourgeois.
Sole Crusher's Latin American Spanish name, Reina Aplastante meaning "Crushing Queen", referencing her mother and Chloé was called by "Queen" word when they were akumatized.
Sole Crusher's European Portuguese name, Calcatriz, is a pun between the words "Calcanhar" (Heel in English) and "Imperatriz" (Empress in English).
Vesperia's name is derived from the Italian word vespa, which means wasp.
In Latin, the name Vesperia means 'Evening Star'.
Vesperia's suit is meant to resemble a Hymenoptera.

title: Zoé Lee
text:
Zoé Lee - Trivia
Character Design and Development
Sole Crusher's initial design had her covered in diamonds before switching to gold.
The pattern on Vesperia's suit was changed late into the production of Season 4: she was initially going to have horizontal stripes over her torso.
Miraculous Holder and Akumatized Villain
Zoé, alongside Juleka Couffaine, Nino Lahiffe, Kagami Tsurugi, Lê Chiến Kim, and Sabrina Raincomprix, are the only current members of the Miraculers to whom Ladybug gave a Magical Charm.
Sole Crusher's ability is similar to Gamer's Robot's ability in that both absorb victims and grow larger from it.
Zoé is the first person in Ms. Mendeleiev's class who uses a Miraculous.
So far, Zoé, Marc and Luka are the only members of the Miraculers that have not met nor interacted with Lila/Cerise, who in season 6 onwards becomes the supervillain Chrysalis.
In "Miraculous: Paris Under Siege", after André Bourgeois cancelled the Aset exhibition due to the centerpiece being broken, due to the anger at her hard work going to waste, she was re-akumatized into Sole Crusher alongside Lady Wifi, Truth, and The Bubbler, working with Stormy Weather to take over Paris using Aset's power.
Miscellaneous

title: Émilie Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Émilie Agreste - Intro
Lady  (born Graham de Vanily) was a minor yet pivotal character of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. She was the daughter of Emil & Milly Graham de Vanily, the wife of the late Gabriel Agreste, the mother of Adrien Agreste, the older twin sister of Amélie Graham de Vanily, the sister-in-law of the late Colt Fathom and the maternal aunt of Félix Fathom. She was also a former actress who played the lead in the film Solitude.
Émilie was also an aristocrat from the noble Graham de Vanily family who renounced her title to marry Gabriel.
Émilie was a former Peacock Miraculous holder. It is revealed in "Representation" that she used it to create her son, with the Miraculous' formerly damaged nature being the cause of her coma. She was in Gabriel's repository, where she was kept in a glass coffin. In "Re-creation", she and Gabriel went to the afterlife after the latter sacrificed his life to heal Nathalie and create a new world.

title: Émilie Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Émilie Agreste - Appearance
Physical appearance
Émilie was a thin and fair-skinned woman who greatly resembled her son. She had a small nose, a pointy chin, thin lips, upturned green eyes, thin eyebrows, and long pale blonde hair which she kept in a side ponytail.
Civilian Attire
Émilie wore a light pink long-sleeved jacket with a black stripe on the edges of the jacket over a black blouse with a pearl-amberish white stripe on the edges of the blouse and a silver five-petaled brooch shaped like a flower with five petals and a pearl. She also wore light pink business pants and black ankle-strap heels.

title: Émilie Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Émilie Agreste - Personality
Émilie was stated to be kind-hearted and loving towards her family.  According to Gabriel, she was stubborn and headstrong when it came to other people's safety meaning she also cared and loved other people, similar to Adrien. Gabriel also said in "Simon Says" that Émilie was "way too overly dramatic".
Since Gabriel called the use of the Peacock Miraculous "their" mistake, it's implied that Émilie knew that the jewel was damaged too showing her recklessness, and determination.
Like her husband, Émilie didn't fully account for the consequences of her actions by using the broken Miraculous. And yet, her intuition was right as she knew what was going to happen if Gabriel fell into his obsession mentioning herself that no one else should suffer to fix their mistake. Also as well as likely knowing by the time her husband had figured it out that he could only have her or their son nor suffer a terrible fate if he went through with the wish she knew that he would have to make an impossible choice or go mad in trying to have them both or everything so she made the choice for him so he wouldn't have too.

title: Émilie Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Émilie Agreste - Personality
However, in her weakened state, she worried about her husband's obsession with the Miraculouses and  entrusted Nathalie to help him and to take care of her son, knowing that Adrien would need both of them in her absence. She even left prerecorded video messages for both of them before falling into her coma, which also demonstrated that she was aware of her fate and accepted it.
According to her nephew's play in "Representation", Émilie was named the heiress of the Graham de Vanily family because she was born seven seconds older than her twin sister Amélie. Being the first-born twin also made her the owner of the Graham de Vanily Twin Rings. As they grew up, they had opposite personalities; while her sister Amélie was responsible, obedient, and wanted to please her parents however she could, Émilie was described as curious, brazen, and adventurous in her youth. Despite the prestige of her status, she hated the limitations of the noble life and tried to escape it at every chance.

title: Émilie Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Émilie Agreste - Personality
Although Émilie's unruly personality frightened her parents (mostly her father) and made them question whether they had entrusted their family's future to the right daughter, her mother believed she would mature and fall in line over time. They sent her to Paris for education and discipline. While Émilie was in Paris, she met Gabriel, and fell madly in love with him. However, her family was furious about her relationship and forbade it, but Émilie willingly renounced her title, rank, and wealth to be together with Gabriel, showing that she did not value money and prestige to be happy and was not afraid to sacrifice for the people she loved. By shedding her wealth, Émilie found out she wasn't so different from everyone else.
Shortly after she and Gabriel were married, they wanted a child, but their hopes were dashed when she and her sister Amélie were infertile. Even with the best medical treatments the twins received from their parents, nothing worked. Émilie really wanted to be a mother, showing her strong desire for what she wanted. The love and desire she felt for her own family made her compassionate for others families as she couldn't rip them apart just to stay with her own.

title: Émilie Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Émilie Agreste - Personality
She still cared for her twin sister and felt sorry as she was also infertile and asked Gabriel to help her and Colt to have a child with the Peacock Miraculous; this showed that she loved and cared for her sister, even though she didn't have a good relationship with her parents.

title: Émilie Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Émilie Agreste - Abilities
As a civilian
Émilie was a professional actress, implying considerable skill in this field. In "Feast", after doing a duet with Plagg on the piano, Adrien mentioned that she was the only one who made him laugh in the way Plagg did, implying at some point she learned to play the piano. She also used to teach her son.
As a Miraculous holder
The Peacock Miraculous granted her enhanced physical abilities, a hand fan as her tool, and Amokization as her superpower, allowing her to manifest emotions of herself or others into physical form to create sentimonsters. Émilie presumably only used the power of the Miraculous once, to create her son Adrien. But since the Miraculous was damaged, Émilie fell very ill, with her health slowly deteriorating as it did with Nathalie. After she eventually became too weak to even speak properly, she fell into a coma and passed away, devastating her husband and son, and also leading Gabriel to becoming unhinged with madness and grief.

title: Émilie Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Émilie Agreste - Trivia
Thomas Astruc revealed Émilie's existence by releasing an image of her hugging Adrien as a sneak peek with the caption, "Where is she?"
The image of Émilie used as Adrien's computer background is actually a real-life photo of Canadian voice actress Tara Strong, with the top changed from magenta to blue and Émilie's face edited over Tara's face.
The writers admitted at an event that they modeled Émilie's design on Tara, whom they favor because of her work.
At Tara Strong's 2016 Q&A panel at Indy Popcon, a fan asked her if she was aware of the photo resembling her. Though she agreed, there were definite similarities, she had no knowledge of it until then.
There is a portrait of Émilie in Gabriel's atelier in the Agreste mansion where it resembles Gustav Klimt's Portrait of Adele Bloch-Bauer I, commonly known as The Woman in Gold or The Lady in Gold.
Behind the painting, there is a secret safe, in which Gabriel keeps the Peacock Miraculous and a booklet that reads "TIBET" in big green letters in front of a picture of her.
The painting has hidden buttons that open the secret entrance to Hawk Moth's lair.

title: Émilie Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Émilie Agreste - Trivia
In "Party Crasher", it's revealed that Émilie had a collection of old records, which Adrien keeps in his room.
In "Gorizilla", it's revealed that because of the emotional attachment that Gabriel has to the film Solitude due to Émilie's role in it, he forbade his son from watching it, though he later changed his mind.
A picture of Émilie is inside of the Butterfly Miraculous.
Throughout many episodes, it's hinted that Gabriel wants the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses to bring Émilie back from her coma.
In "Evolution", Gabriel used the Rabbit Miraculous and traveled to the day he gave Émilie the Peacock Miraculous to save her from becoming sick, but he lost his chance because of his obsession with Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses.
In "Santa Claws", it's revealed that Émilie disappeared sometime in the last year as it is Adrien's first Christmas without her.
A future episode will track the relationship between Émilie and Gabriel.
However, it's unclear if this episode is "Representation", where Félix reveals to Marinette how his aunt and uncle met and got married.

title: Émilie Agreste
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Émilie Agreste - Trivia
In the Miraculous Secrets webisode "Gabriel", Gabriel says he and Émilie used the Peacock Miraculous and if they hadn't, she "wouldn't be where [she] is now", revealing that the Miraculous is responsible for her current condition.
It remains unknown as to why and how Émilie used the Peacock Miraculous enough to render her comatose. However in "Representation", it was revealed by Félix that Émilie was infertile and used the Peacock Miraculous to become pregnant with Adrien and his amok is in the Graham de Vanily Twin Rings.
It was confirmed in "Evolution" that Gabriel gave her the damaged Peacock Miraculous as a gift asking if she was ready to use it and Émilie said yes, this could imply that Émilie was aware that the Miraculous was damaged and the risk it could have for her.
On Twitter, Thomas stated that Émilie's "death" is public knowledge and there was a funeral for her.
Due to her having English origins, Émilie is the second Miraculous holder to have such origins followed by her son and nephew but preceded by Dark Grimalkin.
Like Gilbert du Motier, she was second person to use a Miraculous but not in same place she was born in.

title: Émilie Agreste

Émilie Agreste - Trivia
In "Werepapas", it is revealed she was to be the Duchess of Westchester-Munster.
She is seven seconds older than her twin sister.
She is the second British character to appear in the series, following her son, Adrien.
Émilie's name is a combination of her parents', Emil and Milly.
Additionally, herself, Adrien, and her father share the similar name "Emil", reminiscent of the latter.
