title: Zoé Lee/History
text:
Zoé Lee/History - Intro
Zoé Lee is a teenage girl in Ms. Mendeleiev's class and the current user of the Bee Miraculous, Vesperia.

title: Zoé Lee/History
text:
Zoé Lee/History - Before Season 4
Zoé is the daughter of Audrey Bourgeois' affair to Mr.
Lee, making Chloé Bourgeois her older maternal half-sister and André Bourgeois her stepfather.
Despite her parents residing in the same city, Zoé lived most of her life within a boarding school in New York, where she was surrounded by people who accepted her friendship and her status as Audrey's daughter, one of them being Raymond Pugnant.
However, afraid of her school mates' acceptance being revoked, she made a fake persona to easily gain their approval, acting cruelly to the point of Ray having recorded material to serve as blackmail.
But she disliked pretending to be someone she was not and, unable to keep up her facade forever, Zoé decided to reveal her true self to her school mates.
Despite her hopes of being accepted for who she truly was, she was crushed as her school mates ended their friendship and ridiculed her for being someone they did not approve of.
Out of all her former friends in New York, only one remained with her, this one friend's words of affection would later be drawn by Zoé on her shoe in an effort to remember their kind words.

title: Zoé Lee/History
text:
Zoé Lee/History - Before Season 4
Unfortunately, her one time attempt at revealing her true self in New York also resulted in her being bullied by her former friends for her remaining  time at the boarding school to the point when they put cockroaches in her locker.
Due to the severe bullying but still hopeful she could have a chance to find somewhere she can belong, Zoé left school and moved to Paris to meet her family, hoping to find a better life and a fresh start there.

title: Zoé Lee/History
text:
Zoé Lee/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Sole Crusher", on her way to Le Grand Paris, she ended up in the Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie and bumped into Marinette Dupain-Cheng. The two bonded over Marinette's clumsiness and Zoé's creativity before she went to Le Grand Paris. Scared of not fitting in with her mother and half-sister, she imitated their behavior in hopes they'll accept her. When she first met Chloé, the latter started to explain her expectations for her sister, including belittling everyone and using her step-father as a tool to get what she wanted. At school, she acted hostile to everyone and was transferred to Ms. Mendeleiev's class, but Zoé was aware of her cruel attitude. It reached the point when Chloé proposed they fill Marinette's locker with cockroaches, and Zoé went to the balcony in despair. She was comforted by André Bourgeois and encouraged to cast aside her interests to fit in, but her distress left her vulnerable to Shadow Moth's akumatization.

title: Zoé Lee/History
text:
Zoé Lee/History - [[Season 4]]
After becoming Sole Crusher, she chased down Chloé and kidnapped Marinette. When Chloé tried to manipulate her into attacking Kitty Section and threaten her sending her back to New York, Marinette tried to reason with her and told her the concept of "winner and loser" doesn't exist and reveals all Chloé's false beliefs and lies to her and told her that everyone is unique with their unique interests, unique qualities and individualities. Despite a brief interruption from Cat Noir, who annoyed Sole Crusher, Marinette told her that she might trip or fall, but she will always have someone like her to help her back up and she will always be there for her, which the latter became touched, before Shadow Moth interferes, convincing Sole Crusher otherwise and threatening her of taking away her powers if she disobeys him again. Later she was stopped by Ladybug and Cat Noir, who deakumatized her and gave her a Magical Charm for protection.

title: Zoé Lee/History
text:
Zoé Lee/History - [[Season 4]]
Later that night, Zoé went to the Liberty for a concert, where she apologized to everyone for her behavior and explained her insecurities about fitting in. Afterwards she was reassured she's fine the way she was, became friends with the teens, and stood up for Chloé's expectations when she returned home. André safely escorted her to her new room, and she later sent Marinette a photo montage of all her new memories and friendships in Paris, including adding more doodles to her sneakers and dying part of her bangs bright pink.

title: Zoé Lee/History
text:
Zoé Lee/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Queen Banana", Zoé participated in the school's movie project, as one of the lead characters of the movie "Kreatika". However, she was forced to forfeit the role when Chloé took full control of the movie. After her sister left, Zoé was given her lead role back, but it resulted in Chloé's akumatization into Queen Banana She was led to safety by Marinette, but, feeling responsible for Chloé's akumatization, Zoé came out of hiding and attempted to reason with her by surrendering herself in exchange for Paris' safety. She failed as Queen Banana sarcastically agreed and continued to attack civilians. Before being attacked, she was saved by Ladybug and taken to a secluded location in the subway where Queen Banana's car could not enter. Zoé was asked by the heroine for her help to defeat Queen Banana, receiving the Bee Miraculous. Zoé, who despite being a little hesitant at first, accepted the power and used the Bee Miraculous to transform into Vesperia.

title: Zoé Lee/History
text:
Zoé Lee/History - [[Season 4]]
Afterwards, she went to help Cat Noir fight against Chloé's sentimonster, which went out of control after being touched by his Cataclysm. As she gained the attention of the sentimonster, Vesperia quickly avoided his attacks and used Venom to paralyze it where it stood.
Then, she introduced herself to Cat Noir, who humbly welcomed her to the team, before informing him that Ladybug needed their help. Due to them having already used their powers, the pair momentarily separated to feed their kwamis in order to re-transform. Despite Queen Banana being left without her sentimonster and go-kart, she managed to take Ladybug hostage. Using her sister's temper to their advantage, Vesperia became the target, being turned into a banana instead, but thanks to her, the heroes managed to defeat Queen Banana. After being restored, she watched as Chloé refused Ladybug's magical charm and ran away. Knowing the importance of Chloé having the magical charm to prevent akumatizations, Vesperia had an idea on how to effectively persuade Chloé to accept the charm.

title: Zoé Lee/History
text:
Zoé Lee/History - [[Season 4]]
After de-transforming, Zoé reunited with Chloé in order to tell her that she will always love her as a true sister no matter what. Knowing fully well of Chloé's admiration for their mother, Zoé then tricked her into thinking the magical charm was a gift Audrey had given her but was more than happy to give to her once she requested it, causing Chloé to accept and use it, preventing any more akumatizations.
In "Gabriel Agreste", Zoé and her friends came up a plan to get Marinette and Adrien together, with the help of Nathaniel and Marc. Chloé had recorded the whole meeting and intended to show Gabriel so he would lock up his son at home and never again allow Adrien to go to school again.
Marinette asked Zoé if she was invited to Gabriel's dinner party and able to stop Chloé, but she explained that Chloé somehow convinced her mom to leave her at home. The group soon devised a plan to sneak Marinette in.
Zoé told the butler that the meeting's location had changed, and later coached Marinette from the latter's room.

title: Zoé Lee/History
text:
Zoé Lee/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Mega Leech", she attended her stepfather's project ceremony along with her sister Chloé until she was controlled by a mini Malediktator. Once she was freed by a Polymouse, she was then given the Bee Miraculous again to paralyze Mega Leech. After the job was done, she returned the Bee Miraculous to Ladybug.
In "Crocoduel", she watched Kitty Section preform with her friends, then realized Luka was upset that Marinette wasn't coming to their performances anymore. Zoé and the others came up with a plan to have Marinette see Luka again at his and Juleka's birthday party in an effort to help them reconcile, and helped set up.

title: Zoé Lee/History
text:
Zoé Lee/History - [[Season 4]]
On the twins' birthday, she arrived with Marinette and her friends with presents to the party, which took place on the Liberty. After Marinette ran to hide from Luka, she and the others comforted him, which prevented his akumatization. Upon learning that Jagged Stone was Luka's and Juleka's father, she expressed delight along with everyone else and continued the party. However, when Luka and Juleka's parents were akumatized, she ran off the boat and watched the battle. She helped Alya when she had faked an injury. After the titular villains' defeat, she and everyone returned to the boat to continue the party.

title: Zoé Lee/History
text:
Zoé Lee/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Optigami", she was present at the ceremony for the Fashion Icon of the Month of the Style Queen magazine, as well as the moment her mother is akumatized after being humiliated by Sentialec. She shared a hiding place with Chloé as their mother continued her attacks. After Chloé left their hiding place to tell the villain where Sentialec went, Zoé tried to make sister hide again. When Style Queen tried to turn Chloé into glitter for laughing at her, Zoé was used as a human shield, and the they ended up being turned into glitter together. After Style Queen's defeat, she and everyone else were restored.
In "Ephemeral", Vesperia fought Moolak alongside Ladybug and the rest of the team. She suggested Cat Noir using his Cataclsym, but due to is absence, the team conjured another plan. She used her Venom, protected by Carapace.
In "Kuro Neko", she used her Venom on Gigantitan, which allowed Ladybug to capture the akuma.

title: Zoé Lee/History
text:
Zoé Lee/History - [[Season 4]]
In "Penalteam", Vesperia was recruited once again into Ladybug's team to subdue her akumatuized half-sister. She and Purple Tigress helped protect the area next to their goal, and passed the ball to Rooster Bold. Once the latter scored a goal, she and Polymouse exchanged a high five.
When Ladybug devised a plan after Penalty extended the time, Vesperia pointed out that they could not see their powers indefinitely. After the round started, she paralyzed one of Penalty's clones and passed the ball to Rooster Bold.

title: Émilie Agreste/Movie
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Émilie Agreste/Movie - Differences
Émilie was a theater actress in the movie, while in the show, she was a movie actress.
Émilie had blue eyes in the film, but in the show she has green eyes. Despite this, she is still displayed with green eyes on the painting in Gabriel's atelier, due to the asset being recycled from the show.
Her voice was lower than that of her show counterpart.
She met Gabriel for the first time as a child, while in the series, she met him as an adult.
Unlike her original counterpart she has been dead for 10 years, whereas in the series she was comatose for under a year.
Her original counterpart fell in a coma when the affliction of using the damaged Peacock Miraculous caught up with her, while a deleted scene of the movie states that the Miraculous "cursed her", leading to her death.
Unlike in the show, where she is stated to have "disappeared", in the movie, Adrien saw her pass away in her deathbed.

title: Émilie Agreste/History
text:
Émilie Agreste/History - Intro
Émilie Agreste was the late wife of the late Gabriel Agreste, the mother of Adrien Agreste, the twin sister of Amélie Graham de Vanily, the sister-in-law of the late Colt Fathom and the aunt of Félix Fathom. She was also a former aristocrat from a British noble family and an actress who played the lead in the film Solitude.

title: Émilie Agreste/History
text:
Émilie Agreste/History - Before [[Season 1]]
As revealed during "Representation", Émilie was born Lady Émilie Graham de Vanily, the daughter of the Duke and Duchess of Westchester-Munster, Emil and Milly Graham de Vanily, aristocrats in the British nobility. Her parents were originally expecting one child, a boy, to continue the family's legacy, but instead had her and her younger twin sister by seven seconds later, Amélie. Because of this fact, they handed the responsibilities of the family's future to Émilie; her father also gave her the Graham de Vanily Twin Rings. As Émilie and her sister grew up, they had opposite personalities; Émilie was described as curious, brazen, free-spirited, and adventurous. Despite the prestige of her status, she hated the limitations of the nobility life and tried to escape it at every chance in contrast to Amélie's quiet and obedient personality of wanting to please her parents and staying home doing whatever they wanted.

title: Émilie Agreste/History
text:
Émilie Agreste/History - Before [[Season 1]]
Worried about her rebellious behavior and lack of interest in the family name, her parents decided to send her overseas to Paris, France for her education and as a way for her to eventually fall in line. There, she met and fell in love with Gabi Grassette, who then was a humble tailor. Her parents were furious with their relationship as they didn't believe he was good enough for their daughter, but Émilie willingly renounced her title, rank, and wealth to be with him. Now that they were married, the one thing missing for them was a child. However, as Émilie was infertile, she and Gabriel had a hard time having a child; they even sought out her parents' help for medical attention, but nothing worked. During some time in her life, she became acquainted with the Bourgeois family, and Nathalie Sancoeur. Émilie, Gabriel, and Nathalie went on trips together and during one of their adventures, found the Peacock Miraculous, the Butterfly Miraculous, and the spellbook in Tibet.

title: Émilie Agreste/History
text:
Émilie Agreste/History - Before [[Season 1]]
As seen during the flashbacks in "Evolution", one night when Émilie and Gabriel were having a lovely picnic together in the Agreste mansion, and Gabriel gave her the damaged Peacock Miraculous and asked her if she was sure if she's ready to use it and Émilie told him yes and then Gabriel took her in a bridal carry where she hugged him.
Also revealed during "Representation", the couple finally became pregnant when Émilie used the Peacock Miraculous to create her son Adrien with her and Gabriel's emotions of love and placed his amok in the family rings. But because it was broken at the time, it slowly took its toll on Émilie, eventually putting her in a deep sleep coma. Her body was kept in a glass coffin in a respiratory.

title: Émilie Agreste/History
text:
Émilie Agreste/History - Before [[Season 1]]
Seeing how Gabriel became obsessed with finding the coveted Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses, Émilie recorded and left behind videos. Gabriel ordered Nathalie to destroy them but she still kept them. In those same videos, she wanted Gabriel to stop obsessing with bringing her back to life (she didn't want anyone to be sacrificed for her to be resurrected), move on and be happy after she's gone. Émilie also wanted Nathalie to take care of Adrien and convince Gabriel to stop chasing after the Miraculouses. Her wishes for Adrien were for him to be free, have control over his life, be able to make his own decisions, be protected, and more than anything, she just wanted him to be happy and create his own vision of happiness.

title: Émilie Agreste/History
text:
Émilie Agreste/History - [[Season 2]]
In "Style Queen", Émilie is seen in her glass coffin when Gabriel says that he is sorry that it took him some time. He then states that today he could feel that his prey (Audrey Bourgeois) had more malice in her than anyone he had ever akumatized before and that will be his masterpiece as placed some flowers on the glass coffin.
In "Queen Wasp", Émilie is seen in her glass coffin when Gabriel says that he doesn't want to break his promise, but he can't keep putting Adrien in danger, and that Style Queen, his masterpiece, had also failed. He then says that he feels that he's done all he could and will never Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous, and asks Émilie for her forgiveness as he renounces Nooroo. Émilie is then mentioned by Nadja Chamack that Gabriel Agreste appeared for the first time in public since Émilie disappeared. Later, Émilie is seen in her glass coffin when Gabriel says Ladybug and Cat Noir made a mistake, and that they'll make others, and that they'll eventually be together again.

title: Émilie Agreste/History
text:
Émilie Agreste/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Feast", Émilie is mentioned by Adrien that she used to have dizzy spells like what Natalie had, but Gabriel said like Émilie, Natalie's weren't serious. Later, after Plagg makes Adrien laugh by playing the piano, Adrien said that Émilie was the only other one that could make him laugh like that.
Later, Émilie is seen in her glass coffin when Gabriel says that now that he knows who the guardian of the Miraculous is, he plans on using this to get his revenge on Ladybug and Cat Noir.
In "Party Crasher", Émilie is seen in her glass coffin when Gabriel says they miss her so much, but thanks to his akumas, he'll soon take control of the Miraculous and use the Ultimate Power and reverse their mistake. Later, Adrien says that the old records that they used for the party were his mother's. Later, Émilie is seen in her glass coffin when Gabriel notices that the power goes out, and grows anxious when he notices that the power in Émilie's coffin went out as well, but is later relieved when Party Crasher restores the power in the repository and Émilie's coffin. Later, Émilie is seen in her glass coffin when Gabriel says that he'll soon lead Ladybug and Cat Noir in a "dance of doom."

title: Émilie Agreste/History
text:
Émilie Agreste/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Cat Blanc", Émilie is seen in her glass coffin when Gabriel says he misses her every moment, but that he get the Miraculous and bring her back to them.
Later, in an alternate timeline, during a fight with Ladybug and Cat Noir, after he learned that Adrien was Cat Noir, Hawk Moth revealed this knowledge to them, and revealed Émilie to them, saying that he was doing it to bring her back for them, revealing to them that he was Gabriel, and that he could bring her back if they surrendered their Miraculous to him. This causes Cat Noir to suffer so much that Hawk Moth akumatized him into Cat Blanc, but this backfires as Cat Blanc, heartbroken from not knowing whether to choose his mother or his girlfriend, and this causes him to destroy everything and everyone in Paris, as well as the moon, but later Ladybug erases all of these events from happening.

title: Émilie Agreste/History
text:
Émilie Agreste/History - [[Season 3]]
In "Félix", it's been a year since Émilie died. Émilie is seen in her glass coffin when Gabriel promises that Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous will be his and that they'll be together again. He then separated the Twin Rings and puts one on his ring finger and the other on Émilie's. Later, Adrien is seen in front of a statue of her in the garden. When Adrien says to Gabriel that if Nathalie makes Gabriel happy that she's already part of their family, Gabriel says that nobody could replace Émilie. When Amélie arrives, Adrien confuses her for Émilie. Amilie also said that Gabriel still has Émilie's rings, and says that the rings are from Émilie and Amilie's family, not Gabriel's. Later, when Félix crushes Plagg's cheese, he says to Adrien that he doesn't do that despite losing his mother before realizing that he went too far with what he said.
Later, Gabriel realizes that Félix stole his ring from right off of his hand, so he angrily goes down and takes Émilie's ring and puts it on.
In "Heart Hunter", Later, Émilie is seen in her glass coffin when Gabriel and Nathalie were collecting butterflys when Nathalie starts experiencing the side effects of using a damaged Miraculous.

text:
Émilie Agreste/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Revelation", In Lila Rossi's plan to get revenge on Gabriel, her as Hoaxer, has Nathalie reveal all of Gabriel's secrets to her. Among those secrets are photos of the Agreste and the Bourgeois families, Émilie, Gabriel, and Nathalie in Tibet, Émilie in the respiratory, and one of the family rings.
In "Collusion", Nathalie watches one of Émilie's videos. In another one of them, Émilie has revealed to have accept her fate but Gabriel couldn't. Among her wishes, she still wants Gabriel to let go and move on without her; the same for Adrien as she wants him to be happy (create his own vision of happiness) and for Nathalie to protect him.
In "Revolution", Émilie is mentioned by Gabriel and Adrien. As Adrien tearfully pleads with his father not to send him to London and to let him stay in Paris with Marinette and his friends, Gabriel falsely tells him it's what his mother would have wanted. title: Émilie Agreste/History
text:
Émilie Agreste/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Representation", Nathalie watches Emile's videos again, wanting for Adrien to be free, when Gabriel comes in, and Nathalie hides her phone. He demands to know where Adrien is after his escape and he takes back Émilie's ring, thinking she has something to do with it. Émilie's background is revealed by Félix and Kagami to Marinette.
In "Conformation", Inspired by watching Émilie's videos, Nathalie tries to stop Gabriel but is too weak and he takes her back to her room. Nathalie gives Ladybug Émilie's recordings, pleading with her to stop Monarch and warns her about the villain's plans before succumbing to her illness.

title: Émilie Agreste/History
text:
Émilie Agreste/History - [[Season 5]]
In "Re-creation", Taking their battle to the basement, Bug Noire discovers Émilie's comatose state and just how far Monarch's willing to sacrifice anyone for her and make his dreams come true. Bug Noire berates him for causing this amount of destruction as well as using her and Adrien as horrible excuses to justify his madness. After his defeat, Gabriel finally watches Émilie's videos. She didn't want anyone to be sacrificed for her to be brought back to life and for Gabriel, Nathalie, and Adrien to move on and be happy after she's gone. This made Gabriel realize the damage he caused around the world, especially for Adrien and for something that Émilie never wanted in the first place. He takes the Ladybug and Cat Miraculous and instead uses his wish to sacrifice himself for Nathalie and reunite with Émilie in the afterlife.

title: Émilie's cellphone
text:
Émilie's cellphone - Intro
is a smartphone Émilie Agreste used to own, prior to falling into her coma. She recorded messages for her husband on it and gave it to Nathalie Sancoeur.

title: Émilie's cellphone
text:
Émilie's cellphone - Appearance
Émilie's phone has a silver outline with a light grey cover at the back of the phone. It has a circular lens in the upper left back corner and a large circular power button.

title: Émilie's cellphone
text:
Émilie's cellphone - Features
This cellphone belonged to Émilie Agreste. In her last moments, she shot videos for her husband and Natalie, wishing that Gabriel would give up on his madness of getting the Ladybug and Cat Miraculouses, and instead take care of their son.

title: Émilie's cellphone
text:
Émilie's cellphone - Trivia
It seems to be an older model compared to the phones the other characters use.
Its battery is always at two bars and it has no reception.
Despite the latter, Nathalie successfully sent images to Cerise's cellphone when Hoaxer brainwashed her into sending her all of Gabriel's secrets.
It's possible, however, that this is related to Hoaxer's powers.
It's unknown if Adrien ever saw the videos his mother left behind.
In "Passion", it's revealed that Gabriel ordered Nathalie to delete Émilie's videos due to them being painful to him. However, Nathalie secretly disobeyed him and kept watching the videos in said episode, "Deflagration", "Collusion" and "Representation", and she eventually gave the phone to Ladybug in "Conformation" to use it to stop Gabriel in her last moments, which is exactly what the heroine does in "Re-creation" and what convinces Gabriel to redeem himself by saving Nathalie at the cost of his life.

title: Émilie Agreste/Re-Verse
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Émilie Agreste/Re-Verse - Intro
Émilie Agreste was a posthumous character of Miraculous World: Paris - Tales of Shadybug & Claw Noir. She was the wife of Gabriel Agreste and the mother of Adrien Agreste. She is an alternative version of Émilie Agreste from the Re-Verse.
In "Miraculous Paris", Betterfly reveals that she died after he stole the Butterfly and Peacock Miraculous from the Supreme.

title: Émilie Agreste/Re-Verse
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Émilie Agreste/Re-Verse - Appearance
Her hair looks the same just like her main counterpart and it's the same with her clothes, although they may be in a different color. It also seems like she is wearing eyeshadow.

title: Émilie Agreste/Re-Verse
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Émilie Agreste/Re-Verse - Abilities
The Peacock Miraculous granted her enhanced physical abilities, a hand fan as her tool, and Amokization as her superpower, allowing her to manifest emotions of herself or others into physical form to create sentimonsters.

title: Émilie Agreste/Re-Verse
categories: Members of Graham de Vanily family
text:
Émilie Agreste/Re-Verse - Trivia
It's unknown if this version of Émilie was infertile and used Amokization to create Adrien like her Quantic Counterpart, or if she is fertile and that she and Gabriel managed to have her son.
If the second option is true, that means the Agreste couple used the Peacock Miraculous for something else most likely so her sister Amélie could have a child too if she was infertile.
Émilie's death was the main motivation for her husband to stop using their Miraculous for evil and for him to become a superhero to bring hope to their universe.
It was also Adrien's main reason he became a supervillain and wanted to steal his good counterpart's and Ladybug's Miraculouses to revive her before being convinced to stop by Cat Noir.

title: Zoé Lee/Alternative Universe
text:
Zoé Lee/Alternative Universe - Intro
Zoé Lee is a character of "Miraculous Paris". She is an alternative version of Zoé Lee from an alternate universe, where she's the main holder of the Cat Miraculous instead of Adrien Agreste. When Plagg inhabits the Cat Miraculous, she transforms into Kitty Noire, a black cat-themed superhero who is the partner of Scarabella.

title: Zoé Lee/Alternative Universe
text:
Zoé Lee/Alternative Universe - Appearance
Physical Appearance
It's possible that her civilian outfit might be different from what her main counterpart has.
As Kitty Noire
As Kitty Noire, she has a hairstyle that somewhat resembles Cat Noir's, with a bob-length, spikier cut as compared to her civilian form, coupled with full, spiky bangs, and with green highlights starting around her temples and ending on the tips of her hair. She has cat-like eyes with yellow sclerae, dark orange irises, and slitted pupils and lips covered in a yellow-green lipstick and black cat ears on top of her head.

title: Zoé Lee/Alternative Universe
text:
Zoé Lee/Alternative Universe - Appearance
She wears a black compression shirt topped with a swan-necked cropped black jacket that ends around her mid-chest area with 3/4 length sleeves. Her jacket has green zippers around the shoulders and at the edges of the sleeves, and closes with two silver buttons on the front. On her lower body, she wears high-waisted capri pants with the same fabric as her jacket, with a golden button and green front pockets. She also wears green suspenders that go under her jacket and connected to the waistband of her pants, and a long, black ribbon on her lower back that ends around her ankles, simulating a cat's tail. On her feet, she wears green socks and black sneakers with a green sole and stripe on the back, and black cat-paws prints on the undersoles.
Kitty Noire also has black biker gloves on both of her hands, and sharp, black claw-like nails on her fingers. The jacket, the pants, and the gloves have a similar puple sheen to the fabric, and a leather-like texture. Her Miraculous sits on the ring finger of her right hand, and her weapon, the staff, was now black (as opposed to Cat Noir's and Lady Noire's, which were both silver), and rests retracted on her lower back when not in use.

title: Zoé Lee/Alternative Universe
text:
Zoé Lee/Alternative Universe - Abilities
As Kitty Noire
Kitty Noire has the same abilities as Cat Noir: enhanced skills like speed, agility, and strength, and near invulnerability to physical damage.
As Kitty Noire, she has the same abilities as regular holders of the Cat Miraculous. She utilizes her Staff efficiently for mobility, fighting and can spin it at a high speed to generate a gray-colored  shield to deflect attacks.
She also has the special power Cataclysm, which allows her to destroy any object she touches.

title: Zoé Lee/Alternative Universe
text:
Zoé Lee/Alternative Universe - History
Right after defeating Lollipop Boy, Scarabella reverses all the damage caused by the Sentimonster, successfully repairing the Eiffel Tower. Kitty Noire joins her, and they share a triumphant "Pound it!" fist-bump, just as a portal opened behind them, created by Monarch. Monarch suddenly kicks Kitty Noire aside and tosses Scarabella to the ground, attempting to steal her Miraculous. However, Ubiquity intervenes, delivering a punch to Monarch, causing him to stumble backward through the portal to Kitty's delight.

title: Zoé Lee/Alternative Universe
text:
Zoé Lee/Alternative Universe - Trivia
It's unknown if this version of Zoé has always been in Paris in her whole life or if she was once a residence in New York before moving to Paris like her Quantic Counterpart.
It is unclear whether this Zoé shares the same life as Adrien in the Quantic Universe, where her father, André, is Hawk Moth and Audrey is in a coma. She seems to have a life that is similar to her counterpart in that universe, except for not acquiring the Cat Miraculous. Alternatively, she may have a completely different life altogether.
This universe is likely the spin off of the times where Zoé used the Cat Miraculous temporarily in "Transmission" and "Deflagration".
This version of Zoé deals with an evil user of the Peacock Miraculous, while the original only dealt with a holder of the Butterfly.
It's possible this version of Zoé has feelings for her Scarabella, as her Quantic Counterpart had feelings for Marinette and flirted with the Quantic Scarabella in "Deflagration".

title: École militaire
text:
École militaire - Intro
The  is a military higher education institution located in the 7th arrondissement of Paris.

title: École militaire
text:
École militaire - Description
Built in the 18th century by the architect Ange-Jacques Gabriel at the request of Louis XV, the École militaire is a monumental complex in neoclassical style which closes the south-eastern perspective of the Champ de Mars and overlooks the Eiffel Tower.
The facade consists of a two-story plaza of Corinthian columns. It has a decorated pediment above which a dome with a clock and several sculptures has been erected.
Known for being the seat of studies of Emperor Napoleon I, this school today houses all military higher education organizations, including the Center des Hautes Etudes Military and Command Doctrine and Teaching Center.

title: École militaire
text:
École militaire - Trivia
The École militaire has been declared a Historic Monument since 1990.
This institution is the place of study where soldiers study to rise in rank.
Being the Brigade des Sapeurs-Pompiers de Paris (BSPP) a unit of the French army, it is therefore in this school that Hessenpy studied to rise through the ranks and reach the rank of Captain.

title: Émilie's cryogenic pod
text:
Émilie's cryogenic pod - Intro
was a glass coffin that contained Émilie Agreste's body to prevent it from decomposing. After Gabriel made the wish to reunite with his wife in the afterlife, the capsule became empty.
In "Miraculous London", the coffin was destroyed by Bug Noire's Cataclysm so Adrien doesn't find out that his father was Monarch.

title: Émilie's cryogenic pod
text:
Émilie's cryogenic pod - Appearance
The cryogenic pod was long and gray with a clear glass covering to protect Émilie and and additional retractable panels with a white and yellow butterfly pattern to hide her. It was also connected to several long gray outlets, and inside the capsule was a white bedded mattress.

title: Émilie's cryogenic pod
text:
Émilie's cryogenic pod - Features
The cryogenic pod was designed to continue Émilie's life support. It drew power from the mansion's vast energy supply, and as seen in "Party Crasher", the slightest power outage could result in the body's death. A backup battery system, indicated by diodes at the bottom of the capsule, gave Gabriel time to restore power. Also, as seen in "Cat Blanc" and "Risk", the coffin has a special button, marked by Félix's lens, which causes the panels to slide open and the contents to become visible.

title: Émilie's cryogenic pod
text:
Émilie's cryogenic pod - Trivia
In "Party Crasher", it was revealed that the Agreste mansion has energy equivalent to that of a nuclear power plant, so it can be assumed that Émilie Agreste's coffin uses a lot energy to keep her body in good condition.
It can also be assumed that the pipes visible under the hanging garden are power outlets.
As seen in "Conformation", the cryogenic pod's functions were activated by four switches; when they were turned off, a notification was triggered and the coffin glowed red. However, this was not shown in previous episodes, which could indicate an animation error or the addition of these buttons only in this episode.

title: Île de la Cité
text:
Île de la Cité - Intro
The  is an island located on the Seine, in the heart of Paris. It is considered the ancient cradle of Paris and there are many important monuments and buildings.

title: Île de la Cité
text:
Île de la Cité - Description
Notable buildings and places
Conciergerie
Notre-Dame de Paris
Square du Vert-Galant
Bridges
The Île de la Cité is connected to the rest of Paris by nine bridges over the Seine:
Left and right bank:
Pont Neuf
Right bank:
Pont au Change (Place du Châtelet)
Pont Notre-Dame
Pont d'Arcole (Place de l'Hôtel de Ville)
Left bank:
Pont Saint-Michel
Petit-Pont
Pont au Double
Pont de l'Archevêché
Île Saint-Louis:
Pont Saint-Louis

title: Île de la Cité
text:
Île de la Cité - Trivia
In the series, Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie and Collège Françoise Dupont are in front of the island.
In season 1, the two buildings were facing the southern coast of the island.
From season 2, the geography of Paris improved, and both buildings face the north shore.
In "Crocoduel", the Liberty is anchored in a dock on the northern shore of the island, directly in front of Collège Françoise Dupont.

title: Zoé's second room
text:
Zoé's second room - Intro
is the bedroom of Zoé Lee in Le Sorbonne.

title: Zoé's second room
text:
Zoé's second room - Appearance
The room is located under the roof of the Le Sorbonne building and its window is surrounded by a flowerbed.
The interior is quite simple, with red walls and a smooth yellow wooden floor. The room contains a yellow armchair and some furniture on which Zoé has arranged some movie-themed decorations. There's a large wall mirror and a beige rug. The photos also include some stylized images and maps of New York.
